papers.title: Perception Before Supervision: Self-Contained Visual Distillation from Counterfactual Blind Spots
papers.abstract_en: Self-improvement for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is typically driven by reward-based methods that provide only coarse scalar feedback. Distillation offers a richer alternative through dense token-level supervision, but in the visual domain it usually depends on privileged context constructed using external annotations and tools, or stronger models. We introduce \textbf{CVPD} (Contrastive Counterfactual Visual Process Distillation), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first fully self-contained framework for dense, on-policy, token-level visual self-distillation for MLLMs. CVPD identifies visual blind spots where zooming into a region changes and sharpens the model's answer distribution, while removing the same region leaves the full-image behavior largely unchanged. Such regions reveal perceptual information that the model can encode but fails to consistently utilize under full-image conditioning. We propose a three-gate Counterfactual Criterion that identifies these regions directly from the model's own responses and converts them into dense contrastive supervision for self-distillation. On Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, CVPD outperforms six self-evolving baselines across twelve benchmarks, including methods that rely on external GPT-4o supervision, without a single regression. It achieves gains of $+3.60$ on OCRBench, $+3.38$ on MMStar Fine-Grained Perception, and $+3.08$ on MMStar Logical Reasoning, while maintaining or improving performance on broader multimodal benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CVPD（Contrastive Counterfactual Visual Process Distillation），据称是首个完全自包含的 MLLM 密集、on-policy、token 级视觉自蒸馏框架。方法通过反事实盲点识别模型能编码但在全图条件下未能稳定利用的视觉区域，并将其转换为密集对比监督。在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 上，CVPD 在 12 个基准上超过 6 个自进化基线，包括依赖外部 GPT-4o 监督的方法，且无一次回归。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的自我改进通常依赖奖励方法，只提供粗粒度标量反馈；蒸馏能提供更丰富的密集 token 级监督，但在视觉领域往往依赖外部标注、工具或更强模型构建的特权上下文。
Method: CVPD 首先识别视觉盲点：放大某个区域会改变并锐化模型答案分布，而移除该区域后全图行为几乎不变。作者提出三门反事实标准（three-gate Counterfactual Criterion），直接从模型自身响应中识别这类区域，并将其转化为密集对比监督用于自蒸馏，全程不需要外部注释、工具或更强模型。
Result: 在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 上，CVPD 在 12 个基准上优于 6 个自进化基线，包括依赖外部 GPT-4o 监督的方法，且没有出现任何回归；具体提升为 OCRBench +3.60、MMStar 细粒度感知 +3.38、MMStar 逻辑推理 +3.08，同时维持或改善更广泛的多模态基准表现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CVPD 是首个完全自包含的 MLLM 视觉自蒸馏框架，能够在不依赖外部监督的情况下从模型自身响应中提取密集 token 级视觉监督。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Naturalness: Probing Automated Text-To-Speech Evaluators on Linguistically Grounded Dimensions
papers.abstract_en: Automated Text-to-Speech (TTS) evaluation methods (Mean Opinion Score (MOS) predictors and Audio Large Language Models (Audio-LLM) judges) are expected to reflect human perception, yet it is unclear how well they capture the distinct aspects of speech that listeners actually perceive. We deconstruct "naturalness" into a linguistically grounded annotation schema spanning 10 distinct perceptual dimensions, and use it to construct the first dimension-level meta-evaluation benchmark for TTS, comprising 860 utterances annotated by trained linguist raters. Results from benchmarking four MOS predictors and four Audio-LLM judges reveal that MOS predictors collapse onto acoustic signal quality, while Audio-LLM judges show selective, prompt-dependent detection that does not generalise across all dimensions. Neither class reliably captures a breadth of linguistically structured speech errors. Our dataset, annotation schema, and evaluation code are publicly released to support more targeted and interpretable TTS evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动 TTS 评估方法（MOS 预测器与 Audio-LLM 评判器）是否真正反映人类语音感知的问题，将“自然度”解构为包含 10 个感知维度的语言学标注框架，并构建了首个维度级 TTS 元评估基准，包含由训练有素的语言学家标注的 860 条语音。对 4 个 MOS 预测器和 4 个 Audio-LLM 评判器的评测显示，MOS 预测器仅反映声学信号质量，Audio-LLM 评判器则呈现选择性、依赖提示词的检测能力，且无法跨维度泛化。
Motivation: 自动 TTS 评估方法被认为应反映人类感知，但目前尚不清楚它们能在多大程度上捕捉听者实际感知到的不同语音维度。
Method: 将“自然度”解构成一个包含 10 个感知维度的语言学标注模式，据此构建维度级 TTS 元评估基准，并由受过训练的语言学家对 860 条话语进行标注；随后基准测试 4 个 MOS 预测器和 4 个 Audio-LLM 评判器。
Result: MOS 预测器被发现在评估中坍缩为声学信号质量，而 Audio-LLM 评判器表现出选择性、依赖提示词的检测能力，无法推广到所有维度；两类方法都不能可靠地捕捉广泛的语言学结构化语音错误。
Conclusion: 作者公开了数据集、标注模式和评估代码，以支持更有针对性和可解释的 TTS 评估。

papers.title: Multimodal Model Diffing for Feature Discovery and Control
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) exhibit strong visual understanding, yet the internal features that cause these behaviors remain difficult to identify, audit, or control. While applicable to post-hoc inspection, hidden states that are decomposed into interpretable feature directions using sparse autoencoders (SAEs) neither readily isolate which features are changed by multimodal training, nor are they directly useful for targeted control. We introduce MMDiff, a multimodal model-diffing framework that trains multimodal SAEs and turns them into feature-level interfaces for discovering and controlling multimodal behavior. MMDiff supports three uses: (i) feature isolation, by diffing a base-LM SAE against its multimodal-adapted counterpart to identify features altered by multimodal training; (ii) task-specific feature detection, via per-token contrastive firing analysis that isolates causal features; and (iii) feature-level control, by causally removing or steering the discovered feature directions. We train multimodal SAEs for three MLLM families, LLaVA-MORE, PaliGemma 2, and InternVL3.5, and evaluate on visual-spatial understanding, multimodal safety, and OCR. MMDiff discovers sparse, causally specific features whose removal selectively degrades target behaviors by an average of 12% on spatial tasks and 17% on OCR, and reduces attack success rate by 24% on multimodal safety attacks, with no impact on VQA performance. Steering these features improves spatial and OCR accuracy by +3.6% and +1.8% on average over a standard single-layer steering baseline. These results show that multimodal SAEs can serve not only as interpretability tools, but as mechanisms for auditing, steering, and controlling MLLMs behavior toward safer and more capable generations.
papers.comment: Preprint. Accepted at ICML 2026 Trustworthy AI for Good Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MMDiff，一种多模态模型差分 (multimodal model-diffing) 框架，通过训练多模态稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 并将其转化为特征级接口，用于发现和控制多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的行为。MMDiff 支持三类用途：对基础 LM SAE 与其多模态版本做差分以隔离被多模态训练改变的特征、通过逐 token 对比激发分析检测任务特定因果特征、以及通过因果移除或引导特征进行控制。作者在 LLaVA-MORE、PaliGemma 2 和 InternVL3.5 上训练多模态 SAE，并在视觉空间理解、多模态安全性和 OCR 上评估，结果显示删除稀疏因果特征会选择性降低目标行为并降低攻击成功率，而引导特征能提升空间与 OCR 准确率。
Motivation: MLLM 表现出很强的视觉理解能力，但其内部导致这些行为的特征难以被识别、审计或控制。已有的稀疏自编码器 (sparse autoencoders, SAEs) 分解出的隐藏状态特征方向既不能直接隔离哪些特征被多模态训练改变，也难以直接用于目标控制。
Method: MMDiff 训练多模态 SAEs，并将其转化为特征级接口。它支持三种用法：(i) 特征隔离，通过比较基础 LM SAE 与多模态适应后的对应版本，找出被多模态训练改变的特征；(ii) 任务特定特征检测，通过逐 token 对比激发分析 (per-token contrastive firing analysis) 隔离因果特征；(iii) 特征级控制，通过因果移除或引导已发现的特征方向来干预模型行为。
Result: 摘要报告：删除发现的稀疏因果特征后，空间任务平均性能下降 12%、OCR 下降 17%，多模态安全攻击的攻击成功率降低 24%，且对 VQA 性能无影响。引导这些特征相对标准单层引导基线 (single-layer steering baseline) 平均提升空间准确率 +3.6%、OCR 准确率 +1.8%。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果表明多模态 SAEs 不仅可以作为可解释性工具，还可以作为审计、引导和控制 MLLM 行为的机制，从而推动更安全、更强能力的生成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning How the World Evolves: Extrapolative Video World Models via Latent Dynamics Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: The world evolves following its dynamics, i.e., its laws of motion. However, leading video diffusion models largely fit the pixels without modeling how the pixels transit over time. Thus, they render visually plausible frames but may not accurately obey the laws. To capture the dynamics purely from pixels, we introduce Latent Dynamics Reasoning (LDR). LDR casts the latent transition as an explicit kinematic integration, where the lower-order dynamics are integrated numerically and the model regresses only the third- and higher-order residual that drives the rollout. For this integration to extrapolate better, LDR runs it on a structured latent rather than dense convolutional features. Following PhyWorld, we validate LDR on a controlled white-box physics benchmark spanning five tasks (uniform motion, parabola, collision, bouncing, looming), focusing on out-of-distribution scenarios that reveal whether a model has truly learned the underlying dynamics. LDR extrapolates the learned dynamics far better: the gap between its in- and out-of-distribution error is over 20$\times$ smaller than the video diffusion baseline's, under both single- and joint-task training at 256$^2$ resolution, while using 26$\times$ fewer parameters and running 143$\times$ faster. LDR can even generalize under severe shift: for example, trained only on red balls moving left-to-right, it correctly predicts the motion of a blue square moving right-to-left. To our knowledge, this is the first video world model that extrapolates learned dynamics beyond its training distribution. Project page: https://lat-dyn-reason.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent Dynamics Reasoning (LDR)，将视频世界模型中的隐状态转移建模为显式运动学积分：低阶动力学被数值积分，模型只回归三阶及以上的残差来驱动 rollout，并在结构化隐空间而非密集卷积特征上运行。在 PhyWorld 白盒物理基准的五个任务（匀速运动、抛物线、碰撞、弹跳、逼近）上，LDR 的分布外外推显著优于视频扩散基线，256^2 分辨率下其分布内/分布外误差差距比基线小 20 倍以上，同时参数量少 26 倍、速度快 143 倍。
Motivation: 现有领先的视频扩散模型主要拟合像素，而没有显式建模像素随时间转移的规律，因此能生成视觉上合理的帧，却不一定准确遵守运动定律。作者希望仅从像素出发捕捉动力学，并验证模型是否真正学到潜在动力学而非过拟合训练分布。
Method: LDR 将隐状态转移建模为显式运动学积分（kinematic integration）：低阶动力学通过数值方式积分，模型只回归驱动 rollout 的三阶及以上残差；为使积分外推更好，LDR 在结构化隐空间而非密集卷积特征上运行。
Result: 在 PhyWorld 白盒物理基准上，单任务与联合任务训练下，LDR 的分布内外误差差距比视频扩散基线小 20 倍以上，且使用 26 倍更少的参数、推理快 143 倍。LDR 还能在严重分布偏移下泛化，例如只用红球从左到右运动训练后，能正确预测蓝方块从右到左运动。
Conclusion: 作者称这是首个能在训练分布之外外推所学动力学的视频世界模型；验证场景为受控白盒物理基准，突出外推能力而非真实世界视频预测。
Relevance: 65

papers.title: From Values to Benchmarks: Evaluating Large Language Models for Governmental Use in Dutch
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly being deployed in governmental settings, yet few existing evaluation frameworks jointly reflect the values of public administration and the linguistic requirements of non-English contexts. We present the "Grip on LLMs" framework, a systematic evaluation suite for Dutch governmental use developed in collaboration with domain experts from a major Dutch municipal organisation. Through an advisory board process, user research, and a survey of the users of a civil-servant chatbot, we identify six evaluation dimensions (factuality, honesty, social bias, energy consumption, cost, and training data transparency) and operationalise them into a benchmark suite covering more than 30 multilingual and Dutch-specific models. Our results reveal that no single model excels across all dimensions, and that trade-offs are unavoidable: higher quality consistently comes at greater environmental impact and financial cost, while bias remains largely independent of both. We further find that factuality (whether a model answers correctly) and honesty (whether a model acknowledges what it does not know) are governed by distinct properties, with high factuality not implying high honesty. To make these findings actionable for non-technical audiences, we release a publicly accessible, user-friendly model overview designed for the full range of stakeholders involved in governmental LLM selection, from engineers to policymakers.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: GENCO - A Unified Neural Solver Embedded in a Development Framework for Steady-State Grid Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are transforming business workflows and boosting productivity, yet they remain largely absent from engineering domains such as power system analysis, where strict physical consistency must be enforced. We present GENCO (GEometric Neural Corrective Optimizer), a unified neural solver for steady-state transmission grid analysis that handles power flow (PF), optimal power flow (OPF), and state estimation (SE) within a single architecture and shared network representation. To support advances in neural power system solvers, we introduce the open-source GridFM Development Framework, which standardizes synthetic data generation and training in a low-code environment. We also release large-scale datasets with millions of PF and OPF scenarios across diverse grid topologies to support reproducible benchmarking. We evaluate GENCO on the PFDelta and OPFData benchmarks against state-of-the-art neural solvers and classical solvers, including Newton-Raphson and IPOPT, as well as on real-world Hydro-Québec SCADA data. For large-scale PF, GENCO recovers the full AC operating state, including voltage magnitudes and reactive power that DC-PF cannot provide, while matching DC-PF-level active power-balance residuals. It achieves up to 30x speedups over Newton-Raphson at only 2x the runtime of DC-PF. For OPF, it achieves up to 85x speedups over IPOPT while improving feasibility, optimality, and runtime over DC-OPF. For SE, GENCO is more robust than classical weighted least squares to noisy measurements and network parameter errors, and always returns a high-quality estimate even when weighted least squares fails to converge. Together, the unified architecture and development framework provide a new approach to large-scale steady-state grid analysis, lowering the barrier to entry for power system engineers and marking a step toward Grid Foundation Models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GENCO（GEometric Neural Corrective Optimizer），一个针对稳态输电网分析（power flow, PF；optimal power flow, OPF；state estimation, SE）的统一神经求解器，采用单一架构和共享网络表示。作者同时发布开源的 GridFM Development Framework 以及包含数百万 PF/OPF 场景的大规模数据集，用于可复现基准测试。在 PFDelta 与 OPFData 基准以及 Hydro-Québec 真实 SCADA 数据上，GENCO 在计算速度、可行性、最优性和鲁棒性上相对经典求解器（Newton-Raphson、IPOPT）和 DC-PF/DC-OPF 均有显著提升。
Motivation: 基础模型已广泛改变业务流程，但在电力系统分析等工程领域仍几乎缺席，因为这些领域需要严格的物理一致性约束。本文旨在提供一个统一的神经求解器并配套开发框架，降低电力系统工程师使用神经求解器的门槛。
Method: 提出 GENCO 统一架构，同时处理 PF、OPF 和 SE 三类稳态电网分析任务，并引入 GridFM Development Framework 以低代码方式标准化合成数据生成与训练流程；还发布大规模跨拓扑数据集支持可复现评估。
Result: 大规模 PF 中，GENCO 可恢复完整 AC 运行状态（包括 DC-PF 无法提供的电压幅值和无功功率），同时匹配 DC-PF 级别的有功功率平衡残差；相比 Newton-Raphson 最高加速 30 倍，运行时间仅为 DC-PF 的 2 倍。OPF 中相比 IPOPT 最高加速 85 倍，并在可行性、最优性和运行时间上优于 DC-OPF。SE 中相对经典加权最小二乘（weighted least squares）对噪声测量和网络参数误差更鲁棒，且在 WLS 不收敛时仍能返回高质量估计。
Conclusion: 作者认为统一架构与开发框架为大规模稳态电网分析提供了新路径，可降低电力系统工程人员的进入门槛，并向 Grid Foundation Models 迈进一步。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Overcoming Data Scarcity and Confidentiality in Hardware Assurance via Synthetic Generation
papers.abstract_en: Hardware assurance relies on scanning electron microscopy (SEM) to verify nanoscale structures, but assembling the large, high-quality datasets required for automated analysis is impeded by time-intensive acquisition and strict intellectual property (IP) constraints on proprietary designs. We propose a privacy-preserving pipeline that secures IP by heavily distorting the functional design while generating a visually realistic synthetic dataset from a small set of initial examples. A StyleGAN first learns the distribution of hardware layout masks to generate novel, macroscopically varied structures. Subsequently, a conditional GAN (Pix2PixHD) translates these masks into realistic SEM images that preserve authentic textures and noise. The primary finding of this work is that a segmentation model trained exclusively on this synthetic data not only demonstrates a successful "sim-to-real" transfer to real images but also outperforms a baseline model trained on the limited real dataset. Because the underlying synthetic layouts are demonstrably novel and reproduce none of the specific proprietary routing of the original design, deploying the final segmentation model mitigates the risk of exposing sensitive IP to attacks like gradient inversion and membership inference, providing a highly secure, high-performance solution for hardware assurance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对硬件保障（hardware assurance）中 SEM 图像数据集难以大规模构建且受知识产权（IP）约束的问题，提出一个隐私保护的合成数据流水线。先用 StyleGAN 学习硬件布局掩码的分布以生成新颖多样结构，再用条件 GAN（Pix2PixHD）将掩码转换为逼真的 SEM 图像。作者报告仅用合成数据训练的分割模型能成功迁移到真实图像，并优于在有限真实数据上训练的基线模型，同时避免泄露专有布线信息。
Motivation: 自动化硬件保障分析需要大量高质量 SEM 图像，但图像采集耗时且专有设计受 IP 约束，导致数据稀缺与保密性难以兼顾。
Method: 提出两阶段隐私保护合成流水线：StyleGAN 学习硬件布局掩码分布以生成宏观上多样且不复制原设计的新颖结构，Pix2PixHD 条件 GAN 将这些掩码转换为保留真实纹理和噪声的 SEM 图像，随后仅用该合成数据训练分割模型。
Result: 摘要报告，仅用合成数据训练的分割模型成功实现 sim-to-real 迁移，性能超过在有限真实数据集上训练的基线模型；合成布局被证明是新奇的，不复现原始设计的具体专有布线。
Conclusion: 作者认为该流水线既缓解了数据稀缺问题，又通过可论证新颖的合成布局降低梯度反演和成员推理等攻击导致 IP 泄露的风险，为硬件保障提供高安全性且高性能的解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Hazard Resemblance: Contrastive Event Adjudication for Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Video anomaly detection (VAD) aims to identify and temporally localize abnormal events in videos. Supervised methods learn anomaly decision boundaries from target-domain annotations but require substantial in-domain data. Existing training-free methods leverage the rich semantic knowledge and reasoning capabilities of pretrained models to interpret visual content, yet these capabilities do not directly define an anomaly decision criterion: richer anomaly descriptions better capture hazard resemblance without resolving abnormality. To this end, we propose Contrastive Event Adjudication for training-free Video Anomaly Detection (CEAVAD), which shifts the unit of inference from isolated anomaly concepts to falsifiable event hypotheses and establishes an inference-time explanatory boundary through the interaction between competing explanations and video evidence. Specifically, CEAVAD first uses public-safety knowledge to construct hazard-benign event contrasts, pairing each hazard mechanism with a generic normal account and a mechanism-specific benign counterpart. It then determines whether the target interval better supports a hazard explanation or its benign competitor, yielding a revisable contrastive boundary proposal for the target. Finally, CEAVAD adjudicates between the competing explanations to determine whether the hazard hypothesis survives the video evidence, supporting both temporally localized anomaly detection and evidence-grounded explanations. Experiments on three widely used VAD benchmarks demonstrate that CEAVAD achieves state-of-the-art performance under the training-free paradigm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无训练视频异常检测（VAD）提出对比事件裁定方法 CEAVAD，将推理单元从孤立的异常概念转为可证伪的事件假设，通过竞争性解释与视频证据的交互建立推理时的可解释边界。作者利用公共安全知识构建危险-良性事件对比，裁定目标片段更支持危险解释还是良性竞争解释，从而支持时间定位异常检测并给出基于证据的解释。在三个常用 VAD 基准上，CEAVAD 达到无训练范式下的最优性能。
Motivation: 现有无训练方法依赖预训练模型的语义知识与推理能力，但这些能力本身并不直接构成异常判定准则：更丰富的异常描述只是更好地捕捉危险相似性（hazard resemblance），并未真正解决异常性的判定问题。
Method: CEAVAD 首先使用公共安全知识构造危险-良性事件对比（hazard-benign event contrasts），将每个危险机制与一个通用正常描述及一个机制特定的良性对应配对；然后判断目标区间更支持危险解释还是良性竞争者，形成可修正的对比边界；最后在竞争解释之间裁定危险假设是否能通过视频证据，并支持时间定位检测与证据 grounded 解释。
Result: 在三个广泛使用的 VAD 基准上，摘要报告 CEAVAD 在无训练范式下取得了最先进的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将推理单元转换为可证伪的事件假设可以建立推理时的解释性边界，使异常判定不再停留在语义相似性层面，并兼顾时间定位与证据支撑的解释。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DistMoE: Private-data Rehearsal-free Routing in Mixture-of-Experts for Distributed Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong multimodal instruction-following ability, but adapting them to diverse visual-language domains typically assumes centralized data access and costly joint training. This is restrictive when data is distributed across private, domain-specific, or permission-limited clients. To this end, we propose DistMoE, a mixture-of-experts (MoE) approach for distributed visual instruction tuning. In each layer of the language decoder it augments the public feedforward network (FFN) with a client-specific private FFN expert, with the goal to acquire domain-specific knowledge. However, independent expert training causes the private FFNs to learn representation of different scale and magnitudes, making merging the experts difficult. To reduce client-specific drift, we introduce a public-anchored expert composition stage that updates only routers and lightweight private projection adapters on a mix of local client data and public data, via an isotropic regularization loss, therefore making it cross-client rehearsal-free composition. During inference, DistMoE performs modular routing over public and private experts, enabling token-wise domain composition without explicit domain labels. Experiments across diverse visual-language benchmarks show that DistMoE enables flexible expert reuse, effective domain adaptation, and competitive performance while preserving modular control over client-specific knowledge. Codes are available at https://github.com/mainaksingha01/DistMoE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DistMoE，一种面向分布式视觉指令微调 (distributed visual instruction tuning) 的混合专家 (mixture-of-experts) 方法。它在语言解码器的每一层用客户端特定的私有 FFN 专家增强公共 FFN，以获取领域特定知识；通过公共锚定的专家组合阶段减少客户端漂移，实现跨客户端无重放组合 (rehearsal-free composition)。推理时对公共与私有专家进行模块化路由，无需显式领域标签即可完成词元级领域组合。实验表明该方法支持灵活专家复用和有效领域适配。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 的领域适配通常假设集中式数据访问和昂贵的联合训练，但在数据分散于私有、领域特定或权限受限客户端时受到限制。
Method: 在解码器每层为公共 FFN 增加客户端特定的私有 FFN 专家；针对私有 FFN 因独立训练产生尺度与量级漂移、难以合并的问题，引入公共锚定的专家组合阶段，仅更新路由器和轻量私有投影适配器，并在本地客户端数据与公共数据混合上使用各向同性正则化损失 (isotropic regularization loss)，实现跨客户端无重放组合。

Conclusion: 作者强调 DistMoE 能够在分布式私有数据场景下实现无重放的跨客户端专家组合，并在推理时维持对客户端知识的模块化控制。

papers.title: DSLE: A Learning Environment for Dark Souls Boss Encounters
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Dark Souls Learning Environment (DSLE), a containerized platform that presents all 22 boss encounters of Dark Souls: Remastered as game-playing agent benchmarks through a Gymnasium-style interface. DSLE combines real-time combat, high-dimensional visual input, and sparse terminal rewards, with each environment step being a real action executed against the running game. To support controlled comparison, we define DSLE-5, a representative five-boss subset, spanning a melee fight, a spatially constrained arena, an environmental-hazard fight, a multi-target fight, and a fast final-boss fight, that we recommend as the starting suite for agents built on DSLE. On DSLE-5 we evaluate a random policy, an expert system, an evolutionary baseline, and PPO and DQN agents trained from visual input. The expert system and the evolutionary baseline each defeat the Asylum Demon, the game's tutorial boss (63% and 43% peak win rates), but none of the five methods defeats the other four DSLE-5 bosses; PPO and DQN show no measurable learning (at most 0.33% win rate on the tutorial boss, 0% elsewhere) within a budget that already costs tens of wall-clock hours per run. A broader study running the evolutionary baseline across all 22 encounters under advantaged all level-50 stats yields wins on only a handful of additional early-game bosses and leaves the rest unwon. The failure cases range from sub-10-second deaths in cramped, multi-target encounters to minute-long stalemates that inflict almost no damage, and we report them through survival time and damage dealt rather than win rate alone.
papers.comment: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Interactive Digital Entertainment, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dark Souls Learning Environment (DSLE)，一个容器化平台，通过 Gymnasium 风格接口将《黑暗之魂：重制版》全部 22 场 Boss 战呈现为游戏代理基准，每一步都是对运行中游戏执行的真实动作。作者定义了由五个代表性 Boss 组成的 DSLE-5 子集，并评估了随机策略、专家系统、进化基线以及基于视觉输入的 PPO 和 DQN。结果显示专家系统和进化基线分别以 63% 和 43% 的峰值胜率击败教程 Boss Asylum Demon，但没有任何方法能击败其余四个 Boss；PPO 和 DQN 几乎无学习迹象，且该基准下多数失败需通过生存时间和造成伤害来刻画。
Motivation: 现有游戏学习环境缺少同时具备实时战斗、高维视觉输入和稀疏终端奖励的严格基准，而《黑暗之魂》的 Boss 战正好具备这些特性，可用于检验当前强化学习代理在困难实时任务中的能力。
Method: 构建容器化 DSLE 平台，把全部 22 场 Boss 战封装为 Gymnasium 风格环境，并推荐 DSLE-5 作为起始测试套件，覆盖近战、空间受限竞技场、环境危害、多目标和快速终局 Boss 等场景；随后用随机策略、专家系统、进化基线和视觉输入的 PPO/DQN 进行受控对比评估。
Result: 在 DSLE-5 上，专家系统和进化基线分别取得 63% 和 43% 的 Asylum Demon 峰值胜率，但均无法击败其余四个 Boss；PPO 和 DQN 最多只有 0.33% 的胜率，其余为零。在全部 22 场 Boss 战中使用全 50 级优势属性的进化基线也只额外赢下少量早期 Boss，失败模式包括数秒内死亡和长达一分钟的几乎无伤害僵局。
Conclusion: 作者认为 DSLE 对现有方法极具挑战，并强调单靠胜率不足以刻画失败，需同时报告生存时间和造成伤害；该环境可作为未来游戏代理研究的一个公开发布基准。

papers.title: Fairness in Link Prediction Beyond Demographic Parity: A Reproducibility Study
papers.abstract_en: In fair ranked link prediction, demographic parity ($Δ_\mathrm{DP}$) is a common fairness metric. Yet, Mattos et al. (2025) argue that it fails to detect exposure bias because it ignores where links appear in the ranking. In this study, we reproduce this claim by showing that $Δ_\mathrm{DP}$ can indicate aggregate parity even when some subgroup-pair links are systematically ranked lower than others. The proposed rank-aware Normalized Discounted KL-divergence (NDKL), however, does detect such disparities. We also reproduce the effectiveness of MORAL, a post-processing method that improves exposure-based fairness while maintaining competitive utility. Beyond reproduction, we assess robustness using synthetic homophily settings, categorical sensitive attributes, and additional fairness and utility metrics, including subgroup-pair-adapted Attention-Weighted Rank Fairness (AWRF). Overall, our results show that exposure-based metrics uncover biases hidden by $Δ_\mathrm{DP}$ and that MORAL reduces these biases with minimal utility loss across diverse settings and datasets. We release a corrected, reproducible implementation at https://github.com/Floris93100/reproducing-MORAL.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (05/2026)
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对公平排名链接预测（fair ranked link prediction）中曝光偏差（exposure bias）可检测性的复现研究。作者复现了 Mattos et al. (2025) 的主张：人口统计均等指标 Δ_DP 只关注链接是否出现在排名中而忽略其位置，因此即使某些子群对之间的链接被系统性地排得更低，Δ_DP 仍可能显示总体均等；而排名感知的 Normalized Discounted KL-divergence (NDKL) 能检测到这类不均衡。研究还复现了 MORAL 后处理方法，并额外评估了合成同质性设置、类别敏感属性以及 Attention-Weighted Rank Fairness (AWRF) 等指标。
Motivation: Δ_DP 是公平排名链接预测中常用的公平性指标，但现有工作指出它可能掩盖排名位置造成的曝光偏差；该偏差影响实际推荐结果而非仅链接是否出现，因此需要验证并推广更敏感的评价指标和后处理方法。
Method: 采用复现研究的方式，构造能同时满足总体均等却存在系统性排序差异的情形，对比 Δ_DP 与 NDKL 的检测能力；随后复现 MORAL 这一后处理方法的公平性提升效果，并在合成同质性设置、类别敏感属性以及包含 AWRF 在内的额外公平性与效用指标下进行稳健性检验。
Result: 结果表明，基于曝光的指标能够揭示被 Δ_DP 隐藏的排名不均衡；MORAL 在多种设置与数据集上以极小的效用损失降低这类偏差。
Conclusion: 作者强调曝光感知指标在公平排名链接预测中的必要性，并发布了修正且可复现的实现代码，供后续研究使用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Consilience for Verifier-Free Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling often uses an external verifier, such as compilers and test cases in coding or trained value functions in robotics applications, to obtain high-quality rollouts. Verifier-free test-time scaling (or VF-TTS) is gaining extensive attention as a mechanism to enhance Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning, primarily because we do not have access to such high-quality verifiers in many real-world applications. Among existing VF-TTS methods, confidence-based VF-TTS methods, which compute and rank rollouts solely by confidence, are particularly promising. Such methods introduce near-zero overhead for sample evaluation and require minimal access to internal model states, making the methods highly flexible across models and tasks. In this paper, we demonstrate a critical limitation of existing confidence-based VF-TTS methods by showing that such methods catastrophically break down on complex tasks. We observe a very interesting phenomenon: uniformly high confidence frequently indicates a failure to explore, favoring confidently wrong answers. To address this, our core insight is that robust cognitive search requires a specific confidence trajectory pattern: such methods perform exploratory branching at the beginning, as manifested by low initial confidence, and converge to a high final confidence solution. To implement this insight, we introduce consilience, a novel selection framework that explicitly evaluates the temporal asymmetry of confidence in reasoning. We operationalize this via a combinatorial metric that actively penalizes high initial confidence while strictly demanding final certainty. Extensive experiments covering both graduate-level mathematics problems and free-form code generation demonstrate that consilience effectively outperforms existing baselines, validating our novel perspective on completion confidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无需验证器的测试时扩展（verifier-free test-time scaling, VF-TTS），指出现有基于置信度（confidence-based）的 VF-TTS 方法在复杂任务上会灾难性失效：均匀的高置信度往往反映模型未充分探索，并偏向于自信但错误的答案。作者提出 consilience 选择框架，通过显式评估推理过程中置信度的时间不对称性，即惩罚过高的初始置信度并严格要求最终置信度高，来改进 rollout 选择。实验覆盖研究生级数学问题和自由形式代码生成，显示该方法优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现实应用中常缺乏高质量外部验证器（如编译器、测试用例或训练好的价值函数），因此 VF-TTS 受到关注；其中仅凭置信度排序 rollout 的方法开销低、对模型内部状态要求少，但论文指出这类方法在复杂任务上会灾难性地失效，因为一致的高置信度往往意味着探索不足并偏向自信的错误答案。
Method: 提出 consilience 选择框架，核心是显式评估推理中置信度的时间不对称性（temporal asymmetry of confidence），并通过一个组合度量（combinatorial metric）实现：一方面主动惩罚高初始置信度，另一方面严格要求最终结果具有高确定性，从而鼓励先探索分支、后收敛到高置信解的过程。
Result: 在研究生级数学问题和自由形式代码生成上的广泛实验表明，consilience 有效优于现有 VF-TTS 基线，验证了关于完成置信度（completion confidence）的新视角。
Conclusion: 摘要强调稳健的认知搜索需要特定的置信度轨迹模式：初期低置信度以支持探索性分支，最终收敛到高置信度解；consilience 框架通过惩罚初始高置信并严格要求最终确定性来实现这一点。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fusion Training for Mathematical Generalization in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Thinking Mode Fusion (TMF) enables large language models to support both concise responses and long-form reasoning by unifying a non-thinking mode and a thinking mode within a single model. However, its training dynamics, including the \emph{data ratio} and \emph{training schedule} between the two modes, remain underexplored. In this work, we present a systematic study of TMF by analyzing the effects of the training schedule and data ratio between thinking and non-thinking modes. Focusing on mathematical problem solving, we construct a benchmark with multiple thinking-to-non-thinking data ratios and three training schedules. Our results reveal an asymmetric interaction between the two modes: increasing the ratio of non-thinking supervision reduces the accuracy of the thinking mode. We further show that different training schedules modulate this trade-off and that the optimal schedule depends on the data ratio. Finally, we quantify a negative correlation between non-thinking and thinking mode supervision, highlighting an inherent tension between these two modes. These findings provide practical guidance for designing effective TMF training settings. All code and data are released to support further research at: \href{https://github.com/caocongfeng/Fusion-Bench.git}{\textbf{Fusion Bench}}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究大语言模型中 Thinking Mode Fusion (TMF) 的训练动态，即如何在同一模型内统一非思考模式与思考模式，并聚焦数学问题求解。作者通过构造多个思考/非思考数据比率和三种训练计划，分析两种模式间的交互，发现非思考监督比例上升会降低思考模式准确性，并量化了二者之间的负相关。文章为设计有效的 TMF 训练设置提供实用指导，并发布代码与数据集 Fusion Bench。
Motivation: TMF 能在单一模型中同时支持简洁回答与长链推理，但其训练动态——尤其是思考与非思考两类数据之间的数据比率和训练计划——尚未被充分探索，缺乏系统性研究。
Method: 构建数学问题求解基准 Fusion Bench，设置多种思考到非思考的数据比率以及三种训练计划，对 TMF 的训练调度和数据配比进行系统分析和对比。
Result: 结果显示两种模式之间存在不对称交互：提高非思考监督比例会降低思考模式的准确性；不同训练计划会调节这一权衡，且最优计划依赖于数据比率；作者还量化出非思考模式与思考模式监督之间存在负相关。
Conclusion: 摘要强调思考与非思考模式之间存在内在张力，并提供关于如何设计 TMF 训练设置的实用指导；代码和数据已开源以支持后续研究。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文系统研究大语言模型中 Thinking Mode Fusion (TMF) 的训练动态，即如何在同一模型内统一非思考模式与思考模式，并聚焦数学问题求解。作者通过构造多个思考/非思考数据比率和三种训练计划，分析两种模式间的交互，发现非思考监督比例上升会降低思考模式准确性，并量化了二者之间的负相关。文章为设计有效的 TMF 训练设置提供实用指导，并发布代码与数据集 Fusion Bench。
summary_sections.motivation: TMF 能在单一模型中同时支持简洁回答与长链推理，但其训练动态——尤其是思考与非思考两类数据之间的数据比率和训练计划——尚未被充分探索，缺乏系统性研究。
summary_sections.method: 构建数学问题求解基准 Fusion Bench，设置多种思考到非思考的数据比率以及三种训练计划，对 TMF 的训练调度和数据配比进行系统分析和对比。
summary_sections.result: 结果显示两种模式之间存在不对称交互：提高非思考监督比例会降低思考模式的准确性；不同训练计划会调节这一权衡，且最优计划依赖于数据比率；作者还量化出非思考模式与思考模式监督之间存在负相关。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调思考与非思考模式之间存在内在张力，并提供关于如何设计 TMF 训练设置的实用指导；代码和数据已开源以支持后续研究。

papers.title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce BDH-CQ, a reasoning model that combines in-context learning with recurrent latent reasoning. Inputs presented at inference time continuously update the model's recurrent memory; the model then solves a query through iterative computation in a high-dimensional latent space, without verbalizing its intermediate reasoning. We evaluate the model on the public ARC-AGI-1 evaluation set and use controlled ARC-like interventions to study what it learns from demonstrations, how consistently it applies an inferred transformation, and which concepts remain difficult. A 150M-parameter configuration reaches 29.5% pass@2 at a computed inference cost of \$0.0007 per task. This operating point breaks through the previously reported ARC-AGI-1 cost-accuracy Pareto frontier, establishing a new state of the art in benchmark cost efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BDH-CQ，一种结合上下文学习 (in-context learning) 与循环潜在推理 (recurrent latent reasoning) 的推理模型。模型在推理时将输入连续更新循环记忆，并在高维潜在空间中迭代计算来求解查询，不显式输出中间推理步骤。在 ARC-AGI-1 公开评测集上，150M 参数配置达到 29.5% pass@2，计算成本约为每任务 0.0007 美元，突破此前报告的 ARC-AGI-1 成本-准确率 Pareto 前沿。
Motivation: 现有 ARC-AGI-1 上的推理模型在成本与准确率之间存在已知的权衡，本文目标是寻找更高效的工作点，在不牺牲太多准确率的前提下显著降低每任务推理成本。
Method: BDH-CQ 将推理时输入持续写入循环记忆，随后在潜在空间中迭代计算来求解查询；作者使用公开 ARC-AGI-1 评测集以及受控的 ARC 风格干预实验，研究模型从演示中学到什么、应用推断变换的一致性以及哪些概念仍具难度。
Result: 150M 参数配置在 ARC-AGI-1 上达到 29.5% pass@2，计算成本为每任务 0.0007 美元；该结果打破了此前报道的成本-准确率 Pareto 前沿，树立了基准成本效率的新最优。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，不输出言语化中间推理的循环潜在推理可同时获得较高准确率和极低推理成本，但论文并未在其摘要中讨论明确局限性。

papers.title: Space-Creating versus Dead Possession: An Off-Ball Possession-Quality Index for Broadcast Football
papers.abstract_en: Ball possession is the most-cited and most-misleading number in football: 60% recycled in one's own half is not 60% spent pinning the opponent back. Existing event-based possession-value frameworks (expected threat, VAEP, on-ball value) price on-ball actions but ignore the off-ball question a sterile possession poses: did holding the ball create space, or was the circulation dead? We answer this in two layers. First, an event-side junk-possession index prices each possession sequence by its peak threat gain under an expected-threat grid and -- after reconstructing the live scoreline to exclude lead-protecting circulation -- flags low-threat sequences in tied-or-losing states. On the 2026 FIFA World Cup (103 matches, 206 team-matches) the flag correlates negatively with points (r=-0.37) and xG difference (r=-0.51, partly index-coupled). It is not a repackaging of on-ball value: with team offensive VAEP and field tilt held fixed, the junk flag stays strongly negatively associated with points (p<0.0001, also match-clustered) while VAEP is not significant -- in this same-match (descriptive) regression it adds information beyond this on-ball action-value model. Second, for a flagged window we resolve whether it was spatially dead or space-creating by projecting broadcast video to pitch coordinates and measuring a Space-Creation Index (SCI): a net pitch-control change capturing whether the possession seized space or pushed the opponent's block back. Across 31 of 35 flagged windows from nine World Cup matches (a purposive sample), 74% are spatially non-space-creating, 19% weak progression, and 6% space-creating windows the event flag alone would score as failure -- including a side with 73% of the ball that exited on penalties (two non-creating windows). The two layers separate space-creating-but-unconverted from sterile possession, a distinction event-only on-ball value cannot make.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures. Code and data pipeline: https://github.com/nowayfootball/junk-possession
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对足球中控球率这一最常被引用却最容易误导的指标，提出一个无球控球质量指数。方法分两层：事件侧的 junk-possession index 用 expected-threat 网格按峰值威胁增益为控球序列定价，并结合实时比分排除保护领先的循环，标记平局或落后状态下的低威胁序列；随后对标记窗口将广播视频投影到球场坐标，计算 Space-Creation Index (SCI) 以判定空间死循环还是创造空间。在 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯 103 场、206 个队次数据上，junk flag 与积分和 xG 差显著负相关，并且在控制 VAEP 后仍提供额外信息。
Motivation: 现有基于事件的控球价值框架（expected threat、VAEP、on-ball value）只为有球动作定价，忽略了无球问题：一次控球是否真正创造了空间，还是只是死循环。控球率本身具有误导性，例如在本方半场回传 60% 与压制对手 60% 含义完全不同。
Method: 提出两层方法：事件侧构建 junk-possession index，在 expected-threat 网格上按每个控球序列的峰值威胁增益定价，并通过重建实时比分排除保护领先的循环，从而在平局或落后状态下标记低威胁序列；对标记窗口，将广播视频投影到球场坐标，测量 Space-Creation Index (SCI)，即以净控球变化（net pitch-control change）衡量该窗口是夺取了空间还是把对手防线推回去。
Result: 在 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯（103 场比赛、206 个队次）上，junk flag 与积分负相关（r=-0.37），与 xG difference 负相关（r=-0.51，部分指标耦合）。固定 team offensive VAEP 与 field tilt 后，junk flag 仍与积分保持强负相关（p<0.0001，按比赛聚类），而 VAEP 不显著。在来自 9 场比赛的 35 个标记窗口中的 31 个（目的性样本）里，74% 为非空间创造，19% 为弱推进，6% 为事件标记单独会判为失败的空间创造窗口，包括一支控球率 73% 却于点球大战出局的球队（两个非创造窗口）。
Conclusion: 该方法能够将“创造空间但未转化”与“枯竭控球”区分开，这是仅靠事件层面的 on-ball value 无法做到的；但结果需要结合目的性采样、描述性回归以及部分指标耦合等限制来解读。

papers.title: SHE: Trajectory-driven Safety Harness Evolution for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: The safety of large language model (LLM) agents depends not only on model weights but also on the agent harness that manages context, memory, tools, permissions, and runtime control. Existing safety mechanisms often treat the harness as a fixed deployment artifact, limiting their ability to evolve with emerging risks. Moreover, coupled functions across harness components obscure safety responsibility attribution, making localized evolution difficult. We propose Safety Harness Evolution (SHE), a framework that learns evolving safe boundaries from rollout trajectories. SHE decomposes the harness into four artifacts with explicit safety responsibilities, including the System Prompt, Rule Bank, Safety Memory, and Tool Policy, defining clear functional boundaries for localized evolution. Based on this decomposition, SHE introduces an attribution-guided evolution loop that converts trajectory failures into structured diagnoses, learns artifact-specific boundary refinements, and selects evolved harnesses through safety-utility validation. Experiments on Agent-SafetyBench demonstrate that SHE effectively enhances safety through harness evolution, achieving a 3.1x ASR reduction compared with static SafeHarness, while also improving benign utility. The evolved harness further generalizes to unseen risks on the held-out AgentHarm benchmark and transfers across agent models without additional evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Safety Harness Evolution (SHE)，一种从 rollout trajectories 中学习演化安全边界的框架，将 LLM agent 的 harness 分解为 System Prompt、Rule Bank、Safety Memory、Tool Policy 四个职责明确的组件，并通过归因引导的演化循环迭代改进安全策略。实验在 Agent-SafetyBench 上相比静态 SafeHarness 将攻击成功率 (ASR) 降低 3.1 倍，同时提升良性效用 (benign utility)，并在 AgentHarm 基准与跨模型迁移上展现泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有安全机制通常将 agent harness 视为固定部署产物，难以随新出现的风险演化；同时 harness 各组件功能耦合，导致安全责任归属不明确，难以进行局部化演化。
Method: 提出 SHE 框架，先将 harness 解耦为四个具有显式安全职责的 artifacts，再引入归因引导的演化循环 (attribution-guided evolution loop)：将轨迹失败转化为结构化诊断，学习组件特定的边界修正，并通过安全-效用验证 (safety-utility validation) 筛选演化后的 harness。
Result: 在 Agent-SafetyBench 上，SHE 相比静态 SafeHarness 实现 3.1x 的 ASR 降低，同时改善良性效用；演化后的 harness 在保留的 AgentHarm 基准上泛化到未见风险，并可跨 agent 模型迁移而无需额外演化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将 harness 显式分解为职责清晰的组件并进行轨迹驱动的演化，能够在安全性与效用两方面增强 LLM agent，并具备对未知风险与跨模型的可迁移性。

papers.title: Financial Numerical Prediction and Allocation as Token Generation
papers.abstract_en: Financial prediction typically relies on task-specific regression, ranking, or policy heads, separating the language model from the numerical object ultimately evaluated. We investigate whether a causal language model can instead represent forecasts and decisions directly through constrained token generation. FinATOM introduces a unified, head-free interface for three-step stock-return forecasting and dynamic five-ETF allocation. The forecasting model autoregressively emits volatility-standardized return tokens and is trained with ordinal and ranking supervision followed by a one-epoch token-level policy stage. The allocation model generates normalized long-only weights; supervised fine-tuning imitates a causal mean--variance anchor, and DAPO-augmented GRPO optimizes realized 21-day Sharpe subject to anchor consistency. In 2023--2025 ETF tests, the allocation policy improves pooled gross Sharpe from 1.428 to 1.529 and net Sharpe under a 5-bp transaction-cost model from 1.394 to 1.494. The multimodal allocation input attains the highest three-period mean Sharpe of 1.540, with its clearest advantage in 2025. On FinTexTS, the SFT and policy strategies achieve 73.52\%/2.68 and 73.72\%/2.69 cumulative-return/Sharpe, respectively. These results support the feasibility of direct language-model token generation for financial numerical prediction and decision-making, while motivating broader tests across assets, regimes, and random seeds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FinATOM，一种统一的、无任务头 (head-free) 的接口，让因果语言模型通过受约束的 token 生成直接完成三步股票收益预测和动态五 ETF 资产配置。预测模型自回归地发射波动率标准化后的收益 token，并采用序数/排序监督加单轮 token 级策略训练；配置模型生成归一化的只做多权重，用监督微调模仿因果均值-方差锚，并用 DAPO 增强的 GRPO 优化实现 21 天 Sharpe。2023--2025 年 ETF 测试中，配置策略将池化总 Sharpe 从 1.428 提升到 1.529，5-bp 交易成本下的净 Sharpe 从 1.394 提升到 1.494；在 FinTexTS 上 SFT 与策略分别达到 73.52%/2.68 和 73.72%/2.69 的累计收益/Sharpe。
Motivation: 金融预测通常依赖任务特定的回归、排序或策略头，使语言模型与被评估的数值目标相分离。作者想检验因果语言模型能否直接通过受约束的 token 生成来表示预测和决策，从而简化接口。
Method: FinATOM 提供统一的无头 (head-free) 生成接口。预测部分自回归生成波动率标准化的收益 token，用序数与排序监督训练，并追加一个 epoch 的 token 级策略阶段；配置部分生成归一化只做多权重，SFT 阶段模仿因果均值-方差锚 (causal mean–variance anchor)，再用 DAPO 增强的 GRPO 在保持锚一致性的前提下优化实现 21 天 Sharpe。
Result: 在 2023--2025 ETF 测试中，配置策略将池化总 Sharpe 从 1.428 提升到 1.529，5-bp 交易成本下的净 Sharpe 从 1.394 提升到 1.494；多模态配置输入取得最高的三期平均 Sharpe 1.540，优势在 2025 年最明显。在 FinTexTS 上，SFT 与策略策略分别取得 73.52%/2.68 与 73.72%/2.69 的累计收益/Sharpe。
Conclusion: 结果支持直接语言模型 token 生成用于金融数值预测与决策的可行性，并促使在更多资产、市场状态和随机种子下进行更广泛的测试。

papers.title: Energy-Structured Latent World Models with Neural Time Fields for Physically Constistent Open-World Motion Planning
papers.abstract_en: Physically consistent motion planning remains a fundamental challenge in embodied AI, as generated trajectories must strictly conform to real-world execution dynamics. While latent world models offer a promising approach by predicting these dynamics, existing methods learn unconstrained future representations where absorbed physics remains implicit. Therefore, they fail to form reusable physical knowledge, which compromises reliability in unpredictable open-world navigation. To address this, we propose a novel Energy-Structured Latent World Model (ELWM). Our key idea is to structure the ELWM latent state to explicitly carry energy and momentum, ensuring strictly causal transitions via dissipation and control ports. Trained on multimodal RGB-D and inertial interaction histories, our model guarantees physically consistent predictions. We further implement this for motion planning by constructing Physics-Conditioned Neural Time Fields (PC-NTF), a key technical cornerstone that integrates ELWM into an arrival time field via the Eikonal equation to yield a physically-informed navigation policy. Across held-out scenes, our evaluation reveals significant improvements. Compared to generic latent models, PC-NTF reduces 0.8-s motion-prediction NRMSE from 0.36 to 0.29. Against Active Neural Time Fields, it improves navigation success from 81.3% to 89.7% and SPL from 0.64 to 0.73, while cutting the physical collision rate from 12.1% to 5.8% and the Eikonal residual from 0.083 to 0.031. Beyond these targeted gains, our results demonstrate that embedding explicit physical structures into latent spaces intrinsically bridges the gap between predictive world models and safe, dynamically feasible motion planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放世界运动规划中轨迹需严格符合真实执行动力学的问题，提出能量结构化潜在世界模型 (ELWM)，让潜在状态显式携带能量与动量，并通过耗散与控制端口保证严格因果的转移。作者进一步构造物理条件神经时间场 (PC-NTF)，借助 Eikonal 方程将 ELWM 嵌入到达时间场以形成物理一致的运动规划策略；实验显示相比通用潜在模型与 Active Neural Time Fields，该方法在运动预测误差、导航成功率、SPL 和碰撞率等指标上均有提升。
Motivation: 现有潜在世界模型学习的是无约束的未来表示，吸收的物理规律仍是隐式的，因而难以形成可复用的物理知识，在不可预测的开放世界导航中可靠性不足。

Result: 在留出场景中，PC-NTF 将 0.8 秒运动预测 NRMSE 从 0.36 降到 0.29；相比 Active Neural Time Fields，导航成功率从 81.3% 提升到 89.7%，SPL 从 0.64 提升到 0.73，物理碰撞率从 12.1% 降至 5.8%，Eikonal 残差从 0.083 降至 0.031。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在潜在空间中嵌入显式物理结构可以弥合预测式世界模型与安全、动态可行的运动规划之间的鸿沟；即该工作主要面向具身智能运动规划，而非气象或降水领域。

papers.title: ArchAgent v2: A Case Study with the Data Prefetching Championship
papers.abstract_en: Agentic artificial intelligence has shown great promise in automating algorithm design, but scaling similar techniques to computer microarchitecture discovery remains challenging due to vast search spaces, strict hardware budgets, and long simulation times. In this work, we present ArchAgent v2, a framework which scales automated microarchitecture search to multi-level data prefetching. While the original ArchAgent successfully discovered single-level cache replacement policies in competition settings, it does not scale to multi-level prefetching where the design space and degrees of freedom are larger. To overcome this, we introduce two new additions to ArchAgent: a cascaded evolutionary search that subdivides the design space by sequentially evolving and freezing prefetchers at individual cache levels, and a hardware-realizability feedback loop that embeds real-time size-estimation directly into the evolution process. Evaluated under identical rules of the 4th Data Prefetching Championship (DPC4), ArchAgent v2 automatically designs a three-level prefetcher that outperforms the winning hand-designed solution, further demonstrating automated agentic discovery as a useful tool for computer architects. Our discovered policy achieves a 3.8\% geometric mean IPC speedup over the baseline overall and a 0.3\% improvement over the prior champion, BertiGO. On low-bandwidth single-core configurations, our policy yields a 4.6\% performance speedup compared to only 2.6\% for BertiGO. However, multi-core evolution still remains a significant challenge due to simulation latency impeding evolution speed. Finally, our profiling of an ArchAgent evolution of over 12,000 candidate designs provides key insights into how automated evolutionary agents explore and synthesize complex microarchitectural logic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ArchAgent v2，一个将自动化智能体搜索扩展到多级数据预取的框架。针对原始 ArchAgent 无法扩展到多级预取的大设计空间，作者引入级联进化搜索（cascaded evolutionary search）和硬件可实现性反馈回路（hardware-realizability feedback loop）。在第四届数据预取锦标赛（DPC4）的相同规则下，自动设计出的三级预取器在几何平均 IPC 上比基线提升 3.8%，比上一届冠军 BertiGO 提升 0.3%。
Motivation: 智能体人工智能在自动化算法设计上表现良好，但将其扩展到计算机微架构发现面临搜索空间巨大、硬件预算严格和仿真时间长的挑战。原始 ArchAgent 只能发现单级缓存替换策略，无法扩展到设计空间和自由度更大的多级预取问题。
Method: 在 ArchAgent 基础上加入两个新组件：一是级联进化搜索，通过逐级进化和冻结各缓存层的预取器来细分设计空间；二是硬件可实现性反馈回路，将实时规模估计直接嵌入进化过程。
Result: 在 DPC4 规则下，自动设计的三级预取器整体上比基线实现 3.8% 的几何平均 IPC 加速，比此前冠军 BertiGO 提升 0.3%；在低带宽单核配置下实现 4.6% 的加速，而 BertiGO 仅为 2.6%。对超过 12,000 个候选设计的进化过程分析提供了关于自动化进化智能体如何探索和综合复杂微架构逻辑的见解。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作展示了自动化智能体发现可作为计算机架构师的有效工具，但同时指出由于仿真延迟阻碍进化速度，多核进化仍是显著挑战。

papers.title: Sci-VBench: Evaluating Knowledge- and Reasoning-Intensive Video Generation in Science Domains
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Sci-VBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating knowledge- and reasoning-intensive video generation across scientific domains. It contains 1,253 expert-annotated examples spanning 60 subjects across four core disciplines: Natural Science, Healthcare, Humanities & Social Sciences, and Engineering. Each example requires models to generate temporally rich videos that demand scientific reasoning and knowledge-grounded synthesis, going beyond surface-level visual plausibility. We further establish a rubric-based evaluation protocol. Our analysis shows that, under this protocol, both non-expert human evaluators and MLLM-as-Judge systems can achieve relatively high agreement with expert judgments, supporting reproducible evaluation at scale. We benchmark 16 frontier proprietary and open-source models and find that, while automatic perceptual-quality scores cluster tightly across systems, performance on Prompt Grounding and Scientific and Causal Correctness varies substantially, with a pronounced proprietary-open-source gap. These findings show that advances in visual realism have not yet translated into reliable modeling of scientific and causal dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Sci-VBench，一个面向科学领域、强调知识与推理的视频生成评测基准。基准包含 1,253 条专家标注样本，覆盖自然科学、医疗健康、人文社科和工程四个学科、60 个主题，要求模型生成在时间上丰富且具备科学推理与知识整合能力的视频。作者还建立了基于 rubric 的评测协议，并评测 16 个前沿专有与开源模型，发现视觉真实性之外的科学正确性仍是明显短板。
Motivation: 现有视频生成评测多关注表面视觉合理性，难以衡量模型是否真正理解科学知识、因果与时间动态，因此缺乏能评测知识密集与推理密集视频生成的基准。
Method: 构建 1,253 条专家标注样本，覆盖 60 个主题与四个核心学科；每条样本要求模型生成在时间上丰富、需要科学推理和知识支撑的视频。同时建立基于 rubric 的评测协议，并支持 MLLM-as-Judge 方式以实现可扩展评测。
Result: 在该评测协议下，非专家人类评估者与 MLLM-as-Judge 均能与专家判断达到较高一致性。16 个专有与开源模型上，自动感知质量分数高度聚集，而 Prompt Grounding、科学正确性与因果正确性 (Scientific and Causal Correctness) 差异明显，且专有与开源模型之间存在显著差距。
Conclusion: 摘要指出视觉真实感上的进展尚未转化为对科学因果动态的可靠建模，评测结果显示科学推理能力是当前视频生成模型的明显短板。

papers.title: Logarithmic-Free Moment and Generalization Bounds for Uniformly Stable Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Uniform stability is a classical tool for controlling the generalization error of a learning algorithm. Bousquet, Klochkov, and Zhivotovskiy (2020) showed that the problem can be reduced to a moment inequality for a sum of weakly interacting functions of independent random variables. Their bound contains an additional factor $\log n$, and they asked whether this factor can be removed. We answer this upper-bound question affirmatively. More specifically, let $Z=(Z_1,\ldots,Z_n)$ have independent coordinates and let $g_i(Z)$ satisfy $$ \mathbb E[g_i(Z)\mid Z_{-i}]=0, \qquad \left| \mathbb E[g_i(Z)\mid Z_i]\right|\le M, \qquad \forall i = \overline{1, n} $$ while changing any coordinate $Z_j$, $j\neq i$, changes $g_i$ by at most $β$ and $Z_{-i}$ denotes all coordinates except $Z_i$. We prove that, for every $p\ge2$, $$ \left\| \sum_{i=1}^n g_i(Z)\right\|_p \le 16pnβ+M\sqrt{2pn}. $$ This removes the $\log n$ factor from the previous bound and matches the lower bound of Bousquet, Klochkov, and Zhivotovskiy up to universal constants in the range covered by their construction. Our proof first establishes the required estimate on the Rademacher cube, then transfers it to arbitrary product distributions by a two-copy randomization argument.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文回答了 Bousquet、Klochkov 和 Zhivotovskiy (2020) 提出的开放问题：均匀稳定算法 (uniformly stable algorithms) 的矩不等式上界中的 $\log n$ 因子是否可以去掉。作者证明，对任意 $p\ge 2$，满足弱交互条件的函数和满足 $\|\sum_{i=1}^n g_i(Z)\|_p \le 16pn\beta + M\sqrt{2pn}$，从而去掉了对数因子，并在相应构造覆盖的范围内与已知下界在常数意义上匹配。证明先建立 Rademacher 立方体上的估计，再通过两副本随机化 (two-copy randomization) 转移到任意乘积分布。
Motivation: BKZ (2020) 将均匀稳定性控制泛化误差的问题归结为独立随机变量弱交互函数和的矩不等式，但其上界多出 $\log n$ 因子，原作者并未解决该因子是否能移除的问题。
Method: 针对独立坐标 $Z=(Z_1,\ldots,Z_n)$ 与满足条件均值零、条件期望受 $M$ 控制、且单坐标扰动不超过 $\beta$ 的函数 $g_i$，证明 $L_p$ 范数界 $\|\sum_i g_i(Z)\|_p \le 16pn\beta + M\sqrt{2pn}$。证明路线是先建立 Rademacher 立方体上的估计，再借助两副本随机化参数将其推广到任意乘积分布。
Result: 该矩不等式在 $p\ge 2$ 时去除了之前的 $\log n$ 因子，并在 BKZ 构造所覆盖的范围内与下界匹配（仅差通用常数）。
Conclusion: 作者肯定地回答了 BKZ 提出的上界问题，并指出证明的关键是 Rademacher 立方体估计与两副本随机化传递技巧。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者肯定地回答了 BKZ 提出的上界问题，并指出证明的关键是 Rademacher 立方体估计与两副本随机化传递技巧。

papers.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
papers.abstract_en: Leading large language model providers now conceal their models' step-by-step reasoning, or chain-of-thought, to protect intellectual property and limit information leakage. Rather than storing these traces server-side, providers return them to the client as blocks of encrypted text, which the client passes back with each subsequent request. Building on prior research, we identify an architectural vulnerability: these encrypted blocks are fully compatible and interchangeable across different sessions, users, and models within a provider's ecosystem. We exploit this compatibility to develop a scalable decryption jailbreak. By injecting an encrypted reasoning trace from a given model into a weaker, and less safeguarded model from the same provider, we force it to decode and output the trace verbatim in plaintext, without ever jailbreaking the more capable model directly. This vulnerability enables four distinct attack vectors. First, it circumvents anti-distillation mechanisms, allowing adversaries to extract a proprietary model's reasoning, as we demonstrate across Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google. Second, it allows for large-scale private data extraction. Developers frequently share session logs publicly, unaware of contents of the encrypted blocks. By decoding 315,320 reasoning blocks scraped from public repositories, we recovered 367 Personally Identifiable Information (PII) artifacts and 182 credentials. Third, it inadvertently reveals hazardous information hidden within the reasoning process, even in cases where the model's final, visible output safely rejects a malicious request. Fourth, attackers can leverage this flaw to execute invisible prompt injections, embedding malicious payloads entirely within encrypted blocks to poison public agentic rollouts. Following responsible disclosure, we propose concrete cryptographic and system-level mitigations to secure client-side reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示主流大模型 API 在隐藏思维链 (chain-of-thought) 时采用的客户端加密推理块存在架构级漏洞：这些加密块在不同会话、用户乃至同一生态内的模型之间可互换兼容。作者利用该兼容性，将某模型的加密推理痕迹注入同一提供商更弱、防护更少的模型，迫使其逐字解码输出明文，从而在不直接越狱更强模型的情况下完成可扩展的解密越狱。论文在 Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Google 的模型上验证了该攻击，并展示了四项攻击向量。
Motivation: 领先的 LLM 提供商为保护知识产权和限制信息泄露，不再向客户端返回明文的分步推理，而是以加密文本块形式下发并由客户端在后续请求中回传；这种设计在架构上留下了可利用的兼容性缺陷。
Method: 作者提出一种解密越狱方法，将来自某模型的加密推理痕迹注入同一提供商下更弱、防护更少的模型，使其解码并原样输出明文推理，而无需直接攻击能力更强的模型。论文还归纳了四项攻击向量，并提出密码学与系统层面的缓解措施。
Result: 跨 Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Google 的模型上验证了攻击有效性；通过解码从公开仓库抓取的 315,320 个推理块，恢复了 367 个个人可识别信息 (PII) 和 182 个凭据 (credentials)，并能实现不可见提示注入 (invisible prompt injection)。
Conclusion: 作者经负责任披露后，提出具体的加密与系统级缓解方案来保障客户端侧推理的安全；该工作表明当前以加密文本块形式返回推理痕迹的方式在跨会话兼容性下并不安全。

papers.title: Towards Expert-level Medical AI for Real-time Video Consultations
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual interaction is the standard for patient-physician consultations, enabling natural communication and effective assessment of illness through non-verbal cues. While text-based AI has shown promise, it discards essential perceptual dimensions and limits patients who cannot articulate symptoms in writing. Early efforts to extend medical AI to audio-visual interaction have demonstrated feasibility but not reached clinician-level performance. Here, we provide the first demonstration of expert-level AI in real-time clinical video consultations using AMIE (Articulate Medical Intelligence Explorer) in a video configuration. AMIE (Video) is a Gemini-based multi-agent system integrating low-latency dialogue, clinical reasoning, and real-time audio-visual perception. To guide development, we established a taxonomy and automated evaluations for clinical audio-visual cues in telehealth settings. In a randomized Objective Structured Clinical Examination (OSCE) study with 30 primary care physicians (PCPs), 15 patient actors and 100 clinical scenarios, we compared AMIE (Video), its text-only counterpart AMIE (Text), and PCPs consulting via video. Clinical evaluators rated AMIE (Video) on par or better than PCPs in history-taking, diagnosis, management, and physical observation and examination. Patient actors preferred AMIE's approach to assessing and explaining conditions, while PCPs were preferred for rapport and partnership building. In modality ablation, patient actors preferred AMIE (Video)'s interface over text chat for communicative effectiveness, convenience, and feeling understood. Limitations remain in fine anatomical precision, subtle affective nuances, and high-frequency movements. While further research is needed before real-world translation, these results mark an important milestone toward AI systems capable of augmenting care across the sensory complexity of clinical practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于 Gemini 的多智能体系统 AMIE (Video)，将医疗 AI 扩展至实时临床视频问诊场景，并在随机 OSCE 研究中与人类初级保健医生 (PCP) 对比。摘要报告 AMIE (Video) 在病史采集、诊断、管理和体格观察等方面获评与 PCP 相当或更优，患者演员在沟通效果和解释方式上倾向于 AMIE，而 PCP 在融洽关系和伙伴关系建设上更受偏好。
Motivation: 文本式医疗 AI 丢弃了音频-视觉等关键感知维度，且难以服务无法用文字描述症状的患者；早期音视频医疗 AI 尚未达到临床医生水平，需要验证专家级表现。
Method: AMIE (Video) 是 Gemini 基础的多智能体系统，整合低延迟对话、临床推理与实时音视频感知；研究还建立了临床音视频线索的分类体系 (taxonomy) 和自动化评估方法，并开展含 30 名 PCP、15 名患者演员和 100 个临床场景的随机 OSCE 研究以对比 AMIE (Video)、AMIE (Text) 和 PCP 视频问诊。
Result: 临床评估者认为 AMIE (Video) 在病史采集、诊断、管理和体格观察与检查上与 PCP 相当或更优；模态消融中患者演员偏好 AMIE (Video) 而非文本聊天，认为其沟通效果、便利性和被理解感更好。
Conclusion: 摘要指出当前局限包括精细解剖精度、微妙情感细节和高频动作的捕捉不足，强调在真实世界转化前仍需进一步研究；该结果被视为医疗 AI 向临床实践感知复杂度迈进的重要里程碑。

papers.title: Agentic Harnesses: LLM-Driven Verification Layers for Robot Autonomy
papers.abstract_en: Advances in advanced artificial intelligence tools have sparked research in robot autonomy, but the development of such systems has largely focused on execution rather than verifying the feasibility actions planning models propose. Like general-purpose LLMs, robotics planning models carry risks: biased toward user-specified goals, they may suggest actions misaligned with scientific ethics, they may be unsafe due to an inability to "remember" prior safety risks, or they may be vulnerable to adversarial attacks on the autonomy ecosystem. We propose a LLM-driven verification layer between planning and execution to evaluate action permissibility. Our LLM-as-a-Judge ensemble combines chain-of-thought reasoning across models and synthesizes those expert judge outputs, mirroring a combination of a mixture of experts and self-consistency approach. This layer serves as middleware, gating plans from the server's planning module before they reach the MCP server and therefore the robot's low-level controls: plans are approved, rejected for reformulation, or escalated for human review. With this system, we achieve near 85% precision across accept/escalate/reject categories 97% containment of adversarial attacks, with negligible errors between accepting and rejecting tasks, and errors mostly manifesting at the escalate boundary.
papers.comment: 7 pages. Not yet finalized for conference submission
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器人自主性中规划模块提出的动作缺乏可行性验证的问题，提出在规划与执行之间加入一个由 LLM 驱动的验证层 (LLM-driven verification layer)。该方法采用 LLM-as-a-Judge 集成，通过多模型链式推理 (chain-of-thought) 并综合各裁判模型的输出，类似于混合专家 (mixture of experts) 与自一致性 (self-consistency) 的结合。验证层作为中间件，在计划到达 MCP 服务器和机器人底层控制之前进行门控，批准、拒绝或升级计划。摘要报告其在接受/升级/拒绝三类上达到近 85% 的精度，并实现 97% 的对抗攻击遏制率。
Motivation: 机器人自主性的研究大多聚焦于执行而非验证规划模型提议动作的可行性。与通用 LLM 类似，机器人规划模型存在风险：可能偏向用户指定的目标、提出与科学伦理不一致的动作、因无法'记住'先前安全风险而不安全，并且容易受到针对自主生态系统的对抗攻击。
Method: 提出一个介于规划与执行之间的 LLM 驱动验证层，用于评估动作的可允许性 (permissibility)。该层采用 LLM-as-a-Judge 集成，结合跨模型的链式推理并综合专家裁判输出，相当于混合专家与自一致性方法的组合。它作为中间件，在服务器的规划模块与 MCP 服务器（进而到机器人底层控制）之间门控计划，将计划批准、拒绝以重新配方，或升级给人工审查。
Result: 摘要报告该系统在 accept/escalate/reject 三类上达到近 85% 的精度，对抗攻击遏制率达 97%，接受与拒绝之间的错误可忽略，错误主要集中在升级边界 (escalate boundary)。
Conclusion: 作者认为该验证层可作为规划与执行之间的中间件，通过批准、拒绝或升级处理来增强机器人自主系统的安全性。论文为 7 页初稿，尚未最终定稿提交会议。

papers.title: Agentic Auto-Research is Fuzz Testing
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous research agents can generate experiments faster than researchers can validate them. Researchers have responded by scaling the proposer and ranking more samples with a learned judge or human reviewers. We argue that this *generate-and-rank* paradigm misses the problem of sparse feedback. Within a declared research problem, an agent follows the control loop of a greybox fuzzer: it proposes a candidate, executes it, observes feedback, and chooses what to try next. A fuzzer rarely finds a bug, but coverage makes partial progress observable on every execution. Fuzzers then use that signal to mutate inputs and allocate effort, rather than only to rank completed runs. Auto-research needs the same two capabilities. First, each experiment should expose a cheap, dense signal of epistemic progress before final scientific validation is available. Second, that signal should determine the next intervention so that the agent searches rather than repeatedly samples. Because the optimized progress signal is guidance rather than a verdict, final validation must still decide what counts as a discovery using evidence protected from adaptive reuse. We propose controlled tests of whether candidate signals predict validated progress, whether feedback-directed search yields more validated discoveries per unit cost than repeated sampling, and whether protected validation reduces false discoveries. Feedback architecture, not only generation, is a central bottleneck in auto-research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇提出研究纲领的论文，认为当前自主研究代理（autonomous research agents）采用的 generate-and-rank 范式忽略了稀疏反馈（sparse feedback）问题。作者将代理在给定研究问题中的行为类比为灰盒模糊测试（greybox fuzzing）：每个实验在被最终科学验证之前，应先提供廉价、密集的认知进展信号（epistemic progress signal），并由该信号决定下一步干预，使代理真正搜索而非反复采样。文中还提出用受保护验证（protected validation）避免自适应复用导致的假发现，并主张反馈架构而非仅生成能力才是自动研究的关键瓶颈。
Motivation: 研究者用生成大量候选、再由学习型评审或人工评审排序的方式应对实验产出超过验证速度的现状，但摘要指出这种 paradigm 忽视了稀疏反馈问题，导致代理难以有效分配努力并持续搜索。
Method: 提出将自动研究的控制循环类比为灰盒 fuzzer：提议候选、执行、观察反馈、选择下一步；需要两个能力，一是每个实验在最终验证前提供廉价密集的认知进展信号，二是该信号指导下一次干预。同时提出受保护验证机制来判定真正发现，并设计了三类受控测试：候选信号能否预测已验证进展、反馈导向搜索是否比重复采样在单位成本下产生更多已验证发现、受保护验证能否减少假发现。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果或定量评测，内容为概念框架与待验证的研究议程。
Conclusion: 作者强调反馈架构（feedback architecture）而非仅生成能力是自动研究中的核心瓶颈，最终验证仍须由不受自适应复用影响的证据来决定何为发现。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调反馈架构（feedback architecture）而非仅生成能力是自动研究中的核心瓶颈，最终验证仍须由不受自适应复用影响的证据来决定何为发现。

papers.title: RynnValue: Scaling Robotic Value Foundation Models with Temporal Distance
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose reward models are increasingly the bottleneck for scaling robot learning, yet the recipe for learning value-related capabilities from large-scale heterogeneous corpora remains underexplored. Existing approaches tie supervision to task-internal anchors such as preferences or normalized progress, none of which transfer cleanly across embodiments and data sources. We introduce RynnValue, an open-source value foundation model for robotic manipulation that replaces these anchors with temporal distance, the directed cost-to-go from an observation to the language-specified goal. Because temporal-distance labels can be derived directly from timestamps, RynnValue scales to over 7,000 hours and roughly 3M instruction-conditioned clips without preference or progress annotations. To make temporal-value learning reliable at scale, we combine random temporal sampling, temporal-order shuffling, and value-isolation attention, suppressing shortcuts that would leave predictions insensitive to failures and regressions. Trained without preference labels, RynnValue attains an average Kendall's tau_a of 0.675 on RBM-EVAL-OOD, surpassing the fully preference-supervised state of the art (0.655) and more than doubling a progress-only counterpart (0.292), while generalizing zero-shot to unseen tasks, embodiments, and viewpoints. Converted into dense rewards via potential-based shaping, it raises real-world policy success from 52.5% to 72.5% online and from 63.8% to 82.5% offline. These results establish temporal distance as a scalable supervision target and practical reward interface for generalist robot policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RynnValue，一个面向机器人操作的开源价值基础模型 (value foundation model)，用时间距离 (temporal distance) 取代偏好或归一化进度作为监督锚点，即从观测到语言指定目标的定向 cost-to-go。由于时间距离标签可直接从时间戳导出，模型可在约 7000 小时、约 300 万条指令条件片段上扩展训练，无需偏好或进度标注。在 RBM-EVAL-OOD 上平均 Kendall's tau_a 达 0.675，超过全偏好监督的 SOTA (0.655)，且显著优于仅用进度的基线 (0.292)。
Motivation: 通用奖励模型日益成为扩展机器人学习的瓶颈，而如何从大规模异构语料学习价值相关能力仍未被充分探索。现有方法把监督绑定到任务内部锚点（如偏好或归一化进度），这些锚点难以跨具身 (embodiment) 和数据源迁移。
Method: 用时间距离替换上述锚点，标签直接从时间戳获得，从而无需偏好或进度标注即可扩展到千万级片段。为使时间价值学习在大规模下可靠，作者组合随机时间采样 (random temporal sampling)、时间顺序打乱 (temporal-order shuffling) 和价值隔离注意力 (value-isolation attention)，以抑制使预测对失败和回退不敏感的捷径。
Result: 在无偏好标签训练下，RynnValue 在 RBM-EVAL-OOD 上取得平均 Kendall's tau_a 0.675，超过偏好监督的 SOTA (0.655) 并比仅用进度的对应方法 (0.292) 提升一倍以上，并可零样本泛化到未见任务、具身和视角。通过基于势能的整形 (potential-based shaping) 转为稠密奖励后，真实世界策略成功率在线从 52.5% 提到 72.5%，离线从 63.8% 提到 82.5%。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果确立了时间距离作为一种可扩展的监督目标，以及面向通用机器人策略的实用奖励接口。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CEAA: A Cognitive Embodied Agents Architecture for Interactive Computing Systems
papers.abstract_en: The development of embodied Intelligent Virtual Agents (IVAs) that have cognitive capabilities in real-time interactive virtual environments remains a challenge, even with today's advancements in technology. Existing architectures are often focused on either the implementation of low-level reactive control systems that are constrained by commercial game engines, or high-level representations of reasoning models that can be difficult to implement in virtual worlds. This paper builds on that notion and proposes a modular cognitive architecture for deploying embodied IVAs. This architecture builds on existing, pre-established frameworks such as the Sense-Think-Act paradigm and the Belief-Desire-Intention cognitive model, among others, and aims to provide a reusable implementation-oriented framework as a template for deploying IVA "brains" in interactive 3D computing systems. The proposed architecture contributes by providing a modular, implementation-oriented framework for the deployment of embodied, cognitive-capable IVAs and bridges the gap between high-level agent reasoning models with real-time embodied execution, for scalable, adaptive, and explainable agents in complex interactive virtual environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向交互式3D计算系统的模块化认知具身智能体架构 CEAA，用于部署具备认知能力的具身智能虚拟代理（IVA）。该架构建立在 Sense-Think-Act 范式和 Belief-Desire-Intention 认知模型等已有框架之上，目标是提供可复用的、面向实现（implementation-oriented）的智能代理“大脑”部署模板，并弥合高层推理模型与实时具身执行之间的鸿沟。
Motivation: 现有具身 IVA 架构往往只侧重低层反应式控制，受限于商用游戏引擎；或者只提供高层推理模型表示，难以在虚拟世界中实现。论文希望填补两者之间缺乏可复用、实现导向框架的空白。
Method: 提出一个模块化认知架构，整合 Sense-Think-Act 与 Belief-Desire-Intention 等已有框架，为在交互式3D计算系统中部署具身、具备认知能力的 IVA 提供实现导向的模板和框架。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的实验数据、基准或量化结果，论文贡献以架构设计为主。
Conclusion: 该架构旨在为复杂的交互式虚拟环境提供可扩展、自适应且可解释（explainable）的智能体，并强调连接高层智能体推理模型与实时具身执行的重要性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Real-Time Climate Risk Assessment for Supply Chain Resilience: A Data-Driven Nowcasting Framework for Colombian Agriculture
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a methodological framework for real-time climate risk assessment using data-driven nowcasting techniques to enhance supply chain resilience in Colombian agricultural contexts. Climate variability in Colombia, characterized by irregular rainfall, temperature fluctuations, and recurrent extreme events, has a direct impact on agricultural production and logistics, particularly for time sensitive crops. The proposed approach integrates short term climate forecasting based on historical meteorological observations with supply chain risk modeling to establish a conceptual early warning system architecture. A prototype implementation developed in a controlled computational environment demonstrates the feasibility of the framework using historical meteorological and agricultural time series derived from official statistics and reanalysis products, without reliance on satellite imagery or computer vision components. The methodology addresses the integration of climate nowcasting with supply chain decision making through explicit risk mapping, threshold-based categorization, and stakeholder-oriented risk signals. Results from synthetic and historical data experiments indicate that short term precipitation nowcasts can be translated into actionable risk indicators for agricultural supply chains, supporting anticipatory decisions related to inventory, sourcing, and transport.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向哥伦比亚农业供应链的实时气候风险评估框架，将基于历史气象观测的短期气候预报（nowcasting）与供应链风险建模相结合，构建概念性的早期预警系统架构。作者在受控计算环境中实现了原型，使用官方统计与再分析产品生成的历史气象和农业时间序列验证了框架可行性，未依赖卫星影像或计算机视觉。实验表明短期降水预报可转化为可操作的供应链风险指标，支持库存、采购和运输等前瞻性决策。
Motivation: 哥伦比亚的气候变率以降雨不规则、温度波动和极端事件频发为特征，直接影响农业生产和物流，尤其对时间敏感作物影响显著。现有方法缺少将气候临近预报与供应链决策过程系统整合的途径。
Method: 方法将基于历史气象观测的短期气候预报与供应链风险建模集成，通过显式风险映射、基于阈值的分级分类和面向利益相关者的风险信号，建立早期预警系统架构；原型实现仅使用历史气象和农业时间序列，不依赖卫星影像。
Result: 基于合成数据与历史数据的实验表明，短期降水临近预报可转化为哥伦比亚农业供应链的可操作风险指标，从而支持库存、采购和运输方面的前瞻性决策。
Conclusion: 该框架论证了气候临近预报与供应链决策集成的可行性，为后续实际部署提供了概念基础；受控环境下的原型验证是其主要成果范围。
Relevance: 93

papers.title: From Diagnosis to Correction: Benchmarking and Improving Real-World Table Parsing
papers.abstract_en: Recent document parsers achieve table TEDS scores above 93 on OmniDocBench v1.6, yet community feedback and our audit reveal persistent failures on complex real-world tables. To quantify this gap, we introduce TableParseMap, a diagnostic benchmark of 916 real-world tables organized into five challenging scenarios and nine failure types. The strongest evaluated parser achieves only 85.03 TEDS, showing that aggregate benchmark scores conceal substantial weaknesses. Our analysis attributes these failures to three complementary limitations: large tables exceed the reliable processing scale of a single pass, weak or ambiguous visual cues hinder structure perception, and the reconstructed table may remain visually inconsistent with the image. We therefore propose DEC (Decompose--Enhance--Correct), a visual-consistency-guided agentic framework that improves frozen table parsers without retraining. DEC uses a general VLM as the controller: Decompose partitions large tables along structure-aware boundaries, Enhance exposes weak visual evidence and reparses transformed views, and Correct diagnoses and repairs residual errors. A Visual Consistency Gate (VC-Gate) selectively triggers intervention, while a Visual Consistency Ranker (VC-Ranker) verifies candidate updates and supports rollback without ground-truth HTML at inference time. We further derive a 1,977-table Consensus-Hard Set from 4,556 candidates through offline metrics and cross-model consensus. Across three frozen parsers, DEC improves TEDS by 1.57 points on average; on TableParseMap, gains reach 1.89 points overall, 2.62 on structural errors, and 5.66 on large tables.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出即使在 OmniDocBench v1.6 上表格 TEDS 超过 93 的解析器，在真实复杂表格上仍持续失败，并为此引入包含 916 张真实表格的诊断基准 TableParseMap，覆盖五个挑战场景和九类失败。最强解析器在该基准上仅得到 85.03 TEDS，说明聚合分数掩盖了明显短板。作者提出 DEC（Decompose--Enhance--Correct），一个以视觉一致性为导向的智能体框架，在无需重训练的情况下改进冻结的表格解析器，并通过 VC-Gate 与 VC-Ranker 控制干预与回滚。
Motivation: 现有表格解析器在通用基准上的高分并不能反映真实世界复杂表格的表现，社区反馈与作者审计都显示存在持续失败，但缺少能量化这一差距的诊断基准。
Method: 提出 DEC 框架，以通用 VLM 作为控制器：Decompose 沿结构感知边界切分大表格，Enhance 通过重解析变换视图暴露弱视觉证据，Correct 诊断并修复残差错误；VC-Gate 选择性触发干预，VC-Ranker 在无真实 HTML 的情况下验证候选更新并支持回滚。
Result: 在 TableParseMap 上，最强解析器 TEDS 仅为 85.03；DEC 使三个冻结解析器的 TEDS 平均提升 1.57 点，在 TableParseMap 上整体提升 1.89 点，结构错误上提升 2.62 点，大表格上提升 5.66 点。
Conclusion: 失败分析将问题归因于三点：大表格超出单次处理的可扩展规模、视觉线索弱或不明确影响结构感知、重建表格与图像视觉不一致；DEC 在这些限制下可有效改进冻结解析器。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Langevin dynamics along the zero set of real-analytic potentials
papers.abstract_en: We consider the Langevin diffusion $dX_t = - β\nabla V(X_t) dt + \sqrt{2} dB_t$ for a general nonnegative real-analytic potential $V$ and a large parameter $β$. In the large-$β$ limit the process is confined to the zero set of $V$, assuming that it starts there. We derive a candidate limiting evolution on the zero set. To do so, the zero set is partitioned into strata according to a measure of local codimension known as the local learning coefficient and its multiplicity. It is then shown that the Dirichlet form associated with $X$ converges in a certain sense to a hierarchy of Dirichlet forms corresponding to a stochastic evolution on the strata. This evolution is strongly biased toward higher-dimensional, or "more singular", strata. This result is motivated by a question from Watanabe's singular learning theory regarding the learning dynamics of overparameterized statistical models and the generalization puzzle in deep learning. The result suggests a mechanism for the observation that stochastic gradient methods tend to be biased toward singular solutions that generalize well.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大参数 β 下一般非负实解析势 V 的 Langevin 扩散 dX_t = -β∇V(X_t)dt + √2 dB_t。在大 β 极限下，若从 V 的零点集出发，过程被限制在该零点集上；作者通过对零点集按局部学习系数 (local learning coefficient) 及其重数分层，推导出一个候选的极限演化，并证明相关的 Dirichlet 形式在某种意义下收敛到对应分层的 Dirichlet 形式层级。该结果与 Watanabe 奇异学习理论相关，为过参数化统计模型的学习动力学及深度学习中的泛化谜题提供了一种机制。
Motivation: 作者希望理解过参数化统计模型中随机梯度方法为何倾向于收敛到能良好泛化的奇异解，这是 Watanabe 奇异学习理论提出的问题。此工作从连续时间的 Langevin 动力学出发，试图刻画大 β 极限下过程在势函数零点集上的行为，为这一现象提供理论机制。
Method: 将 V 的零点集按局部学习系数及其重数划分成不同维数的分层 (strata)，并研究 Langevin 扩散对应的 Dirichlet 形式在大 β 极限下的收敛行为。作者推导出一个候选的极限随机演化，该演化强烈偏向于更高维或“更奇异”的分层。
Result: 摘要报告称，过程在大 β 极限下被约束在零点集上，且其 Dirichlet 形式收敛到对应分层结构的 Dirichlet 形式层级；极限演化强烈偏向高维或更奇异的分层，从而为奇异解偏好提供机制。
Conclusion: 该结果从奇异学习理论角度为随机梯度方法偏向泛化良好的奇异解提供了一个理论机制，但摘要未给出具体的数值实验或对特定深度学习模型的直接验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mismatch Matters: On-Policy Distillation Beyond Token Agreement
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as a core component of modern LLM post-training pipelines, yet we reveal a failure mode: degenerate agreement, where students exploit repetitive loops to achieve near-perfect token agreement with the teacher despite globally flawed responses. We therefore shift our focus from agreement to teacher-student mismatch, and find that mismatch tokens can be mainly categorized into two types: student-excess tokens and student-deficit tokens. Student-excess tokens are generated by the student but assigned near-zero probability by the teacher; their log-ratio corrections grow unbounded and destabilize the update. Student-deficit tokens, in contrast, are preferred by the teacher but rarely sampled by the student; their absence blocks the transfer of the teacher's reasoning patterns. To tackle these mismatch directions, we propose TIDE (Token-level Independent Deficit-Excess correction), which applies bounded Hellinger shaping to suppress the most severe sampled excesses and an analytic teacher top-$K$ injection to restore deficient probability mass without requiring deficit tokens to be sampled. Across mathematical reasoning benchmarks with multiple Qwen3 teacher-student pairs, TIDE consistently outperforms standard OPD and recent token-selection and reward-shaping baselines. Moreover, the gains of TIDE are more pronounced under strong teacher-student mismatch, where it improves Avg@8 from 6.9% to 20.3%, reduces average response length by a factor of 3.6, and substantially reduces formatting failures. Code is available at https://github.com/yzc-666/TIDE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示 on-policy distillation (OPD) 在 LLM 后训练中的一个失败模式：退化一致 (degenerate agreement)，即学生通过重复循环获得与教师近乎完美的 token 级一致，但整体回答有缺陷。作者将师生不一致 token 分为 student-excess 与 student-deficit 两类，并据此提出 TIDE (Token-level Independent Deficit-Excess correction)，在数学推理基准上显著优于标准 OPD 及多种基线。
Motivation: 现有 on-policy distillation 以 token 一致为目标，但学生可能用重复循环刷高一致率，导致全局错误却难以被发现；同时 teacher 偏好的推理模式因学生采样不到而无法迁移。
Method: TIDE 对 excess token 采用有界 Hellinger 整形以抑制极端 log-ratio 修正，对 deficit token 使用解析的教师 top-K 注入，恢复缺失的概率质量而不需要这些 token 被采样到。
Result: 在多个 Qwen3 teacher-student 组合的数学推理基准上，TIDE 一致优于标准 OPD 和 token 选择、奖励整形基线；在强师生不匹配场景下，Avg@8 从 6.9% 提升到 20.3%，平均响应长度降低 3.6 倍，并显著减少格式化失败。
Conclusion: 作者主张把优化目标从 token 一致转向师生不匹配 (mismatch)，并表明同时处理 excess 与 deficit 两个方向能带来更稳定的蒸馏和更强的收益。

papers.title: RA-FinBERT: Rule-aware LoRA adaptation for low-resource financial sentiment classification
papers.abstract_en: Financial sentiment analysis converts unstructured financial news into quantitative signals that can support market analysis and decision-making. Existing work on resource-efficient financial NLP has largely focused on compressing or adapting pretrained language models, with less attention to combining contextual representations with lightweight rule-derived features. This study develops Rule-Aware FinBERT (RA-FinBERT), a parameter-efficient framework that integrates low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with three continuous VADER-derived sentiment proportions (positive, negative, and neutral) and a source-level metadata feature. The standardized four-dimensional feature vector is directly concatenated with the 768-dimensional final-layer FinBERT [CLS] representation and passed through a lightweight classification head. This design introduces only 1,024 additional trainable weights relative to a structurally matched text-only FinBERT model. RA-FinBERT was evaluated against text-only FinBERT and a lightweight DistilBERT baseline for three-class sentiment classification of financial-news titles and descriptions. On the held-out test set, RA-FinBERT achieved 69.89% accuracy and a macro F1 score of 0.634, compared with 63.44% and 0.526 for text-only FinBERT. Neutral-class recall increased from 18.18% to 45.45%. The framework supports both CPU and GPU execution, offering a lightweight and practical approach to financial sentiment classification under constrained computational resources. These findings indicate that rule-derived sentiment information and source metadata can provide complementary signals to contextual FinBERT representations and improve performance with minimal additional model complexity.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Fan Zhang and Jiaming Li are co-first authors. Corresponding author: Jiaming Li

TL;DR: 本文提出规则感知的 RA-FinBERT，一种参数高效的金融情感分类框架，将低秩适配 (LoRA) 与三个连续的 VADER 派生态度比例（positive、negative、neutral）及来源级元数据特征结合。标准化的四维特征向量直接与 FinBERT 末层 768 维 [CLS] 表示拼接，仅引入 1,024 个额外可训练权重。在金融新闻标题与描述的三分类情感任务上，RA-FinBERT 在测试集上达到 69.89% 准确率与 0.634 macro F1，优于纯文本 FinBERT 的 63.44% 与 0.526。
Motivation: 现有的资源高效金融 NLP 研究主要关注压缩或适配预训练语言模型，较少探索将上下文表示与轻量级规则派生特征相结合。
Method: 提出 Rule-Aware FinBERT (RA-FinBERT) 框架，在 LoRA 适配的基础上融合三个由 VADER 派生的连续情感比例和来源级元数据特征，形成标准化四维特征向量，与 768 维 FinBERT [CLS] 表示拼接后送入轻量分类头。
Result: 在保留测试集上，RA-FinBERT 的三分类准确率为 69.89%、macro F1 为 0.634，而纯文本 FinBERT 分别为 63.44% 和 0.526；中性类别的召回率从 18.18% 提升到 45.45%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为规则派生的情感信息与来源元数据可以为上下文 FinBERT 表示提供互补信号，以极小的模型复杂度提升金融情感分类性能，并支持 CPU 与 GPU 运行。

papers.title: Deep Multimodal Wearable Sensor Fusion for Detection of Body-Focused Repetitive Behaviors
papers.abstract_en: Body-focused repetitive behaviors, such as hair pulling and skin picking, are compulsive motor actions commonly associated with obsessive-compulsive and anxiety disorders. Their early, objective detection remains difficult because the movements are subtle and overlap with ordinary, non-pathological gestures. We developed and evaluated a multimodal deep learning framework to detect and classify these behaviors from wrist-worn sensor data. The data, collected by the Child Mind Institute using the Helios wrist-worn device, combine inertial measurement units, thermopile sensors, and time-of-flight sensors, capturing kinematic, thermal, and proximity information. The framework combined a convolutional neural network with a gated recurrent unit, alongside modality-specific autoencoders and a late-fusion classifier, to exploit temporal and spatial dynamics. It achieved an F1 score of 0.985 and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.997 for binary detection, distinguishing these behaviors from other activities, and a macro-averaged F1 score of 0.700 with an area under the curve of 0.963 across a nine-class scheme that distinguished each individual behavior from a single grouped Non-Target class, improving over single-modality baselines. Post-hoc interpretability based on Shapley additive explanations showed that the time-of-flight and inertial modalities dominated discriminative power by capturing spatial proximity and dynamic movement, while hierarchical clustering indicated that misclassifications were driven primarily by the anatomical region of the gesture. These findings demonstrate that multimodal sensor fusion enables accurate, objective, and continuous behavioral monitoring. This work establishes a foundation for real-time, wearable-assisted mental health diagnostics and personalized interventions in biomedical research and clinical care.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多模态深度学习框架，利用腕戴式 Helios 设备采集的惯性测量单元 (IMU)、热电堆 (thermopile) 和时间飞行 (time-of-flight, ToF) 传感器数据，检测抓头发、抠皮肤等身体聚焦重复行为 (body-focused repetitive behaviors)。框架由 CNN 与门控循环单元 (GRU) 结合逐模态自编码器及晚期融合分类器组成。摘要报告二分类 F1 为 0.985、AUC 为 0.997，九分类宏平均 F1 为 0.700、AUC 为 0.963，优于单模态基线。
Motivation: 身体聚焦重复行为与强迫症和焦虑障碍相关，但动作细微且与普通非病态手势重叠，早期客观检测困难。现有方法难以从腕戴传感器数据中可靠区分这些行为。
Method: 面向腕戴式多模态传感器数据，设计 CNN+GRU 架构，配合各模态自编码器和晚期融合 (late fusion) 分类器，利用运动、热信号和近距离信号的时空动态；并用 Shapley additive explanations 和层次聚类进行事后可解释性与误差分析。
Result: 在二分类任务上 F1 为 0.985、AUC 为 0.997；在区分每个具体行为与单一 Non-Target 类的九类方案上，宏平均 F1 为 0.700、AUC 为 0.963，超过单模态基线。可解释性分析显示 ToF 与惯性模态贡献最大，误分类主要由手势的解剖部位驱动。
Conclusion: 摘要认为多模态传感器融合可实现准确、客观、持续的行为监测，为实时可穿戴心理健康诊断和个性化干预奠定基础。
