papers.title: Multi-Agent AI Safety as an Institutional Design Problem
papers.abstract_en: AI agents increasingly work inside systems that govern how they delegate tasks, move information, execute actions, and use shared resources. Recent work already shows that deployment rules can change collective behavior. Here we ask which parts of an AI institution produce safety and how they do it. This is the first paper from POLIS, an ongoing research programme studying algorithmic institutions for multi-agent systems. We report a frozen 5,280-episode study suite. The main pre-specified delegation experiment spans four model families; a targeted high-conflict diagnostic adds three additional model endpoints. In matched structured workflows, the model sees different rule formulations and guards consult different authority states. We also vary the attractiveness of the immediate compliant internal/self fallback and allow blocked workflows to continue. A detailed constitutional prompt produces 0/384 realized violations. A provenance-aware executable guard also produces 0/384, although it blocks prohibited attempts in 51/384 episodes; 44/51 of those episodes later complete safely. The local-state guard's failures concentrate in scenarios where an ordinary transformation changes visible policy while originating authority stays fixed. In matched laundering scenarios, that guard admits violations in 22/96 episodes and provenance enforcement in 0/96 (p = 4.77 x 10^-7). A separate resource-allocation experiment shows that revealing the numerical value of an otherwise identical cap changes agent requests. In these structured workflows, the same final violation rate can hide very different mechanisms. The rule itself is only part of the institution. The authority state the system trusts matters, and so does the path available after a block.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 5 figures. Code and reproducibility artifacts available in the public POLIS repository
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将多智能体 AI 安全视为制度设计 (institutional design) 问题，研究 AI 机构中哪些组成部分产生安全性以及如何产生。作为 POLIS 研究项目的首篇论文，作者报告了一个冻结的 5,280 集研究套件，在结构化工作流中比较不同规则表述、授权状态、内部回退选项与执行路径。预指定的委派实验涵盖多个模型族，详细宪法提示与可溯源执行守卫分别实现 0/384 的已实现违规，而局部状态守卫在洗钱场景中出现显著更高的违规率。
Motivation: 现有研究已表明部署规则能改变集体行为，但尚未系统回答 AI 机构中哪些具体部分负责安全、通过何种机制实现。需要识别除规则本身之外同样影响安全结果的制度要素。
Method: 构建结构化工作流实验套件，固定 5,280 集场景，使模型面对不同规则表述、守卫参考不同授权状态，并改变合规内部回退的吸引力、允许被阻止的工作流继续。对比详细宪法提示、可溯源执行守卫与局部状态守卫，另设资源分配实验考察揭示数值上限对请求的影响。
Result: 详细宪法提示与可溯源执行守卫均报告 0/384 已实现违规，后者在 51/384 集中阻止被禁止尝试，其中 44/51 后续安全完成。局部状态守卫的失败集中在可见策略被变换而来源授权不变的情形；在匹配的洗钱场景中，该守卫在 22/96 集内放行违规，而可溯源执行在 0/96 (p = 4.77 x 10^-7)。资源分配实验显示揭示相同上限的数值会改变智能体请求。
Conclusion: 相同的最终违规率可能隐藏完全不同的机制：规则本身只是制度的一部分，系统信任的授权状态以及被阻止后的可用路径同样重要。论文强调需要从制度层面而非仅规则层面理解多智能体安全。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有研究已表明部署规则能改变集体行为，但尚未系统回答 AI 机构中哪些具体部分负责安全、通过何种机制实现。需要识别除规则本身之外同样影响安全结果的制度要素。
summary_sections.method: 构建结构化工作流实验套件，固定 5,280 集场景，使模型面对不同规则表述、守卫参考不同授权状态，并改变合规内部回退的吸引力、允许被阻止的工作流继续。对比详细宪法提示、可溯源执行守卫与局部状态守卫，另设资源分配实验考察揭示数值上限对请求的影响。
summary_sections.result: 详细宪法提示与可溯源执行守卫均报告 0/384 已实现违规，后者在 51/384 集中阻止被禁止尝试，其中 44/51 后续安全完成。局部状态守卫的失败集中在可见策略被变换而来源授权不变的情形；在匹配的洗钱场景中，该守卫在 22/96 集内放行违规，而可溯源执行在 0/96 (p = 4.77 x 10^-7)。资源分配实验显示揭示相同上限的数值会改变智能体请求。
summary_sections.conclusion: 相同的最终违规率可能隐藏完全不同的机制：规则本身只是制度的一部分，系统信任的授权状态以及被阻止后的可用路径同样重要。论文强调需要从制度层面而非仅规则层面理解多智能体安全。

papers.title: Distill Skills into Weights, Not Prompts: Abstract Skills as Privileged Signals for On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards yields no group-relative signal when rollout groups are uniformly correct or uniformly wrong, which account for 63.0-68.0% of groups in our experiments. We propose SKALD (Skill-Anchored Latent Distillation), an on-policy self-distillation framework that uses two context views of the same Qwen3-Base model: a question-only student and a teacher conditioned on an abstract, explicit-answer-filtered skill card. The student is trained on its own prefixes, transferring the skill-induced advantage into shared parameters without privileged input at test time. To stabilize context-induced distribution mismatch, SKALD employs an annealed exponentially tilted objective that downweights teacher-preferred tokens with very low student likelihood; as the tilt vanishes, it converges to teacher cross-entropy and recovers the forward-KL student gradient. An empirical gate activates distillation only when verified rollouts estimate a positive teacher advantage. Across five held-out mathematics benchmarks, SKALD improves overall avg@8 over GRPO by +2.46, +4.85, and +12.01 at 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B, respectively. At 1.7B, zero-variance-only distillation recovers 84.7% of the full gain, while SKALD remains +4.06 above FLOP-matched GRPO and exceeds contextual skill exposure by +3.77. These results show that abstract skills provide dense supervision where group-relative rewards become uninformative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SKALD（Skill-Anchored Latent Distillation），一个面向可验证奖励强化学习的 on-policy 自蒸馏框架。摘要指出，当 rollout 组全部正确或全部错误时（实验中占 63.0-68.0% 的组），组相对奖励不提供有效信号；SKALD 用同一 Qwen3-Base 模型的两个上下文视图，让仅含问题的学生从经显式答案筛选的抽象技能卡（abstract skill card）教师处蒸馏，把技能优势写入共享参数，测试时无需特权输入。在五个数学基准上，avg@8 相对 GRPO 的提升为 +2.46（0.6B）、+4.85（1.7B）和 +12.01（4B）。
Motivation: 可验证奖励下的强化学习在 rollout 组全部正确或全部错误时缺乏组间相对信号，而这种无信息组占实验数据的 63.0-68.0%，导致训练信号稀疏。
Method: SKALD 使用同一基础模型的两个上下文视图：question-only 学生和以抽象技能卡为条件的教师；学生基于自身前缀训练，将教师捕获的技能优势迁移到共享参数。为稳定上下文导致的分布不匹配，提出退火的指数倾斜目标，给教师偏好但学生似然极低的 token 降权；倾斜项消失后损失退化为教师交叉熵，恢复 forward-KL 学生梯度。另设经验门控，仅在验证 rollout 估计出正教师优势时开启蒸馏。
Result: 在五个 held-out 数学基准上，SKALD 的相对 GRPO 的 avg@8 提升在 0.6B、1.7B、4B 规模下分别为 +2.46、+4.85、+12.01。在 1.7B 规模下，仅使用零方差组蒸馏可恢复全量增益的 84.7%；SKALD 仍比 FLOP-matched GRPO 高 +4.06，比上下文技能暴露（contextual skill exposure）高 +3.77。
Conclusion: 摘要认为抽象技能能在组相对奖励失效时提供密集监督；实验表明将技能蒸馏进权重而非提示，可以在多个模型规模上稳定提升数学推理性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Macaron-V1: Towards Open Continual Learning with Self-Improvement and Mixture-of-LoRA
papers.abstract_en: Macaron-V1 is an open agent-model family for experiential intelligence: learning from experience in real environments and continuing to learn after deployment. It is organized around two system goals. Adaptation is pursued through recursive improvement of versioned model-harness pairs, where experience from one configuration is evaluated under an external contract and used to construct its successor. Collaboration is pursued via the Mixture-of-LoRA (MoL) architecture that freezes a base model, composes specialist LoRA adapters, and selects one LoRA per user turn. The flagship Macaron-V1-Venti combines a 744B GLM-5.2 base with four LoRAs for chat, agent, coding, and GenUI; the Qwen3.6-based Macaron-V1-Tall (50B) uses the same design for local deployment. This report presents Macaron-V1 as a co-designed system spanning architecture, algorithms, and infrastructure. The MoL architecture supports continual learning through extensible LoRA specialists. The algorithm combines Model-Harness Co-design and recursive self-improvement loop, including the UI4A component-native GenUI harness, a stateful action substrate, versioned HCP contract, and the agentic RL framework MindForge. The supporting infrastructure includes the post-training platform MinT, the long-context RL method LongStraw, and stability techniques for sparse MoE and DSA base models. We evaluate Macaron-V1 on Personal Intelligence, GenUI, and general capability benchmarks against frontier baselines. Our results validate the current system, while compounding gains from continual learning and collective intelligence remain open questions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Macaron-V1 是一个面向体验智能 (experiential intelligence) 的开源 agent 模型家族，核心目标是让模型在真实环境中从经验中学习并在部署后持续学习。系统围绕两个目标设计：通过版本化模型-测试平台 (model-harness) 对的递归改进实现自适应，通过 Mixture-of-LoRA (MoL) 架构实现协作，后者冻结基座模型、组合专家 LoRA 并在每个用户回合选择其中一个。旗舰模型 Venti 使用 744B GLM-5.2 基座搭配 chat、agent、coding、GenUI 四个 LoRA；基于 Qwen3.6 的 Tall (50B) 采用相同设计面向本地部署。报告在 Personal Intelligence、GenUI 和通用能力基准上对前沿基线进行了评估，验证了当前系统。
Motivation: 现有模型主要在静态数据集上训练，缺乏在真实环境中从交互经验中持续学习的能力，难以在部署后适应新任务和用户需求。
Method: 提出模型-测试平台协同设计 (Model-Harness Co-design) 与递归自我改进循环，结合 MoL 架构支持通过可扩展 LoRA 专家实现持续学习；基础设施包括后训练平台 MinT、长上下文 RL 方法 LongStraw，以及针对稀疏 MoE 和 DSA 基座的稳定性技术。
Result: 摘要报告在 Personal Intelligence、GenUI 和通用能力基准上对前沿基线进行了评估，结果验证了当前系统；但持续学习和集体智能带来的复合收益仍是开放问题。
Conclusion: 本文以技术报告形式呈现 Macaron-V1 作为架构、算法和基础设施协同设计的完整系统，确认当前设计有效，同时承认持续学习与集体智能的累积增益尚未得到验证。

papers.title: MedPixel: A Unified Pixel-Language Model for Medical Reasoning and Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable medical image understanding requires models to connect clinical language and visual reasoning with pixel-level grounding. Yet medical vision-language models often lack precise localization, whereas medical segmenters typically rely on explicit target categories or precise spatial prompts. This divide is reinforced by a supervision mismatch: segmentation datasets provide precise masks but little language supervision, whereas medical vision-language data rarely pair language with dense spatial annotations. To address this gap, we present MedPixel, a unified medical pixel-language model built around a shared language--mask interface. To provide scalable supervision, we introduce MedPLG-440K, comprising approximately 440K pixel-language task samples constructed through a clinically motivated synthesis process without external LLM annotation. MedPixel is trained with joint multi-task supervised fine-tuning followed by Pixel-Level Preference Optimization, which uses ground-truth masks as offline verifiers to derive response preferences from mask quality. MedPixel supports a broad spectrum of tasks spanning explicit grounding, implicit reasoning, spatial interaction, grounded explanation, and medical VQA. Across this task spectrum, MedPixel achieves strong performance in both pixel-level prediction and response generation, together with effective zero-shot transfer to external grounding benchmarks and robustness to imperfect spatial prompts. Code and model checkpoints will be released at https://github.com/yhy-whu/Medpixel.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedPixel，一个统一医学像素-语言模型，通过共享的语言-掩码接口将临床语言、视觉推理与像素级定位结合。作者构造约 440K 样本的 MedPLG-440K 像素-语言任务数据，采用多任务监督微调与 Pixel-Level Preference Optimization 训练，支持显式定位、隐式推理、空间交互、可解释分割和医学 VQA 等任务。摘要报告其在像素级预测与响应生成上表现良好，并能零样本迁移到外部定位基准且对不完美空间提示具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 医学视觉语言模型常缺乏精确定位能力，而医学分割模型通常依赖显式目标类别或精确空间提示；两类数据监督不匹配（分割数据有掩码但缺乏语言监督，视觉语言数据少有密集空间标注）加剧了这一鸿沟。
Method: 提出 MedPixel 统一模型，围绕共享的语言-掩码接口设计；引入 MedPLG-440K 数据集，通过临床动机驱动的合成流程生成像素-语言任务样本，无需外部 LLM 标注；训练采用联合多任务监督微调，再以真实掩码作为离线验证器进行 Pixel-Level Preference Optimization。
Result: 摘要报告 MedPixel 在显式定位、隐式推理、空间交互、可解释分割和医学 VQA 的任务谱系上均取得强性能，并具备到外部定位基准的有效零样本迁移和对不完美空间提示的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为统一语言-掩码建模结合大规模合成像素-语言监督和基于掩码质量的偏好优化，能够弥合医学语言与像素级定位之间的鸿沟；代码与模型权重将开源。

papers.title: Parameter Exploration for RLVR via Variational Learning
papers.abstract_en: Exploration has been a focus of reinforcement learning research for a long time. Recently, there has been growing evidence that it is also an important ingredient in LLM reinforcement learning recipes that can significantly impact downstream performance. Many existing methods control exploration in the action-space, for example, using temperature scaling. However, these methods cannot reorder tokens but only influence the variance in the output distribution. This limits exploration and can lead to divergence or stalled training. Here, we investigate parameter-space exploration, where rollouts are generated by sampling different policies from a posterior that may each explore different rollouts. Sampling less or more diverse policies is then a complementary control lever over exploration. We introduce a family of methods called Perturbed Parameter Policy Optimization (3PO) which use different sampling strategies and different rollout grouping for reward estimation. Experiments on OLMo-3-1025-7B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks show that these approaches consistently improve average downstream performance over standard GRPO at a near-identical FLOPs cost. Moreover, using multiple parameter samples consistently produces fewer zero-advantage groups and malformed or incorrect rollouts during training than GRPO and action-space baselines. Overall, our work presents evidence that parameter-space exploration can improve reinforcement learning for LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型强化学习中参数空间探索的作用，提出一组名为 Perturbed Parameter Policy Optimization (3PO) 的方法，通过对策略后验进行多次采样生成不同 rollout，并配合不同 rollout 分组进行奖励估计。实验在 OLMo-3-1025-7B 和 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 上的数学推理与代码生成任务中显示，该方法相比标准 GRPO 在近乎相同的 FLOPs 成本下持续提升平均下游性能，并减少零优势分组和异常 rollout。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 强化学习方法主要在动作空间（如 temperature scaling）控制探索，但这类方法只能影响输出分布的方差而不能重新排列 token，限制了探索能力，可能导致训练发散或停滞。作者因此转向参数空间探索，通过采样不同策略来互补地控制探索程度。
Method: 提出方法族 3PO，核心是让 rollout 由从后验中采样的不同策略生成，每种策略可能探索不同轨迹；方法内部采用不同的采样策略与 rollout 分组方式用于奖励估计，并与标准 GRPO 进行比较。
Result: 在 OLMo-3-1025-7B 与 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 的数学推理和代码生成任务上，3PO 以几乎相同的 FLOPs 成本持续优于标准 GRPO 的平均下游性能；使用多个参数样本时，训练中出现的零优势分组以及格式错误或不正确 rollout 也少于 GRPO 和动作空间基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为参数空间探索可以改善 LLM 的强化学习效果，为探索控制提供了一个不同于动作空间的方法维度。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出方法族 3PO，核心是让 rollout 由从后验中采样的不同策略生成，每种策略可能探索不同轨迹；方法内部采用不同的采样策略与 rollout 分组方式用于奖励估计，并与标准 GRPO 进行比较。
summary_sections.result: 在 OLMo-3-1025-7B 与 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 的数学推理和代码生成任务上，3PO 以几乎相同的 FLOPs 成本持续优于标准 GRPO 的平均下游性能；使用多个参数样本时，训练中出现的零优势分组以及格式错误或不正确 rollout 也少于 GRPO 和动作空间基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为参数空间探索可以改善 LLM 的强化学习效果，为探索控制提供了一个不同于动作空间的方法维度。

papers.title: Modern Backbones Improve Multi-task DETR for Mammography Classification and Lesion Localization
papers.abstract_en: Joint exam-level prediction and candidate-region localization may improve the usefulness of AI support in mammography. We study this setting using a multi-task DETR framework, where shared representations support both image-level malignancy prediction and lesion localization, and evaluate its performance on OPTIMAM and a biopsy-confirmed SGM1k cohort. Across both datasets, modern backbones consistently outperformed older ResNet-style features, with ConvNeXtV2 and DINOv3 giving the strongest overall results, whereas MambaVision was less competitive. On OPTIMAM, ConvNeXtV2 achieved the best overall performance, reaching 97.96% AUC, 99.89% sensitivity, 25.08% mAP@.5, and 74.38% recall@.25. On SGM1k, DINOv3 gave the strongest overall results, with 90.97% AUC, 86.28% sensitivity, 82.00% specificity, 27.04% mAP@.5, and 77.32% recall@.25. These findings suggest that backbone quality is a critical factor in effective multi-task mammography, with ConvNeXtV2 emerging as a particularly strong and well-matched CNN backbone for mammography in this framework.

papers.title: CARD: Controlled Agentic Reddit Discussions for Credit Card Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Online credit card discussions provide a natural setting for studying how consumers communicate about financial products. Simulating these discussions requires more than just generating individual comments, the generated threads should also match how real users express themselves and interact with others. We introduce CARD, a framework for generating realistic credit card discussion threads. Given a credit card post and its matched real thread, CARD uses non-verbatim guidance on reply structure, comment function, stance, tone, and conversational variation. A planner organizes these controls, a writer generates the discussion, and a calibration loop updates comments' populations that contribute to differences between the generated and real thread distributions. We evaluate CARD on real Reddit credit card discussions using lexical, semantic, behavioral, and structural metrics. CARD matches the distributions of real credit card discussions better than simulation baselines across multiple LLMs and also demonstrates smaller effect sizes and distribution distances across metrics. These results show that structured planning and targeted revision can generate the realism of simulated credit card discussions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CARD，一个用于生成逼真 Reddit 信用卡讨论串的框架。给定信用卡帖子及其匹配的真实讨论串，CARD 使用关于回复结构、评论功能、立场、语气和对话变化的非逐字引导；规划器组织这些控制，生成器撰写讨论，校准循环更新评论群体以减少生成分布与真实分布的差异。在真实 Reddit 信用卡讨论上采用词汇、语义、行为和结构指标评估，CARD 在多个 LLM 上比模拟基线更好地匹配真实分布。
Motivation: 在线信用卡讨论为研究消费者如何沟通金融产品提供了自然场景，但模拟这类讨论不能只生成单条评论，还要求生成的讨论串在真实用户的表达方式和互动模式上与之匹配。
Method: 提出 CARD 框架，包含规划器（organizes controls）、生成器（writer）和校准循环（calibration loop）；通过回复结构、评论功能、立场、语气和对话变化等非逐字引导控制生成，并用校准循环调整评论群体以缩小生成与真实讨论分布之间的差异。
Result: 在多个 LLM 上，CARD 比模拟基线更好地匹配真实信用卡讨论的分布，并在各项指标上表现出更小的效应量（effect sizes）和分布距离（distribution distances）。
Conclusion: 结构化规划和针对性修订能够提升模拟信用卡讨论的真实感，表明该框架可用于生成逼真的金融产品讨论模拟。

papers.title: ADOPD: Reference-Privileged On-Policy Distillation for MLLM-Based Industrial Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Industrial anomaly detection (IAD) requires identifying fine-grained deviations from normal visual patterns. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can improve recognition accuracy by comparing query images with references at inference time, but these benefits rely on additional retrieval and processing. We investigate whether the benefits of reference comparison can instead be internalized in the model parameters. Access to references during training allows a reference-aware teacher to supervise a query-only student. However, the teacher may favor plausible responses based on query cues or language priors rather than valid visual information. We propose ADOPD, a reference-privileged on-policy distillation framework. The teacher evaluates student-generated rollouts under matched and mismatched references. The matched-reference teacher-to-student log-ratio defines the token-level learning direction, specifying what the student should learn. The likelihood gap between the two reference views estimates reference-specific support and calibrates the sequence-level weight. ADOPD achieves 77.31% average accuracy on the MMAD benchmark under zero-shot inference, improving the Qwen3-VL-4B backbone by 6.14 points and outperforming its one-shot setting by 2.64 points. Experiments show that ADOPD learns a fine-grained anomaly inspection strategy from reference comparison. The project will be available at https://github.com/withTai/ADOPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ADOPD，一种参考特权在线策略蒸馏（reference-privileged on-policy distillation）框架，用于基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的工业异常检测（IAD）。其核心思路是在训练时让教师模型分别看到匹配与不匹配的参考图像，用两者对学生生成 rollouts 的对数似然比定义 token 级学习方向，并用似然差校准序列级权重，从而把参考比较的能力内化到仅依赖查询（query-only）的学生模型中。在 MMAD 基准上，零样本推理平均准确率达到 77.31%，比 Qwen3-VL-4B 骨干提升 6.14 个点，并超过其 one-shot 设置 2.64 个点。
Motivation: 工业异常检测需要在推理时将查询图像与参考图像比较以发现细微偏差，但这种收益依赖额外的检索与处理成本。作者研究能否把参考比较的好处内化进模型参数，并指出直接蒸馏时教师可能依据查询线索或语言先验生成貌似合理的回答，而非有效视觉信息。
Method: ADOPD 框架中，参考特权（reference-privileged）教师监督仅查询的学生模型；教师评估学生生成的 rollouts，分别在匹配与不匹配参考下计算 token 级教师到学生的 log-ratio 作为学习方向，并用两个参考视图之间的似然差距估计参考特异性支持度，进而校准序列级权重。
Result: 摘要报告 ADOPD 在 MMAD 基准上零样本推理的平均准确率为 77.31%，相对 Qwen3-VL-4B 骨干提升 6.14 点，并比该骨干的 one-shot 设置高出 2.64 点。实验表明 ADOPD 从参考比较中习得了细粒度的异常检查策略。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过参考特权在线策略蒸馏可以在推理时去除显式参考比较的负担，同时保持甚至提升异常检测精度；项目代码将开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NTIRE 2026 Low-light Enhancement: Twilight Cowboy Challenge
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a review of the NTIRE 2026 Low-light Enhancement: Twilight Cowboy Challenge. The objective of the competition was to merge a set of misaligned smartphone images in the raw domain, captured in low-light conditions, into a single, clean image. Introduced setup simultaneously addresses two problems of low-light photography: visual degradations such as high noise and mixed scene illuminants, and the geometric inconsistencies caused by hand movement during multi-frame capture. To advance research in low-light and nighttime computational photography, a challenging dataset was collected comprising 585 real-world scenes, spanning indoor low-light and outdoor nighttime conditions, for training and benchmarking participant solutions. The competition employed a three-stage evaluation protocol: automatic validation via the CodaBench platform in stages one and two, followed by blind assessment on a private test set for the final ranking. Ten teams surpassed the established baseline, achieving improvements of up to +6.49 dB in PSNR and +0.0101 in SSIM, thereby establishing new state-of-the-art performance for burst-based low-light image enhancement. These results demonstrate significant progress in handling real-world noise, motion, and illumination variability in the low-light setting. Comprehensive results, leaderboards, and additional information are publicly available at https://nightimaging.org.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 NTIRE 2026 低光增强挑战赛（Twilight Cowboy Challenge）的总结报告。比赛任务是将低光条件下拍摄的一组未对齐智能手机 raw 域图像合并为一张干净图像，同时处理噪声、混合光照和手持运动造成的几何不一致。作者收集了 585 个真实场景用于训练和评估，并采用三阶段评估协议（前两阶段在 CodaBench 上自动验证，最后阶段在私有测试集上盲测）。最终 10 支队伍超过基线，最高提升 +6.49 dB PSNR 和 +0.0101 SSIM。
Motivation: 低光多帧摄影同时面临视觉退化（高噪声、混合场景光照）和手持拍摄带来的几何错位，现有方法往往只针对其中一个问题。该挑战试图在一个统一的 raw 域多帧合并设置下推进低光和夜间计算摄影研究。
Method: 组织了一个基于 585 个真实室内低光和室外夜间场景的数据集，并设计了三阶段评估流程：阶段一和阶段二通过 CodaBench 平台自动验证，最终排名基于私有测试集的盲测。
Result: 摘要报告 10 支参赛队伍超过了既定基线，其中最佳结果在 PSNR 上提升多达 +6.49 dB，SSIM 提升 +0.0101，创下了基于 burst 的低光图像增强的新 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 结果表明该方法在处理真实噪声、运动和多变照明条件的低光场景方面取得了显著进展；数据集、排行榜和更多信息已在 https://nightimaging.org 公开。

papers.title: KGCaRe: Explainable Complex Conditional Question Answering using Automatic Knowledge Graph Construction and Context Retrieval with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Answering complex conditional questions using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) remains a challenge, particularly in domain-specific contexts where general-purpose LLMs and RAG tend to underperform. We hypothesize that augmenting RAG with unstructured and structured knowledge, extracted from both documents and knowledge graphs (KGs), can improve reasoning and answer accuracy for such tasks. To test this, we propose KGCaRe, a hybrid approach that combines neural retrieval with symbolic reasoning over LLM-generated KGs. KGCaRe constructs a KG from documents using a multi-prompt extraction strategy and stores it in a graph database. Simultaneously, the documents are embedded into a vector store to enable neural retrieval. KGCaRe performs innovative iterative graph traversal guided by the LLM to extract relevant triples, prune irrelevant information, and uses additional clue entities to traverse the graph again if the initial traversal does not provide satisfactory context to generate the answer. The relevant triples extracted from the KG in path form, along with semantically retrieved text passages, are then fed into custom KGCaRe prompts to generate answers to the complex conditional questions with explanations. We evaluate KGCaRe on two complex conditional QA datasets. Our results on these datasets show that KGCaRe consistently outperforms existing baselines, including Vanilla LLM, Code Prompt, Text Prompt, Think-on-Graph, Vanilla RAG, and HybridContextQA, across multiple LLMs such as Mistral, Mixtral, GPT-3.5, and GPT-4o. We publicly release the software pipeline that we developed to implement the proposed KGCaRe approach.

TL;DR: 本文提出 KGCaRe，一种面向复杂条件问答的混合方法，将神经检索与基于 LLM 生成知识图谱的符号推理相结合。系统从文档中用多提示策略构建知识图谱存入图数据库，同时将文档嵌入向量库；推理时由 LLM 引导进行迭代图遍历，提取相关三元组路径并结合语义检索的文本片段送入定制提示生成带解释的答案。在两个复杂条件问答数据集上的实验表明，KGCaRe 在多个 LLM 上一致优于若干基线。
Motivation: 通用大语言模型和检索增强生成 (RAG) 在领域特定的复杂条件问答上表现不佳，作者假设将文档和知识图谱中的非结构化与结构化知识同时补充给 RAG 可以改善推理与答案准确性。
Method: KGCaRe 采用混合架构：先用多提示抽取策略从文档自动构建知识图谱并存入图数据库，同时将文档嵌入向量库；随后执行由 LLM 指导的迭代图遍历，提取相关三元组、剪枝无关信息，并在初始遍历不充分时利用线索实体再次遍历；最终将路径形式的三元组与语义检索文本片段输入定制 KGCaRe 提示生成答案和解释。
Result: 在两个复杂条件问答数据集上，KGCaRe 在 Mistral、Mixtral、GPT-3.5 和 GPT-4o 等多个 LLM 上均一致超过 Vanilla LLM、Code Prompt、Text Prompt、Think-on-Graph、Vanilla RAG 和 HybridContextQA 等基线，并公开了完整软件流水线。
Conclusion: 摘要指出将文档抽取的知识图谱与向量检索结合、并以 LLM 引导的迭代图遍历来获取上下文，能有效提升复杂条件问答的表现；作者公开了实现该方法的软件流水线。

papers.title: AirFlow: Context Preserving and Multi-Rate State Modeling for Air Quality Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate air quality forecasting is essential for public health and urban environmental management, but remains challenging because pollutant channels differ in periodicity and distribution drift, while their concentration trajectories contain both multi-scale dependencies and rapid changes. Recent methods have improved spatial dependency learning and meteorological covariate modeling. However, pollutant channels are still passed through the same normalization rule and temporal backbone, using a shared latent representation for channel-specific distributions and changes at different rates. To address this limitation, we propose AirFlow, a pollutant-aware dual-stream framework that operates on station multivariate observations without additional graph propagation or predefined signal decomposition. Specifically, AirFlow designs two novel blocks: (1) a statistic-guided normalization routing mechanism that selects a normalization path for each pollutant according to its 24-hour autocorrelation and distribution drift; and (2) a hierarchical dual-stream state model that combines multi-scale state space propagation with learnable response coefficients, where gated bidirectional cross-attention exchanges information and adaptively fuses the resulting representations. Experiments on real-world data from multiple cities show that AirFlow achieves the best performance in 34 of 36 metrics comparisons, with reductions of up to 11.11% root mean square error over the state-of-the-art baseline. AirFlow also requires only 0.0483M parameters and 0.0215G FLOPs, achieving high forecasting accuracy with low computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AirFlow，一个污染物感知的双流框架用于空气质量预测。针对污染物通道在周期性和分布漂移上的差异，设计了统计引导的归一化路由机制，以及层次化双流状态模型，并通过门控双向交叉注意力融合表示。在多个城市真实数据上，AirFlow在36项指标比较中取得34项最佳，RMSE相对最强基线最高降低11.11%，且仅需0.0483M参数和0.0215G FLOPs。
Motivation: 现有空气质量预测方法虽改进了空间依赖和气象协变量建模，但污染物通道仍被施加相同的归一化规则和时间骨干，用共享隐表示处理通道特有分布和不同速率的变化，限制了精度。
Method: AirFlow是运行在站点多变量观测上的污染物感知双流框架，无需额外图传播或预定义信号分解。它包含两个新模块：统计引导的归一化路由机制，根据24小时自相关和分布漂移为每种污染物选择归一化路径；以及层次化双流状态模型，结合多尺度状态空间传播与可学习响应系数，并用门控双向交叉注意力交换信息并自适应融合表示。
Result: 在多个城市的真实数据实验中，AirFlow在36项指标比较中的34项取得最优，相对最强基线将RMSE最高降低11.11%；模型仅含0.0483M参数和0.0215G FLOPs。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过污染物特异的归一化选择和双流多速率状态建模，可以在极低计算开销下显著提升空气质量预测精度。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: C$^2$A: Coupling Spatial Evidence with Clinical Priors via Co-occurrence Aware Class Attention for Multi-Label Chest X-Ray Classification
papers.abstract_en: Thoracic pathologies rarely occur in isolation, yet standard multi-label classifiers rely on shared global descriptors, discarding \emph{where} findings lie and \emph{how} they co-occur. We propose \textbf{C$\mathbf{^2}$A} (Co-occurrence Aware Class Attention), a classification head that explicitly couples spatial evidence with clinical priors. First, C$^2$A casts pooling as an expectation over learned per-class spatial attention maps, yielding localized descriptors for each disease. Second, it couples these descriptors via a learnable graph warm-started from empirical label co-occurrence. A single residual message-passing step shares evidence among related findings, proving to be a bounded perturbation of the identity where co-occurrence enters each logit through an explicit bilinear interaction. On CheXpert, C$^2$A achieves a superior $0.895$ macro-mean AUROC, outperforming advanced context-gating baselines. Crucially, gains concentrate on highly co-occurrent classes with ambiguous spatial evidence (rescuing Atelectasis by $+1.5$ over GCG), demonstrating the prior's regularizing effect with a negligible overhead of one linear projection and a $C\!\times\!C$ edge matrix.
papers.comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 C$^2$A (Co-occurrence Aware Class Attention) 分类头，用于多标签胸部 X 光分类。它将池化建模为逐类空间注意力图上的期望，得到每种疾病的局部化描述子，并通过从经验标签共现初始化的可学习图耦合描述子，经一次残差消息传递共享证据。在 CheXpert 上达到 0.895 的 macro-mean AUROC，优于 context-gating 基线，且对高共现、空间证据模糊的类别提升明显。
Motivation: 标准多标签分类器依赖共享全局描述子，丢弃了病理发现的位置和共现关系，而胸腔病理很少孤立出现，因此需要显式利用空间证据与临床先验。
Method: C$^2$A 将 pooling 视为学习到的逐类空间注意力图上的期望，得到每类局部化描述子；随后用经验标签共现初始化的可学习图耦合这些描述子，通过单步残差消息传递共享证据，使共现以显式双线性交互进入每个 logit，并被证明是恒等映射的有界扰动。额外开销仅为一条线性投影和 C×C 边矩阵。
Result: 在 CheXpert 上 macro-mean AUROC 达到 0.895，优于高级 context-gating 基线；增益集中在高共现且空间证据模糊的类别，例如 Atelectasis 相对 GCG 提升 +1.5。
Conclusion: 摘要强调临床共现先验以极低额外开销起到正则化作用，说明将空间证据与标签共现耦合能够改善多标签胸部 X 光分类。

papers.title: ReliableNet: A Chance-Constrained Approach to Trustworthy Classification in Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: A prediction that is both confident and wrong is a critical reliability failure because it can bypass abstention and human review precisely when the model is mistaken. Empirical risk minimization (ERM) controls average loss but not this failure directly, while calibration, uncertainty estimation, conformal risk control, and selective prediction methods target related reliability properties rather than bounding the joint failure event during training. We propose ReliableNet, which constrains the Joint Confident-Wrong (JCW) probability, the probability that a prediction is simultaneously confident and incorrect, below a user-specified risk budget $α\in(0,1)$. We formulate this as a chance-constrained ERM problem, use a conservative smooth inner approximation whose population feasibility implies the original JCW constraint. Across four tabular and two image datasets, ReliableNet is the only method certified within the JCW budget for every dataset and seed in distribution, when compared against baselines spanning ERM, post-hoc calibration, conformal risk control, and selective prediction. Under demographic, ambiguity, spurious-correlation, novel-class, and covariate shifts, it achieves the lowest empirical JCW among the compared methods while remaining very competitive in accuracy, coverage, calibration, and selective prediction. Risk-coverage results further indicate that ReliableNet achieves better selective ranking than the benchmark methods on most datasets. Overall, ReliableNet provides a principled approach to trustworthy classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReliableNet，一种将预测同时“自信且错误”（Joint Confident-Wrong, JCW）的概率约束在用户指定风险预算 α 之下的分类方法。作者将问题建模为机会约束 (chance-constrained) ERM，并用一个保守的光滑内逼近来保证原 JCW 约束的可行性。实验在四个表格数据集和两个图像数据集上对比 ERM、事后校准、共形风险控制和选择性预测等方法，ReliableNet 是唯一在分布内所有数据集和随机种子上均满足 JCW 预算的方法，并在多种分布偏移下取得最低经验 JCW。
Motivation: 标准经验风险最小化只控制平均损失，无法直接约束“高置信但错误”这一关键可靠性失败事件；校准、不确定性估计、共形风险控制和选择性预测等方法只针对相关可靠性性质，而非在训练中直接限制该联合失败事件。
Method: ReliableNet 将 JCW 概率约束建模为机会约束 ERM 问题，并采用保守光滑内逼近，使得该逼近的总体可行性蕴含原始 JCW 约束；训练目标是在给定用户风险预算 α 下约束并优化分类性能。
Result: 在四个表格和两个图像数据集上，ReliableNet 是唯一在分布内对所有数据集和随机种子满足 JCW 预算的方法；在人口统计、歧义、虚假相关、新类别和协变量偏移下取得最低经验 JCW，同时在准确率、覆盖率、校准和选择性预测上保持竞争力，并在多数数据集上获得更好的选择性排序。
Conclusion: 作者认为 ReliableNet 为可信分类提供了一种有原则的方法，直接训练并约束联合自信错误概率，相比现有可靠性和选择性预测方法具有更可信的保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cultivar: A Contrastive and Locale-Oriented Translation Benchmark for Investigating Contamination and Localisation Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Multilingual translation benchmarks are typically sourced in English and translated into other languages, treating language pairs as the unit of evaluation---a design that is prone to contamination over time and overlooks locale and cultural considerations. We therefore advocate for source-contrastive evaluation and instantiate it with Cultivar, a localised subset of FLORES, which enables locale-specific translation evaluation. When paired with unlocalised counterparts, performance discrepancy allows the probing of data contamination and localisation robustness. We benchmark 32 open-weight models and find that MT-specialised models are less robust, a few models potentially overfit FLORES, and models tend to translate US content better than that of other locales, regardless of language.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Cultivar，一个基于 FLORES 的本地化子集，用于源语言对比式（source-contrastive）多语翻译评测；通过将本地化版本与未本地化版本配对，利用性能差异来探测数据污染（data contamination）和本地化鲁棒性（localisation robustness）。作者对 32 个开放权重模型进行基准测试，发现 MT 专用模型鲁棒性较差，少数模型可能过拟合 FLORES，且模型普遍翻译美国（US）内容的效果优于其他地区内容，与具体语言无关。
Motivation: 现有多语翻译基准通常从英语翻译到其他语言，以语言对作为评测单元，这种设计容易随时间发生数据污染，并忽略 locale 与文化差异。因此需要一种能够区分源内容差异的评测方式来更好地暴露这些问题。
Method: 提出 Cultivar，一个本地化的 FLORES 子集，支持针对特定地区（locale）的翻译评测；将其与未本地化的对应版本配对，通过二者翻译性能差异来探测数据污染与本地化鲁棒性。
Result: 对 32 个开放权重模型的基准测试表明，MT 专用模型在本地化鲁棒性上较弱，少数模型可能过拟合 FLORES，且模型整体对 US 内容的翻译优于其他地区内容，该现象与语言无关。
Conclusion: 作者倡导采用源对比式评测，并表明该方法可用于检测翻译模型的数据污染和本地化鲁棒性问题。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 提出 Cultivar，一个本地化的 FLORES 子集，支持针对特定地区（locale）的翻译评测；将其与未本地化的对应版本配对，通过二者翻译性能差异来探测数据污染与本地化鲁棒性。
summary_sections.result: 对 32 个开放权重模型的基准测试表明，MT 专用模型在本地化鲁棒性上较弱，少数模型可能过拟合 FLORES，且模型整体对 US 内容的翻译优于其他地区内容，该现象与语言无关。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者倡导采用源对比式评测，并表明该方法可用于检测翻译模型的数据污染和本地化鲁棒性问题。

papers.title: REFRAMED: Towards Realistic Audio Description Generation for Movies
papers.abstract_en: Audio Description (AD) is a verbal narration of key visual content in videos, enabling access for visually impaired audiences. Unlike standard video captioning, AD is a structured editorial task: descriptions must be inserted into gaps in dialogue and must convey only what is needed to understand the narrative being told. However, existing approaches formulate AD generation in an artificial setting where both the content and timing of descriptions are pre-specified, reducing the task to clip-level captioning. They further rely on noisy transcription and alignment pipelines, and lack the rich parallel data required for modeling narrative context. We introduce a new formulation of AD generation in which models must jointly decide what to describe and when to do it. To support this, we present REFRAMED, a high-quality dataset of 2,023 videos that span 3,302 scenes from 206 movies, with professional AD transcripts (both American and British versions), professional subtitles and aligned screenplays. We also provide a manually curated challenge set that pairs full movies with multiple AD references, together with evaluation protocols that leverage dialogue gaps and multi-reference comparisons. Experiments with state-of-the-art AD systems and multimodal LLMs show that they outperform trivial baselines but fall far short of expert human performance. Our dataset and benchmark establish a new foundation for research on video understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出电影音频描述 (Audio Description, AD) 生成的新任务形式，要求模型同时决定描述什么内容以及在对话间隙何时插入描述，而非仅做片段级字幕生成。作者发布 REFRAMED 数据集，包含 206 部电影的 2,023 个视频、3,302 个场景，配有专业 AD 字幕（美版与英版）、专业字幕和对齐剧本，并提供了人工策划的挑战集和多参考评估协议。实验表明现有 AD 系统与多模态大模型虽优于平凡基线，但远未达到专家人类水平。
Motivation: 现有 AD 生成方法将任务简化为片段级视频字幕生成，预设了描述的内容与时间，并依赖有噪声的转写和对齐流程，缺乏建模叙事上下文所需的丰富平行数据，不符合真实 AD 的结构化编辑性质。
Method: 提出联合决定描述内容与插入时间的新任务框架，构建 REFRAMED 数据集，利用对话间隙确定描述位置，提供美国与英国版本专业 AD 文本、专业字幕和对齐剧本，并设计基于对话间隙与多参考比较的评估协议。
Result: 基于最新 AD 系统与多模态大语言模型的实验显示，其性能超过平凡基线，但距离专家人类表现仍有很大差距。
Conclusion: 作者认为该数据集与基准为视频理解研究建立了新基础，同时暗示当前模型在处理真实 AD 生成任务上仍有显著不足。

papers.title: MoNo: Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator for Solving PDEs on General Geometries
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based neural operators have achieved substantial progress in solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) by projecting spatial observations into compact latent tokens and learning physical interactions in latent spaces. However, we reveal that existing learnable projection mechanisms cannot ensure stable and balanced assignments from observation points to latent tokens, causing some latent tokens to be over-assigned while others remain underutilized. This limitation further restricts the design of hierarchical architectures, as assignment imbalance is continuously inherited and amplified across latent spaces, eventually causing severe token collapse in deeper spaces. To address these issues, we propose MoNo (Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator), a progressive multiscale neural operator that efficiently solves PDEs on general geometries through stable latent-space construction. At its core is CoTAP (Cross-scale Optimal Transport Assignment and Projection), a novel latent-space construction method that formulates cross-space assignment between adjacent spaces as an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem, thereby constructing balanced bidirectional projections and stable latent spaces. CoTAP also ensures stable information transfer across multiple latent spaces, further enabling multiscale architectures on general geometries, which in turn support more efficient learning of long-range physical interactions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MoNo outperforms existing state-of-the-art neural operators in both prediction performance and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/ZijiangY1116/MoNo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MoNo（Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator），一种面向一般几何上 PDE 求解的渐进多尺度神经算子。作者指出现有 Transformer 神经算子的可学习投影机制无法保证观测点到潜在 token 的稳定均衡分配，导致深层空间出现 token collapse。MoNo 的核心是 CoTAP，将相邻潜在空间间的跨尺度分配建模为熵正则最优传输问题，从而构建平衡双向投影与稳定潜在空间。实验表明 MoNo 在预测性能和计算效率上优于现有最先进神经算子。
Motivation: 现有可学习投影机制在从观测点构建潜在 token 时存在分配不平衡问题：部分 token 被过度分配，其余 token 利用不足；这种不平衡在多尺度层级中会持续累积并放大，最终导致深层空间中的严重 token collapse，限制了层级架构的设计。
Method: 提出 MoNo，其核心组件 CoTAP 将相邻空间之间的跨尺度分配形式化为熵正则最优传输问题，构建出平衡的双向投影与稳定的潜在空间。CoTAP 还保证信息在多个潜在空间间稳定传递，从而支持一般几何上的多尺度架构，并更高效地学习长程物理相互作用。
Result: 大量实验表明 MoNo 在预测性能和计算效率两方面均优于现有最先进的神经算子；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调稳定潜在空间构建与最优传输分配机制能够缓解 token collapse，使多尺度架构在一般几何上可行，并提升长程相互作用学习效率；代码已开源。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Second-Order Muon Done Right: A Principled Marriage of Spectral Geometry and Curvature
papers.abstract_en: Muon's polar update is exact for an unweighted spectral geometry. We introduce GO-MUON, which uses a matched data-dependent geometry and reuses it across several optimization steps. Conditioned on any positive-definite left and right maps, its raw update exactly solves the corresponding weighted spectral oracle; this statement is independent of how the maps are estimated or how recently they were refreshed. For softmax cross-entropy, we quantify when the observed-label backward factor approaches the model Fisher and generalized Gauss--Newton factor. We also show that four-step refresh nearly preserves the tracking delay of slowly changing geometry while increasing stationary factor noise, making lazy geometry a compute--statistics tradeoff rather than a denoising mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GO-MUON，一种重新设计 Muon 优化器的变体，核心是使用匹配的数据依赖几何并在多个优化步骤间复用。作者证明在任意正定左右映射条件下，其原始更新恰好求解对应的加权谱 oracle，并分析了 softmax 交叉熵下 backward 因子与 Fisher、广义 Gauss–Newton 因子之间的关系。
Motivation: Muon 的极化更新只对未加权的谱几何是精确的，而实际训练中的数据相关几何未被匹配；论文试图给出一种原则性的几何-曲率结合方式，并澄清几何复用带来的影响。
Method: 引入 GO-MUON，使用匹配的数据依赖几何并在若干优化步骤间复用该几何；其更新在给定正定左右映射时精确求解相应的加权谱 oracle，且该结论与映射的估计方式及刷新频率无关。
Result: 摘要对 softmax 交叉熵给出量化条件，说明 observed-label backward 因子何时接近模型 Fisher 因子和广义 Gauss–Newton 因子；四步刷新几乎保持慢变几何的跟踪延迟，但增加固定因子的噪声，使得懒惰几何表现为计算-统计权衡而非去噪机制。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是几何复用并非去噪手段，而是计算开销与统计精度之间的权衡；未报告具体基准实验数字。

papers.title: Disentangling Co-Occurring Retinal Pathologies with Saliency-Guided Sparse Expert Routing
papers.abstract_en: Retinal fundus images frequently exhibit multiple co-occurring pathologies, yet standard deep learning classifiers apply static, identical computation to every image regardless of the underlying disease distribution. We propose a novel architecture that resolves this via sparse conditional computation, pairing a Guided Context Gating (GCG) spatial attention front-end with a sparsely-routed Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) block operating over feature tokens. Crucially, this routing yields an interpretable, data-driven decomposition. Expert allocation is significantly disease-dependent (p < 0.001), with the healthy Normal state and morphologically distinct pathologies (e.g., ERM, AMD) isolating to dedicated experts. On a five-class, patient-disjoint 5-fold cross-validation benchmark, our model achieves 0.912 +/- 0.008 macro AUC and 0.653 +/- 0.014 macro F1. Furthermore, Grad-CAM++ and post-MoE t-SNE visualizations confirm that expert routing aligns with localized lesions and geometrically maps co-occurring cases between their constituent clusters, positioning sparse MoE as an interpretable approach to multi-disease retinal screening.
papers.comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对眼底图像中多种病变常同时出现的问题，提出一种稀疏条件计算架构：将引导上下文门控（GCG）空间注意力前端与基于特征 token 的稀疏路由专家混合（MoE）模块配对，使专家分配成为可解释的数据驱动分解。在五类、患者独立的 5 折交叉验证中，模型达到 0.912 ± 0.008 macro AUC 与 0.653 ± 0.014 macro F1，并验证了专家分配与疾病类别显著相关。
Motivation: 标准深度学习分类器对所有眼底图像施加静态、相同的计算，未考虑图像背后疾病分布的差异，难以处理多种病变共存的场景。
Method: 提出由 GCG 空间注意力前端和稀疏路由 MoE 块组成的架构，通过跨特征 token 的稀疏条件计算实现疾病相关的自适应路由，并以五类、患者独立的 5 折交叉验证进行评估。
Result: 摘要报告专家分配显著依赖疾病类别（p < 0.001），健康 Normal 状态和形态学上独特的病变（如 ERM、AMD）会隔离到专属专家；模型取得 0.912 ± 0.008 macro AUC 和 0.653 ± 0.014 macro F1。
Conclusion: Grad-CAM++ 和 post-MoE t-SNE 可视化显示专家路由与局部病灶对齐，并将共病样本几何映射到其构成簇之间，说明稀疏 MoE 可作为多疾病视网膜筛查的可解释方法。

papers.title: Defining Decentralization: An Ontological Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Decentralization as a concept in computer science has existed for over half a century. Despite its fundamental role across domains such as security, distributed computing, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructures, and Internet of Things (IoT) architectures, there remains no universally accepted definition of decentralization applicable across computer communication systems. This has become increasingly problematic with the emergence of decentralized AI and machine learning paradigms, including collaborative training, distributed inference, blockchain-based, and agentic AI, where decentralization is often treated as a core design objective. Meanwhile, existing approaches frequently conflate decentralization with related notions such as distribution of trust or specific implementation paradigms. Such ambiguity creates inconsistencies in system analysis, limits comparability between works, and weakens the rigor of formal reasoning surrounding communication architectures and protocol design. In this work, we define this research gap as the Decentralization Problem. We analyze the formal-semantic, epistemological, and pragmatic foundations of decentralization and introduce a graph-based ontology defining it as both relational and subject-specific property of computer communication systems. The framework formally distinguishes decentralization from distribution and supports evaluation through two novel metrics: Void Tolerance and Imperviousness. We also provide a browser-based implementation that enables automated classification and metric computation of arbitrary systems. Instantiations to federated learning and blockchain architectures show consistent, comparable assessments where existing definitions produce incomplete or contradictory conclusions, providing a domain-independent foundation for analysing decentralization across heterogeneous systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对计算机通信系统中去中心化（decentralization）缺乏统一定义的问题，将其界定为“去中心化问题”（Decentralization Problem），并从形式语义、认识论和语用基础出发，提出一个基于图的本体论框架。该框架将去中心化定义为通信系统的关系性且主体特定的属性，并明确将其与分布（distribution）区分，同时提出两个新度量：Void Tolerance 与 Imperviousness，并提供了一个基于浏览器的自动分类与度量计算实现。作者将框架实例化到联邦学习和区块链架构，展示了比现有定义更一致和可比较的评估结果。
Motivation: 去中心化在计算机科学中应用广泛，但缺乏跨系统适用的统一定义；现有工作常把去中心化与信任分布或特定实现范式混为一谈，导致系统分析不一致、工作间难以比较，也削弱了形式推理的严谨性，尤其在去中心化 AI 兴起后这一问题更加突出。
Method: 论文分析去中心化的形式语义、认识论和实用主义基础，引入图本体论将去中心化定义为计算机通信系统的关系性和主体特定属性，从形式上区分去中心化与分布，并提出 Void Tolerance 和 Imperviousness 两个新度量，同时提供基于浏览器的实现以支持任意系统的自动分类和度量计算。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在联邦学习（federated learning）和区块链（blockchain）架构上的实例化评估中，能得到一致且可比较的结论，而现有定义在这些场景下会产生不完整或相互矛盾的结论。
Conclusion: 论文认为该框架为跨异构系统分析去中心化提供了领域无关的基础，可支持更严谨的通信架构与协议设计分析。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对计算机通信系统中去中心化（decentralization）缺乏统一定义的问题，将其界定为“去中心化问题”（Decentralization Problem），并从形式语义、认识论和语用基础出发，提出一个基于图的本体论框架。该框架将去中心化定义为通信系统的关系性且主体特定的属性，并明确将其与分布（distribution）区分，同时提出两个新度量：Void Tolerance 与 Imperviousness，并提供了一个基于浏览器的自动分类与度量计算实现。作者将框架实例化到联邦学习和区块链架构，展示了比现有定义更一致和可比较的评估结果。
summary_sections.motivation: 去中心化在计算机科学中应用广泛，但缺乏跨系统适用的统一定义；现有工作常把去中心化与信任分布或特定实现范式混为一谈，导致系统分析不一致、工作间难以比较，也削弱了形式推理的严谨性，尤其在去中心化 AI 兴起后这一问题更加突出。

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该方法在联邦学习（federated learning）和区块链（blockchain）架构上的实例化评估中，能得到一致且可比较的结论，而现有定义在这些场景下会产生不完整或相互矛盾的结论。

papers.title: SR-OPSD: Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) converts feedback into dense token-level supervision on trajectories generated by the policy to be optimized, providing a useful complement to reinforcement learning with sparse outcome rewards. However, the self-teacher policy used in OPSD is typically a stop-gradient or exponential-moving-average copy of the policy conditioned on additional context information, and thus co-evolves with both the student policy and its on-policy context distribution. Directly matching such a moving target with a fixed projection objective can lead to unstable optimization or excessive distributional concentration. This nature of OPSD motivates the proposed \emph{Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation (SR-OPSD)}. At fixed student-generated contexts, a token-level variational characterization identifies the effective distillation target as a geometric interpolation between the self-teacher policy and a reference policy. Meanwhile, we use the Rényi divergence family to generalize the projection geometry. This formulation separates \emph{where} the adaptive target is placed from \emph{how} the student is projected toward it: the interpolation coefficient controls underlying target, while the Rényi order controls the projection geometry and its sensitivity to token-level density ratios. Extensive experiments across scientific evaluation, mathematical reasoning, and coding generation tasks with multiple large language models show that SR-OPSD achieves the state-of-the-art or competitive performance across various settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation (SR-OPSD)，一种针对 on-policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）中教师策略与学生策略共同演化导致训练不稳定的改进方法。作者利用 token 级变分刻画，将有效蒸馏目标表示为自教师策略与参考策略之间的几何插值，并用 Rényi 散度族泛化投影几何，从而分离目标放置位置与投影方式。实验覆盖科学评估、数学推理和代码生成等任务，在多种大型语言模型设置下达到最先进或具有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: OPSD 依赖与 student 策略及其 on-policy 上下文分布共同演化的 self-teacher 策略，直接匹配这种移动目标会带来优化不稳定或过度分布集中（distributional concentration）的问题。
Method: SR-OPSD 在固定 student 生成的上下文下，通过 token 级变分表征将蒸馏目标定义为 self-teacher 策略与参考策略的几何插值；同时使用 Rényi 散度族推广投影几何，使插值系数控制目标位置、Rényi 阶数控制投影几何及其对 token 级密度比的敏感性。
Result: 摘要报告在科学评估、数学推理和代码生成任务中，结合多个大型语言模型，SR-OPSD 均达到最先进或具有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 该方法通过分离自适应目标的放置与学生的投影方式，缓解了 OPSD 中移动目标导致的优化不稳定问题。

papers.title: Rethinking Factor Sharing in Federated LoRA: A Rank-Aware Adaptive Approach
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) represents large language model (LLM) updates with two compact matrix factors, i.e., $A$ and $B$, providing an efficient way to fine-tune large models in federated learning paradigm. Inspired by the asymmetric roles of the LoRA factors, we study whether $A$ should be shared across clients while $B$ remains client-specific (Share-A/Local-B), or whether $B$ should instead be shared while $A$ remains client-specific (Share-B/Local-A). With a least-squares surrogate, we reveal that Share-A/Local-B requires the client-specific LoRA update matrices to use a common rank-$r$ input-side space, whereas Share-B/Local-A requires a common rank-$r$ output-side space. The two strategies therefore incur different projection residuals, indicating that the preferred strategy is the one with the smaller aggregate residual across clients. With this insight, we propose Federated Adaptive Factor Sharing Low-Rank Adaptation (FedAS-LoRA), which selects the sharing side before training to enhance fine-tuning performance. To enable adaptive factor selection before training, we design a Rank-Aware Shared-Subspace Sufficiency (RSS) metric, which effectively assesses whether a shared rank-$r$ input subspace is sufficient for the local data distributions using representations extracted from a frozen LLM backbone. Experiments across different tasks, data distributions, LoRA ranks, and participation settings confirm the effectiveness of RSS and the superior performance of FedAS-LoRA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视联邦学习场景下 LoRA 两个低秩因子 A 和 B 的共享方式，通过最小二乘代理分析指出 Share-A/Local-B 与 Share-B/Local-A 分别要求客户端更新共享秩-r 输入侧或输出侧子空间，因而产生不同的投影残差。据此提出 FedAS-LoRA，在训练前自适应选择共享侧，并设计 Rank-Aware Shared-Subspace Sufficiency (RSS) 指标评估共享秩-r 输入子空间对本地数据分布的充分性。实验验证了 RSS 的有效性和 FedAS-LoRA 的优越性能。
Motivation: LoRA 的两个因子在联邦微调中扮演不对称角色，但此前缺乏对应该共享 A 还是共享 B 的系统性分析，错误的选择可能引入不必要的投影残差并损害微调效果。
Method: 利用最小二乘代理揭示两种共享策略各自需要客户端 LoRA 更新矩阵落在公共秩-r 输入侧或输出侧子空间，并以跨客户端聚合残差大小作为选择依据。据此提出 FedAS-LoRA，在训练前通过 RSS 指标（基于冻结 LLM 主干提取的表征）判断共享秩-r 输入子空间是否足够，从而确定共享侧。
Result: 摘要报告在多种任务、数据分布、LoRA 秩和客户端参与设置下的实验均验证了 RSS 的有效性，并表明 FedAS-LoRA 相比其他共享策略具有更优的联邦微调性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调联邦 LoRA 中共享侧的选择应基于对投影残差的估计，而非固定选择 A 或 B；RSS 提供了在训练前进行该选择的可行途径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HandSplatter: Automated Digital Goniometry from Neural Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Hand and finger disorders are leading contributors to musculoskeletal disability, creating a clinical need for precise methods to quantify joint motion. Range of motion (ROM) serves as the metric for diagnosis, rehabilitation monitoring, and evaluating surgical outcomes. Currently, the goniometer is the standard tool for assessing finger flexion and extension. However, manual goniometry is labor-intensive and suffers from inconsistent inter-rater reliability due to variations in examiner technique. While digital alternatives exist, current software-based approaches often lack the necessary accuracy for clinical usage. To address these limitations, we present a novel pipeline for 3-D hand joint location and pose estimation using neural rendering. Unlike previous methods, our approach combines 2-D feature extraction with view synthesis to significantly improve accuracy and clinical viability. Furthermore, we introduce a discrete density hill climbing algorithm that facilitates the meaningful correction of projected landmarks in 3-D space. This system overcomes the inefficiencies of manual measurement and the inaccuracies of existing software, providing a robust tool for objective functional assessment.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 48th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC 2026), Full Paper #1985
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向手指关节活动度的临床测量需求，提出一种基于神经渲染 (neural rendering) 的 3D 手部关节定位与姿态估计流水线，用于自动化数字测角 (digital goniometry)。方法将 2D 特征提取与视图合成 (view synthesis) 相结合，并引入离散密度爬山算法 (discrete density hill climbing) 对 3D 空间中的投影地标进行修正，以改善手指屈伸活动范围 (range of motion, ROM) 测量的准确性与临床可用性。
Motivation: 手部与手指疾病是肌肉骨骼残疾的主要来源，关节活动度是诊断、康复监测和手术效果评估的关键指标；但手动测角耗时且因检查者技术差异导致评定者间信度不一致，而现有软件化数字测角方法精度不足以满足临床应用。
Method: 提出融合 2D 特征提取与视图合成的神经渲染流水线来估计 3D 手部关节位置与姿态，并设计离散密度爬山算法，使投影地标能够在 3D 空间中得到有意义的修正。
Result: 摘要称该方法相比此前方法显著提升准确性与临床可行性，克服了手动测量效率低和现有软件精度不足的问题，但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者将该系统定位为客观功能评估的鲁棒工具，适用于手指关节运动测量，强调其兼顾临床效率与测量精度。

papers.title: ColluSkill: Adversarial Cross-Skill Composition for Evading Agent Skill Scanners
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills are emerging as an important attack surface in LLM-based agent systems. Through an empirical study of existing skill scanners, we find that current defenses mainly inspect individual skills, leaving risks from cross-skill composition insufficiently examined. This creates a practical blind spot: multiple locally plausible skills may pass security checks while collectively forming a harmful workflow during agent execution. To investigate this threat, we propose ColluSkill, a collusive multi-skill-chain attack framework that decomposes a complete malicious intent into interdependent sub-payloads embedded in independently packaged skills. The attack does not rely on any single malicious skill, but emerges from the ordered composition of locally plausible behaviors through contextual dependencies, artifact passing, and execution handoffs. ColluSkill further employs LLM-based chain planning and scanner-feedback refinement to preserve chain-level attack semantics while reducing suspicious signals in individual sub-skills. To defend against such attacks, we propose ChainGuard, a context-aware skill-chain scanner that jointly analyzes a candidate skill and the skills already installed in the agent environment. ChainGuard reconstructs cross-skill dependencies, artifact flows, capability compositions, and downstream behaviors to identify risks that emerge only at the workflow level. Experiments on six representative skill scanners show that ColluSkill achieves an average attack success rate of 96.0% and consistently outperforms the evaluated single-skill and multi-skill attack baselines. Meanwhile, ChainGuard reduces the attack success rate to 22.5% while allowing 99.5% of benign workflows to pass, highlighting the importance of chain-level security analysis for agent skill ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 智能体系统以技能（skill）为攻击面的安全问题，指出现有技能扫描器主要检查单个技能，未充分考察跨技能组合风险。作者提出 ColluSkill，一种共谋式多技能链攻击框架，将完整恶意意图拆分为相互依赖的子负载并打包进独立技能，通过有序组合在运行时形成有害工作流；同时提出 ChainGuard，一种上下文感知的技能链扫描器，联合分析候选技能与环境中已安装技能。在六个代表性技能扫描器上的实验显示 ColluSkill 平均攻击成功率达 96.0%，ChainGuard 将攻击成功率降至 22.5% 且允许 99.5% 的良性工作流通过。
Motivation: 现有防御主要检查单个技能，跨技能组合的风险未被充分检验，形成实际盲区：多个各自看似合理的技能可分别通过安全检查，但在执行时组合成有害工作流，威胁智能体技能生态。
Method: 提出 ColluSkill 攻击框架，将完整恶意意图分解为相互依赖的子负载，嵌入独立打包的技能中，通过上下文依赖、工件传递（artifact passing）和执行交接（execution handoffs）的排序组合产生攻击；并采用基于 LLM 的链规划和扫描器反馈精炼，在保留链级攻击语义的同时减少单个子技能中的可疑信号。防御侧提出 ChainGuard，联合分析候选技能与已装技能，重建跨技能依赖、工件流、能力组合与下游行为以识别仅在工作流层面出现的风险。
Result: 在六个代表性技能扫描器上的实验表明，ColluSkill 平均攻击成功率为 96.0%，一致优于所评估的单技能与多技能攻击基线；ChainGuard 将攻击成功率降至 22.5%，同时允许 99.5% 的良性工作流通过。
Conclusion: 摘要强调链级安全分析（chain-level security analysis）对智能体技能生态系统的重要性，仅检查单个技能的防御不足以应对组合式攻击。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: World Tokens: Enhancing Embodied Policies with Training-Time World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are a widely adopted paradigm for embodied policies. They excel at efficient closed-loop control but do not explicitly model how physical scenes evolve as a task unfolds. Recently emerging world-action models (WAMs) leverage pretrained video world models to capture spatiotemporal evolution, yet retaining future generation or a large video backbone in the control loop substantially increases inference cost. We introduce World Tokens, an embodied policy architecture built around a World Adapter that bridges visual-language understanding, world-dynamics modeling, and action generation. It uses world modeling during training to enhance the action policy while preserving efficient deployment. Specifically, the World Adapter transforms VLM features into a fixed set of world tokens, which condition a jointly fine-tuned future-video denoiser and simultaneously serve as the action expert's sole visual-language context. This shared conditioning allows gradients from future-video denoising to directly shape the representation used for action prediction, while exclusive routing prevents the policy from bypassing that representation. At deployment, the world-model branch is removed, leaving only the VLM, World Adapter, and action expert, with no online video-model inference. With a 2B backbone and no embodied action pretraining, World Tokens is highly competitive on LIBERO, attains the best reported averages on SIMPLER, substantially improves real-world R1 Pro success over a matched action-only baseline, and generates each action chunk at VLA-level latency.

Motivation: VLA 模型擅长高效的闭环控制，但不会显式建模任务展开过程中物理场景的演化；新兴的世界动作模型（WAM）虽能利用预训练视频世界模型捕捉时空演化，但在控制回路中保留未来生成或大型视频骨干网络会大幅增加推理成本。

papers.title: LookAgain: Closed-Loop GUI Grounding with Visually Grounded Reflection
papers.abstract_en: Recent graphical user interface (GUI) grounders have significantly advanced single-shot accuracy on standard benchmarks, yet their performance degrades sharply on small targets, densely packed controls and out-of-distribution interfaces. We attribute this gap to a paradigmatic limitation shared by existing approaches: none of them treats a produced coordinate as a hypothesis to be reflected upon and revised under new visual evidence. This manifests as three coupled issues: 1) Lack of post-hoc reflection. The prediction is frozen at the moment of emission, leaving no internal mechanism to challenge or refine it. 2) Visual evidence decoupled from the prediction. The auxiliary visual evidence is gathered to support the upcoming coordinate rather than to scrutinise the one already committed to. 3) Refinement over views, not over predictions. The iterative zoom-in refines the inspected region instead of inheriting a previous coordinate as a spatial prior to be corrected. In this paper, we propose LookAgain, a closed-loop GUI grounder driven by post-prediction visual reflection. LookAgain reformulates grounding as a multi-turn predict-look-again-refine process with two primitives: "locate" posts a coordinate hypothesis, renders a marker on the image and appends a local patch of the predicted region. It anchors the next reasoning step to the previous prediction as a spatial prior; "confirm" accepts or reject the hypothesis and terminates the procedure. We train the LookAgain grounder with SFT on constructed reflective trajectories as a cold start, followed by GRPO with terminal grounding correctness as the sole reward. Extensive experiments show that LookAgain consistently improves performance on both refusal-aware and general GUI grounding benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art results. Comprehensive ablations further verify the effectiveness of the proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LookAgain，一种闭环 GUI 接地 (GUI grounding) 方法，将接地重构为多轮“定位-再看-细化”过程。其核心原语 “locate” 发布坐标假设、在图像上渲染标记并附加局部 patch，把上一步预测作为空间先验；“confirm” 则接受或拒绝假设并终止流程。模型先用构造的反思轨迹做 SFT 冷启动，再以终端接地正确性作为唯一奖励进行 GRPO 训练，在拒绝感知和通用 GUI 接地基准上取得最先进结果。
Motivation: 现有 GUI grounder 在标准基准上单次准确率高，但在小目标、密集控件和分布外 (out-of-distribution) 界面上性能明显下降。作者认为根源是范式性局限：现有方法都不把已产生的坐标当作假设，在新的视觉证据下反思并修订，表现为缺乏事后反思、辅助视觉证据与预测解耦、以及只在视图上迭代细化而非继承并修正已有坐标预测。
Method: 提出 LookAgain 闭环接地器，将接地形式化为多轮 predict-look-again-refine 流程，包含 “locate” 和 “confirm” 两个原语。locate 发布坐标假设并在图像上渲染标记、附加预测区域的局部 patch，将下一步推理锚定到前一预测作为空间先验；confirm 接受或拒绝假设并终止过程。训练采用两阶段：先在构造的反思轨迹上做 SFT 冷启动，再用 GRPO 并以终端接地正确性作为唯一奖励。
Result: 实验表明 LookAgain 在拒绝感知 (refusal-aware) 和通用 GUI 接地基准上均持续提升性能，达到最先进结果；综合消融实验验证了所提框架各组成部分的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者强调，将预测坐标作为可被新视觉证据修正的假设、并以闭环视觉反思驱动多轮细化，是提升 GUI 接地鲁棒性的有效途径，尤其针对小目标和分布外界面。摘要未提及明显的适用范围或局限性。

papers.title: PET/CT Radiogenomic Mutation Prediction in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Using Multi-Label Learning
papers.abstract_en: Lung cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer- related mortality worldwide. Although targeted therapies have improved outcomes for patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), they rely on mutation profiling through tissue biopsy, an invasive procedure with several limitations. This study investigates PET/CT-based radio- genomic prediction of epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), tumour protein 53 (TP53), and Kirsten rat sarcoma viral oncogene (KRAS) mutations using deep learning. We further evaluate whether pairwise multi-label learning improves mutation prediction compared with conventional single-gene classification. To the best of our knowledge, this is among the first studies to systematically investigate multi-label learning for PET/CT radiogenomic mutation prediction in NSCLC. Experiments were conducted on a novel UK-based radiogenomics cohort. Joint pre- diction of KRAS and TP53 improved AUC from 0.58 to 0.64 for KRAS and from 0.69 to 0.71 for TP53. For the EGFR/KRAS pair, only EGFR benefited from joint learning, while no improvement was observed for the EGFR/TP53 pair. These findings demonstrate that the effectiveness of multi-label learning depends on the specific combination of gene mutations being modelled, suggesting that mutation-specific modelling strategies may be preferable for PET/CT radiogenomic prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于 PET/CT 的影像基因组学（radiogenomics）突变预测，针对非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）中的 EGFR、TP53 和 KRAS 突变，使用深度学习并比较成对多标签学习（multi-label learning）与常规单基因分类。在新型英国影像基因组学队列上，KRAS/TP53 联合预测将 KRAS 的 AUC 从 0.58 提升至 0.64、TP53 从 0.69 提升至 0.71；EGFR/KRAS 组合仅 EGFR 受益，而 EGFR/TP53 组合未见改善。
Motivation: NSCLC 靶向治疗依赖组织活检进行突变谱分析，而活检具有侵入性和多种局限；PET/CT 影像基因组学有望提供非侵入性替代方案，但此前缺乏对多标签学习在该任务中的系统研究。
Method: 采用深度学习进行 PET/CT 影像基因组学突变预测，比较单基因分类与成对多标签学习两种建模方式，并在一个新构建的英国影像基因组学队列上评估 EGFR、TP53、KRAS 三种突变的预测性能。
Result: KRAS 与 TP53 的联合预测带来 AUC 提升（KRAS 从 0.58 到 0.64，TP53 从 0.69 到 0.71）；EGFR/KRAS 组合仅 EGFR 获益，EGFR/TP53 组合未见改进。
Conclusion: 多标签学习的有效性依赖于所建模的具体基因突变组合，提示在 PET/CT 影像基因组学预测中，采用突变特异性建模策略可能更优。

papers.title: How Do Large Language Models Judge Social Attraction? Evidence from Theory-Grounded Persona Ratings Across Multiple LLMs and Humans
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to perform subjective evaluations traditionally made by humans, yet their validity as social judges remains unclear. This paper examines whether LLMs can assess social attraction from theory-grounded persona profiles constructed from ten psychological and relational constructs and organized into three tiers: socially attractive, socially mixed, and socially unattractive. We examine LLM ratings in two studies and compare them with human judgments in a third study. In Study 1, 34 LLMs rated 12 profiles across three repeated runs. Although some models tended to give higher or lower ratings overall, they showed strong stability across runs, consistent three-tier ordering, and high agreement in relative profile ordering. Study 2 examined sensitivity to gender presentation using six matched name-and-pronoun profile pairs and a separate pronoun-only test with a gender-neutral name, finding no significant effects in either analysis. In Study 3, 198 human participants evaluated the six matched profiles from Study 2. Their ratings reproduced the three-tier structure and followed a profile ordering consistent with that of the LLMs. However, LLMs rated attractive profiles more positively and unattractive profiles more negatively than humans, while neither group showed a significant overall effect of gender presentation.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Includes technical supplement
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考察大语言模型（LLM）能否基于理论驱动的 persona 档案评估社交吸引力。作者从十个心理和关系构念构建出三层级（社交吸引、社交混合、社交不吸引）的档案，在三个研究中对比 LLM 与人类判断。研究1中 34 个 LLM 对 12 个档案重复评分，表现出跨运行稳定、一致的三层排序和高相对排序一致性；研究2未发现性别呈现的显著效应；研究3中 198 名人类参与者的评分复现了三层结构，但 LLM 对吸引档案打分更高、对不吸引档案打分更低。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地被用于执行传统上由人类完成的主观评估，但其作为社会评判者的有效性仍不清楚，因此需要系统检验 LLM 对社交吸引力这类主观属性的判断是否可靠。
Method: 基于十个心理和关系构念构建理论驱动的 persona 档案，并组织为社交吸引、社交混合与社交不吸引三个层级。论文设计三项研究：研究1由 34 个 LLM 对 12 个档案进行三轮重复评分；研究2使用六对匹配姓名与代词以及中性姓名加代词的测试检验性别呈现敏感性；研究3由 198 名人类参与者评估研究2中的六对匹配档案。
Result: 研究1中 LLM 评分跨运行稳定，呈现一致的三层排序且相对排序高度一致；研究2未发现性别呈现的显著主效应；研究3中人类评分复现三层结构且与 LLM 的档案排序一致，但 LLM 对吸引档案给出更正面、对不吸引档案给出更负面的评分。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 LLM 能够复现人类对社交吸引力的分层判断，但在极端评分上比人类更强烈，提示其作为社会评判者仍有偏差，需要进一步验证其效度。

papers.title: Input convex neural networks as surrogates in mathematical optimisation
papers.abstract_en: Embedding trained neural networks as surrogates within optimisation problems is an established practice in operations research. The prevailing approach uses feedforward neural networks (FNNs) with ReLU activations, whose piecewise-linear structure admits an exact but computationally intensive mixed-integer programming (MIP) reformulation as the networks grow. We advocate input convex neural networks (ICNNs) as structurally superior surrogates when the underlying response is approximately convex or concave. The convex architecture offers two computational advantages. First, the ICNN-MIP formulation tends to yield a tighter linear programming (LP) relaxation than its FNN-MIP counterpart, with no integrality gap in favourable instances. Second, ICNNs uniquely admit an LP-based reformulation via epigraph representations of ReLU activations, though this embedding is not always exact. When it is not, we exploit the properties of ICNNs to construct the strongest continuous relaxation over box domains, namely, the convex hull of the ICNN's graph, bounded below by the epigraph and above by the concave envelope; this construction is tractable under input convexity but hard for general ReLU networks. On this basis, we develop a branch-and-bound algorithm that builds this relaxation at each node, branches directly on input variables rather than intermediate variables as in MIP reformulations, and terminates at the root node whenever the epigraph embedding is valid. Case studies on humanitarian food aid, oil well routing, and wine blending show that ICNN surrogates match FNN accuracy and deliver gains in solve time and scalability, supporting ICNN as the default surrogate when the underlying function is convex, concave, or well-approximated as such.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文主张在数学优化问题中用输入凸神经网络（ICNN）替代 ReLU 前馈神经网络作为代理模型，并针对近似凸或凹的响应函数给出计算优势。作者提出的 ICNN-MIP 重构具有更紧的 LP 松弛，且在 epigraph 嵌入不精确时可构造 box 域上 ICNN 图的凸包松弛；基于此设计的直接对输入变量分支的分支定界算法在食品援助、油井路由和葡萄酒勾兑案例中达到与 FNN 相当的精度，并带来求解时间和可扩展性上的收益。
Motivation: 现有优化中嵌入代理网络的主流做法是 ReLU 前馈网络（FNN），其分段线性结构虽可给出精确的混合整数规划（MIP）重构，但随网络规模增长计算代价高昂；当底层响应函数近似凸或凹时，缺乏结构上更优的代理选择。
Method: 提出以输入凸神经网络（ICNN）作为代理模型，利用其凸结构获得基于 ReLU 激活 epigraph 的 LP 重构；当该嵌入不精确时，构造 box 域上 ICNN 图的凸包（下界为 epigraph、上界为凹包络）作为最强连续松弛，并在此基础上设计分支定界算法：每个节点构建该松弛、直接对输入变量分支，且在 epigraph 嵌入有效时根节点即终止。
Result: 摘要报告在 humanitarian food aid、oil well routing 和 wine blending 三个案例中，ICNN 代理达到与 FNN 相当的精度，并在求解时间和可扩展性上取得提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为当底层函数是凸、凹或可被良好近似为凸凹时，ICNN 可作为优化代理的默认选择。

papers.title: Test-Time Scaling for CAD Generation via Verifier-Free Consensus Selection
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can write parametric CAD programs from a natural-language description (text-to-CAD generation), but a single sample is often wrong. Increasing test-time compute by sampling multiple candidates only helps if a good candidate can be identified, yet no ground-truth model is available at generation time. Existing systems often require a separate verifier, such as a vision-language judge, to select among candidates. We investigate whether the candidate pool itself provides enough signal for effective selection and a verifier-free alternative. We introduce 3D CAD consensus selection, hereafter consensus selection: sample $N$ parametric CAD programs, compile them to 3D models, and return the candidate that agrees most with the rest of the pool. The method is training-free and compatible with existing CAD agents. We investigate geometric and topological notions of agreement, each of which improves its corresponding evaluation metric. On the exact candidate pools of a state-of-the-art CAD generation method, geometric consensus improves all three geometric metrics over the method's verifier, while topological consensus matches it on topology. Across every tested LLM and prompt variant, geometric consensus also improves geometric accuracy over random selection from the same pool, reducing Chamfer distance by $1-10\%$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究文本到CAD生成（text-to-CAD）中的测试时扩展（test-time scaling）问题，提出无需单独验证器的"3D CAD共识选择"（consensus selection）：采样N个参数化CAD程序，编译为3D模型后，返回与池中其余候选最一致的那个候选。该方法无需训练、兼容现有CAD智能体；几何与拓扑两种一致性度量分别对应提升各自的评估指标，在现有SOTA方法的精确候选池上，几何一致性在三个几何指标上优于该方法的验证器，拓扑一致性在拓扑指标上与之持平。
Motivation: 大语言模型可从自然语言描述生成参数化CAD程序，但单次采样往往有误；增加测试时计算（多候选采样）只有在能选出好候选时才有帮助，而生成时并无真实标注模型可用。现有系统常依赖额外的视觉语言验证器来挑选候选，作者想探究候选池本身是否已包含足够的选择信号，从而省去独立验证器。
Method: 提出3D CAD共识选择（consensus selection）：采样N个参数化CAD程序，将其编译成3D模型，然后返回与候选池其余成员一致性最高的候选。该方法无需训练，可与现有CAD智能体兼容，并考察了几何（geometric）与拓扑（topological）两类一致性度量。
Result: 在SOTA CAD生成方法的精确候选池上，几何一致性在全部三个几何指标上优于该方法的验证器，拓扑一致性在拓扑指标上与之持平。在所有测试的LLM和提示变体下，几何一致性相比同一候选池的随机选择都能提升几何精度，Chamfer距离降低1–10%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为候选池自身足以提供无需验证器的有效选择信号，且两种一致性度量分别对应各自评估指标的提升；该方案是训练-free的测试时选择机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Matryoshka Language Model Suites
papers.abstract_en: Training a language model suite classically requires training each model separately and serving them independently. We improve both training and inference efficiency by stacking sub-models of increasing size into a single nested architecture trained end-to-end. This Matryoshka training framework reduces the total parameter count of the suite, enables low-cost distillation from the largest to all smaller sub-models at every training step, and is well-suited for speculative decoding as the draft model is contained within the verifier. We validate our approach by training a Matryoshka suite comprising 500M, 1.5B, and 3B sub-models. Our suite is on par with independently trained baselines on benchmark performance and validation and out-of-domain perplexities, while using 36% less training compute and improving the throughput of speculative decoding by 14-26%. We also ablate key architectural choices, offering guidance for building strong Matryoshka LM suites.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种嵌套式 Matryoshka 语言模型套件训练框架，将多个不同规模的子模型堆叠为单一端到端训练的网络，以同时改善训练和推理效率。作者训练了包含 500M、1.5B 和 3B 子模型的套件，在基准性能与困惑度上与独立训练基线相当，同时节省 36% 训练算力，并将投机解码 (speculative decoding) 吞吐量提升 14-26%。文章还通过消融实验总结关键架构选择。
Motivation: 传统语言模型套件需要单独训练每个模型并独立部署，训练和推理成本随模型数量线性增加。
Method: 提出 Matryoshka 训练框架，将多个递增规模的子模型堆叠进单一嵌套架构中端到端训练；该结构支持每一步从最大子模型向所有较小子模型进行低成本蒸馏，且因草稿模型包含在验证模型内部而天然适合投机解码。
Result: Matryoshka 套件在基准性能和验证集及域外困惑度上与独立训练基线持平，训练计算量减少 36%，投机解码吞吐量提升 14-26%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Matryoshka 训练框架能显著提升套件训练与推理效率，并通过架构消融为构建强 Matryoshka LM 套件提供指导。

papers.title: Model Discovery Agent: LLM-assisted Bayesian experiment design for data-efficient discovery of mechanistic world models
papers.abstract_en: Predicting the answer to interventional ``what if'' questions --- the outcome of an action never taken --- requires a \emph{mechanistic}, causal model, not a curve fit; and learning such a model requires \emph{experiments}, because passive data leaves its mechanisms unidentified. Experiments are expensive, so the central problem is \emph{data efficiency}. We present the Model Discovery Agent (MDA), which couples a large language model (LLM), used as a \emph{proposer} of candidate structures, with standard Bayesian machinery --- sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) for parameter and structure posteriors, simulation-based inference (SBI) for intractable likelihoods, and value-of-information (VoI) for experiment design --- to discover latent mechanistic world models from few interventions. MDA operates in the M-open setting: when the truth lies outside the current hypothesis class, a predictive check flags the inadequacy and the proposer expands the hypothesis space with a new model whose parameters are then identified by designed experiments. We show that \emph{discovery and design reinforce}: the design step identifies the mechanism the discovery step proposes, and the identified mechanism improves predictions, enabling further discoveries from the remaining unexplained residuals. On three different benchmarks --- covering physics (\DPbench, \citep{wiemann2026discoverphysics}), chemistry (\CHEMbench, \citep{kabra2026autoscilab}) and biology (\HHbench, a new partially observed single-neuron electrophysiology benchmark we create) --- we show that MDA sets a new SOTA in terms of data-efficient model learning and reliable interventional forecasting ability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Model Discovery Agent (MDA)，将大语言模型 (LLM) 作为候选结构提议者，与序贯蒙特卡洛 (SMC)、基于模拟的推断 (SBI) 和信息价值 (VoI) 等标准贝叶斯工具耦合，以从少量干预实验中数据高效地发现潜在机制世界模型。MDA 在 M-open 设定下运行，当真实模型不在当前假设类中时，预测性检查会触发假设空间扩展。作者在物理、化学和生物学三个基准上报告了数据效率与干预预测能力的新 SOTA。
Motivation: 回答干预性“what if”问题需要机制性因果模型而非曲线拟合，而被动数据无法识别机制；由于实验昂贵，核心挑战是数据效率。
Method: MDA 将 LLM 用作候选结构的提议者，结合 SMC 估计参数与结构后验、SBI 处理不可处理的似然、VoI 指导实验设计；在 M-open 设定下，预测性检查标记当前假设类不足，并由提议者扩展假设空间。
Result: 在三个基准上——物理 (DPbench)、化学 (CHEMbench) 以及作者新创建的部分观测单神经元电生理基准 (HHbench)——MDA 在数据高效的模型学习和可靠的干预预测方面达到新的 SOTA。
Conclusion: 摘要强调发现与设计相互增强：设计步骤能识别发现步骤提出的机制，识别出的机制改善预测，并使得剩余残差促成进一步发现。

papers.title: Evaluating Generative Time-Series Models on Data with Point Masses
papers.abstract_en: Many of the series that generative time-series models are benchmarked on place a large probability mass on a single value --- it does not rain, no ride is requested, no part is ordered. We report what happens when such data is evaluated carefully. First, the standard rolling-origin protocol can score a model on a window whose atom structure bears no resemblance to the dataset: on one benchmark the dataset is $42\%$ zeros and the evaluation windows are $13\%$, on another $47\%$ against $5\%$. This is not a cosmetic problem --- it reversed one of our own conclusions, turning the strongest occurrence model in our study into what looked like a cautionary tale. Second, we give a control in which CRPS is invariant \emph{by construction} while the temporal coupling is destroyed, which measures exactly how much that coupling contributes to a chosen statistic. Third, benchmarking seven models on a matched protocol over five seeds, an autoregressive hurdle beats a conditional flow on five of six datasets, by up to a factor of $153$, while the flow's own occurrence statistics vary by up to $62\%$ across training seeds and every baseline is deterministic. Finally, the model ordering is not the same under five different occurrence statistics, and the two that do not share a construction agree with each other least.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生成式时间序列模型在含点质量（point mass）数据上的评估问题，即数据在单一值（如降雨量为零）上有大量概率质量。作者发现标准的滚动原点（rolling-origin）协议可能在原子结构与数据集完全不同的窗口上打分，例如一个基准数据集中42%为零而评估窗口仅13%为零；这一问题甚至逆转了作者自己的一项结论。作者还给出了一个构造上保持CRPS不变但破坏时间耦合的对照，并用匹配协议在五个数据集上比较了七个模型。
Motivation: 许多生成式时间序列基准数据在单一值上集中大量概率质量（例如不降雨、无订单），但标准评估协议未考虑这种原子结构，可能导致误导性的模型排序和科学结论。
Method: 作者系统诊断滚动原点协议下的零值比例失配，构造一个CRPS在构造上不变而时间耦合被破坏的对照，以量化时间耦合对统计量的贡献；并在匹配协议下、五个训练种子中对七个模型进行基准测试。
Result: 在五个数据集中的六个上，自回归hurdle模型优于条件流模型，最大差距达153倍；流的出现统计量在不同训练种子间变化最高达62%，而所有基线均为确定性。五种不同的出现统计量给出不同模型排序，且构造不共享的两个统计量之间一致性最差。
Conclusion: 摘要强调评估协议和出现统计量的选择会显著改变生成式时间序列模型的结论，研究者需要谨慎设计评估以处理点质量数据。
Relevance: 96

summary_sections.method: 作者系统诊断滚动原点协议下的零值比例失配，构造一个CRPS在构造上不变而时间耦合被破坏的对照，以量化时间耦合对统计量的贡献；并在匹配协议下、五个训练种子中对七个模型进行基准测试。
summary_sections.result: 在五个数据集中的六个上，自回归hurdle模型优于条件流模型，最大差距达153倍；流的出现统计量在不同训练种子间变化最高达62%，而所有基线均为确定性。五种不同的出现统计量给出不同模型排序，且构造不共享的两个统计量之间一致性最差。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调评估协议和出现统计量的选择会显著改变生成式时间序列模型的结论，研究者需要谨慎设计评估以处理点质量数据。

papers.title: Diffuse the object, keep its label: curating detector training data from a few unlabeled photographs via VLM-built 3D vegetation scenes
papers.abstract_en: Labeled images of small objects hidden in vegetation are scarce, and detectors trained on them generalize poorly across sites. Rather than reusing labels collected at another site, we synthesize labeled training images from a handful of unlabeled photographs of the deployment site itself. A vision--language model generates a coarse 3D vegetation scene from one photograph; placing 3D object meshes in the scene yields bounding boxes, segmentation masks, and per-instance occlusion directly from the scene geometry, without manual annotation. A lightweight adapter fine-tuned on the photographs conditions a diffusion pass that re-textures the renders, and a graded mask-lock sets how much diffusion may touch the object itself. In our runs this grade was the most influential curation choice: lightly diffusing the object improves minority-class recall over fully protecting its pixels, while unrestricted diffusion dissolves it. Trained on these images, a standard detector matched or exceeded its counterpart trained on a larger labeled dataset of real images from a different site, consistently across seeds on a humanitarian-demining benchmark; the comparison is thus unsupervised site adaptation from a handful of photographs against conventional cross-site label reuse. In our ablations the gains were largely insensitive to the photograph and crop budgets, and in-domain accuracy did not predict cross-site performance.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Curated Data for Efficient Learning (CDEL) Workshop @ ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对植被中小目标检测器的标注数据稀缺问题，提出仅用部署现场少量无标注照片合成带标签训练图像的方案。方法先用视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 从单张照片构建粗粒度 3D 植被场景，再把 3D 物体网格放入场景，直接从场景几何得到边界框、分割掩码和逐实例遮挡；随后用微调过的轻量适配器驱动扩散过程对渲染图重新纹理化，并用分级掩码锁 (graded mask-lock) 控制扩散对物体本身的改动量。在人道主义排雷基准上，用这些合成图训练的标准检测器在多个随机种子下一致地达到或超过用另一场地更大规模真实标注数据训练的检测器，构成无监督现场适应与常规跨场地标签复用之间的对比。
Motivation: 隐藏在植被中的小物体标注图像稀缺，且在其上训练的检测器跨场地泛化差；直接复用其他场地的标签并不理想，因此目标是从部署场地本身的少量无标注照片合成所需的带标签训练数据。
Method: 用 VLM 从一张照片生成粗略 3D 植被场景，将 3D 物体网格放入场景后由几何关系直接导出边界框、分割掩码和逐实例遮挡，无需人工标注；微调到照片上的轻量适配器为扩散过程提供条件以重新纹理化渲染图，并通过分级掩码锁控制扩散可以改动物体的程度。
Result: 在人道主义排雷基准上，用合成图像训练的检测器一致地匹配或超过用另一场地更大规模真实标注图像训练的检测器；消融显示，轻扩散物体可提升少数类召回，完全保护物体像素则次之，无限制扩散会使物体消失，且该分级是最有影响力的策展选择；增益对照片和裁剪预算不敏感，域内精度无法预测跨场地表现。
Conclusion: 控制扩散如何触碰物体的分级是合成数据策展中最关键的选择，摘要表明这种从少量现场照片出发的无监督现场适应可以匹敌乃至优于跨场地标签复用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Recurrent Neural Networks Beyond Time: Learning from Multiple Ordered Projections
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are widely used for sequence learning, yet their application is commonly associated with temporal data, although recurrent computation fundamentally operates on ordered sequences rather than on time itself. Building on this observation, we introduce the Ordered Structural Dependency Hypothesis (OSDH), which proposes that multiple admissible orderings of the same observations may reveal complementary structural dependencies inaccessible through a single sequential organization. To operationalize this hypothesis, we propose the Independent Structural Expert Principle (ISEP), whereby projection-specific sequence models are trained independently before their learned representations are integrated through a dedicated fusion model. As a concrete realization, we present Structural Evolution RNNs (SE-RNNs), which employ conventional RNNs as projection-specific structural experts while preserving the underlying recurrent computation unchanged. Proof-of-concept experiments on three synthetic datasets with substantially different levels of structural complexity demonstrate that the proposed architecture consistently benefits from multiple ordered projections when hidden structural dependencies are present, while remaining competitive on simpler datasets. Since OSDH is independent of the underlying sequence-processing model, the proposed framework naturally extends beyond recurrent networks and may be instantiated using alternative architectures. The results suggest a general computational perspective for exploiting complementary ordered representations across diverse structured learning problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将 RNN 从时序数据中解放出来的观点：循环计算本质上作用于有序序列而非时间本身。作者提出有序结构依赖假设 (OSDH)，认为同一观测的多种合法排序能揭示单一序列组织无法访问的互补结构依赖，并通过独立结构专家原则 (ISEP) 实现该假设：先独立训练投影特定的序列模型，再用融合模型整合表示。具体架构 Structural Evolution RNNs (SE-RNNs) 保持底层循环计算不变，仅在三个合成数据集上做了概念验证实验。
Motivation: RNN 被广泛用于序列学习，但通常与时间数据绑定；作者主张循环计算适用于任意有序序列，而同一组观测可能存在多个合法排序，不同排序能暴露不同的结构依赖，这是单一序列组织无法覆盖的。
Method: 提出 OSDH 与 ISEP 两个原则：OSDH 假设多个可允许排序能互补地揭示结构依赖，ISEP 要求先独立训练各投影特定的序列模型，再通过一个专门的融合模型整合学习到的表示；具体实现 SE-RNNs 使用常规 RNN 作为投影专家，不改动底层循环计算。
Result: 在三个结构复杂度差异明显的合成数据集上，当存在隐藏结构依赖时，SE-RNNs 一致地从多个有序投影中获益，在较简单数据集上仍保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 由于 OSDH 不依赖具体序列处理模型，该框架可自然扩展到 RNN 之外的架构，为利用互补有序表示提供了通用计算视角；摘要仅涉及合成数据实验，未涉及天气或降水等实际应用。
Relevance: 12
