papers.title: Confusion-Geometry Rebalancing for Long-Tailed Adversarial Training
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial training under long tailed distributions suffers from a dual imbalance: the class imbalance skews the training objective toward head classes, and the adversarial inner maximization may further amplify this bias. Existing methods mitigate this issue by correcting class priors or adapting class wise robust supervision, yet they treat each class in isolation and fail to identify which boundaries drive long tailed collapse. We propose a Confusion Geometry Rebalancing method (CGRm) for long tail adversarial training, a plug in framework that leverages directed robust errors as training signals. CGRm leverages periodic robust evaluations to derive source class loss weights, class wise robust coefficients, and a directed confusion geometry graph. The method then couples feedback weighted robust optimization with graph guided margin correction, thereby boosting the robustness of vulnerable classes and sharpening the critical boundaries that drive long tailed performance degradation. Experiments on long tailed benchmarks show that CGRm achieves consistent robust performance gains over existing methods, with ablations validating the contribution of each component. We provide the code in the supplement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Confusion Geometry Rebalancing (CGRm)，一个用于长尾分布对抗训练 (long-tailed adversarial training) 的即插即用框架。该方法利用周期性鲁棒评估得到源类损失权重、类级鲁棒系数和有向混淆几何图，并将反馈加权鲁棒优化与图引导的边界修正相结合。在长尾基准上的实验显示，相对现有方法取得了持续的鲁棒性能提升。
Motivation: 长尾分布下的对抗训练存在双重不平衡：类别不平衡使训练目标偏向头部类，而对抗式内层最大化可能进一步放大这种偏差。现有方法通过修正类别先验或调整类级鲁棒监督来缓解，但孤立地看待每个类别，无法识别真正导致长尾性能崩溃的决策边界。
Method: CGRm 是即插即用框架，通过周期性鲁棒评估推导源类损失权重、类级鲁棒系数和有向混淆几何图 (directed confusion geometry graph)。该方法将反馈加权鲁棒优化与图引导的边界修正耦合，旨在提升脆弱类别的鲁棒性并锐化驱动长尾性能退化的关键边界。
Result: 在长尾基准上的实验表明，CGRm 相比现有方法取得一致的鲁棒性能提升；消融实验验证了每个组件的贡献。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CGRm 作为即插即用框架的有效性，并说明代码在补充材料中提供。

papers.title: FedOrbit: Adaptive Personalized Federated Learning for Non-IID LEO Satellite Constellations
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations is affected by non-IID data and irregular ground-station visibility, both driven by orbital geometry. Global aggregation performs poorly when orbit-level class distributions are disjoint, while strong personalisation can be excessive when these distributions overlap. We present FedOrbit, which combines continuous orbit-level training over inter-satellite links, class-aware hierarchical aggregation, quality-weighted feature aggregation with return-rate dampening, and adaptive feature decomposition based on inter-orbit class similarity. Across three remote-sensing benchmarks and two non-IID partitions, FedOrbit achieves the highest accuracy in five of six settings and is within $0.9$ percentage points of the best result in the sixth. The gains over the strongest baseline reach $16.1$ percentage points under Dirichlet partitioning and $8.6$ under pathological partitioning, with the smallest per-orbit accuracy spread in five of six settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedOrbit，一种面向低轨（LEO）卫星星座的个性化联邦学习方法，用于应对轨道几何导致的非独立同分布（non-IID）数据和地面站可见性不规则问题。该方法结合轨道级连续训练、类别感知层次聚合、质量加权特征聚合与返回率阻尼，以及基于轨道间类别相似度的自适应特征分解。在三个遥感基准和两种 non-IID 划分下，六个设置中五个取得最高准确率，并在第六个设置中与最优结果相差 0.9 个百分点以内。
Motivation: 低轨卫星星座中的联邦学习受轨道几何驱动，存在轨道间类别分布互不重叠或相互重叠的不同情形；全局聚合在分布不重叠时表现差，而强个性化在分布重叠时又可能过度，现有方法难以同时处理两种情况。
Method: 提出 FedOrbit，包含轨道级连续训练、类别感知层次聚合、带返回率阻尼的质量加权特征聚合，以及基于轨道间类别相似度的自适应特征分解。
Result: 在三个遥感基准和两种 non-IID 划分下，FedOrbit 在六个设置中五个达到最高准确率，第六个与最优结果相差不超过 0.9 个百分点；相比最强基线，Dirichlet 划分下最高提升 16.1 个百分点，pathological 划分下提升 8.6 个百分点，并在六个设置中的五个取得最小每轨道准确率离散度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结合轨道级训练与自适应个性化可以有效处理 LEO 卫星联邦学习中类别分布不重叠与重叠并存的问题，同时提升准确率并缩小跨轨道性能差异。

papers.title: Adaptive Semantic Capacity Allocation for Parallel Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive semantic ID recommenders are constrained by expensive beam-search decoding, which limits the practical length of item identifiers. Parallel generation methods alleviate this bottleneck by predicting all semantic ID tokens simultaneously, enabling longer IDs. However, existing semantic ID methods still rely on manually predefined and homogeneous ID structures, where both the number of semantic slots and the codebook size of each slot are treated as fixed hyperparameters. This ignores the heterogeneous capacity demands of different semantic subspaces and may allocate prediction capacity to slots with limited utility. We show that uniformly expanding semantic slots can provide limited gains, indicating redundant capacity in homogeneous semantic IDs. We propose InforID, a lightweight adaptive semantic target construction framework for parallel generative recommendation. InforID allocates a fixed capacity budget across candidate semantic slots, thereby jointly determining the effective ID length and slot-specific codebook sizes. Experiments demonstrate improved recommendation accuracy under comparable capacity budgets while preserving one-step parallel prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对并行生成式推荐中的语义 ID 构建问题，指出现有方法将语义槽数量和每个槽的码本大小视为固定超参数，造成同质化结构下的容量冗余。作者提出 InforID，一个轻量级自适应语义目标构建框架，在固定容量预算下联合确定有效 ID 长度和各槽码本大小。实验表明，在可比容量预算下 InforID 能提升推荐准确率，同时保持一步并行预测。
Motivation: 自回归语义 ID 推荐器受制于昂贵的 beam-search 解码，限制了标识符长度；并行生成虽缓解此问题，但现有语义 ID 方法仍使用人工预定义且同质的 ID 结构，忽略了不同语义子空间对容量的异构需求，可能将预测容量分配给收益有限的槽位。
Method: 提出 InforID 框架，将固定容量预算分配到候选语义槽上，同时确定有效 ID 长度和每个槽的码本大小，从而自适应地构建语义目标，并保留一步并行预测范式。
Result: 摘要报告，均匀扩展语义槽只能带来有限收益，说明同质语义 ID 中存在冗余容量；InforID 在可比容量预算下提升了推荐准确率，且保持一步并行预测。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将容量按语义子空间的实际需求进行自适应分配，比同质化地扩展语义槽更有效，为并行生成推荐提供了一种轻量级的目标构建方案。

papers.title: Deep Learning Imputation of Missing Radius of Maximum Winds (Rmax) Values in Tropical Cyclone Best-Track Data
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic coastal hazard assessments require accurate characterization of tropical cyclone (TC) parameters, yet datasets often contain missing records for the radius of maximum winds (Rmax), a key variable in Joint Probability Method analyses. This study evaluates data-driven approaches for Rmax imputation, including one-dimensional Convolutional Neural Networks (1DCNNs), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and conventional machine learning models. We examine physics-informed input augmentation, temporal modeling, and transfer learning using synthetic RAFT and STORM datasets for pre-training and observational IBTrACS data for fine-tuning. Including the radius of 34-knot winds (R34) substantially improves performance across all model types. Temporal models achieve higher average correlations than non-temporal models despite using approximately an order of magnitude fewer samples, indicating better preservation of relative Rmax variability across storms. This advantage is more pronounced when R34 is unavailable, suggesting temporal information can partially compensate for missing storm-size predictors. Transfer learning does not improve performance, likely because synthetic datasets have lower and less variable Rmax distributions than IBTrACS. These findings demonstrate the potential of temporal deep learning for reconstructing incomplete TC records and highlight the importance of physics-informed inputs, observational data availability, and distributional consistency in coastal hazard assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估多种数据驱动方法对热带气旋最佳路径数据中最大风速半径 (Rmax) 缺失值的插补效果，比较了一维卷积神经网络 (1DCNNs)、长短期记忆网络 (LSTM) 与常规机器学习模型。摘要报告包含 R34（34 节风半径）输入能显著提升所有模型性能，时间模型在样本量少约一个数量级时仍获得更高的平均相关性；迁移学习因合成数据与观测数据分布不一致而未带来提升。
Motivation: 沿海灾害概率评估需要准确的热带气旋参数，但数据集中最大风速半径 (Rmax) 常存在缺失记录，而这是 Joint Probability Method 分析的关键变量，缺失会影响评估可靠性。
Method: 使用 1DCNN、LSTM 和常规机器学习模型进行 Rmax 插补，并考察物理信息输入增强（加入 R34）、时间建模以及基于合成数据集 RAFT 和 STORM 预训练、在观测数据 IBTrACS 上微调的迁移学习策略。
Result: 加入 R34 显著提升所有模型的插补性能；时间模型在样本量约少一个数量级的情况下仍取得更高的平均相关性，且在缺少 R34 时优势更明显；迁移学习未能改善性能，原因是合成数据的 Rmax 分布比 IBTrACS 更低且变异性更小。
Conclusion: 结果表明时间深度学习可用于重建不完整的热带气旋记录，并强调物理信息输入、观测数据可用性以及分布一致性对沿海灾害评估的重要性。

papers.title: Thinking With Tools, Not With Pixels: Tool Calls as Text Scaffolds for Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Tool-augmented vision-language models increasingly "think with images": they call crop, zoom, or code tools and reason over the returned pixels. However, recent work using blind tests, gain decompositions, and attention analyses has shown that returned images contribute little, raising the question: if pixels do not carry the gain, what does? We hypothesize that the load-bearing signal is the structured text emitted before any returned pixel arrives: tool name, coordinates, target description, and intent. This textual scaffold encodes where to look and what to find. We introduce TextCall (call-but-no-return) to test this: it keeps the scaffold but replaces returned images with the text placeholder [Image output skipped]. Three studies support the hypothesis. (i) Non-necessity of returned pixels: across LoRA, full fine-tuning, and RL, TextCall matches or exceeds full thinking-with-images; under RL it preserves tool use at the reported checkpoint, avoiding the failure mode where, under matched settings, seeing the returned image causes the model to stop calling tools and answer directly. (ii) Sufficiency of the scaffold: on matched training queries, scaffold-only input yields equivalent accuracy to returned-image input. (iii) Component specificity: decomposing the scaffold into reasoning text and spatial code shows both components contribute, with the dominant one varying by task. Together these results support the Tool-Call Scaffold Hypothesis: in current thinking-with-images distributions, the active signal is the structured text emitted at tool-call time; the returned image is a redundant carrier. TextCall preserves accuracy while reducing latency by 29-46% and eliminating tool-execution API calls. Our claims hold for current thinking-with-images benchmarks; constructing tasks where pixels are genuinely load-bearing remains an open direction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TextCall（call-but-no-return）测试方法，检验工具增强视觉语言模型中真正承载推理信息的信号。作者假设工具调用前产生的结构化文本（工具名、坐标、目标描述、意图）才是关键，而返回的图像像素是冗余载体；实验在 LoRA、全量微调和 RL 设置下用文本占位符替换返回图像，结果匹配或超过完整“用图像思考”的准确率，并降低延迟 29-46%、省去工具执行 API 调用。
Motivation: 现有工具增强视觉语言模型倾向于“用图像思考”，调用裁剪、缩放或代码工具并对返回像素进行推理，但盲测、增益分解和注意力分析显示返回图像贡献很小；因此需要弄清像素不承载增益时，真正的信号来自哪里。
Method: 提出 TextCall，即保留工具调用前的结构化文本脚手架，但将返回图像替换为文本占位符 [Image output skipped]；并进一步把脚手架分解为推理文本与空间代码，以检验各成分的贡献。
Result: 在 LoRA、全量微调与 RL 三种设置下，TextCall 匹配或超过完整 thinking-with-images 的准确率；RL 下保留工具使用行为，避免看到返回图像后模型停止调用工具直接作答；脚手架单独输入在匹配训练查询上取得与返回图像输入等价的准确率，且两个分解成分均有贡献，主导成分随任务变化。
Conclusion: 结果支持 Tool-Call Scaffold Hypothesis：当前 thinking-with-images 分布中的活跃信号是工具调用时发出的结构化文本，返回图像只是冗余载体；该结论适用于现有基准，构造像素真正承载信息的任务仍是开放方向。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MPISuperRes-PnP: A Super-Resolution Zero-Shot Plug-and-Play Reconstruction Algorithm for Magnetic Particle Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Magnetic Particle Imaging (MPI) is an emerging medical imaging modality. MPI is based on the non-linear response of magnetic nanoparticles to an applied magnetic field and avoids ionizing radiation. The measured signal is the voltage induced in receive coils by the particles' response. Reconstructing the particle concentration from the signal constitutes the imaging task. Even using state-of-the-art measurement-based reconstruction, the associated spatial grid is very coarse, hence super-resolution (SR) techniques are important. In this work, we propose an approach for SR in MPI inspired by energy minimization. Different methods have been proposed for SR in MPI, ranging from upscaling of the associated system matrix to interpolation of the reconstruction. Here we incorporate SR into the reconstruction task via an energy minimization formulation. Following the plug-and-play approach to energy minimization we derive a splitting scheme and a SR method for MPI where the arising Gaussian denoising task is treated with a pre-trained learned Gaussian denoiser in a zero-shot fashion. This way, we incorporate benefits of deep learning without training and avoid the need of training data. Further, we provide a quantitative and qualitative evaluation of the proposed method. Hyper-parameter are selected via an extended parameter search. The found parameters are applied for reconstruction on real data. We show the applicability of our method on synthetic and on real data (MPIData: EquilibriumModelWithAnisotropy and 2D-OpenMPI Data). The proposed method employs a deep-learning denoiser without training -- thus it does not require presently scarcely available MPI training data. The denoiser behaves conservatively, i.e., no hallucination artifacts were observed. The SR approach is generic such that it can be applied in future MPI contexts involving different regularizers or different imaging tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对磁粒子成像 (Magnetic Particle Imaging, MPI) 中重建网格过粗的问题，提出一种基于能量最小化的超分辨率 (SR) 重建方法。作者采用 plug-and-play 框架推导分裂方案，将其中出现的 Gaussian 去噪任务交给预训练的 learned denoiser，以零样本 (zero-shot) 方式引入深度学习优势而无需训练数据。方法在合成数据和真实数据（MPIData: EquilibriumModelWithAnisotropy 与 2D-OpenMPI Data）上验证了适用性。
Motivation: MPI 即使使用最先进的基于测量的重建，其空间网格仍然很粗，因此超分辨率技术很重要。已有的 MPI SR 方法要么对系统矩阵做上采样，要么对重建结果做插值；同时 MPI 训练数据稀缺，难以直接采用需要训练数据的深度学习方法。
Method: 将 SR 通过能量最小化形式融入 MPI 重建任务本身，并采用 plug-and-play 能量最小化思路推导出分裂方案。算法将 Gaussian 去噪子问题交给预训练的 learned Gaussian denoiser 以零样本方式处理，从而在不训练、不需要训练数据的前提下获得深度学习的去噪能力。超参数通过扩展参数搜索选取，并将所选参数应用于真实数据重建。
Result: 摘要报告了对所提方法的定量与定性评估，在合成数据和真实数据上均展示了可行性。去噪器表现保守，未观察到幻觉伪影 (hallucination artifacts)。
Conclusion: 该方法不需要目前稀缺的 MPI 训练数据，且 SR 框架具有通用性，未来可推广到使用不同正则化项或不同成像任务的 MPI 场景。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CIFA: Contextual-Intersectional Fairness Auditing for Hidden Subgroup Discovery in Face Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Fairness evaluation in computer vision commonly relies on aggregate accuracy and demographic subgroup analysis. However, visual models are also sensitive to contextual factors such as illumination, blur, image quality, facial accessories, and appearance attributes. These factors may interact with demographic characteristics, producing hidden subgroups in which performance degrades substantially despite strong aggregate accuracy and apparently acceptable demographic fairness. To address this, we propose the Contextual-Intersectional Fairness Auditing Framework (CIFA), a structured framework for identifying subgroup vulnerabilities arising from interactions between demographic and contextual attributes. CIFA performs demographic, contextual, and contextual-intersectional auditing, followed by worst-group discovery to identify and rank the most vulnerable attribute combinations. We evaluate CIFA on gender classification using ResNet-50 \cite{he2016deep} and ViT-B/16 \cite{dosovitskiy2020image} across FairFace \cite{Karkkainen2021}, CelebA \cite{Liu2015}, and UTKFace \cite{Zhang2017}. Our results show that aggregate accuracy and demographic-only evaluation can mask substantial contextual-intersectional disparities. We further assess several established mitigation strategies through an audit--mitigate--reaudit protocol and find that, although some worst-group disparities are reduced, no single strategy consistently eliminates them across datasets and architectures. These findings establish contextual-intersectional auditing as an important component of fairness evaluation and provide a reproducible framework for discovering, prioritizing, and reassessing hidden subgroup risks in face analysis systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出上下文-交叉公平性审计框架 (Contextual-Intersectional Fairness Auditing Framework, CIFA)，用于发现人脸分析模型中由人口统计属性与上下文属性（如光照、模糊、图像质量、面部配饰等）交互导致的隐藏子组性能退化。作者在 FairFace、CelebA、UTKFace 上使用 ResNet-50 和 ViT-B/16 进行性别分类评估，表明聚合准确率和仅基于人口统计的评估会掩盖显著的上下文-交叉差异，并通过审计-缓解-再审计协议检验了若干既有缓解策略。
Motivation: 计算机视觉的公平性评估通常依赖聚合准确率和人口统计子组分析，但视觉模型还对光照、模糊、图像质量等上下文因素敏感；这些因素可能与人口统计特征交互，形成聚合指标和人口统计公平性看似可接受但性能严重下降的隐藏子组。
Method: 提出 CIFA 框架，依次进行人口统计审计、上下文审计和上下文-交叉审计，并通过最差子组发现 (worst-group discovery) 来识别和排序最脆弱的属性组合；同时采用审计-缓解-再审计 (audit–mitigate–reaudit) 协议评估缓解策略。
Result: 在性别分类任务上，聚合准确率和仅人口统计评估会掩盖明显的上下文-交叉差异；虽然部分最差子组差异被缓解，但没有单一策略能在所有数据集和架构上持续消除这些差异。
Conclusion: 作者认为上下文-交叉审计应成为公平性评估的重要组成部分，并提供了可复现的框架用于发现、优先级排序和重新评估人脸分析系统中的隐藏子组风险。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出上下文-交叉公平性审计框架 (Contextual-Intersectional Fairness Auditing Framework, CIFA)，用于发现人脸分析模型中由人口统计属性与上下文属性（如光照、模糊、图像质量、面部配饰等）交互导致的隐藏子组性能退化。作者在 FairFace、CelebA、UTKFace 上使用 ResNet-50 和 ViT-B/16 进行性别分类评估，表明聚合准确率和仅基于人口统计的评估会掩盖显著的上下文-交叉差异，并通过审计-缓解-再审计协议检验了若干既有缓解策略。
summary_sections.motivation: 计算机视觉的公平性评估通常依赖聚合准确率和人口统计子组分析，但视觉模型还对光照、模糊、图像质量等上下文因素敏感；这些因素可能与人口统计特征交互，形成聚合指标和人口统计公平性看似可接受但性能严重下降的隐藏子组。
summary_sections.method: 提出 CIFA 框架，依次进行人口统计审计、上下文审计和上下文-交叉审计，并通过最差子组发现 (worst-group discovery) 来识别和排序最脆弱的属性组合；同时采用审计-缓解-再审计 (audit–mitigate–reaudit) 协议评估缓解策略。
summary_sections.result: 在性别分类任务上，聚合准确率和仅人口统计评估会掩盖明显的上下文-交叉差异；虽然部分最差子组差异被缓解，但没有单一策略能在所有数据集和架构上持续消除这些差异。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为上下文-交叉审计应成为公平性评估的重要组成部分，并提供了可复现的框架用于发现、优先级排序和重新评估人脸分析系统中的隐藏子组风险。

papers.title: Open Evaluation Agent: Efficient and Promptable Evaluation of Visual Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in visual generative models have enabled high-quality image and video generation, but evaluating these models often demands sampling hundreds or thousands of images or videos, which is computationally expensive. Existing evaluation methods also rely on rigid pipelines that overlook specific user needs and provide numerical results without clear explanations. Mimicking how humans quickly form impressions of a model's capabilities from only a few samples, we propose the Evaluation Agent framework, which employs human-like strategies for efficient, dynamic, multi-round evaluations, offering detailed, user-tailored analyses. Given a natural-language evaluation request, the agent decomposes it into sub-aspects, generates targeted prompts, samples images or videos from the evaluated model, invokes suitable evaluation tools, and iteratively updates its plan from the observed evidence, covering both predefined benchmark dimensions and open-ended user concerns. The framework is thus efficient, promptable, explainable, and scalable across models and tools. Experiments show that Evaluation Agent reduces evaluation time to 10% of traditional methods while delivering comparable results. We further introduce Open Evaluation Agent (Open-EA) by constructing EA-CoT-10K, a corpus of history-conditioned step-level instruction-tuning records derived from multi-round evaluation rollouts, and training EA-3B from Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct as a local planning backbone that preserves the structured reasoning, tool invocation, and summary protocol of the API-based agent while reducing dependence on proprietary backbones. Experiments validate the API-based agent on established T2I/T2V benchmarks and open-ended queries, and evaluate Open-EA on four in-domain and three out-of-domain T2V generator families, showing partial cross-family transfer of the learned policy.
papers.comment: Journal extension of our ACL 2025 paper (arXiv:2412.09645). 12 pages. Code: https://github.com/Vchitect/Evaluation-Agent
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Evaluation Agent 框架，用类人策略对视觉生成模型进行高效、动态、多轮评估，并进一步引入 Open Evaluation Agent (Open-EA)：通过构建 EA-CoT-10K 指令微调语料，从 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 训练出本地规划骨干 EA-3B，保留 API 版 agent 的结构化推理、工具调用与总结协议。实验表明该框架可将评估时间降至传统方法的 10%，同时结果相当；Open-EA 在四个域内和三个域外 T2V 生成器族上展现部分跨族迁移。
Motivation: 现有视觉生成模型评估往往需要采样成百上千张图像或视频，计算开销大；已有评估方法依赖僵化管线，忽略用户特定需求，且只输出数值结果而缺乏清晰解释。
Method: 提出 Evaluation Agent：给定自然语言评估请求后，将其分解为子方面，生成定向提示、从被测模型采样图像或视频、调用合适的评估工具，并根据观测证据迭代更新计划，覆盖预定义基准维度和开放性用户问题。为减少对专有后端的依赖，又构建 EA-CoT-10K 语料并训练 EA-3B 作为本地规划骨干。
Result: 实验显示 Evaluation Agent 将评估时间降低到传统方法的 10%，同时给出可比结果；API 版 agent 在已建立的 T2I/T2V 基准和开放查询上得到验证，Open-EA 在四个域内与三个域外 T2V 生成器族上的评估表明所学策略具有部分跨族迁移能力。
Conclusion: 该框架被描述为高效、可提示 (promptable)、可解释且可跨模型与工具扩展；Open-EA 降低了对专有骨干的依赖，但作者仅声称获得部分跨生成器族的策略迁移，而非完整泛化。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Removing Infrastructure Barriers in Human-Robot Collaboration Through Wireless Reconfigurable Cells
papers.abstract_en: Human-Robot Collaboration (HRC) plays a vital role in dynamic, high mix, low volume industrial scenarios such as remanufacturing, which frequently face workcell rearrangements. Traditional setups are constrained by power and data cabling, restricting modularity and reconfigurations, while the selection of commercial wireless devices suitable for real-time perception and safe collaboration are limited in availability. This paper presents a highly flexible, wireless, 5G-based system that serves as a versatile experimental testbed for applications including remanufacturing, operator training, and user studies. To eliminate infrastructure barriers, the workcell integrates a novel battery-powered, multi-sensor platform prototype. Additionally, to support operator safety and system adaptability across environmental shifts, the system integrates a computer vision module for object detection and pose estimation, further augmented for robust hand recognition. Trained on synthetic and real data, the model reliably detects oriented grasping poses and human hands across varying lighting and background conditions (with an mAP@50-95 of 97.74 +- 0.10% and a mean inference time of 12.5 ms). Offloading these computationally intensive tasks to the edge via 5G, the proposed architecture contributes to resolving the bandwidth-latency trade-off. To demonstrate portability, the system was implemented in both Hungary and Norway, and was evaluated across a combination of public and private, Standalone and Non-Standalone 5G infrastructures. The performed network experiments produced results in round-trip response times down to 12 ms in case of compatible network-device pairings, suitable for safe, adaptive HRC. However, these measurements also revealed practical limitations related to interoperability in current 5G deployments that should be addressed in future works.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS). A supplementary video demonstrating the workcell is available at https://youtu.be/zobin6oytGk
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于5G的无线可重构工作单元（wireless reconfigurable cells）测试平台，面向再制造等动态、高混合低批量的人机协作场景。系统集成了电池供电的多传感器平台和计算机视觉模块，用于目标检测、姿态估计和手部识别，并通过5G将计算密集任务卸载到边缘。在匈牙利和挪威的公共/私有、独立组网（SA）与非独立组网（NSA）5G基础设施上进行了评估，报告了检测精度、推理时间和网络往返延迟。
Motivation: 传统人机协作（HRC）工作单元受电源和数据布线限制，难以实现模块化与快速重构；同时市场上适合实时感知和安全协作的商业无线设备选择有限，阻碍了动态工业场景中的灵活部署。
Method: 提出一个高度灵活的5G无线工作单元系统，包含新型电池供电的多传感器平台，并集成基于合成与真实数据训练的计算机视觉模块，用于检测定向抓取姿态和鲁棒的手部识别；系统通过5G将计算密集型视觉任务卸载到边缘计算节点。
Result: 视觉模型在mAP@50-95上达到97.74 ± 0.10%，平均推理时间为12.5 ms；在兼容的网络-设备配对下，往返响应时间低至12 ms，满足安全自适应HRC的需求。同时，网络实验暴露了当前5G部署中互操作性的实际限制。
Conclusion: 该系统展示了无线可重构HRC工作单元的可行性，适用于再制造、操作员训练和用户研究等场景；但摘要指出当前5G部署的互操作性问题是未来需要解决的实际限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EgoHieraLoc: A Cortically Inspired Hierarchical Segmentation-Guided Framework for Egocentric Visual Query Localization
papers.abstract_en: Visual query localization (VQL) aims to retrieve and re-localize a queried object in egocentric videos, yet remains challenging when object boundaries are ambiguous and global context cannot effectively guide fine-grained localization. Human vision handles such ambiguity through a hierarchical process: it rapidly screens foreground candidates, selectively attends to the target despite distractors, refines perception via feedback between global context and local detail, and, when a single view is unreliable, integrates evidence across viewpoints according to its credibility. Inspired by these competencies, we propose \textbf{EgoHieraLoc}, a unified framework for VQL-2D and VQL-3D. A Discriminative Parsing Module first extracts foreground-aware query representations using segmentation priors; a Query-Aware Module then performs robust target localization through discriminative correlation filtering with deformable modeling; and a Regional Adaptation Module feeds multi-scale context back into local regions to recover precise object boundaries. To extend this perceptual hierarchy to 3D localization, we introduce Geometric-Semantic Joint Confidence (GSJC), which multiplicatively couples segmentation confidence with local depth consistency, multi-view back-projection consistency, and triangulation-baseline quality, so that a viewpoint contributes to the 3D estimate only when it is credible both semantically and geometrically. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on both VQL-2D and -3D benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoHieraLoc，一个受皮层层次感知启发的统一框架，用于 egocentric 视频中的视觉查询定位 (visual query localization, VQL)，同时覆盖 VQL-2D 和 VQL-3D。框架包含判别解析模块 (Discriminative Parsing Module)、查询感知模块 (Query-Aware Module) 和区域自适应模块 (Regional Adaptation Module)，分别处理前景感知表示、鲁棒目标定位以及多尺度上下文反馈恢复边界。针对 3D 定位，作者引入几何-语义联合置信度 (GSJC)，结合分割置信度、局部深度一致性、多视角反投影一致性和三角化基线质量来筛选可信视角。实验声称在 VQL-2D 和 VQL-3D 基准上取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 视觉查询定位在物体边界模糊、全局上下文难以指导细粒度定位时表现不佳；人类视觉通过分层筛选、选择性注意、全局-局部反馈和多视角置信度整合来处理这种模糊性，本文希望将这些能力引入统一框架。
Method: 提出 EgoHieraLoc 统一框架：判别解析模块利用分割先验提取前景感知查询表示；查询感知模块通过带变形建模的判别相关滤波 (discriminative correlation filtering) 进行鲁棒目标定位；区域自适应模块将多尺度上下文反馈到局部区域以恢复精确物体边界；对 3D 定位引入 GSJC，用分割置信度与局部深度一致性、多视角反投影一致性、三角化基线质量相乘，使视角仅在语义和几何上可信时参与 3D 估计。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 VQL-2D 和 VQL-3D 基准上均达到 state-of-the-art 性能，但未给出具体数值或数据集细节。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过感知层次化建模和几何-语义联合置信度筛选，可以统一并改进 2D 与 3D 的 egocentric 视觉查询定位。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hallucination-Free GUI Grounding via Regression-Free Layout-Aware Matching
papers.abstract_en: GUI agents are shifting from metadata-dependent large language models to purely visual multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that operate directly on screenshots. The core task, GUI grounding, requires translating abstract user instructions into precise element coordinates. This task faces a persistent dual obstacle: conventional grounding models lack the semantic richness to interpret abstract instructions, while end-to-end MLLMs suffer from coordinate hallucinations caused by deficient fine-grained perception. We propose a regression-free framework where a frozen MLLM performs instruction parsing and a dedicated grounding model handles precise localization without learning any coordinate regression. A frozen MLLM first elaborates the abstract instruction into a structured visual description rich in layout cues. These descriptions are then fed to a novel Layout-Aware GUI Grounding Model, which performs regression-free localization by matching against layout-prior candidates, inherently suppressing hallucinations and avoiding expensive fine-tuning. The grounding model is trained with only Text/Icon binary labels, requiring no coordinate regression parameters. On ScreenSpot-Pro, our method achieves over 20% improvement in grounding accuracy over end-to-end systems; on Mind2Web, it raises success rate and element selection rate by more than 15%. These results demonstrate that decoupling instruction understanding from layout-aware localization effectively resolves the core challenges of GUI interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 GUI 智能体中的 grounding 任务，提出一个免回归 (regression-free) 框架：冻结的 MLLM 负责把抽象指令解析为富含布局线索的结构化视觉描述，再由一个专用的 Layout-Aware GUI Grounding Model 通过与布局先验候选匹配来完成定位，完全不学习坐标回归。摘要报告该方法在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上比端到端系统提升超过 20% 的 grounding 准确率，在 Mind2Web 上成功率和元素选择率提升超过 15%。作者认为将指令理解与布局感知定位解耦能有效解决 GUI 交互中的坐标幻觉问题。
Motivation: GUI grounding 要求把抽象用户指令映射到精确元素坐标，但现有方法面临双重障碍：传统 grounding 模型缺乏语义丰富度，而端到端 MLLM 因细粒度感知不足而产生坐标幻觉 (coordinate hallucination)。
Method: 提出冻结 MLLM 做指令解析、专用 grounding 模型做定位的两阶段框架；MLLM 先把抽象指令改写为含布局线索的描述，再由 Layout-Aware GUI Grounding Model 通过匹配布局先验候选实现回归-free 定位，训练仅需 Text/Icon 二值标签，无需坐标回归参数。
Result: 在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上 grounding 准确率较端到端系统提升超过 20%；在 Mind2Web 上成功率和元素选择率均提升超过 15%。
Conclusion: 作者强调将指令理解与布局感知定位解耦可以抑制幻觉并避免昂贵的微调，从而应对 GUI 交互的核心挑战。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对 GUI 智能体中的 grounding 任务，提出一个免回归 (regression-free) 框架：冻结的 MLLM 负责把抽象指令解析为富含布局线索的结构化视觉描述，再由一个专用的 Layout-Aware GUI Grounding Model 通过与布局先验候选匹配来完成定位，完全不学习坐标回归。摘要报告该方法在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上比端到端系统提升超过 20% 的 grounding 准确率，在 Mind2Web 上成功率和元素选择率提升超过 15%。作者认为将指令理解与布局感知定位解耦能有效解决 GUI 交互中的坐标幻觉问题。
summary_sections.motivation: GUI grounding 要求把抽象用户指令映射到精确元素坐标，但现有方法面临双重障碍：传统 grounding 模型缺乏语义丰富度，而端到端 MLLM 因细粒度感知不足而产生坐标幻觉 (coordinate hallucination)。

papers.title: Predictive safety filter enhanced curriculum learning control for efficient vehicle dynamics controller
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in learning-based control have enabled impressive achievements in solving complex control problems in various domains. However, since learning-based control may not be able to realize safety-guaranties, it is of great importance to enhance safety and robustness while maintaining good performances. Take vehicle motion \& dynamics control as an example, in order to overcome the pain points of traditional methods such as heavy parameter calibration effort and learning-based control to bring better performance and efficiency in stability \& agility over prior work for state-based vehicle control tasks, in this work, our method aims to develop a curriculum learning controller enhanced with physics-based predictive safety filter. The validation is conducted with the Python-CarSim platform, demonstrating better improvements and scalability under various maneuvers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向车辆运动与动力学控制，提出一种由基于物理的预测安全滤波器（predictive safety filter）增强的课程学习（curriculum learning）控制器，以弥补学习控制缺乏安全保证的问题。摘要在 Python-CarSim 平台上对多种机动场景进行验证，称相比传统方法在参数标定效率、稳定性与敏捷性方面取得更好改进，并具有更好的可扩展性。
Motivation: 传统车辆控制方法依赖大量参数标定，而学习控制虽能提升性能但难以提供安全保证；因此需要在保持性能的同时增强安全性和鲁棒性。
Method: 该方法的控制器以课程学习方式训练，并引入基于物理的预测安全滤波器，对学习策略的输出施加安全约束，从而在训练和部署中保障车辆动力学安全。
Result: 摘要报告在 Python-CarSim 平台上的多种机动场景验证显示，该方法比已有工作有更好的性能提升与可扩展性；摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为，结合预测安全滤波器和课程学习能够在降低参数标定负担的同时改善车辆控制的稳定性与敏捷性；但摘要未讨论方法局限。

papers.title: Activation Probes Surface Code-Security Signals that the Model's Output Misses
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents now write a growing share of production code, and human security review does not scale at the rate code is generated. The agents in widest use are closed-weight, so a deploying team cannot read their internals. It can instead run an open-weight model as a reviewer over the agent's output. That reviewer's activations are readable. We ask whether reading those activations recovers a security signal that simply asking the same reviewer misses. We fit a single linear probe per model on a corpus of paired vulnerable-and-fixed Python functions, then test it without retraining on real disclosed vulnerabilities whose weakness type the probe never saw in training, across five open-weight reviewer models. On the vulnerabilities fixed by changing a single function, the probe scores the vulnerable function above its fix on 61-67% of cases for every model, beating the 50% chance line. It also beats the same model's prompted YES/NO win-rate read from its logits, under every prompt we try. Asking the model for a written verdict, even with chain-of-thought, returns the same answer on the vulnerable and fixed function most of the time and so cannot tell them apart. Model activations carry a code-security signal that prompting the same model misses.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the TAIGR workshop, ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否通过读取开源权重评审模型的激活值，恢复其输出文本中缺失的代码安全信号。作者在每个模型上对成对的易漏洞/修复后 Python 函数拟合单个线性探针 (linear probe)，再不做微调地测试于训练中未见过的真实已披露漏洞上。结果表明探针在单函数修复类漏洞上能将漏洞函数排在修复版本之上，在 61-67% 的样本上超过 50% 的随机基线，且优于同模型基于 logits 的 YES/NO 提示回答。
Motivation: AI 编程智能体正在生成越来越多的生产代码，但人工安全审查无法跟上；最广泛使用的智能体为闭源权重，部署团队无法检查其内部。改用开源权重模型作为审查者时，其激活值可读取，因此作者研究阅读这些激活值能否捕捉到单纯询问该审查者所遗漏的安全信号。
Method: 对五个开源权重评审模型，各训练一个线性探针于成对的易漏洞与修复后 Python 函数语料上；随后在训练中从未见过该弱点类型的真实已披露漏洞上直接测试，无需重新训练。将探针分数与同一模型被提示后从 logits 读出的 YES/NO 判定胜率进行比较。
Result: 在仅修改单个函数即可修复的漏洞上，每个模型的探针在 61-67% 的案例中将漏洞函数排在修复版本之上，高于 50% 随机线；在所有尝试的提示下，探针都优于同模型提示式 YES/NO 的 logits 胜率。要求模型给出书面判决，即使使用 chain-of-thought，大多数时候对漏洞与修复函数给出相同答案，无法区分二者。
Conclusion: 模型激活值携带了提示同一模型所无法获得的代码安全信号。该结论限制于已测的开源权重评审模型与单一函数修复类漏洞；作者以此说明读取激活值可以作为输出文本之外的安全审查途径。

papers.title: Avalon-ToM-Bench: Evaluating Fine-Grained Theory of Mind via Asymmetric Game Mechanics
papers.abstract_en: Theory of Mind (ToM) is essential for agent interactions, yet existing evaluations either rely on static scenarios that oversimplify mental-state reasoning or interactive settings that provide limited diagnostic insight. We present Avalon-ToM-Bench, a fine-grained benchmark that operationalizes ToM through the asymmetric-information mechanics of The Resistance: Avalon. Rather than evaluating end-to-end gameplay, it decomposes ToM into a 2$\times$2 taxonomy -- epistemic versus motivational reasoning crossed with inference versus action -- using human-crafted, perspective-constrained queries. Benchmarking 28 LLMs reveals three insights: 1) Reasoning, not knowledge. Models show strong game-rule comprehension but markedly weaker ToM abilities, isolating failures to social reasoning rather than missing domain knowledge. 2) Expression, not representation. Mechanistic analyses via linear probing and activation steering show that models frequently represent correct mental-state inferences in their hidden states but fail to express them during generation -- linear probes recover 77-82% accuracy versus 62-70% from the models' own chain-of-thought. 3) Policy, not deliberation. Dedicated reasoning training yields substantial improvements whereas test-time chain-of-thought provides only marginal gains (+11.0 versus +1.1 points on average), suggesting that robust ToM depends on a learned reasoning policy rather than increased inference-time deliberation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Avalon-ToM-Bench，一个基于《抵抗：阿瓦隆》(The Resistance: Avalon) 不对称信息机制的细粒度 Theory of Mind (ToM) 基准。它不评估端到端游戏，而是将 ToM 分解为 2×2 分类法——认识论与动机推理、推理与行动——并使用人工构造的视角受限查询。作者对 28 个 LLM 进行基准测试，得出三个洞见：推理而非知识、表达而非表征、策略而非深思。
Motivation: 现有的 ToM 评测要么依赖静态场景而过度简化心理状态推理，要么是诊断信息有限的交互式设置，缺乏既能细粒度分解又能保持交互复杂性的评测手段。
Method: 通过 The Resistance: Avalon 的不对称信息机制来操作化 ToM，将任务拆解为认识论 (epistemic) 与动机 (motivational) 推理、推理 (inference) 与行动 (action) 的 2×2 分类，并采用人工构造、视角受限的查询进行评测；同时使用线性探针 (linear probing) 和激活操控 (activation steering) 做机制分析。
Result: 对 28 个 LLM 的评测显示：模型对游戏规则理解较强但 ToM 能力明显较弱；线性探针可从隐状态恢复 77-82% 的准确率，而模型自身 chain-of-thought 仅为 62-70%；专门的推理训练带来平均 +11.0 分的提升，而测试时思维链仅带来 +1.1 分。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，稳健的 ToM 依赖学习到的推理策略 (learned reasoning policy)，而非增加推理时的深入思考；该基准将领域知识与社交推理的失败相分离，并定位到生成阶段的表达问题。

papers.title: DUET: A Diversity-Quality Duet of Distillation Experts for Two-Step Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have enabled high-quality video generation in recent years, but the high cost of iterative sampling hinders their practical deployment. Few-step distillation alleviates this cost, yet exposes a quality--diversity trade-off between its two dominant paradigms: trajectory-level distillation (e.g., sCM) favors diversity, whereas distribution-level distillation (e.g., DMD) favors quality. Targeting extreme two-step video generation, we introduce DUET, which reconciles the two paradigms through a noise-level duet of experts: an sCM expert takes the high-noise step to lay out diverse structure, and a DMD expert takes the low-noise step to refine appearance detail. Since the two experts are trained independently with their native objectives, DUET sidesteps the optimization difficulties of loss-level combinations and delivers quality and diversity jointly rather than trading one for the other. We further identify the relay interface and the high-noise stage as the remaining bottlenecks, and address them with RL-guided expert adaptation, yielding DUET+. With the Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone, DUET lifts the two-step quality of sCM close to the level of DMD while retaining nearly all of its structural diversity---about twice that of DMD---and DUET+ further improves overall quality while preserving this diversity advantage. Together, these results establish noise-level expert specialization as a simple, effective paradigm for reconciling diversity and quality in two-step video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DUET，一种通过噪声级专家组合（sCM expert 与 DMD expert）来调和两步视频生成中质量与多样性权衡的方法。摘要报告在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 骨干上，DUET 将两步生成质量提升至接近 DMD 水平，同时保留约两倍于 DMD 的结构多样性；DUET+ 通过 RL 引导的专家适配进一步提升整体质量。
Motivation: 扩散模型迭代采样成本高，少步蒸馏可降低成本，但两类主流蒸馏范式（轨迹级蒸馏如 sCM 与分布级蒸馏如 DMD）分别偏向多样性和质量，在极端两步视频生成中存在质量-多样性权衡。
Method: 提出噪声级专家分工：sCM 专家负责高噪声步以布局多样结构，DMD 专家负责低噪声步以细化外观细节；两个专家用各自原生目标独立训练，避免损失级组合的优化困难。进一步用 RL 引导的专家适配（DUET+）解决中继接口（relay interface）和高噪声阶段的瓶颈。
Result: 在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 骨干上，DUET 将两步生成质量提升到接近 DMD 的水平，同时保留约两倍于 DMD 的结构多样性；DUET+ 在保持多样性优势的同时进一步提升整体质量。
Conclusion: 摘要认为噪声级专家特化是一种简单有效的范式，可在两步视频生成中同时兼顾多样性与质量。

papers.title: NeuroRefiner: Morphology-Aware Multi-Agent Refinement for 3D Fluorescence Microscopy Neuron Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate 3D neuron segmentation in fluorescence microscopy is critical for neuroscience. However, the sparse and elongated morphology of neurons poses significant challenges to existing segmentation methods. These methods struggle to preserve both local details and global topology, leading to fragmented results. To address this, we propose NeuroRefiner, a multi-agent system that formalizes the human expert workflow involving iterative global observation and local editing. Specifically, NeuroRefiner comprises three collaborative agents dedicated to diagnosing topological errors, generating correction instructions, and validating refinement quality. To facilitate agent instruction-guided segmentation refinement, we propose TopoRefineNet, a dedicated 3D U-Net-based tool that leverages cross-modality feature fusion to generate refined masks. Through multi-round agent reasoning and voxel-level editing, NeuroRefiner produces topologically more accurate segmentations with enhanced interpretability. Experiments on the BigNeuron, CWMBS, and ZBFWB datasets demonstrate that NeuroRefiner outperforms state-of-the-art methods, notably achieving a 3.02% improvement in F1 score on the challenging ZBFWB dataset.

papers.title: LoRA-based Adaptation Alone Is Not Enough: Understanding the Limits of Foundation Models for Face Presentation Attack Detection
papers.abstract_en: Face presentation attack detection (PAD) aims to reliably detect a wide range of presentation attacks. While PAD methods achieve strong performance within individual datasets, their performance degrades under cross-dataset evaluation. Variations in sensors or lighting conditions can reduce the effectiveness of detectors from near-perfect to nearly random. Foundation models (FMs) have emerged as a promising alternative because typical PAD datasets, such as the MCIO benchmarks (MSU-MFSD, CASIA-FASD, Replay-Attack, and OULU-NPU), are small relative to the scale used for web-based pretraining. However, existing PAD systems primarily focus on CLIP-based foundation models, while overlooking other FMs with different architectures and training procedures. This study addresses this question by systematically evaluating 32 FMs. Zero-shot prompting achieves performance near chance across model families and scales. The vision encoders, when low-rankadapted (LoRA) with fewer than 1% trainable weights, achieve below 2% intra-dataset ACER in most cases, while cross-dataset ACER is substantially higher. LoRA primarily refines the decision boundary within a dataset, suggesting that pretrained representations and the adaptation dataset play a larger role in cross-dataset generalization than the evaluated lightweight adaptation strategy.
papers.comment: accepted at ECCV 2026 Workshop on Foundation and Generative Models in Biometrics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了32种不同架构与训练流程的基础模型（foundation model，FM）用于人脸呈现攻击检测（face presentation attack detection, PAD）的表现。结果显示零样本提示（zero-shot prompting）在多种模型家族和规模下接近随机水平；使用少于1%可训练参数的LoRA（low-rank adaptation）适配视觉编码器后，多数情况下可实现低于2%的域内平均分类误差率（ACER），但跨数据集ACER显著更高。作者认为LoRA主要是在数据集内部细化决策边界，预训练表示与适配数据集对跨数据集泛化的作用大于所评估的轻量适配策略。
Motivation: 现有PAD系统主要关注基于CLIP的基础模型，忽略了其他架构与训练过程不同的基础模型；同时PAD在跨数据集评估下性能退化严重，需要更系统的跨模型比较来理解基础模型在该任务中的潜力与局限。
Method: 在MCIO基准（MSU-MFSD、CASIA-FASD、Replay-Attack和OULU-NPU）上系统评估32个基础模型，比较零样本提示与对视觉编码器进行少于1%可训练参数的LoRA适配两种方案。
Result: 零样本提示在所有模型家族与规模上均接近随机性能；LoRA适配在大多数情况下使域内ACER低于2%，但跨数据集ACER明显更高，说明跨域泛化仍然不足。
Conclusion: 摘要强调LoRA主要优化数据集内部的决策边界，预训练表示和适配数据集的特性对跨数据集泛化起更大作用，所评估的轻量适配策略不足以解决跨域退化问题。

papers.title: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Multitask Image Analysis in Realistic Context with Extreme Label Shift; Application to the CTAO first Large Sized Telescope
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised domain adaptation is a widespread set of methods that leverages the knowledge of a labeled source domain to train a model to perform well on a related unlabeled target domain. They generally introduce an auxiliary adaptation-related task that can be integrated into the multitask paradigm, which aims to merge multiple single-task models into a unified architecture. In this paper, we propose to associate domain adaptation and multitask balancing in the realistic context of an extreme class imbalance. Therefore, we propose a combined framework to cover and validate these approaches, and evaluate its performance in the physics-based context of the Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory (CTAO). Along with a comparative study of some relevant adaptation techniques, we highlight the impact of extreme label shift and extend the investigations on importance weighting to rectify it. The complete code and results are published and available as open-source resources on Zenodo.
papers.comment: This is the accepted version of the article published in Astronomy and Computing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个将无监督域适应 (unsupervised domain adaptation) 与多任务平衡结合的训练框架，用于解决现实场景中极端标签偏移 (extreme label shift) 下的图像分析问题，并以 Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory (CTAO) 第一个大型切伦科夫望远镜任务为应用背景。作者比较了若干相关域适应技术，研究了极端标签偏移的影响，并引入重要性加权 (importance weighting) 来修正偏移。完整的代码和结果已作为开源资源发布在 Zenodo 上。
Motivation: 现有多任务域适应方法通常引入辅助适应任务，但在现实数据普遍存在极端类别不平衡的情况下，这些方法的有效性尚未被充分验证。
Method: 提出一个联合框架，将域适应技术与多任务平衡策略结合，在极端标签偏移条件下进行评估，并扩展重要性加权方法以修正标签偏移的影响。
Result: 摘要报告在 CTAO 首个大型切伦科夫望远镜的相关物理任务背景下验证了该框架的性能，并对多种域适应技术做了比较研究，同时凸显了极端标签偏移的影响及重要性加权的矫正效果，但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为该联合框架能够同时覆盖域适应与多任务平衡两类方法，并提供了完整开源代码与结果供复现。

papers.title: Rethinking Self-Evolving Agents: Do We Still Need Prescribed Optimization Pipelines?
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents are usually built around prescribed optimization pipelines: the framework decides how to gather evidence, revise a persistent artifact, select candidates, and stop. We ask whether this task-specific procedure remains necessary when a frontier model acts as the optimizer. We introduce Open-Ended Optimization (OEO), which keeps the objective, permitted interactions, resource budget, data boundary, and evaluation fixed while allowing the optimizer to compose the improvement process online. We compare OEO with two complementary prescribed approaches: SkillOpt, a staged pipeline with bounded edits, and GEPA, a reflective evolutionary search. Across 14 head-to-head comparisons over 8 benchmark-target-model settings, GPT-5.5-driven OEO records 12 wins, 1 tie, and 1 narrow loss of 0.21 percentage points. It uses a median 34.3 percent of SkillOpt's configured target-interaction token budget. A one-shot, zero-interaction control shows that the gains are not explained by a single prior-driven rewrite. However, delegation has a capability boundary: SkillOpt outperforms OEO with a medium optimizer, and a weak optimizer cannot operate through the unchanged OEO interface. In the fully instrumented OEO-SkillOpt pair, trajectory analysis further shows that prescription changes how optimization proceeds more consistently than it changes final behavior. Together, these findings recast prescribed pipelines as capability-dependent scaffolding: essential constraints remain external, but a sufficiently capable optimizer can compose the route from measurable feedback to persistent improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视自我进化智能体是否仍需预设的优化流水线，提出 Open-Ended Optimization (OEO)，即固定目标、允许交互、资源预算、数据边界与评估，而由优化器在线自行编排改进过程。在 8 个 benchmark-target-model 设置上的 14 组对比中，GPT-5.5 驱动的 OEO 取得 12 胜 1 平 1 负（窄差 0.21 个百分点），中位 token 预算仅为 SkillOpt 的 34.3%，但该优势受优化器能力边界限制。
Motivation: 现有自我进化智能体通常围绕任务特定的预设优化流水线构建，由框架决定如何收集证据、修订持久工件、选择候选以及何时停止。作者质疑当使用前沿模型作为优化器时，这种任务特定程序是否仍然必要。
Method: 提出 Open-Ended Optimization (OEO)，将目标、允许的交互、资源预算、数据边界和评估固定，让优化器在线自主组合改进过程。将其与两种互补的预设方法对比：分阶段流水线且带受限编辑的 SkillOpt，以及反思式进化搜索 GEPA；并加入一个 one-shot、零交互的对照以排除单纯先验驱动重写的解释。
Result: 在 8 个 benchmark-target-model 设置上的 14 组对比中，GPT-5.5 驱动的 OEO 记录 12 胜、1 平、1 负（窄差 0.21 个百分点），中位使用 SkillOpt 配置的 target-interaction token 预算的 34.3%。one-shot 零交互对照表明收益并非由单一的 prior-driven 重写解释；但中等能力优化器下 SkillOpt 胜过 OEO，弱优化器无法通过未改变的 OEO 接口运作。完全仪器化的 OEO-SkillOpt 轨迹分析进一步显示，预设更多改变优化过程进行方式的一致性，而非最终行为。
Conclusion: 作者将预设流水线重新定义为依赖优化器能力的脚手架：必要的约束仍保持外部，但足够强大的优化器可以从可测反馈自行编排通往持久改进的路径。同时摘要明确指出委托存在能力边界。

papers.title: Satellite Trajectory Optimization via Proximal Policy Optimization for Space Debris Avoidance
papers.abstract_en: Collision avoidance systems are commonly used to avoid fragmentation events occurring in Low-Earth Orbit (LEO) and Geosynchronous Equatorial Orbit (GEO). However, these events have been growing in frequency as orbital congestion worsens with the launch of megaconstellations. Consequently, conjunction alerts and collision risks are becoming increasingly common. Current practices, which are commonly manual or rule-based, have difficulty scaling to these worsening dynamic environments. To address this intensifying situation, we propose a reinforcement-learning policy for autonomous collision avoidance, trained via Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) along with an open-source, high-fidelity astrodynamics simulator for training and evaluation. In 1,000 deterministic GEO episodes, our agent achieves a 97.5% collision avoidance success rate, outperforming traditional controllers such as a rule-based baseline (20.7% success) and an impulsive delta-v planner baseline (27.5% success). To achieve these results, we designed a simulator to train and evaluate our agent, using real-world and simulated debris. We simulate Newtonian two-body dynamics using Sun/Moon third-body perturbations, fuel-dependent thrust, and configurable debris fields. The agent is trained with curriculum learning and shaped rewards oriented toward encouraging survival, adequate projected miss distance, and delta-v conservation. Finally, our evaluation consisted of a fully deterministic pipeline, including shared seeds, per-episode logs, and telemetry exports. Our work is a publicly available framework at https://purl.org/sat-trajectory-avoidance

papers.journal_ref: L. Luna, J. Ortiz Couder, and R. A. Vargas-Acosta, "Satellite Trajectory Optimization via Proximal Policy Optimization for Space Debris Avoidance," IEEE Access, vol. 14, pp. 18138-18154, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于近端策略优化 (PPO) 的强化学习策略用于卫星自主碰撞规避，并配套一个开源高保真天体动力学仿真器用于训练与评估。在 1,000 个确定性 GEO 场景中，该智能体达到 97.5% 的避碰成功率，远超基于规则 (20.7%) 和脉冲 delta-v 规划器 (27.5%) 的基线。仿真包含日/月三体摄动、燃料相关推力和可配置碎片场，训练采用课程学习 (curriculum learning) 与塑形奖励 (shaped rewards)。
Motivation: 随着巨型星座部署导致轨道拥塞加剧，近地轨道 (LEO) 和地球同步轨道 (GEO) 的合相告警与碰撞风险日益频繁，而当前常见的手动或基于规则的避碰方法难以扩展到这种不断恶化的动态环境。
Method: 设计强化学习策略并使用 PPO 进行训练；构建开源仿真器，模拟牛顿二体动力学、太阳/月球三体摄动、依赖燃料的推力以及真实和模拟碎片场。训练中采用课程学习与旨在鼓励生存、足够的投影交会距离和 delta-v 节省的塑形奖励；评估采用完全确定性的流水线，包括共享随机种子、逐场景日志和遥测导出。
Result: 在 1,000 个确定性 GEO 场景中，智能体取得 97.5% 的碰撞规避成功率，而基于规则的基线只有 20.7%，脉冲 delta-v 规划基线为 27.5%。
Conclusion: 作者提供了一个公开可用的框架，并表明强化学习策略在自主碰撞规避上优于传统控制器，且其评估流程强调确定性与可复现性。

summary_sections.motivation: 随着巨型星座部署导致轨道拥塞加剧，近地轨道 (LEO) 和地球同步轨道 (GEO) 的合相告警与碰撞风险日益频繁，而当前常见的手动或基于规则的避碰方法难以扩展到这种不断恶化的动态环境。
summary_sections.method: 设计强化学习策略并使用 PPO 进行训练；构建开源仿真器，模拟牛顿二体动力学、太阳/月球三体摄动、依赖燃料的推力以及真实和模拟碎片场。训练中采用课程学习与旨在鼓励生存、足够的投影交会距离和 delta-v 节省的塑形奖励；评估采用完全确定性的流水线，包括共享随机种子、逐场景日志和遥测导出。
summary_sections.result: 在 1,000 个确定性 GEO 场景中，智能体取得 97.5% 的碰撞规避成功率，而基于规则的基线只有 20.7%，脉冲 delta-v 规划基线为 27.5%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者提供了一个公开可用的框架，并表明强化学习策略在自主碰撞规避上优于传统控制器，且其评估流程强调确定性与可复现性。

papers.title: Measuring the Wrong Thing: Internal Harmfulness Scores Anti-Rank Successful Jailbreaks
papers.abstract_en: Internal safety scores judge a prompt before any text is generated, and they are validated by how well they separate harmful prompts from benign ones. That separation is then read as evidence that the score will also catch the attacks that succeed. Harmful intent is a property of the prompt. Jailbreak success is an outcome produced later by a particular target model, decoding policy, and judge. A filter tuned on a score that measures the wrong quantity spends its false positive budget on attacks that would have failed anyway. In this paper we audit that inference. Attention based measurements are usually read from prompt dependent locations, so a wrapper changes both the content being judged and the place the signal is taken from. We therefore introduce Active Attention Probing, which supplies a fixed content independent measurement coordinate. We pair every base goal with a plain and a wrapped version and generate real completions from the target models. On Llama, wrapping raises harmful generation from 0.05 to 0.27 while harmful intent AUROC falls from 0.936 to 0.803, so the attacks grow more dangerous while the prompts look safer to the score. Among wrapped harmful prompts the outcome AUROC is 0.220, which places the attacks that succeeded below the attacks that failed. Rare token, passive, and detector derived channels reproduce the reversal on the same matched design, and the reversal itself persists across three target models, seven attack families, and two independent judges. Distribution shift then degrades calibration and threshold transfer before it degrades ranking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计内部安全分数 (internal safety scores) 是否能预测越狱成功。作者指出有害意图是提示的属性，而越狱成功是目标模型、解码策略和 judge 共同产生的后续结果；用错误量纲的分数做过滤会浪费误报预算在那些本来就会失败的攻击上。他们提出 Active Attention Probing 提供固定且内容无关的测量坐标，并在多模型、多攻击族上复现了“攻击变得更危险、但分数看起来更安全”的反转现象。
Motivation: 内部安全分数在生成前评估提示，通常以区分有害与良性提示的分离能力（AUROC）来验证，但这衡量的是提示的有害意图，而非后续越狱是否真的成功。该推理链条可能不成立，导致过滤器的误报预算被花在不会成功的攻击上。
Method: 引入 Active Attention Probing，以固定且内容无关的测量坐标替代从提示相关位置读取的注意力信号，避免 wrapper 同时改变被评判内容和信号提取位置。将每个基础目标配对普通版与包装版提示，并在目标模型上生成真实补全来评估。
Result: 在 Llama 上，包装使有害生成率从 0.05 升至 0.27，而有害意图 AUROC 从 0.936 降至 0.803；在包装的有害提示中，越狱成功对应的结果 AUROC 仅为 0.220，即成功的攻击被排在失败的攻击之下。该反转在三个目标模型、七类攻击族和两个独立 judge 上持续存在，稀有 token、被动通道和检测器派生通道也复现了同样的现象。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分布偏移会先破坏校准与阈值迁移，然后才破坏排序；内部安全分数在有害意图排序上的表现不能可靠等价于其对越狱成功的预测能力。

papers.title: Adaptive Sequential Test Planning for Multi-Mechanism Reliability Qualification via Bayesian Monte Carlo Tree Search
papers.abstract_en: Reliability qualification of advanced semiconductor devices requires sequential stress decisions that balance characterization objectives against multiple competing failure mechanisms. Current practice relies on static test plans derived from population-level acceleration models, which cannot adapt to per-unit variability or real-time degradation observations. This paper presents a closed-loop adaptive test planning framework that formulates reliability qualification as a partially observable sequential decision problem and solves it using Monte Carlo tree search for seed-action simulators (MCTS-SA) coupled with extended Kalman filter (EKF) belief-state estimation. The framework models stochastic, per-device variability in bias temperature instability (BTI), electromigration (EM), and time-dependent dielectric breakdown (TDDB), and treats stress selection as a constrained sequential optimization, i.e., to maximize the probability of successful degradation characterization while respecting catastrophic failure constraints. Under the experimental assumptions used here (discrete stress actions, proxy damage observability, and cumulative degradation without recovery), we believe this to be a novel application of tree-search-based adaptive test planning to multi-mechanism reliability qualification. Across 5,000 planning iterations, the characterization yield (CY) improves from 20% in the first 500 iterations to over 54% in the final 500, with 39% cumulative success, while the best successful test sequence terminates with EM and TDDB damage fractions DEM=0.564 and DTDDB=0.537, well within safety margins. These results demonstrate that sequential Bayesian planning can synthesize damage-aware test policies that significantly outperform non-adaptive strategies for reliability qualification under competing failure modes.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Reliability
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对先进半导体器件的可靠性鉴定问题，提出一个闭环自适应测试规划框架，将可靠性鉴定建模为部分可观测的序贯决策问题，并用树搜索模拟器（MCTS-SA）结合扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）信念状态估计来求解。框架对偏压温度不稳定性（BTI）、电迁移（EM）和经时介电击穿（TDDB）逐器件随机变异性建模，把应力选择视为受灾难性失效约束的序贯优化。摘要报告在 5000 次规划迭代中，鉴定良率（CY）从前 500 次的 20% 提升到末 500 次的 54% 以上。
Motivation: 现有实践依赖基于群体级加速模型的静态测试方案，无法适应逐器件变异性或实时退化观测，难以在多个相互竞争失效机制间平衡表征目标与失效约束。
Method: 将可靠性鉴定建模为部分可观测序贯决策问题，使用蒙特卡洛树搜索种子动作模拟器（MCTS-SA）并耦合扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）进行信念状态估计；应力选择被处理为约束序贯优化，目标是最大化成功退化表征概率并满足灾难性失效约束。实验假设为离散应力动作、代理损伤可观测性以及无恢复的累积退化。
Result: 在 5000 次规划迭代中，表征良率（CY）从前 500 次的 20% 提升到末 500 次超过 54%，累计成功率 39%；最优成功测试序列结束时 EM 与 TDDB 损伤分数为 D_EM=0.564、D_TDDB=0.537，均在安全裕度内。
Conclusion: 作者认为在本文实验假设下，这是树搜索自适应测试规划在多机制可靠性鉴定中的首次应用，并表明序贯贝叶斯规划可生成感知损伤的测试策略，显著优于非自适应策略。

papers.title: Bayesian Symbolic Regression with Entropic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression is the problem of finding an algebraic expression describing a stochastic dependence of a target variable on a set of inputs. Unlike forms of regression that fit parameters assuming a fixed model structure, symbolic regression is a search problem over the space of expressions, represented, for example, as abstract syntax trees using a library of operators. Symbolic regression is typically used in settings with limited, noisy data in the natural sciences. However, searching for a single best-fitting expression fails to capture the epistemic uncertainty about the expression, which motivates a Bayesian perspective that enables uncertainty quantification and specification of natural priors to constrain the search space. In this work, we propose ERRLESS (Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning for Expression Structure Sampling), a scalable approach for sampling from the posterior distribution over expressions given data using maximum-entropy reinforcement learning. ERRLESS learns a neural policy that constructs expressions sequentially by building up their abstract syntax trees. At convergence, the policy samples expressions from the posterior. At test time, expressions can be sampled by rollouts of this policy. We demonstrate that ERRLESS achieves competitive results on the Feynman benchmark while producing short and interpretable expressions. Additionally, we demonstrate that the mean of the posterior predictive approximated by ERRLESS achieves a high coefficient of determination ($R^2$) compared to an SMC baseline, highlighting the benefits of the Bayesian perspective in symbolic regression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ERRLESS（Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning for Expression Structure Sampling），用最大熵强化学习从给定数据下的表达式后验分布中采样，解决符号回归（symbolic regression）中的认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）问题。策略网络逐步构建抽象语法树（AST）来顺序生成表达式，收敛后策略近似后验分布，测试时通过 rollout 采样表达式。在 Feynman benchmark 上取得有竞争力的结果，并生成短而可解释的表达式；与 SMC baseline 相比，其后验预测均值取得较高的 $R^2$。
Motivation: 符号回归通常只搜索单一最佳拟合表达式，无法刻画关于表达式本身的认知不确定性；而在自然科学中数据往往有限且含噪，贝叶斯视角可以量化不确定性并引入自然先验来约束搜索空间。
Method: 提出 ERRLESS，采用最大熵强化学习训练一个神经网络策略，使其逐步构建表达式的抽象语法树；收敛后策略从后验分布中采样表达式，测试时通过策略 rollout 生成样本。
Result: 摘要报告 ERRLESS 在 Feynman benchmark 上取得有竞争力的结果，生成短且可解释的表达式；与 SMC baseline 相比，由 ERRLESS 近似得到的后验预测均值具有较高的决定系数 $R^2$。
Conclusion: 作者强调贝叶斯视角在符号回归中的价值，表明 ERRLESS 可对表达式后验进行近似采样，并在拟合精度与表达式可解释性之间取得平衡。

papers.title: Marrying Optimal Transport and ODEs for Unified Continuous-Time 4D Reconstruction and Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Existing unified 4D reconstruction and point tracking approaches typically rely on heuristic interpolations or just predict at integer timestamps, lacking kinematic coherence and failing to model dynamics at any arbitrary timestamp. In this paper, we propose Uni4R, a framework that unifies these tasks by learning continuous velocity fields through the synergy of Optimal Transport (OT) and Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE). Importantly, this continuous velocity field acts as a kinematic prior that mutually benefits both 4D reconstruction and point tracking. Specifically, we propose the Flow Matching Guided Decoder (FMGD). A global velocity branch first extracts anchor features that capture the global dynamic state of the sequence. Then, FMGD leverages Flow Matching (FM) theory to formulate a probability path defined by OT on the anchor feature manifold, instantiating it as FM-guided velocity features for velocity prediction. This establishes a robust kinematic inductive bias. Meanwhile, a point reconstruction branch provides geometric features. The local velocity prediction module then joint above features and time embeddings, to decode velocities at arbitrary timestamps. To overcome the absence of high-quality ground-truth velocities in fractional frames, we propose an integral-consistency training strategy. This strategy uses an ODE solver to integrate velocities to recover target pointmaps, enabling the model to be supervised end-to-end directly from integer timestamps. Experimental results demonstrate that Uni4R achieves SOTA performance in both 4D reconstruction and point tracking, and achieves SOTA in our new kinematics-aware benchmark at continuous time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Uni4R，一个统一 4D 重建与点跟踪的框架，通过将最优传输 (Optimal Transport, OT) 与常微分方程 (ODE) 结合来学习连续速度场。该速度场作为运动学先验，同时促进重建与跟踪。方法上提出 Flow Matching 引导解码器 (FMGD) 和积分一致性训练策略，使模型能在任意时间戳解码速度，并直接从整数时间戳端到端监督。摘要报告其在 4D 重建和点跟踪上均达到 SOTA，并在新的连续时间运动学感知基准上达到 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有统一 4D 重建与点跟踪方法通常依赖启发式插值或仅在整数时间戳预测，缺乏运动学连续性，无法建模任意时间戳的动态。
Method: 提出 Uni4R：通过 OT 与 ODE 的协同学习连续速度场。FMGD 中，全局速度分支提取锚点特征，利用 Flow Matching (FM) 理论在锚点特征流形上定义由 OT 确定的概率路径，生成 FM 引导的速度特征；点重建分支提供几何特征，局部速度预测模块融合上述特征与时间嵌入，解码任意时间戳的速度。积分一致性训练策略用 ODE 求解器积分速度以恢复目标点图，实现从整数时间戳的端到端监督。
Result: 实验结果表明 Uni4R 在 4D 重建与点跟踪两个任务上均达到 SOTA，并在新提出的连续时间运动学感知基准上达到 SOTA。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过 OT 与 ODE 的协同学习连续速度场并以此作为运动学先验，是统一 4D 重建与点跟踪的有效途径；arXiv 版本标注为初步版本 (Preliminary version)。

summary_sections.method: 提出 Uni4R：通过 OT 与 ODE 的协同学习连续速度场。FMGD 中，全局速度分支提取锚点特征，利用 Flow Matching (FM) 理论在锚点特征流形上定义由 OT 确定的概率路径，生成 FM 引导的速度特征；点重建分支提供几何特征，局部速度预测模块融合上述特征与时间嵌入，解码任意时间戳的速度。积分一致性训练策略用 ODE 求解器积分速度以恢复目标点图，实现从整数时间戳的端到端监督。
summary_sections.result: 实验结果表明 Uni4R 在 4D 重建与点跟踪两个任务上均达到 SOTA，并在新提出的连续时间运动学感知基准上达到 SOTA。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，通过 OT 与 ODE 的协同学习连续速度场并以此作为运动学先验，是统一 4D 重建与点跟踪的有效途径；arXiv 版本标注为初步版本 (Preliminary version)。

papers.title: Structure-Enhanced Features and Quality-Aware Dynamic Anchor Scoring for Robust Lane Detection
papers.abstract_en: Lane detection requires recovering thin, elongated, and frequently occluded lane structures under challenging driving conditions. While anchor-based detectors provide efficient candidate generation, their performance is limited by two coupled issues: backbone features often lose structural continuity along partially visible lanes, and classification confidence may decouple from line-level localization quality, allowing inaccurate anchors to persist before non-maximum suppression (NMS). We propose a structure-enhanced and quality-aware framework that improves lane representation and dynamic-anchor scoring while preserving the inference pipeline of the Anchor Decomposition Network (ADNet). Specifically, a Gated Horizontal-Vertical Token (GHVT) module enhances mid- and high-level backbone features via lightweight directional token interactions with a learnable residual gate. In parallel, Line-Quality-Aware Dynamic Anchor Scoring (LQAS) calibrates existing classification logits using quality supervision, hard-negative suppression, and pairwise ranking without adding inference branches. On the VIL-100 dataset, our method improves ADNet-R34 from 89.97 to 91.28 in F1 score at the 0.5 intersection-over-union threshold (F1@50), reducing both false positives and false negatives. Additional experiments on CULane and TuSimple datasets, extensive ablations, score-distribution diagnostics, and runtime analysis confirm complementary structural and ranking improvements with minimal computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对锚点式 (anchor-based) 车道检测中特征连续性与分类置信度解耦的问题，提出结构增强与质量感知的动态锚点评分框架。具体包括 Gated Horizontal-Vertical Token (GHVT) 模块增强中高层骨干特征，以及 Line-Quality-Aware Dynamic Anchor Scoring (LQAS) 校准分类 logits，同时保持 Anchor Decomposition Network (ADNet) 的推理管线。在 VIL-100 数据集上，ADNet-R34 的 F1@50 从 89.97 提升至 91.28，并同时减少假阳性和假阴性。
Motivation: 锚点式车道检测器存在两个耦合问题：骨干特征在部分可见车道上容易丢失结构连续性，以及分类置信度与线级定位质量脱节，导致不准确的锚点可能在非极大值抑制 (NMS) 前残留，进而限制检测性能。
Method: 提出 GHVT 模块，通过轻量级方向性 token 交互与可学习残差门增强中高层特征；同时提出 LQAS，利用质量监督、硬负样本抑制和成对排序来校准已有分类 logits，不增加推理分支，保持 ADNet 原有推理流程。
Result: 在 VIL-100 数据集上，该方法将 ADNet-R34 的 F1@50 从 89.97 提高到 91.28，同时减少假阳性和假阴性；在 CULane 和 TuSimple 上的额外实验、广泛消融、分数分布诊断与运行时分析进一步确认了结构增强与排序改进的互补性，且计算开销很小。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在保持 ADNet 推理管线不变的前提下，通过结构增强特征与质量感知动态锚点评分获得互补性改进，并仅带来极小的额外计算开销。

papers.title: TSPORec: Token Selection via Preference Optimization for LLM-Based Sequential Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for improving recommendation systems. The effectiveness of LLMs arises from their ability to harness rich textual information and their capacity to model heterogeneous user preferences based on users' interaction history. However, due to the large-scale and deep architectures, LLM-based sequential recommendation approaches generally incur high inference costs, resulting in a low return on investment. To mitigate this cost, many existing approaches resort to using only the first few tokens of item descriptions, which inadvertently discards valuable information contained in the full text, thereby leading to suboptimal recommendation performance. To address this limitation, we propose a novel Token Selection approach for Preference Optimization in LLM-based sequential Recommendation, i.e., TSPORec, which accurately pinpoints informative tokens throughout the entire textual content to improve recommendation performance. Specifically, we design a three-stage pipeline to select informative tokens and introduce a novel proxy reward to facilitate the implementation. TSPORec not only enhances recommendation performance but also improves computational efficiency. Extensive experiments across two models and datasets demonstrate the superb performance (up to 31.25%) and efficiency (up to 63.4%) of our approach compared with six baseline approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/WNQzhu/TSPORec.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TSPORec，一种面向基于 LLM 的序列推荐 (sequential recommendation) 的 token 选择方法，通过偏好优化精准挑选整个物品描述文本中的信息性 token，以同时提升推荐性能与计算效率。方法采用三阶段 pipeline 并引入代理奖励 (proxy reward) 来支撑实现。在两个模型和两个数据集上的实验显示，相比六种基线方法，推荐性能最高提升 31.25%，计算效率最高提升 63.4%，代码已开源。
Motivation: LLM 推荐系统因模型规模大而推理成本高，现有方法常只使用物品描述的前几个 token 来降本，却丢弃了全文中的有价值信息，导致推荐性能次优。
Method: 提出 TSPORec，设计三阶段 pipeline 对完整文本内容中的信息性 token 进行定位与选择，并引入代理奖励以驱动偏好优化 (preference optimization) 的实现。
Result: 在两个模型和两个数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比六种基线方法在推荐性能上最高提升 31.25%，在计算效率上最高提升 63.4%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 TSPORec 能同时改善推荐效果和推理效率，为 LLM 序列推荐提供了一种低成本的 token 选择思路。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Hybrid Neural-Microfacet BRDF Model for Real-Time Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Over the past decade, microfacet-based BRDF models have formed the foundation of real-time rendering pipelines. Despite their widespread use, they often fail to reproduce subtle appearance effects arising from complex light-surface interactions, which have led to the emergence of specialized physics-based models for specific optical phenomena (e.g., diffraction, iridescence, multilayers). Although more accurate, these models lose versatility and lack performance for real-time rendering. Recently introduced, neural models have demonstrated their ability to approximate BRDF reference data coming from measurements, simulations, or even complex shading networks. However, most current neural models require relatively large networks, making them costly for real-time rendering. In this paper, we introduce a hybrid model that combines a GGX-type microfacet model and a neural model to leverage the best features of both representations. The neural component corrects the appearance approximated by the microfacet component, allowing much smaller network than in existing neural models. We show that, at identical memory cost, our model approximates measurements better than state-of-the-art neural models for a low evaluation overhead compared to a microfacet-based model. Furthermore, our hybrid model remains easily editable by artists and benefits from an important sampling scheme, making it attractive for both offline and real-time rendering.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 12 figures, conference, project page see https://ubisoft-laforge.github.io/world/hybridrdf
papers.journal_ref: Eurographics Symposium on Rendering (EGSR) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个混合 BRDF 模型，将 GGX 型微表面 (microfacet) 模型与一个小型神经模型相结合，由神经分量校正微表面分量的外观近似，从而在相同内存成本下比现有神经模型更准，同时保持较低评估开销。摘要还强调该模型易于艺术家编辑，并配有重要采样 (importance sampling) 方案，适合实时与离线渲染。
Motivation: 微表面 BRDF 模型在实时渲染中被广泛使用，但难以再现复杂光-表面交互带来的细微外观；专用物理模型虽更精确，却缺乏通用性且难以达到实时性能。现有神经模型逼近精度较好，但网络规模大、实时运行成本高。
Method: 将 GGX 型微表面模型与一个神经模型结合成混合表示：神经部分负责校正微表面部分近似的残差外观，从而只需很小的网络即可达到较好的测量数据逼近效果，并保留可编辑性与重要采样能力。
Result: 摘要报告，在相同内存成本下，该混合模型对参考测量数据的近似质量优于现有最先进的神经模型，且相对纯微表面模型仅有较低评估开销 (low evaluation overhead)。摘要未给出具体数值或对比基准名称。
Conclusion: 作者认为该混合模型兼顾了微表面模型的渲染效率与神经模型的拟合精度，同时保留艺术家可控性，因此对离线与实时渲染都具吸引力。摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ResemBrick: Brick Reconstruction from Photographs with Perceptual Fidelity and Buildability
papers.abstract_en: Producing a hand-buildable, colored brick model of a 3D object from a few casual photographs is a clean testbed for a broader challenge: generating 3D content that meets hard physical-assembly constraints under a discrete, budget-limited voxel grid. On a coarse lattice, visual resemblance and structural stability pull against each other, yet prior brick pipelines address only one side and treat voxelization as fixed preprocessing rather than a variable to optimize. We present ResemBrick, which couples the two. Budgeted occupancy completion reframes discretization as allocation: given a target occupied-voxel count, a single resolution-conditioned network decides in one feed-forward pass which surface voxels to fill for best appearance, one weight set spanning 13 resolutions. Buildability by construction then combines support- and look-ahead-aware greedy placement with a deterministic, provably terminating repair that grounds every floating component. Under a matched budget, ResemBrick surpasses existing voxel selectors in perceptual fidelity while uniquely reaching zero floating and zero unstable bricks on unfiltered held-out objects; as a complete pipeline, it attains the best perceptual fidelity among prior brick-construction systems. Our results point to treating discretization and assembly as tightly coupled stages rather than independent ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ResemBrick，一种从少量随意照片生成可手工搭建的彩色积木模型的管线。其核心是把体素化离散化视为需要优化的资源分配问题：在给定占用体素预算下，用一个分辨率条件网络在单次前向传播中决定填充哪些表面体素，同一权重覆盖 13 种分辨率；随后用支持性前瞻贪心放置与确定性、可证明终止的修复步骤保证可搭建性。摘要报告在匹配预算下，ResemBrick 在感知保真度上超过现有体素选择器，并在未过滤的保留对象上实现零悬浮、零不稳定积木。
Motivation: 现有积木重建管线只处理视觉相似性或结构稳定性中的一方，并把体素化当作固定预处理而非可优化变量；在粗网格上视觉相似性与结构稳定性相互冲突，而手工程可搭建、颜色积木模型需要同时满足离散且有预算上限的物理装配约束。
Method: 将体素化建模为预算化占用补全：给定目标占用体素数，一个分辨率条件网络在单次前向传播中决定填充哪些表面体素，一组权重覆盖 13 种分辨率；可搭建性通过结合支持性前瞻贪心放置与确定性、可证明终止的修复步骤来保证，把每个浮动组件接地。
Result: 在匹配预算下，ResemBrick 在感知保真度上优于现有体素选择器，并在未过滤的保留对象上达到零浮动和零不稳定积木；作为完整管线，它在既有积木构建系统中取得最佳感知保真度。
Conclusion: 作者认为应将离散化与装配视为紧密耦合的阶段，而不是彼此独立的阶段。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LEED: Local Embedding Evolution Distance for over-smoothing estimation and virtual node selection in GNN
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) suffer from two fundamental limitations: over-smoothing, where node representations become indistinguishable with depth, and over-squashing, where long-range information is compressed through limited message-passing channels. Existing metrics such as Dirichlet energy provide global characterizations of over-smoothing but lack the resolution to analyze node-level behavior and guide architectural improvements. In this paper, we propose LEED (Local Embedding Evolution Distance), a novel local metric that quantifies over-smoothing by tracking the evolution of individual node embeddings across layers. By operating at the node level, LEED enables fine-grained analysis of representation dynamics during training, revealing heterogeneous over-smoothing patterns that are invisible to global energy-based measures. This locality induces informative node importance scores, interpreted as embedding-driven centrality measures. We leverage LEED to design a more efficient strategy for virtual node selection. Unlike existing approaches that depend on multiple heuristic centrality measures, our method uses LEED as a unique criterion to guide the construction of Local Virtual Nodes to mitigate over-squashing. Experiments show that LEED provides more informative diagnostics than Dirichlet energy while preserving global evaluation, and enables more effective virtual node integration, improving GNN performance across datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LEED（Local Embedding Evolution Distance），一种节点级局部度量，通过追踪单个节点嵌入在层间的演化来量化过度平滑（over-smoothing），并能提供比 Dirichlet 能量更细粒度的诊断信息。作者进一步将 LEED 作为唯一准则用于虚拟节点选择，构建 Local Virtual Nodes 以缓解过度压缩（over-squashing），实验显示该方法在多个数据集上提升 GNN 性能。
Motivation: GNN 面临 over-smoothing 和 over-squashing 两个基本局限；现有 Dirichlet 能量等指标只提供全局刻画，无法分析节点级行为，也难以指导架构改进。
Method: 提出节点级指标 LEED，追踪各节点嵌入跨层的局部演化，得到 embedding-driven 中心性分数；利用 LEED 作为单一标准来选择虚拟节点，替代依赖多个启发式中心性度量的现有方案，构造 Local Virtual Nodes 缓解 over-squashing。

papers.title: From Sweep to Seam: Interleaved Cross-Block Post-Training Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Compressing large language models to two bits or fewer is increasingly feasible through block-wise post-training quantization; cross-block variants reconstruct neighboring Transformer blocks within a moving window. In the fixed two-block setting studied here, the matched sequential baseline moves this window through the network once, so errors introduced early in the sweep are not revisited. We propose Interleaved Cross-Block Quantization (ICBQ), a scheduling modification that revisits the boundary pair between consecutive chunks. Each seam pair is refined twice: first at the end of one chunk and again at the start of the next. The method retains the local two-block objective and reuses the calibration inputs of existing block-wise PTQ pipelines. Under stated local contraction and smoothness assumptions, we derive a depth-wise upper-bound comparison in which seam revisits multiply the propagated term while the residual remains bounded independently of depth. In the reported experiments, ICBQ reduces ternary-quantization perplexity relative to the matched Sequential CBQ baseline, yields finite perplexity in configurations where the baseline has severe degradation, and can also be used with 3-bit and 2-bit GPTQ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对块级后训练量化 (PTQ) 中顺序扫描窗口会引入早期误差且不回头修正的问题，提出交错跨块量化 (Interleaved Cross-Block Quantization, ICBQ)。该方法让相邻 chunk 之间的边界 seam 对被重复精化两次，保留局部双块目标并复用现有校准输入。在假设局部收缩和平滑性的条件下给出深度方向的上界比较，实验显示 ICBQ 在三值量化困惑度上优于匹配的顺序跨块基线，并能在基线严重退化的配置下获得有限困惑度。
Motivation: 现有跨块后训练量化方法在固定双块设置下用移动窗口顺序扫过网络，早期引入的量化误差不会被重新访问，可能导致误差沿深度累积和退化。
Method: ICBQ 对连续 chunk 间的边界 pair 进行两次精化：一次在一个 chunk 末尾，一次在下一个 chunk 开头。方法保持局部双块目标，并复用现有块级 PTQ 管线的校准输入。
Result: 实验显示 ICBQ 降低三值量化困惑度，在基线严重退化的配置下仍能得到有限困惑度，并可用于 3-bit 和 2-bit GPTQ。理论上给出深度方向上 seam 重访使传播项相乘而残差保持有界（与深度无关）的比较。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这种调度修改在不改变局部目标的情况下改进跨块量化稳定性，且适配已有块级 PTQ 流程。

papers.title: Illusion or Integrity? Geometrical Consistency Metric for AIGC Video Quality Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Recently, AI-driven video generation has attracted considerable attention. This surge increases the demand for reliable video quality assessment (VQA) metrics to evaluate AI-generated content (AIGC) videos and guide model optimization. Existing studies assess video quality through visual harmony, video-text consistency, and domain-specific alignment, yet lack quantitative metrics for measuring fidelity to physical laws. To address this limitation, we present a novel benchmark that evaluates the quality of AIGC videos based on their compliance with physical principles by quantitatively measuring geometric consistency across frames extracted from generated sequences. This serves as a proxy for estimating the extent to which generated videos conform to real-world physical rules. Specifically, GeoCon-Bench captures global motion through translation estimation, fits homography or fundamental matrix models using background correspondences, and reports complementary metrics, including inlier ratio and geometric error. We also release a dataset containing 20 scenes across six motion categories. Experiments on state-of-the-art AIGC models demonstrate the reliability of GeoCon-Bench as a video quality assessment metric.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 AIGC 视频质量评估提出 GeoCon-Bench 基准，通过跨帧几何一致性（geometric consistency）来定量衡量生成视频是否符合物理规律。方法通过平移估计捕捉全局运动、利用背景对应关系拟合单应矩阵或基础矩阵，并给出内点比率与几何误差等互补指标；同时发布包含 6 类运动、20 个场景的数据集。在多个 SOTA AIGC 模型上的实验表明该基准作为视频质量评估指标具有可靠性。
Motivation: 现有 AIGC 视频质量评估（VQA）研究主要关注视觉和谐、视频-文本一致性与领域特定对齐，缺少对物理规律符合程度的定量度量，因此难以衡量生成视频在物理一致性上的真实性。
Method: 提出 GeoCon-Bench，从生成序列的帧间几何一致性角度评估 AIGC 视频：先通过平移估计获取全局运动，再基于背景对应关系拟合单应矩阵（homography）或基础矩阵（fundamental matrix）模型，并报告内点比率与几何误差作为互补指标；同时构建包含 20 个场景、6 类运动的数据集。
Result: 在多个 SOTA AIGC 生成模型上的实验验证了 GeoCon-Bench 作为视频质量评估指标的可靠性，但摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调将物理规律符合度纳入 AIGC 视频评估的必要性，并认为 GeoCon-Bench 可作为一种衡量生成视频几何一致性与真实世界物理规则符合程度的代理指标。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MADBench: A Benchmark for Modality-Aware Audio Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in speech synthesis and audio generation have made high-fidelity acoustic forgery low-cost and difficult to attribute, enabling a realistic attack scenario in which speech and background audio are independently manipulated over otherwise authentic video. Yet existing research either focuses on visual manipulation, addresses speech detection in isolation, or conflates speech and non-speech audio as a single undifferentiated audio stream, overlooking the distinct forensic challenges posed by background audio. This conflation is consequential: the two acoustic components arise from fundamentally different generative mechanisms, exhibit distinct artifact profiles, and pose different challenges to detection systems. We introduce MADBench, the first benchmark that treats speech and environmental audio as distinct acoustic components, enabling component-aware evaluation of audio deepfake detection across independently manipulated forgery sources. We benchmark representative state-of-the-art detectors and multimodal large language models under a unified protocol. Our experiments reveal that environmental audio manipulation is more detectable than synthetic speech across general-purpose encoders, while existing pretrained detectors fail on both acoustic components, and manipulated environmental audio asymmetrically degrades speech deepfake detection, findings entirely invisible under the single-label paradigm of prior benchmarks. MADBench establishes a rigorous foundation for future research into robust, component-aware audio deepfake detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MADBench，据称是首个将语音与环境背景音视为独立声学组件的音频深度伪造检测基准，支持针对独立操纵伪造源的组件级评估。作者在统一协议下评测了若干代表性检测器与多模态大语言模型，发现环境音频操纵比合成语音更易被通用编码器检测，现有预训练检测器对两类组件均失效，且被操纵的环境音频会不对称地削弱语音深度伪造检测性能。
Motivation: 现有研究要么只针对语音检测，要么把语音与非语音音频合并为单一音频流，忽视了背景音频不同于语音的取证挑战——两类声学组件来源于不同的生成机制、具有不同的伪影特征，对检测系统构成不同难度。
Method: 提出 MADBench 基准，将语音与环境音频作为独立组件分开评测，并在统一评测协议下对代表性深度伪造检测器和多模态大语言模型进行基准测试。
Result: 实验显示环境音频操纵比合成语音更容易被通用编码器检测；现有预训练检测器对语音和环境音频两类组件均失败；被操纵的环境音频会不对称地降低语音深度伪造检测性能，而这些问题在先前单一标签范式中完全不可见。
Conclusion: 作者认为 MADBench 为未来稳健的、组件感知的音频深度伪造检测研究建立了基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FactorDrive: Adaptive Multi-Step Reasoning Driven by Planning-Critical Factors for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced scene understanding and enabled explicit reasoning in end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing methods insufficiently integrate spatial-physical evidence into planning reasoning, while reasoning adaptation remains coarse-grained and falls short of scene-specific planning demands. Furthermore, reasoning-path optimization for higher planning quality remains largely unexplored in autonomous-driving post-training. To address these limitations, we propose FactorDrive, an end-to-end autonomous driving framework for adaptive multi-step reasoning driven by planning-critical factors (PCFs). We first perform large-scale driving-domain instruction tuning to establish foundational driving knowledge. Building on this foundation, we construct PCF-CoT, a chain-of-thought (CoT) dataset that grounds planning reasoning in trajectory-relevant spatial-physical evidence and organizes reasoning around scene-specific PCFs, enabling the composition and depth of reasoning paths to adapt to different planning demands. We further introduce Quality Search-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization (QS-GRPO), which guides Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with trajectory-level planning rewards to discover reasoning paths with higher planning quality and uses the resulting responses to optimize the policy through GRPO, thereby improving trajectory planning performance. Extensive experiments on both open-loop (nuScenes) and closed-loop-oriented (NAVSIM) benchmarks demonstrate that FactorDrive achieves state-of-the-art planning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FactorDrive，一个面向端到端自动驾驶的自适应多步推理框架，核心是围绕规划关键因子（planning-critical factors, PCFs）组织推理，并用质量搜索引导的 GRPO 优化推理路径。作者先做驾驶领域指令微调，再构建 PCF-CoT 链式推理数据集，最后引入 QS-GRPO，用轨迹级规划奖励引导 MCTS 搜索更高规划质量的推理路径。实验在 nuScenes 与 NAVSIM 基准上取得 SOTA 规划性能。
Motivation: 现有基于 VLM 的自动驾驶方法未能将轨迹相关的空间物理证据充分融入规划推理，推理自适应粒度粗糙，难以匹配具体场景的规划需求；同时，后训练阶段针对推理路径优化以提升规划质量的问题此前基本未被探索。
Method: FactorDrive 包含三部分：大规模驾驶领域指令微调以建立基础驾驶知识；构建 PCF-CoT 数据集，将规划推理锚定在轨迹相关的空间物理证据上，并围绕场景特定的 PCF 组织推理，使推理路径的组合与深度可随规划需求调整；提出 QS-GRPO，用轨迹级规划奖励引导蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）发现更高规划质量的推理路径，并用 GRPO 优化策略。
Result: 摘要报告 FactorDrive 在开放环基准 nuScenes 和闭环导向基准 NAVSIM 上均达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）规划性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将规划关键因子与轨迹相关空间物理证据结合、并通过质量搜索优化推理路径，可以有效提升端到端自动驾驶的轨迹规划质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TeaMatch: Teachable Cross-Modal Representation Learning for 2D-3D Matching
papers.abstract_en: Learning reliable correspondences between images and point clouds is fundamental for 2D-3D matching. Despite recent progress in detection-free methods, existing approaches primarily optimize matching within a single model and often struggle to maintain reliable correspondences under challenging conditions such as noisy inputs, low overlap, and ambiguous structures. In this work, we propose TeaMatch, a novel framework that introduces teachability as a criterion for cross-modal representation learning. We define teachability as the ability of a representation to be effectively recovered by weak learners under degraded inputs, reflecting its structural consistency and robustness. To this end, we construct a set of task-specific weak students that simulate common failure modes and train them to imitate the teacher on a training split while evaluating their recoverability on a disjoint meta split. The teacher is then optimized to improve the students' ability to recover reliable correspondences, guided by correspondence-level and geometry-aware constraints. Our framework can be seamlessly integrated into existing coarse-to-fine matching pipelines without additional inference cost. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TeaMatch improves matching robustness and achieves state-of-the-art performance on challenging 2D-3D matching benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
