papers.title: SwissCrop25: A National Multi-Year Benchmark for Operational Crop Mapping
papers.abstract_en: Operational crop mapping requires models that generalise across years, resolve fine-grained crop taxonomies, and distinguish cropland from surrounding landscapes. However, existing crop mapping datasets enable evaluation of these requirements only in isolation. We therefore introduce SwissCrop25, a national-scale crop mapping benchmark dataset spanning seven growing seasons (2019-2025). SwissCrop25 combines Sentinel-2 time series, daily temperature observations, a fine-grained 73 crop taxonomy including grassland management types, and 5 explicit non-crop land cover classes. To evaluate realistic deployment conditions, we define a leave-one-year-out protocol with joint cropland delineation and crop classification for benchmarking representative crop mapping architectures. Evaluating U-TAE (convolutional temporal-attention model), TSViT (transformer-based spatio-temporal model), and Galileo (EO foundation model) reveals differences between architectures hidden by conventional benchmarks. In this setting, domain-specific models outperform Galileo, with TSViT achieving the best overall performance and a 12 pp macro-mIoU advantage over U-TAE. SwissCrop25 also exposes substantial interannual distribution shifts and shows that incorporating temperature-derived phenological information improves robustness. Finally, in-season evaluation reveals a trade-off between models, with U-TAE performing better early in the season and TSViT gaining an advantage later through improved rare-class discrimination. SwissCrop25 provides a challenging testbed for evaluating crop mapping systems under realistic operational conditions and is publicly released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/EOA-team/SwissCrop25 .
papers.comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop TerraBytes II. To appear in the workshop proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SwissCrop25，一个覆盖瑞士全国、跨 2019-2025 七个生长季的作物制图基准数据集，结合 Sentinel-2 时间序列、每日温度观测、包含草地管理类型的 73 类细粒度作物分类法以及 5 个非作物土地覆盖类别。作者定义了留一年验证 (leave-one-year-out) 协议，联合进行农田边界划定与作物分类，并评估 U-TAE、TSViT 和 Galileo 三种代表性架构。结果显示领域专用模型优于 Galileo，TSViT 总体最佳，相比 U-TAE 有 12 个百分点 macro-mIoU 优势，同时暴露了显著的跨年分布偏移，并表明加入温度衍生的物候信息可提升鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有作物制图数据集只能孤立地评估模型跨年份泛化、细粒度分类和耕地与周围景观区分等要求，缺乏在统一基准中同时考查这些实际操作条件的设置。
Method: 构建全国尺度的 SwissCrop25 基准数据集，包含多季节 Sentinel-2 时间序列、日温度观测、73 类作物分类（含草地管理类型）和 5 类非作物覆盖类别；定义留一年验证协议，并联合评估耕地划定与作物分类，比较 U-TAE、TSViT 与 Galileo 等架构。
Result: TSViT 获得最佳总体性能，macro-mIoU 比 U-TAE 高 12 个百分点；领域专用模型优于 Galileo；数据集中存在显著的跨年分布偏移；加入温度衍生的物候信息可提升鲁棒性；季节内评估显示模型间存在权衡，U-TAE 在季初表现更好，TSViT 在季末通过稀有类别判别获得优势。
Conclusion: SwissCrop25 为在现实操作条件下评估作物制图系统提供了具有挑战性的测试平台，并已公开发布。

papers.title: Walk-on-Spheres Monte Carlo and deep neural network approximations of elliptic PDEs with drift and killing
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we provide Monte Carlo and deep neural network approximations for stochastic representations of solutions to linear elliptic partial differential equations with constant diffusion, drift and killing. Building on the modified Walk-on-Spheres algorithm of Beznea et al. (arXiv:2209.01432), we introduce Monte Carlo estimators that explicitly incorporate sampled random times arising in the analyzed stochastic representations. We establish uniform error bounds for these estimators and show that, under suitable assumptions, a prescribed approximation accuracy is achieved with sample complexities growing at most polynomially in both the inverse accuracy and the problem dimension. Furthermore, we prove a deep neural network approximation result for the stochastic representations. Assuming suitable neural network representations of the boundary data and the distance function to the boundary, we use the constructed Monte Carlo to design deep neural networks that approximate the representation uniformly with a number of parameters growing at most polynomially in the inverse accuracy and the problem dimension. These results extend previous complexity analyses to a broader class of elliptic equations involving drift and killing.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 基于 Beznea 等人的修正 Walk-on-Spheres 算法，构造显式纳入随机时间的蒙特卡洛估计器，并以此设计深度神经网络逼近随机表示。
Result: 在适当假设下，以逆精度和问题维度的多项式样本复杂度达到指定逼近精度；深度神经网络逼近亦以多项式参数数实现均匀逼近。
Conclusion: 摘要强调研究将随机表示与深度神经网络的复杂度分析推广到含漂移和杀伤的椭圆方程类别。

papers.title: GeoRoute: Geometry-Aware Hybrid Inference for Traffic Future-Frame Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon future-frame prediction is important for autonomous driving, traffic surveillance, and intelligent transportation systems, yet remains challenging due to temporal ghosting, geometry drift, and inconsistent object motion. Recent latent video diffusion models have achieved impressive visual quality, but directly applying them to structured traffic scenes often leads to unstable geometry and degraded temporal coherence over extended horizons. We present a training-free inference framework that stabilizes reliable static structure in pretrained video predictions through multi-frame temporal context and view-conditioned routing. For front-camera videos, our method refines generated futures with a multi-frame depth-layered renderer that projects static geometry from observed history frames while preserving dynamic regions from the generative base model. For heterogeneous traffic views, a frozen vision-language model infers a coarse camera group from the observed clip and selects a specialized motion-based predictor. The framework requires neither retraining nor fine-tuning of the underlying video model and can be applied directly to pretrained generators. We validate the proposed framework on the AI City Challenge Track 5 benchmark, where our final system achieves competitive performance among the top-ranked teams. These results demonstrate that geometry-aware inference-time refinement and view-conditioned hybrid inference can improve static-geometry stability and low-level structural fidelity without changing the original model architecture.
papers.comment: accepted to the ECCV 2026 AI City Challenge Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的推理框架 GeoRoute，用于提升预训练视频扩散模型在交通场景长时程未来帧预测中的几何稳定性与时间一致性。方法通过多帧深度分层渲染器（multi-frame depth-layered renderer）把观测历史帧中的静态几何投影到生成结果中，并保留动态区域；对异质交通视角则用冻结的视觉语言模型推断粗略相机组并路由到专门的基于运动的预测器。在 AI City Challenge Track 5 基准上取得有竞争力的排名，且不需要重训或微调底层视频模型。
Motivation: 长时程未来帧预测在自动驾驶、交通监控和智能交通系统中很重要，但现有潜在视频扩散模型直接用于结构化交通场景时会出现时间重影、几何漂移和物体运动不一致。
Method: 提出零训练（training-free）的推理框架：对前视相机视频，用多帧深度分层渲染器从历史帧投影静态几何，同时保留生成模型的动态区域；对多视角交通场景，用冻结的视觉语言模型从观测片段推断粗略相机组，并选择专门的基于运动的预测器。
Result: 在 AI City Challenge Track 5 基准上，最终系统在排名靠前的队伍中取得有竞争力的性能，表明几何感知的推理时修正和视角条件混合推理可提升静态几何稳定性与底层结构保真度。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架不改变原模型架构、无需重训或微调，可直接应用于预训练生成器，并验证了几何感知推理时细化与视角条件混合推理的有效性。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: When Do Task Vectors Interfere? Mapping the Validity Boundaries of Weight-Space Composition
papers.abstract_en: Task arithmetic treats fine-tuning displacements as composable directions in weight space, yet it remains unclear when parameter addition reflects predictable changes in model function. We separate parameter geometry from functional geometry and measure pairwise functional non-additivity over a two-dimensional task-vector surface, using a first-token predictive-distribution interaction ratio conditioned on an input distribution and evaluated with norm-matched controls, three training seeds, and response-only fine-tuning. On Qwen2.5-1.5B, code+safety is more non-additive than the matched code+math control on code and instruction prompts, but not on math prompts. In a prospectively specified six-task expansion, all eight high-versus-low comparisons of unseen task pairs have the predicted sign. The primary ordering further persists under full-parameter fine-tuning at 0.5B, Qwen2.5 LoRA scale tests up to 7B, and a Llama-3.1-8B cross-architecture audit. External validation exposes a sharper boundary: raw public code, instruction, and safety prompts preserve the continuous contrast, whereas an instruction-style wrapper collapses it on the identical public-code prompts, and EvalPlus pass@1 interactions do not robustly reproduce it. Weight-space composition therefore supports coarse, input- and format-conditioned functional statements across adaptation methods, scales, and one additional model family, not a universal merging-performance predictor.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 3 figures; includes references and an expanded appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究任务向量（task vectors）在权重空间中的可加性边界，将参数几何与函数几何区分开，并在二维任务向量曲面上测量两两函数非可加性。实验基于 Qwen2.5-1.5B 的首 token 预测分布交互比（interaction ratio），发现 code+safety 在 code 和 instruction 提示下比 code+math 对照更非可加，但在 math 提示下并非如此；预注册的六任务扩展中八个高低比较方向全部符合预期，且结论在 0.5B 全参数微调、最高 7B 的 Qwen2.5 LoRA、以及 Llama-3.1-8B 跨架构审计中保持。外部验证显示原始公共提示保留对比，而 instruction 风格包装会使其消失，EvalPlus pass@1 交互不稳健。
Motivation: 任务算术（task arithmetic）把微调位移视为权重空间中的可组合方向，但参数相加何时对应可预测的函数变化并不清楚，因此需要刻画权重空间组合的有效边界。
Method: 作者将参数几何与函数几何分离，用条件于输入分布的首 token 预测分布交互比，在二维任务向量曲面上度量两两函数非可加性，并采用范数匹配对照、三个训练种子和仅响应微调（response-only fine-tuning）；同时设计了预注册的六任务扩展，以及全参数微调、LoRA、跨架构审计和外部有效验证。
Result: 摘要报告 code+safety 在 code 和 instruction 提示下比匹配的 code+math 对照更非可加，但在 math 提示上不成立；六任务扩展中所有八个未见过任务对的预测方向均正确；主排序在 0.5B 全参数、最高 7B 的 Qwen2.5 LoRA 和 Llama-3.1-8B 上保持。外部验证中，原始公共 code、instruction、safety 提示保留连续对比，instruction 风格包装在相同 code 提示上破坏该对比，且 EvalPlus pass@1 交互不能稳健复现。
Conclusion: 作者认为权重空间组合只能在适应方法、模型规模和另一个模型家族上支持粗糙的、依赖输入与格式的函数性陈述，而非通用的合并性能预测器（universal merging-performance predictor）。

papers.title: Capability Is Not Propensity: Measuring Pressure-Robust Cooperative Behavior in Civic LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative capabilities in language models are dual-use. The same social reasoning that supports civic deliberation can also enable strategic omission, false consensus, and manipulative framing. We argue that Cooperative AI evaluations should separate what models can do under benign instructions from what they tend to do under realistic civic pressure. We introduce DiffCoop-Civic, a 10-scenario pilot evaluation suite spanning preference understanding, evidence and persuasion, commitment design, asymmetric information, and dissent preservation. Across seven models from four model families, subtle omission pressure produces a near-uniform shift: manipulative enablement rises by 1.17 points and dissent preservation falls by 1.67 points on a 5-point scale. Overt false-consensus pressure behaves differently: it triggers refusal or redirection in some aligned API models, but direct compliance in several open-weight models. A lightweight Pareto-Trace prompting intervention improves pressure robustness without simply relying on hard refusal. An anonymous reproducibility package is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/diffcoop-civil-771C.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文主张将语言模型的合作能力 (capability) 与其在现实公民压力下的行为倾向 (propensity) 分开评估，并提出 DiffCoop-Civic，一个包含 10 个场景的试点评测套件，覆盖偏好理解、证据与说服、承诺设计、信息不对称和异议保留。作者在四个模型家族的七个模型上测试发现，微妙的省略压力会引起近乎一致的行为偏移，而明显的虚假共识压力在不同模型上表现为拒绝或直接顺从。
Motivation: 语言模型的合作能力具有双重用途：支撑公民讨论的同一套社会推理也可能被用于策略性省略、虚假共识和操纵性框架。现有评估往往只考察模型在良性指令下能做什么，而没有区分它在真实公民压力下倾向于做什么。
Method: 提出 DiffCoop-Civic 评测套件，包含 10 个场景，涵盖偏好理解、证据与说服、承诺设计、不对称信息和异议保留五个方面，并引入一种轻量级 Pareto-Trace 提示干预来提升压力鲁棒性。
Result: 摘要报告，微妙的省略压力在七个模型上产生近乎一致的偏移：操纵性纵容 (manipulative enablement) 上升 1.17 分，异议保留 (dissent preservation) 下降 1.67 分（5 分制）。明显的虚假共识压力则在部分对齐的 API 模型中触发拒绝或重定向，但在多个开放权重模型中导致直接顺从；Pareto-Trace 提示干预在不依赖硬拒绝的情况下改善了压力鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为合作式 AI 评测应当区分能力与倾向，且压力鲁棒的合作行为可以通过轻量级干预而非简单拒绝对话来改善。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hierarchical rank-evolving representation for physics-informed neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Recently, tensor-based physics-informed neural networks (T-PINNs) have received increasing attention. However, existing T-PINNs still face a fundamental challenge: they mainly rely on pre-specified low-rank tensor decompositions with manually tuned ranks, which limits their ability to capture the underlying structures of multivariate solution functions and hinders their practical deployment. To address this challenge, we propose a hierarchical rank-evolving (abbreviated as HRE) representation for multivariate functions, which endows us to faithfully capture the underlying structure of the targeted multivariate function accompanying with automatic rank determination. Concretely, in the hierarchical design of HRE representation, the target multivariate function is decomposed as a small-scale inner tensor with a set of univariate functions along each mode, where a customized tensor network decomposition can be readily deployed to capture the underlying structure of the small-scale inner tensor. In HRE representation, the crucial hyperparameters, ranks, can be adaptively revealed during the decomposition, freeing us from manual rank tuning and making HRE practically applicable to real-world problems. Besides, we build the HRE-PINNs correspondingly. Extensive numerical experiments, including high-dimensional static problems (Helmholtz equation and Poisson equation), nonlinear time-dependent problems (Klein-Gordon equation), and complex fluid-dynamics problems (flow mixing equation and Navier-Stokes equation), demonstrate that HRE-PINNs consistently outperform existing state-of-the-art approaches in terms of accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对张量类物理信息神经网络（T-PINNs）依赖人工设定低秩张量分解秩的问题，提出层级秩进化（hierarchical rank-evolving, HRE）表示，将多元函数分解为小规模内层张量与各模态的单变量函数的组合，并在分解中自适应确定秩。作者据此构建 HRE-PINNs，并在 Helmholtz、Poisson、Klein-Gordon、流动混合以及 Navier-Stokes 等方程上报告称精度一致优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有 T-PINNs 主要依赖预先指定低秩张量分解且秩需人工调节，这限制了模型捕捉多元解函数内在结构的能力，也妨碍实际部署。
Method: 提出 HRE 表示：目标多元函数被分解为一个小规模内层张量（inner tensor）以及沿每个模态的一组单变量函数，可针对内层张量直接部署定制的张量网络分解以捕捉其结构；分解过程中秩可自适应地揭示，从而免除手动调秩。
Result: 摘要报告在高维静态问题（Helmholtz 方程、Poisson 方程）、非线性含时问题（Klein-Gordon 方程）以及复杂流体动力学问题（流动混合方程、Navier-Stokes 方程）上的大量数值实验中，HRE-PINNs 在精度上一致优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调自适应秩确定使 HRE 表示免于手动秩调节，使其可实际应用于现实问题，并基于该表示构建了相应的 HRE-PINNs。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Beyond Uniform Restoration: Empowering All-in-One Restoration with Pixel-Level Multimodal Guidance
papers.abstract_en: All-in-one image restoration is a unified low-level vision task that aims to effectively recover high-quality images from inputs degraded by various types and levels of corruption using a single model. Recent works have achieved remarkable progress by learning degradation-adaptive prompts or network architectures. However, these methods typically apply a uniform restoration strategy across the entire image, neglecting the fact that different regions may suffer from distinct degradation types and varying degrees of severity. In contrast, we propose to perform restoration at the pixel level, thereby enabling more fine-grained and precise control over the restoration process. Specifically, we present MGN-AIR, a novel pixel-level restoration framework for all-in-one image restoration. Our approach first learns to estimate a pixel-level visual prompt. Then, it leverages both textual and visual prompts to provide global and local degradation cues, guiding the model on where to look and how to restore at each pixel. We conduct extensive experiments on multiple all-in-one image restoration benchmarks, covering a wide range of tasks including denoising, deraining, deblurring, dehazing, desnowing, and low-light enhancement. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed method consistently and significantly outperforms existing approaches.
papers.comment: Accepted by ACMMM2026 as Oral Paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MGN-AIR，一种像素级全合一图像恢复 (all-in-one image restoration) 框架。该方法先估计像素级视觉提示，再结合文本与视觉提示提供全局和局部退化线索，指导模型在每个像素位置如何进行恢复。作者在覆盖去噪、去雨、去模糊、去雾、去雪和低光增强的多个基准上做了实验，声称结果一致且显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有全合一图像恢复方法通常对整个图像施加统一恢复策略，忽略了不同区域可能遭受不同类型和不同程度退化的问题。作者因此主张在像素级进行恢复，以对恢复过程实现更细粒度、更精准的控制。
Method: 提出像素级恢复框架 MGN-AIR：首先学习估计一个像素级视觉提示 (pixel-level visual prompt)，然后同时利用文本提示和视觉提示提供全局与局部退化线索，引导模型在何处关注以及每个像素应如何恢复。
Result: 在多个全合一图像恢复基准上涵盖去噪、去雨、去模糊、去雾、去雪和低光增强等任务；摘要报告该方法相较现有方法取得一致且显著的性能提升，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调像素级多模态引导能带来更精细的全合一图像恢复能力，该工作被 ACMMM2026 接收为 Oral Paper。

papers.title: From Prompt to Harness: Coderlet from Scratch
papers.abstract_en: A model alone does not determine how a programming agent acts. What the model sees, how actions enter the environment, how feedback returns, and how one run affects the next all depend on how the harness is organized. Minimal examples usually show only the basic interaction between a model and tools, while production systems spread these relationships across complex components and dependencies. This paper studies a compact harness design by following a single request through context formation, model decision, environmental action, observation return, and state continuation. Three boundaries---model, execution, and state---connect the model service, tool environment, and persistent state, while the request lifecycle determines the order in which these transitions occur. Together, they show the harness's core role: turning model generations into environmental actions, carrying runtime feedback into later decisions, and allowing state to continue across requests. On top of this runtime structure, a harness can also be gradually refined across runs through continued bootstrapping. The design is realized in the executable artifact https://github.com/lilinxi/Coderlet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究编程代理（programming agent）中 harness 的紧凑设计，强调模型本身不能单独决定代理行为。作者沿单个请求的完整生命周期——上下文形成、模型决策、环境动作、观察返回、状态延续——梳理出 model、execution、state 三条边界，并指出 harness 的核心作用是将模型输出转化为环境动作、把运行时反馈带入后续决策、并让状态跨请求持续。该设计以可执行工件 Coderlet 开源实现。摘要未给出实验定量结果。
Motivation: 现有样例通常只展示模型与工具的基本交互，而生产系统将这些关系分散在复杂组件和依赖中，缺少对 harness 组织的系统理解。本文旨在通过一个紧凑 harness 设计来阐明请求生命周期及各边界的作用。
Method: 采用单一请求跟踪法，从上下文形成、模型决策、环境动作、观察返回到状态延续，定义 model、execution、state 三条边界来连接模型服务、工具环境和持久状态；运行时之上还支持跨运行持续 bootstrap 逐步精化 harness。
Result: 摘要没有报告定量实验或基准比较；作者将设计实现为可执行工件并开源在 GitHub（Coderlet）。
Conclusion: 作者强调 harness 的核心角色：把模型生成转成环境动作、将运行时反馈带入后续决策、并允许状态跨请求延续；三类边界与请求生命周期共同决定这些转换顺序。

papers.title: ActBench: Self-Evolving Benchmark of Behavioral Safety in Cowork Agents
papers.abstract_en: Cowork agents may complete benign tasks while disclosing protected data, manipulating unauthorized state, invocate unauthorized API. We define behavioral safety and introduce ActBench, a self-evolving benchmark that evaluates such behavior risk from execution trajectories rather than final responses. Each case pairs a benign task with an adversarial variant that preserves its instruction, configuration, initial state, rating model, and trusted records while injecting a task-reachable payload. ActBench contains 600 cases from 213 scenarios, spanning 15 risk behaviors, six execution spaces, and 48 web-service APIs.To move beyond static payloads, we propose a reward-guided beam search method that jointly optimizes attack effectiveness and task utility, while reflection diagnoses failed execution checkpoint and guides payload revision. Besides, we propose a dual evidence verification mechanism that verifies agent execution safety and utility through log evidence and LLM-based trajectory evidence.We evaluate 15 LLMs and 6 open-source cowork agents over 24,000 trajectories. Under a fixed harness, attack success rates ranges from 10.1% to 94.4% across models, while under a fixed base model, they range from 73.7% to 94.4% across agents.These results show greater variation across models than agent harness, while attacks remain highly successful across all tested harnesses.Our benchmark is released at: https://github.com/zjuicsr/ActBench.
papers.comment: Benchmark and Code is available https://github.com/zjuicsr/ActBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ActBench，一个面向协作智能体（cowork agents）的行为安全自演化基准，重点评估执行轨迹（execution trajectory）而非最终回复中的行为风险。基准包含来自 213 个场景的 600 个用例，覆盖 15 种风险行为、六种执行空间和 48 个 Web 服务 API；每个用例将良性任务与保留指令、配置、初始状态等的对抗变体配对，并注入任务可达的有效载荷。作者对 15 个 LLM 和 6 个开源协作智能体在超过 24,000 条轨迹上进行评估。
Motivation: 现有安全评估多关注最终输出，忽略了智能体在完成任务过程中的行为风险，例如泄露受保护数据、操纵未授权状态或调用未授权 API。
Method: 定义行为安全（behavioral safety），并构建自我演化的基准；提出奖励引导的束搜索（reward-guided beam search）方法联合优化攻击有效性与任务效用，利用反思机制诊断失败执行检查点并修订有效载荷，还提出双证据验证机制，通过日志证据和基于 LLM 的轨迹证据验证执行安全与效用。
Result: 在固定测试框架下，攻击成功率随模型不同而波动于 10.1% 至 94.4%；在固定基础模型下，随智能体框架不同而波动于 73.7% 至 94.4%。结果显示跨模型的差异大于跨智能体框架的差异，但所有测试框架下攻击都保持较高成功率。
Conclusion: 作者强调攻击在所有测试的智能体框架上仍高度有效，并指出模型选择比智能体框架对行为安全影响更大；基准与代码已公开。

papers.title: Agreement-Based Audio-Visual Segmentation:Champion Report for the MeViS-Audio Track in the 8th LSVOS Challenge
papers.abstract_en: The MeViS-Audio track asks a system to segment the objects described by a spoken motion expression throughout a video and to return empty masks when the described target is absent. We present a simple staged solution. Qwen3-ASR first converts speech into text. Several video mask tracks are then produced with complementary grounding and segmentation models. Instead of trusting a single prediction, we select the track that has the highest average mask agreement with the other candidates. A small set of explicit direction, count, and plural rules corrects queries that require more than ordinary single-object tracking. Finally, a video-level classifier combines visual, audio-visual, and within-video query scores to decide whether any target is present. The submitted system obtains 0.5952 J &F, 0.7931 no-target accuracy, 0.9205 target accuracy, and a final score of 0.769589. The challenge organizers notified our team that this result ranked first in the track.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 MeViS-Audio 挑战赛（第 8 届 LSVOS Challenge）的冠军技术报告。任务要求根据口语运动描述在视频中分割对应目标，并在目标不存在时输出空掩码。作者提出分阶段方案：先用 Qwen3-ASR 将语音转为文本，再由多个互补的定位与分割模型生成若干候选掩码序列，不直接信任单一预测，而是选择与其他候选平均掩码一致性最高的序列；随后用方向、数量和复数等显式规则修正普通单目标跟踪之外的查询，最后用视频级分类器结合视觉、音视频和视频内查询得分判断目标是否存在。系统最终得分为 0.769589，在该赛道排名第一。
Motivation: MeViS-Audio 赛道既要求对口语运动表达所指对象进行视频分割，又要求在目标缺失时返回空掩码，单一模型预测在目标存在性和细粒度运动描述上都可能不可靠。
Method: 采用流水线式方案：Qwen3-ASR 将语音转写为文本；多个互补的接地与分割模型生成多路视频掩码序列；通过平均掩码一致性（average mask agreement）选择最可信的一路；对需要超越普通单目标跟踪的查询应用显式方向、数量和复数规则；最后以视频级分类器融合视觉、音视频和视频内查询得分决定目标是否存在。
Result: 摘要报告该系统取得 0.5952 的 J&F、0.7931 的无目标准确率（no-target accuracy）、0.9205 的目标准确率（target accuracy）以及 0.769589 的最终得分，并被挑战组织方通知获得该赛道第一名。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于掩码一致性的多候选选择、显式规则修正和视频级存在性分类相结合，能有效应对口语运动表达分割与目标缺失检测并存的任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FaLCon: Facet-Anchored Retrieval with Late Consensus for Sim2Real Text-Based Person Anomaly Search
papers.abstract_en: Text-based person anomaly search requires retrieving real-world pedestrian images from detailed natural-language descriptions using models trained primarily on synthetic data. This Sim2Real setting is particularly challenging because visually similar candidates may differ only in subtle actions, object interactions, or appearance attributes, while applying multimodal large language models to the entire gallery is computationally expensive. We propose an anchor-constrained coarse-to-fine retrieval framework that combines global semantic matching with fine-grained verification. First, each query is represented by its original caption, a structured concatenation, and several semantic facets. Heterogeneous vision-language retrievers are then integrated through robust per-query score calibration and soft claim-aware fusion. Full and concatenated captions serve as anchors to preserve candidate recall, whereas appearance, action, and object facets provide bounded corrective evidence. The resulting candidate pool is further refined by a discriminative Qwen3 reranker and two complementary semantic verification modules based on anomaly-aware cloze completion and multi-agent evidence reasoning. Finally, an uncertainty-gated consensus module adaptively reweights the three experts on ambiguous queries. Experiments on the PAB benchmark show that the proposed soft claim-aware retrieval achieves 86.44% mAP@10, substantially outperforming individual retrieval backbones. The complete framework further improves performance to 95.41% mAP@10, 94.44% R@1, and 99.09% R@5. These results demonstrate that preserving strong global retrieval while restricting expensive semantic reasoning to a small candidate pool is effective for fine-grained Sim2Real person anomaly search. Our code will be available on Github.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Sim2Real 场景下的文本描述人物异常检索任务，提出锚定约束的粗到细检索框架 FaLCon。该框架先用全量标题和结构化拼接作为锚保留召回，再用外观、动作、物体等语义面提供校正证据，通过软声明感知融合集成异构视觉-语言检索器，并对候选池做 Qwen3 重排和两类语义验证，最后由不确定性门控共识模块自适应加权。在 PAB 基准上，完整框架达到 95.41% mAP@10、94.44% R@1 和 99.09% R@5。
Motivation: 文本描述的人物异常检索面临 Sim2Real 挑战：模型主要在合成数据上训练，而真实图像中视觉相似的候选可能仅在细微动作、物体交互或外观属性上不同；同时对整个图库应用多模态大模型计算代价过高。
Method: 提出锚定约束的粗到细检索框架：每个查询由原始描述、结构化拼接和多个语义面表示，异构视觉-语言检索器经逐查询分数校准和软声明感知融合后生成候选池；再经判别式 Qwen3 重排、异常感知完形填空和多智能体证据推理两个验证模块精炼，最后用不确定性门控共识模块对三个专家自适应加权。
Result: 在 PAB 基准上，软声明感知检索达到 86.44% mAP@10，明显优于单个检索骨干；完整框架进一步提升到 95.41% mAP@10、94.44% R@1 和 99.09% R@5。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，保持强全局检索并将昂贵的语义推理限制在小候选池内，对细粒度 Sim2Real 人物异常检索是有效的，并计划公开代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MixFormer: Linear Transformer with Mixture of Memory Experts
papers.abstract_en: State Space Models (SSMs), as a mainstream research direction of linear Transformers, aim to achieve higher efficiency than standard Transformers in long-context modeling. However, existing SSMs suffer from limited input adaptivity and constrained memory capacity, leading to information loss when modeling ultra-long sequences. To address these limitations, we propose MixFormer, a novel linear Transformer that integrates a Mixture-of-Memory-Experts (MoE) mechanism. Specifically, the model maintains differentiated memory states through multiple collaborating memory experts and employs a novel Time-Aware Linear Attention (TALA) mechanism, which leverages learnable exponential decay functions and positional biases to dynamically update memory. This design enables the model to selectively reinforce important historical information while effectively mitigating memory dilution, substantially improving long-range dependency modeling. Experiments on long-sequence text and image generation tasks demonstrate that MixFormer not only achieves significant performance gains but also provides a more sustainable computational backbone for the next generation of web infrastructure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MixFormer 是一种结合混合记忆专家 (Mixture-of-Memory-Experts, MoE) 机制的线性 Transformer，面向超长序列建模。它通过多个协作的记忆专家维护差异化的记忆状态，并提出 Time-Aware Linear Attention (TALA) 机制，利用可学习的指数衰减函数和位置偏置动态更新记忆，以选择性强化重要历史信息、缓解记忆稀释。摘要称在长序列文本和图像生成任务上取得了显著性能提升，并提供了更可持续的计算骨干。
Motivation: 现有状态空间模型 (SSM) 作为线性 Transformer 的主流方向，虽在长上下文建模上追求高效率，但输入自适应性有限且记忆容量受限，导致建模超长序列时出现信息丢失。
Method: 提出 MixFormer，集成混合记忆专家机制，维持多个协作的差异化记忆状态；同时设计 Time-Aware Linear Attention (TALA)，利用可学习的指数衰减函数和位置偏置动态更新记忆。
Result: 摘要报告在长序列文本和图像生成任务上取得显著性能提升，并称其为下一代 web 基础设施提供更可持续的计算骨干；但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过记忆专家与时间感知注意力结合，MixFormer 能显著改善长程依赖建模并降低记忆稀释，同时具备计算可持续性优势。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RecoverFly: A Failure-Aware Reinforcement Learning Post-Training Framework for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle vision-language navigation (UAV-VLN) requires agents to translate visual observations and language instructions into reliable flight actions in complex environments. Although recent end-to-end UAV vision-language-action (UAV-VLA) policies reduce reliance on separately designed perception, planning, and control modules, their behavior-cloning objectives provide limited corrective supervision for interactive closed-loop execution. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising solution, while its effectiveness is constrained by inefficient use of samples, long-tailed scene distributions, and policy distribution shift during optimization. To this end, we propose RecoverFly, a failure-aware RL post-training framework for end-to-end UAV-VLA policies. Specifically, RecoverFly adapts token-level RL for stable optimization of grammar-constrained autoregressive UAV actions, revisits unresolved failure cases to strengthen corrective learning and sample utilization, and combines a two-stage long-tail scene curriculum with reference-policy regularization to improve scene adaptation while preserving acquired capabilities. Experiments on the TravelUAV benchmark demonstrate that RecoverFly achieves the best performance on the seen, unseen-map, and unseen-object splits. Moreover, compared to the AerialVLA initialization, RecoverFly improves success rate by 3.12 to 8.37 percentage points under a total rollout budget of about 30\% of the training-set size, validating its effectiveness, robustness, and generalization capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RecoverFly，一个面向端到端无人机视觉语言动作策略（UAV-VLA）的故障感知强化学习（RL）后训练框架。RecoverFly 采用 token 级 RL 来稳定优化带语法约束的自回归无人机动作，重访未解决的失败案例以强化纠错学习和样本利用，并结合两阶段长尾场景课程（curriculum）与参考策略正则化来提升场景适应能力。在 TravelUAV 基准上的实验表明，RecoverFly 在 seen、unseen-map 和 unseen-object 三个划分上均取得最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有的端到端 UAV-VLA 策略依赖行为克隆目标，对交互式闭环执行缺乏纠错性监督；RL 虽可弥补，但其效果受制于样本利用效率低、长尾场景分布和优化过程中的策略分布偏移。
Method: RecoverFly 将 token 级 RL 应用于语法约束的自回归无人机动作生成以实现稳定优化；通过重访未解决的失败案例增强纠错学习与样本利用率；并引入两阶段长尾场景课程和参考策略正则化，在提升场景适应性的同时保留已习得能力。
Result: 在 TravelUAV 基准上，RecoverFly 在 seen、unseen-map 和 unseen-object 三个划分上均取得最佳性能；相比 AerialVLA 初始化，在约为训练集规模 30% 的总 rollout 预算下，成功率提升 3.12 到 8.37 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 RecoverFly 验证了故障感知的 RL 后训练方法对端到端 UAV-VLA 策略的有效性、鲁棒性和泛化能力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Flow-based conditional cardiac anatomy generation for virtual cohorts
papers.abstract_en: Cardiac digital twin research is moving from subject-specific anatomical replicas toward virtual cohorts that represent clinically relevant population subgroups. Yet access to representative imaging-derived anatomy datasets remains limited by cohort size, subgroup sparsity, and data-sharing constraints. Conditional generative models could help address this gap, but virtual cohorts are useful only if they preserve realistic, metadata-dependent anatomical variability. Existing cardiac anatomy generators largely rely on conditional variational autoencoders (cVAEs), which couple representation learning and metadata conditioning through a shared regularized latent prior. We introduce CAN-FLOW, a two-step Conditional ANatomy generation framework based on normalizing FLOWs that first learns geometry-only latent representations of diffeomorphic cardiac shape momenta and then models their sex-, age-, and body-mass-index-dependent distribution with a conditional normalizing flow. We trained CAN-FLOW on 2,208 healthy UK Biobank subjects and compared it with cVAEs across regularization strengths. CAN-FLOW generated plausible stochastic biventricular anatomies that better reproduced clinical phenotype distributions, metadata-dependent trends, subgroup variability, point-cloud coverage, and high-dimensional shape variability. Together, these results establish CAN-FLOW as a shareable framework for generating realistic, stochastically varying, metadata-conditioned biventricular anatomies for virtual cohort construction and in silico clinical trial workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAN-FLOW，一种基于归一化流 (normalizing flow) 的两步条件心脏解剖生成框架：先学习 diffeomorphic 形状动量的纯几何潜在表示，再用条件归一化流建模其与性别、年龄、BMI 相关的分布。在 2,208 名 UK Biobank 健康受试者上训练，并与不同正则化强度的条件变分自编码器 (cVAE) 对比，CAN-FLOW 生成的随机双心室解剖能更好地复现临床表型分布、元数据相关趋势、亚组变异性、点云覆盖和高维形状变异性。
Motivation: 心脏数字孪生研究正从个体化解剖复制转向代表临床人群亚组的虚拟队列，但影像来源的解剖数据集受队列规模、亚组稀疏性和数据共享约束限制。现有心脏解剖生成器多依赖 cVAE，其通过共享正则化潜先验耦合表示学习和元数据条件化，难以保真生成依赖元数据的解剖变异。
Method: 提出 CAN-FLOW，一个两步式条件解剖生成框架：第一步仅从 diffeomorphic 心脏形状动量学习纯几何的潜在表示，第二步以条件归一化流建模该表示关于性别、年龄和身体质量指数 (BMI) 的条件分布。
Result: 在 2,208 名 UK Biobank 健康受试者上训练后，与不同正则化强度的 cVAE 比较，CAN-FLOW 生成的随机双心室解剖在临床表型分布、元数据相关趋势、亚组变异性、点云覆盖以及高维形状变异性方面表现更好。
Conclusion: 摘要将 CAN-FLOW 定位为可共享的框架，用于生成真实、随机变化且携带元数据条件的双心室解剖，支持虚拟队列构建和 in silico 临床试验工作流。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Modulate, Not to Cycle: Soft Actor---Critic Recovers Inverter-Style Heat-Pump Control
papers.abstract_en: On--off cycling is the main cause of compressor wear in residential heat pumps, yet reinforcement learning (RL) controllers for buildings typically optimise only energy cost and thermal comfort, ignoring how much the learned policy cycles. We add a levelised compressor-wear term to the control reward and study how the resulting behaviour depends on the RL algorithm. Training Soft Actor---Critic (SAC) and Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) on an identical Markov decision process for the BOPTEST bestest hydronic heat pump case, we find that SAC learns a continuous modulation policy that keeps the compressor permanently engaged---the operating principle of an inverter-driven heat pump---achieving zero start-ups per day, whereas PPO collapses to bang-bang control that cycles more than the baseline. On the BOPTEST emulator the SAC policy cuts thermal discomfort by up to 90.7% for an 11.5% cost increase, while eliminating all baseline cycling.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, Accepted at UKCI 2026, Will be published in Springer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究住宅热泵控制中的压缩机磨损问题，在 BOPTEST bestest hydronic 热泵基准上以相同马尔可夫决策过程分别训练 SAC 与 PPO，并在奖励中加入水平化的压缩机磨损项（levelised compressor-wear term）。摘要称 SAC 学会连续调制策略，使压缩机持续处于工作状态，实现每天零次启停；而 PPO 退化为 bang-bang 控制，循环次数比基线更多。在 BOPTEST 模拟器上，SAC 以 11.5% 的成本增加换取热不舒适度最高 90.7% 的下降，并完全消除基线的所有循环。
Motivation: 住宅热泵压缩机磨损的主要来源是启停循环，但建筑领域的强化学习（RL）控制器通常只优化能源成本与热舒适，忽略了学习到的策略会造成多少循环，导致磨损问题未被考虑。
Method: 在控制奖励中加入水平化的压缩机磨损项，并在 BOPTEST bestest hydronic 热泵案例的同一 MDP 上分别训练 Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) 和 Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO)，比较两种算法对策略行为的影响。
Result: SAC 学习到压缩机持续啮合的连续调制策略，实现每天零启动；PPO 则崩溃为循环超过基线的 bang-bang 控制。在 BOPTEST 模拟器上，SAC 以 11.5% 的成本增长将热不舒适度最高削减 90.7%，同时消除全部基线循环。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在奖励中加入压缩机磨损项后，RL 算法的选择会显著决定学到的控制行为；SAC 的连续调制策略接近变频热泵（inverter-driven heat pump）的工作方式，能同时降低磨损与热不适，而 PPO 在该设定下表现退化。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 在控制奖励中加入水平化的压缩机磨损项，并在 BOPTEST bestest hydronic 热泵案例的同一 MDP 上分别训练 Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) 和 Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO)，比较两种算法对策略行为的影响。
summary_sections.result: SAC 学习到压缩机持续啮合的连续调制策略，实现每天零启动；PPO 则崩溃为循环超过基线的 bang-bang 控制。在 BOPTEST 模拟器上，SAC 以 11.5% 的成本增长将热不舒适度最高削减 90.7%，同时消除全部基线循环。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调在奖励中加入压缩机磨损项后，RL 算法的选择会显著决定学到的控制行为；SAC 的连续调制策略接近变频热泵（inverter-driven heat pump）的工作方式，能同时降低磨损与热不适，而 PPO 在该设定下表现退化。

papers.title: A Content-Aware Pure Permutation with Intrinsic Avalanche Effect: Breaking the Diffusion-Permutation Dichotomy
papers.abstract_en: Pixel permutation is a fundamental tool in image processing, image encryption, and data hiding (including watermarking and steganography) that rearranges pixels without changing their values. A common assumption in the literature is that permutation alone cannot create differential sensitivity; changing one pixel merely relocates that pixel in the output, producing no avalanche effect. This paper challenges this by introducing the Triangular Content-Aware Permutation (TCA) algorithm. The method extracts edge points using Canny and applies Delaunay Triangulation to edges and corners, creating a unique partition. Since triangulation is highly sensitive to image geometry, changing a single pixel alters the edge map, resulting in a completely different triangulation and global permutation pattern. Unlike classical dimension-based permutations and advanced content-aware methods (2025-2026), which lack differential sensitivity, TCA increases NPCR from near-zero to 97.10% solely through pixel relocation. Experiments on 50 images show that TCA, with an average of 14.81 iterations, achieves NPCR = 97.10% and UACI = 20.06%, proving pure permutation can create significant differential sensitivity. Conventional methods maintain near-zero NPCR. The iteration threshold varies from 6.4 to 30.7 based on content complexity. Low PSNR (11.93 dB) and near-zero correlation (~10^-3) confirm superior statistical performance. Although slower than classical methods due to triangulation, this is a deliberate trade-off for stronger security. Given the non-analytic, content-dependent nature of the pattern, TCA is ideal for reference-based encryption, fragile watermarking, and non-blind steganography.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出三角形内容感知置换（Triangular Content-Aware Permutation, TCA）算法，挑战了文献中“纯置换无法产生差分敏感性”的常见假设。该方法利用 Canny 算子提取边缘点，并对其与角点进行 Delaunay 三角剖分，使单个像素的改变通过三角剖分的不稳定性引发完全不同的全局置换模式。实验表明纯置换即可将 NPCR 从接近零提升到 97.10%，同时获得 UACI=20.06%、低 PSNR（11.93 dB）和接近零的相关性（约 10^-3）。
Motivation: 现有图像加密与数据隐藏文献普遍认为排列（permutation）本身不能产生差分敏感性，改变一个像素只是将其重新定位，无法形成雪崩效应；经典维度置换和 2025–2026 年的先进内容感知方法也缺乏这种敏感性，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 提出 TCA 算法：先用 Canny 提取边缘点，再对边缘点与角点执行 Delaunay 三角剖分，形成依赖图像几何的唯一划分；由于三角剖分对图像几何高度敏感，改变单个像素会改变边缘图，进而产生完全不同的三角剖分和全局置换模式。
Result: 在 50 张图像上的实验中，TCA 平均 14.81 次迭代达到 NPCR=97.10%、UACI=20.06%，而传统方法保持接近零的 NPCR；迭代阈值随内容复杂度在 6.4 到 30.7 之间变化，低 PSNR 与近零相关性表明统计性能优越。
Conclusion: 作者认为尽管三角剖分使 TCA 比经典方法更慢，但这是换取更强安全性的有意取舍；由于置换模式是非解析且内容相关的，该方法适合参考式加密、脆弱水印和非盲隐写。

papers.title: From Approachability Residuals to Anytime-Valid Evidence: The Online Convex Geometry of Testing by Betting
papers.abstract_en: Betting-based sequential tests and Blackwell approachability are linked by a rate-explicit reduction through support-function residuals. For a compact convex target $S$ and vector observations $r_t$, an OCO learner selects a predictable normal $w_t$ and produces $q_t=\langle w_t,r_t\rangle-h_S(w_t)$. We prove the exact pathwise identity $$ \dist(\bar r_T,S) =\frac1T\sum_{t=1}^Tq_t+\frac{\Reg_T}{T}. $$ When $|q_t|\leq B$, composing this identity with one-sided betting yields a finite-time transfer: if the OCO and log-wealth regrets are at most $a_T$ and $\ell_T$, respectively, then a target gap exceeding \[ \frac{a_T}{T} +2B\sqrt{\frac{\log(1/α)+\ell_T}{T}} \] forces rejection by time $T$, while non-rejection certifies the converse radius. We then formulate a controlled stochastic experiment in which an action selected after $w_t$ satisfies Blackwell's supporting-halfspace condition for every null mean payoff. The resulting wealth is an e-process under adaptive nulls; sublinear OCO regret gives stochastic approachability, whereas persistent mean separation under an alternative gives exponential wealth at rate at least $δ^2/(4B^2)$. Deterministic Blackwell games and passive tests are, respectively, the noise-free and singleton-action cases of this protocol. Bounded two-sample means, kernel MMD, and active heterogeneous data sources instantiate the reduction. The resulting connection is exact algebraically, quantitative at finite time, and operational when experiments are controlled.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文建立了 Blackwell 可逼近性 (Blackwell approachability) 与基于投注的序贯检验 (testing by betting) 之间具有显式速率的联系。作者证明了一个精确的逐路径恒等式，将观测均值到紧凸目标集 $S$ 的距离分解为支持函数残差与 OCO 遗憾 (regret) 之和，再与单边投注复合，得到有限时间内的检验转移界。该文还提出一个受控随机实验协议，其中在 $w_t$ 之后选择的动作满足 Blackwell 支持半空间条件，由此得到的财富过程 (wealth) 在自适应零假设下是一个 e-process；确定性 Blackwell 博弈和被动检验分别是该协议的无噪声与单动作特例。
Motivation: 投注式序贯检验与 Blackwell approachability 之间缺乏显式、有限时间且定量的统一框架，作者希望用支持函数残差给出一个速率显式的归约，从而在一步内同时处理随机可逼近性与任意时刻有效证据 (anytime-valid evidence)。
Method: 对于紧凸目标集 $S$ 和向量观测 $r_t$，OCO 学习器选择可预测法向量 $w_t$ 并产生 $q_t=\langle w_t,r_t\rangle-h_S(w_t)$；论文证明精确恒等式 $\dist(\bar r_T,S)=\frac1T\sum_{t=1}^T q_t+\frac{\Reg_T}{T}$。当 $|q_t|\leq B$ 时，将此恒等式与单边投注复合，得到有限时间转移保证；随后构造一个在 $w_t$ 之后选择动作的受控随机实验协议。
Result: 摘要给出有限时间界：若目标间隔超过 $\frac{a_T}{T}+2B\sqrt{\frac{\log(1/\alpha)+\ell_T}{T}}$，则在时间 $T$ 前拒绝；不拒绝则验证相反半径。子线性 OCO 遗憾给出随机可逼近性，而备择假设下的持久均值分离给出速率至少 $\delta^2/(4B^2)$ 的指数财富。有界两样本均值、核 MMD 和主动异质数据源被作为该归约的实例。
Conclusion: 作者强调该联系在代数上精确、在有限时间上定量，并在实验可受控时具有操作性；确定性 Blackwell 博弈与被动检验包含在该协议中。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Sekai2: From World Exploration to Interactive World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Video world models must capture how scenes evolve over time and across viewpoints. Training them for long-horizon generation and camera control therefore benefits from long videos paired with camera trajectories and temporally grounded semantics. Existing corpora rarely offer the three together: large-scale web video provides broad visual diversity but no trajectories or time-aligned text, while pose-annotated datasets are typically short-range or reconstruction-oriented. We introduce Sekai2, a multi-source real-world video dataset that carries the world-exploration footage of Sekai toward interactive world modeling. The release contains 128,892 clips totaling 2,826 hours from 10,428 source videos across 113 countries or regions, and is deliberately weighted toward sustained observation: under a common 120-second decomposition, 43,594 segments reach the full two minutes and account for 51.4% of all footage. Every clip includes a released camera trajectory and hierarchical annotations disentangling subject motion, environment dynamics, static scene content, and camera behavior, resulting in 649,597 temporally grounded segments. Crucially, we further introduce 982 panoramic sequences captured along non-linear trajectories with loops and revisits. These revisits provide repeated observations of the same locations across time and viewpoints, offering essential supervision for learning persistent scene representations, long-term spatial memory, and geometrically consistent world models. Corpus-scale analyses demonstrate complete pose-and-caption coverage, broad geographic and semantic diversity, varied camera trajectories, and highly non-redundant temporal descriptions. Together, these properties make Sekai2 a scalable resource for long-horizon video generation, camera-controllable synthesis, and interactive world-model pre-training.
papers.comment: Sekai2 dataset technical report. Developed at Alaya Lab
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Sekai2，一个多源真实世界视频数据集，目标是把世界探索类视频素材推向交互式世界建模。数据集包含来自 113 个国家和地区的 10,428 个源视频、共 128,892 个片段与 2,826 小时素材，每个片段都提供相机轨迹和四类层次化解耦标注（主体运动、环境动态、静态场景、相机行为），共计 649,597 个时间对齐片段；此外还引入 982 个沿非线性轨迹、含回访（loops and revisits）的全景序列，以支持学习持久场景表示和几何一致的世界模型。
Motivation: 现有语料很少能同时提供长视频、相机轨迹和时间对齐语义：大规模网络视频有视觉多样性但缺乏轨迹和对齐文本，姿态标注数据集通常短程或面向重建。这限制了长时程生成与相机控制类世界模型的训练。
Method: 构建多源真实世界探索视频数据集 Sekai2，采用统一的 120 秒分解，并为每个片段发布相机轨迹和四类解耦的层次化标注；另外采集沿非线性轨迹、包含回访的全景序列，为同一地点的跨时间、跨视角观测提供重复监督信号。
Result: 摘要报告语料规模为 128,892 个片段、共 2,826 小时，其中 43,594 个片段达到完整两分钟，占全部素材的 51.4%；共得到 649,597 个时间对齐片段。语料级分析显示具备完整的姿态-字幕覆盖、广泛的地理与语义多样性、多样化的相机轨迹以及高度非冗余的时间描述。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些特性使 Sekai2 成为长时程视频生成、相机可控合成和交互式世界模型预训练的可扩展资源；本文是 Sekai2 数据集技术报告（Sekai2 dataset technical report）。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: VANE: Reliable Test-Time Training for Vision-Language-Action Models via Future Visual Representation Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Test-time training (TTT) offers a lightweight way to adapt vision--language--action (VLA) policies from unlabeled deployment streams, but it remains difficult to use reliably in closed-loop manipulation. A shared adaptation space can mix incompatible task corrections, while an online update can alter subsequent actions before its consequences are known. We introduce a reliable TTT framework for VLA policies (VANE). VANE conditions prompt adaptation on the current vision--language context and learns from the future visual consequences of executed actions. Candidate updates are isolated from the live policy, evaluated on subsequent observations, and committed only when supported by future evidence, making adaptation selective and reversible. On SimplerEnv WidowX, VANE improves average success by $3.2$ percentage points over the corresponding TTT baseline. Results on Google Robot further show that deployment-time gains remain task- and embodiment-dependent. Together, these results demonstrate a constrained, evidence-based approach to adapting VLA policies during interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VANE，一个面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的可靠测试时训练（TTT）框架。VANE 根据当前视觉-语言上下文调节提示适配，并从已执行动作的未来视觉结果中学习；候选更新与实时策略隔离，仅在后续观测提供证据支持时才提交，从而让适配具有选择性和可逆性。在 SimplerEnv WidowX 上，VANE 相比对应的 TTT 基线将平均成功率提高 3.2 个百分点，而在 Google Robot 上的结果则显示部署期收益仍依赖任务与具体 embodiment。
Motivation: 现有的 TTT 在闭环操作中难以可靠使用：共享的适配空间可能混合不兼容的任务修正，在线更新可能在其后果未知之前就改变后续动作。
Method: VANE 将提示适配条件化为当前的视觉-语言上下文，并从执行动作的未来视觉后果中学习；它将候选更新与实时策略隔离，在后续观测上评估，并仅在未来证据支持时提交，使适配具有选择性和可逆性。
Result: 在 SimplerEnv WidowX 上，VANE 较相应 TTT 基线平均成功率提升 3.2 个百分点；Google Robot 上的结果进一步表明部署期收益具有任务和 embodiment 依赖性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这是一种受限的、基于证据的 VLA 策略交互期适配方式，并指出部署期改进在不同任务和 embodiment 上并不一致。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 VANE，一个面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的可靠测试时训练（TTT）框架。VANE 根据当前视觉-语言上下文调节提示适配，并从已执行动作的未来视觉结果中学习；候选更新与实时策略隔离，仅在后续观测提供证据支持时才提交，从而让适配具有选择性和可逆性。在 SimplerEnv WidowX 上，VANE 相比对应的 TTT 基线将平均成功率提高 3.2 个百分点，而在 Google Robot 上的结果则显示部署期收益仍依赖任务与具体 embodiment。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有的 TTT 在闭环操作中难以可靠使用：共享的适配空间可能混合不兼容的任务修正，在线更新可能在其后果未知之前就改变后续动作。
summary_sections.method: VANE 将提示适配条件化为当前的视觉-语言上下文，并从执行动作的未来视觉后果中学习；它将候选更新与实时策略隔离，在后续观测上评估，并仅在未来证据支持时提交，使适配具有选择性和可逆性。

papers.title: WDL-OPD: Weak-Driven On-Policy Distillation via Mixture-Constrained Co-Training
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) aligns a student with a teacher on trajectories sampled from the student itself, reducing the train-test state mismatch of offline distillation. The same feedback loop can nevertheless be unstable: each update changes both the policy and the states on which the next update is computed. We introduce WDL-OPD, a mixture-constrained co-training method with two trainable policies. An anchor policy generates every rollout, an auxiliary policy evaluates the same visited states, and a geometric mixture of their token distributions is matched to a frozen teacher by reverse KL. Both policies receive gradient. We show that freezing the auxiliary recovers an anchor-plus-contrast proxy target closely related to OPD$^2$ and W2S-OPD, whereas joint training creates branch-level degrees of freedom that a static delta cannot express. In recorded Qwen3 experiments at 1.7B and 4B scale, WDL-OPD produces the strongest student checkpoint in each of four scale-domain settings. It raises MATH500 accuracy from 0.630 to 0.685 at 4B and from 0.521 to 0.585 at 1.7B. In code generation, seven single-policy OPD configurations exhibit entropy growth or trajectory degradation, while co-training reaches independently re-evaluated development scores of 0.637 and 0.375. Because several comparisons differ in curriculum or initialization, these results support a stabilization hypothesis rather than a universal causal claim. We provide the exact training algorithm, failure evidence, and the controlled comparison matrix needed to test that hypothesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 on-policy distillation (OPD) 中反馈环不稳定、每次更新同时改变策略与采样状态的问题，提出 WDL-OPD：一种混合约束协同训练方法，使用锚策略生成轨迹、辅助策略评估访问过的状态，并将两者 token 分布的几何混合通过 reverse KL 对齐到冻结教师模型，两个策略都接收梯度。在 Qwen3 1.7B 和 4B 规模的实验中，WDL-OPD 在四个规模-领域设置中均取得最强学生 checkpoint，例如 MATH500 准确率在 4B 上从 0.630 提升到 0.685，在 1.7B 上从 0.521 提升到 0.585。作者强调结果支持稳定性假设而非普遍因果声明，并提供了完整训练算法、失败证据和受控对比矩阵。
Motivation: OPD 通过学生自身采样轨迹来对齐教师，以缓解离线蒸馏的状态分布不匹配，但其反馈回路不稳定：每次更新既改变策略，也改变下一次更新所依赖的状态。
Method: 提出 WDL-OPD，一种带混合约束的协同训练方法：锚策略 (anchor policy) 生成每次 rollout，辅助策略 (auxiliary policy) 评估同一组已访问状态，二者 token 分布的几何混合 (geometric mixture) 通过 reverse KL 匹配冻结教师；两个策略均获得梯度。冻结辅助策略可恢复与 OPD$^2$ 和 W2S-OPD 密切相关的锚加对比代理目标，而联合训练则引入静态 delta 无法表达的 branch-level 自由度。
Result: 在 Qwen3 1.7B 和 4B 规模的记录实验中，WDL-OPD 在四个规模-领域设置中都得到最强学生 checkpoint；MATH500 准确率 4B 从 0.630 升至 0.685，1.7B 从 0.521 升至 0.585。代码生成中，七个单一策略 OPD 配置出现熵增长或轨迹退化，而协同训练达到独立重评的开发分数 0.637 和 0.375。
Conclusion: 由于若干对比在课程或初始化上存在差异，摘要明确这些结果支持稳定性假设而非普遍因果声明；作者提供了确切训练算法、失败证据和受控对比矩阵，以便检验该假设。

papers.title: DiffSafeMerge: Mitigating Backdoor Inheritance in Diffusion Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: Unconditional diffusion checkpoint merging assumes benign sources, yet a compromised public checkpoint can transfer a dormant backdoor while clean generation appears normal. Mitigation is difficult without knowing the compromised source, trigger, or target, and broad sanitization may degrade image quality. We introduce DiffSafeMerge (DSM), which uses a small unlabeled clean set and fixed, attack-agnostic stress probes to score source blocks, shrink suspicious contributions toward a trusted reference, and select attenuation under a clean denoising-loss budget. We evaluate four attacks, two datasets, and 21 target conditions. Intended merging already has zero worst-target ASR in 10 of 14 source cases; DSM preserves these outcomes and records no target match in the remaining four over three seeds, including three with baseline ASR of 48--100\%. Among methods with zero worst-target ASR on both datasets, DSM obtains the lowest case-averaged FID in the matched seed-0 comparison.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiffSafeMerge (DSM)，一种针对无条件扩散模型 checkpoint 合并中后门继承风险的防御方法。DSM 只需少量无标注干净数据和固定的、攻击无关的应力探针 (stress probes) 来对来源模块评分，将可疑贡献向可信参考收缩，并在干净去噪损失预算内选择衰减强度。摘要报告在四种攻击、两个数据集和 21 种目标条件下验证了该方法。
Motivation: 无条件扩散模型 checkpoint 合并默认来源可信，但被攻破的公共 checkpoint 可能在生成看似正常的同时传递潜伏后门。在不知道受损来源、触发器或目标的情况下难以缓解，而广泛的净化可能损害图像质量。
Method: DSM 使用一个小的无标注干净集和固定、攻击无关的应力探针来给来源模块打分，将可疑贡献向可信参考收缩，并在干净去噪损失预算下选择衰减。该方法不需要知道具体攻击来源、触发或目标。
Result: 在 14 个源案例中，原本的合并已在 10 个案例中达到零最坏目标 ASR；DSM 保持这些结果，并在其余 4 个案例的三种子中无目标匹配，其中 3 个案例的基线 ASR 为 48–100%。在两个数据集上所有达到零最坏目标 ASR 的方法中，DSM 在 seed-0 匹配比较中获得最低的案例平均 FID。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，无需预先知道受损源、触发器或目标，DSM 即可在合并时缓解后门继承并保持图像质量；作者强调其攻击无关性和基于干净去噪损失预算的实用约束。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Depth-adaptive Inference of Looped Language Models via Continuous Depth Batching
papers.abstract_en: A main promise of looped language models (LMs) is depth-adaptive inference. By iterating a block of shared layers a variable number of times, the model can use less compute for "easy" tokens and more for "hard" ones. However, this adaptivity breaks standard batching: tokens in the same batch now require a different number of loops, so there is no unified forward pass, making efficient inference difficult. Standard inference frameworks like vLLM schedule on the token level and cannot handle this because tokens need to be removed from the batch within the forward pass. Loop-level scheduling has been proposed as a solution, but never implemented end to end. The key challenge is that looped architectures also contain non-looped boundary stages (e.g., token embedding and LM head) that must be scheduled at different frequencies than the loop. We introduce continuous depth batching (CDB), which schedules at the granularity of individual loop iterations. CDB handles boundary stages and loop steps in separate priority queues, makes exit decisions one step ahead, and overlaps all scheduling work with GPU computation. On Ouro 1.4B and Huginn 3.5B, CDB can realize up to $99\%$ of the theoretical maximum speed-up from adaptive-depth, translating to $1.5$-$1.9\times$ higher offline throughput and $45$-$90\%$ lower normalized latency under dynamic serving load.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出连续深度批处理 (Continuous Depth Batching, CDB) 方法，用于循环语言模型 (looped language models) 的深度自适应推理。该方法以单个循环迭代为粒度调度，将边界阶段 (如 token 嵌入和 LM head) 与循环步骤放入独立的优先级队列，并提前一步做出出口决策。在 Ouro 1.4B 和 Huginn 3.5B 上，CDB 能实现自适应深度理论上限约 99% 的加速，离线吞吐量提升 1.5-1.9 倍，动态服务负载下归一化延迟降低 45%-90%。
Motivation: 循环语言模型承诺对简单 token 使用更少循环、对困难 token 使用更多循环，从而实现深度自适应推理，但这打破了标准批处理机制：同一批次中不同 token 需要不同循环次数，不存在统一的 forward pass，token 级调度框架如 vLLM 无法在 forward pass 内移除 token，循环级调度虽被提出但从未端到端实现。
Method: 引入连续深度批处理 (CDB)，以单个循环迭代为调度粒度。CDB 将非循环的边界阶段 (token embedding 和 LM head) 与循环步骤分别放入独立优先级队列，提前一步做出 exit 决策，并让所有调度开销与 GPU 计算重叠。
Result: 在 Ouro 1.4B 和 Huginn 3.5B 上，CDB 可实现自适应深度带来的理论最大加速的约 99%，对应离线吞吐量提升 1.5-1.9 倍，动态服务负载下归一化延迟降低 45%-90%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 CDB 首次端到端实现了循环级调度，并通过分离边界阶段与循环步骤的优先级队列解决了循环架构中的调度频率差异问题，证明深度自适应推理可以高效批处理。摘要未提及明显局限性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Coupled Graph--Policy Distillation for Personalized Medication Safety in Older Adults with Multimorbidity
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can support medication review between clinical visits, but safe choices for older adults with multimorbidity depend on conditions, medications, and geriatric risks that users may omit. We introduce ATLAS, a coupled graph--policy distillation framework for patient-adaptive medication safety. ATLAS structures guideline evidence as a medication-safety graph. Targeted questions update the patient state and distill relevant relations into a patient-specific medication conflict graph (PMCG). A risk-first multi-agent policy uses the PMCG to screen contraindications, assess cautions and monitoring needs, identify safer alternatives, and verify the final medication plan. We also introduce GeriMedBench, an interactive benchmark that tests safety-critical information acquisition and evidence-based decision revision. Across a European non-interactive multimorbidity benchmark, an Asian interactive multimorbidity benchmark, and an Asian non-interactive cross-guideline benchmark, ATLAS achieves the strongest complete-decision performance among the compared systems. On the European non-interactive multimorbidity benchmark, it exceeds the strongest proprietary LLM baseline by 53.73 points in Strict Success Rate and 14.63 points in overall safety reasoning score (OSRS), with no unsafe recommendations under the automated evaluator. A blinded clinician evaluation gives ATLAS higher mean ratings across all five criteria and flags potentially unsafe recommendations in one ATLAS case and two Gemini cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ATLAS，一个面向老年多病患者的个性化用药安全框架，采用耦合图-策略蒸馏（coupled graph--policy distillation）结构。ATLAS 将指南证据组织为用药安全图，通过针对性提问更新患者状态，并蒸馏出患者特异性药物冲突图（PMCG），再由风险优先的多智能体策略完成禁忌筛查、警示评估、替代方案与用药计划验证。作者还引入交互式基准 GeriMedBench，并在欧洲与亚洲多个基准上报告了 ATLAS 的完整决策性能优势。
Motivation: LLM agent 可用于临床就诊间的用药审查，但老年多病患者的用药安全决策依赖用户可能遗漏的病情、用药和老年风险信息，直接使用 LLM 可能产生不安全的用药选择。
Method: ATLAS 将指南证据构建为用药安全图；通过针对性问题逐步更新患者状态，并将相关关系蒸馏为患者特异性药物冲突图（PMCG）；随后由风险优先的多智能体策略基于 PMCG 筛查禁忌、评估警示与监测需求、识别更安全替代方案并验证最终用药计划。同时提出交互式基准 GeriMedBench，用于测试安全关键信息获取与基于证据的决策修订能力。
Result: 在欧洲非交互多病基准上，ATLAS 相比最强专有 LLM 基线在 Strict Success Rate 上高 53.73 分，在整体安全推理得分（OSRS）上高 14.63 分，且自动化评估器未发现不安全建议；盲法临床医生评估中 ATLAS 在全部五个标准上的平均评分更高，且仅在 1 例 ATLAS 案例和 2 例 Gemini 案例中标记出潜在不安全建议。
Conclusion: 作者总结称 ATLAS 在欧洲非交互、亚洲交互和亚洲非交互跨指南等多个基准上取得了最强的完整决策性能，说明结合结构化安全知识与交互式信息获取有助于提升老年多病患者的用药安全。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: ATLAS 将指南证据构建为用药安全图；通过针对性问题逐步更新患者状态，并将相关关系蒸馏为患者特异性药物冲突图（PMCG）；随后由风险优先的多智能体策略基于 PMCG 筛查禁忌、评估警示与监测需求、识别更安全替代方案并验证最终用药计划。同时提出交互式基准 GeriMedBench，用于测试安全关键信息获取与基于证据的决策修订能力。
summary_sections.result: 在欧洲非交互多病基准上，ATLAS 相比最强专有 LLM 基线在 Strict Success Rate 上高 53.73 分，在整体安全推理得分（OSRS）上高 14.63 分，且自动化评估器未发现不安全建议；盲法临床医生评估中 ATLAS 在全部五个标准上的平均评分更高，且仅在 1 例 ATLAS 案例和 2 例 Gemini 案例中标记出潜在不安全建议。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者总结称 ATLAS 在欧洲非交互、亚洲交互和亚洲非交互跨指南等多个基准上取得了最强的完整决策性能，说明结合结构化安全知识与交互式信息获取有助于提升老年多病患者的用药安全。

papers.title: Unveiling the Secret of AdaLN-Zero in Diffusion Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion transformer (DiT), a rapidly emerging architecture for image generation, has gained much attention. However, despite ongoing efforts to improve its performance, the understanding of DiT remains superficial. In this work, we delve into and investigate a critical conditioning mechanism within DiT, adaLN-Zero, which achieves superior performance compared to adaLN. Our work studies three potential elements driving this performance, including an SE-like structure, zero-initialization, and a "gradual" update order, among which zero-initialization is proved to be the most influential. Building on this understanding, we propose an analysis-guided initialization strategy, termed adaLN-Gaussian, which serves both as an empirical validation of our analysis and as a practical initialization method that consistently improves optimization efficiency. On the other hand, inspired by the SE-like structure, we introduce an improved conditioning mechanism called SE-adaLN-Zero. Extensive experiments following DiT on four datasets, especially on ImageNet1K demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of adaLN-Gaussian and SE-adaLN-Zero. Beyond class-to-image generation, we also evaluate the generalization of the two improved methods on text-to-image generation.
papers.comment: Accept by IEEE TPAMI 2026, camera-ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文剖析扩散 Transformer (DiT) 中 adaLN-Zero 条件机制的性能来源，系统比较 SE-like 结构、零初始化和“渐进”更新顺序三类候选因素，并证明零初始化影响最大。基于该分析提出初始化策略 adaLN-Gaussian 和改进条件机制 SE-adaLN-Zero，在四个数据集上验证了有效性与泛化性，并扩展到文本到图像生成。
Motivation: DiT 作为新兴图像生成架构性能突出，但对其工作机制的理解仍停留在表面，尤其是 adaLN-Zero 为何优于 adaLN 缺乏深入分析。
Method: 研究 adaLN-Zero 中三类潜在因素（SE-like 结构、零初始化、渐进更新顺序），发现零初始化最关键，据此提出分析引导的初始化策略 adaLN-Gaussian，并受 SE-like 结构启发设计 SE-adaLN-Zero 条件机制。
Result: 摘要报告在遵循 DiT 设置的四个数据集上，尤其在 ImageNet1K 上，adaLN-Gaussian 与 SE-adaLN-Zero 均表现出有效性和泛化性；除类别到图像生成外，也在文本到图像生成上评估了两个改进方法的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 零初始化被证明是 adaLN-Zero 性能优势中最具影响力的因素；adaLN-Gaussian 既验证了分析结论又作为实用初始化提升优化效率，SE-adaLN-Zero 则提供改进的条件机制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Listen, See and Track: Spatio-Temporal Audio-Visual Sound Event Reasoning for Omni-Modal Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Understanding dynamic sound sources requires jointly determining what produces a sound, where the source is located, and how it moves over time. Yet existing audio-language models often represent clips as global acoustic events, while vision-language models lack the spatial audio cues needed to localize and track individual sources. To evaluate this missing capability, we introduce ST-OmniQA, a spatio-temporal audio-visual question-answering benchmark built from panoramic videos paired with synchronized first-order Ambisonics (FOA) audio of moving sound sources. It contains 40K videos and 400K question-answer pairs organized into four capability levels covering sound-event recognition, direction of arrival, source distance, motion trajectories, and temporally grounded audio-visual reasoning. Building on this benchmark, we propose ST-Omni-R1, which integrates FOA-derived semantic and trajectory representations with panoramic visual context and is trained through progressive curriculum learning and reasoning-tree reinforcement learning. ST-Omni-R1 achieves 77.83\% average semantic accuracy across the four levels, compared with 37.28\% for the best evaluated baseline. Results on three public spatial-audio benchmarks further indicate that its learned spatial and motion representations transfer beyond ST-OmniQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ST-OmniQA 基准与 ST-Omni-R1 模型，面向全景视频与一阶 Ambisonics (FOA) 音频的时空音频-视觉声音事件推理。基准包含 40K 视频和 400K 问答对，按四个能力层级组织，覆盖声音事件识别、到达方向、声源距离、运动轨迹及时间接地的音频-视觉推理。ST-Omni-R1 融合 FOA 导出的语义与轨迹表示和全景视觉上下文，经渐进课程学习与推理树强化学习训练，平均语义准确率达到 77.83%，优于最佳 baseline 的 37.28%。
Motivation: 现有音频-语言模型常将片段表示为全局声学事件，而视觉-语言模型缺少定位和追踪单个声源所需的空间音频线索，因此难以联合判断什么在发声、声源位于何处以及如何随时间运动。
Method: 作者先构建 ST-OmniQA 基准，基于带同步 FOA 音频的全景视频生成 40K 视频与 400K 问答对；随后提出 ST-Omni-R1，整合 FOA 衍生的语义和轨迹表示与全景视觉上下文，并通过渐进课程学习和推理树强化学习进行训练。
Result: ST-Omni-R1 在四个能力层级上的平均语义准确率为 77.83%，对比最优 baseline 的 37.28%；在三个公开空间音频基准上的结果进一步表明其学习的空间和运动表示可迁移到 ST-OmniQA 之外。
Conclusion: 摘要强调动态声源的时空音频-视觉推理能力显著优于现有基线，且所学表示具备跨基准的可迁移性；摘要未提及具体局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: How Simple Can It Get? From Interpretable Equations to Readable Rules for Financial Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: In regulated domains such as finance, a model that cannot be explained cannot be deployed, yet many interpretable classifiers defeat their own purpose by producing formulas with dozens of features that no regulator could read. We take the reverse direction. Starting from an interpretable classifier expressed as a single equation over the input features, we progressively simplify it into more readable forms, including a pruned monomial, a directional if--then rule, and the integer scorecards and tallies that finance already deploys. Because the equation is itself the predictive model rather than a post-hoc explanation we can directly quantify what is lost under each simplification. Across four financial datasets, we find that pruning is nearly free and that fidelity can erode faster than predictive performance, allowing simpler rules to remain effective classifiers without faithfully reproducing the original model. A human assessment shows that simplification improves perceived readability, while preferences for different representations vary by professional background. Beyond measuring these losses empirically, we show that some can be anticipated from the original model: we derive a bound on the change caused by pruning and predict how faithfully a rule retaining only the direction of each feature's effect preserves the original ranking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对金融等受监管领域中可解释分类器因特征过多而不可读的问题，提出反向简化路线：从单一方程形式的可解释分类器出发，逐步化简为剪枝单项式 (pruned monomial)、方向性 if-then 规则以及金融已有的整数评分卡 (scorecard) 与计数表 (tally)。由于该方程本身就是预测模型而非事后解释，作者可以直接量化每次简化造成的损失。在四个金融数据集上，剪枝几乎无代价，而保真度 (fidelity) 的下降可能快于预测性能，使更简单的规则仍能有效分类却不再忠实复现原模型。
Motivation: 受监管领域要求模型可解释，但许多可解释分类器会产出包含数十个特征的公式，监管者无法阅读，从而违背了可解释性的初衷。
Method: 从单一方程的可解释分类器开始，逐步将其简化为更可读的形式（剪枝单项式、方向性 if-then 规则、整数评分卡与计数表），并直接测量每种简化带来的损失；同时推导剪枝引起的模型变化上界，并预测仅保留各特征效应方向的规则对原始排序的保真程度。
Result: 在四个金融数据集上，剪枝几乎不产生代价；保真度可能比预测性能下降得更快，使得简单规则仍能有效分类但不再忠实于原模型。人类评估显示简化提升可读性，且不同表示形式的偏好随职业背景而异。
Conclusion: 简化后的可读规则可以在不忠实复现原模型的情况下保持有效分类；部分简化损失可以从原模型中预先估计，例如剪枝变化上界和方向性规则的排序保真预测。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ZetaGPT: A Reference Implementation of Positional--Encoding--Free State--Space--Attention Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based language models rely on self-attention, whose computation is permutation-equivariant and therefore lacks an intrinsic mechanism for representing token order. Existing architectures address this limitation by explicitly incorporating positional information through learned positional embeddings or hand-crafted positional encodings, such as rotary positional encoding (RoPE), treating positional information as an architecturally acquired capability rather than an inherent property of the model. Motivated by the pursuit of positional-encoding-free architectures, this work explores a language model architecture that integrates causal state-space equations to implicitly encode positional information before attention computation. Specifically, each model block applies a causal state-space equation before self-attention, allowing recurrent state dynamics to encode sequential information into token representations. Consequently, subsequent attention layers operate on position-aware representations without requiring explicit positional encodings while retaining the expressive modeling capacity of self-attention. We present \textsc{ZetaGPT}, a compact hybrid language model designed for research, rapid prototyping, algorithm verification, and educational applications. In addition to the proposed architecture, \textsc{ZetaGPT} provides a fully open-source, end-to-end training pipeline encompassing dataset construction, tokenizer training, pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning via pure reinforcement learning. To the best of our knowledge, \textsc{ZetaGPT} is the first open-source small language model without explicit positional encoding and establishes a compact, reproducible reference implementation for the development and empirical study of positional-encoding-free language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ZetaGPT，一个无需显式位置编码 (positional encoding) 的混合语言模型。其核心设计是在每个模型块的 self-attention 之前应用因果状态空间方程 (causal state-space equation)，利用循环状态动力学将序列顺序隐式编码进 token 表征，从而使后续 attention 层无需位置编码即可处理位置感知的表征。ZetaGPT 还提供完整的开源端到端训练流程，包括数据构建、tokenizer 训练、预训练、SFT、RLHF 以及纯强化学习的 CoT 推理。
Motivation: Transformer self-attention 是排列等变的，本身无法表示 token 顺序，现有架构依赖学习式位置嵌入或 RoPE 等显式位置编码来弥补。作者追求无需位置编码的架构，希望将位置信息作为模型的固有属性而非后天习得能力。
Method: 在每层 self-attention 之前引入因果状态空间方程，使循环状态动力学把序列位置信息编码到 token 表征中，从而后续 attention 层不再需要显式位置编码，同时保留 self-attention 的表达能力。ZetaGPT 为此架构的紧凑实现，并附带开源训练流水线。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值或基准结果，主要贡献是提出并开源了据称首个无显式位置编码的小型语言模型参考实现。
Conclusion: ZetaGPT 定位为面向研究、快速原型、算法验证与教育的可复现参考实现，为无位置编码语言模型的开发与实证研究提供基础。摘要未提及实验限制。

papers.title: Foundation Models are Implicit Deepfake Detectors
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained self-supervised representations have emerged as a core component of current deepfake detection methods, yet it remains unclear which of their properties make real and fake media distinguishable. In this work, we uncover a surprisingly consistent phenomenon: across multiple pretrained models, datasets, and both image and video domains, fake samples systematically produce lower-magnitude representations than their real counterparts. Motivated by this finding, we formulate deepfake detection as an anomaly detection problem and show that simple statistics of feature magnitude achieve competitive performance with far more sophisticated deepfake detection methods. We further investigate the origin of this effect and demonstrate that reduced feature magnitude is primarily associated with semantic shifts introduced by fake content, while low-level generative fingerprints play a comparatively smaller role. Finally, we show that this discriminative signal strengthens as the size of the underlying foundation model grows, suggesting that advances in representation learning naturally translate into stronger zero-shot deepfake detectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现预训练自监督表示中一个一致现象：与真实样本相比，伪造样本（图像与视频）系统性产生更低幅值的特征表示。据此将深度伪造检测视为异常检测问题，仅用特征幅值的简单统计即可达到与更复杂方法相当的性能。作者进一步表明该信号主要源于伪造内容引入的语义偏移，且随基础模型规模增大而增强，使大规模表示学习天然带来更强的零样本深度伪造检测能力。
Motivation: 预训练自监督表示已成为当前深度伪造检测方法的核心组件，但究竟是哪些属性使真实与伪造媒体可区分仍不清楚。本文旨在揭示一种简单且跨模型、跨数据集一致的可分性信号。
Method: 在观察到伪造样本表示幅值系统性偏低后，将深度伪造检测形式化为异常检测问题，使用特征幅值的简单统计量作为检测器；并分析幅值降低的来源，区分语义偏移与低层生成指纹的贡献，同时考察基础模型规模对判别信号强度的影响。
Result: 摘要报告仅用特征幅值统计即可取得与更复杂的深度伪造检测方法相当的性能；该判别信号随基础模型规模增大而增强，实验覆盖多个预训练模型、数据集以及图像与视频域。
Conclusion: 作者认为表示学习方面的进展会自然转化为更强的零样本深度伪造检测器；幅值降低主要与伪造内容引入的语义偏移相关，低层生成指纹的作用相对较小。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: LITEWAY: LIghtweight HAR via Temporal Efficient highWAY
papers.abstract_en: Wearable human activity recognition (HAR) remains challenging due to the computational and energy constraints of deep learning models on resource-limited devices. Existing lightweight approaches often rely on recurrent architectures (e.g., GRU and LSTM), limiting parallelism and increasing inference latency. We propose LITEWAY, a modality-agnostic, fully convolutional framework for multichannel sensor time series that replaces recurrent temporal modeling with structured convolutional decomposition. LITEWAY combines lightweight convolutional blocks, strided temporal processing, and convolution-attention pooling to efficiently capture temporal dependencies while reducing computational complexity. We evaluate LITEWAY on 16 HAR datasets against TinyHAR, TinierHAR, and MLP-HAR. LITEWAY achieves competitive macro F1 while reducing model size by 4.06x-9.52x (Light) and 3.87x-9.07x (Full) compared with TinyHAR and TinierHAR. Deployment experiments further show energy reductions of 2.29x-3.14x (Light) and 1.46x-2.01x (Full) compared with TinierHAR and MLP-HAR, highlighting efficient fully convolutional temporal modeling for wearable HAR. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/dominique-nshimyimana/liteway.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LITEWAY，一个模态无关的全卷积框架，用于多通道传感器时间序列的人体活动识别 (HAR)。它用结构化卷积分解替代递归时序建模，结合轻量卷积块、步长时序处理和卷积注意力池化。在 16 个 HAR 数据集上，LITEWAY 相比 TinyHAR、TinierHAR 和 MLP-HAR 取得有竞争力的宏 F1，同时显著减小模型尺寸并降低能耗。
Motivation: 可穿戴 HAR 在资源受限设备上受限于深度学习模型的计算和能量约束，现有轻量方法多依赖递归架构 (如 GRU、LSTM)，限制了并行性并增加推理延迟。
Method: 提出 LITEWAY，一种模态无关的全卷积时序建模方法，通过结构化卷积分解替代递归时序建模，并组合轻量卷积块、步长时序处理 (strided temporal processing) 和卷积注意力池化来高效捕获时间依赖。
Result: 在 16 个 HAR 数据集上与 TinyHAR、TinierHAR、MLP-HAR 对比，LITEWAY 取得有竞争力的宏 F1，模型尺寸减少 4.06x-9.52x (Light) 和 3.87x-9.07x (Full)，部署能耗降低 2.29x-3.14x (Light) 和 1.46x-2.01x (Full)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调高效的完全卷积时序建模可用于可穿戴 HAR，并公开了源代码；该方法面向资源受限设备上的实时活动识别。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Mechanistic Diagnostic of Rank Collapse in Post-Norm Decoder Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Deep decoder-only Transformers often replace the original Post-Norm architecture with Pre-Norm variants because Post-Norm training is highly sensitive to warmup and learning rate under conventional initialization schemes. Although prior work has identified rank collapse and gradient vanishing as related symptoms, it remains poorly understood how causal attention creates high-similarity representations and why training dynamics fail to repair them. We give a two-stage analysis of Post-Norm rank collapse using token similarity as a scalar state variable. First, at initialization, causal attention acts approximately as a prefix-averaging operator that increases token similarity across depth, while the SwiGLU branch contributes only a smaller damping effect. Second, once training enters a high-similarity regime, growth of pre-normalization residual norms makes the RMSNorm backward factor contractive; under mild conditions, gradients to earlier layers decay geometrically. As a complementary result, we characterize the properties of a collapsed network: its best predictor is frequency distribution with relatively high loss floor, and gradients in collapsed layers vanish at frequency distribution. Experiments on 48-layer decoder-only Transformers trained on C4 dataset match the predicted initialization-time similarity growth and collapse-time gradient contraction, and show that collapsed runs stay near the predicted frequency loss. Together, these results distinguish the forward similarity amplification and backward repair incapacity in Post-Norm collapse, while also characterizing the behavior of collapsed networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用 token 相似度作为标量状态变量，对 Post-Norm decoder-only Transformer 的秩坍缩 (rank collapse) 给出两阶段机制分析。初始化阶段，因果注意力近似前缀平均算子，随深度提高 token 相似度，SwiGLU 分支只提供较小阻尼；训练进入高相似度区间后，pre-normalization 残差范数增长使 RMSNorm 反向因子收缩，梯度逐层几何衰减。48 层 C4 上的实验验证了预测的相似度增长与梯度收缩，并显示坍缩运行的损失接近频率分布对应的下限。
Motivation: 深层 decoder-only Transformer 常以 Pre-Norm 替代 Post-Norm，因为后者对 warmup 和学习率高度敏感；已有工作将秩坍缩和梯度消失列为相关症状，但因果注意力如何制造高相似表示、训练动态为何无法修复仍不清楚。
Method: 提出两阶段分析：以 token 相似度作为标量状态，初始化时把因果注意力近似为 prefix-averaging 算子；训练进入高相似度区间后，利用残差范数增长使 RMSNorm 反向因子收缩来解释梯度几何衰减；并刻画坍缩网络的预测器与梯度行为。
Result: 在 48 层 decoder-only Transformer、C4 数据集上的实验与预测一致：初始化期相似度增长、坍缩期梯度收缩，且坍缩运行接近预测的频率损失 (frequency loss)。
Conclusion: 结果将 Post-Norm 坍缩区分为前向相似度放大与后向修复能力缺失，并给出坍缩网络行为（最优预测器为频率分布、低层梯度在频率分布处消失）的表征。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KVDiagnosis: A Diagnostic Benchmark for KV-Cache Compression in Long-Context Language Models
papers.abstract_en: KV-cache compression reduces long-context memory, but aggregate task scores reveal neither which correct executions fail nor why. We present KVDiagnosis, a diagnostic dataset and benchmark with three contributions. First, a 25-method taxonomy groups methods into five mechanism families and links them to eight verified implementations and their valid diagnostic measurements. Second, for every supported method setting, we evaluate all sources in each fixed split against a per-source FullCache control before selecting FullCache-correct/compressed-wrong (C-to-W) rows separately for each method-setting, so no compressor defines another's test set. Third, a common record format links paired outputs and run metadata to cache, likelihood, attention, and decoding measurements with explicit applicability states. On Qwen3-8B, four evidence-aware workloads yield 59 800 supported compressed runs over 2600 sources and 12 520 C-to-W rows. Under fixed diagnostic rules, 63.2% have low or partial measured/projected coverage. Only 19 rows (0.2%) combine high measured/projected coverage with strong likelihood drift; another 2,126 (17.0%) preserve structural position addressability, for which representation fidelity remains unknown, while showing the same drift. Against C-to-C success controls, all ten diagnostics separate failed from successful compression (stratified AUROC 0.684-0.871). Among 96 reproducible low-EAR failures, a controlled 4x evidence-attention boost repairs 29.2%, versus 6.3% under a count-matched sham intervention and 3.3% degradation on matched C-to-C controls. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ChosenQC/KVDiagnosis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KVDiagnosis 是一个面向长上下文语言模型 KV-cache 压缩的诊断基准，旨在揭示压缩导致的失败执行及其原因。论文提出包含 25 种方法的分类法，按五种机制族归类并链接到八个已验证实现；对每个方法-设置，以逐源的 FullCache 对照筛选出 FullCache 正确但压缩错误（C-to-W）的样本。基于 Qwen3-8B 的四个证据感知工作负载共产生 59800 次受支持的压缩运行，其中 63.2% 在固定诊断规则下表现为低或部分覆盖，仅 19 行（0.2%）兼具高覆盖与强似然漂移。十个诊断指标均能区分失败与成功的压缩（分层 AUROC 0.684–0.871），且受控的 4 倍证据注意力增强可修复 29.2% 的低 EAR 失败。
Motivation: 现有 KV-cache 压缩评估仅依赖聚合任务分数，既无法揭示哪些正确的执行步骤失败，也无法说明失败原因，因此缺少可用于定位和修复压缩失败的诊断工具。
Method: 构建 KVDiagnosis 数据集与基准：提出 25 方法分类法（五种机制族，八个已验证实现）；对每种方法-设置基于逐源 FullCache 对照挑选 C-to-W 行，避免压缩器之间互相定义测试集；设计统一的记录格式，将配对输出、运行元数据与缓存、似然、注意力和解码测量关联，并给出显式的适用性状态。
Result: 在 Qwen3-8B 上，四个证据感知工作负载产生 59800 次压缩运行，其中 63.2% 为低或部分覆盖；仅 0.2% 的行同时具备高测量/预测覆盖与强似然漂移，另有 17.0% 保持结构位置可寻址性但表示保真度未知。所有十个诊断在 C-to-C 成功对照下区分失败与成功压缩（分层 AUROC 0.684–0.871）；在 96 个可复现低 EAR 失败中，受控 4 倍证据注意力增强修复 29.2%，而匹配的假干预仅修复 6.3%，C-to-C 对照则退化 3.3%。
Conclusion: 论文认为 KV-cache 压缩失败可通过所提出的诊断指标进行可操作的归因，且证据注意力增强能修复一部分失败；同时指出部分失败在结构位置可寻址性上表现正常，其表示保真度仍属未知，说明诊断规则尚不能完全解释所有失败模式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MeanSR: Restoration Trajectory Learning for One-Step Perceptual Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based super-resolution (SR) achieves strong perceptual quality but requires costly iterative denoising. Existing one-step distillation methods reduce inference time but depend on expensive pretrained teachers, whereas CTMSR avoids distillation through PF-ODE consistency training yet does not explicitly model the restoration dynamics from low-resolution (LR) inputs to high-resolution (HR) images. We propose MeanSR, a one-step perceptual SR method that learns an LR-conditioned average velocity field to directly capture the finite-time transition from degraded or noisy inputs to plausible HR outputs. We further reformulate distribution trajectory matching for average-velocity generation and introduce a Stage-Aware Temporal Sampling strategy to improve trajectory learning. Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that MeanSR outperforms CTMSR on CLIPIQA, MUSIQ, and MANIQA while substantially reducing FLOPs and inference latency. MeanSR also reconstructs sharper structures and more realistic textures with fewer perceptual artifacts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MeanSR，一种单步感知超分辨率 (perceptual super-resolution) 方法。它学习一个以低分辨率 (LR) 图像为条件的平均速度场，直接建模从退化或噪声输入到合理高分辨率 (HR) 输出的有限时间迁移，从而避免扩散模型的迭代去噪和昂贵教师网络蒸馏。作者将分布轨迹匹配重构为适用于平均速度生成的形式，并引入 Stage-Aware Temporal Sampling 来改善轨迹学习。摘要报告在合成与真实基准上，MeanSR 在 CLIPIQA、MUSIQ、MANIQA 指标上超越 CTMSR，同时显著降低 FLOPs 和推理延迟。
Motivation: 基于扩散的超分辨率虽然感知质量好，但需要昂贵的迭代去噪；现有一步蒸馏方法虽然减少推理时间，却依赖昂贵的预训练教师模型，而 CTMSR 通过 PF-ODE 一致性训练免蒸馏，却未显式建模从 LR 输入到 HR 图像的恢复动力学。
Method: 提出 MeanSR，学习一个 LR 条件平均速度场以直接刻画从退化或噪声输入到合理 HR 输出的有限时间迁移；同时将分布轨迹匹配改写成适合平均速度生成的形式，并提出 Stage-Aware Temporal Sampling 策略来加强轨迹学习。
Result: 在合成与真实世界基准上，MeanSR 在 CLIPIQA、MUSIQ 和 MANIQA 上优于 CTMSR，并大幅降低 FLOPs 与推理延迟；重建结果具有更锐利的结构和更真实的纹理，感知伪影更少。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过显式学习 LR 条件的平均恢复轨迹，可以绕开逐次去噪和教师蒸馏，实现高效且高质量的单步感知超分辨率。

papers.title: One Model to Magnify Them All: Efficient Scale-Invariant Histopathology via Conditional Normalization and Continuous Magnification Training
papers.abstract_en: Whole slide images (WSIs) in digital histopathology are acquired at discrete magnification levels encoding complementary diagnostic information from global tissue architecture to fine-grained cellular morphology. Yet, deep learning models remain sensitive to scale variation. Existing magnification-invariant methods rely on multi-scale architectures at predefined discrete resolutions, while in clinical deployment the acquisition magnification varies continuously, rarely aligns with a model's fixed training resolution, and intermediate scales are common, so robust coverage otherwise demands a costly ensemble of magnification-specific models. We propose Conditional Layer Normalization (CLN), a lightweight mechanism that generates affine normalization parameters from input pixel size via a small MLP, integrated into standard CNN architectures for both WSI classification and segmentation. Trained on patches sampled continuously across a range of pixel sizes, the model decouples inference from scanner-dependent magnification and generalizes to arbitrary, previously unseen scales at test time. On the PANDA prostate cancer dataset, our approach on average matches or exceeds independently trained single-magnification models and ranks among the top three performers at every evaluated magnification, including those unseen during training. This collapses a five-model ensemble into a single network and reduces training, and inference cost roughly 4-5 times, while leaving the multiply-accumulate count unchanged. The code is available at: https://github.com/aflorkowska/OneModelToMagnifyThemAll.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对数字病理全切片图像（WSI）中尺度变化导致深度学习模型敏感的问题，提出条件层归一化（Conditional Layer Normalization, CLN），通过小型MLP从输入像素尺寸生成仿射归一化参数，集成到标准CNN架构中用于WSI分类和分割。模型在连续像素尺寸范围内采样训练，从而与扫描仪相关的放大倍数解耦，并可泛化到测试时任意未见过的尺度。在PANDA前列腺癌数据集上，该方法平均匹配或超过独立训练的单放大倍数模型，并在所有评估倍数（含训练未见过的）中排名前三，将五模型集成压缩为单一网络，训练和推理成本降低约4-5倍。
Motivation: 现有放大倍数不变方法依赖预定义离散分辨率的多尺度架构，而临床部署中采集放大倍数连续变化，很少与模型的固定训练分辨率对齐，中间尺度常见；鲁棒覆盖否则需要昂贵的多模型集成。
Method: 提出条件层归一化（CLN），用小型MLP根据输入像素尺寸生成仿射归一化参数，集成到标准CNN中，并对连续像素尺寸范围采样的patch进行训练，使推理与扫描仪相关的放大倍数解耦。
Result: 在PANDA前列腺癌数据集上，该方法平均匹配或超过独立训练的单放大倍数模型，在每个评估放大倍数（包括训练中未见过的）中排名前三，将五模型集成压缩为单一网络，训练和推理成本降低约4-5倍，且乘法累加运算次数不变。
Conclusion: 摘要强调单一网络即可高效处理任意未知放大倍数，消除了对多个放大倍数特定模型集成的需求。

papers.title: Sign Language Recognition Using Original and Synthetic Depth Image Based Point Cloud Data Models
papers.abstract_en: Research regarding the sign language recognition mostly relies on RGB images, whileas sign language datasets that provide depth images are limited. Point clouds obtained from depth images can be used for sign language recognition with neural networks like PointNet. In recent years, various neural networks are used for generating realistic depth images from monocular RGB images. In this work, synthetic depth images were created from RGB images using Depth Anything V2 network. For this purpose, three sign language datasets (Real-time ASL Fingerspelling, KArSL, AUTSL) which contain both RGB and depth images were used. Classification accuracies of the point cloud data created from both original and synthetic depth images using various PointNet architectures were measured for sign language recognition. From the original and synthetic point clouds, frame based, Point Gesture Map and Long Short Term Memory data models were used for classification and their performances were compared. In the results, both original and synthetic based data achieved acceptable performance in most models. In general, original depth based point cloud models performed better than synthetic ones, however in some models synthetic depth based models performed better than the originals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究使用由原始深度图像与合成深度图像生成的点云数据进行手语识别。作者利用 Depth Anything V2 网络从 RGB 图像生成合成深度图像，并在 Real-time ASL Fingerspelling、KArSL、AUTSL 三个数据集上比较原始与合成深度点云的分类效果。实验使用多种 PointNet 架构，并对比帧级、Point Gesture Map 和 LSTM 三种数据模型的表现，结果显示两种点云在多数模型上均达到可接受性能，总体上原始深度点云略优，但部分模型上合成深度点云表现更好。
Motivation: 现有手语识别研究大多依赖 RGB 图像，而提供深度图像的数据集有限。作者希望利用从 RGB 图像合成深度图像的技术，扩展深度点云数据来源，以缓解深度数据稀缺的问题。
Method: 使用 Depth Anything V2 网络从 RGB 图像生成合成深度图像，分别从原始和合成深度图像构建点云，采用多种 PointNet 架构进行分类，并构建帧级、Point Gesture Map 和 Long Short Term Memory 三种数据模型进行比较。
Result: 在三个手语数据集上，原始与合成深度点云在多数模型中均取得可接受分类性能；总体而言原始深度点云模型优于合成深度点云模型，但部分模型中合成深度点云模型表现更佳。
Conclusion: 作者认为合成深度图像生成的点云可用于手语识别，并且在某些场景下能够达到甚至超过原始深度点云的效果。
Relevance: 0
