papers.title: Monotonicity-Guided Bottom-Up Petri Net Discovery: The SPECpp Framework
authors: Wil M. P. van der Aalst
papers.abstract_en: Process discovery is one of the central challenges in process mining. Petri nets are particularly attractive because simple local constructs can express complex behavior, including concurrency. While their global behavior may be difficult to analyze, individual places can be efficiently characterized using monotonic properties, enabling bottom-up discovery. Unlike top-down approaches such as the Inductive Miner, which rely on predefined constructs for sequences, choices, loops, and concurrency, our approach allows such structures to emerge organically and can exploit the full expressive power of Petri nets, including free-choice constructs and long-term dependencies. The main challenge is the exponential number of candidate places and their combinations. We present the SPECpp framework which implements strategies to obtain high-quality models under time and resource constraints. SPECpp supports rapid experimentation and is used to evaluate these strategies using both synthetic and real-life event data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPECpp 框架，用于从事件日志中自底向上地发现 Petri 网模型。该方法利用库所（place）的单调性特征高效刻画个体位置，并通过候选位置生成与组合策略在时间和资源约束下获得高质量模型，使用合成与真实事件数据进行评估。与依赖预定义结构的自顶向下方法（如 Inductive Miner）不同，该框架允许自由选择构造和长期依赖等结构有机涌现。
Motivation: 过程发现是过程挖掘的核心挑战，而现有自顶向下方法依赖预定义的序列、选择、循环和并发构造，无法充分利用 Petri 网的完整表达能力。候选位置数量及其组合呈指数增长，是自底向上发现面临的主要难题。
Method: 提出 SPECpp 框架，基于位置的单调性性质实现自底向上的 Petri 网发现，并实现多种策略以在时间与资源约束下筛选高质量模型；框架支持快速实验，用于系统评估这些策略。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化结果，仅说明该框架使用合成和真实事件数据评估所提出的发现策略。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法允许结构在发现过程中有机出现，能利用 Petri 网的全部表达能力，包括自由选择构造和长期依赖；主要挑战在于候选位置及其组合的指数级搜索空间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Objectives to What Models Learn: A Landau Theory of Invariant Learning
papers.abstract_en: Invariant learning seeks representations that remain predictive across environments, yet the behavior of its objectives along the regularization path is often opaque. We address this objective-behavior gap by viewing representation learning as multimode magnetization and deriving, from concrete invariant-learning objectives, a Landau-type effective free energy whose low-order coefficients form objective signatures and induce distinct regularization phenotypes. Effective quadratic corrections move the phase boundary and enable finite-strength mode elimination; quartic corrections regulate post-onset amplitude and typically leave residual loading at finite strength; higher-order structure governs non-monotone tails, instability, and collapse at large regularization. In a canonical bilinear model, the theory yields closed-form phase boundaries and steady-state loadings, as well as distinct critical strengths for shortcut and stable modes that define a selective-retention window. Controlled experiments confirm the predicted phase boundaries, loadings, and regularization phenotypes. In one- and two-hidden-layer ReLU networks, the same signatures remain predictive of qualitative regularization-path behavior despite depth-dependent shifts in scale. A matrix extension generalizes the framework to coupled collective modes and yields a spectral phase-boundary criterion. Together, the framework turns low-order objective signatures into predictions of regularization phenotypes and, ultimately, of what models learn as regularization varies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个Landau型有效自由能框架，用于刻画不变学习（invariant learning）目标沿正则化路径的行为。作者从具体的不变学习目标推导出低阶系数作为目标特征（objective signatures），并据此解释二次、四次及高阶修正如何产生不同的正则化表现型（regularization phenotypes），包括模式消除、残余加载、非单调尾部与塌缩。理论在双线性模型、ReLU网络和矩阵扩展中都得到验证或推广。
Motivation: 不变学习目标在正则化路径上的行为往往不透明，存在目标行为差距（objective-behavior gap），即很难理解目标函数如何决定模型实际学到的表示。
Method: 将表示学习类比为多模磁化（multimode magnetization），从不变学习目标推导Landau型有效自由能；分析二次修正对相边界与模式消除的作用、四次修正对起始后振幅与残余加载的作用，以及高阶结构对不稳定性与塌缩的影响，并扩展至矩阵耦合模式。
Result: 在规范双线性模型中得到闭式相边界、稳态加载，以及捷径模式与稳定模式的临界强度，从而定义选择性保留窗口；受控实验验证了预测的相边界和加载；单层与两层ReLU网络中的定性行为预测成立；矩阵扩展给出谱相边界准则。
Conclusion: 该框架把低阶目标特征转化为对正则化表现型的预测，进而解释模型在不同正则化强度下实际学到什么。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Temporal Misgrounding in Legal RAG: A Versioned-Corpus Benchmark for French Tax Law
papers.abstract_en: We identify and quantify temporal misgrounding: the systematic retrieval and citation of the currently in-force version of a legal article when the applicable version is an earlier or future one. Standard legal RAG treats the corpus as static; we argue legal question answering is a temporally-indexed retrieval problem. We introduce FiscalQA Pro, pairing a versioned corpus of 32,436 article-versions of the French tax code (93 years, 1938-2031) with an all-model-hard temporal-reasoning track: 209 scored, expert-reviewed questions across 33 CGI articles (221 released; twelve flagged out of the answerable scope). At selection time, no evaluated model recovered its date-applicable answer closed-book in any of four sampling draws, and the currently in-force text lacks the gold value for all but one of the scored questions. Answers are scored deterministically via atomic ground-truth "nuggets" (regex and numeric-with-tolerance), never LLM-as-judge: an LLM judge would inherit the temporal bias it is meant to score. Across eleven models (five frontier closed-API systems plus Gemini 2.5 Pro as a substitute entry, and five open-weight), parametric knowledge yields 3.0% mean strict accuracy and RAG over a static current-version corpus 2.7%. Static RAG retrieves the date-applicable version 0% of the time, confidently citing a real but inapplicable version. Our end-to-end retriever over a multi-version index, with no oracle, reaches 98.3% mean strict; an oracle-article ablation reaches 99.1%, locating the residual gap in first-stage recall, not version selection. We additionally release a version-aware jurisprudence dataset of 69,208 citation links, together with the corpus, benchmark, model responses, and pipeline code.

TL;DR: 本文提出并量化了法律 RAG 中的时间错位接地 (temporal misgrounding) 问题：检索系统在应当引用更早或未来版本时，却系统地检索并引用当前有效版本。作者引入 FiscalQA Pro 基准，包含法国税法 32,436 个条款版本 (1938-2031) 和 209 道经专家审核的时序推理题 (覆盖 33 个 CGI 条款)。在 11 个模型上，纯参数知识严格准确率均值 3.0%，静态当前版本 RAG 为 2.7% 且对日期适用版本的检索率为 0%；端到端多版本索引检索器无 oracle 时达到 98.3% 严格准确率。作者同时发布含 69,208 条引文链接的版本感知判例数据集。
Motivation: 标准法律 RAG 把语料库当作静态的，而法律问答本质上是时间索引的检索问题，导致系统性地引用不适用于目标日期的条款版本。此外，用 LLM 作为裁判评分会继承其自身的时间偏差，因此需要确定性的评分机制。
Method: 构建带版本语料库的 FiscalQA Pro 基准，并采用原子事实片段 (atomic nuggets，含正则和数值容差) 进行确定性评分而非 LLM 裁判；评估闭卷参数知识与静态 RAG，并引入无 oracle 的多版本索引检索管道，同时发布版本感知判例引用数据集。
Result: 11 个模型在闭卷抽取下没有任何一个在四次采样中恢复出日期适用答案；静态 RAG 检索到日期适用版本的次数为 0%，但会自信地引用真实却不适用版本。端到端多版本检索器达到 98.3% 均值严格准确率，oracle 条款消融达 99.1%，说明剩余误差来自第一阶段召回而非版本选择。
Conclusion: 法律问答需要显式建模版本时间信息，版本索引式检索几乎解决了版本选择问题，残差主要在第一阶段召回；同时 LLM 裁判不适合用于衡量时间错位接地。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CableDex: Cable Length Estimation on Industrial Reels Using a Handheld Device
papers.abstract_en: CableDex is a computer vision system that addresses the time-consuming and inaccurate manual measurement of cable length on industrial reels from a single photograph captured with a mobile phone. The system combines camera calibration, instance segmentation, pose estimation, and volumetric calculation to estimate the cable length across five different reel types and various cable sizes. This system is based on an instance segmentation model trained on 1,000 manually annotated images, achieving 99.5\% mAP50 with an inference time of 5.66 ms per image. Evaluated on 75 reels across five reel types, the system achieves a MAPE of 4.90\%, within the 10\% error tolerance commonly accepted in industrial cable-reel measurement. The demonstration presents the end-to-end pipeline, from reel label scanning and image capture to segmentation and length estimation, through the mobile application.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CableDex 是一个面向工业卷轴电缆长度估计的计算机视觉系统，只需用手机拍摄单张照片即可完成测量。系统结合相机标定、实例分割 (instance segmentation)、姿态估计和体积计算，对五种卷轴类型和多种电缆尺寸估计长度；实例分割模型基于 1000 张人工标注图像训练，达到 99.5% mAP50，单张推理时间 5.66 ms。在 75 个卷轴、五种卷轴类型的评估中取得 4.90% 的 MAPE，满足工业常用的 10% 误差容限。演示展示了从卷轴标签扫描、图像采集到分割与长度估计的端到端移动应用流程。
Motivation: 工业卷轴上的电缆长度目前依赖人工测量，既耗时又容易出错；该论文旨在从手机拍摄的单张照片直接自动估计电缆长度，替代繁琐的人工流程。
Method: 提出端到端计算机视觉管线，将相机标定、实例分割、姿态估计与体积计算相结合，并基于 1000 张人工标注图像训练实例分割模型；移动应用涵盖卷轴标签扫描、图像采集、分割和长度估计等环节。
Result: 摘要报告实例分割模型达到 99.5% mAP50，推理时间为 5.66 ms；在 75 个卷轴、五种卷轴类型上 MAPE 为 4.90%，落在工业电缆卷轴测量通常接受的 10% 误差容限之内。
Conclusion: 作者认为该系统在工业容差范围内实现了准确的电缆长度估计，并以移动应用形式验证了从采集到估算的完整流程。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CoInS-Net: A Continuous Position-Aware Network for Joint Medical Image Interpolation and Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate medical image interpolation and anatomical structure segmentation are fundamental for computer-aided diagnosis and treatment planning. Anisotropic medical volumes with sparse through-plane sampling often suffer from structural discontinuity and boundary blur, hindering reliable clinical image analysis. Most existing methods implement interpolation and segmentation independently, which introduces redundant computation and fails to fully exploit complementary cross-slice structural information between sequential slices. To address these issues, we propose a continuous position-aware interaction network, termed CoInS-Net, for joint frame interpolation and lesion segmentation. Unlike conventional cascaded interpolation-then-segmentation paradigms, the framework enables bidirectional interaction under a shared Swin encoder with continuous spatial coordinate queries. A spatially continuous position interpolation module generates target-position features at every scale from the relative coordinate and physical spacing, and a prototype-based task mutual interaction module lets the segmentation and interpolation branches exchange global structure through a small set of shared prototypes rather than dense feature mixing. A multi-scale task-cooperative decoder further separates each scale into shared and task-specific components, so the two tasks reinforce common anatomy while preserving their distinct requirements down to the boundary level, without extra annotations. Experiments on four public medical imaging datasets with diverse modalities and anatomical regions demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms conventional single-task schemes. The joint optimization framework effectively realizes mutual promotion between interpolation and segmentation tasks, providing a reliable and universal technical scheme for intelligent clinical medical image analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoInS-Net，一个用于医学图像插值与分割联合任务的连续位置感知交互网络。该方法在共享 Swin 编码器下通过连续空间坐标查询实现双向任务交互，并用原型机制交换全局结构，替代传统串行的插值后分割流程。实验在四个公开医学影像数据集上验证了其优于单任务方案。
Motivation: 各向异性医学体数据在层间采样稀疏时易出现结构不连续和边界模糊，而现有方法通常将插值和分割独立处理，既引入冗余计算，又未能充分利用相邻切片间的互补结构信息。
Method: 提出连续位置感知交互网络 CoInS-Net：包含空间连续位置插值模块，利用相对坐标和物理间距在各尺度生成目标位置特征；原型式任务交互模块通过少量共享原型而非密集特征混合，在分割与插值分支间交换全局结构；多尺度任务协同解码器将每个尺度分为共享与任务特定成分，在不增加标注的情况下从边界层面兼顾两个任务。
Result: 在四个覆盖不同模态和解剖区域的公开医学影像数据集上，所提方法优于传统单任务方案，联合优化框架实现了插值与分割任务的相互促进。
Conclusion: 摘要强调联合优化能够有效实现插值和分割的互惠，为智能临床医学影像分析提供可靠且通用的技术方案。

papers.title: Regret, equilibrium, and learning in games: A guided tour
papers.abstract_en: This note aims to serve as an entry point to the literature on learning in games, a topic with significant theoretical appeal and a wide range of applications -- from machine learning and data science to economics and beyond. Our presentation is structured around two complementary viewpoints: We first consider a single agent -- the learner -- engaged in a sequential decision process in an unknown, non-stationary, and possibly adversarial environment. We then examine what happens when the environment is shaped by the decisions of several interacting agents, not necessarily aware of each other's actions or goals, and all seeking to improve their individual rewards. In this general context, we examine a family of regularized learning policies based on best-responding to the past history of play, up to a regularization penalty intended to encourage exploration and prevent over-commitment to suboptimal choices. In the single-agent setting, we present some basic regret bounds for regularized learning in adversarial multi-armed bandits; in the multi-agent setting, we describe an ergodic equilibrium convergence result for zero-sum games in the spirit of classical results on fictitious play, as well as a "folk theorem" linking strategic and dynamic notions of stability -- Nash equilibria and attracting points of regularized learning, respectively. We pay special attention to the information available to the players and, through a unified analysis framework, we study both oracle- and payoff-based (bandit) methods. Our goal is to provide a coherent and comprehensible -- albeit, by necessity, not comprehensive -- account of some recent ideas in the field, and to discuss their implications for the study of rationality.
papers.comment: 44 pages, 3 figures; to appear as a chapter in "Equilibria in Games: Existence, Selection, and Dynamics", edited by Sylvain Sorin and Bernhard von Stengel
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于博弈中学习 (learning in games) 的引导性综述，面向希望进入该领域的读者。内容围绕两个互补视角展开：先考察单个学习者在未知、非平稳且可能对抗的环境中做序贯决策，再考察多个交互智能体各自优化个体收益的情形。文中重点分析一族基于历史最优响应并附加正则惩罚的正则化学习策略，并统一讨论 oracle 型与基于收益 (bandit) 的信息结构。
Motivation: 学习在博弈中兼具理论吸引力与广泛的应用前景（从机器学习、数据科学到经济学），但文献分散且对初学者门槛较高，因此需要一篇连贯可读的导览性综述来梳理近期思想。
Method: 以单智能体序贯决策和多智能体博弈两个视角组织内容；采用一个统一的分析框架，考察正则化学习策略族（在响应历史最优回应时加入正则惩罚以鼓励探索），并同时覆盖 oracle 型与 payoff-based (bandit) 方法。
Result: 单智能体部分给出对抗多臂老虎机中正则化学习的基本遗憾界；多智能体部分给出零和博弈中遍历均衡收敛的结果（与经典虚构博弈结果精神一致），以及联系纳什均衡与正则化学习吸引点之间的“民间定理”。
Conclusion: 作者意在提供连贯、易懂但客观上不全面的近期思想综述，并讨论这些结果对理性 (rationality) 研究的意义。

papers.title: Efficient Human-Contact Representation for Human-Scene Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Human-scene interaction is an active research topic with several industrial applications in virtual reality, gaming, robotics, and surveillance. Despite significant progress in network architectures to improve the results or optimize models' parameters for fast inference speed, the efficient representation of contact between humans and their environments remains an open challenge. In this paper, we propose a new efficient human-contact representation for human-scene interaction. Our primary contribution is the introduction of sparse contact masks that strategically select essential contact information, significantly reducing redundant data in high-dimensional inputs. Leveraging this efficient contact representation, we propose a suite of sparse operators to replace traditional dense operators within deep network layers for faster computation. Our approach not only enhances computational speed but also filters out non-essential contact data, thereby improving the precision of human-scene interaction models. To validate the effectiveness of our method, we conduct intensive experiments across three public benchmark datasets, focusing on two critical tasks for human-scene interaction: contact prediction and scene synthesis. The experimental results show that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art models in reconstruction accuracy and achieves a computation speed-up of at least 12 times over recent baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于人类-场景交互 (human-scene interaction) 的高效接触表示，核心是引入稀疏接触掩码 (sparse contact masks) 来筛选关键接触信息、削减高维输入中的冗余数据，并用一组稀疏算子替换深度网络层中的传统密集算子以加速计算。作者在三个公开基准上针对接触预测和场景合成两项任务进行实验，结果表明重建精度超过现有最优模型，计算速度较近期基线至少提升 12 倍。
Motivation: 尽管已有研究通过改进网络结构或压缩模型参数来提升效果和推理速度，人与环境之间的接触表示仍然低效，高维输入中包含大量冗余信息，阻碍了人类-场景交互任务的精度与效率。
Method: 提出基于稀疏接触掩码的高效接触表示，策略性地选择必要接触信息以减少冗余；并配套设计一组稀疏算子，在深度网络层中替代传统的密集算子实现更快计算。
Result: 在三个公开基准数据集上的接触预测与场景合成实验中，该方法在重建精度上超越 state-of-the-art 模型，并相对近期基线取得至少 12 倍的计算加速。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法的优势同时来自计算加速和非必要接触数据的过滤，两者共同提升了人类-场景交互模型的精度。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Imaginative Generative AI: Crossing the Entropy Wall into Worlds Beyond Imitation
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI models are primarily designed to imitate the data distribution, an objective that neither corrects diversity lost by a learned generator nor defines how generation should extend beyond the diversity of the data itself. We introduce Imaginative Generative AI (IGA), a framework that makes diversity part of the target-distribution design problem: among distributions close to a reference, IGA selects one whose spectral diversity reaches a prescribed level. Diversity is measured by the von Neumann entropy of the generated distribution's kernel covariance operator in a fixed representation space, providing a reference-free representation-guided measure of how broadly probability mass occupies embedding directions. The spectral entropy of the population data distribution defines an Entropy Wall. Below the wall, IGA performs diversity repair, recovering variation that a learned generator has lost while remaining within the diversity level of the data. Beyond the wall, the data distribution itself becomes infeasible, and IGA deliberately departs from it to produce distributions with greater representation-relative spectral diversity, an operational notion of imaginative generation. These regimes form a single regularization path from imitation to imagination and define an i.i.d. target distribution at each prescribed diversity level. We develop the theory of this entropy-constrained projection and show that, under a KL anchor to a pretrained generator, the optimum satisfies a self-consistent exponential-tilt relation. This characterization leads to IGA Guidance, a retraining-free inference-time method for score-based and diffusion models, including DDPM and DDIM samplers. Experiments on synthetic and vision benchmarks demonstrate diversity repair below the Entropy Wall and controlled spectral extrapolation beyond it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Imaginative Generative AI (IGA) 框架，将多样性纳入目标分布设计：在靠近参考分布的候选集中，选择谱多样性（由核协方差算子的 von Neumann 熵度量）达到指定水平的分布。作者定义了 Entropy Wall（数据分布谱熵），低于该墙时 IGA 做多样性修复，高于该墙时则有意偏离数据分布以实现想象力生成，并推导出熵约束投影的最优解满足指数倾斜关系，进而给出无需重训练的推理时方法 IGA Guidance，适用于 DDPM 和 DDIM 等分数模型与扩散模型。实验在合成与视觉基准上展示了墙下的多样性修复和墙外的受控谱外推。
Motivation: 现有生成模型以模仿数据分布为目标，既不纠正生成器丢失的多样性，也未定义生成如何超越数据自身的多样性，缺乏对多样性本身的显式设计。
Method: 提出 IGA 框架，在 KL 锚定到预训练生成器的条件下，通过最大化与参考分布接近且谱多样性达到设定水平的分布，形式化熵约束投影；推导出最优性条件为自洽指数倾斜关系，并据此实现无需重训练的推理时采样方法 IGA Guidance，兼容 score-based 模型、DDPM 和 DDIM。
Result: 实验表明，在合成与视觉基准上，IGA 能在 Entropy Wall 之下修复生成器丢失的多样性，并在墙之上进行受控的谱外推（spectral extrapolation），产生比数据分布更高谱多样性的分布。
Conclusion: 作者认为从模仿到想象构成单一的正则化路径，并在每个指定多样性水平上定义了一个 i.i.d. 目标分布；该方法提供了一种参考无关的、表示引导的多样性控制机制。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Coordinate-Residual Physics-Driven Neural Network for Electromagnetic Inverse Scattering
papers.abstract_en: Electromagnetic inverse scattering is a nonlinear and ill-posed problem, where accurate reconstruction is challenging due to measurement limitations, noise, and high computational costs, especially for 3-D imaging. Although physics-driven neural networks (PDNNs) reduce the dependence on labeled training data, existing accelerated PDNN frameworks often rely on preliminary reconstruction-based region selection, which may introduce instability when the selected region is inaccurate. In this paper, a coordinate-residual physics-driven neural network (CRPDNN) is proposed for 3-D electromagnetic inverse scattering. The proposed solver directly reconstructs the unknown contrast distribution using normalized spatial coordinates and a residual convolutional network, without requiring a preliminary reconstruction. For the reported noise-free 3-D synthetic cases, CRPDNN achieves an average relative error of 2.10\%, compared with 7.97\% for CSI and 3.99\% for $L_{2/3}$-FBE-WCIE, while providing approximately 5.5- and 12.1-fold speedups over the two baselines, respectively. Supplementary 2-D comparisons further confirm its stability and computational efficiency relative to existing PDNN frameworks. CRPDNN also maintains reliable reconstruction performance under noisy measurements, and the 3-D Fresnel experiments further indicate its potential for practical imaging applications. The related code is available at https://github.com/Physics-driven-methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对三维电磁逆散射这一非线性和病态问题，提出一种坐标残差物理驱动神经网络 (CRPDNN)。该方法直接利用归一化空间坐标和残差卷积网络重建未知对比度分布，无需依赖基于初步重建的区域选择。在无噪声三维合成算例中，CRPDNN 的平均相对误差为 2.10%，显著优于 CSI 的 7.97% 与 L2/3-FBE-WCIE 的 3.99%，且分别获得约 5.5 倍和 12.1 倍的加速。
Motivation: 电磁逆散射重建因测量限制、噪声和高计算成本而困难，尤其在三维成像中。现有加速物理驱动神经网络 (PDNN) 框架常依赖基于初步重建的区域选择，当选择区域不准确时会引入不稳定性。
Method: 提出坐标残差物理驱动神经网络 (CRPDNN)，使用归一化空间坐标作为输入，结合残差卷积网络直接重建未知对比度分布，不需要初步重建步骤。
Result: 在无噪声三维合成算例中，CRPDNN 达到 2.10% 的平均相对误差，而 CSI 为 7.97%、L2/3-FBE-WCIE 为 3.99%，并相比两者分别获得约 5.5 倍和 12.1 倍的加速。补充的二维对比验证了其相对现有 PDNN 框架的稳定性与计算效率，且在噪声测量下仍保持可靠重建性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CRPDNN 通过避免初步重建的区域选择，在三维电磁逆散射中实现了更高的精度和计算效率，三维 Fresnel 实验表明其在实际成像应用中具有潜力，代码已开源。

papers.title: OpenLoopEvolve: A Verifiable Self-Evolution Framework for Loop Policies in Long-Horizon Complex Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon complex tasks require agents to repeatedly observe states, formulate plans, invoke tools, verify results, and recover from failures in continuously changing environments. However, such control experience often remains confined to a single context or a fixed prompt, and is difficult to accumulate and reuse across historical traces. This paper presents OpenLoopEvolve (OLE), a self-evolution framework centered on the Loop Policy. OLE represents an agent's observation, planning, memory, action, verification, recovery, stopping, and budget control as portable policy assets with versions and lineages, and provides online and offline evolution modes that can be selected according to practical needs: the online mode triggers candidate generation based on feedback from continuous operation, whereas the offline mode searches for candidate policies from archived traces and failure evidence. Both modes share an evolution mechanism consisting of autonomous proposals by a large language model, Champion--Challenger paired evaluation, and robust release. Policies released online are activated at a subsequent task boundary, monitored using subsequent feedback, and rolled back to their parent versions when degradation conditions are met. On the simulated business benchmark YC-Bench, both modes improve aggregate task performance, task success rate, and risk metrics relative to a fixed initial Loop Policy. The results indicate that treating the Loop Policy as a governable asset can support the accumulation, comparison, release, and reuse of control experience and improve agent performance on long-horizon complex tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OpenLoopEvolve (OLE)，一个以循环策略 (Loop Policy) 为核心的自进化框架，用于长时域复杂任务中的智能体控制经验积累与复用。OLE 将观察、规划、记忆、行动、验证、恢复、停止与预算控制表示成带版本和谱系的便携策略资产，并提供在线与离线两种进化模式，二者共享由大语言模型自主提议、Champion–Challenger 配对评估与稳健发布组成的进化机制。在模拟业务基准 YC-Bench 上，两种模式相比固定初始 Loop Policy 均提升了聚合任务性能、任务成功率与风险指标。
Motivation: 长时域复杂任务中，智能体的控制经验往往局限于单一上下文或固定提示词，难以在历史轨迹间积累和复用，限制了智能体在持续变化环境中的表现。
Method: 提出 OLE 框架，将控制经验建模为带版本和谱系的 Loop Policy 资产；在线模式基于持续运行反馈触发候选生成，离线模式从存档轨迹与失败证据中搜索候选策略；进化机制包含大语言模型自主提议、Champion–Challenger 配对评估和稳健发布，线上发布的策略在后续任务边界激活、受后续反馈监控，并在满足退化条件时回滚到父版本。
Result: 在模拟业务基准 YC-Bench 上，在线与离线两种进化模式相对固定初始 Loop Policy 均改善了聚合任务性能、任务成功率与风险指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为将 Loop Policy 作为可治理资产进行积累、比较、发布与复用，能够改进智能体在长时域复杂任务上的表现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CircuitReason-1k: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Visual-to-Symbolic Reasoning inElectrical Circuits
papers.abstract_en: Electrical circuit analysis requires more than recognizing components in an image. A solver must ground symbols and labels, recover latent topology, select a physical model, formulate coupled equations, propagate intermediate quantities, and preserve units, signs, directions, and phase conventions. We introduce \benchmark, a benchmark of 1,000 authentic textbook problems for evaluating this complete long-horizon visual-to-symbolic reasoning process. Each problem pairs one or more circuit diagrams with a self-contained question, a typed or semantically specified answer, and a reference worked solution. An evidence-first construction pipeline aligns questions, figures, and solutions, while a reasoning-oriented taxonomy organizes problems by circuit type and dependency depth. Evaluation combines conservative typed scoring with identity-blinded multi-model semantic consensus, retaining every problem in the denominator. Across three commercial chatbot systems and six open-source multimodal large language models, the highest-scoring system reaches 84.8\% accuracy. However, performance consistently deteriorates on long-horizon problems, and qualitative analysis exposes persistent failures in topology-to-target binding, physical conventions, and late-stage output propagation. \benchmark{} provides a focused testbed for measuring whether multimodal models can transform technical visual evidence into sustained, physically valid symbolic reasoning. Code are available at GitHub - CircuitReason/CircuitReason1K.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CircuitReason-1k，一个包含 1,000 道真实教科书电路题的基准，用于评估多模态模型从电路图到符号推理的完整长程过程，包括接地符号、恢复潜在拓扑、选择物理模型、建立耦合方程、传播中间量以及保持单位、符号、方向和相位约定。基准采用证据优先的构建流程和按电路类型与依赖深度组织的推理导向分类法，并用保守的带类型评分与身份盲化的多模型语义一致性评估。在三个商业聊天系统和六个开源多模态大语言模型上，最高分系统达 84.8% 准确率，但长程问题上性能持续下降。
Motivation: 电路分析不仅需要识别图像中的元件，还需要完成从视觉证据到物理有效符号推理的多步骤任务，而现有基准很少覆盖这一完整长程视觉到符号推理过程。
Method: 构建了 1,000 道自包含的教科书电路题，每题配有电路图、问题、类型化或语义化答案以及参考解答；采用证据优先的构建流程对齐问题、图形和解答，并用推理导向分类法按电路类型和依赖深度组织题目；评估结合保守的带类型评分与身份盲化的多模型语义共识，且所有题目均保留在分母中。
Result: 在三个商业聊天系统和六个开源多模态大语言模型上，最高分系统达到 84.8% 准确率；然而，性能在长程问题上持续恶化，定性分析揭示拓扑到目标绑定、物理约定和后期输出传播方面存在持续失败。
Conclusion: 该基准为衡量多模态模型能否将技术视觉证据转化为持续且物理有效的符号推理提供了聚焦的测试平台。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Preserve More Details: Mitigating Content Drift in Real-World Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR) aims to reconstruct high-quality (HQ) images from low-quality (LQ) inputs subject to diverse real-world degradations. Recent advances have leveraged the LQ inputs and natural image priors learned by Stable Diffusion models to achieve impressive results. However, existing methods often overlook insufficient clarity of LQ inputs inevitably induce content drift in the generated HQ images. This manifests primarily as visual detail degradation and textual semantic shift, severely compromising both fidelity and perceptual quality. To address this challenge, we propose FSP-Diff, a novel one-step diffusion model featuring a dual-pathway architecture. This architecture comprises a Detail-Conditioned Pathway for injecting structured details to recover fine structures, and a Detail-Modulated Semantic Pathway that refines semantic guidance using structured details to mitigate semantic deviations. Extensive experiments on standard Real-ISR benchmarks demonstrate that FSP-Diff surpasses existing one-step diffusion methods in both quantitative and qualitative metrics.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM MM 2026. This is the author's accepted version. The definitive version is published in the Proceedings of ACM MM 2026

Motivation: 现有 Real-ISR 方法利用 LQ 输入和 Stable Diffusion 学习到的自然图像先验取得了不错效果，但常忽视 LQ 输入清晰度不足必然引发生成 HQ 图像中的内容漂移，表现为视觉细节退化和文本语义偏移，严重损害保真度与感知质量。
Method: 提出 FSP-Diff，一种单步扩散模型，核心是双通路架构：Detail-Conditioned Pathway 负责注入结构化细节以恢复细结构，Detail-Modulated Semantic Pathway 则用结构化细节修正语义引导，从而减少语义偏差。

Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过双通路分别处理细节恢复与语义引导，可以有效缓解真实世界超分任务中的内容漂移问题。

papers.title: FeedbackTrack: Visual-Cortex-Inspired Cross-Frame Feedback for Transformer Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Visual object tracking requires effective temporal integration, yet most Transformer trackers still rely on predominantly feed-forward feature extraction. Existing temporal mechanisms typically update templates, prompts, queries, or prediction states, while intermediate representations are rarely reused to modulate corresponding processing stages. We propose \textbf{FeedbackTrack}, a visual-cortex-inspired framework that introduces sparse, group-level layer-aligned cross-frame feedback into pretrained Transformer trackers. Previous-frame intermediate states are detached, cached, and returned to corresponding Transformer groups in the current frame through two lightweight pathways: Query Feedback for token-level query modulation and Gate Feedback for context-dependent feature modulation. FeedbackTrack preserves the original tracking pipeline with only a fixed-size one-frame cache. Across SPMTrack and ARTrackV2, FeedbackTrack consistently improves five backbone configurations on LaSOT and GOT-10k, achieving 83.4 AO and 79.1 AUC with SPMTrack-G while adding less than 1\% parameters. Controlled comparisons show that cross-frame feedback outperforms same-frame modulation by 1.8--3.2 AO points, demonstrating that the gains mainly come from recurrent historical information. Further analysis reveals a non-uniform depth-dependent organization of learned feedback strengths, highlighting the effectiveness of recurrent feedback for Transformer tracking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FeedbackTrack，一种受视觉皮层启发的跨帧反馈框架，将稀疏、分组级、层对齐的跨帧反馈引入预训练 Transformer 跟踪器。前一帧的中间状态被分离、缓存并返回当前帧的对应 Transformer 组，通过查询反馈 (Query Feedback) 和门控反馈 (Gate Feedback) 两条轻量路径实现。在 SPMTrack 和 ARTrackV2 上，该方法一致提升五种骨干配置在 LaSOT 和 GOT-10k 上的性能，且新增参数少于 1%。
Motivation: 现有 Transformer 跟踪器主要依赖前馈特征提取，已有的时序机制通常只更新模板、提示、查询或预测状态，中间表示很少被复用来调节对应处理阶段，导致时间信息整合不足。
Method: 提出视觉皮层启发的 FeedbackTrack，将前一帧的中间状态分离、缓存并送回当前帧对应 Transformer 组，通过 Query Feedback 进行 token 级查询调制，通过 Gate Feedback 进行上下文相关特征调制，仅需固定大小的一帧缓存。
Result: 在 SPMTrack 和 ARTrackV2 上的一致改进覆盖五种骨干配置，SPMTrack-G 在 GOT-10k 上达 83.4 AO 和 79.1 AUC；跨帧反馈相比同帧调制提升 1.8–3.2 AO 点，说明收益主要来自循环历史信息；分析还显示学习到的反馈强度呈非均匀的深度相关组织。
Conclusion: 作者认为循环反馈对 Transformer 跟踪有效，且该方法保持原有跟踪流程、仅增加少量参数。

papers.title: Beyond Binary: Continuous State Optimization with Graph-Structured Objectives
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale learning systems often face the challenge of balancing multiple, potentially competing objectives, such as fairness, accuracy, and latency. While recent work has formalized this as an optimization problem over binary states, many real-world control parameters, such as fairness thresholds, diversity mixing rates, or resource budgets, are continuous. In this work, we extend the framework to \emph{continuous state spaces}. We model the problem as minimizing a sum of linear objectives subject to \emph{movement costs} that penalize system instability. We capture the local structure of the objectives using a \emph{dependency graph} (or factor graph), where each objective is determined by a subset of the state attributes. To address the tension between exploration and stability, we propose \emph{Lazy Graph-LinUCB}, an algorithm that performs lazy updates to minimize switching costs while maintaining near-optimal regret. Beyond stability, we introduce three advanced mechanisms to exploit the underlying graph structure: (1) an \emph{asynchronous} update schedule that eliminates synchronization overhead in sparse graphs; (2) an \emph{adaptive} algorithm that learns the graph structure from data; and (3) a \emph{joint estimator} that leverages data sharing among correlated objectives to significantly tighten regret bounds. Empirically, we demonstrate that these structural exploitations reduce movement costs by more than a factor of three in heterogeneous systems while maintaining similar cumulative losses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把多目标在线优化从二值状态推广到连续状态空间，目标是极小化一组线性目标之和，并用移动成本 (movement cost) 惩罚系统不稳定。作者用依赖图/因子图刻画目标对状态属性的局部依赖，提出 Lazy Graph-LinUCB 算法，以懒惰更新降低切换成本并保持近最优 regret，同时引入异步更新、自适应图结构学习与联合估计器三种结构利用机制。实验表明这些机制在异构系统中可将移动成本降低三倍以上，同时保持相近的累积损失。
Motivation: 现有工作将多目标权衡形式化为二值状态上的优化，但实际控制参数如公平阈值、多样性混合率或资源预算通常是连续的；同时系统稳定性要求限制状态频繁切换，因此需要处理连续状态空间与移动成本之间的权衡。
Method: 将问题建模为带移动成本约束的连续状态线性目标求和最小化，并用依赖图（因子图）表示各目标与部分状态属性之间的局部结构。在此基础上提出 Lazy Graph-LinUCB：通过懒惰更新在探索与稳定性之间取得平衡，并进一步设计三种结构利用机制，即异步更新调度、从数据自适应学习图结构、以及利用相关目标间数据共享的联合估计器。
Result: 摘要报告称，这些结构利用机制在异构系统中可将移动成本降低超过三倍，同时在累积损失上与对照方法保持相当。
Conclusion: 作者强调利用依赖图结构和懒惰更新可以在满足稳定性的同时维持近最优 regret，连续状态扩展适用于公平阈值、资源预算等实际连续控制参数场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Identifying the large-scale synoptic drivers contributing to the Kerala floods using multivariate feature-based analysis
papers.abstract_en: Parts of Kerala were hit by devastating floods three years in a row. This sequence was historically without precedent. This paper uses a multivariate object-based approach to examine the global forecasts of the Met Office Unified Model for the 2018, 2019 and 2020 monsoon seasons to identify and understand the large-scale synoptic drivers that led to the floods. Identifying similarities between synoptic drivers behind these flooding events was a key objective, as was understanding whether one could enhance predictability by using a multivariate approach for post-processing forecast output, using variables other than just precipitation, which is often inherently less predictable on its own. To this end event identification focused on the analyses first, and then on a day 5 forecast. The study found that the multivariate version of the Method for Object-based Diagnostic Evaluation (MvMODE) was able to successfully identify sequences of days in all three seasons corresponding to the event dates, which in combination, had flood-producing potential. This was achieved in both the analyses and in the 5-day forecasts, proving that a) the events share common synoptic drivers and b) there is inherent predictability which can be tapped into. The 5-day forecasts matched the analysed objects on each occasion, proving that the underlying large-scale drivers may be predictable into the medium-range. Based on the results, the paper proposes a conceptual synoptic pattern evolution which can help identify such events in future. The synoptic pattern has some similarities to atmospheric rivers in the mid-latitudes.
papers.comment: Met Office deliverable D4.1.2 for the Met Office Weather and Climate Science and Services Partnership India project (2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对喀拉拉邦2018、2019、2020年连续三年季风季洪水，使用Met Office Unified Model的全球预报，采用多变量基于对象的方法（MvMODE）识别并理解导致洪水的大尺度天气尺度驱动因素。研究发现MvMODE能够在分析和第5天预报中成功识别出三个季节中对应事件日期的日序列，证明这些事件共享共同的天气尺度驱动因素，且存在可挖掘的可预报性。基于结果提出一个概念性天气尺度型态演化，可用于未来识别此类事件，该型态与中纬度大气河有一定相似性。
Motivation: 喀拉拉邦连续三年遭受史无前例的洪水，需要识别这些洪水事件背后的大尺度天气尺度驱动因素的相似性；同时，仅依赖降水本身往往可预报性较差，需要探索使用降水以外变量的多变量后处理方法以增强可预报性。
Method: 采用多变量的基于对象的诊断评估方法（MvMODE），先对分析场进行事件识别，再对第5天预报场进行识别，以找出与事件日期对应的降水产生潜力的日序列。
Result: MvMODE在分析和5天预报中均成功识别出三个季风季中与事件日期对应的日序列，且5天预报目标与分析对象匹配，表明大尺度驱动因素在中期范围内具有可预报性。
Conclusion: 喀拉拉邦洪水事件共享共同的天气尺度驱动因素，并且这些驱动因素在中期预报中具有内在可预测性；提出的概念性天气尺度型态演化可支持未来此类事件的识别。
Relevance: 85

papers.title: Deep Learning based Detection of Fishing Vessels and Fishing Monitoring using Nightlight Images
papers.abstract_en: The demand for maritime surveillance has given rise to the need for monitoring fishing vessel activities, particularly in addressing the challenge of "dark vessels" that operate without Automatic Identification System (AIS) transmission. This study presents a novel approach for detecting small-scale fishing vessels using nighttime light (NTL) imagery from the SDGSAT-1 satellite, combined with deep learning techniques to enhance fishing monitoring awareness along the western coast of India. A dual-branch YOLO11 architecture was developed to exploit both the 10-meter panchromatic and 40-meter RGB imagery from SDGSAT-1. The custom model architecture was specifically optimized for small object detection in NTL imagery, featuring parallel convolutional backbones that process both modalities before concatenation for enhanced feature extraction. The dual-branch YOLO11 model demonstrated optimal performance with a precision of 0.99, recall of 0.93, F1-score of 0.96, and mAP@50 of 0.96, significantly outperforming single-branch implementations of YOLOv5s, YOLOv8s, and standard YOLO11s architectures. When applied to the western coast of India, the model detected 31525 vessel instances across the temporal dataset spanning 2022-23. Cross-matching analysis with AIS data revealed that only 7146 (22.7%) of detected vessels had corresponding AIS transmissions, while 24379 (77.3%) were identified as potential dark vessels. Spatio-temporal analysis showed peak fishing activity during January-April, with a primary activity corridor parallel to the coastline within 50-100 km, corresponding to productive continental shelf areas. This research contributes to maritime surveillance capabilities by highlighting the effectiveness of nighttime lights satellite imagery for fishing vessel detection and provides valuable insights into fishing patterns and potential regulatory compliance issues in Indian waters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用SDGSAT-1卫星夜间灯光（NTL）影像，结合深度学习检测印度西海岸的小型渔船，特别是未开启AIS的"暗船"（dark vessels）。作者提出一种双分支YOLO11架构，同时处理10米全色和40米RGB影像，针对NTL小目标检测进行优化。模型在检测任务上达到0.99精度、0.93召回率、0.96 F1-score和0.96 mAP@50，优于单分支YOLO变体；应用于2022-23年西印度海岸数据时检测到31525个船舶实例，其中77.3%被识别为潜在暗船。时空分析显示1-4月为捕鱼活动高峰，主要活动带位于离岸50-100公里的大陆架区域。
Motivation: 海上监视需求增加，特别是应对不通过AIS传输位置的"暗船"问题，现有方法难以有效监测小型渔船活动。
Method: 提出双分支YOLO11架构，使用并行卷积主干分别处理SDGSAT-1的10米全色和40米RGB夜间灯光影像，特征拼接后用于小目标检测；模型针对NTL影像中的小目标检测进行了专门优化。
Result: 双分支YOLO11在检测中达到precision 0.99、recall 0.93、F1-score 0.96、mAP@50 0.96，显著优于单分支YOLOv5s、YOLOv8s和标准YOLO11s；在印度西海岸2022-23年数据中检测到31525个船舶实例，其中仅7146个（22.7%）有对应AIS记录，24379个（77.3%）被识别为潜在暗船。

papers.title: ControlRadio: Prompt-Driven Controllable Diffusion for Cross-Modal Radio Map Generation
papers.abstract_en: Radio maps describe how wireless signals propagate across space and are essential for wireless communication, sensing, and network planning. However, constructing accurate radio maps traditionally requires either dense measurements or computationally expensive physical simulations, which limits scalability and real-time deployment. Recent advances in generative artificial intelligence offer a promising alternative, but existing approaches lack fine-grained control and physical consistency when applied to real-world wireless environments. Here we present \textbf{ControlRadio}, a controllable generative framework that produces radio maps from natural-language descriptions and environmental layouts, including building structures and transmitter locations. Joint semantic and spatial conditioning enables interpretable, propagation-plausible generation, while a controlled latent prior and layout-aware conditioning improve stability and structural consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ControlRadio achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and strong generalization across diverse urban scenarios, while reducing computation time by more than four orders of magnitude compared with conventional simulation-based methods. Such results suggest a new paradigm for scalable and controllable wireless environment modeling, with broad implications for next-generation communication systems and data-driven radio sensing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ControlRadio，一个基于扩散模型的可控生成框架，用于从自然语言描述和环境布局（包括建筑结构与发射机位置）生成无线电台图 (radio map)。通过联合语义与空间条件实现可解释且符合传播规律 (propagation-plausible) 的生成，受控潜在先验 (controlled latent prior) 与布局感知条件 (layout-aware conditioning) 用于提升稳定性与结构一致性。实验表明其在多种城市场景下达到最先进精度，计算时间较传统基于仿真的方法减少超过四个数量级。
Motivation: 精确构建无线电台图传统上依赖密集测量或高成本物理仿真，限制了可扩展性和实时部署；现有生成式模型缺乏对真实无线环境进行细粒度控制和物理一致性生成的能力。
Method: 提出可控生成框架 ControlRadio，包含联合语义与空间条件建模、受控潜在先验以及布局感知条件，使模型能够依据语言描述和布局输入生成结构一致的电台图。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多样城市场景下取得最先进精度并具备强泛化能力，同时计算时间比传统仿真方法降低超过四个数量级。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该工作为可扩展、可控的无线环境建模提供了新范式，对下一代通信系统和数据驱动的无线感知具有广泛意义。

papers.title: Alpha as an Efficiency Signal: Visibility-Routed RGBA Image-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: RGBA videos combine RGB appearance with an alpha channel, enabling animated assets to be applied across arbitrary backgrounds, which are heavily used in gaming industry. However, generating high-quality RGBA animations for games remains challenging for two reasons. First, most existing RGBA video datasets are dominated by photorealistic content, with limited coverage of game assets. Second, the traditional generate-then-matte pipelines estimate alpha only after RGB synthesis, so semi-transparent regions are often blurred by background, resulting in unstable matting outputs. More recently, many methods have begun to model RGB and alpha jointly, but existing approaches are mostly text-conditioned, and still have unresolved issues in efficiency and quality. To address these challenges, we introduce GameAlpha-2.4K, a 2.4K-clip game-style RGBA video dataset built with matte-friendly synthesis, multi-hypothesis alpha recovery, and compositing-based quality gates. Using this dataset, we train a reference-conditioned RGBA video generator that jointly produces RGB frames and alpha mattes in a single pass. To improve efficiency, we propose a visibility router that identifies transparent tokens in an early stage and bypasses their later DiT updates, while x_0-lock guides them along the original flow-matching schedule toward self-predicted endpoints. Our model obtains lower FVD than traditional two-stage pipelines, and the visibility router skips 35% of token evaluations in the final two DiT denoising steps, providing a 1.2x backbone speedup with negligible quality degradation compared to dense inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向游戏行业 RGBA 视频生成，指出现有数据集以写实内容为主、generate-then-matte 管线在半透明区域易得到不稳定抠像结果。作者构建了 2.4K 规模的游戏风格 RGBA 视频数据集 GameAlpha-2.4K，并训练了一个参考条件 (reference-conditioned) 的 RGBA 视频生成器，在单次前向中联合生成 RGB 帧与 alpha 通道。为提升效率，提出 visibility router 在早期识别透明 token 并跳过其后续 DiT 更新，配合 x_0-lock 引导它们沿原始 flow-matching 调度走向自预测端点；摘要报告该方法相比传统两阶段管线获得更低 FVD，并在最后两步 DiT 去噪中跳过 35% 的 token 计算。
Motivation: 高质量游戏 RGBA 动画生成存在两个主要障碍：现有 RGBA 视频数据集以写实内容为主、游戏资产覆盖不足；传统先生成后抠像的管线在 RGB 合成后才估计 alpha，半透明区域易被背景模糊而导致不稳定的 matting 输出。现有联合建模 RGB 与 alpha 的方法多为文本条件驱动，且在效率与质量上仍有未解决的问题。
Method: 提出 GameAlpha-2.4K 数据集，通过 matte-friendly 合成、多假设 alpha 恢复和基于合成的质量门控 (compositing-based quality gates) 构建。基于该数据集训练参考条件 RGBA 视频生成器，单次前向联合输出 RGB 帧和 alpha matte；效率上引入 visibility router 提前识别透明 token 并跳过其后期 DiT 更新，并用 x_0-lock 使这些 token 沿原始 flow-matching 调度奔向自预测端点。
Result: 摘要报告该模型相比传统两阶段管线获得更低的 FVD；visibility router 在最后两个 DiT 去噪步骤中跳过 35% 的 token 评估，与密集推理相比带来 1.2 倍 backbone 加速且质量下降可忽略。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过专用游戏风格数据集与联合单遍生成、早期透明 token 路由，可以同时改善 RGBA 视频生成的效率与质量。

papers.title: Test-Time Augmentation for LLMs: When Input Diversity Beats Output Diversity at Matched Compute
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling improves LLM accuracy but multiplies inference cost, making the accuracy gained per unit of compute the metric that matters in deployment. Self-consistency is one of the established approaches, which spends this budget entirely on the output side by sampling repeated reasoning paths. We study Test-Time Augmentation (TTA), which extends self-consistency by also perturbing the input, aggregating predictions across transformed versions of the input, and ask whether input-side diversity converts compute into accuracy more efficiently than output-side diversity. We perform a systematic, matched-compute comparison: we evaluate three simple input-side strategies (semantic rephrasing, lexical perturbations, and visual transformations) across six datasets covering general and multilingual knowledge, mathematical reasoning, multi-modal question answering, and sentiment classification, against chain-of-thought prompting and self-consistency. Semantic rephrasing delivers consistent and statistically significant accuracy gains while Pareto-dominating self-consistency on cost-effectiveness, delivering roughly 1.8X more accuracy per dollar and outperforming it on five of six tasks. We further analyze the number of augmentations, multi-modal strategies, and base model scaling, finding that TTA is most cost-effective for mid-tier models where a stronger model is unavailable or too expensive. Our findings indicate that for current mid-tier LLMs, varying the input converts inference compute into accuracy more efficiently than varying the reasoning path alone. The TTA implementation is available at https://github.com/aws-samples/sample-genai-reflection-for-bedrock.
papers.comment: Published at the COLM 2026 Workshop on Efficient Reasoning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究测试时增强 (Test-Time Augmentation, TTA) 在 LLM 推理中的应用，将其与自一致性 (self-consistency) 做匹配计算量的系统比较。作者在六个数据集上对比三种输入侧策略（语义改写、词法扰动、视觉变换）与链式思维提示和自一致性，发现语义改写带来一致且统计显著的准确率提升，其成本效益帕累托支配自一致性，约 1.8 倍的单位美元准确率。
Motivation: 测试时扩展能提升 LLM 准确率但成倍增加推理成本，部署中真正重要的指标是单位计算量换取的准确率；现有自一致性把预算全部花在输出侧，只采样多条推理路径，作者想验证输入侧多样性是否能更高效地把计算转化为准确率。
Method: 提出 TTA 方法，在推理时扰动输入并在多个变换版本上聚合预测；系统性地在匹配计算量条件下比较语义改写、词法扰动和视觉变换三种策略，并进一步分析增强数量、多模态策略以及基座模型规模的影响。
Result: 语义改写带来一致且统计显著的准确率提升，在成本效益上帕累托支配自一致性，约 1.8 倍每美元准确率，并在六个任务中的五个上优于自一致性；TTA 对中档模型 (mid-tier models) 最划算，尤其是当更强模型不可得或价格过高时。
Conclusion: 对当前中档 LLM 而言，改变输入比仅改变推理路径更能高效地把推理计算转化为准确率；TTA 实现已开源。

papers.title: A Machine Learning Based Search for Lunar Anomalies
papers.abstract_en: The Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) has been collecting high-resolution images (at around 0.5-2 meters per pixel linearly with its Narrow Angle Camera) of the Moon since 2009, amassing a large dataset of images and offering researchers the opportunity to study the surface of the Moon at unprecedented scale. Here, we aim to test the abilities of the Beta-Variational Autoencoder (VAE) created by Lesnikowski et al. (2024), an unsupervised learning model which identifies anomalous features across the Moon's surface, locating not only scientifically useful geologic formations such as rockfall deposits, fresh impact craters, irregular mare patches, or volcanic pits/collapsed lava tubes, but also artificial objects such as landed spacecraft. This investigation further gauged the model's ability to locate anomalous surface features, successfully recovering two places of interest (Plaskett Crater and Paracelsus C Crater) and numerous landed technological assets at a statistically significant rate.
papers.comment: 5 pages. Submitted to Proceedings of IAU Symposium 404: Advancing the Search for Technosignatures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文测试了 Lesnikowski 等人（2024）提出的 Beta-变分自编码器（Beta-VAE）无监督模型，用于在月球勘测轨道飞行器（LRO）窄角相机（Narrow Angle Camera）自 2009 年以来积累的高分辨率月球图像中识别异常特征，包括岩崩沉积、新鲜撞击坑、不规则月海斑块、火山坑/塌陷熔岩管等地质构造，以及着陆航天器等人造物体。该模型以统计显著的水平成功恢复了两个感兴趣地点（Plaskett Crater 和 Paracelsus C Crater）以及多个已着陆的技术资产。
Motivation: LRO 自 2009 年起积累了大量高分辨率月球表面图像，规模空前，需要自动化方法在大数据中高效定位异常表面特征，从而为地质研究和技术特征搜索（technosignatures）提供支持。
Method: 采用 Lesnikowski 等人（2024）创建的 Beta-变分自编码器（Beta-VAE）这一无监督学习模型，对月球表面图像中的异常特征进行检测，并评估其恢复感兴趣地点与人工技术资产的能力。
Result: 摘要报告该模型以统计显著的成功率恢复了两个感兴趣地点（Plaskett Crater 和 Paracelsus C Crater），并定位了众多已着陆的技术资产。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了无监督机器学习模型在月球表面异常检测中的实用性，尤其在与技术特征搜索相关的场景下具有应用潜力。

papers.title: In-Context Density Estimation for Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Density estimation underlies many unsupervised tasks on tabular data such as anomaly detection, out-of-distribution detection, and data augmentation. Although all these problems reduce to questions about where probability mass lies, they are typically solved individually by fitting a separate model to each dataset, with its own hyperparameters and tuning budget. We introduce ICED, an in-context, energy-based density estimator that removes this per-dataset cost. ICED is a transformer-based model pretrained once on a synthetic prior built specifically for density estimation under an objective that fits log-density where it is informative and preserves its ordering elsewhere. In the inference, it reads a dataset as context and returns an unnormalized log-density for any query point in a single forward pass, with no fitting, sampling, or hyperparameter selection. A single frozen ICED model then drives four tasks usually handled by four specialized pipelines: density estimation, out-of-distribution detection, unsupervised anomaly detection, and generative augmentation. papers.title: One-Time Training for All Grains: Open-Set Grain Recognition and Quantitative Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Advances in crop breeding have introduced an increasing number of grain varieties, creating a growing demand for efficient variety recognition and quantitative analysis. However, existing methods are typically trained on a fixed variety set, and incorporating newly introduced varieties requires additional data collection and model retraining. To address this limitation, we propose GROW, a framework for Grain Recognition and quantitative analysis in Open sets Without retraining. GROW first performs class-agnostic grain localization, converting mixed-grain images into individual instances for variety-wise counting and phenotypic measurement. It then combines visual embeddings and morphological descriptors into fused grain descriptors stored in an extensible GrainBank. Query grains are recognized through rank-similarity weighted top-k retrieval, and newly introduced varieties are incorporated by appending their descriptors without updating the deployed models. Extensive experiments under progressive variety expansion, varying grain densities, and background domain shifts demonstrate the scalability, robustness, and adaptability of GROW. Compared with joint retraining, GROW reduced the average category-registration time from 4153 s to only 39 s while maintaining competitive recognition performance. These results demonstrate that GROW provides an efficient and maintainable solution for extensible grain recognition, counting, and phenotypic analysis without repeated model retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GROW 框架，用于开放集谷物识别与定量分析，无需重新训练即可纳入新谷物品种。GROW 先做类别无关的谷物定位，将混合图像转为单个实例，再融合视觉嵌入与形态描述符存入可扩展的 GrainBank，通过 rank-similarity 加权的 top-k 检索识别查询谷物。实验表明在品种逐步扩展、密度变化和背景域偏移下具有良好的规模性、鲁棒性与适应性，平均类别注册时间从联合重训练的 4153 秒降至 39 秒。
Motivation: 现有谷物识别方法在固定品种集上训练，引入新品种需要额外数据采集和模型重训练，难以适应作物育种中品种不断增加的需求。
Method: GROW 分为两阶段：先进行类别无关的谷物定位，将混合图像转换为单个实例用于计数和表型测量；然后将视觉嵌入与形态描述符组合为融合谷物描述符存入可扩展的 GrainBank，查询时通过 rank-similarity 加权的 top-k 检索识别，新品种只需追加描述符而无需更新部署模型。
Result: 在品种逐步扩展、谷物密度变化和背景域偏移等实验条件下验证了扩展性、鲁棒性和适应性；与联合重训练相比，平均类别注册时间从 4153 秒降至 39 秒，同时保持有竞争力的识别性能。
Conclusion: GROW 为可扩展的谷物识别、计数和表型分析提供了一种高效且可维护的解决方案，避免重复模型重训练。

papers.title: Beyond Global Editing: Per-Instance Disentangled Subspaces for Training-Free Hallucination Mitigation in LVLMs
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) have enabled powerful multimodal reasoning by integrating visual encoders with large language models (LLMs). However, their reliability is frequently undermined by hallucinations, where generated text inaccurately describes the visual input. Although fine-tuning can mitigate this problem, it is computationally expensive and requires large, curated datasets, making training-free alternatives attractive. Among these, model editing is more promising than decoding-based approaches: decoding methods adapt outputs per input but introduce computational overhead and instability, whereas model editing modifies internal representations offline, providing a more efficient and stable solution. However, existing model-editing techniques typically rely on a single global subspace to correct hallucinations, treating all test samples identically and failing to capture diverse hallucination modes across inputs. To address this limitation, we propose a training-free hallucination mitigation framework for dynamic, per-instance suppression at test time. Our method first constructs a set of Disentangled Hallucination Subspaces, each isolating a distinct hallucination mode. During inference, the model adaptively calculates weights reflecting each input's relationship to these subspaces, guiding a dynamically combined projection that selectively suppresses the most probable hallucination directions while preserving image-grounded semantics. Extensive experiments across multiple vision-language benchmarks and LVLM families demonstrate consistent improvements, highlighting the robustness, generalizability, and efficiency of our approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种训练无关的视觉语言模型幻觉缓解框架，针对现有模型编辑方法依赖单一全局子空间、无法刻画不同输入间多样幻觉模式的问题。方法先构建一组解耦幻觉子空间 (Disentangled Hallucination Subspaces)，推理时根据输入与各子空间的关系自适应计算权重，动态组合投影以抑制最可能的幻觉方向，同时保留图像语义。摘要报告在多个视觉-语言基准和 LVLM 家族上取得一致性改进。
Motivation: LVLM 的生成文本常与视觉输入不符，微调缓解幻觉虽有效但计算昂贵且依赖大规模精选数据；解码式方法逐输入调整带来额外开销和稳定性问题，模型编辑更高效稳定。但现有编辑方法通常用单一全局子空间处理所有测试样本，无法覆盖不同的幻觉模式。
Method: 提出一个训练无关的测试时动态按实例抑制框架：首先构造一组解耦幻觉子空间，每个子空间隔离一种幻觉模式；推理时模型自适应计算反映输入与各子空间关系的权重，据此形成动态组合投影，选择性抑制最可能的幻觉方向并保留图像语义。
Result: 在多个视觉-语言基准和多个 LVLM 家族上的大量实验显示一致性改进，摘要将其归因于框架的鲁棒性、泛化性和效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调相比单一全局子空间的模型编辑，动态、逐实例的解耦子空间组合能更有效地缓解 LVLM 幻觉，同时保持训练无关、高效且可泛化。

papers.title: LLM-Guided Heuristic Design from Simulation Traces: A Case Study in Dynamic Production and AGV Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Simulation-based optimization (SBO) evaluates executable policies under stochastic dynamics, but most methods treat the simulator as a black box: aggregate scores rank candidates without revealing why they fail or which policy logic should change. We present an LLM-guided heuristic design framework that uses repeated simulation for selection and event-level traces for diagnosis. Each incumbent is assessed through multiple replications, while replaying its lowest-scoring one produces a queryable trace. A manager agent formulates bottleneck hypotheses from this evidence, and editing agents implement parallel code-level revisions. After execution checks and repeated evaluation, best-so-far selection retains only improvements. LLM revision occurs between evaluation batches, while a fixed policy controls each simulation run. We evaluate the framework in a discrete-event simulation of dynamic production and automated guided vehicle (AGV) scheduling. Across five independent optimization runs with Gemini-3.1-Pro, final mean scores averaged 77.51 on the simulator's 0-100 scale. In the highest-scoring run, trace-based diagnoses motivated proactive charging, distance-aware AGV assignment, and rebalanced dispatch priorities, raising the best-so-far mean score from 62.49 to 78.61. On 100 matched seeds, the best final policy outscored representative rolling-MILP, rule-based, and metaheuristic policies on every seed and retained its advantage under random faults without re-optimization. After separate re-optimization for a longer horizon and variable order interarrival times, the resulting policies again outscored all baselines. Ablations with two LLM backbones showed that removing either parallel candidate generation or trace-database access reduced final mean scores. These results show that simulation traces can guide targeted code-level policy improvement in complex simulation-based scheduling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个由 LLM 引导的启发式设计框架，用于基于仿真的动态生产与 AGV 调度优化。与把仿真器当黑箱的传统做法不同，该框架通过多次仿真复现评估当前策略，并用最低得分轨迹生成可查询的 trace，由管理智能体提出瓶颈假设、编辑智能体并行修改代码级策略。在 Gemini-3.1-Pro 下，五次独立优化运行的平均最终得分为 77.51（0-100 尺度），最高单次运行将 best-so-far 均值从 62.49 提升到 78.61；在 100 个匹配随机种子上，最佳最终策略在每个种子上都优于 rolling-MILP、规则型和元启发式基线。
Motivation: 基于仿真的优化 (SBO) 虽然能在随机动态下评估可执行策略，但多数方法把仿真器当作黑箱，只给出聚合分数，无法解释候选策略为何失败或应修改哪部分策略逻辑。
Method: 提出 LLM 引导的启发式设计框架：对每个 incumbent 进行多次仿真复现评估，回放得分最低的一次以生成可查询的 event-level trace；管理智能体据此形成瓶颈假设，编辑智能体实施并行的代码级修改，在执行检查和重复评估后通过 best-so-far 选择只保留改进。LLM 修订发生在评估批次之间，而每次仿真运行由固定策略控制。
Result: 在动态生产与 AGV 调度的离散事件仿真中，Gemini-3.1-Pro 下五次独立运行的平均最终得分为 77.51；最高运行中，基于 trace 的诊断促成了主动充电、考虑距离的 AGV 分配和重新均衡的调度优先级，使 best-so-far 均值从 62.49 提高到 78.61。在 100 个匹配种子上，最终最佳策略在每个种子上都超过 rolling-MILP、规则型和元启发式基线，且在随机故障下无需重新优化仍保持优势；针对更长视界和可变订单到达间隔重新优化后仍优于所有基线。消融显示，去掉并行候选生成或 trace-database 访问都会降低最终平均得分。
Conclusion: 作者认为仿真 trace 能够指导复杂仿真调度场景中针对性的代码级策略改进，并强调并行候选生成与 trace 数据库访问在框架中的必要性。

papers.title: Revisiting the Current Frame: Physical-Trace-Guided Network Output Correction for Video Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Video restoration methods exploit temporal information to recover information missing from degraded observations. However, reference frames within the sequence may introduce inconsistent degradation, content discrepancy, or reconstruction errors due to physical image-formation variations, occlusion, and imperfect temporal aggregation. Existing approaches mainly focus on improving restoration networks, while the reliability of the generated outputs at different spatial locations remains largely unexplored. In this work, we propose ANCHOR, a model-agnostic framework that revisits the low-quality current frame as a temporally aligned anchor for video restoration correction. Specifically, ANCHOR estimates a spatial trust field from heterogeneous physical-trace evidence and adaptively balances the restoration proposal with the original observation. Experiments on High Dynamic Range video reconstruction and video deraining demonstrate consistent improvements across various state-of-the-art restoration models, validating the effectiveness of reliability-aware output correction for video restoration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ANCHOR，一个模型无关 (model-agnostic) 的视频恢复输出校正框架。核心思路是重新审视低质量的当前帧，将其作为时间对齐的锚点，从异构物理痕迹证据中估计空间信任场 (spatial trust field)，并自适应地平衡恢复网络输出与原始观测。实验在 HDR 视频重建和视频去雨任务上报告了相对多种 SOTA 恢复模型的一致性提升。
Motivation: 现有视频恢复方法主要依赖改进网络结构或时序聚合，但参考帧可能因物理成像变化、遮挡或时序聚合不完善而引入不一致退化、内容差异或重建误差；生成输出在不同空间位置的可靠性很少被显式建模，缺乏对不可靠恢复区域的校正机制。
Method: ANCHOR 将当前低质量帧作为时间对齐的锚点，从多种物理痕迹证据中估计逐空间位置的信任度，并用该信任场在恢复提议 (restoration proposal) 与原始观测之间进行自适应加权，从而校正网络输出。该框架是模型无关的，可叠加在已有视频恢复模型之上。
Result: 摘要报告在 HDR 视频重建和视频去雨两个任务上，ANCHOR 对多种现有的 SOTA 视频恢复模型均带来一致的性能提升，验证了可靠性感知输出校正的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为对恢复结果进行基于物理痕迹的可靠性感知校正，而非仅改进网络本身，是提升视频恢复质量的可行方向。摘要未讨论方法在更广退化类型上的适用范围或失败情形。

papers.title: Control-Oriented Scenario Tree Construction through Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multistage stochastic model predictive control (MPC) handles uncertainty by optimizing over a scenario tree, a finite branching approximation of future outcomes constructed from sampled forecasts. To build such a tree, conventional methods focus on matching the underlying probability distribution---e.g., via Wasserstein-based scenario reduction---but improved distributional accuracy does not necessarily yield better control performance. We propose a control-oriented approach that learns scenario tree construction directly from its impact on downstream decisions. Fixing the tree topology, we formulate tree construction as a sequential assignment of sampled scenarios to leaves. This assignment is parameterized by an attention-based policy over the scenario set and trained using reinforcement learning, with closed-loop control profit as the objective. Training is stabilized by an asymmetric critic that leverages realized future trajectories. We evaluate the method on a risk-averse battery arbitrage problem. Across a range of forecast set sizes, the learned construction consistently achieves the highest profit, outperforming classical forward and backward reduction methods and certainty-equivalent (single-trajectory forecast) control. The learned policy also exhibits greater robustness on challenging instances, consistently demonstrating better tail-risk characteristics. Analysis of the resulting trees indicates that our method constructs compact, selectively branching structures that capture high-impact events while keeping most trajectories nearly deterministic. These findings highlight that the value of a scenario tree depends critically on the decisions it supports, and provide an effective framework to train scenario tree constructors merely based on the closed-loop control optimization signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向控制性能的场景树构建方法：在多阶段随机模型预测控制 (MPC) 中，不再以匹配预测分布为目标，而是直接用强化学习 (RL) 学习如何将采样场景分配到树的叶子节点。固定树拓扑后，作者用基于注意力 (attention) 的策略参数化该分配，并以闭环控制利润为训练目标；在风险规避的电池套利问题上，该方法在多种预测集规模下均取得最高利润，优于经典前向/后向缩减方法和确定性等价控制。
Motivation: 传统场景树构建方法（如基于 Wasserstein 的场景缩减）侧重于匹配底层概率分布，但分布精度提高并不必然带来更好的控制性能；本文瞄准这一差距，提出直接根据场景树对下游决策的影响来学习构建。
Method: 固定树拓扑，将场景树构建建模为对采样场景到叶子节点的顺序分配；该分配由基于注意力的策略参数化，并使用强化学习训练，目标函数为闭环控制利润；训练中引入利用实际未来轨迹的非对称 critic (asymmetric critic) 来稳定优化。
Result: 在风险规避的电池套利问题上，跨多种预测集规模，学习到的构建方法均获得最高利润，优于经典前向和后向缩减方法以及单轨迹确定性等价控制；在困难实例上展现出更稳健的尾部风险 (tail-risk) 特征，生成的树结构紧凑且有选择性分支，能捕捉高影响事件同时保持大部分轨迹近乎确定性。
Conclusion: 作者强调场景树的价值关键取决于它所支撑的决策，并展示了仅基于闭环控制优化信号即可有效训练场景树构建器的框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hallucinations and Constraints : Regulating surgical workflow recognition beyond accuracy
papers.abstract_en: Hallucinations are a major concern for the integration of artificial intelligence into medicine, although less explored in the realm of medical image processing. Unlike problems in natural text understanding and reasoning therewith, determining whether or not predictions derived from biomedical images and signals is less intuitively clear. This article suggests that topological errors could constitute hallucinations in a way that can be more readily measured and thus regulated. Certain of these properties for certain types of problems, such as biomedical signal segmentation, can be rephrased as linear temporal logic predicates, a number of which can be explicitly enforced using probabilistic graphical models. Our simulations show the potential of these explicitly constrained predicates for the case of automatic surgical phase recognition in robot-assisted hysterectomy, improving accuracy by approximately 10% while removing the vast majority of topological errors, suggesting that mathematical guarantees of correctness can supplement other empirical forms of regulating machine learning in medical image computing and computer-assisted interventions.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 1 table, accepted to the MICCAI 2026 Workshop on Fairness, Regulation, and Ethics (FAIMI-BRIDGE-EPIMI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将医学图像计算中的幻觉问题与拓扑错误联系起来，认为拓扑错误可以作为一种可测量、可监管的幻觉形式。作者指出某些生物医学信号分割问题可被改写为线性时序逻辑（LTL）谓词，并可用概率图模型显式约束。模拟实验表明，在机器人辅助子宫切除术的自动手术阶段识别中，该方法将准确率提高约10%，并消除了绝大多数拓扑错误。
Motivation: 幻觉是AI进入医学的主要担忧，但在医学图像处理领域研究较少；与自然文本理解不同，判断生物医学图像和信号预测是否正确并不直观，需要一种可测量、可监管的幻觉定义。
Method: 建议将拓扑错误视为幻觉，并将某些生物医学信号分割问题的性质改写为线性时序逻辑（linear temporal logic）谓词，再通过概率图模型（probabilistic graphical models）对这些谓词进行显式约束。
Result: 模拟结果显示，在机器人辅助子宫切除术的自动手术阶段识别中，显式约束的谓词使准确率提升约10%，并去除了绝大多数拓扑错误。
Conclusion: 作者认为数学上的正确性保证可以补充医学图像计算和计算机辅助干预中机器学习经验性监管的其他形式。

papers.title: RAG-Audio: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Faithful Brain-to-Audio Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Brain-to-audio reconstruction is limited by \emph{prior domination}: when a pretrained generator is conditioned on a weak neural signal, it produces realistic but stimulus-inaccurate audio. We introduce RAG-Audio, which decodes fMRI into a semantic audio embedding, retrieves a matching real-audio exemplar, and initializes the frozen generator's sampling trajectory from that exemplar while retaining the decoded embedding as conditioning. On Brain2Music, RAG-Audio improves 10-way stimulus identification from $0.14$--$0.18$ for direct generation, near the $0.10$ chance level, to $0.40$--$0.43$, comparable to retrieval. It also reduces Fréchet Audio Distance by roughly an order of magnitude, from $13.49$ to $1.25$ for AudioLDM. RAG-Audio approaches nearest-neighbor retrieval in identification while remaining generative; its higher FAD is expected because retrieval directly replays real audio. An autoregressive negative control, which lacks an initializable latent trajectory, shows no comparable gain, attributing the improvement to trajectory initialization. These results suggest that retrieval-guided initialization can mitigate prior domination in brain-to-audio generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RAG-Audio，一种用于脑到音频重建的检索增强生成方法，旨在缓解先验主导 (prior domination) 问题——即弱神经信号条件下预训练生成器输出逼真但刺激不准确的音频。该方法将 fMRI 解码为语义音频嵌入，检索匹配的真实音频样例，并用该样例初始化冻结生成器的采样轨迹，同时保留解码嵌入作为条件。在 Brain2Music 上，RAG-Audio 将 10 路刺激识别率从直接生成的 0.14–0.18（接近 0.10 的随机水平）提升到 0.40–0.43，接近纯检索水平；同时将 Fréchet Audio Distance（AudioLDM）从 13.49 降至 1.25。
Motivation: 脑到音频重建受限于先验主导：当预训练生成器以弱神经信号为条件时，会生成真实但刺激不准确的音频，现有直接生成方法在刺激识别任务上几乎接近随机水平。
Method: RAG-Audio 先把 fMRI 解码成语义音频嵌入，再从数据集中检索匹配的真实音频样例，用该样例初始化冻结生成器的采样轨迹，并在采样过程中保留解码嵌入作为条件。作者还设计了缺乏可初始化潜变量轨迹的自回归负对照实验来检验轨迹初始化的作用。
Result: 在 Brain2Music 上，10 路刺激识别率从直接生成的 0.14–0.18 提升到 0.40–0.43，接近最近邻检索；AudioLDM 的 FAD 从 13.49 降至 1.25，约降低一个数量级。自回归负对照未出现可比增益，说明改进来自轨迹初始化。
Conclusion: 作者认为检索引导的初始化能够缓解脑到音频生成中的先验主导问题；RAG-Audio 在保持生成性的同时接近检索的识别性能，其较高的 FAD 在预期之内，因为检索直接回放真实音频。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MaxModShift: Model Privacy via Designed Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Model learning by an eavesdropper is treated as an estimation problem in a federated environment. The Fisher Information Matrix for the eavesdropper's estimation problem is driven to singularity through a signaling design; this ensures that the eavesdropper cannot learn the model. Herein, the innovation of prior designs is that model shifts are designed to maximize the difference in the model learned by Eve and the central server while satisfying a transmission power constraint for the agents. Two shift schemes are provided. MaxModShift outperforms a prior ModShift design while requiring lesser transmission power. Compared to a noise injection scheme, MaxModShift performs better while requiring a lower bandwidth secret channel and a reduced average power consumption.
papers.comment: To appear in the 2026 Asilomar Conference on Signals, Systems and Computers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在联邦学习场景下将窃听者的模型学习问题建模为估计问题，通过信号设计将窃听者估计问题的 Fisher 信息矩阵推向奇异，使其无法学习模型。区别于先前设计的创新点在于：模型移位 (model shifts) 的设计目标是最大化 Eve 与中央服务器所学模型之间的差异，同时满足各智能体的传输功率约束。论文给出两种移位方案，并称 MaxModShift 优于先前的 ModShift 设计且所需传输功率更低；与噪声注入方案相比，MaxModShift 性能更好且所需保密信道带宽更低、平均功耗更低。
Motivation: 在联邦环境中，窃听者可能通过观测代理传输的更新来学习全局模型，现有防护手段（如噪声注入、ModShift）在带宽或功率上有较大代价，需要更高效的模型隐私保护机制。
Method: 将窃听者的模型学习问题形式化为估计问题，并设计模型移位信号，使得窃听者估计问题的 Fisher 信息矩阵趋于奇异；移位方案在最大化 Eve 与服务器所学模型差异的同时，满足代理的传输功率约束，提供了两种具体移位方案。
Result: 摘要报告 MaxModShift 在性能上优于先前 ModShift 设计，并且所需传输功率更低；与噪声注入方案相比，MaxModShift 在更低保密信道带宽和更低平均功耗下取得更好性能。
Conclusion: 本文表明，通过面向 Fisher 信息奇异的模型移位设计，可以在较低通信代价下有效阻止联邦环境中的窃听者学习模型。

summary_sections.method: 将窃听者的模型学习问题形式化为估计问题，并设计模型移位信号，使得窃听者估计问题的 Fisher 信息矩阵趋于奇异；移位方案在最大化 Eve 与服务器所学模型差异的同时，满足代理的传输功率约束，提供了两种具体移位方案。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 MaxModShift 在性能上优于先前 ModShift 设计，并且所需传输功率更低；与噪声注入方案相比，MaxModShift 在更低保密信道带宽和更低平均功耗下取得更好性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文表明，通过面向 Fisher 信息奇异的模型移位设计，可以在较低通信代价下有效阻止联邦环境中的窃听者学习模型。

papers.title: GeoPhysAdapter: Scale-Matched Geophysical Adaptation for Cross-Domain Landslide Mapping with Vision Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Newly triggered landslides rarely carry immediate annotations, so cross-domain transferability determines the value of landslide mapping for emergency response and regional risk assessment. Vision foundation models have strengthened representational transfer, yet on unseen regions, events, and data sources they still generate high-confidence false alarms. Terrain, material, and rainfall triggering can constrain such errors, but their supports are local, regional, and event-scale, so that resampling onto a 10~m grid misaligns them with the segmentation decision unit and compounds the uncertain geographic context problem (UGCoP). We propose GeoPhysAdapter, which anchors on a frozen vision foundation model, restricts terrain, material, and triggering to dense spatial guidance, regional modulation, and event-timing forcing, and applies bounded adaptation at two decision units, the pixel and the candidate landslide body, reverting exactly to the visual prediction where support is insufficient. On an event-isolated PILD dataset of four public sources, 55 global landslide events, and 7,890 test samples, 70.3% of cross-domain false-positive mass lies in near-pure spurious bodies of median equivalent diameter 207m, matching coarse-prior support rather than the pixel. Pixel-level adaptation removes a net 507,817 erroneous pixels and reduces error by 7.76%, whereas raising the decision unit to the candidate body, under identical samples, anchor, and baseline, increases error reduction to 23.99%, approximately 3.1 times the pixel-level effect, improves IoU by 0.031 (14.2% relative), and corrects 9.92 pixels per pixel harmed. The data and code are publicly available at: https://github.com/Liu-Zhihang/geophysadapter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoPhysAdapter，一种基于冻结视觉基础模型 (vision foundation model) 的跨域滑坡测绘适应方法。它针对新触发滑坡缺乏即时标注的问题，将地形、物质和降雨触发信息分别用作密集空间引导、区域调制和事件时序强制，并在像素和候选滑坡体两个决策单元上进行有界适应，支持不足时精确回退到视觉预测。在四个公共来源、55 个全球滑坡事件、7,890 个测试样本的事件隔离 PILD 数据集上，将决策单元提升到候选物体级别后误差降低 23.99%，约为像素级效果的 3.1 倍。
Motivation: 滑坡测绘的跨域迁移能力对应急响应和区域风险评估至关重要，但视觉基础模型在未见区域、事件和数据源上仍会产生高置信度误报；地形、物质和降雨触发等约束具有局部、区域和事件尺度，重采样到 10 m 网格会与分割决策单元错位，加剧不确定地理背景问题 (UGCoP)。
Method: GeoPhysAdapter 锚定在冻结的视觉基础模型上，将地形、物质和触发信息分别约束为密集空间引导、区域调制和事件时序强制，并在像素与候选滑坡体两个决策单元上应用有界适应，当支撑不足时精确回退到原始视觉预测。
Result: 在事件隔离的 PILD 数据集（4 个公共来源、55 个全球事件、7,890 个测试样本）上，70.3% 的跨域假阳性质量集中在近似纯虚假物体上，其中位等效直径 207 m，与粗先验支撑而非像素匹配；像素级适应消除 507,817 个错误像素并降低 7.76% 误差，而将决策单元提升到候选物体（在相同样本、锚点和基线下）将误差降低提高到 23.99%，IoU 提升 0.031（相对 14.2%），每个被伤害像素可修正 9.92 个像素。
Conclusion: 摘要强调视觉基础模型与地球物理先验相结合时，需按先验的实际空间尺度匹配决策单元，才能有效抑制跨域滑坡测绘中的高置信度误报；数据和代码已公开。

papers.title: CoRE: Consensus Rewards via Equilibrium for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: On unlabeled test data, reinforcement learning lacks a ground-truth reward; test-time RL methods derive one from the model's own roll-outs, rewarding those that match the majority vote over $N$ sampled answers. That vote discards a correct answer whenever it is a minority and scores every majority-matching roll-out identically. We replace it with \emph{CoRE} (Consensus Rewards via Equilibrium): the $N$ roll-outs form a graph whose edges combine answer agreement, reasoning similarity, and generation confidence, and replicator dynamics extract its dominant set, yielding a refined pseudo-label, a graded per-roll-out reward, and a per-question cohesiveness gate. CoRE strictly generalizes voting: majority voting is recovered as a special case; a block-value analysis gives a sharp threshold for when consensus recovers a correct minority against a larger wrong plurality; and confidence calibration provably lowers that threshold multiplicatively. Across seven backbones and five benchmarks (42 model--benchmark cells, three seeds each), \emph{CoRE} improves the untrained base by $+21.7$ points on average versus $+20.4$ for majority-vote TTRL, wins wherever agreement is contestable with margins over the vote of up to $+7.5$ points, and reaches the voting baseline's plateau accuracy in $54$--$70$\% fewer steps. Consensus, not counting: treating the roll-out group as a graph rather than a ballot box turns a brittle vote into a calibrated, graded, self-supervised reward at no extra roll-out cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoRE (Consensus Rewards via Equilibrium)，将测试时强化学习 (test-time RL) 中 N 个自采样回答构造成图，边的权重结合答案一致性、推理相似性与生成置信度，并用复制动力学 (replicator dynamics) 提取主导集，从而得到精细化伪标签、逐样本分级奖励和逐问题一致性门控。多数投票被证明是该方法的一个特例。在七个主干、五个基准共 42 个模型-基准组合（各三个种子）上，CoRE 平均比未训练基线提升 +21.7 点，高于多数投票 TTRL 的 +20.4，并能在更少步数内达到投票基线的平台精度。
Motivation: 在无标注测试数据上，强化学习缺乏真值奖励；现有测试时 RL 方法用 N 个采样回答的多数投票作为伪奖励，但投票会丢弃属于少数派的正确答案，并给所有与多数一致的回答分配相同分数，奖励信号粗糙且脆弱。
Method: 将 N 个 roll-out 视为图节点，边结合答案一致性、推理相似性和生成置信度；用复制动力学提取该图的 dominant set，输出 refined pseudo-label、分级 per-roll-out reward 和 per-question cohesiveness gate。CoRE 严格推广多数投票，多数投票是其特例。
Result: 摘要报告在 7 个主干、5 个基准、42 个模型-基准单元（每个 3 个种子）上，CoRE 平均提升 +21.7 点，优于多数投票 TTRL 的 +20.4；在可争议问题上最高比投票多 +7.5 点，并以 54%–70% 更少的步数达到投票基线的平台精度。block-value 分析给出了共识能恢复少数正确回答的阈值，置信度校准可乘法降低该阈值。
Conclusion: 将 roll-out 群体视为图而非票箱，可以在不增加额外采样成本的情况下，把脆弱的多数投票转化为校准化、分级化的自监督奖励。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Diffusion Image Editing via Asynchronous Token Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Text-guided diffusion image editing aims to modify semantic attributes of an image while preserving its identity, layout, and background. However, naïvely switching the text condition during sampling often causes global drift, as denoising dynamics propagate changes across tokens and can disrupt unedited regions. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{A}synchronous \textbf{T}oken \textbf{D}ecoding \textbf{Edit} (ATDEdit), an inference-time framework that views each sampler step as a parallel update of a globally coupled token matrix and enables token-indexed condition switching with differentiated update policies. Instead of applying synchronous target-conditioned updates to all tokens, ATDEdit estimates editable locations using token-wise conditional surprisal and applies target-conditioned corrections to the selected token set. It supplies source key/value memory at keep-token positions and projects selected keep-token latent rows back to their source values; these operations promote background preservation but do not constitute a pixel-level invariance guarantee. This approach combines local editing and background preservation without external or user-provided spatial masks and without model fine-tuning. On PIE-Bench, ATDEdit achieves the strongest reported preservation metrics, including 27.44~dB PSNR and 0.055 LPIPS, while retaining competitive semantic alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ATDEdit，一个用于文本引导扩散图像编辑的推理时框架。它把每个采样步视为全局耦合 token 矩阵的并行更新，通过 token 级条件惊奇度（conditional surprisal）估计可编辑位置，只对选中的 token 应用目标条件校正，并在保留位置提供源 key/value 记忆、把选中保留 token 的潜在行投影回源值，以促进背景保留。作者称该方法无需外部或用户提供的空间掩码，也无需模型微调，在 PIE-Bench 上取得最强的保留指标，包括 27.44 dB PSNR 和 0.055 LPIPS，同时保持有竞争力的语义对齐。
Motivation: 直接切换扩散采样过程中的文本条件常导致全局漂移，因为去噪动力学跨 token 传播变化，可能破坏未编辑区域；现有方法往往依赖外部空间掩码或模型微调。
Method: 提出异步 token 解码编辑（ATDEdit），将每个采样步建模为全局耦合 token 矩阵的并行更新，并用 token 级条件惊奇度估计可编辑位置；对选中的 token 子集施加目标条件校正，对保留 token 位置提供源 key/value 记忆并将选中保留 token 的潜在行投影回源值。
Result: 在 PIE-Bench 上，ATDEdit 报告了最强的保留指标，包括 27.44 dB PSNR 和 0.055 LPIPS，同时保持有竞争力的语义对齐。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在无需外部掩码和模型微调的情况下结合局部编辑与背景保留，但明确表示这些操作促进背景保留而非提供像素级不变性保证。

papers.title: Warp-free Cross-view Geo-localization via Feature-space Consensus Mining
papers.abstract_en: Cross-view geo-localization is challenging due to drastic viewpoint changes and large appearance discrepancies between street-level and satellite imagery. Although existing methods often use geometric warping to expose co-visible cues, such transformations rely on restrictive spatial assumptions and inevitably introduce severe visual distortions under view-dependent visibility, yielding noisy supervision and fragile correspondences. To overcome this, we propose a novel joint-view consensus-guided learning framework that entirely bypasses explicit geometric warping. Instead of forcing rigid spatial alignment, we dynamically mine and adaptively strengthen a semantic consensus directly within the feature space. Specifically, an auxiliary joint-view pathway during training enables direct cross-view interaction, allowing each view to selectively aggregate corroborative evidence into a unified consensus representation. To resolve feature heterogeneity among the single- and joint-view streams, we introduce global pattern probes acting as a semantic dictionary to project divergent modalities into a strictly aligned metric space. Guided by a consensus-mediated contrastive objective, single-view embeddings are explicitly pulled toward the joint-view anchor during training, distilling this consensus-mining capability into the single-view encoders for robust retrieval at inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across four standard benchmarks, underscoring the importance of discovering cross-view semantic consensus for reliable geo-localization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对跨视角地理定位（cross-view geo-localization）中街景与卫星影像的巨大视角差异和外观差异问题，提出一种完全绕过显式几何变换（geometric warping）的联合视角共识引导学习框架。训练时通过辅助联合视角通路在特征空间内动态挖掘并强化语义共识，借助全局模式探针（global pattern probes）将单视角与联合视角流投射到统一度量空间，并用共识介导的对比目标把单视角嵌入拉向联合视角锚点。摘要报告该方法在四个标准基准上达到当前最优性能。
Motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位方法常依赖几何变换来暴露共视线索，但这类变换基于严格空间假设，在视角相关可见性（view-dependent visibility）下会引入严重视觉畸变，导致带噪监督和脆弱的对应关系。
Method: 提出联合视角共识引导学习框架：训练阶段引入辅助联合视角通路，使各视角直接交互、选择性聚合佐证信息为统一共识表示；用作为语义字典的全局模式探针消除单视角与联合视角流的特征异质性；通过共识介导的对比学习目标将单视角嵌入对齐到联合视角锚点，并将共识挖掘能力蒸馏到单视角编码器供推理使用。
Result: 摘要称该方法在四个标准跨视角地理定位基准上达到最先进性能，强调挖掘跨视角语义共识对可靠地理定位的重要性。
Conclusion: 摘要主张无需显式几何对齐、在特征空间中挖掘语义共识即可提升跨视角地理定位的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对跨视角地理定位（cross-view geo-localization）中街景与卫星影像的巨大视角差异和外观差异问题，提出一种完全绕过显式几何变换（geometric warping）的联合视角共识引导学习框架。训练时通过辅助联合视角通路在特征空间内动态挖掘并强化语义共识，借助全局模式探针（global pattern probes）将单视角与联合视角流投射到统一度量空间，并用共识介导的对比目标把单视角嵌入拉向联合视角锚点。摘要报告该方法在四个标准基准上达到当前最优性能。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位方法常依赖几何变换来暴露共视线索，但这类变换基于严格空间假设，在视角相关可见性（view-dependent visibility）下会引入严重视觉畸变，导致带噪监督和脆弱的对应关系。
summary_sections.method: 提出联合视角共识引导学习框架：训练阶段引入辅助联合视角通路，使各视角直接交互、选择性聚合佐证信息为统一共识表示；用作为语义字典的全局模式探针消除单视角与联合视角流的特征异质性；通过共识介导的对比学习目标将单视角嵌入对齐到联合视角锚点，并将共识挖掘能力蒸馏到单视角编码器供推理使用。
summary_sections.result: 摘要称该方法在四个标准跨视角地理定位基准上达到最先进性能，强调挖掘跨视角语义共识对可靠地理定位的重要性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要主张无需显式几何对齐、在特征空间中挖掘语义共识即可提升跨视角地理定位的鲁棒性。

papers.title: MemeMind: Reference-Guided Trace Construction for Offline Context Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Offline context optimization improves an agent by revising its instructions and examples while keeping the model frozen. This approach learns from rollouts on an adaptation set, but some queries produce only failed rollouts. In these cases, the optimizer sees no successful example of how the available tools can reach the correct answer. We introduce MemeMind, which uses an offline reference answer to recover this missing experience. TraceBuilder identifies the evidence required by the reference, executes text search, image retrieval, and visual grounding, and verifies the resulting tool trace before adding it to the adaptation buffer. ToolGuide then summarizes the collected traces into a shared guide and separate instructions for each tool. The reference answers and constructed traces are used only during adaptation, while inference uses the learned guides with a frozen model. We study this problem through Anime, Comic, and Game meme interpretation. These memes combine edited and ambiguous visual content, overlaid text, long tail franchise knowledge, and culture specific references. Their interpretation can require coordinated visual grounding, image retrieval, and text search, making them a demanding setting in which native rollout groups may fail together. We evaluate MemeMind on MemeX, a benchmark of 1,000 such memes annotated by experts. Across two Qwen3-VL models, two language partitions, and two independent judges, MemeMind improves over the strongest context optimization baseline by 22.0% and 21.1% on Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B, and by 8.1% and 8.0% on Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B under GPT-5 judging. Ablations and held out traces show that constructing successful tool use for failed groups provides the largest component gain and produces more effective evidence acquisition at inference time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MemeMind，一种面向离线上下文优化的方法，利用参考答案恢复完全失败 rollout 所缺失的成功工具调用经验。TraceBuilder 通过文本搜索、图像检索与视觉定位构建并验证工具轨迹，ToolGuide 将轨迹总结为共享指南与各工具独立指令；参考答案和构造轨迹仅用于适应阶段，推理时使用冻结模型与习得指南。作者在动漫、漫画与游戏梗图理解任务上评估该方法，并在 MemeX 基准上报告了相对于最强上下文优化基线的显著提升。
Motivation: 离线上下文优化中，部分查询只有失败的 rollout，导致优化器看不到成功使用可用工具获得正确答案的示例；梗图理解包含编辑与模糊视觉内容、叠加文本、长尾作品知识和文化特定指涉，原生 rollout 可能成组失败，因此需要从离线参考答案中恢复缺失经验。
Method: 引入参考答案作为监督信号：TraceBuilder 识别参考所需的证据，执行文本搜索、图像检索和视觉接地，并验证生成的工具轨迹后再加入适应缓冲；ToolGuide 将收集到的轨迹归纳为共享指南和每个工具各自的指令。参考答案与构造的轨迹只在适应阶段使用，推理阶段保持模型冻结、仅使用学到的指南。
Result: 在 MemeX 的 1,000 个专家标注样本上，使用两个 Qwen3-VL 模型、两种语言划分和两个独立评判者，MemeMind 相比最强上下文优化基线在 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B 上提升 22.0% 和 21.1%，在 Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B 上提升 8.1% 和 8.0%（GPT-5 评判）。消融与留出轨迹分析表明，为失败组构造成功的工具使用贡献了最大的成分增益，并能在推理时产生更有效的证据获取。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，为失败 rollout 组显式构造成功的工具轨迹是最大的收益来源，能够改善推理阶段的信息获取；参考答案与构造轨迹仅在适应期使用，推理时仍保持冻结模型。
Relevance: 0
