papers.title: ASPaeroFlow: Decomposition Heuristics for Joint Air Traffic Flow & Capacity Management
papers.abstract_en: While mathematical models act as vital decision support systems for operational Air Traffic Flow and Capacity Management (ATFCM), existing approaches isolate Air Traffic Flow Management (ATFM) from Dynamic Airspace Configuration (DAC). This separation introduces an unresolved circular dependency between fixed-demand and fixed-capacity assumptions. Although joint optimization resolves this gap, the enlarged search space renders exact models computationally intractable for medium- to large-scale instances. To bridge this gap, we propose ASPaeroFlow: a heuristic for the joint ATFCM; it combines instance-space decomposition heuristics with a local exact approach using Answer Set Programming. We benchmark ASPaeroFlow from small to industry-sized instances and compare it with exact and alternative approaches. The results indicate that (1) the heuristic provides a computational middle ground between exact methods and operational baselines; (2) simultaneous optimization can outperform sequential optimization on joint ATFCM; and (3) an ablation study indicates that DAC has a larger impact on solution quality than flow measures.
papers.comment: To cite this contribution, please cite the ATMOS 2026 paper not the arXiv version; the arXiv version includes the supplementary material. Experimental results are available at: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21869481
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ASPaeroFlow，一种面向联合空中交通流量与容量管理（ATFCM）的启发式方法，将实例空间分解启发式与基于回答集编程（Answer Set Programming, ASP）的局部精确求解相结合。作者在从小规模到行业规模级别的实例上进行基准测试，并与精确方法和替代方法对比。结果显示该启发式在精确方法与运行基线之间提供了计算上的中间地带，同时联合优化可优于顺序优化，且消融研究表明动态空域配置（DAC）对解质量的影响大于流量管理措施。
Motivation: 现有方法将空中交通流量管理（ATFM）与动态空域配置（DAC）分离处理，导致固定需求与固定容量假设之间存在未解决的循环依赖；虽然联合优化能消除该问题，但扩大的搜索空间使精确模型在中大规模实例上计算上不可行。
Method: 提出 ASPaeroFlow 启发式算法，结合实例空间分解启发式与基于 ASP 的局部精确求解方法，用于联合优化 ATFCM，在可扩展性与解质量之间取得权衡。
Result: 基准测试表明该方法在精确方法和现有运行基线之间提供了计算折中；联合优化在联合 ATFCM 上可以优于顺序优化；消融实验显示 DAC 对解质量的影响比流量措施更大。
Conclusion: 摘要强调同时优化联合 ATFCM 的潜力以及 DAC 对整体解质量的关键作用，并定位该启发式为大规模实例的实用求解路径。

papers.title: Targeted Label-Flipping and Oversampling Attacks on Federated Conditional GANs
papers.abstract_en: In a federated learning setup for GANs, several adversarial attacks are possible. One such attack is label flipping, in which malicious clients deliberately alter label information during local training in order to manipulate the global generator. The objective of this attack is to skew the learned generation distribution so that samples conditioned on a target label are instead mapped to a source class. In this work, we investigate the effectiveness of label flipping attacks in federated GANs through both theoretical analysis and empirical evaluation. We further consider an oversampling based variant, in which malicious clients upweight poisoned samples during local training to amplify their influence on the aggregated global model. We quantify the resulting distributional shift by computing the Kullback Leibler divergence between the clean and poisoned class conditional distributions, and show both analytically and on FEMNIST, MNIST, and CIFAR10 that the semantic damage of the attack grows linearly in the effective poisoning strength while deviation from the true target distribution grows only quadratically, making the attack effective yet difficult to detect from label agnostic metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究联邦条件GAN（federated conditional GANs）中的标签翻转攻击（label flipping attack）及其过采样变体。恶意客户端在本地训练中篡改标签或对投毒样本过采样，使全局生成器将目标标签的条件样本映射到源类别。作者通过理论分析和在FEMNIST、MNIST、CIFAR10上的实验，用KL散度量化分布偏移，发现攻击的语义损害随有效投毒强度线性增长，而偏离真实目标分布仅二次增长，因此难以被与标签无关的指标检测。
Motivation: 联邦GAN学习中对恶意攻击的鲁棒性问题，具体是标签翻转攻击如何影响条件生成分布以及如何量化分布偏移。
Method: 理论分析标签翻转攻击和基于过采样的变体（恶意客户端在本地训练中上加权投毒样本），并用干净与投毒类条件分布之间的KL散度来量化分布偏移。
Result: 在FEMNIST、MNIST、CIFAR10上实验表明，语义损害随有效投毒强度线性增长，而偏离真实目标分布呈二次增长，使攻击有效且难以从与标签无关的指标检测。
Conclusion: 摘要强调攻击的效力与隐蔽性之间的不对称性，说明需要针对条件生成模型的专用防御或检测机制。

papers.title: Degraded Infrared Small Object Detection via Degradation-Adapted Physics-Guided Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Infrared small object detection has made significant progress in recent years. However, degradations such as fog and nonuniformity can suppress target-background contrast, substantially increasing detection difficulty. Existing methods mainly rely on image restoration as preprocessing, but they are typically designed for specific degradation types and fail to generalize to varying degradations. To alleviate this, we propose DAISOD, a degradation-adapted infrared small object detection framework for robust detection under different degradations. DAISOD first identifies the type and severity of degradations, then adapts the processing via dedicated branches, and finally fuses the results for subsequent detection. Moreover, a physics-guided restoration mechanism is incorporated to explicitly estimate degradation parameters and remove degradation effects through physical models, avoiding excessive restoration that may erase small targets. Moreover, we construct a degraded infrared small object detection dataset covering diverse degradation types and levels. Extensive experiments show that DAISOD outperforms state-of-the-art methods under various degradation conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DAISOD，一个面向退化场景的红外小目标检测框架，针对雾、非均匀性等退化导致的对比度下降问题。框架先识别退化类型与程度，再通过专门分支自适应处理并融合结果，同时引入物理引导的恢复机制估计退化参数、基于物理模型去除退化影响，以避免过度恢复抹除小目标。作者还构建了覆盖多种退化类型与等级的退化红外小目标检测数据集，实验表明 DAISOD 在各种退化条件下优于现有方法。
Motivation: 红外小目标检测在雾和非均匀性等退化下目标-背景对比度被抑制，检测难度显著增加；现有恢复预处理方法通常针对特定退化类型设计，难以泛化到变化的退化条件。
Method: 提出 DAISOD 框架，包含退化识别模块以判断退化类型与严重程度，采用专门分支进行自适应处理并融合结果供后续检测；融合物理引导的恢复机制，显式估计退化参数并通过物理模型去除退化效应，防止过度恢复导致小目标丢失。
Result: 作者构建了涵盖多种退化类型和等级的退化红外小目标检测数据集；大量实验表明 DAISOD 在各种退化条件下优于当前最先进方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过退化自适应与物理引导恢复相结合，可以在不同退化条件下实现稳健的红外小目标检测，其要点是避免过度恢复以保护弱小目标。

papers.title: Linearized 2-Simplicial Attention
papers.abstract_en: We present a linearized form of 2-simplicial attention by rewriting the trilinear score as an inner product between a composite query and a key, so that the sum over one token axis takes the same form as ordinary softmax attention. We then approximate this sum with positive random features and store the entire past in a fixed-size state, while the second axis stays explicit over a short window of recent tokens. This enables us to achieve linear cost in sequence length combined with a global reach that windowed 2-simplicial attention lacks. We implement it with custom Triton kernels and combine it with Kimi Delta Attention to build a model with no softmax attention at all. Under matched compute, this model achieves the highest mean downstream accuracy among the compared architectures, and at 16k context it improves mean accuracy over a KDA hybrid while lowering LAMBADA perplexity from 715.6 to 602.6.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 2-单纯注意力 (2-simplicial attention) 的线性化形式：将三重线性得分改写成复合查询与键的内积，使沿一个 token 轴的求和退化为与普通 softmax 注意力相同的形式；随后用正随机特征 (positive random features) 近似该求和，并用固定大小状态存储全部历史，而第二个轴仍保留在近期 token 的短窗口上显式计算。作者用自定义 Triton 内核实现，并与 Kimi Delta Attention 组合，构建了完全不含 softmax 注意力的模型；在匹配算力下，该模型在对比架构中获得最高的平均下游准确率，并在 16k 上下文中将 LAMBADA 困惑度从 715.6 降至 602.6。

papers.title: SAFE-CHEM: Uncertainty-Aware Policy Switching for Robust Robotic Chemistry
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of autonomous robotic systems in chemistry laboratories is accelerating experimental workflows and providing the foundational data for AI-driven scientific discovery. However, despite the success of data-driven methods in acquiring dexterous skills, safety remains a primary barrier to their deployment in high-risk domains, such as early-stage materials chemistry experiments. Specifically, learning-based policies frequently struggle to distinguish between safe and unsafe actions, leading to overconfident extrapolation and potentially catastrophic failures. To mitigate these safety risks, we propose SAFE-CHEM, an uncertainty-aware framework designed for robust, learning-based robotic chemists. Our approach leverages an ensemble of recurrent neural network-based imitation learning policies to quantify epistemic uncertainty online through the variance of action predictions. By characterising the success-conditioned density of this variance using kernel density estimation, we introduce a hybrid control architecture that autonomously switches from the learned policy to a deterministic, rule-based backup controller when uncertainty exceeds a calibrated safety threshold. We evaluate SAFE-CHEM across three fundamental laboratory manipulation tasks, where our empirical results demonstrate that this hybrid strategy improves overall task success rates and reduces critical safety violations compared to traditional single-policy baselines. Finally, we demonstrate the practical viability of the framework through zero-shot sim-to-real transfer onto a physical Franka Production 3 robot manipulator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAFE-CHEM，一个面向基于学习的机器人化学实验的不确定性感知框架。它利用循环神经网络模仿学习策略的集成，通过动作预测方差在线量化认知不确定性，并用核密度估计刻画成功条件下的方差密度；当不确定性超过校准阈值时，混合控制架构自动从学习策略切换到确定性规则备份控制器。作者在三个基础实验室操作任务上验证，混合策略相比单策略基线提高了任务成功率并减少了关键安全违规，并通过零样本 sim-to-real 迁移在 Franka Production 3 机械臂上展示了实际可行性。
Motivation: 数据驱动方法在灵巧技能获取上取得成功，但安全仍是高风险化学实验场景部署的主要障碍；学习策略往往难以区分安全与危险动作，导致过度自信的外推和潜在的灾难性失败。
Method: 采用一组基于 RNN 的模仿学习策略，利用动作预测方差的方差在线上估计认知不确定性；通过核密度估计刻画成功条件概率密度，构建混合控制架构，在不确定性超过校准后的安全阈值时自动从学习策略切换到确定性的规则备份控制器。
Result: 在三个实验室操作任务上的实验表明，该混合策略相较传统单策略基线提升了整体任务成功率并减少了关键安全违规；同时实现了零样本 sim-to-real 迁移到物理 Franka Production 3 机械臂。
Conclusion: 作者强调不确定性感知的策略切换能够提升学习型机器人化学实验的鲁棒性与安全性，并通过真实机械臂实验验证了框架的实际可行性；摘要未讨论局限或失败模式。

papers.title: Bootstrapping Vision-Language Model for Hysteroscopic Surgical Scene Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Hysteroscopic surgical scene segmentation plays a pivotal role in understanding the hysteroscopic intraoperative environment as well as computer-assisted intervention. However, this task presents unique challenges due to the high morphological similarity among different lesions and the presence of artifacts such as specular reflections, motion blur, and fluid occlusions in surgical videos. In this work, we propose the first vision-language model (VLM)-based hysteroscopic surgical scene segmentation method, which performs pixel-wise localization for fifteen representative categories in hysteroscopic surgical scenes. Our VLM-hyster has a segmentation backbone that utilizes the pretrained image encoder for robust visual feature extraction, coupled with a transformer-based decoder for dense prediction. Moreover, we design category-specific text prompts and incorporate a masked distillation branch to filter out visual features with low correlation to the text prompts, enabling the model to focus more effectively on category-specific image regions and thereby enhancing segmentation performance. We collect a large multicentric hysteroscopic surgical scene dataset, containing 4,020 high-resolution images with detailed mask annotations, for model training and evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that VLM-hyster substantially outperforms state-of-the-art AI models. Furthermore, extensive assessments by gynecologists, as well as multicentre and prospective validations, demonstrate VLM-hyster's robustness and generalizability. The results suggest that VLM-hyster earns considerable potential in enabling AI-assisted localization of surgical instruments and lesions in hysteroscopic surgeries. Code is available at https://github.com/viscom-tongji/VLM-hyster.
papers.comment: Accept by Biomedical Signal Processing and Control
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个基于视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的宫腔镜手术场景分割方法 VLM-hyster，针对十五类宫腔镜手术场景类别进行像素级定位。方法采用预训练图像编码器与 transformer 解码器，并设计类别特定文本提示和掩码蒸馏分支，过滤与文本提示低相关的视觉特征。作者收集了包含 4,020 张高分辨率图像的多中心宫腔镜手术场景数据集，实验显示 VLM-hyster 显著优于现有 AI 模型，并通过妇科医生评估、多中心与前瞻性验证证明了鲁棒性和泛化性。
Motivation: 宫腔镜手术场景分割对理解术中环境与计算机辅助干预至关重要，但病灶形态高度相似，且手术视频存在镜面反射、运动模糊和液体遮挡等伪影，给分割带来独特挑战。
Method: 提出 VLM-hyster：分割骨干利用预训练图像编码器提取鲁棒视觉特征，配合 transformer 解码器进行密集预测；同时设计类别特定文本提示，并引入掩码蒸馏分支以滤除与文本提示相关性较低的视觉特征，使模型更关注类别特定图像区域。
Result: 在自建多中心宫腔镜手术场景数据集（4,020 张高分辨率图像及详细掩码标注）上，VLM-hyster 大幅优于现有 SOTA AI 模型；妇科医生的大规模评估以及多中心、前瞻性验证表明其具有鲁棒性和泛化性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 VLM-hyster 在宫腔镜手术中实现手术器械与病灶的 AI 辅助定位方面具有较大潜力，并已公开代码。摘要未明确讨论方法局限。

papers.title: WorldSimProbe: Diagnosing Simulator Faithfulness in Action-Conditioned World Models for Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) promise to provide embodied AI with scalable predictive simulators for planning, policy evaluation, and data generation. Realizing this promise requires precise action-conditioned transitions rather than merely plausible outputs. Yet their applicability remains difficult to establish because prevailing evaluations emphasize visual quality, task outcomes, or coarse rollout-level responsiveness without directly testing simulator fidelity. To address this gap, we evaluate ACWMs through the observable capabilities expected of physical simulators. Accordingly, we formalize Observable Simulator Contract, a minimal contract that any action-conditioned physical simulator should satisfy: supplied actions must induce corresponding agent motion, and environment responses must be grounded in that realized motion. To operationalize this contract, we introduce WorldSimProbe, comprising five controlled suites spanning local control sensitivity, global trajectory variation, source-diverse actions, interaction grounding, and dynamics. Suite-specific evaluators assess simulator-relative calibration, dense action-to-motion correspondence, false-interaction grounding, and primitive-level dynamics. We evaluate six open-source ACWMs on more than 18,000 instances across RoboTwin, ManiSkill, and LIBERO. World-SimProbe reveals systematic action-realization degradation across control variation, structured failures in interaction grounding and dynamics, and benchmark signals consistent with human judgments and downstream outcomes. Together, this capability-based framework provides a transparent, and standardized paradigm for diagnosing ACWM simulator fidelity beyond coarse, task-directed evaluation.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 18 figures, and 10 tables, including supplementary material. Code and data: https://evophys.com/WorldSimProbe/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WorldSimProbe，一个用于诊断动作条件世界模型 (action-conditioned world models, ACWMs) 作为物理模拟器保真度的能力导向评测框架。作者形式化 Observable Simulator Contract，要求提供的动作必须产生对应的智能体运动，且环境响应必须基于该已实现的运动；并设计五个受控测试套件。在 RoboTwin、ManiSkill、LIBERO 上对六个开源 ACWM 进行超过 18,000 个实例的评估，发现控制变化下系统性的动作-实现退化，以及交互接地和动力学方面的结构化失败。
Motivation: 现有 ACWM 评测多关注视觉质量、任务结果或粗粒度 rollout 响应性，没有直接检验模拟器保真度，导致其作为可扩展预测模拟器用于规划、策略评估和数据生成的适用性难以确立。作者转而通过物理模拟器应具备的可观测能力来评估 ACWM。
Method: 形式化 Observable Simulator Contract，并实现 WorldSimProbe，包含五个受控套件：局部控制灵敏度、全局轨迹变化、多源动作、交互接地和动力学。配套的套件专属评价器分别评估模拟器相对校准、稠密动作-运动对应、虚假交互接地和原语级动力学。
Result: 对六个开源 ACWM 在 RoboTwin、ManiSkill、LIBERO 上评估了超过 18,000 个实例。结果显示控制变化下存在系统性的动作实现退化，交互接地和动力学出现结构化失败，并且基准信号与人类判断及下游结果一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为该基于能力的框架提供了一种透明、标准化的范式，用于诊断 ACWM 的模拟器保真度，超越粗粒度、任务导向的评估。

papers.title: CADEngBench: It Looks Like CAD, but Does It Work? Evaluating Parametric Design, Assembly Reasoning, and Physics Simulation
papers.abstract_en: A CAD model is not engineering-grade merely because it looks correct. It must satisfy design requirements, respond predictably to parameter changes, support controlled edits, match a reference structural response under a declared analysis, and connect to other parts through valid joints. We present CADEngBench, a two-track benchmark for these capabilities. CADEngBench-P evaluates 300 parametric parts, each used for one zero-to-CAD task and one functional-editing task (600 tasks in total), through boundary-representation (B-Rep) validity, engineering and DFM checks, parameter-family perturbations, functional editing, and matched linear-static FEA in CalculiX. CADEngBench-A evaluates 150 body pairs through ranked joint retrieval, exact face-and-edge grounding, joint-frame prediction, and kinematic verification. Across eight multimodal, code-capable models, editing supplied CAD is substantially easier than generating it, while complex edits and matched FEA remain difficult. Assembly predictions often locate the relevant region but fail to recover the recorded joint or mating entities. These results show that CAD evaluation must test engineering behavior rather than appearance alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CADEngBench 是一个双轨基准，用于评估 CAD 模型是否达到工程级质量而不仅仅是外观正确。CADEngBench-P 评估 300 个参数化零件，覆盖零到 CAD 生成和功能编辑共 600 个任务，检验 B-Rep 有效性、工程与 DFM 检查、参数族扰动、功能编辑以及 CalculiX 中匹配的线性静力 FEA；CADEngBench-A 评估 150 对零件体，涉及排序关节检索、面边精确接地、关节框架预测和运动学验证。摘要表明编辑已有 CAD 比生成 CAD 容易，但复杂编辑与匹配 FEA 仍然困难，装配预测常能定位相关区域却无法恢复记录关节或配合实体。
Motivation: 现有 CAD 评估多以外观正确性为准，而工程级 CAD 还必须满足设计需求、对参数变化做出可预测响应、支持受控编辑、匹配声明的分析下的参考结构响应，并通过有效关节与其他零件连接。作者指出缺少系统测试这些工程行为的基准。
Method: 提出双轨基准 CADEngBench-P 与 CADEngBench-A，分别针对参数化设计与功能编辑、装配推理与物理仿真。评估管线包含 B-Rep 有效性、工程与 DFM 检查、参数族扰动、功能编辑、基于 CalculiX 的匹配线性静力 FEA、关节检索、面边接地、关节框架预测和运动学验证，并在八个多模态、代码能力模型上进行测试。
Result: 摘要报告称，编辑提供的 CAD 比从零生成 CAD 明显容易；复杂编辑和匹配 FEA 对现有模型仍具挑战；装配预测经常定位到相关区域，但无法恢复记录的关节或配合实体。
Conclusion: 作者强调，CAD 评估必须测试工程行为而非仅凭外观判断模型能力，这组结果表明现有模型在工程级约束上的表现与视觉合理性之间仍有差距。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond the Capability Boundary: Zeroth-Order Optimization for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving methods improve the capabilities of LLM agents by sampling trajectories from the underlying LLMs and learning from these trajectories. However, these methods struggle to learn beyond the inherent capability boundary of the agents, since the agents cannot sample correct trajectories on difficult examples for further improvements. In this paper, we propose a zeroth-order self-evolution framework that enables agents to learn beyond their capability boundary by perturbing LLM parameters to adapt to difficult examples without any trajectory annotations. Specifically, we perturb LoRA parameters of LLMs, run the agent, compute the losses under the perturbed and original parameters, and use the loss difference to estimate gradients and further update the LoRA parameters. We sample trajectories using the updated LLMs for supervised fine-tuning to break through the capability boundary of the agents, forming a closed self-evolution loop. We introduce a parallel perturbation inference mechanism and an adaptive lookup mechanism to reduce time consumption in zeroth-order optimization, with an answer perplexity loss that provides smooth and stable zeroth-order loss values. Experiments on multiple deep research benchmarks show that our method obtains substantially more successful trajectories and consistently outperforms strong baselines, especially on difficult examples. The code and released artifacts are available at https://github.com/hidk1911/ZOForLLMAgents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自进化型 LLM 智能体难以越过自身能力边界的问题，提出一种零阶优化 (zeroth-order optimization) 自进化框架：通过扰动 LoRA 参数、利用扰动前后损失差估计梯度并更新参数，再用更新后的模型采样轨迹用于监督微调，形成闭环。在多个 deep research 基准上，该方法获得明显更多的成功轨迹，并在困难样本上持续优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有自进化方法依赖从底层 LLM 采样轨迹并从中学习，但智能体在困难样本上无法采样到正确轨迹，因此难以学习到超越其固有能力边界 (capability boundary) 的内容。
Method: 扰动 LLM 的 LoRA 参数后运行智能体，分别计算扰动与原始参数下的损失，用损失差估计梯度并更新 LoRA 参数；随后用更新后的 LLM 采样轨迹进行监督微调。还引入并行扰动推理机制和自适应查找机制以降低零阶优化的时间开销，并采用答案困惑度损失 (answer perplexity loss) 提供平滑稳定的零阶损失值。
Result: 在多个 deep research 基准上的实验显示，该方法获得的成功轨迹数量显著更多，并且一致优于强基线，尤其在困难样本上的优势明显。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架无需轨迹标注即可使智能体突破能力边界，形成闭合的自进化循环，并公开了代码与相关产物。

papers.title: DAVE: A Decoupled Audio-Visual Enhancement Framework for Real-World Speech Separation
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual speech enhancement under real-world conditions remains challenging due to unreliable visual inputs and the lack of large-scale training data with realistic acoustic conditions. Existing approaches usually fuse visual features directly into the separation network, making them vulnerable to degraded visual signals. In this paper, we present DAVE, a decoupled audio-visual enhancement framework for real-world speech separation. Firstly, to address the data scarcity issue, we construct DAVE-Corpus, a large-scale training corpus with 219,411 mixtures generated from public meeting corpora through combinatorial acoustic augmentation. Then, we introduce a progressive multi-objective optimization strategy to jointly improve speech separation, intelligibility, speaker identity preservation, and perceptual quality. We further develop a certified selective enhancement chain that applies scene routing, GAN-based denoising, and loudness normalization only within the no-reference partition, guaranteeing non-degradation of reference-based metrics. Experimental results on the Real-World Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement Challenge demonstrate the robustness of DAVE under both real-world mixed scenarios and visual degradation conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DAVE，一个面向真实场景语音分离的解耦式音视频增强框架，针对视觉输入不可靠和大规模真实声学训练数据缺乏的问题。作者构造了含 219,411 个混合样本的 DAVE-Corpus 训练语料，并采用渐进式多目标优化来同时改善分离、可懂度、说话人身份保持与感知质量。在 Real-World Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement Challenge 上的实验表明，DAVE 在真实混合场景和视觉退化条件下具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 真实环境下的音视频语音增强面临视觉输入不可靠以及缺乏具备真实声学条件的大规模训练数据两大困难；现有方法通常直接将视觉特征融合进分离网络，因而在视觉信号退化时表现脆弱。
Method: 提出解耦式框架 DAVE：先由公共会议语料通过组合式声学增强（combinatorial acoustic augmentation）构建 DAVE-Corpus；再引入渐进式多目标优化策略，联合提升语音分离、可懂度、说话人身份保持和感知质量；最后设计一条经认证的选择性增强链，仅在无参考（no-reference）分区内执行场景路由、基于 GAN 的去噪和响度归一化，从而保证基于参考的指标不退化。
Result: 在 Real-World Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement Challenge 上的实验结果显示，DAVE 在真实混合场景和视觉退化条件下均表现出鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将视觉特征解耦并配合只作用于无参考分区的选择性增强链，可以缓解视觉退化带来的脆弱性，并保证参考指标不退化，从而提升真实场景下的语音分离稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UniDFKD: A Unified Semantic Prior Framework for Architecture-Agnostic Data-Free Knowledge Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Data-Free Knowledge Distillation (DFKD) transfers knowledge from a pretrained teacher model to a compact student model by synthesizing semantically informative data, eliminating the need for access to the original training dataset. Existing DFKD methods rely heavily on architecture-specific statistical priors (e.g., Batch Normalization statistics) to guide data synthesis, however, such architecture-dependent priors are often absent in modern architectures such as Vision Transformers (ViTs), resulting in degraded semantic quality of the synthesized data and consequently catastrophic performance degradation. In this paper, we propose \emph{UniDFKD}, a unified data-free knowledge distillation framework that replaces architecture-specific statistics with explicit, architecture-agnostic semantic priors. \emph{UniDFKD} governs the entire synthesis-distillation pipeline along three dimensions: (1) Categorical Semantic Conditioning (CSC) defines \emph{what} to synthesize by persistently modulating the generator with language-derived embeddings to capture semantic diversity; (2) Spatial Semantic Anchoring (SSA) dictates \emph{where} evidence belongs by anchoring the teacher's spatial attributions to a Gaussian prior; and (3) Spatial Semantic Distillation (SSD) controls \emph{how} knowledge is transferred by explicitly aligning teacher-student spatial evidence alongside predictions. Extensive experiments across CNNs and ViTs demonstrate that UniDFKD establishes a new state-of-the-art, outperforming existing methods by an average absolute margin of over 20\% in both homogeneous and heterogeneous settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniDFKD，一个统一的数据无关知识蒸馏框架，用显式的、架构无关的语义先验替代 Batch Normalization 统计等架构特定先验，以指导数据合成与蒸馏。框架通过三个维度控制整个流程：CSC 用语言派生嵌入调制生成器以定义合成内容，SSA 将教师的空间归因锚定到高斯先验以规定证据位置，SSD 显式对齐师生空间证据与预测以控制知识迁移方式。在 CNN 与 ViT 上的实验表明，该方法在同质与异质设置下平均绝对优势超过 20%，达到新 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有数据无关知识蒸馏方法高度依赖架构特定的统计先验（如 BN 统计）来引导数据合成，但这类先验在 ViT 等现代架构中常常缺失，导致合成数据的语义质量下降，进而造成性能的灾难性退化。
Method: 提出 UniDFKD 统一框架，包含三个组成部分：类别语义条件化（CSC）通过语言派生嵌入持续调制生成器以捕捉语义多样性；空间语义锚定（SSA）将教师的空间归因锚定到高斯先验；空间语义蒸馏（SSD）在预测对齐之外显式对齐师生空间证据。
Result: 在 CNN 和 ViT 上的广泛实验表明，UniDFKD 在同质与异质设置下均优于现有方法，平均绝对性能差距超过 20%，建立新的最先进结果。
Conclusion: 本文表明用架构无关的语义先验统一合成-蒸馏流程可以解决架构特定统计先验缺失导致的 DFKD 性能退化问题，从而覆盖 CNN 与 ViT 等不同架构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VeinCast: Physics-Guided Dynamic Field Graphs with Graph-Conditioned Fusion for Global Medium-Range Weather Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Global medium-range weather forecasting requires modeling structured yet state-dependent interactions among heterogeneous atmospheric fields. Existing data-driven models largely learn these interactions implicitly, whereas equation-level physical constraints may inherit approximation and model-form biases. We present VeinCast, a physics-guided dynamic field graph and graph-conditioned fusion framework that jointly forecasts 69 surface and upper-air fields. Within each local window, its Physics-Guided Dynamic Field Graph combines predefined atmospheric relations with state-dependent Top-K residual edges and adapts Earth-window attention using the resulting graph context. Graph-Conditioned Latent Fusion further employs graph context and source-node centrality to guide field-to-latent aggregation, while bounded feedback preserves field-specific information. On the $1.5^\circ$ ERA5 benchmark, VeinCast demonstrates competitive forecasting performance across all 69 meteorological fields at lead times of up to 14 days, compared with representative global weather forecasting models including FuXi, Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, FengWu, and ARROW. Ablations confirm that the two modules provide complementary gains, demonstrating the effectiveness of relational-level physical guidance for data-driven weather forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VeinCast，一个物理引导的动态场图与图条件融合框架，用于全球中期天气预报，联合预测 69 个地表与高空气象场。在 1.5° ERA5 基准上，该模型在最长 14 天的预报时效内与 FuXi、Pangu-Weather、GraphCast、FengWu、ARROW 等代表性全球预报模型相比具有竞争力。消融实验表明两个模块带来互补增益，说明关系级物理引导对数据驱动预报有效。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动天气预报模型大多隐式学习异质气象场之间结构化且状态依赖的交互；直接引入方程级物理约束则可能继承近似误差和模型形式偏差，缺少关系层面的显式物理引导。
Method: 提出 Physics-Guided Dynamic Field Graph，在局部窗口内将预定义大气关系与状态相关的 Top-K 残差边结合，并利用图上下文自适应地调整 Earth-window attention；Graph-Conditioned Latent Fusion 使用图上下文和源节点中心性指导 field-to-latent 聚合，并通过有界反馈保留各场特有信息。
Result: 在 1.5° ERA5 基准上，VeinCast 对全部 69 个气象场在最长 14 天时效内取得有竞争力的预报性能；消融实验确认两个模块提供互补增益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调关系层面的物理引导可以有效增强数据驱动天气预报模型，VeinCast 的图结构与图条件融合是这一思路的可行实现。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有数据驱动天气预报模型大多隐式学习异质气象场之间结构化且状态依赖的交互；直接引入方程级物理约束则可能继承近似误差和模型形式偏差，缺少关系层面的显式物理引导。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Physics-Guided Dynamic Field Graph，在局部窗口内将预定义大气关系与状态相关的 Top-K 残差边结合，并利用图上下文自适应地调整 Earth-window attention；Graph-Conditioned Latent Fusion 使用图上下文和源节点中心性指导 field-to-latent 聚合，并通过有界反馈保留各场特有信息。
summary_sections.result: 在 1.5° ERA5 基准上，VeinCast 对全部 69 个气象场在最长 14 天时效内取得有竞争力的预报性能；消融实验确认两个模块提供互补增益。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调关系层面的物理引导可以有效增强数据驱动天气预报模型，VeinCast 的图结构与图条件融合是这一思路的可行实现。

papers.title: GLocFM: A Geometry-Aware Foundation Model for 3D Indoor Wireless Localization
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based wireless localizers often fail to utilize geometric information about the propagation environment, limiting their ability to exploit non-line-of-sight (NLoS) propagation and generalize across scenes. To bridge this gap, we propose GLocFM, a Geometry-aware Localization Foundation Model, which jointly exploits WiFi measurements and scene geometry represented as a 3D point cloud. We formulate localization as a maximum-likelihood (ML) estimation problem, where the goal is to find a transmitter position that maximizes the likelihood of the wireless observations conditioned on the scene geometry. The likelihood of a candidate transmitter position is calculated by a learned scoring function that matches the observed delay--angle-of-arrival (AoA) spectrum against the spectrum predicted for that candidate. A hierarchical scene encoder extracts propagation-relevant features to produce geometric priors for LoS and one-bounce reflection paths. For scenarios with imperfect synchronization, we further introduce a time-of-flight (ToF)-robust GLocFM model to handle unknown ToF offsets. GLocFM is trained on a multi-modal synthetic indoor localization dataset comprising 221 diverse scenes whose associated wireless signals are generated using Sionna RT. On both synthetic and the NeRF$^{2}$ dataset based on real measurements, GLocFM reduces mean 3D localization error relative to one of the state-of-the-art localization baselines by 49.5\% and 48.8\%, respectively. Ablations across different number of receiver, bandwidths, and array sizes further demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GLocFM，一个几何感知的定位基础模型 (Geometry-aware Localization Foundation Model)，将 WiFi 测量与由 3D 点云表示的场景几何联合建模，用于室内无线定位。作者将定位形式化为关于场景几何条件的最大似然 (ML) 估计，利用学习得到的评分函数将观测到的时延-到达角 (AoA) 谱与候选位置预测的谱进行匹配。模型在包含 221 个场景的 Sionna RT 多模态合成数据集上训练，并在合成数据和基于真实测量的 NeRF$^{2}$ 数据集上将平均 3D 定位误差相对 SOTA 基线分别降低 49.5% 和 48.8%。
Motivation: 现有的基于学习的无线定位器往往没有利用传播环境的几何信息，因此难以充分挖掘非视距 (NLoS) 传播的潜力，并且跨场景泛化能力受限。
Method: 将定位建模为最大似然估计问题：目标发射机位置使以场景几何为条件的无线观测似然最大化；候选位置的似然由学习评分函数计算，该函数将实测时延-AoA 谱与候选位置预测谱进行匹配。层次化场景编码器提取与传播相关的特征，为视距 (LoS) 和一次反射路径生成几何先验；针对非完美同步，还引入对飞行时间 (ToF) 偏移鲁棒的 GLocFM 变体。
Result: 在合成数据集和基于真实测量的 NeRF$^{2}$ 数据集上，GLocFM 相对 SOTA 定位基线将平均 3D 定位误差分别降低 49.5% 和 48.8%；针对接收机数量、带宽和阵列规模的消融实验进一步验证了框架的有效性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将场景几何显式引入无线定位可以显著提升定位精度和跨场景泛化能力，并能在未知 ToF 偏移下保持鲁棒性；训练数据由 Sionna RT 合成生成，验证覆盖真实测量数据集 NeRF$^{2}$。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ComboShoppingBench: Evaluating LLM Agents for Budget-Constrained Basket Shopping with Coupons
papers.abstract_en: Real-world shopping often requires constructing a basket of complementary items rather than retrieving a single product. Such combo-shopping tasks arise in device setup, meal preparation, event planning, and group takeout ordering, requiring joint reasoning about item compatibility, availability, store-level requirements, delivery fees, coupons, and budgets. Evaluation is challenging because multiple baskets may satisfy the same request, making exact-match metrics unsuitable, whereas semantic evaluation alone cannot detect infeasible orders, invalid coupon combinations, or incorrect payments. We introduce ComboShoppingBench, an agentic shopping benchmark for open-ended yet verifiable basket construction in a simulated commerce and takeout environment. During task synthesis, an exploration agent constructs a feasible and semantically coherent basket of purchasable products; this witness guides the generation of coupons, budget constraints, user queries, and aligned evaluation rubrics. During evaluation, LLM judges assess semantic satisfaction, response quality, and claim faithfulness, while deterministic validation checks product-ID validity, budget compliance, and coupon optimality. Experiments with diverse LLM agents demonstrate that even strong agents struggle on ComboShoppingBench, highlighting substantial room for improvement in reliable, constraint-aware combo shopping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出 ComboShoppingBench，一个面向预算受限的"组合购物"（basket shopping）的智能体评测基准，在模拟电商与外卖环境中要求模型构建包含互补商品的购物篮。任务合成阶段用一个探索智能体构造可行且语义连贯的购物篮作为 witness，并据此生成优惠券、预算约束、用户查询与评估 rubric；评测阶段结合 LLM 裁判做语义评估和确定性校验（商品 ID、预算、优惠券最优性）。实验显示多种 LLM 智能体在该基准上表现挣扎，说明可靠且约束感知的组合购物仍有很大提升空间。
Motivation: 真实购物常需构建互补商品组合而非检索单个商品，现有评测不适合此类任务：精确匹配无法处理多个合法解，而仅靠语义评估无法捕捉不可行订单、无效优惠券组合或错误支付。
Method: 在模拟商业与外卖环境中构建 agentic 购物基准；任务合成时用探索智能体构造可行的语义连贯购物篮作为 witness，并据此生成优惠券、预算约束、用户查询和对齐的评估标准；评测时由 LLM 裁判评估语义满足度、响应质量和 claim faithfulness，同时用确定性校验检查产品 ID 有效性、预算合规和优惠券最优性。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值，仅称对多种 LLM 智能体的实验显示，即使是强智能体在 ComboShoppingBench 上也表现困难，凸显该任务仍有很大改进空间。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该基准可用于开放式但可验证的购物篮构建评估，并指出现有 LLM 智能体在可靠、约束感知的组合购物方面仍明显不足。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MMArch: Benchmarking Multimodal Reasoning Grounded in Architectural Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) perform strongly on engineering imagery, yet existing benchmarks mostly test drawing recognition, information extraction, or compliance checking, leaving open whether models can combine distributed visual evidence with engineering principles to reach a conclusion. We introduce MMArch, a benchmark for architecture and civil engineering spanning ten subdomains and built entirely from figures in peer-reviewed papers. Its $1{,}212$ short-answer items are produced by a decoupled planner--writer pipeline and validated through automated screening, a blind adversarial audit, and expert review, so that answering requires perceiving the relevant evidence, identifying the governing principle, and applying it, not exploiting textual or single-figure shortcuts. Evaluating $18$ open-weight and proprietary MLLMs against a domain-expert panel, we find a wide gap: the strongest open-source model attains about $30\%$ and the best proprietary system $52\%$, while human experts reach $95\%$, more than forty points ahead. Our error analysis shows that failures concentrate in applying principles and combining evidence across figures rather than in locating it, pointing to substantial headroom for future research. Code and data are available at https://dcx-swjtu.github.io/MMArch/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MMArch，一个面向建筑与土木工程领域的多模态推理基准，数据全部来自同行评审论文中的图表，覆盖十个子领域，包含 1,212 道短答题。作者用解耦的 planner-writer 流程生成题目，并经过自动筛选、盲对抗审计和专家评审验证。评测 18 个开放权重和专有 MLLM 后发现与人类专家差距巨大：最强开源模型约 30%，最强专有系统 52%，而人类专家达 95%。错误分析显示失败主要发生在应用工程原理和跨图综合证据，而非定位证据。
Motivation: 现有基准主要测试工程图像的绘图识别、信息抽取或合规检查，无法回答模型能否结合分散的视觉证据与工程原理得出结论这一问题。
Method: 构建 MMArch 基准，题目来自同行评审论文中的图表，采用解耦的 planner-writer 生成流程，并通过自动筛选、盲对抗审计和专家评审保证题目必须依赖感知相关证据、识别支配性原理并加以应用，无法靠文本或单图捷径作答。
Result: 在领域专家对照下，最强开源 MLLM 约 30% 准确率，最强专有系统 52%，人类专家 95%，差距超过四十个百分点；错误主要集中在原理应用和跨图证据综合环节。
Conclusion: 摘要认为当前 MLLM 在需要工程原理推理的多模态任务上仍有很大提升空间，错误分布指向未来研究应聚焦于原理应用与跨图证据整合能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Software Engineering for and with GUI Agent
papers.abstract_en: GUI agents have advanced rapidly, producing a growing body of frameworks, benchmarks, and applications. However, this growth has outpaced the maturity of the field. GUI agents remain technically brittle, incompletely engineered, and insufficiently validated for sustained real-world use. They are evolving into closed-loop software systems. Within these systems, model reasoning is coupled with interface perception, execution feedback, recovery, and human oversight. This evolution calls for a software engineering perspective that remains largely absent from existing research. We address this gap by reviewing 336 GUI-agent papers from January 2018 to April 2026. Five research questions examine the research landscape, architectures, evaluation, software lifecycle concerns, and future opportunities. Our findings show that the field has expanded sharply since 2024, while mobile and web settings remain dominant. Architectures increasingly adopt modular perceive-reason-act loops, but recovery, human escalation, safety enforcement, and auditability remain underdeveloped. This architectural imbalance extends to evaluation. Evaluations are becoming more interactive, but they remain centered on task success and are difficult to compare across protocols. More broadly, existing studies provide limited support for testing beyond benchmarks and for maintaining agents after release. Observability, privacy engineering, and systematic human oversight are also underdeveloped. Together, these findings show that capability improvements alone cannot ensure deployment readiness. Future research should connect dependable execution with lifecycle-centered testing and reproducible evaluation. It should also integrate permission and privacy controls with cost-aware, human-centered governance. This integration is necessary to build dependable, maintainable, secure, and deployable GUI-agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从软件工程视角系统综述了 2018 年 1 月至 2026 年 4 月间的 336 篇 GUI-agent 论文，围绕研究格局、架构、评测、软件生命周期关切与未来机会五个研究问题展开。综述发现该领域自 2024 年以来急剧扩张，移动端与网页端仍占主导；架构日益采用模块化的感知-推理-执行循环，但恢复、人工升级、安全执行与可审计性仍不成熟。评测虽变得更交互，但仍以任务成功为中心且难以跨协议比较，测试与发布后维护、可观测性、隐私工程和系统性人工监督也均发展不足。
Motivation: GUI 智能体虽发展迅速，但技术脆弱、工程化不完整、面向长期真实使用的验证不足，正演变为闭环软件系统；这种演进需要现有研究基本缺失的软件工程视角。
Method: 对 2018 年 1 月至 2026 年 4 月的 336 篇 GUI-agent 论文做系统综述，用五个研究问题考察研究格局、架构、评测、软件生命周期关切与未来机会。
Result: 发现该领域自 2024 年起急剧扩张，移动端和网页端为主；架构更多采用模块化的 perceive-reason-act 循环，但恢复、人工升级、安全执行与可审计性不发达。评测更交互却仍以任务成功为中心且难以跨协议比较，对基准之外的测试和发布后维护支持有限，可观测性、隐私工程与系统性人工监督也明显不足。
Conclusion: 仅靠能力提升无法确保部署就绪；未来研究应将可靠执行与面向生命周期的测试、可复现评测相连接，并把权限与隐私控制同成本敏感、以人为中心的治理相结合，以构建可靠、可维护、安全且可部署的 GUI-agent 系统。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 发现该领域自 2024 年起急剧扩张，移动端和网页端为主；架构更多采用模块化的 perceive-reason-act 循环，但恢复、人工升级、安全执行与可审计性不发达。评测更交互却仍以任务成功为中心且难以跨协议比较，对基准之外的测试和发布后维护支持有限，可观测性、隐私工程与系统性人工监督也明显不足。
summary_sections.conclusion: 仅靠能力提升无法确保部署就绪；未来研究应将可靠执行与面向生命周期的测试、可复现评测相连接，并把权限与隐私控制同成本敏感、以人为中心的治理相结合，以构建可靠、可维护、安全且可部署的 GUI-agent 系统。

papers.title: P$^{3}$: Joint Program-and-Proof Planning for Verified Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Verified code generation asks a large language model (LLM) to generate both an executable program and a machine-checkable proof that the program meets a formal specification, promising software that is correct by construction. The de facto workflow decouples the two halves of the problem: first synthesize a program, then attempt to prove it correct. We observe that this sequential pipeline can be both ineffective and inefficient in practice. A program generated without anticipating its proof can be subtly incorrect or structurally difficult to verify, forcing the LLM into brittle repair loops that alternate between patching the code and patching the proof. Inspired by Dijkstra's view that a program and its correctness argument should be developed hand in hand, we propose $P^3$, an LLM-based agentic workflow that first derives a unified program-and-proof plan from the specification, then elaborates the implementation and proof scaffold under this shared plan. To evaluate verified code generation in realistic settings, we further introduce Lean4Commit0, a repository-derived, library-level benchmark built by extracting core APIs from real-world software repositories and translating their requirements, including relational specifications across APIs, into Lean tasks. Using four frontier LLM backends, we evaluate $P^3$ on Verina, AlgoVeri, and our Lean4Commit0 benchmark, where it achieves the highest solve rate in every benchmark--model setting. Compared with the stronger baseline, it improves solve rates by 4.6--11.2 percentage points and reduces per-task API cost by up to roughly 40\% and wall-clock time by up to roughly 37\% on the difficult subset of each benchmark. A targeted ablation further shows gains of 3.3--8.3 points over implementation-only planning, isolating the benefit of planning the program and proof jointly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 P^3，一种面向验证代码生成 (verified code generation) 的 LLM 智能体工作流：先从形式规约推导统一的程序与证明联合计划，再在该共享计划下细化实现和证明骨架。作者还引入 Lean4Commit0，一个从真实软件仓库抽取核心 API 并翻译为 Lean 任务的库级基准。在 Verina、AlgoVeri 和 Lean4Commit0 上用四个前沿 LLM 后端评测，P^3 在每个基准-模型组合下取得最高求解率，比更强基线提升 4.6–11.2 个百分点，并在困难子集上将每任务 API 成本降低最多约 40%、墙钟时间降低最多约 37%。消融显示联合规划相比仅实现规划带来 3.3–8.3 个百分点的增益。
Motivation: 现有验证代码生成的默认流程是先合成程序再尝试证明其正确性，这种顺序流水线在实践中既低效又低效：未预期证明过程而生成的程序可能隐含错误或在结构上难以验证，迫使 LLM 陷入交替修补代码和证明的脆弱循环。
Method: 提出 P^3 智能体工作流，受 Dijkstra 的“程序与其正确性论证应同步开发”观点启发；工作流先从规约构建统一的程序与证明计划，再据此细化程序实现与证明框架。同时构建 Lean4Commit0 基准，从真实软件仓库提取核心 API 并转译为含跨 API 关系规约的 Lean 任务。
Result: 在 Verina、AlgoVeri 与 Lean4Commit0 上使用四个前沿 LLM 后端，P^3 在每个 benchmark-model 设置下取得最高求解率；相对较强基线提升 4.6–11.2 个百分点，在困难子集上每任务 API 成本最多降低约 40%，墙钟时间最多降低约 37%。消融显示联合规划相对仅实现规划带来 3.3–8.3 个百分点的提升。
Conclusion: 作者强调程序与证明的联合规划是提高验证代码生成效率与效果的关键，并指出 Lean4Commit0 可用于更贴近真实场景的库级评测。

papers.title: Verifiably grounded machine interpretation of lunar geology
papers.abstract_en: Planetary geology relies on historical, interpretive reasoning to reconstruct past events from diverse observations. Here, we present a step toward an automated "machine intelligence geologist" by embedding this distinct methodology of geologic knowledge discovery and inference into a multimodal vision-language architecture. Focusing on the stratigraphy of lunar basaltic mare volcanism, we train a model to generate verifiably grounded geologic interpretations directly from co-registered topographic, spectral, and geologic maps. We demonstrate that while the system successfully balances established geological priors with local visual evidence to accurately describe stratigraphy and terrain, numeric age dating derived solely from vision defaults to memorized priors. Integrating an open-book retrieval mechanism resolves this, enabling the model to faithfully cite published chronologies. Our findings delineate the necessary architecture for automated geologic inference: site evidence must be visually interpreted from local data, while quantitative historical context must be retrieved from the scientific record.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向月球地质的自动化“机器智能地质学家”方案，将行星地质学中基于历史与解释性推理的知识发现方法嵌入多模态视觉-语言架构。模型基于配准的地形、光谱与地质图直接生成可验证的月球玄武岩月海火山活动地层学解释，并发现仅靠视觉进行数值年龄定年会退化为记忆先验，而引入开放书检索机制后可忠实引用已发表年代学。
Motivation: 行星地质学依赖历史性的解释推理来从多样观测中重建过去事件，而现有自动化方法难以承载这种知识发现与推断方法论，因此作者以月球玄武岩月海火山活动地层学为切入点填补该空白。
Method: 将地质知识发现与推断方法论嵌入多模态视觉-语言架构，训练模型从共配准的地形图、光谱图与地质图直接生成可验证的地质解释；并集成开放书检索机制，使定量历史背景能够从科学文献中检索并引用。
Result: 系统能在既定地质先验与局部视觉证据之间取得平衡，准确描述地层与地形；然而仅依赖视觉的数值年龄定年会退化为记忆先验，开放书检索机制解决了该问题，使模型能够忠实引用已发表年代学。
Conclusion: 作者据此界定自动化地质推断的必备架构：现场证据必须从局部数据进行视觉解释，而定量历史背景则须从科学记录中检索获得。

papers.title: Entropy-based Code Adversarial Translation for Real-world Repository Migration
papers.abstract_en: LLMs have demonstrated strong capabilities in code generation and automated program repair, but migrating an entire repository rarely produces a runnable application because long-horizon translation challenges LLM-based agents' ability to maintain repository-level migration objectives. In this work, we propose Entropy-based Code Adversarial Translation (ECAT), a multi-agent framework for automated Android-to-HarmonyOS repository migration. ECAT formulates repository migration as adversarial entropy minimization through a generator-discriminator architecture. The discriminator measures migration quality using a unified metric called Code Entropy and produces text gradients that specify both file-level generation directives and the skills needed to execute them. Guided by these optimization signals, the generator iteratively updates the repository, and each update is accepted only if it reduces Code Entropy. Repeated generator--discriminator interactions progressively drive the migration from an initial template toward a functionally complete HarmonyOS repository. Successful low-entropy trajectories are further distilled into a self-evolving memory tree, enabling transferable migration knowledge across repositories. We also introduce A2H-RepoBench, the first real-world benchmark for Android-to-HarmonyOS repository migration, covering applications from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of lines of code. Evaluated by node alignment and an agent-based functional judge, ECAT achieves 74.7% overall migration quality and consistently outperforms existing agent-based methods across repositories of different scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Entropy-based Code Adversarial Translation (ECAT)，一个面向 Android-to-HarmonyOS 仓库迁移的多智能体框架。ECAT 将仓库迁移建模为生成器-判别器架构下的对抗熵最小化，判别器用统一指标 Code Entropy 衡量迁移质量。作者还引入 A2H-RepoBench，据称是首个真实的 Android-to-HarmonyOS 仓库迁移基准，覆盖数万到数十万行代码的应用。评估显示 ECAT 达到 74.7% 的整体迁移质量，并在不同规模仓库上优于现有基于智能体的方法。
Motivation: 大语言模型在代码生成和自动程序修复上表现强，但迁移整个仓库时，长程翻译挑战会使基于 LLM 的智能体难以维持仓库级迁移目标，导致生成结果往往无法运行。
Method: ECAT 采用多智能体框架，包含生成器与判别器：判别器以统一指标 Code Entropy 评估迁移质量，并生成文本梯度，既包含文件级生成指令，也包含执行这些指令所需技能；生成器据此迭代更新仓库，且仅接受降低 Code Entropy 的更新。成功低熵轨迹被蒸馏进自进化的记忆树，以跨仓库传递可迁移的迁移知识。
Result: 在作者引入的 A2H-RepoBench 真实世界基准上，通过节点对齐和基于智能体的功能评判器评估，ECAT 达到 74.7% 的整体迁移质量，并在不同规模仓库上持续优于现有基于智能体的方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调重复的生成器-判别器交互能逐步将迁移从初始模板推进到功能完整的 HarmonyOS 仓库，且记忆树使迁移知识可跨仓库复用。

papers.title: SoftmaxGRPO: Learning to Reason using Softmax Advantage Group Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Group-based reinforcement learning objectives such as GRPO can allocate learning signal poorly across prompt difficulty: under binary rewards, group normalization induces a divergent weighting on easy prompts. We introduce Softmax Advantage Group Estimation (SoftmaxGRPO), a drop-in alternative that replaces z-score-normalized group advantages with temperature-scaled softmax advantages, keeping weights bounded regardless of prompt difficulty. For binary rewards, we derive the exact finite-group population objective and identify MaxRL as its low-temperature limit. For bounded scalar rewards, we show that the large-group update exactly optimizes a log-moment-generating-function objective, while a universal finite-group scalar objective cannot exist without additional assumptions on the reward distribution. Empirically, SoftmaxGRPO reallocates measured gradient budget away from near-solved prompts and consistently improves over GRPO under identical rewards. It reaches 51.8% on DeepMath with verifiable rewards and improves a 1.5B instruction-tuned model from 35.0% to 68.0% on Poetry using only lightweight text-similarity rewards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SoftmaxGRPO，一种即插即用的组强化学习目标，用于替代 GRPO 中以 z-score 归一化的组优势 (group advantage)。作者指出在二元奖励下组归一化会对简单提示产生发散权重，而 softmax 优势能保持权重有界；在 DeepMath 与 Poetry 基准上，SoftmaxGRPO 在相同奖励下一致优于 GRPO。
Motivation: 基于组的强化学习目标（如 GRPO）在提示难度变化时学习信号分配不佳：二元奖励下组归一化会对简单提示引入发散的加权，导致梯度预算被接近已解出的提示占据。
Method: 提出温度缩放的 softmax 优势替代 z-score 归一化组优势；对二元奖励推导了精确的有限组总体目标，并指出 MaxRL 是其低温极限；对一般有界标量奖励，证明大组更新精确优化对数矩母函数 (log-moment-generating function) 目标，同时说明没有额外奖励分布假设时不存在普适的有限组标量目标。
Result: 实验显示 SoftmaxGRPO 将梯度预算从接近解决的提示重新分配出去，并在相同奖励条件下一致优于 GRPO；在 DeepMath 可验证奖励上达到 51.8%，在 Poetry 上仅用轻量文本相似度奖励将 1.5B 指令微调模型从 35.0% 提升到 68.0%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 softmax 优势估计能跨提示难度稳定组强化学习的信号分配；其理论结果也表明，在缺乏奖励分布假设时，有限组的普适标量目标并不存在，这构成方法适用范围的边界。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: GRASP: Granularity-Aware Region Alignment and Semantic Prototype Learning for Fine-Grained Cross-Modal Understanding in Drone Views
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained cross-modal understanding in drone views is essential for aerial vision-language navigation. However, the inherent wide field of view and overhead perspective of drone scenarios impose dual challenges on vision-language understanding. At the macro level, overwhelming background clutter in visual representations leads to Cross-Modal Focus Misalignment, where the model prioritizes global environmental similarities over specific object details. At the micro level, Visual Isomorphism creates ambiguity, where candidates share similar geometric structures yet differ only in subtle attributes. To address these challenges, we propose the Granularity-Aware Region Alignment and Semantic Prototype (GRASP) learning framework, enhancing discriminative capability through two synergistic strategies. Specifically, we introduce Region-Focused Alignment (RFA) to promote object-centric cross-modal alignment while suppressing background interference. Concurrently, to tackle visual isomorphism, we propose Semantic Perturbation Enhanced Matching (SPEM), which leverages a foreground-purified Semantic Prototype Codebook (SPC) to construct semantically perturbed negatives for fine-grained semantic discrimination. Extensive experiments on the GeoText-1652 benchmark and the unseen ERA dataset demonstrate that GRASP achieves competitive performance in drone-view fine-grained image-text retrieval, validating its effectiveness for cross-modal understanding in aerial scenarios. Our code implementation is available at https://github.com/UCAS-JC/GRASP.

papers.title: Can Coding Agents Solve Repository-Level Issues with Rendered Code? An Exploratory Study of Visual Representations
papers.abstract_en: Visual modality has recently been explored as a way to compress textual tokens, including rendering code as images for static code understanding. We study whether this representation can serve as operational context for agentic coding, where an agent must navigate repositories, edit source files, and verify executable patches. Using SWE-bench Verified, we evaluate rendered code in repository-level repair workflows and introduce controlled agent settings to separate unguided repository exploration from more structured repair stages. Our results show a mixed picture. Rendered code consistently reduces prompt-token cost, but the savings do not increase linearly with the nominal visual compression ratio. It largely preserves end-to-end repair accuracy, but does not overcome the performance limits of the underlying model or agent architecture, and can become unstable under aggressive compression. Further analysis suggests that visual code is most useful when raw source reading is a major bottleneck; once repository localization is structured, much of the remaining cost comes from patch--test trial-and-error, where visual compression has limited leverage. Overall, our study positions rendered code as a viable but conditional compression mechanism for realistic coding agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索将代码渲染为图像（rendered code）作为智能体编码任务的视觉上下文，在 SWE-bench Verified 上评估仓库级代码修复流程。摘要显示：渲染代码一致降低 prompt-token 成本，但节省并不随名义视觉压缩比线性增长；它基本保持端到端修复精度，却不能突破底层模型或智能体架构的性能上限，且在激进压缩下会不稳定。作者通过受控智能体设置区分无引导的仓库探索与结构化修复阶段，定位视觉代码在原始源码阅读是主要瓶颈时最有用。
Motivation: 视觉模态近期被用于压缩文本 token（将代码渲染为图像以进行静态代码理解），但尚不清楚这种表示能否作为 agentic coding 的操作上下文，即智能体需要导航仓库、编辑源文件并验证可执行补丁。作者针对这一空白，在仓库级修复工作流中系统评估渲染代码的作用。
Method: 使用 SWE-bench Verified 基准，在仓库级修复工作流中评估渲染代码；引入受控智能体设置，将无引导的仓库探索与更结构化的修复阶段分离，以区分视觉表示在不同阶段的效果。
Result: 渲染代码一致降低 prompt-token 成本，但节省不随名义视觉压缩比线性增加；它大体上保持端到端修复准确率，但不能克服底层模型或智能体架构的性能限制，且在激进压缩下会不稳定。进一步分析表明，视觉代码在原始源码阅读是主要瓶颈时最有效；一旦仓库定位被结构化，剩余成本主要来自 patch-test 的反复试错，视觉压缩作用有限。
Conclusion: 作者将渲染代码定位为现实编码智能体的一种可行但有条件的压缩机制，其有效性取决于源码阅读瓶颈是否占据主导。

papers.title: Did the Grid Erase the Event? EndoClock for Auditing Medical World-Model Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Medical world models commonly learn from multimodal recordings synchronized onto a fixed-rate grid. This preprocessing resamples each native stream onto a shared time axis. Each stream has an observation clock that governs when observations are emitted or updated. When this clock depends on the latent or acquisition state, it is endogenous. In such settings, synchronization may not be neutral and can erase task-relevant evidence before the model sees the data. We introduce a four-regime taxonomy that characterizes where the evidence needed to distinguish a target event or state survives. The relevant witness may remain in the sampled values, in grid-cell update patterns, in native timing, or only in an external acquisition channel. EndoClock operationalizes this taxonomy as a conservative pretraining audit. It reports the lowest witness-bearing representation supported by the available evidence, or unresolved when no regime can be established. We illustrate this failure in echocardiography, where B-mode video write-outs cease during pulsed-wave Doppler acquisition while the corresponding measurement events remain recorded only in an external acquisition log. This work is a preliminary failure alert and executable audit. Its practical message is to preserve the native observation process long enough to determine whether synchronization has erased information required by the intended task.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 1st MICCAI Workshop on Medical World Models (MWM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学世界模型中将多模态记录同步到固定网格时可能丢失任务相关证据的问题，提出四类体制 (four-regime taxonomy) 来刻画目标事件证据存留的位置。作者将该分类学实现为名为 EndoClock 的保守预训练审计工具，报告证据可支持的最低表征体制或 unresolved 状态。论文以超声心动图为例说明脉冲波多普勒采集期间 B 模式视频写出的中断，并强调应保留原生观测过程以判断同步是否抹除了信息。
Motivation: 当每个观测流带有依赖潜在或采集状态的内生时钟 (endogenous clock) 时，同步到共享固定时间网格并非中性操作，可能在模型看到数据前就擦除任务相关证据。
Method: 提出四类体制分类学，区分证据存活于采样值、网格单元更新模式、原生时序或外部采集通道；EndoClock 以保守预训练审计方式报告最低可支持的证据表征体制。
Result: 该工作为初步失败警报 (preliminary failure alert) 与可执行审计，并在超声心动图中展示 B 模式视频写入在脉冲波多普勒采集期间停止、对应测量事件仅记录在外部采集日志中的失败案例。
Conclusion: 实际信息是应尽可能长久保留原生观测过程，以确定同步化是否擦除了目标任务所需的信息；作者未在摘要中给出定量评测结果。

papers.title: Entropic Partial Optimal Transport and Partial Gromov--Wasserstein Distance between Gaussian Mixtures
papers.abstract_en: Optimal transport and Gromov--Wasserstein distances are useful tools for comparing probability measures and metric measure spaces, but their balanced formulations force all mass to be matched. This constraint is often too strong for data with outliers, missing parts, or only partial overlap. In this paper, we develop entropic partial optimal transport for Gaussian mixture models and define a partial mixture Gromov--Wasserstein distance. For the finite entropic partial optimal transport problem, we prove the existence and uniqueness of the minimizer and establish quantitative large-penalty estimates. Moreover, the resulting entropic partial component couplings induce continuous partial transport plans through Gaussian optimal maps. We analyze their large-penalty and subsequent zero-entropy limits and construct the associated displacement interpolations and barycentric projection maps. In addition, by identifying each Gaussian mixture with a finite metric measure space of Gaussian components, we establish the metric property and large-penalty limit of the partial mixture Gromov--Wasserstein distance. Finally, numerical experiments on synthetic Gaussian mixtures and point clouds illustrate the effects of the penalty and entropic regularization and the robustness of partial matching to outliers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对平衡最优传输（optimal transport）和 Gromov–Wasserstein 距离强制全质量匹配、难以处理异常值与部分重叠数据的问题，为高斯混合模型发展熵正则部分最优传输，并定义部分混合 Gromov–Wasserstein 距离。作者证明有限熵正则部分最优传输问题极小元的存在唯一性，给出定量大惩罚估计，并分析相应部分耦合的零熵极限；通过将高斯混合视为由高斯分量构成的有限度量测度空间，还建立了部分混合 Gromov–Wasserstein 距离的度量性质与大惩罚极限。合成高斯混合和点云上的数值实验展示了惩罚项与熵正则化的作用以及对异常值的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 平衡最优传输和 Gromov–Wasserstein 距离要求所有质量都被匹配，这一约束在数据含有异常值、缺失部分或仅有部分重叠时过强，因此需要部分匹配（partial matching）的最优传输工具。
Method: 提出面向高斯混合模型的熵正则部分最优传输框架，并定义 partial mixture Gromov–Wasserstein 距离；通过高斯最优映射（Gaussian optimal maps）将熵正则部分分量耦合提升为连续部分传输计划，分析其大惩罚和零熵极限，并构造位移插值（displacement interpolation）与重心投影映射（barycentric projection maps）。
Result: 摘要证明有限熵正则部分最优传输问题极小元的存在性与唯一性，建立定量大惩罚估计；同时证明部分混合 Gromov–Wasserstein 距离满足度量性质并具有良好的大惩罚极限；数值实验表明该部分匹配方法对异常值具有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架为异常值、缺失或部分重叠数据提供了带理论保障的部分匹配距离，但实验仅覆盖合成高斯混合和点云数据。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Task-Adaptive 3D Cross-Field MRI Translation via Field-Conditioned Content-Style Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Magnetic field strength is a major source of domain shift in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), affecting signal-to-noise ratio, tissue contrast, spatial detail, and the visibility of anatomical boundaries. The MRIxFields 2026 challenge investigates this problem through cross-field MRI translation across acquisitions at 0.1T, 1.5T, 3T, 5T, and 7T. Its three tasks, Any-to-7T, 0.1T-to-High, and Any-to-Any synthesis, require the generation of target-field image characteristics while preserving subject-specific anatomy. This problem is particularly challenging because paired acquisitions of the same subject across multiple field strengths are rarely available for training. We propose a 3D unpaired cross-field MRI translation framework based on field-conditioned content-style pretraining. The proposed framework first learns controllable field-to-field translation across all available field strengths by disentangling anatomical content from field-dependent contrast characteristics. The pretrained backbone is then adapted to task-specific target domains. Our model comprises a 3D content encoder, a 3D style encoder, a field-conditioned style generator, an AdaIN-modulated decoder, and a multi-field discriminator. Adversarial learning encourages realistic target-field appearance, while cycle-consistency, identity, content, style, and diversity constraints promote anatomical fidelity and controllable translation. We evaluate the proposed method on MRIxFields data spanning five field strengths and three MRI modalities. Experiments on paired test data demonstrate that the framework can adapt to the three challenge settings while preserving three-dimensional anatomical structure in the synthesized volumes. The implementation code is publicly available at https://github.com/Idea89560041/3D-MRI-Field-Translation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于场强条件的内容-风格预训练（field-conditioned content-style pretraining）的3D无配对跨场强MRI翻译框架，用于解决MRIxFields 2026挑战中的三个任务：Any-to-7T、0.1T-to-High和Any-to-Any合成。模型在0.1T、1.5T、3T、5T、7T五种场强和三种MRI模态上学习可控的场间转换，并在保持三维解剖结构的同时生成目标场强特征。摘要报告配对测试数据上的实验表明框架能适应三种挑战设置。
Motivation: 磁场强度是MRI中域偏移的主要来源，影响信噪比、组织对比度、空间细节和解剖边界可见性。跨场强翻译的主要困难在于同一受试者跨多个场强的配对采集数据很少，难以直接监督学习。
Method: 提出3D无配对跨场强MRI翻译框架，先通过内容-风格解耦学习跨所有可用场强的可控场间翻译，再将预训练骨干适配到任务特定目标域。模型由3D内容编码器、3D风格编码器、场条件风格生成器、AdaIN调制解码器和多场判别器组成，结合对抗学习以及循环一致性、身份、内容、风格和多样性约束。
Result: 在MRIxFields数据（涵盖五种场强和三种MRI模态）上的配对测试数据实验表明，该方法能适配三个挑战设置，并保持合成体积的三维解剖结构。摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能够学习可控的场到场翻译并适配任务特定目标域，且实现代码已公开。摘要未提及明确的局限性。

papers.title: Privileged Likelihood Is Not Automatically Value: Three Checks for Token Credit in On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Outcome verifiers score completed reasoning traces but do not assign credit to intermediate tokens. Privileged self-distillation attempts to fill this gap by rescoring a model's own rollout with training-only information. A token likelihood change, however, is not automatically outcome credit. We separate three questions: whether the score tracks better actions, whether feedback construction changes what is compared, and what behavior the training loss reinforces. We establish these distinctions formally. When a rollout is scored using hindsight feedback written about that same rollout, its content determines both the tokens and the scoring context, creating direct self-dependence. Using feedback from another rollout of the same problem removes this dependence but does not guarantee a useful score. In matched experiments with a 20B model on AIME 2025, the implemented additive score is near chance (AUC=0.505) and slightly favors incorrect traces after length adjustment. In the paired comparison, the outcome-only control records 64.2\%, versus 24.2\%--33.9\% for five token-score variants. The results motivate validating score meaning, feedback construction, and training behavior separately before calling a likelihood signal credit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在策略自蒸馏（on-policy self-distillation）中，用特权信息（training-only information）对模型自身 rollout 重新评分时，token 似然变化是否等同于结果信用（outcome credit）。作者形式化区分三个问题：分数是否追踪更好的动作、反馈构造是否改变比较对象、训练损失强化何种行为，并指出用同一 rollout 的事后反馈会造成直接自依赖；用同问题另一 rollout 的反馈可消除该依赖但不保证分数有用。在 AIME 2025 上对 20B 模型的匹配实验中，实现的加性分数接近随机（AUC=0.505），配对比较中纯结果对照组为 64.2%，而五种 token 分数变体为 24.2%–33.9%。
Motivation: 结果验证器（outcome verifier）只对完整推理轨迹打分，无法给中间 token 分配信用；特权自蒸馏试图用训练时信息弥补这一缺口，但 token 似然变化本身并不自动等于结果信用，需要严格检验其含义。
Method: 作者形式化拆分三个问题：分数是否反映更优动作、反馈构造是否改变被比较内容、训练损失实际强化何种行为；并通过控制反馈来源（同一 rollout 的 hindsight 反馈 vs. 同问题另一 rollout 的反馈）来检验自依赖性的影响。
Result: 在 20B 模型与 AIME 2025 的匹配实验中，所实现的加性分数接近随机（AUC=0.505），长度调整后略偏向不正确轨迹；配对比较中，纯结果对照达 64.2%，而五种 token 分数变体仅为 24.2%–33.9%。
Conclusion: 在把似然信号称为信用（credit）之前，应分别验证分数含义、反馈构造和训练行为；当前实现的 token 评分并未带来有效的 token 级信用。

papers.title: SafeQL: Search-based Refinement for Safe and Efficient LLM-based Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have advanced Text-to-SQL by enabling natural language interfaces to databases without task-specific fine-tuning. However, existing LLM-based systems remain unreliable, often generating SQL queries that are invalid under the database schema, referencing non-existent tables, attributes, functions, or values. Such errors persist because interactions with the database management system (DBMS) are typically limited to error messages, leaving it in a largely passive role during query refinement. This paper proposes SafeQL, \textit{a search-based refinement paradigm that redefines the role of the DBMS as an active guide in the refinement process}. Instead of regenerating entire queries after execution failure, SafeQL interprets DBMS feedback to incrementally repair only the erroneous components. Each refinement step is formulated as a guided search within a \textit{safe query space}, where candidate queries are progressively validated through DBMS execution, thereby converging to an executable query and preventing repeated regeneration of errors. Experiments on the Bird and Spider benchmarks show that SafeQL significantly improves execution accuracy and efficiency compared to regeneration-based methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SafeQL，一种基于搜索的 SQL 查询精化框架，将数据库管理系统（DBMS）从被动反馈源转变为主动引导者。与 LLM 在 SQL 执行失败后重新生成整个查询不同，SafeQL 逐步修复错误组件，并在执行验证的约束下进行引导式搜索。在 Bird 和 Spider 基准上，实验显示其执行准确率和效率优于基于重新生成的方法。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的文本到 SQL 系统在生成的查询不符合数据库模式时不可靠，往往引用不存在的表、属性、函数或值。这些错误难以修复，因为与 DBMS 的交互通常仅限于错误信息，使得 DBMS 在查询精化中始终处于被动角色。
Method: SafeQL 提出了搜索式的精化范式，将 DBMS 重新定义为精化过程中的主动引导者。它不会在执行失败后重新生成整个查询，而是解释 DBMS 反馈并增量修复错误的 SQL 部分。每一步精化都被表述为在安全的查询空间（safe query space）内的引导搜索，候选查询通过 DBMS 执行逐步验证，从而收敛到可执行的查询并防止重复生成错误。
Result: 在 Bird 和 Spider 基准上，SafeQL 相比基于重新生成的方法显著提高了执行准确率和效率。
Conclusion: 将 DBMS 执行反馈整合为查询精化中的主动引导，能够带来更安全、更高效的 LLM 文本到 SQL 精化，减少对重新生成的依赖。

papers.title: Full-Feature versus Limited-Input Machine Learning for Residential Energy Estimation: A Comparative Analysis of RECS and ResStock Under Realistic Input Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Residential energy estimates are often needed before detailed envelope characteristics, equipment efficiencies, infiltration, sensor, or billing data are available. This study quantifies the trade-off between predictive accuracy and input accessibility using two nationally representative U.S. residential-energy datasets: the survey-based Residential Energy Consumption Survey (RECS) and the simulation-based ResStock dataset. Full-feature models were first used to establish dataset-specific performance benchmarks. For total-energy estimation, the models were subsequently restricted to ten low-burden variables obtainable from occupants, administrative records, or location-based weather data without an on-site energy audit. Among CatBoost, XGBoost, LightGBM, Random Forest, and Neural Networks, CatBoost consistently achieved the highest predictive performance for the full-feature analysis, reaching R2 = 0.90 for ResStock and R2 = 0.73 for RECS. When the feature set was restricted to ten homeowner-accessible inputs to simulate realistic deployment conditions, model performance converged to R2 = 0.61 for RECS and R2 = 0.62 for ResStock, showing that algorithmic complexity cannot fully compensate for missing physical and behavioral information. However, for a more homogeneous ResStock cohort consisting of single-family detached, natural-gas-heated homes in Climate Zone 6A constructed between 2000 and 2010, a reduced-input model improved accuracy to R2 = 0.85, demonstrating the value of targeted modeling for homogeneous populations. The results indicate that tree-based ensemble models can serve as high-fidelity emulators of national-scale residential energy datasets. However, careful consideration of feature availability, dataset origin (empirical vs. synthetic), and applicable use cases are also important.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对比了全特征与受限输入条件下机器学习模型在美国住宅能耗估计中的表现，使用的数据集为调查性的 RECS 和模拟性的 ResStock。全特征下 CatBoost 表现最佳，R² 分别达到 0.90（ResStock）和 0.73（RECS）；当输入被限制为十个居民易获取变量时，两类数据上的性能收敛至约 R² = 0.61–0.62。对于更同质的住宅子集，简化输入模型的 R² 可提升至 0.85，表明面向同质人群的针对性建模有价值。
Motivation: 住宅能耗估计往往需要在获得详细的围护结构特征、设备效率、渗透率、传感器或账单数据之前完成，而现有模型对输入数据可得性的权衡缺乏系统量化。本文旨在评估在不进行现场能源审计的情况下，仅使用居民、行政记录或基于位置的天气数据等低负担变量时，预测精度会损失多少。
Method: 利用 RECS 和 ResStock 两个全国代表性数据集，先建立全特征模型作为性能基准，再将总能耗模型限制为十个低负担变量。比较 CatBoost、XGBoost、LightGBM、Random Forest 和神经网络，并针对一个由独栋、天然气供暖、位于 6A 气候区、建于 2000–2010 年的住宅组成的同质子集进行受限输入建模。
Result: 全特征分析中 CatBoost 一致取得最高性能，对 ResStock 达 R² = 0.90，对 RECS 达 R² = 0.73。特征受限后，RECS 上 R² = 0.61，ResStock 上 R² = 0.62，说明算法复杂度无法完全弥补物理与行为信息的缺失。在同质子集上，受限输入模型将 R² 提升至 0.85。
Conclusion: 树集成模型可以作为全国尺度住宅能耗数据集的高保真代理模型，但需要谨慎考虑特征可得性、数据集来源（经验 vs. 合成）以及具体应用场景。

papers.title: Business Truth, not SQL Accuracy: A Rule-Gated 7B Analytics Agent Outperforms a Direct-Prompted 32B Baseline
papers.abstract_en: LLM analytics agents are evaluated on SQL syntax accuracy, but production failures look different: questions with two valid business definitions, questions the warehouse cannot answer, deprecated columns after a schema change, and queries that execute successfully while returning the wrong business number. No execution-match metric can score them. This paper introduces WarehouseReliabilityBench, 400 frozen tasks over two synthetic warehouses in which roughly half the correct responses are a clarification, an abstention or a refusal, with pinned denominators and a pre-registered paired bootstrap fixing each claim verb before the numbers existed. QueryProof, a 7B agent, uses rules derived from a semantic layer and physical catalog to determine its behaviour, and gates every answer on deterministic post-execution checks. On an 80-task synthetic test split evaluated once, QueryProof outperforms a direct-prompted 32B baseline by +0.237 [+0.112, +0.375] Business Truth Rate at 71.0% lower cost per correct answer; against a cost-matched few-shot baseline the accuracy gain holds but the cost difference does not resolve. This compares systems rather than model sizes: the 32B baseline receives none of the scaffolding. False success falls from 0.754 to 0.351 of returned answers, and no wrong number was returned on an answerable task (0 of 24), though 13 answers went to questions requiring clarification or abstention. Removing the routing layer changes little (0.562 against 0.537), so the result does not depend on escalation. Routing tuned on validation over-abstains on test, and the fitted confidence model loses to the heuristic it replaced. Resampling template families rather than tasks widens both accuracy intervals to include zero, so the effect's direction is better supported than its magnitude. The gain tracks the deterministic layer, though no component ablation was run.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 7 figures, 11 tables. Benchmark, code, run records, pre-registration and one-command reproduction: https://github.com/k-w-lee/query_proof
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 分析智能体在生产中失败的形式与 SQL 语法正确性不同的问题，提出 WarehouseReliabilityBench 基准（400 个冻结任务，基于两个合成数据仓库，约一半正确答案是澄清、弃答或拒绝），并介绍 7B 智能体 QueryProof。QueryProof 使用从语义层和物理目录推导出的规则，并对每个答案施加确定性执行后检查；在 80 个任务的测试集上，其 Business Truth Rate 比直接提示的 32B 基线高 +0.237（95% CI [0.112, 0.375]），且每个正确答案的成本降低 71.0%。摘要同时报告假成功从 0.754 降至 0.351，可回答任务上没有返回错误业务数字（0/24），但方向稳健性比幅度更受支持。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 分析智能体按 SQL 语法准确率评估，但生产中的失败表现为：存在两种有效业务定义的问题、仓库无法回答的问题、schema 变更后的废弃列，以及成功执行却返回错误业务数字的查询。这些情况无法用执行匹配指标打分。
Method: 构建 WarehouseReliabilityBench：400 个冻结任务、固定分母和预注册的配对 bootstrap（在数字出现前固定每个论断表述）。提出 7B 智能体 QueryProof，规则来自语义层和物理目录，并用确定性执行后检查门控每个答案；同时与直接提示的 32B 基线和成本匹配的少样本基线对比。
Result: QueryProof 在 80 任务测试集上以 +0.237 [+0.112, +0.375] 的 Business Truth Rate 超过直接提示 32B 基线，每个正确答案成本低 71.0%；对成本匹配的少样本基线，准确率优势保持但成本差异不显著。假成功从 0.754 降至 0.351，可回答任务无错误数字（0/24），但有 13 个回答落入需要澄清或弃答的问题。移除路由层变化很小（0.562 对 0.537），而用验证集调优的路由在测试集上过度弃答，拟合的置信模型也不如被替换的启发式。按模板族而非任务重采样时，两个准确率区间都包含零，因此效应方向比幅度更受支持。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是系统对比而非模型规模对比：32B 基线没有获得任何脚手架；增益主要来自确定性检查层，但未做组件消融。由于重采样模板族时置信区间包含零，结论应解读为效应方向可靠而幅度不确定。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有 LLM 分析智能体按 SQL 语法准确率评估，但生产中的失败表现为：存在两种有效业务定义的问题、仓库无法回答的问题、schema 变更后的废弃列，以及成功执行却返回错误业务数字的查询。这些情况无法用执行匹配指标打分。
summary_sections.method: 构建 WarehouseReliabilityBench：400 个冻结任务、固定分母和预注册的配对 bootstrap（在数字出现前固定每个论断表述）。提出 7B 智能体 QueryProof，规则来自语义层和物理目录，并用确定性执行后检查门控每个答案；同时与直接提示的 32B 基线和成本匹配的少样本基线对比。
summary_sections.result: QueryProof 在 80 任务测试集上以 +0.237 [+0.112, +0.375] 的 Business Truth Rate 超过直接提示 32B 基线，每个正确答案成本低 71.0%；对成本匹配的少样本基线，准确率优势保持但成本差异不显著。假成功从 0.754 降至 0.351，可回答任务无错误数字（0/24），但有 13 个回答落入需要澄清或弃答的问题。移除路由层变化很小（0.562 对 0.537），而用验证集调优的路由在测试集上过度弃答，拟合的置信模型也不如被替换的启发式。按模板族而非任务重采样时，两个准确率区间都包含零，因此效应方向比幅度更受支持。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调这是系统对比而非模型规模对比：32B 基线没有获得任何脚手架；增益主要来自确定性检查层，但未做组件消融。由于重采样模板族时置信区间包含零，结论应解读为效应方向可靠而幅度不确定。

papers.title: SkillSentry: Reliable Skill Execution for LLM Agents via Runtime Assurance
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly equipped with skills to perform complex tasks through multi-step reasoning and tool use. Although skills provide reusable procedural knowledge, agents may still execute them unreliably. Even when an agent has demonstrated the capability to complete tasks under the guidance of a skill, it may fail to do so consistently across similar tasks or repeated runs due to deviations from the skill procedure or incorrect execution of individual steps. Such instability limits the practical reliability of LLM agents. To address this problem, we propose SkillSentry, a skill-oriented runtime assurance framework built upon a new domain-specific language (DSL) for representing runtime guidance for skill execution. SkillSentry initializes the runtime guidance by combining a skill specification extracted from the corresponding skill document with execution experience mined from historical successful and failed traces. It then wraps around the agent execution loop to monitor and guide skill execution under the current guidance, while iteratively refining the guidance using newly collected traces. We evaluate SkillSentry on 15 skills across two LLM agents, each paired with two backbone models, i.e., Claude Code with Claude-Haiku-4.5 and Claude-Opus-4.6, and Codex with GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.4. Our results show that SkillSentry improves the task success rate of LLM agents by 24.1% across skills, on average, while exhibiting lower variability across repeated runs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillSentry，一个面向 LLM 智能体技能执行的运行时保障框架。它基于专用领域特定语言 (DSL) 表示技能执行的运行时指导，通过技能规范与历史执行轨迹（成功与失败）初始化指导，并在执行循环中监控、引导并迭代更新指导。在 15 个技能、两个智能体（Claude Code 与 Codex）分别搭配两种骨干模型上的评估显示，技能任务成功率平均提升 24.1%，且重复运行间的波动更低。
Motivation: LLM 智能体即使具备技能并曾展示完成能力，仍可能在相似任务或重复运行中因偏离技能流程或单步执行错误而不稳定，这限制了实际可靠性。
Method: SkillSentry 构建在用于表示技能执行运行时指导的新 DSL 之上；先从技能文档提取技能规范，并从历史成功与失败轨迹挖掘执行经验以初始化指导；随后环绕智能体执行循环，在指导监督下监控并引导执行，同时利用新收集的轨迹迭代细化指导。
Result: 在 15 个技能、两个 LLM 智能体（Claude Code 和 Codex）各配两种骨干模型（Claude-Haiku-4.5/Claude-Opus-4.6、GPT-5.2/GPT-5.4）上，SkillSentry 平均将任务成功率提升 24.1%，并降低重复运行间变异性。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于技能规范和轨迹挖掘的运行时保障能够显著提升 LLM 智能体技能执行的可靠性与稳定性。

papers.title: MoRSE: Task-Oriented Multi-Agent System with Mixture of Role-Subtask Experts
papers.abstract_en: Large language model-based multi-agent systems have recently shown strong potential for complex, long-horizon tasks. However, existing methods mainly rely on coarse prompt-level differentiation without parameter adaptation for diverse subtasks, resulting in insufficient inter-agent heterogeneity and limited specialized capability that bottleneck performance on tasks with complex requirements. To address this, we introduce a Task-Oriented Multi-Agent System with Mixture of Role-Subtask Experts (MoRSE) that distinguishes agents with (role, subtask)-conditional specialization at both the task structure and parameter levels. To make agents' responsibility explicit at the task structure level, we formulate a task-oriented multi-agent system that decomposes each task into a dependency-aware Directed Acyclic Graph of subtasks and assigns each agent a specific (role, subtask), introducing task-level specialization across collaborating agents. Additionally, to address the diverse role and subtask parameter adaptation demands, we propose a dynamic Mixture of (role, subtask) LoRA Experts module with a prototype-based semantic router for subtasks, augmenting agents with parameter-level specialization on a shared LLM substrate cost-effectively. Then, to co-optimize experts and router stably under sparse task rewards, we further propose a hierarchical group-relative policy optimization with two-layer credit assignment that isolates expert updates from the cross-route variance introduced by routing decisions, disentangling expert quality from routing quality. Experiments on code-generation benchmarks across three backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, with improvements in both whole-task and step-wise performance, and the gains from trained specialization generalize across held-out task categories and domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MoRSE，一个面向任务的、在角色与子任务层面做条件化特化的多智能体系统。系统将任务分解为依赖感知的有向无环图，并为每个智能体分配具体的 (role, subtask)；同时引入基于 (role, subtask) 的动态 LoRA 专家模块和原型语义路由器，在共享 LLM 基座上实现参数级特化。作者还提出分层组相对策略优化来稳定联合优化专家与路由器。实验在三个骨干模型上的代码生成基准上验证了整体任务与逐步性能的提升。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的多智能体系统主要依赖粗粒度的提示级差异化，缺乏针对不同子任务的参数级适应，导致智能体间异质性不足、专门能力受限，成为复杂长时程任务性能的瓶颈。
Method: 在任务结构层面，将任务分解为依赖感知的有向无环图并给每个智能体分配 (role, subtask)；在参数层面，设计基于 (role, subtask) 的 LoRA 专家模块搭配原型语义路由器；训练上提出分层组相对策略优化，通过两层信用分配隔离专家更新与路由决策带来的跨路由方差，解耦专家质量与路由质量。
Result: 在三个骨干模型上的代码生成基准中，MoRSE 在整体任务和逐步性能上均有提升，且已训练的特化能力可泛化到保留的任务类别与领域。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在任务结构与参数层面同时引入 (role, subtask) 条件化特化可以有效提升复杂任务上的多智能体协作性能。

papers.title: FEAST: Federated Shared-Space Training for Resource-Heterogeneous Clients
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) must serve devices with varying computational capabilities. A fixed model cannot suit all devices, while training one model per deployment limit is costly. Federated supernet training instead learns one elastic model with differently sized subnetworks, then deploys a suitable one to each device. When client inference budgets differ, however, parameters exclusive to high-cost subnetworks are reachable by fewer clients. We propose FEAST, a federated shared-space training framework that counters this imbalance by jointly training multiple subnetworks within each client's limit. Budget-tailored sub-supernet routing sends only the relevant supernet portion, and sparse aggregation merges the returned parameter slices. The trained supernet directly serves the subnetworks used during federation and supports post-hoc extraction of additional subnetworks without federated retraining. We further show that independently assigning clients' training-data volumes and inference budgets can distort accuracy--inference-cost comparisons in heterogeneous FL simulations, and introduce a one-parameter $γ$-allocation protocol to control this coupling. In our experimental setup, the SuperFedNAS and DeepFedNAS supernet training procedures remain near chance at 25M and reach at most $17.09\%$ at $596$M inference MACs; FEAST reaches $71.06\%$ at $596$M, $2.4$ points above the strongest model-heterogeneous weight-sharing baseline at its largest tier. Across CIFAR-100, CINIC-10, and TinyImageNet-200, FEAST achieves the highest population-averaged accuracy among the evaluated weight-sharing methods when each client receives its largest affordable subnetwork. Sub-supernet routing reduces aggregate model-parameter traffic by $6.8\times$ relative to full-supernet transmission.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FEAST，一个面向资源异构客户端的联邦共享空间训练 (shared-space training) 框架，用于解决联邦超网络 (federated supernet) 训练中高成本子网络专属参数只被少量客户端更新导致的精度不均衡问题。FEAST 在每个客户端预算内联合训练多个子网络，并通过预算定制的子超网络路由 (sub-supernet routing) 与稀疏聚合 (sparse aggregation) 降低通信开销；训练后的超网络可直接服务联邦中使用的子网络，并支持事后提取额外子网络而无需重新联邦训练。实验显示 FEAST 在多个基准上显著优于现有权重共享方法。
Motivation: 联邦学习需要服务计算能力各异的设备，固定模型无法适配所有设备，而按部署配置逐一训练成本高昂。联邦超网络训练虽能学习一个弹性模型，但当客户端推理预算不同时，高成本子网络独有的参数只能被少数客户端更新，造成训练不平衡。
Method: 提出 FEAST 框架，在客户端预算约束内联合训练多个子网络；采用预算定制的子超网络路由只传输超网络中相关部分，并用稀疏聚合合并返回的参数切片。此外引入带单参数 γ 的分配协议 (γ-allocation protocol)，用于控制客户端训练数据量与推理预算在异构联邦模拟中的耦合效应。
Result: 在实验设置中，SuperFedNAS 与 DeepFedNAS 超网络训练流程在 25M 时接近随机水平，在 596M 推理 MACs 下最高仅达 17.09%；FEAST 在 596M 下达到 71.06%，比最强模型异构权重共享基线在其最大规模档高 2.4 个百分点。在 CIFAR-100、CINIC-10 和 TinyImageNet-200 上，当每个客户端获得其可负担的最大子网络时，FEAST 在评估的权重共享方法中取得最高群体平均精度；子超网络路由相比全超网络传输将聚合模型参数流量降低 6.8 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为独立分配客户端训练数据量与推理预算会扭曲异构联邦模拟中的精度-推理成本比较，γ 分配协议可控制这一耦合。FEAST 训练出的超网络可直接服务联邦中使用的子网络，并支持无需联邦重训练的事后子网络提取。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Emotion2Skill: Model-Internal Emotion Signals for Adaptive Skill Selection and Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Skill-based LLM agents select reusable procedures from an external library to solve complex tasks, yet their routing decisions rely entirely on text-level signals such as task descriptions, verbal reflections, and experience-derived rules, while the model's own internal representational state remains unobserved. Recent interpretability work has shown that LLMs maintain linear emotion representations that causally influence behavior; however, these representations have been exploited only for post-hoc analysis or direct output steering, and have not been used to inform agent-level decision-making. We propose Emotion2Skill, a framework that extracts LLM-internal emotion vectors and incorporates them into both skill selection and skill evolution. At each decision step, a 27-dimensional emotion state is extracted from the residual stream and mapped to a confidence-gated summary injected into the routing prompt. Beyond online selection, emotion trajectories are analyzed for abrupt internal-state shifts to pinpoint problematic skill invocations, guiding targeted SOP rewriting that replaces the coarse binary outcome signal of prior methods. On WebShop and ALFWorld, Emotion2Skill with Qwen3-8B improves over the Zero-Shot baseline by +26.9% success rate and +25.5% average success respectively, outperforming all baselines on both benchmarks with consistent gains on Qwen3-14B. Co-activation analysis further reveals semantically coherent emotion--skill pairings, confirming that the routing improvements reflect meaningful internal-state signals rather than opaque statistical correlations. These results establish LLM-internal emotion representations as an effective decision-level signal for orchestrating agent skill systems, extending their utility beyond interpretability and output steering. The code is available at https://github.com/BoHan-LIN04/Emotion2Skill.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Emotion2Skill 框架，从 LLM 残差流中提取内部的 27 维情感向量，并将其用于基于技能的 agent 的在线技能选择与技能演化。在 WebShop 和 ALFWorld 上，用 Qwen3-8B 相比 Zero-Shot 基线分别提升 +26.9% 成功率与 +25.5% 平均成功，并优于所有基线。
Motivation: 现有基于技能的 LLM agent 在路由决策时只依赖文本层面的信号（任务描述、口头反思、经验规则），而模型自身的内部表征状态未被观察；已有可解释性工作表明 LLM 维持线性情感表示且因果影响行为，但这些表示仅用于事后分析或直接输出引导，未用于 agent 级决策。
Method: 在每个决策步从残差流提取 27 维情感状态，映射为置信门控摘要注入路由提示；同时分析情感轨迹中突发的内部状态偏移，以定位有问题的技能调用，并指导针对性的 SOP 重写，取代先前方法粗糙的二元结果信号。
Result: 在 WebShop 和 ALFWorld 上，Emotion2Skill 搭配 Qwen3-8B 相比 Zero-Shot 基线分别提升 +26.9% 成功率与 +25.5% 平均成功，在两个基准上均优于所有基线，并在 Qwen3-14B 上保持一致增益；共激活分析显示语义连贯的情感-技能配对。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LLM 内部情感表示可作为有效的决策级信号来编排 agent 技能系统，将其用途从可解释性和输出引导扩展到决策层面；代码已开源。

papers.title: An Explainable GNN Framework for Component-Level Anomaly Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Industrial processes are complex systems composed of multiple interacting sensors that generate multivariate time series (MTS). Detecting anomalies in such systems is critical for reliability and safety, yet understanding their origin is equally important. Existing Graph Neural Network (GNN)based methods for anomaly detection primarily focus on sensor-level deviations and either attribute anomalies directly to the deviating sensors. When diagnosis is attempted, generally, the most deviated sensor is identified as a root cause of a system fault. However, in many industrial systems, anomalies do not arise from faulty sensors but from disruptions in the influences governing the system dynamics. We propose an explainable GNN-based anomaly detection framework that shifts the perspective from sensor-level anomalies to component-level diagnosis, hypothesizing that anomalous measurements are symptoms of altered inter-sensor influences. Experiments show that the method effectively identifies and prioritizes the true faulty components, providing interpretable insights into system failures.
papers.journal_ref: The 37th International Conference on Principles of Diagnosis and Resilient Systems, Sep 2026, Cork (Irlande), Ireland
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可解释的图神经网络 (GNN) 异常检测框架，面向工业过程中多变量时间序列 (MTS) 的组件级诊断。其核心观点是异常测量值应被视为传感器间影响关系被破坏的症状，而不是直接把最异常传感器当作根因；实验表明该方法能够识别并排序真正的故障组件，提供可解释的故障洞察。
Motivation: 现有基于 GNN 的异常检测主要关注传感器级偏差，诊断时通常把偏差最大的传感器当作根因，但在许多工业系统中异常源自系统动态影响关系的扰动而非传感器本身故障。
Method: 提出可解释 GNN 异常检测框架，将视角从传感器级异常转向组件级诊断，建模传感器之间的影响关系，并据此推断异常测量背后的故障组件。
Result: 摘要报告实验表明该方法能有效识别并优先排序真实故障组件，为系统故障提供可解释的洞察。
Conclusion: 该方法强调异常测量是传感器间影响被改变的症状，组件级诊断比直接归因于最异常传感器更符合工业系统故障机理。
