papers.title: In-Loop Model Adaptation with Coupled Latent-Noise Guidance for High-Fidelity Subject-Driven Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generating high-quality images from a given text prompt. Subject-driven generation aims to synthesize customized images to mimic the appearance of subjects in given reference images within different visual contexts specified by the text prompts. The central challenge here is that, when the reference image changes, the diffusion model cannot efficiently adapt to different visual contexts while consistently maintaining the subject identity. Existing methods either train the model with a large domain-specific dataset or fine-tune the model using the reference image for hundreds of iterations before actual image generation. In this work, we explore a new approach, called \textit{In-Loop Model Adaptation} (IMA), which adapts the core diffusion model at each generation step during the actual process of image generation, without being trained on the reference image before the generation process. To this end, we establish a DDIM inversion chain that maps the reference image to a sequence of latent, as well as a text-to-image generation chain which generates the image from the text prompt only. We then introduce a masked latent consistency loss and a noise regularization loss to characterize the latent-noise difference between the diffusion model and these two chains at each generation step. This coupled latent-noise loss is used to guide the in-loop model adaptation to preserve the subject identity specified by the reference image while maintaining accurate alignment with the text prompt, resulting in high-fidelity text-to-image generation. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed IMA method significantly improves the performance of subject-driven text-to-image generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 In-Loop Model Adaptation (IMA) 方法，在文本到图像扩散模型的生成过程中逐步骤调整核心模型，使模型在保持参考图像主体身份的同时生成符合文本提示内容的高保真图像。该方法不需要预先在参考图像上训练或微调，而是通过 DDIM 反转链与文生图链之间的潜变量-噪声一致性损失来引导适应。
Motivation: 主题驱动生成（subject-driven generation）需要在参考图像改变时同时兼顾主体身份一致性与不同文本上下文的对齐，而现有方法要么依赖大规模领域数据集训练，要么在生成前对参考图像进行数百次迭代微调，效率较低。
Method: 建立将参考图像映射为潜变量序列的 DDIM inversion 链，以及仅由文本提示驱动的文生图链；引入掩码潜变量一致性损失（masked latent consistency loss）和噪声正则化损失，在每个生成步骤刻画扩散模型与两条链之间的潜变量-噪声差异，并用该耦合损失引导模型在生成过程中的逐步适应。
Result: 大量实验表明，所提出的 IMA 方法显著提升了主题驱动文本到图像生成的主体身份保持与文本对齐性能，但摘要未给出具体数据集或数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为在生成过程中逐步骤动态适应扩散模型，无需生成前训练或微调，即可实现高保真的主题驱动文本到图像生成。

papers.title: Multimodal Federated Learning under Dual-Axis Modality Missingness
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal federated learning (FL) supports collaborative modeling in privacy-sensitive health-sensing and medical settings, but realistic deployments often exhibit dual-axis modality missingness: clients have different modality sets, and individual samples may contain only subsets of the modalities available locally. Existing methods typically address these two axes separately. We propose Flux, a multimodal federated learning framework built around two complementary components. First, modality-aware confidence tempering learns sample-specific confidence for each modality through mask-aware unimodal supervision and fuses the confidence estimates from observed modalities into a sample-adaptive temperature that adjusts predictive sharpness according to evidence quality and completeness. Second, gradient-decoupled private adaptation applies this temperature only to a client-private prediction pathway, while training the shared federated model with a standard, untempered objective. This enables sample-specific, client-local confidence adaptation without allowing confidence-dependent gradients to perturb shared representation learning. Across four multimodal datasets, Flux achieves the highest average macro-F1 on every dataset, outperforming the strongest dataset-specific baseline by 0.8~2.2 points and by 1.6 points on average. Additional analyses demonstrate favorable calibration, temperature sensitivity to both modality missingness and input corruption, and more stable shared optimization under private-only tempering. Our code is available at https://github.com/AdibaOrz/Flux.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Flux，一个针对多模态联邦学习（multimodal FL）中双轴模态缺失（dual-axis modality missingness）问题的框架：客户端之间拥有不同模态集合，且单个样本可能只包含本地可用模态的子集。Flux 由两个互补组件构成，一是模态感知置信度温度调节（modality-aware confidence tempering），二是梯度解耦的私有适应（gradient-decoupled private adaptation）。摘要报告其在四个多模态数据集上都取得最高平均 macro-F1，并展现出更好的校准与更稳定的共享优化。
Motivation: 实际部署中的多模态联邦学习常同时出现两类模态缺失：客户端间模态集不同、样本内模态不完整，而现有方法通常分别处理这两个维度，缺乏联合建模。该问题在隐私敏感的健康感知和医疗场景中尤为突出。
Method: Flux 首先通过掩码感知的单模态监督（mask-aware unimodal supervision）为每个模态学习样本级置信度，并将观测到的模态置信度融合为样本自适应的温度，以根据证据质量和完整性调整预测锐度；随后只在客户端私有的预测通路中应用该温度，而共享联邦模型仍用标准未调温目标训练，从而避免置信度相关梯度干扰共享表示学习。
Result: 在四个多模态数据集上，Flux 均取得最高平均 macro-F1，比最强的数据集特定基线高出 0.8~2.2 个点，平均高出 1.6 个点。附加分析表明其校准良好，温度对模态缺失和输入损坏均有敏感性，且私有通路调温下共享优化更稳定。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将温度调节限制在客户端私有通路可以实现样本级、客户端局部的置信度适应，同时不扰动共享表示学习；该方法面向隐私敏感的多模态联邦学习场景，代码已公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RealDenseFace: Real-time Monocular 3D Face Reconstruction from Dense UV-space Priors
papers.abstract_en: Recent monocular 3D face reconstruction methods achieve high fidelity by fitting a 3D Morphable Model (3DMM) to dense priors predicted by networks, but the optimization stage is computationally expensive, often taking tens of seconds per image. We present RealDenseFace, a real-time optimization-based 3D face reconstruction method with dense UV-space network predictions. Our key idea is to formulate 3DMM fitting as a nonlinear least-squares problem and solve it with a tailored Gauss-Newton solver that converges in only a few iterations. The reconstruction is conducted in two stages. In the first stage, the network predicts two dense UV-space maps from a single RGB image: a correspondence map for UV-to-image alignment, and a relative-depth map for geometric constraints along the viewing direction. In the second stage, the solver fits per-vertex targets sampled from these maps at the vertex UV coordinates. The solver supports all three reconstruction settings: single-image fitting, offline sequence reconstruction, and online tracking. Our method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on the NeRSemble SVFR benchmark. The online tracker runs at 80+ FPS, and the offline sequence reconstruction is over 20 times faster than previous optimization-based baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RealDenseFace 提出一种基于优化的实时单目 3D 人脸重建方法。网络从单张 RGB 图像预测两个稠密 UV 空间图（对应图与相对深度图），再将 3DMM 拟合构造为非线性最小二乘问题，用定制的高斯-牛顿求解器在数步内收敛。该方法支持单图拟合、离线序列重建与在线跟踪三种设置，在 NeRSemble SVFR 基准上达到当前最优精度，在线跟踪超过 80 FPS，离线序列重建比此前基于优化的基线快 20 倍以上。
Motivation: 现有基于优化的单目 3D 人脸重建方法通过将 3DMM 拟合到网络预测的稠密先验上取得高保真度，但优化阶段计算开销大，每张图像常需数十秒，难以满足实时应用需求。
Method: 将 3DMM 拟合建模为非线性最小二乘问题，并使用专为该问题设计的高斯-牛顿 (Gauss-Newton) 求解器，仅需少量迭代即可收敛。网络第一阶段预测稠密 UV 空间对应图（用于 UV 到图像对齐）和相对深度图（用于视线方向的几何约束），第二阶段在顶点 UV 坐标处采样目标值进行拟合。
Result: 在 NeRSemble SVFR 基准上取得当前最优精度；在线跟踪速度超过 80 FPS，离线序列重建比此前基于优化的基线快 20 倍以上。
Conclusion: 作者认为将优化问题高效求解与稠密 UV 空间网络先验结合，可以在保持高精度的同时实现实时或近实时的单目 3D 人脸重建。

papers.title: Label Granularity Skew in Federated Learning with Hierarchical Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning enables privacy-preserving collaboration across distributed devices without centralizing local data. However, clients may differ not only in data distributions but also in domain knowledge and annotation capabilities. In this paper, we introduce label granularity skew, a new form of statistical heterogeneity in federated hierarchical classification, in which clients provide taxonomy-consistent labels at different levels of detail within a shared class hierarchy. To model this heterogeneity, we generate client-specific local label hierarchies using a probabilistic relational neighbor classifier and construct a WordNet-guided hierarchy via silhouette score-based coarsening. Our analysis shows that strongly coupled hierarchical models are sensitive to incomplete supervision, while the conditional softmax classifier is more robust. Based on this insight, we propose Branch-wise Decoupled Fine-Tuning (BDFT) and its federated version, FedBDFT, which fine-tune branch-wise classifiers and aggregate them through federated optimization. Experiments on CIFAR-100, TinyImageNet, and ImageNet show that FedBDFT substantially improves robustness under severe label granularity skew, with average gains of 27.9% and 56.4% at skewness levels of 0.6 and 0.9, respectively. Zero-shot results further indicate that FedBDFT better preserves hierarchical representations for unseen fine-grained classes. These findings demonstrate its effectiveness for federated hierarchical classification with heterogeneous label granularities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出联邦层次图像分类中的一种新型统计异质性——标签粒度偏斜 (label granularity skew)，即不同客户端在共享类层次上提供不同细节层次但保持分类学一致的标签。作者用概率关系邻域分类器生成本地标签层次，并基于剪影分数 (silhouette score) 做 WordNet 引导的粗化来建模该异质性。基于条件 softmax 分类器更稳健的观察，提出分支级解耦微调 BDFT 及其联邦版本 FedBDFT，在 CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet 和 ImageNet 上验证了鲁棒性提升。
Motivation: 联邦学习中客户端不仅数据分布不同，领域知识和标注能力也可能有差异；现有工作未考虑客户端在共享类层次上以不同标签粒度标注的情况，这种不完整的监督会使强耦合的层次模型表现敏感。
Method: 提出用概率关系邻域分类器生成客户端专属的本地标签层次，并通过基于剪影分数的粗化构建 WordNet 引导的层次结构；据此提出 Branch-wise Decoupled Fine-Tuning (BDFT) 及其联邦版本 FedBDFT，对分支分类器分别微调并通过联邦优化聚合。
Result: 在 CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet 和 ImageNet 上，FedBDFT 在严重的标签粒度偏斜下显著提升鲁棒性，在偏斜度 0.6 和 0.9 时平均提升分别为 27.9% 和 56.4%；零样本结果显示其能更好地保留未见细粒度类的层次表示。
Conclusion: 作者认为 FedBDFT 能有效应对异构标签粒度下的联邦层次分类，并通过零样本结果说明其层次表示保留能力较强。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: DreOPD: Degraded-Reference Extrapolative On-Policy Distillation for Flow-matching Models
papers.abstract_en: Flow-matching models are now a mainstream method to image generation, but its adaptation to diverse downstream scenarios typically relies on post-training, which may cause conflicts among task-specific optimization objectives. Reinforcement learning enables direct optimization of task-specific rewards beyond the original models, yet trajectory-level optimization may incur high-variance gradients and cross-task interference. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers dense and stable supervision on student rollouts, but conventional teacher matching remains imitation-based. We propose DreOPD, a Degraded-reference extrapolative OPD method for flow-matching models that bridges these two paradigms. Our DreOPD converts implicit reward extrapolation into closed-form velocity regression, enabling extrapolative post-training with the stability of OPD. It further uses a mildly degraded reference to strengthen the teacher-reference contrast, yielding a clearer extrapolation direction. Experiments on single- and multi-teacher settings show that DreOPD outperforms OPD and multi-task RL baselines in average performance, while surpassing specialized teachers on most metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DreOPD，一种面向流匹配模型（flow-matching models）的退化参考外推式在线蒸馏方法。它将隐式奖励外推转换为闭式速度回归，并将轻度退化的参考样本用于增强教师-参考对比，从而在保留 OPD 稳定性的同时实现外推式后训练。实验表明其在单教师和多教师设置下的平均性能优于 OPD 和多任务 RL 基线。
Motivation: 流匹配模型在下游场景适配中常依赖后训练，但任务特定优化目标之间可能冲突；直接使用强化学习优化奖励会产生高方差梯度和跨任务干扰，而传统在线蒸馏（OPD）的教师匹配仍是模仿式、缺乏外推能力。
Method: DreOPD 将奖励外推转化为闭式速度回归（closed-form velocity regression），并用轻度退化的参考（degraded reference）增强教师与参考之间的对比，从而给出更清晰的外推方向，兼顾 OPD 的密集稳定监督与奖励外推能力。
Result: 在单教师和多教师设置下，DreOPD 的平均性能优于 OPD 和多任务 RL 基线，并在大多数指标上超过专门的教师模型。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，通过退化参考增强对比并将外推目标重构为回归问题，可以有效弥合模仿式蒸馏与奖励外推两种训练范式之间的差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BAG: Budget-Aware Gating for Diffusion Caching
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion caching is a lightweight strategy that accelerates Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) by reusing intermediate features across denoising steps, but existing paradigms face a fundamental trade-off: online heuristics lack global budget awareness, whereas static schedules lack instance adaptivity and fail to flexibly adapt to varying runtime budget constraints. To bridge this gap, we present BAG (Budget-Aware Gating), a novel caching policy that unifies global budget pacing with dynamic, instance-adaptive feature reuse. Rather than relying on hand-crafted rules, BAG employs a lightweight gating network that dynamically decides whether to execute a full computation or reuse cached features at each step by jointly conditioning on the budget state and local trajectory feedback. We train this policy via offline-to-online schedule distillation, transferring the decision-making of offline-searched schedules into a compact online gate. Extensive experiments on FLUX.1-dev and Wan2.1 demonstrate that BAG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art caching methods across various speedup tiers while remaining robust across different resolutions, seeds, and guidance scales. Code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BAG (Budget-Aware Gating)，一种用于扩散缓存 (diffusion caching) 的缓存策略，旨在加速 Diffusion Transformers (DiTs)。BAG 通过轻量级门控网络动态决定每个去噪步骤执行完整计算还是复用缓存特征，同时考虑预算状态和局部轨迹反馈，并将离线搜索调度的决策蒸馏为紧凑的在线门控。实验在 FLUX.1-dev 和 Wan2.1 上表明 BAG 在多种加速档位下一致优于现有缓存方法，且对不同分辨率、种子和引导尺度具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有扩散缓存方法存在根本性权衡：在线启发式缺乏全局预算感知，而静态调度缺乏实例自适应性，无法灵活适应运行时预算约束。
Method: BAG 采用轻量级门控网络，联合基于预算状态和局部轨迹反馈进行决策，并通过 offline-to-online 调度蒸馏将离线搜索得到的调度策略压缩到在线门控中，取代手工设计规则。
Result: 在 FLUX.1-dev 和 Wan2.1 上，BAG 在不同加速档位下一致优于最先进的缓存方法，并在不同分辨率、随机种子和引导尺度下保持稳健表现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 BAG 统一了全局预算节奏与动态实例自适应特征复用，代码将公开发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SafeSceneReason: A Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark Connecting Industrial Hazards with Accident Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Industrial-safety understanding requires more than detecting workers, equipment, and personal protective equipment. Models must also assess compliance, identify hazardous interactions, explain potential accident mechanisms, and recommend preventive actions. Existing safety datasets primarily focus on visual perception or isolated violation recognition and provide limited supervision for evidence-grounded reasoning. We introduce SafeSceneReason, a multimodal industrial-safety reasoning benchmark and companion training corpus that connects workplace scenes with knowledge from occupational accident investigations. SafeSceneReason combines two complementary data-construction pipelines. The scene-centric pipeline converts annotated workplace images into executable safety scene graphs and generates deterministic answers through program execution over objects, relations, and safety rules. The report-centric pipeline extracts figures and contextual evidence from accident reports and constructs multimodal questions using evidence graphs, explicit information boundaries, multi-step reasoning paths, and iterative verification. The resulting resource contains 110,581 verified scene-centric question--answer pairs and 13,114 refined report-centric question--answer pairs, covering perception, spatial and quantitative reasoning, compliance assessment, evidence synthesis, causal analysis, and mitigation-oriented decision making. Evaluation of representative proprietary and open-source vision--language models reveals substantial performance differences and persistent weaknesses in comparative, technical, and multi-evidence reasoning, demonstrating that strong general visual understanding does not yet guarantee reliable industrial-safety reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SafeSceneReason，一个面向工业安全的多模态推理基准与配套训练语料，将工作场所场景与职业事故调查知识连接起来。基准通过场景中心 (scene-centric) 和报告中心 (report-centric) 两条数据构造流水线，生成含 110,581 个场景中心问答对和 13,114 个报告中心问答对，覆盖感知、空间与定量推理、合规评估、证据综合、因果分析和缓解导向决策。对代表性闭源与开源视觉-语言模型的评测显示，模型在比较、技术和多证据推理上存在持续弱点，说明强通用视觉理解尚不能保证可靠的工业安全推理。
Motivation: 现有工业安全数据集主要关注视觉感知或孤立的违规识别，缺乏对证据支撑的推理 (evidence-grounded reasoning) 的监督；模型不仅要检测工人、设备和 PPE，还需评估合规性、识别危险交互、解释事故机制并推荐预防措施。
Method: SafeSceneReason 结合两条互补的数据构造流水线：场景中心流水线将标注的工作场所图像转换为可执行的安全场景图 (executable safety scene graphs)，并通过在对象、关系和规则上的程序执行生成确定性答案；报告中心流水线从事故报告中提取图形和上下文证据，利用证据图、显式信息边界、多步推理路径和迭代验证构造多模态问题。
Result: 资源包含 110,581 个已验证的场景中心问答对和 13,114 个精炼的报告中心问答对。对代表性专有和开源视觉-语言模型的评估显示出显著的性能差异，并在比较推理、技术推理和多证据推理方面存在持续缺陷。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，尽管模型具备较强的通用视觉理解能力，但尚不能保证可靠的工业安全推理；SafeSceneReason 可作为衡量和推动这一能力的基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Privileged Solutions or Context-Induced Teacher Behavior? Dissecting On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) is commonly interpreted as the transfer of privileged information: a teacher observes the verified solution to the target problem and supervises the student's trajectory. However, this interpretation conflates two effects. The reference solution not only reveals the answer to the current instance but also changes the context under which the teacher provides token-level supervision. We investigate the role of target-specific privilege with $\mathrm{OP}^{2}\mathrm{SD}$ (On-Policy Self-Distillation from Other Problems), which replaces the paired reference with a problem and solution from a different example, while preserving the student rollout, teacher, and distillation objective. Across three models and three mathematics benchmarks, $\mathrm{OP}^{2}\mathrm{SD}$ improves over the base model, remains competitive with OPSD. The success of $\mathrm{OP}^{2}\mathrm{SD}$ implies that OPSD gains do not necessarily come from access to the reference solution, and that the teacher's context-induced behavior is an important factor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考察在线策略自蒸馏 (On-Policy Self-Distillation, OPSD) 的收益来源，指出现有解释将两种效应混为一谈：参考解既揭示了当前实例的答案，也改变了教师提供 token 级监督时的上下文。作者提出 OP2SD (On-Policy Self-Distillation from Other Problems)，用另一个样本的问题和解替换配对的参考，同时保留学生 rollout、教师和蒸馏目标。在三个模型和三个数学基准上，OP2SD 相对于基础模型有提升，并与 OPSD 表现相当。
Motivation: OPSD 通常被解释为特权信息 (privileged information) 的传递，即教师看到目标问题的已验证解并监督学生轨迹，但这种解释混淆了答案信息与上下文变化两个效应。
Method: 提出 OP2SD，将配对参考替换为来自不同样本的问题和解，同时保持学生 rollout、教师模型和蒸馏目标不变，从而隔离目标特异性特权的作用。
Result: 在三个模型和三个数学基准上，OP2SD 优于基础模型，并与 OPSD 保持竞争力。
Conclusion: OP2SD 的成功表明 OPSD 的提升未必来自参考解的访问，教师因上下文改变而产生的行为是重要因素；论文标注为 work in progress。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Omni2LoRA: Coherence-Preserving Parametric Memory for Efficient Omni Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Omnimodal language models (OLMs) enable unified audio-visual understanding, but processing long joint token sequences makes inference computationally prohibitive. While recent token compression methods attempt to alleviate this burden, compressing modalities in isolation often destroys the temporal cross-modal anchors necessary for coherent reasoning. We introduce Omni2LoRA, a two-stage framework for efficient parametric memory compression via coherence-preserving context distillation that bypasses the token bottleneck entirely. First, a Perceiver hypernetwork processes intermediate representations from a frozen OLM to encode the multimodal context into a full-rank Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapter in a single forward pass. To prevent the resulting parameter footprint from scaling linearly with recording length, we optimize a discrete rank allocation policy via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that uses a modality-ablated counterfactual reward to explicitly penalize the loss of audio-visual coherence, forcing the model to allocate its fixed sub-linear rank budget to synergistic cross-modal anchors rather than isolated visual features. Across three omnimodal backbones, Omni2LoRA operating at a 30% rank budget outperforms direct full-context inference and strong token-compression baselines (OmniZip, OMAC, O-MARC) on four audio-visual question answering benchmarks, improving average accuracy by 8-12% over the strongest baseline and remaining stable under compression ratios as tight as 75%, where token-pruning methods degrade sharply. By converting multimodal memory into a fixed-budget, reusable parameter state, our method drives answer-time multimodal-token load to zero, cutting per-query Time to First Token (TTFT) by up to 12x relative to full-context inference and amortizing to under 0.5s after a handful of queries.

papers.title: RL-Native Distillation: Exploiting Scored Trajectories for Few-Step Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Efficient text-to-image generation requires both reinforcement-learning (RL)-based reward alignment and few-step distillation, yet these procedures are typically performed sequentially, increasing training cost and risking the loss of reward gains during compression. We instead take an RL-native perspective: diffusion RL already generates reward-scored finite-step trajectories, whose intermediate states provide a natural source of distillation supervision rather than a disposable byproduct of sampling. Based on this insight, we propose REST (Reward-Enhanced Scored-Trajectory Distillation), a single-stage RL-distillation co-training framework that attaches a decoupled student to an arbitrary RL teacher. The student learns segment-wise from the teacher's evolving rollout trajectories while leaving the original teacher optimization unchanged. To prevent uniform imitation from preserving undesirable low-reward behaviors, we further introduce Advantage-Modulated Distillation (AMD), which transforms rollout advantages into signed weights over a base distillation loss. AMD strengthens supervision from preferred trajectories and mildly repels the student from low-reward ones. The resulting framework is lightweight and plug-and-play, requires no extra image rollouts, no separate distillation dataset, and no adversarial training. Experiments on compositional generation, visual text rendering, and human-preference alignment show that REST enables few-step CFG-free inference that matches or surpasses its 40-step RL teacher, with an overall additional training cost below 25% over pure RL. REST improves DrawBench PickScore over RTDMD by 0.82 while requiring only one-fifth of the training iterations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REST (Reward-Enhanced Scored-Trajectory Distillation)，一个单阶段的 RL-蒸馏联合训练框架，用于高效文本到图像生成。其核心洞察是扩散 RL 产生的带奖励得分的有限步轨迹本身就可以作为蒸馏监督来源，而不必被丢弃。REST 将解耦的学生模型附着到任意 RL 教师模型上，分段学习教师不断演化的 rollout 轨迹，同时保持教师优化不变；并引入 Advantage-Modulated Distillation (AMD) 用 rollout 优势给基础蒸馏损失加符号权重，强化优轨迹、弱化低奖励轨迹。实验表明该方法无需额外 rollout、独立蒸馏数据集或对抗训练，即可实现匹配或超越 40 步 RL 教师的少步 CFG-free 推理。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像生成通常先做基于强化学习 (RL) 的奖励对齐，再做少步蒸馏，两步顺序执行导致训练成本高，且压缩阶段可能丢失已获得的奖励收益。同时，此前被当作采样副产品的中间状态轨迹实际上携带天然的蒸馏监督信号，未被利用。
Method: 提出 REST，一种轻量且即插即用的单阶段 RL-蒸馏协同训练框架：在任意 RL 教师旁附加一个解耦学生，学生从教师不断更新的 rollout 轨迹中分段学习，教师优化过程完全不变。为克服均匀模仿会保留低奖励行为的问题，进一步提出 AMD，将 rollout 优势转换为作用于基础蒸馏损失上的带符号权重，增强来自优轨迹的监督并轻微推开低奖励轨迹。
Result: 在组合生成、视觉文本渲染和人类偏好对齐等实验上，REST 使少步 CFG-free 推理匹配或超越其 40 步 RL 教师，且相较纯 RL 只增加不到 25% 的总训练成本；相比 RTDMD，REST 在 DrawBench 的 PickScore 上提升 0.82，且仅需其五分之一的训练迭代。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 RL 轨迹的中间状态可以复用为蒸馏监督，通过优势调制避免对低奖励行为的无差别模仿；REST 以单阶段协同训练替代顺序式 RL-蒸馏流程，实现轻量、无需额外数据与对抗训练的少步生成。

papers.title: Governing the KV Cache: Preventing Timing Side-Channel Leakage in Multi-Tenant LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: The key-value (KV) cache is the primary throughput optimization in modern large language model (LLM) inference, enabling prefix reuse across requests. In multi-tenant deployments this cache is shared across tenants, creating a timing side channel: an adversarial tenant can reconstruct another tenant's private prompt by probing cache-hit latency. Three published attacks exploit it -- PROMPTPEEK, EarlyBird and InputSnatch -- reaching up to 100% attack success rate against unprotected vLLM and SGLang, with rates varying by cache architecture and prompt structure. We present KVGov, a governance layer addressing all three attack families' prefix-cache paths under one mechanism. A per-principal salt sigma_p = HMAC_K(secret, principal_id) seeds the block-hash chain, making cache keys cryptographically disjoint across principals. An ablation (N=1000 trials, seed 2026, deterministic judges) isolates this salt as the necessary and sufficient component. KVGov adds ORIGAMI, a Stackelberg water-filling audit scheduler that reduces adversary expected utility by 12.6% at realistic tenant heterogeneity (Gini 0.63), and an evolutionary stability analysis giving a 31.6% adversary-prevalence tipping point below which global caching remains stable. On real hardware (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, vLLM 0.26.0, NVIDIA A100) we measure a gate-verified cold/cached TTFT ratio of 0.22, confirming the channel is exploitable at production scale; the defense itself is evaluated in simulation calibrated to those measurements. We replicate the channel on an independent stack (llama.cpp on Apple Metal, ratio 0.093). Finally, isolation and cache efficiency need not conflict: identifying information resides only where prompts diverge, so injecting the salt at that boundary rather than the chain root retains an estimated 93% of the prefix-cache benefit with no cross-principal signal.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Measurements on NVIDIA A100 with vLLM 0.26.0, independently replicated on llama.cpp/Apple Metal. Experimental scripts and raw results available from the author on request
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多租户 LLM 推理中共享 KV 缓存 (key-value cache) 引发的计时侧信道攻击，提出名为 KVGov 的治理层。其核心机制是用每主体盐 sigma_p = HMAC_K(secret, principal_id) 生成块哈希链，使不同主体的缓存键在密码学上不相交，从而同时阻断 PROMPTPEEK、EarlyBird 和 InputSnatch 三类攻击的前缀缓存路径。摘要还提出 ORIGAMI 审计调度器和演化稳定性分析，并在真实硬件上测得了可利用的冷/热 TTFT 比值。
Motivation: 多租户 LLM 推理中 KV 缓存跨租户共享，攻击者可通过探测缓存命中延迟重建受害者的私有提示；已公开的三种攻击对未保护的 vLLM 和 SGLang 可达 100% 成功率。需要一个统一机制覆盖所有攻击家族的前缀缓存路径。
Method: KVGov 以每主体盐 sigma_p = HMAC_K(secret, principal_id) 播种块哈希链，使缓存键跨主体密码学不相交；并附带 ORIGAMI，一种 Stackelberg 水填充审计调度器，以及演化稳定性分析来确定攻击者盛行率的临界点。为兼顾缓存效率，盐只在提示分歧边界注入而非链根。
Result: 消融实验（N=1000，种子 2026）表明盐是必要且充分组件；ORIGAMI 在真实租户异质性（Gini 0.63）下将对手期望效用降低 12.6%；演化分析给出 31.6% 的攻击者盛行率临界点。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、vLLM 0.26.0、NVIDIA A100 上测到门验证的冷/热 TTFT 比值为 0.22，在 llama.cpp/Apple Metal 上比值为 0.093；防御本身在基于这些测量的仿真中评估。边界注入盐可保留约 93% 的前缀缓存收益且无跨主体信号。
Conclusion: KV 缓存隔离与缓存效率不必冲突：将盐注入提示分歧边界而非链根，可在无跨主体信号的前提下保留大部分前缀缓存收益。摘要强调该机制在仿真中评估，尚需更多实际部署验证。

papers.title: PatchHead: Learning Spatial Patch Evidence for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated image detectors generalize poorly when their training and test images originate from different generators or datasets. Despite the rich spatial representations produced by vision foundation models like DINO, existing detectors typically classify images using only the globally aggregated CLS token. We hypothesize that globally aggregating DINO features into a single CLS token obscures spatially distributed generation traces. To test this hypothesis, we introduce PatchHead, a lightweight spatial aggregation head that preserves the two-dimensional organization of DINO patch tokens and integrates evidence across neighboring regions. During training, we freeze the pretrained DINO backbone and optimize only the inserted LoRA adapters, PatchHead, and auxiliary projection head. Across nine cross-dataset benchmarks spanning manually curated and in-the-wild settings, PatchHead ranks first on seven datasets and second on the remaining two. It improves the strongest prior method from 91.6% to 94.6% in average balanced accuracy (+3.0 points) and raises the worst-case accuracy from 82.4% to 89.4% (+6.9 points), while introducing only 8.6% more trainable parameters and 0.08% additional FLOPs. Further qualitative analysis suggests that PatchHead (i) reduces class-conditional domain discrepancy, and (ii) redirects the representation from content-dominated saliency toward spatially distributed authenticity evidence. Together, these observations provide a representation-level account of why spatial patch aggregation transfers more reliably across generators and datasets than a single CLS-based global representation. Our code and models will be made available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PatchHead，一种轻量级空间聚合头，用于通用 AI 生成图像检测。方法保留 DINO patch token 的二维空间组织，整合相邻区域的生产痕迹证据，训练时冻结 DINO 主干，仅优化 LoRA 适配器、PatchHead 和辅助投影头。在九个跨数据集基准上，平均 balanced accuracy 从 91.6% 提升到 94.6%，最差情况准确率从 82.4% 提升到 89.4%，仅增加 8.6% 可训练参数和 0.08% FLOPs。
Motivation: 现有 AI 生成图像检测器在训练与测试图像来自不同生成器或数据集时泛化差；作者假设将 DINO 特征全局聚合为单一 CLS token 会掩盖空间分布的生产痕迹。
Method: 提出 PatchHead 空间聚合头，保持 DINO patch token 的二维组织结构并跨相邻区域整合证据；训练时冻结预训练 DINO 主干，只优化插入的 LoRA 适配器、PatchHead 和辅助投影头。
Result: 在九个跨数据集基准（含人工整理和 in-the-wild 设置）中，PatchHead 在七个数据集上排名第一、两个第二；平均 balanced accuracy 提升 3.0 个百分点，最差情况准确率提升 6.9 个百分点，且只增加 8.6% 可训练参数和 0.08% FLOPs。定性分析显示该方法降低类条件域差异，并把表示从内容主导的显著性转向空间分布的 authenticity evidence。
Conclusion: 作者认为空间 patch 聚合比基于单一 CLS 的全局表示在跨生成器和数据集上迁移更可靠，并从表示层面给出解释；代码和模型将在论文录用后公开。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有 AI 生成图像检测器在训练与测试图像来自不同生成器或数据集时泛化差；作者假设将 DINO 特征全局聚合为单一 CLS token 会掩盖空间分布的生产痕迹。
summary_sections.method: 提出 PatchHead 空间聚合头，保持 DINO patch token 的二维组织结构并跨相邻区域整合证据；训练时冻结预训练 DINO 主干，只优化插入的 LoRA 适配器、PatchHead 和辅助投影头。

papers.title: FedTVD: Balancing Data Quality and Quantity for Robust Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed client devices while preserving data privacy. However, FL faces significant challenges due to data heterogeneity, particularly in terms of label distribution skewness and variations in dataset sizes, which can lead to biased model updates and hinder convergence. To address this, we propose FedTVD, a novel FL algorithm that weights client contributions during aggregation by considering both data quality and quantity. Unlike traditional FL approaches such as FedAvg, which rely solely on dataset size for client weighting, FedTVD integrates Total Variation Distance (TVD) to measure the divergence between each client's local label distribution and a uniform global distribution. Clients with highly skewed distributions receive lower weights, preventing unbalanced datasets with imbalances from disproportionately influencing the global model. At the same time, dataset size is incorporated to ensure scalability and fairness. This dual-weighting mechanism effectively mitigates the impact of data imbalance, leading to more stable and generalized global models. Experimental results show that FedTVD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across all datasets (FMNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100) and all levels of data heterogeneity. Notably, it achieves up to 10.6% improvement over FedAvg on CIFAR-10 under highly skewed data, while maintaining top performance even under moderate and IID settings.
papers.journal_ref: Future Generation Computer Systems, Volume 176, March 2026, 108177
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedTVD，一种面向非独立同分布 (Non-IID) 数据的联邦学习聚合算法。与传统仅按数据集大小加权的 FedAvg 不同，FedTVD 同时考虑数据质量与数量：用 Total Variation Distance (TVD) 度量各客户端本地标签分布与均匀全局分布的偏离程度，对高度偏斜的客户端降权，并保留数据集大小因素以保证公平性。作者在 FMNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 及不同异构水平下的实验表明，该方法一致优于现有方法。
Motivation: 联邦学习中标签分布偏斜 (label distribution skewness) 与客户端数据集规模差异会导致模型更新有偏并阻碍收敛，而 FedAvg 仅依据数据集大小加权，无法应对数据质量不均的问题。
Method: FedTVD 在聚合时采用双权重机制：一方面利用 TVD 衡量客户端本地标签分布与均匀全局分布的差异，对高度偏斜的客户端赋予较低权重；另一方面纳入数据集大小以保证可扩展性和公平性。
Result: 实验显示 FedTVD 在 FMNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 及所有数据异构水平下均优于现有方法；在高度偏斜的 CIFAR-10 上相比 FedAvg 最高提升 10.6%，且在中等异构和 IID 设置下仍保持最优性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为同时建模数据质量与数量的双重加权机制能有效缓解数据不平衡的影响，从而获得更稳定、泛化能力更强的全局模型。

papers.title: Online Learning of Scale Parameters in Score-Driven Filters
papers.abstract_en: Score-driven filters multiply a scaled log-likelihood score by a gain that controls the update magnitude. We treat this gain as a decision variable and study its online learning. Conditional on the current state, observation, score, and scaling rule, each admissible gain induces a reachable next state and a one-step-ahead predictive density: scalar gains govern distance along a line, while diagonal gains govern coordinatewise transmission. Gain selection is therefore a conditional predictive decision problem with a Kullback-Leibler objective. For a scalar unscaled gain, the negative raw product of consecutive scores is the stochastic gradient of this loss; positive aGAS scaling only rescales the effective step. Monotone differentiable gain links induce mirror-descent geometries on bounded gain domains, while persistence yields a Bregman pull towards a reference gain. Under convexity, compactness, and regularity conditions, we establish dynamic-regret bounds for projected and discounted mirror updates relative to time-varying, current-information comparators. Simulations illustrate the roles of scaling, link geometry, persistence, and coordinatewise transmission rates. An out-of-sample panel of equity-index volatilities shows that the bounded mirror gain generally matches or outperforms a constant gain while avoiding the extreme spikes of a nominally unbounded exponential link, with the strongest improvements observed in multi-crisis markets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将 score-driven 滤波器中控制更新幅度的增益 (gain) 视为决策变量，研究其在线学习问题。作者把增益选择建模为以 KL 散度为目标的条件预测决策问题，推导出标量未缩放增益下连续得分负乘积的随机梯度性质，并在凸性、紧性等条件下给出投影与折扣镜像更新的动态 regret 界。模拟与股票指数波动率面板实验表明，有界镜像增益通常匹配或优于常数增益，并避免无界指数链接的极端尖峰。
Motivation: score-driven 滤波器中的增益通常需要预先指定或启发式设定，而该增益决定了状态更新的幅度和一步预测密度，缺少系统的在线学习框架与理论保证。
Method: 将每个可行增益对应到一个可达的下一状态和一步预测密度，从而把增益选择转化为以 Kullback-Leibler 散度为目标的条件预测决策问题；标量未缩放增益下，连续得分的负原始乘积是该损失的随机梯度，正 aGAS 缩放只改变有效步长；单调可微增益链接在有界增益域上诱导镜像下降几何，持久性项产生指向参考增益的 Bregman 拉力；在凸性、紧性和正则条件下分析投影与折扣镜像更新的动态 regret。
Result: 摘要给出针对时变、当前信息比较器的动态 regret 界；模拟展示了缩放、链接几何、持久性和坐标传输率的作用；样本外股票指数波动率面板中，有界镜像增益一般匹配或优于常数增益，同时避免无界指数链接的极端尖峰，多危机市场中的改进最明显。
Conclusion: 作者将增益在线学习表述为条件预测决策问题，并证明其可在有界镜像更新下获得理论保障和经验稳健性；研究范围限于一类 score-driven 滤波器及其假设条件。

papers.title: Beyond Solvability: Task Learnability as a Static Prior for LLM RL Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a central post-training paradigm for eliciting reasoning capabilities in large language models, yet uniform task sampling allocates compute without regard to differences in how tasks respond to optimization. Existing task-valuation methods mostly rely on snapshot-based signals such as current pass rate or reward, which estimate how solvable a task is under the current policy. However, tasks with similar current solvability can still differ substantially in how positively they respond to further training. We study this residual axis as task learnability: a regime-conditional measure of expected positive response to continued training under a fixed RL post-training regime. By analyzing per-task reward trajectories, we find that learnability is reproducible across independently sampled training contexts and predictive of downstream utility. To make this signal practical before training begins, we propose TrajVal, a lightweight probe-based estimator that approximates per-task learnability from a short probe run and two endpoint evaluations. TrajVal can be used either as a standalone static prior for task sampling or as a multiplicative prior for existing online schedulers. Experiments on mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks across multiple model scales show that TrajVal improves data efficiency over uniform sampling and provides complementary gains when combined with online scheduling methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 强化学习 (RL) 后训练中均匀任务采样忽视任务对优化响应差异的问题，提出任务可学习性 (task learnability) 这一概念，并给出轻量估计器 TrajVal。摘要显示，通过分析逐任务奖励轨迹，可学习性在不同独立采样训练环境下可复现，并能预测下游效用；TrajVal 可作为静态先验或与在线调度器相乘，在数学与逻辑推理基准上提升数据效率。
Motivation: 现有任务价值评估多依赖当前通过率或奖励等快照信号，只能衡量任务在当前策略下是否可解 (solvability)，而可解性相似的任务在继续训练中的正响应可能差异很大；均匀采样则完全忽略这种差异，导致训练计算分配低效。
Method: 提出 TrajVal，一种基于探针 (probe) 的轻量估计器：通过一次短探针运行和两次端点评估来近似每个任务的可学习性；该信号既可作为独立的静态采样先验，也可作为乘性先验叠加到现有在线调度器上。
Result: 在数学与逻辑推理基准、多个模型规模上的实验表明，TrajVal 相比均匀采样提升数据效率，并与在线调度方法结合时带来互补性收益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调把可学习性作为训练前可获得的静态先验是可行的，且这一信号能补充现有的在线调度策略；其适用范围和局限主要围绕固定 RL 后训练体制下的任务采样。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AkasicDB: Demonstrating Omni RAG with a Unified Vector-Graph-Relational DBMS
papers.abstract_en: Recent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems increasingly combine vector retrieval with structured knowledge, such as Graph RAG and Filtered vector search. However, existing database architectures struggle to support such complex RAG workflows efficiently, as they rely on out-of-DB pipelines or in-DB non-native integration, leading to high overhead. This demo paper presents AkasicDB, a database system that natively supports such RAG workflows by jointly executing vector similarity search, graph traversal, and relational filtering within a single execution framework. AkasicDB extends our prior work, Chimera, with native vector support to enable such unified execution. Based on AkasicDB, we demonstrate the first native integration of Vector-Graph-Relational RAG, which we refer to as Omni RAG. Through an interactive chat-style demonstration, users execute and visualize Omni RAG queries, directly experiencing its superior retrieval and reasoning over vector-only approaches while observing the practical limitations of existing database architectures in supporting Omni RAG. A demonstration video is available at https://youtu.be/8d09_dtrEIM
papers.journal_ref: SIGMOD Companion 2026, pp. 70-73
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 SIGMOD 2026 的演示论文，介绍 AkasicDB：一个在单一执行框架内原生联合执行向量相似搜索 (vector similarity search)、图遍历 (graph traversal) 和关系过滤 (relational filtering) 的数据库系统。它扩展了作者此前的 Chimera 系统，加入原生向量支持，从而实现了首次原生的 Vector-Graph-Relational RAG（作者称为 Omni RAG）集成。演示通过交互式聊天界面让用户执行并可视化 Omni RAG 查询，展示其相比纯向量 RAG 在检索与推理上的优势，并揭示现有数据库架构支持 Omni RAG 时的实际限制。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 系统越来越需要结合向量检索与结构化知识（如 Graph RAG、Filtered vector search），但现有数据库架构依赖数据库外流水线或库内非原生集成来支持这类复杂工作流，开销高、效率低。
Method: AkasicDB 在单一执行框架中联合执行向量相似搜索、图遍历与关系过滤，避免跨系统或非原生的集成开销；系统在作者此前的工作 Chimera 之上扩展了原生向量支持，以实现向量-图-关系三者的统一执行。
Result: 该演示首次展示 Vector-Graph-Relational RAG（Omni RAG）的原生集成；交互式演示中，用户可执行并可视化 Omni RAG 查询，直观看到其相比纯向量检索方法更优的检索与推理效果，并观察现有数据库架构在支持 Omni RAG 时的实际局限。
Conclusion: 作为演示论文，AkasicDB 展示了在数据库内部统一执行向量、图和关系操作以支持 Omni RAG 的可行性，并强调现有数据库架构在应对此类综合 RAG 工作流时的不足。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: UNMASK: Discovering and Causally Verifying Spurious Shortcuts in Text Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Neural language models trained on large crowdsourced corpora frequently exploit spurious surface patterns tied to target labels without true linguistic or causal relevance, boosting benchmark performance while failing on adversarial or out-of-distribution inputs. Existing approaches either require manual specification of the feature vocabulary or automate discovery only partially, leaving the gap between dataset-level correlation and model-level exploitation unaddressed. We present U N M ASK, a fully automated pipeline that discovers, causally verifies, and mitigates spurious correlations in text classifiers without additional human annotation. Given unlabeled training examples, U N M ASK generates candidate surface patterns as executable boolean expressions, filters them through a statistical validation protocol with independent replication, and establishes causal model dependence via verified counterfactual interventions. Causally confirmed features then serve as annotation-free group definitions for Deep Feature Reweighting, eliminating the group labels that standard DFR requires. Applied to BERT and RoBERTa trained on MNLI, our pipeline independently rediscovers established lexical-overlap and negation biases, verifying 9 of 10 features on BERT and 6 on RoBERTa, and improving HANS accuracy by up to 12.58 pp. On CivilComments-WILDS, programmatic groups match the 70.1% worst- group accuracy of hand-labeled DFR (Kirichenko et al., 2023) without demographic annotation. We further demonstrate that the discovery and validation stages generalize to reward model preference data, surfacing interpretable spurious correlations in RewardBench2.

papers.title: FedA2L: Adaptive layer-wise learning rate adjustment in decentralized federated learning
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized intelligence systems with heterogeneous devices and limited coordination increasingly rely on decentralized federated learning (DFL). However, DFL suffers from convergence inefficiency under data heterogeneity due to the use of a uniform learning rate (LR) that ignores layer-specific optimization needs. Foundational layers are responsible for maintaining network consensus, while specialized layers adapt to local data characteristics, leading to conflicting gradients and degraded performance under non-IID conditions. To address this fundamental tension, this work introduces FedA2L, a method that dynamically adjusts layer-wise LRs based on model divergence signals. By leveraging local update intensity and network consensus constraints, FedA2L seamlessly integrates into existing DFL protocols without additional communication or coordination. Extensive evaluations across DFL algorithms, various model architectures, and datasets demonstrate that FedA2L achieves up to 4.94 times faster convergence than vanilla DFL and reduces communication rounds by up to 59% compared to scheduler-based baselines. Furthermore, FedA2L exhibits resilience to severe data heterogeneity, larger network sizes, and sparse topologies, reducing communication overhead and establishing it as a versatile optimization tool for resource-constrained or large-scale distributed learning in edge and IoT deployments. The code is released at https://github.com/nclabteam/FedA2L.
papers.journal_ref: Future Generation Computer Systems 186 (2026) 108743
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedA2L，一种面向去中心化联邦学习 (decentralized federated learning, DFL) 的自适应逐层学习率调整方法，基于模型分歧信号动态调整各层学习率，以缓解数据异构 (non-IID) 下的收敛低效。摘要报告在多种 DFL 算法、模型架构和数据集上，相比 vanilla DFL 收敛速度最高提升 4.94 倍，相比基于调度器的基线通信轮次最多减少 59%，并在严重数据异构、更大网络规模和稀疏拓扑下保持鲁棒性。代码已开源。
Motivation: DFL 在数据异构条件下因统一学习率 (uniform learning rate) 忽略逐层优化需求而收敛低效；基础层负责维持网络共识、专用层适应本地数据特性，统一学习率会导致梯度冲突并损害性能。
Method: 提出 FedA2L，利用本地更新强度与网络共识约束，根据模型分歧信号动态调整逐层学习率；该方法无需额外通信或协调，可无缝集成到现有 DFL 协议中。
Result: 摘要报告在多种 DFL 算法、模型架构和数据集上，FedA2L 相比 vanilla DFL 收敛速度最高提升 4.94 倍，相比基于调度器的基线通信轮次最多减少 59%；同时对严重数据异构、更大网络规模和稀疏拓扑具有鲁棒性，并降低通信开销。
Conclusion: 摘要将 FedA2L 定位为资源受限或大规模分布式学习（如边缘与 IoT 部署）场景中的通用优化工具，并公开代码链接。

papers.title: CRUISE: Vision-Language Model-Guided Uncertainty-Aware Cross-Modal Sensor Fusion for Robust Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Modern autonomous vehicles are equipped with multiple sensors, such as cameras, LiDAR, and radar, for comprehensive environmental perception. However, robust cross-modal feature fusion remains a critical challenge, as the reliability of each sensor varies significantly across diverse real-world driving conditions, including poor visibility and adverse weather. While uncertainty quantification (UQ) mitigates this issue by allowing models to prioritize reliable signals, existing uncertainty-aware fusion methods typically rely on simple feature-level uncertainty estimates and thus often fail to generalize effectively in complex, out-of-distribution scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose CRUISE, a novel uncertainty-aware cross-modal sensor fusion framework. CRUISE integrates a vision-language model (VLM)-guided UQ module that generates fine-grained, pixel-level uncertainty estimates. By leveraging the VLM's rich prior knowledge and superior contextual reasoning, our approach provides a highly informative guide for the fusion process. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic adaptive mechanism that explicitly models and captures cross-modal dependencies, ensuring the framework fully exploits the inherent complementary nature of multi-sensor inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CRUISE，一个面向鲁棒自动驾驶的不确定性感知跨模态传感器融合框架。其核心是用视觉语言模型（VLM）引导不确定性量化（UQ）模块，生成细粒度像素级不确定性估计，并引入动态自适应机制显式建模跨模态依赖。摘要称该方案可在恶劣天气等复杂场景中更有效地整合摄像头、LiDAR 和雷达信号。
Motivation: 多传感器在现实驾驶中的可靠性因能见度和恶劣天气等因素变化显著，现有不确定性感知融合方法多依赖简单的特征级不确定性估计，难以在复杂的分布外场景中泛化。
Method: CRUISE 将 VLM 引导的 UQ 模块与动态自适应机制结合：前者利用 VLM 的先验知识和情境推理生成像素级不确定性，后者显式建模并捕获跨模态依赖，以充分利用多传感器输入的互补性。
Conclusion: 作者认为，VLM 引导的细粒度不确定性估计与跨模态依赖建模能够提升融合过程的信息量，从而使框架在复杂驾驶条件下更鲁棒。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Signature-Guided Capacity Occupancy for Dense Expert Merging
papers.abstract_en: Dense expert merging combines domain-specialized language models into one single checkpoint, typically by admitting task-vector support in weight space. However, this admission is governed by three decisions that existing methods answer only partially: where to open layer capacity from cross-expert conflict, who should occupy that capacity based on domain demand, and how to admit the resulting support without relying on costly recipe search. To tackle these issues, we propose SigMerge (Signature-Guided Capacity Occupancy), a structured capacity assignment framework for dense expert merging. Starting from a dense base merge, conflict signatures set each layer's capacity from cross-expert conflict, positive base-merge deficits set each domain's share of that capacity, and a sequential occupancy rule admits each expert delta up to the resulting layer-domain budget. Across 21 paired settings spanning seven dense base merges and three model pools, SigMerge improves every one (by 15.0% on average) and achieves the best average rank (1.67) among six merging methods, outperforming three categories of merging baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SigMerge（Signature-Guided Capacity Occupancy），一个用于稠密专家合并（dense expert merging）的结构化容量分配框架。它通过冲突签名（conflict signatures）确定每层容量，用正基合并赤字（positive base-merge deficits）分配各领域份额，并按顺序占用规则在层-领域预算内接收专家增量。在七个稠密基合并和三个模型池组成的 21 个配对设置中，该方法平均提升 15.0%，平均排名 1.67，优于三类合并基线。
Motivation: 现有稠密专家合并方法在三个关键决策上只给出部分答案：如何从跨专家冲突中打开层容量、谁应根据领域需求占用该容量、以及如何避免昂贵的配方搜索来接收支持。
Method: SigMerge 从稠密基合并出发，用冲突签名设定每层容量，用正基合并赤字设定每个领域在该容量中的份额，并通过顺序占用规则将每个专家增量限制在层-领域预算内。
Result: 在跨越七个稠密基合并和三个模型池的 21 个配对设置中，SigMerge 改善了每一个设置（平均提升 15.0%），并在六种合并方法中获得最佳平均排名（1.67），超过三类合并基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SigMerge 是一种无需昂贵配方搜索的结构化容量分配方法，能系统性地改进稠密专家合并。

papers.title: NBA_Streaming: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Fine-Grained Basketball Commentary Generation in Continuous Streams
papers.abstract_en: Live basketball commentary generation requires determining when an event is sufficiently observable and describing it before subsequent events unfold. However, existing methods are primarily designed for pre-segmented clips or complete videos, making them unsuitable for continuous streams. Existing datasets also provide limited supervision for player identities, fine-grained actions, event attributes, and coherent event chains, restricting the factual richness of generated commentary. To address these limitations, we introduce NBA_Streaming, a large-scale benchmark for online fine-grained basketball commentary generation. It contains 307 hours of basketball broadcasts and approximately 35K temporally aligned events, with annotations of event boundaries, player identities, fine-grained actions, event chains, and natural-language commentary. By moving from isolated clips to continuous streams, NBA_Streaming enables unified evaluation of event localization, response reliability, factual grounding, and commentary quality under causal constraints. We further propose a causal two-stage framework that combines completion-first localization with ball-centric semantic grounding, enabling the system to identify complete events from observed streams and organize scene, event, identity, and action cues for commentary generation. Extensive experiments reveal the difficulty of NBA_Streaming, where existing baselines struggle with online timing, factual grounding, and fine-grained description. Our framework consistently improves over strong alternatives, while the remaining gap highlights NBA_Streaming as a valuable benchmark for streaming sports video understanding and generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NBA_Streaming，一个面向连续直播流的细粒度篮球解说生成大规模基准，包含 307 小时广播和约 35K 个时间对齐事件，标注了事件边界、球员身份、细粒度动作、事件链和自然语言解说。作者还提出一个因果两阶段框架，将补全优先定位 (completion-first localization) 与以球为中心的语义接地 (ball-centric semantic grounding) 结合，以从观测流中识别完整事件并组织场景、事件、身份和动作线索生成解说。实验表明现有基线在在线时序、事实接地和细粒度描述上表现困难，而所提框架一致优于强替代方案，但仍有明显差距。
Motivation: 现有方法主要面向预分割片段或完整视频，无法适用于连续直播流；现有数据集对球员身份、细粒度动作、事件属性和连贯事件链的监督有限，限制了解说的事实丰富性。
Method: 引入大规模基准 NBA_Streaming，将任务从孤立片段扩展到连续流，支持事件定位、响应可靠性、事实接地和解说质量的统一评估；并提出一个因果两阶段框架，先补全定位完整事件，再以球为中心组织场景、事件、身份和动作线索用于解说生成。
Result: 摘要报告 NBA_Streaming 包含 307 小时篮球转播和约 35K 个时间对齐事件；大量实验显示现有基线难以处理在线时序、事实接地和细粒度描述，所提框架一致优于强替代方案，但剩余差距仍然存在。
Conclusion: 作者强调 NBA_Streaming 作为流式体育视频理解与生成基准的价值，并指出所提框架虽然有效，但任务尚未被完全解决。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CPDA: Class-Conditional Path Distribution Alignment for Unsupervised Time-Series Domain Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised time-series domain adaptation (DA) addresses the challenge of transferring a classifier from a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain under distribution shifts induced by different users, sensors, devices, acquisition conditions, or temporal dynamics. Existing methods typically mitigate this shift by aligning marginal feature distributions through adversarial training, optimal transport, or moment-based discrepancies. In this paper, we propose Class-Conditional Path Distribution Alignment (CPDA), a non-adversarial discrepancy-based framework that aligns source and target class-conditional latent path distributions rather than only global feature marginals. CPDA introduces a composite signature-spectral kernel that jointly captures pooled semantic features, temporal path structure, frequency-domain information, and low-rank path-signature dynamics, while using source labels and target soft pseudo-labels to perform class-preserving alignment. We further provide a theoretical analysis showing that CPDA defines a valid kernel discrepancy, admits existing moment-matching methods as restricted cases, and yields a class-conditional target-risk bound. Extensive experiments with CNN, ResNet18, and TCN backbones on 13 different time-series DA benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of CPDA against 30 discrepancy, adversarial, and pseudo-labeling baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CPDA（Class-Conditional Path Distribution Alignment），一种非对抗的基于差异（discrepancy）的无监督时间序列域自适应框架，用于对齐源域与目标域的类条件潜在路径分布，而非仅对齐全局特征边缘分布。方法引入复合 signature-spectral kernel，联合捕获池化语义特征、时间路径结构、频域信息与低秩 path-signature 动态，并使用源标签与目标软伪标签进行类别保持对齐。理论部分证明 CPDA 定义有效核差异、将现有矩匹配方法作为特例，并给出类条件目标风险界；实验在 13 个时间序列 DA 基准上搭配 CNN、ResNet18、TCN 骨干，对比 30 个基线。
Motivation: 现有无监督时间序列域自适应方法通常通过对抗训练、最优传输或矩匹配来对齐边缘特征分布，以缓解不同用户、传感器、设备、采集条件或时间动态引起的分布偏移，但这类全局边缘对齐忽略了类条件结构与时间路径结构，迁移精度受限。
Method: CPDA 提出非对抗的差异度量框架，将源与目标类条件潜在路径分布对齐，而非仅对齐全局特征边缘。它定义复合 signature-spectral kernel，同时建模池化语义特征、时序路径结构、频域信息与低秩路径签名动力学，并利用源标签和目标自适应软伪标签实现类别保持的对齐。
Result: 在 13 个时间序列 DA 基准上，CPDA 搭配 CNN、ResNet18 与 TCN 骨干，优于 30 种差异、对抗和伪标签基线；理论分析还表明 CPDA 是有效核差异，矩匹配方法可视为其受限特例，并导出了类条件目标风险界。
Conclusion: 作者认为类条件路径分布对齐配合复合核能更完整地刻画时间序列中的分布偏移，论文同时提供理论保障与大规模实验验证。摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性或适用边界。

papers.title: Structure-Preserving Uncertainty Propagation in First-Order Proof Search
papers.abstract_en: GK is a query-directed first-order prover that extends ordinary resolution-based proof search with explicit positive and negative claims, numerical confidence values, and prioritized default rules with exceptions. It works directly with non-ground clauses, including equality and function terms. Candidate proofs are found by bounded first-order proof search; exception conditions of defaults are checked by further bounded searches, recursively when exceptions themselves depend on defaults. This avoids requiring a finite global grounding, while allowing incomplete searches to be reported as such. This paper adds structure-preserving quantitative reporting to that framework. Retained proof histories are used in two calculations. The first reconstructs the uncertain ground premises used by each proof and computes the probability that at least one retained proof is available, without counting shared premises independently. The second resolves positive and negative support at intermediate atoms before that support is propagated through later rules; the same calculation evaluates uncertain exception conditions for individual rule applications. Reports separate positive support, negative support, conflict, and ignorance and identify detected incomplete calculations or fallbacks. The implementation performs bounded reconstruction and dependency traversal after proof search and still requires no global grounding. Analytic examples and independent simulators reproduce the reference calculations on their stated fragments. Comparisons with probabilistic logic, probabilistic ASP, default logic, and goal-directed ASP identify cases of agreement, semantic difference, unsupported translation, and incomplete computation.
papers.comment: 79 pages, 6 figures. Executable binaries, documentation, examples, and public samplers: https://github.com/tammet/gkreasoner
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 GK 查询导向的一阶证明器框架中加入保持结构的不确定度定量报告。GK 直接用非 ground 子句（含等式与函词项）做有界证明搜索，并通过递归的有界搜索检查默认规则的异常条件，无需有限全局 grounding。论文利用保留的证明历史做两类计算：一是重建每个证明使用的不确定 ground 前提，并计算至少一个保留证明可用的概率（不重复计算共享前提）；二是在中间原子处解析正负支持后再向后续规则传播，同时对单个规则应用的异常条件做同样计算。报告区分正支持、负支持、冲突与无知，并识别检测到的不完整计算或回退。
Motivation: 现有基于归结的证明搜索缺乏结构化的不确定度传播方式，且默认规则异常检查若不递归处理会依赖有限全局 grounding。论文希望在不要求全局 grounding 的前提下，对候选证明给出可量化的置信度与支持方向，并显式报告搜索不完整的情况。
Method: 在 GK 证明器中，证明搜索后执行有界重构与依赖遍历。两种计算复用保留的证明历史：第一种重构不确定的 ground 前提并计算联合概率，避免共享前提被重复计数；第二种在中间原子处解析正负支持，再将支持传播到后续规则，并评估每条规则应用的不确定异常条件。实现无需全局 grounding，允许将不完整搜索如实标记。
Result: 摘要报告分析性示例与独立模拟器在所述片段上复现了参考计算。与概率逻辑、概率 ASP、默认逻辑和目标导向 ASP 的比较分别识别出一致情形、语义差异、不支持的翻译以及不完整计算的情形。
Conclusion: 该方法为带默认规则与异常的一阶证明搜索提供结构保持的概率与支持度报告，且保留无全局 grounding 的特性；同时显式区分不完整搜索和回退结果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RAGMesh with FaME-G2E: Long-Form Text-Driven 3D Face Generation and Editing
papers.abstract_en: Text-driven 3D face generation and editing remains challenging due to the difficulty of translating long-form descriptions into fine-grained facial geometry. Existing methods primarily align global textual semantics with facial structures but often struggle to capture subtle local deformations, such as eyebrow tension, cheek contraction, and asymmetric mouth motions, resulting in limited geometric fidelity and editing precision. To facilitate fine-grained text-driven facial modeling, we first construct FaME-G2E, a large-scale multimodal dataset containing detailed text--mesh annotations and paired text--blendshape samples for unified 3D facial generation and editing. Based on this dataset, we propose RAGMesh, a retrieval-augmented framework that leverages text-correlated geometric priors to improve high-fidelity facial synthesis and editing. Specifically, the Multi-Scale Retrieval Fusion (MSRF) module retrieves semantically consistent global and regional facial priors and fuses them in the blendshape space, suppressing conflicting local deformations while preserving coherent deformation patterns. Furthermore, we introduce Adaptive RAG-guided Supervision (AdaRAGS), a region-aware constraint that explicitly aligns textual semantics with corresponding facial regions, enhancing regional controllability and editing accuracy. Extensive experiments on FaME-G2E demonstrate that RAGMesh achieves superior performance over state-of-the-art methods in local geometric accuracy, text-guided controllability, regional editing precision, and inference efficiency. Video demo is available at https://youtu.be/Yr0_XkpWcNk, and the source code and dataset will be released upon paper acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RAGMesh，一个面向长文本驱动 3D 人脸生成与编辑的检索增强框架，并构建了大规模多模态数据集 FaME-G2E，包含细粒度 text--mesh 标注与配对 text--blendshape 样本。RAGMesh 通过多尺度检索融合 (MSRF) 在 blendshape 空间整合全局与区域人脸先验，并引入区域感知约束 AdaRAGS 对齐文本语义与对应人脸区域。摘要报告在 FaME-G2E 上的实验表明，该方法在局部几何精度、文本引导可控性、区域编辑精度和推理效率上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有文本驱动 3D 人脸方法主要对齐全局文本语义与人脸结构，难以捕捉眉毛紧张、脸颊收缩、不对称嘴部运动等细微局部形变，导致几何保真度和编辑精度受限。
Method: 先构建包含文本—网格标注和文本—blendshape 配对样本的 FaME-G2E 数据集；随后提出检索增强框架 RAGMesh，其中 MSRF 模块检索语义一致的全局与区域人脸先验并在 blendshape 空间融合，AdaRAGS 则提供区域感知监督以显式对齐文本语义与对应人脸区域。
Result: 在 FaME-G2E 上的大量实验表明，RAGMesh 在局部几何精度、文本引导可控性、区域编辑精度和推理效率方面优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用文本相关几何先验的检索增强框架能够提升高保真人脸合成与编辑性能，并计划在论文接收后发布源代码和数据集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SiriusDeliver: Automating Data Warehouse Delivery at Tencent
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise data warehouses (DWs) support business-critical analytics, but warehouse task delivery remains a complicated production process involving context retrieval, workflow configuration, code generation, platform submission, and failure diagnosis. Although large language models (LLMs) and coding agents have improved software development, they are insufficient for production DW delivery, which requires dependency-aware orchestration, lifecycle-aware artifact control, and continuous adaptation to evolving platform practices. We present SiriusDeliver, an end-to-end delivery automation agent for production warehouse task submission. SiriusDeliver integrates three components: a hierarchical delivery agent that orchestrates warehouse skills, an artifact lifecycle control module that verifies and revises artifacts before and after platform execution, and a trace-driven skill evolution mechanism that maintains reusable skills from delivery trajectories. We evaluate SiriusDeliver through offline datasets and large-scale production deployment on Tencent Cloud WeData. Offline experiments on real-world warehouse delivery cases show that SiriusDeliver improves delivery success and automation efficiency over representative baselines. During a two-month deployment across 6 business teams and 4 warehouse task types, SiriusDeliver served 3,600 monthly active users and supported 18,240 delivery sessions, achieving an 87.2% end-to-end success rate and a 73.5% autonomous submission rate. A one-month A/B test shows that SiriusDeliver reduces median delivery time from 228 to 23 minutes and engineer effort from 95 to 11 minutes, while maintaining comparable final delivery success.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SiriusDeliver，一个面向生产环境数据仓库（DW）任务提交的端到端交付自动化智能体，已在腾讯云 WeData 上大规模部署。系统包含层次化交付智能体、工件生命周期控制模块和基于轨迹的技能演化机制，用于处理上下文检索、工作流配置、代码生成、平台提交与故障诊断。摘要报告了离线实验以及在 6 个业务团队、4 类仓库任务上的两个月生产部署结果，包括 87.2% 的端到端成功率和 73.5% 的自主提交率。
Motivation: 企业数据仓库任务交付仍是复杂的生产流程，涉及上下文检索、工作流配置、代码生成、平台提交和故障诊断；现有大语言模型（LLM）与编码智能体不足以应对生产环境交付，因为该场景需要依赖感知的编排、生命周期感知的工件控制以及对不断演化的平台实践的持续适应。
Method: SiriusDeliver 集成三个组件：负责编排仓库技能的层次化交付智能体（hierarchical delivery agent）、在平台执行前后验证和修订工件的生命周期控制模块（artifact lifecycle control module），以及从交付轨迹中维护可复用技能的轨迹驱动技能演化机制（trace-driven skill evolution mechanism）。
Result: 在真实仓库交付案例的离线实验中，SiriusDeliver 相比代表性基线提升了交付成功率和自动化效率。生产部署期间，系统服务 3,600 名月活用户、支持 18,240 次交付会话，端到端成功率达 87.2%，自主提交率达 73.5%；为期一个月的 A/B 测试将中位交付时间从 228 分钟降至 23 分钟，工程师投入从 95 分钟降至 11 分钟，同时保持相当的最终交付成功率。
Conclusion: 作者认为将层次化编排、工件生命周期控制与轨迹驱动的技能演化相结合，可以在真实生产环境中实现大规模仓库任务交付自动化，并在腾讯云 WeData 上得到验证；摘要未明确讨论方法局限。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在真实仓库交付案例的离线实验中，SiriusDeliver 相比代表性基线提升了交付成功率和自动化效率。生产部署期间，系统服务 3,600 名月活用户、支持 18,240 次交付会话，端到端成功率达 87.2%，自主提交率达 73.5%；为期一个月的 A/B 测试将中位交付时间从 228 分钟降至 23 分钟，工程师投入从 95 分钟降至 11 分钟，同时保持相当的最终交付成功率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为将层次化编排、工件生命周期控制与轨迹驱动的技能演化相结合，可以在真实生产环境中实现大规模仓库任务交付自动化，并在腾讯云 WeData 上得到验证；摘要未明确讨论方法局限。

papers.title: Agentic Router: An Execution-Grounded Continual Learning Approach With Memory
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents provide a promising interface for command-line-based network operations, but a plausible command may still fail or introduce operational risk after execution. Existing approaches mainly focus on command generation or final configuration correctness, and do not use execution-grounded experience to jointly improve candidate coverage and action selection. We propose an execution-grounded dual-path consequence-aware agent for CLI-based SONiC operations, which generates multiple complete actions, predicts their execution consequences, and selects the final action through utility- and risk-aware reranking. The proposal-side path abstracts reusable operational lessons into retrievable guidance to improve feasible-action coverage without modifying the proposal LLM, while the selection-side path adapts the consequence predictor through session-level LoRA updates using real SSH feedback to improve conditional selection quality. Experiments over multi-turn SONiC operation sessions with different Qwen3 proposal models show that the framework improves feasible-action coverage and top-1 execution success, and that the two adaptation paths provide complementary gains over interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向 CLI 式 SONiC 网络运维的 execution-grounded 双路径智能体框架，用于同时改进可行动作覆盖率和动作选择质量。系统会生成多个完整动作、预测执行后果，并通过效用与风险感知的重排序选出最终动作。实验基于多轮 SONiC 操作会话与不同 Qwen3 提案模型，显示框架提升了可行动作覆盖率和 top-1 执行成功率。
Motivation: 现有方法主要关注命令生成或最终配置正确性，未利用执行后的真实反馈来联合改善候选覆盖与动作选择；一个看似合理的命令在执行后仍可能失败或带来运维风险。
Method: 提出双路径框架：提案侧将可复用的运维经验抽象为可检索指导，在不修改提案 LLM 的前提下提升可行动作覆盖；选择侧利用真实 SSH 反馈，通过会话级 LoRA 更新后果预测器，并结合效用与风险感知重排序完成最终动作选择。
Result: 在多轮 SONiC 操作会话中使用不同 Qwen3 提案模型的实验表明，框架提升了可行动作覆盖率和 top-1 执行成功率，且两条适应路径在交互过程中提供互补增益。
Conclusion: 作者认为将执行后果反馈纳入候选覆盖与选择两个环节，可以有效改善基于 LLM 的 CLI 网络运维操作质量。

papers.title: Rethinking Medical Landmark Localization with Prototype Learning-based Progressive Offset Correction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate landmark localization in medical images is a fundamental step for quantitative clinical measurement and downstream analysis. Existing localization methods have advanced, among which multi-stage refinement is a superior solution. Although this strategy mitigates the anatomical ambiguity inherent in single-stage global predictions, its high computational cost limits practical applicability. In this work, we propose a parameter-economic model, PPOC-LL, which leverages Prototype learning-based Progressive Offset Correction for Landmark Localization. Our contribution is three-fold. First, to drive coarse-to-fine landmark optimization, we introduce a multi-scale dynamic perception strategy for patch-level feature pyramid modeling. Second, to effectively handle anatomically similar patterns, we design a similarity-driven prototype learning mechanism that captures informative local semantics for robust offset prediction. Last, to stabilize the model learning and improve the overall performance, we incorporate a novel error-aware reliability regularization via tolerance-based balancing. We collected a large validation cohort, including two public and one private datasets spanning X-ray and ultrasound modalities, covering cephalometric, symphysis-fetal head, and fetal heart landmarks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PPOC-LL achieves satisfactory performance with a favorable trade-off between accuracy and model complexity.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted by MICCAI MLMI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PPOC-LL，一种参数经济的医学图像地标定位模型，基于原型学习驱动的渐进式偏移校正 (Prototype learning-based Progressive Offset Correction)。摘要报告该方法在多尺度动态感知、相似性驱动原型学习和误差感知可靠性正则化三方面改进，并在颅颌、胎儿头和胎儿心脏的 X 光与超声数据集上取得精度与模型复杂度之间的良好平衡。
Motivation: 现有的多阶段细化 (multi-stage refinement) 定位策略能缓解单阶段全局预测的解剖模糊性，但计算成本过高，限制了实际应用。
Method: 提出 PPOC-LL 模型：引入多尺度动态感知策略构建 patch 级特征金字塔实现粗到细的优化；设计相似性驱动的原型学习机制捕获局部语义以鲁棒预测偏移；加入基于容差平衡的误差感知可靠性正则化来稳定训练并提升整体性能。
Result: 在包含两个公开和一个私有数据集的大规模验证队列（覆盖 X 光和超声模态，包括头颅测量、耻骨联合-胎头及胎儿心脏地标）上，PPOC-LL 取得了令人满意的性能，并在精度与模型复杂度之间提供了有利的权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调原型学习驱动的渐进式偏移校正能够以较低复杂度实现可靠的医学图像地标定位。

papers.title: Not All Visual Tokens Are Equally Safe to Remove:Consequence-Sensitive Visual Token Compression
papers.abstract_en: Visual token compression for vision--language models (VLMs) has largely relied on criteria such as attention, redundancy, and uncertainty to maximize average accuracy under a fixed compute budget, implicitly assuming that all errors carry equal cost. However, the consequence of an incorrect prediction on downstream tasks is rarely symmetric: misreading an invoice amount can be far more costly than misclassifying a background color. Motivated by this, we introduce consequence-sensitive visual token compression, which allocates visual computation across requests according to their potential error costs. Our method follows a calibrate-then-allocate procedure, estimating consequence-specific error-budget curves offline and applying the calibrated token budgets online using consequence signals available from question or task information. On a controlled within-task benchmark, high- and low-consequence questions are drawn from the same document images, so content alone cannot reveal which questions are costly to get wrong. In this setting, our method reduces high-stakes errors from 0.300 to 0.133 under the same total token budget, whereas a content-driven allocator performs no better than uniform allocation. Measuring how error rates change with token budget across different cost ratios, we derive an allocation frontier: uniform allocation is optimal when errors are equally costly, and token transfer toward high-consequence questions becomes increasingly beneficial as the cost gap grows. This allocation principle generalizes well across three dense vision-language benchmarks, two budget realization mechanisms (token deletion and resolution reallocation), two VLM architectures, and multiple token selection strategies. On a realistic mixed workload, consequence-sensitive allocation reduces cost-weighted error by 38% while achieving approximately 21% lower latency than full-resolution inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出后果敏感（consequence-sensitive）的视觉 token 压缩方法，用于视觉-语言模型（VLM）。与以往依据注意力、冗余度或不确定性来最大化平均精度的做法不同，该方法在固定总 token 预算下按潜在错误代价分配视觉计算资源，采用先校准后分配（calibrate-then-allocate）的流程，离线估计不同后果下的错误-预算曲线，再用问题或任务信息提供的后果信号在线应用校准后的 token 预算。作者在受控的文档图像任务上将高后果（high-consequence）问题的错误率从 0.300 降到 0.133，并在跨基准、跨架构与跨预算机制的实验中验证了该分配原则的泛化性。
Motivation: 现有视觉 token 压缩隐式假设所有预测错误的代价相同，但下游任务中的错误后果往往不对称，例如发票金额读错比背景颜色误分类的代价高得多。作者指出，平均精度最大化无法反映这种不对称性，因此需要按潜在错误代价分配视觉计算。
Method: 提出 calibrate-then-allocate 流程：离线估计后果特定的错误-预算曲线（consequence-specific error-budget curves），在线利用来自问题或任务信息的后果信号，把校准后的 token 预算分配给不同请求。该分配机制不依赖图像内容，而是由任务后果驱动。
Result: 在受控的 within-task 基准上，高后果问题错误率从 0.300 降至 0.133，而内容驱动分配器不优于均匀分配；当错误代价相等时均匀分配最优，代价差距越大时向高后果问题转移 token 的收益越大。该方法在三个密集 VLM 基准、两种预算实现机制（token 删除与分辨率重分配）、两种 VLM 架构和多种 token 选择策略上均泛化；在真实混合负载上，后果敏感分配使代价加权错误降低 38%，延迟比全分辨率推理低约 21%。
Conclusion: 作者认为，当错误代价不对称时，按后果分配 token 预算优于均匀分配和内容驱动分配，且该原则在多种基准、架构和预算实现方式下保持有效。摘要未提及明显的局限。

papers.title: A Time-Frequency Dual-Domain Multi-Scale Convolutional Neural Network for Bearing Fault Diagnosis under Strong Noise
papers.abstract_en: To address the degradation of bearing fault diagnosis accuracy under strong noise, this paper proposes a time-frequency dual-domain multi-scale convolutional neural network. The time-domain branch employs three parallel convolutional kernels to capture multi-scale impulse features, while the frequency-domain branch applies the Fast Fourier Transform to extract noise-robust spectral structure information. Features from both branches are fused for fault classification, yielding a compact model of 110,122 parameters. Experiments on the CWRU bearing dataset across seven signal-to-noise ratio levels demonstrate that the proposed method achieves 99.75% accuracy under clean conditions and maintains 92.50% at -4 dB SNR, representing a 7.25 percentage-point improvement over the single-domain baseline with monotonically increasing gains under stronger noise. Ablation experiments validate the independent performance contributions of the time-domain multi-scale branch and the frequency-domain branch. Comparative experiments against WDCNN, DRSN-CW, MCNN, and 1D-LeNet confirm the superiority of the proposed method under strong noise conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强噪声下轴承故障诊断精度下降的问题，提出一种时频双域多尺度卷积神经网络。时域分支用三个并行卷积核捕获多尺度冲击特征，频域分支通过快速傅里叶变换（FFT）提取抗噪的频谱结构信息，两分支特征融合后进行分类，模型参数量为110,122。在CWRU轴承数据集上七个信噪比水平下，干净条件下准确率为99.75%，-4 dB SNR下保持92.50%，比单域基线提升7.25个百分点，且噪声越强提升越大。
Motivation: 强噪声会使轴承故障诊断精度显著退化，现有单域或单一尺度特征提取方法对噪声鲁棒性不足，需要同时利用时域冲击特征和频域谱结构信息来提升抗噪能力。
Method: 提出时频双域多尺度卷积神经网络：时域分支采用三个并行卷积核提取多尺度冲击特征，频域分支使用FFT获取噪声鲁棒的频谱结构信息，随后融合两分支特征进行故障分类，得到一个紧凑模型。
Result: 在CWRU数据集七个信噪比水平上，干净条件下准确率为99.75%，-4 dB SNR下为92.50%，较单域基线提升7.25个百分点，且噪声越强提升幅度越大；消融实验验证了时域多尺度分支与频域分支各自的贡献；与WDCNN、DRSN-CW、MCNN和1D-LeNet的对比实验确认了强噪声下的优越性。
Conclusion: 摘要认为时频双域特征融合与多尺度时域卷积结构是提升强噪声鲁棒性的关键，并在紧凑模型规模下实现了较好的诊断精度。

papers.title: From Relevance to Execution Utility: Reward-Aware Dynamic Execution Gating for Skill-Based LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills are increasingly used to equip large language model (LLM) agents with reusable procedural knowledge. Although recent work has substantially improved skill retrieval due to the increasing skill libraries, retrieving a plausible skill bundle does not guarantee that executing it is worthwhile. Since every skill-conditioned rollout is computationally expensive, deciding whether a retrieved bundle should be executed has become an increasingly important challenge. To this end, we introduce the Reward-Aware Dynamic Execution Gate (RADEG), a lightweight, retriever-agnostic decision layer between skill retrieval and agent execution. RADEG learns a low-cost surrogate model that predicts the execution utility of a query--bundle pair before the expensive rollout is launched. To obtain informative supervision while controlling for task difficulty, we locally perturb each retrieved bundle by deleting, adding, or replacing one skill, producing matched same-query rollouts that isolate the effect of bundle composition on verifier reward. During deployment, RADEG updates only a warm-started logistic head as new verifier feedback becomes available, enabling inexpensive adaptation of the execute/skip boundary without retraining either the retriever or the agent. Under a query-level held-out evaluation on 288 collected rollouts, RADEG substantially reduces unnecessary agent executions while preserving a large fraction of the downstream verifier reward. It consistently outperforms relevance-based and random gating across different execution budgets, demonstrating that execution-aware surrogate modeling provides a practical and cost-effective complement to skill retrieval.

papers.title: Particle-Based Conformal Prediction for Contact-Aware Uncertainty Calibration in Stratified Configuration Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Reliable uncertainty representation is essential for deploying autonomous systems that interact with their environment, as robots must reason about how uncertainty arising from both stochasticity and model mismatch is impacted by contacts with obstacles (e.g., when navigating through a cluttered environment or inserting a part into an assembly). We propose Calibrated Particle-sets for Trans-dimensional Uncertainty Representation (CaPTURe), a geometry-aware, conformal prediction-based algorithm that generates probabilistically valid prediction regions of the unknown future system configuration using particle-based models of arbitrary fidelity. While calibrated uncertainty predictions are essential for safe and efficient planning, analytical or learned motion models are often inaccurate - due to limited data, simplifying assumptions, unmodeled effects, etc. - which can lead to unsafe executions or task failure. Additionally, when a robot contacts an obstacle, the distribution of its future configurations can become multimodal or disjoint, or lie along manifolds of lower intrinsic dimension than the space of possible robot configurations. Our method uses a calibration dataset of system transitions to locally calibrate motion uncertainty estimates, constructing regions guaranteed to contain the future robot configuration at a user-set probability. Our calibration procedure captures how motion uncertainty varies between contact-rich and contactless motions, leading to sufficient coverage in both cases. We evaluate our method on two simulated planning tasks: controlling a marble around a labyrinth and performing tight-tolerance peg-in-hole insertion with a manipulator. Compared to relevant baselines, CaPTURe achieves the user-specified coverage requirement both in and out of contact and achieves up to a 30% absolute improvement in task success rate over the best baseline.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at COPA 2026 (Conformal and Probabilistic Prediction with Applications). Project page: https://um-arm-lab.github.io/capture/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CaPTURe，一种基于共形预测 (conformal prediction) 的几何感知算法，用于在分层配置空间中对接触相关的不确定性进行校准。该方法利用系统转移的校准数据集构造以用户设定概率包含未来机器人配置的预测区域，并在接触丰富与无接触运动中都保持覆盖率。在两个模拟规划任务（迷宫大理石控制和机械臂紧公差插孔）上，CaPTURe 相比基线达到最高 30% 的绝对任务成功率提升。
Motivation: 机器人与环境交互时，接触障碍会使未来配置分布变得多模态、不连续或位于低维流形上，而解析或学习运动模型常因数据不足、简化假设等而不准确，导致不安全执行或任务失败。
Method: 提出 CaPTURe，使用粒子模型并通过校准数据集局部校准运动不确定性估计，构造概率有效的未来配置预测区域；校准过程显式区分接触丰富运动与无接触运动中不确定性变化的不同。
Result: 在两个模拟规划任务上，CaPTURe 在接触和非接触情况下均达到用户设定的覆盖率要求，并在任务成功率上比最佳基线取得高达 30% 的绝对提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能同时覆盖接触与非接触运动的不确定性，从而提升任务成功率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CIDER: A Dataset of Contextual Disclosure Boundaries for Privacy Preference Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human privacy preferences requires capturing individuals' disclosure boundaries beyond general privacy norms. However, a gap remains in eliciting such nuanced preferences to evaluate alignment in realistic settings. We introduce CIDER, a dataset of 14,850 human annotations from 169 users, forming 1,650 contextual disclosure boundary sets across 60 interpersonal communication scenarios involving information sharing that violates privacy norms. Each boundary represents a real user's disclosure decisions over 9 sharing variants in a scenario, for a given communication role and AI-mediated condition. We formulate a task in which models predict a user's disclosure decision from historical boundaries, with varying levels of contextual information. Across 12 open and proprietary models, in-context personalization improves prediction accuracy by up to 11.41 percentage points using only 6 historical examples. Larger models such as GPT-5.4 (with medium reasoning effort) and Claude Sonnet 4.6 are better at leveraging semantic context to understand user-specific, context-dependent disclosure preferences for more accurate predictions, while smaller models tend to rely on structured heuristics based on disclosure granularity and identifiability. Personalization generally improves prediction accuracy, but the improvement is often accompanied by imbalanced shifts in false-positive and false-negative rates across models, with only Claude Sonnet 4.6 achieving balanced improvements in both. Our findings reveal both the promise and limitations of inference-time personalization for privacy preference modeling and position CIDER as a resource for advancing personalized privacy alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CIDER，一个用于对齐大语言模型（LLM）与个人隐私偏好的数据集，包含 169 名用户的 14,850 条人工标注，构成 60 个人际沟通场景下的 1,650 组情境化披露边界（disclosure boundary）。每一边界对应一个真实用户在 9 种分享变体上的披露决策，并引入了从历史边界预测用户披露决策的任务。作者在 12 个开源与专有模型上测试了上下文内个性化（in-context personalization），发现它最多可提升 11.41 个百分点准确率，同时揭示了大模型与小模型利用上下文信息方式的不同。
Motivation: 现有研究往往依赖一般性隐私规范来评估模型与人类隐私偏好的对齐，缺少在真实情境中获取个体化、情境相关的披露边界（disclosure boundaries）的方法，因此难以在现实场景中评估对齐效果。
Method: 构建 CIDER 数据集，每个场景下按沟通角色和 AI 中介条件收集真实用户对 9 种分享变体的披露决策，并设计任务让模型基于用户的历史边界、在不同层级的上下文信息条件下预测其披露决策。
Result: 在 12 个开放与专有模型中，仅用 6 个历史示例的上下文内个性化即可将预测准确率提升最多 11.41 个百分点；GPT-5.4（中等推理强度）和 Claude Sonnet 4.6 等较大模型更擅长利用语义上下文理解用户特定且情境相关的披露偏好，而较小模型更依赖基于披露粒度与可识别性的结构化启发式；只有 Claude Sonnet 4.6 在假阳率和假阴率上实现了均衡改善。
Conclusion: 研究发现推理时个性化（inference-time personalization）对隐私偏好建模既有潜力也存在局限，个性化提升准确率时常伴随假阳与假阴的不均衡变化；作者将 CIDER 定位为推进个性化隐私对齐研究的数据资源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Tabular Numeric Stretch Transformation
papers.abstract_en: Tabular data presents unique challenges for deep learning due to its heterogeneous nature, where numeric features exhibit diverse distributions, scales, and statistical properties. Although recent advances have improved how models learn from tabular data, how numeric data are transformed into model-friendly representations remains comparatively underexplored. We introduce the stretch transformation framework, which formulates numeric feature preprocessing as an optimization problem to make the target function smoother and thus more learnable. Our framework has two variants: (1) unsupervised stretch, which uniformly redistributes feature density via minimax optimization, and (2) supervised stretch, which optimizes target-aware numeric feature transformations from the perspective of target-function smoothness by minimizing the target function's Dirichlet energy in the transformed space. Our theoretical analysis further connects this framework to several popular transformations: unsupervised stretch is closely related to Piecewise Linear Encoding through a shared piecewise-linear geometry and approaches the empirical CDF transformation as the number of bins grows, while supervised stretch becomes closely related to target encoding in the fine-binning limit. Comprehensive experiments on 38 datasets from the TALENT benchmark demonstrate that supervised stretch consistently outperforms all baselines. These results show that explicitly optimizing for target function smoothness is a powerful and underexplored strategy for tabular deep learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向表格数据的数值特征预处理框架 stretch transformation，将特征变换形式化为优化问题，以让目标函数更平滑、更易学习。框架有无监督和有监督两个变体：无监督拉伸通过极小极大优化均匀重分布特征密度，监督拉伸则通过最小化变换空间中目标函数的 Dirichlet energy 进行目标感知的变换。在 TALENT 基准的 38 个数据集上，监督拉伸一致优于所有基线。
Motivation: 表格数据中数值特征分布、尺度和统计性质差异很大，而现有深度学习方法虽然改进了表格学习，但对数值特征如何转换为模型友好表示的预处理环节研究不足。作者希望把预处理本身作为可优化目标，从而提升可学习性。
Method: 提出 stretch transformation 框架，将数值特征预处理建模为优化问题。两个变体分别是：unsupervised stretch，通过 minimax optimization 均匀重分布特征密度；supervised stretch，通过最小化变换空间中目标函数的 Dirichlet energy 来优化目标函数平滑性。理论分析还建立了该框架与 Piecewise Linear Encoding、经验 CDF 变换以及 target encoding 之间的联系。
Result: 在 TALENT 基准的 38 个数据集上的实验显示，supervised stretch 一致优于所有基线。理论上，无监督拉伸与 Piecewise Linear Encoding 共享分段线性几何，并在 bin 数增加时趋近经验 CDF 变换；监督拉伸在细 bin 极限下与 target encoding 密切相关。
Conclusion: 作者认为，显式优化目标函数平滑度是表格深度学习中一个有效且尚未充分探索的策略。该结论的适用范围主要是表格数据中的数值特征预处理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SwiftQK: Fast and Communication-Efficient Tensor Parallelism for Query-Key Normalization
papers.abstract_en: Query-Key Normalization (QK-Norm) improves the training stability and quality of modern Large Language Models (LLMs). However, under Tensor Parallelism (TP), layerwise QK-Norm introduces additional cross-GPU communication because the normalization factor depends on the full hidden vector. We present SwiftQK, a multi-GPU RMSNorm kernel that exchanges only scalar normalization statistics and overlaps the remaining Peer-to-Peer reduction with independent element-wise computation in a deadlock-safe persistent kernel. Evaluations on recent LLMs show that SwiftQK reduces QK-Norm latency by 81.4--93.9% relative to the standard TP QK-Norm using full-vector All-Gather. In end-to-end serving, SwiftQK reduces TPOT on average by 29.5% over the All-Gather-based baseline and by 14.3% over an optimized scalar-aggregation implementation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SwiftQK，一个面向张量并行 (Tensor Parallelism) 下 Query-Key Normalization (QK-Norm) 的多 GPU RMSNorm 内核。QK-Norm 的逐层归一化因子依赖完整隐藏向量，在 TP 下需要额外的全向量 All-Gather 通信；SwiftQK 通过只交换标量归一化统计量，并将剩余的 Peer-to-Peer 归约与独立的逐元素计算重叠，以无死锁的持久内核实现。评测显示相比标准 TP QK-Norm，SwiftQK 将 QK-Norm 延迟降低 81.4%–93.9%；在端到端 serving 中相比 All-Gather 基线平均降低 TPOT 29.5%，相比优化的标量聚合实现降低 14.3%。
Motivation: QK-Norm 能提升现代 LLM 的训练稳定性与质量，但在张量并行下，由于归一化因子依赖完整隐藏向量，逐层 QK-Norm 会引入额外的跨 GPU 通信，成为性能瓶颈。
Method: SwiftQK 是一个多 GPU RMSNorm 内核，仅交换标量归一化统计量，并将剩余的 Peer-to-Peer 归约操作与独立的逐元素计算重叠，采用无死锁的持久内核设计以避免通信阻塞。
Result: 在近期 LLM 上的评测中，SwiftQK 相对使用全向量 All-Gather 的标准 TP QK-Norm 将延迟降低 81.4%–93.9%；端到端 serving 中 TPOT 比 All-Gather 基线平均降低 29.5%，比优化后的标量聚合实现平均降低 14.3%。
Conclusion: 该工作表明通过标量统计量交换与计算通信重叠，可以显著削减张量并行下 QK-Norm 的通信开销，从而提升 LLM serving 效率。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 SwiftQK，一个面向张量并行 (Tensor Parallelism) 下 Query-Key Normalization (QK-Norm) 的多 GPU RMSNorm 内核。QK-Norm 的逐层归一化因子依赖完整隐藏向量，在 TP 下需要额外的全向量 All-Gather 通信；SwiftQK 通过只交换标量归一化统计量，并将剩余的 Peer-to-Peer 归约与独立的逐元素计算重叠，以无死锁的持久内核实现。评测显示相比标准 TP QK-Norm，SwiftQK 将 QK-Norm 延迟降低 81.4%–93.9%；在端到端 serving 中相比 All-Gather 基线平均降低 TPOT 29.5%，相比优化的标量聚合实现降低 14.3%。
