papers.title: From Inaudible Inputs to Model Failures: Low-Frequency Safety Risks in LALMs
papers.abstract_en: Large audio-language models (LALMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in understanding diverse audio inputs. This diversity includes low-frequency signals that are inaudible to humans but can still enter the model and influence its generation. However, the practical impact of such low-frequency inputs on LALMs remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we propose Intermittent Low-Frequency Lockout (ILL), an inaudible red teaming method that evaluates this risk using a universal waveform template in a black box setting. ILL uses Sentence Attention Scale Estimation to determine active intervals and Frequency Confusion Transfer to construct a low-frequency waveform with continuous phase from corpus spectral variation. To mitigate this risk, we propose Distributional Requery Guard (DRG) to detect low-frequency distribution shifts and conditionally request a second recording for semantic recovery. Across six LALMs and multiple audio understanding tasks, ILL reduces accuracy by up to 67 percentage points while receiving a mean human audibility rating of 1.33, close to 1.17 for clean audio; DRG raises mean attacked accuracy from 28.5\% to 46.1\% after clean reacquisition. These findings identify a previously overlooked safety risk for LALMs and provide a foundation for future research on robust audio understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型音频语言模型 (LALM) 对人耳不可闻的低频信号的脆弱性，提出一种黑盒不可听红队方法 Intermittent Low-Frequency Lockout (ILL)，并配套提出 Distributional Requery Guard (DRG) 作为缓解手段。摘要报告在六个 LALM 和多个音频理解任务上，ILL 最多使准确率下降 67 个百分点，而平均人耳可听度评分仅为 1.33，接近干净音频的 1.17；DRG 在重新获取干净录音后把平均受攻击准确率从 28.5% 提升到 46.1%。
Motivation: LALM 能够处理包括人类听不见的低频信号在内的多样音频输入，这些信号仍可进入模型并影响其生成，但此类低频输入对 LALM 的实际安全影响此前基本未被探索。
Method: 提出 ILL，一种基于通用波形模板的黑盒不可听红队方法，使用 Sentence Attention Scale Estimation 确定有效干扰区间，并利用 Frequency Confusion Transfer 从语料频谱变化构造具有连续相位的低频波形；缓解端提出 DRG，用于检测低频分布偏移并有条件地请求第二次录音以恢复语义。
Result: 在六个 LALM 和多个音频理解任务上，ILL 使准确率下降最多 67 个百分点，平均人耳可听度评分 1.33（干净音频为 1.17）；DRG 在干净重采后把平均受攻击准确率从 28.5% 提高到 46.1%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这些发现揭示了一个此前被忽视的 LALM 安全风险，并为鲁棒音频理解的后续研究提供基础。

papers.title: TRACE: TRajectory Attribution for Automated Context Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Production AI agents fail when their context sources -- system prompts, knowledge bases, tool descriptions, and procedural skills -- contain errors or gaps. Current maintenance relies on manual log review and ad-hoc debugging, creating a scalability bottleneck as interaction volume grows. We present TRACE (TRajectory Attribution for Automated Context Engineering), an automated feedback loop that mines historical agent trajectories to diagnose and remediate context failures. Our key insight is that trajectories are rich with implicit dissatisfaction signals -- user corrections, rephrasing, abandonment cues -- that reveal precisely where context sources failed, without explicit feedback collection. Unlike model fine-tuning, TRACE operates on the context layer, enabling rapid iteration without retraining. We make four contributions: (1) a trajectory mining framework that systematically extracts diagnostic information from historical agent executions; (2) multi-component causal attribution that extends textual gradients from monolithic prompt optimization to heterogeneous context sources (skills, knowledge bases, tools, prompts); (3) exploratory verification, where agents actively read context sources to distinguish content gaps requiring CREATE from stale content requiring UPDATE, achieving 96% operation accuracy; and (4) a reusable simulation methodology and verifiable benchmark addressing the absence of open datasets for context debugging, with a six-category fault taxonomy, ground truth annotations, and a cross-layer verification protocol. On 60 dissatisfaction traces spanning three complexity tiers (up to 16 execution nodes), TRACE achieves 72.7% root cause attribution and 82% end-to-end fix effectiveness, showing that over 80% of context-layer failures can be automatically diagnosed and remediated by mining historical trajectories, an overlooked resource in production systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE（TRajectory Attribution for Automated Context Engineering），一个面向生产环境 AI agent 的自动化反馈回路，通过挖掘历史轨迹来诊断并修复上下文源（system prompts、知识库、工具描述、程序化技能）中的故障。核心思路是不依赖显式反馈收集，而是从用户纠正、改写、放弃等隐含不满信号中定位上下文源失败的位置。摘要报告该方法在 60 条不满轨迹上达到 72.7% 的根因归因准确率、82% 的端到端修复有效性，并提出一套可复用的仿真方法与可验证基准。
Motivation: 生产环境 AI agent 经常因上下文源存在错误或缺口而失败，现有维护依赖人工日志审查和临时调试，随着交互量增长形成可扩展性瓶颈。
Method: TRACE 包含四个贡献：从历史 agent 执行中系统提取诊断信息的轨迹挖掘框架；将文本梯度（textual gradients）从整体提示优化扩展到异构上下文源的多组件因果归因；让 agent 主动读取上下文源以区分需要 CREATE 的内容缺口与需要 UPDATE 的陈旧内容的探索性验证；以及包含六类故障分类法、ground truth 标注和跨层验证协议的可验证基准。
Result: 在探索性验证中达到 96% 的操作准确率；在跨越三个复杂度层级（最多 16 个执行节点）的 60 条不满轨迹上，TRACE 实现 72.7% 的根因归因和 82% 的端到端修复有效性，表明超过 80% 的上下文层故障可通过挖掘历史轨迹自动诊断和修复。
Conclusion: 作者强调 TRACE 作用于上下文层而非模型微调，可无需重训即可快速迭代，并将历史轨迹视为生产系统中被忽视的故障诊断资源。
Relevance: 7

papers.title: LightAIR: Lightweight Action Inversion and Riemannian Rectification for Text-based Person Anomaly Search
papers.abstract_en: Traditional Text-based Person Search (TPS) is typically limited to matching static appearance attributes, severely neglecting dynamic action information. The Text-based Person Anomaly Search (TPAS) task bridges this gap, requiring models to locate micro-level specific abnormal behaviors while matching macro-level appearance of pedestrians. However, current TPAS methods face fundamental limitations: external explicit pose estimators are fragile in unconstrained surveillance scenarios, and implicit learning encounters visual decoupling failure under pixel-level entanglement, causing dominant appearance information to easily swallow and contaminate subtle action features. Furthermore, performing contrastive optimization on hard negative samples (``same appearance, different actions'') in conventional Euclidean spaces induces severe shortcut learning. To address these, we propose the Lightweight Action Inversion and Riemannian rectification network (LightAIR). First, it introduces textual semantic priors as anchors via a lightweight action inversion operator to extract pure action features, thereby overcoming visual-inherent coupling. Subsequently, it employs orthogonal null-space projection to constrain appearance features within the orthogonal complement space of action features, guaranteeing strict forward decoupling. Finally, we designed a gradient rectification module that computes the Riemannian gradient to constrain the backpropagation trajectory, forcing the gradient flow to update strictly along the tangent space that preserves decoupling properties, thereby cutting off harmful shortcuts. Extensive experiments on the widely used TPAS and TIPR datasets demonstrate that LightAIR significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. Codes are available at https://github.com/rainy-london/LightAIR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LightAIR（Lightweight Action Inversion and Riemannian rectification network），针对基于文本的行人异常搜索（TPAS）任务，通过轻量级动作反演、正交零空间投影和 Riemann 梯度矫正来解耦动作与外观特征。摘要称该方法在 TPAS 和 TIPR 数据集上显著优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 传统基于文本的行人搜索（TPS）仅匹配静态外观属性，忽略了动态动作信息；而 TPAS 需要同时匹配宏观外观和微观异常行为。现有方法依赖脆弱的外部姿态估计器，或受像素级纠缠导致的视觉解耦失败影响，使外观信息淹没动作特征；此外，在欧氏空间对“同外观、不同动作”的难负样本做对比优化会诱发捷径学习（shortcut learning）。
Method: LightAIR 首先利用轻量级动作反演算子，以文本语义先验作为锚点提取纯动作特征，克服视觉固有耦合；随后采用正交零空间投影将外观特征约束在动作特征的正交补空间中，保证前向严格解耦；最后设计梯度矫正模块，计算 Riemann 梯度来约束反向传播轨迹，使梯度流沿保持解耦性质的切空间更新，从而切断有害捷径。
Result: 在广泛使用的 TPAS 和 TIPR 数据集上的实验表明，LightAIR 显著优于现有最先进方法。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过前向和后向同时解耦动作与外观特征、阻断有害捷径是提升异常搜索性能的关键，并已公开代码。

papers.title: OGG-FR: Orthogonal Gradient Gaming and Frequency Rectification for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Infrared Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) infrared image super-resolution aims to recover weak thermal structures for deployment on resource-constrained platforms; lightweight models are therefore preferred, but multi-loss training can be unstable. A common strategy combines pixel-domain and frequency-domain objectives; however, low contrast, limited high-frequency content, and sensor-specific noise often make their gradients weakly aligned or conflicting. To address this optimization ambiguity, we propose Orthogonal Gradient Gaming and Frequency Rectification (OGG-FR), a plug-and-play optimization framework that decomposes the frequency gradient into a redundant parallel component and an orthogonal innovation component relative to the pixel gradient. In the conflict regime, OGG-FR computes a safe base gradient using the Multiple Gradient Descent Algorithm (MGDA) and adds a variance-rectified orthogonal innovation; in the compatible regime, it discards redundant parallel information and injects the orthogonal innovation according to a confidence score estimated from the high-frequency residual. Experimental results on the UAV thermal benchmark show broad gains under BI and BD degradations at $\times 4$ and $\times 8$ scales, while gradient analyses support the effectiveness of the proposed conflict-aware update rule.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OGG-FR（Orthogonal Gradient Gaming and Frequency Rectification），一个即插即用的优化框架，用于无人机红外图像超分辨率任务中的多损失训练不稳定问题。该方法将频率域梯度相对于像素域梯度分解为冗余平行分量与正交创新分量，并在冲突与兼容两种情境下采用不同的更新策略。摘要报告在 UAV 热成像基准的 BI 与 BD 退化、×4 和 ×8 尺度下均有广泛提升，梯度分析支持该冲突感知更新规则的有效性。
Motivation: 无人机红外图像超分辨率需要在资源受限平台上轻量部署，但多损失训练常不稳定；像素域与频率域目标虽然常用，却因低对比度、高频内容有限及传感器噪声而导致梯度弱对齐甚至相互冲突。
Method: 提出 OGG-FR 优化框架：将频率梯度相对像素梯度分解为冗余平行分量与正交创新分量；冲突场景下用多梯度下降算法（MGDA）计算安全基梯度并加入方差修正的正交创新，兼容场景下丢弃冗余平行信息，并根据高频残差估计的置信度注入正交创新。
Result: 在 UAV 热成像基准上，BI 与 BD 两种退化设置、×4 与 ×8 两种尺度下均取得广泛性能提升；梯度分析验证了冲突感知更新规则的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调以频率梯度分解与冲突感知更新解决像素域和频率域目标之间的优化歧义，可提升无人机红外图像超分辨率的训练稳定性与重建效果。

papers.title: RefineAny3D: Depth Refinement as Semantic Alignment for Monocular 3D Detection
papers.abstract_en: Monocular 3D object detection spans two regimes: closed-set detectors operating within a fixed category vocabulary, and open-vocabulary detectors that localize arbitrary categories by leveraging depth foundation models for 3D geometry. We find that current depth foundation models, despite their strong zero-shot generalization, lack the object-level precision 3D detection demands: substituting a state-of-the-art depth foundation model for a strong detector's predicted depth degrades accuracy, even falling below the detector's own prediction. Rather than pushing detectors or depth models to be more accurate end-to-end, we treat object-level depth refinement as a stand-alone task and present RefineAny3D, a vision-language model that corrects depth without ever predicting a numerical value. Our key insight is that depth error has a direct visual signature in image space: when projected onto the image, a correctly placed box tightly encloses the object, while a too-far box projects too small and a too-close box projects too large. Depth refinement thus reduces to a visual alignment problem rather than a metric regression problem, which we instantiate by extending the VLM's vocabulary with action tokens that replace numerical depth output with categorical decisions, and by supervising the model on a large-scale chain-of-thought dataset that grounds each decision in explicit visual evidence. Applied as a single post-hoc step, RefineAny3D delivers consistent gains across closed-set detectors, open-vocabulary detectors, and 3D auto-labeling tools, and generalizes to novel categories, scenes, and cameras without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RefineAny3D，一个用于单目 3D 检测的物体级深度精修模型。作者发现当前深度基础模型（depth foundation model）在零样本泛化上很强，但缺乏 3D 检测所需的物体级精度：直接替换强检测器的预测深度反而会降低精度。RefineAny3D 将深度精修视为语义对齐问题，通过视觉语言模型输出类别化决策而非数值深度，并利用大规模思维链数据训练。作为即插即用的后处理步骤，它在闭集检测器、开放词汇检测器和 3D 自动标注工具上均带来一致提升，且无需重新训练即可泛化到新类别、新场景和新相机。
Motivation: 单目 3D 检测中，深度基础模型虽零样本泛化强，但物体级精度不足；替换检测器自身深度预测反而使精度下降，说明需要专门的物体级深度精修。
Method: 将深度精修重构为视觉对齐问题：正确放置的 3D 框投影后应紧贴物体，过远投影过小、过近投影过大。为此扩展 VLM 词汇表，用动作 token（action tokens）输出类别化决策而非数值深度，并在大规模思维链数据集上训练，每个决策都基于显式视觉证据。
Result: 作为单一后处理步骤，RefineAny3D 在闭集检测器、开放词汇检测器和 3D 自动标注工具上均取得一致精度提升，并能泛化到未见类别、场景和相机。
Conclusion: 作者主张把物体级深度精修当作独立任务，用视觉语言模型以语义对齐方式进行，而非推动端到端更精确的检测器或深度模型。

papers.title: Multi-Submap Implicit Neural SLAM with Local-to-Global Loop Closure for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF)-based SLAM has demonstrated impressive results in small-scale scene reconstruction, yet scaling these methods to extensive, complex environments remains challenging due to catastrophic forgetting and accumulated trajectory drift. This paper presents a robust, large-scale neural SLAM system featuring a multi-submap architecture and a dual-tier loop closure mechanism. Specifically, we propose a progressive mapping strategy that dynamically allocates neural submaps to maintain high-fidelity representations without memory explosion. For robust pose estimation, an optical-flow-based tracking module is integrated to handle aggressive motions. To address global consistency, we introduce a local-to-global loop closure framework leveraging the foundation model for high-performance global descriptor extraction, significantly enhancing relocalization accuracy under varying viewpoints. Furthermore, an inter-submap online distillation algorithm is designed during back-end optimization to enforce geometric and appearance consistency across overlapping submap boundaries. To validate the system, we developed a customized handheld mechatronic platform and conducted extensive evaluations on both public benchmarks and our large-scale indoor-outdoor datasets. Experimental results, including direct deployment on an onboard computing unit, demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art neural SLAM methods in reconstruction quality and localization robustness, providing a scalable solution for real-world robotic perception and digital twinning. We will release the code publicly on \href{https://github.com/dtc111111/MSN-SLAM}{https://github.com/dtc111111/MSN-SLAM} .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向大规模场景重建的多子图隐式神经SLAM系统，采用渐进式子图分配、光流跟踪、基于基础模型的局部到全局回环闭合以及子图间在线蒸馏来缓解灾难性遗忘和轨迹漂移。在公共基准和自建大规模室内外数据集上的实验显示，其重建质量和定位鲁棒性优于现有神经SLAM方法，并已在机载计算单元上直接部署。
Motivation: 基于NeRF的SLAM在小规模场景中效果显著，但扩展到大规模复杂环境时面临灾难性遗忘和轨迹漂移累积的问题，限制了实际机器人感知与数字孪生应用。
Method: 提出多子图架构与双层级回环闭合机制：包括动态分配神经子图的渐进式建图策略、处理剧烈运动的光流跟踪模块、利用基础模型提取全局描述符的局部到全局回环闭合框架，以及用于跨子图几何与外观一致性约束的在线蒸馏算法。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在公共基准和自建大规模室内外数据集上的重建质量与定位鲁棒性优于现有最先进神经SLAM方法，并通过机载计算单元上的直接部署验证了实用性。
Conclusion: 该方法为大规模真实世界机器人感知和数字孪生提供了可扩展的解决方案，代码计划公开；摘要未明确提及局限性。

papers.title: Right Answer, Wrong Heat: Explanation-Aware Evaluation and Thermal-Grounded Feedback for MLLMs on Infrared Images
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly applied to infrared images, where they are commonly scored by answer accuracy alone. However, a correct answer does not ensure that the model's explanation is grounded in infrared thermal evidence. We introduce an explanation-aware evaluation framework that separates answer correctness, output-level explanation groundedness, and thermal grounding for infrared visual questions. Using a Dual-LLM Consensus Judge with a preliminary human-anchor calibration check, we find that correct answers can still rely on weak or visible-light evidence; withholding the original infrared image and showing only a visible-like rendering erodes thermal grounding with little accuracy change; and this erosion is observed most strongly for more capable models but disappears when infrared remains available. We further propose Thermal-Grounded Feedback (TGF), a training-free feedback loop that diagnoses explanation-side failures and revises the explanation while preserving the selected answer. On local paired-input validation, TGF improves explanation-side grounding without changing answers. These findings suggest that future trustworthy MLLMs for infrared scene understanding should be evaluated and developed to produce thermally grounded explanations rather than merely accurate answers.
papers.comment: This manuscript is currently under peer review. Copyright may subsequently be transferred to the publisher, after which the availability of this version may be subject to the publisher's policy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向红外图像多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的解释感知评估框架，将答案正确性、输出级解释的可落地性（groundedness）与热证据（thermal grounding）分离。通过 Dual-LLM Consensus Judge 与人工锚定校准，作者发现正确答案仍可能依赖弱证据或可见光证据；移除原始红外图像、只显示可见光式渲染会侵蚀热 grounding 而准确率几乎不变，且该侵蚀在更强模型上最明显。文中还提出训练无关的 Thermal-Grounded Feedback (TGF) 反馈循环，在保留答案的同时修订解释。
Motivation: 通用 MLLM 越来越多地用于红外图像，但现有评估只看答案准确率，无法保证模型的解释真正基于红外热证据，缺少对解释侧可信度的度量。
Method: 提出 explanation-aware 评估框架，区分答案正确性、输出级解释 groundedness 与热 grounding；使用 Dual-LLM Consensus Judge 并经过 human-anchor calibration。另提出 TGF，一个无需训练的反馈循环，诊断解释侧失败并修订解释，同时保持所选答案不变。
Result: 摘要报告：正确回答仍可能依赖弱或可见光证据；只给 visible-like 渲染而不给原始红外图像时，热 grounding 显著下降而准确率几乎不变；更强模型受此侵蚀最明显，而红外图像可用时该现象消失。在本地配对输入验证中，TGF 提升了解释侧 grounding 且不改变答案。
Conclusion: 作者认为未来面向红外场景理解的可信 MLLM 应以产生热 grounded 解释为目标来评估与开发，而非仅追求准确答案。该手稿目前处于同行评审阶段。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: UniMoFlow: Grounding Instruction-Driven 3D Human Motion Editing in Generation
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-driven editing of 3D human motion requires precise spatiotemporal localization, rich semantic grounding, and strict preservation of unmodified content. Existing methods either resort to training-free adaptation of generative models or rely solely on triplet supervision; however, adaptation often yields suboptimal control, and manually curated triplet datasets remain severely limited in scale and semantic diversity. To overcome this bottleneck, we ground motion editing directly within text-to-motion generation across data, architecture, and inference. At the data level, we develop a closed-loop synthesis-and-verification pipeline that produces Omni-MoEdit, a large-scale dataset spanning body-part, amplitude, temporal, action, and style edits. At the architectural level, we introduce UniMoFlow, a unified latent flow-matching model that shares broad semantic and kinematic knowledge between generation and editing. At the inference level, SAFE (Source-Anchored Flow Editing) complements UniMoFlow with controllable, source-anchored refinement. Furthermore, we augment standard evaluations with semantics-aware metrics to account for valid edits that inherently deviate from a single ground-truth reference. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved target-text alignment, edit effectiveness, and cycle consistency, while maintaining competitive source fidelity and text-to-motion generation quality.
papers.comment: 18 pages, including supplementary material; 8 figures and 7 tables. Code: https://github.com/Yilei-Hua/UniMoFlow. Submitted to AAAI 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniMoFlow，一种将指令驱动的 3D 人体运动编辑直接锚定在文本到运动生成框架中的统一方法，覆盖数据、架构和推理三个层面。作者构建了大规模数据集 Omni-MoEdit，提出共享生成与编辑知识的统一潜在流匹配模型，并设计基于源锚定的推理细化模块 SAFE。实验表明该方法在目标文本对齐、编辑有效性和循环一致性上均有提升，同时保持具有竞争力的源保真度和生成质量。
Motivation: 现有指令驱动的 3D 人体运动编辑方法要么依赖生成模型的免训练改造，控制效果欠佳，要么只依赖三元组监督，而人工构建的三元组数据集在规模和语义多样性上严重受限。
Method: 在数据层面设计闭环的合成-验证流程，生成覆盖身体部位、幅度、时间、动作和风格编辑的大规模数据集 Omni-MoEdit；在架构层面提出统一的潜在流匹配模型 UniMoFlow，使生成与编辑共享语义和运动学知识；在推理层面提出 SAFE（Source-Anchored Flow Editing），提供可控的源锚定细化。
Result: 大量实验表明 UniMoFlow 在目标文本对齐、编辑有效性和循环一致性上优于既有方法，同时保持有竞争力的源保真度与文本到运动生成质量；作者还引入语义感知指标以评估与单一真值参考天然偏离的合法编辑。
Conclusion: 作者认为将运动编辑直接锚定到文本到运动生成中，可以在数据、架构和推理三个层面同时缓解编辑数据稀缺和控制不足的问题；摘要未提及明确局限性。

papers.title: CodecArena: Codec Quality Assessment via Visual Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Video coding is advancing into the low and ultra-low bitrate regime, driven by end-to-end codecs that replace the hand-crafted pipeline with jointly optimized neural networks and generative codecs that exploit the priors of video generation models. Yet the dominant metrics, LPIPS and DISTS, measure feature and texture similarity rather than content fidelity: a reconstruction that hallucinates a wrong face or blurs text into convincing strokes can still score well, even when a human rejects it instantly. To address this, we propose CodecArena, the first vision-language framework for video coding quality assessment, casting codec evaluation as source-conditioned comparative reasoning between a reference and its reconstructions. We optimize CodecArena with Facet-GRPO, a visual reinforcement learning scheme that aligns pairwise codec preferences while grounding the verdict in five fidelity facets: identity, objects, text, texture, and temporal consistency. Its facet-anchored reward uses automatically derived facet directions as weak anchors, rather than human per-facet labels, to prevent any single sub-score from dominating the holistic preference and to yield interpretable fine-grained quality judgments. To support training and evaluation in this underexplored regime, we construct two complementary resources: CodecArena-1K, a fully automatic preference dataset of 1,500 comparison groups built from traditional, neural, and generative codec reconstructions with fused vision-language and objective supervision; and CodecArena-Bench, a human-ranked benchmark with source-disjoint videos for fair out-of-domain evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CodecArena achieves state-of-the-art agreement with human judgments on source-disjoint content across diverse codecs and bitrates, surpassing perceptual metrics and prior vision-language evaluators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CodecArena，一个面向视频编码质量评估的视觉-语言框架，将编码器评估建模为参考与重建之间的源条件比较推理，并用 Facet-GRPO 视觉强化学习对齐成对编码器偏好。作者构建了自动偏好数据集 CodecArena-1K 和人工排序基准 CodecArena-Bench，实验表明其在源不相交内容上达到与人类判断最先进的一致性。
Motivation: 现有视频编码质量指标如 LPIPS 和 DISTS 衡量特征与纹理相似性而非内容保真度，导致重建中幻觉出错误人脸或模糊文本时仍可得高分，与人类直觉不符。低码率乃至极低码率编码场景下这一问题尤为突出。
Method: 提出 CodecArena 视觉-语言框架，将编码器评估转化为源条件下的成对比较推理；用 Facet-GRPO 视觉强化学习对齐偏好，并以五个保真度维度（identity、objects、text、texture、temporal consistency）作为锚点。奖励使用自动派生的方向作为弱锚点而非人工逐维度标签，避免单一子分数主导整体偏好。
Result: 摘要报告 CodecArena 在源不相交视频内容、多种编码器和码率下与人类判断的一致性达到最先进水平，超越感知指标和先前的视觉-语言评估器。
Conclusion: 摘要认为将视觉-语言推理与强化学习结合、以多保真度方面锚定判断，可以实现可解释且符合人类直觉的细粒度视频编码质量评估。

papers.title: SpeedTuning: Speeding Up Policy Execution with Lightweight Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: While learned robotic policies hold promise for advancing generalizable manipulation, their practical deployment is often hindered by suboptimal execution speeds. Imitation learning policies are inherently limited by hardware constraints and the speed of the operator during data collection. In addition, there are no established methods for accelerating policies learned via imitation, and the empirical relationship between execution speed and task success remains underexplored. To address these issues, we introduce SpeedTuning, a reinforcement learning framework specifically designed to enhance the speed of manipulation policies. SpeedTuning learns to predict the optimal execution speed for actions, thereby complementing a base policy without necessitating additional data collection. We provide empirical evidence that SpeedTuning achieves substantial improvements in execution speed, exceeding 2.4x speed-up, while preserving an adequate success rate compared to both the original task policy and straightforward speed-up methods such as linear interpolation at a fixed speed. We evaluate our approach across a diverse set of dynamic and precise tasks, including pouring, throwing, and picking, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness in enhancing real-world robotic manipulation.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 12 figures. Includes an appendix with qualitative simulation rollouts and additional ablations. Published at ICRA 2025
papers.journal_ref: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA), pp. 1184-1192, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpeedTuning，一个用于加速机器人操作策略执行的强化学习框架。它学习预测动作的最优执行速度，从而在不额外采集数据的情况下补充基础策略。实验表明在倒水、投掷、抓取等动态和精细任务上实现超过 2.4 倍加速，同时保持足够的成功率。
Motivation: 模仿学习策略的部署速度受硬件限制和操作员采集数据时的速度限制，且缺乏加速模仿学习策略的成熟方法，执行速度与任务成功率之间的经验关系也尚未充分探索。
Method: SpeedTuning 是一个强化学习框架，学习为动作预测最优执行速度，从而与基础策略互补，无需额外数据收集，并与固定速率的线性插值等简单加速方法进行对比。
Result: 摘要报告 SpeedTuning 在真实世界机器人操作任务上实现超过 2.4 倍的速度提升，同时与原始任务策略和固定速率线性插值相比保持了足够的成功率；评估任务包括倒水、投掷和抓取。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SpeedTuning 能有效且稳健地提升真实世界机器人操作策略的执行速度，同时保持成功率，其适用范围聚焦于操作策略的加速。

papers.title: Bright-Channel Retinex Enhancement with a Conditional Overdispered-Noise Analysis
papers.abstract_en: I present a training-free low-light enhancement method that combines local bright-channel illumination estimation, Retinex division, and edge-preserving denoising. For a fixed illumination estimate, a conditional Negative -Binominal psueduo-count method characterises the heteroscedastic noise amplified by division. The unconstrained reflectance ratio is the pixelwise maximum-likelihood estimate, with a boundary solution for zero-valued observations; the implemented estimate additionally applies illumination filtering and range clipping. The NB model is a diagnostic noise analysis rather than a calibrated sensor model, and the final fixed-bandwidth bilateral filter is an empirical approximation rather than the exact Bayesian solution. On the LOL-v1 dataset, the methodobtains mean PSNR/SSIM of 17.74dB/0.739, the highest values among the evaluated with conventional methods. A 400X600 image is processed at approximately 43 FPS on an Apple M2 Pro CPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的暗光图像增强方法，结合局部亮通道（bright-channel）光照估计、Retinex 除法与保边去噪。作者用条件负二项（Negative Binomial）伪计数方法刻画除法放大后的异方差噪声，并将无约束反射率比视为逐像素最大似然估计。在 LOL-v1 数据集上取得 17.74dB/0.739 的平均 PSNR/SSIM，400X600 图像在 Apple M2 Pro CPU 上约 43 FPS。
Motivation: Retinex 除法会放大低光图像中的异方差噪声，现有方法缺少对该噪声结构的显式刻画，导致增强结果噪声明显。
Method: 先估计局部亮通道光照，再做 Retinex 除法；对固定光照估计，使用条件负二项伪计数方法描述除法放大的异方差噪声，反射率比取逐像素最大似然估计，零值观测采用边界解，并附加光照滤波与范围裁剪，最后用固定带宽双边滤波器近似去噪。
Result: 在 LOL-v1 上平均 PSNR/SSIM 为 17.74dB/0.739，是所评测传统方法中的最高值；400X600 图像在 Apple M2 Pro CPU 上处理速度约为 43 FPS。
Conclusion: 作者指出 NB 模型属于诊断性噪声分析而非校准的传感器模型，最终双边滤波器是经验近似而非精确贝叶斯解；方法本身训练免费且推理快速。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Latents Forget Pixels: Restoring Fidelity in Diffusion Transformer Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Image super-resolution (SR) with large generative models has recently achieved remarkable perceptual quality, yet maintaining fidelity to the LR observation remains challenging. In particular, we observe that diffusion transformers (DiTs) built on latent representations suffer from a critical limitation: the compression bottleneck of the VAE weakens fine-grained spatial information, leading to hallucinated details that are weakly grounded in the input image. In this work, we revisit generative SR from a representation perspective and propose a pixel-grounded super-resolution (PGSR) framework that preserves LR-observed pixel evidence before VAE compression and reuses it throughout restoration. Instead of relying solely on the compressed latent condition, PGSR extracts pre-VAE pixel evidence from the upsampled LR image and reuses it at two stages. First, Condition-Side Trajectory Guidance fuses LR-derived pixel evidence with the latent LR condition to guide the latent restoration trajectory. Second, Decoder-Side Pixel Grounding injects multi-scale pixel features into the frozen VAE decoder to ground the final rendering with LR-observed cues. To efficiently adapt large pretrained DiT models, we keep the latent autoencoder and main flow-matching backbone frozen, and train only lightweight restoration modules. We further study an efficient local-window attention variant for improved high-resolution efficiency and scalability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PGSR improves the realism--fidelity trade-off and produces more faithful, visually convincing results than existing latent generative SR approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出像素接地超分辨率框架PGSR，针对扩散Transformer（DiT）在潜在表示上进行超分辨率时，VAE压缩瓶颈削弱细粒度空间信息、导致幻觉细节与输入LR弱相关的问题。PGSR在VAE压缩前提取LR像素证据，并在两个阶段复用：条件侧轨迹引导融合像素证据与潜在LR条件，解码器侧像素接地向冻结的VAE解码器注入多尺度像素特征。实验表明该方法改善了真实感-保真度权衡，比现有潜在生成式SR方法更忠实、视觉上更可信。
Motivation: 基于大型生成模型的图像超分辨率虽获得出色感知质量，但保持对LR观测的保真度仍是难题；作者观察到基于潜在表示的DiT因VAE压缩瓶颈丢失精细空间信息，导致产生与输入图像弱相关的幻觉细节。
Method: 提出PGSR框架：从放大后的LR图像中提取预VAE像素证据，并分两阶段复用——Condition-Side Trajectory Guidance将LR像素证据与潜在LR条件融合以引导恢复轨迹，Decoder-Side Pixel Grounding向冻结的VAE解码器注入多尺度像素特征以接地最终渲染。保持潜在自编码器和主flow-matching骨干冻结，只训练轻量恢复模块，并研究局部窗口注意力变体以提升高分辨率效率与可扩展性。
Result: 摘要报告广泛实验表明PGSR改善了真实感-保真度权衡，相比现有潜在生成式SR方法产生更忠实且视觉上更可信的结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调从表示层面重新审视生成式SR，通过在压缩前保留并在恢复过程中复用LR像素证据，可在不微调大模型骨干的情况下提升DiT超分辨率的保真度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MARA: Flow-Matching-Guided Multi-Agent Resource Allocation for Computational Resource Efficient Learning
papers.abstract_en: Allocating limited computation among concurrent learning tasks is difficult when each task must reach a target loss before a deadline but its required training effort is unknown. Existing approaches combine online loss prediction with adaptive resource allocation, yet commonly treat computation as continuously divisible throughput. We instead study a practical setting in which tasks arrive over time and computation is provided by discrete nodes. This setting introduces both uncertain demand and constrained sequential decisions. We propose MARA, which predicts future loss trajectories with conditional flow matching and coordinates compute nodes through a cooperative multi-agent autoregressive policy. A potential-based progress reward supplies intermediate training feedback while preserving the undiscounted task-completion objective. Across in-distribution, reinforcement-learning, and vision workloads, flow matching reduces remaining-resource prediction error relative to weighted least squares. At the scheduler's training load, MARA completes 63.46% of tasks on average, 8.54 percentage points above strong baseline Learning with Adaptive Resource Allocation (LARA), and remains ahead under unseen heavier workloads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 MARA，一种针对离散计算节点上并发学习任务的计算资源分配方法。任务随时间到达，每个任务需在截止日期前达到目标损失，但所需训练量未知。MARA 用条件流匹配 (conditional flow matching) 预测未来损失轨迹，并通过协作式多智能体自回归策略 (cooperative multi-agent autoregressive policy) 协调节点调度。摘要报告在调度器训练负载下 MARA 平均完成 63.46% 的任务，比强基线 LARA 高 8.54 个百分点，且在更重的未见负载下仍保持领先。
Motivation: 现有方法通常把计算视为可连续分割的吞吐量，而实际场景中计算由离散节点提供、任务随时间到达，需求不确定且决策是受约束的序列决策。论文针对这一更贴近实际但未被充分研究的设置展开。
Method: 提出 MARA，包含两个核心组件：用条件流匹配预测未来损失轨迹，以及用协作式多智能体自回归策略协调计算节点。训练中使用基于势能的进度奖励 (potential-based progress reward) 提供中间反馈，同时保持无折扣的任务完成目标。
Result: 在分布内、强化学习和视觉工作负载上，流匹配相比加权最小二乘 (weighted least squares) 降低剩余资源预测误差。在调度器训练负载下，MARA 平均完成 63.46% 的任务，比强基线 LARA 高 8.54 个百分点，并在未见过更重工作负载下仍保持领先。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在离散节点和任务动态到达的设置下，MARA 相比现有方法能提升任务完成率，且流匹配带来的预测改进可转化为调度收益。摘要未提及具体局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Social Gym and SPaRTan: Benchmarking and Improving LLM Social Reasoning via Multi-Agent Game Tournaments
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in multi-agent social settings where they must cooperate, negotiate, and adapt to other agents. Measuring and improving these social skills is hard because, unlike math or logic, social interaction offers no objective ground truth: evaluations fall back on LLM judges, which are costly, subjective, and noisy, and models get no reliable signal to learn from. To address both, we first introduce Social Gym, an environment of 21 multi-agent social games (e.g., Werewolves, Resistance, Spyfall) whose rule-decided outcomes make agent performance verifiable and objective, with an Elo tournament that produces a cross-game leaderboard. Benchmarking experiments show that while GPT-5-mini tops the leaderboard, no model excels at all games uniformly or in all game roles, pointing to limitations of social reasoning. Motivated by this, we additionally propose SPaRTan (Self-Play and Reflect-Transfer), a training-free self-improvement loop: a model plays a game, reflects on its trajectories and their outcomes to produce a transferable playbook, and applies that playbook in subsequent games. Our results show that SPaRTan playbooks help GPT-5-mini agents level their performance on weaker roles, but largely do not improve Qwen3-32B's performance. Together, Social Gym and SPaRTan offer a reproducible, verifiable foundation for measuring and improving LLM social reasoning without weight updates.

papers.title: ChronoState: Hidden Elapsed-Time Conditioning for Temporal-State Action Selection in Frozen-Backbone Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Temporal decisions in language-model systems often depend on both symbolic task state and elapsed wall-clock time, such as cache expiration, job completion, quota resets, deadlines, or stale sessions. We study whether elapsed time can be supplied as a non-token, system-side scalar and composed with visible symbolic state by a frozen-backbone language model. We introduce ChronoState, a compositional temporal-state benchmark in which symbolic state appears in the prompt, elapsed seconds tau are supplied through a hidden chronometric-injection channel, and the model selects a forced-choice temporal action. Here, "hidden" means hidden from the user-visible token sequence, not from model computation. Using Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct as a frozen bf16 backbone with a 31-dimensional sinusoidal-plus-log time encoding, gated FiLM residual modulation, and a rank-8 LoRA action surface, hidden-time CI reaches 0.9305 +/- 0.0134 accuracy and 0.9410 +/- 0.0103 balanced accuracy. No-time and shuffled-time controls fall to 0.5511 +/- 0.0042 and 0.3323 +/- 0.0097, respectively, with high shuffled-time wrong-state consistency supporting causal dependence on the injected scalar within the trained distribution. Generalization remains strong for held-out templates, durations, and multi-constraint compositions, but held-out quota-family transfer is weak at 0.5065 +/- 0.0559, while a fair prompt+LoRA timestamp baseline reaches 0.9893 +/- 0.0052. Thus, ChronoState supports a narrow conclusion: hidden elapsed time can be composed with symbolic task state under direct supervision, but does not establish autonomous time tracking, broad unseen-family abstraction, or superiority over prompt-injected timestamps.
papers.comment: Submitted to SPIE Defense and Commercial Sensing 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ChronoState，一个组合式时间-状态决策基准：符号任务状态出现在 prompt 中，经过的真实时间秒数 tau 通过隐藏的 chronometric-injection 通道注入，冻结骨干语言模型需做强制二选一的时间动作。以 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 为冻结 bf16 骨干，配合 31 维正弦加对数时间编码、门控 FiLM 残差调制和 rank-8 LoRA 动作面，隐藏时间条件化在基准上达到约 0.93 的准确率；对照实验和泛化实验显示其对注入标量存在因果依赖，但跨配额族迁移较弱，且不如 prompt 注入时间戳的基线。
Motivation: 语言模型系统中的时间决策常同时依赖符号任务状态和真实流逝时间，例如缓存过期、任务完成、配额重置或会话过期；现有方法未系统研究能否将流逝时间作为非 token 的系统侧标量与可见符号状态组合到冻结骨干模型中。
Method: 构建 ChronoState 组合式时间-状态基准，时间标量 tau 通过隐藏的 chronometric-injection 通道（对用户 token 序列不可见，但参与模型计算）注入；使用 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 作为冻结 bf16 骨干，采用 31 维正弦加对数时间编码、门控 FiLM 残差调制和 rank-8 LoRA 动作面对动作进行预测。
Result: 隐藏时间条件化（hidden-time CI）达到 0.9305 ± 0.0134 准确率和 0.9410 ± 0.0103 平衡准确率；无时间对照为 0.5511 ± 0.0042，乱序时间对照为 0.3323 ± 0.0097 且表现出高乱序时间错误态一致性，支持对注入标量的因果依赖。模板、时长和多约束组合的留出泛化较强，但留出配额族迁移仅 0.5065 ± 0.0559；公平的 prompt+LoRA 时间戳基线达到 0.9893 ± 0.0052。
Conclusion: 作者强调结论是窄的：隐藏流逝时间可以在直接监督下与符号任务状态组合，但该工作并未建立自主时间追踪、广泛的未见族抽象能力，也未证明其优于 prompt 注入的时间戳。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: RISE-RL: Rubric-Informed Selective Exploration for Open-Ended Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) for open-ended tasks is challenging because responses must satisfy multidimensional criteria without following a single correct generation trajectory. Existing rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods compress fine-grained criterion-level feedback into scalar rewards, making persistent capability gaps difficult to target under limited on-policy exploration. We propose $\textbf{RISE-RL}$ (Rubric-Informed Selective Exploration), which uses repeatedly missed rubric criteria to elicit privileged trajectories that are difficult to discover through unguided exploration alone. RISE-RL retains only trajectories whose complete-rubric reward exceeds the mean reward of natural rollouts, and then re-evaluates them under the original prompt to emphasize behaviors that remain weakly supported by the natural policy. The resulting guidance signal is optimized through a separate auxiliary objective and removed once its additional benefit diminishes. Experiments with 4B and 14B models across writing, chat, health, and science show that RISE-RL achieves the highest mean score on every evaluated benchmark under guidance-free evaluation. Compared with standard Rubric-RL, it improves the average score by 1.3 points at the 4B scale and $\textbf{3.3 points at the 14B scale}$, including a $\textbf{6.0-point}$ gain on CreativeWriting-V3. It also improves creative-writing diversity and yields gains on objectively scored medical and scientific benchmarks. These results indicate that selective internalization through reward filtering and policy support shaping is effective for open-ended reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RISE-RL (Rubric-Informed Selective Exploration)，一种面向开放式任务的强化学习方法，通过反复错过的评分细则 (rubric criteria) 引导模型探索难以通过无引导探索发现的轨迹。方法仅保留完整评分奖励高于自然 rollout 平均值的轨迹，并在原提示下重新评估，以强化自然策略支持较弱的行文；该引导信号通过辅助目标优化，并在收益递减时移除。4B 和 14B 模型上的实验覆盖写作、对话、健康与科学任务，显示 RISE-RL 在无引导评估下于所有基准取得最高平均分。
Motivation: 现有基于评分细则的强化学习方法将细粒度标准级反馈压缩为标量奖励，在有限的在线探索下难以针对性弥合持续存在的能力差距；开放式任务要求满足多维度标准，而非遵循单一正确生成轨迹。
Method: 提出 RISE-RL，使用模型反复错过的细则标准来引出难以通过无引导探索发现的专家组轨迹；仅保留完整细则奖励高于自然 rollout 平均奖励的轨迹，并在原始提示下重新评估，以突出自然策略支撑不足的行为；该引导信号通过独立辅助目标优化，并在额外收益消失后移除。
Result: 在 4B 和 14B 规模的多个基准（写作、对话、健康、科学）上，RISE-RL 在无引导评估下均取得最高平均分；相比标准 Rubric-RL，4B 规模平均分提升 1.3 分，14B 规模提升 3.3 分，其中 CreativeWriting-V3 提升 6.0 分；同时改善创意写作多样性，并在客观评分的医学和科学基准上获得增益。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过奖励过滤和策略支持塑形实现的选择性内化 (selective internalization) 对开放式强化学习有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Visual Distortion Detection in UGC Images Using Large Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: The localized depiction of perceptual quality has long been a crucial, yet underexplored, challenge in image quality assessment (IQA). Existing approaches based on large multimodal models (LMMs) predominantly rely on text-driven supervised fine-tuning (SFT). However, this training paradigm exhibits notable limitations in detection accuracy. Moreover, synthetically distorted images, which are often used as the primary training data source, show a significant generalization gap when deployed in real-world scenarios; thus, the \textbf{synthetic-to-authentic (\textit{S2A})} problem represents a critical challenge. Motivated by these issues, we propose \textbf{\textit{VIGIL}}, which leverages the LMM architecture for precise visual distortion detection. From a candidate pool of over 1000K samples, we construct the \textbf{\textit{VIGIL-140K}} training set, which consists of over 140K distorted images. These images are obtained through rigorous quality filtering and carefully crafted distortion injection, covering 8 major synthetic distortion categories. Our model leverages different layers of the large language model (LLM) decoder, treating them as \textit{multiple detectors} that perform synchronous distortion detection using multi-level features. Additionally, we retain distortion cues from predictions assigned to the non-distortion class, which helps mitigate the ambiguous foreground-background (\textit{FG-BG}) separation commonly encountered in the \textit{S2A} problem. After post-processing, our model consistently outperforms strong baselines on both in-domain synthetic distortion detection and \textit{S2A} tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VIGIL，一种基于大多模态模型（LMM）的 UGC 图像视觉失真检测方法。作者从超过 1000K 候选样本中构建 VIGIL-140K 训练集，包含 140K 余张经质量过滤和失真注入的图像，覆盖 8 类合成失真。模型将 LLM 解码器的不同层视为多个检测器，利用多层特征进行同步失真检测，并保留非失真类预测中的失真线索以缓解 synthetic-to-authentic (S2A) 问题。摘要称后处理后模型在域内合成失真检测和 S2A 任务上均持续优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有基于 LMM 的图像质量评估（IQA）方法主要依赖文本驱动的有监督微调（SFT），在检测精度上存在明显局限；同时，常用合成失真训练数据在真实场景中存在显著泛化差距，即 S2A 问题成为关键挑战。
Method: 提出 VIGIL，利用 LMM 架构进行精确失真检测；从大规模候选池构建 VIGIL-140K 训练集，通过严格质量过滤和精心设计的失真注入覆盖 8 类主要合成失真。模型把 LLM 解码器不同层当作多个检测器，使用多层特征执行同步失真检测，并且保留被预测为非失真类样本中的失真线索，以缓解 S2A 中前景-背景（FG-BG）分离模糊的问题。
Result: 经过后处理后，VIGIL 在域内合成失真检测和 S2A 任务上均持续优于强基线；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结合多层特征和非失真类线索能有效改善失真检测在真实场景中的泛化能力，并验证了该方法在合成与 S2A 两类任务上的优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MELLON - Multimodal Enhanced LLM for Online Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Web navigation agents are capable of addressing various types of tasks on different websites. Current baselines on web navigation are either unimodal or lack strong reasoning abilities given multimodal inputs. Focusing on the WebShop benchmark, a real-world website simulation, we explore the alignment of text and images, as well as multimodal reasoning and planning abilities, to enhance the performance of web navigation agents. We propose three innovative multimodal enhancements: Multimodal Enhanced LLM for Online Navigation (MELLON), VQAgent, and Multimodal Ranker. MELLON demonstrates a significant improvement in task completion accuracy, with a 9.26% increase after just one epoch of training. Our findings suggest the necessity of further exploration into multimodal approaches, with a focus on more extensive training and alignment strategies to enhance the effectiveness of web navigation agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 WebShop 基准上的网页导航智能体，提出三种多模态增强方法：MELLON、VQAgent 和 Multimodal Ranker，用于对齐文本与图像并增强多模态推理与规划能力。摘要报告 MELLON 在仅一个训练 epoch 后任务完成准确率提升 9.26%，并认为多模态策略值得进一步探索。
Motivation: 现有网页导航基线要么是单模态的，要么在给定多模态输入时缺乏强推理能力，限制了在 WebShop 这类真实网站模拟环境中的任务完成效果。
Method: 提出三种多模态增强方案：MELLON（多模态增强的网页导航 LLM）、VQAgent 以及 Multimodal Ranker，并在 WebShop 基准上探索文本-图像对齐与多模态推理和规划能力。
Result: 摘要报告 MELLON 在仅一个训练 epoch 后，任务完成准确率提升 9.26%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调需要进一步探索多模态方法，尤其是更广泛的训练与对齐策略，以提升网页导航智能体的有效性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Motif 3: Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Motif 3, a decoder-only Mixture-of-Experts language model with 314 billion total parameters and 13.2 billion activated per token. Each sparse MoE layer contains 384 routed experts, with eight selected per token. This fine-grained sparsity provides substantial expert capacity while limiting computation. Motif 3 is built around Grouped Differential Latent Attention (GDLA), which integrates grouped differential attention with the compressed key-value representation of Multi-head Latent Attention. The architecture further incorporates modified manifold-constrained hyper-connections, Expert Specific PolyNorm activations, and multi-token prediction to improve optimization stability, expert specialization, and inference efficiency. We pretrain Motif 3 on approximately 12.5 trillion tokens spanning web documents, STEM, code, mathematics, multilingual content, and domain-specialized corpora. Expert-balancing and numerical-stabilization techniques support stable training at scale, while selective MXFP8 computation and communication, memory-efficient fused kernels, and window-aware context parallelism enable training with context lengths up to 256K tokens. Our post-training pipeline combines general supervised fine-tuning, six specialist teachers trained with reinforcement learning, a software-engineering teacher trained with supervised fine-tuning, and Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation. The resulting unified model consolidates complementary capabilities in reasoning, coding, tool use, professional work, long-context understanding, calibrated abstention, and instruction following. Across a broad evaluation suite, Motif 3 demonstrates competitive performance against leading open weight models, including strong results on long-horizon agentic tasks, mathematical reasoning, scientific knowledge, and hallucination-sensitive evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 Motif 3 的技术报告，介绍一个解码器 only 的 Mixture-of-Experts 语言模型：总参数 314B，每 token 激活 13.2B 参数，每个稀疏 MoE 层含 384 个路由专家并每次选取 8 个。模型采用 Grouped Differential Latent Attention (GDLA)、流形约束超连接、Expert Specific PolyNorm 激活和多 token 预测等设计，并在约 12.5T token 的多领域语料上预训练。后训练阶段结合通用 SFT、六个强化学习训练的专家教师和 Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation，最终统一模型在推理、编码、工具使用等多项能力上达到与领先开源权重模型竞争的水平。
Motivation: 该报告的目标是在大规模 MoE 架构下同时获得充足的专家容量与受限的计算开销，并通过细粒度稀疏性、压缩键值注意力及稳定化训练技术提升长上下文和多样化任务的综合能力。
Method: 架构以 GDLA 为核心，将分组差分注意力与 Multi-head Latent Attention 的压缩键值表示相结合；还引入流形约束超连接、Expert Specific PolyNorm 激活和多 token 预测。预训练采用约 12.5T token 的多领域语料，并配合专家平衡与数值稳定技术；训练系统使用选择性 MXFP8 计算/通信、内存高效融合内核和 window-aware context parallelism，支持最长 256K token 的上下文。后训练包括通用 SFT、六个 RL 训练的专家教师、一个 SFT 软件工程教师，以及 Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation。
Result: 在广泛评测套件上，Motif 3 与领先的开源权重模型表现相当，尤其在长时程智能体任务、数学推理、科学知识和幻觉敏感评测上取得强结果。
Conclusion: 报告将推理、编码、工具使用、专业工作、长上下文理解、校准的拒答 (calibrated abstention) 和指令跟随等互补能力整合进单一模型，强调其架构设计和训练策略在大规模下的稳定性与效率。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: 3D Modeling of a Tethered Autogyro with Articulated Rotors and Attitude Control using Differential Rotor Braking
papers.abstract_en: A tethered autogyro with articulated rotors can operate as an unmanned aerial vehicle capable of energy-efficient, long-duration deployment by utilizing ambient wind energy to sustain flight. This article presents a model-based attitude control technique for such a system using a full-fidelity dynamic model. Using Lagrangian approach combined with Blade Element Momentum Theory and catenary mechanics, a previously developed 2D hybrid model is extended to three dimensions. The new model describes the complete rigid-body motion of the frame, including roll and yaw dynamics, and is augmented with rotor speed and flapping degrees of freedom for each blade. Equilibrium characteristics are examined through steady-state responses and compared with the prior model. The resulting trends of equilibria are found to be consistent with those reported in the literature. A feedback control strategy based on regenerative differential rotor braking is developed to modulate all three attitude angles. Simulations demonstrate effective attitude regulation and stable flight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对带有铰接旋翼的系留自转旋翼机（tethered autogyro），在完整保真度动力学模型基础上提出基于模型的姿态控制方法。作者将先前开发的二维混合模型扩展到三维，使用拉格朗日方法结合叶素动量理论和悬链线力学，描述机架完整刚体运动（含滚转和偏航动力学），并为每片桨叶增加转速和挥舞自由度。基于再生差动转子制动（regenerative differential rotor braking）的反馈控制策略用于调节三个姿态角，仿真显示姿态调节有效且飞行稳定。
Motivation: 系留自转旋翼机可利用环境风能维持飞行，具有能效高、可长时间部署的潜力，但需要有效的三维姿态控制。已有模型多为二维，缺乏对滚转和偏航等完整刚体运动及铰接旋翼动力学细节的描述，本文旨在填补这一建模与控制缺口。
Method: 采用拉格朗日方法结合叶素动量理论（Blade Element Momentum Theory）和悬链线力学（catenary mechanics），将先前开发的二维混合模型扩展为三维。新模型包含机架六自由度运动及每个叶片的转速与挥舞自由度；控制上开发基于再生差动转子制动的反馈策略，用于调制所有三个姿态角。
Result: 通过稳态响应检验平衡特性并与先前模型对比，所得平衡趋势与文献报道一致；仿真表明所提控制策略能实现有效的姿态调节和稳定飞行。
Conclusion: 摘要指出三维模型可用于系留自转旋翼机的姿态控制研究，并验证了基于差动制动策略的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Probabilistic Circuit-Induced Pseudo-Metric for Out-of-Distribution Detection
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic Circuits (PCs) are tractable generative models whose internal nodes encode a hierarchy of probabilistic sum- maries over different variable scopes. Existing PC-based out- of-distribution (OOD) detection methods ignore this hierar- chy, reducing the entire circuit to the scalar likelihood (or its uncertainty) computed at the root. We introduce Hierar- chical Likelihood Vector (HLV), a representation whose en- tries are the likelihoods associated with selected PC nodes and define the Hierarchical Likelihood Distance (HLD), a PC-induced pseudo-metric that compares the probability dis- tributions through the expectations of their HLVs. We show that HLD is an integral probability metric over a function class naturally induced by the PC and develop a principled goodness-of-fit hypothesis test for unsupervised OOD detec- tion. Unlike existing approaches, the trained PC alone serves as the representation of the in-distribution: no held-out in- distribution data are required at deployment. We further show that the quantities required by the hypothesis test can be com- puted exactly, directly from the trained circuit, yielding an ap- proximate analytic decision threshold. Experiments on tabular and MNIST datasets demonstrate that exploiting the hierarchi- cal probabilistic summaries encoded through the PC improve OOD detection over root-likelihood, uncertainty-, typicality- and kernel-based baselines, while naturally localizing distri- bution shifts to the PC nodes responsible for the shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于概率电路 (Probabilistic Circuits, PC) 的分层似然向量 (Hierarchical Likelihood Vector, HLV) 与相应的分层似然距离 (Hierarchical Likelihood Distance, HLD)，用于无监督分布外 (OOD) 检测。作者证明 HLD 是 PC 自然诱导函数类上的积分概率度量 (integral probability metric)，并据此构造 goodness-of-fit 假设检验。在表格数据与 MNIST 上，该方法优于基于根似然、不确定性、典型性和核方法的基线，并能将分布偏移定位到负责任的具体 PC 节点。
Motivation: 现有基于 PC 的 OOD 检测只利用根节点的标量似然（或其不确定性），忽略了 PC 内部节点编码的层级概率摘要，限制了表征分布偏移的能力，而且部署时通常需要额外的留出分布内数据。
Method: 引入 HLV 作为选定 PC 节点似然的表示，并定义 PC 诱导的伪度量 HLD，通过 HLV 的期望比较概率分布。作者开发了基于 goodness-of-fit 的假设检验用于无监督 OOD 检测，并证明检验所需量可精确地从训练好的电路直接计算，从而得到近似解析决策阈值；部署时仅需训练好的 PC，无需保留的分布内数据。
Result: 在表格数据集和 MNIST 上的实验表明，利用 PC 编码的层级概率摘要相比根似然、不确定性、典型性和基于核的基线提升了 OOD 检测性能，并能自然定位到负责分布偏移的 PC 节点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调训练好的 PC 本身即可作为分布内表示，HLD 及相应假设检验所需的量均可从电路中精确计算。方法在表格与 MNIST 数据上验证有效，但摘要未提供具体量化数值。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RAVEN-Eval: Rubric-Guided Automatic Evaluation for AI Video Generation Models Based on LMM Preference Judgement
papers.abstract_en: AI video generation has advanced rapidly and entered widespread commercial use. As a result, quality differences among videos produced by state-of-the-art AI video generation models~(AIVGMs) have become increasingly difficult to discern using conventional evaluation criteria, such as visual fidelity and semantic instruction following. Meanwhile, human evaluation now requires more expertise and sustained attention, substantially increasing annotation costs. This calls for automated evaluation that can reliably distinguish fine-grained differences among advanced AIVGMs with minimal human intervention. To address this challenge, we present RAVEN-Eval, a rubric-guided automated evaluation framework for AIVGMs, built primarily on the LMM-as-a-judge paradigm. Through an automatic task curation and quality-filtering pipeline, RAVEN-Eval curates 150 text-to-video~(T2V) tasks and 100 image-to-video~(I2V) tasks, and systematically collects more than 4,500 AIGVs. At its core, RAVEN-Eval adopts rubric-guided automated LMM preference judgement, in which LMM judges conduct pairwise comparisons according to task-specific rubrics. It further introduces an anchor-based model insertion approach to reduce the evaluation cost of incorporating new models. Finally, we evaluate 20 high-performance AIVGMs, as well as the judging capabilities of 13 LMM judges, and establish the RAVEN-Eval Leaderboards. Overall, RAVEN-Eval paves a scalable path for automatic and trustworthy evaluation of rapidly evolving AIVGMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RAVEN-Eval，一个基于 rubric 引导的 AI 视频生成模型 (AIVGM) 自动评估框架，构建在 LMM-as-a-judge 范式之上。作者通过自动任务整理与质量过滤流程，整理出 150 个文生视频 (T2V) 任务和 100 个图生视频 (I2V) 任务，并系统收集超过 4,500 个 AI 生成视频 (AIGVs)。框架核心是 rubric 引导的 LMM 偏好判断，让 LMM 评判器按任务特定评分细则进行成对比较，并引入基于锚点的模型插入方法以降低纳入新模型的评估成本；最终评估了 20 个高性能 AIVGM 和 13 个 LMM 评判器，建立 RAVEN-Eval 排行榜。
Motivation: AI 视频生成已进入广泛商用，新一代模型产出的视频在传统指标（如视觉保真度、语义指令跟随）上差异越来越难分辨；同时人工评估需要更高的专业度与持续注意力，标注成本显著上升，亟需低人工干预、能可靠区分先进模型间细粒度差异的自动评估方法。
Method: RAVEN-Eval 以 LMM-as-a-judge 为核心，设计了自动任务整理与质量过滤流水线，构建 150 个 T2V 和 100 个 I2V 任务并收集 4,500 多个 AIGVs；其核心机制是 rubric 引导的自动 LMM 偏好判断，由 LMM 评判器依据任务特定 rubric 进行成对比较，并采用 anchor-based 模型插入方式来降低评估新模型的额外成本。
Result: 摘要报告该框架用于评估 20 个高性能 AIVGM 以及 13 个 LMM 评判器的判断能力，并据此建立 RAVEN-Eval Leaderboards；摘要未提供具体量化性能数字。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RAVEN-Eval 为快速演进的 AIVGM 提供了一条可扩展的自动、可信评估路径。

summary_sections.method: RAVEN-Eval 以 LMM-as-a-judge 为核心，设计了自动任务整理与质量过滤流水线，构建 150 个 T2V 和 100 个 I2V 任务并收集 4,500 多个 AIGVs；其核心机制是 rubric 引导的自动 LMM 偏好判断，由 LMM 评判器依据任务特定 rubric 进行成对比较，并采用 anchor-based 模型插入方式来降低评估新模型的额外成本。

papers.title: View-Adaptive Renderer for View-Consistent 2D-to-3D Generation
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing 3D shapes from a single image remains a fundamental yet challenging problem in computer vision. Traditional monocular 3D generation pipelines typically synthesize multiple views from a single input image before applying Neural Radiance Field (NeRF)-based reconstruction. However, inherent projective ambiguities often produce visual discontinuities across generated viewpoints, leading to inaccuracies in reconstructed 3D models. Current solutions either incur significant additional computational burdens or fail to adequately resolve practical inconsistencies between synthesized views. To address these limitations, we propose a novel viewpoint-adaptive neural rendering framework that enables robust 3D reconstruction even when given partially inconsistent multi-view inputs. Our approach introduces view-adaptive neural renderers that independently correct viewpoint-dependent errors while simultaneously sharing a global feature backbone to preserve structural coherence. Furthermore, we propose a self-attention fusion module that adaptively integrates multi-view information, ensuring geometric consistency without relying heavily on indirect regularizations or computationally intensive methods. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our method consistently improves 3D reconstruction fidelity. Importantly, our approach achieves near state-of-the-art performance without diffusion-based SDS supervision, relying primarily on photometric rendering loss with lightweight attention regularizers. This balance between accuracy and efficiency makes the proposed framework highly practical for real-world applications.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种视角自适应渲染框架，用于从单张图像进行视图一致的2D到3D重建。方法通过独立的视角自适应神经渲染器修正视角相关误差，并共享全局特征骨干保持结构一致性，同时引入自注意力融合模块整合多视角信息。实验表明在不依赖扩散模型SDS监督的情况下，仅用光度渲染损失和轻量注意力正则即可接近最优重建保真度。
Motivation: 传统单目3D生成管线先从单图合成多视角，再用NeRF重建，但投影歧义会造成视角间视觉不连续，导致重建不准确。现有方案要么计算开销大，要么不能解决合成视图间实际不一致的问题。
Method: 提出view-adaptive neural rendering框架，包含独立的视角自适应神经渲染器来纠正视角相关误差，并在其中共享全局特征骨干以保持结构一致性；另外设计自注意力融合模块自适应整合多视角信息，避免重度间接正则或计算密集方法。
Result: 大量实验表明该方法持续提升3D重建保真度，且在不使用扩散模型SDS监督、仅依赖光度渲染损失和轻量注意力正则的情况下达到接近state-of-the-art的性能。
Conclusion: 该框架在准确性和效率之间取得平衡，适合实际应用；摘要未提及具体数据集、数值和局限性。

papers.title: Different Feedback, Different Updates: Selective Self-Learning from User Interactions for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: User feedback offers natural supervision for persistent LLM improvement, but a single message may support multiple behavioral changes with different scopes of generalization. We introduce SLIFT, a selective self-learning framework built on a task-relative view of user feedback. SLIFT decomposes each feedback message into atomic components and interprets each component relative to the original task as Fix, Spec, or Null: requirements for task validity, compatible condition-specific refinements, or content with no reliable positive update direction. To incorporate each change at the appropriate scope, SLIFT trains two complementary LoRA adapters on a shared frozen backbone: a Generalist that consolidates Fix requirements into default behavior through feedback-conditioned self-distillation, and a Specialist that observes only the task and Generalist response to supply residual guidance for applicable, unmet Spec refinements. Null components induce no positive update. Across backbones, SLIFT achieves strong performance on both MemoryBench and WildFB, with targeted analyses further examining its underlying mechanisms. We release our code at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SLIFT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SLIFT，一个基于用户反馈的选择性自学习框架，用于持续改进大语言模型。SLIFT 将每条反馈消息分解为原子组件，并相对原任务解释为 Fix、Spec 或 Null：分别对应任务有效性要求、兼容的条件特定细化、以及没有可靠正向更新方向的内容。作者训练两个共享冻结 backbone 的互补 LoRA 适配器（Generalist 与 Specialist）来按合适范围整合变更，并在 MemoryBench 与 WildFB 上取得强性能。
Motivation: 单条用户反馈消息可能支持多种泛化范围不同的行为变更，而现有方法难以确定每种变更该以何种范围被整合进模型。
Method: 将反馈分解为原子组件并按 Fix、Spec、Null 分类；Fix 需求通过反馈条件自蒸馏 (feedback-conditioned self-distillation) 整合进 Generalist 的默认行为，Specialist 只观察任务和 Generalist 响应来为适用的未满足 Spec 细化提供残差指导，Null 组件不产生正向更新；两个 LoRA 适配器共享冻结的 backbone。
Result: 摘要报告 SLIFT 在多个 backbone 上于 MemoryBench 和 WildFB 两个基准取得强性能，并通过针对性分析进一步检验其底层机制。
Conclusion: 摘要强调任务相对视角的反馈分解配合双 LoRA 适配器可以选择性地在合适范围整合用户反馈，实现持续自学习。

papers.title: Multitask Scanning Probe Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: Scanning probe microscopy provides nanoscale access to structural, electrical, electromechanical, magnetic, and mechanical properties of materials. Its increasing use for wafer-scale characterization and combinatorial materials exploration creates a need to distribute measurements efficiently across large spatial domains. This is particularly important when available modalities differ in acquisition time and potential for tip and sample damage, making exhaustive multimodal mapping over spatial grids impractical. Here, we demonstrate multitask scanning probe microscopy, a live, closed-loop workflow in which a multitask Gaussian process learns spatial and cross-modal relationships and autonomously selects both the next measurement location and the next experimental protocol. The approach is implemented on an automated large-sample atomic force microscope and demonstrated on a composition-spread AlScN wafer using tapping-mode and Dual AC Resonance Tracking (DART) measurements. Paired initial measurements establish the relation between the tasks, after which noncoincident measurements are used to update both response landscapes. The resulting workflow extends active learning in scanning probe microscopy from spatial sampling to autonomous allocation of measurement modalities and provides a basis for combining rapid, weakly perturbative imaging with slower contact, electrical, electromechanical, magnetic, or spectroscopic measurements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多任务扫描探针显微镜 (multitask scanning probe microscopy)，一种实时闭环工作流：多任务高斯过程同时学习空间与跨模态关系，并自主选择下一个测量位置和实验协议。该方法在自动化大样品原子力显微镜上实现，并在 AlScN 成分梯度晶圆上结合 tapping-mode 与 Dual AC Resonance Tracking (DART) 测量进行演示。配对初始测量先建立任务间关系，之后非重合测量用于同时更新两个响应图。
Motivation: 晶圆级表征与组合材料探索需要在大的空间范围上高效分配测量；由于不同模态的采集时间和探针/样品损伤风险不同，对空间网格做穷举式多模态映射不切实际。
Method: 提出以多任务高斯过程为核心的主动学习框架，实时选择下一个测量位置与实验协议；先用配对初始测量学习任务间关系，再用非重合测量更新各响应图。系统部署在自动化大样品 AFM 上，支持 tapping-mode 与 DART 等模态。
Result: 摘要未给出定量结果。实验在 AlScN 成分梯度晶圆上演示了 tapping-mode 与 DART 两种模态的闭环多任务测量流程。
Conclusion: 该方法把扫描探针显微术中的主动学习从空间采样扩展到测量模态的自主分配，为快速弱扰动成像与较慢的接触、电、机电、磁或光谱测量的结合提供基础。

papers.title: Contrastive Mask Fidelity: Reference-Free Auditing of Ground-Truth Masks in Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation models are trained and evaluated against human-drawn masks, yet remote-sensing annotations are often coarse, incomplete, or misaligned; high overlap scores may then reflect agreement with imperfect labels rather than faithfulness to the image, creating an evaluation paradox. We introduce Contrastive Mask Fidelity (CMF), a training-free, reference-free metric that scores competing class masks directly against image evidence. CMF composites keep and erase counterfactual views of each mask and asks a frozen vision-language judge whether class evidence is concentrated inside the mask and absent outside. We validate CMF on controlled mask corruptions, then audit 10,731 image-class pairs across ten remote-sensing benchmarks using candidate masks from Seg-Probe, a training-free open-vocabulary probe built on SegEarth-OV3 that outperforms prior baselines on nine of ten datasets. The audit reveals systematic, class-dependent annotation distortion: man-made classes such as buildings, roads, and cars favor the candidate mask on 62-85% of pairs, whereas ambiguous land cover more often favors human annotations. On a blinded three-annotator consensus, CMF matches expert judgment on 81% of pairs, exceeding keep-only scoring, model confidence, and a trained label-quality baseline. Finally, conservative class-wise arbitration yields supervision that improves cross-domain transfer over raw annotations and matched replacement controls, positioning CMF as a scalable tool for auditing ground truth rather than presuming it infallible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对比掩码保真度（CMF），一种用于遥感语义分割中直接对候选类别掩码与图像证据打分的无训练、免参考度量。作者在受控掩码破坏上验证该方法，然后使用来自Seg-Probe的候选掩码审计10,731个图像-类别对；审计发现人为类别（如建筑物、道路、车辆）和模糊土地覆盖之间的标注失真存在系统性差异。在盲化的三位标注者一致性测试中，CMF在81%的配对上与专家判断一致，表现优于现有基线。
Motivation: 遥感分割的标注常粗糙、不完整或未对齐，导致高重叠分数可能反映与不完美标签的一致性而非与图像的保真度，形成评估悖论。
Method: CMF为每个掩码构造保留与擦除的反事实视图，并让冻结的视觉语言评判器判断类别证据是否集中在掩码内部且外部不存在。利用基于SegEarth-OV3构建的无训练开放词汇探针Seg-Probe生成候选掩码，用于审计多个基准中的图像-类别对。
Result: 审计显示人为类别如建筑物、道路和汽车在62-85%的配对中偏向候选掩码，而模糊土地覆盖更常偏向人类注释。在盲化的三位标注者一致性测试中，CMF在81%的配对上匹配专家判断，超过仅保留评分、模型置信度和训练过的标签质量基线。
Conclusion: 保守的类别级仲裁产生的监督可改善跨域迁移，优于原始注释和匹配的替换对照。作者将CMF定位为可扩展的用于审计地面真值而非假设其无误的工具。

papers.title: Real Data Closes Synthetic-to-Real Gap in Optical Chemical Structure Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Millions of chemical structures appear in patents and papers only as drawings, and using that information at scale requires reading the drawings. OCSR appears nearly solved on synthetic images yet remains difficult on real documents: the starting recognizer, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, exceeds 91% accuracy on synthetic renders but falls below 16% on three real-world benchmarks (ACS, CLEF-IP, USPTO). To identify the main source of improvement, 21 recognizers were fine-tuned on mixtures of synthetically rendered structures and labeled real depictions from patents, journal figures, and hand-drawn collections, varying the vision language model (VLM) base, the fraction of real training data, and the vision-tower adaptation strategy. Labeled real training images make the largest difference. For Qwen2.5-VL, ACS exact match rises from 0.15 with no real data to 0.37 at 9.5% and 0.46 at 50.2%; a controlled experiment across three base models reproduces the trend. A vision-tower LoRA, in contrast, does nothing for Qwen (+0.00, paired p=1.00), substantially helps InternVL3-8B (+22.8 to +34.6 pt), and modestly helps GLM-4.1V-9B (+1.0 to +9.6 pt), so its value depends on the base model. The best configuration reaches 0.96 exact match on clean renders and 0.49, 0.65, 0.84, and 0.76 on ACS, CLEF-IP, UOB, and USPTO, respectively. Gaps between base models are largest without real data (0.21), shrink to 0.06 at 70% real data, and reorder the ranking; base model and real-data mixture must therefore be selected together. Small-scale experiments on handwritten image-to-LaTeX recognition and chart-to-table conversion show that base-model rankings also vary beyond chemistry. More generally, model and adaptation choices for visual structure recognition should be evaluated on the target task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究光学化学结构识别（OCSR）中合成图像到真实文档的泛化差距：起点模型 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 在合成渲染图上超过 91% 准确率，但在 ACS、CLEF-IP、USPTO 三个真实基准上低于 16%。作者微调了 21 个识别器，系统变化 VLM 基座、真实训练数据比例和视觉塔适配策略，发现带标注的真实训练图像是最大的改善来源；对 Qwen2.5-VL，ACS 精确匹配从无真实数据时的 0.15 提升到 9.5% 真实数据时的 0.37 和 50.2% 时的 0.46。最佳配置在干净渲染上达到 0.96，在 ACS、CLEF-IP、UOB、USPTO 上分别达到 0.49、0.65、0.84、0.76。
Motivation: OCSR 在合成图像上看似接近解决，但在专利、论文等真实文档上仍然困难，需要找出最主要的性能改善来源。
Method: 在合成渲染结构和来自专利、期刊图形及手绘集合的带标注真实图像混合数据上微调 21 个识别器，同时变化视觉语言模型（VLM）基座、真实数据比例和视觉塔（vision-tower）适配策略，并围绕三种基座模型做受控实验，另辅以手写图像到 LaTeX 识别和图表到表格转换的小规模实验。
Result: 带标注的真实训练图像带来最大提升；Qwen 的 ACS 精确匹配从 0.15（无真实数据）升至 0.37（9.5%）和 0.46（50.2%）。视觉塔 LoRA 对 Qwen 无效果（+0.00，配对 p=1.00），对 InternVL3-8B 显著提升（+22.8 至 +34.6 个百分点），对 GLM-4.1V-9B 中等提升（+1.0 至 +9.6 个百分点）。基座模型间差距在无真实数据时最大（0.21），在 70% 真实数据时缩小到 0.06，并发生排序重排。
Conclusion: 基座模型与真实数据混合比例必须联合选择；视觉结构识别的模型与适配选择应在目标任务上进行评估，且基座模型排序的差异并不限于化学领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RAVEN: Frozen Random Graph Reservoirs with Physics-Informed Interaction Fingerprints for Protein-Ligand Binding Affinity Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Quantitative estimation of protein-ligand binding affinity from three-dimensional complex structures is a fundamental task in structure-based computational chemistry and molecular modeling. Reliable prediction remains challenging because available structure-affinity data are limited, experimentally heterogeneous, conformation-dependent, and sensitive to dataset partitioning. RAVEN (Randomized Atomistic Views with Ensemble Neural Reservoirs) utilizes a multihead reservoir of independently initialized and fully frozen atomistic graph encoders to generate diverse structural projections without end-to-end optimization of the graph representation. These projections are integrated with a deterministic physicochemical interaction fingerprint and processed by heterogeneous supervised readers, including neural and tree-based regressors, whose outputs are combined through validation-based nonnegative fusion. The random reservoir expands structural feature coverage across independent encoder realizations, whereas the explicit physicochemical descriptors and heterogeneous readers contribute complementary information and distinct inductive biases. Evaluation on a similarity-isolated PDBbind 2020R1 split reconstructed using GEMS similarity resources, together with the protected CASF-2016 subset, demonstrated strong predictive performance. The results indicate that frozen multi-view graph representations, explicit physicochemical statistics, and heterogeneous model fusion provide a robust and flexible framework for protein-ligand binding-affinity prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RAVEN (Randomized Atomistic Views with Ensemble Neural Reservoirs)，用多个独立初始化且完全冻结的原子级图编码器作为随机水库 (reservoir)，在不端到端优化图表示的前提下生成多样结构投影；再结合确定性物理化学相互作用指纹，交给包括神经网络和树回归器在内的异构监督读取器，并通过基于验证集的非负融合整合输出。在基于 GEMS 相似性资源重构的相似性隔离 PDBbind 2020R1 划分以及受保护的 CASF-2016 子集上，摘要称该方法表现出强预测性能。
Motivation: 从三维复合物结构定量估计蛋白质-配体结合亲和力是结构计算化学的基础任务，但可用的结构-亲和力数据有限、实验异质、依赖构象且对数据集划分敏感，可靠预测仍具挑战。
Method: RAVEN 利用多头的、独立初始化且完全冻结的原子级图编码器生成多样结构投影，避免对图表示的端到端优化；将这些投影与确定性物理化学相互作用指纹集成，并由神经网络和树回归器等异构监督读取器处理，最后通过基于验证集的非负融合 (nonnegative fusion) 组合各读取器的输出。随机水库扩展了跨独立编码器实例的结构特征覆盖，而显式物理化学描述符与异构读取器提供互补信息和不同归纳偏置。
Result: 在相似性隔离的 PDBbind 2020R1 划分（用 GEMS 相似性资源重建）和受保护的 CASF-2016 子集上评估，摘要报告该方法取得强预测性能，但未给出具体数字。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，冻结的多视图图表示、显式物理化学统计和异构模型融合为蛋白质-配体结合亲和力预测提供了稳健且灵活的框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SI-Edit: Toward Sketch-Instruction Guided Local Image Editing with Pixel-Level Precision
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid advances in generative models, achieving pixel-level precision in sketch-based image editing remains a persistent challenge, particularly for fine-grained local deformations. This gap stems primarily from the critical shortage of high-quality, publicly available benchmark datasets that jointly provide geometric constraints and semantic instructions. To address this issue, we first introduce **SI-Data**, a high-quality dataset specifically designed for instruction-guided local sketch editing. We develop an automated pipeline leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to synthesize comprehensive quadruplets comprising original images, local geometric sketches, semantic instructions, and corresponding edited images. By providing both reliable spatial anchors and explicit semantic intent, SI-Data uniquely enables collaborative spatial-semantic learning. Building upon this, we propose a collaborative framework called **SI-Edit** that integrates semantic instructions with precise geometric constraints. Furthermore, to address the lack of standardized evaluation, we establish a comprehensive set of metrics designed to measure both structural fidelity (e.g., sketch-to-edge alignment) and semantic adherence. Experimental results demonstrate that SI-Edit provides more reliable structural control than baselines for sketch-based image editing, and achieves precise, pixel-level local refinements aligned with user intent. The data and code are released on the [project page](https://github.com/ywxsuperstar/SIEdit).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于草图（sketch）的局部图像编辑中像素级精度不足的问题，提出数据集 SI-Data 与协同编辑框架 SI-Edit。作者用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）自动合成“原图-局部几何草图-语义指令-编辑后图像”四元组，并设计同时衡量结构保真度（如 sketch-to-edge alignment）与语义一致性的评估指标。实验表明 SI-Edit 相比基线提供更可靠的结构控制，并能实现符合用户意图的像素级局部精修。
Motivation: 现有生成模型在基于草图的图像编辑中难以实现像素级精度，尤其是细粒度局部形变；主要瓶颈是缺少同时提供几何约束与语义指令的高质量公开基准数据集。
Method: 提出自动数据构建流程，利用多模态大语言模型合成 SI-Data 四元组数据；在此基础上提出 SI-Edit 协同框架，将语义指令与精确几何约束整合，并建立包含结构保真度和语义遵循度的标准化评估指标。
Result: 实验结果显示，SI-Edit 在基于草图的图像编辑中比基线提供更可靠的结构控制，并实现与用户意图一致的像素级局部精修。
Conclusion: 作者强调高质量空间-语义配对数据与协同框架能弥补草图编辑中像素级局部变形的不足，并已公开数据和代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Who Bridges Safety? Identifying and Targeting Cross-Lingual Shared Safety Pathways
papers.abstract_en: Uncovering the internal mechanisms underlying the safety capabilities of large language models (LLMs) is crucial for developing trustworthy artificial intelligence. Currently, mechanistic interpretability studies on multilingual safety are largely confined to local components, such as isolated neurons. However, this static and fragmented perspective overlooks the synergy among components and fails to elucidate how safety signals dynamically propagate within the model to drive safety decisions ultimately. In this work, we move beyond isolated neurons to identify and target the cross-layer functional pathways formed during safety signal propagation, thereby uncovering the mechanisms driving the cross-lingual safety gap. Specifically, we first identify monolingual safety pathways and validate their impact on refusing harmful requests. Subsequent cross-lingual analyses reveal a sparse subset of cross-lingual shared safety pathways, confirming that this intersection acts as the internal bridge transferring safety capabilities from high-resource (HR) languages to non-high-resource (NHR) languages. Building on these mechanistic findings, we propose a pathways-targeted alignment method based on the cross-lingual shared safety pathways. Experimental results show that updating only a small fraction of pathway parameters significantly improves safety in NHR languages while largely preserving the model's general capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型(LLM)多语言安全能力的内部机制，将视角从孤立神经元扩展到安全信号传播过程中形成的跨层功能通路。作者先识别单语安全通路并验证其对拒绝有害请求的作用，跨语言分析发现一个稀疏的跨语言共享安全通路子集，并将其确认为把安全能力从高资源语言(HR)迁移到非高资源语言(NHR)的内部桥梁。基于此提出面向通路的对齐方法，仅更新少量通路参数即可显著提升NHR语言安全性，同时基本保持通用能力。
Motivation: 现有关于多语言安全的机制可解释性研究大多局限于局部组件（如孤立神经元），这种静态且碎片化的视角忽视了组件间的协同作用，也无法阐明安全信号如何在模型内部动态传播并最终驱动安全决策。
Method: 作者将分析对象从孤立神经元扩展到安全信号传播中形成的跨层功能通路；首先识别单语安全通路并验证其对拒绝有害请求的因果影响，随后通过跨语言分析找出跨语言共享安全通路的稀疏子集，并基于这些机制发现提出通路定向对齐方法(pathways-targeted alignment)。
Result: 实验结果表明，仅更新一小部分通路参数即可显著改善NHR语言的安全性，同时大体上保持模型的通用能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调跨语言共享安全通路是安全能力从高资源语言迁移到非高资源语言的内部桥梁，为面向多语言安全对齐提供了可干预的机制性靶点。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Announcement Carries the Cue: Markup, Boundaries, and the Notation of Pre-Training Corpora
papers.abstract_en: How a document's arrangement is written down, its notation, is a training variable that no dataset card records. The field has established that text-extraction choices change model behaviour, and has never once measured the notation of what those choices put into the corpus. We define clean-window survival, a deterministic count of how much of a stream still demands the boundary inference, and measure notation on three fronts. What corpora carry: a census of thirteen public corpora, where survival falls to 0.153 in a vision-converted PDF slice against 0.889 in C4; the scarce resource is not unmarked text but long unmarked text; a pre-registered supply test finds what remains institutional, not consumer. Our own pre-registered prediction failed: converters do not fabricate structure on prose, and that null forced the reliability mechanism that survives it. What readers use: across five base models spanning 0.6B to 8.2B and two pipelines, deleting a structural announcement makes the following prose measurably harder to predict, while swapping its notation moves nothing. That zero does not make notation unimportant; it relocates the variable: the operative cue is the announcement, not the sigil. What writers impose: a bounded null. Base models do not impose the marked register above the authored baseline, and handed prose with every announcement deleted they do not put one back, at a rate indistinguishable from zero against an authored reference of zero. We ship the format those measurements imply: the pure frame, paragraphs in authored order, every announcement deleted into a reversible sidecar, mixed against the marked copy over announcement presence rather than notation. Choose format operators by the capability they train, not by the fidelity they preserve, and record extractor identity and survival on data cards.
papers.comment: 44 pages, 10 tables, 7 figures. Pre-registered protocols and their amendment history ship with the repository. Code, data, and instruments: https://github.com/emfreeburg/announcement-carries-cue
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次把语料的“记法”（notation，即文档结构如何被写入文本）当作预训练语料中一个未被任何数据集卡记录的训练变量来测量。作者定义 clean-window survival，统计一段文本流中仍需要边界推断的比例，并从三个层面测量：语料携带了什么（13 个公开语料普查，C4 为 0.889，vision-converted PDF 切片低至 0.153）、读者使用什么（5 个基础模型、两条管线，删除结构 announcement 使后续散文更难预测，但替换其符号无影响）、作者强加什么（一个有界零结果，基础模型不会在作者基准之上强加标记 register，也不会补回被删的 announcement）。摘要还提出了这些测量所指向的数据格式 "pure frame"。
Motivation: 领域已确立文本抽取选择会改变模型行为，但从未测量抽取所放入语料的内容的记法；数据集卡不记录这一训练变量，而记法可能是影响预训练效果的重要因素。
Method: 定义 clean-window survival 作为确定性的计数指标，对 13 个公开语料做普查，执行预注册的供给测试与预测实验，并跨 5 个基础模型（0.6B 到 8.2B）和两条管线检验结构 announcement 删除与符号替换的效果；最后提出 pure frame 格式：段落保持作者顺序，所有 announcement 被删除进可逆 sidecar，并与标记副本按 announcement 存在性而非记法混合。

Conclusion: 作者认为起作用的线索是 announcement 本身而非符号（sigil），格式运算符应依据其训练出的能力而非保真度来选择，并应在数据卡上记录抽取器身份与 survival 值。

papers.title: TLDChoiceNet: Quantitatively Choosing a Transfer Learning Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Transfer learning is particularly useful in settings with limited training data, and within image classification it is common to transfer learn upon massive datasets like ImageNet , CIFAR-100, or COCO . Qualitatively, it seems a transfer learning dataset should have both more classes and more examples per class than the fine tuning dataset; however, a quantitative method to choose the best transfer learning dataset does not currently exist. In this paper, we design TLDChoiceNet, a model to choose the best transfer learning dataset given a fine tuning dataset by predicting the test-set accuracy after fine-tuning. A simple version 1 achieves 0.154 MSE on the test dataset, while a version 2 leveraging an ImageNet pre-trained ResNet50 v2 embedding with per-class information attains a 5X lower MSE of 0.031. We further design two metrics that enable an unsupervised method of choosing an optimal transfer learning dataset: distribution distance (DD), which linearly regresses against fine-tune accuracy with an R2 of 0.89, and average class correlation (ACC), which improves the R2 to 0.97. Our results underscore that a dataset's low-level statistics can explain the transfer learning effect, and that using a pre-trained ImageNet can embed different classes further apart in latent feature space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TLDChoiceNet，一个用于在给定微调数据集时定量选择最佳迁移学习数据集的模型，通过预测微调后的测试准确率来实现。简单版本在测试集上 MSE 为 0.154，利用 ImageNet 预训练 ResNet50 v2 嵌入并加入每类信息的版本 2 将 MSE 降低约 5 倍至 0.031。作者还设计了两个无监督指标：分布距离 (DD) 和平均类相关性 (ACC)，分别与微调准确率的线性回归 R² 达到 0.89 和 0.97。
Motivation: 目前缺乏一种定量方法从候选数据集中选择最优迁移学习数据集，通常仅凭直觉认为迁移数据集应比微调数据集拥有更多类别和每类更多样本。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 设计 TLDChoiceNet 模型，以微调数据集为输入，预测微调后的测试集准确率；版本 1 为简单模型，版本 2 使用 ImageNet 预训练 ResNet50 v2 嵌入并结合每类信息。此外设计两个无监督指标：分布距离 (DD) 和平均类相关性 (ACC)，用于在无监督条件下选择最优迁移学习数据集。
Result: 版本 1 在测试集上 MSE 为 0.154，版本 2 达到 0.031（约为前者的 1/5）。DD 对微调准确率做线性回归的 R² 为 0.89，ACC 可将 R² 提升至 0.97。
Conclusion: 结果表明数据集的低层统计特征可以解释迁移学习效果，并且使用预训练 ImageNet 可以将不同类别在潜在特征空间中嵌入得更远。

papers.title: A Multi-Scale Temporal Framework with Dynamic Fusion for EEG-Based Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Mixed emotions represent a clinically relevant but still underexplored target for automatic emotion recognition. EEG provides millisecond-level access to neural activity, yet most EEG pipelines analyze the signal through a single temporal window, thereby fixing the temporal structure available to the model. This study introduces a multi-scale temporal framework for EEG-based emotion recognition. The EEG waveform is decomposed into windows of one or several durations, processed by a shared attention-based encoder, and integrated through a dynamic fusion module that assigns sample-specific weights across temporal scales. The framework is evaluated under a subject-independent protocol in binary and three-class settings, with the three-class task including the mixed affective category. The best results are 65.22% for the two-class task and 45.43% for the three-class task. Both are obtained with three-scale dynamic-fusion configurations and remain substantially above the full-signal baseline. The best-performing temporal scales differ between the two tasks. Dynamic fusion outperforms concatenation in the highest-scoring two-class configuration and slightly exceeds it in the highest-scoring three-class configuration, although these multi-scale settings require substantially more computation than the full-signal baseline.
papers.comment: The paper has been accepted at: IEEE | 2026 9th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 EEG 的多尺度时间框架 (multi-scale temporal framework) 用于情绪识别，重点针对临床上相关但研究不足的混合情绪 (mixed emotions) 分类。EEG 波形被分解为一种或多种时长的窗口，由共享的注意力编码器处理，并通过动态融合模块为每个样本分配各时间尺度的权重。在 subject-independent 协议下，两分类与三分类（含混合情绪类别）任务分别达到 65.22% 和 45.43% 的准确率，均显著高于全信号基线，但多尺度设置的计算开销明显更大。
Motivation: 混合情绪是自动情绪识别中具有临床相关性但仍未被充分探索的目标；现有 EEG 管线通常只通过单一时间窗口分析信号，从而固定了模型可用的时间结构。
Method: 引入多尺度时间框架：将 EEG 波形分解为若干不同时长的窗口，输入共享的基于注意力的编码器，再通过动态融合模块按样本为不同时间尺度分配权重并集成结果。
Result: 在 subject-independent 协议下，两分类任务最佳准确率为 65.22%，三分类任务（含混合情绪类别）最佳准确率为 45.43%，两者均由三尺度动态融合配置取得，且明显高于全信号基线。最佳时间尺度在两个任务间不同；动态融合在最高分两分类配置中优于拼接，在最高分三分类配置中略优于拼接，但多尺度设置比全信号基线需要更多计算。
Conclusion: 摘要表明多尺度动态融合配置能显著提升 EEG 情绪识别性能，但计算成本大幅增加，且最佳时间尺度随任务变化。

papers.title: Learning human joint torques from pixels
papers.abstract_en: Estimating human joint torques from visual observations is a key step toward bringing biomechanical analysis from controlled laboratories to real-world movement scenarios. Existing torque estimation methods typically depend on surface electromyography, motion-capture markers, force plates, or simulated imitation data, which limits their applicability to ordinary RGB images. In this work, we introduce VID, a vision-based inverse dynamics dataset and benchmark for predicting human joint torques directly from real monocular images. VID contains 63,369 synchronized frames with real human images, kinematic annotations, anthropometric attributes, and OpenSim-derived dynamic labels, providing paired visual and biomechanical supervision for real-image inverse dynamics. We further define a standardized evaluation protocol covering overall torque estimation, joint-specific analysis, and action-specific prediction. To establish a strong reference model, we propose VID-Network, which combines pose-pretrained spatial probabilistic features, marker regression, and temporal torque inference to recover joint torques from image sequences. Experiments on VID show that VID-Network achieves an overall mPJE of 1.7612 N$\cdot$m/kg, improving over the best compared baseline by 39.81\%, and obtains the lowest error across all evaluated joint types and most action categories. VID establishes a first practical benchmark for vision-driven human inverse dynamics and provides a foundation for studying biomechanical inference in less constrained environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VID，一个基于视觉的逆动力学数据集与基准，旨在直接从真实单目 RGB 图像预测人体关节力矩，并配套提出 VID-Network 作为参考模型。VID 包含 63,369 帧带有人体图像、运动学标注、人体测量属性和 OpenSim 推导动态标签的同步数据，提供配对的视觉与生物力学监督。实验表明 VID-Network 在总体 mPJE 上达到 1.7612 N·m/kg，相比最佳基线提升 39.81%，并在所有关节类型和多数动作类别上取得最低误差。
Motivation: 现有关节力矩估计方法通常依赖表面肌电、动捕标记、测力台或模拟模仿数据，难以推广到普通 RGB 图像场景，限制了生物力学分析从实验室走向真实世界。
Method: 构建 VID 数据集与标准化评测协议（覆盖总体力矩估计、关节特定分析和动作特定预测），并提出 VID-Network，该网络结合姿态预训练空间概率特征、标记回归 (marker regression) 和时间力矩推断，从图像序列恢复关节力矩。
Result: 在 VID 基准上，VID-Network 的总体 mPJE 为 1.7612 N·m/kg，相对最优对比基线改进 39.81%，且在所有评估的关节类型和大多数动作类别中误差最低。
Conclusion: 该工作建立了第一个面向视觉驱动人体逆动力学 (vision-driven human inverse dynamics) 的实用基准，为在较少受约束环境中研究生物力学推断提供了基础。
