papers.title: F2STNet: Fair and Federated Spectral-Temporal Modeling for Graph Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Spatiotemporal prediction on graph-structured data is central to traffic forecasting and environmental monitoring, yet decentralized and heterogeneous data complicate both sequence modeling and collaborative training. We propose F$^2$STNet, a federated forecasting framework that combines truncated graph-Fourier features, a lightweight diagonal state-space temporal encoder, graph convolution, and Fairness-aware Federated Aggregation (FFA). The spectral branch exposes graph-frequency structure, while the state-space layer models long temporal dependencies with linear complexity in the sequence length. FFA adjusts the FedAvg prior using client validation losses and an increasing fairness schedule. Experiments on PeMS04, HZMetro, and KnowAir show favorable forecasting accuracy relative to the evaluated baselines; federated experiments on PeMS04 additionally improve worst-client and client-dispersion metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 F^2STNet，一个面向图结构时空预测的联邦学习框架，由截断图傅里叶特征、轻量对角状态空间时序编码器、图卷积和公平感知联邦聚合 (FFA) 组成。FFA 利用客户端验证损失与递增公平调度调整 FedAvg 先验。摘要报告在 PeMS04、HZMetro、KnowAir 上相对所评估基线取得更优预测精度，并在 PeMS04 联邦实验中改善最差客户端与客户端离散度指标。
Motivation: 图结构数据上的时空预测（如交通流与环境监测）通常依赖集中式序列建模，但实际数据分散且异构，给协同训练和预测精度带来挑战。
Method: 提出联邦预测框架：谱分支使用截断图傅里叶特征暴露图频率结构；轻量对角状态空间层以序列长度线性复杂度建模长时间依赖；并设计公平感知联邦聚合 FFA，用客户端验证损失和递增公平调度调整 FedAvg 先验。
Result: 在 PeMS04、HZMetro、KnowAir 三个数据集上，相对所评估基线取得更优预测精度；PeMS04 上的联邦实验进一步改善了最差客户端和客户端离散度指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将谱-时域建模与基于验证损失的公平联邦聚合结合，可在异构分散数据上兼顾整体预测精度与客户端公平性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: When Confidence Fails: Overconfidence in LLMs under Uncertainty and Missing Clinical Information
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in medical question answering and clinical reasoning tasks. However, their reliability under uncertainty remains poorly understood which raises critical concerns for deployment in high-stakes clinical settings. In such environments, incorrect predictions are inherently risky, but confident incorrect predictions can be particularly harmful as they may mislead clinical decision-making. In this paper, we conduct a systematic behavioral analysis of LLMs under clinical information uncertainty. We propose an evaluation framework based on the MedMCQA dataset consisting of two complementary uncertainty settings. First, we introduce linguistic uncertainty cues through prompt modifications to simulate ambiguous clinical contexts. Second, we construct an answer removal setting, wherein the correct option is deliberately excluded mandating the model to recognize insufficient information and abstain. We analyze both model accuracy and confidence behavior using multiple calibration metrics including calibration gap, Expected Calibration Error (ECE), and Unsafe Confident Error Rate (UCER) across 500 medical questions. Our results reveal a consistent failure mode, i.e., although accuracy degrades under increasing uncertainty, model confidence remains misaligned with accuracy. This leads to a substantial increase in unsafe confident errors, indicating that model confidence remains largely insensitive to clinically meaningful information loss. Furthermore, we observe significant variation across models in their ability to abstain when the correct answer is unavailable, with some models persistently producing high confidence hallucinated answers. These findings expose critical limitations in the epistemic reliability of current LLMs and highlight the need for uncertainty aware evaluation methods prior to their deployment in clinical workflows.

TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）在临床信息不确定性下的可靠性问题，基于 MedMCQA 数据集提出一个包含两种互补不确定性设置的评估框架：通过提示修改引入语言层面的不确定性线索，以及移除正确选项迫使模型识别信息不足并弃权。作者在 500 道医学题目上用校准差距、Expected Calibration Error (ECE) 和 Unsafe Confident Error Rate (UCER) 等指标分析准确率与置信度行为，发现一个一致的失败模式：不确定度上升时准确率下降，但置信度与准确率失配，导致不安全的高置信错误显著增加。
Motivation: LLM 在医学问答和临床推理任务上表现强劲，但在不确定性下的可靠性尚未被充分理解；在临床等高危场景中，错误预测本身有风险，而高置信的错误预测可能误导临床决策，危害尤其大。
Method: 提出基于 MedMCQA 的评估框架，包含两种设置：其一通过提示修改引入语言不确定性线索以模拟模糊临床情境；其二构造答案移除设置，故意排除正确选项，迫使模型识别信息不足并弃权。分析使用校准差距、ECE 和 UCER 等多项校准指标，覆盖 500 道医学问题。
Result: 摘要报告结果显示一个一致失败模式：随着不确定性增加准确率下降，但模型置信度与准确率保持失配，不安全的高置信错误大幅上升，说明置信度对临床意义的信息缺失基本不敏感；不同模型在正确答案缺失时的弃权能力差异显著，部分模型持续给出高置信的幻觉答案。
Conclusion: 这些发现暴露了当前 LLM 在认知可靠性（epistemic reliability）上的关键局限，并强调在临床工作流部署前需要不确定性感知的评估方法。

papers.title: Personalized Federated Learning via Variance-Aware Nonparametric Empirical Bayes
papers.abstract_en: We develop a new approach to Personalized Federated Learning across heterogeneous clients using Nonparametric Empirical Bayes (NPEB). Leveraging the asymptotic normality of local parameter estimates obtained from Empirical Risk Minimization or M-estimation, our method formulates these estimates as noisy observations to estimate an unknown shared prior via Nonparametric Maximum Likelihood. A key challenge in applying NPEB in this setting is that existing approaches assume known fixed variances, which is not true in practice. To address this, we introduce a Variance-Aware Nonparametric Empirical Bayes (VANEB) framework that leverages the parameter-dependent asymptotic variance of local M-estimators. A key technical contribution is a generalized Tweedie's formula for this heteroskedastic setting. We then establish non-asymptotic error rates for density estimation in the average squared Hellinger distance and derive an oracle denoising inequality that provides error bounds for our estimator. While our theoretical guarantees are rooted in the asymptotic regime of M-estimators, we empirically explore heuristic extensions of VANEB to modern federated learning settings involving Deep Neural Networks (DNNs). For DNNs, we propose VANEB-head and VANEB-FT, which personalize the last fully connected layer via an NPEB step using an approximate diagonal variance estimator. We show that our method has strong performance on popular vision datasets MNIST and CIFAR-10, using a convolutional neural network architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于方差感知非参数经验贝叶斯（Variance-Aware Nonparametric Empirical Bayes, VANEB）的个性化联邦学习方法。作者利用局部M估计量的渐近正态性，将局部参数估计视为带噪声观测并通过非参数最大似然估计共享先验，针对现有方法假定方差已知的局限引入参数依赖的渐近方差，并推广了Tweedie公式。理论上给出密度估计的非渐近误差界与oracle去噪不等式，实验在MNIST和CIFAR-10上验证了DNN场景下的个性化性能。
Motivation: 联邦学习中客户端数据异质性使得单一全局模型难以适应每个客户端，个性化联邦学习需要建模客户端间的共享结构；现有非参数经验贝叶斯方法假定已知固定方差，而实际中局部M估计量的方差未知且依赖参数，限制了该方法在该场景下的应用。
Method: 方法将经验风险最小化或M估计得到的局部参数估计视为噪声观测，用非参数最大似然估计未知共享先验；核心是提出VANEB框架，利用参数依赖的渐近方差并推导异方差（heteroskedastic）情形下的广义Tweedie公式。对深度神经网络场景，作者提出VANEB-head和VANEB-FT，通过近似对角方差估计对最后一层全连接层进行NPEB个性化。
Result: 摘要报告建立了平均平方Hellinger距离下密度估计的非渐近误差率，并导出为估计量提供误差界的oracle去噪不等式；在MNIST和CIFAR-10上使用卷积神经网络架构的实验表明该方法性能较强。
Conclusion: 理论保证建立在M估计量的渐近机制之上，向现代联邦学习DNN设置的扩展属于启发式；作者通过VANEB-head和VANEB-FT展示了该方法在常见视觉数据集上的有效性。

papers.title: A Unified Issue Resolution Benchmark for Requirement Clarification, Planning, and Code Generation for Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model-powered coding agents are increasingly used to modify existing code repositories, for example, by adding features or fixing bugs. Yet existing repository-level benchmarks typically evaluate only whether the final patch passes tests. Satisfying a user request requires a long chain of interdependent reasoning and decisions: an agent must recover explicit and implicit requirements, formulate a repository-grounded implementation plan, and translate it into correct code. A pass/fail outcome cannot characterize how an unsuccessful trajectory diverges from the requirements and implementation process needed for a correct patch. To address this gap, we introduce SWE-RPG, a repository-level benchmark that combines executable patch evaluation with validated ground-truth references (GTs) for (1) Requirement Clarification and (2) Implementation Planning. These intermediate GTs support retrospective, GT-aligned diagnosis of complete coding-agent trajectories across clarification, planning, code generation, and artifact submission. SWE-RPG comprises 163 tasks from 31 Python and Java repositories, including 113 bug fixes and 50 feature additions. We evaluate 3 coding agents, including Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, with 6 large language model backends, including Claude-Sonnet-5 and GPT-5.6-Terra. Results show that the evaluated popular coding agents still struggle to implement user requests in existing repositories, achieving an average resolved rate of only 31.5% on SWE-RPG. Intermediate-GT diagnosis further identifies implicit requirement recovery as the main bottleneck, accounting for 24.5%--46.0% of agent runs. This result suggests implicit-requirement recovery as a key candidate direction for improving coding agents. The benchmark data and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/Xin-Zhou-smu/SWE-RPG-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SWE-RPG，一个面向仓库级编码智能体的统一问题解决基准，在可执行补丁评估之外增加需求澄清与实现规划两类的验证过的 ground-truth 参考。基准包含来自 31 个 Python 和 Java 仓库的 163 个任务（113 个缺陷修复、50 个功能新增），并评估了 3 个编码智能体与 6 个 LLM 后端。结果显示平均 resolved rate 仅 31.5%，中间参考诊断表明隐式需求恢复是主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有仓库级基准只评估最终补丁是否通过测试，无法刻画不成功轨迹在需求澄清、规划、代码生成过程中具体偏离正确流程的环节。
Method: 构建 SWE-RPG 基准，将可执行补丁评估与两类验证过的 ground-truth 参考（需求澄清、实现规划）结合，支持对完整编码智能体轨迹进行回顾式的 GT 对齐诊断。数据集包含 Python 与 Java 仓库的缺陷修复和功能新增任务。
Result: 在 SWE-RPG 上评估 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等编码智能体及 6 个 LLM 后端，平均 resolved rate 仅 31.5%；中间 GT 诊断显示隐式需求恢复占 agent 运行的 24.5%–46.0%，是主要瓶颈。
Conclusion: 摘要将隐式需求恢复视为改进编码智能体的关键方向，并公开了基准数据和评估代码。

papers.title: Two-Step MV-DeepONet: Probabilistic Operator Learning for Uncertainty Propagation Driven by Random Input Fields
papers.abstract_en: Forward uncertainty propagation in complex physical systems can induce structured covariance across field-valued outputs. For a probabilistic surrogate, the total predictive covariance comprises the covariance of conditional means across input realizations and the average conditional predictive covariance. Probabilistic DeepONet (Prob-DeepONet) provides lightweight uncertainty quantification by predicting pointwise Gaussian means and variances in a single forward pass, but its conditional predictive covariance is restricted to a diagonal form. To represent cross-location conditional dependence without explicitly parameterizing a full high-dimensional covariance matrix, we develop a two-step mean-variance DeepONet (two-step MV-DeepONet) through two principal modifications. First, two-step training is used to decouple output-basis learning from the input-to-coefficient mapping, together with basis orthogonalization and subspace rotation. Second, Gaussian probabilistic modeling is transferred from the high-dimensional physical output space to the low-dimensional rotated coefficient space. Mapping these probabilistic coefficients through the shared basis induces a generally non-diagonal conditional predictive covariance in the physical output space while retaining single-pass inference. A Frobenius-norm error decomposition and corresponding upper bound identify low-rank covariance compressibility, trunk-subspace approximation, finite-sample statistical error, and coefficient-space covariance estimation as the principal factors governing covariance recovery. Numerical experiments on three representative problems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs) and a hypersonic blunt-body aerothermal problem show improved generalization, more structured uncertainty bands, and accurate recovery of off-diagonal correlation patterns compared with Prob-DeepONet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种两步训练的概率算子学习框架 two-step MV-DeepONet，用于随机输入场驱动的前向不确定性传播。该方法在低维旋转系数空间进行高斯概率建模，并经由共享基映射回物理输出空间，从而在保持单次前向推理的同时产生非对角条件预测协方差。作者给出 Frobenius 范数误差分解与上界，并在多个 PDE 问题和高超音速钝体气动热问题中验证了改进的泛化与相关性恢复。
Motivation: 现有 Prob-DeepONet 只能给出逐点对角条件预测协方差，无法刻画跨位置的条件依赖；而显式参数化完整高维协方差矩阵代价过高，限制了概率代理模型在复杂物理系统中的应用。
Method: 通过两项主要修改：一是两步训练，将输出基学习与输入到系数映射解耦，并引入基正交化和子空间旋转；二是把高斯概率建模从高维物理输出空间转移到低维旋转系数空间，再通过共享基映射回物理空间，从而诱导非对角条件预测协方差，同时保留单次前向推理。
Result: 摘要报告在三个代表性 PDE 问题和高超音速钝体气动热问题上，相比 Prob-DeepONet 有更好的泛化、更结构化的不确定性带，以及更准确的离对角相关模式恢复；同时给出误差分解与上界，识别出低秩协方差可压缩性、trunk 子空间近似、有限样本统计误差和系数空间协方差估计为主要误差来源。
Conclusion: 作者通过结合低秩协方差可压缩性与系数空间协方差估计，论证了无需显式参数化完整协方差矩阵即可恢复物理输出空间中的条件依赖结构。摘要未讨论应用局限性。

papers.title: Model the Edit, Not the Image: Visual Autoregressive Editing from a Source-Centric Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Next-scale visual autoregressive models (VARs) have emerged as a powerful generative paradigm, producing high-quality images through efficient coarse-to-fine prediction. However, their potential for text-guided image editing remains largely underexplored. Existing training-free VAR editing approaches often formulate editing as target-conditioned regeneration guided or constrained by the source image, and may rely on inversion, test-time optimization, attention control, or user-provided masks. This generation-centric formulation does not fully exploit the multiscale source representations provided by VARs and may introduce additional computation or intervention. We instead take a source-centric perspective on VAR editing, in which the encoded source image tokens serve as the primary visual state and the editing process focuses on condition-induced changes. Based on this perspective, we propose \textbf{EditMod}, which compares source- and target-conditioned predictions under a shared autoregressive context, treats their difference as a scale-wise editing direction, and applies it as a residual update to source tokens at selected scales. Experiments show that EditMod achieves leading source-image fidelity while maintaining strong text alignment, and completes end-to-end editing of a 1K image in only 1.57 seconds on a single A100 GPU without per-image preparation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向视觉自回归模型（VAR）的文本引导图像编辑方法 EditMod，从源图像中心视角（source-centric perspective）而非生成目标中心视角来处理编辑。方法在共享自回归上下文下比较源条件与目标条件的预测，将二者差异作为尺度级编辑方向，并以残差更新的方式作用于源 token 的选定尺度。摘要报告该方法在保持源图保真度的同时实现强文本对齐，并在单张 A100 GPU 上以 1.57 秒完成 1K 图像的端到端编辑，无需逐图像准备。
Motivation: 现有免训练的 VAR 图像编辑方法通常将编辑表述为目标条件再生成，受源图引导或约束，且可能依赖反演（inversion）、测试时优化、注意力控制或用户掩码。这种生成中心视角未充分利用 VAR 提供的多尺度源表示，且会引入额外计算或人工干预。
Method: 提出 EditMod：在共享自回归上下文下同时获取源条件与目标条件的预测，计算二者差异作为尺度级编辑方向，再将该方向作为残差更新施加到所选尺度的源 token 上，从而实现编辑。
Result: 摘要报告 EditMod 在源图保真度上达到领先水平，同时保持强文本对齐；在单张 A100 GPU 上端到端编辑 1K 图像仅需 1.57 秒，且无需逐图像准备。
Conclusion: 作者认为从源中心视角建模编辑（即建模编辑过程本身而非重新生成整幅图像）能更充分利用 VAR 的多尺度源表示，并实现高效、高保真的文本引导编辑。

papers.title: Diagnosing as Cardiologists Do: ECG Agents with Doctor-Grounded Priors for Clinical Reasoning Across Diseases and Populations
papers.abstract_en: Cardiologists interpret electrocardiograms by localizing waveform components, measuring rhythm and interval patterns, and translating these structured observations into diagnostic evidence. Whether this expert reading process can serve as an effective prior for ECG agents remains unclear. To address this question, we introduce LuminaECG, a clinically structured ECG reasoning framework that reformulates ECG interpretation as measurement-grounded visual reading. ECG signals are rendered on standard electrocardiographic grid paper to preserve the spatial and scale cues used in clinical reading. P-wave, QRS-complex, and T-wave boundaries are explicitly delineated, and color-coded segmentation decomposes the waveform into discrete visual measurement primitives. A general 2B vision-language backbone is then trained with low-rank supervised fine-tuning to associate these primitives with diagnostic reasoning, without architectural modification. Across open, proprietary, and ECG-specialist zero-shot baselines, LuminaECG improves both waveform measurement and diagnostic recovery. It reaches a clinically meaningful reader tier on the CODE-test benchmark, transfers across geographically diverse ECG datasets without retraining, and generates reports whose structure contains an emergent prognostic signal. These findings suggest that effective ECG agents require not only larger models, but supervision that preserves the alignment between measurable waveform evidence and clinical knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LuminaECG，一个以临床结构化的 ECG 推理框架，将心电图解读重构为基于测量的视觉阅读。信号被渲染在标准心电图网格纸上以保留空间与尺度线索，P 波、QRS 波和 T 波边界被显式标注，并通过颜色编码分割分解为离散的视觉测量原语。一个通用 2B vision-language 主干经低秩监督微调后即可关联这些原语与诊断推理，无需修改架构。在开放、专有及 ECG 专家零样本基线上，该方法同时改善了波形测量与诊断恢复。
Motivation: 心内科医生解读心电图时依靠定位波形成分、测量节律和间期模式，并将结构化观察转化为诊断证据；但专家这一阅读过程能否作为 ECG 智能体的有效先验尚不清楚，这是本文要回答的问题。
Method: 提出 LuminaECG 框架，将 ECG 信号绘制到标准心电图网格纸上以保留临床阅读所用的空间和尺度线索，显式勾画 P/QRS/T 波边界，并用颜色编码分割将波形分解为离散视觉测量原语。随后使用通用 2B vision-language 主干进行低秩监督微调（low-rank supervised fine-tuning），将原语与诊断推理关联起来，且不改变网络架构。
Result: 摘要报告，在开放、专有和 ECG 专家零样本基线上，LuminaECG 同时提升了波形测量与诊断恢复；在 CODE-test 基准上达到具有临床意义的阅读等级；无需重新训练即可跨地理多样性的 ECG 数据集迁移；其生成报告的结构中还包含突现的预后信号。
Conclusion: 作者认为，有效的 ECG 智能体不仅需要更大的模型，还需要能够保持可测量波形证据与临床知识之间对齐的监督方式。

papers.title: Triple Expert Learning from Noisy Labels for Semi-Supervised Vision Foundation Model Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised adaptation of vision foundation models (VFMs) commonly freezes the pretrained backbone and updates lightweight modules such as LoRA. However, pseudo-labels have mixed reliability, and a single LoRA adapter must absorb reliable, ambiguous, and noisy gradients in the same low-rank space. This can make VFM adaptation sensitive to pseudo-label noise. We propose \textbf{TriNoL}, a \textbf{Tri}ple-expert learning framework from \textbf{No}isy \textbf{L}abels for semi-supervised VFM adaptation. TriNoL routes unlabeled samples into three confidence regions and assigns them to three LoRA experts: a Positive Expert for high-confidence pseudo-labels, an Alignment Expert for medium-confidence ambiguous samples, and a Negative Expert for low-confidence noisy samples. The VFM backbone remains frozen, and only the LoRA experts and classifier head are updated. By separating different pseudo-label reliability regions into specialized adaptation paths, TriNoL improves robustness to noisy supervision while keeping the training cost low.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026. Official list of accepted papers: https://bmvc2026.bmva.org/programme/accepted_papers/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TriNoL，一种针对半监督视觉基础模型 (VFM) 适应的三重专家学习框架，旨在缓解伪标签噪声带来的适应不稳定性。TriNoL 将未标记样本按置信度分成三个区域，并分别交给三个 LoRA 专家处理：高置信度伪标签对应 Positive Expert，中等置信度模糊样本对应 Alignment Expert，低置信度噪声样本对应 Negative Expert。骨干网络保持冻结，仅更新 LoRA 专家和分类头，从而在低训练成本下提升对噪声监督的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 半监督 VFM 适应中，伪标签可靠性不一，而单个 LoRA 适配器需要在同一个低秩空间中同时吸收可靠、模糊和带噪声的梯度，导致适应过程对伪标签噪声敏感。
Method: 提出 TriNoL 框架，将未标记样本划分到三个置信度区域，并分别分配给三个 LoRA 专家（Positive、Alignment、Negative Expert）；VFM 骨干冻结，仅训练 LoRA 专家与分类头，从而将不同伪标签可靠性区域分离到专门的适应路径中。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，仅说明该方法在保持训练成本较低的同时，提高了对噪声监督的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 通过将不同伪标签可靠性区域分离到专门的适应路径，TriNoL 可提升半监督 VFM 适应对噪声监督的鲁棒性，且训练开销低。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: GeoAI-based post-segmentation quality validation of building footprints via spatial feature engineering
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning-based building footprint extraction from high-resolution imagery often produces topologically inconsistent vectors unfit for direct GIS database ingestion. To address this, we present a multidomain GeoAI quality control framework that automates error detection to systematically purify vector footprint databases. Candidate footprints were generated across five UAV survey sites in Bangladesh using U-Net (ResNet-34) and SAM-LoRA (ViT-B). The extracted raster masks were vectorized, geometrically regularized, and consolidated under a spatial-exclusivity constraint to eliminate duplicate representations. We used twenty-four predictors capturing geometric, spatial-contextual, and raster-derived spectral and texture properties. Machine Learning (ML) classifiers were trained on a development partition (Sites B-D) and rigorously validated on a spatially independent test set (Site E) excluded from hyperparameter tuning and class balancing. The experimental results demonstrate that geometric and spatial-contextual predictors using Decision Tree (DT) provide the most effective discriminatory evidence for identifying object-level boundary deformations. DT achieved an accuracy of 95.31%, an F1-score of 91.06%, and a Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) of 0.880 on the unseen testing site. At the database level, this framework successfully identified 87.34% of erroneous footprints while maintaining 98.31% of acceptable structures, reducing the residual error proportion from 27.32% to 4.62% and improving final database purity to 95.38%. This translates into a relative error reduction of 83.09%. The findings indicate that post-segmentation object-level ML provides a highly transferable, robust mechanism for automated quality assurance in production-ready geographic information system (GIS) workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多域 GeoAI 质量控制框架，用于对深度学习提取的建筑足迹 (building footprints) 进行分割后质量验证。候选足迹来自孟加拉国五个 UAV 站点的 U-Net (ResNet-34) 与 SAM-LoRA (ViT-B)，经矢量化、几何规整和空间独占约束合并后，用 24 个几何、空间上下文及栅格光谱/纹理特征训练 ML 分类器。决策树 (Decision Tree) 在空间独立的测试站点上达到 95.31% 准确率、91.06% F1 和 0.880 MCC。
Motivation: 高分辨率影像的深度学习建筑足迹提取常产生拓扑不一致的矢量结果，无法直接写入 GIS 数据库；需要一个自动化误差检测机制来系统性地净化矢量足迹数据库。
Method: 提出端到端 GeoAI 质量保证流程：在五个 UAV 站点生成候选足迹，经矢量化、几何正则化并在空间独占约束下合并去重；构建 24 个预测因子，涵盖几何、空间上下文和栅格派生的光谱与纹理属性；在开发分区 (Sites B-D) 上训练 ML 分类器，并在排除超参调优和类别平衡的独立测试集 (Site E) 上验证。
Result: 实验显示几何与空间上下文特征配合决策树对识别对象级边界形变最有效，在未见测试站点上准确率 95.31%、F1 91.06%、MCC 0.880。数据库层面正确识别 87.34% 的错误足迹，同时保留 98.31% 的可接受结构，残差错误比例从 27.32% 降至 4.62%，最终数据库纯度达 95.38%，相对错误减少 83.09%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分割后的对象级 ML 验证为生产级 GIS 工作流提供了高可迁移、稳健的自动化质量保证机制。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Diversity Matters: Distributional Feature Coverage Sample Selection for Data-Efficient Backdoor Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Backdoor attacks compromise training data so that a model retains clean accuracy but predicts an attacker-chosen target on triggered inputs. At very low poisoning rates, only a few samples convey the trigger--target association, making poison-sample selection critical. Existing methods typically rank candidates using per-sample scores, which can select redundant samples from similar semantic regions, and many require task-specific surrogate training. We propose Distributional Feature Coverage Sample Selection (DFCS), a training-free, trigger-agnostic method that clusters fixed pretrained features into one region per poisoning slot and selects the centroid-nearest sample from each region. A local first-order analysis relates this allocation to feature-coverage and representative-mass terms. Across BadNets and Blended attacks on CIFAR-10, Tiny-ImageNet, and Imagenette, DFCS achieves the highest mean attack success rate among seven selectors in all six dataset--attack settings, averaging $96.30\%$ and exceeding the strongest comparator in each setting by 4.60 percentage points on average while preserving clean accuracy. These results support distributional feature coverage as an effective selection principle for low-budget dirty-label backdoor attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Distributional Feature Coverage Sample Selection (DFCS)，一种无训练、触发器无关的毒样本选择方法，用于极低投毒率下的脏标签后门攻击。DFCS 将固定预训练特征聚类为每个投毒槽一个区域，并选择每个区域中离质心最近的样本；在 BadNets 和 Blended 攻击下对 CIFAR-10、Tiny-ImageNet、Imagenette 的六个数据集–攻击组合中，DFCS 平均攻击成功率最高，达到 96.30%，平均超过最强对比方法 4.60 个百分点，同时保持干净准确率。
Motivation: 低投毒率下只有少量样本承载触发器–目标关联，毒样本选择很关键；现有方法通常用逐样本分数排序，容易从相似语义区域选到冗余样本，而且许多方法需要任务特定的代理训练。
Method: DFCS 是一种训练免费、触发器无关的方法：对固定的预训练特征做聚类，每个投毒槽对应一个区域，然后从每个区域中选择离质心最近的样本；并通过局部一阶分析将该分配策略与特征覆盖 (feature coverage) 和代表性质量 (representative mass) 两项联系起来。
Result: 在 BadNets 和 Blended 攻击、CIFAR-10/Tiny-ImageNet/Imagenette 的六个设置中，DFCS 在七个选择器中取得最高平均攻击成功率，平均 96.30%，每个设置下平均超过最强对比方法 4.60 个百分点，且干净准确率保持不变。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果支持分布性特征覆盖是低预算脏标签后门攻击中一种有效的样本选择原则。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 Distributional Feature Coverage Sample Selection (DFCS)，一种无训练、触发器无关的毒样本选择方法，用于极低投毒率下的脏标签后门攻击。DFCS 将固定预训练特征聚类为每个投毒槽一个区域，并选择每个区域中离质心最近的样本；在 BadNets 和 Blended 攻击下对 CIFAR-10、Tiny-ImageNet、Imagenette 的六个数据集–攻击组合中，DFCS 平均攻击成功率最高，达到 96.30%，平均超过最强对比方法 4.60 个百分点，同时保持干净准确率。
summary_sections.motivation: 低投毒率下只有少量样本承载触发器–目标关联，毒样本选择很关键；现有方法通常用逐样本分数排序，容易从相似语义区域选到冗余样本，而且许多方法需要任务特定的代理训练。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为结果支持分布性特征覆盖是低预算脏标签后门攻击中一种有效的样本选择原则。

papers.title: Bridging the Gap Between Semantics and Reconstruction:Unifying Sign Language Translation and Production
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in sign language (SL) research have shown a trend toward unifying multiple sign language understanding (SLU) subtasks, such as isolated sign language recognition (ISLR), continuous sign language recognition (CSLR), and sign language translation (SLT), within a single framework, leading to substantial progress. Meanwhile, sign language production (SLP), which generates sign sequences from text, has also attracted growing attention. This naturally raises an important question: can sign language understanding and production be unified within a single framework? Compared with unifying SLU subtasks, this problem is substantially more challenging. Existing SLU tasks largely share the same direction of mapping, namely from sign inputs to linguistic outputs, whereas SLT and SLP lie in opposite directions of sign-text mapping. A unified framework must therefore address two key challenges: (1) bridging the modality gap between continuous sign motions and discrete text tokens through a shared sign tokenizer that supports both linguistic abstraction and motion reconstruction; and (2) learning a single conditional autoregressive model that can take either sign or text as input and generate the corresponding target sequence in the opposite modality. To this end, we propose Uni-SLTP, a unified framework for SLT and SLP with two key components: (1) a shared sign tokenizer that converts sign sequences into discrete tokens and latent representations, capturing both semantic and reconstructive information; and (2) a unified autoregressive generation model that formulates both tasks as conditional sequence generation. Experiments on widely used public datasets show that Uni-SLTP achieves superior motion accuracy for SLP while maintaining competitive SLT performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Uni-SLTP，一个统一手语翻译 (SLT) 与手语生成 (SLP) 的框架。框架包含两个核心组件：共享符号分词器 (sign tokenizer)，将连续手语动作转换为离散 token 和潜在表示，同时保留语义与重建信息；以及统一的因果自回归生成模型，将 SLT 和 SLP 均建模为条件序列生成。在常用公开数据集上，Uni-SLTP 在手语生成的运动精度上优于现有方法，同时保持有竞争力的翻译性能。
Motivation: 现有手语研究多统一理解侧子任务（如识别、翻译），但理解与生成（文本到手语）方向相反，难以放入同一框架。作者希望解决两个关键挑战：弥合连续手语动作与离散文本 token 之间的模态差距，并训练一个既能以手语为输入也能以文本为输入并输出相反模态序列的单一条件自回归模型。
Method: 提出 Uni-SLTP 统一框架，包含两部分：一是共享符号分词器，将手语序列编码为离散 token 与潜在表示，同时捕获语义信息和运动重建信息；二是统一的自回归生成模型，将 SLT（手语转文本）与 SLP（文本转手语）都视为条件序列生成任务，从而用同一套参数处理两个方向。
Result: 在广泛使用的公开数据集上，Uni-SLTP 在手语生成 (SLP) 任务上取得更优的运动精度，同时保持与现有方法相当的翻译 (SLT) 性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为统一理解与生成生成是可行的，通过共享 token 与统一自回归模型可以桥接手语和文本的双向映射，相关实验支持该框架在 SLP 上的优势及 SLT 上的稳定性。

papers.title: Don't Scroll Back: Missing-Evidence Memory for Streaming Dialogue Summarization
papers.abstract_en: Users of modern platforms repeatedly need summaries of recent dialogue, but the window rarely contains enough context to be interpreted on its own. We formalize this setting as streaming dialogue summarization, where a system must summarize a current window using selective memory from an unbounded history under a fixed budget. We show that the central challenge is not how much history is accessed, but whether memory recovers the evidence that the current window presupposes. We construct a benchmark and evaluation protocol that separately assesses whether memory contains gap-resolving evidence and whether the generated summary reflects it. We propose ReMEMBER, a missing-evidence memory framework that conditions retrieval on unresolved window dependencies and refines retrieved chunks into evidence-dense memory under a fixed budget. Experiments on dialogues with histories up to 160K tokens show that ReMEMBER improves memory recall and gap-resolution completeness over memory construction baselines under the same budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化流式对话摘要任务：系统需在固定预算下利用无限历史中的选择性记忆来摘要当前窗口。作者指出核心挑战不在于访问多少历史，而在于记忆能否恢复当前窗口预设的缺失证据，并提出 ReMEMBER 框架，基于未解析窗口依赖进行条件化检索，并在固定预算下将检索块精炼为证据密集的记忆。在历史长达 160K tokens 的对话实验中，ReMEMBER 在相同预算下相比记忆构建基线提升了记忆召回与间隙补全完整性。
Motivation: 现代平台用户反复需要最近对话的摘要，但当前窗口常常缺乏足够的上下文来独立解释。现有方法没有区分访问历史量与记忆是否恢复当前窗口所预设的证据，因此作者为该问题建立正式设定、基准与评估协议。
Method: 提出 ReMEMBER 缺失证据记忆框架，检索过程以当前窗口未解决的依赖为条件，并在固定预算下把检索到的块精炼为证据密集的记忆。同时构造基准与评估协议，分别检验记忆是否包含解决间隙的证据以及生成摘要是否反映该证据。
Result: 在历史长达 160K tokens 的对话实验上，ReMEMBER 在相同预算下相比记忆构建基线提高了记忆召回和间隙补全完整性。
Conclusion: 作者强调流式摘要的中心问题不是访问历史量，而是记忆能否恢复当前窗口预设的证据；ReMEMBER 在固定预算下改善了证据恢复，并为该场景提供了基准与评估方向。

papers.title: DualCert: A Solver for the Traveling Salesman Problem with Constraint-Coupled Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large traveling salesman problem (TSP) instances require a solver to allocate limited computation while preserving the validity of its outputs. Existing neural--operations-research (OR) hybrids predict guidance without requiring learned transitions to satisfy constraints discovered during search. DualCert introduces \emph{constraint-coupled learning}, in which current degree equations and dynamically separated subtour-elimination constraints (SECs) define each learned transition. At each refinement, the degree equations and selected, strictly satisfied SEC equations, with positive slacks, define an iterate-dependent primal-slack Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) manifold. Repaired dual variables and violated SEC rows define a local cost field. An exact constrained mirror-descent step maps each finite state to a positive state on the same manifold. Where selected rows and deterministic ties remain fixed, implicit differentiation maps parameter perturbations into the manifold tangent space and reuses the forward constraint operator for the local-cost-field derivative. The terminal edge state allocates computation across Held--Karp ascent, candidate-graph edge tests, and tour construction under a fixed budget. Deterministic verification recomputes original costs and accepts only verified candidate-graph lower bounds and edge decisions. On 1,000 held-out TSP1000 instances, DualCert attains a mean tour-cost gap of \(0.0573\%\) from Lin--Kernighan--Helsgaun version 3 (LKH-3) reference tours in \(9.55\) batch-amortized seconds per instance. It returns a verified candidate-graph lower bound for every instance and achieves \(81.46\%\) edge-decision coverage. The mean gap is \(67.1\%\) smaller than the reported NeuroLKH mean gap. Thus, optimization constraints govern learning, while deterministic verification preserves output validity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DualCert，一个面向大规模旅行商问题 (TSP) 的求解器，将神经网络指导与确定性验证结合，引入约束耦合学习 (constraint-coupled learning)：每次学习到的转移由当前度方程和动态分离的子环消除约束 (SECs) 定义。在 1,000 个留出的 TSP1000 实例上，DualCert 相对 LKH-3 参考 tour 的平均 tour-cost gap 为 0.0573%，每个实例平均耗时 9.55 秒（批摊销），且对每个实例都返回验证过的候选图下界。
Motivation: 大规模 TSP 实例要求求解器在有限的算力预算下分配计算，同时保持输出的有效性；现有的神经-运筹 (neural-OR) 混合方法预测引导信息，但无法保证学习到的转移满足搜索过程中发现的约束。
Method: 提出约束耦合学习框架：每个学习转移由度方程和动态分离、严格满足的 SEC 方程（带正松弛变量）定义，构成随迭代变化的 primal-slack KKT 流形；修复的对偶变量和违反的 SEC 行定义局部代价场，精确的约束镜像下降 (constrained mirror descent) 将有限状态映射到同一流形上的正状态；通过隐式微分将参数扰动映射到流形切空间，并复用前向约束算子计算局部代价场导数。终端边状态在固定预算下将计算分配给 Held-Karp 上升、候选图边测试和 tour 构建。
Result: 在 1,000 个留出的 TSP1000 实例上，平均 tour-cost gap 为 0.0573%（相对 LKH-3 参考），单实例批摊销耗时 9.55 秒；每个实例均返回经过验证的候选图下界，边决策覆盖率达 81.46%；平均 gap 比报告的 NeuroLKH 平均 gap 小 67.1%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，优化约束应当主导学习过程，而确定性验证则保证输出有效性，从而在有限算力预算下兼顾求解质量与结果可信度。

papers.title: Decision-Focused Learning in Network Interdiction Games
papers.abstract_en: We study decision-focused learning (DFL) in shortest-path network interdiction (SPNI) games, a Stackelberg game where an interdictor (leader) strengthens the networks' arcs against attacks, while an evader (follower) who is uncertain about costs of attacking network arcs relies on a machine-learned predictor to identify the shortest path. While DFL is highly effective as an end-to-end optimization framework, we show that it faces a fundamental structural failure when employed in this game setting: its training objective admits a broad decision-equivalence class of cost estimators that achieve zero nominal loss yet fail under interdiction, reversing DFL's usual advantage over a naive prediction-focused learning (PFL) approach. To address this, we propose Adversarial DFL (A-DFL), which replaces nominal training samples with interdicted scenarios to collapse the harmful equivalence class. Experiments on synthetic and real-world networks confirm that A-DFL restores DFL's advantage in this game setting, enabling effective end-to-end optimization.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, accepted at GameSec2026 Conference on Game Theory and AI for Security
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究最短路径网络拦截博弈（shortest-path network interdiction, SPNI）中的决策聚焦学习（decision-focused learning, DFL）。作者指出 DFL 在此 Stackelberg 博弈设定中存在结构性失败：其训练目标存在一个宽的决策等价类（decision-equivalence class），其中的成本估计器在名义样本上达到零损失，但在拦截情境下失效，反而使 DFL 劣于朴素的预测聚焦学习（PFL）。作者提出对抗性 DFL（A-DFL），用被拦截的场景替代名义训练样本来消除有害等价类，并在合成与真实网络上验证其恢复 DFL 优势。
Motivation: 在博弈环境中，DFL 作为端到端优化框架通常会优于 PFL，但本文发现该优势在 SPNI 博弈中会反转：训练目标存在满足零名义损失却在拦截下失效的等价成本估计器，这是一个尚未被识别的结构性失败。
Method: 提出 A-DFL（Adversarial DFL），其核心是用拦截后的情景（interdicted scenarios）替换名义训练样本，从而压缩并消除导致 DFL 失效的决策等价类，使模型在对抗性设定下仍能进行有效的端到端优化。
Result: 在合成网络和真实世界网络上的实验表明，A-DFL 能够恢复 DFL 在该博弈设定中相对于 PFL 的优势，并实现有效的端到端优化。
Conclusion: 作者强调在对抗性博弈环境下，DFL 需要采用对抗性训练数据（如 A-DFL）才能避免等价类带来的失效；其适用范围限于最短路径网络拦截博弈这一类 Stackelberg 设定。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调在对抗性博弈环境下，DFL 需要采用对抗性训练数据（如 A-DFL）才能避免等价类带来的失效；其适用范围限于最短路径网络拦截博弈这一类 Stackelberg 设定。

papers.title: MusicLayout: Explicit Structural Planning for Controllable Text-to-Music Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-music generation has advanced rapidly, but current systems still rely primarily on global text prompts, leaving the structural organization of generated music implicit and difficult to inspect, control, or revise before audio generation. To address this issue, we introduce MusicLayout, an explicit intermediate representation for controlling musical structure in text-to-music generation. MusicLayout describes a musical piece as a time-aligned layout of sections, textures, repetitions, variations, and instrument-level arrangements, serving as an interpretable planning layer between textual intent and the generated music. We integrate MusicLayout into a text-to-music framework built on a unified autoregressive formulation, where the model first generates a MusicLayout representation and subsequently predicts audio tokens conditioned on this representation within a single sequence. The resulting MusicLayout can be inspected and modified prior to audio generation, providing a mechanism for layout-level structural control. We evaluate MusicLayout through layout-conditioned generation, layout manipulation experiments, and matched-data ablations, providing evidence that explicit layout planning can improve long-range structural organization and support layout-level control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MusicLayout，一种用于可控文本到音乐生成的显式中间表示，将音乐描述为时间对齐的段落、织体、重复、变奏和乐器级编排布局。作者将其集成到统一自回归框架中，使模型先生成 MusicLayout 再基于该表示预测音频 token。摘要报告布局条件生成、布局操作实验和匹配数据消融的结果，表明显式布局规划可改善长程结构组织并支持布局级控制。
Motivation: 现有文本到音乐生成主要依赖全局文本提示，音乐的结构组织隐式存在，难以在音频生成前检查、控制或修改。
Method: 引入 MusicLayout 作为文本意图与生成音频之间的可解释规划层，并在统一自回归序列中先预测 MusicLayout，再基于该布局预测音频 token，从而支持布局级结构控制。
Result: 通过布局条件生成、布局操作实验和匹配数据消融进行评估，结果表明显式布局规划能改善长程结构组织并支持布局级控制。
Conclusion: 显式布局规划可以作为文本到音乐生成中一种可行的结构控制机制，但其具体量化收益和适用范围以摘要所述证据为限。

papers.title: HOPPER: Learnable Hop Extraction for Linearized Graph Sequence Models
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks typically propagate information through repeated message-passing layers, coupling the distance over which information travels with the number of nonlinear transformations applied. This coupling can make deep architectures difficult to optimize and can lead to over-smoothing, over-squashing, and the loss of long-range information. Linearized Graph Sequence Models (LGSMs) address this issue by separating information depth from processing depth and treating the successive propagation states of each node as a sequence. However, existing LGSMs construct these sequences using fixed graph operators, limiting their ability to adapt propagation to the input graph, node features, and downstream task. We introduce HOPPER, an end-to-end learnable extension of LGSM that learns how hop sequences should be extracted before they are processed by a modern state-space model. Our framework supports feature-conditioned, structure-aware, graph- and hop-adaptive propagation mechanisms while preserving permutation equivariance. Standard adjacency-based and non-backtracking LGSM sequences arise as special cases of our proposed extractor family. We show that HOPPER is state-of-the-art or competitive across the ECHO-Synth benchmark, and that varying the maximum neighborhood size of message backtracking cancellation (i.e. structural memory window) can optimize accuracy on the LRIM physics-based long-range dependency benchmark. These results demonstrate that learnable sequence extraction provides a flexible and effective approach to long-range graph representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HOPPER，一种端到端可学习的线性化图序列模型（LGSM）扩展，通过学习如何提取跳数（hop）序列，再交由状态空间模型处理，从而实现特征条件化、结构感知、图与跳数自适应的传播机制，同时保持置换等变性。摘要报告其在 ECHO-Synth 基准上达到或接近最优，并在 LRIM 长期依赖基准上通过调节消息回溯取消的最大邻域大小（结构记忆窗口）优化精度。
Motivation: 现有图神经网络通过重复消息传递层传播信息，将信息传播距离与非线性变换层数耦合，导致深层架构难优化，并伴随过平滑、过挤压和长距离信息丢失。已有 LGSM 使用固定图算子构建传播状态序列，无法根据输入图、节点特征和下游任务自适应调整传播方式。
Method: 提出 HOPPER，作为 LGSM 的可学习扩展：在将跳序列交给现代状态空间模型之前，学习如何提取跳序列；支持特征条件化、结构感知、图与跳数自适应的传播机制，并保持置换等变性；标准邻接式和非回溯式 LGSM 序列是其提取器族的特例。
Result: 摘要报告 HOPPER 在 ECHO-Synth 基准上达到或接近最先进水平，并在 LRIM 物理基础长期依赖基准上，通过改变消息回溯取消的最大邻域大小来优化精度。
Conclusion: 结果表明，可学习的序列提取为长距离图表示学习提供了一种灵活有效的方法；作者强调结构记忆窗口的调节可影响长期依赖任务的精度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Closing the loop in learning with missing data
papers.abstract_en: What should a machine learning model learn when data is missing during training? We look at the learning process from a dynamical systems perspective, cast data missingness as a structured loss of actuation that limits controllability of the parameter error dynamics, and ultimately derive adaptation mechanisms with Lyapunov stability characteristics that throttle model updates in ways that preserve learning coherence under partial, intermittent observability. Under recurrent excitation, our analysis provides ISS-type residual-to-state bounds with respect to a bounded closed-loop mismatch between the loss residual and the preconditioned update geometry. We evaluate the efficacy of our directional observability-aware adaptive learning approach on multimodal contexts, reinforcing its premise in promoting learning coherence and stability even in pathologically sparse domains and problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从动态系统视角看待训练数据缺失问题，将数据缺失建模为一种结构性的执行损失 (loss of actuation)，它限制了参数误差动态的可控性。作者由此推导出具有 Lyapunov 稳定性特征的适应机制，在部分、间歇可观测条件下抑制模型更新，以保持学习连贯性。在持续激励下，分析给出了关于损失残差与预处理更新几何之间闭环失配的 ISS 型残差-状态界，并在多模态情境下验证了该方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有机器学习训练通常假设数据完整，而实际中训练时数据缺失是常见问题，可能导致参数更新偏离学习方向、破坏学习连贯性。本文试图从控制论和动态系统角度给出缺失数据下稳定学习的理论框架。
Method: 将参数误差动态视为受执行缺失影响的受控系统，基于 Lyapunov 稳定性理论设计观测感知的方向性适应机制 (directional observability-aware adaptive learning)，在部分可观测时自动节流模型更新，并利用持续激励条件导出 ISS 型残差-状态界。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多模态任务上验证了其有效性，即使数据极其稀疏、近乎病态的问题设定下仍能促进学习连贯性与稳定性；理论分析给出了关于闭环失配的 ISS 型界。
Conclusion: 作者认为将数据缺失视为执行损失并从控制理论出发设计更新机制，是一种有前景的、有助于在稀疏观测下保持学习稳定性的思路。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: PolicyKG: An Agentic LLM Pipeline for Translating Institutional Policies into SHACL Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Institutional policies stay in natural language while the systems that check compliance demand machine-readable constraints. Bridging that gap is still done by hand. PolicyKG closes the loop. It is an LLM pipeline that reads a policy PDF, classifies each sentence as an obligation, permission, or prohibition, lifts the label into first-order deontic logic, and emits SHACL constraints. Four stages run on a LangGraph state machine with per-stage validators. The piece that matters most is the Corpus Adapter: a YAML vocabulary registry that grounds LLM predicates in a target ontology. Retargeting to a new domain means swapping the registry, not retraining a model. On the Asian Institute of Technology Policies and Procedures corpus (1,663 sentences, 443 rules), PolicyKG reaches 86.9% deontic classification accuracy (Cohen's kappa = .709). Three annotators independently re-label a 50-item sample and agree at Fleiss' kappa = .844. SHACL shape correctness on a 69-shape subset is F1 = .866. The FOL path handles 79.2% of rules; the rest go through a direct NL-to-SHACL fallback. We audited every one of the 443 rules for second- or higher-order constructs. An automated regex checklist flagged none, and a first-author pass on the 92 FOL-fallback cases confirmed the same. The exact upper 95% Clopper-Pearson bound on the true HOL rate is 0.67%. This is an audit finding for one corpus, not a proof of FOL sufficiency for institutional policy. Swapping the AIT registry for a GDPR registry raises exact property alignment from 1/15 to 11/15 (Fisher's exact p < .001; Cohen's h = 1.53). On the LexDeMod lease-contract benchmark (N = 200), Macro F1 drops to .370 because lease English uses "shall be entitled" for permission -- exactly the vocabulary mismatch registry swap is meant to fix. Repeated runs produce hash-identical SHACL outputs.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Under review at IJCKG 2026, Bangkok, Thailand
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PolicyKG，一个基于 LLM 的 agentic 流水线，将机构政策 PDF 自动转换为 SHACL 约束知识图谱。流程对每个句子做义务/许可/禁止分类，提升为一阶道义逻辑 (first-order deontic logic) 后生成 SHACL 约束，整体运行在 LangGraph 状态机上并带逐阶段验证器。核心组件 Corpus Adapter 是用 YAML 维护的词汇注册表，将 LLM 谓词锚定到目标本体，换领域只需替换注册表而无需重训模型。在 AIT 政策语料上，道义分类准确率为 86.9%，SHACL shape 正确性 F1=.866。
Motivation: 机构政策以自然语言形式存在，而合规检查系统需要机器可读约束，目前两者之间的桥接仍依赖人工。论文目标是构建自动化流水线来消除这一瓶颈，并让跨领域迁移不依赖重新训练模型。
Method: 四阶段 LLM 流水线：读取政策 PDF，将句子分类为 obligation、permission 或 prohibition，把标签提升为一阶道义逻辑，再输出 SHACL 约束；流水线由 LangGraph 状态机驱动并有逐阶段验证器。关键的 Corpus Adapter 是 YAML 词汇注册表，负责把 LLM 使用的谓词锚定到目标本体；无法走 FOL 路径的规则使用直接的 NL-to-SHACL 回退。
Result: 在 AIT Policies and Procedures 语料（1,663 句、443 条规则）上，道义分类准确率 86.9%（Cohen's kappa=.709）；三位标注者重标 50 条样本的 Fleiss' kappa=.844。69 条 SHACL shape 子集上 F1=.866，FOL 路径覆盖 79.2% 的规则。对 443 条规则的高阶构念审计未发现违规，92 条 FOL 回退案例人工复核一致，真实高阶率的上 95% Clopper-Pearson 界为 0.67%。将 AIT 注册表换成 GDPR 注册表后，精确属性对齐从 1/15 提升到 11/15（Fisher's p<.001，Cohen's h=1.53）；在 LexDeMod 租赁合同基准（N=200）上 Macro F1 降至 .370，归因于租赁英语用 "shall be entitled" 表达许可的词汇不匹配。
Conclusion: 摘要强调对 443 条规则的高阶构念审计只是针对单一语料的发现，不是 FOL 足以覆盖机构政策的证明。通过可替换的词汇注册表实现领域迁移是可行的，但跨领域性能仍受目标领域表达习惯影响，LexDeMod 上的下降正是注册表替换欲解决的词汇不匹配问题。

papers.title: Context Is Not Authority: Structured Runtime Governance for Financial Market Agents
papers.abstract_en: Financial agents can turn correct context into an unauthorized effect: a customer-facing commitment, trade, or deployed policy. We present SAGE-Fin, a finance-specific authority-handoff contract that makes the proposed effect, not merely its text, the object of runtime control. SAGE-Fin compiles proposals into typed, adapter-bound candidates; records missing or stale institutional obligations as coverage debt; contracts authority under current market, account, policy, and dialogue state; and requires an exact-artifact receipt whose nominal type matches the consuming response, execution, or policy adapter. Evidence and workflow progress cannot substitute for effect authority, and prior authorization is rechecked after state changes. Across an authored 616-case catalog, five deterministic specifications yield 3,080 outputs; a label-isolated harness obtains 616/616 binary reference-prototype parity, including 3/3 named response-gate fixtures, while 22 tests cover selected paths. These results establish executable conformance, not independent safety accuracy. Separately, SAGE-Fin's response gate processed real customer-facing production requests at a confidential digital-asset platform. An operational team independent of the implementation team reached a strongly positive post-deployment conclusion on practical usefulness and workflow fit, and end-user feedback was also strongly positive. Disclosure permits only the review's independence, stakeholder classes, assessed dimensions, and directional conclusion, so this is qualitative field corroboration rather than an aggregate effect estimate. Three distinct de-identified predecessor failures, with independently confirmed 0/3 interception, ground repeated-emission drift, stale account evidence, and missing escalation state without estimating prevalence or treatment effect.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAGE-Fin，一种面向金融场景的权威移交契约 (authority-handoff contract)，目标是让运行时控制的对象是智能体提案所产生的效果 (effect)，而不只是文本内容。SAGE-Fin 将提案编译为带类型、绑定适配器的候选；把缺失或过期的制度义务记为 coverage debt；依据当前市场、账户、策略和对话状态收缩授权；并要求精确工件收据 (exact-artifact receipt) 的名义类型与消费方适配器匹配。在 616 个案例的目录上，五个确定性规范产生 3,080 个输出并取得 616/616 的二进制参考原型一致性；其响应门 (response gate) 还在一个保密数字资产平台上处理了真实生产请求。
Motivation: 智能体可能把正确的上下文转化为未经授权的实际效果，例如对客户的承诺、交易或已部署的策略，而现有方法缺乏对效果本身的运行时管控。
Method: SAGE-Fin 将提案编译成类型化、适配器绑定的候选，记录缺失或过期的制度义务为 coverage debt，在结合市场、账户、策略和对话状态的基础上收缩授权，并要求消费方响应、执行或策略适配器的名义类型与精确工件收据一致；状态变化后还会重新检查先前授权。
Result: 在 616 例标注目录上，五个确定性规范生成 3,080 个输出；标签隔离的测试装置 (label-isolated harness) 达到 616/616 的二进制参考原型一致性，包括 3/3 命名响应门固件，并有 22 个测试覆盖选定路径。响应门在保密数字资产平台上处理了真实客户生产请求，独立运营团队在部署后给出强正面的实用性结论，终端用户反馈也强正面；另有三个去标识化的前序失败案例被独立确认 0/3 拦截。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这些结果证明的是可执行的一致性 (executable conformance)，而非独立的安全准确性；生产现场证据属于定性佐证而非总体效应估计，且披露仅允许给出审查独立性、利益相关者类别、评估维度和方向性结论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Provable Parameter-Free Fixed-Point Algorithms with Linear Convergence Rates
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we develop provable parameter-free and adaptive fixed-point algorithms for contractive mappings, with an emphasis on automatically exploiting hidden contractivity without requiring prior knowledge of the contraction factor. Our first method is a completely parameter-free variant of the Halpern fixed-point iteration. It requires no line search, bisection, or prior estimate of the contraction factor, while retaining essentially the same per-iteration computational cost as classical fixed-point schemes. We establish explicit linear convergence rates for both the fixed-point residual and the distance to the unique fixed point. The second algorithm is an adaptive Halpern method that requires only an upper bound on the contraction factor and reduces to an existing adaptive Halpern scheme in the nonexpansive case. This method also enjoys explicit linear convergence guarantees. We further extend these ideas in two directions. First, by combining the proposed fixed-point schemes with Tikhonov regularization, we obtain a parameter-free method for solving co-coercive equations and establish an iteration complexity of $\mathcal{O}({ε^{-1}\ln(ε^{-1})})$ for computing an $ε$-solution. Second, using the relation between Halpern iterations and Nesterov's accelerated fixed-point schemes, we derive parameter-free Nesterov's accelerated variants that inherit linear convergence in the contractive setting. Numerical experiments on several examples demonstrate that the proposed algorithms are competitive with, and often outperform, existing adaptive fixed-point methods. In particular, the methods successfully exploit contractive behavior when it is present while remaining effective on nonexpansive problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可证明的免参数（parameter-free）自适应不动点算法，面向压缩映射（contractive mappings）。第一个方法是完全免参数的 Halpern 迭代变体，不需要线搜索、二分法或收缩因子的先验估计，每轮计算开销与经典不动点格式基本一致；第二个是仅需收缩因子上界的自适应 Halpern 方法，在非扩张情形退化为已有方案。摘要还给出显式线性收敛率，并利用 Tikhonov 正则化求解 co-coercive 方程、借助 Halpern 与 Nesterov 加速的关系派生免参数加速变体。数值实验表明这些方法能与现有自适应不动点方法竞争，且常常更优。
Motivation: 现有固定点算法通常需要预先知道收缩因子或借助线搜索、二分等额外步骤，这限制了其在实际非扩张问题上的即插即用性；论文希望在没有收缩因子先验的情况下自动利用隐藏的收缩性，同时保持可证明的收敛保证。
Method: 提出两类算法：一类是完全免参数的 Halpern 不动点迭代，无需任何参数估计或线搜索；另一类是自适应 Halpern 方法，只需收缩因子的上界并在非扩张情形退化到已有方案。进一步将算法与 Tikhonov 正则化结合求解 co-coercive 方程，并利用 Halpern 迭代与 Nesterov 加速固定点方案的关系，导出免参数的 Nesterov 加速变体。
Result: 摘要对固定点残差和到唯一不动点的距离均建立了显式线性收敛率；对 co-coercive 方程给出 O(ε^{-1} ln(ε^{-1})) 的迭代复杂度以求得 ε-解。多个数值算例显示，所提算法与现有自适应固定点方法相当或更优，既能利用压缩行为，也能在非扩张问题上保持有效。
Conclusion: 论文的核心主张是：免参数设计可以保留与经典算法相近的计算代价，并在线性收敛意义上具有可证明保证，同时通过自适应机制在非扩张情形下仍然有效。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: How People Evaluate AI-, Expert-, and Peer-Style Financial Advice
papers.abstract_en: As generative AI increasingly becomes a common source of daily decision-making, including financial choices, it is critical to understand how people evaluate AI-generated financial advice. We conducted a preregistered vignette experiment (N = 285) in which substantive financial content---including facts, numerical values, recommendation direction, and core reasoning---was held constant while communication style varied across AI Financial Assistant (AI), Certified Financial Planner (Expert), and Online Community Forum (OC) advice. Displayed source attribution was independently manipulated through correctly labeled, unlabeled, and mislabeled conditions, allowing us to separate attribution effects from source-specific communication cues. Expert advice was rated more favorably than AI advice on 9 of 10 outcomes (|d|=0.20--0.47), and this advantage remained visible without source labels, where Expert advice outperformed AI advice on 8 of 10 outcomes (up to d=0.60). Correct labels added limited differentiation, whereas mislabeling increased ratings of AI advice for situational fit and overall quality (d=0.42 for each) and attenuated the Expert advantage in situational fit (d=-0.36). Descriptive analyses further showed that AI advice was most responsive to displayed attribution and, conversely, that advice-style differences were most visible under an AI label. These findings show that financial-advice evaluations are shaped jointly by displayed attribution and message-level communication cues. We position disclosure not as a neutral transparency mechanism, but as an interpretive frame whose accuracy and interaction with message cues can shape trust and reliance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一个预注册的 vignette 实验（N=285），在保持财务内容（事实、数值、建议方向与核心推理）完全一致的前提下，变换 AI 财务助手、注册理财规划师（专家）与在线社区论坛三种沟通风格，并对显示来源归属进行正确标注、无标注和错误标注的独立操纵。结果显示专家建议在 10 项结果中的 9 项上优于 AI 建议（|d|=0.20–0.47）；错误标注会提升 AI 建议在情境契合度与整体质量上的评分（各 d=0.42），并削弱专家的情境契合度优势（d=-0.36）。作者认为财务建议评价由显示归属与信息层沟通线索共同塑造。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 正日益成为包括财务决策在内的日常决策来源，理解人们如何评价 AI 生成的财务建议至关重要；现有研究难以把来源标注效应与特定来源的沟通风格效应分开，本文针对这一缺口展开。
Method: 采用预注册的 vignette 实验（N=285），将实质性财务内容保持恒定，仅改变 AI、专家（Certified Financial Planner）与在线社区论坛三种风格的建议文本；同时独立操纵显示来源归属（正确标注、无标注、错误标注），以分离归属效应与沟通线索效应。
Result: 专家建议在 10 项结果中的 9 项上获得比 AI 建议更积极的评价（|d|=0.20–0.47），且该优势在无来源标签时仍然存在（8/10 项，最高 d=0.60）；正确标签带来的区分有限，而错误标签将 AI 建议的情境契合度与整体质量评分各提高 d=0.42，并使专家的情境契合度优势减弱（d=-0.36）。描述性分析还显示 AI 建议对显示归属的响应最强，而建议风格差异在 AI 标签下最明显。
Conclusion: 财务建议的评价由显示归属与信息层沟通线索共同决定；作者主张不应把披露视为中立的透明机制，而应视为一种解释框架（interpretive frame），其准确性及与信息线索的交互会影响信任与依赖。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PreGress: Ranking-Native Pre-training and Prompting for Graph Node Ranking
papers.abstract_en: Node ranking is a fundamental problem in graph information retrieval, measuring the relative importance of nodes and supporting a wide range of applications such as influence analysis, recommendation, and graph-based retrieval augmented generation. However, exact computation of graph-based ranking measures is often computationally prohibitive at scale. Existing GNN-based ranking methods provide scalable approximations, but they are typically tailored to individual ranking criteria and require retraining for each downstream task, which limits their transferability and efficiency. Recent graph pre-training approaches aim to enable knowledge transfer across tasks, yet their learning objectives are largely misaligned with node ranking, resulting in suboptimal adaptability to ranking-oriented applications. To address these limitations, we propose PreGress, the first ranking-native pre-training and prompting framework for supporting a wide range of node ranking tasks. PreGress performs multi-task pre-training using our carefully designed objectives, including degree centrality prediction and attribute reconstruction, to jointly capture structural and attribute information. To support heterogeneous ranking criteria, we design lightweight, task-specific prompt modules that adapt a frozen ranking backbone to downstream tasks without full retraining. Experiments on six public graphs and two real-world query-to-item benchmarks---Yelp2018 and MovieLens-100K---together with a controlled five-criterion graph-access study demonstrate strong ranking quality with low task-specific state overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PreGress，一个面向图节点排序的预训练与提示（pre-training and prompting）框架，据称是首个“排序原生”的此类框架。它通过多任务预训练（度中心性预测与属性重建）联合捕获结构与属性信息，并用轻量任务特定 prompt 模块适配冻结的排序主干，避免针对每个下游任务重训。实验在六个公共图和 Yelp2018、MovieLens-100K 两个查询到条目基准上展示强排名质量与低任务特定开销。
Motivation: 图节点排序在图上信息检索中很重要，但精确计算大规模不可行；现有 GNN 排序方法通常针对单一排序准则且需逐任务重训，迁移性差。近期图预训练方法的学习目标又与节点排序不对齐，导致排序任务上适应性不佳。
Method: PreGress 采用排序原生的多任务预训练目标，包括度中心性预测（degree centrality prediction）和属性重建（attribute reconstruction），以联合捕获结构与属性信息；同时设计轻量、任务特定的 prompt 模块，在不全量重训的情况下将冻结的排序骨干适配到不同排序准则。
Result: 在六个公共图、两个真实查询到条目基准（Yelp2018 和 MovieLens-100K）以及一个受控的五准则图访问研究中，PreGress 展示了强排名质量，并保持较低的任务特定状态开销。
Conclusion: 作者强调 PreGress 通过排序原生的预训练与轻量提示机制，可支持多种异构节点排序任务并避免针对每个任务的完整重训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dynamic Distribution-Aware Uncertainty Tracking in Vision-Language Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) aims to measure the reliability of model predictions, serving as a critical safeguard for deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in safety-critical scenarios. Post-hoc approaches are widely adopted due to their lightweight nature, mapping the outputs of VLMs to uncertainty measures through learnable modules or inductive summarization. However, Post-hoc approaches remain inherently confined to fitting the failure patterns of the source domain, ignoring the dynamic nature of test distributions. To address this challenge, we propose a Dynamic Distribution-Aware Uncertainty Quantification framework (DDA-UQ) that shifts the paradigm from static mapping to a dynamic distribution-aware process. During training, we leverage a Gaussian Mixture Model to model the VVLMs'embedding space and extract distributional evidence, thereby dynamically deriving uncertainty estimates. During inference, the design dynamically responds to changes in the data distribution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DDA-UQ（Dynamic Distribution-Aware Uncertainty Quantification）框架，用于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的不确定性量化。与静态的 post-hoc 映射不同，该方法在训练时用高斯混合模型（GMM）建模 VLM 的嵌入空间并提取分布证据，在推理时动态响应测试数据分布的变化。摘要称大量实验表明该方法显著优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有 post-hoc 不确定性量化方法本质上只能拟合源域中的失败模式，忽略测试分布是动态变化的，这在安全关键场景下限制了 VLM 可靠性度量的有效性。
Method: 提出 DDA-UQ 框架，将不确定性估计从静态映射转变为动态分布感知过程：训练阶段利用高斯混合模型（GMM）对 VLM 嵌入空间建模并提取分布证据以动态推导不确定性估计；推理阶段根据数据分布变化动态调整估计。
Result: 摘要报告在多个实验上该方法显著优于现有最先进方法（state-of-the-art），但未给出具体数据集或数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为将范式从静态映射转向动态分布感知过程可以应对测试分布的动态变化，从而改进 VLM 的不确定性量化。

papers.title: SignLlama: Enhancing Gloss-free Sign Language Translation by Prioritizing Visual Features for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success across a wide range of tasks. However, fine-tuning LLMs for Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation (GFSLT) remains a challenge. In this paper, we investigate how to effectively adapt LLMs to the GFSLT task. We show that there are two key issues that need to be solved: (1) the inherent distributional gap between visual feature inputs and text feature inputs makes it difficult for LLMs to interpret visual inputs; and (2) existing approaches typically concatenate visual and textual features in an autoregressive framework, which leads to the model overemphasizing textual inputs and deprioritizing visual cues, as LLMs are pretrained predominantly on text-centric data. To address the first challenge, we propose a simple yet effective method named Filtered Pseudo-Gloss CTC Pretraining, which leverages filtered pseudo-gloss sequences generated from text sequences to supervise the training of the visual backbone. To tackle the second issue, we introduce a Visual-Prioritized Distillation training strategy. Specifically, we define a visual-only prediction path in which text inputs are masked, and the model is required to generate the target sequence relying solely on visual inputs. To guide this path, the outputs from the standard visual-textual prediction are then distilled into the visual-only prediction path, encouraging the model to prioritize visual features. Comprehensive experiments and qualitative analyses demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model. The proposed SignLlama achieves very competitive performance on multiple datasets for GFSLT tasks, without using any extra modalities or external sign language datasets for pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SignLlama，一种面向无注释手语翻译 (Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation, GFSLT) 的 LLM 适配方法。作者指出两个关键问题：视觉特征与文本特征之间存在分布差距，以及现有自回归拼接方式使模型过度依赖文本而忽视视觉信息。为此提出 Filtered Pseudo-Gloss CTC Pretraining 与 Visual-Prioritized Distillation 两种策略，并在多个 GFSLT 数据集上取得有竞争力的性能，且无需额外模态或外部手语数据集。
Motivation: LLM 在手语翻译任务中难以直接理解视觉输入，主要因为视觉与文本特征分布不一致；同时现有方法在自回归框架中拼接视觉与文本特征，导致模型因预训练数据以文本为主而过度重视文本、轻视视觉线索。
Method: 提出 Filtered Pseudo-Gloss CTC Pretraining，利用从文本序列生成的过滤伪注释序列 (pseudo-gloss sequences) 监督视觉骨干训练；同时引入 Visual-Prioritized Distillation 训练策略，定义遮蔽文本输入的纯视觉预测路径，并将标准视觉-文本预测的输出蒸馏到该路径，以鼓励模型优先利用视觉特征。
Result: 综合实验与定性分析表明方法有效，SignLlama 在多个 GFSLT 数据集上取得非常有竞争力的性能，且未使用任何额外模态或外部手语数据集进行预训练。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过过滤伪注释预训练和面向视觉优先的蒸馏，可以有效解决 LLM 在手语翻译中对视觉特征利用不足的问题，并验证了该方法的泛化性。

papers.title: A Tight Lower Bound for Smooth Nonconvex Stochastic Optimization with Bounded Gradient Noise
papers.abstract_en: We prove a sharp lower bound for smooth nonconvex stochastic optimization with uniformly bounded gradient noise. In the \(K=1\) fresh-sample model, every randomized adaptive algorithm requires $$Ω\left( \frac{ΔL}{ε^2} + \frac{ΔLσ^2}{ε^4} \right)$$ queries to find a point with expected gradient norm at most \(ε\). This matches the standard upper bound and, to the best of our knowledge, resolves the question raised by [Arjevani et al. 2023] of whether almost-surely bounded oracle error permits a better rate than bounded variance. The proof was independently generated with GPT-5.6 Sol in Codex's Ultra mode during a two-hour session. The human author supplied the prompt and was responsible only forchecking the proof and revising and polishing the manuscript.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明光滑非凸随机优化在一致有界梯度噪声下的尖锐下界：在 K=1 的新样本模型（fresh-sample model）中，任何随机自适应算法都需要 Ω(ΔL/ε² + ΔLσ²/ε⁴) 次查询才能找到期望梯度范数不超过 ε 的点。该下界与标准上界匹配，并解决了 Arjevani et al. 2023 提出的开放问题，即几乎必然有界的 oracle 误差是否允许优于有界方差情形的速率。摘要还披露证明由 GPT-5.6 Sol 在 Codex Ultra 模式下于两小时会话中独立生成，人类作者仅提供提示并负责检查和润色。
Motivation: 平滑非凸随机优化中，噪声模型的选择（有界方差 vs 几乎必然有界）是否影响最优查询复杂度下界此前尚不明确，这是 Arjevani et al. 2023 提出的开放问题。
Method: 作者在 K=1 新样本模型下构造下界证明，对任意随机自适应算法给出 Ω(ΔL/ε² + ΔLσ²/ε⁴) 的查询复杂度下界；证明过程由语言模型自动生成，人工作者负责验证与修改。
Result: 得到与标准上界匹配的紧下界，表明几乎必然有界的梯度噪声并不能带来比有界方差更优的速率。
Conclusion: 该结果闭合了有界噪声假设下光滑非凸随机优化的复杂度刻画；此外，摘要明确披露证明由 AI 生成并经人工校验，这为理解其可靠性和可复现性提供了背景。

papers.title: Mind the Hook: Source-Level Auditing of Privacy Defenses in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Black-box privacy scores for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) are difficult to interpret unless the audited defense's active pipeline hook is known. We propose an active-path audit: inventory source-level hooks over retrieval, retrieved content, and generation; map each metric to the leakage channel it observes; and validate generated-text effects with exact-match canaries. In our benchmark reimplementations, the DP-style defenses modify retrieval scores only: their generation hooks are TODO-flagged stubs that return responses unchanged. This active path explains why they affect membership-inference behavior but track No-Defense on generated-text named-entity leakage, measured by NEL_strict. By contrast, the end-to-end LPRAG path is canary-validated on the email channel, recovering 53/150 canaries under No-Defense and 0/150 under LPRAG. These findings concern our reimplementations on our stack, not released defenses or defense families; the contribution is a methodology and case study, not a universal ranking
papers.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Accepted as a regular paper at the 25th IEEE International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对检索增强生成 (RAG) 隐私防御的黑盒隐私分数难以解释的问题，提出一种主动路径审计 (active-path audit) 方法：在检索、检索内容和生成三个阶段盘点源码级 hook，将每个指标映射到其观测的泄漏通道，并用精确匹配的 canary 验证生成文本效应。在作者对基准方法的复现中，DP 风格防御只修改检索分数，其生成 hook 是 TODO 标记的桩函数；相比之下，端到端 LPRAG 路径在邮箱通道上通过 canary 验证，No-Defense 下恢复 53/150 个 canary，LPRAG 下为 0/150。作者强调这些发现仅针对其代码栈上的复现实现，贡献在于方法论与案例研究而非防御家族间的普适排名。
Motivation: 黑盒隐私分数难以解释，除非知道被审计防御实际生效的流水线 hook 位于哪一环节；论文针对这一可解释性缺口提出审计方法。
Method: 提出主动路径审计：盘点检索、检索内容与生成三层的源码级 hook，将每个隐私指标映射到其观测的泄漏通道，并用精确匹配的 canary 验证生成文本中的实际泄漏效应。
Result: 在作者的基准复现中，DP 风格防御仅改变检索分数，生成 hook 为 TODO 桩函数，因此它们影响成员推断行为，但在生成文本命名实体泄漏指标 NEL_strict 上与 No-Defense 表现一致；LPRAG 在邮箱通道上通过 canary 验证，将恢复的 canary 数从 No-Defense 的 53/150 降至 0/150。
Conclusion: 论文强调其发现仅限于自身代码栈上的复现实现，不适用于已发布防御或防御家族；贡献是审计方法论和一个案例研究，而非对防御方法的普适排序。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DeepFreqMark: End-To-End Learnable Frequency-Domain Watermarking with Spherical Attack Simulation for Latent Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of AI-generated images produced by Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) has raised critical concerns regarding copyright infringement and misinformation. Although existing frequency-domain watermarking methods embed handcrafted geometric patterns into the initial latent noise prior to generation, they suffer from limited capacity and rigid pattern designs. We propose DeepFreqMark, an end-to-end learnable frequency-domain watermarking framework that replaces manual pattern engineering with a neural message encoder and decoder. To circumvent the computational bottleneck caused by Denoising Diffusion Implicit Model (DDIM) inversion during training, we introduce a Spherical Linear Interpolation (Slerp)-based attack simulation. This approach operates directly on the noise latent while strictly preserving the Gaussian variance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeepFreqMark achieves significantly lower Bit Error Rates (BER) than baseline methods under real-world attacks and scales to 256 bits message capacity. Our source code is available at https://github.com/chenhsiu48/DeepFreqMark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeepFreqMark，一个用于潜在扩散模型 (LDM) 的端到端可学习频域水印框架，用神经消息编码器和解码器替代手工艺几何图案嵌入。为解决训练中 DDIM 反演带来的计算瓶颈，作者引入基于球面线性插值 (Slerp) 的攻击模拟，直接在噪声潜变量上操作并严格保持高斯方差。实验表明其在真实攻击下取得显著更低的比特错误率 (BER)，并支持 256 bit 消息容量。
Motivation: LDM 生成的 AI 图像引发版权侵权和虚假信息问题；现有频域水印方法在生成前将手工几何图案嵌入初始潜噪声，存在容量有限和图案设计僵化的缺陷。
Method: 提出端到端可学习的频域水印框架 DeepFreqMark，包含神经消息编码器和解码器；引入基于 Slerp 的攻击模拟来绕过训练中 DDIM 反演的计算瓶颈，该方法直接作用于噪声潜变量并严格保持高斯方差。
Result: 大量实验表明，在真实世界攻击下 DeepFreqMark 的比特错误率 (BER) 显著低于基线方法，并且可扩展到 256 bit 消息容量。
Conclusion: 摘要认为可学习的频域水印方法能够取代手工图案工程，同时提升水印的鲁棒性与容量；作者并公开了源代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-agent discovery of practical quantum LDPC codes
papers.abstract_en: Quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes can encode multiple logical qubits using sparse parity checks, yet searching for useful finite-length instances remains a challenging design problem because code performance must be optimized while satisfying practical constraints. Motivated by recent advances in artificial-intelligence agents for scientific discovery, we develop a multi-agent framework for discovering practical qLDPC codes. The framework combines specialist proposal and review, persistent scientific memory, long-horizon evolution of executable programs, and deterministic construction and evaluation within a closed-loop search. These programs instantiate coset-orbit balanced-product codes, providing a search space that includes bicycle and lifted-product constructions as well as non-normal subgroup actions. To incorporate practical constraints, we restrict the search to binary CSS codes with block length $n\leq400$ and overall weight $w\leq10$. Within this regime, the framework discovers codes with leading or competitive rate--distance performance in every weight class considered, with representative instances including $[[288,16,18]]$ at $w=7$, $[[288,18,18]]$ at $w=9$, and $[[234,28,18]]$ at $w=10$. The search also uncovers structurally distinct, high-performing constructions, including a $[[336,12,\leq24]]$ candidate and a $[[368,18,16]]$ code, both of which are genuine balanced-product constructions with non-normal subgroup actions. When evaluated under code-capacity depolarizing noise using a common BP-OSD decoding protocol, the discovered codes also exhibit low logical failure rates. Together, these results provide hardware-relevant finite-length candidates for further experimental evaluation and show how structured agentic search can contribute to scientific discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多智能体 (multi-agent) 框架用于发现实用的量子 LDPC (qLDPC) 码，结合专家提议与审查、持久科学记忆、长时程程序演化以及闭环搜索中的确定性构造与评估。程序实例化 coset-orbit balanced-product codes，搜索空间覆盖 bicycle、lifted-product 以及非正规子群作用，并限制在块长 n≤400、权重 w≤10 的二元 CSS 码范围内。摘要报告发现了多个领先或竞争性的码，包括 [[288,16,18]]、[[288,18,18]] 和 [[234,28,18]] 等实例，并在 BP-OSD 解码下表现出低逻辑故障率。
Motivation: qLDPC 码能用稀疏校验编码多个逻辑量子比特，但寻找满足实际约束且性能良好的有限长实例仍然困难，因为需要在多个实际条件下同时优化码性能。
Method: 开发多智能体搜索框架，包含专家提议与评审、持久科学记忆、可执行程序的长时程演化，以及确定性构造与评估。搜索空间由 coset-orbit balanced-product codes 实例化，涵盖 bicycle、lifted-product 和非正规子群作用，并将搜索限制为二元 CSS 码、块长 n≤400、整体权重 w≤10。
Result: 框架在每个考虑的权重类别中都发现了领先或具有竞争力的 rate–distance 性能码，代表实例有 w=7 的 [[288,16,18]]、w=9 的 [[288,18,18]] 和 w=10 的 [[234,28,18]]。还发现结构上不同且高性能的构造，包括 [[336,12,≤24]] 候选码和 [[368,18,16]] 码，两者都是具有非正规子群作用的真实 balanced-product 构造；在码容量去极化噪声下用 BP-OSD 解码时，这些码表现出低逻辑故障率。
Conclusion: 这些结果提供了面向硬件的有限长候选码，可供进一步实验评估，并展示了结构化智能体搜索对科学发现的贡献。

papers.title: Guardian Crawler: Retrieval-First Knowledge Discovery with Bounded LLM Augmentation for Noisy Web Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Retrieving relevant evidence from noisy web data is challenging, particularly in sensitive domains containing incomplete reports, heterogeneous language, and irrelevant content. We present Guardian Crawler, a reproducible retrieval-first testbed for controlled experiments on knowledge discovery and evidence-grounded summarization over synthetic web-like corpora. The architecture combines BM25 retrieval with risk-aware, embedding-augmented, and hybrid reranking, followed by constrained retrieval-augmented generation with explicit document citations. Experiments on a synthetic 900-document corpus and 10 queries produced the highest descriptive retrieval scores under risk-based reranking, with P@10 = 1.00 and NDCG@10 = 0.94, compared with 0.94 and 0.81 for BM25. The best hybrid and BM25+Semantic configurations reached NDCG@10 values of 0.94 and 0.88, respectively. All 41 evaluable generated bullets passed the lexical coverage threshold; an automated LLM judge classified 36 as supported, one as partially supported, and four as unsupported. These results demonstrate the feasibility of Guardian Crawler as a controlled testbed but do not establish statistical superiority, human-validated faithfulness, or transfer to live-web investigative environments.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Accepted as a Short Paper at KDIR 2026 (International Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Information Retrieval)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Guardian Crawler，一个可复现的 retrieval-first 测试平台，用于在合成网页风格语料上进行受控的知识发现与基于证据的摘要实验。系统结合 BM25 检索与风险感知、嵌入增强及混合重排序，并配合带显式引文的受限检索增强生成 (RAG)。在 900 篇文档与 10 个查询的合成语料上，风险感知重排序取得 P@10=1.00、NDCG@10=0.94，优于 BM25 的 0.94 与 0.81；作者明确表示该结果只证明其作为受控测试平台的可行性。
Motivation: 从含噪网页数据中检索相关证据具有挑战性，尤其是在包含不完整报告、异构语言和无关内容的敏感领域，现有方法难以在受控条件下进行可复现的对比实验。
Method: 构建 retrieval-first 测试平台 Guardian Crawler，以 BM25 为基线，加入风险感知、嵌入增强和混合重排序策略，并采用带显式文档引文的受限 RAG 生成；实验基于合成网页风格语料。
Result: 在 900 篇文档、10 个查询的实验中，风险感知重排序取得最高描述性检索分数 P@10=1.00、NDCG@10=0.94，而 BM25 为 0.94/0.81；最佳混合配置与 BM25+Semantic 配置的 NDCG@10 分别为 0.94 与 0.88。41 条可评估生成要点全部通过词汇覆盖阈值，自动 LLM 判定其中 36 条受支持、1 条部分支持、4 条不受支持。
Conclusion: 作者强调结果仅表明 Guardian Crawler 作为受控测试平台的可行性，未确立统计显著性、经人工验证的忠实性，也未证明能迁移到真实网络调查环境。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Far Do Foundation Models Transfer to Infant Signals? A Cross-Dataset Transfer Audit with a Unified Need Ontology
papers.abstract_en: Public infant cry corpora are small, label-incompatible, and almost always evaluated one corpus at a time. We ask what this practice hides and what fixes it. Across four cry corpora screened by a multi-level leakage audit (byte-level and embedding-level deduplication plus a within-corpus train-test near-duplicate audit), we probe four frozen encoders and a handcrafted baseline under a unified five-class need ontology and shared task formulations. The audit exposes what single-corpus evaluation conceals: within-domain macro-F1 swings by 0.57-0.80 for the same encoder, cross-corpus transfer is negative on average (negative-transfer ratio 0.19-0.35, significant in 18 of 30 directed cells, BH-FDR), and 349 content-identical clip groups carry conflicting metadata labels across corpus distributions. The same audit, however, reveals a consistent way forward. Transfer into the noisiest corpus is consistently positive in effect size at matched training size and after near-duplicate removal, offering a practical recipe for small, noisy corpora. Frozen probes saturate at modest label budgets, while stabilized fine-tuning wins with full labels; domain-adaptive pretraining significantly beats stabilized fine-tuning at 5-10-shot (the 1-shot advantage is not robust to optimization-seed variance) but shows no significant advantage at 50-shot or beyond. In the tested binary, shared-label settings, ontology-mapped joint training wins in all four encoder-by-target combinations, whereas naively merging unmapped labels costs up to 37 F1 points. We release the ontology, mapping code, and audit pipeline, turning incompatible cry corpora into a usable joint-training resource.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 7 figures. Under review at AAAI 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对四个婴儿哭声语料库做跨数据集迁移审计，构建统一五类需求本体 (need ontology) 与共享任务设定，并引入多层泄漏审计（字节级与嵌入级去重、语料内训练-测试近重复检查）。研究发现单语料评测会掩盖问题：同一编码器的域内 macro-F1 波动达 0.57-0.80，跨语料迁移平均为负（负迁移比率 0.19-0.35），且 349 组内容相同的片段带有冲突的元数据标签。作者同时给出可行方案：向噪声最大的语料迁移在匹配训练规模并去除近重复后始终为正；在 5-10 shot 下域自适应预训练显著优于稳定微调，而本体映射的联合训练在所有四个编码器-目标组合上均胜出。
Motivation: 公开婴儿哭声语料库规模小、标签体系不兼容，且几乎总是逐个语料独立评测，这掩盖了跨语料迁移的真实表现。本文旨在揭示这种单语料评测隐藏的问题，并寻找能把这些不兼容语料变成可用联合训练资源的修复方法。
Method: 作者提出一套审计与训练流程：先对四个哭声语料库执行多层泄漏审计（字节级和嵌入级去重，加上语料内训练-测试近重复审计），再在统一五类需求本体和共享任务设定下评测四个冻结编码器 (frozen encoder) 与一个人工特征基线。训练端比较了 frozen probe、稳定微调、域自适应预训练 (domain-adaptive pretraining) 以及基于本体映射的联合训练。
Result: 审计显示同一编码器的域内 macro-F1 波动 0.57-0.80，跨语料迁移平均为负（负迁移比率 0.19-0.35，30 个有向单元中 18 个显著，BH-FDR 校正），且 349 组内容相同片段标签相互冲突。在匹配训练规模并去除近重复后，向最嘈杂语料的迁移效应量一致为正；域自适应预训练在 5-10 shot 时显著优于稳定微调（1-shot 优势对优化种子不稳定），50-shot 及以上无显著优势。在二分类共享标签设定下，本体映射联合训练在所有四个编码器-目标组合上均胜出，而朴素合并未映射标签最多损失 37 个 F1 点。
Conclusion: 作者强调多层级泄漏审计与统一本体能把不兼容的哭声语料转化为可用的联合训练资源，并释放了本体、映射代码和审计管线。适用边界被限定在所测试的婴儿信号分类任务与共享标签设定上。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SoftMCC: An MCC-Brier Calibration Bridge for Threshold-Free Model Selection under Class Imbalance
papers.abstract_en: Model selection for imbalanced binary classification often uses the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), but thresholding makes validation rankings threshold-dependent. SoftMCC is a post-training MCC validation framework on established probability-valued confusion counts, coupling an MCC-specific calibrated identity with a tie-aware, shared-pool selection protocol. Its core score is a covariance-normalized probability-label association, reduces exactly to MCC for hard predictions, and is Pearson-bounded. Under perfect population calibration it equals the Brier skill score with identical candidate ordering; outside that regime the gap does not identify calibration error. Across 18 settings with 12 duplicate-safe grouped repeats, SoftMCC attains the best stability mean rank (2.31) and highest mean tie-corrected Kendall's W (0.659), with a significant Friedman test (p=0.007); Nemenyi analysis separates it from AUPRC and MCC@0.5, while 14-source-family sensitivity retains only the latter. Selected-model utility shows no advantage. Three of six prespecified comparisons have negative mean test-MCC differences, only F1@best survives Holm correction (p=0.014), and the dataset-level test is not significant (p=0.117). Label permutation lowers mean W to 0.092; temperature scaling shifts SoftMCC rankings (mean Spearman 0.851) whereas rank-based and threshold-optimized metrics remain invariant. SoftMCC is a calibration-sensitive MCC-family selector with bounded stability and utility evidence.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to the Journal of Machine Learning Research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SoftMCC，一个面向类别不平衡二分类的后训练模型选择框架，在概率值混淆计数（probability-valued confusion counts）上构造协方差归一化的概率-标签关联得分，并耦合 MCC 特定校准恒等式与平局感知的共享池选择协议。该得分对硬预测精确退化为 MCC，且受 Pearson 界约束。在 18 个设置、12 次去重分组重复实验中，SoftMCC 取得最佳稳定性平均秩 (2.31) 和最高平均 tie-corrected Kendall's W (0.659)，Friedman 检验显著 (p=0.007)；但选定模型的效用无优势，且数据集级效用检验不显著 (p=0.117)。
Motivation: 不平衡二分类的模型选择常使用 MCC，但阈值化使验证排名依赖阈值，导致验证排序不稳定；需要阈值无关且对校准敏感的选择指标来缓解这一问题。
Method: 提出 SoftMCC 后训练验证框架：在概率值混淆计数上定义协方差归一化的概率-标签关联得分，与 MCC 特定校准恒等式耦合，并采用平局感知、共享池（tie-aware, shared-pool）的选择协议；对硬预测精确简化为 MCC，得分受 Pearson 界约束。
Result: 在 18 个设置、12 次去重分组重复中，SoftMCC 取得最佳稳定性平均秩 (2.31) 和最高平均 tie-corrected Kendall's W (0.659)，Friedman 检验 p=0.007；Nemenyi 分析将其与 AUPRC 和 MCC@0.5 区分，14-source-family 敏感性只保留与后者的差异。但六个预指定比较中有三个平均 test-MCC 差值为负，仅 F1@best 通过 Holm 校正 (p=0.014)，数据集级检验不显著 (p=0.117)。标签置换将平均 W 降至 0.092；温度缩放改变 SoftMCC 排序（平均 Spearman 0.851），而基于秩和阈值优化的指标保持不变。
Conclusion: 作者将 SoftMCC 定性为对校准敏感的 MCC 族选择器，其稳定性与效用证据均有界；在完全总体校准（perfect population calibration）下它等价于 Brier skill score 且候选排序一致，在该条件之外两者差异不能识别校准误差。

papers.title: Twin Rollouts: Noise-Coupled Counterfactual Branching in Interactive Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Interactive video world models generate rollouts autoregressively under an action stream, yet they are trained and evaluated almost exclusively on factual prediction. We study counterfactual generation inside the rollout: given a trajectory the model has itself generated, what would have happened had the actions differed from step t* onward? We formalize noise-coupled twin rollouts --- a factual and a counterfactual branch sharing the generated prefix and the future exogenous noise sequence, diverging only in the action stream at an intervention point. Because the factual branch is self-generated, its exogenous noise is known exactly: the abduction step of Pearl's counterfactual procedure is exact by construction, sidestepping the approximate-inversion problem faced by editing-based pipelines. Noise coupling further turns the minimal-change principle into a per-sample verifiable property: we define a spatiotemporal locality metric that penalizes divergence outside the causal descendants of the intervention, computable against simulator ground truth without a learned judge. Forking the simulator state at t* yields ground-truth counterfactual re-renders, which we use as verifiable rewards for post-training. This note establishes the formal framework, metric definitions, and positioning; experiments are forthcoming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究交互式视频世界模型（interactive video world models）在 rollout 过程中的反事实生成问题，提出噪声耦合双 rollout（noise-coupled twin rollouts）框架：事实分支与反事实分支共享已生成前缀和未来外生噪声序列，仅从干预点 t* 起改变动作流。由于事实分支是模型自生成的，其外生噪声精确已知，使得 Pearl 反事实程序中的 abduction 步骤构造成立，绕过了编辑式管线面临的近似反演问题。作者进一步定义时空局部性度量来惩罚干预因果后代之外的发散，并用模拟器 ground truth 反事实重渲染作为可验证奖励进行 post-training。摘要明确表示实验尚待进行。
Motivation: 现有交互式视频世界模型几乎只在事实预测上训练和评估，缺乏对反事实生成的研究。编辑式反事实管线需要近似反演外生噪声，且最小变更原则难以逐样本验证，这是该文试图填补的空白。
Method: 形式化噪声耦合双 rollout：事实与反事实分支共享生成前缀及未来外生噪声序列，仅在干预点后分叉动作流。利用自生成轨迹的噪声精确可知性，使 abduction 步骤成为构造成精确的操作；定义时空局部性度量惩罚干预因果后代之外的发散，并 fork 模拟器状态获得 ground-truth 反事实重渲染作为可验证奖励，用于 post-training。
Result: 论文未报告实验结果；摘要仅说明建立了形式框架、度量定义和定位，实验尚待进行。
Conclusion: 作者将该文定位为建立可验证反事实生成框架的理论性说明，声称噪声耦合使最小变更原则成为逐样本可验证性质，并能与模拟器 ground truth 结合作为训练奖励；具体效果留待后续实验验证。

papers.title: Detecting Clear Contact Lenses for Iris Recognition: A Two-Stage Mask-Guided Attention Approach
papers.abstract_en: This work focuses on the impact and detection of clear contact lenses in the context of iris recognition. While the detection of cosmetic or patterned contact lenses has been extensively studied under the presentation attack detection (PAD) paradigm, clear prescription contact lenses, that are typically transparent, have received comparatively less attention despite their widespread use. Unlike patterned lenses, clear lenses introduce no salient texture artifact, making them difficult to detect and are often assumed to have no impact on iris recognition. We first examine this assumption using the commercial VeriEye matcher on four benchmark datasets and show that clear lenses marginally degrade genuine match scores and increase verification error. We then propose a two-stage contact-lens detection framework. Stage~1 uses an existing PAD model to identify patterned lenses, while Stage~2 focuses on the more challenging clear-lens versus no-lens distinction using a ConvNeXt-Base model equipped with Mask-Guided Spatial Attention (MGSA). The proposed MGSA module incorporates a Hough-derived anatomical ROI mask together with learned spatial attention and Squeeze-and-Excitation channel recalibration, allowing the network to focus on subtle limbal cues associated with clear lens wear. Across four datasets, the full pipeline consisting of both patterned and clear contact lens detection achieves between 90.0\%--98.8\% accuracy. Finally, we introduce a z-score calibration method that adjusts VeriEye match scores when a clear lens is detected in the input images. This calibration reduces EER by 4.1\%--28.3\% across datasets, demonstrating that reliable clear contact lens detection can directly improve iris verification performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究透明隐形眼镜（clear contact lenses）对虹膜识别的影响及其检测问题。作者先用商业 VeriEye 匹配器在四个基准数据集上验证：透明镜片会轻微降低真实匹配分数并增大验证错误，随后提出两阶段检测框架。第二阶段使用带 Hough 推导 ROI 掩码引导空间注意力（MGSA）的 ConvNeXt-Base 模型区分透明镜片与无镜片，完整管线在四个数据集上取得 90.0%–98.8% 的准确率；进一步提出的 z-score 校准方法可将 EER 降低 4.1%–28.3%。
Motivation: 带图案或美瞳镜片的检测已在呈现攻击检测（PAD）范式下被广泛研究，但广泛使用的透明处方隐形眼镜因不引入明显纹理伪影而很少被关注，且常被假设对虹膜识别没有影响。作者先检验该假设并发现透明镜片会轻微损害匹配分数并增加验证错误，说明需要专门的检测手段。
Method: 提出两阶段接触镜检测框架：阶段 1 复用现有 PAD 模型识别花纹镜片；阶段 2 针对更难的透明镜片与无镜片判别，使用配备 Mask-Guided Spatial Attention (MGSA) 的 ConvNeXt-Base 模型。MGSA 模块将 Hough 变换得到的解剖 ROI 掩码与学习到的空间注意力及 Squeeze-and-Excitation 通道重标定结合，使网络关注与透明镜片佩戴相关的细腻角膜缘线索；另提出 z-score 校准方法，在检测到透明镜片时调整 VeriEye 匹配分数。
Result: 在四个数据集上，包含花纹与透明镜片检测的完整管线达到 90.0%–98.8% 的准确率；z-score 校准将不同数据集上的 EER 降低 4.1%–28.3%。VeriEye 实验同时显示透明镜片会轻微降低真实匹配分数并增大验证错误。
Conclusion: 作者认为可靠的透明隐形眼镜检测可直接提升虹膜验证性能，并演示了结合检测结果进行匹配分数校准的收益。摘要未给出具体数据集名称与更多部署细节，结论以虹膜识别任务为边界。
