papers.title: Label-Free Parkinson's Disease Screening from Face and Voice through Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Parkinson's disease (PD) is the second most common neurodegenerative disorder. Typical machine learning screening methods require PD labels, but the available data is limited by privacy concerns and the need for expert annotation. We propose a label-free face-plus-voice PD screen built entirely on frozen pretrained encoders--a face-expression Vision Transformer and HuBERT--in which no PD label touches any fit; the reference is training controls only. The voice modality uses a synthetic-dysarthria contrastive activation addition (CAA) direction built from time-stretch and breathy degradation of healthy speech; the face modality uses a k-nearest-neighbor anomaly score to the control embedding cluster. We introduce the alignment principle, a post-hoc analysis showing that a synthetic-degradation CAA detector works when the cosine similarity between the synthetic and real disease directions exceeds zero. Measured on the YouTubePD benchmark, this cosine is +0.37 for voice (CAA works, AUROC 0.765) and -0.48 for face (CAA fails; anomaly succeeds, AUROC 0.751). Equal-weight late fusion reaches AUROC 0.802 (95% CI [0.70,0.89]) with NPV 0.95, supporting a rule-out triage interpretation. An overfitting audit shows the voice detector transfers cleanly, while the face-side--and thus fused--AUROC is potentially optimistic pending external validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种完全无标签的帕金森病 (PD) 筛查方法，仅基于冻结的预训练编码器（人脸表情 Vision Transformer 与 HuBERT），在整个拟合过程中不使用任何 PD 标签，仅以健康对照作为参考。语音模态使用健康语音的时间拉伸和气息退化构造合成构音障碍对比激活加性 (CAA) 方向，人脸模态使用到对照嵌入簇的 k 近邻异常分数，并引入对齐原则 (alignment principle) 作为事后分析。在 YouTubePD 基准上，语音 CAA 方向与真实疾病方向的余弦相似度为 +0.37，AUROC 0.765；人脸为 -0.48，其中异常检测有效，AUROC 0.751；等权晚期融合达到 AUROC 0.802，NPV 0.95。
Motivation: 典型机器学习 PD 筛查依赖疾病标签，但可用数据因隐私问题和专家标注需求而受限，因此需要一种不接触 PD 标签的筛查方案。
Method: 提出完全基于冻结预训练编码器的标签无关人脸加语音筛查框架：语音侧通过时间拉伸和气息退化生成合成构音障碍 CAA 方向，人脸侧使用对对照嵌入簇的 kNN 异常分数；并提出对齐原则，即当合成退化方向与真实疾病方向的余弦相似度大于零时，合成退化 CAA 检测器有效。
Result: 在 YouTubePD 上，语音 CAA 的余弦相似度为 +0.37（AUROC 0.765），人脸 CAA 为 -0.48 因而失败，改用异常检测后 AUROC 为 0.751；等权晚期融合达到 AUROC 0.802（95% CI [0.70, 0.89]）和 NPV 0.95。过拟合审计显示语音检测器可干净迁移，而人脸侧及融合 AUROC 可能偏乐观，有待外部验证。
Conclusion: 摘要支持将该融合筛查解释为排除式分诊 (rule-out triage) 工具，并强调人脸侧及融合结果的 AUROC 可能因过拟合而乐观，需外部验证。

papers.title: How Can Rhetoric Reward-Hack AI Reviewers? Dissecting Rhetorical Sensitivity in AI-Based Peer Review
papers.abstract_en: As large language models increasingly participate in scientific evaluation, we investigate a potential form of reward hacking: how rhetorical choices shape AI-review judgments when reported scientific content is preserved and how these effects vary across evaluation conditions. We construct a controlled corpus of 4,200 full-paper manuscripts derived from 120 anonymized ICLR 2026 submissions. Two LLM rewriters transform six rhetorical dimensions in opposing directions, and five LLM reviewers evaluate the resulting manuscripts under standard and strict protocols. We also test joint, recursive, and reviewer-guided rewriting. Our results show that rhetorical sensitivity is structured rather than uniform. Evidence framing and novelty stance produce the largest positive-negative contrasts in overall assessment, with scope framing forming a weaker second tier; the remaining dimensions have smaller or less stable effects. This hierarchy persists across human-assessed quality levels, but score movement depends strongly on the AI reviewer's original score: lower scores tend to rise, higher scores tend to fall, and directional contrasts are clearest in the middle ranges. More elaborate workflows do not reliably yield larger gains. Joint rewriting is strongly rewriter-dependent, reviewer guidance does not consistently outperform an unguided second pass, and repeated rewriting yields diminishing, configuration-dependent returns. Across conditions, the rewriter primarily determines the separation between opposing variants, whereas the reviewer determines the magnitude and sign of their score effects. Strict review lowers mean OA by 1.36 points without consistently changing rhetorical sensitivity. These findings identify when rhetorical presentation influences AI scientific review and motivate evaluation systems robust to content-preserving variation in scientific writing.

TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型审稿人面对保持科学内容不变的修辞变化时，其评分是否会受到奖励黑客式操纵。作者基于 120 篇匿名 ICLR 2026 投稿构建 4200 篇全稿受控语料，用两个 LLM 重写器沿六个修辞维度朝相反方向改写，再由五个 LLM 审稿人在标准与严格两种协议下评估。结果显示修辞敏感性是结构化的：证据框架和新颖性立场的正负对比最大，范围框架次之，其余维度效应较小或更不稳定；分数变化强烈依赖审稿人的原始评分，低分倾向上升、高分倾向下降，中间分数区间方向性对比最清晰。更复杂的重写流程并不稳定地带来更大增益，且严格审稿将平均总体评估分数降低 1.36 点但不改变修辞敏感性的整体格局。
Motivation: 大语言模型日益参与科学评估，但修辞选择可能在不改变报告内容的情况下影响 AI 审稿判断，这构成一种奖励黑客风险。论文试图系统量化修辞敏感性的存在、结构及其在不同评估条件下的变化。
Method: 构造受控语料库，从 120 篇匿名 ICLR 2026 投稿扩展出 4200 篇完整手稿；两个 LLM 重写器沿六个修辞维度朝相反方向改写，五个 LLM 审稿人在标准与严格协议下评估，并额外测试联合重写、递归重写和审稿人引导的重写。
Result: 证据框架与新颖性立场产生最大的总体评估正负对比，范围框架次之，其余维度效应更小或更不稳定；分数移动方向取决于审稿人原始分数，较低分数上升、较高分数下降，中间范围最清晰。联合重写高度依赖重写器，审稿人引导并不一致地优于无引导的第二遍重写，重复重写收益递减；严格审稿使平均 OA 降低 1.36 点但未一致改变修辞敏感性。
Conclusion: 研究定位了修辞呈现在哪些情况下会影响 AI 科学评审，并提出应构建对科学写作中保持内容不变的变体具有鲁棒性的评估系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GALA: Graph-Augmented LLM Agents for Root Cause Analysis and Incident Response in Microservices
papers.abstract_en: Microservice root cause analysis (RCA) requires correlating failures across heterogeneous telemetry within complex service dependency graphs. Existing methods often rely on a single telemetry modality; recent LLM-based approaches can suffer from unconstrained exploration and hallucination; and most systems stop at fault ranking without producing actionable incident response. We present GALA+, a graph-augmented LLM agentic framework centered on graph-guided investigation, which uses service dependencies to bound exploration and refine diagnosis through localized multi-modal evidence. For initial hypothesis generation, GALA+ combines complementary telemetry signals with STRIX, a novel trace- and graph-structure-aware scoring module. GALA+ then produces ranked diagnoses, incident summaries, and stratified action recommendations. We further introduce SURE-Score, a human-guided evaluation framework co-developed with industry SRE experts for assessing RCA-specific output quality beyond conventional text similarity metrics. On two microservice benchmarks, GALA+ consistently achieves the strongest overall results, surpassing the best LLM-based baseline by more than 25 percentage points in AC@1, while also receiving the highest ratings from both SURE-Score and independent human SRE evaluation.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE '26), October 12--16, 2026, Munich, Germany
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GALA+，一个面向微服务根因分析 (RCA) 的图增强 LLM 智能体框架。它利用服务依赖图约束探索并引导诊断，结合异构遥测信号与 STRIX 打分模块生成初始假设，最终输出排序后的诊断、事件摘要和分层行动建议。在两个微服务基准上，GALA+ 的 AC@1 比最强的 LLM 基线高 25 个百分点以上，并同时获得 SURE-Score 与独立人类 SRE 评估的最高评分。
Motivation: 微服务 RCA 需要在复杂服务依赖图中关联异构遥测；现有方法多依赖单一监控模态，基于 LLM 的方法存在无约束探索与幻觉问题，且大多数系统止步于故障排序，无法提供可执行的 incident response。
Method: 提出图引导调查的 agentic 框架，用服务依赖关系约束探索，并通过局部多模态证据精炼诊断；初始假设生成阶段结合互补遥测信号与 STRIX（一种 trace 与图结构感知的打分模块）。同时引入 SURE-Score，一个与行业 SRE 专家共同开发的人类引导评估框架，用于衡量 RCA 输出的专门质量。
Result: 在两个微服务基准上，GALA+ 取得最强综合结果，AC@1 比最佳 LLM 基线提高超过 25 个百分点，并在 SURE-Score 与独立人类 SRE 评估中获得最高评分。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将图引导的探索与多模态证据相结合，既能提升 RCA 诊断质量，也能产出可操作的事件响应；SURE-Score 提供了超越常规文本相似度指标的 RCA 质量评估手段。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoRe-UIE: Rethinking Coexisting and Region-wise Degradation for Underwater Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Underwater images often suffer from diverse and coexisting degradations, including color distortion, scattering haze, texture attenuation, and uneven illumination. These degradations vary across regions and may coexist locally, making conventional uniform restoration difficult to adapt to different degradation patterns. To address this problem, we propose Coexisting and Region-wise Degradation for Underwater Image Enhancement (\textbf{CoRe-UIE}), a degradation-oriented expert collaboration framework. CoRe-UIE combines a content-preserving shared expert with four shared-backbone routed experts for color correction, scattering suppression, texture recovery, and illumination protection. The routed experts share the same architecture but have independent parameters, and are assigned to different regions through input-derived degradation cues and region-adaptive Top-\(k\) routing. We further introduce a Hilbert--Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC)-based representation constraint to reduce statistical dependence among expert features and alleviate redundant expert responses. Experiments on UIEB, LSUI, and U45 demonstrate that CoRe-UIE achieves competitive quantitative performance and visually balanced enhancement under diverse underwater degradation conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoRe-UIE，一个面向水下图像增强的退化导向专家协作框架，针对水下图像中颜色失真、散射雾、纹理衰减和光照不均等多类退化共存且随区域变化的问题。框架由一个内容保持共享专家和四个共享主干路由专家组成，通过输入退化线索和区域自适应 Top-k 路由分配专家，并引入基于 HSIC 的表示约束降低专家特征统计依赖。在 UIEB、LSUI 和 U45 数据集上取得有竞争力的定量结果和视觉上更均衡的增强效果。
Motivation: 水下图像退化多样且在局部区域共存，传统统一恢复方法难以适配不同退化模式，需要能根据区域退化线索动态分配处理能力的方法。
Method: 提出退化导向专家协作框架 CoRe-UIE：内容保持共享专家加四个共享主干路由专家，分别负责颜色校正、散射抑制、纹理恢复和光照保护；通过输入退化线索与区域自适应 Top-k 路由分配专家，并用 Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) 约束减少专家特征统计依赖、缓解冗余响应。
Result: 在 UIEB、LSUI 和 U45 数据集上，CoRe-UIE 达到有竞争力的定量性能，并在多样水下退化条件下呈现视觉上均衡的增强效果。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该框架能够同时处理局部共存的多类水下退化，实现定量性能与视觉效果的平衡增强。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MASS: Multiplayer World Models with Authoritative Shared State
papers.abstract_en: Current video world models struggle in multiplayer environments because they entangle world state with view-dependent visual latents, leading to redundant compute, view inconsistencies, and poor scalability. We propose MASS (Multiplayer world models with Authoritative Shared State) to resolve this limitation. Inspired by multiplayer game architectures, MASS disentangles world dynamics and view rendering. A learned Logic Engine advances a global, authoritative typed state from joint actions without any hand-written transition function, acting as the sole recurrent memory and synchronization reference. From this shared state, a learned Rendering Engine generates independent and consistent views for any requested camera on demand. This explicit disentangling allows MASS to achieve superior state accuracy and lower cross-view inconsistency compared to state-of-the-art multi-view baselines on a matched multiplayer Snake benchmark. It advances predicted worlds with 1,024 concurrent players for 10,000 recurrent steps. Our results show that explicit, authoritative state modeling provides a practical foundation for scalable and consistent multi-agent world simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MASS（Multiplayer world models with Authoritative Shared State），受多人游戏架构启发，将世界动态建模与视图渲染解耦。学习得到的 Logic Engine 在没有手写转移函数的情况下，从联合动作推进全局、权威的 typed state，并作为唯一的循环记忆与同步参考；Rendering Engine 则按需为任意相机生成独立且一致的视图。在匹配的多人 Snake 基准上，MASS 相比多视图基线在状态准确性和跨视角一致性上更优，并能以 1,024 个并发玩家推进 10,000 步递归预测。
Motivation: 当前视频世界模型在多人环境中将世界状态与视角相关的视觉隐变量纠缠在一起，导致计算冗余、视角不一致和可扩展性差，难以支持多智能体场景。
Method: MASS 明确解耦世界动力学与视图渲染：Logic Engine 学习从联合动作推进全局权威 typed state，不依赖手写转移函数；Rendering Engine 基于共享状态按需生成任意相机的独立一致视图。
Result: 在匹配的多人 Snake 基准上，MASS 相比最先进的多视图基线实现了更高的状态准确性和更低的跨视角不一致性，并支持 1,024 个并发玩家、10,000 步递归预测。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式、权威的状态建模为可扩展且一致的多智能体世界模拟提供了实用基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Toward Deployable Bangla Sign Language Recognition with Expert-Validated Data and a Lightweight Attention-Based Model
papers.abstract_en: Deaf and hard-of-hearing people in Bangladesh communicate mainly through Bangla Sign Language (BdSL). Automatic BdSL recognition on personal devices could widen access to education and services. Existing systems use controlled-setting datasets without expert verification and heavyweight pretrained backbones unsuited to on-device use. We introduce RSBdSL38, 10,874 expert-validated images spanning all 38 BdSL hand signs, representing the 51 letters of the Bangla alphabet, recorded from real signers at three special-needs schools across Bangladesh. We propose a lightweight attention based convolutional network of 298,470 parameters, built from grouped bottleneck residual blocks, channel and spatial attention, a multi-scale depthwise hand-feature block, dual pooling, and Swish activations. Trained from scratch, it attains 96.37% accuracy (95.72% +- 0.54% over five seeds), within 1.08 percentage points of the best of nine ImageNet-pretrained efficient architectures under an identical protocol, using 8.5 to 68x fewer parameters and 1.3 to 21.7x fewer MACs. Retrained, it reaches 92.95 to 98.33% on six public BdSL benchmarks, 97.04% on a merged corpus, and 76.25% zero-shot on BdSL-38. Removing any architectural stage costs 7.61 to 89.30 points, against at most 3.17 for the training recipe. Grad-CAM with deletion-insertion and weight-randomization checks confirms that predictions follow the signing hand. A signer-independent split holding out 6 of 36 signers yields 85.18%. Quantized to 0.48 MB, it runs at 3.98 ms per image within a 15.5 MB footprint on a commodity smartphone. Together, RSBdSL38 and our from-scratch model turn benchmark accuracy into deployable accessibility at a fraction of pretrained-backbone cost; dataset, code, and models are released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RSBdSL38，一个包含 10,874 张专家验证图像的孟加拉手语（BdSL）数据集，覆盖全部 38 个手语手势，对应孟加拉字母表的 51 个字母，数据来自孟加拉三所特殊教育学校的真实手语使用者。作者同时设计了一个仅 298,470 参数的轻量级注意力卷积网络，从零训练达到 96.37% 准确率，并在多个公开 BdSL 基准上表现良好；量化后模型仅 0.48 MB，在普通智能手机上以 15.5 MB 占用实现每张图 3.98 ms 的推理。
Motivation: 孟加拉听障人群主要使用孟加拉手语（BdSL），在个人设备上自动识别 BdSL 可改善教育与服务可及性；现有系统使用未经专家验证的受控场景数据集，并依赖不适合端侧部署的重型预训练骨干网络。
Method: 构建专家验证的 RSBdSL38 数据集，并提出一个从零训练的轻量级注意力卷积网络，包含分组瓶颈残差块（grouped bottleneck residual blocks）、通道与空间注意力、多尺度深度可分离手部特征块（multi-scale depthwise hand-feature block）、双池化（dual pooling）和 Swish 激活函数。

papers.title: Poli-Bias: Understanding and Measuring Large Language Model Biases in International Political Conflicts
papers.abstract_en: Measuring political bias in large language models (LLMs) remains challenging as it can manifest through subtle differences in framing, argumentation, and legal reasoning that are difficult to capture with a single metric. In this work, we introduce Poli-Bias, a counterfactual framework for measuring whether LLMs treat legally equivalent conflict scenarios differently depending on the countries involved. Poli-Bias compares responses to paired prompts in which country identities are systematically swapped across diverse geopolitical relationships, legal violations, and reasoning tasks. Rather than reducing bias to a single judgment, our framework decomposes response disparities into five interpretable dimensions, revealing how and where unequal treatment manifests. Across 13 contemporary LLMs spanning diverse model families and sizes, we find that country identities and user affiliations can systematically affect how equivalent actions are described, evaluated, and defended under international law. Our results thus establish Poli-Bias as a fine-grained framework for auditing political even-handedness and sycophancy in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Poli-Bias，一个用于测量大语言模型在国际政治冲突中偏见 (political bias) 的反事实框架。该框架通过系统交换国家身份来配对提示，并比较模型在法律上等价但涉及不同国家的情境下的回应差异，将反应差异分解为五个可解释维度。在 13 个当代 LLM 上的实验表明，国家身份和用户归属会系统地影响模型对同等行动在国际法下的描述、评价与辩护，从而确立了该框架作为审计模型政治公正性与谄媚性 (sycophancy) 的细粒度工具。
Motivation: 衡量 LLM 中的政治偏见仍然具有挑战性，因为偏见可能通过措辞、论证和法律推理等细微差异显现，难以用单一指标捕获。
Method: 提出 Poli-Bias 反事实框架，在多样的地缘政治关系、法律违规类型和推理任务中系统地交换国家身份，比较配对提示下的模型回应，并将回应差异分解为五个可解释维度而非归结为单一判断。
Result: 在跨越不同模型家族和大小的 13 个当代 LLM 中，发现国家身份和用户归属会系统性地影响模型对国际法下等价行为的描述、评价和辩护方式。
Conclusion: 摘要将 Poli-Bias 确立为一种用于审计 LLM 政治公正性和谄媚性的细粒度审计框架。

papers.title: Multi-Year Geospatial Reasoning using Interannually-Consistent Historical Predictions as a Free Input Modality
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning, and deep networks in particular, are increasingly used to derive higher-level Earth observation (EO) products such as annual land-cover and crop-type maps. Many are generated operationally: each year a new acquisition is processed, typically with the same model, extending a multi-year archive. In the process these systems accumulate two kinds of useful signal that are almost never fed back into the model: the system's own archive of past predictions, and ancillary layers produced by other partners in a processing consortium. Both are normally used outside the network, as rule-based post-processing or a fixed input mask. Using the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service High Resolution Layer (HRL) Croplands crop-type product as a testbed, we show that bringing both signals inside the model turns a single-year, single-task pixel classifier into one that reasons across years. We introduce a Crop Type (CTY) embedding encoder that represents each past prediction as a confidence-scaled, time-ordered categorical token and attends over the year axis, and we study how the externally provided Base Vegetation Layer (BVL) mask should be represented in the model's inputs and outputs. To compare designs fairly when they relabel non-crop pixels, we evaluate on the 18 crop classes only and report precision and recall separately. On a pan-European dataset of about 5.4M labelled pixels, adding the prediction history raises crop-only F1 by 1.6 percentage points (pp) and, more importantly, corrects a recall-skewed error profile, with the largest gains on perennial and tree crops (olives +4.6, fruits +3.7, nuts +3.2 pp). Representing the BVL mask consistently in both the history and the target year adds about 2.5 pp on the crop classes. The approach is a low-cost recipe for any recurring geospatial or foundation model that emits class maps.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 7 figures Updated abstract to match with arxiv submission
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将多年度地理空间推理中模型自身的历史预测与外部辅助图层作为额外输入模态引入网络内部，以 Copernicus HRL Croplands 作物类型产品为试验台。作者引入 Crop Type (CTY) 嵌入编码器，将过去每年的预测表示为置信度加权的、按时间排序的分类 token，并在年份轴上做注意力，同时研究外部 Base Vegetation Layer (BVL) 掩膜在输入和输出中的表示方式。在约 540 万标注像素的泛欧洲数据集上，加入预测历史使仅作物类别的 F1 提升 1.6 个百分点，并修正了召回倾斜的误差分布。
Motivation: 运行化的地球观测系统每年用同一模型处理新观测，积累了多年的预测档案和外部合作方提供的辅助图层，但这些信号几乎从不反馈给模型，通常只作为规则后处理或固定输入掩膜使用，导致模型无法跨年份进行推理。
Method: 将历史预测和外部图层纳入网络内部：设计 CTY 嵌入编码器，把每年过去的预测编码为置信度标定的、时间排序的分类 token，并在年份轴上做注意力；同时研究 BVL 掩膜在历史年份和目标年份中应如何一致地表示在输入和输出端。为公平比较重新标注非作物像素的设计，仅对 18 个作物类别评估，并分别报告精确率和召回率。
Result: 在约 5.4M 标注像素的泛欧洲数据集上，加入预测历史使仅作物的 F1 提高 1.6 个百分点，并修正了召回倾斜的误差轮廓，其中多年生和乔木作物收益最大（橄榄 +4.6、水果 +3.7、坚果 +3.2 个百分点）；在历史年份和目标年份中一致表示 BVL 掩膜额外带来约 2.5 个百分点的作物类别提升。
Conclusion: 该方法是一种低成本的通用配方，适用于任何周期性输出类别地图的地理空间模型或基础模型，试验台为 Copernicus HRL Croplands 作物类型产品。

papers.title: Short-term load forecasting under EU-AI Act Requirements in Safety-Critical Environments: Results from a 41-day live challenge on the aggregated German transmission-grid load
papers.abstract_en: Short-term load forecasting (STLF) play a vital role in the electric power industry. It serves infrastructure that European and German law designate as critical. Determinism, reproducibility, and auditability are engineering requirements rather than optional extras. STLF is no longer purely an accuracy problem. It is also a software-engineering and compliance problem. This paper describes results from a 41-day live challenge that evaluated a complete STLF pipeline for the aggregated German transmission-grid load. The pipeline is based on the open-source Python library spotforecast2-safe, which implements the EU-AI Act Requirements in Safety-Critical Environments by design. The pipeline predicts the 24 hourly load values of a target day from European Network of Transmission System Operators for Electricity (ENTSO-E) data. It includes anomaly detection and gap-aware data preparation, calendar and weather covariates, a recursive multi-step forecasting algorithm, and hyperparameter tuning. Forecast accuracy is measured against the official ENTSO-E day-ahead forecast. The EU-AI act compliant spotforecast2-safe pipeline beats the ENTSO-E baseline. In-context models show competitive performance. Transparent, low-cost, and auditable local models (referred to as macl2l in this paper) are competitive with more than 100-million-parameter large, energy-intensive pre-trained foundation models such as chronos-2. The challenge infrastructure, the complete submission history of all teams, and the frozen final leaderboard are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一个为期 41 天的实时挑战赛结果，用于评估面向德国输电网聚合负荷的短期负荷预测（STLF）完整流水线。该流水线基于开源 Python 库 spotforecast2-safe，按设计满足欧盟《人工智能法案》在安全关键环境中的要求，从 ENTSO-E 数据预测目标日的 24 个小时负荷值。摘要称该符合欧盟 AI 法案的流水线在精度上击败了官方的 ENTSO-E 日前预测基线，并且透明、低成本、可审计的本地模型（macl2l）能在性能上匹敌超过 1 亿参数的基础大模型。
Motivation: 短期负荷预测服务于被欧洲和德国法律认定为关键的基础设施，因此确定性、可复现性和可审计性不再是可选项；STLF 不仅是精度问题，更是软件工程与合规性问题。现有研究多关注精度提升，而本文强调在安全关键环境中满足欧盟 AI 法案要求的重要性。
Method: 提出基于 spotforecast2-safe 的完整 STLF 流水线，包含异常检测和考虑数据缺失的数据准备、日历与天气协变量、递归多步预测算法以及超参数调优。通过 41 天在线挑战赛对德国输电网聚合负荷进行验证，预测目标日 24 个小时负荷值，并以官方 ENTSO-E 日前预测作为基线。
Result: 摘要报告该符合欧盟 AI 法案的流水线在预测精度上优于 ENTSO-E 基线；in-context 模型表现有竞争力；透明的本地模型 macl2l 与 chronos-2 等超过 1 亿参数的高能耗预训练基础大模型性能相当。挑战基础设施、各队完整提交历史和冻结的最终排行榜已公开。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过设计实现欧盟 AI 法案合规的工程化流水线可以在低成本和可审计的条件下达到具有竞争力的预测性能，无需依赖超大基础模型；相关工作产物以公开数据集和排行榜形式发布。

papers.title: ColorFD: A Finite-Difference Guided Black-Box Physical Adversarial Attack for Remote Sensing Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Although deep neural network-based remote sensing object detectors have achieved strong performance, they remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Existing studies mainly focus on digital or white-box settings, whereas black-box physical attacks remain underexplored. These attacks are often constrained by limited physical feasibility and inefficient optimization in high-dimensional search spaces. To address these challenges, this paper proposes ColorFD, a black-box physical attack based on multiple pure-color patches. The patch positions and color parameters are jointly optimized using Differential Evolution (DE). A target-wise fitness and selection mechanism evaluates the attack state of each target and preserves target-specific improvements during evolution. Two guidance strategies further constrain the patch search space. Key-region localization identifies sensitive regions through finite-difference color probing. Common-feature extraction provides category-level spatial priors and avoids repeated localization. Although evaluated on aircraft, the formulation is not inherently restricted to this category. Experiments on YOLOv3u, YOLOv5u, and Faster R-CNN show that ColorFD outperforms the tested black-box patch method across all evaluated detectors and remains competitive with strong white-box baselines. Physical-world experiments further demonstrate that the optimized pure-color patches can be transferred from the digital domain to real imaging conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ColorFD，一种基于有限差分引导的黑盒物理对抗攻击方法，用于遥感目标检测。该方法通过差分进化 (Differential Evolution, DE) 联合优化多个纯色补丁的位置与颜色参数，并引入目标级适应度与选择机制、关键区域定位和常见特征提取等引导策略。实验在 YOLOv3u、YOLOv5u 和 Faster R-CNN 上超过所测黑盒补丁方法，且与强白盒基线相当；物理世界实验验证了补丁从数字域到真实成像条件的可迁移性。
Motivation: 现有对抗攻击研究多集中于数字或白盒设置，黑盒物理攻击在遥感目标检测中探索不足，且这类攻击常受限于物理可行性不足以及高维搜索空间中的优化效率低下。
Method: 提出基于多个纯色补丁的黑盒物理攻击 ColorFD，使用差分进化联合优化补丁位置与颜色参数；通过目标级适应度和选择机制保留目标特定改进，并用关键区域定位（基于有限差分颜色探测）和常见特征提取（提供类别级空间先验）两条引导策略约束补丁搜索空间。
Result: 在 YOLOv3u、YOLOv5u 和 Faster R-CNN 上，ColorFD 优于被测试的黑盒补丁方法，并与强白盒基线持平；物理世界实验表明优化后的纯色补丁可以从数字域迁移到真实成像条件。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在飞机类别上评估，但公式并不限于该类别；其主要优势在于物理可行性、优化效率以及数字域到真实条件的跨域迁移能力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: An adaptive split-combine Gaussian mixture filter for nonlinear and multimodal state estimation
papers.abstract_en: Filtering combines model predictions with measurements to estimate the probability density function (PDF) of a system state over time. The PDF often becomes highly asymmetric and even multimodal in nonlinear systems with oscillatory or chaotic dynamics. Such non-Gaussian features violate the single-Gaussian assumption underlying Kalman-type filters. To address this problem, Gaussian mixture filtering has been proposed. However, accurately propagating mixture components and adaptively adjusting their number and weights over time remain open challenges. Here, we develop an adaptive split-combine Gaussian mixture filter (AMF) that estimates the time evolution of asymmetric and multimodal PDFs by adaptively splitting and combining Gaussian particles without auxiliary online numerical optimization. Notably, the proposed splitting method guarantees a reduction in variance along a target level-set-point direction of a Gaussian particle. This enables accurate and efficient propagation of particles. We show that AMF consistently outperforms various baseline filters across diverse benchmarks, including single and coupled slow-fast Van der Pol oscillators and the Lorenz attractor. We also propose a parallel implementation of AMF, allowing high-fidelity PDF estimation with practical computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文提出一种自适应分裂-合并高斯混合滤波器(AMF)，用于估计非线性系统中随时间演化的非对称、多模态状态概率密度函数(PDF)，即无需辅助在线数值优化即可自适应地分裂和合并高斯粒子。方法保证分裂过程沿目标水平集点方向降低方差，从而准确高效地传播粒子；在包括慢快Van der Pol振荡器和Lorenz吸引子等基准中一致优于多种基线滤波器，并提出并行实现以降低计算成本。
Motivation: 卡尔曼型滤波器依赖单一高斯假设，但在振荡或混沌非线性系统中状态PDF常呈现强非对称甚至多模态，违反该假设。尽管高斯混合滤波已被提出，如何准确传播混合分量并随时间自适应调整其数目与权重仍是开放挑战。
Method: 提出自适应分裂-合并高斯混合滤波器(AMF)，通过分裂和合并高斯粒子来追踪非高斯PDF的时间演化，避免在线数值优化。分裂方案保证粒子沿目标水平集点方向方差减小，并配合并行实现以获得高保真估计和实用计算成本。
Result: 摘要报告AMF在多种基准(包括单/耦合慢快Van der Pol振荡器和Lorenz吸引子)上一致优于多种基线滤波器，且并行实现能以实用计算成本完成高保真PDF估计。
Conclusion: 摘要强调AMF能为非线性状态估计提供准确且计算可行的PDF传播机制，并指出其分裂策略是该方法的有效性关键；但摘要未展开讨论具体适用范围或局限性。
Relevance: 55

papers.title: RealWeather: Realistic and Scene-Faithful Weather Translation with Driving World Models
papers.abstract_en: Realistic weather translation is valuable for developing and evaluating autonomous driving systems, yet collecting paired videos of the same scenes under different weather conditions at scale is impractical. Existing methods therefore rely on synthetic data, 3D weather editing, or geometry-conditioned generation, often compromising weather realism or scene fidelity. We propose RealWeather, a driving world model for both realistic and scene-faithful weather translation. Our key idea is to learn authentic weather dynamics directly from real-world videos. Specifically, RealWeather employs Progressive Realism Bootstrapping, an iterative data-refinement strategy. Assisted by an auxiliary Pseudo-Clear Generation pipeline, training initially starts with pseudo-style conditioning videos. As training proceeds, these inputs are progressively replaced with increasingly realistic videos generated by the model itself. This strategy bridges the pseudo-to-real domain gap, allowing the model to adapt seamlessly to real-world input distributions and naturally support bidirectional clear adverse translation. Furthermore, to strictly enforce structural integrity and suppress hallucinations, we introduce Scene-Fidelity RL Optimization, a reward-driven policy optimization strategy that explicitly penalizes alterations to safety-critical driving elements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RealWeather significantly outperforms existing methods in visual realism and structural preservation, while enabling robust long-tail weather scenario generation and strong zero-shot out-of-distribution generalization. Our video demos can be found at https://hust-umi.github.io/RealWeather/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RealWeather，一个用于真实且保持场景一致性的天气变换 (weather translation) 的驾驶世界模型 (driving world model)。核心思路是从真实视频中学习天气动态，通过渐进式真实感引导 (Progressive Realism Bootstrapping) 和伪晴空生成 (Pseudo-Clear Generation) 流水线，逐步用模型自身生成的越来越真实的视频替换伪风格训练输入，并引入场景保真强化学习优化 (Scene-Fidelity RL Optimization) 来惩罚对安全关键驾驶元素的改动。实验表明该方法在视觉真实感和结构保持上显著优于现有方法，并支持长尾天气场景生成和零样本分布外泛化。
Motivation: 收集同一场景在不同天气条件下的成对视频在大规模上不可行，现有方法依赖合成数据、3D 天气编辑或几何条件生成，往往在天气真实感或场景保真度上有所妥协。
Method: 使用渐进式真实感引导策略：训练初期借助伪晴空生成流水线提供伪风格条件视频，随训练推进逐步替换为模型自己生成的更真实视频，从而弥合伪到真域差距并支持晴-雨双向变换；同时采用奖励驱动的场景保真强化学习优化，显式惩罚对安全关键驾驶元素的改动以抑制幻觉。
Result: 实验表明 RealWeather 在视觉真实感和结构保持上显著优于现有方法，并展现出稳健的长尾天气场景生成能力和强零样本分布外泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者强调从真实世界视频中学习天气动态，结合渐进式数据精炼与保真奖励优化，可以在自动驾驶场景中实现既真实又保持场景一致性的天气变换。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: GradCuit: Credit-Assigned Gradient Flow Enables Robust and Interpretable Test-Time Latent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Optimization-based latent reasoning improves large language model outputs by optimizing instance-specific continuous states at test time while keeping model parameters frozen. Existing methods, however, typically connect these states to the reasoning trajectory through decoded tokens, making sequence-level credit assignment indirect and obscuring how latent updates shape subsequent reasoning. We introduce GradCuit (gradient through circuit), which inserts optimizable latent states at a selected Transformer layer between the hidden representations of the prompt and the generated continuation. Causal self-attention provides every continuation-token log-probability with a differentiable path to every preceding latent state through the remaining Transformer blocks, enabling reward-weighted gradients from the entire continuation to be assigned directly to the latents. Across five instruction-tuned backbones, three reasoning benchmarks, and two answer formats, GradCuit achieves an average accuracy of 64.5%, outperforming chain-of-thought prompting by 6.6 percentage points and the strongest competing method by 2.4 points. GradCuit also demonstrates greater robustness: across seven learning-rate settings, it consistently outperforms LatentSeek while reducing the standard deviation of accuracy from 1.53 to 0.82, and even its random-walk variant remains competitive with LatentSeek. For interpretability, token-level gradient attribution reveals that latent influence concentrates on reasoning-connector tokens, while layer analysis identifies early-to-middle Transformer layers as the most effective optimization space. By directly optimizing internal reasoning from outcome feedback, GradCuit opens a new axis of robust and interpretable test-time scaling, where LLMs adapt how they reason rather than merely regenerate, sample, or rerank outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GradCuit，一种面向大语言模型的测试时潜在推理 (test-time latent reasoning) 方法：在选定的 Transformer 层中，于 prompt 的隐表示与生成续写之间插入可优化的潜在状态。由于因果自注意力使每个续写 token 的对数概率都通过剩余 Transformer 块与每个前置潜在状态存在可微路径，整段续写的奖励加权梯度可直接分配给潜在状态。在五个指令微调骨干、三个推理基准和两种答案格式上，GradCuit 平均准确率为 64.5%，比 chain-of-thought prompting 高 6.6 个百分点，比最强对比方法高 2.4 个百分点，并展现出更强的学习率鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有的基于优化的潜在推理方法通常通过解码后的 token 将潜在状态连接到推理轨迹，导致序列级信用分配 (credit assignment) 是间接的，难以看清潜在更新如何影响后续推理。
Method: GradCuit (gradient through circuit) 在选定的 Transformer 层的隐表示之间插入可优化的潜在状态，利用因果自注意力将来自整段续写的奖励加权梯度直接分配给这些潜在状态，从而从结果反馈直接优化内部推理。
Result: 在五个指令微调骨干、三个推理基准和两种答案格式上，GradCuit 平均准确率为 64.5%，超过 chain-of-thought prompting 6.6 个百分点、最强对比方法 2.4 个百分点；在七种学习率设置下，其准确率标准差从 LatentSeek 的 1.53 降至 0.82，且随机游走变体仍与 LatentSeek 相当。token 级梯度归因显示潜在影响集中于推理连接 token，层分析显示早至中层 Transformer 是最有效的优化空间。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，直接优化内部推理为测试时扩展提供了新的稳健且可解释的维度，使 LLM 改变推理方式而非仅仅重新生成、采样或重排序输出。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RoMeRL: Balancing Feedback Coverage and the Memory-Reward Trap in Self-Evolving Agent Memory via Reduced-Order Utility States
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based memory systems for self-evolving LLM agents face two tightly coupled challenges. First, trajectory-indexed utilities grow with the interaction history, thereby dispersing limited feedback over an ever-expanding state space. Second, because trajectory-level rewards are jointly assigned to co-retrieved memories, irrelevant experiences may receive misleading utility updates and consequently enter the memory-reward trap. To address these challenges, we introduce Reduced-Order Memory Reinforcement Learning (RoMeRL), which represents the growing trajectory-indexed utility space using a fixed-dimensional per-task memory state factorized by outcome polarity and memory dynamics. RoMeRL incorporates new experiences through a fixed set of semantic coordinates whose contents are updated or replaced over time, thereby concentrating feedback over a bounded utility support. Theoretically, we show that this reduced-order parameterization increases the average feedback received by each utility coordinate and characterize the steady-state occupancy of erroneous coordinates under a generic coordinate-transition model. Empirically, across ALFWorld and LifelongAgentBench, RoMeRL improves task performance, reduces the Cold-Q ratio by 80.0%, increases feedback density by approximately 6.0 times, reduces the maintained memory size by 84.4%, and cuts LLM calls by 21.1%. These results show that reduced-order utility states support efficient self-evolving agent memory while limiting persistent reward contamination. Code is available at: https://github.com/YOUNG-fnxm/RoMeRL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自进化 LLM 智能体记忆系统中的两个耦合问题——轨迹索引效用空间随交互历史膨胀导致反馈分散，以及轨迹级奖励被同时赋予共检索记忆导致无关经验收到误导性更新（即 memory-reward trap）——提出降阶记忆强化学习 (Reduced-Order Memory Reinforcement Learning, RoMeRL)。RoMeRL 用按结果极性 (outcome polarity) 和记忆动态 (memory dynamics) 分解的固定维度每任务记忆状态表示增长的效用空间，并通过固定语义坐标集合的更新或替换来纳入新经验。在 ALFWorld 和 LifelongAgentBench 上，该方法提升了任务性能，并将 Cold-Q ratio 降低 80.0%、反馈密度提高约 6.0 倍、维护记忆规模减少 84.4%、LLM 调用减少 21.1%。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的记忆系统中，轨迹索引的效用 (trajectory-indexed utilities) 会随交互历史增长，使有限的反馈被分散到不断扩大的状态空间；同时轨迹级奖励被共同分配给共检索的记忆，导致无关经验获得误导性效用更新并陷入记忆-奖励陷阱。
Method: 提出 RoMeRL，将增长的轨迹索引效用空间表示为固定维度的每任务记忆状态，状态由结果极性和记忆动态分解；新经验通过一组固定语义坐标进入，其内容随时间更新或被替换，从而把反馈集中到有界效用支撑上。理论上证明该降阶参数化提高了每个效用坐标获得的平均反馈，并在通用坐标转移模型下刻画了错误坐标的稳态占用。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 和 LifelongAgentBench 上，RoMeRL 改善任务性能，Cold-Q ratio 降低 80.0%，反馈密度提升约 6.0 倍，维护记忆大小减少 84.4%，LLM 调用减少 21.1%。
Conclusion: 作者认为降阶效用状态 (reduced-order utility states) 能够在限制持续奖励污染 (persistent reward contamination) 的同时支持高效的自进化智能体记忆。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CAVE: Competence-Aware Visual Boundary Evidence Alignment for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved substantial performance gains in Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) through reinforcement learning (RL). However, existing methods primarily rely on outcome correctness rewards that evaluate only the final predicted intervals, leaving boundary-related visual evidence and its correspondence with timestamp predictions insufficiently constrained. In this paper, we delve into timestamp prediction and its underlying boundary-level visual evidence, showing prevalent misalignment between visual evidence and predicted timestamps across widely used benchmarks. To address this issue, we propose Competence-Aware Visual Boundary Evidence Alignment (CAVE), which augments localization optimization with boundary-specific visual evidence rewards to mitigate evidence-timestamp misalignment. Specifically, to explicitly represent the boundary-specific visual evidence, CAVE introduces boundary-specific evidence tokens and initializes their structured generation and distinct boundary semantics through a lightweight supervised warm-up. During RL, the visual boundary evidence alignment reward reinforces the visual attention of special evidence tokens within the ground-truth boundaries, thereby promoting alignment between visual evidence and temporal boundaries. Moreover, performance-aware gating for evidence supervision is designed to adaptively retain evidence guidance for poorly localized groups while reducing it once localization becomes sufficiently accurate to avoid over-constraining fine-grained boundary refinement. Extensive experiments on several public VTG benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAVE（Competence-Aware Visual Boundary Evidence Alignment），针对视频时间定位（Video Temporal Grounding）中视觉证据与预测时间戳不对齐的问题，在强化学习（RL）训练中加入边界特定的视觉证据奖励。方法引入边界特定证据 token，并通过轻量监督预热初始化其结构化生成与边界语义，RL 中利用证据对齐奖励强化证据 token 对真值边界内的视觉注意，同时用性能感知门控自适应调节证据监督强度。实验在多个公开 VTG 基准上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有基于 RL 的视频时间定位方法主要依赖只评估最终预测区间的结果正确性奖励，对边界相关视觉证据及其与时间戳预测的对应关系约束不足，导致常用基准上普遍存在视觉证据与预测时间戳的错位。
Method: 提出 CAVE，将边界特定的视觉证据奖励纳入定位优化以缓解证据-时间戳错位；具体地，引入边界特定证据 token，通过轻量监督预热初始化其结构化生成和不同边界语义；RL 阶段用视觉边界证据对齐奖励强化特殊证据 token 在真值边界内的视觉注意力。还设计性能感知门控，对定位较差的分组保留证据引导，在定位足够准确时减少引导以避免过度约束精细边界细化。
Result: 在多个公开 VTG 基准上的大量实验表明该方法有效，摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过边界特定视觉证据奖励与性能感知门控的联合设计，可以促进视觉证据与时间边界之间的对齐，同时避免对已足够准确的定位造成过度约束。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FAST-GS: Frequency Aware Space-time Gaussian Splatting for Photorealistic Dynamic Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) excels in dynamic 3D reconstruction and real-time novel view synthesis via efficient 4D Gaussian representations and parallelizable rendering. However, existing 4DGS approaches rely on a single polynomial to model motion, which limits performance in complex dynamic scenes where high-frequency motion components are prevalent, and fails to ensure long-term stability due to cumulative trajectory drift. To address these issues, we propose a Fourier Motion Modeling module: this paradigm decomposes motion into frequency-based sinusoidal components, capturing both low-frequency global trajectories and high-frequency local details to model complex motion patterns accurately. It retains the real-time rendering capability of 4DGS while improving complex motion fitting and long-term coherence. Additionally, we integrate a motion-aware regularization strategy into the loss function: it uses frequency-dependent weights to suppress high-frequency jitter while preserving low-frequency motion coherence. Extensive experiments on N3V and Google Immersive datasets from multiple scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 4D 高斯泼溅（4D Gaussian Splatting, 4DGS）在动态场景建模中的运动表示局限，提出频率感知的时空高斯泼溅框架 FAST-GS。核心是 Fourier Motion Modeling 模块，将运动分解为基于频率的正弦分量，以同时刻画低频全局轨迹与高频局部细节；并引入运动感知正则化（motion-aware regularization）抑制高频抖动、保持低频运动一致性。在 N3V 和 Google Immersive 数据集上的实验表明该方法在保持实时渲染的同时提升复杂运动拟合与长时间一致性。
Motivation: 现有 4DGS 方法使用单一多项式建模运动，难以处理含丰富高频运动分量的复杂动态场景，且累积轨迹漂移导致长期稳定性不足。
Method: 提出 Fourier Motion Modeling 模块，将运动分解为基于频率的正弦分量，覆盖低频全局轨迹与高频局部细节；同时在损失函数中加入运动感知正则化策略，用频率相关权重抑制高频抖动并保持低频运动一致性。
Result: 在 N3V 和 Google Immersive 数据集上的多个场景实验中验证了方法的有效性，保持 4DGS 实时渲染能力的同时改善了复杂运动拟合与长期连贯性。
Conclusion: 作者认为频率分解的运动建模与频率加权正则化能够提升 4DGS 在复杂动态场景下的运动拟合精度和长期稳定性，并被 ICASSP2026 接收。

papers.title: Agentic Stage-One Stellarator Optimization: Autonomous Multi-Objective Search for Finite-Beta Equilibria
papers.abstract_en: Stage-one stellarator design searches a high-dimensional family of three-dimensional plasma boundaries and fixed-boundary MHD equilibria for configurations that jointly meet requirements on confinement, field-line topology, force balance, stability proxies, and geometry. These specifications do not provide a general constructive map to a validated finite-beta equilibrium. High-quality targets are commonly developed through iterative numerical optimization whose outcome depends on the initial configuration, active Fourier resolution, objective priorities, and local solver budget. Coordinating this process is computationally costly and expert-intensive, limiting both design throughput and the production of consistently evaluated data. We present a proof of concept for \emph{agentic} stage-one optimization. A bounded language-model agent diagnoses the current equilibrium and selects the next local optimization experiment, while deterministic DESC execution owns prescribed profiles and flux, symmetry, metric evaluation, solver validity, and acceptance. On a common-budget subset from an expanding finite-beta campaign, the number of gate-valid configurations increases from five inputs to nineteen outputs; median Boozer QS RMS decreases from $2.39\times10^{-4}$ to $1.07\times10^{-4}$, and median maximum principal curvature decreases from $62.56$ to $33.00\,\mathrm{m}^{-1}$. A complementary long route achieves a $9.10\times$ QS reduction while repairing magnetic-well and curvature defects. The system also records every attempted local action as transition evidence, yielding 734 structured parent--action--outcome records in the reported experiments. These results show that agentic outer-loop control can sustain finite-beta, multi-objective search and turn repeated optimization into a scalable source of improved equilibria and reusable decision data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种 agentic 的一阶段仿星器（stellarator）优化方法：一个有边界的语言模型智能体诊断当前平衡态并选择下一个局部优化实验，而确定性的 DESC 程序负责轮廓、磁通、对称性、度量评估、求解器有效性与接受判据。在有限贝塔（finite-beta）多目标优化中，公共预算子集上的门控有效构型从 5 个增加到 19 个，中位 Boozer QS RMS 从 2.39e-4 降至 1.07e-4，中位最大主曲率从 62.56 降至 33.00 m^-1。实验还记录下 734 条结构化的 parent-action-outcome 决策记录。
Motivation: 阶段一仿星器设计需要在高维三维等离子体边界和固定边界 MHD 平衡族中搜索同时满足约束、磁场线拓扑、力平衡、稳定性代理与几何要求的构型，但这些规格并不提供到已验证有限贝塔平衡的通用构造映射。传统迭代数值优化依赖初始构型、Fourier 分辨率、目标优先级和局部求解器预算，过程计算昂贵且依赖专家，限制了设计吞吐量和一致评估数据的产出。
Method: 提出 agentic 外环控制：一个有边界的语言模型智能体负责诊断当前平衡并选择下一个局部优化实验，确定性 DESC 执行负责所有预设物理量与求解有效性验证。该方法将迭代优化过程转化为自主的多目标搜索，并记录每次局部动作作为转移证据。
Result: 在公共预算子集上，门控有效构型数量从 5 个增至 19 个；中位 Boozer QS RMS 从 2.39e-4 降至 1.07e-4，中位最大主曲率从 62.56 降至 33.00 m^-1。补充的长程优化路线实现 9.10 倍的 QS 降低，同时修复磁阱和曲率缺陷；实验共产生 734 条结构化 parent-action-outcome 记录。
Conclusion: 作者认为 agentic 外环控制能够维持有限贝塔多目标搜索，并把重复优化转化为可扩展的改进平衡来源和可复用的决策数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One Query, Many Scales: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Hierarchical Cross-View Geo-Localization
papers.abstract_en: Cross-view geo-localization (CVGL) retrieves geo-tagged satellite imagery for a ground-view query. Most systems exhaustively search a flat, fixed-resolution gallery, incurring high cost over large areas and adapting poorly to satellite resolution changes. Autoregressive coarse-to-fine alternatives reduce comparisons but bind later predictions to earlier decisions and a predefined hierarchy. We introduce GeoMoE, a sparse mixture-of-experts dual encoder that decouples global multi-scale representation learning from local hierarchical search. Global multi-scale supervision and content-adaptive routing map ground and satellite images across resolutions into a globally comparable embedding space. At inference, each image is encoded once, and probabilistic beam search follows parent--child links to score a small candidate subset. Later levels reuse these descriptors rather than features generated by preceding levels, limiting feature-level error propagation and hierarchy coupling. We further introduce VIGOR-M, a four-city benchmark with an explicit parent--child satellite hierarchy and held-out half-step galleries for single-resolution, cross-resolution, and hierarchical evaluation. GeoMoE achieves 95.78% R@40m on Just Zoom In, 2.77 percentage points above the previous best, and 62.39% R@1 on VIGOR-M. The latter requires 0.885 MMAC/query for descriptor matching, 5.27% of an exhaustive L3 scan, while exceeding the strongest exhaustive baseline by 3.12 percentage points in R@1. One model trained on L1, L2, and L3 also outperforms a matched dense control across all six galleries and transfers to three withheld resolutions. By decoupling globally trained embeddings from local hierarchical search, GeoMoE jointly improves localization accuracy, search efficiency, and cross-resolution transfer.

papers.title: Beyond Static Anchors: Bounded Prototype Conditioning for Language-Free Medical Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Medical anomaly detection identifies abnormal images and localizes lesions under scarce supervision while generalizing across organs and modalities. Existing CLIP-based methods reduce annotation requirements through vision--language alignment, but their normal and abnormal references, whether text prompts or learned visual tokens, remain fixed across test images. Such static references may not transfer reliably to unseen targets in a cross-domain medical imaging scenario. To address this, we propose ReCAP, a language-free framework that replaces static anchors with input-conditioned visual prototypes. ReCAP re-centers separated normal and abnormal prototypes for each image through a bounded gated modulation, enabling query-adaptive anomaly scoring while constraining context-induced prototype drift. For the few-shot setting, we introduce a non-parametric normal-reference memory to preserve instance-level target-domain variation and complement the conditional prototype branch. Across six medical benchmarks, ReCAP achieves the best image-level AUROC on all zero-shot and 23 of 24 few-shot settings, and the best zero-shot pixel-level AUROC on all three segmentation datasets. Particularly, it reduces inference latency by over 70% compared to the fastest baseline, without text prompts or test-time gradient updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReCAP，一个无语言（language-free）的医学异常检测框架，用输入条件化的视觉原型（input-conditioned visual prototypes）替代 CLIP-based 方法中固定的文本提示或可学习视觉 token，以提升跨器官、跨模态的零样本与少样本泛化。摘要报告在六个医学基准上，ReCAP 在全部零样本设置和 23/24 个少样本设置取得最佳图像级 AUROC，并在三个分割数据集上取得最佳零样本像素级 AUROC，同时比最快基线降低超过 70% 推理延迟。
Motivation: 现有 CLIP-based 医学异常检测依赖的 normal/abnormal 参考（文本提示或可学习视觉 token）在测试图像之间保持固定，难以可靠迁移到未见过的跨域医学影像目标，成为零样本和少样本泛化的瓶颈。
Method: ReCAP 通过有界门控调制（bounded gated modulation）针对每张图像重新居中分离的 normal 与 abnormal 原型，实现查询自适应的异常评分并限制上下文引起的原型漂移；少样本设置下引入非参数 normal-reference memory 保留实例级目标域变化，与条件原型分支互补。
Result: 在六个医学基准上，ReCAP 获得全部零样本设置和 23/24 个少样本设置的最佳图像级 AUROC，并在全部三个分割数据集上获得最佳零样本像素级 AUROC；推理延迟比最快基线降低超过 70%，且无需文本提示或测试时梯度更新。
Conclusion: 摘要强调用有界条件原型替代静态锚点可提升医学异常检测的跨域迁移能力，且无语言设计带来显著推理效率优势。

papers.title: End-to-End Fairness Optimization with Fair Decision-Focused Learning
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world systems rely on predictive models to inform decisions, and fairness concerns arise in both the prediction and decision stages. We introduce end-to-end fairness optimization (E2EFO) as a unifying framework that integrates fairness across the prediction-to-decision pipeline. We focus on resource allocation with group-based fairness: the prediction task estimates allocation impacts while limiting accuracy disparity across groups, and the decision task distributes those impacts equitably by optimizing a group-based alpha-fairness measure. Within this framework, we propose fair decision-focused learning (FDFL), a training paradigm that jointly accounts for prediction accuracy, prediction fairness, and decision regret -- the loss in decision fairness due to imperfect predictions. FDFL trains the predictor by gradient descent, combining the objective gradients through multi-task learning techniques. The core computational challenge is the decision Jacobian with respect to the predictor parameters: we derive exact closed-form formulas for a tractable class of fair allocation and apply a differentiable optimization layer in the general case. We further establish a finite-sample generalization bound for the scalarized FDFL objective. Numerical experiments on a healthcare-based single resource allocation and a synthetic multiple resource allocation illustrate the value of jointly accounting for prediction fairness and decision fairness in prediction-informed decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出端到端公平性优化（E2EFO）框架，将公平性贯穿从预测到决策的流水线，并在此框架下提出公平决策焦点学习（FDFL）。FDFL 是一种联合考虑预测精度、预测公平性和决策遗憾（decision regret）的训练范式；作者对一类可处理的公平分配问题推导了决策 Jacobian 的精确闭式解，并在一般情形下使用可微优化层。摘要还给出了标量化 FDFL 目标的有限样本泛化界，并在医疗保健单资源分配与合成多资源分配实验上验证了方法。
Motivation: 许多现实系统依赖预测模型来指导决策，而公平性问题同时出现在预测和决策阶段；现有方法往往只单独处理某一阶段，缺少统一考虑预测公平性与决策公平性的端到端训练范式。
Method: 提出 E2EFO 统一框架，聚焦基于群体的资源分配：预测任务估计分配影响并限制组间精度差距，决策任务通过优化基于群体的 alpha-公平性度量来公平分配影响。FDFL 通过梯度下降训练预测器，并利用多任务学习技术组合各目标梯度；核心计算难点是预测器参数对决策 Jacobian 的求解，作者对可处理的公平分配类推导精确闭式公式，一般情形则采用可微优化层。
Result: 摘要报告在基于医疗保健的单资源分配和合成的多资源分配数值实验上，联合考虑预测公平性与决策公平性能够体现其价值，并给出了 FDFL 标量化目标的有限样本泛化界。
Conclusion: 作者认为在预测驱动的决策中，联合考虑预测公平性和决策公平性是有益的，FDFL 提供了实现这一目标的端到端训练途径。

papers.title: ConMem: Contribution-Aware Memory for Long-Horizon Manufacturing Inspection Logs
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon steel-equipment inspection requires reasoning over heterogeneous records accumulated across repeated inspection cycles. Existing retrieval-augmented generation systems treat historical logs as a static corpus and retain records without estimating their diagnostic value, failing to report early risk. To this end, we propose ConMem, a contribution-aware memory framework for LLM-assisted equipment inspection, supporting a human-in-the-loop early-risk screening system. Specifically, our ConMem first segments inspection logs into functional evidence units, then estimates each memory unit's contribution to downstream diagnosis through a Shapley-style estimation, and finally retains high-value evidence under a constrained memory budget. In experiments, we evaluate ConMem on real-world dataset and ConMem achieves 76.0% QA accuracy, exceeding the strongest directly comparable baseline. Relative to the naive 8K-context LLM baselines, it reduces the average number of input tokens by 88.2% and response time by 86.6%. Ablation studies also show that the functional-role-aware segmentation and contribution-based valuation are helping prioritize weak degradation signals for targeted field inspection. Practical deployments further confirm that ConMem retains the weak early signal across three inspection cycles, providing an early-stage seal-wear alert targeted for on-site inspectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ConMem，一个面向 LLM 辅助设备检修的贡献感知记忆框架，用于长周期钢铁设备检修日志的早期风险筛查。框架先将检修日志切分为功能证据单元，再用 Shapley 式估计评估每个单元对下游诊断的贡献，并在受限记忆预算下保留高价值证据。在真实数据集上，ConMem 达到 76.0% 的 QA 准确率，超过最强直接可比基线；相对于朴素 8K 上下文 LLM 基线，平均输入 token 数减少 88.2%，响应时间减少 86.6%。实际部署显示该方法能在三个检修周期内保留微弱早期信号，并向现场检查人员提供早期密封磨损预警。
Motivation: 现有检索增强生成（RAG）系统把历史检修日志当作静态语料，保留记录时不评估其诊断价值，因此难以报告早期风险。
Method: 提出 ConMem 框架：先将检修日志切分为功能证据单元，通过 Shapley 式估计（Shapley-style estimation）量化每个记忆单元对下游诊断的贡献，再在受限记忆预算下筛选并保留高价值证据，并支持人在回路的早期风险筛查系统。
Result: 在真实数据集上 QA 准确率达 76.0%，超过最强直接可比基线；相对朴素 8K 上下文 LLM 基线，平均输入 token 数减少 88.2%，响应时间减少 86.6%。消融实验表明功能角色感知切分与基于贡献的估值有助于优先关注弱退化信号；实际部署确认该方法在三个检修周期内保留早期密封磨损预警信号。
Conclusion: 作者认为贡献感知记忆与功能角色感知切分相结合，能够提升长周期检修日志上的早期风险筛查能力，并在实际部署中验证了对弱早期信号的持续保留。

papers.title: SemPIC: Learning Semantic Position-Independent KV Caches
papers.abstract_en: Long-context retrieval and agentic workloads repeatedly reuse the same documents under changing instructions, histories, and document orders. Prefix caching cannot exploit this reuse, while position-independent caching (PIC) remains unreliable because independently compiled KV states lack the future context in which they will be consumed. Our diagnostics show that a learned boundary-conditioned baseline sharply reduces attention deviation near reusable-block boundaries but leaves interior and task-level residuals, motivating adaptation of the document representation itself. We present \emph{SemPIC}, which trains a LoRA-enabled Writer to compile native per-layer document KVs through behavioral distillation while retaining the pretrained decoder as an unchanged Reader. Adaptation is confined to offline cache construction, preserving the standard KV interface and cache-hit decoding path. We further introduce KV Gradient Checkpointing, which reduces peak training memory without severing gradients through cached KVs. Across three models and four tasks, SemPIC raises mean micro-F1 over KV Packet from 0.53 to 0.60, approaching Full Recompute at 0.62. Code: https://github.com/jn12-29/SemPIC
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SemPIC，一种通过学习位置无关 KV 缓存（position-independent KV cache）来提升长上下文检索与 agentic 工作负载中文档复用效率的方法。核心思路是训练一个带 LoRA 的 Writer，通过行为蒸馏（behavioral distillation）离线编译逐层的文档 KV，同时保持预训练 decoder 作为不变的 Reader。摘要报告在三个模型、四个任务上，SemPIC 将平均 micro-F1 从 KV Packet 的 0.53 提升到 0.60，接近 Full Recompute 的 0.62，并引入 KV Gradient Checkpointing 降低训练峰值内存。
Motivation: 长上下文检索与 agentic 工作负载会在指令、历史记录和文档顺序变化的情况下反复复用相同文档，而前缀缓存（prefix caching）无法利用这种复用；位置无关缓存（PIC）又因独立编译的 KV 状态缺少未来消费上下文而不可靠。诊断显示，学习边界条件（boundary-conditioned）的基线虽然显著降低了可复用块边界附近的注意力偏差，但仍留有内部与任务级残差，因此需要直接适应文档表示本身。
Method: 提出 SemPIC，训练一个启用 LoRA 的 Writer，通过行为蒸馏将文档编译为原生逐层 KV，同时保持预训练 decoder 作为不变的 Reader。适应过程被限制在离线缓存构建阶段，从而保留标准 KV 接口与缓存命中解码路径；此外引入 KV Gradient Checkpointing，在不切断经过缓存 KV 的梯度的情况下降低峰值训练内存。
Result: 在三个模型和四个任务上，SemPIC 将平均 micro-F1 从 KV Packet 的 0.53 提高到 0.60，接近 Full Recompute 的 0.62。
Conclusion: 作者主张通过适应文档表示本身来改进位置无关缓存，并将所有适应限制在离线缓存构建中，从而保持标准的 KV 接口和缓存命中解码路径不变。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Endo-NeRF++: Uncertainty-Aware Neural Rendering with Multi-Resolution Hash Encoding for Dynamic Surgical Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing dynamic surgical scenes is crucial for robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery; however, it continues to be difficult because of tissue deformation, occlusions, specular reflections, and restricted viewpoints. In this study, we introduce Endo-NeRF++, a neural rendering framework that accounts for uncertainty in the reconstruction of dynamic surgical scenes. Expanding on EndoNeRF, the suggested approach incorporates multi-resolution hash-grid encoding, temporal feature merging, and uncertainty-informed adaptive sampling to enhance reconstruction accuracy and temporal coherence in deformable endoscopic scenes.The multi-resolution hash-grid representation within the framework effectively captures both coarse and fine anatomical details, while temporal feature blending ensures stable reconstruction during tissue deformation and surgical tool occlusions. Additionally, uncertainty-driven adaptive sampling assigns more samples to uncertain areas to enhance rendering quality and geometric coherence. Experiments on robotic surgical video sequences demonstrate that the proposed uncertainty-guided adaptive sampling improves PSNR by up to 1.22dB (4.3%), increases SSIM by up to 5.3%, and reduces LPIPS by up to 55.1% compared with the EndoNeRF baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Endo-NeRF++，一种面向动态手术场景重建的神经渲染框架，在 EndoNeRF 基础上引入多分辨率哈希网格编码、时间特征融合与不确定性引导的自适应采样。在机器人手术视频序列上，相比 EndoNeRF 基线，PSNR 最高提升 1.22dB（4.3%），SSIM 最高提升 5.3%，LPIPS 最高降低 55.1%。
Motivation: 动态手术场景重建对机器人辅助微创手术至关重要，但组织形变、遮挡、镜面反射和受限视角使重建困难，现有方法在精度和时间连贯性上仍有不足。
Method: 以 EndoNeRF 为基础，加入多分辨率哈希网格编码 (multi-resolution hash-grid encoding) 以同时捕获粗细解剖细节，采用时间特征融合 (temporal feature merging) 保证形变与工具遮挡下的稳定重建，并使用不确定性驱动的自适应采样，将更多样本分配到不确定区域以提升渲染质量。
Result: 在机器人手术视频序列上的实验表明，与 EndoNeRF 基线相比，不确定性引导的自适应采样使 PSNR 最高提升 1.22dB（4.3%），SSIM 最高提升 5.3%，LPIPS 最高降低 55.1%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调不确定性感知与多分辨率哈希编码相结合可提升可变形内窥镜场景的重建精度和时间连贯性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: DreamStyle3D: Efficient 3D Stylized Asset Generation via Dual-Attention Disentanglement
papers.abstract_en: With the growth of gaming, animation, and virtual reality industries, the demand for efficient generation of stylized 3D assets is rapidly increasing. However, existing approaches still struggle to jointly preserve style fidelity, geometric consistency, and generation efficiency, as most of them still rely on indirect 2D-to-3D stylization pipelines. This motivates a native 3D stylization framework that can explicitly disentangle style from geometry while remaining efficient. To this end, we propose DreamStyle3D, an efficient framework for stylized 3D asset generation built on a Decoupled Dual Cross-Attention mechanism. Our method explicitly separates geometric and stylistic features to enable efficient style injection while preserving structural consistency, and further adopts a lightweight training strategy to enhance style consistency and model generalization. In addition, we build an automated data pipeline and construct a dataset of about 15K content-style-stylized triplets for training and evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our DreamStyle3D can generate high-fidelity, geometrically consistent stylized 3D assets within 10 seconds, substantially improving efficiency while maintaining superior style quality and offering a new solution for 3D content creation. The project is available at https://github.com/NK-JittorCV/nk-3D/tree/main/models/DreamStyle3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DreamStyle3D，一个面向风格化 3D 资源生成的高效框架，基于解耦双交叉注意力 (Decoupled Dual Cross-Attention) 显式分离几何与风格特征。作者还构建了约 15K 个 content-style-stylized 三元组的数据集用于训练和评估。实验表明该方法可在 10 秒内生成高保真且几何一致的风格化 3D 资源，显著提升效率并保持风格质量。
Motivation: 游戏、动画和虚拟现实行业对高效生成风格化 3D 资产的需求快速增长，而现有方法大多依赖间接的 2D-to-3D 风格化流程，难以同时兼顾风格保真度、几何一致性和生成效率。
Method: 提出基于解耦双交叉注意力机制的原生 3D 风格化框架，将几何特征与风格特征显式分离以实现高效风格注入并保持结构一致性；同时采用轻量训练策略提升风格一致性与模型泛化能力，并搭建自动化数据流程构建约 15K 三元组数据集。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能够在 10 秒内生成高保真、几何一致的风格化 3D 资产，在保持优越风格质量的同时大幅提升生成效率。
Conclusion: 该方法为 3D 内容创作提供了新的解决思路，核心贡献在于以解耦注意力实现高效、几何一致的风格化生成。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: How Context Attribution Handles What the Model Already Knows
papers.abstract_en: Context attribution methods for large language models (LLMs) identify which input context contributes to the model response. Recent works show the initial success in attributing the con- tributive score of the contexts. However, we observe that when the context overlaps with the training data, these methods can- not disentangle in-context from in-weight (IW) contributions, producing unreliable scores. Based on this observation, in this work, we introduce: 1) an evaluation protocol that relies on four new metrics (base-model context attribution score (BCS), cross-model context attribution consistency (CAC), attribution preservation score (APS), source separation pre- cision (SSP)) and 2) a benchmark dataset (WMDP-Cyber++) with ground-truth provenance labels to systematically assess attribution under IW overlap. In our experiments across four well-known context attribution methods, we demonstrate that they provide unfaithful attribution when the knowledge from the context also exists in the weights. Finally, we adapt these methods for source separation (IW vs. in-context learning (ICL)) and show that they cannot do the disentanglement based on the contributive score
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型 (LLM) 的上下文归因 (context attribution) 方法，指出当输入上下文与训练数据重叠时，现有方法无法区分上下文内贡献 (in-context) 与权重内贡献 (in-weight, IW)，导致归因分数不可靠。作者为此提出包含四个新指标 (BCS, CAC, APS, SSP) 的评估协议，并构造带真实来源标注 (provenance labels) 的基准数据集 WMDP-Cyber++。实验表明四种常见上下文归因方法在知识同时存在于权重和上下文时给出不忠实的归因，且将这些方法适配为来源分离 (IW vs. ICL) 后仍无法基于贡献分数完成解耦。
Motivation: 现有上下文归因方法在上下文与训练数据重叠时不能将 ICL 贡献与 IW 贡献分开，导致贡献分数不可靠；这一缺陷缺乏系统评估手段，影响归因可信度。
Method: 提出评估协议，包含四个新指标：基础模型上下文归因分数 (BCS)、跨模型上下文归因一致性 (CAC)、归因保持分数 (APS) 和来源分离精度 (SSP)；同时构建带 ground-truth 来源标签的基准数据集 WMDP-Cyber++，并在该协议下测试四种已知上下文归因方法。
Result: 在四个已知上下文归因方法上的实验显示，当上下文中的知识也存在于权重中时，这些方法给出不忠实的归因；将其适配到 IW 与 ICL 的来源分离任务后，它们也无法仅依据贡献分数实现解耦。
Conclusion: 作者认为现有上下文归因方法无法处理上下文与训练数据重叠的情形，且当前归因分数不足以支撑 IW 与 ICL 的来源分离，需要新的方法或评估思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Wrong Design Intent Is Worse Than Never Conditioning: A Derangement-Control Diagnosis of Header Conditioning in CAD Program Completion
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuned code LLMs are routinely conditioned on a design-intent specification, but the correctness axis of such a signal -- a wrong intent rather than an absent one -- has not been tested, and the benefit of conditioning is usually scored with the same detector that defines the signal. We study CADCON, a five-feature design-intent header prepended to CadQuery-style programs during LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B, scoring adherence with executable geometric assertions that share no code with the header-defining extractor. On a pre-registered sample of 400 deduplicated held-out programs stratified over eleven intent profiles, at 40% prefix and three seeds, a semantically wrong header degrades adherence below the never-header-trained baseline on 3/3 seeds under both tokenizations at the program level, and on 3/3 token and 2/3 text seeds at the 298 distinct model inputs they present. Wrong-header executability is not depressed relative to that baseline. A derangement control, retrained so every program receives another program's header -- holding the header marginal fixed while destroying its correlation with the program -- saw the same programs, indices and wrong headers. Its correct-to-wrong change is -0.006/+0.016/-0.003 against 0.124/0.241/0.230 for the standard model, and the interaction is significant on 3/3 seeds (p <= 5.9e-7), so the model's sensitivity to whether the header is right or wrong requires the learned mapping. The control sits below the baseline by the same margin under a correct as under a wrong header, so we claim that sensitivity and not the below-baseline level. On features the true intent lacks, the standard model realizes a feature far more often when the wrong header names it; the control does not. Ground truth itself scores only 0.567 here, the scale on which arm levels should be read. Wrong design intent is not inert: it actively misdirects generation.
papers.comment: 47 pages, 4 figures. v4: referee-response revision, no evaluation re-run. Causal claim narrowed to correct-to-wrong content sensitivity; the control's offset vs the unconditioned baseline is arm-invariant and now reported. Cluster-level analysis over 298 distinct inputs is now the headline, with bootstrap intervals. Wrong-target uptake added, control as placebo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 CAD 程序补全中设计意图 (design-intent) 头条件化的语义正确性影响。作者在 Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B 的 LoRA 微调中为 CadQuery 风格程序加入 CADCON 五特征设计意图头，并使用与头部定义提取器无代码共享的可执行几何断言进行评分。预注册样本为 400 条去重保留程序，跨 11 个意图剖面，在 40% 前缀和三个种子下，语义错误的头将程序级依从性降至从未训练过头的基线之下；错头可执行性相对基线未被压低。作者通过错排控制 (derangement control) 证明模型对头正确与否的敏感性依赖于学到的映射，并强调敏感性而非低于基线的水平才是其因果主张。
Motivation: 微调代码大语言模型通常以设计意图规范为条件，但信号的正确性轴（错误意图而非缺失意图）尚未被测试，且条件化收益通常用定义该信号的同一检测器来评分。
Method: 构造五特征 CADCON 设计意图头并预置到 CadQuery 风格程序，采用与头部定义提取器无共享代码的可执行几何断言评分；引入错排控制，使每个程序获得另一个程序的头部，在保持头部边际分布的同时破坏其与程序的关联。
Result: 在 400 条去重保留程序的预注册样本上，语义错误的头在 3/3 种子下将程序级依从性降至无头基线之下；标准模型的正确到错误变化为 -0.006/+0.016/-0.003，而对照组为 0.124/0.241/0.230，交互在 3/3 种子上显著（p <= 5.9e-7）。对照组在正确与错误头下均低于基线相同幅度，且真实标注本身仅为 0.567。
Conclusion: 错误的设计意图并非惰性，而是会主动误导生成；论文将因果主张收窄为对正确与错误内容敏感性的估计，并报告控制组相对无条件基线的偏移与臂无关。

summary_sections.motivation: 微调代码大语言模型通常以设计意图规范为条件，但信号的正确性轴（错误意图而非缺失意图）尚未被测试，且条件化收益通常用定义该信号的同一检测器来评分。
summary_sections.method: 构造五特征 CADCON 设计意图头并预置到 CadQuery 风格程序，采用与头部定义提取器无共享代码的可执行几何断言评分；引入错排控制，使每个程序获得另一个程序的头部，在保持头部边际分布的同时破坏其与程序的关联。
summary_sections.result: 在 400 条去重保留程序的预注册样本上，语义错误的头在 3/3 种子下将程序级依从性降至无头基线之下；标准模型的正确到错误变化为 -0.006/+0.016/-0.003，而对照组为 0.124/0.241/0.230，交互在 3/3 种子上显著（p <= 5.9e-7）。对照组在正确与错误头下均低于基线相同幅度，且真实标注本身仅为 0.567。
summary_sections.conclusion: 错误的设计意图并非惰性，而是会主动误导生成；论文将因果主张收窄为对正确与错误内容敏感性的估计，并报告控制组相对无条件基线的偏移与臂无关。

papers.title: The Lift Spectrum: How Measurement-to-Space Adaptivity Shapes Robustness in Image-Free Single-Pixel Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Single-pixel sensing encodes a scene as a short sequence of coded measurements, and image-free methods infer the task directly from that sequence. We show that removing image reconstruction relocates the central design problem to the lift: how 1D measurements become a 2D task representation. We organize this choice as a lift spectrum from a fixed-physics inverse, through a learned static projection, to content-adaptive retrieval. These are not interchangeable forms of reconstruction: the fixed-physics route reconstructs an image consumed at inference, whereas our spatiotemporal soft-fusion (STSF) network lifts measurements directly into task features, and task-prioritized loss scheduling (TPLS) uses a separate learned reconstruction branch only as scheduled training supervision. A probe-selected recurrent encoder and a parameter-matched lift ablation identify the STSF design. In simulation, STSF+TPLS exceeds the prior image-free baseline on three datasets at 3.13% sampling (+3.2 to +9.9 pp foreground mIoU) and remains competitive down to 0.39%. The strongest clean-trained reconstruct-then-segment baseline wins without measurement noise, but measurement noise reverses the ranking: the reconstructed task input carries a 20-70x larger normalized relative perturbation than the measurements themselves. Stressed to failure, the three lift regions exhibit distinct dominant signatures--collapse, imprinting, and coarsening. STSF+TPLS transfers without fine-tuning to a real single-pixel bench, where the reversal reappears as a proof of concept; inference takes about 14 ms per mask on an RTX 4090. Within the tested fixed-acquisition regime, measurement-to-space adaptivity therefore organizes both the clean-to-noisy operating envelope and the failure a system encounters. Code and pretrained weights: https://github.com/Hanyuyuan6/STSF-TPLS.
papers.comment: 25 pages (13 main text + 12 supplementary material), 8 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Computational Imaging
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无图像（image-free）单像素感知中，从一维测量升维到二维任务表征的"lift"设计问题，提出一个从固定物理逆（fixed-physics inverse）、学习静态投影到内容自适应检索（content-adaptive retrieval）的升维谱系（lift spectrum）。作者提出时空软融合（spatiotemporal soft-fusion, STSF）网络将测量直接提升为任务特征，并用任务优先损失调度（task-prioritized loss scheduling, TPLS）将独立重建分支仅作为训练监督信号。仿真表明该方法在低采样率下优于先前 image-free 基线，且在有测量噪声时反转与 reconstruct-then-segment 方法的排名，并在真实单像素平台上验证了迁移性。
Motivation: 移除图像重建之后，单像素感知的核心设计问题转移到了"lift"：一维测量如何变为二维任务表征。作者认为不同提升方式并非可互换的重建形式，而是决定了系统在干净与含噪条件下的性能及失效模式，现有工作对此缺乏系统组织。
Method: 将升维选择组织为一个从固定物理逆到内容自适应检索的谱系，并在此基础上提出 STSF 网络直接把测量提升为任务特征，以及 TPLS 把单独的学习重建分支仅用作调度式训练监督。作者用探针选择的循环编码器（recurrent encoder）和参数匹配的 lift 消融来确认 STSF 设计。
Result: 在 3.13% 采样率下，STSF+TPLS 在三个数据集上超过先前 image-free 基线，前景 mIoU 提升 +3.2 到 +9.9 个百分点，并在 0.39% 采样率下仍具竞争力；无测量噪声时最强的干净训练 reconstruct-then-segment 基线胜出，但加入噪声后排名反转，重建任务输入携带的归一化相对扰动比测量本身大 20-70 倍。该方法无需微调即可迁移到真实单像素平台，RTX 4090 上每掩膜推理约 14 ms。
Conclusion: 在测试的固定采集机制内，measurement-to-space adaptivity 同时组织系统从干净到含噪的运行包络及其失效模式；三种 lift 区域在压力测试下分别表现出 collapse、imprinting 和 coarsening 的典型失效特征。

papers.title: ExpertVerse: A General-Purpose Benchmark for Expert-Level Reasoning in Knowledge-Intensive Visual Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal generative models have enabled instruction-based image generation to move beyond semantic manipulation to knowledge-driven visual reasoning. However, these methods focus on explicit commonsense reasoning, shallow causal understanding, and direct knowledge recall, failing at knowledge-intensive generation. We develop \textbf{ExpertVerse}, a capability-centric benchmark to evaluate generative models via knowledge-intensive lens. ExpertVerse stratifies reasoning generation across an orthogonal taxonomy of \textit{9 cognitive capabilities} and \textit{8 expert disciplines}, yielding \textit{58 sub-disciplines}. We curate 1,611 expert-annotated instances covering single-image editing, multi-image composition, and text-to-image generation. We further develop an automated workflow to produce \textbf{ExpertVerse-100K}, a large-scale dataset with reasoning traces and knowledge-anchored rationale annotations. Based on this, we train \textbf{KnowThinker} with RL fine-tuning, a VLM reasoning engine with world knowledge that jointly generates thinking processes and refined instructions. Towards the cross-modal credit misalignment and multi-objective gradient conflicts in multi-reward optimization, we propose a tailored Bootstrapped Pareto Policy Optimization (BPPO), which synergizes Bootstrapping Reward Rectification (BRR) and Conflict-Aware Pareto Advantage Fusion (CPAF). Extensive results of both open-source and proprietary models exposes critical reasoning deficits, highlighting imperative for knowledge-intensive benchmarks towards next-generation visual generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ExpertVerse，一个面向知识密集型视觉合成（knowledge-intensive visual synthesis）的通用评测基准，用 9 种认知能力与 8 个专家学科的正交分类法划分推理生成，形成 58 个子学科，并人工标注了 1,611 个覆盖单图编辑、多图合成和文生图的实例。作者还构建了 ExpertVerse-100K 大规模数据集，并训练带世界知识的 VLM 推理引擎 KnowThinker，以及提出 Bootstrapped Pareto Policy Optimization (BPPO) 训练算法。评测显示开源与闭源模型均存在明显推理缺陷。
Motivation: 现有指令式图像生成方法只能处理显式常识推理、浅层因果理解和直接知识回忆，在知识密集型生成任务上表现不足；缺少专门从知识密集型视角评估生成模型的 capability-centric 基准。
Method: 提出包含 9 种认知能力和 8 个专家学科的标注体系，并整理 1,611 个专家标注实例；开发自动化流程生成带推理轨迹和知识锚定理由标注的 ExpertVerse-100K。基于该数据，用 RL 微调训练 VLM 推理引擎 KnowThinker，并针对多奖励优化中的跨模态信用错位和多目标梯度冲突，提出结合 Bootstrapping Reward Rectification (BRR) 与 Conflict-Aware Pareto Advantage Fusion (CPAF) 的 BPPO。
Result: 对多种开源和闭源模型的广泛评测暴露出关键推理缺陷，说明现有生成模型在知识密集型视觉任务上的能力缺口。摘要未给出具体定量指标。
Conclusion: 作者强调知识密集型基准对下一代视觉生成的重要性，并认为当前模型在这类任务上的不足值得进一步关注；摘要未说明方法本身的局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Delineate Anything v2: A Global Foundation Model for Field Delineation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate agricultural field boundary delineation at large scale is a foundational task for food security, supply chain transparency, and carbon accounting. While vision foundation models like SAM show remarkable zero-shot capabilities, they frequently fail in geospatial domains due to topological complexity, cropland texturing patterns, and a lack of physical scale awareness. In this work, we introduce Delineate Anything v2, a globally scalable foundation model designed specifically for wide-area field boundary mapping. We construct FBIS-73M, a 73-million-instance multi-resolution dataset spanning 61 countries. To address the pervasive issue of multi-field administrative parcel merging, we introduce a resolution-specific data curation pipeline that leverages topological image-space adaptation to homogenize merged parcels and strengthen weak physical boundaries. Furthermore, we establish a novel, manually curated evaluation benchmark covering 100 countries to assess independent zero-shot generalization. Our results show that Delineate Anything v2 surpasses the current state-of-the-art, including the Delineate Anything framework, by 0.284 mAP@0.5 (+103.3% relative gain), while maintaining execution speeds suitable for rapid national- and global-scale deployment, as demonstrated by nationwide mapping of Ukraine (603,000 km^2) in 5.4 hours on a consumer-grade workstation. Code, pre-trained weights, the FBIS-73M dataset, and ready-to-use national-scale vector boundary products are publicly available at https://lavreniuk.github.io/Delineate-Anything/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Delineate Anything v2，一个面向全球尺度农田地块边界绘制的视觉基础模型。作者构建了覆盖 61 个国家、7300 万个实例的多分辨率数据集 FBIS-73M，并引入基于拓扑图像空间适配的分辨率特定数据整理流程来处理多地块行政合并问题；同时建立了一个覆盖 100 个国家的人工整理零样本评测基准。结果显示该模型在 mAP@0.5 上超越现有最优方法 0.284（相对提升 103.3%），并能在消费级工作站上 5.4 小时完成乌克兰全国 603,000 平方公里的地块制图。
Motivation: 大尺度农业地块边界划分对粮食安全、供应链透明度和碳核算至关重要，但视觉基础模型如 SAM 在地理空间领域常因拓扑复杂性、农田纹理模式以及缺乏物理尺度感知而失效。
Method: 构建 73M 实例的多分辨率数据集 FBIS-73M，提出分辨率特定的数据整理流程，利用拓扑图像空间适配（topological image-space adaptation）来合并地块并强化弱物理边界；同时建立人工整理、覆盖 100 国别的零样本评测基准。
Result: Delineate Anything v2 在 mAP@0.5 上超过包括 Delineate Anything 在内的现有最优方法，绝对提升 0.284（相对 +103.3%），并在消费级工作站上以 5.4 小时完成乌克兰全国（603,000 km^2）的快速部署。
Conclusion: 作者强调该模型具备快速的国家级与全球尺度部署能力，并公开了代码、预训练权重、FBIS-73M 数据集以及可直接使用的国家尺度矢量边界产品。

papers.title: HindsightBench: A Black-Box Behavioral Audit Protocol for Parametric Hindsight in Time-Indexed LLM Decision Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large language models leak parametric knowledge of what followed a historical date into decision tasks indexed by that date -- not necessarily a lookup of the realized outcome, but knowledge of the period all the same. Existence is settled; what users lack is a cheap way to audit a given model. We present HindsightBench, a black-box audit protocol that profiles parametric hindsight in any time-indexed LLM decision task at probe-level cost (no backtests, no logprobs, no corpus access). It chains a four-arm date-manipulation matrix (revealed/date-only/masked/transplanted), dual memory probes (date recovery; outcome recall), and six metrics -- trigger strength, transplant effect, post-cutoff placebo, recoverability, behaviorally effective cutoff, and recall-accuracy dissociation -- with explicit gates where identifiability is data-dependent. Applied to 15 models from seven vendors on a 258-node vintage-correct macro panel, it yields three patterns: (i) the date-trigger reflex is not a scale phenomenon -- it tracks training recency, though what installs it is not identified here: absent across every 2024 open-weight row where it is measurable, including a 70B tier with cutoff-aligned recall propensity, present in every tested 2026-generation model, and switching on within one vendor lineage (Qwen3 -> Qwen3.6) in the same MoE family at ~3B active; (ii) effective cutoffs span 22 months across vendors and precede vendor-reported dates by up to eight months, invalidating calendar-window placebos; (iii) results are not invariant to serving -- BF16 serving of an FP8-referenced model breaks the trigger estimate's stability while AWQ-INT4 preserves it, and a provider-locked reasoning regime makes one probe non-convergent -- so the protocol pins quantization and thinking regime as part of its contract. We release the panel, preregistrations, audit rows, transcripts, and one-command regeneration.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 3 figures. Code, panel, and per-model audit rows: https://github.com/Khaozhe/hindsightbench (v1.0 release archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21453191)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HindsightBench，一个黑盒行为审计协议，用于在时间索引的 LLM 决策任务中刻画参数化后见（parametric hindsight），即以探针级成本评估模型是否泄露历史日期之后的知识。协议结合四臂日期操作矩阵、双记忆探针和六项指标，并在 15 个厂商模型的宏观面板上发现：日期触发反射并非规模现象而是与训练新鲜度相关，有效截止日期（effective cutoff）跨厂商差异大，且结果对 serving 配置敏感。
Motivation: 大语言模型会把历史日期之后发生的参数化知识带入以该日期为索引的决策任务，用户缺乏低成本的黑盒手段来审计具体模型是否具有这种后见偏差。
Method: 设计四臂日期操作矩阵（revealed/date-only/masked/transplanted），配合双记忆探针（日期恢复与结果回忆），并定义六项指标：触发强度、移植效应、截止后安慰剂、可恢复性、行为有效截止日期、回忆-准确率解离，且对数据依赖的识别性问题设置显式门控。
Result: 在来自七家厂商的 15 个模型、258 节点 vintage-correct 宏观面板上，发现日期触发反射在 2024 年开源模型中不可测但存在于所有 2026 代模型，并可在同一 MoE 家族（Qwen3 到 Qwen3.6）中开启；有效截止日期跨厂商跨度达 22 个月，可比厂商报告日期早八个月；BF16 serving 会破坏 FP8 参考模型的触发估计稳定性，而 AWQ-INT4 保持稳定，且受限推理模式导致一个探针不收敛。

papers.title: ChannelGuard: Safe Models Do Not Compose into Safe Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM applications chain a planner, worker agents, a verifier, and a synthesizer, and every hop between agents is an unmonitored channel through which an adversary can smuggle instructions. Existing defenses guard only the input boundary (IBProtector, Llama Guard, perplexity filters, SmoothLLM) or run outside the application as opaque, stochastic provider-side filters. We show this gap carries a consequence rarely measured: on a 2,100-trace evaluation across eight attack families, five defenses, and three model backends, an undefended pipeline that appears fully safe under standard reporting (attack success 0.000 on tool- and memory-poisoning) owes that safety almost entirely to the cloud provider's server-side filter (54 of 60 blocks on Azure GPT-5), and silently shifts to the agent model's own alignment on a backend without such a filter. Outcome-only reporting hides this dependence. We present ChannelGuard, a training-free defense-in-depth framework placing information-bottleneck gates on every inter-agent channel; each scores channel text against an adversarial phrase bank by embedding similarity and deterministically passes, compresses, or blocks it, adding no LLM call, while an attribution method records which layer stopped each attack. ChannelGuard's tool-output gate blocks Tool Poisoning 30 of 30 at the application layer, identically across Azure GPT-5, Anthropic Sonnet 4.5, and Anthropic Haiku 4.5, whereas the undefended pipeline shifts entirely across backends; it also lowers Prompt Injection attack success by half (0.333 to 0.167) and preserves GSM8K accuracy exactly (0.867). White-box adaptive paraphrase evades every embedding gate, where a perturb-and-vote baseline does better. An extended appendix adds baselines, ablations, sweeps, a benign-preservation analysis, and a judge audit (kappa = 0.900), at a total cost of 47.36 USD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出多智能体 LLM 应用中智能体之间的每个信道都是未监控的通道，攻击者可以借此走私指令，而现有防御只保护输入边界或依赖云提供商的外部过滤器。作者在 2,100 条痕迹、8 类攻击、5 种防御和 3 个后端上评估，发现未防御管线在标准结果报告下看似完全安全（工具投毒与记忆投毒的 attack success 为 0.000），但这种安全几乎全部来自云供应商的服务器端过滤（Azure GPT-5 上 60 个拦截中有 54 个），换到无此类过滤的后端时会静默转移到智能体模型自身的对齐。为此提出 ChannelGuard，一种免训练的分层防御框架，在每个智能体间信道上放置信息瓶颈门，按嵌入相似度对文本打分并确定性地放行、压缩或阻断，不增加 LLM 调用，并附带记录各层拦截来源的归因方法。
Motivation: 现有防御（如 IBProtector、Llama Guard、perplexity filters、SmoothLLM）只防护输入边界，或作为应用外的不透明随机过滤器运行，中间智能体信道缺乏监控，成为指令走私的漏洞。
Method: 提出 ChannelGuard，一种免训练 (training-free) 的分层防御框架，在每个智能体间信道上放置信息瓶颈门 (information-bottleneck gates)；每个门利用嵌入相似度将信道文本与对抗短语库比对，并确定性地选择放行、压缩或阻断，且不增加额外 LLM 调用；还提供归因方法记录每个攻击由哪一层拦截。
Result: 在 2,100 条痕迹、8 类攻击、5 种防御和 3 个后端上，未防御管线在标准报告下对工具投毒和记忆投毒的 attack success 为 0.000，但该安全主要来自 Azure GPT-5 的服务器端过滤器（60 个拦截中 54 个）；ChannelGuard 的工具输出门在应用层将 Tool Poisoning 30/30 全部阻断，且在 Azure GPT-5、Anthropic Sonnet 4.5 和 Anthropic Haiku 4.5 上表现一致，而 Prompt Injection 成功率从 0.333 降至 0.167，GSM8K 准确率保持 0.867 不变；但白盒自适应改写 (adaptive paraphrase) 可绕过所有嵌入门，且 perturb-and-vote 基线表现更好。
Conclusion: 本文强调仅看结果型报告会掩盖对云提供商过滤器的依赖，主张对多智能体系统采用覆盖每个信道的分层防御；同时指出嵌入相似度门对白盒自适应改写的脆弱性是当前方案的局限。

papers.title: FlashRT: Agent Harness for Guiding Agents to Deploy Real-Time Multimodal Applications
papers.abstract_en: Real-time multimodal applications, including voice agents and interactive video generation, compose heterogeneous models into pipelines whose efficient deployment requires application-specific decisions about placement, streaming, and intra-model parallelism. Existing serving systems and auto-parallelism compilers commit to limited transformations and fixed workload assumptions, so achieving high performance on a new application requires hand-crafting an efficient implementation. We present FlashRT, an agent harness that guides coding agents to lift simple developer-written reference implementations into optimized multi-GPU deployments that flexibly weigh target metrics like latency and throughput. Using a new chain-of-program paradigm, FlashRT directs a generic coding agent through a multi-pass transformation process where an agent transforms the reference into an intermediate representation (IR) to capture data dependencies and persistent-state scopes, validates this IR via a sequential interpreter, and performs static analyses to identify candidate transformations. Then, the agent iteratively implements, verifies, and benchmarks each candidate under a measurement-gated optimization loop to produce effective deployments that span different hardware budgets. Across various applications, including video world models and multimodal LLMs, FlashRT converts reference implementations into highly efficient deployments, delivering up to ~70x latency reduction and 2.8x throughput improvement on NVIDIA B200 GPUs. On AMD MI355X GPUs, FlashRT matches the peak latency reduction while increasing peak throughput improvement to 3.6x, demonstrating that agent-driven optimization can be more scalable on platforms with less mature expert optimization. In fact, for Qwen3-Omni text-to-audio inference, FlashRT reduces response latency by 65% compared to the expert vLLM-Omni implementation on AMD MI355X.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlashRT，一个引导编码 agent 将简单的开发者参考实现自动优化为多 GPU 部署的 agent harness，面向实时多模态应用（如语音 agent 和交互式视频生成）。它采用 chain-of-program 范式，通过多遍转换过程让 agent 生成中间表示 (IR)、用顺序解释器验证、做静态分析识别候选变换，并在测量门控的优化循环中迭代实现、验证和基准测试。摘要报告在 NVIDIA B200 上最高约 70 倍延迟降低和 2.8 倍吞吐提升，在 AMD MI355X 上匹配峰值延迟降低并将吞吐提升提高到 3.6 倍。
Motivation: 实时多模态应用将异构模型组合成流水线，其高效部署依赖与具体应用相关的放置、流式和模型内并行决策；现有 serving 系统与自动并行编译器只支持有限的变换并假设固定工作负载，导致新应用需要手工编写高效实现。
Method: FlashRT 提出 chain-of-program 范式，指导通用编码 agent 对参考实现进行多遍转换：先将其变换为捕获数据依赖和持久状态作用域的中间表示 (IR)，通过顺序解释器验证 IR，并执行静态分析以识别候选变换；随后 agent 在测量门控的优化循环中迭代实现、验证和基准测试每个候选，生成可权衡延迟与吞吐等指标的部署。
Result: 在视频世界模型和多模态 LLM 等多种应用上，FlashRT 在 NVIDIA B200 上带来最高约 70 倍延迟降低和 2.8 倍吞吐提升；在 AMD MI355X 上保持峰值延迟降低的同时将峰值吞吐提升提高到 3.6 倍。对于 Qwen3-Omni 的文本到音频推理，FlashRT 在 AMD MI355X 上相比专家实现的 vLLM-Omni 将响应延迟降低 65%。
Conclusion: 摘要指出 agent 驱动的优化在专家优化尚不成熟的平台上可以更具可扩展性，并以 AMD MI355X 上的结果作为支撑；整体上 FlashRT 旨在把人工调优过程自动化到不同硬件预算上。
