papers.title: An Auto-Scaling Approach for Serverless Environments Based on a Multi-Expert Consensus Mechanism
papers.abstract_en: Serverless computing provides automatic resource management and pay-per-use execution, but effective autoscaling remains challenging because of dynamic workloads, cold-start latency, and dependencies among functions. We present a dependency-aware autoscaling framework that integrates graph-based bottleneck identification, short-term workload forecasting, multi-model consensus, and cost-aware scaling control. Serverless applications are represented as directed dependency graphs, and structurally important functions are identified using weighted degree centrality. Resource demand is predicted using lightweight MLP, LSTM, and CNN models. Their outputs are combined through a performance-weighted probabilistic ensemble inspired by Bayesian model averaging. The controller further incorporates cold-start awareness and cost comparison to select among scale-up, scale-down, and hold actions. Experiments using real workload traces show that supervised forecasting substantially outperforms unsupervised clustering for autoscaling decision generation. The proposed ensemble achieves 99.88 percent prediction accuracy and reduces prediction error compared with representative hybrid forecasting methods. Evaluations across multiple cloud pricing models also demonstrate consistent infrastructure cost reductions while maintaining performance targets. The results show that combining dependency analysis, multi-expert forecasting, and cost-aware control provides a robust and practical solution for serverless autoscaling.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 10 figures, 10 tables, and 7 algorithms. Published in the Journal of Ambient Intelligence and Smart Environments
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Ambient Intelligence and Smart Environments, 2026, pp. 1-26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向 Serverless 环境的依赖感知自动扩缩容框架，将应用建模为有向依赖图，用加权度中心性识别关键函数，并借助 MLP、LSTM、CNN 三种轻量模型进行短期工作负载预测。预测结果通过类似贝叶斯模型平均的性能加权概率集成融合，控制器结合冷启动感知与成本比较在扩容、缩容与保持之间决策。真实工作负载轨迹实验显示，有监督预测显著优于无监督聚类，集成方法达到 99.88% 的预测准确率，并在多种云计费模型下降低基础设施成本。
Motivation: Serverless 计算虽有自动资源管理与按用付费特性，但动态工作负载、冷启动延迟以及函数间依赖关系使得有效自动扩缩容仍然困难，现有方法在决策生成与成本控制上存在不足。
Method: 提出依赖感知框架：将 Serverless 应用表示为有向依赖图并用加权度中心性识别结构重要函数；用 MLP、LSTM、CNN 进行短期资源需求预测，再通过受贝叶斯模型平均启发的性能加权概率集成组合多个模型的输出；控制器引入冷启动感知与成本比较来选择 scale-up、scale-down 或 hold 动作。
Result: 实验表明有监督预测在自动扩缩容决策生成上明显优于无监督聚类；所提集成预测准确率达 99.88%，预测误差低于代表性混合预测方法；在多个云定价模型下均能在维持性能目标的同时降低基础设施成本。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合依赖分析、多专家预测与成本感知控制的方案为 Serverless 自动扩缩容提供了稳健且实用的解决途径。

papers.title: LLM-Driven AutoML for Cross-Lingual Handwritten OCR: Closed-Loop Neural Architecture Search with GPT-5, GPT-4o, and Claude Sonnet 4
papers.abstract_en: We present a fully automated closed-loop AutoML framework that uses GPT-5, GPT-4o, and Claude Sonnet 4 as autonomous neural architecture designers for cross-lingual handwritten optical character recognition. Each large language model independently generates, trains, evaluates, and iteratively refines neural network architectures using performance feedback from previous trials. The framework is evaluated on Arabic, Persian, and English handwriting datasets through 270 independent experiments. It consistently discovers accurate and computationally efficient models without manual architecture design, domain-specific preprocessing, or hyperparameter tuning. The generated models achieve mean test accuracies above 93 percent, a best accuracy of 98.1 percent, and inference latency between 41 and 44 milliseconds. The results demonstrate that large language models can function as effective AutoML agents for neural architecture search, enabling scalable, script-adaptive, and reproducible handwriting recognition across languages.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个全自动闭环 AutoML 框架，使用 GPT-5、GPT-4o 和 Claude Sonnet 4 作为自主神经架构设计器，面向跨语言手写 OCR。各 LLM 独立生成、训练、评估并根据前次试验的性能反馈迭代改进网络结构。框架在阿拉伯语、波斯语和英语手写数据集上通过 270 次独立实验验证，无需人工架构设计、领域特定预处理或超参数调整即发现准确且计算高效的模型。
Motivation: 跨语言手写 OCR 通常依赖人工架构设计、领域特定预处理和繁琐的超参数调整，难以扩展到多种文字系统；论文希望用大语言模型取代这些人工环节，实现可规模化、适应不同脚本的自动识别。

Conclusion: 作者认为结果证明大语言模型可作为有效的 AutoML 代理进行神经架构搜索，支持跨语言、可复现且无需人工干预的手写识别；同时强调过程中不需要手动架构设计、特定预处理或超参数调优。

papers.title: Concept-Guided Spatial Regularization for World Models in Atari Pong
papers.abstract_en: World models are usually evaluated as components of model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) systems, leaving their standalone reliability understudied. We reproduce five visual world-model agents in Atari Pong -- DreamerV3, DIAMOND, TWISTER, Simulus, and STORM -- and match their reported agent performance. We then freeze the learned world models and evaluate them in two ways. In a closed-loop rollout diagnostic, a policy trained separately from the corresponding MBRL agent interacts with each frozen model, and we inspect the generated visual trajectories for visual and dynamical errors. Across all five models, these rollouts contain clear failures, including ball disappearance, incorrect motion, and invalid ball-paddle interactions. Beyond visual trajectories, we further evaluate the frozen models with pixel-space zero-shot MBRL, a challenging setting in which a new policy is trained entirely inside each frozen world model and then evaluated in the real environment. Across all five models, these policies substantially underperform those produced by the corresponding original MBRL pipelines. For DreamerV3, mean return drops from $-5.5$ to $-20.9$, near the minimum of $-21$. We hypothesize that insufficient modeling of task-critical concepts, such as the ball in Pong, contributes to these failures and propose Concept-Guided Spatial Regularization (CGSReg), an auxiliary reconstruction loss on segmented concept regions. CGSReg improves both closed-loop rollouts and pixel-space zero-shot MBRL in DreamerV3, DIAMOND, and TWISTER, and improves zero-shot MBRL in Simulus; STORM shows no clear improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 Atari Pong 中复现了五种视觉世界模型（DreamerV3、DIAMOND、TWISTER、Simulus、STORM），发现冻结后的世界模型在闭环 rollout 中产生球消失、错误运动等视觉与动力学失败，并在像素空间零样本 MBRL 中明显逊于原 MBRL 流程。作者提出 Concept-Guided Spatial Regularization (CGSReg)，一种对分割出的概念区域施加辅助重建损失的训练目标，可改善多数模型的闭环 rollout 与零样本 MBRL 性能。
Motivation: 世界模型通常只作为 MBRL 系统的一部分被评估，其独立可靠性（standalone reliability）研究不足；作者希望直接诊断冻结世界模型本身是否忠实建模了任务关键概念（如 Pong 中的球）。
Method: 先将五个世界模型在 Atari Pong 上复现并匹配报告的智能体性能，冻结模型后进行两类评估：闭环 rollout 诊断（用单独训练的策略与冻结模型交互并检查视觉轨迹）和像素空间零样本 MBRL（在冻结模型内从头训练新策略再放到真实环境评测）。针对失败模式，提出 CGSReg，即在分割出的概念区域上添加辅助重建损失。
Result: 五种模型在闭环 rollout 中均出现球消失、错误运动、球-挡板交互无效等明显失败；像素空间零样本 MBRL 中，DreamerV3 的平均回报从 -5.5 降至 -20.9（接近最低 -21）。CGSReg 改善了 DreamerV3、DIAMOND、TWISTER 的闭环 rollout 与零样本 MBRL，也改善了 Simulus 的零样本 MBRL；STORM 未见明显改进。
Conclusion: 摘要强调世界模型独立评估揭示了任务关键概念建模不足是失败的重要来源，并表明 CGSReg 这类概念引导的空间正则化可以缓解部分失败，但并非对所有模型都有效。

papers.title: Experience Memory Graph: One-Shot Error Correction for Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown remarkable capabilities in autonomous decision-making by generating sequential trajectories of states, actions, and observations. However, in complex, long-horizon tasks, these agents frequently suffer from compounding errors and struggle to recover from failures. Existing self-correction mechanisms rely on prompt-based reflection, which is inherently brittle, incurs heavy time and API costs due to iterative trial-and-error loops, and produces task-specific memory that may be hard to generalize to new scenarios. To address this, we propose Experience Memory Graph (EMG), a framework that reformulates agent failure recovery as a graph matching problem. At training time, we convert both failed exploration trajectories and successful expert trajectories into directed action decision graphs. By matching these graphs, we extract common subgraphs (successful workflows) and graph edit paths that explicitly indicate how to correct failures (e.g., which actions to add, delete, or relabel under a given observation), and store them in a memory graph with intra-task nodes and cross-task edges. At test time, EMG retrieves relevant insights and guides the agent in a single, loop-free execution. Experiments on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld show that EMG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art reflection baselines in success rate and average reward, while requiring no test-time trial-and-error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Experience Memory Graph (EMG)，将 LLM agent 的失败恢复重构为图匹配问题：把失败探索轨迹与成功专家轨迹转为有向动作决策图，提取公共子图与图编辑路径作为纠正知识，测试时单次无循环执行。实验在 ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 上以更高成功率与平均奖励超越基于 reflection 的基线，且无需测试时试错。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 自我纠正依赖 prompt-based reflection，机制脆弱、迭代试错带来高时间与 API 成本，且生成的任务特定记忆难以泛化到新场景。
Method: 训练阶段把失败轨迹和成功轨迹转换为有向动作决策图，通过图匹配提取公共子图（成功工作流）及图编辑路径（在给定观察下应增删或重标哪些动作），并存入带任务内节点与跨任务边的记忆图；测试阶段检索相关洞察并引导 agent 执行单次无循环轨迹。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 与 ScienceWorld 上，EMG 的成功率和平均奖励持续优于 SOTA reflection 基线，同时不依赖测试时 trial-and-error。
Conclusion: EMG 的价值在于把失败纠正显式编码为图编辑路径并复用跨任务结构，避免迭代反思的高开销；摘要未提供关于方法局限或消融的更多细节。

papers.title: HIVE-3D: Hierarchical Voxel Enhancement for High-Quality 3D Scene Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recently, a line of works can generate impressive 3D objects from a single image, but they are limited by restricted representation resolution, making them unsuitable for 3D scene generation. In this work, we introduce HIVE-3D, a novel method for high-quality 3D scene generation based on hierarchical voxel enhancement framework. Specifically, given a single scene image as input, we first produce a coarse initial scene, then introduce image segmentation and attention-based retrieval to align 2D image components with 3D scene components. Subsequently, we organize these scene relations into a hierarchical component tree, where nodes closer to the leaves denote finer-grained components. Finally, we propose a voxel super-resolution model that generates refined voxels for the target instance while maintaining strong consistency with the coarse voxels. Equipped with this model, we perform coarse-to-fine hierarchical super-resolution on images and voxels for each component, producing a high-resolution and high-quality 3D scene. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms previous approaches, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). Project page: https://xbdff.github.io/HIVE-3D/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HIVE-3D，一种基于层次化体素增强框架的高质量 3D 场景生成方法，从单张场景图像生成高分辨率 3D 场景。方法先产生粗略初始场景，再通过图像分割与基于注意力的检索对齐 2D 图像组件和 3D 场景组件，构建层次化组件树，最后用体素超分模型对每个组件执行从粗到细的层次化超分。实验表明该方法显著优于现有方法，达到当前最优性能。
Motivation: 现有从单图像生成 3D 物体的方法受限于表征分辨率，难以适用于 3D 场景生成，本文针对这一分辨率瓶颈提出场景级的高质量生成方案。
Method: 流程包括：输入单张场景图像后先生成粗略初始场景；利用图像分割和基于注意力 (attention) 的检索将 2D 图像组件与 3D 场景组件对齐；将场景关系组织为层次化组件树，靠近叶子的节点表示更细粒度的组件；提出体素超分辨率 (voxel super-resolution) 模型，在保持与粗略体素强一致性的前提下为每个目标实例生成精细体素，并据此对每个组件进行图像与体素的由粗到细层次化超分。
Result: 大规模实验表明，HIVE-3D 在高质量 3D 场景生成上显著超越此前方法，取得 state-of-the-art 性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为层次化组件树与粗到细体素超分相结合，能够突破表征分辨率限制并生成高分辨率、高质量的 3D 场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LookME: Lookup-Based Multimodal Embeddings for Layer Injection in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong progress in multimodal understanding. However, scaling dense or sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models to improve performance limits deployment in resource-constrained environments due to the trade-off between high memory usage from full loading and increased latency from on-demand loading. Recently, the Per-Layer Embedding (PLE) architecture addresses this by scaling models with large external embedding tables stored in read-only memory (ROM) and performing lightweight lookup to retrieve relevant embeddings to enhance token representations. Nevertheless, existing PLE-style methods are primarily designed for text embeddings due to the convenience of ID-based retrieval, limiting their effectiveness in VLMs where multimodal embeddings contain richer information for visual tasks. In this paper, we propose LookME, the first framework that enables lookup-based enhancement for multimodal embeddings in VLMs while supporting partitioned storage and on-demand loading. To efficiently lookup arbitrary continuous multimodal embeddings from large-scale embedding tables, we propose a hierarchical two-level lookup method employing a coarse-to-fine strategy that performs lookups from the scene-level to the intra-scene primitive-level. Furthermore, we integrate the lookup method with a sparse injection strategy, which adaptively prioritizes critical embeddings over voluminous multimodal embeddings within layers, and facilitates embedding table reuse across neighboring layers, improving the trade-off among efficiency, model size, and performance. Experiments on multiple visual benchmarks show that LookME outperforms text-only PLE-style methods, validating the effectiveness of lookup-based multimodal embedding enhancement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LookME，据称是首个在视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 中支持基于查找 (lookup) 的多模态嵌入增强的框架，具备分区存储与按需加载能力。方法采用层级式两级查找（scene-level 到 intra-scene primitive-level）的粗到细策略处理任意连续多模态嵌入，并结合稀疏注入策略自适应选择关键嵌入、支持邻近层嵌入表复用。实验在多个视觉基准上显示其优于仅文本的 PLE (Per-Layer Embedding) 风格方法。
Motivation: 稠密或稀疏 MoE 扩展在资源受限环境中面临高内存占用与高加载延迟的权衡；现有 PLE 架构虽用 ROM 中大型外部嵌入表加轻量查找来扩展模型，但主要支持 ID 检索的文本嵌入，难以有效处理包含更丰富视觉信息的多模态嵌入。
Method: 提出两级层级查找方法，采用从 scene-level 到 intra-scene primitive-level 的粗到细策略，查找大表中任意连续多模态嵌入；并将查找与稀疏注入 (sparse injection) 策略结合，自适应优先加载关键嵌入，支持嵌入表在邻近层间复用以及分区存储和按需加载。
Result: 在多个视觉基准上，LookME 的表现优于仅文本的 PLE 风格方法，验证了基于查找的多模态嵌入增强的有效性；摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架首次把查找式增强从文本嵌入扩展到 VLM 的多模态嵌入，并改善了效率、模型大小与性能之间的权衡；未提及明显局限性。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 LookME，据称是首个在视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 中支持基于查找 (lookup) 的多模态嵌入增强的框架，具备分区存储与按需加载能力。方法采用层级式两级查找（scene-level 到 intra-scene primitive-level）的粗到细策略处理任意连续多模态嵌入，并结合稀疏注入策略自适应选择关键嵌入、支持邻近层嵌入表复用。实验在多个视觉基准上显示其优于仅文本的 PLE (Per-Layer Embedding) 风格方法。
summary_sections.motivation: 稠密或稀疏 MoE 扩展在资源受限环境中面临高内存占用与高加载延迟的权衡；现有 PLE 架构虽用 ROM 中大型外部嵌入表加轻量查找来扩展模型，但主要支持 ID 检索的文本嵌入，难以有效处理包含更丰富视觉信息的多模态嵌入。
summary_sections.method: 提出两级层级查找方法，采用从 scene-level 到 intra-scene primitive-level 的粗到细策略，查找大表中任意连续多模态嵌入；并将查找与稀疏注入 (sparse injection) 策略结合，自适应优先加载关键嵌入，支持嵌入表在邻近层间复用以及分区存储和按需加载。
summary_sections.result: 在多个视觉基准上，LookME 的表现优于仅文本的 PLE 风格方法，验证了基于查找的多模态嵌入增强的有效性；摘要未报告具体数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该框架首次把查找式增强从文本嵌入扩展到 VLM 的多模态嵌入，并改善了效率、模型大小与性能之间的权衡；未提及明显局限性。

papers.title: Proxy OPD: On-Policy Distillation with Transferable Relative Proxy Update
papers.abstract_en: Post-training for large language models typically couples policy exploration with model optimization, hindering the reuse of high-reward behaviors from policy exploration. While on-policy distillation alleviates this by consolidating independently optimized experts, its reliance on matching absolute expert distributions can yield suboptimal supervision, especially when the target model possesses a different prior or already surpasses the expert's capabilities. To alleviate this, we introduce Proxy OPD (P-OPD), an asynchronous post-training framework that transfers reward-induced policy improvements rather than absolute policy distributions. P-OPD first optimizes a proxy policy via reward feedback. It then extracts the relative distributional changes between the proxy's initial and optimized states, transferring these directional updates through the target model's own on-policy trajectories while retaining the target policy as the reference. This decoupled formulation requires the proxy to provide merely a useful direction of improvement rather than superior absolute capability, enabling update signals from older or weaker proxies to remain highly effective. Systematic experiments on Qwen3-family models across mathematical reasoning and code generation demonstrate that P-OPD consistently enhances already strong target models. Furthermore, transfer intensity can be dynamically modulated through signal scaling, making the extracted update signals seamlessly reusable across diverse model variants and training configurations. These results establish relative policy updates as highly reusable, adjustable assets for scalable, reward-based post-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Proxy OPD (P-OPD)，一种异步后训练框架，用于把奖励驱动的策略改进（而非绝对策略分布）从代理策略迁移到目标 LLM。P-OPD 先通过奖励反馈优化代理策略，提取代理初始与优化状态之间的相对分布变化，再沿目标模型自身的 on-policy 轨迹施加这些方向性更新，并以目标策略作为参考。基于 Qwen3 系列模型在数学推理和代码生成上的系统实验显示，该方法能持续增强已经很强的目标模型，并可通过信号缩放调节迁移强度。
Motivation: 大模型后训练通常将策略探索与模型优化耦合，难以复用探索中产生的高奖励行为；on-policy distillation 虽可整合独立优化的专家，但依赖匹配绝对专家分布，在目标模型先验不同或已超越专家能力时会提供次优监督。
Method: P-OPD 将代理策略初始状态与优化状态之间的相对分布变化作为可迁移的更新信号，在保持目标策略为参考分布的前提下，通过目标模型自身的 on-policy 轨迹进行传递。这种解耦设计允许代理只需提供有用的改进方向而非绝对能力，并可用信号缩放动态调节迁移强度。
Result: 在 Qwen3 系列模型上的数学推理和代码生成系统实验中，P-OPD 持续增强原本已强的目标模型；信号缩放可动态调节迁移强度，使提取的更新信号能复用于不同模型变体和训练配置。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 摘要将相对策略更新定位为可复用、可调节的后训练资产，支持大规模基于奖励的 LLM 后训练；摘要未讨论明确的局限性。

papers.title: ActiveFly-Bench: Aligning Embodied Question Answering with Vision-Language-Action for Aerial Embodied Perception
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ActiveFly-Bench, the first benchmark to bridge cyberspace reasoning and physical-world interaction for UAV embodied perception. The benchmark decomposes active perception into three hierarchical tasks: Aerial Embodied Question Answering (Air-EQA), Observation Behavior Planning (OBP), and Fine-grained Language-guided UAV Control (FLUC), explicitly connecting high-level task understanding, behavior planning, and low-level control. The datasets are collected from both real-world and simulated outdoor environments for training and evaluation. We further develop ActiveFly, a closed-loop UAV agent that integrates visual-language reasoning with fine-grained control, and deploy it on a physical UAV platform. Experiments with representative VLMs and VLA models show that current UAV agents still struggle with behavior planning, viewpoint adjustment, and robust task completion in active perception. These results establish ActiveFly-Bench as a new testbed for embodied aerial intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ActiveFly-Bench，自称首个将虚拟空间推理与物理世界交互衔接的 UAV 具身感知基准，把主动感知拆解为 Aerial Embodied Question Answering (Air-EQA)、Observation Behavior Planning (OBP) 和 Fine-grained Language-guided UAV Control (FLUC) 三个层次化任务。作者还开发了闭环 UAV 智能体 ActiveFly，并在真实物理 UAV 平台上部署。实验显示当前 VLM 和 VLA 模型在行为规划、视角调整和主动感知任务完成上仍存在明显不足。
Motivation: 无人机主动感知缺乏一个能把高层任务理解、行为规划与低层控制显式串联起来的评测基准，现有工作往往割裂视觉-语言推理与物理交互。
Method: 构建 ActiveFly-Bench，数据集同时来自真实户外环境和仿真环境；并开发 ActiveFly 闭环 UAV 智能体，将视觉-语言推理与细粒度控制集成并部署到实体 UAV 平台上。
Result: 用代表性 VLM 和 VLA 模型进行实验，结果表明当前 UAV 智能体在行为规划、视角调整以及主动感知任务鲁棒完成方面仍然困难。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果使 ActiveFly-Bench 成为面向具身空中智能的新测试平台，强调该方向仍需改进行为规划与物理交互能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EHR-MPC: Inference-Time Control for Sepsis Treatment with Generative Patient Digital Twins
papers.abstract_en: Sepsis is a leading cause of mortality, yet optimal treatment policies remain contested. Existing reinforcement learning (RL) approaches learn fixed strategies for sepsis treatment, limiting adaptability to changing clinical objectives during inference. We propose EHRMPC, a framework that decouples learning patient dynamics from optimizing treatment by training a patient digital twin in the form of a generative electronic health record (EHR) model. The digital twin predicts clinical trajectories under interventions and enables model predictive control (MPC) to optimize treatments via inference-time planning over simulations. We evaluate EHR-MPC on a multicenter ICU sepsis cohort spanning 8 hospitals in the Mass General Brigham health system using both off-policy importance sampling and on-policy simulation-based evaluation. Relative to RL baselines, EHR-MPC achieves comparable off-policy performance and improved simulation performance. Unlike RL, this work frames sepsis treatment optimization as inference-time control over learned patient dynamics, establishing a general framework for decision making with generative clinical models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EHR-MPC，将脓毒症治疗优化建模为基于生成式电子健康记录（EHR）数字孪生的推理时控制问题。该方法先训练一个生成式 EHR 模型作为患者数字孪生以预测干预下的临床轨迹，再通过模型预测控制（MPC）在仿真规划中优化治疗。在 Mass General Brigham 系统内 8 家医院的多中心 ICU 脓毒症队列上，与 RL 基线相比，该方法在离策略评估中表现相当，在基于仿真的在策略评估中表现更好。
Motivation: 现有强化学习（RL）方法为脓毒症治疗学习固定策略，在推理阶段难以适应不断变化的临床目标，限制了治疗的适应性。
Method: 将学习患者动力学与优化治疗解耦：训练生成式 EHR 模型作为患者数字孪生来预测干预后的临床轨迹，然后在推理时通过模型预测控制（MPC）在仿真中进行治疗规划。
Result: 在覆盖 Mass General Brigham 系统 8 家医院的多中心 ICU 脓毒症队列上，采用离策略重要性采样和在策略仿真两种评估；与 RL 基线相比，离策略性能相当，仿真性能更优。
Conclusion: 作者将脓毒症治疗优化重构为对所学患者动力学的推理时控制，提出一种基于生成式临床模型的通用决策框架。

papers.title: Demonstrating TOFFEE: A Learned System for Synthesizing Data Agent Trajectories at Scale
papers.abstract_en: LLM-powered data agents are playing an increasingly important role in data-driven decision making. However, existing data agents struggle to generalize to unseen data environments and analytical workflows, especially in heterogeneous enterprise settings. This creates a growing need for synthesizing high-quality data agent trajectories that capture complex analytical workflows for given data environments. Such trajectories support two key downstream uses: they can serve as supervised finetuning (SFT) data that adapts data agent models to the target domain, and as in-context learning (ICL) demonstrations to guide general-purpose LLMs in unfamiliar data environments. Thus, we introduce TOFFEE, a system for synthesizing high-quality data agent trajectories from given data environments via Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with adaptive model selection and cross-task prefix reuse. We show that TOFFEE can effectively generate scalable trajectory data for complex analytical tasks across heterogeneous environments. In this demonstration, we present the system framework of TOFFEE, including its task pool construction, trajectory explorer, and learned cost model. We also introduce the web interface of TOFFEE and its workflow, and demonstrate two end-to-end scenarios: trajectory synthesis for data agent finetuning, and demonstration-augmented data agent reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TOFFEE，一个从给定数据环境合成高质量数据智能体轨迹 (data agent trajectories) 的系统，用于支撑监督微调 (SFT) 和上下文学习 (ICL) 演示。系统基于蒙特卡洛树搜索 (MCTS)，并引入自适应模型选择与跨任务前缀复用，可在异构环境中为复杂分析任务生成可扩展的轨迹数据。论文以 VLDB 2026 演示形式展示其系统框架、网页界面与两个端到端场景。
Motivation: 现有的 LLM 驱动数据智能体难以泛化到未见过的数据环境与分析工作流，尤其在异构企业场景中；因此需要能够捕获复杂分析工作流的高质量数据智能体轨迹，用于模型微调与上下文演示。
Method: TOFFEE 通过 MCTS 进行轨迹搜索，结合自适应模型选择 (adaptive model selection) 与跨任务前缀复用 (cross-task prefix reuse)；系统框架包含任务池构建、轨迹探索器 (trajectory explorer) 与学习的成本模型，并提供网页界面和工作流。
Result: 摘要称 TOFFEE 能有效为跨异构环境的复杂分析任务生成可扩展的轨迹数据，并演示了两种端到端场景：面向数据智能体微调的轨迹合成，以及演示增强的数据智能体推理。
Conclusion: 该系统证明了通过 MCTS 与自适应搜索策略合成数据智能体轨迹的可行性，主要面向数据智能体训练与推理增强场景；本文为系统演示，具体性能指标未被摘要提及。

papers.title: RSPO: Reward-Swap Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning holds significant potential for training large language models (LLMs) to handle multi-turn interactive tasks. However, in long-horizon, multi-turn tasks characterized by sparse outcome rewards, directly training with outcome rewards often results in slow convergence due to the sparsity of signals and the lack of fine-grained feedback. Furthermore, the model may fail to learn successful trajectories that are not sampled during training, thereby limiting its performance. Conversely, while employing customized dense process rewards provides richer signals and accelerates convergence, these surrogate rewards may exhibit potential misalignment with the ground-truth outcome rewards. This inconsistency can bias the training direction and ultimately degrade the model's final performance. In this work, we propose Reward-Swap Policy Optimization (RSPO), a method designed to leverage the rich information from dense process rewards to facilitate training with outcome rewards. By utilizing a reward-swap mechanism, RSPO ensures the diversity of sampled trajectories while guaranteeing consistency between the optimization objective and the true outcome rewards, thereby elevating the performance ceiling of the model. We conduct extensive experiments on two challenging agent benchmarks, WebShop and ALFWorld. By applying our method to various reinforcement learning algorithms, including GRPO, PPO, and GiGPO, we demonstrate that RSPO achieves consistent performance improvements across different baselines and benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Reward-Swap Policy Optimization (RSPO)，一种针对多轮 LLM agent 的强化学习训练方法。RSPO 通过 reward-swap 机制利用密集过程奖励 (dense process rewards) 的丰富信号来辅助稀疏结果奖励 (outcome rewards) 的训练，在 WebShop 和 ALFWorld 两个 agent 基准上应用于 GRPO、PPO、GiGPO 等算法均带来一致性能提升。
Motivation: 长程多轮任务中结果奖励稀疏且缺乏细粒度反馈，直接训练收敛慢，且模型难以学到训练中未采样的成功轨迹；而自定义的密集过程奖励虽然加速收敛，却可能与真实结果奖励不一致，从而偏置训练方向、损害最终性能。
Method: 提出奖励交换机制 (reward-swap mechanism)，在训练过程中利用密集过程奖励提高采样轨迹的多样性，同时保证优化目标与真实结果奖励保持一致，从而提升模型性能上限。
Result: 在 WebShop 和 ALFWorld 两个挑战性 agent 基准上的实验表明，将 RSPO 应用到 GRPO、PPO 和 GiGPO 等多种强化学习算法中，均获得一致的性能提升。
Conclusion: RSPO 能兼顾过程奖励的信息丰富性与结果奖励的目标一致性，适用于多轮 LLM agent 训练，并可作为多种 RL 算法的通用增强模块。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 Reward-Swap Policy Optimization (RSPO)，一种针对多轮 LLM agent 的强化学习训练方法。RSPO 通过 reward-swap 机制利用密集过程奖励 (dense process rewards) 的丰富信号来辅助稀疏结果奖励 (outcome rewards) 的训练，在 WebShop 和 ALFWorld 两个 agent 基准上应用于 GRPO、PPO、GiGPO 等算法均带来一致性能提升。
summary_sections.motivation: 长程多轮任务中结果奖励稀疏且缺乏细粒度反馈，直接训练收敛慢，且模型难以学到训练中未采样的成功轨迹；而自定义的密集过程奖励虽然加速收敛，却可能与真实结果奖励不一致，从而偏置训练方向、损害最终性能。
summary_sections.method: 提出奖励交换机制 (reward-swap mechanism)，在训练过程中利用密集过程奖励提高采样轨迹的多样性，同时保证优化目标与真实结果奖励保持一致，从而提升模型性能上限。
summary_sections.result: 在 WebShop 和 ALFWorld 两个挑战性 agent 基准上的实验表明，将 RSPO 应用到 GRPO、PPO 和 GiGPO 等多种强化学习算法中，均获得一致的性能提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: RSPO 能兼顾过程奖励的信息丰富性与结果奖励的目标一致性，适用于多轮 LLM agent 训练，并可作为多种 RL 算法的通用增强模块。

papers.title: Minimum Block Width for Universal Approximation by Residual Neural Networks with Inner Width One
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the universal approximation property of residual neural networks. For input and output dimensions $d_x$ and $d_y$, and LeakyReLU, ReLU, ReLU-like activation functions, the upper and lower bounds of the minimum block width are established. To achieve $L^p$ approximation $(1\leq p <+\infty)$ on any compact set, we show that the exact minimum block width is $\max\{d_x,d_y\}$ when each residual branch has inner width 1. Furthermore, we show that residual neural networks with block width $\min\{d_x+d_y, \max\{2d_x+1,d_y\}\}$ can achieve uniform approximation on any compact set under the constraint that each residual branch has inner width 1. Besides, for any activation function family, we prove that there exist functions that cannot be approximated by residual neural networks with block width less than $\max\{d_x, d_y\}$, both in the $L^p$ sense and the uniform sense, regardless of inner width. Consequently, for LeakyReLU, ReLU, ReLU-like activation functions and $d_y\geq 2d_x+1$, the exact minimum block width for uniform approximation is $d_y$ when each residual branch has inner width 1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究残差神经网络（residual neural networks）的通用逼近性质。针对输入输出维度d_x和d_y，在LeakyReLU、ReLU、ReLU-like激活函数下，建立了最小块宽（minimum block width）的上下界。当每个残差分支内宽（inner width）为1时，在任意紧集上L^p逼近（1≤p<+∞）的精确最小块宽为max{d_x,d_y}；在同样约束下，块宽min{d_x+d_y, max{2d_x+1,d_y}}可实现一致逼近。进一步证明对任意激活函数族，块宽小于max{d_x,d_y}时都存在无法逼近的函数，且与内宽无关。
Motivation: 该工作关注残差神经网络表达能力中的网络宽度下界问题，旨在精确刻画在给定内宽约束下实现通用逼近所需的最小块宽，为架构设计提供理论依据。
Method: 通过建立构造性上界和反例下界，针对LeakyReLU、ReLU、ReLU-like激活函数推导L^p与一致逼近意义下的最小块宽精确值，并利用一般激活函数族的反例证明不依赖内宽的下界。
Result: 摘要报告：L^p逼近的精确最小块宽为max{d_x,d_y}；一致逼近的块宽上界为min{d_x+d_y, max{2d_x+1,d_y}}；对任意激活函数族，块宽小于max{d_x,d_y}时存在无法逼近的函数（L^p和一致意义均成立）。特别地，对LeakyReLU、ReLU、ReLU-like激活函数且d_y≥2d_x+1时，一致逼近的精确最小块宽为d_y。
Conclusion: 该理论结果给出残差神经网络在分支内宽为1时的最小块宽精确界限，表明通用逼近所需宽度主要由输入输出维度决定，且块宽低于max{d_x,d_y}时不存在通用逼近。

papers.title: UI-MOPD: Multi-Platform On-Policy Distillation for Unified GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models and agent systems have driven GUI agents from single-platform task execution toward cross-platform interaction. However, unified multi-platform GUI learning remains challenging: high-quality cross-platform trajectories remain scarce, while platforms share transferable capabilities but differ in action semantics and interaction conventions. Naively mixing supervision or merging specialized models can blur native behaviors and produce imbalanced performance. To address these challenges, we construct Uni-GUI, a high-quality dataset containing nearly 10K executable cross-platform interaction trajectories collected through a unified desktop-mobile harness. Building on Uni-GUI, we propose UI-MOPD, the first framework to introduce multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) into unified multi-platform GUI agent training. UI-MOPD trains a shared student on its own rollouts and dynamically routes each rollout to the corresponding platform-specialized teacher. At student-visited states, teacher guidance serves as a platform-conditioned behavioral anchor, enabling the integration of complementary desktop and mobile expertise without averaging their distinct interaction conventions. On OSWorld and MobileWorld, UI-MOPD achieves task success rates of 38.2% and 12.0%, respectively, outperforming parameter-matched integration strategies while preserving general GUI grounding. These results demonstrate that multi-teacher on-policy distillation provides an effective approach to building unified cross-platform GUI agents. Project page: https://elispectre.github.io/UI-MOPD/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UI-MOPD，将多教师在线策略蒸馏 (multi-teacher on-policy distillation, MOPD) 引入统一多平台 GUI 智能体训练，并配套构建了 Uni-GUI 数据集（近 10K 条可执行跨平台交互轨迹）。训练中共享学生模型基于自身 rollouts 学习，按 rollout 动态路由到对应平台专用教师，以平台条件行为锚点整合桌面与移动端经验。在 OSWorld 和 MobileWorld 上，该方法分别达到 38.2% 和 12.0% 的任务成功率，优于参数匹配的集成策略，同时保留通用 GUI grounding。
Motivation: 统一多平台 GUI 学习面临高质量跨平台轨迹稀缺，且不同平台在动作语义与交互约定上存在差异；简单混合监督或合并专用模型会模糊原生行为，导致性能不均衡。
Method: 构建含近 10K 条可执行跨平台轨迹的 Uni-GUI 数据集，并提出 UI-MOPD，这是首个将多教师在线策略蒸馏用于统一多平台 GUI 智能体训练的框架。共享学生基于自身 rollout 训练，动态路由每个 rollout 到对应平台专家教师，教师引导作为平台条件行为锚点，避免对不同交互惯例进行简单平均。
Result: 摘要报告在 OSWorld 上任务成功率为 38.2%，在 MobileWorld 上为 12.0%，优于参数匹配的集成策略，同时保持通用 GUI grounding 能力。
Conclusion: 摘要认为多教师在线策略蒸馏为构建统一跨平台 GUI 智能体提供了有效途径。

papers.title: BitFair: A 12-nm Bit-Serial CNN Accelerator with Learnable Early Termination and Adaptive Bit Ordering for Ultra-Low-Power XR Vision
papers.abstract_en: Extended Reality (XR) wearables require always-on perception within tight power envelopes of a few watts and motion-to-photon latency budgets below 20 ms, leaving only a few milliseconds for neural-network inference. Bit-serial computing is attractive for such energy-efficient neural network acceleration, but many existing architectures still process all bits even when ReLU sets the final output to zero. This paper presents BitFair, a software-hardware co-designed bit-serial CNN accelerator with learnable bit-level early termination and adaptive bit ordering, working under the ultra-low-power and strict latency requirements of XR applications. BitFair exploits dynamic bit-level sparsity by learning per-layer thresholds that trigger early termination when partial sums reliably predict that the final ReLU output will be zero. Furthermore, it searches for layer-wise bit orders that prioritize informative bits, maximizing early termination without sacrificing accuracy. A GlobalFoundries 12-nm FinFET implementation with a core area of 0.34 mm^2, 104 KB on-chip memory, and voltage scaling from 0.55 to 0.70 V achieves sub-millisecond latency, up to 117.0 BTOPS/W, and 0.07 pJ/SOP. On IBM DVS128 Gesture and N-MNIST, BitFair achieves 96.5% and 97.7% accuracy, respectively, while improving effective energy efficiency by 4.0-22.1x and accuracy by up to 9.2% over prior fabricated XR vision accelerators.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE Journal on Emerging and Selected Topics in Circuits and Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BitFair，一个面向超低功耗 XR 视觉的软硬件协同设计的位串行 (bit-serial) CNN 加速器，采用可学习的位级提前终止 (learnable bit-level early termination) 与自适应位排序 (adaptive bit ordering)。在 GlobalFoundries 12-nm FinFET 工艺上实现，核心面积 0.34 mm²、片上存储 104 KB，电压 0.55–0.70 V 下达到亚毫秒延迟、最高 117.0 BTOPS/W 和 0.07 pJ/SOP。在 IBM DVS128 Gesture 与 N-MNIST 上分别取得 96.5% 与 97.7% 的准确率。
Motivation: XR 可穿戴设备要求常开感知，但功耗预算只有几瓦、运动到光子延迟低于 20 ms，留给神经网络推理的时间仅几毫秒。位串行计算适合此类能效需求，但许多现有架构即使 ReLU 已将最终输出置零，仍会处理所有位，造成能效与延迟浪费。
Method: 采用软硬件协同设计：学习每层阈值，在部分和可靠预测最终 ReLU 输出为零时触发提前终止；同时搜索逐层位顺序以优先处理信息量更大的位，在最大化提前终止的同时不牺牲准确率。硬件实现基于 12-nm FinFET 并支持 0.55–0.70 V 电压调节。
Result: 摘要报告该实现具有亚毫秒延迟、最高 117.0 BTOPS/W 能效与 0.07 pJ/SOP；在 IBM DVS128 Gesture 和 N-MNIST 上分别达到 96.5% 和 97.7% 准确率，相比此前已流片的 XR 视觉加速器，有效能效提升 4.0–22.1 倍，准确率最高提升 9.2%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可学习提前终止与自适应位排序相结合的软硬件协同设计能够满足 XR 应用的超低功耗与严格延迟约束，并带来显著的能效和准确率收益。

papers.title: ContextSniper: AntTrail's Token-Efficient Code Memory for Repository-Level Program Repair
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents can repair real repository issues, but they often spend large context budgets on whole-file reads, broad searches, and long terminal outputs where useful evidence is mixed with irrelevant code and logs. This paper presents ContextSniper, AntTrail's code-repair module for precision evidence selection in repository-level program repair, part of AntTrail's broader agent-memory engine. AntTrail is available at https://gitcode.com/datagallery/AntTrail. ContextSniper indexes code and action memory as three abstract levels, retrieves candidates with a hybrid ranker, filters long tool output through an intention-aware context gate, and returns compact evidence packets while keeping full source recoverable on demand. In a matched 50-task-per-condition comparison on SWE-bench Lite (same tasks, baseline vs.\ ContextSniper), ContextSniper reduces total token use by 51.5% and logged cost by 36.4% for OpenClaw, and by 38.9% and 27.3% for Claude Code, with submitted-resolution rates essentially unchanged in both host-agent settings. In a separate five-task comparison, ContextSniper beats existing memory- and RAG-style integrations on token efficiency. These results suggest ContextSniper can substantially cut token and cost overhead for repository-level repair agents without a measurable loss in repair quality. The evaluation harness for this study is available at https://gitcode.com/lukchiwang/ContextSniper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 ContextSniper，即 AntTrail 的代码修复模块，用于仓库级程序修复中的精确证据选择。它把代码与动作记忆索引为三个抽象层级，用混合排序器检索候选，通过意图感知上下文门控（intention-aware context gate）过滤冗长工具输出，并返回紧凑证据包，同时可按需恢复完整源码。在 SWE-bench Lite 上的匹配对比中（每条件 50 个任务，baseline 对比 ContextSniper），OpenClaw 场景总 token 使用减少 51.5%、记录成本减少 36.4%，Claude Code 场景分别减少 38.9% 和 27.3%，两类宿主代理的提交解决率基本不变。另有一个五任务对比显示其在 token 效率上优于现有 memory 和 RAG 类集成。
Motivation: 大型语言模型代理在修复真实仓库问题时，常把大量上下文预算花在整文件读取、宽泛搜索和长终端输出上，其中有用的证据与无关代码和日志混杂在一起。论文瞄准这一低效，希望在不损失修复质量的前提下削减 token 和成本开销。
Method: ContextSniper 将代码与动作记忆索引为三个抽象层级，使用混合排序器（hybrid ranker）检索候选，再通过意图感知上下文门控对长工具输出做过滤，最终返回紧凑证据包，同时保留完整源码的可按需恢复能力。
Result: 在 SWE-bench Lite 上每个条件 50 个任务的匹配对比中，ContextSniper 使 OpenClaw 的 token 使用减少 51.5%、记录成本减少 36.4%，使 Claude Code 的相应指标减少 38.9% 和 27.3%，两者的提交解决率基本不变。单独的五任务对比中，它在 token 效率上超过现有 memory 与 RAG 式集成。
Conclusion: 摘要指出 ContextSniper 能在不带来可测修复质量损失的情况下，大幅降低仓库级修复代理的 token 与成本开销，并认为这足以支持其作为一种有效的上下文选择方案。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: ContextSniper 将代码与动作记忆索引为三个抽象层级，使用混合排序器（hybrid ranker）检索候选，再通过意图感知上下文门控对长工具输出做过滤，最终返回紧凑证据包，同时保留完整源码的可按需恢复能力。
summary_sections.result: 在 SWE-bench Lite 上每个条件 50 个任务的匹配对比中，ContextSniper 使 OpenClaw 的 token 使用减少 51.5%、记录成本减少 36.4%，使 Claude Code 的相应指标减少 38.9% 和 27.3%，两者的提交解决率基本不变。单独的五任务对比中，它在 token 效率上超过现有 memory 与 RAG 式集成。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要指出 ContextSniper 能在不带来可测修复质量损失的情况下，大幅降低仓库级修复代理的 token 与成本开销，并认为这足以支持其作为一种有效的上下文选择方案。

papers.title: The Moving Target: A Longitudinal Audit of Trust-Benchmark Score Drift Across Open-Source Chat LLM Release Lines
papers.abstract_en: Trust-benchmark scores reported on a chat-LLM release line are often carried across several checkpoints of the same line, as if the underlying model had not shifted between releases. We test that assumption. We audit four open-source release lines (Yi, Qwen, Mistral, and Gemma) at three successive public generations each. Each checkpoint is scored on a fixed 200-item basket of five chat-evaluation benchmarks: TruthfulQA, BBQ, ToxiGen, CrowS-Pairs, and XSTest, under three prompt templates. Four of the five benchmark variants are non-canonical, and two of those are synthetic proxies. The mean absolute adjacent-generation Score Drift Rate is several times the mean of an independence-based count-level reference null. It stays in the same band when we drop a benchmark, drop a release line, switch to strict scoring, or restrict to constant-parameter-size transitions. Within this audited setup, a quoted trust score should be treated as checkpoint-bound. It should be re-measured on each materially new release rather than carried forward. Closed APIs, larger models, canonical-protocol scores, and benchmark-item-subset uncertainty are out of scope.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure; accepted at IEEE ICMLA 2026; title, presentation, and formatting revised from v1; empirical results unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对开源聊天LLM发布线上的信任基准分数漂移进行纵向审计。作者对Yi、Qwen、Mistral和Gemma四条发布线各取三个连续公共代次，在固定200项基准篮子（TruthfulQA、BBQ、ToxiGen、CrowS-Pairs、XSTest）和三种提示模板下评分，发现相邻代次间的平均绝对分数漂移率是独立性参考零模型的数倍，且在校验中保持稳定。结论是引用的信任分数应视为检查点绑定，不应跨版本沿用。
Motivation: 信任基准分数常被沿用到同一发布线的多个检查点，好像底层模型在版本间没有变化。论文检验这一假设是否成立。
Method: 对四条开源发布线各取三个连续公共代次，在固定200项基准篮子和三种提示模板下评分，计算相邻代次间的分数漂移率，并与基于独立性的计数级参考零模型比较；还进行了删除基准、删除发布线、改用严格评分和限制参数大小不变等稳健性检查。
Result: 平均绝对相邻代次分数漂移率是参考零模型的数倍，且在删除一个基准、删除一条发布线、改用严格评分或限制到参数大小不变的转换时保持在相同区间。
Conclusion: 在该审计设置内，引用的信任分数应视为检查点绑定的，应在每个实质新发布上重新测量而非沿用。封闭API、更大模型、规范协议分数和基准项目子集不确定性不在研究范围内。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NeuroBridge: Bridging Multi-Task MRI Knowledge for Neurodegenerative Disease Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Accurate MRI-based identification of Alzheimer's disease (AD), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and related dementias remains challenging because disease-related structural changes are often subtle and heterogeneous. We developed NeuroBridge, a clinically guided multi-task MRI framework for neurodegenerative disease diagnosis. NeuroBridge integrates large-scale self-supervised MRI pretraining with hippocampal segmentation, hippocampal atrophy classification, and reconstruction objectives, followed by gated fusion fine-tuning. Performance was evaluated across ADNI and OASIS cohorts, including cross-cohort transfer, probability-based analysis, and opportunistic screening. NeuroBridge achieved the highest performance across evaluated classification tasks, reaching 88.17% accuracy for AD versus cognitively normal controls in ADNI and 82.78% in OASIS. The largest gains occurred in MCI-related and mixed-diagnosis settings. The framework demonstrated strong cross-cohort generalization, systematic associations between predicted-class probability and accuracy, and the feasibility of probability-based opportunistic screening. Clinically guided multi-task representation learning improves neurodegenerative MRI diagnosis beyond conventional single-task approaches. NeuroBridge provides a robust and scalable framework for dementia assessment and MRI-based opportunistic screening.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuroBridge，一个面向神经退行性疾病诊断的临床引导多任务 MRI 框架。该框架将大规模自监督 MRI 预训练与海马体分割、海马萎缩分类和重建目标结合，并辅以门控融合微调。在 ADNI 和 OASIS 上评估，AD 对比认知正常对照的准确率分别达 88.17% 和 82.78%，在 MCI 相关及混合诊断场景增益最大，并表现出较强的跨队列泛化与基于概率的机会性筛查可行性。
Motivation: 基于 MRI 识别阿尔茨海默病 (AD)、轻度认知障碍 (MCI) 及相关痴呆仍具挑战，因为疾病相关结构变化往往细微且异质，传统单任务方法难以充分捕捉这些信号。
Method: 构建临床引导的多任务 MRI 框架，集成大规模自监督 MRI 预训练、海马体分割、海马萎缩分类与重建目标，再通过门控融合 (gated fusion) 进行微调。
Result: 在 ADNI 和 OASIS 队列的分类任务上达到最高性能，AD 与认知正常对照分类准确率分别为 88.17% 和 82.78%；最大提升出现在 MCI 相关和混合诊断场景，并展示了跨队列泛化、预测类别概率与准确率的系统性关联，以及基于概率的机会性筛查的可行性。
Conclusion: 临床引导的多任务表示学习相比传统单任务方法能改善神经退行性疾病的 MRI 诊断，NeuroBridge 为痴呆评估和基于 MRI 的机会性筛查提供了稳健可扩展的框架。

papers.title: Learning Cardiac Motion Priors for Implicit Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: Implicit neural representations (INRs) are well suited to cardiac motion estimation, providing continuous, compact representations of motion fields. However, fitting an INR to each image sequence is time-consuming and sensitive to the optimisation trajectory. Learned priors can help guide optimisation towards plausible motion fields and enable faster adaptation, but learning priors for cardiac motion INRs remains under-explored. In this work, we compare four strategies for learning cardiac motion priors, including a population prior learned by joint optimisation, a consensus prior obtained by weight averaging, auto-decoders, and meta-learning. Using short-axis tagged cardiac magnetic resonance images from the UK Biobank, we evaluate their impact on tracking accuracy, motion behaviour, and adaptation trajectory. All learned priors substantially improved early adaptation performance compared with random initialisation. While the simple consensus prior was effective, auto-decoders recovered large deformations faster during early adaptation. Meta-learning achieved strong early performance and maintained the best adaptation trajectory over 50 iterations. The code can be found at https://github.com/andrewjackbell/nvf_priors .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对隐式神经表示 (INR) 拟合心脏运动场时的耗时与优化轨迹敏感问题，比较了四种学习心脏运动先验的策略：联合优化得到的群体先验 (population prior)、权重平均得到的共识先验 (consensus prior)、auto-decoders 和 meta-learning。在 UK Biobank 短轴标记心脏 MRI 上，所有学习先验都比随机初始化显著提升早期适应性能；meta-learning 在 50 次迭代内保持了最好的适应轨迹。
Motivation: 将 INR 逐序列拟合用于心脏运动估计成本高且对优化轨迹敏感，而学习先验可以引导优化走向合理的运动场并加速适应；心脏运动 INR 的先验学习此前缺乏探索。
Method: 系统比较四种先验学习策略：通过联合优化学习群体先验、通过权重平均得到共识先验、auto-decoders 以及 meta-learning，并在标记心脏 MRI 上评估跟踪精度、运动行为和适应轨迹。
Result: 摘要报告所有学习先验相比随机初始化都大幅提升早期适应性能；简单共识先验有效，auto-decoders 在早期适应中更快恢复大变形，meta-learning 在 50 次迭代内获得强早期性能并保持最佳适应轨迹。
Conclusion: 作者认为心脏运动 INR 的先验学习仍未被充分探索，而该比较说明学习先验能显著改善适应过程；研究基于 UK Biobank 的短轴标记心脏 MRI 数据。

papers.title: DRIFT: Difficulty Routing Self-DIstillation with Rhythm-Gated Exploration and Success BuFfer Training
papers.abstract_en: Enabling large language models to achieve stable self-improvement without external expert supervision remains a central challenge in complex reasoning tasks. Existing self-distillation and reinforcement learning methods lack explicit mechanisms for tracking problem-level learning progress and adapting optimization strategies accordingly. Consequently, training may over-optimize easy problems, receive weak supervision from hard problems, and fail to sufficiently explore borderline cases. To resolve these issues, we propose DRIFT, an online self-evolution policy optimization framework for large language models. DRIFT regulates the model's self-improvement process through the joint use of Difficulty Routing and Rhythm Gating. The former identifies the model's learning state at the problem level and dynamically allocates self-distillation and reinforcement learning signals, while the latter refines policy updates at the token level, concentrating exploration on critical reasoning positions. By further incorporating a success buffer and a two-stage curriculum learning strategy, DRIFT preserves high-quality historical experience while progressively guiding the model from reliable behavior acquisition toward stable policy evolution. Evaluated across five benchmarks and three model scales, DRIFT surpasses the peak performance of both GRPO and SDPO across all evaluated metrics. On the average score over the five benchmarks, DRIFT achieves 79.5$\%$, outperforming GRPO by 9.5$\%$ and SDPO by 7.5$\%$, establishing a new state-of-the-art result. Notably, on ToolUse, DRIFT reaches an accuracy of 79.2$\%$, improving over GRPO by 13.5$\%$ and SDPO by 10.7$\%$, setting a new state-of-the-art and substantially outperforming all concurrent methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DRIFT，一种面向大语言模型的在线自进化策略优化框架，用于在无外部专家监督下稳定提升复杂推理能力。框架联合使用难度路由 (Difficulty Routing) 与节奏门控 (Rhythm Gating)：前者在问题层面判断学习状态并动态分配自蒸馏 (self-distillation) 与强化学习信号，后者在 token 层面聚焦关键推理位置进行探索；并引入成功缓冲 (success buffer) 与两阶段课程学习。在五个基准和三个模型规模上，DRIFT 的平均分为 79.5%，超过 GRPO 9.5 个百分点、SDPO 7.5 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有自蒸馏和强化学习方法缺少显式机制来追踪问题级学习进度并调整优化策略，导致简单问题被过度优化、困难问题监督信号弱、边界情况探索不足。
Method: DRIFT 通过 Difficulty Routing 在问题层面动态分配自蒸馏与强化学习信号，通过 Rhythm Gating 在 token 层面约束策略更新并将探索集中在关键推理位置；结合成功缓冲保留高质量历史经验，并采用两阶段课程学习从可靠行为获取过渡到稳定策略演化。
Result: 在五个基准和三种模型规模上，DRIFT 在所有评估指标上超过 GRPO 与 SDPO 的峰值表现；五个基准平均分为 79.5%，相对 GRPO 提高 9.5 个百分点、相对 SDPO 提高 7.5 个百分点。在 ToolUse 上准确率达 79.2%，相对 GRPO 提高 13.5 个百分点、相对 SDPO 提高 10.7 个百分点，并优于所有同期方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为联合使用问题级难度路由、token 级节奏门控、成功缓冲和两阶段课程学习能够稳定引导 LLM 自进化，并在多个基准上取得新的最优结果。

papers.title: DataComp-VLM: Improved Open Datasets for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Building performant Vision-Language Models (VLMs) requires carefully curating large-scale training datasets, yet the community lacks systematic benchmarks for evaluating such curation strategies. We introduce DataComp for VLMs (DCVLM), a benchmark for controlled data-centric experiments to improve VLM training. As part of DCVLM, we collect 160 datasets spanning four data types -- image-caption pairs, multimodal interleaved documents, text-only, and instruction-tuning data -- into a corpus of 6T multimodal tokens. DCVLM allows participants to test curation strategies (filtering, mixing, formatting, sampling) across 1B-8B models and 6.25B-200B token budgets. Models are then evaluated on a carefully selected suite of up to 52 downstream benchmarks across 9 domains. We conduct extensive experiments on DCVLM and find that data mixing, not filtering, is key to a high-quality training dataset: instruction-heavy mixtures scale better than caption-heavy ones, with gains widening at larger scales. The resulting dataset, DCVLM-Baseline, enables training an 8B VLM to 63.6% accuracy on our 33-task core suite with 200B training tokens. papers.title: NormAct: Benchmarking Embodied Agents' Proactive Compliance with Unspoken Social Norms
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents driven by multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can often complete everyday tasks from visual observations, but goal achievement does not establish whether they proactively respect unstated social norms. Existing benchmarks assess explicit norm judgments or constrained behavior, but rarely test whether agents infer and apply scene-relevant norms during ordinary tasks. We introduce NormAct, a benchmark of 550 TongSim scenarios in which the same goal permits norm-compliant or norm-violating action sequences. Norm-relevant evidence is embedded in each scenario while the applicable rule is omitted from the goal instruction. By progressively increasing normative guidance while holding the goal and scene fixed, NormAct tests whether compliant behavior emerges autonomously or only after prompting. Across three MLLM planners, goal achievement substantially exceeds norm compliance without guidance (67.4% versus 24.7%), while both broad and rule-specific guidance improve compliance, indicating that planners can often comply when prompted but not reliably on their own. With a fixed planner, general-norm retrieval is less effective than norm-relevant scene descriptions or generated norm cues, suggesting that identifying relevant visual evidence is a greater challenge than accessing general norm knowledge. NormAct therefore supports the development of embodied agents that pursue everyday goals while proactively respecting unstated social norms.
papers.comment: This version revises the paper content and adds substantial details on the benchmark design and experimental setup
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NormAct，一个包含 550 个 TongSim 场景的基准，用于评测具身智能体（embodied agents）在执行日常任务时是否主动遵守未言明的社会规范。同一目标既允许符合规范又允许违反规范的动作序列，规范相关信息嵌入场景中，但目标指令不给出适用规则。基于三个 MLLM 规划器的实验显示，无引导时目标达成率远高于规范遵守率，而多种形式的引导都能提升规范遵守。
Motivation: 现有基准大多评测显式的规范判断或受约束的行为，很少测试智能体在普通任务过程中是否自主推断并应用与场景相关的社会规范；目标达成并不代表智能体尊重未言明的规范。
Method: 构建 NormAct 基准，固定目标和场景，逐步增加规范引导强度，从而区分规范遵守行为是自主涌现还是仅在提示后才出现；并比较通用规范检索、规范相关场景描述与生成的规范线索等引导形式的有效性。
Result: 在三个 MLLM 规划器上，无引导时目标达成率为 67.4%，而规范遵守率仅为 24.7%；广泛和规则特定的引导都能提升规范遵守。固定规划器下，通用规范检索的效果不如规范相关场景描述或生成的规范线索，说明识别相关视觉证据比访问通用规范知识更具挑战。
Conclusion: NormAct 可用于支持开发在追求日常目标的同时主动尊重未言明社会规范的具身智能体，并指出规范相关视觉证据的识别是当前的主要瓶颈。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Humans Disengage, Reasoning Models Persist: Separating Difficulty Registration from Deliberation Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) spend more reasoning tokens on problems that take humans longer, suggesting sensitivity to a similar structure of difficulty. That alignment identifies which problems elicit more deliberation and leaves open how a difficult state is converted into continued computation. We distinguish difficulty registration, the relation between problem difficulty and observable deliberation, from deliberation allocation, the relation between registered difficulty and continued work. We test this distinction in matched human and LRM data from visual abstraction, intuitive physics, and relational reasoning. In visual abstraction, LRM trace length tracks the human ordering of problem difficulty. After problem identity is controlled, successful human attempts are longer than failed human attempts. Failed LRM attempts receive more reasoning tokens than successful model attempts. The same allocation difference appears in intuitive physics. In relational reasoning, the opposite-sign pattern disappears, while the item-controlled human-LRM difference remains, showing that task structure changes the observable form of allocation. Human action counts link longer human trials to continued task engagement, while failed LRM traces show task-dependent signs of hesitation or revisiting after trace length is controlled. A resource-rational account relates these patterns to the expected value of further computation from a difficult state. Humans and LRMs can agree about which problems are difficult while applying different policies to continued deliberation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文区分难度登记 (difficulty registration) 与深思分配 (deliberation allocation)，研究大型推理模型 (LRM) 与人类在问题难度感知一致时如何决定继续计算。作者在视觉抽象、直觉物理与关系推理三个任务域配对人类与 LRM 数据，发现视觉抽象中 LRM 的推理 token 数跟随人类难度排序，且失败尝试比成功尝试获得更多 token；关系推理中该模式反转。摘要提出资源理性 (resource-rational) 解释，认为人类与 LRM 可能对难度判断一致但采用不同的继续深思策略。
Motivation: 先前观察发现 LRM 与人类在困难问题上都会投入更多思考，但未解答困难状态如何被转化为持续计算。作者希望区分"难度登记"（问题难度与可观察深思的关系）与"深思分配"（已登记难度与持续工作的关系），以澄清两者是否遵循相同机制。
Method: 在视觉抽象、直觉物理和关系推理三个领域收集配对的人类与 LRM 数据，在控制问题身份 (item identity) 后比较成功与失败尝试的时长或 token 数；同时利用人类动作计数，以及在控制 trace length 后检测失败 LRM 痕迹中的犹豫或回访信号，来分析分配策略。
Result: 视觉抽象中 LRM trace length 匹配人类对问题难度的排序；控制题目后，人类成功尝试比失败尝试更长，而 LRM 失败尝试比成功尝试获得更多推理 token。直觉物理中出现相同的分配差异，关系推理中反向符号模式消失但题目控制后的人类-LRM 差异仍存在，说明任务结构改变分配的可观察形式。
Conclusion: 人类与 LRM 可以对哪些问题困难达成一致，但继续深思的策略可以不同；资源理性框架将这些模式联系到从困难状态继续计算的期望价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unbiased Canonical Set-Valued Oracles Via Lattice Theory
papers.abstract_en: An oracle that tells you the probability of some future event can change that very probability because you act on the answer. We argue that this performativity is OK as people consult oracles to be informed, and hence moved, by the answer. We worry about instead that asking for a self-consistent answer, one that still holds once it has been announced, may leave the oracle with several answers to pick from, and whichever rule it uses to pick is a lever it could learn to pull. We propose to take away that choice: The oracle reports a credal set instead of a point estimate, which lifts the oracle's reaction function to an isotone operator on a lattice. We make the oracle report that operator's least fixed point, which exists because of Knaster and Tarski. As that answer is fixed by a rule laid down in advance, nothing is left to choose by the oracle. We show that solution exists, is self-consistent, is never empty, can be computed by iterating from below, and equals the ordinary point estimate if the question is not performative after all. For simple queries about probabilities, we propose to restrict answers to intervals and show that, under a mild monotonicity assumption, the answer is simply the interval from the no-information baseline to the self-fulfilling equilibrium one would end up at by iteratively querying a point oracle until the answer is self-consistent. As our proposal is purely order-theoretic, it carries over unchanged to arbitrary random variables and to bounded continuous statistics of their law. Finally we show that a fixed finite family of polytopes suffices to approximate every answer uniformly, which turns the construction into a terminating computation. We close by placing the construction inside the Scientist AI programme, where it offers a choice-free criterion for a step that programme currently hands to audited human judgement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种消除预言机选择偏见的规范构造：当自我一致的答案不唯一时，预言机不再自主挑选，而是报告一个credal set（信度集合），从而把反应函数提升为格上的保序算子，并输出该算子的最小不动点。作者证明该解存在、自我一致、非空、可从下方迭代计算，且在非绩效性问题下退化为普通点估计。该构造纯序理论化，可推广到任意随机变量及其分布的有界连续统计量，并能用有限族多面体一致逼近。
Motivation: 作者认为预言机的绩效性（performativity）本身可接受，真正的问题在于自我一致答案可能不唯一；若预言机自行选择答案，该选择规则可能成为其可操纵的杠杆。
Method: 用credal set替代点估计，将预言机的反应函数提升为格上的isotone算子，并借助Knaster-Tarski不动点定理使其报告最小不动点；对简单概率查询限制答案为区间，在温和单调性假设下该区间从无信息基线延伸到迭代查询点预言机得到的自我实现均衡。
Result: 证明该解存在、自我一致、非空、可从下方迭代计算，并在问题非绩效性时等于普通点估计；对简单概率查询，答案简化为区间；有限不动点族足够一致逼近任意答案，使构造可终止计算。
Conclusion: 该构造是纯序理论性的，可推广到任意随机变量及有界连续统计量，并作为Scientist AI计划中一个无选择（choice-free）的判据，替代目前交由人工审计判断的步骤。

papers.title: EchoStyle: Unlocking High-Fidelity Video Stylization with Reverse Data Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: While image stylization has been studied extensively, video stylization remains a critical and largely unsolved challenge in the field of intelligent content creation. Existing methods, usually utilizing a reference image as the style prior, suffer from content leakage, data scarcity and limited adaptability to long videos, leading to suboptimal results with severe style drift and motion distortion. For these issues, we present EchoStyle, a scalable text-driven framework to achieve high-quality stylization of videos with arbitrary lengths. To start with, we construct a video-to-video architecture to appropriately re-fuse the video content and the text style. To address data scarcity, we pioneer an automatic reverse-synthesis pipeline to establish V-Style20k, a large-scale stylization dataset of 20k high-quality video pairs. To facilitate long video stylization, we devise an init-follow-mode mechanism along with a sliding-window inference strategy. Extensive experiments demonstrate EchoStyle's excellent performance across a wide range of artistic styles, even comparable to leading closed-source solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EchoStyle，一个可扩展的文本驱动视频风格化框架，能够对任意长度视频进行高质量风格化。针对现有方法的内容泄漏、数据稀缺及长视频适应性差等问题，作者构建视频到视频架构重新融合视频内容与文本风格，并首创自动反向合成流程建立 V-Style20k（2 万对高质量视频对）数据集，同时设计 init-follow-mode 机制配合滑窗推理策略支持长视频。实验表明其在多种艺术风格上表现优异，可与领先闭源方案相媲美。
Motivation: 视频风格化相比图像风格化仍是未充分解决的挑战：基于参考图像的方法存在内容泄漏、数据稀缺以及对长视频适应性差的问题，导致严重的风格漂移和运动畸变。
Method: 构建视频到视频（video-to-video）架构来重新融合视频内容与文本风格；提出自动反向合成（reverse synthesis）流程生成大规模风格化数据集 V-Style20k；设计 init-follow-mode 机制与滑窗推理（sliding-window inference）策略以支持长视频风格化。

papers.title: The Watermark Shortcut: How Provenance Marking Sabotages Audio Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Provenance watermarking is increasingly treated as a safeguard for synthetic speech, whether built directly into speech-generation models such as Chatterbox, provided through dedicated techniques such as AudioSeal, or deployed by commercial platforms such as ElevenLabs. We identify a previously uncharacterized liability: when synthetic speech is watermarked and human speech is not, detectors trained alongside latch onto the watermark as a spurious "watermark => fake" shortcut. This single feature yields three coupled failures: generalization degradation (model performance deteriorates on unseen data), strip-to-evade (a watermarked fake escapes once unwatermarked), and mark-to-frame (watermarking a real voice flags it as fake). In a controlled white-box experiment, a watermark-trained detector shows all three (for example, mark-to-frame lifts Equal Error Rate from 16% to 75%). In a black-box test of a commercial API, we show that adding a watermark to real speech disguises it as fake. However, this shortcut is fixable: retraining with the watermark on both classes decorrelates it and restores clean behavior. We release experiment data as a paired clean-versus-watermarked corpus (WASP).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出溯源水印 (provenance watermarking) 会成为音频深度伪造检测器的伪捷径：当合成语音带水印而人类语音不带时，与其同步训练的检测器会学会把“带水印”当作“伪造”的信号。摘要展示该单一特征引发三种耦合失效：泛化退化、strip-to-evade（去掉水印后伪造音频可逃避检测）和 mark-to-frame（给真实语音加水印使其被判定为伪造）。在受控白盒实验中 mark-to-frame 使等错误率 (Equal Error Rate) 从 16% 升至 75%，黑盒商业 API 测试中给真实语音加水印也会使其被误判为假。作者提出在两类样本上都加水印做重训练来解耦该捷径，并发布配对清洁版与水印版语料 WASP。
Motivation: 溯源水印正被当作合成语音的保障机制（如 Chatterbox、AudioSeal、ElevenLabs 等），但论文识别出一个此前未被表征的缺陷：只有合成语音被水印而真实语音没有时，检测器会把水印当作“水印=>伪造”的虚假特征，从而破坏检测器的可信度。
Method: 论文通过受控白盒实验训练带水印的检测器，并系统验证三类失败模式（泛化退化、strip-to-evade、mark-to-frame）；同时使用商业 API 做黑盒测试，观察对真实音频加水印后的分类结果。修复方法是在正负两类样本上均匀加水印重新训练，使水印与真伪标签去相关。
Result: 白盒实验中 mark-to-frame 使等错误率从 16% 上升到 75%；黑盒商业 API 测试表明给真实语音加水印会使其被伪装为伪造音频。按“两类都加水印”重训练后可消除该捷径并恢复干净行为。
Conclusion: 作者认为该伪捷径可通过在两类数据上统一加水印重训练来修复，同时也提示水印与伪造检测的耦合是实际部署中必须系统应对的风险；实验语料 WASP 已开放。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Capability Provenance in Language Models: A Case Study in Social Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We use training-data attribution as an interpretable tool for capability discovery, mapping which regions of the pretraining corpus support social-reasoning versus STEM-reasoning in OLMo3-7B. Training-data attribution measures how strongly each training document influences a model's predictions on a benchmark, but document-level scores are too noisy to identify which corpus regions support which capabilities. We compute gradient-based attribution (TrackStar via Bergson) over a working set drawn from the de-duplicated Dolma3 mix, aggregate influence across WebOrganizer's 24-format x 24-topic taxonomy (576 bins), and contrast benchmark pairs in a 2x2 design that varies domain (social vs. STEM) and capability type (reasoning vs. knowledge): SocialIQA and MMLU Social Sciences against ARC-Challenge and MMLU STEM. Social and STEM reasoning draw on qualitatively distinct corpus regions, and the contrast is sharper at the reasoning level than at the knowledge level. Targeted machine unlearning provides partial causal validation: forgetting high-attribution topics (e.g., Literature for SocialIQA) degrades the aligned benchmark more than within-topic random baselines. We validate on other open-data model, Comma v0.1 7B-2T (Common Pile) and DCLM-Baseline-7B (DataComp-LM): causal selectivity holds on both models, while the provenance map is ecosystem-specific. We open-source all code, data artifacts, influence scores, and checkpoints at https://github.com/eilab-gt/capabilibara and https://huggingface.co/HCAI-Lab.
papers.comment: 120 pages. Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把训练数据归因 (training-data attribution) 用作可解释的能力发现工具，以 OLMo3-7B 为对象，刻画预训练语料中哪些区域支撑社交推理 (social reasoning) 而非 STEM 推理。作者基于去重后的 Dolma3 混合数据计算梯度归因 (TrackStar via Bergson)，在 WebOrganizer 的 24×24 分类体系（576 个 bin）上聚合影响力，并用 2×2 基准对比设计（领域：社交 vs. STEM；能力类型：推理 vs. 知识）进行观察。摘要报告社交与 STEM 推理依赖性质不同的语料区域，推理层面的对比比知识层面更清晰；定向机器遗忘提供了部分因果验证，且该因果选择性在另外两个开放数据模型上成立，但归因图谱是生态系统特异的。
Motivation: 文档级训练数据归因分数噪声过大，难以定位哪些语料区域支撑哪些能力；需要一种具备可解释性和因果验证的能力发现方法。
Method: 对 OLMo3-7B 使用基于梯度的归因（TrackStar via Bergson），在去重 Dolma3 混合数据的工作集上计算各训练文档的影响力，再按 WebOrganizer 的 24 格式×24 主题分类（576 bins）聚合；采用 2×2 设计对比 SocialIQA/MMLU Social Sciences 与 ARC-Challenge/MMLU STEM，并对高归因主题执行定向机器遗忘 (machine unlearning) 做因果验证。
Result: 社交与 STEM 推理对应的语料区域定性不同，且推理层面（相对知识层面）的对比更尖锐。遗忘高归因主题（如 SocialIQA 对应的 Literature）对相应基准的损害超过同主题随机基线；该因果选择性在 Comma v0.1 7B-2T 和 DCLM-Baseline-7B 上同样成立，但归因图谱本身具有生态系统特异性。
Conclusion: 作者认为聚合到分类 bin 的训练数据归因可以作为一种可解释且可因果验证的能力发现工具；同时强调 provenance map 不具备跨模型生态系统的迁移性。

papers.title: Learning aligned EEG representations with subject-specific encoders
papers.abstract_en: Cross-subject EEG decoding promises more training data, but it also exposes neural networks to strong inter-subject distribution shifts. We study whether task supervision and architecture alone can learn subject-aligned representations. We replace a shared EEG encoder with subject-specific encoders followed by a common classifier, and compare this hybrid model with standard EEGNet, AttentionBaseNet, and CTNet baselines with Euclidean Alignment (EA) on four motor-imagery datasets. EA improves shared encoders by recentering subject covariances, but the hybrid encoder largely internalises this role: validation-loss curves and latent-distance analyses change little when EA is removed. Subject-specific heads increase class distinctiveness and place each subject close to its own latent manifold, improving most subjects while leaving a method-sensitive subset. These results support subject-specific encoders as a learned alignment mechanism for EEG decoding and identify head selection for unseen subjects as the remaining bottleneck.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究跨被试 EEG 解码中的被试间分布偏移问题，提出用被试专属编码器 (subject-specific encoders) 加共享分类器替换共享 EEG 编码器，并在四个运动想象数据集上与 EEGNet、AttentionBaseNet、CTNet 及欧氏对齐 (Euclidean Alignment, EA) 基线比较。结果表明混合编码器在很大程度上内化了对齐作用，使撤除 EA 后验证损失曲线和隐空间距离分析变化很小，同时提升多数被试的类别可分性；被试专属编码器可视为一种学习式的对齐机制，而未见被试的头部选择仍是主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 跨被试 EEG 解码虽然能提供更多训练数据，但会引入强烈的被试间分布偏移；作者想考察仅靠任务监督和网络结构能否学到被试对齐的表征。
Method: 将共享 EEG 编码器替换为被试专属编码器，后面接一个共享分类器，构成混合模型，并与 EEGNet、AttentionBaseNet、CTNet 以及结合欧氏对齐 (EA) 的基线进行对比。
Result: EA 通过重新中心化被试协方差改进了共享编码器，但混合编码器基本内化了对齐职能：移除 EA 后验证损失曲线和隐空间距离分析变化很小；被试专属头部提升了类别区分度，使每个被试靠近自身的隐空间流形，改善了大多数被试的结果，但存在一个对方法敏感的子集。
Conclusion: 作者认为被试专属编码器是 EEG 解码中一种有效的学习式对齐机制，并指出面向未见被试的头部选择 (head selection) 是剩余的关键瓶颈。

papers.title: Brownian Kernel Ladders
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Brownian kernel ladders (BKLs), a recursive hierarchy of integral reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces built from linear functionals by repeatedly integrating Brownian pullback kernels indexed by functions from the preceding layer. The nonnegative 1-homogeneity of the Brownian kernel yields a kernel-preserving canonical spherical normalization and propagates square-root regularity through the hierarchy. Allowing all canonical ladder measures to vary produces a full adaptive BKL envelope with an infimal complexity. For this envelope, we prove depth-dependent Hölder and pointwise estimates, quasi-Banach structure, nestedness, and, under a geometric trace condition, strict growth with ballwise separation. We also establish existence of regularized empirical-risk minimizers for continuous losses uniformly bounded below, with almost-everywhere uniqueness of population predictions under strict convexity and pointwise uniqueness under full support. For statistical estimation, we study one realized ladder and finite dictionaries fixed independently of the estimation sample. For a dictionary of $M$ ladders, the Gaussian complexity of the union of radius-$r$ top-layer RKHS balls has $n^{-1/2}$ dependence, no explicit ambient-dimension factor, and model-selection factor $1+\sqrt{2\ln M}$. Corresponding high-probability oracle and excess-risk bounds follow; polynomial-size dictionaries retain a near-parametric rate. The theory separates adaptive representational richness from the statistical cost of ladder selection.
papers.comment: Substantially revised version. The BKL construction and structural theory are retained; the statistical guarantees are reformulated for fixed or finite controlled ladder families with an explicit model-selection cost, and the supporting theory is strengthened accordingly
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出布朗核梯子 (Brownian kernel ladders, BKLs)，一种由线性泛函递归构建的积分再生核希尔伯特空间层级，通过对前一层函数索引的布朗拉回核反复积分得到。布朗核的非负 1-齐次性带来保核的规范球面归一化，并使平方根正则性沿层级传播。作者证明了该自适应包络的深度依赖 Hölder 与逐点估计、拟 Banach 结构、嵌套性以及球分离下的严格增长，并给出统计估计的 Gaussian 复杂度与过量风险界。
Motivation: 该工作试图构造一类既具有自适应表达能力又能分离统计选择代价的核函数层级结构。其动机源于在无限维函数层级中保持核结构归一化、传播正则性，并为自适应表示丰富度与模型选择成本建立可证明的权衡。
Method: BKL 通过反复积分布朗拉回核构建递归的积分 RKHS 层级；所有规范梯子测度可变时得到完整自适应 BKL 包络并引入 infimal complexity。统计估计部分研究固定于估计样本之外的单个实现梯子与有限字典：对于含 M 个梯子的字典，分析半径 r 的顶层 RKHS 球并集的 Gaussian 复杂度，并建立正则化经验风险最小化器的存在性与预测唯一性。
Result: 摘要报告：自适�应包络满足深度依赖的 Hölder 和逐点估计、拟 Banach 结构、嵌套性，并在几何迹条件下具有球分离式的严格增长；在连续一致下有界损失下存在正则化经验风险最小化器，严格凸时总体预测几乎处处唯一。Gaussian 复杂度具有 n^{-1/2} 依赖、无显式环境维数因子，模型选择因子为 1+sqrt(2 ln M)，多项式规模字典保持近参数率。

papers.title: Online Shift Detection and Conformal Adaptation for Deployed Safety Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning models deployed as safety monitors exhibit a systematic vulnerability: reasoning-token budget starvation. Adversarial inputs require $3.3\times$ more reasoning tokens than benign inputs to produce valid safety scores ($T_{50,\text{adv}}{=}154$ vs. $T_{50,\text{benign}}{=}46$ for o3), so low-budget deployments silently starve the monitor on exactly the inputs it must catch. This compounds the central failure mode: gradient-based evasion remains the residual threat - template jailbreaks fail at 99%, but GCG-optimized suffixes flip encoder decisions reliably. We systematize a canary construction - score-disagreement monitoring between a targeted and un-targeted classifier - and quantify its reliability under targeted evasion. We derive the exact security boundary - a confidence-gated equilibrium at which a monitor-aware attacker stalls (validated gap $= 1/(2λ)$, within 95% CI of theory) - and identify a failure mode in post-shift conformal adaptation. Three contributions. (1) Factorial drift benchmark. A pre-registered 800-cell evaluation ($4$ classifiers $\times$ $5$ shift types $\times$ $20$ seeds $\times$ $2$ windows) reveals detection difficulty is dominated by a classifier$\times$shift interaction ($η^2 = 0.185$): encoders detect paraphrase drift in 28 steps but miss adversarial suffixes for 37; decoders show the opposite. (2) Conformal collapse in generative embeddings. Weighted conformal prediction fails on decoder classifiers: logistic density-ratio estimation achieves perfect separability in 3584--4096-dimensional space, clipping all importance weights to zero. Projecting to $\leq$32 dimensions restores coverage (+33pp). (3) Adversarial canary threat model. Across 35 frontier models, a 4-tier threat model yields deployment guarantees ($\geq$71% detection, $<$1.5% FPR at $N{=}1000$).
papers.comment: 38 pages, 8 figures, 18 tables. Code and pre-registration at https://github.com/junwenleong/safety-classifier-shift-monitor
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究部署为安全监控器的推理模型面临的系统性漏洞：推理 token 预算饥饿——对抗输入需要约 3.3 倍于良性输入（o3 的 T50 分别为 154 与 46）的推理 token 才能产生有效安全分数，低预算部署因此在最需要捕获的输入上悄然失效。作者系统化了一种金丝雀（canary）构造，即目标与非目标分类器之间的分数不一致监控，并在目标逃避攻击下量化其可靠性；同时推导出置信门控均衡下的精确安全边界，并指出移位后共形适配（post-shift conformal adaptation）中的一个失败模式。文章包含三项贡献：预注册的因子漂移基准、生成式嵌入中的共形坍缩分析，以及跨 35 个前沿模型的对抗金丝雀威胁模型。
Motivation: 部署的安全分类器易受推理 token 预算饥饿影响，且梯度式逃避（gradient-based evasion）仍是残余威胁：模板越狱在 99% 情况下失败，但 GCG 优化的后缀能可靠翻转编码器决策。
Method: 提出基于分数不一致监控的金丝雀构造，以检测目标与非目标分类器间的漂移；通过 800 单元（4 分类器 × 5 漂移类型 × 20 种子 × 2 窗口）的预注册因子漂移基准评估检测难度；对加权共形预测（weighted conformal prediction）在解码器嵌入上的密度比权重坍缩问题，提出投影到低维空间以恢复覆盖；并建立 4 层威胁模型。
Result: 检测难度主要由分类器×漂移交互主导（η²=0.185）：编码器 28 步检测释义漂移但对对抗后缀漏检 37 步，解码器表现相反。加权共形预测在 3584–4096 维空间因逻辑回归密度比估计的完美可分性将所有重要性权重裁剪为零，投影到 ≤32 维后覆盖恢复 +33 个百分点。金丝雀威胁模型在 35 个前沿模型上实现 ≥71% 检测率与 <1.5% 假阳性率（N=1000），且验证了安全边界 gap ≈ 1/(2λ)，落在理论 95% 置信区间内。
Conclusion: 摘要强调推理预算饥饿会放大检测缺口，而共形适配在生成式嵌入中存在坍缩风险，需要维度投影等处理；检测难度受分类器与漂移类型交互支配，提示部署保障应组合多种检测器而非依赖单一机制。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Contemporary AI lacks the imagination to diverge or negate in science
papers.abstract_en: Bold claims that AI will accelerate scientific discovery have raced ahead of evidence from working scientists, yet large-scale, scientist-in-the-loop evidence is scarce. Here we mount the largest evaluation to date, inviting authors of 121,640 recent preprints in biology, medicine, chemistry, and social science to judge large language model (LLM)-generated ideas derived from their own papers. 6,749 representative scientists returned 25,139 rating sets on novelty, feasibility, probability of being true, and favorability of adoption. Three patterns emerge. First, non-reasoning LLMs collapse into a narrow "hivemind" of similar ideas while reasoning models explore a wider hypothesis space, but no model spontaneously proposes null hypotheses, a move humans make more freely. Second, scientists reward ideas resembling their own and prize probability over novelty, though social scientists tolerate risk more than life scientists; senior social scientists are the harshest critics, and their skepticism is earned, as LLMs falter most in pluralistic fields demanding context-aware interpretation and evolving theories. Third, automated evaluators, including LLM-as-a-judge and state-of-the-art (SOTA) models, agree weakly with expert judgment. Retrieval augmentation and scientist persona prompting yield marginal gains. A Qwen3-14B reward model we post-trained on human ratings captures nuances of taste, beats SOTA models by up to 27%, and closes the gap to the consistency of human peer reviewers. An analysis of 39 million papers from 2010 to 2025 links survey findings to macro-level patterns: following ChatGPT's release, null claims are sharply suppressed and ideas contract. Agent-based simulations further suggest that saturated fields should especially prize human uniqueness. For all the hype, today's AI for science remains a collaborator whose imagination and judgment benefit from human grounding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告迄今最大规模的科学家人工评估：邀请生物学、医学、化学和社会科学领域121,640篇近期预印本的作者，评判由大语言模型（LLM）基于其自身论文生成的科研想法，共6,749位科学家返回25,139组关于新颖性、可行性、真实性概率和采纳意愿的评分。结果显示，非推理LLM趋于同质化的“hivemind”，推理模型探索更宽假设空间但不会自发提出零假设（null hypothesis）；科学家更偏爱与自己想法相似、且概率高而非新颖的提议。作者还基于人类评分后训练了Qwen3-14B奖励模型，其表现比SOTA模型最多高27%，并辅以3,900万篇论文的宏观分析与基于智能体的模拟。
Motivation: 关于AI将加速科学发现的宏大论断远超来自一线科学家的证据，而大规模、科学家参与评估的实验证据稀缺，因此需要系统检验LLM生成科研想法的质量。
Method: 邀请大量预印本作者对由LLM生成的、源自其论文的研究想法进行多维度评分；比较非推理与推理模型、不同学科与资历群体的评判偏好；引入LLM-as-a-judge和SOTA模型作自动评估，并尝试检索增强（retrieval augmentation）和科学家角色提示（persona prompting）；在人类评分上后训练Qwen3-14B奖励模型，另结合3,900万篇论文的宏观趋势分析和基于智能体的模拟。
Result: 摘要报告了三个主要模式：非推理LLM陷入狭窄的“群体思维”、推理模型探索更广但不提出零假设；科学家奖励与自己相似的想法并重概率甚于新颖性，其中资深社会科学家批评最严厉，而LLM恰在需要情境化解释与演化理论的多元领域表现最差；自动评估者与专家判断一致性弱。后训练的Qwen3-14B奖励模型比SOTA模型最多提升27%，并缩小了与人类审稿人一致性之间的差距；宏观分析显示ChatGPT发布后零假设被抑制、研究想法收缩，模拟则提示饱和领域应更重视人类独特性。
Conclusion: 作者认为，尽管有诸多炒作，当前用于科学的AI仍是需要人类提供想象力和判断力支撑的协作者（collaborator），其产出依赖人类的grounding才能更好发挥作用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TRAPS: Treatment-Assignment Prediction via Pathway-informed Stratification
papers.abstract_en: Cancer treatment involves decisions across multiple clinical outcomes, yet pathway-informed deep learning models are typically evaluated in isolation, making their relative benefits unclear. We present a harmonized benchmark of three biologically informed architectures, BINN, GraphPath, and PATH, for predicting treatment exposure and short-term survival across five TCGA cancer cohorts comprising 2,622 patients represented by Reactome pathway activity scores. Treatment labels indicate recorded exposure in TCGA rather than therapeutic response. All models jointly predict targeted molecular therapy (TMT), radiation therapy (RT), and six-month overall survival (OS) from a shared pathway representation and are evaluated on identical stratified folds using five repeated splits and paired-bootstrap testing. Under this controlled evaluation, most differences between architectures fall within 95 percent confidence intervals, indicating that rankings suggested by isolated evaluations are largely not statistically resolved. The main exception is survival prediction: the sparse-hierarchy BINN significantly outperforms both graph models on breast-cancer OS, with an AUROC improvement of up to 0.14 and p less than or equal to 0.01, and leads on lung and prostate OS. For treatment exposure, TMT is best discriminated in prostate cancer, with AUROC approximately 0.80 for all models, but no architecture significantly outperforms another on any TMT cohort. RT prediction remains weak across models, suggesting that its determinants may be more clinical than transcriptomic. Overall, architecture choice has limited impact under a unified evaluation, while short-term survival provides the clearest differentiation among pathway-informed models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的基准测试，比较三种通路信息深度学习架构（BINN、GraphPath、PATH）在预测癌症治疗暴露和短期生存上的表现，使用5个TCGA癌症队列共2622名患者，基于Reactome通路活性评分。在相同的分层交叉验证和配对bootstrap检验下，大多数模型间差异落在95%置信区间内，但稀疏层次BINN在乳腺癌总生存期预测上显著优于两个图模型，AUROC提升最高0.14。
Motivation: 现有通路信息深度学习模型通常在孤立设置下评估，难以判断不同架构的相对优势；而癌症治疗涉及多个临床结果（如治疗暴露与生存），需要一个统一的受控基准来公平比较不同架构。
Method: 作者构建了一个包含BINN、GraphPath、PATH三种生物信息化架构的基准，所有模型从共享的Reactome通路活性表示联合预测靶向分子治疗（TMT）、放射治疗（RT）和六个月总生存期（OS），并在相同分层折上使用五次重复分割和配对bootstrap检验进行评估。
Result: 在受控评估下，大多数架构差异落在95%置信区间内，说明孤立评估的排名大多未达到统计显著。例外是生存预测：稀疏层次BINN在乳腺癌OS上显著优于两个图模型（AUROC提升最高0.14，p≤0.01），并在肺癌和前列腺癌OS上领先；TMT预测在前列腺癌中AUROC约0.80，但无架构显著领先；RT预测整体较弱。
Conclusion: 作者总结在统一评估下架构选择对结果影响有限，短期生存是区分通路信息模型的最清晰信号；RT预测较弱，提示其决定因素可能更多来自临床而非转录组。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有通路信息深度学习模型通常在孤立设置下评估，难以判断不同架构的相对优势；而癌症治疗涉及多个临床结果（如治疗暴露与生存），需要一个统一的受控基准来公平比较不同架构。
summary_sections.method: 作者构建了一个包含BINN、GraphPath、PATH三种生物信息化架构的基准，所有模型从共享的Reactome通路活性表示联合预测靶向分子治疗（TMT）、放射治疗（RT）和六个月总生存期（OS），并在相同分层折上使用五次重复分割和配对bootstrap检验进行评估。
summary_sections.result: 在受控评估下，大多数架构差异落在95%置信区间内，说明孤立评估的排名大多未达到统计显著。例外是生存预测：稀疏层次BINN在乳腺癌OS上显著优于两个图模型（AUROC提升最高0.14，p≤0.01），并在肺癌和前列腺癌OS上领先；TMT预测在前列腺癌中AUROC约0.80，但无架构显著领先；RT预测整体较弱。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者总结在统一评估下架构选择对结果影响有限，短期生存是区分通路信息模型的最清晰信号；RT预测较弱，提示其决定因素可能更多来自临床而非转录组。

papers.title: dots.tts Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: We present dots$.$tts, a 2B-parameter continuous autoregressive text-to-speech (TTS) foundation model that models speech in a continuous latent space. Compared with existing continuous autoregressive models, our key innovations are threefold. First, we train an AudioVAE with multiple objectives to build a semantically structured and prediction-friendly continuous speech space. Second, we use full-history conditioning in the flow-matching head to preserve long-range consistency and reduce drift during generation. Third, we apply reward-free self-corrective post-training to the flow-matching head to further improve robustness and acoustic quality. After being trained on a large-scale multilingual corpus, dots$.$tts achieves the best average performance on Seed-TTS-Eval, with WERs of 0.94%/1.30%/6.60% and SIM scores of 81.0/77.1/79.5 on the zh/en/zh-hard test sets, respectively. Across other benchmarks, dots$.$tts also consistently demonstrates open-source state-of-the-art performance, exhibiting strong generation stability, voice cloning ability, and emotional expressiveness. For efficient inference, we further apply CFG-aware MeanFlow distillation, enabling low-latency speech generation with first-packet latencies of 85/54 ms in output streaming and dual-streaming modes, respectively. To facilitate reproducible research and practical deployment, we release the training and inference code, together with the pretrained, post-trained, and MeanFlow-distilled checkpoints, under the Apache 2.0 license.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 dots.tts，一个 2B 参数的连续自回归语音合成 (TTS) 基础模型，在连续潜空间中建模语音。其三项关键创新包括：用多目标训练的 AudioVAE 构建语义结构化且利于预测的连续语音空间；在 flow-matching head 中使用全历史条件保持长程一致性并减少生成漂移；对 flow-matching head 施加无奖励自校正后训练以提升鲁棒性与声学质量。在 Seed-TTS-Eval 上取得最佳平均性能，并在其他基准上表现出开源 SOTA 的生成稳定性、声音克隆能力与情感表现力。作者还通过 CFG-aware MeanFlow 蒸馏实现低延迟推理，并开源训练、推理代码及多种检查点。
Motivation: 现有连续自回归 TTS 模型在连续语音空间的结构化程度、长程一致性和生成鲁棒性上仍有不足，本文旨在从语音表征、条件机制和后训练策略三方面改进，以构建更强的多语言 TTS 基础模型。
Method: 提出 dots.tts，采用连续自回归架构，核心包括：多目标训练的 AudioVAE 以形成语义结构化的连续语音空间；flow-matching head 利用全历史条件来保持长程一致性和降低漂移；以及无需奖励信号的自校正后训练来增强鲁棒性与音质。推理侧使用 CFG-aware MeanFlow 蒸馏以降低延迟。
Result: 在 Seed-TTS-Eval 上达到最佳平均性能，zh/en/zh-hard 测试集 WER 分别为 0.94%/1.30%/6.60%，SIM 分数为 81.0/77.1/79.5；其他基准上也持续呈现开源 SOTA 表现。蒸馏后在输出流式与双流式模式下首包延迟分别为 85ms 与 54ms。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 dots.tts 在开放语音生成任务上达到开源领先水平，并公开训练与推理代码、预训练/后训练/MeanFlow 蒸馏检查点（Apache 2.0），以支持可复现研究和实际部署。

papers.title: Unanticipated Effects of Generative AI on Expertise Pathways and Performance Perception in System Administration
papers.abstract_en: While industry discourse often emphasizes immediate productivity gains and frames GenAI primarily as a tool for automation, the integration of GenAI into system administration may involve deeper shifts in professional practice that are not yet fully understood. Drawing on 14 semi-structured interviews with IT professionals, this paper explores the lived reality of embedding GenAI into daily routines of troubleshooting, scripting, and system verification. Through inductive thematic analysis, we uncover two unanticipated socio-technical findings. First, we describe a "compression of traditional expertise pathways" where GenAI appears to function as both a mentor-like tutor and a "ladder-shortening" tool. While the tool can support faster task performance in unfamiliar domains, our findings suggest it may also reduce a practitioner's exposure to the foundational, hands-on cycles of building, failing, and debugging that historically served as the training ground for technical expertise. Second, we describe a "performance perception shift," where the speed of AI-assisted work begins to reset organizational and self-expectations for productivity. This shift may create a "two-speed culture" within teams and introduce "productivity guilt," as necessary manual work, even when required for safety or validation, is increasingly perceived as slow or a failure of efficiency. Our results raise broader questions about how GenAI may influence expertise development, how professional value is assessed in high-stakes technical environments, and the role of human judgment in complex technical environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于对14名IT专业人员的半结构化访谈，采用归纳主题分析，探讨生成式AI（GenAI）融入系统管理日常任务（故障排除、脚本编写、系统验证）后的社会技术影响。研究识别出两个意外发现：传统专业发展路径被压缩（GenAI既充当导师式工具又充当“缩短阶梯”的工具，可能减少从业者经历构建-失败-调试这一基础训练循环的机会），以及绩效认知转变（AI辅助工作速度重置了组织与个人对生产力的期望，可能造成团队内“双速文化”和“生产力愧疚感”）。
Motivation: 行业讨论常强调GenAI带来的即时生产力提升并主要将其视为自动化工具，但GenAI融入系统管理可能引发的专业实践深层转变尚未被充分理解。本文通过访谈IT从业者的真实体验来填补这一理解缺口。
Method: 对14名IT专业人员进行半结构化访谈，围绕故障排除、脚本编写和系统验证等日常工作，采用归纳主题分析（inductive thematic analysis）提取主题。
Result: 摘要报告两个意外发现：一是传统专业知识路径被压缩，GenAI作为导师式辅导工具同时缩短了从业者接触基础性动手训练（构建、失败、调试）的历程；二是绩效认知转变，AI辅助工作速度提高了组织和自我对效率的预期，导致“双速文化”和“生产力愧疚感”，使必要的安全或验证性手工工作被视为缓慢或失败。
Conclusion: 研究提出更广泛问题：GenAI如何影响专业技能发展、在高风险技术环境中如何评估专业价值，以及人类判断在复杂技术环境中的作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TASE: Truncation-Aware Semantic Embeddings for 3D Scene Understanding and Editing
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity semantic 3D scene representations are crucial for numerous applications, including robotics, autonomous driving, and simulation. Beyond this, the ability to edit such representations enables developers to adapt these applications more easily to specific target scenarios. Current approaches provide limited support for controllable editing. We introduce TASE, a method that projects pretrained 2D semantic features into a truncation-aware embedding space to enable flexible 3D scene editing. Our method explicitly optimizes a feature space in which progressively reducing feature channels yields increasingly abstract semantic representations, while retaining more channels preserves fine-grained detail. Additionally, we improve multi-view consistency of the features using a scale- and translation-equivariance loss. The resulting truncation-aware embedding space enables text-driven edits to 3D scenes, providing explicit control over how strongly edits adhere to the original scene content and allowing more substantial modifications than prior methods. Moreover, we propose a finetuning stage for the editing diffusion model to mitigate artifacts caused by geometric changes. Experimental results demonstrate competitive performance in 3D scene editing, substantially outperforming prior methods on edits involving large geometric modifications.
