papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TASE，一种将预训练 2D 语义特征投影到截断感知嵌入空间 (truncation-aware embedding space) 的方法，用于灵活的三维场景编辑。该方法显式优化特征空间，使逐步减少特征通道得到越来越抽象的表征，而保留更多通道则保留细粒度细节，并通过尺度与平移等变性损失改善多视角一致性。基于这一嵌入空间，TASE 支持文本驱动的三维场景编辑，并显式控制编辑对原始场景内容的遵从程度，允许比此前方法更大的修改幅度；同时提出针对编辑扩散模型的微调阶段以缓解几何变化带来的伪影。实验显示在三维场景编辑上表现有竞争力，并在涉及大几何修改的编辑任务上显著优于此前方法。
Motivation: 高保真语义三维场景表示对机器人、自动驾驶和仿真等应用至关重要，但现有方法对可控编辑的支持有限，难以让开发者将场景适应特定目标场景。
Method: 将预训练的 2D 语义特征投影到截断感知嵌入空间，显式优化一个随特征通道减少而语义层次变抽象、通道保留越多细节越丰富的特征空间；使用尺度与平移等变性损失 (scale- and translation-equivariance loss) 改进多视角一致性，并为编辑扩散模型增加微调阶段以减轻几何变化伪影。
Result: 摘要报告方法在三维场景编辑上取得有竞争力的性能，并在涉及大规模几何修改的编辑任务上显著超越此前方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为截断感知嵌入空间结合扩散模型微调，能够对三维场景编辑提供显式的修改强度控制并支持更大的几何改动。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Pave-GRPO: Beyond Instantaneous Guidance through Principled Average Velocity Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization(GRPO) has emerged as an effective paradigm for aligning flow-based generative models with human preferences. However, the high cost of group rollouts forces existing methods to use very few denoising steps, resulting in sparse temporal supervision and leaving most intermediate stages without direct reward guidance. To address this, we propose Pave-GRPO, which reformulates the GRPO objective through principled average velocity decomposition. Rather than generating expensive high-step rollouts, we maintain efficient few-step group sampling but decompose each coarse transition into an equivalent ensemble of finer sub-trajectories spanning multiple intermediate timesteps, propagating reward feedback to a denser set of temporal stages for more comprehensive preference alignment. Crucially, this incurs no additional stochastic rollout generation or reward evaluation: the decomposed sub-trajectories are constructed analytically around the observed transitions, requiring only a small number of extra velocity-network evaluations during the policy update. This design offers two benefits: (i) rollout-free horizon expansion: through the direct reuse of few-step group samples and their associated rewards, Pave-GRPO significantly broadens the effective optimization scope under a fixed sampling and reward budget; and (ii) comprehensive temporal supervision: by equivalently decomposing an instantaneous velocity target into a multi-timestep ensemble, it distributes reward signals across more intermediate stages of the denoising process, enabling finer-grained and more thorough preference optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）在流式生成模型（flow-based generative models）偏好对齐中因少步去噪导致的时间监督稀疏问题，提出 Pave-GRPO。该方法通过 principled average velocity decomposition，在不增加随机 rollout 生成和奖励评估的前提下，把粗粒度的转换分解为覆盖多个中间时间步的细分子轨迹集合，从而把奖励反馈传播到更密集的时间阶段。
Motivation: GRPO 对齐流式生成模型时，由于组 rollout 成本高，现有方法只能用很少的去噪步数，导致时间监督稀疏，大部分中间阶段缺乏直接奖励引导。
Method: 提出 Pave-GRPO：保持高效的少步组采样，但将每次粗粒度转换解析地分解为跨多个中间 timestep 的等价格子轨迹集成，仅需在策略更新时增加少量速度网络（velocity-network）评估，即可把奖励信号扩展到更多去噪中间阶段，无需额外 rollout 或奖励计算。
Result: 摘要报告两个收益：一是在固定采样与奖励预算下通过复用少步组样本实现 rollout-free horizon expansion，显著拓宽有效优化范围；二是通过把瞬时速度目标等价分解为多时间步集成，实现 comprehensive temporal supervision，进行更细粒度的偏好优化。摘要未给出定量实验结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Pave-GRPO 能以几乎零额外生成代价换取更密集的时间监督，提升流式生成模型的偏好对齐效果。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出 Pave-GRPO：保持高效的少步组采样，但将每次粗粒度转换解析地分解为跨多个中间 timestep 的等价格子轨迹集成，仅需在策略更新时增加少量速度网络（velocity-network）评估，即可把奖励信号扩展到更多去噪中间阶段，无需额外 rollout 或奖励计算。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告两个收益：一是在固定采样与奖励预算下通过复用少步组样本实现 rollout-free horizon expansion，显著拓宽有效优化范围；二是通过把瞬时速度目标等价分解为多时间步集成，实现 comprehensive temporal supervision，进行更细粒度的偏好优化。摘要未给出定量实验结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为 Pave-GRPO 能以几乎零额外生成代价换取更密集的时间监督，提升流式生成模型的偏好对齐效果。

papers.title: PortBench: A Correlation-Aware, Full-Pipeline Benchmark for LLM-Driven Portfolio Management
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance across diverse financial tasks, yet portfolio management (PM) remains poorly benchmarked. Existing benchmarks exhibit two gaps: they are often equity-only and ignore cross-asset correlations; they fail to evaluate the complete PM decision pipeline. We introduce PortBench, a benchmark spanning six heterogeneous asset classes over ten years. PortBench comprises two layers: a static QA dataset of 6,269 questions across seven task templates, and a dynamic five-stage allocation pipeline. To evaluate these layers, we introduce two metrics: a dual-layer correlation score for inter-class hedging and intra-class concentration, and CEPS, which quantifies how reasoning errors compound across pipeline stages. We further evaluate under three stress regimes and risk profiles, and support real-time evaluation to mitigate pretraining contamination on historical markets. Evaluating ten frontier LLMs, we find that despite strong financial QA performance, 90\% of model-profile cases fail to outperform equal-weight allocation in 2024, and this deficit persists across other market regimes; models that satisfy every procedural constraint still suffer large drawdowns under stress. Our source code is available at \href{https://github.com/AgenticFinLab/portbench}{this https URL}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PortBench，一个覆盖六类异质资产、跨越十年的 LLM 投资组合管理基准。基准包含两层：一个含 6,269 道题的静态 QA 数据集（七个任务模板）和一个动态五阶段配置流水线。作者引入双重相关分数和 CEPS 两类指标，分别评估类别间对冲与类别内集中度、以及推理误差在流水线各阶段的复合效应。对十个前沿 LLM 的评估显示，尽管金融 QA 表现较强，90% 的模型-风险画像组合在 2024 年未能跑赢等权重配置。
Motivation: 现有基准对投资组合管理（portfolio management）的评测不足：往往只覆盖股票资产、忽略跨资产相关性，并且没有评估完整的 PM 决策流水线。
Method: 提出 PortBench，包含静态 QA 数据集（6,269 道题、七个任务模板）与五阶段动态分配流水线两层；配套引入双层相关分数（评估跨类别对冲与类别内集中度）和 CEPS（量化推理误差跨流水线阶段的复合）。评测覆盖三种压力情景与风险画像，并支持实时评测以缓解预训练数据污染。
Result: 在十个前沿 LLM 上的评估表明，尽管金融 QA 表现强，90% 的模型-风险画像组合在 2024 年未能跑赢等权重配置，且该劣势在其他市场情景下持续；满足所有程序性约束的模型在压力情景下仍出现较大回撤。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LLM 的金融 QA 能力不能直接转化为有效的投资组合决策，突显了对覆盖完整决策流水线的基准设计的需求。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Questions: Evaluating LLM's Knowledge Expression
papers.abstract_en: Parametric knowledge in large language models (LLMs) is a cornerstone of their success, yet remains poorly understood. Existing knowledge benchmarks typically rely on predefined questions (e.g., "What is the birth date of M.L. King?"), evaluating only knowledge that benchmark designers explicitly choose to query, a problematic availability bias. In this paper, we introduce open knowledge evaluation, a new paradigm for LLM knowledge expression benchmarking. Instead of asking narrow questions, it evaluates models on the knowledge they choose to surface in response to open-ended elicitation prompts (e.g., "Tell me everything you know about M.L. King"). This shifts the focus from predefined answer retrieval toward characterizing the knowledge models naturally express. We instantiate this paradigm with BeQu (Beyond Questions), a benchmark of 10,000 entities paired with reference corpora for statement verification. Using BeQu, we evaluate a broad range of language models and analyze the effects of reasoning effort, model scale, prompt format, and knowledge domain. Data and leaderboard are available on this work's GitHub repository and at the benchmark's website.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出开放知识评估 (open knowledge evaluation) 这一新范式，用于评测大语言模型 (LLM) 的参数化知识表达。与依赖设计者预设问题的传统基准不同，该方法使用开放式提示（如“告诉我关于 M.L. King 你知道的一切”）让模型自由呈现知识，并对生成内容进行陈述验证。作者以此构建了 BeQu (Beyond Questions) 基准，包含 10,000 个实体及其参考语料，并评测了多种语言模型，分析推理努力、模型规模、提示格式和知识领域的影响。
Motivation: 现有知识基准依赖预定义问题，只能评测基准设计者选择查询的知识，存在可获取性偏差 (availability bias)；同时 LLM 的参数化知识仍缺乏充分理解。
Method: 引入开放知识评估范式，用开放式引发提示 (open-ended elicitation prompts) 替代狭窄问题，并构建 BeQu 基准：10,000 个实体与用于陈述验证的参考语料配对，对模型自由表达的知识进行验证与分析。
Result: 摘要报告使用 BeQu 评测了多种语言模型，并分析了推理努力、模型规模、提示格式和知识领域对知识表达的影响，但未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者主张将知识评测从预定义答案检索转向刻画模型自然表达的知识，并已公开数据与排行榜。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Function-Vector Heads Are Two Populations: Writers and Cancellers in In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Function-vector (FV) analyses commonly identify attention heads by the magnitude of their causal contribution to in-context tasks. Magnitude does not retain the direction of the effect on the task readout. We preserve the sign and validate candidate heads with path patching. Across six main Pythia (model, task) cells, the validated population separates into writers, whose direct effects favour the rule-correct label, and cancellers, whose effects oppose it. Labels assigned on path-patching prompts predict held-out group lesions, and a sign-shuffle null rejects a chance partition in five cells. Measurements not used to assign the roles show corresponding structure. Writers attend more to demonstration labels, cancellers more to format tokens, and their OV write directions are shifted toward opposition relative to same-layer controls. A magnitude-ranked mean-ablation baseline preferentially recovers cancellers on the hierarchical task and writers on the modular task. Signed lesion directions recur in all fifteen cells tested across six Pythia scales and three architectures. Cross-template transfer shows that these are task-conditioned roles that can persist, weaken, or reverse. Zero-ablating cancellers raises the correct-label logit difference by +0.13 to +0.29 nats in all six main cells, with accuracy point estimates increasing in all six. Together, the results separate causal importance from functional role and show that a function vector can remain a useful task-level representation while its head-level causal implementation contains opposed, task-conditioned components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究上下文学习（in-context learning）中的函数向量（function vector, FV）头，指出常见的按因果贡献幅度识别注意力头的方法丢失了效应方向。作者保留符号并用路径修补（path patching）验证候选头，在 Pythia 的六个主 (模型, 任务) 单元中发现头群分为两类：writer 直接效应支持规则正确标签，canceller 直接效应反对该标签。零消融 cancellers 在所有六个主单元中使正确标签 logit 差提升 +0.13 到 +0.29 nats，准确率点估计也全部上升；作者由此区分了因果重要性与功能角色。
Motivation: 传统函数向量分析按注意力头对上下文任务的因果贡献幅度排序，但幅度不保留效应方向，因此无法区分哪些头促进、哪些头抑制任务读出（task readout）。
Method: 在幅度之外保留效应符号，并利用路径修补验证候选头；依据路径修补提示上的直接效应将验证后的头群划分为 writers 与 cancellers，并用符号打乱零假设（sign-shuffle null）和留出群组消融来检验分组的可靠性，同时考察跨模板迁移。
Result: 在六个 Pythia 主单元中，路径修补分配的标签能预测留出群组消融结果，符号打乱零假设在五个单元拒绝随机划分；零消融 cancellers 在所有六个主单元将正确标签 logit 差提高 +0.13 到 +0.29 nats，准确率点估计全部上升；这些有符号的角色在六个 Pythia 规模、三种架构的十五个单元中均出现。
Conclusion: 因果重要性与功能角色是分离的：函数向量仍可作为有效的任务级表示，而其头级因果实现包含方向相反、受任务条件约束的组件；跨模板迁移显示这些角色可以持续、减弱或反转。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Don't Retrain, Just Reuse: Recovering Dual-Target Molecules from Single-Target Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Designing a single molecule that modulates two targets is a promising strategy for polypharmacology, but it remains substantially harder than standard single-target generation because one candidate must satisfy two binding requirements while preserving drug-likeness and synthesizability. Existing dual-target generative methods typically introduce dual-target capability by either retraining the generator or intervening in the diffusion process during sampling. The former can be costly and difficult to stabilize when dual-target supervision is sparse, while the latter may be sensitive to denoising-time target balancing and competing update directions. These limitations motivate a generator-preserving alternative that keeps the pretrained prior intact: can dual-target candidates instead be recovered from the input space of a frozen single-target diffusion model, without modifying its parameters or denoising dynamics? We formulate this task as a constrained multi-objective optimization problem and propose REUSE, which evolves the input noise of a frozen diffusion generator rather than molecular structures. Each input is decoded multiple times and scored by the collective quality of the generated molecular family. Candidates are then screened progressively: lower-cost evaluations prioritize molecules satisfying chemical-feasibility criteria, full docking is reserved for a reduced frontier, and the survivors are jointly selected as a diverse panel with strong affinity to both targets. Experiments show that REUSE achieves stronger and more balanced dual-target recovery than prior dual-target baselines, improving Dual High Affinity by 21.1 percentage points over the strongest prior baseline while retaining QED and SA profiles consistent with commonly used chemical-feasibility criteria.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REUSE 方法，在冻结（frozen）单靶点扩散生成器不变的前提下，把双靶点候选分子恢复任务形式化为约束多目标优化，并在输入噪声空间中演化搜索而非修改参数或去噪动力学。摘要报告该方法相比先前双靶点基线将 Dual High Affinity 提升 21.1 个百分点，同时 QED 和 SA 分布符合常用化学可行性标准。
Motivation: 现有双靶点分子生成方法要么重训练生成器（代价高且双靶点监督稀疏时不稳定），要么在采样中干预扩散过程（对去噪时目标平衡和竞争更新方向敏感）。作者希望保留预训练先验，直接从冷冻单靶点扩散模型的输入空间恢复双靶点候选。
Method: 将任务建模为约束多目标优化，REUSE 演化冷冻扩散生成器的输入噪声而非分子结构；每个输入被多次解码并用生成分子族的集体质量评分。候选经过渐进筛选：低开销评估优先满足化学可行性标准，全对接（docking）仅用于缩减后的候选前沿，最终联合选择对两个靶点都有强亲和力的多样化面板。
Result: 实验显示 REUSE 比先前双靶点基线取得更强且更均衡的双靶点恢复，Dual High Affinity 较最强先验基线提升 21.1 个百分点，同时保持 QED 与 SA 分布符合常用化学可行性标准。
Conclusion: 摘要强调生成器保留（generator-preserving）的双靶点恢复策略可行，即无需修改参数或去噪动力学，仅依靠输入空间演化即可从单靶点模型获得双靶点分子；摘要未详细说明方法适用范围或局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding and Mitigating Premature Confidence for Better LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Long chains of thought (CoT) from current language models frequently contain logical gaps and unjustified leaps, limiting the gains from additional test-time compute. Improving reasoning quality directly would require process reward models, but the step-level annotations needed to train them are expensive and scarce. We find such a signal in how the model's confidence evolves during reasoning: premature confidence, the tendency to commit to an answer early and use the remaining tokens to rationalize it, strongly predicts flawed reasoning across tasks and model scales. We exploit this in progressive confidence shaping, a reinforcement learning objective that trains models to update their confidence as they reason rather than commit early -- rewarding gradual confidence growth and penalizing early commitment, with no external labels or reward models. The method improves accuracy and reasoning quality from 1.5B to 8B parameters across arithmetic (Countdown), math (DAPO, AIME), and science (ScienceQA): on Countdown, accuracy improves 3.2x (+42.0pp) and flawed reasoning drops 48pp; on AIME, Pass@64 improves 6.6pp. Consistent with this mechanism, the method also improves faithfulness: on a safety benchmark, our models more transparently surface misleading content in their reasoning traces rather than concealing it. Controlled experiments reveal that the problem and its remedy scale together: premature confidence grows with model size and task difficulty, and so do the gains from addressing it.

papers.title: Latent Spectroscopy: Posterior Collapse as a Feature
papers.abstract_en: We show that, in linear Gaussian VAEs, posterior collapse is a form of latent feature selection. Feature importance is set by each latent coordinate's contribution to reconstruction, itself given by the corresponding PCA eigenvalue. Varying the regularizer strength $β$ reveals a ranked spectrum of collapse events, with thresholds set by the utility/PCA spectrum. A mode-by-mode analysis identifies the scale-invariant signal fraction as an order parameter obeying Landau scaling near collapse. WorldClim experiments confirm both the utility-threshold calibration and the predicted near-collapse scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在线性高斯 VAE 中证明后验坍缩 (posterior collapse) 等价于一种潜在特征选择机制：每个隐坐标的重要性由其重构贡献决定，即对应的 PCA 特征值。改变正则化强度 β 会揭示按效用/PCA 谱排序的坍缩事件谱，并识别出尺度不变的信号分数作为序参量，在坍缩附近满足 Landau 标度律。WorldClim 实验验证了效用阈值校准与近坍缩标度行为。
Motivation: 后验坍缩通常被视为 VAE 训练中的失败模式，本文则将其重新解释为有意义的潜在特征选择过程，并试图在可解析的线性高斯设定下刻画其特征重要性、坍缩阈值与临界标度，从而理解隐变量表达与重构效用之间的关系。
Method: 在 linear Gaussian VAE 框架下进行解析分析，将每个潜在坐标的重构贡献与 PCA 特征值对应；通过扫描正则化强度 β 观察坍缩事件的排名谱，并进行 mode-by-mode 分析，把尺度不变的信号分数 (scale-invariant signal fraction) 作为序参量来研究近坍缩行为。
Result: 摘要报告坍缩事件阈值由效用/PCA 谱决定，且序参量在坍缩附近服从 Landau 标度律；WorldClim 实验同时确认了效用阈值校准和预测的近坍缩标度关系。
Conclusion: 作者主张后验坍缩应被视为潜在特征选择而非缺陷，并给出了由效用谱决定阈值及 Landau 标度行为的理论刻画；分析限于线性高斯 VAE，实验验证基于 WorldClim 数据。

papers.title: Robust Recommendation from Noisy Implicit Feedback: A GMM-Weighted Bayes-label Transition Matrix Framework
papers.abstract_en: Label noise is a central challenge in learning from implicit feedback for recommendation. Conventional approaches discard noisy examples for robustness, but this sacrifices data efficiency. Unlike filtering approaches, Bayes-label transition matrix (BLTM) based methods keep all data, but their transition matrix estimates are skewed in practice. To reduce this skew, we introduce GMM-weighted Bayes-label Transition Matrix (RGBT), which augments BLTM with GMM-based instance weights. A GMM assigns each instance a reliability score, and these scores calibrate the BLTM to reduce bias. We show theoretically that RGBT retains all samples for BLTM estimation, yields consistent estimates, and provably reduces variance compared to CLTM. Experiments on real and synthetic datasets show that RGBT handles noisy samples more effectively than sample-selection methods, and calibrates the transition matrix more accurately than existing approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对推荐系统中隐式反馈的标签噪声问题，提出 GMM 加权的 Bayes 标签转移矩阵框架（RGBT）。该方法用 GMM 为每个实例生成可靠性分数，并以此校准 BLTM 以减少估计偏差；理论上证明其保留全部样本、得到一致估计，并且方差可证明低于 CLTM。实验在真实与合成数据集上表明 RGBT 比样本选择方法更有效地处理噪声样本，且转移矩阵校准比现有方法更准确。
Motivation: 隐式反馈中的标签噪声是推荐学习的核心挑战；过滤式方法通过丢弃噪声样本换取鲁棒性，但牺牲了数据效率，而基于 Bayes 标签转移矩阵（BLTM）的方法虽保留全部数据，其转移矩阵估计在现实中存在偏斜。
Method: 提出 GMM 加权 Bayes 标签转移矩阵（RGBT）：用 GMM 给每个实例分配可靠性分数，并利用这些分数校准 BLTM 以降低偏差；理论上证明该框架保留所有样本用于 BLTM 估计、得到一致估计，并且相比 CLTM 可证明地降低方差。
Result: 在真实和合成数据集上的实验显示，RGBT 比样本选择方法能更有效地处理噪声样本，并且相比现有方法能更准确地校准转移矩阵。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过 GMM 权重校准转移矩阵，可以在保留数据效率的同时提升噪声隐式反馈下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Delta Forcing: Trust Region Steering for Interactive Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Interactive real-time autoregressive video generation is essential for applications such as content creation and world modeling, where visual content must adapt to dynamically evolving event conditions. A fundamental challenge lies in balancing reactivity and stability: models must respond promptly to new events while maintaining temporal coherence over long horizons. Existing approaches distill bidirectional models into autoregressive generators and further adapt them via streaming long tuning, yet often exhibit persistent drift after condition changes. We identify the cause as conditional bias, where the teacher may provide condition-aligned but trajectory-agnostic guidance, biasing generation toward locally valid yet globally inconsistent modes. Inspired by Trust Region Policy Optimization, we propose Delta Forcing, a simple yet effective framework that constrains unreliable teacher supervision within an adaptive trust region. Specifically, Delta Forcing estimates transition consistency from the latent delta between teacher and generator trajectories, and uses it to balance teacher supervision with a monotonic continuity objective. This suppress unreliable teacher-induced shifts while preserving responsiveness to new events. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Delta Forcing significantly improves consistency while maintaining event reactivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向交互式实时自回归视频生成，本文提出 Delta Forcing，一个受信任区域策略优化（Trust Region Policy Optimization）启发的框架。作者识别出条件偏置这一漂移源头，即教师模型可能给出条件对齐但轨迹无关的引导，并通过潜在 delta 估计过渡一致性来约束不可靠的教师监督，从而在保持事件响应性的同时提升长时间一致性。实验显示该方法显著改善一致性。
Motivation: 现有将双向模型蒸馏到自回归生成器并做流式长调优的方法在条件变化后仍常出现持续漂移。作者将其归因于条件偏置：教师提供的引导可能是局部有效但全局不一致的模式，导致模型倾向局部有效而全局不一致的状态。
Method: 提出 Delta Forcing，利用教师与生成器轨迹之间的潜在 delta 估计过渡一致性（transition consistency），并用它来平衡教师监督与一个单调连续性目标（monotonic continuity objective），将不可靠的教师监督限制在自适应信任区域内。
Result: 大量实验表明 Delta Forcing 在保持事件响应性的同时显著提升了生成一致性。摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Delta Forcing 能够抑制不可靠教师引起的生成偏移，同时保留对新事件的响应能力，为交互式实时视频生成中的稳定性-响应性权衡提供了一种简单有效的解法。

papers.title: Dimensional Balance Improves Large Scale Spatiotemporal Prediction Performance
papers.abstract_en: Accurate spatiotemporal pattern analysis is critical in fields such as urban traffic, meteorology, and public health monitoring. However, existing methods face performance bottlenecks, typically yielding only incremental gains and often exhibiting limited cross-domain transferability. We analyze this bottleneck through spatial and temporal entropy measures, which are used as diagnostic indicators of spatiotemporal complexity mismatch rather than as guarantees that entropy alignment alone yields better forecasting. Empirically, larger mismatch is often accompanied by higher prediction uncertainty, especially under a fixed model-capacity budget. Guided by this diagnostic, we propose a scalable, adaptive framework that harmonizes spatial and temporal feature representations. Spatial dimensionality is compressed via low-rank matrix embedding to preserve essential structure, while an extended temporal horizon captures long-range dependencies and mitigates cumulative errors arising from temporal heterogeneity. Extensive experiments on urban traffic, meteorological, and epidemic datasets demonstrate substantial accuracy gains and broad applicability across the evaluated domains, suggesting that the framework is promising for a wide range of spatiotemporal tasks beyond the current study. The code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/ST-Balance/ST-Balance.
papers.journal_ref: Neural Networks 205 (2027) 109434
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模时空预测中现有方法仅能取得增量提升且跨域迁移性有限的问题，提出一种可扩展的自适应框架 ST-Balance。该框架先用空间与时间熵作为时空复杂度失配的诊断指标，再通过低秩矩阵嵌入压缩空间维度、扩展时间视野来协调时空特征表示。在城市交通、气象与流行病数据集上的实验显示其准确率提升明显，代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有时空预测方法存在性能瓶颈，通常只能带来增量改进，且跨领域迁移能力有限；作者用空间与时间熵诊断发现，复杂度失配越大，预测不确定性往往越高，尤其在固定模型容量预算下。
Method: 提出基于熵诊断引导的可扩展自适应框架：空间维度通过低秩矩阵嵌入（low-rank matrix embedding）压缩以保留关键结构，扩展时间视野以捕获长程依赖并缓解时间异质性带来的累积误差。
Result: 在城市交通、气象与流行病数据集上的大量实验表明该方法取得了可观的准确率提升，并在所评估领域内具有广泛适用性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架有望推广到当前研究之外的更多时空任务，但也提示熵对齐本身并不能保证更好的预测，仅是诊断指标。

papers.title: AgentPSO: Evolving Agent Reasoning Skill via Multi-agent Particle Swarm Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent reasoning has shown promise for improving the problem-solving ability of large language models by allowing multiple agents to explore diverse reasoning paths. However, most existing multi-agent methods rely on inference-time debate or aggregation, which can be vulnerable to incorrect peer influence and biased consensus. Moreover, the agents' reasoning procedures remain static, as they do not accumulate reusable behaviors across tasks. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{AgentPSO}, a particle-swarm-inspired framework for evolving multi-agent reasoning skills. AgentPSO treats each agent as a particle-like reasoner whose state is a natural-language skill and whose velocity is a semantic update direction, iteratively guiding agents toward higher-performing skill configurations. Across training iterations, each agent updates its skill by combining its previous velocity, personal-best skill, global-best skill, and a self-reflective direction derived from peer reasoning trajectories. This enables agents to learn reusable reasoning behaviors by drawing on their own experience and on the strongest skills found by the population, without updating the parameters of the backbone language model. Experiments on mathematical and general reasoning benchmarks show that AgentPSO improves over static single-agent skills and test-time-only multi-agent reasoning baselines. The evolved skills further transfer across benchmarks and to another backbone model, suggesting that AgentPSO captures reusable reasoning procedures rather than merely optimizing benchmark-specific prompts. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/HYUNMIN-HWANG/AgentPSO/.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentPSO，一种受粒子群优化 (Particle Swarm Optimization) 启发的多智能体推理框架，用于演化 LLM 智能体的推理技能。每个智能体被看作一个粒子，其状态为自然语言技能、速度为语义更新方向，训练中结合上一时刻速度、个体最优技能、全局最优技能以及由同伴推理轨迹推导的自我反思方向来更新技能，全程不更新骨干语言模型参数。在数学与通用推理基准上，AgentPSO 优于静态单智能体技能和仅测试时多智能体推理基线，且演化出的技能可跨基准并迁移到另一个骨干模型。
Motivation: 现有大多数多智能体方法依赖推理时辩论或聚合，容易受到错误同伴影响并产生有偏共识；同时智能体的推理过程是静态的，无法跨任务积累可复用的行为，因此需要让推理技能在训练过程中持续演化。
Method: 借鉴粒子群优化思想，将每个 agent 视为类粒子推理器，用自然语言技能描述其状态、用语义更新方向描述速度；迭代时依据前一速度、个体最优技能、群体最优技能和从同伴推理轨迹得到的自我反思方向进行更新，从而在不修改骨干模型参数的前提下学习可复用推理行为。
Result: 在数学和通用推理基准上的实验显示，AgentPSO 相对静态单智能体技能与仅测试时多智能体推理基线均有提升；演化后的技能还能跨基准迁移并转移到另一个骨干模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为 AgentPSO 捕获的是可复用的推理过程而非仅针对特定基准的提示优化，并公开了代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: BRIDGE: Background Routing and Isolated Discrete Gating for Coarse-Mask Local Editing
papers.abstract_en: Coarse-mask local image editing asks a model to modify a user-indicated region while preserving the surrounding scene. In practice, however, rough masks often become unintended shape priors: instead of serving as flexible edit support, the mask can pull the generated object toward its accidental boundary. We study this failure as mask-shape bias and frame the task through a Two-Zone Constraint, where the background should remain stable while the editable region should follow the instruction without being forced to inherit the mask contour. BRIDGE addresses this setting by keeping masks outside the DiT backbone for support construction and blending, avoiding DiT-internal mask injection and copied control branches. It uses BridgePath generation, where a Main Path preserves background context and a Subject Path generates editable content from independent noise. Motivated by a diagnostic Qwen-Image experiment showing that positional embeddings and attention connectivity regulate which image context visual tokens reuse, BRIDGE introduces a learnable Discrete Geometric Gate for token-level positional-embedding routing. This gate lets subject tokens borrow background-anchored coordinates near fusion regions or keep subject-centric coordinates for geometric freedom. We evaluate BRIDGE on BRIDGE-Bench, MagicBrush, and ICE-Bench. On BRIDGE-Bench, BRIDGE improves Local SigLIP2-T from 0.262 with FLUX.1-Fill and 0.390 with ACE++ to 0.503, with parallel gains in local DINO and DreamSim. Zero-shot results on MagicBrush and ICE-Bench further indicate competitive alignment and source preservation beyond the curated benchmark, while the added routing module remains compact at 13.31M parameters compared with ControlNet-style copied branches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BRIDGE，一种面向粗掩码局部图像编辑的方法，针对掩码形状偏差（mask-shape bias）问题，即粗糙掩码会被当作形状先验并把生成对象拉向掩码边界。作者将任务建模为 Two-Zone Constraint：背景应保持稳定，可编辑区域应遵循指令而不继承掩码轮廓。BRIDGE 将掩码保持在 DiT 骨干之外用于支持构建和混合，通过 BridgePath 生成（Main Path 保留背景上下文，Subject Path 从独立噪声生成可编辑内容），并引入可学习的 Discrete Geometric Gate 进行 token 级位置嵌入路由。在 BRIDGE-Bench 上，Local SigLIP2-T 从 FLUX.1-Fill 的 0.262 和 ACE++ 的 0.390 提升到 0.503，同时 local DINO 和 DreamSim 也有并行提升；MagicBrush 和 ICE-Bench 上的零样本结果显示有竞争力的对齐和源保留，且额外路由模块仅 13.31M 参数。
Motivation: 粗掩码局部编辑中，粗糙的掩码常成为意外的形状先验，使生成对象被拉向掩码的偶然边界，而不是作为灵活的编辑支持。作者将这一失败命名为掩码形状偏差，并用 Two-Zone Constraint 刻画任务：背景应稳定，可编辑区域应遵循指令而不被强制继承掩码轮廓。
Method: BRIDGE 将掩码保留在 DiT 骨干之外，用于支持构建和混合，避免 DiT 内部掩码注入以及 ControlNet 式复制分支。它使用 BridgePath 生成：Main Path 保留背景上下文，Subject Path 从独立噪声生成可编辑内容。受 Qwen-Image 诊断实验启发，提出可学习的 Discrete Geometric Gate，对 token 级位置嵌入路由进行控制，使主体 token 在融合区域附近借用背景锚定坐标或保留主体中心坐标以获得几何自由度。
Result: 在 BRIDGE-Bench 上，BRIDGE 将 Local SigLIP2-T 从 FLUX.1-Fill 的 0.262 和 ACE++ 的 0.390 提升到 0.503，并在 local DINO 和 DreamSim 上有并行提升。MagicBrush 和 ICE-Bench 上的零样本结果进一步显示有竞争力的对齐和源保留，且新增路由模块仅 13.31M 参数，比 ControlNet 风格的复制分支更紧凑。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过将掩码排除在 DiT 内部之外并采用 token 级离散几何门控，可以在保持背景稳定的同时减轻掩码形状偏差，实现更忠实于指令的局部编辑；该模块紧凑并具备跨基准的零样本泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Safeguarding LLM Agents from Misalignment through Provenance Analysis
papers.abstract_en: As LLM agents gain increasing access to powerful tools, ensuring that their actions align with the user's intent becomes critical. When an agent's proposed action deviates from that intent---a phenomenon called misalignment---it may cause harm that is difficult to undo. Existing runtime guardrails rely on an LLM-as-a-judge paradigm that lacks a systematic framework for reasoning about alignment, often producing inconsistent or difficult-to-audit judgments. Motivated by provenance analysis, we propose a conceptual framework that formalizes misalignment detection as determining whether a proposed tool call is supported by traceable evidence in the agent's context. Based on this framework, we build ProvenanceGuard, a multi-stage pipeline that analyzes the agent's action for three types of misalignment before its execution and only allows aligned actions. We evaluated ProvenanceGuard on AgentSafetyBench and WorkBench, across 11 backbone LLMs. Compared to the LLM-as-a-judge baseline, ProvenanceGuard reduces error rate on misaligned traces from 44.3% to 2.1% on Agent-SafetyBench and from 32.4% to 18.7% on WorkBench, while reducing interventions on task-successful traces from 31.2% to 13.0% and introducing no statistically significant increase in unnecessary interventions on aligned traces. These results demonstrate that structured, provenance-based reasoning provides an effective and practical foundation for safeguarding LLM agents from misalignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProvenanceGuard，一个基于溯源分析（provenance analysis）的多阶段管线，用于在 LLM agent 执行工具调用前检测 misalignment。作者将 misalignment 检测形式化为判断提议的工具调用是否得到 agent 上下文中可追溯证据的支持，并只允许对齐的动作。在 AgentSafetyBench 和 WorkBench 上、跨 11 个 backbone LLM 的评估中，该方法相比 LLM-as-a-judge 基线大幅降低误判率，同时减少了对成功轨迹的不必要干预。
Motivation: LLM agent 拥有强工具访问能力后，其动作偏离用户意图（misalignment）可能造成难以挽回的伤害。现有运行时 guardrails 依赖 LLM-as-a-judge 范式，缺乏系统化的对齐推理框架，容易产生不一致且难以审计的判断。
Method: 作者提出一个概念框架，将 misalignment 检测形式化为判断提议的工具调用是否被 agent 上下文中的可追溯证据支持；基于该框架构建 ProvenanceGuard 多阶段 pipeline，在执行前分析三类 misalignment，仅放行对齐的动作。
Result: 在 AgentSafetyBench 和 WorkBench 上、跨 11 个 backbone LLM，相比 LLM-as-a-judge 基线，misaligned traces 的错误率在 Agent-SafetyBench 上从 44.3% 降至 2.1%，在 WorkBench 上从 32.4% 降至 18.7%；对 task-successful traces 的干预从 31.2% 降至 13.0%，且未引入统计显著的多余干预。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，结构化的基于溯源的推理为保护 LLM agents 免受 misalignment 提供了有效且实用的基础，优于依赖 LLM 作为评判者的现有做法。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Multi-frame Restoration for 10 Hz Lissajous Confocal Laser Endomicroscopy
papers.abstract_en: Lissajous confocal laser endomicroscopy (CLE) is a promising solution for high-speed in vivo optical biopsy for handheld scenarios. However, Lissajous scanning traces a resonant trajectory and samples only the visited pixels per frame; at high frame rates, many pixels remain unvisited, creating structured holes. In this work, we introduce the first benchmark for 10 Hz Lissajous CLE, consisting of low-quality video clips paired with high-quality reference images. The reference images are wide-FOV mosaics obtained by stitching stabilized, slow-scan frames of the same tissue, enabling temporally aligned supervision. Using this dataset, we propose MIRA, a lightweight recurrent framework for Lissajous CLE restoration that iteratively aggregates temporal context through feature reuse and displacement alignment. Our experiments demonstrate that MIRA outperforms both lightweight and high-complexity baselines in restoration quality while maintaining a favorable computational efficiency suitable for clinical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 10 Hz Lissajous 共聚焦激光内窥显微镜 (CLE) 的高帧率成像问题，首次构建了由低质量视频片段与高质量参考图像配对组成的基准数据集，参考图像来自同一组织的稳定慢扫描拼接宽视场马赛克。作者提出轻量级循环恢复框架 MIRA，通过特征复用和位移对齐迭代聚合时间上下文，实验显示其在恢复质量上优于轻量级和高复杂度基线，同时保持适合临床部署的计算效率。
Motivation: Lissajous CLE 以共振轨迹扫描，每帧仅采样部分像素；高帧率下大量像素未被访问，形成结构化空洞，影响高速体内光学活检的图像可用性。
Method: 构建首个 10 Hz Lissajous CLE 恢复基准，包含低质量视频片段与时空对齐的高质量参考图；提出轻量级循环框架 MIRA，利用特征复用和位移对齐在帧间迭代聚合时间上下文以完成恢复。
Result: 实验表明 MIRA 在恢复质量上同时超过轻量级和高复杂度基线，并具有对临床部署有利的计算效率。
Conclusion: 该工作为 10 Hz Lissajous CLE 提供了首个基准和高效的恢复方案，其轻量特性指向临床实时应用的可行性。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Predictive Safety Filters for Probabilistic Neural Network Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Predictive safety filters (PSFs) leverage model predictive control to enforce constraint satisfaction during deep reinforcement learning (RL) exploration, yet their reliance on first-principles models or Gaussian processes limits scalability and broader applicability. Meanwhile, model-based RL (MBRL) methods routinely employ probabilistic ensemble (PE) neural networks to capture complex, high-dimensional dynamics from data with minimal prior knowledge. However, existing attempts to integrate PEs into PSFs lack rigorous uncertainty quantification. We introduce the Uncertainty-Aware Predictive Safety Filter (UPSi), a PSF that provides rigorous safety verification using PE dynamics models by formulating future outcomes as reachable sets. UPSi introduces an explicit certainty constraint that prevents model exploitation and integrates seamlessly into common MBRL frameworks. We evaluate UPSi under practical simplifications within Dyna-style MBRL on standard safe RL benchmarks and report substantial improvements in exploration safety over prior neural network PSFs while maintaining performance on par with standard MBRL. UPSi bridges the gap between the scalability and generality of modern MBRL and the safety guarantees of predictive safety filters.
papers.comment: Reinforcement Learning Journal, 2026. Reinforcement Learning Conference (RLC), Montréal, August 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Uncertainty-Aware Predictive Safety Filter (UPSi)，一种基于概率集成神经网络 (probabilistic ensemble neural network) 动力学模型的安全预测滤波器，通过将未来输出建模为可达集 (reachable sets) 来提供严格的安全验证。摘要称 UPSi 在一个显式确定性约束下防止模型被利用，并在 Dyna 式 MBRL 中的标准安全 RL 基准上显著提升了探索安全性，同时性能与标准 MBRL 相当。
Motivation: 现有预测安全滤波器 (PSFs) 依赖第一性原理模型或高斯过程，限制了可扩展性和通用性；而将概率集成网络融入 PSF 的尝试缺乏严格的 uncertainty quantification。
Method: UPSi 将 PE 动力学模型下的未来结果形式化为可达集，并引入显式的确定性约束 (certainty constraint) 以避免对模型的过度信任或利用，从而无缝集成到常见 MBRL 框架中。
Result: 在 Dyna 式 MBRL 的实用简化设定下，UPSi 相比之前的神经网络 PSF 带来实质性的探索安全性提升，同时保持与标准 MBRL 相当的性能。
Conclusion: UPSi 弥合了现代 MBRL 的可扩展性与预测安全滤波器的安全保证之间的差距，但其评估仍限于实用简化设定下的安全 RL 基准。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 Uncertainty-Aware Predictive Safety Filter (UPSi)，一种基于概率集成神经网络 (probabilistic ensemble neural network) 动力学模型的安全预测滤波器，通过将未来输出建模为可达集 (reachable sets) 来提供严格的安全验证。摘要称 UPSi 在一个显式确定性约束下防止模型被利用，并在 Dyna 式 MBRL 中的标准安全 RL 基准上显著提升了探索安全性，同时性能与标准 MBRL 相当。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有预测安全滤波器 (PSFs) 依赖第一性原理模型或高斯过程，限制了可扩展性和通用性；而将概率集成网络融入 PSF 的尝试缺乏严格的 uncertainty quantification。

papers.title: GIFGuard: Proactive Forensics against Deepfakes in Facial GIFs via Spatiotemporal Watermarking
papers.abstract_en: The rapid evolution of deepfake technology poses an unprecedented threat to the authenticity of Graphics Interchange Format (GIF) imagery, which serves as a representative of short-loop temporal media in social networks. However, existing proactive forensics works are designed for static images, which limits their applicability to animated GIFs. To bridge this gap, we propose GIFGuard, the first spatiotemporal watermarking framework tailored for deepfake proactive forensics in GIFs. In the embedding stage, we propose the Spatiotemporal Adaptive Residual Encoder (STARE) to ensure robustness against high-level semantic tampering. It employs a 3D convolutional backbone with adaptive channel recalibration to capture globally coherent temporal dependencies. In the extraction stage, we design the Deep Integrity Restoration Decoder (DIRD). It utilizes a spatiotemporal hourglass architecture equipped with 3D attention to restore latent features, allowing for the accurate extraction of watermark signals even under severe facial manipulation. Furthermore, we construct GIFfaces, the first large-scale benchmark dataset curated for GIF proactive forensics to facilitate research in this domain. Extensive results show that GIFGuard achieves high-fidelity visual quality and remarkable robustness performance against deepfakes. The related code and dataset are available at https://github.com/vpsg-research/GIFGuard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GIFGuard，这是首个面向 GIF 动图的深度伪造主动取证水印框架。嵌入阶段采用时空自适应残差编码器（STARE），提取阶段设计深度完整性恢复解码器（DIRD），并构建了首个 GIF 取证基准数据集 GIFfaces。实验表明该方法在保持高保真视觉质量的同时对深度伪造具有较强鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有主动取证方法主要针对静态图像，难以直接用于社交网络中常见的短循环动态媒体 GIF；深度伪造技术对 GIF 真实性的威胁尚未被专门研究。
Method: GIFGuard 在嵌入阶段使用基于 3D 卷积主干和自适应通道重标定的 STARE 编码器，以捕获全局时间依赖并抵抗高级语义篡改；提取阶段采用带 3D 注意力的时空沙漏结构 DIRD，在严重面部操作下恢复潜在特征并提取水印。
Result: 摘要报告 GIFGuard 在深度伪造场景下实现了高保真视觉质量和显著鲁棒性，并发布了首个大规模 GIF 主动取证基准数据集 GIFfaces 及代码。
Conclusion: 该工作填补了 GIF 动态媒体主动取证空白，验证了时空水印框架的有效性；相关代码和数据集已公开。

papers.title: Rethinking KV Cache Eviction via a Unified Information-Theoretic Objective
papers.abstract_en: Key-Value (KV) caching is essential for large language model inference, yet its memory overhead poses a critical bottleneck for long-context generation. Existing eviction policies predominantly rely on empirical heuristics, lacking a rigorous theoretical foundation. This work rethinks KV cache eviction through the lens of the Information Bottleneck principle. Under a linear-Gaussian surrogate of attention, we derive a closed-form mutual information objective that characterizes the effective information capacity of a retained KV cache subset. This formulation reveals that a wide range of existing eviction strategies can be interpreted as different approximations of the same capacity-maximization principle. Guided by this insight, we introduce CapKV, a capacity-aware eviction method that directly targets information preservation via a log-determinant approximation using statistical leverage scores. This approach replaces heuristic selection with a theoretically grounded mechanism that preserves the maximum predictive signal. Extensive experiments across multiple models and long-context benchmarks show that CapKV consistently outperforms prior methods, achieving a better trade-off between memory efficiency and generational fidelity. Our code is available at https://github.com/jiamingyy/CapKV
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从信息瓶颈（Information Bottleneck）原则重新审视 KV cache 驱逐问题。在线性高斯注意力替代模型下推导出闭式互信息目标，刻画保留 KV 子集的有效信息容量，并证明多种现有驱逐策略可视为同一容量最大化原则的近似。据此提出 CapKV，一种基于统计杠杆分数（leverage scores）与 log-determinant 近似的容量感知驱逐方法，在多个模型和长上下文基准上优于已有方法。
Motivation: 现有 KV cache 驱逐策略主要依赖经验启发式，缺乏严格理论支撑；而 KV cache 的内存开销是长上下文生成的关键瓶颈。
Method: 借助信息瓶颈原则，在线性高斯注意力代理下推导出闭式互信息目标；提出 CapKV，用统计杠杆分数的 log-determinant 近似直接最大化信息保留，以理论指导的机制替代启发式选择。
Result: 在多种模型和长上下文基准上的广泛实验表明，CapKV 一致优于先前方法，在内存效率与生成保真度之间取得更好的权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作将经验性驱逐策略统一到容量最大化原理之下，并以理论指导的机制替代启发式；未提及明显局限。

papers.title: Majorization-Guided Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language Models under Modality-Specific Shift
papers.abstract_en: Vision--language models can face asymmetric visual and textual shifts at deployment. These shifts expose a multimodal failure mode in which an unreliable branch remains overconfident, dominates fusion, and causes entropy-based test-time adaptation to sharpen an incorrect prediction. We model this behavior as doubly stochastic posterior mixing and cast adaptation as constrained de-mixing. Majorization-Guided Multimodal Test-Time Adaptation (MG-MTTA) freezes both encoders and updates only a lightweight fusion module. Running-anchor consistency estimates relative branch drift, while cross-modal conflict regulates modality dominance before entropy sharpening. The analysis gives sufficient conditions for entropy reduction to preserve the clean decision and an explicit threshold at which a biased modality reverses the fused ranking. Across visual, textual, and joint shifts, MG-MTTA improves ImageNet top-1 accuracy from 57.97\% to 66.51\% under textual shift and from 21.68\% to 26.27\% under joint shift, while reducing wrong-more-confident failures. The largest gains occur under textual and joint shifts, where the two branches differ more in reliability. Project page: https://mg-mtta.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向视觉-语言模型模态偏移的测试时适应方法 MG-MTTA（Majorization-Guided Multimodal Test-Time Adaptation）。作者将部署时的不对称视觉/文本偏移建模为双随机后验混合（doubly stochastic posterior mixing），并把适应问题视为约束去混合；方法冻结两个编码器，仅更新轻量融合模块。实验显示在视觉、文本及联合偏移下均提升 ImageNet top-1 精度，并减少“错误但更自信”（wrong-more-confident）的失败。
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型在部署时会遇到不对称的视觉和文本偏移，导致不可靠分支过度自信并主导融合，使基于熵的测试时适应反而锐化错误预测。现有方法没有针对这种多模态失效模式进行显式建模。
Method: 将偏移行为形式化为双随机后验混合，并将适应建模为受约束的去混合问题。MG-MTTA 冻结两个编码器，只更新轻量融合模块；用运行锚一致性（running-anchor consistency）估计分支相对漂移，并在熵锐化之前通过跨模态冲突（cross-modal conflict）调节模态主导性。理论分析给出熵降低保持干净决策的充分条件，以及偏置模态翻转融合排序的显式阈值。
Result: 在 ImageNet 上，文本偏移下 top-1 精度从 57.97% 提升到 66.51%，联合偏移下从 21.68% 提升到 26.27%；同时减少了错误但更自信的失败。最大提升出现在文本偏移和联合偏移场景，即两个分支可靠性差异更大的情形。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过对后验进行约束去混合并在熵锐化前调节模态主导性，可以在模态特定偏移下保持干净决策；收益在分支可靠性差异大时最显著。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Time-Series Forecasting in Safety-Critical Environments: An Open-Source Package for EU-AI-Act-Compliant Development / Zeitreihenprognose in sicherheitskritischen Umgebungen: Ein Open-Source-Paket für die KI-VO-konforme Entwicklung
papers.abstract_en: With spotforecast2-safe we present an integrated Compliance-by-Design approach to Python-based point forecasting of time series in safety-critical environments. A review of the relevant open-source tooling shows that existing compliance solutions operate consistently outside of the library to be used - e.g. as scanners, templates, or runtime layers. spotforecast2-safe takes the inverse approach and anchors the requirements of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (the EU AI Act, in German: KI-VO), of IEC 61508, of the ISA/IEC 62443 standards series, and of the Cyber Resilience Act within the library: in application-programming-interface contracts, persistence formats, and continuous-integration gates. The approach is operationalised by four non-negotiable code-development rules (zero dead code, deterministic processing, fail-safe handling, minimal dependencies) together with the corresponding process rules (model card, executable docstrings, CI workflows, Common-Platform-Enumeration (CPE) identifier, REUSE-conformant licensing, release pipeline). Interactive visualisation, hyperparameter tuning and automated machine learning (AutoML), as well as deep-learning and large-language-model backends are deliberately excluded, because each of these components either enlarges the attack surface, introduces non-determinism, or impairs reproducibility. Every article of the EU AI Act that is relevant to the library is discussed in detail. A bidirectional traceability matrix maps every regulatory provision onto the corresponding mechanism in the code; an end-to-end example of European-market electricity generation, transmission, and consumption forecasting demonstrates the application. The package is open-source and available under Affero General Public License (AGPL) 3.0-or-later.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 spotforecast2-safe，一个面向安全关键环境的开源 Python 点预测 (point forecasting) 包，采用 Compliance-by-Design 方法将欧盟《人工智能法案》(EU AI Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689)、IEC 61508、ISA/IEC 62443 系列标准以及《网络弹性法案》的要求直接嵌入库内部，而非依赖外部扫描器、模板或运行时层。实现手段包括 API 契约、持久化格式、持续集成门禁、四条不可协商的代码开发规则以及配套流程规则，并附有双向可追溯性矩阵和电力市场预测的端到端示例。
Motivation: 现有开源合规工具通常在所用库之外运作，如扫描器、模板或运行时层，导致合规要求与库的实际开发过程脱节；本文针对这一缺口提出将监管要求内置于库本身的替代路径。
Method: spotforecast2-safe 将法规要求锚定在库内的应用程序编程接口契约、持久化格式和持续集成门禁中，并依靠四条代码开发规则（零死代码、确定性处理、故障安全处理、最小依赖）及相应流程规则（模型卡、可执行 docstring、CI 工作流、CPE 标识符、REUSE 许可、发布流水线）来运转，同时刻意排除交互式可视化、超参数调优、AutoML 以及深度学习和大型语言模型后端。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，而是通过一个欧洲市场电力发电、输电和消费预测的端到端示例展示该方法的实际应用，并给出将每项监管条款映射到代码机制的逐条讨论和双向可追溯性矩阵。
Conclusion: 作者认为将合规要求嵌入库内部可以实现安全关键环境下时间序列预测的合规开发，且该包以 AGPL 3.0-or-later 许可开源发布；排除非确定性组件是该方法有意为之的边界。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Process Supervision of Confidence Margin for Calibrated LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Scaling test-time computation with reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a reliable path to improve large language models (LLM) reasoning ability. Yet, outcome-based reward often incentivizes models to be overconfident, leading to hallucinations, unreliable confidence-based control, and unnecessary compute allocation. We introduce Reinforcement Learning with Confidence Margin (RLCM), a calibration-aware RL framework that jointly optimizes correctness and confidence reliability via a margin-enhanced process reward over intermediate-budget completions. Rather than aligning confidence to correctness likelihoods, RLCM encourages the model to widen the confidence margin between correct and incorrect steps within a single reasoning trajectory. Across mathematical, code, logic and science benchmarks, our method substantially improves calibration while maintaining or improving accuracy. We further show that, with calibrated confidence signals, the resulting models enable more efficient conformal risk control and effective confidence-weighted aggregation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RLCM（Reinforcement Learning with Confidence Margin），一个将校准感知纳入强化学习 (RL) 的 LLM 推理框架，通过在中间预算补全上使用 margin-enhanced process reward 同时优化正确性与置信度可靠性。在数学、代码、逻辑和科学基准上，该方法在保持或提升准确率的同时显著改善校准，并支持更高效的 conformal risk control 与有效的置信度加权聚合。
Motivation: 基于结果的奖励 (outcome-based reward) 常激励模型过度自信，导致幻觉、不可靠的置信度控制以及不必要的计算分配，因此需要显式地把置信度校准纳入训练目标。
Method: 引入 margin-enhanced process reward，鼓励模型在单个推理轨迹内拉大正确步骤与错误步骤之间的置信度边际，而不是把置信度直接对齐到正确性似然；整个框架在 RL 中联合优化正确性和置信度可靠性。
Result: 在数学、代码、逻辑和科学等基准上，RLCM 在维持或提升准确率的同时显著改善校准；校准后的置信度信号还能带来更高效的 conformal risk control 和有效的置信度加权聚合。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将置信度边际纳入过程奖励可以同时兼顾正确性与校准，并说明校准信号在实际风险控制和聚合场景中的实用价值。

papers.title: GeoLink: A 3D-Aware Framework Towards Better Generalization in Cross-View Geo-Localization
papers.abstract_en: Generalizable cross-view geo-localization aims to match the same location across views in unseen regions and conditions without GPS supervision. Its core difficulty lies in severe semantic inconsistency caused by viewpoint variation and poor generalization under domain shift. Existing methods mainly rely on 2D correspondence, but they are easily distracted by redundant shared information across views, leading to less transferable representations. To address this, we propose GeoLink, a 3D-aware semantic-consistent framework for Generalizable cross-view geo-localization. Specifically, we offline reconstruct scene point clouds from multi-view drone images using VGGT, providing stable structural priors. Based on these 3D anchors, we improve 2D representation learning in two complementary ways. A Geometric-aware Semantic Refinement module mitigates potentially redundant and view-biased dependencies in 2D features under 3D guidance. In addition, a Unified View Relation Distillation module transfers 3D structural relations to 2D features, improving cross-view alignment while preserving a 2D-only inference pipeline. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that GeoLink consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods and achieves superior generalization across unseen domains and diverse weather environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoLink，一个面向可泛化跨视角地理定位（cross-view geo-localization）的 3D 感知语义一致框架，目标是在未见区域和不同条件下匹配同一地理位置。该方法离线利用 VGGT 从多视角无人机图像重建场景点云作为结构先验，并通过两个互补模块改进 2D 表征学习，同时保持推理时的纯 2D 管线。在多个基准上，GeoLink 一致优于现有最先进方法，并在未见域和多样天气环境下取得更好的泛化。
Motivation: 跨视角地理定位的核心难点在于视角变化带来的严重语义不一致，以及域偏移下的泛化不足；现有方法主要依赖 2D 对应关系，容易受到跨视角冗余共享信息的干扰，导致表征可迁移性较差。
Method: 提出 GeoLink 框架：先用 VGGT 离线从多视角无人机图像重建场景点云，提供稳定的 3D 结构先验；再通过 Geometric-aware Semantic Refinement 模块在 3D 引导下削减 2D 特征中冗余和视角偏置依赖，并通过 Unified View Relation Distillation 模块将 3D 结构关系蒸馏到 2D 特征，改进跨视角对齐且不改变推理时的 2D-only 流程。
Result: 多个基准上的广泛实验表明，GeoLink 持续优于最先进方法，并在未见域和多样天气环境中取得更好的泛化性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调借助 3D 结构先验并配合蒸馏式表征学习，可以缓解 2D 跨视角匹配中的语义不一致问题，同时保持纯 2D 推理管线以适应实用场景。

papers.title: Multi-Head Residual-Gated DeepONet for Coherent Nonlinear Wave Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Coherent nonlinear wave dynamics are often strongly shaped by a compact set of physically meaningful descriptors of the initial state. Traditional neural operators typically treat the input-output mapping as a largely black-box high-dimensional regression problem, without explicitly exploiting this structured physical context. Common feature-integration strategies usually rely on direct concatenation or FiLM-style affine modulation in hidden latent spaces. Here we introduce a different paradigm, loosely inspired by the complementary roles of state evolution and physically meaningful observables in quantum mechanics: the wave field is learned through a standard DeepONet state pathway, while compact physical descriptors follow a parallel conditioning pathway and act as residual modulation factors on the state prediction. Based on this idea, we develop a Multi-Head Residual-Gated DeepONet (MH-RG), which combines a pre-branch residual modulator, a branch residual gate, and a trunk residual gate with a low-rank multi-head mechanism to capture multiple complementary conditioned response patterns without prohibitive parameter growth. We evaluate the framework on representative benchmarks including highly nonlinear conservative wave dynamics and dissipative trapped dynamics and further perform detailed mechanistic analyses of the learned multi-head gating behavior. Compared with feature-augmented baselines, MH-RG DeepONet achieves consistently lower error while better preserving phase coherence and the fidelity of physically relevant dynamical quantities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Multi-Head Residual-Gated DeepONet (MH-RG)，针对相干非线性波动力学建模，将波场学习放入标准 DeepONet 状态通路，同时让紧凑的物理描述符经并行条件通路以残差调制方式影响状态预测。网络结合 pre-branch 残差调制器、branch 残差门、trunk 残差门以及低秩多头机制，在强非线性保守波动力学和耗散被困动力学基准上评估，并分析多门控行为。
Motivation: 传统神经算子通常把输入输出映射视为黑盒高维回归，未显式利用初始状态中少量有物理意义的描述符；常见的特征融合方式多是直接拼接或 FiLM 式仿射调制，缺乏对物理上下文的显式结构利用。
Method: 借鉴量子力学中状态演化和物理可观测量互补角色的思想，提出双通路框架：波场经标准 DeepONet 状态通路学习，物理描述符走并行条件通路并作为残差调制因子作用于状态预测；具体由 pre-branch 残差调制器、branch 残差门和 trunk 残差门配合低秩多头机制构成 MH-RG。
Result: 在强非线性保守波动力学与耗散被困动力学等代表性基准上，相比特征增强基线，MH-RG DeepONet 获得持续更低的误差，同时更好地保持相位一致性与物理相关动力学量的保真度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过物理描述符的残差门控条件化能改进相干非线性波动力学的神经算子建模，并给出了学习到的多头门控行为的机械式分析。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: Fairness is Not Flat: Geometric Phase Transitions Against Shortcut Learning
authors: Nicolas Rodriguez-Alvarez (Instituto de Educacion Secundaria Parquesol
papers.abstract_en: Deep Neural Networks are highly susceptible to shortcut learning, frequently memorizing low-dimensional spurious correlations instead of underlying causal mechanisms. This phenomenon not only degrades out-of-distribution robustness but also induces severe demographic biases in sensitive applications. In this paper, we propose a geometric \textit{a priori} methodology to mitigate shortcut learning. By deploying a zero-hidden-layer ($N=1$) Topological Auditor, we mathematically isolate features that monopolize the gradient without human intervention. We empirically demonstrate a Capacity Phase Transition: once linear shortcuts are pruned, networks are forced to utilize higher geometric capacity ($N \geq 16$) to curve the decision boundary and learn ethical representations. Our approach outperforms L1 Regularization -- which collapses into demographic bias -- and operates at a fraction of the computational cost of post-hoc methods like Just Train Twice (JTT), successfully reducing counterfactual gender vulnerability from 21.18\% to 7.66\%.
papers.comment: Authorship correction: F. Rodriguez-Merino moved to Acknowledgements with consent
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种几何先验方法缓解深度神经网络的捷径学习 (shortcut learning)：利用零隐层 (N=1) 的 Topological Auditor 在不需人工干预的情况下数学化地隔离垄断梯度的特征。作者实证展示了容量相变 (Capacity Phase Transition)：剪除线性捷径后，网络被迫使用更高的几何容量 (N ≥ 16) 来弯曲决策边界并学习符合伦理的表示。该方法优于 L1 正则化，计算成本远低于 Just Train Twice (JTT) 等事后方法，并将反事实性别脆弱性从 21.18% 降至 7.66%。
Motivation: 深度神经网络极易陷入捷径学习，记忆低维虚假相关而非底层因果机制，这不仅损害分布外鲁棒性，还会在敏感应用中引发严重的人口统计偏差。
Method: 提出几何先验方法：部署零隐层 (N=1) 的 Topological Auditor，数学上隔离垄断梯度的特征，从而在不需人工标注的情况下剪除线性捷径，迫使网络利用更高几何容量 (N ≥ 16) 学习更合理的决策边界。
Result: 摘要报告了容量相变现象，并显示该方法优于会坍缩为人口统计偏见的 L1 正则化，且计算开销远低于 JTT 等事后方法，成功将反事实性别脆弱性从 21.18% 降到 7.66%。
Conclusion: 作者强调，以几何先验方式剪除线性捷径能够触发容量相变，使网络学到更具伦理性的表示，并在效率和效果上优于传统正则化与事后干预方法。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Bidirectional Learning of Facial Action Units and Expressions via Structured Semantic Mapping across Heterogeneous Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Facial action unit (AU) detection and facial expression (FE) recognition can be jointly viewed as affective facial behavior tasks, representing fine-grained muscular activations and coarse-grained holistic affective states, respectively. Despite their inherent semantic correlation, existing studies predominantly focus on knowledge transfer from AUs to FEs, while bidirectional learning remains insufficiently explored. In practice, this challenge is further compounded by heterogeneous data conditions, where AU and FE datasets differ in annotation paradigms (frame-level vs.\ clip-level), label granularity, and data availability and diversity, hindering effective joint learning. To address these issues, we propose a Structured Semantic Mapping (SSM) framework for bidirectional AU--FE learning under different data domains and heterogeneous supervision. SSM consists of three key components: (1) a shared visual backbone that learns unified facial representations from dynamic AU and FE videos; (2) semantic mediation via a Textual Semantic Prototype (TSP) module, which constructs structured semantic prototypes from fixed textual descriptions with learnable context prompts for supervision and cross-task alignment in a shared semantic space; and (3) a Dynamic Prior Mapping (DPM) module that incorporates FACS-derived prior knowledge and learns data-adaptive bidirectional association matrices in the textual semantic space for explicit knowledge transfer. Extensive experiments on popular AU detection and FE recognition benchmarks show that SSM consistently outperforms its single-task and multi-task baselines and achieves competitive performance against task-specific methods. The FE-to-AU results further show that holistic expression semantics provides useful supervision for fine-grained AU learning across heterogeneous datasets.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 17 figures, 20 tables. Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing. Revised after peer review. The source code and models will be publicly available at https://github.com/MSA-LMC/SSM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结构化语义映射（SSM）框架，用于在异构数据集上双向学习面部动作单元（AU）检测与面部表情（FE）识别。框架由共享视觉骨干、文本语义原型（TSP）模块和动态先验映射（DPM）模块组成，在共享语义空间中实现跨任务对齐与显式知识迁移。在常用 AU 与 FE 基准上，SSM 一致优于单任务和多任务基线，并取得与任务专用方法相竞争的性能；FE-to-AU 结果显示表情语义可为细粒度 AU 学习提供有效监督。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注从 AU 到 FE 的知识迁移，AU 与 FE 间的双向学习尚未被充分探索；同时，AU 和 FE 数据集在标注范式（帧级 vs 片段级）、标签粒度以及数据可用性和多样性上存在异质性，阻碍了有效的联合学习。
Method: 提出 SSM 框架，包含三个关键组件：共享视觉骨干从动态 AU/FE 视频中学习统一面部表征；TSP 模块利用固定文本描述与可学习上下文提示构造结构化语义原型，用于监督和跨任务对齐；DPM 模块引入 FACS 先验知识并学习数据自适应的双向关联矩阵，在文本语义空间中完成显式知识迁移。
Result: 在常用 AU 检测与 FE 识别基准上的大量实验表明，SSM 一致优于其单任务和多任务基线，并与任务专用方法竞争性能；FE-to-AU 结果进一步表明，整体表情语义能为异构数据集上的细粒度 AU 学习提供有用的监督信号。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过语义空间中的结构化映射和 FACS 先验，可以支持异构监督下的双向 AU-FE 学习，并有效提升两个任务的性能。摘要未给出明确的局限性讨论。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在常用 AU 检测与 FE 识别基准上的大量实验表明，SSM 一致优于其单任务和多任务基线，并与任务专用方法竞争性能；FE-to-AU 结果进一步表明，整体表情语义能为异构数据集上的细粒度 AU 学习提供有用的监督信号。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，通过语义空间中的结构化映射和 FACS 先验，可以支持异构监督下的双向 AU-FE 学习，并有效提升两个任务的性能。摘要未给出明确的局限性讨论。

papers.title: FinTrace: Holistic Trajectory-Level Evaluation of LLM Tool Calling for Long-Horizon Financial Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies demonstrate that tool-calling capability enables large language models (LLMs) to interact with external environments for long-horizon financial tasks. While existing benchmarks have begun evaluating financial tool calling, they focus on limited scenarios and rely on call-level metrics that fail to capture trajectory-level reasoning quality. To address this gap, we introduce FinTrace, a benchmark comprising 800 expert-annotated trajectories spanning 34 real-world financial task categories across multiple difficulty levels. FinTrace employs a rubric-based evaluation protocol with nine metrics organized along four axes -- action correctness, execution efficiency, process quality, and output quality -- enabling fine-grained assessment of LLM tool-calling behavior. Our evaluation of 13 LLMs reveals that while frontier models achieve strong tool selection, all models struggle with information utilization and final answer quality, exposing a critical gap between invoking the right tools and reasoning effectively over their outputs. To move beyond diagnosis, we construct FinTrace-Training, the first trajectory-level preference dataset for financial tool-calling, containing 8,196 curated trajectories with tool-augmented contexts and preference pairs. We fine-tune Qwen-3-8B/32B using supervised fine-tuning followed by direct preference optimization (DPO) and show that training on FinTrace-Training consistently improves intermediate reasoning metrics, with DPO more effectively suppressing failure modes. However, end-to-end answer quality remains a bottleneck, indicating that trajectory-level improvements do not yet fully propagate to final output quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FinTrace，一个包含 800 条专家标注轨迹、覆盖 34 类真实金融任务类别且含多难度等级的基准，用于评估 LLM 在长时程金融任务中的工具调用。其采用基于 rubric 的评估协议，包含沿动作正确性、执行效率、过程质量和输出质量四个轴的九项指标。对 13 个 LLM 的评测显示前沿模型工具选择强，但在信息利用和最终答案质量上普遍薄弱；作者进一步构建 FinTrace-Training 轨迹级偏好数据集并对 Qwen-3-8B/32B 进行 SFT+DPO 微调。
Motivation: 现有金融工具调用基准场景有限，且依赖调用级指标，无法捕捉轨迹级推理质量，因此缺少对长时程金融任务中推理过程的细粒度评估。
Method: 构建包含 800 条专家标注轨迹的 FinTrace 基准，设计基于 rubric 的四轴九指标评估协议；并在此基础上构建 FinTrace-Training，这是首个金融工具调用的轨迹级偏好数据集，含 8,196 条工具增强上下文与偏好对，随后对 Qwen-3-8B/32B 使用监督微调 (SFT) 加直接偏好优化 (DPO) 进行训练。
Result: 13 个 LLM 的评测显示，前沿模型工具选择能力强，但所有模型在信息利用和最终答案质量上表现薄弱；在 FinTrace-Training 上训练能一致改善中间推理指标，且 DPO 更能有效抑制失败模式，但端到端答案质量仍然是瓶颈。
Conclusion: 摘要强调轨迹级改进尚未完全传导到最终输出质量，说明从正确调用工具到对工具输出进行有效推理之间仍存在关键差距，需要进一步弥合。

papers.title: Post-Deployment Accountability in AI Governance: A Cross-Regulatory Empirical Analysis of AI Incidents
papers.abstract_en: Post-deployment accountability has become central to AI governance, yet little empirical evidence shows whether monitoring, incident reporting, and impact assessment obligations are visible when AI systems fail. This study analyzes real-world AI incidents from the AI Incident Database (2020-2026) and codes them against nine post-deployment provisions from the EU AI Act, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and the GDPR. The findings show substantial accountability gaps: 77.1% of incidents lack evidence of EU AI Act post-market monitoring, and 99.6% lack documented Data-Protection Impact Assessment evidence. Governance gaps are also systemic, with 9.8% of incidents simultaneously non-compliant under two or more regimes. Incidents detected through internal monitoring show much higher compliance than externally detected incidents (87.5% vs. 5.3% under the EU AI Act; 95.8% vs. 58.1% under NIST), suggesting that monitoring capacity is a key condition for effective post-deployment governance. Building on these findings, the paper proposes the Proactive AI Governance Compliance Framework (PAGCF), a four-phase lifecycle for pre-deployment assessment, continuous monitoring, incident preparedness, and cross-framework verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于 AI Incident Database (2020-2026) 中的真实 AI 事故，对照 EU AI Act、NIST AI Risk Management Framework 和 GDPR 的九项部署后义务进行编码，考察监测、事故报告和影响评估义务在系统故障时是否可见。结果显示问责缺口显著：77.1% 的事故缺乏 EU AI Act 上市后监测 (post-market monitoring) 证据，99.6% 缺乏数据保护影响评估 (DPIA) 证据，9.8% 的事故同时在两个及以上监管框架下不合规。内部监测发现的事故合规率明显高于外部发现（EU AI Act 下 87.5% 对 5.3%，NIST 下 95.8% 对 58.1%），并据此提出四阶段的生命周期框架 PAGCF。
Motivation: 部署后问责已成为 AI 治理的核心议题，但缺乏经验证据说明监测、事故报告和影响评估等义务在 AI 系统实际失效时是否被落实，即现有治理框架的事后执行情况缺少实证分析。
Method: 对 AI Incident Database (2020-2026) 中的真实 AI 事故进行编码，逐一比对其与 EU AI Act、NIST AI RMF、GDPR 的九项部署后条款的合规证据，并基于实证结果提出 Proactive AI Governance Compliance Framework (PAGCF)，包括部署前评估、持续监测、事故准备和跨框架验证四个阶段。
Result: 摘要报告 77.1% 的事故没有 EU AI Act 上市后监测的可见证据，99.6% 没有 DPIA 证据；9.8% 的事故同时在两个及以上监管制度下不合规。内部监测发现的事故合规率远高于外部发现：EU AI Act 下 87.5% 对 5.3%，NIST 下 95.8% 对 58.1%。
Conclusion: 本文认为监测能力是有效部署后治理的关键条件，并提出 PAGCF 作为跨框架验证与问责改进的生命周期方案，以缩小现有监管义务与实际 AI 事故应对之间的差距。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SkillClaw: Let Skills Evolve Collectively with Agentic Evolver
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents such as OpenClaw rely on reusable skills to perform complex tasks, yet these skills remain largely static after deployment. As a result, similar workflows, tool usage patterns, and failure modes are repeatedly rediscovered across users, preventing the system from improving with experience. While interactions from different users provide complementary signals about when a skill works or fails, existing systems lack a mechanism to convert such heterogeneous experiences into reliable skill updates. To address these issues, we present SkillClaw, a framework for collective skill evolution in multi-user agent ecosystems, which treats cross-user and over-time interactions as the primary signal for improving skills. SkillClaw continuously aggregates trajectories generated during use and processes them with an autonomous evolver, which identifies recurring behavioral patterns and translates them into updates to the skill set by refining existing skills or extending them with new capabilities. The resulting skills are maintained in a shared repository and synchronized across users, allowing improvements discovered in one context to propagate system-wide while requiring no additional effort from users. By integrating multi-user experience into ongoing skill updates, SkillClaw enables cross-user knowledge transfer and cumulative capability improvement, and experiments on WildClawBench show that limited interaction and feedback, it significantly improves the performance of Qwen3-Max in real-world agent scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillClaw，一个面向多用户智能体生态系统的集体技能演化框架，旨在解决 LLM 智能体（如 OpenClaw）技能在部署后保持静态、无法从跨用户经验中改进的问题。SkillClaw 持续聚合用户使用轨迹，由自主进化器识别重复行为模式，并通过精炼或扩展技能来更新共享技能库，改进可跨用户同步传播。在 WildClawBench 上的实验表明，在有限交互和反馈下，该方法显著提升了 Qwen3-Max 在真实世界智能体场景中的性能。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体依赖可复用技能，但技能部署后基本静态，相似工作流、工具使用模式和失败方式在不同用户间被反复重新发现，系统无法随经验改进；虽然不同用户的交互提供了技能何时有效或失败的互补信号，但已有系统缺乏将这种异质经验转化为可靠技能更新的机制。
Method: SkillClaw 将跨用户和随时间推移的交互作为改进技能的主要信号，持续聚合使用过程中生成的轨迹，并通过一个自主进化器（autonomous evolver）识别重复行为模式，将其转化为对技能集的更新——要么精炼现有技能，要么扩展新能力；更新后的技能保存在共享仓库中并跨用户同步，使改进无需用户额外努力即可系统范围传播。
Result: 实验在 WildClawBench 上进行，摘要报告在有限交互和反馈条件下，SkillClaw 显著提升了 Qwen3-Max 在真实世界智能体场景中的性能，表明多用户经验的整合带来了跨用户知识迁移与累积能力提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过将多用户经验纳入持续技能更新，SkillClaw 能够实现跨用户知识迁移和系统能力的累积提升，但摘要未给出关于局限性的明确陈述。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Preference Redirection via Attention Concentration: An Attack on Computer Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Advancements in multimodal foundation models have enabled the development of Computer Use Agents (CUAs) capable of autonomously interacting with GUI environments. As CUAs are not restricted to certain tools, they allow to automate more complex agentic tasks but at the same time open up new security vulnerabilities. While prior work has concentrated on the language modality, the vulnerability of the vision modality has received less attention. In this paper, we introduce PRAC, a novel attack that, unlike prior work targeting the VLM output directly, manipulates the model's internal preferences by redirecting its attention toward a stealthy adversarial patch. We show that PRAC is able to manipulate the selection process of a CUA on an online shopping platform towards a chosen target product. While we require white-box access to the model for the creation of the attack, we show that our attack generalizes to fine-tuned versions of the same model, presenting a critical threat as multiple companies build specific CUAs based on open weights models.
papers.journal_ref: Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRAC，一种针对 Computer Use Agents (CUAs) 的新型攻击。与直接攻击 VLM 输出的既有工作不同，PRAC 通过将模型的注意力重定向到一个隐蔽的对抗补丁 (adversarial patch)，操纵模型的内部偏好。作者在在线购物平台场景中展示了该攻击能使 CUA 的选项选择过程偏向指定目标商品；攻击生成需要白盒访问，但可以泛化到同一模型的不同微调版本。
Motivation: 多模态基础模型驱动的 CUAs 能自主操作 GUI，完成更复杂的智能体任务，但也引入了新的安全漏洞。已有攻击研究主要集中于语言模态，视觉模态的脆弱性关注不足。
Method: PRAC 是一种针对视觉模态的攻击方法，它不直接修改或攻击 VLM 输出，而是生成一个隐蔽的对抗补丁，将模型内部注意力重定向到该补丁，从而改变模型对被选目标的内在偏好。攻击补丁的生成需要白盒访问模型，但作者检验了其对微调版本的迁移性。
Result: 在在线购物平台任务中，PRAC 成功操纵 CUA 的选择流程，使其倾向选择攻击者指定的目标商品。该攻击还能迁移到同一模型的不同微调版本，构成对基于开放权重模型构建专用 CUAs 的威胁。
Conclusion: 作者强调，由于多家公司基于开放权重模型构建专门的 CUAs，此类可迁移到微调版本的白盒攻击是一个严重威胁；同时该结果表明视觉模态是 CUA 安全中此前被低估的攻击面。

papers.title: Continual Visual Anomaly Detection on the Edge: Benchmark and Efficient Solutions
papers.abstract_en: Visual Anomaly Detection (VAD) is a critical task for many applications including industrial inspection and healthcare. While VAD has been extensively studied, two key challenges remain largely unaddressed in conjunction: edge deployment, where computational resources are severely constrained, and continual learning, where models must adapt to evolving data distributions without forgetting previously acquired knowledge. Our benchmark provides guidance for the selection of the optimal backbone and VAD method under joint efficiency and adaptability constraints, characterizing the trade-offs between memory footprint, inference cost, and detection performance. Studying these challenges in isolation is insufficient, as methods designed for one setting make assumptions that break down when the other constraint is simultaneously imposed. In this work, we propose the first comprehensive benchmark for VAD on the edge in the continual learning scenario, evaluating seven VAD models across three lightweight backbone architectures. Furthermore, we propose Tiny-Dinomaly, a lightweight adaptation of the Dinomaly model built on the DINO foundation model that achieves a 11$\times$ smaller memory footprint and 20$\times$ lower computational cost while improving localization (Pixel F1) by 5 percentage points. Finally, we introduce targeted modifications to PatchCore and PaDiM to improve their efficiency in the continual learning setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个面向边缘设备（edge deployment）与持续学习（continual learning）联合场景的视觉异常检测（VAD）基准，评估七个 VAD 模型在三种轻量级骨干网络上的表现。作者还提出 Tiny-Dinomaly，基于 DINO 基础模型的轻量级 Dinomaly 改编，内存占用降低 11 倍、计算成本降低 20 倍，同时定位性能（Pixel F1）提升 5 个百分点。此外，作者对 PatchCore 和 PaDiM 进行了针对性修改，以提高它们在持续学习场景下的效率。
Motivation: 视觉异常检测在工业检测和医疗等应用中至关重要，但边缘部署的资源受限与持续学习中的数据分布漂移两大挑战很少被联合研究。单独研究其中一种场景会导致方法做出的假设在另一种约束下失效，因此需要同时考虑效率与适应性的综合基准。
Method: 构建了一个覆盖七个 VAD 模型、三种轻量级骨干架构的综合基准，并在此框架下提出 Tiny-Dinomaly 这一轻量化的 Dinomaly 变体。此外，对 PatchCore 和 PaDiM 做针对性修改，使其在持续学习设置下更高效。
Result: 摘要报告 Tiny-Dinomaly 相比原模型实现 11 倍更小的内存占用和 20 倍更低的计算成本，同时将定位性能 Pixel F1 提升 5 个百分点。
Conclusion: 该基准为在效率和适应性联合约束下选择最优骨干网络与 VAD 方法提供指导，刻画了内存占用、推理成本与检测性能之间的权衡。

papers.title: Is CLIP Cross-Eyed? Revealing and Mitigating Center Bias in the CLIP Family
papers.abstract_en: Recent research has shown that contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP often lack fine-grained understanding of visual content. While a growing body of work has sought to address this limitation, we identify a distinct failure mode in the CLIP family, which we term center bias, that persists even in recent model variants. Specifically, CLIP tends to disproportionately focus on the central region of an image, overlooking important objects located near the boundaries. This limitation is fundamental as failure to recognize relevant objects makes it difficult to perform any sophisticated tasks that depend on those objects. To understand the underlying causes of the limitation, we conduct analyses from both representation and attention perspectives. Using interpretability methods, i.e., embedding decomposition and attention map analysis, we find that relevant concepts especially those associated with off-center objects vanish from the model's embedding in the final representation due to information loss during the aggregation of visual embeddings, particularly the reliance on pooling mechanisms. Finally, we show that this bias can be alleviated with training-free strategies such as visual prompting and attention redistribution by redirecting models' attention to off-center regions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文识别并命名了 CLIP 系列视觉-语言模型中的一个失败模式——中心偏置 (center bias)，即模型过度关注图像中心区域而忽略边界附近的重要物体。作者通过 embedding 分解和 attention map 分析，从表征与注意力两个视角诊断其原因，发现相关概念（尤其是非中心物体）在视觉 embedding 聚合（特别是 pooling 机制）过程中发生信息丢失而消失。最后提出无需训练的缓解策略，如视觉提示 (visual prompting) 和注意力重分配 (attention redistribution)。
Motivation: CLIP 等对比式视觉-语言模型常缺乏对视觉内容的细粒度理解，已有工作试图改进但未解决一个基础性缺陷：边界物体被系统性忽略。由于无法识别相关物体会阻碍依赖这些物体的复杂下游任务，理解并缓解这一偏置具有重要意义。
Method: 采用可解释性方法，包括 embedding 分解和注意力图分析，从表征与注意力两个层面研究中心偏置的成因；并提出训练-free 的缓解手段，即视觉提示和注意力重分配，将模型注意力引导至非中心区域。
Result: 分析发现，最终表征中与 off-center 物体相关的概念因视觉 embedding 聚合（尤其依赖 pooling 机制）过程中的信息丢失而消失；训练-free 策略能够缓解该偏置。
Conclusion: 摘要强调中心偏置是 CLIP 家族中持续存在的固有失败模式，且可通过无需训练的策略加以缓解，为后续改进细粒度视觉理解提供了方向。

papers.title: SALLIE: Generation-Free Hidden-State Detection of Jailbreaks and Prompt Injections Across Text and Vision
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are vulnerable to jailbreaks and prompt injections delivered through text or images. Existing defenses often narrow threat coverage or add inference cost through input transformations, repeated model queries, generated responses, or threat-specific detectors. We present SALLIE (Single-Pass Activation Lookup for Layerwise Input Evaluation), a white-box, generation-free detector with a common architecture for textual and visual jailbreaks and prompt injections. Using one backbone forward pass, SALLIE extracts last-token residual-stream representations, applies layer-wise k-nearest-neighbor probes, and averages their scores across a contiguous layer range, without modifying the backbone or generating a response. To distinguish reusable detector configurations from deployment-specific tuning, we compare shared, threshold-only, and fully calibrated regimes across backbones and modalities. We evaluate SALLIE on compact open-weight VLMs (Gemma-3-4b-it, Phi-3.5-vision-instruct, SmolVLM2-2.2B-Instruct) using heterogeneous held-out test data spanning both threat families and modalities. Fully calibrated SALLIE-Phi achieves an aggregate F1 of 0.87 and higher aggregate balanced accuracy than RCS-KCD on all three backbones under a matched-calibration protocol. On Phi-3.5 visual inputs, threshold-only calibration yields an F1 of 0.99 with zero observed false positives, versus 0.54 for zero-shot Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite. On Gemma-4-E2B-it, a backbone held out from representation-hyperparameter selection, the same procedure raises F1 from 0.62 to 0.79 on text and 0.68 to 0.98 on visual inputs. Representation hyperparameters can thus transfer across some backbones, while operating points remain backbone-, modality-, and distribution-dependent. We further report FPR/FNR tradeoffs, latency, and representation ablations.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 17 tables. Preprint under review. v2: substantially revised - new title expansion, reworked method presentation, added calibration-regime analysis (shared / threshold-only / fully calibrated) and matched-protocol comparison with RCS-KCD; technical appendices A-H now included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SALLIE（Single-Pass Activation Lookup for Layerwise Input Evaluation），一种白盒、无生成（generation-free）的检测器，用单一骨干网络前向传播检测文本和视觉模态下的越狱（jailbreak）与提示注入（prompt injection）。方法提取最后 token 的残差流表示，应用逐层 k 近邻探针并跨连续层范围平均分数，不修改骨干网络也不生成响应。作者在紧凑开源 VLM（Gemma-3-4b-it、Phi-3.5-vision-instruct、SmolVLM2-2.2B-Instruct）上评估，并比较共享、仅阈值和全校准三种校准机制。
Motivation: 现有防御常通过输入变换、重复查询、生成响应或威胁特定检测器来扩大威胁覆盖或增加推理成本，作者希望在不修改骨干、不生成响应且不增加明显开销的前提下，统一检测文本和图像携带的越狱与提示注入。
Method: SALLIE 使用一次骨干前向传播，提取最后 token 的残差流表示，逐层施加 k 近邻（k-NN）探针，再对连续层范围的得分取平均；同时区分可复用的检测器配置与部署特异的调参，比较 shared、threshold-only 和 fully calibrated 三种校准机制，并在多个骨干和模态上评估。
Result: 摘要报告全校准的 SALLIE-Phi 聚合 F1 为 0.87，且在匹配校准协议下三个骨干上的聚合平衡准确率均高于 RCS-KCD；在 Phi-3.5 视觉输入上，仅阈值校准达到 F1 0.99 且零假阳性，对比零样本 Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite 的 0.54；在未参与表示超参选择的 Gemma-4-E2B-it 上，文本 F1 从 0.62 提升到 0.79，视觉从 0.68 提升到 0.98。
Conclusion: 表示超参数可在部分骨干间迁移，但操作点（operating points）仍依赖骨干、模态和数据分布；摘要还报告了 FPR/FNR 权衡、延迟和表示消融。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Are Latent Reasoning Models Easily Interpretable?
papers.abstract_en: Latent reasoning models (LRMs) have attracted significant research interest due to their low inference cost (relative to explicit reasoning models) and theoretical ability to explore multiple reasoning paths in parallel. However, these benefits come at the cost of reduced interpretability: LRMs are difficult to monitor because they do not reason in natural language. This paper presents an investigation into LRM interpretability by examining two state-of-the-art LRMs. First, we find that latent reasoning tokens are often unnecessary for LRMs' predictions; on logical reasoning datasets, LRMs can almost always produce the same final answers without using latent reasoning at all. This underutilization of reasoning tokens may partially explain why LRMs do not consistently outperform explicit reasoning methods and raises doubts about the stated role of these tokens in prior work. Second, we demonstrate that when latent reasoning tokens are necessary for performance, we can decode gold reasoning traces up to 65-93% of the time for correctly predicted instances. This suggests LRMs often implement the expected solution rather than an uninterpretable reasoning process. Finally, we present a method to decode a verified natural language reasoning trace from latent tokens without knowing a gold reasoning trace a priori, demonstrating that it is possible to find a verified trace for a majority of correct predictions but only a minority of incorrect predictions. Our findings highlight that current LRMs largely encode interpretable processes, and interpretability itself can be a signal of prediction correctness.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究潜在推理模型 (latent reasoning models, LRMs) 的可解释性，针对两个 state-of-the-art LRM 进行实验。作者发现潜在推理 token 常常对最终预测并非必要，在逻辑推理数据集上模型几乎可以不用潜在推理就得到相同答案；当这些 token 确有必要时，从正确预测实例中可解码出金标准推理轨迹 (gold reasoning traces) 的 65-93%。作者还提出一种无需先验金标准轨迹即可解码并验证自然语言推理轨迹的方法，并指出可解释性本身可作为预测正确性的信号。
Motivation: LRM 因推理成本低且理论上能并行探索多条推理路径而受到关注，但不在自然语言中推理，导致难以监控、可解释性下降。现有工作对潜在推理 token 的实际作用及其可解释性缺乏系统考察。
Method: 通过对两个 state-of-the-art LRM 在逻辑推理数据集上进行实验，检查潜在推理 token 是否必要；当必要时，评估能否解码出金标准推理轨迹，并进一步提出无需先验金标准轨迹即可解码并验证自然语言推理轨迹的方法。
Result: 潜在推理 token 在大多数情况下并非必要，LRM 几乎可以不使用潜在推理而得到相同最终答案；当潜在推理 token 必要时，正确预测实例中有 65-93% 能解码出金标准推理轨迹。所提验证轨迹解码方法能在多数正确预测但仅少数错误预测中找到已验证的推理轨迹。
Conclusion: 作者总结当前 LRM 在很大程度上编码了可解释的过程，可解释性本身可以作为预测正确性的信号；这一发现对 LRM 的监控与可信使用有启示，也对其声称的推理 token 角色提出质疑。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Goose: Anisotropic Speculation Trees for Training-Free Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting multiple candidate tokens and verifying them in a single forward pass. Candidates are organized as a tree: deeper trees accept more tokens per step, but adding depth requires sacrificing breadth (fallback options) under a fixed verification budget. Existing training-free methods draft from a single token source and shape their trees without distinguishing candidate quality across origins. We observe that two common training-free token sources -- n-gram matches copied from the input context, and statistical predictions from prior forward passes -- differ sharply in acceptance rate (~6x median gap, range 2-18x across five models and five benchmarks). We prove that when such a quality gap exists, the optimal tree is anisotropic (asymmetric): reliable tokens should form a deep chain while unreliable tokens spread as wide branches, raising the depth ceiling of balanced trees. We realize this structure in GOOSE, a training-free framework that builds an adaptive spine tree: a deep chain of high-acceptance context-matched tokens with wide branches of low-acceptance alternatives at each node. The resulting tree provably accepts at least as many tokens per step as either source alone. On five LLMs (7B-33B) and five benchmarks, GOOSE achieves 1.9-4.3x lossless speedup, outperforming balanced-tree baselines by 12-33% under the same budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GOOSE，一种无需训练的投机解码 (speculative decoding) 框架，利用各向异性 (anisotropic) 推测树加速大语言模型推理。作者观察到两类免训练 token 来源——从输入上下文复制的 n-gram 匹配与先前前向传播的统计预测——接受率差异显著（中位约 6 倍，范围 2-18 倍），并证明在此类质量差距下最优树应为非对称结构。GOOSE 由此构建自适应主干树，在五个 LLM（7B-33B）和五个基准上取得 1.9-4.3x 无损加速，同等预算下比平衡树基线提升 12-33%。
Motivation: 现有免训练投机解码方法从单一 token 源采样，并以不考虑来源间候选质量差异的方式构造树；在固定验证预算下，加深树会牺牲宽度（回退选项）。作者指出不同 token 来源接受率存在巨大差距，这一差距应被用于设计更优的树结构。
Method: GOOSE 构建自适应主干树 (adaptive spine tree)：用高接受率的上下文匹配 token 组成深链，在每个节点用低接受率的替代 token 形成宽分支。作者证明当来源间存在质量差距时，这种非对称结构是最优的，且能提升平衡树的深度上限；该树可证明每个步长接受的 token 数至少不低于任一单独来源。
Result: 在五个 LLM（7B-33B）和五个基准上，GOOSE 实现 1.9-4.3x 无损加速，并在同一验证预算下比平衡树基线提升 12-33%。摘要还量化了 n-gram 匹配与统计预测两类来源之间 2-18 倍、中位约 6 倍的接受率差距。
Conclusion: GOOSE 表明，利用来源间接受率差异构造深度主干与宽分支的非对称树，可以在免训练条件下提升投机解码的每步接受 token 数并进一步提高加速比。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cognitive Energy Modeling for Neuroadaptive Human-Machine Systems using EEG and WGAN-GP
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive insight into the brain's cognitive and emotional dynamics. However, modeling how these states evolve in real time and quantifying the energy required for such transitions remains a major challenge. The Schrödinger Bridge Problem (SBP) offers a principled probabilistic framework to model the most efficient evolution between the brain states, interpreted as a measure of cognitive energy cost. While generative models such as GANs have been widely used to augment EEG data, it remains unclear whether synthetic EEG preserves the underlying dynamical structure required for transition-based analysis. In this work, we address this gap by using SBP-derived transport cost as a metric to evaluate whether GAN-generated EEG retains the distributional geometry necessary for energy-based modeling of cognitive state transitions. We compare transition energies derived from real and synthetic EEG collected during Stroop tasks and demonstrate strong agreement across group and participant-level analyses. These results indicate that synthetic EEG preserves the transition structure required for SBP-based modeling, enabling its use in data-efficient neuroadaptive systems. We further present a framework in which SBP-derived cognitive energy serves as a control signal for adaptive human-machine systems, supporting real-time adjustment of system behavior in response to user cognitive and affective state.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用脑电图（EEG）数据，通过薛定谔桥问题（SBP）将脑状态间最有效的演化建模为认知能量成本，并以此传输代价为度量评估 WGAN-GP 生成的合成 EEG 是否保留状态转移所需的分布几何。作者在 Stroop 任务上比较真实与合成 EEG 的转移能量，报告群体和参与者层面均呈现强一致性，并进一步提出以 SBP 推导的认知能量作为自适应人机系统控制信号的框架。
Motivation: EEG 能非侵入式观测大脑认知与情感动态，但实时建模这些状态的演化并量化状态转移所需能量仍是主要挑战；GAN 虽广泛用于 EEG 数据增强，但合成 EEG 是否保留基于转移分析所需的动态结构尚不清楚。
Method: 使用 SBP 作为概率框架，将脑状态间最有效的演化解释为认知能量成本；以 SBP 导出的传输代价作为度量，评估生成式模型（WGAN-GP）合成的 EEG 是否保持分布几何；在 Stroop 任务中比较真实与合成 EEG 的转移能量，并设计以认知能量作为控制信号的神经自适应人机系统框架。
Result: 摘要报告在群体层面和参与者层面分析中，真实与合成 EEG 的转移能量表现出强一致性，表明合成 EEG 保留了 SBP 建模所需的转移结构，可支持数据高效的神经自适应系统。
Conclusion: 作者认为合成 EEG 可以用于基于 SBP 的认知状态转移建模，且推导出的认知能量可作为控制信号，支持系统根据用户认知与情感状态实时调整行为。
Relevance: 0
