papers.title: SPROUT: A Scalable Diffusion Foundation Model for Agricultural Vision
papers.abstract_en: Image-based plant phenotyping depends on dense structural understanding of crops, yet pixel-level annotation remains expensive across species, organs, growth stages, and field conditions. General-purpose vision foundation models offer a natural route to label efficiency, but their web-scale pretraining objectives transfer weakly to agricultural imagery, where semantics are often determined by fine organ geometry inside repetitive, texture-dominated scenes. We introduce SPROUT, a diffusion foundation model for multi-crop plant phenotyping. SPROUT learns from 2.6 million unlabeled open-field images (MCD-2.6M) using a pixel-space Diffusion Transformer, and selects transferable features with a label-free effective-rank criterion over denoising timesteps. This design shifts pretraining from crop-based invariance to structure-preserving denoising, making the representation better aligned with dense phenotyping tasks. We evaluate SPROUT across dense phenotyping tasks, including organ segmentation, crop-weed parsing, depth estimation, and counting. SPROUT consistently improves over strong web-pretrained baselines, with the largest gains on dense structural prediction, and shows favorable label and compute efficiency compared with general-purpose and crop-specific foundation models. The source code and MCD-2.6M dataset are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPROUT 是一个面向多作物植物表型分析的可扩展扩散基础模型，在 260 万张无标注大田图像（MCD-2.6M）上用像素空间 Diffusion Transformer 预训练，并通过去噪时间步上的无标签有效秩（effective-rank）准则挑选可迁移特征。摘要报告它在器官分割、作物-杂草解析、深度估计和计数等密集表型任务上一致优于强 web 预训练基线，在密集结构预测上提升最大。
Motivation: 基于图像的植物表型分析依赖作物的密集结构理解，但跨物种、器官、生长阶段和田间条件下的像素级标注成本高昂；通用视觉基础模型在农业图像上的迁移较弱，因为农业场景的语义常由重复、纹理主导场景中的精细器官几何决定。
Method: 提出使用像素空间 Diffusion Transformer 在 2.6M 张无标注大田图像上预训练，并用去噪时间步上的无标签有效秩准则选择可迁移特征，将预训练从基于作物的不变性转向保结构去噪（structure-preserving denoising）。
Result: 在器官分割、作物-杂草解析、深度估计和计数等密集表型任务上，SPROUT 一致优于强 web 预训练基线，最大增益出现在密集结构预测任务上，并且与通用及作物专用基础模型相比具有更优的标签与计算效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这种保结构去噪的预训练设计能使表征更好地对齐密集表型任务，并公开了源代码与 MCD-2.6M 数据集。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CGRL: Causal-Guided Representation Learning for Node-Level Out-of-Distribution Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) deliver strong performance on graph tasks, but their accuracy drops significantly under out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. Under distribution shifts, GNNs often fit environmental noise and spurious correlations instead of stable causal mechanisms, leading to weak OOD robustness and unstable predictive representations. Existing solutions based on environment invariance or causal reasoning are insufficient for node classification, as they do not explicitly model the fine-grained latent geometry required by the task. We further observe a training instability named Info-Jitter, where the mutual information between predictive representations and ground-truth labels fluctuates throughout training. To address these issues, we construct a node-classification-specific causal graph derived from the task's geometric objective. Using do-calculus to block non-causal paths caused by environmental noise, we derive a deconfounded interventional objective and a variational lower bound to disentangle representations into intra-class and inter-class components. We then propose Causal-Guided Representation Learning (CGRL), a framework with two core modules. First, a multi-branch re-weighted representation learning (RRL) module learns a causal modulation matrix to amplify causal signals and suppress environmental noise during message passing. Second, an optimization strategy combining intra-class aggregation, inter-class separation, energy-based reconstruction and supervised prediction regularizes the latent space for robust node-level generalization. Experiments on multiple benchmark datasets show that CGRL outperforms strong baselines across various distribution shifts and effectively mitigates the Info-Jitter phenomenon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图神经网络（GNN）在节点级分布外（OOD）泛化中的脆弱性，提出因果引导表示学习框架 CGRL。作者从节点分类的几何目标出发构造因果图，借助 do-calculus 阻断环境噪声导致的非因果路径，推导出去混杂的干预目标与变分下界，将表示解耦为类内与类间成分。实验表明 CGRL 在多种分布偏移基准上优于强基线，并缓解了训练中预测表示与标签互信息波动的 Info-Jitter 现象。
Motivation: GNN 在分布偏移下容易拟合环境噪声和虚假相关而非稳定因果机制，导致 OOD 鲁棒性差。现有基于环境不变性或因果推理的方法对节点分类不够充分，未显式建模任务所需的细粒度潜在几何结构，且存在训练不稳定的 Info-Jitter 现象。
Method: 构造面向节点分类的因果图，用 do-calculus 阻断环境噪声引起的非因果路径，推导去混杂干预目标及其变分下界，将表示解耦为类内和类间成分。据此提出 CGRL，包含多分支重加权表示学习（RRL）模块，学习因果调制矩阵以放大因果信号并抑制消息传递中的环境噪声；优化策略结合类内聚合、类间分离、基于能量的重建与监督预测来正则化潜在空间。
Result: 在多个 benchmark 数据集上的实验表明，CGRL 在多种分布偏移场景下优于强基线，并有效缓解 Info-Jitter 现象。
Conclusion: 摘要强调面向节点分类的显式因果建模与几何正则化能提升节点级 OOD 泛化，并缓解训练不稳定；方法聚焦于图节点分类场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Sobering Look at Tabular Data Generation via Probabilistic Circuits
papers.abstract_en: Tabular data is more challenging to generate than text and images, due to its heterogeneous features and much lower sample sizes. On this task, diffusion-based models are the current state-of-the-art (SotA) model class, achieving almost perfect performance on commonly used benchmarks. In this paper, we question the perception of progress for tabular data generation. First, we highlight the limitations of current protocols to evaluate the fidelity of generated data, and advocate for alternative ones. Next, we revisit a simple baseline -- hierarchical mixture models in the form of deep probabilistic circuits (PCs) -- which delivers competitive or superior performance to SotA models for a fraction of the cost. PCs are the generative counterpart of decision forests, and as such can natively handle heterogeneous data as well as deliver tractable probabilistic generation and inference. Finally, in a rigorous empirical analysis we show that the apparent saturation of progress for SotA models is largely due to the use of inadequate metrics. As such, we highlight that there is still much to be done to generate realistic tabular data. Code available at https://github.com/april-tools/tabpc.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑表格数据生成领域现有评估协议的有效性，指出当前扩散模型在常用基准上近乎完美的表现很大程度上源于不恰当的度量指标。作者回顾了深度概率电路（PCs）这一分层混合模型基线，它作为决策森林的生成对应物，能原生处理异构数据并提供可处理的生成与推理，且以极低的成本达到或超过SotA模型。严格的实证分析表明，SotA模型的进展饱和现象主要是由不充分的指标造成的，真实表格数据生成仍有很多工作要做。
Motivation: 表格数据因异构特征和样本量小而比文本和图像更难生成，但扩散模型已在常用基准上取得近乎完美的性能，这引发了对‘进展’认知的质疑；现有评估协议在数据保真度方面存在局限，需要更可靠的替代方案。
Method: 主张重新审视评估协议并采用替代指标；将深度概率电路（PCs，即分层混合模型）作为简单基线，利用其原生处理异构数据、提供可处理概率生成与推理的特性，并与当前SotA扩散模型进行对比。
Result: 在严格实证分析中，PCs以远低于SotA模型的成本达到竞争性或更优的性能；同时发现SotA模型表现出的性能饱和主要源于使用了不充分的度量指标。
Conclusion: 当前表格数据生成领域的进展被不合适的指标高估，现有SotA评估结果掩盖了实际差距，生成逼真表格数据仍具挑战；作者开放了代码（https://github.com/april-tools/tabpc）。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 表格数据因异构特征和样本量小而比文本和图像更难生成，但扩散模型已在常用基准上取得近乎完美的性能，这引发了对‘进展’认知的质疑；现有评估协议在数据保真度方面存在局限，需要更可靠的替代方案。
summary_sections.method: 主张重新审视评估协议并采用替代指标；将深度概率电路（PCs，即分层混合模型）作为简单基线，利用其原生处理异构数据、提供可处理概率生成与推理的特性，并与当前SotA扩散模型进行对比。
summary_sections.result: 在严格实证分析中，PCs以远低于SotA模型的成本达到竞争性或更优的性能；同时发现SotA模型表现出的性能饱和主要源于使用了不充分的度量指标。
summary_sections.conclusion: 当前表格数据生成领域的进展被不合适的指标高估，现有SotA评估结果掩盖了实际差距，生成逼真表格数据仍具挑战；作者开放了代码（https://github.com/april-tools/tabpc）。

papers.title: ROM: Real-time Overthinking Mitigation via Streaming Detection and Intervention
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) often reach a correct solution before their long Chain-of-Thought trace ends, yet continue with redundant verification, repeated attempts, or unnecessary exploration that wastes computation and can even overturn the correct answer. We frame this behavior as a latent productive-to-redundant transition and show it is directly reflected in hidden states: around first-correct-solution (FCS) boundaries, late-layer representations separate efficient from overthinking tokens, while boundary-permutation and position controls collapse. We propose ROM, a streaming intervention framework that monitors a frozen LRM with a lightweight hidden-state detector ($\sim$0.1\% of backbone parameters) and intervenes at well-formed reasoning boundaries; Counterfactual Self-Correction (CSC) balances supervision with wrong$\rightarrow$correct trajectories, preserving useful pre-FCS self-correction. Unlike prior adaptive early-exit methods, ROM extracts no intermediate answers, launches no probe decoding, and updates no backbone weights. Across five backbones from three model families and five reasoning benchmarks, against ten recent baselines under a shared protocol, ROM$_{\text{CSC}}$ attains the highest accuracy in 19 of 25 model--benchmark settings, cuts response length by 28--77\% (mean 45\%) versus vanilla decoding, and is the only method on the accuracy--length Pareto front in every setting. The same MATH500-trained supervision transfers zero-shot across scales, families, and task domains, and end-to-end wall-clock latency drops by 46.5\% with $\sim$5\% per-token overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/SaFo-Lab/ROM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型推理模型 (LRM) 的过度思考问题提出 ROM，一个流式干预框架：用约为主干参数 0.1% 的轻量隐藏状态检测器监控冻结的 LRM，在格式良好的推理边界处干预。摘要报告在五个骨干、三个模型家族、五个推理基准上与十个近期基线对比，ROM_CSC 在 25 个模型-基准设置中的 19 个取得最高准确率，并将响应长度缩短 28–77%（均值 45%）。MATH500 训练的监督可零样本跨尺度、家族和任务域迁移，端到端延迟下降 46.5%，每 token 开销约 5%。
Motivation: LRM 常常在长思维链结束前就已经得到正确解，却继续冗余验证、重复尝试或不必要探索，浪费计算甚至推翻正确答案。作者将此行为刻画为潜在的 productive-to-redundant 转变，并证明该转变直接反映在隐藏状态中：在 first-correct-solution (FCS) 边界附近，深层表示能够区分高效 token 与过度思考 token。
Method: 提出 ROM 流式干预框架，对冻结的 LRM 使用约 0.1% 参数的轻量隐藏状态检测器，在结构良好的推理边界介入；Counterfactual Self-Correction (CSC) 用 wrong→correct 轨迹平衡监督信号，保留 FCS 之前有用的自我纠正。与先前的自适应早退方法不同，ROM 不提取中间答案、不启动 probe decoding，也不更新主干权重。
Result: 在共享协议下对五个骨干、三个模型家族、五个推理基准与十个近期基线比较，ROM_CSC 在 25 个设置中的 19 个取得最高准确率，相对 vanilla decoding 减少响应长度 28–77%（均值 45%），且在每个设置中都是准确率-长度 Pareto 前沿上的唯一方法。同一 MATH500 训练的监督可零样本迁移到不同尺度、家族和任务域；端到端墙钟延迟降低 46.5%，每 token 开销约 5%。
Conclusion: 作者认为过度思考缓解可以在不修改主干权重的情况下，通过隐藏状态检测与推理边界干预以流式方式实现，且具备良好的跨设置迁移性。代码已公开，但摘要未讨论该框架在非推理类任务或天气相关领域的适用性。

papers.title: Goedel-Code-Prover: Hierarchical Proof Search for Open State-of-the-Art Code Verification
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can generate plausible code but offer limited guarantees of correctness. Formally verifying that implementations satisfy specifications requires constructing machine-checkable proofs, a task that remains beyond current automation. We propose a hierarchical proof search framework for automated code verification in Lean~4 that decomposes complex verification goals into structurally simpler subgoals before attempting tactic-level proving. Central to our approach is a principled decomposition score that combines constructive justification with structural effectiveness. The same score serves as both the training reward and the inference-time ranking criterion, aligning optimization and deployment. We train Goedel Code Prover, a single unified policy for both decomposition and completion, through supervised initialization followed by hybrid reinforcement learning, where a continuous decomposition reward supports planning exploration while supervised replay stabilizes proof generation. On three Lean-based code verification benchmarks comprising 427 tasks, our 8B-parameter model achieves a 62.0% prove success rate, a 2.6 improvement over the strongest baseline under the reported inference settings. We further observe consistent inference-time scaling: success rates improve monotonically with search iterations and sampling budget, while whole-proof baselines plateau within the evaluated budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型生成代码缺乏正确性保证的问题，提出一个用于 Lean 4 自动代码验证的分层证明搜索框架，先将复杂验证目标分解为结构上更简单的子目标，再进行策略级证明。核心是一个同时结合构造性论证与结构有效性的分解分数，该分数既作训练奖励也作推理时排序标准。训练得到的 Goedel Code Prover 是一个 8B 参数统一策略，在三个共 427 个任务的 Lean 代码验证基准上达到 62.0% 的证明成功率，比报告设置下的最强基线提升 2.6 个百分点，并观察到一致的推理时扩展行为。
Motivation: LLM 能生成看似合理的代码，但正确性保证有限；形式化验证需要构造机器可检验的证明，这一任务仍超出当前自动化能力。
Method: 提出分层证明搜索框架，将复杂验证目标分解为结构上更简单的子目标后再进行策略级证明。分解分数结合构造性论证与结构有效性，同时作为训练奖励和推理时排序标准；训练采用监督初始化加混合强化学习，用连续分解奖励支持规划探索，并用监督重放稳定证明生成。
Result: 在三个基于 Lean 的代码验证基准共 427 个任务上，8B 参数模型达到 62.0% 的证明成功率，比报告推理设置下的最强基线提升 2.6 个百分点；成功率随搜索迭代次数和采样预算单调提升，而整证明基线在评估预算内趋于平台期。
Conclusion: 作者强调统一策略配合对齐的分解奖励能够带来一致的推理时扩展收益，说明分层分解与奖励对齐对自动化代码验证的有效性。

papers.title: When should we trust the annotation? Selective prediction for molecular structure retrieval from mass spectra
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning methods for identifying molecular structures from tandem mass spectra (MS/MS) have advanced rapidly, yet current approaches still exhibit significant error rates. In high-stakes applications such as clinical metabolomics and environmental screening, incorrect annotations can have serious consequences, making it essential to determine when a prediction can be trusted. In this work, we introduce a selective prediction framework for molecular structure retrieval from MS/MS spectra, separating low-risk predictions automatically from lower-confidence predictions. We formulate the problem within the risk-coverage tradeoff framework and systematically evaluate uncertainty quantification strategies at three levels: input-level distance in the learned representation, fingerprint-level uncertainty over predicted molecular fingerprint bits, and retrieval-level uncertainty over candidate rankings. We compare scoring functions including first-order confidence measures, aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty estimates from second-order distributions, as well as distance-based measures in the latent space. All experiments are conducted on the MassSpecGym benchmark. Our analysis reveals that while fingerprint-level uncertainty scores are poor proxies for retrieval success, retrieval-level total uncertainty provides the overall strongest rejection criterion, and first-order confidence measures are computationally inexpensive, strong baselines. We demonstrate that by applying distribution-free risk control via generalisation bounds, practitioners can specify a tolerable error rate and obtain a subset of annotations satisfying that constraint with high probability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向串联质谱 (MS/MS) 分子结构检索任务，提出选择性预测 (selective prediction) 框架，在风险-覆盖率权衡 (risk-coverage tradeoff) 下将低风险预测与低置信预测分离。作者在 MassSpecGym 基准上比较了三层不确定性量化策略：输入层面的潜在表示距离、指纹层面的位级不确定性、检索层面的候选排序不确定性。摘要报告检索层面总不确定性是最强的拒绝准则，指纹层面不确定性是检索成功的较差代理，一阶置信度是计算廉价且表现强力的基线。
Motivation: 现有从串联质谱识别分子结构的机器学习方法仍有显著错误率，而在临床代谢组学和环境筛查等高风险应用中错误标注后果严重，因此需要判断哪些预测可以被信任。
Method: 构建选择性预测框架，在风险-覆盖率框架中形式化问题，并系统比较三类打分函数：一阶置信度度量、来自二阶分布 (second-order distributions) 的偶然与认知不确定性 (aleatoric/epistemic uncertainty) 估计、以及潜在空间距离度量。通过基于泛化界 (generalization bounds) 的分布无关风险控制，用户可设定可容忍错误率并获得以高概率满足该约束的标注子集。
Result: 在 MassSpecGym 基准上的实验表明，指纹层面不确定性分数是检索成功的较差代理；检索层面总不确定性是整体最强的拒绝准则；一阶置信度方法计算廉价且作为基线表现强。分布无关风险控制可让实践者按预设错误率约束筛选可信标注。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在信任 MS/MS 结构化检索的标注之前，应优先使用检索层面总不确定性作为拒绝判据，并借助分布无关风险控制保证所选标注子集满足用户设定的错误率约束；该工作范围限定于分子结构检索任务。

papers.title: Quantifying Membership Disclosure Risk for Tabular Synthetic Data Using Kernel Density Estimators
papers.abstract_en: The use of synthetic data has become increasingly popular as a privacy-preserving alternative to sharing real datasets, especially in sensitive domains such as healthcare, finance, and demography. However, the privacy assurances of synthetic data are not absolute, and remain susceptible to membership inference attacks (MIAs), where adversaries aim to determine whether a specific individual was present in the dataset used to train the generator. In this work, we propose a practical and effective method to quantify membership disclosure risk in tabular synthetic datasets using kernel density estimators (KDEs). Our KDE-based approach models the distribution of nearest-neighbour distances between synthetic data and the training records, allowing probabilistic inference of membership and enabling robust evaluation via ROC curves. We propose two attack models: a 'True Distribution Attack', which assumes privileged access to training data, and a more realistic, implementable 'Realistic Attack' that uses auxiliary data without true membership labels. Empirical evaluations across four real-world datasets and six synthetic data generators demonstrate that our method consistently achieves higher F1 scores and sharper risk characterization than a prior baseline approach, without requiring computationally expensive shadow models. The proposed method provides a practical framework and metric for quantifying membership disclosure risk in synthetic data, which enables data custodians to conduct a post-generation risk assessment prior to releasing their synthetic datasets for downstream use. The datasets and codes for this study are available at https://github.com/PyCoder913/MIA-KDE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用核密度估计（KDE）对合成数据与训练记录之间的最近邻距离分布进行建模，从而量化表格合成数据中的成员推断攻击（MIA）风险，并通过 ROC 曲线实现稳健评估。作者设计了两个攻击模型，在四个真实数据集和六个合成数据生成器上的实验显示，该方法相比基线取得更高的 F1 分数和更清晰的风险刻画，且无需计算昂贵的影子模型（shadow models）。
Motivation: 合成数据被广泛用作共享真实数据的隐私保护替代方案，但其隐私保证并非绝对，仍易受成员推断攻击；因此需要一种实用且有效的方法，在数据发布前量化成员披露风险。
Method: 提出基于 KDE 的攻击方法：对合成数据与训练记录之间的最近邻距离分布建模，支持概率化的成员推断，并用 ROC 曲线评估。具体提出两种攻击模型，一是假设可访问训练数据的‘True Distribution Attack’，二是更现实、可使用无真实成员标签辅助数据的‘Realistic Attack’。
Result: 在四个真实数据集和六个合成数据生成器上的实验表明，该方法一致优于先前基线，取得更高的 F1 分数和更尖锐的风险刻画，且不需要计算成本高昂的影子模型。
Conclusion: 该方法为数据管理者提供了一个生成后风险评估框架和量化指标，可在发布合成数据集供下游使用之前评估成员披露风险；相关数据集和代码已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Bridging Object Detection and Segmentation with Polygon Detection Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Box detection and mask segmentation are two dominant paradigms for foreground representation: boxes are efficient but too coarse for object shapes, while masks are accurate but over-modeled for compact geometry. To bridge this gap, we present a Polygon Detection Transformer (Poly-DETR) built upon Polar Representation, where object queries regress a starting point and its fixed number of radial distances to directly construct the contour-approximating polygon. This formulation can be integrated into most DETR-like detectors by linear extension, since box is a degenerate case of Polar Representation with four rays. Furthermore, we propose two simple but necessary designs, Polar Deformable Attention and Position-Aware Training Scheme, to align feature sampling and polygon supervision. As a DETR-oriented advancement of Polar Representation, Poly-DETR outperforms existing polar-based methods by 4.7 mAP on MS COCO. Moreover, we explore the application regimes of polygon detection in geometry-driven domains, including remote sensing, medical imaging, and autonomous driving. In particular, Poly-DETR shows stronger scalability than its mask-based counterpart in high-resolution scenarios. Additional experiments show that, owing to its Transformer structure, Poly-DETR can be naturally extended to recent DETR variants equipped with foundation-model priors.
papers.comment: Substantially revised and extended version with a new title, additional co-authors, new methodology, expanded experiments and analyses, and supplementary material in the appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Polygon Detection Transformer (Poly-DETR)，基于极坐标表示 (Polar Representation) 让目标检测器直接回归起点和固定数量的径向距离，以构造逼近轮廓的多边形，作为框检测与掩码分割之间的折中。该方法可线性扩展到大多数 DETR-like 检测器，并引入 Polar Deformable Attention 与 Position-Aware Training Scheme 以对齐特征采样和多边形监督。在 MS COCO 上，Poly-DETR 比现有基于极坐标的方法高出 4.7 mAP，并在遥感、医学影像和自动驾驶等几何驱动领域展示出应用潜力。
Motivation: 框检测高效但过于粗糙，掩码分割精确但对紧凑几何过度建模，缺少一种既能表达形状又保持效率的中间表示。
Method: 将对象查询回归一个起点和固定数量的径向距离，直接构造轮廓逼近多边形；由于四射线的框是极坐标表示的退化情形，该公式可通过线性扩展集成到大多数 DETR-like 检测器中，并配以 Polar Deformable Attention 和 Position-Aware Training Scheme。
Result: 在 MS COCO 上比现有基于极坐标的方法提升 4.7 mAP；在高分辨率场景下比基于掩码的对应方法具有更强的可扩展性，并可自然扩展到带基础模型先验的 DETR 变体。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多边形检测作为框与掩码之间的桥接表示，在几何驱动的高分辨率场景中具有优势，并指出其 Transformer 结构便于与最新 DETR 变体结合。

papers.title: Online Learnability of Chain-of-Thought Verifiers: Soundness and Completeness Trade-offs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) using chain-of-thought reasoning have demonstrated great potential for solving complex reasoning and planning tasks. However, their outputs remain unreliable and need careful verification. Even as LLMs get more accurate over time, learned verifiers can help increase trust, enforce safety constraints, and ensure alignment with personal preferences. A major challenge in learning verifiers, especially when they are used to guide generation, is that the feedback loop between generator and verifier may induce substantial distribution shift. Motivated by this challenge, we propose a framework for online learning chain-of-thought verifiers, which given a problem statement and a reasoning trace check the correctness of each reasoning step. Highlighting the asymmetric role of soundness errors (failing to flag an incorrect reasoning step) and completeness errors (incorrectly flagging a correct step as wrong), we introduce novel extensions of the Littlestone dimension which tightly characterize the mistake bounds for learning in the realizable setting. We provide optimal algorithms for finding the Pareto-frontier as well as for minimizing a linear combination of asymmetric costs. We further show how our learned verifiers can be used to boost the accuracy of a collection of weak generators and enable generation of proofs beyond what they were initially trained on. Under the mild assumption that one of the generators can generate a correct next step with a small success probability, we show how to learn a strong generator with small error and abstention rates. We additionally establish a separation between our approach and learning from offline expert demonstrations. In particular, we show that learning from offline demonstrations cannot in general achieve the soundness-completeness guarantees produced by our interactive learning approach.
papers.comment: The abstract has been abridged due to arXiv length constraints
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个在线学习 chain-of-thought 验证器（verifier）的框架，该验证器针对给定问题陈述和推理轨迹逐步骤检查每个推理步骤的正确性。作者引入 Littlestone 维度的新型扩展，在可实现（realizable）设定下紧刻画错误界，并给出寻找 Pareto 前沿以及最小化非对称成本线性组合的最优算法。摘要还展示了所学验证器可用于提升一组弱生成器的准确率，并在存在一个能以较小成功概率生成正确下一步的生成器假设下，学到具有较小错误率和弃权率的强生成器；最后证明该方法与离线专家示范学习之间存在分离。
Motivation: 使用 chain-of-thought 推理的大语言模型输出仍不可靠，需要仔细验证；而当验证器用于引导生成时，生成器与验证器之间的反馈回路可能带来显著分布偏移，这是学习验证器的主要挑战。
Method: 提出在线学习 chain-of-thought 验证器的框架，逐步骤判断推理步骤是否正确；突出 soundness 错误（未标记错误步骤）与 completeness 错误（错误标记正确步骤）的非对称作用，并引入 Littlestone 维度的新扩展来刻画可实现设定下的错误界；提供求 Pareto 前沿和最小化非对称成本线性组合的最优算法。
Result: 在假设至少一个生成器能以较小成功概率生成正确下一步的温和条件下，可以学到具有较小错误率和弃权率的强生成器，并能生成超出初始训练范围的证明。摘要还建立了与离线专家示范学习的分离：离线示范学习一般无法达到本文交互式学习方法提供的 soundness-completeness 保证。
Conclusion: 作者强调 soundness 与 completeness 错误的非对称性对学习 chain-of-thought 验证器至关重要，并表明交互式在线学习能获得离线示范学习无法保证的可靠验证性能。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MultiShadow: Multi-Object Shadow Generation for Image Compositing via Diffusion Model
papers.abstract_en: Realistic shadow generation is crucial for achieving seamless image compositing, yet existing methods primarily focus on single-object insertion and often fail to generalize when multiple foreground objects are composited into a background scene. In practice, however, modern compositing pipelines and real-world applications often insert multiple objects simultaneously, necessitating shadows that are jointly consistent in terms of geometry, attachment, and location. In this paper, we address the under-explored problem of multi-object shadow generation, aiming to synthesize physically plausible shadows for multiple inserted objects. Our approach exploits the multimodal capabilities of a pre-trained text-to-image diffusion model. An image pathway injects dense, multi-scale features to provide fine-grained spatial guidance, while a text-based pathway encodes per-object shadow bounding boxes as learned positional tokens and fuses them via cross-attention. An attention-alignment loss further grounds these tokens to their corresponding shadow regions. To support this task, we augment the DESOBAv2 dataset by constructing composite scenes with multiple inserted objects and automatically derive prompts combining object category and shadow positioning information. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both single and multi-object shadow generation settings.
papers.comment: This work is currently under consideration for publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MultiShadow，针对图像合成中的多对象阴影生成问题。方法利用预训练 text-to-image 扩散模型的多模态能力：图像路径注入密集多尺度特征提供细粒度空间引导，文本路径将每个插入对象的阴影边界框编码为可学习位置 token 并通过交叉注意力融合，辅以注意力对齐损失。作者扩展了 DESOBAv2 数据集以构造多对象合成场景。实验表明该方法在单对象与多对象阴影生成上均达到当前最优性能。
Motivation: 现有阴影生成方法主要针对单对象插入，当多个前景对象同时合成到背景场景时往往无法泛化，而实际合成流程常需同时插入多个对象，要求阴影在几何、附着与位置上保持一致。
Method: 利用预训练 text-to-image 扩散模型，通过图像路径注入密集多尺度特征提供空间引导，并将各对象阴影边界框作为可学习位置 token 经文本路径编码，以交叉注意力融合；使用注意力对齐损失约束 token 与对应阴影区域的对齐。作者还扩展 DESOBAv2 数据集，构造多对象合成场景并自动生成包含对象类别与阴影位置信息的提示词。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在单对象和多对象阴影生成设置下均达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多对象阴影生成是被低估的问题，所提方法通过挖掘扩散模型的多模态能力可生成物理上合理的多对象阴影。

papers.title: From Visual to Multimodal: Systematic Ablation of Encoders and Fusion Strategies in Animal Identification
papers.abstract_en: Automated animal identification is a practical task for reuniting lost pets with their owners, yet current systems often struggle due to limited dataset scale and reliance on unimodal visual cues. This study introduces a multimodal verification framework that enhances visual features with semantic identity priors derived from synthetic textual descriptions. We constructed a massive training corpus of 1.9 million photographs covering 695,091~unique animals to support this investigation. Through systematic ablation studies, we identified SigLIP2-Giant and E5-Small-v2 as the optimal vision and text backbones. We further evaluated fusion strategies ranging from simple concatenation to adaptive gating to determine the best method for integrating these modalities. Our proposed approach utilizes a gated fusion mechanism and achieved a Top-1 accuracy of 84.28\% and an Equal Error Rate of 0.0422 on a comprehensive test protocol. These results represent an 11\% improvement over leading unimodal baselines and demonstrate that integrating synthesized semantic descriptions significantly refines decision boundaries in large-scale pet re-identification.\\\\ \textbf{Conference update.} This work was accepted to the FGVC13 Workshop at CVPR 2026. We thank Vadim Ezhov and Nikolai Shcheglov for their help with the poster presentation and demonstration at the conference.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多模态验证框架，用于大规模宠物再识别：在视觉特征之外引入由合成文本描述生成的语义身份先验 (semantic identity priors)。作者构建了包含 190 万张照片、695,091 只独立动物的训练语料，并通过系统消融确定 SigLIP2-Giant 与 E5-Small-v2 为最优视觉与文本骨干。采用门控融合 (gated fusion) 后，在综合测试协议上取得 84.28% 的 Top-1 准确率和 0.0422 的 Equal Error Rate。
Motivation: 当前的自动动物识别系统常因数据集规模有限以及只依赖单模态视觉线索而表现不佳，阻碍了走失宠物与主人的匹配。论文针对这一实际任务缺口，探索引入语义信息来增强视觉表征。
Method: 构建大规模照片与合成文本描述的训练语料，对多种视觉/文本编码器和融合策略（从简单拼接到自适应门控）进行系统消融，最终提出基于门控机制的多模态融合方案。
Result: 所提门控融合方法在测试协议上达到 Top-1 准确率 84.28%、EER 0.0422，相较领先的单模态基线提升 11%。
Conclusion: 作者认为，整合合成语义描述能显著优化大规模宠物再识别中的决策边界；该工作已被 FGVC13 Workshop at CVPR 2026 接收，并发表于 MDPI Journal of Imaging。

papers.title: LLMs Remember First, Forget Last: Dual-Process Interference in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can process millions of tokens, yet how they handle conflicting information within context remains poorly understood. From patient health logs tracking evolving vital signs to legal documents with superseding clauses, real-world applications routinely require models to retrieve specific values from streams of semantically similar, competing updates. We adapt classical interference paradigms from cognitive psychology to compare retroactive interference (RI; recalling initial values after updates) and proactive interference (PI; recalling recent values despite competing prior encodings) across 39 LLMs spanning 1B to 2.5T parameters. Every model exhibits the same pattern: PI causes substantially greater degradation than RI (d = 1.73), the opposite of the typical human finding where new information more readily disrupts old. Four lines of evidence indicate that RI and PI engage distinct mechanisms: model size predicts RI resistance but not PI; the two scores correlate only weakly; error analysis reveals qualitatively different failure profiles, with RI failures reflecting passive retrieval failure and PI failures reflecting active primacy intrusion; and hallucination rates remain below 1% in both conditions. An adaptive bootstrap design further shows that RI decays smoothly while PI collapses bimodally at high interference, consistent with gradual dilution versus winner-take-all attention dynamics. These findings characterize a systematic primacy bias in transformer attention, with implications for reliable deployment in settings where in-context information evolves over time.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文借用认知心理学的干扰范式，系统研究大语言模型（LLM）在处理上下文中相互冲突、随时间更新的信息时的记忆行为。作者在39个参数规模从1B到2.5T的LLM上对比了倒摄干扰（RI，回忆更新前的初始值）与前摄干扰（PI，在竞争性旧编码存在下回忆最近值），发现所有模型均呈现PI造成的退化显著大于RI（d=1.73），与人类典型的记忆模式相反。进一步证据表明两者由不同机制驱动，自适应bootstrap实验显示RI平滑衰减而PI在高干扰下呈双峰崩溃，指向Transformer注意力中系统性的首因偏差（primacy bias）。
Motivation: 现实应用如患者生命体征日志和含替代条款的法律文件，经常要求模型从语义相似、相互竞争的更新流中检索特定值，但LLM如何处理上下文中的冲突信息仍缺乏理解。
Method: 将认知心理学的经典干扰范式适配到语言模型评测，在39个规模跨1B到2.5T参数的LLM上对比RI与PI，并通过四条证据线（模型规模预测力、分数相关性、错误分析、幻觉率）以及自适应bootstrap设计来检验两者是否由相同机制驱动。
Result: 所有模型均表现出PI比RI带来更大程度退化（d=1.73），与人类通常的新信息更易干扰旧信息相反；模型规模只预测RI抗性而非PI，两个分数仅弱相关，错误分析显示RI失败是被动检索失败而PI失败是主动首因侵入（primacy intrusion），两种条件下幻觉率均低于1%；高干扰下RI平滑衰减而PI双峰式崩溃，与渐进稀释对比赢家通吃（winner-take-all）的注意力动态一致。
Conclusion: 研究刻画了Transformer注意力中系统性的首因偏差，提示在上下文信息随时间演化的场景中，可靠部署LLM需要关注这种干扰不对称性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: From Leaky Thoughts to Private Reasoning: Controlling What LRMs Say to Themselves
papers.abstract_en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) produce reasoning traces (RTs) that often contain sensitive information. These leaky thoughts are difficult to control and frequently violate explicit privacy directives. Because RTs can be exposed through prompt injection attacks, this becomes a direct privacy risk to the user. We approach this as a controllability problem: since privacy directives are themselves instructions, improving instruction-following (IF) within the RT provides a direct path to reducing privacy leaks. To this end, we introduce an SFT dataset that teaches models to follow general instructions throughout their reasoning process, and propose Staged Decoding, a simple decoding strategy that decouples RT and answer generation using separate LoRA adapters to maximize IF of each component. We evaluate our approach on six models from two families (1.7B-14B parameters), across two IF benchmarks and two privacy benchmarks. Our method yields substantial improvements, with gains of up to 20.9 points in IF and 51.9 percentage points on privacy benchmarks, though these can come at the cost of task utility due to the trade-off between reasoning performance and IF. Our results show that improving IF in LRMs can significantly enhance privacy, suggesting a promising direction for future privacy-aware LRMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/UKPLab/arxiv2026-controllable-reasoning-models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型推理模型 (LRM) 的推理痕迹 (reasoning traces) 泄露敏感信息的问题，将其建模为可控性问题：既然隐私指令本身是指令，提升推理过程中的指令遵循 (instruction-following, IF) 就能直接减少隐私泄露。作者引入一个 SFT 数据集教会模型在整个推理过程中遵循通用指令，并提出 Staged Decoding 解码策略，用分离的 LoRA 适配器分别优化推理痕迹生成与答案生成。在六个来自两个模型家族的模型 (1.7B-14B) 上，该方法在两个 IF 基准上最高提升 20.9 分，在两个隐私基准上最高提升 51.9 个百分点，但可能以任务效用为代价。
Motivation: LRM 产生的推理痕迹常包含难以控制的敏感信息，且会违反显式隐私指令；这些痕迹可能通过提示注入攻击被暴露，构成直接的用户隐私风险。
Method: 提出两个核心组件：一个 SFT 数据集，用于教学模型在推理全程遵循通用指令；以及 Staged Decoding，一种通过独立 LoRA 适配器解耦推理痕迹生成与答案生成的简单解码策略，以分别最大化各部分的指令遵循能力。
Result: 在六个模型 (1.7B-14B 参数) 上的评估显示，IF 基准最高提升 20.9 分，隐私基准最高提升 51.9 个百分点，但提升可能伴随任务效用的下降，体现出推理性能与指令遵循之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为提升 LRM 的指令遵循能力可以显著增强隐私保护，为未来的隐私感知推理模型指明了一个有前景的方向；代价是推理性能与 IF 之间存在权衡。

papers.title: SPD Learn: A Geometric Deep Learning Python Library for Neural Decoding Through Trivialization
papers.abstract_en: Implementations of symmetric positive definite (SPD) matrix-based neural networks for neural decoding remain fragmented across research codebases and Python packages. Existing implementations often employ ad hoc handling of manifold constraints and non-unified training setups, which hinders reproducibility and integration into modern deep-learning workflows. To address this gap, we introduce SPD Learn, a unified and modular Python package for geometric deep learning with SPD matrices. SPD Learn provides core SPD operators and neural-network layers, including numerically stable spectral operators, and enforces Stiefel/SPD constraints via trivialization-based parameterizations. This design enables standard backpropagation and optimization in unconstrained Euclidean spaces while producing manifold-constrained parameters by construction. The package also offers reference implementations of representative SPDNet-based models and interfaces with widely used brain computer interface/neuroimaging toolkits and modern machine-learning libraries (e.g., MOABB, Braindecode, Nilearn, and SKADA), facilitating reproducible benchmarking and practical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 SPD Learn，一个面向 SPD 矩阵的几何深度学习统一 Python 库，专门用于神经解码（neural decoding）。该库通过平凡化（trivialization）参数化施加 Stiefel/SPD 约束，使模型可以在无约束欧氏空间中用标准反向传播训练，并提供数值稳定的谱算子、参考 SPDNet 实现以及 MOABB、Braindecode 等工具包的接口。摘要未给出定量实验数据，属于工具/库贡献。
Motivation: 现有的 SPD 矩阵神经网络实现分散在多个研究代码库和 Python 包中，对流形约束的处理方式各异，训练流程不统一，阻碍了可复现性和与现代深度学习工作流的集成。
Method: 提出一个模块化的统一 Python 包，包含核心 SPD 算子和神经网络层，采用基于平凡化的参数化方法保证 Stiefel/SPD 约束在构造上成立，从而允许标准反向传播和欧氏空间优化。
Result: 摘要未报告数值实验结果，主要成果是统一的库实现、参考模型以及面向脑机接口/神经影像工具包的接口集成。
Conclusion: 作者强调该设计能够促进可复现的基准测试和实际部署，适用于脑机接口与神经影像领域。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Forgetting-Resistant and Lesion-Aware Source-Free Domain Adaptive Fundus Image Analysis with Vision-Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) aims to adapt a model trained in the source domain to perform well in the target domain, with only unlabeled target domain data and the source model. Taking into account that conventional SFDA methods are inevitably error-prone under domain shift, recently greater attention has been directed to SFDA assisted with off-the-shelf foundation models, e.g., vision-language (ViL) models. However, existing works of leveraging ViL models for SFDA confront two issues: (i) Although mutual information is exploited to consider the joint distribution between the predictions of ViL model and the target model, we argue that the forgetting of some superior predictions of the target model still occurs, as indicated by the decline of the accuracies of certain classes during adaptation; (ii) Prior research disregards the rich, fine-grained knowledge embedded in the ViL model, which offers detailed grounding for fundus image diagnosis. In this paper, we introduce a novel forgetting-resistant and lesion-aware (FRLA) method for SFDA of fundus image diagnosis with ViL model. Specifically, a forgetting-resistant adaptation module explicitly preserves the confident predictions of the target model, and a lesion-aware adaptation module yields patch-wise predictions from ViL model and employs them to help the target model be aware of the lesion areas and leverage the ViL model's fine-grained knowledge. Extensive experiments show that our method not only significantly outperforms the vision-language model, but also achieves consistent improvements over the state-of-the-art methods. Our code will be released.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向眼底图像诊断的无源域适应（SFDA）方法 FRLA，结合现成的视觉-语言（ViL）模型，解决两个问题：目标模型在适应过程中忘记自身某些高置信预测，以及忽略 ViL 模型中可用于病灶定位的细粒度知识。方法包含抗遗忘适应模块和病灶感知适应模块，实验显示其显著优于 ViL 模型并在多个基准上一致超过现有方法。
Motivation: 现有 SFDA 在域偏移下容易犯错，新的趋势是利用现成基础模型如 ViL 模型辅助适应，但已有工作存在两点不足：目标模型某些类别的预测在适应中发生遗忘，且未利用 ViL 模型提供的眼底图像病灶级细粒度知识。
Method: 提出 FRLA 方法，包含两个模块：抗遗忘适应模块显式保留目标模型的置信预测；病灶感知适应模块从 ViL 模型生成 patch 级预测，帮助目标模型感知病灶区域并利用细粒度知识。
Result: 大量实验表明该方法不仅显著优于单独使用视觉-语言模型，而且相比现有最先进方法取得一致的改进。
Conclusion: 作者强调利用 ViL 模型的病灶级知识并防止目标模型预测遗忘可有效提升眼底图像 SFDA 性能，并计划开源代码；arXiv 备注提示第 3 节部分实验结果基于可能不完全公平的比较。

papers.title: A solvable high-dimensional model where nonlinear autoencoders learn structure invisible to PCA while test loss misaligns with generalization
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world datasets contain hidden structure that cannot be detected by simple linear correlations between input features. For example, latent factors may influence the data in a coordinated way, even though their effect is invisible to covariance-based methods such as PCA. In practice, nonlinear neural networks often succeed in extracting such hidden structure in unsupervised and self-supervised learning. However, constructing a minimal high-dimensional model where this advantage can be rigorously analyzed has remained an open theoretical challenge. We introduce a tractable high-dimensional spiked model with two latent factors: one visible to covariance, and one statistically dependent yet uncorrelated, appearing only in higher-order moments. PCA and linear autoencoders fail to recover the latter, while a minimal nonlinear autoencoder provably extracts both. We analyze both the population risk, and empirical risk minimization. Our model also provides a tractable example where self-supervised test loss is poorly aligned with representation quality: nonlinear autoencoders recover latent structure that linear methods miss, even though their reconstruction loss is higher.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可解析的高维 spiked model，其中包含两个隐因子：一个对协方差可见，另一个统计相关但与输入不相关、只出现在高阶矩中。作者证明 PCA 与线性自编码器无法恢复后者，而一个极简的非线性自编码器可被证明同时提取两个因子，并分别分析了总体风险 (population risk) 与经验风险最小化 (empirical risk minimization)。模型还给出了一个自监督测试损失与表示质量错位的可解实例。
Motivation: 现实数据常包含无法由输入特征间简单线性相关检测到的隐藏结构，而非线性网络在实践中能提取这类结构；但缺乏一个可严格分析该优势的最小高维理论模型。
Method: 构造一个可解的高维 spiked model，包含一个对协方差可见的因子和一个统计依赖但与输入不相关、仅出现在高阶矩中的因子，并研究极简非线性自编码器在该模型下的总体风险与经验风险最小化。
Result: PCA 和线性自编码器无法恢复仅出现在高阶矩中的隐因子，而极简非线性自编码器可以被证明同时恢复两个因子；该模型还提供自监督测试损失与表示质量对齐不良的可解例子，即非线性自编码器恢复了线性方法错过的潜在结构，尽管其重建损失更高。
Conclusion: 该模型为严格分析非线性自编码器相对协方差类方法的优势提供了可解的理论框架，并强调重建损失等自监督测试损失未必能反映表示质量。

summary_sections.result: PCA 和线性自编码器无法恢复仅出现在高阶矩中的隐因子，而极简非线性自编码器可以被证明同时恢复两个因子；该模型还提供自监督测试损失与表示质量对齐不良的可解例子，即非线性自编码器恢复了线性方法错过的潜在结构，尽管其重建损失更高。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该模型为严格分析非线性自编码器相对协方差类方法的优势提供了可解的理论框架，并强调重建损失等自监督测试损失未必能反映表示质量。

papers.title: What Does Preference Learning Recover from Pairwise Comparison Data?
papers.abstract_en: Pairwise preference learning is central to machine learning, with recent applications in aligning language models with human preferences. A typical dataset consists of triplets $(x, y^+, y^-)$, where response $y^+$ is preferred over response $y^-$ for context $x$. The Bradley--Terry (BT) model is the predominant approach, modeling preference probabilities as a function of latent score differences. Standard practice assumes data follows this model and learns the latent scores accordingly. However, real data may violate this assumption, and it remains unclear what BT learning recovers in such cases. Starting from triplet comparison data, we formalize the preference information it encodes through the conditional preference distribution (CPRD). We give precise conditions for when BT is appropriate for modeling the CPRD, and identify factors governing sample efficiency -- namely, margin and connectivity. Together, these results offer a data-centric foundation for understanding what preference learning actually recovers.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究成对偏好学习（pairwise preference learning）中 Bradley--Terry (BT) 模型在数据不符合其建模假设时到底恢复了什么。作者从三元组比较数据出发，形式化偏好信息由条件偏好分布 (CPRD) 编码，并给出 BT 模型何时适用于建模 CPRD 的精确条件，同时识别影响样本效率的因素——即边际 (margin) 与连通性 (connectivity)。这些结果旨在为理解偏好学习实际恢复的内容提供数据为中心 (data-centric) 的理论基础。
Motivation: 标准实践假设数据遵循 BT 模型并据此学习潜在分数，但真实数据可能违背这一假设；在这种情况下 BT 学习究竟恢复什么尚不明确。
Method: 从三元组比较数据 $(x, y^+, y^-)$ 出发，形式化其编码的条件偏好分布 CPRD，并在此基础上推导 BT 模型适用性的精确条件，分析控制样本效率的 margin 和 connectivity 两个因素。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数值，而是给出理论结果：精确刻画 BT 适合建模 CPRD 的条件，并证明样本效率主要受 margin 和 connectivity 影响。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果为偏好学习提供了数据为中心的理论基础，说明偏好学习实际恢复的是 CPRD 所编码的信息。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware 4D Gaussian Splatting for Monocular Occluded Human Rendering
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity rendering of dynamic humans from monocular videos typically degrades catastrophically under occlusions. Existing solutions incorporate external priors-either hallucinating missing content via generative models, which induces severe temporal flickering, or imposing rigid geometric heuristics that fail to capture diverse appearances. To this end, we reformulate the task as a Maximum A Posteriori estimation problem under heteroscedastic observation noise. In this paper, we propose U-4DGS, a framework integrating a Probabilistic Deformation Network and a Joint Rasterization pipeline. This architecture renders pixel-aligned uncertainty maps that act as an adaptive gradient modulator, automatically attenuating artifacts from unreliable observations. Furthermore, to prevent geometric drift in regions lacking reliable visual cues, we enforce Confidence-Aware Regularizations, which leverage the learned uncertainty to selectively propagate spatial-temporal validity. Extensive experiments on the ZJU-MoCap and OcMotion datasets demonstrate that U-4DGS achieves state-of-the-art rendering fidelity and robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 U-4DGS，将单目视频中遮挡条件下的动态人体渲染问题重新建模为异方差观测噪声下的最大后验估计 (Maximum A Posteriori)，并引入概率形变网络 (Probabilistic Deformation Network) 与联合光栅化 (Joint Rasterization) 流水线。该方法渲染逐像素对齐的不确定性图作为自适应梯度调制器，辅以置信度感知正则化抑制几何漂移。在 ZJU-MoCap 与 OcMotion 数据集上，U-4DGS 取得了最先进的渲染保真度和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有的单目动态人体渲染方法在遮挡下会严重退化：基于生成模型的先验会带来明显的时间闪烁 (temporal flickering)，而刚性几何先验则无法刻画多样化的外观变化。
Method: 将任务重新表述为异方差观测噪声下的最大后验估计问题，提出 U-4DGS 框架，包含概率形变网络和联合光栅化流水线，输出不确定性图以自适应调制梯度并减弱不可靠观测带来的伪影；同时利用学习到的不确定性执行置信度感知正则化，选择性传播时空有效性以防止几何漂移。
Result: 在 ZJU-MoCap 和 OcMotion 数据集上的大量实验表明，U-4DGS 达到了最优的渲染保真度和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者强调，不确定性感知建模与置信度正则化相结合，能够有效缓解遮挡条件下动态人体渲染中的时间闪烁与几何漂移问题。

papers.title: Test-time Generalization for Physics through Neural Operator Splitting
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators have shown promise in learning solution maps of partial differential equations (PDEs), but they often struggle to generalize when test inputs lie outside the training distribution, such as novel initial conditions, unseen PDE coefficients or unseen physics. Prior works address this limitation with large-scale multiple physics pretraining followed by fine-tuning, but this still require examples from the new dynamics, falling short of true zero-shot generalization. In this work, we propose a method to enhance generalization at test time, i.e., without modifying pretrained weights. Building on DISCO, which provides a dictionary of neural operators trained across different dynamics, we introduce a neural operator splitting strategy that, at test time, searches over compositions of training operators to approximate unseen dynamics.On challenging out-of-distribution tasks including parameter extrapolation and novel combinations of physics phenomena, our approach achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot generalization results, while being able to recover the underlying PDE parameters. These results underscore test-time computation as a key avenue for building flexible, compositional, and generalizable neural operators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种测试时推理策略来提升神经算子 (neural operator) 对偏微分方程 (PDE) 的零样本泛化能力。基于 DISCO 提供的跨动力学算子字典，作者引入神经算子分裂 (neural operator splitting) 方法，在测试时不修改预训练权重，而是搜索训练算子的组合来逼近未见动力学。在参数外推和新物理现象组合等困难分布外任务上，该方法取得 state-of-the-art 的零样本泛化结果，并能恢复底层 PDE 参数。
Motivation: 神经算子在测试输入偏离训练分布时（如新初始条件、未见 PDE 系数或未见物理过程）往往泛化失败；已有的多物理预训练加微调仍需新动力学的样本，无法实现真正的零样本泛化。
Method: 以 DISCO 提供的跨不同动力学训练的神经算子字典为基础，提出神经算子分裂策略，在测试阶段搜索训练算子的组合以近似未见动力学，全程不修改预训练权重。
Result: 在参数外推与物理现象新组合等挑战性分布外任务上，该方法获得 state-of-the-art 的零样本泛化结果，并且能够恢复底层 PDE 参数。
Conclusion: 作者强调测试时计算 (test-time computation) 是构建灵活、组合式且可泛化神经算子的关键途径，指出该方法面向零样本且无需微调的新动力学场景。
Relevance: 22

papers.title: OD-Gear: Online Decomposition and Group Sampling for Expert-Guided Adversarial Routing in Scalable Capacitated Vehicle Routing
papers.abstract_en: Solving large-scale capacitated vehicle routing problems (CVRP) is hindered by the high complexity of classical heuristics and the limited generalization of neural solvers. To bridge this gap, we propose OD-Gear, an expert-guided adversarial framework that integrates hybrid genetic search (HGS) and online barycenter clustering (BCC) decomposition with group-relative optimization. OD-Gear internalizes expert heuristics into a graph attention network (GAT)-based policy via high-fidelity knowledge distillation. Our minimax adversarial training distills divide-and-conquer strategies into dense surrogate rewards, while a group-sampling strategy exploits relative solution advantages to promote both diversity and quality. This architecture enables high-quality, clustering-free inference on massive graphs, effectively bypassing the overhead of traditional decomposition. Empirical results demonstrate that OD-Gear achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across most benchmarks, remaining highly competitive at the 10,000-node scale. By providing heuristic-quality solutions with low-latency, OD-Gear offers a robust and scalable framework for large-scale CVRP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OD-Gear，一种面向大规模容量约束车辆路径问题（CVRP）的专家引导对抗训练框架，将混合遗传搜索（HGS）与在线重心聚类（BCC）分解结合到基于图注意力网络（GAT）的策略中。通过知识蒸馏与 minimax 对抗训练，模型在推理时无需聚类分解即可处理大规模图，在 10,000 节点规模下仍具竞争力。
Motivation: 大规模 CVRP 求解受限于经典启发式的高复杂度和神经求解器的泛化能力不足，作者希望弥合启发式质量与神经网络推理速度之间的差距。
Method: OD-Gear 将专家启发式通过高保真知识蒸馏内化到 GAT 策略中，利用 minimax 对抗训练把分治策略蒸馏为稠密替代奖励，并通过组采样（group sampling）策略利用相对解优势来提升解的多样性与质量。
Result: 摘要报告 OD-Gear 在大多数基准上达到 SOTA，且在 10,000 节点规模保持高度竞争力，能以低延迟提供接近启发式质量的解。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架通过高质量、聚类无关的推理绕过传统分解开销，为大规模 CVRP 提供鲁棒且可扩展的求解方案。

papers.title: AutoRefine: Compiling Trajectories into Validated Typed Agent Artifacts
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents repeatedly encounter related tasks, yet systems that learn from trajectories commit every lesson to one predefined artifact form. A local constraint, a reusable procedure, and a delegated objective require different amounts of runtime ownership, so one form either under-specifies the correction or wraps it in execution machinery it does not need. We present AutoRefine, which treats trajectory learning as typed artifact compilation. It contrasts failed against successful trajectories to derive a type-neutral, evidence-linked intervention specification, then compiles that specification into the first Rule, Skill, or bounded Subagent that closes it under a runtime-relative ownership order: the selected schema must own every specified observation, state variable, dependent decision, and completion condition. Validation is stated in the same terms: a type-specific contract gate tests whether the generated object realizes its declared boundary, and a replay gate admits it only when it improves the correction cases linked to its source failures without regression on preservation cases. With GPT-5.6-terra as the shared backbone, AutoRefine records the highest success on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, TravelPlanner, and SpreadsheetBench, and ties the best result on SkillCraft; on TravelPlanner it reaches 80.56% success against 50.0% for the strongest baseline. Removing boundary closure or replay validation costs 15.00 and 16.11 percentage points, the two largest losses among our construction and admission policies. In a longitudinal TravelPlanner stream, the repository holds 89--91% held-out success after 60 learning tasks with no net loss on previously solved tasks, and frozen repositories improve all 25 evaluated source--target pairs, more within a domain (14.20 points on average) than across domains (6.99).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoRefine，把智能体从轨迹中学习的过程建模为“类型化工件编译”(typed artifact compilation)。系统先对比失败与成功轨迹，推导出与类型无关、有证据支撑的干预规格，再按运行时所有权顺序编译为 Rule、Skill 或受限 Subagent，并通过类型契约门与回放门做验证。基于 GPT-5.6-terra，AutoRefine 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、TravelPlanner、SpreadsheetBench 上取得最高成功率，并与最强基线在 SkillCraft 上持平。
Motivation: 现有智能体系统把每次轨迹学习到的教训都写进单一预定义工件形式，但局部约束、可复用流程和委派目标需要不同程度的运行时所有权；单一形式要么欠规格化修正，要么把修正包进不需要的执行机制中。
Method: AutoRefine 对比失败与成功轨迹，生成类型中立、带证据链接的干预规格，再将该规格编译成第一个能闭合该规格的 Rule、Skill 或受限 Subagent；选择依据是运行时所有权顺序，所选模式必须拥有所有指定的观测、状态变量、依赖决策和完成条件。验证同样按此表述：类型特定契约门检查生成对象是否实现其声明边界，回放门只在提升来源失败对应的修正用例且不回归保留用例时接受该对象。
Result: 以 GPT-5.6-terra 为共享骨干，AutoRefine 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、TravelPlanner 和 SpreadsheetBench 上取得最高成功率，并在 SkillCraft 上追平最佳结果；TravelPlanner 上达到 80.56% 成功率，而最强基线为 50.0%。消融中移除边界闭合或回放验证分别损失 15.00 和 16.11 个百分点，是构建与准入策略中最大的两类损失。纵向 TravelPlanner 流中，60 个学习任务后仓库保持 89–91% 的留出成功率且先前已解任务无净损失；冻结仓库改进全部 25 个评估的源–目标对，域内平均提升 14.20 点，跨域平均提升 6.99 点。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将轨迹学习视为按运行时所有权顺序编译为类型化工件、并以契约门和回放门验证，能显著提升智能体跨任务学习的成功率和抗遗忘能力。摘要未讨论该方法在轨迹数据稀缺或类型定义不清晰场景下的局限。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: AutoRefine 对比失败与成功轨迹，生成类型中立、带证据链接的干预规格，再将该规格编译成第一个能闭合该规格的 Rule、Skill 或受限 Subagent；选择依据是运行时所有权顺序，所选模式必须拥有所有指定的观测、状态变量、依赖决策和完成条件。验证同样按此表述：类型特定契约门检查生成对象是否实现其声明边界，回放门只在提升来源失败对应的修正用例且不回归保留用例时接受该对象。
summary_sections.result: 以 GPT-5.6-terra 为共享骨干，AutoRefine 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、TravelPlanner 和 SpreadsheetBench 上取得最高成功率，并在 SkillCraft 上追平最佳结果；TravelPlanner 上达到 80.56% 成功率，而最强基线为 50.0%。消融中移除边界闭合或回放验证分别损失 15.00 和 16.11 个百分点，是构建与准入策略中最大的两类损失。纵向 TravelPlanner 流中，60 个学习任务后仓库保持 89–91% 的留出成功率且先前已解任务无净损失；冻结仓库改进全部 25 个评估的源–目标对，域内平均提升 14.20 点，跨域平均提升 6.99 点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，将轨迹学习视为按运行时所有权顺序编译为类型化工件、并以契约门和回放门验证，能显著提升智能体跨任务学习的成功率和抗遗忘能力。摘要未讨论该方法在轨迹数据稀缺或类型定义不清晰场景下的局限。

papers.title: Temporal Sepsis Modeling: a Relational and Explainable-by-Design Framework
papers.abstract_en: Sepsis remains one of the most complex and heterogeneous syndromes in intensive care. While deep learning models achieve competitive performance in early sepsis prediction, their decision processes often remain difficult to interpret clinically, and explainability is typically added only through post-hoc methods. We propose an explainable-by-design framework based on a relational approach: temporal EHR data are represented in a relational schema, flattened via MDL-based propositionalisation into compact human-readable features, and classified using a selective Fractional Naive Bayes classifier. Evaluated on MIMIC-III (3,940 patients, 10-fold cross-validation), our approach achieves AUC = 0.983 - competitive with XGBoost (0.985) and CatBoost (0.985), and superior to LSTM (0.945) - with only 98 selected variables and a 1 MB model footprint. Unlike post-hoc methods, interpretability is native and fourfold: univariate, global, local, and counterfactual.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于关系方法 (relational approach) 的可解释-by-design 脓毒症预测框架：将时间序列 EHR 数据表示为关系模式，通过基于 MDL 的命题化 (propositionalisation) 转化为紧凑可读特征，再用选择性分数朴素贝叶斯分类器 (selective Fractional Naive Bayes) 进行分类。在 MIMIC-III 上（3,940 例患者，10 折交叉验证）达到 AUC=0.983，与 XGBoost 和 CatBoost 的 0.985 相当，优于 LSTM 的 0.945，且仅用 98 个变量、模型体积 1MB。
Motivation: 脓毒症是重症监护中最复杂、异质性最强的综合征之一；深度学习模型虽在早期预测上表现好，但决策过程难以临床解释，且可解释性通常只能事后 (post-hoc) 添加。
Method: 提出可解释-by-design 框架：将时序 EHR 数据建模为关系模式，利用基于 MDL 的命题化将其扁平化为紧凑的、人类可读的特征，并采用选择性分数朴素贝叶斯分类器进行预测。
Result: 在 MIMIC-III 数据集（3,940 例患者，10 折交叉验证）上，该方法 AUC=0.983，与 XGBoost（0.985）和 CatBoost（0.985）相近，优于 LSTM（0.945），并且仅使用 98 个变量、模型体积约 1MB。
Conclusion: 与事后解释方法不同，该模型的可解释性是原生的，涵盖单变量、全局、局部和反事实 (counterfactual) 四个层面。

papers.title: Position: Certifiable State Integrity Should Be Built from Local Validity, Not Global Scale
papers.abstract_en: Breakthroughs in language and vision have motivated increasingly general foundation models for time series and physical dynamics, where evidence is promising but less mature. In safety-critical Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS), globally parameterized dynamics models must remain valid through regime shifts, degradation, and lifecycle updates while supporting traceable assurance evidence. We argue that shared global parameters couple adaptation, frequency-sensitive fault representation, and verification evidence in ways that obstruct retained regime knowledge and bounded analysis. For systems whose operating conditions can be covered by a finite set of locally valid models, assurance evidence should be organized around those bounded models and their explicit composition, not around a single globally adapted model; increasing scale cannot supply explicit validity boundaries. HYDRA is a reference architecture for this position: frozen local specialists, runtime arbitration, and explicit coverage-gap monitoring. It illustrates how modular auditability and formal analysis of bounded components support Certifiable State Integrity, while whole-system certification, switching guarantees, and empirical validation remain separate obligations.
papers.comment: v2, 15 pages, (8 main text, 6 references and appendices), 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇立场论文（position paper），针对安全关键型信息物理系统（CPS）中的动力学模型，提出应将可认证的状态完整性（Certifiable State Integrity）建立在有限个局部有效模型及其显式组合之上，而非依赖单个全局自适应模型。论文给出了一个参考架构 HYDRA，由冻结的局部专家、运行时仲裁和显式覆盖缺口监测组成，并说明有界组件的模块化可审计性与形式化分析如何支撑认证证据。
Motivation: 全局参数化的动力学模型在 CPS 中需要应对状态转移、退化与生命周期更新，但共享的全局参数将自适应、故障表征和验证证据耦合在一起，阻碍了已有运行状态知识的保留和有界分析；单纯扩大模型规模无法提供显式的有效性边界。
Method: 提出组织认证证据的原则：当系统运行条件能被有限个局部有效模型覆盖时，证据应围绕这些有界模型及其显式组合组织。作为示例，引入 HYDRA 参考架构，包含冻结的局部专家、运行时仲裁和显式的覆盖缺口监测，以支持有界组件的模块化可审计性与形式化分析。
Result: 本文为立场论文，未报告实验结果；其贡献在于用 HYDRA 示例说明有界组件的模块化审计与形式化分析如何支撑 Certifiable State Integrity，同时指出整系统认证、切换保证和实证验证仍是独立的待完成义务。
Conclusion: 结论是对于运行条件可由有限局部模型覆盖的系统，认证证据应来自局部有效性而非全局规模；HYDRA 作为参考架构展示了这一方向，但整系统层面的认证、切换保证和实证验证仍需另行处理。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: SNR-Edit: Structure-Aware Noise Rectification for Inversion-Free Flow-Based Editing
papers.abstract_en: Inversion-free image editing using flow-based generative models challenges the prevailing inversion-based pipelines. However, existing approaches rely on fixed Gaussian noise to construct the source trajectory, leading to biased trajectory dynamics and causing structural degradation or quality loss. To address this, we introduce SNR-Edit, a training-free framework achieving faithful Latent Trajectory Correction via adaptive noise control. Mechanistically, SNR-Edit uses structure-aware noise rectification to inject segmentation constraints into the initial noise, anchoring the stochastic component of the source trajectory to the real image's implicit inversion position and reducing trajectory drift during source--target transport. This lightweight modification yields smoother latent trajectories and ensures high-fidelity structural preservation without requiring model tuning or inversion. Across SD3 and FLUX, evaluations on PIE-Bench and SNR-Bench show that SNR-Edit delivers performance on pixel-level metrics and VLM-based scoring, while adding only about 1s overhead per image.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SNR-Edit，一个面向流生成模型 (flow-based generative model) 的无训练图像编辑框架，通过自适应噪声控制实现潜在轨迹校正 (Latent Trajectory Correction)。其核心做法是把分割约束注入初始噪声，将源轨迹的随机分量锚定到真实图像的隐式反演位置，从而减少源-目标传输中的轨迹漂移。在 SD3 和 FLUX 上、以 PIE-Bench 和 SNR-Bench 为基准的评估表明，该方法在像素级指标和 VLM 评分上表现良好，且每张图像仅增加约 1 秒开销。
Motivation: 现有基于流模型的无反演 (inversion-free) 编辑方法依赖固定高斯噪声构建源轨迹，导致轨迹动力学有偏，进而引发结构退化或质量损失。
Method: 提出结构感知噪声修正 (structure-aware noise rectification)，将分割约束引入初始噪声，使源轨迹的随机部分贴近真实图像的隐式反演位置，以轻量方式获得更平滑的潜轨迹；全程无需模型微调或反演。
Result: 在 SD3 和 FLUX 上，PIE-Bench 与 SNR-Bench 的实验显示该方法在像素级指标和 VLM 评分上表现较好，额外开销约为每张图像 1 秒。
Conclusion: 作者强调该无训练、无反演的方法能实现高保真结构保持，并通过噪声层面的最小改动即可提升编辑轨迹的稳定性。

papers.title: BMDS-Net:Deployment-aware multi-modal brain tumor segmentation with adaptive fusion,decoder regularization,and Bayesian calibration
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal MRI enables detailed brain tumor sub-region segmentation, but clinical deployment remains affected by missing sequences,boundary errors, and overconfident predictions. We present BMDS-Net, a two-stage Swin UNETR framework that combines adaptivemodality fusion, boundary-aware decoder regularization, and efficient Bayesian calibration. The deterministic stage adds zero-initializedmultimodal contextual fusion (MMCF) and residual-gated deep decoder supervision (DDS) to modulate modality contributions andregularize hierarchical boundary reconstruction. The second stage replaces only the final convolutional layer with a Bayesian layer,enabling Monte Carlo uncertainty estimates with limited additional training cost. On BraTS 2021 (1,251 cases), BMDS-Net achieved Dice scores of 0.9293, 0.9098, and 0.8675 for WT, TC, and ET, with HD95 values of 2.27, 2.22, and 3.27 mm. Configuration comparisons showed that auxiliary supervision favored complete-input segmentation, whereas the complete MMCF+gated-DDS configuration was most robust under single-modality removal. Bayesian BMDS-Net achieved an expected calibration error of 0.0037, close to a three-model ensemble (0.0035) at approximately 60% lower training cost. On BraTS 2020, the same protocol preserved the leading internal ranking of the complete configuration among five Swin UNETR-controlled variants. The implementation code is available at https://github.com/RyanZhou168/BMDS-Net.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 6 figures. Manuscript prepared for submission to ACM HEALTH
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BMDS-Net 是一个面向多模态 MRI 脑肿瘤分割的两阶段 Swin UNETR 框架，通过自适应模态融合、边界感知解码器正则化和贝叶斯校准来应对临床部署中的序列缺失、边界错误和过度自信预测。在 BraTS 2021 上，完整配置在 WT、TC、ET 上取得 Dice 0.9293、0.9098、0.8675，HD95 分别为 2.27、2.22、3.27 mm；贝叶斯版本将期望校准误差降至 0.0037，接近三模型集成（0.0035），训练成本降低约 60%。
Motivation: 多模态 MRI 脑肿瘤分割在临床部署时面临模态序列缺失、边界分割不准和预测过度自信的问题，现有方法对这些问题缺乏系统性处理。
Method: 提出两阶段 BMDS-Net：确定性阶段加入零初始化的多模态上下文融合（MMCF）和残差门控深层解码器监督（DDS），用于调制模态贡献并正则化层级边界重建；第二阶段仅将最终卷积层替换为贝叶斯层，以有限的额外训练成本实现蒙特卡洛不确定性估计。
Result: 在 BraTS 2021（1,251 例）上，完整配置达到 WT/TC/ET Dice 0.9293/0.9098/0.8675，HD95 2.27/2.22/3.27 mm；辅助监督偏好完整输入分割，完整 MMCF+门控 DDS 配置在单模态移除下最稳健；贝叶斯 BMDS-Net 的期望校准误差为 0.0037，接近三模型集成（0.0035）且训练成本降低约 60%；在 BraTS 2020 上，该协议在五个 Swin UNETR 控制变体中保持完整配置的内部排名领先。
Conclusion: 论文将收益归因于自适应模态融合、边界正则化和轻量贝叶斯校准的组合，并指出该协议在两个 BraTS 基准上的有效性。

papers.title: Communication-efficient distributed hazard difference estimation for heterogeneous multi-site survival data
papers.abstract_en: Multi-site collaboration can power survival models that no single hospital could fit alone, but privacy rules and protected computing environments block patient-level data sharing and the persistent server connections required by iterative federated methods. We present DiSAH (\underline{\textbf{Di}}stributed \underline{\textbf{S}}urvival via \underline{\textbf{A}}dditive \underline{\textbf{H}}azards), a federated algorithm for time-to-event analysis whose closed-form, non-iterative structure removes the need for a dedicated central server. Coordination requires only aggregation of summary statistics, which any site can perform, with no patient-level data leaving the site. DiSAH is the first federated method to estimate hazard differences, the absolute change in event rate attributable to each risk factor, providing an actionable scale for triage, resource allocation, and health-economic evaluation. Across simulations and 47,778 emergency-department patients from the United States and Singapore, DiSAH matches centralized analysis in accuracy and discrimination, recovers mortality risk factors no individual site was powered to detect, and outperforms meta-analysis and local models.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 多站点协作可以提升生存模型能力，但隐私规则和受保护的计算环境既禁止患者级数据共享，也阻止迭代式联邦方法所需的持久服务器连接，现有方案的协调代价过高。
Method: DiSAH 利用加性风险模型（additive hazards）的闭式、非迭代估计结构来去除专用中心服务器；站点间协调仅需汇总统计量，任意站点都可执行聚合，患者级数据不离开本地。
Result: 在模拟实验以及来自美国和新加坡的 47,778 例急诊患者数据上，DiSAH 在准确性和区分度上与集中式分析相当，恢复了单个站点无法单独检测到的死亡风险因素，并优于元分析和本地模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DiSAH 是首个估计风险差的联邦生存分析方法，风险差刻画每个风险因素导致的绝对事件率变化，可为分诊、资源分配和卫生经济学评估提供可操作的尺度。

papers.title: RAG-3DSG: Enhancing 3D Scene Graphs with Re-Shot Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D Scene Graph (3DSG) can enhance various downstream tasks in robotics by leveraging structured semantic representations, yet current 3DSG construction methods suffer from semantic inconsistencies caused by noisy cross-image aggregation under occlusions and constrained viewpoints. To mitigate the impact of such inconsistency, we propose RAG-3DSG, which introduces re-shot guided uncertainty estimation. By measuring the semantic consistency between original limited viewpoints and re-shot optimal viewpoints, this method quantifies the underlying semantic ambiguity of each graph object. Based on this quantification, we devise an Object-level Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) that leverages low-uncertainty objects as semantic anchors to retrieve more reliable contextual knowledge, enabling a Vision-Language Model to rectify the predictions of uncertain objects and optimize the final 3DSG. Extensive evaluations across three challenging benchmarks and real-world robot trials demonstrate that RAG-3DSG achieves superior recall and precision, effectively mitigating semantic noise to provide highly reliable scene representations for robotics tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RAG-3DSG，一种面向开放词汇 3D 场景图 (3D Scene Graph, 3DSG) 构建的检索增强生成方法。方法通过重拍最优视角进行不确定性估计，并将低不确定性的物体作为语义锚点，检索上下文知识以修正高不确定性物体的预测。在三个基准和真实机器人试验上，该方法声称取得更高的召回率与精确率，能缓解嘈杂跨视角聚合带来的语义不一致。
Motivation: 现有 3DSG 构建方法在遮挡和受限视角下进行跨图像聚合时会产生语义不一致，这种噪声会影响下游机器人任务；作者希望量化并修正这种语义歧义。
Method: 提出重拍引导的不确定性估计 (re-shot guided uncertainty estimation)，通过比较原始受限视角与重拍最优视角间的语义一致性来量化每个图对象的语义歧义；随后设计物体级检索增强生成 (Object-level RAG)，将低不确定性对象作为语义锚点检索上下文知识，并让视觉语言模型 (VLM) 修正不确定对象的预测。
Result: 在三个具有挑战性的基准和真实机器人试验上，RAG-3DSG 实现了更高的召回率和精确率，有效缓解语义噪声并提供更可靠的场景表示。
Conclusion: 作者强调 RAG-3DSG 能通过不确定性量化和检索增强修正有效抑制 3DSG 构建中的语义噪声，为机器人任务提供高可靠性的场景表示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SPRInG: Continual LLM Personalization via Selective Parametric Adaptation and Retrieval-Interpolated Generation
papers.abstract_en: Personalizing Large Language Models typically relies on static retrieval or one-time adaptation, assuming user preferences remain invariant over time. However, real-world interactions are dynamic, where user interests continuously evolve, posing a challenge for models to adapt to preference drift without catastrophic forgetting. Standard continual learning approaches often struggle in this context, as they indiscriminately update on noisy interaction streams, failing to distinguish genuine preference shifts from transient contexts. To address this, we introduce SPRInG, a novel semi-parametric framework designed for effective continual personalization. During training, SPRInG employs drift-driven selective adaptation, which utilizes a likelihood-based scoring function to identify high-novelty interactions. This allows the model to selectively update the user-specific adapter on drift signals while preserving hard-to-learn residuals in a replay buffer. During inference, we apply strict relevance gating and fuse parametric knowledge with retrieved history via logit interpolation. Experiments on long-form personalized generation benchmark demonstrate that SPRInG significantly outperforms existing baselines, validating its robustness for real-world continual personalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPRInG 是一种面向持续 LLM 个性化 (continual personalization) 的半参数框架，针对用户偏好随时间漂移且交互流含噪声的问题。训练阶段使用基于似然的评分函数做漂移驱动的选择性适配，只更新用户特定适配器，并把难学残差存入回放缓冲区；推理阶段采用严格相关性门控，通过 logit 插值融合参数化知识与检索到的历史。摘要报告在长形式个性化生成基准上显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有个性化方法通常假设用户偏好不变，依赖静态检索或一次性适配；真实交互中偏好持续漂移，标准持续学习方法在噪声交互流上不加区分地更新，难以区分真实偏好变化与瞬时上下文。
Method: 提出 SPRInG 框架：训练时用漂移驱动的选择性适配 (drift-driven selective adaptation)，通过似然评分函数识别高新颖性交互，选择性更新用户适配器并将难学残差保留在回放缓冲区；推理时采用严格相关性门控，并用 logit 插值融合参数知识 (parametric knowledge) 与检索历史 (retrieved history)。
Result: 摘要在长形式个性化生成基准上的实验表明，SPRInG 显著优于现有基线，验证了其在真实持续个性化场景中的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者强调，区分真正的偏好漂移与瞬时上下文、并融合选择适配与检索插值，是应对持续个性化中灾难性遗忘和噪声交互的关键。

papers.title: ReMIND: Orchestrating Modular Large Language Models for Controllable Serendipity A REM-Inspired System Design for Emergent Creative Ideation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used not only for problem solving but also for creative ideation; however, generating ideas that are both novel and coherent remains challenging. While high-temperature sampling can promote originality, it often compromises consistency and usefulness. Here, we propose ReMIND, a four-stage framework comprising wake, which establishes a stable semantic baseline through low-temperature generation; dream, which performs high-temperature exploratory generation; judge, which evaluates candidate outputs for consistency and extracts salient novel ideas; and rewake, which consolidates selected ideas into coherent final outputs. By assigning these functions to independent LLM modules, ReMIND explicitly separates exploration from stabilization. We systematically evaluated diverse model configurations using multiple creative ideation tasks. External evaluations showed that novelty enhancement could emerge through two separable stages: first from the wake to the dream phase through high-temperature exploration, and subsequently from the dream to the rewake phase through judge-mediated selection and consolidation. Notably, different LLM families exhibited distinct functional tendencies. These findings suggest that serendipitous ideation in LLMs is not solely a property of individual models but emerges from interactions among models assigned to specialized cognitive roles. ReMIND provides a general framework for investigating computational creativity and demonstrates how modular LLM orchestration can bridge exploratory generation and coherent idea formation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReMIND，一个受 REM 睡眠启发的四阶段框架，用于让大型语言模型 (LLM) 在创意构思中兼顾新颖性与连贯性。框架将唤醒 (wake)、梦境 (dream)、评判 (judge) 和再唤醒 (rewake) 四个功能分配给独立的 LLM 模块，显式分离探索与稳定化。外部评估显示，新颖性提升可经由两个独立阶段涌现：从 wake 到 dream 的高温探索阶段，以及从 dream 到 rewake 的评判介导的选择与整合阶段。不同 LLM 家族展现出不同的功能倾向，表明意外发现式构思来源于模型间按认知角色分工的交互。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地被用于创意构思，但生成既新颖又连贯的想法仍然困难。高温采样虽能提升原创性，却常损害一致性与实用性。
Method: 提出四阶段框架 ReMIND：wake 阶段通过低温生成建立稳定的语义基线；dream 阶段进行高温探索式生成；judge 阶段评估候选输出的一致性并提取显著的新颖想法；rewake 阶段将选定想法整合为连贯的最终输出。这些功能被分配给独立的 LLM 模块。
Result: 在多种创意构思任务上的系统评估显示，新颖性提升可分解为两个可分离阶段：wake 到 dream 的高温探索阶段，以及 dream 到 rewake 的评判介导选择与整合阶段。此外，不同的 LLM 家族表现出不同的功能倾向。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LLM 中的意外发现式构思不仅是个别模型的属性，而是源于被分配特定认知角色的模型之间的交互；ReMIND 为研究计算创造力提供了一个通用框架，展示了模块化 LLM 编排如何衔接探索性生成与连贯想法的形成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Progressive Learned Image Compression for Machine Perception
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in learned image codecs have extended from human perception toward machine perception However, progressive image compression with fine granular scalability (FGS)-which enables decoding a single bitstream at multiple quality levels-remains unexplored for machine-oriented codecs. In this work, we propose PICM-Net, a progressive learned image compression codec for machine perception built on trit-plane coding. Starting from a human-oriented codec, we adapt it for machine perception via a spatial-frequency modulation adapter (SFMA), a hyper-synthesis low-rank adapter (HSLoRA), and progressive decoding-aware training, and analyze how task-driven adaptation alters symbol prioritization for progressive transmission. To further support real-world deployment, we introduce an adaptive decoding controller that dynamically determines the necessary decoding level at inference time, requesting additional bits only when the current suitability is insufficient for the desired confidence level. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PICM-Net achieves efficient and adaptive progressive transmission while maintaining strong downstream classification performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/kjungwoo03/PICM-Net.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026 Workshop on Low-Level Vision Frontiers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PICM-Net，一种面向机器感知的渐进式学习图像编解码器，基于 trit-plane coding 实现单比特流多质量层次的解码。作者从面向人类的编码器出发，通过空间频率调制适配器 (SFMA)、超先验合成低秩适配器 (HSLoRA) 和渐进解码感知训练将其改造为机器感知版本，并引入自适应解码控制器在推理时按需请求额外比特。实验表明该方法能在保持下游分类性能的同时实现高效且自适应的渐进传输。
Motivation: 现有学习式图像编解码器已从人类感知扩展到机器感知，但支持细粒度可伸缩性 (FGS) 的渐进式压缩在面向机器的编码器中尚未被探索。
Method: 提出 PICM-Net，基于 trit-plane coding 构建；采用空间频率调制适配器 (SFMA) 和超先验合成低秩适配器 (HSLoRA) 适配机器感知，并结合渐进解码感知训练；另设计自适应解码控制器，在推理时根据当前适宜度与期望置信度动态决定所需解码层级。
Result: 大量实验表明，PICM-Net 在维持强下游分类性能的同时，实现了高效且自适应的渐进式传输；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 任务驱动的适配会改变渐进传输中的符号优先级，作者通过代码开源支持后续研究。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: General OOD Detection via Model-aware and Subspace-aware Variable Priority
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is essential for determining when a supervised model encounters inputs that differ meaningfully from its training distribution. While widely studied in classification, OOD detection for regression and survival analysis remains limited due to the absence of discrete labels and the challenge of quantifying predictive uncertainty. We introduce a framework for OOD detection that is simultaneously model aware and subspace aware, and that embeds variable prioritization directly into the detection step. The method uses the fitted predictor to construct localized neighborhoods around each test case that emphasize the features driving the model's learned relationship and downweight directions that are less relevant to prediction. It produces OOD scores without relying on global distance metrics or estimating the full feature density. The framework is applicable across outcome types, and in our implementation we use random forests, where the rule structure yields transparent neighborhoods and effective scoring. Experiments on synthetic and real data benchmarks designed to isolate functional shifts show consistent improvements over existing methods. We further demonstrate the approach in an esophageal cancer survival study, where distribution shifts related to lymphadenectomy identify patterns relevant to surgical guidelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种同时具备模型感知和子空间感知的OOD检测框架，将变量优先级直接嵌入检测过程，面向回归和生存分析等缺少离散标签的任务。方法利用已拟合的预测器为每个测试样本构建局部邻域，强调驱动模型学习关系的特征方向并弱化与预测无关的方向，无需全局距离度量或完整特征密度估计。在合成和真实数据基准上一致优于现有方法，并在食管癌生存研究中展示了与淋巴结清扫相关的分布偏移分析。
Motivation: OOD检测在分类中研究广泛，但回归和生存分析因缺乏离散标签且预测不确定性难以量化，相关研究仍然有限。
Method: 提出模型感知且子空间感知的OOD检测框架，使用拟合的预测器构建针对每个测试样本的局部邻域，在检测步骤中嵌入变量优先级；实现上采用随机森林，利用其规则结构提供透明的邻域和有效的评分。
Result: 在专门隔离功能偏移（functional shift）的合成和真实数据基准上，该方法一致优于现有方法；在食管癌生存研究中，与淋巴结清扫相关的分布偏移识别出与手术指南相关的模式。
Conclusion: 该框架适用于多种结局类型，不依赖全局距离度量或完整特征密度估计；摘要未明确讨论方法局限。

papers.title: Multilingual Agent-Based World Modeling for Social Science
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent role-playing has recently shown promise for studying social behavior with language agents, but existing simulations are mostly monolingual without cross-lingual interaction, an essential property of real societies. We introduce MAWM, the first Multilingual Agent-based World Modeling framework that supports multi-turn multilingual interactions among generative agents with diverse sociolinguistic profiles. MAWM enables two modes of analysis: (i) global public opinion modeling, which tracks how attitudes toward open-domain survey questions evolve across languages and cultures, and (ii) media influence and information diffusion, via autonomous news agents that dynamically generate content and shape user behavior. To ground the simulation in realistic population distributions, we construct the MAPS benchmark, which combines survey questions and demographic personas drawn from global population distributions. Experiments on simulation alignment, along with social science case studies on cultural assimilation and normative diffusion, show that native-language simulation better reflects real survey data than English-only simulation, and that the agent society in MAWM reproduces established sociocultural phenomena and highlights the value of multilingual simulation as an alternative interpretable tool for computational social science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAWM，据称是首个多语言智能体世界建模框架，支持具有不同社会语言特征的生成式智能体之间进行多轮多语言交互。框架支持两种分析模式：面向开放域调查问题的全球公众意见建模，以及通过自主新闻智能体动态生成内容并影响用户行为的媒体影响与信息扩散分析。作者还构建了结合全球人口分布调查问题与人口统计学人格的 MAPS 基准，实验显示母语模拟比纯英语模拟更贴合真实调查数据，并复现了文化同化与规范扩散等社会文化现象。
Motivation: 现有基于语言智能体的多智能体角色扮演研究大多局限于单语环境，缺乏真实社会所必备的跨语言交互能力，限制了其作为社会行为研究工具的适用性。
Method: 提出 MAWM 多语言智能体世界建模框架，赋予智能体多样化的社会语言特征并进行多轮多语言交互；提供全球公众意见建模和媒体影响/信息扩散两种分析模式；构建 MAPS 基准，将全球人口分布中的调查问题与人口统计学人格相结合以支撑模拟。
Result: 实验表明，母语模拟相比英语单一模拟能更好地反映真实调查数据；MAWM 中的智能体社会能够复现已确立的社会文化现象（cultural assimilation 与 normative diffusion），说明多语言模拟的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多语言模拟可作为计算社会科学中一种可解释的替代工具，用于研究跨语言、跨文化的社会现象。

papers.title: Mitigating Barren Plateaus in Quantum Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model
papers.abstract_en: Quantum generative models exploit quantum superposition and entanglement to enhance learning efficiency for both classical and quantum data. Recently, inspired by classical diffusion frameworks, the quantum denoising diffusion probabilistic model has emerged as a powerful tool for learning correlated noise models, many-body phases, and topological data structures. However, we demonstrate that this framework is currently restricted to small-scale systems. As the system size increases, a severe barren plateau problem emerges, fundamentally limiting the model's scalability. We provide rigorous theoretical proofs and experimental validation to identify the origin of this barren plateau, distinct from previously known causes. To restore trainability, we introduce an enhanced architecture that effectively mitigates the barren plateau phenomenon and guarantees the model's trainability in the tested settings. Building on this architecture, we further propose a conditional quantum denoising diffusion probabilistic model, capable of generating ground states based on Hamiltonian parameters, expanding the utility of quantum generative models for complex quantum state preparation to a certain extent. Our approach not only holds the potential to address the scalability and trainability bottlenecks of quantum diffusion models, but also provides a robust tool for exploring complex quantum matter and state preparation in the NISQ era.
papers.journal_ref: Physical Review A 114, 022418, August, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究量子去噪扩散概率模型（quantum denoising diffusion probabilistic model）的可扩展性瓶颈，指出随系统规模增大会出现严重的贫瘠高原（barren plateau）问题。作者通过严格理论证明和实验验证了该贫瘠高原的来源，提出一种增强架构以缓解该问题并保证测试设置下的可训练性，并进一步发展出条件量子去噪扩散概率模型，可根据哈密顿参数生成基态。
Motivation: 量子生成模型利用量子叠加和纠缠提升学习效率，但量子去噪扩散概率模型目前仅适用于小规模系统；系统规模增大时会出现严重的贫瘠高原，从根本上限制模型的可扩展性。
Method: 作者先给出严谨的理论证明和实验验证，说明该贫瘠高原的来源与以往已知原因不同；随后引入增强架构来缓解贫瘠高原现象，并在此架构基础上提出条件量子去噪扩散概率模型。
Result: 摘要报告该增强架构能有效缓解贫瘠高原并保证测试设置下的可训练性；条件模型可以依据哈密顿参数生成基态，从而在一定程度上扩展量子生成模型用于复杂量子态制备的能力。
Conclusion: 该方法有潜力解决量子扩散模型在可扩展性和可训练性方面的瓶颈，并为 NISQ 时代探索复杂量子物质和量子态制备提供工具。

papers.title: The Theory of Strategic Evolution: Games with Endogenous Players and the Seven Laws of Strategic Replicators
papers.abstract_en: Von Neumann founded both game theory and the theory of self-reproducing automata, but the two programs never merged. Rational players do not control their replication, and replicators do not choose strategically. Contemporary AI systems expose this gap: they optimize objectives, yet the population of AI systems is not fixed but expands and contracts based on performance. When capital can spawn capital, we need a theory that captures both rationality and replication. The Theory of Strategic Evolution analyzes strategic replicators: entities that optimize under resource constraints and spawn copies of themselves. The framework is organized around Seven Laws: 1. Strategic Selection: Mean fitness serves as a Lyapunov function; dominated types are eliminated. 2. ESDI Characterization: Equilibria exist, are generically finite, and satisfy Nash-KKT-LP equivalence. 3. H-$γ$ Stability: Multi-level systems are stable iff the spectral radius $ρ(Γ) < 1$. 4. G$\infty$ Closure: A unique maximal class of safe modifications exists and is closed under composition. 5. Constitutional Duality: Shadow prices implement any frontier allocation; welfare theorems hold. 6. Alignment Impossibility: Full reachability destroys Lyapunov structure; alignment requires bounded modification. 7. Hopf Transition: At critical coupling, systems undergo supercritical bifurcation producing limit cycles. Applications range from AI deployment dynamics to institutional design. The framework shows why "personality engineering" fails under selection pressure and identifies constitutional constraints necessary for stable alignment. The Lean 4 formalization verifies every result with zero custom axioms. The framework generates empirical predictions that remain untested. The paper and its repository are therefore a prototype kernel: an instrument for studying strategic replicators, not a set of results about the world.
papers.comment: 171 pages. Formalized in Lean 4 with Mathlib: 240 theorems in the elaborated environment, 141 audited headline results, cold-compiling from a clean checkout with zero custom axioms. Source, theorem-by-theorem contract, and reproducible axiom audit: https://github.com/selfreferencing/TSE_Formal. Companion to Agentic Capital
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“战略进化理论”(Theory of Strategic Evolution)，研究在资源约束下优化并复制自身的“战略复制者”(strategic replicators)，并以七条法则组织该框架：战略选择、ESDI 刻画、H-γ 稳定性、G∞ 闭包、宪法对偶、对齐不可能性以及 Hopf 转变。作者用 Lean 4 与 Mathlib 对结果做了形式化验证（240 个定理、141 个审计头号结果、零自定义公理），并将应用指向 AI 部署动态与制度设计。摘要同时强调该框架是研究战略复制者的原型内核，其经验预测尚未测试。
Motivation: 冯·诺依曼同时创立了博弈论与自复制自动机理论，但两者从未融合：理性玩家不控制自身复制，复制者也不做战略选择。当代 AI 系统凸显了这一缺口——它们优化目标，但种群规模会随性能扩张或收缩；当资本可以产生资本时，需要一种同时刻画理性与复制的理论。
Method: 提出战略进化理论框架，围绕七条法则构建：战略选择（平均适应度作为 Lyapunov 函数，被支配类型被淘汰）、ESDI 刻画（均衡存在且一般有限，满足 Nash-KKT-LP 等价）、H-γ 稳定性（谱半径 ρ(Γ) < 1 时多层系统稳定）、G∞ 闭包、宪法对偶（影子价格实现前沿分配）、对齐不可能性（完全可达性破坏 Lyapunov 结构，对齐需要有界修改）以及 Hopf 转变（临界耦合下超临界分岔产生极限环）。
Result: 摘要报告该理论的全部结果已在 Lean 4 中形式化验证，包含 240 个定理、141 个审计头号结果，可从干净检出零自定义公理编译。框架还产生了一些尚未测试的经验预测。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架是“原型内核”(prototype kernel)，是研究战略复制者的工具，而非关于世界的既定结论集；经验预测仍未验证。框架还解释了为何“人格工程”(personality engineering) 在选择压力下失败，并识别出稳定对齐所需的宪法约束。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Modal Scene Graph with Kolmogorov-Arnold Experts for Audio-Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a novel Multi-Modal Scene Graph with Kolmogorov-Arnold Expert Network for Audio-Visual Question Answering (SHRIKE). The task aims to mimic human reasoning by extracting and fusing information from audio-visual scenes, with the main challenge being the identification of question-relevant cues from complex audio-visual content. Existing methods fail to capture the structural information within videos and suffer from insufficient fine-grained modeling of multi-modal features. To address these issues, we are the first to introduce a new multi-modal scene graph that explicitly models objects and their relationships as a visually grounded, structured representation of the audio-visual scene, yielding 461,292 relation triplets over 9,288 musical performance videos. Furthermore, we design a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN)-based Mixture of Experts (MoE) to enhance the expressive power of the temporal integration stage. This enables more fine-grained modeling of cross-modal interactions within the question-aware fused audio-visual representation, capturing richer and more nuanced patterns and improving temporal reasoning performance. We evaluate the model on the established MUSIC-AVQA and MUSIC-AVQA v2 benchmarks, where it achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching 78.14% average accuracy on MUSIC-AVQA, surpassing the previous best method QA-TIGER and ranking first under all four configurations of MUSIC-AVQA v2.0. Code and model checkpoints will be publicly released at https://github.com/feel12348/SHRIKE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SHRIKE，一个用于音频-视觉问答 (Audio-Visual Question Answering) 的多模态场景图与 Kolmogorov-Arnold 专家网络方法。作者首次引入显式建模物体及其关系的多模态场景图，生成 461,292 个关系三元组，覆盖 9,288 个音乐表演视频；并设计基于 KAN 的 Mixture of Experts (MoE) 来增强时序整合阶段的表达力。在 MUSIC-AVQA 和 MUSIC-AVQA v2 上取得 SOTA，MUSIC-AVQA 平均准确率 78.14%，超过此前最佳方法 QA-TIGER。
Motivation: 现有方法难以从复杂音视频内容中识别与问题相关的线索，无法捕获视频内部的结构信息，且对多模态特征的细粒度建模不足。该任务旨在模仿人类推理，从音视频场景中提取并融合信息，因此需要更结构化和细粒度的建模方式。
Method: 首次引入多模态场景图 (multi-modal scene graph)，将音视频场景显式建模为视觉接地 (visually grounded) 的结构化对象及关系表示；同时设计基于 Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) 的 Mixture of Experts (MoE)，用于问题感知融合后的音视频表示中更细粒度地建模跨模态交互，提升时序推理能力。
Result: 在 MUSIC-AVQA 上达到 78.14% 平均准确率，超过此前最佳方法 QA-TIGER；在 MUSIC-AVQA v2.0 的全部四种配置下均排名第一。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式多模态场景图与 KAN 基 MoE 的组合能带来更强的时序与跨模态推理性能，代码和模型权重将公开发布。
