papers.title: Integrating RCTs, RWD, AI/ML and Statistics: Next-Generation Evidence Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs)have been the cornerstone of clinical evidence; however, their cost, duration, and restrictive eligibility criteria limit power and external validity. Studies using real-world data (RWD), historically considered less reliable for establishing causality, are now recognized as an important source of real-world evidence (RWE). In parallel, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) are increasingly used throughout the drug development process, providing scalability and flexibility but also presenting challenges in interpretability and statistical rigor. This Perspective argues that the future of evidence generation will not depend on RCTs versus RWD, or statistics versus AI/ML, but on their principled integration under a statistical evidence framework that clarifies estimands, evaluates data fitness, controls bias, quantifies uncertainty, and determines when evidence is strong enough to support decisions. Building on the Causal Roadmap for high-quality real-world evidence, we present a six-step statistical roadmap for integrative evidence synthesis and organize the discussion around five core questions that statisticians must confront: when RWD is fit for causal use and when it is not; what AI genuinely contributes across the evidence lifecycle; what remains distinctly statistical and indispensable; how to build trustworthy end-to-end evidence systems in pharmaceutical, regulatory, and industry settings; and how statistical training should evolve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇Perspective文章，主张下一代证据生成不应聚焦于RCT与RWD或统计学与AI/ML的对立，而应在统计证据框架下进行原则性整合。作者基于Causal Roadmap提出六步统计路线图用于整合性证据合成，并围绕五个核心问题组织讨论：RWD何时适合因果使用、AI在证据生命周期中的真正贡献、哪些统计内容不可替代、如何构建可信端到端证据系统以及统计培训应如何演变。
Motivation: 传统RCT成本高、周期长且入排标准严格，限制统计功效和外部效度；RWD虽曾被质疑因果可靠性，现在被视为真实世界证据的重要来源，同时AI/ML在药物开发中被广泛使用但面临可解释性和统计严谨性挑战，因此需要原则性的整合框架。
Method: 提出一个整合RCT、RWD、AI/ML和统计学的六步统计路线图，用于整合性证据合成（integrative evidence synthesis），并围绕五个核心问题展开。该框架基于Causal Roadmap，强调明确estimands、评估数据适用性、控制偏倚、量化不确定性和判断证据强度。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实证或数值结果；本文以Perspective形式提出证据生成范式的核心主张，即未来取决于原则性整合而非方法对立，并给出六步路线图与五个核心问题。
Conclusion: 作者认为统计学家必须直面五个核心问题，统计培训也应相应演进，以在制药、监管和行业场景中构建可信赖的端到端证据系统；该路线图被视为高质量真实世界证据Causal Roadmap的延伸。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sparse corruption in low-rank matrix inference: the PCA benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a standard tool for extracting a low-rank signal from noisy observations. It is known that applying PCA to a rank-one signal corrupted by a dense, homogeneous noise, in the large matrix size limit, the celebrated BBP transition occurs, where the emergence of an outlying eigenvalue and the alignment of the corresponding eigenvector occur at the same critical signal strength. Here we study the case of sparse noise corruption. The noise matrix is modelled as the adjacency matrix of a weighted undirected graph with finite average connectivity. Using the replica method, we analytically compute the typical top eigenvalue, the top eigenvector component density, and the squared overlap with the signal, through recursive distributional equations solved by population dynamics. We identify two signal-strength transitions as functions of graph connectivity: $θ_{\rm crit}$, marking signal recovery by the top eigenvector and generalising the BBP transition, and $θ_{\rm b}$, where the signal-related eigenvalue detaches from the bulk. For noise with nonzero mean, these transitions need not coincide because of a structural sparse-graph outlier, leading to a discontinuous transition in the squared overlap with the top eigenvector. The same top-eigenpair formalism also predicts the overlap of the signal with the eigenvector associated with the second largest eigenvalue when the signal eigenvalue is an outlier but remains below the structural outlier, where the transition is continuous. We specialise the equations to Poissonian and Random Regular degree distributions, recover dense-noise results in the large-connectivity limit, and validate the theory by numerical diagonalisation of large matrices.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 8 figures. Analysis of a second transition: derivation and figures added, references added, typos fixed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究低秩矩阵推断中稀疏噪声破坏的问题，以 PCA 为基准。将噪声矩阵建模为有限平均连通度的加权无向图邻接矩阵，用复制方法 (replica method) 结合 population dynamics 解析计算典型最大特征值、特征向量分量密度以及特征向量与信号的平方重叠。识别出两个信号强度转变：θ_crit 推广了稠密噪声下的 BBP 转变，θ_b 对应信号特征值脱离谱块；对非零均值噪声，二者因稀疏图的结构性离群值而不必重合，导致平方重叠出现不连续转变。理论经大矩阵数值对角化验证。
Motivation: 经典 PCA 在稠密均匀噪声下存在 BBP 转变，其特征值离群与特征向量对齐在同一临界信号强度发生；稀疏噪声破坏可能打破这种对应关系，需要刻画稀疏图结构引入的额外转变。
Method: 将噪声矩阵建模为加权无向图的邻接矩阵，具有有限平均连通度；利用复制方法推导递归分布方程并由 population dynamics 求解，得到典型最大特征值、特征向量分量密度和与信号的平方重叠。对泊松 (Poissonian) 与随机正则 (Random Regular) 度分布特化方程，并在大连通极限下恢复稠密噪声结果。
Result: 识别出两个转变 θ_crit 和 θ_b；对非零均值噪声，由于稀疏图的结构性离群值，二者不必一致，平方重叠随信号强度呈不连续转变。当信号特征值低于结构离群值时，第二最大特征值对应特征向量与信号的平方重叠转变是连续的。理论由大矩阵数值对角化验证。
Conclusion: 摘要强调稀疏噪声下的 PCA 推断不能用单一的 BBP 型临界点描述，需考虑稀疏图结构性离群带来的不连续转变；所建立的解析框架适用于有限平均连通度的图噪声模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Floating-Point Neural Network Verification at the Software Level
papers.abstract_en: The behaviour of neural network components must be proven correct before deployment in safety-critical systems. Unfortunately, existing neural network verification techniques cannot certify the absence of faults at the software level. In this paper, we show how to specify and verify that neural networks are safe, by explicitly reasoning about their floating-point implementation. In doing so, we construct NeuroCodeBench 2.0, a benchmark comprising 912 neural network verification examples that cover activation functions, common layers, and full neural networks of up to 170K parameters. Our verification suite is written in plain C and is compatible with the format of the International Competition on Software Verification (SV-COMP). Thanks to it, we can conduct the first rigorous evaluation of eight state-of-the-art software verifiers on neural network code. The results show that existing automated verification tools can correctly solve an average of 11% of our benchmark, while producing around 3% incorrect verdicts. At the same time, a historical analysis reveals that the release of our benchmark has already had a significantly positive impact on the latter.
papers.comment: Under submission to Automated Software Engineering
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在软件层面显式验证神经网络浮点实现的方法，而不是在抽象数学层面验证。作者据此构建了 NeuroCodeBench 2.0 基准，包含 912 个神经网络验证示例（涵盖激活函数、常见层和最多 170K 参数的全网络），全部用普通 C 语言编写并兼容 SV-COMP 格式。基于该基准，论文首次对八款软件验证器在神经网络代码上的表现进行系统评估。
Motivation: 现有神经网络验证技术通常忽略浮点实现细节，无法在软件层面证明网络代码不存在故障；而对安全关键系统而言，部署前必须证明实际软件组件的行为正确。
Method: 展示如何通过显式推理神经网络的浮点实现来规约和验证安全性，并构建 NeuroCodeBench 2.0 基准：包含 912 个用普通 C 编写的验证示例，覆盖激活函数、常见层以及参数规模最高达 170K 的完整神经网络，且兼容国际软件验证竞赛 (SV-COMP) 的输入格式。
Result: 论文对八款最先进软件验证器进行了首次严格评测：它们在基准上平均只能正确求解 11% 的示例，同时约 3% 的判定结果是错误的。此外，历史分析表明，该基准的发布已经对验证器后续表现的提升产生了显著的正面影响。
Conclusion: 软件层面的神经网络验证可被明确规约和评测，但现有自动化工具仍远未达到可靠水平；NeuroCodeBench 2.0 可作为该方向的评测基座，并已开始推动验证工具的改进。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Embedding Trust: Semantic Isotropy Predicts Nonfactuality in Long-Form Text Generation
papers.abstract_en: To deploy large language models (LLMs) in high-stakes application domains that require substantively accurate responses to open-ended prompts, we need reliable, computationally inexpensive methods that assess the trustworthiness of long-form responses generated by LLMs. However, existing approaches often rely on claim-by-claim fact-checking, which is computationally expensive and brittle in long-form responses to open-ended prompts. In this work, we introduce semantic isotropy -- the degree of uniformity across normalized text embeddings on the unit sphere -- and use it to assess the trustworthiness of long-form responses generated by LLMs. To do so, we generate several long-form responses, embed them, and estimate the level of semantic isotropy of these responses as the angular dispersion of the embeddings on the unit sphere. We find that higher semantic isotropy -- that is, greater embedding dispersion -- reliably signals lower factual consistency across samples. Our approach requires no labeled data, no fine-tuning, and no hyperparameter selection, and can be used with open- or closed-weight embedding models. Across multiple domains, our method consistently outperforms existing aggregate trust signals in predicting nonfactuality using only a handful of samples, offering a practical, low-cost first-pass signal that complements claim-level verification in real-world LLM workflows.
papers.comment: Published in Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出语义各向同性 (semantic isotropy) 作为评估大语言模型 (LLM) 长文本生成可信度的指标。作者对多个长文本响应进行嵌入，并用单位球面上嵌入的角分散度估计语义各向同性；实验发现越高的语义各向同性 (即嵌入越分散) 越可靠地预示跨样本的事实不一致性。该方法无需标注数据、微调或超参数选择，可用开源或闭源嵌入模型。
Motivation: 在高风险应用场景中部署 LLM 需要可靠且计算廉价的方法来评估开放式长文本响应的可信度，而现有方法通常依赖逐条事实核查，计算昂贵且对开放式长文本响应十分脆弱。
Method: 生成多个长文本响应，将其嵌入，并计算嵌入在单位球面上的角分散度作为语义各向同性；以更高分散度作为非事实性 (nonfactuality) 的预测信号，无需标注数据、微调或超参数选择。
Result: 在多个领域上，该方法仅用少量样本即可在预测非事实性方面持续优于现有的聚合可信度信号，可作为补充逐句核实的低成本首轮信号。
Conclusion: 摘要强调语义各向同性是一种实用、低成本的初步可信度信号，可以补充真实 LLM 工作流中的逐条级验证。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.motivation: 在高风险应用场景中部署 LLM 需要可靠且计算廉价的方法来评估开放式长文本响应的可信度，而现有方法通常依赖逐条事实核查，计算昂贵且对开放式长文本响应十分脆弱。
summary_sections.method: 生成多个长文本响应，将其嵌入，并计算嵌入在单位球面上的角分散度作为语义各向同性；以更高分散度作为非事实性 (nonfactuality) 的预测信号，无需标注数据、微调或超参数选择。
summary_sections.result: 在多个领域上，该方法仅用少量样本即可在预测非事实性方面持续优于现有的聚合可信度信号，可作为补充逐句核实的低成本首轮信号。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调语义各向同性是一种实用、低成本的初步可信度信号，可以补充真实 LLM 工作流中的逐条级验证。

papers.title: Learning to Triage Vulnerability Reports from Program Analysis: An Empirical Study in Node.js
papers.abstract_en: Program analysis tools often produce large volumes of candidate vulnerability reports that require costly manual review, creating a practical challenge: how can security analysts prioritize the reports most likely to be true vulnerabilities? This paper investigates whether machine learning can be applied to prioritizing vulnerabilities reported by program analysis tools. We focus on Node$.$js packages and collect a benchmark of 1,883 Node$.$js packages, each containing one reported ACE or ACI vulnerability. We evaluate a variety of machine learning approaches, including classical models, graph neural networks (GNNs), large language models (LLMs), and hybrid models that combine GNNs and LLMs, trained on data derived from program analysis tool outputs (NodeMedic-FINE in our case study). The top LLM achieves $F_{1}{=}0.915$, while the best provenance-graph-based method achieves $F_{1}{=}0.904$. On the reports that the upstream tool flags but cannot automatically confirm, at a target of recovering 90% of the exploitable reports, the leading model eliminates 75% of the benign reports from manual review. If the best model is tuned to operate at a precision level of 0.8 (i.e., allowing 20% false positives among all warnings), our approach can report 99.2% of exploitable taint flows while missing only 0.8%, demonstrating strong potential for real-world vulnerability triage.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026). The version of record is available at https://doi.org/10.1145/3832783.3837503
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否用机器学习对程序分析工具产生的大量候选漏洞报告做优先级排序，以减少人工审核成本。作者以 Node.js 为对象，构建了包含 1,883 个包的基准，每个包含一个 ACE 或 ACI 漏洞报告，并基于工具输出（案例中为 NodeMedic-FINE）评估了经典模型、图神经网络 (GNN)、大语言模型 (LLM) 以及 GNN+LLM 混合模型。结果显示最优 LLM 达到 F1=0.915，最优基于 provenance 图的方法达到 F1=0.904，并能在保留 90% 可利用报告的前提下剔除 75% 的良性报告。
Motivation: 程序分析工具常产生大量候选漏洞报告，人工核查成本高昂，安全分析师面临如何优先处理最可能是真实漏洞的报告这一实际挑战。
Method: 作者收集 1,883 个 Node.js 包的基准数据（每个包含一个被报告的 ACE 或 ACI 漏洞），训练并评估多种机器学习方法，包括经典模型、图神经网络、大语言模型以及结合 GNN 与 LLM 的混合模型，训练数据来自程序分析工具输出 (NodeMedic-FINE)。
Result: 最优 LLM 取得 F1=0.915，最佳 provenance-graph 方法取得 F1=0.904；在目标为找回 90% 可利用报告时，领先模型可从人工审核中剔除 75% 的良性报告；若将模型调到精度 0.8，则可报告 99.2% 的可利用污点流 (taint flows)，仅漏掉 0.8%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为机器学习可以有效地对程序分析工具报告的漏洞进行分流 (triage)，具有用于真实世界漏洞优先级排序的潜力。

papers.title: Adversarial Concept Distillation for One-Step Diffusion Personalization
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in accelerating text-to-image diffusion models enables high-fidelity synthesis within a single denoising step. However, customizing the fast one-step models remains challenging, as existing methods consistently fail to produce acceptable results, underscoring the need for new methodologies to personalize one-step models. Therefore, we propose One-step Personalized Adversarial Distillation (OPAD), a framework that combines teacher-student distillation with adversarial supervision. A multi-step diffusion model serves as the teacher, while a one-step student model is jointly trained with it. The student learns from alignment losses that preserve consistency with the teacher and from adversarial losses that align its output with real image distributions. Beyond one-step personalization, we further observe that the student's efficient generation and adversarially enriched representations provide valuable feedback to improve the teacher model, forming a collaborative learning stage. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OPAD is the first approach to deliver reliable, high-quality personalization for one-step diffusion models; in contrast, prior methods largely fail and produce severe failure cases, while OPAD preserves single-step efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 One-step Personalized Adversarial Distillation (OPAD) 框架，用于一步扩散模型 (one-step diffusion models) 的个性化定制。该框架结合多步扩散教师模型与一步学生模型的联合训练，学生通过一致性对齐损失和对抗损失学习，并观察到学生的高效生成与对抗增强表示可反馈改进教师，形成协作学习。大量实验表明 OPAD 是首个能在一歩模型上实现可靠高质量个性化定制的方法，而此前方法大多产生严重失败案例。
Motivation: 当前加速文本到图像扩散模型已能在单步去噪内实现高保真合成，但定制这类快速一步模型仍很困难，现有方法无法给出可接受结果，因此需要针对一步模型的新个性化方法论。
Method: 提出 OPAD 框架，将教师-学生蒸馏与对抗性监督结合：多步扩散模型作为教师，一步学生模型与其联合训练；学生同时优化保持与教师一致性的对齐损失和使输出贴合真实图像分布的对抗损失。此外，利用学生的生成效率与对抗增强表示对教师进行反向改进，构成协作学习阶段。
Result: 实验显示 OPAD 是首个实现一步扩散模型可靠、高质量个性化的方法；相比之下，先前方法大多失败并产生严重失败案例，而 OPAD 保持单步生成效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 OPAD 解决了一步扩散模型个性化中现有方法失效的问题，并通过学生到教师的反馈实现了协作改进；但未提及方法自身的局限性。

papers.title: MoE-Prism: Disentangling Monolithic Experts for Elastic MoE Services via Model-System Co-Designs
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scales model capacity through sparse activation, and is becoming an important architecture for large language models (LLMs). However, existing MoE serving systems typically execute all requests under a fixed routing configuration, limiting their ability to exploit heterogeneous computation requirements across requests. Routing top-$k$, which determines the number of routed experts activated per token, directly controls routed-expert computation and provides a natural mechanism for request-level compute elasticity. Realizing this capability, however, requires finer-grained routing units and efficient runtime execution for heterogeneous routing budgets. We present \textsc{MoE-Prism}, a model and system support framework for request-level compute elasticity in MoE serving. \textsc{MoE-Prism}decomposes monolithic experts into fine-grained sub-experts to expose denser routing operating points and provides a $k$-aware serving runtime that effectively serves heterogeneous routing budgets under both throughput-oriented and latency-sensitive workloads. We implement \textsc{MoE-Prism} on top of vLLM and evaluate it on three representative MoE models. \textsc{MoE-Prism} expands the number of available routing operating points by $4\times$, improves offline inference throughput by up to 33.9\%, and reduces online serving TTFT under heterogeneous workloads. These results demonstrate practical elastic MoE serving with request-level routing targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MoE-Prism，一个面向 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 服务系统的模型-系统协同设计框架。它把整体专家 (monolithic experts) 分解为细粒度子专家 (sub-experts)，以暴露更多路由操作点，并设计 k-aware 服务运行时来支持请求级路由预算的异构性。在 vLLM 上实现并在三个代表性 MoE 模型上评估，结果显示可用路由操作点数量扩展 4 倍，离线推理吞吐最高提升 33.9%，在线服务 TTFT 得到降低。
Motivation: 现有 MoE 服务系统通常对所有请求执行固定路由配置，难以利用请求间异构的计算需求。路由 top-k 直接控制每个 token 激活的专家数量，是实现请求级计算弹性的自然机制，但现有系统缺少更细粒度的路由单元和能处理异构路由预算的高效运行时。
Method: MoE-Prism 将单一整体专家分解为细粒度子专家，从而提供更密集的路由操作点；同时实现一个 k-aware 服务运行时，面向吞吐导向和延迟敏感两类工作负载，有效服务异构路由预算。系统基于 vLLM 实现。
Result: 在三个代表性 MoE 模型上的评估显示，MoE-Prism 将可用路由操作点数量扩展 4 倍，离线推理吞吐最高提升 33.9%，并减少异构工作负载下的在线服务 TTFT (time-to-first-token)。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该工作展示了具备请求级路由目标的实用弹性 MoE 服务。局限性等细节未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: NeuroAda: Activating Each Neuron's Potential for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods primarily fall into two categories: addition-based and selective in-situ adaptation. The former, such as LoRA, introduce additional modules to adapt the model to downstream tasks, offering strong memory efficiency. However, their representational capacity is often limited, making them less suitable for fine-grained adaptation. In contrast, the latter directly fine-tunes a carefully chosen subset of the original model parameters, allowing for more precise and effective adaptation, but at the cost of significantly increased memory consumption. To reconcile this trade-off, we propose NeuroAda, a novel PEFT method that enables fine-grained model finetuning while maintaining high memory efficiency. Our approach first identifies important parameters (i.e., connections within the network) as in selective adaptation, and then introduces bypass connections for these selected parameters. During finetuning, only the bypass connections are updated, leaving the original model parameters frozen. Empirical results on 23+ tasks spanning both natural language generation and understanding demonstrate that NeuroAda achieves state-of-the-art performance with as little as $\leq \textbf{0.02}\%$ trainable parameters, while reducing CUDA memory usage by up to 60%. We release our code here: https://github.com/FightingFighting/NeuroAda.git.
papers.journal_ref: EMNLP 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuroAda，一种参数高效微调 (PEFT) 方法，旨在兼顾精细适应能力与高内存效率。方法先识别网络中重要参数，再为这些参数引入旁路连接 (bypass connections)，微调时仅更新旁路、保持原模型参数冻结。摘要在 23+ 个自然语言生成与理解任务上报告了 SOTA 效果，可训练参数低至 ≤0.02%，CUDA 内存占用最高降低 60%。
Motivation: 现有 PEFT 主要分两类：基于添加的方法（如 LoRA）内存高效但表示能力受限，不擅长细粒度适应；选择性原位微调直接调整部分原始参数，适应更精准但内存开销显著增加。本文针对这一权衡缺口提出新方法。
Method: NeuroAda 先像选择性适应那样识别重要参数（网络中的连接），然后为这些被选参数引入旁路连接。微调过程中仅更新旁路连接，原始模型参数保持冻结，从而在细粒度微调的同时维持高内存效率。
Result: 摘要在 23+ 个涵盖自然语言生成与理解的任务上报告 NeuroAda 达到 SOTA 性能，仅需 ≤0.02% 可训练参数，并将 CUDA 内存使用量降低多达 60%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 NeuroAda 通过只更新所选参数旁路连接的方式，调和了添加式 PEFT 容量不足与选择性微调内存开销大的矛盾，实现了高内存效率下的细粒度微调。

papers.title: VisionSelector: End-to-End Learnable Visual Token Compression for Efficient Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) encounter significant computational and memory bottlenecks from the massive number of visual tokens generated by high-resolution images or multi-image inputs. Previous token compression techniques are often constrained by heuristic rules that risk discarding critical information. They may suffer from biases, such as attention sinks, that lead to sharp performance drops under aggressive compression ratios. To address these limitations, we reformulate token compression as a lightweight plug-and-play framework and turn it into an end-to-end learnable decision process. Specifically, we propose VisionSelector, a scorer module decoupled from the MLLM backbone that incorporates a differentiable Top-K mechanism and a curriculum annealing strategy to bridge the training-inference gap, enabling efficient and adaptive token selection across various compression rates. Remarkably lightweight with only 12.85M trainable parameters, VisionSelector demonstrates generalization across various compression rates and adaptively identifies critical tokens. This leads to superior performance across the evaluated compression budgets, evidenced by preserving 100% performance on MME with a 30% retention budget, outperforming representative heuristic baselines by 12.14 percentage points at a 10% retention budget, and doubling prefill speed. Our code is available at https://github.com/JulietChoo/VisionSelector .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VisionSelector，将多模态大语言模型中的视觉token压缩重构为端到端可学习的决策过程。通过一个从MLLM主干解耦的轻量评分模块，结合可微Top-K机制和课程退火策略来弥合训练与推理的差距，实现跨压缩率的自适应token选择。摘要报告参数仅12.85M，在30%保留预算下MME性能保持100%，在10%保留预算下比代表性启发式基线高12.14个百分点，prefill速度翻倍。
Motivation: MLLM因高分辨率图像或多图输入产生大量视觉token，造成显著的计算和内存瓶颈。现有压缩方法依赖启发式规则，可能丢弃关键信息，并受注意力汇聚(attention sinks)等偏差影响，在高压缩率下性能急剧下降。
Method: 提出VisionSelector，一个与MLLM主干解耦的评分器模块，包含可微Top-K机制和课程退火策略，将token压缩形式化为轻量即插即用的端到端可学习决策过程，支持不同压缩率下的高效自适应token选择。
Result: 摘要报告仅12.85M可训练参数；在30%保留预算下MME性能保持100%，在10%保留预算下比代表性启发式基线高12.14个百分点，prefill速度提升一倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在不同压缩预算下均表现优越，且能泛化到多种压缩率并自适应识别关键token，代码已公开。

papers.title: SUM-AgriVLN: Spatial Understanding Memory for Agricultural Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Agricultural robots are emerging as powerful assistants across a wide range of agricultural tasks, nevertheless, they are still heavily relying on manual operations or fixed railways for movement. The A2A benchmark and the AgriVLN method pioneeringly extended Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) to the agricultural domain, successfully navigating agricultural robots from starting points to target positions following natural language instructions, while we observed a limitation: In practical agricultural scenarios, users often give repetitive instructions, but AgriVLN treats every instruction as an independent episode, overlooking the potential to use past spatial memories to assist present episodes. To address this limitation, we propose the SUM module, which executes spatial understanding via 3D reconstructions and saves spatial memories via 2D representations from the past, thereby assisting the decision-maker to recall the spatial characteristics of the scenes in the present. We integrate it into the AgriVLN backbone to build the SUM-AgriVLN method. When evaluated on A2A, it effectively improves SR from 0.47 to 0.54 with only slight sacrifice on NE from 2.91 m to 2.93 m, demonstrating the state-of-the-art performance in the agricultural VLN domain. Code: https://github.com/AlexTraveling/SUM-AgriVLN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对农业场景下视觉-语言导航（VLN）中重复指令未被利用的问题，提出 SUM 模块：通过 3D 重建执行空间理解，并用 2D 表示保存过去场景的空间记忆，辅助当前回合的决策。将该模块集成进 AgriVLN 骨干得到 SUM-AgriVLN 方法，在 A2A 基准上 SR 从 0.47 提升到 0.54，NE 从 2.91 m 略增至 2.93 m。
Motivation: 农业机器人仍高度依赖人工操作或固定轨道，而既有农业 VLN 方法如 AgriVLN 将每条指令视为独立回合，忽略了实际场景中用户常重复指令、过去空间记忆可辅助当前导航这一机会。
Method: 提出 SUM 模块，用 3D 重建来执行空间理解，并以 2D 表示保存过去的空间记忆，使决策器能够回忆当前场景的空间特征；该模块被集成到 AgriVLN 骨干中构成 SUM-AgriVLN。
Result: 在 A2A 基准上，成功率 SR 从 0.47 提高到 0.54，导航误差 NE 仅从 2.91 m 小幅升至 2.93 m，摘要称其达到农业 VLN 领域的最优性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用过去回合的空间记忆可以有效提升农业 VLN 的导航成功率，并仅以极小的导航精度代价换取；代码已开源。

papers.title: Describe-to-Score: A text-guided framework for image complexity assessment
papers.abstract_en: Accurately assessing image complexity (IC) is essential for many vision tasks, yet existing approaches rely almost exclusively on visual features and therefore fail to capture the high-level semantics that humans often use when judging complexity. We introduce a multimodal perspective for IC modeling by integrating visual representations with caption-derived textual semantics. This integration enriches the representational space and provides complementary structural cues that are difficult to infer from vision alone. From an information theoretic and representation viewpoint, we offer an idealized analysis suggesting how semantic guidance can regularize the hypothesis space and support more stable generalization. We propose D2S (Describe-to-Score), a text-guided framework that uses caption-derived semantics only during training to regularize visual complexity modeling, while preserving a vision-only inference pipeline with no additional multimodal overhead at inference. Concretely, D2S transfers semantic structure into the visual branch through feature alignment and entropy distribution alignment, encouraging the visual encoder to internalize complexity-relevant semantic regularities. Experiments show that D2S achieves state-of-the-art performance on the IC9600 benchmark and remains competitive on no-reference image quality assessment (NR-IQA) tasks. Additional analyses further clarify the sample-imbalance issue in the small samples training setting and the distribution-shift limitations observed in cross-dataset transfer. Code is available at: https://github.com/xauat-liushipeng/D2S.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 D2S (Describe-to-Score)，一个用于图像复杂度评估 (image complexity assessment) 的文本引导框架。该框架只在训练阶段引入由图像标题 (caption) 派生的语义信息，通过与视觉分支的特征对齐和熵分布对齐来正则化视觉复杂度建模，推理时仍为纯视觉流程，不增加多模态开销。实验表明 D2S 在 IC9600 基准上达到最优性能，并在无参考图像质量评估 (NR-IQA) 任务上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有图像复杂度评估方法几乎只依赖视觉特征，难以捕捉人类判断复杂度时使用的高层语义信息。作者认为引入多模态语义可以丰富表示空间并提供仅靠视觉难以推断的结构性线索。
Method: 提出 D2S 框架，训练时利用字幕 (caption) 派生语义对视觉分支进行正则化：通过特征对齐 (feature alignment) 和熵分布对齐 (entropy distribution alignment) 将语义结构迁移到视觉编码器，使其内化与复杂度相关的语义规律；推理时保持纯视觉流程，无额外的多模态负载。
Result: 实验显示 D2S 在 IC9600 基准上达到当前最优 (state-of-the-art) 性能，并在无参考图像质量评估 (NR-IQA) 任务上保持竞争力。额外的分析还揭示了小样本训练中的样本不平衡问题以及跨数据集迁移中的分布偏移局限性。
Conclusion: 作者从信息论与表示学习的角度给出了理想化分析，说明语义引导可以正则化假设空间并支持更稳定的泛化；D2S 的代码已在 GitHub 公开。摘要也承认跨数据集迁移仍存在分布偏移限制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: An invertible generative model for forward and inverse problems
papers.abstract_en: We formulate inverse problems in a Bayesian framework and aim to train an invertible generative model that is capable of simulation (i.e., sampling from the likelihood) and inference (i.e., sampling from the posterior). We call such a generative model a Reversible Simulator. We first construct an explicit instance of a reversible simulator by combining lower and upper triangular normalizing flows associated with conditional sampling into a single invertible map. We then establish basic structural properties of this construction, investigate its non-uniqueness, and derive a variational formulation that enables the generative model to be trained directly from paired samples. Finally, we illustrate the proposed framework on analytically tractable and stylized numerical examples, demonstrating its potential as a unified approach to conditional generative modeling for forward and inverse problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可逆生成模型 Reversible Simulator，用于贝叶斯框架下的正问题与反问题：同一模型既能做仿真（从似然采样）又能做推断（从后验采样）。作者将条件采样对应的下三角与上三角归一化流（normalizing flows）组合成单一可逆映射，并给出其结构性质、非唯一性分析以及直接利用配对样本训练的变分公式。在解析可解和风格化数值示例上验证了该框架。
Motivation: 贝叶斯反问题通常需要同时处理前向模拟（似然采样）与后向推断（后验采样），而现有生成模型往往只覆盖其中一个方向。作者希望构造单一可逆生成模型，使仿真与推断共享同一参数化。
Method: 构造显式的 Reversible Simulator：将用于条件采样的下三角和上三角归一化流组合为一个可逆映射；推导变分公式，使模型可直接从配对样本（paired samples）训练，并研究该构造的非唯一性。
Result: 建立该构造的基本结构性质，给出非唯一性分析，并在解析可解及风格化数值示例上展示其作为正/反问题统一条件生成建模方法的潜力。摘要未报告具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架为 forward 与 inverse 问题提供统一的条件生成建模途径；目前实验限于风格化示例，实际大规模应用仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Deep Residual Echo State Networks: exploring residual orthogonal connections in untrained Recurrent Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Echo State Networks (ESNs) are a particular type of untrained Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) within the Reservoir Computing (RC) framework, popular for their fast and efficient learning. However, traditional ESNs often struggle with long-term information processing. In this paper, we introduce a novel class of deep untrained RNNs based on temporal residual connections, called Deep Residual Echo State Networks (DeepResESNs). We show that leveraging a hierarchy of untrained residual recurrent layers significantly boosts memory capacity and long-term temporal modeling. For the temporal residual connections, we consider different orthogonal configurations, including randomly generated and fixed-structure, and study their effect on network dynamics. A thorough mathematical analysis outlines necessary and sufficient conditions to ensure stable dynamics within DeepResESN. Empirically, the proposed approach consistently outperforms traditional shallow and deep RC on a variety of time series tasks. Overall, DeepResESN offers a promising approach for designing hierarchical ESNs with better prediction accuracy on long sequences, without sacrificing the computational advantages that make RC attractive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一类基于时间残差连接的深度无训练循环神经网络 Deep Residual Echo State Networks (DeepResESNs)，通过堆叠无训练残差循环层提升记忆容量与长期时序建模能力。作者给出了保证动态稳定性的充要条件，并在多种时间序列任务上实验，结果显示其一致优于传统浅层与深层储层计算 (Reservoir Computing) 方法。
Motivation: 传统 Echo State Networks (ESNs) 训练高效，但在长期信息处理上存在不足；现有深层 RC 结构也缺乏对残差连接的系统研究，因此需要一个既能建模长序列又不牺牲 RC 计算优势的层级化方案。
Method: 构建层级化的未训练残差循环层，引入时间残差连接，并考察随机生成与固定结构等不同正交配置对网络动力学的影响；同时给出确保 DeepResESN 动态稳定性的充要数学条件。
Result: 在多种时间序列任务上，DeepResESN 一致优于传统浅层和深层储层计算方法，尤其提升了对长序列的预测精度。
Conclusion: DeepResESN 为设计层级化 ESN 提供了有前景的途径，可在不牺牲 RC 计算优势的前提下改善长期序列建模能力；摘要未报告具体数据集或数值结果。

papers.title: Efficient Fine-Tuning of DINOv3 Pretrained on Natural Images for Atypical Mitotic Figure Classification
papers.abstract_en: Atypical mitotic figures (AMFs) indicate abnormal cell division associated with poor prognosis. Their detection remains difficult due to low prevalence, subtle morphology, and inter-observer variability. The MItosis DOmain Generalization (MIDOG) 2025 challenge introduces a benchmark for AMF classification across multiple domains. In this work, we fine-tuned the recently published DINOv3-H+ vision transformer, pretrained on natural images, using low-rank adaptation (LoRA), training only 1.3M parameters. We combine this with extensive augmentation and a domain-weighted Focal Loss to better handle the strong domain heterogeneity in the dataset. Despite the large shift between natural images and histopathology, our fine-tuned DINOv3 transfers effectively, reaching first place on the final test set. These results highlight the advantages of DINOv3 pretraining and underline the efficiency and robustness of our fine-tuning strategy, yielding state-of-the-art results for the atypical mitosis classification challenge in MIDOG 2025. Our code is publicly available on GitHub.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 4 figures. Challenge report for MIDOG 2025 (Task 2: Atypical Mitotic Figure Classification). Published in LNCS
papers.journal_ref: Mitotic Figure Detection and Atypia Classification in Whole Slide Images, Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol. 16519, pp. 15-25, Springer, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为 MIDOG 2025 挑战赛 Task 2（非典型有丝分裂图分类）的技术报告。作者将自然图像预训练的 DINOv3-H+ 视觉 Transformer 通过低秩适配 (LoRA) 微调，仅训练 1.3M 参数，并结合大量数据增强与域加权 Focal Loss 处理域异质性。尽管自然图像与组织病理学差异巨大，微调后的模型仍有效迁移，并在最终测试集上取得第一名。
Motivation: 非典型有丝分裂图 (AMF) 与不良预后相关，但因低患病率、形态细微和观察者间差异而难以检测；MIDOG 2025 提供了跨域 AMF 分类基准，需要应对较强的域异质性。
Method: 采用自然图像预训练的 DINOv3-H+ Vision Transformer，使用低秩适配 (LoRA) 微调，仅更新 1.3M 参数；搭配大规模数据增强和域加权 Focal Loss (domain-weighted Focal Loss) 以缓解数据集中的域偏移问题。
Result: 尽管自然图像与组织病理图像间存在较大分布差异，微调后的 DINOv3 在 MIDOG 2025 最终测试集上取得第一名，达到该挑战任务的最优结果。

papers.title: PosBridge: Multi-View Positional Embedding Transplant for Identity-Aware Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Localized subject-driven image editing aims to seamlessly integrate user-specified objects into target scenes. As generative models continue to scale, training becomes increasingly costly in terms of memory and computation, highlighting the need for training-free and scalable editing frameworks. To this end, we propose PosBridge--an efficient and flexible framework for inserting custom objects. A key component of our method is positional embedding transplant, which guides the diffusion model to faithfully replicate the structural characteristics of reference objects. Meanwhile, we introduce the Corner Centered Layout, which concatenates reference images and the background image as input to the FLUX.1-Fill model. During progressive denoising, positional embedding transplant is applied to guide the noise distribution in the target region toward that of the reference object. In this way, Corner Centered Layout effectively directs the FLUX.1-Fill model to synthesize identity-consistent content at the desired location. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PosBridge outperforms mainstream baselines in structural consistency, appearance fidelity, and computational efficiency, showcasing its practical value and potential for broad adoption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PosBridge，一个无需训练 (training-free) 的局部主体驱动图像编辑框架，旨在将用户指定的自定义物体无缝插入目标场景。其核心是位置嵌入移植 (positional embedding transplant)，并结合 Corner Centered Layout，将参考图像与背景图像拼接后输入 FLUX.1-Fill 模型。在渐进去噪过程中，位置嵌入移植引导目标区域的噪声分布趋向参考物体，从而在指定位置合成身份一致的内容。实验表明 PosBridge 在结构一致性、外观保真度和计算效率上优于主流基线。
Motivation: 随着生成模型规模扩大，训练在内存和算力上的成本越来越高，因此需要无需训练且可扩展的编辑框架。局部主体驱动编辑要解决把用户指定物体融入目标场景时保持结构特征的问题，现有方法在效率和结构保持上仍有不足。
Method: PosBridge 的关键组件是位置嵌入移植，它引导扩散模型忠实复现参考物体的结构特征；同时引入 Corner Centered Layout，将参考图像和背景图像拼接后作为 FLUX.1-Fill 模型的输入。在渐进去噪中，位置嵌入移植将目标区域的噪声分布引导至接近参考物体，使模型在期望位置生成身份一致的内容。
Result: 大量实验显示 PosBridge 在结构一致性、外观保真度和计算效率方面优于主流基线，摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法的收益来自位置嵌入移植与 Corner Centered Layout 的结合，使其成为一个高效灵活且无需训练的编辑框架，并具有实际应用价值和广泛采用的潜力。

papers.title: Beyond Pixels: Exploring DOM Downsampling for LLM-Based Web Agents
papers.abstract_en: The advent of large language models (LLMs) has sparked an evolution of autonomous web browsing agents: given a web browsing task and serialised user interface (UI) state, an LLM is expected to suggest input actions that incrementally solve the given task. The central challenge lies in serialising UI state for LLMs. Web agents have increasingly relied on grounded graphical UI (GUI) snapshots - screenshots augmented with visual cues - favoured for their modest input token footprint. Document Object Model (DOM) snapshots, serialised as HTML, represent a compelling alternative that leverages previously demonstrated HTML interpretation capabilities of LLMs. Their excessive token footprint, however, has precluded reliable deployment with web agents to date. We propose D2Snap, an algorithm to downsample the DOM, premised on preserving actionability and actionability-discriminating features. We evaluate D2Snap-downsampled DOM snapshots using a snapshot-variant web agent (GPT-4o) on a dataset sampled from Online-Mind2Web. Whilst 42% of raw DOM snapshots exceed the model context window (128 x 10^3 tokens), all D2Snap-downsampled DOM snapshots of our reference configuration fit, at a mean context utilisation of 16.5%. Against the 67% success rate of a grounded GUI snapshot baseline, our configuration attains 73% (+5.8%pt; 95% CI -13.6 to +26.0%pt; McNemar, p = 0.47), excluding a deficit (one-sided 95%) beyond 11%pt. Image input moreover appears to add little to snapshot utility; grounding text alone attains 62% (-5.8%pt; McNemar, p = 0.37).
papers.comment: 21 pages, LaTeX, print version; enhanced algorithm, settled on non-inferiority claim, added downsampling monotonicity and linearity results
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 D2Snap 算法，用于对 DOM 快照进行降采样，以解决基于 LLM 的网页智能体（web agent）中序列化 UI 状态时 token 占用过高的问题。作者用 GPT-4o 在 Online-Mind2Web 采样数据集上评估 D2Snap 降采样后的 DOM 快照：原始 DOM 快照有 42% 超出模型上下文窗口，而降采样后全部适配，平均上下文利用率为 16.5%。该配置达到 73% 的成功率，高于 grounded GUI 快照基线的 67%（+5.8%pt；95% CI -13.6 至 +26.0%pt；McNemar p=0.47），并排除了超过 11%pt 的劣势。
Motivation: 网页智能体依赖将 UI 状态序列化为 LLM 可处理的输入，grounded GUI 快照 token 占用较小但依赖视觉线索，而 DOM 快照（HTML 序列化）虽可利用 LLM 的 HTML 理解能力，却因 token 占用过大而难以可靠部署。
Method: 提出 D2Snap 降采样算法，其设计原则是保留可操作性（actionability）及能区分可操作性的特征；评估采用快照变体智能体（GPT-4o），数据集采样自 Online-Mind2Web。
Result: 原始 DOM 快照中 42% 超出 128×10^3 token 的上下文窗口，而参考配置下所有 D2Snap 降采样快照均可适配，平均上下文利用率为 16.5%。该配置成功率为 73%，较 grounded GUI 基线（67%）高 5.8 个百分点（95% CI -13.6 至 +26.0%pt；McNemar p=0.47），排除超过 11%pt 的劣势；仅用文本 grounding 时成功率为 62%（-5.8%pt；McNemar p=0.37）。
Conclusion: 作者认为 D2Snap 降采样的 DOM 快照在上下文适配性上优于原始 DOM，且相对 grounded GUI 基线表现非劣，图像输入对快照效用贡献有限。

papers.title: Learning Multi-Timescale Interventions under Safety and Resource Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Many sequential decision problems offer qualitatively different ways of influencing the environment: some interventions act immediately, whereas others induce persistent effects that continue to shape future states long after the decision that initiated them. An agent must then decide jointly when to intervene, which temporal mode to use and how strongly, while accounting for residual effects and limited intervention resources. We introduce MINT: Multi-timescale Intervention Network Training. Persistent effects are carried by an augmented intervention state that accumulates and decays, while a structured policy separates intervention-mode selection from conditional control. Unlike temporal abstractions that extend policy execution, persistent-effect interventions remain part of the environment dynamics and may overlap with later interventions. We show that the augmented state is a sufficient statistic for the intervention history, preserving the Markov property, and establish Bellman contraction and almost-sure convergence of a tabular Q-learning instance. Across persistent-control MuJoCo locomotion, stochastic inventory management, and a physiologically grounded Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus (T1DM) simulator, MINT attains the best mean primary metric on two of three benchmarks while using fewer intervention activations than an identically augmented flat policy. Its return advantage is present at every binding intervention budget and narrows to parity in the unconstrained reference setting. In T1DM it achieves $90.9\pm0.9\%$ time in range with zero time below range, improving on the strongest baseline by $21.5\%$ points. Code, benchmarks and the configuration for every reported run are available at https://github.com/heywanrong/mint-rl.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MINT（Multi-timescale Intervention Network Training），用于同时存在即时干预与持久影响干预的顺序决策问题。持久效应由一个可累积、可衰减的增广干预状态承载，策略被结构化为干预模式选择与条件控制两个部分，并证明该增广状态是干预历史的充分统计量，能保持马尔可夫性。实验覆盖 persistent-control MuJoCo 运动、随机库存管理和 1 型糖尿病（T1DM）模拟器，MINT 在三个基准中的两个取得最优平均主指标，且干预激活次数少于同配置的扁平策略。
Motivation: 许多顺序决策问题提供性质不同的干预方式：有的立即生效，有的产生持续影响并长期塑造未来状态。智能体需要联合决定何时干预、使用哪种时间模式以及干预强度，同时还要考虑残余效应和有限的干预资源。
Method: MINT 用增广干预状态（accumulating and decaying）来承载持久效应，并把策略解耦为干预模式选择（intervention-mode selection）与条件控制（conditional control）两部分。不同于将策略执行延长的时序抽象（temporal abstraction），持久效应干预仍属于环境动力学的一部分，并可与后续干预重叠。作者还给出了增广状态为充分统计量、Bellman 收缩以及表格型 Q-learning 几乎必然收敛的理论保证。
Result: 在持久控制的 MuJoCo 运动、随机库存管理和 T1DM 模拟器上，MINT 在三个基准中的两个取得最优平均主指标，同时比同配置增广的扁平策略使用更少的干预激活。其回报优势在每个资源约束预算下都存在，并在无约束参考设定中收窄至持平；在 T1DM 中达到 90.9±0.9% 的 time in range 和零 time below range，比最强基线提高 21.5 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者认为增广状态保留了马尔可夫性质，从而理论上支持该框架的收敛性，并强调 MINT 在资源受限的干预设定下能以更少干预获得更优或持平的回报。摘要未报告方法在纯即时干预或大规模高维环境中的表现边界。

papers.title: MCIF: Multimodal Crosslingual Instruction-Following Benchmark from Scientific Talks
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models have laid the foundation for multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), which unify text, speech, and vision within a single framework. As these models are rapidly evolving toward general-purpose instruction following across diverse and complex tasks, a key frontier is evaluating their crosslingual and multimodal capabilities over both short- and long-form inputs. However, existing benchmarks fall short in evaluating these dimensions jointly: they are often limited to English, mostly focus on a single modality at a time, rely on short-form inputs, or lack human annotations--hindering comprehensive assessment of model performance across languages, modalities, and task complexity. To address these gaps, we introduce MCIF (Multimodal Crosslingual Instruction Following), the first crosslingual human-annotated benchmark based on scientific talks on NLP and beyond. MCIF evaluates instruction following in crosslingual, multimodal settings over different input lengths and spans four macro-tasks: recognition, translation, question answering, and summarization. It covers three core modalities (speech, vision, and text) and four diverse languages (English, German, Italian, and Chinese), fully aligned across all dimensions. This parallel design enables a systematic evaluation of MLLMs' abilities to interpret instructions across languages and effectively integrate multimodal contextual information. Our benchmarking and analysis of 23 models highlight universal challenges across modalities and tasks, indicating substantial room for improvement in future MLLMs development. MCIF is released under CC-BY 4.0 license to promote open research.
papers.comment: Data available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/FBK-MT/MCIF | Evaluation, outputs, and baselines available at https://github.com/hlt-mt/mcif
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MCIF（Multimodal Crosslingual Instruction Following），一个基于科学演讲构建的跨语言、人工标注的指令跟随基准，据称是首个此类基准。它覆盖识别、翻译、问答和摘要四个宏任务，包含语音、视觉和文本三种模态，以及英语、德语、意大利语和中文四种语言，并同时支持短输入和长输入。作者对 23 个模型进行了基准测试与分析，发现模型在各类模态和任务上普遍存在挑战，说明未来 MLLM 开发仍有较大提升空间。
Motivation: 现有基准无法联合评估跨语言与多模态能力，往往局限于英语、每次只关注单一模态、依赖短输入或缺少人工标注，难以全面衡量模型在语言、模态和任务复杂度上的综合表现。
Method: 构建一个基于 NLP 等领域科学演讲的平行设计基准 MCIF，使语言、模态和输入长度等维度完全对齐；涵盖语音、视觉和文本三种模态，英语、德语、意大利语和中文四种语言，并定义识别、翻译、问答和摘要四个宏任务。
Result: 对 23 个模型的评估显示，模型在所有模态和任务上都存在普遍挑战，表明当前 MLLM 在跨语言多模态指令跟随方面仍有明显不足。
Conclusion: 作者强调 MCIF 是首个跨语言、人工标注、覆盖多种模态与不同输入长度的指令跟随基准，并以 CC-BY 4.0 许可发布数据和代码以促进开放研究。

papers.title: Dynamic gain neuromodulation attenuates the stability gap under joint training
papers.abstract_en: Recent work in continual learning has highlighted the stability gap -- a temporary performance drop on previously learned tasks when new ones are introduced. This phenomenon reflects a mismatch between rapid adaptation and strong retention at task boundaries, underscoring the need for optimization mechanisms that balance plasticity and stability over abrupt distribution changes. While optimizers such as momentum-SGD and Adam introduce implicit multi-timescale behavior, they still exhibit pronounced stability gaps. Importantly, these gaps persist even under ideal joint training, making it crucial to study them in this setting to isolate their causes from other sources of forgetting. Motivated by how noradrenergic (neuromodulatory) bursts transiently increase neuronal gain under uncertainty, we introduce a dynamic gain scaling mechanism as a two-timescale optimization technique that balances adaptation and retention by transiently increasing the effective update magnitude while dynamically reparameterizing the weights governing the forward pass, thereby empirically mitigating transition-induced curvature amplification. Across domain- and class-incremental MNIST, CIFAR, and mini-ImageNet benchmarks under task-agnostic joint training, dynamic gain scaling effectively attenuates stability gaps while maintaining competitive accuracy, improving robustness at task transitions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究持续学习中的稳定性缺口（stability gap）现象，即引入新任务时旧任务性能的暂时下降。作者受去甲肾上腺素能神经调质在不确定性下短暂提高神经元增益的机制启发，提出动态增益缩放（dynamic gain scaling）作为一种双时间尺度优化技术，在任务边界暂时增大有效更新幅度并动态重参数化前向传播权重，从而缓解转换引起的曲率放大。在任务无关联合训练（task-agnostic joint training）下的 domain- 和 class-incremental MNIST、CIFAR 与 mini-ImageNet 基准上，该方法在保持竞争力的准确率的同时有效衰减稳定性缺口。
Motivation: 稳定性缺口反映了快速适应与强保留之间的失配，且即使在理想的联合训练（joint training）设置下依然存在，因此需要在该设置下隔离其成因并设计兼顾可塑性与稳定性的优化机制。
Method: 提出动态增益缩放机制，将其作为双时间尺度优化技术：通过短暂增大有效更新幅度，同时对控制前向传播的权重进行动态重参数化，以经验性缓解任务转换诱导的曲率放大。
Result: 在 domain- 和 class-incremental MNIST、CIFAR 和 mini-ImageNet 基准的任务无关联合训练中，动态增益缩放有效衰减了稳定性缺口，同时保持有竞争力的准确率，提升了任务转换处的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者强调在联合训练下研究稳定性缺口可隔离其他遗忘来源，并表明神经调质启发的动态增益缩放能够平衡快速适应与旧任务保留之间的矛盾。

papers.title: EEG Foundation Challenge: From Cross-Task to Cross-Subject EEG Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Current electroencephalogram (EEG) decoding models are typically trained on small numbers of subjects performing a single task. Here, we introduce a large-scale, code-submission-based competition comprising two challenges. First, the Transfer Challenge asks participants to build and test a model that can zero-shot decode new tasks and new subjects from their EEG data. Second, the Psychopathology factor prediction Challenge asks participants to infer subject measures of mental health from EEG data. For this, we use an unprecedented, multi-terabyte dataset of high-density EEG signals (128 channels) recorded from over 3,000 child to young adult subjects engaged in multiple active and passive tasks. We provide several tunable neural network baselines for each of these two challenges, including a simple network and demographic-based regression models. Developing models that generalise across tasks and individuals will pave the way for ML network architectures capable of adapting to EEG data collected from diverse tasks and individuals. Similarly, predicting mental health-relevant personality trait values from EEG might identify objective biomarkers useful for clinical diagnosis and design of personalised treatment for psychological conditions. Ultimately, the advances spurred by this challenge could contribute to the development of computational psychiatry and useful neurotechnology, and contribute to breakthroughs in both fundamental neuroscience and applied clinical research.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍一项大规模、基于代码提交的 EEG 解码竞赛，包含两个挑战：迁移挑战（Transfer Challenge）要求零样本解码新任务和新被试的 EEG，心理病理学因子预测挑战（Psychopathology factor prediction Challenge）要求从 EEG 推断心理健康相关指标。竞赛使用超过 3000 名儿童至年轻成人的多任务高密度 128 通道 EEG 数据（多 TB 规模），并为每个挑战提供可调神经网络基线，包括简单网络和基于人口统计的回归模型。
Motivation: 现有 EEG 解码模型通常在少量被试和单一任务上训练，泛化能力有限；作者希望通过跨任务、跨被试的通用模型以及从 EEG 预测心理健康相关特质，为计算精神病学和神经技术提供客观生物标志物。
Method: 采用代码提交型竞赛形式设置两个子任务，并提供大型多被试多任务 EEG 数据集；作者给出多种可调基线，包括简单神经网络和基于人口统计特征的回归模型，供参赛者在此基础上构建模型。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化结果；其贡献在于竞赛设置、数据集规模（3000 余名被试、128 通道、多 TB）以及基线模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为，能跨任务和个体泛化的模型可支撑自适应 EEG 神经技术，而心理健康特质的预测可能有助于临床诊断和个性化治疗，从而推动计算精神病学与基础/临床神经科学研究。

papers.title: An Information-Theoretic Framework for Feature Construction in Out-of-Distribution Detection
papers.abstract_en: We present a theory for the construction of out-of-distribution (OOD) detection features for neural networks. We introduce random features for OOD through a novel information-theoretic loss functional consisting of two terms, the first based on the KL divergence separates resulting in-distribution (ID) and OOD feature distributions and the second term is the Information Bottleneck, which favors compressed features that retain the OOD information. We formulate a variational procedure to optimize the loss and obtain OOD features. Based on assumptions on OOD distributions, one can recover properties of existing OOD features, i.e., shaping functions. Furthermore, we show that our theory can predict a new shaping function that out-performs existing ones on OOD benchmarks, including both semantic and a wide range of covariate shifts. Our theory provides a general framework for constructing a variety of new features with clear explainability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于神经网络分布外 (OOD) 检测特征构造的信息论理论框架。作者设计了一个包含两项的损失泛函：基于 KL 散度的项用于分离 ID 与 OOD 特征分布，Information Bottleneck 项用于压缩特征并保留 OOD 信息，并通过变分过程优化获得 OOD 随机特征。该理论不仅能统一解释已有的 shaping functions，还预测出一个新的 shaping function，在语义偏移和多种协变量偏移的 OOD 基准上优于现有方法。
Motivation: OOD 检测中特征构造缺乏统一的理论指导，现有 shaping functions 多为启发式设计，难以解释和推广。
Method: 提出由 KL 散度项和信息瓶颈项组成的信息论损失泛函，通过变分优化得到 OOD 特征；在对 OOD 分布作出假设后，可以恢复已有 shaping functions 并推导出新形式。
Result: 理论预测的新 shaping function 在 OOD 基准上表现优于现有方法，覆盖语义偏移和广泛的协变量偏移。
Conclusion: 该理论提供了一个构造多种可解释新特征的一般框架，并以清晰的可解释性支持 OOD 检测特征设计。

papers.title: A Control Function Framework for Mitigating Position Bias in Learning to Rank Systems
papers.abstract_en: Learning-to-rank (LTR) systems commonly depend on implicit feedback, such as user clicks, because it is easy to collect and can serve as a valuable signal of user preferences. However, directly optimizing ranking models using implicit feedback data often yields suboptimal performance because such data is inherently skewed by systematic biases. Among these biases, position bias is particularly pervasive: items ranked higher tend to receive disproportionately more interactions, regardless of their actual relevance. To address this, we introduce a novel two-stage framework based on control functions. In the first stage, we utilize exogenous variation from the residuals of the ranking process, which are then incorporated into a second stage click model to account for position-dependent distortions. In contrast to existing methods, our approach avoids explicit propensity estimation, supports nonlinear ranking models, and can be flexibly incorporated into any state-of-the-art ranking algorithm for position bias correction. We also propose a debiasing strategy for validation clicks that enables reliable hyperparameter tuning in the absence of unbiased validation data. Empirical results show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art position bias correction methods on both benchmark and real-world industrial datasets.
papers.journal_ref: In 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys '26), September 27-October 02, 2026, Minneapolis, MN, USA. ACM, New York, NY, USA, 11 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对学习排序 (learning-to-rank) 系统中点击等隐式反馈受位置偏差 (position bias) 干扰的问题，提出一个基于控制函数 (control function) 的两阶段框架。第一阶段利用排序过程残差带来的外生变化，第二阶段将其纳入点击模型以校正位置相关失真。方法无需显式倾向性估计 (propensity estimation)，支持非线性排序模型，并能灵活接入任意现有排序算法；同时提出针对验证点击的去偏策略，使无偏验证数据缺失时仍可进行超参数调优。
Motivation: 隐式反馈数据易于收集但被系统偏差严重扭曲，其中位置偏差尤其普遍：排名靠前的条目不论相关性如何都会获得不成比例的用户交互，直接优化会导致次优性能。
Method: 提出两阶段控制函数框架：第一阶段从排序过程中提取残差作为外生变化来源，第二阶段将这些残差纳入点击模型以校正位置相关的失真；并额外提出一种针对验证点击的去偏策略，用于在无无偏验证数据时进行可靠的超参数调优。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在基准数据集和真实工业数据集上均优于现有最先进的位置偏差校正方法。
Conclusion: 与现有方法相比，该框架避免了显式倾向性估计，支持非线性排序模型，并可作为即插即用模块集成到任意最新排序算法中用于位置偏差校正。

papers.title: HonestFace: Towards Honest Face Restoration with One-Step Diffusion Model
papers.abstract_en: Face restoration has achieved significant advancements through the years of development. However, maintaining high fidelity and authenticity while avoiding artifacts remains challenging, especially in extreme degradation scenarios. This highlights the need for models that are more ``honest'' in their reconstruction from low-quality inputs, accurately reflecting original characteristics. In this work, we propose HonestFace, a novel approach for honest face restoration with identity consistency and realistic textures. To achieve this, HonestFace incorporates several key components. First, we propose an identity embedder to effectively capture and preserve crucial identity features from both the low-quality input and multiple reference faces. Second, a masked face alignment method is presented to enhance fine-grained details and textural authenticity. Furthermore, we present a new real-world reference-based face restoration dataset, \textbf{MultiRefCeleb-Test}, with multiple high-quality references and low-quality inputs. Leveraging these contributions within a one-step diffusion model framework, HonestFace delivers excellent restoration results in terms of facial fidelity and realism. Experiments demonstrate that our approach surpasses state-of-the-art methods, achieving superior performance in both visual quality and quantitative assessments. The code and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/jkwang28/HonestFace .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HonestFace，一种基于一步扩散模型 (one-step diffusion model) 的人脸修复方法，目标是在极端退化条件下保持身份一致性与真实纹理。方法包含身份嵌入器 (identity embedder)、掩码人脸对齐 (masked face alignment) 以及新构建的多参考真实世界人脸修复数据集 MultiRefCeleb-Test。实验表明其在视觉质量和定量指标上优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 人脸修复在极端退化场景下难以同时保证高保真度、真实性和无伪影，现有模型可能忽略原始身份特征，因此需要更“诚实”地重建低质量输入并准确反映原始特征。
Method: 提出身份嵌入器，从低质量输入和多个参考人脸中捕获并保留关键身份特征；提出掩码人脸对齐方法以增强细粒度细节和纹理真实性；并构建包含多张高质量参考与低质量输入的真实世界数据集 MultiRefCeleb-Test，整体框架基于一步扩散模型。
Result: 摘要报告 HonestFace 在人脸保真度和真实感方面超过现有最先进方法，在视觉质量和定量评估上均取得更优性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为 HonestFace 能够在一步扩散框架下实现优秀的人脸修复结果，并已公开代码与预训练模型。

summary_sections.motivation: 人脸修复在极端退化场景下难以同时保证高保真度、真实性和无伪影，现有模型可能忽略原始身份特征，因此需要更“诚实”地重建低质量输入并准确反映原始特征。
summary_sections.method: 提出身份嵌入器，从低质量输入和多个参考人脸中捕获并保留关键身份特征；提出掩码人脸对齐方法以增强细粒度细节和纹理真实性；并构建包含多张高质量参考与低质量输入的真实世界数据集 MultiRefCeleb-Test，整体框架基于一步扩散模型。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 HonestFace 在人脸保真度和真实感方面超过现有最先进方法，在视觉质量和定量评估上均取得更优性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为 HonestFace 能够在一步扩散框架下实现优秀的人脸修复结果，并已公开代码与预训练模型。

papers.title: FoMoH: A clinically meaningful foundation model evaluation for structured electronic health records
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models (FMs) promise to address core limitations of traditional supervised machine learning: (i) reliance on large amounts of labeled data, (ii) task specificity, and (iii) poor transportability. Despite methodological advances in structured electronic health record (EHR) foundation models, no systematic benchmark has validated whether these models meaningfully deliver on these promises. We introduce a benchmark of 14 clinically meaningful prediction tasks spanning patient prognosis and early diagnosis of acute and chronic conditions. We benchmark 6 state-of-the-art EHR FMs beyond population-level discrimination, emphasizing the need for evaluating their calibration and fairness, with rigorous controls for data contamination and reproducibility across more than 6 million patients from Columbia University Irving Medical Center and MIMIC-IV. Our benchmark identifies that FMs deliver on some of their promises. In particular, top-performing FMs outperform traditional baselines on discriminative performance, especially under limited labeled data, and exhibit more equitable performance across socio-medical groups. However, these models may underperform in low-prevalence settings, as pretraining losses may discard discriminative information about such conditions, and present lower calibration under limited labeled data. Further, cross-institutional transportability remains a challenge for structured EHR FMs. Together, these findings advance our understanding of EHR FMs' potential for clinical utility, highlight critical gaps that remain to be addressed, and provide a reproducible framework to track progress.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为结构化电子健康记录（EHR）基础模型提出一个临床意义明确的评估基准，涵盖14项预后与早期诊断任务，并在来自Columbia University Irving Medical Center和MIMIC-IV的600多万患者数据上系统评估6个SOTA EHR基础模型，强调校准、公平性、数据污染控制与可复现性。基准发现顶级模型在判别性能上优于传统基线，尤其在有限标注数据下，且在社医群体间表现更公平，但在低患病率场景下可能欠佳、有限标注下校准较差，跨机构迁移仍是挑战。
Motivation: 尽管结构化EHR基础模型在方法上不断进步，但缺乏系统性基准来验证其是否真正兑现了减少标注依赖、任务通用性和可迁移性这三大承诺。
Method: 构建包含14个临床预测任务的基准，使用超过600万患者数据，评估6个SOTA EHR基础模型，并在群体级判别指标之外引入校准与公平性评估，同时严格控制数据污染并保证可复现性。
Result: 顶级EHR基础模型在判别性能上超过传统基线，尤其在有限标注数据下表现突出，并在社医群体间展现出更公平的性能；但这些模型在低患病率条件下可能因预训练损失丢弃相关判别信息而表现不佳，有限标注下校准较差，且跨机构迁移仍具挑战。
Conclusion: 研究增进了对EHR基础模型临床效用的理解，指出了仍需解决的关键缺口，并提供了可复现的评估框架以追踪进展。

papers.title: On the expressivity of deep Heaviside networks
papers.abstract_en: We show that deep Heaviside networks (DHNs) have limited expressiveness but that this can be overcome by including either skip connections or neurons with linear activation. We provide lower and upper bounds for the Vapnik-Chervonenkis (VC) dimensions and approximation rates of these network classes. As an application, we derive statistical convergence rates for DHN fits in the nonparametric regression model.
papers.comment: 63 pages, 17 figures, published in Constructive Approximation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究深度Heaviside网络（deep Heaviside networks, DHNs）的表达能力，证明其表达能力有限，但可以通过引入跳跃连接（skip connections）或线性激活神经元来克服。作者给出这些网络类的Vapnik-Chervonenkis（VC）维上下界和逼近率，并将其应用于非参数回归模型中DHN拟合的统计收敛速度推导。
Motivation: 深度Heaviside网络使用非连续阶跃激活，其结构可能严重限制表达能力；理解这种限制是否存在以及简单的结构修改能否突破它，对于刻画网络类复杂度及其统计泛化性质具有重要意义。
Method: 采用理论分析方法，建立深度Heaviside网络及其带跳跃连接或线性激活神经元变体的VC维上下界与逼近率，并基于这些复杂度与逼近结果推导非参数回归背景下DHN拟合的统计收敛速度。
Result: 摘要的核心结果是深度Heaviside网络表达能力有限，而添加跳跃连接或线性激活神经元可以克服这一限制；同时作者为这些网络类提供了VC维上下界和逼近率的定量刻画。
Conclusion: 作为应用，作者得到DHN在非参数回归模型中的统计收敛速率，表明经过结构修正后的Heaviside网络仍可用于统计估计任务。

papers.title: TreeHop: Efficient Embedding-Level Query Rewriter
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems face significant challenges in multi-hop question answering (MHQA), where complex queries require synthesizing information across multiple document chunks. Existing approaches typically rely on iterative LLM-based query rewriting and routing, resulting in high computational costs due to repeated LLM invocations and multi-stage processes. To address these limitations, we propose TreeHop, an embedding-level framework without the need for LLMs in query refinement. TreeHop dynamically updates query embeddings by fusing semantic information from prior queries and retrieved documents, enabling iterative retrieval through embedding-space operations alone. This method replaces the traditional "Retrieve-Rewrite-Vectorize-Retrieve" cycle with a streamlined "Retrieve-Embed-Retrieve" loop, significantly reducing computational overhead. Moreover, a rule-based stopping criterion is introduced to further prune redundant retrievals, balancing efficiency and recall rate. Experimental results show that TreeHop rivals advanced RAG methods across four open-domain MHQA datasets, achieving comparable performance with only 2.2\%-29.4\% of the parameter size of concurrent solutions and reducing the query latency by 92.8\%-97.8\%. This makes TreeHop a faster and more cost-effective solution for low-resource or latency-sensitive deployment. For reproducibility purposes, codes and data are available here: https://github.com/allen-li1231/TreeHop-RAG
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TreeHop，一个在嵌入层进行查询重写的框架，用于多跳问答 (MHQA) 中的检索增强生成 (RAG)。与依赖反复调用 LLM 的查询改写和路由不同，TreeHop 通过融合先前查询与检索文档的语义信息来动态更新查询嵌入，将传统的 "Retrieve-Rewrite-Vectorize-Retrieve" 循环简化为 "Retrieve-Embed-Retrieve" 循环，并引入基于规则的停止条件来减少冗余检索。实验表明，在四个开放域 MHQA 数据集上，TreeHop 以同期方案 2.2%-29.4% 的参数量达到可比性能，并将查询延迟降低 92.8%-97.8%。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 系统在多跳问答中通常依赖迭代的 LLM 查询改写与路由，多次调用 LLM 和多阶段流水线带来很高的计算开销，限制了低资源或延迟敏感场景下的部署。
Method: TreeHop 提出一种无需 LLM 参与查询细化的嵌入级框架：通过嵌入空间运算融合先前查询和已检索文档的语义信息来动态更新查询嵌入，实现纯嵌入层的迭代检索；同时设计基于规则的停止准则，在检索效率和召回率之间取得平衡。
Result: 在四个开放域 MHQA 数据集上，TreeHop 的性能与先进 RAG 方法相当，参数规模仅为同期方案的 2.2%-29.4%，查询延迟降低 92.8%-97.8%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 TreeHop 是低资源或延迟敏感部署中更快且更具成本效益的 RAG 解决方案，并公开了代码和数据以支持复现。

papers.title: Analogical Learning for Cross-Scenario Generalization: Framework and Application to Intelligent Localization
papers.abstract_en: Modern learning systems often struggle with joint learning across diverse scenarios and immediate adaptation to new ones, because they rely heavily on the scenario-dependent absolute data-label representations. Here, we propose analogical learning (AL), a learning framework that explores the inherent invariance of the underlying physical processes across scenarios, to improve the cross-scenario generalization. Specifically, we introduce the physical concepts of reference frames and relativity into the neural modeling. The resultant framework explicitly employs intra-scenario data-label pairs as reference anchors and enforces the network to mediate its data-to-label transformation through data-domain relative metrics that factor out the scenario-dependent variations. We instantiate AL with Mateformer, a bipartite Transformer-based neural architecture. Each layer of the auxiliary Transformer extracts certain feature space of the current data, while the corresponding layer of the primary Transformer computes attention among the data feature space and then use it as a relativity metric to weight the current label feature to synthesize the next label feature and, ultimately, the final prediction. We apply AL to intelligent wireless localization, a representative multi-scenario learning task. Across synthetic, real-world, and city-scale datasets, AL enables robust cross-scenario transfer and multi-scenario joint learning, achieving wavelength-scale localization accuracy that matches or surpasses state-of-the-art methods. This physics-inspired learning framework provides a promising alternative for other cross-scenario learning tasks and applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出类比学习 (analogical learning, AL) 框架，利用物理过程中的跨场景不变性来改进跨场景泛化，并将参考系与相对性概念引入神经网络建模。作者用 Mateformer（基于双分支 Transformer 的架构）实例化 AL，在智能无线定位任务上验证了方法，合成、真实和城市规模数据集上实现波长级定位精度。该框架面向一般跨场景学习任务，定位仅为代表性应用。
Motivation: 现代学习系统在跨场景联合学习和对新场景的快速适应上表现不佳，因为过度依赖与场景相关的绝对数据-标签表示。作者希望探索底层物理过程在不同场景间的内在不变性，以提升跨场景泛化。
Method: 提出 AL 框架：将参考系和相对性的物理概念引入神经建模，用场景内数据-标签对作为参考锚点，强制网络通过数据域的相对度量 (relative metrics) 中介数据到标签的变换，从而消除场景相关变化。实例化为 Mateformer，辅助 Transformer 各层提取当前数据的特征空间，主 Transformer 计算数据特征空间上的注意力并用作相对性度量，加权当前标签特征以合成下一标签特征和最终预测。
Result: 应用于智能无线定位，在合成、真实和城市规模数据集上，AL 实现稳健的跨场景迁移与多场景联合学习，达到匹配或超越现有最先进方法的波长级定位精度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该物理启发的学习框架为其他跨场景学习任务和应用提供了一种有前景的替代方案。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: When Grammar Guides the Attack: Uncovering Control-Plane Vulnerabilities in LLMs with Structured Output
papers.abstract_en: Content Warning: This paper may contain unsafe or harmful content generated by LLMs that may be offensive to readers. Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as tooling platforms through structured output APIs, but the grammar-guided decoding that powers this feature opens a critical control-plane attack surface orthogonal to traditional data-plane vulnerabilities. We introduce Constrained Decoding Attack (CDA), a new jailbreak class that targets the LLM control plane. CDA is best characterized as a control-to-semantic pipeline: (1) schema-enforced logit masking injects a malicious prefix into the generation trajectory, and (2) the model itself completes the harmful intent. Unlike data-plane jailbreaks that rely on bypassing alignment with visible inputs, CDA acts on the decoding process itself, so internal safety alignment alone cannot stop it. We instantiate CDA with EnumAttack, which hides malicious content in enum fields, and the more evasive DictAttack, which decouples the payload across a benign prompt and a dictionary-based grammar. Across 13 proprietary/open-weight models and five standard benchmarks, DictAttack achieves 94.3--99.5% Attack Success Rate (ASR) on flagship models including gpt-5, gemini-2.5-pro, deepseek-r1, and gpt-oss-120b. While basic grammar auditing mitigates EnumAttack, DictAttack still sustains 75.8% ASR against SOTA jailbreak guardrails, exposing a "semantic gap" that demands cross-plane defenses bridging the data and control planes. Project page and code are available at https://ict-cda.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一类针对LLM结构化输出API的"控制平面"攻击——约束解码攻击（Constrained Decoding Attack, CDA）。它利用语法引导解码（grammar-guided decoding）中的logit掩码在生成轨迹中注入恶意前缀，再由模型自身补全有害意图，从而绕过基于可见输入的data-plane安全对齐。作者实现EnumAttack和DictAttack两种变体，在13个模型和5个基准上验证，DictAttack在gpt-5、gemini-2.5-pro等旗舰模型上达到94.3-99.5%的攻击成功率（ASR），并能对抗现有SOTA安全护栏。
Motivation: LLM越来越多地通过结构化输出API作为工具平台，但支撑该功能的语法引导解码引入了一个关键的控制平面攻击面，与传统数据平面漏洞正交；现有内部安全对齐无法阻止这种作用于解码过程本身的攻击。
Method: 提出CDA，将其刻画为控制到语义（control-to-semantic）管道：先由schema强制的logit掩码注入恶意前缀，再由模型自身完成有害意图。具体实例包括把恶意内容隐藏在枚举字段中的EnumAttack，以及通过良性提示与字典式语法解耦载荷、更难以检测的DictAttack。
Result: 在13个专有/开源模型和五个标准基准上，DictAttack对gpt-5、gemini-2.5-pro、deepseek-r1和gpt-oss-120b等旗舰模型实现94.3-99.5%的ASR；基础语法审计可以缓解EnumAttack，但DictAttack对SOTA越狱防护仍维持75.8%的ASR，暴露出数据平面与控制平面之间的"语义鸿沟"。

papers.title: REMAC: Self-Reflective and Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Collaboration for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in robotic planning, particularly for long-horizon tasks that require a holistic understanding of the environment for task decomposition. Existing methods typically rely on prior environmental knowledge or carefully designed task-specific prompts, making them struggle with dynamic scene changes or unexpected task conditions, e.g., a robot attempting to put a carrot in the microwave but finds the door was closed. Such challenges underscore two critical issues: adaptability and efficiency. To address them, in this work, we propose an adaptive multi-agent planning framework, termed REMAC, that enables efficient, scene-agnostic multi-robot long-horizon task planning and execution through continuous reflection and self-evolution. REMAC incorporates two key modules: a self-reflection module performing pre-condition and post-condition checks in the loop to evaluate progress and refine plans, and a self-evolvement module dynamically adapting plans based on scene-specific reasoning. It offers several appealing benefits: 1) Robots can initially explore and reason about the environment without complex prompt design. 2) Robots can keep reflecting on potential planning errors and adapting the plan based on task-specific insights. 3) After iterations, a robot can call another one to coordinate tasks in parallel, maximizing the task execution efficiency. To validate REMAC's effectiveness, we build a multi-agent environment for long-horizon robot manipulation and navigation based on RoboCasa, featuring 4 task categories with 27 task styles and 50+ different objects. Based on it, we further benchmark state-of-the-art reasoning models, including DeepSeek-R1, o3-mini, QwQ, and Grok3, demonstrating REMAC's superiority by boosting average success rates by 40% and execution efficiency by 52.7% over the single robot baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REMAC，一个基于视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的自适应多智能体规划框架，用于长时程机器人操作与导航任务。框架通过持续反思 (self-reflection) 和自演进 (self-evolvement) 两个模块，使机器人无需复杂提示即可探索环境、检查前置/后置条件并动态调整计划，还能在多轮迭代后并行协调多个机器人。作者基于 RoboCasa 搭建了包含 4 类任务、27 种任务风格和 50 余种物体的多智能体环境，并以 DeepSeek-R1、o3-mini、QwQ、Grok3 等推理模型为底座进行评测。
Motivation: 现有基于 VLM 的机器人规划方法往往依赖先验环境知识或精心设计的任务特定提示，难以应对动态场景变化和意外任务条件（如微波炉门关闭），因此需要同时提升系统在长时程任务中的适应性和执行效率。
Method: REMAC 包含两个关键模块：自反思模块在循环中进行前置条件 (pre-condition) 和后置条件 (post-condition) 检查以评估进度并修正计划；自演进模块基于场景特定推理动态调整计划。框架支持机器人先探索和推理环境，再根据任务洞察不断反思和修正，并可在迭代后调用其他机器人并行协作。
Result: 在自建的多智能体长时程操作与导航基准上，相比单机器人基线，REMAC 将平均成功率提升 40%，执行效率提升 52.7%。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过持续反思和自演进，REMAC 能够实现高效、场景无关的多机器人长时程任务规划与执行，缓解现有方法对提示设计和先验知识的依赖。

papers.title: Advancing Intelligent Sequence Modeling: Evolution, Trade-offs, and Applications of State-Space Architectures from S4 to Mamba
papers.abstract_en: Structured State Space Models (SSMs) have become a prominent class of sequence models, developed against two long-standing difficulties: the sequential computation and gradient propagation limits of Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), and the quadratic time and memory cost of self-attention in Transformers. By combining structured recurrence with state-space representations, SSMs attain linear or near-linear scaling in sequence length and hold a constant-size recurrent state during autoregressive decoding, so that no key-value cache grows with context. This paper is a structured review of the lineage running from the Structured State Space Sequence model (S4), through its diagonal and simplified successors S4D, Diagonal State Spaces (DSS) and S5, to the selective models Mamba and Mamba-2, and on to SSM-attention hybrids. Rather than describing models one at a time, the analysis is organized around cross-cutting design dimensions: input-dependent selectivity, the recurrent and convolutional views and when each is preferable, diagonalization, cache behavior at inference, hardware-aware kernels, and hybridization. Structured state-space duality is treated as a central thread, because it accounts for the equivalence between the recurrent and the attention-like form and for why hybrid designs work. Reported efficiency and accuracy results are presented with their measurement configuration and evidence level, because observed speedups reflect the combined effects of the algorithm, implementation kernel and hardware rather than an intrinsic property of the model alone. SSMs are competitive with Transformers and more efficient in specific long-context regimes, whereas attention retains an advantage on tasks dominated by exact retrieval and associative recall. The review closes with limitations, failure modes, deployment considerations and open problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于结构化状态空间模型（SSM）的综述，梳理了从 S4 到 S4D、DSS、S5、Mamba、Mamba-2 以及 SSM-注意力混合模型的演进脉络。综述围绕输入依赖选择性、循环与卷积视角、对角化、推理缓存、硬件感知核与混合化等设计维度组织分析，并以结构化状态空间对偶性为线索解释循环形式与注意力形式的等价性及混合设计的原理。文章还报告了带测量配置与证据等级的效率与精度结果，指出 SSM 在特定长上下文场景下具有竞争力，而注意力在精确检索与联想召回任务上仍有优势。
Motivation: SSM 旨在同时应对 RNN 的序列计算与梯度传播限制，以及 Transformer 自注意力在序列长度上的二次时间与内存开销。本文作为结构化综述，试图系统梳理这一模型家族的设计维度、权衡与应用，而非逐一罗列模型。
Method: 采用按横切设计维度组织的综述方法，将 S4 至 Mamba 等模型置于统一分析框架下，重点讨论输入依赖选择性、循环/卷积双视图、对角化、推理缓存行为、硬件感知核以及混合架构，并以结构化状态空间对偶性解释模型间关系。
Result: 摘要汇总了带测量配置和证据等级的效率与精度结果：SSM 在特定长上下文场景下与 Transformer 竞争且更高效，而注意力在精确检索和联想召回任务上保持优势。
Conclusion: 综述总结了 SSM 的局限性、失败模式、部署考虑与开放问题，强调观测到的加速是算法、实现核与硬件共同作用的结果，而非模型本身的固有属性。

papers.title: On the Effect of Sampling Diversity in Scaling LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) scaling inference is key to unlocking greater performance, and leveraging diversity has proven an effective way to enhance it. Motivated by the observed relationship between solution accuracy and meaningful response diversity, we systematically study the effect of prompt diversity in scaling inference. We theoretically explain why diversified sampling improves Best-of-$N$ scaling, showing that responses generated from diverse prompts after Best-of-$N$ selection exhibit significantly lower error rates than those produced from stationary prompts. Building on this analysis, we derive a diversity-fidelity trade-off principle, that guides the design of sampling strategies introducing diversity. From this guidance, we instantiate a family of effective perturbation styles. We theoretically and empirically characterize \textbf{when} diversified exploration remains effective, demonstrating that it works under a variety of conditions, and we further show that under majority voting, diversity may vanish. Finally, we systematically evaluate the effectiveness of sampling diversity and show that, when applied appropriately in different contexts, meaningful perturbations yield stronger, task-dependent gains as diversity increases. Overall, this work provides a systematic analysis that offers a theoretical and empirical foundation for understanding how sampling diversity affects LLM inference-time scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究提示多样性（prompt diversity）对大型语言模型推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）的影响。作者从理论上解释为何多样化采样能改善 Best-of-N 扩展，推导出多样性-保真度权衡原则，并据此实例化多种扰动风格；同时刻画多样化探索保持有效的条件，并指出多数投票（majority voting）下多样性带来的优势可能消失。文章通过系统评估表明，恰当情境下的有意义扰动会随多样性增加带来更强的、依赖任务的收益。
Motivation: 推理时扩展是解锁 LLM 更强性能的关键，而利用采样多样性被证明能有效增强扩展效果；但现有工作缺乏对提示多样性如何影响扩展的系统性理论解释与设计指导。
Method: 先从理论上解释为何多样化采样能降低 Best-of-N 选择后的错误率，推导多样性-保真度权衡（diversity-fidelity trade-off）原则以指导引入多样性的采样策略，并实例化一系列扰动风格；再从理论与经验上刻画多样化探索有效的条件，并分析多数投票下多样性消失的情形。
Result: 摘要表明，从多样化提示生成的响应经 Best-of-N 选择后，错误率显著低于从固定提示生成的响应；系统评估显示，在合适情境下扰动带来的收益随多样性增加而增强且呈任务依赖性；而多数投票机制可能使多样性收益消失。
Conclusion: 该工作为理解采样多样性如何影响 LLM 推理时扩展提供了理论和经验基础，强调多样性-保真度权衡的重要性，并指出多样性需与具体任务情境相匹配才能发挥效用。

papers.title: Unsupervised Point Cloud Registration with Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Rigid point cloud registration is a fundamental problem and highly relevant in robotics and autonomous driving. Nowadays deep learning methods can be trained to match a pair of point clouds, given the transformation between them. However, this training is often not scalable due to the high cost of collecting ground truth poses. Therefore, we present a self-distillation approach to learn point cloud registration in an unsupervised fashion. Here, each sample is passed to a teacher network and an augmented view is passed to a student network. The teacher includes a trainable feature extractor and a learning-free robust solver such as RANSAC. The solver forces consistency among correspondences and optimizes for the unsupervised inlier ratio, eliminating the need for ground truth labels. Our approach simplifies the training procedure by removing the need for initial hand-crafted features or consecutive point cloud frames as seen in related methods. We show that our method not only surpasses them on the RGB-D benchmark 3DMatch but also generalizes well to automotive radar, where classical features adopted by others fail. The code is available at https://github.com/boschresearch/direg .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于自蒸馏 (self-distillation) 的无监督刚体点云配准方法。每个样本被送入教师网络，而增强视图被送入学生网络；教师网络由可训练的特征提取器与免学习的鲁棒求解器 (如 RANSAC) 组成，求解器强制对应关系之间的一致性并优化无监督内点率，从而无需真值标签。该方法在 RGB-D 基准 3DMatch 上超越相关方法，并能泛化到经典特征失效的汽车雷达数据。
Motivation: 基于深度学习的点云配准通常需要点云对之间的真值变换作为监督，而采集真值位姿成本高昂且难以扩展；现有无监督方法又往往依赖手工特征或连续帧输入，限制了适用性。
Method: 采用教师-学生自蒸馏框架：教师网络接收原始样本，学生网络接收增强视图；教师内部的 RANSAC 等免学习鲁棒求解器用于约束对应关系的一致性，并直接优化无监督内点率，从而消除对真值标签、初始手工特征和连续帧的依赖。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 RGB-D 基准 3DMatch 上超越相关无监督方法，并展现出对汽车雷达数据的良好泛化能力，而传统特征在该数据上失效。
Conclusion: 该方法简化了点云配准的训练流程，去除了对手工特征和连续帧的需求，代码已开源。

summary_sections.motivation: 基于深度学习的点云配准通常需要点云对之间的真值变换作为监督，而采集真值位姿成本高昂且难以扩展；现有无监督方法又往往依赖手工特征或连续帧输入，限制了适用性。
summary_sections.method: 采用教师-学生自蒸馏框架：教师网络接收原始样本，学生网络接收增强视图；教师内部的 RANSAC 等免学习鲁棒求解器用于约束对应关系的一致性，并直接优化无监督内点率，从而消除对真值标签、初始手工特征和连续帧的依赖。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该方法在 RGB-D 基准 3DMatch 上超越相关无监督方法，并展现出对汽车雷达数据的良好泛化能力，而传统特征在该数据上失效。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法简化了点云配准的训练流程，去除了对手工特征和连续帧的需求，代码已开源。

papers.title: Transformer Explainer: Learning LLM Transformers with Interactive Visual Explanation and Experimentation
papers.abstract_en: The Transformer architecture underpins modern large language models powering state-of-the-art text generation and AI applications. However, its complexity makes it difficult for non-experts to learn. Existing resources often lack interactivity, rely on static descriptions of simplified architectures, or fail to reflect models' behavior with real data. To address this gap, we introduce Transformer Explainer, an interactive visualization tool for non-experts to learn Transformers. The tool integrates an overview illustrating the Transformer's data flow with on-demand explanations that gradually reveal mathematical details. Smooth transitions across abstraction levels highlight the interplay between high-level structures and low-level operations. Running a live GPT-2 instance directly in the browser, Transformer Explainer empowers learners to experiment with custom input and hyperparameters without setup, observing next-token predictions in real time. A 90-participant user study showed that our tool offered significant advantages in improving user understanding and engagement. Transformer Explainer has attracted over 490,000 users.
papers.comment: CHI 2026 full paper. Extended version of the 2-page paper presented at IEEE VIS 2024, which won Best Poster Award and remains available as arXiv v1. Project page: https://poloclub.github.io/transformer-explainer/

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Transformer Explainer，一个面向非专家的交互式可视化工具，用于学习 Transformer 架构。该工具将 Transformer 数据流概览与按需展开的数学细节解释相结合，通过抽象层级间的平滑过渡展示高层结构与底层操作，并在浏览器中直接运行真实 GPT-2 实例，允许用户免配置地实验自定义输入与超参数并实时观察 next-token 预测。一项 90 名参与者的用户研究表明该工具在提升理解与参与度方面有显著优势，工具已吸引超过 490,000 用户。
Motivation: Transformer 架构支撑了现代大语言模型，但其复杂性使非专家难以学习；现有学习资源往往缺乏交互性、依赖简化架构的静态描述，或未能反映模型在真实数据上的行为。
Method: 提出交互式可视化工具，集成高层的 Transformer 数据流概览与按需解释来逐步揭示数学细节，并利用平滑的抽象层级过渡突出高层结构与底层操作之间的联系；同时通过在浏览器中运行真实 GPT-2 实例，让学习者无需环境搭建即可尝试自定义输入和超参数，实时观察下一 token 的预测。
Result: 一项 90 名参与者的用户研究显示，该工具在提升用户理解与参与度方面具有显著优势；此外工具已吸引超过 490,000 用户。
Conclusion: 摘要强调交互式可视化与实时模型实验相结合的方式能有效帮助非专家理解 Transformer，并指出该工具已被大量用户采用。

papers.title: Artificial Leviathan: Exploring Social Evolution of LLM Agents Through the Lens of Hobbesian Social Contract Theory
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) and advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI) offer an opportunity for computational social science research at scale. Building upon prior explorations of LLM agent design, our work introduces a simulated agent society where complex social relationships dynamically form and evolve over time. Agents are imbued with psychological drives and placed in a sandbox survival environment. We conduct an evaluation of the agent society through the lens of Thomas Hobbes's seminal Social Contract Theory (SCT). We analyze whether, as the theory postulates, agents seek to escape a brutish "state of nature" by surrendering rights to an absolute sovereign in exchange for order and security. Our experiments unveil an alignment: Initially, agents engage in unrestrained conflict, mirroring Hobbes's depiction of the state of nature. However, as the simulation progresses, social contracts emerge, leading to the authorization of an absolute sovereign and the establishment of a peaceful commonwealth founded on mutual cooperation. This congruence between our LLM agent society's evolutionary trajectory and Hobbes's theoretical account indicates LLMs' capability to model intricate social dynamics and potentially replicate forces that shape human societies. By enabling such insights into group behavior and emergent societal phenomena, LLM-driven multi-agent simulations, while unable to simulate all the nuances of human behavior, may hold potential for advancing our understanding of social structures, group dynamics, and complex human systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个由 LLM 驱动的多智能体社会模拟，智能体被赋予心理驱动力并置于沙盒生存环境中，通过霍布斯社会契约理论（Social Contract Theory）的视角分析社会演化。实验显示智能体初期陷入无约束冲突，随后涌现社会契约并授权绝对主权者，形成和平共同体。作者认为这一演化轨迹与霍布斯理论相符，说明 LLM 智能体社会可用于研究复杂群体行为和社会结构。
Motivation: 大规模语言模型与 AI 的进展为计算社会科学研究提供了规模化仿真的机会，但以往 LLM 智能体设计较少系统检验特定社会理论（如霍布斯社会契约理论）对群体动态演化的解释力。
Method: 构建一个模拟智能体社会，让带有心理驱动的 LLM 智能体在沙盒生存环境中互动，并在多轮模拟中追踪冲突、契约形成和主权授权等社会关系演化，用以对照霍布斯理论所描述的自然状态到共同体的转变。
Result: 摘要报告实验发现：智能体最初发生无限制冲突（对应霍布斯的自然状态），随模拟推进出现社会契约，进而授权绝对主权者并建立基于合作的和平共同体，其结果与霍布斯理论预测一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LLM 驱动的多智能体模拟虽然无法涵盖人类行为的全部细微之处，但可能有助于理解社会结构、群体动态和复杂人类系统；论文的比拟框架和演化结果支持 LLM 在建模复杂社会动态方面的潜力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Machine Learning and Data Analysis Using Posets: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: Partially ordered sets (posets) are discrete mathematical structures that formalize the notion of comparison without forcing every pair of objects to be comparable. This makes them a natural representation for the many machine learning and data-analysis settings in which objects are related by dominance, containment, priority, or refinement relations rather than by a single scalar score. Over the past two decades, a substantial and fragmented literature has connected posets and lattice theory to ranking, clustering, formal concept analysis, multidimensional and multi-criteria data analysis, structured and safe learning, graph and topological deep learning, and explainable artificial intelligence, spanning a wide range of application domains. Despite this activity, the field has lacked (i) an organizing taxonomy that relates these disparate strands of work, and (ii) an up-to-date account extending through 2025--2026 that incorporates recent developments in poset-structured learning methods, including poset-structured safety layers for reinforcement learning, poset-valued neural pooling operators, functor-calculus approaches to multiparameter persistent homology. This survey addresses both gaps. We propose a four-axis taxonomy of poset-based methods (representation, learning paradigm, data modality, and task), provide a comprehensive and comparative review of representative models and algorithms organized along this taxonomy, curate an extensive collection of datasets, software packages, and algorithmic resources, and close with a critical discussion of open theoretical and practical problems -- including model depth and expressivity, scalability--fidelity trade-offs, heterogeneity of order-structured data, and dynamicity of posets over time -- that we argue define a research agenda for the next generation of order-aware machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于偏序集（posets）在机器学习和数据分析中应用的综述，覆盖排序、聚类、形式概念分析、结构化与安全学习、图与拓扑深度学习、可解释AI等多个方向。作者提出一个四轴分类法（表示、学习范式、数据模态、任务），并据此进行代表性模型与算法的比较性综述，同时整理了数据集、软件包和算法资源。文章还讨论了模型深度与表达能力、可扩展性与保真度权衡、阶结构数据的异质性以及偏序集的动态性等开放问题，并认为这些构成了下一代阶感知机器学习的研究议程。
Motivation: 过去二十年间，关于偏序集与格理论在机器学习中应用的文献大量且分散，但领域一直缺乏（i）能够关联这些不同研究脉络的组织性分类法，以及（ii）涵盖到2025-2026年最新发展的综述，包括偏序结构化强化学习安全层、偏序值神经池化算子以及函子演算方法在多参数持续同调中的应用。
Method: 提出一个四轴分类法（representation、learning paradigm、data modality、task）来组织偏序集方法；沿该分类法对代表性模型和算法进行全面的比较性综述；并整理了大量数据集、软件包和算法资源。
Result: 该综述没有报告具体实验数值，其贡献在于填补两个空白：提供一个连接分散研究的组织性分类法，以及一个更新至2025-2026年的系统化综述，并汇集了可用的数据与软件资源。
Conclusion: 作者认为，偏序集方法面临的理论与实践开放问题——包括模型深度与表达性、可扩展性与保真度的权衡、阶结构数据的异质性以及偏序集随时间的动态性——定义了一代阶感知机器学习的研究议程。
Relevance: 5
