papers.title: Matrix Completion via Nonsmooth Regularization of Fully Connected Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Conventional matrix completion methods approximate the missing values by assuming the matrix to be low-rank, which leads to a linear approximation of missing values. It has been shown that enhanced performance could be attained by using nonlinear estimators such as deep neural networks. Deep fully connected neural networks (FCNNs), one of the most suitable architectures for matrix completion, suffer from over-fitting due to their high capacity, which leads to low generalizability. In this paper, we control over-fitting by regularizing the FCNN model in terms of the $\ell_{1}$ norm of intermediate representations and nuclear norm of weight matrices. As such, the resulting regularized objective function becomes nonsmooth and nonconvex, i.e., existing gradient-based methods cannot be applied to our model. We propose a variant of the proximal gradient method and investigate its convergence to a critical point. In the initial epochs of FCNN training, the regularization terms are ignored, and through epochs, the effect of that increases. The gradual addition of nonsmooth regularization terms is the main reason for the better performance of the deep neural network with nonsmooth regularization terms (DNN-NSR) algorithm. Our simulations indicate the superiority of the proposed algorithm in comparison with existing linear and nonlinear algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对全连接神经网络 (FCNN) 在矩阵补全任务中因容量过高而过拟合的问题，提出在中间表示上施加 ℓ1 范数、在权重矩阵上施加核范数的非光滑正则化方案。作者设计了一个近端梯度法的变体，并证明其收敛到临界点；训练初期忽略正则项、随轮次逐步增强其影响。模拟实验表明该算法优于现有线性和非线性矩阵补全方法。
Motivation: 传统矩阵补全通常假设矩阵低秩，只能对缺失值做线性逼近；深度神经网络可提供非线性估计，但全连接网络容量大、易过拟合，导致泛化能力差。
Method: 将目标函数构造为含 ℓ1 范数中间表示和核范数权重矩阵的非光滑非凸问题，并给出一种近端梯度法变体；该算法在训练初期不施加正则项，随轮次逐渐引入非光滑正则，作者分析了其收敛到临界点的性质。
Result: 摘要报告模拟结果表明，所提出的带非光滑正则项的深度神经网络 (DNN-NSR) 算法在矩阵补全性能上优于现有线性和非线性算法；但摘要未给出具体数值或基准细节。
Conclusion: 作者强调逐步加入非光滑正则项是 DNN-NSR 性能提升的主要原因，该方法为高容量 FCNN 的过拟合控制提供了一种可收敛的优化途径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Online Statistical Inference for Nonlinear Stochastic Approximation with Markovian Data
papers.abstract_en: Many stochastic approximation (SA) algorithms evolve along a single trajectory, making uncertainty quantification challenging under nonlinear dynamics and Markov dependence. We develop an online inference framework for nonlinear SA with decreasing step sizes. Under local stability and verifiable conditions, we establish a functional central limit theorem for the partial-sum path. The proof uses a Poisson-equation decomposition to handle Markov dependence and a uniform bound to control endpoint-dependent remainders induced by decreasing step sizes. The resulting path limit yields self-normalized confidence intervals without estimating the asymptotic variance. Our primary construction uses a five-dimensional polynomial-series normalizer, has an asymptotic Student $t_5$ pivot, and requires only constant memory. We apply the framework to Q-learning, including asynchronous tabular, projected linear, and entropy-regularized updates, as well as SGD for generalized linear models with Markov data and inference for the identified product in low-rank adaptation (LoRA). Across four settings, the polynomial-series method achieves near-nominal coverage, with shorter confidence intervals and lower computational cost than online bootstrap.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对递减步长、非线性且带马尔可夫依赖的随机近似（SA）算法，发展了一个在线统计推断框架。作者在局部稳定性与可验证条件下建立部分和路径的函数中心极限定理，并用泊松方程分解处理马尔可夫依赖、用一致界控制递减步长带来的端点余项。主要构造采用五维多项式序列归一化器，得到渐近 Student t5 枢轴量，且只需常数内存。框架应用于 Q-learning（异步表格、投影线性、熵正则）以及马尔可夫数据下的广义线性模型 SGD 和 LoRA 中的识别乘积推断。
Motivation: 许多随机近似算法只沿单条轨迹演化，在非线性动力学和马尔可夫依赖下，沿单轨迹的不确定性量化很困难，这限制了在线推断的可靠性。
Method: 提出在线推断框架：在局部稳定和可验证条件下证明部分和路径的函数中心极限定理；证明中使用泊松方程分解处理马尔可夫依赖，用一致界控制递减步长引起的端点相关余项。主要推断构造为五维多项式序列归一化器，得到渐近 Student t5 枢轴，无需估计渐近方差，内存占用为常数。
Result: 在四种设置（异步表格 Q-learning、投影线性 Q-learning、熵正则 Q-learning、马尔可夫数据下广义线性模型的 SGD 以及 LoRA 中识别乘积推断）中，多项式序列方法达到接近名义覆盖率，并且比在线 bootstrap 产生更短的置信区间和更低的计算成本。
Conclusion: 该框架提供自归一化置信区间，无需估计渐近方差，并以常数内存实现在线推断；本版本大幅修订并聚焦统计推断，前版中的弱收敛速率结果已被移除并将在后续论文中研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Math-Vision Diagrams: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Mathematical Diagram Generation Capabilities
papers.abstract_en: The generation of mathematically precise diagrams from tex- tual prompts has emerged as a critical yet underexplored capability of Large Language Models (LLMs). This has been of interest to researchers in the areas of curriculum preparation, automated ranking of problem sets, and scientific publishing. For LLMs to achieve this, it requires per- fect coordination between Spatial Reasoning, Mathematical Reasoning, and Rendering systems. While existing benchmarks such as MathVision, MathVista are built for Math Reasoning or DiagramGenBenchmark, Mer- maidSeqBench on general purpose diagram generation, no prior work provides a standardized set of prompt, image pairs that can be used to evaluate the LLMs specifically on math diagram generation. This includes fields that span both both text-to-code and text-to-image paradigms. We introduce Math-Vision Diagrams, the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate LLMs on mathematical diagram generation, and the first to assess text-to-code and text-to-image generation paradigms together in a single unified setting, agnostic of the underlying coding lan- guage or model type. Building on the Math-Vision benchmark, we select a subset of 2920 images out of 3040 from high-quality competition problems with essential visual context. A novel pipeline combining an ensemble of LLMs with Subject Matter Expert (SME) curation is presented, together with a suite of evaluation metrics. Testing several leading models against this benchmark, we demonstrate that LLMs struggle with math diagram generation. All code, data, curation pipeline, and evaluation scripts will be fully open-sourced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Math-Vision Diagrams，据称是首个专门评估大语言模型（LLM）数学图表生成能力的基准，并在统一设置中同时评测 text-to-code 与 text-to-image 两种生成范式，且与底层代码语言或模型类型无关。作者从 Math-Vision 基准的 3040 幅图像中选出 2920 幅来自高质量竞赛题且含必要视觉上下文的图像，构建了结合 LLM 集成与领域专家（SME）人工策划的数据流水线及评估指标。在多个主流模型上的测试显示，LLM 在这类数学图表生成任务上表现困难。
Motivation: 数学图表生成需要空间推理、数学推理与渲染系统的精确协调，但此前缺少专门针对数学图表生成的标准化的 prompt-图像对评测集；现有基准如 MathVision、MathVista 面向数学推理，DiagramGenBenchmark、MermaidSeqBench 面向通用图表生成，无法覆盖这一特定能力。
Method: 提出 Math-Vision Diagrams 基准，从 Math-Vision 中筛选 2920 幅竞赛问题图像，采用多 LLM 集成与领域专家人工策划相结合的流水线来构造 prompt-图像对，并配套一套评估指标；该基准同时覆盖 text-to-code 与 text-to-image 两种生成路径，且不依赖具体代码语言。
Result: 通过对多个领先模型的测试，摘要表明 LLM 在数学图表生成上仍存在明显困难（struggle），但未给出具体数值或榜单。
Conclusion: 作者认为这是首个专门评估数学图表生成的基准，也是首个在统一框架中联合评测 text-to-code 与 text-to-image 范式的工作；所有代码、数据、策划流水线和评估脚本将完全开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Fourier Self-Supervision for Fine-Grained Generalized Category Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Generalized Category Discovery aims to recognize known categories while identifying novel ones within unlabeled data. Existing methods, typically based on self-supervision and contrastive learning, often struggle to capture fine-grained distinctions, relying on superficial visual cues rather than the intrinsic attributes humans use for categorization. We introduce Fourier Self-Supervision, that leverages the Fourier transform of images to enhance the discrimination of subtle differences and support the discovery of new categories. Our method employs a dual frequency filtering strategy: a low-pass filter first extracts broad, abstract attributes that capture high-level category information, while a high-pass filter emphasizes fine details such as edges and textures that are essential for fine-grained recognition. Each operates on a dedicated latent space, and their overlapping representations together yield a richer, more complete feature space. This dual-frequency approach not only refines feature extraction to identify novel categories, but also strengthens the model's discriminative power in fine-grained category discovery. Experiments on multiple fine-grained datasets show that incorporating Fourier Self-Supervision outperforms state-of-the-art methods, even when the number of classes is unknown, demonstrating its effectiveness for Generalized Category Discovery. Our code is available at: https://github.com/SarahRastegar/FourEx.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Fourier Self-Supervision 方法用于细粒度广义类别发现 (Generalized Category Discovery)，通过图像的傅里叶变换提取双频特征：低通滤波捕获抽象高层类别信息，高通滤波强调边缘与纹理等细粒度细节，并在各自潜在空间上学习后融合。实验在多个细粒度数据集上超越现有方法，且不依赖已知类别数。
Motivation: 现有基于自监督和对比学习 (contrastive learning) 的广义类别发现方法往往依赖表面视觉线索，难以捕捉人类分类所用的内在属性，导致细粒度区分能力不足。
Method: 提出傅里叶自监督策略，采用低通与高通双滤波器分别作用于不同的潜在空间，提取互补的类别级与细节级表示，并将重叠表示融合为更丰富的特征空间。
Result: 在多个细粒度数据集上的实验表明，即使类别数未知，该方法也优于现有最先进方法，验证了其在细粒度类别发现中的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者强调双频傅里叶自监督能细化特征提取并增强判别力，代码已开源；摘要未讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gradient Under Microscope: Benchmarking Resource Utilization of Memory-Efficient Gradient Computation Methods
papers.abstract_en: AI training's rising resource intensity is straining electricity supplies and carbon budgets, motivating systematic study of memory-efficient training on constrained hardware. We benchmark five gradient optimizers (SGD, Adam, Adagrad, Adadelta, and Conjugate Gradient Descent) under three memory strategies (standard training, gradient checkpointing, and gradient accumulation) across four transformer architectures (ViT, ModernBERT, Llama 3.1 1B, and NanoVLM), measuring training loss, GPU utilization, training time, and memory usage. Gradient accumulation emerges as the most reliable strategy, cutting training loss by roughly an order of magnitude on the vision-language model and about four-fold on the language model without additional GPU memory. Contrary to common practice, Adam is not universally superior: Adadelta and SGD outperform it on the encoder and autoregressive architectures. Gradient checkpointing's effect is strongly architecture-dependent, improving vision transformer loss while severely degrading the encoder model, and it increases training time by up to 60% on memory-bound models. GPU utilization is governed primarily by architecture, ranging from 8-15% for the memory-bound language model to 96-99% for compute-bound vision models. These findings provide practical guidelines for optimizer and gradient-strategy selection in resource-efficient model training and deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评测了五种梯度优化器（SGD、Adam、Adagrad、Adadelta、共轭梯度下降 Conjugate Gradient Descent）与三种显存策略（标准训练、梯度检查点 gradient checkpointing、梯度累积 gradient accumulation）在四种 Transformer 架构（ViT、ModernBERT、Llama 3.1 1B、NanoVLM）上的表现，测量训练损失、GPU 利用率、训练时间和显存占用。摘要报告梯度累积是最稳定的策略，在不增加显存的情况下使视觉-语言模型训练损失降低约一个数量级、语言模型降低约四倍；梯度检查点的效果则高度依赖架构。
Motivation: AI 训练的资源消耗正在给电力供应和碳预算带来压力，而现有工作缺乏对受限硬件上记忆高效训练方法的系统比较，因此作者希望为优化器与显存策略的选择提供可操作的经验依据。
Method: 在四种 Transformer 架构上，对五种优化器与三种显存策略进行交叉基准测试，记录训练损失、GPU 利用率、训练时间和显存使用，并据此比较不同策略组合的资源利用效率。
Result: 梯度累积最稳定：在 NanoVLM 上训练损失降低约一个数量级，在语言模型上降低约四倍，且无需额外显存。Adam 并非普遍最优，Adadelta 和 SGD 在 encoder 与自回归架构上优于它。梯度检查点在 ViT 上改善损失但严重损害 encoder，并在 memory-bound 模型上使训练时间最多增加 60%。GPU 利用率主要由架构决定，范围从 memory-bound 语言模型的 8-15% 到 compute-bound 视觉模型的 96-99%。
Conclusion: 作者给出的结论是：梯度累积是资源高效训练中最可靠的默认选择，Adam 的优越性因架构而异，梯度检查点的取舍需结合架构的显存与计算特征；这些发现被定位为面向资源受限模型训练与部署的实用指南。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reading is not Reasoning: Bridging the Agentic Policy Gap in Vision-Text Compression
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step language-model agents repeatedly process growing interaction histories, leading to substantial context costs. Vision--text compression reduces these costs by rendering history as images, but the resulting modality shift creates a marked capability gap. Through controlled evaluations of history recovery, matched-state decisions, and complete trajectories, we show that this gap cannot be explained by OCR quality alone. Visual-history agents exhibit systematic drift in action selection, query formulation, stopping, and evidence use, revealing an agentic policy gap. We introduce \textbf{CAPS}, a two-stage \textbf{C}ross-modal \textbf{A}gentic \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{S}elf-distillation framework that uses the same model's stronger text-history policy to supervise its visual-history counterpart. Offline trajectory self-distillation transfers successful text-policy behavior to visual-history inputs, while online policy self-distillation provides dense supervision on states visited by the visual-history policy during reinforcement learning. On SearchQA, CAPS improves over AgentOCR by 5.0\% and 3.4\% with 3B and 7B backbones, respectively. On full-history ALFWorld, the corresponding gains are 15.6\% and 14.5\%. Across settings, CAPS reduces average memory-context cost by up to 63.3\% and peak cost by up to 83.4\% relative to matched text-history policies. These results show that explicit cross-modal policy self-distillation can preserve agent capability under vision--text compression. Our code will be made publicly available in a future release.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多步语言模型智能体在将交互历史压缩为图像后产生的能力下降问题，指出该差距无法仅由 OCR 质量解释，而源于动作选择、查询生成、停止和证据使用上的系统性漂移，即智能体策略差距 (agentic policy gap)。作者提出 CAPS，一种两阶段跨模态智能体策略自蒸馏 (cross-modal agentic policy self-distillation) 框架，用同一模型更强的文本历史策略来监督其视觉历史对应策略，在 SearchQA 和 ALFWorld 上超越 AgentOCR，并大幅降低记忆上下文开销。
Motivation: 多步语言模型智能体反复处理不断增长的交互历史，产生高昂上下文成本；视觉-文本压缩 (vision-text compression) 可降低该成本，但模态转换带来明显的能力差距，需要理解并弥补这一差距。
Method: 提出 CAPS 框架，包含两阶段自蒸馏：离线轨迹自蒸馏将成功的文本策略行为迁移到视觉历史输入，在线策略自蒸馏则在强化学习期间对视觉历史策略访问的状态提供密集监督。
Result: 在 SearchQA 上，CAPS 在 3B 和 7B 主干上分别较 AgentOCR 提升 5.0% 和 3.4%；在完整历史的 ALFWorld 上对应提升为 15.6% 和 14.5%。相较匹配的文本历史策略，平均记忆上下文成本最多降低 63.3%，峰值成本最多降低 83.4%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式的跨模态策略自蒸馏能够在视觉-文本压缩下保持智能体能力，并说明代码将在未来版本中公开。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究多步语言模型智能体在将交互历史压缩为图像后产生的能力下降问题，指出该差距无法仅由 OCR 质量解释，而源于动作选择、查询生成、停止和证据使用上的系统性漂移，即智能体策略差距 (agentic policy gap)。作者提出 CAPS，一种两阶段跨模态智能体策略自蒸馏 (cross-modal agentic policy self-distillation) 框架，用同一模型更强的文本历史策略来监督其视觉历史对应策略，在 SearchQA 和 ALFWorld 上超越 AgentOCR，并大幅降低记忆上下文开销。
summary_sections.motivation: 多步语言模型智能体反复处理不断增长的交互历史，产生高昂上下文成本；视觉-文本压缩 (vision-text compression) 可降低该成本，但模态转换带来明显的能力差距，需要理解并弥补这一差距。
summary_sections.method: 提出 CAPS 框架，包含两阶段自蒸馏：离线轨迹自蒸馏将成功的文本策略行为迁移到视觉历史输入，在线策略自蒸馏则在强化学习期间对视觉历史策略访问的状态提供密集监督。
summary_sections.result: 在 SearchQA 上，CAPS 在 3B 和 7B 主干上分别较 AgentOCR 提升 5.0% 和 3.4%；在完整历史的 ALFWorld 上对应提升为 15.6% 和 14.5%。相较匹配的文本历史策略，平均记忆上下文成本最多降低 63.3%，峰值成本最多降低 83.4%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调显式的跨模态策略自蒸馏能够在视觉-文本压缩下保持智能体能力，并说明代码将在未来版本中公开。

papers.title: Depth-Aware Implicit Neural Representation Priors for 3D Gravity Inversion
papers.abstract_en: Gravimetry images subsurface density contrasts associated with geological structures, geothermal systems, and intrusive bodies. Recovering a three-dimensional density model from gravity observations is highly ill-posed because of its non-uniqueness, limited data coverage, and the attenuation of the gravity field with depth. Classical inversion methods rely on explicit regularization and parameter tuning, whereas supervised deep-learning approaches require representative gravity--density pairs that are rarely available. This paper proposes an unsupervised depth-aware implicit neural representation for 3D gravity inversion. The density volume is represented by multiple coordinate-based neural networks assigned to overlapping depth slabs and optimized directly from the observed gravity measurements through the sensitivity matrix. Slab-specific Fourier features, physics-based depth gains, and scheduled regularization provide structural priors without requiring labeled density models. Experiments on four synthetic scenarios show that the proposed method provides better overall performance in terms of RMSE, PSNR, and SSIM than the evaluated conventional and neural baselines. It also recovers more compact and spatially coherent density bodies, improves the separation of nearby anomalies, preserves internal structures, and reconstructs their vertical extent better. These results indicate that the proposed depth-aware formulation helps to mitigate the depth ambiguity inherent in gravity inversion. In the field experiment, where no ground-truth density model was available, the method produced compact, separated, and vertically coherent anomalies consistent with the observed gravity pattern.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无监督的深度感知隐式神经表示用于3D重力反演：将密度体积表示为多个分配给重叠深度切片 (depth slabs) 的坐标基神经网络，通过灵敏度矩阵直接从观测重力数据优化，无需标注密度模型。在四个合成场景上，该方法在 RMSE、PSNR 和 SSIM 上优于所评估的传统与神经基线，恢复出更紧凑、空间连贯的密度体，并改善异常分离与垂直范围重建。野外实验中无真值密度模型，仍产生了与观测重力模式一致的紧凑、分离且垂直连贯的异常。
Motivation: 重力反演因非唯一性、数据覆盖有限以及重力场随深度衰减而高度病态。经典方法依赖显式正则化与参数调节，监督式深度学习方法又需要现实中很少具备的代表性重力-密度配对数据。
Method: 提出无监督的深度感知隐式神经表示架构：密度体积由多个分配给重叠深度切片的坐标基神经网络表示，利用灵敏度矩阵直接从观测重力测量优化；模型引入切片特定的傅里叶特征、基于物理的深度增益和计划正则化作为结构先验，无需标注密度模型。
Result: 在四个合成场景下，该方法在 RMSE、PSNR 和 SSIM 上全面优于所比较的常规与神经基线；恢复出的密度体更紧凑且空间更连贯，相邻异常分离更好，内部结构得以保留，垂直范围重建也更准确。
Conclusion: 作者认为深度感知的公式化设计有助于缓解重力反演固有的深度模糊性；野外实验虽无真值，但结果与观测重力模式一致，表现出紧凑、分离且垂直连贯的异常特征。

papers.title: Idea Search: Guiding Tree Search with Ideas to Explore Diverse Scientific Methods
papers.abstract_en: Tree Search-based test-time scaling of LLMs is a powerful tool for automated scientific coding. However, pure Tree Search sometimes struggles with systematic exploration, becoming trapped in local optima, or unproductive loops, especially in the vast search space of scientific methods. To address this limitation, we propose Idea Search, a framework that systematically integrates a dynamic "Idea Bank" into Tree Search. Idea Search involves three steps: (1) decomposing existing methods into atomic ideas, (2) sampling from this bank of ideas to guide branches of code mutations, and (3) dynamically updating the bank with new ideas discovered through execution. On single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) batch integration, Idea Search reliably breaks the plateau of a strong pure Tree Search baseline, improving the mean score from 0.678 to 0.697 and reaching a best score of 0.728. We then characterize which design choices drive these gains: bank augmentation helps bandit sampling but not random sampling, "Exploratory" prompting that prioritizes new ideas surfaces the rare best-performing solutions, while increasing sampling-level exploration is counterproductive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Idea Search 框架，将动态的“Idea Bank”集成进 Tree Search，以改善 LLM 在自动化科学编码中的测试时扩展（test-time scaling）。该方法把现有方法分解为原子想法，采样这些想法引导代码变异分支，并根据执行结果动态更新想法库。在单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）批次整合任务上，该方法显著突破强纯 Tree Search 基线的平台期，均值分数从 0.678 提升到 0.697，最佳分数达 0.728。
Motivation: 纯 Tree Search 在自动化科学编码中常陷入局部最优或无产出的循环，尤其在科学方法的巨大搜索空间中缺乏系统性探索，导致测试时扩展收益受限。
Method: 提出三步骤框架：将现有方法分解为原子想法（atomic ideas），从 Idea Bank 中采样想法来指导代码变异分支，并通过执行新发现动态更新想法库；同时研究了不同提示策略与采样方式的组合。
Result: 在 scRNA-seq 批次整合上，Idea Search 将强纯 Tree Search 基线的平均分从 0.678 提升到 0.697，最佳分达到 0.728。设计选择分析显示：bank 增广（bank augmentation）对 bandit 采样有效但不利于随机采样；优先新想法的“Exploratory”提示能浮现罕见的最优解，而增加采样级探索反而有害。
Conclusion: 作者认为将动态想法库与 Tree Search 结合可以避免局部最优并实现更系统的科学方法探索，但收益依赖具体采样策略与提示设计，并非所有探索增强都有效。

papers.title: RMR-Net: Degradation-Evidence-Guided Road-Image Restoration for Defect Detection
papers.abstract_en: Vehicle-mounted road cameras are vulnerable to motion blur, defocus, poor illumination, and noise, which can erase thin cracks and pothole boundaries needed by road defect detectors. This paper presents RMR-Net, a compact task-aware restoration front end that estimates degradation evidence from the image, optionally fuses it with existing corruption context/parameters, conditions lightweight restoration blocks, and returns high-frequency pavement detail through a bounded residual path. The experimental scope is deliberately controlled: the conditioning information used on the Image and Vision Computing New Zealand (IVCNZ) pothole dataset and the Road Damage Dataset: Potholes, Cracks and Manholes (PCM) consists of saved synthetic-generator parameters, not measured vehicle telemetry. A clean-trained, frozen YOLO11s detector evaluates every image source. Across eight held-out degradation conditions, RMR-Net obtains the highest mAP50 in seven, including 0.140-0.427 for IVCNZ motion blur and 0.060-0.233 for PCM defocus. A compact ablation identifies the bounded detail path as the largest local contributor, while degradation conditioning and detector-aware stability terms provide complementary guidance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RMR-Net，一种面向车载道路图像的紧凑任务感知复原前端，用于帮助道路缺陷检测。它从图像估计退化证据，可选地与已有退化上下文/参数融合，条件化轻量复原块，并通过有界残差路径返回高频路面细节。在 IVCNZ 坑洼数据集与 PCM 数据集上，使用保存的合成生成器参数作为条件信息，并用干净训练、冻结的 YOLO11s 检测器评估；在八个保留退化条件下，其中七项取得最高 mAP50。
Motivation: 车载道路相机易受运动模糊、失焦、光照不足和噪声影响，这些退化会抹掉细裂纹和坑洼边界等缺陷检测器所需的关键信息，导致缺陷漏检。
Method: 提出 RMR-Net 复原前端：估计图像退化证据，可选择与现有退化上下文/参数融合，对轻量复原块进行条件化，并通过有界残差路径保留高频路面细节；评估时使用干净训练且冻结的 YOLO11s 检测器。
Result: 在八个保留退化条件下，RMR-Net 在其中七项取得最高 mAP50，例如 IVCNZ 运动模糊为 0.140-0.427，PCM 失焦为 0.060-0.233。紧凑消融表明有界细节路径是最大的局部贡献者，退化条件化和检测器感知的稳定性项提供互补引导。
Conclusion: 摘要强调实验范围刻意受控：条件信息使用保存的合成生成器参数而非实测车辆遥测数据；该方法在受控退化条件下能提升缺陷检测精度，但未涉及真实遥测条件下的泛化表现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Damage Classification for 3D Point Cloud Data via 3D Data Analysis and Vision Foundation Model-based 2D Projections
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained damage classification of 3D point cloud data (PCD) remains a persistent challenge, constrained by high computational demands and limited labeled data. This study examines two methods: 3D PCD-based damage assessment (3PDA) algorithm and 2D projection damage assessment (2PDA) In our 3PDA analysis algorithm, TDA is used to derive compact representations of 3D PCD segmented by pointNet, which are then integrated with anomaly detection algorithms to quantify structural degradation. We show that TDA effectively compresses geometric structure from VFM-segmented components into discriminative feature vectors and that anomaly detection models can reliably distinguish components with varying damage severity using only 3D PCD inputs. In the 2D projection analysis algorithm, we leverage large VFMs for granular damage detection by projecting 3D PCD into 2D views. These projections allow VFM based models to achieve competitive classification performance while requiring only a fraction of the computational cost associated with full 3D data processing. Our results demonstrate that 2D VFM pipelines in 2PDA can perform strongly on fine-grained damage classification tasks, highlighting their viability as lightweight, resource-efficient alternatives to traditional 3PDA architectures. Comparative evaluation shows that the 3PDA attains higher accuracy but only for a narrow subset of object geometries and at substantially higher computational cost due to its reliance on TDA and the scarcity of high-fidelity 3D datasets. In contrast, the 2PDA algorithm yields slightly lower accuracy but offers an order of magnitude reduction in time complexity and generalizes across a far broader range of object categories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对三维点云数据（PCD）的细粒度损伤分类问题，比较了两种方法：基于 3D PCD 的损伤评估（3PDA）和基于 2D 投影的损伤评估（2PDA）。3PDA 使用拓扑数据分析（TDA）对 PointNet 分割后的组件提取紧致表示，再结合异常检测量化结构退化；2PDA 则将 3D PCD 投影为 2D 视图，借助大型视觉基础模型（VFM）进行损伤检测。结果表明 2PDA 在准确率略低的情况下，时间复杂度降低一个数量级，并能泛化到更广的对象类别。
Motivation: 细粒度三维点云损伤分类长期受限于高计算需求和标注数据稀缺，现有方法难以兼顾精度与效率。
Method: 提出两条技术路线：3PDA 用 TDA 将 VFM 分割组件的几何结构压缩为判别性特征向量，再配合异常检测模型；2PDA 将 3D PCD 投影成 2D 视图并利用大型 VFM 进行细粒度损伤分类。
Result: 摘要报告 3PDA 在较窄的对象几何子集上准确率更高，但依赖 TDA 且计算开销显著；2PDA 准确率略低，但时间复杂度降低约一个数量级，并能在更广泛的对象类别上泛化。
Conclusion: 作者认为 2D VFM 流程在细粒度损伤分类上表现强劲，可作为传统 3PDA 架构的轻量级、资源高效替代方案。

papers.title: Do AI Forecast Ensembles Sample the Correct Conditional Distribution?
papers.abstract_en: Ensemble forecasting aims to sample the conditional distribution of outcomes; whether AI forecast ensembles do this correctly in a joint sense remains largely untested. We train a diffusion model for probabilistic subseasonal coastal sea level forecasts at eight US East Coast tide gauge stations, with sea level derived from reanalysis, and find that marginal and joint forecast quality decouple: positive skill at every station and lead time marginally, while joint spatial structure is worse than climatological draws. A shuffle-based permutation decomposition reveals this failure is invisible to the energy score but detected by the variogram score. Lorenz-96 experiments across 0.7-170 equivalent years show the gap persists regardless of training volume and is reproduced by a linear baseline, indicating structural inadequacy of the learned distribution. A dynamical ensemble does not replicate the failure while a deterministic emulator does, suggesting it is specific to learned emulators rather than ensemble forecasting generally.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文检验AI预报集成是否在联合意义上正确采样条件分布。作者训练扩散模型进行美国东海岸8个潮汐站的海平面次季节概率预报，发现边缘和联合预报质量解耦：各站和各提前期的边缘技能为正，但联合空间结构劣于气候学抽样。通过shuffle置换分解，该失败对能量分数不可见但能被variogram分数检测，且Lorenz-96实验表明该差距不随训练量增加而消失，线性基线也能复现，提示学习分布存在结构性不足。
Motivation: 集成预报的目标是采样结果的联合条件分布，但AI预报集成是否在联合意义上正确采样这一点尚未被充分检验。
Method: 训练一个扩散模型用于概率次季节沿海海平面预报，数据来自再分析；使用基于shuffle的置换分解，并对比能量分数和variogram分数；在Lorenz-96系统上跨0.7-170等效年做实验，并引入线性基线与动力学集成、确定性仿真器进行对照。
Result: 摘要报告各站点与提前期的边缘技能为正，但联合空间结构比气候学抽样更差；该失败无法被能量分数感知，却能由variogram分数检测；训练量增加不能消除差距，线性基线可以复现该现象；动力学集成不复制该失败，而确定性仿真器会复制。
Conclusion: 学习型仿真器（learned emulator）所学的联合分布存在结构性不足，该问题特定于学习型仿真器而非集成预报的一般特性。

papers.title: Topology-Aware Global-Local Mamba Networks for Palm Vein Biometrics
papers.abstract_en: Palm-vein recognition is a fine-grained biometric task in which both local vascular texture and the global layout of the vessel tree carry discriminative information, while public datasets remain limited. We propose a topology-aware global-local backbone that combines multi-scale local features, a structureguided directional stream built on a fixed Sobel-magnitude edge prior, and a four-direction state-space scan global pathway within six Topology-Aware Blocks. A staged gated fusion integrates local, structural, and global representations in that order. On HKPUNIR, our method achieves 99.13% top-1 accuracy and 0.08% EER with 7.2 M parameters; on VERA Palm Vein, it achieves 92.42% accuracy and 0.61% EER. Across both datasets it attains the lowest EER among ResNet50, Vim-S, ViT-S, and GLVM at the smallest parameter count, while GLVM remains the strongest in top-1 accuracy and the cheapest in FLOPs. Code is available upon request.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向掌静脉识别的拓扑感知全局-局部骨干网络（Topology-Aware Global-Local Mamba Networks），在多尺度局部特征基础上引入基于固定 Sobel 幅值边缘先验的结构引导方向流，以及四方向状态空间扫描的全局通路，并设计六层 Topology-Aware Block 与分阶段门控融合。在 HKPUNIR 上达到 99.13% top-1 准确率和 0.08% EER，在 VERA Palm Vein 上达到 92.42% 准确率和 0.61% EER，参数量为 7.2 M。
Motivation: 掌静脉识别是细粒度生物识别任务，局部血管纹理与血管树的全局布局都包含判别信息，同时公开数据集规模有限，现有方法难以同时建模局部纹理与全局拓扑结构。
Method: 提出结合多尺度局部特征、基于固定 Sobel 幅值边缘先验的结构引导方向流，以及四方向状态空间扫描全局路径的骨干网络，并通过分阶段门控融合依次整合局部、结构与全局表示。
Result: 在 HKPUNIR 上 top-1 准确率为 99.13%、EER 为 0.08%；在 VERA Palm Vein 上准确率为 92.42%、EER 为 0.61%。两个数据集上，该方法以最小参数量取得低于 ResNet50、Vim-S、ViT-S 和 GLVM 的 EER，但 GLVM 在 top-1 准确率与 FLOPs 上仍占优。
Conclusion: 作者认为拓扑感知的局部-全局建模对掌静脉识别有效，并在小参数量下取得较好的 EER；代码可按需获取。

papers.title: EndoMD-SLAM: Endoscopic Gaussian Splatting SLAM under Optical Degradation with Memory and Static-Transient Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Dense 3D reconstruction is critical for clinical endoscopic navigation and documentation. While Gaussian Splatting SLAM systems show promise in this domain, they fundamentally rely on strict multi-view photometric consistency. In routine procedures, this assumption is severely violated by intermittent optical degradations like moving debris and water flushing. Standard systems erroneously fuse these cameraattached artifacts into the persistent 3D geometry, causing severe tracking drift and irreversible map corruption. To address this limitation, we propose EndoMD-SLAM, a framework designed to maintain stability under optical degradation through specialized tracking and mapping mechanisms. On the tracking side, a memory-driven gating mechanism detects unreliable observations to suspend map updates and utilizes historical keyframes for drift-aware relocalization. On the mapping side, a self-supervised static-transient decomposition isolates visual contaminants into a dedicated transient field. This explicit separation prevents artifacts from structurally entangling with the persistent anatomical map. We curate a degradationfocused benchmark from colonoscopy videos to systematically evaluate these failure modes. Extensive experiments show that while standard baselines fail under severe optical degradation, EndoMD-SLAM preserves geometric integrity, reducing absolute trajectory error by 91% and improving rendering fidelity by 9.9 dB PSNR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EndoMD-SLAM，面向内窥镜场景中光学退化（如移动碎屑、水冲洗）下的高斯溅射 SLAM（Gaussian Splatting SLAM）。跟踪侧引入记忆驱动门控机制来暂停地图更新并利用历史关键帧进行漂移感知重定位；建图侧通过自监督的静态-瞬态分解（static-transient decomposition）将视觉污染物隔离到独立瞬态场中，避免其与持久解剖结构地图纠缠。作者从结肠镜视频构建了面向退化场景的基准，实验显示在严重光学退化下标准基线失效，而 EndoMD-SLAM 将绝对轨迹误差降低 91%，渲染保真度提升 9.9 dB PSNR。
Motivation: 现有高斯溅射 SLAM 系统依赖严格的多视角光度一致性，而常规内窥镜操作中碎屑和水冲洗会间歇性破坏这一假设，导致系统将附着于镜头的伪影错误融合进持久几何，造成严重跟踪漂移和不可逆的地图破坏。
Method: 在跟踪端提出记忆驱动门控机制，检测不可靠观测并暂停地图更新，同时利用历史关键帧进行漂移感知的重定位；在建图端采用自监督静态-瞬态分解，将视觉污染物显式分离至独立瞬态场，避免与解剖结构地图结构纠缠。作者还从结肠镜视频中构建了聚焦退化的基准数据集。
Result: 在严重光学退化下标准基线方法失败，而 EndoMD-SLAM 保持了几何完整性，绝对轨迹误差（ATE）降低 91%，渲染保真度（PSNR）提升 9.9 dB。
Conclusion: 作者强调将瞬态伪影与持久解剖地图显式分离是维持退化条件下建图稳定性的关键，所提框架能在光学退化下保持系统稳定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can Webcam Gaze Constrain Mesa-Objectives in Driving Models? An Instrument Precision Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Current hazard detection systems in autonomous driving may develop mesa objectives, learned internal goals that achieve high training performance through spurious correlations rather than genuine hazard recognition. We investigate whether human gaze patterns, captured via webcam-based eye tracking (WebGazer.js), can serve as privileged information to constrain mesa-objective formation. We collected 137,663 frame-level gaze samples synchronized with hazard annotations across 388 real dashcam clips, then test this hypothesis across two calibration protocols (9-point/45-click and 11-point/440-click), two model architectures (Random Forest and causal Transformer), and five random seeds per experiment with paired t-tests. No experiment yields a statistically significant improvement from gaze (p = 0.919, 0.578, and 0.667 respectively). A geometric analysis reveals the root cause: WebGazer's reported error (~130-257 px depending on configuration) exceeds 93% of detected hazard object sizes (median 36 px), rendering object-level gaze attribution physically impossible at this instrument precision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自动驾驶危险检测系统中可能形成的 mesa-objectives（因虚假相关而非真正危险识别获得高训练性能的内在目标），检验网络摄像头眼动追踪（WebGazer.js）能否作为特权信息约束该目标的形成。作者收集了 137,663 帧与危险标注同步的注视样本（来自 388 段真实行车记录仪片段），在两种标定协议、两种模型架构和五个随机种子下做实验，未获得统计显著的改进（p 值分别为 0.919、0.578、0.667）。几何分析指出根因：WebGazer 的报告误差（约 130–257 px）超过 93% 检测到的危险目标尺寸（中位 36 px），使对象级注视归因在此仪器精度下物理上不可行。
Motivation: 危险检测系统可能学到通过虚假相关达到高训练性能的 mesa-objectives，而非真正的危险识别能力，因此需要外部信息加以约束；人类注视是候选的特权信息，但低成本网络摄像头眼动追踪的精度是否足以支撑对象级注视归因尚不清楚。
Method: 使用 WebGazer.js 采集与危险标注同步的眼动数据，共 137,663 帧、覆盖 388 段真实行车记录仪片段。实验比较两种标定协议（9 点/45 次点击 与 11 点/440 次点击）、两种模型架构（Random Forest 与因果 Transformer），每组实验用五个随机种子并做配对 t 检验；同时进行几何分析，将仪器报告误差与检测到的危险目标尺寸对比。
Result: 所有实验均未显示 gaze 带来的统计显著改进（p 值分别为 0.919、0.578、0.667）。几何分析表明 WebGazer 的误差约 130–257 px，超过了 93% 检测到的危险目标尺寸（中位 36 px），因此对象级注视归因在当前仪器精度下不可能实现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调当前网络摄像头眼动追踪的精度不足以约束驾驶模型中的 mesa-objectives；在该仪器误差与目标尺寸不匹配得到解决之前，需要更高精度眼动设备或尺度相匹配的目标才能继续验证这一思路。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: What Would Fix This RAG Failure? Auditing Counterfactual Response with Paired Evidence Interventions
papers.abstract_en: A failed retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) answer can be consistent with several unseen responses to evidence repair. We introduce Pair-ID, an offline audit that holds one query, retrieval state, and reader constant, then crosses two operations, adding missing support and deleting verified nonsupport, to measure a same-failure counterfactual response vector. A complete funnel over 19,981 benchmark queries identifies 11,105 eligible Qwen failures, from which a prospectively fixed SHA-256 ordering selects 1,200 before generating any sampled response. Among 1,190 regenerated-valid failures, support addition repairs 197/600 JOINT cases (0.328, 95% CI [0.292, 0.367]), and deletion repairs 162/1,190 cases (0.136, 95% CI [0.117, 0.155]); length- and position-matched shams retain semantic contrasts of 0.223 and 0.101. The original view carries partial predictive signal for individual response cells (macro AUROC 0.678; Brier 0.152 versus 0.160 for a marginal baseline), but exact-vector accuracy, 0.637, does not exceed the 0.646 majority-vector baseline, and vector macro-F1 is 0.170. Across four readers, both marginal sensitivities recur, while pooled exact-vector agreement is 0.675-0.765 and JOINT-only agreement falls to 0.538-0.691. These results show that evidence sensitivity occurs at meaningful rates in the hash-selected eligible-failure sample, is only partially predictable from the observed failure, and is conditional on the reader. The evidence supports a frame-scoped offline response audit, not an information-theoretic impossibility result, reader-independent taxonomy, or runtime repair policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pair-ID，一种针对检索增强生成（RAG）失败的离线审计方法：固定查询、检索状态和阅读器不变，交叉执行“添加缺失支持”与“删除已验证不支持”两种证据干预，测量同一失败下的反事实响应向量。基于 19,981 条基准查询的完整漏斗筛选出 11,105 个符合条件的 Qwen 失败样本，再经哈希排序前瞻性地选取 1,200 个。结果显示证据敏感性以有意义的比率出现，但只能从观察到的失败中部分预测，且依赖具体阅读器。
Motivation: 一个失败的 RAG 回答可能同时与多种未见的证据修复结果相容，因此需要离线审计来回答“什么能修复这种失败”，并检验失败是否可预测、是否与阅读器相关。
Method: Pair-ID 采用配对证据干预实验设计，保持查询、检索状态和阅读器不变，比较添加缺失支持与删除已验证不支持两种操作；通过完整漏斗筛选合格失败样本，并用 SHA-256 排序在生成任何采样响应之前前瞻性选出 1,200 个案例，最终在 1,190 个可重新生成的有效失败上评估修复率与预测性能。
Result: 支持添加修复了 197/600 个 JOINT 案例（0.328，95% CI [0.292, 0.367]），删除修复了 162/1,190 个案例（0.136，95% CI [0.117, 0.155]）；长度和位置匹配的虚假干预保留了 0.223 和 0.101 的语义差异。原始失败视图对单个响应单元有部分预测信号（macro AUROC 0.678，Brier 0.152），但精确向量准确率 0.637 未超过 0.646 的多数向量基线，向量 macro-F1 仅为 0.170；四种阅读器下边际敏感性重现，而精确向量一致性在 0.675-0.765 之间，JOINT 案例一致性降至 0.538-0.691。
Conclusion: 作者认为证据敏感性在哈希选出的合格失败样本中以有意义比率出现，仅能部分从观察到的失败预测，并且依赖于阅读器；这支持一种限定框架的离线响应审计，而非信息论不可能性结论、与阅读器无关的分类或运行时修复策略。

papers.title: From Operational Design Domain to Action: A Systematic Behavioral Taxonomy for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Operational Design Domain (ODD) specifications describe where an automated driving system (ADS) is permitted to operate, but they do not prescribe what the ADS must demonstrably do once deployed within that domain. This gap between operating condition specification and behavioral validation represents a critical unresolved challenge in ADS safety assurance. This paper presents a structured, standards-grounded taxonomy of 21 behavioral competencies organized across three operational domains-Highway (HWY), Urban (URB), and Hub (HUB)-derived systematically from the PEGASUS six-layer model-based ODD. Each behavior is decomposed along longitudinal and lateral control axes and characterized against a four-property framework: Safety (gap maintenance, conflict avoidance, kinematic stability), Compliance (legal rules and behavioral norms), Comfort (rider dynamics and trust), and Efficiency (mission completion and product-level metrics). We further demonstrate that the crossing of ODD layer parameterizations with behavioral competency specifications yields concrete scenario families suitable for systematic behavioral testing and SOTIF coverage evidence. The taxonomy is grounded in AVSC00008202111, SAE J3237, and SAE J3016, and is validated as an operational specification layer through its deployment in a rule-enforced trajectory optimization system. The Hub domain is identified as a structurally distinct, underspecified domain warranting dedicated research attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶系统（ADS）安全性验证中运行设计域（ODD）与实际行为验证之间的缺口，提出一个基于标准的、包含21项行为能力的结构化分类体系，覆盖高速（HWY）、城市（URB）和枢纽（HUB）三个运行域。该分类体系由PEGASUS六层模型ODD系统推导而来，每个行为沿纵向和横向控制轴分解，并用安全性、合规性、舒适性和效率四属性框架刻画。作者还展示了ODD层参数化与行为能力规格相交可生成具体的场景族，用于系统性行为测试和SOTIF覆盖证据，并在规则约束的轨迹优化系统中验证该分类体系作为运行规范层的有效性。
Motivation: ODD规格说明描述了ADS允许运行的环境条件，但并未规定ADS在该域内必须可演示地执行什么行为，这一运行条件规格与行为验证之间的缺口是ADS安全保证中未被解决的关键挑战。
Method: 从PEGASUS六层模型ODD出发，系统性地构建了跨三个运行域的21项行为能力分类体系；每个行为按纵向和横向控制轴分解，并用安全性（Safety）、合规性（Compliance）、舒适性（Comfort）和效率（Efficiency）四属性框架刻画；通过将ODD层参数化与行为能力规格相交，生成适合系统性行为测试与SOTIF覆盖证据的具体场景族。
Result: 该分类体系通过部署在规则约束的轨迹优化系统中得到验证，作为运行规范层有效；此外识别出枢纽（Hub）域是一个结构上独特且规格不足的领域，值得专门研究。摘要未报告定量实验数据。
Conclusion: 该分类体系以AVSC00008202111、SAE J3237和SAE J3016为基础，可作为连接ODD规格与行为验证的操作性规范层；作者特别强调Hub域缺乏充分规格，需要专门的研究关注。

papers.title: Not an A11y: How Android Accessibility Exposes Mobile AI Agents to Indirect Prompt Injection
papers.abstract_en: The rise of autonomous AI agents represents a major paradigm shift in how users interact with mobile devices. Frameworks such as MobileRun and Mobile-Use can autonomously navigate Android applications and execute complex multi-step tasks. To interpret user interfaces, these frameworks rely primarily on Android accessibility (A11y) trees and secondarily on visual screenshots. In this paper, we demonstrate that this architectural dependence on unsanitized accessibility metadata, together with visual input, introduces a systemic vulnerability to indirect prompt injection. We show that adversarial prompts can cause autonomous agents to abandon their original objectives, violate context boundaries, and perform unauthorized device actions. Our empirical evaluation demonstrates goal hijacking, context drift, and unauthorized actions across visually hidden and fully exposed attack scenarios. In aggregate, MobileRun reaches an attack success rate of 0.822 with Gemma4:31B, while Mobile-Use with Qwen3.6:35B reduces this to 0.150 but does not eliminate context drift or unauthorized actions. These findings reveal that current mobile agent frameworks fail to enforce semantic context boundaries, treating passive environmental text as trusted instructions. Finally, we present a taxonomy of these attacks and discuss the need for zero-trust input validation, dedicated security agents, and strict context isolation within mobile agent architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究移动端自主 AI 代理（agent）在依赖 Android 无障碍（accessibility, A11y）树和屏幕截图进行 UI 理解时，对间接提示注入（indirect prompt injection）的系统性脆弱性。作者展示对抗性提示可导致代理放弃原始目标、违反上下文边界并执行未经授权的设备操作。在 MobileRun 和 Mobile-Use 等框架上的实证评估显示，MobileRun 配 Gemma4:31B 的攻击成功率为 0.822，Mobile-Use 配 Qwen3.6:35B 降至 0.150，但并未消除上下文漂移或未授权操作。论文还给出攻击分类，并呼吁零信任输入验证、专用安全代理和严格的上下文隔离。
Motivation: 移动 AI 代理依赖未净化的无障碍元数据（A11y 树）以及视觉截图来解析界面，被动环境文本被视为可信指令，因此存在间接提示注入的系统性安全漏洞。
Method: 通过在视觉隐藏和完全暴露两类攻击场景中构造对抗性提示，测试代理的目标劫持（goal hijacking）、上下文漂移（context drift）和未授权操作，并提出攻击的 taxonomy 以及防御方向。
Result: 摘要报告 MobileRun（Gemma4:31B）的攻击成功率为 0.822；Mobile-Use（Qwen3.6:35B）降至 0.150，但仍存在上下文漂移和未授权操作。
Conclusion: 当前移动代理框架未能强制执行语义上下文边界，需要零信任输入验证、专用安全代理以及严格的上下文隔离来缓解此类攻击。

papers.title: Integrated Multimodal AI System for Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning, Object Sensing, and Damage Analysis
papers.abstract_en: This work presents a unified multimodal AI system for damage assessment that integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) models, thermal spectrum perception, vision foundation model pipelines, and exploratory wireless signal sensing. A RAG component is developed to ground a locally hosted language model in project-specific documentation, including specialized damage level classification criteria to mitigate hallucinations during inference. Controlled comparisons against static few-shot prompting demonstrate that dynamic retrieval improves grounding and factual consistency. We further compare vector-based RAG with a knowledge graph variant constructed via entity-relation extraction, and show that graph-based retrieval produces stronger responses for damage assessment queries requiring cross-document reasoning, motivating hybrid dense, sparse, and graph-aware retrieval. To address limitations of EO imagery under adverse lighting and weather conditions, infrared (IR)/thermal sensing is employed for object detection and segmentation. Our detectors generate candidate detections, yielding improved segmentation of a broad array of objects. Paired IR versus visible spectrum tracking experiments reveal failure modes, motivating multimodal fusion for robust object detection and damage analysis. Vision foundation and vision-language models are leveraged to generate synthetic damage imagery and classify damage severity with high accuracy, supporting training and validation of downstream damage assessment models. Finally, exploratory Wireless-based sensing demonstrates potential to detect presence, motion, and post-event environmental changes where EO and IR sensing are ineffective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向灾害损毁评估的统一多模态 AI 系统，整合检索增强生成（RAG）、热红外感知、视觉基础模型流水线与无线信号感知。摘要显示动态检索比静态 few-shot 提示更能提升grounding与事实一致性，图感知检索在跨文档推理的损毁评估查询上表现更强，红外/热感知用于改善不良光照与天气下的目标检测和分割，视觉-语言模型用于生成合成损毁图像与严重度分类，无线感知则探索 EO 和 IR 失效场景下的存在、运动及灾后环境变化检测。
Motivation: 现有损毁评估依赖 EO 图像在不良光照与天气下受限，且本地语言模型在专业文档推理中容易产生幻觉，缺乏统一的多模态框架来整合检索、热感知与无线感知。
Method: 构建包含 RAG 组件（以项目文档和损毁等级判据 grounding 本地语言模型）、红外/热成像检测与分割流水线、视觉基础模型与视觉-语言模型合成及分类管线，并探索无线信号感知；比较向量 RAG 与基于实体-关系抽取的知识图谱变体，以及 IR 与可见光跟踪实验。
Result: 摘要报告动态检索提升grounding与事实一致性，图感知检索在跨文档损毁评估查询上响应更强；IR 检测器改进物体分割；IR 与可见光跟踪对比暴露失败模式并支持多模态融合；视觉-语言模型能高精度分类损毁严重度；无线感知可检测存在、运动与灾后环境变化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调混合稠密、稀疏与图感知检索的必要性，以及多模态融合对稳健目标检测和损毁分析的价值；无线感知仍处于探索性阶段，主要作为 EO 与 IR 失效场景的补充手段。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Zero-shot 2D Grounding with Novel Affordance Types
papers.abstract_en: 2D affordance grounding aims to locate the region of an object that a human can interact with. Existing research focuses on recognizing affordance types seen during training and does not study models' ability to generalize to novel affordances, which is crucial for real-world applications. We propose the task of zero-shot 2D grounding with novel affordance types (NAT) and introduce the NAT benchmarks. We then propose AffordAnything, a training-free method that leverages segmentation cues, motivated by the strong correlation between affordance regions and object subparts. To further improve performance, we develop AffordAnything+, a trainable variant that learns to combine these cues. On the proposed AGD20K-NAT benchmark, our best model AffordAnything+ achieves a substantial improvement of 12.3% (absolute) in IoU@0.4 over the SOTA affordance grounding method, OOAL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出零样本新功能类型二维定位 (zero-shot 2D grounding with novel affordance types, NAT) 任务及其基准，并给出两类方法：免训练的 AffordAnything 与可训练的 AffordAnything+。在提出的 AGD20K-NAT 基准上，最佳模型 AffordAnything+ 在 IoU@0.4 上较现有 SOTA 功能定位方法 OOAL 取得 12.3% 的绝对提升。
Motivation: 现有 2D 功能定位 (affordance grounding) 研究只处理训练中见过的功能类型，未考察模型对未见功能的泛化能力，而这一能力对真实应用至关重要。
Method: 利用功能区域与对象子部分之间的强相关性，提出免训练方法 AffordAnything，借助分割线索 (segmentation cues) 进行零样本定位；并进一步提出可训练变体 AffordAnything+，让模型学习组合这些线索以提升性能。
Result: 在提出的 AGD20K-NAT 基准上，AffordAnything+ 在 IoU@0.4 上比 SOTA 功能定位方法 OOAL 取得 12.3% 的绝对提升。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，利用分割线索与对象子部分的关联可以为新功能类型实现零样本定位，且用可训练方式组合线索能进一步改善效果。

papers.title: Decoding Phenotypes: A Framework for Fusing Genomic Language Models and Neuroimaging
papers.abstract_en: Neuroimaging and genetic testing are two important clinical references for nervous system diseases, offering complementary diagnostic information. However, integrating genomic and neuroimaging data for precise disease diagnosis is challenging due to cross-modality heterogeneity. Existing imaging-genetics approaches mainly encode genetic information as hard-coded labels, which lose the local sequence context around disease-associated variants. To address this limitation, we propose GeneFuse, a multimodal learning framework that aligns genetic representations from pre-trained Genomic Language Models (GLMs) with features extracted from images. GeneFuse integrates two components: (1) Genotype-Conditioned Feature Modulation (GCFM), a FiLM-inspired module that uses genomic embeddings to modulate image feature maps; and (2) Uncertainty-aware Genomic Residual Fusion (U-GRF), a fusion strategy that uses imaging-derived predictive uncertainty to gate the contribution of genotypic features. We evaluate GeneFuse on early cognitive decline identification (NC vs. MCI) and dementia screening (NC vs. AD). In the APOE-centered setting, GeneFuse achieves AUROCs of 0.77 and 0.83, outperforming existing imaging-genetics fusion methods. These results indicate that GLM-derived genomic embeddings provide additional information to imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeneFuse，一个融合预训练基因组语言模型 (Genomic Language Models, GLMs) 与神经影像特征的多模态学习框架，用于神经系统疾病诊断。框架包含 FiLM 启发的 Genotype-Conditioned Feature Modulation (GCFM) 和基于影像预测不确定性的 Uncertainty-aware Genomic Residual Fusion (U-GRF)。在基于 APOE 的早发性认知下降 (NC vs. MCI) 与痴呆筛查 (NC vs. AD) 任务上，AUROC 分别达到 0.77 和 0.83，优于现有影像-遗传融合方法。
Motivation: 神经影像与基因检测对神经系统疾病提供互补诊断信息，但跨模态异质性使两者整合困难。现有影像-遗传学方法多将遗传信息编码为硬编码标签，丢失疾病相关变异周围的局部序列上下文，因此需要能保留序列上下文的融合方式。
Method: GeneFuse 由两部分组成：一是 GCFM，采用 FiLM 思想用基因组嵌入调制图像特征图；二是 U-GRF，利用影像衍生的预测不确定性来门控基因型特征的贡献，实现不确定性感知的基因残差融合。
Result: 在 APOE 中心的设置下，GeneFuse 在早期认知下降识别 (NC vs. MCI) 上取得 AUROC 0.77，在痴呆筛查 (NC vs. AD) 上取得 AUROC 0.83，均优于现有影像-遗传融合方法。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些结果表明，GLM 衍生的基因组嵌入能为影像数据提供额外信息，从而支持融合基因组语言模型与神经影像用于疾病诊断。

papers.title: From Noise to Meaning: Meaningful Secret Sharing with Tamper Detection for Facial Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Popularity of AI-based face recognition system directly demands protection of sensitive biometric data used for training. Visual secret sharing is an interesting idea, as it splits facial images into secret shares that look random and spread across many institutions. However, these shares look like noise and can easily spark suspicion and recognized as encrypted content. This makes them open to targeted collection and harvest-now-decrypt-later attacks. Additionally, visual secret sharing does not detect tampering, allowing attackers to modify shares and threaten the integrity of reconstruction. In this paper, we introduce a new method that turns distracting noise-like secret shares into visually appealing cover images with additional cryptographic tamper detection. The proposed technique works with visual secret sharing and introduces cover images to embed the shares using adaptive least significant bit steganography. Here, cover images with perceptual transparency are used to store secret shares while guaranteeing complete privacy. A two layer authentication using strong digital watermarking and cryptographic hashing is used to protect the integrity of shares. The proposed technique shows high resilience in stopping bit-flipping, cropping, and substitution attacks. Extensive experiments on multiple public face datasets show that the technique shows better FR accuracy, while eliminating share conspicuousness and guaranteeing integrity. The proposed framework sets a new standard for protecting facial data in such a way that privacy, security, and integrity are protected.
papers.comment: Accepted at the IEEE International Joint Conference on Biometrics (IJCB) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向人脸识别系统中敏感生物特征数据的保护，提出一种将视觉秘密共享 (visual secret sharing) 的噪声状秘密份额嵌入自然封面图像的方法，并加入密码学篡改检测。方法使用自适应最低有效位隐写 (adaptive LSB steganography) 隐藏份额，同时用数字水印和密码学哈希构成两层认证以保证完整性。实验表明该方法在多个公开人脸数据集上保持较好的人脸识别准确率，并能抵御比特翻转、裁剪和替换攻击。
Motivation: 视觉秘密共享生成的秘密份额形似噪声，容易被识别为加密内容并遭到定向收集和 harvest-now-decrypt-later 攻击；此外该方法本身无法检测篡改，攻击者可修改份额威胁重构完整性。
Method: 提出将秘密份额通过自适应最低有效位隐写嵌入到具有感知透明性的封面图像中，以消除份额的显眼性；并利用强数字水印和密码学哈希构建两层认证，保护份额完整性。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多个公开人脸数据集上取得更好的人脸识别准确率，同时消除秘密份额的显眼性并保证完整性，对比特翻转、裁剪和替换攻击具有高韧性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架在隐私、安全与完整性三个维度上为保护人脸数据设立了新标准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Clustered Attractor Manifolds and Dynamical Condensation in Self-Attention
papers.abstract_en: Transformer layers generate state-dependent interaction networks: token representations determine the attention matrix, which in turn updates the representations. We study this feedback in a minimal normalized self-attention dynamics and identify the overlap gap as the central quantity governing its attractor structure in the thermodynamic limit. When tokens form internally aligned clusters and their similarity to members of the same cluster exceeds that to every other cluster by a nonvanishing amount, inter-cluster attention is exponentially suppressed as the dimension increases. This mechanism produces a high-dimensional manifold of clustered fixed points, ranging from a few macroscopic clusters to extensive microscopic fragmentation, and also controls their stability against perturbations. Starting from an unstructured Gaussian state, we find that clustered states nucleate from the diffuse background only above a finite threshold in attention sharpness, giving rise to a dynamical attention-condensation transition.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Supplemental Material: 25 pages, 9 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Transformer 层中由 token 表示决定注意力矩阵、注意力矩阵再更新表示的状态依赖反馈动力学，在最小化归一化自注意力动力学中于热力学极限下识别出重叠间隙作为刻画吸引子结构的关键量。摘要表明，当 token 形成内部对齐的簇、且簇内相似度超过对任意其他簇的相似度一个非消失量时，簇间注意力随维度增加呈指数抑制；由此产生从少数宏观簇到广泛微观碎片的高维簇状不动点流形，并控制其抗扰动稳定性。从无结构高斯态出发，簇态只在注意力锐度超过有限阈值时从弥散背景成核，对应一个动力学注意力凝聚转变。
Motivation: Transformer 层中的自注意力反馈机制使得表示与交互网络相互决定，但其在热力学极限下的吸引子结构缺乏理论刻画；作者希望用最小化模型揭示这一反馈的本质组织原则。
Method: 在最小化归一化自注意力动力学中，以重叠间隙为核心序参量分析高维极限下的不动点结构，考察簇状态的成核条件与稳定性，并研究从无结构高斯态出发的动力学。
Result: 摘要报告簇间注意力随维度指数抑制；系统存在覆盖宏观簇到微观碎片的高维簇状不动点流形；从高斯态出发时，簇态仅在注意力锐度超过有限阈值后成核，形成动力学注意力凝聚转变。
Conclusion: 该工作提出簇状吸引子与注意力凝聚转变的机制，为自注意力反馈动力学的理论理解提供了统一框架；摘要未涉及实验验证或实际 Transformer 任务上的结果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Domain-Structured Ensemble Framework for Perioperative Outcome Prediction Using Electronic Health Record Data
papers.abstract_en: Perioperative risk prediction models are often limited by narrow surgical populations, incomplete intraoperative data, poor calibration, and limited interpretability. We present a domain-structured ensemble framework for perioperative outcome prediction using routinely collected electronic health record (EHR) data. Predictors are organized into patient-related, surgery-related, and anesthetics-related domains. Domain-specific gradient boosting models generate independent risk estimates that are integrated through a logistic regression meta-learner. We demonstrate the framework using postoperative delirium (POD) in a case-control sample of 5,386 surgical encounters (2,693 cases, 2,693 controls) from a statewide health information exchange. POD required both delirium-related ICD codes and a positive Confusion Assessment Method screening within seven postoperative days; patients with preexisting dementia were excluded. The stacked meta-learner achieved AUROC 0.899 (95% CI: 0.891-0.906), precision-recall AUC 0.881, and Brier score 0.126, compared with AUROC 0.849 for the best single-stage model. Domain ablation showed improved discrimination and calibration over a surgery-only model (AUROC 0.879, Brier 0.140). Temporal validation on held-out post-2017 data yielded AUROC 0.915. Calibration was excellent, with intercept -0.006 (95% CI: -0.083 to 0.070) and slope 1.035 (95% CI: 0.982 to 1.088). Decision curve analysis, corrected for case-control sampling, showed positive net benefit across clinically plausible thresholds. The modular framework supports alternative outcomes, extension of predictor domains, and dynamic risk updating, providing a scalable foundation for interpretable, calibration-aware perioperative clinical decision support.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Healthcare Informatics (ICHI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种领域结构化集成框架，用于基于常规电子健康档案 (EHR) 数据的围手术期结局预测。预测变量被划分为患者相关、手术相关和麻醉相关三个领域，各领域用梯度提升模型生成独立风险估计，再通过逻辑回归元学习器整合。研究以术后谵妄 (POD) 为示例，在 5,386 例手术 encounters（2,693 例病例，2,693 例对照）上验证，堆叠元学习器 AUROC 达 0.899，优于最佳单阶段模型的 0.849，且校准良好。
Motivation: 现有围手术期风险预测模型常受限于狭窄手术人群、术中数据不完整、校准差和可解释性有限，难以支撑临床决策支持。
Method: 构建模块化的领域结构化集成框架：将预测因子按患者、手术、麻醉三个领域分组，训练领域特定的梯度提升模型生成独立风险估计，再用逻辑回归元学习器堆叠整合这些估计，并支持领域扩展与动态风险更新。
Result: 在州级健康信息交换的病例对照样本上，堆叠元学习器取得 AUROC 0.899（95% CI: 0.891-0.906）、PR-AUC 0.881、Brier 分数 0.126，优于最佳单阶段模型（AUROC 0.849）；与仅手术模型相比（AUROC 0.879, Brier 0.140）判别和校准均有改善；在 2017 年后数据上的时间验证 AUROC 为 0.915；校准截距 -0.006（95% CI: -0.083 至 0.070）、斜率 1.035（95% CI: 0.982 至 1.088），并经病例对照抽样校正的决策曲线分析显示临床合理阈值下净收益为正。
Conclusion: 该框架具有模块化特点，可扩展至其他结局、扩展预测域并支持动态风险更新，为可解释且校准良好的围手术期临床决策支持提供了可扩展基础。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在州级健康信息交换的病例对照样本上，堆叠元学习器取得 AUROC 0.899（95% CI: 0.891-0.906）、PR-AUC 0.881、Brier 分数 0.126，优于最佳单阶段模型（AUROC 0.849）；与仅手术模型相比（AUROC 0.879, Brier 0.140）判别和校准均有改善；在 2017 年后数据上的时间验证 AUROC 为 0.915；校准截距 -0.006（95% CI: -0.083 至 0.070）、斜率 1.035（95% CI: 0.982 至 1.088），并经病例对照抽样校正的决策曲线分析显示临床合理阈值下净收益为正。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架具有模块化特点，可扩展至其他结局、扩展预测域并支持动态风险更新，为可解释且校准良好的围手术期临床决策支持提供了可扩展基础。

papers.title: Toward CT-Equivalent Image Quality in Low-Dose Radiotherapy Planning: Conditional Diffusion-Based CBCT-to-CT Synthesis and the Impact of CBCT Input Representation
papers.abstract_en: During standard radiotherapy planning, repeated CT acquisitions are often required for patient registration, verification, and adaptive planning, resulting in increased cumulative X-ray dose. To mitigate this, low-dose cone-beam CT (CBCT) is routinely acquired during treatment delivery. However, CBCT image quality remains insufficient for accurate dose calculation and adaptive radiotherapy planning due to increased scatter, noise, beam hardening, and reconstruction related artifacts. This study develops a supervised deep learning based CBCT to CT synthesis framework using a conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM), where the generation of a CT-based planning for accurate positioning and dose calculation is obtained using generative models with low dose CBCT imaging. Beyond demonstrating CBCT to CT synthesis, the primary objective is to investigate how the representation of CBCT input data, either standard clinical DICOM CBCT images or filtered back-projection (FDK) reconstructions from raw projection data, affects the performance of diffusion based CT synthesis. The overarching aim is to assess whether physics aware CBCT representations better support CT-equivalent image quality while maintaining reduced imaging dose in radiotherapy workflows.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, European Conference of Radiology (ECR) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于条件去噪扩散概率模型 (DDPM) 的 CBCT 到 CT 合成框架，用于低剂量放疗规划中的定位与剂量计算。研究重点是比较两种 CBCT 输入表示——标准临床 DICOM CBCT 图像与从原始投影数据经滤波反投影 (FDK) 重建的图像——对扩散模型合成 CT 质量的影响，以检验物理感知的 CBCT 表示能否在降低成像剂量的同时达到 CT 等效图像质量。
Motivation: 标准放疗计划中重复 CT 采集会增加累积 X 射线剂量；低剂量 CBCT 虽在治疗中常规采集，但散射线、噪声、束硬化和重建伪影使其图像质量不足以支撑准确的剂量计算和自适应放疗计划。作者因而研究 CBCT 到 CT 的合成，并专门考察 CBCT 输入表示方式的影响。
Method: 采用监督深度学习方法，基于条件 DDPM 实现 CBCT 到 CT 的合成；核心实验设计是比较标准临床 DICOM CBCT 图像与由原始投影数据重建的 FDK 图像两种输入表示对扩散合成性能的影响。
Result: 摘要未报告定量结果；主要贡献是展示 CBCT 到 CT 合成，并评估输入表示（临床 DICOM 与 FDK 重建）对扩散模型合成质量的作用。
Conclusion: 目标是考察物理感知的 CBCT 表示是否能在放疗工作流中保持降低成像剂量的同时实现 CT 等效的图像质量。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Learning for Robust Acoustic Localization with Calibrated Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Passive Acoustic Monitoring (PAM) offer an opportunity to obtain ecological spatial point-process data at unprecedented scale. However, realizing this opportunity necessitates the development of accurate and scalable localization methods. In real-world outdoor soundscapes, however, the assumptions underlying classical localization methods such as hyperbolic and score-based localization are routinely violated by multipath dominance, near-field effects, and complex propagation. Under these conditions, classical localization methods become brittle, with extreme errors possible even in small detection arrays. Rather than statistically replacing the underlying physics, we propose a method to refine it and increase robustness outside of ideal operating conditions: a learned model operating on physics-informed acoustic features corrects a fast hyperbolic solver where it produces implausible solutions, substantially reducing catastrophic worst-case errors while matching its median accuracy on field data. We further provide calibrated, geometry-aware uncertainty estimates suitable for propagation into downstream spatial models. Evaluating on distributed microphone arrays in real and simulated outdoor environments, we demonstrate that the proposed method yields robust, uncertainty-aware localization, providing a step toward scalable automated wildlife monitoring in complex acoustic environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对被动声学监测（PAM）中的鲁棒声源定位问题，提出一种物理信息学习方法：学习模型基于物理启发的声学特征，修正快速双曲定位求解器产生的不合理解，从而显著降低最坏情况下的灾难性误差，同时保持与经典方法相当的中位精度，并提供可标定、几何感知的不确定性估计。作者在真实和模拟户外分布式麦克风阵列数据上验证了方法的稳健性，目标是推动复杂声学环境中的规模化野生动物自动监测。
Motivation: 真实户外声景中的多径主导、近场效应和复杂传播经常违反双曲定位和基于评分的经典定位方法的假设，使这些方法变得脆弱，即使在小检测阵列中也可能出现极端误差。
Method: 提出不替换物理模型而是对其精炼的策略：在物理信息声学特征上训练一个学习模型，用于纠正快速双曲求解器在不可信区域产生的解，并提供经过标定且几何感知的不确定性估计，以便传播到下游空间模型。
Result: 在真实和模拟户外环境的分布式麦克风阵列评估中，该方法大幅减少灾难性最坏情况误差，同时保持与经典方法相当的中位精度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在复杂声学环境中提供稳健、不确定性感知的定位能力，是迈向可扩展自动化野生动物监测的一步；其范围限定在室外声学定位与PAM应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Tied Trit-Planes: Constraining PTQTP to a Uniform Nine-Level Quantizer, with a Persistent Folded Format for Disk-Streamed Mixture-of-Experts Serving
papers.abstract_en: PTQTP decomposes LLM weight matrices into two ternary (trit) planes with two free per-group scales. Tying the scales to a fixed ratio of three collapses the decomposition into a single uniform nine-level quantizer, a known balanced-ternary identity. To our knowledge, at the time of writing, this work is the first to impose that identity as a constraint inside PTQTP's solver. The two trit planes then fold losslessly into one 4-bit code plane that we make the persistent serving representation: disk bytes, expert-cache bytes, and kernel input are the same 4.0625-bits/weight blocks, consumed in one integer dot pass. For this conjunction (ratio-3 nine-level code, CPU-SIMD kernels, SSD expert streaming, identical persistent bytes) we likewise found no precedent. We apply this to the routed experts of DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, a 284B-A13B mixture-of-experts model, quantizing in one shot from the released MXFP4 expert weights and streaming experts from SSD on a 64 GB laptop. Against a 4.5-bit Q4_K baseline, measured one process per fixture with an expert-lossless anchor arm as reference control, the tied model matches the official serving API on 5/5 fixtures at step 0 (Q4_K: 4/5) and 12/14 captured continuation steps (11/14), scores 86 vs. 84 on a 100-item MMLU subset, decodes 6.7% faster in decode phase, and ships 9% smaller files: no detected fidelity difference at these small evaluation sizes, and every fixture-level difference between the arms traces to a single measured near-tie cell. The tied fit nevertheless shows higher weight-reconstruction error and worse perplexity, a measured dissociation between proxy metrics and reference fidelity. A cumulative trunk-ternarization ladder and bitwise-pinned aarch64/x86-64 kernels complete the report. All code, formats, and evaluation artifacts are open source in the fucina inference stack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种将 PTQTP 权重量化约束为统一九级量化器的方法：把两个三元（trit）平面的每组缩放比例固定为 3:1，从而折叠为单个 4-bit 编码平面，并以此作为磁盘持久化格式、专家缓存格式与内核输入格式。作者将该方法应用于 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 的 MoE 路由专家，在 64 GB 笔记本上从 MXFP4 专家权重一步量化并从 SSD 流式加载专家，与 4.5-bit Q4_K 基线对比：5/5 个固定配置在 step 0 匹配官方 API（Q4_K 为 4/5），12/14 个延续步骤匹配（11/14），100 项 MMLU 子集得分 86 对 84，解码阶段提速 6.7%，文件减小 9%；但绑定拟合的权重重建误差更高、困惑度更差，显示代理指标与参考保真度之间出现分离。
Motivation: 现有 PTQTP 分解为每个组保留两个自由缩放因子，未将已知的均衡三元恒等式（ratio-3 折叠为九级量化器）作为求解器约束；同时缺少一种把统一量化编码同时用作磁盘字节、专家缓存字节和内核输入的端到端持久化格式，尤其缺乏针对 SSD 流式 MoE 服务的实现先例。
Method: 将 PTQTP 的两个三元平面缩放比例绑定为固定 3:1，使分解坍塌为单个均匀九级量化器，并作为约束加入 PTQTP 求解器；两个 trit 平面随后无损折叠成 4-bit 编码平面（4.0625 bits/weight），该平面同时作为持久化存储格式、专家缓存格式与 CPU-SIMD 内核输入，在一次整数点积中消费；还加入了累积主干三值化阶梯（trunk-ternarization ladder）与位级固定的 aarch64/x86-64 内核。
Result: 在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731（284B-A13B MoE）上，从发布的 MXFP4 专家权重一步量化并在 64 GB 笔记本上从 SSD 流式专家：在 5/5 个 fixture 的 step 0 匹配官方 serving API（Q4_K 为 4/5），12/14 个延续步骤匹配（11/14），MMLU 100 项子集得分 86 对 84，解码阶段快 6.7%，文件小 9%；所有 fixture 级差异可追溯到单个接近平局（near-tie）的单元。
Conclusion: 作者认为该绑定方法在保真度上未见可检测差异，但测量到权重重建误差与困惑度更差，说明代理指标与实际参考保真度发生分离；论文强调所有代码、格式与评估工件已在 fucina 推理栈中开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ToolVision: Learning When and How to Use Visual Tools with Capability-Aligned Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Thinking with images allows a multimodal model to compensate for limited perception by invoking visual tools through code. Yet the prevailing SFT-then-RL recipe creates a different supervision misalignment at each stage. SFT is expected to teach how to use tools, but trajectories from stronger teachers may succeed through perceptual capabilities that a smaller student cannot reliably reproduce or exploit, causing the student to imitate tool-call patterns without learning how to make them useful. RL is expected to teach when to use tools, but outcome-only rewards make fallible tool execution a liability and suppress tool use, whereas a blanket bonus for every correct tool-using trajectory encourages valid but ineffective operations. To address these two misalignments, we introduce ToolVision. During SFT, a multi-agent pipeline explores candidate trajectories, and a committee including student-scale models scores stepwise evidence gain to rank and prune the search branches. Only successfully executed trajectories with correct final answers are retained for SFT. Before RL, ToolVision compares the learner's performance with and without tools, then rewards successful tool use only on questions where tools provide a clear benefit. Both signals are constructed automatically from public task data without additional human annotations of tool use or necessity. ToolVision-8B improves over its base on all seven main benchmarks, surpasses Thyme-7B, CodeVision-8B, and CodeDance-7B on all three high-resolution benchmarks, and outperforms Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking on V* and HRBench 8K. We will publicly release the datasets and source code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ToolVision，用于解决多模态模型通过代码调用视觉工具 (visual tools) 时 SFT 与 RL 两个训练阶段中的监督错配问题。SFT 阶段用多智能体管线探索候选轨迹，并由包含学生规模模型的委员会按逐步证据增益 (stepwise evidence gain) 排序和剪枝，只保留最终答案正确且工具执行成功的轨迹；RL 阶段先对比学习者有/无工具的表现，仅在工具带来明确收益的问题上对成功的工具使用给予奖励。ToolVision-8B 在全部七个主要基准上超过其基础模型，在三个高分辨率基准上超过 Thyme-7B、CodeVision-8B 和 CodeDance-7B，并在 V* 和 HRBench 8K 上超过 Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking。
Motivation: 现有的 SFT-then-RL 训练范式在两个阶段存在不同的监督错配：SFT 旨在教授如何使用工具，但更强教师模型的轨迹可能依赖学生无法稳定复现的感知能力，导致学生只模仿工具调用模式而学不到其用途；RL 旨在教授何时使用工具，但仅基于最终结果的奖励会使易出错的工具执行成为负担并抑制工具使用，而对所有正确轨迹一律加分的做法又会鼓励有效但无意义的操作。
Method: ToolVision 在 SFT 阶段使用多智能体管线生成候选轨迹，由包含学生规模模型的委员会对逐步证据增益打分以排序和剪枝搜索分支，仅保留工具执行成功且最终答案正确的轨迹用于 SFT；在 RL 阶段，先比较学习者有工具和无工具的表现，只对工具能带来明确收益的问题上的成功工具使用给予奖励。两个信号均从公开任务数据自动构建，无需额外人工标注工具使用或必要性。
Result: 摘要报告 ToolVision-8B 在全部七个主要基准上优于其基础模型，在三个高分辨率基准上优于 Thyme-7B、CodeVision-8B 和 CodeDance-7B，并在 V* 和 HRBench 8K 上优于 Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking。
Conclusion: 作者强调两种监督错配的诊断以及两个训练信号均可自动构建，并宣布将公开发布数据集和源代码；其范围集中于多模态模型的视觉工具使用而非特定下游领域。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 ToolVision，用于解决多模态模型通过代码调用视觉工具 (visual tools) 时 SFT 与 RL 两个训练阶段中的监督错配问题。SFT 阶段用多智能体管线探索候选轨迹，并由包含学生规模模型的委员会按逐步证据增益 (stepwise evidence gain) 排序和剪枝，只保留最终答案正确且工具执行成功的轨迹；RL 阶段先对比学习者有/无工具的表现，仅在工具带来明确收益的问题上对成功的工具使用给予奖励。ToolVision-8B 在全部七个主要基准上超过其基础模型，在三个高分辨率基准上超过 Thyme-7B、CodeVision-8B 和 CodeDance-7B，并在 V* 和 HRBench 8K 上超过 Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking。

summary_sections.method: ToolVision 在 SFT 阶段使用多智能体管线生成候选轨迹，由包含学生规模模型的委员会对逐步证据增益打分以排序和剪枝搜索分支，仅保留工具执行成功且最终答案正确的轨迹用于 SFT；在 RL 阶段，先比较学习者有工具和无工具的表现，只对工具能带来明确收益的问题上的成功工具使用给予奖励。两个信号均从公开任务数据自动构建，无需额外人工标注工具使用或必要性。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调两种监督错配的诊断以及两个训练信号均可自动构建，并宣布将公开发布数据集和源代码；其范围集中于多模态模型的视觉工具使用而非特定下游领域。

papers.title: Federated Attention Autoencoders with a Stochastic Aggregation Scheme for Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Outlier detection in decentralized data environments is a challenging task for many machine learning implementations, particularly in settings where data cannot be shared. Recently, there have been advances in federated outlier detection, some of which are based on the use of autoencoder networks. The introduction of attention mechanisms to autoencoders boosts their efficiency. However, the application of attention-based models in federated learning remains underdeveloped due to the absence of proper aggregation functions for these types of networks. In our work, we propose two novel aggregation functions tailored for attention-based autoencoders, which better preserve the learned information stored within the memory modules of these networks. We evaluated our approach on the KDDCUP10 dataset, and we showed that the proposed methods achieve up to 2.9\% and 5.1\% better results for F1 score and AUC ROC respectively when compared to traditional autoencoders.
papers.comment: Accepted and presented at the 3rd International Conference on Federated Learning Technologies and Applications (FLTA 2025)
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 3rd International Conference on Federated Learning Technologies and Applications (FLTA 2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦学习环境下的异常检测，提出两种专为基于注意力的自编码器（attention-based autoencoders）设计的新型聚合函数，以更好地保留这类网络记忆模块中学到的信息。作者在KDDCUP10数据集上评估，相比传统自编码器，F1分数和AUC ROC分别最高提升2.9%和5.1%。
Motivation: 联邦异常检测中已有基于自编码器的方案，注意力机制能提升自编码器效率，但联邦学习中缺乏适用于注意力网络的聚合函数，导致这类模型在联邦设置下应用不足。
Method: 提出两种针对注意力自编码器定制的聚合函数，核心目标是更充分地保留网络记忆模块中存储的已学习信息。
Result: 在KDDCUP10数据集上，所提方法相比传统自编码器在F1分数上最高提升2.9%，在AUC ROC上最高提升5.1%。
Conclusion: 合适的聚合函数对联邦学习中基于注意力的自编码器至关重要，所提方法在异常检测任务上优于传统自编码器。

papers.title: From Recovery to Drop-off: How Action Post-training Reduces a VLM's Late-Layer Depth Decodability
papers.abstract_en: How much of a vision-language model's (VLM) spatial understanding remains after the action post-training process of building a vision-language-action model (VLA)? We probe depth perception, a primitive of spatiogeometric understanding, from every decoder layer of a weight-matched open-source base VLM/VLA pair: Molmo2-ER and MolmoAct2-LIBERO. First, the VLA decodes depth worse at every layer, a persistent gap we call the floor. Second, the degradation is not uniform: while the base VLM's depth decodability improves through its final layers, the VLA's collapses, an additional late-layer drop we call the cliff. We causally localize the cliff to late-layer MLP interference: ablating the late-layer MLP writes recovers the majority of the terminal decodability cliff, while matched attention ablations and the same intervention in the weight-matched base VLM produce no comparable recovery. A module-level decomposition explains this dissociation: the base VLM carries depth most accessibly in accumulated MLP writes, whereas action post-training collapses depth decodability in the late accumulated writes.
papers.comment: Accepted to the archival proceedings track of the Embodied Multimodal Reasoning (EMR) Workshop at ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在动作后训练（action post-training）过程中，其空间理解能力（以深度感知为探针）如何退化。作者对权重匹配的开源基础VLM/VLA对（Molmo2-ER 与 MolmoAct2-LIBERO）的每个解码器层进行深度解码探测，发现VLA在所有层都更差（称为floor），并且在后期层出现额外崩溃（称为cliff）。通过因果消融，将cliff定位到后期层MLP写入的干扰：消融后期层MLP写入可恢复大部分终端解码损失，而注意力消融或对基础VLM的相同干预无此效果。模块级分解表明基础VLM在累积的MLP写入中携带深度信息，而动作后训练破坏了后期累积写入中的深度可解码性。
Motivation: 现有工作多关注VLA的动作能力，但很少系统评估构建VLA的动作后训练对VLM底层空间几何理解（如深度感知）的破坏程度及其机制。理解这一退化有助于指导VLA训练以保留基础感知能力。
Method: 对权重匹配的Molmo2-ER（基础VLM）和MolmoAct2-LIBERO（VLA）进行逐解码器层的深度探测（depth decoding probe），并实施因果干预：分别消融后期层MLP写入与注意力写入，比较对终端可解码性cliff的恢复效果，再结合模块级分解定位深度表征的载体。
Result: 摘要报告：VLA在所有层上的深度解码都更差（floor）；基础VLM在后期层深度可解码性提升，而VLA在后期层崩溃（cliff）。消融后期层MLP写入可恢复大部分cliff，注意力消融和基础VLM上的相同干预均无类似恢复。基础VLM的深度信息主要累积在MLP写入中，动作后训练使后期累积MLP写入中的深度可解码性崩溃。
Conclusion: 作者认为动作后训练通过干扰后期层MLP写入，破坏了VLM深度感知这一空间理解基元，且这种退化可被因果定位。摘要未讨论对下游VLA动作性能的影响或可能的缓解策略。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A New Approach to Characterising Optimisation Problems Using Programmatic Representation and Complexity Measures
papers.abstract_en: Characterising optimisation problem instances is a fundamental part of understanding the behaviour and performance of different algorithms as well as providing information for algorithm selection and configuration. In this paper we propose a novel approach to problem characterisation based on the representation of instances when implemented as a program. The intuition is that the complexity of the code required to express an objective function should relate to the complexity of the search landscape. We identify the Halstead volume as a measure of code complexity, which can be seen as a simplified version of the entropy of the program. Given a code implementation of the objective function, the Halstead volume and entropy can be quickly calculated using existing libraries. We apply the proposed complexity measures to the well-known BBOB optimisation problem suite and the simple feed-forward neural network training task. We also show that the measures are negatively correlated with algorithm performance and therefore show potential as predictive meta-features for algorithm selection and other problem analysis. We envisage the proposed measures as complementary to other problem characterisation approaches, but with the advantages of not requiring any sampling of the search space, being invariant to transformations, and being very quick to calculate automatically.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的优化问题实例刻画方法：将目标函数视为程序实现，以 Halstead volume（可看作程序熵的简化版）作为代码复杂度度量，并假设代码复杂度与搜索景观复杂度相关。作者在 BBOB 基准套件和简单前馈神经网络训练任务上验证，发现这些度量与算法性能负相关，有潜力用作算法选择和问题分析的预测元特征。相比现有方法，该方案无需对搜索空间采样、对变换不变且可自动快速计算。
Motivation: 刻画优化问题实例是理解算法行为、支持算法选择与配置的基础；现有特征化方法往往需要采样搜索空间或计算成本较高，缺少基于程序代码表示的低成本替代方案。
Method: 提出基于实例程序化表示的复杂度度量：计算目标函数实现的 Halstead volume 与熵，并利用现有库快速获取这些值，从而刻画搜索景观的复杂度。
Result: 在 BBOB 优化问题套件和简单前馈神经网络训练任务上，度量的计算结果与算法性能呈负相关，显示出作为预测元特征（meta-features）的潜力。
Conclusion: 作者将该度量视为对其他问题刻画方法的补充，并强调其优势：不需要采样搜索空间、对变换不变、能快速自动计算。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: From Manuals to Maintenance: Fine-Tuning MedGemma for Multi-Modal Imaging System Support in Low-Resource Settings
papers.abstract_en: Imaging device downtime is a major barrier to healthcare delivery in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), often driven by limited access to specialized biomedical engineering support. We present a multi-modality medical equipment maintenance question-answering (QA) framework and demonstrate the fine-tuning of a medical foundation model for specialized technical troubleshooting tasks. Guided by a multi-country survey across nine LMICs, we curated technical manuals from MRI and ultrasound systems to generate the INGENZI_DatasetV1, containing 10,294 high-quality, filtered QA-context pairs. Using QLoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning, we adapted the MedGemma-4b-it model to interpret system error logs and generate step-by-step equipment repair instructions. Compared to the baseline model, the fine-tuned system achieved substantial improvements across metrics, including F1 score (0.22 to 0.38), ROUGE-2 (0.18 to 0.41), and BERTScore F1 (0.86 to 0.91). These metric gains demonstrate that the model generates significantly more precise and procedurally accurate technical responses to new troubleshooting queries. This work establishes a reliable foundation for AI-assisted diagnostic and maintenance tools in resource-constrained settings.
papers.comment: Accepted at the AFRICAI 2026 Workshop, a satellite event at MICCAI 2026. To appear in Springer Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向多模态医疗影像设备维护的问答框架，并展示了对医学基础模型 MedGemma-4b-it 的微调。作者基于九国调查，从 MRI 和超声设备手册中构建了包含 10,294 对高质量问答上下文对的 INGENZI_DatasetV1，并使用 QLoRA 参数高效微调让模型解读设备错误日志并生成逐步维修说明。微调后模型在 F1、ROUGE-2 和 BERTScore 上较基线均有明显提升。
Motivation: 在中低收入国家（LMICs），影像设备停机是医疗服务的主要障碍，而专业生物医学工程支持稀缺，因此需要专门的技术故障排查问答能力来辅助维护。
Method: 通过多国调查指导数据构建，从 MRI 与超声系统技术手册中整理出 INGENZI_DatasetV1（10,294 个过滤后的 QA-上下文对），再基于 QLoRA 对 MedGemma-4b-it 进行参数高效微调，使其能解释系统错误日志并生成逐步设备维修指令。
Result: 与基线模型相比，微调后模型在 F1（0.22 提升至 0.38）、ROUGE-2（0.18 提升至 0.41）和 BERTScore F1（0.86 提升至 0.91）上均取得显著提升，表明生成的针对新故障排查问题的技术回答更精确、程序上更准确。
Conclusion: 该工作为资源受限环境下的 AI 辅助诊断与维护工具建立了可靠基础，但其范围限于医疗影像设备维护问答，未涉及本文关键词相关的降水或天气预报领域。

papers.title: LLM Reasoning for Subjective Tasks: Failure Modes, Mitigation, and Dynamic Reasoning Routing
papers.abstract_en: Recommendation systems thrive on personalization, where ''correctness'' is rarely a binary truth but a matter of subjective human preference. As Large Language Models (LLMs) are deployed as autonomous verifiers of safety and quality guidelines, they face a distinctive challenge: context-aware preference alignment. Recent gains in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) are indexed mostly on objective, mathematical tasks. Through a large-scale study spanning both proprietary and open-source models on four real-world verification tasks from a production recommender platform, we ask whether explicit reasoning generalizes to subjective, human-centric industry rubrics. We expose a fundamental vulnerability: rigid, math-centric reasoning traces actively degrade verification, and applying standard RLVR triggers a phenomenon we term reasoning collapse, in which the policy abandons deliberation in favor of rapid heuristic guessing. We introduce a conditional length-penalized post-training algorithm that intertwines verification accuracy with bounded reasoning length, halting collapse and recovering performance. Finally, we show that a reasoning trace's efficacy is tightly coupled with its socio-linguistic framing: across 1500 synthesized personas, verification accuracy swings by nearly 0.38 macro-F1 depending solely on the adopted reasoning persona---evidence that much subjective-verification error is really reasoning-style mismatch. This observation motivates a mid-training architecture that routes reasoning through contextually aligned personas. This work offers both a scalable algorithmic patch and a long-term architectural blueprint for aligning reasoning models with real-world subjective constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM在主观性验证任务中的显式推理行为，基于生产推荐平台的四个真实验证任务，对专有与开源模型做了大规模对比。作者发现面向数学的推理链会实际降低验证表现，标准RLVR会引发所谓的推理崩溃，即策略放弃深思而转向快速启发式猜测。他们提出一种条件长度惩罚的后训练算法来阻止崩溃并恢复性能，并进一步发现推理轨迹的效果强烈依赖其社会语言学框架（persona），据此设计按上下文对齐persona进行推理路由的中间训练架构。
Motivation: 现有RLVR提升主要集中在客观数学任务，但推荐系统等工业场景中的正确性本质上依赖主观人偏好；LLM被部署为安全与质量准则的自主验证器时，显式推理能否泛化到主观、以人为中心的行业准则尚不清楚。
Method: 通过覆盖专有与开源模型的大规模实验，在四个推荐平台验证任务上分析推理效果；提出条件长度惩罚后训练算法，将验证准确率与有界推理长度结合；并提出一种中间训练架构，基于上下文对齐的persona对推理进行路由。
Result: 标准RLVR在主观任务上触发推理崩溃，条件长度惩罚可停止崩溃并恢复表现；在1500个合成persona下，仅更换推理persona即可使验证宏F1波动近0.38，说明大量主观验证错误源于推理风格不匹配。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作既提供了可扩展的算法补丁，也给出了对齐推理模型与真实世界主观约束的长期架构蓝图。

papers.title: Full-bandwidth transformer
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive transformers compute along two axes: horizontally across generated tokens, and vertically through model depth. Dense attention gives each token broad horizontal access to the past, but the vertical feedback channel between decoding steps remains narrow: only the sampled token returns to the bottom of the stack, while the top-layer hidden state is discarded. We introduce the \emph{full-bandwidth transformer}, which widens this channel with \emph{latent feedback}: at each decoding step, the previous top-layer hidden state is fused with the sampled token embedding through a gated linear unit and fed back as the next input. Latent feedback lets non-verbalized computation re-enter the stack with a renewed depth budget, while preserving the standard transformer architecture, KV cache, and language-modeling objective. To train full-bandwidth transformers without losing parallel teacher forcing, we use a scheduled multi-pass objective that introduces latent feedback late in pretraining and mixes a small fraction of deeper feedback passes for stability. We train 1B-parameter full-bandwidth transformers up to 400B tokens and find that latent feedback improves validation loss, 5-shot language-model evaluation, math and coding generation, and instruction-tuned performance. With negligible per-token decoding overhead, full-bandwidth transformers match or approach standard transformers trained with roughly $1.5\times$ more tokens, and manage to produce shorter reasoning traces at equal or better accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出全带宽 Transformer (full-bandwidth transformer)，通过潜在反馈 (latent feedback) 加宽自回归解码中从顶层隐藏状态到下一输入的垂直反馈通道。具体做法是在每个解码步骤把前一时刻的顶层隐藏状态与采样 token 嵌入经门控线性单元融合后作为下一输入，同时保持标准架构、KV cache 与语言建模目标不变。作者在 1B 参数、400B token 规模上训练，发现该方法改善了验证损失、5-shot 语言模型评估、数学与代码生成以及指令微调性能。
Motivation: 自回归 Transformer 中水平方向有密集注意力提供对过去的广泛访问，但垂直反馈通道很窄：只有被采样的 token 返回堆栈底部，顶层隐藏状态被丢弃，限制了计算在深度间的复用。
Method: 引入潜在反馈 (latent feedback)：每一步将前一时刻的顶层隐藏状态与当前采样 token 的嵌入通过门控线性单元融合，作为下一步输入，使非语言化的计算能以新的深度预算重新进入网络。为保持并行 teacher forcing，使用调度式多遍目标 (scheduled multi-pass objective)，在预训练后期引入潜在反馈并混合少量更深的反馈遍以维持稳定性。
Result: 在 1B 参数模型上训练至 400B tokens，潜在反馈改善了验证损失、5-shot 语言模型评估、数学与代码生成以及指令微调性能；解码开销可忽略，模型匹配或接近用约 1.5 倍 token 训练的标准 Transformer，并在同等或更高精度下生成更短的推理轨迹。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在不改动标准 Transformer 架构、KV cache 和训练目标的前提下，仅拓宽垂直反馈通道即可带来一致的性能提升，且解码开销可忽略。

papers.title: City Sentinel: A Unified AI-Based Smart Surveillance Framework for Real-Time Multi-Threat Detection Using Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Rapid urbanization has increased the need for surveillance systems that can monitor multiple public safety risks at the same time. Traditional systems often use separate solutions for facial recognition, vehicle identification, fire detection, and behavioral analysis, resulting in fragmented infrastructure and multiple interfaces for operators to manage. This paper presents City Sentinel, a unified AI-based surveillance framework that integrates six detection capabilities into one scalable platform: facial recognition, automatic number plate recognition (ANPR), fire and smoke detection, weapon and knife detection, violence detection, and road accident detection. The system combines a Next.js operator dashboard, FastAPI backend, cloud-based PostgreSQL event storage, InsightFace and YOLOv8 vision models, and EasyOCR for plate recognition. Camera streams are processed through dedicated inference workers using RTSP. On a workstation equipped with an NVIDIA RTX 3060 GPU, the system achieves a median end-to-end latency of 743 ms and supports four concurrent RTSP streams within a two-second latency limit. It achieves a 91.2% face-match rate, 85.7% plate-reading accuracy, and mAP@0.5 scores of 0.846 to 0.889 across the fire, knife, and weapon detection modules. In user-acceptance testing, operators could enroll a new identity in under one minute and identify a flagged person from live footage in an average of 12 seconds. The results demonstrate that a modular, open-source, multi-model architecture can provide broad surveillance coverage, cloud-based auditability, and flexibility for adding new detection capabilities while maintaining practical real-time performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 City Sentinel，一个统一的 AI 监控框架，将人脸识别、车牌识别 (ANPR)、火情/烟雾检测、武器/刀具检测、暴力检测和交通事故检测集成为单一可扩展平台。系统基于 Next.js 操作台、FastAPI 后端、云 PostgreSQL 事件存储、InsightFace 与 YOLOv8 视觉模型以及 EasyOCR 进行车牌识别，通过 RTSP 接入摄像头流并由专用推理 worker 处理。在 NVIDIA RTX 3060 工作站上，系统实现中位端到端延迟 743 ms，支持四路并发 RTSP 流，并在检测准确率与用户验收测试中报告了具体指标。
Motivation: 快速城市化要求监控系统同时监测多种公共安全风险，而传统系统通常将人脸识别、车辆识别、火灾检测和行为分析拆分为独立方案，导致基础设施碎片化、操作员需要管理多个界面。
Method: 提出模块化、开源的多模型架构：将六类检测能力集成到一个平台，摄像头流经 RTSP 由专用推理 worker 处理，前端为 Next.js 操作台，后端为 FastAPI，事件存储使用云 PostgreSQL；视觉部分结合 InsightFace、YOLOv8 与 EasyOCR，支持人脸、车牌、火焰/烟雾、武器/刀具、暴力及道路事故检测。
Result: 在配备 NVIDIA RTX 3060 的工作站上，系统实现中位端到端延迟 743 ms，并在两秒延迟限制内支持四路并发 RTSP 流；人脸匹配率 91.2%，车牌读取准确率 85.7%，fire、knife、weapon 检测模块的 mAP@0.5 在 0.846 到 0.889 之间。用户验收测试中，操作员可在不到一分钟内完成新身份注册，从实时画面识别被标记人员平均耗时 12 秒。
Conclusion: 作者认为模块化、开源、多模型架构能够在保持实际实时性能的同时，提供广泛的监控覆盖、云端可审计性，并便于灵活添加新的检测能力。
