papers.title: AquiLLM: An Architecture for Supporting Tacit Knowledge Capture in Research Groups
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and large language models (LLMs) enable researchers to integrate AI into scientific workflows. However, using proprietary commercial AI systems raises concerns about transparency, reproducibility and privacy, which are essential for scientific practices. To this end, AquiLLM was developed as an open-source modular RAG-LLM framework using open-weight models, designed to support research groups in capturing tacit knowledge. In this work, we present a series of architectural improvements and feature enhancements to AquiLLM, including local embedding and reranking, multimodal capabilities, OpenAI-compatible inference interfaces, user interface improvements, semantic and episodic memory capabilities, and skills support. These enhancements were informed by discussions with domain experts, including astrophysicists and environmental researchers, and represent a step toward AI systems more closely aligned with scientific research practices.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the NGEN-AI 2026 proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 AquiLLM，一个面向研究组隐性知识捕获的开源模块化 RAG-LLM 框架，使用开放权重模型而非专有商业 AI。工作呈现一系列架构与功能增强，包括本地嵌入与重排序、多模态能力、OpenAI 兼容推理接口、用户界面改进、语义与情景记忆以及技能支持，并说明这些改进由天体物理学家和环境研究者等领域专家的讨论所驱动。摘要未给出量化实验评估。
Motivation: 专有商业 AI 系统在透明度、可复现性和隐私方面存在隐患，而这些对科研实践至关重要；现有工具难以支持研究组中的隐性知识捕获。
Method: 提出对 AquiLLM 的模块化增强方案，包含本地嵌入和重排序、多模态能力、OpenAI 兼容推理接口、界面改进、语义与情景记忆（semantic and episodic memory）以及技能支持（skills support）。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化结果，仅描述这些架构与功能改进是通向更贴近科研实践的 AI 系统的一步。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些增强能使 AI 系统更好地服务于科研实践，尤其有助于研究组的隐性知识捕获；其设计受到天体物理学家和环境研究者等专家讨论的启发。

papers.title: Epistemic Transfer in AI-Assisted Verification: A Framework and Evaluation Protocol
papers.abstract_en: AI tools that help people judge online claims are usually evaluated while the tool is present. This paper asks a different question: after using such a tool, what can the user still do on their own? I call this epistemic transfer. It refers to the effect of prior AI-assisted verification on later unassisted performance on new claims. In this paper, I make three contributions. First, I distinguish epistemic transfer from nearby outcomes such as correction effects, trust, reliance, and human--AI team performance. Second, I introduce two simple quantities for studying it: the Epistemic Transfer Effect (ETE), which compares delayed unassisted performance across conditions, and Tool-Removal Cost (TRC), which measures the immediate drop in performance when the tool is taken away. Third, I turn these ideas into a practical evaluation protocol that can be used in online experiments or field studies. The protocol combines answer-first and evidence-first AI conditions with active-practice and no-practice controls, delayed tests on held-out claims, behavioral measures, and participant- and item-level analyses. Putting ETE and TRC together yields a diagnostic space that separates capability building, capability plus tool advantage, epistemic inertness or de-skilling, and verification on loan. The point is not that every AI tool must teach. The point is that when independent judgment matters, we should test not only whether a tool helps now, but also what it leaves behind.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“认知迁移”(epistemic transfer) 概念，指先前的 AI 辅助验证对之后无辅助验证新主张时表现的影响，并给出两个量化指标：认知迁移效应 (ETE) 与工具移除代价 (TRC)。文章还将这些概念转化为一套可用于在线实验或实地研究的评估协议，组合 ETE 与 TRC 形成诊断空间，以区分能力提升、能力加工具优势、认知惰性/技能退化以及“验证靠外借”等状态。摘要未报告实证结果，属于概念与方法论贡献。
Motivation: 现有 AI 辅助工具通常在工具在场时被评估，忽视了用户脱离工具后的独立判断能力；当独立判断重要时，不能只看工具当下的帮助，还要看工具留下了什么。
Method: 先将认知迁移与纠正效应、信任、依赖、人机团队绩效等相近概念区分开；再定义 ETE（比较延迟的无辅助表现）和 TRC（测量工具移除后的即时表现下降）；最后给出结合回答优先与证据优先 AI 条件、主动练习与无练习控制组、延迟测试、行为测量以及参与者和题目层面分析的评估协议。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果或数值，主要产出是概念区分、两个量化指标、诊断空间和可操作的评估协议。
Conclusion: 作者强调并非每个 AI 工具都必须承担教学功能，但当独立判断很关键时，应同时检验工具当下的帮助及其留下的能力。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出“认知迁移”(epistemic transfer) 概念，指先前的 AI 辅助验证对之后无辅助验证新主张时表现的影响，并给出两个量化指标：认知迁移效应 (ETE) 与工具移除代价 (TRC)。文章还将这些概念转化为一套可用于在线实验或实地研究的评估协议，组合 ETE 与 TRC 形成诊断空间，以区分能力提升、能力加工具优势、认知惰性/技能退化以及“验证靠外借”等状态。摘要未报告实证结果，属于概念与方法论贡献。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 AI 辅助工具通常在工具在场时被评估，忽视了用户脱离工具后的独立判断能力；当独立判断重要时，不能只看工具当下的帮助，还要看工具留下了什么。
summary_sections.method: 先将认知迁移与纠正效应、信任、依赖、人机团队绩效等相近概念区分开；再定义 ETE（比较延迟的无辅助表现）和 TRC（测量工具移除后的即时表现下降）；最后给出结合回答优先与证据优先 AI 条件、主动练习与无练习控制组、延迟测试、行为测量以及参与者和题目层面分析的评估协议。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果或数值，主要产出是概念区分、两个量化指标、诊断空间和可操作的评估协议。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调并非每个 AI 工具都必须承担教学功能，但当独立判断很关键时，应同时检验工具当下的帮助及其留下的能力。

papers.title: Theory-Guided Deception Detection: A RAG-Based Artificial Intelligence Exploration
papers.abstract_en: The current work developed seven Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models based on leading deception theories and compared how deception judgments were made relative to baseline models. Across 700 statements drawn from five published deception datasets, four large language models (gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-6, ollama/llama3, deepseek-v4-flash), and two run-types (RAG vs. baseline), a total of 39,200 deception judgments were rendered. Detection accuracies were consistent with typical human accuracies and not statistically different across RAG (54.5%) and baseline models (54.6%). RAG-based models (57.0%) were less truth-biased than baseline models (59.7%), but the effect size was quite small. Theoretical perspective mattered little for accuracy yet mattered substantially for response bias, which ranged from highly lie-biased (the verifiability approach, 32.2%) to highly truth-biased (truth-default theory, 88.1%). Content effects and model effects further moderated the results. Theory-guided AI judgments are unreliable with current parameters, yet they might show promise with additional datasets, model testing, and theory-to-data matching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于七种主流欺骗理论构建检索增强生成 (RAG) 模型，系统比较其与基线模型在大语言模型欺骗判断上的表现。研究覆盖五个已发表欺骗数据集中的 700 条陈述、四个大语言模型 (gpt-4o、claude-sonnet-4-6、ollama/llama3、deepseek-v4-flash) 以及 RAG 与基线两种运行方式，共产生 39,200 次欺骗判断。结果显示 RAG 与基线模型的检测准确率分别为 54.5% 与 54.6%，与人类水平相当且无统计显著差异；理论选择对响应偏差影响显著。
Motivation: 现有自动欺骗检测研究缺乏理论指导，本文尝试用欺骗理论引导的 RAG 模型改善大语言模型的欺骗判断，并考察不同理论视角如何影响判断准确率与偏差。
Method: 基于七种主要欺骗理论 (包括 verifiability approach、truth-default theory 等) 开发 RAG 模型，在五个公开欺骗数据集、四个大语言模型和两种运行方式下进行大规模比较实验，分析理论、内容和模型因素对判断结果的调节作用。
Result: RAG 与基线模型的检测准确率 (54.5% vs. 54.6%) 无统计显著差异；RAG 模型的 truth-bias 略低于基线 (57.0% vs. 59.7%) 但效应量很小。理论对准确率影响甚微，却对响应偏差影响很大，偏差范围从 verifiability approach 的高度 lie-biased (32.2%) 到 truth-default theory 的高度 truth-biased (88.1%)。
Conclusion: 作者认为在当前参数下，理论引导的 AI 欺骗判断仍不可靠；但通过增加数据集、扩展模型测试以及改进理论-数据匹配，该方法可能展现出前景。

papers.title: DistillCache: KL-Guided Adaptive KV-Cache Eviction for Memory-Efficient LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across many tasks, but their Key-Value (KV) cache grows linearly with sequence length, creating a severe memory bottleneck for long-context inference. Existing heuristic eviction methods (e.g., H$_2$O and SnapKV) rely on static attention or positional signals that often fail to capture a token's future predictive influence. We propose DistillCache, a reinforcement learning framework that formulates KV-cache eviction as a sequential decision problem. DistillCache learns a lightweight policy network using rich internal model signals (attention statistics, value norms, entropy, and position) and trains it with REINFORCE via a per-step KL-divergence reward to preserve the full-cache output distribution. On a 7B-parameter instruction-tuned Transformer (Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3), DistillCache retains 94.2% of full-cache accuracy on LongBench at a 25% cache budget, outperforming both strong heuristic baselines (H$_2$O, SnapKV) by up to 2.7 absolute points and, under our re-implementations, concurrent RL-based methods (ForesightKV, RLKV) by up to 1.4 points on long-context tasks. On reasoning benchmarks, DistillCache is competitive with the best concurrent method and surpasses it under aggressive compression. It also delivers up to 2.1x full-cache throughput while maintaining competitive practical efficiency. These results highlight the effectiveness of learned, distribution-aware policies for memory-efficient long-context LLM inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DistillCache，一个将 KV 缓存逐出 (KV-cache eviction) 建模为序贯决策问题的强化学习框架。策略网络利用注意力统计量、value 范数、熵和位置等内部信号，通过 REINFORCE 配合逐 token 的 KL 散度奖励训练，以保留全缓存输出分布。在 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 上、25% 缓存预算下于 LongBench 保留 94.2% 的全缓存准确率，并优于 H2O 与 SnapKV 等启发式基线。
Motivation: Transformer 大语言模型的 KV 缓存随序列长度线性增长，成为长上下文推理的严重内存瓶颈；现有启发式逐出方法（如 H2O 和 SnapKV）依赖静态注意力或位置信号，往往无法捕捉 token 对未来的预测影响力。
Method: 将 KV 缓存逐出形式化为强化学习中的序贯决策问题；学习一个轻量策略网络，输入为注意力统计量、value 范数、熵和位置等模型内部信号，并用 REINFORCE 训练，奖励为逐 token 的 KL 散度，目标是逼近全缓存输出分布。
Result: 在 7B 指令微调 Transformer（Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3）上，以 25% 缓存预算在 LongBench 保留 94.2% 的全缓存准确率；比 H2O、SnapKV 最高提升 2.7 个绝对百分点，比作者重实现的并发强化学习方法（ForesightKV、RLKV）在长上下文任务上最高提升 1.4 个百分点；在推理基准上与最优并发方法相当并在激进压缩下更优，吞吐量最高达全缓存的 2.1 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，学习得到的、分布感知的逐出策略能有效实现内存高效的长上下文 LLM 推理；实验主要在 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 上开展，并与作者重实现的基线比较。

papers.title: Inductive Graph Layout with Implicit Neural Fields
papers.abstract_en: A graph layout is normally a table of $N$ free coordinates. We optimise a function with a fixed number of parameters instead. This gives a drawing a sample complexity and an extensible domain. Force-directed algorithms remain the standard tools for graph drawing. The most accurate among them minimise stress in the Kamada-Kawai formulation by directly optimising the node coordinates, at a full objective cost of $O(N^2)$ in time and space. Here, we propose Fling (Field Layout via Implicit Neural Geometry), a small neural network mapping the distances of each node to a set of landmarks, positioning it in the plane by training on the layout energy. The full spring system then becomes tractable without its distance matrix, as rest lengths follow from a landmark bound in constant time per pair while a second network learns the majorisation sums from exact anchor rows, at $O(|\mathcal{A}|N)$ per step for $|\mathcal{A}|\ll N$ anchors. Unlike neural drawers that read the graph by message passing, we represent the drawing as a function of node features. An unseen node costs one forward pass, where sparse and low-rank majorisation remain transductive. As the unknowns are weights rather than coordinates, the energy only requires a small fraction of the nodes, and a field fitted that way outperforms PivotMDS, landmark MDS, and a kernel ridge trained on the same energy and features, when the task is fitting the energy of a graph from a sample of its nodes. In addition, the same parameterisation enables a stochastic pivot stress variant, an aesthetics-optimised variant carrying a neighbour-embedding energy with node-edge clearance and crossing terms on the same field, and conditioning on the weight between two energies gives a whole layout family from one run.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Fling（Field Layout via Implicit Neural Geometry），用一个小型神经网络把每个节点到一组地标（landmark）的距离映射为平面坐标，并直接在布局能量上训练，从而把图布局看作参数固定的函数而非 N 个自由坐标。该方法无需构造完整的距离矩阵：每对节点的静止长度可由地标界在常数时间得到，另一个网络从精确锚点行学习主化求和，每步复杂度为 O(|A|N)。在从节点样本拟合图能量的任务上，Fling 优于 PivotMDS、地标 MDS 以及在相同能量与特征上训练的核岭回归。
Motivation: 力导向算法仍是图绘制的标准工具，其中最精准的 Kamada-Kawai 应力最小化直接优化节点坐标，但完整目标的时间与空间复杂度为 O(N^2)，难以扩展到大规模图。
Method: Fling 用隐式神经几何场表示布局：网络以节点到一组地标的距离为输入并输出平面坐标，通过布局能量训练；静止长度借助地标界在每对节点上常数时间得到，第二个网络从少量锚点行学习主化求和，从而绕过距离矩阵。该表示是节点特征的函数，未见过的新节点只需一次前向传播。
Result: 在从节点样本拟合图能量的任务上，Fling 优于 PivotMDS、landmark MDS 以及在相同能量和特征上训练的核岭回归。
Conclusion: 由于未知量是网络权重而非节点坐标，能量只需少量节点即可计算；同一参数化还支持随机 pivot 应力变体、带节点-边间距与交叉项的邻域嵌入美学优化变体，并可通过调节两个能量间的权重在一次运行中得到整个布局族。

papers.title: AeroReformer2: Spoken-Query Referring Segmentation for Aerial Images
papers.abstract_en: Spoken language offers a natural, hands-free interface for specifying an arbitrary target in dense remote-sensing imagery, yet existing referring remote-sensing image segmentation benchmarks accept only written expressions. To bridge this gap, we introduce \dataset, a spoken-query benchmark derived from RISBench that adds accent- and voice-diverse speech while preserving the original image, mask, and data splits. Its hard evaluation sets combine rotor, wind, and mixed interference with three signal-to-noise levels. We also propose \model, an efficient bilateral network that combines a boundary-preserving visual path with token-preserving speech encoding, kernel linear cross-modal attention, and a resolution refinement head. The design conditions visual features at two scales without materializing a dense speech--visual affinity matrix, then restores fine boundaries using high-resolution visual features. On the clean test split, \model with Swin-Base achieves 62.09\% mean intersection over union (mIoU) and 68.22\% overall intersection over union (oIoU), outperforming the strongest audio-adapted remote-sensing baseline by 5.38 and 2.08 percentage points, respectively. It retains the best hard-set mIoU at 54.09\%. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first benchmark and model study of full-sentence spoken-query referring segmentation for remote-sensing imagery. The code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AeroReformer2，首个面向遥感影像的整句语音查询指称分割（spoken-query referring segmentation）框架，并引入基于 RISBench 构建的语音查询基准 AeroSpeechBench。该基准在保留原图像、掩码与数据划分的同时，加入口音和声音多样性语音，并设置含旋翼、风与混合干扰的困难评测集。模型采用边界保持视觉路径与 token 保持语音编码的双分支网络，结合核线性跨模态注意力与分辨率细化头，避免稠密语音-视觉亲和矩阵。在干净测试集上 Swin-Base 达到 62.09% mIoU 与 68.22% oIoU，分别超过最强音频适配遥感基线 5.38 和 2.08 个百分点，困难集 mIoU 为 54.09%。
Motivation: 现有遥感指称分割基准只接受书面表达式，而语音是遥感密集影像中指定任意目标的自然、免提交互方式，该空白限制了实际应用。
Method: 提出高效双边网络 AeroReformer2：包含边界保持视觉路径与 token 保持语音编码，采用核线性跨模态注意力在两种尺度上条件化视觉特征，无需生成稠密语音-视觉亲和矩阵，并通过分辨率细化头利用高分辨率视觉特征恢复精细边界。
Result: 在干净测试集上，Swin-Base 达到 62.09% mIoU 和 68.22% oIoU，较最强音频适配遥感基线分别提升 5.38 和 2.08 个百分点；在含旋翼、风和混合干扰的困难集上保持最佳 mIoU 54.09%。
Conclusion: 该工作首次对遥感影像进行整句语音查询指称分割的基准与模型研究，代码将公开。

summary_sections.method: 提出高效双边网络 AeroReformer2：包含边界保持视觉路径与 token 保持语音编码，采用核线性跨模态注意力在两种尺度上条件化视觉特征，无需生成稠密语音-视觉亲和矩阵，并通过分辨率细化头利用高分辨率视觉特征恢复精细边界。
summary_sections.result: 在干净测试集上，Swin-Base 达到 62.09% mIoU 和 68.22% oIoU，较最强音频适配遥感基线分别提升 5.38 和 2.08 个百分点；在含旋翼、风和混合干扰的困难集上保持最佳 mIoU 54.09%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作首次对遥感影像进行整句语音查询指称分割的基准与模型研究，代码将公开。

papers.title: Sparse Attention to Emotion: Efficient Facial Emotion Recognition via Token Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Facial Emotion Recognition (FER) is an important task that has significant implications across various fields such as biometrics, health, and human-computer interaction. Current Vision Transformer-based approaches display quadratic complexity $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$, with N being the input sequence length, making them cumbersome to deploy at the edge. In this paper, we hypothesize that the FER task does not necessarily require all facial information to correctly interpret emotional states, as specific regions such as the eyes, the mouth, and parts of the cheeks carry discriminative information that can be sufficient to recognize emotions. Based on this, we propose Sparse Attention to Emotion (SAE), a model that discards image tokens that have no added value to the emotional context, while preserving good accuracy and achieving a significant gain in computational cost. Surprisingly, even after suppressing 90\% of the image tokens, our model achieves competitive accuracy to state of the art methods at much lower cost, providing a lightweight Facial Emotion Recognition approach. Experimental results demonstrate that SAE achieves new state of the art results on the RAF-DB dataset while reducing the computational complexity by up to 90\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Sparse Attention to Emotion (SAE)，一种基于Vision Transformer的面部表情识别(FER)轻量化方法，通过丢弃对情绪上下文无附加价值的图像token来降低计算复杂度。摘要称即使抑制90%的图像token，模型仍能达到与现有方法竞争的准确率，并在RAF-DB数据集上取得新的最先进结果，计算复杂度最多降低90%。
Motivation: 当前基于Vision Transformer的FER方法具有二次复杂度O(N^2)，难以在边缘部署。作者假设FER任务不需要全部面部信息，眼睛、嘴巴和部分脸颊等区域已足以识别情绪，因此希望减少输入token。
Method: 提出SAE模型，在注意力机制中稀疏化输入：丢弃对情绪上下文无效的图像token，保留携带判别性信息的区域，从而在保持准确率的同时显著降低计算成本。
Result: 实验表明，即使抑制90%的图像token，SAE仍能达到与最先进方法竞争的准确率；在RAF-DB数据集上取得新的最先进结果，同时最多降低90%的计算复杂度。
Conclusion: SAE提供了一种轻量级的FER方法，验证了稀疏token选择可以在大幅降低计算开销的同时保持高准确率，适合边缘部署场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Approximation Rates for Metaplectic Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we develop quantitative approximation results for shallow neural networks constructed using a dictionary based on metaplectic operators. First, we extend the concept of Barron spaces by considering a symplectically motivated extension of the Fourier transform, known as the metaplectic transform. Then, after establishing embedding between metaplectic Barron spaces and Sobolev spaces we consider a neural metaplectic dictionary and we prove Monte-Carlo approximation bounds for metaplectic Barron functions using finite linear combinations of atoms of the dictionary. Finally, we validate the introduction of the neural metaplectic dictionary by devising a deep neural network architecture that uses as building blocks the atoms of the dictionary. We test it to approximate solutions of time-dependent Schrödinger equations, demonstrating better performance compared to classical phyisics informed neural networks architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文建立基于 metaplectic 算子的浅层神经网络的定量逼近结果：将 Barron 空间概念推广到 metaplectic 变换，证明 metaplectic Barron 空间与 Sobolev 空间的嵌入关系，并给出用字典原子有限线性组合逼近 metaplectic Barron 函数的 Monte-Carlo 误差界。作者进一步设计以这些原子为构建块的深层网络，在含时 Schrödinger 方程求解上表现优于经典物理信息神经网络 (PINN)。
Motivation: 经典 Barron 空间和 Fourier 型字典的逼近理论难以覆盖更一般的振荡函数类，而量子动力学中 Schrödinger 方程解常具有辛结构驱动的振荡特性，需要更贴合这些结构的逼近框架。
Method: 通过辛动机的 metaplectic 变换推广 Fourier 变换并定义 metaplectic Barron 空间；先建立其与 Sobolev 空间的嵌入关系，再构造神经网络 metaplectic 字典，证明有限原子线性组合的 Monte-Carlo 逼近界，并据此设计以字典原子为构建块的深度网络架构。
Result: 摘要给出 metaplectic Barron 函数的逼近率估计；在含时 Schrödinger 方程数值实验上，所提架构比经典 PINN 架构表现更好。
Conclusion: 作者认为引入 metaplectic 字典并用于构造网络架构，为处理具有辛结构或振荡性质的函数逼近提供了一个有理论保证的新工具。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Zero-Shot Traffic Accident Detection via a Coarse-to-Fine VLM-Tracking Pipeline
papers.abstract_en: Traffic surveillance cameras capture accidents continuously, yet converting raw CCTV footage into structured event records that pinpoint when, where, and what type of collision occurred remains unsolved at scale. The ACCIDENT @ CVPR benchmark evaluates exactly this joint prediction under a strict constraint: no labeled real-world training data is available. We introduce a training-free, two-pass coarse-to-fine pipeline that pairs a frozen Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct vision-language model with YOLO11x object detection and BoT-SORT tracking. A first pass sparsely samples the full clip to anchor the collision moment in time; a second pass re-examines a tight window around that estimate using frames annotated with stable vehicle identities and normalized bounding-box coordinates, which gives the model both a visual overlay and an explicit numeric description of the same scene. On the official 2,027-clip real-CCTV test set, our system achieves a three-way harmonic mean score of 0.504, surpassing all organizer-published baselines including the best multi-model ensemble (0.412) by a 22% relative margin.
papers.comment: Accepted at the AUTOPILOT Workshop, CVPR 2026, Denver, CO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的粗到细两阶段流水线用于零样本交通事故检测，将冻结的 Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct 视觉语言模型与 YOLO11x 目标检测和 BoT-SORT 跟踪结合。第一阶段稀疏采样整段视频以定位碰撞时刻，第二阶段在紧邻该时刻的窗口内结合稳定车辆身份和归一化边界框坐标作为视觉叠加与数值描述重新检查。在官方 2,027 段真实 CCTV 测试集上，系统达到三路谐波均值 0.504，比组织者发布的最佳多模型集成（0.412）相对提升 22%。
Motivation: 交通监控摄像头持续捕获事故，但将原始 CCTV 视频转换为结构化事件记录（何时、何地、何种碰撞类型）在大规模场景下仍未被解决，且 ACCIDENT @ CVPR 基准严格限制不能使用带标注的真实世界训练数据。
Method: 提出一个训练无关的两遍粗到细流水线：第一遍稀疏采样整段片段以锚定碰撞时刻，第二遍在一个紧凑时间窗口内，利用带有稳定车辆身份和归一化边界框坐标的帧来同时提供视觉叠加和显式数值描述给视觉语言模型。
Result: 在官方 2,027 段真实 CCTV 测试集上，系统取得三路谐波均值 0.504，超过所有组织者发布的基线，包括最佳多模型集成（0.412），相对提升 22%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该训练自由流水线在无标注真实世界训练数据的严格约束下超越了既有基线，展示了视觉语言模型与跟踪模块结合用于事故时空与类别联合预测的可行性。

papers.title: Agentic Anomaly Detection with ORCA-Style Dynamic Inductive Bias Adaptation in Multimodal Wearable Time Series Data
papers.abstract_en: Wireless Body Area Networks (WBANs) generate multivariate physiological time series that are highly nonstationary and must often be processed under strict computational and memory constraints. A critical yet underexplored challenge in this setting is selecting an appropriate temporal receptive field, which serves as a strong inductive bias for anomaly detection models. Existing approaches typically rely on fixed temporal contexts, which can perform inconsistently across heterogeneous signal regimes and require dataset-specific tuning. We propose ORCA, an agentically controlled anomaly detection framework that dynamically adapts the temporal receptive field at inference time based on lightweight signal statistics. Rather than introducing additional trainable parameters or learned policies, ORCA employs a supervisory controller that autonomously selects among discrete temporal contexts, enabling state-dependent inductive bias adaptation without retraining. Across a custom WBAN dataset, ORCA achieves performance comparable to the strongest fixed-context baselines (AUROC = 0.99) while eliminating the need to tune temporal horizons in advance. We further evaluate ORCA on MIMIC-IV as a challenging out-of-distribution benchmark, observing conservative generalization behavior without performance collapse under heterogeneous clinical conditions. These results highlight adaptive temporal inductive bias control as a practical and robust design principle for anomaly detection in resource-constrained, nonstationary physiological time series.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ORCA，一个面向无线体域网 (WBAN) 多模态生理时间序列的异常检测框架，在推理时根据轻量信号统计量动态选择时间感受野 (temporal receptive field)。该方法不引入额外可训练参数或学习策略，而是通过监督控制器在离散时间上下文间自主切换，从而无需重训练即可实现状态相关的归纳偏置自适应。在自建 WBAN 数据集上达到与最强固定上下文基线相当的 AUROC=0.99，并在 MIMIC-IV 上展示保守的泛化行为。
Motivation: WBAN 生成的多变量生理时间序列高度非平稳，且需在严格计算与内存约束下处理；选择合适的时间感受野是关键但未充分探索的归纳偏置。现有方法依赖固定时间上下文，在异质信号状态下表现不一致，且需要针对数据集手动调参。
Method: 提出 ORCA 框架，采用智能体式监督控制器，基于轻量信号统计量在推理时从离散时间上下文中自动选择感受野，实现无重训练的归纳偏置自适应；不增加可训练参数或学习策略。
Result: 在自建 WBAN 数据集上，ORCA 取得与最强固定上下文基线相当的 AUROC=0.99，同时免去预先调整时间视野的需求；在 MIMIC-IV 这一分布外基准上表现出保守泛化，未出现性能崩溃。
Conclusion: 作者认为自适应时间归纳偏置控制是资源受限、非平稳生理时间序列异常检测中实用且稳健的设计原则。

papers.title: Beyond Routing: Decoupling Expert Dispatch and Aggregation in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routers commonly use the same scores both to select experts and to weight their already-computed outputs. We study whether these two roles, dispatch and aggregation, should be coupled. On pretrained OLMoE-1B-7B, we keep selected Top-8 expert IDs, expert computation, and total selected router mass fixed and change only within-set aggregation. A structured oracle improves full-horizon cross-entropy by 0.0160 +/- 0.0039 across three seeds; the router's top-scored expert is the counterfactual-best vertex only 17.2% of the time, with router-utility Spearman 0.030. We therefore train Fixed-Dispatch Adaptive Aggregation (FDAA), a 301K-parameter post-compute head optimized directly with the language-modeling objective while freezing the backbone, router, and experts. On OLMoE, FDAA improves fresh WikiText-103 test by Delta CE = -0.1523 +/- 0.0031 across three seeds, and mixed-domain training gives robust gains on WikiText-103, C4, and held-out Penn Treebank under frozen confirmatory evaluation. We also replicate the fixed-dispatch audit on DeepSeek-V2-Lite, which uses Top-6 routed experts plus shared experts. Best-vertex headroom remains significant on WikiText and C4, while router Top1 identifies the best selected expert in only 12.5% and 16.7% of audited examples. In a one-seed mixed-domain replication, FDAA improves locked WikiText and PTB, while C4 is statistically neutral. These results support a cross-architecture distinction between expert selection and expert commitment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究稀疏 MoE 中路由分数同时承担专家选择与输出加权两个角色是否合理。作者在已预训练的 OLMoE-1B-7B 上固定 Top-8 选中的专家集合、专家计算与路由总质量，仅改变集合内聚合方式，发现结构化 oracle 可将完整序列交叉熵改善 0.0160 ± 0.0039（三个种子），而路由最高分专家仅在 17.2% 的例子中是反事实最优顶点。基于此提出 FDAA（Fixed-Dispatch Adaptive Aggregation），一个 30.1 万参数的 post-compute 头，在冻结主干、路由与专家的情况下直接用语言建模目标优化，并在 OLMoE 与 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 上验证了专家选择与专家承诺可解耦。
Motivation: 现有稀疏 MoE 路由普遍用同一组分数既选择专家又对已算出的专家输出加权，作者质疑这两个角色是否应当耦合，并用审计实验检验路由分数用于聚合时的次优性。
Method: 提出 FDAA：保持原路由的专家分派（dispatch）不变，在专家输出之后引入一个 301K 参数的聚合头，在冻结 backbone、router 与 expert 的条件下直接用语言建模目标优化（aggregation），并采用混合领域训练以提升泛化。
Result: 在 OLMoE 上，FDAA 使未见过的 WikiText-103 测试集获得 ΔCE = -0.1523 ± 0.0031（三个种子）；混合领域训练在 WikiText-103、C4 与留出的 Penn Treebank 上均有稳健提升。在 DeepSeek-V2-Lite（Top-6 路由专家加共享专家）上，路由 Top1 仅在 12.5% 与 16.7% 的审计样本中识别出最佳选中专家；单种子混合领域复现中 FDAA 改进锁定的 WikiText 与 PTB，而 C4 统计上中性。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果支持跨架构地将专家选择（expert selection）与专家承诺（expert commitment）区分开，即路由分数不应同时承担分派与聚合双重职责。

papers.title: Findings of the First Teaching Monster Challenge: A Benchmark of Pedagogical Content Knowledge in AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents can now solve problems, answer like subject experts, and generate long-form multimodal content. However, whether they can adapt a lesson to fit a specified learner, which education calls Pedagogical Content Knowledge (PCK), has not been benchmarked. To measure it, we introduce the Teaching Monster Challenge, the first instructional video generation benchmark to treat the learner persona as an explicit evaluation criterion. Each system is given a topic and a learner persona and must generate a complete instructional video. Every video is screened by an LLM-judge, ranked by crowd pairwise voting, and finalized by an expert panel. The first edition shows that today's systems handle the content well but are far weaker at presenting it and adapting it to the learner. The same process exposes a limit of automatic judging. The LLM-judge separates a clear low-performing tail but ranks the strongest systems poorly. The strongest systems receive nearly identical scores from the judge, so its ranking of them does not match human preference. Progress therefore requires not only better teaching systems but also better automatic judges, and we release the benchmark, rubric, and human judgments as a testbed for both.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Teaching Monster Challenge，据称是第一个把学习者人设 (learner persona) 作为显式评估标准的教学视频生成基准。每个系统拿到一个主题和一个人设后需生成完整教学视频，视频先由 LLM-judge 筛查、再经众包成对投票排序、最后由专家小组定稿。首届结果显示当前系统内容处理尚可，但在呈现方式和针对学习者的适配方面明显偏弱；同时自动评测暴露了局限性，LLM-judge 能分出低分尾部，但对最强系统的排序与人类偏好不一致。作者公开了基准、评分细则 (rubric) 和人类判断，作为改进教学系统与自动评测器的测试平台。
Motivation: 现有基准未检验 AI 智能体能否将一节课适配到指定学习者，而教育领域称之为教学内容知识 (Pedagogical Content Knowledge, PCK)；该能力缺乏量化评测，因此需要专门基准来衡量。
Method: 构建教学视频生成基准：输入为主题和学习者人设，要求系统生成完整教学视频；采用 LLM-judge 初步筛选、众包成对投票排序、专家小组最终裁决的三级评估流程。
Result: 首届评测显示系统在内容维度表现好，但在呈现与学习者适配维度明显较弱；LLM-judge 只能识别明显低分尾部，却对最强系统给出几乎相同的分数，导致其排序与人类偏好不符。
Conclusion: 作者认为该领域进展既需要更强的教学生成系统，也需要更强的自动评测器，并把基准、rubric 与人类判断作为公开测试平台提供给社区。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Toward Mask Annotation-Free Surgical Instrument Segmentation from Endoscopic Images Using Text-Prompted Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3)
papers.abstract_en: Surgical instrument segmentation is a fundamental task for computer-assisted interventions, yet most existing methods rely on pixel-level annotations or manual spatial prompts, which limit scalability and automation. The recently introduced Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) offers a pathway to annotation-free, automatic segmentation via text-based prompting; however, the instrument name as a text prompt could not be directly used due to a large domain gap. To overcome these limitations, we propose a two-stage framework that achieves instance-level segmentation without requiring ground truth masks or manual interaction. In the first stage, we leverage a natural-language-aligned generic prompt - "tool" - to produce binary masks using SAM3's zero-shot capability. In the second stage, these masks are extended to instance-level by integrating a vision-language model (Qwen) that is fine-tuned on SAM3-generated masked regions for instrument classification. We evaluate our approach on the EndoVis 2017 and 2018 datasets. Results show that, while our two-stage approach does not reach the performance of current fully supervised methods, it significantly outperforms the direct use of SAM3 for instance-level instrument segmentation with text prompts. Overall, our findings highlight both the limitations and potential of SAM3, suggesting a promising direction toward annotation-free surgical instrument segmentation.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Medical Image Understanding and Analysis (MIUA)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段框架，利用文本提示的 Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) 实现无需掩码标注的外科手术器械实例分割。第一阶段用通用文本提示 "tool" 借助 SAM3 的零样本能力生成二值掩码，第二阶段用基于 SAM3 掩码区域微调的视觉语言模型 Qwen 进行分类并扩展到实例级。在 EndoVis 2017 和 2018 数据集上的结果表明，该两阶段方法虽不及全监督方法，但显著优于直接使用 SAM3 进行文本提示的实例分割。
Motivation: 现有手术器械分割方法大多依赖像素级标注或人工空间提示，限制了可扩展性和自动化；而 SAM3 的文本提示因领域差距无法直接使用器械名称作为提示。
Method: 提出两阶段流程：第一阶段使用自然语言对齐的通用提示 "tool" 通过 SAM3 零样本能力生成二值掩码；第二阶段将掩码区域输入经 SAM3 生成掩码微调的视觉语言模型 Qwen，进行器械分类并扩展为实例级分割。
Result: 在 EndoVis 2017 和 2018 数据集上，两阶段方法未达到当前全监督方法的性能，但显著优于直接使用 SAM3 配合文本提示的实例级器械分割。
Conclusion: 研究同时展示了 SAM3 在无标注手术器械分割中的局限与潜力，为迈向免标注的分割方向提供了探索性结论。

papers.title: SLAP: Selective Local Vision-Language Alignment for Fish Re-Identification via Partial Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Individual fish re-identification (ReID) is a fine-grained recognition problem in which identity-discriminative cues are often localized to specific body regions rather than distributed uniformly across the animal. Nevertheless, recent CLIP-based ReID methods rely predominantly on global image-text alignment, allowing background and weakly discriminative regions to contribute to cross-modal supervision. We propose a selective local vision-language alignment framework that establishes localized correspondences between visual patch embeddings and multiple identity-aware prompt embeddings through Partial Optimal Transport (POT). Rather than enforcing exhaustive correspondence, POT enables selective matching between visual patches and prompt embeddings, allowing the model to emphasize the strongest cross-modal correspondences while avoiding forced alignment of weakly matching regions, thereby yielding more discriminative visual representations for retrieval. The framework is trained end-to-end, while only the adapted visual encoder is retained during inference. Experiments on the longitudinal Symphodus melops dataset demonstrate consistent improvements over recent CLIP-based ReID methods under both closed-set and open-set evaluation protocols. Additional evaluations on other datasets further demonstrate the generalization capability of the proposed method across diverse marine ReID benchmarks.
papers.comment: This is the author version prior to incorporating the camera-ready comments. The final version will be included in the Proceedings of the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SLAP，一种面向鱼类个体再识别 (fish re-identification) 的选择性局部视觉-语言对齐框架，借助部分最优传输 (Partial Optimal Transport, POT) 在视觉 patch 嵌入与多个身份感知 prompt 嵌入之间建立局部对应。框架端到端训练，推理时仅保留适配后的视觉编码器。在 Symphodus melops 纵向数据集上，该方法在闭集与开集评估协议下均一致优于近期基于 CLIP 的 ReID 方法，并在其他海洋 ReID 基准上表现出泛化能力。
Motivation: 鱼类的身份判别线索往往集中在特定身体区域而非均匀分布，但现有基于 CLIP 的 ReID 方法主要依赖全局图像-文本对齐，使背景和弱判别区域也参与跨模态监督，从而限制表示判别力。
Method: 提出选择性局部视觉-语言对齐框架，通过部分最优传输 (POT) 在视觉 patch 嵌入与多个身份感知 prompt 嵌入之间建立选择性局部对应，而非强制穷举对齐，从而突出最强跨模态对应并避免弱匹配区域的强迫对齐；训练采用端到端方式，推理时仅保留适配的视觉编码器。
Result: 在 Symphodus melops 纵向数据集上，该方法在闭集和开集评估协议下均一致优于近期基于 CLIP 的 ReID 方法；在多个其他数据集上的额外评估进一步表明其在不同海洋 ReID 基准上的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过 POT 实现的选择性匹配能够获得更具判别力的检索视觉表示，且该框架可泛化到多种海洋 ReID 基准。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SG-WAM: Text-Grounded and Spatial-aware Semantic Guidance for World-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation. However, most existing WAMs generate future videos and actions by relying mainly on visual cues rather than language instructions, since off-the-shelf text encoders embed instructions independently of visual observations. As a result, the videos predicted by these WAMs are often semantically misaligned with their corresponding language instructions, which degrades the accuracy of the predicted actions. To overcome this limitation, we propose SG-WAM, a semantic guidance method for world-action models that leverages a vision-language model (VLM) as a semantic planner to enhance the instruction-grounding capacity of world-action models. Specifically, we train a VLM-based planner to predict text-grounded and spatial-aware semantic foresight. The text-grounded semantic foresight grounds the instruction by identifying the correct target objects, and the spatial-aware semantic foresight provides the scene geometry for precise manipulation. We then inject this foresight into the world-action model as high-level semantic guidance, ensuring that both future-video generation and action prediction faithfully follow the language instruction. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate the superiority of our semantic guidance method, showcasing precise manipulation and strong instruction-following capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SG-WAM，一种面向世界动作模型 (World-Action Model, WAM) 的语义引导方法，用于提升机器人操作中语言指令与预测视频/动作的对齐程度。作者训练一个基于视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的语义规划器，生成文本锚定 (text-grounded) 和空间感知 (spatial-aware) 的语义前瞻 (semantic foresight)，并将其注入世界动作模型作为高层语义引导。仿真与真实实验表明该方法能实现更精确的操作和更强的指令跟随能力。
Motivation: 现有大多数世界动作模型主要依赖视觉线索而非语言指令来生成未来视频和动作，因为现成文本编码器对指令的编码与视觉观察相互独立。这导致预测视频与语言指令之间出现语义错位，进而降低动作预测精度。
Method: 训练一个 VLM 作为语义规划器，预测两类语义前瞻：文本锚定的语义前瞻用于识别正确目标物体以对齐指令，空间感知的语义前瞻提供精细操作所需的场景几何信息。随后将这些前瞻作为高层语义引导注入世界动作模型，使未来视频生成和动作预测都遵循语言指令。
Result: 摘要报告在仿真和真实世界的广泛实验中，该语义引导方法优于基线，展现出精确的操控能力和强指令跟随能力；摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过 VLM 提供文本与空间语义前瞻，可以有效增强世界动作模型的指令接地 (instruction-grounding) 能力，从而改善操作精度与指令一致性。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为通过 VLM 提供文本与空间语义前瞻，可以有效增强世界动作模型的指令接地 (instruction-grounding) 能力，从而改善操作精度与指令一致性。

papers.title: Visual Token Codec: Unleashing Spatial Redundancy for ViT Feature Coding
papers.abstract_en: Distributed deployment of large vision foundation models often partitions a ViT backbone and exchanges intermediate token features between computing nodes, making efficient feature compression critical under bandwidth and computation constraints. Existing ViT feature codecs typically flatten heterogeneous global and patch tokens into an L x C pseudo image, causing entropy models to mainly capture sequence-axis dependencies while overlooking the native two-dimensional patch-grid structure. In this paper, we show that ViT patch tokens retain strong local spatial correlations on the original grid. To exploit this structural prior, we propose the Visual Token Codec (VTC), a dual-path learned codec that separates global and patch tokens into dedicated coding paths. Global tokens are compressed with a lightweight factorized prior, whereas patch tokens are encoded on the patch-token grid using a spatial-channel context entropy model. To support intermediate-layer compression and practical rate adaptation, VTC further incorporates feature-matching supervision after subsequent ViT blocks and variable-rate modules within a single codec. Experiments on DINOv2 and SAM3 show that VTC consistently outperforms representative ViT feature coding baselines on classification, segmentation, and detection tasks. At 90% of uncompressed-feature performance, VTC reduces bitrate by 15.7x-37.4x across these tasks. We further provide intermediate-layer rate-utility analyses for practical transmission- and storage-oriented deployment scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出视觉令牌编解码器（Visual Token Codec, VTC），针对分布式部署视觉基础模型时中间 ViT 令牌特征的压缩问题，利用 patch token 在原始二维网格上的局部空间相关性进行编码。VTC 采用双路径结构，分别处理全局令牌和 patch 令牌，并加入特征匹配监督与可变码率模块。实验表明在 DINOv2 和 SAM3 上，相比代表性 ViT 特征编码基线，在分类、分割、检测任务中均取得更优的率失真性能。
Motivation: 分布式部署大规模视觉基础模型时，需要在节点间传输 ViT 中间令牌特征，而现有 ViT 特征编解码器通常将异构的全局令牌与 patch 令牌展平成 L×C 伪图像，导致熵模型主要捕捉序列轴依赖，忽略了 patch 网格固有的二维结构先验。
Method: VTC 是一种双路径学习编解码器，将全局令牌和 patch 令牌分离到独立编码路径；全局令牌用轻量因子化先验压缩，patch 令牌在 patch token 网格上使用空间-通道上下文熵模型编码。此外，VTC 在后续 ViT 块后加入特征匹配监督，并在单一编解码器内支持可变码率模块，以适配中间层压缩和实际码率调整。
Result: 在 DINOv2 和 SAM3 上的实验显示，VTC 在分类、分割和检测任务上一致优于代表性 ViT 特征编码基线。在达到未压缩特征性能的 90% 时，VTC 可将码率降低 15.7 倍至 37.4 倍。摘要还提供了面向传输和存储部署场景的中间层率-效用分析。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用 patch 令牌的原始二维空间结构先验能显著提升 ViT 特征编码效率，VTC 为中间层特征压缩提供了可行的率-效用权衡方案。

papers.title: PROSLEX: A Novel Dataset for Expert-Annotated Legal Statute Prediction for Indian Judiciary
papers.abstract_en: Legal Statute Prediction (LSP) involves automatically identifying relevant legal statutes given factual descriptions in legal documents, typically framed as a multi-label classification task within natural language processing and information retrieval research. While recent advances have begun incorporating Large Language Models (LLMs) for statute prediction, current approaches primarily focus on accuracy metrics without addressing the critical need for legal reasoning, a fundamental requirement in judicial contexts where decisions must be explainable and justifiable. To address this research gap, we present PROSLEX (PRediction Of Statutes and LEgal eXplanation), a comprehensive dataset comprising 1,623 expert-annotated legal documents from the Indian context. Each document is paired with statute predictions and detailed explanations, totaling 7,450 explanations, capturing the underlying legal reasoning. Using this dataset, we systematically evaluate various prompting strategies, including zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, and tree-of-thoughts approaches, to generate both statute predictions and their corresponding legal rationales. Our evaluation framework measures not only predictive performance but also the coherence and legal validity of generated explanations, positioning PROSLEX as a benchmark for developing explainable AI systems that can support legal practitioners while advancing research in interpretable legal NLP. To ensure reproducibility, we have made our PROSLEX dataset and model code available on GitHub: https://github.com/subinay494/Legal_Statute_Prediction_Explanation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PROSLEX，一个面向印度司法语境的法律条文预测（Legal Statute Prediction, LSP）数据集，包含 1,623 篇专家标注的法律文档、条文预测以及共 7,450 条解释，用于捕捉法律推理过程。作者系统评估了零样本、少样本、思维链（chain-of-thought）和思维树（tree-of-thoughts）等提示策略，同时衡量预测性能与生成解释的连贯性和法律有效性，旨在推动可解释的法律 NLP 研究。数据集和代码已公开在 GitHub。
Motivation: 现有法律条文预测研究多依赖 LLM 并只关注准确率指标，忽视了司法场景中决策必须具备可解释性和可辩护性的关键需求，缺少同时提供条文预测与法律推理依据的基准资源。
Method: 构建 PROSLEX 数据集，由专家为每篇印度法律文档标注条文预测及详细法律解释；在此数据集上比较多种提示策略（zero-shot、few-shot、chain-of-thought、tree-of-thoughts），并设计评估框架同时检查预测表现与解释的连贯性和法律有效性。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的定量结果，仅说明该方法能生成条文预测与对应法律理由，并将 PROSLEX 定位为可解释 AI 系统的基准，数据与代码已开源。
Conclusion: PROSLEX 可作为开发可解释法律 NLP 系统的基准资源，支持法律从业者并推动解释性研究；作者强调数据集与代码已公开以保证可复现性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deployable Per-Instance Multi-Layer Activation Steering for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering edits the behaviour of a frozen language model by adding a learned vector to its residual stream, and current practice fixes the injection layers globally per task. We argue that the best layers are an instance-level decision, and we make per-instance, multi-layer selection both well understood and deployable. On two open-weight 8B models and six binary persona traits, a per-instance oracle over layer subsets shows that the best layers vary from one input to the next: on most trait-model pairs, no fixed global layer set recovers the per-instance benefit. A greedy rule that ranks layers by single-layer marginal effect recovers nearly all of the oracle's benefit, but both must score candidate layers against the gold answer, so neither can run at deployment; the rule instead becomes the target a prompt-only predictor is trained to reproduce. Our deployable recipe needs no label at inference: a per-instance layer ranker read off the prompt embedding, a classifier that infers the steering direction, and an adaptive gate that scores short steered passes against that inferred direction and steers no more layers than necessary. The recipe recovers most of the oracle's lift (the bulk on the stronger model, a clear majority on the harder one), never drives any trait-model pair below its unsteered alignment baseline on average, and largely avoids the fluency collapse that strong global selection incurs at higher layer counts. A mechanistic account, "direction over magnitude", explains the behavioural flip under a mis-directed global set, the output collapse from steering too many layers, and the ceiling of unsteerable inputs.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 24 figures, 30 tables. Under review at ACL Rolling Review (August 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型激活引导 (activation steering) 中的注入层选择问题，主张最优层是实例级 (per-instance) 决策而非任务级全局固定。作者在两个 open-weight 8B 模型与六种二值人格特质上构造逐实例 oracle，发现固定全局层集无法恢复逐实例收益；随后提出无需推理时标签的可部署配方，即基于 prompt embedding 的逐实例层排序器、推断引导方向的分类器和自适应门控，该配方恢复了大部分 oracle 提升并避免流畅性崩溃。
Motivation: 现有激活引导实践将注入层固定为每个任务一次的全局选择，但作者论证最佳注入层应随输入实例变化，且目前缺少既在理论上可理解又能在部署时运行的多层逐实例选择方案。
Method: 首先用逐实例 oracle 枚举层子集证明最佳层随输入变化，并用按单层边际效应排序的贪心规则逼近 oracle；由于这两种方法都需要对候选层对照 gold 答案打分而无法部署，作者将其作为目标，训练一个纯 prompt 预测器来模仿。可部署配方包括：基于 prompt embedding 的逐实例层排序器、推断引导方向的分类器，以及一个对短引导前向传播 (steered passes) 按推断方向打分、并尽量少引导层的自适应门控，推理时无需标签。
Result: 在两个 open-weight 8B 模型和六种二值人格特质上，多数特质-模型对不存在能恢复逐实例收益的固定全局层集；贪心规则恢复近乎全部 oracle 收益。可部署配方恢复了大部分 oracle 提升（在较强模型上为主体、在较难模型上为明确多数），从未使任何特质-模型对平均低于未引导对齐基线，并在高引导层数下大体避免了强全局选择造成的流畅性崩溃。
Conclusion: 作者提出机制性解释 “direction over magnitude”（方向压倒幅度），统一解释了错误方向全局集导致的行为翻转、引导过多层导致的输出塌缩以及不可引导输入的收益上限。实验范围限定在两个 8B 模型和六种人格特质上。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: The Cost of Adaptivity: Matching Lower Bounds Across Learning Problems
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive procedures must work without nuisance information an oracle may use, such as a gradient scale or smoothness index, and robust procedures may have to answer queries whose coordinate and inspection time are chosen only after the data are seen. Such comparisons are meaningful only when the oracle advantage and validity contract are stated explicitly. We formalize nuisance adaptation via a slice-normalized minimax ratio retaining the worst-case instance within each nuisance slice, and separately define the robustness cost of expanding from one preannounced Gaussian query to arbitrary post-hoc inspection. Our main result is a finite-horizon composition law for Gaussian certification: from M independent coordinates, a familywise certifier protecting every coordinate and time up to T pays optimal normalized squared half-width of order log(eM) + log log(e^eT), within the sample-mean-centered rectangular class. Epoch stitching gives the upper bound; independent Gaussian block increments across coordinates and geometric time scales give a matching lower bound, already holding on a geometric checkpoint grid, forcing quantiles of the realized maximum width so selection and stopping taxes add. Two benchmark regimes complete the picture: unknown gradient scale in online convex optimization has constant cost, while pointwise adaptation over nested Holder classes costs order (log n / log log n)^(s1/(2s1+1)). Cast as model monitoring, the law lets an analyst inspect any of M slice metrics at any data-dependent time: the naive fixed-query band's selected coverage degrades sharply, to 0.30 at M=1 and to zero for M>=10, while the epoch-stitched certifier holds familywise coverage at an additive iterated-logarithm width cost. Experiments put both sharp predictions at risk of refutation; both survive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化研究自适应过程（adaptive procedure）的代价，提出以切片归一化极小极大比率（slice-normalized minimax ratio）刻画对 nuisance 信息的适应，并单独定义从预宣布高斯查询扩展到任意事后检查的稳健性代价。核心结果是一个有限时域的高斯认证组合律：在样本均值居中的矩形类中，保护 M 个独立坐标和直到时间 T 的族系认证器（familywise certifier）需付出最优归一化平方半宽阶 log(eM)+log log(e^eT)。上界由 epoch stitching 给出，下界由跨坐标独立高斯块增量与几何时间尺度匹配得到，且在下界中选择与停止的代价自动叠加。两个基准情形分别给出在线凸优化中未知梯度尺度的常数代价，以及嵌套 Hölder 类逐点适应的阶 (log n / log log n)^(s1/(2s1+1)) 代价。
Motivation: 自适应程序必须在没有 oracle 可能使用的 nuisance 信息（如梯度尺度或光滑度指标）下工作，而稳健程序可能需要在看到数据后才选择查询的坐标和检查时间；这类比较只有在显式说明 oracle 优势与有效性契约时才有意义，现有框架缺少这种形式化。
Method: 作者定义切片归一化极小极大比率，在每个 nuisance 切片内保留最坏实例，并分别定义从单一预宣布高斯查询扩展到任意事后检查的稳健性代价。主要技术是建立高斯认证的有限时域组合律：用 epoch stitching 构造上界，用独立高斯块增量和几何时间尺度构造匹配下界，并指出该下界在几何检查点网格上已迫使实现最大宽度的分位数，从而选择与停止代价自然累加。
Result: 摘要报告了匹配的上下界：归一化平方半宽为 log(eM)+log log(e^eT) 阶；未知梯度尺度的在线凸优化代价为常数；嵌套 Hölder 类上逐点适应代价为 (log n / log log n)^(s1/(2s1+1)) 阶。在模型监控实验中，朴素固定查询带的选定覆盖率在 M=1 时剧烈下降至 0.30，M>=10 时降为 0，而 epoch-stitched 认证器以加性迭代对数宽度代价保持族系覆盖率；两个尖锐预测的实验均未遭反驳。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将问题建模为模型监控后，分析者可以在任意数据相关时间检查 M 个切片指标中的任意一个；实验使两个尖锐理论预测面临被驳斥的风险，但两个预测都幸存下来，说明所提出的代价律与下界具有实质预测力。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文形式化研究自适应过程（adaptive procedure）的代价，提出以切片归一化极小极大比率（slice-normalized minimax ratio）刻画对 nuisance 信息的适应，并单独定义从预宣布高斯查询扩展到任意事后检查的稳健性代价。核心结果是一个有限时域的高斯认证组合律：在样本均值居中的矩形类中，保护 M 个独立坐标和直到时间 T 的族系认证器（familywise certifier）需付出最优归一化平方半宽阶 log(eM)+log log(e^eT)。上界由 epoch stitching 给出，下界由跨坐标独立高斯块增量与几何时间尺度匹配得到，且在下界中选择与停止的代价自动叠加。两个基准情形分别给出在线凸优化中未知梯度尺度的常数代价，以及嵌套 Hölder 类逐点适应的阶 (log n / log log n)^(s1/(2s1+1)) 代价。
summary_sections.motivation: 自适应程序必须在没有 oracle 可能使用的 nuisance 信息（如梯度尺度或光滑度指标）下工作，而稳健程序可能需要在看到数据后才选择查询的坐标和检查时间；这类比较只有在显式说明 oracle 优势与有效性契约时才有意义，现有框架缺少这种形式化。
summary_sections.method: 作者定义切片归一化极小极大比率，在每个 nuisance 切片内保留最坏实例，并分别定义从单一预宣布高斯查询扩展到任意事后检查的稳健性代价。主要技术是建立高斯认证的有限时域组合律：用 epoch stitching 构造上界，用独立高斯块增量和几何时间尺度构造匹配下界，并指出该下界在几何检查点网格上已迫使实现最大宽度的分位数，从而选择与停止代价自然累加。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告了匹配的上下界：归一化平方半宽为 log(eM)+log log(e^eT) 阶；未知梯度尺度的在线凸优化代价为常数；嵌套 Hölder 类上逐点适应代价为 (log n / log log n)^(s1/(2s1+1)) 阶。在模型监控实验中，朴素固定查询带的选定覆盖率在 M=1 时剧烈下降至 0.30，M>=10 时降为 0，而 epoch-stitched 认证器以加性迭代对数宽度代价保持族系覆盖率；两个尖锐预测的实验均未遭反驳。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调将问题建模为模型监控后，分析者可以在任意数据相关时间检查 M 个切片指标中的任意一个；实验使两个尖锐理论预测面临被驳斥的风险，但两个预测都幸存下来，说明所提出的代价律与下界具有实质预测力。

papers.title: Hybrid Neural-Classical Correction for Frozen Time Series Foundation Models: A Comprehensive Ablation Study on High-Frequency Stock Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models for time series forecasting demonstrate impressive zero-shot generalization but often underperform on specialized domains such as high-frequency finance. We present a comprehensive study of hybrid neural-classical correction for adapting frozen TimesFM (200M parameters) to stock return prediction during the volatile opening trading hour. We compare two neural correction architectures - AttnCorrect (multi-head self-attention, approximately 471K parameters) and GatedLinear (low-rank bilinear projection with gating, approximately 49K parameters) - each augmented with Random Forest residual learning. Through systematic ablation across 10 major technology stocks (NVDA, MSFT, AAPL, GOOG, GOOGL, AMZN, META, AVGO, TSLA, NFLX) spanning 2 million data points, we reveal critical insights: (1) The hybrid neural-classical approach achieves 0.597 pooled correlation and 6.4x mean per-day correlation improvement over frozen TimesFM; (2) Classical residual learning (Random Forest) provides the largest single-component contribution, matching or exceeding the neural correction component; (3) Simpler neural architectures surprisingly outperform complex ones when classical residual learning is removed; (4) Self-attention provides the largest neural-only contribution. GatedLinear+RF achieves best overall performance with 9x fewer neural parameters than AttnCorrect+RF. We report three complementary correlation metrics - mean per-day, cross-day cumulative, and pooled - to provide a complete picture of predictive quality. Our results provide practical guidance: effective foundation model adaptation requires careful integration of neural and classical components, with classical methods playing a crucial complementary role.
papers.comment: Accepted and presented at IJCNN 2026, part of the IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence (WCCI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对冻结的时间序列基础模型 TimesFM（200M 参数）在美股开盘后一小时的高频股票收益预测上进行混合神经-经典校正（hybrid neural-classical correction）的系统消融研究。作者对比了两种神经校正结构 AttnCorrect（多头自注意力，约 471K 参数）和 GatedLinear（低秩双线性投影加门控，约 49K 参数），并分别结合 Random Forest 残差学习。基于 10 只大型科技股共 200 万数据点的实验显示，混合方法将池化相关性提升到 0.597，平均每日相关性较冻结 TimesFM 提升 6.4 倍。
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型在零样本泛化上表现突出，但在高频金融等专业领域常表现不佳，现有研究缺乏对如何系统适配这类冻结基础模型的深入分析。
Method: 提出并比较两种结合 Random Forest 残差学习的神经校正架构：AttnCorrect（多头自注意力）和 GatedLinear（低秩双线性投影加门控），并在 10 只科技股上开展组件级消融实验，同时用平均每日、跨日累积和池化三种相关性指标评估。
Result: GatedLinear+RF 取得最佳整体性能，且神经参数比 AttnCorrect+RF 少 9 倍；Random Forest 经典残差学习是单一贡献最大的组件，其效果达到或超过神经校正组件；移除经典残差学习后，更简单的神经架构反而优于复杂架构；自注意力提供最大的纯神经贡献。
Conclusion: 有效的冻结基础模型适配需要神经组件与经典方法的谨慎整合，经典方法在其中扮演关键的补充角色；该结论对高频金融预测具有实践指导意义。

papers.title: Automated Generation of Complexity-Validated Decision Scenarios Using Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Cognitive decision-making research depends on diverse scenarios with carefully controlled complexity, yet manual production is slow, inconsistent, and biased. We developed an automated pipeline that uses LLms to generate structured decision scenarios and validates their complexity through a composite framework rooted in established task-complexity theory. We evaluated 4,238 scenarios across multiple domains and complexity tiers. Measurement validation met rigorous psychometric standards. Agreement among five independent model families was nearly perfect, with an intraclass correlation coefficient of 0.997 and a kappa of 0.971. Known-groups validity demonstrated large separation between tiers, with an eta-squared of 0.587 and all pairwise comparisons significant at p less than .001. Factor analysis revealed a dominant complexity construct, with loadings between 0.87 and 0.96 across three frameworks, while interactivity formed a weaker secondary dimension at 0.34. Discriminant validity was limited by a strong relationship between complexity and text length that persisted after controlling for tier, yielding a partial correlation of 0.86. This constrains construct purity but does not undermine the instrument's tier-grading function. Model analyses showed a negative association between throughput and schema pass rate (r = -0.967, p = .007, n = 5), suggesting a speed-quality trade-off, though largely driven by one high-throughput model. Llama 4 Maverick generated scenarios fastest at 134 per minute versus 25 for DeepSeek Chat V3.2, but underproduced complex-tier scenarios, whereas DeepSeek Chat V3.2 balanced domain coverage with high schema compliance. The system demonstrated strong psychometric properties, enabling reliable classification into Simple, Moderate, and Complex tiers and providing the measurement infrastructure needed for downstream cognitive assessment of AI systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个自动化流水线，利用大语言模型（LLM）生成结构化的决策场景，并基于任务复杂度理论（task-complexity theory）的复合框架验证其复杂度分级。研究评估了 4,238 个跨领域、跨复杂度层级的场景，心理测量学指标表现良好，能将场景可靠地分为 Simple、Moderate、Complex 三个层级，为下游 AI 系统的认知评估提供测量基础设施。
Motivation: 认知决策研究依赖复杂度受控且多样化的场景，但人工生成场景速度慢、不一致且存在偏差，缺乏可扩展的自动化手段。
Method: 构建自动化流水线，使用 LLM 生成结构化决策场景，并通过一个基于既有任务复杂度理论的复合框架来验证场景复杂度；随后用多种心理测量学方法（如组间效度、因子分析、信度一致性）评估该测量工具的性能。
Result: 摘要报告 4,238 个场景的实验：五个独立模型家族的一致性接近完美（ICC=0.997，kappa=0.971）；已知组效度显示层级间分离明显（eta-squared=0.587，所有两两比较 p<.001）；因子分析显示主导的复杂度构念（载荷 0.87–0.96），而交互性为较弱的次级维度（0.34）；区分效度受复杂度与文本长度强相关限制（偏相关 0.86）。模型分析显示吞吐量与 schema 通过率负相关（r=-0.967, p=.007），Llama 4 Maverick 生成最快（134 个/分钟）但复杂层级场景生成不足，DeepSeek Chat V3.2（25 个/分钟）在领域覆盖与 schema 合规间更平衡。
Conclusion: 该系统的心理测量学属性较强，能够可靠地将场景分类到不同复杂度层级，但其构念纯度受复杂度与文本长度关联的制约；摘要强调该系统为下游 AI 系统认知评估提供了测量基础设施。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LogiShot: Logically Coherent Cross-Shot Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating cross-shot videos that are logically connected is essential for content creation. Currently, most cross-shot video-generation workflows, such as short-drama production, still rely on isolated textual scripts or explicit reference images to specify the generated content. Consequently, when user instructions are underspecified or ambiguous, a generated clip may appear visually plausible on its own but fail to align with the overall narrative, leading to disjointed content. We argue that achieving cross-shot logical coherence in video generation requires establishing logical connections across shots and maintaining visual consistency. To this end, we propose LogiShot, which incorporates information through two complementary paths: 1) LogiShot jointly encodes the context video and other conditioning signals, yielding dense multimodal cues that provide visual-semantic evidence for cross-shot generation; 2) the model maintains a visual memory of the context video throughout generation to preserve visual consistency across shots. Additionally, we construct a dataset with 110K samples and a dedicated benchmark for evaluating cross-shot logical coherence. Experiments demonstrate that LogiShot consistently outperforms existing baselines in terms of logical coherence across multiple shots. Model and data will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LogiShot，一种面向跨镜头视频生成的逻辑连贯性方法。LogiShot 通过联合编码上下文视频与其他条件信号得到密集多模态线索，并在生成全程维护上下文视频的视觉记忆，以同时保证镜头间的逻辑连接和视觉一致性。作者还构建了 110K 样本的数据集与专用基准，实验显示该方法在多个镜头的逻辑连贯性上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有跨镜头视频生成流程多依赖孤立文本脚本或显式参考图，当用户指令不明确时，单个镜头虽然视觉上自洽，却可能偏离整体叙事，造成内容割裂。作者认为需要建立镜头间的逻辑联系并保持视觉一致性。
Method: 提出两条互补信息路径：其一，LogiShot 联合编码上下文视频与其他条件信号，获得用于跨镜头生成的密集多模态线索；其二，在生成过程中维护上下文视频的视觉记忆。此外还构建了 110K 样本数据集和专门评估跨镜头逻辑连贯性的基准。
Result: 实验表明，LogiShot 在多镜头场景的逻辑连贯性上持续优于现有基线。摘要未给出具体的量化指标。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是，跨镜头逻辑连贯性需要同时实现镜头间的逻辑连接与视觉一致性；作者表示模型和数据将公开，但未讨论局限性。

papers.title: MRI super-resolution in ten sampling steps using a diffusion bridge model
papers.abstract_en: Objective. MRI provides excellent soft-tissue contrast, but long acquisition times can cause patient discomfort and lead to motion artifacts, forcing a trade-off between spatial resolution and scan time. Diffusion-based super-resolution (SR) reconstructs high-resolution (HR) images from low-resolution (LR) inputs, but typically needs many sampling steps and initializes from a Gaussian prior ill-suited to image restoration. We developed an efficient diffusion framework that reconstructs HR MRI directly from LR data. Approach. We propose super-resolution diffusion bridge model (SR-DBM), a super-resolution diffusion bridge model that casts SR as a stochastic transport between the LR and HR image distributions. Through a Doob's h-transform of a mean-reverting stochastic differential equation, SR-DBM pins the process to the paired HR and LR images at its endpoints, initializing reconstruction from the measured anatomy rather than from Gaussian noise. The HR image is recovered by a deterministic reverse trajectory in which a network predicts the clean image at each of only ten sampling steps. We evaluated SR-DBM on ultra-high-field 7T brain T1 MP2RAGE maps and pelvic T2-weighted prostate images against nine comparison methods using PSNR, SSIM, GMSD, and LPIPS. Main results. SR-DBM attained the highest PSNR and SSIM and the lowest GMSD on both datasets (brain: 27.66+-1.52 dB, 0.96+-0.02, 7.96+-1.86$; prostate: 27.87+-2.29 dB, 0.80+-0.05, 8.38+- 1.44), with statistically significant gains over every comparison method (two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test with Holm correction, p<0.05). The strongest baseline, SR-EMamba, ranked second. Qualitatively, SR-DBM produced the smallest residual errors and best preserved fine structures and lesions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出超分辨率扩散桥模型 (SR-DBM)，将 MRI 超分辨率建模为低分辨率 (LR) 与高分辨率 (HR) 图像分布之间的随机输运。通过 Doob's h-transform 的均值回复随机微分方程，固定过程端点为配对图像，从测量解剖结构而非高斯噪声初始化，用确定性逆轨迹在仅十步采样中恢复 HR 图像。在 7T 脑 T1 MP2RAGE 和盆腔 T2 前列腺数据上评估，SR-DBM 在 PSNR、SSIM、GMSD 上均优于九种对比方法。
Motivation: MRI 采集时间长导致患者不适和运动伪影，需要在空间分辨率和扫描时间之间权衡。现有基于扩散的超分辨率方法通常需要大量采样步骤，且从不适于图像恢复的高斯先验初始化，效率与质量受限。
Method: 提出 SR-DBM，将超分辨率视为 LR 与 HR 图像分布间的随机输运；利用 Doob's h-transform 构造均值回复随机微分方程，使过程端点锚定配对 HR 和 LR 图像，从而从真实测量解剖结构初始化；通过仅十步的确定性逆轨迹，由网络逐步预测干净图像。
Result: 在两个数据集上 SR-DBM 均取得最高 PSNR 和 SSIM、最低 GMSD（脑部：27.66±1.52 dB、0.96±0.02、7.96±1.86；前列腺：27.87±2.29 dB、0.80±0.05、8.38±1.44），且经两侧 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验与 Holm 校正后相对所有对比方法均有显著提升 (p<0.05)；最强基线 SR-EMamba 排名第二。定性上残差最小，细结构和病灶保留最好。
Conclusion: 作者认为将 SR 构建为配对的 LR-HR 扩散桥并固定端点、仅用十步确定性采样，可以高效地从 LR 数据重建 HR MRI，并优于现有扩散 SR 方法。

papers.title: Distilling Vision-Language Models for Robust Traffic Sign Perception in Autonomous Vehicles
papers.abstract_en: Traffic sign recognition (TSR) models based on deep neural networks achieve strong clean-data performance but remain vulnerable to physically realizable adversarial attacks, including shadow perturbations, natural-light interference, and printed patches. Existing defenses often improve robustness against one attack type while degrading performance on others, and can reduce clean accuracy. We propose LAMDA (Language-Anchored Model for Direction Alignment), a training framework that transfers language-grounded structure into TSR models without using adversarial examples or adding inference-time overhead. LAMDA builds two fixed prototype banks from VLM-generated sign descriptions and class names using a frozen OpenCLIP text encoder, and uses them to supervise visual features through two complementary auxiliary losses during training. At inference, the adapter and prototype banks are discarded, leaving a standard backbone and classifier. Evaluated on GTSRB and LISA across four backbones and three physical attack types, LAMDA is the only method among ten evaluated that consistently improves robustness across all attack-backbone-dataset combinations, with gains of up to +12.5 pp under shadow attacks and +13.2 pp under natural-light attacks, while preserving or improving clean accuracy in nearly all cases.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LAMDA（Language-Anchored Model for Direction Alignment），一种面向自动驾驶交通标志识别（TSR）的训练框架，利用冻结的 OpenCLIP 文本编码器从 VLM 生成的标志描述和类名构建两个固定原型库，并通过两个辅助损失在训练中监督视觉特征，从而在不使用对抗样本、不增加推理开销的情况下提升对物理可实现对抗攻击的鲁棒性。在 GTSRB 和 LISA 数据集、四种骨干网络和三种物理攻击类型上，LAMDA 是十种被评估方法中唯一在所有攻击-骨干-数据集组合上均稳定提升鲁棒性的方法。
Motivation: 深度神经网络 TSR 模型在干净数据上表现良好，但容易受到阴影扰动、自然光干扰和印刷贴片等物理可实现对抗攻击；现有防御往往只提升对一种攻击的鲁棒性却损害其他攻击或降低干净准确率。
Method: LAMDA 使用冻结的 OpenCLIP 文本编码器，从 VLM 生成的标志描述和类名构建两个固定原型库，在训练过程中通过两个互补的辅助损失将语言引导的结构迁移到视觉特征中；推理时丢弃适配器和原型库，仅保留标准骨干网络和分类器。
Result: 在 GTSRB 和 LISA 上跨四种骨干网络和三种物理攻击类型评估，LAMDA 是十种方法中唯一在所有攻击-骨干-数据集组合上稳定提升鲁棒性的方法，在阴影攻击下增益最高达 +12.5 个百分点，在自然光攻击下达 +13.2 个百分点，且几乎在所有情况下保持或提升干净准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过语言锚定的原型监督可以在不引入对抗训练样本或推理开销的情况下，同时改善多种物理攻击下的 TSR 鲁棒性并保住干净精度。

papers.title: 360CityArena: A Realistic Virtual Urban Navigation Benchmark for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: We present 360CityArena, a benchmark for evaluating the urban exploration capabilities of embodied agents within a photorealistic environment constructed from 360-degree videos. Existing outdoor benchmarks either lack sufficient photorealism or complexity, resulting in a considerable gap from real-world urban environments. 360CityArena is built on a realistic reconstruction of the Akihabara district in Tokyo, Japan, using 602 360-degree video segments covering 85 streets, and consists of 175 meticulously human-crafted tasks. It encompasses three task categories: Environment Understanding, Path Reasoning, and Spatial Reasoning, covering fundamental abilities required for urban exploration, such as localization, landmark search, path planning, and relational spatial reasoning, thereby enabling comprehensive evaluation in realistic urban scenes. Our evaluation using state-of-the-art LMM-based agents shows that even the strongest model, Gemini 2.5 Flash, performs far below human level (human: 77.3% vs. Gemini 2.5 Flash: 17.1%), revealing substantial challenges that remain in city-scale embodied navigation and reasoning. 360CityArena provides a necessary and challenging testbed for photorealistic urban-district navigation and spatial reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 360CityArena 是一个面向具身智能体 (embodied agents) 的城市探索能力评估基准，基于东京秋叶原地区的 360 度视频构建了逼真环境，包含 602 个视频片段、覆盖 85 条街道，并设计了 175 个人工任务。任务分为环境理解、路径推理和空间推理三类，覆盖定位、地标搜索、路径规划与关系性空间推理等能力。评测显示最强的 LMM 智能体 Gemini 2.5 Flash 仅有 17.1% 的准确率，远低于人类的 77.3%，说明城市级具身导航与推理仍面临巨大挑战。
Motivation: 现有的室外导航基准要么缺乏足够的照片级真实感，要么复杂度不足，导致与真实城市环境之间存在明显差距，难以有效评估具身智能体在真实城市尺度下的探索能力。
Method: 提出 360CityArena 基准，使用 602 段 360 度视频重建东京秋叶原区域，覆盖 85 条街道，并构建 175 个由人工设计的任务，分为环境理解、路径推理和空间推理三大类别。
Result: 在基于 SOTA LMM 的智能体评测中，最强模型 Gemini 2.5 Flash 仅达到 17.1% 的准确率，而人类为 77.3%，显示出当前模型与人类水平之间存在显著差距。
Conclusion: 作者认为该基准为照片级真实感的城市区域导航与空间推理提供了一个必要且具有挑战性的测试平台，并揭示了该任务目前仍未解决的核心困难。

papers.title: AdapterMoE: A Two-Stage Hard-Routing Mixture-of-Experts Architecture for Multi-Crop Disease Recognition with Calibrated Rejection and Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Timely crop-disease identification is critical to food security. Multi-crop recognition suits Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), but conventional soft-routing MoE learns crop assignment freely end-to-end, letting a few experts dominate (expert collapse) with no semantic correspondence to crops, and facing high retraining costs, unstable rejection of non-target inputs, and a saturated accuracy ceiling. We shift the objective from accuracy toward a trade-off among deployment cost, scaling flexibility, and rejection stability, using deterministic hard routing. We propose AdapterMoE: a RouterHead classifies the crop and rejects non-target crops via a Maximum Softmax Probability threshold, with a dual-gate Energy+KNN out-of-distribution module catching distribution-shifted inputs; five per-crop Adapters atop a frozen EfficientNet-B0 backbone discriminate diseases, each calibrated via Temperature Scaling. Because experts are hard-isolated at the data level, the design avoids expert collapse and exposes an add_crop interface for local, per-crop updates instead of full retraining. On PlantVillage (5 crops, 26 classes), across a fair five-system comparison, AdapterMoE attains accuracy statistically indistinguishable from the best baselines (Macro-F1 within a 0.24-point band) while cutting training cost to about 9% of full-network baselines, expanding to a new crop in
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdapterMoE，一种面向多作物病害识别的两阶段硬路由混合专家（MoE）架构。与传统软路由 MoE 相比，它以确定性硬路由将作物分配与专家解耦，避免专家坍缩（expert collapse），并通过 RouterHead 的 Maximum Softmax Probability 阈值拒绝非目标作物，配合 Energy+KNN 双门控 OOD 模块处理分布偏移输入。在 PlantVillage 数据集上，该方法在精度上与最佳基线无统计显著差异，同时将训练成本降至全网络基线的约 9%，并支持按作物增量扩展。
Motivation: 传统软路由 MoE 在端到端训练中自由学习作物分配，导致少数专家主导（专家坍缩）、专家与作物无语义对应，且面临高重训成本、对非目标输入拒绝不稳定以及精度天花板饱和的问题。作者将目标从单纯精度转向部署成本、扩展灵活性和拒绝稳定性之间的权衡。
Method: 采用两阶段确定性硬路由：RouterHead 先分类作物并通过 Maximum Softmax Probability 阈值拒绝非目标作物；dual-gate Energy+KNN 模块检测分布偏移输入；五个按作物划分的 Adapter 置于冻结的 EfficientNet-B0 骨干之上判别具体病害，每个 Adapter 用 Temperature Scaling 校准。专家在数据层面硬隔离，暴露 add_crop 接口以支持局部按作物更新而非全模型重训。
Result: 在 PlantVillage（5 种作物、26 个类别）上，与五个基线系统的公平对比中，AdapterMoE 的精度与最佳基线在统计上不可区分（Macro-F1 差距在 0.24 个百分点以内），而训练成本降至全网络基线的约 9%，并可将新作物扩展纳入系统。
Conclusion: 摘要强调硬路由设计避免了专家坍缩，实现了增量式按作物更新，在几乎不损失精度的前提下大幅降低训练成本，并将评估视角从纯精度转向部署成本、扩展灵活性和拒绝稳定性的权衡。

papers.title: Three Generations of Healthcare IT: From the Digital Record to the Computable Care Process
papers.abstract_en: Objective. Healthcare IT is usually organized by the technologies it adopts. We instead organize it by the unit of information a system makes computable, and describe a computational layer whose object is patient-specific clinical intent. Approach. We give criteria for a computational layer, derive three (record, clinical state, and a proposed layer of intent), and formalize the Actionable Clinical Record (ACR) as the atomic object of the third layer. Discussion. The framework distinguishes prescribed, observed, and intended process; existing standards represent intent once it is structured but do not recover it from natural communication, the capability we localize. The ACR is complementary to FHIR workflow resources, guidelines, and process mining; a companion feasibility study illustrates tractability for one narrow subproblem. Conclusion. Computable clinical intent is a coherent research direction; the ACR, its readiness ladder, and an executable-correctness evaluation framework are reusable constructs for subsequent work to extend, evaluate, or falsify.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出以系统可计算的信息单元（而非所采用的技术）来组织医疗 IT，由此推导出三代层次：病历记录（record）、临床状态（clinical state）以及提议中的临床意图（intent）层。作者将 Actionable Clinical Record (ACR) 形式化为第三层的原子对象，并区分了规定的、观察到的与预期的过程。摘要称该框架与 FHIR 工作流资源、指南和流程挖掘互补，且伴随的可行性研究展示了某一狭窄子问题的可处理性。
Motivation: 现有医疗 IT 通常按采用的技术来组织，缺少以系统实际可计算的信息单元为线索的统一视角；同时，已有标准只能在意图被结构化之后表示它，无法从自然交流中恢复临床意图，这正是作者定位的能力缺口。
Method: 作者给出计算层的判据，推导出记录、临床状态和意图三个层次，并将 ACR 形式化为第三层的原子对象；还提出了就绪阶梯（readiness ladder）和可执行正确性（executable-correctness）评估框架作为可复用构件。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验指标，仅提及伴随的可行性研究说明该方法在某个狭窄子问题上具有可处理性（tractability）。
Conclusion: 可计算的临床意图（computable clinical intent）是一个连贯的研究方向；ACR、其就绪阶梯和可执行正确性评估框架可被后续工作扩展、评估或证伪。

summary_sections.method: 作者给出计算层的判据，推导出记录、临床状态和意图三个层次，并将 ACR 形式化为第三层的原子对象；还提出了就绪阶梯（readiness ladder）和可执行正确性（executable-correctness）评估框架作为可复用构件。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告定量实验指标，仅提及伴随的可行性研究说明该方法在某个狭窄子问题上具有可处理性（tractability）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 可计算的临床意图（computable clinical intent）是一个连贯的研究方向；ACR、其就绪阶梯和可执行正确性评估框架可被后续工作扩展、评估或证伪。

papers.title: LASA: Language-and-Source-Anchored Alignment for Domain Generalized Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Domain Generalization Semantic Segmentation (DGSS) focuses on generalizing knowledge from labeled source domains to unseen target domains where data is unavailable during the training phase. While conventional methods utilize style randomization or feature normalization to mitigate domain shifts, they often impair feature integrity. Specifically, style randomization distorts the underlying feature manifold due to its coarse-grained nature, while feature normalization suppresses discriminative, domain-sensitive semantic details owing to its rigid design. To address these limitations, we propose the Language-and-Source-Anchored Alignment (LASA) framework, which comprises three synergistic components: Text-and-Source-Guided Style Transfer (TSGST), Domain-Aware Query Adapter (DAQA), and Domain-Aware Decoder Optimizer (DADO). Concretely, the TSGST module addresses manifold distortion by utilizing source features as structural anchors and vision-language model (VLM) priors as fine-grained guidance. To restore suppressed discriminative and domain-sensitive details, the DAQA module recalibrates object queries via categorical guidance and domain-aware signatures, while the DADO module aligns the resulting query distributions with a shared classifier to ensure consistent categorical responses across domains. Extensive experiments on challenging benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出语言与源锚定对齐（LASA）框架，用于域泛化语义分割（DGSS），其目标是从带标签源域泛化到训练阶段不可见的目标域。LASA 由三个组件组成：文本与源引导的风格迁移（TSGST）、域感知查询适配器（DAQA）和域感知解码器优化器（DADO）。摘要称该方法在多个具有挑战性的基准上显著优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有 DGSS 方法依靠风格随机化或特征归一化缓解域偏移，但会损害特征完整性：风格随机化因粒度粗糙而扭曲底层特征流形，特征归一化因设计僵化而抑制具有区分性的域敏感语义细节。
Method: LASA 包含三个协同组件：TSGST 利用源特征作为结构锚点、并引入视觉语言模型（VLM）先验作为细粒度指导以缓解流形扭曲；DAQA 通过类别引导和域感知签名重新校准对象查询，以恢复被抑制的判别与域敏感细节；DADO 将查询分布与共享分类器对齐，确保跨域类别响应一致。
Result: 摘要在多个具有挑战性的基准上进行大量实验，报告该方法显著优于现有最先进方法，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过同时保持特征完整性并恢复判别性细节，基于源锚定和 VLM 先验的对齐框架可有效改善 DGSS 的跨域泛化。

papers.title: ML-Based Hierarchical Prediction for Practical Energy Scheduling in Dynamic NTN-WPT Systems
papers.abstract_en: With advancements in long-distance wireless power transfer (WPT) and space-based energy technologies, integrating WPT into non-terrestrial networks (NTNs), referred to as NTN-WPT, is emerging as a promising approach for next-generation wireless networks. This paper proposes an energy-scheduling approach that jointly optimizes energy efficiency, task completion rate, and task waiting time for power transfer from low Earth orbit satellites to terrestrial mobile user devices (UDs). To address scheduling challenges caused by satellite and UD mobility and channel uncertainty from stochastic propagation effects, we decompose the problem into three subproblems within a three-layer predictive framework: 1) a state prediction layer forecasts UD and satellite states; 2) an interaction mapping layer uses a graph neural network (GNN) to model energy transfer efficiency; and 3) a decision-making layer determines the energy allocation plan. Distinct machine learning (ML) methods are tailored to each layer. To balance the competing objectives, we adopt a multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) technique that scalarizes them into a weighted-sum reward, transforming the multi-objective problem into a tractable single-objective problem. We further introduce a multi-agent deep learning model integrating self-attention with multi-agent proximal policy optimization (MAPPO) to improve objective balancing. Simulation results show that the proposed approach achieves a better overall trade-off than baseline methods, maintaining competitive task completion rates and energy efficiency while reducing task waiting times, and remains robust under highly variable conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向动态非地面网络无线能量传输（NTN-WPT）系统的能源调度方案，将无线能量传输集成到低轨卫星到地面移动用户的传输中。作者将问题分解为三层的机器学习预测框架：状态预测层、基于图神经网络（GNN）的交互映射层和决策层，并采用多目标强化学习（MORL）将多个目标加权求和转化为单目标问题，同时引入结合自注意力与 MAPPO 的多智能体模型以改善目标平衡。仿真显示该方法相比基线在能源效率、任务完成率与任务等待时间之间取得更好的整体权衡，并在高度变化条件下保持鲁棒性。
Motivation: 卫星和用户设备（UD）的移动性以及随机传播效应带来的信道不确定性，使得 NTN-WPT 系统中的能源调度具有挑战性；需要联合优化能源效率、任务完成率与任务等待时间。
Method: 将能源调度问题分解为三个子问题，构成三层预测框架：1) 状态预测层预测 UD 与卫星状态；2) 交互映射层使用 GNN 建模能量传输效率；3) 决策层确定能量分配方案。每层采用不同的机器学习方法；通过 MORL 将多目标加权为单一奖励，并引入融合自注意力与 MAPPO 的多智能体深度模型。
Result: 仿真结果表明，所提方法相较基线实现了更好的整体权衡，能保持有竞争力的任务完成率和能源效率，同时降低任务等待时间，并且在高度可变的条件下保持鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该层次化预测框架与多目标强化学习相结合的方法能够有效应对 NTN-WPT 动态环境中的能源调度问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Improving Generalization Robustness of Multimodal RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) makes Multimodal Large Language Models more accurate, but the gains are brittle: simply paraphrasing a question or changing the prompt template can degrade them, which challenges reliable deployment in high-stakes scenarios like medical VQA. We trace this to two issues of the standard RL objective. First, the binary verifier conflates format with content, so the reward signal cannot tell a wrong answer apart from a misformatted one. Second, the training distribution covers only a thin slice of the real-world prompts that the model might meet at deployment, so policies that perform well on the training distribution can behave differently under unseen prompts during test. Both failures call for a robust post-training method that helps the policy cover a broader distribution of semantically equivalent prompts, and we identify two measures that help achieve this objective: separating format from semantics in the reward, and applying policy invariance across perturbed prompts with equivalent semantics. We therefore propose Prompt-Invariant RLVR (PIRL), consisting of a dynamic trinary reward and a consistency regularizer based on an embedding-space adversary. Under stress testing, PIRL's average accuracy on benchmarks drops by only $\le 1\%$, where GRPO drops ~3%. On dynamic evaluation, PIRL also achieves the smallest performance drop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态 RLVR（Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards）训练后精度提升但鲁棒性差的问题，提出 Prompt-Invariant RLVR（PIRL）。作者将脆弱性归因于二元验证器混淆格式与内容，以及训练分布只覆盖现实提示的狭窄子集；PIRL 通过动态三值奖励（dynamic trinary reward）和基于嵌入空间对抗的的一致性正则化（consistency regularizer）来提升对语义等价提示扰动的鲁棒性。压力测试中 PIRL 的平均精度下降不超过 1%，而 GRPO 下降约 3%。
Motivation: RLVR 能让多模态大模型更准确，但这种提升很脆弱：改写问题或更换提示模板即可导致性能退化，影响医疗 VQA 等高危场景的可靠部署。
Method: 提出 PIRL，包含两个核心措施：在奖励中把格式与语义分开（动态三值奖励），以及通过嵌入空间对抗（embedding-space adversary）构造语义等价的扰动提示并对策略施加不变性（policy invariance）正则化。
Result: 在压力测试下，PIRL 在基准上的平均准确率下降不超过 1%，而 GRPO 下降约 3%；在动态评估中，PIRL 也表现出最小的性能下降。
Conclusion: 作者强调，鲁棒的 post-training 方法需要帮助策略覆盖更广的语义等价提示分布，关键是分离奖励中的格式与语义，并对语义等价的扰动提示施加策略不变性。

papers.title: Deferred Audio Pruning with Local Audio-Visual Dynamics for Omni-LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Omni-modal LLMs jointly process audio, video, and text, but long multimodal sequences incur substantial prefill and KV-cache costs. Existing omni-modal compression methods primarily focus on pre-LLM token reduction, leaving modality-specific compression across the LLM boundary underexplored. We propose A-PACK, a two-stage framework that defers audio pruning until query-conditioned multimodal interactions emerge. Our analysis shows that audio exhibits higher task-relevant information density and representational diversity per token than video. We further find that local audio-visual dynamics provide a more effective cue for visual selection than token-wise matching. We therefore preserve audio and compress video with local dynamics before the LLM, then progressively prune low-relevance audio and visual tokens and their KV-cache entries inside the LLM. Across four benchmarks on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B/3B, A-PACK achieves the strongest average performance among the evaluated prior methods while reducing prefill FLOPs by up to 78% and improving decoding throughput by up to 2.21x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 A-PACK，一个面向 Omni-modal LLM（如 Qwen2.5-Omni）的两阶段音频剪枝框架，将音频剪枝推迟到查询条件化的多模态交互产生之后。论文通过分析发现音频每 token 的任务相关信息密度和表征多样性高于视频，且局部音视频动态（local audio-visual dynamics）比逐 token 匹配更适合指导视觉选择；因此在进入 LLM 前保留音频并用局部动态压缩视频，进入 LLM 后再渐进剪除低相关性的音频与视觉 token 及其 KV-cache 条目。
Motivation: Omni-modal LLM 需要联合处理音频、视频和文本，长多模态序列会带来高昂的 prefill 和 KV-cache 开销。现有 omni-modal 压缩方法主要聚焦于进入 LLM 之前的 token 缩减，跨 LLM 边界的模态特定压缩尚未被充分探索。
Method: A-PACK 采用两阶段框架：先用局部音视频动态在 LLM 之前压缩视频并保留音频，然后在 LLM 内部基于查询条件化的多模态交互，渐进剪除低相关性音频和视觉 token 以及对应的 KV-cache 条目。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B/3B 上的四个基准中，A-PACK 在被评估的既有方法中取得最强平均性能，同时将 prefill FLOPs 最多降低 78%，并将解码吞吐量提升最多 2.21 倍。
Conclusion: 论文认为推迟音频剪枝并利用局部音视频动态来选择视觉信息，可以更有效地压缩 omni-modal LLM 的长序列；文中的信息密度分析和动态选择线索是这一收益的关键依据。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: End-to-End Neural Decomposition with Koopman Operators for Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Koopman theory offers a linear-operator view of nonlinear sequence dynamics by lifting observations into a space where evolution is governed by a linear time-invariant Koopman operator. While the Koopman operator provides a linear representation of nonlinear dynamics, it is generally infinite dimensional and defined under time-invariant assumptions. To model non-stationary signals with frequency-dependent behavior, a frequency-varying extension is required. In recent years, deep learning has been increasingly employed to exploit its powerful function-approximation ability for learning the Koopman operator. In this study, we propose a novel approach called neural decomposition Koopman (NDKoop), an end-to-end architecture that integrates a learnable signal decomposition module with both frequency-independent and frequency-dependent Koopman based networks for sequence forecasting. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to jointly realize end-to end Koopman modeling and signal decomposition within a unified neural framework. We demonstrate that decomposing a signal into a frequency-independent trend component and a frequency-dependent periodic component, each governed by a corresponding Koopman operator, improves prediction accuracy when perfect linearization is unattainable. Numerical experiments across several forecasting benchmarks indicate that the proposed NDKoop provides strong performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出神经分解 Koopman（NDKoop），一种端到端时序预测架构，将可学习的信号分解模块与频率无关和频率相关的 Koopman 网络相结合。作者称这是首个在统一神经框架中联合实现端到端 Koopman 建模与信号分解的工作，并在多个预测基准上取得较强性能。
Motivation: Koopman 算子虽然能将非线性动力学线性化，但通常是无限维的，且建立在时不变假设之上，难以建模具有频率依赖行为的非平稳信号，因此需要频率变化的扩展。
Method: NDKoop 将信号分解为频率无关的趋势分量和频率相关的周期分量，每个分量分别由对应的 Koopman 算子建模，整个架构以端到端方式联合训练。
Result: 摘要报告在多个预测基准上的数值实验表明 NDKoop 性能强劲，并指出当无法实现完美线性化时，这种信号分解能提升预测精度。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是首次在统一神经框架中联合实现端到端 Koopman 建模与信号分解，为不可完美线性化的非线性序列预测提供了一种改进途径。

papers.title: SymDiag: Explainable Diagnosis for LLM Reasoning via Neuro-Symbolic Verification
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as data-driven reasoners, yet their chains-of-thought (CoT) can be unfaithful even when final answers are correct. Most existing ``verification'' signals are not diagnostic: answer matching observes only the outcome, LLM-as-judge provides subjective and non-verifiable critiques, and scalar rewards (e.g., PRMs/RMs) offer little insight into where a multi-step derivation fails.We propose \textbf{SymDiag}, a neuro-symbolic framework that \textbf{reframes reasoning verification as structured failure diagnosis}. SymDiag translates natural-language CoT into symbolic constraints and performs step-level satisfiability/entailment checks to (i) localize failing steps and (ii) produce verifiable diagnostic evidence, including counterexamples, inconsistency witnesses, and missing-premise indicators. A central challenge is that apparent ``logic violations'' can be caused either by genuine reasoning defects or by neural-to-symbolic translation noise. SymDiag therefore incorporates a Self-Auditor that disentangles TranslationError from ReasoningError via dual symbolic encodings consistency checks, enabling robust diagnosis under partial observability. Across diverse mathematical, logical, scientific, and general reasoning benchmarks, SymDiag improves detection of unfaithful reasoning and provides substantially more effective feedback for multi-round reasoning repair than outcome-only verification and LLM-based judging, offering a principled foundation for trustworthy and scalable reasoning diagnosis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SymDiag，一个将大语言模型（LLM）推理验证重构为结构化失败诊断的神经符号框架。它把自然语言思维链（CoT）翻译为符号约束，进行步级可满足性/蕴含检查，以定位失败步骤并生成可验证的诊断证据（如反例、不一致见证、缺失前提指示）。为区分真正的推理缺陷与神经到符号的翻译噪声，SymDiag 引入 Self-Auditor，通过双符号编码一致性检查分离 TranslationError 与 ReasoningError。在数学、逻辑、科学和一般推理基准上，SymDiag 比仅结果验证和 LLM 评判更能检测不忠推理，并为多轮推理修复提供更有效的反馈。
Motivation: 现有验证信号不具备诊断能力：答案匹配只观察最终结果，LLM-as-judge 提供主观且不可验证的批评，标量奖励（如 PRM/RM）对多步推导中失败位置缺乏洞察。
Method: SymDiag 将自然语言 CoT 翻译为符号约束，执行步级可满足性/蕴含检查来定位失败步骤，并产生反例、不一致见证和缺失前提指示等可验证证据；Self-Auditor 通过双符号编码一致性检查来区分翻译错误（TranslationError）和推理错误（ReasoningError），从而在部分可观测条件下实现鲁棒诊断。
Result: 在数学、逻辑、科学和一般推理基准上，SymDiag 相比仅结果验证和 LLM 评判，提高了对不忠推理的检测，并为多轮推理修复提供了显著更有效的反馈。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该框架为可信且可扩展的推理诊断提供了原则性基础。
