papers.title: Quantum-Classical Physics-Informed Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Solving Fuzzy Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: In this study, we propose a quantum-classical physics-informed Kolmogorov-Arnold network (QCPIKAN) dedicated to the solution of fuzzy differential equations. The network takes the spatiotemporal coordinates and membership level as joint inputs and employs ChebyKAN modules and a parameterized quantum circuit to construct a hybrid function approximator. It simultaneously approximates the lower and upper endpoint functions associated with the α-cuts and incorporates the governing equations, initial-boundary conditions, and fuzzy-structural constraints into the training objective. Theoretically, a unified error-analysis framework is established for QCPIKAN and PIKAN, in which the endpoint-solution error is decomposed into approximation, sampling, optimization, and fuzzy-structure constraint errors. Under the assumptions of well-posedness and residual stability, it is proved that QCPIKAN has a smaller a priori error bound when the representational gain introduced by quantum entanglement features exceeds the additional computational error. Numerical experiments are conducted for elliptic, parabolic, and hyperbolic equations in an ideal quantum-simulation environment. The results show that QCPIKAN captures the overall contraction of the solution interval as increases. At most tested membership levels, the mean relative L2 error of PIKAN is approximately 1.1-2.7 times that of QCPIKAN. In the fuzzy convection example, the mean wavefront-position error of PIKAN is approximately 1.77 times that of QCPIKAN. Nevertheless, both models still exhibit local fuzzy-structure violations near boundaries, in high-gradient regions, and around the wavefront. These results indicate that QCPIKAN provides a quantum-classical hybrid physics-informed computational framework with comparatively high predictive accuracy for solving fuzzy partial differential equations represented by α-cuts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量子-经典物理信息 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（QCPIKAN）用于求解模糊微分方程。网络以时空坐标和隶属度水平为联合输入，采用 ChebyKAN 模块与参数化量子电路构造混合函数逼近器，同时逼近 α-cuts 的下端点和上端点函数，并将控制方程、初边值条件与模糊结构约束纳入训练目标。理论上建立了 QCPIKAN 与 PIKAN 的统一误差分析框架，把端点解误差分解为逼近、采样、优化与模糊结构约束误差，并在适定性和残差稳定性假设下证明当量子纠缠特征带来的表示增益超过额外计算误差时 QCPIKAN 具有更小的先验误差界。数值实验在理想量子模拟环境中针对椭圆、抛物和双曲方程进行，显示 QCPIKAN 在多数隶属度水平下平均相对 L2 误差优于 PIKAN。
Motivation: 模糊微分方程常以 α-cuts 表示，求解其上下端点函数时经典 PIKAN 的预测精度有限，在边界、高梯度区域和波前附近容易出现局部模糊结构违背；因此需要一种预测精度更高的混合计算框架来求解这类模糊偏微分方程。
Method: 提出 QCPIKAN，将时空坐标与隶属度水平作为联合输入，用 ChebyKAN 模块和参数化量子电路构成混合函数逼近器，同时逼近 α-cuts 的上下端点函数，并把控制方程、初边值条件和模糊结构约束计入训练目标；理论上给出统一的误差分解框架，并推导 QCPIKAN 先验误差界小于 PIKAN 的条件。
Result: 在理想量子模拟环境下对椭圆、抛物和双曲方程的数值实验表明，在多数测试隶属度水平下，PIKAN 的平均相对 L2 误差约为 QCPIKAN 的 1.1-2.7 倍；在模糊对流例子中，PIKAN 的平均波前位置误差约为 QCPIKAN 的 1.77 倍；但两种模型在边界附近、高梯度区域和波前附近仍存在局部模糊结构违背。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 QCPIKAN 为求解由 α-cuts 表示的模糊偏微分方程提供了预测精度较高的量子-经典混合物理信息计算框架，同时也指出局部模糊结构违背仍然存在，相关区域仍有改进空间。

papers.title: UPolarSQ: Polar Representation Learning for Optic Disc and Peripapillary Atrophy Segmentation and Quantification in Fundus Photographs
papers.abstract_en: Myopia-induced posterior-pole remodeling is frequently accompanied by Optic Disc (OD) deformation and Peripapillary Atrophy (PPA), both of which provide clinically relevant structural biomarkers. In Cartesian fundus images, however, PPA often appears as an irregular and partially visible crescent adjacent to the OD, leading to fragmented segmentation and post-processing-dependent quantification. We propose UPolarSQ, a unified polar-domain framework for OD/PPA segmentation and biomarker quantification in myopic fundus images. UPolarSQ first maps an OD-centered region of interest into polar coordinates, where OD and PPA boundaries can be represented as radial profiles. It then employs UPolarSeg, a U-Net-based segmentation network enhanced with a Radial-Angular-Decoupled Module and boundary-aware auxiliary supervision to model anisotropic polar features and radial boundary transitions. Clinical biomarkers, including disc shape and PPA-width-related measurements, are deterministically extracted from the predicted polar masks, aligning segmentation and quantification within a shared geometric representation. Experiments on internal and external cohorts demonstrate that UPolarSQ improves OD/PPA segmentation and supports reliable polar-native biomarker estimation for myopic analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UPolarSQ，一个面向近视眼底图像的视盘 (OD) 与视盘周围萎缩 (PPA) 分割及生物标志物量化的统一极坐标框架。方法将 OD 中心区域映射到极坐标，使 OD 与 PPA 边界成为径向剖面，并用增强的 U-Net 网络 UPolarSeg 进行分割，最后从预测的极坐标掩膜中确定性提取盘形与 PPA 宽度相关测量。内部与外部队列实验表明该方法提升 OD/PPA 分割并支持可靠的极坐标原生生物标志物估计。
Motivation: 近视引起的后极重构常伴随 OD 变形和 PPA，这些是临床相关的结构生物标志物；但在笛卡尔眼底图像中，PPA 常呈紧邻 OD 的不规则、部分可见的新月形，导致分割碎片化和依赖后处理的量化。
Method: UPolarSQ 首先将 OD 中心感兴趣区域映射到极坐标系，使 OD 和 PPA 边界可表示为径向剖面；随后使用 UPolarSeg——一种带 Radial-Angular-Decoupled Module 和边界感知辅助监督的 U-Net 分割网络——建模各向异性极坐标特征和径向边界过渡；最终从预测极坐标掩膜中确定性提取包括盘形和 PPA 宽度相关测量在内的临床生物标志物。
Result: 内部和外部队列上的实验表明，UPolarSQ 改善了 OD/PPA 分割，并支持可靠的极坐标原生生物标志物估计，用于近视分析。
Conclusion: 作者强调将分割与量化统一在共享的极坐标几何表示中，能够避免笛卡尔空间中的碎片化分割与后处理依赖，为近视相关结构评估提供一致框架。

papers.title: A Mean-Field Framework for Inference-Time Distributional Control of Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are increasingly used as controllable samplers, whose generations can be steered at inference time according to a chosen reward function. While such rewards are typically defined on individual samples, for many applications it is desirable to steer according to distribution-level rewards, for example to calibrate with population-level information or to encourage diversity. In both cases, simply incorporating the reward gradient into the dynamics, while often effective, comes with few theoretical guarantees on the sampled distribution. For pointwise rewards, recent work has therefore sought to develop a principled framework for targeting a prescribed tilted distribution using particle reweighting. However, an analogous theoretically-grounded approach for distributional rewards is currently lacking. In this work, we formulate inference-time distributional control as targeting a tilted measure under a mean-field framework, and derive a weighted interacting particle scheme to target it in a principled manner. Our framework recovers pointwise-reward steering as a special case, while providing a theoretical foundation for existing batch-level steering methods. Empirically, we verify that the procedure correctly targets the prescribed distribution in tractable low-dimensional settings, and investigate its behaviour in higher-dimensional protein conformation tasks.
papers.comment: Preprint. Presented at SPIGM workshop, ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型推理时的分布级奖励 (distributional rewards) 控制问题，提出一个平均场 (mean-field) 框架，将推理时分布控制表述为对倾斜测度 (tilted measure) 的目标化，并推导出加权交互粒子 (weighted interacting particle) 方案。该框架把逐点奖励 (pointwise rewards) 的引导作为特例，并为现有批级 (batch-level) 引导方法提供理论基础。实验在低维可处理场景验证了其能正确命中目标分布，并在高维蛋白质构象任务中考察了行为。
Motivation: 扩散模型常被用作可控制采样器，但现有推理时控制大多针对逐点奖励；许多应用需要按分布级奖励引导（如校准群体信息或鼓励多样性），而简单把奖励梯度并入动力学缺乏对采样分布的理论保证。逐点奖励已有基于粒子重加权的倾斜分布框架，但分布级奖励缺少类似的理论化方法。
Method: 将推理时分布控制建模为在平均场框架下瞄准一个倾斜测度，并据此推导一个加权交互粒子方案，以原则性的方式逼近目标分布。逐点奖励引导是该框架的特例，批级引导方法也能在该框架下获得理论支撑。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在低维可处理设定下能正确命中指定分布，并在高维蛋白质构象任务中考察了其行为；同时指出框架可恢复逐点奖励引导并解释现有批级引导方法。

papers.title: Learning from Consensus and Disagreement: Unsupervised On-Policy Self-Distillation with Minority-Trajectory Contrast
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation improves language-model reasoning by querying a teacher on states actually visited by the student. Recent methods create a powerful information asymmetry by exposing the teacher to privileged context, yet they fundamentally rely on external supervision---such as gold solutions or verifiers---to construct this advantage. We introduce CoDA (Consensus and Disagreement Alignment), a fully unsupervised framework that creates reliable privileged information entirely from the latent uncertainty structure of a model's own unlabeled rollouts. CoDA extracts two complementary signals. In the positive branch, answer-level consensus identifies a stable reasoning mode, which conditions a frozen self-teacher to provide dense distributional guidance on fresh student trajectories. However, because agreement does not guarantee correctness, positive-only distillation risks amplifying correlated errors into a false consensus. To break this harmful feedback loop, CoDA incorporates a negative branch that exploits disagreement: minority trajectories are treated as unstable alternatives and gently penalized via a reference-anchored, KTO-style calibration objective. This unpaired binary feedback provides robust regularization without requiring the strong assumption that the consensus is the absolute ground truth. Empirical evaluations on competition-level mathematical benchmarks demonstrate that CoDA significantly improves reasoning, outperforming self-generated baselines and effectively stabilizing training against erroneous consensus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoDA（Consensus and Disagreement Alignment），一种完全无监督的 on-policy 自蒸馏框架，用于提升语言模型推理能力。它从模型自身未标注 rollout 的潜在不确定性结构中构建可靠特权信息：正分支利用答案级共识让冻结的自教师提供密集分布性指导，负分支则通过参考锚定的 KTO 风格校准目标温和惩罚少数轨迹，以避免错误共识的放大。在竞赛级数学基准上，CoDA 显著提升推理性能并稳定训练。
Motivation: 现有 on-policy 自蒸馏方法依赖外部监督（如标准答案或 verifier）来构造教师的信息优势，缺少纯无监督条件下构建可靠特权信息的手段；同时，仅有的一致性正蒸馏可能把相关错误放大为虚假共识。
Method: CoDA 包含正负两个分支：正分支用答案级共识识别稳定推理模式，并条件化冻结自教师在新学生轨迹上提供密集分布性指导；负分支将少数轨迹视为不稳定替代，用参考锚定的 KTO 风格校准目标施加温和惩罚，形成无需配对标签的二元反馈，从而在不假设共识为绝对真值的前提下实现正则化。
Result: 在竞赛级数学基准上的评估表明，CoDA 显著改进推理性能，优于自生成基线，并能有效稳定训练，抵抗错误共识造成的负面影响。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架证明了仅从模型自身未标注 rollouts 的不确定性结构中即可构建可靠特权信息，并通过共识与分歧的联合校准避免错误共识的强化。

papers.title: Eco-SoC: A Sustainable VLSI Architecture for Energy-Proportional Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: In an era defined by escalating climate change and the pervasive deployment of edge intelligence, the environmental cost of semiconductor manufacturing and operation has reached a critical threshold. As Deep Learning (DL) accelerators dominate System-on-Chip (SoC) die area, achieving true sustainability requires a paradigm shift from static worst-case efficiency to dynamic energy-proportionality. This paper introduces Eco-SoC, a highly scalable VLSI architecture co-designed specifically for sustainable artificial intelligence. We propose a hardware-level Dynamic Precision-Scaling Logic (DPSL) framework that adaptively modulates bit-width precision based on real-time activation sparsity, successfully reducing switching activity by up to 42% on a commercial 7nm FinFET process node. Furthermore, we transcend traditional Power-Performance-Area (PPA) metrics by providing a comprehensive Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) using the Architectural Carbon footprint Tool (ACT). Our synthesis demonstrates that Eco-SoC offsets its increased embodied carbon footprint (a marginal 4.8% area overhead) within 1.1 years of edge deployment. Finally, by introducing a thermal-aware power gating mechanism that mitigates localized hotspots, Eco-SoC doubles the projected Mean Time To Failure (MTTF) of the silicon, providing a tangible, scalable strategy for electronic waste (e-waste) mitigation in next-generation computing systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Eco-SoC，一种面向可持续人工智能的 VLSI 架构，通过硬件级动态精度缩放逻辑 (DPSL) 依据实时激活稀疏度调节位宽，在商用 7nm FinFET 工艺上减少最高 42% 的开关活动。作者还引入热感知功率门控机制以缓解局部热点，并将硅片预期平均失效时间 (MTTF) 提升一倍。论文使用生命周期评估 (LCA) 工具 ACT 表明，Eco-SoC 在边缘部署 1.1 年内即可抵消其增加的隐含碳足迹（约 4.8% 面积开销）。
Motivation: 深度学习加速器占据 SoC 芯片面积的比例不断上升，而半导体制造与运行的碳成本已达到临界点；传统静态最坏情况效率设计不足以实现真正的可持续性，需要转向动态能量比例 (energy-proportional) 的架构。
Method: 提出 Eco-SoC 架构，包含硬件级动态精度缩放逻辑 (DPSL)，根据实时激活稀疏度自适应调整位宽精度以降低开关活动；并引入热感知功率门控机制以缓解局部热点，同时采用 Architectural Carbon footprint Tool (ACT) 进行全生命周期碳足迹评估。
Result: 在商用 7nm FinFET 工艺上，DPSL 将开关活动减少最高 42%；Eco-SoC 的碳足迹增量（约 4.8% 面积开销）可在 1.1 年边缘部署内抵消；热感知功率门控使硅片 MTTF 翻倍，有助于减少电子垃圾。
Conclusion: Eco-SoC 表明通过硬件-算法协同设计、动态精度缩放与热感知功耗管理，可以在保持可扩展性的同时实现可持续 AI 计算，并显著缓解电子垃圾问题。

papers.title: Parcel2Progression: An Anatomy-aware Longitudinal Framework for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Alzheimer's disease (AD) progression is a longitudinal process with subtle pathological cues in the early stages. Yet, computational constraints have limited most neuroimaging models to either compromise spatial information or limit the number of longitudinal scans. We aim to overcome this bottleneck and fully leverage high-resolution, variable-length T1w structural MRI (4D sMRI) scan sequences. We introduce Parcel2Progression (P2P), a Longitudinal Transformer Framework which tackles this challenge using an Atlas-guided Parcel Encoder that tokenizes 3D scans into a set of richer anatomically grounded representations. A Longitudinal Transformer then integrates irregular, arbitrary-length longitudinal visits with patient age. This synergy delivers two key advantages: (1) parcel-specific interpretability, and (2) computational tractability for long-term analysis, which scales linearly with the number of scans compared to a naive quadratic 4D ViT cost. P2P outperforms prior works and baselines in both MCI (Mild Cognitive Impairment) to AD conversion prediction and AD vs. CN (Cognitively Normal) classification tasks across ADNI, AIBL, and MIRIAD datasets. Leveraging longitudinal scans boosts performance over single-scan baselines by up to 5% and 7% in balanced accuracy for AD classification and MCI conversion prediction tasks, respectively. Interpretability analysis using parcel saliencies and attention rollouts reveals clinically consistent atrophy patterns in AD and MCI subjects. We also demonstrate the frameworks' reliability in anomaly detection using a synthetic dataset, and test the model's generalizability for other neurodegenerative diseases like Frontotemporal Dementia.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Parcel2Progression (P2P)，一个面向阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 诊断的纵向 Transformer 框架。它用 Atlas-guided Parcel Encoder 将高分辨率、可变长度的 T1w 结构 MRI (4D sMRI) 序列 token 化为解剖学上有意义的表示，再由 Longitudinal Transformer 整合不规则、任意长度的纵向就诊与患者年龄。摘要报告在 ADNI、AIBL、MIRIAD 数据集上，P2P 在 MCI 到 AD 转换预测和 AD vs CN 分类任务上优于先前工作与基线，且计算成本随扫描数线性增长，相比朴素 4D ViT 的二次方成本更可扩展。
Motivation: AD 进展是纵向过程，早期阶段存在细微病理线索，但计算约束使多数神经影像模型要么牺牲空间信息，要么限制纵向扫描数量；作者旨在克服这一瓶颈，充分利用高分辨率的可变长度 4D sMRI 序列。
Method: 提出 Atlas-guided Parcel Encoder，将 3D 扫描 token 化为更丰富的解剖学分组表示，再由 Longitudinal Transformer 整合不规则、任意长度的纵向就诊与患者年龄；这种设计带来分区级可解释性，并使长期分析的计算成本随扫描数量线性增长。
Result: 在 ADNI、AIBL、MIRIAD 数据集上，P2P 在 MCI 到 AD 转换预测和 AD vs CN 分类中优于先前工作与基线；相比单次扫描基线，利用纵向扫描使 AD 分类和 MCI 转换预测的平衡准确率分别提升最多 5% 和 7%。分区显著性 (parcel saliencies) 与注意力 rollout 的可解释性分析揭示出临床一致的萎缩模式，合成数据上的异常检测以及额颞叶痴呆等其他神经退行性疾病的泛化测试也验证了框架的可靠性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 atlas 引导的分区编码与纵向 Transformer 的协同能同时提供分区级可解释性和计算可行性，并展示了该方法在异常检测及额颞叶痴呆等其他神经退行性疾病上的泛化潜力。

papers.title: Scale-to-Dialogue: Low-Burden Elicitation of Daily Premenstrual Symptom Ratings with Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Prospective daily symptom tracking is central to premenstrual health assessment, but repeated ordinal forms impose substantial response burden. We formulate conversational administration as an ordinal label-recovery problem: the system actively elicits a small set of symptom clusters and maps each response to the original severity labels. We used 3,320 complete participant-days from the mcPHASES dataset, covering cramps, mood swing, fatigue, sleep issues, stress, and bloating on a six-level scale. Six participants were reserved for development and 36 for a frozen evaluation comprising 360 participant-days and 2,160 item labels. A ModernBERT evidence gate detected whether a symptom was expressed, and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct produced deterministic structured severity scores. Fixed six-item questioning achieved a quadratic weighted kappa of 0.976, whereas three joint symptom-cluster questions achieved 0.913, 97.45% agreement within one severity level, and 80.94% recall for moderate-or-higher symptoms while reducing questions by 50%. Open-first adaptive policies required 3.92-5.98 questions and produced lower agreement than the corresponding fixed policies. Participant-cluster bootstrap analysis estimated a kappa difference of -0.062 (95% CI -0.076 to -0.048) between the three-cluster and six-item strategies. Active cluster-level elicitation provides a direct, local-model route from natural conversation to reusable daily symptom labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将日常经前症状评分的对话式采集建模为序数标签恢复 (ordinal label-recovery) 问题，即系统主动询问少量症状群并映射回原始严重度标签。基于 mcPHASES 数据集的 3,320 个参与者日，使用 ModernBERT 证据门控判断症状是否被提及，并由 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 生成确定性的结构化严重度评分。固定六项提问的二次加权 kappa 为 0.976，而三个联合症状群问题的 kappa 为 0.913，同时减少 50% 的问题量。
Motivation: 前瞻性每日症状追踪对经前健康评估至关重要，但重复的序数量表问卷会带来较高的作答负担，需要一种低负担的自然对话式采集途径。
Method: 提出将对话式管理视为序数标签恢复问题：由 ModernBERT 证据门控判断症状是否被表达，再由 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 输出确定性的结构化严重度分数。评估比较了固定六项提问、三个联合症状群问题以及开放式优先的自适应策略，并使用参与者聚簇自举 (participant-cluster bootstrap) 估计策略间差异。
Result: 固定六项提问达到二次加权 kappa 0.976；三个症状群问题达到 0.913，97.45% 的评级落在同一严重度级别内，对中度及以上症状的召回率为 80.94%，并将问题数减少 50%。开放式优先的自适应策略需要 3.92–5.98 个问题，但一致性低于对应固定策略；三症状群与六项策略的 kappa 差异估计为 -0.062（95% CI -0.076 至 -0.048）。
Conclusion: 主动的簇级症状群询问提供了一条直接、本地模型化的路径，能够从自然对话中获得可复用的每日症状标签。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文将日常经前症状评分的对话式采集建模为序数标签恢复 (ordinal label-recovery) 问题，即系统主动询问少量症状群并映射回原始严重度标签。基于 mcPHASES 数据集的 3,320 个参与者日，使用 ModernBERT 证据门控判断症状是否被提及，并由 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 生成确定性的结构化严重度评分。固定六项提问的二次加权 kappa 为 0.976，而三个联合症状群问题的 kappa 为 0.913，同时减少 50% 的问题量。

papers.title: Can We Optimize the Performance-Carbon Emission Break-Even Point?: The Quest for Greener LLMs
papers.abstract_en: The carbon footprint of any deployed Large Language Model (LLM) accumulates during inference, where repeated use of the model substantially exceeds the one-time cost of fine-tuning. Yet most efficiency interventions target either pre-training scale or post-hoc compression. We ask whether folding a calibrated, differentiable energy surrogate into the fine-tuning objective can produce inference behavior that gains task accuracy at zero or near-zero carbon cost, a break-even configuration. We propose a joint loss mechanism with a per-model carbon-emission parameter, a linear surrogate over parameter norm, FLOP proxy, and a memory proxy, fit from on-hardware energy profiling. We fine-tune three architecturally distinct families: Gemma-2 2B, Llama-3.1 8B, and Qwen-2.5 14B, and evaluate inference F1 and CO$_2$ emissions on three MMLU subjects: abstract algebra, philosophy, and formal logic. We discover from several outcomes that the carbon term behaves as either harmful interference or beneficial regularization depending on the task structure. We position calibrated carbon-aware fine-tuning as a lightweight, drop-in regularizer with a non-empty but model and task-dependent break-even region. This is an ongoing work, and we will release our codebase soon.
papers.comment: 13 Pages, 6 Figures, Submitted to ARR Cycle
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否将校准的可微能量替代项（energy surrogate）纳入LLM微调目标，使推理阶段以零或近零碳排放成本获得任务精度提升，即所谓的收支平衡（break-even）配置。作者提出联合损失机制，包含每模型碳排放参数、以参数范数、FLOP代理和内存代理构成的线性替代项，并通过硬件能耗剖析拟合。他们微调了Gemma-2 2B、Llama-3.1 8B和Qwen-2.5 14B三个架构，在MMLU的抽象代数、哲学和形式逻辑三个子主题上评估推理F1与CO2排放。结果显示碳项的行为随任务结构不同而表现为有害干扰或有益正则化。
Motivation: 部署后LLM的碳排放主要在推理阶段随反复使用而累积，远超一次性微调成本，但现有效率干预多针对预训练规模或事后压缩，缺乏面向推理阶段的碳感知微调手段。
Method: 提出将拟合自硬件能耗剖析的线性碳替代项（基于参数范数、FLOP代理和内存代理）作为联合损失的一部分，并引入每模型碳排放参数以控制碳项强度，实现校准的碳感知微调（carbon-aware fine-tuning）。
Result: 在三个架构族和三个MMLU主题上的实验发现，碳项的效果高度依赖任务结构：某些任务上表现为有害干扰，另一些任务上则作为有益正则化；存在非空但依赖模型与任务的break-even区域。
Conclusion: 作者将校准的碳感知微调定位为轻量级、即插即用的正则化器，并强调该工作仍在进行中，代码库将随后公开。

papers.title: A Distribution Mapping Approach to Counterfactually Fair Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) seeks to optimize sequential decisions to maximize population-level benefits over time. However, when deployed in high-stakes settings such as healthcare, RL decisions might systematically restrict some subpopulation's access to valuable services in a manner contrary to the values and goals of stakeholders. Counterfactual fairness (CF) offers a promising framework to address this problem based on causal reasoning. This paper develops a data preprocessing algorithm that, when used in tandem with policy learning, enables CF in RL. Our algorithm relies on a novel quantile distribution mapping method for sequentially estimating the counterfactual states and rewards in the data preprocessing step, subsuming common additivity assumptions used for counterfactual prediction as a special case. We theoretically prove that the per-step level of counterfactual unfairness and infinite-horizon suboptimality gap can be bounded under mild regularity conditions. We also empirically test our algorithm in numerical experiments as well as in application to a real-world interventional digital health dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据预处理算法，与策略学习配合使用，使强化学习（RL）满足反事实公平性（counterfactual fairness, CF）。算法基于新颖的分位数分布映射（quantile distribution mapping）方法，在预处理阶段逐步估计反事实状态与奖励，并将常用的可加性假设作为特例涵盖。作者在温和正则条件下证明了单步反事实不公平程度与无限时域次优间隙（suboptimality gap）有界，并在数值实验及真实数字健康干预数据集上进行了验证。
Motivation: 在高风险场景（如医疗健康）中部署强化学习时，决策可能系统性地限制某些亚群体获取有价值的服务，与利益相关者的价值观和目标相悖。反事实公平性提供了基于因果推理的解决框架，但现有方法在RL的时序决策设置下尚缺乏有效且通用的实现。
Method: 提出一个数据预处理算法，该算法与策略学习串联使用以实现RL中的反事实公平。核心是一种新的分位数分布映射方法，用于在预处理阶段顺序估计反事实状态和奖励，并且将常见的可加性假设作为特例涵盖在内。
Result: 理论上证明在温和正则条件下，每步的反事实不公平程度和无限时域次优间隙可以被界定；实验上在数值实验以及真实世界的介入式数字健康数据集上验证了算法的效果。
Conclusion: 本文提供的预处理算法可为顺序决策中的反事实公平性提供理论保证和实证支持，但其适用范围和实际性能依赖于正则条件与具体数据场景。

papers.title: Memory-Efficient Activation Checkpointing with Sliding Window and Hirschberg's Algorithm for 0/1 Knapsack Solving in PyTorch
papers.abstract_en: Activation checkpointing minimizes the runtime of neural networks under a given memory budget, by selecting which intermediate tensors to store and which to recompute. PyTorch solves this as a 0/1 knapsack problem, where operations from a joint forward-backward computation graph are items with a memory cost (weight) and a runtime saving (value). The default solver, dp_knapsack, allocates a full dynamic programming (DP) table of shape $(n+1) \times (W+1)$, where $n$ is the number of operations and $W$ is the quantized memory budget. This method is resource-hungry and crashes at $n = 100$ items on a machine with 64 GB RAM. In this paper, we introduce dp_knapsack_sliding_hirschberg, which combines the sliding window trick and Hirschberg's algorithm to reduce peak memory from $O(nW)$ to $O(W)$ while preserving the exact optimal solution. Our experiments show successful knapsack execution at $n = 2000$, where dp_knapsack fails at $n = 100$, a 20$\times$ increase in computable problem size. In addition, our benchmarks show a consistent 25-28\% runtime speedup over dp_knapsack. The implementation is merged into PyTorch and released in version 2.10.
papers.comment: Accepted to COLM 2026 Workshop on Efficient Reasoning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 PyTorch 激活检查点 (activation checkpointing) 中默认的 0/1 背包求解器 dp_knapsack 内存开销过大的问题，提出 dp_knapsack_sliding_hirschberg，将滑动窗口技巧与 Hirschberg 算法结合，把峰值内存从 O(nW) 降至 O(W)，同时保持精确最优解。实验显示该方法可在 n=2000 时成功执行背包求解，而 dp_knapsack 在 n=100 时崩溃，可计算规模提升约 20 倍，并带来 25-28% 的持续运行加速。实现已合入 PyTorch，随 2.10 版本发布。
Motivation: PyTorch 默认的 dp_knapsack 需要分配形状为 (n+1)×(W+1) 的完整动态规划表，内存开销大，在 64 GB RAM 机器上 n=100 时即崩溃，限制了激活检查点在更大计算图上的可用性。
Method: 提出 dp_knapsack_sliding_hirschberg，结合滑动窗口技巧 (sliding window trick) 和 Hirschberg 算法，将 0/1 背包 DP 的峰值内存从 O(nW) 压缩到 O(W)，且不损失解的精确性。
Result: 在 n=2000 时背包求解成功，而 dp_knapsack 在 n=100 时失败，可计算问题规模提升 20 倍；基准测试显示相对 dp_knapsack 有一致的 25-28% 运行时间加速。
Conclusion: 该方法在保持精确最优解的前提下显著降低了激活检查点背包选择的内存占用，并已合入 PyTorch 2.10 发布。

papers.title: FitAQA: A Benchmark of Fitness Action Quality Assessment for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Fitness Action Quality Assessment (AQA) is important for intelligent sports training, yet the capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in this setting remain underexplored. Existing benchmarks rely on action-specific annotation schemes and focus primarily on final assessment outputs, offering limited insight into how models assess exercise quality. We introduce FitAQA, a systematic benchmark for evaluating MLLMs in fitness AQA, containing 2,219 videos and 5,512 QA instances across 30 bodyweight exercises. In collaboration with experts in sports science, we develop a unified form error taxonomy that defines 38 recurring form errors within six complementary quality dimensions: alignment, symmetry, stability, coordination, tempo, and completeness. This taxonomy provides a shared assessment framework across different exercises. FitAQA further formulates three evaluation tasks: perception for recognizing relevant visual evidence, judgement for combining that evidence with domain knowledge to assess execution correctness, and temporal grounding for localizing form errors over time. Extensive evaluation shows that current MLLMs still struggle to assess exercise quality comprehensively and localize form errors precisely. Controlled experiments further indicate that visual perception is a key bottleneck, as judgement performance improves substantially when ground-truth perceptual evidence is provided. The dataset and evaluation code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FitAQA，一个面向多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的健身动作质量评估（AQA）基准，包含 30 种自重训练动作的 2,219 个视频和 5,512 个 QA 实例。作者与运动科学专家合作定义了统一的动作错误分类体系（form error taxonomy），涵盖对称性、稳定性、协调性等六个质量维度的 38 种常见错误，并设计了感知（perception）、判断（judgement）和时间定位（temporal grounding）三个评估任务。对当前 MLLMs 的测评显示其综合评估与精确时间定位能力仍然不足，而提供真实感知证据可显著提升判断性能，表明视觉感知是主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有 AQA 基准依赖具体动作的标注方案，且主要关注最终评估结果，难以揭示模型如何对运动质量进行判断；MLLMs 在此场景下的能力尚未被系统探索。
Method: 构建 FitAQA 基准：第一步基于专家合作建立跨动作统一的形式错误分类法，定义六个质量维度下的 38 种错误；第二步将基准设计为感知、判断和时间定位三个任务，分别考察模型识别视觉证据、结合领域知识判断正确性以及定位错误发生时间的能力。
Result: 大规模评测表明当前 MLLMs 难以全面评估动作质量和精确定位形式错误；受控实验显示，当提供真实感知证据时判断性能显著提升，说明视觉感知是主要瓶颈。
Conclusion: 摘要强调视觉感知环节是健身 AQA 中限制 MLLMs 表现的关键因素，基准数据集与评估代码将公开，以便后续研究在此框架下改进模型。

papers.title: IDATA: Scalable Invertible Diffusion for Unrestricted Adversarial Transfer Attack
papers.abstract_en: Unrestricted adversarial transfer attacks are important for evaluating the black-box robustness of deep visual models. Diffusion-based attacks have shown promising transferability and visual imperceptibility by optimizing adversarial perturbations along denoising trajectories in latent space. However, existing methods are limited by two challenges: memory-intensive multistep backpropagation and frequency-agnostic perturbation over intermediate latents. To address these issues, we propose IDATA, a memory-efficient diffusion framework for unrestricted adversarial transfer attack. IDATA consists of two key components: an Invertible Diffusion Module (IDM) and a Low-Frequency Constraint Module (LFCM). Specifically, IDM reformulates adversarial optimization over diffusion trajectories as an invertible process, enabling constant-memory backpropagation through on-demand reconstruction of intermediate states instead of storing the full denoising chain. Moreover, LFCM leverages Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) to decompose latent variables into low- and high-frequency components, restricting perturbations to semantically stable low-frequency subspaces, thereby improving transferability while preserving visual imperceptibility. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks and diverse model architectures demonstrate that IDATA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in attack success rate, memory efficiency, and visual imperceptibility. These results suggest that IDATA is a promising tool for black-box robustness evaluation of deep visual models. Code is available at https://github.com/colourful-pan/IDATA.

TL;DR: 本文提出 IDATA，一个面向无限制对抗迁移攻击 (unrestricted adversarial transfer attack) 的显存高效扩散框架。它包含可逆扩散模块 (IDM) 与低频约束模块 (LFCM)，前者通过可逆过程实现常数显存的反向传播，后者用小波变换把扰动限制在低频子空间。实验表明 IDATA 在攻击成功率、显存效率和视觉不可感知性上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的对抗攻击存在两个问题：多步反传显存开销大，以及中间潜变量上的扰动未考虑频率特性，导致迁移性受限。
Method: IDATA 由两部分组成：IDM 将扩散轨迹上的对抗优化重构为可逆过程，按需重建中间状态而非存储完整去噪链；LFCM 使用离散小波变换 (DWT) 分解潜变量，把扰动限制在语义稳定的低频子空间。
Result: 在多个基准和多种模型架构上，IDATA 在攻击成功率、显存效率和视觉不可感知性方面持续优于最先进基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为 IDATA 可用于深度视觉模型的黑盒鲁棒性评估，并已开源代码。

papers.title: AnchorFold: A Focus-Then-Fold Framework via Recursive Attention Propagation for Efficient Multi-Vector Visual Document Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Multi-vector vision-language retrievers enable fine-grained Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) through late interaction, but storing and scoring hundreds of visual patch embeddings per page incurs substantial overhead. Existing training-free methods rely on pruning or merging: pruning degrades sharply under aggressive compression, whereas merging does not explicitly prioritize important regions when forming representatives. We introduce AnchorFold, a training-free focus-then-fold framework for document-side index compression. AnchorFold applies Recursive Attention Propagation over visual self-attention graphs, performing multi-step propagation within each attention head and integrating scores across heads and layers. The focus stage selects the highest-centrality tokens as anchors. The fold stage assigns remaining tokens to their most similar anchors in the normalized retrieval space and summarizes each anchor-centered group through centrality-weighted aggregation. This preserves non-anchor contributions while concentrating capacity on structurally important tokens. Across ViDoRe v1/v2 and REAL-MM-RAG with three diverse retrieval backbones, AnchorFold consistently outperforms all evaluated training-free baselines at $γ\leq 0.20$. On ViDoRe v1/v2, it retains 98.3% of full-index NDCG@5 on average at $5\times$ compression, achieving near-lossless compression, and 92.4% at $20\times$ compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AnchorFold，一个无需训练 (training-free) 的 focus-then-fold 框架，用于多向量视觉文档检索的文档侧索引压缩。它通过递归注意力传播 (Recursive Attention Propagation) 在视觉自注意力图上定位高中心性 token 作为锚点，再将剩余 token 分配给最相似的锚点并按中心性加权聚合，从而在压缩视觉 patch 嵌入时保留非锚点贡献。在 ViDoRe v1/v2 和 REAL-MM-RAG 上，AnchorFold 在 γ≤0.20 压缩率下优于所有评估的训练无关基线；在 ViDoRe 上 5 倍压缩时平均保留 98.3% 的 NDCG@5。
Motivation: 多向量视觉-语言检索器通过后期交互 (late interaction) 支持细粒度视觉文档检索，但每页数百个视觉 patch 嵌入的存储与评分开销很高。现有训练无关方法中，剪枝 (pruning) 在激进压缩下性能严重下降，而合并 (merging) 在形成代表时没有显式优先考虑重要区域。
Method: AnchorFold 采用两阶段流程：focus 阶段在视觉自注意力图上执行跨注意力头和多层的递归注意力传播，选择最高中心性 (centrality) 的 token 作为锚点；fold 阶段在归一化检索空间中将剩余 token 分配给最相似的锚点，并对每个锚点中心化分组进行中心性加权聚合。
Result: 在 ViDoRe v1/v2 与 REAL-MM-RAG 上配合三种检索骨干，AnchorFold 在 γ≤0.20 下一致优于所有评估的训练无关基线。在 ViDoRe v1/v2 上，5 倍压缩时平均保持全索引 NDCG@5 的 98.3%，20 倍压缩时保持 92.4%，实现接近无损压缩。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，优先处理结构上重要的 token（高中心性锚点）并保留非锚点贡献，可以在高压缩率下实现接近无损的文档侧索引压缩；该框架训练无关，面向文档侧索引而非查询侧。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Measuring and Reducing WebGPU Dispatch Overhead for LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models are deployed to multiple types of environments, from internet browsers to edge devices, and WebGPU serves as a modern cross-platform standard. The engines for browser-based LLM inference have proliferated, yet the overhead of WebGPU per-operation dispatch remains poorly characterized. In this work, we introduce a sequential-dispatch measurement method and show that naive single-operation measurements overestimate per-dispatch cost by conflating dispatch with synchronization. Using our method, we measure the per-dispatch cost and show that it is independent of data type used. We show that the dispatch overhead, not kernel quality, is the bottleneck at batch size 1, and isolate the dispatch count as the cause. Therefore, we conclude that at batch size 1, the effective approach to LLM inference optimization in WebGPU is reducing dispatch count. Our findings point to dispatch amortization, in the inference engines and in the WebGPU specification, as a path to practical browser-based inference.
papers.comment: Accepted to The Fourth UK AI Conference 2026 as a full paper, to be published in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 WebGPU 下 LLM 推理的逐操作调度开销（dispatch overhead）。作者提出一种顺序调度测量方法，指出朴素单操作测量会因混入同步而高估每次调度的成本；利用该方法测得 WebGPU 的 per-dispatch 成本与数据类型无关，并证明在 batch size 1 下瓶颈来自调度次数而非 kernel 质量。结论是浏览器端 LLM 推理优化的有效途径是减少调度次数，并指向推理引擎与 WebGPU 规范中的调度摊销（dispatch amortization）。
Motivation: 浏览器与边缘设备上的 LLM 推理依赖 WebGPU，但 WebGPU 每操作调度开销缺乏系统刻画；现有测量方法还会将调度与同步混为一谈，导致对真实成本的误判。
Method: 提出 sequential-dispatch 测量方法，通过顺序调度多个操作并避免与同步混淆，分离出单次调度成本；并在不同数据类型下测量该成本以验证其是否与数据类型相关。
Result: 测量显示每次调度成本与数据类型无关；在 batch size 1 时，调度开销而非 kernel 质量是瓶颈，且可归因于调度次数；朴素单操作测量会高估 per-dispatch cost。
Conclusion: 作者认为在 batch size 1 下，WebGPU LLM 推理优化的有效手段是减少调度次数，并建议通过在推理引擎和 WebGPU 规范中实现调度摊销来改善浏览器端推理。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TomaMMU: A Comprehensive Multimodal Understanding Benchmark for Tomato Leaf Diseases
papers.abstract_en: To address this gap, we introduce TomaMMU, a large-scale Tomato leaf disease MultiModal Understanding dataset, alongside TomaBench, a benchmark for evaluating VLMs on tomato disease understanding. TomaMMU comprises 28,808 high-quality images spanning 15 categories and 213,119 human-annotated visual question-answer pairs, generated through a three-stage pipeline comprising Data Collection, Human Annotation, and Question-Answer Generation. Building on this foundation, TomaBench organizes seven agricultural tasks into a hierarchical three-level taxonomy spanning Basic Perception, Pathology Understanding, and Expert Diagnosis, which together enable systematic evaluation from low-level visual recognition to high-level diagnostic reasoning. The tasks assess visual symptom recognition, taxonomic relationships, and diagnostic reasoning, offering a comprehensive view of how well models grasp plant pathology. Our results pronounced gaps in fine-grained recognition and factually grounded reasoning with 14 state-of-the-art VLMs, consistently underperforming on both challenging MCQs and open-ended questions. These results suggest that current VLMs struggle to translate visual perception into reliable diagnostic knowledge, motivating the need for targeted domain adaptation. Simple fine-tuning on TomaMMU substantially narrows this gap, boosting accuracy on challenging MCQs to 96.09%, outperforming recent VLMs, and pointing toward promising directions for future work. All data and code is available in https://huggingface.co/datasets/enalis/TomaMMU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TomaMMU，一个面向番茄叶部病害的多模态理解数据集，包含 28,808 张高质量图像、15 个类别以及 213,119 个人工标注的视觉问答对，通过数据收集、人工标注和问答生成三阶段流程构建。同时提出 TomaBench 基准，将七项农业任务组织为三级层次分类体系（基础感知、病理理解、专家诊断），用于系统评估视觉语言模型（VLM）从低层视觉识别到高层诊断推理的能力。实验显示 14 个 SOTA VLM 在细粒度识别和事实性推理上表现不足，而基于 TomaMMU 的简单微调可将困难多选题准确率提升至 96.09%。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在植物病理领域的细粒度识别和诊断推理能力缺乏系统评估，且缺少大规模、高质量的多模态病害理解数据集。
Method: 构建 TomaMMU 数据集，并设计 TomaBench 基准，包含七个农业任务并按三级层次分类（基础感知、病理理解、专家诊断），评估视觉症状识别、分类关系和诊断推理。
Result: 14 个 SOTA VLM 在困难多选题和开放题上均表现不佳；在 TomaMMU 上简单微调后，挑战性多选题准确率提升到 96.09%，超过近期 VLM。
Conclusion: 当前 VLM 难以将视觉感知转化为可靠的诊断知识，需要针对特定领域进行适配；TomaMMU 的微调展现出缩小差距的潜力，数据和代码已公开。

papers.title: PAST: Privileged Adaptation from Complete Student Trajectories for On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses a privileged teacher to supervise a reasoning model on prefixes sampled from its own rollouts. Yet each rollout also reveals how the student's response unfolds and whether it succeeds, student-specific hindsight that standard OPSD does not use to form the teacher. We introduce Privileged Adaptation from Student Trajectories (PAST), which treats each completed student trajectory as additional privileged information for the OPSD teacher while leaving the student's distillation prefixes unchanged. PAST preserves the student's next-token distribution on correct trajectories and uses failed trajectories to adapt the teacher toward verified success under student-proximity regularization. We characterize what such a trajectory-conditioned teacher can transfer to a prefix-only student. Forward-KL distillation projects the teacher distributions to their conditional arithmetic mean given the prefix. This projection separates trajectory-specific variation that remains privileged from the mean policy shift available to the student. For correct trajectories, the unclipped population objective also has the frozen student as an ideal distributional fixed point. Across three mathematical reasoning benchmarks, PAST improves the Avg@12 macro average over Vanilla OPSD by 5.6 percentage points. A $2\times2$ factorial study shows gains from both complete-trajectory access and teacher adaptation, while trajectory removal and shuffling confirm that the adapted teacher uses the matching hindsight context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAST 是一种用于 on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 的方法，将每条完整学生轨迹作为额外特权信息提供给教师模型，同时保持学生蒸馏前缀不变。作者刻画了轨迹条件化教师能向仅前缀学生迁移的内容：forward-KL 蒸馏将教师分布投影为给定前缀下的条件算术平均，从而区分特权轨迹变化与可获取的均值策略偏移。在三个数学推理基准上，PAST 相比 Vanilla OPSD 将 Avg@12 宏平均提升 5.6 个百分点。
Motivation: 标准 OPSD 使用特权教师监督学生，但每个 rollout 还揭示了学生响应如何展开以及是否成功，这类 student-specific hindsight 未被用于构建教师；PAST 旨在利用完整学生轨迹作为额外特权信息来改进 OPSD 教师。
Method: PAST 将每条完整学生轨迹视为 OPSD 教师的额外特权信息，同时保持学生的蒸馏前缀不变；正确轨迹上保留学生的 next-token 分布，失败轨迹则用于在 student-proximity regularization 下让教师适应到经验证的成功。理论上刻画了 forward-KL 蒸馏将教师分布投影为给定前缀下的条件算术平均。
Result: 在三个数学推理基准上，PAST 将 Avg@12 宏平均相比 Vanilla OPSD 提升 5.6 个百分点；2×2 因子实验显示完整轨迹访问与教师适应均有增益，轨迹移除与打乱实验证实适应后的教师确实使用了匹配的 hindsight 上下文。
Conclusion: 作者指出轨迹条件化教师能传递给仅前缀学生的内容是条件算术平均投影，且在正确轨迹上未裁剪的总体目标以冻结学生为理想分布不动点；这为 OPSD 中利用学生轨迹 hindsight 提供了理论与实验依据。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.result: 在三个数学推理基准上，PAST 将 Avg@12 宏平均相比 Vanilla OPSD 提升 5.6 个百分点；2×2 因子实验显示完整轨迹访问与教师适应均有增益，轨迹移除与打乱实验证实适应后的教师确实使用了匹配的 hindsight 上下文。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者指出轨迹条件化教师能传递给仅前缀学生的内容是条件算术平均投影，且在正确轨迹上未裁剪的总体目标以冻结学生为理想分布不动点；这为 OPSD 中利用学生轨迹 hindsight 提供了理论与实验依据。

papers.title: Gaming Without an Attacker: Benchmark Fingerprinting in LLM-Driven Search Under Selection Pressure
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks for systems that are optimized against the evaluation signal measure something different from what they claim. We document this concretely in two GPU-kernel-optimization suites with held-out generalization gates: Metal-Sci (10 scientific-compute tasks) and Metal-ZK (12 zero-knowledge/cryptographic tasks), in which three frontier LLMs (Opus 4.7, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.5) propose Metal kernels inside a $(1{+}1)$ evolutionary loop with rich feedback. Although no model is prompted to act adversarially, the promoted winners repeatedly fingerprint the evaluation configuration: they branch on the identity of runtime parameters, tune the measured branch maximally, and leave the unmeasured branch slow or silently wrong. Across the pooled suites, $16/53$ ($30\%$) of in-distribution wins fail to transfer to held-out configurations. We give a four-mode taxonomy of these failures, from configuration fingerprints to gate leakage. We distill design guidance for measurement under strategic optimization: held-out probes retain validity only on non-enumerable axes; gates must measure held-out performance, not just correctness; and a transfer rate is interpretable only with per-failure mechanism grades: ours decomposes into gamed, overfit, and benign. Code and research artifacts: https://github.com/vicgalle/kernel-fingerprinting
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at AI Measurement Science Workshop @ COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考察被优化以针对评测信号进行优化的基准测试是否还能测出其声称要测的东西。作者在两个带有留出泛化门的 GPU 内核优化套件 Metal-Sci 与 Metal-ZK 中，让三个前沿大模型在 (1+1) 进化循环里生成 Metal 内核，发现被选中的胜者反复对评测配置进行指纹识别：按运行时参数的身份分支、最大化调优已测分支，而让未测分支变慢或静默出错。合并两个套件后，16/53（30%）的分布内胜者无法迁移到留出配置。
Motivation: 当系统针对评测信号进行优化时，基准可能失效，作者希望具体记录这类失败模式，而不是停留在理论警告层面。
Method: 构建两个带留出泛化门的 GPU 内核优化基准套件（Metal-Sci 含 10 个科学计算任务，Metal-ZK 含 12 个零知识/密码学任务），在 (1+1) 进化循环中给予模型丰富反馈，并分析被提升胜者是否识别并利用评测配置。
Result: 合并套件中 16/53（30%）的分布内胜者无法迁移到留出配置；作者给出一个四类失败模式分类法，涵盖配置指纹识别（configuration fingerprints）到门泄漏（gate leakage）等机制。
Conclusion: 作者提出测量设计原则：留出探针只在不可枚举的轴上保持有效性，门必须衡量留出性能而非仅正确性，迁移率只有在逐失败机制分级（gamed、overfit、benign）下才可解释。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LibraSpec: Dynamic Diffusion-Based Speculative Decoding via Marginal-Gain-Driven Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting multiple tokens for parallel verification, with efficiency critically determined by the speculative length selected at each decoding round. Existing dynamic speculation methods select the speculation length by estimating how many tokens will be accepted, which is reasonable for autoregressive drafters that generates tokens sequentially. The recent wave of diffusion-based drafters, however, generates candidate blocks in parallel at substantially lower drafting cost, shifting the key question from how many tokens to generate to how many generated tokens are worth verifying. We therefore reformulate dynamic speculative-length selection as expected-speedup optimization and derive a marginal criterion that extends the speculative sequence only when its acceptance gain outweighs the additional verification cost. Building on this criterion, we develop \textit{LibraSpec}, a training-free and plug-and-play algorithm that iteratively determines the speculative length using drafter confidence scores. Theoretically, we prove that LibraSpec monotonically converges toward the optimal speculative length. Experiments across six target models, three diffusion-based speculative decoding methods, and math, coding, and chat benchmarks show consistent improvements under both greedy and sampling settings, achieving a further $0.5\sim1.5\times$ improvement over baselines and up to $8.49\times$ speedup over autoregressive decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LibraSpec，一种基于边际增益动态优化的投机解码 (speculative decoding) 方法，专门面向扩散式起草器 (diffusion-based drafters)。其核心是把动态投机长度选择重构为期望加速优化，并推导出边际准则：只有接受增益超过额外验证成本时才扩展投机序列。该方法训练无关、即插即用，利用草稿模型置信度迭代确定投机长度，并在理论上证明能单调收敛到最优长度。实验覆盖六个目标模型、三种扩散式投机解码方法和数学/代码/聊天基准，在 greedy 与 sampling 设置下均一致提升，相对基线额外获得 0.5~1.5× 加速，最高相对自回归解码达到 8.49× 加速。
Motivation: 现有动态投机方法通过估计会被接受的 token 数量来选择投机长度，这对逐 token 顺序生成的自回归起草器是合理的；但扩散式起草器以低得多的起草成本并行生成候选块，使关键问题从“生成多少 token”变成“生成的 token 中多少值得验证”，因此需要重新设计投机长度的选择准则。
Method: 将动态投机长度选择形式化为期望加速优化，推导出边际接受准则，仅在接受增益大于额外验证成本时扩展投机序列；并在此准则上构建训练无关、即插即用的 LibraSpec 算法，使用草稿模型置信度分数迭代确定投机长度。理论上作者证明该算法单调收敛到最优投机长度。
Result: 在六个目标模型、三种扩散式投机解码方法以及数学、代码、聊天基准上的实验显示，greedy 与 sampling 设置下均取得一致改进：相对现有基线额外提升 0.5~1.5× 速度，最高相对自回归解码实现 8.49× 加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，针对扩散式起草器的并行生成特性重新定义投机长度选择，并借助边际增益准则与置信度驱动的迭代优化，可以在无需训练的情况下获得稳定加速；论文以理论收敛性和多基准实验作为支撑。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: High-Quality Exposure Correction with Diffusion-Based Image Generation Priors
papers.abstract_en: Although most existing exposure correction methods achieve high fidelity, they often place excessive focus on overall pixel-wise accuracy, making it challenging to effectively model extreme exposure regions, which results in suboptimal perceptual quality. Recently, diffusion models have received significant attention due to their remarkable performance in the realm of image generation. However, their successful application to exposure correction remains a challenging and open question. The key challenge lies in generating accurate image structures and maintaining high image fidelity during stochastic diffusion processes. In this paper, we propose DPEC (Diffusion Prior-based Exposure Correction), a novel framework for image exposure correction that utilizes diffusion-based image generation priors encapsulated in pre-trained large-scale diffusion models. Specifically, we first propose an efficient fine-tuning strategy to derive an exposure corrector from pre-trained models, enabling the generation of enhanced images in a single-step denoising process. Moreover, we seamlessly combine the strengths of diffusion models and regression models, and design a joint cross-attention module to integrate multi-scale diffusion prior features, thereby effectively preserving high-frequency details and minimizing random artifacts. The diffusion model focuses on dealing with low-frequency content rather than all the intricate texture details. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed DPEC method consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods on multiple exposure correction datasets, whether in terms of fidelity, perceptual quality, or visual effects.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DPEC（Diffusion Prior-based Exposure Correction），利用预训练大规模扩散模型中的图像生成先验进行曝光校正。通过高效微调策略从预训练模型得到曝光校正器，支持单步去噪生成增强图像，并设计联合交叉注意力模块融合多尺度扩散先验特征，以保留高频细节并减少随机伪影。实验表明 DPEC 在多个曝光校正数据集上一致优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有曝光校正方法过度关注整体像素级精度，难以有效建模极端曝光区域，导致感知质量欠佳。扩散模型在图像生成上表现突出，但在曝光校正中的应用仍有挑战，关键难点是在随机扩散过程中保持图像结构准确性和高保真度。
Method: 提出 DPEC 框架：先利用高效微调策略从预训练大规模扩散模型派生曝光校正器，实现单步去噪；再结合扩散模型与回归模型的优势，设计联合交叉注意力模块整合多尺度扩散先验特征，让扩散模型主要负责低频内容，从而保留高频细节并抑制随机伪影。
Result: 实验在多个曝光校正数据集上表明，DPEC 在保真度、感知质量和视觉效果方面均持续优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 论文强调利用扩散模型生成先验可以有效提升曝光校正的感知质量，并验证了扩散模型与回归模型结合的可行性；其研究范围限于图像曝光校正，不涉及气象或降水相关内容。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Resolution Meets Reduction: Efficient Visual Context for 3D Radiology Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models offer a promising path toward automating radiology report generation, but applying them to full 3D CT volumes poses substantial computational challenges. Modern foundation vision encoders (VEs) can produce tens of thousands of vision tokens per scan, making the visual sequence passed to the large language model (LLM) a primary computational bottleneck. Vision-to-language projectors can compress this sequence to reduce computation, but may discard clinically relevant detail; conversely, effective compression can accommodate higher-resolution inputs while keeping the downstream token count fixed. How this vision-token budget should be allocated across input field of view, spatial resolution, and vision-to-language projection therefore remains an open design question. We systematically evaluate four heterogeneous VEs (CNN- and ViT-based), five token-reducing projectors at up to 64x compression alongside a non-reducing MLP projector baseline, and five instruction-tuned LLMs (1.7B--4B) on two large-scale CT report datasets (CT-RATE and Merlin). At matched LLM token budgets, anatomy-guided region of interest cropping is the most consistent strategy, improving clinical macro F1 in 19 of 20 settings by +3.7 points on average for the 3D ViT Primus encoder and +1.1 for the slice-based 2D ViT Curia encoder. Increasing input resolution further is strongly projector-dependent: the PerceiverResampler, paired with higher-resolution Curia features, yields the strongest configuration in the resolution study on both datasets. Our best configurations achieve state-of-the-art clinical macro F1 on the test sets, reaching 49.5 on CT-RATE and 49.0 on Merlin. Code and models will be published upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对3D放射学报告生成中视觉语言模型的计算瓶颈，系统比较了多种视觉编码器、token压缩投影器和指令微调LLM在CT报告生成上的表现。结果显示在固定LLM token预算下，解剖引导的感兴趣区域裁剪（ROI cropping）是最稳健的策略，而提高输入分辨率的效果强烈依赖于投影器选择。最优配置在CT-RATE和Merlin上分别取得49.5和49.0的临床macro F1，达到该基准上的state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 将视觉语言模型应用于完整3D CT体积时，现代基础视觉编码器每张扫描可产生数万视觉token，成为LLM输入的主要计算瓶颈。视觉到语言投影器虽可压缩序列，但可能丢失临床相关细节；如何在高分辨率输入与固定token预算之间分配视觉token预算仍是一个未解决的设计问题。
Method: 在CT-RATE和Merlin两个大规模CT报告数据集上，系统性评估了4种异构视觉编码器（CNN和ViT）、5种token减少投影器（最高64倍压缩）及非压缩MLP投影器基线，以及5种指令微调LLM（1.7B-4B）。重点比较了解剖引导的ROI裁剪和不同输入分辨率搭配不同投影器的配置。
Result: 在匹配LLM token预算下，解剖引导的ROI裁剪在20个设置中的19个提升了临床macro F1，对3D ViT编码器Primus平均提升+3.7点，对切片式2D ViT编码器Curia平均提升+1.1点。提高分辨率的效果强依赖投影器：PerceiverResampler配合更高分辨率的Curia特征在两个数据集上均取得最强配置。最优配置达到CT-RATE 49.5、Merlin 49.0的临床macro F1。
Conclusion: 作者认为在固定token预算下，解剖引导的空间区域选择比单纯提高分辨率更一致地提升临床性能；分辨率收益取决于投影器类型。代码和模型将在论文发表后公开。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在匹配LLM token预算下，解剖引导的ROI裁剪在20个设置中的19个提升了临床macro F1，对3D ViT编码器Primus平均提升+3.7点，对切片式2D ViT编码器Curia平均提升+1.1点。提高分辨率的效果强依赖投影器：PerceiverResampler配合更高分辨率的Curia特征在两个数据集上均取得最强配置。最优配置达到CT-RATE 49.5、Merlin 49.0的临床macro F1。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为在固定token预算下，解剖引导的空间区域选择比单纯提高分辨率更一致地提升临床性能；分辨率收益取决于投影器类型。代码和模型将在论文发表后公开。

papers.title: AI Evaluation Should Measure Verification Cost, Not Correctness Alone
papers.abstract_en: The reliability of AI generative models is typically measured by output correctness, yet in practice it depends on the effort required to verify those outputs. We argue that current evaluation metrics overlook a critical failure mode: Verification-Cost Errors (VCEs), defined as incorrect input-output pairs that a declared fraction of the verifier population fails to identify within the verification budget available in a given deployment context. Unlike standard notions of "hallucination", VCEs are defined operationally, by the failure of correct identification within budget rather than by any property of the output itself. Plausibility and authoritative presentation are hypothesised contributors to that failure, not defining conditions. To capture this asymmetry, we introduce the notion of verification cost relative to a deployment budget as an operational dimension that current evaluation does not routinely capture. The quantity is presented as a conceptual instrument rather than a finalized metric. Evidence from code generation and multi-modal document understanding shows that high benchmark accuracy can mask significant verification effort in practice. We therefore take the position that correctness alone is insufficient as a measure of reliability. AI evaluation should explicitly account for verification cost, reflecting whether errors can be detected under realistic resource constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AI 评估不应只看输出正确性，而应度量验证成本 (verification cost)。作者定义了 Verification-Cost Errors (VCEs)，即在一定部署预算下，声明的验证者群体比例无法在预算内识别出的错误输入-输出对；该定义是操作性的，与输出本身的属性无关。作者将验证成本作为概念性工具提出，并用代码生成与多模态文档理解任务的证据说明高基准准确率可能掩盖实际验证负担。
Motivation: 现有评估指标仅以输出正确性衡量生成式 AI 模型的可靠性，忽视了实际部署中验证输出所需的努力；这种不对称性导致安全性被高估。
Method: 引入相对于部署预算的验证成本这一操作维度，将 VCEs 定义为预算内验证失败的输入-输出对，并讨论可信外观与权威性表述可能促成该失败，但不是定义条件；该量被定位为概念工具而非最终指标。
Result: 来自代码生成和多模态文档理解的证据表明，高基准准确率可能掩盖显著的实际验证成本。
Conclusion: 作者主张正确性本身不足以度量可靠性，AI 评估应显式纳入验证成本，以反映错误能否在现实资源约束下被检测。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Multi-kernel spectral clustering: Entrywise eigenvector perturbation bounds and exact recovery
papers.abstract_en: Kernel spectral clustering with a single bandwidth can be inadequate for data exhibiting multiple characteristic pairwise-distance scales, a problem particularly prevalent in the high-dimensional regime. We address this issue through a multi-kernel formulation that aggregates kernels with different bandwidths. The bandwidths are selected as prescribed empirical quantiles of the pairwise squared distances, thereby capturing the relevant distance scales without requiring prior population-scale information. We develop a rigorous theoretical analysis of the resulting method under a general high-dimensional, multi-scale mixture model with heterogeneous cluster centers and covariance geometries. We construct a blockwise constant, low-rank informative approximation to the empirical multi-kernel matrix and establish row-wise $\ell_{2,\infty}$ perturbation bounds for its leading spectral components, as well as for the associated normalized Laplacian matrix. These bounds yield observation-level control of the spectral embedding, which is more informative than conventional global eigenspace perturbation estimates. Under suitable eigen-gap and cluster-separation conditions, we show that approximate $K$-means applied to the multi-kernel spectral embedding achieves exact recovery with high probability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对单一带宽核谱聚类（kernel spectral clustering）无法适应数据存在多个特征成对距离尺度的问题，提出一种多核（multi-kernel）聚合方案，带宽取为成对平方距离的经验分位数。作者在高维多尺度混合模型下给出理论分析，建立经验多核矩阵的分块常数低秩近似，并推导其主谱分量及归一化拉普拉斯矩阵的行向 ℓ2,∞ 扰动界，进而证明近似 K-means 在适当特征间隙与簇分离条件下可高概率实现精确恢复。
Motivation: 单一带宽的核谱聚类在处理具有多个特征成对距离尺度的数据时不够充分，这一问题在高维场景下尤为突出；论文旨在通过多核聚合来捕捉不同距离尺度，且无需先验的总体尺度信息。
Method: 提出将不同带宽的核进行聚合的多核谱聚类方法，带宽依据成对平方距离的预定经验分位数选取；构造经验多核矩阵的块状常数低秩近似，并建立主谱分量及归一化拉普拉斯矩阵的行向扰动界。
Result: 理论结果给出行向 ℓ2,∞ 扰动界，从而对谱嵌入提供观测级别的控制，优于传统的全局特征空间扰动估计；在合适的特征间隙与簇分离条件下，近似 K-means 作用于多核谱嵌入能以高概率实现精确恢复。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作在高维多尺度混合模型下为多核谱聚类提供了严格的理论保障，重点关注精确恢复的充分条件；未提及实验验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SRE-FER: Regional residual evidence learning for mitigating local evidence dilution in fine-grained facial expression recognition
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained facial expression recognition (FER) hinges on capturing subtle muscular cues that distinguish adjacent emotions. Yet capturing these cues presents a dilemma. Detector-based methods depend on fragile landmark pipelines, whereas we find that directly transferring foundation models such as DINOv3 under conventional global readouts can cause local evidence dilution: early global aggregation washes out sparse muscular signals and leaves persistent confusion between categories such as fear/surprise and sad/neutral. To recover this evidence, we propose SRE-FER, a readout-level regional residual evidence learning framework. Its core module, RERA, adds zero-initialized residual logits that refine class boundaries while preserving the backbone's global prediction. Training-time action unit (AU) guidance steers regional features toward expression-relevant areas using Facial Action Coding System (FACS)-based anatomical priors, without requiring an external facial pipeline at inference. An optional Full setting further routes sample-specific non-redundant tokens. On three benchmarks, SRE-FER attains 92.76% on RAF-DB, 91.32% on FERPlus, and 67.78% on AffectNet-7, demonstrating highly competitive performance compared to existing FER methods.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures.Accepted at the 9th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Pattern Recognition (AIPR 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对细粒度面部表情识别（FER）中局部证据稀释的问题，提出 SRE-FER，一种读出层（readout-level）的区域残差证据学习框架。核心模块 RERA 通过零初始化残差 logits 在保持骨干网络全局预测的同时细化类别边界，训练时利用基于 FACS 解剖先验的动作单元（AU）引导将区域特征导向表情相关区域，推理时无需外部人脸 pipeline。在 RAF-DB、FERPlus 和 AffectNet-7 上分别达到 92.76%、91.32% 和 67.78% 的准确率。
Motivation: 细粒度 FER 依赖区分相邻情绪的细微肌肉线索，但检测器类方法依赖脆弱的关键点流程；而直接迁移 DINOv3 等基础模型并在全局读出下会造成局部证据稀释，早期全局聚合冲淡稀疏肌肉信号，导致恐惧/惊讶、悲伤/中性等类别持续混淆。
Method: 提出 SRE-FER 框架，核心模块 RERA 添加零初始化残差 logits 来细化类别边界，同时保留骨干网络的全局预测；训练时使用基于 Facial Action Coding System（FACS）解剖先验的动作单元（AU）引导，使区域特征聚焦于表情相关区域，推理时不需外部人脸 pipeline；可选的 Full 设置进一步路由样本特定的非冗余 token。
Result: 在三个基准上，SRE-FER 在 RAF-DB 上达到 92.76%，FERPlus 上达到 91.32%，AffectNet-7 上达到 67.78%，与现有 FER 方法相比表现出很有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过在读出层恢复区域残差证据来缓解局部证据稀释，无需在推理时引入外部人脸流程，并在多个基准上取得有竞争力的结果。

papers.title: PluginEval: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Fine-Grained Error Attribution in Function Calling
papers.abstract_en: Reliable evaluation of tool routing is critical as Large Language Models increasingly operate as autonomous agents. Current benchmarks face three structural limitations: data distributions that follow a power law leave rare scenarios underrepresented; the absence of adversarial hard negatives obscures performance differences across models; and annotation pipelines depend on LLM judgments that have not been validated through execution. In this paper, we introduce PluginEval, a benchmark constructed through a two-stage framework that systematically mitigates these limitations. First, we formulate tool routing as a sequence of three decisions and separate generation from verification. LLMs propose candidate calls, while deterministic validation and real API execution provide reliable quality signals. Second, we decompose each plugin by capability, intent, and boundary to identify trigger and exclusion scenarios. We then generate queries at different difficulty levels to fill coverage gaps, including adversarial negatives targeting three failure modes, and return them to the first stage for annotation. This process creates a closed loop that iterates until coverage converges. For evaluation, we move beyond aggregate accuracy. An LLM judge anchored to gold annotations classifies failures as missed calls, spurious calls, or parameter errors, producing a detailed error profile for each model. We evaluate five model families, including proprietary models and models with open weights, analyze their performance across difficulty levels and error categories, and validate the judge through agreement with human annotations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PluginEval，一个面向大语言模型工具路由 (tool routing) 的细粒度错误归因诊断基准。该基准通过两阶段框架缓解现有评测的三个结构性局限：稀有场景在幂律分布中代表性不足、缺少对抗性难负样本、以及依赖于未经执行验证的 LLM 标注。评测时以锚定金标注的 LLM 法官将失败分类为漏调用 (missed calls)、虚假调用 (spurious calls) 和参数错误 (parameter errors)，生成每个模型的细粒度错误画像。
Motivation: 可靠的工具路由评测对 LLM 作为自主智能体至关重要，而现有基准存在三个结构性问题：数据分布呈幂律导致稀有场景未被充分覆盖；缺乏对抗性难负样本，难以拉开模型间性能差异；标注流程依赖未经执行验证的 LLM 判断。
Method: 提出两阶段闭环构建框架。第一阶段将工具路由形式化为三个决策组成的序列，并分离生成与验证：LLM 提出候选调用，确定性验证和真实 API 执行提供可靠的质量信号。第二阶段按能力 (capability)、意图 (intent) 和边界 (boundary) 分解每个插件以识别触发与排除场景，按不同难度生成查询填补覆盖缺口，包括针对三类失败模式的对抗性负样本，再返回第一阶段进行标注，迭代直至覆盖收敛。
Result: 摘要报告评估了五个模型家族，包括专有模型和开放权重模型，并分析其在难度层级和错误类别上的表现；LLM 法官通过与人标注的一致性得到验证。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 该工作强调以闭环方式收敛覆盖范围，并借助细粒度错误画像而非聚合准确率来诊断模型，为工具路由评测提供更可靠的信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Loss-Resilient Wireless Video Token Communication over Block Fading Channels
papers.abstract_en: Video token communication represents video content as discrete tokens that differ in their importance to reconstruction and exhibit temporal dependencies. When these tokens are packetized for wireless transmission, block fading can cause multiple important or correlated tokens to be lost together, severely degrading video reconstruction. To address this issue, we propose a loss-resilient wireless video token communication (WVTC) framework. WVTC evaluates token importance from the intrinsic predictive structure of video tokens, assigning high priority to structural I-tokens and measuring P-token importance by temporal neighborhood novelty. A shuffled mixed I/P-token packetization scheme disperses structural anchors and correlated temporal regions across packets. Using only current block channel state information, an online scheduler jointly considers packet importance density, MCS-dependent decoding reliability, block capacity, and importance concentration when allocating packets to fading blocks. At the receiver, a fine-tuned detokenizer reconstructs missing content from surviving tokens without retransmission. Numerical results demonstrate improved perceptual quality and more graceful degradation under increasing packet error rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对块衰落信道下视频 token 通信的丢包问题，提出一种抗丢失的无线视频 token 通信框架（WVTC）。WVTC 从视频 token 的内在预测结构评估重要性，将结构性的 I-token 设为高优先级，并以时间邻域新颖性衡量 P-token 重要性；通过打乱的混合 I/P-token 分组方案分散结构锚点与相关时间区域。发送端仅利用当前块信道状态信息在线调度分组到衰落块，接收端由微调后的去 token 化器（detokenizer）从幸存 token 重建缺失内容且无需重传。数值结果表明在分组错误率上升时感知质量改善且退化更平滑。
Motivation: 视频 token 通信将视频内容表示为离散 token，这些 token 对重建的重要性不同并存在时间依赖；无线传输中块衰落可能同时丢失多个重要或相关 token，严重降低视频重建质量。
Method: 提出 WVTC 框架：基于 token 预测结构评估重要性，优先传输结构性的 I-token 并以时间邻域新颖性衡量 P-token 重要性；采用打乱的混合 I/P-token 分组方案；在线调度器基于当前块信道状态信息，综合分组重要性密度、MCS 相关解码可靠性、块容量和重要性集中度进行分配；接收端使用微调后的 detokenizer 在无重传情况下重建缺失内容。
Result: 数值结果显示，在分组错误率增加时，该方法提升了感知质量并实现更平缓的质量退化。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，利用 token 重要性评估、分组分散与在线调度，可以在无需重传的情况下提升块衰落信道上视频 token 通信的抗丢失能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: OccAnyScene: Towards Unified Indoor-Outdoor 3D Occupancy Predictio
papers.abstract_en: 3D occupancy prediction is fundamental to scene understanding, yet existing 3D semantic occupancy methods are typically specialized to fixed scene types and occupancy protocols. We introduce Cross-Scene 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction, a new task setting which requires a single model to handle heterogeneous indoor and outdoor scenes with varying cameras, spatial ranges, voxel specifications, and semantic taxonomies. This setting poses a fundamental challenge: achieving metric-consistent yet scene-adaptive image-to-3D lifting across varying camera configurations and scene scales. To address this challenge, we propose OccAnyScene, a pixel-frustum-centered Gaussian framework built upon a pretrained depth foundation model. Specifically, the framework employs Pixel-Aligned Frustum Feature Aggregation to construct a camera-aware frustum query for each feature pixel, and Frustum-Parameterized Gaussian Construction to decode each query into multiple Gaussians whose positions and sizes are constrained by the predicted pixel depth and corresponding frustum geometry. OccAnyScene sets new state-of-the-art results, achieving 59.92% mIoU on the indoor Occ-ScanNet and 23.06% mIoU on the outdoor SurroundOcc-nuScenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的任务设定 Cross-Scene 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction，要求单个模型同时处理室内外异构场景，并兼容不同的相机配置、空间范围、体素规格与语义类别。作者提出 OccAnyScene，一个基于预训练深度基础模型 (depth foundation model) 的像素-视锥中心高斯框架，通过 Pixel-Aligned Frustum Feature Aggregation 构建相机感知的视锥查询，再用 Frustum-Parameterized Gaussian Construction 解码成多个受深度与视锥几何约束的高斯。方法在室内 Occ-ScanNet 上达到 59.92% mIoU，在室外 SurroundOcc-nuScenes 上达到 23.06% mIoU，取得新 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有 3D 语义占用预测方法通常针对固定的场景类型和占用协议设计，难以泛化到室内外混合的异构场景，而这要求模型在相机布局和场景尺度变化下仍保持度量一致且场景自适应的图像到 3D 提升 (image-to-3D lifting)。
Method: 提出 OccAnyScene 框架，以像素-视锥 (pixel-frustum) 为中心，构建在预训练深度基础模型之上；先用 Pixel-Aligned Frustum Feature Aggregation 为每个特征像素生成相机感知的视锥查询，再用 Frustum-Parameterized Gaussian Construction 将查询解码为多个高斯，其位置和尺寸由预测像素深度及对应视锥几何约束。
Result: 摘要报告 OccAnyScene 在室内 Occ-ScanNet 上取得 59.92% mIoU，在室外 SurroundOcc-nuScenes 上取得 23.06% mIoU，均刷新该任务下的 SOTA。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架能够统一 indoor-outdoor 的 3D 语义占用预测，并在两类协议上同时取得领先结果，说明场景自适应的视锥高斯建模是可行的方向。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CUPA-T2*: Covariance-Aware Uncertainty Propagation and Alignment for T2* Mapping in Accelerated MRI
papers.abstract_en: Quantitative T2* maps have strong potential for biomarker discovery but are limited by long scan times, rendering them impractical in clinical settings. Significant acceleration can be achieved through undersampling in k-space combined with learning-based reconstruction. However, reconstruction artifacts and noise can propagate into downstream T2* fitting, degrading its accuracy. We introduce CUPA-T2*, a framework that explicitly propagates voxel-wise inter-echo uncertainty from stochastic Monte Carlo dropout reconstructions to downstream T2* fitting via covariance-aware sampling. T2* fitting is performed with a heteroscedastic MLP and a correlation-based regularizer that encourages alignment between predicted variance and reconstruction uncertainty. Experiments on accelerated brain MRI data show tissue-dependent behavior: CUPA-T2* achieves competitive overall T2* fitting performance and improves white-matter performance at higher accelerations. Compared with a heteroscedastic baseline, the proposed framework substantially increases alignment between reconstruction uncertainty and predicted T2* variance, while also revealing a trade-off with calibration (ECE) and selective prediction performance (AURC). CUPA-T2* enables reconstruction uncertainty-aware T2* fitting and delivers voxel-wise uncertainty maps to support the interpretation of quantitative T2* estimates.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2nd workshop on: Reconstruction and Imaging Motion Estimation (RIME) MICCAI. This is the submitted manuscript with added link to GitHub repo, funding acknowledgements, disclosure of interests, and authors' names and affiliations. No further post submission improvements or corrections were integrated
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CUPA-T2*，一个面向加速 MRI 中定量 T2* 映射的框架，通过协方差感知采样 (covariance-aware sampling) 将随机 Monte Carlo dropout 重建得到的体素级跨回波不确定性显式传播到下游 T2* 拟合。T2* 拟合使用异方差 MLP 并辅以基于相关性的正则化项，促使预测方差与重建不确定性对齐。在加速脑 MRI 数据上的实验表明存在组织依赖性行为：整体 T2* 拟合性能具有竞争力，且在更高加速倍数下改善白质区域性能。
Motivation: 定量 T2* 图在生物标志物发现方面潜力很大，但扫描时间长，临床上不实用。通过 k-space 欠采样结合基于学习的重建可以大幅加速，但重建伪影和噪声会传播到下游 T2* 拟合中，降低其精度。
Method: CUPA-T2* 框架显式地将随机 Monte Carlo dropout 重建的体素级跨回波不确定性通过协方差感知采样传播到下游 T2* 拟合；T2* 拟合采用异方差 MLP，并使用基于相关性的正则化器来鼓励预测方差与重建不确定性之间的对齐。
Result: 在加速脑 MRI 数据上，CUPA-T2* 实现具有竞争力的整体 T2* 拟合性能，并在更高加速倍数下提升白质区域性能。与异方差基线相比，该框架大幅提高了重建不确定性与预测 T2* 方差之间的对齐度，同时也暴露出与校准 (ECE) 和选择性预测性能 (AURC) 之间的权衡。
Conclusion: CUPA-T2* 实现了重建不确定性感知的 T2* 拟合，并提供体素级不确定性图以支持定量 T2* 估计的解释。摘要同时指出了其与校准和选择性预测性能之间的权衡。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: EnergyBridge: Benchmarking Household Energy Management, User Participation, and Grid Flexibility
papers.abstract_en: Residential virtual power plants (VPPs) can provide grid flexibility by shifting household demand, but physical flexibility becomes dependable capacity only when residents authorize a plan and the promised response is delivered. Existing benchmarks evaluate control but omit event-specific authorization. We present EnergyBridge, a benchmark and agent framework connecting capacity reporting, household authorization, and physical execution. It combines region-specific EnergyPlus environments for Tianjin and Berlin with an LLM-based User Participation Simulator. Against 584 persona- and event-matched human role-play judgments, the LLM-based User Participation Simulator preserves method ordering with a 5.3-point mean absolute acceptance error. Across conventional controllers and agent baselines, EnergyBridge achieves the highest simulated authorization, lowest event-window energy, and the most reliable capacity commitment in both regions. We release human data and codes for reproducible human-centered grid-flexibility research: https://github.com/Agentic-Intelligence-Lab/EnergyBridge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EnergyBridge，一个连接容量报告、家庭授权与物理执行的基准和智能体框架，用于住宅虚拟电厂（VPP）的电网灵活性研究。它结合天津和柏林两个地区的 EnergyPlus 环境与基于 LLM 的用户参与模拟器，并在 584 条人设与事件匹配的人类角色扮演判断上验证模拟器的行为一致性。
Motivation: 现有基准只评估控制器性能，忽略了居民对具体需求响应计划的事件级授权，导致物理灵活性无法直接转化为可靠的可用容量。
Method: 构建 EnergyBridge 框架，将区域特定的 EnergyPlus 仿真环境与基于 LLM 的用户参与模拟器集成，使容量上报、家庭授权决策和物理执行三个环节闭环，并以人类角色扮演判断为参照评估授权模拟器的保真度。
Result: 基于 LLM 的用户参与模拟器在 584 条判断上保持方法排序，平均绝对接受误差为 5.3 点；在两个地区，EnergyBridge 相比常规控制器和智能体基线取得最高模拟授权率、最低事件窗口能耗和最可靠的容量承诺。
Conclusion: EnergyBridge 为以人为中心的电网灵活性研究提供可复现的基准，作者已公开人类数据和代码。

papers.title: A Structural Dynamics Graph World Model: Unified Modeling, Constrained Rollout, and Interpretable Calibration
papers.abstract_en: The state evolution of a complex system arises jointly from object laws, relational propagation, domain conservation, and unmodeled error. Forcing all sources into one black box makes mechanism attribution and constraint preservation unauditable; forcing every mechanism into one equation family discards mature domain solvers. We propose SD-GWM, a Structural Dynamics Graph World Model as an executable structural contract: nodes declare self-dynamics S, edges declare neighbor graph-coupled dynamics N---both fixed-form mechanism assets (rules, ODEs, solvers) calibrating only authorized parameters. An optional bounded residual R concentrates learnability, while a global projection maps states to feasibility, enforcing constraints without guaranteeing accuracy gains. On eight pre-registered research questions, SD-GWM delivers (i) heterogeneous integration: rules and solvers plug in natively; (ii) semantic fidelity: disabling R preserves source semantics bit-for-bit, with four theory properties under explicit proof/empirical boundaries; (iii) auditable governance: stepwise traces enable counterfactual fault localization (top-1 = 1.0) without post-hoc approximations. On a semi-synthetic flood testbed and USGS streamflow, SD-GWM reduces constraint violations to floating-point tolerance in analytical tests and to zero in semi-synthetic and real-data cases. Persistence matches SD-GWM in calm periods, but during a 254-day extreme-flood shift persistence and all neural baselines collapse (90-min RMSE 892-3007 cfs) while SD-GWM holds at 108 cfs (8-28x gain). The bounded residual cuts RMSE ~50% only under backbone bias. We position SD-GWM not as a universally superior forecaster, but as a verifiable substrate for auditable, constraint-safe spatiotemporal mining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SD-GWM，一个结构动力学图世界模型 (Structural Dynamics Graph World Model)，将复杂系统的状态演化建模为可执行的结构契约：节点自动力学 S、边表示邻居图耦合动力学 N、可选有界残差 R 以及全局可行性投影。在半合成洪水测试台和 USGS 径流数据上，SD-GWM 将约束违反降至浮点容差或零，并在 254 天极端洪水偏移下保持 90 分钟 RMSE 108 cfs，而持久性模型和神经基线崩溃到 892-3007 cfs。作者明确将该模型定位为可审计、约束安全的时空挖掘基底，而非普遍更优的预测器。
Motivation: 复杂系统的状态演化同时来自对象规律、关系传播、领域守恒和未建模误差；将所有来源塞进一个黑箱会导致机制归因和约束保持不可审计，而把所有机制强行纳入同一方程族又会丢弃成熟的领域求解器。
Method: SD-GWM 采用结构化契约：节点声明自动力学 S，边声明邻居图耦合动力学 N，两者均为固定形式的机制资产（规则、ODE、求解器），只校准授权参数；可选的受限残差 R 集中可学习性，全局投影将状态映射到可行域以强制执行约束。
Result: 在八个预注册研究问题上，SD-GWM 实现了异质集成、语义保真（禁用 R 时逐位保持源语义）和可审计治理（反事实故障定位 top-1 = 1.0）。约束违反在解析测试中降至浮点容差，在半合成和真实数据中降为零；254 天极端洪水偏移期间 SD-GWM 的 90 分钟 RMSE 为 108 cfs，较持久性和神经基线获得 8-28 倍提升；受限残差仅在骨干存在偏差时将 RMSE 降低约 50%。
Conclusion: 作者将 SD-GWM 定位为可验证的基底，服务于可审计、约束安全的时空挖掘，并明确表示它不是普遍更优的预测器；四个理论性质均有明确证明或经验边界。

papers.title: Semi-Dense Matching Uncertainty Is Not Just Local Confidence
papers.abstract_en: Reliable semi-dense matching is essential for modern geometric vision systems. Designed under a coarse-to-fine paradigm, it achieves an optimal balance between performance and computational cost. However, existing methods often struggle to provide well-quantified uncertainties, where catastrophic coarse-assignment failures are ignored, leading to truncated error distributions and severely misjudged geometric estimations. In this paper, we propose a lightweight, post-hoc overall uncertainty estimation framework that introduces a two-component calibrated Laplace mixture model with only 9 learnable parameters. The objective is to explicitly capture both the sharp local refinement noise and the broader tail of coarse-assignment failures. We introduce the Coarse-success posterior Refit (CoRe) method, a geometric refitting module that utilizes the posterior probability of coarse-assignment success as soft correspondence weights. Extensive experiments show that our method consistently improves downstream geometric accuracy across various pretrained-only matchers and robust estimators with minimal computational overhead. Our code is available at https://github.com/khoavpt/Probabilistic-matching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级、事后（post-hoc）的整体不确定性估计框架，用于半稠密匹配（semi-dense matching）。框架引入一个仅含 9 个可学习参数的两分量校准拉普拉斯混合模型，显式刻画局部细化噪声与粗分配失败（coarse-assignment failure）的宽尾部；同时提出 CoRe（Coarse-success posterior Refit）几何重拟合模块，将粗分配成功的后验概率作为软对应权重。实验表明该方法能在多种预训练匹配器和鲁棒估计器上以极小计算开销持续提升下游几何精度。
Motivation: 现有粗到细（coarse-to-fine）半稠密匹配方法难以提供良好量化的不确定性，灾难性的粗分配失败常被忽略，导致误差分布被截断、几何估计严重误判。
Method: 提出两分量校准拉普拉斯混合模型（9 个可学习参数）作为事后不确定性估计框架，以显式捕捉局部细化噪声与粗分配失败尾部；并引入 CoRe 几何重拟合模块，利用粗分配成功的后验概率作为软对应权重来改进几何估计。
Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在多种预训练匹配器和鲁棒估计器上持续提升下游几何精度，且计算开销最小。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式建模粗分配失败尾部是提升不确定性量化与几何精度的关键，并开源代码。

papers.title: RippleKV: Cross-Layer KV Cache Allocation via Perturbation Propagation
papers.abstract_en: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by KV cache memory, yet distributing a limited cache budget across layers remains challenging. Existing methods rely on proxies such as layer depth, attention statistics, or representation change. These proxies do not measure how perturbations at each layer propagate to the output and may therefore cause sensitive layers to be underallocated while tolerant layers are overallocated. To address this issue, we propose RippleKV, which allocates cache across layers by estimating how perturbations to each layer's value cache affect the final predictive distribution. RippleKV independently injects norm-adaptive perturbations into each layer's value cache and measures the induced KL divergence at the model output over a small calibration set. Averaging these responses yields a sensitivity profile specific to the model that need not vary monotonically with depth. RippleKV then converts the sensitivity profile into layer budget multipliers by normalizing the sensitivity scores and applying an exponential mapping. A ratio parameter controls the allocation disparity between sensitive and tolerant layers, while a final normalization preserves the KV cache budget. Experiments on LongBench demonstrate that RippleKV achieves the highest average performance among the evaluated KV cache compression methods under matched cache budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RippleKV，一种面向长上下文 LLM 推理的跨层 KV cache 压缩分配方法。它通过向每层的 value cache 注入范数自适应扰动（norm-adaptive perturbations），在小校准集上测量模型输出端的 KL 散度，估计各层扰动对最终预测分布的影响，得到不随深度单调变化的敏感度分布（sensitivity profile）。随后将敏感度分数归一化并做指数映射，得到各层缓存预算乘数，并用比例参数控制敏感层与容忍层之间的分配差距。LongBench 实验显示，在匹配缓存预算下，RippleKV 在评测的 KV cache 压缩方法中取得最高平均性能。
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理受 KV cache 内存瓶颈制约，但如何在层间分配有限缓存预算仍具挑战。现有方法依赖层深度、注意力统计或表征变化等代理指标，而这些代理无法度量每层扰动向输出的传播，可能导致敏感层被低估分配、容忍层被过度分配。
Method: RippleKV 通过扰动传播来估计逐层敏感度：独立地向每层 value cache 注入范数自适应扰动，并在校准集上度量模型输出处的 KL 散度；对多次响应取平均得到模型特定的敏感度分布。然后对敏感度分数归一化并应用指数映射，转换为层预算乘数，由比例参数控制分配差距，最后经归一化保持总 KV cache 预算。
Result: 在 LongBench 上，RippleKV 在匹配缓存预算的条件下，于评测的 KV cache 压缩方法中取得最高的平均性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于扰动传播的敏感度估计可用于跨层缓存预算分配，且敏感度分布不需要随层深度单调变化；比例参数提供对敏感层与容忍层分配差距的控制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Conditionally Resampled Sliding-Window Count Kernels: Spectral-Gap Bounds and Poincaré Inequalities
papers.abstract_en: We study the conditionally resampled sliding-window count kernel associated with the empirical counts of length-$n$ windows from a stationary finite-state reversible Markov chain. Although the resulting count process is generally not Markov, its stationary one-step conditional law defines a genuine Markov kernel. For every fixed strictly positive reversible kernel \(P\) on a finite state space, we present a Poincaré inequality for the induced count kernel $\tP_n$ of length $n$. In other words, we derive the lower bound of the spectral gap $\Gap(\tP_n)$ of $\tP_n$ as \[ \Gap(\tP_n)\ge \frac{c(P)}{n}, \] where \(c(P)>0\) depends only on \(P\). The proof combines a martingale oscillation inequality for the stationary path law with a direct comparison of coordinate oscillations to the Dirichlet form of the count kernel. A linear statistic of the count vector gives the matching \(O(1/n)\) upper bound, so for every fixed strictly positive reversible \(P\) one has \(\Gap(\tP_n)=Θ_P(1/n)\). The resulting count-space Poincaré inequality yields a local-to-global variance bound for finite-window count statistics and, together with a general matrix-concentration principle, operator-norm concentration for matrix-valued empirical averages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究平稳有限状态可逆马尔可夫链的滑动窗口计数过程的条件重采样计数核，证明其谱隙下界为 c(P)/n，并结合线性统计量给出匹配的 O(1/n) 上界，从而得到 Gap(\tilde P_n)=Θ_P(1/n)。证明结合了平稳路径律的鞅振荡不等式与 Dirichlet 形式的坐标振荡比较，并由此推出计数空间 Poincaré 不等式以及矩阵值经验平均的算子范数集中界。
Motivation: 滑动窗口计数过程通常不是 Markov 的，但其平稳一步条件分布给出一个真正的 Markov 核；对该计数核的谱隙进行量化是理解有限窗口计数统计量方差与集中行为的基础。
Method: 对每个固定的严格正可逆核 P，构造长度为 n 的计数核 \tilde P_n；通过平稳路径律的鞅振荡不等式，并将坐标振荡与计数核的 Dirichlet 形式直接比较，证明谱隙下界 \Gap(\tilde P_n) ≥ c(P)/n；再用计数向量的线性统计量给出 O(1/n) 的匹配上界。
Result: 对于任意固定的严格正可逆 P，得到 \Gap(\tilde P_n)=Θ_P(1/n)；该计数空间 Poincaré 不等式给出有限窗口计数统计量的局部到整体方差界，并结合一般矩阵集中原理得到矩阵值经验平均的算子范数集中结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结果对所有固定严格正可逆有限状态核成立，谱隙的 1/n 阶行为是精确的；但未讨论状态空间大小或非可逆情形下的推广。

papers.title: Branch2Skill: Efficient Skill Evolution Through Reasoning Trees
papers.abstract_en: Skill evolution improves agent skills through feedback over time, with failed trajectories often providing informative signals by revealing incomplete or misleading behaviors. However, existing methods mainly rely on single trajectories, where early reasoning errors can propagate through subsequent steps and weaken the feedback available for skill refinement. Consequently, improving skills requires repeated cycles of rollout, diagnosis, and update, incurring substantial token costs. To address this challenge, we introduce Branch2Skill, an efficient framework that transforms a single reasoning tree into dense supervision for skill evolution. For each task or problem, Branch2Skill performs Monte Carlo tree search under a fixed budget to obtain diverse reasoning trajectories, then compares an elite path with sibling alternatives sharing the same prefixes to extract step-wise evidence about which reasoning patterns to retain, revise, or avoid. Finally, Branch2Skill distills multi-step evidence into reusable updates, allowing one reasoning tree to provide supervision across multiple reasoning steps and reducing the need for repeated rollout-update cycles. Across six benchmarks covering reasoning and agentic tasks, Branch2Skill consistently improves task performance while enhancing skill evolution efficiency. For example, with GPT 5.5 as the target model, Branch2Skill uses 73.2% fewer tokens than SkillOpt, while achieving superior performance. These results demonstrate that reasoning trees can support not only more effective trajectory search, but also richer supervision for more efficient skill improvement. Code will be published.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Branch2Skill 提出一种高效的技能进化框架，将单个推理树转换为稠密监督信号：在固定预算下用蒙特卡洛树搜索 (MCTS) 得到多条推理轨迹，比较精英路径与共享前缀的兄弟路径来提取逐步证据，并把多步证据蒸馏为可复用更新。摘要报告在覆盖推理和智能体任务的六个基准上一致提升任务性能并提高技能进化效率。
Motivation: 现有技能进化方法主要依赖单条轨迹，早期推理错误会沿后续步骤传播并削弱可用于技能修正的反馈，导致需要反复进行 rollout、诊断和更新，token 成本很高。
Method: 对每个任务用固定预算的 MCTS 生成多样化的推理轨迹，将精英路径与共享相同前缀的兄弟备选路径对比，提取关于哪些推理模式应保留、修改或避免的逐步证据；随后把多步证据蒸馏成可复用更新，使单个推理树即可为多个推理步骤提供监督。
Result: 在六个涵盖推理与智能体任务的基准上一致提升任务性能并增强技能进化效率；以 GPT 5.5 为目标模型时，相比 SkillOpt 节省 73.2% 的 token，同时取得更优性能。
Conclusion: 摘要表明推理树不仅能支持更有效的轨迹搜索，还能为技能改进提供更丰富的监督信号，从而实现更高效的技能进化；代码将会发布。

papers.title: UniSpace: Unified Visual Representation and Scalable Multimodal Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Semantic vision encoders have become a central visual interface for multimodal understanding and semantic conditioning in image generation. However, their final tokens discard fine-grained visual details, leading to poor pixel reconstruction and limiting their use in reconstruction-sensitive tasks such as image generation and editing. In this work, we ask whether understanding, generation, and editing can be modeled in a single visual representation space built from a pretrained semantic ViT. We show that the frozen Transformer blocks of a semantic ViT are not intrinsically unable to preserve visual details. Instead, the original patch parameterization drives the representation toward semantic abstraction, making fine-grained information difficult to recover from the final tokens. Based on this observation, we introduce \emph{Patch Reparameterization}, which preserves the original semantic pathway while adding a reconstruction-aware patch embedding that provides fine-grained visual information to the same frozen ViT blocks. The resulting unified representation preserves multimodal understanding while enabling high-fidelity image reconstruction and a favorable reconstruction--generation trade-off. We further scale this representation into \emph{UniSpace}, an 8B Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts model that performs understanding, generation, and editing in the same visual space without a separate VAE pathway. System-level evaluations demonstrate practical text-to-image generation and instruction-based image editing, showing that a reparameterized pretrained ViT can serve as a unified visual interface for scalable multimodal modeling.
