papers.title: Efficient Test-Time Scaling for LLM-based Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Long-term time series forecasting benefits from preserving global structure such as trends and seasonality. Recent LLM-based forecasters often improve accuracy through test-time scaling (e.g., iterative refinement), but these methods are computationally expensive and increasingly prone to global-shape mismatch as the prediction horizon extends. We propose SCALER, a coarse-to-fine forecasting framework that first employs a lightweight Transformer tailored to long-term shape modeling to predict a coarse representation of future dynamics. This predicted shape then serves as a compact guide for an LLM to perform test-time scaling via iterative coarse-to-fine residual token refinement, while processing substantially fewer tokens at each step. By guiding refinement with an explicit future-shape prediction, SCALER reduces reliance on long description prompts, and its fixed-step refinement avoids costly reward-model-based selection, further lowering computational overhead. Experimental results demonstrate that SCALER outperforms strong forecasting baselines in long-term, short-term and zero-shot forecasting while significantly reducing the inference cost associated with scaled LLM for time series forecasting. Code: https://github.com/xuanmay2701/SCALER.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCALER，一个面向基于 LLM 的时间序列预测的粗到细测试时缩放框架。它先用一个轻量 Transformer 对长期趋势、季节性等全局形状建模，预测未来动态的粗糙表示，再用该预测形状作为紧凑引导，让 LLM 以固定步数的迭代残差 token 精化完成测试时缩放，从而大幅减少每步处理的 token 数。实验表明 SCALER 在长期、短期和零样本预测上均超过强基线，同时显著降低 LLM 缩放带来的推理成本。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的预测器常通过测试时缩放（如迭代精化）提升精度，但这种方法计算开销大，且随预测视界延长越来越容易出现全局形状失配；而长期时间序列预测又依赖对趋势和季节性等全局结构的保持。
Method: SCALER 采用粗到细两阶段：先由轻量 Transformer 预测未来动态的粗糙表示作为全局形状引导，再将此形状作为紧凑提示交给 LLM，进行固定步数的残差 token 迭代精化。相比依赖长描述提示和 reward-model 选择的方案，SCALER 处理更少 token 且无需额外选择模型，从而降低计算开销。
Result: 摘要报告 SCALER 在长期、短期和零样本预测基准上均优于强基线，并显著降低基于 LLM 的时间序列预测在测试时缩放带来的推理成本；具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Conclusion: 作者强调，用显式未来形状预测引导迭代精化，可以在保持全局结构的同时降低对长描述提示的依赖与计算开销；代码已公开。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: Backward Compatibility in Tree-Based Explanations and Enhanced CART Algorithm
papers.abstract_en: In the operation of machine learning models, model update is a fundamental process that requires careful consideration of its impact on downstream decision-making. Particularly when operating explainable models, changes in explanations resulting from model updates can lead to detrimental outcomes for users. Decision trees, due to their high transparency, are frequently employed in risk-sensitive decision-making and serve as a prominent example in which the aforementioned issue is evident. However, existing research addressing similar issues has focused on explanations based on feature contributions, and thus cannot handle explanations derived from tree structures. Therefore, this paper proposes the Backward Compatibility Loss in Tree-based eXplanations (BCLTX), a loss metric that suppresses changes in decision tree explanations before and after updates. Furthermore, we design CART with Backward Compatibility in Tree-based eXplanations (CART-BCTX), a lightweight algorithm that improves upon CART for the decision tree update problem under BCLTX. Experimental results using 10 real-world datasets, including both classification and regression tasks, show that CART-BCTX achieves favorable trade-offs between prediction performances and BCLTX values, with comparable computation times to CART, regardless of the task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对决策树模型更新后解释变化的问题，提出 BCLTX 损失度量来抑制更新前后的解释差异，并设计 CART-BCTX 这一轻量级算法。在 10 个真实数据集（涵盖分类与回归）上的实验显示，CART-BCTX 在预测性能与 BCLTX 值之间取得良好权衡，且计算时间与 CART 相当。
Motivation: 模型更新可能改变可解释模型的解释，从而对下游决策用户产生不利影响；已有研究仅处理基于特征贡献的解释，无法应对基于树结构的解释变化。
Method: 提出 Backward Compatibility Loss in Tree-based eXplanations (BCLTX) 作为损失度量，并设计 CART with Backward Compatibility in Tree-based eXplanations (CART-BCTX) 算法，在 BCLTX 约束下改进决策树更新问题。
Result: 在 10 个真实数据集上的分类与回归实验中，CART-BCTX 取得预测性能与 BCLTX 值的良好权衡，计算时间与 CART 相当，且不受任务类型影响。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 BCLTX 与 CART-BCTX 能在保持 CART 计算效率的前提下，抑制决策树解释在模型更新前后的变化。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: This work explores the relationship between task similarity and catastrophic forgetting in reinforcement learning. Catastrophic forgetting, the phenomenon in machine learning of losing the ability to effectively perform on previous tasks, is a significant impediment to continual learning. This study aims to understand the extent to which the similarity of a new task influences the performance on the previous task. Interpretable reinforcement learning, specifically Q-learning, is employed on graph-based tasks with the objective of minimising the number of steps to reach a goal. The study investigates the performance on a previously learned task after training on a new task, for tasks of varying relative levels of complexity. The experimental results reveal a complex dynamic between task similarity and forgetting, with significant fluctuations in forgetting severity observed across degrees of task similarities and task complexities, and are suggestive of an interdependence of forgetting on the similarity and complexity of tasks. The observations were accompanied by observations of high degrees of variability in forgetting and an uneven distribution of task similarity measures. The relationship between these variables remains unclear and no evidence of statistical significance that task similarity has an effect, independently, on forgetting is found in continual reinforcement learning. Further research is warranted to gain a comprehensive understanding of the potential interplay between task similarity and catastrophic forgetting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究持续强化学习（continual reinforcement learning）中任务相似度与灾难性遗忘（catastrophic forgetting）之间的关系。作者采用可解释的 Q-learning 在基于图的任务上训练，以最小化到达目标所需的步数为目标，考察在不同相对复杂度与相似度的新任务训练后，旧任务性能的下降程度。实验显示遗忘严重程度随任务相似度和复杂度出现明显波动，但未发现任务相似度单独对遗忘有统计学显著影响。
Motivation: 灾难性遗忘是持续学习的主要障碍，但任务相似度如何影响先前任务上的性能保持尚不明确，理解这一关系有助于设计更稳健的持续强化学习算法。
Method: 使用可解释的强化学习，具体为 Q-learning，在基于图的任务上以最小化到达目标的步数为目标；通过在新任务上训练后测量先前任务的性能，考察不同相对复杂度与相似度任务对遗忘的影响。
Result: 实验结果揭示任务相似度与遗忘之间存在复杂动态，遗忘严重程度在不同相似度和复杂度组合下显著波动，且伴随高变异性与任务相似度分布不均；未发现任务相似度独立地对遗忘产生统计显著影响的证据。
Conclusion: 作者认为任务相似度与灾难性遗忘的关系仍不清晰，结果暗示遗忘可能同时依赖于任务相似度和复杂度，需要进一步研究以理解二者之间的潜在交互。

papers.title: FiRe: Fixed-Noise Refinement for Visual Counterfactual Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Visual counterfactual explanations aim to change classifier decisions through realistic and localized edits while preserving decision-irrelevant content. Existing DDPM-based methods typically perform classifier-guided editing along a long reverse denoising trajectory. The changing noise levels make semantic editability and spatial control difficult to balance, and the editable state is noisy, whereas the target classifier is trained on clean images. As a result, these methods require either costly recursive denoising or low-quality one-step estimates to obtain classifier-facing clean images. We propose FiRe, a Fixed-noise Refinement framework for visual counterfactual explanations. Rather than following a reverse denoising trajectory, FiRe maps the input to a fixed noise level and iteratively refines the noisy state at that level. To provide clean images for classifier guidance, FiRe first adapts Pixel Mean Flow to visual counterfactual explanation, enabling direct clean-image prediction from noisy states. To make fixed-noise refinement produce minimal and localized counterfactual edits, FiRe introduces three FiRe-specific controls: a dynamic dual-mask strategy, adaptive guidance, and early stopping, which determine where edits accumulate, which changes become visible, and when refinement stops. Experiments on five tasks across three datasets show that, compared with the strongest recent baseline, FiRe achieves about 3$\times$ faster online inference and 8$\times$ fewer FLOPs while obtaining comparable or state-of-the-art counterfactual quality.
papers.comment: Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FiRe（Fixed-noise Refinement）框架，用于视觉反事实解释（visual counterfactual explanations）。与现有 DDPM 方法沿长反向去噪轨迹进行分类器引导编辑不同，FiRe 将输入映射到固定噪声水平并迭代精炼该噪声状态，并适配 Pixel Mean Flow 以从噪声状态直接预测干净图像。为使编辑最小且局部化，FiRe 引入动态双掩码策略、自适应引导和早停三种控制机制。实验在三个数据集的五个任务上，相比最强近期基线实现约 3 倍更快的在线推理和 8 倍更少的 FLOPs，同时保持相当或最先进的反事实质量。
Motivation: 现有基于 DDPM 的反事实解释方法沿长反向去噪轨迹进行编辑，噪声水平变化使语义可编辑性与空间控制难以平衡；可编辑状态含噪声，而目标分类器在干净图像上训练，导致需要昂贵的递归去噪或低质量的一步估计来获得分类器可用的干净图像。
Method: FiRe 将输入映射到固定噪声水平并对该水平的噪声状态进行迭代精炼，而非遵循反向去噪轨迹；为提供干净图像给分类器引导，FiRe 将 Pixel Mean Flow 适配到视觉反事实解释任务，实现从噪声状态直接预测干净图像；同时引入动态双掩码策略、自适应引导和早停，分别决定编辑累积位置、哪些变化可见以及精炼何时停止。
Result: 在三个数据集的五个任务上，与最强近期基线相比，FiRe 实现约 3 倍更快的在线推理和 8 倍更少的 FLOPs，并达到相当或最先进的反事实编辑质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调固定噪声精炼配合任务特定的控制机制，可以在避免长反向去噪轨迹的同时获得高效且高质量的反事实解释。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调固定噪声精炼配合任务特定的控制机制，可以在避免长反向去噪轨迹的同时获得高效且高质量的反事实解释。

papers.title: A Dynamic-Semantics Framework for Grounding Human Referring Expressions in Visual Perceptual Data
papers.abstract_en: Humans converge on shared names for novel, hard-to-describe objects through repeated interaction, a process psycholinguists call lexical entrainment. Leading vision-language models fail at this: recent empirical work documents that they do not shorten references, reuse successful expressions, or maintain stable pact state across turns. We present a framework that addresses the gap by externalizing pact state into three explicit, inspectable sets of referent-object bindings ($Γ, Ξ, Ω$), updated by a dynamic-semantics context-change rule. The symbolic layer sits on top of a lightweight perceptual-alignment pipeline that grounds noisy human referring expressions in crowd-sourced imagery via SIFT homographies and the Universal Quality Index. Evaluated on the Stanford Repeated Reference Game corpus (over 15{,}000 director-matcher utterances on abstract tangram stimuli), the framework places the correct target in its top-5 hypothesis set 83.56% of the time from a single director utterance. Human matcher top-1 accuracy on the same corpus is approximately 77-80%. We also report results on a held-out condition in which obvious tangram-adjacent images are excluded from the retrieved set, which provides a more conservative measurement of the grounding signal. Ablations isolate the contribution of each component: SIFT alignment, UQI, query preprocessing, and image augmentation. The central contribution is the combination: a transparent, auditable symbolic layer that recovers the structure of lexical entrainment turn by turn, paired with a perceptual channel whose behavior can be examined ablation by ablation. We also discuss in detail what the framework does not do. It is not interactive, it does not close the loop with the director, and its retrieval-driven perceptual channel is vulnerable to a class of leakage effects that we quantify and bound rather than wave away.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言模型在指称表达 (referring expressions) 中无法复现人类词汇趋同 (lexical entrainment) 行为的问题，提出一个动态语义框架：将对话中的 pact state 外部化为三组显式、可检查的指称-对象绑定 (Γ, Ξ, Ω)，并用动态语义上下文变化规则更新。符号层构建在轻量级感知对齐流水线之上，通过 SIFT 单应变换和 Universal Quality Index 将噪声指称表达锚定到众包图像。在 Stanford Repeated Reference Game 语料库（15,000 余条 director-matcher 话语）上，单次 director 话语下正确目标进入 top-5 假设集的概率为 83.56%，而人类 matcher 的 top-1 准确率约为 77-80%。
Motivation: 已有实证工作显示，主流视觉-语言模型在多轮交互中不会缩短指称、不会复用成功表达，也无法跨轮维持稳定的 pact state，这与人类通过反复交互收敛到共享名称的词汇趋同过程形成明显差距。
Method: 提出将 pact state 外化为三组显式可检查的指称-对象绑定 (Γ, Ξ, Ω)，由动态语义上下文变化规则更新；符号层叠加在轻量级感知对齐流水线上，利用 SIFT 单应变换与 Universal Quality Index 在众包图像中接地噪声指称表达，并通过消融检验 SIFT 对齐、UQI、查询预处理与图像增广各自的贡献。
Result: 在 Stanford Repeated Reference Game 语料库上，框架从单条 director 话语中将正确目标置于 top-5 假设集的概率为 83.56%；同时报告了排除明显与 tangram 相邻图像的 held-out 条件下的保守测量结果，并用消融实验分离各组件作用。
Conclusion: 摘要强调核心贡献是透明、可审计的符号层与可逐项消融的感知通道相结合，能够逐轮恢复词汇趋同的结构；同时明确说明框架不具备交互性、不与 director 闭环，且检索驱动的感知通道存在一类可量化并界定边界的泄漏效应。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Kernel Methods for Refined Prophet Inequalities
papers.abstract_en: The single-selection prophet inequality is a canonical Bayesian online selection problem in which independent nonnegative values arrive sequentially and the decision-maker must irrevocably select at most one. Classical single-threshold guarantees are tight in the worst case, but the hard instances that prove tightness are highly irregular: the prophet's advantage is driven by rare, very large realizations of the maximum. We refine this worst-case picture by imposing a bound on the relative variance of the prophet's value, $\mathrm{Var}(\max_{i\in[n]}X_i)/\mathbb E[\max_{i\in[n]}X_i]^2$. This yields a nonparametric complexity measure that interpolates between deterministic instances, where the full prophet value can be recovered, and the unrestricted worst-case regime. Our main technical contribution is a general kernel method for single-threshold prophet inequalities. The method represents an instance by the quantile function of the maximum and rewrites the payoff of a threshold as a linear kernel functional of this quantile. This turns the worst-case analysis into an infinite-dimensional convex program, restores strong minimax duality in quantile space, and reduces the bounded-variance adversary's problem to a one-parameter variational family. Applying this framework, we obtain an exact characterization of the IID bounded-variance curve and asymptotically optimal finite-horizon thresholds, a closed-form expression for the fixed-order non-identical model, and a prophet-secretary lower-bound program together with a strict separation from the IID benchmark at every positive finite variance constraint. As a further application of the same kernel viewpoint, we derive an exact formula for IID random horizons under a convexity condition on the horizon pgf, which includes monotone-hazard-rate horizons, highlighting the broad applicability of this new technique for single threshold settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究单选择 prophet inequality（先知不等式），通过在 prophet 值的相对方差上施加界来细化经典最坏情况分析，并提出一种一般核方法（kernel method）：用最大值的分位函数表示实例，将阈值收益写成该分位函数的线性核泛函，从而把最坏情况分析化为无穷维凸规划并恢复分位空间中的强 minimax 对偶。应用该框架，作者得到 IID 有界方差曲线的精确刻画、固定顺序非相同分布模型的闭式表达式、prophet-secretary 下界规划及其与 IID 基准的严格分离，并对 IID 随机时域在生成函数凸性条件下给出精确公式。
Motivation: 经典单阈值 prophet inequality 的最坏情况下界是紧的，但证明紧性的困难实例高度不规则，prophet 的优势来自最大值罕见且极大的实现。作者通过限制 prophet 值的相对方差，提出一个介于确定性实例与无约束最坏情况之间的非参数复杂度度量，以细化最坏情况图景。
Method: 提出一般核方法：将实例表示为最大值的分位函数，并把阈值收益重写为该分位函数的线性核泛函。这一转化将最坏情况分析化为无穷维凸规划，在分位空间恢复强 minimax 对偶，并将有界方差对手的问题约化为单参数变分族。
Result: 摘要报告获得 IID 有界方差曲线的精确刻画及渐近最优的有限时域阈值；固定顺序非相同分布模型的闭式表达式；prophet-secretary 下界规划，并证明在任意正有限方差约束下与 IID 基准严格分离；此外还推导出 IID 随机时域在时域概率生成函数满足凸性条件下的精确公式，涵盖单调风险率（monotone-hazard-rate）时域。
Conclusion: 作者强调该核方法对单阈值设置具有广泛适用性，能够统一处理有界方差、固定顺序非相同分布、prophet-secretary 以及随机时域等多种模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Degradation-Guided Underwater Image Restoration with Task-Oriented Latent Control
papers.abstract_en: Degradation information in underwater images plays a dual role: its spatial and spectral cues can guide adaptive restoration, while degradation-entangled features may be propagated without explicit regulation during decoding. Existing methods largely overlook this dual role, either underexploiting degradation cues or directly forwarding encoder features through skip connections. To address this issue, we propose PROTEUS, which couples degradation-guided feature adaptation with task?oriented latent control. PROTEUS tackles this problem from two complementary perspectives. At the feature level, the Guided Dynamic Feature Modulation Block exploits spatially varying degradation cues to adapt feature processing across network stages. At the representation level, the task-oriented latent controller learns a structured control code under discriminative regularisation and uses it for channel-wise modulation of skip features, without requiring the code to form a metrically cleaner embedding. Extensive experiments on five paired and four non-reference underwater benchmarks demonstrate that PROTEUS achieves highly competitive restoration performance, with a favourable balance between restoration quality and computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出名为 PROTEUS 的水下图像恢复方法，认为退化信息具有双重作用：其空间与光谱线索可用于引导自适应恢复，但退化纠缠特征可能未经显式调控就在解码阶段传播。PROTEUS 从特征层和表征层两个互补视角出发，分别用退化引导的动态特征调制模块和任务导向的隐式控制器来改进恢复效果。实验在五个成对数据集和四个非参考水下基准上验证了恢复质量与计算成本的平衡。
Motivation: 现有水下图像恢复方法要么未充分利用退化线索，要么直接通过跳跃连接转发编码器特征，忽略了退化信息在引导恢复与无调控传播之间的双重角色。
Method: 提出 PROTEUS：在特征层面使用 Guided Dynamic Feature Modulation Block，利用空间变化的退化线索跨网络阶段自适应调节特征处理；在表征层面设计任务导向的隐式控制器，在判别性正则下学习结构化控制码，并用它对跳跃连接特征做通道级调制，且不要求该编码形成度量意义上更干净的嵌入。
Result: 在五个成对数据集和四个非参考水下基准上的广泛实验表明，PROTEUS 达到具有竞争力的恢复性能，并在恢复质量与计算成本之间取得良好平衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调退化引导的特征适应与任务导向隐式控制相结合可有效处理水下图像恢复中的退化信息双重作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: JSGS: JPEG State-Guided Supervision for 3D Gaussian Splatting from Mixed-Quality Views
papers.abstract_en: Standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) assumes that every input image faithfully samples scene radiance. However, mixed-quality JPEG images violate this assumption because compression-induced blocking and ringing artifacts can corrupt updates to Gaussians shared across views. To address this problem, we propose JPEG State-Guided Supervision for 3D Gaussian Splatting from Mixed-Quality Views (JSGS). JSGS uses luminance and chrominance quantization tables stored in each JPEG file to construct a view-specific JPEG observation operator. This operator encodes and decodes each rendered view for domain-matched comparison with the corresponding decoded input image. The luminance quantization table supplies continuous weights within a fixed middle frequency band. A loss in the low frequency band anchors coarse structure, while the weighted middle frequency loss redistributes supervision among the selected DCT coordinates. The resulting block disagreement also guides the Gaussian Controller to regularize small primitives with high opacity in disagreement regions. Across seven scenes and three mixed-quality schedules, JSGS achieves the lowest mean LPIPS and the highest mean SSIM under every schedule while rendering at approximately 150 FPS. Code: https://github.com/Jayden-Cui/JSGS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对混合质量 JPEG 视图下 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 重建质量问题，提出 JSGS（JPEG State-Guided Supervision）。JSGS 利用每个 JPEG 文件中的亮度和色度量化表构建视图相关的 JPEG 观测算子，对渲染视图进行编码再解码，与对应的解码输入图像做域匹配比较；低频损失锚定粗略结构，加权中频损失按 DCT 坐标重新分配监督，并由块不一致性引导 Gaussian Controller 正则化不一致区域中的高不透明度小图元。在七个场景和三种混合质量调度下，JSGS 均取得最低平均 LPIPS 和最高平均 SSIM，渲染速度约为 150 FPS。
Motivation: 标准 3DGS 假设每张输入图像都忠实地采样场景辐射亮度，但混合质量的 JPEG 图像违反该假设：压缩引入的块效应（blocking）和振铃（ringing）伪影会破坏跨视图共享高斯更新的过程。
Method: JSGS 从每个 JPEG 文件存储的亮度与色度量化表构建视图特定的 JPEG 观测算子，对渲染视图执行编码再解码，从而与对应解码输入进行域匹配比较；亮度量化表在固定中频带内提供连续权重，低频带损失锚定粗略结构，加权中频带损失在选定 DCT 坐标上重新分配监督，块不一致性还引导 Gaussian Controller 对不一致区域中的高不透明度小图元进行正则化。
Result: 摘要报告在七个场景和三种混合质量调度下，JSGS 在每个调度中都取得最低的平均 LPIPS 和最高的平均 SSIM，并保持约 150 FPS 的渲染速度。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是，利用 JPEG 量化表进行状态引导监督可以有效缓解混合质量 JPEG 视图对 3DGS 训练的破坏，同时保持高渲染效率；代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要的结论是，利用 JPEG 量化表进行状态引导监督可以有效缓解混合质量 JPEG 视图对 3DGS 训练的破坏，同时保持高渲染效率；代码已公开。

papers.title: The Scaffolding Matters More Than the Interface: A Controlled Comparison of MCP and CLI Tool Use Across Seven Agent Scaffoldings, Five Language Models, and One Software Task
papers.abstract_en: How much an AI coding agent costs to run can depend more on the agent scaffolding that drives it than on the interface through which it reaches its tools. We set out to measure the cost of tool use over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) against tool use over an ordinary command-line interface (CLI), a difference on which published estimates disagree by more than an order of magnitude while resting on practitioner reports that cannot be reproduced. We ran one fixed software task -- six operations against a private online git repository -- across seven agent scaffoldings and five language models, and we verified completion by inspecting the repository state rather than trusting the agent's self-report. The dominant effect was the scaffolding. Two of the seven ship no MCP support at all; they completed every run using only the CLI, which shows that MCP is unnecessary for this class of work, and they were 5.0x to 28x cheaper than the five scaffoldings that do support MCP, comparing CLI runs alone with no MCP server attached anywhere. The effect was largest for a small 27-billion-parameter model running locally, whose cost varied 139x across scaffoldings while it completed the task under all of them. The comparison we set out to make proved unstable: thirteen strictly paired MCP-to-CLI ratios span 0.43x to 29x, with outliers on both sides. The two interfaces separate on the cost of failure, where 12.9 per cent of the money spent on MCP runs bought no completed work against 2.2 per cent on CLI runs, but not on its frequency: failures were equally common in both, in the original runs and in their repetitions alike. Agents frequently ignored the interface they were assigned, so comparisons that do not verify actual behaviour measure an unknown mixture. The harness, the task, the verification and the complete dataset are released as open source.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 4 figures, 8 tables. Companion methodology paper: arXiv:2606.11869. Dataset and measurement harness (open source, GPL-3.0): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21851992
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较 AI 编码代理通过 MCP 与普通 CLI 调用工具的运行成本，针对同一固定软件任务（对私有在线 git 仓库执行六项操作），在七个代理脚手架 (agent scaffolding) 和五个语言模型上测量，并通过检查仓库状态而非代理自报告来验证任务完成。结果显示脚手架是主导因素：两个不支持 MCP 的脚手架仅用 CLI 完成全部运行，且比支持 MCP 的五个脚手架便宜 5.0 到 28 倍；严格配对的 MCP 与 CLI 成本比在 0.43x 到 29x 之间波动，比较本身不稳定。作者将测量工具、任务、验证流程和数据集以开源形式发布。
Motivation: 关于 MCP 与 CLI 工具调用成本的既有估计相差超过一个数量级，且都基于不可复现的从业者报告，缺乏可验证的受控测量。
Method: 作者在七个代理脚手架和五个语言模型上运行同一个固定软件任务，比较 MCP 与 CLI 接口下的工具调用成本，并通过检查在线 git 仓库的实际状态来验证任务是否真正完成；同时统计各运行中代理实际使用的接口。
Result: 脚手架效应远大于接口效应：两个无 MCP 支持的脚手架仅用 CLI 完成全部运行，并比支持 MCP 的五个脚手架便宜 5.0x 到 28x；一个本地运行的 270 亿参数模型在不同脚手架下成本相差 139 倍；13 个严格配对的 MCP/CLI 成本比介于 0.43x 到 29x，两端都有异常值。MCP 与 CLI 的差异主要体现在失败成本上（12.9% 的 MCP 花费未换来完成任务，CLI 为 2.2%），而失败频率两者相当。
Conclusion: MCP 对此类软件任务并非必要，且接口对比结果不稳定；代理经常忽略被分配的接口，因此不验证实际行为的比较测量到的是未知的混合；作者强调脚手架选择对成本的影响更大。

papers.title: LegoLM: Structured Weight Sharing for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We present \LegoLM{}, a structured weight-sharing compression framework for large language models grounded in a systematic study of why global weight sharing fails and how to fix it. We identify two distinct failure modes. Distributional mismatch: for vector blocks of dimension d <= 2, transformer layers with heterogeneous weight scales impose a scale-mismatch penalty that grows linearly with d and cannot be resolved by increasing K, producing perplexity in the millions.Outlier dominance: for scalar blocks, a fraction ~1/K of weights lies beyond the outermost Lloyd-Max decision threshold and cannot be represented by any centroid; their misrepresentation accumulates across layers, causing catastrophic quality loss. \LegoLM{} resolves both failure modes via three data-free adaptations: 1 scalar-block encoding to eliminate the $d$-linear mismatch component, 2 percentile-selective replacement that identifies and preserves outlier weights verbatim, and 3 boundary-layer protection for the first and last transformer blocks. Across GPT-2 small (124M) and Mistral-7B, \LegoLM{} achieves +0.03% PPL degradation at 4.41X compression on Mistral-7B - outperforming PTQ-8bit in both quality and compression ratio - and -0.02% at 2.67X. Downstream evaluation on LAMBADA and HellaSwag confirms that \LegoLM{} at K=64, p=99% preserves accuracy within noise at 5.12 X compression, exceeding PTQ-8bit's compression ratio while matching its accuracy. We further discover that outlier dominance grows with model scale: full replacement at K=128 degrades GPT-2 small by only +23% but catastrophically degrades Mistral-7B by +1,134,279%, while selective replacement at p=99% rescues both models to under +15%. A controlled ablation confirms that selective replacement is the dominant mechanism: adding it to per-layer K-means also yields near-lossless quality, matching \LegoLM{} within 0.02%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LegoLM，一个面向大语言模型的结构化权重共享（structured weight sharing）压缩框架。作者系统研究全局权重共享失败的原因，识别出两种失效模式：分布失配（distributional mismatch）与离群值主导（outlier dominance），并给出三种无数据自适应修复。在 GPT-2 small (124M) 与 Mistral-7B 上，LegoLM 在 4.41X 压缩时仅带来 +0.03% 困惑度退化，在质量和压缩比上均优于 PTQ-8bit。
Motivation: 全局权重共享在 LLM 压缩中会失效，但失败机制未被系统解释；作者希望定位这些失效模式并设计针对性修复，从而让基于码本（codebook）的压缩方法能在大模型上保持近无损质量。
Method: 提出三项数据无关（data-free）适配：1) 标量块编码（scalar-block encoding）消除与维度 d 线性增长的尺度失配惩罚；2) 百分位选择性替换（percentile-selective replacement）逐字保留离群权重；3) 边界层保护（boundary-layer protection）对首尾 Transformer 块不做压缩。
Result: 在 Mistral-7B 上，LegoLM 在 4.41X 压缩时 PPL 退化 +0.03%，在 2.67X 时退化 -0.02%，质量与压缩比均超过 PTQ-8bit；K=64、p=99% 时在 LAMBADA 与 HellaSwag 上保持精度，以 5.12X 压缩比超过 PTQ-8bit 并匹配其精度。离群值主导随规模加剧：K=128 全量替换仅使 GPT-2 small 退化 +23%，却使 Mistral-7B 退化约 1,134,279%；p=99% 选择性替换将两者降回 +15% 以内。消融表明选择性替换是主导机制，将其加入逐层 K-means 即可获得近无损质量，与 LegoLM 相差不超过 0.02%。
Conclusion: 作者认为选择性替换是恢复近无损质量的关键机制，且离群值主导问题随模型规模增长而加剧，因此需要显式的离群值保护策略。

papers.title: Agentic Visual Reasoning in Whole-Slide Pathology Images via Active Perception
papers.abstract_en: Whole-slide visual reasoning requires identifying sparse diagnostic evidence in gigapixel pathology slides and integrating observations across spatial scales. Existing WSI methods either compress densely sampled patches into global representations or use pretrained vision-language models with heuristic region selection, weakening links between predictions and morphology or lacking pathology-trained observation policies. We present AdaptivePath, an active-perception framework that formulates WSI evidence acquisition as sequential decision making. The Navigator learns question-agnostic abnormality-driven navigation from pathologist-reviewed labels to select observation locations and spatial extents, avoiding costly question-specific trajectory annotations. We train this policy through alternating representation learning and proximal policy optimization, followed by fine-tuning with geometric and appearance consistency objectives to stabilize focus trajectories. During inference, the Navigator hierarchically acquires sparse observations from low to high magnification under a limited ROI budget. A Morphology Interpreter converts observations into question-conditioned evidence, while the Deliberator evaluates evidence and revises intermediate answers across magnifications. The Arbiter integrates deliberation history to produce final answers. AdaptivePath achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on WSI and region pathology VQA benchmarks and reaches 80.14% accuracy for cancer subtype classification across six TCGA cohorts. In a blinded diagnostic-utility study, pathologists using AdaptivePath-selected observation sequences achieve 82.9% accuracy. These results demonstrate that learned active perception enables effective and traceable visual reasoning over gigapixel pathology slides.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdaptivePath，一个面向全切片病理图像 (whole-slide pathology images) 的主动感知框架，将巨像素切片中的证据获取建模为序列决策问题。Navigator 通过病理学家审核的标签学习与问题无关的异常驱动导航，在有限的 ROI 预算下从低倍到高倍分层获取稀疏观察；随后 Morphology Interpreter 将观察转为问题相关的证据，Deliberator 跨倍率评估并修正中间答案，Arbiter 综合推理历史给出最终答案。摘要报告该方法在 WSI 与区域病理 VQA 基准上取得零样本 SOTA，并在六个 TCGA 队列的癌症亚型分类上达到 80.14% 准确率。
Motivation: 现有 WSI 方法要么将密集采样 Patch 压缩为全局表征，要么使用预训练视觉-语言模型配合启发式区域选择，导致预测与形态学之间缺乏强关联，或缺少病理学训练的观察策略。
Method: 将 WSI 证据获取形式化为顺序决策，提出三模块架构：Navigator 通过交替表征学习与近端策略优化 (PPO) 训练，并用几何与外观一致性目标微调以稳定聚焦轨迹；推理时在 ROI 预算内分层获取稀疏观察；Morphology Interpreter、Deliberator 与 Arbiter 分别负责证据转换、跨倍率推理修订与最终答案综合。
Result: 摘要报告在 WSI 和区域病理 VQA 基准上取得零样本最先进性能；在六个 TCGA 队列的癌症亚型分类上达到 80.14% 准确率；在盲法诊断效用研究中，使用 AdaptivePath 选择观察序列的病理学家达到 82.9% 准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要认为学习到的主动感知能够实现对吉像素病理切片的有效且可追溯的视觉推理；该方法避免了代价高昂的逐问题轨迹标注。

papers.title: Multi-Relational Knowledge Graph Enhanced Embedding for Trajectory-User Linking
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory-User Linking (TUL) aims to identify the owner of an anonymous trajectory from a set of candidate users, providing a basis for user mobility analysis and personalized location-aware services. Existing methods often learn Point of Interest (POI), temporal, and semantic features independently, make limited use of structural knowledge shared across trajectories, and compress structural and sequential information before classification. To address these issues, we propose Multi-Relational Knowledge Graph Enhanced Embedding for Trajectory-User Linking (MakeTUL), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first attempt to introduce knowledge graph representation learning into TUL. MakeTUL organizes visit-time, POI-category, and transfer-speed information as typed relations in a multi-relational mobility knowledge graph, allowing heterogeneous mobility semantics to jointly constrain the learned embeddings. The resulting POI representations are further enriched with high-order co-occurrence patterns extracted from the trajectory collection, providing structural prior knowledge for sparse and overlapping trajectories. By integrating these prior-enhanced representations with temporal, category, and transfer information, the trajectory sequence learning module captures ordered mobility patterns, while a dual-branch classification layer preserves and combines global structural evidence and sequential evidence at the decision level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MakeTUL，据作者称是首个将知识图谱表示学习引入轨迹-用户关联（Trajectory-User Linking, TUL）的工作。MakeTUL 将访问时间、POI 类别和转移速度组织为多关系移动知识图谱中的类型化关系，并用轨迹集合中的高阶共现模式增强 POI 表示，再结合时序、类别与转移信息学习轨迹序列，最后通过双分支分类层在决策层面同时保留并融合全局结构证据与序列证据。
Motivation: 现有 TUL 方法通常独立学习 POI、时间和语义特征，对跨轨迹共享的结构性知识利用有限，且在分类前压缩结构信息与序列信息，导致信息损失。
Method: 提出多关系移动知识图谱，将访问时间、POI 类别和转移速度建模为类型化关系来联合约束嵌入；利用轨迹集合的高阶共现模式增强 POI 表示；轨迹序列学习模块捕获有序移动模式；双分支分类层在决策层合并全局结构证据与序列证据。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验指标，仅提出方法设计并声称能缓解上述现有方法的局限，属于方法学贡献。
Conclusion: 作者认为在 TUL 中引入知识图谱表示学习、并以结构先验增强稀疏和重叠轨迹的表示，同时保留至决策层的结构与序列信息，是可行且有价值的方向。

summary_sections.method: 提出多关系移动知识图谱，将访问时间、POI 类别和转移速度建模为类型化关系来联合约束嵌入；利用轨迹集合的高阶共现模式增强 POI 表示；轨迹序列学习模块捕获有序移动模式；双分支分类层在决策层合并全局结构证据与序列证据。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告量化实验指标，仅提出方法设计并声称能缓解上述现有方法的局限，属于方法学贡献。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为在 TUL 中引入知识图谱表示学习、并以结构先验增强稀疏和重叠轨迹的表示，同时保留至决策层的结构与序列信息，是可行且有价值的方向。

papers.title: Path-dependent Discrete Amortized Inference
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of sampling compositional and discrete objects from a given unnormalized posterior distribution. Notably, recent studies have shown that this problem can be efficiently solved by learning a deterministic Markov Decision Process (MDP) that progressively builds each object in proportion to the posterior. In this work, however, we demonstrate that the Markovian assumption can both hamper signal propagation during training and catastrophically reduce the learned sampler's expressivity due to state aliasing. To address these issues, we propose lifting the MDP with a learnable latent dynamical system that allows the underlying policy to depend on the entire past trajectory---and not only on the current state. In view of this, we refer to the resulting method as path-dependent discrete amortized inference. Importantly, we provably extend existing learning algorithms for discrete amortized samplers to our setting. In experiments on standard benchmark problems, we also show that our approach often leads to faster learning convergence and improved state space exploration relatively to prior techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何从非归一化后验分布中采样组合式离散对象，指出现有基于马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的确定性采样器会因状态混叠（state aliasing）而损害训练中的信号传播并降低表达能力。作者提出用可学习的隐动力系统来提升 MDP，使策略依赖完整历史轨迹，称为路径依赖的离散摊销推断（path-dependent discrete amortized inference）。实验表明该做法常能加快学习收敛并改善状态空间探索。
Motivation: 现有方法将离散对象生成建模为确定性 MDP，逐步按后验比例构建对象，但马尔可夫假设会阻碍训练时的信号传播，并因状态混叠而严重降低学习采样器的表达能力。
Method: 将 MDP 提升为一个带有可学习隐动力系统的模型，使底层策略不仅依赖当前状态，还依赖整个过去的采样轨迹；同时作者从理论上证明现有离散摊销采样器的学习算法可以推广到该设置。
Result: 在标准基准问题上的实验表明，相对既有方法，本方法通常能带来更快的训练收敛和更好的状态空间探索。
Conclusion: 本文强调移除马尔可夫限制、引入路径依赖可以提升离散摊销推断的训练效率与表达能力，并给出了相应学习算法的可证明推广。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Exact Rank-Space KL Projection for Shared-Marginal Low-Rank Factors: Application to Doubly Stochastic Clustering
papers.abstract_en: We study exact Kullback--Leibler (KL) projection for low-rank factorizations whose two nonnegative factors have prescribed row marginals and a shared, learned column marginal. For arbitrary positive row marginals of equal total mass, the joint KL projection reduces exactly to a strictly convex gauge-fixed dual with only $r-1$ effective variables; its Hessian is a sum of categorical covariance terms and admits $O((n+m)r)$ matrix-free Hessian--vector products. The projection theorem is objective-independent. We then specialize this geometry to doubly stochastic (DS) graph learning through $W=U\operatorname{Diag}(g)^{-1}V^\top$, where row-simplex factors with a common column mass induce an exactly DS graph without materializing an $n\times n$ optimization variable. Combined with observed-edge sparse fitting, a stochastic anchor-reduced manifold regularizer, and Bregman backtracking, the resulting mirror-descent method preserves exact feasibility at every accepted step. Under a nonvanishing latent-mass condition, it satisfies sufficient decrease and an $O(1/N)$ mirror-stationarity bound, while strictly positive accumulation points are KKT stationary. Matched clustering experiments show competitive accuracy, feasibility residuals near numerical precision, and favorable anytime behavior without a dense learned graph.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究具有指定行边际和共享学习列边际的低秩非负因子分解上的精确 KL 投影。作者证明联合 KL 投影可严格等价于一个只有 r-1 个有效变量的凸对偶问题，其 Hessian 是类别协方差项之和，且支持 O((n+m)r) 的矩阵自由 Hessian-向量乘积。随后将该几何用于双随机 (doubly stochastic, DS) 图学习，提出保持精确可行性的镜像下降方法，并给出收敛性与 KKT 驻点保证；匹配聚类实验显示精度有竞争力、可行性残差接近数值精度。
Motivation: 现有双随机图学习通常需要显式维护 n×n 的优化变量，计算与存储代价高；本文希望利用低秩因子分解和共享边际结构，在不物化稠密图变量的前提下直接得到精确双随机图。
Method: 将共享边际低秩因子的 KL 投影化简为 gauge-fixed 严格凸对偶，仅含 r-1 个有效变量；再以 W=U Diag(g)^{-1} V^T 参数化双随机图，结合观察边稀疏拟合、随机锚点约简流形正则化 (stochastic anchor-reduced manifold regularizer) 与 Bregman backtracking，构造每一步都保持精确可行性的镜像下降算法。
Result: 在非消失潜在质量条件下，算法满足充分下降性质与 O(1/N) 镜像驻点界，且严格正的累积点是 KKT 驻点。匹配聚类实验表明准确率有竞争力，可行性残差接近数值精度，并在不依赖稠密学习图的情况下具有较好的 anytime 行为。
Conclusion: 作者强调该投影定理与目标函数无关，可作为通用工具；将其用于双随机图学习可避免显式 n×n 变量，并在每个接受步保持精确可行性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SkillReason: Reasoning-Enhanced Agent Skill Retrieval for Implicit User Requests
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly rely on reusable skills to extend their capabilities beyond parametric knowl- edge. However, retrieving the appropriate skill from a large- scale library remains challenging because realistic user re- quests are often concise and underspecified, stating only the task goal while leaving the required capabilities and execu- tion steps implicit. Existing benchmarks provide limited cov- erage of such requests. To address this gap, we introduce SkillReason-Bench, a large-scale cross-domain benchmark containing 3,729 queries and a retrieval corpus of 61,228 skills spanning nine domains. We further propose SkillRea- son, a two-stage framework that uses chain-of-thought rea- soning as training-time supervision for skill retrieval. In Stage I, capability reasoning traces generated by a stronger teacher provide explicit supervision through contrastive learning, re- trieval distribution alignment, and language modeling, en- couraging the retriever to internalize capability reasoning in its query representation. In Stage II, a retrieval-guided GRPO objective encourages the model to explore reasoning trajecto- ries better suited to its own capabilities and more effective for retrieval. At inference, SkillReason directly encodes the orig- inal query without autoregressive CoT generation, preserv- ing efficient query-only retrieval. Extensive experiments on SkillReason-Bench, SkillRet, and SRA-Bench show that Skill- Reason achieves state-of-the-art performance across all three benchmarks, demonstrating that reasoning-enhanced training better bridges the semantic gap between high-level task goals and skill capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型智能体从大规模技能库中检索合适技能的问题，指出真实用户请求往往简短且未明确所需能力与执行步骤。作者提出 SkillReason-Bench 基准（3,729 条查询、61,228 个技能、覆盖九个领域）以及 SkillReason 两阶段训练框架，用思维链推理作为训练时监督。推理阶段直接编码原始查询而不生成 CoT，在 SkillReason-Bench、SkillRet 和 SRA-Bench 上取得当前最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有技能检索基准对隐含能力与步骤的用户请求覆盖不足，而这类请求在实际场景中很常见，导致检索器难以弥合高层任务目标与技能能力之间的语义鸿沟。
Method: 提出两阶段框架 SkillReason：阶段一用强教师生成的能力推理痕迹作为显式监督，通过对比学习、检索分布对齐和语言建模让检索器在查询表示中内化能力推理；阶段二采用检索引导的 GRPO 目标，激励模型探索更适合自身能力且更利于检索的推理轨迹。推理时仅编码原始查询，避免自回归 CoT 生成以保持效率。
Result: 在 SkillReason-Bench、SkillRet 和 SRA-Bench 三个基准上均取得当前最佳（state-of-the-art）性能，验证推理增强训练对检索的有效性。摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要认为推理增强的训练能更好地弥合高层任务目标与技能能力之间的语义差距，同时保持推理时的高效查询检索。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Smart Compaction: Predicting Compaction Utility from Lakehouse Table Metadata
papers.abstract_en: Open lakehouse table formats accumulate small data files over time, which degrades query performance. Deciding when compaction is worthwhile remains threshold-driven, but which metadata features actually determine compaction utility is not well understood. We present an open simulation framework that generates 2,376 Apache Iceberg tables spanning three orders of magnitude in file size, extracts 17 metadata features from manifest files without reading data, and trains XGBoost to predict the continuous file-reduction ratio (R2 = 0.998, RMSE= 0.013). The binary compaction decision turns out to be trivially separable by a single partition-level threshold max_files_per_partition> 4, requiring no learned model. Cross-schema validation on 96 TPC-H tables confirms generalisation without retraining (R2 = 0.976). A query benchmark reveals that compaction benefits metadata-heavy queries but can slow full-scan aggregations by reducing task parallelism. All code and data are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究湖仓表格式（lakehouse table format）中小文件累积导致的查询性能退化问题，并提出基于元数据预测压缩效用（compaction utility）的方案。作者构建了一个开源模拟框架，生成 2,376 张 Apache Iceberg 表，从 manifest 文件中提取 17 个元数据特征（无需读取数据），用 XGBoost 预测连续的文件缩减比（file-reduction ratio），取得 R2=0.998、RMSE=0.013。二值压缩决策被发现可由单一分区级阈值 max_files_per_partition>4 平凡分离，无需学习模型；在 96 张 TPC-H 表上的跨 schema 验证取得 R2=0.976。查询基准显示压缩有利于元数据密集型查询，但可能因降低任务并行度而拖慢全表扫描聚合。
Motivation: 现有压缩时机的决策主要依赖阈值驱动，但哪些元数据特征真正决定压缩效用尚未被充分理解，需要更系统的方法来预测压缩收益。
Method: 提出一个开放模拟框架：生成跨三个数量级文件大小的 Apache Iceberg 表，从 manifest 文件中抽取 17 个元数据特征，并训练 XGBoost 回归模型预测连续的文件缩减比；同时对比二值压缩决策与简单阈值规则。
Result: XGBoost 在文件缩减比预测上达到 R2=0.998、RMSE=0.013；二值决策可由单阈值 max_files_per_partition>4 平凡解决；跨 schema 在 96 张 TPC-H 表上无需重训练即达 R2=0.976；查询基准中压缩提升元数据密集型查询但降低全表扫描聚合的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要表明仅凭元数据即可高精度预测压缩效用，且对二值压缩决策而言简单分区阈值已足够；同时强调压缩可能对全表扫描聚合产生负面性能影响，代码与数据已公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CuteTTS: Efficient and High-Quality Speech Synthesis via Autoregressive Modeling of Continuous Latents
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) now supports interactive assistants, personalized media, and accessibility tools. All TTS systems require faithful linguistic rendering, consistent speaker identity, and low-latency response. Yet compact streaming systems must preserve sufficient acoustic detail in a predictable low-rate latent sequence, while iterative diffusion sampling and classifier-free guidance multiply inference cost at every autoregressive step. To strike a balance between high-fidelity synthesis and low-latency inference, we present CuteTTS, a compact continuous-autoregressive TTS system. It combines semantically aligned causal VAE latents with patch-level autoregression, explicit speaker conditioning, and a bidirectional flow-matching head. We further introduce guidance-step distillation, which absorbs classifier-free guidance and multiple solver steps into a single interval-conditioned student. Evaluations on LibriSpeech and Seed-TTS-Eval demonstrate competitive intelligibility and speaker similarity in zero-shot voice cloning, while distillation lowers first-audio latency by 23.3% and real-time factor by 40.8% relative to the base model with comparable objective and subjective quality. These results provide a practical path toward continuous-autoregressive TTS that reconciles high-fidelity generation with the latency demands of real-time interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CuteTTS，一个紧凑的连续自回归 (continuous-autoregressive) 语音合成系统，结合语义对齐的因果 VAE 潜变量、patch 级自回归、显式说话人条件以及双向 flow-matching 解码头，并引入 guidance-step distillation 将 classifier-free guidance 和多步求解器折叠进单次区间条件学生模型中。在 LibriSpeech 和 Seed-TTS-Eval 上的评估显示，零样本声音克隆的 intelligibility 与 speaker similarity 具有竞争力，而蒸馏相比基座模型将首音频延迟降低 23.3%、实时率 (real-time factor) 降低 40.8%。

Method: 提出紧凑的连续自回归 TTS 架构，采用语义对齐的因果 VAE 潜变量与 patch 级自回归建模，加入显式说话人条件和一个双向 flow-matching 头；另提出 guidance-step distillation，用区间条件学生模型吸收 classifier-free guidance 和多个 solver steps，从而减少推理开销。
Result: 在 LibriSpeech 和 Seed-TTS-Eval 上取得有竞争力的 intelligibility 和 speaker similarity；与基座模型相比，蒸馏后首音频延迟降低 23.3%，real-time factor 降低 40.8%，同时客观与主观质量相当。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为连续自回归 TTS 提供了一条实用路径，能够在高保真生成与实时交互的延迟需求之间取得折中。

papers.title: Enhancing Scientific Named Entity Recognition via Large Language Models: A Type-driven Multi-task Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: Scientific named entity recognition (SciNER) plays a crucial role in information extraction and knowledge discovery from scientific texts. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated the capacity to achieve competitive SciNER performance with minimal human effort. Existing research highlights the importance of incorporating candidate entity type information for accurate entity recognition and classification by LLMs. However, when too many candidate entity types are provided in the prompt, LLMs struggle to accurately recognize and label entities in scientific texts, where entity types are more complex than in general domains. To address this challenge, we propose TdSciNER, a type-driven approach that effectively leverages entity type information to enhance SciNER performance. In TdSciNER, we first design an entity type filter model to identify the most likely entity types present in a given sentence. Subsequently, we introduce an auxiliary multi-class entity typing task within a multi-task learning framework alongside SciNER to obtain richer contextual representations. Then, we develop a novel demonstration selection strategy based on sentence similarity and entity type diversity to activate the in-context learning capabilities of LLMs, thereby improving entity recognition accuracy across diverse scientific domains. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that our method achieves performance comparable to fully supervised models. Further analysis validates that each entity type-driven component in TdSciNER contributes to the improvement of SciNER performance. This work provides valuable insights for future advancements in SciNER and broader information extraction tasks in scientific text mining.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TdSciNER，一种面向科学文本命名实体识别 (SciNER) 的类型驱动方法，利用大语言模型 (LLM) 提升实体识别与分类性能。方法包括实体类型过滤模型、多任务学习中的辅助实体类型分类任务，以及基于句子相似度和实体类型多样性的演示选择策略。在三个数据集上的实验表明，该方法可达到与全监督模型相当的性能，并验证了各类型驱动组件的贡献。
Motivation: 现有研究表明向 LLM 提供候选实体类型信息有助于 SciNER，但当提示中候选实体类型过多时，LLM 在实体类型更复杂的科学文本中难以准确识别和标注实体。
Method: TdSciNER 首先训练实体类型过滤模型筛选句子中最可能出现的实体类型；随后在包含 SciNER 的多任务学习框架中引入辅助的多类别实体类型分类任务，以获得更丰富的上下文表示；最后设计基于句子相似度和实体类型多样性的演示选择策略，激活 LLM 的上下文学习能力。
Result: 在三个数据集上的实验显示该方法取得了与全监督模型相当的性能；进一步分析验证了每个实体类型驱动组件都对 SciNER 性能提升有贡献。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为 SciNER 及更广泛的科学文本挖掘信息抽取任务提供了有价值的见解。

papers.title: Can Open-Weight Models Compete on Financial Text Comprehension?
papers.abstract_en: Open-weight language models from Chinese AI labs caught up on benchmarks relative to proprietary frontier models in recent months. Yet their reliability on real-world financial tasks remains largely untested. We updated the Financial Touchstone benchmark, which now has 2,967 question context-answer triplets across 495 international annual reports. We also apply a new set of models on the benchmark, expanding coverage from eleven to twenty models across ten providers, including recent open-weight models such as GLM 4.7, GLM 5, Kimi K2.6, and DeepSeek V3.2, as well as Alibaba's proprietary flagship Qwen3-Max. Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 achieves the highest accuracy (88.4%), while Google's Gemini 2.5 Pro maintains the lowest hallucination rate (0.08%). Notably, the open-weight Kimi K2.6 ranks third in accuracy, and the non-reasoning models GLM 5 and Mistral 3 rank fourth and fifth, challenging the assumption that reasoning architectures or proprietary weights are a prerequisite for strong financial comprehension. Information retrieval remains the primary bottleneck, accounting for 48.9% of all failures. We also document a new finding: geopolitical content filters in Chinese models refuse legitimate financial questions (0.08% of attempts), sometimes without clear reason, and the refusal behavior depends on the access route as much as on the model. The complete dataset and evaluation framework are publicly available.
papers.comment: To be presented at the workshop International Symposium on Large Language Models for Financial Services (FinLLM@IJCAI2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文更新了 Financial Touchstone 基准，现包含 495 份国际年报中的 2,967 个问答三元组，并将模型覆盖从 11 个扩展到 10 家提供商的 20 个模型，特别纳入 GLM 4.7、GLM 5、Kimi K2.6、DeepSeek V3.2 等开放权重模型以及阿里闭源旗舰 Qwen3-Max。结果显示 Claude Opus 4.6 准确率最高（88.4%），Gemini 2.5 Pro 幻觉率最低（0.08%），而开放权重模型 Kimi K2.6 准确率排名第三，非推理模型 GLM 5 和 Mistral 3 分列第四和第五。信息检索仍是主要瓶颈，占全部失败的 48.9%。论文还发现中国模型的地理政治内容过滤器会拒绝合法金融问题（占 0.08% 的尝试），且拒绝行为与访问途径的关系不亚于模型本身。
Motivation: 开放权重模型在近期基准上已接近专有前沿模型，但其在真实金融任务上的可靠性缺乏系统验证，现有基准的覆盖范围和模型数量也不足。
Method: 更新 Financial Touchstone 基准，扩展数据集规模并纳入 20 个模型，对金融文本理解进行系统评估，同时分析失败类型和内容过滤行为。
Result: Claude Opus 4.6 取得最高准确率 88.4%，Gemini 2.5 Pro 幻觉率最低（0.08%）；开放权重模型 Kimi K2.6 排名第三，非推理模型 GLM 5 和 Mistral 3 分列第四、第五；信息检索失败占 48.9%，并记录了内容过滤器拒绝合法问题的现象。
Conclusion: 开放权重模型和非推理架构也能在金融文本理解上取得强竞争力，推理架构或专有权重并非必要条件；信息检索是主要瓶颈，且内容过滤行为受访问途径影响。

papers.title: A QUBO-Inspired Computational Framework for Airport Landside Bottleneck Diagnosis and Dynamic Dispatch Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Airport landside traffic centers connect terminal arrivals with taxis, ride-hailing vehicles, private cars, buses, metro services, parking facilities, and terminal-area roadways. Peak arrivals can create coupled congestion across passenger queues, vehicle queues, pickup berths, storage areas, and access roads. This study proposes a QUBO-inspired computational framework for bottleneck diagnosis and dynamic dispatch in this setting. Shanghai Pudong International Airport and Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport serve as case airports. A five-minute state model links passenger arrivals, vehicle supply, pickup berth service, vehicle storage, and road capacity. Bottleneck diagnosis uses service intensity, road demand saturation, bottleneck frequency, queue severity, shadow-price leverage, and a composite congestion severity index. Two dispatch schemes are tested under consistent demand inputs: finite-action model predictive control and quadratic-unconstrained-binary-optimization-inspired simulated annealing. In the strong-peak baseline scenario, the QUBO-inspired method reduces the final passenger queue from 3445 to 2477 passengers at Shanghai Pudong and from 2053 to 1482 passengers at Hangzhou Xiaoshan. Case results indicate different dominant bottlenecks. Shanghai Pudong is more affected by road saturation, whereas Hangzhou Xiaoshan is more affected by pickup berth service. Robustness tests under demand, supply, service, road-capacity, modal-share, and random-noise perturbations show retained queue-reduction benefits under the tested uncertainty levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种受 QUBO（二次无约束二值优化）启发的计算框架，用于机场陆侧交通瓶颈诊断与动态调度优化，并以上海浦东和杭州萧山机场为案例。框架采用五分钟状态模型联结旅客到达、车辆供给、上客泊位服务、车辆存储与道路容量；瓶颈诊断使用服务强度、道路需求饱和度、瓶颈频率、队列严重度、影子价格杠杆和综合拥堵严重度指数。在强高峰基准场景下，QUBO 启发方法将浦东机场最终旅客队列从 3445 人降至 2477 人，萧山机场从 2053 人降至 1482 人。
Motivation: 机场陆侧交通中心在高峰到达时段会出现旅客队列、车辆队列、上客泊位、停车区与进场道路之间的耦合拥堵，现有方法难以同时对瓶颈进行诊断并实现动态调度。
Method: 提出 QUBO 启发的计算框架，包括五分钟状态模型、多指标瓶颈诊断体系，以及两种调度方案：有限动作模型预测控制（finite-action model predictive control）和 QUBO 启发模拟退火（QUBO-inspired simulated annealing）。
Result: 在强高峰基准场景下，QUBO 启发方法将浦东机场最终旅客队列从 3445 人降至 2477 人，萧山机场从 2053 人降至 1482 人；案例显示两机场主导瓶颈不同，浦东更受道路饱和影响，萧山更受上客泊位服务影响。稳健性测试表明，在需求、供给、服务、道路容量、出行方式份额及随机噪声扰动下，队列缩减收益在测试的不确定性水平下得以保持。
Conclusion: 摘要强调不同机场的陆侧瓶颈类型存在差异，QUBO 启发调度方案在多种不确定性扰动下仍能保留队列缩减收益。

papers.title: Trajectory Design and Budgeted Querying for Digital Twin Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Digital-twin calibration requires interaction data that is expensive to collect. We study two acquisition decisions: which trajectories to generate, and when to spend a limited budget on privileged parameter measurements. Our framework couples an excitation-oriented reinforcement learning controller, a recurrent parameter estimator with predictive uncertainty, and a budgeted query policy. In Pendulum, a Random Forest diagnostic recovers gravity only weakly from task-oriented trajectories and does not recover mass or length, while a GRU trained on excitation-oriented trajectories reaches a mean absolute error of 0.0066 with no queries. We then withdraw continuous oracle access partway through an episode, so that the twin must run on the estimator's output for the remainder. The estimator-plus-policy pipeline achieves a terminal error of 0.0092 under a three-query budget, against 0.2031 for an uncalibrated twin. In partially observable Waterworld, five controllers produce different observed error profiles across three hidden parameters, and an estimator trained on a five-controller mixture reaches online normalized errors of roughly 4-5%. These exploratory case studies are not controlled ablations, but they motivate treating trajectory design and query allocation as explicit design variables in data-scarce calibration.
papers.comment: Accepted at the CDEL 2026 workshop at ECCV 2026 (non-archival)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究数字孪生标定中两类采集决策：生成哪些轨迹，以及何时在有限预算下进行特权参数测量。框架耦合激励导向的强化学习控制器、带预测不确定性的循环参数估计器与预算化查询策略。在 Pendulum 上，GRU 在激励导向轨迹上无查询即达到 0.0066 的 MAE；在部分可观测 Waterworld 中，混合五控制器轨迹的估计器达到约 4-5% 的在线归一化误差。
Motivation: 数字孪生标定需要昂贵的交互数据，现有方法很少将轨迹生成与参数测量预算分配作为显式设计变量，导致数据稀缺场景下标定效果受限。
Method: 提出一个耦合框架：激励导向(excitation-oriented)的强化学习控制器生成轨迹，带预测不确定性的循环参数估计器(GRU)进行参数推断，并由预算化查询策略决定何时花费有限预算进行特权参数测量。实验中在 episode 中途撤掉连续 oracle 访问，使孪生体在剩余部分依赖估计器输出运行。
Result: 在 Pendulum 中，Random Forest 从任务导向轨迹仅能弱恢复重力且无法恢复质量或长度，而 GRU 在激励导向轨迹上无查询达到 MAE 0.0066；在三查询预算下估计器加策略管线实现终端误差 0.0092，而未标定孪生体为 0.2031。在部分可观察 Waterworld 中，五控制器产生不同观测误差剖面，混合五控制器训练出的估计器达到约 4-5% 的在线归一化误差。
Conclusion: 作者强调这些是探索性案例研究而非受控消融，但结果表明在数据稀缺标定中应当把轨迹设计和查询分配视为显式设计变量。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究数字孪生标定中两类采集决策：生成哪些轨迹，以及何时在有限预算下进行特权参数测量。框架耦合激励导向的强化学习控制器、带预测不确定性的循环参数估计器与预算化查询策略。在 Pendulum 上，GRU 在激励导向轨迹上无查询即达到 0.0066 的 MAE；在部分可观测 Waterworld 中，混合五控制器轨迹的估计器达到约 4-5% 的在线归一化误差。
summary_sections.motivation: 数字孪生标定需要昂贵的交互数据，现有方法很少将轨迹生成与参数测量预算分配作为显式设计变量，导致数据稀缺场景下标定效果受限。
summary_sections.method: 提出一个耦合框架：激励导向(excitation-oriented)的强化学习控制器生成轨迹，带预测不确定性的循环参数估计器(GRU)进行参数推断，并由预算化查询策略决定何时花费有限预算进行特权参数测量。实验中在 episode 中途撤掉连续 oracle 访问，使孪生体在剩余部分依赖估计器输出运行。

papers.title: VLZip: Unified Visual and Textual Compression for Interleaved Long-Context Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) face significant challenges with ultra-long, interleaved image-text sequences due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Current solutions either resort to aggressive token pruning, risking irreversible information loss, or adopt efficient but less precise architectures, while largely ignoring the equally vital textual component. We introduce VLZip, a framework that unifies visual and textual compression for high-fidelity reasoning within a pure Transformer. At its core, VLZip hierarchically distills visual and textual segments into compact, layer-specific "soft prefixes" and injects them into each decoder layer's hidden states, drastically shortening the attention sequence while preserving fine-grained global context. To address deficient evaluations in the field, we also introduce LongVLBench, a new benchmark derived from video narratives that demands holistic, narrative-level reasoning. Extensive experiments show VLZip achieves leading performance on long-context multimodal reasoning, enabling training up to 120K tokens, a 6x increase over the baseline, and inference beyond 280K tokens with significantly reduced memory, while demonstrating the memory scalability to handle up to 2M tokens. By excelling at extreme context lengths where existing methods collapse, VLZip establishes an efficient and powerful new standard for long-context multimodal AI. Code is available at https://github.com/ShareLab-SII/VLZip.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLZip 是一个面向超长交错图像-文本序列的视觉语言模型压缩框架，在纯 Transformer 内将视觉和文本片段层级蒸馏为逐层软前缀 (soft prefix) 注入解码器隐藏状态，以缩短注意力序列并保留全局上下文。作者同时提出基于视频叙事的长上下文多模态评测基准 LongVLBench。实验显示 VLZip 支持 120K token 训练（较基线提升 6 倍）、280K token 以上推理，并具有扩展到 2M token 的记忆可扩展性。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 处理超长交错图文序列时受限于自注意力的二次复杂度，已有方案要么激进剪枝导致不可逆信息损失，要么采用高效但不精确的架构，且普遍忽视文本部分的同等重要性。
Method: 提出 VLZip 统一压缩框架，将视觉与文本片段分层蒸馏为每一解码器层特有的紧凑软前缀，并注入各层隐藏状态，从而在保留细粒度全局上下文的同时大幅缩短注意力序列；同时构建从视频叙事中导出的长上下文多模态推理基准 LongVLBench。
Result: 实验表明 VLZip 在长上下文多模态推理上达到领先性能，支持训练达 120K tokens（为基线的 6 倍），推理超过 280K tokens 且内存显著降低，并展示可扩展到 2M tokens 的记忆可扩展性；在现有方法失效的极端上下文长度下表现出色。
Conclusion: VLZip 通过统一视觉与文本压缩，在纯 Transformer 中实现了高效且高保真的长上下文多模态建模，作者称其为长上下文多模态 AI 的新标准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UniMoMo: Expert Merging-Based MoE Acceleration for Large Recommendation Models
papers.abstract_en: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers expand recommendation capacity through conditional computation, yet a trained checkpoint still stores and routes over its full expert bank. We study a deployment problem: convert that checkpoint to a smaller standard MoE under an explicit expert budget, without adding a compression-specific online module. To address this, we introduce UniMoMo, a post-training compression framework formulated as a constrained graph coarsening problem. Rather than relying on parameter distance, UniMoMo groups experts based on their functional similarity, using an unlabeled calibration set to measure how similarly experts respond to shared recommendation states. To prevent performance degradation, we introduce a layer-adaptive protection mechanism that restricts the merging of high-traffic experts based on their routing exposure. Across Amazon Beauty, KuaiRec, and TenRec with 2, 4, and 6 MoE blocks, the final four-expert checkpoints obtain source-relative five-run mean NDCG@10 ratios of 99.92%--102.30% and measured A100 speedups of 1.28$\times$--1.63$\times$. An aggressive two-expert, top-1 operating point obtains ratios of 98.36%--104.24% and speedups of 1.47$\times$--2.21$\times$. These endpoint results evaluate the complete conversion-and-adaptation workflow and show that a trained recommendation MoE can be exported at multiple serving budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniMoMo，一种面向大模型推荐系统中稀疏 MoE（mixture-of-experts）层的部署期压缩框架。它将训练好的 MoE checkpoint 在显式专家预算下转换为更小的标准 MoE，且不引入压缩专用的在线模块；问题被形式化为带约束的图粗化（graph coarsening）。在 Amazon Beauty、KuaiRec 和 TenRec 上，最终四专家 checkpoint 相对于源的 NDCG@10 比值为 99.92%--102.30%，A100 加速为 1.28--1.63 倍；更激进的二专家 top-1 配置得到 98.36%--104.24% 比值和 1.47--2.21 倍加速。
Motivation: 训练好的稀疏 MoE 层虽然通过条件计算扩展了推荐容量，但其 checkpoint 仍存储并对全部专家进行路由，带来部署负担。作者针对的痛点是：在给定专家预算下将训练好的 MoE 转换为更小的标准 MoE，同时不引入压缩专用的在线模块。
Method: UniMoMo 将专家合并建模为带约束的图粗化问题，不依赖参数距离，而是使用无标注校准集度量专家对共享推荐状态响应的功能相似性来分组。为防止性能退化，引入层自适应保护机制，根据路由暴露程度（routing exposure）限制高流量专家的合并。
Result: 在 Amazon Beauty、KuaiRec、TenRec 以及 2、4、6 个 MoE 模块的设置下，最终四专家 checkpoint 取得源相对的 5 次运行平均 NDCG@10 比值为 99.92%--102.30%，实测 A100 加速 1.28--1.63 倍；两专家 top-1 配置达到 98.36%--104.24% 比值和 1.47--2.21 倍加速。
Conclusion: 这些端到端结果评估了完整的转换与适配工作流，表明训练好的推荐 MoE 可以在多个服务预算下导出。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Domain-Aware Pruning: Sparsity and Domain Generalization via Regularized Probabilistic Masking
papers.abstract_en: Domain generalization (DG) and neural network pruning are conventionally treated as distinct objectives, targeting out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness and model efficiency, respectively. In this work, we bridge this gap by introducing Domain-Aware Pruning (DAP), a framework that leverages network sparsity as a mechanism to implicitly enhance generalization to unseen domains. Diverging from standard binary mask optimization, DAP learns a continuous parameter retention probability $p \in [0, 1]$, framing network compression as a continuous probabilistic masking problem. By introducing a regularization objective that actively penalizes the retention of domain-sensitive weights during the mask training, DAP identifies a domain-invariant subnetwork. Empirical results across five DG benchmark datasets demonstrate that DAP achieves significant sparsity while consistently matching or exceeding the OOD performance of its dense counterparts. Crucially, DAP is an algorithm-agnostic framework that integrates seamlessly with existing DG pipelines without necessitating post-hoc fine-tuning. Beyond efficiency and generalization, we show that DAP natively provides increased robustness to adversarial perturbations and yields highly interpretable models, where the retained weights reliably encapsulate the most domain-invariant and task-critical representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Domain-Aware Pruning (DAP)，将网络剪枝与域泛化统一到同一框架中。与标准二值掩码优化不同，DAP 学习连续参数保留概率 p∈[0,1]，把压缩视为连续概率掩码问题，并通过正则项惩罚保留域敏感权重，从而识别域不变子网络。在五个域泛化 (DG) 基准数据集上，DAP 实现显著稀疏度，同时 OOD 性能一致匹配或超过稠密模型，且无需事后微调，并额外带来对抗鲁棒性和可解释性收益。
Motivation: 域泛化和神经网络剪枝通常被视为两个不同目标，分别针对 OOD 鲁棒性和模型效率。论文希望弥合这一差距，利用网络稀疏性作为隐式机制增强对未见域的泛化能力。
Method: DAP 将网络压缩建模为连续概率掩码问题，学习每个参数被保留的概率；在掩码训练中加入正则化目标，主动惩罚域敏感权重的保留，从而得到域不变子网络。该框架与具体 DG 算法无关，可直接集成到现有 DG 流程，且不需要事后微调。
Result: 在五个 DG 基准数据集上，DAP 在达到显著稀疏度的同时，OOD 性能一致匹配或超过其稠密对应模型。此外，DAP 原生提供更强的对抗扰动鲁棒性，并得到高度可解释的模型，保留权重可靠地对应最域不变且任务关键的表示。
Conclusion: 作者强调 DAP 是一个算法无关的框架，能与现有 DG 管线无缝集成且无需事后微调，在效率之外同时带来泛化、鲁棒性和可解释性方面的收益。

papers.title: MedCalc-R1: Knowledge-Guided Reward Framework for Medical Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: In Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) frameworks for mathematical reasoning tasks, floating-point results are typically evaluated using a tolerance-based reward. However, this strategy suffers from challenges such as difficulty in threshold calibration, unstable training dynamics, and limited accuracy, especially in clinical scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose a knowledge-guided hybrid reward framework (\textsc{MedCalc-R1}). Specifically, we introduce a knowledge verification reward mechanism that enforces explicit generation of computational formulas, which are further validated by an external verifier to enhance interpretability and reasoning reliability. Furthermore, we design a hybrid soft-hard reward scheme combining a hard constraint based on clinical safety thresholds with a soft, precision-sensitive reward that progressively guides learning within the acceptable range. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines in both reasoning accuracy and generalization capability, validating the effectiveness and applicability in safety-critical domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedCalc-R1，一个面向医学数学推理的知识引导混合奖励框架。针对 RLVR 中基于容差的浮点奖励在临床场景下的阈值标定困难、训练不稳定和精度有限等问题，引入知识验证奖励机制，强制生成计算式并由外部验证器校验，同时设计软硬混合奖励（临床安全阈值的硬约束与精度敏感的软奖励）。摘要称方法在推理准确率和泛化能力上显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: RLVR 在数学推理任务中常用基于容差的浮点奖励，但存在阈值标定困难、训练动态不稳定、精度有限等问题，在临床场景中尤为突出。
Method: 提出知识引导的混合奖励框架：一是知识验证奖励机制，强制模型显式生成计算公式并由外部验证器验证，以增强可解释性和推理可靠性；二是设计软硬混合奖励方案，结合基于临床安全阈值的硬约束与精度敏感的软奖励，在可接受范围内渐进引导学习。
Result: 实验结果表明，该方法在推理准确率和泛化能力上显著优于现有基线，并验证了其在安全关键领域的有效性和适用性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架能够提升安全关键场景下医学数学推理的准确性与泛化能力，但摘要未涉及局限性讨论。

papers.title: VADER: Adaptive Debiasing for Hallucination Mitigation in Video Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in open-ended video understanding, yet they remain prone to fluent responses unsupported by video evidence. Existing training-free methods typically apply a globally fixed visual intervention or construct a contrastive branch through input perturbation. The former cannot accommodate video-dependent fusion paths, while the latter can be compensated by cross-frame redundancy. We therefore propose Video-Adaptive Debiasing via Evidence Reweighting (VADER), a training-free framework with two complementary modules. Visual Focus Reallocation (VFR) automatically instantiates an intervention policy for each video-question input: it diagnoses layer-wise visual-to-text evidence flow, determines where to intervene, and derives how strongly to reallocate pre-softmax attention from system-token to video-token blocks. Selective Evidence Erasure (SEE) independently masks high-importance visual tokens in every frame, constructing a prior-biased branch that is difficult to compensate through neighboring frames. Contrastive decoding then down-weights predictions that remain confident after selective evidence erasure. Across multiple VideoLLMs, VADER yields substantial improvements on event-level grounding and temporal consistency; on LLaVA-Video-7B, it reaches 72.60% accuracy on EventHallusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Video-Adaptive Debiasing via Evidence Reweighting (VADER)，一个无需训练的框架，用于缓解视频大语言模型 (VideoLLM) 中的幻觉问题。VADER 包含两个互补模块：Visual Focus Reallocation (VFR) 按视频-问题输入动态决定干预位置与强度，Selective Evidence Erasure (SEE) 在每帧掩蔽高重要性视觉 token 以构造难以补偿的先验偏向分支，再通过对比解码 (contrastive decoding) 降低仍自信输出的权重。在多个 VideoLLM 上，该方法显著提升事件级 grounding 与时间一致性，在 LLaVA-Video-7B 上于 EventHallusion 基准达到 72.60% 准确率。
Motivation: 现有训练-free 幻觉缓解方法要么使用全局固定的视觉干预，无法适应视频依赖的融合路径，要么通过输入扰动构造对比分支，但跨帧冗余会补偿扰动效果。本文针对这两个缺陷提出视频自适应的去偏方案。
Method: VADER 由两个模块组成：VFR 对每个视频-问题输入诊断逐层视觉-文本证据流，确定干预位置并计算如何将 pre-softmax 注意力从系统 token 重新分配到视频 token；SEE 逐帧掩蔽高重要性视觉 token，构造难以被相邻帧补偿的先验偏向分支，并通过对比解码对证据擦除后仍保持自信的预测进行降权。
Result: 在多个 VideoLLM 上，VADER 在事件级 grounding 和时间一致性上带来显著改进；在 LLaVA-Video-7B 上于 EventHallusion 达到 72.60% 准确率。

papers.title: Business Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents in a Realistic Marketplace
papers.abstract_en: Running a business is a challenging form of intelligent work. Operators must infer opportunities from partial signals, commit capital under uncertainty, adapt to delayed outcomes in a changing market, and satisfy regulatory obligations before trading legally. Frontier LLM agents can increasingly complete complex workflows, yet business-related capabilities are rarely evaluated in existing agent benchmarks. We introduce \textbf{Business Arena}, a controlled environment where an AI agent runs a cross-border shop, buying from suppliers and selling to buyers over a long horizon. We ground the arena in real Alibaba.com sourcing data and market conditions calibrated from authoritative sources. Delayed and coupled consequences make individual business decisions difficult to judge, but their combined outcome is measurable through profit. Because profit alone cannot explain why an agent succeeds or fails, we compare agents with human-designed strategies to estimate available opportunity, use skill-level metrics to reveal underlying strengths and weaknesses, and trace realized gains and losses to the actions that produced them. We use mechanism ablations to establish that strong results reflect genuine business intelligence rather than neglect or simulator-specific shortcuts. We evaluate 15 frontier models and find a ninefold difference in mean final net worth. Even the best model falls behind human-designed strategies, indicating that business operation remains challenging for LLM agents. Skill-level analysis reveals operating styles, from margin-focused premium sellers to high-turnover wholesalers and customer-service specialists, while action-level attribution identifies the sourcing, pricing, and recovery decisions that create or destroy value. Together, Business Arena takes a first step toward a realistic and trustworthy testbed for evaluating end-to-end business agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Business Arena，一个基于真实 Alibaba.com 采购数据与权威来源校准市场条件的受控环境，用于评估 LLM 智能体在长周期跨境店铺经营中的能力。智能体需要从供应商采购并向买家销售，以净资产和利润衡量整体表现。作者评估了 15 个前沿模型，发现平均最终净资产相差九倍，且最佳模型仍落后于人类设计策略。结合技能级指标、行动级归因与机制消融，作者论证强结果反映的是真实商业智能而非模拟器捷径。
Motivation: 经营企业需要从部分信号中推断机会、在不确定下投入资本、适应延迟回报并满足监管合规，这类能力在前沿 LLM 智能体上很少被检验；现有智能体基准几乎不评估商业相关能力。
Method: 构建一个可控的跨境电商经营环境：智能体在长时间跨度内从供应商采购并向买家销售，环境基于真实 Alibaba.com 采购数据和权威来源校准的市场条件。作者用人类设计策略对比来估算可用机会，用技能级指标揭示底层优缺点，用行动级归因把盈亏追溯到具体决策，并通过机制消融排除疏忽或模拟器特有捷径。
Result: 对 15 个前沿模型的评估显示平均最终净资产存在九倍差距，即使最佳模型也落后于人类设计策略。技能级分析呈现从高毛利精品卖家、高周转批发商到客服专家的不同运营风格，行动级归因识别出采购、定价和回款恢复决策中创造或破坏价值的关键环节。
Conclusion: 作者将 Business Arena 定位为评估端到端商业智能体的第一步，强调以利润为可测结果并结合技能指标、行动归因与消融来构建现实且可信的测试平台，同时指出商业运营对 LLM 智能体仍是挑战性任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RAG-Based Auto-Configuration for Industrial Fieldbus Devices
papers.abstract_en: Industrial device commissioning requires engineers to manually extract hundreds of protocol-specific parameters from heterogeneous PDF manuals and transcribe them into supervisory control systems, a time-intensive, error-prone workflow. This paper presents SysName, a production-oriented pipeline that automates device configuration end-to-end for Modbus RTU, OPC-UA, Profibus DP, and CANopen. It builds a hybrid dense-sparse retrieval index augmented by an ontology graph derived from ECLASS, AAS, and SOSA/SSN, using a BGE-M3 encoder with a cross-encoder reranker to surface relevant manual passages. A local LLM (T=0.1) generates ontology-aligned JSON-LD configurations via protocol-specific prompts and a four-step repair pipeline. A two-stage abstention gate, combining a reranker-score threshold and an IRI resolution ratio, blocks unsafe LLM invocations and filters low-coverage configurations before SHACL validation. On a gold set of 28 field-level queries, the hybrid retriever reaches 0.96 HitRate@10, and the reranker raises MRR@10 from 0.56 to 0.63 with perfect score separation for abstention. The generator attains field-level F1=0.87 with exact match on 9 of 12 runs. End-to-end runs on an H100 GPU complete in 2.6-6.6s per device with zero unsafe writes and zero silent failures on a five-device benchmark; every unsuccessful run is flagged by abstention or deployment verification. Component-wise evaluation localises the single systematic failure to OPC-UA generation, invisible to end-to-end metrics alone. A case study commissions a physics-simulated Universal Robots UR5e robot from unmodified vendor documentation (254-page manual, 8-page register list, 496 chunks), reaching field-level F1=1.0 over three runs with read-back and joint-consistency verification. An ablation study and comparison with five industrial-LLM systems complete the analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SysName，一个面向工业现场总线设备的端到端自动配置管线，覆盖 Modbus RTU、OPC-UA、Profibus DP 和 CANopen。它从 PDF 手册中检索协议参数，通过本地 LLM（T=0.1）生成与本体对齐的 JSON-LD 配置，并用两级弃权门（abstention gate）和 SHACL 校验拦截不安全输出。摘要报告在 28 条现场级查询上混合检索器 HitRate@10 达 0.96，生成器字段级 F1=0.87，并在五设备基准上实现零不安全写入与零静默失败。
Motivation: 工业设备调试需要工程师从异构 PDF 手册中手动提取数百个协议特定参数并转录到监控系统中，该流程耗时且易出错。
Method: 构建由 ECLASS、AAS 和 SOSA/SSN 派生的本体图增强的混合稠密-稀疏检索索引，使用 BGE-M3 编码器加交叉编码器重排序 (cross-encoder reranker) 定位手册相关段落。本地 LLM 通过协议特定提示和四步修复管线生成本体对齐的 JSON-LD 配置；两级弃权门结合重排序分数阈值和 IRI 解析率，在 SHACL 校验前拦截不安全的 LLM 调用并过滤低覆盖配置。
Result: 在 28 条现场级查询的金标准上，混合检索器 HitRate@10 为 0.96，重排序器将 MRR@10 从 0.56 提升到 0.63 且弃权分数完全分离；生成器字段级 F1=0.87，12 次运行中 9 次精确匹配。端到端在 H100 GPU 上每设备耗时 2.6-6.6 秒，五设备基准上零不安全写入、零静默失败；组件级评估将唯一的系统性失败定位到 OPC-UA 生成。案例研究用未修改的厂商文档（254 页手册、8 页寄存器列表、496 个块）为通用机器人 UR5e 生成配置，三次运行均达字段级 F1=1.0。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SysName 能以可忽略的安全风险实现工业设备配置自动化，且仅靠端到端指标会掩盖 OPC-UA 生成这一系统性失效，需借助弃权门和部署验证来暴露并定位失败。

papers.title: Walking through Discussions: A Mobile Visual Analytics System for In-Situ Group Discussion Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Group discussion-based teaching is widely used to foster collaborative learning, yet teachers in physical classrooms often struggle to simultaneously monitor multiple groups and quickly diagnose a target group before intervening. Existing visual analytics tools primarily support post-hoc analysis on desktop, providing limited support for in-situ walk-around teaching. To address this gap, we present MobileGroupVis, a mobile visual analytics system for in-situ analysis of classroom group discussions. MobileGroupVis integrates multi-group monitoring, single-group diagnosis, and instructional intervention into a concise analytical workflow tailored for small-screen touch interaction. The system is powered by a lightweight streaming analysis pipeline that converts group audio into structured discussion data and further extracts interaction patterns, topic progression, and topic deviation through a dialogue analysis module. To enable both glanceable overview and traceable diagnosis, we design six coordinated views, including a compact glyph that visually encodes word count, interaction intensity, and topic deviation for efficient cross-group comparison and anomaly localization, along with detailed views for opinion evolution, interaction dynamics, topic coverage, and dialogue records. We evaluate MobileGroupVis through two case studies and expert interviews. The results provide preliminary evidence that MobileGroupVis supports teachers in understanding discussion processes, identifying groups in need of attention, and facilitating in-class intervention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MobileGroupVis，一个面向课堂小组讨论现场分析（in-situ analysis）的移动端可视化分析系统。系统将多组监控、单组诊断与教学干预整合为适合小屏幕触控交互的工作流，通过轻量级流式分析管线把小组音频转换为结构化讨论数据，并提取交互模式、话题进展与话题偏离。系统设计了六个协调视图，包含一个紧凑字形（glyph）用于跨组比较和异常定位，以及观点演化、交互动态、话题覆盖和对话记录等详细视图。作者通过两个案例研究和专家访谈提供了初步证据，表明系统能帮助教师理解讨论过程、识别需要关注的小组并支持课堂内干预。
Motivation: 基于小组讨论的教学法广泛用于协作学习，但教师在实体教室中难以同时监控多个小组，并难以在干预前快速诊断目标小组。现有可视化分析工具主要支持桌面端的事后分析（post-hoc analysis），对现场走动式教学支持不足。
Method: 提出 MobileGroupVis，一个针对小屏幕触控交互的移动可视化分析系统。其核心是轻量级流式分析管线，将小组音频转换为结构化讨论数据，再通过对话分析模块提取交互模式、话题进展和话题偏离；系统设计了六个协调视图，包括紧凑字形用于高效跨组比较与异常定位，以及观点演化、交互动力学、话题覆盖和对话记录等详细视图。
Result: 通过两个案例研究和专家访谈进行评估，结果提供了初步证据，表明 MobileGroupVis 能支持教师理解讨论过程、识别需要关注的小组，并促进课堂内的教学干预。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该系统填补了现场走动式教学场景下分析工具缺失的空白，并指出当前证据仍属初步（preliminary evidence），尚未给出大规模或定量实验结论。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 通过两个案例研究和专家访谈进行评估，结果提供了初步证据，表明 MobileGroupVis 能支持教师理解讨论过程、识别需要关注的小组，并促进课堂内的教学干预。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该系统填补了现场走动式教学场景下分析工具缺失的空白，并指出当前证据仍属初步（preliminary evidence），尚未给出大规模或定量实验结论。

papers.title: REVEAL: A Rubric-Guided Agent for Explicit Evidence Sufficiency Verificationin Long-Video Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Recently, retrieval-augmented and memory-augmented methods have emerged as two promising paradigms for long-video question answering. However, existing methods typically rely on rigid, fixed-length temporal chunking (e.g., 10s) and static offline memory banks, which not only fragment coherent continuous events but also fail to adapt during real-time reasoning. Moreover, whether using multi-scale summaries or multimodal knowledge graphs, current approaches prioritize retrieval relevance while overlooking evidence sufficiency, often stopping to answer once only semantically relevant clues are retrieved, even when key temporal, causal, or fine-grained action evidence is still missing. To tackle these challenges, we propose REVEAL, a rubric-guided agent framework. As a foundation, we introduce an adaptive visual-similarity-based preprocessing pipeline that groups visually coherent adjacent frames into natural event units to construct an offline-online video memory---capturing global video context offline while dynamically maintaining question-conditioned memory online. Built upon this structured memory, REVEAL uses an automatically constructed rubric library to explicitly verify whether retrieved evidence satisfies sufficiency criteria, pinpoints missing clues upon verification failure, and directs targeted re-retrieval for complementary information. Without any extra training, REVEAL consistently outperforms both closed-source and open-source state-of-the-art methods across extensive experiments. These results show that explicitly verifying evidence sufficiency, rather than stopping at semantic relevance, retrieves the decisive clues that prior methods miss and yields more reliable long-video reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REVEAL，一个基于评估准则引导 (rubric-guided) 的智能体框架，用于长视频问答中的显式证据充分性验证。方法以自适应视觉相似性预处理将相邻帧聚为自然事件单元，构建离线-在线视频记忆，并利用自动构建的准则库验证检索证据是否充分，缺失时定位缺失线索并定向补充检索。实验显示无需额外训练即可超越闭源与开源 SOTA 方法。
Motivation: 现有长视频问答方法依赖固定长度时间切块和静态离线记忆库，破坏连续事件且无法适应实时推理；同时检索增强方法只追求语义相关性，忽略证据充分性，在关键时间、因果或细粒度动作证据缺失时仍过早作答。
Method: 提出 REVEAL 智能体框架：先通过基于视觉相似性的自适应预处理将视觉连贯的相邻帧分组为自然事件单元，构建同时包含离线全局视频上下文与在线问题条件动态记忆的结构化记忆；再基于自动构建的准则库显式验证检索证据是否满足充分性标准，验证失败时定位缺失线索并引导有针对性的补充检索。
Result: 在广泛实验上，REVEAL 无需任何额外训练，一致优于闭源和开源的现有最先进方法；结果表明显式验证证据充分性而非止步于语义相关性，能检索到先前方法遗漏的关键线索，带来更可靠的长视频推理。
Conclusion: 作者强调显式验证证据充分性对长视频问答的有效性，并指出该框架基于自适应的离线-在线记忆与准则库实现。

papers.title: ADEx-FNO: A Unified Ambient-Domain Framework for Fourier Neural Operators on Varying Geometries
papers.abstract_en: Fourier neural operators (FNOs) provide efficient nonlocal spectral learning, but varying geometries and independently chosen discretizations remain difficult to accommodate. We introduce the ambient-domain extension Fourier neural operator (ADEx-FNO), a deterministic framework that incorporates geometry without modifying the defining Fourier-operator layers. Each physical domain is embedded in a fixed ambient hypercube and represented by a signed distance function. Inputs and solution fields are deterministically extended to the ambient domain, transferred to a common, potentially nonuniform rectilinear latent grid, processed by the FNO, then interpolated to an independently chosen target discretization and restricted to the physical domain. All geometry-transfer operations lie outside the optimization procedure and require no trainable graph, point-cloud, deformation, or geometry-decoding modules. ADEx-FNO achieves relative l2 errors of 0.32%-0.77% on held-out smooth-domain nonlinear Poisson and advection-reaction-diffusion problems in 2D and 3D, and is also evaluated on unseen nonsmooth geometries. A single ADEx-FNO inference is then used to initialize conventional CFD solvers. For all 29 converged 2D and 3D RANS cases, pseudo-time iterations decrease, with mean reductions of 44.17% and 43.03%, respectively, with comparable gains across three mesh resolutions. URANS cases reduce post-window physical-time advances by 18.52%-27.51%. In transfer from 2D URANS training data to DNS at different Mach and Reynolds numbers, the bootstrap interval decreases by 23.47%-48.21%, depending on the target statistic. In all CFD tests, ADEx-FNO provides only the initial field; the governing-equation solver controls the subsequent solution, while physical or statistical consistency is assessed separately from computational savings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 ADEx-FNO 的确定性框架，在不修改 FNO 定义层的前提下处理变化几何与独立选择的离散化。每个物理域被嵌入固定环境超立方体并用符号距离函数表示，输入与解场经确定性延拓、转换到公共非均匀矩形潜网格、由 FNO 处理后插值回目标离散化并限制到物理域。摘要报告在 2D/3D 非线性 Poisson 与对流-反应-扩散问题上相对 l2 误差为 0.32%-0.77%，并用于初始化 CFD 求解器，降低 RANS/URANS 迭代或物理时间推进，同时在 DNS 传输中改善统计量置信区间。
Motivation: FNO 提供高效的非局部谱学习，但变化几何和独立选择的离散化难以适配；现有方法常引入可训练图、点云、变形或几何解码模块，增加了复杂度。
Method: 提出环境域延拓 FNO（ADEx-FNO）：将每个物理域嵌入固定环境超立方体并用符号距离函数表示，确定性延拓输入和解场到环境域，转换到公共非均匀矩形潜网格，经 FNO 处理后插值到独立选择的目标离散化并限制回物理域；所有几何传输操作在优化过程之外，无需可训练模块。
Result: 在 2D 和 3D 平滑域非线性 Poisson 与对流-反应-扩散问题上，相对 l2 误差为 0.32%-0.77%，并在未见过的非光滑几何上评估。用于初始化传统 CFD 求解器时，全部 29 个收敛的 2D/3D RANS 算例伪时间迭代均值分别减少 44.17% 和 43.03%，三种网格分辨率下增益相当；URANS 算例物理时间推进减少 18.52%-27.51%；从 2D URANS 训练数据迁移到不同马赫数和雷诺数的 DNS 时，目标统计量 bootstrap 区间减小 23.47%-48.21%。所有 CFD 测试中 ADEx-FNO 仅提供初始场，后续由控制方程求解器主导，物理/统计一致性另行评估。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能统一处理变化几何而无需修改 FNO 核心层，并可作为 CFD 求解器的初始化工具带来计算收益；但物理或统计一致性需独立于计算节省进行验证。

papers.title: Mitigating Gender Bias in English to Romanian Machine Translation
papers.abstract_en: Machine translation (MT) systems often fail to correctly translate gender, especially when converting from a gender-neutral language like English to a gendered target language such as Romanian. This bias results in translations that default to masculine forms or reinforce gender stereotypes. We propose a hybrid pipeline to mitigate this issue by combining large language model (LLM)-based gender classification with neural machine translation (NMT). Our system uses a fine-tuned LLM to detect the intended gender of target words in English sentences and insert inline gender hint tags. These tagged sentences are then passed to a Transformer model fine-tuned to generate morphologically correct Romanian translations. To support this, we introduce three novel datasets for gender disambiguation and translation. Our approach improves gender accuracy on the WinoMT and WinoGender benchmarks by over 40 percentage points compared to a baseline MT system. This is the first method to explicitly address and evaluate gender bias in English-Romanian MT using both LLM inference and tag-aware translation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对英语到罗马尼亚语机器翻译中的性别偏见问题，提出混合流水线：先由微调后的 LLM 检测英语句子中目标词的预期性别并插入行内性别提示标签 (gender hint tags)，再交给微调后的 Transformer 模型生成形态正确的罗马尼亚语译文。作者为此引入三个新的性别消歧与翻译数据集，并在 WinoMT 和 WinoGender 基准上将性别准确率相对基线 MT 系统提升超过 40 个百分点。
Motivation: 机器翻译从英语这类语法性别中性的语言转换到罗马尼亚语等有语法性别的目标语言时，常默认使用阳性形式或强化性别刻板印象，而现有系统缺乏针对该语言对的显式抑制手段。
Method: 提出混合流水线，结合基于 LLM 的性别分类与 NMT：微调 LLM 识别英语句子中目标词的预期性别并插入行内性别提示标签，再使用微调的 Transformer 模型基于这些标签生成形态正确的罗马尼亚语译文；同时构建三个新的用于性别消歧与翻译的数据集。
Result: 在 WinoMT 和 WinoGender 基准上，相比基线 MT 系统，性别准确率提升超过 40 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者称这是首个同时利用 LLM 推理与标签感知翻译来显式处理和评估英语-罗马尼亚语 MT 性别偏见的方法。

papers.title: ForestBench: A Unified Graph Framework for Evaluating Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on Large Language Models (LLMs) are proliferating rapidly, but their heterogeneous execution traces provide no common basis for evaluation across methods. Outcome-only benchmarks discard collaborations, whereas LLM-as-Judge evaluation requires additional, model-dependent inference and can vary with the LLM and rubric. We introduce a generalizable evaluation framework that maps native MAS traces into a shared space of unified collaboration graphs, enabling different methods to be evaluated under the same representation, reference set, and metric panel. Candidate graphs are compared with a query-specific reference forest. Each forest is a benchmark-provided collection of verified-success graphs: it records diverse ways in which representative MAS methods can complete the task, rather than prescribing a unique optimal process. Instantiating the framework as ForestBench, we filter $844$ collaboration-necessary queries from seven public datasets, precompute ten successful target-conditioned reference graphs per query, and evaluate six representative MAS frameworks. Controlled backbone, reference-construction, and perturbation studies test the stability and scope of evaluation. Once the benchmark forests are built, ForestBench scores a trace in milliseconds without further LLM inference, providing a reusable structural basis for comparing diverse MAS collaboration traces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ForestBench，一个基于统一协作图 (collaboration graph) 的 LLM 多智能体系统 (MAS) 评估框架。它把不同 MAS 的原生执行轨迹映射为共享图表示，并与查询特定的参考森林 (reference forest) 比较；参考森林记录多种已验证成功的协作方式而非单一最优流程。作者从七个公开数据集筛出 844 个协作必要查询，为每个查询预计算 10 个成功参考图，并评测六个代表性 MAS 框架。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 多智能体评估缺乏跨方法的统一基础：仅看结果会丢弃协作过程信息，而 LLM-as-Judge 需要额外的模型相关推理，且结果随 LLM 与评分准则变化。
Method: 提出可泛化的评估框架，将原生 MAS 轨迹映射到统一协作图空间，使不同方法在同一表示、同一参考集和同一指标面板下比较。候选图与基准提供的查询相关参考森林对比，森林由已验证成功的图集合构成；具体实例 ForestBench 包含查询筛选、参考图预计算和受控对照实验。
Result: 从七个公开数据集构建 844 个协作必要查询，每个查询预计算 10 个成功目标条件参考图，并评估六个代表性 MAS 框架。基准森林构建完成后，打分一条轨迹只需毫秒级时间，无需额外 LLM 推理。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架为多样的 MAS 协作轨迹提供了可复用、结构化的比较基础，并通过受控骨干、参考构建和扰动实验检验评估的稳定性与适用范围。
