papers.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Agent-Specific Preference
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is a powerful framework for solving complex collaborative tasks, but it relies heavily on well-defined global reward functions. Designing such rewards is challenging, especially in systems with heterogeneous agents, where a single scalar objective may fail to capture diverse behaviors. In this paper, we introduce Multi-AGent Preference-Integrated lEarning (MAGPIE), which addresses these challenges through agent-specific preference modeling. Each agent is evaluated by a dedicated expert through preference signals, eliminating the need for global evaluation. We theoretically prove that optimizing these decentralized preferences converges to a Nash equilibrium policy. To integrate local preferences into a coherent global objective, we construct agent-specific reward models from preference data and combine them via a monotonic aggregation mechanism. We further prove that optimizing this aggregate reward model is equivalent to training the Nash equilibrium policy. Extensive experiments on benchmark multi-agent tasks and a sequential production line task show that MAGPIE achieves performance comparable to reward-engineered baselines, demonstrating its potential to facilitate policy learning in scenarios where precise reward engineering is impractical.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Multi-AGent Preference-Integrated lEarning (MAGPIE)，一种通过智能体特定偏好建模来替代全局奖励函数的多智能体强化学习方法。每个智能体由专门专家通过偏好信号评估，无需全局评价；作者理论上证明优化这些去中心化偏好可收敛到 Nash 均衡策略。实验表明 MAGPIE 在基准多智能体任务和顺序生产线任务上达到与人工奖励工程基线相当的性能。
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习依赖精心设计的全局奖励函数，而在异质智能体系统中单一标量目标难以刻画多样化行为，奖励设计非常困难。
Method: MAGPIE 为每个智能体构建基于偏好数据的专属奖励模型，并通过单调聚合 (monotonic aggregation) 机制将这些局部偏好整合为一致全局目标。作者证明优化该聚合奖励模型与训练 Nash 均衡策略等价。
Result: 作者给出两层理论保证：优化去中心化偏好收敛到 Nash 均衡，且优化聚合奖励模型等价于训练该均衡策略。实验在基准多智能体任务和顺序生产线任务中显示性能与奖励工程化的基线相当。
Conclusion: MAGPIE 或可在精确奖励工程不可行的场景中促进策略学习，但摘要未报告相对基线的量化优势，仅称性能相当。

papers.title: Unaccountable Delegation, Fading Skills: Mapping the Risks of Workplace AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: To anticipate socio-technical risks from AI agents, organizations need taxonomies to classify them. However, existing AI risk taxonomies focus on broad risks and do not capture job-specific risks introduced by agents. To address this gap, we make three main contributions. First, we developed a multi-layer framework from a literature review of AI agents. The framework models three core components and their interactions: agents, goals, and environment. Second, we embedded this framework in a structured prompt and applied it to descriptions of 2,078 job tasks from the O*NET database, producing 8,356 risk scenarios labeled by severity and deployment mode (automation or augmentation). We validated these scenarios with 45 workers across 10 job roles and an independent LLM judge, confirming their plausibility and alignment with job tasks. Finally, we extended an existing taxonomy to create a 15-category taxonomy of workplace AI agent risks that covers all our risk scenarios. Our analysis highlights four findings. First, augmentation is not inherently safe because overreliance on agents can gradually erode workers' skills and oversight. Second, Erroneous Agent Actions accounts for the largest share of risk scenarios and has the highest concentration of severe risks. Many arise at the human-agent boundary. Third, automation is associated mainly with organizational risks, while augmentation is associated mainly with risks to workers. Fourth, workers found our taxonomy easier to use for a risk classification task than two other taxonomies and preferred it in 64% of non-tied comparisons with a recent generative AI risk taxonomy. These findings show that workplace AI agent risks do not arise from agents alone; they also depend on how people work with agents and how agents are deployed. Safer workplaces require not only safer agents but also carefully designed human-AI agent collaboration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对职场 AI 智能体（AI agent）引入的岗位特定风险，提出一个多层分类框架，并将其用于从 O*NET 数据库的 2,078 个工作任务描述中生成 8,356 个风险场景。作者将这些场景按严重性和部署模式（自动化或增强）标注，经 45 名工人和独立 LLM 法官验证后，扩展出一个 15 类职场 AI 智能体风险分类法。分析显示，增强（augmentation）并非天然安全，过度依赖会侵蚀工人技能；错误智能体行为（Erroneous Agent Actions）占风险场景的最大份额且集中了最严重风险；自动化主要关联组织风险，增强主要关联工人风险；工人认为该分类法比两个现有分类法更易用，并在 64% 的非平局比较中更偏好它。
Motivation: 现有 AI 风险分类法聚焦于宽泛风险，未能捕捉智能体在工作岗位层面引入的特定风险，组织需要能对未来 socio-technical 风险进行前瞻分类的工具。
Method: 通过文献综述构建一个由智能体（agents）、目标（goals）和环境（environment）三个核心组件及其交互组成的多层框架；将该框架嵌入结构化提示，应用于 O*NET 数据库中 2,078 个工作任务描述，生成 8,356 个风险场景，按严重程度和部署模式标注，并用 45 名工人和独立 LLM 法官验证场景的合理性与对齐性；最后扩展现有分类法为 15 类的职场 AI 智能体风险分类法。
Result: 四个主要发现：增强模式并非内在安全，过度依赖会随时间侵蚀工人的技能与监督；错误智能体行为占风险场景的最大比例且严重风险集中于此，许多风险出现在人机边界；自动化主要关联组织风险，而增强主要关联工人风险；工人认为该分类法比另外两种分类法更易用于风险分类任务，并在 64% 的非平局比较中偏好它（相对于近期生成式 AI 风险分类法）。
Conclusion: 职场 AI 智能体风险不仅源自智能体本身，还取决于人们如何与智能体协作以及智能体如何被部署；更安全的工作场所既需要更安全的智能体，也需要精心设计的人机协作方式。

papers.title: Population-Scalable Multi-Agent World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: World models have recently achieved impressive progress in visual prediction and interactive generation, but extending them to multi-agent environments introduces a fundamental scalability challenge. Existing methods generally assume a fixed number of agents during training and inference, which ties the model to a pre-determined agent population and limits inference-time scalability. Our key insight is that cross-view consistency should arise from a shared world state whose evolution does not assume a predefined number of agents, while agent-specific observations should be generated by querying this state through a unified rendering interface. Based on this insight, we propose Khora, a scalable multi-agent world model that supports inference-time expansion to arbitrary numbers of agents without retraining. Our framework decouples world-state evolution from visual rendering and introduces a population-agnostic rendering mechanism for incorporating other agent information. This design maintains cross-view consistency through the shared world state rather than through dense interactions among observation streams inside the expensive video generator, enabling approximately linear practical scaling with the number of queried views. Qualitative experiments demonstrate that our approach generalizes to unseen numbers of agents while maintaining visual quality and multi-agent consistency. We further implement a real-time interactive system to demonstrate scalable open-world simulation.
papers.comment: Technical report. Project page: https://rhos.ai/research/khora. Online demo: https://ophilus.ai/khora
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Khora，一种可扩展的多智能体世界模型（multi-agent world model），将世界状态演化与视觉渲染解耦，并引入群体无关的渲染机制，使模型在推理时可扩展到任意数量的智能体而无需重训练。摘要称该方法通过共享世界状态保持跨视角一致性，而非在昂贵的视频生成器内部进行密集观测流交互，从而实现对查询视角数量的近似线性实际扩展。定性实验显示其能泛化到未见过的智能体数量，同时保持视觉质量与多智能体一致性，并实现了实时交互式系统用于可扩展开放世界仿真。
Motivation: 现有世界模型在扩展到多智能体环境时通常假设固定的智能体数量，将模型绑定到预定的群体规模，限制了推理时的可扩展性。作者的核心观点是跨视角一致性应来自不预设智能体数量的共享世界状态，而智能体特定观测应通过统一渲染接口查询该状态来生成。
Method: 提出 Khora 框架，将世界状态演化与视觉渲染解耦，并设计群体无关的渲染机制（population-agnostic rendering）以纳入其他智能体信息；通过共享世界状态来维持跨视角一致性，避免在视频生成器内部密集交互观测流。
Result: 摘要报告定量上该方法对查询视图数量呈近似线性实际扩展；定性实验表明其可泛化到未见过的智能体数量，同时保持视觉质量与多智能体一致性，并实现了实时交互式系统以展示可扩展开放世界仿真。
Conclusion: 作者强调，将世界状态演化与渲染解耦、并通过统一渲染接口查询共享状态，可以在不重训练的情况下支持推理时扩展到任意智能体数量。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Goal-oriented Navigation Instruction Generation with Tour Video Priors
papers.abstract_en: Navigation Instruction Generation (NIG) aims to produce step-by-step natural language instructions for navigation guidance. Existing studies primarily treat NIG as an auxiliary task for vision-andlanguage navigation (VLN), focusing on data augmentation or multi-task learning. However, generating navigation instructions from compact environmental priors requires meticulous spatial reasoning, especially when the target route does not simply follow the demonstrated tour, and remains challenging for current multimodal models. In this work, we introduce VideoNIG, a goal-oriented video-grounded NIG task that generates navigation instructions from ego-centric tour videos, an initial observation, and a textual or visual goal, without relying on intermediate representations such as graphs and maps. We instantiate VideoNIG in a controlled simulator benchmark with 60K tour videos across continuous indoor environments and 37K multimodal prompts with progressive difficulty levels. We further introduce a diagnostic evaluation protocol that combines text similarity, choice-based spatial consistency tests, and downstream navigation execution. To address this task, we propose a two-stage Curriculum Learning framework that decomposes the learning into foundational motion perception and long-horizon navigation reasoning. Specifically, we first employ Action Warmup for spatial action-view alignment, followed by Complexity Progression using trajectories with increasing exploratory difficulty. Extensive experiments show that existing MLLMs struggle with VideoNIG, while our approach significantly improves instruction quality across complementary diagnostic metrics. Finally, integrating VideoNIG-generated instructions with a VLN agent demonstrates the executability of this task formulation for end-to-end navigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VideoNIG，一个以目标为导向、基于视频的导航指令生成任务：从第一视角 tour 视频、初始观测和文本/视觉目标直接生成逐步导航指令，不依赖图或地图等中间表示。作者在受控仿真环境中构建了含 60K tour 视频和 37K 多模态提示（带渐进难度）的基准，并提出两阶段课程学习框架（Action Warmup 与 Complexity Progression）来解决该任务。实验表明现有多模态大模型在此任务上表现困难，而该方法在多类诊断指标上显著提升指令质量，且生成指令可被 VLN 智能体用于端到端导航。
Motivation: 现有导航指令生成（NIG）研究多将其视为 VLN 的辅助任务，用于数据增强或多任务学习；而从紧凑环境先验生成指令需要细致的空间推理，当目标路线不完全跟随演示 tour 时，当前多模态模型仍难以胜任。作者认为需要一个新的任务定义和基准来直接检验这一能力。
Method: 提出 VideoNIG 任务，并实例化为受控仿真器基准，包含 60K tour 视频和 37K 带渐进难度的多模态提示；同时设计结合文本相似度、基于选择的时空一致性测试和下游导航执行的诊断评估协议。方法上提出两阶段课程学习框架：先以 Action Warmup 进行空间动作-视角对齐，再通过 Complexity Progression 使用探索难度递增的轨迹进行训练。
Result: 摘要报告现有 MLLM 在 VideoNIG 上表现挣扎，而所提方法在互补的诊断指标上显著提升指令质量；将 VideoNIG 生成的指令接入 VLN 智能体，验证了该任务设定对端到端导航的可执行性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 VideoNIG 作为一个不依赖中间图/地图表示的目标导向任务，能够检验并提升多模态模型的长程导航推理能力，其生成指令可用于实际 VLN 执行。摘要未报告具体量化数值或与特定基线的详细对比。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为 VideoNIG 作为一个不依赖中间图/地图表示的目标导向任务，能够检验并提升多模态模型的长程导航推理能力，其生成指令可用于实际 VLN 执行。摘要未报告具体量化数值或与特定基线的详细对比。

papers.title: SDDBMs: Soft Denoising Diffusion Bridge Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion bridge models leverage Doob's \(h\)-transform to construct stochastic transports between arbitrary endpoint distributions, and have shown strong potential in image-to-image translation and restoration. However, most existing bridge models rely on hard endpoint conditioning, which forces the terminal state to match a prescribed target exactly. This hard constraint induces terminal-boundary singularities: the terminal law collapses to a Dirac measure, and the resulting drift coefficients become ill-conditioned near the endpoint. In this paper, we propose Soft Denoising Diffusion Bridge Models (SDDBMs), a generalized framework that regularizes diffusion bridges directly at the level of their terminal constraints. Instead of imposing an exact endpoint, SDDBMs prescribe a non-degenerate Gaussian terminal marginal under the transformed path measure, with a flexible terminal center and variance. Starting from this prescribed marginal, we develop a complete closed-form construction of the soft bridge, including the Gaussian terminal reweighting and soft \(h\)-function, the induced Gaussian forward marginals and \(\mathbf{x}_0\)-free dynamics. Theoretically, SDDBMs provide a unified probabilistic perspective that encompasses existing diffusion bridge models, including DDBMs, GOUB, and UniDB, as special cases under specific parameter choices. Extensive experiments on image restoration tasks demonstrate that SDDBMs achieve improved numerical stability and superior generation quality over existing bridge-based methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出软去噪扩散桥模型（SDDBMs），通过在终端约束层面进行正则化来克服硬端点条件导致的终端边界奇异性问题。该方法指定非退化高斯终端边缘分布，并给出包含高斯终端重加权、软 h 函数、高斯前向边缘分布及不依赖 x0 的动力学在内的完整闭式构造。理论表明 SDDBMs 统一了 DDBMs、GOUB 和 UniDB 等现有扩散桥模型，实验在图像恢复任务上验证了数值稳定性和生成质量的提升。
Motivation: 现有扩散桥模型依赖硬端点条件，迫使终点状态精确匹配目标，导致终端定律退化为 Dirac 测度且漂移系数在端点附近病态，从而产生终端边界奇异性。
Method: SDDBMs 在变换路径测度下规定一个非退化的高斯终端边缘分布，并保留灵活的终端中心和方差；由此推导出高斯终端重加权、软 h 函数、诱导的高斯前向边缘分布以及 x0-free 动力学的完整闭式构建。
Result: 摘要报告在图像恢复任务上，SDDBMs 相比现有基于桥的方法取得更好的数值稳定性和生成质量，并将 DDBMs、GOUB、UniDB 作为特殊参数情形纳入统一概率视角。
Conclusion: 作者认为在终端约束层面直接正则化扩散桥是一种有效的统一框架，能够缓解硬端点奇异问题并提升生成性能；摘要未提及面向天气或降水的应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RobustDefect-LLM: Explainable and Robustness-Aware Industrial Surface Defect Classification with Decision Support and AI-Assisted Reporting
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents RobustDefect-LLM, an industrial surface-defect inspection framework integrating deep-learning classification, operator-facing visual evidence, confidence-aware decision support, controlled AI-assisted reporting, traceable storage, and mobile interaction in a unified quality-control workflow. Here, robustness-aware denotes explicit evaluation under controlled image degradation and confidence-aware review routing, not an intrinsic robustness guarantee. Four transfer-learning-based convolutional neural networks, ResNet50, EfficientNet-B0, DenseNet121, and MobileNetV3-Large, were evaluated on 1,799 images from the six-class NEU-DET dataset using fixed training, validation, and held-out in-domain test partitions. MobileNetV3-Large achieved the highest numerical test accuracy (99.26%) and macro F1-score (0.9926), with a bootstrap 95% accuracy CI of 0.9815-1.0000. An exact paired McNemar test found no significant difference from DenseNet121 (p = 1.000). The selected model averaged 0.060 s per CPU forward pass (16.66 FPS). Under combined synthetic degradation, accuracy fell to 87.78% at mild intensity and below 40% at stronger intensities, revealing sensitivity to severe image-quality deterioration. Grad-CAM supplied visual evidence, while predictions with confidence below 0.90 or a top-2 margin below 0.10 were routed to HUMAN REVIEW. This conservative policy provided 12.22% automatic coverage and 100% observed selective accuracy among 33 eligible cases (95% CI: 89.43%-100.00%), while routing both observed classification errors to review. Under nominal controlled conditions, all 100 generated reports passed deterministic consistency checks, with a mean latency of 1.66 s. Results support the feasibility of the integrated workflow while emphasizing the need for calibration, repeated evaluation, and real-world industrial validation.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 11 figures, 16 tables, preprint manuscript, the source code is publicly available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RobustDefect-LLM，一个面向工业表面缺陷检测的集成框架，将迁移学习 CNN 分类、面向操作员的 Grad-CAM 视觉证据、置信度感知的决策支持、受控 AI 辅助报告、可追踪存储与移动端交互整合到统一质检流程中。作者在六类 NEU-DET 数据集（1,799 张图像）上评估了 ResNet50、EfficientNet-B0、DenseNet121 与 MobileNetV3-Large，其中 MobileNetV3-Large 取得最高测试准确率 99.26% 与宏 F1 0.9926；在合成退化下模型性能显著下降。摘要还报告了基于置信度阈值的人工复核路由策略和报告一致性与延迟指标。
Motivation: 工业表面缺陷检测需要的不只是准确分类，还需要可解释性、鲁棒性评估以及支持决策和报告生成的统一工作流；现有方法往往缺乏对操作员交互、置信度路由和受控 AI 报告的集成验证。
Method: 构建一个统一质检框架，使用四种迁移学习 CNN 作为分类骨干，Grad-CAM 提供视觉证据；预测置信度低于 0.90 或 top-2 间隔低于 0.10 时路由到 HUMAN REVIEW；同时引入 AI 辅助报告生成、可追溯存储和移动端交互，并在受控图像退化下显式评估鲁棒性。
Result: MobileNetV3-Large 测试准确率 99.26%、宏 F1 0.9926，bootstrap 95% 置信区间 0.9815-1.0000，与 DenseNet121 的精确配对 McNemar 检验无显著差异（p=1.000）；CPU 前向平均 0.060 秒（16.66 FPS）。在合成退化下，轻度和较强退化时准确率分别降至 87.78% 和低于 40%。保守人工复核策略在 33 个合格样本上实现 12.22% 自动覆盖率、100% 选择性准确率（95% CI: 89.43%-100.00%），并将两个观察到的分类错误全部路由到复核。100 份报告在名义受控条件下全部通过确定性一致性检查，平均延迟 1.66 秒。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该集成工作流具备可行性，但 robustness-aware 仅指受控退化下的显式评估与置信度感知复核，并非内在鲁棒性保证；作者指出仍需校准、重复评估和真实工业环境验证。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: LazyHMC: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo Simulation for Lazy, Infinite Dimensional Probabilistic Programs
papers.abstract_en: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) is a successful generic inference method in probabilistic programming, but in its ordinary formulation it needs gradients and finite-dimensional parameter spaces. In Haskell, lazy evaluation lets probabilistic programs express stochastic processes and other non-parametric Bayesian models over implicit infinite-dimensional spaces. This paper develops new formulations of gradient-based HMC for this infinite-dimensional setting, via lazy evaluation. For automatic differentiation, we provide an analysis based on a new notion of "piecewise analytic under cylindrical analytic partition" (PACAP), to show that even if a program is infinite-dimensional and defined lazily, the gradient of the likelihood function is finitely supported. For the Monte Carlo method itself, we develop several HMC variants and a No-U-Turn Sampler that operate over the infinite-dimensional parameter space but are still productive because of lazy evaluation. Experiments cover Gaussian mixture clustering, random walks, and piecewise-constant regression with Poisson-process changepoints.
papers.journal_ref: Proc. ACM Program. Lang. 10, ICFP, Article 298 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LazyHMC，一套基于惰性求值 (lazy evaluation) 的哈密顿蒙特卡洛 (HMC) 推断方法，面向 Haskell 概率程序中隐式无限维参数空间。作者引入新的分析概念“piecewise analytic under cylindrical analytic partition”(PACAP)，用以证明即使程序无限维且惰性定义，似然函数的梯度仍是有限支撑的；同时构造多种 HMC 变体和一个 No-U-Turn Sampler，使其能在无限维参数空间上运行并保持生产力。实验覆盖高斯混合聚类、随机游走和带 Poisson 过程变点的分段常数回归。
Motivation: 普通 HMC 需要梯度和有限维参数空间，无法直接处理 Haskell 惰性求值所表达的非参数贝叶斯模型，例如隐式无限维空间上的随机过程。需要为这类无限维概率程序设计可行的梯度计算与采样方法。
Method: 通过惰性求值发展新的梯度型 HMC 公式。自动微分方面，用 PACAP 分析证明无限维惰性程序的似然梯度有限支撑；蒙特卡洛方面，提出多个 HMC 变体和 No-U-Turn Sampler，在无限维参数空间上运行而不失 productivity。
Result: 理论上引入 PACAP 概念，证明惰性定义的无限维程序中似然梯度具有有限支撑；实验在 Gaussian mixture clustering、random walks 以及带 Poisson-process changepoints 的分段常数回归任务上验证了所提 HMC 变体与 NUTS 的可用性。
Conclusion: 作者认为，借助惰性求值，梯度型 HMC 可以推广到概率编程中的隐式无限维参数空间，为非参数贝叶斯模型提供通用且可产出的推断方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: EvTrajGS: Accurate and Efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting from Unposed Event Streams
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras, with high temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and asynchronous sensing characteristics, have shown great potential for dense 3D reconstruction. Traditional reconstruction methods based on off-the-shelf pose estimates achieve high efficiency but produce low-fidelity results, as inaccurate pose initialization introduces cumulative reconstruction errors. In contrast, recent SLAM-style methods stabilize joint pose-scene optimization through incremental tracking and mapping, yielding higher reconstruction fidelity at the expense of considerable computational overhead. To address this trade-off, this paper presents EvTrajGS, an accurate and efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for unposed event streams. Our method enables reliable joint pose-scene optimization initialized from coarse pose priors, eliminating the need for computationally expensive SLAM-style pipelines. EvTrajGS parameterizes camera motion as a continuous-time trajectory initialized from discrete camera poses, providing a unified representation for pose refinement. We then aggregate adjacent trajectory states into a temporally coupled pose, promoting temporally consistent pose updates during joint optimization. Additionally, we introduce a loss-reweighted event sampling strategy to adaptively emphasize temporally under-reconstructed intervals. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that EvTrajGS outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of both geometric reconstruction quality and pose estimation accuracy, achieving 3.8 dB higher PSNR, 0.1 higher SSIM, and over 40\% lower ATE RMSE while retaining high computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EvTrajGS，一种用于无位姿事件流（unposed event streams）的3D高斯溅射框架，通过连续时间轨迹参数化相机运动，从粗位姿先验出发进行位姿-场景联合优化，避免SLAM式的高计算开销。引入时间耦合位姿和损失重加权事件采样策略，在合成和真实数据集上相较SOTA方法在几何重建质量和位姿精度上均有提升，例如PSNR提高3.8 dB、SSIM提高0.1、ATE RMSE降低40%以上，并保持高计算效率。
Motivation: 传统基于现成位姿估计的重建方法效率高但保真度低，因为位姿初始化不准会造成累积重建误差；SLAM风格方法通过增量跟踪和建图获得更高保真度但计算开销大。作者希望在不依赖SLAM管线的前提下，从粗位姿先验出发实现可靠的联合位姿-场景优化。
Method: EvTrajGS 将相机运动参数化为由离散位姿初始化的连续时间轨迹（continuous-time trajectory），作为统一的位姿精化表示；聚合相邻轨迹状态成时间耦合位姿（temporally coupled pose），促进联合优化中的时间一致性更新；并引入损失重加权事件采样（loss-reweighted event sampling）策略，自适应强调时间上重建不足的区间。
Result: 在合成与真实数据集上，EvTrajGS 在几何重建质量和位姿估计精度上均超过SOTA方法，摘要报告PSNR提高3.8 dB、SSIM提高0.1、ATE RMSE降低超过40%，同时保持高计算效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，使用连续时间轨迹与时间耦合位姿的联合优化，可以在无需SLAM式管线的情况下，兼顾重建精度、位姿精度和计算效率。

papers.title: Where Is the Bee? Detecting Tiny Pollinators with a Single Collaborative-Head Transformer
papers.abstract_en: The CVPPA@ECCV 2026 BuzzSpot Challenge asks us to detect bees, bumblebees, hoverflies, and moths in 1920x1080 field keyframes. Its annotations carry 2 difficulties: the median box occupies 0.16% of a frame, and bees account for 80% of the labels. To cope with the small boxes, we compare 10 recorded detector configurations on held-out keyframes; plain Co-DINO with a Swin-L backbone has the highest mAP in this comparison, so we select it. Training then addresses the bee dominance in 2 ways: fine-tuning on a crop-mosaic pool in which the combined annotation share of the 3 rare classes rises from 19.9% to 55.1%, and a class-weighted simplex equiangular tight frame (ETF) loss that pulls the projected states of matched decoder queries toward fixed class directions. The full schedule spans 12+3+2 epochs. Without inference-time ensembling or test-time augmentation, we rank first on FinalTest at 0.5062 mAP@[.5:.95].

papers.title: When Can Fraud Operations Authorize Automation? A Decision-Support Framework for Fresh Audit Evidence and Review Workload
papers.abstract_en: Fraud operations must allocate events among automatic approval, analyst review, and automatic blocking even though the labels needed to evaluate these actions are selective and delayed. Predictive scores order cases, but they do not show whether the evidence is current and representative enough to delegate an action to the model. We develop freshness-constrained audit capacity (FCAC), a decision-support framework that treats automation as an authorization decision constrained by action risk, evidence freshness, and shared review capacity. It evaluates candidate action regions from mature randomized audits and a prespecified temporal allowance. Supported regions are automated; unsupported regions remain in review. The resulting decision record reports evidence age, audit demand, total review workload, value exposure, and compatible temporal change. We show that current action risk is unidentified without restricting unobserved label evolution. Under representative randomized audits, label-independent evidence windows, and a prespecified condition linking historical and current action risk, we derive simultaneous finite-sample control of unsafe authorization. Chronological evaluations with simulated audits on IEEE-CIS, ULB-Worldline, and Elliptic++ yield zero-drift automation rates of 84.4%, 67.4%, and 81.3%, with total review workloads of 24.1%, 46.0%, and 43.1%. The experiments reveal an audit-capacity trade-off: sparse auditing delays authorization, whereas intensive auditing eventually increases workload. A separately specified BAF stress test further indicates that fallback thresholds must reflect candidate-specific evidence rather than a common fraction of the risk limit. These findings identify audit freshness and analyst capacity as joint design considerations for fraud decision support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 freshness-constrained audit capacity (FCAC)，一个面向欺诈运营的决策支持框架，将自动化视为受动作风险、证据新鲜度和共享审核容量约束的授权决策。框架从成熟随机审计和预设时间容限中评估候选动作区域，受支持的区域自动执行，不支持的保留人工审核。在 IEEE-CIS、ULB-Worldline 和 Elliptic++ 上使用模拟审计的时序评估得到零漂移自动化率 84.4%、67.4%、81.3%，总审核负载 24.1%、46.0%、43.1%。
Motivation: 欺诈运营需要在自动批准、分析师审核和自动拦截之间分配事件，但评估这些动作所需的标签是选择性的且延迟到达；预测分数只能排序案件，无法表明证据是否足够新鲜和具有代表性以将动作委托给模型。
Method: 提出 FCAC 决策支持框架，利用成熟随机审计和预设时间允许度生成候选动作区域，并输出包含证据年龄、审计需求、总审核负载、价值暴露和兼容时间变化的决策记录。在理论上，作者证明若不对未观测标签演化加以限制，当前动作风险无法识别；在代表性随机审计、与标签无关的证据窗口以及连接历史与当前动作风险的预设条件下，推导了对不安全授权的有限样本联合控制。
Result: 使用模拟审计的时序评估在 IEEE-CIS、ULB-Worldline 和 Elliptic++ 上得到零漂移自动化率 84.4%、67.4%、81.3%，总审核负载 24.1%、46.0%、43.1%；实验显示审计容量权衡：稀疏审计延迟授权，密集审计最终增加工作量。另设的 BAF 压力测试表明，回退阈值应反映候选特定证据，而非风险限额的公共比例。
Conclusion: 研究指出审计新鲜度和分析师容量是欺诈决策支持中需要联合考虑的设计因素，并强调当前动作风险在未限制未观测标签演化时是不可识别的。

papers.title: CDGC-Net: 3D Medical Image Segmentation with Cooperative Dual-Scale Self-Attention and Grouped Channel Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Accurate 3D medical image segmentation requires the integration of long-range anatomical context with fine boundary detail. Existing methods often model global and local features in separate modules or feature levels and perform channel recalibration independently. This may cause semantic mismatch between global context and local boundaries, insufficient channel relationship modeling, weak spatial-channel interaction, and redundant representations. We propose CDGC-Net, a 3D medical image segmentation network that combines cooperative dual-scale spatial attention with grouped hierarchical channel modeling. With-in each CDGC block, Cooperative Dual-Scale Self-Attention (CDSA) assigns attention heads to parallel local-window and global-sparse branches. The two branches capture fine spatial details and long-range anatomical context at the same feature level. Their outputs are concatenated into an $N\times C$ spatial representation and directly passed to Grouped Hierarchical Channel Attention (GHCA). GHCA organizes the channels into $r$ groups and models both within-group and cross-group dependencies. CDSA and GHCA reuse a shared key projection to maintain a consistent feature reference. Residual feature alignment subsequently integrates the refined features with the original representation. On the Synapse, ACDC, BraTS, and LA datasets, CDGC-Net achieved mean DSC values of 86.96\%, 92.91\%, 82.56\%, and 93.52\%, respectively, exceeding the next-highest reported values by 0.39, 0.47, 0.17, and 0.32 percentage points. CDGC-Net contains 25.83M parameters and 28.62G FLOPs for an input size of $64\times128\times128$, reducing these quantities by 39.87\% and 40.30\%, respectively, relative to UNETR++. These results indicate a favorable trade-off between segmentation accuracy and computational complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CDGC-Net，一种面向 3D 医学图像分割的网络，将协作式双尺度自注意力（CDSA）与分组层次化通道注意力（GHCA）结合在统一的 CDGC 块中。CDSA 在同一特征层并行使用局部窗口和全局稀疏分支以同时获取细粒度边界与长距离解剖上下文，GHCA 则对通道分组并建模组内与跨组依赖，两组注意力共享同一 key 投影以保持特征参照一致。作者在 Synapse、ACDC、BraTS 和 LA 数据集上报告了平均 DSC 的提升，并相对 UNETR++ 降低了参数量和 FLOPs。
Motivation: 现有 3D 医学图像分割方法通常在不同模块或特征层级分别建模全局与局部特征，并独立进行通道重标定，这可能导致全局上下文与局部边界之间的语义不匹配、通道关系建模不足、空间-通道交互较弱以及表征冗余。
Method: 提出 CDGC-Net，其核心 CDGC 块包含 Cooperative Dual-Scale Self-Attention（CDSA）与 Grouped Hierarchical Channel Attention（GHCA）。CDSA 将注意力头分配到并行的局部窗口分支和全局稀疏分支，在相同特征层级捕获细节与长程上下文；两分支输出拼接为 N×C 空间表征后送入 GHCA，GHCA 将通道划分为 r 组并同时建模组内与组间依赖。CDSA 与 GHCA 复用共享的 key 投影以保持特征参照一致，随后通过残差特征对齐将精化特征与原始表征融合。
Result: 在 Synapse、ACDC、BraTS 和 LA 数据集上，CDGC-Net 的平均 DSC 分别达到 86.96%、92.91%、82.56% 和 93.52%，超过次优报告值 0.39、0.47、0.17 和 0.32 个百分点。模型参数量为 25.83M、FLOPs 为 28.62G（输入 64×128×128），相比 UNETR++ 分别减少 39.87% 和 40.30%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 CDGC-Net 在分割精度与计算复杂度之间取得了有利的权衡，表明在同一特征层级协作建模双尺度空间信息并配合分组层次化通道建模是有前景的 3D 医学图像分割方向。

papers.title: Robust Reputation-Driven Crowdsourced Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Crowdsourced Federated Learning (CrowdFL) extends traditional federated learning by enabling open and heterogeneous participation through a crowdsourcing paradigm. In this setting, reputation-driven incentive mechanisms are commonly employed to guide worker selection and enhance trustworthiness. While such approaches improve participant reliability, existing frameworks largely overlook the quantification of their robustness against stealthy adversaries, particularly those capable of evading standard detection mechanisms. To fill this gap, this paper proposes R2CFL, a robust reputation-driven CrowdFL framework. R2CFL introduces a robust reputation model coupled with a nearest neighbor mixing (R2-NNM) defense mechanism that links reputation evolution with the filtering of updates during aggregation. The proposed mechanism prevents stealthy attackers from gradually accumulating trust and influencing future tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that R2-NNM matches or surpasses state-of-the-art Byzantine-robust and backdoor defense mechanisms against adaptive attackers. Furthermore, when integrated with existing detect-and-filter defenses, the proposed reputation model faithfully captures the statistical robustness of the underlying defense by producing reputation scores that closely reflect its true positive and false positive characteristics.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the HotDiSec Workshop, co-located with ESORICS'26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 R2CFL，一个面向众包联邦学习 (Crowdsourced Federated Learning, CrowdFL) 的鲁棒信誉驱动框架。其核心是结合鲁棒信誉模型与最近邻混合防御机制 (R2-NNM)，在聚合阶段将信誉演化与更新过滤联系起来，防止隐蔽攻击者逐步积累信任。实验表明 R2-NNM 在自适应攻击下匹敌或超越现有拜占庭鲁棒与后门防御方法，且信誉分数能反映底层防御的统计鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有 CrowdFL 中的信誉驱动激励机制虽能提升参与者可靠性，但大多忽略了对隐蔽攻击者的鲁棒性量化，尤其是那些能规避标准检测机制的对手。
Method: 提出 R2CFL 框架，引入鲁棒信誉模型，并设计最近邻混合 (R2-NNM) 防御机制，将信誉演化与聚合阶段的更新过滤相结合，以阻止隐蔽攻击者逐步积累信任并影响未来任务。
Result: 实验显示 R2-NNM 在自适应攻击下匹敌或超越最先进的拜占庭鲁棒与后门防御机制；与现有检测-过滤防御集成时，信誉分数能紧密反映其真正例与假正例特性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将信誉演化与更新过滤耦合可增强 CrowdFL 对隐蔽攻击者的鲁棒性，且信誉模型可作为底层防御统计鲁棒性的忠实指标。

papers.title: FailForge: Distilling Procedural Competence from Persistent Failures into Code Agents
papers.abstract_en: Rejection sampling fine-tuning (RFT) is widely used to train code agents by generating trajectories on verifiable software engineering tasks, retaining those that pass the tests, and fine-tuning on the successful rollouts. However, even strong code agents repeatedly fail on a substantial fraction of such tasks, and standard RFT simply discards these failures. The discarded samples are precisely the hardest and most informative ones, drawn from verifiable instances that are costly to curate. Stronger base models may reduce the number of failures, but the remaining hard cases still define the frontier for further improvement. We propose FailForge, an agentic framework that converts failed rollouts into training signal. For each failed instance, an agent diagnoses the failure from error feedback and execution traces, distills the diagnosis into a concise and actionable skill, and injects the skill into the agent context for a guided second attempt. Trajectories that succeed under skill guidance are folded back into the RFT corpus. Crucially, the skill is removed at training time, so the model internalizes the recovered behavior rather than relying on external hints at inference. FailForge recovers over 26% of previously failed instances at marginal additional cost, and training Qwen3.5-4B on the augmented corpus improves the SWE-bench Verified resolve rate by 6.6 points over a strong RFT baseline, with gains concentrated on the hardest problems.

papers.title: VoxZip: Semantic-Anchored Temporal KV Cache Compression for Long-Context Audio Inference
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in Speech Large Language Models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in understanding complex audio tasks. Despite this progress, their long-context inference remains severely bottlenecked by prohibitive KV cache memory demands. Existing text-centric compression methods struggle here, often disrupting speech continuity or discarding crucial semantic cues. To address this, we propose VoxZip, a train-free, two-stage semantic-anchored KV cache compression framework. The first stage uses automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcriptions as explicit semantic anchors to temporally align, compress, and fuse audio tokens, significantly reducing the initial KV cache while elevating token information density. To further improve the compression ratio, the second stage employs a dynamic filtering strategy based on temporally decayed accumulated attention to evict non-essential tokens while mitigating early-token bias. Comprehensive evaluations on Qwen3-Omni across six diverse audio benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our approach. VoxZip excels in long-audio reasoning and consistently maintains high-fidelity perception on short-form tasks. Notably, it sustains over 90\% of the uncompressed baseline performance even under an aggressive 20x KV cache compression in long-context scenarios. Furthermore, at a 4x compression ratio, VoxZip yields a 1.9x increase in inference throughput alongside a 3.3x reduction in peak memory overhead. Code and models will be available at https://github.com/MM-Speech/VoxZip.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VoxZip，一个免训练 (train-free) 的两阶段语义锚定 KV 缓存压缩框架，用于 Speech Large Language Models 的长上下文音频推理。第一阶段利用自动语音识别 (ASR) 转录文本作为显式语义锚点，对音频 token 进行时间对齐、压缩与融合；第二阶段基于时间衰减的累积注意力 (temporally decayed accumulated attention) 动态过滤并驱逐非必要 token，同时缓解早词偏差。在 Qwen3-Omni 上六个音频基准的评测显示，20x 激进压缩下仍能保持未压缩基线 90% 以上的性能。
Motivation: Speech LLM 在复杂音频任务上能力显著，但长上下文推理受限于巨大的 KV 缓存内存需求；现有文本中心式压缩方法会破坏语音连续性或丢失关键语义线索。
Method: VoxZip 是两阶段、免训练的语义锚定 KV 缓存压缩框架：第一阶段以 ASR 转录作为显式语义锚点，对音频 token 做时间对齐、压缩与融合，降低初始 KV 缓存并提升 token 信息密度；第二阶段采用基于时间衰减累积注意力的动态过滤策略，驱逐非必要 token 并缓解早期 token 偏差。
Result: 在 Qwen3-Omni 上的六个音频基准中，VoxZip 在长上下文场景下 20x KV 缓存压缩时仍维持未压缩基线超过 90% 的性能；在 4x 压缩比下，推理吞吐提升 1.9 倍，峰值内存开销降低 3.3 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为 VoxZip 在长音频推理上表现优异，并能保持短时任务的保真感知；代码与模型将公开在 GitHub 上。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neural Message Passing on Structural Interaction Graphs for Fully-Inductive Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: A central obstacle in building graph foundation models is the input heterogeneity in terms of feature space dimensionality, semantics, and structure. Such heterogeneity limits the capability of graph neural networks to generalize to new graphs with unseen feature spaces. We address the transferability challenge with SIGIL, a framework that maps any attributed graph to a unified representation space of fixed dimension. Given a graph, SIGIL lifts it to a structural interaction graph, where nodes are the input feature dimensions and weighted, typed edges encode feature alignment across multiple orders of the graph's connectivity. A relational message-passing network embeds each feature dimension into a shared space, transforming the original node features, of arbitrary dimensionality, into representations transferable to any downstream graph. By construction, SIGIL is equivariant to permutations of nodes, feature dimensions, and labels. Additionally, when the input features are one-hot indicators of discrete relations, SIGIL recovers and strictly generalizes existing foundation models for knowledge graph reasoning. A single SIGIL model, pretrained on one graph, delivers strong fully-inductive link prediction. Also, SIGIL can be used to implement existing knowledge graph foundation models. As such, SIGIL unifies several existing regimes in graph foundation model design under a single framework
papers.comment: 7 pages, 1 figure in the main body. 12 pages, 5 figures in appendix. Submitted to AAAI 2027 (main track) and currently under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SIGIL，一个将任意属性图映射到固定维度统一表示空间的框架，以解决图基础模型中输入特征空间维度、语义和结构异构带来的迁移难题。SIGIL 把图提升为结构交互图，节点为输入特征维度，加权类型边编码跨多阶连接的特征对齐，并用关系消息传递网络把各特征维度嵌入共享空间。摘要指出，当输入特征为离散关系的一热指标时，SIGIL 能恢复并严格推广现有知识图谱推理基础模型，且单个模型在单个图上预训练即可实现强完全的归纳链接预测。
Motivation: 图基础模型的核心障碍是输入在特征空间维度、语义和结构上的异构性，这限制了图神经网络泛化到具有未见特征空间的新图。
Method: SIGIL 将图提升为结构交互图，其中节点是输入特征维度、边是带权重和类型的特征对齐关系；随后用关系消息传递网络把各特征维度嵌入共享空间，使任意维度的原始节点特征转化为可迁移的表征。该构造对节点、特征维度和标签的排列具有等变性。
Result: 摘要报告单个 SIGIL 模型在一个图上预训练后即可在完全归纳链接预测上取得强性能；当输入特征是一热离散关系指示时，SIGIL 恢复并严格推广现有知识图谱推理基础模型。
Conclusion: SIGIL 将多种现有图基础模型设计范式统一到单一框架下，并可用于实现现有知识图谱基础模型。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: On-Device Multi-Species Malaria Detection with Uncertainty-Calibrated Slide-Level Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Malaria remains a leading cause of mortality in resource-limited settings, where expert microscopists are scarce. Automated diagnosis based on microscopy images thus has strong potential to improve care delivery. But for an algorithm to deploy, a necessary requirement is that it meet a suite of non-obvious (from a machine learning (ML) perspective) clinical constraints. Therefore, in close consultation with a national health center we developed a malaria diagnosis pipeline which addresses key requirements listed by the health care center but typically ignored in the ML malaria literature. In particular, it includes: (i) stopping criteria (to reduce image acquisition and time-to-result); (ii) human-in-the-loop functionality (for review and accountability); (iii) multi-species discrimination (since treatment varies by species); (iv) thick film detection (standard for microscopy); (v) computationally-efficient uncertainty calculations (to aid clinician review); and (vi) an edge device platform (since internet can be spotty in this catchment area). The mobile system performs all inference on-device using YOLOv13n deployed via TensorFlow Lite. It detects four species and white blood cells from Giemsa-stained thick blood smear images, aggregating per-image detections into slide-level parasitemia with World Health Organization (WHO)-standard quantification. This paper highlights these various clinical constraints and offers methods to address them. Evaluated on 2,739 annotated images across all four species, the system achieves mAP@0.5 of 0.863, per-image parasite count correlation of r = 0.812, slide-level r = 0.951 (soft counting, 10 images/slide), and runs entirely offline with a pipeline time of 10.27 +- 1.65 s per image.
papers.comment: Accepted at The Fifth Workshop on Applications of Medical AI (AMAI) 2026, a satellite event at MICCAI 2026. To appear in Springer Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向资源有限环境中疟疾显微镜诊断的部署需求，提出一套完全在设备端运行的疟疾检测流水线。系统使用通过 TensorFlow Lite 部署的 YOLOv13n，在 Giemsa 染色的厚血膜图像上检测四种疟原虫物种和白细胞，并将逐图像检测聚合成符合 WHO 标准的玻片级寄生虫血症定量。在 2,739 张标注图像上，系统达到 mAP@0.5 0.863，逐图像寄生虫计数相关性 r=0.812，玻片级 r=0.951，流水线每张图像耗时 10.27 ± 1.65 秒且完全离线运行。
Motivation: 疟疾是资源有限地区的主要死因，但专业镜检人员稀缺；自动化显微镜诊断有潜力改善诊疗，但算法要真正部署必须满足一系列临床上关键、却常被机器学习文献忽略的约束，如停止标准、人工复核、多物种区分等。
Method: 在与国家卫生中心密切协商后，作者构建了满足六项临床要求的疟疾诊断流水线：停止标准以减少图像采集和时间到结果、人机协作功能、多物种判别、厚膜检测、计算高效的置信度不确定性估计，以及边缘设备平台。系统在设备端用 YOLOv13n 进行推理，将检测结果聚合成 WHO 标准计数的玻片级寄生虫血症。
Result: 在覆盖全部四种物种的 2,739 张标注图像上，系统达到 mAP@0.5 0.863，逐图像寄生虫计数相关性 r=0.812，玻片级（软计数，每玻片 10 张图像）相关性 r=0.951；流水线完全离线，每张图像处理时间为 10.27 ± 1.65 秒。
Conclusion: 论文强调医疗部署中常被忽视的临床约束并给出相应解决方案，展示了一套可在网络不稳定地区离线运行的疟疾检测系统。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Performance Evaluation of the WeatherEx Forecasting System (WFS) for Extreme Monsoon Rainfall over Kerala
papers.abstract_en: Extreme monsoon rainfall over Kerala presents a major operational forecasting challenge because of the interaction of Arabian Sea moisture transport, mesoscale convection, coastal convergence, and strong orographic forcing along the Western Ghats. Spatial analysis showed that WFS reproduced the principal Western-Ghats-aligned rainfall corridor and represented localized high-intensity rainfall structures more distinctly than the smoother global-model guidance examined for the event. The results demonstrate the complementary roles of operational regional guidance and higher-resolution diagnostic forecasts and highlight the importance of region-specific calibration, spatial verification, and continued evaluation across multiple monsoon events and forecast lead times.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估 WeatherEx 预报系统 (WFS) 在喀拉拉邦极端季风降雨事件中的表现。空间分析显示，WFS 较好地复现了沿西高止山脉 (Western Ghats) 的主要降雨走廊，并且比该事件中考察的全球模式指导产品更清晰地刻画了局地高强度降雨结构。作者强调业务区域指导与更高分辨率诊断预报之间的互补作用。
Motivation: 喀拉拉邦的极端季风降雨因阿拉伯海水汽输送、中尺度对流、海岸辐合以及西高止山脉的强烈地形强迫相互作用，给业务预报带来重大挑战。
Method: 对 WFS 进行空间验证与诊断评估，将其降雨空间结构与全球模式指导产品进行对比分析，检验其对地形相关降雨走廊和局地高强度降雨结构的再现能力。
Result: 空间分析表明，WFS 复现了主要的西高止山脉走向降雨走廊，并且对局地高强度降雨结构的刻画比更平滑的全球模式指导更为清晰。
Conclusion: 结果展示了业务区域指导与更高分辨率诊断预报的互补作用，并强调区域特定校准、空间验证以及跨多个季风事件和预报时效持续评估的重要性。
Relevance: 84

papers.title: Deep probabilistic logic programming for diagnostic reasoning from incomplete information: A case study in stroke detection
papers.abstract_en: In medical applications, raw data is frequently associated with significant privacy concerns, lending particular importance to the encoding of summary statistics from the literature. On the other hand, deep learning has become an invaluable tool for assessing symptoms based on visual or auditory sensor data. DeepProbLog allows for an extensible neuro-symbolic approach that accommodates connectionist components to analyse patient images within a transparent and rigorous probabilistic framework, namely probabilistic logic programming under the distribution semantics. Framed as a case study in stroke detection from multimodal data, this contribution explores the pathway from summary statistics available in the literature to a DeepProbLog-based diagnostic system. It suggests a workflow using established maximum entropy techniques to complete available probabilistic information and the probabilistic logic programming system ProbLog 2 to move from the entropy-maximising causal model to a discriminative neuro-symbolic model expressible within DeepProbLog. The relative performance of models derived from less complete data is analysed alongside the potential of the probabilistic inductive logic programming system ProbFOIL 2 for compressing large discriminative models, and the perspectives and implications of using DeepProbLog for diagnostic reasoning are discussed.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at IJCLR 2026. This is the accepted version, _not_ the camera-ready version for the post-proceedings of the conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以中风检测为案例，研究如何用 DeepProbLog 进行基于不完整信息的诊断推理。作者提出从文献中的汇总统计量出发，借助最大熵技术补全概率信息，再通过 ProbLog 2 建立熵最大化的因果模型，并转化为 DeepProbLog 中可表达的判别式神经符号模型。摘要还分析了不完整数据下模型的相对性能，以及 ProbFOIL 2 压缩大型判别模型的潜力。
Motivation: 医疗应用中原始数据常涉及严重隐私问题，因此利用文献中的汇总统计量进行编码尤为重要；同时深度学习在基于视觉或听觉传感器数据的症状评估中很有价值，需要一种能整合连接主义组件且保持透明严谨的概率框架。
Method: 提出一条从文献汇总统计量到 DeepProbLog 诊断系统的工作流：使用最大熵技术补全可用的概率信息，用概率逻辑编程系统 ProbLog 2 从熵最大化的因果模型过渡到 DeepProbLog 中可表达的判别式神经符号模型，并探讨用概率归纳逻辑编程系统 ProbFOIL 2 对大型判别模型进行压缩。
Result: 作为多模态中风检测的案例研究，摘要未报告具体量化指标，主要比较了源自不完整数据的模型的相对性能，并分析了 ProbFOIL 2 的压缩能力。
Conclusion: 作者讨论了 DeepProbLog 用于诊断推理的前景和影响，认为从文献统计量到可运行的诊断系统的路径可行，但具体效果仍需结合案例细节评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Differentiate the Solver, Not the Equation: Reverse-Sweep Adjoints for Block Implicit Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Differentiable simulation is a key component in learning, control, and inverse problems, where gradients through nonlinear implicit solvers are required. Existing approaches either rely on unrolled automatic differentiation, whose memory grows with solver depth, or on equation-level implicit differentiation, which assembles global Jacobians and solves large sparse adjoint systems, discarding the locality of the forward solver -- and differentiating the converged equation rather than the finite computation that actually ran. We propose solver-level differentiation, which differentiates the executed solver itself. When a solver is composed of block implicit updates, its discrete adjoint is obtained by applying the corresponding adjoint updates in reverse order, yielding a reverse-sweep formulation whose backward pass mirrors the forward solver. From an operator perspective, the forward pass realizes an approximate inverse through ordered local solves, and the backward applies its transpose through reverse local adjoint solves, constructing no global system. We instantiate this idea on Vertex Block Descent, yielding a differentiable solver whose reverse colored Gauss-Seidel sweeps are composed entirely of local $3\times 3$ adjoint solves. The backward matches automatic differentiation through the identical executed forward to machine precision at every solver depth, where the equation-level adjoint is off by 37% after one sweep; in a controlled same-codebase, same-GPU comparison it is 33x faster and uses 71x less memory than unrolled automatic differentiation; and the same construction is exact on projective dynamics and extended position-based dynamics. We scale differentiable elastodynamics to $10^6$ contact-coupled soft bodies (8M vertices) on one GPU. Overall, this work highlights solver structure as a practical organizing principle for efficient differentiable simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种求解器级微分 (solver-level differentiation) 框架，用于块隐式可微仿真：不对方程做隐式微分，而是对实际执行的求解器本身进行反向扫描，得到与正向求解器镜像的离散伴随形式。作者将该思想实例化到 Vertex Block Descent 上，得到由局部 3×3 伴随求解组成的反向彩色 Gauss-Seidel 扫描，并报告其在精度、速度和内存上均显著优于展开式自动微分，且可扩展到百万量级软体。
Motivation: 现有可微仿真方法要么使用展开式自动微分导致内存随求解器深度增长，要么使用方程级隐式微分来组装全局 Jacobian 并求解大型稀疏伴随系统，丢弃了正向求解器的局部性且微分的对象是收敛方程而非实际运行的计算。
Method: 提出求解器级微分：当求解器由块隐式更新组成时，按逆序应用对应的伴随更新得到反向扫描 (reverse-sweep formulation)。从算子视角看，正向过程通过有序局部求解实现近似逆算子，反向过程通过局部伴随求解实现其转置，且不构造全局系统；在 Vertex Block Descent 上具体化为仅含局部 3×3 伴随求解的彩色 Gauss-Seidel 反向扫描。
Result: 摘要报告该反向过程在任意求解器深度下都与相同正向执行的自动微分在机器精度内一致，而方程级伴随在单次扫描后误差达 37%；在受控的同代码库、同 GPU 对比中，比展开式自动微分快 33 倍且内存少 71 倍；同一构造在 projective dynamics 和 extended position-based dynamics 上精确成立，并将可微弹性动力学扩展到单 GPU 上 10^6 个接触耦合软体（8M 顶点）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调求解器结构可以作为高效可微仿真的实用组织原则，并指出该构造在多种块隐式求解器上具有通用性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OpenVisTool: An Open Recipe for Synthesizing Instructive Visual Tool-Use Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Visual tool use has emerged as a fundamental capability for multimodal agents to actively acquire evidence beyond a fixed image encoding. The prevailing recipe learns this capability from teacher-generated trajectories filtered for answer correctness, implicitly assuming that every successful demonstration provides effective supervision. We argue this assumption is flawed: a strong teacher often reaches the correct answer without needing its tool calls, and imitating such trajectories teaches a student that tool calls accompany correct answers, not that tool observations ground them. We present OpenVisTool, an open framework for constructing instructive visual tool-use trajectories that provide effective supervision for tool learning. The key insight is that a trajectory should be retained only if its answer is correct (outcome validity) and its tool observations causally contribute to that answer (causal utility). The framework operates in three stages: difficulty screening to select queries that are not reliably answerable without tools, domain-specific trajectory synthesis to elicit coherent tool-use trajectories, and supervision verification to jointly test both conditions. Rather than encouraging models to imitate tool calls, the resulting supervision teaches when and how visual evidence should be acquired. Using this framework, we construct OpenVisTool-42K, a dataset spanning five visual reasoning domains, together with OpenVisTool-Bench, a benchmark covering the same domains. Across four backbones (4B-27B), fine-tuning on OpenVisTool-42K consistently improves visual tool-use performance and yields gains on two out-of-distribution benchmarks; the larger models approach leading closed-source systems. The evidence suggests that effective visual tool use is learned from causally grounded supervision rather than tool-calling patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OpenVisTool，一个用于构建具有指导性的视觉工具使用轨迹 (visual tool-use trajectories) 的开放框架。核心观点是：仅当轨迹的答案正确（结果有效性）且工具观察对答案有因果贡献（因果效用）时才应保留该轨迹。框架包含难度筛选、领域特定轨迹合成和监督验证三个阶段，并据此构建了 OpenVisTool-42K 数据集与 OpenVisTool-Bench 基准。在四个 backbone（4B-27B）上微调一致提升视觉工具使用性能，并在两个分布外基准上取得增益，大模型接近领先闭源系统。
Motivation: 现有方法从教师生成轨迹中筛选答案正确的样本进行模仿，但强教师常常无需工具调用也能答对，这类轨迹只会让学生学会“工具调用伴随正确答案”，而非“工具观察支撑答案”，因此无法提供有效的工具学习监督。
Method: 提出三阶段框架：先进行难度筛选，选出不借助工具难以可靠回答的查询；再进行领域特定的轨迹合成，生成连贯的工具使用轨迹；最后进行监督验证，联合检验结果有效性与因果效用，只保留同时满足两个条件的轨迹。
Result: 基于该框架构建的 OpenVisTool-42K 覆盖五个视觉推理领域，OpenVisTool-Bench 覆盖相同领域。在四个 backbone（4B-27B）上微调均提升视觉工具使用性能，并在两个分布外基准上获得增益；较大模型接近领先闭源系统的水平。
Conclusion: 摘要认为有效的视觉工具使用应从因果基础的监督中学习，而非模仿工具调用模式；该框架提供的监督教模型“何时以及如何获取视觉证据”。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SC-Diff: Semantically Calibrated Diffusion for Visible-to-Infrared Image Translation
papers.abstract_en: Visible-to-infrared image translation provides a practical way to expand infrared training data using abundant visible images. Diffusion models are promising for this task because of their strong generative performance. However, existing diffusion-based methods typically use semantic priors only as external conditions, without explicitly regulating token interactions within the denoising network. Consequently, they struggle to preserve object locations, shapes, and semantic layouts required for reliable annotation reuse. We propose SC-Diff, a semantically calibrated latent diffusion framework that uses semantic priors for both conditional guidance and internal self-attention calibration. A pretrained SAM3 model with predefined text prompts first extracts category-specific semantic masks from visible images. These masks are merged into a semantic map and fused with the visible image as the input condition. The same map is converted into token-level semantic labels to calibrate self-attention in the denoising network. Based on these labels, we introduce Semantic-Guided Self-Attention Calibration (SGSC), which adaptively applies positive biases to query-key pairs of the same category. The query-wise calibration strength depends on the dispersion of attention across semantic categories and the attention assigned to the query's own category. The original attention scores further modulate the bias, giving greater calibration to same-category keys with stronger responses. This soft calibration reduces cross-category interference while retaining global contextual interactions, thereby improving semantic consistency in generated infrared images. Extensive experiments show that SC-Diff improves perceptual quality and produces more effective synthetic training data for downstream infrared object detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SC-Diff，一个语义校准的潜在扩散框架，用于可见光到红外图像翻译。它利用预训练 SAM3 提取的语义掩码同时作为外部条件输入和去噪网络内部自注意力的校准信号，并提出 Semantic-Guided Self-Attention Calibration (SGSC)。实验表明该方法提升了生成图像的感知质量，并为下游红外目标检测提供了更有效的合成训练数据。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的可见光到红外翻译方法通常只把语义先验当作外部条件，没有显式调控去噪网络内部的 token 交互，因此难以保持物体位置、形状和语义布局，不利于标注的可靠复用。
Method: 使用预训练 SAM3 配合预设文本提示从可见图像提取类别语义掩码，合并为语义图后与可见图像融合作为输入条件；同一语义图被转换为 token 级语义标签，用于校准去噪网络中的自注意力。提出的 SGSC 根据注意力在语义类别上的分散程度以及 query 自身类别的注意力强度，对同类别 query-key 对自适应施加正偏置，并由原始注意力分数调节偏置幅度。
Result: 大量实验表明，SC-Diff 能改善生成图像的质量，并能为下游红外目标检测任务产生更有效的合成训练数据。摘要未给出具体量化数字。
Conclusion: 这种软校准方法在降低跨类别干扰的同时保留全局上下文交互，从而提升生成红外图像的语义一致性。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有基于扩散的可见光到红外翻译方法通常只把语义先验当作外部条件，没有显式调控去噪网络内部的 token 交互，因此难以保持物体位置、形状和语义布局，不利于标注的可靠复用。
summary_sections.method: 使用预训练 SAM3 配合预设文本提示从可见图像提取类别语义掩码，合并为语义图后与可见图像融合作为输入条件；同一语义图被转换为 token 级语义标签，用于校准去噪网络中的自注意力。提出的 SGSC 根据注意力在语义类别上的分散程度以及 query 自身类别的注意力强度，对同类别 query-key 对自适应施加正偏置，并由原始注意力分数调节偏置幅度。
summary_sections.result: 大量实验表明，SC-Diff 能改善生成图像的质量，并能为下游红外目标检测任务产生更有效的合成训练数据。摘要未给出具体量化数字。
summary_sections.conclusion: 这种软校准方法在降低跨类别干扰的同时保留全局上下文交互，从而提升生成红外图像的语义一致性。

papers.title: Transfer Learning-Enabled Distortion Compensation for Amplitude-Phase-Time Block Modulation-Based Nonlinear Single-Carrier Wireless Communications
papers.abstract_en: Power amplifier (PA) nonlinearity and memory effects significantly limit the spectral compliance, reliability, and energy efficiency of communication systems. To address this, we propose a transfer-learning-enabled, fully digital transceiver-cooperative method for amplitude-phase-time block modulation (APTBM)-based nonlinear single-carrier transmission under adjacent channel leakage ratio (ACLR) constraints. At the transmitter, iterative clipping and filtering (ICAF) and static digital pre-distortion (SDPD) act jointly to reduce signal peaks and suppress spectral regrowth without requiring wideband feedback. At the receiver, the inherent amplitude-phase constraints of APTBM provide weakly supervised prior knowledge for offline inverse-model pretraining, which is followed by the online few-shot adaptation of a lightweight digital post-distortion (DPoD) network. Subsequently, a cascaded DPoD and clipping-noise cancellation scheme systematically compensates for residual distortions induced by both the PA and ICAF. Simulation and measurement results demonstrate reliable transmission at an input back-off of approximately 2 dB under a 30-dBc ACLR constraint. Furthermore, the proposed DPoD approach significantly reduces online training time and computational overhead, delivering a performance gain of over 2 dB compared to conventional learning-based DPoD schemes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于幅度-相位-时间块调制 (APTBM) 的非线性单载波传输，提出一种利用迁移学习 (transfer learning) 的全数字收发机协同失真补偿方案，在邻道泄漏比 (ACLR) 约束下改善功率放大器 (PA) 非线性和记忆效应带来的性能损失。发射端联合使用迭代限幅滤波 (ICAF) 和静态数字预失真 (SDPD)，接收端利用 APTBM 的固有幅度-相位约束作为弱监督先验进行离线逆模型预训练，再通过在线 few-shot 自适应得到轻量级数字后失真 (DPoD) 网络，并与限幅噪声消除级联。仿真和实测结果显示在 30-dBc ACLR 约束下约 2 dB 输入回退 (input back-off) 即可可靠传输，且所提 DPoD 相比传统基于学习的 DPoD 减少在线训练时间和计算开销，并带来超过 2 dB 的性能增益。
Motivation: PA 非线性和记忆效应显著限制通信系统的频谱合规性、可靠性和能效；现有方案需在 ACLR 约束下同时抑制信号峰值和频谱再生，且宽带反馈成本高，亟需无需宽带反馈的失真补偿方法。
Method: 提出全数字收发机协同方案：发射端用 ICAF 与 SDPD 联合降低信号峰值并抑制频谱再生；接收端以 APTBM 的幅度-相位约束提供弱监督先验，先离线预训练逆模型，再在线进行轻量级 DPoD 网络的 few-shot 自适应，最后用 DPoD 与限幅噪声消除级联补偿 PA 和 ICAF 引入的残余失真。
Result: 仿真与测量结果表明，在 30-dBc ACLR 约束下可在约 2 dB 输入回退处实现可靠传输；所提 DPoD 显著缩短在线训练时间并降低计算开销，相比传统基于学习的 DPoD 方案获得超过 2 dB 的性能增益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将发射端 ICAF/SDPD 与接收端基于迁移学习的轻量级 DPoD 相结合，可在 ACLR 约束下系统性地补偿 PA 与 ICAF 造成的失真，同时降低在线训练成本；其适用范围为 APTBM 非线性单载波传输系统。

papers.title: MotionCraft: Latent World Modeling with Sparse Attention for Visual Upscaling
papers.abstract_en: Video super-resolution (VSR) aims to recover high-fidelity high-resolution videos from low-resolution inputs and is central to applications ranging from mobile capture to streaming and archival restoration. Existing approaches trade off among local-detail fidelity, long-range spatio-temporal modeling, perceptual realism, and efficiency: convolutional alignment techniques preserve local structure but suffer when motion is large or degradations are complex; transformer-based methods capture long-range dependencies yet require architectural or algorithmic adaptations to remain computationally feasible; and recent latent or diffusion-based generators synthesize rich texture but require specialized temporal constraints to maintain coherence. We present MotionCraft, a controllable VSR framework that formulates restoration as motion-aware latent state prediction inspired by world models and integrates adaptive sparse attention with an explicit user-accessible control interface. MotionCraft combines robust motion fusion, a Latent World Transformer that balances locality and targeted non-local interactions, and a compact conditional decoder to deliver temporally consistent, high-quality reconstructions under streaming constraints. Empirical evaluations show that MotionCraft achieves strong reconstruction and perceptual performance while enabling predictable trade-offs between temporal smoothness and reconstruction fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MotionCraft 是一个面向视频超分辨率 (VSR) 的可控生成框架，把恢复问题建模为借鉴世界模型 (world models) 的运动感知潜状态预测，并结合自适应稀疏注意力与显式用户控制接口。它由运动融合、Latent World Transformer 和紧凑条件解码器组成，目标是兼顾局部细节、长程时空建模、感知真实感与流式传输效率。摘要报告其在重建与感知性能上表现强，并可在时间平滑度与重建保真度之间提供可预测的权衡。
Motivation: 现有 VSR 方法难以同时兼顾局部细节保真、长程时空建模、感知真实感和计算效率：卷积对齐在大运动或复杂退化下受限，Transformer 方法依赖架构或算法改造来控制计算成本，潜变量或扩散生成器则需专门的时间约束来维持一致性。
Method: MotionCraft 将视频恢复表述为运动感知的潜状态预测，集成鲁棒运动融合、用于平衡局部性与定向非局部交互的 Latent World Transformer，以及紧凑的条件解码器，并提供一个用户可访问的控制接口来调节输出。
Result: 经验评估表明 MotionCraft 在重建与感知性能上均取得较强结果，同时能在时间平滑度和重建保真度之间实现可预测的权衡，并满足流式传输约束。
Conclusion: 作者认为将 VSR 建立为运动感知的世界模型式潜状态预测、配合自适应稀疏注意力，可以在流式约束下生成时间一致的高质量重建，同时让用户对时间平滑度与保真度的取舍可控。

papers.title: Curriculum Generation under Structured Parametric Environments for Robust Navigation Policies
papers.abstract_en: Robust navigation policies for autonomous agents must generalize across continuously varying environmental conditions such as turn rates, obstacles, friction, pits, and slopes. Curriculum generation provides a principled mechanism for improving generalization by progressively adapting training environments, but designing such curricula in a sample-efficient and automated manner remains challenging. This paper proposes a reparameterized curriculum generation framework for structured continuous environment parameters using unidirectional gradient-based optimization. To improve robustness in multimodal observation spaces consisting of image-based and scalar inputs, a distribution-shift regularization objective is incorporated to encourage the learning of finer-grained latent representations. The proposed method is evaluated across two continuous-control OpenAI Gym environments: a 2D obstacle-based Car Racing variant and Bipedal Walker variant, where coupled environment parameters jointly influence policy performance. Across five random seeds, our method consistently outperforms vanilla policy training, random parameter sampling, manual curricula, frontier-based methods, Self-Paced Reinforcement Learning (SPRL), Absolute Learning Progress with Gaussian Mixture Models (ALP-GMM), and reverse curriculum learning baselines. Ablation studies further demonstrate the effectiveness of the reparameterized curriculum mechanism across both environments, while highlighting environment-dependent benefits of the auxiliary regularization objective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对结构化连续环境参数的重参数化课程生成框架（reparameterized curriculum generation），通过单向梯度优化自动调整训练环境，并引入分布偏移正则化（distribution-shift regularization）以改进图像与标量组成的多模态观测空间中的潜在表征。方法在 2D 障碍物 Car Racing 变体和 Bipedal Walker 变体两个 OpenAI Gym 连续控制环境中评估，跨五个随机种子一致优于多种基线，消融实验验证了重参数化课程机制的有效性。
Motivation: 自主智能体的鲁棒导航策略需要在连续变化的环境条件（如转弯速率、障碍物、摩擦力、坑洞和坡度）下泛化；课程生成（curriculum generation）是提升泛化的原则性机制，但如何以样本高效且自动化的方式设计这类课程仍然具有挑战性。
Method: 提出针对结构化连续环境参数的重参数化课程生成框架，使用单向基于梯度的优化（unidirectional gradient-based optimization）逐步调整训练环境；为应对图像与标量输入构成的多模态观测空间，加入分布偏移正则化目标，鼓励网络学习更细粒度的潜在表征。
Result: 在五个随机种子下，该方法在 Car Racing 变体和 Bipedal Walker 变体上一致优于 vanilla 策略训练、随机参数采样、人工课程、frontier-based 方法、Self-Paced Reinforcement Learning (SPRL)、Absolute Learning Progress with Gaussian Mixture Models (ALP-GMM) 以及反向课程学习基线；消融研究显示重参数化课程机制在两种环境中均有效，而辅助正则化目标带来的收益依环境而定。
Conclusion: 摘要强调重参数化课程生成框架结合分布偏移正则化能在耦合环境参数下稳定提升导航策略性能，且消融实验表明课程机制的核心作用与辅助正则化的环境依赖性；其评估范围限于两个 2D 连续控制 OpenAI Gym 环境。

papers.title: When Skills Meet Safety: Benchmarking and Characterizing the Adaptive Jailbreak Robustness of Skill-Merged LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Model merging has become the default way to give an aligned language model new skills without retraining: a practitioner folds task vectors from math, code, or domain specialists into a safety-aligned base using task arithmetic, TIES, or DARE. This convenience is known to carry a safety cost, but almost all of that evidence rests on static refusal tests: fixed harmful prompts scored for compliance. We argue this is misleading. Because safety alignment is "shallow," concentrated in the first few generated tokens, a merged model's static refusal can stay clean while a real adaptive attack still breaks it. We introduce SkillSafe-Bench, a controlled benchmark that scores skill-merged models on static refusal, adaptive jailbreak robustness, and capability retention under a conservative two-judge AND rule. Across six open-weight bases (five families, two scales), static safety does not predict robustness to attack: under a semantic template attack, safe-looking merges on the fragile bases (both Qwen scales and Gemma) are jailbroken 60-76% of the time while others (Llama, Phi-4) stay robust. We further show the static effect of merging is base-conditional, characterize same-recipe abliteration-style safety erosion through a data-free geometric signal (the overlap of a task vector with a safety subspace), and outline SubSafe-Merge, which projects this overlap away to remove that erosion at held capability. Adaptive evaluation is not optional for merged LLMs: the models that most need it look safe under static screening.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出模型合并（model merging）在给已对齐的 LLM 增加技能时会有安全代价，但现有证据几乎都来自静态拒绝（static refusal）测试，这具有误导性：安全对齐集中在前几个生成 token 上，合并模型的静态拒绝可能干净，而真实自适应攻击仍能攻破。作者提出 SkillSafe-Bench 基准，在六个开放权重基础模型（五个系列、两个规模）上同时评估静态拒绝、自适应越狱鲁棒性和能力保持，并发现静态安全性无法预测攻击鲁棒性；同时给出数据无关的几何信号刻画任务向量与安全子空间的重叠，并勾勒了 SubSafe-Merge 方案。
Motivation: 现有关于合并模型安全性的证据几乎全部来自静态拒绝测试，即用固定有害提示打合规分；但安全对齐是“浅层”的，集中在最初几个生成 token，导致静态测试表现干净的合并模型仍然可能被自适应攻击攻破。
Method: 提出 SkillSafe-Bench，采用保守的双评判 AND 规则，对 skill-merged 模型同时测静态拒绝、自适应越狱鲁棒性与能力保持；并通过任务向量与安全子空间的重叠这一数据无关几何信号，表征同配方 abliteration 式安全侵蚀，提出 SubSafe-Merge 将该重叠投影去除以消除侵蚀。
Result: 在六个开放权重基础模型、五个系列、两个规模上的实验显示，静态安全不能预测攻击鲁棒性：在语义模板攻击下，属于脆弱基础族的 Qwen 两个规模和 Gemma 上，看似安全的合并模型有 60-76% 被越狱，而 Llama 与 Phi-4 保持稳健；合并的静态影响是基础模型条件性的。
Conclusion: 作者强调自适应评估（adaptive evaluation）对合并后的 LLM 不是可选项，因为最需要这类评估的模型在静态筛选中恰恰看起来是安全的。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文指出模型合并（model merging）在给已对齐的 LLM 增加技能时会有安全代价，但现有证据几乎都来自静态拒绝（static refusal）测试，这具有误导性：安全对齐集中在前几个生成 token 上，合并模型的静态拒绝可能干净，而真实自适应攻击仍能攻破。作者提出 SkillSafe-Bench 基准，在六个开放权重基础模型（五个系列、两个规模）上同时评估静态拒绝、自适应越狱鲁棒性和能力保持，并发现静态安全性无法预测攻击鲁棒性；同时给出数据无关的几何信号刻画任务向量与安全子空间的重叠，并勾勒了 SubSafe-Merge 方案。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有关于合并模型安全性的证据几乎全部来自静态拒绝测试，即用固定有害提示打合规分；但安全对齐是“浅层”的，集中在最初几个生成 token，导致静态测试表现干净的合并模型仍然可能被自适应攻击攻破。
summary_sections.method: 提出 SkillSafe-Bench，采用保守的双评判 AND 规则，对 skill-merged 模型同时测静态拒绝、自适应越狱鲁棒性与能力保持；并通过任务向量与安全子空间的重叠这一数据无关几何信号，表征同配方 abliteration 式安全侵蚀，提出 SubSafe-Merge 将该重叠投影去除以消除侵蚀。
summary_sections.result: 在六个开放权重基础模型、五个系列、两个规模上的实验显示，静态安全不能预测攻击鲁棒性：在语义模板攻击下，属于脆弱基础族的 Qwen 两个规模和 Gemma 上，看似安全的合并模型有 60-76% 被越狱，而 Llama 与 Phi-4 保持稳健；合并的静态影响是基础模型条件性的。

papers.title: Rethinking Attention Locality in Spiking Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Transformers provide a promising paradigm for efficient visual processing with spike-driven computation, yet their Softmax-free Spiking Self-Attention (SSA) struggles to establish spatially localized token interactions. Although existing locality-enhanced SSA methods improve accuracy, it remains unclear whether they consistently induce spatial locality across layers and different Spiking Transformer architectures. Through Mean Attention Distance (MAD) analysis, we reveal that computational locality does not necessarily translate into spatial locality and show that uniformly applying the same locality enhancement overlooks architecture-dependent deployment requirements. Motivated by these observations, we propose Spatially Contiguous Local Attention with Boundary Continuity Pathway (SCLA-BCP). SCLA computes attention within non-overlapping regions of spatially adjacent tokens, while BCP facilitates cross-boundary information exchange through a lightweight convolutional pathway. Furthermore, we develop a hierarchical locality deployment strategy to effectively apply SCLA-BCP across the two major Spiking Transformer architectures. Extensive experiments on seven static and neuromorphic datasets covering classification, detection, and segmentation demonstrate consistent improvements with limited parameter and energy overhead. Notably, our approach improves mAP@50 by up to 9.50% on COCO 2017 and mIoU by up to 3.42% on ADE20K. Visualizations, MAD analysis, and ablation studies further validate its effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Spiking Transformers 中注意力局部性问题，指出 Softmax-free Spiking Self-Attention 难以建立空间局部 token 交互。通过 Mean Attention Distance (MAD) 分析，作者发现计算局部性并不必然转化为空间局部性，且统一施加局部性增强会忽略架构相关的部署需求。为此提出 Spatially Contiguous Local Attention with Boundary Continuity Pathway (SCLA-BCP)，并在七个静态与神经形态数据集上验证了其有效性。
Motivation: Spiking Transformers 的 SSA 缺少空间局部交互能力，现有局部性增强方法在不同层和不同架构上是否一致地诱导空间局部性尚不明确，统一方法忽视了架构相关的部署要求。
Method: 提出 SCLA-BCP：SCLA 在空间相邻 token 的非重叠区域内计算注意力，BCP 通过轻量卷积路径实现跨边界信息交换；同时设计分层局部性部署策略，将该方法适配到两种主流 Spiking Transformer 架构。
Result: 在覆盖分类、检测和分割的七个静态与神经形态数据集上取得一致性提升，且参数与能量开销有限；其中 COCO 2017 上 mAP@50 最高提升 9.50%，ADE20K 上 mIoU 最高提升 3.42%。可视化、MAD 分析与消融实验进一步验证了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者强调计算局部性不等于空间局部性，局部性增强应根据架构进行分层部署；所提方法在多种视觉任务上以较小开销带来稳定收益。

papers.title: Can Graph Learning Learn Circuits?
papers.abstract_en: Circuit localization is a mechanistic interpretability task whose goal is to identify a sparse subgraph of a transformer's computation graph sufficient to reproduce a particular behavior. Most established methods localize circuits independently for each model--task pair. We instead frame circuit localization as a graph machine learning problem in which the edges of a computation graph represent computational pathways, and graph neural networks (GNNs) model interactions among these pathways. We introduce Graph Circuit Learning (GCL), a supervised, amortized framework that trains a GNN across multiple model--task pairs and applies it to unseen cases. To provide sufficient data, we augment the InterpBench benchmark with additional cases derived from the TracrBench programs. Of the 14 evaluated GCL configurations, the highest scored a median edge AUROC of $0.902$ (interquartile interval $[0.861, 0.942]$) on the 16 original held-out InterpBench cases. This is close to the published InterpBench median of $0.910$ for EAP-IG while remaining below ACDC's $0.959$. Removing all message-passing edges reduces the median to $0.825$. We also adapt PGExplainer, a GNN explainability method, to circuit localization, obtaining a median edge AUROC of $0.858$ on the same cases. These preliminary results suggest that graph machine learning offers a natural and potentially powerful perspective on circuit localization, and we hope this perspective encourages closer exchange between the two communities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把电路定位 (circuit localization) 重新表述为图机器学习问题，提出有监督、摊销化的 Graph Circuit Learning (GCL) 框架：用 GNN 对计算图中表示计算通路的边进行建模，跨多个模型-任务对训练后直接应用于未见过的案例。作者用 TracrBench 程序扩充 InterpBench 数据，在 14 种 GCL 配置中最佳配置于 16 个原始留出 InterpBench 案例上取得中位边 AUROC 0.902，接近已发表的 EAP-IG (0.910)，低于 ACDC (0.959)。
Motivation: 既有电路定位方法大多针对每个模型-任务对独立进行，缺乏跨案例的泛化能力；作者希望将电路定位视为图机器学习问题，以摊销方式学习可复用的通路交互模式。
Method: 将 transformer 计算图的边视为计算通路，用 GNN 建模边之间的相互作用；提出受监督的摊销式 GCL 框架，在多个模型-任务对上训练并应用到未见案例。为提供足够数据，作者用 TracrBench 程序扩充 InterpBench 基准，并评估了 14 种 GCL 配置，同时把 GNN 可解释性方法 PGExplainer 改造为电路定位基线。
Result: 最佳 GCL 配置在 16 个原始留出 InterpBench 案例上达到中位边 AUROC 0.902（四分位区间 [0.861, 0.942]），接近 EAP-IG 的 0.910，低于 ACDC 的 0.959；移除全部消息传递边后降到 0.825，PGExplainer 变体为 0.858。
Conclusion: 这些初步结果表明图机器学习为电路定位提供了自然且有潜力的视角，作者希望借此促进可解释性与图学习两个社区之间更密切的交流；结果仍属初步，尚未超越现有最优方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ERF-GS: Reconstructing Fast Motion from Disjoint Event-RGB Viewpoints
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning-driven representations such as neural radiance fields (NeRFs) and 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) have revolutionized the field of dynamic 3D scene reconstruction with improved visual precision and scalability. However, the reconstruction of fast-moving objects remains a challenge; existing methods based on conventional frame-based videos often struggle in scenarios such as sports events and animal videography. We propose an event-RGB fusion Gaussian splatting (ERF-GS) framework that integrates event information into both optimization and densification stages of the Gaussian splatting pipeline, taking advantage of novel event sensors with high frame-rate. Unlike many other event-assisted scene reconstruction methods, ERF-GS was developed using realistic simulation settings and realizes event-based learning detached from RGB inputs. This design enables its application beyond straightforward synthetic data into the realm of natural video with complex layout, low frame rates and severe motion blur. Our experiments show that ERF-GS outperforms both the 4DGS baseline and the concurrent E-D3DGS on different variants of the Neu3D and Nvidia datasets which include blurry RGB frames and disjoint RGB-event viewpoints. Our code is available at https://github.com/andrewbxy/ERF-GS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出事件-RGB 融合的高斯泼溅框架 ERF-GS，用于从高速运动场景的 RGB 帧与事件流重建动态 3D 场景。框架将事件信息同时引入 3DGS 的优化与致密化阶段，并在现实仿真设置下实现脱离 RGB 输入的事件学习。实验显示其在 Neu3D 和 Nvidia 数据集变体上超越 4DGS 基线和并行的 E-D3DGS，尤其在带运动模糊的低帧率 RGB 帧与不相交事件-RGB 视角场景中。
Motivation: 基于帧的传统视频方法在体育赛事、动物拍摄等快速运动场景中难以重建动态 3D 场景，因为低帧率和运动模糊导致信息不足。现有事件辅助重建方法多依赖合成数据或 RGB 输入耦合，难以泛化到复杂布局和真实自然视频。
Method: 提出 ERF-GS 框架，将事件相机的高时间分辨率信息融合进 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 的优化和致密化两个阶段，并采用现实仿真设置使事件学习部分不依赖 RGB 输入。
Result: 在包含模糊 RGB 帧和不相交 RGB-事件视角的 Neu3D 与 Nvidia 数据集变体上，ERF-GS 性能优于 4DGS 基线和并行的 E-D3DGS。
Conclusion: 作者强调该设计使方法能应用于布局复杂、低帧率且存在严重运动模糊的自然视频，而不仅限于合成数据，代码已公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Task-to-Model Optimization for Enterprise LLM Coding Assistants: A Data-Driven Framework for Cost-Optimal Routing
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise AI coding assistants incur substantial inference spend, and naive token-cost minimization often fails to reduce end-to-end cost once retries, escalations, and developer wait time are included. We present Task-to-Model Optimization (T2MO), a data-driven methodology for optimizing model selection in production coding workflows. We treat each developer session as a task that can be discovered, classified, graded for difficulty, benchmarked in a production-like harness, and routed to the cheapest model able to complete it within quality and latency constraints. The framework is a nine-stage pipeline spanning telemetry instrumentation, taxonomy discovery, difficulty grading, benchmark construction, candidate evaluation, optimal mix derivation, forecasting and version planning, staged routing deployment, and continuous governance. Unlike token-centric routing rules, our objective is cost per completed task, with failure escalation priced in explicitly. We show that this expected-completion-cost objective weakly dominates token-cost minimization under escalation, and we derive the routing boundary, the minimum pass rate a cheaper model must reach on a given cell to be worth deploying. Decisions are organized as a two-level hierarchy of task category difficulty tier, and per-cell displacement opportunities are aggregated into a traffic-weighted savings waterfall that ranks replacement candidates by realized dollar impact. The framework supports developer guidance, spend forecasting, and a staged transition from static policies to shadow-mode classifiers, verified cascades, and ultimately an intelligent router. We describe the methodology, optimization objective, evaluation protocol, and governance loop in a form suitable for production deployment and future empirical study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Task-to-Model Optimization (T2MO)，一个面向企业级 LLM 编程助手的、数据驱动的模型选择优化框架。框架把每个开发者会话视为一个可发现、分类、难度分级、在生产型测试环境中评测并路由的任务，目标是选择能在质量和延迟约束下完成任务的最便宜模型。摘要强调其优化目标不是 token 成本，而是包含失败升级 (escalation) 成本的每完成任务成本 (cost per completed task)。
Motivation: 企业 AI 编程助手会产生大量推理支出，而单纯的 token 成本最小化在计入重试、升级和开发者等待时间后往往无法降低端到端成本。
Method: 提出九阶段流水线，涵盖遥测埋点、分类法发现、难度分级、基准构建、候选模型评估、最优模型组合推导、预测与版本规划、分阶段路由部署和持续治理；决策采用任务类别难度层级的二级层次结构，并用流量加权节省瀑布 (savings waterfall) 按实际美元影响对替换候选排序。
Result: 摘要从理论上表明，在存在升级的情况下，期望完成成本目标弱支配 token 成本最小化，并推导出路由边界，即更便宜模型在给定单元格上值得部署所需达到的最低通过率。
Conclusion: 框架支持开发者指导、支出预测以及从静态策略到影子模式分类器、再到智能路由器的分阶段演进；摘要称其适合生产部署和未来实证研究，但本文本身未报告实证结果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Out-of-Distribution Federated Distillation with Domain-Aware Proxy
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning is a distributed machine learning paradigm that trains a global model by aggregating local clients without sharing private data of each client. Federated Distillation (FD) builds upon this paradigm by leveraging knowledge distillation to exchange soft predictions on proxy data instead of model parameters, enabling more efficient communication and supporting heterogeneous model collaboration. However, FD models trained on In-Distribution data are hardly adapted to Out-of-Distribution (OOD) scenarios. In this paper, we propose a domain-aware proxy selection framework to better adopt proxy data for OOD problems. The experimental results show that the proposed models effectively address the challenges of distribution shifts under OOD with and without proxy data by achieving average 82.9\% and 80.6\% over existing works on standard benchmarks. The codes and data are released in https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DPS-FD-8596.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦蒸馏 (Federated Distillation, FD) 在分布外 (Out-of-Distribution, OOD) 场景下泛化能力不足的问题，提出一种域感知代理选择 (domain-aware proxy selection) 框架。摘要报告该方法在标准基准上、分别在有/无代理数据的 OOD 情境下，相较现有工作平均提升 82.9% 和 80.6%。代码与数据已公开。
Motivation: 联邦蒸馏利用代理数据上的软预测进行知识交换，但基于 In-Distribution 数据训练的 FD 模型难以适应 OOD 场景，分布偏移成为其实际部署的关键障碍。
Method: 提出域感知代理选择框架，用于更好地选择与适配代理数据，以缓解 FD 在 OOD 条件下的分布偏移问题。
Result: 在标准基准上，所提方法在无代理数据和有代理数据的 OOD 情形下分别取得平均 82.9% 和 80.6% 的指标提升（相对现有工作）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能有效应对有无代理数据两种 OOD 分布偏移挑战，并公开了代码与数据以供复现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Discovering Diverse Planning Policies for Multimodal Embodied Agents with Quality-Diversity Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal embodied agents are increasingly required to solve long-horizon tasks by integrating visual observations, textual goals, and interaction history into closed-loop decision making. However, state-of-the-art large-model-based planners often rely on a single dominant planning style during execution. Once this execution mode becomes ineffective, the agent may remain stalled for many steps, repeatedly interacting with the environment without making meaningful progress. We address this limitation by proposing a Quality-Diversity (QD) framework for discovering diverse planning policies for multimodal embodied agents. The proposed method treats planning-policy templates as evolvable individuals and organizes them into a behavior-indexed archive rather than collapsing search to a single prompt style. In the offline stage, rollout trajectories are summarized into structured success and failure experiences, which guide policy variation through recombination and experience-guided mutation. The resulting policies are mapped into a behavior space defined by interaction intensity and goal-directedness, and the highest-quality policy in each niche is retained in the archive. In the online stage, the agent executes one policy at a time while monitoring task progress. When persistent stall is detected, the system rolls back to the latest checkpoint and switches to a behaviorally distinct archive policy to resume execution. Experiments on the ThreeDWorld transport benchmark show that the proposed framework improves both task success and interaction efficiency over representative baseline planners. These results suggest that discovering diverse policy repertoires is an effective way to support adaptive multimodal planning and online failure recovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于质量多样性（Quality-Diversity, QD）优化的框架，用于为多模态具身智能体发现多样化的规划策略。作者将规划策略模板视为可进化的个体，并组织成按行为索引的档案库，而不是将搜索收敛到单一提示风格。离线阶段利用轨迹数据总结成功与失败经验来指导策略变异，在线阶段在检测到持续停滞时回滚到最近检查点并切换到行为不同的策略继续执行。在 ThreeDWorld 运输基准上的实验表明，该框架相比代表性基线规划器同时提升了任务成功率和交互效率。
Motivation: 现有多模态具身智能体的规划器通常依赖单一的主导规划风格，一旦该执行模式失效，智能体会与环境反复交互却长期停滞，无法推进任务。
Method: 提出 QD 框架：将规划策略模板作为可进化个体，存入按行为索引的档案库；离线阶段将 rollout 轨迹总结为结构化成功与失败经验，通过重组和经验引导的突变产生策略变异，并按交互强度与目标导向性映射到行为空间，每个小生境保留最高质量策略；在线阶段每次执行一个策略并监控任务进度，检测到持久停滞时回滚到最新检查点并切换到行为上不同的档案策略。
Result: 在 ThreeDWorld 运输基准上的实验显示，该方法相比代表性基线规划器同时改善了任务成功率和交互效率。
Conclusion: 作者认为发现多样化的策略档案库是支持多模态自适应规划与在线失败恢复的有效途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Combined Feature-Based Framework for Disguise and Spoofing Detection in Face Recognition Systems
papers.abstract_en: Face recognition systems face two distinct, commonly-separated failure modes: spoofing, where an impostor presents a photograph or video of an authorized user, and disguise, where a legitimate user is rejected because their appearance differs from their enrolled template due to accessories, facial hair, illumination, or pose. This paper proposes and compares five combined feature-extraction and classification pipelines that address both problems within a single framework: PM (PCA and Minimum Euclidean Distance, MED), LPM (Local Binary Patterns with PCA and MED), HPM (Histogram of Oriented Gradients with PCA and MED), SM (Speeded-Up Robust Features with MED), and HM (Harris corner features with MED). Each pipeline follows a common two-phase process comprising pre-processing, feature extraction, feature filtering, and classification. The methods were trained on 115 subjects drawn from the FEI, Disguised Faces Database, and NUAA databases and evaluated on six test conditions covering mixed appearances, frontal faces, dark illumination, left- and right-turned poses, and photo-spoofing attempts. The HOG-based pipeline (HPM) achieved the most consistent performance across conditions, with 94.59% accuracy on mixed-appearance disguise, 81.5-93.2% across pose and illumination variants, and 91.67% on spoofing, while the LBP-based pipeline (LPM) achieved the highest spoofing-detection accuracy (93.2%) but weaker robustness to pose change. These results reveal a measurable trade-off between spoof sensitivity and disguise robustness among classical feature representations, motivating the deep-learning and cross-database extensions discussed in the concluding sections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对人脸识别系统中两个常被分开处理的失效模式——欺骗攻击 (spoofing) 与伪装 (disguise)——提出一个统一框架，比较了五种特征提取与分类流水线：PM (PCA+MED)、LPM (LBP+PCA+MED)、HPM (HOG+PCA+MED)、SM (SURF+MED) 和 HM (Harris 角点+MED)。方法在来自 FEI、Disguised Faces Database 和 NUAA 的 115 个主体上训练，并在六种测试条件下评估。结果表明基于 HOG 的 HPM 在各条件下最稳定，而基于 LBP 的 LPM 在欺骗检测上准确率最高但姿态鲁棒性较弱。
Motivation: 人脸识别系统面临两种通常被分开研究的失败模式：欺骗攻击（冒名者出示授权用户的照片或视频）和伪装（合法用户因配饰、胡须、光照或姿态导致外观与注册模板不同而被拒绝）。该论文的目标是在单一框架内同时处理这两个问题。
Method: 提出并比较五种组合流水线，每种都遵循共同的二阶段流程：预处理、特征提取、特征过滤和分类。具体包括使用 PCA 与最小欧氏距离 (MED) 的 PM、加入局部二值模式 (LBP) 的 LPM、加入方向梯度直方图 (HOG) 的 HPM、使用加速稳健特征 (SURF) 与 MED 的 SM，以及使用 Harris 角点特征与 MED 的 HM。训练数据来自 FEI、Disguised Faces Database 和 NUAA 数据库，共 115 个主体。
Result: 基于 HOG 的 HPM 在混合外观伪装上准确率为 94.59%，在姿态与光照变体上为 81.5%-93.2%，在欺骗攻击上为 91.67%；基于 LBP 的 LPM 达到最高的欺骗检测准确率 (93.2%)，但对姿态变化的鲁棒性较弱。这些结果显示出经典特征表示在欺骗敏感性与伪装鲁棒性之间存在可量化的权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在经典特征表示中，欺骗检测灵敏度与伪装鲁棒性之间存在可测的权衡；这一发现为论文结尾部分讨论的深度学习扩展与跨数据库扩展提供了动机。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: eBIRD: Event-based Intensity Image Reconstruction Using Controllable Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Intensity-image reconstruction from event streams remains a challenging problem due to the binary, sparse, and asynchronous nature of event data. This work proposes eBIRD, an event-guided reconstruction framework that combines a DDPM with ControlNet-based conditioning. We analyze generic and specialized diffusion learning strategies for handwritten digit (N-MNIST) and face (RGBE-Gaze) reconstruction using 33ms event windows. On N-MNIST, the general model achieves the best reconstruction quality (MSE 0.0052, SSIM 0.8982, PSNR 23.34dB), whereas the specialized model performs best on RGBE-Gaze (MSE 0.0161, SSIM 0.7605, PSNR 19.08dB). These preliminary results suggest that controllable diffusion models are a promising approach for event-guided intensity-image reconstruction, while highlighting that the preferred learning strategy depends on the reconstruction domain.
papers.journal_ref: The 19th European Conference on Computer Vision Workshops (ECCVW 2026); Workshop on Neuromorphic Vision (NeVi)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 eBIRD，一种结合 DDPM 与 ControlNet 条件机制的事件引导强度图像重建框架。作者在 N-MNIST 手写数字与 RGBE-Gaze 人脸数据集上，用 33ms 事件窗口比较通用与专用扩散学习策略。结果显示 N-MNIST 上通用模型最优（MSE 0.0052，SSIM 0.8982，PSNR 23.34dB），RGBE-Gaze 上专用模型最优（MSE 0.0161，SSIM 0.7605，PSNR 19.08dB），表明可控制扩散模型在此任务上具有潜力且最优策略依域而变。
Motivation: 事件流具有二值、稀疏、异步特性，从事件流重建强度图像仍具挑战性，现有方法难以充分利用事件数据的时间与结构信息。
Method: 提出 eBIRD 框架，将扩散模型 DDPM 与基于 ControlNet 的条件机制相结合，以事件流为条件引导强度图像重建；并在手写数字与面部数据集上评测通用与专用两种扩散学习策略。
Result: 摘要报告 N-MNIST 上通用模型取得 MSE 0.0052、SSIM 0.8982、PSNR 23.34dB 的最佳重建质量；RGBE-Gaze 上专用模型取得 MSE 0.0161、SSIM 0.7605、PSNR 19.08dB 的最佳表现。
Conclusion: 初步结果表明可控制扩散模型是事件引导强度图像重建的有前景方向，但最优学习策略取决于具体重建域；作者将其明确为初步结果，未给出跨域一致的单一最优方案。
Relevance: 5
