papers.title: Reproducing and Stress-Testing Two Approaches to LLM Reasoning Reliability: Test-Time Probability Aggregation and Logic-Representation Editing
papers.abstract_en: We independently reproduce two recent methods for making large language model (LLM) reasoning more reliable, and stress-test them across domains and models (RPC across four new task domains with Qwen3-8B, LCF across four 7-8B models). The first, RPC, aggregates token probabilities and self-consistency at inference; the second, LCF, trains projectors that split hidden states into "content" and "logic" and edits the logic part toward a valid region. Validating such reliability claims matters because the original evaluations are run by each method's own authors and were never independently reproduced or stress-tested across models and domains, and LCF shipped no public code. We re-run RPC's published-path aggregation and re-implement LCF's projector, contrastive, and intervention pipeline, then extend both to text-to-SQL, legal extraction, fallacy identification, and precedent grading, and probe LCF's representation directly. RPC reproduces the original grid exactly on the authors' released reasoning paths; on four new domains its edge over self-consistency is never significant (ties or small mixed differences, paired p >= 0.28), and on BIRD, the one domain where we vary the budget, the edge grows with K as predicted but its largest gap (+2.5 accuracy at K=32, p=0.16) reverses to -0.25 when we enlarge the sample to n=200. LCF's logic-validity direction is real but weak (0.82 separability at the single best sub-layer versus 0.95 for a semantic-attribute control); its one positive effect (Qwen3 $Δ$Prob) is not significant (p=0.56), while it significantly reduces $Δ$Prob on two of the other three models.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Code, data, and experiment logs: https://github.com/rabqatab/llm-reasoning-reliability-reproduction
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文独立复现并压力测试了两种提升大语言模型（LLM）推理可靠性的方法：RPC（测试时概率聚合与自一致性）和 LCF（逻辑表征编辑）。作者将两者推广到四个新任务域与多个 7-8B 模型上，发现 RPC 在域外相对自一致性无显著优势，而 LCF 的逻辑方向虽真实但效果微弱，且在某些模型上出现显著负效应。
Motivation: 这两种方法的原始评估都由各自作者自行完成，从未被独立复现或跨模型、跨域压力测试；此外 LCF 没有公开代码。可靠性声明缺乏独立验证，因此作者认为有必要进行独立检验。
Method: 作者完整复现 RPC 的已发布路径聚合流程，并基于公开材料重新实现 LCF 的 projector、对比损失（contrastive）与干预（intervention）流水线；随后将两者扩展到 text-to-SQL、法律抽取、谬误识别和先例评分四个新域，并直接探测 LCF 的中间表征。
Result: RPC 在作者发布的推理路径上精确复现了原网格结果；在四个新域上其相对自一致性的优势从不显著（配对 p≥0.28）。在 BIRD 上优势随 K 增大而增长，但最大差距（K=32 时 +2.5 准确率，p=0.16）在样本扩到 n=200 后反转为 -0.25。LCF 的逻辑有效性方向真实但微弱（最优子层分离度 0.82，语义属性对照为 0.95）；其唯一正向效应（Qwen3 的 ΔProb）不显著（p=0.56），并在其余三个模型中的两个上显著降低 ΔProb。
Conclusion: 摘要强调独立复现和跨域压力测试的必要性，结果显示两类推理可靠性方法的效果在域外传播中明显缩水，尤其 LCF 的实际收益弱于原论文声称的水平。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.tldr: 本文独立复现并压力测试了两种提升大语言模型（LLM）推理可靠性的方法：RPC（测试时概率聚合与自一致性）和 LCF（逻辑表征编辑）。作者将两者推广到四个新任务域与多个 7-8B 模型上，发现 RPC 在域外相对自一致性无显著优势，而 LCF 的逻辑方向虽真实但效果微弱，且在某些模型上出现显著负效应。
summary_sections.motivation: 这两种方法的原始评估都由各自作者自行完成，从未被独立复现或跨模型、跨域压力测试；此外 LCF 没有公开代码。可靠性声明缺乏独立验证，因此作者认为有必要进行独立检验。
summary_sections.method: 作者完整复现 RPC 的已发布路径聚合流程，并基于公开材料重新实现 LCF 的 projector、对比损失（contrastive）与干预（intervention）流水线；随后将两者扩展到 text-to-SQL、法律抽取、谬误识别和先例评分四个新域，并直接探测 LCF 的中间表征。
summary_sections.result: RPC 在作者发布的推理路径上精确复现了原网格结果；在四个新域上其相对自一致性的优势从不显著（配对 p≥0.28）。在 BIRD 上优势随 K 增大而增长，但最大差距（K=32 时 +2.5 准确率，p=0.16）在样本扩到 n=200 后反转为 -0.25。LCF 的逻辑有效性方向真实但微弱（最优子层分离度 0.82，语义属性对照为 0.95）；其唯一正向效应（Qwen3 的 ΔProb）不显著（p=0.56），并在其余三个模型中的两个上显著降低 ΔProb。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调独立复现和跨域压力测试的必要性，结果显示两类推理可靠性方法的效果在域外传播中明显缩水，尤其 LCF 的实际收益弱于原论文声称的水平。

papers.title: Time Present and Time Past: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Temporally Evolving Document Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Evolving documents, such as laws, tax codes, and software documentation, are amended, replaced, and sometimes reverted over time, so a question has different correct answers at different dates. In contrast to encyclopedic knowledge, where an old fact is simply overwritten, an amendment is itself an official text that states what it replaces and when it takes effect, and the earlier version stays correct for its validity period. The central challenge is therefore version resolution, that is, identifying the version in force on the queried date. Existing temporal QA datasets treat time only as an annotation, so version resolution stays untested. We present TIDE, an expert-verified benchmark of 3,050 QA pairs over 644 official customs instruments issued between 1969 and 2025 by the Government of Bangladesh, covering eight task types over deeply code-mixed documents that are heterogeneous in layout and dated in two calendars. In addition, we evaluate nine recent LLMs under a single protocol across parametric, gold-context, and retrieval access, scored by a three-judge LLM council with a hard date gate separating correct meaning from correct time. The best macro-averaged accuracy is only 68.5%. Resolving a version from an implicit date reaches 59.7%, and detecting that the supplied version does not govern the query reaches only 26.7%. Models are more likely to find correct versions than to reject incorrect ones, and they tend to follow a confident parametric answer over the supplied authoritative text. All code and data are available at https://github.com/icsetepa44/TIDE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TIDE，一个由专家验证的时间演化文档理解基准，包含 3,050 个问答对，覆盖 1969 至 2025 年孟加拉国政府发布的 644 份海关公文，涉及八种任务类型，文档深度代码混合、排版异构且使用双历法。作者用统一协议在参数访问、黄金上下文和检索访问下评估九个近期 LLM，并由三法官 LLM 委员会配合硬性日期门控评分，最佳宏平均准确率仅 68.5%。研究还发现模型更易找出正确版本而非拒绝错误版本，并倾向于跟随自信的参数化答案而非提供的权威文本。
Motivation: 现有时间问答数据集仅把时间当作标注，版本解析（version resolution）未得到测试；而法律、税法和软件文档等演化文档在不同日期有不同的正确答案，旧版本在其有效期内仍然正确，这构成独特挑战。
Method: 构建专家验证的 TIDE 基准，将版本解析作为核心评测目标；在参数访问、黄金上下文和检索访问三种设置下评测九个 LLM，并用三法官 LLM 委员会与硬性日期门控（hard date gate）分离“含义正确”与“时间正确”。
Result: 最佳宏平均准确率为 68.5%；从隐式日期解析版本的准确率为 59.7%；检测给定版本不适用于查询日期的准确率仅 26.7%。模型更倾向于找到正确版本而非拒绝错误版本，且可能被自信的参数化答案带偏。
Conclusion: 作者强调版本解析是时间演化文档理解的核心难题，现有模型在此任务上表现有限，并公开全部代码与数据以推动后续研究。

papers.title: Towards Adaptive Super-Resolution and Quality Assessment via Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents doctoral research on adaptive video super-resolution and perceptual quality modeling under real-world conditions. Existing video super-resolution (VSR) methods struggle to generalize under unknown degradations arising from heterogeneous devices, codecs, and network environments. We address this challenge through test-time adaptation (TTA), a unified paradigm that improves robustness and perceptual quality without retraining or high-quality supervision. Specifically, we: 1) propose a TTA-based framework for no-reference video quality assessment (VQA), where adapted quality predictions provide perceptual guidance for VSR under unseen distortions; 2) develop a transformer-based architecture for screen-content super-resolution that preserves text clarity and structural fidelity; and 3) introduce a region-aware TTA strategy that selectively refines text and non-text regions without requiring high-resolution ground truth. Experimental results across diverse benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in perceptual quality and readability. We also outline ongoing work toward fully adaptive video enhancement systems capable of generalizing across unseen domains.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables, 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia, Accepted as Doctoral Symposium Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是面向 ACM MM 博士生论坛的研究摘要，探讨以测试时自适应 (Test-Time Adaptation, TTA) 统一解决真实场景下的视频超分辨率 (VSR) 与感知质量建模问题。作者提出基于 TTA 的无参考视频质量评估 (VQA)、面向屏幕内容超分辨率的 Transformer 架构，以及无需高清真值即可选择性细化文本与非文本区域的区域感知 TTA 策略。摘要称在多个基准上取得一致的感知质量与可读性提升。
Motivation: 现有视频超分辨率方法在来自异构设备、编码器和网络环境的未知退化条件下难以泛化，而重训练或依赖高质量监督并不现实。作者希望在不重训练、不借助高清真值的前提下提升模型鲁棒性和感知质量。
Method: 采用 TTA 作为统一范式，包含三部分：一是基于 TTA 的无参考视频质量评估，用自适应的质量预测为 VSR 提供感知引导；二是面向屏幕内容超分辨率的 Transformer 架构，以保持文字清晰度和结构保真；三是区域感知 TTA 策略，对文本与非文本区域进行选择性精化，且无需高分辨率真值。
Result: 摘要报告在多个不同基准上的实验均显示感知质量和可读性的持续改进，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者将其定位为博士阶段的研究，并指出后续工作将走向能够在未见领域泛化的全自适应视频增强系统。

papers.title: Understanding Calibration and Truncation Error Propagation in Training-Free Low-Rank Compression for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Training-free low-rank compression frameworks have been gaining prominence for LLM compression given their effectiveness in reducing model parameter count while maintaining task-level accuracy. However, existing SOTA frameworks share two key limitations: (1) residual errors in calibration data activations accumulate across layers during compression, causing misalignment between representations simulated at compression time and those experienced at inference; (2) the assumption that layer importance distribution is preserved post-compression does not hold. Together, these two effects introduce misalignment in the compression process in relation to the deployed model. We study these effects and propose a simple, training-free methodology compatible with existing frameworks to mitigate them, comprising: (1) Layer-by-Layer Compression with Calibration Correction; (2) Iterative Compression with Rank Allocation Correction. Implemented atop an existing SOTA decomposition framework, and evaluated on Llama and Qwen3 models across various benchmarks and compression rates, our approach demonstrates up to ~1-2.5 accuracy point improvements over per-weight and joint decomposition baselines on zero-shot tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无训练低秩压缩 (training-free low-rank compression) 框架在 LLM 压缩中的误差传播机制，指出两类关键缺陷：校准数据激活的残差误差跨层累积导致压缩时模拟表示与推理时不一致，以及“压缩后层重要性分布不变”的假设不成立。作者提出一个与现有框架兼容的简单无训练方法，在 Llama 和 Qwen3 模型上零样本任务中相比基线提升约 1–2.5 个准确率点。
Motivation: 现有 SOTA 无训练低秩压缩框架在降低参数量时存在两个被忽视的问题：校准数据激活残差在逐层压缩中累积，造成压缩期模拟与推理期表示错位；且压缩后各层重要性分布已被改变，原有假设失效。这两点使压缩过程与最终部署模型之间产生系统性偏差。
Method: 提出无需训练的修正方法，包含两部分：(1) 逐层压缩并配合校准修正 (Layer-by-Layer Compression with Calibration Correction)；(2) 迭代压缩并配合秩分配修正 (Iterative Compression with Rank Allocation Correction)。该方法可叠加在现有 SOTA 分解框架之上运行。
Result: 在 Llama 与 Qwen3 模型、多个基准与压缩率下进行评估，零样本任务上相比逐权重 (per-weight) 与联合分解 (joint decomposition) 基线获得约 1–2.5 个准确率点的提升。
Conclusion: 作者强调校准误差传播与截断误差 (truncation error) 对无训练低秩压缩的精度影响可被显式修正，从而提升压缩后模型与推理时行为的一致性。

papers.title: MathShikkha: A Controlled Study of Answer-Only and Chain-of-Thought Supervision for Bangla Mathematical Reasoning in Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Mathematical reasoning remains challenging in low-resource languages such as Bangla. We study whether teacher-generated Bangla Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision provides benefits beyond ordinary supervised fine-tuning. We construct \textsc{MathShikkha}, a Bangla mathematical reasoning dataset with GPT-5.4-generated rationales, and fine-tune four 4B--7B student models under a matched protocol in which answer-only and CoT conditions share data splits, response-only loss masking, decoding, and scoring, differing only in the training target. In-domain, CoT provides no significant improvement over answer-only fine-tuning for three stronger backbones (paired bootstrap 95\% CIs include zero; exact McNemar $p \geq 0.17$), despite generating 15--52$\times$ more tokens, but significantly improves the weaker 4B model by 18.56 points ($p < 0.0001$). On the larger, contamination-audited BanglaMATH benchmark, this pattern reverses: CoT significantly outperforms answer-only supervision for all four models by 20.1--28.1 points (all $p < 0.0001$). Answer-only fine-tuning also reduces out-of-domain accuracy below the base model for three models, whereas CoT preserves or improves it for all four. A human study with two co-author annotators, external-expert adjudication, and Cohen's $κ= 0.76$--$1.00$ finds no significant CoT improvement over the base model on reasoning-content criteria; instead, its measurable effect is target-language adherence and producing inspectable reasoning. Overall, rationale supervision's value depends on backbone capability and distribution shift: in this setting, its main benefits are Bangla adherence, auditable reasoning, and out-of-domain robustness rather than improved in-domain reasoning validity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究孟加拉语低资源数学推理中，教师生成的思维链（Chain-of-Thought）监督相对仅答案监督微调是否带来额外收益。作者构建 MathShikkha 数据集并使用 GPT-5.4 生成理由，在匹配协议下微调四个 4B–7B 学生模型。摘要报告域内测试中 CoT 对三个较强骨干无显著提升，但显著提升较弱模型；在更大的 BanglaMATH 基准上 CoT 全面占优，而人类研究显示其主要可测效果是目标语言遵循和可检查推理，而非推理内容本身的改进。
Motivation: 数学推理在孟加拉语等低资源语言中仍然困难，现有工作缺乏对教师生成的 CoT 监督是否真正优于普通监督微调（supervised fine-tuning）的受控证据。
Method: 构建 Bangla 数学推理数据集 MathShikkha，包含 GPT-5.4 生成的理由；在四个 4B–7B 学生模型上采用匹配协议进行微调，answer-only 与 CoT 条件共享数据划分、仅响应部分损失掩码、解码和评分设置，唯一差异是训练目标。
Result: 域内测试中，CoT 对三个较强骨干相对 answer-only 无显著提升（配对 bootstrap 95% CI 含零，McNemar p ≥ 0.17），但对较弱 4B 模型显著提升 18.56 点（p < 0.0001）；在经污染审计的 BanglaMATH 基准上，CoT 对全部四个模型显著领先 20.1–28.1 点（均 p < 0.0001）。answer-only 微调还使三个模型的域外准确率低于基础模型，而 CoT 对四个模型均保持或改善；人类研究（Cohen's κ = 0.76–1.00）未发现 CoT 在推理内容标准上的显著改进。
Conclusion: 理由监督的价值取决于骨干模型能力和分布偏移；在本设定中，其主要收益是孟加拉语遵循、可审计推理和域外鲁棒性，而非提升域内推理有效性。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 理由监督的价值取决于骨干模型能力和分布偏移；在本设定中，其主要收益是孟加拉语遵循、可审计推理和域外鲁棒性，而非提升域内推理有效性。

papers.title: Linguistically-Aligned and Visually-Grounded Preference Optimization for Clinically-Augmented Medical Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Despite significant advances in Medical Report Generation (MRG), the reliability remains constrained by the prevalence of factual errors. While Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has emerged as a promising post-training paradigm to enhance the performance of Supervised Fine-Tuned (SFT) MRG models, existing DPO-based MRG methods typically adopt a naive preference construction that directly pairs model-generated reports with ground truth reports. This strategy inadvertently entangles critical clinical findings with clinically irrelevant linguistic characteristics, and fundamentally lacks explicit vision-language alignment. To address these challenges, we propose DPO-Clin, a novel post-training framework that focuses preference optimization on clinical findings and cross-modal alignment. First, we introduce the Entity-level Clinical Diagnostic (ECD) module to perform a precise entity-level factual diagnosis. ECD guides the generation of linguistically-aligned report preference pairs, isolating clinical discrepancies from linguistic variations. Second, to achieve fine-grained cross-modal alignment, we develop M$^2$DPO, a retrieval-augmented multi-modal DPO variant that enforces textual preference inversion triggered by visual context switches. Third, we locate correct yet highly uncertain predicted entities and apply counterfactual modifications to construct targeted preference data for latent risk mitigation, thereby further enhancing the model reliability. Extensive experiments on two public chest X-ray datasets (MIMIC-CXR and IU X-Ray) and an in-house endoscopy dataset demonstrate that DPO-Clin significantly improves the SFT baselines on clinical-aware metrics. Furthermore, it achieves superior performance over existing DPO-based MRG methods, exhibiting robust generalizability across distinct baseline architectures and diverse medical imaging modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DPO-Clin，一个面向医学报告生成（Medical Report Generation, MRG）的偏好优化后训练框架，旨在减少生成报告中的事实性错误。框架包含实体级临床诊断模块（ECD）、检索增强的多模态 DPO 变体 M²DPO，以及基于反事实修改的潜在风险缓解数据构造。在 MIMIC-CXR、IU X-Ray 和内窥镜数据集上的实验表明，该方法在临床相关指标上显著优于 SFT 基线及现有基于 DPO 的 MRG 方法。
Motivation: 现有 DPO 类 MRG 方法采用朴素偏好构造，直接将模型生成报告与真实报告配对，容易混淆关键临床发现与无关的语言特征，且缺乏显式的跨模态（vision-language）对齐，导致事实性错误仍是可靠性的主要瓶颈。
Method: 首先用 ECD 模块做实体级事实诊断，基于临床差异构造语言对齐的偏好对；其次提出 M²DPO，通过检索增强的多模态 DPO 在视觉上下文切换时触发文本偏好反转，实现细粒度跨模态对齐；最后定位正确但高不确定性的预测实体并施加反事实修改来构造针对性偏好数据，缓解潜在风险。
Result: 在两个公共胸部 X 光数据集（MIMIC-CXR、IU X-Ray）和一个院内内窥镜数据集上，DPO-Clin 在临床相关指标上显著提升 SFT 基线，并优于现有 DPO-based MRG 方法，且在不同基线架构和医学成像模态上表现出稳健的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将偏好优化聚焦于临床发现并增强跨模态对齐，能够有效提升 MRG 的可靠性与事实准确性，且该方法具备跨架构、跨模态的通用性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TrustRoboReward: Preference-Ordered Isotonic Score Editing for Multi-Paradigm Robot Reward Models
papers.abstract_en: Reward models are a bottleneck for reinforcement learning in embodied AI. Long-horizon robotic manipulation requires scalable vision feedback beyond handcrafted rewards or task-specific annotations. Existing open-source VLM reward judges like RoboReward adopt simple 1--5 trajectory progress scoring, lacking pairwise preferences for RLHF, DPO and Bradley-Terry frameworks, while failing to optimize video scene understanding. Augmenting RoboReward with pairwise comparison and video-QA supervision causes inconsistency between pairwise preferences and pointwise scores, introducing training noise and hurting downstream performance---an issue aggregation methods such as TrustJudge cannot resolve. To address this, we propose TrustRoboReward, a multi-paradigm reward modeling framework equipped with Preference-Ordered Isotonic Score Editing (POISE). We construct a unified four-paradigm dataset with trajectory progress scoring (Score-A), video-QA answer quality scoring (Score-B), and their pairwise counterparts (Pair-A, Pair-B). Pairwise labels align better with human judgment than pointwise scores, inspiring us to calibrate pointwise scores to avoid score-pair reversals against pairwise preferences. POISE rectifies pointwise scores and eliminates cross-paradigm reversal conflicts unresolved by TrustJudge. Theoretically, POISE reduces score-pair reversal conflicts from 20.15% to 0%, whereas TrustJudge retains 20.46% conflicts on the same corpus. Evaluated on our benchmark, Qwen3-VL-4B trained with POISE achieves an overall reward score of 77.96%, nearly matching GPT-5-mini (78.09%, gap 0.13%) and outperforming the strongest RoboReward-4B baseline by 10.13%. It also lifts test-time score-pair consistency to 71.90%, exceeding RoboReward-4B (57.26%) and GPT-5-mini (68.09%). Integrating TrustJudge aggregation during inference boosts the overall score to 78.57%, surpassing the GPT-5-mini teacher model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TrustRoboReward，一个面向机器人奖励建模 (reward modeling) 的多范式框架，并配备偏好有序等渗分数编辑 (Preference-Ordered Isotonic Score Editing, POISE)。针对开源 VLM 奖励评判器（如 RoboReward）中逐点分数 (pointwise scores) 与成对偏好 (pairwise preferences) 不一致的问题，POISE 通过校准逐点分数消除跨范式分数-对反转冲突。摘要报告该方法将理论反转冲突从 20.15% 降至 0%，并在机器人奖励评测上使训练出的模型接近 GPT-5-mini 教师模型。
Motivation: 奖励模型是具身 AI 中强化学习的瓶颈，长时程机器人操作需要可扩展的视觉反馈，而现有开源 VLM 奖励评判器只采用简单的 1–5 轨迹进度评分，缺乏 RLHF、DPO 和 Bradley-Terry 框架所需的成对偏好。简单加入成对比较和视频问答监督会引入逐点分数与成对偏好之间的不一致，造成训练噪声并损害下游性能，而 TrustJudge 等聚合方法无法解决该问题。
Method: 提出 TrustRoboReward 框架，核心是 POISE。论文构建统一的四范式数据集，包含轨迹进度评分 (Score-A)、视频问答答案质量评分 (Score-B) 及其成对版本 (Pair-A, Pair-B)，并利用成对标签与人类判断更一致的特点，通过 POISE 校准逐点分数以避免与成对偏好的分数-对反转。
Result: 理论上，POISE 将分数-对反转冲突从 20.15% 降至 0%，而 TrustJudge 在同一语料上仍保留 20.46% 冲突。在作者基准上，经 POISE 训练的 Qwen3-VL-4B 取得 77.96% 的总体奖励分数，几乎匹配 GPT-5-mini (78.09%)，并超出最强 RoboReward-4B 基线 10.13%；测试时分数-对一致性达到 71.90%，超过 RoboReward-4B (57.26%) 和 GPT-5-mini (68.09%)。推理时集成 TrustJudge 聚合可将总体分数提升至 78.57%，超过 GPT-5-mini 教师模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为，解决逐点分数与成对偏好之间反转冲突的关键在于分数校准而非仅靠推理时聚合，POISE 可消除跨范式反转冲突并提升下游奖励模型性能；与 TrustJudge 聚合结合可进一步超越教师模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: No Unique Minimizer, No Problem: On the Consistency of Robust Neural Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Neural network classifiers trained by cross-entropy minimization are highly sensitive to label noise and adversarial contamination. While robust alternatives offer bounded influence and resistance to corruption, their statistical foundations in the deep learning setting are insufficient due to a fundamental difficulty: neural parameterizations are non-identifiable, so the population loss minimizer is an equivalence class of parameters, not a unique point. We develop a consistency theory for robust neural classifiers based on the S-divergence family that requires no identifiability assumption. Casting training as stochastic optimization over a non-identifiable parameter space, we prove that empirical S-divergence minimizers converge to the population-optimal equivalence class under mild regularity conditions, and verify these conditions for three architecture choices. We further establish that limit points of the robust training algorithm are stationary points of the empirical objective. Experiments on vision and language benchmark datasets confirm that S-divergence training maintains clean-data accuracy while exhibiting performance competitive with existing robust methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于 S-divergence 族 (S-divergence family) 的鲁棒神经网络分类器的一致性理论。由于神经网络参数化不可辨识 (non-identifiable)，总体损失最小化子是一个等价类而非唯一参数点；作者在无需可辨识性假设的条件下证明经验 S-divergence 最小化子收敛到总体最优等价类，并验证了三种架构下的正则条件。实验表明 S-divergence 训练在视觉和语言基准上保持干净数据精度，并与现有鲁棒方法性能相当。
Motivation: 交叉熵训练的神经网络对标签噪声和对抗污染高度敏感，而现有鲁棒替代方法虽提供有界影响函数和抗污染能力，但在深度学习场景下缺乏统计基础，其根本困难在于神经网络参数化不可辨识，导致总体损失最小化子是一个参数等价类而非唯一参数点。
Method: 将训练建模为非可辨识参数空间上的随机优化，基于 S-divergence 族建立一致性理论；在温和正则条件下证明经验 S-divergence 最小化子收敛到总体最优等价类，并进一步证明鲁棒训练算法的极限点是经验目标的驻点 (stationary points)。作者对三种架构选择验证了所需的正则条件。
Result: 在视觉和语言基准数据集上的实验显示，S-divergence 训练在保持干净数据精度的同时，与现有鲁棒方法性能相当。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作去除了可辨识性假设，为鲁棒神经分类器的一致性提供了理论基础；未报告具体数值结果或方法局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RenderMatte: Exact-Alpha Rendering and Group-Relative Alignment for Image Matting
papers.abstract_en: Image matting is an essential enabling technology for modern visual content production, where foreground extraction determines the realism and editability of downstream creation workflows. However, precise alpha estimation in open-world scenes remains challenging because real foregrounds exhibit highly diverse appearances and opacity patterns. This makes existing methods struggle with semantic ambiguity and fine-grained opacity variation, especially in sparse boundary regions that are fragile and difficult to supervise. To address this gap, we present RenderMatte, a trimap-guided matting framework that adapts FLUX.1 Kontext through full-parameter fine-tuning, leveraging image editing priors for structure-preserving alpha prediction. During supervised adaptation, an alpha-edge objective preserves the latent flow-matching signal while strengthening pixel-space boundary supervision. We further introduce group-relative alpha alignment for post-training. It compares multiple mattes sampled under the same trimap condition using matting-specific rewards for alpha accuracy, boundary fidelity, trimap compliance, and compositional consistency. To overcome the lack of precise edge annotations, we construct the RenderMatte dataset, a large-scale synthetic dataset combining 3D-rendered RGBA foregrounds with diverse multi-source assets. It features exact strand-level alpha annotations and diverse background composites. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance across all benchmarks, demonstrating a scalable path toward high-fidelity matting in open-world scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RenderMatte，一个基于 trimap 引导的图像抠图框架，通过对 FLUX.1 Kontext 进行全参数微调来利用图像编辑先验进行结构保持的 alpha 预测。作者引入 alpha-edge 目标以在监督适配中强化像素级边界监督，并提出 group-relative alpha alignment 用于后训练，用抠图专属奖励比较同一 trimap 条件下的多个采样结果。为弥补精确边缘标注缺失，他们构建了包含 3D 渲染 RGBA 前景与多样背景合成的大规模合成数据集 RenderMatte，并报告在全部基准上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 开放世界场景中的精确 alpha 估计仍然困难，因为真实前景的外观和透明度模式高度多样，现有方法在稀疏边界区域面临语义模糊和细粒度透明度变化问题，边界区域脆弱且难以监督。
Method: 采用 trimap 引导的抠图框架，对 FLUX.1 Kontext 进行全参数微调；监督适配阶段使用 alpha-edge 目标保留潜在流匹配信号并强化像素空间边界监督；后训练阶段引入 group-relative alpha alignment，用针对 alpha 精度、边界保真度、trimap 一致性和合成一致性的抠图专属奖励比较同一 trimap 条件下采样的多个 matte。同时构建含精确 strand-level alpha 标注和多样背景合成的大规模合成数据集 RenderMatte。
Result: 实验表明该方法在所有基准上达到最先进性能，展示了面向开放世界高保真抠图的可扩展路径。
Conclusion: 论文强调利用图像编辑先验和合成数据可以在开放世界场景中实现高保真抠图，并指出这是可扩展的方法。

summary_sections.method: 采用 trimap 引导的抠图框架，对 FLUX.1 Kontext 进行全参数微调；监督适配阶段使用 alpha-edge 目标保留潜在流匹配信号并强化像素空间边界监督；后训练阶段引入 group-relative alpha alignment，用针对 alpha 精度、边界保真度、trimap 一致性和合成一致性的抠图专属奖励比较同一 trimap 条件下采样的多个 matte。同时构建含精确 strand-level alpha 标注和多样背景合成的大规模合成数据集 RenderMatte。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明该方法在所有基准上达到最先进性能，展示了面向开放世界高保真抠图的可扩展路径。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文强调利用图像编辑先验和合成数据可以在开放世界场景中实现高保真抠图，并指出这是可扩展的方法。

papers.title: HoloAegis: Frozen Representation, Topological Inference: Minimally Parametric Safety Manifolds for Zero-Shot LLM Guardrails
papers.abstract_en: Current LLM safety guardrails face a fundamental tension: fine-tuning distorts pre-trained representations while generative judges incur prohibitive inference costs. We challenge the prevailing paradigm by asking: can safety be achieved through pure geometric reasoning over frozen semantic representations? We present HoloAegis, a minimally parametric topological inference framework that decouples representation from reasoning. We term our approach minimally parametric because the only free parameters are the anchor count K and the temperature tau, both fixed after construction and requiring no gradient-based training. An un-fine-tuned encoder maps text to a unit sphere, after which all decisions are purely geometric. We formalize safety evaluation as a Gibbs-Boltzmann Free Energy computation over a pre-computed System Topology Anchor Bank, and we introduce Dual Time-Scale Exponential Moving Averages to detect progressive multi-turn semantic drift. Our key theoretical insight is a Topological Boundary Stability Conjecture: we provide theoretical motivation and strong empirical evidence that sparse anchor centroids stabilize the decision boundary against high-frequency lexical perturbations far better than full vector space methods. Evaluated across 8 benchmarks, HoloAegis achieves state-of-the-art accuracy (1.0000 AUC on AuthenHallu, 0.9802 on HarmBench) with sub-millisecond latency, zero cold-start data, and cross-lingual transfer (0.9758 AUC on Chinese CHIFRAUD).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HoloAegis 提出一种最小参数化 (minimally parametric) 的拓扑推理框架，用于 LLM 安全护栏 (guardrails)：将文本映射到单位球面后，完全基于几何推理做安全判断，无需微调编码器或梯度训练。作者将安全评估形式化为对预计算 System Topology Anchor Bank 的 Gibbs-Boltzmann 自由能计算，并用双时间尺度指数移动平均检测多轮语义漂移。在 8 个基准上报告了 SOTA 精度、亚毫秒延迟、零冷启动数据以及跨语言迁移能力。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 安全护栏面临根本性矛盾：微调会扭曲预训练表示，而生成式评判器 (generative judges) 推理成本过高。作者质疑主流范式，试图验证仅凭冻结语义表示上的纯几何推理能否实现安全判别。
Method: 提出 HoloAegis，其自由参数仅为 anchor 数量 K 和温度 tau，二者在构造后固定，无需梯度训练。未微调的编码器将文本映射到单位球面，之后全部决策均为几何计算；安全评估通过预计算的拓扑 anchor 库上的 Gibbs-Boltzmann 自由能完成，并引入 Dual Time-Scale Exponential Moving Averages 捕捉渐进式多轮语义漂移。核心理论是 Topological Boundary Stability Conjecture，即稀疏 anchor 质心比全向量空间方法更能稳定高频词法扰动下的决策边界。
Result: 在 8 个基准上，HoloAegis 在 AuthenHallu 上达到 1.0000 AUC，在 HarmBench 上达到 0.9802 AUC，并具备亚毫秒延迟、零冷启动数据以及跨语言迁移能力（中文 CHIFRAUD 上 0.9758 AUC）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将表示与推理解耦后，无需任何训练即可实现高效、稳健且可跨语言迁移的安全判别；稀疏 anchor 质心对词法扰动的边界稳定性得到理论与强经验证据支持。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SuperNeuroMAT: An Efficient Matrix-based Simulator for Spiking Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer a promising pathway to energy-efficient AI and brain-inspired computing. However, their widespread adoption is hindered by a lack of fast, accessible, and versatile simulation frameworks. In this paper, we introduce SuperNeuroMAT, an open-source, scalable, and highly efficient Python-based SNN simulator. We devise a novel matrix-based approach to model the leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neuron dynamics and natively support dense and sparse execution modes. This enables fast simulation of approximately 10,000 neurons in dense mode and 100,000 neurons in sparse mode on standard laptops and desktops without requiring specialized hardware. We demonstrate that SuperNeuroMAT consistently outperforms four established SNN simulators---NEST, Brian2, BindsNET, and snnTorch---on two performance metrics (execution speed and peak resident memory) and across various network sizes and connection probabilities. Furthermore, we demonstrate SuperNeuroMAT's applicability across a diverse set of problems. SuperNeuroMAT can efficiently handle conventional machine learning benchmarks such as the Digits and citation network datasets as well as neuromorphic event-based vision tasks such as N-CARS and ASL-DVS. Moreover, it can be extended beyond machine learning workloads and facilitate general-purpose workloads. We validated this by implementing the neuromorphic shortest path algorithm and two arithmetic primitives (addition and multiplication). SuperNeuroMAT can be installed via the Python Package Index (PyPI), thereby lowering the barrier to entry into the field of neuromorphic computing and accelerating the broader development of neuromorphic algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 SuperNeuroMAT，一个基于 Python 的开源、可扩展且高效的脉冲神经网络 (SNN) 模拟器。作者提出一种矩阵化方法建模 leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) 神经元动态，并原生支持稠密与稀疏两种执行模式，从而在普通笔记本电脑和台式机上无需专用硬件即可模拟约 10,000 个（稠密）与 100,000 个（稀疏）神经元。实验表明，SuperNeuroMAT 在执行速度和峰值内存两个指标上一致优于 NEST、Brian2、BindsNET 和 snnTorch，并在常规机器学习基准、神经形态事件视觉任务以及通用负载（最短路径、加法与乘法）上展示了广泛适用性。
Motivation: 脉冲神经网络在能效 AI 和类脑计算方面具有潜力，但缺乏快速、易访问且通用的仿真框架，阻碍了其广泛采用。
Method: 提出一种基于矩阵的模拟方法来表示 LIF 神经元动态，并原生支持稠密和稀疏执行模式；仿真器以开源 Python 包形式提供，可通过 PyPI 安装。
Result: 在标准硬件上，稠密模式可模拟约 10,000 个神经元，稀疏模式约 100,000 个神经元；在不同网络规模和连接概率下，执行速度与峰值内存均优于 NEST、Brian2、BindsNET 和 snnTorch。此外，该方法在 Digits、引文网络、N-CARS、ASL-DVS 等任务以及非机器学习通用负载上均得到验证。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SuperNeuroMAT 能够降低进入神经形态计算领域的门槛，并加速神经形态算法的更广泛开发。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RayLift: Lifting Complementary Ray-Wise Evidence with 3D Geometry Priors for Semantic Scene Completion
papers.abstract_en: Camera-based 3D semantic scene completion (SSC) provides comprehensive scene understanding for autonomous driving and robotics. However, existing methods often treat stereo depth estimates as deterministic geometric constraints, causing depth uncertainty and local correspondence errors to propagate directly into voxel representations. To address this issue, we propose RayLift, a framework that uses stereo geometry as a metric reference while incorporating complementary ray evidence to recover reliable 3D structures adaptively. RayLift first employs a Complementary Context Encoder that extracts geometry-aware priors from a frozen 3D vision foundation model, thereby enriching the scene context. It then introduces a Depth Ray Evidence Lifter module that jointly models geometric dissimilarity, depth confidence, and spatial uncertainty to adaptively sample and weight candidate surface locations along each camera ray. Finally, a Semantic-Aware Voxel Integrator injects the resulting ray evidence into voxel features by explicitly modeling their spatial support. Extensive experiments on SemanticKITTI and SSCBench-KITTI-360 demonstrate that RayLift achieves competitive performance and consistently outperforms existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RayLift，一个基于相机图像的 3D 语义场景补全 (Semantic Scene Completion, SSC) 框架。作者认为立体深度估计存在不确定性和局部匹配误差，直接作为几何约束会把这些误差传播到体素表示；RayLift 将立体几何作为度量参考，并引入互补的光线证据来自适应恢复可靠 3D 结构。在 SemanticKITTI 和 SSCBench-KITTI-360 上，摘要报告 RayLift 达到有竞争力的性能并一致优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有相机式 SSC 方法通常把立体深度估计当作确定性几何约束，导致深度不确定性和局部对应误差直接传播到体素表示，影响场景补全质量。
Method: 该方法包含三个模块：Complementary Context Encoder 从冻结的 3D 视觉基础模型中提取几何感知先验；Depth Ray Evidence Lifter 沿每条相机射线联合建模几何不相似性、深度置信度和空间不确定性，自适应采样并加权候选表面位置；Semantic-Aware Voxel Integrator 通过显式建模空间支持将光线证据注入体素特征。
Result: 在 SemanticKITTI 和 SSCBench-KITTI-360 上的实验表明，RayLift 达到有竞争力的性能，并一致优于现有方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为将立体几何作为度量参考并结合互补的射线证据，可以自适应恢复可靠的 3D 结构。该工作面向自动驾驶与机器人场景的相机式 SSC 任务。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Yesterday's Shield, Today's Spear: A Self-Evolving Safety Guardrail in Production
papers.abstract_en: Deployed LLM safety guardrails are predominantly static: trained once and frozen at release, while new jailbreak techniques and previously un-addressed harmful categories emerge within days, leaving the defense perpetually a step behind. We present SESG (Self-Evolving Safety Guardrails), a multi-agent system running in production. SESG monitors the live traffic behind a deployed guardrail and surfaces two classes of failure: jailbreaks novel in form and harmful categories novel in content. Once a failure is confirmed, a generation agent synthesizes paired training data targeted at it; a validation agent rebalances the batch toward the direction in which the deployed model errs, so that the model's own mistakes steer its training set; and a routing agent matches the training action to the diagnosed gap and returns the next version to production. Over six rounds of live evolution (V0 to V6), a 1.7B guardrail adapts to a new threat in 16-24 hours, with about 2 hours of human effort, versus the 40-90 hours of the manual process it replaces. On six emerging threats, it outperforms static guardrails from 0.6B to 9B and an adaptive baseline while preserving its general screening competence. Since April 2026, SESG has been the primary update pipeline of Sangfor's guardrail, autonomously closing 14 of 15 new threat scenarios in two months. We release 9 test sets for the 6 new threats at https://github.com/Trams1017/SESG. Warning: This paper contains examples that may be harmful or offensive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SESG（Self-Evolving Safety Guardrails），一个在生产环境中运行的多智能体系统，用于让已部署的 LLM 安全护栏（safety guardrail）持续自我进化。SESG 监控实时流量，识别两类失败——形式新颖的 jailbreak 和内容新颖的有害类别，再由生成、验证、路由三个智能体协作构造针对性训练数据并发布新版本。论文报告在六轮在线进化（V0 到 V6）中，一个 1.7B 护栏可以在 16-24 小时内适应新威胁，仅需约 2 小时人工投入，而人工流程需要 40-90 小时。
Motivation: 已部署的 LLM 安全护栏大多是静态的：训练一次并在发布时冻结，而新的 jailbreak 技术和未处理的有害类别往往在数天内出现，导致防御始终滞后。
Method: SESG 是一个多智能体生产系统：监控代理负责从实时流量中暴露失败样本；生成代理（generation agent）合成针对失败样本的配对训练数据；验证代理（validation agent）按模型出错方向重新平衡训练批次；路由代理（routing agent）将训练动作匹配到诊断出的缺陷并把新版本送回生产。
Result: 在六个新兴威胁上，SESG 驱动的 1.7B 护栏优于 0.6B 到 9B 的静态护栏以及一个自适应基线，同时保持通用筛查能力。自 2026 年 4 月起，SESG 成为 Sangfor 护栏的主要更新管线，两个月内自主关闭了 15 个新威胁场景中的 14 个，并发布了 9 个测试集。
Conclusion: 论文认为生产环境中的安全护栏可以通过自我进化机制显著缩短威胁响应时间并减少人工干预，同时维持通用防护能力。摘要同时警告论文包含可能有冒犯性或有害的例子。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Aero Realtime: Fully Aligned Input-Output Streams for Low-Latency Streaming Multimodal Generation
papers.abstract_en: Existing streaming multimodal models process observations incrementally but still follow a turn-based prefill-then-decode pattern, making them non-duplex: new observations cannot naturally enter an active generation stream. Proactive alternatives use micro-turn polling or external response gates, which fragment continuous interaction, decouple response timing from language generation, and complicate KV-cache-friendly serving. We introduce Aero Realtime, a 4B streaming multimodal model with a duplex architecture for realtime generation. Aero Realtime aligns video, audio, and textual output on a shared temporal grid, where each approximately 80-ms audio slot predicts either a lexical token or a silence token. This allows input and output to advance together, enabling one autoregressive objective to learn both when to respond and what to generate. During inference, Aero Realtime appends only the newest multimodal slot, carries forward the previous output state, and reuses the KV cache for efficient incremental execution. We further provide a complete training and serving recipe, including realtime QA construction, slot-aligned supervision, hardware-aware distributed training, and resumable inference. On four NVIDIA A6000 workstation GPUs, Aero Realtime maintains 84-ms median and 173-ms P95 processing lag over 20 minutes of a continuously streamed video, remaining within 200~ms of the source timeline. These results demonstrate the feasibility of fully aligned input-output modeling for duplex, proactive, and hardware-aligned multimodal interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Aero Realtime，一个 4B 参数的流式多模态模型，采用双工 (duplex) 架构实现低延迟实时生成。核心设计是将视频、音频与文本输出对齐到共享时间网格，每个约 80-ms 的音频槽预测一个词汇 token 或静音 token，从而用单一的自回归目标同时学习何时响应和生成什么。推理时只追加最新的多模态槽、沿用先前输出状态并复用 KV cache。在 4 张 NVIDIA A6000 工作站 GPU 上，对连续 20 分钟视频流的处理延迟中位数为 84-ms、P95 为 173-ms，保持在源时间线 200-ms 以内。
Motivation: 现有流式多模态模型虽增量处理观测，但仍遵循基于回合的 prefill-then-decode 模式，无法实现双工交互，即新观测不能自然进入正在进行的生成流。此前的主动式方案依赖微轮询或外部响应门控，会割裂连续交互、使响应时序与语言生成解耦，并增加 KV-cache 友好的服务复杂度。
Method: 引入 Aero Realtime，一个 4B 流式多模态模型，将视频、音频和文本输出对齐到共享时间网格；每约 80-ms 的音频槽预测一个词汇 token 或静音 token，使输入输出同步推进。推理阶段仅追加最新多模态槽，继承先前输出状态并复用 KV cache；并给出完整训练与服务配方，包括实时 QA 构建、槽对齐监督、硬件感知分布式训练和可恢复推理。
Result: 摘要报告在 4 张 NVIDIA A6000 GPU 上，连续流式视频 20 分钟内实现 84-ms 中位数和 173-ms P95 处理延迟，始终保持在源时间线 200-ms 以内。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果证明了完全对齐的输入-输出建模对于双工、主动且硬件对齐的多模态交互是可行的。

papers.title: SkillsMetric: Mapping the Detection Boundary of Static Analysis for Malicious Agent Skills
papers.abstract_en: Agent Skills---structured packages of instructions and scripts that augment LLM-based agents---are rapidly proliferating, yet their security properties remain under-explored. We present \textsc{SkillsMetric}, a five-stage static analysis framework that scores skill packages along pattern density, statistical anomaly, dataflow taint, import anomaly, and capability mismatch dimensions. We construct an adversarial evaluation dataset of 2{,}266 skills spanning 16~attack types across code-level, system-level, and semantic-level threats, and evaluate on the full SkillMD-138K corpus. Our framework achieves an AUC of 0.93 and 5-fold cross-validated F1 of 73.4\%$\pm$0.5\%, with strong detection of data exfiltration (93\%) and steganographic payloads (93\%). Crucially, we identify fundamental blind spots: \emph{host destruction} attacks using common shell commands evade all five stages (0\% detection), and \emph{prompt injection} via natural-language manipulation achieves only 42\% detection. These findings establish that static analysis alone is insufficient for skill security, motivating defense-in-depth architectures that combine fast static pre-screening with semantic review.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillsMetric，一个五阶段静态分析框架，用于评估和检测 LLM 智能体技能包（Agent Skills）中的恶意行为。作者构建了包含 2,266 个技能、覆盖 16 种攻击类型的对抗性评估数据集，并在完整 SkillMD-138K 语料上评估，取得 AUC 0.93 与 5 折交叉验证 F1 73.4%±0.5% 的结果。框架能有效检测数据外泄与隐写载荷，但宿主破坏和提示注入类攻击仍构成明显盲区。
Motivation: Agent Skills（增强 LLM 智能体的结构化指令与脚本包）正在快速普及，但其安全属性缺乏充分研究，现有静态分析方法对多种攻击类型的覆盖能力尚不明确。
Method: 提出五阶段静态分析框架 SkillsMetric，从模式密度、统计异常、数据流污点、导入异常和能力不匹配五个维度对技能包打分；并构建覆盖代码级、系统级和语义级威胁的对抗性评估数据集。
Result: 在 SkillMD-138K 完整语料上取得 AUC 0.93 和 5 折交叉验证 F1 73.4%±0.5%；对数据外泄和隐写载荷的检测率达 93%，但对使用常见 shell 命令的宿主破坏攻击检测率为 0%，对自然语言提示注入的检测率仅 42%。
Conclusion: 作者认为静态分析单独不足以保障技能安全，主张采用将快速静态预筛查与语义审查相结合的深度防御架构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM within MCP Matters: Measuring Inefficient Resource Utilization Driven by LLMs
papers.abstract_en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes how servers expose data and tools to Large Language Models (LLMs). A common server design embeds frequently used reference data, such as identifier lookup tables, directly in the server instructions: the system-prompt text a server hands to the host application. When a query concerns an entry of the embedded table, the model can act on it immediately instead of re-discovering the same information through a search tool. We test whether client LLMs actually consume such instruction-embedded data, reporting a 54,000-trial study across 24 LLMs (9 Claude, 6 Gemini, 9 GPT) on a production legal-information MCP server. A diagnostic condition that removes the competing search tool shows that failures are dominated by behavioral preference rather than missing capability. With search unavailable, 23 of 24 models read the embedded data reliably (hit ratio at least 98%); with a search tool merely present, 9 models drop below 15%. A 2^3 factorial analysis of three instruction-level interventions reveals strong interaction effects: combining all three restores at least 86% for 20 of 24 models, but individual interventions can backfire for specific model families. Per-server prompt engineering is therefore a workaround rather than a fix; we argue that MCP host applications should provide an explicit mechanism that places server instructions ahead of tool selection in the client LLM's deliberation.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 1 table. Accepted at the AgentSearch Workshop at SIGIR 2026, Melbourne, Australia (non-archival). Code and data: https://github.com/rabqatab/llm-in-mcp-matters
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器将常用参考数据嵌入系统提示词时，客户端大语言模型 (LLM) 是否真的会消费这些指令内嵌数据。作者在 24 个 LLM（9 个 Claude、6 个 Gemini、9 个 GPT）上进行了 54,000 次试验，基于一个生产环境的法律信息 MCP 服务器，发现模型失败主要由行为偏好而非能力缺失导致，且多种指令级干预的组合可恢复大部分命中率。
Motivation: MCP 服务器常把标识符查找表等高频参考数据直接放进服务器指令文本里，以便模型立即使用；但客户端 LLM 是否真正使用这些内嵌数据并不清楚，这关系到服务器设计的有效性。
Method: 在 24 个 LLM 上开展 54,000 次试验；通过移除竞争性搜索工具的诊断条件区分能力缺失与行为偏好，并对三种指令级干预进行 2^3 因子分析 (factorial analysis)。
Result: 当搜索工具不可用时，23/24 个模型能可靠读取内嵌数据（命中率至少 98%）；当搜索工具存在时，9 个模型命中率跌至 15% 以下。三种干预全部组合可让 20/24 个模型恢复至少 86%，但单独干预对特定模型家族可能适得其反。
Conclusion: 逐个服务器的提示工程 (prompt engineering) 只是临时手段而非根本修复；作者主张 MCP 宿主应用应提供显式机制，将服务器指令置于客户端 LLM 工具选择之前。

papers.title: Hierarchical Self-Improvement: A Framework for Task-Specific Evolvable Agent Harnesses
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLM agents are often improved by modifying prompts, tools, or workflows manually, while the executable scaffold surrounding the model---the \emph{harness}---is typically treated as a fixed artifact after deployment. This work studies an alternative where the harness is \emph{task-specific and continuously evolvable}: each task family maintains its own harness, which is hot-swapped across iterations through a fixed task-injection seam and rewritten using environment feedback. We introduce \textbf{Hierarchical Self-Improvement (HSI)}, a framework in which a single frozen LLM $M$ operates across three hierarchical scopes: a task harness $H$ that executes tasks, an evolver that rewrites $H$, and a meta-evolver that rewrites the evolver's strategy code under a frozen outer anchor. A thinking-on/off design isolates the contribution of harness evolution by disabling reasoning during task execution while enabling it during self-modification. HSI is bounded by two factors: a \emph{feedback-fidelity bound}, since evolution requires informative reward signals to guide selection, and a \emph{backbone capability bound}, since harness redesign cannot overcome limitations of the frozen model. On BALROG with DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Preview as the frozen backbone, HSI achieves consistent gains over the initial harness on moderate-difficulty tasks ($+39.3$ on BabyAI, $+33.0$ on Crafter, $+25.0$ on TextWorld, and $+15.0$ on MiniHack, all in raw \% Progress), while obtaining strong held-out generalization on BabaIsAI sub-suites ($0.98$ best-test on BreakStop and $1.00$ on GoTo from a $20\%$ unseen split). On tasks beyond the backbone's capability (NLE), harness evolution provides no improvement. These results demonstrate task-specific harness evolution as a viable axis for improving frozen LLM agents under clear empirical limits. Code is available at https://github.com/TailinZhou/hsi.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hierarchical Self-Improvement (HSI) 框架，研究任务特定且持续可演化的 agent harness：固定一个冻结的 LLM 作为骨干，通过三层作用域（任务 harness H、重写 H 的 evolver、在冻结外层锚点下重写 evolver 策略代码的 meta-evolver）利用环境反馈迭代改写执行脚手架。在 BALROG 基准上以 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Preview 为冻结骨干，中等难度任务上持续超过初始 harness，并在超出骨干能力的任务上显示演化无收益。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 通常靠手动修改提示、工具或工作流来改进，而部署后围绕模型的可执行脚手架（harness）被视为固定产物。作者研究替代方案：让 harness 针对任务家族保持独立并持续演化，从而为冻结的 LLM 提供一条无需改变权重的改进途径。
Method: 提出 HSI 框架，单一冻结 LLM 在三个层次作用域中运行：任务 harness H 执行任务，evolver 重写 H，meta-evolver 在冻结外层锚点下重写 evolver 的策略代码；采用 thinking-on/off 设计，任务执行时禁用推理、自我修改时启用推理，以隔离 harness 演化的贡献。
Result: 在 BALROG 上使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Preview 作为冻结骨干，HSI 在中等难度任务上取得一致增益：BabyAI +39.3、Crafter +33.0、TextWorld +25.0、MiniHack +15.0（均为原始 % Progress）；在 BabaIsAI 子套件的 20% 未见划分上表现出强泛化（BreakStop best-test 0.98，GoTo 1.00）。对超出骨干能力的 NLE 任务，harness 演化没有带来改进。
Conclusion: 任务特定的 harness 演化是在明确经验界限内改进冻结 LLM agent 的可行方向；作者指出两个界限：反馈保真度界限（演化需要信息丰富的奖励信号）和骨干能力界限（harness 重设计无法克服冻结模型的局限）。代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Halpern Iteration Achieves $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(ε^{-1/p})$ $p$th-Order Oracle Complexity for Monotone Variational Inequalities
papers.abstract_en: We study second- and higher-order methods for solving smooth monotone variational inequalities (MVI). Monteiro and Svaiter (SIAM J. Optim., 2012) showed that a second-order method, NPE, converges at the rate of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1.5})$. For convex-concave minimax optimization, a subset of MVI problems, Chen, Liu, Luo, and Zhang (COLT 2025) recently improved the complexity to $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}( T^{-1.75})$ . However, it is open whether the conjectured complexity for MVI can be improved. In this paper, by using a large-step inexact Halpern iteration, we propose a novel Halpern-NPE method that achieves an even faster rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{-2})$ for solving MVIs. We also provide the $p$th-order generalization of our method. We first introduce an Anchored Tensor Method (ATM) that achieves the rate of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-(p-1)})$, and then combine it with the Halpern iteration to achieve a faster convergence rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{-p})$. This improves all prior results for $p \ge 2$ and matches the classical extragradient method for $p=1$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究光滑单调变分不等式（MVI）的二阶及更高阶求解方法。作者提出基于大步不精确 Halpern 迭代的 Halpern-NPE 方法，将收敛率提升到 ~O(T^{-2})，并给出 p 阶推广：先引入 Anchored Tensor Method (ATM) 达到 O(T^{-(p-1)})，再与 Halpern 迭代结合达到 ~O(T^{-p})，改善了 p>=2 的所有先前结果。
Motivation: Monteiro 和 Svaiter 提出的二阶方法 NPE 在 MVI 上收敛率为 O(T^{-1.5})，而对凸凹极小极大优化（MVI 子集）已有 ~O(T^{-1.75}) 的改进，但 MVI 的猜想复杂度是否可改进仍是开放问题。
Method: 提出使用大步不精确 Halpern 迭代的 Halpern-NPE 方法；对 p 阶推广，先设计 Anchored Tensor Method (ATM) 获得 O(T^{-(p-1)}) 收敛率，再与 Halpern 迭代结合以加速到 ~O(T^{-p})。
Result: Halpern-NPE 在求解 MVI 时达到 ~O(T^{-2}) 的收敛率；p 阶推广达到 ~O(T^{-p})，对所有 p>=2 改进此前结果，并在 p=1 时匹配经典外梯度法（extragradient method）。
Conclusion: 作者表明 Halpern 迭代与高阶张量方法的结合能够显著提升 MVI 的求解复杂度，但摘要未讨论方法的数值实验或实际计算开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: InstructionCrafter: Generating Consistent and High-Fidelity Visual Instructions
papers.abstract_en: Given textual task instructions, generating step-by-step visual instructions as an image sequence requires the simultaneous satisfaction of multiple properties, specifically step faithfulness, cross-image consistency, and per-frame visual quality. Existing text-to-image generation approaches rarely meet all three properties, owing to independent sampling that breaks consistency, finetuning on low-quality video that degrades per-frame quality, and frozen backbones that lack multi-step understanding. In this work, we propose InstructionCrafter, a diffusion-based framework with the key idea of separating the optimization of temporal and instructional alignment from per-frame visual quality via (1) spatial-freeze training and (2) instruction-aware adapters. Built on a pretrained video diffusion backbone, InstructionCrafter freezes the spatial layers that control per-frame detail and updates only temporal and text-conditioning pathways to learn instruction semantics and inter-step relations, which preserves the generative prior for per-frame quality and reduces trainable parameters by about 50 percent compared with full finetuning. We also introduce two lightweight adapters that enhance the model's understanding of instructional context. The Consistent Adapter aggregates textual cues from the entire instruction sequence and from neighboring steps to keep object identity and attributes consistent across frames, and the Context-Aware Temporal Adapter converts cross-attention outputs into biases for temporal self-attention, explicitly propagating inter-frame relations. Extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art overall performance on step faithfulness, cross-image consistency, and per-frame visual quality while significantly reducing noise, blur, and spurious subtitles. Our code and trained models will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InstructionCrafter，一个基于预训练视频扩散模型的指令图像序列生成框架，目标是同时满足步骤忠实性 (step faithfulness)、跨图像一致性 (cross-image consistency) 和单帧视觉质量。其核心思路是通过空间层冻结 (spatial-freeze) 训练和两个轻量适配器 (Consistent Adapter 与 Context-Aware Temporal Adapter)，将时间与指令对齐的优化与单帧视觉质量解耦，在避免破坏生成先验的同时学习多步指令语义。在两个基准数据集上，作者报告该方法在步骤忠实性、跨图像一致性和逐帧视觉质量上取得整体最优，同时减少噪声、模糊和伪字幕。
Motivation: 现有文本生成图像方法难以同时满足步骤忠实性、跨图像一致性和单帧视觉质量：独立采样破坏一致性、在低质量视频上微调损害逐帧质量、冻结骨干网络缺乏多步指令理解。
Method: 基于预训练视频扩散骨干，冻结控制逐帧细节的空间层，只更新时间与文本条件通路；引入 Consistent Adapter 聚合整段指令与相邻步骤的文本线索以保持物体身份和属性一致，并引入 Context-Aware Temporal Adapter 将交叉注意力输出转换为时间自注意力偏置以传播帧间关系。
Result: 两个基准数据集上的实验显示，该方法在步骤忠实性、跨图像一致性、逐帧视觉质量方面达到整体最优，并显著减少噪声、模糊与伪字幕；相比全量微调，可训练参数约减少 50%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将时间/指令对齐与逐帧视觉质量的优化分离，是保持视频扩散先验并实现一致高保真视觉指令序列生成的关键；代码与训练模型将公开。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Beyond Tables: Doc2DB-Bench for Relationally Faithful Document-to-Database Construction
papers.abstract_en: Practical AI systems increasingly need to turn long, heterogeneous documents into queryable relational databases, not isolated spreadsheets. In domains such as finance, healthcare, education, transportation, and enterprise operations, downstream workflows rely on normalized schemas, entity identities, keys, cross-table relationships, and integrity constraints for analytics, compliance, auditing, and SQL-backed decision making. Existing Document-to-Table benchmarks are insufficient for this setting: flattening evidence into single tables can duplicate entities, obscure many-to-many relationships, create sparse records, and avoid testing whether extracted facts form a valid database instance. This creates an urgent need to evaluate document understanding as database construction rather than field extraction. We introduce Doc2DB-Bench, a benchmark for Document-to-Database construction, containing 203 long-document instances across 42 schemas and seven domain groups, with 117 entity tables, 132 relationship tables, 7,341 rows, and 41,935 cells. Built through a controllable DB-to-Doc synthesis pipeline and organized by a taxonomy of intra-table extraction and inter-table reasoning, the generated documents undergo authenticity verification, proving indistinguishable from real-world references. Doc2DB-Bench thus provides a testbed for reliable, auditable, and relationally faithful LLM-based data systems. The benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/SetonLiang/Doc2DB-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Doc2DB-Bench，一个面向文档到数据库构建 (Document-to-Database) 的基准，包含 203 个长文档实例、42 个 schema、七个领域组，共 117 张实体表、132 张关系表、7,341 行和 41,935 个单元格。基准通过可控的 DB-to-Doc 合成流水线构建，并按表内抽取与表间推理的分类组织，文档经真实性验证被认为与真实世界参考难以区分。该基准旨在评估 LLM 将非结构化长文档转换为关系型数据库实例的能力，而非传统的单表字段抽取。
Motivation: 现有 Document-to-Table 基准将证据压平成单表，会导致实体重复、掩盖多对多关系、产生稀疏记录，且不检验抽取事实是否构成有效的数据库实例。金融、医疗、教育、交通和企业运营等下游工作流依赖规范化 schema、实体身份、键、跨表关系和完整性约束，因此需要把文档理解评估从字段抽取转向数据库构建。
Method: 构建 Doc2DB-Bench 基准：通过可控制的 DB-to-Doc 合成流水线，从已知数据库实例生成 203 个长文档实例，覆盖 42 个 schema 和七个领域组；按表内抽取 (intra-table extraction) 与表间推理 (inter-table reasoning) 的任务分类组织，并对生成文档进行真实性验证。
Result: 基准包含 117 张实体表、132 张关系表、7,341 行和 41,935 个单元格；生成的文档通过真实性验证，被证明与真实世界参考不可区分。
Conclusion: Doc2DB-Bench 为可靠、可审计且关系忠实的基于 LLM 的数据系统提供测试平台，基准已公开在 GitHub 上。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Keeps Agent Skills from Being Reusable? Evidence from 138K SKILL.md Files
papers.abstract_en: Under the current standard, Agent Skills are SKILL.md files that combine instructions with supporting resources, enabling Large Language Model (LLM) agents to reuse procedures beyond a single conversation. Yet many public skills appear to originate from a single task, repository, or conversation, even when they are shared as reusable components. We analyze this gap across 138,133 public SKILL.md files from 20,556 repositories using a two-tier defect taxonomy grounded in the official specification and best-practice guidance. We find that 91.8% of skills contain at least one detected defect, with stable estimates across lenient and strict thresholds (88.8-94.6%). The dominant failures are ordinary packaging problems rather than exotic attacks: weak routing metadata, bloated or non-actionable bodies, and poor resource organization. A deterministic routing stress test over 20,000 skills shows the functional impact: skills with valid routing metadata are retrieved more reliably from startup descriptions than skills with routing defects. Defect rates vary by platform and provenance: specification-aware skills contain fewer defects, while AI-marked skills show more safety and portability problems. Lightweight enforcement and repair experiments support a quality-assured generation workflow combining spec-aware prompting, lightweight linting, automated repair, and safety gating.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 20,556 个代码仓库中的 138,133 个公开 SKILL.md 文件进行大规模实证分析，研究 LLM 智能体技能（Agent Skills）难以复用的问题。基于官方规范与最佳实践构建两级缺陷分类法（two-tier defect taxonomy），发现 91.8% 的技能至少包含一个缺陷（宽松与严格阈值下估计稳定在 88.8%-94.6%），且主导失败是普通打包问题而非恶意攻击。确定性路由压力测试显示，路由元数据有效的技能更容易从启动描述中被检索到；规范感知的技能缺陷更少，而 AI 标记技能在安全性和可移植性上问题更多。
Motivation: 当前标准下 Agent Skills 是 SKILL.md 文件，旨在让 LLM 智能体在单次对话之外复用流程；但许多公开技能看似源于单一任务、仓库或对话，即使被共享为可复用组件也未必真正可复用。作者希望量化这种差距，并找出阻碍技能复用的主导缺陷类型。
Method: 对 138,133 个公开 SKILL.md 文件（来自 20,556 个仓库）使用基于官方规范和最佳实践指南的两级缺陷分类法进行分析；对 20,000 个技能进行确定性路由压力测试（deterministic routing stress test）以评估功能影响；并开展轻量级强制与修复（lightweight enforcement and repair）实验，验证一种结合规范感知提示、轻量级 linting、自动修复与安全门控的质量保证生成工作流。
Result: 91.8% 的技能至少包含一个被检测到的缺陷，宽松与严格阈值下估计稳定在 88.8%-94.6%；主导缺陷是弱路由元数据、臃肿或不可操作的正文、以及糟糕的资源组织。路由元数据有效的技能比有路由缺陷的技能能更可靠地从启动描述中被检索到；缺陷率随平台和来源变化：规范感知（specification-aware）技能缺陷更少，AI 标记技能在安全性和可移植性方面问题更多。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，通过规范感知提示、轻量级 linting、自动修复和安全门控组成质量保证生成工作流，可以有效提升 SKILL.md 技能的可复用性；该结论以轻量级强制与修复实验为支撑。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Calling the Bluff: Detecting Ever-Shifting Harmful Chat Dialogue via Ordered Reasoning Chain Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Harmful chat dialogues are ever-shifting through type-shifting and lexical evasion, yet we find they share invariant principles, i.e., an Ordered Reasoning Chain (ORC) of recurring topics, harm language indicators, severity hierarchies, and type characteristics, which can help us capture the key information in the frequently changing lexical expressions. We propose BRACE, which encodes the ORC as four differentiable stages (Topic -> Indicator -> Severity -> Type) with intermediate supervision, serving as a structured regularizer blended with direct heads, and supported by prototype-based feature augmentation and feature path disentanglement. The evaluation results show that, across 4 domains and 5 harm categories, BRACE achieves harm-type macro F1 of 0.934 (RoBERTa-wwm-ext, 3-seed mean), with decoder backbones (Qwen3-1.7B LoRA) reaching 0.949. Ablation studies show that all components contribute to BRACE, and the structural decomposition of ORC enables BRACE to distinguish harmful types with semantic ambiguity. Disclaimer: This paper may contain content that is disturbing to some readers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对不断通过类型转换和词汇规避变化的有害聊天对话，提出其共享不变的有序推理链（Ordered Reasoning Chain, ORC），并据此提出 BRACE 方法。BRACE 将 ORC 编码为主题→指标→严重性→类型四个可微阶段并加中间监督，作为与直接分类头融合的结构化正则化器，配合基于原型的特征增强和特征路径解纠缠。在 4 个领域、5 个危害类别上，BRACE 在 RoBERTa-wwm-ext 上达到宏 F1 0.934（3 种子平均），解码器骨干（Qwen3-1.7B LoRA）达到 0.949；消融实验显示各组件均有贡献，且 ORC 的结构分解有助于区分语义模糊的有害类型。
Motivation: 有害聊天对话通过类型转移和词汇规避不断变化，难以被静态检测器捕捉；作者发现这些对话共享不变的推理原则（ORC），可用于从频繁变化的词汇表达中提取关键信息，从而更稳健地识别危害。
Method: 提出 BRACE：将有序推理链编码为四个可微阶段（Topic -> Indicator -> Severity -> Type）并施加中间监督，作为与直接分类头融合的结构化正则化器；同时引入基于原型的特征增强（prototype-based feature augmentation）和特征路径解纠缠（feature path disentanglement）。
Result: 在 4 个领域、5 个危害类别上，BRACE 实现危害类型宏 F1 0.934（RoBERTa-wwm-ext，3 种子平均），解码器骨干（Qwen3-1.7B LoRA）达 0.949。消融实验表明所有组件均有贡献，且 ORC 的结构分解使模型能区分语义模糊的有害类型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调有序推理链的结构化分解能够帮助模型在语义模糊情况下区分有害类型，且各设计组件整体有效；同时附注称论文内容可能令部分读者不适。

papers.title: Hidden Language Consistency Phenomena in Reasoning LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multilingual reasoning models are commonly evaluated by whether they arrive at the correct answer, but not by whether they preserve the intended language while reasoning and responding. This omission conceals important multilingual behaviors that emerge as tasks become harder. In this paper, we study task difficulty, task accuracy, thinking-language consistency (TC), and answer-language consistency (AC) across reasoning models using PolyMath benchmark in eight languages and four difficulty levels. We uncover four findings: (1) language consistency exhibits four difficulty-dependent behaviors: output-language consistency remains aligned with input, remains misaligned, degrades gradually, or collapses abruptly. (2) We identify the language consistency breakdown effect, where increasing difficulty can cause a sudden drop in output-language consistency, especially in less strongly represented and non-Latin-script languages. (3) Due to this breakdown effect, accuracy can be preserved or even improved at a harder difficulty level as the model shifts to its internal dominant language. (4) Quantization can improve or degrade output-language consistency independently of its effect on accuracy, with GPTQ and AWQ often outperforming AutoRound under tolerance-based voting with ε = 1.0. These results show that multilingual capability cannot be characterized by accuracy alone; reliable evaluation should jointly consider task accuracy, language consistency, and task difficulty for multilingual benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多语言推理大模型在推理与回答时是否保持目标语言，而不仅看答案是否正确。作者基于 PolyMath 基准、八种语言和四个难度级别，考察任务难度、准确率、思维语言一致性 (TC) 与答案语言一致性 (AC)，发现语言一致性存在四种难度依赖行为，并提出语言一致性崩溃效应：难度增加会导致输出语言一致性骤降，尤其在资源较弱和非拉丁字母语言中；此时准确率可能保留甚至提升，因为模型转向其内部主导语言。此外，量化方法对语言一致性的影响独立于其对准确率的影响。
Motivation: 现有对多语言推理模型的评测只关心是否得出正确答案，忽略推理和回答过程中是否保持预期语言；随着任务变难，这种缺失会掩盖重要的多语言行为，因此需要把语言一致性和任务难度纳入评测。
Method: 使用 PolyMath 基准在八种语言和四个难度级别上，系统测量任务准确率、思维语言一致性 (TC) 与答案语言一致性 (AC)，并比较 GPTQ、AWQ 与 AutoRound 等量化方法在基于容差的投票 (tolerance-based voting, ε=1.0) 下对输出语言一致性的影响。
Result: 研究得到四点发现：语言一致性有四种难度依赖模式（保持对齐、保持错位、逐渐退化、突然崩溃）；存在语言一致性崩溃效应，难度增加会使输出语言一致性骤降，尤其影响资源较弱和非拉丁字母语言；崩溃效应下准确率在更难级别上可保持甚至提升，因为模型转向内部主导语言；量化可独立于准确率改善或损害输出语言一致性，且 GPTQ 与 AWQ 在该设置下常优于 AutoRound。
Conclusion: 作者强调多语言能力不能仅用准确率刻画，可靠评估应同时考虑任务准确率、语言一致性与任务难度。

papers.title: TRACE-Memory: Public-Conditioned Retrieval and Utility-Aware Evidence Admission for Personalized Generation
papers.abstract_en: Personalized generation systems retrieve user history by request--memory relevance and inject it into the model context. Yet relevant history may concern the wrong preference aspect, duplicate public information, or provide insufficient support. We argue that personal memory should be used only when it adds utility beyond a public-only response. We propose TRACE-Memory, a two-stage framework for selective personalization. Stage 1 queries for user-specific information missing from the request and public context, then retrieves a coverage-oriented candidate pool. Stage 2 admits a compact subset of source-traceable evidence units, or the empty set, according to response-level incremental utility. We progressively train the query-generation and evidence-admission policies through structured SFT initialization, reduced-space stage-wise GRPO warm-up, and nested multi-sample Joint GRPO. Across 4,500 Controlled and Natural tasks from Goodreads, Amazon Reviews, and Reddit, TRACE-Memory consistently outperforms random and lexical memory use, improves over semantic retrieval, remains competitive with frontier-LLM memory pipelines as local generator capacity increases, and conditions evidence admission on public-context sufficiency, supporting selective rather than default personalization.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, and 6 tables. Submitted to the 41st AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI 2027)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE-Memory，一个面向选择性个性化生成的两阶段框架。阶段 1 查询用户特定且请求与公共上下文缺失的信息，检索覆盖导向的候选池；阶段 2 根据响应级增量效用接纳紧凑、可溯源证据子集或空集。训练采用结构化 SFT 初始化、降维阶段式 GRPO 热启和嵌套多采样联合 GRPO。在来自 Goodreads、Amazon Reviews 和 Reddit 的 4,500 个受控与自然任务上，TRACE-Memory 持续优于随机和词法记忆使用，改进语义检索，并与前沿 LLM 记忆管道保持竞争力。
Motivation: 相关历史记忆可能涉及错误的偏好方面、重复公共信息或提供不足的支持。作者认为个人记忆只应在超越纯公共响应的增量效用时被使用，而非默认注入。
Method: 提出两阶段选择性个性化框架：阶段 1 生成查询以定位请求与公共上下文中缺失的用户特定信息，并构建覆盖导向的候选池；阶段 2 依据响应级增量效用接纳紧凑的可溯源证据单元集合或空集。训练过程包括结构化 SFT 初始化、降维阶段式 GRPO 热启以及嵌套多采样联合 GRPO。
Result: 在 4,500 个 Goodreads、Amazon Reviews 和 Reddit 的受控与自然任务上，TRACE-Memory 一致优于随机和词法记忆使用，优于语义检索，随着本地生成器容量增加与前沿 LLM 记忆管道表现相当，并将证据接纳条件化为公共上下文是否充分。
Conclusion: 摘要强调证据接纳应基于增量效用和公共上下文充分性，支持选择性而非默认的个性化记忆使用。

papers.title: Forgotten History or Test-of-Time? Retrospect and Prospect on RAG from an IR Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is widely regarded as a novel paradigm born from the limitations of large language models (LLMs)--a mechanism to ground their outputs in external knowledge. This view, however, is incomplete when considered within a broader historical context. In this paper, we argue that the core ideas underlying RAG are not new: foundational concepts such as integrating retrieval and language generation, knowledge augmentation, answer verification, and iterative query (or prompt) refinement had already been studied and instantiated in information retrieval (IR) and question answering (QA) research dating back to the early 2000s, well before the emergence of LLMs. We make this case by systematically tracing the intellectual lineage of modern RAG and Agentic RAG back to their classical IR and QA antecedents, and examining why this continuity has gone under-recognized -- a consequence of community fragmentation, shifting terminology, and the recency bias endemic to fast-moving fields. Rather than treating LLMs as the origin point of retrieval-augmented intelligence, we propose viewing them as a new interface layer atop a decades-old QA architecture. This reframing is not merely historical: by situating RAG within the longer trajectory of IR research, we surface underutilized prior work -- on user modeling, answer validation, and query refinement -- that can directly inform next-generation RAG design, reducing unintentional rediscovery and fostering genuine cross-community integration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从信息检索 (IR) 视角回顾 RAG，主张 RAG 的核心思想并非由 LLM 首创，而是早在 2000 年代初的 IR 与问答 (QA) 研究中已有雏形，包括检索与生成结合、知识增强、答案验证以及查询（或提示）迭代优化。作者系统梳理现代 RAG 与 Agentic RAG 的思想谱系，将其定位为几十年 QA 架构之上的新接口层，并提出这种历史视角有助于减少重复发现并促进跨社区整合。
Motivation: 现有观点普遍把 RAG 视为 LLM 局限下诞生的新范式，忽视了它在 IR/QA 领域的历史先例；这种割裂源于社区碎片化、术语变迁以及快节奏领域的近因偏差 (recency bias)，导致大量有价值的早期工作未被充分利用。
Method: 采用思想谱系 (intellectual lineage) 的系统梳理方法，将现代 RAG 与 Agentic RAG 的核心思想追溯到经典 IR 和 QA 研究，并分析其连续性为何未被充分认识。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数据；其核心论点是 RAG 的底层架构在 LLM 出现之前数十年已被研究，并梳理出用户建模、答案验证和查询优化等尚未充分利用的早期工作。
Conclusion: 作者主张不应把 LLM 视为检索增强智能的起点，而应看作既有 QA 架构的新接口层；将 RAG 置于 IR 的长期轨迹中有助于减少无意的重复发明并促进真正的跨社区整合。

papers.title: Private Etymology: Designing Relational Reuse of Shared Symbols in Long-Term Human-AI Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Previous studies have shown that people can develop shared symbols, partner-specific expressions, personal idioms, inside jokes, and other parts of a relational microculture. Recent work has also examined how humans and conversational AI negotiate and revise symbolic meanings. However, long-term human-AI systems still lack a clear design model for recording how a dyad-specific expression gains meaning, checking whether both sides still accept that meaning, and safely reusing the expression in later sessions. This concept-and-prototype paper introduces Private Etymology, a machine-representable relational provenance that records how a dyad-specific symbolic expression is proposed, interpreted, negotiated, repaired, reused, revised, stabilized, contested, forgotten, or retired over time. I also propose relational reuse: reactivating a dyad-specific expression in a later session without fully explaining its meaning again. The contribution is not the invention of shared symbols or relational microcultures. Instead, this paper integrates prior ideas into persistent, revisable, and evidence-grounded symbolic units for human-AI relationships. I present a lifecycle model, an illustrative machine-readable schema, a working Apple Watch prototype, and a longitudinal research agenda. In the prototype, a language model classifies discrete conversational evidence, while deterministic local code decides whether a Shared Symbol can be updated. This prevents a free-form model confidence score or an AI proposal by itself from directly updating the persisted symbol. Private Etymology is proposed as infrastructure for conversational agents to participate in changing relational microcultures without inventing their origins or treating relational meaning as a fixed memory value.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇概念与原型 (concept-and-prototype) 论文，提出 Private Etymology，一种机器可表示的 relational provenance，用于在长期人机对话中记录双人特定 (dyad-specific) 符号表达如何被提出、解读、协商、修复、重用、修订、稳定、争议、遗忘或退役。作者同时提出 relational reuse，即在后续会话中无需完整重新解释即可重新激活某个双人特定表达。论文给出生命周期模型、说明性的机器可读 schema、Apple Watch 原型以及纵向研究议程；原型中语言模型对离散对话证据分类，而确定性的本地代码决定 Shared Symbol 是否可更新。
Motivation: 长期人机对话系统缺乏清晰的设计模型，来记录双人特定表达如何获得意义、检查双方是否仍接受该意义，以及在后续会话中安全地重用该表达。
Method: 提出 Private Etymology 作为持久的、可修订的、基于证据的符号单元，并引入 relational reuse 机制；实现上采用语言模型对对话证据进行分类，再由确定性本地代码决定是否更新 Shared Symbol，避免自由形式的模型置信度或 AI 提案直接修改持久化符号。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果；论文以概念说明、生命周期模型、机器可读 schema 和 Apple Watch 原型作为主要展示内容。
Conclusion: 本文的贡献不是发明共享符号或关系性微文化，而是把既有思想整合为可持久化、可修订且基于证据的符号基础设施，使对话智能体能参与变迁中的关系性微文化，而不把关系意义视为固定存储值。

papers.title: MGMCL: Multi-Granularity Manifold Contrastive Learning With Neural ODEs for Cross-Subject EEG Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Cross-subject electroencephalogram (EEG)-based emotion recognition remains challenging due to substantial inter-individual variability and discrete formulation that overlooks affective continuity. Existing methods operate in Euclidean space and focus on marginal distribution alignment, failing to preserve the semantic structure of emotions across subjects. This article proposes MGMCL, reconceptualizing emotion recognition as learning continuous representations on symmetric positive definite (SPD) Riemannian manifolds. The frame?work introduces multi-granularity manifold contrastive learning at instance, emotion, and trajectory levels while preserving semantic ordering. Neural ordinary differential equations on manifolds model continuous emotion dynamics. Cross-subject generalization employs Gromov-Wasserstein manifold alignment. Weakly-supervised learning enables continuous valence-arousal-dominance prediction from discrete labels. Extensive experiments on three public datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance: 91.23% accuracy on SEED, 73.82% on SEED-IV, and 76.38% on DEAP, achieving consistent improvements of 1.89%, 1.66%, and 1.28% over previous best methods, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MGMCL，将跨被试 EEG 情绪识别重新建模为在对称正定 (SPD) 黎曼流形上学习连续表征的问题，以应对个体间差异大以及离散标签忽略情感连续性的挑战。框架在实例、情绪和轨迹三个粒度上做流形对比学习 (multi-granularity manifold contrastive learning)，并用流形上的神经 ODE 建模连续情绪动态，结合 Gromov-Wasserstein 流形对齐提升跨被试泛化，同时用弱监督学习从离散标签预测连续的 valence-arousal-dominance。在 SEED、SEED-IV 和 DEAP 三个公开数据集上取得 SOTA 精度，分别为 91.23%、73.82% 和 76.38%。
Motivation: 跨被试 EEG 情绪识别面临显著的个体差异，且现有方法多采用离散化建模，忽略了情感本身的连续性；同时已有方法基于欧氏空间并只做边际分布对齐，无法保持跨被试的情绪语义结构。
Method: 提出 MGMCL，将情绪识别重构为在 SPD 黎曼流形上学习连续表征；引入实例、情绪、轨迹三粒度的流形对比学习并保持语义顺序，使用流形上的神经 ODE 建模连续情绪动态，通过 Gromov-Wasserstein 流形对齐提升跨被试泛化，并采用弱监督学习从离散标签预测连续 valence-arousal-dominance。
Result: 在 SEED、SEED-IV、DEAP 三个公开数据集上，精度分别达到 91.23%、73.82% 和 76.38%，相较此前最佳方法一致提升 1.89%、1.66% 和 1.28%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将情绪识别建模为黎曼流形上的连续表征学习，并在多粒度上保持语义结构，可以显著改善跨被试 EEG 情绪识别的性能。

papers.title: FSTC-Encoder: Feature--Spatial--Temporal Correlation Learning for Generalizable RF Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous RF sensing differs substantially in feature structure, spatial layout, and temporal scale, making existing models difficult to reuse across devices, environments, and RF modalities. We propose FSTC-Encoder, which unifies heterogeneous RF representation learning through feature, spatial, and temporal correlation modeling. Structure-aware feature encoding accommodates different signal structures, set-based spatial encoding aggregates variable observations, and hierarchical temporal encoding jointly captures local variations and long-range dependencies. Across sensing tasks and modalities, FSTC-Encoder retains the same spatial--temporal backbone architecture while varying only the feature configuration and task head. Across Widar3.0, CSI-Bench, and XRF55, FSTC-Encoder achieves 92.15% mean Accuracy under multi-factor cross-domain protocols, ranks first on three of four additional sensing tasks, remains consistently strong across WiFi, millimeter-wave radar, and RFID, and reduces the cross-modality performance gap from 18.85% to 12.93% through cross-RF learning. These results demonstrate that FSTC-Encoder achieves high domain robustness, task generality, and modality extensibility.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, and 6 tables. Submitted to the 41st AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI 2027)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FSTC-Encoder，一种面向异质射频（RF）感知的统一表示学习框架，通过特征、空间与时间三个维度的相关性建模来提升跨设备、跨环境与跨模态的泛化能力。摘要报告其在 Widar3.0、CSI-Bench 和 XRF55 上达到 92.15% 的平均准确率，在四个附加感知任务中三个排名第一，并将跨模态性能差距从 18.85% 缩小到 12.93%。
Motivation: 异质 RF 感知在特征结构、空间布局和时间尺度上差异显著，导致现有模型难以在不同设备、环境和 RF 模态间复用，阻碍了跨域泛化。
Method: FSTC-Encoder 包含结构感知的特征编码以适配不同信号结构，基于集合的空间编码以聚合可变数量观测，以及层级时间编码以同时捕捉局部变化与长程依赖。模型在不同任务和模态下保持相同的时空骨干架构，仅改变特征配置与任务头。
Result: 在多因子跨域协议下，FSTC-Encoder 在 Widar3.0、CSI-Bench 和 XRF55 上取得 92.15% 的平均准确率；四个附加感知任务中三个排名第一；在 WiFi、毫米波雷达和 RFID 上表现一致稳定，并将跨 RF 学习的跨模态性能差距从 18.85% 降至 12.93%。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果表明 FSTC-Encoder 具备高域鲁棒性、任务通用性和模态可扩展性。摘要未提及具体局限性。

papers.title: FreCast: Refining Radar Echo Intensity via Phase-Preserving Amplitude Residual Diffusion for Precipitation Nowcasting
papers.abstract_en: Precipitation nowcasting predicts the spatiotemporal evolution of future radar echoes from historical radar echo sequences, thereby estimating the occurrence, development, and movement of precipitation over the near term. In recent years, deep learning has become an important approach to precipitation nowcasting. Although state-of-the-art models can generally capture the overall spatial distribution of future precipitation, their predictions still exhibit substantial biases in radar echo intensity at individual locations. This observation motivates a more targeted strategy for reducing forecast errors. Instead of regenerating an entire radar echo sequence without spatial constraints, the predicted precipitation structure can be used to guide the refinement of echo intensities at individual locations. This structure-guided refinement directly targets echo intensity biases. Accordingly, we propose FreCast, a two-stage framework for radar echo prediction. The first stage generates an initial forecast of future radar echoes. The second stage uses the spatial structure of the initial forecast as a constraint to further correct intensity biases at individual locations in the first-stage prediction. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that FreCast achieves consistent improvements across forecast skill metrics. Qualitative results further show that FreCast better preserves rainband continuity and intense precipitation structures at longer lead times.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FreCast 是一个面向降水临近期预报 (precipitation nowcasting) 的两阶段雷达回波预测框架。第一阶段生成初始回波预报，第二阶段以初始预报的空间结构为约束，对逐点回波强度偏差进行修正。在三个数据集上的实验显示，FreCast 在多个预报技能指标上取得一致性改进，并在较长预报时效下更好地保持雨带连续性和强降水结构。
Motivation: 现有深度学习临近期预报模型虽能大致抓住未来降水的整体空间分布，但在单个格点位置上的雷达回波强度仍存在明显偏差，直接整段生成回波序列缺乏空间约束，导致误差较大。
Method: 提出两阶段结构引导的强度修正框架：第一阶段使用已有模型生成初始回波预报；第二阶段将第一阶段的预测空间结构作为约束，针对性地修正逐个位置的回波强度偏差，而不是无约束地重新生成整段回波序列。
Result: 在三个数据集上，FreCast 相对基线在预报技能指标上取得一致的改进；定性结果表明其在较长预报时效下能更好地保持雨带连续性和强降水结构。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，用预测降水结构引导逐点强度修正可以降低雷达回波强度误差，并强调该方法在较长预报时效下的结构保持能力。
Relevance: 96

papers.title: Human-Guided Causal Knowledge Injection for Virtual Cells
papers.abstract_en: Virtual cells employ machine learning models to simulate and predict cellular behaviors, serving as a critical computational framework for investigating health and disease. Injecting causal graphs into virtual cells can improve the interpretability, but such graphs are usually not available in real-world applications. Recently, many methods have been proposed to construct causal graphs from data, which group genes based on their similarities to form concepts and extract their causal relationships. However, since this automatic process is unsupervised, the causal graphs usually contain errors. In this paper, we propose a human-guided causal knowledge injection method for virtual cells. We developed a gene-similarity-aware causal graph visualization supported by a hybrid optimization algorithm to help explore both the causal relationships between concepts and the similarities between genes. Based on the exploration, we further developed a counterfactual analysis strategy supported by a counterfactual visualization and a causal path visualization to help validate and refine causal graphs. The effectiveness of our method is demonstrated through two real-world case studies, the extraction of scientifically meaningful causal insights, and positive feedback from domain experts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向虚拟细胞（virtual cells）的可解释性，提出一种人机协同的因果知识注入方法。针对自动构建的因果图含有错误的问题，作者开发了基因相似性感知的因果图可视化与混合优化算法，并配合反事实分析和因果路径可视化来验证和修正因果图。两个真实案例研究和领域专家反馈表明该方法能提取有科学意义的因果洞见。
Motivation: 将因果图注入虚拟细胞可提升可解释性，但真实应用中因果图通常缺失；现有从数据自动构建因果图的方法是无监督的，容易包含错误。
Method: 提出基因相似性感知的因果图可视化，由混合优化算法支持，用于同时探索概念间因果关系与基因间相似性；再基于反事实分析策略，配合反事实可视化与因果路径可视化，验证并修正因果图。
Result: 通过两个真实世界案例研究验证有效性，成功提取具有科学意义的因果洞见，并获得领域专家正面反馈。
Conclusion: 摘要强调人机交互（human-guided）方式能改善虚拟细胞因果图的质量与可解释性；但摘要未报告量化评估指标，结果以案例研究和专家反馈为主。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ARC: Augmented-Rank Conformalization for Changepoint Localization --- Finite-Sample Validity and Distribution-Robust Efficiency
papers.abstract_en: Conformal changepoint localization turns any score into a confidence set for the changepoint with finite-sample coverage. Coverage is universal; efficiency is not. The oracle score is a likelihood ratio, so practical scores estimate density ratios, and set length deteriorates under heavy tails, skewness, and distribution shift, where no length guarantee applies. We propose ARC (Augmented-Rank Conformalization), a family of scores depending on the data only through within-segment ranks: rank-CUSUM location and scale channels, their fixed combinations, and a lightweight neural score frozen after synthetic training. Every ARC score inherits finite-sample coverage for every frozen weight configuration, including random initialization and mistraining. The main result is an efficiency transfer theorem: the entire ARC confidence set is almost surely invariant under strictly increasing marginal transforms, so the set length distribution depends on the data pair only through its rank structure, and lengths certified once hold verbatim across its monotone orbit, whereas a plug-in score's length changes with every re-expression. Across different rank structures lengths do change, and are reported as such. Classical rank-test theory positions ARC as targeting the optimal invariant score at bounded cost. Simulations confirm nominal coverage for all scores, including sabotaged networks, identical sets under monotone transforms where plug-in scores inflate, and smooth degradation where plug-in sets become vacuous; on the well-log benchmark ARC localizes annotated shifts to three to five candidates and flags misfit by an empty set. Two boundaries are stated rather than hidden: serial dependence destroys exactness, and trend-type alternatives lie outside the piecewise-exchangeable model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ARC (Augmented-Rank Conformalization)，一族仅通过段内秩 (within-segment ranks) 依赖数据的保形变点定位分数，包括 rank-CUSUM 位置与尺度通道、其固定组合，以及合成训练后冻结的轻量神经分数。主要结果是一个效率传递定理：在严格递增的边际变换下，整个 ARC 置信集几乎必然不变，因此集合长度分布只取决于数据的秩结构，一次认证的长度可沿其单调轨道原样成立。模拟实验验证了名义覆盖率，并在 well-log 基准上以 3 到 5 个候选定位标注变化点。
Motivation: 保形变点定位 (conformal changepoint localization) 对所有分数都提供有限样本覆盖，但覆盖是普适的而效率不是；最优分数是似然比，实际分数需要估计密度比，在重尾、偏斜和分布偏移下集合长度会恶化且没有任何长度保证。
Method: 提出 ARC 分数族，分数仅通过段内秩依赖数据，包含 rank-CUSUM 的位置与尺度通道、它们的固定组合，以及合成训练后冻结的轻量神经分数；每个 ARC 分数在任意冻结权重配置下都继承有限样本覆盖，包括随机初始化和错误训练。
Result: 证明效率传递定理：ARC 置信集在严格递增边际变换下几乎必然不变，集合长度分布仅取决于数据对的秩结构，而插件 (plug-in) 分数的长度会随数据重表达而变化；模拟显示包括被破坏网络在内的所有分数都达到名义覆盖，在单调变换下 ARC 集合保持一致而插件分数膨胀，well-log 基准上将标注变化点定位到三到五个候选并用空集标记不匹配。
Conclusion: 作者明确说明两个边界而非回避：序列依赖会破坏精确性，趋势型备择不在分段可交换 (piecewise-exchangeable) 模型之内；ARC 以有界代价瞄准最优不变分数。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Population-Level Generative Modeling for Ranking Data
papers.abstract_en: Ranking data arise in scientific and machine learning applications, including recommendation systems, information retrieval, voting, marketing, and AI preference ranking from human feedback. Existing statistical work has primarily focused on inference tasks such as preference estimation, rank aggregation, and ranking prediction. However, generating realistic synthetic rankings from an observed population is important for privacy-preserving data sharing, benchmark construction, simulation, and uncertainty quantification. This task is challenging because rankings are high-dimensional combinatorial objects with non-Euclidean dependence structures, while ranking populations often exhibit substantial preference heterogeneity. We propose a framework for population-level generative modeling through a latent preference simplex embedding. It estimates a low-dimensional latent preference simplex through a likelihood-based ranking model, leverages flow matching to learn the population distribution of latent preferences, and generates new rankings through the fitted probabilistic ranking model. We show that ranking generation admits an oracle reduction to latent distribution learning and derive finite-sample generative guarantees that clarify how the number of items, ranking length, and latent dimension affect accuracy. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate improved population-level fidelity and provide a statistically interpretable representation of preference heterogeneity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对排名数据 (ranking data) 的群体级生成建模问题，提出通过潜在偏好单纯形嵌入 (latent preference simplex embedding) 的框架：用基于似然的排名模型估计低维潜在偏好单纯形，用 flow matching 学习潜在偏好的群体分布，再通过拟合的概率排名模型生成新排名。作者证明排名生成可归约到潜在分布学习 (oracle reduction)，并给出有限样本生成保证。在合成和真实数据上的实验显示群体级保真度提升，并提供可统计解释的偏好异质性表征。
Motivation: 排名数据广泛存在于推荐系统、信息检索、投票和 AI 偏好排序等场景，但现有统计工作主要关注偏好估计、排名聚合和排名预测等推断任务，缺乏从观测群体生成真实合成排名的生成式方法；而该生成能力对隐私保护数据共享、基准构建、模拟和不确定性量化很重要。任务难点在于排名是高维组合对象且具有非欧几里得依赖结构，同时排名群体常呈现显著偏好异质性。
Method: 提出群体级生成建模框架，包含三部分：通过基于似然的排名模型估计低维潜在偏好单纯形；利用 flow matching 学习潜在偏好的群体分布；借助拟合的概率排名模型生成新排名。理论上证明排名生成可归约到潜在分布学习，并推导出关于物品数量、排名长度和潜在维度的有限样本生成保证。
Result: 摘要报告实验在合成和真实数据集上提升了群体级生成保真度，并给出偏好异质性的可统计解释表示；理论部分澄清了物品数量、排名长度和潜在维度如何影响生成准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架为排名数据的群体级生成建模提供了统计可解释的方案，并通过有限样本保证明确了关键维度对准确率的影响；其适用范围聚焦于排名数据，未涉及其他数据类型。
Relevance: 5
