papers.title: Learning Deep Modality-Shared Self-Expressiveness for Image Clustering with Textual Information
papers.abstract_en: Leveraging textual information for image clustering has emerged as a promising direction, largely owing to the powerful representations learned by Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Existing approaches typically retrieve a textual counterpart for each image and then refine multimodal representations by directly enforcing cross-modal agreement, e.g., maximizing image-text similarity inherited from pretrained VLMs. However, such a strategy aligns heterogeneous representations across modalities without explicitly modeling the intrinsic structure within each modality and thus might yield unreliable alignment or distort modality-specific structures that are crucial for clustering. In this paper, we propose a simple but principled approach, termed deep modality-shared self-expressive model (DeepMORSE), which discovers cross-modal structures via a modality-shared self-expressive model and simultaneously learns structured representations that conform to a union of modality-specific subspaces. Moreover, we theoretically justify that the modality-shared self-expressive coefficients suppress inter-class noise towards a subspace-preserving solution, and show that mini-batch optimization procedure introduces an implicit regularization onto the self-expressive model. We evaluate our DeepMORSE on six widely used image clustering benchmarks and observe performance improvements exceeding 3% on the UCF-101, DTD-47, and ImageNet-Dogs datasets. In addition, we demonstrate the strong transferability of the learned representations by achieving state-of-the-art performance on downstream tasks such as image retrieval and zero-shot classification---without requiring any task-specific losses or post-processing. The code is available at: https://github.com/mengxianghan123/DeepMORSE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeepMORSE，一种用于图像聚类的深度模态共享自表达模型（modality-shared self-expressive model），利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）的文本信息。与直接强制跨模态一致性的方法不同，DeepMORSE 通过模态共享的自表达系数发现跨模态结构，同时学习符合各模态专属子空间并集的结构化表示。摘要报告在 UCF-101、DTD-47 和 ImageNet-Dogs 等六个基准上聚类性能提升超过 3%，并在图像检索和零样本分类下游任务上取得最优结果。
Motivation: 现有方法通常为每张图像检索文本对应物并直接最大化图像-文本相似性以对齐多模态表示，但这种对齐没有显式建模各模态内部的内在结构，可能产生不可靠的对齐或扭曲对聚类关键的结构。
Method: 提出 DeepMORSE：用模态共享的自表达模型发现跨模态结构，同时学习符合模态专属子空间并集的结构化表示；并从理论上证明模态共享自表达系数可抑制类间噪声、趋向子空间保持解，且小批量优化引入隐式正则化。
Result: 在六个广泛使用的图像聚类基准上评估，在 UCF-101、DTD-47 和 ImageNet-Dogs 上性能提升超过 3%；在图像检索和零样本分类等下游任务上无需任务特定损失或后处理即达到最优。
Conclusion: 作者强调模态共享自表达能够更好地利用文本信息进行聚类，并展示了所学表示的强迁移性；代码已公开。

papers.title: Optimal Learning Under Tsybakov Noise
papers.abstract_en: Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learning [Val84] is a fundamental learning model that has been extensively investigated. In this model, $\mathcal{H} \subseteq \{0,1\}^{\mathcal{X}}$ is a concept class, and $h^*\in\mathcal{H}$ is the target concept to be learned. Having access to i.i.d. labeled examples from a distribution $\mathcal{D}$ over $\mathcal{X}\times\{0,1\}$, which admits $h^*$ as the best concept in $\mathcal{H}$, the goal is to design a learning algorithm that outputs a hypothesis having low error competitive to $h^{*}$ with high probability. This model was initially studied under the realizable setting, which assumes that $h^*$ has no error. A natural relaxation is to allow label noise, that is, the true label can be flipped with probability $η\in(0,1/2)$. In reality, certain labels might be extremely noisy, especially for those points near the decision boundary. Hence, it is natural to allow very noisy points, though only rarely. This is quantified by a noise model introduced by [MT99] and [Tsy04], now known as Tsybakov noise. For learning general concept classes, [MN06] gave the general upper and lower bounds for error guarantees under Tsybakov noise. However, their upper and lower bounds differ by a logarithmic factor. Resolving this gap has remained a well-known open question for the past twenty years. In this work, we resolve this open question by improving the upper bound to match the best known lower bound, thus establishing the optimal error guarantee for learning under Tsybakov noise. Our learning algorithm operates by adaptively partitioning the instance space into regions, roughly corresponding to different noise levels, and returning a hypothesis in the concept class satisfying a specific error constraint for each region. Our technique shares a conceptual foundation with several recent advances in non-realizable learning, such as [HLZ24] and [Han25].
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Tsybakov 噪声下的 PAC 学习，目标是弥合 MN06 给出的误差保证上界与下界之间的对数因子差距。作者提出一种自适应划分实例空间为不同噪声水平区域的算法，并在每个区域返回满足特定误差约束的概念类假设，从而将上界改进到与已知下界匹配，确立该设置下的最优误差保证。
Motivation: 经典 PAC 学习在可实现设定下研究，而 Tsybakov 噪声允许决策边界附近的标签以更高概率翻转，更贴近实际。MN06 给出的 Tsybakov 噪声下学习一般概念类的上下界相差一个对数因子，这一差距成为二十年来公开的开放问题。
Method: 提出的学习算法自适应地将实例空间划分为大致对应不同噪声水平的区域，对每个区域施加特定的误差约束，并返回概念类中满足这些约束的假设。技术路线与近期非可实现学习进展（如 HLZ24、Han25）有共同的概念基础。
Result: 摘要表明该工作将上界改进到与已知最优下界匹配，从而在 Tsybakov 噪声下建立了学习的紧误差保证，但未给出具体数值或实验数据。
Conclusion: 作者认为其工作解决了 Tsybakov 噪声下 PAC 学习误差保证的对数因子上下界差距问题，确立了最优误差保证。

papers.title: Constrained Learning with Universally Learnable Concept Classes
papers.abstract_en: We study constrained statistical learning over infinite-dimensional hypothesis classes in the fully nonconvex setting, and establish universal PACC learnability of the solutions of dual algorithms: Probably Approximately Correct on Constraints, guaranteeing optimality and constraint satisfaction at once. This strengthens near-PACC results, whose feasibility residual no amount of data can remove. Optimality is caught between generalization, governed by Rademacher complexity and favoring small classes, and strong Lagrangian duality, which rests on Lyapunov convexity for vector measures and needs decomposability, a demand pulling the other way. We reconcile the two by posing the population problem over a universal RKHS $\mathcal{H}_K$, dense in a decomposable envelope, and learning over norm balls of growing radius. This yields the Tikhonov complexity $\mathfrak{T}^{\varepsilon}_{n}$, the least RKHS norm reaching an $\varepsilon$-optimal Lagrangian level set; we prove it finite, obtain exact learnability of the optimal value, and make the sample threshold explicit and polynomial in $1/\varepsilon$ under a source condition. Feasibility is harder: absent convexity the Lagrangian may not attain its infimum, and dual information pins down only an averaged constraint-risk vector, not the risks of any returned predictor. We introduce the closure-realization gap $\varepsilon^\star_\infty$, an index of how well $\mathcal{H}_K$ retrieves feasible solutions from dualization; it is a property of the problem, not of a modeling choice. Learnability is exact when $\varepsilon^\star_\infty=0$, in particular under dual differentiability, and near-PACC with residual exactly $\varepsilon^\star_\infty$ otherwise. Finally, no distribution-free threshold exists already in the unconstrained specialization, so universality is the canonical frame for dual algorithms over large hypothesis classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无限维假设类上的约束统计学习，在完全非凸设定下证明对偶算法 (dual algorithms) 具有普适的 PACC 可学习性 (Probably Approximately Correct on Constraints)，同时保证最优性与约束满足。作者引入 Tikhonov 复杂度与闭包-实现间隙 (closure-realization gap)，在通用 RKHS 上调和 Rademacher 复杂度控制的泛化与基于 Lyapunov 凸性的强对偶之间的矛盾。摘要声称该框架将此前近 PACC (near-PACC) 结果中无法用数据消除的可行性残差改进为可精确刻画的学习性条件。
Motivation: 现存的 near-PACC 结果具有无法被任何数据量消除的可行性残差，本文目标是建立更强的普适 PACC 可学习性；同时需要解决泛化偏好小假设类与强对偶要求可分解性之间的张力。
Method: 将总体问题定义在稠密于可分解包络的通用 RKHS 上，并在半径递增的范数球上学习；定义 Tikhonov 复杂度为达到 ε-最优 Lagrangian 水平集所需的最小 RKHS 范数，并引入闭包-实现间隙来衡量对偶化过程从 RKHS 中恢复可行解的能力。
Result: 摘要证明 Tikhonov 复杂度有限、最优值精确可学习，且在源条件 (source condition) 下样本阈值关于 1/ε 是多项式的；当闭包-实现间隙为零时学习性是精确的，否则为残差恰为该间隙的 near-PACC；即使在无约束特例下也不存在与分布无关的阈值。
Conclusion: 作者强调普适性是大假设类上对偶算法的规范框架，而可行性由问题本身的闭包-实现间隙决定，并非建模选择所能改变。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究无限维假设类上的约束统计学习，在完全非凸设定下证明对偶算法 (dual algorithms) 具有普适的 PACC 可学习性 (Probably Approximately Correct on Constraints)，同时保证最优性与约束满足。作者引入 Tikhonov 复杂度与闭包-实现间隙 (closure-realization gap)，在通用 RKHS 上调和 Rademacher 复杂度控制的泛化与基于 Lyapunov 凸性的强对偶之间的矛盾。摘要声称该框架将此前近 PACC (near-PACC) 结果中无法用数据消除的可行性残差改进为可精确刻画的学习性条件。
summary_sections.motivation: 现存的 near-PACC 结果具有无法被任何数据量消除的可行性残差，本文目标是建立更强的普适 PACC 可学习性；同时需要解决泛化偏好小假设类与强对偶要求可分解性之间的张力。
summary_sections.method: 将总体问题定义在稠密于可分解包络的通用 RKHS 上，并在半径递增的范数球上学习；定义 Tikhonov 复杂度为达到 ε-最优 Lagrangian 水平集所需的最小 RKHS 范数，并引入闭包-实现间隙来衡量对偶化过程从 RKHS 中恢复可行解的能力。
summary_sections.result: 摘要证明 Tikhonov 复杂度有限、最优值精确可学习，且在源条件 (source condition) 下样本阈值关于 1/ε 是多项式的；当闭包-实现间隙为零时学习性是精确的，否则为残差恰为该间隙的 near-PACC；即使在无约束特例下也不存在与分布无关的阈值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调普适性是大假设类上对偶算法的规范框架，而可行性由问题本身的闭包-实现间隙决定，并非建模选择所能改变。

papers.title: Abstracted Away: Resisting Alienation and Ungrounded Abstraction in AI Research Communities
papers.abstract_en: Logics of abstraction in computational AI research often push important forms of knowledge and reflection aside: dominant standards of legitimacy separate from lived experience of harm; the goals of work misalign with the practices that operationalize them; and career demands crowd out critical reflection. Even as prior academic and community-oriented efforts have sought to recontextualize and challenge common practices, exposure to sociotechnical harms and epistemic injustice persists. As three early-career critical AI researchers, we experienced this as alienation: feeling like outsiders in our research communities. This alienation has involved having some aspects of our backgrounds overlooked and others tokenized. We argue our alienation occurred through mechanisms that mirror abstraction by creating distance from relevant material realities. Beyond abstraction's role in computational AI research as a foundational practice structuring complex computational tasks, we have encountered it as a social norm in computational research spaces, illustrated through an autoethnographic inquiry into our alienation. We narrate three vignettes describing how we encountered and resisted alienation in our research communities. By analyzing themes across these accounts, we construct an interpretive framework of alienation categorizing its preconditions, mechanisms, and harms. Finally, we identify affect abstraction, one of the mechanisms of alienation we describe, as a high-leverage mechanism that is resistible by staying attuned to our affective responses, and collective action as a way to reduce risk and isolation when engaging in resistance. To assist others with similar reflection, we present our framework as a hermeneutic resource. Critical self-reflection and meaning-making are necessary steps toward challenging exclusionary disciplinary norms and cultivating more inclusive forms of AI research.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 9th AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics and Society (AIES-26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是三位早期职业批判性 AI 研究者对自身在研究共同体中异化体验的自我民族志 (autoethnographic) 探究。作者认为，计算 AI 研究中的抽象逻辑常将重要知识与反思排斥在外，而他们的异化通过某种模仿抽象的社会机制发生，即与相关物质现实拉开距离。论文叙述三段关于遭遇与抵抗异化的个人叙事，并据此构建一个分类异化前提、机制与伤害的解释性框架。
Motivation: 计算 AI 研究中的合法性标准与受伤害的生活经验相分离，工作目标与其实践方式错位，职业压力挤占批判性反思；既有学术与社群努力仍未能消除社会技术伤害与认识论不正义 (epistemic injustice)。作者作为早期职业研究者亲身经历这种异化，感到在研究共同体中是局外人，部分背景被忽视、部分被工具化。
Method: 采用自我民族志方法，通过三段第一人称叙事描述在各自研究共同体中遭遇并抵抗异化的经历，然后跨叙事进行主题分析，构建一个将异化分为前提、机制和伤害的解释性框架。作者还区分出'情感抽象' (affect abstraction) 这一机制，并提出集体行动作为降低抵抗风险与孤立的途径。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验，其核心产出是异化的解释性框架，以及两项洞察：情感抽象是可被抵抗的高杠杆机制，方法是保持对自身情感反应的觉察；集体行动有助于在抵抗时降低风险与孤立。
Conclusion: 作者将框架作为诠释学资源 (hermeneutic resource) 提供给有类似反思需求的人，并强调批判性自我反思与意义建构是挑战排他性学科规范、培育更具包容性的 AI 研究形式的必要步骤。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Does a Toehold Make a Bidder Bolder? Preemption and Multiplicity in Multi-Round Takeover Auctions
papers.abstract_en: A bidder can quietly buy a stake in a company before making an offer for it. That stake, a toehold, is supposed to pay for itself twice: it makes the bidder willing to bid harder, and it frightens rivals into staying out of the fight. The first effect is arithmetic. The second is what would justify the cost and exposure of taking one at all. Yet toeholds are rare in practice, a standing puzzle. We ask whether that second effect is there once the contest is modelled as several rounds of escalating offers rather than the single exchange classical models assume. We turn it into a game a computer can solve, and certify the answers to an accuracy a referee can check. Three findings. The auction fixes what the toehold-holder earns but not how it bids: the same contest supports a bidder who opens aggressively against a rival who folds, and one who opens cheaply against a rival who does not, with the same profit either way. Aggressive preemptive bidding still appears when the toehold is removed entirely, so it comes from bidding in public and in turns, not from owning the stake. And the tidy "bigger toehold, more deterrence" relationship holds only in a contest cut short after one round; give it a real second round and it stops responding. So the two reasons to buy a toehold do not fare alike. The profit reason holds up; the deterrence reason does not, which suggests why toeholds may be rarer than theory predicts, alongside the procedural costs of disclosure and price impact that this model omits. A warning follows for anyone computing economics from a game solver: solve this auction once and it returns a confident figure for what a preemptive bid is worth; solve it again from a different start and it returns a different one, equally converged. We also report which solvers cope with contests of this shape, including versions too large to enumerate. Code is released.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Games, solvers, and experiments: https://github.com/zainnab-sparq/sequential-takeover-auctions . Companion paper: arXiv:2606.29457
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多轮收购拍卖中“脚趾持股”(toehold)对竞标者行为的影响，将经典单轮模型扩展为可计算的序贯博弈，并验证求解精度。摘要报告三个发现：拍卖决定持股者的收益而非出价方式，同一竞赛可支持不同出价模式但利润相同；即使完全移除持股，激进的先发制人出价仍然出现；且“越大持股越具威慑”的关系只在单轮拍卖中成立。结论认为持股的收益动机成立而威慑动机不成立，并警告博弈求解器在不同初始条件下可能给出同样收敛但不同的数值结果。
Motivation: 经典模型假设单一回合报价，无法解释现实中脚趾持股罕见这一难题；作者将其重新建模为多轮升级报价的博弈，以检验持股的威慑效应是否真实存在。
Method: 将多轮收购拍卖转化为计算机可解的博弈，并给出可被裁判验证的精度保证；同时报告哪些求解器能处理此类竞赛，包括规模过大无法枚举的版本。
Result: 摘要给出三个核心发现：拍卖固定了持股者的收益而非具体出价路径；激进先发制人出价来自公开且轮流报价的机制而非持股本身；且持股与威慑的单调关系只在单轮拍卖中成立，加入第二轮后该关系失效。
Conclusion: 论文认为购买脚趾持股的两个理由表现不一：利润动机成立，威慑动机不成立，这有助于解释为何实际中脚趾持股比理论预测更少见；同时提醒基于博弈求解器计算经济学结论时注意多重解问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Learning-Based Influence Maximization: Simple Neural Surrogates and Native Discrete Search
papers.abstract_en: Existing learning-based influence maximization frameworks rely heavily on complex neural architectures and continuous optimization over seed representations. We challenge this paradigm with SIMBA, a diffusion-model-agnostic framework pairing a lightweight neural surrogate with direct discrete search. SIMBA introduces three key components: 1) uniformly anchored node embeddings that eliminate initialization noise and encourage learning driven by graph topology and diffusion pattern, 2) a shallow two-layer graph neural network surrogate predicting final infection states, and 3) batched multi-swap simulated annealing that explores combinatorial seed space without gradients or continuous relaxation. By shifting compute from complex representation learning to effective discrete search, SIMBA drastically cuts time-to-solution while achieving superior influence spread and data efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/yl489/rethink-IM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视基于学习的影响力最大化 (influence maximization) 范式，提出 SIMBA，一个不依赖具体扩散模型的框架，将轻量神经网络代理与直接离散搜索相结合。SIMBA 采用均匀锚定的节点嵌入、两层图神经网络代理以及批量多交换模拟退火，在无梯度和无连续松弛的条件下搜索种子集合。摘要称该方法大幅缩短求解时间，同时获得更优的影响力传播效果和数据效率。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的影响力最大化方法严重依赖复杂神经架构和对种子表示的连续优化，可能存在计算开销大、对初始化敏感等问题。作者希望验证用简单神经代理配合原生离散搜索是否足以超越这一主流范式。
Method: SIMBA 包含三个关键组件：均匀锚定节点嵌入 (uniformly anchored node embeddings) 以消除初始化噪声并让学习由图拓扑和扩散模式驱动；浅层两层图神经网络代理用于预测最终感染状态；批量多交换模拟退火 (batched multi-swap simulated annealing) 在组合种子空间中进行无梯度搜索。
Result: 摘要报告 SIMBA 大幅缩短 time-to-solution，并在影响力传播 (influence spread) 和数据效率 (data efficiency) 上取得优于现有方法的表现。摘要未给出具体数值或基准名称。
Conclusion: 作者的结论是把计算资源从复杂表示学习转移到有效的离散搜索，可以用更简单的组件达到更好的效果，从而对当前基于学习的框架提出质疑。

papers.title: Agentic AI-powered flexible fiber-bundle endoscopy for high-resolution NIR-II fluorescence imaging in vivo
papers.abstract_en: Fiber-bundle endoscopy offers a compact and flexible route for clinical fluorescence imaging through natural human orifices, but since its first report in the 1950s, it has remained limited by low spatial resolution, honeycomb artifacts, and inter-core crosstalk. The crosstalk becomes more pronounced at near-infrared-II wavelengths (NIR-II, 1000-3000 nm), a spectral window that offers superior contrast, resolution, and tissue penetration depth for biomedical imaging. Here, we present an AI-powered flexible endoscopy platform that overcomes these constraints through optical-computational co-design: optimizing ultrathin fiber bundles to mitigate crosstalk-induced image blur and enable high-fidelity image transmission across the visible-to-NIR-II spectral range, and developing an Agent-Guided Mixture-of-Experts (GAME) pipeline for honeycomb-artifact removal and image restoration. GAME provides a single restoration entry point for diverse biomedical images acquired with our endoscope, spanning cell, mouse and human samples. It dynamically routes each input to suitable restoration experts via a vision-language model, facilitating image reconstruction with a fourfold resolution improvement beyond the NyquistShannon sampling limit. The utility of our endoscope is demonstrated through in vivo NIR-II imaging of anatomical structures in mice, as well as imaging of the digital micromirror device (DMD)-projected human gastric tube and lymphatic system, paving the way for future clinical translation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于光计算协同设计 (optical-computational co-design) 的 AI 驱动柔性光纤束内窥镜平台，用于可见光至 NIR-II (1000-3000 nm) 范围的高保真荧光成像。作者开发了 Agent-Guided Mixture-of-Experts (GAME) 流水线，通过视觉语言模型动态路由到相应修复专家，去除蜂窝伪影并恢复图像，实现超越 Nyquist-Shannon 采样极限四倍的分辨率提升。摘要展示了小鼠体内 NIR-II 成像以及 DMD 投影的人胃管和淋巴系统成像，指向临床转化。
Motivation: 光纤束内窥镜自 1950 年代起受限于低空间分辨率、蜂窝伪影和芯间串扰 (inter-core crosstalk)，该问题在 NIR-II 波段尤为严重，限制了高对比度、高穿透深度生物成像的应用。
Method: 采用光学与计算协同设计：一方面优化超薄光纤束以缓解串扰引起的图像模糊并支持可见光到 NIR-II 的高保真传输；另一方面提出 GAME 流水线，以视觉语言模型为引导，将不同生物医学图像动态路由至合适的恢复专家，统一完成蜂窝伪影去除和图像复原。
Result: 摘要报告 GAME 在细胞、小鼠和人体样本等多种图像上实现单一恢复入口，并带来超出 Nyquist-Shannon 采样极限四倍的分辨率提升；体内实验包括小鼠解剖结构 NIR-II 成像及 DMD 投影的人胃管和淋巴系统成像。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该平台有望克服光纤束内窥镜长期存在的分辨率和伪影瓶颈，为未来临床转化铺平道路；其验证目前覆盖细胞、小鼠和人体样本的成像场景。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 采用光学与计算协同设计：一方面优化超薄光纤束以缓解串扰引起的图像模糊并支持可见光到 NIR-II 的高保真传输；另一方面提出 GAME 流水线，以视觉语言模型为引导，将不同生物医学图像动态路由至合适的恢复专家，统一完成蜂窝伪影去除和图像复原。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 GAME 在细胞、小鼠和人体样本等多种图像上实现单一恢复入口，并带来超出 Nyquist-Shannon 采样极限四倍的分辨率提升；体内实验包括小鼠解剖结构 NIR-II 成像及 DMD 投影的人胃管和淋巴系统成像。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该平台有望克服光纤束内窥镜长期存在的分辨率和伪影瓶颈，为未来临床转化铺平道路；其验证目前覆盖细胞、小鼠和人体样本的成像场景。

papers.title: Anatomically Consistent Cross-Contrast Super-Resolution of Anisotropic Brain T2w MRI
papers.abstract_en: T2-weighted (T2w) brain MRI provides fluid-sensitive soft-tissue contrast that is important for neuro-oncology and radiotherapy planning. However, T2w scans are acquired with anisotropic voxels and appear blurred or stair-stepped on coronal and sagittal views, which obscures small structures and weakens any downstream 3D analysis. We propose VIPP-SR (View-Independent Patched Projection Super-Resolution), a cross-contrast guided super-resolution framework that restores the inter-plane resolution of an existing anisotropic T2w volume without an isotropic ground-truth T2w. VIPP-SR first trains a view-independent patched generator (VIP-GAN) to learn local T1c-to-T2w anatomical correspondence from high-resolution axial slices. The trained generator is then applied to axial, coronal, and sagittal views of the T1c volume to generate three orthogonal T2w estimates. Shape-preserving patching and deepest-skip removal reduce view-specific shortcuts, thereby constraining the generator to learn patch-local representations and enabling the zero-shot inter-plane transfer. Central to VIPP-SR, a projection-based optimization then enforces anatomical consistency across the three view-specific volumes, fusing them by balancing inter-plane self-consistency against per-view data fidelity. The generator is trained on BraTS-MET and evaluated on both the held-out BraTS-MET testing set and the BraTS-GLI cohort without retraining, assessing the cross-cohort generalizability. The results validate that VIPP-SR improves downstream segmentation over the real anisotropic T2w baseline, raising mean-label Dice from 0.330 to 0.465 on BraTS-MET and, zero-shot, from 0.473 to 0.563 on BraTS-GLI and ablation studies identify inter-plane self-consistency as the main source of the gain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VIPP-SR，一种跨对比度引导的超分辨率框架，用于在不依赖各向同性 T2w 真值的情况下恢复各向异性脑 T2w MRI 的层间分辨率。方法先训练视图无关的 patch 生成器（VIP-GAN）学习 T1c-to-T2w 解剖对应，再在三正交视图上生成 T2w 估计，并通过基于投影的优化融合三个视图体积。在 BraTS-MET 和零样本 BraTS-GLI 上，该方法提升了下游分割的 mean-label Dice。
Motivation: T2w 脑 MRI 对神经肿瘤和放疗规划很重要，但各向异性体素导致冠状面和矢状面模糊或阶梯伪影，削弱小结构可见性和下游 3D 分析；同时缺少各向同性 T2w 真值使得常规超分辨率难以实现。
Method: VIPP-SR 分为两部分：先训练视图无关的 patch 生成器 VIP-GAN，从高分辨率轴向切片学习 T1c-to-T2w 局部解剖对应；再将其零样本应用到 T1c 体积的轴向、冠状和矢状视图，得到三个正交 T2w 估计。通过保持形状的 patching 和移除最深跳跃连接来减少视图特定捷径，最后用基于投影的优化在三个视图体积间施加解剖一致性，平衡层间自一致性与逐视图数据保真度。
Result: 在 BraTS-MET 测试集上，与真实各向异性 T2w 基线相比，mean-label Dice 从 0.330 提升到 0.465；在无需重新训练的 BraTS-GLI 跨队列零样本评估中，从 0.473 提升到 0.563。消融研究显示层间自一致性是主要增益来源。
Conclusion: 摘要表明跨对比度引导、视图无关的 patch 生成结合投影优化能够在无各向同性 T2w 真值条件下提升各向异性 T2w 的层间分辨率，并改善下游分割；但验证范围限于脑 MRI 数据集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exact Rank and Convex Calibration Dimension Lower Bounds for the Multi-Label F1 Loss
papers.abstract_en: The instance-wise $F_1$ measure is a central performance measure for multi-label classification. For a problem with $s$ labels, it defines a $2^s\times 2^s$ loss matrix. Previous work exhibited $s^2+1$-coordinate affine and shifted low-rank representations and used them to construct quadratic-dimensional convex calibrated surrogates. We determine the exact rank. Under the convention $F_1(\varnothing,\varnothing)=1$, the $F_1$ score matrix, the shifted loss matrix, and the unshifted loss matrix all have rank $s^2-s+2$, while the column-affine dimension of the loss is $s^2-s+1$. The proof factors the nonempty score matrix through subset-incidence matrices and a positive-definite Cauchy matrix. Exact rank does not, by itself, lower-bound the dimension of an arbitrary convex calibrated surrogate. We therefore analyze the Bayes geometry of $F_1$ directly. We construct a distribution for which precisely all supersets of a fixed core label set are Bayes optimal, and show that the corresponding active loss columns, restricted to the witness support, have affine dimension $hn$, where $n=s-\lfloor s/3\rfloor$ and $h=\lceil(s\lfloor s/3\rfloor)^{1/2}\rceil-1$. Applying the feasible-subspace lower bound for convex calibration dimension gives \[ \operatorname{CCdim}(L^{F_1}) \ge \left(\frac{2}{3\sqrt{3}}-o(1)\right)s^2. \] Together with the quadratic upper bound, this establishes $\operatorname{CCdim}(L^{F_1})=Θ(s^2)$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多标签分类中 instance-wise F1 损失的精确秩与凸校准维数（convex calibration dimension）。摘要表明，在 F1(∅,∅)=1 的约定下，F1 得分矩阵、移位损失矩阵和非移位损失矩阵的秩均为 s^2-s+2，损失的列仿射维为 s^2-s+1。作者进一步直接分析 F1 的 Bayes 几何，构造使固定核心标签集的所有超集均 Bayes 最优的分布，并得到 CCdim(L^{F1}) ≥ (2/(3√3)-o(1))s^2 的下界；结合已有的二次上界，确立 CCdim(L^{F1})=Θ(s^2)。
Motivation: instance-wise F1 是多标签分类的核心性能度量，其损失矩阵的秩与凸校准替代所需的最小维度此前未被精确刻画。仅知道精确秩不足以约束任意凸校准替代的维度，因此需要直接研究 F1 损失在 Bayes 决策规则下的几何结构。
Method: 证明部分将非空 F1 得分矩阵通过子集关联矩阵（subset-incidence matrices）和一个正定 Cauchy 矩阵进行分解，从而确定矩阵秩和列仿射维。校准维数部分构造一个特定的标签分布，其中固定核心标签集的所有超集都是 Bayes 最优，然后计算相应活动损失列在支撑集上的仿射维数，并应用可行子空间下界（feasible-subspace lower bound）得到凸校准维数的下界。
Result: 摘要报告：F1 得分矩阵、移位与非移位损失矩阵的秩均为 s^2-s+2，损失的列仿射维为 s^2-s+1；凸校准维数满足 CCdim(L^{F1}) ≥ (2/(3√3)-o(1))s^2，连同二次上界最终给出 CCdim(L^{F1})=Θ(s^2)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该结果与已有二次上界一起，确立了多标签 F1 损失凸校准维数的渐近阶为 Θ(s^2)。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Estimating Uncertainty in Galaxy Morphology Classification
papers.abstract_en: Astronomers classify galaxy morphology to investigate cosmic evolution. While deep foundation models are increasingly utilized in Galaxy Morphology Classification (GMC), little work has been done on evaluating the uncertainty of GMC results. Uncertainty evaluation is important because astronomical data are inherently noisy due to instrumental and environmental limitations. Also, the continuous evolution of galaxies creates intrinsic morphological ambiguity. However, current foundation models operate as deterministic point estimators, failing to quantify the uncertainty. To overcome this limitation, we propose UEGMC, a post-hoc framework of Uncertainty Estimation for Galaxy Morphology Classification. It categorizes uncertainty in GMC into distinct types by model parameters, astronomical data, reference standards, or intrinsic physical ambiguities, thereby facilitating better classification. Our framework can directly predict uncertainties from representations extracted from the frozen backbones of foundation models, without computationally expensive sampling, therefore enabling fine-grained uncertainty evaluations. Our experimental results demonstrate that UEGMC provides competitive uncertainty quantification performance compared with previous methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UEGMC，一个面向星系形态分类 (Galaxy Morphology Classification, GMC) 的不确定性估计后处理框架。该框架将不确定性按模型参数、天文数据、参考标准和固有物理模糊性分类，并利用冻结的 foundation model 骨干提取的表示直接预测不确定性，避免计算昂贵的采样。实验表明 UEGMC 相比先前方法提供了有竞争力的不确定性量化性能。
Motivation: 天文数据因仪器和环境限制天然含噪，且星系连续演化造成固有形态模糊，但现有深度基础模型在 GMC 中仅作为确定性点估计器，无法量化这些不确定性，也缺少对 GMC 结果不确定性的系统评估。
Method: 提出 UEGMC，一种后处理 (post-hoc) 的不确定性估计框架；它先按模型参数、天文数据、参考标准或内在物理模糊性对不确定性分类，再从基础模型冻结骨干提取的特征直接预测各类不确定性，从而无需昂贵采样即可进行细粒度评估。
Result: 摘要报告 UEGMC 提供的不确定性量化性能与先前方法相比具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架通过分类并直接预测不确定性，能够支持细粒度的不确定性评估并改善星系形态分类。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: From Product Search to Preference Articulation: The Economics of Agentic Commerce
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI is shifting digital commerce from browsing toward agentic search, in which consumers delegate product discovery to AI agents. We compare manual search, which accurately evaluates a limited product set, with agentic search, which screens a broad catalog through noisy representations of preferences and products. Preference complexity is the number of satisfaction-relevant dimensions that are difficult to articulate before search but readily evaluated upon inspection. Consumers have finite attention and choose search intensity: products inspected manually or preference-refinement depth with an agent. We obtain three findings. First, manual search collapses beyond a finite complexity threshold: inspection ceases, mismatch reaches the no-search benchmark, and platform revenue falls to zero. Agentic search avoids this collapse. Once refinement becomes worthwhile, it remains worthwhile as complexity rises; mismatch stays below the no-search benchmark and revenue remains positive, although articulation effort and mismatch may increase. Second, platforms rank the regimes by conversion revenue, whereas consumers also bear search expenditure. When manual inspection is sufficiently inexpensive, agentic search becomes revenue-superior before consumers voluntarily adopt it, creating an adoption lag in which consumers rationally continue manual search. Third, conditional on agentic participation, platforms may assign lower fidelity to consumers with larger attention budgets because they can offset noisier representations through additional refinement, yielding an inverted fidelity allocation. Agentic commerce thus shifts scarcity from product inspection to preference articulation, making consumers' willingness and ability to interact central to voluntary use and platform fidelity design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生成式 AI 将数字商务从浏览推向智能体搜索（agentic search）后的经济学问题：消费者委托 AI 代理进行产品发现。作者比较了能准确评估有限产品集的手动搜索，与通过偏好和产品的噪声表征筛选广泛目录的智能体搜索。核心发现是：偏好复杂度超过有限阈值时手动搜索会崩溃，而智能体搜索避免这种崩溃；平台按转化收入排序两种制度，但消费者还承担搜索成本，导致采纳滞后；在智能体参与下平台可能对注意力预算更大的消费者分配更低保真度，形成反转的保真度分配。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 正在改变数字商务形态，从浏览转向智能体式搜索，但现有理论未系统比较手动搜索与智能体搜索的经济后果，尤其是偏好复杂度、有限注意力和平台收益之间的权衡。
Method: 构建理论模型，将偏好复杂度定义为搜索前难以表达但检查时易于评估的满意度相关维度数；消费者具有有限注意力并选择搜索强度，即手动检查产品数量或与智能体进行偏好细化（preference refinement）的深度。
Result: 摘要给出三项结果：手动搜索在有限复杂度阈值之上崩溃，检查停止、错配回到无搜索基准、平台收入降为零，而智能体搜索避免崩溃且细化一旦值得就持续值得；当手动检查足够便宜时，智能体搜索在消费者自愿采纳前就已实现收入优势，产生采纳滞后；条件于智能体参与，平台可能对注意力预算更大的消费者分配更低保真度，形成反转保真度分配。
Conclusion: 智能体商务将稀缺性从产品检查转移到偏好表达（preference articulation），消费者互动意愿与能力成为自愿使用和平台保真度设计的核心。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 摘要给出三项结果：手动搜索在有限复杂度阈值之上崩溃，检查停止、错配回到无搜索基准、平台收入降为零，而智能体搜索避免崩溃且细化一旦值得就持续值得；当手动检查足够便宜时，智能体搜索在消费者自愿采纳前就已实现收入优势，产生采纳滞后；条件于智能体参与，平台可能对注意力预算更大的消费者分配更低保真度，形成反转保真度分配。
summary_sections.conclusion: 智能体商务将稀缺性从产品检查转移到偏好表达（preference articulation），消费者互动意愿与能力成为自愿使用和平台保真度设计的核心。

papers.title: CAP: A Scalable Benchmark for Evaluating Cross-Site Browser Agents with Complex Actions and Perception
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents that interact with the web through browsers. While recent progress has been driven by benchmarks that evaluate end-to-end task success, these evaluations largely overlook two fundamental sources of difficulty in real web browsing: complex actions over rich user interfaces and visual perception of dynamically rendered content, especially in workflows that span multiple websites. We introduce CAP, a scalable benchmark for evaluating browser agents on cross-site, human-like web tasks that require non-trivial UI interactions and visual understanding. Specifically, we adopt a decomposition-and-recomposition pipeline that first abstracts each website into a structured site card capturing user-facing functions, complex execution operations, and perceptual requirements, and then recomposes these components into realistic cross-site workflows. Each task is therefore grounded in multiple specific operations on each website, enabling fine-grained diagnosis. Built on this framework, we construct 420 tasks across 108 real-world websites and 24 domains under careful quality control. Experiments on state-of-the-art browser agents using our verifiable agent-as-a-judge evaluation framework show low success rates and reveal that perception-heavy interactions remain a major bottleneck, exposing substantial gaps between current agents and real-world web browsing demands.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAP，一个用于评估跨站点（cross-site）浏览器智能体的可扩展基准，聚焦复杂 UI 交互与视觉感知。作者采用分解-重组（decomposition-and-recomposition）管线，将网站抽象为结构化站点卡片（site card）并重组为跨站点工作流，在 108 个真实网站、24 个领域上构建了 420 个任务。使用可验证的 agent-as-a-judge 评估框架对最先进浏览器智能体进行实验，结果显示成功率低，感知密集型交互是主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有浏览器智能体基准主要评估端到端任务成功率，忽略了真实网页浏览中两个基本难点：富用户界面上的复杂操作，以及动态渲染内容的视觉感知，尤其在多网站工作流中。
Method: 采用分解-重组流程：先将每个网站抽象为结构化站点卡片，捕获面向用户的功能、复杂执行操作和感知需求，再将组件重组为真实的跨站点工作流；并配套可验证的 agent-as-a-judge 评估框架。
Result: 构建了覆盖 108 个真实网站、24 个领域、共 420 个任务的评测集；对最先进浏览器智能体的实验显示成功率低，并揭示感知密集型（perception-heavy）交互仍是主要瓶颈，暴露当前智能体与真实网页浏览需求之间的显著差距。
Conclusion: 摘要强调复杂 UI 交互和视觉感知是真实网页浏览的关键难点，CAP 通过细粒度、跨站点的可扩展任务支持诊断，并表明当前浏览器智能体在这方面仍明显不足。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lasso Universality Under Linearly Dependent Covariates in the Sparse Regime
papers.abstract_en: Throughout the last decade, Gaussian universality has been widely studied for high-dimensional estimation problems. Most of the literature focuses on i.i.d. sensing matrices or accounts for special forms of dependence, such as block dependence or other specific row/column dependencies. More general simultaneous row and column mixing has not yet been fully studied. In this paper, we focus on that setting. We prove a Gaussian universality theorem for the lasso in the sparse regime, where the non- Gaussian covariates have linearly dependent rows and columns. To the best of our knowledge, our setting permits a broader simultaneous row and column dependence structure than those treated in much of the prior universality literature. Numerical illustrations for various sparse profiles support the universality claims of this paper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高维估计问题中高斯普适性 (Gaussian universality) 的推广，针对 lasso 在稀疏机制下协变量同时具有线性相关的行和列依赖的情况，证明了一个高斯普适性定理。作者声称该设定允许比先前普适性文献更广泛的同步行列依赖结构，并用数值示例支持普适性结论。
Motivation: 现有高斯普适性研究大多假设 i.i.d. 感知矩阵或仅处理块依赖等特殊依赖形式，更一般的同步行和列混合尚未被充分研究。
Method: 针对非高斯协变量具有线性相关行和列的 lasso，在稀疏机制下证明高斯普适性定理，并给出数值实验。
Result: 摘要报告数值示例支持其普适性主张，但未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者强调他们的设定涵盖了比先前普适性文献更广的同步行列依赖结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Not Worth Another Token: Marginal Value Estimation for Efficient Deep Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon research agents solve open-ended tasks through iterative retrieval, aggregation, and synthesis, but context grows rapidly while the marginal value of additional evidence often declines. This leads to unnecessary token cost, higher latency, and noisier inputs for final report generation. We study marginal value estimation for context management in deep research agents and present the first systematic stage-aware comparison of pruning strategies across the pipeline. We evaluate lightweight heuristic criteria and a learned value model at pre-retrieval, post-retrieval, and pre-synthesis stages. Our results show that pruning effectiveness depends more on where pruning is applied than on the specific scoring rule: early pruning yields the largest end-to-end savings, while later pruning mainly refines the final synthesis context. Lightweight heuristics reduce token usage by up to 73% with little quality degradation, learned pruning remains competitive on selected trade-offs, and no single method dominates across quality, efficiency, and faithfulness. These findings provide practical guidance for designing efficient long-horizon agentic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长时程研究智能体（deep research agents）中上下文快速增长而额外证据边际价值递减的问题，首次给出跨流水线的分阶段（stage-aware）剪枝策略系统比较。作者在检索前（pre-retrieval）、检索后（post-retrieval）和综合前（pre-synthesis）三个阶段评估了轻量级启发式准则与学习式价值模型。结果发现剪枝效果更取决于应用位置而非具体评分规则：早期剪枝带来最大的端到端节省，后期剪枝主要优化最终综合上下文；轻量级启发式可减少最多 73% 的 token 使用且质量损失很小，但没有单一方法在质量、效率和忠实性上全面占优。
Motivation: 长时程研究智能体通过迭代检索、聚合与综合解决开放任务，但上下文快速增长，而额外证据的边际价值往往下降，导致不必要的 token 成本、更高延迟以及最终报告输入噪声增加。本文旨在系统研究上下文管理中的边际价值估计问题。
Method: 提出首个系统性的分阶段剪枝策略比较框架，在检索前、检索后和综合前三个阶段评估轻量级启发式准则与一个学习式价值模型在上下文剪枝中的表现。
Result: 摘要报告剪枝有效性更依赖剪枝应用的阶段而非具体评分规则：早期剪枝产生最大的端到端 token 节省，后期剪枝主要优化最终综合上下文；轻量级启发式最高减少 73% token 使用且质量退化很小，学习式剪枝在选定的权衡上具有竞争力，但没有单一方法在质量、效率与忠实性上全面占优。
Conclusion: 这些发现为设计高效的长时程智能体系统提供了实用指导，强调选择剪枝位置比选择评分规则更重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Safety Cost of Steering Vectors Is Separable and Reducible
papers.abstract_en: Steering vectors are a lightweight tool for controlling LLM behavior. However, emerging evidence shows that steering vectors can unintentionally compromise a model's safety mechanisms and increase compliance with harmful requests, while no effective mitigation yet exists. In this work, we show that this safety degradation arises from a separable component in the vector that disrupts the model's safety mechanisms but contributes little to the steering objective. We identify and remove this safety-degrading component, formulating the task as a constrained optimization problem solved through primal-dual updates, subject to preserving the intended steering effect and bounding false refusal. The resulting solution is both interpretable and surgical: the optimization recovers a single direction whose ablation from the steering vector restores model safety with minimal utility cost. Across models, steering behaviors, and attack suites, including unseen attacks types, our method substantially reduces steering-induced safety degradation while preserving the original steering effect with minimal impact on false refusal. Our method offers a post-hoc correction to steering vectors that mitigates their safety cost, and more broadly, it provides a general recipe for applying activation-level model interventions without paying a safety tax.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 steering vectors 在控制 LLM 行为时意外削弱安全机制、增加对有害请求服从度的问题，并提出一种可解释且外科手术式的后处理修正方法。作者将任务建模为带约束的优化问题，通过 primal-dual 更新求解，恢复一个单一方向，将其从 steering vector 中消融后即可在极小效用代价下恢复模型安全性。实验覆盖多种模型、steering 行为和攻击套件（含未见过的攻击类型），显示该方法能大幅降低由 steering 引起的安全退化，同时基本保持原有 steering 效果。
Motivation: Steering vectors 是一种轻量级控制 LLM 行为的手段，但已有证据表明它们可能无意中破坏模型的安全机制并增加对有害请求的遵从，目前缺乏有效缓解措施。
Method: 将安全退化归因于向量中一个可分离的组分，该组分破坏安全机制但对 steering 目标贡献很小；据此把去除该组分的形式化为带约束优化问题，并使用 primal-dual 更新求解，同时约束保留预期 steering 效果并限制错误拒绝 (false refusal)。优化结果恢复出一个单一方向，其消融即可修复安全性。
Result: 摘要报告称，跨多种模型、steering 行为和攻击套件（包括未见过的攻击类型），该方法显著降低 steering 引发的安全退化，同时保持原有 steering 效果且对错误拒绝影响很小。
Conclusion: 该方法是对 steering vectors 的一种事后修正，可缓解其安全代价，并推广为一种无需支付安全税 (safety tax) 的激活层面模型干预的一般方案。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: LLMVisor: A Real-Time Latency Attribution Model for Multi-Tenant LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: As LLM inference shifts to multi-tenant GPU clusters, co-batching improves throughput but obscures per-tenant usage and limits control. Enabling fractional sharing of the inference engine requires a real-time, per-request attribution primitive that is accurate and light enough to run inside the scheduling loop. We present LLMVisor, a roofline-guided latency attribution model that captures the memory-bound and compute-bound phases via a concise piecewise-linear form over features proportional to FLOPs and memory I/O traffic. LLMVisor decomposes batch latency into additive, per-request shares and runs efficiently at microsecond scale. We evaluate LLMVisor across Llama 3.1-8B and Qwen 2.5-14B/32B on A100/H100 GPUs under varying tensor parallelism and workload mixes. Compared to a token-count baseline, LLMVisor attains near-perfect R-squared and reduces relative error by up to 2.5x and 3.3x at p90 and p99, respectively, for prefill, and by up to 3.5x and 4.4x for decode, despite batching variability and sequence divergence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LLMVisor，一个基于 roofline 模型的实时延迟归因 (latency attribution) 方法，用于多租户 LLM 推理服务。LLMVisor 通过关于 FLOPs 和内存 I/O 流量的简洁分段线性函数，将批处理延迟分解为可加性的逐请求份额，并在微秒级运行。在 Llama 3.1-8B、Qwen 2.5-14B/32B 以及 A100/H100 GPU 上，相比 token 计数基线，该模型达到接近完美的 R²，并显著降低 p90/p99 相对误差。
Motivation: 多租户 GPU 集群中，co-batching 提升了吞吐量，但掩盖了每个租户的实际资源使用情况，限制了细粒度的控制和计费。要实现推理引擎的分片共享，需要一个准确且轻量、能在调度循环内实时运行的逐请求归因原语。
Method: 提出 LLMVisor，一种 roofline 引导的延迟归因模型，通过基于 FLOPs 和内存 I/O 流量的分段线性函数建模 memory-bound 和 compute-bound 阶段，将批处理总延迟分解为可加性的逐请求份额，并以微秒级开销运行。
Result: 在 Llama 3.1-8B 和 Qwen 2.5-14B/32B 上，使用 A100/H100 并改变张量并行度和工作负载混合，相比 token-count 基线，LLMVisor 获得接近完美的 R²；在 prefill 的 p90 和 p99 相对误差分别降低最多 2.5 倍和 3.3 倍，在 decode 分别降低最多 3.5 倍和 4.4 倍，同时面对批处理变化和序列长度发散仍保持稳健。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，LLMVisor 的归因模型精度高且足够轻量，适合在真实调度循环中运行，能够为多租户推理服务提供准确的逐请求延迟分解。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 LLMVisor，一个基于 roofline 模型的实时延迟归因 (latency attribution) 方法，用于多租户 LLM 推理服务。LLMVisor 通过关于 FLOPs 和内存 I/O 流量的简洁分段线性函数，将批处理延迟分解为可加性的逐请求份额，并在微秒级运行。在 Llama 3.1-8B、Qwen 2.5-14B/32B 以及 A100/H100 GPU 上，相比 token 计数基线，该模型达到接近完美的 R²，并显著降低 p90/p99 相对误差。
summary_sections.motivation: 多租户 GPU 集群中，co-batching 提升了吞吐量，但掩盖了每个租户的实际资源使用情况，限制了细粒度的控制和计费。要实现推理引擎的分片共享，需要一个准确且轻量、能在调度循环内实时运行的逐请求归因原语。
summary_sections.method: 提出 LLMVisor，一种 roofline 引导的延迟归因模型，通过基于 FLOPs 和内存 I/O 流量的分段线性函数建模 memory-bound 和 compute-bound 阶段，将批处理总延迟分解为可加性的逐请求份额，并以微秒级开销运行。
summary_sections.result: 在 Llama 3.1-8B 和 Qwen 2.5-14B/32B 上，使用 A100/H100 并改变张量并行度和工作负载混合，相比 token-count 基线，LLMVisor 获得接近完美的 R²；在 prefill 的 p90 和 p99 相对误差分别降低最多 2.5 倍和 3.3 倍，在 decode 分别降低最多 3.5 倍和 4.4 倍，同时面对批处理变化和序列长度发散仍保持稳健。

papers.title: DoRF++: Spherical Representation Learning over Doppler Radiance Fields for Robust Wi-Fi Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by the IEEE 802.11bf effort to standardize advanced WLAN sensing, interest in Wi-Fi Channel State Information (CSI) for passive, device-free, and privacy-preserving activity and gesture recognition has grown rapidly. Recent studies have shown that Doppler velocity projections extracted from CSI, which directly reflect human-motion velocity, enable more robust human activity recognition (HAR) and stronger generalization across users and unseen conditions. Nevertheless, reliable generalization under real-world variability remains a major challenge, hindering the adoption of Wi-Fi sensing in real-world applications. To address this challenge, we introduce Doppler Radiance Fields (DoRF), bringing the concept of neural radiance fields (NeRF) from computer vision into Wi-Fi sensing. DoRF models Doppler velocity projections extracted from Wi-Fi CSI as sparse and diverse virtual-camera views of human motion. It then infers a latent 3D motion sequence whose projections along learned effective Doppler directions explain the CSI-derived Doppler observations. The recovered motion is subsequently projected onto an equiangular grid of directions on the unit sphere, producing a spherical representation of the underlying motion. Since DoRF naturally defines the Doppler representation on spheres, we further introduce DoRF++, a spherical-learning design that applies spherical Transformers for activity classification. Experiments on our collected hand-gesture dataset show that DoRF++ significantly outperforms state-of-the-art Wi-Fi-based HAR methods in cross-user generalization accuracy, especially for difficult gestures in settings with a single multi-antenna receiver access point (AP).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DoRF（Doppler Radiance Fields），将神经辐射场（NeRF）思想从计算机视觉引入 Wi-Fi 感知：把从 CSI 提取的多普勒速度投影建模为人体运动的稀疏虚拟相机视图，推断隐式 3D 运动序列，再投影到单位球面的等角网格上得到球面表示。进一步提出 DoRF++，用球形 Transformer 完成活动分类；在自采手势数据集上的跨用户泛化准确率显著优于现有 Wi-Fi 人体活动识别（HAR）方法。
Motivation: Wi-Fi CSI 的被动、无设备、保护隐私感知虽受 IEEE 802.11bf 推动而受到关注，但真实世界变化下的可靠泛化仍是主要挑战，阻碍实际部署。
Method: DoRF 从 Wi-Fi CSI 提取多普勒速度投影，将其视为人体运动在不同虚拟相机视角下的观测，学习隐式 3D 运动序列；随后在单位球面的等角方向网格上定义球面表示，DoRF++ 使用球形 Transformer（spherical Transformer）对该表示进行活动分类。
Result: 在作者采集的手势数据集上，DoRF++ 在跨用户泛化准确率上显著优于最先进的 Wi-Fi HAR 方法，尤其在单个多天线接收 AP 场景下的困难手势上优势明显。
Conclusion: 作者认为将 NeRF 概念引入 Wi-Fi 感知并采用球面表示学习可提升跨用户泛化；但实验仅基于自采数据集，未涉及其他环境或更大规模验证。

papers.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation without Any Supervision
papers.abstract_en: On-policy (Self-)Distillation (OPD / OPSD) has shown strong potential for post-training large language models (LLMs). However, existing methods still rely heavily on external supervision, including ground-truth signals, environmental feedback, or guidance from larger models, and therefore fall short of genuine "self"-distillation. In this study, we show that on-policy self-distillation can be achieved using only a model's own generations via internal consistency. We propose unsupervised on-policy self-distillation (U-OPSD). U-OPSD first samples multiple rollouts and constructs a pseudo solution by majority vote under a self-consistency threshold. It then conditions the model's distribution on the pseudo-solution and distills itself on the disagreeing completions, allowing the model to correct itself precisely where it is confidently wrong. Across diverse benchmarks, base models, and training settings, U-OPSD consistently improves over the base models and matches or surpasses supervised methods with ground truth (GT) such as OPSD and GRPO. On five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, i.e., AIME24, AIME25, HMMT25, MATH500, and AMC23, U-OPSD improves over the base model by 8.5% and 10.7% on Qwen3 non-thinking mode at 4B and 8B scales, and outperforms OPSD by 3.2% and 2.3% on average, respectively. In thinking mode, U-OPSD stays on par with OPSD, ahead by 0.9% at 4B and level at 8B and surpassing GRPO by 0.7% and 1.1%, respectively. Code is available at [https://github.com/williamium3000/u-opsd](https://github.com/williamium3000/u-opsd).
papers.comment: Project page at https://williamium3000.github.io/u-opsd/ and code at https://github.com/williamium3000/u-opsd
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出无监督在线自蒸馏方法 U-OPSD，仅利用模型自身生成的多种 rollout 与内部一致性构造伪解，并在模型产生分歧的完成上进行自蒸馏，从而在不需要任何外部监督信号的情况下实现真正的自蒸馏。在五个数学推理基准上，U-OPSD 在 Qwen3 非思考模式下显著提升基础模型性能，并匹配或超过使用 GT 的 OPSD 与 GRPO。
Motivation: 现有的在线自蒸馏方法（如 OPSD）仍依赖外部监督，包括真值标签、环境反馈或更大模型的指导，因此并非真正的无监督自蒸馏。本文的目标是表明仅靠模型自身的生成和内部一致性即可实现有效的在线自蒸馏。
Method: U-OPSD 首先采样多个 rollout，并在自洽阈值下通过多数投票构造伪解，然后以该伪解为条件对模型的分布进行蒸馏，仅针对模型与伪解不一致的完成进行自我纠正，使模型精确修正自己高置信的错误区域。
Result: 在 AIME24、AIME25、HMMT25、MATH500 和 AMC23 五个数学推理基准上，U-OPSD 在 Qwen3 非思考模式下分别将 4B 和 8B 模型提升 8.5% 和 10.7%，平均超过 OPSD 3.2% 和 2.3%；思考模式下与 OPSD 持平（4B 高 0.9%，8B 持平），并分别超过 GRPO 0.7% 和 1.1%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，仅利用模型自身的生成和内部一致性即可实现有效的在线自蒸馏，无需任何外部监督，并且在多种基础模型和训练设置下都能带来一致改进。

papers.title: ViSR-KGC: Visual Subgraph Reasoning with Vision-Language Models for Multimodal Knowledge Graph Completion
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graph completion (KGC) aims to infer missing entities or relations from incomplete graph structures, and has evolved into multimodal knowledge graph completion (MMKGC), where entities are associated with multiple modalities such as text and images. Traditional representation learning approaches follow the embedding-based paradigm and may struggle when relation-specific evidence is limited. Meanwhile, LLM-based reasoning methods typically linearize graph structures into textual prompts, which obscures structural topology and neglects vital visual information. While vision-language models (VLMs) excel at multimodal reasoning, they cannot natively interpret structured graph topology, particularly when it comes to knowledge graphs where nodes and edges carry complex semantics. To bridge this gap, we propose ViSR-KGC, a visual subgraph reasoning approach for KGC. It integrates three complementary capabilities to capture semantic correlations: identifying global topology dependencies via representation learning, analyzing local multimodal evidence using VLMs, and providing necessary commonsense knowledge inherent in pre-trained models. Based on learned multimodal embeddings, our framework first extracts a compact and query-aware subgraph from the MMKG. Then, this subgraph is transformed into a visually interpretable image using a layout strategy selected through empirical comparison. Finally, the visualized subgraph, entity images, textual descriptions, and candidate answers are combined into a unified prompt, enabling the VLM to infer the missing entity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ViSR-KGC，一种面向多模态知识图谱补全 (MMKGC) 的视觉子图推理方法。它结合表示学习、VLM 多模态证据分析和预训练模型中的常识知识，先将 query 相关的子图可视化为图像，再与实体图像、文本描述和候选答案组合成统一提示，让 VLM 推断缺失实体。摘要未报告定量实验数据。
Motivation: 传统嵌入方法在关系特定证据有限时难以应对；LLM 推理方法将图结构线性化为文本，模糊了拓扑并忽略视觉信息；VLM 虽擅长多模态推理，却无法原生理解节点和边带复杂语义的图谱结构。
Method: 框架基于学习到的多模态嵌入先提取紧凑且 query 相关的子图，通过经验比较选择布局策略将子图转化为视觉可解释的图像，并将可视化子图、实体图像、文本描述和候选答案组合为统一提示，交由 VLM 推断缺失实体；同时集成全局拓扑依赖、局部多模态证据和预训练常识三种互补能力。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值、数据集或基线结果；核心主张是该方法能捕获全局拓扑依赖、局部多模态证据与常识相关性，并使 VLM 完成缺失实体推断。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过把子图可视化为图像并纳入统一提示，可以弥合 VLM 与结构化图拓扑之间的鸿沟，为多模态知识图谱补全提供新的推理范式，但未提及局限。

papers.title: Epistemic Trustworthiness in Generative AI: A Normative Framework for Warranted Reliance in High-Stakes Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes professional contexts, where their outputs shape what users believe, how they reason, and what they treat as settled. This raises a central question for responsible AI: under what conditions is reliance on generative AI outputs epistemically warranted rather than behaviourally induced? Existing frameworks largely ask whether AI outputs are accurate, fair, explainable, safe, or trusted by users. These questions remain necessary, and each can contribute to warranted reliance. However, they do not directly specify warranted reliance as a distinct evaluative target: the conditions under which users are justified in treating AI outputs as inputs into their own reasoning. We argue that this requires an account of epistemic trustworthiness: what makes a system epistemically worthy of reliance. Drawing on philosophical accounts of trustworthiness as competence and audience-orientation, we develop a constitutive normative framework comprising three jointly necessary and non-fungible conditions. First, epistemic humility requires systems to represent and communicate the limits of their competence. Second, epistemic access requires systems to enable users to inspect, question, and contest outputs in context. Third, resistance to epistemic injustice requires systems to recognise users as legitimate epistemic agents and avoid marginalising their knowledge and experience. Through real-world case analyses in legal reasoning, medical reasoning, and hiring, we show how failures of epistemic humility, epistemic access, and resistance to epistemic injustice can produce consequential harms that standard measures of accuracy, fairness, and usability do not address on their own. We conclude by outlining design and evaluation implications for GenAI systems organised around epistemically warranted reliance rather than output correctness alone.
papers.comment: Accepted at AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为高风险工作流中的生成式 AI 提出一个关于认知可信赖性 (epistemic trustworthiness) 的规范性框架，主张应以“有理由的依赖”而非单纯输出正确性作为评估目标。作者提出三个联合必要且不可相互替代的条件：认知谦逊、认知可及性以及对认知不正义的抵抗，并通过法律推理、医疗推理和招聘等案例分析论证这些条件的重要性。
Motivation: 现有负责任 AI 框架主要追问输出是否准确、公平、可解释、安全或是否被用户信任，但这些都不能直接刻画用户何时有理由将 AI 输出作为自身推理的输入；需要把有理由的依赖作为独立的评估目标。
Method: 借鉴哲学上把可信赖性理解为能力 (competence) 与受众导向 (audience-orientation) 的论述，提出包含认知谦逊、认知可及性和抵抗认知不正义三个构成性条件的规范框架。
Result: 通过对法律推理、医疗推理和招聘中的真实案例进行分析，说明这三个条件的失效会产生标准准确性、公平性和可用性指标单独无法涵盖的实质性伤害。
Conclusion: 作者主张 GenAI 系统的设计与评估应围绕认知上有理由的依赖来组织，而非仅围绕输出正确性，并据此概述了设计与评估含义。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Small Foundation Models of Human Cognition and Behaviour
papers.abstract_en: Large language models fine-tuned on human behavioural data have emerged as general-purpose cognitive proxies, but the scale this requires, and whether these models process task structure or exploit statistical shortcuts, remain open questions. We train fourteen models from 135M to 14B parameters across four architecture families on Psych-101, a dataset of 10.7 million trial-level choices from 160 experiments. For in-distribution simulations, scale barely matters. The models fall within a narrow band, as though against a ceiling, and 0.6B to 1B parameters suffice to match a 70B baseline on held-out participants. Out-of-distribution, that band opens into a markedly steeper scaling gradient, with larger models clearly advantaged in generalisation to novel task structure. To determine what information these models use, we run two diagnostics. We progressively strip four prompt channels -- task instructions, experimental stimuli, outcome feedback, and choice history -- across 27 experiments, and permute trial order. Masking the content of stimuli and feedback destroys 75.7% of learned information and pushes models below chance, demonstrating that choice history alone does not account for performance. Permutation reveals invariance on tasks with independent trials but sensitivity where trial order is determined by prior responses. Small cognitively fine-tuned models therefore show promise as noise ceiling estimators for psychological experiments, though their scope remains bounded by the paradigms seen in training.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 Psych-101 数据集（来自 160 个实验的 1070 万条试次级选择数据）上训练了四个架构家族的 14 个模型（135M 到 14B 参数），考察规模对认知代理 (cognitive proxy) 的作用。分布内模拟中规模几乎不起作用，0.6B 到 1B 参数即可匹敌 70B 基线；分布外泛化则呈现更陡的规模梯度。通过剥离提示通道和置换试次顺序的诊断实验，作者发现掩盖刺激与反馈内容会破坏 75.7% 的已学信息并将模型推至低于随机水平，说明选择历史本身不足以解释性能。
Motivation: 基于人类行为数据微调的大语言模型已成为通用认知代理，但所需规模是否必要、模型究竟是在加工任务结构还是利用统计捷径，这两个问题仍然悬而未决。
Method: 在 Psych-101 上训练四个架构家族的 14 个模型（135M 至 14B 参数），并设计两项诊断：在 27 个实验中逐步剥离四类提示通道（任务指令、实验刺激、结果反馈、选择历史），以及对试次顺序进行置换。
Result: 分布内条件下模型性能落在一个狭窄区间内，0.6B 到 1B 参数即可在保留参与者上匹敌 70B 基线；分布外条件下该区间打开为明显更陡的扩展梯度，较大模型在泛化到新任务结构时占优。掩蔽刺激和反馈内容使模型损失 75.7% 的已学信息并低于随机水平；置换试次顺序在独立试次任务上显示不变性，而在试次顺序由先前反应决定的任务上显示敏感性。
Conclusion: 小型认知微调模型有望作为心理实验的噪声天花板估计器 (noise ceiling estimator)，但其适用范围仍受训练中所见范式限制。

papers.title: Teaching Foundation Models to Read mmWave: Pose-Guided Kinematic Representation for Human Behavior Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents need to perceive human behavior in physical environments. Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar provides a privacy-friendly and contactless sensing modality, but radar observations are difficult to align with language. Existing radar-language methods often rely on synthetic data or lack explicit supervision for human body structure and motion. We present mmMind, a radar-language model that uses synchronized 3D pose as training-only supervision. A spatio-temporal radar encoder is pretrained to capture body configuration and motion dynamics, after which the pose head is removed so that inference requires radar alone. The learned radar representations are then aligned with an LLM for behavior captioning and spatio-temporal question answering. We also introduce mmMind-Bench, a real-world mmWave-language benchmark containing 17.9 hours of recordings from 23 participants across seven indoor environments. Experiments on captioning, question answering, and unseen-action generalization show that mmMind consistently outperforms existing radar-language baselines, while ablations confirm the importance of pose-guided pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 mmMind，一种以同步 3D 姿态作为训练期监督的毫米波雷达-语言模型。时空雷达编码器先通过姿态监督预训练以捕捉身体结构和运动动态，之后移除姿态头，使推理阶段仅依赖雷达输入；习得的雷达表示再与 LLM 对齐，用于行为描述 (captioning) 和时空问答。作者还引入 mmMind-Bench 真实毫米波-语言基准（17.9 小时、23 名参与者、7 个室内环境），实验显示该方法在描述、问答和未见动作泛化上优于现有雷达-语言基线。
Motivation: 大语言模型智能体需要在物理环境中感知人类行为，毫米波雷达是一种隐私友好且非接触的感知模态，但雷达观测难以与语言对齐；现有雷达-语言方法常依赖合成数据，或缺乏对人体结构和运动的显式监督。
Method: 采用时空雷达编码器，以同步 3D 姿态作为唯一的训练期监督进行预训练，捕捉人体姿态配置和运动动态；预训练后移除姿态头，使推理仅使用雷达。随后将学习到的雷达表示与 LLM 对齐，支持行为描述和时空问答。
Result: 在行为描述、问答和未见动作泛化任务上，mmMind 一致优于现有雷达-语言基线；消融实验确证姿态引导预训练的重要性。基准 mmMind-Bench 包含 17.9 小时来自 23 名参与者在 7 个室内环境的真实记录。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果验证了姿态引导预训练对跨模态对齐的有效性，并强调推理阶段不依赖姿态标注，仅需雷达输入；该工作面向毫米波人体行为理解，与降水、临近预报等气象主题无关。

papers.title: Keep the Needle, Prune the Haystack: Defect-Preserving Token Pruning for Efficient Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot visual anomaly detection has achieved remarkable progress, with recent vision-only approaches further improving performance while simplifying the inference pipeline. However, existing methods typically perform dense computation over all images and spatial tokens, despite the fact that normal samples dominate real-world scenarios and anomalies usually occupy only small regions. Token pruning offers a promising solution, but introduces an asymmetric pruning risk in anomaly detection: retaining normal tokens mainly incurs redundant computation, whereas removing anomalous tokens may eliminate the only evidence for detection and localization. This risk is particularly severe in early layers, where pruning provides the greatest computational benefit but anomaly semantics remain unreliable. We propose KeepAD, a defect-preserving token pruning framework that formulates token selection as high-recall, anomaly-aware routing. In shallow layers, KeepAD combines coverage-preserving selection over local $2\times2$ patch neighborhoods with deterministic anomaly rescue to reduce the risk of discarding subtle defects. In deeper layers, frozen normal and abnormal prototypes guide pruning under an image-adaptive token budget, aggressively removing low-risk normal tokens while preserving local anomaly evidence. Dense-to-sparse self-distillation further supervises early token routing without introducing additional inference overhead. Experiments on six industrial and seven medical zero-shot anomaly detection benchmarks show that KeepAD reduces the token retention ratio to below $20\%$, while limiting the average degradation in image-level and pixel-level AUROC to within $2.7$ percentage points. At the most aggressive operating point, KeepAD achieves a $7.9\times$ speedup over the strongest CLIP-based baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KeepAD，一种缺陷保持的 token 剪枝框架，用于零样本视觉异常检测的高效推理。方法将 token 选择建模为高召回、异常感知的路由：浅层结合局部 2×2 patch 邻域的覆盖保持选择与确定性异常救援，深层用冻结的正常/异常原型在图像自适应 token 预算下剪枝。在六个工业与七个医学零样本异常检测基准上，token 保留率降至 20% 以下，图像级与像素级 AUROC 平均下降不超过 2.7 个百分点；在最激进配置下相对最强 CLIP 基线获得 7.9 倍加速。
Motivation: 现有零样本视觉异常检测方法通常对所有图像和空间 token 进行密集计算，但实际场景中正常样本占主导、异常通常只占很小区域。token 剪枝虽有潜力，却带来不对称风险：剪掉正常 token 主要造成冗余计算，剪掉异常 token 可能删除检测与定位的唯一证据，且该风险在浅层尤为严重，因为浅层剪枝收益最大但异常语义尚不可靠。
Method: KeepAD 将 token 选择形式化为高召回、异常感知的路由。浅层采用局部 2×2 patch 邻域的覆盖保持选择并加入确定性异常救援以降低丢弃细微缺陷的风险；深层利用冻结的正常和异常原型，在图像自适应的 token 预算下激进剪除低风险正常 token，同时保留局部异常证据。此外还用密集到稀疏的自蒸馏 (dense-to-sparse self-distillation) 监督早期 token 路由，且不增加推理开销。
Result: 在六个工业与七个医学零样本异常检测基准上，KeepAD 将 token 保留率降至 20% 以下，图像级与像素级 AUROC 的平均下降控制在 2.7 个百分点以内；在最激进的运行点上，相对最强的基于 CLIP 的基线实现了 7.9 倍加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过异常感知路由、原型引导的剪枝和图像自适应 token 预算，token 剪枝可以在保持缺陷证据的同时大幅降低计算开销。其适用场景为视觉零样本异常检测，精度损失在保留率低于 20% 时仍被限制在较小范围。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Oh Deer, How Should I Handle This? Seasonal Priors for Selective Wildlife Annotation and Classification
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained wildlife classification in aerial imagery is limited not only by model performance, but also by unreliable labels: animals occupy few pixels, key visual cues vary seasonally, and modality-specific evidence can be ambiguous. We study adult-male identification in red deer ($\textit{Cervus elaphus}$), where the antler cycle defines predictable windows of reliable evidence for both annotation and prediction. Using 7,295 RGB-only, thermal-only, and matched RGB+thermal crop sets from low-altitude UAV surveys, labeled by three annotators, we show that seasonal structure links (I) annotation quality, (II) downstream classification, and (III) selective prediction. Matched RGB+thermal review resolves more samples than either single modality, recovering majority-male labels otherwise missed by RGB or thermal alone, in human-based as well as model-based classification. Months with high annotator abstention also show lower classifier confidence, and soft seasonal priors mainly benefit the season-limited thermal view. Uncertainty-band abstention further raises covered accuracy to 98.9%, though at reduced coverage and with deferral that falls disproportionately on males. Overall, a biologically grounded seasonal calendar predicts where annotation and prediction are unreliable, and can guide both annotation protocol design and modality weighting.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Computer Vision for Ecology (CV4Ecology), archival proceedings track. 17 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于无人机航拍图像的红鹿成年雄性识别任务，发现季节结构同时影响标注质量、下游分类和选择性预测。利用 7,295 个 RGB-only、thermal-only 及匹配 RGB+thermal 的裁剪集，作者证明匹配的双模态复核能比单一模态解决更多样本，并恢复被单一模态漏掉的多数雄性标签。不确定性带的弃权机制可将覆盖率下的准确率提升到 98.9%，但降低覆盖率且弃权不成比例地落在雄性样本上。
Motivation: 航拍图像中的细粒度野生动物分类受限于不可靠标签：动物只占少数像素、关键视觉线索随季节变化、单一模态证据可能含糊。论文以红鹿成年雄性识别为例，指出鹿角周期提供了可预测的可靠证据窗口，可用于指导标注与预测。
Method: 使用来自低空无人机调查的 7,295 个 RGB-only、thermal-only 和匹配 RGB+thermal 裁剪集，由三位标注者标注，研究季节先验（seasonal priors）在人工标注、模型分类和选择性预测中的作用，并比较单模态与匹配双模态复核以及不确定性带弃权策略。
Result: 匹配的 RGB+thermal 复核比任一单模态解决更多样本，能在人工和模型分类中恢复被单独 RGB 或 thermal 漏掉的多数雄性标签。高标注弃权月份对应较低的分类器置信度；软季节先验主要对受季节限制的 thermal 视图有益。不确定性带弃权将覆盖率下的准确率提升到 98.9%，但降低覆盖率且弃权不成比例地落在雄性样本上。
Conclusion: 生物学 grounded 的季节日历能预测标注和预测不可靠的位置，可用于指导标注协议设计和模态权重分配。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hermite Curves as Trajectory Priors for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent progress in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotic manipulation, the action chunk remains a weakly structured interface. Existing work typically flatten each chunk into per-timestep controls, relying on implicit data learning that manifests as jagged motion and boundary discontinuities during physical execution. To address these limitations, we introduce Hermite trajectory priors, parameterizing the chunk trajectory as a piecewise cubic Hermite curve defined by endpoint positions and velocities to explicitly enforce smoothness and continuity. We instantiate this fixed operator across discrete autoregressive and continuous generative paradigms via three variants: (1) Hermite Tokens, which predict quantized boundary variables autoregressively; (2) Hermite Scaffold, which decomposes clean actions into a base scaffold and residuals; and (3) Hermite Regularization, which applies the prior strictly as an auxiliary training objective. Across simulation benchmarks and real-robot platforms, Hermite Regularization achieves superior performance among these three variants, improving π0.5 baseline success rates from 95.9% to 98.7% on LIBERO, 85.7% to 90.9% on LIBERO-plus, and 63.4% to 90.0% across four real-robot tasks without additional inference overhead. Trajectory analyses reveal that explicitly structuring trajectory priors serves most effectively as a learning inductive bias rather than a runtime constraint.

TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型在机器人操作中动作块(action chunk)接口结构弱的问题，提出将块轨迹参数化为分段三次Hermite曲线，用端点位置和速度显式施加平滑性与连续性。作者在离散自回归和连续生成两种范式下设计了Hermite Tokens、Hermite Scaffold和Hermite Regularization三种变体，其中Hermite Regularization表现最佳，在LIBERO上把π0.5基线成功率从95.9%提升到98.7%，并在四个真实机器人任务上从63.4%提升到90.0%。轨迹分析表明显式轨迹先验主要作为学习归纳偏置(inductive bias)起作用，而非运行时约束。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型通常把动作块展平成逐时间步控制，依赖隐式数据学习，导致物理执行中出现抖动和边界不连续；作者认为动作块作为接口结构过于弱，需要显式引入平滑性和连续性的轨迹先验。

Result: 模拟基准和真实机器人平台上Hermite Regularization在三种变体中性能最佳，将π0.5基线成功率从LIBERO的95.9%提升到98.7%、LIBERO-plus的85.7%提升到90.9%，四个真实机器人任务从63.4%提升到90.0%，且不增加推理开销。

papers.title: Decoy Images Amplify Caption-Mediated Defenses Against Encoded Jailbreaks
papers.abstract_en: We report a counter-intuitive interaction between image inputs and existing black-box defenses on Vision--Language Models (VLMs): pairing an encoded jailbreak prompt with an unrelated decoy image can sharply lower attack success rate (ASR). The operative change is in the defense pipeline, not in the image. Across five frontier VLMs, two encoded-attack families, and three black-box defenses, a caption-mediated defense (ECSO) that leaves ASR essentially unchanged on text-only encoded input drops it by up to $73$pp once a content-free decoy is attached; every non-saturated contrast is significant under exact McNemar tests. We advance two hypotheses for this pattern, supported by indirect evidence rather than pipeline introspection, since a black-box threat model precludes inspecting vendor internals: caption-mediated defenses branch on image presence, and intrinsic image-side safety engages on image-resident content. Three controls constrain the explanation. Blank-canvas and natural-photograph decoys reproduce the effect on every model, implicating image presence rather than content; the effect replicates on three open-weight VLMs served with no moderation layer, so it is not a vendor-filtering artifact; and a non-symbolic, meaning-based encoder reproduces it, so it is not specific to symbolic obfuscation. Attaching a decoy unconditionally is not deployable --- it raises benign refusal to $20$--$79\%$, an inflation of $+10$ to $+67$pp --- but gating attachment on a lightweight encoded-input detector returns benign refusal to the text baseline while preserving the safety gain wherever the detector fires, making detector recall the binding constraint. Under adaptive attacks that target the caption-mediated re-check, the effect degrades but holds. We frame this as an observation about pipeline interaction, not as a robust defense.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了视觉语言模型 (VLM) 上图像输入与现有黑盒防御机制之间的一种反直觉交互：将编码后的越狱提示 (encoded jailbreak prompt) 与无关的诱饵图像 (decoy image) 配对，会显著降低攻击成功率 (ASR)。作者在五个前沿 VLM、两类编码攻击和三种黑盒防御上验证，其中基于字幕介导的防御 ECSO 在纯文本编码输入下几乎不改变 ASR，但附加无内容诱饵后 ASR 最多下降 73 个百分点。作者明确将结果定性为对流水线交互的观察，而非稳健的防御方案。
Motivation: 现有的 VLM 黑盒防御在编码型越狱输入上表现不稳定，且图像输入是否影响防御行为尚不清晰。作者希望解释为何附加无关诱饵图像会让原本有效的编码攻击失效，并判断这种效果来自图像存在性还是图像内容。
Method: 采用黑盒经验协议，在五个前沿 VLM、两个编码攻击家族和三种黑盒防御上系统对比纯文本编码输入与附加诱饵图像的编码输入；通过空白画布与自然照片诱饵、无审核层的开源权重 VLM、以及非符号化的基于语义的编码器三组对照实验排除内容、厂商过滤和符号混淆等解释；并用轻量编码输入检测器对诱饵附加进行门控，同时测试针对字幕介导复查的适应性攻击。
Result: ECSO 配合诱饵图像使 ASR 最多下降 73 个百分点，所有非饱和对比在精确 McNemar 检验下均显著；诱饵无条件附加会把良性拒答率推高到 20%–79%，即上升 +10 到 +67 个百分点；而用检测器门控附加可将良性拒答率恢复到文本基线，同时保留检测触发时的安全收益，因此检测器召回率成为关键约束；在适应性攻击下效果下降但仍保持。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是对流水线交互的观察而非稳健防御，黑盒威胁模型使其无法检查厂商内部机制，因此两种假设仅由间接证据支持；实用化的代价是良性拒答率显著上升，门控策略虽能缓解，但受限于编码输入检测器的召回率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evolutionary Curriculum Learning Improves Biological Sequence Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) trained on multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) have emerged as powerful generative models for biological sequences, with applications ranging from disease variant prediction to functional RNA design. However, standard biological VAE training treats all sequences as exchangeable, ignoring the rich evolutionary structure that organizes homologous sequences from evolutionarily close to highly divergent. We propose Evolutionary Curriculum Learning (ECL), a training strategy that exploits this structure by progressively exposing the model to sequences of increasing evolutionary distance from sampled anchors, following a power-law expansion schedule. Applied to two architecturally distinct VAE models and two biological domains--protein variant effect prediction with EVE and RNA family sequence generation with RfamGen--ECL improves downstream task performance across five random seeds per configuration. Mean ClinVar classification AUROC rises from 0.981 to 0.989 for p53; for PTEN, ECL attains 1.000 in every seed whereas the baseline is unstable (mean 0.905, falling as low as 0.54). For RNA, ECL raises mean covariance-model bit scores on all three families tested and exceeds its seed-matched baseline in 12 of 15 training runs, though with only three families the effect cannot be established as significant at the family level. Ablation experiments show that progressively expanding the sampled sequences by evolutionary distance outperforms fixed-size neighborhood sampling in addition to uniform random sampling. Evolutionary distance is therefore a useful inductive bias for ordering the training curriculum in biological sequence modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出进化课程学习（Evolutionary Curriculum Learning, ECL），一种利用同源序列间进化距离来排序训练数据的策略。在蛋白质变异效应预测（EVE）和RNA家族序列生成（RfamGen）两类VAE模型上，ECL持续提升下游指标，例如p53的ClinVar AUROC从0.981升至0.989，PTEN在5个随机种子下均达到1.000而基线不稳定。消融显示按进化距离渐进扩大采样范围优于固定邻域采样和均匀随机采样。
Motivation: 标准生物序列VAE把序列视为可交换，忽略同源序列从进化近到远的结构。作者认为这种进化结构可作为训练课程顺序的归纳偏置。
Method: 提出ECL训练策略，从锚点序列出发按幂律扩展调度（power-law expansion schedule）逐步增加暴露序列的进化距离，并将该课程应用到EVE和RfamGen两种架构不同的VAE上。
Result: 摘要报告ECL在5个随机种子配置下改善下游性能：p53的ClinVar AUROC均值从0.981提升到0.989；PTEN上ECL每种子均达1.000，而基线均值0.905且最低可至0.54。RNA上，三个家族的平均协方差模型位分均提高，15次训练中12次超过种子匹配基线，但由于仅三个家族，无法在家族层面确立显著性。
Conclusion: 作者认为进化距离是有用的归纳偏置，渐进扩展进化距离的课程优于固定邻域或均匀随机采样。适用范围限于两个VAE架构和两个生物域，RNA家族层面的显著性尚不充分。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Learning to Coordinate Symbolic Tools: LLM Agents for Verified Sum-of-Squares Certificates
papers.abstract_en: Tool calling allows large language models (LLMs) to invoke external computation during problem solving, a useful capability in various fields including AI for mathematics. We study this setting through weighted sum-of-squares (SOS) decomposition, a machine-checkable route to proving polynomial nonnegativity and hence polynomial inequalities. A candidate decomposition can be checked exactly, but finding one requires choosing among non-unique regroupings and coordinating multiple symbolic transformations. We develop an agent that combines algebraic task training, symbolic tools, and verifier-grounded optimization for this task. Rather than training only on the composite SOS task, we construct 1.35 million synthetic examples covering eight supporting polynomial tasks together with weighted-SOS decomposition. We first apply supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to direct algebra problems and simulated symbolic traces, and then use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with task-specific symbolic rewards. The SFT corpus contains no native tool-calling messages; at evaluation, the agent uses native SymPy calls for expansion, collection, reordering, and factorization. Every final SOS answer is checked by exact expansion and coefficient comparison. On held-out, same-generator synthetic problems, the full SFT+GRPO+tools system is the strongest of four evaluated configurations, reaching 78.96% verified success on weighted SOS, compared with 44.73% for the base model with the same tools, and 91.75% macro accuracy across nine polynomial tasks. Within this controlled setting, our work provides a case study of combining domain-specific skill training, executable tools, and verifier feedback, and may inform the design of tool-calling agents in other domains with exactly checkable outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究利用工具调用 (tool calling) 的 LLM 智能体求解加权平方和分解 (weighted sum-of-squares, weighted SOS) 问题，该问题可作为证明多项式非负性的机器可验证途径。作者构建了 135 万个覆盖八个辅助多项式任务与加权 SOS 分解的合成样本，先进行监督微调 (SFT)，再用带任务特定符号奖励的 GRPO 强化学习，评测时使用原生 SymPy 调用进行展开、合并、重排与因式分解，并通过精确展开与系数比对验证每个最终答案。在同类生成器生成的留出合成问题上，SFT+GRPO+tools 系统达到 78.96% 的加权 SOS 验证成功率。
Motivation: SOS 分解的候选解可以精确验证，但寻找过程需要在非唯一的重新分组中选择并协调多种符号变换，现有方法难以自动完成；该文要探讨结合领域技能训练、符号工具与验证器反馈能否提升这类可验证数学任务的求解能力。
Method: 提出一个组合代数任务训练、SymPy 符号工具和验证器引导优化的智能体框架：构造 1.35M 合成样例覆盖八个支持性多项式任务和加权 SOS 分解；先对代数问题和模拟符号轨迹做 SFT（语料不包含原生工具调用消息），再用 GRPO 配合任务特定符号奖励优化。
Result: 在留出且同生成器的合成问题上，完整的 SFT+GRPO+tools 配置是四种评估配置中最强的，加权 SOS 验证成功率达 78.96%，而具备相同工具的基础模型为 44.73%；九个多项式任务上的宏平均准确率为 91.75%。
Conclusion: 摘要在受控设置下表明，将领域技能训练、可执行符号工具与验证器反馈结合可以显著提升精确可验证任务的完成率，并为其他含可精确检查输出的领域的工具调用智能体设计提供案例参考。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要在受控设置下表明，将领域技能训练、可执行符号工具与验证器反馈结合可以显著提升精确可验证任务的完成率，并为其他含可精确检查输出的领域的工具调用智能体设计提供案例参考。

papers.title: A Constitution-Grid Instrument for Data-Efficient RL Alignment (C-Guard)
papers.abstract_en: Conflicting objectives are general in RL alignment, and training on them data-efficiently is hard. Training a safety guard with RL means optimizing two objectives that conflict: catch real harm, and do not refuse benign prompts. Our finding is that over-refusal improves 22.4% to 12.8%, while under-refusal on adversarial attacks silently worsens 0.27 to 0.33. We present C-Guard, a constitution-grid instrument that generates the RL training data, and C-LIM, a per-cell learnability score that decides each cell's move: prune, densify, amend, expand. C-LIM flags the dead-weight data region before any training budget is spent: 187 untargeted rows had bought zero gain, and our method lifts the same region's learning impact 0.733 to 0.80. Code and the constitution are open-sourced.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 11 figures. To be presented at the Efficient Reasoning Workshop at COLM 2026 (ER)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 C-Guard，一种用于数据高效 RL 对齐的 constitution-grid 数据生成工具，以及 C-LIM，一个逐单元可学习性评分，用于决定每个数据单元应 prune、densify、amend 还是 expand。摘要报告 over-refusal 从 22.4% 改善到 12.8%，而对对抗攻击的 under-refusal 从 0.27 恶化到 0.33；C-LIM 能在训练预算投入前识别出 187 行零收益的 untargeted 数据，并将同一区域的 learning impact 从 0.733 提升到 0.80。代码与 constitution 已开源。
Motivation: RL 对齐中普遍存在相互冲突的目标，且在这种目标上做数据高效的训练很困难；例如安全 guard 需要在“捕获真实危害”和“不拒绝良性提示”两个互相冲突的目标间优化。
Method: 提出 C-Guard constitution-grid 工具来生成 RL 训练数据，并提出 C-LIM 逐单元可学习性评分，根据评分决定每个数据单元的操作：剪枝、加密、修正或扩展。
Result: 摘要报告 over-refusal 指标从 22.4% 改善到 12.8%，而对对抗性攻击的 under-refusal 从 0.27 恶化到 0.33；187 行 untargeted 数据此前未带来任何收益，方法将该区域的 learning impact 从 0.733 提升到 0.80。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在花费训练预算前识别“死重”数据区域可以提升数据效率，并指出代码与 constitution 已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A foundation model of numerical intelligence with cross-disciplinary generalization
papers.abstract_en: Intelligence is commonly understood as the ability to acquire and apply knowledge, adapt to unfamiliar situations and solve new problems. Large language models exhibit this capacity by inferring task-relevant knowledge from textual context and applying it to new tasks. Yet intelligence need not be confined to language. For scientific and social systems, we need models that acquire and apply knowledge from numerical context-an ability we call numerical intelligence. Here we introduce UNified In-Context Operator Networks (UNICON), a foundation model that exhibits numerical intelligence across disciplines. Using graph-based examples from a system as context, UNICON infers the predictive relation shared across them and applies it to queries from the same system. Across scientific and social systems, including those from disciplines absent from training, the same model approaches specialist performance without retraining. Combining UNICON with language-model agents yields further gains, enabling it to surpass state-of-the-art specialists in a discipline unseen in training. We further show that training-corpus diversity improves generalization to unseen disciplines. Together, these results establish UNICON as a foundation model of numerical intelligence and position it as a building block for a broader ecosystem of artificial intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UNified In-Context Operator Networks (UNICON)，一个面向数值智能（numerical intelligence）的基础模型。它以图结构示例作为上下文，推断同一系统内共享的预测关系，并将其应用到同一系统的查询。摘要称该模型在包括训练未出现学科在内的科学与社会系统上无需微调即可接近专家性能，与语言模型智能体结合后还能超越某一未见学科上的现有专家。
Motivation: 通用智能不应局限于语言；科学与社会系统需要从数值上下文获取并应用知识的能力，而现有模型缺乏这种跨学科的数值智能。
Method: 提出 UNICON，利用来自同一系统的图结构示例作为上下文，推断跨示例共享的预测关系，并将该关系应用到同一系统的查询；此外可与语言模型智能体组合以进一步提升能力。
Result: 摘要报告 UNICON 在跨学科系统上接近专家性能且无需训练时未见学科的微调；结合语言模型智能体后，在训练未出现的学科上超越 SOTA 专家；训练语料多样性越高，对未见学科的泛化越好。
Conclusion: 作者将 UNICON 定位为数值智能的基础模型，并认为它是构建更广泛的通用人工智能生态的组成部分。

papers.title: Now You Have My Healthy Attention: A U-DiT for Brain-MRI Inpainting
papers.abstract_en: The ASNR-MICCAI BraTS Local Synthesis (Inpainting) task asks for the anatomically plausible completion of healthy brain tissue within a masked region of a T1-weighted MRI, providing a tumor-free anatomical reference for downstream analysis. As the task is scored by distortion metrics (SSIM, PSNR, MSE), we build a deterministic regression model and focus on giving it inductive biases tailored to inpainting. Our network follows the U-DiT principle of performing self-attention on a downsampled token grid: a volumetric encoder-decoder imports long-range context through a downsampled global self-attention block with three-dimensional rotary position embeddings, while convolutions and skip connections preserve high-frequency detail. Two ideas drive our results. First, we constrain the attention so that occluded ("void") tokens attend only to known-healthy tokens of the same volume, with a learned bias toward each query's contralateral homologue, forcing the completion to be inferred from observed anatomy rather than from other unknown regions. Second, we add a contralateral-symmetry input that supplies the mirrored healthy hemisphere as a patient-specific prior; since the brain is approximately bilaterally symmetric and lesions are typically unilateral, this prior improves the distortion metrics at matched structural similarity. On the official BraTS-2026 validation leaderboard our submission reaches a mean healthy-region SSIM of $0.864$, PSNR of $24.7$\,dB and MSE of $4.6{\times}10^{-3}$ over $219$ cases. We further analyse the residual smoothness inherent to distortion-optimal regression and discuss its implications for anatomical realism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向 ASNR-MICCAI BraTS Local Synthesis (Inpainting) 任务，提出一个基于 U-DiT 的确定性回归模型，用于对 T1 加权 MRI 掩膜区域进行解剖学合理的健康脑组织补全。模型采用降采样 token 网格上的全局自注意力，并引入两项针对 inpainting 的归纳偏置：受限注意力（void token 仅关注同卷已知健康 token，并加入对侧同源偏好）和对侧对称输入（镜像健康半球作为患者特异性先验）。在 BraTS-2026 官方验证榜上，模型在 219 例上达到健康区域 SSIM 0.864、PSNR 24.7 dB、MSE 4.6×10^-3。
Motivation: BraTS 局部合成任务要求在不提供肿瘤参考的情况下完成健康脑组织的解剖学合理补全，而任务的官方指标是 SSIM、PSNR、MSE 等失真度量；作者认为需要专门为 inpainting 设计具有归纳偏置的确定性回归模型来适配该评分方式。
Method: 网络遵循 U-DiT 结构，在降采样 token 网格上做自注意力：体素编码器-解码器通过带三维旋转位置嵌入的降采样全局自注意力块引入长程上下文，卷积与跳跃连接保留高频细节。关键设计有二：一是约束注意力，使被掩蔽的 void token 只能关注同一卷中的已知健康 token，并对每个 query 的对侧同源位置加入学习的偏好偏置；二是增加对侧对称输入，把镜像后的健康半球作为患者特异性先验，利用大脑近似双侧对称且病灶通常单侧的特点。
Result: 在官方 BraTS-2026 验证榜上，该提交在 219 例数据上取得健康区域平均 SSIM 0.864、PSNR 24.7 dB、MSE 4.6×10^-3。
Conclusion: 作者进一步分析了失真最优回归所固有的残差平滑性，并讨论其对解剖真实性的影响；这意味着该方法在失真指标上表现良好，但平滑残差可能限制像素级解剖细节的保真度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Attack Ensembles Expose a Safety-Utility Trade-off in Black-Box Guard Defenses Against Encoded VLM Jailbreaks
papers.abstract_en: Safety classifiers ("guards") are the dominant black-box defense for vision-language models, yet a guard judges an input's surface form, not its meaning: a harmful request re-encoded as set theory, formal logic, a classical language, code, or text rendered inside an image slips past a guard that would block it in plain language - the decode gap. The standard fix is a preprocessor that recovers image content and decodes the encoding before the guard. We build one and evaluate it against an ensemble of eleven published encoding attacks, counting a behavior as broken if any attack succeeds. That metric separates two mechanisms such defenses conflate. Restoring a view the guard never had improves it on both axes at once: it blocks far more attacks, and, measured on a category-balanced benign set, it blocks fewer benign requests, because restating a request normalizes the borderline phrasing a classifier over-flags. It still does not make the system safer: against an attacker free to choose among eleven encodings, closing one channel relocates the success rather than removing it, and no ensemble contrast survives multiple-comparison correction. What does lower ensemble attack success is re-screening the recovered pre-decode surface, and that step is where the entire benign cost falls. The safety-utility trade-off is therefore not a property of recovery; it is localized to one step. Across the full guard x target x condition factorial, no configuration reaches an ensemble attack-success rate at or below 40% while holding benign over-refusal under 70%. The per-attack averages usually reported understate the attacker roughly fourfold, which is why this frontier is easy to miss. Composing across defense families is the one lever that moved the safety axis, beating every configuration we measured, and still landing far outside any deployable refusal budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究黑盒守卫防御（guard）针对编码式VLM越狱攻击的效能，构建了一个预处理解码器并评估11种已发表编码攻击的集成。结果表明恢复图像内容并解码编码能同时提升安全性与良性请求通过率，但攻击者可自由选择编码时，关闭一个通道只是转移成功而非消除；真正降低集成攻击成功率的是重新筛查恢复后的解码前表面，而全部良性成本集中在该步骤。跨全部守卫×目标×条件因子，没有任何配置能同时达到攻击成功率≤40%且良性过拒绝率<70%。
Motivation: 安全分类器（守卫）是视觉-语言模型（VLM）的主要黑盒防御，但它只判断输入表面形式而非语义；有害请求被重新编码为集合论、形式逻辑、古典语言、代码或图像内文本时可绕过守卫，形成解码差距（decode gap）。标准修复是预处理解码，但缺乏针对编码攻击集成效能的系统评估。
Method: 作者构建一个预处理解码器，在守卫之前恢复图像内容并解码各类编码，随后用11种已发表编码攻击的集成进行评估；行为定义为任一攻击成功即算破坏，并在类别平衡的良性集上测量良性拒绝率。
Result: 恢复守卫从未见过的输入视图可同时改善两个指标：拦截更多攻击且良性拒绝更少；但面对可在11种编码中选择的攻击者时，关闭一个通道只是转移成功而非移除成功，且没有集成对比能通过多重比较校正。真正降低集成攻击成功率的是重新筛查恢复后的解码前表面，而全部良性成本集中在该步骤；跨全部守卫×目标×条件因子，无配置达到攻击成功率≤40%且良性过拒绝<70%。常用的每攻击平均指标约低估攻击者四倍。
Conclusion: 安全-效用权衡不是恢复过程的属性，而是被定位在重筛查解码前表面的那一步；跨防御家族组合是唯一能移动安全轴的措施，但仍远超出可部署的拒绝预算，说明该权衡难以通过单一恢复器回避。
Relevance: 0
