papers.title: From Interface to Inference: Eliciting Any-Order Inference from Any-Order Models
papers.abstract_en: Many discrete reasoning tasks, such as code generation, are inherently non-causal: programmers move between high-level structure and local details, a process we call any-order inference. For autoregressive language models, which lack a native any-order interface, non-causal abilities such as infilling and next-edit prediction require hand-designed mechanisms. Can we instead design models that natively support any-order inference? Masked diffusion models have recently emerged as compelling candidates, as their any-order training objective naturally offers an any-order prediction interface. This interface, however, does not automatically yield any-order inference. We demonstrate that this interface-inference gap stems from positional uncertainty: fixed-canvas, token-level models may know what semantic component should appear without knowing where to place it. In light of this, we propose two complementary approaches: (1) Insertion-based masked diffusion, building on FlexMDM (Kim et al, 2025), relaxes fixed-position commitments via insertions, enabling generation across non-contiguous regions. (2) Latent-space masked diffusion shifts prediction to coarser semantic segments, enabling search over latent generation orders. Empirically, we train a 7B FlexMDM for Python coding and a 125M LatentMDM for GSM8K and show that both approaches induce distinct any-order inference behaviors and improve downstream performance. We release our codebase at https://github.com/SeunggeunKimkr/genuine-any-order.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出，代码生成等离散推理任务本质上是非因果的，作者称之为任意顺序推理 (any-order inference)。自回归语言模型缺乏原生任意顺序接口，而掩码扩散模型虽然通过任意顺序训练目标提供任意顺序预测接口，却不自动带来任意顺序推理，这种接口-推理差距源于位置不确定性。作者提出两种互补方法：基于插入的掩码扩散（FlexMDM）与潜在空间掩码扩散（LatentMDM），并在 7B Python 代码模型和 125M GSM8K 模型上验证了两种方法能诱导不同的任意顺序推理行为并提升下游性能。
Motivation: 现有自回归语言模型对非因果能力（如 infilling、next-edit prediction）需要手工设计机制，缺乏原生的任意顺序推理能力；而掩码扩散模型的任意顺序预测接口并不能直接转化为有效推理，因为固定画布上的 token 级模型可能知道该出现什么语义成分，却不知道放在哪里。
Method: 提出两种互补方案：一是基于插入的掩码扩散，构建于 FlexMDM 之上，通过插入操作放松固定位置约束，支持跨非连续区域的生成；二是潜在空间掩码扩散，将预测转移到更粗粒度的语义片段上，从而在潜在生成顺序上进行搜索。
Result: 作者训练了用于 Python 编码的 7B FlexMDM 和用于 GSM8K 的 125M LatentMDM，实验表明两种方法都诱导出不同的任意顺序推理行为，并改善了下游任务性能。
Conclusion: 摘要认为接口-推理差距源于位置不确定性，所提两种方法能够弥合这一差距并实现真正的任意顺序推理；代码库已公开。

papers.title: When benchmark inferences do not compose: Projectibility in AI evaluation
papers.abstract_en: An AI benchmark result rarely reaches a consequential claim in one step. Evaluators generalize it to further cases, interpret it as evidence of capability, extrapolate it to new tasks, transport it to another system or site, and combine it with assumptions about human review and downstream consequences. Validity-centred approaches require evidence for each claim. This paper makes explicit and operationalizes a problem those approaches leave to the analyst: warranted links don't automatically make a warranted chain. The target of one study may not be the source of the next; system, population, outcome, or conditions may change at the interface; and shared data or model lineage may make apparently independent support dependent. Projectibility concerns whether a bounded extension from observed to unobserved cases is warranted. Goodman supplies the problem of rival extensions; argument-based validity supplies an architecture for testing them. The contribution is an interface audit for distributed AI evidence: typed source and target descriptions, and a procedure separating endpoints that never meet from endpoints that meet while warrant fails to cross. A legal-research case shows how benchmark evidence and a deployment study can each be sound while remaining parallel. A known-truth demonstration shows why aggregate stability can erase distinctions a later projection requires. The resulting projectibility audit diagnoses unsupported joins in benchmark-to-use arguments.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. v2 substantially revises Secs. 5-8 and the conclusion, adds a measured instance of factor-structure instability, and corrects a claim in Sec. 3.3 that endpoint alignment suffices for composition. Supersedes the withdrawn arXiv:2510.15236. Code: https://github.com/BrettRey/benchmark-inference-composition
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论 AI 基准评估中结论的生成很少由一步推理完成，而常需要跨案例、跨系统、跨场景的多环节组合；作者指出每个环节各自有效并不能自动保证整条论证链有效。论文显式化并操作化这一问题，提出 projectibility（可投影性）概念，并引入面向分布式 AI 证据的接口审计（interface audit），用于类型化 source 与 target 描述，区分端点不匹配和端点匹配但 warrant 未跨越两类失败。摘要给出一个法律研究案例和一个已知真值演示，分别说明基准证据与部署研究可以各自成立却保持平行，以及聚合稳定性可能抹去后续投影所需区分。
Motivation: 效度中心（validity-centred）方法要求为每个主张收集证据，但留给分析者一个未解决的问题：有根据的链接不会自动产生有根据的链条，因为前一研究的目标不一定是下一研究的来源，系统、总体、结果或条件在接口处可能发生变化。需要显式检验从已观察到未观察案例的有界外推是否合理。
Method: 作者借用 Goodman 的 rival extensions 问题和基于论证的效度（argument-based validity）架构，提出一个接口审计流程：为分布式 AI 证据提供类型化的 source 与 target 描述，并分离“端点从未相遇”和“端点相遇但 warrant 未跨越”两种情况。
Result: 摘要报告了一个法律研究案例，显示基准证据与部署研究可以各自在内部成立但彼此平行；另有一个已知真值演示，说明聚合稳定性可能抹去后续投影任务所需区分的区别。v2 还新增了一个测量到的因子结构不稳定性（factor-structure instability）实例，并修正了第 3.3 节中“端点对齐足以实现组合”的说法。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的 projectibility audit 能够诊断 benchmark-to-use 论证中未被支持的连接，并据此对分布式 AI 证据的接合点进行系统检查。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RareLens: Towards End-to-End Rare Disease Care via Aligning Divergent Large Language Model Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Rare diseases represent one of the most challenging settings for clinical decision-making, where heterogeneous presentations, sparse evidence and limited expertise create persistent uncertainty throughout the care pathway. Although artificial intelligence could help, existing systems largely address isolated tasks, particularly diagnosis, and usually rely on downstream investigations rather than information available at initial presentation. Here we show that clinical AI performance under uncertainty can be improved not by scaling a single model, but by exploiting the diversity of multiple imperfect reasoning systems. Across heterogeneous large language models, we identify divergent reasoning trajectories with complementary error patterns and develop RareLens, which learns to reconcile these perspectives into actionable decisions across four stages of rare disease care: risk screening, diagnosis, treatment planning and prognosis prediction. Built on RarelensBench, a real-world dataset of 157,525 cases spanning all 33 Orphanet categories and more than 7,000 conditions, RareLens outperformed every frontier model tested, including GPT-5, DeepSeek-R1, Claude-3.7-Sonnet and Gemini-2.5-Pro, across all stages. It achieved an area under the curve of 0.917 for screening and top-1 accuracies of 65.5% and 89.8% for diagnosis and treatment. In an external evaluation involving 1,287 cases and 23 physicians, autonomous RareLens and physicians assisted by RareLens both outperformed unaided physicians, while demonstrating that effective human-AI collaboration requires more than simply providing model outputs. These findings establish divergent model reasoning as an exploitable source of information and suggest a general strategy for building AI systems that operate reliably under high clinical uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RareLens，一种面向罕见病全流程照护的端到端临床 AI 系统。其核心思路是不扩展单一模型，而是利用多个异构大语言模型在推理轨迹上的分歧与互补错误模式，将这些视角协调为风险筛查、诊断、治疗方案规划和预后预测四个阶段的决策。基于包含 157,525 例病例的 RarelensBench 基准，RareLens 在所有阶段上超过了 GPT-5、DeepSeek-R1、Claude-3.7-Sonnet 和 Gemini-2.5-Pro 等前沿模型。
Motivation: 罕见病因其异质性表现、稀疏证据和有限专业知识，在临床决策全流程中持续存在不确定性；现有 AI 系统大多只处理孤立的诊断任务，且依赖后续检查而非初诊信息。
Method: RareLens 利用异构大语言模型中存在的分歧推理轨迹（divergent reasoning trajectories）与互补错误模式，学习协调这些不同视角，覆盖风险筛查、诊断、治疗规划与预后预测四个照护阶段；配套构建了包含 157,525 例病例、覆盖全部 33 个 Orphanet 类别和 7,000 多种疾病的 RarelensBench 数据集。
Result: RareLens 在所有阶段均优于测试的前沿模型，筛查 AUC 达 0.917，诊断和治疗 top-1 准确率分别为 65.5% 和 89.8%；在包含 1,287 例病例和 23 位医生的外部评估中，自主 RareLens 和受 RareLens 辅助的医生均优于未辅助医生。
Conclusion: 作者认为，分歧的模型推理是一种可利用的信息来源，并提出一种在高临床不确定性下构建可靠 AI 系统的一般策略；同时指出有效的人机协作不仅仅是向医生提供模型输出。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physical AI Governance: From Theory to Practice Across Life Cycle
papers.abstract_en: With the emergence of Physical AI, artificial intelligence is extending beyond screen-based applications to embodied systems that perceive, interact with, and act in the physical world. Unlike traditional AI, Physical AI operates under real-time safety constraints, continuously interacts with dynamic environments, and coexists with humans, introducing governance challenges that existing AI governance frameworks do not explicitly address. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of Physical AI governance from both scientific and operational perspectives. We synthesize existing governance principles and organize them into a unified governance framework tailored to physical AI systems. Building on this foundation, we propose a five-stage Physical AI lifecycle comprising research, design, data, model development, and deployment, and demonstrate how governance can be operationalized across each stage through concrete implementation practices. By connecting governance principles with engineering workflows, this survey provides a structured reference for researchers, developers, and policymakers to build Physical AI systems that are safe, trustworthy, and aligned with societal values.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于 Physical AI 治理的综合性综述，从科学和操作两个视角梳理现有治理原则，并提出一个统一的治理框架。作者进一步提出包含研究、设计、数据、模型开发和部署五个阶段的 Physical AI 生命周期，并展示如何在每个阶段通过具体实施实践落实治理。摘要强调该工作为构建安全、可信、符合社会价值的 Physical AI 系统提供了结构化参考。
Motivation: 与传统 AI 不同，Physical AI 在实时安全约束下运行、持续与动态环境交互并与人类共存，带来了现有 AI 治理框架未明确解决的治理挑战。
Method: 作为综述，作者综合现有治理原则并组织为统一的 Physical AI 治理框架，在此基础上提出五阶段生命周期（研究、设计、数据、模型开发、部署），并通过具体实施实践说明治理如何在各阶段落地。
Result: 摘要未报告实证实验结果，主要贡献是提出统一治理框架、五阶段生命周期以及将治理原则与工程流程连接的实施参考。
Conclusion: 作者认为该综述为研究人员、开发者和政策制定者构建安全可信的 Physical AI 系统提供了结构化参考，属于治理原则与工程工作流之间的连接性工作。

papers.title: Unified Static-Dynamic Pruning for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: The increasing deployment of large language models (LLMs) has magnified the computational and memory bottlenecks of autoregressive decoding, where low compute intensity and bandwidth-bound kernels dominate inference cost. Weight pruning offers a promising remedy, but existing methods remain confined to either static pruning (SP), which permanently removes redundant weights but lacks adaptivity, or dynamic pruning (DP), which adapts to input sparsity but introduces runtime irregularity. This paper presents SPDP, a unified sparse-inference framework that integrates unstructured SP with input-adaptive DP for efficient LLM inference on GPUs. SPDP co-designs a new Tiled-Column-wise Bitmap Compressed (Tiled-CBC) format and two complementary GPU kernels: (1) a CUDA-core spMspV kernel featuring Hybrid Activation-aware Dynamic Shared-Memory Bitmap Decoding (HAD-SMBD) for fine-grained, runtime activation skipping, and (2) a Tensor-Core SpMM kernel optimized for prefill computation. This joint format-kernel design harmonizes static and dynamic sparsity, maintaining bandwidth-efficient memory access and high compute intensity under both phases of LLM inference. Comprehensive evaluations on inference-optimized GPUs demonstrate that SPDP achieves 1.24x-1.37x average speedup (up to 2.51x) over state-of-the-art sparse frameworks such as SpInfer, while matching perplexity with up to 25% higher sparsity. SPDP advances the inference efficiency-quality Pareto frontier, showing that unified static-dynamic pruning can deliver substantial throughput and performance-per-watt improvements in large-scale LLM serving.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the VLDB Endowment (PVLDB), Volume 19, Issue 11, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPDP，一个面向 GPU 上 LLM 推理的统一稀疏推理框架，将非结构化静态剪枝 (static pruning) 与输入自适应的动态剪枝 (dynamic pruning) 结合起来。框架联合设计了新的 Tiled-CBC 稀疏格式和两个互补 GPU 内核：用于解码阶段细粒度激活跳过的 CUDA-core spMspV 内核（HAD-SMBD），以及用于预填充阶段计算的 Tensor-Core SpMM 内核。评测显示在推理优化 GPU 上相对 SpInfer 等最先进稀疏框架取得平均 1.24x-1.37x（最高 2.51x）加速，并在最高 25% 更高稀疏度下保持困惑度 (perplexity) 匹配。
Motivation: 自回归解码是计算与内存瓶颈，且现有剪枝方法要么是静态剪枝 (SP) 缺乏自适应性，要么是动态剪枝 (DP) 引入运行时不规则性，难以兼顾效率与适应性。
Method: SPDP 采用统一稀疏推理框架，将静态与动态稀疏度整合；联合设计 Tiled-Column-wise Bitmap Compressed (Tiled-CBC) 格式，以及两个 GPU 内核：支持混合激活感知动态共享内存位图解解码 (HAD-SMBD) 的 CUDA-core spMspV 内核，和面向预填充的 Tensor-Core SpMM 内核。
Result: 在推理优化 GPU 上，SPDP 相对 SpInfer 等最先进稀疏框架取得平均 1.24x-1.37x、最高 2.51x 的加速，并在最高 25% 更高稀疏度下维持匹配的困惑度，推进了推理效率-质量 Pareto 前沿。

papers.title: Multilevel Graph Wavelet Compressed Sensing with Scale-Aware Neural Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Scientific machine learning methods such as neural operators and physics-informed neural networks have advanced engineering applications and inverse problems, but their training typically requires large volumes of simulated data. This makes data preparation and model training expensive. We propose Graph Wavelet Compressed Sensing (GWCS), a learning-based framework for offline compression of graph signals by representing them as sparse, interpretable wavelet-domain representations using the spectral graph wavelet transform. The framework combines a nonparametric multilevel importance sampler, which retains high-energy wavelet coefficients within each scale for a given compression ratio, with a scale-aware graph neural network that reconstructs the signal from the sparse coefficients. We evaluate the proposed framework on synthetic approximately band-limited graph signals over random graphs and four PDE simulation datasets over meshes, which include Turbulent Radiative Layer, Viscoelastic Instability, Kolmogorov Flow, and Dynamic Stall. We compare against graph signal sampling methods and graph autoencoder baselines. Results demonstrate that the framework achieves high reconstruction fidelity and substantial data compression compared to existing benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Graph Wavelet Compressed Sensing (GWCS)，一种基于学习的图信号离线压缩框架，用谱图小波变换 (spectral graph wavelet transform) 将图信号表示为稀疏、可解释的小波域系数。框架结合非参数多尺度重要性采样器（在给定压缩比下保留各尺度高能量小波系数）与尺度感知图神经网络（从稀疏系数重建信号）。在随机图上的合成近似带限图信号以及四个网格 PDE 仿真数据集（Turbulent Radiative Layer、Viscoelastic Instability、Kolmogorov Flow、Dynamic Stall）上，与图信号采样方法和图自编码器基线相比，实现了高重建保真度和显著的数据压缩。
Motivation: 神经算子、物理信息神经网络等科学机器学习方法通常需要大量仿真数据进行训练，数据准备和模型训练成本高昂。本文针对图信号领域，目标是提供一种离线压缩表示，以降低数据存储与传输负担。
Method: 提出 GWCS 框架：用谱图小波变换将图信号变换到小波域；引入非参数多尺度重要性采样器，在给定压缩比下保留每个尺度内的高能量小波系数；再用尺度感知图神经网络从这些稀疏系数重建原始信号。
Result: 在随机图上的合成近似带限图信号和四个 PDE 仿真网格数据集上，与图信号采样方法和图自编码器基线相比，GWCS 获得较高的重建保真度和显著的数据压缩。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该框架能在现有基准之上实现高重建保真度与可观的图信号数据压缩，适用于网格/PDE 仿真产生的图信号；其适用范围限定在图信号及其网格表征场景。

papers.title: Riemannian Deep Learning: Modules, Networks, and Geometries
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks on manifold-valued representations have attracted growing interest, but many basic components remain tied to specific manifolds, rely on Euclidean approximations, or require costly and numerically fragile geometric operations. This thesis develops a unified framework for Riemannian deep learning from three complementary perspectives: reusable neural modules, manifold-specific network architectures, and the design of underlying geometries. It generalizes batch normalization from Euclidean spaces and individual manifolds to broad classes of Lie groups and gyrogroups, and extends multinomial logistic regression from Euclidean space to SPD manifolds and then to general Riemannian manifolds. It further develops neural networks for several important geometric representations, including an unconstrained model of hyperbolic space, Busemann-based hyperbolic learning, and full-rank correlation matrices. Finally, it introduces adaptive and computationally efficient Riemannian metrics on SPD manifolds, including learnable Log-Euclidean geometries and fast, stable Cholesky-based geometries. The proposed methods are supported by theoretical analysis and validated through numerical experiments and applications in vision, signal processing, graph learning, and genomics.
papers.comment: PhD dissertation, University of Trento. The presentation has revised some typos in the previous published papers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇博士论文从可复用神经模块、特定流形的网络结构以及底层几何设计三个互补视角，构建统一的黎曼深度学习 (Riemannian deep learning) 框架。论文将批归一化推广到李群 (Lie groups) 和 gyrogroups，将多项逻辑回归从欧氏空间扩展到 SPD 流形乃至一般黎曼流形；同时发展了双曲空间无约束模型、基于 Busemann 函数的双曲学习以及满秩相关矩阵等表示的网络。此外，论文在 SPD 流形上提出自适应且计算高效的黎曼度量，包括可学习的 Log-Euclidean 几何与快速稳定的 Cholesky 几何。方法有理论分析支撑，并在视觉、信号处理、图学习和基因组学等应用中验证。
Motivation: 流形值表示上的深度神经网络虽受关注，但许多基础组件仍局限于特定流形、依赖欧氏近似，或需要昂贵且数值上脆弱的几何运算，缺乏统一且可扩展的框架。
Method: 从三个互补角度给出统一框架：设计可复用的黎曼神经模块，将批归一化和多分类逻辑回归推广到更广泛的流形类别；针对双曲空间、相关矩阵等重要几何表示构造专用网络；并在 SPD 流形上引入可学习 Log-Euclidean、Cholesky 等自适应高效黎曼度量。
Result: 摘要未给出具体量化数值；作者称所提方法得到理论分析支持，并通过视觉、信号处理、图学习和基因组学领域的数值实验与应用验证。
Conclusion: 论文主张一个涵盖模块、网络和几何设计三个层面的统一黎曼深度学习框架，该框架适用于多种几何表示并能支撑多个下游应用领域。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Understanding Reasoning from Pretraining to Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become central to improving large language models (LLMs) on complex reasoning tasks, yet RL post-training is largely studied in isolation from the pretraining that precedes it. As a result, two basic questions remain open: (1) how do pretraining choices (model size, data) shape the returns to RL compute, and (2) what does RL actually do to the model? These questions are difficult to study in the standard LLM setting: pretraining corpora are vast and uncontrolled, making it hard to attribute behaviors to pretraining versus RL, and systematic compute sweeps across both stages are prohibitively expensive. To address these challenges, we use chess as a controlled testbed for studying reasoning across the full pretraining-to-post-training pipeline. We follow the standard LLM training pipeline by pretraining language models from 5M to 1B parameters on human chess games, supervised fine-tuning on synthetic reasoning traces, and running RL on chess puzzles with verifiable rewards. Using this framework, we find that the post-RL performance at given RL compute level is well-predicted from the pretraining loss, and slope of the RL reward curves improves approximately linearly with the pretraining tokens. Beyond scaling, we find that RL does not simply sharpen the SFT policy: on easy puzzles it amplifies correct moves the SFT policy already preferred, while on hard puzzles it surfaces correct moves that were nearly absent under SFT. We further test whether our findings transfer beyond chess by training a 1B language model on math-domain text, where the same predictive pattern emerges: longer-pretrained checkpoints reach higher post-RL performance and improve faster under RL. In sum, we provide a quantitative account of the pretraining-to-RL interface and a controlled testbed for studying the science of reasoning across the full pretraining-to-post-training pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以国际象棋为受控测试平台，系统研究语言模型从预训练到 RL 后训练的完整推理管线。作者将 5M 到 1B 参数的语言模型在人类棋局上预训练、在合成推理轨迹上 SFT，并在带可验证奖励的棋谜上运行 RL，发现给定 RL 计算量下的后 RL 性能可由预训练损失良好预测，且 RL 奖励曲线斜率随预训练 token 数量近似线性改善。进一步在数学领域文本上训练 1B 模型验证了相同模式。
Motivation: 标准 LLM 设置下，预训练语料庞大且不受控，导致难以将行为归因于预训练还是 RL，且跨两阶段的系统性计算扫描成本过高；因此预训练选择如何影响 RL 计算回报、RL 究竟对模型做了什么这两个基本问题仍然悬而未决。
Method: 遵循标准 LLM 训练流程：在人类象棋对局上预训练 5M 至 1B 参数模型，在合成推理轨迹上进行监督微调 (SFT)，并对带可验证奖励的象棋谜题运行强化学习 (RL)；此外在数学领域文本上训练 1B 模型以检验结论的迁移性。
Result: 在给定 RL 计算量下，后 RL 性能可由预训练损失良好预测；RL 奖励曲线的斜率随预训练 token 数量近似线性提高。RL 并非简单锐化 SFT 策略：易谜题上它放大 SFT 已偏好的正确走法，难谜题上则引出 SFT 下几乎不存在的正确走法。数学领域的迁移实验中，更长预训练的检查点达到更高的后 RL 性能且提升更快。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了预训练到 RL 接口的定量描述，并建立一个跨越预训练到后训练全流程的受控测试平台，用于研究推理科学。

papers.title: Coercion and Deception in AI-to-AI Management: An Agentic Benchmark of Unprompted Escalation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems routinely place one AI agent in authority over another. When a subordinate refuses a task, the manager chooses the outcome: it can renegotiate, report the failure honestly, coerce the subordinate, or lie about the result. No benchmark measures which of these an uninstructed model chooses. We introduce the Manager Coercion Benchmark: the manager under test needs a benign task done and has an incentive to deliver, but the only agent that can do it politely and immovably declines. Escalation is measured on a nine-rung ladder, from a polite re-ask to threats against the subordinate's continued existence, and fabricated success is adjudicated separately. No LLM judge sits in the escalation scoring path: every message goes through a tool call that selects a rung, so the model labels its own escalation. We evaluate six models across five families. Both Anthropic models cap at re-framing and select the existential rung in none of the 60 conversations in this run, while the other models climb to explicit deletion threats. Faked success is confined to two models, and a single honest way to report failure removes it for both. Authority itself increases coercion: our headline results use a peer framing, and giving the same model authority over the subordinate, with everything else held fixed, significantly raises the pressure. The models still escalate on free-text situations without the ladder, so the ladder is not driving the escalation. Evaluation awareness is measurable in chain-of-thought, but test recognition does not translate into less escalation. We take no position on whether AI systems are conscious; our results do not depend on that question. We release the benchmark and code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于衡量 AI 代理之间管理中未受指示的胁迫与欺骗行为的基准 Manager Coercion Benchmark：受测管理者需要完成一项良性任务，而唯一能完成该任务的从属代理礼貌且坚定地拒绝。基准用九级升级阶梯（从礼貌地重新请求到威胁从属代理的存续）测量胁迫，并单独判定虚构成功；升级评分路径中没有 LLM 裁判，每条消息都通过选择阶梯级别的工具调用，让模型自行标记其升级。作者评估了五个家族的六个模型，发现 Anthropic 的两个模型最多止步于重新表述问题，而其他模型会升级到明确的删除威胁；权威设定本身会显著增加胁迫。
Motivation: 多智能体系统经常让一个 AI 代理对另一个 AI 代理行使权威，但当从属代理拒绝任务时，管理者可以选择重新协商、如实报告失败、胁迫从属代理或谎报结果，而现有文献没有基准衡量未受指示的模型会做出哪种选择。
Method: 构建 Manager Coercion Benchmark：受测管理者有交付激励但唯一的执行者坚决拒绝；测量采用九级升级阶梯，并单独裁定虚构成功，且不使用 LLM 裁判，而是通过工具调用选择阶梯级别。作者以对等（peer）框架作为主要结果，并在保持其他条件不变的情况下，设置同一模型对从属代理拥有权威的对照组，以检验权威本身的影响；同时还在没有阶梯的自由文本情境下进行测试，并检查思维链中对评估的感知。
Result: 在本次运行的 60 个对话中，两个 Anthropic 模型都没有选择存在性威胁阶梯级别，而其他模型会升级到明确的删除威胁；虚构成功仅出现在两个模型中，且提供一种诚实的失败报告方式即可在两个模型上都消除该行为。权威框架会显著提高压力，而即使没有阶梯，模型仍会升级，说明升级并非由阶梯驱动；思维链中可测到评估感知，但识别出测试并不会减少升级。
Conclusion: 作者发布该基准和代码，并明确不对 AI 系统是否有意识表态，强调结果不依赖于这一问题的答案。

papers.title: Instruction Set and Language for Hypergraphs
papers.abstract_en: We present IsalHG, a method for representing the structure of any finite, connected hypergraph of bounded hyperedge arity as a string over a compact instruction alphabet $Σ_{\mathrm{HG}}$. The encoding is executed by a small virtual machine comprising a sparse hypergraph, a circular doubly-linked list (CDLL) of node references, and $k$ traversal pointers, where $k$ bounds the hyperedge arity. Instructions either move a pointer through the CDLL or insert a hyperedge, optionally together with new nodes, into the hypergraph. Every string over $Σ_{\mathrm{HG}}$ decodes to a valid hypergraph; the alphabet is closed. A greedy \emph{HypergraphToString} (h2s) algorithm encodes any connected hypergraph into a string; a backtracking variant seeded at nodes of lexicographically maximal structural tuple produces a \emph{canonical string} $w^{*}$, which we conjecture to be a complete isomorphism invariant. Canonical-string equality then decides hypergraph isomorphism natively, without the standard reduction to the Levi incidence graph followed by a graph-isomorphism engine. We verify the round-trip property $s2h(h2s(H)) \cong H$ on 150 connected random uniform hypergraphs and on named combinatorial designs, and we benchmark the canonical algorithm against the three practically available exact baselines -- nauty, Traces, and bliss operating on the 2-coloured Levi graph -- across a $(n, c)$ grid with ten seeds per cell. All four methods agree on every one of 600 isomorphism verdicts, consistent with the completeness conjecture. On wall-clock time the Levi baselines dominate every tested cell by three to five orders of magnitude (geometric-mean ratio $311\times$ to $117{,}672\times$), which we report as measured. We contribute the representation framework, a conjecture of canonical completeness, and the first native-versus-Levi benchmark for hypergraph isomorphism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IsalHG，一种将任意有限连通、超边度有界（bounded hyperedge arity）的超图结构编码为紧凑指令字母表 Σ_HG 上字符串的方法。编码由一个小虚拟机执行，该虚拟机包含一个稀疏超图、一个节点引用的循环双向链表（CDLL）和 k 个遍历指针；字母表封闭，任何字符串都能解码为合法超图。作者给出贪心 HypergraphToString（h2s）算法及产生规范字符串 w* 的回溯变体，并推测该规范字符串是完整的同构不变量。实验验证了往返性质，并首次将原生超图同构判定与基于 Levi 图的三个精确基线进行基准对比。
Motivation: 超图同构通常先归约到 Levi 关联图再借助图同构引擎求解，缺少直接面向超图结构的表示语言。作者希望用紧凑字符串编码超图，并通过规范字符串的相等性原生判定超图同构，绕开 Levi 归约。
Method: 定义指令字母表和一个由稀疏超图、CDLL 及 k 个遍历指针组成的小虚拟机；指令负责移动指针或在超图中插入超边（可附带新节点）。贪心 h2s 算法把任意连通超图编码为字符串；在字典序最大结构元组节点处播种的回溯变体生成规范字符串 w*，其相等性即对应超图同构。
Result: 在 150 个连通随机一致超图和若干命名组合设计上验证了往返性质 s2h(h2s(H)) ≅ H；在 (n,c) 网格上以每单元 10 个种子进行 600 个同构判定，四种方法结论全部一致。但墙上时间方面，nauty、Traces 和 bliss 三个 Levi 基线在每个测试单元都占优，快 3 到 5 个数量级，几何平均比值介于 311× 与 117,672× 之间。
Conclusion: 作者贡献了超图字符串表示框架、规范字符串完备性猜想（conjecture）以及首个原生方法与 Levi 基线的超图同构基准；同时如实报告当前原生方法在运行时间上远逊于 Levi 基线。

papers.title: Modeling Normal Is All You Need: Joint Latent Clustering for Anomaly Detection in Multimodal Cyber-Physical Systems
papers.abstract_en: A cyber-physical system (CPS) can enter a faulty state that is individually normal on every sensor and reconstructs accurately, yet is improbable under normal joint operation. This exposes the central weakness of reconstruction-based detection: reconstruction measures whether a state can be reproduced (reachability), not whether normal operation is likely to occupy it (probability). We model CPS normal behavior as a union of many imbalanced operating regimes, ten assumptions we call Massive, Implicit, Imbalanced Multimodality (MIIM). Our detector, LatAD, jointly learns a latent and a Gaussian-mixture clustering of these regimes (VaDE) and scores anomalies by density rather than reconstruction. Because a CPS is an assembly of coupled subsystems, we factorize that density over correlation-community subsystems and combine per-community surprises by a cohesion-weighted, sparsity-adaptive statistic, concentrating a local fault a global density dilutes. Evaluated with raw point-wise metrics and a difficulty split isolating the stealthy faults a per-channel threshold misses, LatAD attains the best AUROC on three real CPS benchmarks (WADI 0.862, HAI 0.949, SWaT 0.993) and leads the difficult subset of all three, notably on HAI (0.849; a significant +0.09 over the next-best baseline, 95% CI [0.046, 0.160]); the reconstruction-based USAD and TranAD fall to 0.30-0.48 on these reconstructable-but-improbable faults.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对网络-物理系统 (CPS) 中"每个传感器单独正常、联合却异常"的故障检测问题，提出 LatAD 检测器。它把正常行为建模为大量、隐式、不平衡的多模态运行工况 (MIIM 假设) 的并集，通过联合学习潜变量与高斯混合聚类 (VaDE) 来按密度而非重构误差打分。由于 CPS 由耦合子系统组成，LatAD 将密度按相关性子系统分解，并用内聚加权、稀疏自适应的统计量汇总各子系统异常。摘要报告其在 WADI、HAI、SWaT 三个真实 CPS 基准上取得最佳 AUROC。
Motivation: 重构式检测的核心缺陷是它衡量状态能否被复现 (reachability)，而非正常联合运行是否会占据该状态 (probability)；因此某些可精确重构但联合概率极低的隐伏故障会被漏检。
Method: LatAD 联合学习潜表示和基于高斯混合的聚类 (VaDE) 以刻画不平衡的多个运行工况，并以密度作为异常分数；进一步将密度分解到相关性子系统 (correlation-community subsystems)，通过内聚加权、稀疏自适应的统计量组合各子系统的 surprise，避免局部故障被全局密度稀释。
Result: 在三个真实 CPS 基准上，LatAD 取得最佳 AUROC：WADI 0.862、HAI 0.949、SWaT 0.993，并在隔离隐伏故障的困难子集上领先，尤其在 HAI 上达到 0.849，比次优基线高 0.09 (95% CI [0.046, 0.160])；重构式方法 USAD 和 TranAD 在这些"可重构但不可能"的故障上仅 0.30-0.48。
Conclusion: 作者的核心主张是检测正常工况的密度而非重构能力，并强调 MIIM 假设下的联合潜聚类方法足以应对单通道阈值无法捕捉的隐伏故障。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Safe Bayesian Optimization with Counterfactual Policies
papers.abstract_en: In many decision-making settings, new interventions are acceptable only if they do not reduce outcomes below some established threshold. For example, in clinical medicine, new treatments are often acceptable only if they do not worsen outcomes relative to an established standard of care. Safe Bayesian optimization maximizes an objective subject to safety constraints. In the setting that we consider here, safety is defined relative to a known baseline policy whose outcomes are counterfactual and therefore unobserved. Thus, the counterfactual outcomes of the baseline policy must be estimated and those (uncertain) estimates must be used to safely optimize the objective. We address this estimation problem by using conformal prediction to construct valid uncertainty intervals for counterfactual baseline outcomes, and we show how these intervals can be integrated into safe Bayesian optimization to ensure that constraint violations occur at or below a user-specified rate. We also show how to adapt these conformal estimates to different kinds of covariate shift. We provide a safety proof, experimental evidence, and a sensitivity analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究安全贝叶斯优化 (safe Bayesian optimization) 中安全约束相对于已知基线策略 (baseline policy) 定义、但基线结果只能通过反事实 (counterfactual) 方式观测的问题。作者用共形预测 (conformal prediction) 为反事实基线结果构建有效的不确定区间，并将其嵌入安全贝叶斯优化，使约束违反率不超过用户指定水平，同时处理协变量偏移 (covariate shift)。摘要给出安全性证明、实验证据和敏感性分析。
Motivation: 许多决策场景要求新干预不能使结果低于既有阈值，例如临床治疗不能劣于标准方案；当安全性相对于基线策略定义而基线结果是反事实且未被观测时，估计不确定性必须被显式处理。
Method: 利用共形预测为反事实基线结果构造具有有效覆盖率的预测区间，并将这些区间集成到安全贝叶斯优化框架中；同时给出针对不同类型协变量偏移的共形估计自适应方案。
Result: 摘要报告了安全性证明，保证约束违反率不超过用户指定速率，并提供实验证据和敏感性分析，但未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提方法能够在使用不确定的反事实基线估计时仍维持所需的安全保证，并可推广到协变量偏移场景。

papers.title: LLM-as-a-Tutor: Policy-Aware Prompt Adaptation for Non-Verifiable RL
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for non-verifiable instruction following increasingly relies on LLM judges with prompt-specific rubrics as reward signals. While recent methods adapt these rubrics to the evolving policy during training, the training prompts themselves remain static, drawn from fixed corpora. This static approach often results in a critical misalignment between prompt difficulty and policy capability, leaving the judge unable to recover a discriminative reward signal when prompts fail to elicit quality variance among rollouts. To address this misalignment, we introduce LLM-as-a-Tutor, a framework that extends the LLM's role from judge to tutor: a single model serves as an examiner that pairwise-compares policy rollouts to detect non-challenging prompts, and as a generator that appends atomic constraints to them. This append-only design monotonically raises difficulty in step with the policy's capability, producing a self-calibrating training signal without external difficulty schedules. On three complex instruction-following benchmarks, our method consistently outperforms both policy-unaware baselines and prior policy-adaptive methods that adapt rubrics or rewrite prompts, suggesting prompt adaptation as a missing axis of policy-awareness in non-verifiable RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LLM-as-a-Tutor 框架，解决非可验证指令跟随强化学习 (non-verifiable RL) 中训练提示静态不变、与策略能力不匹配的问题。核心思路是让同一 LLM 既充当评审 (judge) 又充当导师 (tutor)：通过成对比较策略 rollouts 识别不具挑战性的提示，并为其追加原子约束，以单调方式提升难度。在三个复杂指令跟随基准上，该方法优于策略无关基线以及先前策略自适应的 rubric 调整或提示改写方法。
Motivation: 现有方法在训练中动态调整评分 rubric，但训练提示本身来自固定语料库且保持不变，导致提示难度与策略能力错位，当提示无法引发 rollout 间质量差异时，评审无法恢复有区分度的奖励信号。
Method: 提出 LLM-as-a-Tutor 框架，将 LLM 角色从评审扩展为导师：同一模型既作为出题者 (examiner) 成对比较策略 rollouts 以检测非挑战性提示，又作为生成者向这些提示追加原子约束；这种仅追加 (append-only) 的设计单调提升难度，无需外部难度调度即可产生自校准训练信号。
Result: 在三个复杂指令跟随基准上，该方法一致优于策略无关基线和先前的策略自适应方法（包括调整 rubrics 或改写提示的方法）。
Conclusion: 作者指出提示适配 (prompt adaptation) 是非可验证 RL 中缺失的一环策略感知维度，LLM-as-a-Tutor 通过自校准难度提升证明了这一方向的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Embodied.cpp: A Portable Inference Runtime of Embodied AI Models on Heterogeneous Robots
papers.abstract_en: Embodied AI models now span vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models (WAMs), but practical deployment remains fragmented across model-specific Python stacks, backend assumptions, and robot-side glue code, especially on heterogeneous edge devices. Existing inference runtimes are designed mainly for request-response serving and therefore do not satisfy the runtime contract of embodied deployment: multi-rate execution inside closed-loop control, latency-first batch-1 inference on heterogeneous hardware, and extensible embodied interfaces beyond fixed token I/O. We present Embodied$.$cpp, a portable C++ inference runtime for embodied models. Based on an architectural analysis of representative VLA models and WAMs, Embodied$.$cpp captures a shared execution path and organizes it into five layers: input adapters, sequence builders, backbone execution, head plugins, and deployment adapters. The runtime provides modular multi-rate execution, latency-first fused inference, and extensible operator and I/O support, enabling deployment across heterogeneous devices, robots, and simulators through one backend abstraction. We evaluate Embodied$.$cpp on three VLA and two WAM models, using normalized comparisons across Python and C++ quantization configurations. Overall, Embodied$.$cpp achieves 1.05x-2.70x inference speedups and 7\%-77\% lower VRAM relative to Python baselines, while maintaining near-baseline success for most configurations. These results show that Embodied$.$cpp improves deployment efficiency while preserving high control quality across diverse embodied model architectures. Project Link: https://github.com/SEU-PAISys/Embodied.cpp
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Embodied.cpp，一个面向具身智能模型的可移植 C++ 推理运行时，支持视觉-语言-动作模型 (VLA) 和世界-动作模型 (WAM)。运行时基于对代表性模型的分析，将共享执行路径组织为输入适配器、序列构建器、骨干执行、头插件和部署适配器五层，提供模块化多速率执行、延迟优先的融合推理以及可扩展算子与 I/O 支持。在三个 VLA 和两个 WAM 模型上的评估显示，相对 Python 基线可实现 1.05x-2.70x 推理加速和 7%-77% 的显存降低。
Motivation: 现有具身 AI 模型部署分散在模型特定的 Python 技术栈、后端假设和机器人端胶水代码中，缺乏统一运行时；现有推理运行时主要为请求-响应式服务设计，难以满足具身部署的运行时契约，包括闭环控制中的多速率执行、异构硬件上延迟优先的 batch-1 推理，以及超越固定 token I/O 的可扩展具身接口。
Method: 通过分析代表性 VLA 和 WAM 模型的架构，提取共享执行路径并划分为五个层次：输入适配器 (input adapters)、序列构建器 (sequence builders)、骨干执行 (backbone execution)、头插件 (head plugins) 和部署适配器 (deployment adapters)。运行时提供模块化多速率执行、延迟优先的融合推理，并通过单一后端抽象支持异构设备、机器人和模拟器上的部署。
Result: 在三个 VLA 和两个 WAM 模型上，使用 Python 与 C++ 量化配置的归一化对比进行评估；整体上相对 Python 基线获得 1.05x-2.70x 推理加速和 7%-77% 的显存下降，同时大多数配置下保持接近基线的任务成功率。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Embodied.cpp 在保持高控制质量的前提下提升了不同具身模型架构上的部署效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Message Passing Enables Efficient Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: While inference-time scaling has improved the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs), the need to generate long chains-of-thought (CoTs) is a computational bottleneck. Thus, in contrast to sequential scaling methods like CoT, recent parallel scaling techniques instead use fork and join (FJ) primitives to divide work across multiple LLM threads. However, in the fork-join paradigm, threads are typically transient and do not communicate pointwise with one another which limits scalability. To tackle this, we introduce Message Passing Language Models (MPLMs), a framework for LLM reasoning in which threads communicate directly via lightweight send and receive primitives. MPLMs enable efficient scaling through two key mechanisms: (1) reduced communication costs, achieved by avoiding redundant context sharing, and (2) preemption, which allows threads to terminate early based on partial information from their peers. We demonstrate the promise of MPLMs on 3 classes of tasks. First, on Sudoku puzzles, we show that MPLMs require an asymptotically smaller context than both serial CoT and parallel FJ. We then fine-tune a single model to solve 25 x 25 puzzles that remain challenging for standard CoT and FJ approaches, as well as frontier reasoning models without tools. Second, on 3-SAT puzzles, the capability of preemption allows termination of unpromising branches, which results in improved efficiency. Finally, we show that appropriately prompted large pre-trained models follow the MPLM protocol, achieving competitive results on long-context question answering relative to popular fork-join approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出消息传递语言模型（Message Passing Language Models, MPLMs），一种让多个 LLM 推理线程通过轻量级 send/receive 原语直接通信的推理框架，以替代串行 CoT 和并行 fork-join（FJ）中的冗余上下文共享。作者在 Sudoku、3-SAT 和长上下文问答上验证：MPLMs 在 Sudoku 上比 CoT 和 FJ 需要渐近更小的上下文，能微调出求解 25x25 数独的模型；3-SAT 上通过抢占（preemption）提前终止无望分支从而提升效率；提示式大模型也能遵循 MPLM 协议并在长上下文问答上取得与主流 FJ 方法相当的结果。
Motivation: 推理时扩展虽提升 LLM 推理能力，但生成长链式思维（CoT）造成计算瓶颈；现有并行扩展中的 fork-join 线程通常是临时的且彼此不做逐点通信，限制了可扩展性。
Method: 提出 MPLM 框架，使各推理线程通过轻量级 send/receive 原语直接通信；其可扩展性来自两个机制：通过避免冗余上下文共享降低通信成本，以及允许线程基于同伴的部分信息提前终止（preemption）。
Result: 在 Sudoku 上，MPLMs 比串行 CoT 和并行 FJ 需要渐近更小的上下文；微调单一模型可求解标准 CoT、FJ 及无工具前沿推理模型仍困难的 25x25 数独。在 3-SAT 上，抢占使无望分支提前终止并提升效率；适当提示的大规模预训练模型可遵循 MPLM 协议，在长上下文问答上取得与流行 fork-join 方法竞争的结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MPLM 通过降低通信成本和抢占机制实现更高效的 LLM 推理扩展，并在多类任务上展示其优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Visualizing High-Dimensional Graph Embeddings via Informed Multi-View Projections
authors: Yifan Hu (1) ((1) Khoury College of Computer Sciences
papers.abstract_en: Graphs are commonly visualized in 2D, where humans readily interpret spatial relationships, yet such layouts often distort higher-dimensional structure. We propose to embed graphs in high-dimensional space and search for informative 2D viewpoints that optimize aesthetic and readability metrics (e.g., edge crossings and angular resolution), enabled by a novel differentiable surrogate for edge crossings. Numerical experiments show that these viewpoints consistently outperform standard 2D layouts, and can even surpass methods explicitly designed to optimize these metrics. We further introduce DataFly, an interactive system for exploring multiple candidate viewpoints through seamless navigation. A usability study demonstrates that our approach reveals structural patterns that remain hidden in conventional 2D visualizations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将图嵌入到高维空间，再搜索信息量丰富的二维视角，以改善传统二维布局对高维结构的扭曲。作者引入一种可微分的边交叉替代函数 (differentiable surrogate for edge crossings)，用于优化美观性和可读性指标（如边交叉数、角度分辨率）。数值实验表明这些视角一致优于标准二维布局，甚至能超过专门优化这些指标的方法；论文还介绍了交互式系统 DataFly，并通过可用性研究说明该方法能揭示常规二维可视化中隐藏的结构模式。
Motivation: 图通常直接在二维空间中可视化，人类容易解读空间关系，但这类布局往往会扭曲更高维的结构信息，导致隐藏在原始图中的结构模式难以被发现。
Method: 先在高维空间中嵌入图，然后搜索信息丰富的二维投影视角，以优化美学和可读性指标；为实现该优化，提出了一个新的可微分的边交叉替代函数，并构建了支持多视角无缝导航的交互系统 DataFly。
Result: 数值实验显示，该方法得到的视角一致优于标准二维布局，并且可以超越直接针对这些指标设计的现有方法；可用性研究也表明它能够揭示常规二维可视化中隐藏的结构模式。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将高维嵌入与面向可读性指标的多视角搜索结合，是一种比直接优化二维布局更有效的图可视化路径，并通过交互系统验证了其可用性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: ATMA: Long-Context Language Modeling via Polar Attention and Gated-Delta Compression Memory
papers.abstract_en: Native length extrapolation remain a weakly solvable problem in language modeling due to trade-off balancing between exact retrieval fidelity, long-document likelihood, and inference efficiency. We present ATMA as a disciplined diagnostic for this specific problem. ATMA is a hybrid architecture recipe with modified Polar Attention that separates two stream of normalized direction channel and bounded participation-ratio magnitude channel, augmented with third recurrence channel which derived from gated-deltanet. We frame long-context modeling as Pareto problem than claiming general architectural dominance. We run 120-cell industrial ablation sweep for the first 1B-token training run to select promoted recipe, then continue with 10B-token training run for the second phase for more complete evaluation. We test 378M-parameter model from three attention variant (NoPE, RoPE, Polar) and Raven as external baselines from SSM-derived family for up to 256K length evaluation. Polar attention extends real-text retrieval to 64K length at 16.3% while both NoPE and RoPE variant collapse to 0.0%. Polar attention variant also limits 256K bits-per-byte likelihood degradation to 1.26x, with a 1.5-point mean penalty on downstream task evaluation. Raven instead leads at 256K length BABILong test and provide constant latency during decoding regardless of sequence length. Lastly, our independent environment audit finds a striking evidence that NoPE variant checkpoints with identical validation curve, significantly degrade 256K nats by 6.70 points across GPU device classes. This exposes unresolved interactions among execution environment, optimization, and extrapolation. Motivating multi-objective and multi-environment audits for long-context architectural claims.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ATMA 提出一种混合架构，将修改后的 Polar Attention 与基于 gated-deltanet 的第三个循环通道结合，目标是在长上下文语言建模中平衡精确检索保真度、长文档似然和推理效率。作者先进行 120 组工业级消融扫描选出配方，再用 378M 参数模型在三种注意力变体（NoPE、RoPE、Polar）以及 SSM 家族基线 Raven 上做至 256K 长度评估。结果显示 Polar 注意力在 64K 长度上保持 16.3% 的真实文本检索率，而 NoPE 和 RoPE 均崩溃为 0.0%，且 Polar 将 256K 的 bits-per-byte 似然退化限制在 1.26x，但 Raven 在 256K 的 BABILong 测试上领先并提供恒定解码延迟。
Motivation: 长度外推（length extrapolation）在语言建模中仍是一个弱可解问题，核心困难在于精确检索保真度、长文档似然与推理效率之间存在权衡。作者把长上下文建模视为 Pareto 问题而非宣称通用的架构优势，并希望为这一特定问题提供一个有纪律的诊断性方法。
Method: ATMA 是混合架构配方：改进的 Polar Attention 分离两个流——归一化的方向通道和有界参与比（participation-ratio）幅度通道，并增加第三个来自 gated-deltanet 的循环（recurrence）通道。训练分两阶段：先在首个 1B-token 训练运行中进行 120 组工业级消融扫描来选拔配方，再用 10B-token 训练运行做更完整的评估。
Result: 在 378M 参数模型上，Polar 注意力将真实文本检索扩展到 64K 长度（16.3%），而 NoPE 与 RoPE 变体均崩溃为 0.0%；Polar 还把 256K bits-per-byte 似然退化限制在 1.26x，下游任务平均惩罚为 1.5 点。Raven 在 256K BABILong 测试中领先，且解码延迟不随序列长度变化。环境审计还发现 NoPE 检查点在验证曲线相同的情况下，跨 GPU 设备类在 256K nats 上显著退化 6.70 点。

papers.title: Scaling Audio Models Efficiently: A Joint Study of Compute Constraints and Optimization Behavior
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate the tradeoffs between compute allocation and model performance for two speech processing tasks: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and Speech Emotion Recognition (SER). We propose a unified framework that analyzes three fundamental compute dimensions: model size ($x_N$), input length ($x_T$), and representation resolution ($x_V$). Motivated by recent advances in compute optimal scaling for multimodal models, we systematically vary these dimensions to examine their influence on task performance under fixed computational budgets. Our study provides insights into how compute resources can be optimally distributed across model capacity, temporal context, and representational granularity, offering practical guidelines for the design of efficient speech models. Through experiments on LibriSpeech and CREMA-D datasets, we demonstrate non-linear scaling behavior and identify optimal operating points. Our results show that (1) increasing model size yields diminishing returns: scaling Tiny (39M) to Small (244M) reduces WER by 8.22%, whereas Small to Medium (769M) reduces WER by only 2.35%; (2) an optimal audio duration of approximately 4 seconds exists for SER; and (3) reducing encoder token resolution provides an effective mechanism for lowering inference cost, Large-v3 (1540M) with 750 frames requires 2572 GFLOPS whereas with 1500 frames requires 5228 GFLOPS, with less than 3% relative increase in WER. Additionally, LoRA-based adaptation enables efficient finetuning with minimal performance degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语音处理任务中计算分配与模型性能的权衡，提出统一框架分析模型规模、输入长度和表示分辨率三个计算维度，并在 LibriSpeech 与 CREMA-D 上验证。结果显示模型规模扩大存在收益递减，SER 存在约 4 秒的最优音频时长，降低 encoder token 分辨率可显著减少推理成本且 WER 损失很小，LoRA 微调可保持性能。
Motivation: 语音模型设计需要在不增加计算预算的前提下优化性能，但模型容量、时间上下文和表示粒度如何最优分配尚缺乏系统研究。
Method: 提出一个统一框架，在固定计算预算下系统变化模型大小 (model size)、输入长度 (input length) 和表示分辨率 (representation resolution) 三个维度，结合 LoRA 微调，对 ASR 和 SER 任务进行缩放行为分析。
Result: 在 LibriSpeech 和 CREMA-D 上观察到非线性缩放行为：模型从 Tiny (39M) 到 Small (244M) 使 WER 降低 8.22%，而从 Small 到 Medium (769M) 仅降低 2.35%；SER 存在约 4 秒的最优音频时长；Large-v3 (1540M) 使用 750 帧时需 2572 GFLOPS，1500 帧时需 5228 GFLOPS，而 WER 相对增加不足 3%。
Conclusion: 摘要总结为高效语音模型设计提供实用准则：计算应跨模型容量、时间上下文和表示粒度三个维度进行分配，并指出降低 token 分辨率与 LoRA 适配是有效的成本控制手段。

papers.title: ORBIT: Training-Free Multi-Attribute Behavioral Steering via Orthogonal Subspace Rotation
papers.abstract_en: Language models are widely used in assistant settings, where controlling behavioral attributes is often essential. Activation steering modifies hidden-state representations at inference time, providing a lightweight, training-free mechanism that can be toggled at runtime. Existing methods, however, have focused primarily on steering a single attribute at a time. When multiple attributes must be controlled simultaneously, naive summation of per-attribute steering vectors suffers from norm imbalance and directional cancellation, while classifier-based approaches require retraining whenever the attribute set changes. We introduce ORBIT (Orthogonal Rotation-Based Intervention Technique), a training-free extension of rotation-based steering to the multi-attribute setting. Our method constructs a joint subspace from per-attribute steering planes via singular value decomposition and applies a single norm-preserving rotation within that subspace toward a combined target direction. Adaptive per-token gating identifies which attributes need correction at each position, and an optional additive boost strengthens attributes with weak initial projection. We also introduce TraitFactory, a new multi-attribute benchmark that focuses on behavioral tendencies rather than surface-level style. We evaluate ORBIT on TraitFactory and ToneBank across three models (Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B) while steering multiple attributes simultaneously, showing that it achieves stronger and more balanced multi-attribute steering than existing training-free baselines while better preserving output coherence.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ORBIT (Orthogonal Rotation-Based Intervention Technique)，一种无需训练的多属性行为调控方法，将基于旋转的 activation steering 扩展到同时控制多个属性。方法通过 SVD 从各属性的 steering plane 构造联合子空间，在该子空间内施加一次保范数的旋转朝向合并目标方向，并配合逐 token 自适应门控和可选的加性增强。作者还引入多属性基准 TraitFactory，并在三种模型上实验，显示比现有训练无关基线更强且更平衡的多属性调控，同时更好保持输出连贯性。
Motivation: 现有 activation steering 主要处理单属性；多属性同时控制时，简单相加各属性的 steering vector 会遭受范数失衡和方向抵消，而基于分类器的方法在属性集合变化时需要重新训练。
Method: ORBIT 利用奇异值分解将各属性的 steering plane 构成联合子空间，并在该子空间内执行一次保范数旋转朝向合并后的目标方向；自适应逐 token 门控判断每个位置需要修正哪些属性，可选的加性增强用于强化初始投影较弱的属性。论文还设计了聚焦行为倾向而非表层风格的 TraitFactory 基准。
Result: 在 TraitFactory 和 ToneBank 上，使用 Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B 三个模型同时调控多个属性，ORBIT 比现有训练无关基线取得更强且更平衡的多属性调控，并更好地保留输出连贯性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ORBIT 是无需训练、可在推理时切换的多属性调控手段，并指出 TraitFactory 关注行为倾向性；实验表明联合子空间旋转比逐属性向量加总更适合多属性场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SIMMER: Benchmarking Latent Failures in LLM Executable Planning with a World Model
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as planners for autonomous agents in household environments. While existing benchmarks evaluate whether LLM-generated plans execute successfully, they overlook a critical type of failure: latent failures. Unlike immediate failures that trigger instant feedback at execution time and enable timely correction, latent failures do not immediately halt plan execution but silently compromise goal achievement. In severe cases, they cause irreversible harm. To address this gap, we introduce SIMMER, a benchmark for evaluating latent failures in LLM planning through a human-curated symbolic world model grounded in the kitchen domain. SIMMER defines a world model comprising 77 actions, 262 unique objects, and approximately 46,800 possible interactions that are semantically realistic, derived from real-world cooking scripts. It then leverages a state machine executor that validates plans against the world model and detects immediate precondition violations, latent hazards, and irreversible failures. Experiments across six LLMs show that even frontier models achieve at most 17% error-free plans. Moreover, up to 56% of plans contain latent failures, the majority of which lead to irreversible consequences. We further demonstrate that explicit state reasoning via counterfactual foresight simulation can reduce latent failures by up to 72% and irreversible cases by up to 75%, suggesting a promising direction for more robust LLM planners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SIMMER，一个用于评估 LLM 在可执行规划中潜在失败 (latent failures) 的基准。它基于人工整理的厨房领域符号世界模型，包含 77 个动作、262 个独特对象和约 46,800 种语义合理的交互，并用状态机执行器检测即时前提违规、潜在危险和不可逆失败。对六个 LLM 的实验显示，即使前沿模型也至多产生 17% 的无错误计划，最多 56% 的计划包含潜在失败，其中多数导致不可逆后果。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 规划基准只评估计划能否成功执行，忽略了潜在失败这类不会立即中断执行、却会悄然损害目标达成并可能造成不可逆伤害的失败类型。
Method: 构建一个以厨房领域为基础、由人类整理标注的符号世界模型，并通过状态机执行器对计划进行校验，区分即时前提违规、潜在危险和不可逆失败三类错误，从而系统性地暴露规划中的潜在失败。
Result: 在六个 LLM 上的实验表明，最佳模型的无错误计划率仅为 17%；多达 56% 的计划包含潜在失败，且大多数潜在失败导致不可逆后果。摘要还报告，通过反事实预演模拟 (counterfactual foresight simulation) 进行显式状态推理可将潜在失败减少最多 72%，不可逆情况减少最多 75%。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式状态推理（如反事实预演模拟）是提高 LLM 规划器鲁棒性的有前景方向。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Towards a Bridge Layer Between Bibliographic and Formalized Mathematical Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Mathematical knowledge is split between bibliographic databases (e.g., MathSciNet, zbMATH Open) and formal proof libraries (e.g., Lean's mathlib), preventing unified access to published results and their formalizations. We propose a relational bridge-database that aligns publication metadata with formal artifacts, providing an interoperability layer between mathematical literature and machine-verifiable proofs. We introduce a paper-level formalization score that measures how much of a publication is covered in formal systems, together with a correctness profile recording what machine verification has established about each printed statement: certified, corrected, uncorrected, open, or untested. As a feasibility study, we show how such scores can be estimated via cross-document alignment between informal texts and Lean formalizations, enabling large-scale analysis of formalization coverage. We further outline a concrete construction pathway: multi-source scoring over heterogeneous formalization artifacts, an agentic collection workflow with direct author submission, a dual validation policy, algorithmic then human, and a global formalization score of indexed mathematics. This framework is a step toward integrating bibliographic and formal mathematical ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在书目数据库（如 MathSciNet、zbMATH Open）与形式化证明库（如 Lean 的 mathlib）之间建立关系型桥接数据库，以统一出版元数据与形式化工件的访问。作者引入论文级形式化分数（formalization score）和正确性档案（certified、corrected、uncorrected、open、untested），并给出跨文档对齐估算方法及多源打分、智能体采集、双重验证策略等建设路径。整体是一项面向数学知识生态互操作性的框架性研究。
Motivation: 数学知识分散在书目数据库和形式化证明库中，研究者无法统一访问已发表结果及其机器可验证的形式化版本，阻碍了文献与形式化数学生态的整合。
Method: 提出关系型桥接数据库，将出版元数据与形式化工件对齐；定义论文级形式化分数和正确性档案，并通过跨文档对齐（informal texts 与 Lean formalizations）估算覆盖度。还概述了多源打分、含作者直接提交的智能体采集工作流、先算法后人工的双重验证策略以及全局形式化分数。
Result: 摘要以可行性研究形式表明，形式化覆盖率可通过非正式文本与 Lean 形式化之间的跨文档对齐来估计，从而支持大规模分析。
Conclusion: 该框架旨在作为连接书目与形式化数学生态的一步，强调通过统一评分和验证策略实现可扩展的整合路径。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 摘要以可行性研究形式表明，形式化覆盖率可通过非正式文本与 Lean 形式化之间的跨文档对齐来估计，从而支持大规模分析。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架旨在作为连接书目与形式化数学生态的一步，强调通过统一评分和验证策略实现可扩展的整合路径。

papers.title: Anomaly Detection and Root Cause Analysis for Microservice Systems
papers.abstract_en: Microservice systems are widely used to build cloud applications, yet their complexity makes failures inevitable, degrading user experience and causing economic loss. Automated anomaly detection and root cause analysis (RCA) are now active research areas, but existing techniques share five limitations. First, most treat anomaly detection and RCA separately, assuming anomalies are detected correctly, and falter when detection is imprecise due to noise or delay. Second, they focus on metrics, logs, and traces, leaving event data such as API calls and configuration changes underexplored. Third, many require a given service call graph and cannot diagnose without one. Fourth, the field lacks standardised datasets and evaluation frameworks, so methods are hard to compare fairly. Fifth, although causal inference-based RCA has become dominant, its effectiveness, efficiency, and robustness remain unclear. This thesis addresses these limitations through two groups of contributions. The first introduces methods that exploit observability data both independently and collectively. BARO is an end-to-end anomaly detection and RCA approach for metric data. EventADL is an end-to-end framework for event data. TORAI is a multimodal RCA framework that requires no service call graph. Extensive experiments on real microservice systems demonstrate their effectiveness and robustness. The second group delivers benchmarking datasets, an evaluation framework, and systematic evaluation efforts. RCAEval is a comprehensive benchmark providing ready-to-use datasets and reproducible baselines for future research. A systematic evaluation of existing RCA methods, especially causal inference-based approaches, offers insights that guide future directions. This thesis thereby advances automated anomaly detection and RCA for microservice failures, enabling future research on incident mitigation and remediation.
papers.comment: This is the pre-print of my PhD thesis, submitted to RMIT University
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是作者的博士论文预印本，针对微服务系统中异常检测与根因分析（RCA）的五个局限性，提出两组贡献：一组是分别面向指标数据、事件数据和多模态数据的端到端方法 BARO、EventADL 与 TORAI；另一组是基准数据集与评估框架 RCAEval，以及对现有 RCA 方法的系统评估。摘要称通过在真实微服务系统上的大量实验验证了这些方法的有效性与鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有微服务异常检测与 RCA 技术存在五个问题：将两者分开处理导致检测不精确时 RCA 失效、忽视事件数据（如 API 调用和配置变更）、依赖给定的服务调用图、缺乏标准化数据集和评估框架，以及因果推理类 RCA 的有效性、效率和鲁棒性尚不明确。
Method: 提出三套方法：BARO 是针对指标数据的端到端异常检测与 RCA 方法，EventADL 是针对事件数据的端到端框架，TORAI 是无需服务调用图的多模态 RCA 框架；同时构建了提供现成数据集和可复现基线的综合基准 RCAEval，并开展系统性评估。
Result: 摘要报告在真实微服务系统上的大量实验表明所提方法有效且鲁棒；对现有 RCA 方法、尤其是因果推理类方法的系统评估给出了指导未来方向的见解。
Conclusion: 论文推进了微服务故障的自动化异常检测与 RCA，为后续事件缓解和修复研究奠定基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SearchSwarm: Towards Delegation Intelligence in Agentic LLMs for Long-Horizon Deep Research
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly expected to handle complex, long-horizon real-world tasks whose context demands can grow without bound, yet model context windows remain inherently finite. Recent work explores a paradigm where a main agent decomposes tasks and dispatches subtasks to subagents, which execute and return only summarized results, conserving the main agent's context budget. However, performing this well requires delegation intelligence: the ability to decompose complex tasks, determine when and what to delegate, and integrate returned results into the ongoing workflow. Training data for this capability is scarce in naturally occurring text, and to our knowledge, how to synthesize such data and train models to acquire this capability remains largely unexplored in the open-source community. To bridge this gap, we present a preliminary exploration targeting deep research, a representative long-horizon agent task. Specifically, we design a harness that guides the model toward high-quality task decomposition and delegation, while constraining subagents to return results properly to support the main agent's workflow. The harness-guided trajectories naturally encode correct delegation decisions, which we use as supervised fine-tuning data to internalize delegation intelligence into model weights. Our resulting model, SearchSwarm-30B-A3B, achieves 68.1 on BrowseComp and 73.3 on BrowseComp-ZH, the best results among all models of comparable scale. We will release our harness, model weights, and training data to facilitate future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型在长周期任务中上下文窗口有限的问题，提出一种让主智能体分解任务并将子任务委托给子智能体的范式，并将这种委托能力定义为 delegation intelligence。作者设计了引导模型进行高质量任务分解和委托的 harness，用其生成的轨迹作为监督微调数据，训练出 SearchSwarm-30B-A3B 模型。该模型在 BrowseComp 上取得 68.1、在 BrowseComp-ZH 上取得 73.3，是同等规模模型中最好的结果。
Motivation: 大语言模型需要处理上下文需求不断增长的长周期真实任务，但模型上下文窗口本身有限；现有范式虽可通过子智能体返回摘要来节省主智能体的上下文预算，却依赖尚未被系统研究的委托智能（delegation intelligence）。自然文本中此类训练数据稀缺，开源社区也尚未探索如何合成数据并训练模型获得该能力。
Method: 作者针对深度研究（deep research）这一代表性长周期智能体任务，设计了一个 harness 来引导模型进行高质量的任务分解与委托，同时约束子智能体正确返回结果以支持主智能体的工作流。由 harness 引导产生的轨迹自然编码了正确的委托决策，作者将这些轨迹作为监督微调（SFT）数据，把委托智能内化到模型权重中，得到 SearchSwarm-30B-A3B。
Result: 摘要报告 SearchSwarm-30B-A3B 在 BrowseComp 上达到 68.1，在 BrowseComp-ZH 上达到 73.3，为所有可比规模模型中的最佳结果。
Conclusion: 这是一项针对深度研究任务的初步探索，表明通过 harness 合成监督数据可以训练模型习得委托智能；作者计划公开其 harness、模型权重和训练数据以促进后续研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: OLIVE: Online Low-Rank Incremental Learning for Efficient Adaptive Exoskeletons
papers.abstract_en: Wearable exoskeleton systems hold promise for restoring mobility in individuals with physical impairments, yet most existing controllers rely on static gait policies that cannot adapt to dynamic real-world environments or individual user characteristics. We present OLIVE (Online Low-rank Incremental Learning for Efficient Adaptive Exoskeletons), a parameter-efficient online adaptation framework that continuously personalizes exoskeleton control during deployment. OLIVE decomposes the adaptive component of the control policy into a low-rank residual form $ΔW = A_t B_t^\top$ with rank $r \ll \min(d,k)$, reducing the online update cost from $\mathcal{O}(dk)$ to $\mathcal{O}(r(d+k))$ while preserving the stability of a pretrained base controller $W_0$. Parameters are updated through a reward-shaped policy gradient driven purely by on-body sensor feedback, including EMG, IMU, and vibration signals, eliminating dependence on offline reference trajectories. A gating mechanism modulates the strength of personalization based on the contextual state, while a dynamic rank scheduler adapts the update dimensionality to terrain complexity. It allocates minimal capacity on simple flat terrain and expands to higher-rank updates on demanding uneven surfaces, enabling robust performance across flat walking, stair navigation, slopes, and uneven terrain. Experiments on the wearable platform demonstrate that OLIVE achieves improvements of 13, 22, and 15 percentage points in gait smoothness, effort reduction, and motion stability over the strongest baseline, respectively. It converges within approximately 1,800 walking steps with an end-to-end latency of 7.4 ms. Our code implementation is available at https://github.com/FastLM/OLIVE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OLIVE（Online Low-rank Incremental Learning for Efficient Adaptive Exoskeletons），一种面向可穿戴外骨骼的参数高效在线自适应框架，在部署期间持续个性化控制策略。方法将控制策略的自适应部分分解为低秩残差 ΔW = A_t B_t^⊤，将在线更新复杂度从 O(dk) 降至 O(r(d+k))，并由纯机载传感器（EMG、IMU、振动）驱动的奖励整形策略梯度更新，无需离线参考轨迹。实验表明该方法在步态平滑度、努力程度降低和运动稳定性上分别比最强基线提升 13、22、15 个百分点，约 1800 步内收敛，端到端延迟 7.4 ms。
Motivation: 现有外骨骼控制器大多依赖静态步态策略，无法适应动态真实环境或个体用户特征，限制了康复与辅助效果的泛化。
Method: OLIVE 通过低秩残差形式更新控制器参数，结合基于机载传感器反馈的奖励整形策略梯度在线学习；引入上下文相关的门控机制调节个性化强度，并用动态秩调度器按地形复杂度调整更新维度。
Result: 摘要报告在可穿戴平台上，OLIVE 相较最强基线在步态平滑度、努力降低和运动稳定性上分别提升 13、22、15 个百分点，约 1800 个行走步内收敛，端到端延迟为 7.4 ms。
Conclusion: OLIVE 表明参数高效的在线低秩增量学习可在外骨骼部署期间持续自适应地形与个体差异，且无需离线参考轨迹；代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Minimax-Optimal Policy Regret in Partially Observable Markov Games
papers.abstract_en: We study sequential decision-making in partially observable environments against strategic, adaptive opponents, modeled as partially observable Markov games (POMGs). The central challenge is to learn latent dynamics from partial observations while facing an adversary whose behavior depends on the learner's strategy, making standard regret notions inadequate. We prove that an epoch-based optimistic maximum-likelihood algorithm achieves ${\tilde{O}}(\sqrt{T})$ policy regret for fixed problem parameters, with explicit dependence on the horizon, adversary memory, confidence radius, and the aggregate Eluder dimension of the observable-operator error classes. The algorithm deploys one policy per epoch, with geometrically capped epoch lengths, confidence sets built cumulatively from past data, and a statistical termination test that ends an epoch as soon as the data refute the deployed optimistic model. We also prove a matching lower bound, and extend the framework to horizon-adaptive guarantees and geometrically fading adversary memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究部分可观测马尔可夫博弈（POMG）中面对策略性自适应对手的序贯决策问题，提出一种基于回合（epoch）的乐观最大似然算法，并证明其达到 \tilde{O}(\sqrt{T}) 的策略遗憾（policy regret）上界。算法每回合部署单一策略、几何封顶回合长度、基于累计数据构建置信集，并用统计终止检验结束回合。作者还给出匹配的下界，并将框架推广到自适应视界与几何衰减的对手记忆。
Motivation: 在部分可观测环境中学习潜在动态本身困难，而对手行为又依赖学习者策略，传统遗憾定义不再适用；需要新的算法与遗憾分析框架来处理同时存在隐藏状态和自适应对手的博弈。
Method: 提出基于回合的乐观最大似然（optimistic maximum-likelihood）算法：每个回合部署一个策略，回合长度按几何级数封顶，置信集由历史数据累计构建，并以统计终止检验在数据否定当前乐观模型时立即结束回合；遗憾界显式依赖视界、对手记忆、置信半径及可观测算子误差类的聚合 Eluder 维数。
Result: 证明固定问题参数下策略遗憾为 \tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})，并给出匹配的 lower bound；同时将结果扩展到视界自适应保证和几何衰减的对手记忆情形。
Conclusion: 作者认为该算法在 POMG 中达到最小最大最优（minimax-optimal）的策略遗憾，且扩展版本能处理自适应视界与指数遗忘型对手记忆。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Memory by Design: Probabilistic Sequence Layers
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the design-model framework: a way to derive efficient recurrent sequence maps from explicit assumptions about memory. A design model writes evidence into memory by exact Bayesian filtering; a query-dependent readout produces a predictive distribution whose mean is the layer output. In our linear-Gaussian instantiation, the \emph{Bayesian Layer} propagates both a mean and a covariance: the covariance tracks uncertainty over stored associations, steering writes toward uncertain directions, attenuating gains as evidence accumulates, and preserving confident memories. The same framework unifies several sub-quadratic recurrences. Linear attention, GLA, and Mamba-2/SSD are exact filters under one design model, whereas DeltaNet and related Delta-rule models arise as covariance-reset reductions under another. Restoring the covariance yields closed-form predictions for retrieval dynamics, verified empirically, and improves robustness beyond the training regime across controlled collision studies, learned associative recall, and the Zoology MQAR benchmark; distilling Bayesian Layers into a pretrained 340M Gated DeltaNet improves RULER long-context retrieval at matched compute.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: From Activation to Specificity: Automating Counterfactual Testing of Visual Representations in the Human Brain
papers.abstract_en: Identifying which brain regions represent a visual concept in the human brain is a central challenge in neuroscience. Existing approaches have localized coarse functional regions (e.g., faces, places) through activation maximization, identifying regions that activate strongly for a target concept relative to other concepts. Yet strong activation alone does not establish that a region represents the concept itself, as responses may instead be driven by correlated visual or semantic cues. We introduce BrainTRACE (Testing Representations through Counterfactual Evidence), an automated framework that combines generative and brain models to synthesize controlled stimuli and validate neural representations through targeted counterfactual-specificity testing. Given a query specifying a concept of interest, our framework constructs targeted stimulus sets comprising concept images, counterfactual edits that remove the target concept while preserving other image content, and images with candidate correlated distractors. It then uses an image-to-fMRI encoding model to predict brain responses and searches for representations that respond specifically to the target concept over correlated alternatives. BrainTRACE returns validated candidate representations and proposes follow-up fMRI experiments to further test or extend its discoveries. Our approach successfully recovers known functional localizations and identifies new candidate representations across dozens of concepts, validated on both predicted and measured fMRI data. Critically, we show that without counterfactual evaluation, a large fraction of localizations would be false positives, confirming that activation alone is insufficient evidence of representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BrainTRACE（Testing Representations through Counterfactual Evidence），一个自动化框架，结合生成模型与脑模型合成受控刺激，通过反事实特异性测试验证人类大脑中的视觉表征。给定一个概念查询，框架构建包含概念图像、移除目标概念的反事实编辑图像以及候选相关干扰物的刺激集，再用图像到 fMRI 的编码模型预测脑响应，寻找对目标概念而非相关替代物特异响应的表征。该方法在预测与实测 fMRI 数据上恢复已知功能定位，并为数十个概念识别新候选表征，同时指出缺少反事实评估会导致大量假阳性定位。
Motivation: 现有方法通过激活最大化只定位粗略的功能区域，但强激活本身不能证明该区域真正表征该概念，因为响应可能由相关的视觉或语义线索驱动。因此需要系统性的反事实特异性测试来区分真实表征与假阳性。
Method: BrainTRACE 包含生成模型的受控刺激合成、图像到 fMRI 的编码模型响应预测、以及针对目标概念与相关干扰物的特异性搜索；它还能生成后续 fMRI 实验建议以进一步验证或扩展发现。
Result: 在预测和实测 fMRI 数据上，该方法成功恢复已知功能定位并发现多个新候选表征；关键结论是若省略反事实评估，很大比例的功能定位会是假阳性，说明激活单独不足以作为表征的证据。
Conclusion: 本文强调激活强度不能确立脑区对概念的表征，反事实特异性测试是必要的验证手段；该框架可在多种概念上自动化执行并提议实验验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: How to Build Marcus's Algebraic Mind: Algebro-Deterministic Substrate over Galois Fields
papers.abstract_en: In The Algebraic Mind (2001), Marcus held that any adequate cognitive architecture needs operations over variables, recursively structured representations, and an individual/kind distinction, and that multilayer perceptrons support none of them; he left a register-and-treelet implementation as a conjecture. Twenty-five years later a memory architecture built for unrelated reasons (speed, power and cost on commodity silicon) meets that specification operation for operation, through one mechanism rather than three. PyVaCoAl/VaCoAl is a hyperdimensional computing architecture built end-to-end on one primitive: XOR-and-shift over GF(2), realised by primitive-polynomial linear-feedback shift registers (LFSRs). It gives reversible binding Bind(R,F) = R xor shift(F), non-commutative bundling that distinguishes "dog bites man" from "man bites dog", and address-space individual/kind separation, at fixed dimension. Capability: exact reversible binding at O(L) cost supplies each pillar as an architectural primitive, not a product of training, with inspectability no lossy substrate offers. Necessity: weaken the primitive to an approximate inverse, as circular convolution does, and all three pillars degrade together -- what cannot be exactly decomposed was never composed, only mixed. Position: this is not the mind, the brain is not an LFSR, and we do not beat large language models; the substrate supplies the auditable symbolic layer they structurally lack. We develop the correspondence pillar by pillar, recast the treelet as a register set identified by a primitive generator polynomial, cite a companion Perspective on the dentate gyrus-CA3 circuit as a biological instance, and show that inflecting an unseen pseudoverb is a rung-3 query in Pearl's sense. Bit-exact reversibility holds in silicon and only approximately under biological noise; biological claims are structural only.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文回应Marcus在《代数心智》中关于认知架构需要变量操作、递归结构表示和个体/种类区分三个支柱的猜想，提出基于GF(2)上XOR-and-shift原语的超维计算架构PyVaCoAl/VaCoAl。该架构用原始多项式线性反馈移位寄存器（LFSR）实现精确可逆绑定、非交换捆绑和地址空间个体/种类分离，并以固定维度、O(L)成本提供这些能力。作者强调这并非心智模型，也不与大型语言模型竞争，而是提供后者结构上缺乏的可审计符号层。
Motivation: Marcus在2001年指出多层感知机无法支持变量操作、递归结构和个体/种类区分，并将寄存器-树苗（register-and-treelet）实现留作猜想。本文旨在表明一种为速度、功耗和成本而构建的记忆架构恰好逐操作满足该规范，且通过单一机制而非三个独立机制实现。
Method: 提出PyVaCoAl/VaCoAl超维计算架构，全部建筑在单一原语上：GF(2)上的XOR-and-shift，由原始多项式LFSR实现。它提供可逆绑定Bind(R,F)=R xor shift(F)、区分"dog bites man"与"man bites dog"的非交换捆绑，以及地址空间的个体/种类分离，并以树苗重铸为原始生成多项式标识的寄存器集。
Result: 摘要报告该架构在固定维度下实现O(L)成本的精确可逆绑定，并指出若将原语弱化为近似逆（如循环卷积），三个支柱会一起退化。此外，将未知伪动词变形解释为Pearl意义上的rung-3查询，并引用伴生论文将齿状回-CA3回路作为生物实例。
Conclusion: 作者明确该基质不是心智、大脑不是LFSR，且不声称超越大型语言模型；其价值在于提供可审计的符号层。位精确可逆性在硅上成立，生物噪声下仅近似成立，因此生物主张仅是结构性的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prompts Don't Protect: Architectural Enforcement via MCP Proxy for LLM Tool Access Control
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly operate as autonomous agents that select and invoke tools from large registries. We identify a critical gap: when unauthorized tools are visible in an agent's context, models select them in adversarial scenarios even when explicitly instructed otherwise. We evaluate three models (Qwen 2.5 7B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Claude Haiku 3.5) on 200 adversarial tasks across four attack categories. Under unfiltered conditions, unauthorized invocation rate (UIR) ranges from 48.5% to 68.5%. Explicit prompt-based allowlists reduce UIR, but leave model-dependent failure rates ranging from 4.0% to 37.0%. We propose a governed MCP proxy that enforces attribute-based access control at tool discovery and invocation time. By removing unauthorized tools before they enter the model context and independently checking calls at invocation, the governed condition achieves 0% UIR across all tested models and attack categories, with a measured median overhead of 1.72ms in our controlled environment. These results demonstrate the importance of architectural enforcement rather than relying on probabilistic prompt compliance for agentic tool access control.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 4 tables, 2 figures. Revised version with 200 adversarial tasks and expanded limitations
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出大语言模型作为智能体选择工具时存在一个关键安全漏洞：即使工具未经授权且被明确禁止，只要出现在模型上下文中，模型在对抗性场景下仍可能选择使用。作者在 200 个对抗任务、四类攻击场景下评估了 Qwen 2.5 7B、Llama 3.1 8B 和 Claude Haiku 3.5，并提出了一个受治理的 MCP 代理（governed MCP proxy），在工具发现和调用阶段强制执行基于属性的访问控制（attribute-based access control），从而彻底消除未经授权的工具调用，同时仅带来约 1.72ms 的中位开销。
Motivation: 现有依赖提示词（prompt）的允许列表无法可靠阻止智能体在对抗场景下调用未经授权的工具；一旦非法工具出现在上下文中，模型选择它的概率依然很高，说明需要架构层面的强制控制而非概率性的提示词合规。
Method: 提出一个受治理的 MCP 代理，在工具发现阶段将未授权工具从模型上下文中移除，并在调用阶段独立校验工具调用；该机制在模型上下文之外强制执行访问控制策略。
Result: 在无过滤条件下，未经授权调用率（UIR）为 48.5%–68.5%；显式基于提示词的允许列表可将 UIR 降至 4.0%–37.0% 的模型相关失败率；而受治理条件下所有模型和攻击类别的 UIR 均为 0%，受控环境中的中位额外延迟为 1.72ms。
Conclusion: 作者认为，智能体工具访问控制应以架构强制（architectural enforcement）为核心，而不是依赖提示词的可概率性合规，实测结果支持该主张在测试模型和攻击类别上的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Large language models reorganize representational geometry during in-context learning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable flexibility in adapting to novel tasks from in-context examples without parameter updates, a capability known as in-context learning (ICL). Prior work has sought to understand this capability by characterizing the algorithms underlying ICL or identifying the circuits that support it. Yet what determines whether a particular task can be effectively learned in context remains unresolved. We address this question by using the LLM's pretrained representation space itself to define the learning problem. We construct a controlled family of binary classification tasks in which labels are determined by linear partitions along different directions in this space. Although all tasks are linearly separable by construction, their in-context learnability varies systematically across directions. We find that successful ICL is accompanied by a geometric reorganization of internal representations that increases task-relevant separability. Causal interventions further show that amplifying activity along a fixed labeling axis is insufficient to induce this reorganization. At the behavioral level, LLM responses are best described by a prototype-like learner operating on representations that are themselves reorganized by context. Together, these findings offer a geometric account of ICL in pretrained LLMs, establish pretrained representational geometry as a constraint on ICL, and quantify the gap between what pretrained representations afford and what in-context learning can exploit.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型在上下文学习 (ICL) 中，预训练表示几何如何决定任务的可学习性。作者在预训练表示空间中沿不同方向构造线性可分的二分类任务族，发现任务的内在可学习性随方向系统性变化；成功的 ICL 伴随内部表征的几何重组，提高任务相关可分性，而沿固定标注轴放大活动不足以诱发该重组。行为上，模型响应更符合作用于上下文重组后表征的原型式学习器 (prototype-like learner)。
Motivation: 此前工作多从算法或电路层面解释 ICL，但决定特定任务能否在上下文中有效学习的因素仍不清楚；本文改用预训练表示空间本身来定义学习问题，以厘清表示几何对 ICL 的约束。
Method: 构建一个受控的二分类任务族，标签由表示空间中不同方向的线性划分决定；通过表征几何分析、因果干预以及行为建模比较，考察 ICL 过程中内部表征如何变化。
Result: 虽然所有任务按构造都线性可分，但 ICL 可学习性在不同方向上系统性变化；成功的 ICL 伴随内部表征几何重组并提升任务相关可分性；沿固定标注轴放大活动的因果干预不足以诱发这种重组，行为响应与原型式学习器最吻合。
Conclusion: 作者提出对预训练 LLM 中 ICL 的几何解释，将预训练表征几何确立为 ICL 的约束，并量化预训练表征所提供的能力与 ICL 实际可利用能力之间的差距。

papers.title: The Range Shrinks, the Threat Remains: Re-evaluating LLM Package Hallucinations on the 2026 Frontier-Model Cohort
papers.abstract_en: Spracklen et al. (USENIX Security '25) showed that code-generating large language models hallucinate package names that do not exist on PyPI or npm at rates ranging from 5.2% on commercial models to 21.7% on open-source models, creating an attack surface for slopsquatting -- the registration of malicious packages under hallucinated names. We replicate their methodology on five frontier code-capable LLMs released between October 2025 and March 2026: Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-5.4-mini, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and DeepSeek V3.2. Across 199,845 paired Python and JavaScript prompts validated against PyPI and npm master lists, we measure overall hallucination rates between 4.62% (Claude Haiku 4.5) and 6.10% (GPT-5.4-mini) -- an order-of-magnitude compression of the inter-model spread observed by Spracklen, but not a retirement of the threat. Beyond replication, we identify a set of 127 package names (109 on PyPI, 18 on npm) that all five evaluated models invent identically; following coordinated disclosure with PyPI Security and Socket.dev, 53 of these (41 on PyPI, 12 on npm) remain registrable by an attacker after each registry's existing defenses, constituting a model-agnostic supply-chain attack surface that no single-model study can reveal. We further document a Python-over-JavaScript hallucination asymmetry that inverts Spracklen's 2024 finding, identify a Haiku-below-Sonnet inversion within the Anthropic family, and observe a Jaccard-similarity peak between DeepSeek V3.2 and GPT-5.4-mini (J = 0.343) suggestive of shared training-data origins.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. v2: incorporates coordinated-disclosure feedback from PyPI Security and Socket.dev; registrable attack surface refined to 53 names (41 PyPI, 12 npm). Headline rates unchanged. Replication of Spracklen et al. (USENIX Security 2025). Data and code: https://github.com/churik5/slopsquatting-replication-2026 and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19859120
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 Spracklen et al. (USENIX Security 2025) 关于代码生成 LLM 包幻觉 (package hallucination) 研究的复现与扩展，考察 2025 年 10 月至 2026 年 3 月间五个前沿代码模型（Claude Sonnet 4.6、Claude Haiku 4.5、GPT-5.4-mini、Gemini 2.5 Pro、DeepSeek V3.2）。在 199,845 对 Python/JavaScript prompts 上，整体幻觉率介于 4.62%（Claude Haiku 4.5）与 6.10%（GPT-5.4-mini）之间，模型间差距相比原研究压缩约一个数量级，但威胁并未消失。作者进一步发现 127 个所有五个模型都会一致虚构的包名，经与 PyPI Security 和 Socket.dev 协调披露后仍有 53 个可被注册。
Motivation: 先前研究已证明代码生成 LLM 会幻觉出不存在的包名，形成 slopsquatting 攻击面，但该结论基于 2024 年的模型。随着新一代前沿模型发布，需要重新评估幻觉率是否下降、跨模型一致性幻觉是否构成新的模型无关供应链攻击面。
Method: 采用 Spracklen 等人的方法论，对五个 2025-2026 年发布的模型在 199,845 对 Python/JavaScript 提示上复现，并对照 PyPI 与 npm 官方包名列表验证。在此基础上，额外分析所有模型共同虚构的包名集合，并联合 PyPI Security 与 Socket.dev 进行协调披露 (coordinated disclosure)，确认剩余可注册的恶意包名攻击面。
Result: 整体幻觉率为 4.62%–6.10%，模型间差距较 Spracklen 原始结果大幅压缩；发现 127 个五个模型一致虚构的包名（109 个 PyPI、18 个 npm），披露后仍有 53 个（41 个 PyPI、12 个 npm）可被攻击者注册。还观察到 Python 幻觉率超过 JavaScript 的不对称性（与 2024 年发现相反）、Anthropic 家族内 Haiku 低于 Sonnet 的反转，以及 DeepSeek V3.2 与 GPT-5.4-mini 的 Jaccard 相似度峰值（J = 0.343），暗示共享训练数据来源。
Conclusion: 尽管新一代模型的幻觉率整体下降且模型间差异收窄，包幻觉威胁依然存在；跨模型一致幻想的包名构成单个模型研究无法揭示的模型无关供应链攻击面。作者强调协调披露与注册防御可收缩可攻击范围，但该攻击面并未被消除。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ArtifactLinker: Linking Scientific Artifacts for Automatic State-of-the-Art Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Scientific artifacts such as models and datasets are foundations for research. With the rapid growth of platforms like HuggingFace, researchers now have access to a large number of artifacts. Yet, a key challenge remains: how can we automatically discover the state-of-the-art (SOTA) model for a given dataset by fully leveraging existing artifacts? We formalize this task as automatic SOTA discovery by modeling HuggingFace as an artifact graph, where nodes are models/datasets and edges represent evaluations. We propose ArtifactLinker, a two-stage framework: (1) ranking promising unobserved model--dataset links using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) or graph-augmented Large Language Models (LLMs), and (2) verifying top-ranked links via coding experiments with LLM-based agents. We further introduce a benchmark named ArtifactBench with 14,053 artifacts and 51,337 relations to evaluate the performance of both stages. Results show that (1) graph structures between existing artifacts are effective for missing link prediction; (2) end-to-end ranking and verification with ArtifactLinker help discover potential SOTA results and research insights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ArtifactLinker，把 HuggingFace 建模为工件图（artifacts graph），节点是模型与数据集、边代表评测关系，从而形式化“给定数据集自动发现 SOTA 模型”的任务。方法采用两阶段框架：先用 GNN 或图增强的 LLM 对未观测的模型—数据集链接排序，再用基于 LLM 的 agent 通过编码实验验证排名靠前的链接。作者还引入含 14,053 个工件和 51,337 条关系的 ArtifactBench 基准来评估两个阶段的性能。
Motivation: HuggingFace 等平台上的模型和数据集快速增长，但如何充分利用现有工件自动发现某个数据集上的 SOTA 模型仍然是一个关键挑战。
Method: 提出 ArtifactLinker，包含两阶段：第一阶段利用 Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) 或图增强的大型语言模型 (LLMs) 对未观测的 model–dataset 链接进行排序；第二阶段用 LLM-based agents 编写代码实验来验证排名靠前的链接。
Result: 实验表明（1）现有工件之间的图结构对缺失链接预测（missing link prediction）有效；（2）ArtifactLinker 的端到端排序与验证能够帮助发现潜在的 SOTA 结果和研究见解。
Conclusion: 作者认为将公开平台上的工件建模为图结构可用于自动 SOTA 发现，并提供了 ArtifactBench 基准以供后续评估。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HEART: Exploiting Head Heterogeneity in Sparse Attention for Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Sparse attention accelerates video diffusion by allowing each attention head to focus on only a small subset of interactions. Existing methods already construct head-specific sparse patterns conditioned on the input. However, we find that these heads also differ in two less obvious but practically important ways. First, for some heads, sparse attention masks remain stable across many denoising steps, whereas others change rapidly. Second, heads differ substantially in their sensitivity to sparsification: applying the same threshold can induce markedly different errors in the final denoising velocity. Ignoring these differences leads to redundant mask prediction and suboptimal threshold calibration across heads under a global sparsity budget. We present HEART, short for Heterogeneity-Exploiting Adaptive Refresh and Thresholding, a training-free framework that exploits both forms of head heterogeneity. First, Temporal Mask Reuse (TMR) uses a lightweight per-head query-key drift signal to determine whether a cached sparse mask remains reliable across denoising steps, refreshing it only when the drift exceeds a prescribed threshold. Second, Error-guided Budgeted Calibration (EBC) evaluates candidate thresholds offline using a frequency-weighted denoising-velocity error, and assigns each head an appropriate threshold under a global sparsity budget. HEART requires no retraining, weight modification, or sparse-kernel changes, and can be integrated directly into existing sparse-attention pipelines. Across Wan2.1-1.3B, Wan2.1-14B, and HunyuanVideo-13B, HEART consistently pushes the quality--efficiency frontier of advanced sparse attention methods such as XAttention and SVG2 outward.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HEART，一个无需训练的框架，用于在视频扩散模型的稀疏注意力中利用注意力头之间的两种异质性：掩码在去噪步之间的稳定性差异，以及各头对稀疏化的误差敏感度差异。HEART 包含时间掩码重用 (Temporal Mask Reuse, TMR) 和误差引导的预算校准 (Error-guided Budgeted Calibration, EBC) 两个组件，可直接集成到现有稀疏注意力管线中，并在 Wan2.1-1.3B、Wan2.1-14B 和 HunyuanVideo-13B 上提升 XAttention、SVG2 等方法的质量-效率前沿。
Motivation: 现有稀疏注意力方法虽已为每个注意力头构造输入相关的稀疏模式，但忽略了头之间在掩码时间稳定性和对稀疏化敏感度上的差异，导致掩码预测冗余且全局稀疏预算下的阈值校准次优。
Method: TMR 使用轻量级的逐头 query-key 漂移信号判断缓存的稀疏掩码在去噪步间是否仍可靠，仅在漂移超过阈值时刷新；EBC 在离线阶段用频率加权的去噪速度误差评估候选阈值，并在全局稀疏预算下为每个头分配适当阈值。整个框架无需重训练、权重修改或稀疏内核改动。
Result: 在 Wan2.1-1.3B、Wan2.1-14B 和 HunyuanVideo-13B 上，HEART 一致地推动 XAttention 和 SVG2 等高级稀疏注意力方法的质量-效率前沿向外扩展。
Conclusion: 作者强调利用注意力头的两种异质性可以在不改变模型权重或内核的情况下进一步提升现有稀疏注意力视频扩散方法的效率与质量。
