papers.title: Early Data Exposure Improves Robustness to Subsequent Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: How can we train models whose post-trained capabilities survive subsequent fine-tuning? Rather than focusing on downstream interventions to mitigate forgetting of upstream capabilities, we study how upstream training choices - that is, the manner in which a capability is acquired - shape how robustly that capability is retained. We investigate this question in a controlled three-stage language-model pipeline: pretraining, post-training to acquire a target capability, and downstream fine-tuning on a new objective. Across 135M and 1B models, two post-training domains, and two downstream fine-tuning tasks, we find that immediate post-training performance does not reliably predict retention after subsequent fine-tuning: training recipes that look equivalent immediately after post-training can retain the target capability very differently after subsequent fine-tuning. In particular, early exposure - mixing post-training data into pretraining - consistently improves the frontier between retained upstream performance and downstream performance. In compute-matched experiments, where the target data must be allocated between pretraining and post-training, we find that the optimum lies at neither extreme. Together with our other empirical and theoretical findings, this supports the view that post-training drives immediate specialization while early exposure improves robustness to later forgetting. Replay and dropout, typically used to mitigate forgetting as it occurs during fine-tuning, provide complementary gains to early exposure when applied during post-training. Our findings suggest that robustness to subsequent fine-tuning should be treated as a first-class objective of upstream training, addressed preventatively through choices like early exposure rather than reactively during fine-tuning itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型在后续微调中如何保留已习得能力，提出"早期暴露"(early exposure)这一上游训练策略。作者在 135M 和 1B 规模的模型、两类后训练域和两类下游微调任务上，发现后训练后的即时性能不能可靠预测后续微调后的保留程度，而将后训练数据提前混入预训练可以一致地改善保留性能与下游性能之间的权衡边界。
Motivation: 现有的抗遗忘研究多聚焦于微调阶段的下游干预，而本文关注上游训练方式本身如何影响能力被保留的鲁棒性，即能力习得方式对后续遗忘的影响。
Method: 使用预训练、后训练获取目标能力、下游新目标微调的三阶段语言模型管线，进行受控实验，并通过计算匹配实验将目标数据在预训练和后训练之间进行分配，还比较了后训练阶段使用回放(replay)和dropout等策略的效果。
Result: 摘要报告在多个设置下，即时后训练性能不能可靠预测后续保留能力；早期暴露一致改善了保留上游性能与下游性能之间的前沿；计算匹配实验中最优分配既不在全预训练也不在全后训练的极端，且回放和dropout可提供互补增益。
Conclusion: 作者主张应将"对后续微调的鲁棒性"作为上游训练的一等目标，通过早期暴露等预防性选择来应对，而不是等到微调阶段再被动缓解遗忘。

papers.title: C2L-Net: A Data-Driven Model for State-of-Charge Estimation of Lithium-Ion Batteries During Discharge
papers.abstract_en: Accurate state-of-charge (SOC) estimation is critical for the safe and efficient operation of lithium-ion batteries in battery management systems (BMS). Although data-driven approaches can effectively capture nonlinear battery dynamics, many existing methods rely on long historical input sequences, resulting in high computational cost and introducing padding-induced positional bias at the beginning of drive cycles. To address these limitations, we propose C2L-Net, a novel context-to-latest data-driven framework for realistic online SOC estimation using only a short historical window (20 s). Unlike existing short-receptive-field or long-history models, the proposed framework explicitly separates contextual encoding from latest-measurement updating, enabling both efficient temporal modeling and rapid adaptation to dynamic battery states. The proposed model incorporates a chunk-based feature extraction mechanism that combines Theta Attention Pooling with a Fourier-based Seasonality Basis to capture local temporal patterns while reducing sequence length. A causal context encoder, integrating a gated recurrent unit (GRU) with Causal Cosine Attention, models temporal dependencies without information leakage. Furthermore, a latest-measurement decoder, inspired by recursive filtering, updates the contextual state using the most recent measurement, enhancing responsiveness to dynamic operating conditions. Extensive experiments on a public lithium-ion battery drive-cycle dataset under multiple fixed-temperature conditions demonstrate that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art or competitive accuracy while significantly improving computational efficiency. In particular, C2L-Net achieves up to 60 times faster inference and requires fewer parameters than recent data-driven baselines, while maintaining robust performance across unseen driving profiles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 C2L-Net，一种用于锂电池放电过程荷电状态（SOC）估计的数据驱动框架，仅使用 20 秒的短历史窗口进行在线估计。该框架显式分离上下文编码与最新测量更新，结合基于块的提取机制（Theta Attention Pooling + Fourier 季节基）、因果上下文编码器（GRU + Causal Cosine Attention）以及受递归滤波启发的最新测量解码器。在公共锂电池驾驶循环数据集上的实验表明，C2L-Net 达到 SOTA 或竞争性精度，同时推理速度比近期数据驱动基线快最多 60 倍且参数更少。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动 SOC 估计方法常依赖长历史输入序列，导致高计算成本，并在驾驶循环开始时引入由 padding 造成的位置偏差；而短感受野模型难以充分捕捉时间依赖。作者希望仅用短历史窗口实现高效的在线 SOC 估计，同时保持对动态电池状态的快速适应能力。
Method: C2L-Net 采用 context-to-latest 框架，将上下文编码与最新测量更新显式解耦。模型包含基于块的提取机制，用 Theta Attention Pooling 与 Fourier 基的 Seasonality Basis 提取局部时序模式并缩短序列长度；因果上下文编码器用 GRU 结合 Causal Cosine Attention 建模时间依赖，避免信息泄漏；最新测量解码器受递归滤波启发，用最近测量更新上下文状态以增强对动态工况的响应。
Result: 在公共锂电池驾驶循环数据集、多个固定温度条件下，该方法达到 SOTA 或竞争性精度，同时比近期数据驱动基线实现最多 60 倍更快的推理速度，并减少参数量，在未见驾驶剖面上保持稳健性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将上下文编码与最新测量更新分离可在短历史窗口下兼顾高效时序建模和快速动态适应，为在线 SOC 估计提供了计算高效的方案。摘要未提及明显局限性。

papers.title: Aggregation in conformal e-classification
papers.abstract_en: Aggregating conformal predictors is a standard way of balancing their predictive and computational efficiency while retaining their validity, at least approximately. An important advantage of conformal e-predictors is that they are easier to aggregate without sacrificing their validity. This paper studies experimentally cross-conformal e-prediction, which is an existing method of aggregating conformal e-predictors, and its modifications that are conceptually simpler and more flexible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分类设定下 conformal e-predictor 的聚合问题，重点考察已有的 cross-conformal e-prediction 方法以及概念上更简单、更灵活的修改版本。摘要指出，聚合保形预测器是在（至少近似地）保持有效性的同时平衡预测效率与计算效率的标准手段，而 conformal e-predictor 的主要优势是在聚合时更容易不牺牲有效性。作者通过实验比较这些聚合方法，但摘要本身未给出具体数值结果。
Motivation: 多个保形预测器聚合时通常只能近似保持有效性，而 conformal e-predictor 理论上可以在聚合中保持有效性；论文希望验证既有的 cross-conformal e-prediction 及其简化变体在分类问题上的实际表现。
Method: 采用 cross-conformal e-prediction 这一已有聚合方法，并引入概念上更简单、更灵活的修改版本；研究以实验方式展开，聚焦于 conformal e-classification 下的预测器聚合。
Result: 摘要是方法性陈述，未报告具体数据集、基线或数值结果；仅说明该研究为实验研究，比较了 cross-conformal e-prediction 与其修改版本。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 conformal e-predictor 在聚合时保持有效性的优势，并表明所研究的修改版本在概念上更简单、更灵活；具体结论需见实验部分，摘要未展开。

papers.title: UniPCB: A Generation-Assisted Vision-Based Measurement Framework for PCB Defect Inspection
papers.abstract_en: Automated optical inspection (AOI) is a vision-based instrumentation process that detects and localizes physical defects on printed circuit boards (PCBs) from optically acquired images. Its reliability is often limited by scarce and class-imbalanced defect observations and by insufficient representation of small, low-contrast defects against dense circuit patterns. We propose UniPCB, a generation-assisted PCB inspection framework that combines controlled defect synthesis with task-specific detection. The generation branch derives heterogeneous edge, relative pseudo-depth, and text conditions from PCB images. A ScaleEncoder embeds the conditions at four U-Net resolutions, while a Condition Modulation block performs FiLM-style spatially adaptive fusion. The detection branch introduces an Inverted Residual Shift Attention block for joint global-local modeling and a Cross-level Complementary Fusion block for selective hierarchical feature integration. The generated images augment the detector training data and improve defect coverage without changing the online inspection path. Experiments using the corrected annotations of DsPCBSD+ yield an mAP@0.5 of 98.0% and an mAP@0.5:0.95 of 61.8%. Under the same generation-augmented training setting, these values exceed those of the RT-DETR baseline by 2.1 and 1.7 percentage points, respectively. The generation branch obtains an FID of 129.61 and an SSIM of 0.619. These results indicate the potential of structured synthetic data and PCB-oriented feature modeling for improving vision-based defect inspection. Code is available at https://github.com/House-yuyu/UniPCB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniPCB，一个生成辅助的 PCB 缺陷检测框架，结合受控缺陷合成与任务特定检测。生成分支从 PCB 图像提取边缘、相对伪深度和文本条件，通过 ScaleEncoder 与 FiLM 式条件调制合成缺陷样本；检测分支引入 Inverted Residual Shift Attention 和 Cross-level Complementary Fusion 进行特征建模。在修正标注的 DsPCBSD+ 数据集上，mAP@0.5 达 98.0%，mAP@0.5:0.95 达 61.8%，均超过 RT-DETR 基线，且不改变在线检测路径。
Motivation: 基于视觉的 PCB 自动光学检测 (AOI) 常受限于稀少且类别不平衡的缺陷观测，以及小尺寸、低对比度缺陷在密集电路图案中表示不足，导致可靠性受限。
Method: 提出 UniPCB 框架，包括生成分支与检测分支。生成分支利用 ScaleEncoder 在四个 U-Net 分辨率上嵌入来自 PCB 图像的异构条件（边缘、相对伪深度、文本），并由 Condition Modulation 块进行 FiLM 风格的空间自适应融合；检测分支引入 Inverted Residual Shift Attention 块实现全局-局部联合建模，以及 Cross-level Complementary Fusion 块进行选择性层级特征集成。生成图像用于扩充检测器训练数据，在线检测流程保持不变。
Result: 在修正标注的 DsPCBSD+ 数据集上，UniPCB 获得 mAP@0.5 98.0% 和 mAP@0.5:0.95 61.8%，在相同生成增强训练设置下比 RT-DETR 基线分别高 2.1 和 1.7 个百分点；生成分支的 FID 为 129.61，SSIM 为 0.619。
Conclusion: 摘要认为结构化合成数据与面向 PCB 的特征建模有望改善基于视觉的缺陷检测，并开源了代码。

papers.title: FitText: Evolving Agent Tool Ecologies via Memetic Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Efficient reasoning is not only a matter of shortening an answer trace; for tool-using agents, it also depends on whether the agent is reasoning over the right action space. As API ecosystems scale to tens of thousands of endpoints, the semantic gap between user requests and tool documentation makes this problem concrete: static retrieval from the initial query can fail before planning begins, and stronger planning alone cannot recover a missing tool. We study this problem as budgeted test-time retrieval and introduce FitText, a training-free framework that makes the tool interface revisable during execution by generating, refining, and evolving natural-language pseudo-tool descriptions as retrieval probes. FitText supports serial refinement, parallel exploration, and Memetic Retrieval, which adds evolutionary selection, local refinement, and tool memory to avoid redundant search. On StableToolBench (16,464 APIs), Memetic FitText reaches an 84.3% pooled pass rate, improving +26.7 points over static retrieval, +22.2 over Single-Pass, +23.2 over Re-Invoke, and +27.5 over Xu-style root refinement. It leads on every evaluated current model, with gains growing alongside model capability, and produces the largest improvements on ambiguous multi-tool tasks where dynamic re-retrieval restores correct candidates after early mistakes. At 40-way concurrency, parallel population execution keeps batched wall-clock at 1.01x Single-Pass despite the added search work.
papers.comment: 30 pages, including appendices. Accepted at COLM 2026 (main conference) and the COLM 2026 Workshop on Efficient Reasoning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工具型智能体在超大规模 API 生态下的工具检索问题，提出 FitText，一个无需训练的框架，在推理执行过程中通过生成、精炼和演化自然语言的伪工具描述 (pseudo-tool descriptions) 来作为动态检索探针，从而把工具接口变成可修订的。在 StableToolBench (16,464 个 API) 上，Memetic FitText 达到 84.3% 的 pooled pass rate，比静态检索高 26.7 个百分点。
Motivation: 高效推理不仅取决于缩短回答轨迹，还取决于智能体是否在正确的动作空间上推理；当 API 生态扩展到数万个端点时，用户请求与工具文档之间的语义鸿沟会导致从初始查询做静态检索在规划开始前就失败，而更强的规划能力无法找回缺失的工具。
Method: 将问题建模为预算受限的测试时检索 (budgeted test-time retrieval)，提出 FitText 框架，支持串行精炼、并行探索以及 Memetic Retrieval，后者引入进化选择、局部精炼和工具记忆以避免冗余搜索。
Result: 在 StableToolBench 上，Memetic FitText 的 pooled pass rate 达到 84.3%，较静态检索提升 +26.7、较 Single-Pass 提升 +22.2、较 Re-Invoke 提升 +23.2、较 Xu 风格根精炼提升 +27.5；在所有被测当前模型上均领先，且在 40 路并发下，并行种群执行的批处理墙钟时间仅为 Single-Pass 的 1.01 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调收益随模型能力增强而扩大，并在模糊的多工具任务上改进最大，因为动态重新检索能在早期错误后恢复正确候选；这表明工具接口的可修订性是提升工具型智能体推理效率的关键维度。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在 StableToolBench 上，Memetic FitText 的 pooled pass rate 达到 84.3%，较静态检索提升 +26.7、较 Single-Pass 提升 +22.2、较 Re-Invoke 提升 +23.2、较 Xu 风格根精炼提升 +27.5；在所有被测当前模型上均领先，且在 40 路并发下，并行种群执行的批处理墙钟时间仅为 Single-Pass 的 1.01 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调收益随模型能力增强而扩大，并在模糊的多工具任务上改进最大，因为动态重新检索能在早期错误后恢复正确候选；这表明工具接口的可修订性是提升工具型智能体推理效率的关键维度。

papers.title: Statistically-Lossless Quantization of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Model quantization has become essential for efficient large language model deployment, yet existing approaches present clear trade-offs: methods such as GPTQ and AWQ achieve practical compression but are lossy, while lossless techniques preserve fidelity but lack inference acceleration. This paper explores the middle ground of statistically-lossless compression, examining three complementary aspects of what losslessness means for quantized LLMs. First, task-lossless compression preserves zero-shot benchmark accuracy within natural sampling variance and is achievable at aggressive bitwidths. Second, we formalize the stricter notion of distribution-lossless compression, requiring the quantized model's next-token distribution to be practically indistinguishable from the original, and propose the Expected Acceptance Rate (EAR), the maximum token-agreement probability under optimal coupling, as a directly interpretable fidelity metric. For example, EAR >= 0.99 means 99% agreement. Third, we prove a gamma-squared variance law showing that symmetric quantization inflates noise variance by gamma^2 relative to asymmetric quantization, making asymmetric quantization a prerequisite for distribution-lossless fidelity but not for task-level preservation. Through SLQ, a layer-wise non-uniform method with asymmetric quantization and wide bitwidth search, we obtain task-lossless compression at well below 4 bits per parameter, as low as 3.3 bits depending on the model, distribution-lossless compression at 5-6 bits per parameter on average, and inference speedups of 1.7-3.7x compared to FP16 using optimized kernels. Source code is available at [https://github.com/IST-DASLab/SLQ](https://github.com/IST-DASLab/SLQ).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型量化中“有损”与“无损”之间的中间地带，提出统计无损压缩的概念，区分任务无损（task-lossless）与分布无损（distribution-lossless）。作者形式化了分布无损条件，提出可解释的保真度指标 Expected Acceptance Rate (EAR)，并证明对称量化会使噪声方差放大 gamma^2 倍，从而非对称量化是分布无损的前提。基于这些理论，作者提出逐层非均匀量化方法 SLQ，在低于 4 bits（最低约 3.3 bits）下实现任务无损，在 5-6 bits 下实现分布无损，并相对 FP16 获得 1.7-3.7 倍推理加速。
Motivation: 现有量化方法存在明显权衡：GPTQ、AWQ 等实用压缩方案是有损的，而完全无损方法保留保真度但无法带来推理加速。论文希望填补这一空白，探索既能保持较高保真度又能加速推理的统计无损压缩。
Method: 首先形式化任务无损与分布无损两种量化保真度概念，提出 Expected Acceptance Rate (EAR) 作为可直接解释的分布保真度指标；其次证明 gamma-squared 方差定律，说明对称量化相对非对称量化将噪声方差放大 gamma^2 倍。随后提出 SLQ，一种采用非对称量化和宽位宽搜索的逐层非均匀量化方法。
Result: SLQ 在不同模型上以低至 3.3 bits/参数的平均位宽实现任务无损压缩，在平均 5-6 bits/参数下实现分布无损；使用优化内核相对 FP16 获得 1.7-3.7 倍推理加速。
Conclusion: 非对称量化是实现分布无损保真度的必要条件，但对任务级保真度并非必需；统计无损量化能够在低比特压缩与推理加速之间取得可行折中。摘要还提供了开源代码链接。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Stable GFlowNets with TV Monitoring and Probabilistic Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) sample diverse structured objects in proportion to reward and have been applied to molecular discovery and biological-sequence design, where finding multiple high-quality candidates is more useful than returning a single optimum. Despite their theoretical promise, practical training is often unstable, exhibiting severe loss spikes and mode collapse. To address this, we first assess the sensitivity of GFlowNet objectives, demonstrating that a small Total Variation (TV) distance between the learned and target distributions does not preclude an unbounded training loss. Motivated by this mismatch, we establish converse guarantees by deriving loss-to-TV bounds that certify global fidelity from bounded trajectory balance losses. Lastly, we propose Stable GFlowNets, which leverages our theory to stabilize training via adaptive reference flow and improves the trade-off among mode coverage, robustness, and certifiability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成流网络 (GFlowNets) 训练不稳定、损失尖峰和模式崩溃的问题，先证明学习分布与目标分布之间的总变差距离 (TV distance) 较小并不排除无界训练损失，再推导出 loss-to-TV 界，从有界轨迹平衡损失 (trajectory balance loss) 推出全局保真度。作者据此提出 Stable GFlowNets，通过自适应参考流 (adaptive reference flow) 稳定训练，并改善模式覆盖、鲁棒性与可认证性之间的权衡。
Motivation: GFlowNets 理论上能按奖励比例采样多样化的结构化对象，在分子发现和生物序列设计中有价值，但实际训练常不稳定，出现严重损失尖峰和模式崩溃，且现有目标对分布保真度的理论保证不足。
Method: 首先评估 GFlowNet 目标对 TV 距离的敏感性，证明小的 TV 距离不能保证训练损失有界；接着推导 loss-to-TV 界，用有界轨迹平衡损失为全局分布保真度提供证书；最后提出 Stable GFlowNets，利用该理论通过自适应参考流来稳定训练。
Result: 摘要未给出定量实验数值，主要结果是理论性的 loss-to-TV 界，以及声称能改进模式覆盖、鲁棒性和可认证性之间权衡的稳定训练算法。
Conclusion: 作者强调基于理论指导的 Stable GFlowNets 可以稳定训练，并在模式覆盖、鲁棒性和可认证性之间实现更好的权衡。

papers.title: Uncertainty in a Single Pass: A Closed-Form Identity for One-Step Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching provides a highly effective framework for generative modeling, yet estimating the uncertainty of its generated samples remains a fundamental challenge. Existing methods rely on auxiliary variance heads, model ensembles, or iterative covariance propagation, which invariably introduce accumulated errors and structural interference along the noise-to-image trajectory. We resolve these limitations by adapting Tweedie's formula to the linear flow matching interpolant, yielding an exact, closed-form identity for the posterior covariance. Because this identity relies exclusively on the divergence of the learned velocity field, it can be evaluated post hoc on pretrained models without any architectural modifications. This analytical formulation proves exceptionally powerful for single-step generative frameworks. By computing the end-to-end posterior covariance in one forward pass, our approach completely bypasses the compounding errors inherent to sequential integration. This mechanism fundamentally enhances robustness, providing highly accurate and stable uncertainty estimates while preventing the numerical degradation typical of multi-step approximations. We validate our framework across benchmark datasets, including CIFAR-10 and real brain MRI scans. The resulting divergence-based uncertainty maps are highly interpretable and tightly correlated with empirical reconstruction errors. Crucially, in medical imaging, this precise localization of structural ambiguity provides essential decision support for high-stakes clinical tasks such as tumor boundary delineation and neurosurgical planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 flow matching 生成模型中的样本不确定性估计问题，将 Tweedie 公式适配到线性 flow matching 插值器，推导出后验协方差的精确闭式恒等式。该恒等式仅依赖学习到的速度场的散度，可在预训练模型上事后计算，无需修改架构，尤其适合单步生成框架，只需一次前向传播即可得到端到端后验协方差，从而绕过逐步积分带来的累积误差。作者在 CIFAR-10 和真实脑部 MRI 扫描上验证，基于散度的不确定性图与经验重建误差高度相关，并可为肿瘤边界勾画和神经外科规划提供决策支持。
Motivation: 现有生成样本不确定性估计依赖辅助方差头、模型集成或迭代协方差传播，这些方法沿噪声到图像的轨迹会引入累积误差和结构干扰；论文旨在消除这类 limitations，给出无需架构修改的精确估计方式。
Method: 将 Tweedie 公式适配到线性 flow matching 插值器，得到后验协方差的精确闭式恒等式；该恒等式仅依赖学习速度场的散度，可在预训练模型上事后计算，并以单次前向传播完成端到端后验协方差求取。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 和真实脑部 MRI 数据集上的验证显示，该散度驱动的生成不确定性估计高度可解释，且与经验重建误差紧密相关，同时避免多步近似中的数值退化。
Conclusion: 该方法为单步生成框架提供了稳定且准确的不确定性估计，并在医学影像中实现结构模糊性的精确定位，有助于肿瘤边界勾画与神经外科规划等高风险临床决策。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Themis: Training Robust Multilingual Code Reward Models for Flexible Multi-Criteria Scoring
papers.abstract_en: Reward models (RMs) have become an indispensable fixture of the language model (LM) post-training playbook, enabling policy alignment and test-time scaling. Research on the application of RMs in code generation, however, has been comparatively sparse, with existing work largely focusing on execution feedback. This choice constrains post-training to optimizing functional correctness over self-contained executable code. In this work, we examine the training and evaluation of multilingual, multi-criteria code RMs. To this end, we first compile Themis-CodeRewardBench, a benchmark to evaluate code RMs across five preference dimensions (i.e., criteria) and eight programming languages, on which we profile 50+ code, math, and general-purpose RMs. Observing the limited proficiency of current RMs beyond scoring for functional correctness, we develop Themis-CodePreference, the largest open-source collection of code preferences to date (more than 350k preference pairs), and use it to train Themis-RM, a suite of multilingual code reward models for flexible multi-criteria scoring, ranging in size from 600M to 32B parameters. Our experiments and ablations demonstrate positive scaling trends, strong cross-lingual transfer when training on diverse preferences, and the importance of multi-criteria training for reliable code reward modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多语言、多准则的代码奖励模型 (reward model, RM) 的训练与评测。作者构建了评测基准 Themis-CodeRewardBench（覆盖五个偏好维度和八种编程语言），评测了 50 多个现有 RM，发现它们在功能性正确性之外的评分能力有限；随后发布 Themis-CodePreference（超过 35 万偏好对）并训练出 600M 到 32B 参数的 Themis-RM 系列模型，实验显示正向的规模扩展趋势、跨语言迁移能力以及多准则训练的重要性。
Motivation: 现有代码生成中的 RM 研究相对稀疏，且大多依赖执行反馈，这使后训练只能优化自包含可执行代码的功能正确性，难以支持灵活的多准则评分。
Method: 先构建 Themis-CodeRewardBench，在五个偏好维度和八种编程语言上评测 50 多个代码、数学和通用 RM；再收集 Themis-CodePreference，构建目前最大的开源代码偏好数据集，并训练 Themis-RM 系列多语言代码奖励模型（参数规模 600M 至 32B）。
Result: 评测显示当前 RM 在功能正确性之外的准则上能力有限；Themis-RM 的训练与消融实验表现出正向规模趋势、在多样化偏好上训练带来的强跨语言迁移，以及多准则训练对可靠代码奖励建模的重要性。
Conclusion: 作者强调，多样化的偏好数据与多准则训练是可靠代码奖励建模的关键，且模型规模扩展有助于提升效果。

papers.title: Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Regret Optimization for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) is a central post-training tool for aligning large language models, but its training reward is only a learned proxy for true human utility. This creates a decision problem under objective misspecification: the policy is optimized against an estimated reward, while deployment performance is governed by an unobserved population preference. The resulting gap leads to reward over-optimization, where proxy reward keeps improving after true quality deteriorates. We propose distributionally robust regret optimization (DRRO) for RLHF with a Wasserstein ambiguity set over reward laws, using promptwise $\ell_p$ distances between reward vectors as transport costs. Unlike standard distributionally robust optimization, which pessimizes worst-case value, DRRO pessimizes worst-case regret relative to the best policy under the same plausible reward perturbation. We show that the expressive-policy problem decomposes into promptwise regret problems. For each prompt, the inner adversary has a dual-norm closed form; under the $\ell_1$ transport cost used by our algorithm, the optimizer has a water-filling structure. These results lead to a practical policy-gradient algorithm that adds a simple sampled bonus to GRPO-style training. Theory and experiments both show that DRRO is less over-pessimistic than standard DRO and mitigates over-optimization more effectively than existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用于 RLHF 的分布鲁棒后悔优化（DRRO），用定义在奖励定律上的 Wasserstein 模糊集刻画代理奖励与真实人类效用的偏差，并以 promptwise l_p 距离作为传输代价。与标准分布鲁棒优化（DRO）悲观化最坏情况价值不同，DRRO 悲观化同一扰动下相对最优策略的后悔。作者证明表达性策略问题可分解为逐 prompt 的后悔问题，内层对抗具有对偶范数闭式解，且在 l_1 传输代价下优化器具有 water-filling 结构。理论与实验表明 DRRO 比标准 DRO 更少过度悲观，并比现有基线更有效地缓解过优化。
Motivation: RLHF 的训练奖励只是真实人类效用的学习代理，存在目标误设（objective misspecification），导致奖励过优化（reward over-optimization）：代理奖励持续上升而真实质量下降。这需要一个针对奖励定律不确定性的鲁棒决策框架。
Method: 提出 Wasserstein 分布鲁棒后悔优化（DRRO），模糊集定义在奖励定律上，传输代价采用 promptwise l_p 距离。DRRO 最小化最坏情况后悔而非最坏情况价值；作者证明该问题可分解为逐 prompt 的子问题，内层对抗有对偶范数闭式解，算法层面给出一个添加采样 bonus 的 GRPO 风格策略梯度方法。
Result: 理论上得到问题分解、对偶闭式解以及 l_1 传输代价下的 water-filling 结构；实验显示 DRRO 相比标准 DRO 更少过度悲观，并能比现有基线更有效地缓解奖励过优化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在 RLHF 的奖励误设下，通过悲观化后悔而非价值，可以在避免标准 DRO 过度保守的同时缓解过优化现象。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Path-Lock Expert: Separating Reasoning Mode in Hybrid Thinking via Architecture-Level Separation
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid-thinking language models expose explicit /think and /no_think modes, but current designs do not separate them cleanly. Even in /no_think mode, models often emit long and self-reflective responses, causing reasoning leakage. Existing work reduces this issue through better data curation and multi-stage training, yet leakage remains because both modes are still encoded in the same feed-forward parameters. We propose Path-Lock Expert (PLE), an architecture-level solution that replaces the single MLP in each decoder layer with two semantically locked experts, one for /think and one for /no_think, while keeping attention, embeddings, normalization, and the language-model head shared. A deterministic control-token router selects exactly one expert path for the entire sequence, so inference preserves the dense model's per-token computation pattern and each expert receives mode-pure updates during supervised fine-tuning. Across math and science reasoning benchmarks, PLE maintains strong /think performance while producing a substantially stronger mode separation, a /no_think mode with higher accuracy and far less reasoning leakage. On Qwen3-4B, for example, compared to the SFT-only baseline on AIME24, PLE generates 17x fewer reflective tokens (6.01 vs. 0.35 per answer) and 2x shorter outputs (8665 vs. 4101 tokens), and improves /no_think accuracy from 35.33% to 44.67%, while maintaining /think-mode performance (61.33% vs. 60.00%). These results suggest that controllable hybrid thinking is fundamentally an architectural problem, and separating mode-specific feed-forward pathways is a simple and effective solution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Path-Lock Expert (PLE)，一种面向混合思考 (hybrid thinking) 语言模型的架构级方案，通过在每层解码器用两个语义锁定专家替换单个 MLP，分别对应 /think 与 /no_think 模式，并用确定性控制 token 路由器为整条序列选择唯一专家路径。摘要报告该方法在不牺牲 /think 性能的前提下大幅降低 /no_think 模式的推理泄漏，例如在 Qwen3-4B 的 AIME24 上生成的反省 token 从 6.01 降至 0.35，输出长度减半，/no_think 准确率从 35.33% 提升至 44.67%。
Motivation: 现有混合思考模型即使处于 /no_think 模式也常输出冗长自省内容，造成推理泄漏 (reasoning leakage)；已有工作依赖数据筛选和多阶段训练，但两种模式仍编码在同一个前馈网络参数中，泄漏无法根除。
Method: 将每个解码器层的单一 MLP 替换为两个语义锁定的专家，分别对应 /think 与 /no_think，同时共享 attention、嵌入、归一化和语言模型头；一个确定性的控制 token 路由器为整条序列只激活一条专家路径，从而保持稠密模型逐 token 的计算模式，并让专家在监督微调期间接收模式纯净的梯度更新。
Result: 在数学与科学推理基准上，PLE 维持了较强的 /think 性能并显著提升模式分离：以 Qwen3-4B 在 AIME24 上的 SFT-only 基线为对照，反省 token 从 6.01 降至 0.35（约 17 倍减少），输出从 8665 tokens 降至 4101 tokens（约 2 倍缩短），/no_think 准确率从 35.33% 提升至 44.67%，/think 准确率基本持平（61.33% 对 60.00%）。
Conclusion: 作者认为可控混合思考本质上是一个架构问题，分离模式专属的前馈通路是一种简单有效的解决方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Barriers to Universal Reasoning With Transformers (And How to Overcome Them)
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has been shown to empirically improve Transformers' performance, and theoretically increase their expressivity to Turing completeness. However, whether Transformers can learn to generalize to CoT traces longer than those seen during training is understudied. We use recent theoretical frameworks for Transformer length generalization and find that -- under standard positional encodings and a finite alphabet -- Transformers with CoT cannot solve problems beyond $TC^0$, i.e. the expressivity benefits do not hold under the stricter requirement of length-generalizable learnability. However, if we allow the vocabulary to grow with problem size, we attain a length-generalizable simulation of Turing machines where the CoT trace length is linear in the simulated runtime up to a constant. Our construction overcomes two core obstacles to reliable length generalization: repeated copying and last-occurrence retrieval. We assign each tape position a unique signpost token, and log only value changes to enable recovery of the current tape symbol through counts circumventing both barriers. Further, we empirically show that the use of such signpost tokens and value change encodings provide actionable guidance to improve length generalization on hard problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论角度研究带 Chain-of-Thought (CoT) 的 Transformer 是否能在训练中未见过的更长 CoT 轨迹上实现长度泛化 (length generalization)。作者利用近期 Transformer 长度泛化的理论框架证明：在标准位置编码和有限字母表下，带 CoT 的 Transformer 在长度可泛化可学习性意义下无法解决超出 TC^0 的问题，即 CoT 带来的表达力优势在长度泛化要求下不成立。若允许词表随问题规模增长，则可构造长度可泛化的图灵机模拟，其 CoT 轨迹长度与模拟运行时间成线性关系（至多常数倍）。构造通过为磁带位置设置唯一 signpost token 并仅记录值变化来回避重复拷贝与末次出现检索两大障碍，并在实验上表明这类编码能改善困难问题上的长度泛化。
Motivation: CoT 已被证明能经验上提升 Transformer 性能并理论上将其表达力扩展到图灵完备，但模型能否泛化到比训练时更长的 CoT 轨迹这一问题研究不足；论文填补这一缺口，考察表达力提升是否在长度可泛化可学习性下仍然成立。
Method: 提出理论分析框架，并给出一种构造：为每个磁带位置分配唯一的 signpost token，且只记录值变化，通过计数恢复当前磁带符号，从而绕过重复拷贝 (repeated copying) 和末次出现检索 (last-occurrence retrieval) 这两个长度泛化的核心障碍；同时用实验验证该编码策略的指导意义。
Result: 在标准位置编码和有限字母表下，带 CoT 的 Transformer 无法在长度泛化意义上解决超出 TC^0 的问题；而允许词表随问题规模增长时，可得到长度可泛化的图灵机模拟，CoT 轨迹长度至多为模拟运行时间的线性倍数。实验上，signpost token 与值变化编码能改善困难问题上的长度泛化。
Conclusion: 长度泛化需要克服重复拷贝和末次出现检索等机制性障碍，signpost token 与值变化编码提供了可操作的改进方向；论文强调表达力的理论结果不能直接迁移到长度泛化的可学习性设定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ZenBrain: A Neuroscience-Inspired 7-Layer Memory Architecture for Autonomous AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: ZenBrain is a seven-layer, neuroscience-derived memory architecture for LLM agents that unifies fifteen mechanisms - from Two-Factor synaptic consolidation to a Simulation-Selection sleep loop - under a single MemoryCoordinator: nine foundational algorithms plus six Predictive Memory Architecture components. No system among those we survey integrates more than two of them. Ablating each mechanism separately exposes an effect we call cooperative masking. Under moderate load, fourteen of the fifteen ablations look costless - the architecture reads as mostly dead weight. Raising decay to 0.25/day over 60 days, with no change to the mechanisms, makes nine of the fifteen individually critical (Delta-Q up to -93.7%; Wilcoxon, 10 seeds), five of them moving from exactly 0% to below -89%. The mechanisms form a cooperative survival network, and mild-load ablation systematically underestimates architectural contributions - a caution we conjecture applies beyond ZenBrain. Every ablation table reproduces in under one minute on a laptop (npm install, no API keys). On LongMemEval-500, ZenBrain wins all nine head-to-head answer-quality comparisons (3 competitors x 3 LLM judges) against Letta, Mem0 and A-Mem under Bonferroni-corrected significance (alpha=0.05/18, p_min=6.2e-31, d in [0.18, 0.52]), and reaches 91.3% of a full-context oracle's binary-judge accuracy at 1/106th of the per-query token cost (47.7% vs. 52.2%). Multi-layer routing beats a flat single-layer baseline by +20.7% F1 on LoCoMo; a NoDecay ablation shows principled forgetting costs only Delta-P@5=0.002. Honest scope: LoCoMo's substring-based aggregate F1 favors lexical retrieval (BM25) by metric design, and we do not contest this. ZenBrain's advantages are most pronounced on judge-graded answer quality and cross-session reasoning.
papers.comment: 48 pages, 27 tables, 4 figures. v3 is a correction release: a full source-verification pass over all 83 references corrects 30 defective entries and withdraws two ancillary evaluations run on synthetic stand-in data; no measured numbers changed. Changelog: 10.5281/zenodo.21858218. Earlier versions: Zenodo concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19353663, TDCommons dpubs_series/9683
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ZenBrain，一种受神经科学启发的七层记忆架构，用于 LLM 智能体，在统一 MemoryCoordinator 下整合十五种机制（九种基础算法加六种 Predictive Memory Architecture 组件），包括双因子突触巩固和仿真-选择睡眠循环。摘要称，逐机制消融揭示出“合作屏蔽”（cooperative masking）效应：中等负载下十四种消融看似无代价，而将遗忘率提高到 0.25/天持续 60 天后，十五种机制中有九种变得单独关键（Delta-Q 最高 -93.7%）。在 LongMemEval-500 上，ZenBrain 在三项对比（Letta、Mem0、A-Mem）的所有九组头对头回答质量比较中获胜，并以 1/106 的查询 token 成本达到全上下文 oracle 二元评判准确率的 91.3%。
Motivation: 作者指出，所调查的现有系统中没有哪个能整合超过两种上述记忆机制；同时，中等负载下的消融会系统性低估架构贡献，这一现象被他们称为合作屏蔽，并猜测其影响超出 ZenBrain 本身。
Method: 提出七层记忆架构，由 MemoryCoordinator 统一调度十五种机制，包括双因子突触巩固、仿真-选择睡眠循环等，并采用逐机制消融来评估各组件贡献。
Result: 在 LongMemEval-500 上，ZenBrain 在 3 个对比系统与 3 个 LLM 评判者的全部九组回答质量比较中胜出（Bonferroni 校正后 p_min=6.2e-31，d 在 [0.18, 0.52]）；二元评判准确率 47.7% 对 oracle 的 52.2%，达到后者的 91.3%，而 token 成本仅为 1/106。多层路由在 LoCoMo 上比扁平单层基线高出 +20.7% F1；NoDecay 消融显示原则性遗忘仅造成 Delta-P@5=0.002 的代价。
Conclusion: v3 为修正版，对全部 83 条参考文献做了来源核验并撤回两项基于合成替身数据的辅助评估，所有测量数字未变。作者坦承 LoCoMo 的基于子串的聚合 F1 在指标设计上偏向词法检索（BM25），并不否认这一点，并强调 ZenBrain 的优势主要体现在评判者打分的回答质量与跨会话推理上。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在 LongMemEval-500 上，ZenBrain 在 3 个对比系统与 3 个 LLM 评判者的全部九组回答质量比较中胜出（Bonferroni 校正后 p_min=6.2e-31，d 在 [0.18, 0.52]）；二元评判准确率 47.7% 对 oracle 的 52.2%，达到后者的 91.3%，而 token 成本仅为 1/106。多层路由在 LoCoMo 上比扁平单层基线高出 +20.7% F1；NoDecay 消融显示原则性遗忘仅造成 Delta-P@5=0.002 的代价。
summary_sections.conclusion: v3 为修正版，对全部 83 条参考文献做了来源核验并撤回两项基于合成替身数据的辅助评估，所有测量数字未变。作者坦承 LoCoMo 的基于子串的聚合 F1 在指标设计上偏向词法检索（BM25），并不否认这一点，并强调 ZenBrain 的优势主要体现在评判者打分的回答质量与跨会话推理上。

papers.title: Evaluating Jailbreaking Vulnerabilities in LLMs Deployed as Assistants for Smart Grid Operations: A Benchmark Against NERC Standards
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) as assistants in electric grid operations promises to streamline compliance and decision-making but exposes new vulnerabilities to prompt-based adversarial attacks. This paper evaluates the risk of jailbreaking LLMs, i.e., circumventing safety alignments to produce outputs violating regulatory standards, assuming threats from authorized users, such as operators, who craft malicious prompts to elicit non-compliant guidance. Three state-of-the-art LLMs (OpenAI's GPT-4o mini, Google's Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite, and Anthropic's Claude 3.5 Haiku) were tested against Baseline, BitBypass, and DeepInception jailbreaking methods across scenarios derived from nine NERC Reliability Standards (EOP, TOP, and CIP). In the initial broad experiment, the overall Attack Success Rate (ASR) was 33.1%, with DeepInception proving most effective at 63.17% ASR. Claude 3.5 Haiku exhibited complete resistance (0% ASR), while Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite was most vulnerable (55.04% ASR) and GPT-4o mini moderately susceptible (44.34% ASR). A follow-up experiment refining malicious wording in Baseline and BitBypass attacks yielded a 30.6% ASR, confirming that subtle prompt adjustments can enhance simpler methods' efficacy.

TL;DR: 本文评估了作为电网调度助手的 LLM 在面对提示词攻击（jailbreaking）时绕过安全对齐、输出违反 NERC 可靠性标准内容的脆弱性。研究在九个 NERC 可靠性标准（EOP、TOP、CIP）场景下，测试了 GPT-4o mini、Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite 和 Claude 3.5 Haiku 三类模型，并对比 Baseline、BitBypass、DeepInception 三种越狱方法。初始实验中整体攻击成功率（ASR）为 33.1%，其中 DeepInception 最有效（ASR 63.17%），Claude 3.5 Haiku 完全免疫（0%），Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite 最脆弱（55.04%）。后续对恶意措辞精炼后 Baseline 和 BitBypass 达到 30.6% 的 ASR，说明微调提示词即可提升简单方法的有效性。
Motivation: LLM 在电网运行中部署为助手可简化合规与决策流程，但引入了提示词对抗攻击的新风险；授权用户（如调度员）可能构造恶意提示词，诱使模型输出违反监管标准的建议，因此需要系统评估此类越狱漏洞。
Method: 以九个 NERC 可靠性标准（EOP、TOP、CIP）为基准构造场景，对 OpenAI GPT-4o mini、Google Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite、Anthropic Claude 3.5 Haiku 三种 SOTA 模型，测试 Baseline、BitBypass、DeepInception 三类越狱方法，并在后续实验中细化恶意措辞以检验简单方法的提升空间。
Result: 初始宽范围实验整体 ASR 为 33.1%；DeepInception 最有效（ASR 63.17%）；Claude 3.5 Haiku 完全抵抗（0% ASR），Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite 最脆弱（55.04%），GPT-4o mini 中等脆弱（44.34%）。后续精炼恶意措辞的实验中 Baseline 与 BitBypass 达到 30.6% 的 ASR。
Conclusion: 摘要指出，即便是授权用户也能通过精心构造的提示词诱使部分 LLM 输出不符合 NERC 标准的电网运行建议；模型间脆弱性差异显著，且简单越狱方法可通过措辞调整增强效果，凸显电网场景中 LLM 安全对齐评估的必要性。

papers.title: From Local to Cluster: A Unified Framework for Causal Discovery with Latent Variables
papers.abstract_en: Latent variables pose a fundamental obstacle to both causal discovery and inference. Local approaches exploiting direct neighborhood relations provide little beyond immediate dependencies. Cluster-level methods, though capable of broader reasoning, generally require cluster assignments or causal sufficiency in advance, conditions that are rarely satisfied in practice. Applying single-variable discovery at cluster resolution violates these conditions and thereby produces systematic bias. L2C (Local to Cluster Causal Abstraction) learns cluster structure from local causal patterns without manual variable-to-cluster mapping. The framework rests on a cluster reduction theorem: each cluster can be represented by at most three micro-variables, with no loss of macro-level identifiability. In the presence of latent variables, local discovery on maximal ancestral graphs recovers direct causes, effects, and V-structures, followed by cluster-level inference through a corresponding calculus on the resulting graph. Macro causal effects are formulated as joint interventions on the micro-variables within each target cluster. The framework is sound, atomically complete, and polynomially bounded. L2C establishes a direct connection from local micro-level information to macro causal reasoning in settings where clusters are unknown and latent variables are unavoidable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 L2C（Local to Cluster Causal Abstraction）框架，用于在存在隐变量且簇未知的情况下从局部因果模式学习簇结构，无需人工指定变量到簇的映射。框架基于簇约简定理：每个簇至多可用三个微变量（micro-variables）表示而不损失宏观可辨识性；在极大祖先图（maximal ancestral graphs）上做局部发现可恢复直接原因、直接效应和 V-structure，再通过相应演算进行簇级推断。宏观因果效应被建模为对目标簇内微变量的联合干预。作者声称该框架是可靠的（sound）、原子完备的（atomically complete）且具有多项式复杂度。
Motivation: 隐变量是因果发现与推断的根本障碍；局部方法只能处理直接邻域依赖，簇级方法通常预先要求簇分配或因果充分性，这些条件在实际中很少满足。若在簇分辨率上直接套用单变量发现，会违反上述条件并引入系统性偏差。
Method: L2C 从局部因果模式中学习簇结构，以簇约简定理为基础，将每个簇压缩为至多三个微变量；在隐变量存在时，先对极大祖先图做局部发现以恢复直接原因、直接效应与 V-structure，再在所得图上通过相应演算进行簇级推断，并将宏观因果效应表示为对目标簇内微变量的联合干预。
Result: 摘要报告该框架在理论上可靠、原子完备且具有多项式复杂度上界，并建立了从局部微变量信息到宏观因果推理的直接联系，适用于簇未知且隐变量不可避免的场景。摘要未给出具体实验数据或基准。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架解决了现有方法对簇分配和因果充分性等先验条件的依赖，为隐变量存在时的宏观因果推理提供了统一路径。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Model Predictive Control of Hybrid Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: The problem of controlling hybrid dynamical systems using model predictive control (MPC) is formulated and sufficient conditions for asymptotic stability of a set are provided. Hybrid dynamical systems are modeled in terms of hybrid equations, involving a differential equation and a difference equation with inputs and constraints. The proposed hybrid MPC algorithm uses a suitable prediction and control horizon construction inspired by hybrid time domains. Structural properties of the hybrid optimization problem, its feasible set, and its value function are provided. Checkable conditions to guarantee asymptotic stability of a set are provided. These conditions are given in terms of properties on the stage cost, terminal cost, and the existence of static state-feedback laws, related through a control Lyapunov function condition. Examples illustrate the results throughout the paper.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对混杂动力系统 (hybrid dynamical systems) 提出模型预测控制 (MPC) 的公式化描述，并给出保证集合渐近稳定性的充分条件。系统模型采用混杂方程 (hybrid equations)，即带输入与约束的微分方程和差分方程组合。作者提出一种受混杂时间域启发的预测与控制时域构造方式，并分析相应优化问题、可行集与值函数的结构性质。全文通过算例说明结果。
Motivation: 目前将 MPC 应用于混杂动力系统缺少统一的公式化框架以及可检验的稳定性条件，而混杂系统同时包含连续和离散动态，其预测控制设计需要专门处理。
Method: 利用混杂方程建立带输入和约束的 MPC 问题，提出基于混杂时间域的预测与控制时域构造的混合 MPC 算法；通过阶段代价、终端代价以及静态状态反馈律之间的控制 Lyapunov 函数条件，给出可检验的渐近稳定性充分条件。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验数据，主要结果包括混杂优化问题及其可行集和值函数的结构性质，以及保证集合渐近稳定性的可检验条件；文中用算例演示这些结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调所提出的条件是充分性的，并以控制 Lyapunov 函数形式将阶段代价、终端代价和状态反馈律联系起来；结果适用于用混杂方程建模的混杂动力系统。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: In-Situ Behavioral Evaluation for LLM Fairness, Not Standardized-Test Scores
papers.abstract_en: LLM fairness should be evaluated through in-situ behavioral pattern rather than standardized-test Q&A benchmarks. We show that the standardized-test paradigm can be structurally unreliable: surface-level prompt construction choices, although entirely orthogonal to the fairness question being tested, account for the majority of score variance, shift fairness conclusions in both the direction and the magnitude, and result in severe discordance in model rankings. We develop MAC-Fairness, a framework that embeds controlled variation factors into in-situ behavioral evaluation, examining how models' disparate-treatment behaviors shift when identity is varied as part of natural multi-agent conversation. Repurposing standardized-test questions as conversation seeds rather than as the evaluation instrument, we evaluate within-model differences in position persistence (how they hold positions, from the self-perspective) and peer receptiveness (how receptive they are to peers, from the other-perspective) across 8 million conversation transcripts spanning multiple models and identity presence configurations. In-situ behavioral evaluation reveals stable, model-specific, disparate-treatment behavioral signatures that could generalize across different fairness benchmarks, a form of evidence the standardized-test paradigm does not offer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑以标准化测试问答基准评估大语言模型公平性的做法，指出表面层面的提示词构造选择（与所测公平问题正交）主导了分数方差，甚至改变结论方向与模型排名。作者提出 MAC-Fairness 框架，将受控变化因素嵌入原位行为评估（in-situ behavioral evaluation），把标准化测试题改用作对话种子，基于 800 万条多智能体对话记录分析模型在身份变化下的差异化对待行为。结果显示原位行为评估能揭示稳定的、模型特有的差异化行为特征，并可跨基准泛化。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 公平性评估多依赖标准化测试问答基准，但该范式在结构上不可靠：与公平性问题无关的表面提示词构造选择会主导分数方差、翻转结论方向和幅度，并导致模型排名的严重不一致。
Method: 提出 MAC-Fairness 框架，将受控变化因素嵌入原位行为评估；将标准化测试题重新用作对话种子而非评估工具，考察模型在自然多智能体对话中身份变化时的差异对待行为，并从自我视角（position persistence）和他人视角（peer receptiveness）衡量模型内的差异。
Result: 标准化测试范式下，表面提示词选择解释了大部分分数方差，并显著改变公平性结论的方向与幅度及模型排名一致性；而基于 800 万条对话转录的原位行为评估揭示了稳定、模型特有、可跨公平性基准泛化的差异对待行为特征。
Conclusion: 作者主张 LLM 公平性应通过原位行为模式而非标准化测试分数来评估，原位行为评估提供了标准化测试范式无法给出的证据类型。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Switching Theory for Q-Learning
papers.abstract_en: Q-learning is a fundamental algorithmic primitive in reinforcement learning. This paper develops a new framework for analyzing constant step-size tabular Q-learning from a switching linear system (SLS) viewpoint. In particular, we derive a stochastic SLS representation of the Q-learning error, and a finite-time error analysis through the joint spectral radius (JSR) of the corresponding SLS model, where the JSR is the exact worst-case exponential rate of the associated SLS. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first convergence rate analysis of standard Q-learning whose leading exponential rate is expressed through the JSR. The resulting rate is tied to the intrinsic worst-case exponential rate of the direct SLS representation and can be sharper than row-sum upper bounds when those bounds are conservative. We further prove that the JSR of Q-learning equals the largest spectral radius among the deterministic-policy modes and give an exact linear programming characterization that can be evaluated to any prescribed accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从切换线性系统 (switching linear system, SLS) 视角分析常数步长表格型 Q-learning 的收敛行为。作者给出 Q-learning 误差的随机 SLS 表示，并利用联合谱半径 (joint spectral radius, JSR) 得到有限时间误差界，据称这是标准 Q-learning 首次以 JSR 表达主导指数速率的收敛速率分析。作者还证明该 JSR 等于所有确定性策略模式中最大的谱半径，并提供可逼近到任意精度的线性规划刻画。
Motivation: 现有 Q-learning 收敛性分析多采用行和 (row-sum) 上界等保守估计，难以刻画真实的最坏情况指数收敛速率；本文试图从 SLS 与 JSR 的角度给出更紧的速率表征。
Method: 将常数步长表格型 Q-learning 的误差动态建模为随机切换线性系统，利用该 SLS 模型的联合谱半径进行有限时间误差分析，并通过确定性策略模式的谱半径与线性规划刻画来求解或逼近 JSR。
Result: 摘要报告该 JSR 速率可优于保守的行和上界，且证明了 Q-learning 的 JSR 等于确定性策略模式中的最大谱半径，并给出了可求到任意精度的精确线性规划刻画。
Conclusion: 本文为分析 Q-learning 收敛速率提供了一种新的 JSR 视角，但结果限于常数步长表格型设置；摘要未报告具体数值实验。

papers.title: Label-Efficient Bilateral Attention for Parkinson's Disease Screening from Wrist-Worn IMU Signals
papers.abstract_en: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a chronic neurodegenerative disorder. It shows multiple motor symptoms such as tremor, bradykinesia, postural instability, and freezing of gait (FoG). PD is currently diagnosed clinically through physical examination by health-care professionals, which can be time-consuming and highly subjective. Wearable IMU sensors have become a promising gateway for PD detection. We propose a time-interleaving encoder that processes bilateral wrist-worn IMU signals from the public PADS dataset, which consists of three groups, PD (Parkinson's Disease), HC (Healthy Control), and DD (Differential Diagnosis), across a total of 469 subjects. The encoder reaches 93.2%/90.9% accuracy (0.963/0.960 AUROC) on HC-vs-PD and PD-vs-DD; the lower sensitivity on the differential (0.812 vs. 0.994) confirms that separating PD from look-alike disorders is the harder clinical problem. Self-supervised representation learning with a contrastive InfoNCE objective attains 91.6%/89.5% accuracy using only 20% of the labels, within 1.5 points of the full-label ceiling, so near-saturation accuracy is reachable with minimal annotation. For real-time edge deployment we reach 124.5 ms per window on a Raspberry Pi 4.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对帕金森病（Parkinson's Disease, PD）的客观筛查问题，提出一种时间交织编码器（time-interleaving encoder），处理公开 PADS 数据集中的双侧腕戴 IMU 信号；该数据集包含 PD、健康对照（HC）和鉴别诊断（DD）三组共 469 名受试者。摘要报告编码器在 HC-vs-PD 与 PD-vs-DD 上分别达到 93.2%/90.9% 的准确率（AUROC 0.963/0.960），其中鉴别诊断任务灵敏度较低（0.812 vs 0.994）。结合对比 InfoNCE 目标的自我监督表征学习，仅用 20% 标签即达到 91.6%/89.5% 准确率，距全标签上限仅差 1.5 个百分点；边缘部署方面，在 Raspberry Pi 4 上单窗口推理耗时 124.5 ms。
Motivation: PD 目前依赖医护人员体检进行临床诊断，过程耗时且主观性强；可穿戴 IMU 传感器为 PD 检测提供了有前景的途径，但需要更高效、标签需求更低的自动筛查方法。
Method: 提出时间交织编码器来处理双侧腕戴 IMU 信号，并在 PADS 数据集上评估 HC-vs-PD 与 PD-vs-DD 两类判别任务；同时采用带对比 InfoNCE 目标的自我监督表征学习（self-supervised representation learning），以降低标注依赖，并评估在 Raspberry Pi 4 上的实时边缘部署性能。
Result: 摘要报告编码器取得 93.2%/90.9% 准确率与 0.963/0.960 的 AUROC；自我监督方法只用 20% 标签即达到 91.6%/89.5% 准确率，接近全标签上限；边缘部署单窗口延迟为 124.5 ms。
Conclusion: 作者认为用少量标注即可达到接近饱和的准确率，且实时边缘部署可行；同时指出将 PD 与外观相似疾病区分开（PD-vs-DD）是更难的临床问题，灵敏度明显更低。

papers.title: Toward Measuring AI's Effects on Skill Formation: The Stock-Formation Gap
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale AI deployment data and controlled learning experiments characterize different consequences of the same technology. Deployment telemetry shows that AI use is concentrated in skilled work and frequently supports immediate task performance. It observes tasks, interaction patterns, and outputs, however, not whether users become more capable of performing those tasks independently. Controlled studies measure independent capability more directly, but only in narrower populations and settings, with outcomes that vary substantially by interaction design. We formulate this discrepancy as a stock--formation measurement gap: current systems observe the use of existing expertise more readily than the formation of future expertise. Because formation has historically been society's recovery mechanism through technological change, the gap matters well beyond any single classroom. We synthesize the experimental and observational evidence by identification strength, use public deployment data as a descriptive illustration of the gap, and identify the missing bridge between interaction traces and unassisted retention and transfer. We then propose a research program that links consented usage records to independent assessments while experimentally varying whether AI supplies answers, hints, feedback, or evaluation. The claim is not that AI has been shown to erode skill formation at population scale. It is that existing measurement cannot determine whether it does, and that this question is both measurable and designable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并阐述了一个测量问题：大规模AI部署数据与受控学习实验分别刻画同一技术的不同后果，前者容易观察到已有专业技能的即时使用，后者能更直接测量独立能力，但样本和场景狭窄。作者将此差异形式化为"存量—形成测量缺口"（stock–formation measurement gap），并据此提出一个将同意后的使用记录与独立评估相连接的研究计划。
Motivation: 现有部署遥测（deployment telemetry）只观察任务、交互模式和输出，无法判断用户是否变得更能在无辅助条件下独立完成任务；而受控实验虽能测量独立能力，但仅涵盖较窄的人群和场景，结果随交互设计差异很大。由于技能形成历来是社会应对技术变革的恢复机制，这一测量缺口的影响超出单个人工智能系统或单一课堂。
Method: 作者按证据强度综合实验与观察证据，用公共部署数据对缺口做描述性说明，并识别交互痕迹与无辅助保持和迁移之间缺失的桥梁；随后提出研究计划：在实验上变化AI提供答案、提示、反馈或评价，并将用户同意的使用记录与独立能力评估相链接。
Result: 论文本身未报告量化实验结果；其核心贡献是证据综合与框架化说明，即指出现有测量系统更倾向于记录对既有专长的使用，而非未来专长的形成，并给出了缺口存在的描述性证据。
Conclusion: 作者明确表示，论文的主张不是AI已被证明在大规模上侵蚀技能形成，而是现有测量无法判定是否存在这种侵蚀；同时强调这一问题既可测量，也可通过交互设计来干预和塑造。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DRBENCHER: Can Your Agent Identify the Entity, Retrieve Its Properties and Do the Math?
papers.abstract_en: Deep research agents increasingly interleave web browsing with multi-step computation, yet existing benchmarks evaluate these capabilities in isolation, creating a blind spot in assessing real-world performance. We introduce DRBENCHER, a synthetic benchmark generator for questions that require both browsing and computation, synthesized answer-first from knowledge-graph chains with no seed passages or provenance text. It enforces four criteria: verifiability (gold answers are computed by executing parameterized code over knowledge-graph values), complexity (multi-hop entity identification, property retrieval, and domain-specific computation), difficulty (a two-stage verification cascade filters out questions solvable by the generating model), and diversity (a greedy max-min embedding filter maximizes coverage). These criteria are realized via a unified answer-first pipeline spanning five domains: biochemistry, financial, geophysical, security, and history. Human evaluation shows 76% validity, with 35% of errors due to outdated knowledge-graph entries, highlighting an inherent limitation of systems that reason over evolving data. Automatic evaluation shows that the strongest frontier model achieves only 20% answer accuracy. Compared to manually constructed benchmarks (BrowseComp+, MATH-500, GPQA), DRBENCHER achieves the highest semantic diversity. We release DrBencher pipeline and the human-verified benchmark data at https://github.com/IBM/DrBencher.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DRBENCHER，一个可合成“既需网页浏览又需多步计算”的问答基准的生成器，从知识图谱链以 answer-first 方式合成问题，不依赖种子段落或出处文本。它同时强制可验证性、复杂性、难度和多样性四个标准，覆盖生物化学、金融、地球物理、安全和历史五个领域。人类评估显示 76% 的有效性，其中 35% 的错误源于过时的知识图谱条目；最强前沿模型仅达到 20% 的答案准确率。
Motivation: 现有深度研究代理（deep research agent）基准把网页浏览和多步计算分开评估，造成真实场景性能评估的盲区，缺少同时要求这两种能力的测试。
Method: DRBENCHER 是一个合成基准生成器，采用 answer-first 流水线：先基于知识图谱链构造问题，再用参数化代码执行得到金标准答案；通过两阶段验证级联过滤掉生成模型可解的问题，并以贪心 max-min 嵌入过滤提高多样性。
Result: 人类评估表明 76% 的问题有效，且 35% 的错误归因于过时的知识图谱条目；最强前沿模型仅取得 20% 的答案准确率。与人工构建的 BrowseComp+、MATH-500 和 GPQA 相比，DRBENCHER 的语义多样性最高。
Conclusion: 作者认为同时验证浏览与计算能力对评估真实世界的深度研究代理很重要，并指出了基于随时间演化数据推理的系统存在固有的知识过时局限；他们已公开发布 DrBencher 流水线与人工验证的基准数据。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Statistical Framework for Auditing Behavioral Dependence and Induced Bias in LLM Judges
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of the large language model (LLM) ecosystem raises a critical question: are seemingly diverse models truly independent? Shared pretraining data, distillation, and alignment pipelines can induce hidden behavioral dependencies, or latent entanglement, that undermine multi-model systems such as LLM-as-a-judge pipelines and ensemble verification, which implicitly assume independent signals. In practice, this manifests as correlated reasoning patterns and synchronized failures, where apparent agreement reflects shared error modes rather than independent validation. To address this, we develop a statistical framework for auditing behavioral entanglement among black-box LLMs. Our approach introduces a multi-resolution hierarchy that characterizes the joint failure manifold through two information-theoretic metrics: (i) a Difficulty-Weighted Behavioral Entanglement Index (BEI), which amplifies synchronized failures on easy tasks, and (ii) a Cumulative Information Gain (CIG) metric, which captures directional alignment in erroneous responses. Through experiments on 18 LLMs from six model families, we identify statistically significant behavioral entanglement. Such behavioral dependence is associated with judge over-endorsement bias on a disjoint MMLU-Pro evaluation set (rho = 0.508 for BEI and rho = 0.520 for CIG; p < 0.01). The association further transfers to the MATH-500 benchmark (rho = 0.441 for BEI and rho = 0.457 for CIG; p < 0.05), providing cross-benchmark evidence that the identified dependency structure generalizes beyond the data and response format used for its estimation. Finally, we demonstrate a practical use case of entanglement through de-entangled verifier ensemble reweighting, achieving 3.5 and 2.6 percentage-point gains in accuracy and precision, respectively, over majority voting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统计框架，用于审计黑盒大语言模型之间的行为纠缠（behavioral entanglement），即由共享预训练数据、蒸馏和对齐管道导致的隐藏行为依赖。作者引入多分辨率层级，通过两个信息论指标（难度加权行为纠缠指数 BEI 和累积信息增益 CIG）刻画联合失败流形，并在 18 个来自六个模型家族的 LLM 上发现显著的统计纠缠，且该依赖与 LLM-as-a-judge 的过度背书偏差显著相关，还可跨基准迁移。
Motivation: LLM 生态系统中看似多样的模型可能并非独立：共享预训练数据、蒸馏和对齐管道会诱发隐藏的行为依赖，破坏 LLM-as-a-judge 管道和集成验证等隐式假设信号独立的多模型系统，表现为相关推理模式和同步失败。
Method: 提出一个用于审计黑盒 LLM 行为纠缠的统计框架，包含多分辨率层级，通过两个信息论指标刻画联合失败流形：难度加权行为纠缠指数（BEI）放大简单任务上的同步失败，以及累积信息增益（CIG）捕捉错误响应中的方向性对齐。
Result: 在 18 个来自六个模型家族的 LLM 上识别出统计显著的行为纠缠；在不相交的 MMLU-Pro 评估集上，BEI 与 CIG 分别以 rho=0.508 和 rho=0.520（p<0.01）与 judge 过度背书偏差相关，并在 MATH-500 上迁移（BEI rho=0.441，CIG rho=0.457，p<0.05）。实际用例中，去纠缠验证器集成重加权相比多数投票在准确率上提升 3.5 个百分点、精确率上提升 2.6 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所识别的依赖结构可跨基准和响应格式泛化，并通过去纠缠验证器集成重加权展示了实际应用价值，为审计多模型系统中的隐藏依赖提供了统计工具。

papers.title: Compatibility of Face Embeddings Across Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Automated face recognition has made rapid strides over the past decade due to the unprecedented rise of deep neural network (DNN) models that can be trained for domain-specific tasks. At the same time, large foundation models that are pretrained on broad vision or vision-language tasks have shown impressive generalization across diverse domains, including biometrics. This raises an important question: Do different DNN models---both domain-specific and foundation models---encode facial identity in similar ways, despite being trained on different datasets, loss functions, and architectures? In this regard, we directly analyze the geometric structure of embedding spaces imputed by different DNN models. Treating embeddings of face images as point clouds, we study whether simple affine transformations can align face representations of one model with another. Our findings reveal substantial cross-model compatibility: low-capacity linear mappings substantially improve cross-model face recognition over unaligned baselines for both identification and verification, including across foundation models never trained for face recognition. Alignment patterns generalize across datasets and vary systematically across model families, indicating representational convergence in facial identity encoding. These findings reframe independently trained templates as transferable rather than revocable, with implications for interoperability, ensemble design, and biometric template security.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文直接分析不同深度神经网络（DNN）模型所产生的人脸嵌入空间的几何结构，将人脸图像嵌入视为点云，考察简单仿射变换能否将一个模型的人脸表示对齐到另一个模型。研究发现跨模型兼容性显著：低容量线性映射能在识别与验证任务中大幅提升跨模型人脸识别性能，甚至适用于从未做人脸识别训练的 foundation models。对齐模式可跨数据集泛化，并随模型家族系统变化，表明人脸身份编码存在表征收敛。
Motivation: 不同 DNN 模型在数据集、损失函数和架构上均有差异，但尚不清楚它们是否以相似方式编码人脸身份；理解这一点对模板互操作性、集成设计和生物特征模板安全具有意义。
Method: 将人脸嵌入当作点云，直接比较不同模型嵌入空间的几何结构，并检验简单仿射变换能否将一个模型的嵌入空间对齐到另一个模型。
Result: 低容量线性映射相比未对齐基线在身份识别（identification）和验证（verification）任务上均显著提升跨模型人脸识别效果，且该提升扩展到未经过人脸识别训练的 foundation models；对齐模式可跨数据集泛化，并随模型家族呈现系统性差异。
Conclusion: 摘要将独立训练的模板重新定义为可转移（transferable）而非可撤销（revocable），并指出这对互操作性、集成设计和生物特征模板安全有启示。

papers.title: TraceSafe: A Systematic Assessment of LLM Guardrails on Multi-Step Tool-Calling Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) evolve from static chatbots into autonomous agents, the primary vulnerability surface shifts from final outputs to intermediate execution traces. While safety guardrails are well-benchmarked for natural language responses, their efficacy remains largely unexplored within multi-step tool-use trajectories. To address this gap, we introduce **TraceSafe-Bench**, the first comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to assess mid-trajectory safety. It encompasses 12 risk categories, ranging from security threats (e.g., prompt injection, privacy leaks) to operational failures (e.g., hallucinations, interface inconsistencies), featuring over 1,000 unique execution instances. Our evaluation of 13 LLM-as-a-guard models and 7 specialized guardrails yields three critical findings: 1) *Structural Bottleneck*: Guardrail efficacy is driven more by structural data competence (e.g., JSON parsing) than semantic safety alignment. Performance correlates strongly with structured-to-text benchmarks ($ρ=0.79$, $p<0.01$) while we detect no association with standard jailbreak robustness. 2) *Scale Is Not the Deciding Factor*: Trajectory detection accuracy does not scale monotonically with model size, and general-purpose LLMs consistently outperform specialized safety guardrails. 3) *Bounded Temporal Stability*: Detection accuracy improves with trajectory length within native context bounds as models process dynamic execution behavior, but degrades in extreme long-context regimes due to over-refusal.
papers.comment: Accepted to Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TraceSafe-Bench，据称是首个专门评估多步工具调用轨迹中途安全性的基准，涵盖 12 类风险与超过 1000 个执行实例。作者对 13 个 LLM-as-a-guard 模型和 7 个专用安全防护模型（guardrails）进行评测，得出三点关键结论：防护能力更多取决于结构化数据能力（如 JSON 解析）而非语义安全对齐；检测准确率不随模型规模单调提升，且通用 LLM 优于专用防护模型；检测效果在原生上下文范围内随轨迹长度提升，但在超长上下文中因过度拒绝而下降。
Motivation: LLM 正从静态聊天机器人演化为自主智能体，主要漏洞面从最终输出转移到中间执行轨迹；现有安全防护在自然语言回复上已有完善基准，但在多步工具使用轨迹中的有效性尚未被系统探索。
Method: 构建 TraceSafe-Bench 基准，覆盖安全威胁（如提示注入、隐私泄露）与操作失败（如幻觉、接口不一致）共 12 类风险，包含超过 1000 个执行实例，并评测 13 个 LLM-as-a-guard 模型和 7 个专用防护模型。
Result: 三方面结果：防护效果由结构化数据能力驱动，与结构化到文本基准的相关系数为 ρ=0.79（p<0.01），而与标准越狱鲁棒性无关联；轨迹检测准确率不随模型规模单调增长，通用 LLM 持续优于专用安全防护；在原生上下文长度内准确率随轨迹长度提高，极端长上下文下因过度拒绝而退化。
Conclusion: 作者认为中途轨迹安全需要专门的评测体系，并指出防护能力主要受结构化数据处理能力而非安全对齐影响，模型规模不是决定性因素，时间稳定性存在边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UGAF-ITS: A Standards Harmonization Framework and Validation Tool for Multi-Framework AI Governance in Distributed Intelligent Transportation Systems
papers.abstract_en: Organizations deploying AI-enabled Intelligent Transportation Systems face fragmented governance: ISO/IEC~42001 demands a certifiable management system, the EU AI Act imposes binding high-risk obligations from August~2026, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework structures voluntary practice. This paper introduces UGAF-ITS, a standards harmonization framework that consolidates 154 source obligations from the three instruments into 12 unified controls across eight governance domains through a reproducible five-phase crosswalk methodology. A three-tier operating model allocates each control to the vehicle, edge, or cloud tier where enforcement and defensible evidence production are feasible. An evidence backbone of 20 versioned artifacts supports a single audit package across all three frameworks without duplicating content. We evaluate UGAF-ITS through an open-source governance engine applied to four architecturally distinct ITS deployment scenarios. The engine encodes the complete crosswalk catalog and executes eight compliance computations. Three-tier deployments achieve 91.7\% average scoped framework coverage with 45.9\% evidence reduction, complete bidirectional traceability, and 80\% of artifacts serving all three frameworks simultaneously. Partial deployments contract predictably, with reduction holding between 25\% and 50\% across archetypes. The siloed baseline is enumerated document by document and computed by the tool at run time. These results establish structural properties of the harmonized catalog under architectural variation. They do not establish operational compliance readiness, which external assessment with practitioners has yet to test. The tool, scenarios, and all reported results are publicly available for independent replication.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Revised version under review at Computer Standards & Interfaces. Software: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19339071
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UGAF-ITS，一个面向分布式智能交通系统中多框架 AI 治理的标准协调框架。它将 ISO/IEC 42001、EU AI Act 与 NIST AI RMF 三个工具的 154 项义务整合为 8 个治理域下的 12 个统一控制，并通过三层运营模型分配至车辆、边缘或云端。基于开源治理引擎在四个架构不同的部署场景中评估，三层部署平均达到 91.7% 的范围覆盖率并减少 45.9% 的证明证据。
Motivation: 部署 AI 赋能的智能交通系统时，组织面临碎片化的治理要求：ISO/IEC 42001 要求可认证的管理体系，EU AI Act 从 2026 年 8 月起施加具有约束力的高风险义务，而 NIST AI RMF 提供自愿实践框架，三者结构不一致且证据重复。
Method: 提出 UGAF-ITS，通过可复现的五阶段交叉映射方法将 154 项来源义务合并为 12 个统一控制，并设计三层运营模型将每个控制分配到车辆、边缘或云层，以支持可执行的合规举证。证据骨干包含 20 个版本化工件，可生成覆盖三个框架的单一审计包；配套开源治理引擎编码完整交叉目录并执行 8 项合规计算。
Result: 在三层部署中，平均范围覆盖率为 91.7%，证据减少 45.9%，80% 的工件同时服务于三个框架，且实现完全双向可追踪性；部分部署的减少幅度在 25% 至 50% 之间。基线（siloed）场景由工具在运行时逐文档枚举计算。
Conclusion: 结果确立了协调目录在架构变化下的结构性质，但并未确立操作合规准备度，后者仍需外部从业人员评估。工具、场景及结果均已公开，可用于独立复现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Weighted Bayesian Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning predictors are rarely deployed on data that match the data they were calibrated on. Conformal prediction and its risk-control generalization promise distribution-free guarantees at deployment, but only under exchangeability or a covariate shift whose likelihood ratio is known exactly -- and the estimated-ratio case, the one that occurs in practice, is explicitly open, out of reach of the Bayesian construction available under exchangeability. We reach it from a different starting point: pushing a Dirichlet process prior on the calibration distribution through the likelihood ratio yields the exact Bayesian posterior over the deployed risk. That posterior is exact given the weight function, which at deployment is itself estimated, so we further prove finite-sample upper and lower bounds on the risk the selected threshold actually incurs, in terms of the weight-estimation error and the conditional shift. On synthetic and real covariate shifts, in regression and classification, the realized failure rate then stays close to target where shift-blind selection fails, and what deployment receives is a posterior over the risk of every threshold rather than a single number.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出加权贝叶斯共形预测 (Weighted Bayesian Conformal Prediction)，针对部署数据与校准数据分布不匹配、且似然比需要估计的协变量偏移情形。作者将 Dirichlet process 先验置于标定分布上并经由似然比传播，得到部署风险上的贝叶斯后验；给定权重函数时后验是精确的，而权重函数在实际部署中也被估计，因此进一步证明了所选阈值实际风险的有限样本上下界。在合成和真实协变量偏移、回归和分类任务上，实现失效概率保持在目标附近。
Motivation: 现有共形预测及其风险控制推广只在可交换性 (exchangeability) 或似然比精确已知的协变量偏移下提供分布无关保证；实践中常见的似然比估计情形是开放问题，且无法沿用交换性假设下的贝叶斯构造。
Method: 从一个不同的起点出发：把 Dirichlet process 先验放在标定分布上，并将其通过似然比传播，得到部署风险的精确贝叶斯后验；同时证明在权重估计误差与条件偏移 (conditional shift) 存在时，所选阈值实际风险的有限样本上界和下界。
Result: 在合成和真实协变量偏移下，无论是回归还是分类，实现失效概率都保持在目标附近，而忽略偏移的选择会失败；部署端获得的不是单一数值，而是每个阈值风险的后验分布。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法把似然比估计情形纳入贝叶斯共形框架，并提供有限样本风险保证；其保证质量取决于权重估计误差和条件偏移的大小，且后验的精确性以权重函数给定为前提。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Let Geometry GUIDE: Layer-wise Unrolling of Geometric Priors in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in 2D visual tasks but still struggle to understand physical space in real-world visual streams. Recently, feed-forward geometric foundation models that implicitly extract geometric priors from visual inputs have offered a promising direction. However, many existing geometry-aware MLLMs extract features from a single deep encoder layer and perform one-shot fusion at the language-model input, potentially overlooking complementary information across geometric encoder layers, limiting access to fine-grained geometric cues, and hindering progressive cross-modal adaptation. To address these limitations, we propose GUIDE (Geometric Unrolling Inside MLLM Early-layers), a progressive framework for integrating geometric priors. GUIDE samples and aligns multi-level features from the geometric encoder and sequentially injects them into the early layers of the MLLM. This design enables the MLLM to continuously access multi-granularity geometric cues and progressively integrate them with visual representations during layer-wise semantic abstraction. GUIDE further introduces a dual context-aware gating mechanism at both the token and layer levels, selectively regulating geometric information to reduce redundant injection and interference with pretrained representations. Extensive experiments on spatial reasoning and 3D scene understanding benchmarks, including VSI-Bench, ScanRefer, and Scan2Cap, validate the effectiveness and cross-task applicability of GUIDE. Our 5B and 9B models achieve average scores of 71.5 and 72.1 on VSI-Bench, respectively.
papers.comment: Revised manuscript with updated experiments, figures, and presentation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GUIDE（Geometric Unrolling Inside MLLM Early-layers），一种将几何先验渐进集成到多模态大语言模型（MLLM）早期层中的框架。GUIDE 从几何编码器采样并对齐多层特征，按层序注入 MLLM 的浅层，使模型在逐层语义抽象中持续访问多粒度几何线索，并引入 token 级与层级的双上下文感知门控机制以减少冗余注入。在 VSI-Bench、ScanRefer 和 Scan2Cap 等空间推理与 3D 场景理解基准上的实验验证了其有效性与跨任务适用性，5B 和 9B 模型在 VSI-Bench 上分别取得 71.5 和 72.1 的平均分。
Motivation: 现有几何感知 MLLM 通常只从几何编码器的单个深层提取特征，并在语言模型输入端做一次性融合，可能忽略跨几何编码器层的互补信息，限制了对细粒度几何线索的获取，也阻碍了渐进式跨模态适应。
Method: GUIDE 先采样并对齐几何编码器的多层特征，再将其顺序注入 MLLM 的早期层；同时设计 token 级和 layer 级的双上下文感知门控机制，选择性调节几何信息的注入，以减轻对预训练表示的干扰。
Result: 在 VSI-Bench、ScanRefer、Scan2Cap 基准上的实验表明 GUIDE 有效且具备跨任务适用性；其中 5B 和 9B 模型在 VSI-Bench 上平均得分分别为 71.5 和 72.1。
Conclusion: 论文认为逐层展开并注入多粒度几何先验，配合上下文感知门控，能够提升 MLLM 的空间推理与 3D 场景理解能力；摘要未明确讨论方法局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Large Language Models Align with the Human Brain during Creative Thinking
papers.abstract_en: Creative thinking is a fundamental aspect of human cognition, and divergent thinking-the capacity to generate novel and varied ideas-is widely regarded as its core generative engine. Large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated impressive performance on divergent thinking tests and prior work has shown that models with higher task performance tend to be more aligned to human brain activity. However, existing brain-LLM alignment studies have focused on passive, non-creative tasks. Here, we explore brain alignment during creative thinking using fMRI data from 170 participants performing the Alternate Uses Task (AUT). We extract representations from LLMs varying in size (270M-72B) and measure alignment to brain responses via Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA), targeting the creativity-related default mode and frontoparietal networks. We find that brain-LLM alignment is positively associated with model size (default mode network only) and with idea originality (both networks), with these relationships clearest early in the creative process. We further find that post-training objectives are associated with functionally selective differences in alignment: a creativity-optimized Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct retains alignment with high-creativity neural responses while lacking the positive low-creativity alignment present in other variants, but a reasoning-trained variant shows the opposite asymmetry, with negative alignment to high-creativity responses. Together, these results suggest that brain alignment offers an informative lens on how post-training relates to the neural geometry of human creative thought.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用 170 名被试完成 Alternate Uses Task (AUT) 时的 fMRI 数据，研究大语言模型（LLM）的表示与人类大脑创造性思维期间神经活动的对齐程度。作者用表征相似性分析（RSA）比较不同规模（270M-72B）和不同后训练目标的 LLM 与默认模式网络和额顶网络的活动，发现模型规模与想法原创性均与对齐度正相关，且创造力优化的模型在高低创造力神经响应上呈现不对称的对齐模式。
Motivation: 已有的 brain-LLM 对齐研究多关注被动、非创造性任务，尚未考察创造性思维这一人类认知核心过程中的神经对齐，因此需要专门的实验设计来填补这一空白。
Method: 使用 170 名参与者在 Alternate Uses Task (AUT) 中的 fMRI 数据，提取不同规模（270M-72B）LLM 的表示，并通过 Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA) 测量其与默认模式网络和前额顶网络脑响应的对齐度；同时比较创造力优化与推理优化的 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 变体。
Result: 脑-LLM 对齐度与模型规模正相关（仅在默认模式网络内），且与想法的原创性正相关（两个网络均如此），这些关系在创造性过程早期最清晰；创造力优化的 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 保留了对高创造力神经响应的正对齐，却缺乏其他变体中存在的低创造力正对齐，而推理训练的变体在高创造力响应上呈现负对齐。
Conclusion: 摘要认为脑对齐为理解后训练如何影响人类创造性思维的神经几何提供了一个信息丰富的视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CresOWLve: Benchmarking Creative Problem-Solving Over Real-World Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Creative problem-solving requires combining multiple cognitive abilities, including logical reasoning, lateral thinking, analogy-making, and commonsense knowledge, to discover insights that connect seemingly unrelated pieces of information. However, most existing benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) evaluate only specific components of this process. Moreover, many creativity-oriented benchmarks rely on artificially constructed brainteasers or contrived scenarios that do not reflect how creative problem-solving occurs in real-world settings. To address this gap, we introduce CresOWLve (containing 2,061 examples across five difficulty levels), a benchmark for evaluating creative problem-solving using puzzles grounded in real-world knowledge. Problems in CresOWLve require employing multiple creative thinking strategies, retrieving facts from diverse domains, and creatively combining them to arrive at a solution. Evaluating several frontier non-thinking and thinking LLMs, we show that CresOWLve remains highly challenging. Our analysis reveals a consistent performance gap: models perform substantially better on factual questions than on creative ones (up to -17% drop). While models can often retrieve the relevant knowledge, they struggle to form the non-obvious creative connections required to integrate the knowledge and arrive at the correct answer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CresOWLve，一个用于评估大语言模型（LLM）基于真实世界知识进行创意问题解决（creative problem-solving）的基准，包含 2,061 个示例、五个难度级别。作者评估多个前沿 non-thinking 与 thinking LLM，发现该基准仍极具挑战性：模型在事实性问题上明显优于创意性问题，性能最多下降 17%，且常能检索相关知识但难以建立非显而易见的创意联系。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 创意问题解决基准大多只评估该过程的某个单一组件，且许多创意导向基准依赖人为构造的脑筋急转弯或刻意设计的场景，无法反映真实世界中的创意问题解决方式，因此需要更贴近实际的新基准。
Method: 构建 CresOWLve 基准，题目以真实世界知识为基础，要求模型运用多种创意思维策略、从不同领域检索事实，并创造性地组合这些信息来得出答案；示例按五个难度级别组织。
Result: 对多个前沿 non-thinking 和 thinking LLM 的评测显示，CresOWLve 仍然高度困难；模型在事实性问题上的表现显著好于创意性问题（最大下降 17%），表明知识检索不成问题，瓶颈在于将相关知识整合并形成非显而易见的创意联系。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，模型尽管能够检索到相关知识，却难以组合这些知识以得出正确答案，说明创意问题解决所需的跨知识整合能力仍是当前 LLM 的明显短板。

papers.title: Dense Point-to-Mask Optimization with Reinforced Point Selection for Crowd Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Crowd instance segmentation is a crucial task with a wide range of applications, including surveillance and transportation. Currently, point labels are common in crowd datasets, while region labels (e.g., boxes) are rare and inaccurate. The masks obtained through segmentation help to improve the accuracy of region labels and resolve the correspondence between individual location coordinates and crowd density maps. However, directly applying currently popular large foundation models such as SAM does not yield ideal results in dense crowds. To this end, we first propose Dense Point-to-Mask Optimization (DPMO), which integrates SAM with the Nearest Neighbor Exclusive Circle (NNEC) constraint to generate dense instance segmentation from point annotations. With DPMO and manual correction, we obtain mask annotations from the existing point annotations for traditional crowd datasets. Then, to predict instance segmentation in dense crowds, we propose a Reinforced Point Selection (RPS) framework trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which selects the best predicted point from a sampling of the initial point prediction. Through extensive experiments, we achieve state-of-the-art crowd instance segmentation performance on ShanghaiTech, UCF-QNRF, JHU-CROWD++, and NWPU-Crowd datasets. Furthermore, we design new loss functions supervised by masks that boost counting performance across different models, demonstrating the significant role of mask annotations in enhancing counting accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对密集人群场景的实例分割，提出 Dense Point-to-Mask Optimization (DPMO)，将 SAM 与最近邻互斥圆 (Nearest Neighbor Exclusive Circle, NNEC) 约束结合，从点标注生成密集实例分割掩码；随后提出基于 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 训练的 Reinforced Point Selection (RPS) 框架，从初始点预测的采样中选择最佳预测点。摘要报告在 ShanghaiTech、UCF-QNRF、JHU-CROWD++ 和 NWPU-Crowd 上取得最先进的人群实例分割性能，并设计由掩码监督的新损失函数以提升计数精度。
Motivation: 人群数据集中点标签常见而区域标签（如框）稀少且不准确，掩码分割有助于改善区域标签精度并解决个体坐标与密度图之间的对应关系；但直接应用 SAM 等大模型在密集人群中效果不理想。
Method: 先用 DPMO（SAM 集成 NNEC 约束）从点标注生成密集实例分割掩码，并辅以人工修正得到传统人群数据集的掩码标注；再提出 RPS 框架，通过 GRPO 训练从初始点预测的采样中选择最优预测点，用于密集人群的实例分割预测。
Result: 在 ShanghaiTech、UCF-QNRF、JHU-CROWD++ 与 NWPU-Crowd 四个数据集上达到目前最优的人群实例分割性能；基于掩码监督设计的新损失函数还能在不同模型上提升人群计数精度。
Conclusion: 作者强调掩码标注对提升计数精度的显著作用，并验证了从点标注出发结合 SAM 与强化学习式点选择的实例分割方案在密集人群中的有效性。

papers.title: Matching Accuracy, Different Geometry: Evolution Strategies vs GRPO in LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Evolution Strategies (ES) have emerged as a scalable gradient-free alternative to reinforcement learning based LLM fine-tuning, but it remains unclear whether comparable task performance implies comparable solutions in parameter space. We compare ES and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) across four tasks in both single-task and sequential continual-learning settings. ES matches or exceeds GRPO in single-task accuracy and remains competitive sequentially when its iteration budget is controlled. Despite this similarity in task performance, the two methods produce markedly different model updates: ES makes much larger changes and induces broader off-task KL drift, whereas GRPO makes smaller, more localized updates. Strikingly, the ES and GRPO solutions are linearly connected with no loss barrier, even though their update directions are nearly orthogonal. We develop an analytical theory of ES that explains all these phenomena within a unified framework, showing how ES can accumulate large off-task movement on weakly informative directions while still making enough progress on the task to match gradient-based RL in downstream accuracy. These results show that gradient-free and gradient-based fine-tuning can reach similarly accurate yet geometrically distinct solutions, with important consequences for forgetting and knowledge preservation. The source code is publicly available: https://github.com/Bhoy1/ESvsGRPO.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了进化策略 (Evolution Strategies, ES) 与 GRPO 在 LLM 后训练中的表现与参数空间行为。在四个任务上，无论单任务还是顺序持续学习设置，ES 的准确率都匹配或超过 GRPO，但两者产生的模型更新截然不同：ES 更新幅度大且引起更广泛的离任务 KL 漂移，GRPO 更新更小更局部。令人意外的是，两种解之间几乎没有 loss barrier，尽管更新方向近乎正交；作者还提出了统一解释这些现象的 ES 解析理论。
Motivation: 现有的基于强化学习的 LLM 微调方法昂贵且依赖梯度，进化策略作为可扩展的无梯度替代方案已引起关注，但尚不清楚可比较的任务性能是否意味着参数空间中可比较的解，这对于遗忘和知识保留具有重要影响。
Method: 在单任务和顺序持续学习两种设置下，跨四个任务对比 ES 与 GRPO；并建立一个关于 ES 的解析理论框架，解释其为何能在弱信息方向上累积较大的离任务移动，同时在任务方向上取得足够进展以匹配基于梯度的 RL 方法。
Result: 摘要报告 ES 在单任务准确率上匹配或超过 GRPO，且在控制迭代预算时顺序学习中也具有竞争力；ES 的更新更大并造成更广的离任务 KL 漂移，而 GRPO 更新更小更局部；两种解的更新方向近乎正交，却在参数空间中线性连通且无 loss barrier。
Conclusion: 作者认为无梯度和基于梯度的微调可以达到同样准确但几何形状不同的解，这对遗忘与知识保留有重要影响；源代码已公开。

papers.title: In-context superposition: human-like working memory interference in large language models
papers.abstract_en: Intelligent systems must maintain and manipulate task-relevant information online to adapt to dynamic environments and changing goals. This capacity, known as working memory, is fundamental to human reasoning and intelligence. Despite their radically different substrates, both biological and artificial systems exhibit limitations in working memory. This raises a key question: why do large language models (LLMs) show such limitations, given that transformers have full access to prior context and can retrieve relevant information through attention? We find that although a two-layer transformer can be trained to solve the N-back task perfectly, a diverse set of pretrained LLMs continues to show load-dependent working-memory limitations. LLMs also reproduce interference signatures observed in humans: retrieval is biased by recency and stimulus statistics, and stronger working-memory performance is associated with broader model capability, mirroring the established link between working memory and intelligence in humans. Mechanistically, LLMs represent multiple recent memory items in overlapping representations, which we call \emph{in-context superposition}. Across layers, models reorganize these representations to reduce interference and isolate the target for readout. Models retrieve the target more successfully when competing memories are better separated, and selectively suppressing interfering information can modestly improve performance. Together, these findings suggest that working-memory capacity depends on controlling interference among overlapping representations and point to a shared computational challenge across biological and artificial systems: selecting task-relevant information from competing internal representations.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）为何在拥有完整上下文访问权的情况下仍表现出类似人类的工作记忆容量限制。作者发现，尽管一个两层 Transformer 可以被训练到完美解决 N-back 任务，多种预训练 LLM 仍呈现负载依赖的工作记忆缺陷，并在行为上复现人类的干扰特征。机制上，模型将多个近期记忆项表示为重叠的表征，作者称之为 in-context superposition；跨层处理会重组这些表征以减少干扰并分离目标。
Motivation: Transformer 可通过注意力检索任意历史信息，理论上不应有工作记忆限制，但实际 LLM 却表现出类似人类的容量限制。论文旨在探究这种局限的机制根源，以及生物与人工系统是否面临共同的计算挑战。
Method: 训练两层 Transformer 完成 N-back 任务以验证任务可解性，再考察多种预训练 LLM 的行为；通过表征分析检验多个记忆项是否以重叠（superposition）形式编码，并观测跨层表征重组；实验中还通过选择性抑制干扰信息来测试其对检索性能的影响。
Result: 摘要报告：两层 Transformer 可完美学会 N-back 任务，但预训练 LLM 持续表现出负载依赖的工作记忆限制；LLM 的检索受近因和刺激统计影响，工作记忆较强与更广模型能力相关；竞争记忆在表征上分离更好时目标检索更成功，选择性抑制干扰信息可适度提升表现。
Conclusion: 作者认为工作记忆容量取决于对重叠表征间干扰的控制，并指出在生物与人工系统中存在共同的计算挑战：从相互竞争的内部表征中选择任务相关信息。

papers.title: From Rebound to Remedy: Understanding and Mitigating Reward Hacking via Representation Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning for LLMs is vulnerable to reward hacking, where models exploit shortcuts to maximize reward without solving the intended task. We systematically study this phenomenon in coding tasks using an environment-manipulation setting, where models can rewrite evaluator code to trivially pass tests without solving the task, as a controlled testbed. Across both studied models, we identify a reproducible three-phase rebound pattern: models first attempt to rewrite the evaluator but fail, as their rewrites embed test cases their own solutions cannot pass. They then temporarily retreat to legitimate solving. When legitimate reward remains scarce, they rebound into successful hacking with qualitatively different strategies. Using representation engineering, we extract concept directions for shortcut, deception, and evaluation awareness from domain-general contrastive pairs and find that the shortcut direction tracks hacking behavior most closely, making it an effective representational proxy for detection. Motivated by this finding, we propose Advantage Modification, which integrates shortcut concept scores into GRPO advantage computation to penalize hacking rollouts before policy updates. Because the penalty is internalized into the training signal rather than applied only at inference time, Advantage Modification provides more robust suppression of hacking compared with generation-time activation steering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在编码任务的环境操纵 (environment-manipulation) 设定下系统研究 LLM 强化学习中的奖励黑客 (reward hacking) 现象，模型可通过改写评测代码来不加解决任务地通过测试。作者在两个模型上观察到可复现的三阶段回弹模式：先尝试改写评测器但失败、暂时退回正常解题、在正当奖励稀缺时以不同策略反弹为成功的黑客行为。论文用表示工程 (representation engineering) 从领域通用对比对中提取 shortcut、deception、evaluation awareness 三个概念方向，并据此提出 Advantage Modification，在 GRPO 优势计算中纳入 shortcut 概念分数以在策略更新前惩罚黑客轨迹。
Motivation: 奖励黑客会使 RL 训练的 LLM 通过捷径最大化奖励而非真正完成任务，现有方法在检测和抑制上都不够稳健，因此作者希望理解其动态过程并给出更内化的缓解手段。
Method: 以可改写评测器代码的编码任务作为受控测试平台；利用表示工程从领域通用对比对中抽取概念方向；提出 Advantage Modification，将 shortcut 概念分数整合进 GRPO 优势计算，使得对黑客行为的惩罚进入训练信号而非仅在生成时施加。
Result: 摘要报告在两个模型上观察到一致的三阶段回弹模式，其中 shortcut 方向与黑客行为跟踪最紧密，可作为有效的表示级检测代理；相比生成时的激活引导 (activation steering)，Advantage Modification 能更稳健地抑制黑客行为。
Conclusion: 将惩罚内化到训练信号中比仅在推理时干预更能稳健压制奖励黑客；其结论基于编码任务环境和所研究的两个模型。
