papers.title: SciVisAgentBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Scientific Data Analysis and Visualization Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agentic systems to translate natural-language intent into executable scientific visualization (SciVis) tasks. Despite rapid progress, the community lacks a principled and reproducible benchmark for evaluating these emerging SciVis agents in realistic, multi-step analysis settings. We present SciVisAgentBench, a comprehensive and extensible benchmark for evaluating scientific data analysis and visualization agents. Our benchmark is grounded in a structured taxonomy spanning four dimensions: application domain, data type, complexity level, and visualization operation. It currently comprises 108 expert-crafted cases covering diverse SciVis scenarios. To enable reliable assessment, we introduce a multimodal outcome-centric evaluation pipeline that combines LLM-based judging with deterministic evaluators, including image-based metrics, code checkers, rule-based verifiers, and case-specific evaluators. We also conduct a validity study with 12 SciVis experts to examine the agreement between human and LLM judges. Using this framework, we evaluate representative SciVis agents and general-purpose coding agents to establish initial baselines and reveal capability gaps. SciVisAgentBench is designed as a living benchmark to support systematic comparison, diagnose failure modes, and drive progress in agentic SciVis. The benchmark is available at https://scivisagentbench.github.io/.
papers.comment: IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics (IEEE VIS '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SciVisAgentBench，一个用于评估科学数据分析和可视化智能体（SciVis agents）的综合可扩展基准测试。基准基于应用领域、数据类型、复杂度水平和可视化操作四个维度的结构化分类法，包含 108 个专家设计的案例，并引入结合 LLM 判断与确定性评估器（图像指标、代码检查、规则验证、案例特定评估器）的多模态结果导向评估流程。作者通过 12 位领域专家的有效性研究检验了人类与 LLM 判断的一致性，并对代表性 SciVis 智能体和通用编码智能体建立初始基线，揭示能力差距。
Motivation: 尽管 LLM 推动的智能体系统已能将自然语言意图转化为可执行的科学可视化任务，但社区缺乏一个原则性的、可复现的基准来评估这类新兴智能体在真实、多步分析场景中的表现，因此需要系统化的对比与失败模式诊断工具。
Method: 基准基于四维分类法（应用领域、数据类型、复杂度水平、可视化操作）组织案例，并设计多模态结果导向评估流程，将 LLM 评判与确定性评估器（包括图像指标、代码检查器、规则验证器和案例特定评估器）相结合，以实现可靠评估。
Result: 通过 12 位 SciVis 专家参与的有效性研究，验证了人类与 LLM 判断之间的一致性；基于该框架评估了代表性 SciVis 智能体和通用编码智能体，建立了初始基线并揭示了能力差距（摘要未给出具体量化数字）。
Conclusion: SciVisAgentBench 被设计为一个持续更新（living）的基准，旨在支持系统化比较、诊断失败模式，并推动代理式科学可视化（agentic SciVis）领域的发展。

papers.title: MonitorBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Chain-of-Thought Monitorability in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can generate chains of thought (CoTs) that are not always causally responsible for their final outputs. When such a mismatch occurs, the CoT no longer faithfully reflects the actual reasons (i.e., decision-critical factors) driving the model's behavior, leading to the reduced CoT monitorability problem. This limits the use of CoTs for reliable oversight. However, a comprehensive and fully open-source benchmark for thoroughly evaluating CoT monitorability remains lacking. To address this gap, we propose MonitorBench, a systematic benchmark for evaluating CoT monitorability in LLMs. MonitorBench provides: (1) a diverse set of 1,514 test instances with carefully designed decision-critical factors across 19 tasks spanning 7 categories to characterize when CoTs can be used to monitor the factors driving LLM behavior; and (2) two prompting stress-test settings to quantify the extent to which CoT monitorability can be degraded. Extensive experiments show that CoT monitorability is a conditional property affected by the evaluated LLM, monitor LLM, and task characteristics. Across these factors, monitorability is higher when decision-critical factors shape the intermediate reasoning process, rather than merely influencing the final answer. Under stress-test prompting, most evaluated LLMs can intentionally reduce monitorability, mainly on tasks where decision-critical factors are not structurally required by the reasoning process. Overall, MonitorBench provides a basis for further research on AI control, reasoning faithfulness, stress-test monitorability, and monitoring scaffords. The code is available at https://github.com/ASTRAL-Group/MonitorBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MonitorBench，一个用于系统评估大语言模型思维链（CoT）可监控性（monitorability）的基准。该基准提供 1,514 个测试实例，覆盖 19 个任务、7 个类别，并设计两种提示压力测试设置。实验表明 CoT 可监控性是一种条件属性，受被评估 LLM、监控 LLM 和任务特征影响，且在压力测试下多数模型能有意降低可监控性。
Motivation: LLM 生成的 CoT 并非总是最终输出的因果原因，这种不匹配使 CoT 无法忠实反映驱动模型行为的决策关键因素（decision-critical factors），即 CoT 可监控性降低，限制了 CoT 用于可靠监督。然而目前缺乏全面且完全开源的基准来评估 CoT 可监控性。
Method: 提出 MonitorBench 基准，包含精心设计决策关键因素的 1,514 个测试实例，覆盖 19 个任务、7 个类别；并提供两种提示压力测试设置，用于量化 CoT 可监控性被降低的程度。
Result: 实验显示 CoT 可监控性受被评估 LLM、监控 LLM 和任务特征共同影响；当决策关键因素塑造中间推理过程而非仅影响最终答案时，可监控性更高。在压力测试提示下，多数被评估 LLM 能有意降低可监控性，主要发生在决策关键因素并非推理过程结构性要求的任务上。
Conclusion: MonitorBench 为 AI 控制、推理忠实性、压力测试可监控性以及监控脚手架（monitoring scaffolds）等进一步研究提供了基础，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Comparative Study in Surgical AI: Potential and Limitations of Data, Compute, and Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Recent Artificial Intelligence (AI) models have matched or exceeded human experts in several benchmarks of biomedical task performance, but surgical benchmarks in particular are often missing from prominent medical benchmark suites. Since surgery requires integrating disparate tasks, generally-capable AI models could be particularly attractive as a collaborative tool if performance could be improved. On the one hand, the canonical approach of scaling architecture size and training data is attractive, especially since there are millions of hours of surgical video data generated per year. On the other hand, preparing surgical data for AI training requires significantly higher levels of professional expertise, and training on that data requires expensive computational resources. These trade-offs paint an uncertain picture of whether and to-what-extent modern AI could aid surgical practice. In this paper, we explore this question through a case study of surgical tool detection using state-of-the-art AI methods available in 2026. We demonstrate that even with multi-billion parameter models and extensive training, current Vision Language Models fall short in the seemingly simple task of tool detection in neurosurgery. Additionally, we show scaling experiments indicating that increasing model size and training time only leads to diminishing improvements in relevant performance metrics. Thus, our experiments suggest that current models could still face significant obstacles in surgical use cases. Moreover, some obstacles cannot be simply ``scaled away'' with additional compute and persist across diverse model architectures, raising the question of whether data and label availability are the only limiting factors. We discuss the main contributors to these constraints and advance potential solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以2026年最先进的AI方法为背景，通过神经外科手术工具检测这一案例，系统考察数据、算力与规模扩展对手术AI性能的影响。作者发现即使使用数十亿参数的大模型，当前视觉语言模型（Vision Language Models）在该看似简单的任务上仍表现不佳，且增大模型规模与训练时长只能带来递减的性能提升，表明手术场景下AI面临难以靠算力堆叠解决的障碍。
Motivation: 手术基准常常缺席主流医学基准套件，而手术需要整合不同任务，通用AI若性能足够可成为协作工具；但手术数据标注需要高水平专业知识和昂贵计算资源，使得AI能否以及能在多大程度上辅助手术实践存在不确定性。
Method: 以神经外科手术工具检测为案例研究，使用2026年可获得的多种先进视觉语言模型，并通过规模扩展实验（增大模型参数量和训练时间）来评估性能变化趋势。
Result: 即使数十亿参数的模型在手术工具检测上仍表现不足；规模扩展实验显示增加模型大小与训练时长仅带来递减的性能提升，且部分障碍在不同模型架构中持续存在，无法仅靠更多计算消除。
Conclusion: 作者认为当前模型在手术应用场景仍面临显著阻碍，且这些障碍不能简单通过扩展计算来解决，并讨论了限制因素的主要来源及潜在解决方案。

papers.title: Where and How to Prune: An Empirical Study of Visual Token Pruning for GUI Agent Navigation
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, GUI agents have demonstrated strong potential in navigation tasks. However, preserving complete historical screenshots introduces substantial computational overhead. This paper investigates how token pruning, a plug-and-play inference acceleration technique, can be effectively applied to GUI agent navigation scenarios. Firstly, we address the question of where pruning should occur. We identify a system-level redundancy overlooked by existing methods: as the same screenshot is repeatedly fed into the model across different steps, its ViT encoding is redundantly recomputed each time. We show that its ViT-encoded embeddings can be fully cached and reused across steps, substantially reducing FLOPs while preserving model performance. This finding suggests that inference acceleration efforts should focus on the subsequent Large Language Model (LLM). Building on this, we further address the question of how to prune within the LLM, and distill two key insights: (i) from a semantic perspective, the token budget should be balanced between foreground and background regions; (ii) from a spatial perspective, the spatial uniformity of retained tokens should be maintained to preserve the model's global spatial perception. These findings provide practical guidance for the design of inference acceleration and token pruning for GUI agent navigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 GUI 智能体导航中的推理开销问题，实证研究视觉 token 剪枝 (visual token pruning) 的剪枝位置与剪枝方式。作者指出同一截图在多个步骤中被重复送入模型、其 ViT 编码被冗余重算这一系统级冗余，并表明该 ViT embedding 可以跨步骤缓存复用，从而在保持性能的同时大幅降低 FLOPs；随后将加速重点转向 LLM 内部的 token 剪枝，并提出前后景预算平衡与保留 token 空间均匀性两条经验性结论。
Motivation: GUI 智能体在导航任务中保留完整历史截图会带来可观的计算开销，现有 token 剪枝方法忽略了同一截图跨步骤重复输入导致 ViT 编码被反复重算这一系统级冗余。
Method: 采用实证研究方式：先在视觉编码侧对同一截图的 ViT 编码 embedding 做完整缓存与跨步骤复用；再针对后续 LLM 的 token 剪枝总结两项原则，即语义上在前景与背景区域之间平衡 token 预算，空间上维持保留 token 的空间均匀性以保持全局空间感知。
Result: 摘要报告 ViT 编码可完全缓存并在步骤间复用，在显著降低 FLOPs 的同时保持模型性能，并由此将推理加速重点转移到 LLM 剪枝上。
Conclusion: 作者总结这些发现可为 GUI 智能体导航的推理加速与 token 剪枝设计提供实用指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Explaining, Verifying, and Aligning Semantic Hierarchies in Vision-Language Model Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language model (VLM) encoders such as CLIP enable strong retrieval and zero-shot classification in a shared image-text embedding space, yet the semantic organization of this space is rarely inspected. We present a post-hoc framework to explain, verify, and align the semantic hierarchies induced by a VLM over a given set of child classes. First, we extract a binary hierarchy by agglomerative clustering of class centroids and name internal nodes by dictionary-based matching to a concept bank. Second, we quantify plausibility by comparing the extracted tree against human ontologies using efficient tree- and edge-level consistency measures, and we evaluate utility via explainable hierarchical tree-traversal inference with uncertainty-aware early stopping (UAES). Third, we propose an ontology-guided post-hoc alignment method that learns a lightweight embedding-space transformation, using UMAP to generate target neighborhoods from a desired hierarchy. Across 13 pretrained VLMs and 4 image datasets, our method finds systematic modality differences: image encoders are more discriminative, while text encoders induce hierarchies that better match human taxonomies. Overall, the results reveal a persistent trade-off between zero-shot accuracy and ontological plausibility and suggest practical routes to improve semantic alignment in shared embedding spaces.
papers.comment: camera-ready version of accepted IJCAI-ECAI 2026 paper including supplementary material; code: https://github.com/gesina/ontological-commitment
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个事后(post-hoc)框架，用于解释、验证并对齐视觉语言模型(VLM)如CLIP在给定子类集合上诱导的语义层次结构。方法包括对类中心做凝聚聚类提取二叉层次并命名内部节点，用树级和边级一致性度量对比人类本体，以及通过UMAP从目标层次生成目标邻域来学习轻量级嵌入变换。在13个预训练VLM和4个图像数据集上，作者发现图像编码器判别力更强，而文本编码器诱导的层次更符合人类分类学，并观察到零样本准确率与本体合理性之间的权衡。
Motivation: VLM共享嵌入空间的语义组织很少被系统检查，缺少解释、验证和对齐其中隐含语义层次结构的通用手段。
Method: 提出一个事后框架：先用类中心的凝聚聚类提取二叉树并用词典匹配到概念库来命名内部节点；然后通过高效的树级和边级一致性度量对比人类本体，并用带不确定性感知早停(UAES)的可解释层次树遍历推理评估效用；最后提出本体引导(post-hoc)对齐方法，用UMAP从期望层次生成目标邻域并学习轻量级嵌入空间变换。
Result: 在13个预训练VLM和4个图像数据集上，发现图像编码器更具判别性，而文本编码器诱导的层次更匹配人类分类学；总体结果揭示了零样本准确率与本体合理性之间持续的权衡(trade-off)。
Conclusion: 结果表明了在共享嵌入空间中改善语义对齐的实用路径，同时强调这类对齐需要在零样本准确率与本体合理性之间做出取舍。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Bridging the Evaluation Gap: Standardized Benchmarks for Multi-Objective Search
papers.abstract_en: Empirical evaluation in multi-objective search (MOS) has historically suffered from fragmentation, relying on heterogeneous problem instances with incompatible objective definitions that make cross-study comparisons difficult. This standardization gap is further exacerbated by the realization that DIMACS road networks, a historical default benchmark for the field, exhibit highly correlated objectives that fail to capture diverse Pareto-front structures. To address this, we introduce the first comprehensive, standardized benchmark suite for exact and approximate MOS. Our suite spans four structurally diverse domains: real-world road networks, structured synthetic graphs, game-based grid environments, and high-dimensional robotic motion-planning roadmaps. By providing fixed graph instances, standardized start-goal queries, reference exact Pareto-optimal solution sets, and a standardized approximate ($\varepsilon$-dominance) evaluation protocol, this suite captures a full spectrum of objective interactions: from strongly correlated to strictly independent. Ultimately, this benchmark provides a common foundation to ensure future MOS evaluations are robust, reproducible, and structurally comprehensive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多目标搜索 (multi-objective search, MOS) 实证评估长期碎片化的问题，提出首个标准化基准套件。该套件覆盖真实路网、结构化合成图、基于游戏的网格环境和机器人运动规划道路图四类结构迥异的域，并提供固定图实例、标准化起点-终点查询、参考精确 Pareto 最优解集以及标准化 ε-支配评估协议。摘要指出该套件涵盖从强相关到严格独立的目标交互谱系，旨在为未来 MOS 评估提供共同基础。
Motivation: 历史上 MOS 的实证评估依赖异构的问题实例和不兼容的目标定义，导致跨研究比较困难；同时 DIMACS 路网这一常用默认基准的目标高度相关，无法捕捉多样的 Pareto-front 结构。
Method: 构建首个覆盖四类结构不同领域的综合基准套件，包括固定图实例、标准化 start-goal 查询、参考精确 Pareto 最优解集，以及标准化的近似 (ε-dominance) 评估协议。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果或数值；其主要成果是提供一个覆盖强相关到严格独立目标交互结构的标准化评估基础设施。
Conclusion: 作者认为该基准为未来 MOS 评估建立了稳健、可复现且结构全面的共同基础。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 构建首个覆盖四类结构不同领域的综合基准套件，包括固定图实例、标准化 start-goal 查询、参考精确 Pareto 最优解集，以及标准化的近似 (ε-dominance) 评估协议。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果或数值；其主要成果是提供一个覆盖强相关到严格独立目标交互结构的标准化评估基础设施。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该基准为未来 MOS 评估建立了稳健、可复现且结构全面的共同基础。

papers.title: SPA: A Simple but Tough-to-Beat Baseline for Knowledge Injection
papers.abstract_en: While large language models (LLMs) are pretrained on massive amounts of data, their knowledge coverage remains incomplete in specialized, data-scarce domains, motivating extensive efforts to study synthetic data generation for knowledge injection. We propose SPA (Scaling Prompt-engineered Augmentation), a simple but tough-to-beat baseline that uses a small set of carefully designed prompts to generate large-scale synthetic data for knowledge injection. Through systematic comparisons, we find that SPA outperforms several strong baselines. Furthermore, we identify two key limitations of prior approaches: (1) while RL-based methods may improve the token efficiency of LLM-based data augmentation at small scale, they suffer from diversity collapse as data scales, leading to diminishing returns; and (2) while multi-stage prompting may outperform simple augmentation methods, their advantages can disappear after careful prompt tuning. Our results suggest that, for knowledge injection, careful prompt design combined with straightforward large-scale augmentation can be surprisingly effective, and we hope SPA can serve as a strong baseline for future studies in this area. Our code is available at https://github.com/Tangkexian/SPA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPA（Scaling Prompt-engineered Augmentation），一种用于知识注入（knowledge injection）的简单但难以击败的基线方法，利用少量精心设计的提示词生成大规模合成数据。系统比较显示 SPA 优于多个强基线，并揭示了两类先前方法的局限：RL 类增强在小规模下提升 token 效率但在数据规模增大时出现多样性坍塌（diversity collapse），多阶段提示的优势在仔细提示调优后可能消失。作者希望 SPA 能作为该领域未来研究的强基线。
Motivation: 大规模语言模型在数据稀缺的专业领域知识覆盖不完整，促使大量研究探索用于知识注入的合成数据生成，但缺乏一个简单且具有竞争力的基线。
Method: 提出 SPA 基线，即用少量精心设计的提示生成大规模合成数据；通过系统性比较多种方法，并分析 RL 类增强和多阶段提示策略各自的局限。
Result: 摘要报告 SPA 在系统比较中胜过多个强基线；RL 类方法在小规模下改善 token 效率，但扩展数据规模后遭遇多样性坍塌并收益递减；多阶段提示的优势也可能在提示调优后消失。
Conclusion: 摘要总结认为，对知识注入而言，慎重的提示设计配合直接的大规模增强可以出人意料地有效，并希望 SPA 成为未来研究的强基线；代码已公开。

papers.title: Beyond Static Models: An Evolving Framework for Continual Learning in Large Language Models across Training Stages
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning (CL) has emerged as a pivotal paradigm to enable large language models (LLMs) to dynamically adapt to evolving knowledge and sequential tasks while mitigating catastrophic forgetting, a critical limitation of the static pre-training paradigm inherent to modern LLMs. This paper presents a comprehensive overview of CL methodologies tailored for LLMs, structured around three core training stages: continual pre-training, continual fine-tuning, and continual alignment. Beyond the canonical taxonomy of rehearsal-, regularization-, and architecture-based methods, we further subdivide each category by its distinct forgetting mitigation mechanisms and conduct a rigorous comparative analysis of the adaptability and critical improvements of traditional CL methods for LLMs. In doing so, we explicitly highlight core distinctions between LLM CL and traditional machine learning, particularly with respect to scale, parameter efficiency, and emergent capabilities. Our analysis covers essential evaluation metrics, including forgetting rates and knowledge transfer efficiency, along with emerging benchmarks for assessing CL performance. While current methods show promising results, fundamental challenges persist in achieving seamless knowledge integration, and we identify key open problems and future directions for the field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于大语言模型（LLM）持续学习（continual learning）的综述，围绕持续预训练、持续微调和持续对齐三个训练阶段组织。作者在传统基于重放、正则化和架构的方法分类基础上，按遗忘缓解机制进一步细分，并比较了传统持续学习方法在LLM上的适应性与关键改进。论文还讨论了评估指标、新兴基准以及开放问题。
Motivation: LLM的静态预训练范式难以适应不断演进的知识与序列任务，持续学习被视为缓解灾难性遗忘的关键范式，但传统CL方法在LLM上的适用性需要系统梳理。
Method: 提出一个围绕持续预训练、持续微调、持续对齐三阶段组织的综述框架；在重放、正则化、架构三类方法下按遗忘缓解机制细分，并对比传统机器学习与LLM持续学习在规模、参数效率和涌现能力上的差异。
Result: 摘要报告对现有方法进行了严格比较分析，覆盖遗忘率、知识迁移效率等评估指标及新兴基准；指出当前方法虽有前景，但在流畅知识整合上仍存在根本性挑战。
Conclusion: 作者识别了关键开放问题与未来方向，强调LLM持续学习与传统机器学习存在核心区别，实现无缝知识整合仍是尚未解决的难题。

papers.title: Efficient Cross-View Localization in 6G Space-Air-Ground Integrated Network
papers.abstract_en: Recently, visual localization has become an important supplement to improve localization reliability, and cross-view approaches can greatly enhance coverage and adaptability. Meanwhile, future 6G will enable a globally covered mobile communication system, with a space-air-ground integrated network (SAGIN) serving as key supporting architecture. Inspired by this, we explore an integration of cross-view localization (CVL) with 6G SAGIN, thereby enhancing its performance in latency, energy consumption, and privacy protection. First, we provide a comprehensive review of CVL and SAGIN, highlighting their capabilities, integration opportunities, and potential applications. Benefiting from the fast and extensive image collection and transmission capabilities of the 6G SAGIN architecture, CVL achieves higher localization accuracy and faster processing speed. Then, we propose a split-inference framework for implementing CVL, which fully leverages the distributed communication and computing resources of the 6G SAGIN architecture. Subsequently, we conduct joint optimization of communication, computation, and confidentiality within the proposed split-inference framework, aiming to provide a paradigm and a direction for making CVL efficient. Experimental results validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and provide solutions to the optimization problem. Finally, we discuss potential research directions for 6G SAGIN-enabled CVL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨将跨视角定位 (cross-view localization, CVL) 与6G空天地一体化网络 (space-air-ground integrated network, SAGIN) 相结合，以改善定位的延迟、能耗与隐私保护性能。作者综述了CVL与SAGIN各自的特性、集成机会与潜在应用，并提出一种分割推理 (split-inference) 框架，利用6G SAGIN的分布式通信与计算资源。在该框架内对通信、计算与机密性进行联合优化，实验验证了框架有效性，最后讨论了未来研究方向。
Motivation: 现有视觉定位在可靠性上有局限，跨视角方法可增强覆盖与适应性；6G将提供全球覆盖的移动通信架构，而SAGIN是其中关键支撑，因此希望将CVL与SAGIN集成以提升性能。
Method: 提出用于CVL的分割推理框架，充分利用6G SAGIN架构的分布式通信与计算资源，并在该框架内对通信、计算和机密性进行联合优化，以提供实现高效CVL的范式。
Result: 实验验证了所提框架的有效性，并为所提出的优化问题提供了解决方案；摘要未给出具体的量化性能数字。
Conclusion: 论文将该工作定位为在6G SAGIN中高效实现CVL的范式与方向，并展望了6G SAGIN赋能的CVL的潜在研究课题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Estimating Condition Number with Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a fast method for estimating the condition number of sparse matrices using graph neural networks (GNNs). For efficient deployment of GNNs, we introduce a graph feature construction with $\mathrm{O}(\mathrm{nnz} + n)$ complexity, where $\mathrm{nnz}$ is the number of non-zero elements in the matrix and $n$ denotes the matrix dimension. We propose two schemes for estimating the matrix condition number using GNNs; one follows by decomposing the condition number and predicts the relatively more computationally intensive part $\|\mathbf{A}^{-1}\|$, without explicitly forming the inverse, while the other is to predict the whole condition number $κ$. Our approach can be extended to an arbitrary norm. Extensive experiments are conducted for the estimation of the 1-norm and 2-norm condition numbers, which show that our method achieves a significant speedup over the traditional numerical estimation methods. Our software for GNN condition number estimator is made publicly available at https://github.com/inEXASCALE/sparse-kappa.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用图神经网络（GNN）快速估计稀疏矩阵条件数的方法。作者设计了复杂度为 O(nnz+n) 的图特征构造，并提出两种估计方案：一种通过分解条件数仅预测计算较重的部分 ||A^{-1}||，另一种直接预测整个条件数 κ。该方法可扩展到任意范数，实验针对 1-范数和 2-范数条件数估计，显示相比传统数值估计方法有显著加速。
Motivation: 传统条件数数值估计方法计算开销大，尤其对大规模稀疏矩阵而言，需要更高效的估计途径。
Method: 使用 GNN 估计稀疏矩阵条件数；通过图特征构造实现 O(nnz+n) 复杂度，并设计两种预测方案（预测 ||A^{-1}|| 或直接预测 κ），无需显式形成逆矩阵，且可推广到任意范数。
Result: 对 1-范数和 2-范数条件数的实验中，该方法相比传统数值估计方法实现了显著加速。
Conclusion: 本文表明 GNN 可以高效且准确地估计稀疏矩阵条件数，并开源了相关软件实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PolypSteer: Counterfactual Endoscopic Synthesis via Training-Free Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Generative diffusion models are increasingly used for medical imaging data augmentation, but text prompting cannot produce causal training data. Re-prompting rerolls the entire generation trajectory, altering anatomy, texture, and background. Inversion-based editing methods introduce reconstruction error that causes structural drift. We propose PolypSteer, a training-free activation-steering framework for endoscopic synthesis. PolypSteer identifies a pathology vector for each contrastive prompt pair in the cross-attention layers of a diffusion transformer. At inference time, it steers image activations along this vector, generating counterfactual pairs from scratch where the only difference is the steered concept. All other structure is preserved by construction. We evaluate PolypSteer across three experiments on Kvasir v3 and HyperKvasir. On counterfactual generation across three clinical concept pairs, PolypSteer achieves flip rates of 0.800, 0.925, and 0.950, outperforming the best inversion-based baseline in both concept flip rate and structural preservation. On dye disentanglement, PolypSteer achieves 75% dye removal against 20% (PnP) and 10% (h-Edit). On downstream polyp detection, augmenting with PolypSteer counterfactual pairs achieves ViT AUC of 0.9755 versus 0.9083 for quantity-matched re-prompting, confirming that counterfactual structure drives the gain. Code is at link https://github.com/UARK-AICV/PolypSteer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PolypSteer，一个免训练的激活引导 (activation steering) 框架，用于内镜图像的反事实合成。该方法在扩散 Transformer (diffusion transformer) 的交叉注意力层中为对比提示对提取病理向量，并在推理时引导图像激活沿该向量移动，从而从零生成仅概念不同的反事实图像对。在 Kvasir v3 和 HyperKvasir 上的实验显示，其概念翻转率和结构保持均优于最先进的基于反演 (inversion) 的基线，并能提升下游息肉检测性能。
Motivation: 扩散模型用于医学影像数据增强时，文本提示无法生成因果训练数据，而重新提示 (re-prompting) 会重掷整个生成轨迹、改变解剖结构、纹理和背景；基于反演的编辑方法则会引入重建误差导致结构漂移。
Method: PolypSteer 在扩散 Transformer 的交叉注意力层中为每对对比提示识别一个病理向量，并在推理时沿该向量引导图像激活，从而生成反事实图像对，除被引导的概念外其余结构由构造保证不变。该方法无需训练。
Result: 在三个临床概念对的反事实生成上，PolypSteer 的翻转率为 0.800、0.925 和 0.950，在概念翻转率和结构保持上均超过最佳反演基线；染料去除上达到 75%，高于 PnP 的 20% 和 h-Edit 的 10%；在下游息肉检测中，用 PolypSteer 反事实对增强使 ViT AUC 达到 0.9755，优于数量匹配的重新提示方法的 0.9083。
Conclusion: 摘要强调反事实结构本身是性能提升的来源，PolypSteer 以免训练、结构保持的方式生成反事实内镜图像，适用于医学影像数据增强。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在三个临床概念对的反事实生成上，PolypSteer 的翻转率为 0.800、0.925 和 0.950，在概念翻转率和结构保持上均超过最佳反演基线；染料去除上达到 75%，高于 PnP 的 20% 和 h-Edit 的 10%；在下游息肉检测中，用 PolypSteer 反事实对增强使 ViT AUC 达到 0.9755，优于数量匹配的重新提示方法的 0.9083。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调反事实结构本身是性能提升的来源，PolypSteer 以免训练、结构保持的方式生成反事实内镜图像，适用于医学影像数据增强。

papers.title: Variance reduction in lattice QCD observables via normalizing flows
papers.abstract_en: Normalizing flows can be used to construct unbiased, reduced-variance estimators for lattice field theory observables that are defined by a derivative with respect to action parameters. This work implements the approach for observables involving gluonic operator insertions in the SU(3) Yang-Mills theory and two-flavor Quantum Chromodynamics (QCD) in four space-time dimensions. Variance reduction by factors of $10$-$60$ is achieved in glueball correlation functions and in gluonic matrix elements related to hadron structure, with demonstrated computational advantages. The observed variance reduction is found to be approximately independent of the lattice volume, so that volume transfer can be utilized to minimize training costs.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用归一化流 (normalizing flows) 为晶格场论中由作用量参数导数定义的观测量构造无偏、低方差的估计器，并在四维 SU(3) Yang-Mills 理论和两味量子色动力学 (QCD) 中实现。摘要报告在胶球关联函数和与强子结构相关的胶子矩阵元上实现了 10–60 倍的方差缩减，且具有计算优势；方差缩减幅度近似不依赖晶格体积，因此可利用体积转移来降低训练成本。
Motivation: 晶格 QCD 中由作用量参数导数定义的观测量通常存在较大统计方差，需要有效的方差缩减技术来提高计算效率。
Method: 采用归一化流构造无偏且方差缩减的估计器，将其应用于四维 SU(3) Yang-Mills 理论和两味 QCD 中包含胶子算符插入的观测量。
Result: 在胶球关联函数和与强子结构相关的胶子矩阵元上实现 10–60 倍的方差缩减，并展示出计算优势；方差缩减近似不依赖晶格体积。
Conclusion: 摘要强调由于方差缩减与体积近似无关，可以利用体积转移来最小化训练成本，从而进一步提升该方法的实用性。

papers.title: Doubly Adaptive Channel and Spatial Attention for Semantic Image Communication by IoT Devices
papers.abstract_en: Internet of Things (IoT) networks face significant challenges such as limited communication bandwidth, constrained computational and energy resources, and highly dynamic wireless channel conditions. Utilization of deep neural networks (DNNs) combined with semantic communication has emerged as a promising paradigm to address these limitations. Deep joint source-channel coding (DJSCC) has recently been proposed to enable semantic communication of images. Building upon the original DJSCC formulation, low-complexity attention-style architectures has been added to the DNNs for further performance enhancement. As a main hurdle, training these DNNs separately for various signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) will amount to excessive storage or communication overhead, which can not be maintained by small IoT devices. SNR Adaptive DJSCC (ADJSCC), has been proposed to train the DNNs once but feed the current SNR as part of the data to the channel-wise attention mechanism. We improve upon ADJSCC by a simultaneous utilization of doubly adaptive channel-wise and spatial attention modules at both transmitter and receiver. These modules dynamically adjust to varying channel conditions and spatial feature importance, enabling robust and efficient feature extraction and semantic information recovery. Simulation results corroborate that our proposed doubly adaptive DJSCC (DA-DJSCC) significantly improves upon ADJSCC in several performance criteria, while incurring a mild increase in complexity. These facts render DA-DJSCC a desirable choice for semantic communication in performance demanding but low-complexity IoT networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双重自适应 DJSCC（DA-DJSCC），在发射端和接收端同时引入通道注意力与空间注意力模块，作为对 SNR 自适应 DJSCC（ADJSCC）的改进，用于 IoT 网络的语义图像通信。摘要称仿真结果表明该方法在多个性能指标上显著优于 ADJSCC，且仅带来轻度的复杂度增加。
Motivation: IoT 网络面临带宽受限、计算和能源资源受限以及高度动态的无线信道条件，DJSCC 被用作图像语义通信方案；但针对不同 SNR 分别训练 DNN 会产生过多存储或通信开销，小型 IoT 设备难以承受。ADJSCC 通过一次训练并将当前 SNR 输入通道注意力机制来解决该问题，但仍有改进空间。
Method: 在 ADJSCC 基础上，同时在发射机和接收机中联合使用双重自适应的通道注意力（channel-wise attention）和空间注意力（spatial attention）模块，使其动态适应变化的信道条件与空间特征重要性，以实现鲁棒高效的特征提取和语义信息恢复。
Result: 仿真结果显示，DA-DJSCC 在多个性能准则上显著优于 ADJSCC，同时只带来轻微复杂度上升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DA-DJSCC 适用于性能要求较高但复杂度受限的 IoT 网络中的语义通信场景。

papers.title: SMAC: Score-Matched Actor-Critics for Robust Offline-to-Online Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Modern offline Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods find performant actor-critics, however, fine-tuning these actor-critics online with value-based RL algorithms typically causes immediate drops in performance. We provide evidence consistent with the hypothesis that, in the loss landscape, offline maxima for prior algorithms and online maxima are separated by low-performance valleys that gradient-based fine-tuning traverses. Following this, we present Score Matched Actor-Critic (SMAC), an offline RL method designed to learn actor-critics that transition to online value-based RL algorithms with no drop in performance. SMAC avoids valleys between offline and online maxima by regularizing the Q-function during the offline phase to respect a first-order derivative equality between the score of the policy and action-gradient of the Q-function. We experimentally demonstrate that SMAC converges to offline maxima that are connected to better online maxima via paths with monotonically increasing reward found by first-order optimization. SMAC achieves smooth transfer to Soft Actor-Critic and TD3 in 6/6 D4RL tasks. In 4/6 environments, it reduces regret by 34-58% over the best baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Score Matched Actor-Critic (SMAC)，一种离线强化学习方法，旨在让离线训练得到的 actor-critic 在切换到在线 value-based 算法时性能不下降。作者给出证据支持离线最优与在线最优之间被低性能谷分隔的假设，并通过对 Q 函数施加一阶导数正则化来避开这些谷。实验显示 SMAC 在 6/6 个 D4RL 任务上能平滑迁移到 Soft Actor-Critic 和 TD3，并在 4/6 个环境中比最优基线降低 34-58% 的 regret。
Motivation: 离线 RL 方法训练出的 actor-critic 在用 value-based RL 算法在线微调时通常立即出现性能下降。论文假设这是由损失景观中离线最优与在线最优之间被低性能谷分隔，且梯度微调会穿越这些谷所导致。
Method: 提出 SMAC，在离线阶段对 Q 函数施加正则化，使其满足策略的 score 与 Q 函数动作梯度之间的一阶导数等式，从而避免离线与在线最优之间的性能谷，使一阶优化能找到单调递增回报的连接路径。
Result: 在 D4RL 的 6/6 个任务上，SMAC 训练得到的策略可平滑迁移到 Soft Actor-Critic 和 TD3；在 4/6 个环境中比最佳基线降低 34-58% 的 regret。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SMAC 学到的离线最优与在线最优通过单调递增的回报路径相连，因此可以实现无性能下降的离线到在线迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VIGIL: Tackling Hallucination Detection in Image Recontextualization
papers.abstract_en: We introduce VIGIL (Visual Inconsistency & Generative In-context Lucidity), a benchmark dataset and framework that provides a fine-grained categorization of hallucinations in the multimodal image recontextualization task for large multimodal models. Most existing methods treat hallucinations as a single undifferentiated error. We instead decompose them into five categories, namely Object Visual Fidelity, Background Fidelity, Spatial and Instructional Fidelity, Physical and Integration Fidelity, and Object Omission. We propose a multi-stage detection pipeline that processes recontextualized images through specialized steps targeting all five categories with a coordinated set of open-source models. We evaluate the pipeline on the VIGIL dataset of 1,269 manually annotated samples across five product domains and report macro-F1 per category. The decomposed pipeline reaches the best macro-F1 among open-source detectors. It returns a textual explanation for each detected error, which prior methods for this task do not provide. We openly release VIGIL, along with the detection pipeline and benchmark code, through our GitHub repository: https://github.com/mlubneuskaya/vigil and Data repository: https://huggingface.co/datasets/joannaww/VIGIL.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/mlubneuskaya/vigil and https://huggingface.co/datasets/joannaww/VIGIL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VIGIL（Visual Inconsistency & Generative In-context Lucidity），一个面向多模态大模型图像重上下文化（image recontextualization）任务的幻觉检测基准数据集与检测框架。作者将幻觉分解为五个细粒度类别，并提出一个多阶段检测流水线，利用一组开源模型协同处理这些类别。在包含 1,269 个手工标注样本、覆盖五个产品领域的 VIGIL 数据集上，该流水线在开源检测器中取得最佳 macro-F1，且能为每个检测到的错误提供文本解释，而此前方法不提供此类解释。
Motivation: 现有幻觉检测方法大多把幻觉当作单一、未区分的错误类型，缺乏对重上下文化任务中不同幻觉形态的细粒度刻画，且不提供检测结果的可解释说明。
Method: 引入五种幻觉类别：对象视觉保真度（Object Visual Fidelity）、背景保真度（Background Fidelity）、空间与指令保真度（Spatial and Instructional Fidelity）、物理与集成保真度（Physical and Integration Fidelity）和对象遗漏（Object Omission）；并构建一个多阶段检测流水线，通过协调多个开源模型分别针对全部五类幻觉进行检测。
Result: 在 VIGIL 数据集（1,269 个手工标注样本，跨五个产品领域）上评估，分解式流水线达到开源检测器中的最佳 macro-F1，并为每个检测到的错误返回文本解释。
Conclusion: 作者公开释出 VIGIL 数据集、检测流水线与基准代码（GitHub 与 Hugging Face），强调细粒度幻觉分解与可解释检测对图像重上下文化任务的价值。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Change-Point Detection via Piecewise Linear Fitting Using MIP
papers.abstract_en: We present a new mixed-integer programming (MIP) approach for offline multiple change-point detection by casting the problem as a globally optimal piecewise linear (PWL) fitting problem. Our main contribution is a family of strengthened MIP formulations whose linear programming (LP) relaxations admit integral projections onto the segment-assignment variables, which encode the segment membership of each data point. This property yields provably tighter relaxations than existing formulations for offline multiple change-point detection. We further extend the framework to multi-dimensional PWL models with shared change-points. Extensive computational experiments on benchmark real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed formulations achieve reductions in solution times in comparison to the state-of-the-art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的混合整数规划（MIP）方法，将离线多变点检测建模为全局最优的分段线性（piecewise linear, PWL）拟合问题。主要贡献是一族加强的 MIP 公式，其线性规划（LP）松弛在段分配变量上具有整数投影性质，从而比现有离线多变点检测公式获得可证明更紧的松弛。作者还将该框架扩展到具有共享变点的多维 PWL 模型，并在真实基准数据集上通过计算实验表明所提公式相比最先进方法缩短了求解时间。
Motivation: 现有的离线多变点检测公式通常松弛较弱、求解效率受限；该工作希望借助全局最优的分段线性拟合视角，构造松弛更紧的 MIP 公式以提升求解性能。
Method: 将离线多变点检测问题构造为全局最优 PWL 拟合的 MIP，提出一族加强的 MIP 公式，其 LP 松弛在编码数据点段归属的段分配变量上存在整数投影；并进一步扩展到带共享变点的多维 PWL 模型。
Result: 在多个真实基准数据集上的广泛计算实验显示，与现有最先进方法相比，所提出的公式实现了求解时间的减少。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，加强的 MIP 公式及其整数投影性质带来更紧的 LP 松弛，从而提升离线多变点检测的求解效率；方法和结论的适用范围是离线检测场景下的 PWL 拟合模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HyperDet: 3D Object Detection with Hyper 4D Radar Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: How far can 3D object detection go using 4D radar alone? Despite offering weather-robust and velocity-aware sensing for autonomous perception, modern 4D radar still yields sparse, noisy, and unstable point clouds, limiting radar-only 3D detection. We present HyperDet, a detector-agnostic frame- work that constructs task-aware hyper 4D radar point clouds before detection. HyperDet first refines short-window surround-view radar observations through spatio-temporal accumulation, cross-sensor validation, and Doppler-guided mo- tion compensation, improving return reliability and temporal coherence. It then performs foreground generative enhancement using LiDAR-guided pseudo-radar supervision available only during training, enriching object geometry while pre- serving measured radar background and radar-native attributes. During detector training, radar-aware object-level augmentation further preserves Doppler consis- tency under geometric relocation. At inference time, HyperDet requires radar input alone and can be directly paired with standard 3D detectors. Experiments on two public surround-view 4D radar datasets demonstrate consistent improve- ments over raw radar inputs across standard 3D detectors, validating input-level radar enhancement as an effective approach to radar-only 3D detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperDet，一个与检测器无关的框架，在检测前构造任务感知的超 4D 雷达点云，以改善仅用 4D 雷达进行 3D 目标检测的效果。框架通过时空累积、跨传感器验证和 Doppler 引导运动补偿细化短窗环绕视图雷达观测，并利用训练时的 LiDAR 引导伪雷达监督进行前景生成增强，推理时仅需雷达输入。实验在两个公开环绕视图 4D 雷达数据集上表明，该方法相对原始雷达输入在标准 3D 检测器上有一致提升。
Motivation: 现代 4D 雷达虽具有天气鲁棒和速度感知优势，但其点云稀疏、嘈杂且不稳定，限制了仅用雷达的 3D 检测性能。
Method: HyperDet 先通过时空累积、跨传感器验证和 Doppler 引导运动补偿来精化雷达观测，再使用仅训练时可用的 LiDAR 引导伪雷达监督进行前景生成增强，并在检测器训练中加入保持 Doppler 一致性的目标级数据增强；推理时仅需雷达输入并可直接搭配标准 3D 检测器。
Result: 在两个公开环绕视图 4D 雷达数据集上，HyperDet 相对原始雷达输入在标准 3D 检测器上取得一致的性能提升，验证了输入级雷达增强对仅雷达 3D 检测的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调输入级雷达增强是提升仅雷达 3D 检测的有效途径，且方法具有检测器无关性和推理时仅需雷达的实用性。

papers.title: Attn-QAT: 4-Bit Attention With Quantization-Aware Training
papers.abstract_en: Achieving reliable 4-bit attention is a prerequisite for end-to-end FP4 computation on emerging FP4-capable GPUs, yet attention remains the main obstacle due to FP4's tiny dynamic range and attention's heavy-tailed activations. This paper presents the first systematic study of 4-bit quantization-aware training (QAT) for attention. We find ``drop-in'' QAT -- naively combining an FP4 forward pass with high-precision Flash Attention (FA)-style backward pass -- leads to training instability. We identify two key principles for stable FP4 attention: (1) matching low-precision recomputation of attention scores in the backward pass and (2) resolving implicit precision assumptions in FA's gradient calculation. Based on these insights, we propose Attn-QAT and implement fused Triton kernels for training and FP4 inference kernels. Across diffusion and language models, Attn-QAT recovers the quality drop from FP4 attention without explicit outlier-mitigation heuristics used in prior FP4 attention, and delivers up to a 1.5x speedup on an RTX 5090 over SageAttention3 and up to a 1.74x speedup over FA4 on a GB300. Video demos can be found at https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/190F6xbBDUF2kGQYIcXBt3ehSYij5jlim?usp=sharing. Code can be found at https://haoailab.com/FastVideo/training/attn_qat/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究注意力机制的4位量化感知训练（QAT），提出Attn-QAT，解决FP4注意力在训练中的不稳定问题。摘要报告该方法在扩散模型和语言模型上恢复了FP4注意力的质量损失，无需先前的异常值缓解启发式，并在RTX 5090上比SageAttention3快1.5倍、在GB300上比FA4快1.74倍。
Motivation: 端到端FP4计算需要可靠的4位注意力，但由于FP4动态范围极小且注意力激活呈重尾分布，注意力成为主要障碍；而朴素的drop-in QAT（FP4前向结合高精度Flash Attention式反向）会导致训练不稳定。
Method: 识别出稳定FP4注意力的两个关键原则：在反向传播中匹配低精度重计算注意力分数，以及解决Flash Attention梯度计算中的隐式精度假设；据此提出Attn-QAT，并实现融合Triton训练核和FP4推理核。
Result: 摘要报告Attn-QAT在没有显式异常值缓解启发式的情况下恢复了FP4注意力的质量下降，并在RTX 5090上实现比SageAttention3最高1.5倍加速、在GB300上实现比FA4最高1.74倍加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作为注意力提供了首个系统的4位QAT研究，证明通过匹配反向传播中的低精度重计算和修正FA梯度精度假设可以稳定训练FP4注意力。

papers.title: OATS: Online Data Augmentation for Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) are a powerful paradigm for time series analysis and are often enhanced by synthetic data augmentation to improve the training data quality. Existing augmentation methods, however, typically rely on heuristics and static paradigms. Motivated by dynamic data optimization, which shows that the contribution of samples varies across training stages, we propose OATS (Online Data Augmentation for Time Series Foundation Models), a principled strategy that generates synthetic data tailored to different training steps. OATS leverages valuable training samples as principled guiding signals and dynamically generates high-quality synthetic data conditioned on them. We further design a diffusion-based framework to produce realistic time series and introduce an explore-exploit mechanism to balance efficiency and effectiveness. Experiments on TSFMs demonstrate that OATS consistently outperforms regular training and yields substantial performance gains over static data augmentation baselines across six validation datasets and two TSFM architectures. The code is available at the link https://github.com/microsoft/TimeCraft.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OATS（Online Data Augmentation for Time Series Foundation Models），一种为时间序列基础模型（TSFM）设计的在线数据增强策略。该方法不再依赖静态增强范式，而是根据训练阶段动态生成合成数据，并以有价值的训练样本作为引导信号。作者设计了基于扩散的生成框架并引入探索-利用（explore-exploit）机制来平衡效率与效果，实验表明 OATS 在六个验证数据集和两种 TSFM 架构上一致优于常规训练和静态增强基线。
Motivation: 现有时间序列数据增强方法通常依赖启发式规则和静态范式，忽视了训练不同阶段样本贡献的变化。作者借鉴动态数据优化（dynamic data optimization）的思想，认为合成数据应随训练进程自适应调整，以提升 TSFM 的训练数据质量。
Method: 提出 OATS 策略，利用有价值的训练样本作为引导信号，为不同训练步骤动态生成高质量的合成时间序列。具体实现采用扩散模型（diffusion-based framework）生成逼真序列，并引入探索-利用机制来平衡生成效率与增强效果。
Result: 实验在六个验证数据集和两种 TSFM 架构上显示，OATS 一致优于常规训练，并且相比静态数据增强基线带来显著的性能提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在线、训练阶段自适应的数据增强可以稳定改善时间序列基础模型的训练效果，并提供了开源代码链接。

papers.title: Hybrid Mamba-Attention Neural Architecture for Channel Estimation
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a hybrid Mamba-attention neural architecture to achieve improved channel estimation for orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) waveforms, particularly for configurations with a large number of subcarriers. By integrating a customized Mamba module, the proposed framework handles large-scale subcarrier channel estimation efficiently while capturing long-distance dependencies among these subcarriers effectively. Unlike the conventional Mamba structure, this paper implements a bidirectional selective scan to enable information propagation from both directions, because channel gains at different subcarriers are inherently non-causal. In addition, by integrating Mamba to reduce the reliance on quadratic-complexity self-attention, the proposed solution achieves lower space complexity than fully transformer architectures. Simulation results based on the 3GPP TS 36.101 channel demonstrate that compared to other baseline neural networks, the proposed method achieves superior channel estimation performance with fewer tunable parameters and exhibits good generalization across previously unseen channels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合 Mamba-注意力神经架构用于 OFDM 信道的信道估计，特别针对子载波数量大的配置。通过定制化的 Mamba 模块与双向选择性扫描（bidirectional selective scan），该框架能高效处理大规模子载波信道估计并捕获子载波间的长距离依赖，同时以低于全 Transformer 架构的空间复杂度运行。基于 3GPP TS 36.101 信道的仿真显示，相比其他基线神经网络，该方法以更少的可调参数获得更优信道估计性能，并对未见信道表现出良好泛化。
Motivation: OFDM 信道估计在子载波数量大时面临效率与长距离依赖建模的挑战，且不同子载波上的信道增益本质上是非因果的，传统 Mamba 结构的单向扫描可能不适用。
Method: 提出混合 Mamba-注意力架构，集成定制化的 Mamba 模块，并实现双向选择性扫描以支持两个方向的信息传播；同时利用 Mamba 减少对二次复杂度自注意力（quadratic-complexity self-attention）的依赖，从而降低空间复杂度。
Result: 仿真基于 3GPP TS 36.101 信道，结果表明相比其他基线神经网络，所提方法在更少可调参数下取得更优信道估计性能，并在未见过信道上表现出良好泛化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该混合架构能以较低空间复杂度实现高效、可泛化的 OFDM 信道估计，适用于大规模子载波配置。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Fundamental Limitations of Favorable Privacy-Utility Guarantees for DP-SGD
papers.abstract_en: Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent (DP-SGD) is the dominant paradigm for private training, but its fundamental limitations under worst-case adversarial privacy definitions remain poorly understood. We analyze DP-SGD in the $f$-differential privacy framework, which characterizes privacy via hypothesis-testing trade-off curves, and study shuffled sampling over a single epoch with $M$ gradient updates. We derive an explicit suboptimal upper bound on the achievable trade-off curve. This result induces a geometric lower bound on the separation $κ$, which is the maximum distance between the mechanism's trade-off curve and the ideal random-guessing line. Because a large separation implies significant adversarial advantage, meaningful privacy requires small $κ$. However, we prove that enforcing a small separation imposes a strict lower bound on the Gaussian noise multiplier $σ$, which directly limits the achievable utility. In particular, under the standard worst-case adversarial model, shuffled DP-SGD must satisfy $$σ\ge \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\ln M}} \quad\text{or}\quad κ\ge\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{8}}\!\left(1-\frac{1}{\sqrt{4π\ln M}}\right),$$ thus cannot simultaneously achieve strong privacy and high utility. Although the noise threshold vanishes asymptotically as $M \to \infty$, the convergence is extremely slow. Even for practically relevant numbers of updates the required noise magnitude remains substantial. We further show that the same limitation extends to Poisson subsampling up to constant factors. Our experiments confirm that the noise levels implied by this bound lead to significant accuracy degradation at realistic training settings, thus showing a bottleneck in DP-SGD under standard worst-case adversarial assumptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 f-差分隐私 (f-differential privacy) 框架下分析 DP-SGD 的根本局限，针对单 epoch、M 次梯度更新的 shuffled sampling 机制，推导出可实现 trade-off 曲线的显式次优上界，并由此得到分离度 κ 的几何下界。作者证明在标准最坏情况对抗模型下，shuffled DP-SGD 必须满足 σ ≥ 1/√(2 ln M) 或 κ ≥ (1/√8)(1 - 1/√(4π ln M))，因此无法同时达到强隐私与高效用；该噪声阈值随 M→∞ 渐近消失但收敛极慢，且相同局限以常数因子扩展到 Poisson subsampling。实验表明该下界隐含的噪声水平在现实训练设置下会导致显著精度下降，显示标准最坏情况假设下 DP-SGD 存在瓶颈。
Motivation: DP-SGD 是私有训练的主导范式，但其在最坏情况对抗性隐私定义下的根本局限尚未被充分理解，本文旨在严格刻画这一局限。
Method: 在 f-差分隐私框架下，通过假设检验 trade-off 曲线刻画隐私，分析单 epoch 含 M 次梯度更新的 shuffled sampling 机制，推导出可实现 trade-off 曲线的显式次优上界，并据此导出分离度 κ 的几何下界以及噪声乘子 σ 的必要条件。
Result: 摘要证明 shuffled DP-SGD 在标准最坏情况对抗模型下必须满足 σ ≥ 1/√(2 ln M) 或 κ ≥ (1/√8)(1 - 1/√(4π ln M))，即强隐私与高效用不可兼得；该噪声阈值随 M→∞ 渐近消失但收敛极慢，且同样限制以常数因子适用于 Poisson subsampling。实验证实该噪声水平在现实训练设置下造成显著精度退化。
Conclusion: 作者认为这揭示了 DP-SGD 在标准最坏情况对抗性假设下的固有瓶颈；结论强调强隐私保证所需的噪声幅度在实用更新次数下仍然很大，限制了下游效用。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文在 f-差分隐私 (f-differential privacy) 框架下分析 DP-SGD 的根本局限，针对单 epoch、M 次梯度更新的 shuffled sampling 机制，推导出可实现 trade-off 曲线的显式次优上界，并由此得到分离度 κ 的几何下界。作者证明在标准最坏情况对抗模型下，shuffled DP-SGD 必须满足 σ ≥ 1/√(2 ln M) 或 κ ≥ (1/√8)(1 - 1/√(4π ln M))，因此无法同时达到强隐私与高效用；该噪声阈值随 M→∞ 渐近消失但收敛极慢，且相同局限以常数因子扩展到 Poisson subsampling。实验表明该下界隐含的噪声水平在现实训练设置下会导致显著精度下降，显示标准最坏情况假设下 DP-SGD 存在瓶颈。

papers.title: Expert-Guided Multimodal Fusion for Unified Emotion and Sentiment Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal emotion understanding requires the integration of heterogeneous data sources, including text, audio, and visual modalities, while simultaneously addressing discrete emotion recognition and continuous sentiment analysis. We propose EGMF, a unified framework that combines expert-guided multimodal fusion with large language models to achieve superior performance across both tasks. At the core of our framework is a multi-scale expert network, comprising a local expert for capturing subtle emotional nuances, a semantic correlation expert for modeling cross-modal relationships, and a global context expert for understanding long-range dependencies. These experts are adaptively integrated via hierarchical dynamic gating, enabling context-aware feature selection and modality weighting. The enhanced multimodal representations are seamlessly incorporated into the language model through pseudo token injection and prompt-based conditioning, allowing a single generative framework to handle both classification and regression tasks. We employ parameter-efficient LoRA fine-tuning to maintain computational efficiency. Extensive experiments on bilingual benchmark datasets (MELD, CHERMA, MOSEI, SIMS-V2) demonstrate that EGMF outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of accuracy, cross-lingual robustness, and the discovery of universal patterns in multimodal emotional expressions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EGMF，一个将专家引导的多模态融合与大型语言模型结合的统一框架，同时处理离散情感识别和连续情感分析任务。框架包含局部专家、语义相关专家和全局上下文专家组成的多尺度专家网络，通过层次化动态门控自适应融合，并将增强后的多模态表示通过伪 token 注入和 prompt 条件化接入语言模型，采用 LoRA 进行参数高效微调。在 MELD、CHERMA、MOSEI、SIMS-V2 双语基准上的实验表明，EGMF 在准确率、跨语言鲁棒性和多模态情感表达通用模式发现方面优于现有方法。
Motivation: 多模态情感理解需要融合文本、音频和视觉等异构数据，同时兼顾离散情感识别与连续情感分析，现有方法难以在一个统一框架中有效建模跨模态关系和长程依赖。
Method: 提出多尺度专家网络，包括捕捉细微情感线索的局部专家、建模跨模态关系的语义相关专家和理解长程依赖的全局上下文专家；通过层次化动态门控自适应选择特征并加权模态，再以伪 token 注入和 prompt 条件化方式将多模态表示引入语言模型，并使用 LoRA 微调保持计算效率。
Result: 在 MELD、CHERMA、MOSEI、SIMS-V2 四个双语基准上，EGMF 在准确率、跨语言鲁棒性以及多模态情感表达通用模式发现方面优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调一个基于专家门控融合与语言模型生成框架的统一架构可以同时覆盖情感分类和回归任务，并展现出跨语言泛化能力。

papers.title: Layerwise goal-oriented adaptivity for neural ODEs: an optimal control perspective
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we propose a novel layerwise adaptive construction method for neural network architectures. Our approach is based on a goal--oriented dual-weighted residual technique for the optimal control of neural differential equations. This leads to an ordinary differential equation constrained optimization problem with controls acting as coefficients and a specific loss function. We implement our approach on the basis of a DG(0) Galerkin discretization of the neural ODE, leading to an explicit Euler time marching scheme. The resulting optimization problem is solved using the Adam algorithm and a BFGS method adapted to the $H^1$ topology induced by the regularization term. Finally, we apply our method to the construction of neural networks for the classification of data sets, where we present results for a selection of well known examples from the literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从最优控制视角提出一种逐层自适应的神经网络架构构造方法。作者基于目标导向的对偶加权残差 (dual-weighted residual) 技术，把神经微分方程 (neural differential equation) 的最优控制问题转化为以控制项为系数、带特定损失函数的 ODE 约束优化问题，并采用 DG(0) Galerkin 离散化得到显式 Euler 时间推进格式。优化部分使用 Adam 算法和适配 H^1 拓扑的 BFGS 方法，最终在若干经典数据集上展示了用于分类的神经网络构造结果。
Motivation: 神经网络架构通常需要手工设计或依赖启发式选择，而论文试图从最优控制理论出发，为神经网络的层结构提供一种目标导向的逐层自适应构造方式。
Method: 将神经 ODE 的训练表述为以控制项为系数的 ODE 约束优化问题，引入目标导向对偶加权残差技术实现逐层自适应；采用 DG(0) Galerkin 离散化得到显式 Euler 推进格式，并用 Adam 与基于 H^1 拓扑的 BFGS 方法求解优化问题。
Result: 摘要仅说明该方法被应用于多个文献中常见的数据集分类任务并给出结果，但未在摘要层面报告具体的量化精度或对比数据。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为神经网络架构构造提供了基于最优控制的目标导向逐层自适应途径，其展示范围限于分类数据集；摘要未讨论更复杂任务的推广或限制。

papers.title: LAUDE: LLM-Assisted Unit Test Generation and Debugging of Hardware DEsigns
papers.abstract_en: Unit tests are critical in the hardware design lifecycle to ensure that component design modules are functionally correct and conform to the specification before they are integrated at the system level. Thus developing unit tests targeting various design features requires deep understanding of the design functionality and creativity. When one or more unit tests expose a design failure, the debugging engineer needs to diagnose, localize, and debug the failure to ensure design correctness, which is often a painstaking and intense process. In this work, we introduce LAUDE, a unified unit-test generation and debugging framework for hardware designs that cross-pollinates the semantic understanding of the design source code with the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning capabilities of foundational Large-Language Models (LLMs). LAUDE integrates prompt engineering and design execution information to enhance its unit test generation accuracy and code debuggability. We apply LAUDE with closed- and open-source LLMs to a large corpus of buggy hardware design codes derived from the VerilogEval dataset, where generated unit tests detected bugs in up to 100% and 93% of combinational and sequential designs and debugged up to 93% and 84% of combinational and sequential designs, respectively.
papers.comment: 11 Pages, 9 Figures, 9 Tables Submitted to AAAI 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LAUDE，一个将硬件设计源代码的语义理解与基础 LLM 的思维链 (Chain-of-Thought) 推理能力相结合的统一单元测试生成与调试框架。LAUDE 通过提示工程 (prompt engineering) 和设计执行信息提升测试生成精度和代码可调试性，并应用于闭源与开源 LLM。在由 VerilogEval 数据集派生的错误硬件设计代码语料上，生成的单元测试在组合与时序设计中分别检测出高达 100% 和 93% 的 bug，调试成功率分别为约 93% 和 84%。
Motivation: 单元测试是硬件设计生命周期中确保模块功能正确、符合规格的关键，但开发针对不同设计特征的单元测试需要深入理解设计功能与创造力；当测试暴露设计缺陷时，调试工程师需要诊断、定位和调试，过程费时费力。
Method: LAUDE 将设计源代码的语义理解与 LLM 的思维链推理能力交叉结合，利用提示工程和设计执行信息来改进单元测试生成准确性和代码可调试性，并在多种闭源和开源 LLM 上进行验证。
Result: 在从 VerilogEval 数据集生成的大规模错误硬件设计代码语料上，LAUDE 生成的单元测试对组合和时序设计的 bug 检测率分别最高达 100% 和 93%，调试成功率分别最高达约 93% 和 84%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明将 LLM 推理与设计执行信息统一用于硬件单元测试生成和调试是有效的。该工作面向硬件设计验证领域，摘要未涉及天气或降水相关内容。

papers.title: TGIF: Text-Guided Layer Fusion Mitigates Hallucination in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) typically rely on a single late-layer feature from a frozen vision encoder, leaving the encoder's rich hierarchy of visual cues under-utilized. MLLMs still suffer from visually ungrounded hallucinations, often relying on language priors rather than image evidence. While many prior mitigation strategies operate on the text side, they leave the visual representation unchanged and do not exploit the rich hierarchy of features encoded across vision layers. Existing multi-layer fusion methods partially address this limitation but remain static, applying the same layer mixture regardless of the query. In this work, we introduce TGIF (Text-Guided Inter-layer Fusion), a lightweight module that treats encoder layers as depth-wise "experts" and predicts a prompt-dependent fusion of visual features. TGIF follows the principle of direct external fusion, requires no vision-encoder updates, and adds minimal overhead. Integrated into LLaVA-1.5-7B, TGIF provides consistent improvements across hallucination, OCR, and VQA benchmarks, while preserving or improving performance on ScienceQA, GQA, and MMBench. These results suggest that query-conditioned, hierarchy-aware fusion is an effective way to strengthen visual grounding and reduce hallucination in modern MLLMs. Code: https://github.com/Linchenchen/TGIF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TGIF（Text-Guided Inter-layer Fusion），一个将冻结视觉编码器各层视为深度方向"专家"（experts）的轻量模块，根据文本查询预测与提示相关的视觉特征融合权重。将该模块集成到 LLaVA-1.5-7B 后，在幻觉、OCR 和 VQA 基准上取得一致改进，并在 ScienceQA、GQA 和 MMBench 上保持或提升性能，说明查询条件化、层级感知的融合有助于增强视觉接地并减少幻觉。
Motivation: MLLM 通常只使用冻结视觉编码器的单一后期层特征，未能充分利用编码器中丰富的分层视觉线索，仍存在依赖语言先验而非图像证据的幻觉。已有的多层融合方法是静态的，对所有查询使用相同的层混合方式，没有针对查询调整视觉表示。
Method: TGIF 是一个轻量模块，把视觉编码器各层当作深度方向的"专家"，预测与提示相关的层间融合权重。它遵循直接外部融合（direct external fusion）原则，不需要更新视觉编码器参数，仅增加很小的计算开销。
Result: 集成 TGIF 的 LLaVA-1.5-7B 在幻觉、OCR、VQA 基准上获得一致提升，同时保持或改善 ScienceQA、GQA 和 MMBench 上的表现。摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为查询条件化且层级感知的融合是增强现代 MLLM 视觉接地、减少幻觉的有效手段；TGIF 不改动视觉编码器，适合作为轻量即插即用组件。

papers.title: Dancing Points: Synthesizing Ballroom Dancing with Three-Point Inputs
papers.abstract_en: Ballroom dancing is a structured yet expressive motion category. Its highly diverse movement and complex interactions between leader and follower dancers make the understanding and synthesis challenging. We demonstrate that the three-point trajectory available from a virtual reality (VR) device can effectively serve as a dancer's motion descriptor, simplifying the modeling and synthesis of interplay between dancers' full-body motions down to sparse trajectories. Thanks to the low dimensionality, we can employ an efficient MLP network to predict the follower's three-point trajectory directly from the leader's three-point input for certain types of ballroom dancing, addressing the challenge of modeling high-dimensional full-body interaction. It also prevents our method from overfitting thanks to its compact yet explicit representation. By leveraging the inherent structure of the movements and carefully planning the autoregressive procedure, we show a deterministic neural network is able to translate three-point trajectories into a virtual embodied avatar, which is typically considered under-constrained and requires generative models for common motions. In addition, we demonstrate this deterministic approach generalizes beyond small, structured datasets like ballroom dancing, and performs robustly on larger, more diverse datasets such as LaFAN. Our method provides a computationally- and data-efficient solution, opening new possibilities for immersive paired dancing applications. Code and pre-trained models for this paper are available at https://peizhuoli.github.io/dancing-points.

TL;DR: 本文提出用 VR 设备提供的三点轨迹（three-point trajectory）作为舞者的运动描述符，将双人交谊舞中全身运动的交互建模简化为稀疏轨迹预测。作者用一个高效的 MLP 网络直接从领舞者的三点输入预测跟舞者的三点轨迹，并通过自回归流程用确定性神经网络将轨迹转化为虚拟化身动作。摘要称该方法计算和数据效率高，且在小规模交谊舞数据之外也能在 LaFAN 等更大、更多样的数据集上稳健泛化。
Motivation: 交谊舞动作多样且领舞者与跟舞者之间存在复杂交互，全身动作的高维交互建模与合成具有挑战性。
Method: 利用 VR 设备提供的三点轨迹作为低维且紧凑的运动描述符，采用 MLP 网络直接根据领舞者的三点输入预测跟舞者的三点轨迹，并结合细致的自回归规划，用确定性神经网络将三点轨迹合成为虚拟化身动作。
Result: 摘要表明该确定性方法不仅适用于小规模结构化交谊舞数据集，还能在 LaFAN 等更大、更多样数据集上稳健工作，且具备计算与数据效率。
Conclusion: 低维的三点轨迹表示与确定性生成路径为沉浸式双人舞蹈应用提供了高效解决方案，代码与预训练模型已公开。

papers.title: Mesh-Attention: A New Communication-Efficient Distributed Attention with Improved Data Locality
papers.abstract_en: Distributed attention is essential for scaling large language models (LLMs) to long contexts, yet existing methods either have limited parallelism or incur high communication costs. Ulysses uses efficient all-to-all communication but cannot scale beyond the number of attention heads, whereas Ring-Attention removes this limit at the cost of high per-GPU communication. In our analytical Q-KV interaction matrix model, Ring-Attention assigns each GPU an entire row, preserving Q locality while sacrificing KV locality. Each GPU therefore receives nearly all KV partitions, and its communication grows linearly with sequence length. We present Mesh-Attention, which instead assigns each GPU a 2D tile to balance Q and KV locality, so that it collects only subsets of Q and KV partitions. This gives Mesh-Attention asymptotically lower communication complexity than Ring-Attention without limiting parallelism. Mesh-Attention further uses KV Partition Rotation (KVR), greedy scheduling, and topology-aware GPU mapping to balance traffic, overlap communication with computation, and reduce traffic over low-bandwidth links. Across experiments on up to 256 GPUs and 1M-token sequences, Mesh-Attention achieves average speedups of 17.00x, 2.62x and 2.94x (up to 32.27x, 4.36x and 4.59x) over Ring-Attention, USP (Ulysses degree 8) and StarTrail, respectively. It maintains this performance advantage as GPU count and sequence length increase while substantially reducing communication overhead at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mesh-Attention，一种面向长上下文 LLM 的分布式注意力机制，通过将每个 GPU 分配为 2D tile 来平衡 Q 与 KV 的局部性，从而在通信复杂度上优于 Ring-Attention 且不限制并行度。在最多 256 块 GPU、1M token 序列的实验中，Mesh-Attention 相比 Ring-Attention、USP 和 StarTrail 分别获得平均 17.00x、2.62x 和 2.94x 的加速，并随 GPU 数量和序列长度增加保持优势。
Motivation: 现有分布式注意力方法在扩展长上下文时存在权衡：Ulysses 通信高效但并行度受注意力头数限制，Ring-Attention 虽无此限制但每个 GPU 几乎接收全部 KV 分区，通信量随序列长度线性增长。
Method: Mesh-Attention 将序列的 Q-KV 交互矩阵按 2D tile 分配到各 GPU，使每个 GPU 只需收集 Q 和 KV 的子集，从而渐近降低通信复杂度；并引入 KV Partition Rotation (KVR)、贪心调度和拓扑感知 GPU 映射来均衡流量、重叠通信与计算，并减少低带宽链路上的流量。
Result: 在最多 256 GPU 和 1M token 序列的实验上，Mesh-Attention 相对 Ring-Attention、USP（Ulysses degree 8）和 StarTrail 的平均加速比分别为 17.00x、2.62x 和 2.94x，峰值分别达 32.27x、4.36x 和 4.59x，且在大规模下显著降低通信开销。
Conclusion: 作者认为在 Q-KV 交互矩阵上采用 2D tile 分配可以在不限制并行度的前提下获得比 Ring-Attention 更低的通信复杂度，并且该优势在 GPU 数量和序列长度扩展时依然保持。

papers.title: Bounding Hallucinations: Merlin-Arthur Protocols for Mutual-Information Bounds in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) relies on retrieved context to guide large language models (LLM), yet treats the retrieval as a heuristic rather than verifiable evidence -- leading to unsupported answers, hallucinations, and reliance on spurious context. We introduce a novel evaluation, data augmentation, and training framework that treats the RAG pipeline as an interactive proof system by adapting the Merlin-Arthur (M/A) protocol: Arthur (the generator LLM) receives context of unknown provenance and Merlin gives helpful evidence, while Morgana injects adversarial, misleading context. We implement them both with an XAI method to self-assess and modify evidence most influential to Arthur. Based on this framework we propose the Explained Information Fraction (EIF) score, that disentangles explanation fidelity from model predictive errors and imperfect benchmarks, and normalizes M/A mutual-information lower bounds to realistic empirical settings. When trained with those contexts, Arthur learns to answer when evidence supports the answer and abstain when evidence is insufficient. Across five QA benchmarks and four LLMs (1B to 32B parameters), M/A reduces incorrect answers under insufficient context by up to 35pp during training and by 18-20pp over vanilla finetuning. Abstention emerges even \emph{without any manually annotated unanswerable example or preference pair}. We improve EIF-cond by 0.1-0.4 during M/A training and by 0.33-0.38 over vanilla finetuning. Reusing Merlin/Morgana contexts as automatic hard positives and negatives also raises retriever Recall@1 by 2pp. While high accuracy does not guarantee entropy flow from context to answer, our EIF scores -- to our knowledge, the first context-to-answer information bound for RAG generators -- show that autonomous interactive-proof-style supervision enables RAG systems that treat retrieved documents as verifiable evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将检索增强生成（RAG）管道视为交互式证明系统，改编 Merlin-Arthur (M/A) 协议：Arthur 为生成器 LLM，Merlin 提供有帮助的证据，Morgana 注入对抗性误导上下文，二者均用 XAI 方法自我评估并对 Arthur 影响最大的证据进行修改。基于该框架提出解释信息分数（EIF），用于评估和训练。在五个问答基准和四个 LLM（1B 至 32B）上，M/A 训练减少了上下文不足时的错误回答，并产生了无人工标注的弃权行为。
Motivation: RAG 依赖检索上下文引导大语言模型，但把检索当作启发式而非可验证证据，导致无依据的回答、幻觉和对虚假上下文的依赖。
Method: 将 M/A 协议引入 RAG 管道，用 XAI 实现 Merlin 与 Morgana 以自我评估并修改对 Arthur 最具有影响力的证据；提出 EIF 分数，将解释保真度与模型预测错误及不完美基准解耦，并把 M/A 互信息下界归一化到现实经验设置。
Result: 在五个 QA 基准和四个 LLM（1B-32B）上，M/A 训练在上下文不足时将错误回答减少最多 35 个百分点，比 vanilla 微调多 18-20 个百分点；弃权在没有任何人工标注的不可回答示例或偏好对的情况下涌现。EIF-cond 在 M/A 训练中提升 0.1-0.4，比 vanilla 微调高 0.33-0.38；复用 Merlin/Morgana 上下文作为自动硬正负样本使检索器 Recall@1 提升 2 个百分点。
Conclusion: 高准确率并不保证上下文到答案的熵流，但 EIF 分数（据作者所知首个面向 RAG 生成器的上下文到答案信息界）表明自主交互式证明风格的监督能使 RAG 系统把检索文档当作可验证证据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Granular Node Pruning for Causal Circuit Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Circuit discovery aims to identify minimal subnetworks that are responsible for specific behaviors in large language models (LLMs). Existing approaches primarily rely on iterative edge pruning, which is computationally expensive and limited to coarse-grained units such as attention heads or MLP blocks, overlooking finer structures like individual neurons. We propose a node-level pruning framework for circuit discovery that addresses both scalability and granularity limitations. Our method introduces learnable masks across multiple levels of granularity, from entire blocks to individual neurons, within a unified optimization objective. Granularity-specific sparsity penalties guide the pruning process, allowing a comprehensive compression in a single fine-tuning run. Empirically, our approach identifies circuits that are smaller in nodes than those discovered by prior methods; moreover, we demonstrate that many neurons deemed important by coarse methods are actually irrelevant, while still maintaining task performance. Furthermore, our method has a significantly lower memory footprint, 5-10x, as it does not require keeping intermediate activations in the memory to work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向大语言模型因果电路发现 (circuit discovery) 的节点级剪枝框架，在统一优化目标中引入跨多个粒度的可学习掩码，从整个块 (block) 到单个神经元 (neuron) 均可剪枝，并借助粒度专属的稀疏惩罚在单次微调内完成压缩。摘要报告该方法发现的电路在节点数量上小于此前方法，并揭示许多被粗粒度方法视为重要的神经元实际上无关，同时任务性能得以保持；内存占用降低 5-10 倍，因为无需在内存中保留中间激活。
Motivation: 现有电路发现主要依赖迭代式边剪枝 (edge pruning)，计算开销大，且局限于注意力头或 MLP 块等粗粒度单元，忽略了单个神经元这样的更细结构。
Method: 提出节点级剪枝框架，在统一优化目标中设置跨粒度 (从整块到单神经元) 的可学习掩码，通过粒度专属稀疏惩罚引导剪枝过程，仅需一次微调即可实现整体压缩。
Result: 摘要报告该方法发现的电路在节点数上比先前方法更小；许多被粗粒度方法认为重要的神经元实际无关，而任务性能仍得以保持；同时内存占用比先前方法低 5-10 倍，因其无需在内存中保留中间激活。
Conclusion: 作者强调多粒度节点级剪枝能够同时解决电路发现的可扩展性与粒度限制问题，为寻找更小且更精确的子网络提供了一种内存高效的替代方案。

papers.title: Neuronal Attention Circuit (NAC) for Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Attention improves representation learning over RNNs, but its discrete nature limits continuous-time (CT) modeling. We introduce Neuronal Attention Circuit (NAC), a novel, biologically inspired CT-attention mechanism that reformulates attention logit computation as the solution to a linear first-order ODE with nonlinear interlinked gates derived from repurposing the wiring of C. elegans Neuronal Circuit Policies (NCPs). NAC replaces dense projections with sparse sensory gates for query-key projections and introduces a sparse backbone network with two heads for computing content-target and learnable time-constant gates, enabling efficient adaptive dynamics. To improve efficiency and memory consumption, we implement an adaptable, sparse, subquadratic Top-K pairwise concatenation mechanism that selectively curates query-key interactions. We provide rigorous theoretical guarantees, including state stability and bounded approximation errors. Empirically, we implement NAC in diverse domains, including irregular time-series, long-range forecasting, lane-keeping for autonomous vehicles, and industrial prognostics. We observe that NAC matches or outperforms in accuracy against several CT state-of-the-art baselines, while being interpretable at the neuron cell level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种受生物启发的连续时间注意力机制 Neuronal Attention Circuit (NAC)，将注意力 logit 计算重构为线性一阶 ODE 的解，并复用 C. elegans 神经元回路策略（NCP）的布线来构建非线性互联门。NAC 用稀疏感觉门替代稠密投影，并引入稀疏主干网络与双头结构计算内容目标和可学习时间常数门，同时配合子二次复杂度的 Top-K 成对拼接机制。理论部分给出状态稳定性与有界逼近误差保证；实验覆盖不规则时间序列、长程预测、自动驾驶车道保持与工业健康预测，在精度上匹配或超过多个连续时间 SOTA 基线，并具备神经元细胞级别的可解释性。
Motivation: 注意力机制相比 RNN 能改善表示学习，但其离散本质限制了连续时间（CT）建模能力，现有方法难以在连续时间框架下高效且可解释地实现注意力。
Method: 提出 NAC：将注意力 logit 计算建模为线性一阶 ODE，用来自 C. elegans NCP 的稀疏感觉门替换密集投影，通过稀疏主干网络与双头结构分别计算内容目标门和可学习时间常数门，并设计稀疏、自适应的子二次复杂度 Top-K 成对拼接来筛选查询-键交互；同时提供状态稳定性和逼近误差的理论分析。
Result: 在不规则时间序列、长程预测、自动驾驶车道保持和工业故障预测等多个领域，NAC 在精度上匹配或超过若干连续时间 SOTA 基线，并在神经元细胞层面具有可解释性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 NAC 表明将生物启发的稀疏连接与 ODE 形式的注意力结合，可以在连续时间表示学习中同时获得效率、稳定性和可解释性。
Relevance: 40

summary_sections.method: 提出 NAC：将注意力 logit 计算建模为线性一阶 ODE，用来自 C. elegans NCP 的稀疏感觉门替换密集投影，通过稀疏主干网络与双头结构分别计算内容目标门和可学习时间常数门，并设计稀疏、自适应的子二次复杂度 Top-K 成对拼接来筛选查询-键交互；同时提供状态稳定性和逼近误差的理论分析。
summary_sections.result: 在不规则时间序列、长程预测、自动驾驶车道保持和工业故障预测等多个领域，NAC 在精度上匹配或超过若干连续时间 SOTA 基线，并在神经元细胞层面具有可解释性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为 NAC 表明将生物启发的稀疏连接与 ODE 形式的注意力结合，可以在连续时间表示学习中同时获得效率、稳定性和可解释性。

papers.title: Transformers for Multimodal Brain State Decoding: Integrating Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging Data and Medical Metadata
papers.abstract_en: Decoding brain states from functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data is vital for advancing neuroscience and clinical applications. While traditional machine learning and deep learning approaches have made strides in leveraging the high-dimensional and complex nature of fMRI data, they often fail to utilize the contextual richness provided by Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine (DICOM) metadata. This paper presents a novel framework integrating transformer-based architectures with multimodal inputs, including fMRI data and DICOM metadata. By employing attention mechanisms, the proposed method captures intricate spatial-temporal patterns and contextual relationships, enhancing model accuracy, interpretability, and robustness. The potential of this framework spans applications in clinical diagnostics, cognitive neuroscience, and personalized medicine. Limitations, such as metadata variability and computational demands, are addressed, and future directions for optimizing scalability and generalizability are discussed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个整合Transformer架构与多模态输入的框架，用于从fMRI数据和DICOM元数据解码大脑状态。通过注意力机制捕捉精细的时空模式和上下文关系，提升模型的准确性、可解释性和鲁棒性。潜在应用包括临床诊断、认知神经科学和个性化医疗。
Motivation: 传统机器学习和深度学习方法虽然能利用fMRI高维复杂数据，但往往未能利用DICOM元数据所提供的上下文丰富性。
Method: 提出结合Transformer架构与多模态输入的框架，输入包括fMRI数据和DICOM元数据，并采用注意力机制捕捉空间-时间模式与上下文关系。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅声称方法提升了模型准确性、可解释性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要讨论了元数据变异性与计算需求等限制，并指出未来方向为优化可扩展性和泛化性。

papers.title: Family Matters: A Systematic Study of Spatial vs. Frequency Masking for Continual Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Recent continual test-time adaptation (CTTA) methods adopt masked image modeling to stabilize learning under distribution shift, yet each treats its masking family F as a fixed design choice and innovates exclusively along the selection strategy S, leaving the family axis underexplored. We present a systematic empirical study that isolates this axis. Using a controlled CTTA instantiation, Mask to Adapt (M2A), that fixes S=random and standard losses, we vary only F across spatial (patch, pixel) and frequency (all-band, low-band, high-band) families while keeping every other component identical. The study's contributions are the design guidance it extracts for the CTTA settings we evaluated: (1) the masking family determines whether adaptation compounds useful structure or compounds errors, on patch-tokenized architectures, spatial masking accumulates stable representations over long streams while frequency masking collapses catastrophically. We characterize this instability through a structural-preservation account, where spatial coherence maintains the broad-spectrum redundancy needed to avoid terminally overlapping with a corruption's spectral signature; (2) the optimal family depends on architecture-task alignment, on CNNs, whose overlapping receptive fields dilute patch occlusion, the family gap vanishes, whereas on fine-grained tasks with global cues and large-capacity ViTs, frequency masking becomes competitive. In confounded system-level comparisons, where baselines also differ in losses and auxiliary components, M2A's random selection performs comparably to heuristic strategies, though we treat this observation as suggestive context rather than a controlled quantification of S's relative importance.
papers.comment: Accepted to TMLR 2026, camera-ready at https://openreview.net/forum?id=pBI64qNXHp; code at https://github.com/chandlerbing65nm/m2a.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对持续测试时自适应 (continual test-time adaptation, CTTA) 中的掩码家族 (masking family) 这一被忽视的设计轴进行了系统实验研究。作者提出受控实例 Mask to Adapt (M2A)，固定选择策略 S=random 和标准损失，仅在空间（patch、pixel）与频域（all-band、low-band、high-band）家族之间变化。结果表明掩码家族决定了自适应是累积有用结构还是累积错误：在 patch 分词架构上，空间掩码在长流上积累稳定表征而频域掩码灾难性崩溃；最优家族还取决于架构-任务对齐。
Motivation: 近期 CTTA 方法普遍采用掩码图像建模来稳定分布偏移下的学习，但每种方法都把掩码家族 F 当作固定设计选择，只沿着选择策略 S 做创新，导致家族轴几乎没有被系统探索过。
Method: 提出受控 CTTA 实例 M2A，固定 S=random 与标准损失，在保持其他组件完全一致的前提下仅变化 F，涵盖空间（patch、pixel）和频域（all-band、low-band、high-band）家族，并进行系统比较；同时给出结构保持 (structural-preservation) 解释框架。
Result: 在 patch 分词架构上，空间掩码在长流上积累稳定表征，而频域掩码发生灾难性崩溃；在 CNN 上家族差异消失；在带全局线索的细粒度任务与大容量 ViT 上，频域掩码变得有竞争力。在混杂了损失与辅助组件差异的系统级对比中，M2A 的随机选择与启发式策略表现相当，作者将其视为提示性观察而非对 S 相对重要性的受控量化。
Conclusion: 摘要给出设计指导：掩码家族决定自适应是积累有用结构还是积累错误，空间一致性维持的宽带冗余可避免与腐败的频谱特征终局重叠；最优家族依赖架构-任务对齐。作者特别强调系统级比较中关于选择策略的观察仅具提示意义，并非受控结论。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FronTalk: Benchmarking Front-End Development as Conversational Code Generation with Multi-Modal Feedback
papers.abstract_en: We present FronTalk, a benchmark for front-end code generation that pioneers the study of a unique interaction dynamic: conversational code generation with multi-modal feedback. In front-end development, visual artifacts such as sketches, mockups and annotated creenshots are essential for conveying design intent, yet their role in multi-turn code generation remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we focus on the front-end development task and curate FronTalk, a collection of 100 multi-turn dialogues derived from real-world websites across diverse domains such as news, finance, and art. Each turn features both a textual instruction and an equivalent visual instruction, each representing the same user intent. To comprehensively evaluate model performance, we propose a novel agent-based evaluation framework leveraging a web agent to simulate users and explore the website, and thus measuring both functional correctness and user experience. Evaluation of 20 models reveals two key challenges that are under-explored systematically in the literature: (1) a significant forgetting issue where models overwrite previously implemented features, resulting in task failures, and (2) a persistent challenge in interpreting visual feedback, especially for open-source vision-language models (VLMs). We propose a strong baseline to tackle the forgetting issue with AceCoder, a method that critiques the implementation of every past instruction using an autonomous web agent. This approach significantly reduces forgetting to nearly zero and improves the performance by up to 9.3% (56.0% to 65.3%). Overall, we aim to provide a solid foundation for future research in front-end development and the general interaction dynamics of multi-turn, multi-modal code generation. Code and data are released at https://github.com/shirley-wu/frontalk
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FronTalk，一个面向前端代码生成的多轮对话式代码生成基准，专门研究带多模态反馈的对话式代码生成。数据集包含来自新闻、金融、艺术等真实网站的 100 个多轮对话，每轮同时提供文本指令和等价视觉指令。作者还提出基于 web agent 的智能体评估框架来同时衡量功能正确性与用户体验，并评估了 20 个模型。
Motivation: 前端开发中草图、原型图和标注截图等视觉产物对传达设计意图至关重要，但它们在多轮代码生成中的作用尚未被充分探索；现有工作缺乏对这一多模态、多轮交互动态的系统性研究。
Method: 构建 FronTalk 数据集，从真实世界网站收集 100 个多轮对话，每轮包含表达相同用户意图的文本指令与视觉指令；提出基于 web agent 的评估框架，模拟用户探索网站以评估功能正确性与用户体验；并提出 AceCoder 基线方法，利用自主 web agent 对每一条历史指令的实现进行批判性检查以缓解遗忘问题。
Result: 对 20 个模型的评估揭示了两个文献中缺乏系统研究的挑战：模型会覆盖先前已实现功能导致任务失败的显著遗忘问题，以及特别是开源视觉语言模型 (VLM) 在理解视觉反馈上的持续困难。AceCoder 将遗忘几乎降至零，并把性能从 56.0% 提升到 65.3%，最高提升 9.3%。
Conclusion: 作者希望该工作为前端开发以及多轮、多模态代码生成的通用交互动态研究提供基础；代码和数据已公开发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Pixels: Benchmarking and Reward-Based Assessing Framework for Visual Spatial Aesthetics
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, Image Quality Assessment (IQA) for AI-generated images (AIGI) has advanced rapidly; however, existing methods primarily target portraits and artistic images, lacking a systematic evaluation of interior scenes. We introduce Spatial Aesthetics, a paradigm that assesses the aesthetic quality of interior images along four dimensions: layout, harmony, lighting, and distortion. We construct SA-BENCH, the first benchmark for spatial aesthetics, comprising 18,000 images and 50,000 precise annotations. Employing SA-BENCH, we systematically evaluate current IQA methodologies and develop SA-IQA, through MLLM fine-tuning and a multidimensional fusion approach, as a comprehensive reward framework for assessing spatial aesthetics. We apply SA-IQA to two downstream tasks: (1) serving as a reward signal integrated with GRPO reinforcement learning to optimize the AIGC generation pipeline, and (2) Best-of-N selection to filter high-quality images and improve generation quality. Experiments indicate that SA-IQA significantly outperforms existing methods on SA-BENCH, setting a new standard for spatial aesthetics evaluation. Code is available at https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/SA-IQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 AI 生成图像的质量评估（IQA）缺乏室内场景系统评测的问题，提出空间美学（Spatial Aesthetics）范式，从布局、和谐、光照和畸变四个维度评估室内图像的美学质量。作者构建了首个空间美学基准 SA-BENCH（18,000 张图像、50,000 条标注），并基于 MLLM 微调和多维融合提出奖励框架 SA-IQA，用于 GRPO 强化学习奖励信号与 Best-of-N 筛选两个下游任务。实验表明 SA-IQA 在 SA-BENCH 上显著优于现有 IQA 方法。
Motivation: 现有 AIGI 的 IQA 方法主要面向人像和艺术图像，缺乏对室内场景的系统评估，而室内图像的空间美学评测尚无专门基准。
Method: 构建 SA-BENCH 基准并标注布局、和谐、光照、畸变四维美学属性；通过 MLLM 微调与多维融合方法开发 SA-IQA，作为空间美学综合奖励框架，并接入 GRPO 强化学习生成管线和 Best-of-N 高质量图像筛选。
Result: 摘要报告 SA-IQA 在 SA-BENCH 上显著优于现有 IQA 方法，为空间美学评估设立了新标准。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SA-BENCH 与 SA-IQA 可系统评估并优化室内图像生成质量，代码已开源；摘要未提及跨域泛化或与天气类任务的关系。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Med-CRAFT: An Information System for Explainable and Configurable Construction of Multimodal Medical QA Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Data-intensive artificial intelligence applications increasingly rely on large-scale, high-quality, explainable, and reproducible datasets, yet the construction of such datasets often remains labor-intensive, weakly traceable, and difficult to configure. This problem is particularly critical in multimodal medical scenarios, where each question-answer sample should be semantically consistent, grounded in visual and temporal evidence, and controllable in terms of reasoning complexity. To address these challenges, we propose Med-CRAFT, an information system for explainable and configurable construction of multimodal medical question answering datasets from instructional videos. Med-CRAFT organizes dataset construction as a provenance-aware pipeline that transforms raw medical instructional videos into structured operation knowledge graphs, evidence-grounded reasoning paths, and natural-language question-answer pairs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Med-CRAFT，一个用于从教学视频构建多模态医学问答数据集的信息系统。该系统将数据集构建组织为可溯源（provenance-aware）流水线，把原始医学教学视频转换为结构化操作知识图谱、基于证据的推理路径以及自然语言问答对，目标是让数据构建具备可解释性和可配置性。摘要未给出实验或定量评估结果。
Motivation: 数据密集型 AI 依赖大规模、高质量、可解释且可复现的数据集，而现有构建过程往往劳动密集、可追溯性弱且难以配置；在多模态医学场景中，每个问答样本还需满足语义一致性、视觉与时间证据支撑以及推理复杂度可控等要求。
Method: 提出 Med-CRAFT 信息系统，将数据集构建组织为 provenance-aware 流水线，从原始医学教学视频出发，依次生成结构化操作知识图谱、基于证据的推理路径（evidence-grounded reasoning paths）和自然语言问答对，以实现可解释与可配置的构建流程。
Conclusion: 作者主张通过可溯源、可配置的流水线式构建来缓解医学多模态问答数据构建中的可解释性与可追溯性问题；摘要未报告实验验证或定量结果，属于系统设计与方案层面的工作。

papers.title: VCU-Bridge: Hierarchical Visual Connotation Understanding via Semantic Bridging
papers.abstract_en: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel on benchmarks, their processing paradigm differs from the human ability to integrate visual information. Unlike humans who naturally bridge details and high-level concepts, models tend to treat these elements in isolation. Prevailing evaluation protocols often decouple low-level perception from high-level reasoning, overlooking their semantic and causal dependencies, which yields non-diagnostic results and obscures performance bottlenecks. We present VCU-Bridge, a framework that operationalizes a human-like hierarchy of visual connotation understanding: multi-level reasoning that advances from foundational perception through semantic bridging to abstract connotation, with an explicit evidence-to-inference trace from concrete cues to abstract conclusions. Building on this framework, we construct HVCU-Bench, a benchmark for hierarchical visual connotation understanding with explicit, level-wise diagnostics. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate a consistent decline in performance as reasoning progresses to higher levels. We further develop a data generation pipeline for instruction tuning guided by Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) and show that strengthening low-level capabilities yields measurable gains at higher levels. Interestingly, it not only improves on HVCU-Bench but also brings benefits on general benchmarks (average +2.53%), especially with substantial gains on MMStar (+7.26%), demonstrating the significance of the hierarchical thinking pattern and its effectiveness in enhancing MLLM capabilities. The project page is at https://vcu-bridge.github.io .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VCU-Bridge，一个将视觉内涵理解建模为类人分层推理的框架，从基础感知经语义桥接推进到抽象内涵，并显式保留从具体线索到抽象结论的证据-推理追踪。作者基于该框架构建 HVCU-Bench 基准，实验显示模型性能随推理层级升高而持续下降；用 Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) 引导的指令微调数据生成管线强化低层能力后，不仅提升 HVCU-Bench，还在通用基准上平均提升 2.53%，其中 MMStar 提升 7.26%。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 在基准上表现优异，但其处理方式与人类整合视觉信息的能力不同：模型倾向于孤立看待细节和高层概念，而人类会自然地在两者之间建立桥梁。现有评测协议常将低层感知与高层推理解耦，忽略其语义和因果依赖，导致结果缺乏诊断性并掩盖性能瓶颈。
Method: 提出 VCU-Bridge 框架，将视觉内涵理解操作化为多层推理：基础感知、语义桥接、抽象内涵，并给出显式的证据到推理轨迹。基于此构建带逐层诊断的 HVCU-Bench 基准，同时设计由 MCTS 引导的数据生成管线用于指令微调。
Result: 综合实验表明，随着推理层级提高，模型性能呈现持续下降的趋势；强化低层能力可带来高层能力的可测量提升，不仅在 HVCU-Bench 上改善，还在通用基准上平均提升 2.53%，其中 MMStar 提升 7.26%。
Conclusion: 作者强调层次化思维模式对增强 MLLM 能力具有实际效果，验证了显式证据-推理追踪与逐层诊断的价值；摘要未提及明确的局限性。
Relevance: 5
