papers.title: The Belief-Desire-Intention Ontology for modelling mental reality and agency
papers.abstract_en: The Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) model is a cornerstone for representing rational agency in artificial intelligence and cognitive sciences. Yet, its integration into structured, semantically interoperable knowledge representations remains limited. This paper presents a formal BDI Ontology, conceived as a modular Ontology Design Pattern (ODP) that captures the cognitive architecture of agents through beliefs, desires, intentions, and their dynamic interrelations. The ontology ensures semantic precision and reusability by aligning with foundational ontologies and best practices in modular design. Two complementary lines of experimentation demonstrate its applicability: (i) coupling the ontology with Large Language Models (LLMs) via Logic Augmented Generation (LAG) to assess the contribution of ontological grounding to inferential coherence and consistency; and (ii) integrating the ontology within the Semas reasoning platform, which implements the Triples-to-Beliefs-to-Triples (T2B2T) paradigm, enabling a bidirectional flow between RDF triples and agent mental states. Together, these experiments illustrate how the BDI Ontology acts as both a conceptual and operational bridge between declarative and procedural intelligence, paving the way for cognitively grounded, explainable, and semantically interoperable multi-agent and neuro-symbolic systems operating within the Web of Data.
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Web Semantics (2026) 90:100885
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个正式的信念-愿望-意图 (BDI) 本体，作为模块化的 Ontology Design Pattern (ODP)，用于刻画智能体的认知架构及其信念、愿望、意图之间的动态关系。作者将该本体与大型语言模型 (LLM) 通过 Logic Augmented Generation (LAG) 结合，评估本体接地对推理连贯性与一致性的贡献；同时将其集成到 Semas 推理平台，实现 RDF 三元组与智能体心智状态之间的双向流动 (T2B2T)。两项实验共同展示该本体作为声明式与程序式智能之间概念与操作桥梁的作用。
Motivation: BDI 模型在人工智能与认知科学中广泛用于表示理性智能体，但其与结构化、语义可互操作的知识表示之间的集成仍然有限，缺少一个既形式化又可复用的本体方案。
Method: 设计了一个正式的 BDI Ontology，采用模块化 ODP 形式，并与基础本体 (foundational ontologies) 及模块化设计最佳实践对齐以保证语义精度和可复用性；通过两条实验线验证：一是用 LAG 将本体与 LLM 耦合，二是在 Semas 平台中实现 T2B2T 范式，使 RDF 三元组与智能体心智状态双向转换。
Result: 摘要报告两项互补实验分别验证了本体在增强 LLM 推理连贯性与一致性方面的贡献，以及其在 Semas 平台上支持 RDF 三元组与智能体信念等心智状态双向流动的可操作性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该 BDI Ontology 在声明式与程序式智能之间架起桥梁，为 Web of Data 上认知接地、可解释且语义可互操作的多智能体与神经符号系统奠定基础。

papers.title: iLTM: Integrated Large Tabular Model
papers.abstract_en: Tabular data underpins decisions across science, industry, and public services. Despite rapid progress, advances in deep learning have not fully carried over to the tabular domain, where gradient-boosted decision trees (GBDTs) remain a default choice in practice. We present iLTM, an integrated Large Tabular Model that unifies tree-derived embeddings, dimensionality-agnostic representations, a meta-trained hypernetwork, multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), and retrieval within a single architecture. Pre-trained on more than 1,800 heterogeneous classification datasets, iLTM achieves consistently superior performance across tabular classification and regression tasks, from small datasets to large and high-dimensional tasks. After light fine-tuning, the meta-trained hypernetwork transfers to regression targets, matching or surpassing strong baselines. Extensive experiments show that iLTM outperforms well-tuned GBDTs and leading deep tabular models while requiring less task-specific tuning. By bridging the gap between tree-based and neural methods, iLTM offers a new framework for tabular foundation models for robust, adaptable, and scalable tabular learning.
papers.comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at KDD '26
papers.journal_ref: Proc. 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conf. on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining, 2, 186-197 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 iLTM（Integrated Large Tabular Model），一个统一的表格基础模型架构，整合树派生嵌入 (tree-derived embeddings)、维度无关表示、元训练超网络 (meta-trained hypernetwork)、多层感知机和检索机制。模型在 1,800 多个异构分类数据集上预训练，在表格分类与回归任务上从中小规模到大规模高维数据均取得一致的优越性能；轻量微调后超网络可迁移到回归目标并匹配或超越强基线。实验表明 iLTM 在需要更少任务特定调参的情况下，优于调优良好的 GBDT 和主流深度表格模型。
Motivation: 表格数据在高影响力场景中居核心地位，但深度学习的进展未能充分迁移到表格领域，实践中梯度提升决策树 (GBDT) 仍是默认选择；工作旨在弥合基于树的方法与神经方法之间的差距。
Method: 提出一个集成式架构，将树派生嵌入、维度无关表示、元训练超网络、MLP 与检索统一在单一模型中，并在超过 1,800 个异构分类数据集上预训练；通过轻量微调将分类预训练的超网络迁移到回归任务。
Result: 摘要报告 iLTM 在表格分类与回归任务中持续优于调优良好的 GBDT 和领先深度表格模型，覆盖从小型到大型高维数据；经轻量微调后在回归目标上匹配或超越强基线，且所需任务特定调参更少。
Conclusion: 作者将 iLTM 定位为新的表格基础模型框架，能够实现稳健、自适应、可扩展的表格学习，并弥合树方法与神经方法之间的鸿沟。

papers.title: Intelligence Foundation Model: A New Perspective to Approach Artificial General Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: We propose a new perspective for approaching artificial general intelligence (AGI) through an intelligence foundation model (IFM). Unlike existing foundation models (FMs), which specialize in pattern learning within specific domains such as language, vision, or time series, IFM aims to acquire the underlying mechanisms of intelligence by learning directly from diverse intelligent behaviors. Vision, language, and other cognitive abilities are manifestations of intelligent behavior; learning from this broad range of behaviors enables the system to internalize the general principles of intelligence. Based on the fact that intelligent behaviors emerge from the collective dynamics of biological neural systems, IFM consists of two core components: a novel network architecture, termed the state neural network, which captures neuron-like dynamic processes, and a new learning objective, neuron output prediction, which trains the system to predict neuronal outputs from collective dynamics. The state neural network emulates the temporal dynamics of biological neurons, allowing the system to store, integrate, and process information over time, while the neuron output prediction objective provides a unified computational principle for learning these structural dynamics from intelligent behaviors. Together, these innovations establish a biologically grounded and computationally scalable foundation for building systems capable of generalization, reasoning, and adaptive learning across domains, representing a step toward truly AGI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种通向通用人工智能 (AGI) 的新视角：智能基础模型 (Intelligence Foundation Model, IFM)。与在语言、视觉或时序等特定领域进行模式学习的现有基础模型不同，IFM 直接从多样化的智能行为中学习智能的底层机制，将视觉、语言等视为智能行为的表现。其核心包括名为状态神经网络 (state neural network) 的新架构和名为神经元输出预测 (neuron output prediction) 的新学习目标，前者模拟生物神经元的时间动态以存储、整合和处理信息，后者为从智能行为中学习结构动态提供统一计算原则。
Motivation: 现有基础模型 (foundation models) 局限于特定领域（如语言、视觉、时间序列）的模式学习，缺乏对智能底层机制的建模；作者认为从广泛智能行为中学习一般智能原则是逼近 AGI 的更根本路径。
Method: 提出 IFM，由两个核心组件构成：状态神经网络，用于模拟生物神经元的类神经元动态过程并支持随时间存储与加工信息；以及神经元输出预测目标，即从集体动态中预测神经元输出，作为学习这些结构动态的统一计算原理。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的实验数据或基准结果，仅从概念上论证该方法为跨领域的泛化、推理和自适应学习提供了有生物学依据且可计算扩展的基础。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些创新代表了迈向真正 AGI 的一步，但摘要中未讨论局限、规模或实验验证范围。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告具体的实验数据或基准结果，仅从概念上论证该方法为跨领域的泛化、推理和自适应学习提供了有生物学依据且可计算扩展的基础。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为这些创新代表了迈向真正 AGI 的一步，但摘要中未讨论局限、规模或实验验证范围。

papers.title: Directional-Clamp PPO
papers.abstract_en: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is widely regarded as one of the most successful deep reinforcement learning algorithms, known for its robustness and effectiveness across a range of problems. The PPO objective encourages the importance ratio between the current and behavior policies to move to the "right" direction -- starting from importance sampling ratios equal to 1, increasing the ratios for actions with positive advantages and decreasing those with negative advantages. A clipping function is introduced to prevent over-optimization when updating the importance ratio in these "right" direction regions. Many PPO variants have been proposed to extend its success, most of which modify the objective's behavior by altering the clipping in the "right" direction regions. However, due to randomness in the rollouts and stochasticity of the policy optimization, we observe that the ratios frequently move to the "wrong" direction during the PPO optimization. This is a key factor hindering the improvement of PPO, but it has been largely overlooked. To address this, we propose the Directional-Clamp PPO algorithm (DClamp-PPO), which further penalizes the actions going to the strict "wrong" direction regions, where the advantage is positive (negative) and importance ratio falls below (above) $1 - β$ ($1+β$), for a tunable parameter $β\in (0, 1)$. The penalty is by enforcing a steeper loss slope, i.e., a clamp, in those regions. We demonstrate that DClamp-PPO consistently outperforms PPO, as well as its variants, by focusing on modifying the objective's behavior in the "right" direction, across various MuJoCo environments, using different random seeds. The proposed method is shown, both theoretically and empirically, to better avoid "wrong" direction updates while keeping the importance ratio closer to 1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Directional-Clamp PPO (DClamp-PPO)，一种针对 PPO 目标函数的改进算法。作者观察到，由于 rollout 和策略优化的随机性，重要性比率 (importance ratio) 在优化过程中经常朝与优势方向相反的"错误"方向移动，这是被现有研究忽视的限制 PPO 提升的因素。DClamp-PPO 通过在严格"错误"方向区域（正优势下比率低于 1-β、负优势下比率高于 1+β）施加更陡的损失斜率（clamp）来惩罚这类更新。实验表明，在多个 MuJoCo 环境和不同随机种子下，该方法一致优于 PPO 及其变体。
Motivation: 标准 PPO 通过 clipping 防止重要性比率在"正确"方向区域过度优化，但随机性导致比率频繁走向"错误"方向，该现象未被充分关注，成为制约 PPO 进一步提升的关键因素。
Method: 提出 DClamp-PPO，在 PPO 目标中引入对严格"错误"方向区域的额外惩罚：当 advantage 为正且比率低于 1-β，或 advantage 为负且比率高于 1+β 时，通过设置更陡的损失斜率（即 clamp）来惩罚，β 为可调超参数。
Result: 在多种 MuJoCo 环境和不同随机种子下，DClamp-PPO 一致优于 PPO 及其变体；理论与经验结果均表明该方法能更好地避免"错误"方向更新，并使重要性比率保持在更接近 1 的范围。
Conclusion: 作者强调，聚焦修改目标函数在"正确"方向上的行为并对"错误"方向更新施加惩罚，可以进一步提升 PPO 的性能和稳定性。

papers.title: TempoBench: Reasoning Execution Without Causal Attribution Is Just Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Current training paradigms, optimized for long-horizon reasoning trace execution, have made Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at pattern matching and forward simulation of reasoning, but underperform at counterfactual causal understanding and reasoning. We introduce TempoBench, the first formally verifiable temporal benchmark that isolates counterfactual causal attribution over execution trajectories, and we show that LLMs categorically fall back to brute-force simulation-based reasoning to solve causal reasoning problems. Built from synthesized deterministic Mealy machines, TempoBench provides an infinitely scalable corpus of trajectory-based causal reasoning problems with controllable complexity and provably correct causal labels. Frontier models reach 96% step accuracy simulating a system forward, and fall to 32% when asked which inputs were necessary for an observed output, displaying what we call the SIM/MIN gap. Our findings show that LLMs cannot reliably identify minimal necessary causes, often confusing ``possible inputs'' with ``necessary causes,'' demonstrating an inability to understand which inputs were not needed. This failure is critical for deployment in causal inference tasks such as debugging, root cause analysis, and task planning where agents must use counterfactual reasoning to plan for specific desired outcomes. We show that training on TempoBench yields a targeted gain on causal benchmarks in open-source models while matching general-purpose, math, and code reasoning datasets on standard benchmarks. This indicates counterfactual causal reasoning is a learnable, architecturally distinct capability that sits on top of existing reasoning competencies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TempoBench，一个基于合成确定性 Mealy 机（deterministic Mealy machines）构建的、可形式化验证的时间性基准，用于隔离执行轨迹上的反事实因果归因（counterfactual causal attribution）。作者发现 LLM 在因果推理问题上会退化为暴力模拟式推理：前沿模型前向模拟系统时步准确率达 96%，而被要求判断哪些输入对观测输出是必要原因时降至 32%，形成所谓的 SIM/MIN 差距。在开源模型上使用 TempoBench 训练能在因果基准上获得针对性提升，同时保持通用、数学和代码推理能力不变。
Motivation: 现有训练范式面向长程推理轨迹执行优化，使 LLM 擅长模式匹配与前向模拟，但反事实因果理解不足；这种失败会制约调试、根因分析和任务规划等需要反事实推理的部署场景。
Method: TempoBench 由合成的确定性 Mealy 机生成，提供可无限扩展、复杂度可控且因果标签可证明正确的轨迹式因果推理问题，并要求模型区分“可能的输入”与“最小必要原因”（minimal necessary causes），从而将因果归因从执行模拟中分离出来。
Result: 摘要报告前沿模型前向模拟的系统步准确率为 96%，而识别必要输入准确率仅 32%；TempoBench 训练在开源模型上带来因果基准的针对性提升，同时不损害通用、数学和代码基准的表现。
Conclusion: 作者认为反事实因果推理是可学习的、与现有推理能力叠加的架构层面独立能力，且当前 LLM 无法可靠识别最小必要原因，常混淆“可能的输入”与“必要原因”。

papers.title: flowengineR: A Modular and Extensible Framework for Fair and Reproducible Workflow Design in R
papers.abstract_en: flowengineR is an R package designed to provide a modular and extensible framework for building reproducible algorithmic workflows for general-purpose machine learning pipelines. It is motivated by the rapidly evolving field of algorithmic fairness, where new metrics, mitigation strategies, and methods continuously emerge. A central challenge in fairness, but also far beyond, is that existing toolkits either focus narrowly on single interventions or treat reproducibility and extensibility as secondary considerations rather than core design principles. flowengineR addresses this by introducing a unified architecture of standardized engines for data splitting, execution, preprocessing, training, inprocessing, postprocessing, evaluation, and reporting. Each engine encapsulates one methodological task yet communicates via a lightweight interface, ensuring workflows remain transparent, auditable, and easily extensible. Although implemented in R, flowengineR builds on ideas from workflow languages (CWL, YAWL), graph-oriented visual programming languages (KNIME), and R frameworks (BatchJobs, batchtools). Its emphasis, however, is less on orchestrating engines for resilient parallel execution than on the straightforward setup and management of distinct engines as data structures. This orthogonalization enables distributed responsibilities, independent development, and streamlined integration. In the context of fairness, by structuring fairness methods as interchangeable engines, flowengineR lets researchers integrate, compare, and evaluate interventions across the modeling pipeline. At the same time, the architecture generalizes to explainability, robustness, and compliance metrics without core modifications. While motivated by fairness, flowengineR ultimately provides a general infrastructure for any workflow context where reproducibility, transparency, and extensibility are essential.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. v2: revised terminology (S7 renamed "Regulatory Suitability", FAIR acronym corrected), added discussion of AI governance frameworks, updated related-work positioning and references, added a caveat on LLM-assisted engine generation, and hedged claims on runtime overhead and synthetic data. Software and reported benchmarks unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 flowengineR，一个用 R 实现的模块化、可扩展框架，用于构建可复现的通用机器学习流水线（algorithmic workflows），并以算法公平性（algorithmic fairness）为主要动机。该框架引入一套统一的标准化引擎架构，覆盖数据划分、执行、预处理、训练、inprocessing、postprocessing、评估与报告等环节，每个引擎封装单一方法任务并通过轻量级接口通信。作者强调其重点不是弹性并行执行，而是将不同引擎作为数据结构进行简单设置与管理，从而支持职责分离、独立开发和流畅集成，并可推广到可解释性、鲁棒性和合规性等场景。
Motivation: 现有工具包要么狭窄地聚焦于单一干预措施，要么把可复现性和可扩展性当作次要考虑而非核心设计原则；而公平性领域的新指标、缓解策略和方法持续涌现，需要一种能灵活集成、比较和评估这些干预的通用基础设施。
Method: 提出统一架构，将数据划分、执行、预处理、训练、inprocessing、postprocessing、评估和报告标准化为可互换的引擎（engines），引擎之间通过轻量级接口通信，并以数据结构方式管理；该设计借鉴了 CWL、YAWL、KNIME、BatchJobs 和 batchtools 等既有工作流与 R 框架的思想。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果或基准，其贡献主要是架构层面的：将公平性方法组织为可互换引擎，使研究者能在建模流水线中集成、比较和评估干预措施，同时该架构无需核心修改即可推广到可解释性、鲁棒性和合规性指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为 flowengineR 最终为任何以可复现性、透明性和可扩展性为核心的工作流场景提供通用基础设施；论文定位是框架与设计方法，而非针对特定任务的实证性能声称。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Self-Attention to Operator Learning-based 3D-IC Thermal Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Thermal management in 3D ICs is increasingly challenging due to higher power densities. Traditional PDE-solving-based methods, while accurate, are too slow for iterative design. Machine learning approaches like FNO provide faster alternatives but suffer from high-frequency information loss and high-fidelity data dependency. We introduce Self-Attention U-Net Fourier Neural Operator (SAU-FNO), a novel framework combining self-attention and U-Net with FNO to capture long-range dependencies and model local high-frequency features effectively. Transfer learning is employed to fine-tune low-fidelity data, minimizing the need for extensive high-fidelity datasets and speeding up training. Experiments demonstrate that SAU-FNO achieves state-of-the-art thermal prediction accuracy and provides an 842x speedup over traditional FEM methods, making it an efficient tool for advanced 3D IC thermal simulations.
papers.journal_ref: DAC 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAU-FNO（Self-Attention U-Net Fourier Neural Operator），将 self-attention 与 U-Net 结构结合到傅里叶神经算子（FNO）中，用于 3D IC 热仿真。该方法在保留 FNO 快速求解能力的同时，更好地建模长程依赖与局部高频热特征，并利用迁移学习在低保真度数据上微调以减少高保真数据需求。实验表明 SAU-FNO 达到最先进的热预测精度，相对传统有限元方法（FEM）获得 842 倍加速，发表于 DAC 2025。
Motivation: 3D IC 功率密度不断增大使热管理愈发困难，传统基于 PDE 求解的方法虽然准确但迭代设计时速度太慢；现有机器学习方法（如 FNO）虽有加速效果，却存在高频信息丢失和对高保真数据依赖强的问题。
Method: 提出 SAU-FNO 框架，在 FNO 中组合 self-attention 与 U-Net，以同时捕捉长程依赖和局部高频特征；并采用迁移学习对低保真数据进行微调，从而减少对大规模高保真数据集的依赖并加快训练。
Result: 实验显示 SAU-FNO 取得当前最优的热预测精度，并对传统 FEM 方法实现 842 倍加速，摘要未给出具体误差数值或数据集细节。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SAU-FNO 是面向先进 3D IC 热仿真的高效工具，兼顾高精度与显著加速；摘要未明确讨论泛化范围或局限性。

papers.title: Deep Generative Model for Human Mobility Behavior
papers.abstract_en: Understanding and modeling human mobility is central to challenges in transport planning, sustainable urban design, and public health. Despite decades of effort, simulating individual mobility remains challenging because of its complex, context-dependent, and exploratory nature. Here, building on the activity-based view of daily mobility, we propose MobilityGen, a diffusion-based generative framework for simulating multi-attribute activity-travel sequences over days to weeks at large spatial scales. By linking behavioral attributes with environmental context, MobilityGen reproduces key patterns such as scaling laws for location visits, activity time allocation, and the coupled evolution of travel mode and destination choices. It reflects spatio-temporal variability and generates diverse and plausible mobility patterns consistent with the built environment. Beyond standard validation, MobilityGen enables analyses that have been difficult with earlier models, including how access to urban space varies across travel modes and how co-presence dynamics shape social exposure and segregation. Together, these results support an integrated, data-driven basis for fine-grained studies of human mobility behavior and its societal implications.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 理解并模拟人类移动行为对交通规划、可持续城市设计和公共健康至关重要，但个体移动仿真因其复杂、情境依赖和探索性而长期具有挑战性。
Method: 基于活动视角的日常移动观，提出 MobilityGen 扩散生成框架，生成多属性的活动-出行序列，并通过将行为属性与环境背景关联来刻画移动模式。
Result: MobilityGen 复现了地点访问标度律、活动时间分配、出行方式与目的地选择的耦合演化等关键模式，能够反映时空变异性并生成与建成环境一致、多样且合理的移动模式。摘要还报告了此前模型难以进行的分析，如不同出行方式下城市空间可达性的差异，以及共现动态对社会暴露和隔离的影响。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些结果为人类移动行为及其社会影响的细粒度研究提供了集成的、数据驱动的基础。

papers.title: Autonomy Reshapes How Personalization Affects Privacy Concerns and Trust in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents require personal information for personalization in order to effectively act on users' behalf, but this raises privacy concerns that can discourage data sharing, limiting both the autonomy levels at which agents can operate and the effectiveness of personalization. Yet the expanded design space of agent autonomy also presents opportunities to shape these effects, which remain underexplored. We conducted a $3\times3$ between-subjects experiment ($N=450$) to study how agent autonomy level influences personalization's effects on users' privacy concerns, trust, and willingness to use, as well as the underlying psychological processes. We find that risk-contingent autonomy, where the agent delegates control back to users upon detecting potential privacy leakage, improves users' perceived control. This in turn attenuates personalization's adverse effects: privacy concerns rise less and trust declines less. Our results suggest that designing $\textbf{agent's autonomy}$ that supports $\textbf{human autonomy}$ (both perceived control and oversight effectiveness) helps users benefit from personalization without being deterred by growing privacy concerns. This positions aligning decision authority between users and agents ($\textbf{autonomy alignment}$) as an important opportunity and challenge for trustworthy human-agent interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一个 3×3 被试间实验（N=450）考察 LLM 代理 (LLM agent) 的自主性水平如何调节个性化对用户隐私担忧、信任和使用意愿的影响，并探究其中的心理机制。研究发现，风险条件自主性（risk-contingent autonomy，即代理在检测到潜在隐私泄露时将控制权交回用户）能够提升用户的感知控制，从而减弱个性化的负面效应：隐私担忧上升更少、信任下降更少。作者据此提出，设计既支持人类自主性（感知控制与监督有效性）的代理自主性，有助于用户在隐私担忧下仍受益于个性化。
Motivation: LLM 代理为实现个性化需要获取用户个人信息，但隐私担忧会阻碍数据共享，进而限制代理可运行的自主性水平和个性化效果。代理自主性的扩展设计空间可能被用来塑造这些效应，但这一机会尚未被充分探索。
Method: 作者开展了一个 3×3 的被试间在线实验（N=450），操纵代理自主性水平，测量用户的隐私担忧、信任、使用意愿以及感知控制等心理过程。关键设计是引入风险条件自主性，即代理在检测到潜在隐私泄露时把决策控制归还给用户。
Result: 摘要报告，相比其他自主性设计，风险条件自主性显著提高了用户的感知控制，并借此缓解了个性化带来的负面影响：隐私担忧上升幅度更小、信任下降幅度也更小。
Conclusion: 作者总结称，将代理的决策权威与用户的自注意愿对齐（autonomy alignment）是可信人机交互的重要机遇与挑战，合理的自主性设计应同时支持用户的感知控制和监督有效性，使个性化收益不被隐私担忧抵消。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Matrix-free Neural Preconditioner for the Dirac Operator in Lattice Gauge Theory
papers.abstract_en: Linear systems arise in generating samples and in calculating observables in lattice quantum chromodynamics~(QCD). Solving the Hermitian positive definite systems, which are sparse but ill-conditioned, involves using iterative methods, such as Conjugate Gradient (CG), which are time-consuming and computationally expensive. Preconditioners can effectively accelerate this process, with the state-of-the-art being multigrid preconditioners. However, constructing useful preconditioners can be challenging, adding additional computational overhead, especially in large linear systems. We propose a framework, leveraging operator learning techniques, to construct linear maps as effective preconditioners. The method in this work does \emph{not} rely on explicit matrices from either the original linear systems or the produced preconditioners, allowing efficient model training and application in the CG solver. In the context of the Schwinger model U(1) gauge theory in 1+1 spacetime dimensions with two degenerate-mass fermions), this preconditioning scheme effectively decreases the condition number of the linear systems and approximately halves the number of iterations required for convergence in relevant parameter ranges. We further demonstrate the framework learns a general mapping dependent on the lattice structure which leads to zero-shot learning ability for the Dirac operators constructed from gauge field configurations of different sizes.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 10 figures. Accepted for publication in ACM Transactions on AI for Science
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向格点量子色动力学（lattice QCD）中求解 Dirac 算子线性系统的问题，提出一种基于算子学习（operator learning）的无矩阵（matrix-free）神经预条件子框架。该方法不依赖原始线性系统或预条件子的显式矩阵，可直接用于共轭梯度（CG）求解器。在 1+1 维 Schwinger 模型 U(1) 规范理论的实验中，预条件子有效降低了线性系统的条件数，并在相关参数范围内将收敛所需迭代次数减少约一半。作者还展示了该框架学习到依赖格点结构的通用映射，对不同尺寸规范场构型构造的 Dirac 算子具有零样本（zero-shot）学习能力。
Motivation: 格点 QCD 中生成样本和计算可观测量需要求解大量稀疏但病态的 Hermitian 正定线性系统，迭代方法如共轭梯度（CG）耗时且计算昂贵。现有的最先进预条件子是多网格（multigrid）预条件子，但其构造在大规模线性系统中具有额外计算开销且具有挑战性。
Method: 提出利用算子学习技术构建作为有效预条件子的线性映射，全程不依赖原始线性系统或预条件子的显式矩阵，从而支持高效的模型训练和 CG 求解器中的应用。
Result: 在包含两个简并质量费米子的 1+1 维 Schwinger 模型 U(1) 规范理论中，该预条件方案降低了线性系统的条件数，并在相关参数范围内将收敛所需迭代次数大约减半；框架还展示了针对不同尺寸格点规范场构型的零样本泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能够学习依赖格点结构的通用映射，从而实现对不同尺寸 Dirac 算子的零样本学习，同时通过避免显式矩阵降低训练与应用成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scalable extensions to given-data Sobol' index estimators
papers.abstract_en: Given-data methods for variance-based sensitivity analysis have significantly advanced the feasibility of Sobol' index computation for computationally expensive models and models with many inputs. However, the limitations of existing methods still preclude their application to models with an extremely large number of inputs. In this work, we present practical and theoretical extensions to the existing given-data Sobol' index method, which allow variance-based sensitivity analysis to be efficiently performed on large models such as neural networks, which have $>10^4$ inputs. For models of this size, holding all input-output evaluations simultaneously in memory---as required by existing methods---can quickly become impractical. Our extensions include a general definition of the given-data Sobol' index estimator with arbitrary partition, a streaming algorithm to process input-output samples in batches, and an asymptotic analysis of the new estimator that motivates a practical screening heuristic for small indices. We show that the equiprobable partition employed in existing given-data methods can introduce significant bias into Sobol' index estimates even at large sample sizes and provide numerical analyses that demonstrate why this can occur. We also show that the streaming algorithm can achieve comparable accuracy and runtime while substantially reducing memory requirements, enabling sensitivity analysis of models with much larger input dimension. We demonstrate our novel developments on two application problems in neural network modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了基于给定数据的 Sobol' 指数估计方法，使其适用于输入维度超过 10^4 的大型模型（如神经网络）。作者提出任意划分下的估计量通用定义、流式批量处理算法以及支持小指数筛选的渐近分析，并指出现有等概率划分可能在大样本下仍引入显著偏差。在两个神经网络建模问题上的数值实验表明，流式算法在保持精度和运行时间的同时大幅降低内存需求。
Motivation: 现有的 given-data Sobol' 指数方法要求同时将所有输入-输出评估保留在内存中，对于具有极多输入（如神经网络）的模型不可行，限制了方差敏感性分析在大规模模型上的应用。
Method: 提出三个扩展：任意分区下 given-data Sobol' 指数估计量的通用定义；分批处理输入-输出样本的流式算法；新估计量的渐近分析，并据此提出针对小指数的实用筛选启发式。此外还数值分析了等概率分区导致估计偏差的原因。
Result: 数值分析表明现有方法使用的等概率分区即使在大样本下也会给 Sobol' 指数估计引入显著偏差；流式算法在实现相当精度和运行时间的同时大幅减少内存需求，使更大输入维度模型的敏感性分析成为可能。方法在神经网络建模的两个应用问题上得到验证。
Conclusion: 作者强调这些扩展使方差敏感性分析能够高效应用于输入超过 10^4 的大型模型，并指出等概率分区的偏差问题以及流式算法在内存效率上的优势。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: ATLASFusion: Aggregation Tracking with Location-Aware Sparse Fusion for Robust Spatio-Temporal Multi-View Pedestrian Tracking
papers.abstract_en: For multimedia spatial intelligence through time, multi-view multi-object tracking (MVMOT) suffers from persistent challenges in maintaining consistent object identities across different camera views, leading to tracking inaccuracies. A key source of these errors in modern methods is the distortion of feature representations when projecting from multiple views into a unified Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) space. This projection often creates non-uniform feature densities, harming the reliability of the fused representation. To address this, we present ATLASFusion, a reliability-aware sparse BEV fusion framework built on three complementary techniques: a sparse perspective transform that projects only valid feature points to prevent interpolation artifacts, density-aware weighted aggregation that assigns higher confidence to spatially reliable regions, and per-view BEV supervision that supervises each camera's BEV features independently before fusion. Experiments on the WildTrack and MultiViewX benchmarks demonstrated improvements in IDF1, MODP, and robustness over the baseline. ATLASFusion achieved a 95.9\% IDF1 tracking score on WildTrack, the highest among the compared methods and improved the localization precision (MODP) from 75.0\% to 89.2\% on MultiViewX. ATLASFusion also exhibited strong robustness under calibration noise. When high-magnitude noise was injected, TrackTacular failed entirely at 0.0\% MODA, whereas ATLASFusion retained 40.1\% MODA. When the input resolution was reduced by half, MVTr failed entirely and TrackTacular degraded by 2.7\% MODA, while ATLASFusion sustained 92.5\% MODA with only a 1.1\% decrease. These gains were achieved with negligible computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ATLASFusion，一种可靠性感知的稀疏 BEV 融合框架，用于多视角多目标跟踪（MVMOT）。它通过稀疏透视变换、密度感知加权聚合和逐视角 BEV 监督来缓解多视角投影到统一 BEV 空间时产生的特征扭曲与非均匀密度问题。在 WildTrack 和 MultiViewX 上，该方法在 IDF1、MODP 和鲁棒性上均优于基线，且计算开销可忽略。
Motivation: 多视角多目标跟踪中跨视角维持身份一致性困难，现有方法将多视角投影到统一 Bird's-Eye-View（BEV）空间时会造成特征表示扭曲，产生非均匀特征密度，从而损害融合表示的可靠性，导致跟踪不准确。
Method: 提出可靠性感知的稀疏 BEV 融合框架，包含三种互补技术：仅投影有效特征点的稀疏透视变换以避免插值伪影；密度感知加权聚合，对空间可靠区域赋予更高置信度；以及在融合前对每个相机的 BEV 特征进行独立监督的逐视角 BEV 监督。
Result: 在 WildTrack 和 MultiViewX 基准上，IDF1、MODP 和鲁棒性均较基线提升。WildTrack 上达到 95.9% IDF1，为对比方法中最高；MultiViewX 上 MODP 从 75.0% 提升至 89.2%。高幅校准噪声下，TrackTacular 完全失败（MODA 为 0.0%），而 ATLASFusion 仍保持 40.1% MODA；输入分辨率减半时，MVTr 完全失败、TrackTacular 下降 2.7% MODA，ATLASFusion 仅下降 1.1% 并保持 92.5% MODA，且计算开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过可靠性感知的稀疏 BEV 融合可以有效缓解投影导致的特征失真，在提升 MVMOT 精度和鲁棒性的同时保持极低的额外计算成本。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 ATLASFusion，一种可靠性感知的稀疏 BEV 融合框架，用于多视角多目标跟踪（MVMOT）。它通过稀疏透视变换、密度感知加权聚合和逐视角 BEV 监督来缓解多视角投影到统一 BEV 空间时产生的特征扭曲与非均匀密度问题。在 WildTrack 和 MultiViewX 上，该方法在 IDF1、MODP 和鲁棒性上均优于基线，且计算开销可忽略。
summary_sections.motivation: 多视角多目标跟踪中跨视角维持身份一致性困难，现有方法将多视角投影到统一 Bird's-Eye-View（BEV）空间时会造成特征表示扭曲，产生非均匀特征密度，从而损害融合表示的可靠性，导致跟踪不准确。
summary_sections.method: 提出可靠性感知的稀疏 BEV 融合框架，包含三种互补技术：仅投影有效特征点的稀疏透视变换以避免插值伪影；密度感知加权聚合，对空间可靠区域赋予更高置信度；以及在融合前对每个相机的 BEV 特征进行独立监督的逐视角 BEV 监督。
summary_sections.result: 在 WildTrack 和 MultiViewX 基准上，IDF1、MODP 和鲁棒性均较基线提升。WildTrack 上达到 95.9% IDF1，为对比方法中最高；MultiViewX 上 MODP 从 75.0% 提升至 89.2%。高幅校准噪声下，TrackTacular 完全失败（MODA 为 0.0%），而 ATLASFusion 仍保持 40.1% MODA；输入分辨率减半时，MVTr 完全失败、TrackTacular 下降 2.7% MODA，ATLASFusion 仅下降 1.1% 并保持 92.5% MODA，且计算开销可忽略。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明，通过可靠性感知的稀疏 BEV 融合可以有效缓解投影导致的特征失真，在提升 MVMOT 精度和鲁棒性的同时保持极低的额外计算成本。

papers.title: NeuroBreak: Unveil Internal Jailbreak Mechanisms in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: In deployment and application, large language models (LLMs) typically undergo safety alignment to prevent illegal and unethical outputs. However, the continuous advancement of jailbreak attack techniques, designed to bypass safety mechanisms with adversarial prompts, has placed increasing pressure on the security defenses of LLMs. Strengthening resistance to jailbreak attacks requires an in-depth understanding of the security mechanisms and vulnerabilities of LLMs. However, the vast number of parameters and complex structure of LLMs make analyzing security weaknesses from an internal perspective a challenging task. This paper presents NeuroBreak, a top-down jailbreak analysis system designed to analyze neuron-level safety mechanisms and mitigate vulnerabilities. We carefully design system requirements through collaboration with three experts in the field of AI security. The system provides a comprehensive analysis of various jailbreak attack methods. By incorporating layer-wise representation probing analysis, NeuroBreak offers a novel perspective on the model's decision-making process throughout its generation steps. Furthermore, the system supports the analysis of critical neurons from both semantic and functional perspectives, facilitating a deeper exploration of security mechanisms. We conduct quantitative evaluations and case studies to verify the effectiveness of our system, offering mechanistic insights for developing next-generation defense strategies against evolving jailbreak attacks.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 10 figures. Accepted to IEEE VIS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuroBreak，一个自顶向下的越狱分析系统，用于在神经元层面分析大语言模型的安全机制并缓解脆弱性。系统通过与三位 AI 安全专家协作设计需求，整合层表示探测分析（layer-wise representation probing），并支持从语义和功能两个视角分析关键神经元。定量评估和案例研究验证了系统有效性，为应对不断演化的越狱攻击提供机制性见解。
Motivation: 越狱攻击技术持续进步，对 LLM 的安全防御造成压力，而加深对模型内部安全机制和漏洞的理解是强化防御的前提；但 LLM 参数规模庞大、结构复杂，从内部视角分析安全弱点较为困难。
Method: 通过三位 AI 安全领域专家的协作来设计系统需求；系统综合分析多种越狱攻击方法，引入逐层表示探测分析以呈现模型生成过程中的决策机制，并支持从语义与功能角度分析关键神经元。
Result: 定量评估与案例研究验证了系统的有效性，并提供了可用于开发下一代防御策略的机制性见解。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该系统能为理解 LLM 内部安全机制提供新视角，并为对抗不断演化的越狱攻击、设计下一代防御策略奠定基础。

papers.title: Enhancing Knowledge Tracing through Leakage-Free and Recency-Aware Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge Tracing (KT) aims to predict a student's future performance based on their sequence of interactions with learning content. Many KT models rely on knowledge concepts (KCs), which represent the skills required for each item. However, some of these models are vulnerable to label leakage, a phenomenon in which the input data inadvertently reveal the correct answer, particularly in datasets with multiple KCs per question. We propose a straightforward yet effective solution to prevent label leakage by masking ground-truth labels during input embedding construction whenever such leakage could occur. To accomplish this, we introduce a dedicated \texttt{MASK} label, inspired by masked language modeling (e.g., BERT), to replace ground-truth labels. In addition, we introduce Recency Encoding, which encodes the step-wise distance between the current item and its most recent previous occurrence. This distance is important for modeling learning dynamics such as forgetting, which is a fundamental aspect of human learning, yet it is often overlooked in existing models. Recency Encoding demonstrates improved performance over traditional positional encodings on multiple KT benchmarks. We show that incorporating our embeddings into KT models such as DKT, DKT+, AKT, and SAKT consistently improves prediction accuracy across multiple benchmarks. The approach is both efficient and widely applicable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对知识追踪（Knowledge Tracing, KT）中多知识点（KC）题目前提下输入嵌入可能意外泄露正确答案（label leakage）的问题，提出在输入嵌入构建时用类似 BERT 的专用 MASK token 替换可能泄露的 ground-truth 标签；同时提出 Recency Encoding，编码当前题目与其最近一次出现之间的步数距离，以建模遗忘这类学习动态。将该嵌入融入 DKT、DKT+、AKT、SAKT 等模型后，在多个 KT 基准上一致提升预测准确率。
Motivation: KT 模型在使用多个知识点的题目时，输入数据可能无意中泄露正确答案，妨碍模型的可靠评估；此外已有模型很少显式考虑题目最近出现距离，而该距离对建模遗忘等人脑学习动态很重要。
Method: 提出两个嵌入层面的改进：一是标签泄漏防护掩码，在可能发生泄漏时用专门的 MASK label 替换 ground-truth 标签；二是 Recency Encoding，将当前项目与其最近一次出现之间的逐步距离编码进输入表示。
Result: 摘要报告 Recency Encoding 在多个 KT 基准上优于传统位置编码（positional encoding）；将上述嵌入集成进 DKT、DKT+、AKT 和 SAKT 后，在多个基准上均持续提升预测准确率。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 该方法高效且广泛适用，可在不改动模型主体的情况下提升多种 KT 模型的预测精度，同时缓解标签泄漏并显式注入遗忘相关的距离信息。

papers.title: ML-PWS: Estimating the Mutual Information Between Experimental Time Series Using Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: The ability to quantify information transmission is crucial for the analysis and design of both natural and engineered systems. For systems driven by time-varying signals, the fundamental measure is the information transmission rate. However, due to the high dimensionality of signal trajectory space, this rate cannot be obtained directly from time-series data without approximations. Path Weight Sampling (PWS) is a computational technique that enables the exact calculation of the information rate for any stochastic model, raising the question of how this rate can be determined from time-series data in the absence of a prior model. Here, we present a method that combines machine learning (ML) with PWS: a generative model is learned from time-series data, to which PWS is applied to yield a rigorous lower bound on the information rate. We demonstrate the accuracy of this technique, called ML-PWS, by comparing its results on synthetic time-series data generated from several non-linear models against ground-truth results obtained by applying PWS directly to the same models. We illustrate the utility of ML-PWS by applying it to neuronal time-series data.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables, includes Supplemental Material; submitted to Phys. Rev. Lett
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ML-PWS，一种结合机器学习与路径权重采样（Path Weight Sampling, PWS）的方法，用于从实验时间序列数据中估计信息传输率。其思路是先学习一个生成模型，再对其应用PWS，从而得到信息率的严格下界。作者在多个非线性模型生成的合成时间序列上与直接应用PWS得到的真实结果对比，验证了准确性，并将其应用于神经元时间序列数据。
Motivation: 由于信号轨迹空间维度高，信息传输率无法直接从时间序列数据中获得，通常需要近似。PWS虽能对任意随机模型精确计算信息率，但前提是已有模型；这里要解决的是在缺乏先验模型时如何从数据估计该速率。
Method: 提出ML-PWS：从时间序列数据学习一个生成模型，然后将PWS应用于该模型，得到信息传输率的严格下界。
Result: 在多个非线性模型生成的合成时间序列上，ML-PWS的结果与直接对模型应用PWS得到的真实结果一致，验证了准确性；并将该方法应用于神经元时间序列数据，展示了其实用性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调ML-PWS能在没有先验模型的情况下，通过生成模型与PWS结合，从时间序列数据严格估计信息传输率，并在神经科学数据上显示出应用价值。

papers.title: Probabilistic Circuits for Knowledge Graph Completion with Reduced Rule Sets
papers.abstract_en: Rule-based methods for knowledge graph completion provide explainable results, but often require tens of thousands of rules to achieve competitive performance. Although individual predictions may use only a few rules, reasoning over an entire dataset requires these massive rule sets, hampering system-level understanding. We address this by learning a probability distribution over sets of rules that work together using probabilistic circuits. Our approach achieves a 70-96% reduction in the number of rules needed to reach peak baseline performance. Using an equivalent minimal number of rules, we outperform the baseline by up to 31$\times$. When comparing our minimal rule sets against baseline's full rule sets, we preserve 91% of peak baseline performance. Empirical validation on 8 benchmark datasets shows that our reduced rule sets exhibit higher utilization---fewer rules are wasted, and each prediction requires fewer rules. We show that our framework is grounded in well-known semantics of Nilsson's probabilistic logic and does not require independence assumptions. We provide exact probabilistic inference as well as an efficient lower bound and evaluate both.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于规则的知识图谱补全（knowledge graph completion）需要数万条规则才能达到有竞争力性能的问题，提出用概率电路（probabilistic circuits）学习规则的联合分布，从而选择少量可协同工作的规则构成精简规则集。摘要报告该方法在 8 个基准数据集上将达到基线峰值性能所需规则数减少 70-96%，在等效最小规则数下比基线最高提升 31 倍，并用精简规则集保留了基线完整规则集 91% 的峰值性能。
Motivation: 基于规则的知识图谱补全方法虽可解释，但为了在整个数据集上取得有竞争力的性能通常需要数万条规则；即使单条预测只依赖少数规则，系统级推理仍被巨大规则集拖累，阻碍对模型的整体理解。
Method: 提出用概率电路对能协同工作的规则集合上的概率分布进行学习，以挑选精简规则子集；该框架建立在 Nilsson 概率逻辑的语义之上，不需要独立性假设，并提供精确概率推理以及一个高效下界。
Result: 在 8 个基准数据集上，精简规则集达到基线峰值性能所需规则数减少 70-96%；使用等价最小规则数时性能最高超出基线 31 倍；与基线完整规则集相比，精简规则集保留 91% 的峰值性能，并展现出更高的规则利用率，即更少规则被浪费且每次预测所需规则更少。
Conclusion: 作者认为其框架能显著压缩规则集并保持大部分性能，同时提升规则利用率与系统级可理解性；方法在理论上与 Nilsson 概率逻辑一致，且无需独立性假设，但压缩后仍会损失约 9% 的峰值性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physics-Informed Policy Iteration for High-Dimensional Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman Equations: Interior Error Bounds without Boundary Data
papers.abstract_en: We develop a physics-informed policy-iteration method for stationary second-order Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equations arising in continuous-time stochastic control. Each policy-evaluation step is a linear elliptic PDE and is approximated by a mesh-free neural residual solver; policy improvement is then performed pointwise from the surrogate gradient. The analysis addresses bounded-domain training without prescribed boundary data. We prove well-posedness of the PDE-defined evaluation for every Borel Markov policy, establish Lipschitz stability of the greedy map on bounded gradient ranges, and derive an exponential attenuation estimate for unresolved boundary information. These ingredients yield a closed finite-step interior error bound whose floors are determined by a continuous $L^p$ residual, with a finite exponent $p>d$, and an attenuated amplitude term. The experiments measure the quantities in the estimate. On a linear--quadratic testbed with an exact reference, the gradient-error floor scales nearly linearly with a fresh-sample $L^p$ residual estimate, and finite-difference probes identify when a training buffer is beneficial. At matched architecture and budget, linear fixed-policy training becomes markedly more reliable than direct minimization of the nonlinear HJB residual as the tested problems become more difficult. The method also produces effective feedback on an inverted pendulum, a planar quadrotor, and a 100-dimensional posterior-seeking problem. These nonlinear tests expose two limitations not visible from sampled residuals alone: the collocation distribution may miss the region visited by the learned closed loop, and evaluation without boundary data may leave undetermined the gradient component on which the greedy update depends. On-policy collocation, rollout-anchored evaluation, and rollout-based stopping provide effective model-only safeguards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理信息策略迭代方法 (physics-informed policy iteration)，用于求解连续时间随机控制中的稳态二阶 Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman 方程。每个策略评估步骤对应一个线性椭圆 PDE，用无网格神经残差求解器近似，策略改进则从代理梯度逐点执行。作者在无预设边界数据的有限域训练场景下，证明了 Borel Markov 策略下评估问题的适定性、贪心映射的 Lipschitz 稳定性以及未解析边界信息的指数衰减估计，并由此导出闭式有限步内点误差界。实验在 LQ 基准、倒立摆、平面四旋翼和 100 维后验追踪问题上验证方法。
Motivation: 高维 HJB 方程求解受维度诅咒影响且通常依赖边界数据，而实际随机控制问题往往难以提供完整边界信息；作者希望建立无需边界数据的有界域神经求解方法，并给出严格的内点误差保证。
Method: 采用策略迭代框架：每个策略评估步骤解一个线性椭圆 PDE，用无网格神经残差求解器近似；策略改进在逐点上由神经网络代理梯度完成。理论部分分析了评估问题的适定性、贪心映射在有界梯度范围内的 Lipschitz 稳定性，并利用边界信息随距离指数衰减的性质构造内点误差界，界中地板项由连续 L^p 残差 (p>d) 和衰减幅度项决定。
Result: 在线性二次 (linear-quadratic) 测试床上，梯度误差下界与新鲜样本的 L^p 残差估计近似呈线性关系；有限差分探针可用于判断训练缓冲是否有利。在相同架构与计算预算下，线性固定策略训练比直接最小化非线性 HJB 残差更可靠，且该方法在倒立摆、平面四旋翼和 100 维后验追踪问题中能产生有效反馈控制。
Conclusion: 作者强调，非线性测试暴露了仅看采样残差难以发现的两个局限：配点分布可能漏掉学习闭环实际访问的区域，且无边界数据评估可能留下贪心更新所依赖的梯度分量不确定。为此提出 on-policy 配点、rollout-anchored 评估和 rollout-based 停止作为仅依赖模型的有效防护措施。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MetaLint: Easy-to-Hard Generalization for Code Linting
papers.abstract_en: Large language models excel at code generation but struggle with code linting, particularly in generalizing to unseen or evolving best practices beyond those observed during training. We introduce MetaLint, a meta-learning framework that formulates code linting as an instruction-following task, where a model evaluates whether code adheres to a natural language specification of best practices. In contrast to prior work that trains models to detect violations from a fixed set of best practices, MetaLint evaluates code against a provided natural language specification, enabling test-time control over which practices to enforce and generalization to unseen or evolving rules without retraining. We demonstrate that models trained solely on synthetic data generated from automatic linters still generalize to harder, context-dependent best practices for which such linters are not available. To evaluate generalization beyond such easy signals, we introduce a human-curated benchmark of hard best practices inspired by Python Enhancement Proposals (PEPs). On this benchmark, MetaLint substantially improves performance without explicit fine-tuning on target best practices and exhibits strong, easy-to-hard generalization. Qwen3-4B achieves a 2.7x detection F-score gain (25.9% -> 70.4%), the highest recall, and a 26.7% localization F-score, matching larger models such as o3-mini. These gains generalize across programming languages, model families, scales, reasoning settings, and linter sources. We release the code and benchmark to support reproducibility and future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MetaLint，一个将代码 linting 表述为指令跟随任务的元学习框架，使模型依据自然语言的最佳实践规范来评估代码，从而支持测试时控制执行哪些规则，并能泛化到未见或演化的规则。作者仅用自动 linter 生成的合成数据训练，便可在人工策划的、基于 PEP 的困难最佳实践基准上表现出显著的 easy-to-hard 泛化。Qwen3-4B 在检测 F-score 上从 25.9% 提升至 70.4%（2.7 倍），并匹配 o3-mini 等更大模型的定位能力。
Motivation: 大型语言模型在代码生成上表现出色，但在代码 linting 上困难，尤其是在泛化到训练中未见或随时间演变的最佳实践时。现有方法依赖固定的最佳实践集合进行违规检测，难以适应新规则。
Method: MetaLint 将代码 linting 转化为指令跟随任务：给定自然语言的最佳实践规范，模型评估代码是否遵守该规范。训练数据由自动 linter 生成的合成数据构成，测试时可动态指定要执行的实践，无需针对目标任务微调。
Result: 在人工策划的 PEP 基准上，Qwen3-4B 的检测 F-score 从 25.9% 提升到 70.4%（2.7 倍），取得最高召回率，并达到 26.7% 的定位 F-score，与 o3-mini 等更大模型相当；这些提升跨编程语言、模型家族、规模、推理设置和 linter 来源保持一致。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MetaLint 展示了无需对目标最佳实践显式微调即可实现的 strong easy-to-hard 泛化，并发布代码与基准以支持复现和后续研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MateInfoUB: A Real-World Benchmark for Testing LLMs in Competitive, Multilingual, and Multimodal Educational Tasks
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has transformed various domains, particularly computer science (CS) education. These models exhibit remarkable capabilities in code-related tasks and problem-solving, raising questions about their potential and limitations in advanced CS contexts. This study presents a novel bilingual (English-Romanian) multimodal (text and image) dataset of multiple-choice questions derived from a high-level computer science competition. A particularity of our dataset is that the problems are conceived such that some of them are easier solved using reasoning on paper, while for others writing code is more efficient. We systematically evaluate State of The Art LLMs on this dataset, analyzing their performance on theoretical programming tasks. Our findings reveal the strengths and limitations of current LLMs, including the influence of language choice (English vs. Romanian), providing insights into their applicability in CS education and competition settings. We also address critical ethical considerations surrounding educational integrity and the fairness of assessments in the context of LLM usage. These discussions aim to inform future educational practices and policies. To support further research, our dataset will be made publicly available in both English and Romanian. Additionally, we release an educational application tailored for Romanian students, enabling them to self-assess using the dataset in an interactive and practice-oriented environment.
papers.comment: 14 pages (9 paper, 2 references, 3 annexes). Accepted for BEA 2025!
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 MateInfoUB，一个双语（英语-罗马尼亚语）、多模态（文本与图像）的计算机科学竞赛多选题数据集，用于评测 LLM 在高级 CS 教育任务上的表现。作者系统评估了多种 SOTA LLM，分析其在理论编程任务上的能力，以及语言选择（英语 vs 罗马尼亚语）的影响，并讨论了教育诚信与评估公平性的伦理问题。数据集将以英罗双语公开，并发布面向罗马尼亚学生的自测教育应用。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 评测多聚焦代码生成与问题求解，缺乏针对高级 CS 竞赛场景、融合文本与图像且跨语言的理论性任务的真实世界基准；同时需要探讨 LLM 在 CS 教育评估中的适用性与伦理影响。
Method: 构建来自高水平计算机科学竞赛的双语多模态多项选择题数据集，题目设计上部分适合纸面推理、部分更适合写代码解决；随后对 SOTA LLM 进行系统评测，并对比英语与罗马尼亚语输入下的表现。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，仅报告了当前 LLM 在理论编程任务上的优势与局限，并指出语言选择会影响模型表现。
Conclusion: 作者认为研究结果可为 LLM 在 CS 教育与竞赛场景中的应用提供洞见，并为教育实践与政策制定提供参考；数据集与教育应用将公开以支持后续研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: High-Layer Attention Pruning with Rescaling
papers.abstract_en: Pruning is a highly effective approach for compressing large language models (LLMs), significantly reducing inference latency. However, conventional training-free structured pruning methods often employ a heuristic metric that indiscriminately removes some attention heads across all pruning layers, without considering their positions within the network architecture. In this work, we propose a novel pruning algorithm that strategically prunes attention heads in the model's higher layers. Since the removal of attention heads can alter the magnitude of token representations, we introduce an adaptive rescaling parameter that calibrates the representation scale post-pruning to counteract this effect. We conduct comprehensive experiments on a wide range of LLMs, including LLaMA3.1-8B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, Qwen2-7B, and Gemma2-9B. Our evaluation includes both generation and discriminative tasks across 27 datasets. The results consistently demonstrate that our method outperforms existing structured pruning methods. This improvement is particularly notable in generation tasks, where our approach significantly outperforms existing baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/SongtaoLiu0823/HARP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对大语言模型（LLM）的训练无关结构化剪枝算法，策略性地剪除模型较高层（higher layers）中的注意力头，并引入自适应重缩放参数（adaptive rescaling parameter）来校准剪枝后 token 表示的幅度。作者在 LLaMA3.1-8B、Mistral-7B-v0.3、Qwen2-7B 和 Gemma2-9B 上，覆盖 27 个数据集的生成与判别任务进行评估，结果显示该方法一致优于现有结构化剪枝方法，尤其在生成任务上提升显著。
Motivation: 现有训练无关的结构化剪枝方法通常采用启发式度量，在所有剪枝层中不加区分地移除注意力头，没有考虑注意力头在网络架构中的位置。作者认为这种忽视层位置的做法会导致次优剪枝，同时剪枝造成的 token 表示幅度变化也未被处理。
Method: 提出高层注意力剪枝算法，专门选择性地剪除模型较高层中的注意力头，以保留低层结构与功能。由于移除注意力头会改变 token 表示的幅度，作者引入自适应重缩放参数，在剪枝后重新校准表示的比例，以抵消这种影响。
Result: 在 LLaMA3.1-8B、Mistral-7B-v0.3、Qwen2-7B、Gemma2-9B 四个 LLM 上，跨 27 个数据集的生成与判别任务评估中，该方法一致优于现有结构化剪枝方法，其中在生成任务上的性能优势特别显著。
Conclusion: 作者强调剪枝时应考虑注意力头所在网络层的位置，并且剪枝后的表示需要重新缩放校准；代码已在 GitHub 开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: $T^{3}S$: Think in Thermal Time for Generalizable Crop Mapping from Satellite Image Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Crop type classification from optical satellite time series remains limited in its ability to generalize across growing seasons, particularly when crop phenology shifts due to inter-annual weather variability. This hampers deployment in operational settings where current-year labels are unavailable. In addition, uncertainty quantification is often overlooked, reducing the reliability of such approaches for practical crop monitoring. Inspired by ecophysiological principles, we introduce Thermal Time-based Temporal Sampling ($T^3S$), a simple, model-agnostic method that replaces calendar time with thermal time. By re-indexing satellite observations by cumulative growing degree days, $T^3S$ aligns phenologically equivalent growth stages across years, reducing temporal redundancy while concentrating on the most biologically informative periods. We evaluate $T^3S$ across three architecturally distinct backbones on (i) SwissCrop, a new country-scale, multi-year Sentinel-2 dataset with paired temperature data that we publicly release, and (ii) the cross-region TimeMatch benchmark spanning Denmark and France. Across these settings, $T^3S$ consistently improves cross-year and cross-region crop classification over several state-of-the-art baselines, including thermal positional encoding, with particularly strong gains in uncertainty calibration, robustness under label scarcity, and early-season prediction, while requiring no architectural modification. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/moturkoglu/T3S.
papers.comment: Camera-ready version for the ECCV CVPPA workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Thermal Time-based Temporal Sampling（T$^3$S），一种不依赖模型结构的时间序列重采样方法，把卫星观测的时间索引从日历年替换为累积生长度日（growing degree days），从而对齐不同年份间物候等价的生长阶段。作者在瑞士全国尺度新发布的 SwissCrop Sentinel-2 数据集和跨区域的 TimeMatch 基准（丹麦与法国）上，用三种不同骨干网络验证该方法。摘要报告 T$^3$S 在跨年和跨区域作物分类上持续优于多个基线，尤其在不确定性校准、标签稀缺鲁棒性和季初预测方面提升明显，且无需修改模型架构。
Motivation: 基于光学卫星时间序列的作物类型分类在跨生长季节泛化上受限，尤其是作物物候随年际天气变化发生漂移时；当前生长季标签不可用的运营场景更难部署。此外，不确定性量化常被忽略，降低了实际作物监测的可靠性。
Method: 借鉴生态生理学原理，提出用热时间（thermal time）替代日历时间：把卫星观测按累积生长度日重新索引，以对齐物候等价生长阶段，同时减少时间冗余并聚焦最具生物学信息价值的时段。方法本身是简单且模型无关的，不要求修改任何架构。
Result: 在 SwissCrop 和 TimeMatch（丹麦与法国）两个基准上，T$^3$S 在跨年和跨区域作物分类中一致优于多个当前最优基线，包括热位置编码（thermal positional encoding）；收益最突出的是不确定性校准、标签稀缺下的鲁棒性和早期季节预测。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，用热时间重索引时序观测可以更好地对齐不同年份的物候阶段，从而提升作物分类的跨季节与跨区域泛化能力；代码和数据集已公开。

papers.title: Reflex First, Reflect Later: Latency-Aware Embodied LLM Agents for Dynamic Response
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have substantially improved the planning capabilities of embodied agents, enabling their deployment in dynamic and safety-critical environments. However, these settings expose a critical limitation: inference latency. Delayed LLM responses can weaken real-time responsiveness and misalign agent reasoning with rapidly changing environmental states. This paper systematically studies the impact of inference latency on LLM-based embodied agents in dynamic environments. We introduce an FPS-based Time Conversion Mechanism (TCM) that maps inference time to elapsed simulation time, allowing computational delays to directly affect environmental evolution and agent outcomes. We instantiate this protocol in HAZARD and introduce Response Latency (RL) and Latency-to-Action Ratio (LAR) to evaluate agent responsiveness. Building on this framework, we propose the Rapid-Reflex Async-Reflect Agent (RRARA), which integrates rapid reflexive actions with asynchronous LLM reflection to mitigate latency-induced errors. We further introduce an LLM-based PrePlanner that generates cached object-centric subgoals, reducing repeated LLM calls while retaining the model's high-level reasoning capability. Experiments show that accounting for inference latency substantially changes embodied-agent performance and that RRARA achieves a stronger balance between decision quality and responsiveness.
papers.comment: Accepted by the CVPR 2025 Embodied AI Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究推理延迟对基于 LLM 的具身智能体在动态环境中的影响，并提出延迟感知的评估协议与代理架构。作者引入基于 FPS 的时间转换机制 (TCM) 将推理时间映射为仿真时间，在 HAZARD 环境实例化该协议，定义响应延迟 (RL) 和延迟-动作比 (LAR)。在此基础上提出 Rapid-Reflex Async-Reflect Agent (RRARA)，结合快速反射动作与异步 LLM 反思，并用 LLM-based PrePlanner 缓存面向对象的子目标以减少重复推理。实验表明考虑推理延迟会显著改变具身智能体性能，RRARA 在决策质量与响应性之间取得更好平衡。
Motivation: LLM 提升了具身智能体的规划能力，但在动态、安全关键环境中推理延迟会导致响应滞后、智能体推理与实际环境状态错配，削弱实时性。现有评估与设计大多忽略这一延迟成本。
Method: 提出基于 FPS 的时间转换机制 (TCM)，将推理时间映射为仿真时间，使计算延迟直接参与环境演化；在 HAZARD 中实例化协议并引入响应延迟 (RL) 与延迟-动作比 (LAR) 两个评估指标。随后构建 Rapid-Reflex Async-Reflect Agent (RRARA)，用快速反射动作保证即时响应、异步 LLM 反思修正错误，并引入 LLM-based PrePlanner 生成缓存的面向对象子目标以减少重复 LLM 调用。
Result: 实验表明，将推理延迟纳入考量会显著改变 LLM 具身智能体的性能评估结果；RRARA 在决策质量与响应性之间取得了比基线更强的平衡。
Conclusion: 作者强调在动态环境中需要延迟感知的评估协议与代理设计，RRARA 的快速反射加异步反思架构可作为兼顾实时性与高级推理能力的有效方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Contamination Means Overestimation? A Fine-Grained Empirical Study in Code Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, code intelligence has gained increasing importance in the field of automated software engineering. Meanwhile, the widespread adoption of Pretrained Language Models (PLMs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) has raised concerns regarding data contamination and its potential impact on model performance evaluation. Previous studies mainly focused on sample-level contamination, ignoring partial contamination scenarios that are pervasive in code intelligence. This paper fills this gap and presents a systematic empirical study to investigate the fine-grained data contamination on mainstream code tasks. Our study involves diverse representative PLMs: RoBERTa and GPT-2, and LLMs: LLaMA and StarCoder, covering three major tasks: code translation, code generation, and code summarization, across two Programming Languages (PLs): Java and Python. We categorize contamination scenarios into four types according to the code intelligence practice, namely input-only, output-only, unpaired, and paired contamination settings, and construct corresponding experimental and control groups for exploration. Experimental results show that, under the pre-training, fine-tuning, and inference paradigm adopted by PLMs, even deliberately injecting paired contamination does not lead to significant performance overestimation. But direct inference or small-scale fine-tuning uncovers the contamination effects. In contrast, LLMs with pre-training and inference paradigm are significantly affected by the paired contamination. Apart from the above, other contamination scenarios have no impact on both PLMs and LLMs. Our findings challenge the conventional belief that contamination inevitably leads to performance overestimation, providing new insights into the evaluation and deployment of code intelligence models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对代码智能任务中的数据污染问题，提出一种细粒度实证研究，将污染场景按代码智能实践划分为仅输入、仅输出、非配对和配对四类，并系统考察其在代码翻译、代码生成与代码摘要上的影响。实验覆盖 RoBERTa、GPT-2 等 PLM 以及 LLaMA、StarCoder 等 LLM，结果发现配对污染并非必然导致性能高估，挑战了传统认知。
Motivation: 以往研究主要关注样本级污染，忽略了代码智能中普遍存在的部分污染（partial contamination）场景，这会影响模型性能评估的可靠性。
Method: 作者构建了四种污染设置的实验组与对照组，覆盖代码翻译、代码生成、代码摘要三类任务以及 Java 和 Python 两种编程语言，并分别考察 PLM（RoBERTa、GPT-2）与 LLM（LLaMA、StarCoder）在不同训练推理范式下的表现。
Result: 在 PLM 的预训练-微调-推理范式下，即使刻意注入配对污染也不会导致显著性能高估；但直接推理或小规模微调会暴露污染效应。相比之下，采用预训练与推理范式的 LLM 会明显受到配对污染影响，而其余污染场景对两类模型均无影响。
Conclusion: 研究结论认为污染并不必然带来性能高估，这为代码智能模型的评测与部署提供了新的视角。

papers.title: ACEvo: Adversarial Co-Evolution of Problem Distributions and Solvers for Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to synthesize heuristic programs, yet most existing pipelines optimize solvers against fixed benchmark distributions. This static setup can obscure solver weaknesses and limit understanding of how LLM-designed algorithms adapt under distribution shift. We present Adversarial Co-Evolution (ACEvo), a closed-loop framework in which LLMs iteratively co-evolve two types of executable programs: heuristic solvers and problem generators. The generator proposes increasingly challenging instances, while the solver is refined to improve performance on the evolving distribution, forming an automated adversarial curriculum for program design and evaluation. We instantiate ACEvo on routing problems, including TSP, OP, and CVRP. Across these domains, the framework produces instance distributions that consistently induce larger optimality gaps than standard benchmarks and yields solver programs that outperform those obtained from static-training baselines under distribution shift. Beyond final performance, ACEvo provides a testbed for studying LLM-based algorithm design under evolving distributions, including how reflective mutation, adversarial feedback, and co-adaptation shape the evolution of both generators and solvers. These results suggest that closed-loop co-evolution is a promising paradigm for using language models not only to generate algorithms, but also to construct adaptive evaluation environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ACEvo（Adversarial Co-Evolution），一个闭环框架，让大语言模型（LLM）迭代协同进化两类可执行程序：启发式求解器（heuristic solver）和问题生成器（problem generator）。生成器不断产生更具挑战性的实例，求解器则在演化分布上被持续改进，从而构成自动化的对抗式课程（adversarial curriculum）。作者在 TSP、OP、CVRP 等路由问题上实例化该框架，发现其生成的实例分布比标准基准诱导出更大的最优性差距，且得到的求解器在分布偏移下优于静态训练基线。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的启发式程序合成管线大多在固定基准分布上优化求解器，这种静态设置会掩盖求解器的弱点，也限制了人们理解 LLM 设计的算法在分布偏移下如何适应。
Method: 提出 ACEvo 闭环协同进化框架：LLM 同时进化问题生成器和求解器程序，生成器提出越来越难的实例，求解器针对不断演化的实例分布进行改进；框架还包含反思式变异（reflective mutation）、对抗反馈（adversarial feedback）和协同适应（co-adaptation）机制。
Result: 在 TSP、OP 和 CVRP 上，ACEvo 产生的实例分布比标准基准持续诱导更大的最优性差距，并且所得求解器在分布偏移下优于静态训练基线的求解器。
Conclusion: 作者认为闭环协同进化是使用语言模型不仅生成算法、还构建自适应评估环境的有前景范式，并为研究 LLM 算法设计在演化分布下的行为提供了测试平台。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: How Much Backtracking is Enough? Exploring the Interplay of SFT and RL in Enhancing LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) suggest that reinforcement learning (RL) effectively internalizes search strategies, yielding significant improvements on challenging reasoning tasks through extended chains of thought. While backtracking is widely viewed as the core mechanism enabling this improvement, its precise dynamics and how SFT and RL interact to optimize for it, remain poorly understood. In this work, we argue that backtracking, the ability to explicitly revisit and revise earlier reasoning steps, is a key operator that enables the transition from linear generation to non-linear tree search for LLMs, unlocking strong performance on combinatorially complex tasks. We motivate this claim by first studying the interplay between supervised fine-tuning (SFT) warm-up and RL across eight reasoning tasks: Countdown, Sudoku, Arc 1D, Advanced Geometry, Color Cube Rotation, List Functions, Zebra Puzzles, and Self Reference. We find that a regular SFT warm-up using self-sampled CoT sequences provides a modest boost to subsequent RL compared to training without any SFT warm-up; however, such gains saturate as tasks become more difficult. Motivated by this failure mode, we introduce a backtracking-centric training recipe. By synthetically varying the number of explicit backtracking steps in the SFT warm-up, we show that (i) longer CoTs containing backtracks stabilize and amplify RL, and (ii) the optimal backtrack depth scales with task difficulty: zero for Arc 1D, one for Countdown, and five or more for Sudoku. Our findings establish that principled backtracking is essential for improving the model's reasoning capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究监督微调 (SFT) 与强化学习 (RL) 在增强大语言模型推理能力时的交互作用，主张回溯 (backtracking) 是使模型从线性生成转向非线性树搜索的关键算子。作者在八个推理任务上实验，发现常规 SFT warm-up 对后续 RL 提升有限，并提出以回溯为中心的训练方案，证明最优回溯深度随任务难度增加。
Motivation: RL 被认为能有效内化搜索策略，但回溯的具体动态以及 SFT 与 RL 如何协同优化回溯仍不清楚；常规 SFT warm-up 在困难任务上的收益会饱和，这是本文要解决的核心问题。
Method: 提出以回溯为中心的训练方案，在 SFT warm-up 中通过合成方式改变显式回溯步数，再叠加 RL，以观察回溯深度对不同难度推理任务的影响。
Result: 摘要报告：包含回溯的长 CoT 序列能稳定并放大 RL 的收益；最优回溯深度随任务难度增加，Arc 1D 为零步、Countdown 为一步、Sudoku 为五步及以上；常规 SFT warm-up 相比无 warm-up 只带来适度提升，且困难任务上饱和。
Conclusion: 作者强调，有原则的回溯 (principled backtracking) 对提升模型推理能力至关重要，而不是简单地依赖更长的思维链或常规 SFT warm-up。

summary_sections.motivation: RL 被认为能有效内化搜索策略，但回溯的具体动态以及 SFT 与 RL 如何协同优化回溯仍不清楚；常规 SFT warm-up 在困难任务上的收益会饱和，这是本文要解决的核心问题。
summary_sections.method: 提出以回溯为中心的训练方案，在 SFT warm-up 中通过合成方式改变显式回溯步数，再叠加 RL，以观察回溯深度对不同难度推理任务的影响。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告：包含回溯的长 CoT 序列能稳定并放大 RL 的收益；最优回溯深度随任务难度增加，Arc 1D 为零步、Countdown 为一步、Sudoku 为五步及以上；常规 SFT warm-up 相比无 warm-up 只带来适度提升，且困难任务上饱和。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调，有原则的回溯 (principled backtracking) 对提升模型推理能力至关重要，而不是简单地依赖更长的思维链或常规 SFT warm-up。

papers.title: Transformer-Based Neural Quantum Digital Twins for Many-Body Spectral Reconstruction and Adaptive Quantum-Annealing Schedule Design
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Transformer-based Neural Quantum Digital Twins (Tx-NQDTs) to reconstruct the low-energy spectral evolution of many-body quantum systems along quantum-annealing paths, including ground- and first-excited-state energies, spectral gaps, and transition matrix elements, at efficient computational cost. Tx-NQDTs employ a graph-informed Transformer neural network trained to estimate the spectral information needed for annealing-schedule design. We integrate these estimates with an adaptive schedule-construction procedure guided by first-order adiabatic perturbation theory (FOAPT), which is used as a closed-system spectral diagnostic to allocate annealing time near predicted spectral bottlenecks. Experiments on a D-Wave quantum annealer ($N=10,15,20$ logical variables, with schedules represented by up to 12 control points) show that Tx-NQDT-informed schedules can improve empirical ground-state success probabilities relative to the default $20\,μ\mathrm{s}$ linear schedule under the tested hardware conditions. The proposed schedules achieve success probabilities $2.2$--$11.7$ percentage points higher across the reported easy and hard subsets and outperform the default baseline in 44 of 60 cases. The results demonstrate the feasibility of using learned logical spectral information to automatically generate adaptive quantum-annealing schedules for practical hardware experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于 Transformer 的神经网络量子数字孪生 (Transformer-based Neural Quantum Digital Twins, Tx-NQDTs)，用于以较低计算成本重建多体量子系统沿量子退火路径的低能谱演化，包括基态与第一激发态能量、谱隙及跃迁矩阵元。作者将该谱估计与基于一阶绝热微扰理论 (FOAPT) 的自适应调度构造流程结合，并在 D-Wave 量子退火机上（N=10, 15, 20 个逻辑变量）进行实验。结果显示，相比默认 20 μs 线性调度，所生成调度将经验基态成功概率提高 2.2–11.7 个百分点，并在 60 个测试案例中的 44 个超过默认基线。
Motivation: 量子退火调度的设计需要沿退火路径的谱信息来识别绝热瓶颈，但对多体系统进行精确谱计算成本很高；该工作旨在以高效的计算开销重构所需的谱信息，并自动生成适用于实际硬件实验的自适应退火调度。
Method: 采用图感知的 Transformer 神经网络 (graph-informed Transformer) 训练用于估计退火调度设计所需的谱信息，并将这些估计与基于 FOAPT 的自适应调度构造过程集成，以闭系统谱诊断的方式在预测的谱瓶颈附近分配退火时间。
Result: 在 D-Wave 量子退火机上，针对 N=10、15、20 逻辑变量、每个调度最多 12 个控制点的设置，Tx-NQDT 生成的调度相比默认 20 μs 线性调度在报告的易、难子集上将经验基态成功概率提高 2.2–11.7 个百分点，并在 60 例中 44 例优于默认基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果证明了利用学到的逻辑谱信息自动生成自适应量子退火调度的可行性，可用于实际硬件实验；其贡献集中在退火路径谱重建与调度构造的结合上。

papers.title: SAKE: Structured Agentic Knowledge Extrapolation for Complex LLM Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge extrapolation is the process of inferring novel information by combining and extending existing knowledge that is explicitly available. It is essential for solving complex questions in specialized domains where retrieving comprehensive external knowledge is impractical. We propose SAKE (Structured Agentic Knowledge Extrapolation), a RL powered agentic framework that trains LLMs to autonomously retrieve and extrapolate structured knowledge through tool-augmented reinforcement learning. SAKE defines two exte nal KG tools: entity group construction and cross-group triplet retrieval. The model learns to interleave these 2 retrieval tools during a three-turn rollout: extracting key entities, filtering relevant concept groups, and associative reasoning by constructing new triplets through analogy. The entire pipeline is optimized end-to-end with GRPO using a reward that combines output format and answer correctness, teaching the model what to retrieve and how to reason over it. Our experiments proved that SAKE fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B model surpasses GPT-3.5-Turbo with state-of-the-art agentic KG reasoning on both biomedical (75.4% vs. 70.1%) and commonsense (81.3% vs. 74.7%) benchmarks, while reducing token usage by over 90%. These results demonstrate that associative reasoning over incomplete structured knowledge does not require large models with complex, multi-step prompting, thus can be learned end-to-end by small, open-weight models through reinforcement learning with the right tools and training signal. Our code is available at https://github.com/jxfan99/SAKE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAKE（Structured Agentic Knowledge Extrapolation），一个基于强化学习的智能体框架，让 LLM 通过工具增强的 RL 自主检索并外推结构化知识。该框架定义了两个外部知识图谱（KG）工具——实体组构建和跨组三元组检索，模型在三轮 rollout 中交替使用它们，完成关键实体提取、概念组过滤和基于类比的新三元组构造。整个管线用 GRPO 端到端优化，奖励结合输出格式与答案正确性。微调后的 Qwen2.5-7B 在生物医学与常识基准上超过 GPT-3.5-Turbo，并将 token 使用量降低 90% 以上。
Motivation: 在专业领域回答复杂问题时，检索全面外部知识往往不切实际，因此需要知识外推（knowledge extrapolation），即结合并扩展已有显式知识来推断新信息。作者希望证明这种能力不一定依赖超大模型和复杂多步提示，而可以由小型开放权重模型通过强化学习端到端学会。
Method: 提出 SAKE 框架，定义实体组构建与跨组三元组检索两个外部 KG 工具，模型在包含三轮的 rollout 中学习交替使用它们，依次提取关键实体、过滤相关概念组、并通过类比构造新三元组。整个流程使用 GRPO 端到端优化，奖励函数结合输出格式与答案正确性，从而同时教模型检索什么以及如何基于检索结果推理。
Result: 摘要报告 SAKE 微调的 Qwen2.5-7B 在生物医学基准上达到 75.4%（对比 GPT-3.5-Turbo 的 70.1%），在常识基准上达到 81.3%（对比 74.7%），同时 token 使用量减少超过 90%，取得当时最先进的智能体 KG 推理结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为，在结构化知识不完整时进行关联推理并不需要大模型配合复杂多步提示，借助恰当的工具和训练信号，小型开放权重模型可以通过强化学习端到端习得该能力；代码已开源。

papers.title: X2C: A Dataset Featuring Nuanced Facial Expressions for Realistic Humanoid Imitation
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained facial expression transfer from humans to humanoid agents presents a unique pattern recognition challenge due to the significant domain gap between biological facial dynamics and mechanical control spaces. While visual synthesis of talking heads has advanced rapidly, mapping high-dimensional visual cues to precise, physically constrained actuation signals remains an open problem, primarily due to the lack of large-scale paired data. To bridge this gap, we introduce X2C, a comprehensive benchmark dataset comprising 100,000 (image, control value) pairs. Unlike existing resources, X2C features nuanced, physically grounded expressions annotated with 30 continuous control parameters, establishing a high-fidelity standard for this task. Building on this resource, we propose X2CNet, a two-stage deep learning framework that explicitly decouples visual motion features from mechanical control regression to model the correspondence between human perceptual cues and humanoid actuation. Extensive experiments, including quantitative benchmarking and real-world physical validation, demonstrate that our approach achieves superior cross-domain consistency and enables robust, in-the-wild expression imitation. Code and Data: https://lipzh5.github.io/X2CNet/
papers.comment: Accepted by Pattern Recognition. Title updated and manuscript revised following peer review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 X2C，一个包含 100,000 对 (image, control value) 的人形机器人细粒度表情模仿基准数据集，并配套提出两阶段深度框架 X2CNet，将视觉运动特征与机械控制回归显式解耦。摘要称在量化基准和真实物理验证中，该方法取得更优的跨域一致性并支持鲁棒的野外表情模仿。
Motivation: 细粒度面部表情从人类迁移到人形机器人存在生物动态与机械控制空间之间的显著域差距，而高维视觉线索到受物理约束的执行信号的映射缺乏大规模配对数据，是当前开放问题。
Method: 构建 X2C 数据集，包含用 30 个连续控制参数标注的细粒度、物理基础的表情对；提出 X2CNet，一种两阶段深度学习框架，将视觉运动特征提取与机械控制回归显式解耦，建模人类感知线索与人形执行之间的对应关系。
Result: 摘要报告，在定量基准测试和真实世界物理验证中，X2CNet 相比现有方法实现更优的跨域一致性，并具备鲁棒的野外表情模仿能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为该数据集和两阶段框架为高保真人形表情模仿建立了基准，并公开代码与数据。

papers.title: neuralGAM: An R Package for Fitting Generalized Additive Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Nowadays, Neural Networks are considered one of the most effective methods for various tasks such as anomaly detection, computer-aided disease detection, or natural language processing. However, these networks suffer from the ``black-box'' problem which makes it difficult to understand how they make decisions. In order to solve this issue, an R package called neuralGAM is introduced. This package implements a Neural Network topology based on Generalized Additive Models, allowing to fit an independent Neural Network to estimate the contribution of each feature to the output variable, yielding a highly accurate and interpretable Deep Learning model. The neuralGAM package provides a flexible framework for training Generalized Additive Neural Networks, which does not impose any restrictions on the Neural Network architecture. We illustrate the use of the neuralGAM package in both synthetic and real data examples.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 4 figures. Accepted version; published in The R Journal 18(1):253-276
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 neuralGAM，一个用于拟合广义可加神经网络（Generalized Additive Neural Networks）的 R 包。该包基于广义可加模型设计神经网络拓扑，为每个特征单独拟合一个神经网络以估计其对输出变量的贡献，从而在保持高精度的同时提升模型可解释性。包本身不限制神经网络架构，并通过合成数据与真实数据示例展示其用法。
Motivation: 神经网络虽然在许多任务上表现优秀，但存在“黑箱”问题，难以理解模型的决策过程；neuralGAM 旨在结合广义可加模型的结构来获得可解释且准确的深度学习模型。
Method: 实现广义可加神经网络：对每个特征拟合独立的神经网络分量来估计其加性贡献，并提供一个不限制底层神经网络架构的灵活训练框架。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化性能，仅在合成数据与真实数据示例中演示了包的用法与应用效果。
Conclusion: 该工作以 R 包形式发布（已发表于 The R Journal），提供了一种将神经网络与广义可加模型相结合的可解释深度学习实现。

papers.title: An Expectation-Maximization Perspective on Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has emerged as a powerful approach for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models, as demonstrated by systems such as OpenAI's O1~\cite{o1} and DeepSeek-R1~\cite{r1}. However, widely used algorithms such as PPO~\cite{ppo} and GRPO~\cite{grpo} rely on likelihood-ratio correction and heuristic clipping, which increase algorithmic complexity and may introduce additional variance and optimization bias. We present \textbf{EM Policy Gradient (EMPG)}, a simple and principled framework that formulates reinforcement learning over reasoning trajectories as an Expectation-Maximization (EM) problem~\cite{em, dempster1977em}. The E-step constructs a reward-weighted distribution over rationale trajectories, while the M-step improves the language model by maximizing their weighted log-likelihood. This formulation leads to a practical off-policy policy-gradient algorithm that directly optimizes the EM surrogate objective without trajectory-level importance weighting or likelihood-ratio clipping. Moreover, under exact E- and improving M-steps, EMPG guarantees monotonic improvement of the expected-reward objective. Experiments on GSM8K and MATH Hard with multiple Qwen2.5 base models show that EMPG achieves performance comparable to or better than GRPO while using a substantially simpler optimization procedure. EMPG also produces more concise reasoning trajectories and exhibits structured reasoning behaviors, including subproblem decomposition, self-verification, reflection, and backtracking. These results suggest that the EM perspective provides an effective theoretical and algorithmic foundation for reinforcement learning of reasoning language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EM Policy Gradient (EMPG)，将大语言模型推理轨迹上的强化学习重新形式化为期望最大化 (Expectation-Maximization) 问题。E 步构造奖励加权的推理轨迹分布，M 步通过最大化加权对数似然改进语言模型，从而得到不需要轨迹级重要性权重或似然比裁剪的 off-policy 策略梯度算法。在 GSM8K 和 MATH Hard 及多个 Qwen2.5 base 模型上的实验显示，EMPG 与 GRPO 性能相当或更好，且产生更简洁的推理轨迹并表现出子问题分解、自验证、反思和回溯等结构化推理行为。
Motivation: PPO 和 GRPO 等常用算法依赖似然比修正和启发式裁剪，增加了算法复杂度并可能引入额外方差与优化偏差。作者希望提供一个更简单、有原则基础的强化学习框架来训练推理语言模型。
Method: 将推理轨迹上的强化学习建模为 EM 问题：E 步在奖励加权下构造推理轨迹的分布，M 步通过最大化该分布的加权对数似然来更新语言模型。由此导出一个实用的 off-policy 策略梯度算法，无需轨迹级重要性加权或似然比裁剪，并在精确 E 步与改善 M 步条件下保证期望奖励目标的单调改进。
Result: 在 GSM8K 和 MATH Hard 上使用多个 Qwen2.5 base 模型，EMPG 取得与 GRPO 相当或更好的性能，同时优化过程更简单；生成的推理轨迹更简洁，并呈现子问题分解、自验证、反思和回溯等结构化推理行为。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 EM 视角为推理语言模型的强化学习提供了有效的理论与算法基础；其单调改进保证依赖于精确 E 步和改善 M 步的设定。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Regret Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) is widely used for decision-making under uncertainty, but its adversarial focus on worst-case loss can lead to overly conservative policies. To mitigate this, we study ex-ante Distributionally Robust Regret Optimization (DRRO) with Wasserstein ambiguity sets, designed to balance robustness with upside potential. We develop a theory of Wasserstein DRRO (WDRRO) paralleling Wasserstein DRO. Under smoothness and regularity, WDRRO selects among ERM optima by a first-order gradient-discrepancy rule. If the ERM optimizer is unique, first-order sensitivity vanishes and a second-order expansion governs deviations. For convex quadratics ERM and DRRO coincide for any radius. We then study regimes where these assumptions fail: nondifferentiable max-affine losses, discrete references, and larger radii, where WDRRO can differ from ERM and WDRO. We show that computing WDRRO regret is NP-hard even without bilinear terms. Nevertheless, we develop exact algorithms, a tractable convex relaxation with guarantees, and experiments showing tightness and loss-dependent behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 ex-ante 分布鲁棒遗憾优化（Distributionally Robust Regret Optimization, DRRO），在 Wasserstein 模糊集下构建与 Wasserstein DRO 平行的理论框架。摘要表明，在光滑性与正则性条件下，WDRRO 通过一阶梯度过失规则从 ERM 最优解中做选择；若 ERM 最优解唯一，则一阶敏感性消失并由二阶展开主导偏离。文章还证明即使不含双线性项，计算 WDRRO 遗憾也是 NP-hard，并提出精确算法、可处理的凸松弛及其保证，实验显示松弛紧致且行为依赖损失函数。
Motivation: 传统 DRO 对抗性聚焦于最坏情形损失，可能导致策略过度保守；作者希望通过遗憾准则来平衡鲁棒性与上行潜力（upside potential）。
Method: 提出 Wasserstein DRRO（WDRRO）理论，类比 Wasserstein DRO；在光滑性下得到选择 ERM 最优解的一阶梯度差异规则，对唯一最优点使用二阶展开；并针对非光滑 max-affine 损失、离散参考分布与大半径场景给出精确算法、凸松弛和理论保证。
Result: 摘要报告：对凸二次损失，任意半径下 ERM 与 DRRO 重合；当假设不成立（非光滑损失、离散参考、较大半径）时 WDRRO 可与 ERM 和 WDRO 不同；计算 WDRRO 遗憾是 NP-hard；实验表明所提松弛紧致且呈现依赖于损失的行为。
Conclusion: 作者强调 WDRRO 提供了在非光滑、离散参考和大半径情形下不同于 ERM 与 WDRO 的框架，并可通过精确算法和具有保证的凸松弛加以计算。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LEGO-Puzzles: How Good Are MLLMs at Multi-Step Spatial Reasoning?
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world applications of spatial intelligence, such as robotic control, autonomous driving, and automated assembly, require spatial reasoning across multiple sequential steps. However, the extent to which current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) possess this capability remains largely unexplored. Inspired by LEGO construction, a recreational activity that critically relies on multi-step spatial reasoning, we introduce LEGO-Puzzles: a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the spatial reasoning capabilities of MLLMs from basic spatial understanding to multi-step planning. LEGO-Puzzles contains two task sets. The Elementary set covers 11 visual question-answering (VQA) tasks with 1,100 carefully curated samples to test elementary spatial reasoning skills that are cruical for LEGO assembly. The Planning set directly requires the model to generate a step-by-step plan for assembling a target LEGO structure, where the tasks are organized into subsets with different planning horizons ranging up to 8. Our evaluation of 29 state-of-the-art MLLMs shows that even the strongest models struggle with elementary reasoning tasks in LEGO construction, falling at least 20% behind human performance. The planning accuracy also quickly drops to 0% as the number of planning steps increases, whereas our human participants solve all the tasks perfectly. Switching the output format from multiple choice to image generation degrades model performance even further, leading to zero accuracy even for planning 3 steps. Overall, LEGO-Puzzles reveals critical limitations in current MLLMs' spatial reasoning capabilities and highlights the need for substantial advances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LEGO-Puzzles 基准，用于系统评估多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 在多步空间推理上的能力，包括基础空间理解与逐步规划。作者评估了 29 个 SOTA MLLMs，发现即使最强模型在 LEGO 构造的基础推理任务上也落后人类至少 20%，规划准确率随步数增加迅速降至 0%，而人类参与者能完美解决所有任务。
Motivation: 机器人控制、自动驾驶、自动装配等实际应用依赖多步空间推理，但当前 MLLMs 在这方面的能力尚未被系统探索。
Method: 引入 LEGO-Puzzles 基准，包含两个任务集：Elementary 集覆盖 11 个视觉问答 (VQA) 任务，含 1,100 个精心筛选的样本，测试 LEGO 组装所需的基础空间推理技能；Planning 集要求模型生成组装目标 LEGO 结构的逐步计划，子任务规划步数最多到 8。
Result: 对 29 个 MLLMs 的评估显示，最强模型在基础推理任务上比人类低至少 20%；规划准确率随步骤增加快速下降至 0%，而人类参与者全部完美解决；将输出格式从选择题改为图像生成后性能进一步恶化，即使 3 步规划准确率也为 0%。
Conclusion: LEGO-Puzzles 揭示了当前 MLLMs 在空间推理能力上的关键局限，并强调需要实质性进展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ProPINN: Demystifying Propagation Failures in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have earned high expectations in solving partial differential equations (PDEs), but their optimization usually faces thorny challenges due to the unique derivative-dependent loss function. By analyzing the loss distribution, previous research observed the propagation failure phenomenon of PINNs, intuitively described as the correct supervision for model outputs cannot ''propagate'' from initial states or boundaries to the interior domain. Going beyond intuitive understanding, this paper provides a formal and in-depth study of propagation failure and its root cause. Based on a detailed comparison with classical finite element methods, we ascribe the failure to the conventional single-point-processing architecture of PINNs and further prove that propagation failure is essentially caused by the lower gradient correlation of PINN models on nearby collocation points. Compared to superficial loss maps, this new perspective provides a more precise quantitative criterion to identify where and why PINN fails. The theoretical finding also inspires us to present a new PINN architecture, named ProPINN, which can effectively unite the gradients of region points for better propagation. ProPINN can reliably resolve PINN failure modes and significantly surpass advanced Transformer-based models with 46% relative promotion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对物理信息神经网络（PINN）在求解偏微分方程时的传播失败（propagation failure）现象进行了形式化分析，指出现有单点处理架构导致模型在邻近配置点上的梯度相关性过低，从而无法将边界或初始条件的监督传播到内部区域。基于这一理论认识，作者提出新架构 ProPINN，通过联合区域点的梯度来改善传播，并在实验中显著超越基于 Transformer 的先进模型。
Motivation: PINN 的优化因依赖导数的损失函数而面临困难，已有研究仅从损失分布角度直观描述传播失败现象，缺乏对其根因的严格解释，难以精确判定失败位置和原因。
Method: 通过与经典有限元方法对比，将传播失败归因于 PINN 的单点处理架构，并证明其本质是模型在邻近配置点上的梯度相关性不足。据此提出 ProPINN，一种能够有效联合区域点梯度以促进监督传播的新 PINN 架构。
Result: 摘要报告 ProPINN 能可靠解决 PINN 的失败模式，并相比先进的基于 Transformer 的模型取得 46% 的相对提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为相比表面的损失图，梯度相关性视角提供了更精确的定量判据来识别 PINN 何时何地失效，并为设计更有效的 PINN 架构提供了理论指导。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Machine Learning for Inverse Problems and Data Assimilation
papers.abstract_en: The aim of this book is to demonstrate the potential for ideas in machine learning to impact on the fields of inverse problems and data assimilation. The perspective is one that is primarily aimed at researchers from inverse problems and/or data assimilation who wish to see a mathematical presentation of machine learning as it pertains to their fields. As a by-product, we include a succinct mathematical treatment of various fundamental underpinning topics in machine learning, and adjacent areas of (computational) mathematics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一本面向反问题 (inverse problems) 与数据同化 (data assimilation) 研究者的书，目标是展示机器学习思想如何影响这两个领域。书中除讨论 ML 在这些领域中的应用外，还给出机器学习若干基础主题及相关计算数学的简洁数学化处理，全文约 377 页。
Motivation: 反问题和数据同化领域的研究者需要一个从数学视角系统介绍机器学习如何服务于本领域的资料，填补现有文献在这类交叉视角上的缺口。
Method: 以数学化的方式呈现机器学习在反问题和数据同化中的应用，同时涵盖机器学习基础主题与相邻计算数学内容，面向目标读者进行系统组织。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验或数值结果，属于综述/教材性质的著作。
Conclusion: 本书的定位是面向反问题和数据同化研究者，提供机器学习及其数学基础的系统阐述；其范围限于方法论介绍与数学框架，而非特定任务的经验评估。
Relevance: 78
