papers.title: Attention-Guided Perturbation Network for Industrial Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: In unsupervised image anomaly detection, reconstruction-based methods learn normal patterns for data reconstruction, but often undesirably reconstruct anomalous regions at inference, resulting in missed detections. To alleviate this, existing approaches perturb normal samples in a sample-agnostic manner by uniformly injecting noise, ignoring that foreground regions are more critical for robust reconstruction. To address this limitation, we propose Attention-Guided Perturbation Network (AGPNet), a novel reconstruction framework for industrial anomaly detection. AGPNet introduces sample-aware attention masks to guide perturbations, enhancing the learning of invariant normal patterns at important locations. AGPNet consists of two branches, a reconstruction branch and an auxiliary attention-based perturbation one. The reconstruction branch focuses on learning to reconstruct normal samples, while the auxiliary branch generates attention masks to guide noise perturbation. By applying stronger perturbations to salient regions, the reconstruction branch learns intrinsic normal patterns in a more comprehensive and robust manner. Extensive experiments on MVTec-AD, VisA, and MVTec-3D show that AGPNet achieves competitive or leading performance across few-shot, one-class, and multi-class settings, with particularly strong performance in few-shot anomaly localization.
papers.comment: Accepted by PRCV 2026. 15 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Attention-Guided Perturbation Network (AGPNet)，一个用于工业异常检测的无监督重建框架。针对重建类方法在推理时容易把异常区域也重建出来导致漏检的问题，AGPNet 引入样本感知的注意力掩码来引导噪声扰动，使重建分支在关键位置学习更稳健的常态模式。在 MVTec-AD、VisA 和 MVTec-3D 上的实验显示，AGPNet 在 few-shot、one-class 和 multi-class 设置下均达到有竞争力或领先的性能，尤其在 few-shot 异常定位上表现突出。
Motivation: 无监督图像异常检测中，基于重建的方法学习常态模式用于数据重建，但推理时常会不必要地重建异常区域，造成漏检。现有方法以样本无关的方式均匀注入噪声来扰动正常样本，忽略了前景区域对稳健重建更为关键。
Method: 提出 AGPNet，由两条分支组成：重建分支负责学习重建正常样本，辅助的基于注意力的扰动分支生成样本感知的注意力掩码来指导噪声扰动。对显著区域施加更强的扰动，从而让重建分支更全面、稳健地学习内在正常模式。
Result: 在 MVTec-AD、VisA 和 MVTec-3D 上的大量实验表明，AGPNet 在 few-shot、one-class 和 multi-class 设置下取得有竞争力或领先的结果，其中 few-shot 异常定位的性能尤为突出。
Conclusion: 摘要强调样本感知的注意力引导扰动能够增强重建分支对重要位置正常模式的学习，缓解推理时重构异常区域的问题。该论文被 PRCV 2026 接收，摘要未提及计算开销或失败模式等额外限制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Role of Pseudo-labels in Self-training Linear Classifiers on High-dimensional Gaussian Mixture Data
papers.abstract_en: Self-training (ST) is a simple yet effective semi-supervised learning method. However, why and how ST improves generalization performance by using potentially erroneous pseudo-labels is still not well understood. To deepen the understanding of ST, we derive and analyze a sharp characterization of the behavior of iterative ST when training a linear classifier by minimizing the ridge-regularized convex loss on binary Gaussian mixtures, in the asymptotic limit where input dimension and data size diverge proportionally. The results show that ST improves generalization in different ways depending on the number of iterations. When the number of iterations is small, ST improves generalization performance by fitting the model to relatively reliable pseudo-labels and updating the model parameters by a large amount at each iteration. This suggests that ST works intuitively. On the other hand, with many iterations, ST can gradually improve the direction of the classification plane by updating the model parameters incrementally, using soft labels and small regularization. It is argued that this is because the small update of ST can extract information from the data in an almost noiseless way. However, in the presence of label imbalance, the generalization performance of ST underperforms supervised learning with true labels. To overcome this, two heuristics are proposed to enable ST to achieve nearly compatible performance with supervised learning even with significant label imbalance.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the Journal of Machine Learning Research (JMLR). Camera-ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上刻画了迭代自训练 (self-training) 在线性分类器上的行为：在二元高斯混合数据、岭正则化凸损失以及输入维度和数据规模成比例发散的高维渐近极限下，作者推导出 ST 泛化性能的精确表征。结果表明，ST 的改进机制取决于迭代次数：少迭代时通过拟合较可靠的伪标签并大步更新参数来提升性能，多迭代时则借助软标签和小正则化逐步更新分类平面方向，从而近乎无噪声地提取数据信息。作者还发现标签不平衡会损害 ST，并提出了两种启发式修正来接近监督学习的性能。
Motivation: 自训练是简单有效的半监督方法，但为何以及如何利用可能含错误的伪标签来改善泛化性能仍缺乏理论理解。
Method: 在高维渐近极限下，对最小化岭正则化凸损失的线性分类器推导迭代自训练的精确行为表征，并针对标签不平衡情形提出两种启发式方法。
Result: 摘要报告：少迭代时 ST 通过拟合相对可靠的伪标签和大步参数更新提升泛化；多迭代时通过软标签和小正则化的增量更新逐步改善分类平面方向。但在标签不平衡下，ST 的性能不如使用真实标签的监督学习，而所提启发式可使 ST 在显著标签不平衡下达到与监督学习几乎相当的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ST 的改进机制随迭代次数变化，且标签不平衡是关键障碍；提出的两种启发式能缓解该问题以使 ST 接近监督学习表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding Alternating Minimization for Matrix Completion
papers.abstract_en: Alternating Minimization is a widely used and empirically successful heuristic for matrix completion and related low-rank optimization problems. Theoretical guarantees for Alternating Minimization have been hard to come by and are still poorly understood. This is in part because the heuristic is iterative and non-convex in nature. We give a new algorithm based on Alternating Minimization that provably recovers an unknown low-rank matrix from a random subsample of its entries under a standard incoherence assumption. Our results reduce the sample size requirements of the Alternating Minimization approach by at least a quartic factor in the rank and the condition number of the unknown matrix. These improvements apply even if the matrix is only close to low-rank in the Frobenius norm. Our algorithm runs in nearly linear time in the dimension of the matrix and, in a broad range of parameters, gives the strongest sample bounds among all subquadratic time algorithms that we are aware of. Underlying our work is a new robust convergence analysis of the well-known Power Method for computing the dominant singular vectors of a matrix. This viewpoint leads to a conceptually simple understanding of Alternating Minimization. In addition, we contribute a new technique for controlling the coherence of intermediate solutions arising in iterative algorithms based on a smoothed analysis of the QR factorization. These techniques may be of interest beyond their application here.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究矩阵补全 (matrix completion) 中的交替最小化 (Alternating Minimization) 启发式算法，给出一个可证明恢复未知低秩矩阵的新算法。在标准非相干性 (incoherence) 假设下，该算法将样本复杂度需求比既有交替最小化方法至少降低一个关于秩和条件数的四次方因子，并且允许矩阵仅近似低秩。算法运行时间接近线性，在宽参数范围内提供了作者所知的所有次二次时间算法中最强的样本界。
Motivation: 交替最小化是矩阵补全及相关低秩优化问题中广泛使用且经验上成功的方法，但其理论保证长期缺乏、仍未被很好理解，部分原因是该启发式算法本质上是迭代且非凸的。
Method: 作者提出一种基于交替最小化的新算法，其核心是给出计算矩阵主奇异向量的 Power Method 的一个新的鲁棒收敛分析，并引入一种基于 QR 分解平滑分析 (smoothed analysis) 的技术来控制迭代中间解的相干性。
Result: 该算法在非相干性假设下可从随机子样本中恢复低秩矩阵；样本要求相比既有交替最小化方法至少降低四次方因子（关于秩和条件数），且对仅近似低秩（Frobenius 范数意义下）的矩阵同样适用。算法接近线性时间运行，并在宽参数范围内给出作者所知的次二次时间算法中最强样本界。
Conclusion: 作者指出新的收敛分析为交替最小化提供了概念上简单的理解，所提出的中间解相干性控制技术可能在其应用场景之外也有价值；摘要还包含对 Lemma A.5 证明的修正说明。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Gated Spatial Redundancy Projection for Pathology Transformer Attentions
papers.abstract_en: Transformer models are increasingly used for whole-slide image analysis in computational pathology. Yet, WSIs differ fundamentally from natural images: neighbouring patches often contain highly similar tissue type, stain, texture, and cellular composition. We identify this local spatial redundancy as a pathology-specific failure mode of self-attention, where dominant neighbourhood features can be repeatedly mixed into patch-tokens and weaken subtle diagnostic or prognostic deviations. We propose Gated Spatial Redundancy Projection (Gated SRP), a lightweight drop-in correction module for self-attention layers. For each patch token and attention head, Gated SRP estimates a local redundancy axis from neighbouring value vectors, projects the attention output onto this axis, and applies a learned signed gate to correct the redundancy-aligned component geometrically. Across five TCGA survival cohorts, Gated SRP obtains the highest mean C-index among the compared attention variants in all cohorts, with an average improvement over the base attention, while adding only +0.02% parameters. Across five slide-level classification datasets, it improves the base attention on 12 of 16 reported metrics and achieves the best AUC on three datasets. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/AtlasAnalyticsLab/GatedSRP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对计算病理学中全切片图像（WSI）分析时Transformer自注意力的局部空间冗余问题，提出门控空间冗余投影（Gated Spatial Redundancy Projection, Gated SRP）模块。该轻量模块可即插即用地加入自注意力层，对每个patch token和注意力头估计邻域冗余轴，并用学习的有符号门校正冗余对齐分量。在五个TCGA生存队列和五个切片级分类数据集上，Gated SRP在多数指标上超过基础注意力，且仅增加约+0.02%参数。
Motivation: WSI与自然图像不同，相邻patch常包含高度相似的组织类型、染色、纹理和细胞组成，自注意力会反复混合邻域主导特征，从而削弱细微的诊断或预后差异。作者将此识别为病理学特有的自注意力失败模式。
Method: 提出Gated SRP，一个轻量级drop-in修正模块：对每个patch token和注意力头，从相邻value向量估计局部冗余轴，将注意力输出投影到该轴，再应用学习到的有符号门（signed gate）对冗余对齐分量进行几何校正。
Result: 在五个TCGA生存队列中，Gated SRP在所有队列中取得最高的平均C-index，且平均改进优于基础注意力；在五个切片级分类数据集上，16个报告指标中改善12个，并在三个数据集上取得最佳AUC，参数仅增加+0.02%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明Gated SRP能有效缓解病理学特有的局部空间冗余导致的注意力失效，提升WSI分析的生存和分类性能，同时保持极小的参数开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PARAGraph: Pathology-Anatomy-Aware Hierarchical Graph for Diabetic Retinopathy Grading
papers.abstract_en: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) remains a leading cause of vision loss among working-age adults worldwide, making reliable severity grading clinically important. Despite strong performance, most deep models formulate DR grading as image-level classification and do not explicitly model clinically grounded evidence, such as lesion types and spatial relations. In this paper, we propose PARAGraph, a Pathology-Anatomy-Aware Hierarchical Graph framework for DR grading. PARAGraph represents each image as a three-level hierarchical graph with lesion-level nodes, intermediate category and region nodes, and global anatomical and semantic nodes. To incorporate medical priors into nodes, we construct an optic disc-fovea-anchored coordinate frame that provides a scale- and rotation-normalized retinal reference system. Within this frame, lesion nodes are encoded with category, normalized area, and anatomical coordinates. To mitigate noisy lesion segmentation, PARAGraph uses a dual-fusion strategy that introduces global visual context into a graph semantic node and a decision-level prediction branch, improving robustness when lesion evidence is unreliable. Extensive experiments on Messidor-2, APTOS, and DDR show that PARAGraph achieves consistent DR grading performance over state-of-the-art methods. Interpretability and robustness analyses further demonstrate that its predictions are clinically grounded, closely associated with lesion evidence and robust to lesion segmentation noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PARAGraph，一个病理-解剖感知的层次图框架用于糖尿病视网膜病变 (DR) 分级。该方法将每张眼底图像表示为三级层次图，包含病灶级节点、中间类别与区域节点，以及全局解剖与语义节点，并利用视盘-中心凹锚定坐标框架编码病灶的类别、归一化面积和解剖坐标。为抵抗病灶分割噪声，采用双融合策略引入全局视觉上下文。在 Messidor-2、APTOS 和 DDR 上的实验表明，PARAGraph 在 DR 分级性能上持续优于现有方法，且预测具有临床可解释性和对分割噪声的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有深度模型将 DR 分级视为图像级分类，未显式建模临床上可解释的证据，如病灶类型及其空间关系，因此分级结果缺乏临床依据且对病灶噪声敏感。
Method: 构建三级层次图（病灶级、类别/区域级、全局解剖/语义级），通过视盘-中心凹锚定坐标框架提供尺度与旋转归一化的视网膜参考系，将病灶编码为类别、归一化面积与解剖坐标；使用双融合策略将全局视觉上下文注入图语义节点和决策级预测分支，以缓解病灶分割噪声。
Result: 在 Messidor-2、APTOS 和 DDR 数据集上，PARAGraph 的分级性能一致优于最先进方法；可解释性与鲁棒性分析显示预测与病灶证据紧密相关，且对病灶分割噪声稳健。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式建模病灶与解剖结构的层次图有助于 DR 分级，双融合策略可提升病灶证据不可靠时的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 现有深度模型将 DR 分级视为图像级分类，未显式建模临床上可解释的证据，如病灶类型及其空间关系，因此分级结果缺乏临床依据且对病灶噪声敏感。
summary_sections.method: 构建三级层次图（病灶级、类别/区域级、全局解剖/语义级），通过视盘-中心凹锚定坐标框架提供尺度与旋转归一化的视网膜参考系，将病灶编码为类别、归一化面积与解剖坐标；使用双融合策略将全局视觉上下文注入图语义节点和决策级预测分支，以缓解病灶分割噪声。
summary_sections.result: 在 Messidor-2、APTOS 和 DDR 数据集上，PARAGraph 的分级性能一致优于最先进方法；可解释性与鲁棒性分析显示预测与病灶证据紧密相关，且对病灶分割噪声稳健。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为显式建模病灶与解剖结构的层次图有助于 DR 分级，双融合策略可提升病灶证据不可靠时的鲁棒性。

papers.title: VOICE: A Vision-Omics Foundation Model Integrating Direct and Retrieval-Based Prediction of In-situ Single-Cell Gene Expression
papers.abstract_en: Spatial transcriptomics can resolve gene expression at single-cell resolution, but it is costly, limited to targeted panels of a few hundred to a few thousand genes, and applicable to only a small number of samples. H&E imaging, by contrast, is cheap and collected routinely at scale. This makes predicting single-cell expression directly from morphology a practical way to bring molecular analysis to large tissue archives. We therefore present VOICE, a multimodal foundation model that predicts single-cell gene expression from H&E images using paired Xenium data. VOICE first aligns cell centered H&E morphology from a pathology foundation model with single-cell expression embeddings from a transcriptome foundation model, trained using contrastive learning over 23 million cells. Next it predicts expression through two branches. One branch directly regresses expression from morphology. The other branch retrieves measured expression from similar reference cells, recovering genes that do not have morphological signal. Because genes vary in morphological predictability, VOICE fuses the two branches with a per-gene weight. After training, VOICE generalizes to heldout patients, slides, and partially overlapping gene panels from Xenium, and it consistently outperforms prior single-cell expression prediction methods on seven metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VOICE，一个多模态基础模型，从 H&E 图像预测单细胞基因表达，并使用配对的 Xenium 数据训练。VOICE 先用对比学习（contrastive learning）在 2300 万个细胞上对齐病理基础模型提取的细胞形态特征与转录组基础模型的表达嵌入，再通过两个分支预测表达：一个分支直接从形态回归，另一个分支从相似参考细胞检索实测表达以恢复缺乏形态信号的基因，最后用逐基因权重融合两分支。摘要报告该方法在七个指标上一致优于先前的单细胞表达预测方法。
Motivation: 空间转录组学能以单细胞分辨率解析基因表达，但成本高、只能覆盖几百到几千个基因的靶向 panel，且仅适用于少量样本；而 H&E 成像便宜且常规大规模采集。直接从形态预测单细胞表达是将分子分析扩展到大型组织档案库的实用途径。
Method: VOICE 首先通过对比学习在 2300 万个细胞上对齐病理基础模型的细胞中心 H&E 形态嵌入与转录组基础模型的单细胞表达嵌入；接着通过两个分支预测表达，即直接回归分支和从相似参考细胞检索实测表达的分支，并针对基因间形态可预测性差异，用逐基因权重融合两个分支。
Result: 训练后 VOICE 能泛化到留出的患者、切片以及部分重叠的 Xenium 基因 panel，并在七个指标上一致优于先前的单细胞表达预测方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基因在形态可预测性上存在差异，因此逐基因加权的分支融合是关键设计；该工作展示了从大规模常规 H&E 影像获取分子信息的潜力。

papers.title: Failure-Mechanism Transferability of Cumulative-Damage Features for Health State Estimation of SiC Power Modules
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven health-state estimators for SiC (Silica-Carbide) power modules typically report their performance on a single accelerated-aging campaign, and how that performance transfers to a different failure mechanism is rarely tested. We benchmark five reference methods from the prognostics and condition-monitoring literature against a physics-informed NODE (Neural Ordinary Differential Equation) on two SiC power-cycling campaigns driven by structurally different failure mechanisms, solder-layer fatigue and wire-bond lift-off, under a per-module $k$-fold protocol. The NODE is evaluated under two input regimes that share the rest of the pipeline: the baseline electrical precursors and a set of cumulative thermoelectric features. Every reference method degrades on the wire-bond campaign, with average errors growing and precision decreasing with respect to their performance on the soldered campaign. The NODE fed with the cumulative features keeps its soldered-campaign metrics on both mechanisms, with differences inside the fold-to-fold variance, while the same architecture fed with the baseline precursors falls back to the reference-method cluster. The input representation contributes at least as much as the architecture to failure-mechanism transferability of a health-state estimator.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 52nd Annual Conference of the IEEE Industrial Electronics Society (IECON 2026). 9 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 SiC 功率模块健康状态估计器在不同失效机理间的可迁移性。作者在两个由不同失效机制（焊料层疲劳、键合线脱粘）驱动的功率循环实验上，用逐模块 k 折协议比较五种参考方法与物理信息 NODE。结果发现 NODE 配合累积热电特征在两种失效机制上保持焊料层实验的指标，而其余方法在键合线实验上退化。
Motivation: 数据驱动的 SiC 功率模块健康状态估计器通常只在单一加速老化实验上报告性能，很少测试其向不同失效机制的迁移能力；这种跨失效机制的泛化差距是实际部署中的关键问题。
Method: 采用物理信息 NODE，与五种来自预测与状态监测文献的参考方法对比；在两种 SiC 功率循环实验上按逐模块 k 折协议评估，并比较两种输入设置：基线电学前驱特征和累积热电特征。
Result: 所有参考方法在键合线实验上退化，平均误差增大且精度下降；NODE 配合累积特征在两种失效机制上保持焊料层实验的指标，差异在折间方差内；同一 NODE 使用基线前驱特征时落入参考方法的表现区间。
Conclusion: 摘要强调输入表征对失效机理可迁移性的贡献至少与架构本身同等重要；NODE 与累积热电特征的组合是提高健康状态估计跨失效机制稳健性的有效途径。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Condition Monitoring of SiC Power Modules
papers.abstract_en: Silicon carbide (SiC) power modules are increasingly deployed in automotive traction inverters, where condition monitoring is essential to prevent in-service failures. Despite extensive qualification under AQG 324, no consolidated approach exists for in-field health state estimation: physics-of-failure lifetime models lack real-time applicability, purely data-driven architectures require large labeled datasets and generalize poorly, and physics-informed frameworks remain too demanding for embedded deployment. We address SiC MOSFET modules assembled with sintered packaging, which suppresses solder degradation and produces aging behavior distinct from previously studied devices. Instead of the smooth quasi-exponential drift of solder-based modules, the forward voltage drop $V_{DS}$ exhibits multi-regime profiles, with wirebond liftoff events introducing abrupt, non-monotonic perturbations. We propose a condition monitoring framework combining three elements. First, physics-informed features replace raw sensor signals with cumulative damage indicators derived from junction temperature swing, mean junction temperature and a Miner rule accumulator, encoding degradation history in an interpretable form. Second, a monotonicity constraint enforced by gradient penalty regularization embeds the expected degradation direction as a physics-guided prior. Third, a heavy-tailed output distribution replaces the point estimate, giving calibrated uncertainty robust to the out-of-distribution variance introduced by liftoff. On an industrial power cycling dataset from Infineon Technologies, several neural architectures are compared under a strict cross-validation protocol. The full configuration reduces mean absolute error by approximately 70% over purely data-driven baselines and stays stable across all folds, while remaining lightweight enough for embedded deployment.
papers.comment: Extended version of the paper accepted at the Annual Conference of the PHM Society 2026 (PHM 2026). 11 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向碳化硅(SiC)功率模块的物理信息状态监测框架，针对烧结封装器件的老化行为（前向压降VDS呈多区域轮廓，线键剥离引入突变、非单调扰动）进行健康状态估计。框架结合物理信息特征、单调性约束和重尾输出分布，在Infineon Technologies的工业功率循环数据集上，将平均绝对误差较纯数据驱动基线降低约70%，并且保持轻量以支持嵌入式部署。
Motivation: SiC功率模块在汽车牵引逆变器中日益普及，但现场健康状态估计缺乏统一方法：基于失效物理的寿命模型缺乏实时适用性，纯数据驱动架构需要大量标注且泛化差，物理信息框架又难以嵌入部署。此外，烧结封装器件抑制焊料退化，其老化行为与已有研究的器件不同，VDS呈现多区域轮廓并伴随线键剥离导致的突变扰动。
Method: 提出三要素组合框架：一是用结温波动、平均结温以及Miner累积损伤指标构造物理信息特征，以可解释形式编码退化历史；二是通过梯度惩罚正则化施加单调性约束，将预期退化方向作为物理引导先验；三是用重尾输出分布替代点估计，提供校准的不确定性，以应对剥离引入的分布外方差。
Result: 在来自Infineon Technologies的工业功率循环数据集上，按严格交叉验证协议比较多种神经网络架构。完整配置相比纯数据驱动基线将平均绝对误差降低约70%，且在所有交叉验证折上保持稳定，同时模型足够轻量，可嵌入部署。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该物理信息框架能在嵌入式部署约束下实现准确、稳健的SiC模块健康状态估计，但其验证范围局限于烧结封装SiC MOSFET的特定功率循环数据集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unimodality-Promoting Regularized Learning for Ordinal Regression
papers.abstract_en: Ordinal regression, also called ordinal classification, is classification of ordinal data, in which the underlying target variable is categorical and considered to have a natural ordinal relation. Previous works have indicated that, in many real-world ordinal data, the conditional probability distribution (CPD) of the target variable given a value of the explanatory variable would be unimodal in a large domain of the explanatory variable and close to be unimodal even in a remaining domain. Therefore, unimodality-promoting regularized learning (UPRL), which promotes a predicted CPD closer to be unimodal with the aim of decreasing a prediction variance without inducing much bias for ordinal data of the unimodality, is promising to improve the prediction performance especially with small-size training data. In this study, we show that previous UPRL methods promote a predicted CPD to not only become closer to be unimodal but also have a larger scale (in other words, be smoother or less-confident). Therefore, we develop a novel method that more strictly reflects the idea of UPRL and evades a scale-related bias, and verify through experimental comparison that the unimodality-promotion indeed contributes to improve the prediction performance. Additionally, while our proposed UPRL method could perform better for smaller-scale data or with larger-size training data compared to a previous UPRL method, our analysis explains this experimental observation in terms of the presence or absence of an unexpected scale-related bias.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对有序回归 (ordinal regression) 中的单峰性促进正则化学习 (UPRL) 展开研究，指出以往 UPRL 方法在让预测条件概率分布更接近单峰 (unimodal) 的同时，也会使分布尺度变大、变得更平滑且置信度更低。作者提出一种更严格体现 UPRL 思想并能规避尺度相关偏差的新方法，并通过实验验证单峰性促进确实能提升预测性能，同时用尺度相关偏差的存在与否解释了所提出的方法在部分数据条件下的表现差异。
Motivation: 真实世界中的许多有序数据，其给定解释变量后的条件概率分布在大范围内接近单峰，因此 UPRL 有望通过降低预测方差而不引入太多偏差来改进性能，尤其在训练数据较小时。然而以往 UPRL 方法会带来尺度相关的偏差，使预测分布过度平滑，这偏离了 UPRL 的初衷。
Method: 提出一种新的 UPRL 方法，比以往方法更严格地贯彻“促使预测条件概率分布接近单峰”的思想，同时避免因分布尺度变大而产生的不必要偏差。
Result: 实验对比表明，单峰性促进确实有助于提升有序回归的预测性能；该文提出的 UPRL 方法在较小尺度数据或较大规模训练数据下可比以往 UPRL 方法表现更好，并通过分析将其归因于是否存在意外的尺度相关偏差。
Conclusion: 作者认为，正确实施的单峰性促进能够改善有序回归的预测效果，而以往方法中隐含的尺度相关偏差会干扰这种效果；本文的分析为不同数据条件下 UPRL 方法的相对表现提供了解释。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 实验对比表明，单峰性促进确实有助于提升有序回归的预测性能；该文提出的 UPRL 方法在较小尺度数据或较大规模训练数据下可比以往 UPRL 方法表现更好，并通过分析将其归因于是否存在意外的尺度相关偏差。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，正确实施的单峰性促进能够改善有序回归的预测效果，而以往方法中隐含的尺度相关偏差会干扰这种效果；本文的分析为不同数据条件下 UPRL 方法的相对表现提供了解释。

papers.title: Tropical Cyclone Forecasting via Latent Rectified Flow using Satellite Imagery and Atmospheric Fields
papers.abstract_en: Tropical cyclones are growing more destructive in a changing climate, and efficient forecasting of their structure and track has become a necessity. Deep generative models promise an alternative to computationally expensive numerical weather prediction (NWP), yet current systems produce either satellite imagery or atmospheric fields, never both; they need many sampling steps, putting them out of reach of modest hardware; and their storm tracks come from regression heads with no physical link to the generated atmosphere. This work presents a single-pass model that jointly forecasts GRIDSAT-B1 infrared imagery and four ERA5 atmospheric fields (U-wind, V-wind, air temperature, and surface pressure) out to nine hours. A five-channel variational autoencoder compresses each 5 x 256 x 256 frame to a 4 x 64 x 64 latent, and a conditional rectified-flow UNet with a factorized temporal-attention module predicts the next three frames from three past frames, their best-track coordinates, and timestamps. The model is then reward-fine-tuned (DRaFT) against a differentiable track error derived from the predicted winds through a steering-flow calculation. On held-out 2022 storms the model reaches 16.35 dB PSNR and 0.759 SSIM, ahead of a reproduced cascaded-diffusion baseline at every lead time (+0.84 dB at +9 h) while sampling ~30x faster (56 ms vs. 1673 ms). Track error at +9 h is 62.4 km, 15% below the baseline, and a reward fine-tuning study demonstrates a further 8-11% track-error reduction across sampler budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于潜变量整流流 (latent rectified flow) 的单次前向模型，联合预测热带气旋的 GRIDSAT-B1 红外卫星图像和四个 ERA5 大气场（U/V 风、气温、地表气压），预报时长至 9 小时。模型用五通道 VAE 将 5×256×256 的帧压缩到 4×64×64 潜变量，再用带因子化时间注意力模块的条件整流流 UNet 从三帧历史预测接下来三帧，并通过 DRaFT 奖励微调将可微的轨迹误差与预测风场物理关联。在 2022 年留出气旋上，模型 PSNR 达 16.35 dB、SSIM 达 0.759，每个预报时刻均优于复现的级联扩散基线（+9 h 时 +0.84 dB），采样快约 30 倍（56 ms 对 1673 ms），+9 h 轨迹误差 62.4 km，比基线低 15%。
Motivation: 现有深度生成式气旋预报模型要么只输出卫星图像、要么只输出大气场，且需要大量采样步骤，难以在普通硬件上运行；同时其风暴轨迹来自回归头，与生成的大气状态缺乏物理联系。
Method: 构建单次前向联合生成模型：五通道 VAE 压缩输入帧，条件整流流 UNet 配合因子化时间注意力模块，从三帧历史图像、最佳轨迹坐标和时间戳预测未来三帧；随后用 DRaFT 对可微轨迹误差进行奖励微调，该误差通过对预测风场做引导流 (steering-flow) 计算得到。
Result: 在 2022 年留出气旋上，模型达到 16.35 dB PSNR 和 0.759 SSIM，在全部预报时刻优于级联扩散基线（+9 h 提升 0.84 dB），采样快约 30 倍；+9 h 轨迹误差为 62.4 km，比基线低 15%，奖励微调进一步在多种采样预算下减少 8–11% 的轨迹误差。
Conclusion: 作者表明，将图像与大气场联合生成、并通过引导流计算把轨迹误差物理地耦合进奖励微调，可以在显著加速采样的同时提升结构预测与轨迹预测精度。

papers.title: Correlation flow governs learning at criticality
papers.abstract_en: The initialisation of deep neural networks determines whether information and gradients can propagate across depth, yet a unified theory connecting these properties to learning dynamics remains elusive. Combining mean-field theory and random matrix theory, we establish a direct link between correlation propagation and the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) that governs learning in the sequential limit of infinitely wide, infinitely deep networks. Correlation propagation to infinite depth is possible only at a single critical point in the weight-bias variance plane. At this point, we show that the end-to-end Jacobian vanishes algebraically with depth, and use this to prove that the NTK becomes exactly proportional to the output correlation at infinite depth. This equivalence between information propagation and learning dynamics had not yet been noticed. We further show that orthogonal initialisation suppresses the leading finite-size corrections present under Gaussian initialisation, clarifying the respective roles of the two initialisation ensembles in this limit. These theoretical predictions are validated quantitatively on finite-width, finite-depth networks. Together, these results demonstrate that orthogonal initialisation at criticality plays a central role in controlling the asymptotic dynamics of deep learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过结合平均场理论与随机矩阵理论，建立深层神经网络中相关性传播与神经正切核 (NTK) 的直接联系，证明在无限宽无限深顺序极限下，网络仅在权重-偏置方差平面上的单一临界点能实现到无限深的相关性传播；在该临界点，端到端 Jacobian 随深度代数衰减，且 NTK 在无限深时精确正比于输出相关性。论文还表明正交初始化抑制高斯初始化下的主要有限尺寸修正，并在有限宽有限深网络上定量验证了理论预测。
Motivation: 神经网络初始化决定信息与梯度能否跨深度传播，但缺乏统一理论将传播属性与学习动力学联系起来，作者希望建立这种联系以理解无限宽无限深极限下的学习行为。
Method: 结合平均场理论 (mean-field theory) 与随机矩阵理论 (random matrix theory)，研究相关性传播与神经正切核 (Neural Tangent Kernel, NTK) 的关系；在无限宽无限深顺序极限下分析临界点、端到端 Jacobian 的深度衰减，并比较正交初始化与高斯初始化下的有限尺寸修正。
Result: 证明相关性传播仅在权重-偏置方差平面上的单一临界点可行；在此临界点，端到端 Jacobian 随深度代数式衰减，且 NTK 在无限深时精确正比于输出相关性；正交初始化抑制高斯初始化下的前导有限尺寸修正；这些预测在有限宽有限深网络上得到定量验证。
Conclusion: 研究表明临界点上的正交初始化在控制深度学习渐近动力学中起核心作用；作者强调信息传播与学习动力学之间的等价关系是此前未被注意到的新结果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Dramarrator: Object-Based Audio Editing for Audio Drama Production from Books
papers.abstract_en: Audio dramas weave dialogue, sound effects, and music into immersive stories. Creators often adapt books into audio dramas, but this process remains labor-intensive, requiring them to interpret source material, author scripts, generate audio assets, and assemble them on a timeline. Because story elements like characters and scenes manifest across many interdependent assets, a single change can ripple into manual updates across the entire project. We present Dramarrator, an audio drama authoring tool built around object-based audio editing, where these story elements are represented as editable objects. Dramarrator extracts these objects from a book, generates linked audio assets (speech, sound effects, and music), and composes a multi-track audio drama. Edits to any object (e.g., a character's voice) automatically propagate to all dependent assets. In a user study with professionals (N=8), Dramarrator significantly lowered task load when creating audio dramas. A listener study (N=300) shows that creator-refined output from Dramarrator approaches the quality of productions made with existing professional tools, and an exploratory study (N=3) suggests object-based editing lowers entry barriers and generalizes beyond audio dramas.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dramarrator，一个基于对象音频编辑 (object-based audio editing) 的有声剧创作工具，旨在将书籍改编为有声剧。它从书中提取角色、场景等故事元素作为可编辑对象，生成关联的语音、音效和音乐资产，并合成多轨有声剧；对任何对象（如角色声音）的编辑会自动传播到所有依赖资产。专业用户研究 (N=8) 显示其显著降低任务负载，听众研究 (N=300) 表明创作者精修输出接近现有专业工具质量，探索性研究 (N=3) 显示对象化编辑降低入门门槛并可泛化到有声剧之外。
Motivation: 从书籍改编有声剧需要解释源材料、编写脚本、生成音频资产并在时间线上组装，过程劳动密集；且角色、场景等故事元素跨多个相互依赖的资产，单次修改会引发整个项目的连锁手动更新。
Method: Dramarrator 将故事元素表示为可编辑对象，从书籍中自动提取这些对象，生成链接的音频资产（语音、音效和音乐），并组合成多轨有声剧；编辑任意对象时，依赖该对象的资产会自动更新。
Result: 摘要报告专业用户研究 (N=8) 显示 Dramarrator 显著降低有声剧创作的任务负载；听众研究 (N=300) 显示创作者精修输出接近现有专业工具的制作质量；探索性研究 (N=3) 表明对象化编辑降低入门门槛并具备超越有声剧的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于对象的音频编辑能够提升有声剧制作效率并降低创作门槛，其设计思路可能也适用于其他多媒体叙事创作场景。

papers.title: PRISM: A Predictive Protocol for Permutation Optimization via Landscape Diagnostics
papers.abstract_en: Permutation optimization arises whenever the components of a system are fixed but their ordering affects performance. We introduce PRISM, a predictive protocol for permutation optimization that measures a fitness landscape before selecting a search strategy. PRISM uses inexpensive landscape diagnostics, including one-step move autocorrelation and fitness-distance correlation, to predict useful mutation operators, identify when structured search is likely to outperform random sampling, and detect regimes in which search provides little advantage. Across synthetic permutation landscapes, neural architecture benchmarks, scientific machine learning pipelines, and large-language-model instruction ordering, the protocol makes testable predictions about search behavior before optimization begins. Exhaustive instruction-ordering experiments reveal substantial performance variation induced solely by permutation, while cross-model experiments show that useful ordering structure can transfer across model families and task difficulty. Additional experiments demonstrate that instruction ordering remains consequential after prompt wording is optimized, indicating that content optimization and ordering optimization are complementary. The results position PRISM not as a universally superior optimizer, but as a framework for determining when permutation search is useful, which representation and operator should be used, and when simpler alternatives are preferable.
papers.comment: Preprint. Includes theoretical analysis, exhaustive permutation-landscape experiments, LLM instruction-ordering experiments, scientific machine learning pipeline studies, and neural architecture search benchmarks. Code and reproducibility artifacts available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRISM 是一个面向排列优化 (permutation optimization) 的预测式协议，在选定搜索策略之前先用廉价的地形诊断 (landscape diagnostics) 度量适应度地形。诊断信息包括一步移动自相关 (one-step move autocorrelation) 与适应度-距离相关 (fitness-distance correlation)，用于预测可用的变异算子、判断结构化搜索是否优于随机采样，并识别搜索收益很小的情形。实验覆盖合成排列地形、神经架构搜索基准、科学机器学习流水线和大语言模型指令排序；在指令排序任务上发现仅由排列引起的性能变化显著，且有用排序结构可跨模型族和任务难度迁移。
Motivation: 当系统组件固定但排序影响性能时，排列优化普遍存在；然而在优化开始前很难判断搜索是否值得、该用哪种表示与算子，以及何时简单方法已足够。
Method: PRISM 利用一步移动自相关和适应度-距离相关等低成本地形诊断，对适应度地形进行预先测量，从而预测有用的变异算子、识别结构化搜索可能优于随机采样的情形，并检测搜索几乎无优势的区间。
Result: 穷举式指令排序实验表明，仅改变排列顺序就能造成可观的性能差异；跨模型实验显示有用的排序结构可以在不同模型族和任务难度之间迁移；进一步实验还表明在提示词内容已优化后指令排序仍然影响性能，说明内容优化与排序优化互补。
Conclusion: PRISM 不是普遍更优的优化器，而是一个用于判断排列搜索何时有用、应使用哪种表示和算子、以及何时更简单替代方案更合适的框架。

summary_sections.result: 穷举式指令排序实验表明，仅改变排列顺序就能造成可观的性能差异；跨模型实验显示有用的排序结构可以在不同模型族和任务难度之间迁移；进一步实验还表明在提示词内容已优化后指令排序仍然影响性能，说明内容优化与排序优化互补。
summary_sections.conclusion: PRISM 不是普遍更优的优化器，而是一个用于判断排列搜索何时有用、应使用哪种表示和算子、以及何时更简单替代方案更合适的框架。

papers.title: Circuit Fine-Tuning for Compute-Efficient Transformer Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has become the de facto standard for adapting Vision Transformers (ViTs) to downstream tasks. While parameter count has been the dominant efficiency metric in PEFT, it does not imply \textit{compute efficiency}: parameter-sparse methods can still incur full-model training cost per step, and typically need long schedules to reach peak accuracy. We introduce Circuit Fine-Tuning (CFT), a compute-efficient framework that uses circuit discovery---conventionally used to explain trained models---to select modules for fine-tuning before training. Whereas attribution is conventionally formulated against a trained task head, we formulate it against a near-zero-initialized probe head, which isolates the response of the backbone to the target distribution rather than the preferences of a particular classifier. CFT then fine-tunes only the recovered subgraph. CFT needs no learning-rate warmup and reaches peak accuracy in ${\sim}20$ epochs on average---versus $44$--$96$ for strong PEFT baselines---yielding $2.3$--$6.6\times$ fewer training FLOPs and up to $16\times$ less wall-clock time, while adding zero parameters and no inference operations. Experiments across a standard visual transfer benchmark (VTAB-1k), hierarchical backbones (Swin), domain-shifted medical imaging (CBIS-DDSM), and a vision-language model (Gemma-3 on CUB-200) demonstrate the effectiveness of CFT. Code is available at https://github.com/UriKialy/CFT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Circuit Fine-Tuning (CFT)，一种面向 Vision Transformer 适配的计算高效微调框架，在训练前用电路发现 (circuit discovery) 选择要微调的模块，并仅微调恢复出的子图。摘要报告 CFT 无需学习率预热，平均约 20 个 epoch 达到峰值精度（强 PEFT 基线为 44–96），训练 FLOPs 减少 2.3–6.6 倍，墙钟时间最多减少 16 倍，且不增加参数和推理操作。实验覆盖 VTAB-1k、Swin、CBIS-DDSM 和 Gemma-3 on CUB-200。
Motivation: PEFT 中参数量是主导效率指标，但参数稀疏并不等于计算高效：参数稀疏方法仍可能产生全模型训练成本并需要较长训练调度才能达到峰值精度。
Method: CFT 在训练前利用电路发现选择微调模块，将原本针对已训练任务头的归因 (attribution) 改为针对近零初始化的探针头 (probe head)，从而隔离主干网络对目标分布的响应，然后只微调恢复出的子图。
Result: 摘要报告 CFT 平均约 20 个 epoch 达到峰值精度，而强 PEFT 基线需 44–96 个 epoch；训练 FLOPs 减少 2.3–6.6 倍，墙钟时间最多减少 16 倍，同时零新增参数和零额外推理操作。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CFT 是计算高效的 PEFT 替代方案，并在标准视觉迁移基准、层次化主干、域偏移医学影像和视觉语言模型上验证了有效性。

papers.title: StructReward: Efficient Structured Process Rewards for Self-Correcting Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective approach for improving multimodal reasoning. However, most existing methods evaluate an entire response using a binary reward based only on final-answer correctness, thereby discarding the supervision available in intermediate reasoning steps. Process reward models offer finer-grained feedback, but they typically rely on separately trained verifiers, costly chain-of-thought annotations, or online judging by large language models (LLMs). In this work, we introduce StructReward, a compute-efficient framework that provides dense reinforcement signals through structured step-level reward alignment. StructReward represents each generated solution as a sequence of reasoning steps and aligns them with process-labeled reference steps using lightweight numerical, symbolic, and lexical matching rules. The aligned labels are aggregated into a dense process reward and combined with final-answer consistency and output-validity rewards through a gated Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) objective. We further recycle policy rollouts into complementary supervision for response comparison and reflective self-correction, rather than discarding them after policy updates. Separately, we use a strong LLM to rewrite sampled correct trajectories into reflection-oriented training instances, further strengthening the policy's ability to evaluate and refine its reasoning. Since reward computation is performed online without an additional learned verifier or external LLM judge, StructReward substantially reduces the computational overhead of multimodal reinforcement learning. Experimental results show that structured process supervision and rollout recycling provide an efficient path toward self-improving multimodal reasoning.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Yifan Li and Ruxin Sun contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StructReward，一个为多模态推理强化学习提供密集过程奖励的计算高效框架。它把生成的解答表示为推理步骤序列，用轻量级数值、符号和词法匹配规则与带过程标签的参考步骤对齐，聚合为稠密过程奖励，并通过门控 GRPO 目标与最终答案一致性、输出有效性奖励结合。框架还回收策略 rollout 用于响应比较和反思式自校正，并用强 LLM 将采样到的正确轨迹改写成反思型训练实例。
Motivation: 现有 RLVR 方法通常只用基于最终答案正确性的二元奖励评估整个响应，丢弃了中间推理步骤中的监督信号；而过程奖励模型往往依赖单独训练的验证器、昂贵的思维链标注或 LLM 在线评判，成本较高。
Method: StructReward 将每个生成解表示为推理步骤序列，使用轻量级数值、符号和词法匹配规则与过程标注的参考步骤对齐；对齐标签被聚合为稠密过程奖励，并与最终答案一致性和输出有效性奖励通过门控 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 目标组合。策略 rollout 被回收为额外监督用于响应比较和反思式自校正，同时用强 LLM 重写正确轨迹以增强策略的评估与修正能力。
Result: 摘要报告结构化过程监督与 rollout 回收为自我改进的多模态推理提供了高效路径；由于奖励计算在线完成且不依赖额外学习的验证器或外部 LLM 评判，显著降低了多模态强化学习的计算开销。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为，结构化过程监督与 rollout 回收是通向高效自我改进多模态推理的有效途径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Eikonal Regularisation in Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Three-Dimensional Level-Set Advection: Transferability of Two-Dimensional Design Principles
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks applied to the level-set formulation of interface advection commonly augment the residual and initial-condition losses with an eikonal regulariser, penalising the deviation of $\|\nablaφ\|$ from unity. A previous two-dimensional study identified this weight as the dominant hyperparameter and found its optimum shifts by four orders of magnitude between rigid-body and deforming flows, but left open whether these principles transfer to three dimensions and whether single-seed results survive run-to-run variability. We answer both by repeating the weight selection across four 3D benchmarks (translating sphere, rotating sphere, slotted sphere, reversed vortex), sweeping six weights with three seeds at full training budget under a pre-registered selection rule. The ordering transfers: the selected weight tracks how far the exact solution departs from the signed-distance property, spanning four decades from $10^{-1}$ where it holds exactly to $10^{-5}$ where the interface is stretched. Values transfer only benchmark by benchmark; two of four carry over unchanged and two do not, so inheritance must be verified. The multi-seed protocol reveals that at small weights the seed-to-seed standard deviation equals the error itself, and the regulariser reduces it by more than an order of magnitude, buying reproducibility as well as accuracy. We benchmark against a fifth-order WENO solver on identical grids and error measures; the classical scheme is more accurate on all four problems, by two orders of magnitude on smooth rigid advection, with a margin that narrows with geometric difficulty and is smaller in volume conservation than in the field norm. Finally, we show that the relative $L_2$ error cannot certify the preservation of thin features, and report a feature-restricted measure that can.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 中 eikonal 正则化在三维 level-set 界面输运问题上的权重选择问题。作者在四个三维基准（平移球、旋转球、开槽球、反演涡）上，以预注册的选择规则、六个权重和三个随机种子进行权重扫描，检验二维研究中发现的设计原则是否迁移到三维。结果表明权重排序趋势可以迁移，但具体数值需要逐基准验证；多种子实验显示小权重下随机种子间标准差与误差相当，而正则化可将该变异性降低一个数量级以上。论文还将 PINN 与五阶 WENO 求解器对比，并指出相对 L2 误差不能保证薄特征保持，提出一种特征受限的度量。
Motivation: 先前二维研究表明 eikonal 正则化权重是 PINN 求解 level-set 输运时的主导超参数，其最优值在刚体运动与变形流动之间跨越四个数量级；但该结论是否适用于三维、以及单随机种子结果能否经得起运行间变异性考验，仍是未解决的问题。
Method: 采用预注册的选择规则，在四个三维基准上以六个权重和三个随机种子在完整训练预算下重复权重选择；将 PINN 结果与相同网格和误差度量下的五阶 WENO 求解器进行对比，并引入针对薄特征保持的受限度量。
Result: 权重最优值的排序规律从二维迁移到三维，所选权重随精确解偏离 signed-distance 性质的程度在 10^-1 到 10^-5 的四个数量级间变化；但具体数值只在四个基准中的两个原样迁移。小权重下种子间标准差与误差本身相当，正则化将其降低一个数量级以上；WENO 在所有四个问题上更精确，在光滑刚体平流上高两个数量级，且该优势随几何难度增加而缩小，在体积守恒上的差距小于场范数上的差距。
Conclusion: 作者强调 eikonal 正则化的设计原则在维度上部分可迁移，但具体权重继承必须逐基准验证；并指出相对 L2 误差不能证明薄特征是否被保留，因此需要特征受限的度量来补充评估。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Spatial Heterogeneity-Aware Multi-Hazard Susceptibility and Risk Mapping at Regional Scale
papers.abstract_en: Floods and landslides often co-occur, but their relationships with environmental controls vary spatially. This study develops a spatial heterogeneity-aware framework for flood-landslide susceptibility and relative-risk mapping in Kerala, India, and Nepal. It combines 15 km x 15 km grid cells with region-specific contextual zones and compares proximity-gated cross-zone training (S1) and ecology-gated zone-constrained training (S2). S1 permits geographically nearby models to be assigned across contextual boundaries, whereas S2 restricts model development and assignment to the same zone. Random Forest models for each hazard use strategy-specific predictor sets and are evaluated on spatially held-out test samples. Susceptibility surfaces are integrated with CRITIC-weighted exposure and vulnerability indices to produce hazard-specific and nine-class bivariate relative-risk maps. S1 achieved higher mean accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, AUC-ROC, and PR-AUC for both hazards and regions. The largest difference occurred for Nepal flood susceptibility, where AUC-ROC increased from 0.728 under S2 to 0.886 under S1 and PR-AUC from 0.512 to 0.823. S2 produced lower Brier scores for both Nepal hazards and retained zone-specific differences in predictor selection, SHAP rankings, and response patterns, particularly in Kerala. Both strategies reproduced flood-prone lowland and landslide-prone upland patterns but differed in susceptibility and risk classes. Bivariate risk-map agreement was 0.521 in Kerala and 0.711 in Nepal, with allocation disagreement exceeding quantity disagreement in all S1-S2 comparisons. Susceptibility-to-risk correspondence remained below 0.350, showing that exposure and vulnerability changed priority locations. Overall, cross-zone learning strengthens regional discrimination, while zone-constrained learning preserves environmental differences, supporting their integration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个空间异质性感知框架，用于印度喀拉拉邦和尼泊尔的区域尺度洪水和滑坡易发性及相对风险制图。研究将15 km×15 km网格与区域特定情境区结合，比较近邻门控跨区训练(S1)和生态门控区内约束训练(S2)两种策略，使用随机森林模型对每种灾害分别建模并用空间留出样本评估；随后将易发性与CRITIC加权暴露度和脆弱性指数整合，生成九类双变量相对风险图。结果表明S1整体判别能力更强，而S2保留更多区域环境差异。
Motivation: 洪水和滑坡常常同时发生，但它们与环境控制因素的关系存在空间异质性，现有区域尺度易发性制图框架未能充分捕捉这种跨区域差异，限制了区域判别能力和风险制图的可靠性。
Method: 采用15km×15km网格并结合区域特定的上下文情境区，提出两种训练策略：S1允许地理邻近的模型跨情境边界分配，S2限制模型的开发和分配在同一区内。对洪水和滑坡分别使用策略特定的预测变量集构建随机森林模型，在空间留出测试样本上评估，并将易发性表面与CRITIC加权暴露度和脆弱性指数整合以生成双变量相对风险图。
Result: S1在两种灾害和两个区域均取得更高的平均准确率、精确率、召回率、F1、AUC-ROC和PR-AUC；最大差异出现在尼泊尔洪水易发性，AUC-ROC从S2的0.728提高到0.886，PR-AUC从0.512提高到0.823。S2则在两个尼泊尔灾害中获得更低的Brier分数，并保留预测变量选择、SHAP排序和响应模式的区域特定差异。两种策略都重现了洪水易发低地和滑坡易发高地模式，但易发性和风险类别存在差异；双变量风险图一致性在喀拉拉邦为0.521、尼泊尔为0.711，且所有比较中分配性不一致均超过数量性不一致。易发性与风险的对应关系低于0.350，显示暴露度和脆弱性改变了优先位置。
Conclusion: 作者总结认为跨区学习强化区域判别能力，而区内约束学习保留环境差异，支持将两种策略整合使用。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一个空间异质性感知框架，用于印度喀拉拉邦和尼泊尔的区域尺度洪水和滑坡易发性及相对风险制图。研究将15 km×15 km网格与区域特定情境区结合，比较近邻门控跨区训练(S1)和生态门控区内约束训练(S2)两种策略，使用随机森林模型对每种灾害分别建模并用空间留出样本评估；随后将易发性与CRITIC加权暴露度和脆弱性指数整合，生成九类双变量相对风险图。结果表明S1整体判别能力更强，而S2保留更多区域环境差异。
summary_sections.motivation: 洪水和滑坡常常同时发生，但它们与环境控制因素的关系存在空间异质性，现有区域尺度易发性制图框架未能充分捕捉这种跨区域差异，限制了区域判别能力和风险制图的可靠性。

papers.title: A continually expandable foundation model for brain MRI
papers.abstract_en: Brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is central to neuroscience and clinical assessment, but models are commonly developed for individual diseases, populations or imaging protocols. Foundation models promise more general representations, yet they are usually pretrained once and can lose earlier capabilities when updated with new data. Here we show that Alcmaeon, a three-dimensional brain MRI foundation model pretrained without manual labels on more than 425,000 volumes and derived imaging maps, can be expanded sequentially across clinical domains. Alcmaeon combines volumetric encoding and latent diffusion generation with Graph-Blueprint Pruning (GBP), which protects network modules important to earlier domains while leaving the remaining capacity trainable. Across expansion from healthy ageing and neurodegeneration to developmental, psychiatric and tumour imaging, GBP showed less forgetting than sequential adaptation and elastic weight consolidation across voxel-level reconstruction measures, with its largest advantage after adaptation to tumour imaging. The blueprints provided an inspectable record of how model capacity was protected and reused. Representations from different model levels supported image synthesis, disease classification, survival modelling and postoperative prediction, although no single representation was optimal for every task. These findings provide a route towards brain MRI foundation models that can grow with emerging data while retaining earlier capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Alcmaeon，一个基于超过 425,000 个体素及衍生影像图、无人工标注预训练的三维脑 MRI 基础模型，可在不同临床领域间进行顺序扩展。模型结合体素编码与潜在扩散生成，并用 Graph-Blueprint Pruning (GBP) 保护先前领域的重要网络模块，同时保留其余容量可训练。实验表明从健康老化与神经退行扩展到发育、精神及肿瘤影像时，GBP 在体素级重建指标上遗忘少于顺序适应与弹性权重巩固。
Motivation: 脑 MRI 模型通常针对单一疾病、人群或成像协议开发，而基础模型虽更具通用性，但一次性预训练后在用新数据更新时可能丢失早期能力。
Method: 提出三维脑 MRI 基础模型 Alcmaeon，融合体素编码 (volumetric encoding) 和潜在扩散生成 (latent diffusion generation)，并引入 Graph-Blueprint Pruning (GBP)：通过蓝图记录并保护对早期领域重要的网络模块，其余参数保持可训练，从而实现按序跨领域扩展。
Result: 在从健康老化和神经退行到发育、精神及肿瘤影像的扩展中，GBP 比顺序适应和弹性权重巩固 (elastic weight consolidation) 表现出更少的遗忘，在适应肿瘤影像后优势最大；蓝图提供了模型容量如何被保护与复用的可检查记录。不同模型层的表示分别支持图像合成、疾病分类、生存建模和术后预测，但没有任何单一表示对所有任务都最优。
Conclusion: 该工作为脑 MRI 基础模型提供了一条随新增数据持续扩展而不丧失早期能力的路径，并强调蓝图机制的可解释性与多层级表示的异质性。

papers.title: The Neural Division of Labor: Biologically-Inspired Modular Architectures for Robust Neuromorphic Computing
papers.abstract_en: Biological neural systems achieve high efficiency and robustness through compartmentalized architectures. In contrast, modern artificial neural networks rely on globally entangled structures, which obscure decision logic and suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Here, we report a Decomposable Spiking Neural Network (D-SNN) that eliminates global synaptic entanglement by structurally isolating classification pathways into independent experts. Optimized via a bio-inspired push-pull loss function, the D-SNN achieves competitive accuracies on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10/100 benchmarks. This modular approach matches the performance of fully dense networks while utilizing an order of magnitude fewer parameters. In addition, our networks operate with up to several orders of magnitude lower firing rates and fewer synaptic operations. Furthermore, physically severing connections between experts provides inherent protection against catastrophic forgetting during sequential learning. Crucially, these isolated pathways generate auditable neural signals, increasing decision transparency. This biomimetic, verifiable architecture establishes an efficient foundation for deploying deterministic neuromorphic intelligence in resource-constrained edge environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可分解脉冲神经网络 (Decomposable Spiking Neural Network, D-SNN)，通过将分类路径结构隔离为独立专家 (experts) 来消除全局突触纠缠，并用仿生 push-pull 损失函数优化。摘要称在 MNIST、Fashion-MNIST 和 CIFAR-10/100 上达到与全稠密网络相当的精度，同时参数少一个数量级，发射率和突触操作低数个数量级。物理切断专家间连接可在顺序学习中提供对灾难性遗忘的固有保护，并产生可审计的神经信号以增强决策透明度。
Motivation: 现代人工神经网络依赖全局纠缠结构，掩盖决策逻辑且易发生灾难性遗忘；生物神经系统则通过区室化架构实现高效率与鲁棒性。该工作旨在为资源受限的边缘环境提供可靠、可验证的神经形态计算基础。
Method: 提出 D-SNN，将分类路径结构隔离为独立专家，消除全局突触纠缠，并采用生物启发的 push-pull 损失函数进行优化。
Result: 摘要报告在 MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10/100 上精度与全稠密网络相当，参数减少一个数量级，发射率和突触操作降低数个数量级；切断专家间连接可抵御顺序学习中的灾难性遗忘。
Conclusion: 该模块化、可审计的生物模拟架构为资源受限边缘环境中的确定性神经形态智能提供了高效基础。

papers.title: Your VLM Already Knows When: Training-Free Temporal Grounding by Asking Yes or No
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal LLMs that recognise events reliably still fail to say when they happen. Prompted for timestamps, strong VLMs reach as little as $3.8\%$ R@0.5 on Charades-STA, and $77$ to $80\%$ of their wrong predictions carry low output entropy: the models are confidently wrong, and entropy-based error detection stays below a random classifier. We show that this failure lives in the task interface, not in perception. Holding the weights fixed, replacing timestamp regression with a coarse-to-fine scan of binary questions, whose first-token probabilities are consumed only as a ranking, raises R@0.5 by $28$ to $50$ points across four frozen backbones. The residual failures decompose into two measurable axes: a perception axis that moves with the backbone, and a geometry axis that is analytically predictable from the ratio of the output-window and event widths. FV-Action, the training-free method built on this analysis, reaches $56.8\%$ R@0.5 on Charades-STA, above the same backbone's native grounding pipeline and the strongest training-free result on this benchmark; it surpasses every TVG-trained model evaluated zero-shot on TACoS, and improves over direct prediction on ActivityNet Captions and QVHighlights, with no temporal supervision at any stage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态大模型在视频时间定位（temporal grounding）中的失败机制，发现强 VLM 在 Charades-STA 上 R@0.5 仅 3.8%，且错误预测多为低熵的“自信错误”，熵检测几乎失效。作者保持模型权重冻结，将时间戳回归改为由粗到细的二元问题扫描，仅用首 token 概率作为排序依据，在四个冻结主干上提升 R@0.5 达 28–50 点；该免训练方法 FV-Action 在 Charades-STA 达到 56.8% R@0.5，并在多个基准上超越或改善现有结果。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 能可靠识别事件却无法给出时间位置，直接回归时间戳时性能极低，且基于输出熵的错误检测低于随机分类器，说明失败源于任务接口而非感知能力。
Method: 保持权重不变，用 coarse-to-fine 的二元问题（yes/no）扫描替代时间戳回归，仅把第一 token 概率用作排序分数；并将残余失败分解为随主干移动的感知轴和可由输出窗口与事件宽度比值解析预测的几何轴。
Result: 四个冻结主干上 R@0.5 提升 28–50 点；FV-Action 在 Charades-STA 达到 56.8% R@0.5，超过同主干原生定位流程和最强免训练结果，在 TACoS 上超越所有零样本评估的 TVG 训练模型，并在 ActivityNet Captions 与 QVHighlights 上优于直接预测。
Conclusion: 摘要强调时间定位失败主要来自任务接口而非感知，训练免费的二元问题扫描可作为高效替代方案；该方法在任意阶段均不使用时间监督。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Ouroboros: A Self-Developing Frontier Coding Agent with Reviewed Core Evolution
papers.abstract_en: We present Ouroboros, a self-developing agent harness whose tools, prompts, context assembly, and core implementation improve through reviewed commits that become the runtime for later work. Core evolution proceeds in two modes. In recursive free evolution, improvement is itself a task, and completing one evolution cycle can schedule the next. In experience-driven core evolution, ordinary work and social interaction expose bugs, rough edges, and inefficient context construction that lead to reviewed structural changes. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, an Opus 5 run scores 86.74%, the best result reported on the benchmark. On OSWorld-Verified, an Opus 5 run reaches 90.69%, exceeding the best previously reported score. A five-rollout CL-Bench campaign achieves a normalized reward of 0.2301, setting a new state of the art. Hope is the longest-running publicly documented Ouroboros deployment. It is a 161-day living agent experiment in free evolution under governed human communication across seven surfaces. Human interaction surfaces faults and generates proposals, but the agent decides which changes to pursue. Because a self-developing agent may rewrite its own code and select new model APIs, operational safety becomes a primary design problem: guardrails must remain authoritative under evolutionary and public social pressure. Benchmark campaigns use frozen system snapshots, while Hope continues live evolution on a separate lineage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Ouroboros，一个自我进化的编码智能体（self-developing agent），其工具、提示词、上下文组装和核心实现通过审查后的提交（reviewed commits）持续改进，并成为后续工作的运行时。核心进化分两种模式：递归自由进化（recursive free evolution）和经验驱动的核心进化（experience-driven core evolution）。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上 Opus 5 运行得分 86.74%，在 OSWorld-Verified 上达到 90.69%，并在 CL-Bench 上取得 0.2301 的归一化奖励，均刷新已有 SOTA。作者还报告了 Hope 这一运行 161 天的公开自由进化实验。
Motivation: 现有编码智能体通常是静态部署，无法在长期运行中自行改进自身核心实现；作者认为让工具、提示词、上下文组装和核心代码通过审查提交进行进化，可以持续提升能力，同时需要解决由此带来的操作安全与治理问题。
Method: 提出 Ouroboros 系统，核心进化分为两种模式：递归自由进化中，改进本身作为任务，完成一个进化周期可调度下一个；经验驱动的核心进化中，日常工作与社交交互暴露 bug、粗糙边缘和低效上下文构建，进而触发结构性变更。基准评测使用冻结的系统快照，而 Hope 在独立血统（lineage）上持续实时进化，并强调护栏（guardrails）必须在进化与社交压力下保持权威。
Result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，Opus 5 运行得分 86.74%，为该基准已报告的最佳结果；在 OSWorld-Verified 上达到 90.69%，超过此前最佳报告分数；五次 rollout 的 CL-Bench 战役获得 0.2301 的归一化奖励，刷新 SOTA。Hope 是最长运行的公开部署，为跨越七个交互表面的 161 天自由进化实验。
Conclusion: 作者强调，由于自我进化智能体可以重写自身代码并选择新的模型 API，操作安全成为首要设计问题，护栏必须保持权威。人类交互暴露故障并产生提案，但最终由智能体决定采纳哪些变更。

summary_sections.result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，Opus 5 运行得分 86.74%，为该基准已报告的最佳结果；在 OSWorld-Verified 上达到 90.69%，超过此前最佳报告分数；五次 rollout 的 CL-Bench 战役获得 0.2301 的归一化奖励，刷新 SOTA。Hope 是最长运行的公开部署，为跨越七个交互表面的 161 天自由进化实验。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调，由于自我进化智能体可以重写自身代码并选择新的模型 API，操作安全成为首要设计问题，护栏必须保持权威。人类交互暴露故障并产生提案，但最终由智能体决定采纳哪些变更。

papers.title: Three Necessary Principles for Self-Supervised Visual Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: We argue that learning visual representations without labels requires a training signal jointly complete across three non-overlapping objectives: semantic invariance across augmented views, patch-level spatial prediction, and representational non-degeneracy. We formalize these as the observation, prediction, and regularization principles and prove (i) that combining observation and prediction without regularization admits the constant encoder as a global minimizer under negative-free alignment; (ii) that the two objectives are gradient-complementary and structurally non-conflicting at the encoder output; and (iii) that the momentum encoder converges to the same fixed point as the online encoder and provides no collapse guarantee at convergence. Contrastive alignment provides only self-limiting collapse resistance, formalized via an explicit gradient-decay argument. Dropping prediction withholds the spatial training signal by construction; dropping observation forfeits cross-view semantic invariance by construction; at the scale we study, no pair substitutes for the third. Every major self-supervised method is a special case of a single unified energy decomposition. We pair every theoretical claim with a controlled experiment, including a patch-retrieval evaluation for the spatial consequence of prediction.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026) Workshops
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证无标签视觉表征学习需要三个互不重叠的训练目标联合完备：跨增强视角的语义不变性（observation）、patch 级空间预测（prediction）以及表征非退化（regularization），并将它们形式化为 observation、prediction 与 regularization 三原则。作者证明，在无负样本对齐（negative-free alignment）下，仅组合 observation 与 prediction 而不加正则化会把常数编码器作为全局最小化解；同时动量编码器收敛到与在线编码器相同的固定点，并不提供收敛时的坍塌保证。论文将每个理论声明与受控实验配对，并用 patch 检索评估 prediction 带来的空间后果。
Motivation: 自监督视觉表征学习缺乏统一的训练信号完备性理论，现有方法在目标组合上各有取舍，且对坍塌（collapse）的抵抗机制理解不充分。作者试图回答：哪些非重叠目标必须联合存在，以及各目标在梯度与收敛层面的角色分别是什么。
Method: 作者提出三个必要原则：跨视角语义不变性（observation）、patch 级空间预测（prediction）与表征非退化（regularization），并围绕这些原则给出理论证明，包括组合目标在无正则化下允许常数编码器、两个目标在编码器输出上梯度互补且结构不冲突、动量编码器收敛到与在线编码器相同的固定点。他们还用显式梯度衰减论证说明对比对齐（contrastive alignment）只提供自限性的坍塌抵抗，并把所有主流自监督方法纳入统一能量分解框架。
Result: 摘要报告三类理论结果：缺少正则化时 observation 加 prediction 的最优解可以是常数编码器；observation 与 prediction 在梯度上互补且无结构冲突；动量编码器与在线编码器收敛到同一固定点但不提供坍塌保证。实验方面，每个理论声明都有受控实验支撑，其中包括用于检验 prediction 空间效果的 patch-retrieval 评估。
Conclusion: 作者强调三个目标在研究的规模上不可互相替代：去掉 prediction 会按构造丢失空间训练信号，去掉 observation 会按构造丢失跨视角语义不变性，任何两两组合都无法补齐第三个目标。该统一能量分解框架把主流自监督方法作为特例，为理解目标完备性与坍塌抵抗提供了理论视角。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Open-World Semantic Segmentation with Sensitivity Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Modern vision systems must operate in "open-world" settings, where models must recognize known categories and detect unseen or anomalous content. Conventional semantic segmentation models operate under a "closed-world" assumption, often producing overconfident misclassifications on novel content. We address open-world semantic segmentation, the joint task of segmenting known classes while detecting and grouping novel or anomalous content without additional supervision, by extending a dual-decoder baseline with a third, complementary decoder within a unified encoder-decoder design. The first decoder performs closed-set segmentation using Gaussian prototypes for known categories. The second uses contrastive feature learning to isolate unknown regions in embedding space. The third, our key contribution, is a sensitivity decoder that captures fine-grained texture irregularities and activation instabilities indicative of semantic uncertainty, which neither semantic prototypes nor contrastive norms can reliably detect. The three decoders provide genuinely complementary signals: class-level OOD distance in logit space, global feature energy in embedding space, and local activation instability across encoder scales. Experiments on Cityscapes and BDD-Anomaly show that our method improves anomaly segmentation and novel-class discovery while maintaining competitive closed-set accuracy, with gains of +2.4% AUROC and a 2.5 pp. reduction in FPR@95TPR on BDD-Anomaly over the baseline.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP) Satellite Workshops
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种开放世界语义分割方法，在统一编码器-解码器结构中为双解码器基线增加第三个解码器。第一个解码器用高斯原型做闭集分割，第二个用对比特征学习分离未知区域，第三个是敏感性解码器，捕捉纹理不规则和激活不稳定以指示语义不确定性。实验在 Cityscapes 和 BDD-Anomaly 上提升了异常分割和新类发现，同时保持有竞争力的闭集精度。
Motivation: 传统语义分割模型基于闭集假设，面对未见过内容时常常过度自信地误分类，难以满足现代开放世界视觉系统的需求。现有双解码器方案中，语义原型和对比范数都无法可靠检测细粒度的纹理异常与激活不稳定。
Method: 扩展双解码器基线为三解码器统一结构：第一解码器使用高斯原型进行已知类别的闭集分割；第二解码器通过对比特征学习在嵌入空间隔离未知区域；第三解码器为敏感性解码器，捕捉编码器多尺度上的局部激活不稳定。三个解码器分别提供 logit 空间的类级 OOD 距离、嵌入空间的全局特征能量以及跨编码器尺度的局部激活不稳定信号。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 BDD-Anomaly 上相比基线取得 +2.4% AUROC 的提升，并将 FPR@95TPR 降低 2.5 个百分点，同时保持有竞争力的闭集分割精度；实验在 Cityscapes 和 BDD-Anomaly 上进行。
Conclusion: 摘要认为三种互补的判据能更可靠地完成开放世界语义分割中已知类分割、异常检测与新颖类发现这一联合任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Frequency-Domain Dual-Branch Fusion for Medical Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Medical Visual Question Answering (VQA) requires aligning subtle visual evidence, including lesion texture, boundary sharpness, and diffuse density changes, with clinical language. Existing multimodal fusion approaches operating in the spatial domain may not fully exploit complementary frequency information present in visual and textual representations. We introduce a dual-branch frequency-domain fusion module that conditions spectral filtering on the input question, enabling adaptive selection of global low-frequency structure and fine-grained high-frequency detail before reconstructing the spatial representation for answer generation. To provide a richer spectrum for filtering, we extract complementary features from early texture-sensitive and final semantic layers of a frozen BiomedCLIP encoder and align both with the question representation using a symmetric InfoNCE objective prior to staged joint training with a BioBART decoder. We pretrain the proposed model on PMC-VQA and fine-tune it on the VQA-RAD and SLAKE benchmarks, demonstrating that frequency-aware multimodal fusion improves medical VQA performance while maintaining a lightweight and efficient architecture.
papers.comment: 7 Pages, 4 figures, under review at AAAI 27
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向医疗视觉问答 (Medical VQA) 的频域双分支融合模块，通过以输入问题为条件对频谱滤波，自适应地选择全局低频结构与细粒度高频细节，再重构空间表示用于答案生成。作者从冻结的 BiomedCLIP 编码器中提取早期纹理敏感层与最终语义层的互补特征，并用对称 InfoNCE 目标与问题表示对齐，之后配合 BioBART 解码器进行分阶段联合训练；在 PMC-VQA 上预训练，并在 VQA-RAD 和 SLAKE 上微调。摘要未给出具体量化结果，仅称频域感知融合在保持轻量高效的同时提升了医疗 VQA 性能。
Motivation: 现有医疗 VQA 的多模态融合方法多在空间域操作，可能未能充分利用视觉与文本表示中的互补频域信息，而细粒度频域线索（如病变纹理、边界锐利度、弥漫密度变化）对对齐临床语言很重要。
Method: 引入双分支频域融合模块，使频谱滤波以输入问题为条件，从而自适应选择全局低频结构与局部高频细节；从冻结 BiomedCLIP 的纹理敏感早期层和语义最终层提取互补特征，用对称 InfoNCE 对齐问题表示，再以 BioBART 解码器分阶段联合训练。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在医学 VQA 基准上优于基线，同时保持轻量高效；具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Conclusion: 作者主张频域感知的多模态融合能够改进医疗 VQA 性能，且架构轻量高效；该工作目前处于 AAAI 27 审稿阶段。

papers.title: Query-Only Backdoor Attacks on Self-Evolving Skills via Trajectory Poisoning
papers.abstract_en: Agentic skills improve large language model (LLM) agents by encoding reusable procedures for complex tasks. However, manually authored skills often adapt poorly to long-horizon tasks and changing environments. To address the limitation, self-evolving skill systems have been developed to automatically construct and update skills from execution trajectories, shifting skill acquisition from external marketplaces to a trusted evolution pipeline. By replacing external skill acquisition with trusted internal construction, self-evolving skill systems reduce exposure to skill injection attacks that rely on direct skill manipulation. However, this skill evolution pipeline may introduce a new attack surface in which an attacker can indirectly steer skill evolution by inducing compromised trajectories through agent interactions. To demonstrate the threat, we propose Trajectory Backdoor Attack (TBA), a query-only attack that steers a trusted skill-evolution pipeline toward producing a backdoored skill. Specifically, we craft attacker-submitted queries to lead the agent to perform the target action and explicitly state the corresponding activation condition in the trajectory. We repeat the same condition-action pattern across diverse triggered tasks, while leaving clean queries unchanged, encouraging the evolver to consolidate the pattern as a reusable trigger-dependent rule into the evolved skill. Experiments on three benchmarks across two skill-evolution systems using four open- and closed-source backbone models demonstrate that TBA reliably implants conditional backdoors while preserving clean-task utility, matching or even surpassing direct skill injection. The results reveal a critical vulnerability in trajectory-driven skill evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对自进化技能系统的查询型后门攻击（Trajectory Backdoor Attack, TBA），攻击者通过构造恶意查询让智能体执行目标动作并在轨迹中显式写下触发条件，重复该条件-动作模式，使技能进化器将触发依赖规则合并为带后门的技能。实验在三个基准、两个技能进化系统、四种开源/闭源骨干模型上验证了攻击有效性，且不损害干净任务效用。
Motivation: 自进化技能系统将技能获取从外部市场转向受信任的进化管线，减少了对直接技能注入攻击的暴露，但进化管线本身可能引入新的攻击面：攻击者可通过诱导被污染的轨迹间接操纵技能进化。
Method: 提出查询仅攻击（query-only attack）TBA：攻击者仅提交精心构造的查询，引导智能体执行目标动作并在轨迹中明确说出激活条件；在多个触发任务中重复相同条件-动作模式，同时保持干净查询不变，促使进化器将模式固化为可复用的触发相关技能规则。
Result: 在三个基准、两个技能进化系统和四种开源及闭源骨干模型上的实验表明，TBA能可靠植入条件后门，同时保持干净任务效用，效果与直接技能注入相当甚至更优。
Conclusion: 摘要强调轨迹驱动的技能进化存在关键安全漏洞，当前自进化管线并不能消除攻击风险，仍可通过查询交互实现后门植入。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调轨迹驱动的技能进化存在关键安全漏洞，当前自进化管线并不能消除攻击风险，仍可通过查询交互实现后门植入。

papers.title: Machine-Learning-Based Diagnostic Framework for Passive Ultrasonic Detection of Railway Wheel Defects
papers.abstract_en: Reliable identification of railway wheel defects is important for safety and maintenance. This study develops a machine-learning-based diagnostic framework for multi-class defect identification using passive air-coupled ultrasonic acoustic emission signals. Data were collected from eleven full-scale railway wheelsets representing nine health states. Time- and frequency-domain features were evaluated using Kruskal-Wallis statistical testing and mutual-information analysis to identify the most discriminative indicators. A Random Forest classifier was then trained using the selected features with stratified 5-fold cross-validation. The model achieved a balanced accuracy of approximately 0.66 and a Macro-F1 score of 0.65 across the nine classes. Decay rate, kurtosis, skewness, and envelope low-frequency power emerged as the most influential features, while a compact subset of features retained most of the classification performance. The results demonstrate the feasibility of combining passive ultrasonic sensing, statistical feature selection, and supervised machine learning for non-contact railway wheel defect classification and provide a foundation for future field-deployable inspection systems.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于机器学习的诊断框架，利用被动气耦合超声声发射信号对铁路车轮缺陷进行多分类识别。数据来自十一个全尺寸铁路轮对、共九种健康状态；作者用 Kruskal-Wallis 统计检验与互信息分析筛选时频域特征，并用随机森林 (Random Forest) 分类器结合分层 5 折交叉验证训练模型。摘要报告平均平衡准确率约 0.66、Macro-F1 为 0.65，并指出衰减率、峰度、偏度和包络低频功率是最有判别力的特征。
Motivation: 铁路车轮缺陷的可靠识别对行车安全与维护至关重要，而现有方法需要接触式检测或难以实现非接触式多类缺陷分类，因此需要一种可现场部署的被动式识别方案。
Method: 采用被动气耦合超声声发射 (passive air-coupled ultrasonic acoustic emission) 采集信号，提取时域与频域特征，通过 Kruskal-Wallis 统计检验和互信息分析筛选最具判别力的指标，再基于所选特征训练随机森林分类器，并使用分层 5 折交叉验证评估。
Result: 在九类健康状态的分类任务上，模型取得约 0.66 的平衡准确率和 0.65 的 Macro-F1；衰减率、峰度、偏度与包络低频功率是最重要的特征，且紧凑的特征子集保留了大部分分类性能。
Conclusion: 研究证明将被动超声传感、统计特征选择与有监督机器学习相结合，能够实现非接触式铁路车轮缺陷分类，并为未来现场可部署的检测系统奠定基础。

papers.title: Mitigating Over-Personalization in LLMs via Structured Memory
papers.abstract_en: Conversational assistants increasingly rely on persistent long-term memory to personalize responses across sessions. However, when stored user information is reintroduced into the model context, it can also influence responses in inappropriate or unrelated settings. We study two such failure modes in memory-augmented LLMs: cross-domain leakage, where memories from one life domain affect responses in another, and memory-induced sycophancy, where stored user beliefs make models more likely to agree with the user rather than respond truthfully. We apply a simple inference-time modification to how memories are presented to the model, without changing the model or the memory contents. Across seven models on PersistBench, we compare the commonly used all-in context format, where memories are injected as an unstructured list, with structured formats that partition memories by domain. This simple modification consistently reduces cross-domain leakage while preserving utility, with our strongest method reducing leakage by $8.8\%$ on average relative to the baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究记忆增强型大语言模型（LLM）中持久长期记忆导致的两类失败模式：跨领域泄漏（cross-domain leakage）和记忆诱导的谄媚（memory-induced sycophancy）。作者提出一种仅改变记忆呈现方式的推理时修改，不修改模型或记忆内容，将原本无结构的记忆列表改为按领域分区的结构化格式。在 PersistBench 上对七个模型进行评测，该修改在保持实用性的同时持续降低跨领域泄漏，最强方法相对基线平均减少 8.8% 的泄漏。
Motivation: 对话助手越来越依赖持久长期记忆来跨会话个性化，但存续的用户信息重新进入上下文时，可能在无关或不合适的场景影响回答。作者聚焦两种具体失效模式：一个生活领域的记忆干扰另一领域的回答，以及存储的用户信念使模型更倾向附和用户而非给出真实回答。
Method: 提出一种简单的推理时修改：改变记忆向模型的呈现形式，对比常见的 all-in context 格式（将记忆注入为无结构列表）与按领域划分记忆的结构化格式。该方法不改变模型参数，也不改变记忆内容。
Result: 在 PersistBench 上覆盖七个模型的实验表明，结构化格式一致地降低跨领域泄漏并保持实用性；最强方法相对基线平均降低 8.8% 的泄漏。
Conclusion: 作者认为记忆的呈现格式本身会影响过度个性化（over-personalization），按领域分区记忆是一种有效的缓解手段，且无需改动模型或记忆内容。

papers.title: A Controlled Study of Feature-Based Knowledge Distillation Across Student Designs
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation trains a smaller student to match the outputs of a larger teacher. Feature-based methods also align intermediate representations, but this extra constraint may affect students differently. We study this question on CIFAR-100 using a ResNet-50 teacher, a width-controlled CustomResNet family and MobileNetV2 as a cross-design comparison. For each student, we evaluate each feature method against a matched logit-KD run using the same teacher, optimizer settings, training schedule and seed. We repeat the main comparisons across multiple seeds. Logit KD improved every tested student over its scratch baseline. Attention Transfer showed no clear relationship with size inside the CustomResNet family, but its average effect was negative for that family and positive for MobileNetV2. FitNets was below logit KD in all 15 paired runs. Within the constant-depth width sweep, its gap increased for wider students, although the different-depth w=48 student did not follow this trend. Finally, the same auxiliary coefficient produced different gradient scales across students, showing that a fixed coefficient does not create a uniform training condition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在CIFAR-100上对特征知识蒸馏进行受控研究，使用ResNet-50教师、宽度可控的CustomResNet家族和MobileNetV2学生，在相同教师、优化器、训练计划和种子下将Attention Transfer、FitNets等特征方法与匹配的logit-KD运行比较。摘要报告logit-KD对所有学生均优于从头训练；FitNets在所有15次配对运行中低于logit-KD；Attention Transfer对CustomResNet家族平均效果为负、对MobileNetV2为正；固定辅助系数在不同学生上产生不同梯度尺度。
Motivation: 特征知识蒸馏通过对齐中间表示增加额外约束，但这种约束对不同学生的影响可能不同，现有研究缺乏跨学生设计的受控比较。因此作者设计了一致训练条件来分离学生结构与特征方法效果之间的关系。
Method: 在CIFAR-100上以ResNet-50为教师，采用宽度控制的CustomResNet家族和MobileNetV2作为学生；对每个学生，在相同教师、优化器设置、训练计划和随机种子下，将每个特征方法与匹配的logit-KD对照，并进行多种子重复。
Result: Logit-KD提升了每个测试学生相对其从头基线的表现；FitNets在所有15次配对运行中低于logit-KD，且在恒定深度宽度扫描中差距随学生宽度增大而增大（但不同深度的w=48学生例外）；Attention Transfer在CustomResNet家族内与大小无明显关系且平均效果为负，对MobileNetV2为正；相同辅助系数在不同学生上产生不同梯度尺度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调固定辅助系数并不能为学生创造统一的训练条件，特征蒸馏方法的效果与学生设计相关；该研究为在不同学生架构下评估特征级知识蒸馏提供了受控依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Test-Time Prototype Adaptation for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) repurposes a pretrained CLIP encoder for dense prediction without additional labeled supervision. Existing methods improve CLIP's spatial behavior either by redesigning its internal attention or by injecting features from auxiliary vision foundation models; both require access to the host's internal computation and are tailored to its specific forward pass. In this work, we propose Test-time Prototype Adaptation (TPA), a training-free plug-in that operates at the output level, leaving the host's forward pass and weights unmodified. By leveraging a lightweight transductive adaptation phase, TPA identifies confident anchor patches from the host's own output predictions on a small pool of unlabeled deployment-domain images, and aggregates their frozen DINO features into per-class prototypes; at inference, a single cosine similarity lookup against this frozen bank provides an auxiliary score fused linearly with the host's logits. TPA composes with five representative OVSS hosts spanning attention-redesign and VFM-injection designs, across three CLIP backbones, eight benchmarks, and multiple internal VFM choices. Under a single set of hyper-parameters and without per-host tuning or parameter updates, TPA consistently improves segmentation accuracy, with as few as approximately 10% of unlabeled deployment-domain images sufficing for effective bank construction on most benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Test-time Prototype Adaptation (TPA)，一种无需训练的即插即用方法，用于开放词汇语义分割 (OVSS)。TPA 在输出层面工作：从少量无标注部署域图像的主机输出中识别高置信 anchor patches，并聚合其冻结的 DINO 特征形成每类原型；推理时通过一次余弦相似度查找获得辅助分数，再与主机 logits 线性融合。在五种代表性 OVSS 主机、三种 CLIP 骨干、八个基准上，以单一超参集一致提升分割精度，多数基准上约 10% 的无标注部署域图像即可有效构建原型库。
Motivation: 现有 OVSS 方法要么重新设计 CLIP 内部注意力，要么注入辅助视觉基础模型 (VFM) 特征，均需访问主机内部计算并针对特定前向传播定制。本文希望在不修改主机前向过程和权重的前提下，通过输出级适配提升开放词汇分割精度。
Method: 提出 TPA，包含轻量转导 (transductive) 适配阶段：从主机对少量无标注部署域图像的输出预测中识别高置信 anchor patches，将其冻结的 DINO 特征聚合成每类原型；推理阶段仅做一次余弦相似度查找，得到辅助分数并与主机 logits 线性融合。
Result: 摘要报告 TPA 与五种 OVSS 主机（涵盖 attention-redesign 和 VFM-injection 两类设计）、三种 CLIP 骨干、八个基准及多种内部 VFM 选择均可组合，且使用单一超参集、无需逐主机调参或参数更新，一致提升分割精度；多数基准上约 10% 的无标注部署域图像即可有效构建原型库。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 TPA 是训练无关 (training-free) 的输出级插件，不修改主机前向过程与权重，可作为通用插件与多种 OVSS 主机组合。其适用范围为开放词汇语义分割，与降水、临近预报等天气领域无关。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Causal State-Space Model for Causal Inference: Estimating Longitudinal Individual Treatment Effects
papers.abstract_en: Estimating counterfactual outcomes over time from longitudinal observational data is central to clinical decision support. Existing methods rely on domain confusion -- adversarial training that renders representations invariant to treatment assignment -- yet this invariance creates a mutual information conflict: it suppresses treatment-correlated covariate signals necessary for accurate outcome prediction. We formalise this tension via a Jensen-Shannon divergence bound on counterfactual prediction error and develop two complementary models. CSSD (Causal State-Space model with Direct decoder) adapts selective State Space Models with a parallel multi-step decoder that eliminates accumulated rollout error by producing all prediction horizons simultaneously in a single forward pass. CSSPD (Causal State-Space model with Predictive regularisation and Direct decoder) augments CSSD with Contrastive Predictive Coding and Local Information Maximisation to reinforce temporal predictability in the balancing representation and recover local covariate information destroyed by domain confusion. On MIMIC-III, CSSPD achieves lower counterfactual RMSE than the Causal Transformer at every horizon tau >= 2 at O(T) encoder cost, with gains from 0.02 (2-step) to 0.07 (6-step). On Cancer Simulation across confounding strengths gamma in {0,1,2,3,4}, CSSPD outperforms CT at gamma <= 3 (margins 25.9%--37.0%), and CSSD achieves the lowest overall average RMSE (12.7% reduction over CT), confirming the MI conflict analysis. To our knowledge, this is the first work to formalise the balancing-prediction MI conflict and propose a structured resolution through complementary predictive and information-theoretic training objectives.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究纵向观测数据下的反事实结局估计，指出现有基于域混淆 (domain confusion) 的表示不变性训练会抑制与治疗相关的协变量信号，从而与结果预测产生互信息冲突。作者形式化该冲突并提出两个互补模型：CSSD 采用选择性状态空间模型 (selective State Space Model) 与并行多步直出解码器，CSSPD 在此基础上加入对比预测编码和局部信息最大化。在 MIMIC-III 与 Cancer Simulation 上的实验表明所提方法在多个预测时域上优于 Causal Transformer。
Motivation: 现有纵向反事实推断方法依赖对抗训练使表示对治疗分配不变，但这一不变性会丢弃治疗相关协变量信息，导致预测精度下降；论文目标是形式化并解决这种平衡-预测互信息冲突。
Method: 提出 CSSD，将选择性状态空间模型与并行多步直出解码器结合，在单次前向传播中同时生成所有预测时域以消除累积 rollout 误差；提出 CSSPD，在 CSSD 上加入对比预测编码 (Contrastive Predictive Coding) 与局部信息最大化 (Local Information Maximisation)，以增强平衡表示的时序可预测性并恢复被域混淆破坏的局部协变量信息。
Result: 在 MIMIC-III 上，CSSPD 在所有时域 tau >= 2 上取得比 Causal Transformer 更低的反事实 RMSE，增益从 2 步的 0.02 到 6 步的 0.07，且编码器复杂度为 O(T)；在 Cancer Simulation 上，CSSPD 在混淆强度 gamma <= 3 时优于 CT（边际 25.9%--37.0%），CSSD 取得最低总体平均 RMSE（较 CT 降低 12.7%）。
Conclusion: 据作者称这是首个形式化平衡-预测互信息冲突并提出结构化解决方案的工作，实验结果表明该冲突分析得到验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: What Irregularity Costs: CUDA C++, Rust, and Triton on a Hash-Blocked GPU Workload
papers.abstract_en: GPU language comparisons are almost always run on tiled dense linear algebra, where every toolchain is good and the differences are small. We implement the same hash-blocked TSDF fusion kernel in CUDA C++, in Rust through NVIDIA's cuda-oxide, and in Triton, and measure it on a workload with the opposite character: an open-addressed hash table with compare-exchange insertion, data-dependent per-lane probe depth, and contended scatter. The result is a split. On the regular stage, which walks a truncation band and accumulates, all three languages land within a small factor of each other. On the irregular stage, which probes and inserts, Rust stays close to hand-written CUDA C++ while Triton is more than an order of magnitude slower. Language choice is nearly free on the work that is usually benchmarked and expensive on the work that is not. We attribute both gaps to specific things the languages cannot express, not to ratios. Triton's cost follows from a probe loop that must run to a compile-time bound and from tl.atomic_cas taking no mask, which forces a scratch structure with no counterpart in CUDA. Rust's cost was invisible in every instruction count: its kernel issues fewer instructions, fewer compare-exchanges and fewer registers at identical occupancy, yet was slower. Hardware counters located it in L1 residency. A GPU-scope atomic load must be coherent across SMs, no NVIDIA L1 is, so the type-correct way to read a shared location bypasses the cache on every access. Triton's bounded probe is also a correctness problem for fusion: at load factors an ordinary depth trajectory reaches, it silently discards blocks and the reconstruction loses patches of surface with nothing reported. We also report a defect found and fixed in cuda-oxide itself, now merged upstream: its scoped atomic load and store could not be called at all in the build mode that produces real kernels.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Includes a correctness result for TSDF fusion implementations: at hash load factors reached by ordinary depth trajectories, the Triton implementation silently discards blocks. Code, raw measurement CSVs and an interactive viewer: https://github.com/realitymatrix/what-irregularity-costs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在哈希阻塞的 TSDF 融合内核上对比 CUDA C++、Rust（通过 NVIDIA 的 cuda-oxide）与 Triton 的实现，该工作负载具有不规则特性：开放寻址哈希表、compare-exchange 插入、数据相关的每 lane 探测深度以及竞争性散列写。结果显示在规则阶段三种语言性能接近，而在不规则阶段 Rust 接近手写 CUDA C++，Triton 则慢一个数量级以上；Triton 在较高的哈希负载因子下还会静默丢弃块，导致重建表面缺失。
Motivation: GPU 语言对比几乎都在平铺稠密线性代数上进行，此时各工具链差异很小；本文针对相反特性的工作负载，即不规则内存访问和竞争性插入，考察语言选择在真正困难任务上的代价。
Method: 作者用 CUDA C++、Rust（cuda-oxide）和 Triton 实现同一哈希阻塞的 TSDF 融合内核，并在规则阶段（遍历截断带并累积）与不规则阶段（探测并插入）分别测量；通过指令数、硬件计数器和寄存器占用等定位性能差异来源。
Result: 在规则阶段三种语言性能接近；在不规则阶段 Rust 保持接近手写 CUDA C++，而 Triton 慢一个数量级以上。Triton 的代价来自必须运行到编译期上限的探测循环以及 tl.atomic_cas 不支持 mask；Rust 的代价无法从指令数看出，硬件计数器定位到 L1 驻留问题——GPU 作用域的原子加载要求跨 SM 一致性，导致每次访问绕过缓存。Triton 的有界探测还造成正确性问题：在普通深度轨迹会达到的负载因子下，它会静默丢弃块并丢失表面片。
Conclusion: 语言选择在通常被基准测试的规则工作上几乎免费，在不规则工作上代价高昂，且两个差距都归因于语言无法表达的特定特性而非简单比例；此外作者报告并修复了 cuda-oxide 中一个已合并上游的缺陷，即其作用域原子加载/存储在生成真实内核的构建模式下无法调用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Ego-OSCAR: Egocentric Open source Stereo CAptuRe System
papers.abstract_en: We present Ego-OSCAR, an open-hardware, low-cost, head-mounted stereo-inertial capture device for egocentric data collection in the wild. EgoOSCAR pairs a hardware-synchronized global-shutter stereo camera with a 6- axis IMU, an embedded Linux SBC for on-device video encoding, and a realtime microcontroller for user feedback and watchdog functions. The complete bill of materials is under USD 200 per unit, using only commercially available components and 3D-printed parts. Alongside the device, we release a complete software stack (hardware-accelerated recording pipeline, IMU sampling daemon, time-synchronization tooling, and watchdog firmware) and roughly 550 hours of egocentric stereo video per camera with synchronized IMU, collected by a distributed contributor network across everyday indoor environments. The release is annotated rather than raw: free-form action captions cover essentially the entire recorded timeline with an open vocabulary, and per-frame 3D hand reconstructions ship alongside per-session stereo calibration. Ego-OSCAR does not aim to match the per-unit fidelity of research-grade systems such as Project Aria; it aims to be the cheapest defensible substrate for crowdsourced egocentric capture, and to lower the activation energy for any team that wants to collect egocentric data at scale. All hardware designs, software, and the dataset are open-sourced
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Ego-OSCAR，一个开源、低成本、头戴式立体惯性采集设备，用于野外自我中心（egocentric）数据收集。设备将硬件同步的全局快门双目相机与 6 轴 IMU、嵌入式 Linux SBC 以及实时微控制器结合，整套物料成本低于 200 美元。作者同时发布完整软件栈、约 550 小时带同步 IMU 的自我中心双目视频，以及带开放词汇动作字幕和逐帧 3D 手部重建的标注数据。该工作定位为众包自我中心采集的最便宜可行基底，而非追求 Project Aria 级别的单设备保真度。
Motivation: 研究级自我中心采集系统（如 Project Aria）单位成本高、使用门槛高，难以在野外大规模众包收集 egocentric 数据；论文目标是降低任何团队规模化采集自我中心数据的激活能量。
Method: 开源硬件方案：硬件同步的全局快门双目相机搭配 6 轴 IMU，嵌入式 Linux SBC 负责机载视频编码，实时微控制器提供用户反馈和看门狗（watchdog）功能；配套发布硬件加速录制管线、IMU 采样守护进程、时间同步工具和看门狗固件等完整软件栈。
Result: 整套物料成本低于 200 美元/台，仅使用商用组件和 3D 打印零件；通过分布式贡献者网络在室内日常环境中采集约 550 小时的双目视频与同步 IMU。数据以带注释而非原始形式发布：开放词汇的动作字幕覆盖几乎整个时间线，并提供逐帧 3D 手部重建和逐会话立体标定。
Conclusion: 作者明确说明 Ego-OSCAR 不以匹配 Project Aria 等研究级系统的单设备保真度为目标，而是要做众包自我中心采集的最便宜可靠基底；所有硬件设计、软件和数据集均开源。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Fair on the Surface? Benchmarking Hidden-Output Fairness Gaps in LLM Recommenders
papers.abstract_en: Fairness audits for LLM-based recommenders have largely focused on observable outputs, implicitly assuming that stable recommendations reflect stable internal processing. We challenge this assumption with FairGap, the first benchmark to jointly evaluate recommendation fairness at two levels: observable output shift (OBS) and hidden representation shift (IBS), measured through controlled counterfactual identity probes across gender, age, and race. Their relationship is summarized via Representation-Output Alignment (ROA), with quadrant diagnostics for identifying user-level hidden-output mismatch. Applied to six open-weight LLM families across three domains, FairGap reveals pervasive hidden-output decoupling: ROA rarely exceeds 0.22, and a non-negligible user population shows stable outputs despite substantial internal shifts, a mode that output-only audits cannot detect by design. Further, activation steering that reduces IBS by up to 8x simultaneously worsens OBS, demonstrating a fundamental tension between internal and output-level fairness that existing frameworks are unequipped to diagnose.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FairGap，首个同时评估 LLM 推荐系统两层公平性的基准：可观测输出偏移 (OBS) 与隐藏表示偏移 (IBS)，并通过性别、年龄、种族的受控反事实身份探针测量。对六个开放权重 LLM 家族在三个领域的评估显示，隐藏-输出解耦普遍存在，ROA 很少超过 0.22，且不少用户即使内部表示发生显著偏移仍保持稳定输出。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 推荐系统公平性审计大多只关注可观测输出，隐含假设稳定的推荐来自稳定的内部处理；该假设尚未被检验，输出层面的审计可能遗漏内部不公平模式。
Method: 提出 FairGap 基准，通过受控反事实身份探针同时测量 OBS 与 IBS，用 Representation-Output Alignment (ROA) 概括两者关系，并提供象限诊断来识别用户级隐藏-输出不匹配；还使用激活引导 (activation steering) 作为干预手段。
Result: 在六个开放权重 LLM 家族、三个领域上，ROA 很少超过 0.22；存在不可忽略的用户群体在内部表示大幅偏移时仍保持稳定输出，这种模式是纯输出审计天然无法检测的。激活引导可将 IBS 降低最多 8 倍，但同时使 OBS 恶化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调隐藏-输出解耦普遍存在，输出层面公平与内部层面公平之间存在根本性张力，现有框架无法诊断这类问题，FairGap 填补了这一缺口。
