papers.title: Do Evaluation Metrics Detect Errors in Classical Chinese to English Translations?
papers.abstract_en: Although large language models can translate some historical languages surprisingly well, their usefulness in digital humanities workflows is limited by the lack of reliable evaluation. We investigate whether existing automatic evaluation metrics developed for modern languages are reliable in this setting, using translation from Classical Chinese to English as a test case. We introduce a diagnostic framework based on minimal pairs capturing error types salient in scholarly use, probing both reference-based and reference-free metrics for error sensitivity and tolerance to valid variation. We find that all metrics exhibit blind spots, however MetricX24 performs best overall. Our findings highlight the need for more robust and interpretable metrics for historically and culturally distinct translation settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究现有自动评估指标能否可靠评估大语言模型将文言文 (Classical Chinese) 翻译为英语的质量。作者提出一个基于最小对 (minimal pairs) 的诊断框架，覆盖学术使用中常见的错误类型，并系统检验基于参考翻译和无参考的指标对错误的敏感度以及对合法变体的容忍度。研究发现所有指标都有盲区，其中 MetricX24 综合表现最佳。
Motivation: 大语言模型在历史语言翻译上表现不错，但数字人文工作流中缺乏可靠的评估手段；面向现代语言的自动评估指标是否适用于文言文这类历史语言尚不清楚。
Method: 以文言文到英语翻译为测试场景，构建基于最小对 (minimal pairs) 的诊断框架，其中包含学术使用中重要的错误类型，并用该框架同时探测基于参考 (reference-based) 和无参考 (reference-free) 评估指标的误差敏感性与对合法变体的容忍度。
Result: 所有被测试的评估指标都存在盲点 (blind spots)，但 MetricX24 整体表现最佳。
Conclusion: 研究强调，对于历史上和文化上独特的翻译场景，需要更稳健且可解释的评估指标。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Stateful CARS: Exact Cross-History Reuse for Policy-Constrained LLM Agents
authors: Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using language-model agents face constraints whose meaning changes with observations and prior actions. We study exact sampling from the model distribution conditioned on a hard stateful validator while reusing invalidity certificates across histories. Stateful CARS freezes a bank of sound state--continuation schemas within each attempt and removes every trajectory containing a certified continuation at a matching abstract state. An exact residual Doob transform samples from the resulting proposal. We give a checkable future-validity bisimulation condition, prove schema soundness, adaptive exactness, i.i.d.\ outputs, almost-sure termination, monotone acceptance, and compression invariance, and characterize computation by the number of reachable full-history product states. This number can be exponential for a history-dependent language model; the evaluated method therefore makes no generic finite-trie scalability claim. On enumerable workflows, its analytic law matches the valid conditional to $10^{-16}$ at validity probability $6\times10^{-8}$, whereas state-aware local decoding can be $0.97$ away. A matched comparison is negative: observation-keyed official CARS is cheaper in sampler steps (root/Stateful ratio $0.942$ $[0.934,0.951]$), and the Qwen comparison is null ($0.99$ $[0.90,1.08]$). Cross-history transfer helps only in an internal matched-key ablation ($1.27\times$). Thus the evidence supports exact schema-induced conditioning, not a systems advantage over CARS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在硬状态化验证器 (hard stateful validator) 约束下从语言模型分布做精确采样的问题，并尝试在历史轨迹间复用无效性证书。所提 Stateful CARS 在每次尝试中冻结一组可靠的状态–延续模式 (state–continuation schemas)，并剔除所有在匹配抽象状态处包含已认证延续的轨迹，再用精确残差 Doob 变换从建议分布采样。理论部分给出可检验的未来有效性互模拟条件，并证明模式可靠性、自适应精确性、i.i.d. 输出、几乎必然终止、单调接受与压缩不变性；实验显示其解析分布与有效条件分布在有效性概率 6×10⁻⁸ 时吻合到 10⁻¹⁶。
Motivation: 工具型语言模型智能体面临的约束会随观测和先前的动作改变含义，现有方法难以在硬状态化验证器约束下实现精确采样；同时希望跨历史复用无效性证书以提高效率。
Method: 提出 Stateful CARS：在每次采样尝试中冻结一组可靠的状态–延续模式，删除在匹配抽象状态处包含已认证延续的所有轨迹，并利用精确残差 Doob 变换对所得建议分布进行采样；作者还给出可检验的未来有效性互模拟条件并证明多种理论性质。
Result: 摘要报告解析分布与有效条件分布吻合到 10⁻¹⁶（有效性概率为 6×10⁻⁸），而状态感知的局部解码误差可达 0.97；配对比较为负面结果：官方 CARS 在采样步数上更便宜（root/Stateful 比率为 0.942，置信区间 [0.934,0.951]），Qwen 比较为无效结果（0.99 [0.90,1.08]），跨历史迁移仅在内部匹配键消融中带来 1.27× 的提升。
Conclusion: 作者指出证据支持的是精确的模式诱导条件化 (schema-induced conditioning)，而非相对 CARS 的系统性优势；由于可达全历史乘积状态数可能指数增长，方法不做通用有限字典 (finite-trie) 可扩展性声明。

papers.title: Exploring LLM Capabilities for Situational Understanding and COLREG compliance on real-world maritime navigation scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown considerable capability for situational understanding, reasoning, and decision making in different domains, most notable in the automotive sector. Therefore, we explore current state-of-the-art LLMs as a tool for maritime navigation, which includes both codified rules in the Collision Regulations (COLREGs) and uncodified best practices summarized in the concept of ``Good Seamanship''. We construct a dataset consisting of 50 diverse, real-world navigation scenarios from AIS data, label scenarios with applicable COLREG rules, recommended actions, and the reasoning for the action. We explore a variety of different LLM architectures and sizes to determine their understanding of maritime navigation tasks as well as evaluate their reasoning capabilities in this domain. The results obtained indicate that the maritime navigation task remains difficult to solve without fine-tuning, even for larger online models.
papers.comment: Submitted and accepted to the IFAC WC 2026 as an invited session paper for track 7.2 Transportation and Vehicle Systems - Marine Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索将当前大语言模型（LLM）用于海事导航情境理解与避碰规则（COLREGs）合规判断。作者基于 AIS 数据构建了 50 个真实航行场景的数据集，并为每个场景标注适用的 COLREG 规则、推荐动作及推理依据，随后比较多种 LLM 架构与规模在该任务上的理解与推理能力。摘要结论是，即使对于较大的在线模型，未经微调的海事导航任务仍然难以解决。
Motivation: 汽车等领域已展示 LLM 的情境理解与决策能力，而海事导航同时涉及成文规则（COLREGs）和未成文的“良好船艺”（Good Seamanship）最佳实践，现有工作尚未充分评估 LLM 在这一领域的表现。
Method: 从 AIS 数据构建包含 50 个多样化真实航行场景的数据集，对每个场景标注适用的 COLREG 规则、推荐行动及其推理过程；然后对不同架构和规模的 LLM 进行评估，考察其对海事导航任务的理解与推理能力。
Result: 摘要报告，在未进行微调的情况下，即使较大的在线模型也仍难以解决海事导航任务，说明该任务对现有 LLM 具有挑战性。
Conclusion: 作者认为海事导航的情境理解与 COLREG 合规判断难以靠现成 LLM 直接解决；该文已被 IFAC WC 2026 作为邀请会议论文接收。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Action- and Language-Conditioned Video Assessment for Embodied Control
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based embodied agents executing multi-step natural language instructions require feedback mechanisms that assess task progress over complete trajectories. Conventional approaches based on final-frame matching or continuous embedding similarity may overlook intermediate transitions that are necessary for determining whether an instruction has been completed. We propose ALVA (Action- and Language-Conditioned Video Assessment), a trajectory evaluator that conditions its assessment on visual observations, the executed action sequence, and the natural language instruction. The method uses a pre-trained vision-language model (VLM) in two stages: it first summarizes frame-to-frame visual transitions conditioned on the executed actions and then assesses the generated summary with respect to the instruction to produce a discrete trajectory-level progress score. In simulated 3D household environments, ALVA exhibits a conservative assessment pattern with near-zero false-positive rates. When used as terminal feedback for closed-loop policy optimization, it provides more effective feedback than the evaluated static image and embedding-based visual baselines and reduces the performance gap to a ground-truth oracle. These results support action- and language-conditioned video assessment as an interpretable feedback mechanism for the evaluated simulated embodied-control tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ALVA（Action- and Language-Conditioned Video Assessment），一种面向具身控制轨迹的评估器，将评估条件建立在视觉观测、已执行动作序列和自然语言指令上。方法分两阶段使用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）：先基于已执行动作对帧间视觉转换进行总结，再对照指令评估该总结，输出离散的轨迹级进度分数。在仿真 3D 家庭环境中，ALVA 呈保守评估模式，假阳性率接近零；作为闭环策略优化的终端反馈时，它比静态图像和基于嵌入的视觉基线提供更有效的反馈，并缩小了与真值 oracle 的性能差距。
Motivation: 执行多步自然语言指令的视觉具身智能体需要能对整个轨迹评估任务进度的反馈机制。基于最后一帧匹配或连续嵌入相似度的传统方法可能忽略决定指令是否完成的中间过渡。
Method: ALVA 是一个轨迹评估器，其评估同时以视觉观测、动作序列和语言指令为条件；它利用预训练 VLM 分两阶段工作：先在被执行动作的条件下总结帧间视觉转换，再依据指令评估该总结并产生离散的轨迹级进度分数。
Result: 在仿真 3D 家庭环境中，ALVA 表现出保守的评估模式，假阳性率接近零。作为闭环策略优化的终端反馈时，它比所评估的静态图像基线和基于嵌入的视觉基线更有效，并缩小了与真值 oracle 的性能差距。
Conclusion: 结果表明，动作与语言条件下的视频评估可作为一种可解释的反馈机制，适用于所评估的仿真具身控制任务。

papers.title: Learning under Opponent Unawareness in Linear-Quadratic Stochastic Games
papers.abstract_en: As firms increasingly deploy machine learning for strategic decision-making, understanding algorithmic interactions has become central to operations research and economics. This paper studies learning in infinite-horizon, nonzero-sum linear-quadratic stochastic games under a radically uncoupled information structure, where players are either unaware of opponents or strategically oblivious, observing only a common state and their own action history. Under this minimal information, we analyze an asynchronous decentralized learning process in which each player independently runs a single-agent $ε$-greedy iterated least-squares algorithm. We prove that, despite being unable to identify the system parameters, players' learning dynamics converge almost surely to the complete-information Nash equilibrium and characterize the convergence rate. We then apply the framework to a dynamic Cournot competition with sticky prices. Numerical experiments validate the theoretical results and show that learning under limited information reduces firm profits under both low and high price stickiness, while total surplus declines and market concentration increases when price stickiness is high. Publicly revealing aggregate market output substantially accelerates convergence and mitigates these welfare losses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无限时域、非零和线性二次随机博弈（linear-quadratic stochastic games）中的学习问题，假设一种激进的解耦信息结构：参与者对对手不知情或策略性无视，只能观测共同状态与自身动作历史。在此最小信息下，每个参与者独立运行单智能体的 ε-greedy 迭代最小二乘算法；作者证明即使无法识别系统参数，学习动力学仍几乎必然收敛到完全信息 Nash 均衡并给出收敛速率，并将框架应用于带价格粘性的动态古诺竞争。数值实验验证理论结果，并显示有限信息学习在低与高价格粘性下均降低企业利润，高粘性时总剩余下降且市场集中度上升，而公开披露总产出可显著加速收敛并缓解福利损失。
Motivation: 企业越来越多地使用机器学习进行战略决策，理解算法之间的交互已成为运筹学与经济学研究的核心问题。论文针对参与者完全不知晓对手、仅依赖共同状态和自身动作历史的激进解耦信息结构，考察在这种最小信息下分散式学习能否达到完整信息下的均衡。
Method: 提出异步去中心化学习过程，每个参与者独立执行单智能体的 ε-greedy 迭代最小二乘（iterated least-squares）算法；理论分析证明几乎必然收敛并刻画收敛速率，同时将框架应用于带价格粘性的动态古诺竞争并通过数值实验验证。
Result: 证明在无法辨识系统参数的情况下，玩家的学习动力学几乎必然收敛到完整信息 Nash 均衡，并刻画了收敛速率。数值实验显示，有限信息学习在低和高价格粘性下都降低企业利润；高价格粘性时总剩余下降且市场集中度上升，公开披露市场总产出则显著加速收敛并缓解福利损失。
Conclusion: 作者强调，即使在玩家互相不知情、仅凭自身动作历史学习的极端信息结构下，线性二次随机博弈中的学习仍可收敛到完整信息 Nash 均衡；同时公共信息（总产出）的披露有助于加速收敛并改善福利。该结论限定于线性二次设定与粘性价格古诺应用的范围内。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究无限时域、非零和线性二次随机博弈（linear-quadratic stochastic games）中的学习问题，假设一种激进的解耦信息结构：参与者对对手不知情或策略性无视，只能观测共同状态与自身动作历史。在此最小信息下，每个参与者独立运行单智能体的 ε-greedy 迭代最小二乘算法；作者证明即使无法识别系统参数，学习动力学仍几乎必然收敛到完全信息 Nash 均衡并给出收敛速率，并将框架应用于带价格粘性的动态古诺竞争。数值实验验证理论结果，并显示有限信息学习在低与高价格粘性下均降低企业利润，高粘性时总剩余下降且市场集中度上升，而公开披露总产出可显著加速收敛并缓解福利损失。

papers.title: On the Robustness of LLMs' Internal Representation of Code Correctness
papers.abstract_en: Code generated by modern language models often reads naturally. Yet, it also often fails to implement what was asked. This should be no surprise, as research shows the models' own confidence signals are poorly calibrated with actual correctness. A promising way to assess correctness looks inside the model: by contrasting the hidden states of correct and incorrect programs, recent work captured an internal signal of code correctness that is able to judge candidate solutions better than the model's token-level or stated confidence, with no test execution. However, this signal was captured under one particular way, leaving open an important question: whether it reflects a robust property of the model or an artifact of that choice. We study this question systematically, varying how the signal is extracted from the model internals. Besides this, we also ask if the signal's quality is limited by the data used to extract it, by constructing program pairs that differ only in the fault that makes them incorrect. Our results show that no single configuration is best, and that isolating the fault does not help.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究从大型语言模型内部隐藏状态中提取代码正确性信号（internal signal of code correctness）的稳健性。作者变化信号提取方式，并构造仅因故障不同而不同的程序对来检验用于提取信号的数据是否限制信号质量。结果表明没有单一配置最优，且隔离故障并不能帮助提升信号。
Motivation: 已有工作通过对比正确与不正确程序的隐藏状态，得到无需测试执行即可判断候选代码的内部正确性信号，但该信号可能只是某种特定提取方式下的产物，而非模型的稳健属性。
Method: 作者系统地变化从模型内部提取该信号的方式，并构造仅在导致错误的故障上有所不同的程序对（program pairs），以考察提取信号所用数据对信号质量的影响。
Result: 摘要报告的结果显示，不存在单一最优的提取配置，并且将故障隔离出来（isolating the fault）并不能提升内部正确性信号的质量。
Conclusion: 研究表明该内部正确性信号对提取配置敏感，不能视为模型的一种稳健性质；其适用范围是无需测试执行的代码正确性判断，且受限于所研究的提取方式和程序对构造。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Opportunity Is Not Realizability: Selection-Valid Diagnostics for Multi-LLM Routing
authors: Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan
papers.abstract_en: Oracle routing measures how much a pool of language models could gain from per-query selection, but the diagnostic has two flaws: testing against a best fixed model selected on the same examples invalidates paired inference, and a full-information oracle sees outcomes no deployable router observes. We separate three estimands (outcome-oracle opportunity, the Bayes-optimal gain from a declared pre-answer signal, and the held-out gain of a learned router) and prove selection-valid confidence intervals that survive choosing the best fixed model or the best member of a router family, a signal-information sandwich, and a $(1-1/e)$ greedy guarantee for building compact pools from submodular complementary coverage. On eight checkpoints from six families over four benchmarks, selection-valid intervals certify a population oracle gap of $9.7$--$30.7$ points on every task, yet the strongest deployable prompt router recovers only $7.5$--$14.4\%$ of it, and the simultaneous interval for the best of eleven tested policies has lower limit zero throughout. The realizable share of oracle opportunity is small and certifiable: strong routers beat the best fixed model, and most of the gap remains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出多 LLM 路由的 oracle 诊断存在两个缺陷：在相同样本上选出最佳固定模型再进行配对推断会失效，且全信息 oracle 看到了任何可部署路由器都观察不到的结果。作者区分了三个估计目标（outcome-oracle opportunity、给定决策前信号的 Bayes 最优增益、已学习路由器的留出增益），并证明了具有选择有效性（selection-valid）的置信区间，可承受对最佳固定模型或最佳路由器族的后验选择。在六个家族的八个 checkpoint、四个基准上，这些区间认证了 9.7–30.7 个百分点的总体 oracle 差距，但最强的可部署 prompt 路由器仅恢复其中的 7.5–14.4%，且对十一种测试策略中最佳者的联合区间下界为零。
Motivation: 现有 oracle routing 诊断夸大了按查询选择 LLM 可获得的潜在收益，因为基于同一样本选择的最佳固定模型破坏了配对推断，而全信息 oracle 又利用了部署时无法观测的结果。需要一种在选择模型或路由器族之后仍然有效的统计检验来诚实量化可实现的收益。
Method: 将估计目标拆分为 outcome-oracle opportunity、基于声明信号（pre-answer signal）的 Bayes 最优增益和已学习路由器的留出增益，并证明在选择最佳固定模型或路由器族后依然有效的选择有效置信区间；同时给出信号信息三明治（signal-information sandwich）以及基于次模互补覆盖（submodular complementary coverage）构建紧凑模型池的 (1-1/e) 贪心保证。
Result: 在八个来自六个家族的 checkpoint 和四个基准上，选择有效区间在所有任务上认证了 9.7–30.7 个百分点的总体 oracle 差距；最强的可部署 prompt 路由器仅恢复其中的 7.5–14.4%，而针对十一种测试策略中最佳者的联合置信区间下界为零。
Conclusion: 作者强调 oracle 机会中可实际实现（realizable）的份额很小且可被经验认证：强的路由器确实优于最佳固定模型，但大部分 oracle 差距仍然无法被可部署路由器捕获。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: OBLIVION: Workflow-Level Operational Skill Unlearning for Deployed Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents are becoming operational interfaces to files, memories, registries, and external tools. This deployment shift creates a new skill revocation problem: after a skill is removed from an explicit registry, an agent may still reconstruct it from residual carriers such as archives, transcripts, schemas, or memory entries. We study this problem as operational skill unlearning, where the goal is not parameter-level forgetting, but preventing a deployed agent from rebuilding a revoked skill through primitive tools. We introduce OBLIVION, a controlled benchmark and defense harness for revoked-skill resurrection. OBLIVION models each episode as a source-to-sink workflow, applies Cross-Surface Coherent Erasure to reduce residual carriers, and uses frozen workflow remediation near dangerous sinks. On the locked 88 attack episodes, the no-defense arm reaches formal attack success rate 1.0. OBLIVION reduces the rate to 0.114 and impact-weighted exposure to 0.115 while keeping locked utility at 1.0 and benign block rate at 0. In a separate skill-attack-derived sandbox, OBLIVION reduces attack success from 1.0 to 0.2 and impact-weighted exposure from 1.0 to 0.213 while preserving all utility controls. These results support workflow-level evaluation beyond checking explicit skill entries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型智能体在技能被撤销后仍可能通过归档、日志、模式或记忆等残余载体重建该技能的问题，将其定义为操作性技能遗忘 (operational skill unlearning)，并提出 OBLIVION 基准与防御框架。OBLIVION 将每个攻击场景建模为从源到汇的工作流，采用跨表面一致性擦除 (Cross-Surface Coherent Erasure) 减少残余载体，并在危险汇点附近使用冻结工作流修复。在 88 个锁定攻击场景上，无防御基线攻击成功率为 1.0，OBLIVION 将其降至 0.114，影响加权暴露降至 0.115，同时保持锁定效用 1.0 与良性阻断率 0。
Motivation: 智能体正成为文件、内存、注册表和外部工具的操作接口，技能从显式注册表中删除后，智能体仍可从残余载体重建该技能，现有方法只关注参数级遗忘，未解决部署后通过原始工具重建已撤销技能的问题。
Method: 提出 OBLIVION，一个针对已撤销技能复活的受控基准与防御框架；每个场景建模为 source-to-sink 工作流，使用跨表面一致性擦除降低残余载体，并在危险汇点附近使用冻结工作流修复 (frozen workflow remediation) 阻止技能重建。
Result: 在 88 个锁定攻击场景中，无防御攻击成功率为 1.0，OBLIVION 将其降至 0.114，影响加权暴露降至 0.115，锁定效用保持 1.0，良性阻断率为 0；在另一个源自技能攻击的沙盒中，攻击成功率从 1.0 降至 0.2，影响加权暴露从 1.0 降至 0.213，且保持了所有效用控制。
Conclusion: 结果表明，技能撤销评估应超越显式技能条目检查，采用工作流级评估；OBLIVION 在防御技能复活的同时不损害正常效用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning from Environmental Feedback: Credit Assignment across Multiple Timescales for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) often suffers from delayed and sparse rewards in real-world environments. A promising solution to this challenge is credit assignment, which aims to decompose trajectory-level rewards and provide more fine-grained supervision for intermediate decisions. However, existing credit assignment approaches ignore the rich process information naturally generated during environment interaction, e.g., interaction history. We argue that such information provides valuable supervision for identifying the contribution of individual actions. To this end, we propose Environmental Feedback-based Credit Assignment (EFCA), a multi-timescale credit assignment approach for long-horizon agentic RL. EFCA complements the long-term outcome signal with two environment-grounded process signals: a short-term feedback signal that captures the immediate effect of the current action and a medium-term state-history signal that identifies ineffective patterns from recent interactions. Both signals are directly extracted from environment feedback and integrated through a return reweighting mechanism. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate that EFCA consistently improves both task success and task quality over strong baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of environment-grounded multi-timescale credit assignment for long-horizon agentic RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 agentic RL 中延迟且稀疏的奖励问题，提出基于环境反馈的信用分配方法 EFCA（Environmental Feedback-based Credit Assignment）。EFCA 在长期结果信号之外补充两种环境接地过程信号：捕捉当前动作即时效应的短期反馈信号，以及识别近期交互中无效模式的中间层状态历史信号，并通过返回重新加权机制整合。在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上的实验显示，该方法相较强基线持续提升任务成功率和任务质量。
Motivation: 现实环境中的 agentic RL 常因延迟和稀疏奖励而难以训练，现有信用分配方法将轨迹级奖励分解时忽略了环境交互过程中自然产生的丰富过程信息（如交互历史），而这些信息有助于判断单个动作的贡献。
Method: 提出 EFCA，一种面向长时程 agentic RL 的多时间尺度信用分配方法；它用短期环境反馈信号和中间层状态历史信号补充长期结果信号，两者直接从环境反馈中提取，并通过返回重新加权机制（return reweighting）整合。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上的实验表明，EFCA 在任务成功率和任务质量两个维度上均持续优于强基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，环境接地的多时间尺度信用分配对长时程 agentic RL 是有效的，展示了利用环境反馈信号改进信用分配的价值。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，环境接地的多时间尺度信用分配对长时程 agentic RL 是有效的，展示了利用环境反馈信号改进信用分配的价值。

papers.title: Your Prompt Is Not the Only Prompt: How Much Do LLMs Weight Structured-Output Schema Descriptions?
papers.abstract_en: Structured output, where an LLM populates a predefined JSON schema, has become a default mechanism for data labeling and information extraction, but it also introduces a second instruction channel through schema descriptions. We tested whether classification-label definitions are better placed in the system prompt, user prompt, or schema description using a single-field classification task with nonce labels across ten model configurations from two vendors. Schema descriptions did not consistently outperform prompt-based placement; for GPT-4.1 and GPT-5.4 without reasoning, schema placement underperformed system prompts by 11-13 percentage points. Yet schemas are not inert metadata: when prompts and schemas conflicted, incorrect schema instructions caused accuracy drops of 5-45 points, with Claude Haiku 4.5 falling from 52.5% to 7%, indicating that schema instructions can override prompt instructions, and GPT-5.5 falling from 100% to 73%. Further, adding a required intermediate reasoning field before the label field improved schema-only accuracy by 15-24 points when headroom existed, exceeding system-prompt-only performance in every case tested. The effect held even for Claude Sonnet 4.6 at medium reasoning, where extended thinking alone did not produce a comparable gain. This suggests that schema design can affect how effectively models use information encoded in field descriptions. Overall, these results indicate that schema influence is model-dependent. In practice, the system prompt remains a safe default for definitions, but the bigger discipline is maintaining a single source of truth and preventing prompt/schema drift. More importantly, schema design itself may be a stronger lever than instruction placement. Practitioners should treat prompts and schemas as a unified instruction surface and empirically validate both placement and field design for their target model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究结构化输出场景下分类标签定义放在系统提示（system prompt）、用户提示（user prompt）还是 schema 描述中对 LLM 分类准确率的影响，使用非ce标签（nonce labels）的单字段分类任务，覆盖两家厂商的十种模型配置。结果显示 schema 放置并不稳定优于提示词放置：在未开启推理的 GPT-4.1 和 GPT-5.4 上，schema 放置比 system prompt 低 11-13 个百分点；但当提示与 schema 冲突时，错误的 schema 指令可造成 5-45 个百分点的准确率下降，说明 schema 指令能覆盖提示指令。在标签字段前加入必需的中间推理字段可在存在余量时将 schema-only 准确率提升 15-24 个百分点，并在所有测试场景中超过仅用 system prompt 的表现。作者认为 schema 的影响具有模型依赖性，应把提示与 schema 视为统一的指令面。
Motivation: 结构化输出已成为数据标注和信息抽取的默认机制，schema 描述由此构成第二条指令通道；但标签定义放在 system prompt、user prompt 还是 schema 描述中效果更优尚不清楚，这关系到提示词与 schema 的一致性和模型实际服从哪条指令。
Method: 采用单字段分类任务和非ce标签，在两家厂商的十种模型配置上系统比较标签定义放在 system prompt、user prompt 与 schema description 三种位置的效果；进一步构造提示与 schema 冲突的场景，并测试在标签字段前增加必需中间推理字段的变体。
Result: GPT-4.1 和 GPT-5.4（无推理）的 schema 放置比 system prompt 低 11-13 个百分点；冲突时错误 schema 指令使准确率下降 5-45 个百分点，其中 Claude Haiku 4.5 从 52.5% 降至 7%，GPT-5.5 从 100% 降至 73%。增加中间推理字段后，schema-only 准确率在有提升余量的情况下提高 15-24 个百分点，且每次测试都超过仅用 system prompt 的效果；该效应在 Claude Sonnet 4.6 中等推理强度下依然成立，而单独扩展思考并未产生同等提升。
Conclusion: schema 的影响高度依赖模型；实践上 system prompt 仍是定义标签的安全默认位置，但更重要的是维护单一事实来源、防止提示与 schema 漂移。作者强调 schema 设计本身可能是比指令放置更强的杠杆，从业者应把提示和 schema 当作统一指令面，并针对目标模型实证验证放置方式与字段设计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SuperLocalMemory 4.0: The Governed Memory Operating System for AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are becoming shared infrastructure, yet durable memory is commonly assembled from separate retrieval, governance, and operational components. We present SuperLocalMemory 4.0, a governed, local-first memory operating system for AI agents. The system combines dense semantic, BM25 lexical, temporal, Hopfield-associative, and spreading-activation retrieval through reciprocal-rank fusion; a governed learning and behaviour layer; bi-temporal recall; multi-scope personal, shared, and global memory; role-based access control; GDPR-oriented export and verified erasure; audit trails; and a deployment-context EU AI Act checklist. V4 introduces a reliability spine for its primary write path: generation-fenced admission, a policy registry, verifiable memory transactions with per-projection apply, verify, compensate, and erase owners, and hash-checkable completion manifests. The runtime is available through CLI, MCP, an HTTP daemon, a dashboard, editor integration, and framework adapters, and supports fully local, local-with-on-device-model, and provider-assisted modes. We evaluate eleven fault-injection and mechanism scenarios, each repeated 200 times. The released evidence bundle reports 2,200 of 2,200 deterministic repetitions upholding their scoped component properties. The governed write envelope measured 3.522 ms at p50 and 5.297 ms at p99, versus 1.835 ms and 2.569 ms for the ungoverned baseline, corresponding to in-process control-plane overheads of 1.687 ms at p50 and 2.728 ms at p99. These are scoped component and mechanism measurements, not an end-to-end multi-process or external retrieval-accuracy benchmark. The paper consolidates prior SuperLocalMemory work on privacy-preserving multi-agent memory, information-geometric retrieval, and the V3.3 Living Brain lifecycle.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 17 figures, 4 tables. Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21853302. Code: https://github.com/qualixar/superlocalmemory/releases/tag/v4.0.0
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SuperLocalMemory 4.0，一个受治理的、本地优先的 AI 智能体记忆操作系统，将密集语义、BM25 词法、时间、Hopfield 联想和激活扩散检索通过互逆排名融合 (reciprocal-rank fusion) 结合起来，并加入治理层、双时态召回、多范围记忆、RBAC、GDPR 导出与擦除、审计追踪及 EU AI Act 检查清单。V4 新增主写入路径的可靠性骨架，包括生成围栏准入、策略注册表、可验证记忆事务和哈希可校验的完成清单。评估报告称 11 个故障注入与机制场景各重复 200 次，共 2,200/2,200 次确定性重复均维持其限定组件属性；受治理写入包络线 p50 为 3.522 ms、p99 为 5.297 ms，而未治理基线为 1.835 ms 和 2.569 ms，作者强调这是组件级而非端到端基准。
Motivation: AI 智能体正成为共享基础设施，但持久记忆通常由相互分离的检索、治理和运维组件拼装而成，缺少一个集成的受治理记忆操作系统。
Method: 系统组合多种检索策略与统一融合，并构建治理学习和行为层、双时态召回、多范围个人/共享/全局记忆、角色访问控制、GDPR 导向的导出和可验证擦除、审计追踪以及 EU AI Act 检查清单；V4 的可靠性骨架包括生成围栏准入、策略注册表、带逐投影 apply/verify/compensate/erase 所有者的可验证记忆事务、哈希可校验完成清单。运行时支持 CLI、MCP、HTTP daemon、仪表盘、编辑器集成和框架适配器，并提供完全本地、本地加设备端模型及提供商辅助三种模式。
Result: 摘要报告 2,200/2,200 次确定性重复均满足其限定组件属性；受治理写入包络线在 p50 和 p99 分别为 3.522 ms 和 5.297 ms，对应进程内控制面开销为 p50 1.687 ms、p99 2.728 ms。
Conclusion: 作者将这些测量限定为组件与机制层面的验证，而非端到端多进程或外部检索准确性基准；论文同时整合了此前 SuperLocalMemory 在隐私保护多智能体记忆、信息几何检索和 V3.3 Living Brain 生命周期上的工作。

papers.title: Conditional Distribution Estimation for Functional Responses with Random Forests
papers.abstract_en: Many functional data analyses reduce random functions to scalar summaries or conditional mean curves. This is limiting when we wish to understand how covariates affect the distribution of entire functional responses, including their shape, timing, or variability. We study the problem of estimating conditional laws of functional outcomes and show that these objects can be estimated and evaluated in a practical nonparametric framework. To do this, we introduce functional distributional random forests, which estimate each conditional law as a covariate-dependent distribution over sampled functions by training a random forest to minimize a kernel-based maximum mean discrepancy within the leaf nodes of the decision tree. This supports inference on arbitrary functionals of the conditional distribution while keeping predictive samples tied to realistic curves. We consider a variety of kernels defined on function spaces, including Sobolev and operator-induced kernels. We also provide conditions for consistency of our estimator and develop scoring rules for comparing it to baseline estimators. In simulations, our method recovers distributional changes that are missed by baseline methods. In an application to NHANES accelerometer data, it identifies interesting covariate-associated changes in both median activity profiles and predictive dispersion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究函数型响应（functional responses）的条件分布估计问题，提出函数型分布随机森林（functional distributional random forests）：在决策树叶节点内以基于核的最大均值差异（maximum mean discrepancy, MMD）为目标训练随机森林，把每个条件律估计为协变量依赖的函数样本分布。摘要报告了估计量的一致性条件、用于比较基线估计器的评分规则，并在模拟和NHANES加速度计数据应用中显示其能捕获基线方法遗漏的分布变化。
Motivation: 许多函数型数据分析把随机函数简化为标量摘要或条件均值曲线，无法刻画协变量如何影响整个函数响应的分布（包括形状、时点或变异性）。该工作针对这一缺口，研究如何在实用的非参数框架中估计函数型结果的条件律。
Method: 提出函数型分布随机森林，通过最小化叶节点内的核化最大均值差异来训练随机森林，从而把每个条件律表示为依赖于协变量的分布；考虑定义在函数空间上的多种核，包括 Sobolev 核和算子诱导核（operator-induced kernels），并给出估计量的一致性条件。
Result: 在模拟中，该方法能够恢复基线方法遗漏的分布变化；在 NHANES 加速度计数据应用中，识别出与协变量相关的中位活动曲线以及预测离散度（predictive dispersion）的变化。
Conclusion: 该框架支持对条件分布的任意泛函进行推断，同时使预测样本保持与真实曲线相符；摘要还强调了一致性条件与评分规则，可用于与基线估计器进行比较。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Data Drift Detection and Recovery for Large-Scale LLM Applications via Proxy Representations
papers.abstract_en: LLM applications deployed at scale face a fundamental challenge: privacy constraints prevent direct inspection of user interactions, making it difficult to obtain any representative evaluation dataset or to track the ongoing evolution of production traffic. We present ProxyDrift, a framework that (i) identifies and measures drift between production traffic and offline evaluation sets, and (ii) constructs and refreshes those evaluation sets accordingly; all without access to raw user data. Our approach operates entirely on non-PII proxy representations: structured, multi-dimensional descriptors derived from LLM-based classification of user interactions. We introduce (1) a chance-calibrated, redundancy-aware (RA) alignment score that aggregates per-dimension drift measurements via mutual information; (2) a conditional sampler that generates synthetic proxies respecting inter-dimensional dependencies; (3) a roundtrip consistency analysis that exposes generator/classifier disagreements and guides proxy taxonomy refinement; and (4) a feedback-linkage analysis that ties per-dimension and per-value proxy distributions to user satisfaction, surfacing actionable failure and success modes. Serving hundreds of millions of users, ProxyDrift enables continuous drift monitoring and targeted synthetic data generation without exposing sensitive user data. Experiments confirm strong roundtrip consistency, discriminator-level indistinguishability of synthetic queries from human queries, and tight end-to-end alignment (RA~0.9) with production.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProxyDrift，一个面向大规模 LLM 应用、在不访问原始用户数据的前提下进行数据漂移检测与评估集恢复的框架。其核心思想是完全基于非 PII 的代理表示（proxy representations）——即由 LLM 对用户交互进行分类得到的结构化多维描述符——来度量生产流量与离线评估集之间的漂移，并据此构建和刷新评估集。框架引入了基于互信息的冗余感知对齐分数、考虑维度间依赖的条件采样器、往返一致性分析以及反馈关联分析。该系统已在数亿用户规模上部署，实验显示合成查询与人类查询在判别器层面不可区分，端到端对齐分数 RA 约 0.9。
Motivation: 大规模部署的 LLM 应用面临隐私约束，无法直接检查用户交互，这使得获取代表性评估数据集以及跟踪生产流量的持续演化变得非常困难。
Method: 框架完全运行在非 PII 的代理表示上，包含四部分：(1) 机会校准且冗余感知（redundancy-aware, RA）的对齐分数，通过互信息聚合各维度的漂移测量；(2) 条件采样器，生成尊重维度间依赖的合成代理数据；(3) 往返一致性分析，暴露生成器与分类器之间的不一致并指导代理分类体系（proxy taxonomy）改进；(4) 反馈关联分析，将各维度和各取值的代理分布与用户满意度关联，以发现可操作的失败与成功模式。
Result: 摘要报告该系统已服务于数亿用户，实验确认了强往返一致性、合成查询与人类查询在判别器级别的不可区分性，以及端到端对齐分数 RA 约 0.9。

papers.title: FemWear: A Specialized Wearable Foundation Model for Women's Health
papers.abstract_en: General wearable foundation models are pretrained across broad sensor streams and populations, but are not designed around women's-health tasks. We introduce FemWear, a specialized wearable foundation model that parameter-efficiently repurposes a pretrained multimodal wearable backbone. FemWear retains the patch projection and Transformer encoder, training 239,236 parameters (1.11% of a 21.54M-parameter encoder) through low-rank residual adapters and causal task-family heads. It learns one shared longitudinal representation for menstrual, symptom, affective, sleep/recovery, autonomic, activity, and pregnancy-related outcomes. We evaluate six cohorts with 63 comparable primary metrics, including 33 from women's-health cohorts, while retaining the 32-task OpenMHC ability-retention benchmark. On a fixed participant split over three seeds, FemWear improved cycle-phase macro-F1 by 8.15% and reduced mean absolute error for cramps, mood symptoms, and sleep problems by 9.32%, 5.80%, and 9.43%, respectively. In a stricter 42-participant nested leave-one-participant-out audit, 24-hour onset, 72-hour onset, and cramps retained positive changes of 2.87%, 6.35%, and 2.19%; phase, mood, and sleep were neutral or negative, and no endpoint had a strictly positive corrected confidence interval. Capacity-matched experiments outperformed a latest-day multilayer perceptron but not shared-GRU or multi-gate mixture-of-experts baselines. Train-only calibration reduced onset expected calibration error by 84.2--88.2% with zero temporal-nesting violations. FemWear enables targeted transfer and coherent probability outputs for women's-health research, but does not establish universal performance dominance or clinical validity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FemWear 是一个面向女性健康的专用可穿戴基础模型，通过低秩残差适配器和因果任务族头对预训练的多模态可穿戴骨干进行参数高效微调，仅训练 239,236 个参数（占 21.54M 编码器的 1.11%），并学习月经、症状、情感、睡眠/恢复、自主神经、活动和妊娠相关结局的共享纵向表示。在六个队列、63 项可比主要指标上评估，固定参与者划分下周期阶段 macro-F1 提升 8.15%，若干症状误差下降；但在更严格的嵌套留一参与者审计中仅部分终点保留正向变化。模型支持定向迁移和连贯概率输出，但摘要明确表示未建立普遍性能优势或临床有效性。
Motivation: 通用可穿戴基础模型在广泛传感器流和人群上预训练，但并非围绕女性健康任务设计，缺乏针对月经、症状、情感、睡眠/恢复、自主神经、活动和妊娠相关结局的专门建模能力。
Method: FemWear 保留预训练多模态可穿戴骨干的补丁投影与 Transformer 编码器，通过低秩残差适配器（low-rank residual adapters）和因果任务族头（causal task-family heads）训练少量参数，学习单一共享的纵向表示以支持多种女性健康相关结局。评估采用固定参与者划分（三颗种子）以及更严格的 42 参与者嵌套留一参与者外（nested leave-one-participant-out）审计，并包含容量匹配基线与仅训练校准。
Result: 固定参与者划分下，周期阶段 macro-F1 提升 8.15%，抽筋、情绪症状和睡眠问题的平均绝对误差分别降低 9.32%、5.80%、9.43%。在 42 参与者嵌套留一审计中，24 小时发作、72 小时发作和抽筋保留正向变化 2.87%、6.35%、2.19%，但阶段、情绪和睡眠为中性或负，且无终点具有严格正向校正置信区间。容量匹配实验优于最新日多层感知器，但未优于共享 GRU 或多门控混合专家基线；仅训练校准将发作期望校准误差降低 84.2–88.2% 且零时间嵌套违规。
Conclusion: FemWear 能够为女性健康研究提供定向迁移和连贯的概率输出，但摘要强调其并未确立普遍性能优势或临床有效性，在严格外推审计下部分终点表现中性或负面。

papers.title: A Fair Objective for Human-Empowerment-Preserving AI: Desiderata, Design, and Likely Behavioral Consequences
papers.abstract_en: This paper explores the idea of promoting well-being and safety in human-AI interactions by forcing AI agents explicitly to empower humans and to manage the power balance between humans and AI agents in a desirable way. Using a principled, partially axiomatic approach based on desirable properties, we design a parametrizable and decomposable objective function for AI systems that represents an inequality- and risk-averse long-term aggregate of human power. It can take into account models of human bounded rationality and social norms, and crucially, considers a wide variety of possible human goals. We prove how certain desiderata enforce particular functional forms and restrict parameter ranges. We exemplify the consequences of softly maximizing this metric in several paradigmatic situations and describe what instrumental sub-goals it will likely imply.
papers.comment: Slightly extended version of paper accepted for Algorithmic Decision Theory 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从公理化视角为人类-AI 交互设计一个显式赋予人类权力并管理权力平衡的目标函数。作者提出一个可参数化、可分解的长期人类权力聚合指标，纳入不平等厌恶、风险厌恶、人类有限理性与社会规范，并考虑多种可能的人类目标。摘要报告证明特定 desiderata 会强制某些函数形式并限制参数范围，并通过若干范式情境展示软最大化该指标的后果与可能产生的工具性子目标。
Motivation: 现有 AI 系统常将人类福祉与安全作为软约束或外部奖励，缺乏明确、可操作的目标来衡量 AI 是否在赋予人类权力。本文试图通过设计一个基于理想性质（desirable properties）的公理化目标函数，系统解决如何在人机交互中显式衡量与管理权力平衡的问题。
Method: 采用部分公理化的方法，从一组期望性质出发推导目标函数的形式，提出一个可参数化、可分解的长期人类权力聚合函数。该函数可整合人类有限理性模型、社会规范以及广泛的人类目标设定，并通过证明性质与函数形式之间的对应关系来约束参数范围。
Result: 摘要中的主要理论结果是若干 desiderata 会强制特定的函数形式并限定参数范围；另外，通过在几种范式情境中软最大化该指标，作者描述了其可能隐含的工具性子目标（instrumental sub-goals）及其行为后果。
Conclusion: 论文认为这种以人类赋权为核心、同时考虑不平等与风险的目标函数是促进人类福祉与安全的一种有前景方向，但其行为后果取决于参数选择与情境，且实际影响仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: The Replay Gap: Static Evaluation of Model Switching in LLM Agents Scores the Wrong World
papers.abstract_en: LLM routers promise efficiency by matching each request to the cheapest adequate model, and are increasingly applied per step inside multi-step agents. Yet agentic routers are evaluated like single-turn routers: by replaying logged trajectories and substituting another model's recorded outputs, assuming the rest of the trajectory is unaffected. We test this assumption with branching rollouts: we fork live SWE-bench agent trajectories at controlled points, rebuild the environment, continue each fork with a different model, and compare against same-model control forks that isolate sampling and replay noise. Across six paired runs (~900 rollouts), swaps exceed their matched control floors by +0.25 to +0.66 normalized edit distance (multiplicity-corrected CIs exclude zero), rewriting 61-94% of post-fork actions; 74-77% of early swaps diverge at the first post-fork action, versus 6-35% of controls, leaving only 3% of replayed states valid. Divergence decreases with fork depth in both directions. All five outcome flips we observe occur in swap arms, upgrades rescuing unsolved instances and a downgrade losing the sole solve, and zero occur across 359 control forks. Scoring these same swaps with a log-stitching replay evaluator, replay mispredicts every success-relevant outcome call and predicts patches with 0.00-0.11 similarity to reality. Auditing the noise floor, temperature-0 "determinism" is configuration-dependent: FP8-served controls diverge on over 90% of forks while AWQ-served ones remain near-identical; and under tight budgets the stronger model more often exhausts its steps without submitting. Replay-based benchmarks score the wrong world for agentic routing; we release our harness and all trajectories.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling 2026. Code: https://github.com/AshrithaG/replay-gap Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ashritha0907/replay-gap-trajectories
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文检验多步 LLM agent 中模型路由 (LLM routing) 的评估方式：当前做法像评估单轮路由一样，通过在已记录轨迹上回放 (replay)，用另一模型的输出替换原输出，并假设轨迹其余部分不受影响。作者用分支式 rollout (branching rollouts) 在受控点分叉 SWE-bench 的实时 agent 轨迹、重建环境并以不同模型继续，同时设置同模型对照组隔离采样与回放噪声。结果显示模型替换会大幅改写后续动作、在早期分叉时几乎必然立即发散，且所有结果翻转都只出现在替换组中，说明基于回放的评估测错了世界。
Motivation: LLM router 通过为每个请求匹配合适的模型来提升效率，并越来越多地被用于多步 agent 的每一步；然而这类 agentic router 仍按单轮 router 的方式评估，即回放已记录轨迹并替换另一模型的输出，默认轨迹其余部分不受影响。作者要检验这个默认假设是否成立。
Method: 提出分支式 rollout 评估框架：在受控位置分叉实时的 SWE-bench agent 轨迹，重建环境并用不同模型继续每个分叉，再与同模型的控制分叉比较，从而隔离采样噪声和回放噪声。此外还审计了温度 0 的确定性是否依赖服务配置（FP8 与 AWQ），以及预算约束下强模型的行为。
Result: 在六组配对运行约 900 次 rollout 中，模型替换组比匹配的控制底线高出 +0.25 到 +0.66 的归一化编辑距离（多重性校正的置信区间不含零），并重写了 61–94% 的分叉后动作；74–77% 的早期替换在第一个分叉后动作即发散，而对照组只有 6–35%，最终仅 3% 的回放状态有效。发散程度随分叉深度增加而降低；观察到的五次结果翻转全部发生在替换组（升级挽救未解决实例，降级丢失唯一解），359 个控制分叉中没有一次翻转。用 log-stitching 回放评估器对同样的替换打分时，回放错误预测了所有与成功相关的调用，预测补丁与真实补丁相似度仅 0.00–0.11。噪声底限审计显示，FP8 服务的控制分叉在超过 90% 的分叉中发散，而 AWQ 服务的几乎保持一致；紧预算下较强的模型更常耗尽步骤而无法提交。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于回放的基准对 agentic routing 测错了世界，并开源了评估框架与全部轨迹数据。

summary_sections.result: 在六组配对运行约 900 次 rollout 中，模型替换组比匹配的控制底线高出 +0.25 到 +0.66 的归一化编辑距离（多重性校正的置信区间不含零），并重写了 61–94% 的分叉后动作；74–77% 的早期替换在第一个分叉后动作即发散，而对照组只有 6–35%，最终仅 3% 的回放状态有效。发散程度随分叉深度增加而降低；观察到的五次结果翻转全部发生在替换组（升级挽救未解决实例，降级丢失唯一解），359 个控制分叉中没有一次翻转。用 log-stitching 回放评估器对同样的替换打分时，回放错误预测了所有与成功相关的调用，预测补丁与真实补丁相似度仅 0.00–0.11。噪声底限审计显示，FP8 服务的控制分叉在超过 90% 的分叉中发散，而 AWQ 服务的几乎保持一致；紧预算下较强的模型更常耗尽步骤而无法提交。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为基于回放的基准对 agentic routing 测错了世界，并开源了评估框架与全部轨迹数据。

papers.title: SAGE: SLO-Aware Adaptive Retrieval for Production RAG Systems
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems in production operate under strict service level objectives (SLOs) on tail latency and infrastructure cost. However, standard retrieval pipelines rely on fixed retrieval budgets that ignore query difficulty, over-retrieving for easy queries and under-serving hard ones, forcing operators to trade answer quality against SLO compliance. This paper proposes SAGE, a learned SLO-aware adaptive retrieval policy that dynamically selects the number of passages k per query. SAGE uses lightweight features derived from initial retrieval (e.g., score distributions, rank gaps, lexical signals) and is trained offline via imitation learning from an oracle that approximates optimal latency-quality trade-offs. At inference, it adds no LLM calls and minimal overhead. On Natural Questions, under a 5s P95 latency SLO, SAGE achieves 95% SLO compliance versus 30% for the best static baseline (k=20), reduces P95 latency by 36% and retrieval cost by 51% with only 2 percentage points Exact Match (EM) loss. A single policy trained on Natural Questions generalizes across HotpotQA, UnSeenTimeQA, and four LLM families (Llama, Qwen, Mistral, Gemma), consistently yielding +45-52 point SLO improvements without quality degradation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAGE，一种面向生产环境 RAG 系统的 SLO 感知自适应检索策略，按查询难度动态选择检索段落数 k。该方法利用初始检索得到的轻量特征（分数分布、排名间隙、词汇信号），并离线通过模仿学习从近似最优延迟-质量权衡的 oracle 中训练。在 Natural Questions 上，5 秒 P95 延迟 SLO 下 SAGE 达到 95% 的 SLO 合规率，而最佳静态基线（k=20）仅为 30%，同时 P95 延迟降低 36%、检索成本降低 51%，EM 仅损失 2 个百分点。
Motivation: 标准 RAG 检索管线使用固定检索预算，忽略查询难度差异，导致简单查询过度检索、困难查询检索不足，迫使运维人员在答案质量与 SLO 合规之间进行取舍。
Method: SAGE 是一个学习型 SLO 感知自适应检索策略，基于初始检索的轻量特征（如分数分布、排名间隙、词汇信号）训练，采用离线模仿学习从近似最优延迟-质量权衡的 oracle 中学习，推理时为每个查询动态选择段落数 k，不增加 LLM 调用且开销极小。
Result: 在 Natural Questions 上、5s P95 延迟 SLO 约束下，SAGE 实现 95% 的 SLO 合规率（静态 k=20 基线为 30%），P95 延迟降低 36%，检索成本降低 51%，EM 仅下降 2 个百分点；单一策略可泛化到 HotpotQA、UnSeenTimeQA 以及四个 LLM 家族（Llama、Qwen、Mistral、Gemma），持续带来 +45-52 个百分点的 SLO 改进且无质量下降。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 SLO 感知的自适应检索可以在几乎不损失答案质量的前提下显著改善生产 RAG 系统的延迟与成本合规性，并且所学策略具有跨数据集和跨 LLM 家族的泛化能力。

papers.title: LatticeMind: A Conflict-Aware Memory Primitive for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems often fail not for lack of candidate answers, but because they have no persistent mechanism for deciding which incompatible claim should currently be trusted. Majority vote, debate, and judge-based selection choose an output without recording which claim wins, which is contested, or why a later update supersedes it. We present \term{LatticeMind}, a conflict-aware structured memory that handles contradiction at write time. It maintains explicit item status, applies cheap symbolic conflict checks, and invokes LLM reconciliation only for unresolved semantic cases. On a label-blind ConflictBank evaluation that removes source-name hints, LatticeMind reaches 0.97 accuracy versus 0.61 for the strongest aggregation baseline, with the gap significant at $p<10^{-6}$ by paired McNemar test. Ablations show that removing the checker or the reconciler costs 12 to 14 points. On four secondary planning benchmarks the picture is mixed: LatticeMind beats naive merge on three of four, but does not replace deliberation methods on tasks rewarding iterative search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LatticeMind，一种面向多智能体 LLM 系统的冲突感知结构化记忆原语，在写入时即处理矛盾。它维护显式 item 状态、执行廉价符号冲突检查，并仅对未解决的语义情况调用 LLM 调和（reconciliation）。在去除来源名称提示的 label-blind ConflictBank 评估上达到 0.97 准确率，而最强聚合基线为 0.61；消融实验显示移除 checker 或 reconciler 会损失 12 到 14 个点。在四个次要规划基准上表现不一：三个优于 naive merge，但并未取代奖励迭代搜索的 deliberation 方法。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统常常不是因缺少候选答案而失败，而是缺乏持续性机制来决定当前应信任哪个互不兼容的声明。多数投票、辩论和 judge 式选择在给出输出时，并未记录哪一方获胜、哪一方存在争议、以及后续更新为何取代先前结果。
Method: LatticeMind 在写入时处理矛盾：维护每个条目的显式状态（item status），对新增信息执行低成本的符号冲突检查（symbolic conflict checks），并且只在符号检查无法解决的语义冲突上才调用 LLM 调和（LLM reconciliation）。
Result: 在去除来源名称提示的 label-blind ConflictBank 评测中，LatticeMind 达到 0.97 准确率，显著高于最强聚合基线的 0.61（配对 McNemar 检验 p<10^-6）。消融显示移除冲突检查器或调和器分别造成 12 到 14 个点的下降。在四个次要规划基准上，LatticeMind 在三个上优于 naive merge，但在奖励迭代搜索的任务上并未取代 deliberation 方法。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 LatticeMind 作为一种写入时冲突感知的记忆机制，能显著提升多智能体系统中冲突声明的聚合可靠性，但在需要迭代搜索的规划任务上仍不能替代专门的 deliberation 方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: High-Capacity Generalized Hopfield Networks
papers.abstract_en: Generalized Hopfield networks are introduced where memories and neurons are continuous variables that lie on a Riemannian manifold. We explicitly focus on symmetric spaces associated with the special unitary groups SU(d), and use both numerical and analytical (replica) techniques to demonstrate an almost order of magnitude enhancement in critical capacity over the vector networks starting with d=3 and further rapidly growing with d. To circumvent the non-linear geometric constraints, we use a Lie algebraic method [following V. Galitski, Phys. Rev. A 84, 012118 (2011)] to exactly describe the classical neural network in terms of linear algebra in an auxiliary Hilbert space. It is shown that in contrast to the traditional Hopfield networks, memory recall in SU(d) Hopfields corresponds to neuron alignment along a top eigenvector of a spiked matrix, which is less susceptible to random matrix crosstalk than other models with continuous neuron variables. Physical platforms to realize SU(d) Hopfields are briefly discussed and physical (in addition to algorithmic) recall mechanism is demonstrated, where memory recovery occurs naturally through generalized Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert dynamics. To illustrate SU(3) memory recall, we introduce a color (RGB) image encoding/decoding protocol and explicitly run image recovery on corrupted cues. Finally, we quantize the generalized Hopfields which are shown to reduce to Sachdev-Ye glassy type of models. Their many-body spectra generally feature two types of dark and memory bands, where the latter exhibits chaotic Wigner-Dyson level statistics that hides Hebbian data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一类广义 Hopfield 网络（generalized Hopfield networks），其中记忆和神经元为黎曼流形上的连续变量，并重点研究特殊酉群 SU(d) 对应的对称空间。作者结合数值与解析（replica）方法证明，在 d=3 时临界容量相比向量网络提升近一个数量级，且随 d 进一步快速增长。文中还引入李代数方法将网络精确映射为辅助希尔伯特空间中的线性代数问题，并演示了基于广义 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 动力学的物理回忆机制以及 SU(3) 的 RGB 图像编码/解码恢复。
Motivation: 传统 Hopfield 网络及其连续神经元变体受随机矩阵串扰（random matrix crosstalk）影响，记忆容量受限；作者希望在保留连续变量的同时，通过几何约束与对称空间结构实现更高的临界容量和更鲁棒的回忆。
Method: 采用李代数方法（参照 V. Galitski, PRA 84, 012118 (2011)）将 SU(d) 对称空间上的非线性几何约束转化为辅助希尔伯特空间中的线性代数描述；使用 replica 技巧分析容量；用 spiked matrix 的 top eigenvector 对齐刻画回忆，并通过广义 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 动力学实现物理层面的记忆恢复；最后对网络进行量子化，得到 Sachdev-Ye 玻璃模型类型的谱结构。
Result: 摘要报告 SU(d) Hopfield 网络在 d=3 时临界容量比向量网络增强近一个数量级，并随 d 快速增长；其回忆机制对应神经元沿 spiked matrix 的 top eigenvector 对齐，比其它连续神经元模型更不易受随机矩阵串扰；以 SU(3) 为例展示了在损坏线索上的 RGB 图像恢复。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SU(d) Hopfield 网络兼具高容量与物理可实现的回忆机制，并简要讨论了物理平台；量子化版本约化为 Sachdev-Ye 玻璃类模型，其多体谱包含暗带与记忆带，记忆带呈现混沌的 Wigner-Dyson 能级统计并隐藏 Hebbian 数据。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Control-Diverse Reinforcement Fine-Tuning: Decoupling the Shared Control Bottleneck of RL Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning post-training unlocks complex reasoning in LLMs. Yet benchmark scores reveal only whether a model improved, not what changed inside it, nor how it splits finite capability across tasks. A representative interpretability line attributes the success of RL fine-tuning to stronger and more diverse circuit activation. We challenge this activation-centered account by separating activation from control: an activated circuit need not control the post-training reward gain. Adapting Metabolic Control Analysis, we define the Post-training Control Coefficient to measure component control over reward gain and arrange these coefficients by task family into a control matrix, paired with an activation-magnitude matrix. We call cross-task control concentration the Shared Control Bottleneck and the difference between activation and control concentration the Activation-Control Gap. This reveals that highly shared activations can coexist with task-specific control, while a small gap indicates that control has collapsed onto a shared direction and lost task specificity. To reduce this collapse, we regularize the post-training loss with the Shared Control Bottleneck and propose Control-Diverse Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (CD-RFT). The exact regularizer gradient requires second-order automatic differentiation incompatible with flash attention, so we derive a first-order proxy with worst-case overhead below eight percent. On Qwen2.5-7B, CD-RFT achieves the largest control decoupling and improves multi-task capability over matched GRPO across mathematics, code, and logic. The no-KL variant leads on pass@1, and the KL-penalized variant leads on large-k pass@k coverage that KL otherwise degrades. Together, these results show that the Shared Control Bottleneck is both a mechanistic diagnostic and a training regularizer, and that control decoupling and capability gains transfer to Llama-3.2-3B.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出控制多样化强化微调 (Control-Diverse Reinforcement Fine-Tuning, CD-RFT)，用于缓解 LLM 强化学习后训练中跨任务共享控制瓶颈 (Shared Control Bottleneck) 导致的能力坍缩。作者借鉴代谢控制分析，定义 Post-training Control Coefficient 来度量组件对奖励增益的控制，并构造控制矩阵与激活幅度矩阵，从而区分激活与控制。基于这一诊断，他们用共享控制瓶颈作为正则项，并推导一阶梯度近似以避免与 flash attention 不兼容的二阶自动微分。实验在 Qwen2.5-7B 上显示 CD-RFT 比匹配的 GRPO 在数学、代码和逻辑任务上取得更好的多任务能力，且无 KL 变体在 pass@1 上领先，KL 惩罚变体在大 k 的 pass@k 覆盖率上优于 KL 退化的基线。
Motivation: 现有强化学习后训练的基准分数只能说明模型是否提升，无法揭示内部变化或有限能力如何在任务间分配；主流的可解释性观点将 RL 微调的成功归因于更强且更多样的电路激活，但本文质疑这一以激活为中心的解释，指出激活的电路未必控制奖励增益。
Method: 定义 Post-training Control Coefficient 度量组件对奖励增益的控制，并按任务族排列成控制矩阵，配以激活幅度矩阵；将跨任务控制集中程度定义为 Shared Control Bottleneck，将激活与控制集中度的差异定义为 Activation-Control Gap。以此为基础，在后训练损失中加入共享控制瓶颈正则，提出 CD-RFT，并推导一阶梯度代理，最坏情况开销低于 8%。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-7B 上，CD-RFT 实现最大的控制解耦，并在数学、代码和逻辑任务上超过匹配的 GRPO 多任务能力；无 KL 变体的 pass@1 领先，KL 惩罚变体在大 k 的 pass@k 覆盖率上占优，而 KL 本身会损害该覆盖率；控制解耦与能力提升可迁移到 Llama-3.2-3B。

papers.title: Metanormative Theory for RL-Based Moral Agents
papers.abstract_en: The overlapping disciplines of machine ethics and value alignment are concerned with designing artificial agents that are aligned with human values and that act in ethically acceptable ways. A recent trend in these disciplines is the use of reinforcement learning (RL) to design such agents, sidelining the philosophical literature that used to play a more central role. Against this backdrop, this paper pursues two goals. The first is to draw out ideas from recent work in metanormative theory that can be useful for designing artificial moral and value-aligned agents. The second is to examine the RL architecture through the lens of these ideas. This will give us clearer criteria for when an RL agent's behavior can be classified as moral, as well as a basis for evaluating and comparing different RL-based approaches to machine ethics and value alignment.
papers.comment: The 14th International Workshop on Engineering Multi-Agent Systems (EMAS 2026) held May 25-26, 2026 Co-located with AAMAS 2026 Paphos, Cyprus
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从元规范性理论 (metanormative theory) 的近期工作中提炼可用于设计道德与价值对齐智能体的思想，并用这些思想审视强化学习 (RL) 架构。作者据此提出更清晰的标准，用于判断 RL 智能体的行为何时可被归类为道德的，同时为评估和比较不同的基于 RL 的机器伦理与价值对齐方法提供基础。
Motivation: 机器伦理与价值对齐领域近年来转向用 RL 设计智能体，但哲学文献的作用被边缘化。本文希望重新引入元规范性理论的洞见，以填补行为分类标准与评估框架的缺失。
Method: 论文采用概念性方法：首先从近期的元规范性理论研究中提取对设计人工道德智能体有用的思想，然后以这些思想为透镜分析 RL 架构，从而导出分类与评估准则。
Result: 摘要未报告实验或量化结果，其贡献在于理论层面：给出判断 RL 智能体行为是否具有道德属性的更清晰标准，以及比较不同 RL 机器伦理方法的基础框架。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合元规范性理论可以更清晰地区分道德行为与非道德行为，并为 RL 驱动的价值对齐研究提供评估与比较依据，但结论停留在概念论证层面。

papers.title: VTO: Visual Tool Orchestration for Video Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is a critical yet challenging task due to the complex and diverse nature of real-world scenarios. Traditional deep learning approaches are fundamentally limited by poor generalization across diverse scenarios. While multimodal agents offer a promising tool-learning paradigm for VAD, current systems relying on supervised fine-tuning struggle with complex orchestration, and standard reinforcement learning often causes premature termination due to coarse-grained outcome rewards. To address these challenges, we propose VTO, a process-supervised reinforcement learning framework. Moving beyond static tool usage, VTO enables the agent to dynamically explore and interact with the environment. Specifically, we introduce a foundation model-driven cognitive evaluator to provide context-aware semantic feedback, which is seamlessly integrated into a Process-Supervised Cognitive Alignment that delivers fine-grained, step-wise supervision. By explicitly penalizing logical truncation and rewarding complete causal chains, the agent optimizes its multi-step reasoning policy for interrelated tool orchestration. To support our proposed framework, we meticulously crafted VAD-Tool, a hierarchical visual tool set comprising 12 specialized vision tools spanning from entity tracking to high-stakes hazard detection, and established the corresponding benchmark for rigorous multi-step reasoning evaluation. Extensive experiments on VAD-Tool demonstrate that VTO significantly outperforms baselines, achieving up to a 10.2\% absolute accuracy improvement in tool scheduling. Code and data are available at https://github.com/MICLAB-BUPT/VTO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VTO，一个面向视频异常检测 (VAD) 的基于过程监督强化学习的框架。VTO 引入基础模型驱动的认知评估器，将其与过程监督认知对齐 (Process-Supervised Cognitive Alignment) 结合，提供细粒度的逐步监督信号，以惩罚逻辑截断并奖励完整因果链。作者构建了包含 12 个专用视觉工具的层次化工具集 VAD-Tool 及相应基准，并报告绝对准确率最高提升 10.2%。
Motivation: 传统深度学习视频异常检测方法跨场景泛化能力差；基于多模态智能体的方法依赖监督微调，难以处理复杂的工具编排，而标准强化学习因粗粒度结果奖励常导致过早终止。
Method: 提出过程监督强化学习框架 VTO：由基础模型驱动的认知评估器提供上下文感知的语义反馈，配合过程监督认知对齐进行逐步监督，显式惩罚逻辑截断并奖励完整因果链，使智能体在多步骤推理中优化工具编排策略。
Result: 在 VAD-Tool 基准上，VTO 显著优于基线，在工具调度上取得最高 10.2% 的绝对准确率提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调过程级监督与认知反馈能有效改善多步骤工具编排，且面向 VAD 的层次化工具集与基准已开源。

papers.title: Harmful Content Is Not Enough: Continuation Framing Moderates In-Context Emergent Misalignment
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) can induce emergent misalignment (EM), where narrow misaligned examples alter answers to unrelated questions. Existing prompts, however, conflate harmful-text exposure with an invitation to continue assistant behavior. We hold harmful answers fixed while varying their delivery as demonstrations, evidence, assistant history, or tool output. Across ten independently sampled contexts, demonstration framing raises broad EM by $30$--$32$ percentage points on a susceptible Gemini model; the gap survives domain exclusion, semantic clustering, unseen questions, and four prompt templates. Format and length-matched controls show that harmful content is necessary but insufficient. A role times continuation factorial further reveals model-dependent provenance effects: Gemini follows both assistant and tool histories, whereas Grok largely resists tool-framed continuation. Several other frontier and open-weight models show no gap. Blinded human audits confirm every main contrast and show that the model judge underestimates active-condition failures. Thus continuation framing is a strong, model-dependent moderator of ICL-EM, not a universal consequence of harmful context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究上下文学习 (in-context learning) 中涌现性错位 (emergent misalignment, EM) 的调节因素。作者固定有害回答内容不变，仅改变其呈现方式（演示、证据、助手历史、工具输出），发现在易感的 Gemini 模型上，演示式框架 (demonstration framing) 将广泛 EM 提升 30–32 个百分点，而格式和长度匹配的对照表明有害内容必要但不充分。其他多个前沿与开源模型未显示该差距，说明延续框架是一个强且依赖模型的调节变量。
Motivation: 现有诱发 EM 的提示词把有害文本的暴露与邀请模型延续助手行为混为一谈，作者希望区分究竟是内容本身还是呈现框架驱动了模型对无关问题的错位回答。
Method: 在十个独立采样上下文中，固定有害回答不变，并以演示、证据、助手历史或工具输出四种方式传递；同时使用格式和长度匹配的对照、角色×延续 (role × continuation) 因析实验、领域排除与语义聚类、未见问题以及四种提示模板，并辅以盲审人工评估来分离内容与框架的贡献。
Result: 演示框架在 Gemin模型上将广泛 EM 提高 30–32 个百分点，且该差距在排除相关领域、语义聚类、未见问题和多种模板后依然存在；Grok 基本抵抗工具框架的延续，而其他若干前沿和开源模型无差异。盲审人工评估确认了各主要对比，并显示模型判断器 (model judge) 低估了主动条件下的失败。
Conclusion: 延续框架 (continuation framing) 是 ICL-EM 的强且依赖模型的调节因素，而非有害上下文的普适后果；抽象强调有害内容本身不足以产生 EM。

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation-Based Color Restoration for Low-Light Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Recent low-light image enhancement (LLIE) methods have driven brightness and structural fidelity close to that of normally-exposed images, yet their outputs still exhibit systematic color shifts such as greenish skies, yellowish faces, and warm-tinted white objects. We attribute this to end-to-end LLIE training coupling brightness, structure, and color within a single network, leaving the color channels weakly supervised. We recast color restoration as an independent sub-problem and decouple it from brightness enhancement, realizing it as a general-purpose post-processing module built on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Rather than relying solely on parametric color priors learned during training, the module dynamically retrieves a reference image from an external high-quality color knowledge base and injects its color distribution into a color-restoration network to correct residual bias. The design has three components: (i) a dual-index FAISS retriever built on intermediate VGG19 features, capturing textural and structural similarity through global mean and variance statistics; (ii) GlobalSPHistAdaIN, which reduces the reference spatial-preserving color histogram to a global color vector and modulates network features via adaptive instance normalization, removing dependence on pixel-level correspondence; and (iii) a residual formulation that predicts a color correction over the front-end output. Across LOLv1, LOLv2-Real, and LOLv2-Synthetic, the module consistently improves color-specific metrics, and it remains effective when the front end is swapped among CPGA-Net++, LLFormer, FLIGHTNet, and IAT, confirming cross-front-end generality. Ablations show that a VGG19 dual index outperforms CLIP-based retrieval, indicating that color restoration depends on textural and structural similarity rather than high-level semantics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低光图像增强（LLIE）后仍存在系统性色偏（如天空泛绿、人脸偏黄、白色物体偏暖）的问题，提出将颜色恢复从亮度增强中解耦，构建一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）的通用后处理模块。该模块从外部高质量颜色知识库中检索参考图像，并把其颜色分布注入颜色恢复网络以修正残余色偏。在 LOLv1、LOLv2-Real 和 LOLv2-Synthetic 上，该方法一致提升颜色相关指标，且更换不同前端网络后依然有效。
Motivation: 现有端到端 LLIE 方法把亮度、结构和颜色耦合在单个网络中训练，导致颜色通道监督不足，输出仍带有系统性色偏；论文认为颜色恢复应被建模为独立子问题，而不是与亮度增强捆绑在一起。
Method: 提出一种基于 RAG 的通用后处理模块，包含三个组件：基于 VGG19 中间特征的全局均值/方差构建双索引 FAISS 检索器；GlobalSPHistAdaIN 将参考图像的颜色直方图压缩为全局颜色向量并通过自适应实例归一化调制网络特征；以及预测前端输出颜色校正量的残差公式，摆脱像素级对应关系。
Result: 在 LOLv1、LOLv2-Real 和 LOLv2-Synthetic 上，该模块一致提升颜色特定指标；当将前端替换为 CPGA-Net++、LLFormer、FLIGHTNet 和 IAT 时仍保持有效，说明具有跨前端通用性。消融实验显示，VGG19 双索引优于基于 CLIP 的检索，表明颜色恢复依赖纹理和结构相似性，而非高层语义。
Conclusion: 摘要强调把颜色恢复从亮度增强中解耦、并依据纹理与结构相似性进行检索，可以作为一种与具体前端无关的通用后处理手段；其验证范围限于摘要列出的 LLIE 基准和颜色指标。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出一种基于 RAG 的通用后处理模块，包含三个组件：基于 VGG19 中间特征的全局均值/方差构建双索引 FAISS 检索器；GlobalSPHistAdaIN 将参考图像的颜色直方图压缩为全局颜色向量并通过自适应实例归一化调制网络特征；以及预测前端输出颜色校正量的残差公式，摆脱像素级对应关系。
summary_sections.result: 在 LOLv1、LOLv2-Real 和 LOLv2-Synthetic 上，该模块一致提升颜色特定指标；当将前端替换为 CPGA-Net++、LLFormer、FLIGHTNet 和 IAT 时仍保持有效，说明具有跨前端通用性。消融实验显示，VGG19 双索引优于基于 CLIP 的检索，表明颜色恢复依赖纹理和结构相似性，而非高层语义。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调把颜色恢复从亮度增强中解耦、并依据纹理与结构相似性进行检索，可以作为一种与具体前端无关的通用后处理手段；其验证范围限于摘要列出的 LLIE 基准和颜色指标。

papers.title: Illusion of Alignment: Detecting Hidden Disagreement in Collaborative Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative dialogue can end with apparent agreement while participants still differ on goals, assumptions, or execution plans, creating an \textbf{illusion of alignment (IoA)}. A real-user study across 18 meetings confirms that IoA arises routinely in human collaboration. Yet IoA poses a paradox: if participants were aware of such disagreements, they would already be explicit; if not, they cannot articulate them when asked, leaving IoA invisible to both participants and observers. In this work, we make IoA detectable by generating diagnostic multiple-choice questions whose divergent answers across participants provide direct behavioral evidence of hidden disagreement. We construct \textbf{IoA-Suite}, a dataset and evaluation protocol for detecting hidden disagreement, spanning five task types and six domains. We find that even the best model attains only 49.5\% F1, with the bottleneck traced to private context that the dialogue does not surface. We then train \textbf{IoA-Prober-8B} based on IoA-Suite, reaching 51.8\% F1 on IoA-Suite. Across the aforementioned 18 real meetings, it surfaces 2.89 hidden disagreements per meeting that participants confirm they had not voiced, transferring to live human dialogue. Further, in multi-agent collaboration, pairing IoA-Prober-8B with LLM agents improves downstream task performance on BigCodeBench-Hard and HiddenBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究协作对话中的"对齐幻觉"(illusion of alignment, IoA)：参与者表面上达成一致，但目标、假设或执行计划仍存在未言明的分歧。作者提出通过生成诊断性多项选择题来使隐藏分歧可检测，并构建了涵盖五个任务类型、六个领域的 IoA-Suite 数据集与评估协议；基于该数据集训练的 IoA-Prober-8B 在 IoA-Suite 上达到 51.8% F1，并在 18 场真实会议中平均每场揭示 2.89 个参与者确认从未言明的分歧，还能提升多智能体协作的下游任务表现。
Motivation: 协作对话常以表面一致结束但参与者仍存在目标、假设或执行计划上的分歧；若参与者意识到分歧则早已明说，若未意识到则无法在被问及时表达，导致 IoA 对参与者和观察者都不可见，现有方法难以检测。
Method: 通过生成诊断性多项选择题，利用不同参与者答案的分歧作为隐藏分歧的直接行为证据；构建包含五个任务类型、六个领域的 IoA-Suite 数据集和评估协议，并基于该数据集训练 IoA-Prober-8B 检测模型。
Result: 即使最强模型在 IoA-Suite 上也只有 49.5% F1，瓶颈在于对话未呈现的私有上下文；IoA-Prober-8B 达到 51.8% F1，在 18 场真实会议中平均每场揭示 2.89 个未言明分歧，且在多智能体协作中与 LLM 智能体配对可提升 BigCodeBench-Hard 和 HiddenBench 上的下游任务表现。
Conclusion: 作者认为 IoA 可以通过行为证据被检测并迁移到真实对话与多智能体场景，但当前 F1 仍偏低，私有上下文的缺失是主要限制。

papers.title: FreSH: Frequency-Segmented Hierarchical Multi-Expert Framework for Multivariate Time Series Classification
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate Time Series Classification (MTSC) demands models that can effectively capture complex temporal patterns across multiple scales while remaining computationally efficient. However, existing approaches generally struggle to reconcile fine-grained representation learning, especially under class imbalance and real-world constraints. In this paper, we present FreSH, a Frequency-Segmented Hierarchical Multi-Expert Framework designed to address these challenges. FreSH introduces a new perspective for MTSC by enabling adaptive, multi-scale analysis of temporal signals, allowing different aspects of the data to be modeled in a complementary and coordinated manner. By combining localized specialization with holistic context modeling, FreSH achieves strong representational capacity without incurring excessive computational overhead. An adaptive fusion strategy further enhances flexibility, enabling the model to dynamically emphasize the most informative components of the input. In addition, we incorporate a more robust optimization objective that improves learning stability across varying sample difficulties and class distributions. Extensive evaluations on 30 UEA benchmark datasets and real-world vibration data demonstrate that FreSH consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in classification accuracy, while substantially reducing model size and efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FreSH，一个面向多元时间序列分类（MTSC）的频率分段分层多专家框架。它通过自适应的多尺度时间信号分析，将局部专业化（localized specialization）与整体上下文建模（holistic context modeling）互补结合，并采用自适应融合策略动态突出信息量最大的输入成分，同时引入更稳健的优化目标以应对样本难度差异与类别分布不均衡。在 30 个 UEA 基准数据集和真实振动数据上，摘要称 FreSH 在分类准确率上持续优于现有方法，并显著减小模型规模和计算开销。
Motivation: 现有 MTSC 方法普遍难以在细粒度表示学习、类别不均衡和现实约束（如计算效率）之间取得平衡，缺少能够跨多个尺度有效捕获复杂时间模式且保持高效的手段。
Method: FreSH 采用频率分段（Frequency-Segmented）的分层多专家结构，对不同频率成分进行自适应多尺度建模，让局部专业化和整体上下文建模协同工作；配合自适应融合策略以及更稳健的优化目标，提升不同样本难度和类别分布下的学习稳定性。
Result: 在 30 个 UEA 基准数据集和真实振动数据上的广泛评估表明，FreSH 在分类准确率上持续优于 state-of-the-art 方法，同时大幅降低模型尺寸并提升效率。
Conclusion: 摘要将收益归因于局部专业化与整体上下文建模的互补协同、自适应融合带来的灵活性，以及稳健优化目标带来的学习稳定性；该框架在较低计算开销下获得强表示能力，适用于多变量时间序列分类任务。

papers.title: Conditional Diffusion for Nonparametric Instrumental Variable Quantile Regression
papers.abstract_en: This work proposes deep nonparametric Instrumental variable quantile regression (IVQR), a two-stage estimator that combines conditional diffusion modeling with a kernel-smoothed conditional moment formulation. In the first stage, we estimate the joint conditional distribution of the outcome and endogenous covariates given the instrument using a variance-preserving conditional diffusion model. In the second stage, we approximate the conditional moment operator through Monte Carlo sampling and a kernel-smoothed surrogate for the indicator function, and then estimate the structural quantile function by empirical risk minimization over deep neural networks. We establish an excess-risk bound for the proposed estimator and derive end-to-end total variation guarantees for the conditional diffusion model under unbounded support, explicitly accounting for score estimation, early stopping, and discretization errors. Our theory is developed under a polynomial-tail envelope on the data distribution and degenerates continuously to the exponential setting: as the tail index grows, the obtained excess-risk rate converges to the minimax-optimal rate of nonparametric regression, thus our heavy-tailed theory covers the classical light-tailed nonparametric guarantees as a limiting case. Simulation studies and a real-data application demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing nonparametric IVQR approaches, with gains that become increasingly pronounced as the dimensionality of the covariates and instruments increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出深度非参数工具变量分位数回归 (IVQR) 的两阶段估计器，将条件扩散模型 (conditional diffusion model) 与核平滑条件矩公式相结合。第一阶段用保方差条件扩散模型估计结果变量与内生协变量给定工具变量时的联合条件分布；第二阶段以蒙特卡洛抽样和核平滑代理指示函数近似条件矩算子，再通过深度神经网络上的经验风险最小化估计结构分位函数。作者建立了估计器的超额风险界，并在无界支撑下给出条件扩散模型端到端的总变差保证，显式计入得分估计、早停与离散化误差。
Motivation: 现有非参数 IVQR 方法在高维协变量和工具变量下性能受限，且缺乏针对深度生成式两阶段估计器的端到端理论保证。本文旨在用条件扩散模型构造可扩展且可证明的 IVQR 估计器。
Method: 两阶段估计器：第一阶段使用保方差条件扩散模型估计给定工具变量下结果变量与内生协变量的联合条件分布；第二阶段通过蒙特卡洛抽样与核平滑的指示函数代理来近似条件矩算子，并在深度神经网络函数类上做经验风险最小化以估计结构分位函数。
Result: 摘要报告模拟研究和真实数据应用中该方法优于现有非参数 IVQR 方法，且当协变量与工具变量维度增大时优势更明显；理论上给出了超额风险界和条件扩散模型的端到端总变差保障，并在多项式尾包络假设下得到随尾指数增大而收敛到非参数回归最小最大最优速率的极限结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调其理论在重尾（多项式尾）数据分布下成立，并连续退化为经典轻尾指数设置，从而覆盖传统非参数保证作为极限情形；摘要未讨论明确局限性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Beyond Aggregate Calibration: Decomposing Income-Conditional Recall Disparities in Automated Credit Default Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Data-centric curation pipelines frequently rely on model confidence scores to flag and filter noisy or mislabeled training instances. Evaluating this filtering convention on a large-scale consumer lending sample (LendingClub, N = 1,344,936) uncovers an underlying demographic asymmetry: high-income defaulters are disproportionately classified as label noise relative to low-income defaulters (Cramer's V approximately 0.03-0.07). Re-examining this behavior through the lens of equal opportunity [Hardt et al., 2016] reveals a far more severe discrepancy: a 16.86 percentage point gap in true positive rate (recall) between high- and low-income borrowers who ultimately defaulted. Implementing a sequential feature-blinding methodology allows us to isolate the drivers of this disparity across three distinct mechanisms: (1) direct reliance on self-reported applicant income; (2) algorithmic absorption of upstream institutional bias encoded within origination interest rates; and (3) a residual disparity (3.55 percentage points in cross-validation; 2.56 percentage points on a held-out test partition, Z = -4.04, p < 0.0001) that remains even after purging both income and interest rates from the model. Out-of-sample signed SHAP valuations demonstrate that this residual gap is maintained by structural proxies, most notably loan amount and home ownership status. These empirical findings show that simply blinding an algorithm to sensitive attributes fails to ensure fairness when institutional pricing decisions and behavioral proxy variables collectively reconstruct the omitted signals. We outline the practical implications of these findings for auditing data-centric AI workflows within regulated financial institutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对数据为中心的机器学习管线上用模型置信度过滤疑似噪声样本的做法，在 LendingClub 大规模消费信贷数据（N = 1,344,936）上检验其对不同收入群体的影响。结果显示高收入违约者更易被标记为标签噪声，且以 equal opportunity 视角评估时，高收入与低收入违约者之间的真正例率（recall）差距达 16.86 个百分点。作者通过顺序特征遮蔽法分离收入、机构利率和残余机制，发现即使剔除收入与利率，残余差距仍显著存在，并由贷款金额、房屋所有权等结构性代理变量维持。
Motivation: 数据为中心的 AI 工作流常依赖模型置信度过滤噪声样本，但这种做法可能引入人口统计层面的不对称偏差；同时，仅从聚合校准角度评估公平性会掩盖收入条件化的 recall 差距。该问题对受监管金融机构的模型审计具有重要意义。
Method: 在 LendingClub 大规模样本上，作者先以 Cramer's V 度量标签噪声分类中的收入不对称，再用 equal opportunity 框架量化 recall 差距，并实现顺序特征遮蔽（sequential feature-blinding）以分离三类驱动机制：对自我报告收入的直接依赖、对发起利率中所含制度性偏差的吸收，以及剔除收入和利率后仍存在的残余差距。残余差距通过样本外 signed SHAP 估值进一步归因。
Result: 高收入违约者被过度分类为标签噪声（Cramer's V 约 0.03-0.07）；高收入与低收入违约者的 TPR（recall）差距为 16.86 个百分点。剔除了收入和利率后，残余差距在交叉验证中为 3.55 个百分点，在留出测试集上为 2.56 个百分点（Z = -4.04, p < 0.0001），且 signed SHAP 显示主要由贷款金额和房屋所有权状态等结构性代理变量维持。
Conclusion: 作者强调，仅对模型遮蔽敏感属性并不能保证公平，因为制度性定价决策和行为代理变量会共同重构被遗漏的信号；这些发现为受监管金融机构审计数据为中心 AI 工作流提供了实践含义。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对数据为中心的机器学习管线上用模型置信度过滤疑似噪声样本的做法，在 LendingClub 大规模消费信贷数据（N = 1,344,936）上检验其对不同收入群体的影响。结果显示高收入违约者更易被标记为标签噪声，且以 equal opportunity 视角评估时，高收入与低收入违约者之间的真正例率（recall）差距达 16.86 个百分点。作者通过顺序特征遮蔽法分离收入、机构利率和残余机制，发现即使剔除收入与利率，残余差距仍显著存在，并由贷款金额、房屋所有权等结构性代理变量维持。
summary_sections.motivation: 数据为中心的 AI 工作流常依赖模型置信度过滤噪声样本，但这种做法可能引入人口统计层面的不对称偏差；同时，仅从聚合校准角度评估公平性会掩盖收入条件化的 recall 差距。该问题对受监管金融机构的模型审计具有重要意义。
summary_sections.method: 在 LendingClub 大规模样本上，作者先以 Cramer's V 度量标签噪声分类中的收入不对称，再用 equal opportunity 框架量化 recall 差距，并实现顺序特征遮蔽（sequential feature-blinding）以分离三类驱动机制：对自我报告收入的直接依赖、对发起利率中所含制度性偏差的吸收，以及剔除收入和利率后仍存在的残余差距。残余差距通过样本外 signed SHAP 估值进一步归因。
summary_sections.result: 高收入违约者被过度分类为标签噪声（Cramer's V 约 0.03-0.07）；高收入与低收入违约者的 TPR（recall）差距为 16.86 个百分点。剔除了收入和利率后，残余差距在交叉验证中为 3.55 个百分点，在留出测试集上为 2.56 个百分点（Z = -4.04, p < 0.0001），且 signed SHAP 显示主要由贷款金额和房屋所有权状态等结构性代理变量维持。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调，仅对模型遮蔽敏感属性并不能保证公平，因为制度性定价决策和行为代理变量会共同重构被遗漏的信号；这些发现为受监管金融机构审计数据为中心 AI 工作流提供了实践含义。

papers.title: Persuasive and Compliant Tendencies Predict Group Decision-Making in Humans and Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly involved in group decision-making with other LLMs and humans. Yet it remains unclear whether their influence is driven by persuasion-oriented expression or compliance-oriented accommodation. We introduce DecisionQE, a questionnaire-based framework for measuring each model's persuasive and compliant tendencies across multiple decision scenarios, and use the Werewolf game as an interactive testbed to study their effects on social influence and group outcomes under asymmetric information. Across experiments, stronger persuasive tendency does not significantly improve group outcomes, whereas compliant-oriented models show more stable advantages in cooperation. We further reveal a dual effect of compliance: it supports cooperation in honest roles but improves concealment in adversarial roles. These findings suggest that LLM group interactions reveal not only task outcomes, but also measurable patterns of intrinsic behavioral tendency. LLMs can therefore serve as a lens for sociological observation of language-mediated interaction, while highlighting the need to incorporate behavioral tendencies into safety evaluation of LLM systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）在多智能体及人机混合群体决策中的影响力来源，提出基于问卷的 DecisionQE 框架来测量模型的劝说倾向（persuasive tendency）与顺从倾向（compliant tendency），并以狼人杀（Werewolf）游戏作为非对称信息下的交互测试平台。摘要报告的主要结果是：更强的劝说倾向并未显著改善群体任务结果，而顺从倾向较强的模型在合作中表现出更稳定的优势；顺从倾向还呈现双重效应——在诚实角色中促进合作、在对抗角色中增强隐藏伪装。作者认为 LLM 群体交互可以揭示内在行为倾向，并可作为社会学观察的工具。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地参与与其他 LLM 及人类的群体决策，但它的影响力究竟来自说服式表达还是顺从式妥协尚不明确；理解这一机制对预测群体结果和评估 LLM 系统安全性都很重要。
Method: 提出 DecisionQE，一种基于问卷的框架，用于跨多个决策场景测量每个模型的劝说与顺从倾向；并以狼人杀游戏作为交互测试平台，在非对称信息条件下观察这些倾向对社交影响和群体结果的作用。
Result: 实验显示，更强的劝说倾向并未显著改善群体结果；顺从取向的模型在合作中展现出更稳定的优势。顺从还表现出双重效应：在诚实角色中支持合作，而在对抗角色中提升隐藏能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LLM 的群体交互不仅反映任务结果，也反映可测量的内在行为倾向，因此 LLM 可以作为语言中介互动社会学观察的透镜；同时提示需要将行为倾向纳入 LLM 系统的安全评估。

papers.title: Targeted Counterfactual Fingerprinting for Black-Box LLM Ownership Verification
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are high-value assets that can be derived through redeployment, fine-tuning, quantization, or further alignment. Because deployed LLMs are commonly exposed only through query APIs, ownership verification must often rely on black-box text responses. This setting is difficult: generations are open-ended and can vary across repeated queries, while existing black-box fingerprints rely on signals that are fragile under a final-response interface, including full-text matching, soft behavioral features, or model-specific prompts designed not to transfer. We propose TCF (Targeted Counterfactual Fingerprinting), a black-box LLM fingerprinting framework that converts open-ended generation comparison into constrained-answer targeted counterfactual transfer. TCF restricts each verification query to a finite answer space, reducing the surface-form ambiguity that enters the verification score, and optimizes a prompt perturbation toward a counterfactual target different from the protected model's clean answer on the original prompt. Verification reduces to checking whether the suspect model's parsed final answer matches the recorded target. We introduce the source-model counterfactual margin (SCM), a protected-model-only quantity that certifies the target is unlikely before the perturbation and likely after it; SCM controls target selection, perturbation stopping, and fingerprint filtering. Under explicit derived-preservation and independent-transfer budgets motivated by local behavioral closeness, we derive a target-accuracy gap between derived and independent models. Across four LLM families, TCF achieves an average AUC of 0.9861, improving over TRAP, ProFLingo, and ZeroPrint by 0.07 to 0.19.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TCF（Targeted Counterfactual Fingerprinting），一种面向黑盒 LLM 所有权验证的指纹框架。它把开放式生成比较转化为受限答案空间上的定向反事实迁移（targeted counterfactual transfer），并引入仅依赖被保护模型的源模型反事实边际（SCM）来控制目标选择、扰动停止和指纹过滤。摘要报告在四个 LLM 家族上平均 AUC 为 0.9861，较 TRAP、ProFLingo 和 ZeroPrint 提升 0.07 至 0.19。
Motivation: 部署后的 LLM 常只通过查询 API 暴露，因此所有权验证只能依赖黑盒文本响应；但开放式生成具有歧义且重复查询不稳定，现有黑盒指纹（如全文本匹配、软行为特征或不可迁移的模型专属提示）在最终响应接口下信号脆弱。
Method: TCF 将每个验证查询限制在有限答案空间，降低表面形式歧义对验证分数的影响，并优化提示扰动，使其朝与被保护模型原始干净答案不同的反事实目标迁移。验证时只需检查嫌疑模型解析后的最终答案是否匹配记录目标；SCM 是被保护模型独有的量，用于认证目标在扰动前不太可能、扰动后很可能出现，并控制目标选择、扰动停止和指纹过滤。
Result: 在四个 LLM 家族上，TCF 的平均 AUC 达到 0.9861，相比 TRAP、ProFLingo 和 ZeroPrint 提升 0.07 至 0.19。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在显式派生保持（derived-preservation）与独立迁移（independent-transfer）预算下，推导出派生模型与独立模型之间的目标准确率差距（target-accuracy gap），表明该方法适用于黑盒场景下的 LLM 所有权验证。

papers.title: A Minimal $κ$--$τ$ Logic for Risk-Sensitive Abduction
papers.abstract_en: Standard approaches to abductive reasoning can retain multiple candidate explanations, but they do not generally combine explicit compositional cross-hypothesis interaction with an internal, rival-sensitive commitment judgment. This paper argues that in risk-sensitive domains -- where premature commitment carries asymmetric downside costs -- the timing of commitment is itself a governed decision that the inferential apparatus should formally represent. We present a minimal $κ$--$τ$ logical framework built on two primitives: epistemic interaction among hypotheses ($κ$) and a normative commitment threshold ($τ$). Hypotheses may coexist, reinforce or inhibit one another, and form emergent composite explanations, while collapse into committed conclusions is regulated by governance constraints rather than forced by inference alone. The logic is developed in two complementary modes sharing the interaction relation and the governance apparatus: a synthetic mode, in which atomic hypotheses are composed upward into emergent explanations, and an analytic mode, in which complex observed states of affairs are decomposed into causal clusters of latent factors, with commitment governed at both the cluster and the factor level. The framework provides formal machinery for domains in which the distinction between highly likely and commit-worthy is operationally consequential. The $κ$--$τ$ logic is positioned as the symbolic governance layer of a neurosymbolic architecture: its epistemic parameters are naturally estimated by neural components -- semantic embeddings and generative models, as demonstrated in existing computational realizations -- while its normative parameters remain under explicit human governance, yielding transparent and auditable abductive reasoning for deployment in high-stakes settings.
papers.comment: 44 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to Neurosymbolic Artificial Intelligence (IOS Press/Sage)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个最小的 $κ$--$τ$ 逻辑框架，用于风险敏感溯因推理（abductive reasoning），以两个原语为基础：假设之间的认知交互（$κ$）和规范性承诺阈值（$τ$）。框架支持假设共存、相互增强或抑制，并形成涌现性的复合解释，同时承诺过程由治理约束而非纯推理强制决定。逻辑包含综合与分析两种互补模式，并定位为神经符号架构中的符号治理层。
Motivation: 标准溯因推理可以保留多个候选解释，但通常不结合显式的跨假设组合交互与带有内部竞争敏感性的承诺判断。在风险敏感领域，过早承诺会带来不对称的代价，因此承诺的时机本身应被推理装置形式化表达，而现有方法缺乏这种表达。
Method: 构建一个最小的 $κ$--$τ$ 逻辑，其中 $κ$ 表示假设间的认知交互关系，$τ$ 表示规范性承诺阈值。框架在共享交互关系与治理机制下运行两种模式：综合模式从原子假设向上组合成涌现解释，分析模式将复杂观察状态分解为潜在因子的因果簇，并在簇与因子两级治理承诺。神经组件估计认知参数，规范参数则由人类显式治理。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数字，主要结果是形式化机制本身：该逻辑能够区分“高度可能”与“值得承诺”这两种在操作上后果不同的情形，并为高风险环境提供透明、可审计的溯因推理能力。
Conclusion: 作者将 $κ$--$τ$ 逻辑定位为神经符号架构的符号治理层：认知参数可由现有神经实现（如语义嵌入和生成模型）估计，而规范参数保留在人类治理之下，从而实现可审计的溯因推理，适用于高风险部署场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BAP-MOS: Bandit-Based Adaptive Prompting for Boundary-Sensitive Multi-Organ Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-organ ultrasound segmentation remains challenging when anatomically adjacent structures must be delineated jointly, as localized boundary errors can persist even when Dice scores are high. To address these challenges, we propose Boundary-Adaptive Prompting for Multi-Organ Segmentation (BAP-MOS), a closed-loop adaptive prompting framework. BAP-MOS formulates prompt selection as an organ-specific multi-armed bandit problem over box, point, and combined prompts. An outer Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) loop selects the prompt-selection parameter vector, while an inner UCB-Tuned loop adapts per-organ prompt preferences during fine-tuning using a bounded Dice--MSD--HD95 validation-probe reward. The framework further introduces an organ-scaled negative prompt ring to adapt sparse prompt geometry across anatomical scales, while keeping the image and prompt encoders frozen and updating only the mask decoder. We evaluate BAP-MOS on pooled prostate-region TRUS cohorts against U-Net, nnU-Net, MedSAM, fixed-prompt SAM/MedSAM, and adaptive policy variants. On this benchmark, BAP-MOS achieves Dice 0.982, HD95 0.482, and MSD 0.204, reducing HD95 by approximately 48% and MSD by 45% relative to the strongest conventional baseline. To verify the generalization ability of the framework, we tested it on the external PFUS1 pelvic-floor ultrasound corpus using MedSAM and its adaptive strategy variants, and the results were good. These results support adaptive prompt allocation as an effective mechanism for improving boundary-sensitive multi-organ ultrasound segmentation without modifying the foundation-model backbone. Source Code is available at: https://github.com/SatvikPraveen/BAP-MOS
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Source code available at https://github.com/SatvikPraveen/BAP-MOS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BAP-MOS，一个面向多器官超声分割的闭环自适应提示框架，将提示选择建模为器官特定的多臂老虎机问题，并用 UCB-Tuned 与 TPE 双层循环在微调中调节每个器官的提示偏好。实验在 pooled 前列腺 TRUS 队列上达到 Dice 0.982、HD95 0.482、MSD 0.204，相比最强常规基线将 HD95 降低约 48%、MSD 降低约 45%，并在外部 PFUS1 骨盆底超声语料上验证了泛化能力。
Motivation: 多器官超声分割中，解剖上相邻的结构需要联合勾画，局部边界误差即使在高 Dice 分数下仍会存在，现有方法难以精细刻画边界。
Method: 提出闭环自适应提示框架 BAP-MOS：外层用 Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) 选择提示选择参数向量，内层用 UCB-Tuned 循环在微调期间逐器官调整 box、point 与组合提示的偏好，奖励为有界的 Dice–MSD–HD95 验证探针；并引入器官尺度化的负提示环以适应不同解剖尺度，冻结图像与提示编码器，只更新掩码解码器。
Result: 在 pooled 前列腺 TRUS 队列上，BAP-MOS 达到 Dice 0.982、HD95 0.482、MSD 0.204，相对最强常规基线将 HD95 降低约 48%、MSD 降低约 45%；在外部 PFUS1 骨盆底超声语料上测试 MedSAM 及其自适应策略变体，结果良好。
Conclusion: 摘要认为自适应提示分配是不修改基础模型主干条件下提升边界敏感的多器官超声分割的有效机制。
