summary_sections.motivation: 多器官超声分割中，解剖上相邻的结构需要联合勾画，局部边界误差即使在高 Dice 分数下仍会存在，现有方法难以精细刻画边界。
summary_sections.method: 提出闭环自适应提示框架 BAP-MOS：外层用 Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) 选择提示选择参数向量，内层用 UCB-Tuned 循环在微调期间逐器官调整 box、point 与组合提示的偏好，奖励为有界的 Dice–MSD–HD95 验证探针；并引入器官尺度化的负提示环以适应不同解剖尺度，冻结图像与提示编码器，只更新掩码解码器。
summary_sections.result: 在 pooled 前列腺 TRUS 队列上，BAP-MOS 达到 Dice 0.982、HD95 0.482、MSD 0.204，相对最强常规基线将 HD95 降低约 48%、MSD 降低约 45%；在外部 PFUS1 骨盆底超声语料上测试 MedSAM 及其自适应策略变体，结果良好。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为自适应提示分配是不修改基础模型主干条件下提升边界敏感的多器官超声分割的有效机制。

papers.title: Janus: An Algorithm-Evaluator Co-Evolution Framework for LLM-Driven Discovery under Expensive Evaluation Budgets
papers.abstract_en: LLM-driven program discovery relies on rapid evaluator feedback, but many scientific and engineering tasks require high-fidelity simulations, hardware execution, or physical experiments, making each evaluation expensive. Cheap surrogate evaluators can reduce this cost, yet fixed surrogates are vulnerable to search-induced distribution shift and are difficult to fit reliably from sparse, search-biased labels. We introduce Janus, a framework that uses LLMs to co-evolve target programs and executable proxy evaluators. To address label scarcity, Janus leverages domain knowledge encoded in LLMs to generate task-specific evaluator programs and calibrates them using real outcomes. To mitigate distribution shift, Janus evolves evaluators alongside target programs, selects them using a promotion-aligned objective, and maintains region-conditioned portfolios with online credit updates. Because proxy predictions remain fallible, Janus uses them only to prioritize candidates and requires real validation before candidates can enter the target-program population or update the incumbent. Across five scientific and engineering design tasks, Janus achieves a larger area under the best-so-far improvement curve over the real-evaluation budget and higher final performance than a matched baseline that evolves only target programs. On average, Janus reaches 99/% of the baseline's final improvement with 59.1/% fewer real evaluations. Evolved proxy evaluators also rank promising candidates more accurately than their seed versions. Together, these results extend evaluator-guided LLM discovery from tasks with cheap, scalable feedback to scientific domains where trustworthy evaluation is scarce and expensive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Janus，一个算法-评估器共同演化框架，利用LLM同时演化目标程序和可执行的代理评估器，以应对昂贵评估预算下的科学发现任务。摘要称在五个科学和工程设计任务上，Janus在真实评估预算下取得更大的最佳-到目前为止改进曲线下面积和更高最终性能，平均用59.1%更少的真实评估达到基线最终改进的99%。
Motivation: 许多科学和工程任务需要高保真模拟、硬件执行或物理实验，每次评估昂贵；固定代理评估器容易受搜索引起的分布偏移影响，且难以从稀疏、搜索有偏的标签中可靠拟合。
Method: Janus利用LLM编码的领域知识生成任务特定的评估器程序，并用真实结果校准；同时将评估器与目标程序共同演化，使用推广对齐目标选择评估器，维护区域条件评估器组合并在线更新信用。代理预测仅用于候选优先排序，候选必须经过真实验证后才能进入目标程序种群或更新当前最优解。
Result: 在五个科学和工程设计任务中，Janus比仅演化目标程序的匹配基线取得更大的最佳-到目前为止改进曲线下面积和更高最终性能；平均使用59.1%更少的真实评估达到基线最终改进的99%。演化后的代理评估器比初始版本更准确地排序候选。
Conclusion: 这些结果将评估器引导的LLM发现从廉价可扩展反馈的任务扩展到评估稀缺且昂贵的科学领域。

papers.title: Quantization Degradation in Large Language Models: A Signal-Noise Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization reduces the deployment cost of large language models, yet how severely a quantized model degrades is not determined by bit-width alone. We systematically study weight-only post-training quantization across bit-widths, quantization methods, model scales and downstream tasks on multiple model families. We observe that such degradation varies substantially across these factors: 4-bit quantization usually preserves performance, 2-bit often causes broad degradation, and at 3-bit, degradation becomes apparent but varies markedly with task type, quantization method and model scale. To explain this variability, we use the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) to measure how strongly quantization perturbs full-precision representations. We trace degradation back to two linked processes: how quantization errors arise within individual modules, and how they accumulate across layers. First, a source SNR decomposition shows that newly introduced errors depend on three factors: the magnitude of the weight error, the strength of the task-specific signal, and how strongly the quantization error aligns with task-specific activations. Different factors affect these components in distinct ways. Second, a cross-layer propagation analysis shows that these errors can be attenuated, preserved, or amplified as they pass across layers, and that larger models benefit from weaker error amplification. Together, these results establish that quantization degradation is governed by how errors are introduced at the source and how they accumulate across the network.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从信号噪声比（SNR）视角系统研究大语言模型的仅权重后训练量化（weight-only post-training quantization），考察比特宽度、量化方法、模型规模与下游任务等多因素对性能退化的影响。摘要报告：4-bit 量化通常保持性能，2-bit 常导致广泛退化，3-bit 时退化明显且随任务类型、量化方法和模型规模变化。作者将退化追溯到误差在模块内的产生与跨层累积两个关联过程。
Motivation: 现有观点认为量化模型的退化程度并不只由比特宽度决定，但缺乏对不同因素如何影响退化的系统解释；本文试图用统一框架解释为何退化在比特宽度、量化方法、模型规模和任务类型之间差异显著。
Method: 提出以信噪比（SNR）度量量化对全精度表示的扰动程度，并做两层分析：一是源端 SNR 分解，将新引入误差归因于权重误差大小、任务特定信号强度以及量化误差与任务相关激活的对齐程度；二是跨层传播分析，考察误差在层间是被减弱、保持还是放大。
Result: 实验覆盖多个模型家族，观察发现 4-bit 量化通常保持性能，2-bit 常造成广泛退化，3-bit 退化明显且因任务类型、量化方法和模型规模而异；跨层分析显示更大模型的误差放大更弱。
Conclusion: 摘要总结认为量化退化由误差在源头的产生方式与在网络中的跨层累积方式共同决定，这一 SNR 视角可以为不同因素导致的性能差异提供统一解释。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Large Multimodal Agents for Intelligent Transportation Systems: Architectures, Evidence, and Deployment Challenges
papers.abstract_en: Large multimodal agents (LMAs) are increasingly proposed for intelligent transportation systems (ITS), but existing studies often conflate multimodality, agency, empirical performance, and deployment readiness. This review provides an auditable evidence map of 42 primary study families released between January 2023 and 3 August 2026 within a corpus of 91 mapped sources. It distinguishes model-level, system-level, and hybrid multimodality and classifies each family by system architecture and action authority. Evidence is assessed independently through functional capability (C0-C3), validation setting (E0-E4), three evidence propositions (P1-P3), and eight methodological-concern domains (Q1-Q8). Transportation semantics (P1) are directly evaluated in 23 families and multidimensional integration (P3) in 24; 19 families directly evaluate both. Evidence reconciliation (P2) remains unresolved because no family demonstrates the complete provenance-challenge-handling-comparison-outcome chain. Fourteen families reach C3, but 13 remain at E2; only one reaches E3 and none reaches E4. Across ITS domains, LMAs are best supported for semantic interpretation, intent translation, evidence organisation, scenario authoring, explanation, and specialist-tool coordination. Numerical forecasting, optimisation, simulation fidelity, hard constraints, low-level control, safety fallback, and final authority should remain with independently verifiable specialist systems or accountable humans. The review therefore supports bounded orchestration rather than replacement and provides a matched comparative evaluation protocol and staged roadmap for accountable deployment. The living evidence repository is available at https://github.com/pangjunbiao/ITS-LMA-Review.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于大型多模态智能体（LMA）在智能交通系统（ITS）中应用的系统性综述，基于91个映射来源中的42个主要研究族（2023年1月至2026年8月3日）构建可审计证据图谱。综述区分模型级、系统级与混合多模态，按系统架构和行动权限对研究族分类，并使用功能能力（C0-C3）、验证设置（E0-E4）、三种证据命题（P1-P3）和八个方法论关注域（Q1-Q8）独立评估证据。最终结论是LMA适合有界编排（bounded orchestration）而非取代现有系统，并提供了比较评估协议和分阶段部署路线图。
Motivation: 现有ITS中的LMA研究常将多模态性、能动性、经验性能和部署就绪性混为一谈，缺乏对证据的系统审计；该综述旨在厘清这些概念，为LMA在ITS中的实际部署提供可核验的证据基础。
Method: 采用综述式证据映射方法，对91个映射来源中的42个研究族进行系统分类和评估；建立多模态层级分类（模型级、系统级、混合）、行动权限分类，以及独立的证据评估框架（功能能力C0-C3、验证设置E0-E4、证据命题P1-P3、方法学关注域Q1-Q8）。
Result: 23个研究族直接评估交通语义（P1），24个评估多维集成（P3），19个同时评估两者；但没有任何研究族完整呈现证据协调（P2）所需的全链条。14个研究族达到C3，13个停留在E2，仅1个达到E3，无研究达到E4。LMA在语义解释、意图翻译、证据组织、场景编写、解释和专家工具协调方面证据最强；数值预测、优化、仿真保真度、硬约束、低级控制、安全回退和最终权限则应保留给独立可验证的专家系统或负责任人。
Conclusion: 综述支持有界编排而非直接替换，强调在ITS高安全场景中保留人类和专家系统的最终权威，并提供一个匹配的比较评估协议和分阶段部署路线图。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Biologically Informed Representation Learning for Robust Cross-Center Generalization of MALDI-TOF Mass Spectrometry
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models for MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry have shown considerable promise for clinical microbiology tasks such as microbial identification and antimicrobial resistance prediction. However, their deployment across institutions remains limited by domain shift, as acquisition-specific variability often leads models to capture technical artifacts rather than transferable biological information. Existing representation learning approaches primarily address this problem through statistical domain alignment while largely overlooking the biological supervision naturally available in microbiology datasets. We introduce DALMA, a probabilistic representation learning framework that jointly models acquisition-specific variability and biological supervision to learn biologically structured latent representations. By combining domain-specific reconstruction with biologically guided representation learning, DALMA learns transferable representations that generalize across heterogeneous clinical centers without requiring institution-specific components at inference, enabling zero-shot deployment on previously unseen sites. We evaluate DALMA on a multi-center benchmark comprising seven datasets from three countries. DALMA consistently achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot microbial identification across two held-out clinical centers, while the learned representations also transfer effectively to antimicrobial resistance prediction. Furthermore, latent-space novelty estimation enables reliable selective prediction under previously unseen domain shifts. These results demonstrate that biologically informed representation learning provides an effective strategy for robust and transferable ML in clinical microbiology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DALMA，一个概率表征学习框架，用于 MALDI-TOF 质谱数据的跨中心泛化。DALMA 联合建模采集特异性变异和生物监督，学习生物结构化的潜在表征，推理时无需机构特定组件，从而支持对未见过临床中心的零样本部署。在涵盖三个国家七个数据集的多中心基准上，DALMA 在两个留出临床中心上取得最优的零样本微生物鉴定性能，其表征也能迁移到抗菌药物耐药性预测。
Motivation: MALDI-TOF 质谱机器学习模型在不同机构间部署受限于领域偏移，模型常学到技术伪影而非可迁移的生物信息。现有表征学习方法主要通过统计域对齐解决该问题，却忽略了微生物数据集中天然可用的生物监督信息。
Method: 提出 DALMA 概率表征学习框架，将领域特异性重建与生物引导的表征学习相结合，以显式建模采集特异性变异并学习可迁移的生物结构表征。该方法在推理阶段不需要机构特定组件，支持对未见站点的零样本部署，并利用潜在空间中的新颖性估计实现选择性预测。
Result: 在多中心基准（三个国家、七个数据集）上，DALMA 在两个留出临床中心上持续取得零样本微生物鉴定的最优性能；学习到的表征还能有效迁移到抗菌药物耐药性预测，并在未见的领域偏移下实现可靠的选择性预测。
Conclusion: 作者认为，生物信息驱动的表征学习为临床微生物学中鲁棒且可迁移的机器学习提供了一种有效策略。摘要未报告与现有方法相比的具体数值改进，也未涉及方法在非质谱数据上的适用范围。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出 DALMA 概率表征学习框架，将领域特异性重建与生物引导的表征学习相结合，以显式建模采集特异性变异并学习可迁移的生物结构表征。该方法在推理阶段不需要机构特定组件，支持对未见站点的零样本部署，并利用潜在空间中的新颖性估计实现选择性预测。
summary_sections.result: 在多中心基准（三个国家、七个数据集）上，DALMA 在两个留出临床中心上持续取得零样本微生物鉴定的最优性能；学习到的表征还能有效迁移到抗菌药物耐药性预测，并在未见的领域偏移下实现可靠的选择性预测。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，生物信息驱动的表征学习为临床微生物学中鲁棒且可迁移的机器学习提供了一种有效策略。摘要未报告与现有方法相比的具体数值改进，也未涉及方法在非质谱数据上的适用范围。

papers.title: A Grounded and Decomposed Framework for Relation-Level Hallucination Evaluation in Abstractive Summarization
papers.abstract_en: Abstractive text summarization systems frequently generate fluent yet unfaithful summaries by fabricating or distorting relationships between entities and events. Such relation-level hallucinations undermine the reliability of generated summaries, particularly in high-stakes domains. In this work, we present a refined and grounded framework for evaluating relation hallucination in abstractive summarization. We present the empirical Relation Hallucination Index (RHI) by introducing a dependency-aware relation extraction algorithm that incorporates lemmatization-based normalization, named entity grounded subject resolution, passive agent recovery, negation-aware verb modeling, reporting verb filtering, nominal relation fallback, clausal propagation, and systematic deduplication. These enhancements improve the structural fidelity of extracted relation triples and reduce spurious matches during evaluation. In addition, we introduce a normalized formulation of RHI to ensure scale-invariant comparison between datasets and models. The revised metric decomposes hallucination into interpretable components, aggregates relation hallucination metric into a normalized relation faithfulness score. Extensive evaluation across multiple state-of-the-art summarization models demonstrates that the grounded extraction process yields more stable and discriminative hallucination measurements. The proposed framework advances automated relation-level faithfulness evaluation and supports coherence-aware, hallucination-sensitive model analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于语法依赖和实体锚定的关系级幻觉评估框架，用于抽象式摘要 (abstractive summarization)。作者给出经验性的关系幻觉指数 (Relation Hallucination Index, RHI)，通过依赖感知的关系抽取算法与归一化公式，将幻觉分解为可解释成分并聚合为归一化的关系忠实度分数。在多个 SOTA 摘要模型上的评估表明，该抽取过程能产生更稳定、更具区分度的幻觉测量。
Motivation: 抽象式摘要系统常生成流畅但不忠实的摘要，通过捏造或扭曲实体与事件之间的关系产生关系级幻觉 (relation-level hallucination)，这在高风险领域会严重损害摘要的可靠性。
Method: 提出基于语言结构的关系幻觉评估框架：实现依赖感知的关系抽取算法，包含词形还原归一化、命名实体锚定的主语消解、被动语态施事恢复、否定感知动词建模、转述动词过滤、名词性关系回退、从句传播和系统去重；并引入 RHI 的归一化形式，使不同数据集和模型之间的比较尺度不变。
Result: 在多种 SOTA 摘要模型上的广泛评估显示，基于锚定 (grounded) 的抽取过程能产生更稳定、更具判别力的幻觉测量结果；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 该框架推进了自动化的关系级忠实度评估，并支持一致性感知、幻觉敏感的模型分析。

papers.title: Matching Supervision to the Student's Learning Capacity: A Unified Framework for On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves the reasoning abilities of LLMs by internalizing privileged context into model parameters through self-distillation. Two recent research lines promote vanilla OPSD by choosing which tokens to learn from and by controlling how much privileged information the teacher receives, respectively. However, we show that each line optimizes one variable while holding the other fixed, which leads to a suboptimal solution. We argue that the two variables are coupled through the student's learning capacity: the privileged information sets the per-token divergence the teacher prescribes, while token weighting selects which of these the student must absorb. We formalize the two lines of work into a unified optimization framework, which maximizes the aggregate teacher--student divergence, subject to a budget on the aggregate learning difficulty the student can absorb. Under this modelling, we propose Unified On-Policy Self-Distillation (USD), a lightweight online algorithm to solve the Lagrangian. USD reveals that a single dual variable governs both decisions: at one price for learning difficulty, it simultaneously sets the token-selection threshold and the direction of privileged-information adjustment, keeping supervision matched to the student's evolving capacity. Through extensive experiments, USD consistently demonstrates superior performance over OPSD and token- and PI-side baselines across various model scales on various reasoning benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/lauvlalala/USD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对在线自蒸馏 (on-policy self-distillation, OPSD) 在 LLM 推理能力提升上的两种改进路线——选择从哪些 token 学习、以及控制教师接收多少特权信息——指出它们各自只优化一个变量而固定另一个，因而次优。作者将两条路线统一为带学习难度预算的优化框架，提出轻量在线算法 USD 求解 Lagrangian，用一个对偶变量同时控制 token 选择阈值与特权信息调整方向。摘要报告 USD 在多种模型规模和多种推理基准上一致优于 OPSD 及 token 侧和 PI 侧基线。
Motivation: 现有的 OPSD 改进要么只优化 token 选择、要么只优化教师接收的特权信息量，两者相互独立导致次优解；作者认为这两个变量通过学生的学习容量耦合，需要统一建模。
Method: 形式化一个统一优化框架，在聚合学习难度预算约束下最大化聚合的教师-学生散度 (teacher–student divergence)；提出 USD (Unified On-Policy Self-Distillation)，一个轻量在线算法求解 Lagrangian，其中单一对偶变量同时决定 token 选择阈值和特权信息调整方向。
Result: 摘要报告在多种模型规模和多个推理基准上，USD 一致优于 OPSD 以及 token 侧与 PI 侧的基线方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调单一对偶变量可以把监督信号与学生的动态学习容量相匹配，从而让自蒸馏更高效；代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: $\texttt{DisMorph}$: learning to disentangle technical distortions from true biological change
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal MRI enables sensitive measurement of structural brain change for studying aging and neurodegenerative disease. Deformable image registration is a key tool for estimating such change by computing a dense deformation that captures geometric differences between longitudinal scans. However, MRI scanners introduce geometric distortions that vary across acquisition systems and protocols, such as gradient non-linearity (GNL) distortion. Existing registration methods estimate a single field that conflates biological and technical effects, potentially biasing downstream morphometric measurements if distortions remain (partially) uncorrected. We propose $\texttt{DisMorph}$, a registration framework trained entirely on synthetic data that explicitly decomposes longitudinal deformation into technical and anatomical transforms. It predicts two dense deformations, each encoding one effect. During training, a novel generative model synthesizes both effects separately to provide disentanglement supervision, while domain randomization promotes generalization across imaging protocols. We evaluate our method in three complementary settings. On simulated data with known ground truth, our method detects anatomical change more accurately and consistently than conventional registration. On real image pairs that differ only by GNL distortion, our method assigns most geometric change to the distortion field, demonstrating specificity in the absence of anatomical change. On longitudinal Alzheimer's disease (AD) pairs, our method detects anatomical change in AD-related brain structures while identifying residual distortion left after standard correction. By disentangling MRI-induced distortion from biological change in the longitudinal deformation, our method paves the way for more accurate longitudinal morphometry in clinical settings where maintaining acquisition consistency is challenging.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, longitudinal morphometry, deformable registration, neuroimaging, domain randomization, gradient non-linearity distortion, accepted by the SASHIMI Workshop at MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DisMorph，一个完全在合成数据上训练的配准框架，用于将纵向 MRI 的形变分解为技术性形变（如梯度非线性 GNL 畸变）与真实解剖变化。方法同时预测两个稠密形变场，并通过生成模型分别合成两类效应提供解缠监督，配合域随机化提升跨协议泛化。在模拟数据、仅含 GNL 畸变的真实图像对以及纵向阿尔茨海默病（AD）数据上，该方法相比传统配准更准确地检测解剖变化，并能将畸变归因到对应场。
Motivation: 纵向 MRI 中，变形配准常把生物变化与扫描仪几何畸变混在一个形变场里，若畸变未完全校正会偏置下游形态测量；现有方法缺少将技术效应与解剖变化分离的机制。
Method: 提出 DisMorph，纯合成数据训练的配准框架，显式解耦纵向形变为技术变换与解剖变换，预测两个稠密形变场；训练时用新生成模型分别合成两类效应以提供解缠监督，并用域随机化提升跨成像协议的泛化性。
Result: 在已知真值的模拟数据上，比传统配准更准确且更一致地检测解剖变化；在仅存在 GNL 畸变的真实图像对上，将大部分几何变化归因于畸变场；在纵向 AD 数据上能检测 AD 相关脑区解剖变化，同时识别标准校正后残留的畸变。
Conclusion: 解缠 MRI 畸变与生物变化有助于在采集一致性难以维持的临床环境中实现更准确的纵向形态测量。

papers.title: Wiener Representation Filtering for VLM Hallucination Suppression
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) excel at open-ended captioning and visual QA but often describe objects, attributes, or relations absent from the image, a phenomenon known as object hallucination. We propose a {training-free, post-hoc representation editing technique} that operates in the representation space of the language backbone. The method performs a lightweight, one-time offline calibration on a modest paired dataset to estimate the required covariance structures, using only forward passes and empirical second-order statistics with no gradient updates or fine-tuning, after which the correction is absorbed directly into the model's existing weights. By modeling hidden states as a superposition of truthful and hallucination-associated components, we derive a Wiener-type estimator whose optimal gains are given in closed form from the covariances of paired truthful and hallucinated representations. An eigendecomposition yields mode-wise attenuation that respects a stability criterion, i.e., the filter responds continuously to estimation noise. The correction is applied once to the feed-forward output projections of selected deeper layers, at inference time, the model runs unchanged and at the same speed. Experiments on LLaVA-1.5, MiniGPT-4, Gemma3, and mPLUG-Owl2 demonstrate consistent reductions in object hallucination on CHAIR, POPE, and MME while maintaining caption fluency and overall response quality. We further demonstrate the generality of our approach on the TempCompass video understanding benchmark and on discrete diffusion language models for grounded dialogue, showing that representation filtering reduces hallucinations even in temporal video reasoning and multi-step, sequence-wide denoising settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练、事后(post-hoc)的表示编辑技术，在视觉语言模型(VLM)语言骨干的表示空间中抑制目标幻觉(object hallucination)。方法通过轻量级一次性离线校准估计协方差结构，仅使用前向传播和二阶统计量，不进行梯度更新或微调，并将校正直接吸收进模型现有权重。作者将隐状态建模为真实与幻觉相关成分的叠加，推导出 Wiener 型估计器，其最优增益由成对真实/幻觉表示的协方差闭式给出；特征分解得到满足稳定性准则的按模式衰减。推理时模型保持不变、速度不变，并在多个 VLM 及视频理解等任务上验证了效果。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在开放式描述和视觉问答中常描述图像中不存在的物体、属性或关系，即目标幻觉，这影响模型的可靠性。
Method: 提出基于 Wiener 表示的滤波校正：用配对真实与幻觉表示估计协方差，将校正投影吸收进选定的深层前馈输出权重；通过对协方差做特征分解实现按模式衰减，并加入稳定性准则使滤波器对估计噪声连续响应。
Result: 在 LLaVA-1.5、MiniGPT-4、Gemma3 和 mPLUG-Owl2 上，该方法在 CHAIR、POPE、MME 基准上一致降低目标幻觉，同时保持描述流畅性和整体响应质量；在 TempCompass 视频理解基准和离散扩散语言模型上，表示滤波也减少了时间视频推理及多步序列级去噪中的幻觉。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法无需训练、推理时零额外开销，且可推广到视频时序推理和离散扩散语言模型的对话生成场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Predicting blood clot growth from sparse post-onset measurements with latent neural differential equations
papers.abstract_en: Computational models of blood clotting improve understanding of thrombus formation, but their clinical application remains limited because many model inputs are difficult to measure and patient-specific data are often sparse. We present a computational framework based on latent neural differential equations that infers unknown model parameters from sparse measurements and forecasts thrombosis progression. We demonstrate the framework using data generated from a multiphysics blood-clotting model in which clot growth is governed by the coagulation cascade and diffusion. Four known biochemical inputs (fibrinogen and factors IX, VIII, and V), together with sparse early clot-size observations, are used to infer the tissue-factor parameter and predict subsequent clot growth. We compare seven probabilistic methods: stochastic neural ordinary differential equations (SNODE), stochastic neural functional differential equations (SNFDE), a latent neural-process baseline, a monotone probabilistic deep ensemble, empirical trajectory retrieval, PCA-ridge Gaussian posterior, and Gompertz-curve retrieval. SNODE achieved the best performance in inferring the unknown input and forecasting future clot-growth trajectories. SNFDE performed similarly and consistently outperformed the other non-differential models. Prediction accuracy improved as more observations became available, whereas longer forecasting horizons increased uncertainty and decreased accuracy. Latent neural differential equations thus effectively combine parameter inference and clot-growth forecasting from sparse measurements, providing a promising foundation for personalized thrombosis modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于潜神经微分方程（latent neural differential equations）的计算框架，从稀疏测量中推断未知模型参数并预测血栓进展。作者用多物理场凝血模型生成数据，以纤维蛋白原和凝血因子 IX、VIII、V 以及稀疏早期凝块尺寸观测为输入，推断组织因子参数并预测后续凝块生长。在七种概率方法对比中，SNODE 在参数推断和轨迹预测上表现最佳，SNFDE 表现相近且优于其余非微分模型。
Motivation: 计算凝血模型有助于理解血栓形成，但许多模型输入难以测量且患者数据稀疏，导致其临床应用受限。
Method: 构建潜神经微分方程框架，利用稀疏早期凝块尺寸观测与四个已知生化输入推断未知的组织因子参数，并据此预测后续凝块生长；同时比较 SNODE、SNFDE、潜神经过程基线、单调概率深度集成、经验轨迹检索、PCA-ridge 高斯后验和 Gompertz 曲线检索七种方法。
Result: 摘要报告 SNODE 在推断未知输入和预测未来凝块生长轨迹上性能最佳，SNFDE 表现类似且一致优于其他非微分模型；观测越充足预测越准确，预测时域越长则不确定性越大、精度越低。
Conclusion: 潜神经微分方程能有效结合参数推断与凝块生长预测，为个性化血栓建模提供了有前景的基础。

papers.title: STEMMA: An Adversarial Multi-Agent Framework for Evaluating Self-Identity Consistency in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge Distillation is a widely adopted technique in the training and fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) enabling transfer of structured information and functional behavior from a large teacher model to a smaller student model while significantly reducing computational costs. However, as the use of distillation increases in both scale and complexity it raises an important question about what kind of knowledge is really transferred from the teacher model. In this work, we argue that apart from the functional knowledge, student models also learn behavioral patterns, specifically how a model represents its own identity raising concerns about output homogeneity, model biases, and accountability. To address this challenge, we introduce STEMMA, a multi-modal and multi-agent framework in which role specific agents collaboratively probe self identification behavior in different models. We also contribute a set of adversarial prompts designed manually to evaluate identity consistency in LLMs. Our results show that to an extent most models are vulnerable to inconsistencies in self-representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STEMMA，一个多模态多智能体（multi-modal multi-agent）框架，用于评估大语言模型（LLM）的自我身份一致性（self-identity consistency）。作者认为知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）不仅迁移功能知识，还会让学生模型继承教师模型的自我表征行为模式，从而引发输出同质性、模型偏见和问责问题。摘要报告大部分被测模型在一定程度上都容易受到自我表征不一致的影响。
Motivation: 知识蒸馏在大模型训练与微调中被广泛采用，但以往关注点在于功能知识的迁移；本文指出学生模型还会学到教师模型的行为模式，特别是模型对自身身份的表征方式，这关系到输出同质性与可问责性，是一个尚未被充分研究的问题。
Method: 引入 STEMMA 框架，采用多模态多智能体的方式，由角色特定的智能体协作探测不同模型的自识别（self-identification）行为；同时贡献一组手工设计的对抗性提示（adversarial prompts）来评估 LLM 的身份一致性。
Result: 结果表明，大多数被测模型在一定程度上容易在自我表征上出现不一致（inconsistencies in self-representations）。
Conclusion: 作者强调知识蒸馏可能传递身份相关的行为模式，STEMMA 可以作为暴露这类身份一致性漏洞的评估工具；摘要未给出具体基准或量化结果。

papers.title: Agentic AI-driven Immersive Simulation: A Knowledge-Aware Virtual Training Platform forHigh Dose Rate (HDR) Brachytherapy
papers.abstract_en: The convergence of the Metaverse and Large Language Model (LLM)-based AI agent is catalyzing a shift toward autonomous, immersive, and personalized pedagogical frameworks in medical education. This paper presents a novel agentic AI-driven immersive simulation specifically designed for High Dose Rate (HDR) vaginal cylinder (VC) brachytherapy in cancer care. By integrating Virtual Reality (VR) and mobile computing, the system establishes a high-fidelity, risk-free environment that allows trainees to master complex procedural skills without the facility or safety constraints posed by physical anatomy or live radioactive sources. A core contribution of this work is the seamless integration of a knowledge-aware assistant leveraging Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to ground agent interactions in authoritative clinical guidelines. This architecture also enables an interactive agent to provide natural language interfaces and hands-free, real-time guidance during intricate medical maneuvers. We validate the proposed system through a prototype deployment comprising a Meta Quest 3 interface linked to a local GPU-accelerated AI backend, demonstrating a feasible architecture for HDR brachytherapy simulation. Experimental results indicate that the system maintains suitable end-to-end latency and high context precision, answer completeness, and relevance in the RAG-enhanced pedagogical support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向高剂量率 (HDR) 阴道筒 (VC) 近距离放疗的智能体驱动沉浸式模拟训练平台，结合虚拟现实 (VR) 和移动计算构建无风险、高保真的技能训练环境。系统核心是将基于检索增强生成 (RAG) 的知识感知助手集成进 LLM 智能体，使其能够依据权威临床指南提供自然语言交互和无手操作的实时引导。作者通过 Meta Quest 3 搭配本地 GPU 加速 AI 后端的原型验证了架构可行性，并报告端到端延迟合适、RAG 教学支持的上下文精确度、回答完整性和相关性较高。
Motivation: HDR 近距离放疗等复杂医疗操作技能训练受限于物理解剖和活体放射源带来的设施与安全约束，难以在真实环境中反复练习；同时医学教育正朝着自主、沉浸和个性化方向发展，需要一种无风险、高保真的模拟训练方案。
Method: 提出一个智能体驱动的沉浸式模拟系统，集成 VR 和移动计算以构建高保真训练环境；核心贡献是引入基于检索增强生成 (RAG) 的知识感知助手，将智能体交互锚定在权威临床指南上，并通过交互智能体提供自然语言接口和手术过程中的免提实时指导。验证采用 Meta Quest 3 前端连接本地 GPU 加速 AI 后端的原型架构。
Result: 原型验证表明系统能够维持合适的端到端延迟，并在 RAG 增强的教学支持中实现较高的上下文精确度、回答完整性和相关性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为该架构为 HDR 近距离放疗模拟提供了一条可行路径，强调将 RAG 与 LLM 智能体结合以基于临床指南进行知识支撑是系统的核心价值。

papers.title: Can LLM Agents Stick to the Script? A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Consistency in Interactive Narratives
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) is revolutionizing AI for Games by enabling open-ended and fluid interactive storytelling. However, existing research has largely overlooked the critical challenge of maintaining long-horizon logical consistency and narrative integrity against unconstrained user interventions. To address this, we formulate this challenge as Narrative Commitment Preservation (NCP), and take interactive narrative as our testbed. We introduce NCP-Bench, a benchmark of 100 narrative environments derived from movie synopses. Each environment includes a structured narrative specification (trajectory, commitments, and initial facts) that we can automatically check throughout the interaction between the player agent and the narrator agent. Experiments across state-of-the-art LLMs reveal a substantial long-horizon consistency gap: high linguistic quality does not guarantee commitment preservation; even strong models frequently generate logically conflicting content under adversarial interventions, with the best-performing model (GPT-5.2) achieving only 42% survival rate after 20 turns and fact conflict rates ranging from 40% to 68% across models, and only isolated runs satisfying all achievement commitments within the 100-turn limit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出交互式叙事中长程一致性问题并将其形式化为叙事情节承诺保持 (Narrative Commitment Preservation, NCP)，据此构建基准 NCP-Bench，包含从电影梗概衍生的 100 个叙事环境。每个环境带有可自动检查的结构化叙事规格（轨迹、承诺、初始事实），用于评测叙事者智能体与玩家智能体交互过程中的一致性。实验显示现有强 LLM 存在显著的长程一致性缺口：最高语言质量并不保证承诺保持，最佳模型 GPT-5.2 在 20 回合后的存活率仅为 42%，各模型的事实冲突率在 40% 到 68% 之间，且几乎没有运行能在 100 回合限制内满足所有成就承诺。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 驱动的开放交互式叙事研究大多关注生成流畅度，忽视了在用户不受约束干预下维持长时段逻辑一致性与叙事完整性的关键挑战。
Method: 将挑战形式化为 NCP，并以交互式叙事为测试平台；构建包含 100 个叙事环境的 NCP-Bench，每个环境由轨迹、承诺和初始事实构成结构化规格，可在玩家智能体与叙事者智能体的整个交互过程中自动检查。
Result: 跨多个 SOTA LLM 的实验表明存在实质性长程一致性差距：最佳模型 GPT-5.2 在 20 回合后存活率仅 42%，各模型事实冲突率介于 40% 至 68%，并且仅在个别运行中能在 100 回合限制内满足全部成就承诺。
Conclusion: 摘要强调高质量语言输出并不能保证叙事承诺的保持，现有模型在对抗性干预下仍频繁生成逻辑冲突内容，说明 NCP 是值得专门评测与改进的方向。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Is a Steerable Concept Representation Real? Measurement Confounds in a Cross-Family Audit of Neuroscience Parallels in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly reported to exhibit human-like neural and cognitive signatures, including concept cells, mental number lines, and cognitive maps. These claims often rely on linear probing and activation steering applied to a single model, yet both methods are highly sensitive to measurement choices. A reported parallel may therefore reflect the model, the measurement procedure, or both. We audit four representative neuroscience-inspired paradigms across 17 models from five families, spanning $0.6$B to $72$B parameters. Our main experiment examines the causal steerability of concept directions. With raw activation units and a fixed layer and coefficient, steerability appears to increase with model scale, resembling an emergent capability. However, this pattern is produced by an uncalibrated pipeline rather than by a claim established in the steering literature. The trend depends jointly on raw units, the readout metric, and the operating point; correcting any one of these removes it. With residual-norm-comparable interventions and held-out operating-point selection, concept steering remains significant at every scale, but shows no significant trend across the Qwen3 series, although the confidence interval does not rule out a moderate positive slope. The remaining results are mixed. A linear geographic world map is consistently decodable in every tested checkpoint up to $72$B. Number magnitude is strongly encoded, but whether individual neurons appear bell-shaped or monotonic depends on the selection criterion. Language-specific structure is localizable, but the direction of the cross-lingual asymmetry reverses under a different attribution method. These results suggest that the main constraint on AI neuroscience is not a lack of phenomena, but a lack of comparable measurements and adequate controls. We release the protocol, stimuli, and code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 LLM 中所谓人类化神经与认知表征（概念细胞、心理数字线、认知地图等）进行跨模型审计，覆盖 5 个模型家族、17 个检查点，参数规模 0.6B 到 72B。核心实验检验概念方向的可引导性（steerability），发现原始激活单位下随规模增长的表观涌现趋势其实来自未校准的测量流程，而非稳定的模型能力；在校正测量后，概念引导在各级规模仍然显著但不再表现出明确趋势。其余结果混杂：地理世界地图在所有检查点可解码，数字量值编码较强，但神经元形状与跨语言不对称的结论依赖测量或归因选择。作者认为 AI 神经科学的主要瓶颈不是缺少现象，而是缺少可比较的测量和充分对照，并发布了协议、刺激与代码。
Motivation: 现有文献常基于单一模型上的线性探针和激活引导（activation steering）声称 LLM 具有人脑样表征，但这两类方法对测量选择高度敏感，因此所报告的平行现象可能来自模型、测量流程或二者共同作用，缺乏跨模型审计与对照。
Method: 对四个神经科学启发的代表性范式进行审计，主要实验检验概念方向的可引导性；通过对比原始激活单位与残差范数可比的干预，以及固定操作点与留出操作点（operating point）选择，并换用不同归因方法检验跨语言不对称，来区分真实能力与测量伪影。
Result: 在原始激活单位、固定层和系数下，可引导性随模型规模上升，看似涌现，但该趋势取决于原始单位、读出指标和操作点，修正任一因素即消失；采用可比较干预和留出操作点后，概念引导在各规模仍显著，但在 Qwen3 系列上没有显著趋势，置信区间不排除中等正斜率。线性地理世界地图在所有测试检查点（至 72B）均可解码；数字量值编码很强，但单个神经元呈钟形还是单调依赖选择标准；语言特异性结构可定位，但跨语言不对称方向在不同归因方法下反转。

papers.title: A Unified Framework for Dynamic Reward Shaping in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Sparse, delayed, and weakly informative rewards remain central obstacles to efficient reinforcement learning. Reward shaping addresses these limitations by supplementing the task reward with an auxiliary signal that can accelerate learning while, in the classical setting, the original objective remains the evaluation criterion. Established theory guarantees safety for fixed shaping signals: potential-based reward shaping preserves optimal policies when the auxiliary term is the discounted difference of a time-invariant potential. In contemporary reinforcement learning systems, however, both the learner and the information available for guidance evolve during training: value estimates improve, novelty diminishes, feedback shifts, and predictive models are refined. Adaptive reward mechanisms occur across exploration, Bayesian inference, human-in-the-loop learning, automated reward design, and foundation-model-based approaches. This study introduces a unified analytical framework for comparing dynamic reward shaping and neighbouring adaptive reward mechanisms. The proposed framework distinguishes parametric revision from state-dependent variation, separates additive shaping from reward replacement and reward-adjacent guidance, and organises existing methods along temporal, informational, and theoretical dimensions. Using this framework, twelve method families are comparatively analysed. The framework further highlights the conditions under which optimality guarantees survive contemporary deep reinforcement learning pipelines, replay buffers, bootstrapped critics, and reward normalisation, while exposing the unresolved relationship between adaptation rate and learner stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习中稀疏、延迟和弱信息奖励的问题，提出一个统一分析框架来比较动态奖励塑形 (dynamic reward shaping) 与邻近的自适应奖励机制。框架区分参数修正与状态依赖变化，分离加性塑形与奖励替换、奖励邻近引导，并沿时间、信息和理论三个维度组织现有方法。作者用该框架对比分析了十二个方法族，并考察最优性保证在当代深度强化学习管线中的存续条件。
Motivation: 经典势函数奖励塑形 (potential-based reward shaping) 理论只对时不变势函数保证最优策略保持，而当代强化学习系统中学习者和可用引导信息都在训练中演化，奖励自适应机制大量出现却缺乏统一比较框架。
Method: 提出一个统一分析框架，从时间、信息和理论维度对动态奖励塑形及邻近自适应奖励机制进行分类，区分参数修正与状态依赖变化、加性塑形与奖励替换/奖励邻近引导，并据此对十二个方法族进行对比分析。
Result: 摘要未报告数值结果，主要贡献是框架性分析：指出最优性保证在深度强化学习管线、回放缓冲区、bootstrapped critic 和奖励归一化条件下存续的条件，同时暴露了适应速率与学习者稳定性之间尚未解决的关系。
Conclusion: 该框架强调现代深度强化学习管线中奖励塑形最优性保证的存续条件，并指出适应速率与学习者稳定性之间的关系仍然是未解决问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Hybrid Nested Harness for Decoupling Structure and Parameters in LLM-Driven Optimization
papers.abstract_en: In evolutionary algorithms powered by language models, the LLM acts as a single operator that simultaneously updates structural components (like control flow) and continuous parameters. While LLMs can be good at the first, they are not efficient at the second, wasting tokens taking discrete jumps inside a trial and error loop. We resolve this by formalizing a hybrid nested search, in which an outer loop has the LLM propose a structural sketch, with numeric gaps, and an inner numerical optimizer tunes the sketch. Both the outer and inner solvers are pluggable: any text-based optimizer can be combined with a zero-order optimizer (CMA-ES), gradient-based routines, or MCMC samplers. We validate our framework across three scientific domains: (i) meta-optimizers on closed-form test functions, (ii) code-based policies for systems research and social dilemmas; and (iii) approximate Bayesian inference tasks. Across all three, the hybrid optimizer is superior to both vanilla LLM-driven search and pure numerical optimization baselines. Code at: https://github.com/vicgalle/hybrid-nested-search
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at LM4Sci Workshop @ COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合嵌套搜索框架 (hybrid nested search)，用于解耦 LLM 驱动的优化问题中的结构搜索与连续参数调优。外层循环由 LLM 提出带数值空位的结构草图，内层数值优化器负责填充并调优参数；内外求解器均可插拔。作者在三个科学领域的任务上验证，混合优化器优于纯 LLM 驱动搜索和纯数值优化基线，代码已开源。
Motivation: 在基于语言模型的进化算法中，LLM 通常作为单一算子同时更新结构组件（如控制流）和连续参数，而 LLM 对参数级精调效率低下，会在试错循环中浪费大量 token。
Method: 将优化形式化为混合嵌套搜索：外层循环用 LLM 提出带数值空位的结构草图，内层用数值优化器（如零阶优化器 CMA-ES、基于梯度的例程或 MCMC 采样器）调优草图；外循环和内循环均可替换为任意文本优化器或数值优化器。
Result: 在三个科学领域（闭式测试函数上的元优化器、系统研究和社会困境的基于代码的策略、近似贝叶斯推断任务）上，混合优化器均优于 vanilla LLM 驱动搜索与纯数值优化基线。
Conclusion: 作者强调解耦结构提议与参数优化可以提升 LLM 驱动搜索的效率，该框架的插拔式设计使其具有跨领域通用性。摘要未涉及明显局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Exact Zarankiewicz Values On Two Finite Frontier Slices
papers.abstract_en: The Zarankiewicz number Z(m,n,s,t) is the maximum number of edges in a bipartite graph with parts of orders m and n containing no copy of Ks,t. We give one combined, certificate-based computer-assisted proof for two finite slices and a corrected neighboring frontier: Z(12,n,3,3) = 6n (18 <= n <= 22), Z(13,22,3,3) = 137, Z(13, 18, 3, 3) = 116, Z(14, 18, 3, 3) = 124, Z(15,18,3,3) = 132, Z(14, 17, 3, 3) = 118, Z(15, 17, 3, 3) = 126, 132 <= Z(16,17,3,3) <= 133. The load-bearing new upper bounds are the exact 12 x 18 and 13 x 18 certificate packages. Their orbit certificates exclude every hypothetical matrix at the next edge count. Deletion lemmas and explicit witnesses close four neighboring cells, while the 16 x 17 entry is deliberately reported as an interval because only its 132-edge lower witness and the published 133 upper bound are certified here. Separately, the 13 x 22 proof excludes 138 ones by reducing to 83 degree profiles, rationally separating 77 of them, and eliminating the remaining six by marked-row congruences, leave enumeration, modular Gram tests, and exact Farkas certificates. All accepted claims are replayed by standard-library Python and exact integer/rational arithmetic; floating-point optimization is used only to discover certificates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Zarankiewicz 数 Z(m,n,s,t)，即不含完全二分图 K_{s,t} 的二分图的最大边数，并给出一个组合的、基于证书（certificate）的计算机辅助证明，覆盖两个有限前沿切片并修正相邻边界值。摘要报告了多个精确值和区间，包括 Z(12,n,3,3)=6n（18≤n≤22）、Z(13,22,3,3)=137、Z(13,18,3,3)=116、Z(14,18,3,3)=124、Z(15,18,3,3)=132、Z(14,17,3,3)=118、Z(15,17,3,3)=126，以及 132≤Z(16,17,3,3)≤133。
Motivation: Zarankiewicz 数在极值图论中具有基础重要性，但精确值往往难以计算；论文针对有限尺寸切片给出精确或收紧的边界，并特别修正了相邻前沿处此前的结果。
Method: 采用统一的证书式计算机辅助证明：轨道证书（orbit certificates）排除下一边数下的所有假设矩阵；删除引理（deletion lemmas）与显式构造（witnesses）封闭四个相邻单元格；13×22 的证明将排除 138 个 1 的问题约化为 83 个度分布，并用有理分离、标记行同余、leave 枚举、模 Gram 检验和精确 Farkas 证书处理。全部被接受结论由标准库 Python 和精确整数/有理算术回放，浮点优化仅用于发现证书。
Result: 摘要给出的主要结果为：Z(12,n,3,3)=6n（18≤n≤22），Z(13,22,3,3)=137，Z(13,18,3,3)=116，Z(14,18,3,3)=124，Z(15,18,3,3)=132，Z(14,17,3,3)=118，Z(15,17,3,3)=126，以及 132≤Z(16,17,3,3)≤133；承重的新上界是精确的 12×18 和 13×18 证书包。
Conclusion: 作者强调 16×17 的条目被有意报告为区间，因为这里只保证了 132 边的下界构造与已发表的 133 上界；所有被接受的论断都能用精确整数/有理算术复现，浮点只用于证书发现阶段。

papers.title: Learning Structural Illumination for Unsupervised Low-light Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Existing unsupervised low-light image enhancement (LLIE) methods often estimate illumination directly from the entire low-light input, without separating its spatially varying illumination pattern, termed relative illumination structure, from the absolute exposure level or preventing unreliable low signal-to-noise ratio regions from biasing the estimate. Moreover, fixed exposure targets impose a scene-agnostic enhancement criterion, limiting adaptation across diverse lighting conditions. Inspired by the spatial propagation of light, we propose a Relative Illumination Structure Estimation (RISE) framework that decouples relative illumination structure from absolute exposure and infers it from reliable bright regions, enabling interpretable and robust enhancement. For scene-adaptive exposure adjustment, we further propose a Dual-Metering Exposure Reference derived from each input, allowing RISE to adapt the enhancement strength to individual scenes and generalize across diverse lighting conditions. Extensive benchmark and real-world generalization experiments show that RISE achieves state-of-the-art performance among unsupervised LLIE methods while producing visually natural results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出无监督低光图像增强 (unsupervised low-light image enhancement, LLIE) 框架 RISE，将相对光照结构 (relative illumination structure) 与绝对曝光水平解耦，并只从可靠亮区推断该结构，以避免低信噪比区域干扰估计。进一步引入由每张输入导出的 Dual-Metering Exposure Reference，实现场景自适应的曝光调整。实验表明 RISE 在无监督 LLIE 方法中达到当前最优性能并生成视觉自然的结果。
Motivation: 现有无监督 LLIE 方法通常直接从整个低光输入估计光照，既没有把空间上变化的相对光照结构与绝对曝光水平分离，也没有防止低信噪比 (low signal-to-noise ratio) 区域对估计造成偏差；同时固定曝光目标使增强准则与场景无关，难以适应多样光照条件。
Method: 受光的空间传播启发，提出 RISE 框架，将相对光照结构与绝对曝光解耦，并从可靠亮区推断相对光照结构，以支持可解释且鲁棒的增强。为进行场景自适应的曝光调整，进一步提出由每个输入自身导出的 Dual-Metering Exposure Reference，据此调整增强强度。
Result: 在多个基准数据集和真实世界泛化实验上，RISE 在无监督 LLIE 方法中取得当前最优性能，并产生视觉自然的结果；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将相对光照结构估计与场景自适应曝光参考结合，可以提升增强的鲁棒性与可解释性，并实现对不同光照条件的泛化。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出无监督低光图像增强 (unsupervised low-light image enhancement, LLIE) 框架 RISE，将相对光照结构 (relative illumination structure) 与绝对曝光水平解耦，并只从可靠亮区推断该结构，以避免低信噪比区域干扰估计。进一步引入由每张输入导出的 Dual-Metering Exposure Reference，实现场景自适应的曝光调整。实验表明 RISE 在无监督 LLIE 方法中达到当前最优性能并生成视觉自然的结果。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有无监督 LLIE 方法通常直接从整个低光输入估计光照，既没有把空间上变化的相对光照结构与绝对曝光水平分离，也没有防止低信噪比 (low signal-to-noise ratio) 区域对估计造成偏差；同时固定曝光目标使增强准则与场景无关，难以适应多样光照条件。

papers.title: DoGMA: A Central-Dogma-Guided Foundation Model for Multi-Omics Alignment and Multi-Task Learning in Oncology
authors: Cheng Jin (1) ((1) Institute of Medical Robotics
University of Shanghai for Science and Technology)
papers.abstract_en: Attention mechanisms have been widely utilized in modern deep learning, and many existing multi-omics models inherit their conventional use to allow unrestricted bidirectional interactions. However, the fundamental logic of life is directional. Existing designs often overlook the directionality suggested by the central dogma, potentially limiting transfer across heterogeneous cancers, downstream tasks, and incomplete modality settings.In this work, we present DoGMA, a central-dogma-guided foundation model for pan-cancer multi-omics analysis, arguing that robust transfer requires representations with domain-specific inductive bias. Concretely, we build it on a Transformer-MoE architecture where directed attention biases inter-omics communication toward central-dogma information flow. We further pretrain our model with masked hierarchical omics reconstruction to guide it toward learning central-dogma-consistent interactions. Across diverse downstream tasks, including cancer representation learning, survival prediction, and metastasis prediction, DoGMA consistently demonstrates strong predictive performance. Ablations and analyses further suggest that the performance gains arise from the synergy between central-dogma-guided directed attention and reconstruction-based pretraining, which together promote more biologically consistent cross-omics information exchange. Overall, DoGMA demonstrates that domain-specific inductive biases can improve the robustness and transferability of multi-omics foundation models, offering new insights into the design of attention mechanisms for multi-omics representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DoGMA，一个以中心法则（central dogma）为导向的泛癌多组学基础模型，采用 Transformer-MoE 架构，通过定向注意力（directed attention）约束组学间的信息流，并用掩码分层组学重建（masked hierarchical omics reconstruction）进行预训练。摘要报告其在癌症表示学习、生存预测和转移预测等下游任务上表现良好，消融分析表明性能提升来自中心法则定向注意力与重建预训练的协同作用。
Motivation: 现有深度学习的注意力机制允许无约束的双向交互，但生命信息流动本质上是方向性的；已有模型忽略中心法则的方向性，可能限制跨癌种、下游任务及模态不完整场景下的迁移能力。
Method: 构建基于 Transformer-MoE 的模型，引入中心法则引导的定向注意力偏置，使组间通信符合中心法则信息流；同时使用掩码分层组学重建进行预训练，以学习与中心法则一致的多组学交互。
Result: 在癌症表示学习、生存预测与转移预测等多样下游任务上，DoGMA 一致表现出较强的预测性能；消融与分析表明，性能增益源于中心法则定向注意力与重建预训练之间的协同。
Conclusion: 论文认为，将领域特定的归纳偏置（如中心法则方向性）引入多组学基础模型可提升跨癌种的鲁棒性和可迁移性，并为多组学表示学习中的注意力机制设计提供新思路。

papers.title: Long SKILL Compliance as Logical Reasoning: Closure-Grounded Detection with Scaling-Guided On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: The increasing complexity of enterprise business scenarios has promoted the widespread adoption of long SKILL documents in agent systems, posing new challenges for compliance detection: large models incur substantial inference costs, while small models may fail to maintain detection accuracy. To address this gap, we propose SkillCDG, a graph-based framework for long SKILL compliance detection. SkillCDG represents complex business policies as a two-layer constraint dependency graph, where the upper layer indexes SKILL descriptions for scenario routing and the lower layer captures dependencies among atomic constraints within each SKILL. During inference, two-level retrieval followed by dependency closure supports compliance judgment and source traceability. We comprehensively evaluate the framework on three enterprise datasets and two controlled public benchmark variants. Experimental results demonstrate that SkillCDG outperforms baseline methods by up to 12.8 percentage points in detection F1 score, while reducing token consumption by a maximum 64.3\%. Moreover, we further investigate the inherent relationships among policy-graph complexity, model scale, and detection performance. Comparative experiments conducted on four checkpoints from a single model family validate a concise and effective scaling trend: end-to-end detection correctness exhibits a complexity-differentiated scaling pattern, and the complexity metric derived from the constraint dependency graph can effectively quantify instance difficulty and the performance improvement potential of models. Leveraging this insightful scaling trend, we conduct adaptive training sample selection and adopt on-policy distillation to efficiently enhance the compliance detection capability of small-scale models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillCDG，一个用于智能体系统中长 SKILL 文档合规检测的图结构框架。该框架将复杂业务策略建模为两层约束依赖图，推理时通过两级检索加依赖闭包 (dependency closure) 完成合规判断与来源追溯。在三个企业数据集和两个受控公开基准变体上，SkillCDG 相比基线在检测 F1 上最高提升 12.8 个百分点，同时最多降低 64.3% 的 token 消耗。作者还利用策略图复杂度与模型规模的关系发现一种缩放趋势，并据此进行自适应训练样本选择与 on-policy distillation，以提升小模型的检测能力。
Motivation: 企业业务场景日益复杂，长 SKILL 文档在智能体系统中被广泛采用，这给合规检测带来新挑战：大模型推理成本高，小模型又难以保证检测精度。作者希望弥合成本与准确性之间的这一差距。
Method: 提出 SkillCDG 图框架，把业务策略表示成两层约束依赖图：上层索引 SKILL 描述用于场景路由，下层刻画每个 SKILL 内原子约束之间的依赖关系。推理阶段先做两级检索，再通过依赖闭包支持合规判定与来源追溯；此外，基于约束依赖图导出的复杂度指标，进行自适应训练样本选择，并采用 on-policy distillation 提升小规模模型的检测能力。
Result: 在三个企业数据集和两个受控公开基准变体上，SkillCDG 的检测 F1 相比基线最高提升 12.8 个百分点，token 消耗最多降低 64.3%。在单一模型家族的四个 checkpoint 上，实验验证了一种简洁有效的缩放趋势：端到端检测正确性呈现复杂度差异化缩放，且由约束依赖图得到的复杂度指标可以有效量化实例难度和模型的性能提升潜力。
Conclusion: 作者认为，图化策略表示结合 scaling 引导的 on-policy distillation，可以在显著降低推理成本的同时增强小规模模型的合规检测能力。需要说明的是，缩放趋势结论基于单一模型家族的四个 checkpoint，且实验范围限于企业数据集和受控公开基准变体。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TokenPrint: A Calibrated Token-Space Fingerprint for Language-Model Provenance
papers.abstract_en: Establishing the provenance of a language model---including its base checkpoint and possible overlap in training distributions---is a governance challenge that metadata alone cannot resolve. We introduce a training-free fingerprint based on the top-$k$ vocabulary projections of late hidden states elicited by 250 fixed knowledge probes, compared using Jaccard overlap over decoded token strings. We evaluate the method on 32 open-weight models from nine families (0.6B--32B) with documented relationships. (1)~A \emph{similarity ladder} broadly follows model relatedness: independently trained models on identical data score 0.48 raw (0.35 vocabulary-corrected), followed by shared-base fine-tunes (0.39/0.33), same-developer relatives (0.38/0.28), and models with no documented relationship (0.22/0.17). This identical-data signal persists across three organizations, two tokenizer families, and two architecture classes, and emerges within the first 1\% of training before measurable task competence, suggesting a contribution from shared training data beyond capability convergence. (2)~As a nearest-neighbor \emph{lineage-retrieval} method, the fingerprint ranks the exact documented base among the top two candidates for all five R1 distillations (mean rank 1.8, MRR 0.60), including a math-specialized base not identifiable from coarse metadata. (3)~A \emph{depth ablation} shows that lineage group discrimination strengthens toward the output distribution, with AUC increasing from 0.72 at quarter depth to 0.90 at the output; using only the top 5 output tokens retains AUC 0.87. (4)~The fingerprint remains stable under quantization, with Jaccard similarity of 0.92 under int8 and 0.82--0.85 under int4, compared with a maximum cross-model similarity of 0.81 in the calibration pool. We release the probes, code, and fingerprints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的语言模型来源指纹方法 TokenPrint，基于 250 个固定知识探针在模型后期隐藏状态上的 top-k 词表投影，用解码 token 的 Jaccard 重叠进行比较。作者在 9 个家族的 32 个开源模型（0.6B–32B）上验证，发现相似度阶梯基本符合模型亲缘关系，最近邻谱系检索能定位蒸馏基座模型，且指纹在量化下保持稳定。
Motivation: 仅靠元数据无法可靠判断语言模型的来源，包括基座检查点以及训练分布的重叠情况，这构成治理与溯源上的挑战。
Method: 提出训练无关的指纹方法：用 250 个固定知识探针抽取模型后期隐藏状态，对 top-k 词表投影进行解码，并以解码 token 字符串的 Jaccard 重叠作为模型间相似度度量。
Result: 独立训练但数据相同的模型原始相似度为 0.48（词汇校正后 0.35），共享基座微调为 0.39/0.33，开发者内部相关模型为 0.38/0.28，无记录关系模型为 0.22/0.17；该信号在三个机构、两类 tokenizer 与两类架构中持续存在。作为最近邻谱系检索，指纹对五个 R1 蒸馏模型都能在 top 2 内找到真实基座（平均排名 1.8，MRR 0.60）；深度消融显示区分力随层深提升，AUC 从四分之一深度的 0.72 升至输出的 0.90，仅用 top 5 输出 token 仍达 0.87；int8 下 Jaccard 相似度为 0.92，int4 下为 0.82–0.85，高于校准池中最大跨模型相似度 0.81。
Conclusion: 作者认为该指纹能作为语言模型来源追溯的有效工具，并已公开探针、代码与指纹数据；摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: EFFEKT: Efficient Federated Knowledge Transfer to Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent data protection laws have accelerated the adoption of Federated Learning (FL) for privacy-preserving decentralized training. Nevertheless, increasing model sizes impose substantial computational demands on client devices, limiting FL applicability in resource-constrained settings. We introduce a novel multi-domain federated learning framework in which lightweight client-side proxy models collaborate with a server-side Foundation Model (FM) to learn new concepts without sharing private data. Our approach, EFFEKT, enables efficient server-side training of domain-specific LoRA adapters while preserving feature-space alignment between the FM and proxy extractors via novel bi-directional cross-distillation strategies. Experiments on multiple real-world datasets and deployments on low-power edge devices demonstrate improvements over state-of-the-art baselines in most considered domains while maintaining lightweight computation at the client side.
papers.comment: 12 main content pages, 8 appendix pages; 3 main figures, 9 appendix figures; 8 main tables, 9 appendix tables; 1 main algorithm, 4 appendix algorithms; accepted at TMLR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EFFEKT，一种多域联邦学习框架，让轻量级客户端代理模型与服务器端基础模型（Foundation Model）协作学习新概念，同时不共享私有数据。方法通过新颖的双向交叉蒸馏策略保持基础模型与代理提取器之间的特征空间对齐，并在服务器端高效训练域特定 LoRA 适配器。在多个真实数据集和低功耗边缘设备上的实验显示，在大多数考虑域中优于现有基线，同时客户端计算保持轻量。
Motivation: 大型模型规模的不断增长给客户端设备带来沉重计算负担，限制了联邦学习在资源受限场景下的适用性，而现有隐私保护联邦学习方式难以满足这一约束。
Method: EFFEKT 采用客户端轻量代理模型与服务器端基础模型协作的联邦学习框架，通过双向交叉蒸馏（bi-directional cross-distillation）保持特征空间对齐，并在服务器端训练域特定 LoRA 适配器，实现高效的联邦知识迁移。
Result: 在多个真实世界数据集和低功耗边缘设备部署上，该方法在大多数考虑域中优于当前最优基线（state-of-the-art baselines），同时维持客户端侧轻量计算。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架能够在资源受限客户端上完成高效的联邦知识迁移，并在多数域中获得优于现有基线的表现。

summary_sections.result: 在多个真实世界数据集和低功耗边缘设备部署上，该方法在大多数考虑域中优于当前最优基线（state-of-the-art baselines），同时维持客户端侧轻量计算。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该框架能够在资源受限客户端上完成高效的联邦知识迁移，并在多数域中获得优于现有基线的表现。

papers.title: Compositional Cross-Modality Translation via Whole-Volume Multitask Latent Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modality medical image translation can reduce the burden of multi-modal acquisitions, yet the field remains constrained by two coupled limitations: methods operate on 2D slices or 3D patches rather than whole volumes, and train a separate model for each translation task. Both stem from a single cause, the absence of a sufficiently strong volumetric prior, which forces generative models to learn anatomical appearance and cross-modality mapping simultaneously, an ill-posed problem at the scale of available paired datasets. We propose to decouple these objectives. A large-scale pretrained 3D variational autoencoder provides a compact latent representation of volumetric appearance, reducing translation to a conditional flow-matching problem. This compression makes whole-volume processing tractable, while a resolution-aware sampling strategy preserves native anatomical scale. We train a single model jointly across inter-modality (MRI$\to$CT, CBCT$\to$CT) and intra-modality (MRI$\to$MRI) tasks over three multi-center datasets. Across all tasks, whole-volume processing outperforms its patch-based counterpart, and the multi-task model matches task-specific baselines while replacing $N$ networks with one. Crucially, joint training unlocks capabilities inaccessible to task-specific approaches: zero-shot generalization to anatomical regions unseen during training, within 0.15 SSIM of the fully supervised model, and compositional cross-dataset translation along paths never directly supervised. These results suggest that combining a strong volumetric prior with multitask training is a scalable route toward synthesis systems that generalize beyond their training distribution. Code is available at https://github.com/arco-group/Whole-Volume-Latent-FM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学图像跨模态翻译中两个耦合的限制（基于2D切片或3D补丁而非全脑体积，以及每个翻译任务单独训练一个模型），提出用大规模预训练3D变分自编码器提供紧凑的体积外观潜在表示，把翻译简化为条件流匹配问题，并在三个多中心数据集上联合训练单一模型完成 MRI→CT、CBCT→CT 和 MRI→MRI 任务。摘要报告全脑体积处理优于补丁方法，多任务模型在匹配任务特定基线的同时用一个网络替代 N 个网络，并展现出零样本解剖区域泛化和组合式跨数据集翻译能力。
Motivation: 现有跨模态医学图像翻译方法受限于两个互相关联的缺陷：只在2D切片或3D补丁上运行，且为每个翻译任务单独训练模型。作者认为根源是缺少足够强的体积先验，导致生成模型被迫同时学习解剖外观和跨模态映射，在现有配对数据集规模下是病态问题。
Method: 提出解耦这两个目标：使用大规模预训练的3D变分自编码器获得紧凑的体积外观潜在表示，将翻译转为条件流匹配问题；这种压缩使全脑体积处理可行，并采用分辨率感知采样策略保留原生解剖尺度。训练时在多个任务（MRI→CT、CBCT→CT、MRI→MRI）上联合训练单一模型，数据集来自三个多中心数据集。
Result: 在所有任务中，全脑体积处理优于基于补丁的对应方法；多任务模型达到与任务特定基线相当的性能，同时用一个网络替代 N 个网络。联合训练还带来任务特定方法不具备的能力：对训练中未见的解剖区域零样本泛化（与全监督模型差距在0.15 SSIM以内），以及沿从未直接监督的路径进行组合式跨数据集翻译。
Conclusion: 作者认为，强体积先验结合多任务训练是通向能泛化到训练分布之外的综合系统的一条可扩展路径。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: When Does An Extra View Help? Adapting Single-View 3D Reconstruction with Extra Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Reconstruction of 3D objects from a single image is a challenging research problem in computer vision. The key challenge is the lack of critical information from viewpoints to complete 3D structures. Using an additional view may help to resolve the issue. However, there is no mechanism that can integrate the extra view into the single-view 3D reconstruction principle. We address this challenge by proposing ASV3D, a framework for adapting single-view 3D object reconstruction to test-time data with support from one additional image. We introduce two adaptation strategies: (i) a zero-shot adaptation scheme that leverages the auxiliary image to improve the reconstruction quality of an object without retraining, and (ii) an optimised adaptation scheme that further enhances visual fidelity and cross-view consistency via contrastive learning. We apply our ASV3D to improve two state-of-the-art single-view 3D reconstruction pipelines on both benchmark and real-world datasets. Results demonstrate that our approach consistently improves reconstruction accuracy and robustness under unconstrained multi-view inputs, outperforming the baselines in both quantitative metrics and human preference. We publish our code and the real-world object dataset in our project page at https://github.com/YNhuHuynh/ASV3D/tree/main.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ASV3D，一个在测试时利用一张额外图像来改进单视图 3D 重建的框架。作者引入零样本适应 (zero-shot adaptation) 和基于对比学习 (contrastive learning) 的优化适应两种策略，并将 ASV3D 应用到两个 SOTA 单视图重建流程上。摘要报告该方法在基准和真实世界数据集上一致提升重建精度与鲁棒性，且在无约束多视图输入下优于基线。
Motivation: 单视图 3D 重建缺乏其他视角的关键信息来补全三维结构，而现有方法没有机制把额外视角图像整合到单视图重建流程中。作者针对这一缺口提出测试时适应方案。
Method: 提出 ASV3D 框架，包含两种适应策略：一是零样本适应，利用辅助图像在不重新训练的情况下提升物体重建质量；二是优化适应，通过对比学习进一步增强视觉保真度和跨视图一致性 (cross-view consistency)。
Result: 在基准和真实世界数据集上将该框架应用到两个 SOTA 单视图 3D 重建管线，摘要报告在无约束多视图输入下重建精度和鲁棒性持续提升，定量指标和人类偏好均优于基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为额外视角可以被整合进单视图重建流程而无需重训，并开源代码和真实世界物体数据集。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Compositional Threat Analysis of Latent Compromise in LLM Agent Systems: The Order 66 Scenario
papers.abstract_en: In the fictional Order 66, catastrophe does not arise from a powerful command alone: a trusted population is preconditioned, a short directive activates the concealed condition, and protective authority turns against the system. This paper translates that mechanism into an origin-neutral security analysis of tool-using large language model (LLM) agents. A representative scenario combines a deployed artifact or shared memory bearing a dormant destructive rule, a later email, document, update, or peer message that activates it, and an agent harness granting operational and recovery authority. We introduce a compositional model explaining why no component is catastrophic alone, yet their conjunction can produce correlated destructive action. We separate three population-reach routes --- release-time pre-positioning, post-release durable seeding, and peer replication --- from a common core of dormancy, activation, authority, reachable targets, and failed recovery. This yields defensive cut sets and shows why checkpoint scanning or prompt filtering cannot close every route. A two-class example shows that cross-class feedback can sustain spread even when both within-class reproduction terms are below one; isolation and persistence controls suppress the loop. Published work instantiates constituent mechanisms, while incidents demonstrate autonomous boundary crossing, malicious agent extensions, agent-assisted reconnaissance, and public-package propagation, but not the full dormant-implant composition. We found no public observation, in evidence reviewed through 5 August 2026, traversing the complete Order 66 graph. The result is neither dismissal nor prediction: the scenario is componentwise credible under stated assumptions, damage depends on the harness, and the strongest defenses are capability mediation, durable-state provenance, propagation isolation, and protected recovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把虚构的 Order 66 机制（潜伏规则 + 触发指令 + 被背叛的权威）转译为对工具使用型大语言模型 (LLM) 智能体的安全分析。作者提出一个组合模型，说明没有任何单一组件是灾难性的，但其组合可能产生相关的破坏性行动，并将三条人群传播路径与一个公共核心（潜伏、激活、权限、可达目标、恢复失败）分离。截至 2026 年 8 月 5 日审查的证据中，未观察到完整穿越该 Order 66 图的公开案例，但场景在给定假设下逐组件可信。
Motivation: 现有安全检查往往孤立地审视组件，而此类潜伏妥协 (latent compromise) 威胁的风险正来自多个组成部分的组合效应；本文尝试给出一种与来源无关 (origin-neutral) 的框架来分析这种组合性威胁。
Method: 提出一个组合模型，区分三类传播路径（发布前预置、发布后持久播种、对等复制）与共同核心要素（潜伏、激活、权限、可达目标、恢复失败），并据此构造防御割集 (defensive cut sets)；还用一个两类示例分析跨类反馈对传播的影响。
Result: 两类示例表明，即使各类内部繁殖项均低于 1，跨类反馈仍可维持传播，而隔离与持久性控制能抑制该回路。已发表工作只实例化了组成机制，事件报告展示了自主越界、恶意智能体扩展、智能体辅助侦察与公共包传播，但未观察到完整的潜伏植入组合。
Conclusion: 作者强调结论既非否定也非预测：该场景在陈述假设下逐组件可信，实际损害取决于智能体 harness，最强的防御是能力中介、持久状态溯源、传播隔离与受保护恢复。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improving Constraint Models with LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: The runtime of Constraint Programming (CP) solvers is highly sensitive to modeling choices, such as symmetry breaking, implied constraints, global constraints, constraint reformulation, and variable representation. Improving these constraint models has traditionally required human expertise, and existing automated reformulation systems are restricted to a predefined library of hand-crafted transformation rules. We introduce an agentic framework that instead reformulates a constraint model from an open-ended space and establishes correctness empirically rather than by construction: a Large Language Model (LLM) agent, given a model and three training instances, proposes alternative formulations, validates each by injecting its solution back into the original model, and diagnoses and repairs failures, returning the best variant it finds in a median of about fifteen minutes. The models are expressed in the CPMpy modeling library, and each proposed model is evaluated on three larger test instances. Across nine combinatorial optimization problems, the generated models outperform the originals on 21 of 27 test instances, and on some problems solve more than two orders of magnitude faster. A comparison against non-agentic baselines that reuse the same validation and selection tools indicates that the gains stem from the agent's iterative diagnosis and repair, not merely from sampling several candidates. These results demonstrate that autonomous agentic methods can support the improvement of constraint models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个智能体框架（agentic framework），用大语言模型（LLM）代理在开放空间中重构约束模型（constraint model），而不是依赖预定义的手工变换规则。代理根据一个模型和三个训练实例提出备选表述，通过将解注入原模型来验证正确性，并诊断与修复失败，最终返回最佳变体，中位运行时间约十五分钟。在九个组合优化问题上，生成模型在 27 个测试实例中的 21 个上优于原始模型，部分问题求解速度快两个数量级以上。
Motivation: 约束规划（CP）求解器的运行时间对建模选择高度敏感，如对称破缺、隐含约束、全局约束和变量表示；传统上改进这些模型依赖人类专家，而现有自动重构系统局限于预定义的手工变换规则库。
Method: 引入基于 LLM 代理的框架：给定模型与三个训练实例，代理提出替代表述，将每个候选模型的解注入原始模型以经验性验证正确性，并诊断和修复失败，最终返回找到的最佳变体。模型用 CPMpy 建模库表达，每个候选在三个更大的测试实例上评估。
Result: 在九个组合优化问题上，生成模型在 27 个测试实例中的 21 个上优于原始模型，部分问题求解速度提升超过两个数量级；与复用相同验证和选择工具的非智能体基线相比，收益来自代理的迭代诊断与修复，而非仅采样多个候选。
Conclusion: 结果表明自主智能体方法能够支持约束模型的改进，且正确性通过经验验证而非构造保证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Accurate Ensembles, Fragile Narratives: Multi-Scale Stacking and a Fidelity Audit of LLM-Generated Explanations for Credit Risk
papers.abstract_en: Credit scoring increasingly relies on models whose decision logic cannot be read off their parameters, in tension with supervisory expectations that adverse decisions be explainable. A common proposal closes that gap with a language model: compute feature attributions, hand them to an LLM, and let it write the rationale. We build such a system end to end and test whether the second half of the promise holds. The predictive component is a multi-scale stacking ensemble fusing four differently regularised gradient-boosting learners with a residual network through a neural meta-learner trained on out-of-fold predictions. On a public 32,581-application credit dataset it reaches test ROC-AUC 0.9539 (95% CI [0.9462, 0.9616]) and PR-AUC 0.9137, beating the best single model by Delta-AUC = 0.0143 (p = 0.016 under a conservative independence assumption). Our central finding is asymmetric. The ranking gain is real but operationally small: at the F1-optimal threshold the ensemble avoids only six additional missed defaults out of 1,422 against a tuned random forest, cutting cost-weighted loss by under 2%. The narrative layer fails in a way prompt engineering alone does not fix. In an audited case the model named three factors as risk-increasing that the supplied attributions scored as risk-reducing, omitted the dominant driver, and introduced a feature never given to it. We trace this to properties we measure rather than assume: SHAP and LIME agree on which features matter (overlap@10 = 0.80) but not on their order (tau = 0.43, p = 0.18), and the attribution sign for the model's most sensitive input is near a coin flip across applicants (modal-sign share 0.53). Calibration (ECS = 0.117) and perturbation stability (DPD = 0.078) both fall short of our own thresholds. Constrained prompting is necessary but not sufficient: grounding must be verified after generation, not assumed.

TL;DR: 本文端到端构建了信用评分系统：预测部分是多尺度堆叠集成（多尺度 stacking ensemble），融合四种不同正则化的梯度提升学习器与残差网络，由基于 out-of-fold 预测训练的神经元学习器融合；解释部分将特征归因交给 LLM 生成自然语言理由，并对该解释层做保真度审计。在公开的 32,581 条申请数据集上，集成达到 test ROC-AUC 0.9539 和 PR-AUC 0.9137，排名收益真实但操作上很小；审计发现 LLM 解释严重失真，提示工程无法修复。核心结论是必须对生成后的解释进行 grounding 验证，而不能假定其成立。
Motivation: 信用评分越来越依赖无法直接从参数读出决策逻辑的模型，与监管要求可解释性相冲突。常见补救方案是把特征归因交给 LLM 写理由，但该方案的后半段是否真的成立缺乏系统验证。
Method: 构建端到端系统：预测部分采用多尺度堆叠集成，融合四种不同正则化的梯度提升学习器与残差网络，神经元学习器在 out-of-fold 预测上训练；解释部分将 SHAP/LIME 等特征归因交给 LLM 生成理由。随后对解释层执行保真度审计，测量 SHAP 与 LIME 的一致性、归因符号稳定性、校准（ECS）和扰动稳定性（DPD）。
Result: 在 32,581 条申请数据集上，集成达到 test ROC-AUC 0.9539（95% CI [0.9462, 0.9616]）和 PR-AUC 0.9137，比最佳单一模型高 Delta-AUC = 0.0143（p = 0.016）。但操作收益很小：在 F1 最优阈值下只比调优随机森林多避免 1,422 个违约中的 6 个，成本加权损失下降不到 2%。审计中模型把三个被归因标记为风险降低的因素说成风险增加，遗漏主导驱动因素，并引入一个从未提供的特征；SHAP 与 LIME 的重要性重叠高（overlap@10 = 0.80）但顺序不一致（tau = 0.43，p = 0.18），最敏感输入的归因符号近乎随机（modal-sign share 0.53），ECS = 0.117 与 DPD = 0.078 均未达阈值。

papers.title: Staying True to the Origin: Continuous Image Stylization with Smooth Transitions
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative models have achieved remarkable performance in text- and image-conditioned editing. However, preserving the content of a given image while referencing style patterns from another remains challenging, often leading to uncontrollable stylization results. In this paper, we approach image stylization from the perspective of continuous control, aiming to enable modern Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based multi-reference editing models to (1) faithfully preserve the semantic structure of the content image, (2) render strong stylization effects, and (3) smoothly transition between the two. To this end, we propose a simple yet effective two-stage training strategy along with a style-strength-aware spline formulation. Specifically, in the first stage, the model is trained to produce strongly stylized outputs while preserving the content semantics as much as possible. In the second stage, with the base model frozen, we learn a set of anchor projectors that map various stylization strengths into the model parameter space. During inference, by performing style-strength-aware spline interpolation in a low-rank space, our method enables continuous control over stylization strength, even though the model is trained with only a few discrete strength levels. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method supports precise and continuous manipulation of stylization strength while generating high-fidelity results with modern DiT models. Project page: https://reychiaro.github.io/StyleController.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 的多参考图像风格化方法，从连续控制的角度解决风格化中内容保持与风格强度可控性之间的权衡。方法采用两阶段训练策略：第一阶段训练模型在尽量保持内容语义的同时产生强风格化输出；第二阶段冻结基础模型，学习一组锚点投影器 (anchor projectors) 将离散的风格强度映射到参数空间。推理时通过样式强度感知的样条插值 (style-strength-aware spline interpolation) 在低秩空间中实现连续风格强度控制，实验表明该方法在 DiT 模型上支持精确且连续的风格化强度调节。
Motivation: 现有生成模型在文本或图像条件编辑中难以在保持给定图像内容的同时参考另一图像的风格模式，常常导致风格化结果不可控，缺少对风格强度的连续调节能力。
Method: 提出两阶段训练策略：第一阶段训练模型在保留内容语义的前提下输出强风格化结果；第二阶段冻结基础模型，学习一组 anchor projectors 将不同风格强度映射到模型参数空间。推理时在低秩空间中进行样式强度感知的样条插值，使仅用少量离散强度级别训练的模型也能实现连续的风格强度控制。
Result: 摘要报告大量实验表明该方法能够在现代 DiT 模型上支持对风格化强度的精确、连续操控，同时生成高保真结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调其核心贡献是将风格化视为连续控制问题，通过低秩空间中的样条插值解耦风格强度与内容保持，从而在忠实保留内容语义与强风格化效果之间实现平滑过渡。

papers.title: Constraining ontology mappings using metaphysical choices
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we discuss the foundations behind a novel methodology for the validation of semantic mappings between different data sources based upon different foundation ontologies, where the methodology builds a framework based upon the metaphysical commitments of the ontologies. We provide as example the test case of mappings between IES and BFO, and we especially focused on providing cardinality constraints on the mappings between the two ontologies. In order to demonstrate the applicability of our method, we showcased how these principles can be operationalized through SPARQL queries validating the results of a mapping pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于本体论形而上学承诺 (metaphysical commitments) 的语义映射验证方法，用于校验建立在不同基础本体之上的数据源之间的映射关系。作者以 IES 与 BFO 之间的映射为测试案例，重点给出映射上的基数约束 (cardinality constraints)，并通过 SPARQL 查询对映射流水线 (mapping pipeline) 的输出进行验证以展示方法的可操作性。
Motivation: 不同数据源往往基于不同的基础本体，导致语义映射缺乏统一、可靠的验证依据；作者希望用本体自身的形而上学承诺来约束和验证映射，而不仅仅是依赖语法或结构匹配。
Method: 构建一个以本体形而上学承诺为基础的验证框架，在映射上附加基数约束，并把这些原则实现为 SPARQL 查询，用于自动校验映射流水线产生的结果。
Result: 以 IES 与 BFO 之间的映射为测试用例，演示了所提方法如何通过 SPARQL 查询验证映射的有效性；摘要未报告定量实验结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于形而上学承诺的约束能够支撑数据源间语义映射的验证，并用 IES-BFO 案例证明该原则可以被实际运行。

papers.title: TSDS-Toolbox: A Toolbox for Measuring Time-Series Dataset Similarity
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) has significantly accelerated research in time-series analysis, particularly in forecasting, classification, and generation tasks. Recent models, especially foundation models, benefit from time-series dataset similarity due to its significant role in source dataset selection for fine-tuning. However, many existing implementations for benchmarking time-series dataset similarity methods are fragmented and difficult to extend. To address this, we present a unified framework, the Time-Series Dataset Similarity Toolbox (TSDS-Toolbox). Our work enables (1) systematic and reproducible comparisons of time-series dataset similarity methods; (2) flexible extensibility for users to add customized datasets, similarity methods, and downstream time-series tasks; and (3) consistent evaluation of both dataset-level and series-level similarity methods through integrated time-series dataset reducers. The effectiveness of TSDS-Toolbox is validated through comprehensive experiments under diverse experimental settings. Our toolbox is publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间序列数据集相似性评测实现碎片化、难以扩展的问题，提出统一框架 TSDS-Toolbox。该工具箱支持对数据集级 (dataset-level) 和序列级 (series-level) 相似性方法进行系统化、可复现的比较，允许用户自定义数据集、相似性方法与下游时间序列任务，并通过集成的时间序列数据集缩减器 (reducer) 保持一致评估。作者在多种实验设置下验证了其有效性，并公开了工具箱。
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型在下游任务微调时依赖源数据集选择，而数据集相似性在其中起关键作用；但现有相似性方法评测实现分散、难以扩展，缺乏统一基准。
Method: 提出 TSDS-Toolbox 统一框架，整合相似性方法、时间序列数据集、下游任务与数据集缩减器，提供系统化评测流程，并强调模块化扩展性以支持自定义组件。
Result: 摘要报告在多种实验设置下进行了全面实验，验证了工具箱的有效性，但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: TSDS-Toolbox 旨在为时间序列数据集相似性研究提供统一、可复现且易扩展的评测平台，并已公开可用。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Neurosymbolic Discovery of Algebraic Graph Constructions
papers.abstract_en: There are several methods for searching for graphs with prescribed properties, such as SAT solvers and specialized generators. These methods return the result as raw data: an adjacency matrix or a string encoding. The raw data certifies that the graph exists, but it does not reveal any structural properties of the graph. We ask whether one can automatically discover a short algebraic description if only this raw data is provided. We look for a description such as a Cayley graph $\mathrm{Cay}(Γ, S)$ or a lexicographic product $C_5[K_3]$. We address this question with a neurosymbolic approach. We propose an agent that runs on a general-purpose large language model with no fine-tuning or per-target training. The model interleaves reasoning with calls to the computer algebra system SageMath: it analyzes the target graph, proposes and tests candidate constructions, and revises them until the output matches the target. The agent communicates with SageMath through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, which we release as a general-purpose bridge. Whether a construction matches the target is checked by a single exact isomorphism test, and therefore rests on the symbolic side and not on the model. We test the approach on a benchmark of 100 highly symmetric graphs, namely two-orbit graphs on up to 25 vertices; the benchmark was fixed in advance. Our agent could find verified algebraic constructions for all of them, without falling back to raw encodings. A strong template-enumeration baseline reaches only about $20\%$, and a catalog lookup could not identify any of these graphs. However, construction quality declines when symmetry is removed. As a concrete application, we identify the smallest known counterexample to the Bernhart-Kainen dispersability conjecture, a $16$-vertex graph that enumeration found as raw data. For this graph, our agent found an explicit algebraic construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何从图搜索工具（如 SAT 求解器）输出的原始数据（邻接矩阵或字符串编码）中自动发现图的短代数构造描述，例如 Cayley 图或字典积。作者提出一种神经符号方法：基于通用大语言模型构建代理，无需微调即可与计算机代数系统 SageMath 交替推理，通过精确同构检验验证候选构造。在 100 个高度对称的 two-orbit 图（最多 25 个顶点）基准上，代理为所有图找到了可验证的代数构造，并成功为 Bernhart-Kainen 可分散性猜想的最小已知反例（16 顶点图）给出显式代数构造。
Motivation: 现有满足特定性质的图搜索方法只返回原始数据，能证明图存在，却无法揭示图的结构性质；从原始数据中自动发现简洁的代数描述是一个尚未解决的缺口。
Method: 提出一个运行在通用大语言模型上的神经符号代理，不进行微调也不针对目标训练；代理在推理过程中调用 SageMath，分析目标图、提出并测试候选构造，然后反复修正。代理通过发布的通用 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器与 SageMath 通信，构造是否匹配由精确的同构测试决定，因此验证完全落在符号层面。
Result: 在预先固定的 100 个高度对称 two-orbit 图（最多 25 个顶点）基准上，代理为全部图找到经核验的代数构造，未退回原始编码；强模板枚举基线仅约 20%，目录查找无法识别任何图。当移除对称性时构造质量下降。作为具体应用，代理为枚举得到的 Bernhart-Kainen 可分散性猜想最小已知反例（16 顶点图）找到了显式代数构造。
Conclusion: 作者表明自动从原始图数据中发现带验证的代数构造是可行的，但该方法依赖图的对称性，对称性降低时效果变差；验证可靠性由符号同构测试保证，而非模型判断。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究如何从图搜索工具（如 SAT 求解器）输出的原始数据（邻接矩阵或字符串编码）中自动发现图的短代数构造描述，例如 Cayley 图或字典积。作者提出一种神经符号方法：基于通用大语言模型构建代理，无需微调即可与计算机代数系统 SageMath 交替推理，通过精确同构检验验证候选构造。在 100 个高度对称的 two-orbit 图（最多 25 个顶点）基准上，代理为所有图找到了可验证的代数构造，并成功为 Bernhart-Kainen 可分散性猜想的最小已知反例（16 顶点图）给出显式代数构造。

papers.title: SUMI: Scalable Unified Model for 3D Point Cloud Inference
papers.abstract_en: Point cloud completion commonly follows a coarse-to-fine paradigm, where a low-density coarse shape is first predicted and then upsampled to the target resolution. Although recent methods have improved global structure recovery, the fine stage often remains limited by simple upsampling and insufficient interaction with coarse structural features, making local detail reconstruction challenging. We propose SUMI, a diffusion-enhanced refinement module for coarse-to-fine point cloud completion. Unlike prior diffusion-based completion methods that use diffusion as a standalone point generator, SUMI injects noisy geometric features into cross-attention with coarse structural features, enabling reverse denoising to refine local geometry while preserving global consistency. SUMI can also be integrated into existing coarse-to-fine models as a flexible refinement module. Experiments on PCN, ShapeNet-55/34, and MVP demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines. SUMI achieves the best overall CD and F1-score on PCN, reduces CD by up to 16.1% on ShapeNet-55, and obtains the best CD across all output densities on MVP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SUMI，一种用于粗到细点云补全的扩散增强细化模块。与将扩散作为独立点生成器的现有方法不同，SUMI 将带噪几何特征注入与粗结构特征的交叉注意力中，使反向去噪能在保持全局一致性的同时细化局部几何。SUMI 可被集成到现有粗到细模型中作为灵活细化模块，并在 PCN、ShapeNet-55/34 和 MVP 基准上取得一致提升。
Motivation: 现有粗到细点云补全方法在细阶段常受限于简单上采样，且与粗结构特征交互不足，导致局部细节重建困难；而先前的基于扩散的补全方法仅将扩散用作独立生成器，未能充分利用粗结构信息。
Method: 提出 SUMI，一个扩散增强的细化模块：将带噪几何特征与粗结构特征进行交叉注意力融合，通过反向去噪细化局部几何，同时保持全局一致性；该模块可作为灵活组件接入现有粗到细模型。
Result: 在 PCN 上取得最佳整体 CD 和 F1-score；在 ShapeNet-55 上将 CD 降低最多 16.1%；在 MVP 上所有输出密度下均取得最佳 CD。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SUMI 作为可插拔细化模块能稳定提升多种粗到细点云补全基线，且优于强基线，但未讨论在非粗到细架构中的适用性或对极端稀疏输入的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Finite basis physics-informed neural networks with hard constraints for viscous fluid flow in highly perforated domains
papers.abstract_en: In this work, viscous fluid flow governed by the Stokes equations in highly perforated domains is studied using physics-informed neural networks (PINNs). Perforated microstructures induce complex boundary conditions and fine-scale flow features that are difficult for standard neural networks to resolve. Conventional PINNs, even when combined with advanced training techniques, can suffer from a loss of accuracy and efficiency as the number of perforations increases. One important source of this difficulty is the soft enforcement of boundary conditions through penalty terms, which can lead to stiffness, gradient conflicts, and poor resolution of near-boundary flow structures. Hard constraints provide an alternative by encoding boundary conditions exactly into the network ansatz, but may introduce undesirable non-local effects due to the global nature of the approximation. To address these challenges, finite basis PINNs (FBPINNs), which are based on domain decomposition and localisation principles, are used together with hard boundary constraints that efficiently encode perforation-related boundary conditions. This approach helps mitigate spectral bias, improves overall accuracy, and exhibits convergence that is only weakly affected by the number of perforations, thereby providing an efficient and highly parallelisable neural network framework. The proposed approach is further supported with theoretical arguments, specifically focusing on the localisation and approximation properties of FBPINNs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用带硬约束的有限基底物理信息神经网络（FBPINNs）求解高穿孔域中的Stokes粘性流动。作者指出标准PINN因用罚项软施加边界条件，在穿孔数量增多时精度和效率下降；而FBPINNs基于域分解与局部化原理，配合硬边界约束可精确编码穿孔相关边界条件，从而减轻谱偏差、提高精度，并使收敛性几乎不受穿孔数影响。文中还给出了关于FBPINNs局部化与逼近性质的理论论证。
Motivation: 穿孔微结构带来复杂边界条件和细尺度流动特征，标准神经网络难以分辨；传统PINN通过罚项软施加边界条件会导致刚度、梯度冲突及近边界流动结构解析不足，且随穿孔数增加精度和效率损失。
Method: 采用基于域分解和局部化原理的有限基底PINNs（FBPINNs），并将穿孔相关的边界条件以硬约束方式精确编码进网络ansatz，以替代软惩罚项。
Result: 摘要报告该方法缓解了谱偏差、提高了整体精度，且收敛性仅受穿孔数量微弱影响，是一个高效且高度可并行化的神经网络框架。
Conclusion: 该框架为高穿孔域中的粘性流问题提供了有效求解途径，并辅以关于FBPINNs局部化与逼近性质的理论支持。

papers.title: Think Deep, Speak Once: Relit, A Recursive Latent Implicit Transformer Framework
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has become the dominant paradigm for eliciting reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs), yet it creates substantial computational overhead by forcing models to externalize intermediate reasoning steps as discrete tokens. Recent latent reasoning approaches attempt to internalize this process within continuous hidden states. One of the latest advancements in the field of latent reasoning, Tiny Recursive Models (TRMs) excel at symbolic reasoning but struggle to preserve semantic coherence in natural language settings. To bridge this gap, we introduce ReLIT (Recursive Latent Implicit Transformer), a hybrid framework that grounds deep recursive reasoning within the rich semantic representations of a foundational model. ReLIT augments a frozen LLM backbone (TinyLlama-1.1B) with a lightweight, trainable recursive block that iteratively refines its latent thinking (z) before committing to a final output, structurally solving linguistic intuition from algorithmic processing and enabling "deep thinking" via gradient-isolated recurrent loops without the latency of explicit token generation. Empirically, ReLIT achieves high parameter efficiency on the GLoRE logical reasoning benchmark, matching or outperforming significantly larger models on challenging tasks such as ProofWriter and RuleTaker despite minimal supervision. These results demonstrate that reasoning capability can be scaled efficiently through recurrent depth rather than parameter width, offering a principled framework for semantically grounded implicit reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReLIT（Recursive Latent Implicit Transformer），一种混合框架，将深度递归推理嵌入冻结的基础模型（TinyLlama-1.1B）的语义表示中，通过轻量级可训练递归块迭代精炼潜在思维 (z)，避免显式生成中间 token。摘要报告在 GLoRE 逻辑推理基准上以高参数效率匹配或超越更大模型，在 ProofWriter 和 RuleTaker 等任务上表现突出。
Motivation: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) 提示迫使模型将中间推理步骤外部化为离散 token，带来大量计算开销；现有潜在推理方法如 Tiny Recursive Models (TRMs) 擅长符号推理但在自然语言语义连贯性上不足。
Method: ReLIT 在冻结的 LLM 骨干（TinyLlama-1.1B）上附加一个轻量级可训练递归块，该块在最终输出前迭代精炼潜在思考 (z)，通过梯度隔离的循环实现深度思考，无需显式 token 生成。
Result: 在 GLoRE 逻辑推理基准上，ReLIT 以极小的监督和参数规模匹配或超越显著更大的模型，尤其是在 ProofWriter 和 RuleTaker 等挑战性任务上。
Conclusion: 摘要认为推理能力可以通过递归深度而非参数宽度高效扩展，为语义 grounded 的隐式推理提供了框架。
