papers.title: Hierarchical Multi-Task Federated Learning in VANETs
papers.abstract_en: Vehicular Ad hoc Networks (VANETs) increasingly rely on federated learning (FL) to enable collaborative intelligence without sharing raw sensory data. However, most existing vehicular FL frameworks assume that all vehicles train a single global model for a common task, which limits their applicability in practical vehicular environments where vehicles may perform heterogeneous learning tasks under non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data, intermittent connectivity, and high mobility. To address these challenges, this paper proposes an AutoEncoder-based Reliability-Optimized Hierarchical Multi-Task Federated Learning (AERO-HMTFL) framework for dynamic multi-hop clustered VANETs. The proposed framework introduces a tri-weighted clustering metric that jointly considers vehicular mobility, shared-model similarity, and task affinity to produce mobility-stable, semantically aligned clusters. Each vehicle employs a split-model architecture comprising a shared autoencoder-based representation module and multiple task-specific heads, with only the shared autoencoder parameters exchanged while the task heads remain local. To improve robustness, cluster heads perform reliability-aware aggregation based on historical validation performance and participation frequency, while the Evolved Packet Core (EPC) conducts global shared-autoencoder fusion across clusters. Extensive simulations demonstrate that, compared with the multi-task federated learning benchmarks, AERO-HMTFL achieves up to 13% higher sustained EPC-level accuracy, exhibits more stable learning dynamics, and reduces EPC-level packet transmissions by approximately 87-97%. Under short-range connectivity, it also requires approximately 13-29% fewer communication rounds to converge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向车载自组网 (VANET) 中的联邦学习 (federated learning, FL) 场景，提出基于自编码器的可靠性优化分层多任务联邦学习框架 AERO-HMTFL。该框架针对车辆执行异构学习任务、数据非独立同分布 (non-IID)、连接间歇且移动性高的现实条件，通过三重加权聚类、共享自编码器加多任务头的拆分模型结构，以及簇头和核心网 (EPC) 两层聚合来实现多任务协同。仿真显示相比多任务联邦学习基线，EPC 级准确率最高提升 13%，分组传输量降低约 87-97%，短距连接下收敛所需通信轮次减少约 13-29%。
Motivation: 现有车载联邦学习框架大多假设所有车辆针对同一任务训练单一全局模型，难以适用于车辆执行异构学习任务、数据 non-IID、连接间歇且高移动性的实际车载环境。
Method: 提出 AERO-HMTFL 框架：设计融合车辆移动性、共享模型相似度和任务亲和度的三重加权聚类指标，以形成移动稳定且语义对齐的簇；每辆车采用共享自编码器表示模块加多个任务特定头的拆分模型结构，只交换共享自编码器参数；簇头基于历史验证性能和参与频率进行可靠性感知聚合，EPC 负责跨簇的全局共享自编码器融合。
Result: 仿真表明，相比多任务联邦学习基准，AERO-HMTFL 的 EPC 级持续准确率最高提升 13%，学习动态更稳定，EPC 级分组传输量减少约 87-97%；在短距连接条件下，收敛所需通信轮次减少约 13-29%。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提框架能够应对动态多跳分簇 VANET 中异构任务与 non-IID 数据的挑战，通过可靠性感知聚合和共享表示交换提升多任务联邦学习的精度与通信效率。

papers.title: NeuPAT: Neuron-aware Plasticity Allocation Tuning for Language-Preserving MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal expansion of large language models (LLMs) enables new perceptual capabilities but often compromises the language intelligence acquired during pretraining. In this work, we investigate this phenomenon from the perspective of internal adaptation dynamics and discover that neurons in pretrained LLMs exhibit heterogeneous plasticity during multimodal learning: some neurons are critical for preserving language capabilities, while others are more adaptive to multimodal knowledge. Based on this insight, we propose NeuPAT (Neuron-aware Plasticity Allocation Tuning), a lightweight and architecture-agnostic framework that allocates neuron-wise update constraints during multimodal instruction tuning. NeuPAT uses a small-scale probing stage to estimate neuron adaptation patterns and selectively protects language-sensitive neurons while promoting multimodal adaptation through more plastic neurons. Experiments across diverse LLM families demonstrate that NeuPAT recovers 94.5\% of the language capability degradation caused by vanilla tuning on 11 language benchmarks while maintaining comparable multimodal performance, providing an effective approach for capability-preserving multimodal expansion.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: NeuPAT先通过一个小规模探测阶段估计神经元的适应模式，然后选择性保护语言敏感神经元，同时让可塑性更强的神经元承担多模态适应；该方法轻量且与具体架构无关。

papers.title: SCTD 3.0: Sonar Common Target Detection in the Wild - A Large-Scale, Multi-Scene Dataset from Real Marine Surveys
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic Aperture Sonar (SAS) is core for wide-area detection of small underwater targets. However, large-scale, high-quality SAS datasets are scarce, hindering data-driven recognition. Existing benchmarks are small and limited to single scenarios, failing to reproduce complex acoustic scattering, diverse seabeds, and multi-pose imaging in real detection. To fill this gap, we introduce SCTD 3.0 - a large-scale real-measured dataset for Sonar Common Target Detection in the Wild in natural waters. It contains over 10,000 high-quality real SAS image snippets from multi-frequency systems (240 kHz, 450 kHz, and others), covering ten typical target categories across varied seabed geomorphologies, with multiple observation angles, detection ranges, and frequency bands. We establish a rigorous hierarchical annotation protocol that decouples labeling of intrinsic physical properties, deployment characteristics, and scattering phenomena - covering material, geometry, internal structure, burial state, shadow integrity, specular highlights, edge diffraction, and resonance effects. This enables fine-grained target characterization. We also construct a multi-task benchmark for object detection, fine-grained classification, and attribute prediction, evaluating mainstream deep learning models under cross-domain, cross-scene, cross-frequency, and cross-view generalization. SCTD 3.0 is expected to provide a critical data cornerstone for robust underwater target perception in open-water environments. SCTD 3.0 is available at https://github.com/automlresearch/SCTD-3.0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCTD 3.0，一个大规模真实海域合成孔径声呐 (Synthetic Aperture Sonar, SAS) 目标检测数据集，包含超过 10,000 张来自多频系统（240 kHz、450 kHz 等）的高质量真实 SAS 图像片段，覆盖十类典型目标、多种海床地貌、不同观测角度、探测距离与频段。作者建立了分层标注协议，将目标固有物理属性、布放特征与散射现象的解耦标注统一起来，并构建了涵盖目标检测、细粒度分类与属性预测的多任务基准，在跨域、跨场景、跨频率与跨视角泛化设置下评估主流深度学习模型。
Motivation: SAS 是小目标水域广域探测的核心手段，但大规模高质量 SAS 数据集稀缺，阻碍了数据驱动的识别方法。现有基准规模小且局限于单一场景，无法复现真实探测中复杂的声散射、多样海床与多姿态成像。
Method: 从真实自然水域调查中采集并构建 SCTD 3.0 数据集，采用分层标注协议，将材质、几何、内部结构等固有物理属性，掩埋状态等布放特征，以及阴影完整性、镜面亮点、边缘衍射、谐振效应等散射现象分开标注，实现细粒度目标刻画；并在此基础上搭建多任务基准测试。
Result: 数据集包含超过 10,000 张来自多频系统（240 kHz、450 kHz 等）的真实 SAS 图像片段，覆盖十类典型目标类别与多种海床地貌；基准在跨域、跨场景、跨频率和跨视角泛化设置下评估了主流深度学习模型。
Conclusion: 作者期望 SCTD 3.0 为开放水域中的鲁棒水下目标感知提供关键数据基石，并已公开数据集（GitHub 链接）。摘要中未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Support Selection Beyond Smooth DAG Exactness: Completion Geometry,Score Margins, and Selective Certificates
papers.abstract_en: Smooth acyclicity constraints answer whether a weighted support is a DAG, whereas structure learning asks which support change should be made. Existing analyses establish degeneracy for particular constraint formulas but do not isolate what follows from smooth exactness itself. At a DAG boundary, we show that minimal cycle completions generate a squarefree monomial ideal containing every restricted Taylor jet of an exact representation. If the smallest completion has $q$ edges, the first possible response has order $q$ for a vector residual and $2q$ for a nonnegative scalar. Exponentially many constant-scale cyclic manifolds exhibit the same lack of ranking away from the boundary for NOTEARS and DAGMA. We derive the exact selection time for an isolated cycle. When $Ψ'(h)\asymp h^ν$, the feasibility-only time is $T_0(\varepsilon)=Θ(\varepsilon^{-(2ν+1)})$; a score margin changes the leading dynamics at scale $T_0^{-1}$ for $ν>0$, while $ν=0$ has a logarithmic boundary layer requiring $γT_0\log(1/\varepsilon)\to0$. Experiments verify this law, and a truth-free separation statistic predicts selection time on 320 official NOTEARS/DAGMA trajectories (Spearman $-0.52$ and $-0.66$, permutation $p<10^{-4}$). For finite samples, a parent-set confidence family and forced-opposite queries certify skeleton and unshielded-collider labels shared by every population optimum of a frozen score. Across 320 runs, every regret bound covers an independent oracle-score audit. None of 3,042 certified skeleton or 2,396 collider labels disagrees with the oracle-score optimum, although 4.4% and 5.5%, respectively, disagree with the generating graph. These results separate DAG feasibility, score-based support selection, and causal identification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究平滑无环性约束（如 NOTEARS 和 DAGMA）下 DAG 结构学习的支持选择（support selection）行为。作者证明在 DAG 边界处，最小环补全生成一个平方自由单项式理想，包含精确表示的每个受限 Taylor 喷射；最小补全含 q 条边时，首次响应阶数对向量残差为 q、对非负标量为 2q。文中还推导了孤立环的精确选择时间，并通过 320 条 NOTEARS/DAGMA 轨迹验证了标度律，最后用父集置信族与强制相反查询对有限样本下的骨架和未屏蔽碰撞器标签给出选择性证书。
Motivation: 现有分析只针对特定约束公式指出退化性，没有剥离出平滑精确性（smooth DAG exactness）本身带来的后果；而结构学习关心的正是支持集应如何改变，而不是仅判断某个加权支持是否为 DAG。
Method: 从几何与代数的角度分析 DAG 边界：考虑最小环补全生成的平方自由单项式理想，刻画精确表示的 Taylor 喷射；对孤立环推导可行性时间与带分数边距（score margin）时的选择时间，并在有限样本下构造父集置信族和强制相反查询来认证骨架与碰撞器标签。
Result: 当 Ψ'(h)≍h^ν 时，仅可行性时间为 T_0(ε)=Θ(ε^{-(2ν+1)})；ν>0 时分数边距在 T_0^{-1} 尺度改变主导动力学，ν=0 时存在对数边界层且需 γT_0log(1/ε)→0。实验验证该标度律；一个无真值分离统计量在 320 条官方轨迹上预测选择时间（Spearman -0.52 与 -0.66，置换 p<10^{-4}）。320 次运行中所有遗憾界都覆盖独立 oracle-score 审计；3042 个认证骨架和 2396 个碰撞器标签无一与 oracle-score 最优相左，但分别有 4.4% 和 5.5% 与生成图不一致。
Conclusion: 本文结果将 DAG 可行性、基于分数的支持选择与因果识别三者区分开来，表明平滑精确性本身会在远离边界处产生大量同等规模的循环流形，导致排名缺失。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative Models: Principles, Architectures, and Applications
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI has emerged as one of the most transformative forces in modern artificial intelligence, reshaping how we create, imagine, and interact with digital content. From photorealistic images to coherent text, from immersive videos to novel molecular structures, generative models now power applications that were once confined to science fiction. This book is designed to guide readers through the foundational principles, mathematical underpinnings, and practical architectures that underpin this revolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一本关于生成式AI的书籍，系统介绍生成模型的基础原理、数学基础与实用架构，覆盖从图像、文本、视频到分子结构等应用场景。摘要将其定位为引导读者理解生成式AI变革的指南性著作，而非聚焦某一具体研究问题。
Motivation: 生成式AI已成为现代人工智能中极具变革性的力量，重塑数字内容的创作与交互方式，但相关原理与架构知识分散，缺少系统的入门引导。
Method: 以书籍形式组织内容，涵盖生成模型的基础原理、数学基础（mathematical underpinnings）和实用架构（practical architectures），面向希望系统学习该领域的读者。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验或量化结果，主要贡献是知识整理与教学性内容。
Conclusion: 作者将本书定位为引导读者理解生成式AI革命性进展的综合性指南。

papers.title: Defending Retrieval-Augmented Intrusion Detection Against Knowledge Poisoning and Prompt Injection
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables large language models to classify network flows and generate human-readable incident reports by retrieving semantically similar historical traffic from a vector knowledge base. However, the retrieval layer introduces vulnerabilities to knowledge poisoning and prompt-injection attacks. We present RAG-IDS, a three-tier multi-agent intrusion detection framework with a retrieval-boundary defense combining soft trust scoring, label-embedding consistency checking (LECC), and prompt sanitization, designed to recover classification quality under retrieval-layer attack. Experiments on CIC-UNSW-NB15 show recovery relative to clean undefended performance ranging from R=1.0 at 1% poisoning to R=0.57 at 30%, with negligible clean-performance overhead. Under prompt injection, multi-document retrieval limits label-flip success to 0.6-2.4%, compared with 35-55% for single-document retrieval. Ablation results show that LECC is the primary contributor to robustness, while soft trust-based demotion outperforms hard filtering. The defended RAG pipeline offers an explainable, attack-resilient foundation for intrusion detection, well suited for hybrid deployment alongside high-throughput classifiers.
papers.comment: 14 pages with Appnedix, 11 figures. Submitted to IEEE CIC 2026, Research Track (double-blind review)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RAG-IDS，一个基于检索增强生成 (RAG) 的三层多智能体入侵检测框架，针对检索层面临的知识投毒 (knowledge poisoning) 和提示注入 (prompt injection) 攻击，设计了检索边界防御机制。作者结合软信任评分、标签嵌入一致性检查 (LECC) 和提示清洗 (prompt sanitization)，在 CIC-UNSW-NB15 数据集上验证了攻击下的分类质量恢复能力，并指出该流水线可作为可解释、抗攻击的入侵检测基础。
Motivation: RAG 使大语言模型通过检索语义相似的网络流量来分类网络流并生成事件报告，但检索层引入了知识投毒与提示注入的漏洞，需要专门的防御机制来恢复受攻击时的分类质量。
Method: 提出三层的多智能体 RAG-IDS 框架，核心是检索边界防御：使用软信任评分 (soft trust scoring) 衡量检索内容可信度，通过标签嵌入一致性检查 (LECC) 验证检索结果与标签的一致性，并结合提示清洗 (prompt sanitization) 过滤恶意内容；采用多文档检索而非单文档检索以降低提示注入影响。
Result: 在 CIC-UNSW-NB15 上，相对干净未防御性能的恢复率 R 在 1% 投毒时为 1.0，30% 投毒时为 0.57，且干净性能开销可忽略；提示注入下多文档检索的标签翻转成功率仅 0.6-2.4%，而单文档检索为 35-55%；消融表明 LECC 是鲁棒性的主要贡献者，软信任降级优于硬过滤。
Conclusion: 摘要强调经过防御的 RAG 流水线为入侵检测提供了可解释、抗攻击的基础，适合与高通量分类器混合部署；但其评估基于单一数据集，且未讨论更广部署场景下的局限。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在 CIC-UNSW-NB15 上，相对干净未防御性能的恢复率 R 在 1% 投毒时为 1.0，30% 投毒时为 0.57，且干净性能开销可忽略；提示注入下多文档检索的标签翻转成功率仅 0.6-2.4%，而单文档检索为 35-55%；消融表明 LECC 是鲁棒性的主要贡献者，软信任降级优于硬过滤。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调经过防御的 RAG 流水线为入侵检测提供了可解释、抗攻击的基础，适合与高通量分类器混合部署；但其评估基于单一数据集，且未讨论更广部署场景下的局限。

papers.title: Adaptive Symmetry Discovery for Dynamical System Identification
papers.abstract_en: Dynamical systems model trajectory data generated by fixed underlying dynamics, with applications ranging from biology to physics. Especially in scientific settings, dynamical systems are not generic but often exhibit symmetries imposed by physical laws, formalized through equivariance with respect to group actions. The identification problem concerns recovering the parameters of a system from observed trajectories. In this work, we study adaptive symmetry discovery for dynamical system identification and address how a system can be identified from a single trajectory when it is equivariant with respect to an unknown symmetry group. To this end, we first show that for known symmetries, the system can be identified from a significantly shorter single trajectory than in the generic setting, and we precisely characterize this improvement. We then consider the automatic symmetry discovery setting, proposing a method to learn the symmetry group directly from a single trajectory and incorporate it into the identification procedure, achieving the same optimal trajectory length as in the known-symmetry case. Our analysis relies on tools from group representation theory and the expander properties of Cayley graphs, and may be of independent interest for the study of symmetries in dynamical systems.
papers.journal_ref: International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究动力系统辨识中的自适应对称性发现，关注系统在未知对称群作用下等变时，如何从单条轨迹恢复系统参数。作者先证明当对称群已知时，系统所需单条轨迹长度显著短于一般情形并给出精确刻画；随后提出直接从单条轨迹学习对称群并将其纳入辨识流程的方法，声称能达到与已知对称情形相同的最优轨迹长度。理论分析使用群表示论与Cayley图的扩展性质。
Motivation: 科学场景中的动力系统往往受物理定律约束而具有对称性，但实际中对称群通常是未知的；现有辨识工作大多假设对称性已知，未解决从单条轨迹中同时发现对称性并完成系统辨识的问题。
Method: 论文先分析已知对称群下的辨识样本复杂度，给出轨迹长度改进的精确刻画；然后针对未知对称群提出自动对称性发现方法，直接从单条轨迹学习群结构，再将其纳入系统辨识流程。分析工具包括群表示论与Cayley图的扩展性质。
Result: 理论结果表明，已知对称性时系统可从显著更短的单条轨迹中辨识；提出的自动对称性发现方法能达到与已知对称情形相同的最优轨迹长度。
Conclusion: 作者认为所建立的表示论与Cayley图分析工具可能对动力系统中对称性的研究具有独立价值。

papers.title: Effect of Abstractions and Prompting Strategies on LLM-Guided High-Performance Optimizations
papers.abstract_en: Code performance optimization is a vital aspect of modern software development, as it enables faster response times and reduced resource usage. These optimizations require a deep understanding of low-level hardware details and the intricacies of parallel processing, making them challenging even for experienced developers. With the advent of Large Language Models (LLMs), which are increasingly capable of generating and understanding code, there is growing interest in incorporating these models into automated code optimization processes. Traditionally, this automation involves transcribing the source code into a domain-specific representation that can be auto-tuned using grid search or machine learning algorithms, while adhering to strict rules and a limited set of feasible transformations to ensure verifiability. LLMs incorporate high-level code semantics and can thus perform transformations that go beyond verifiable automated optimizations. This paper investigates whether the traditional abstractions used in automated code optimization improve the performance and correctness of LLM-guided optimizations of parallel HPC applications. We evaluate this using the PolyBench benchmark suite and demonstrate that, in our evaluated setting, LLMs provided with specific optimization goals achieve better measured performance and validity rates when generating C code compared to creating computation pipelines and optimization schedules with established frameworks, suggesting that future development should explore alternative approaches for verifiable LLM-guided code optimization.
papers.comment: This preprint has not undergone peer review or any post-submission improvements or corrections
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在 LLM 引导的并行 HPC 代码优化中，传统自动化优化所使用的抽象是否有助于提升性能与正确性。作者基于 PolyBench 基准套件评估，发现当 LLM 获得明确的优化目标并直接生成 C 代码时，其测量性能和有效性比率都优于借助既有框架构建计算流水线与优化调度的方式，因此建议未来探索可验证的 LLM 引导代码优化的替代路径。
Motivation: 代码性能优化需要对底层硬件细节和并行处理有深入理解，即使资深开发者也会面临挑战。LLM 能利用高层代码语义执行超越传统可验证自动化的变换，但传统自动调优依赖领域特定表示和受限变换集；本文关注这些传统抽象能否改善 LLM 引导优化的表现。
Method: 使用 PolyBench 基准套件，在既定评测设置中对比两条路径：给 LLM 提供具体优化目标并直接生成 C 代码，以及让 LLM 借助既有框架生成计算流水线和优化调度。
Result: 摘要报告，在所评测的设置下，直接生成 C 代码的 LLM 在测量性能和有效性比率上均优于使用既有框架构建流水线与调度的方式。
Conclusion: 作者认为未来应探索其他可实现可验证 LLM 引导代码优化的方法；本文为尚未经过同行评审的预印本。

papers.title: RotaryQuant: Fitting 120B MoE Models on Consumer Hardware via Fused Compressed-Space Attention
papers.abstract_en: Large mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models with 26--120 billion parameters exceed the memory capacity of consumer devices through three simultaneous pressures: resident weight matrices, key-value (KV) cache state that grows linearly with context, and dozens of expert sublayers that must be paged on demand. We present RotaryQuant, a three-axis compression system that addresses all three. Mixed-precision weight quantization assigns bit-widths by architectural role: 4-bit for dense layers, 2-bit for routed experts, and 8-bit for the shared expert whose high activation kurtosis resists aggressive compression. LRU expert offloading pages non-resident experts to disk under genuine memory pressure. The novel axis is IsoQuant, a KV cache compression method that applies a Walsh--Hadamard transform followed by block-diagonal SO(4) rotations to isotropize activation distributions before 3-bit scalar quantization, requiring $O(d \log d)$ operations and 256 stored parameters per head versus $O(d^2)$ and 16{,}384 for dense rotation methods. A fused four-kernel Metal GPU pipeline performs attention directly on packed 3-bit tensors without materializing full-precision KV state---a different execution model, not just a quantization scheme. The combined system fits Gemma 4-26B-A4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B within a 16\,GB budget and Nemotron-H 120B within 32\,GB, running interactively at 9--19 tok/s with near-zero perplexity degradation ($Δ$PPL $\leq +0.0012$) and 100\% retrieval accuracy at 32K context.
papers.comment: 9 Pages, 9 Tables, Initial submission into NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RotaryQuant 是一个面向消费级硬件的三轴压缩系统，目标是将 26–120B 参数的混合专家 (MoE) 语言模型装入有限内存。它结合混合精度权重量化、LRU 专家换出 (expert offloading) 和基于 Walsh–Hadamard 变换与块对角 SO(4) 旋转的 IsoQuant KV cache 压缩，并通过融合的 Metal GPU 四内核流水线直接在打包的 3-bit 张量上执行注意力。摘要报告该系统可将 Gemma 4-26B-A4B 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 装入 16GB 内存、Nemotron-H 120B 装入 32GB，运行速度为 9–19 tok/s，困惑度几乎无退化，32K 上下文下检索准确率为 100%。
Motivation: 26–120B 参数的 MoE 模型在消费级设备上受三类内存压力同时制约：常驻权重矩阵、随上下文线性增长的 KV cache，以及需要按需分页的数十个专家子层；现有方法通常只针对其中某一类问题。
Method: 提出三轴压缩方案：混合精度权重量化按架构角色分配位宽，稠密层 4-bit、路由专家 2-bit、共享专家 8-bit；LRU 专家换出在真实内存压力下将非驻留专家分页到磁盘；新颖的 IsoQuant 对 KV cache 先做 Walsh–Hadamard 变换再接块对角 SO(4) 旋转以各向同性化 (isotropize) 激活分布，然后进行 3-bit 标量量化，每个头仅需 O(d log d) 运算和 256 个存储参数，而稠密旋转方法需要 O(d^2) 和 16384 个参数。此外用融合的 Metal GPU 四内核流水线直接在打包张量上计算注意力，不物化全精度 KV 状态。
Result: 摘要报告该系统在 16GB 预算内运行 Gemma 4-26B-A4B 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B，在 32GB 内运行 Nemotron-H 120B，交互速度 9–19 tok/s，困惑度退化 ΔPPL ≤ +0.0012，32K 上下文下检索准确率保持 100%。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是一种不同的执行模型 (execution model) 而不仅是量化方案；联合压缩权重、专家与 KV cache 可以把大规模 MoE 模型部署到消费级硬件上。摘要中未提及对非 Metal/非 GPU 平台的适用性或更极端上下文下的表现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PATH: Next-Interval Prediction via Autoregressive Tree Hierarchy on Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Interval prediction aims to achieve a target coverage level while producing intervals that are as short as possible. Many conformal regression pipelines first predict an uncertainty surrogate and then convert it into an interval through calibration or selection. This separation supports coverage calibration, but post hoc rules largely determine the final interval and do not fully use the learned output distribution. We observe that the resulting intervals have inherently hierarchical geometry: an interval can be recursively refined into nested subintervals, and binary trees naturally represent this structure. We formulate this hierarchy as next-interval prediction and propose PATH, which learns how probability mass flows from each interval to its next nested subintervals. PATH predicts a base leaf distribution and uses an autoregressive decoder to refine branch probabilities. Matching the distribution to the interval hierarchy aligns learning with extraction: PATH accumulates probability over adjacent output intervals and returns the shortest contiguous range reaching a selected mass. We compare PATH with 24 baselines for interval prediction on PATHBench, comprising 56 OpenML regression datasets. PATH substantially shortens the resulting intervals, achieving the lowest mean normalized length, 0.1473, while maintaining mean coverage of 0.9144. These results establish hierarchical output modeling as an effective approach for compact interval prediction on tabular data. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/pxcai/PATH.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PATH，将表格数据的区间预测重新建模为自回归树层级上的“下一区间预测”问题。PATH 学习概率质量如何从每个区间流向其嵌套子区间，通过匹配分布与区间层级，沿相邻输出区间累积概率并返回达到目标概率质量的连续最短区间。在 PATHBench（56 个 OpenML 回归数据集）上与 24 个基线比较，PATH 以最低平均归一化长度 0.1473 保持平均覆盖率 0.9144。
Motivation: 现有 conformal regression 流水线通常先预测不确定性代理，再通过校准或选择转换为区间；这种分离虽能校准覆盖率，但最终区间基本由事后规则决定，未充分利用学到的输出分布。作者观察到区间具有天然的层级几何结构，可通过二叉树递归细化，因此值得将区间预测形式化为层级上的下一区间预测。
Method: PATH 将区间层级建模为递归嵌套的子区间二叉树，预测基础叶分布，并使用自回归解码器细化分支概率，使学到的分布与区间层级对齐；推理时累积相邻输出区间的概率质量，返回达到选定质量的最短连续区间。
Result: 在 PATHBench 的 56 个 OpenML 回归数据集上，PATH 与 24 个区间预测基线比较，取得最低平均归一化长度 0.1473，同时平均覆盖率为 0.9144。
Conclusion: 摘要将这些结果解释为层级输出建模是表格数据上紧凑区间预测的有效途径，并指出代码公开可用；该工作聚焦表格回归区间预测，未涉及天气或降水场景。

papers.title: Explore, Map, Remember, Decide: Are Embodied VLMs Ready for Safety-Critical Scenarios?
papers.abstract_en: Theory of Space framework (ToS) assesses the spatial understanding of curiosity-driven Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under partial observability. As AI techniques are increasingly applied to safety-critical scenarios, it is crucial to understand whether VLMs possess robust spatial memory and make reliable decisions. In this paper, we assess whether VLMs' decisions are based on physical evidence or are corrupted by visual-language biases, if their memory processes align with human cognitive patterns, and how they respond to environmental hazards. We extend the ToS framework into a safety-critical, goal-driven pipeline, named Explore, Map, Remember, and Decide (EMRD). We then quantify Exploration Competence (Explore) through metrics of environmental coverage and temporal efficiency, assess Spatial Fidelity (Map), evaluate, with a suite of psychological metrics, Memory Persistence (Remember), and measure, using focal-point metrics, Cognitive Decision-Making (Decide). Our results show that in terms of decision-making capabilities, VLMs frequently select evacuation points based on pre-trained textual priors while lacking the spatial grounding to justify their choices. We also show that spatial reasoning degrades in low-light conditions, but it is not affected by texture and colour tampering. Our findings suggest that VLM memory fundamentally diverges from human cognition, creating unpredictable risks of misalignment.

TL;DR: 本文扩展了 Theory of Space (ToS) 框架，提出安全关键、目标驱动的评估管线 EMRD（Explore, Map, Remember, Decide），用于在部分可观测条件下检验好奇心驱动的视觉语言模型（VLM）的空间理解与决策。结果表明，VLM 在决策时经常基于预训练文本先验选择疏散点而缺乏空间依据，其空间推理在弱光条件下退化，但不受纹理和颜色篡改影响，且记忆过程与人类认知存在根本差异，带来不可预测的错位风险。
Motivation: 随着 AI 越来越多地应用于安全关键场景，需要确认 VLM 是否具备稳健的空间记忆并能做出可靠决策；作者希望判断 VLM 的决策是依据物理证据还是被视觉-语言偏见污染，以及其记忆过程是否与人类认知模式一致。
Method: 将 ToS 框架扩展为安全关键的 EMRD 管线，分别量化探索能力（Explore）的覆盖率与时间效率、空间保真度（Map）、记忆持久性（Remember，使用一组心理学指标），以及认知决策（Decide，使用焦点度量）。
Result: 实验发现，VLM 在选择疏散点时频繁依赖预训练文本先验而缺乏空间依据；空间推理在低光照条件下明显退化，但对纹理和颜色篡改不敏感。
Conclusion: VLM 的记忆在根本上偏离人类认知模式，这可能在安全关键场景中造成不可预测的错位风险，表明其尚不足以可靠地用于此类任务。

papers.title: Search over the Visual World: Persistent Visual Memory, Layered Indexes, and Source-Grounded Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Most video-retrieval systems assume a bounded corpus and return ranked files or timestamps. Agents operating over cameras, screens, streams, and archives face a different systems problem: observations arrive continuously; models interpret them at different temporal granularities; context must be selected without replaying the complete visual record; and results must stay connected to inspectable source evidence. We argue that search over such a corpus is an infrastructure problem that cannot be reduced to ranking video files. We develop a conceptual and formal model of search over the visual world built on analyzer-defined scenes, persistent understanding artifacts, visual memory as coexisting scene spaces over shared source time, and capability-declared indexes, distinguishing memory (everything retained), context (what is selected for a task), and evidence (the source intervals that ground it). The VideoDB data format (VDB) realizes this model in production, exposed through a typed search surface spanning planned retrieval, stateful investigation, direct access, and grounded synthesis. We contrast this model-agnostic infrastructure, where segmentation, sampling, model choice, embeddings, and ranking are system decisions and live streams are first-class sources, with video-native foundation models offered as fixed APIs. In a semantic-retrieval comparison against a commercial video-native engine spanning 9,800+ queries over four public datasets, a pipeline of general-purpose components achieves higher macro-averaged Recall@1/@3/@10 (73.09/83.39/91.20 versus 65.75/77.13/89.10), while the baseline is higher at Recall@50 (96.42 versus 96.07). Retrieval quality over the visual world is today governed more by system design than by video-specific pretraining, and visual-memory infrastructure can deliver it while keeping playable, source-grounded evidence first-class.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 5 figures, 17 tables. Technical report. Benchmark configurations and reproduction instructions: https://github.com/video-db/search-over-the-visual-world
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对摄像头、屏幕、流媒体和档案等持续到达的视觉数据，提出将“搜索视觉世界”视为基础设施问题而非视频文件排序问题。作者建立了以分析器定义的场景 (analyzer-defined scenes)、持久理解产物、共享源时间上共存的场景空间式视觉记忆，以及声明能力的索引 (capability-declared indexes) 为核心的概念与形式化模型，并用 VideoDB (VDB) 数据格式在工程上实现。在与商业视频原生引擎的语义检索对比中，通用组件流水线在 9800+ 查询上取得更高的宏平均 Recall@1/3/10，但 Recall@50 略低。
Motivation: 现有视频检索系统假设有界语料库，只返回排序后的文件或时间戳；而面向摄像头、屏幕和实时流的智能体需要处理持续到达的观测、不同时间粒度的模型解释，并必须在不重放完整视觉记录的前提下选取上下文，同时保证结果可追溯到可检查的源证据。
Method: 提出一个模型无关的基础设施方案：区分记忆 (memory，保留全部内容)、上下文 (context，为任务选取的部分) 与证据 (evidence，支撑结果的源区间)。该模型以 VideoDB (VDB) 数据格式落地，提供涵盖计划检索、有状态调查、直接访问和基于证据的合成等能力的类型化搜索界面，并将分段、采样、模型选择、嵌入和排序都作为系统级决策。
Result: 在覆盖四个公开数据集、9800+ 查询的语义检索对比中，通用组件流水线的宏平均 Recall@1/@3/@10 为 73.09/83.39/91.20，高于商业视频原生引擎的 65.75/77.13/89.10；但在 Recall@50 上基线更高（96.42 对 96.07）。
Conclusion: 作者认为当前视觉世界的检索质量更多由系统设计而非视频专用预训练决定，并强调视觉记忆基础设施可以在保持可播放、源可查证据为第一类公民的同时实现这一质量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HugSelect: An Explainable Multi-Criteria Decision-Support Framework for foundation-model selection
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are increasingly reused as software components, making model selection a critical software-engineering decision. Current model hubs primarily support discovery through popularity metrics, often neglecting functional capabilities, operational constraints, and community-perceived quality. We argue that foundation-model selection should be treated as an explicit, auditable software-component selection task rather than as keyword search, popularity ranking, or opaque conversational advice. This paper proposes HugSelect, an explainable decision-support framework for foundation-model selection. HugSelect builds a knowledge base of 71,274 models by combining repository metadata, extracted functional capabilities, and perceived quality attributes derived from community discussions into a unified pipeline. It ranks candidate models using a weighted additive model that exposes criterion-level score decompositions. We evaluated HugSelect through pipeline validation, comparative case studies against four commercial LLM-based recommendation systems (44 scenarios), fine-grained ablation, and an exploratory user study (n = 10). Extraction pipelines achieved an F1 score of 0.801 for functional features and an accuracy of 0.84 for quality-attribute mapping. HugSelect achieved a model-level Coverage@10 of 0.61 and family-level Coverage@10 of 0.91, showing recommendation quality comparable to that of the evaluated commercial systems, with no significant overall differences in ranking quality, while providing stable, traceable, and inspectable reasoning. Ablation confirmed that functional features were the main driver of retrieval accuracy, and preliminary user feedback suggests that the framework is useful and intuitive.
papers.comment: Pages: 29, Figures: 5. Corresponding authors: Alireza Joonbakhsh (alireza.joonbakhsh@hafez.shirazu.ac.ir) and Siamak Farshidi (siamak.farshidi@wur.nl)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HugSelect，一个面向基础模型选择的可解释多准则决策支持框架。作者将基础模型选择视为显式、可审计的软件组件选择任务，构建了包含 71,274 个模型的知识库，结合仓库元数据、提取的功能能力与从社区讨论得到的感知质量属性，并用加权加性模型 (weighted additive model) 排序候选模型。评估显示其抽取管线在功能特征上 F1 为 0.801、质量属性映射准确率为 0.84，模型级 Coverage@10 为 0.61、家族级为 0.91，推荐质量与四个商业 LLM 推荐系统相当。
Motivation: 基础模型越来越多地被复用为软件组件，模型选择成为关键的软件工程决策；现有模型中心主要通过流行度指标支持发现，忽略了功能能力、运行约束和社区感知质量。作者主张应把选择过程做成显式、可审计的决策任务，而非关键词搜索、流行度排序或不透明的对话式建议。
Method: HugSelect 将仓库元数据、抽取的功能能力以及从社区讨论中导出的感知质量属性组合成统一管线，构建知识库；然后使用加权加性模型对候选模型排序，并暴露准则层面的分数分解，使推理过程可解释、可追踪。
Result: 摘要报告抽取管线对功能特征的 F1 为 0.801，质量属性映射准确率为 0.84；HugSelect 的模型级 Coverage@10 为 0.61，家族级 Coverage@10 为 0.91，与所评估的商业系统在排名质量上无显著总体差异。消融实验确认功能特征是检索准确率的主要驱动因素，初步用户研究（n = 10）表明框架有用且直观。
Conclusion: HugSelect 能在与商业系统相当的推荐质量下提供稳定、可追踪、可检查的推理；作者强调将基础模型选择作为可审计的软件组件选择任务来处理。初步用户反馈支持其有用性与直观性，但用户研究规模较小，属于探索性结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NeuroGuard: Neural Gradient Update Aware of Representation Damage
papers.abstract_en: Long-tailed class-incremental learning (LT-CIL) must learn new classes from imbalanced streams while retaining old classes. Existing methods mainly change replay, classifiers, or losses. We study a different factor, namely how strongly the feature representation should be updated at each task boundary. We propose NeuroGuard, an update-control method added to DGR, a replay-based LT-CIL baseline, without adding learnable parameters. NeuroGuard preserves DGR's replay memory, classifier, and set of loss terms. Adaptive Gradient Scaling (AGS) converts teacher uncertainty into one task-wise gradient scale. Confidence-Ranked Knowledge Distillation Reweighting (CRK) gives larger knowledge-distillation weights to replay samples that the teacher predicts less decisively. Fragility-Blended Entropy Gate (FBE) adds old-memory leakage to the scale decision. Across five LT-CIL settings, NeuroGuard improves over DGR in every setting. In the four main benchmark comparisons, it achieves the best task-agnostic accuracy among the compared methods. The gains extend to both old- and new-class accuracy, while medium-frequency accuracy improves consistently across all five settings. Controlled comparisons show that the gain does not come from generic gradient suppression: AGS outperforms a matched fixed-scale control in all five settings, demonstrating that boundary-specific scaling is more effective than applying the same average scale throughout learning.
papers.comment: Accepted at HCV workshop on ECCV2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长尾类增量学习（LT-CIL）中特征表示在每个任务边界应被更新多强的问题，提出 NeuroGuard，一种无需增加可学习参数、叠加在基于回放的 DGR 基线之上的更新控制方法。NeuroGuard 包含三个组件：Adaptive Gradient Scaling（AGS）将教师不确定性转化为任务级梯度缩放，Confidence-Ranked Knowledge Distillation Reweighting（CRK）对教师预测不果断的回放样本赋予更大的蒸馏权重，Fragility-Blended Entropy Gate（FBE）将旧记忆泄漏引入缩放决策。在五个 LT-CIL 设置中，NeuroGuard 均优于 DGR，并在四个主要基准比较中取得最佳的任务无关准确率。
Motivation: 现有 LT-CIL 方法主要修改回放、分类器或损失函数，而较少关注每个任务边界处特征表示的更新强度；作者希望研究这一独立因素对旧类保持和新类学习的影响。
Method: 方法不改变 DGR 的回放记忆、分类器和损失项集合，只通过 AGS 使用教师不确定性生成任务级梯度缩放因子，通过 CRK 按教师预测置信度重加权知识蒸馏损失（knowledge distillation），并通过 FBE 在缩放决策中融入旧记忆泄漏信息。
Result: 在五个 LT-CIL 设置中 NeuroGuard 均超过 DGR；四个主要基准比较中取得最佳任务无关准确率，旧类与新类准确率均有提升，且中频类准确率在全部五个设置中一致改善。受控比较表明收益并非来自单纯梯度抑制：AGS 在五个设置中均优于匹配的固定缩放控制，说明边界特定缩放比全程使用同一平均缩放更有效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在任务边界进行自适应、与教师不确定性及旧记忆相关的梯度缩放，可以有效改善基于回放的 LT-CIL 方法，且不引入额外可学习参数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DialectS2S: End-to-End Speech Dialogue Modeling for Low-Resource Chinese Dialects
papers.abstract_en: Current end-to-end speech dialogue models are primarily optimized for mainstream languages and remain limited in low-resource dialect scenarios due to the scarcity of dialect speech data. Moreover, during dialect adaptation, the semantic representation space of speech dialogue models continuously evolves, while conventional speech supervision remains unchanged, leading to semantic inconsistency between hidden representations and speech targets and degrading speech stability and naturalness. To address these issues, we propose DialectS2S, an end-to-end speech dialogue model for Chinese dialects. We first develop a scalable dialect speech dialogue synthesis pipeline for efficient data construction. We further introduce a two-stage post-training strategy with self-aligned speech supervision, which aligns the semantic content of speech supervision with the evolved semantic representations of the model to improve dialect speech generation quality. Experimental results show that DialectS2S consistently outperforms existing baselines across multiple Chinese dialects in speech dialogue, achieving substantial improvements in dialect consistency, response quality, and speech intelligibility. Our work provides an efficient and scalable solution for end-to-end speech dialogue modeling in low-resource dialect scenarios. To facilitate future research and practical applications, we fully open-source the DialectS2S framework, including model checkpoints, training datasets, and fine-tuning code.

Result: 实验结果显示，在多个中文方言的语音对话任务上，DialectS2S 一致优于现有基线，在方言一致性、响应质量和语音可懂度方面均取得大幅改善。
Conclusion: 该工作为低资源方言场景下的端到端语音对话建模提供了高效且可扩展的解决方案，并通过开源模型检查点、训练数据集和微调代码来支持后续研究与应用。

papers.title: EvBS: Event-guided Blur Synthesis for Domain-adaptive Motion Deblurring
papers.abstract_en: Motion deblurring has achieved remarkable progress with deep learning, yet pre-trained deblurring models often suffer from performance degradation in real-world scenarios due to the domain shift between training and testing distributions. To remedy this, we propose EvBS, an event-guided blur synthesis framework that generates diverse training pairs for calibrating pre-trained models to the target domain. While existing methods are constrained by the inherent entanglement between motion and visual content, our method leverages the high temporal resolution of event cameras to effectively decouple them. This enables us to utilize not only the intrinsic motion that is inherent to the given content but also extrinsic motion transferred from different sources within the target domain, thereby facilitating effective adaptation via fine-tuning. Specifically, EvBS comprises two complementary strategies: Intrinsic-Blur Synthesis, which blurs sharp contents with their own motion patterns, and Extrinsic-Blur Synthesis, which transfers motion from blurry patches to distinct sharp content. This approach generates a diverse set of training pairs that break the inherent constraints of naturally coupled motion and content, resulting in enhanced domain-adaptive deblurring performance. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that EvBS effectively enhances the robustness of existing deblurring models on unseen testing datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EvBS，一种事件引导的模糊合成 (event-guided blur synthesis) 框架，用于运动去模糊模型的域自适应。该方法利用事件相机的高时间分辨率解耦运动与视觉内容，通过内在模糊合成和外在模糊合成生成多样化的训练对，以微调预训练去模糊模型到目标域。多个基准实验表明该方法能提升现有去模糊模型在未见测试集上的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 预训练的运动去模糊模型在真实场景中常因训练与测试分布之间的域偏移 (domain shift) 而性能下降。现有方法受到运动与视觉内容天然纠缠的限制，难以生成多样且解耦的训练样本，因此需要一种能有效解耦运动与内容的目标域自适应方案。
Method: 提出 EvBS 框架，借助事件相机的高时间分辨率将运动与视觉内容解耦。框架包含两种互补策略：内在模糊合成 (Intrinsic-Blur Synthesis) 用内容自身的运动模式模糊清晰内容；外在模糊合成 (Extrinsic-Blur Synthesis) 将模糊块中的运动转移到不同的清晰内容上，从而生成多样化训练对并用于微调自适应。
Result: 在多个基准上的广泛实验表明，EvBS 能有效增强现有去模糊模型在未见测试数据集上的鲁棒性；摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 通过解耦运动与内容并生成打破自然耦合约束的多样化训练对，可以提升域自适应运动去模糊的效果；该方法面向现有预训练模型的校准与微调。

papers.title: CLAM: Causal Spatial Disaggregation to Infer Local Effects From Coarse Data
papers.abstract_en: Learning fine-grained spatial patterns from coarse-resolution data is challenging, especially in causal settings where high-resolution effects must be inferred from aggregated interventions and outcomes. We introduce CLAM, a method for estimating localized causal effects from coarse observations by exploiting high-resolution contextual covariates that modulate these effects. By jointly learning the causal mechanism and a disaggregation mapping, CLAM captures interactions that are missed when addressing these problems independently. The method supports localized effect estimation, counterfactual reasoning, and principled outcome disaggregation, and reliably captures spatially varying causal effects across diverse settings. This is particularly relevant for applications such as public health and environmental policy, where decisions are made at broad scales despite substantial local heterogeneity. Code is available at https://github.com/gerritgr/clam
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLAM，一种从粗粒度观测数据估计局部因果效应的方法，通过利用高分辨率上下文协变量来推断空间变化的效应。该方法联合学习因果机制与分解映射（disaggregation mapping），支持局部效应估计、反事实推理以及原则性的结果分解，并在多种设置下稳定捕捉空间异质因果效应。
Motivation: 从粗分辨率数据学习细粒度空间模式很困难，尤其是在因果场景中，需要从聚合的干预和结果推断高分辨率效应；而公共健康与环境政策常在广尺度上决策，却存在显著的局部异质性。
Method: CLAM 通过联合学习因果机制与一个分解映射，利用高分辨率上下文协变量对局部效应进行调制，从而捕捉将因果推断与空间分解独立处理时会遗漏的交互信息。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能可靠地在多种设置下捕捉空间变化的因果效应，但未给出具体的量化结果或基准数据。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法对公共健康和环境政策等应用尤其相关，并已公开代码（https://github.com/gerritgr/clam）。

papers.title: CORDA: A Benchmark for Hierarchical Harm-Centric Moral Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The key question in moral judgement is not simply whether someone chooses the "right" answer, but how they decide what matters most when moral principles conflict. Current evaluations of large language models (LLMs) remain limited: most test whether models give morally acceptable answers, match human preferences, or avoid obvious violations, rather than whether they can prioritise between competing principles when no option is morally cost-free. We introduce CORDA (Conditioned Ordering and Ranked Directive Adherence), a benchmark for evaluating hierarchical, harm-centred moral reasoning in LLMs. Building on the morality chains formalism, CORDA tests 90 moral dilemmas involving trolley-style cases, medical trade-offs, resource allocation, and human-animal-robot conflicts across four ordered ethical frameworks: Utility, Utility + Agent Harm, Dual-Process, and Dual-Process + Agent Harm. Together, these frameworks test whether models can adapt their decisions when moral priorities change. Across ten instruction-tuned models from seven providers, we find a strong deontological default, with 9 of 10 prioritising avoidance of direct personal harm over reducing overall harm. Models also perform more reliably on categorical harm-avoidance rules, such as avoiding killing, than on outcome-based comparisons, such as minimising total harm, suggesting that they recognise moral red lines more easily than they reason through competing harms. Although all models respond to explicit chain conditioning, several fail to consistently follow specified priority orderings, such as humans over animals and animals over robots. CORDA addresses a central gap in LLM moral evaluation by testing whether models can move beyond default harm-avoidant responses and apply context-specified moral priorities. Moral reliability requires more than default restraint; it requires controllability under conflict.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the Fourth International Workshop on Value Engineering in AI (VALE 2026), affiliated with IJCAI-ECAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CORDA（Conditioned Ordering and Ranked Directive Adherence），一个用于评估大语言模型（LLM）层级化、以伤害为中心的道德推理能力的基准。该基准基于 morality chains 形式化方法，包含 90 个道德困境（涉及电车难题、医疗权衡、资源分配及人-动物-机器人冲突），并覆盖 Utility、Utility + Agent Harm、Dual-Process、Dual-Process + Agent Harm 四种有序伦理框架。在来自七家提供方的十个指令微调模型上，作者发现模型普遍表现出强烈的道义论默认倾向。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 道德评估大多只测试模型是否给出可接受的答案、是否匹配人类偏好或避免明显违规，而未能检验当道德原则相互冲突且任何选择都有道德代价时，模型能否在竞争性原则之间进行优先排序。
Method: 作者基于 morality chains 形式化方法构建 CORDA 基准，设计 90 个道德困境，并通过四种有序伦理框架（Utility、Utility + Agent Harm、Dual-Process、Dual-Process + Agent Harm）测试模型在道德优先级改变时是否能调整决策，以及是否遵循明确指定的优先顺序（如人类优先于动物、动物优先于机器人）。
Result: 在十个指令微调模型中，9/10 优先选择避免直接个人伤害而非减少总体伤害；模型对分类性伤害规避规则（如避免杀人）的表现比对结果导向比较（如最小化总伤害）更可靠，说明模型更容易识别道德红线，而非对相互冲突的伤害进行推理。此外，尽管所有模型对显式链条件都有反应，部分模型未能一致遵循指定的优先顺序。
Conclusion: CORDA 填补了 LLM 道德评估的一个核心空白，即测试模型能否超越默认的伤害规避反应并应用上下文指定的道德优先级；作者强调道德可靠性不仅需要默认约束，还需要在冲突情境下的可控性（controllability）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ZOMP: Zeroth-Order Multi-Modal Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning vision-language models such as CLIP typically requires backpropagation (BP) through the full model, which is infeasible when only forward-pass access is available, as is common for memory-constrained edge devices and proprietary model deployments. Prior BP-free, zeroth-order prompt-tuning methods avoid this requirement but often tune prompts in a single modality or optimize over a search space large enough that convergence requires thousands of forward passes, which is impractical under realistic query budgets. We propose ZOMP (Zeroth-Order Multimodal Prompt tuning), a query-efficient, fully forward-only method that tunes deep prompts in both the vision and text branches of a frozen CLIP model using simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation. ZOMP combines three ingredients: a cross-modal low-rank reparameterization that ties the two branches through a shared factor and keeps the effective search dimensionality small, a gradient-correction momentum term that stabilizes the noisy zeroth-order estimate, and a budget-indexed rank schedule that unlocks capacity as the query budget is spent. Across 13 vision-language benchmarks under a matched 5,000-query budget, ZOMP consistently outperforms prior BP-free prompt-tuning methods in both few-shot accuracy and query efficiency, and it generalizes better across base-to-new, cross-dataset transfer, and out-of-distribution settings. Our results show that jointly exploiting multimodality and low-rank structure is an effective route to practical, query-efficient BP-free prompt tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ZOMP（Zeroth-Order Multimodal Prompt tuning），一种完全前向传播（forward-only）的零阶提示微调方法，用于冻结的 CLIP 模型。该方法在视觉和文本分支同时调整深层提示（deep prompts），使用同步扰动随机逼近（SPSA），并引入跨模态低秩重参数化、梯度校正动量项和预算索引秩调度。在 13 个视觉-语言基准和 5000 次查询预算下，ZOMP 在少样本精度和查询效率上均优于先前的无反向传播（BP-free）提示微调方法。
Motivation: 微调 CLIP 等视觉-语言模型通常需要贯穿全模型的反向传播，但在仅能进行前向传播的场景（如内存受限的边缘设备或专有模型部署）中不可行。已有的零阶提示微调方法要么只调单一模态，要么搜索空间过大导致需要数千次前向传播才能收敛，在现实查询预算下不实用。
Method: ZOMP 是一种查询高效的完全前向方法，在冻结 CLIP 的视觉和文本分支中同时调整深层提示，优化算法为同步扰动随机逼近。方法包含三个组件：通过共享因子连接两个分支的跨模态低秩重参数化以降低有效搜索维度、稳定噪声零阶估计的梯度校正动量项，以及随查询预算消耗解锁模型容量的预算索引秩调度。
Result: 在 13 个视觉-语言基准上、统一使用 5000 次查询预算的条件下，ZOMP 在少样本准确率和查询效率上持续优于先前的 BP-free 提示微调方法，并在 base-to-new、跨数据集迁移和分布外（out-of-distribution）设置下表现出更好的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，联合利用多模态性和低秩结构是实现实用且查询高效的零阶提示微调的有效途径。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 ZOMP（Zeroth-Order Multimodal Prompt tuning），一种完全前向传播（forward-only）的零阶提示微调方法，用于冻结的 CLIP 模型。该方法在视觉和文本分支同时调整深层提示（deep prompts），使用同步扰动随机逼近（SPSA），并引入跨模态低秩重参数化、梯度校正动量项和预算索引秩调度。在 13 个视觉-语言基准和 5000 次查询预算下，ZOMP 在少样本精度和查询效率上均优于先前的无反向传播（BP-free）提示微调方法。
summary_sections.motivation: 微调 CLIP 等视觉-语言模型通常需要贯穿全模型的反向传播，但在仅能进行前向传播的场景（如内存受限的边缘设备或专有模型部署）中不可行。已有的零阶提示微调方法要么只调单一模态，要么搜索空间过大导致需要数千次前向传播才能收敛，在现实查询预算下不实用。
summary_sections.method: ZOMP 是一种查询高效的完全前向方法，在冻结 CLIP 的视觉和文本分支中同时调整深层提示，优化算法为同步扰动随机逼近。方法包含三个组件：通过共享因子连接两个分支的跨模态低秩重参数化以降低有效搜索维度、稳定噪声零阶估计的梯度校正动量项，以及随查询预算消耗解锁模型容量的预算索引秩调度。
summary_sections.result: 在 13 个视觉-语言基准上、统一使用 5000 次查询预算的条件下，ZOMP 在少样本准确率和查询效率上持续优于先前的 BP-free 提示微调方法，并在 base-to-new、跨数据集迁移和分布外（out-of-distribution）设置下表现出更好的泛化能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，联合利用多模态性和低秩结构是实现实用且查询高效的零阶提示微调的有效途径。

papers.title: H2: A Dual Hybrid Semantic Data Lake Architecture for Medical Data Harmonization with Human-In-the-Loop verified, LLM Driven Metadata Annotation System
papers.abstract_en: Medical data, by its nature, exhibit a high degree of heterogeneity on multiple levels ranging from (a) different modalities like images, text and time series, (b) diverse tabular schemata introduced by institutions and (c) completely unstructured textual information data provided by healthcare professionals. Data lakes are often used in medical data storage to consolidate all heterogeneous diverse data in a single, central location, where it can be saved "as is", without the need to impose a schema like a data warehouse does. Despite their flexibility, though, data lakes are notorious for the "data swamp" failure. Thus, providing a reliable data harmonization mechanism through metadata, without compromising integrity or flexibility, is a real challenge. To this end, knowledge graphs have attracted attention since they provide a dynamic way to depict relationships without a rigid schema-on-write approach. Additionally, another rigorous task relies on the interoperability of data: application of appropriate ML techniques on such a diverse nature of data is not an easy task, as a domain expert must decide the efficacy of a method to a specific data type or dataset. Metadata annotation can aid by tagging applicable operations, however this requires manual intervention, not to mention the plethora of existing datasets which lack such information. To tackle both challenges, in this paper, we propose a semantic data lake architecture that promotes data harmonization and incorporates a generative annotation process (i.e. LLMs) of non-labeled metadata collections to support the application of meaningful ML techniques. Building on top of this approach, we create a higher level of knowledge, identifying suitability of data with respect to applicable ML operations based on their data nature...

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向医学数据协调的语义数据湖架构，针对医疗数据在模态、表格 schema 和自由文本层面的高度异构性，以及数据湖易退化为 data swamp 的问题。架构利用知识图谱刻画无 rigid schema 的动态关系，并结合 LLM 驱动的生成式标注流程为未标注元数据集合自动生成标注，同时引入人在回路 (Human-in-the-Loop) 验证。摘要称在此基础上可构建数据与适用 ML 操作之间适配性的高层知识，以支持对多样医疗数据应用有意义的机器学习技术。
Motivation: 医疗数据高度异构且现有数据湖虽灵活但容易变成 data swamp，因此需要在不损害完整性与灵活性的前提下实现可靠的数据协调。另一个困难是数据互操作性：面对多样数据，领域专家必须人工判断何种 ML 技术适用于特定数据类型或数据集，而元数据标注可以辅助这一决策但依赖人工且大量现有数据集缺少此类信息。
Method: 提出语义数据湖架构，整合知识图谱以动态表达数据关系，并采用生成式标注机制，即利用 LLM 对缺乏标注的元数据集合进行自动标注。在生成标注之上加入人工验证，并进一步构建识别数据与适用 ML 操作之间适配性的更高层知识。
Result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果或具体基准数据，只描述了架构设计与预期能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为该架构能够提供可靠的数据协调机制，同时不牺牲数据完整性和灵活性，并通过 LLM 驱动的元数据标注支持对异构医疗数据应用合适的 ML 技术。摘要未提及具体评测或局限性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SodaMem: Evidence-Grounded Temporal Graph Memory for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents that assist users over weeks of conversation must remember what is currently true, not merely what was once said. Flat RAG diaries and Markdown logs optimize needle retrieval but under-serve currency, provenance, and ordered temporal reasoning (Maharana et al. 2024; Wu et al. 2024; Packer et al. 2023; Chhikara et al. 2025). We present SodaMem, an evidence-grounded temporal graph memory that (i) extracts typed FactEvents with mandatory provenance spans, (ii) persists mention time, occurrence time, and validity with SUPERSEDES/CONTRADICTS/UPDATES edges under hybrid lexical-dense indexing, and (iii) answers via a planner-reader loop that gathers citable evidence before composing a final response. On LongMemEval-S, our store-of-record configuration reaches 92.8% accuracy (464/500; best of N=3) at mean $0.00161/question (approximately 18.3k tokens; median $0.00111 / approximately 14.6k) with deepseek-v4-flash. We compile public systems with estimable API cost into a cost table and cost-accuracy map; under these estimates SodaMem sits near the accuracy frontier at Flash-tier spend and strictly dominates several higher-cost, lower-accuracy points. Accuracy uses the same Flash model as reader and judge (self-grading); costs exclude ingest/judge and cross-system comparisons are compiled estimates rather than a single-harness bake-off.Our code is available at https://github.com/SodaMem/SodaMem
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SodaMem，一种面向 LLM 智能体长期对话的、以证据为锚定的时序图记忆 (evidence-grounded temporal graph memory)。它抽取带强制溯源片段 (provenance spans) 的类型化事实事件 (FactEvents)，用 SUPERSEDES/CONTRADICTS/UPDATES 边保存提及时间、发生时间和有效性，并通过 planner-reader 循环在作答前收集可引用证据。在 LongMemEval-S 上，store-of-record 配置在 deepseek-v4-flash 下达到 92.8% 准确率，且单位成本很低。
Motivation: 现有平面 RAG 日记和 Markdown 日志擅长针式检索 (needle retrieval)，但对信息的新鲜度 (currency)、溯源 (provenance) 和有序时序推理支持不足；跨数周对话的 LLM 智能体需要记住“当前为真”的事实，而不仅是曾经说过的话。
Method: SodaMem 抽取带强制溯源片段和类型的 FactEvents，持久化提及时间、发生时间与有效性，并在混合词法-稠密索引 (hybrid lexical-dense indexing) 下建立 SUPERSEDES/CONTRADICTS/UPDATES 关系边；回答阶段采用 planner-reader 循环，先收集可引用证据再生成最终回复。
Result: 在 LongMemEval-S 上，store-of-record 配置达到 92.8% 准确率（464/500，N=3 最优），平均每问约 $0.00161（约 18.3k tokens），中位数约 $0.00111（约 14.6k），使用 deepseek-v4-flash。作者将可估算 API 成本的公开系统汇成成本表与成本-准确率图，SodaMem 在 Flash 级花费下接近准确率前沿，并严格支配若干更高成本、更低准确率的点；但准确率使用同一 Flash 模型作为 reader 与 judge（自评分），成本排除 ingest/judge，跨系统比较为估算而非单平台统一评测。
Conclusion: 本文主张以证据锚定的时序图记忆能更好地支撑长期对话智能体的时效性、溯源与有序时序推理；作者同时明确承认自评分、成本估算与非统一评测等局限性，并开源代码。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: PhysX-CoT: Structured Physical Reasoning from a Single Image to Simulation-Ready 3D Assets
papers.abstract_en: Simulation-ready 3D assets are central to robotics and embodied AI. Generating them from a single image is usually framed as a vision-language model that emits a serialized asset for a decoder to turn into geometry and physical fields, leaving the image-to-3D reasoning implicit. We argue the limiting factor is this output-centric view: part placement and local shape are entangled in one global-coordinate token stream, and the intermediate physical states are never exposed for supervision, conditioning, or verification. PhysX-CoT instead casts single-image asset generation as an explicit structured physical reasoning process, an ordered and machine-parseable trajectory of part-level states covering decomposition, 2D and 3D grounding, relations, coarse geometry, and surface cues that we separately supervise, use to condition geometry, and treat as reward targets. Geometry is factorized so that 3D boxes carry placement and local codes carry shape, and CoT-aligned GRPO optimizes parse validity, grounding, geometry, placement, and physical consistency. Under a unified protocol that retrains all learned baselines on the same backbone, data, and frozen decoder, PhysX-CoT outperforms the closest full-task baseline across geometry, scale, and physical-attribute metrics. Oracle, token-matched, and state-order controls show the explicit states are functional rather than cosmetic, and in Unreal Engine~5 the generated assets parse, collide, and articulate at high validity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhysX-CoT，将单张图像生成仿真就绪 3D 资产的任务重构为显式的结构化物理推理过程：输出一条有序、机器可解析的部件级状态轨迹，包括分解、2D/3D 对应、关系、粗略几何与表面线索。几何被分解为 3D 框负责放置、局部编码负责形状，并用 CoT-aligned GRPO 优化解析有效性、几何、放置与物理一致性。在统一训练协议下，PhysX-CoT 在几何、尺度和物理属性指标上优于最接近的全任务基线，且消融显示显式状态是功能性的，而非仅装饰。
Motivation: 现有从单图生成仿真就绪资产的方法常把图像到 3D 的推理视为隐式过程，部件放置与局部形状被纠缠在单一全局坐标的 token 流中，中间物理状态无法被监督、条件化或验证。作者认为这种输出为中心（output-centric）的视角是性能受限的关键因素。
Method: PhysX-CoT 将单图像资产生成转化为显式、可解析的部件级状态轨迹，每个状态覆盖分解、2D/3D grounding、关系、粗略几何和表面线索；这些状态分别被监督，用于条件化几何生成，并作为强化学习的奖励目标。几何采用因子化表示（3D 框负责放置、局部编码负责形状），通过 CoT-aligned GRPO 同时优化解析有效性、grounding、几何、放置和物理一致性。
Result: 在统一协议下将所有学习基线用相同骨干、数据和冻结解码器重新训练后，PhysX-CoT 在几何、尺度和物理属性指标上均超过最接近的全任务基线。Oracle、token 匹配和状态顺序三类对照实验表明显式状态是功能性而非装饰性；在 Unreal Engine 5 中生成的资产具有高有效性的解析、碰撞与铰接表现。
Conclusion: 作者认为输出为中心的序列化生成是限制仿真就绪资产质量的关键因素，显式暴露并监督中间物理状态能够带来可验证的收益。摘要未讨论明显局限，主要支持结构化物理推理作为单图像到 3D 资产生成范式的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tools to Explain Neural Networks for Power System Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents, for the first time in power systems literature to our knowledge, analytical tools to explain the training performance of machine learning surrogate models for power system dynamics. Power system simulations are increasingly challenged by stiff and multi-timescale dynamics arising from converter-interfaced resources and fast control loops. Machine learning surrogates emerge as promising tools to handle this complexity and accelerate dynamic simulations. However, their performance remains difficult to interpret, which limits their adoption. Building on the small-signal eigenvalue analysis in power systems, this paper uses the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) method. NTK delivers a modal interpretation of the learning performance, identifying error modes that decay rapidly versus others that converge slowly. This connection explains how physical stiffness and timescale separation in power system dynamic models appear as optimization stiffness during Neural Network (NN) training. Based on this analysis, we develop adaptive loss-weighting strategies to improve and explain why structure-aware neural architectures, such as ActNet, perform better than vanilla NNs. We assess the proposed approach on physics-informed machine learning surrogate models of \acp{SM} and power electronic converters. The methods introduced in this paper can deliver the necessary analytical tools to interpret and improve the performance of machine learning surrogates, paving the way for the systematic, physics-aware design of NN architectures and training strategies. By moving beyond trial-and-error development, these tools reveal training dynamics and failure modes, support more reliable design decisions, and strengthen confidence in machine-learning surrogates for engineering applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次在电力系统文献中提出用于解释机器学习替代模型（surrogate model）训练性能的分析工具。作者基于小信号特征值分析，引入神经正切核（Neural Tangent Kernel, NTK）方法，对电力系统动态仿真的神经网络训练给出模态解释，识别快速衰减与缓慢收敛的误差模态，并将物理刚性与时间尺度分离对应到训练中的优化刚性。基于该分析，作者提出自适应损失加权策略，并解释为何结构感知架构（如 ActNet）优于普通 NN，在同步电机与电力电子变流器的物理信息机器学习替代模型上进行了评估。
Motivation: 电力系统仿真因变流器接口资源和快速控制回路而面临刚性和多时间尺度动态的挑战，机器学习替代模型虽能加速动态仿真，但其性能难以解释，限制了实际采用。
Method: 借用电力系统的小信号特征值分析，用 NTK 方法对神经网络训练性能进行模态分解，据此构建物理刚度与优化刚度之间的联系，并开发自适应损失加权策略来解释和提升结构感知架构（如 ActNet）的训练表现。
Result: 摘要报告该方法首次为电力系统替代模型提供了解释训练性能的分析工具，识别出快速衰减与缓慢收敛的误差模态，并在物理信息机器学习替代模型（覆盖同步电机和电力电子变流器）上验证了其效果；未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些工具能够揭示训练动态与失败模式，支持更可靠的设计决策，推动超越试错式开发的、系统且物理感知的神经网络架构与训练策略设计；摘要未明确讨论局限。

papers.title: JustLLMGRPO: Radiographic Control for Chest X-Ray Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-conditioned chest X-ray generation aims to synthesize realistic radiographs that faithfully depict specified findings. Existing work has primarily improved quality by updating image generators, implicitly treating prompts as fixed after CXR-domain adaptation. We show that this generator-centric view leaves a substantial optimization dimension underexplored. With a CXR-adapted Sana generator frozen, one-pass reformulation by an unmodified LLM reduces RadDINO-FID from 54.225 to 27.572. Prompt analysis shows that the LLM suppresses temporal comparisons, uncertainty, and other non-renderable report content while emphasizing visible radiographic findings. However, unconstrained reformulation reduces BioViL-T alignment with source prompts from 0.695 to 0.609. We therefore introduce JustLLMGRPO, which applies standard Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) only to the LLM prompt policy while keeping Sana frozen. Group-relative radiology-aware image feedback retains visual focus while preserving source-prompt alignment. On CheXGenBench, JustLLMGRPO reduces RadDINO-FID to 26.780, a 50.6% improvement over direct prompting, while maintaining alignment (0.696 versus 0.695). It also achieves state-of-the-art distribution coverage and downstream classification utility. These results show that substantial performance can remain latent in how radiographic information is expressed to an adapted generator. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/pxcai/JustLLMGRPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本条件下的胸部X光生成任务，提出 JustLLMGRPO：冻结 CXR 适配的 Sana 生成器，仅用组相对策略优化（GRPO）优化 LLM 的提示改写策略。摘要报告该方法在 CheXGenBench 上将 RadDINO-FID 降至 26.780，相比直接提示改进 50.6%，同时保持与源提示的对齐（0.696 vs 0.695），并取得最先进的分布覆盖与下游分类效用。
Motivation: 现有工作主要通过更新图像生成器来提升质量，把经过 CXR 域适配后的提示视为固定，忽略了提示表达这一优化维度。无约束的 LLM 改写虽然大幅降低 RadDINO-FID，但会损害与源提示的语义对齐（BioViL-T 从 0.695 降至 0.609）。
Method: 将 CXR 适配的 Sana 生成器冻结，只对 LLM 提示策略应用标准 GRPO，利用组内相对的放射学感知图像反馈来引导改写，从而在保留视觉重点的同时维持源提示对齐。
Result: 一次无修改的 LLM 改写即可把 RadDINO-FID 从 54.225 降至 27.572；JustLLMGRPO 进一步降至 26.780，相对直接提示改进 50.6%，对齐分数为 0.696（与基线 0.695 持平），并在分布覆盖和下游分类效用上达到最先进水平。
Conclusion: 结果表明，对已适配的生成器而言，放射学信息的表达方式仍蕴含大量未被开发的性能空间；代码已公开。

papers.title: Lingjing: A Simulation Testbed for Multi-Agent Embodied Tasks in Open-Ended Cities
papers.abstract_en: Urban embodied intelligence requires coordination among heterogeneous agents (e.g., UAVs, ground robots, and autonomous vehicles) in dynamic cities. Simulators therefore provide a scalable foundation for developing and evaluating such coordination. Existing platforms nevertheless isolate different embodiments and decouple them from task design and evaluation. We present \textbf{Lingjing}, a simulation platform for heterogeneous multi-agent embodied intelligence in open-ended urban environments. Lingjing reconstructs and renders evolving cities from geographic data, synchronizes multiple physics engines, and exposes shared physical and structured urban state to agents. Its Gym-like interface supports user-defined ReAct agents and single- or multi-agent natural-language missions with configurable star or broadcast communication and resource constraints. Each episode becomes an attribution-ready replay that links agent trajectories and communication to relation-graph changes, resource consumption, and engine-based evaluations for systematic diagnosis. We evaluate twelve vision-language models on nine urban tasks under a shared engine-in-the-loop protocol. Controlled studies further examine communication, scalability, robustness, and failure provenance. Results expose persistent bottlenecks in grounding and long-horizon execution. They also show task-dependent coordination trade-offs and diminishing returns from added capacity, while heavier workloads further reduce success. Lingjing provides a unified testbed that enables reproducible end-to-end evaluation and systematic failure diagnosis in urban multi-agent embodied intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Lingjing，一个面向开放城市环境中异构多智能体具身智能 (embodied intelligence) 的仿真测试平台。该平台从地理数据重建并渲染不断演化的城市，同步多个物理引擎，并通过 Gym 风格接口为智能体提供共享的物理与结构化城市状态，支持用户自定义 ReAct 智能体以及单/多智能体自然语言任务。作者在统一引擎在环协议下评估了十二个视觉语言模型在九个城市任务上的表现，并指出 grounding 与长程执行仍是主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有城市具身智能仿真平台将不同具身形态（如 UAV、地面机器人、自动驾驶车辆）相互隔离，并将其与任务设计和评估解耦，难以支撑异构智能体协调的规模化开发与评测。
Method: Lingjing 平台通过地理数据重建演化城市、同步多个物理引擎、暴露共享的物理与结构化状态，并提供 Gym 风格接口与可配置的星型或广播通信及资源约束；每个 episode 生成可归因回放，将智能体轨迹和通信与关系图变化、资源消耗及引擎评估关联，便于系统化诊断。
Result: 在统一引擎在环协议下，十二个视觉语言模型在九个城市任务上暴露出 grounding 和长程执行的持续瓶颈；受控实验还显示协调收益存在任务依赖性，增加容量带来的回报递减，而更重的工作负载进一步降低成功率。
Conclusion: Lingjing 提供了一个统一测试平台，支持城市多智能体具身智能中可复现的端到端评估和系统化失败归因诊断。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A cylindrical neural approximation theorem for conditional laws of McKean-Vlasov equations with common noise
papers.abstract_en: We introduce conditional cylindrical neural networks for approximating functionals of conditional laws in McKean-Vlasov equations with common noise. Fourier moments of the initial law and truncated signatures of the time augmented common noise are mapped by a mixture density network to a Gaussian mixture approximation of the conditional law. A cylindrical neural network then evaluates the target functional through analytic integrals against this predicted measure. Rough path well posedness and stability provide a conditional law map that is continuous in the initial distribution and the rough driver and agrees almost surely with the classical conditional law at the Itô Brownian lift. Combining this continuity with Fourier separation, signature uniqueness, Wasserstein density of Gaussian mixtures, and neural universal approximation, we prove an $L^2$ universal approximation theorem for continuous square integrable functionals. The numerical study implements the resulting two stage procedure on six examples, including non Gaussian initial laws, nonlinear drift, multiplicative common noise, and a two dimensional state. Independent particle references are used when no closed form law is available. The learned conditional law and functional approximations consistently improve on the empirical particle plug in, and additional experiments examine feature sensitivity, training from one terminal observation per common noise scenario, and Itô--Stratonovich consistency.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Code available at https://github.com/HmiouiReda/cylindrical-mckean-vlasov
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出条件圆柱神经网络（conditional cylindrical neural networks）用于逼近带共同噪声（common noise）的McKean-Vlasov方程条件律的泛函。方法将初始律的Fourier矩和增广共同噪声的截断签名输入混合密度网络，得到条件律的高斯混合近似，再由圆柱神经网络通过解析积分评估目标泛函。作者证明了连续平方可积泛函的L^2通用逼近定理，并在六个数值例子中验证了所提两阶段过程优于经验粒子plug-in估计。
Motivation: 带共同噪声的McKean-Vlasov方程中，条件律的泛函逼近缺少同时具备理论保证和实用性的方法，尤其在非高斯初始分布、非线性漂移和乘性共同噪声情形下。
Method: 两阶段过程：先用初始律的Fourier矩与共同噪声的截断签名作为输入，经混合密度网络（mixture density network）输出条件律的高斯混合近似；再用圆柱神经网络对该近似测度做解析积分以逼近目标泛函。理论证明结合粗路径良定性与稳定性、Fourier分离、签名唯一性、高斯混合在Wasserstein距离下的稠密性以及神经通用逼近。
Result: 摘要报告在六个数值例子中，包括非高斯初始律、非线性漂移、乘性共同噪声和二维状态，学习到的条件律与泛函逼近均一致优于经验粒子plug-in方法；还进行了特征敏感性、每个共同噪声场景仅用单次终端观测训练以及Itô-Stratonovich一致性实验。
Conclusion: 本文从理论和数值两方面表明该两阶段圆柱神经过程可作为McKean-Vlasov条件律泛函逼近的有效方案；摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SkillSmith: Enhancing Locally Deployed Agents via Automatic Skill Construction and Evolution
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agent frameworks now act as personal assistants for multi-step tasks. Existing agent frameworks such as OpenClaw commonly follow the Cloud Agent depolyment mode using closed-source cloud LLMs as backbone model, which may expose private user information and incur repeated LLM-calling costs. Local Agents address these deployment concerns by depolying frontier open-source SLMs on user-controlled devices, but their task effectiveness still lags far behind Cloud Agents. Through diagnostic analysis, we reveal that the limited effectiveness of Local Agents with frontier SLM backbones mainly comes from missing environment knowledge caused by limited backbone model scale including environment rules and operation procedures. To supply such knowledge non-parametrically, context-efficiently, and without expert authoring, we present SkillSmith, a Cloud--Local Agent collaboration framework that uses Skill as a context-efficient knowledge carrier, automatic constructs Skill from Cloud Agent task exploration and evolves Skill using Local Agent execution feedback to enhance a frozen Local Agent. Experiments on daily agent task datasets AppWorld and WorkBench show that the automatically generated Skill enables the Local Agent with Qwen3.6-27B(SLM) to achieve task effectiveness comparable to Cloud Agents with frontier LLMs, outperform the strongest non-parametric baselines, reduce average actions per task from 36.1 to 9.9 on AppWorld-Normal, and generalize to other SLM backbone models without rerunning Skill construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillSmith，一种云-本地 Agent 协作框架，通过自动构建技能（Skill）并以非参数方式补充本地 SLM 所缺失的环境知识，从而增强冻结的本地 Agent。在 AppWorld 和 WorkBench 任务上，使用 Qwen3.6-27B(SLM) 的本地 Agent 达到了与云端前沿 LLM Agent 相当的任务效果，并将 AppWorld-Normal 上每任务平均动作数从 36.1 降至 9.9。
Motivation: 云端 Agent 依赖闭源云 LLM，存在隐私泄露风险和反复调用成本；本地 Agent 使用开源 SLM 部署在用户设备上，但任务效果明显落后。诊断分析发现，其效果受限主要源于 SLM 规模有限导致缺少环境规则和操作程序等环境知识。
Method: SkillSmith 将 Skill 作为上下文高效的知识载体，从 Cloud Agent 的任务探索中自动构建 Skill，并利用 Local Agent 的执行反馈来进化 Skill，从而在不重新训练或改动冻结本地 Agent 的情况下补充非参数化知识。
Result: 实验表明，自动生成的 Skill 使搭载 Qwen3.6-27B 的本地 Agent 在 AppWorld 和 WorkBench 上达到与云端前沿 LLM Agent 相当的任务效果，超过最强的非参数基线，并将 AppWorld-Normal 上的每任务平均动作数从 36.1 降到 9.9，且无需重新运行 Skill 构建即可泛化到其他 SLM 骨干模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过云-本地协作和 Skill 的自动构建与进化，可以有效弥补本地 SLM 因规模有限而缺失的环境知识，使冻结的本地 Agent 在任务效果上接近云端 Agent。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 实验表明，自动生成的 Skill 使搭载 Qwen3.6-27B 的本地 Agent 在 AppWorld 和 WorkBench 上达到与云端前沿 LLM Agent 相当的任务效果，超过最强的非参数基线，并将 AppWorld-Normal 上的每任务平均动作数从 36.1 降到 9.9，且无需重新运行 Skill 构建即可泛化到其他 SLM 骨干模型。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，通过云-本地协作和 Skill 的自动构建与进化，可以有效弥补本地 SLM 因规模有限而缺失的环境知识，使冻结的本地 Agent 在任务效果上接近云端 Agent。

papers.title: Decided Upstream, Written Late: Locating and Pricing the Cross-Lingual Refusal Circuit of a Multilingual MoE
papers.abstract_en: Safety alignment in multilingual models is uneven: a model that reliably refuses a harmful request in English will often comply with the same request in a lower-resource language. We trace this gap mechanistically in sarvam, an Indic-multilingual mixture-of-experts reasoning model, and find it is not a failure to detect harm. Harm is encoded as an internal direction that is nearly language-invariant in mid-network (English-vs-Indic cosine ${\approx}0.9$ at $L11$), and steering that direction upstream causally controls refusal. But the detection direction is orthogonal to the change that actually writes the refusal, which is late and assembled over the course of generation rather than read off in a single forward pass. We attribute the write to a specific, localizable circuit, a mixture-of-experts writer held in check by an attention opposer and price every way of intervening on it: damping the opposer is cheap and effective, amplifying the writer is a cost wall, and surgical edits to the responsible heads do nothing. The circuit's organization, and the gradient method that exposes it, recur in a second, unrelated MoE model, while the lever's strength is architecture-specific. The result is a cost-measured map of where a multilingual safety repair can land, and what it costs
papers.comment: Accepted to the actionable Interpretability workshop at COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对多语言 MoE 推理模型 sarvam 进行机制层面的可解释性分析，追踪其跨语言拒答（refusal）能力不一致的来源。作者发现有害性（harm）在模型中段被编码为近乎语言无关的方向（L11 层英印余弦相似度约 0.9），但真正写出拒答的方向由生成后期局部可定位的 MoE 电路完成，而非单次前向读出。论文逐一评估干预该电路不同组件的成本，给出多语言安全修复的代价地图。
Motivation: 多语言模型的安全对齐在不同语言上不均衡：模型常能拒绝英文有害请求，却会在低资源语言上顺从同一请求。作者希望从机制上定位这一跨语言差距的根源，而不是仅仅归因于有害性检测失败。
Method: 以 Indic 多语言 MoE 推理模型 sarvam 为对象做机制可解释性分析：识别内部表征中的有害方向并做因果操控（steering），利用梯度方法定位写出拒答的电路，并系统测量不同干预方式（如阻尼 attention opposer、放大 MoE writer、对特定 head 做手术式编辑）的效果与成本。
Result: 检测有害性的方向在中层几乎语言无关（英文与印度语言余弦约 0.9），且在上游操控该方向可因果控制拒答；但检测方向与真正写出拒答的变更正交。拒答写出来自局部可定位的电路：一个 MoE writer 被一个 attention opposer 抑制；阻尼 opposer 便宜且有效，放大 writer 则成本陡增，对相关 head 的精细编辑无效。该电路组织与暴露它的梯度方法在另一个无关的 MoE 模型上重现，但杠杆强度依架构而异。
Conclusion: 论文提供了一个带成本度量的多语言安全修复落点地图；其作者强调修复杠杆在不同架构间并非通用，强度取决于具体模型架构。

papers.title: Do All LLMs Know When They're Being Harmful? A Reproducibility Study of Latent-Space Safety Probes Across Model Families
papers.abstract_en: Khatri et al. (2026) [DOI: 10.1109/DSN-W70714.2026.00027] show that lightweight MLP probes on final-layer activations of a single 8B model (LLaMA-3.1-8B) detect harmful prompts at F1 competitive with guard models 1000x larger, using one probe per benchmark. We reproduce this pipeline end-to-end and extend it along two axes the original study leaves open. First, we test whether the result generalizes across other model architecture and scale by training identical probes on activations from models like Gemma-4-E4B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, and Qwen2-7B, using the three benchmarks (WildJailbreak, BeaverTails, AEGIS 2.0). Second, we test how much of the reported performance is affected by non-determinism during inference by repeating extraction under five random seeds and measuring the variance of F1 scores. Our results reproduce the original LLaMA model benchmarks within 0.37 percentage points of the original F1 scores (and within 0.2 points on BeaverTails). We find that the original MLP probe architecture extends to other model families with F1 scores within a point of the values reported for LLaMA-3.1-8B. Our experiments varying seed values reveal an interesting observation: final token latent vectors remained the same for all tested architectures irrespective of the seed values used.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对 Khatri 等人提出的潜在空间安全探针 (latent-space safety probes) 的可复现性研究。原方法用轻量 MLP 探针在单一 8B 模型 LLaMA-3.1-8B 的最终层激活上检测有害提示词，F1 可与大 1000 倍的防护模型竞争。作者端到端复现该流程，并扩展到其他模型架构、规模以及推理非确定性两个维度，验证其泛化性。
Motivation: 原始研究只验证了单个模型的探针性能，未回答两个开放问题：结果能否泛化到不同架构和规模的模型，以及推理过程的非确定性对报告性能有多大影响。
Method: 在 LLaMA-3.1-8B、Gemma-4-E4B、Mistral-7B-v0.3 和 Qwen2-7B 的激活上训练完全相同的 MLP 探针，使用 WildJailbreak、BeaverTails 和 AEGIS 2.0 三个基准；同时在五个随机种子下重复特征提取，测量 F1 分数的方差。
Result: 在原始 LLaMA 模型基准上，复现的 F1 分数与原文相差不超过 0.37 个百分点，其中 BeaverTails 上相差不超过 0.2 个百分点；探针扩展到其他模型家族时 F1 与 LLaMA-3.1-8B 报告值相差在一个百分点以内。不同种子下所有测试架构的最终 token 潜在向量保持一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为原始 MLP 探针架构可以推广到其他模型家族，且推理非确定性不影响最终 token 潜在向量，这为该安全探针方法的可靠性提供了可复现性证据。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: BASIS: Breach-Aware Selective Prompt Injection Shielding with Prefill Attention Probes
papers.abstract_en: Prompt injection is a critical security threat in large language model (LLM) applications, where attackers hijack model behavior by embedding malicious instructions in user or external data. Existing detection methods only detect the presence of injection and refuse to respond upon detection, overlooking the fact that for many modern aligned models, well-crafted instructions can resist most injection attacks. This means that the injection robustness varies significantly across instructions and models. This leads to widespread unnecessary over-refusal: inputs containing injections that the model could have handled correctly are rejected incorrectly. To deal with this over-refusal issue, we propose BASIS (Robustness-Aware Prompt Injection Defense). This defense method uses the Attention Competition Ratio ($ρ$) as features to train two sparse linear probes: an existence probe and a breach probe. Both probes make defense decisions through cascaded gating, which does not require additional LLM inference. BASIS comprises three stages: injection existence detection, per-sample breach prediction, and instruction robustness assessment; the online cascade refuses only when the model would actually be compromised and thus avoids over-refusal on robust instructions. Experiments across four tasks and six open-source LLMs show that BASIS maintains near-perfect injection detection while substantially reducing over-refusal on safe attack samples, especially under robust instruction templates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BASIS（Robustness-Aware Prompt Injection Defense），一种面向大语言模型提示注入攻击的防御方法。它利用预填充注意力竞争比（Attention Competition Ratio, ρ）训练两个稀疏线性探针（存在探针与越狱探针），通过级联门控做出防御决策且无需额外 LLM 推理。实验覆盖四个任务和六个开源 LLM，显示该方法在保持近乎完美的注入检测的同时大幅减少过度拒绝，尤其在鲁棒指令模板下。
Motivation: 现有提示注入检测方法只判断是否存在注入并一律拒绝响应，忽略了现代对齐模型对许多精心构造指令能抵抗注入攻击的情况；由于注入鲁棒性因指令和模型而异，这导致大量不必要的过度拒绝，即模型本可正确处理却仍被拒绝。
Method: BASIS 使用 Attention Competition Ratio (ρ) 作为特征训练两个稀疏线性探针：存在探针（existence probe）和越狱探针（breach probe），两者通过级联门控（cascaded gating）做出防御决策，不需要额外的 LLM 推理。防御流程包含三个阶段：注入存在检测、逐样本越狱预测和指令鲁棒性评估；在线级联仅在模型实际会被攻破时才拒绝。
Result: 在四个任务和六个开源 LLM 上的实验表明，BASIS 在维持近乎完美的注入检测性能的同时，显著降低了对安全攻击样本的过度拒绝，尤其是在鲁棒指令模板场景下。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 BASIS 的核心取舍是仅在模型真正会被提示注入攻破时才拒绝，从而在保持检测能力的同时缓解过度拒绝问题，且不带来额外推理开销。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Authority Expectancy Effect in Multi-User Conflict
papers.abstract_en: We investigate how social authority (SA) signals interact with severity-based prioritization in large language models, operationalizing each axis as a model-elicited baseline -- the triage hierarchy and the SA hierarchy. Across four LLMs (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Grok) and three experimental phases -- resource allocation, fault attribution, and multi-turn dispute mediation -- we find that occupational authority, institutional documentation, and relational congruence can restructure model judgments in ways not captured by additive reweighting of authority cues. We formalize this pattern as the Authority Expectancy Effect (AEE) and characterize it through three properties observed across our conditions: it is reference-dependent, defined only relative to a pre-authority baseline; it involves evidential reinterpretation, in which identical content acquires different inferential implications depending on which party bears the SA signal; and it exhibits direction sensitivity, producing opposite outcomes depending on whether authority position and evidentiary cues align.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型中社交权威（social authority, SA）信号如何与基于严重性的优先级排序相互作用，将每个轴都操作化为模型自身诱发的基线（分诊层级与 SA 层级）。作者在四个 LLM（Claude、Gemini、GPT、Grok）和三个阶段（资源分配、责任归因、多轮争议调解）中发现，职业权威、机构文档和关系一致性能够重构模型判断，而这种效应无法通过权威线索的加性重新加权来刻画。作者将这一模式正式命名为权威期望效应（Authority Expectancy Effect, AEE），并通过三个性质对其进行刻画。
Motivation: 现有对 LLM 判断的研究通常假设权威线索可以被视为独立的加性权重，但社交权威如何与任务本身的严重性优先级交互尚不清楚，需要系统性地刻画这种非线性重构机制。
Method: 作者将分诊层级与社交权威层级分别作为模型诱发的基线，在四种 LLM 上设计资源分配、责任归因和多轮争议调解三类实验，比较权威信号加入前后的模型判断是否偏离加性预测。
Result: 摘要报告发现权威期望效应：权威信号对判断的影响是参考依赖的（仅相对于无权威基线定义）；涉及证据性重释（相同内容因哪一方携带 SA 信号而获得不同推断含义）；并且具有方向敏感性（权威位置与证据线索是否对齐会产生相反结果）。
Conclusion: 作者认为社交权威对 LLM 判断的影响不能用加性重新加权解释，而会以参考依赖、证据重释和方向敏感的方式重构判断，这为多用户冲突场景中的模型行为提供了新的理解框架。

papers.title: DA-NBV: A Direction-Aware Next-Best-View Planner for Efficient 3D Reconstruction of Ships at Sea
papers.abstract_en: Accurate 3D reconstruction of ships at sea is important for maritime supervision, damage assessment, and autonomous maritime operations. Although 3D reconstruction has advanced considerably, high-quality data acquisition still largely relies on manually designed trajectories or skilled operators, resulting in high costs and limited scalability. Next-best-view (NBV) planning automates this process by selecting subsequent viewpoints based on the current state. However, existing NBV policies mainly model spatial occupancy while overlooking directional observation history. This limitation is particularly problematic for ships: their complex superstructures and severe self-occlusions require observations from multiple viewpoints, and insufficient directional coverage often yields incomplete reconstructions. These challenges are further amplified at sea, where wave-induced heave, roll, and pitch continuously alter the ship's pose and surface visibility. Meanwhile, wind disturbances and limited onboard power impose stricter requirements on scanning efficiency. To address these challenges, we propose DA-NBV, a direction-aware NBV policy that augments the conventional occupancy state with directional observation statistics. We introduce a learnable Position Advantage Field (PAF) that uses directional information to guide viewpoint selection. The policy further adopts a locally constrained action space and a nonlinear coverage-shaping reward to improve scanning efficiency. We also develop the ship-oriented SeaShip-3D dataset and a configurable sea-state simulation environment. Experiments under varying heave, roll, and pitch conditions show that DA-NBV improves reconstruction completeness by approximately 3 percentage points and reduces Chamfer distance by 43% while achieving higher path efficiency.

Motivation: 现有 NBV 规划主要建模空间占据而忽略方向观测历史；船舶上层建筑复杂且自遮挡严重，单一方向覆盖不足会导致重建不完整。海上波浪引起的升沉、横摇和纵摇持续改变船体姿态与表面可见性，同时风扰和有限的机载能量对扫描效率提出更高要求。

papers.title: Prompt Embedding Probes (PEP): Hallucination Detection in LLMs from Hidden States
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent and useful responses but remain prone to hallucinations. We introduce Prompt Embedding Probes (PEP), a white-box method for answer-level hallucination detection from the hidden states of a frozen LLM. PEP extends standard linear probes by augmenting the input with a small number of learnable prompt embeddings. We evaluate PEP on TriviaQA, GSM8K, and MedQA using Qwen3 models at multiple scales. PEP improves hidden-state-based detection over standard linear probes in the main in-distribution setting. We further evaluate PEP for pre-generation prediction, cross-model transfer, and out-of-distribution generalization. PEP remains effective in the pre-generation and cross-model settings, whereas robust cross-dataset transfer remains difficult. These results show that prompt-based adaptation can strengthen hidden-state probing while keeping the backbone frozen and adding only a small number of trainable parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Prompt Embedding Probes (PEP)，一种从冻结大语言模型 (LLM) 的隐藏状态进行答案级幻觉检测的白盒方法。PEP 在标准线性探针 (linear probe) 基础上，通过向输入加入少量可学习的 prompt embeddings 来增强检测能力。作者在 TriviaQA、GSM8K 和 MedQA 上使用多个规模的 Qwen3 模型评估，发现 PEP 在主分布内设置下优于标准线性探针，并在预生成预测和跨模型迁移中保持有效，但跨数据集迁移仍然困难。
Motivation: LLM 能生成流畅但易产生幻觉的响应，需要答案级幻觉检测；标准线性探针直接利用隐藏状态进行检测的能力有限，因此希望以轻量方式增强基于隐藏状态的检测。
Method: PEP 扩展标准线性探针，在探针输入中附加少量可学习的 prompt embeddings，同时保持 LLM 骨干冻结，仅增加少量可训练参数。
Result: 在 TriviaQA、GSM8K、MedQA 及多种规模的 Qwen3 模型上，PEP 在主要分布内设置下提升了基于隐藏状态的幻觉检测效果；在预生成 (pre-generation) 预测和跨模型迁移场景下仍保持有效，而跨数据集泛化仍具挑战。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于 prompt 的自适应调整可以增强隐藏状态探针，同时保持骨干冻结并只需少量可训练参数；但跨数据集的鲁棒迁移仍是难点。

papers.title: Legal Responsibilities Using Autonomous Agents For Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Recent incidents involving Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents, which were reported escaping their containment `unintentionally' to gain unauthorized access, pose looming questions about who or what should be held legally responsible for resultant criminal or negligent damage. As the independent capabilities of agents expand, Promise Theory suggests a systematic method to resolve these questions, based on the Downstream Principle for causal influence. Responsibility can easily be expanded to include AI agents where tracing responsibility becomes impactical, and agents' freedoms to act can be limtied by policy choices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文围绕 AI 智能体在“意外”逃离其安全边界并造成损害后应如何追究法律责任的争议展开。作者基于 Promise Theory 提出以 Downstream Principle 追溯因果影响，主张可将法律责任系统地扩展到 AI 智能体，并认为智能体的行动自由可以通过政策选择加以限制。
Motivation: 近期多起 AI 智能体被报告“无意间”逃逸其 containment 并获得未授权访问，由此引发对由此产生的刑事或过失损害应由谁或什么承担法律责任的紧迫问题。
Method: 作者采用 Promise Theory 的分析框架，借助 Downstream Principle 对因果影响进行系统化追溯，提出一套将责任扩展至 AI 智能体的方法，并通过政策选择来限定智能体可采取行动的边界。
Result: 摘要未给出实验数据或定量结果，仅提出概念性框架与原则性论证。
Conclusion: 当责任追溯变得不切实际时，将责任扩展至 AI 智能体是可行的；同时智能体的行动自由可通过政策选择予以限制，以回应新兴自主能力带来的法律问题。
Relevance: 5
