papers.title: Evidence-RL: Towards Evidence-intensive Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) should answer from concrete image evidence rather than language priors, dataset shortcuts, or irrelevant visual context. Existing perception-aware post-training methods encourage image use through global perturbations or attention proxies, but they do not test whether a sampled answer causally depends on the local evidence that supports it. We propose Counterfactual Evidence Disentanglement (CED), a training-time evidence audit for VLM grounding. For each response, CED neutralizes an object-centric Evidence Region and compares the resulting support drop against matched non-evidence Regions. We combine this signal with answer correctness inside GRPO, rewarding correct answers that rely on the evidence path rather than shortcut or nuisance paths. CED uses weak object-level proposals, requires no question-specific evidence annotations, and adds no inference-time overhead. Across nine public benchmarks and four backbones, CED outperforms prior RL-based post-training methods, with targeted analyses verifying its object-centric signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Counterfactual Evidence Disentanglement (CED)，一种针对视觉语言模型 (VLM) grounding 的训练时证据审计方法。CED 通过中和对象中心的证据区域并比较支持度下降与匹配的非证据区域，将因果证据信号与答案正确性结合进 GRPO，从而奖励依赖证据路径而非捷径或干扰路径的正确答案。方法只需弱对象级提议，无需问题特定的证据标注，也不增加推理开销。在九个公开基准和四个骨干网络上，CED 优于先前的基于 RL 的后训练方法。
Motivation: 现有感知感知的后训练方法通过全局扰动或注意力代理鼓励模型使用图像，但并未检验采样答案是否在因果上依赖于支持它的局部证据，因此模型仍可能依赖语言先验、数据集捷径或无关视觉上下文。
Method: 提出 Counterfactual Evidence Disentanglement (CED)：对每个响应，中和一个对象中心的证据区域 (Evidence Region)，并对比匹配的非证据区域 (non-evidence region) 所致的支持度下降；将该信号与答案正确性结合，在 GRPO 中奖励正确且依赖证据路径的答案。CED 使用弱对象级提议，无需问题特定证据标注，且不增加推理开销。
Result: 摘要报告在九个公开基准和四个骨干网络上，CED 优于先前基于 RL 的后训练方法；针对性分析验证了其对象中心信号的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为训练时的因果证据审计能够提升 VLM 的 grounding 能力，CED 以弱监督方式实现该目标且无推理期额外成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Thought-Level Beam Search for Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Test-time compute scaling is a primary driver of performance in large reasoning models (LRMs), but extreme inefficiency bounds current approaches, shifting the critical question from \emph{how much} compute to spend, to \emph{where} to allocate it. We formalize test-time reasoning as a constrained compute allocation problem over partial trajectories. Under a fixed hardware budget, existing paradigms fail to actively allocate the compute to the most promising partial progress: traditional parallel sampling treats traces independently and induces severe memory bottlenecks, while subtractive pruning starves hardware and fails to actively and sufficiently shift the output distribution. To overcome this dichotomy, we introduce Gambit, an inference algorithm that executes \emph{thought-level beam search}. By periodically pruning unpromising trajectories and immediately branching from high-quality prefixes, Gambit dynamically concentrates compute onto the most promising reasoning traces via a light-weight scorer probing hidden states while maintaining continuous high hardware utilization. Extensive evaluations across multiple models and benchmarks demonstrate that Gambit strictly dominates existing baselines. Under identical hardware constraints, our method yields up to a +6.7\% absolute accuracy gain on HMMT-24 and +3.3\% on AIME-25 over pruning baselines, delivers $>2\times$ higher throughput on trace completion, and reduces total token consumption by up to 68.5\% relative to standard parallel sampling.
papers.comment: Gambit is a thought-level beam search algorithm that reallocates inference compute to high-quality reasoning traces, achieving up to +6.7% accuracy gains and 68.5% token reduction over pruning and parallel sampling under strict hardware constraints
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型推理模型 (LRM) 测试时计算扩展的低效问题，将推理形式化为部分轨迹上的受限计算分配问题，并提出 Gambit——一种在思维层面执行束搜索 (thought-level beam search) 的推理算法。Gambit 通过周期性剪枝低质量轨迹并立即从高质量前缀分支，借助轻量级评分器探测隐藏状态，在维持高硬件利用率的同时把计算集中到最有前景的推理轨迹上。
Motivation: 现有测试时计算扩展的瓶颈已从花费多少计算转向在哪里分配计算；传统并行采样把轨迹独立处理并带来严重内存瓶颈，而减法式剪枝 (subtractive pruning) 会饿死硬件且无法充分主动地改变输出分布。
Method: 提出 Gambit 推理算法，执行思维级束搜索：周期性地剪除不理想的轨迹，并立即从高质量前缀分支扩展；利用轻量级 scorer 探测 hidden states 来动态集中计算资源，同时保持连续的硬件高利用率。
Result: 在相同硬件约束下，Gambit 相对于剪枝基线在 HMMT-24 上取得最高 +6.7% 的绝对准确率提升、在 AIME-25 上提升 +3.3%；轨迹完成吞吐量提高 2 倍以上；与标准并行采样相比，总 token 消耗最多减少 68.5%。
Conclusion: 作者强调，在固定硬件预算下 Gambit 在多个模型和基准上严格优于现有基线，表明将测试时推理视为受限计算分配问题并主动分配计算是提高推理效率的有效方向。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: EgoTrack3D: A Modular Framework for Egocentric 3D Object Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Understanding 3D scenes from egocentric video is fundamental for robotics and autonomous navigation, yet rapid viewpoint changes and partial occlusions make building structured representations challenging. Existing 3D tracking and scene graph construction methods primarily address explicit interactions or assume static scenes, limiting their ability to capture complex dynamics. We introduce EgoTrack3D, a modular framework that reconstructs and maintains a dynamic 3D scene representation directly from egocentric RGB video. The framework lifts 2D segmentation masks into a global 3D coordinate frame, using a point-based motion scoring mechanism alongside a voxel-based merging heuristic to associate object tracks. EgoTrack3D maintains accurate representations over time, achieving an 11% improvement in percentage of correct locations (PCL) relative to the strongest baseline on the Aria Digital Twin (ADT) dataset, while addressing the more general setting of persistent 3D tracking for both static and dynamic objects. Furthermore, to demonstrate the system's robustness under degraded conditions that simulate real-world deployment constraints, we replace dense depth maps with sparse 3D bounding box estimation and integrate interaction-guided dynamic association, enabling EgoTrack3D to maintain accurate spatial representations despite noisy observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoTrack3D，一个从第一人称 RGB 视频重建并维护动态 3D 场景表示的模块化框架。框架将 2D 分割掩码提升到全局 3D 坐标框架，结合基于点的运动评分机制与基于体素的合并启发式来关联目标轨迹。在 Aria Digital Twin (ADT) 数据集上，相对最强基线实现 11% 的正确位置百分比 (PCL) 提升，并覆盖静态与动态目标的持久 3D 跟踪这一更一般设定。
Motivation: 现有 3D 跟踪与场景图构建方法主要处理显式交互或假设静态场景，难以捕捉第一人称视频中的复杂动态；同时快速视点变化和部分遮挡使得构建结构化表示具有挑战。
Method: 提出模块化框架，将 2D 分割掩码提升到全局 3D 坐标框架，使用基于点的运动评分机制配合基于体素的合并启发式关联目标轨迹；在降级条件下用稀疏 3D 包围盒估计替换密集深度图，并集成交互引导的动态关联。
Result: 在 Aria Digital Twin (ADT) 数据集上，相对最强基线将 PCL 提升 11%；在模拟真实部署约束的噪声观测下，系统仍能维持准确的空间表示。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法适用于静态与动态目标的持久 3D 跟踪这一更一般设定，并在稀疏深度和交互引导关联等降级条件下保持鲁棒性。

papers.title: Ground-Truth Neighborhood Regularization for Reinforcement Learning Post-Training of Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting (TSF) plays an important role in a wide range of real-world applications. Recently, time series foundation models (TSFMs), pretrained on large-scale datasets, have demonstrated strong generalization capabilities and emerged as an important paradigm for TSF. Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has consequently attracted growing attention as a means of further improving their performance on downstream tasks. However, we find that, in certain forecast regions, RL post-training may gradually shift the output distributions of TSFMs away from the ground truth, thereby limiting their performance. We refer to this phenomenon as \textbf{suboptimal collapse}. Our analysis suggests that difficulty in initially sampling high-quality trajectories near the ground truth is an important contributing factor to suboptimal collapse. To address this issue, we propose Ground-Truth Neighborhood Regularization (GTN-R) for RL post-training of TSFMs. GTN-R uses the ground truth as a reference for locating high-quality regions and guides the model's probability mass toward the ground-truth neighborhood. This increases the probability of sampling high-quality trajectories, mitigates suboptimal collapse, and improves performance. Moreover, GTN-R can be flexibly integrated into various RL methods for TSFMs. Extensive experiments show its effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的强化学习（RL）后训练中出现的“次优崩溃”（suboptimal collapse）现象提出解决办法。作者观察到，在某些预测区域，RL后训练会使模型输出分布逐渐偏离真值，原因之一是初始阶段难以在真值附近采样到高质量轨迹。为此提出真值邻域正则化（GTN-R），以真值为参考引导概率质量靠近真值邻域，从而提升采样质量并缓解崩溃；该正则化可灵活接入多种RL方法，实验验证其有效。
Motivation: RL后训练虽能提升TSFM的下游性能，但在某些预测区域会导致输出分布偏离真值，出现限制性能的次优崩溃；作者将这一现象归因于初始难以在真值附近采样到高质量轨迹，因此需要一种能保持输出分布贴近真值的训练干预。
Method: 提出GTN-R（Ground-Truth Neighborhood Regularization），利用真值作为定位高质量区域的参照，通过引导模型概率质量向真值邻域移动，增加高质量轨迹的采样概率；该机制被设计为可与各种RL后训练方法灵活集成的插件形式。
Result: 摘要仅报告大量实验表明该方法的有效性，未给出具体数据集或数值指标；因此结果呈现为实验上验证了GTN-R能减缓次优崩溃并提升性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为GTN-R能缓解次优崩溃并改善TSFM的RL后训练性能，且可以灵活集成到各种RL方法中；摘要未明确讨论适用范围或局限性。

papers.title: Evidence-Grounded Forensic Reasoning for Detecting and Grounding Multi-Modal Media Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Fake news increasingly relies on cross-modal image-text forgeries, making transparent and verifiable reasoning chains an urgent need for Detecting and Grounding Multi-Modal Media Manipulation (DGM4). Existing methods produce black-box detection results without any decision rationale, limiting their reliability in forensic practice. Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a natural path toward explainability, but applying them to DGM4 raises two difficulties. First, models tend to generate explanations disconnected from predicted evidence locations, producing unverified attribution. Second, enforcing evidence-conclusion consistency requires active optimization, yet uniform training signals fail to distinguish localization tokens from classification tokens, making multi-head joint training unreliable. We propose a multi-modal manipulation detector based on an Evidence-Grounded Forensic Reasoning (EFR) framework. EFR introduces an Anchor-and-Verify reasoning chain that enforces modality-isolated perception before cross-modal comparison, with conclusion coordinates as explicit anchors to which downstream evidence must spatially correspond. A verifiable reward system then enforces evidence-conclusion consistency during training, while a Modality-Decoupled Advantage (MDA) routing mechanism mitigats credit misassignment across prediction tasks. Experiments show that EFR achieves state-of-the-art performance while producing structured forensic reasoning records that explicitly bind explanations to evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于证据的取证推理框架 (Evidence-Grounded Forensic Reasoning, EFR)，用于检测与定位多模态媒体操纵 (DGM4)。EFR 引入 Anchor-and-Verify 推理链，先进行模态隔离感知再跨模态比较，并以结论坐标为锚点约束证据的空间对应；训练时用可验证奖励系统强化证据-结论一致性，并用 Modality-Decoupled Advantage (MDA) 路由机制缓解多任务信用分配问题。实验表明 EFR 在 DGM4 上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，同时生成将解释显式绑定到证据的结构化取证推理记录。
Motivation: 现有 DGM4 方法输出黑盒检测结果、缺乏决策依据，限制了取证实践中的可靠性；多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 虽然有可解释性潜力，但容易生成与预测证据位置脱节的解释，且统一训练信号无法区分定位 token 与分类 token，使多任务联合训练不可靠。
Method: 提出多模态操纵检测器 EFR，包含 Anchor-and-Verify 推理链（模态隔离感知、跨模态比较、以结论坐标为锚点约束证据空间对应），并在训练中引入可验证奖励系统以及 Modality-Decoupled Advantage (MDA) 路由机制来缓解预测任务间的信用错分配。
Result: 实验显示 EFR 在 DGM4 任务上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，并生成显式将解释绑定到证据的结构化取证推理记录。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过将结论与证据显式空间绑定，并用可验证奖励和模态解耦路由进行训练，可以提升多模态媒体操纵检测的可解释性与可靠性。

papers.title: Quality-Diversity Stress Tests for Process Reward Models:What Archive Coverage Can and Cannot Certify
papers.abstract_en: Process reward models (PRMs) score intermediate reasoning steps and are widely used for search, ranking, and training, but optimization can exploit these learned proxies by increasing reward while turning correct reasoning into incorrect reasoning. We formulate PRM stress testing as a quality-diversity search problem using MAP-Elites, retaining the most severe correctness-flipping edit in each behavior-space region while separating search coverage from exploit coverage. We characterize what such archives certify: finite-cell repair bounds covered-cell tail risk and average residual severity but cannot bound the worst remaining cell from covered fraction alone; under Lipschitz post-repair loss and metric-cover auditing, the residual is bounded by archive fitting error plus the Lipschitz constant times the covering radius. A controlled landscape validates this certificate and the impossibility of any fraction-only worst-case guarantee. On real PRMs, the search reveals an aggregation-dependent vulnerability in Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B: padding yields 44 strict exploits with maximum gain 0.294 under mean pooling versus one exploit under minimum readout; a matched syntactic control isolates the mechanism, and an RLHFlow value-head model shows the same qualitative effect with maximum gain 0.005. A predeclared paired LoRA repair protocol reduces exploit rates from 0.148 to 0.037 to 0.074, lowers the worst attack from 0.333 to 0.177 to 0.212, improves ranking AUROC without degrading best-of-4 accuracy, attributes gains to adversarial fine-tuning rather than archive diversity, and is confirmed by independent unpaired replications (44 to 1, clean-split worst gain 0.0092, MATH-500 41 to 0, clean ranking 40/40).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把过程奖励模型 (process reward model, PRM) 的压力测试形式化为质量-多样性搜索问题，使用 MAP-Elites 在每个行为空间区域保留最严重的正确性翻转编辑，并区分搜索覆盖率与利用覆盖率。作者刻画了这种存档 (archive) 能证明什么：有限单元修复只能约束已覆盖单元的风险和平均残差，无法仅凭覆盖比例约束最差未覆盖单元；在 Lipschitz 后修复损失和度量覆盖审计下，残差由上界加 Lipschitz 常数乘覆盖半径决定。在真实 PRM 上观察到 Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B 的聚合方式相关漏洞，并验证了 LoRA 修复协议能降低利用率。
Motivation: PRM 被广泛用于推理步骤的搜索、排序和训练，但优化过程可能利用学习到的代理分数，在提升奖励的同时把正确推理变成错误推理。现有研究缺少对这种脆弱性的系统压力测试，也不清楚覆盖率存档究竟能提供何种保证。
Method: 将 PRM 压力测试建模为质量-多样性搜索，用 MAP-Elites 保留每个行为区域中最严重的正确性翻转编辑；理论部分分析存档的可证明性，给出基于 Lipschitz 连续性和覆盖半径的残差上界；实证部分设计配对 LoRA 修复协议并配合独立非配对复现来排除混杂因素。
Result: 在受控地形上验证了证书的正确性，并证明仅凭覆盖比例不可能给出最坏情形保证。对 Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B，padding 在均值池化下产生 44 个严格利用、最大增益 0.294，而最小读出下只有 1 个；RLHFlow value-head 模型显示相同定性效应，最大增益 0.005。修复协议将利用率从 0.148 降到 0.037 再降到 0.074，最坏攻击从 0.333 降到 0.177 再到 0.212，同时提升排序 AUROC 且不降低最佳 4 准确率；独立非配对复现确认了 44 比 1、干净分割最坏增益 0.0092、MATH-500 上 41 比 0、干净排序 40/40 等结果。
Conclusion: 覆盖存档可以限制已覆盖单元的尾部风险和平均残余严重度，但不能仅凭覆盖比例限制最坏未覆盖单元；在 Lipschitz 假设下残差可由存档拟合误差加 Lipschitz 常数乘覆盖半径界定。收益归因于对抗微调而非存档多样性，修复协议在真实 PRM 上有效降低利用。

papers.title: The Spectral Neuron
papers.abstract_en: As machine learned models increase in complexity and expressive power, features of simpler models, such as interpretability and control over the shape of the modeled function are lost. On the one edge of the spectrum we have simple linear models are transparent and possess good interpretability and explainability properties, but have a limited expressive power. On the other edge we have neural networks, that have expressive power that improves with scaling, but are mostly opaque. In this work we develop the \emph{spectral neuron} concept: a scalar model given by $f(\vx)=λ_k \left(A_0+\sum_{i=1}^n x_i A_i\right)$, with learned real symmetric matrices \(A_0,\ldots,A_n\). The input enters the model through an affine matrix function, but the prediction is obtained by reading one of its eigenvalues. Thus, the model is nonlinear, but the source of nonlinearity is still mathematically explicit. This gives us a useful middle ground: the model can become more expressive as the matrix dimension grows, while retaining a degree of structural interpretability through the learned matrices. For example, extremal eigenvalues yield convex or concave functions, semidefinite constraints on the coefficient matrices impose monotonicity, and the associated eigenspaces characterize local feature sensitivity. We study the robustness, structural interpretability, and shape-control properties of this model family, and then test whether it can be learned and scaled in practice. We develop a systematic study of this model family, bringing together spectral results from several mathematical literatures to characterize its expressivity, robustness, interpretability, and shape-control properties.

TL;DR: 本文提出 spectral neuron 概念：一个标量模型 f(x)=λ_k(A_0+Σ x_i A_i)，其中 A_i 为可学习的实对称矩阵，输入通过仿射矩阵函数进入模型，预测则读取该矩阵函数的某个特征值。模型是非线性的，但非线性来源在数学上显式，随矩阵维度增长可以增强表达力，同时通过学习到的矩阵保留一定结构可解释性。作者对该模型族的鲁棒性、结构可解释性与形状控制性质做了系统研究，并检验其能否在实践中被学习和扩展。
Motivation: 复杂模型（如神经网络）表达力随规模提升但缺乏可解释性，简单线性模型透明但表达力有限。作者希望在线性模型与神经网络之间提供中间地带，使模型在提升表达力的同时保留对函数形状的控制和可解释性。
Method: 定义 spectral neuron，即通过读取仿射矩阵函数的特征值来产生非线性预测；利用系数矩阵的半定约束实现单调性或凸/凹形状约束，并用相关特征空间刻画局部特征敏感性。作者整合多个数学文献中的谱结果，对该模型族的表达力、鲁棒性、可解释性与形状控制进行系统分析。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数字；主要贡献是对该模型族的表达力、鲁棒性、可解释性和形状控制性质给出理论表征，并初步验证其可学习性与可扩展性。
Conclusion: 该模型族可作为线性模型与神经网络之间的中间选择，其非线性来源明确并保留结构可解释性。摘要未提及具体下游任务或实际应用场景。

papers.title: Evaluator Ensembles Under Reward Hacking: Covariance Geometry and Finite-Search Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Language-model judges and reward models enable scalable supervision, but finite optimization can exploit evaluator errors rather than improve response quality. We characterize this failure through the covariance geometry of evaluator ensembles. For calibrated judges, the ensemble mean retains common-mode error along the all-ones direction, whereas cross-judge disagreement captures only orthogonal error. Consequently, disagreement can be high despite robust aggregation, or low while shared response-dependent errors persist. We prove that common-mode error is not identifiable from internal judge scores alone. Under a joint sub-Gaussian model, we bound best-of-K selection overstatement and target-quality regret, extending the guarantees to predictably adaptive search under conditional calibration. The resulting search terms scale as the square root of log K and are asymptotically tight for Gaussian projected errors. We further show that noisy quality proxies introduce artificial rank-one covariance without changing disagreement, and propose a bounded two-anchor Bernstein certificate for finite-search error and regret. Fixed-seed Gaussian stress tests over 120 (J, rho, K) configurations and real-model audits validate the theory while revealing the limits of disagreement-based diagnostics under increasing search pressure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从协方差几何角度刻画语言模型评委（judges）与奖励模型集成在有限优化下的奖励黑客（reward hacking）失效机制。作者证明，校准后的评委集成均值会沿全一方向保留共模误差（common-mode error），而评委间分歧只捕捉正交误差，因此分歧信号可能在稳健聚合时偏高、在共享响应相关误差持续时偏低；并证明仅凭内部评委分数无法识别共模误差。理论部分在联合次高斯模型下给出 best-of-K 选择的夸大程度与目标质量后悔界，并提出有限搜索误差与后悔的有界两锚 Bernstein 证书，最后用 120 组 (J, rho, K) 配置的固定种高斯压力测试和真实模型审计验证结论。
Motivation: 有限优化可以钻评估器错误的空子，而非真正提升响应质量；现有基于评委分歧的诊断可能误导人们对集成聚合稳健性的判断，因此需要从几何上刻画这种失效并给出可证明的搜索保证。
Method: 利用评委集成输出的协方差几何进行理论刻画；在联合次高斯模型下推导 best-of-K 选择过报与目标质量后悔的界，扩展至条件校准下的可预测自适应搜索；提出带噪声质量代理的秩一协方差分析与有界两锚 Bernstein 证书，并进行固定种子压力测试与真实模型审计。
Result: 摘要指出分歧可以很高而聚合仍稳健，也可以很低而共享误差持续存在；共模误差无法仅从内部评委分数识别。搜索项随 log K 的平方根增长，对高斯投影误差渐近紧；噪声代理会引入人工秩一协方差但不改变分歧。实验覆盖 120 个 (J, rho, K) 配置并验证了理论，同时显示分歧诊断在搜索压力增大时失效。
Conclusion: 作者强调分歧类诊断在高搜索压力下有其局限；协方差几何与所提证书可用于刻画有限搜索下的评估器利用误差与后悔。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: PE-Mamba: Bidirectional Selective Layer Aggregation for AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated image (AIGI) detection has become increasingly challenging due to the rapid advancement of generative models and the diminishing gap between synthetic and authentic content. Existing vision transformer-based detectors commonly rely on weighted-sum strategies to aggregate intermediate representations across transformer layers, often overlooking the inherently ordered semantic progression of hierarchical features from shallow texture cues to deep semantic representations. In this work, we propose \textbf{PE-Mamba}, a novel framework built upon a pre-trained PE-Core vision transformer with lightweight LoRA adaptation that introduces three complementary components for cross-layer feature aggregation and fusion. First, a bidirectional selective aggregator (BSA) processes layer-wise classification tokens through forward and backward selective scans, where the forward scan progressively accumulates shallow-to-deep forensic evidence, and the backward scan performs deep-to-shallow contextual refinement to reinterpret low-level cues in light of high-level semantic context. Second, a softmax-weighted aggregator (SWA) computes a learned global summary of all layer tokens as a complementary aggregation path. Third, a sigmoid-gated blend (SGA) adaptively fuses the BSA and SWA outputs via a learnable scalar gate, allowing the model to dynamically balance directional sequential evidence and global layer-wise aggregation. Extensive experiments on UniversalFakeDetect (96.6\% mACC, 99.5\% mAP) and AIGCDetect (95.3\% mACC, 98.1\% mAP) demonstrate that \methodname{} outperforms 18 detectors with superior generalization across diverse generative models, while training only 1.3\% of total parameters (0.13\% for LoRA alone).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PE-Mamba，一种基于预训练 PE-Core 视觉 Transformer 的 AI 生成图像检测框架，通过轻量 LoRA 适配，引入三个互补的跨层特征聚合组件。其中双向选择性聚合器 (BSA) 对逐层分类 token 做前向与后向选择性扫描，软最大聚合器 (SWA) 计算全局层 token 摘要，sigmoid 门控融合 (SGA) 自适应平衡两者输出。实验在 UniversalFakeDetect 和 AIGCDetect 上分别达到 96.6% mACC / 99.5% mAP 与 95.3% mACC / 98.1% mAP，优于 18 个检测器，且仅训练总参数的 1.3%（其中 LoRA 占 0.13%）。
Motivation: 生成模型的快速进步使合成与真实内容差距缩小，AIGI 检测日益困难。现有基于视觉 Transformer 的检测器常用加权求和聚合各层中间表示，忽略了从浅层纹理到深层语义这一层级特征的顺序语义演进。
Method: 在预训练 PE-Core 视觉 Transformer 上提出 PE-Mamba 框架，采用三组件互补聚合：BSA 通过前向扫描累积浅层到深层的取证证据、后向扫描做深层到浅层的上下文细化；SWA 用 softmax 权重计算所有层 token 的全局摘要；SGA 以可学习标量门控自适应融合 BSA 与 SWA 的输出。
Result: 摘要报告在 UniversalFakeDetect 上达到 96.6% mACC 与 99.5% mAP，在 AIGCDetect 上达到 95.3% mACC 与 98.1% mAP，超越 18 个检测器，并在多种生成模型上展现出更强泛化能力；训练参数仅占总参数的 1.3%，其中 LoRA 仅占 0.13%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调双向选择性聚合与全局层聚合的联合能够有效提升跨生成模型的 AIGI 检测泛化性，同时以极少的可训练参数实现高性能。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: VDGR-RAG: Vectors, Directories, Graphs, and Reflection Are All You Need for Unified Reasoning over Hierarchical Enterprise Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is essential for enterprise knowledge question answering (QA), particularly in domains with complex product documentation like telecommunications. However, existing RAG approaches largely overlook the holistic integration of diverse retrieval strengths, leading to inaccurate domain routing, poor utilization of hierarchical document structures, and consequently limited reasoning capabilities over enterprise knowledge. To address these limitations, we present VDGR-RAG, which integrates vector retrieval, directory-driven reasoning, graph traversal, and iterative reflection in a unified framework for accurate enterprise knowledge QA. Specifically, VDGR-RAG is an agentic GraphRAG system that first constructs a Hierarchical Heterogeneous Knowledge Graph ($\text{H}^2$KG) from document chunks to preserve both hierarchical directory structures and semantic relationships, and then employs a set of atomic tools for knowledge retrieval that can be freely composed to navigate the $\text{H}^2$KG: (1) a directory-enhanced routing tool that uses table-of-contents (TOC) structures to route user queries to appropriate domain-specific $\text{H}^2$KGs; (2) a multi-route retrieval tool that combines vector search, TOC-based agentic search, and graph search for comprehensive knowledge retrieval; (3) a directory backtracking tool that corrects knowledge localization biases; and (4) a dynamic reflection tool that iteratively plans the next retrieval phase. We conduct extensive experiments on our enterprise product documents across four wireless domains (e.g., energy saving and fault management). Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms a variety of RAG baselines in terms of both knowledge retrieval recall and QA accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VDGR-RAG，一个面向企业知识问答的 agentic GraphRAG 系统，将向量检索、目录驱动推理、图遍历与迭代反思整合到统一框架中。系统先从文档块构建分层异构知识图谱（H^2KG）以保留目录结构与语义关系，再用一组可自由组合的原子工具（目录增强路由、多路检索、目录回溯、动态反思）进行检索。在电信无线域产品文档上的实验表明，该方法在知识检索召回率和 QA 准确率上显著优于多种 RAG 基线。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 方法没有整体集成各类检索方式的优势，导致领域路由不准确、对层次化文档结构利用不足，进而限制了企业知识问答的推理能力。
Method: 构建分层异构知识图谱（H^2KG），并提供四类原子检索工具：基于目录（TOC）的领域路由工具、融合向量搜索/TOC agentic 搜索/图搜索的多路检索工具、纠正知识定位偏差的目录回溯工具，以及迭代规划下一检索阶段的动态反思工具。
Result: 在四个无线域（如节能、故障管理）的企业产品文档实验上，该方法在知识检索召回率和 QA 准确率上显著优于多种 RAG 基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为统一集成向量、目录、图与反思的框架能够更准确地处理分层企业知识问答，并对层次文档结构的利用是关键。

papers.title: MRBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Human Motion-Text Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Human motion-text retrieval provides a rigorous means of assessing cross-modal alignment. Prevailing benchmarks are dominated by homogeneous indoor motions, imbalanced motion distributions, and oversimplified, repetitive texts, which hinder the reliable measurement of cross-domain and cross-granularity alignment. We thus introduce MRBench, a comprehensive motion-text retrieval benchmark featuring heterogeneous motions, broad and balanced category coverage, and reliable, discriminative, multi-granular descriptions. MRBench is constructed through a meticulously designed multi-stage data curation pipeline, which filters and balances candidates, verifies unambiguous semantic alignment, and generates motion-grounded descriptions at multiple granularities. The resulting benchmark contains 3,390 motions drawn from motion capture, in-the-wild videos, synthetic videos, and motion generative models, covering 118 fine-grained categories. Each motion is paired with concise, standard, and fine-grained descriptions, yielding 10,170 captions. Extensive evaluations of representative retrieval baselines on MRBench reveal a substantial cross-dataset generalization gap and pronounced sensitivity to query granularity. We propose a lightweight granularity-aware model anchored at a frozen standard-caption-aligned retrieval model. LLM-based concise and fine-grained captions provide pseudo-supervision for extra-branch granularity-specific motion extractors and text adapters. For inference, granularity-aware score fusion integrates global and adapted similarities while strictly maintaining score comparability across all description levels. The resulting model improves mixed-granularity retrieval without compromising standard-caption performance. We believe that our MRBench provides a comprehensive testbed for advancing motion-language alignment evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MRBench，一个面向人体运动-文本检索的综合基准，包含异构运动来源、118 个细粒度类别、3,390 段运动以及每段运动对应的简洁、标准和细粒度描述共 10,170 条字幕。作者通过多阶段数据整理流程构建该基准，并评测了代表性检索基线，发现显著的跨数据集泛化差距和对查询粒度的敏感性。他们还提出一个轻量级粒度感知检索模型，在保持标准字幕性能的同时提升混合粒度检索效果。
Motivation: 现有运动-文本检索基准以同质室内运动、不平衡运动分布和过于简单重复的文本为主，难以可靠衡量跨领域和跨粒度的跨模态对齐能力。
Method: 构建 MRBench 的多阶段数据整理流程，包括候选过滤与平衡、语义对齐验证、多粒度运动相关描述生成；在此基础上提出冻结标准字幕对齐检索模型，并利用大语言模型生成的简洁与细粒度字幕作为伪监督，训练额外分支的粒度特定运动提取器和文本适配器，推理时通过粒度感知分数融合保持不同描述层级间分数可比性。
Result: 代表性检索基线在 MRBench 上表现出明显的跨数据集泛化差距和对查询粒度的敏感性；所提粒度感知模型在混合粒度检索上取得改善，且不牺牲标准字幕检索性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为 MRBench 可作为推进运动-语言对齐评估的综合性测试平台。

papers.title: Advantage-Guided Gate: Reshaping Open-Ended Reasoning for Vision-Based Spatial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in complex spatial scene understanding and reasoning tasks. However, their open-ended reasoning process is prone to decision errors and error accumulation, leading to instability in answer quality. To address this, we propose an advantage-guided gating framework that dynamically intervenes in and corrects deviations during the reasoning process. Specifically, we model step-by-step reasoning as a finite-horizon decision process and introduce Monte Carlo value evaluation on the reasoning tree to provide intermediate supervision signals. The framework includes Step-Advantage Gate and Trajectory-Advantage Gate, which dynamically select high-value reasoning steps and high-quality complete reasoning trajectories, respectively. During training, we perform supervised learning for the gates using reasoning trees generated via multi-branch sampling, and combine shared-parameter initialization with task-specific heads to achieve cross-task robustness and diversity. During inference, the model greedily selects high-value prefix reasoning steps while choosing the optimal reasoning head based on the problem type, thereby significantly improving the accuracy of the final answer. Furthermore, we constructed the Reasoning-Tree-160k dataset and performed two-stage learning on it. Extensive experiments demonstrate that this advantage-guided gating framework effectively enhances the performance of benchmark MLLMs in visual-based spatial understanding and reasoning tasks. The code is open to the public for research: https://github.com/LingLin-ll/Advantage-Guided-Gate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在开放端推理中因决策错误和误差累积导致的答案不稳定问题，提出优势引导门控框架（Advantage-Guided Gate）。作者将逐步推理建模为有限时域决策过程，借助推理树上的蒙特卡洛价值评估提供中间监督信号，并设计 Step-Advantage Gate 与 Trajectory-Advantage Gate 分别筛选高价值推理步骤和高质量完整轨迹。该方法在自建 Reasoning-Tree-160k 数据集上完成两阶段训练，推理时贪心选择高价值前缀步骤并按问题类型选择最优推理头，实验表明可有效提升基准 MLLM 在基于视觉的空间理解与推理任务上的表现。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 在复杂空间场景理解与推理中表现潜力大，但开放端推理过程容易产生决策错误并出现误差累积，导致最终答案质量不稳定，需要动态干预机制来纠正推理偏差。
Method: 将逐步推理建模为有限时域决策过程，在推理树上引入蒙特卡洛价值评估作为中间监督；训练阶段通过多分支采样生成推理树并监督学习两个门控模块，结合共享参数初始化与任务特定头实现跨任务鲁棒性和多样性；推理阶段贪心选择高价值前缀推理步骤，并根据问题类型选择最优推理头。此外构建了 Reasoning-Tree-160k 数据集并采用两阶段学习。
Result: 摘要报告大量实验表明该优势引导门控框架能有效提升基准 MLLM 在基于视觉的空间理解与推理任务上的性能，但未给出具体数值或基准名称。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架通过动态门控干预可显著改善 MLLM 开放端空间推理的准确性和稳定性，并将代码开源以供研究使用；其适用场景为视觉空间智能任务，未讨论超出该范围或针对具体领域（如气象）的适用性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AgriField-40K: Adapting Vision Models to Agriculture With Efficient Continual Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Field-based agricultural computer vision is important for precision agriculture, yet it largely depends on expensive annotations and costly adaptation of large pretrained models. We introduce AgriField-40K, a field-centric dataset curated from 17 public resources and covering diverse crops, weeds, and field conditions. Building on this, we present AgriMAE, a parameter-efficient continual pretraining baseline that adapts a masked autoencoder pretrained on natural images by training only lightweight adapters. We further explore semantic feature reconstruction as an alternative pretraining objective and evaluate transfer across multiple tasks. AgriMAE consistently improves downstream performance and can match or even outperform full fine-tuning while using up to $9\times$ fewer trainable parameters, showing that AgriField-40K is a practical resource for continual pretraining in agricultural vision. Project page: https://dtu-pas.github.io/agrifield40k/
papers.comment: Accepted at the Computer Vision in Plant Phenotyping and Agriculture (CVPPA) Workshop at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对田间农业计算机视觉中对昂贵标注和大规模预训练模型适配成本高的问题，构建了 AgriField-40K 数据集，并提出 AgriMAE 参数高效持续预训练基线。AgriMAE 通过仅训练轻量适配器 (adapters)，将基于自然图像的掩码自编码器 (masked autoencoder) 适配到农业场景，并探索了语义特征重建作为替代预训练目标。实验表明 AgriMAE 在多个下游任务上持续提升性能，能以最多 9 倍更少的可训练参数匹配甚至超越全量微调。
Motivation: 田间农业计算机视觉依赖昂贵的人工标注和大规模预训练模型的适配成本，缺乏低成本、面向实际田间条件的持续预训练资源。
Method: 从 17 个公开资源整理出覆盖多种作物、杂草和田间条件的 AgriField-40K 数据集；在此基础上提出 AgriMAE，用掩码自编码器在自然图像上预训练后仅训练轻量适配器；并将语义特征重建作为替代预训练目标进行评估。
Result: AgriMAE 一致地提升下游任务性能，并能以最多 9 倍更少的可训练参数匹配甚至超过全量微调的效果。
Conclusion: 作者认为 AgriField-40K 是农业视觉持续预训练中实用的数据集资源，参数高效的持续预训练范式对农业场景有效。
Relevance: 6

papers.title: AdaDINO: Pair-Aware In-Backbone Adaptation of Frozen DINO for Efficient Remote Sensing Change Detection
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation models (VFMs) such as DINO are pretrained for single-image representation, whereas remote sensing change detection requires reasoning over a bi-temporal pair. Existing VFM-based methods usually encode the two images independently and compare them only afterward, leaving the VFM backbone unaware of cross-temporal relations. To bridge this mismatch, we present AdaDINO, a pair-aware in-backbone adaptation framework that equips a frozen DINO encoder with bi-temporal interaction for efficient change detection. Its core component, Change-aware Gated Local Adaptation (CGLA), couples the two streams after selected frozen blocks and injects a shared temporal residual into them with opposite signs, enhancing genuine change responses while preserving the pair midpoint. Batch-Shared Chunk Selection (BSCS) further reduces feed-forward network (FFN) computation by retaining a batch-shared subset of channel chunks that can be executed as a compact dense FFN. A CGLA-Prior-Guided Refinement (CPGR) decoder reuses encoder-side change responses for coarse-to-fine prediction. Experiments on four remote sensing change detection benchmarks show that AdaDINO achieves competitive or superior performance against VFM-based baselines, with the largest gain on the category-agnostic SYSU-CD dataset. With 62.5% of the FFN hidden width removed, AdaDINO still achieves an F1 score of 85.29% on SYSU-CD while delivering a 1.41$\times$ throughput speedup. The code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaDINO 提出一种对冻结 DINO 编码器进行成对感知 (pair-aware) 的主干内适配框架，用于遥感变化检测，使预训练的单图表示模型能够感知双时相 (bi-temporal) 关系。其核心组件 CGLA 在选定的冻结模块后耦合两条时间流，并注入符号相反的共享时间残差；BSCS 通过保留批共享通道子集来降低 FFN 计算；CPGR 解码器复用编码端变化响应进行由粗到细的预测。在四个遥感变化检测基准上，AdaDINO 达到与 VFM 基线相当或更优的性能，并在去除 62.5% FFN 隐藏宽度后在 SYSU-CD 上仍取得 85.29% 的 F1 和 1.41 倍的吞吐加速。
Motivation: 视觉基础模型 (VFM) 如 DINO 是为单图表示预训练的，而遥感变化检测需要对双时相图像对进行推理；现有 VFM 方法通常独立编码两幅图像并在之后才比较，导致主干网络无法感知跨时间关系。
Method: 提出 AdaDINO，为冻结的 DINO 编码器配备双时相交互。核心是 Change-aware Gated Local Adaptation (CGLA)，它在选定冻结块后耦合两个流，并以相反符号注入共享时间残差以增强真实变化响应并保持双时相中点；Batch-Shared Chunk Selection (BSCS) 保留批共享的通道子集，以减少 FFN 计算并可作为紧凑稠密 FFN 执行；CGLA-Prior-Guided Refinement (CPGR) 解码器复用编码端变化响应进行由粗到细的预测。
Result: 在四个遥感变化检测基准上，AdaDINO 达到与 VFM 基线相当或更优的性能，最大增益出现在类别无关的 SYSU-CD 数据集。去除 62.5% 的 FFN 隐藏宽度后，SYSU-CD 上仍获得 85.29% 的 F1 分数，并带来 1.41 倍吞吐加速。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过在冻结 DINO 主干内部引入成对感知适配，可以弥合单图预训练表示与双时相变化检测需求之间的不匹配，实现高效变化检测；代码将发布。

papers.title: Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models
papers.abstract_en: Streaming world models predict future visual states online while maintaining physically coherent dynamics over long horizons. However, their rollouts often violate basic physical constraints. A common approach distills pretrained bidirectional DiTs into few-step causal generators. However, this paradigm suffers from two fundamental limitations: generic bidirectional teachers acquire limited physical priors from visually oriented pretraining, and the limited priors suffer further loss during bidirectional-to-causal distillation. We present PhyS, a three-stage framework for distilling physical priors into streaming world models. To acquire physical priors from real-world interactions, we construct PhyS-120K, a dataset of 120K real-world physical-interaction videos spanning rigid-body dynamics, soft-body deformation, fluid phenomena, and phase transitions. Each video is annotated with structured descriptions of object properties and causal state transitions. Physics-aware supervised fine-tuning injects the physical priors into a bidirectional 14B DiT teacher, which we then distill into a lightweight 1.3B causal DiT for few-step autoregressive streaming generation. Finally, we use online reinforcement learning to incentivize the distilled model to generate physically plausible rollouts and further propose Temporal Credit Routing (TCR) to address temporal credit assignment. TCR evaluates physical consistency over overlapping temporal windows and routes the resulting group-relative advantages to temporally aligned denoising actions. On PhysicsIQ, PhyS improves the Wan2.1-14B teacher by 18.2\% and the Self Forcing, Rolling Forcing, and Causal Forcing by 23.7\%, 14.8\%, and 31.4\%, respectively. Results also improve the physics-aware video benchmarks VideoPhy, VideoPhy2, and PhyGenBench. The dataset, code, and more sample videos are available on our Project Page.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhyS，一个三阶段框架，用于将物理先验蒸馏进流式世界模型 (streaming world models)，以改善长时程 rollout 的物理一致性。作者构建了包含 12 万条真实物理交互视频的 PhyS-120K 数据集，覆盖刚体、软体、流体和相变，并配以结构化物理描述；先对 14B 双向 DiT 教师进行物理感知监督微调，再蒸馏为 1.3B 因果 DiT，最后用在线强化学习与 Temporal Credit Routing (TCR) 激励物理合理的生成。在 PhysicsIQ 上，相对 Wan2.1-14B 教师提升 18.2%，相对 Self Forcing、Rolling Forcing、Causal Forcing 分别提升 23.7%、14.8%、31.4%，并在 VideoPhy、VideoPhy2、PhyGenBench 上取得改进。
Motivation: 现有流式世界模型的 rollout 经常违反基本物理约束；从预训练双向 DiT 蒸馏到因果生成器的常见做法有两个局限：通用双向教师从视觉预训练中获得的物理先验有限，且该有限先验在双向到因果蒸馏中进一步损失。
Method: 提出三阶段框架 PhyS：构建 PhyS-120K 物理交互视频数据集；用物理感知监督微调将物理先验注入 14B 双向 DiT 教师；将该教师蒸馏为 1.3B 因果 DiT 用于少步自回归流式生成；最后用在线强化学习激励物理合理 rollout，并提出 Temporal Credit Routing (TCR) 在重叠时间窗口上评估物理一致性，将组相对优势路由到时间对齐的去噪动作，以解决时间信用分配问题。
Result: 在 PhysicsIQ 上，PhyS 使 Wan2.1-14B 教师提升 18.2%，使 Self Forcing、Rolling Forcing、Causal Forcing 分别提升 23.7%、14.8%、31.4%；同时改进物理感知视频基准 VideoPhy、VideoPhy2 和 PhyGenBench。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过物理先验数据、教师微调与在线强化学习结合，可以显著改善流式世界模型的物理一致性，并公开了数据集、代码和示例视频。

papers.title: Verication-driven closed-loop multi-agent large language modelframework for code-compliant structural design
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent large language model(LLM)systems are applied to structural design,yet most use one-shot generation and cannot verify their output,leaving themill-suited to safety-critical tasks.Rather than trusting LLM self-correction,thisframework injects feedback from an external physics-based verier into a closedrepair loop.The framework couples a three-layernite-element verication systemwith a dual-node loop.Node 1 turns code violations into hard repair constraints,Node 2 turns a four-dimensional quality score into safety-rst soft constraints,and a retrieval-augmented code base makes every violation traceable to a clause.Overve structure types and 44 cases,code compliance rises from 56.8%to 98.6%and the composite score from 63.8 to 71.4(p<0.000001),using about 5.8%lessmaterial.Removing either node degrades performance,and compliance does notchange detectably across the two backbone LLMs tested,indicating that it ishere attributed to the external verier rather than the model.The framework,the 44-case benchmark and all experiment scripts are released as open source forreplicability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向结构设计的闭环多智能体大语言模型（LLM）框架，使用外部物理有限元验证系统（finite-element verification）而非依赖LLM自我修正，将违规反馈注入闭环修复回路。摘要报告在5种结构类型和44个案例上，规范符合率（code compliance）从56.8%提升至98.6%，综合得分从63.8提升至71.4（p<0.000001），并节省约5.8%材料；移除任一节点都会退化性能。框架、基准和实验脚本已开源。
Motivation: 现有多智能体LLM系统用于结构设计时多为一次性生成，无法验证输出，不适合安全关键任务；作者认为不应依赖LLM的自我修正，而应注入外部物理验证器的反馈。
Method: 框架将三层有限元验证系统与双节点闭环回路耦合：节点1把代码违规转化为硬性修复约束，节点2把四维质量评分转化为安全优先的软约束，并通过检索增强的规范库（retrieval-augmented code base）使每条违规可追溯至具体条款。
Result: 摘要报告在44个案例中规范符合率从56.8%升至98.6%，综合得分从63.8升至71.4（p<0.000001），材料用量减少约5.8%；移除任一节点性能下降，且两种测试的骨干LLM下符合率无明显变化，表明提升归因于外部验证器而非模型自身。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法的性能提升主要来自外部验证器的反馈注入而非LLM能力差异，并开源了框架、44案例基准和实验脚本以支持可复现性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ZeroLock: Concurrent Memory-Efficient LLM Training via Modular Update Decoupling
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) fine-tuning at the edge adapts the model to scenario-specific data while preserving privacy. Although existing studies proposed pipeline parallelism to address the limited memory and computing resources of edge devices, they commonly rely on backpropagation (BP) training, which has a fundamental limitation of update locking and could experience severe throughput and memory bottlenecks. In this work, we propose a BP-free algorithm, called ZeroLock, that decouples the model updates into independent chunk updates by local objective construction. It breaks the update locking of BP and hence can improve throughput at the algorithm level and lower memory usage by reducing activation storage. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first theoretical framework for such local objective construction-based approaches under general model chunk division by mapping local objectives to the global objective. We prove that ZeroLock has a convergence rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/\sqrt{T})$, which differs from BP only by polylogarithmic factors. We design a system for ZeroLock and build real-world prototypes, incorporating techniques such as early forwarding and failure recovery for efficient and robust implementation. Experiments on the prototype show that compared to BP-based baselines, ZeroLock reduces the memory by 26.5% and improves throughput by 4.9%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ZeroLock，一种面向边缘设备大语言模型微调的无反向传播 (BP-free) 算法。ZeroLock 通过局部目标构造将模型更新解耦为独立的块更新，打破 BP 的更新锁定 (update locking)，从而在算法层面提升吞吐并减少激活存储以降低内存。作者给出首个在一般模型分块下将局部目标映射到全局目标的理论框架，证明 ZeroLock 以 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/\sqrt{T})$ 收敛，与 BP 仅差多对数因子；原型实验相比 BP 基线减少 26.5% 内存并提升 4.9% 吞吐。
Motivation: 边缘设备上的大语言模型微调常依赖流水线并行，但现有研究仍基于 BP 训练，存在更新锁定的根本限制，导致吞吐与内存瓶颈。
Method: 提出 BP-free 算法 ZeroLock，通过构造局部目标将模型更新解耦为独立的块更新，并设计了包含提前前向传播 (early forwarding) 与失败恢复的系统原型。
Result: 摘要报告 ZeroLock 的收敛率为 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/\sqrt{T})$，与 BP 仅差多对数因子；在原型上相比 BP 基线内存降低 26.5%、吞吐提升 4.9%。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是首个针对基于局部目标构造方法在一般模型分块下的理论框架，证明其可打破 BP 的更新锁定同时保持相近收敛性；适用场景为边缘 LLM 微调。

papers.title: Thinking Hard, Not Smart: Reasoning Models Fail to Ration Test-Time Compute Across Questions
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning language models increasingly use test-time compute to improve performance, but existing evaluations typically study this compute one question at a time. Yet when multiple problems share an end-to-end cost or latency constraint, models must decide how to divide limited inference compute among them. We introduce an exam-style evaluation framework for studying this setting, in which a model must distribute one shared token budget across questions with different difficulty and point values to maximize its total score. Across several open and frontier reasoning models, we find that models fail to allocate a shared budget strategically across questions of varying difficulties and values. Models behave largely as greedy sequential solvers: they prioritize questions by presentation order, front-load effort on early questions, and remain insensitive to value, with these tendencies becoming more pronounced as the number of questions grows. Explicit planning prompts spread compute more evenly but do not produce value- or difficulty-aware prioritization. The same behavioral pattern extends from mathematical to code reasoning. These findings establish global budget allocation as a distinct capability that is not captured by conventional per-question evaluation and remains a challenge for current reasoning models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对推理语言模型对测试时计算 (test-time compute) 的分配问题，提出一种考试式评估框架：模型必须在一个共享 token 预算下，对不同难度和分值的多道题目分配推理计算以最大化总分。作者在多个开源和前沿推理模型上发现，模型无法跨题目战略性分配共享预算，而是表现为贪心的顺序求解器，且这一行为模式从数学推理扩展到代码推理。
Motivation: 现有评估通常逐题研究测试时计算，但现实场景中多道问题共享端到端成本或延迟约束，模型需要决定如何在题目间划分有限的推理计算；这一全局分配能力尚未被系统评估。
Method: 引入考试式评估框架，要求模型在一个共享 token 预算内，向不同难度和分值的题目分配计算以最大化总分，并考察题目数量、显式规划提示等因素对分配行为的影响。
Result: 模型大体表现为贪心顺序求解器：按呈现顺序优先处理题目、在早期题目上集中精力、对分值不敏感，且这些倾向随题目数量增加而更明显；显式规划提示能使计算分布更均匀，但并未产生分值或难度感知的优先级排序；相同行为模式出现在数学与代码推理中。
Conclusion: 全局预算分配是一种独立于传统逐题评估的能力，当前推理模型在此方面仍然失败，需要专门的评估与改进方法。

papers.title: CyberAGENTS: Structured Autonomy for Agentic Gamified Learning in Cybersecurity
papers.abstract_en: Gamification is especially effective in learning domains requiring active problem-solving and iterative skill-building, such as cybersecurity education. Generative AI agents offer a path to delivering such experiences adaptively at scale, but introduce well-documented risks in educational settings: inconsistent behavior, hallucinated reasoning, and misalignment with pedagogical frameworks. Grounding these systems in learning science is therefore essential. We present \model, an agentic framework for gamified cybersecurity learning that enables structured autonomy through ontology-guided validation, schema-governed behavioral control, and competency-based progression. The system is organized around a competency-based progression model that structures topics by difficulty and prerequisite relationships, reflecting evidence-based principles of scaffolded instruction. The learning loop is decomposed into four specialized agents: challenge, support, evaluation, and reward, each governed by behavioral schemas that encode operational modes and progression logic, bounding agent autonomy without eliminating generative flexibility. A cybersecurity ontology validates all generated content prior to display, enforcing domain-consistent reasoning and safety constraints. We evaluate CyberAgents through classroom deployment with undergraduate students, complemented by expert evaluations from educators and domain specialists. Results indicate improved engagement, clearer feedback interpretation, and greater learner trust in AI-generated responses when behavioral schemas and ontology validation are active. Preliminary comparisons with an unconstrained configuration further support the role of structured control in stabilizing instructional behavior. These findings offer a blueprint for designing pedagogically grounded agentic gamified learning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CyberAgents，一个面向网络安全游戏化学习的智能体框架，通过本体引导的内容验证、模式约束的行为控制和基于能力的进度模型来限定智能体自主性。学习循环被拆分为 challenge、support、evaluation 和 reward 四个专门智能体，所有生成内容在展示前都经网络安全本体校验。作者在本科生课堂部署并辅以教育者和领域专家评估，报告称启用行为模式与本体验证时学习者的参与度、反馈理解清晰度和对 AI 生成内容的信任度均有提升。
Motivation: 游戏化在需要主动解决问题和迭代技能训练的网络安全教育中效果显著，生成式 AI 智能体有望以可扩展方式提供自适应学习体验，但在教育场景中存在行为不一致、推理幻觉和与教学框架错位等风险，因此需要将系统建立在学习科学基础上并施加结构化约束。
Method: 框架围绕基于能力的学习进度模型组织，按难度和先修关系安排主题；四个专门智能体分别负责挑战生成、支持、评估和奖励，每个智能体由编码了操作模式与进度逻辑的行为模式（behavioral schemas）约束，同时保留生成灵活性；网络安全本体（cybersecurity ontology）在内容展示前对全部生成内容进行领域一致性推理与安全约束验证。
Result: 在本科生课堂部署及教育者与领域专家评估中，启用行为模式和本体验证后观察到更高的参与度、更清晰的反馈理解以及更强的学习者信任；与无约束配置的初步对比进一步支持结构化控制有助于稳定教学行为。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现为设计具有教学基础（pedagogically grounded）的智能体游戏化学习系统提供了蓝图，强调结构化自主性在平衡生成灵活性与教育可靠性中的作用。

summary_sections.motivation: 游戏化在需要主动解决问题和迭代技能训练的网络安全教育中效果显著，生成式 AI 智能体有望以可扩展方式提供自适应学习体验，但在教育场景中存在行为不一致、推理幻觉和与教学框架错位等风险，因此需要将系统建立在学习科学基础上并施加结构化约束。
summary_sections.method: 框架围绕基于能力的学习进度模型组织，按难度和先修关系安排主题；四个专门智能体分别负责挑战生成、支持、评估和奖励，每个智能体由编码了操作模式与进度逻辑的行为模式（behavioral schemas）约束，同时保留生成灵活性；网络安全本体（cybersecurity ontology）在内容展示前对全部生成内容进行领域一致性推理与安全约束验证。
summary_sections.result: 在本科生课堂部署及教育者与领域专家评估中，启用行为模式和本体验证后观察到更高的参与度、更清晰的反馈理解以及更强的学习者信任；与无约束配置的初步对比进一步支持结构化控制有助于稳定教学行为。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为这些发现为设计具有教学基础（pedagogically grounded）的智能体游戏化学习系统提供了蓝图，强调结构化自主性在平衡生成灵活性与教育可靠性中的作用。

papers.title: EasyBalance: Cross-Layer Load Balancing in Distributed MoE Inference
papers.abstract_en: Load Balancing has emerged as a critical problem in expert-parallel distributed inference of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. As routing distributions are typically skewed across experts, devices hosting lighter-loaded experts must idle to wait for the heaviest during expert computing, leading to inefficiency. Existing load-balancing approaches primarily rely on expert replication or migration within each layer, which introduce additional overhead and limit their flexibility and scalability. To address this problem, we propose EasyBalance, a cross-layer load balancing strategy that requires no modifications to the expert-device mapping, enabling instant adaptability and incurring essentially no additional overhead. Our key insights are that (1) experts of other layers can be viewed as naturally redundant for the current layer, and (2) cross-layer MoE workloads can be jointly executed to mitigate their individual imbalance. Based on these observations, EasyBalance greedily schedules a subset of cross-layer workloads to run at each MoE step and defers the remaining workloads for future balancing opportunities, effectively leveraging cross-layer imbalance mitigation. Extensive experiments across models, tasks, and configurations demonstrate that EasyBalance consistently accelerates distributed MoE inference, reducing GPU idling by mostly over 40%. Code is available at https://github.com/yize-wu/EasyInfra.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EasyBalance，一种面向分布式 MoE 推理的跨层负载均衡策略。其核心观察是其他层的专家可视为当前层的天然冗余，且跨层 MoE 负载可以联合执行以缓解各自的不均衡。EasyBalance 在每一步 MoE 计算中贪心调度一部分跨层工作负载，并将剩余工作延迟到后续机会，无需修改专家-设备映射，几乎不增加额外开销。实验表明该方法在多种模型、任务和配置下能稳定加速分布式 MoE 推理，多数情况下将 GPU 空闲等待时间降低超过 40%。
Motivation: MoE 模型的路由分布通常在专家间偏斜，导致承载较轻负载专家的设备在专家计算阶段必须空闲等待最重负载的专家，造成推理效率低下。现有负载均衡方法主要依赖层内专家复制或迁移，会引入额外开销并限制灵活性和可扩展性。
Method: 提出跨层负载均衡策略 EasyBalance，不改动专家-设备映射即可即时适配。其关键思想是利用其他层专家作为当前层的天然冗余，并在每个 MoE 步骤贪心调度一部分跨层工作负载执行，将剩余工作负载推迟以留待后续均衡机会，从而利用跨层负载的不均衡互补。
Result: 摘要报告在多种模型、任务和配置上的大量实验显示，EasyBalance 能持续加速分布式 MoE 推理，多数情况下将 GPU 空闲时间降低超过 40%。
Conclusion: 作者认为跨层 MoE 工作负载可以联合执行以缓解个体不均衡，EasyBalance 在不增加实质开销的前提下提供即时适应性。

papers.title: SCOUT: Self-Checking and Recovery-Aware Tool-Thought Agents for Ultra-Long Egocentric Video Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Ultra-long egocentric video understanding requires reasoning over temporally sparse evidence distributed across hours or days, challenging current multimodal models with limited context and the grounding of key video segments. While Chain-of-Tool-Thought (CoTT) agent systems enable iterative retrieval and inspection, they suffer from error propagation due to rigid zoom-in strategies that lack recovery mechanisms. In this work, we address these challenges through SCOUT (Self-Checking Chain-Of-Tool-thought), a recovery-aware agentic framework introducing an adaptive policy that evaluates intermediate tool observations and dynamically trades off exploitation (zoom-in) and exploration (region switching), enabling robust multi-hop reasoning over extremely long horizons. However, training such multi-turn tool-using agents remains challenging, as existing RL methods rely on sparse outcome-level rewards and lack supervision over extended decision trajectories, resulting in suboptimal credit assignment for long-horizon reasoning. To address this, we develop UPS-GRPO, an uncertainty-prioritized policy optimization method that concentrates exploration on high-uncertainty post-tool states while preserving sample efficiency. We further introduce a turn-level advantage decomposition that integrates outcome rewards with tool-grounded temporal alignment rewards for improved credit assignment. Experiments show that SCOUT achieves state-of-the-art results on ultra-long egocentric benchmarks, while remaining competitive on shorter-horizon long-video settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCOUT（Self-Checking Chain-Of-Tool-thought），一个面向超长第一人称（egocentric）视频推理的恢复感知智能体框架。它通过自适应策略评估中间工具观察，在 exploitation（zoom-in 放大检查）与 exploration（region switching 区域切换）之间动态权衡，并引入 UPS-GRPO 策略优化方法与回合级优势分解来改进多轮工具使用智能体的训练。实验显示该方法在超长 egocentric 基准上达到 SOTA，并在较短时长长视频设置上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 超长 egocentric 视频理解需要跨数小时或数天的稀疏证据进行推理，现有多模态模型的上下文有限且难以定位关键片段；基于 Chain-of-Tool-Thought 的智能体虽有迭代检索能力，但刚性 zoom-in 策略缺乏恢复机制，导致错误传播。同时，多轮工具使用智能体的强化学习训练因稀疏结果级奖励和缺乏对长决策轨迹的监督而存在信用分配困难。
Method: 提出 SCOUT 框架，其核心是自适应策略：评估中间工具观察结果并动态权衡 exploitation 与 exploration。训练方面开发 UPS-GRPO（uncertainty-prioritized policy optimization），将探索集中在后工具状态的高不确定性区域以保持样本效率；并引入 turn-level advantage decomposition，将结果奖励与基于工具接地的时间对齐奖励结合，改善长时程推理的信用分配。
Result: 摘要报告 SCOUT 在超长 egocentric 视频基准上取得 state-of-the-art 结果，并在较短时长 long-video 设置上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 作者强调恢复感知的自检机制与不确定性优先的强化学习优化相结合，能够支撑超长时间跨度上的鲁棒多跳推理；该工作发表于 ACM Multimedia 2026。

papers.title: LIBAD: A Multimodal Anomaly Detection Benchmark for Li-Ion Battery Electrode Manufacturing
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal industrial anomaly detection has largely focused on discrete products using strongly correlated RGB and 3D observations, leaving continuous process manufacturing and weakly correlated sensing modalities underexplored. We introduce LIBAD, the first multimodal anomaly detection benchmark for Li-ion battery electrode manufacturing. Collected from real roll-to-roll production lines, LIBAD provides aligned double-sided visible-light imaging, high-resolution X-ray radiography, and inline-compatible low-resolution X-ray radiography. Electrode patches in LIBAD exhibit highly homogeneous material appearance, while defect evidence can be strong in one modality but weak or absent in another, resulting in pronounced cross-modal anomaly inconsistency. Benchmarks of representative methods under the inline-compatible visible-light and low-resolution X-ray setting exhibit limited transferability and consistently high false-positive rates. We therefore propose DA-Core, a memory-based method that jointly considers feature-space coverage and local density of normal features during coreset selection, allowing compact memory banks to better preserve fine-grained normal variations. With a coreset ratio of 0.05, DA-Core reduces FPR95 from 60.4% to 54.3% compared with standard farthest point sampling. At this ratio, DA-Core also outperforms the best standard coreset result (obtained at 0.20) while reducing inference time by 43.9%. These results suggest that both the data distribution of normal features and the modality relationship itself require explicit consideration when designing anomaly detection methods for process manufacturing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LIBAD，首个面向锂离子电池电极制造的多模态异常检测基准，数据来自真实卷对卷生产线，包含对齐的双面可见光成像、高分辨率 X 射线成像和适用于在线检测的低分辨率 X 射线成像。电极斑块外观高度同质，而缺陷证据可能在一个模态中显著、在另一模态中微弱甚至缺失，造成显著的跨模态异常不一致。作者还提出基于记忆库的 DA-Core 方法，在 core-set 选择中联合考虑特征空间覆盖率和正常特征的局部密度。
Motivation: 现有工业多模态异常检测主要聚焦离散产品，且依赖强相关的 RGB 和 3D 观测；连续过程制造以及弱相关传感模态（如可见光与 X 射线）尚未被充分探索。
Method: 构建 LIBAD 基准并评估代表性方法在可见光加低分辨率 X 射线这一在线兼容设置下的表现；提出 DA-Core，一种基于记忆库的方法，在 core-set 选择时同时考虑特征空间覆盖率和正常特征的局部密度，使紧凑记忆库能更好保留细粒度的正常变化。
Result: 在 core-set 比例为 0.05 时，DA-Core 将 FPR95 从标准最远点采样的 60.4% 降至 54.3%；该比例下也优于最佳标准 core-set 结果（比例为 0.20），同时推理时间减少 43.9%。
Conclusion: 结果表明，为过程制造设计异常检测方法时，需要显式考虑正常特征的数据分布以及模态间关系本身。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Neuro-Symbolic Skills for Tool-Augmented Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models have achieved strong performance in multimodal reasoning, but they remain unreliable on fine-grained spatial tasks that demand both precise spatial perception and fine-grained geometric computation beyond end-to-end generation. Tool augmentation offers a natural solution, while existing methods either plan tool calls from scratch without explicit dependency constraints or rely on fixed pipelines that are redundant and generalize poorly across spatial tasks. An effective spatial reasoning agent should instead accumulate reusable experience and adaptively compose it for new problems. To this end, we propose NeSy-Spatial, a neuro-symbolic framework for self-evolving spatial skills. NeSy-Spatial abstracts tool interactions and geometric operations into typed executable atomic instructions and composes them into two complementary skill types: Tool-Use Skills for organizing tool execution and Geometry Skills for structured geometric reasoning. During inference, NeSy-Spatial retrieves and executes relevant skills in a closed-loop process. During evolution, it analyzes buffered successful and failed trajectories to refine skill structures and prune unreliable or inactive entries. Experiments on three spatial reasoning benchmarks show that NeSy-Spatial consistently improves reasoning accuracy with more precise tool utilization.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 9 figures, 10 tables; includes supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NeSy-Spatial，一个面向工具增强空间推理的神经符号 (neuro-symbolic) 自演化技能框架。它将工具调用与几何操作抽象为带类型的可执行原子指令，并组合成 Tool-Use Skills 与 Geometry Skills 两类互补技能；推理时闭环检索执行相关技能，演化阶段则依据成功和失败轨迹调整技能结构并剪枝不可靠条目。在三个空间推理基准上，该方法持续提升推理精度并实现更精确的工具利用。
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在细粒度空间任务上仍不可靠，因为这类任务需要精确空间感知和几何计算，超出端到端生成能力。现有工具增强方法要么无显式依赖约束地从零规划工具调用，要么依赖固定流水线，后者冗余且跨任务泛化差；因此需要能积累可复用经验并针对新问题自适应组合的智能体。
Method: NeSy-Spatial 将工具交互和几何操作抽象为类型化可执行原子指令，组合成 Tool-Use Skills（组织工具执行）和 Geometry Skills（结构化几何推理）两类互补技能。推理时检索并闭环执行相关技能；演化阶段分析缓存的成功与失败轨迹，细化技能结构并剪枝不可靠或不活跃条目。
Result: 在三个空间推理基准上的实验表明，NeSy-Spatial 一致地提升推理精度，并带来更精确的工具利用。
Conclusion: 作者主张空间推理智能体应积累可复用经验并自适应组合这些经验，而非从零规划或依赖固定流水线；NeSy-Spatial 的闭环检索与技能演化机制为这一目标提供了有效实现。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者主张空间推理智能体应积累可复用经验并自适应组合这些经验，而非从零规划或依赖固定流水线；NeSy-Spatial 的闭环检索与技能演化机制为这一目标提供了有效实现。

papers.title: KGCache: Amortized Subgraph Retrieval for KG Reasoning with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can answer knowledge-intensive questions more reliably when they are grounded with knowledge graphs, but systems such as Think-on-Graph and Reasoning-on-Graph repeatedly query the same graph neighborhoods across different questions. In this work, we study this repeated retrieval in Knowledge Graph Question Answering~(KGQA) workloads and propose KGCache, an in-memory cache for one-hop knowledge graph neighborhoods. KGCache is designed to be compatible with both iterative traversal (ToG) and one shot planning (RoG) KGQA paradigms. KGCache is placed between the KGQA engine and the backend serving the KG, so repeated entity requests can be served from cache instead of issuing new KG queries. We evaluate KGCache on WebQSP and CWQ using LRU, LFU, and a trace-aware Oracle policy. Our analysis shows that both datasets contain substantial entity reuse among starting entities and entities reached during traversal. We also explore semantic caching for similar queries, which shows additional hit-rate gains on WebQSP and needs further accuracy testing on CWQ. Entity caching accelerates KG retrieval by up to $1.91\times$, while semantic-context caching achieves up to $1.06\times$ full-system speedup in the evaluated WebQSP configurations, with each hit being up to $3.73\times$ faster.

papers.title: From Uncertainty to Failure Attribution: Self-Diagnosing Models for Failure Attribution under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Distribution shift poses a significant challenge to the robustness of machine learning models, but the current solutions only aim to detect out-of-distribution (OOD) samples and predict uncertainty levels. We introduce a problem setting for failure attribution under distribution shift, which enables the models not only to detect OOD samples, but also to find out the reason for their failure. The solution we propose is called self-diagnosing models, which are capable of jointly learning predictive output, predictive uncertainty, and a failure attribution signal. In particular, we use the failure attribution vector, produced by a neural network, which provides a structured representation of predictive unreliability by distinguishing four different types of failures: covariance shift, semantic shift, noise corruption, and adversarial perturbation. In other words, we move from scalar uncertainty towards failure identification. For training the model, we introduce a consistency regularizer that encourages consistency between uncertainty and failure attribution predictions. Moreover, to be able to evaluate the model on its ability to find the reasons for failure, we construct several distribution shift benchmarks with predefined mechanisms for generating distribution shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分布偏移下的失败归因 (failure attribution) 问题，并引入自诊断模型 (self-diagnosing models)：模型同时学习预测输出、预测不确定性和失败归因向量，后者用于区分协变量偏移、语义偏移、噪声污染与对抗扰动四类失败原因。训练中引入一致性正则化器 (consistency regularizer) 以协调不确定性与归因预测，并构建了带预定义偏移生成机制的基准用于评测。
Motivation: 现有分布偏移解决方案主要集中于 OOD 检测和不确定性估计，无法解释模型失败的具体原因；本文目标是让模型不仅检测分布外样本，还能定位失败来源。
Method: 提出的自诊断模型通过神经网络输出失败归因向量，把预测不可靠性表示成四类失败的结构化信号；训练时加入一致性正则化器，促使不确定性估计与失败归因预测保持一致，并构造具有预定义偏移机制的分布偏移基准以评估归因能力。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化结果，仅指出模型能够区分协变量偏移、语义偏移、噪声污染和对抗扰动四类失败，实现从标量不确定性到失败识别的转变。
Conclusion: 作者强调从标量不确定性走向结构化失败识别的思路，并用一致性正则化和专用基准支撑该设定；摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Persistent Semantic Entities in Tool-Augmented LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: Tool-augmented LLM agents can harbor implicit state that persists across sessions, activates through events, and propagates across agent boundaries---largely invisible to standard debugging. We formalize this as Persistent Semantic Entities (PSEs): constructs defined by name binding, event triggering, and cross-boundary propagation, and evaluate them across 24 models from 11 families (1.5B--1T parameters). First, every tested model is susceptible (20--100% on the 20-model susceptibility panel), with name binding as the necessary and dominant mechanism: without it, contamination is 0%. Second, persistence depends on contamination type rather than scale or deployment: preference contamination persists undecayed on every model probed (100% at t=10) and instruction contamination persists wherever adopted, persona-style injection decays partially (90%$\to$10%), while factual injection is model-dependent---self-corrected on Llama-3.1-8B and GPT-4o-mini but held at ceiling on both Qwen2.5-coder variants, so we do not claim it self-corrects in general. The preference and instruction results hold across providers in our controlled setting. Third, context-isolated self-verification achieves 20--79% reduction (median 36.5%) without oracle references while keyword-based detection produces systematic false positives, and contamination compounds 1.9$\times$ along a four-stage agent pipeline (40%$\to$75%). Preference and instruction contamination---persistent, lacking self-correction, and poorly captured by standard monitoring---represent a particularly concerning attack surface for deployed agent systems.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). Camera-ready version; 32 pages . The openreview url is https://openreview.net/forum?id=zPjmtawzT8&noteId=CXB95ws5so and ICML poster url is https://icml.cc/virtual/2026/poster/60521
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究工具增强 LLM 智能体中一种隐性状态污染现象，将其形式化为 Persistent Semantic Entities (PSEs)，定义为名称绑定、事件触发与跨边界传播三种机制，并在 11 个家族的 24 个模型（1.5B–1T 参数）上系统评估。结果显示所有被测模型均易受污染（20–100%），且名称绑定是必要且主导机制；偏好与指令污染在所有模型上持久不衰减，构成对已部署智能体系统的重要攻击面。作者还提出上下文隔离的自验证检测方法，可无 oracle 地将污染降低 20–79%（中位数 36.5%），而基于关键词的检测会产生系统性误报。
Motivation: 工具增强 LLM 智能体可能携带跨会话持续、由事件触发并能跨智能体边界传播的隐式状态，这类状态对标准调试基本不可见，形成潜在的攻击面；现有工作缺乏对此类污染机制的正式刻画与系统评估。
Method: 将 PSE 形式化为由名称绑定、事件触发和跨边界传播定义的构造，并在 24 个模型上做污染注入与持续性探测，同时提出上下文隔离的自验证 (context-isolated self-verification) 作为不需要 oracle 参考的缓解手段，并与基于关键词的检测方法对比。
Result: 所有 20 个模型的易感性面板均受污染（20–100%），且去掉名称绑定后污染降为 0%，说明名称绑定是必要机制；偏好污染在 t=10 时仍为 100% 不衰减，指令污染一旦被采纳即持续，人格式注入部分衰减（90%→10%），事实注入则依赖模型（在 Llama-3.1-8B 与 GPT-4o-mini 上自纠正，但在两个 Qwen2.5-coder 变体上保持天花板）；自验证带来 20–79%（中位数 36.5%）的污染降低，关键词检测有系统性误报，且污染在四阶段智能体流水线上复合 1.9×（40%→75%）。
Conclusion: 作者强调偏好与指令污染具有持久性、缺乏自纠正且难以被标准监控捕获，是已部署智能体系统尤其令人担忧的攻击面；事实注入的自纠正不能一般化，取决于具体模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Guixu: Valuation-Driven Data Discovery for Autonomous AI Agents with On-Chain Attestation
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents increasingly rely on external data to complete downstream tasks such as model training and decision support. However, existing data discovery systems remain largely retrieval-oriented: they surface candidate datasets from heterogeneous sources, but provide limited support for estimating task-specific utility, selecting cost-effective datasets under budget constraints, or incorporating trustworthy feedback from prior usage. This paper presents Guixu, a valuation-driven data discovery system for autonomous agents. Guixu employs a three-phase valuation pipeline with proxy-label propagation and multi-round knapsack optimization for task-aware data valuation. Guixu integrates agentic payment protocol to enable budget-constrained data procurement workflows. Guixu leverages on-chain data market and attestation signals for verifiable data discovery. Our demonstration highlights how Guixu enables an agent to move beyond keyword-based dataset retrieval toward task- and budget-aware, trustworthy data discovery and procurement. Attendees can interactively explore the full workflow, from NL task specification and multi-source search to data valuation and verifiable transaction feedback.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at VLDB 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Guixu，一个面向自主智能体的价值驱动数据发现系统，采用代理标签传播与多轮背包优化进行任务感知的数据估值，并集成智能体支付协议及链上数据市场与证明 (attestation) 信号，实现预算约束下的可验证数据采购。演示展示了从自然语言任务规范、多源检索，到数据估值与可验证交易反馈的完整工作流。
Motivation: 现有数据发现系统大多面向检索，只能从异构来源返回候选数据集，缺乏对任务特定效用 (task-specific utility) 的估计、预算约束下的成本效益选择，以及来自先前使用经验的可信反馈整合。
Method: Guixu 采用三阶段价值评估管线，包含代理标签传播 (proxy-label propagation) 与多轮背包优化 (multi-round knapsack optimization)；集成智能体支付协议 (agentic payment protocol) 以支持预算受限的数据采购流程，并利用链上数据市场与证明信号实现可验证的数据发现。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果；演示部分突出了智能体如何从基于关键字的检索转向任务与预算感知、可信的数据发现和采购，并允许与会者交互式探索 NL 任务规范、多源搜索、数据估值与可验证交易反馈的完整流程。
Conclusion: 作者强调 Guixu 使智能体能够超越关键字式数据集检索，实现任务与预算感知且可验证的数据发现与采购，并整合可验证的交易反馈。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SynVAR: Synergizing Spatial and Semantic Alignment in Visual Autoregressive Model
papers.abstract_en: VAR has gained widespread popularity due to its next-scale prediction paradigm. However, it faces substantial performance bottlenecks when handling complex scenes with multiple objects and attributes. Existing diffusion-based enhancement methods fail to adequately address the unique challenge of cross-scale error propagation and accumulation in VAR. To this end, we propose SynVAR, the first training-free enhancement framework specifically tailored for the VAR paradigm, which introduces a spatial-semantic collaborative control strategy to effectively suppress propagation error and improve generation quality. SynVAR comprises three key components: (1) Global guidance to ensure reasonable spatial structure in the early stages, (2) Receptive field constraints to mitigate early-stage semantic confusion, (3) High-frequency compensation to recover fine-grained details. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate the significant improvements in the ability of SynVAR to enhance the VAR's capability for complex scene modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SynVAR，一个针对视觉自回归模型（Visual Autoregressive Model, VAR）的无训练增强框架，旨在缓解 VAR 在 next-scale 预测范式下处理多物体、多属性复杂场景时的性能瓶颈。SynVAR 通过空间-语义协同控制策略抑制跨尺度误差传播，包含全局引导、感受野约束和高频补偿三个组件。定量与定性实验表明其在增强 VAR 复杂场景建模能力上取得显著提升。
Motivation: VAR 虽因 next-scale 预测范式而流行，但在包含多个物体和属性的复杂场景中面临明显性能瓶颈；现有基于扩散的增强方法未能针对 VAR 特有的跨尺度误差传播与累积问题给出有效解决方案。
Method: 提出训练免费的增强框架 SynVAR，由三部分组成：全局引导（Global guidance）在早期阶段保证合理的空间结构；感受野约束（Receptive field constraints）缓解早期语义混淆；高频补偿（High-frequency compensation）恢复细粒度细节。
Result: 大量定量与定性实验显示，SynVAR 能显著提升 VAR 在复杂场景建模方面的生成质量；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调该工作是首个专门针对 VAR 范式的无训练增强框架，通过空间-语义协同控制有效抑制传播误差并改善生成质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Directed Neuro-Symbolic Stochastic Execution for Verification of Distributed Parallel AI Programs
papers.abstract_en: Distributed parallel Artificial Intelligence (AI) programs expose reliability gaps that conventional testing cannot close: parallel executions are non-deterministic, and AI workloads bring high-dimensional inputs and non-linear operations that defeat fuzzing and symbolic execution in isolation. We present Directed Neuro-Symbolic Stochastic Execution (DNSSE), a hybrid testing framework that couples schedule prediction guided by a Large Language Model (LLM) with symbolic constraint solving and coverage-guided stochastic mutation. We model distributed AI executions as non-deterministic transition systems, specify correctness in linear temporal logic, and prove soundness, bounded completeness, and probabilistic completeness of the hybrid solver, together with an expected-cost analysis of LLM-guided schedule exploration. A scalable implementation on PyTorch and Ray detects 2.9% more concurrency bugs than the strongest baseline and raises average branch coverage from 68.6 % to 91.6 % across five realistic distributed AI benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Directed Neuro-Symbolic Stochastic Execution (DNSSE)，一种用于分布式并行 AI 程序的混合测试框架，将大语言模型引导的调度预测与符号约束求解、覆盖引导的随机变异相结合。作者将分布式 AI 执行建模为非确定迁移系统，用线性时序逻辑描述正确性，并证明了混合求解器的可靠性、有界完备性和概率完备性，还给出 LLM 引导调度探索的期望成本分析。在 PyTorch 和 Ray 上的可扩展实现比最强基线多检测出 2.9% 的并发错误，并在五个真实分布式 AI 基准上将平均分支覆盖率从 68.6% 提升到 91.6%。
Motivation: 分布式并行 AI 程序存在常规测试无法弥补的可靠性空白：并行执行是非确定的，且 AI 工作负载的高维输入和非线性运算使模糊测试与符号执行单独使用均失效。
Method: 提出 DNSSE 混合测试框架，将 LLM 引导的调度预测与符号约束求解、覆盖引导的随机变异耦合；将执行建模为非确定迁移系统并用线性时序逻辑指定正确性，同时给出混合求解器的可靠性、有界完备性、概率完备性证明和 LLM 引导调度探索的期望成本分析。
Result: 摘要报告该方法比最强基线多检测出 2.9% 的并发错误，并在五个真实分布式 AI 基准上将平均分支覆盖率从 68.6% 提升到 91.6%。
Conclusion: 作者强调混合求解器具备可靠性、有界完备性与概率完备性保障，并说明 DNSSE 能在分布式并行 AI 程序上实现更有效的并发错误检测与覆盖率提升。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Metadata Reconstruction from Values Alone: Recovering Column Semantics in Undocumented Warehouses
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-SQL benchmarks ship schemas whose column names already say what the columns mean. Production warehouses are the inverse: cryptic identifiers, partial or absent documentation. We address the problem they pose first: recovering what columns and values mean from the data itself. Rosetta places a language model inside a verification harness: a deterministic profiler extracts structural evidence (value fingerprints, a 26-pattern library, checksum verdicts), the model proposes semantics conditioned on that evidence, and every fact carries provenance and a confidence bounded by its evidence class. Against human documentation on 680 paired columns across eleven BIRD databases, identifiers destroyed, the harness delivers metadata that is 0.475 accurate on the 42% of columns it commits to, against 0.223 on 94% for the same model used directly. Restricted to the 283 columns where both arms speak, the harness writes no better prose than the model alone; the gain is selection: deterministic evidence governs whether the system speaks (coverage +0.257 [0.128, 0.378]), not how well. The deterministic layer is a competence detector, not a competence amplifier. A backbone swap bounds the claim: the prose finding reproduces, but prompt-requested abstention does not transfer; a code-enforced commit gate (predictions registered first; measured on a third backbone and held-out databases) makes no-evidence coverage 0.000 on every backbone. On a blind i2b2 clinical warehouse Rosetta decodes 95.5% of 134 real ICD-9 codes from values alone and abstains on all 44 NDC drug codes. The catalog supports calibrated abstention at query time: under full schema opacity a naive translator falls from 0.92 to 0.42 execution accuracy while our gate answers at 86% accuracy over 59% coverage. Negative results are reported plainly, including that our own authority ladder is not the mechanism behind the headline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Rosetta，一个把语言模型放入验证框架 (verification harness) 的系统，用于在缺乏文档的仓库中仅凭数据值恢复列语义。确定性剖析器提取结构证据（值指纹、26 模式库、校验和判定），模型依据证据提出语义，每条事实带有来源和受证据类别约束的置信度。在 11 个 BIRD 数据库的 680 对列（去掉标识符）上，系统对承诺回答的 42% 列达到 0.475 准确率，而同一模型直接使用在 94% 列上仅 0.223；在盲测 i2b2 临床仓库上从值中解码 95.5% 的真实 ICD-9 码并对全部 NDC 药品码弃权。摘要同时如实报告了负面结果，包括其权威阶梯并非主效应机制。
Motivation: Text-to-SQL 基准的 schema 列名已包含语义信息，而生产仓库的列名往往是隐秘标识符且文档缺失或不全。因此需要直接从数据本身恢复列与值的含义，这是仓库能实际使用前必须解决的首要问题。
Method: Rosetta 将语言模型置于验证框架内：确定性剖析器提取结构证据（值指纹、26 模式库、校验和判定），模型基于这些证据提出语义；所有事实携带来源 (provenance) 与受证据类别约束的置信度。系统还引入代码强制提交门 (code-enforced commit gate) 与查询时校准弃权 (calibrated abstention)。
Result: 在 680 个配对列上，框架对承诺列达到 0.475 准确率（覆盖率 42%），而直接使用同一模型在 94% 覆盖率下仅 0.223；受限子集中文笔无提升，增益来自选择（覆盖率 +0.257 [0.128, 0.378]）。关键发现是确定性层是能力检测器而非能力放大器；骨干网络替换后，提示式弃权不迁移，而代码强制提交门在所有骨干上达到无证据覆盖率 0.000。在盲测 i2b2 仓库中解码 95.5% 的 ICD-9 码并对全部 44 个 NDC 码弃权；完全 schema 遮蔽下，朴素翻译器执行准确率从 0.92 降到 0.42，而该门在 59% 覆盖率下以 86% 准确率作答。
Conclusion: 摘要强调系统的收益在于选择是否作答（coverage），而非生成更好的自然语言描述；确定性层的作用是能力检测器。系统支持查询时的校准弃权，且作者明确报告负面结果，包括其自身的权威阶梯并非标题效果背后的机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ScaleSense: Cost-Intelligent Scaling Framework via Learned Resource Estimation in Alibaba AnalyticDB
papers.abstract_en: Cloud-native serverless data warehouses achieve fine-grained elasticity by decoupling storage from compute, yet determining the optimal resource allocation for highly heterogeneous ad-hoc queries remains a formidable industrial challenge. Our analysis of production workloads in Alibaba AnalyticDB exposes a costly ``provisioning trap'': the fear of catastrophic resource depletion drives users to blindly over-provision resources, wasting immense monetary budgets without alleviating non-CPU bottlenecks (e.g., I/O saturation). To break this impasse, we propose ScaleSense, a proactive, query-level resource scaling framework. Specifically, it features a multi-faceted query encoder that jointly models plan topologies and hardware specifications. Crucially, a quantile-based resource predictor estimates multi-dimensional physical footprints, acting as a reliable safety net for optimal resource scaling. An auto-scaling controller then navigates the performance-cost Pareto frontier, dynamically tailoring allocations to specific business priorities without requiring model retraining. Evaluations on over 1.36 million production queries show that ScaleSense achieves state-of-the-art prediction accuracy with good prediction interval coverage. By achieving a 76.7% relative improvement in optimal resource configuration selection over the best baseline, this approach addresses the critical performance-cost trade-off while maintaining low-overhead inference latency, confirming its practical performance in production deployments. Under the performance-optimization policy, ScaleSense satisfies user-defined performance requirements while reducing monetary cost by up to 5.22x.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at VLDB 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ScaleSense，一个面向阿里云 AnalyticDB 的主动式查询级资源扩缩容框架，旨在解决云原生 serverless 数仓中异构 ad-hoc 查询的资源分配难题。框架包含多面查询编码器（联合建模计划拓扑与硬件规格）、基于分位数（quantile）的资源预测器以及自动扩缩容控制器。在超过 136 万条生产查询上，ScaleSense 取得最优资源配置选择相对最佳基线 76.7% 的提升，并在性能优化策略下最多降低 5.22x 成本。
Motivation: 生产负载分析揭示了一个代价高昂的“配置陷阱”（provisioning trap）：对资源耗尽的恐惧导致用户盲目过度配置，浪费大量资金且无法缓解非 CPU 瓶颈（如 I/O 饱和）。因此需要一种能针对高度异构查询自动确定最优资源分配的方法。
Method: ScaleSense 采用三层设计：多面查询编码器同时建模计划拓扑和硬件规格；基于分位数的资源预测器估计多维物理资源足迹，为扩缩容提供安全网；自动扩缩容控制器在性能-成本帕累托前沿上导航，可根据业务优先级动态调整分配且无需重新训练模型。
Result: 在 Alibaba AnalyticDB 超过 136 万条生产查询上的评估显示，ScaleSense 具备领先的预测精度和良好的预测区间覆盖率，最优资源配置选择相对最佳基线提升 76.7%，同时在性能优化策略下满足用户性能要求并将货币成本最多降低 5.22x，且推理开销低。
Conclusion: ScaleSense 在真实生产部署中有效平衡了性能与成本，验证了主动式查询级资源扩缩容的实用性；该工作已被 VLDB 2026 接收。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Locating Failure in Multi-Page Visually Rich Document Understanding: An Empirical Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Multi-page visually-rich document understanding (MP-VRDU) requires managing evidence that is sparse, spread across pages, and often exceeds a model's context window. Prior work has produced competing, largely untested claims about how these systems should be built. We attribute incorrect answers to three failure modes, representation, selection, and reasoning, and isolate each over a multi-page document understanding dataset by intervening on one while holding the others fixed. We find that vision is necessary but does not replace text extraction, that missing pages bound accuracy while distractors cost little, and that reasoners fail to integrate evidence across pages even when it is fully supplied. Prompting can shift reasoning behaviour substantially, improving some outcomes at the expense of others. We translate these findings into guidance for building such systems under a fixed compute budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对多页视觉丰富文档理解（MP-VRDU）中的错误进行归因，提出表示（representation）、选择（selection）和推理（reasoning）三类失败模式，并在多页文档数据集上通过固定其余变量、干预单一环节的方式来隔离每类模式。摘要报告了若干实证发现：视觉是必要的但不能替代文本提取；缺失页面限制准确率而干扰项代价很小；即使证据完全提供，推理器仍难以跨页整合证据；提示（prompting）能显著改变推理行为，但会以牺牲某些结果为代价。
Motivation: 多页视觉丰富文档理解需要处理稀疏、跨页且常超出上下文窗口的证据，而先前工作对系统应如何构建存在相互竞争且大多未经检验的主张。
Method: 将错误答案归因于表示、选择和推理三类失败模式，并通过在数据集上干预某一环节、同时保持其他环节固定来分别隔离每类模式。
Result: 摘要报告：视觉必要但不取代文本提取；缺失页面制约准确率而干扰项影响小；即使证据完整供给，推理器仍不能跨页整合证据；提示可以显著改变推理行为，但对部分指标有得有失。
Conclusion: 作者将这些发现转化为在固定计算预算下构建此类系统的指导建议。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LAD-COD: Language-Aligned Dense Perception for Camouflaged Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Camouflaged object detection (COD) aims to segment objects that exhibit high visual similarity to their surroundings, which reduces foreground-background discriminability and weakens boundary evidence across appearance, texture, and structure. Such limitations motivate the use of instruction-conditioned semantics as top-down guidance for identifying which weak visual cues are relevant to the target. Recent segmentation systems built on large multimodal models (LMMs) demonstrate this possibility through instruction-conditioned target embeddings that guide mask decoding. However, in this language-to-mask paradigm, the generated target embedding conditions mainly the mask decoder, leaving the dense visual features that must preserve low-contrast boundaries and fine local structure without explicit guidance. We propose Language-Aligned Dense perception for COD (LAD-COD), a framework that aligns top-down semantic target guidance with bottom-up hierarchical visual features. Instead of fully adapting a large generic image encoder, LAD-COD learns a trainable hierarchical visual branch that captures camouflage-sensitive texture, boundary, and contextual information. To align these features with the target embedding, LAD-COD applies Language-Aligned Dual Visual Fusion (LADVF), which extends the embedding beyond sparse prompting to query patch-level language-aligned features and to gate their residual integration with the hierarchical features. This design allows semantic information to guide localization while preserving the fine structural details needed for camouflage segmentation. Experiments on CAMO, COD10K, and NC4K show that LAD-COD obtains the best reported value in all 12 dataset-metric comparisons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LAD-COD，一种面向伪装目标检测 (COD) 的语言对齐密集感知框架。该框架在不对大型通用图像编码器做全量适配的前提下，学习一个可训练的层次视觉分支，并用语言对齐的双视觉融合 (LADVF) 将目标嵌入扩展到 patch 级查询与门控残差集成。实验在 CAMO、COD10K 和 NC4K 上报告了全部 12 项数据集-指标组合的最佳值。
Motivation: 伪装目标与背景高度相似，前景-背景判别性低，外观、纹理和结构上的边界证据都很弱；而现有基于大多模态模型 (LMM) 的语言到掩码范式仅用目标嵌入条件化掩码解码器，密集视觉特征缺乏显式指导，难以保留低对比度边界和细粒度局部结构。
Method: 提出 LAD-COD 框架：自底向上的层次视觉分支捕获对伪装敏感的纹理、边界和上下文信息；LADVF 将目标嵌入扩展到查询 patch 级语言对齐特征，并通过门控将这些特征与层次视觉特征进行残差集成，从而让语义信息指导定位。
Result: 在 CAMO、COD10K 和 NC4K 三个数据集上，摘要称 LAD-COD 在所有 12 个数据集-指标组合中取得了最佳报告值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法的关键在于将自上而下的语义目标指导与自下而上的层次视觉特征对齐，使语义指导定位的同时保留伪装分割所需的细粒度结构细节。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlexSplat: Flexible Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting without Point Cloud Correspondence
papers.abstract_en: We present FlexSplat, a feed-forward framework for novel view synthesis (NVS) from uncalibrated, object-centric multi-view image collections. A recent line of query-based methods reconstructs a compact set of 3D Gaussians by treating them as transformer queries that are refined with multi-view deformable attention; these methods, however, assume that camera poses are given. FlexSplat removes this assumption: a geometry transformer is trained jointly with the Gaussian decoder to predict per-image camera parameters and depth, which in turn ground a depth-guided Gaussian parameterization and a multi-view deformable cross-attention that aggregates evidence across all input views into a single, view-consistent set of primitives. An uncertainty-weighted depth-consistency objective lets the jointly trained geometry adapt to the reconstruction task, while the cross-view consensus formed during decoding absorbs the residual error of the estimated cameras and depth. The representation uses a compact Gaussian budget that is decoupled from the input resolution - unlike pixel-aligned methods, the primitive count does not grow with the image grid - and is not dictated by the number of views. On ShapeNet-SRN and Google Scanned Objects (GSO), FlexSplat matches or approaches posed state-of-the-art reconstructors while requiring neither camera poses nor ground-truth depth, and matches the best perceptual (LPIPS) quality among the compared methods on GSO. Our results indicate that a jointly trained geometry front-end is sufficient to bring calibration-free operation to query-based Gaussian reconstruction while staying within 0.7 dB PSNR of posed methods and matching their perceptual quality.
papers.comment: Accepted to the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026. Code: https://github.com/amir-sbg/FlexSplat
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlexSplat 是一个面向未标定、以物体为中心的多视图图像集合的前馈新视图合成 (novel view synthesis) 框架。它移除了现有基于查询 (query-based) 的 3D 高斯重建方法对相机位姿的依赖，让几何 transformer 与高斯解码器联合训练，预测每张图像的相机参数与深度，并用深度引导的高斯参数化和多视图可变形交叉注意力聚合出视图一致的紧致基元集。摘要报告在 ShapeNet-SRN 和 Google Scanned Objects (GSO) 上，它无需位姿和真值深度即可匹配或接近有位姿的最先进重建器。
Motivation: 现有把 3D 高斯当作 transformer 查询、用多视图可变形注意力精炼的一类方法假设相机位姿已知，这限制了在未标定多视图图像集合上的应用。
Method: 提出与高斯解码器联合训练的几何 transformer，用于预测每张图像的相机参数和深度；深度再引导高斯参数化以及一个跨所有输入视图聚合证据的多视图可变形交叉注意力。训练中加入不确定性加权的深度一致性损失，紧凑高斯预算与输入分辨率和视图数量解耦。
Result: 在 ShapeNet-SRN 和 GSO 上，FlexSplat 在既不需要相机位姿也不需要真值深度的条件下匹配或接近有标定方法，与有位姿方法相比 PSNR 差距在 0.7 dB 以内，并在 GSO 上匹配比较方法中最好的 LPIPS 感知质量。
Conclusion: 摘要认为联合训练的几何前端足以让基于查询的高斯重建实现无标定运行，解码过程中的跨视图共识可以吸收估计相机和深度的残差误差。
Relevance: 5
