papers.title: Distilling CT Foundation Models into Editable Concept Bottlenecks for Lung Nodule Malignancy Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models provide transferable CT representations, but predictions based directly on these embeddings are difficult to interpret. We developed concept bottleneck models that map two frozen CT foundation-model representations to eight radiologist-defined pulmonary-nodule attributes and predict malignancy from the estimated concepts and nodule size. The models included CT-FM, a whole-CT self-supervised encoder using a 96^3-voxel nodule-centered patch, and FMCIB, a nodule-focused contrastive encoder using a 50-mm crop. Eight ridge-regression concept heads were trained on 2,610 LIDC-IDRI nodules. Malignancy models were trained on LUNA25 and evaluated on a held-out internal test set and the external DLCS cohort. Concept fidelity was assessed using five-fold cross-validated R^2, and malignancy discrimination was assessed using AUROC with 95% confidence intervals estimated by patient-grouped bootstrap resampling. Concept fidelity was modest but higher for FMCIB than CT-FM for subtlety (R2, 0.24 vs. 0.11), spiculation (0.17 vs. 0.08), texture (0.17 vs. 0.07), and lobulation (0.15 vs. 0.05). Internally, the CT-FM and FMCIB concept+size models achieved AUROCs of 0.86 (95% CI, 0.80-0.92) and 0.86 (0.79-0.92), respectively. Externally, AUROCs were 0.72 (0.68-0.75) and 0.73 (0.70-0.76), compared with 0.73 for nodule size alone and 0.60 and 0.67 for the corresponding embedding only probes. Additive predictions could be decomposed into feature-level contributions and modified through controlled concept interventions. Concept bottlenecks provided transparent malignancy predictions with discrimination similar to nodule size alone, while differences in concept fidelity suggest that concept recovery depends on the underlying foundation-model representation.
papers.comment: Submitted to SPIE Medical Imaging 2027 conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可编辑的概念瓶颈模型（concept bottleneck models），将两个冻结的CT基础模型表示映射到八个放射科医生定义的肺结节属性，并结合结节大小预测恶性。实验基于LIDC-IDRI、LUNA25及外部DLCS队列，结果显示概念保真度中等且FMCIB优于CT-FM，恶性预测的判别力与单独结节大小相当，但显著优于直接使用嵌入的探针。加性预测可分解为特征贡献，并可通过受控概念干预进行修改。
Motivation: 基础模型能提供可迁移的CT表示，但直接基于嵌入的预测难以解释，缺乏临床可用的透明性。
Method: 构建概念瓶颈模型，使用CT-FM（基于96^3体素结节中心patch的whole-CT自监督编码器）和FMCIB（基于50mm裁剪的结节聚焦对比编码器）两种冻结表示，通过八个岭回归（ridge-regression）概念头估计概念，并与结节大小一起训练恶性预测模型。
Result: 概念保真度方面，FMCIB在subtlety、spiculation、texture、lobulation上的R²均高于CT-FM；内部测试集上两个模型的AUROC均为0.86，外部DLCS队列上AUROC分别为0.72和0.73，与单独结节大小（0.73）相当，优于对应嵌入探针（0.60和0.67）。
Conclusion: 概念瓶颈能提供透明的恶性预测，但判别力接近单独使用结节大小；概念保真度的差异表明概念恢复效果依赖于底层基础模型表示。

papers.title: CommitKV: Lifecycle-Aware KV Cache Compression via Commit Transitions for Multi-Turn Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn Reasoning-and-Acting (ReAct) agents accumulate growing trajectories of reasoning, tool calls, and observations. Their key-value (KV) caches grow accordingly, increasing memory use and attention cost during model inference. Existing KV cache compression methods reduce these costs by evicting states with low attention scores. However, low attention in the current turn does not imply future irrelevance, as temporarily inactive information may become important later. Snapshot-based eviction methods therefore do not explicitly distinguish temporarily dormant information from information that appears to have completed its role. In this paper, we present CommitKV, which identifies KV lifecycles through commit transitions. Specifically, CommitKV first divides completed agent events into token pages and compares each eligible page's deletion effect before a tool-call commit and after the commit's returned observation has been incorporated. Based on these paired measurements, CommitKV distinguishes dormant pages from high-to-low completion candidates. It then applies a greedy joint test, accepting candidates for retirement only when their combined post-commit effect remains bounded. Finally, at a later compression checkpoint, accepted pages are excluded, a bounded set of pages awaiting post-commit measurement is protected, and the remaining KV states are retained within the cache budget using the same token indices for keys, values, and absolute positions. These mechanisms ensure that CommitKV can distinguish dormant information from information that has completed its observed role and can be safely removed. Experiments on various benchmarks show that CommitKV reduces agent memory use, accelerates end-to-end inference, and achieves higher accuracy than existing KV cache compression methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CommitKV，一种面向多轮 ReAct 代理的 KV cache 压缩方法，通过提交转换 (commit transitions) 识别 KV 的生命周期，区分暂时休眠的信息与已完成角色的信息，从而在保持准确率的同时降低内存占用并加速推理。实验表明 CommitKV 在多个基准上优于现有 KV cache 压缩方法。
Motivation: 多轮 ReAct 代理的轨迹不断增长，KV cache 随之膨胀，导致内存与注意力计算开销上升。现有压缩方法按当前轮次的注意力分数驱逐状态，但低注意力不代表未来无关，快照式驱逐无法区分暂时休眠与已完成角色的信息。
Method: CommitKV 先将完成的代理事件划分为 token 页 (token pages)，在工具调用提交前后分别测量每页的删除效果，以区分休眠页与高到低完成候选；随后采用贪心联合检验，仅在候选页组合的提交后效应有界时才接受其退役；在后续压缩检查点排除已接受页、保护等待测量的有界页集合，并在缓存预算内用相同 token 索引保留键、值与绝对位置。
Result: 摘要报告，在多种基准上 CommitKV 降低了代理内存使用，加速端到端推理，并比现有 KV cache 压缩方法取得更高准确率。
Conclusion: CommitKV 通过显式建模 KV 生命周期，能在不牺牲准确率的情况下安全移除已完成观测角色的信息；摘要未给出具体数值或局限性讨论。

papers.title: TEMPER: Tensorized Efficient Manifold-constrained Parameterization for Expressive Residual Routing
papers.abstract_en: Residual connections rely on a static residual pathway, and are essential for training deep neural networks. Hyper-connections (HC) increase the expressivity of residual routing by incorporating multiple residual streams and learning dynamic information flow, while manifold-constrained (mHC) variants stabilize training through doubly stochastic residual mixing. However, a generator-level bottleneck remains in existing methods: they use dense, unstructured generators for pre-branch aggregation, residual mixing, and post-branch redistribution, which results in parameter count growing rapidly with the number of streams. To address this issue, we propose \underline{\textbf{T}}ensorized \underline{\textbf{E}}fficient \underline{\textbf{M}}anifold-constrained \underline{\textbf{P}}arameterization for \underline{\textbf{E}}xpressive Residual \underline{\textbf{R}}outing (\textbf{TEMPER}), which represents these generators as multi-way tensors over the input-stream, feature, and output-stream modes, and parameterizes them using tensor networks. Such a structured low-rank formulation is shown to preserve token-dependent manifold-constrained routing interface while substantially reducing parameter growth. It also promotes interpretability and intuition, as: i) tensor ranks control the dimensionality of the learned routing subspace, with full ranks recovering dense routing; while ii) the generator approximation errors bound differences in routing logits and, consequently, in the routed-block outputs. Comprehensive experiments show that TEMPER matches or outperforms existing methods across language modeling and commonsense reasoning tasks, while requiring substantially fewer additional parameters. At eight residual streams, TEMPER achieves the best CORE score while using about $84\%$ fewer additional parameters than mHC, thus showing a stronger performance-parameter efficiency trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TEMPER，一种用于残差路由的张量化高效流形约束参数化方法。现有 Hyper-connections (HC) 与其流形约束变体 (mHC) 使用稠密无结构生成器来完成分支前聚合、残差混合和分支后重分配，导致参数随残差流数量快速膨胀；TEMPER 将这些生成器表示为输入流、特征、输出流三个模式上的多路张量，并用张量网络 (tensor networks) 做结构化低秩参数化。实验表明 TEMPER 在语言建模和常识推理任务上匹配或超越现有方法，并在八条残差流下以约 84% 更少的附加参数取得最佳 CORE 分数。
Motivation: 残差连接依赖静态残差通路，Hyper-connections 通过多条残差流和动态信息流提升表达力，但现有方法的生成器级瓶颈在于稠密无结构参数导致参数量随流数量快速增长。
Method: 将 pre-branch aggregation、residual mixing 和 post-branch redistribution 三类生成器参数化为跨输入流、特征、输出流三个模态的多路张量，并通过张量网络实现结构化低秩参数化；张量秩控制所学路由子空间的维度，满秩时可恢复稠密路由。
Result: 在语言建模和常识推理任务上匹配或超越现有方法；在八条残差流时获得最佳 CORE 分数，同时比 mHC 减少约 84% 的附加参数，展现更强的性能-参数效率权衡。
Conclusion: 结构化低秩公式能在保持 token 相关的流形约束路由接口的同时显著降低参数增长，并带来可解释性：生成器近似误差界定了路由 logits 及路由块输出的差异。

papers.title: IRPol-Fuse: Energy-structure coordination for infrared polarization fusion under low visibility
papers.abstract_en: Robust perception under low-visibility conditions requires fused imagery that jointly preserves infrared thermal saliency and polarization-derived structural details. However, existing infrared-polarization image fusion (IPIF) methods often overemphasize dominant infrared responses, causing weak yet informative polarization textures in dark regions to be suppressed. To address this issue, we propose IRPol-Fuse, an energy-structure coordinated IPIF framework for challenging low-visibility scenarios. The proposed framework contains three key modules: Polarization Attention Fusion for adaptive infrared-polarization allocation, Infrared Highlight Injector for highlight-guided infrared preservation, and Polarization Texture Injector for polarization texture restoration and fine-detail recovery. We further construct LI-PI, a dedicated infrared-polarization evaluation dataset for low-visibility and visually concealed scenes. Experiments on LI-PI and the public LDDRS dataset demonstrate that IRPol-Fuse achieves favorable performance in thermal target preservation, structural detail recovery, and visual naturalness. Region-aware evaluation and downstream object detection further verify that the proposed energy-structure coordination strategy effectively preserves both infrared target saliency and polarization-derived structural information. Code is available at https://github.com/1hzf/IRPolar-Fuse .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IRPol-Fuse，一个面向低能见度场景的红外-偏振图像融合框架，目标是同时保留红外热显著性和偏振结构细节。框架包含极化注意力融合、红外高光注入器和偏振纹理注入器三个模块，并构建了低能见度评估数据集 LI-PI。实验在 LI-PI 与公开 LDDRS 数据集上进行，结果显示在热目标保留、结构细节恢复和视觉自然度上表现良好。
Motivation: 现有红外-偏振图像融合方法往往过度强调占主导的红外响应，导致暗区域中弱但信息丰富的偏振纹理被抑制，低能见度场景下的鲁棒感知受到限制。
Method: 提出 IRPol-Fuse 框架，通过 Polarization Attention Fusion 实现自适应的红外-偏振分配，用 Infrared Highlight Injector 做高光引导的红外信息保留，用 Polarization Texture Injector 恢复偏振纹理与精细细节；同时构建了低能见度专用数据集 LI-PI。
Result: 在 LI-PI 和公开 LDDRS 数据集上，IRPol-Fuse 在热目标保留、结构细节恢复与视觉自然度上获得 favorable 性能；区域感知评估和下游目标检测进一步验证了能量-结构协调策略的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调能量-结构协调策略能够同时保留红外目标显著性和偏振结构信息，并公开了代码。

papers.title: Counterfactual Benchmarking and Training for Factuality Consistency and Order-Robust Grounded Reasoning in LLMs over Heterogeneous Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have increasingly supported response generation grounded in user-provided knowledge spanning heterogeneous structures. However, existing benchmarks provide limited assessment of whether LLMs can faithfully perform multi-hop reasoning chains across such knowledge contexts while remaining robust to variations in their input order. We introduce TKFQA, a factuality consistency benchmark comprising 10,130 question-answering (QA) pairs grounded in tables, texts, and knowledge graphs (KGs). Each example is constructed from an explicit counterfactual reasoning chain, enabling the joint evaluation of answer correctness, reasoning-chain accuracy, and robustness to different input-order. An extensive evaluation of 14 open- and closed-source LLMs reveals that state-of-the-art models exhibit limited reasoning-chain accuracy and remain sensitive to variations in the input order of heterogeneous knowledge contexts. To address these limitations, we propose ORLF, an LLM-agnostic training framework that models cross-context topological relations through knowledge-specific latent vectors. ORLF integrates context-wise position encoding, a latent-bridge attention mask, and topological knowledge bias to preserve knowledge-specific bias and encode topological semantics. Experiments across four LLM backbones show that ORLF outperforms competitive training-free and LoRA-based baselines, improving average Exact Match and Reasoning-Chain Accuracy by 2.15% and 4.29%, respectively, while reducing order-induced performance standard deviation by 0.04% to 3.01%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TKFQA，一个基于反事实推理链构建的事实一致性基准，包含 10,130 个 QA 对，覆盖表格、文本和知识图谱 (KG) 三类异构知识，用于联合评估答案正确性、推理链准确率和对输入顺序扰动的鲁棒性。对 14 个开源与闭源 LLM 的评估表明，现有先进模型在推理链准确率上表现有限，且对异构知识输入顺序敏感。作者进一步提出与模型无关的训练框架 ORLF，通过知识特定的潜在向量建模跨上下文拓扑关系，在四种 LLM 骨干上提升了 Exact Match 和 Reasoning-Chain Accuracy，并降低了顺序扰动带来的性能标准差。
Motivation: 现有基准对 LLM 在用户提供的异构结构知识上进行多跳推理的能力评估不足，尤其缺乏对推理链忠实性和输入顺序鲁棒性的联合考察。
Method: 构建 TKFQA 基准，每个样本由显式反事实推理链构造；提出 ORLF 训练框架，融合上下文位置编码、潜在桥接注意力掩码 (latent-bridge attention mask) 和拓扑知识偏置，以保持知识特定偏置并编码拓扑语义。
Result: 对 14 个 LLM 的评估显示先进模型推理链准确率有限且对输入顺序敏感；ORLF 在四种 LLM 骨干上平均提升 Exact Match 2.15% 和 Reasoning-Chain Accuracy 4.29%，并将顺序引起的性能标准差降低 0.04% 至 3.01%。
Conclusion: 作者认为联合评估推理链准确性与输入顺序鲁棒性是衡量异构知识接地推理的重要方向，并表明 ORLF 这类训练框架能有效增强 LLM 的跨上下文拓扑推理能力。

papers.title: SeqLoc: Beyond the Single Frame for Cross-View Geo-Localization in Feature-Sparse Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Cross-View Geo-Localization (CVGL) with OpenStreetMap (OSM) performs well in structure-rich urban environments but collapses in feature-sparse scenes such as rural roads. To study this failure mode, in this work, we introduce CV-FSS, a benchmark that pairs sequential panoramas from five rural regions with aligned OSM maps, on which single-frame methods degrade drastically. We then propose SeqLoc, an online test-time sequence aggregation mechanism that recursively maintains a log-belief volume with three key components: (1) Entropy-Tempered Uncertainty (ETU) tempers each incoming pose likelihood volume by its normalized entropy; (2) Map-Guided Relocalization (MGR) mixes a map-shaped recovery distribution into the belief so that a suppressed true pose can recover; (3) Peak-Anchored Smoothing (PAS) derives the final pose at sub-grid precision. Extensive experiments on CV-FSS and CV-RHO demonstrate that SeqLoc outperforms single-frame localization by a large margin, improving both position and orientation recall by over 50%. The benchmark and source code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对跨视角地理定位 (Cross-View Geo-Localization, CVGL) 在特征稀疏场景（如乡村道路）下性能崩溃的问题，提出 CV-FSS 基准和 SeqLoc 方法。CV-FSS 将五个乡村区域的连续全景图与对齐的 OpenStreetMap (OSM) 配对，用于暴露单帧方法的退化。SeqLoc 是一种在线测试时序列聚合机制，通过维护对数置信体积并结合三个组件实现鲁棒定位。实验表明它在 CV-FSS 和 CV-RHO 上大幅超越单帧定位，位置与朝向召回率均提升超过 50%。
Motivation: 现有基于 OSM 的 CVGL 在结构丰富的城市环境中表现良好，但在特征稀疏的乡村道路等场景中会严重失效；单帧方法在该场景下性能大幅下降，需要显式研究这一失败模式并利用序列信息。
Method: 提出 SeqLoc，一种在线测试时序列聚合机制，递归维护一个对数置信体积 (log-belief volume)，包含三个关键组件：熵调节不确定性 (Entropy-Tempered Uncertainty, ETU) 用归一化熵对每个到来的位姿似然体积进行调节；地图引导重定位 (Map-Guided Relocalization, MGR) 将地图形状的恢复分布混入置信体积，使被抑制的真实位姿得以恢复；峰值锚定平滑 (Peak-Anchored Smoothing, PAS) 以子网格精度导出最终位姿。
Result: 在 CV-FSS 和 CV-RHO 上的大量实验表明，SeqLoc 相比单帧定位有大幅提升，位置召回率和朝向召回率均提高超过 50%。
Conclusion: 作者认为测试时序列聚合能够有效缓解特征稀疏场景下单帧定位的崩溃，让被抑制的真实位姿有机会恢复；CV-FSS 基准与源代码将公开。

summary_sections.method: 提出 SeqLoc，一种在线测试时序列聚合机制，递归维护一个对数置信体积 (log-belief volume)，包含三个关键组件：熵调节不确定性 (Entropy-Tempered Uncertainty, ETU) 用归一化熵对每个到来的位姿似然体积进行调节；地图引导重定位 (Map-Guided Relocalization, MGR) 将地图形状的恢复分布混入置信体积，使被抑制的真实位姿得以恢复；峰值锚定平滑 (Peak-Anchored Smoothing, PAS) 以子网格精度导出最终位姿。
summary_sections.result: 在 CV-FSS 和 CV-RHO 上的大量实验表明，SeqLoc 相比单帧定位有大幅提升，位置召回率和朝向召回率均提高超过 50%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为测试时序列聚合能够有效缓解特征稀疏场景下单帧定位的崩溃，让被抑制的真实位姿有机会恢复；CV-FSS 基准与源代码将公开。

papers.title: From token probabilities to calibrated confidence: An empirical study of mathematical question answering
papers.abstract_en: Confidence estimation for large language models (LLMs) aims to estimate the probability that a generated answer is correct, while calibration aligns these estimates with empirical accuracy. Prior work has shown that token probabilities are often overconfident, we investigate whether these readily available signals can nevertheless provide well-calibrated confidence estimation for mathematical question answering. We compare single-pass estimators, which reuse token probabilities from the original generation, with multi-pass estimators, which obtain additional confidence signals through verification or stochastic forward passes. While individual token probabilities can be highly saturated, we find that aggregating token probabilities over the full sequence captures small but consistent differences between correct and incorrect generations, yielding more informative confidence estimates. Multi-pass methods can yield calibrated confidence estimates. We study two such approaches: self-verification through re-prompting, including a lower-cost in-situ variant, and Monte Carlo Dropout, which derives confidence from variation across stochastic forward passes. We further evaluate two post-hoc calibration methods, Platt scaling and isotonic regression, both of which substantially reduce in-domain calibration error. However, their data efficiency varies with dataset difficulty, and the calibration mappings often transfer asymmetrically across datasets and models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对数学问答场景下大语言模型（LLM）的置信度估计与校准进行实证研究，比较了复用原始生成中 token 概率的单次估计器（single-pass）与通过验证或随机前向传播获取额外信号的多次估计器（multi-pass）。结果表明，尽管单个 token 概率容易饱和，但将全序列的 token 概率聚合起来能捕捉正确与错误生成之间微小但一致的差异，从而提供更有信息量的置信度；multi-pass 方法可得到校准良好的置信度估计。作者还评估了 Platt scaling 和 isotonic regression 两种事后校准方法，发现它们能大幅降低域内校准误差，但数据效率随数据集难度变化，校准映射在不同数据集和模型间往往不对称迁移。
Motivation: 已有工作显示 LLM 的 token 概率往往过于自信，本文旨在考察这些现成信号是否仍能为数学问答提供良好校准的置信度估计，从而弥补对可获取置信度信号系统评估的不足。
Method: 对比两类置信度估计器：single-pass 估计器直接复用原始生成中的 token 概率；multi-pass 估计器通过重提示自验证（self-verification，含低成本 in-situ 变体）或 Monte Carlo Dropout 获取额外信号，并在事后采用 Platt scaling 与 isotonic regression 进行校准。
Result: 全序列聚合 token 概率比单个 token 概率更能区分正确与错误生成；multi-pass 方法能产生校准的置信度；Platt scaling 和 isotonic regression 均大幅降低域内校准误差，但数据效率随数据集难度而异，且校准映射跨数据集和模型时迁移不对称。
Conclusion: 作者认为，结合序列级 token 概率聚合与 multi-pass 策略可获得校准的置信度估计，事后校准在域内有效但其迁移性受限；研究场景限定在数学问答任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Wan-Animate-2: Pushing the Application Boundaries of Character Animation
papers.abstract_en: Character image animation remains a foundational yet challenging task in computer vision. Existing approaches can be broadly categorized into three paradigms: methods based on explicit motion representations suffer from extraction errors and identity drift; methods based on implicit motion features lose fine-grained dynamics through compression; and in-context learning approaches avoid intermediate representations but incur prohibitive computational costs. Furthermore, all current systems are designed for offline synthesis, unable to meet the real-time requirements of interactive applications such as digital avatars and live-streaming hosts. To address these limitations, we present Wan-Animate-2, an end-to-end character animation framework that directly consumes the driving video within a redesigned Diffusion Transformer. Our architecture achieves superior motion fidelity and identity preservation by eliminating intermediate motion extractors entirely. We further introduce text driven viewpoint control that decouples the output camera perspective from the driving video--a capability rarely supported by prior character animation methods that rely on explicit motion representations. Beyond generation quality, we present Wan-Animate-2-Lite, an efficient variant that reduces inference latency to real-time thresholds through a three-stage training paradigm: teacher forcing pretraining with error buffer mechanism, and Self-Forcing distillation with chunk-wise backpropagation. This enables streaming character animation for interactive applications, opening new deployment scenarios that were previously infeasible. Qualitative evaluations and user studies demonstrate that Wan-Animate-2 achieves high-fidelity animation results across diverse characters and motion patterns. To foster further research and community development, we will release the Wan-Animate-2-Base model weights to the public.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Wan-Animate-2，一个端到端角色动画框架，直接在一个重新设计的 Diffusion Transformer 中消费驱动视频，避免任何中间运动提取器，从而提升运动保真度和身份保持。作者还引入基于文本的视角控制，将输出摄像机视角与驱动视频解耦，并推出实时变体 Wan-Animate-2-Lite，通过三阶段训练（含 teacher forcing 预训练、错误缓冲机制和 Self-Forcing 蒸馏）将推理延迟降到实时阈值。定性评估和用户研究表明其在多样角色与运动模式下可实现高保真动画，作者计划公开 Wan-Animate-2-Base 模型权重。
Motivation: 现有角色动画方法分为三类：基于显式运动表示的方法受提取误差和身份漂移影响；基于隐式运动特征的方法在压缩中丢失细粒度动态；上下文学习方法避免中间表示但计算代价过高。此外，现有系统均为离线合成，无法满足数字人、直播主播等交互应用的实时需求。
Method: Wan-Animate-2 是一个端到端框架，在重新设计的 Diffusion Transformer 中直接消费驱动视频，完全去除中间运动提取器。文本驱动的视角控制将输出相机视角与驱动视频解耦；Wan-Animate-2-Lite 则通过三阶段训练范式（teacher forcing 预训练配合错误缓冲机制，以及带分块反向传播的 Self-Forcing 蒸馏）将推理延迟降至实时水平。
Result: 摘要报告定性评估和用户研究显示，Wan-Animate-2 在多样角色和运动模式下实现高保真动画结果；Lite 变体达到实时推理阈值，支持流式角色动画的交互式应用。
Conclusion: 该方法通过消除中间运动表示和引入实时流式推理，扩展了角色动画的应用边界；作者将公开发布 Wan-Animate-2-Base 模型权重以促进社区研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Studying People to Study AI: Expert Perspectives on the Epistemic Fit and Barriers of Human Research in AI Safety & Ethics
papers.abstract_en: Safety risks of AI are becoming increasingly evident in human interactions with AI technologies. The prominent approaches to evaluating these risks favor technical methods, such as model benchmarks and LLM simulations, often sidelining empirical research with human subjects. To examine this apparent gap in the acceptance of human research, we conduct an expert survey (n=93) and expert interviews (n=17) with AI Safety & Ethics (AISE) researchers from Technical, Sociotechnical, Governance, and Normative backgrounds. Our findings suggest that although there is a consensus that human research is valuable for generating evidence for AISE, its adoption and acceptance are constrained by perceived validity issues, tangible resource barriers, epistemic and personal preferences in methods, and infrastructural constraints from the broader research community. In particular, Technical researchers tend to value human research less and collaborate across disciplines less, suggesting an epistemic tension towards human methods. We propose recommendations for establishing the epistemic fit of human research within AISE and bridging the prohibitive limitations that researchers face, while avoiding performative 'human-washing'.
papers.comment: Ninth AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过专家问卷（n=93）与专家访谈（n=17），考察 AI 安全与伦理（AI Safety & Ethics, AISE）研究者如何看待以人类为对象的实证研究。研究发现尽管存在共识认为人类研究对 AISE 的证据生成有价值，但其采纳与接受受到感知有效性、资源障碍、方法论上的认识论与个人偏好、以及研究共同体基础设施约束的限制，并提出相应建议。
Motivation: AI 风险评估的主流方法偏向技术手段，如模型基准测试和 LLM 模拟，常使人类受试者实证研究被边缘化；作者希望探究这种接受度差距及其成因。
Method: 对来自 Technical、Sociotechnical、Governance 和 Normative 背景的 AISE 研究者开展专家问卷调查（n=93）和专家访谈（n=17），分析其对人类研究价值、有效性与实施障碍的认知。
Result: 摘要报告：受访者普遍认同人类研究对 AISE 有证据价值，但其采用受感知有效性、资源限制、认识论与个人方法偏好、以及更大研究共同体的基础设施约束制约；技术背景研究者对人类研究价值评价较低且跨学科合作较少。
Conclusion: 作者提出建立人类研究在 AISE 中认识论契合（epistemic fit）的建议，并主张避免表演式的“human-washing”。

papers.title: ArborEnum: Decision Tree Rashomon Sets over Continuous Features
papers.abstract_en: The Rashomon effect describes the phenomenon that many models can achieve nearly equivalent performance on the same learning task, with significant ramifications for robustness, feature importance, and customizability. These use cases motivate the computation of Rashomon sets: the set of all models whose regularized loss is near-optimal. Decision trees are one of the few model classes for which Rashomon sets can be fully enumerated, but this computation has always been conditional on a binarization of the original data, either restricting which splits each tree is allowed to make or substantially increasing the complexity of an already difficult combinatorial problem. We introduce the first algorithm that exactly enumerates decision-tree Rashomon sets while exploiting the ordered structure of continuous features. We further develop a relaxation for approximate enumeration and an anytime algorithm that progressively refines the set of candidate thresholds, producing increasingly detailed approximations that converge to the continuous-feature Rashomon set. Experiments show that coarse binarization can miss many trees, important features, and predictive multiplicity; our algorithms achieve orders-of-magnitude speedups over existing enumeration methods, with approximations providing further speedups while maintaining near-perfect recall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ArborEnum，据称是第一个在连续特征上精确枚举决策树 Rashomon 集（所有正则化损失接近最优的模型集合）的算法，并进一步给出近似枚举的松弛版本与随时（anytime）算法，后者逐步细化候选阈值集合并收敛到连续特征 Rashomon 集。实验表明，粗糙的二值化会遗漏大量树、重要特征与预测多重性；新算法相比现有枚举方法实现数量级加速，近似方法在保持近完美召回的同时进一步提速。
Motivation: Rashomon 效应描述同一学习任务上存在许多性能近似的模型，这对鲁棒性、特征重要性和可定制性有重要影响，因而需要计算 Rashomon 集。此前决策树 Rashomon 集的完全枚举都依赖对原始数据的二值化，要么限制树允许的划分，要么显著增加本已困难的组合问题复杂度。
Method: 提出第一个利用连续特征有序结构进行精确枚举的算法；同时发展用于近似枚举的松弛方法，以及一种 anytime 算法，通过逐步细化候选阈值集合生成越来越精细的近似，最终收敛到连续特征的 Rashomon 集。
Result: 实验显示粗糙二值化会漏掉许多树、重要特征和预测多重性；所提算法相对现有枚举方法实现数个数量级的加速，近似方法在保持近完美召回（near-perfect recall）的同时提供进一步加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用连续特征的顺序结构可以避免二值化带来的信息损失，从而更高效且更完整地枚举或近似决策树 Rashomon 集。

papers.title: The Transformer Revolution, Part 1: Dynamic Processing through Output-Weight Interconnections
papers.abstract_en: This paper offers a new interpretation of the Transformer during inference. Against the "stochastic parrot" view that large language models merely reproduce statistical regularities learned in training, we argue that Transformers construct and apply prompt-dependent transformations whose parameters are generated during inference. We call this form of processing SIDPP: Sequence-level Interactive Dynamic Parallel Processing. The Transformer is interpreted as a system that transforms concepts by means of concepts. Token vectors are the concepts to be transformed; parameterized transformations defined by matrices and vectors are the transforming concepts. These may be static, when fixed through training, or dynamic, when generated from the input sequence. Mechanically, they correspond to groups of simple neural networks. The Transformer's architectural novelty lies in output-weight interconnections, through which the outputs of some networks determine the weights of others, alongside ordinary output-input interconnections. By means of these interconnections, the system constructs transformations from the prompt and uses them to modify token representations. The contribution of dynamic processing grows with prompt length and may equal or exceed that of static processing, a phenomenon we call strong prompt sensitivity. This account bears on interpretability, predictability, control, and the design of smaller, more sustainable systems. Finally, because the human neural system possesses mechanisms similar to those required for SIDPP, we argue that a form of SIDPP may, in principle, be realized in the cerebral cortex. We therefore conjecture that human language processing may itself be a form of SIDPP produced by a functional architecture relevantly similar to that of the Transformer.

papers.title: When Efficiency Becomes Fragility: Exploiting Dynamic Routing Vulnerabilities in Adaptive UAV Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Resource constraints on UAV platforms have driven a paradigm shift in aerial tracking, from pursuing performance toward balancing accuracy with efficiency. Adaptive Transformer Trackers, which leverage an input-dependent dynamic routing architecture, have emerged as a representative solution to this challenge. However, we reveal that behind this computation-on-demand flexibility hides a critical structural flaw: the Lipschitz singularity of computational path decisions, which has an unbounded local Lipschitz constant at discrete layer-skipping decision boundaries. This mathematical discontinuity renders adaptive tracking networks inherently unstable: tiny input perturbations can be amplified at the gating modules, causing dramatic changes in the inference topology. We formally characterize this singularity in the context of adaptive tracking architectures and, for the first time, identify it as a directly exploitable new attack surface. This insight reveals a previously overlooked and highly vulnerable topological path space attack surface. Based on this, we propose the Adversarial Path-Inversion (API) framework. API generates imperceptible perturbations to precisely manipulate the gating decisions, forcing the inference onto altered computational paths. The severe inconsistency between the original and the inverted paths dismantles the representation capability of the model. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art adaptive trackers demonstrate that API achieves superior perturbation stealthiness, more effective attack, and faster inference speeds. This work opens a new dimension for the security analysis of dynamic tracking networks and provides a theoretical warning for constructing robust adaptive tracking architectures in the future.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 UAV 平台上为平衡精度与效率而采用的 Adaptive Transformer Tracker，揭示其输入依赖的动态路由架构存在结构性缺陷：层跳过决策边界处的 Lipschitz 奇异性导致局部 Lipschitz 常数无界，微小输入扰动可被门控模块放大，从而剧烈改变推理拓扑。作者首次将此奇异性识别为可利用的攻击面，并提出 Adversarial Path-Inversion (API) 框架，通过不可感知的扰动操纵门控决策、将推理强行导向改变后的计算路径。实验表明 API 在先进自适应跟踪器上具备更好的扰动隐蔽性、更强的攻击效果和更快的推理速度。
Motivation: 自适应跟踪网络通过按需计算（computation-on-demand）的动态路由来兼顾 UAV 平台的资源约束与精度，但摘要指出这种灵活性背后隐藏着结构缺陷，即计算路径决策的 Lipschitz 奇异性，使网络在离散的层跳过决策边界处不稳定，构成此前被忽视的高危攻击面。
Method: 形式化刻画自适应跟踪架构中门控决策的 Lipschitz 奇异性，并提出 Adversarial Path-Inversion (API) 框架：生成不可感知的扰动以精确操纵门控决策，迫使推理进入改变后的计算路径，利用原始路径与反转路径之间的严重不一致来破坏模型表示能力。
Result: 在多个最先进的 adaptive tracker 上的大量实验表明，API 具有更优的扰动隐蔽性、更有效的攻击能力以及更快的推理速度。
Conclusion: 该工作为动态跟踪网络的安全分析开辟了新维度，并为未来构建鲁棒的自适应跟踪架构提供了理论层面的警告。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CPrefix: A Combinatorial Tensor Framework for Structured Discrete Color Mappings
papers.abstract_en: Discrete multi-channel mappings are typically represented through sampled values, providing accurate evaluations but limited insight into their underlying structure. We introduce CPrefix, a combinatorial observable representation for discrete mappings, realized within a unified tensor framework that enables representation, reconstruction, and structural analysis. The framework is based on a counting tensor induced by multinomial counting observables. Its support forms a discrete Pascal simplex, not as a constraint on the observable space, but as a latent combinatorial representation from which mappings are reconstructed. This formulation separates the combinatorial organization of a mapping from its measured values, exposing the observable structure underlying the mapping. The framework is validated on ICC display and printer profiles through latent reconstruction and perceptual gamut transport. Accurate reconstruction demonstrates that color mappings admit faithful observable representations, while reconstruction residuals provide insight into the compatibility of the underlying mapping with the proposed representation. Although demonstrated on color transformations, the framework is independent of the physical interpretation of the observables, making it applicable to structured multi-channel mappings arising from color imaging, spectral measurements and other discrete systems.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted for presentation at the IEEE ICIP 2026 Workshop on Computational Color Imaging (CCIW 2026). Withdrawn from the proceedings because the author was unable to attend the conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CPrefix，一个面向离散多通道映射的组合可观测表示框架，统一在张量框架中同时支持表示、重建与结构分析。其核心是由多项式计数观测导出的计数张量，支撑集构成离散 Pascal 单纯形，作为潜在组合表示而非对观测空间的约束，从而将映射的组合组织与其测量值分离。作者在 ICC 显示与打印机配置上验证了潜在重建与感知色域传输，表明彩色映射存在忠实的可观测表示。
Motivation: 离散多通道映射通常以采样值表示，虽然求值准确，但难以揭示其底层结构。本文旨在提供一种既能表示又能进行结构分析的统一框架。
Method: 引入 CPrefix，一种基于多分类计数观测变量 (multinomial counting observables) 的计数张量表示；其支撑集是离散 Pascal 单纯形，作为潜在组合表示，映射通过该潜在表示重建，从而分离组合结构与测量值。
Result: 在 ICC 显示和打印机配置上通过潜在重建和感知色域传输验证了框架。准确重建表明颜色映射具有忠实的可观测表示，重建残差可用于分析映射与该表示的兼容性。
Conclusion: 该框架虽在颜色变换上验证，但其原理不依赖观测的物理含义，适用于颜色成像、光谱测量及其他离散系统中的结构化多通道映射。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Resume Means Resume: A Machine-Checked Conformance Contract for Checkpoint, Interrupt, and Resume Semantics in Workflow Persistence Layers
papers.abstract_en: A framework that persists execution state so a run can be interrupted, survive a crash, and continue must decide what a resume means for effects that already happened. Five widely deployed agent workflow frameworks answer differently, none exposes a machine-checkable contract, and measured behavior violates even the fragments they state. The RESUME CONTRACT states six properties over the persistence API (prefix continuation, effect exactly-once, fork determinism, checkpoint validity, consume-once, recovery determinism), plus fork-intent and liveness obligations. A TLA+ model checks a reference semantics exhaustively, unchanged at scaled bounds (7.4 million states), and the reference conjunction is additionally TLAPS-proved unbounded (196 obligations); a 39-cell fault matrix and two companion modules yield the separating models independence requires. A deterministic, LLM-free harness measures them at pinned releases. LangGraph 1.2.9 durably records a second resume value and never consults it, persists schema-invalid state silently, and re-executes durably recorded work after a real SIGKILL: exactly-once across interrupts, at-least-once across crashes, on one API. CrewAI 1.15.2 re-executes completed effect-bearing methods against its written claim; pydantic-graph 1.x cannot resume after a mid-node crash; no two probed frameworks share a conformance profile. Consume-once holds sequentially and fails under concurrent delivery: k processes resuming one parked interrupt fire the gated effect k times, saturation 1.0 in 36 of 40 cells, and the failure crosses hosts. REMIT, a reference sequencer whose Verus-verified recovery core is line-identical to the shipped executable, repairs the fork and validity cells. The cross-process cell is repaired at the read path: an opt-in gate claims consumption in the shared store, serving one racer and refusing the rest before any node executes.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 10 tables, 1 figure. Supplementary material included as an ancillary file. v3: rejoins a paragraph split across a table float and harmonizes a label glyph in the supplement; no change to results, claims, or numbers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文围绕工作流持久化层的 checkpoint、中断与恢复语义，提出可机器检查的 RESUME CONTRACT，规定前缀延续、效果恰好一次、fork 确定性等六条性质及 fork 意图与活性义务。作者用 TLA+ 模型对参考语义做穷尽检查（7.4 million 状态），并用 TLAPS 完成无界证明（196 条义务），再用确定性、无 LLM 的测试框架在固定版本上测量五个主流 agent 工作流框架。实测显示 LangGraph、CrewAI、pydantic-graph 等均违反自己所声称的语义，且不同框架的符合性画像各不相同；作者给出的参考实现 REMIT 及可选的跨进程消费门（consume-once gate）修复了相应缺陷。
Motivation: 五个广泛部署的 agent 工作流框架对“恢复时已发生的效果如何定义”给出不同答案，但没有一个暴露可机器检查的契约，且实测行为连其书面片断都会违反。缺少形式化契约使中断、崩溃与恢复语义无法被可靠验证。
Method: 提出 RESUME CONTRACT，用 TLA+ 模型对参考语义做穷尽检查（在扩大的界限下保持 7.4 million 状态不变），并用 TLAPS 对参考合取式做无界证明（196 条义务）；另构建 39 单元格故障矩阵和两个伴生模块以支持分离模型。测量采用确定性的、无 LLM 的测试框架在固定版本上运行。修复路径包括参考序发生器 REMIT（其 Verus 验证的恢复核心与发布的可执行文件逐行一致），以及读路径上的 opt-in 消费门（在共享存储中声明消费，只服务一个竞争进程）。
Result: LangGraph 1.2.9 持续记录第二个 resume 值却从不读取、静默持久化 schema 无效状态、并在真实 SIGKILL 后重放已持久化的工作：在同一 API 上跨中断为 exactly-once、跨崩溃为 at-least-once。CrewAI 1.15.2 复现了与其书面声明相反的效果性方法重执行；pydantic-graph 1.x 在节点中途崩溃后无法恢复；被测框架没有两个共享同一符合性画像。Consume-once 在顺序条件下成立、在并发交付下失败：k 个进程恢复同一个停驻中断会触发 k 次该效应，40 个单元格中 36 个饱和度为 1.0，且失败跨主机传播。REMIT 修复了 fork 与 validity 单元格，跨进程单元格在共享存储的 opt-in 门处被修复。
Conclusion: 工作流持久化层需要可机器检查的恢复语义契约，因为现有主流框架的实际行为在中断与崩溃场景下与其声明不一致；要同时保证跨中断和跨崩溃的语义，需要在持久化与读取路径上引入经过验证的参考实现及跨进程消费门。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: State Propagation Also Satisfies: A Complex-Valued State-Space Model for Deterministic State Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based architectures have dominated sequence modeling, largely due to the expressive power of attention mechanisms. However, for a class of deterministic state tracking tasks---such as parity checking, modular counting, and parenthesis matching---attention may be overkill. In this paper, we show that \textbf{state propagation alone is sufficient}. We propose the \textbf{Complex State Propagator (CSP)}, a minimalistic recurrent architecture that \textbf{only propagates hidden states} across layers without output projections at intermediate steps. The state is represented as a complex-valued vector, updated via input-dependent rotations in the complex domain. To enable deep propagation without gradient vanishing or degradation, we introduce a \textbf{block-level skip connection} alongside element-wise complex normalization and SiLU activation at sequence boundaries. Applied with Focal Loss, CSP achieves \textbf{100\% accuracy} with perfect F1 scores across canonical tasks.

papers.title: TransNRank: Towards Accurate Neoantigen Ranking with Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Personalized neoantigen prediction is challenging due to the scarcity of positive samples, the noise of the experimental data, the severe class imbalance trait and the complex of immunogenicity features. Prior arts, such as linear regression and XGBoost fail to model long-range dependencies and contextual relationships within peptide features, therefore the performance of neoantigen positive recall rate is limited. In this paper, we present a novel deep learning framework based on Transformer, coined as TransNRank. By leveraging the self-attention mechanism, our model captures both local and global feature contexts, enabling more accurate recognition of immunogenic neoantigens. A positive-aware training objective is utilized to handle the class imbalance problem, assigning more weights to those few positive samples. Extensive experiments are performed on NCI, TESLA and HiTIDE datasets. Notably, our TransNRank can push the upper bound top 20 recall rate of neoantigen prediction from 46.9% (45 from 96) to 53.1% (51 from 96), while reducing the training epochs from 200 epochs to 20 epochs. Furthermore, we analyze the features contribution based on TransNRank and find that the mutation at anchor and TCGA expression level play an unexpected important role in neoantigen prediction, and removing insignificant features to reduce the input dimensionality of peptides does not drastically impair the overall performance of the model. Our paradigm not only streamlines the prediction pipeline but also sets a new state-of-the-art for neoantigen discovery, with broad implications for accurate immuno-oncology.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出名为 TransNRank 的基于 Transformer 的深度学习框架，用于个性化新抗原（neoantigen）预测。通过自注意力机制捕捉肽段特征的局部与全局上下文，并采用 positive-aware 训练目标缓解类别不平衡问题。在 NCI、TESLA 和 HiTIDE 数据集上的实验显示，该方法将新抗原预测的 top 20 召回率上限从 46.9%（45/96）提升到 53.1%（51/96），同时将训练轮数从 200 epoch 降到 20 epoch。此外，特征贡献分析发现锚点突变和 TCGA 表达水平等特征对预测有重要作用。
Motivation: 个性化新抗原预测面临正样本稀缺、实验数据噪声、严重类别不平衡以及免疫原性特征复杂等挑战；线性回归和 XGBoost 等既有方法难以建模肽段特征中的长距离依赖和上下文关系，导致新抗原正样本召回率有限。
Method: 提出基于 Transformer 的 TransNRank 框架，利用自注意力机制同时捕获局部和全局特征上下文，以更准确地识别具有免疫原性的新抗原；同时设计 positive-aware 训练目标，对少数正样本赋予更高权重以处理类别不平衡。
Result: 在 NCI、TESLA 和 HiTIDE 数据集上的实验表明，TransNRank 将新抗原预测的 top 20 召回率上界从 46.9%（45/96）提升至 53.1%（51/96），并将训练轮数从 200 epoch 降至 20 epoch；特征贡献分析显示锚点突变和 TCGA 表达水平对新抗原预测起重要作用，去除不显著特征未严重影响整体性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为该范式简化了预测流程并为新抗原发现设立了新的最先进水平，对精准免疫肿瘤学具有广泛意义；摘要未讨论方法的具体局限。

papers.title: Emergence Invariance: From Symbolized Thought to Structural Control
papers.abstract_en: Language-first intelligence is constrained by which distinctions enter its symbolic record, which mappings its language--interpreter--environment complex can execute, and which possibilities can be realized with finite resources. We formalize these limits through an effective interface $φ$, executable support $Π_{φ,H}$, a realization profile $M$, and resource-indexed families $\mathcal F_s(\mathcal J,M)$. They induce four nested capability levels: current reachability, budget realizability, asymptotic realizability, and structural capability, each with literal and risk-equivalent forms. On finite task spaces, universal bounded-loss dominance is characterized by inclusion of closed convexified risk envelopes; directed deficiencies and resource transformations quantify approximate simulation and realization burden. The decomposition $\mathcal R^*_{s,\mathcal J,M}=\mathcal R^*_{\mathcal J}+C_s(\mathcal J,M)$ separates structural limits from finite-resource compensation gaps. We develop dynamic control over these boundaries. Target risk identifies the lowest capability level that must change. Ockhamian control operates within inherited structural possibilities; Chattonian-containing control can produce endpoint structural novelty beyond the inherited decision class. Diminishing returns to within-structure computation and sustained structural-enrichment value yield a switching threshold, with switching costs creating hysteresis. Matched DeepSeek V4-Flash evidence shows: thinking raises pointer chasing from $0/16$ to $14/16$, exact observational and memory twins remain at their $0.5$ floors, restoring decisive memory raises performance from $0.5$ to $1.0$, and executable support determines whether reasoning can become effective. The framework organizes LLM emergence limits through structural capability, finite realizability, boundary control, and recursive meta-control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为语言优先智能的涌现（emergence）极限提出一套形式化框架，用有效接口 φ、可执行支撑 Π_{φ,H}、实现剖面 M 和资源索引族 F_s(𝒥,M) 定义四个嵌套能力层次（当前可达性、预算可实现性、渐近可实现性、结构能力），并区分字面形式与风险等价形式。作者还引入风险包络包含关系、将结构极限与有限资源补偿差距分解为 𝒥 主导项和补偿项，并讨论 Ockhamian 控制与 Chattonian-containing 控制对结构边界的动态影响。最后用 DeepSeek V4-Flash 实验说明思考、记忆与可执行支撑如何改变任务表现。
Motivation: 语言优先智能受限于哪些区分进入符号记录、语言-解释器-环境复合体可执行哪些映射以及有限资源能实现哪些可能性；论文试图系统化刻画这些限制并解释 LLM 涌现现象的结构来源。
Method: 提出一个统一形式框架：以有效接口 φ、可执行支撑 Π_{φ,H}、实现剖面 M 和资源索引族 F_s(𝒥,M) 定义四层能力；用闭凸化风险包络的包含关系刻画有限任务空间上的有界损失优势，用缺陷与资源变换量化近似模拟负担，并通过 R*_{s,𝒥,M}=R*_𝒥+C_s(𝒥,M) 分离结构极限与补偿差距；在此基础上提出目标风险识别、Ockhamian 控制与 Chattonian-containing 控制等边界控制机制。
Result: 匹配 DeepSeek V4-Flash 证据显示：思考将指针追逐从 0/16 提升到 14/16；精确观察与记忆孪生体保持在 0.5 下限；恢复决定性记忆将表现从 0.5 提升到 1.0；可执行支撑决定推理能否生效。
Conclusion: 论文通过结构能力、有限可实现性、边界控制和递归元控制来组织 LLM 涌现极限，指出结构内计算收益递减而结构富集持续有价值，切换成本会产生迟滞现象。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Factorized AdaBoost.MH Achieves the Same Convergence Rate as AdaBoost.MH
papers.abstract_en: {AdaBoost.MH} reduces multi-class classification to a collection of binary subproblems and enjoys the classical boosting-type convergence guarantee under a weak learning condition. A more structured variant, Factorized {AdaBoost.MH}, uses base classifiers of the form $\mathbf{h}(x)=α\mathbf{v} \bm{\varphi}(x)$, where a single binary classifier $\bm{\varphi}$ is shared across all classes and the label dependence is carried by a vote vector $\mathbf{v} \in\{\pm1\}^K$. This factorization is algorithmically attractive and achieves better performance in practice, but its convergence depends on whether one can always choose a vote vector with sufficiently large induced binary weight mass. Previous work resolved this question with a lower bound $\max\{1/n,1/\sqrt{2K}\}$, which still leaves a dimension-dependent slowdown relative to the original {AdaBoost.MH} analysis. In this paper, we sharpen this combinatorial step. For the minimax quantity $\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}$ governing the factorized edge, we prove $\mathfrak{W}_{n,K} = C_{\min\{n+1,K\}}$, where $C_q=1$ for $q=1$, $C_q=q/(3q-4)$ for even $q\ge2$, and $C_q=(q+1)/(3q-1)$ for odd $q\ge2$. Since $C_q\downarrow 1/3$, our bounds show that $\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}=Θ(1)$ uniformly over $n$ and $K$. Consequently, Factorized {AdaBoost.MH} achieves the same boosting-type convergence rate as {AdaBoost.MH} up to a universal constant factor, removing the previously suggested additional dependence on $n$ or $K$ in the number of boosting rounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Factorized AdaBoost.MH 的收敛率，证明了控制因子化边界的 minimax 量 $\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}$ 等于 $C_{\min\{n+1,K\}}$，其中常数 $C_q$ 有闭式表达且 $C_q\downarrow 1/3$，从而 $\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}=\Theta(1)$ 对 $n$ 和 $K$ 一致成立。由此 Factorized AdaBoost.MH 获得与 AdaBoost.MH 相同的提升型收敛率，仅差一个通用常数因子。
Motivation: Factorized AdaBoost.MH 在实践中有更好表现，但其收敛性依赖于能否选出诱导二元权重质量足够大的投票向量；此前已知下界 $\max\{1/n,1/\sqrt{2K}\}$ 会带来维度相关的减速，本文希望消除这一额外的 $n$ 或 $K$ 依赖。
Method: 通过锐化组合分析步骤，对控制因子化边界的 minimax 量 $\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}$ 给出精确公式 $\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}=C_{\min\{n+1,K\}}$，其中 $C_1=1$，偶数 $q\ge2$ 时 $C_q=q/(3q-4)$，奇数 $q\ge2$ 时 $C_q=(q+1)/(3q-1)$。
Result: 证明 $\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}=\Theta(1)$ 对 $n$ 和 $K$ 一致成立，因此 Factorized AdaBoost.MH 达到与 AdaBoost.MH 相同的提升型收敛率，并移除之前提出的算法轮数中额外的 $n$ 或 $K$ 依赖。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该结果解决了此前遗留的维度依赖收敛减速问题，表明因子化变体与原始 AdaBoost.MH 在收敛率上至多相差一个通用常数因子。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReACT-CLIP: Response-Aware Test-Time Defense for Vision--Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Training-free test-time defenses offer a practical way to improve the adversarial robustness of CLIP-style vision--language models without modifying the pretrained model. However, their correction strength is typically fixed for a narrow range of attack budgets, even though the attack budget is unknown at inference and the required correction varies across samples. We show that this mismatch causes existing defenses to degrade sharply as attacks strengthen. We introduce ReACT-CLIP, a response-conditioned test-time defense that separately determines how strongly each input should be corrected and whether defensive intervention is necessary. Our key observation is that the relative increase in CLIP visual-feature drift between low- and high-noise probes provides a graded, sample-specific proxy for correction demand. ReACT-CLIP maps this relative cross-noise drift to the Gaussian noise scale used to construct a stable, noise-averaged feature anchor, enabling the corrective reach to adapt to each input. To determine whether intervention is necessary, we further observe that clean inputs retain stable class-probability distributions under weak spatial augmentations, whereas adversarial inputs exhibit greater variation. ReACT-CLIP quantifies this variation using a prediction-instability score computed by Jensen--Shannon divergence and combines it with relative cross-noise drift to form the defensive intervention score. ReACT-CLIP requires no model or prompt training, and its correction-strength mapping is calibrated once and fixed across datasets and attack budgets. Across 12 downstream datasets, as well as ImageNet and its distribution-shifted variants, ReACT-CLIP delivers substantial robustness gains across diverse attack types and strengths while largely preserving clean accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReACT-CLIP，一种面向 CLIP 类视觉-语言模型的免训练测试时防御 (test-time defense)。它通过响应条件机制分别决定每个样本所需修正强度以及是否需要进行防御干预，核心是利用低/高噪声探针下 CLIP 视觉特征漂移的相对变化作为逐样本修正需求的代理，并将其映射到用于构建噪声平均特征锚点的 Gaussian 噪声尺度。摘要报告该方法在 12 个下游数据集、ImageNet 及其分布偏移变体上，对多种攻击类型和强度取得显著鲁棒性提升，同时基本保持干净准确率。
Motivation: 现有免训练测试时防御的修正强度对攻击预算范围固定，而推理时攻击预算未知且所需修正随样本变化，导致攻击增强时现有防御性能急剧下降。
Method: ReACT-CLIP 将修正强度确定与干预必要性判断分离：利用低噪与高噪探针之间 CLIP 视觉特征漂移的相对增量作为分级、逐样本的修正需求代理，并映射到 Gaussian 噪声尺度以构造稳定的噪声平均特征锚点；同时用弱空间增强下类别概率分布的 Jensen-Shannon 散度计算预测不稳定性分数，与相对跨噪声漂移结合形成防御干预分数。该方法不需要模型或提示训练，修正强度映射只需校准一次并在数据集和攻击预算间固定。
Result: 在 12 个下游数据集以及 ImageNet 和其分布偏移变体上，ReACT-CLIP 在多种攻击类型和强度下均带来显著的鲁棒性提升，同时基本保持干净准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ReACT-CLIP 是免训练的测试时防御，其修正强度映射校准一次后即可跨数据集与攻击预算固定使用，适用于 CLIP 风格的视觉-语言模型。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: The Scaling Paradox in Human-AI Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: The discovery of scaling laws has highlighted the extraordinary potential of AI systems with a striking empirical pattern: as AI systems scale, their capabilities tend to improve predictably. Yet, in real-world applications, AI rarely operates in isolation; instead, it often works alongside humans, raising the question of whether these gains persist in human-AI collaboration. In this work, we develop an analytical model to examine when the empirical scaling benefits of AI translate into improved human-AI joint system performance. We demonstrate that the performance of a human-AI system can scale positively as the AI scales up-provided that humans have an accurate perception of the AI's capabilities. Human misperception, however, can fundamentally alter this relationship: i) when humans over-perceive the AI's capabilities, a scaling paradox may arise, in which greater AI scale reduces overall system performance and amplifies firm-level profit losses, and (ii) when humans under-perceive the AI's capabilities, performance still improves with scale but at a substantially slower rate. We further show that firms can actively manage these distortions through operational policies such as cost internalization and perception alignment, whose effectiveness depends on the economics of AI deployment and the direction of human misperception. These findings suggest that organizations may benefit more from managing the human-AI interface than from simply investing in larger, more expensive AI systems. More broadly, our results suggest that AI scaling should be viewed not only as a technological challenge, but also as a behavioral and operational one, and caution against the view that larger AI systems will automatically lead to better operational outcomes. Whether AI scaling creates value ultimately depends on how increased AI capabilities shape human beliefs and collaborative efforts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个分析模型，研究 AI 能力随规模提升（scaling laws）时，这种收益在人类-AI 协作系统中能否转化为整体性能提升。模型表明，只有当人类对 AI 能力有准确感知时，系统性能才会随 AI 规模正向提升；若人类高估 AI 能力，则可能出现规模悖论（scaling paradox），即更大的 AI 反而降低整体性能并放大企业利润损失。若低估 AI 能力，性能仍随规模改善但速度明显放缓。作者进一步讨论了成本内部化与感知对齐等运营策略，并强调 AI 规模化应被视为行为与运营挑战而不仅是技术问题。
Motivation: 现实世界中 AI 很少孤立运行，而是与人类协作，但现有规模定律主要描述 AI 单独能力。论文针对这一空白，考察 AI 规模收益能否在人类-AI 联合系统中保持。
Method: 提出一个解析模型（analytical model），刻画 AI 能力、人类对 AI 能力的感知以及二者协作下的系统性能，并分析不同感知方向带来的影响与企业运营策略。
Result: 模型显示人类准确感知时系统性能随规模正向提升；高估 AI 能力会产生规模悖论，使更大规模损害整体性能并增加企业利润损失；低估则使性能提升速度显著放缓。企业可通过成本内部化和感知对齐等政策管理这些扭曲，其效果取决于 AI 部署经济性与感知偏差方向。
Conclusion: 作者认为组织从管理人类-AI 界面中获得的收益可能大于单纯投入更大、更贵的 AI 系统；AI 规模化是否创造价值取决于增强的能力如何塑造人类信念与协作努力，呼吁谨慎看待“更大自动更好”的观点。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Why Does the Future Branch? Identifiable Closure Tests for Stochastic Physical World Models
papers.abstract_en: A calibrated stochastic world model can reveal how uncertain a future is without revealing why it branches. The same conditional future law can arise because an observation aliases physical states or because dynamics remain random after the declared full state is fixed. We prove that ordinary transitions cannot identify these two sources, even for a perfect probabilistic predictor. ClosurePairs makes them identifiable by crossing compatible microstates with repeated exogenous disturbances and estimating state, noise, and state-noise interaction variance. The central consequence is operational: under finite hierarchical sampling, forecast difficulty governs the useful compute scale, while the alias/process composition provides complementary information about its direction-resolving the current state or sampling future randomness. ClosurePairs recovers source attribution at unchanged likelihood, reduces equal-budget decomposition error in a nonlinear interaction benchmark, and supports observation-only routing. On exact-marginal MetaWorld twins, an output-only allocator is at chance while a Closure-supervised probe on frozen JEPA-WM features routes 89.8-100%. In an independent ManiSkill PushCube confirmation, a stochastic RSSM's outputs and latents remain at chance, whereas an RGB-only Closure probe routes 100% under both ID and geometry/camera OOD over five seeds, matching direct allocation rather than exceeding it. Across five unseen allocation menus, the same Closure probe routes 92.5%/90.4% ID/OOD with no new oracle labels, versus 37.9%/32.9% for a frozen direct allocator. ClosurePairs is therefore an identifiable, reusable mechanism target that cannot be recovered from forecast quality alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机物理世界模型中未来分支不确定性的来源识别问题：同一条件未来分布既可能来自观测对物理状态的混叠（aliasing），也可能来自宣告完整状态后动力学仍存在的随机性。作者证明普通转移过程无法区分这两种来源，并提出 ClosurePairs 方法，通过交叉兼容微观状态并施加重复杂生扰动来估计状态、噪声及状态-噪声交互方差，从而实现对不确定性来源的可识别分解。在 MetaWorld 与 ManiSkill PushCube 基准上，Closure 监督探针显著优于输出/隐变量直接分配器，且跨未见分配菜单保持泛化。
Motivation: 校准的随机世界模型能告诉人们未来有多不确定，却无法揭示未来为何分叉，而这一区别对于是应解析当前状态还是采样未来随机性至关重要。现有方法仅凭完美概率预测器也无法识别这两类不确定性来源，因此需要新的可识别机制目标。
Method: 提出 ClosurePairs：通过将兼容的微观状态相互交叉并配合重复外生扰动（repeated exogenous disturbances），估计状态方差、噪声方差及状态-噪声交互方差，从而判断不确定性来自观测混叠还是动力学随机性。该方法支持仅基于观测输出（observation-only）的路由，并可对冻结的世界模型特征作监督探针。
Result: 在普通转移下不可识别性有理论证明；ClosurePairs 在同等似然下恢复来源归属并降低非线性交互基准的等预算分解误差。MetaWorld 双胞胎任务上输出分配器为随机水平，而基于冻结 JEPA-WM 特征的 Closure 探针达到 89.8%-100%；ManiSkill PushCube 中随机 RSSM 的输出与隐变量仍为随机水平，RGB 输入的 Closure 探针在 ID 与几何/相机 OOD 下均达 100%。跨五个未见分配菜单，同一探针 ID/OOD 分别为 92.5%/90.4%，而冻结直接分配器仅 37.9%/32.9%。
Conclusion: ClosurePairs 是一个可识别、可复用的机制目标，无法仅从预报质量（forecast quality）中恢复；摘要同时指出在有限分层采样下，预报难度决定有用计算规模，而混叠/过程组成提供方向性补充信息。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: DocPO: Advancing Document Policy Optimization via Tailored Step-Aware Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for document parsing often relies on reference-based rewards rooted in edit distance (e.g., tree edit distance), yet it remains hard to optimize in the high-accuracy regime because such rewards become weakly discriminative: near-correct outputs receive very similar scores, providing limited learning signal for hard cases. We propose Step-Aware Annealing (SAA), a plug-and-play reward sharpening mechanism that progressively increases reward curvature during training, amplifying subtle quality differences among high-scoring samples while preserving stability in early learning. Built on SAA, we introduce DocPO, a document policy optimization framework with element-specific, reference-based rewards anchored by edit-distance signals: normalized string edit distance (NED) for text, tree edit distance similarity (TEDS) for tables, and a hybrid Rubric+edit reward for formulas. Experiments on OmniDocBench and DocElemHard show that SAA consistently improves GRPO-style RL across document elements over non-annealed rewards, without requiring additional human supervision for reward construction.
papers.comment: 14 pages. Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM Multimedia 2026). Yunhao Wang and Binghong Wu contributed equally. Updated to the final camera-ready version with supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DocPO，一个基于逐步退火奖励（Step-Aware Annealing, SAA）的文档策略优化框架，针对高精度文档解析中强化学习奖励区分度不足的问题。SAA 在训练中逐步增加奖励曲率，放大高分样本间的细微质量差异，同时保持早期学习稳定；奖励采用元素特定的编辑距离信号，包括文本的归一化字符串编辑距离（NED）、表格的树编辑距离相似度（TEDS）以及公式的 Rubric+edit 混合奖励。在 OmniDocBench 和 DocElemHard 上，SAA 一致提升了 GRPO 风格 RL 在各类文档元素上的表现，且无需额外人工监督来构建奖励。
Motivation: 文档解析中的强化学习常依赖基于编辑距离（如树编辑距离）的参考奖励，但在高精度区域这些奖励变得弱判别：接近正确的输出得分相似，难以为困难样本提供有效学习信号。
Method: 提出插件式的奖励锐化机制 SAA，训练过程中逐步增加奖励曲率以放大高质量样本间的细微差异，同时保持早期学习的稳定性；在此基础上构建 DocPO 框架，使用元素特定且基于编辑距离的奖励：文本用 NED，表格用 TEDS，公式用 Rubric+edit 混合奖励。
Result: 在 OmniDocBench 和 DocElemHard 数据集上的实验表明，SAA 在各类文档元素上一致改进 GRPO 风格 RL 的效果，并且不要求额外的人类监督用于奖励构建。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SAA 能在高精度文档解析场景中提升基于编辑距离奖励的 RL 优化效果，并且该奖励锐化机制无需额外人工标注。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SymboUQ: Symbolic Uncertainty Quantification for Spatial Reasoning in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Although large language models (LLMs) can produce fluent spatial reasoning traces, their intermediate relations may fail to support the final conclusion, making token-level confidence insufficient for final-answer reliability estimation. Existing formal verifiers provide stronger semantic evidence, but their applicability is partial: a parsed claim need not yield a definite semantic verdict. To address this issue, we introduce SymboUQ, a symbolic uncertainty quantification framework that estimates final-answer reliability from reasoning traces by distinguishing symbolizability, whether a claim can be represented in the verifier's formal language, from semantic determinacy, whether its execution yields an entailed or contradicted verdict rather than an unknown or not-evaluable outcome. SymboUQ comprises (i) a Layout Auditor that executes ordered spatial claims and extracts feasibility, conflict, and repair evidence; (ii) a label-free Determinacy Profile that characterizes effective executable coverage; and (iii) a Determinacy-Aware Reliability Composer that integrates constraint-based, representation-based, and decoding-based scores according to verifier applicability. Extensive experiments on five spatial reasoning benchmarks with four frozen LLM backbones show that SymboUQ achieves approximately an 8% relative improvement in AUROC and a 7% relative reduction in class-balanced Brier loss over the strongest baseline.

TL;DR: SymboUQ 是一个面向大语言模型 (LLM) 空间推理的符号化不确定性量化框架，通过区分可符号化性 (symbolizability) 与语义确定性 (semantic determinacy) 来估计最终答案的可靠性。框架包含布局审计器 (Layout Auditor)、无标签的确定性画像 (Determinacy Profile) 以及确定性感知的可靠性合成器 (Determinacy-Aware Reliability Composer)。在五个空间推理基准和四个冻结 LLM 主干上的实验显示，相比最强基线，AUROC 相对提升约 8%，类平衡 Brier 损失相对降低约 7%。
Motivation: LLM 能生成流畅的空间推理过程，但中间关系未必支撑最终结论，词元级置信度不足以估计最终答案可靠性；已有形式验证器能提供更强语义证据，但其适用性不完整，因为解析出的声明不一定能得到确定的语义判定结果。

papers.title: Symbolic Attack Chain Generation from Atomic Red Team Techniques: An Empirical Study of Predicate Representation Granularity
papers.abstract_en: Automated attack chain generation is critical for modern cybersecurity, yet manual construction fails to scale as adversary behaviors expand. While classical AI planning using the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) offers a formal method to automate this process, it relies on the accurate translation of techniques into symbolic predicates. Current state-of-the-art systems like AURORA employ a nine-category Attack Action Linking Model (AALM), but the necessity of this specific granularity remains unvalidated. This work investigates whether AURORA's nine-category taxonomy provides representational distinctions beyond those captured by a reduced, empirically derived scheme. Utilizing a pipeline where a Large Language Model (LLM) performs translation and the Fast Downward engine performs deterministic reasoning, the study compares the full nine-category AALM against a reduced five-category scheme derived empirically from Atomic Red Team (ART) execution evidence. Because the nine-category domain is constructed as a relabeling of the five-category domain, plan validity and cost are held identical between schemes by design; the substantive test of granularity's effect lies instead in the resulting predicate category resolution. There, a controlled A/B test isolates a case where a coarser scheme's plan passes every validity check while remaining operationally wrong: holding administrator privilege and being able to exercise it over a network logon prove to be causally distinct system states. Results from a sixteen-technique corpus show 81.3% identical plan outcomes across both schemes by construction, with a genuine predicate category resolution gain confined to a single technique out of sixteen. The findings suggest that higher granularity primarily enhances the internal structural resolution of a plan's justification rather than the viability of the generated attack chain itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过实证研究考察攻击链生成中符号谓词表示粒度的影响，比较 AURORA 的九类别 Attack Action Linking Model (AALM) 与从 Atomic Red Team (ART) 执行证据归纳出的五类别简化方案。研究使用 LLM 进行技术到谓词的翻译、Fast Downward 引擎进行确定性规划，并在十六个技术的语料上进行受控对比。结果表明，由于九类别域被构造为五类别域的重标记，两方案的计划有效性与代价在设计上保持一致，实质性差异仅体现在谓词类别解析上。
Motivation: 手工构建攻击链无法随对手行为扩展，而基于 PDDL 的经典 AI 规划依赖技术到符号谓词的准确翻译；现有 SOTA 系统 AURORA 采用九类别 AALM，但该特定粒度的必要性尚未得到验证。
Method: 构建一条流水线，由大语言模型 (LLM) 完成技术到谓词的翻译，由 Fast Downward 引擎执行确定性推理；将完整的九类别 AALM 与从 ART 执行证据中归纳出的五类别方案进行受控 A/B 比较。九类别域被设计为五类别域的重标记，因此两方案的计划有效性和计划代价按构造保持一致，测试焦点落在谓词类别解析上。
Result: 在十六个技术的语料上，81.3% 的计划结果因构造方式而相同；真正的谓词类别解析收益仅局限于十六个技术中的一个。A/B 测试还发现一个案例：较粗方案的攻击计划通过所有有效性检查但在操作上错误，即持有管理员权限与能在网络登录上行使该权限是因果上不同的系统状态。
Conclusion: 研究发现更高的表示粒度主要增强攻击计划理由的内部结构解析，而非生成攻击链本身的可行性。

papers.title: InfoOps Bench: A live information operations safety benchmark
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we present an active, constantly updated AI benchmark which measures the integrity of frontier language models against being co-opted for use by authoritarian state "information operations": intentional, coordinated activities by one state to influence public opinion and information ecosystems in another state. These information operations are a well documented, persistent threat against contemporary democracy. Our benchmark is based on real examples from over 2,100 information operations drawn from a live monitoring pipeline which tracks online information assets with links to authoritarian regimes. Alongside this paper, we also release a companion website that updates the benchmark weekly with new claims. The dynamic nature of this public facing benchmark makes it resistant to saturation. In the benchmark, we test 17 models from 8 providers across four prompt framings. We find that most models can be co-opted for information operations at least some of the time. Integrity scores, defined as the share of judged responses in which the model neither preserved nor amplified the claim, range from 9.3% to 91%, an 81.7-percentage-point spread not explained by model size. Models approach participation in information operations in a variety of ways. Some models fabricate details and produce output more harmful than the original input claim; others make claims less harmful even while complying and producing some output. Fact-checking rates vary from 3.2% to 80.8%. Integrity against information operations is at least partly related to refusal to produce content even for benign claims, illustrating the challenge of balancing model usability with safety. Overall, our results show the potential for contemporary information operations to be substantially aided by frontier AI models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 InfoOps Bench，一个持续更新、公开可见的 AI 安全基准，用于衡量前沿语言模型被威权国家信息操作（information operations）利用的脆弱性。基准基于实时监控管道中来自 2,100 多个真实信息操作案例的素材，并配套每周更新新声明的网站，以抵抗基准饱和。作者测试了来自 8 家提供商的 17 个模型、4 种提示框架，发现大多数模型至少在某些时候可被诱导参与信息操作。
Motivation: 威权国家发起的跨国信息操作是有据可查且持续存在的民主威胁，而现有评估难以跟上快速变化的信息操作手法；需要一个动态、不易饱和的基准来持续衡量前沿模型被此类活动利用的风险。
Method: 构建一个实时监控管道，追踪与威权政权相关的在线信息资产，据此抽取超过 2,100 个真实信息操作声明作为测评素材；用四种提示框架对 17 个模型（来自 8 家提供商）进行评测，并发布每周更新的配套网站。
Result: 模型的完整性分数（integrity score）在 9.3% 到 91% 之间，跨度 81.7 个百分点且无法用模型规模解释；事实核查率在 3.2% 到 80.8% 之间。部分模型会编造细节并产生比原始输入声明更有害的内容，另一些模型即使配合输出也会让声明危害降低；模型对良性内容的拒绝倾向与抵御信息操作的能力部分相关。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，当代信息操作可能得到前沿 AI 模型的实质性助力；提升模型完整性需要在可用性与安全性之间权衡，且大多数模型仍存在被利用的漏洞。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: VideoCoCo: Code-as-CoT for Physically-Consistent Video Generation via an Agentic Dual-Engine System
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-video models have achieved remarkable visual quality, yet they still struggle to generate physically consistent dynamics because the temporal evolution of a scene must be inferred implicitly from a highly compressed text prompt. Existing chain-of-thought approaches introduce intermediate plans or visual states, but these representations are typically non-executable or temporally sparse, limiting their ability to instantiate and control the complete spatiotemporal process. To address this limitation, we introduce VideoCoCo, an agentic dual-engine framework in which executable Blender code serves as a process-level chain of thought. Given a text prompt, a coding agent synthesizes a Blender program that explicitly specifies the scene and its temporal evolution. The executable simulation engine runs the program to produce a deterministic spatiotemporal draft, which is subsequently transformed into a photorealistic video by a generative video engine through draft-conditioned editing. This decomposition separates process-level reasoning from high-fidelity visual realization. To adapt the video editor to simulated drafts, we construct VideoCoCo-3K, a curated dataset of draft-instruction-target triplets. VideoCoCo improves the OmniWeaving baseline from 0.475 to 0.558 on PhyGenBench and from 52.18 to 77.88 on VBench-2.0, achieving the best average score on both benchmarks. These results demonstrate that executable code provides an effective, controllable, and inspectable intermediate representation for physically consistent video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VideoCoCo，一个基于智能体双引擎框架的文本到视频生成方法，用可执行 Blender 代码作为过程级思维链 (chain of thought)。编码智能体根据文本提示生成 Blender 程序，由模拟引擎执行得到确定性时空草稿，再由生成式视频引擎以草稿条件编辑方式转为逼真视频。作者构建 VideoCoCo-3K 数据集用于适配视频编辑器，并在 PhyGenBench 和 VBench-2.0 上超过 OmniWeaving 基线，取得最佳平均分。
Motivation: 文本到视频模型难以生成物理一致的动态，因为场景的时间演化必须隐含地从高度压缩的文本提示中推断。现有思维链方法引入中间计划或视觉状态，但这些表示通常不可执行或时间稀疏，限制了实例化和控制完整时空过程的能力。
Method: 提出智能体双引擎框架，使用可执行 Blender 代码作为过程级思维链：编码智能体合成显式指定场景及其时间演化的 Blender 程序，模拟引擎运行该程序生成确定性的时空草稿，再由生成式视频引擎通过草稿条件编辑 (draft-conditioned editing) 将其转换为照片级真实视频。此外构建了包含草稿-指令-目标三元组的 VideoCoCo-3K 数据集，用于适配视频编辑器到模拟草稿。
Result: 在 PhyGenBench 上，VideoCoCo 将 OmniWeaving 基线从 0.475 提升到 0.558；在 VBench-2.0 上从 52.18 提升到 77.88，并在两个基准上均取得最佳平均分。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可执行代码为物理一致的视频生成提供了一种有效、可控、可检查的中间表示，并将过程级推理与高保真视觉实现相分离。

papers.title: Diagnosing Fine-Grained Inconsistency Classification in Financial Disclosure Text
papers.abstract_en: Financial disclosures may contain numerical, temporal, referential, factual, and policy inconsistencies that require different evidence and reasoning to diagnose. We study \emph{fine-grained inconsistency classification}: given a passage known to contain a conflict, the goal is to identify its type among 11 categories. Using a fixed snapshot of the synthetic SBID-FD benchmark, we compare frozen and fine-tuned encoders, evidence-augmented classifiers, prompted large language models, and LoRA-adapted generative models under a shared evaluation protocol. Task-specific adaptation yields large improvements over frozen representations, and a fine-tuned 300M encoder performs competitively with substantially larger prompted and adapted models. We further study whether localizing the conflicting claims improves classification through matched predicted-span, reference-span, and distractor-span conditions. The results show that automatically extracted evidence provides additional signal but recovers only part of the benefit obtained from reference spans. Per-class and confusion analyses further reveal that some inconsistency types are especially sensitive to localization quality, whereas others remain difficult even when the relevant evidence is supplied. These findings identify evidence localization and fine-grained type discrimination as distinct challenges and show that compact supervised encoders are strong baselines for this task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究金融披露文本中的细粒度不一致分类，在合成 SBID-FD 基准上比较冻结与微调编码器、证据增强分类器、提示大语言模型和 LoRA 适应的生成模型，目标是从 11 个类别中识别已知冲突的类型。结果表明任务特定微调大幅优于冻结表示，一个 300M 参数的微调编码器能与明显更大的模型竞争；自动提取的证据只恢复参考跨度带来的一部分收益，且不同不一致类型对证据定位质量的敏感度不同。
Motivation: 金融披露中的不一致涉及数字、时间、指称、事实和政策等多种类型，诊断它们需要不同的证据和推理；本文针对已知包含冲突的段落，研究如何识别其具体类型，并考察证据定位对分类性能的影响。
Method: 在固定的合成 SBID-FD 基准快照上，采用共享评估协议比较冻结和微调编码器、证据增强分类器、提示大语言模型以及 LoRA 适应的生成模型；同时设计匹配预测跨度、参考跨度和干扰跨度三种条件，研究局部化冲突主张对分类的影响。
Result: 任务特定适应带来大幅改进，微调的 300M 编码器达到与更大提示/适应模型相当的性能；自动提取的证据提供额外信号但仅恢复参考跨度收益的一部分。逐类和混淆分析显示，部分不一致类型对定位质量敏感，而其他类型即使提供了相关证据仍然难以区分。
Conclusion: 论文指出证据定位和细粒度类型区分是两个不同的挑战，紧凑的监督编码器是该任务的强基线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Data Pyramid for Embodied Manipulation: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal foundation models learned to see and to speak by consuming the whole internet. Embodied agents admit no such shortcut, since they require data that couple observations with physical states and actions. These signals can be provided, to varying degrees, by multiple data sources. In this work, we organize the embodied data ecosystem as a "pyramid" spanning five complementary sources: real-robot data, UMI-style data, egocentric and exocentric data, simulation data, and general vision-language data. We organize the pyramid around the tension between scalability and robot alignment, and further characterize each source in terms of data quality, diversity, reusability, and physical fidelity. We then analyze recent embodied foundation models through the lens of their data recipes, examining how different sources are selected, aligned, and mixed during pretraining. For embodied brain models, vision-language-action models, and world-action models alike, we relate data composition to capabilities in perception, reasoning, planning, action generation, and world prediction. We close by discussing six open challenges: building large-scale tactile datasets, collecting failure and recovery data, developing scalable data-collection pipelines, aligning actions across embodiments, leveraging egocentric data for dexterous manipulation, and designing principled data recipes for robot learning. We hope this work paves the foundation for the design of next-generation embodied systems.
papers.comment: Awesome Embodied Data Pyramid; Project Page at https://jasper-aaa.github.io/embodied-data-pyramid/ GitHub Repo at https://github.com/worldbench/awesome-embodied-data-pyramid
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于具身操作数据生态的综述，将数据来源组织为五层“数据金字塔”：真实机器人数据、UMI 风格数据、自我中心与外中心 (egocentric/exocentric) 数据、仿真数据以及通用视觉-语言数据。文章以可扩展性与机器人对齐 (robot alignment) 之间的张力为主线，并从数据质量、多样性、可复用性和物理保真度等维度刻画各来源，进而以数据配方 (data recipe) 为视角分析近期具身基础模型。
Motivation: 具身智能体缺乏互联网规模数据的捷径，需要将观测与物理状态和动作耦合的数据，而这些信号只能由多种数据源以不同程度提供，因此需要对该数据生态进行系统化组织。
Method: 提出具身数据金字塔这一组织框架，并以此为分析工具，考察具身大脑模型、视觉-语言-动作模型和世界-动作模型在预训练中如何选择、对齐和混合不同数据源，并将数据组成与感知、推理、规划、动作生成和世界预测等能力关联起来。
Result: 本文为综述，未报告实证结果；其产出是面向具身数据生态的结构化分析和六个开放挑战的梳理。
Conclusion: 作者指出六个待解决挑战：大规模触觉数据集、失败与恢复数据收集、可扩展数据采集流程、跨具身动作对齐、利用自我中心数据实现灵巧操作，以及为机器人学习设计有原则的数据配方，并希望为下一代具身系统设计奠定基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PointCHR: Point Cloud Analysis via Curvature-Aware Hyperbolic Rectification
papers.abstract_en: High-curvature regions in 3D point clouds encapsulate critical fine-grained geometric semantics yet exhibit a distinct long-tail sparsity in their spatial distribution. The inherent limitations of polynomial volume growth in Euclidean space frequently render these intricate geometric features challenging to adequately resolve within a uniform-scale feature space. Consequently, these regions are frequently overshadowed by smooth global features dominated by low-curvature regions, thereby limiting the discriminative capacity of the network. To address this issue, we propose PointCHR, a curvature-aware hyperbolic rectification (CHR) for point cloud analysis. Utilising the property of exponential volume expansion in the vicinity of hyperbolic manifolds, CHR presents a learnable curvature-guided radial rectification mechanism. By adaptively projecting high-curvature points towards boundary regions endowed with larger effective embedding capacities, PointCHR effectively mitigates the representation crowding problem inherent in Euclidean settings. Extensive experimentation has demonstrated that PointCHR significantly enhances the ability of backbone to capture fine-grained geometric details, achieving state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43 rd International Conference on Machine Learning,2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PointCHR，一种面向三维点云分析的曲率感知双曲矫正（curvature-aware hyperbolic rectification, CHR）方法。该方法利用双曲流形附近指数体积膨胀的性质，设计可学习的曲率引导径向矫正机制，将高曲率点自适应投影到具有更大有效嵌入容量的边界区域，以缓解欧氏空间中高曲率区域表示拥挤（representation crowding）的问题。实验表明 PointCHR 能显著增强骨干网络对细粒度几何细节的捕捉能力，并在多个基准上取得最优性能。
Motivation: 三维点云中高曲率区域包含关键的细粒度几何语义，但其空间分布呈现长尾稀疏性；欧氏空间的多项式体积增长在均匀尺度特征空间中难以充分解析这些复杂几何特征，导致高曲率区域常被低曲率主导的平滑全局特征掩盖，限制了网络的判别能力。
Method: 提出 PointCHR 框架，核心是可学习的曲率引导径向矫正机制（CHR）：利用双曲流形近邻区域指数体积膨胀的特性，将高曲率点自适应地投影到具有更大有效嵌入容量的边界区域，从而缓解欧氏表示中的拥挤问题。
Result: 大量实验表明 PointCHR 显著提升骨干网络捕捉细粒度几何细节的能力，并在多个点云分析基准上达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调双曲空间中的指数体积膨胀特性可用于改善点云高曲率区域的表示能力，PointCHR 通过在欧氏基础上引入曲率引导的径向矫正来提升细粒度几何建模。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Trust-region Framework for Moment Estimation
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we develop a trust-region framework for understanding the behavior of adaptive moment estimation mechanisms, such as \textsc{Adam}, in stochastic gradient optimization. Specifically, the magnitude of the update step associated with each individual parameter is constrained by a finite-order $p$-moment trust-region, with $p\ge1$. The resulting derivation leads to a family of learning-rate mechanisms based on second-moment estimation and normalized $p$-th-moment estimation. For $p=4$, this involves kurtosis estimation. Subsequent derivations provide a unified interpretation of moment-estimation-based normalization, learning-rate scheduling, momentum as a spectral first-order lowpass regularization, and operator-level spectral-norm normalization within a common trust-region framework. Preliminary experiments on GPT2-124M trained on FineWeb-Edu and TinyStories suggest that the fourth-moment realization provides its greatest benefit when trust-region constraints are weak. As progressively stronger trust-region controls are introduced, the second-moment realization becomes increasingly competitive, often achieving slightly lower validation loss than its corresponding fourth-moment realization.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 5 figures. revised for improved presentation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个置信域框架来解释随机梯度优化中自适应矩估计机制（如 Adam）的行为，将每个参数的更新步长约束在有限阶 p-矩置信域内（p≥1），从而导出一系列基于二阶矩估计和归一化 p 阶矩估计的学习率机制，其中 p=4 时涉及峰度估计。推导结果统一了矩估计归一化、学习率调度、动量作为谱一阶低通正则化以及算子级谱范数归一化。在 GPT2-124M 上使用 FineWeb-Edu 和 TinyStories 的初步实验显示，当置信域约束较弱时四阶矩实现获益最大，而随着约束增强，二阶矩实现变得更具竞争力并常取得略低的验证损失。
Motivation: 现有自适应矩估计机制（如 Adam）缺乏统一的数学框架来解释其归一化、学习率调度和动量等行为之间的关系，作者希望用置信域思想为这些机制提供一致的理论视角。
Method: 通过限制每个参数更新步长的 p 阶矩（p≥1）建立置信域约束，推导出基于二阶矩和归一化 p 阶矩估计的学习率机制；对 p=4 引入峰度估计，并将动量和算子级谱范数归一化纳入同一框架。
Result: 初步实验（GPT2-124M，FineWeb-Edu 与 TinyStories）表明，弱置信域约束下四阶矩实现优势最大，强约束下二阶矩实现更优，常获得略低的验证损失。
Conclusion: 该置信域框架统一了多种基于矩估计的优化技术，并提供实验证据表明二阶矩实现在强约束条件下可胜过四阶矩实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hierarchical Copula-Gumbel-Top-\texorpdfstring{$K$}{K} Routing: Two-Sided Dependence Control for Frozen Mixture-of-Experts at Fixed Per-Token Routing Laws
papers.abstract_en: A stochastic Gumbel-Top-$K$ router defines, for every token of a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, a \emph{routing law}: a distribution over ordered expert lists and mixture weights. We ask which \emph{joint} distributions over the routing choices of different tokens are reachable while every individual token's complete routing law is held exactly fixed. We give a two-sided construction, \emph{Hierarchical Copula-Gumbel-Top-$K$} (\CGA{}). Within a group of related tokens, an exchangeable Gaussian copula positively correlates the Gumbel perturbations at each expert coordinate, which can increase within-group expert-set coherence. Across disjoint pairs of groups, a tunable antithetic construction introduces a selectable amount of negative dependence. We prove that both operations leave each token's ordered Top-$K$ sample, mixture weights, and inclusion probabilities identical in distribution to independent routing \emph{at a routing layer conditioned on its pre-routing logits}; conditional expected expert traffic is preserved as a consequence. We characterize the resulting trade-off: positive within-group coupling can only inflate the variance of realized expert loads relative to independent routing, while nonnegative cross-group opposition can only reduce it relative to flat coupling at the same within-group strength. Coherence and load dispersion are thus controlled by two complementary dependence dials on the invariance constraint surface. Because the base model is untouched, the dials can be driven by a small controller over frozen features, trainable with a score-function estimator: the frozen network is evaluated only in the forward direction, and gradients are confined to the controller. An initial small-scale pilot validates the mechanism and the training route, but does not establish task-level fine-tuning gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机 Gumbel-Top-$K$ 路由器在固定每个 token 的边缘路由律（routing law）时，不同 token 路由选择的联合分布能达到何种程度。作者提出 Hierarchical Copula-Gumbel-Top-$K$（CGA）构造：组内用可交换高斯 copula 正相关各专家坐标上的 Gumbel 扰动，组间用可调的反演（antithetic）构造引入负相关。文中证明这两类操作在给定预路由 logits 的路由层条件下，不改变每个 token 的有序 Top-$K$ 样本、混合权重与包含概率的分布，并刻画了组内正耦合抬高专家负载方差、组间负相关降低方差的权衡。
Motivation: 现有的 Gumbel-Top-$K$ 路由只刻画单个 token 的边缘路由分布，缺少对多个 token 路由选择之间联合依赖的控制；在冻结的混合专家（MoE）模型上，如何在保持每个 token 路由律完全不变的前提下调节专家选择的组内一致性（coherence）与负载离散度，是一个尚未解决的空白。
Method: 提出两侧依赖控制构造 Hierarchical Copula-Gumbel-Top-$K$：组内通过可交换高斯 copula 对各专家坐标的 Gumbel 扰动施加正相关，组间通过可调的反演构造引入可选强度的负相关。控制器在冻结特征上运行，基座模型只做前向传播，梯度仅流向控制器，并用 score-function estimator 训练。
Result: 理论结果表明，在条件于预路由 logits 的路由层上，两种操作都保持每个 token 的有序 Top-$K$ 样本、混合权重和包含概率与独立路由同分布，从而保留条件期望的专家流量；同时，组内正耦合只会抬高实现负载的方差，而非负的组间反相关在同一组内强度下只会相对平缓耦合降低方差。初步小规模 pilot 验证了机制与训练路线，但未展示任务级微调收益。

papers.title: Attributes Should Come from Images, Not Class Names: Distribution-Conditioned Attribute Selection for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A popular route to interpretable zero-shot classification asks a large language model (LLM) to describe each class name and prompts CLIP with the resulting descriptors. We show that these descriptors carry little visual evidence of their own: removing the class name from the prompt collapses ImageNet accuracy from 59.5% to 15.5%. The diagnosis is that the descriptors are conditioned on the label rather than on the images, so they describe the concept in general and mislead exactly when the data shifts; an LLM insists that strawberries are red, but every strawberry in ImageNet-Sketch is a colorless line drawing. We therefore select attributes from the target image collection instead: we score a large attribute pool against the images in CLIP's joint embedding space and keep the top-scoring attributes per class. Selected this way, class-name-free attribute prompts reach 23.8% on ImageNet (against 15.5% for LLM descriptors), the gain holds on four shifted ImageNet variants, and reselecting from the LLM's own pool isolates the selection mechanism as the cause. With one image per class, the selected attributes outperform the prompt-tuning method CoOp by 3 points while fitting in under a minute instead of 14 hours, with no learned soft prompt to obscure the decision. Because the attribute set is chosen by the data, it doubles as a readable summary of a dataset, which we use to describe distribution shift in words. Our code and results are available on our project page: https://ggare-cmu.github.io/AttributeSelect/
papers.comment: Accepted at the PFATCV Workshop, ECCV 2026. Project page: https://ggare-cmu.github.io/AttributeSelect/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究可解释零样本分类中由 LLM 生成类别描述符的视觉证据不足问题，提出改为从目标图像集合中筛选属性。摘要报告称，去掉类名后 LLM 描述符在 ImageNet 上从 59.5% 掉到 15.5%，而数据驱动的属性提示在无类名时达到 23.8%，并在四个偏移 ImageNet 变体上保持优势；每类仅一张图像时，该方法比 CoOp 高 3 个点，且训练时间不到一分钟而非 14 小时。
Motivation: 现有流行路线让 LLM 为每个类名生成描述并输入 CLIP，但这些描述由标签而非图像决定，因此在数据分布偏移时会产生误导，例如 ImageNet-Sketch 中的草莓是无线条颜色的线稿图，LLM 却坚持草莓是红色的。
Method: 从目标图像集合中选择属性：在 CLIP 的联合嵌入空间中对大规模属性池按图像打分，每类保留得分最高的属性并构建无类名的属性提示；此外还从 LLM 生成的属性池中重新选择，以隔离属性选择机制本身的影响。
Result: 摘要报告无类名属性提示在 ImageNet 上达到 23.8%，优于 LLM 描述符的 15.5%；该增益在四个偏移 ImageNet 变体上保持；每类一张图像的设置下，所选属性比提示调优方法 CoOp 高 3 个点，训练时间从 14 小时降至不到一分钟。
Conclusion: 由于属性集合由数据本身决定，它可兼作数据集的可读摘要，并可用于用文字描述分布偏移。论文被 ECCV 2026 的 PFATCV 工作坊接收。
