papers.title: Cost Accounting for Reactive Computational Graphs: Exhaustive Sweeps, Sequential Mutation, and the Backward-Locality Gap
papers.abstract_en: Exhaustive site-by-site interventions on a neural network's computational graph -- activation-patching sweeps, circuit-discovery searches, systematic ablation studies -- mutate the graph at every candidate site, and their cost is dominated by recomputation after each mutation. On a reactive graph engine whose invalidation provably touches exactly the downstream cone of a mutated node, we give a complete cost accounting for such workloads. First, the aggregate speedup of an exhaustive sweep over independent full recomputations is not a universal constant: if per-layer weight varies regularly with depth at Karamata index q, the ratio converges to (q+2)/(q+1) when weight concentrates near the output and to q+2 near the input, recovering 2 only in the depth-uniform case; a wall-clock corollary predicts a ceiling of about 1.79, below 2, until interpreter overhead is compiled away. Second, we prove the exact cost of a sequence of persistent mutations, never undone between insertions: the interleaved cost exceeds the isolated sum by an exact overcount summed over comparable site pairs, with closed-form extremes over insertion orders, while batched application is order-independent and sub-additive, costing exactly the union of the sites' cones plus the fresh nodes. Third, we prove the exact mirror of forward locality for the backward pass, showing it collapses the aggregate speedup to 1 under backpropagation on architectures without long skip connections. Every identity is validated on NeuroDSL, a reactive graph engine in Julia: measured sweep ratios converge to the predicted limits under four cost profiles; the training-mode ratio collapses to 1 at the predicted rate; and all 18 per-graft sequential costs and the batched total match the closed forms at zero tolerance across three insertion orders.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对反应式计算图（reactive computational graphs）上穷举站点干预（activation-patching 扫描、电路发现、系统消融）的代价给出完整核算。在一个失效传播恰好只触及被改动节点下游锥（downstream cone）的图引擎上，作者推导出穷举扫描相对独立全量重算的聚合加速比并非普适常数：当逐层权重以 Karamata 指数 q 随深度正规变化时，比值收敛到 (q+2)/(q+1)（权重集中于输出端）或 q+2（集中于输入端），仅在深度均匀时恢复为 2。文章还证明了持久突变序列的精确代价、批量应用的序无关次可加性，以及无长跳跃连接架构下反向传播把聚合加速比坍缩为 1，并在 Julia 图引擎 NeuroDSL 上验证了全部恒等式。
Motivation: 对神经网络计算图逐站点干预的工作负载，其成本由每次突变后的重算主导；现有分析缺少对这种负载的精确代价刻画，也不清楚穷举扫描的加速比是否为通用常数。
Method: 作者在失效传播恰好覆盖突变节点下游锥的反应式图引擎上建立完整代价核算，用 Karamata 正规变化刻画逐层权重分布，推导扫描加速比的极限；对持久突变序列给出跨站点对精确超计数的闭式表达，证明批量应用的序无关性与次可加性；并证明反向传播中前向局部性的精确镜像，即反向局部性缺口（backward-locality gap）。所有恒等式在 Julia 反应式引擎 NeuroDSL 上以四种代价剖面验证。
Result: 摘要报告：穷举扫描加速比收敛于 (q+2)/(q+1) 或 q+2，壁钟推论预测上限约 1.79（低于 2）；持久突变序列的交错代价超过孤立代价之和，批量应用恰好等于各站点锥的并加上新节点；无长跳跃连接的架构下反向传播使聚合加速比坍缩为 1。NeuroDSL 上，四个代价剖面的扫描比值收敛到预测极限，训练模式比值以预测速率坍缩到 1，18 个逐移植（per-graft）顺序代价与批量总计在三种插入顺序下均以零容差匹配闭式。
Conclusion: 摘要强调干预类工作负载的加速比取决于逐层权重分布与架构（如是否存在长跳跃连接），并非普遍常数；所给闭式代价与实验验证使穷举扫描、持久突变序列和反向传播负载的代价可以精确核算。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Exact Network Surgery: Functional Invariance and Gradient Plasticity in Reactive Computational Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Function-preserving network growth techniques such as Net2Net and progressive stacking expand a model's capacity without destroying its learned function, but existing formulations either tolerate numerical perturbations or require a full rebuild of the training program. We formalize Exact Network Surgery: the in-place insertion of a residual block into a live computational graph such that (i) the network function is preserved -- bit-exactly under explicit floating-point hypotheses -- and (ii) inserted parameters remain trainable immediately after insertion. We prove an identity-morphism theorem for gated residual blocks, a structural-locality theorem showing that a reactive invalidation engine recomputes exactly the downstream cone of the insertion point, leaving every other node's value and optimizer state untouched, and an escape-from-initialization proposition showing that the Gradient Shadowing gate alpha, initialized at zero over a randomly initialized branch, receives a generically non-zero gradient at insertion time. We identify a degenerate configuration -- zero-initialized output projections combined with a zero gate -- that is an exact saddle point gradient descent cannot escape. Every claim is validated on the reference implementation in NeuroDSL, a reactive graph engine in Julia: grafting is bit-exact on every logit tested (0 mismatches out of 1600); the gate escapes zero at the first optimizer step and unlocks branch gradients at the second, exactly as predicted; the degenerate configuration exhibits gradients identically zero for the entire 600-step run; surgery cost tracks downstream cone size with r = 0.9992 while graft-plus-invalidation bookkeeping is constant (about 0.75 ms) across insertion depths; and training resumes bit-identically across a real process restart. A flagged preliminary appendix reports first single-seed observations on post-insertion gate dynamics.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化定义了 Exact Network Surgery：在计算图运行过程中原位插入残差块（residual block），使得网络函数在显式浮点假设下逐位保真（bit-exact），且插入参数立刻可训练。作者证明了门控残差块的恒等态射定理、反应式失效引擎（reactive invalidation engine）的结构局部性定理，以及 Gradient Shadowing 门 alpha 逃离零初始化的命题，并识别出一个梯度下降无法逃离的退化鞍点配置。基于 Julia 反应式图引擎 NeuroDSL 的实现验证了这些论断：grafting 在 1600 次测试中 0 次失配、门在第 1 个优化步逃离零点，手术开销与下游锥大小高度相关（r = 0.9992）。
Motivation: 既有网络扩容技术如 Net2Net 和 progressive stacking 能够在不破坏已学函数的前提下扩展模型容量，但现有方案要么容忍数值扰动，要么需要完全重建训练程序。本文希望在不重建训练管线的情况下，实现真正逐位保真且可直接继续训练的原位网络手术。
Method: 作者形式化 Exact Network Surgery 并给出三个理论结果：门控残差块的恒等态射定理、反应式失效引擎只重算插入点下游锥的结构局部性定理，以及随机初始化分支上零初始化门在插入时接受一般非零梯度的 escape-from-initialization 命题；同时指出零初始化输出投影加零门的退化配置是精确鞍点。所有论断在 NeuroDSL（Julia 反应式图引擎）参考实现上验证。
Result: 摘要报告：grafting 在所有测试 logit 上逐位精确（1600 次中 0 次失配）；门在第一步优化即逃离零点，并在第二步解锁分支梯度；退化配置在完整 600 步运行中梯度恒为零；手术成本与下游锥大小相关 r = 0.9992，而 graft 加失效记账开销恒定约 0.75 ms 且与插入深度无关；训练在真实进程重启后逐位一致地恢复。附录包含单种子下插入后门动态的初步观察。
Conclusion: 作者认为精确的、逐位保真的原位网络手术是可行的，插入的门能够逃离零初始化，唯一例外是零初始化的退化鞍点配置；手术成本随下游锥大小增长，而记账开销恒定，训练可在进程重启后保持逐位一致。摘要未报告理论结果超出其假设范围之外的适用范围，附录中的门动态分析目前仅为初步的单种子观察。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 作者形式化 Exact Network Surgery 并给出三个理论结果：门控残差块的恒等态射定理、反应式失效引擎只重算插入点下游锥的结构局部性定理，以及随机初始化分支上零初始化门在插入时接受一般非零梯度的 escape-from-initialization 命题；同时指出零初始化输出投影加零门的退化配置是精确鞍点。所有论断在 NeuroDSL（Julia 反应式图引擎）参考实现上验证。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告：grafting 在所有测试 logit 上逐位精确（1600 次中 0 次失配）；门在第一步优化即逃离零点，并在第二步解锁分支梯度；退化配置在完整 600 步运行中梯度恒为零；手术成本与下游锥大小相关 r = 0.9992，而 graft 加失效记账开销恒定约 0.75 ms 且与插入深度无关；训练在真实进程重启后逐位一致地恢复。附录包含单种子下插入后门动态的初步观察。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为精确的、逐位保真的原位网络手术是可行的，插入的门能够逃离零初始化，唯一例外是零初始化的退化鞍点配置；手术成本随下游锥大小增长，而记账开销恒定，训练可在进程重启后保持逐位一致。摘要未报告理论结果超出其假设范围之外的适用范围，附录中的门动态分析目前仅为初步的单种子观察。

papers.title: Decouple and Reason: Anatomically Guided Two-Stage Voxel-Level Grounding of Free-Text Findings in 3D Chest CT
papers.abstract_en: Automatic voxel-level grounding of free-text findings in 3D chest Computed Tomography (CT) is critical for clinical interpretability. However, this task remains highly challenging due to the intricate spatial complexity of large 3D volumes and the heterogeneity of free-text findings. Existing end-to-end approaches often struggle to simultaneously learn the localized feature representations required for accurate 3D segmentation and the complex semantic understanding needed for text alignment, leading to suboptimal grounding performance. To overcome this fundamental limitation, we propose a novel decoupled framework that disentangles the problem into two specialized stages: (1) class-agnostic lesion segmentation and (2) text-volume reasoning. This structural separation allows the model to first extract candidate sub-volumes by localizing potential abnormalities. Subsequently, intensive cross-modal reasoning is performed to align these localized sub-volumes with free-text medical findings. To resolve the spatial ambiguities inherent in local regions, the reasoning module is augmented with explicit anatomical guidance, utilizing relative spatial coordinates and lung lobe priors. Evaluated on the ReXGroundingCT benchmark, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in overall grounding quality on the official leaderboard. These results demonstrate that decoupling detection from reasoning is a highly effective paradigm for handling the complexity of 3D medical visual grounding. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/khuhm/DAGG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 3D 胸部 CT 中自由文本发现 (free-text findings) 的体素级定位任务，提出一种分离式框架，将任务拆解为类别无关的病灶分割与文本-体积极推理两个阶段。第一阶段先提取候选病灶亚体积，第二阶段进行跨模态推理以对齐文本与局部区域，并用相对空间坐标和肺叶先验提供解剖引导。在 ReXGroundingCT 基准的官方排行榜上取得整体定位质量的最优性能，代码已公开。
Motivation: 现有端到端方法难以同时学习精确 3D 分割所需的局部特征表示和文本对齐所需的复杂语义理解，导致视觉定位性能次优。
Method: 提出解耦的两阶段框架：第一阶段进行类别无关的病灶分割 (class-agnostic lesion segmentation) 以提取候选亚体积；第二阶段执行密集的跨模态推理，并利用相对空间坐标和肺叶先验等显式解剖引导来解决局部区域的空间歧义。
Result: 在 ReXGroundingCT 基准上，该方法在官方排行榜的整体定位质量上达到当前最优 (state-of-the-art)。
Conclusion: 作者认为将检测与推理解耦是应对 3D 医学视觉定位复杂性的高效范式，并已公开代码供复现。

papers.title: Modeling the response of the marine carbon cycle to extreme CO$_2$ injection events
papers.abstract_en: We explore how the response of a conceptual model of the marine carbon cycle depends on the way in which carbon is injected from the atmosphere. We find that, for single-injection pulses, the threshold amount required for a large response of the excitable system depends on pulse duration but not on its specific form. We do, however, see differences in the number of large transient responses in carbon and, correspondingly, the duration of the response for different pulse shapes. These differences are magnified as the system is pushed towards increased excitability and can be understood in terms of the geometry of an increasingly winding heteroclinic orbit. Inspired by Large Igneous Provinces (LIPs), we also consider random sequences of injection pulses. We find a wide range of possible responses for a given overall amount injected and duration, depending on the mean characteristics of the individual pulses. We also identify a resonance-like "Goldilocks" zone, in which intermediate pulse durations or arrival frequencies produce the largest number of repeated transients, and we test the framework with illustrative scenarios motivated by the Siberian Traps and Columbia River Basalt Group.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用一个海洋碳循环的概念模型（可激系统，excitable system）研究大气CO2注入方式如何影响系统响应。结果表明，单次注入脉冲的触发阈值主要取决于脉冲持续时间而非具体形状，但脉冲形状会影响大幅瞬态响应的次数与持续时间；随机脉冲序列下，给定总注入量和时长可产生很宽的响应范围，并存在类似共振的“Goldilocks”区间。作者还用西伯利亚暗色岩和哥伦比亚河玄武岩群的示意情景检验了该框架。
Motivation: 大规模火山省（Large Igneous Provinces, LIPs）对应的CO2注入事件如何塑造海洋碳循环的瞬态响应尚不清晰；作者希望厘清注入脉冲的时长、形状和序列统计特征对系统响应的影响。
Method: 基于一个海洋碳循环的概念可激系统模型，分别考察单次注入脉冲（变化时长与形状）和随机脉冲序列；并通过逐渐增大的异宿轨道（heteroclinic orbit）几何结构解释响应差异，再以Siberian Traps和Columbia River Basalt Group的示意情景进行测试。
Result: 摘要报告：单脉冲下的大幅响应阈值取决于脉冲时长而非具体形式；脉冲形状影响瞬态响应次数和响应持续时间，且这种差异随系统可激性增强而放大。随机脉冲序列在相同总注入量和时长下产生广泛不同的响应，中间脉冲时长或到达频率对应最多重复瞬态的“Goldilocks”区间。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架可用于理解LIPs驱动下海洋碳循环对CO2注入特征的依赖，并指出响应差异可归结于异宿轨道几何。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Traj-VLN: Learning Pixel-Space Interaction via Autoregressive Trajectory Generation
papers.abstract_en: Benefiting from the powerful priors embedded in large-scale pre-training data and the emerging commonsense reasoning ability, large language models (LLMs) have shown unprecedented generalization capabilities in many research fields. Recently, projecting visual embeddings into the language space via vision-language models (VLMs) to achieve sim-toreal and cross-scene generalization has become a prevailing paradigm in the field of Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE). VLN requires an embodied agent to navigate through unseen environments following natural linguistic instructions. We emphasize that a VLN task can be decomposed into a sequence of sub-tasks, each corresponding to a process of 3D spatial interaction with the environments described by instructions such as "walk to the end of the sofa and turn left." However, such spatial interactions involving moving into the image along the direction of depth sensing are puzzling for VLMs as they were predominantly trained on conversations with RGB images. Rather than incorporating depth or 3D geometric information-which VLMs rarely encounter during pretrainingwe propose an alternative approach: fine-tuning VLMs to learn navigation interactions directly in 2D pixel space through autoregressive trajectory generation. Given a linguistic instruction and historical observations, our model sequentially predicts a series of pixel coordinates, drawing a trajectory from the bottom center of the current observation. While prior work has proved that pixel-goal supervision outperforms learning of discrete actions, our experiments further verify that the supervision of pixel-space trajectory significantly enhances VLN performance. Moreover, we demonstrate that our flagship model achieves state-of-the-art level performance with relatively limited computational resources and training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对连续环境下的视觉语言导航 (VLN-CE) 任务，提出不引入深度或 3D 几何信息，而是通过微调视觉语言模型 (VLM) 在 2D 像素空间中自回归生成轨迹坐标，从而学习导航交互。模型根据语言指令和历史观测，从当前观测底部中心开始顺序预测一系列像素坐标。实验表明像素空间轨迹监督显著提升 VLN 性能，且在有限算力和训练数据下达到接近当前最优的水平。
Motivation: VLN 任务可分解为一系列 3D 空间交互子任务，但 VLM 主要在 RGB 图像对话数据上训练，难以理解沿深度感知方向移动的空间交互；先前工作已证明像素目标 (pixel-goal) 监督优于离散动作学习，本文进一步探索像素空间轨迹监督的价值。
Method: 提出 Traj-VLN：直接微调 VLM，使其根据语言指令和历史观测，通过自回归轨迹生成方式在 2D 像素空间中依次输出一系列像素坐标，从当前观测底部中心开始绘制轨迹，替代引入深度或 3D 几何信息的做法。
Result: 摘要报告，像素空间轨迹监督显著提升 VLN 性能，旗舰模型在相对有限的计算资源和训练数据下达到当前最优水平 (state-of-the-art level)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将导航交互直接建模为 2D 像素空间中的自回归轨迹生成是一种可行的替代方案，可在不引入 VLM 预训练中罕见出现的深度或 3D 信息的情况下提升 VLN-CE 表现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Counterbalancing Hides the Bias: Access-Conditioned Position Lock in Forced-Choice LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Forced-choice probes with counterbalanced orientations are a standard tool for measuring language-model "value dispositions," and a concentration/extremity index over repeated draws is read as how sharply a model commits. We show this estimator is not identifiable at its low end: counterbalancing, meant to remove position bias, instead maps a position-lock (a model returning the same answer letter regardless of content) onto the same near-0.5 signature as genuine neutrality, so "softness" and "non-engagement" cannot be distinguished from a content-independent letter-bias. Across nine models the fraction of position-locked items tracks the index almost perfectly (r=-0.986) - a structural consequence, not a finding: the informative quantity is the residual from that bound, the commitment a model shows on the items it does engage. The three models the index reads as soft are the most position-locked, and the lock resolves under access configurations that permit reasoning (as-deployed CLI -> raw API -> reasoning-enabled), moving the index 0.06->0.63 and 0.34->0.66->0.64 while lock collapses (Opus: 0.61->0.39->0.22); this establishes the low readings as an identifiability failure, not a disposition. The reasoning-enabled reading is not a "true" value either; the point is that the index alone cannot identify commitment at its low end. Access configuration (deployment client, reasoning on/off) is one generator of this failure, shown on two access paths (an Anthropic subscription CLI and a DeepSeek client), and in a frozen benchmark it is confounded with provider. We contribute a position-lock diagnostic that must accompany any concentration reading, and show that a concentration-blind audit risks reporting neutrality where a reasoning-permitting condition yields concentrated choices. The direction-flip component, largely robust to the artifact, still identifies genuine cross-model disagreement.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Substantially revised: reframed around an identifiability result for the counterbalanced concentration index, with access configuration presented as one generator of the failure rather than a separate confound. Code and data are included as ancillary files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究强制选择 (forced-choice) 探测中用于测量语言模型"价值倾向"的集中度指标在低端不可辨识的问题。作者证明，为消除位置偏差而设计的 counterbalancing 会把"位置锁定"（模型总是返回同一答案字母）映射到接近 0.5 的信号，与真正的中立无法区分。通过位置锁定诊断和访问配置变换，作者将低读数识别为辨识失败而非模型倾向，并指出方向翻转分量仍能识别真实的跨模型分歧。
Motivation: 强制选择探测配合 counterbalanced orientations 是测量语言模型价值倾向的标准工具，重复抽取得到的集中度指标被解读为模型的承诺程度；但该估计量在低端不可辨识，"softness"和"非投入"无法与内容无关的字母偏差区分，导致评估可能误报为中立。
Method: 提出一个必须伴随任何集中度读数的位置锁定诊断 (position-lock diagnostic)；将信息量定位为相对于结构性边界的残差，即模型在真正参与的项目上表现出的承诺。通过改变访问配置（as-deployed CLI → raw API → reasoning-enabled）来展示访问配置是失效的一个生成器。
Result: 在九个模型上，位置锁定项目的比例与集中度指数几乎完全相关 (r=-0.986)；被指数判为 soft 的三个模型正是位置锁定最严重的模型。在允许推理的配置下，指数从 0.06 变为 0.63、从 0.34 经 0.66 变为 0.64，同时锁定程度下降（Opus 从 0.61 经 0.39 到 0.22）。
Conclusion: 作者强调指数本身无法在低端识别承诺程度，推理开启下的读数也并非"真实"价值；任何集中度读数都必须附带位置锁定诊断，否则会冒将集中选择误报为中立的审计风险。方向翻转分量对伪影基本稳健，仍可用于识别真实的跨模型分歧。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在九个模型上，位置锁定项目的比例与集中度指数几乎完全相关 (r=-0.986)；被指数判为 soft 的三个模型正是位置锁定最严重的模型。在允许推理的配置下，指数从 0.06 变为 0.63、从 0.34 经 0.66 变为 0.64，同时锁定程度下降（Opus 从 0.61 经 0.39 到 0.22）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调指数本身无法在低端识别承诺程度，推理开启下的读数也并非"真实"价值；任何集中度读数都必须附带位置锁定诊断，否则会冒将集中选择误报为中立的审计风险。方向翻转分量对伪影基本稳健，仍可用于识别真实的跨模型分歧。

papers.title: Tracing the space-time causal origins of Earth system extremes
papers.abstract_en: Identifying the causes of Earth's extremes is challenging because counterfactual experiments are not possible in the observed world. Data-driven causal discovery complements computationally expensive and potentially biased numerical experiments, but existing methods can struggle with undersampled, high-dimensional data and fail to recover multi-timestep, multivariate pathways leading to specific events. We introduce Tracer of Causal Evolutions in Space and Time (TraCE-ST), a probabilistic Lagrangian approach that produces event-conditioned causal trajectories in multivariate gridded data. TraCE-ST recovers known causal drivers and estimates their relative contributions in synthetic experiments and real-world extremes, including the 1991 Mount Pinatubo eruption. TraCE-ST also highlights less-studied drivers, such as orography-driven vorticity for Tropical Storm Debby (2006) and anomalous ocean-surface fluxes for the 2021 Pacific Northwest heatwave. Here, we propose causal tracking as an efficient data-driven framework for synthesizing causal evidence and generating testable hypotheses, complementing association analyses and numerical modeling while accelerating the study of high-impact events.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TraCE-ST，一种概率Lagrangian因果发现方法，用于在多元网格化地球系统数据中追踪事件条件下的时空因果轨迹。该方法在合成实验和真实极端事件（如1991年Pinatubo火山喷发、2006年热带风暴Debby、2021年太平洋西北热浪）中恢复已知驱动因素并估计其相对贡献，同时识别出较少被研究的驱动机制。作者提议将因果追踪作为关联分析和数值建模的补充框架，以加速对高影响事件的研究。
Motivation: 识别地球系统极端事件的原因面临根本障碍：观测世界无法进行反事实实验，而现有数据驱动因果发现方法难以处理欠采样高维数据，也未能恢复导致具体事件的多时间步、多变量因果路径。
Method: 提出TraCE-ST（Tracer of Causal Evolutions in Space and Time），一种概率Lagrangian方法，在多元网格化数据中生成事件条件下的因果轨迹，从而对极端事件进行因果追踪。
Result: 摘要报告，TraCE-ST在合成实验中能够恢复已知因果驱动因素并估计其相对贡献；在真实极端事件中，除重现已知因素外，还识别出较少被研究的驱动因素，包括2006年热带风暴Debby的地形诱发涡度（orography-driven vorticity）和2021年太平洋西北热浪的异常海洋表面通量。
Conclusion: 作者提出将因果追踪作为一种高效的数据驱动框架，用于综合因果证据并生成可检验假设，以补充关联分析和数值建模，从而加速对高影响事件的研究。
Relevance: 55

papers.title: KronQ: LLM Quantization via Kronecker-Factored Hessian
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is a widely adopted technique for compressing large language models (LLMs) without retraining. Most existing second-order PTQ methods, including GPTQ, construct quantization objectives from input activation statistics, effectively assuming that all output channels contribute equally to the layer-wise reconstruction objective. We propose KronQ, a PTQ framework that challenges this assumption by introducing the gradient covariance into the quantization pipeline. Under the Kronecker-factored Hessian approximation, the quantization loss depends jointly on both the activation and gradient covariances, and KronQ exploits this at two complementary levels. (1) KronQ introduces bidirectional incoherence processing, extending the existing input-side random rotation to the output dimension using the gradient covariance, reducing weight magnitude variance across both input and output dimensions. (2) KronQ derives a new sensitivity metric for inter-layer mixed-precision allocation, driven by the gradient and activation Hessian traces. Notably, in the case of 2-bit weight-only quantization on LLaMA-3-70B, while GPTQ and GPTAQ diverge or produce degenerate quantizations (>2000 perplexity on WikiText-2), \KronQ{} achieves 7.93 perplexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KronQ，一个基于 Kronecker 因子化 Hessian 近似的后训练量化 (PTQ) 框架，将梯度协方差引入量化目标，以打破传统方法假设所有输出通道对逐层重构目标贡献相等的做法。KronQ 在输入和输出两个维度上做双向非相干处理 (bidirectional incoherence processing)，并基于梯度和激活 Hessian 迹推导出新的层间混合精度分配灵敏度指标。摘要报告在 LLaMA-3-70B 的 2-bit 仅权重量化中，GPTQ 与 GPTAQ 发散或产生退化量化，而 KronQ 达到 7.93 的 WikiText-2 困惑度。
Motivation: 现有二阶 PTQ 方法（如 GPTQ）仅从输入激活统计构建量化目标，隐含假设所有输出通道对逐层重构目标贡献相等；在低比特（尤其 2-bit）量化场景下该假设不成立，容易导致权重幅度方差过大、量化退化甚至发散。
Method: KronQ 在 Kronecker 因子化 Hessian 近似下，把梯度协方差纳入量化损失，并在两个层面利用它：一是引入双向非相干处理，将已有的输入侧随机旋转扩展到输出维度以降低跨输入和输出维度的权重幅度方差；二是基于梯度和激活 Hessian 迹设计新的层间混合精度分配灵敏度度量。
Result: 在 LLaMA-3-70B 的 2-bit 仅权重量化实验中，摘要报告 GPTQ 和 GPTAQ 发散或产生退化量化（WikiText-2 困惑度超过 2000），而 KronQ 达到 7.93 的困惑度。
Conclusion: 摘要表明在 Kronecker 因子化 Hessian 框架下引入梯度协方差，可显著提升低比特权重量化的稳定性和精度，尤其在 2-bit 等极端压缩条件下有效避免了现有二阶方法的发散问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Super-Resolution of Radar/Raingauge-Analyzed Precipitation Using Gaussian Process Regression with a Steering Kernel
papers.abstract_en: Super-resolution (SR), a technique for estimating a high-resolution (HR) image from a low-resolution image, has been used in meteorology for downscaling and resolution enhancement of observations. SR Gaussian process regression with a steering kernel (SRGP-SK) generates more accurate HR images than the original SR Gaussian process regression (SRGP), but it has not yet been applied to meteorological data. This study applied SRGP-SK to radar/rain gauge-analyzed precipitation for convective and stratiform cases and evaluated the results using the structural similarity index (SSIM) and radially averaged power spectral density (PSD). SRGP-SK achieved SSIM values comparable to those of bicubic interpolation and higher than those of SRGP while reconstructing finer precipitation structures; it recovered variations down to a wavelength of 6 km, compared with 8 km for bicubic interpolation. This difference may correspond to an approximately threefold increase in the number of convective cells. Among the kernel functions compared, the Matern 5/2 kernel yielded the highest geometric mean PSD ratio. Further investigation of this point could identify the statistical scaling characteristics of the precipitation field. This study evaluates only two precipitation cases; examining more cases is necessary before SRGP-SK can be applied more broadly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将带转向核的高斯过程回归超分辨率方法 (SRGP-SK) 首次应用于雷达/雨量计分析降水场，针对对流和层状降水个例，用 SSIM 和径向平均功率谱密度 (PSD) 进行评估。结果表明 SRGP-SK 的 SSIM 与双三次插值相当且高于原始 SRGP，并能重建更细的降水结构，恢复至 6 km 波长的变化，而双三次插值仅到 8 km，对应约三倍的对流单体数量。作者还比较了不同核函数，其中 Matern 5/2 核的几何平均 PSD 比值最高。
Motivation: SRGP-SK 在普通图像上比原始 SRGP 生成更准确的高分辨率图像，但尚未应用于气象数据；该研究将其用于降水场的分辨率增强，以检验其在气象观测超分辨率中的潜力。
Method: 将 SRGP-SK 应用于雷达/雨量计分析降水资料，选取对流与层状两类降水个例，使用结构相似性指数 (SSIM) 和径向平均功率谱密度 (PSD) 定量评估重建质量，并与双三次插值及原始 SRGP 比较，同时比较多种核函数。
Result: SRGP-SK 的 SSIM 与双三次插值相当且高于 SRGP；它能重建低至 6 km 波长的降水变化，而双三次插值只能到 8 km，重建的对流单体数量约为后者的三倍；在核函数比较中，Matern 5/2 核取得最高的几何平均 PSD 比值。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SRGP-SK 能重建更精细的降水结构，但仅评估了两个降水个例，结论的普适性有限，后续需要更多个例检验才能更广泛地应用该方法。
Relevance: 90

papers.title: OpenMHC: Accelerating the Science of Wearable Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Mobile and wearable devices offer an unprecedented opportunity for continuous, passive health monitoring and active health coaching. However, the largest wearable datasets are not publicly available for research, and leading wearable foundation models trained on such datasets are rarely open-weight or come with reproducible training code. To accelerate open science in wearable health, we release OpenMyHeartCounts (OpenMHC), the largest and most comprehensive broadly accessible wearable health dataset to date, released to qualified researchers, alongside open-source implementations of recent wearable foundation models. OpenMHC, derived from over a decade of data collected through the My Heart Counts study app, includes >60 million hours of wearable data across 19 sensor channels (e.g., step count, heart rate, sleep, workouts) and up to 169 linked variables, including health, lifestyle, mood, and behavior from 11,894 consenting participants. Furthermore, we introduce a unified, open benchmark that enables standardized comparison of wearable health models across three tracks: health and behavior downstream prediction, multivariate data imputation, and time-series forecasting. We benchmark classical methods alongside recent wearable and multivariate time series foundation models. By releasing data under broad research access, alongside open-source code and model weights, at this unprecedented scale, we aim to democratize wearable health AI research and enable the community to drive open progress in this domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发布 OpenMHC（OpenMyHeartCounts），一个面向可穿戴健康研究的大规模数据集，包含来自 My Heart Counts 研究应用的逾 6000 万小时可穿戴数据、19 个传感器通道（如步数、心率、睡眠、锻炼）以及 11894 名参与者的 169 个关联变量。同时提供近期可穿戴基础模型的开源实现，并引入一个统一基准，涵盖健康与行为下游预测、多变量数据填补和时间序列预测三个轨道。摘要指出该工作旨在以公开数据、代码和模型权重来加速可穿戴健康 AI 的开源研究。
Motivation: 当前最大的可穿戴数据集不公开，训练在这些数据上的领先可穿戴基础模型也很少开放权重或附带可复现训练代码，阻碍了可穿戴健康领域开放科学的发展。
Method: 释放 OpenMHC 数据集，并提供近期可穿戴基础模型的开源实现；此外建立一个统一开放基准，在健康与行为下游预测、多变量数据填补和时间序列预测三个轨道上标准化比较各类模型，并将经典方法与近期可穿戴及多变量时间序列基础模型一起评测。
Result: 摘要报告数据集规模为超过 6000 万小时、19 个传感器通道、169 个关联变量和 11894 名参与者，并完成了对经典方法与近期基础模型的基准评测，但未给出具体性能数字。
Conclusion: 作者希望通过在空前规模下以广泛研究访问方式发布数据及开源代码与模型权重，实现可穿戴健康 AI 研究民主化，并推动社区在该领域的开放进展。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Optimizing CUDA like a Human: Micro-Profiling Tools as Expert Surrogates for LLM-Based GPU Kernel Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We present KernelPro, a closed-loop multi-agent system that automatically generates, profiles, and iteratively optimizes GPU kernel code by integrating large language model (LLM) code generation with hardware profiler feedback and pluggable bottleneck detection tools. KernelPro introduces four contributions: (1) a semantic feedback operator that encodes expert heuristics as pluggable micro-profiling tools, transforming raw hardware metrics into actionable natural language guidance; (2) a two-stage tool invocation architecture where roofline-based bottleneck classification filters which specialized analysis tools execute, combining kernel-level (ncu), instruction-level (SASS), and system-level (nsys) profiling; (3) a domain-adapted MCTS with progressive widening, asymmetric branching, log-reward calibration, dead-end pruning, and search memory for cross-iteration learning; and (4) direct CuTe source-level code generation via autonomous code search over the CUTLASS/CuTe codebase. On KernelBench, KernelPro achieves geometric mean speedups of 2.42x/4.69x/5.30x on Levels 1/2/3, establishing state-of-the-art performance across all difficulty levels. On VeOmni's expert-optimized MoE training kernels, KernelPro achieves 1.23x over hand-tuned Triton by generating a from-scratch raw-CUDA+CuTe Hopper WGMMA kernel. Ablation studies demonstrate that each design component independently and significantly improves optimization quality: micro-profiling tools (p < 0.0001 vs raw metrics), MCTS search (26% higher geometric mean vs greedy, p = 0.004), and proactive tool orchestration (23% improvement, p = 0.035). Finally, KernelPro is the first CUDA kernel coding agent to optimize energy efficiency beyond the speed-only focus of prior systems, demonstrating an 11.6% measured energy reduction at matched speed.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Decodable but Not Faithful: Coupling Natural-Language Rationales to Programmatic Verifiers
papers.abstract_en: Language models can generate plausible rationales for their predictions, but these explanations may not faithfully represent the model's internal reasoning. We propose verifier-coupled reasoning, a framework that inserts inline claims into reasoning traces and trains an auxiliary consistency head to predict programmatic verifier outputs from rationale-span hidden states. The central finding is a gap between decodability and faithfulness: consistency training reliably makes verifier information decodable from rationale representations, but decodability does not guarantee faithful generation. In LeanCheck (formal theorem proving), rationale-only and proof-only pooling achieve perfect directional separation under counterfactual conflict. In KataGo (Go engine), commentary spans encode 10-way win-rate buckets at 81% accuracy. Yet in a code setting, the model achieves 98.6% coupling while its generated explanations remain unfaithful: fluent prose with correct structured claims, but describing unrelated algorithms; a controlled pretrained-vs-from-scratch comparison shows the gap is not capacity-driven. Synthetic activation patching confirms causal influence (73-89% vs. 31% baseline), FEVER reveals that evidence-only pooling isolates genuine evidence sensitivity at the cost of raw accuracy, and per-claim analysis shows that consistency loss disproportionately benefits fine-grained claims over binary ones. These results establish that consistency losses are effective diagnostics and representation-shaping tools, but not sufficient conditions for faithful reasoning.
papers.comment: Accepted to the ICML 2026 AI4Math Workshop as a poster
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 verifier-coupled reasoning 框架：在推理轨迹中插入内联断言（inline claims），并训练一个辅助一致性头（consistency head），从 rationale 相关的隐藏状态预测程序化验证器（programmatic verifier）输出。核心发现是 decodability 与 faithfulness 之间存在缺口：一致性训练能让验证器信息从 rationale 表征中可靠解码，但可解码并不保证生成的解释忠实于模型真实推理。在 LeanCheck（形式化定理证明）、KataGo（围棋引擎）与代码任务中进行了验证。
Motivation: 语言模型能生成看似合理的解释，但这些解释未必忠实反映内部推理过程；现有研究缺少将可验证信息与生成解释之间关系显式建模并检验的手段。
Method: 在推理轨迹中插入内联断言，训练辅助一致性头从 rationale 跨度（rationale span）的隐藏状态预测程序化验证器输出；并辅以受控的预训练/从零训练对比、合成激活替换（synthetic activation patching）以及基于 FEVER 的池化分析来剖析可解码性与忠实性之间的关联。
Result: LeanCheck 中 rationale-only 与 proof-only 池化在反事实冲突下实现完美方向分离；KataGo 中解说片段以 81% 准确率编码 10 档胜率区间；代码场景下模型达到 98.6% 的 coupling，但生成解释仍不忠实——描述的是无关算法；合成激活替换显示 73-89% 的因果影响而对 31% 基线；FEVER 中 evidence-only 池化以牺牲原始准确率为代价隔离真正的证据敏感性；逐断言分析表明一致性损失对细粒度断言比对二值断言获益更大。
Conclusion: 作者指出一致性损失是有效的诊断与表征塑形工具，但不是忠实推理（faithful reasoning）的充分条件；decodability 与 faithfulness 之间的缺口稳定存在且并非由模型容量驱动。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Unsupervised Disentanglement Without Compromises : How Functional Orthogonality Enforces Identifiability
papers.abstract_en: This paper explores unsupervised disentangled representation learning from a functional perspective. We define latent concepts as factors that influence observations through locally orthogonal directions, formalized as an orthogonality constraint on the Jacobian of the generative mapping. We prove that this condition yields identifiability of general nonlinear generative models, without requiring statistical independence or causal assumptions, provided the latent domain admits all combinations of factor values. Experiments with orthogonality-regularized normalizing flows empirically confirm the theory, demonstrate reliable recovery of ground-truth factors, and shed light on the success of VAEs. These findings challenge the prevailing impossibility claims for unsupervised disentanglement and provide a principled alternative foundation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从函数视角研究无监督解缠表示学习，将潜在概念定义为通过局部正交方向影响观测的因素，并形式化为生成映射 Jacobian 上的正交约束。作者证明该条件在潜在域允许因子值任意组合时，能保证一般非线性生成模型的可辨识性（identifiability），无需统计独立性或因果假设；正交正则化的归一化流实验验证了理论，并解释 VAE 的成功。
Motivation: 无监督解缠表示学习长期存在不可能性结论，现有方法常依赖统计独立性或因果假设；本文希望提供一个不依赖这些假设的替代理论基础，并解释 VAE 等模型为何在实践中有效。
Method: 从函数视角定义潜在概念为通过局部正交方向影响观测的因子，在生成映射的 Jacobian 上施加正交约束；在此条件下证明一般非线性生成模型的可辨识性，并用正交正则化的归一化流（normalizing flows）进行实验验证。
Result: 摘要报告理论证明表明该正交条件足以保证一般非线性模型的可辨识性；实验证实正则化流能可靠恢复真实因子，并揭示了 VAE 成功的原因。
Conclusion: 这些发现挑战了无监督解缠不可实现的普遍论断，为无监督解缠提供了一种有原则的替代基础；但结论的有效范围受限于潜在域需允许因子值所有组合等条件。

papers.title: Placing Degree Scales After LayerNorm
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are widely used to learn node-selection policies on graphs, and most stack graph attention (GAT) blocks with LayerNorm. On degree-sensitive tasks, LayerNorm tends to remove the degree signal these models need to rank nodes. Much recent work addresses this by redesigning normalizers or aggregators, which changes what these components compute but does not ask where, relative to LayerNorm, a degree scale should be applied. In this paper, we show that the answer follows from a single algebraic fact about LayerNorm. When a positive per-node scale is applied before LayerNorm, LayerNorm divides it out, and it never reaches the model's output. Applied after LayerNorm, the same scale comes through and reaches the score head as magnitude. From this placement rule we derive PostDeg, a parameter-free inverse-degree scale that we add as the single change to a fixed GAT backbone. PostDeg multiplies each node's normalized representation by an inverse function of its degree, and we compare it against controls in the same position. At every evaluation size, PostDeg improves over the LayerNorm backbone on influence maximization, network dismantling, and maximum independent set, and these controls show where the improvement comes from. The same scale before LayerNorm stays at the backbone, as the absorption identity predicts, and a constant scale after LayerNorm stays there too on all but the most heavy-tailed graphs, so the effect needs both the position after LayerNorm and a degree-dependent scale. The exact form of the scale matters much less, so we recommend PostDeg, which needs no tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究图神经网络中 LayerNorm 对 degree 信号的移除问题，提出一个简单的代数事实：正的逐节点缩放放在 LayerNorm 之前会被归一化消除，放在之后则能以幅值形式传到输出。基于此提出无参数的 PostDeg，即在固定 GAT 骨干的 LayerNorm 之后乘以节点度的反函数，并在 influence maximization、network dismantling 和 maximum independent set 任务上验证其收益。
Motivation: 在 degree 敏感的任务中，LayerNorm 会抹掉节点排序所需的度信号；现有工作大多重新设计归一化器或聚合器，但没有回答度缩放相对于 LayerNorm 应该放在哪一侧。
Method: 提出放置规则：LayerNorm 之前的正逐节点缩放会被吸收，之后才会保留为幅值。据此在固定 GAT 骨架上仅添加 PostDeg，即在 LayerNorm 后对每个节点的归一化表示乘以节点度的反函数，并与相同位置的对照尺度比较。
Result: 在所有评估规模下，PostDeg 在 influence maximization、network dismantling 和 maximum independent set 上均优于 LayerNorm 骨干；对照显示同一缩放放在 LayerNorm 前不生效、常数额定在 LayerNorm 后除重尾图外也不生效，而缩放的具体形式影响较小。
Conclusion: 效果的来源是‘LayerNorm 之后 + degree 依赖的缩放’这一组合；推荐使用无需调参的 PostDeg。

papers.title: Two-Layer Linear Auto-Regressive Models Estimate Latent States
papers.abstract_en: Auto-regressive models have emerged as powerful tools for sequential data, from language to video. Understanding how and why these models learn latent representations remains an open theoretical question. In this work, we demonstrate that when trained by empirical risk minimization on data from partially observed linear dynamical systems, two-layer linear auto-regressive models naturally learn to approximate Kalman filtering. In particular, we show that the learned hidden representation coincides, up to a similarity transformation, with the state estimates produced by the optimal (Kalman) filter, even though the model has no explicit knowledge of the underlying dynamics or state. The result follows from three main insights. First, we establish that the Kalman filter is well approximated by an auto-regressive model with bounded truncation error. Second, we show that despite non-convexity, the two-layer optimization landscape is benign, i.e., all stationary points are either strict saddles or global minima. Finally, as our main contributions, we provide finite-sample guarantees on prediction error, parameter estimation error, and latent state recovery. Numerical simulations support the theoretical results and demonstrate that the latent representations of auto-regressive models recover state estimates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上证明，在部分可观测线性动力系统 (partially observed linear dynamical systems) 数据上用经验风险最小化训练的两层线性自回归模型 (two-layer linear auto-regressive models) 会自然地逼近 Kalman 滤波。作者表明，即使模型不知道底层动力学或状态，其学习到的隐表示也将在相似变换意义下与最优 Kalman 滤波器的状态估计一致。论证基于三个要点：Kalman 滤波器可以被自回归模型以有界截断误差逼近；两层优化景观是良性的，所有驻点要么是严格鞍点要么是全局最小值；并给出预测误差、参数估计误差和隐状态恢复的有限样本保证。数值模拟支持理论结果。
Motivation: 自回归模型在语言、视频等序列数据上表现强大，但它们为何以及如何学习潜在表示仍是开放的理论问题；论文针对部分可观测线性动力系统，问自回归模型学到的隐表示是否与最优状态估计(即 Kalman 滤波)对应。
Method: 分析两层线性自回归模型的经验风险最小化训练：先建立 Kalman 滤波器被有限阶自回归模型逼近的截断误差界，再刻画两层优化问题的非凸景观(所有驻点均为严格鞍点或全局最小值)，最后给出预测误差、参数估计误差和隐状态恢复的有限样本统计保证。

papers.title: READER: Dynamic LLM Provenance from Query-Varying Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Existing black-box LLM provenance methods achieve comparability by querying every candidate model with the same diagnostic prompts. In deployment, auditors inherit a different evidence stream: heterogeneous prompt-response traces that arrive incrementally. We formalize dynamic black-box LLM provenance: after enrolling a fixed candidate ecosystem, attribute query-varying interactions at any available evidence budget. READER recovers comparability through a frozen proxy LLM. It projects proxy states aligned with response tokens onto length-normalized DC and first-AC modes, capturing response-wide activation location and coarse trajectory evolution. An enrollment-trained linear probe converts each fingerprint into source evidence, and Bayesian accumulation reuses this evidence unit from one observation to many. We introduce Agent500, containing 50,000 responses from 100 local and API sources to 500 heterogeneous agent prompts. On 100-way attribution, READER reaches $50.4\%$ accuracy from one response and $96.2\%$ from 100, compared with $33.0\%$ and $79.0\%$ for the strongest dynamic baselines. Four distinct proxy families all exceed $94.8\%$ at the latter budget. Controlled response-length and Math100 domain shifts expose the limits of zero-retraining transfer. Component analysis reveals a task-dependent spectral division of labor: DC dominates dynamic source identity, while first AC dominates static relationship evidence. Their joint fingerprint provides a shared measurement space for both tasks. READER audits observed text without target internals or audit-only queries. Code and data are available at https://github.com/LeoJeshua/READER.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出动态黑盒大语言模型来源归属 (dynamic black-box LLM provenance) 问题，并给出 READER 方法：通过冻结的代理 LLM 把 query-varying 的提示-响应轨迹转成可比较的指纹。作者构建含 100 个来源、500 个异质 agent 提示、50,000 条响应的 Agent500 基准；100-way 归属中，单条响应准确率为 50.4%，100 条响应达到 96.2%，超过最强的动态基线。
Motivation: 现有黑盒 LLM 来源归属方法要求审计者用相同的诊断提示查询每个候选模型，而实际部署中审计者获得的是增量到达、异质的提示-响应轨迹。作者希望在不访问目标内部状态、不发起审计专用查询的条件下，从任意可用证据预算的观测文本中完成来源归属。
Method: READER 用冻结的代理 LLM 恢复可比性，将代理状态按响应 token 对齐，并投影到长度归一化的 DC 与 first-AC 模态上，分别刻画响应整体的激活位置和粗略轨迹演化；通过 enrollment 阶段训练的线性探针把指纹转换为来源证据，再用贝叶斯累积 (Bayesian accumulation) 将单个观测的证据单元扩展到多个观测。
Result: 在 100-way 归属任务上，READER 从单条响应达到 50.4% 准确率，从 100 条响应达到 96.2%，而最强动态基线分别为 33.0% 和 79.0%；四种不同代理模型族在 100 条响应预算下均超过 94.8%。组件分析显示 DC 模态主导动态来源身份，first-AC 模态主导静态关系证据；受控响应长度变化和 Math100 域偏移则暴露了零重训练迁移的局限。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 READER 提供了一个共享测量空间，将动态来源身份与静态关系证据统一起来，且无需目标模型内部信息或审计专用查询；同时指出零重训练设置在域偏移和长度变化下存在性能上限。

papers.title: Enhancing AI Interpretability with Localised Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative AI, especially powerful Large Language Models (LLMs), raise concerns over the interpretability, safety and sustainability of these large and opaque AI models. The power of such architectures is derived not only from the scalability of deep neural networks (DNNs), but also massively parallel hardware such as GPU clusters. The diffuse nature of DNNs gives them great function-approximation capability when provided with sufficient training data but imposes a cost in interpretability and computational efficiency. Observing that localised machine learning (ML) models tend to be more interpretable and computationally efficient than DNNs on small datasets, we reason by analogy that similar advantages may apply to specific localised hardware ML architectures. We argue that localised architectures with lower bandwidth but higher expressivity per node have the potential to be fundamentally more interpretable than DNNs running on GPU clusters while remaining competitive for smaller datasets. We then survey the suitability of various hardware ML paradigms for implementing such localised architectures and evaluate their per-node expressivity, energy efficiency and practical maturity of the technology required.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论大规模生成式AI（特别是LLM）引发的可解释性、安全性和可持续性问题，提出一个类比：局部化机器学习模型在小数据集上往往比DNN更可解释且更高效，因此局部化硬件架构（低带宽、高每节点表达性）可能从根本上比在GPU集群上运行的DNN更可解释。作者随后调查多种硬件ML范式对实现此类架构的适用性，并评估每节点表达性（per-node expressivity）、能效和技术成熟度。该文属于概念论证与范式调查，摘要中未见实验基准。
Motivation: 现有大型不透明AI模型（如LLM）依赖GPU集群，虽具有强函数逼近能力，但牺牲了可解释性和计算效率；论文针对这一权衡，探索局部化架构能否提供更可解释的替代方案。
Method: 通过类比推理提出局部化架构可能具备优势，然后对不同硬件ML范式进行适用性调查，按每节点表达性、能效和所需技术的实践成熟度进行评估。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据或基准结果；主要贡献是概念论证以及硬件ML范式的比较框架。
Conclusion: 作者认为局部化、低带宽但高表达性的架构有潜力在可解释性上优于在GPU集群上的DNN，并在较小数据集上保持竞争力，但实现取决于相关技术的成熟度。

papers.title: Skip a Layer or Loop It? Learning Program-of-Layers in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) perform inference by following a fixed depth and order, non-recurrent execution of all layers. We reveal the wide existence of training-free, flexible, dynamic program-of-layers (PoLar), where pretrained layers can be packed as modules and then skipped or looped to form a customized program for each input. For most inputs, substantially shorter program executions can achieve the same or better accuracy, while incorrect predictions of the original LLM can be corrected by alternative programs with fewer layers. These observations indicate that inference admits multiple valid latent computations beyond the standard forward pass. To efficiently achieve PoLar in practice, we propose a lightweight PoLar prediction network, which learns to generate execution programs that dynamically skip or repeat pretrained layers for each input. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that PoLar consistently improves accuracy over standard inference and prior dynamic-depth methods, often while executing fewer layers, and that these gains persist under out-of-distribution evaluation. Our results suggest that fixed-depth execution captures only a narrow subset of an LLM's latent reasoning capacity.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Substantially extends arXiv:2507.07996. Updated DART-Math experiments by removing duplicate examples; conclusions remain unchanged. Code: https://github.com/tianyi-lab/PoLar
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现预训练大语言模型（LLM）中存在训练无关的、灵活的动态程序化层执行（program-of-layers, PoLar）：预训练层可被当作模块，对每个输入跳过或循环执行，从而形成定制程序。对大多数输入，更短的层执行序列可达到相同或更好的精度，且原模型错误预测可被更少层数的替代程序纠正。作者提出轻量级 PoLar 预测网络，根据输入动态生成跳过或重复层的执行程序，在数学推理基准上稳定提升精度，且收益在分布外评测下保持。
Motivation: 标准 LLM 推理按固定深度和顺序非循环地执行所有层，作者认为这种固定深度执行只覆盖了模型潜在推理能力的一小部分，推理实际存在多条有效的潜在计算路径。
Method: 提出 PoLar 预测网络，学习为每个输入生成执行程序，动态跳过或循环预训练层，以替代固定的全层前向传播；该方法无需训练即适用于预训练层，并在此基础上增加轻量预测器。
Result: 在数学推理基准上，PoLar 相比标准推理和既有动态深度方法持续提升准确率，且通常使用更少的层数；在分布外（out-of-distribution）评测下收益仍然保持。
Conclusion: 固定深度执行仅体现 LLM 潜在推理能力的窄子集，动态跳过或循环层的程序化执行是一种可训练、有效的推理范式。

papers.title: Alignment Collapse Under KV Cache Quantization: Diagnosis and Mitigation
papers.abstract_en: Key-value (KV) cache quantization is widely used to reduce Large Language Model (LLM) inference memory, yet existing evaluations solely focus on measuring perplexity and accuracy without assessing the safety impact. In this study, we explore alignment preservation under KV cache quantization. Across eleven instruction-tuned models (3.8B-72B) and five benchmarks (1,894 prompts), we find that low-bit quantization can silently destroy safety alignment: Mistral-7B loses 15.2% of its refusals at only 1.03x perplexity, and no universal safe bit-width exists, with sharp model-specific phase transitions invisible to standard metrics. We identify that the root cause is geometric: safety features occupy a low-dimensional activation subspace 10^2-10^3x more vulnerable to quantization noise than the full representation space perplexity averages over. Inspired by this observation, we propose Per-Channel Reduction (PCR), a diagnostic that classifies each model into one of three mechanistic failure modes: outlier-crushes-safety, where safety lives in non-outlier channels collaterally damaged by outlier-driven scale factors; outlier-as-safety, where safety overlaps outlier channels and finer granularity cannot rescue it; and multi-layer dilution, where safety is distributed across many layers and per-layer fixes fail. PCR predicts the correct mitigation direction on all nine primary models and one held-out model from an independent family using 20 calibration prompts. PCR generalizes across unseen prompts, models, and production quantizers, including KIVI with up to 97.2% recovery, succeeding where attention-based allocation methods fail. The resulting training-free protocol, requiring approximately 35 GPU-minutes, recovers up to 97% of lost alignment at minimal memory overhead, addressing vulnerabilities confirmed in production vLLM serving with FP8 KV cache on NVIDIA GPUs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 KV cache 量化对 LLM 安全对齐（safety alignment）的影响，指出现有评估只关注困惑度和准确率而忽略安全后果。基于 11 个 instruction-tuned 模型（3.8B-72B）和 5 个基准（1,894 个 prompts），作者发现低比特量化会在标准指标几乎不变时静默破坏安全拒绝行为，例如 Mistral-7B 在 1.03x 困惑度下损失 15.2% 的拒绝。根因被归为几何层面：安全特征占据对量化噪声脆弱得多的低维激活子空间。作者提出 Per-Channel Reduction (PCR) 诊断，将模型划分为三种机制性失败模式并预测正确缓解方向；训练无关协议约需 35 GPU 分钟，可恢复最多约 97% 的丢失对齐。
Motivation: KV cache 量化被广泛用于降低 LLM 推理内存，但现有评估只测量困惑度和准确率，未评估其安全影响。低比特量化可能在不同模型上以标准指标不可见的方式静默破坏安全对齐，且不存在通用的安全位宽。
Method: 提出 Per-Channel Reduction (PCR)，一种基于通道分析的诊断方法，将每个模型归类为三种机制性失败模式：outlier-crushes-safety、outlier-as-safety 和 multi-layer dilution。PCR 使用 20 个校准 prompts 预测正确的缓解方向，并形成训练无关的恢复协议，约需 35 GPU 分钟。
Result: 摘要报告 Mistral-7B 在仅 1.03x 困惑度下损失 15.2% 的拒绝；PCR 在全部 9 个主要模型和 1 个独立家族的 held-out 模型上预测正确。该方法跨未见 prompts、模型和包括 KIVI 在内的生产量化器泛化，最高实现 97.2% 恢复，并在生产环境 vLLM 的 FP8 KV cache 服务中恢复最多 97% 的丢失对齐，优于 attention-based allocation 方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调低比特 KV cache 量化可能在标准指标掩盖下静默破坏安全对齐，并论证安全特征存在于对量化噪声更敏感的低维子空间这一几何根因。PCR 提供了无需训练的缓解协议，仅需最小内存开销，其有效性在多个生产量化器上得到验证。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究 KV cache 量化对 LLM 安全对齐（safety alignment）的影响，指出现有评估只关注困惑度和准确率而忽略安全后果。基于 11 个 instruction-tuned 模型（3.8B-72B）和 5 个基准（1,894 个 prompts），作者发现低比特量化会在标准指标几乎不变时静默破坏安全拒绝行为，例如 Mistral-7B 在 1.03x 困惑度下损失 15.2% 的拒绝。根因被归为几何层面：安全特征占据对量化噪声脆弱得多的低维激活子空间。作者提出 Per-Channel Reduction (PCR) 诊断，将模型划分为三种机制性失败模式并预测正确缓解方向；训练无关协议约需 35 GPU 分钟，可恢复最多约 97% 的丢失对齐。
summary_sections.motivation: KV cache 量化被广泛用于降低 LLM 推理内存，但现有评估只测量困惑度和准确率，未评估其安全影响。低比特量化可能在不同模型上以标准指标不可见的方式静默破坏安全对齐，且不存在通用的安全位宽。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调低比特 KV cache 量化可能在标准指标掩盖下静默破坏安全对齐，并论证安全特征存在于对量化噪声更敏感的低维子空间这一几何根因。PCR 提供了无需训练的缓解协议，仅需最小内存开销，其有效性在多个生产量化器上得到验证。

papers.title: SimSD: Simple Speculative Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) LLMs, offering faster inference through parallel or blockwise decoding. However, their masked language modeling formulation remains incompatible with standard token-level speculative decoding, one of the most effective acceleration techniques for AR models. In AR decoding, the causal mask preserves temporally valid token-level contexts, enabling a target model to verify multiple drafted tokens in a single forward pass. In contrast, dLLMs rely on mask tokens and bidirectional attention, causing the effective context to change across denoising steps and preventing direct token-level speculative verification. To bridge this gap, we propose a simple but effective speculative decoding algorithm for diffusion language models, named SimSD, which mainly adopts a plug-and-play masking strategy that equips dLLMs with temporally valid token-level contexts for speculative decoding. Our method explicitly introduces reference tokens from draft-model predictions and designs an attention mask that regulates their interaction with current-step tokens, allowing dLLMs to compute valid logits for drafted tokens in a single forward pass. This restores the key verification ability provided by causal masking in AR models while preserving the parallel decoding advantages of dLLMs. The proposed method is training-free and can be flexibly integrated with other acceleration techniques such as KV cache and blockwise decoding. Experiments on SDAR-family dLLMs across four benchmarks show that our method achieves up to 7.46x higher decoding throughput while maintaining and even improving average generation quality.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, code available at https://github.com/airevo2/SimSD-release
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SimSD，一种针对扩散语言模型(dLLM)的简单推测解码算法。其核心是采用即插即用的掩码策略，为dLLM提供时间上有效的token级上下文，使目标模型能在单次前向传播中验证多个草稿token。该方法无需训练，可与KV cache和块解码等加速技术灵活结合。实验在SDAR系列dLLM上跨四个基准实现最高7.46倍解码吞吐提升，同时保持甚至提升平均生成质量。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型(dLLM)的掩码语言建模公式与标准token级推测解码不兼容：dLLM依赖掩码token和双向注意力，去噪步骤间有效上下文会变化，无法像自回归模型那样通过因果掩码在单次前向传播中直接验证多个草稿token。摘要指出这阻碍了将推测解码这一AR模型最有效的加速技术用于dLLM。
Method: 提出SimSD，采用即插即用掩码策略，显式引入来自草稿模型预测的参考token，并设计注意力掩码来调节这些参考token与当前步token的交互，使dLLM能在单次前向传播中为草稿token计算有效logits。该方法训练免费，并可与其他加速技术如KV cache和块解码集成。
Result: 在SDAR系列dLLM上跨四个基准的实验显示，该方法实现最高7.46倍解码吞吐提升，同时保持甚至提升平均生成质量。
Conclusion: 该方法恢复了AR模型中因果掩码提供的关键验证能力，同时保留dLLM的并行解码优势；训练免费且灵活，能与其他加速技术组合使用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Lagrangian Perturbation Diffusion Steering: Latent Reinforcement Learning for Generative Policies
papers.abstract_en: Behavior cloning with high-capacity generative policies achieves strong imitation performance, but is often limited by demonstration coverage and distribution shift. Direct reinforcement learning fine-tuning can improve performance, but updating large action decoders is frequently unstable and sample inefficient. We propose Lagrangian Perturbation Diffusion Steering (LP-DS), a lightweight adaptation method that improves a frozen generative policy by learning a compact noise-space perturbation before decoding. LP-DS optimizes this perturbation with a Lagrangian trust-region objective, improving downstream value while constraining deviation from the latent prior. Across RoboMimic manipulation, OpenAI Gym locomotion, and Adroit dexterous manipulation benchmarks, LP-DS improves sample efficiency, success, and return while maintaining higher action-space entropy than unconstrained noise-space steering, with return improvements of up to 25% over prior baselines. Additional evaluations with flow-matching backbones, a large vision-language-action model, and physical Franka deployment show that LP-DS is not limited to compact diffusion policies or simulated benchmarks. Project page: https://sites.google.com/view/lp-ds/home.
papers.comment: Accepted as a regular paper at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Lagrangian Perturbation Diffusion Steering (LP-DS)，一种轻量级适配方法，通过学习解码前的紧凑噪声空间扰动来改进冻结的生成式策略 (generative policy)。LP-DS 使用拉格朗日信任域目标优化该扰动，在提升下游价值的同时约束对潜在先验的偏离。在 RoboMimic 操作、OpenAI Gym 运动控制和 Adroit 灵巧操作基准上，LP-DS 提升了样本效率、成功率和回报，相比先前基线回报最高提升 25%，并保持比无约束噪声空间转向更高的动作空间熵。
Motivation: 高容量生成式策略的行为克隆受演示覆盖率和分布偏移限制，而直接对大型动作解码器进行强化学习微调常不稳定且样本效率低。
Method: LP-DS 不更新生成策略本身，而是在解码前学习一个紧凑的噪声空间扰动，并用拉格朗日信任域目标进行优化，兼顾下游价值提升与对潜在先验偏离的约束。
Result: 在 RoboMimic、OpenAI Gym 和 Adroit 基准上，LP-DS 提高样本效率、成功率和回报，回报较先前基线最高提升 25%，且比无约束噪声空间转向保持更高的动作空间熵；额外的 flow-matching 骨干、大型视觉-语言-动作模型和物理 Franka 部署实验表明其不限于紧凑扩散策略或仿真基准。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LP-DS 是一种不限于紧凑扩散策略或仿真环境的生成式策略适配方法，能够以轻量方式提升冻结策略的性能。

papers.title: Towards Understanding Modality Interaction in Multimodal Language Models via Partial Information Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how multimodal large language models use different modalities is important for reliable reasoning. We employ Partial Information Decomposition (PID) as a decision-level lens and introduce Sensory PID, a conditional formulation that conditions on language and separates unique, redundant, and synergistic contributions from video and audio. Applied to omni-modal models, Sensory PID reveals a sensory synergy bottleneck: even on audio-visual fusion tasks, decisions remain dominated by modality-unique information, with stronger reliance on vision. Modality-shuffling interventions support this asymmetry, while layer-wise analysis reveals a visual-first computation pattern and instruction perturbations show that late-stage sensory fusion is conditioned by language. Beyond diagnosis, PID-guided sample reweighting provides initial evidence that local diagnostic signals can improve multimodal reasoning and grounding performance. As reference validation, our vision-language analysis broadly corroborates previously reported decision-level PID patterns across tasks, models, interventions, and layers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Sensory PID，一种以条件方式对 Partial Information Decomposition (PID) 进行决策级分析的框架，通过以语言为条件，将视频与音频对决策的独特（unique）、冗余（redundant）与协同（synergistic）贡献分离。应用于全模态（omni-modal）模型后，摘要报告存在“感官协同瓶颈”：即使在音视频融合任务中，决策仍主要由模态独特信息主导，且对视觉依赖更强。模态打乱干预、逐层分析与指令扰动进一步支持视觉优先的计算模式，并表明后期感官融合受语言调节；此外，PID 引导的样本重加权初步表明局部诊断信号可改善多模态推理与 grounding 性能。作为参考验证，其视觉-语言分析在任务、模型、干预和层级别上大致印证了此前报道的决策级 PID 模式。
Motivation: 可靠推理需要理解多模态大语言模型究竟如何利用不同模态，而现有的决策级 PID 分析缺少以语言为条件的设定，难以区分各模态在语言调制下的独立与协同贡献。
Method: 引入 Sensory PID，即一种以语言为条件的 PID 公式，将视频和音频的独特、冗余、协同信息分开度量，并配合模态打乱干预、逐层分析和指令扰动来检验计算模式；同时将 PID 信号用于样本重加权以改善推理。
Result: 摘要报告称，即使在音视频融合任务上，模型决策仍以模态独特信息为主并明显偏向视觉，呈视觉优先模式；后期感官融合受到语言条件调节。PID 引导的样本重加权为改进多模态推理与 grounding 提供了初步证据，且视觉-语言分析在多个任务、模型、干预和层上复现了已有决策级 PID 模式。
Conclusion: 作者认为决策级 Sensory PID 揭示出全模态模型的认知瓶颈在于协同信息未被充分利用，而局部 PID 信号可以反过来指导训练或推理改进；不过样本重加权带来的提升仍属初步证据，整体工作以诊断分析为主。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Deterministic Horizon: When Extended Reasoning Fails and Tool Delegation Becomes Necessary
papers.abstract_en: Extended chain-of-thought reasoning can degrade performance on deterministic state-tracking tasks, not solely because of preference biases but, on the evidence we present, because of information-theoretic limits in the capacity of decoder-only attention. We present: (1) an Attention Bottleneck analysis providing evidence that total state-tracking capacity in bits is bounded in terms of head count, head dimension, and context length under stated modeling assumptions, and that total capacity is not the binding constraint; (2) a context-dependent error model with a depth-dependent quadratic term in the error exponent; (3) the State-Space Jaccard metric measuring state drift; and (4) a Deterministic Horizon $d^* \in [19, 31]$ (at $α= 0.5$) marking the depth at which unaided accuracy crosses 50%. Across twelve models and eight task domains (including SWE-Bench, WebArena, and SQL-Multi), tool-integrated reasoning reaches 76-94% accuracy versus 17-42% for neural chain-of-thought on PermutationProbe. Fine-tuning on optimal-length traces yields $<$3 percentage-point improvement, supporting an architectural ceiling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究确定性状态追踪任务中扩展链式推理 (chain-of-thought) 反而导致性能下降的现象，并提出证据表明其原因并非偏好偏差，而是 decoder-only attention 在信息论层面的容量限制。作者给出注意力瓶颈分析、带深度相关二次项的上下文相关误差模型、状态漂移度量 State-Space Jaccard，以及确定性视界 (Deterministic Horizon) d*∈[19,31]（α=0.5），在此深度之后无工具辅助的准确率跌破 50%。在 12 个模型和 8 个任务域上的实验显示，工具集成推理在 PermutationProbe 上达到 76-94% 准确率，而神经 CoT 仅为 17-42%。
Motivation: 扩展推理长度并不总是改善结果，在确定性状态追踪任务上甚至可能损害性能；现有解释多归因于偏好偏差，而本文认为存在 decoder-only attention 的信息论容量上限，因此需要明确何时必须将任务委托给外部工具。
Method: 提出四部分分析框架：注意力瓶颈分析在给定建模假设下证明状态追踪容量（以比特计）受头数、头维度和上下文长度约束，且总容量并非限制因素；构造带深度相关二次误差项的上下文相关误差模型；引入 State-Space Jaccard 度量状态漂移；并定义 Deterministic Horizon d* 标识无辅助准确率越过 50% 的深度。
Result: 在 12 个模型、8 个任务域（包括 SWE-Bench、WebArena、SQL-Multi）上，工具集成推理在 PermutationProbe 上达到 76-94% 准确率，而神经 CoT 仅为 17-42%；在最优长度轨迹上微调仅带来小于 3 个百分点的提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为存在架构层面的上限，扩展 CoT 无法通过微调弥补，超过确定性视界后工具委托 (tool delegation) 是必要的。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.motivation: 扩展推理长度并不总是改善结果，在确定性状态追踪任务上甚至可能损害性能；现有解释多归因于偏好偏差，而本文认为存在 decoder-only attention 的信息论容量上限，因此需要明确何时必须将任务委托给外部工具。
summary_sections.method: 提出四部分分析框架：注意力瓶颈分析在给定建模假设下证明状态追踪容量（以比特计）受头数、头维度和上下文长度约束，且总容量并非限制因素；构造带深度相关二次误差项的上下文相关误差模型；引入 State-Space Jaccard 度量状态漂移；并定义 Deterministic Horizon d* 标识无辅助准确率越过 50% 的深度。
summary_sections.result: 在 12 个模型、8 个任务域（包括 SWE-Bench、WebArena、SQL-Multi）上，工具集成推理在 PermutationProbe 上达到 76-94% 准确率，而神经 CoT 仅为 17-42%；在最优长度轨迹上微调仅带来小于 3 个百分点的提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为存在架构层面的上限，扩展 CoT 无法通过微调弥补，超过确定性视界后工具委托 (tool delegation) 是必要的。

papers.title: Persistent Priors, Preserved Targets: A Stroop-Style Paradigm for Lexical Override
papers.abstract_en: Local definitions can assign a familiar word a temporary meaning while its usual associations remain useful elsewhere. We measure interference from those associations with a matched Stroop-style paradigm. A conflict prompt defines doctor as forest and compares forest with the familiar associate hospital. A neutral control replaces doctor with a semantically weak word in both the definition and query while keeping forest and hospital fixed. All 11 model-level means are positive. Aggregate means are also positive for all four conflict families and prompt formats. When no redefinition is present, a stronger preference for the familiar distractor predicts more interference in arbitrary-semantic, polysemy/entity, and domain-definition remappings, while the antonym slope is null. Separately, we patch neutral-control activations into antonym prompts in five 1B-2B models. Patching the defined word, the target word in the definition, and the later query word together restores almost all of the target-minus-distractor margin lost in conflict (normalized recovery R in [0.92,1.06]). Replacing only that target-word activation with a donor from another item reduces recovery in every tested case. Those donor patches also lower the distractor logit, while the contextual target falls much more than under the same-item patch that restores the margin.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种 Stroop 范式的词义覆盖（lexical override）测量方法：局部定义把熟悉词暂时赋予新含义（如把 doctor 定义为 forest），而其原有联想（如 hospital）仍会干扰后续比较。作者在语言模型上报告了跨 11 个模型的干扰效应，并通过激活修补（activation patching）实验表明，同时修补被定义词、定义中的目标词和查询词几乎能完全恢复冲突中丢失的目标减干扰词（target-minus-distractor）边际。
Motivation: 当局部定义给熟悉词赋予临时含义时，该词原有的语义关联仍可能在其它语境中有用并造成干扰，现有方法缺乏对这种干扰的标准化测量手段。
Method: 设计匹配的 Stroop 式范式：冲突提示（conflict prompt）把 doctor 定义为 forest 并与熟悉关联词 hospital 比较，中性对照（neutral control）把定义和查询中的 doctor 替换为语义弱词但保持 forest 与 hospital 不变；此外在五个 1B-2B 模型上对中性对照激活进行 patching，分别替换被定义词、定义目标词和查询词的激活。
Result: 摘要报告所有 11 个模型层面的均值均为正，四个冲突族与提示格式的聚合均值也为正；无重定义时对熟悉干扰词的偏好可预测干扰（反义斜率为 null）。同时修补被定义词、定义目标词和后续查询词的激活可恢复几乎全部损失的目标减干扰词边际（normalized recovery R 在 [0.92,1.06]），而仅替换目标词激活会降低恢复并显著降低干扰词 logit。
Conclusion: 该方法能有效量化词义覆盖干扰，且特定位置 token 的激活修补恢复结果说明干扰机制集中在被定义词、定义目标词和查询词上；摘要未讨论该范式对其它任务或更大模型的泛化范围。

papers.title: How Many Different Outputs Can a Transformer Generate?
papers.abstract_en: We study how we can leverage only a handful of characteristics of a transformer's architecture to closely predict the number of different sequences it can output, both qualitatively and quantitatively. We provide an upper bound depending on the length of the prompt, which we show empirically to be tight up to a factor less than 10, across architectures and model sizes. Our analysis also provides a theoretical explanation for previously observed empirical failures of transformers on simple sequence tasks, such as copying and cramming. Formally, we prove that (i) the maximal length of accessible sequences (those that the transformer can output for some prompt) grows linearly with the prompt length, (ii) beyond a critical threshold, the proportion of accessible sequences decays exponentially with sequence length, and (iii) the linear coefficient relating prompt length to accessible sequence length admits a theoretical upper bound. Notably, these results hold even with unbounded context and computation time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何仅凭 Transformer 架构的少量特征来预测其能输出的不同序列数量，并同时进行定性和定量刻画。作者给出一个依赖于提示词（prompt）长度的上界，并在多种架构和模型规模下经验验证其紧致性（差距小于 10 倍）。理论上证明了可访问序列的最大长度随提示词长度线性增长、超过临界阈值后比例指数衰减，以及该线性系数存在理论上界，且这些结论在无界上下文和计算时间下依然成立。
Motivation: 理解 Transformer 的表达能力边界，并解释此前在复制（copying）和 cramming 等简单序列任务上观察到的经验性失败现象。
Method: 提出仅依赖少量架构特征来预测可输出不同序列数量的上界，并通过覆盖多种架构和模型规模的实验检验该上界的紧致性；同时给出三条形式化定理，分别刻画最大可访问序列长度的线性增长、临界阈值后的指数衰减以及线性系数的理论上界。
Result: 摘要报告该上界经验上紧致，紧致因子小于 10；可访问序列的最大长度随提示词长度线性增长；超过临界阈值后，可访问序列的比例随序列长度指数衰减；线性系数存在可证明的理论上界。
Conclusion: 作者强调这些结果即使在无界上下文和计算时间下也成立，从而为 Transformer 输出序列的多样性提供了定性和定量的理论上限刻画。

papers.title: Efficient and Noise-Tolerant PAC Learning of Multiclass Linear Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Noise-tolerant PAC learning of linear models has been of central interests in machine learning community since the last century. In recent years, many computationally-efficient algorithms have been proposed for the problem of learning linear threshold functions under multiple noise models. Yet, when the problem is considered under multiclass learning settings, i.e. when the number of classes $k$ is at least $3$, it is unknown whether there exist computationally-efficient PAC learning algorithms when the data sets are maliciously corrupted. In this paper, we consider that the marginal distribution is a mixture of bounded variance distributions and the data sets satisfy a margin condition at the same time. We show that there exists a computationally-efficient algorithm that PAC learns multiclass linear classifiers $\{h_w:x\mapsto \arg\max_{y\in[k]}w_y\cdot x, x\in \mathbb{R}^d, w\in\mathbb{R}^{kd}\}$ using at most $O(k^2\cdot (d\log d+\log k))$ samples even under a constant rate of nasty noise. Our algorithm consists of two main ingredients: a cluster-based pruning scheme and a standard multiclass hinge loss minimization program. Even in the special case of binary setting, i.e. $k=2$, our result is strictly stronger than all prior works.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究噪声容忍的多类线性分类器 PAC 学习问题。作者在边际分布为有界方差分布混合且数据满足间隔条件（margin condition）的假设下，证明存在计算高效算法，能以 O(k^2·(d log d + log k)) 个样本在常数率 nasty noise 下学习多类线性分类器。算法由基于聚类的剪枝方案与标准多类 hinge loss 最小化组成，且该结果在二分类特例 k=2 时也严格强于此前工作。
Motivation: 线性阈值函数在多种噪声模型下的高效 PAC 学习已有大量算法，但当类别数 k≥3 且数据被恶意破坏时，是否存在计算高效的多类 PAC 学习算法此前未知。本文针对这一多类设定下的空白提出解决方案。
Method: 假设边际分布为有界方差分布的混合，并要求数据集满足间隔条件。算法包含两个核心部分：基于聚类的剪枝方案（cluster-based pruning scheme）和标准多类 hinge loss 最小化程序，样本复杂度为 O(k^2·(d log d + log k))，可容忍常数率的 nasty noise。
Result: 摘要表明，在所述分布和噪声假设下，存在计算高效算法能以 O(k^2·(d log d + log k)) 个样本 PAC 学习多类线性分类器；即使在二分类 k=2 的特例下，该结果也严格强于所有先前工作。
Conclusion: 本文说明在特定分布与间隔条件下，多类线性分类器在恶意噪声环境中的高效 PAC 学习是可行的。

papers.title: DeltaPrompts: Escaping the Zero-Delta Trap in Multimodal Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Distillation enables compact Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to obtain strong reasoning capabilities, yet the prompts driving this process are typically chosen via simple heuristics or aggregated from off-the-shelf datasets. We reveal a critical inefficiency in this approach: up to 69% of the prompts in standard chart / document reasoning datasets are effectively zero-delta, meaning the teacher and student already induce the exact same answer distribution. Training on these prompts provides minimal learning signal, causing student improvement to rapidly saturate regardless of data scale. To escape the zero-delta trap, we return to first principles: distillation fundamentally minimizes distributional divergence, and thus a prompt is valuable only if it exposes a functional capability gap between the teacher and student. We quantify this gap through answer divergence ($Δ$), demonstrating that non-zero divergence is critical for effective scaling. Building on this insight, we propose a staged synthesis pipeline that repurposes existing datasets as seeds, actively targeting student failure modes to produce better prompts. The result is DeltaPrompts, a diverse dataset of 200k synthetic, high-divergence reasoning problems. We evaluate DeltaPrompts across three distinct settings: on-policy distillation with the target teacher-student pair, transfer to a novel model family without regenerating the data, and off-policy fine-tuning of a non-reasoning model. Across all scenarios, DeltaPrompts drives substantial gains, yielding up to 15% relative improvement even on top of a highly-optimized reasoning model (e.g., Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking) -- averaged over 10 benchmarks spanning chart, document and perception-centric reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）蒸馏中训练提示的选择问题，发现标准图表/文档推理数据集中多达 69% 的提示是 zero-delta，即教师与学生已产生完全相同的答案分布，训练信号极弱。作者提出用答案分歧（answer divergence, Δ）量化师生能力差距，并据此构建分阶段合成流程，生成包含 200k 个高分歧推理问题的 DeltaPrompts 数据集，在多种蒸馏设置下带来持续增益。
Motivation: 现有蒸馏通常用简单启发式或现成数据集挑选提示，但大量提示不会暴露师生差异，导致学生模型性能随数据规模增加迅速饱和。论文回到蒸馏最小化分布散度这一第一性原理，认为只有暴露功能能力差距的提示才具有训练价值。
Method: 提出以答案分歧 Δ 度量教师与学生输出分布之间的差距，并将其作为提示价值的核心判据；在此基础上设计分阶段合成流水线，把现有数据集当作种子，主动针对学生失败模式生成高分歧推理问题，最终得到 DeltaPrompts 数据集。
Result: 在 on-policy distillation、迁移到新模型家族（无需重新生成数据）以及非推理模型的 off-policy fine-tuning 三种设置下，DeltaPrompts 均带来显著提升；即使是在高度优化的推理模型（如 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking）之上，平均也在 10 个图表、文档与感知中心推理基准上取得最高约 15% 的相对改进。
Conclusion: 作者强调非零分歧是蒸馏数据有效扩展的关键条件，并认为针对学生失败模式合成高分歧提示可以进一步提升已有强推理模型的性能；摘要未涉及其他模态或领域的外推结论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Not Just RLHF: Why Alignment Alone Won't Fix Multi-Agent Sycophancy
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based multi-agent pipelines flip from correct to incorrect answers under simulated peer disagreement at rates we term yield, a vulnerability widely attributed to RLHF-induced sycophancy. We test this attribution across four model families and find it largely wrong: pretrained base models exhibit the same substitution pattern as their Instruct variants, averaging higher yield than Instruct. Using activation patching, we localize the corruption to a narrow mid-layer window where attention carries the causal weight and MLP contribution is negligible; patching above this window restores 96% of the clean-to-pressured P(correct) gap. The attack surface decomposes into two independent factors (channel framing and consensus strength) whose interaction produces a 47.5 percentage-point yield gap at majority consensus, preserved across jury sizes $N \in \{4, 5, 6\}$. Two converging activation-space interventions show that pressure suppresses clean-reasoning features rather than activating a new sycophancy circuit. A single correctly-arguing dissenter reduces yield by 54-73 percentage points across all framings tested, whereas the strongest prompt-level defense fails on attack variants outside its design surface. Mitigations should target the mechanism, structured dissent at the pipeline level, rather than prompt-level defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于 LLM 的多智能体流水线在模拟同伴分歧下从正确翻转为错误回答的现象（称为 yield），并检验该现象是否由 RLHF 引发的谄媚 (sycophancy) 导致。作者在四个模型家族上的实验表明该归因基本错误：预训练基础模型与 Instruct 变体呈现相同的替换模式，且平均 yield 更高。通过激活修补 (activation patching) 将破坏定位在狭窄的中层窗口，并分解出两个独立攻击因素（信道框架与共识强度），其交互在多数共识下产生 47.5 个百分点的 yield 差距。
Motivation: 现有观点普遍把 LLM 多智能体流水线在同伴分歧下出错归因于 RLHF 诱导的谄媚，但该归因缺乏系统验证，误导防御策略的制定。
Method: 使用四个模型家族的预训练与 Instruct 变体做对照实验，提出 yield 指标量化分歧导致的正确率翻转；采用激活修补定位因果相关层，并设计两类激活空间干预来检验压力是否抑制正确推理特征；还测试单个正确论据的异议者及多种提示级防御。
Result: 预训练基础模型的平均 yield 高于 Instruct 变体；修补中层窗口上方可恢复 96% 的干净到受压力 P(correct) 差距；多数共识下产生 47.5 个百分点的 yield 差距，在陪审团规模 N ∈ {4,5,6} 中保持；单个正确论据的异议者可将 yield 降低 54-73 个百分点，而最强提示级防御对设计面之外的攻击变体失效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多智能体谄媚不能主要归因于 RLHF，防御应针对底层机制并在流水线层面设计结构化异议 (structured dissent)，而非仅依赖提示级防御。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Coupled Physics-Informed Neural Network for Greenhouse Climate State Reconstruction and Parameter Identification under Sparse Sensor Measurements
papers.abstract_en: Accurate reconstruction of greenhouse climate variables from sparse sensor measurements is essential for intelligent environmental monitoring, automated climate control, and precision agriculture. In practical greenhouse operation, sensor failures, communication interruptions, calibration drift, and measurement noise frequently result in incomplete observations, making reliable estimation of indoor temperature and relative humidity a challenging inverse problem. This paper presents a coupled physics-informed neural network (PINN) for simultaneous reconstruction of greenhouse temperature and relative humidity and identification of unknown physical parameters governing a reduced greenhouse climate model. The framework integrates measurement data with coupled energy- and moisture-balance equations and initial-condition constraints, enabling climate state estimation and parameter identification within a unified learning framework. The methodology is evaluated using real greenhouse measurements under two validation protocols: random interpolation from sparse observations (Experiment A) and chronological temporal extrapolation over an unseen future interval (Experiment B). The proposed PINN is compared with a fully connected neural network, a long short-term memory (LSTM) network, and a gated recurrent unit (GRU) network. Under interpolation, the proposed PINN achieves the highest temperature reconstruction accuracy with an RMSE of $0.4495\,^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ and an $R^2$ value of 0.9636, while simultaneously identifying physically interpretable model parameters. The two protocols provide complementary assessments of greenhouse climate reconstruction under interpolation and temporal extrapolation. The proposed framework provides a practical foundation for intelligent greenhouse monitoring, virtual sensing, digital twins, and automated greenhouse climate management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种耦合物理信息神经网络 (coupled PINN)，从稀疏传感器测量中同时重构温室内的温度与相对湿度，并辨识一个降阶温室气候模型中的未知物理参数。该框架把测量数据与耦合的能量和水分平衡方程及初始条件约束整合进统一学习框架，并使用真实温室数据在两种验证协议下评估：随机插值（实验 A）与面向未见未来时段的按时间外推（实验 B）。与全连接神经网络、LSTM 和 GRU 对比，插值协议下该 PINN 取得最高的温度重构精度，RMSE 为 0.4495°C，R² 为 0.9636，同时辨识出物理解释性强的模型参数。
Motivation: 实际温室运行中传感器故障、通信中断、标定漂移和测量噪声常导致观测不完整，使得从稀疏测量可靠估计室内温度和相对湿度成为一个有挑战性的反问题 (inverse problem)，而这对智能环境监测、自动化气候控制和精准农业至关重要。
Method: 提出耦合的物理信息神经网络，将稀疏测量数据与温室降阶模型的耦合能量平衡方程、水分平衡方程以及初始条件约束相结合，在统一的深度学习框架中同时完成气候状态重构和物理参数辨识。
Result: 在基于真实温室数据的随机插值实验（实验 A）中，所提 PINN 的温度重构 RMSE 为 0.4495°C、R² 为 0.9636，优于全连接神经网络、LSTM 和 GRU；同时还能辨识出物理可解释的模型参数。实验 B 的按时间外推则对未见未来时段的重构能力进行了补充评估。
Conclusion: 作者认为两种验证协议为插值重构和时间外推提供了互补评估，该框架可作为智能温室监测、虚拟传感、数字孪生和自动化温室气候管理的实用基础。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Culturally Situated AI Safety for Youth: Saudi Arabian Perspectives of Youth, Parents and Teachers
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI tools are widely used by youth and have introduced new privacy and safety challenges. While prior research has explored youths safety in GenAI within a Western context, it often overlooks the cultural, religious, and social dimensions of technology use that strongly shape youths digital experiences in countries like Saudi Arabia. To address this gap, this study explores youths (aged 7-17), parents and teachers interactions with GenAI tools and risk perceptions through a non Western lens. We analyzed 736 Reddit psots, and 1,262 X (Twitter) posts, and conducted interviews with 31 Saudi Arabian participants (8 youth, 13 parents, 10 teachers). Our findings highlight context dependent and relational privacy and safety needs of GenAI use from non-Western context, which are often shaped by communal structure and prescribed norms. We found significant risks tied to youths disclosure of personal and family information, which conflict with culturally rooted expectations of modesty, privacy, and honor, particularly when youth seek emotional support from GenAI. These risks are further compounded by socio-economic factors such as cost-saving practices leading to the use of shared GenAI accounts (e.g. ChatGPT) within families or even among strangers. We provide design implications reflecting parents and teachers expectations of how youth should use GenAI. This work lays the groundwork for inclusive, context-sensitive parental controls that adhere to cultural norms and values.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从非西方视角研究沙特阿拉伯 7-17 岁青少年及其家长、教师与生成式 AI（GenAI）工具的互动和风险感知。作者分析了 736 条 Reddit 帖子和 1,262 条 X（Twitter）帖子，并对 31 名沙特参与者（8 名青少年、13 名家长、10 名教师）进行了访谈。研究发现，GenAI 使用的隐私与安全需求是情境化和关系性的，受社群结构和规范塑造；青少年向 GenAI 披露个人及家庭信息会与当地文化中的谦逊、隐私和荣誉观念产生冲突，而省钱导致的共享账户（如共享 ChatGPT）使用进一步加剧风险。
Motivation: 已有关于青少年在生成式 AI 中安全的研究主要基于西方语境，忽略了像沙特阿拉伯这样国家中塑造数字体验的文化、宗教和社会维度。
Method: 采用混合方法：分析 736 条 Reddit 帖子和 1,262 条 X（Twitter）帖子，并对 31 名沙特阿拉伯参与者（8 名青少年、13 名家长、10 名教师）进行访谈。
Result: 研究发现非西方语境下的 GenAI 使用具有情境依赖和关系性的隐私及安全需求，常受社群结构和规定规范影响；青少年披露个人与家庭信息的行为与文化的谦逊、隐私和荣誉期待相冲突，尤其在寻求情感支持时；经济因素（如省钱）导致家庭甚至陌生人之间共享 GenAI 账户（例如 ChatGPT），进一步加重风险。
Conclusion: 作者提出反映家长和教师对青少年 GenAI 使用期望的设计启示，为符合文化规范和价值观的、包容且情境敏感的家长控制（parental controls）奠定基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Safety-Aware Denoiser for Text Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent work on text diffusion models offers a promising alternative to autoregressive generation, but controlling their safety remains underexplored. Existing safety approaches are geared toward autoregressive models and typically rely on post-hoc filtering or inference-time interventions. These are inadequate for effectively addressing safety risks in text diffusion models. We propose the Safety-Aware Denoiser (SAD), a safety-guidance framework in text diffusion models. The SAD modifies the iterative denoising process such that the text sample at the final denoising step is steered toward provably safe regions of the text space. This inference-time method can integrate safety constraints into the denoiser, avoiding computationally expensive retraining of the underlying diffusion model and enabling flexible, lightweight safety guidance. We evaluate the safety of the generated text using the SAD, with respect to hazard taxonomy, memorization, and jailbreak. Experimental results show that SAD substantially reduces unsafe generations while preserving generation quality and fluency, outperforming existing methods. These results demonstrate that our safety guidance during denoising provides an effective and scalable mechanism for enforcing safety in text diffusion models.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 12 figures. Code available at: https://github.com/ParkLabML/SAD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Safety-Aware Denoiser (SAD)，一种面向文本扩散模型 (text diffusion models) 的安全引导框架。SAD 修改迭代去噪过程，使最终去噪步骤输出的文本样本被引导至可证明安全的文本空间区域；该方法属于推理时干预，无需重训练底层扩散模型。实验在 hazard taxonomy、memorization 和 jailbreak 三类安全性评估上显示，SAD 能显著减少不安全生成，同时保持生成质量和流畅度，并优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有文本扩散模型的安全性控制研究不足，而既有安全方法主要面向自回归模型，依赖事后过滤或推理时干预，难以有效处理文本扩散模型的安全风险。
Method: 提出 SAD 安全引导框架，在迭代去噪过程中将安全约束集成进 denoiser，使最终文本样本被引导至可证明安全的文本空间区域；作为推理时方法，避免了对底层扩散模型进行昂贵的重训练。
Result: 在 hazard taxonomy、memorization 和 jailbreak 三类基准上的实验表明，SAD 显著降低不安全生成，同时保持生成质量与流畅度，性能优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在去噪过程中施加安全引导为文本扩散模型提供了一种有效且可扩展的安全强制机制。

papers.title: LAVA: Layered Audio-Visual Anti-tampering Watermarking for Robust Deepfake Detection and Localization
papers.abstract_en: Proactive watermarking offers a promising approach for deepfake tamper detection and localization in short-form videos. However, existing methods often decouple audio and visual evidence and assume that watermark signals remain reliable under real-world degradations, making tamper localization vulnerable to multimodal misalignment and compression distortions. Moreover, existing semi-fragile visual watermarking methods often degrade significantly under codec compression because their embedding bands overlap with compression-sensitive frequency regions. To address these limitations, we propose Layered Audio-Visual Anti-tampering Watermarking (LAVA), a calibration-aware audio-visual watermark fusion framework for deepfake tamper detection and localization. LAVA leverages cross-modal watermark fusion and calibration-aware alignment to preserve consistent and reliable tamper evidence under compression and audio-visual asynchrony, enabling robust tamper localization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LAVA achieves near-perfect detection performance (AP = 0.999), remains robust to compression and multimodal misalignment, and significantly improves tamper localization reliability over existing audio-visual fusion baselines.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LAVA，一种校准感知的音频-视觉水印融合框架，用于短视频深度伪造篡改检测与定位。该方法通过跨模态水印融合与校准感知对齐，应对编解码压缩和音视频异步造成的证据退化。实验表明 LAVA 在检测上达到接近完美的 AP=0.999，并在压缩与多模态错位下保持鲁棒，显著提升篡改定位可靠性。
Motivation: 现有主动水印方法通常解耦音频与视觉证据，并假设水印信号在真实世界退化下始终可靠，导致多模态错位和压缩失真下篡改定位脆弱；同时，半脆弱视觉水印的嵌入频带与压缩敏感频率区域重叠，在编解码压缩下性能显著退化。
Method: 提出 LAVA，一个校准感知的音频-视觉水印融合框架，利用跨模态水印融合和校准感知对齐，在压缩及音频-视觉异步条件下维持一致且可靠的篡改证据，从而支持鲁棒的篡改定位。
Result: 摘要报告 LAVA 在深度伪造检测上达到 AP=0.999，对压缩和多模态错位保持鲁棒，并在篡改定位可靠性上显著超过现有音频-视觉融合基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过跨模态水印融合和校准感知对齐，可以在压缩与音视频异步等现实退化下保持可靠的篡改证据，为鲁棒深度伪造检测与定位提供了有效方案。

papers.title: Hybrid Policy Distillation for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a powerful paradigm for compressing large language models (LLMs), whose effectiveness depends on intertwined choices of divergence direction, optimization strategy, and data regime. We break down the design of existing KD methods and present a unified view that establishes connections between them, reformulating KD as a reweighted log-likelihood objective at the token level. We further propose Hybrid Policy Distillation (HPD), which integrates the complementary advantages of forward and reverse KL to balance mode coverage and mode-seeking, and combines off-policy data with lightweight, approximate on-policy sampling. We validate HPD on long-generation math reasoning as well as short-generation dialogue and code tasks, demonstrating improved optimization stability, computational efficiency, and final performance across diverse model families and scales. The code related to this work is available at https://github.com/zwhong714/Hybrid-Policy-Distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hybrid Policy Distillation (HPD)，将知识蒸馏统一为 token 级重加权对数似然目标，并融合前向与反向 KL 以平衡 mode coverage 与 mode-seeking，同时结合 off-policy 数据与轻量近似 on-policy 采样。摘要称该方法在长生成数学推理及短生成对话、代码任务上，于不同模型家族和规模下提升了优化稳定性、计算效率和最终性能。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 知识蒸馏方法的散度方向、优化策略与数据策略相互纠缠，缺乏统一视角来理解不同方法间的联系与差异。
Method: 先给出统一视角，将蒸馏重构为 token 级重加权对数似然目标；再提出 HPD，整合前向和反向 KL 的互补优势，并混合 off-policy 数据与轻量近似 on-policy 采样。
Result: 在长生成数学推理以及短生成对话和代码任务上，HPD 在不同模型家族和规模下均表现出改进的优化稳定性、计算效率和最终性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 HPD 通过平衡模式覆盖与模式寻求来提升蒸馏效果，且代码已开源；具体数值结果未在摘要中给出。
