papers.title: Certainty Is Redundant: Token Sparsification for Efficient Camouflaged Object Detection with Vision Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Camouflaged object detection (COD) aims to segment objects that closely resemble their surrounding environments. Vision foundation models (VFMs) provide strong transferable representations for COD, but their large-scale architectures and full-token processing incur substantial computational overhead. To address this issue, we propose Certainty-Aware Token Sparsification (CATS) for efficient VFM-based COD. Rather than estimating general token importance, CATS determines whether each token still requires deeper refinement according to its foreground--background certainty. It progressively terminates the independent updates of high-certainty tokens while retaining ambiguous tokens for further reasoning, thereby shortening the active token sequence across encoder stages. Since computational redundancy does not imply informational irrelevance, we further introduce Dual-Path Feature Compensation (DPFC), which separately compresses removed foreground and background tokens into compact certainty-weighted prototypes. Extensive experiments across multiple VFMs, backbone scales, COD architectures, and benchmark datasets show that our method significantly reduces computational cost with only marginal accuracy degradation, suggesting a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off for VFM-based COD. The code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于视觉基础模型 (VFM) 的伪装目标检测 (COD) 计算开销过大的问题，提出 Certainty-Aware Token Sparsification (CATS)：根据每个 token 的前景-背景确定度 (certainty) 决定其是否仍需更深层细化，在编码器各阶段逐步终止高确定度 token 的独立更新并缩短活跃 token 序列。同时引入 Dual-Path Feature Compensation (DPFC)，将被移除的前景和背景 token 分别压缩为确定度加权的紧凑原型。跨多种 VFM、骨干网络规模、COD 架构和基准数据集的实验显示，该方法显著降低计算成本且仅带来轻微精度下降。
Motivation: VFM 为 COD 提供了强迁移表示，但其大规模架构和全 token 处理带来可观的计算开销；现有 token 稀疏化方法估计的是通用 token 重要性，而非判断 token 是否仍需细化，因此冗余计算未被有效消除。
Method: CATS 依据前景-背景确定度判断每个 token 是否仍需要更深层推理，逐步停止高确定度 token 的独立更新而保留模糊 token；DPFC 则把已移除的前景与背景 token 分别压缩为确定度加权的紧凑特征原型，以补偿被剪枝 token 的信息损失。
Result: 在多个 VFM、不同骨干规模、多种 COD 架构及基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法能显著降低计算开销，同时仅造成轻微的精度退化。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法在 VFM-based COD 上取得了有利的精度-效率权衡，并承诺发布代码；摘要未提及具体数值或与特定基线的量化对比。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RankGuide: Tensor-Rank-Guided Routing and Steering for Efficient Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) enhance problem-solving capabilities by generating explicit multi-step chains of thought (CoT) reasoning; however, they incur substantial inference latency and computational overhead. To mitigate this issue, recent works have explored model collaboration paradigms, where small reasoning models (SRMs) generate intermediate reasoning steps to achieve a better accuracy--latency trade-off. Despite recent progress, effectively and efficiently detecting and mitigating SRM failures in collaborative systems remains a key challenge. To address this issue, we analyze SRM inference in both the generated text and hidden-state spaces, and identify three types of failure modes: \textit{overconfidence}, \textit{uncertainty}, and \textit{heavy revalidation}. Building on these insights, we propose \textbf{RankGuide}, a framework that improves the efficiency and effectiveness of SRM--LRM collaboration through tensor-rank-guided routing and steering. Specifically, RankGuide leverages a routing signal that incorporates tensor-rank signals derived from consecutive hidden states to detect when SRMs are likely to fail and selectively invoke LRMs. In addition, we introduce a tensor-rank-filtered steering vector extraction method to modulate the reasoning trajectory of SRMs, thereby improving their generation quality. By improving both routing and steering through tensor-rank signals, RankGuide enables SRM--LRM collaborative systems to achieve more efficient reasoning with fewer steps and improved accuracy. Experiments across three reasoning domains -- mathematics, code generation, and scientific QA -- demonstrate the efficacy of RankGuide in reducing latency by up to $1.75\times$ compared to LRM, while maintaining competitive accuracy relative to prior methods. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/TTTTTTris/RankGuide}{https://github.com/TTTTTTris/RankGuide}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RankGuide，一个基于张量秩（tensor-rank）信号引导路由和转向的框架，用于改进小推理模型（SRM）与大推理模型（LRM）协作的效率。作者在文本和隐藏状态空间中分析 SRM 推理失败模式，归纳为过度自信、不确定性和重度再验证三类，并利用相邻隐藏状态的张量秩信号检测 SRM 何时可能失败，从而选择性调用 LRM；同时提出张量秩过滤的转向向量提取方法来调节 SRM 的推理轨迹。实验覆盖数学、代码生成和科学问答三个推理领域，显示与 LRM 相比可降低最多 1.75 倍延迟，同时保持与既有方法相当的准确率。
Motivation: 大型推理模型（LRM）依赖显式多步思维链（CoT）推理，导致推理延迟和计算开销很大；现有 SRM-LRM 协作范式虽能改善准确率-延迟权衡，但如何在协作系统中有效检测并缓解 SRM 失败仍是一个关键挑战。
Method: 通过分析 SRM 在生成文本和隐藏状态空间中的推理过程，识别出过度自信（overconfidence）、不确定性（uncertainty）和重度再验证（heavy revalidation）三类失败模式；在此基础上提出 RankGuide，利用连续隐藏状态导出的张量秩信号作为路由信号来检测 SRM 可能失败的时刻并有选择地调用 LRM，同时引入张量秩过滤的转向向量提取方法调节 SRM 的推理轨迹。
Result: 在数学、代码生成和科学问答三个推理领域的实验中，RankGuide 相比 LRM 将延迟最多降低约 1.75 倍，并保持与先前方法相当的准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过张量秩信号同时改进路由（routing）和转向（steering），SRM-LRM 协作系统可以用更少的推理步骤实现更高效的推理并改善准确率；代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical PINNs for Scientific Computing: A Multi-GPU Open-Source Framework
papers.abstract_en: We present QPINNACLE, an open-source computational framework for physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that integrates modern training strategies, multi-GPU acceleration, and hybrid quantum-classical architectures within a unified modular workflow. The framework enables systematic evaluation of PINN performance across benchmark problems including 1D hyperbolic conservation laws, incompressible flows, and electromagnetic wave propagation. It supports a range of architectural and training enhancements, including Fourier feature embeddings, random weight factorization, strict boundary condition enforcement, adaptive loss balancing, curriculum training, and second-order optimization strategies, with extensibility to additional methods. We provide a comprehensive benchmark study quantifying the impact of these methods on convergence, accuracy, and computational cost, and analyze distributed data parallel scaling in terms of runtime and memory efficiency. In addition, we extend the framework to hybrid quantum-classical PINNs and derive a formal estimate for circuit-evaluation complexity under parameter-shift differentiation. Results highlight the sensitivity of PINNs to architectural and training choices, confirm their high computational cost relative to classical solvers, and identify regimes where hybrid quantum models offer improved parameter efficiency. QPINNACLE provides a foundation for benchmarking physics-informed learning methods and guiding future developments through quantitative assessment of their trade-offs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QPINNACLE，一个面向物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 的开源计算框架，将多种训练技巧、多 GPU 并行加速与混合量子-经典架构整合进统一模块化流程，并用于 1D 双曲守恒律、不可压缩流动和电磁波传播等基准问题。作者提供了系统基准研究，量化不同架构与训练方法对收敛速度、精度和计算成本的影响，同时分析了数据并行扩展性；还扩展到混合量子-经典 PINN，并给出参数位移求导下电路评估复杂度的形式化估计。
Motivation: PINN 的性能对架构和训练选择高度敏感，但缺少统一、可扩展且支持混合量子-经典架构的基准框架来系统评估这些设计选择及其计算代价。
Method: 设计模块化开源框架 QPINNACLE，支持 Fourier 特征嵌入、随机权重因子化、严格边界条件强制、自适应损失平衡、课程训练、二阶优化等增强方法，并结合分布式数据并行多 GPU 加速；同时扩展混合量子-经典 PINN，推导参数位移微分下的电路评估复杂度估计。
Result: 基准结果显示 PINN 对架构与训练选择敏感，相对经典数值求解器计算成本高；分布式数据并行在运行时间和内存效率上的扩展性被量化；混合量子模型在特定参数区间表现出更好的参数效率。
Conclusion: 作者将 QPINNACLE 定位为物理信息学习方法基准测试与权衡评估的基础设施，强调其可用于指导未来方法开发；摘要未报告具体数值结果，也未提及实际天气或降水类应用。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Controllable Video Object Insertion via Multi-View Priors
papers.abstract_en: Video object insertion places a user-specified object in an existing dynamic scene. Existing methods typically condition generation on text or a single reference image. Consequently, object appearance is underconstrained under viewpoint changes, often leading to identity drift, incorrect foreground-background layering, boundary artifacts, and temporal flickering. In this paper, we propose a video object insertion framework that incorporates multi-view object priors to address these limitations. The framework lifts a 2D reference image into a multi-view representation and uses view-consistent conditioning to provide stable identity guidance and view-adaptive appearance cues. A quality-aware weighting mechanism reduces the influence of noisy or imperfect reconstructed views. We further introduce an Integration-Aware Consistency Module that promotes plausible occlusion, clean boundaries, and temporal continuity. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework improves visual quality, controllability, identity consistency, and foreground-background integration for video object insertion compared to the baseline methods. Project page: https://polarisxq.github.io/MOVI/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个利用多视图先验的可控视频物体插入框架，将2D参考图像提升为多视图表示，借助视图一致的条件提供身份引导与视图自适应外观线索，并引入质量感知加权机制和集成感知一致性模块，以缓解身份漂移、前后景分层错误、边界伪影和时间闪烁问题。实验表明该方法相比基线在视觉质量、可控性、身份一致性和前后景融合上均有提升。
Motivation: 现有视频物体插入方法通常只依赖文本或单张参考图像，在视角变化下物体外观约束不足，导致身份漂移、前后景分层错误、边界伪影和时间闪烁。
Method: 框架先将2D参考图像提升为多视图表示，使用视图一致条件来提供稳定的身份引导和视图自适应外观线索；通过质量感知加权机制降低噪声或欠佳重构视图的影响；并引入集成感知一致性模块（Integration-Aware Consistency Module）促进合理的遮挡、干净边界和时间连续性。
Result: 摘要报告该方法相比基线方法提升了视频物体插入的视觉质量、可控性、身份一致性和前景-背景集成效果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多视图先验与视图一致条件能有效改善视频物体插入中的身份一致性与集成质量，但未提及明显的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Cost of Language: Centroid Erasure Exposes and Exploits Modal Competition in Multimodal Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal language models systematically underperform on visual perception tasks, yet the structure underlying this failure remains poorly understood. We propose centroid replacement, mapping tokens to their nearest K-means centroid and removing within-cluster residual structure, as a controlled probe for modal dependence. Across seven models spanning four architecture families, post-image text replacement costs 4x more accuracy than visual replacement on six BLINK tasks; VPBench and MedBLINK preserve this aggregate ordering. Since text replacement also disrupts the task and answer interface, the gap measures relative dependence. Text centroid contrastive decoding (TCCD) exploits this asymmetry without retraining, recovering up to +16.9% accuracy on an individual task at oracle best-per-task $α_\text{interp}$; every model gains on at least one task, although gains vary across tasks and models. Together, centroid replacement provides a retraining-free audit of modal dependence on labeled data, while TCCD offers a reusable inference-time intervention. Code and artifacts are available at: https://github.com/yahskapar/centroid-erasure
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出质心替换（centroid replacement）方法，通过将token映射到最近的K-means质心并去除簇内残差结构，作为研究多模态语言模型中模态依赖的受控探针。在7个模型、4种架构族、6个BLINK任务上，后图像文本替换比视觉替换的准确率损失高约4倍；基于该不对称性提出的文本质心对比解码（TCCD）无需重训练即可在单个任务上恢复至多+16.9%的准确率。作者称该方法可对模态依赖进行无需重训练的审计，并提供可复用的推理时干预。
Motivation: 多模态语言模型在视觉感知任务上系统性表现不佳，但导致这种缺陷的结构性原因尚不明确，需要一种受控手段来量化模型对文本与视觉模态的依赖程度。
Method: 提出质心替换，将token映射到最近的K-means质心并移除簇内残差结构，以对比文本替换与视觉替换对下游任务的影响；进而提出文本质心对比解码（TCCD），利用文本干扰更强的模态竞争不对称性来增强视觉感知，全程无需重训练。
Result: 在7个模型上，后图像文本替换相比视觉替换在6个BLINK任务中造成约4倍的准确率损失，VPBench和MedBLINK上保持相同的总体排序；TCCD在oracle最佳逐任务α_interp下，单个任务最高提升+16.9%准确率，且每个模型至少在一个任务上有增益，但增益随任务和模型变化。
Conclusion: 质心替换提供了一种无需训练、基于标注数据的模态依赖审计工具，TCCD是可复用的推理时干预手段；但其效果在任务和模型间存在差异。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Collaborative Multi-Agent Scripts Generation for Enhancing Imperfect-Information Reasoning in Murder Mystery Games
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown impressive capabilities in perceptual tasks, yet they degrade in complex multi-hop reasoning under multiplayer game settings with imperfect and deceptive information. In this paper, we study a representative multiplayer task, Murder Mystery Games, which require inferring hidden truths based on partial clues provided by roles with different intentions. To address this challenge, we propose a collaborative multi-agent framework for evaluating and synthesizing high-quality, role-driven multiplayer game scripts, enabling fine-grained interaction patterns tailored to character identities (i.e., murderer vs. innocent). Our system generates rich multimodal contexts, including character backstories, visual and textual clues, and multi-hop reasoning chains, through coordinated agent interactions. We design a two-stage agent-monitored training strategy to enhance the reasoning ability of VLMs: (1) chain-of-thought based fine-tuning on curated and synthetic datasets that model uncertainty and deception; (2) GRPO-based reinforcement learning with agent-monitored reward shaping, encouraging the model to develop character-specific reasoning behaviors and effective multimodal multi-hop inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly boosts the performance of VLMs in narrative reasoning, hidden fact extraction, and deception-resilient understanding. Our contributions offer a scalable solution for training and evaluating VLMs under uncertain, adversarial, and socially complex conditions, laying the groundwork for future benchmarks in multimodal multi-hop reasoning under imperfect information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在多人游戏不完全信息与欺骗信息场景下多跳推理能力退化的问题，以谋杀之谜游戏（Murder Mystery Games）为代表任务，提出协作式多智能体框架来生成高质量、角色驱动的多模态游戏脚本，并设计两阶段 agent 监督训练策略。实验表明该方法显著提升 VLM 在叙事推理、隐藏事实提取和抗欺骗理解上的表现。
Motivation: VLM 在感知类任务上表现优异，但在含不完全信息与欺骗信息的多人游戏设置中，复杂多跳推理能力明显退化；需要一种可扩展的训练与评测方案来模拟这种不确定、对抗和社交复杂的条件。
Method: 提出协作式多智能体框架，通过协调的智能体交互生成包含角色背景、视觉与文本线索以及多跳推理链的丰富多模态上下文；训练采用两阶段策略：先基于链式思考（chain-of-thought）在建模不确定性与欺骗的精选及合成数据上微调，再用带 agent 监控奖励塑形的 GRPO 强化学习，鼓励模型形成角色特定推理行为与有效的多模态多跳推理。
Result: 大量实验显示该方法显著提升 VLM 在叙事推理、隐藏事实提取以及抗欺骗理解方面的性能，摘要未给出具体量化数字。
Conclusion: 该方法为在不确定、对抗和社交复杂条件下训练与评测 VLM 提供了可扩展的方案，并为不完全信息下多模态多跳推理的未来基准奠定基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Symmetry Reveals Layerwise Dynamics: How Transformers Perform In-Context Classification
papers.abstract_en: Transformers can perform in-context classification from a few labeled examples, yet the inference-time algorithm remains opaque. We study multi-class linear classification in the hard no-margin regime and make the computation identifiable by enforcing feature- and label-permutation equivariance at every layer. This enables interpretability while maintaining functional equivalence and yields highly structured weights. From these models we extract an explicit depth-indexed recursion: an end-to-end identified, emergent update rule inside a softmax transformer, to our knowledge the first of its kind. Attention matrices formed from mixed feature-label Gram structure drive coupled updates of training points, labels, and the test probe. The resulting dynamics implement a geometry-driven algorithmic motif, which can provably amplify class separation and yields robust expected class alignment.
papers.comment: appears in the Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从对称性角度研究 Transformer 的上下文分类机制。作者在多类线性分类的困难无间隔 (hard no-margin) 设置下，通过强制每层特征与标签置换等变性 (equivariance) 使计算可识别，得到高度结构化的权重，并从中提取出以深度为索引的显式递归更新规则。该规则由混合特征-标签 Gram 结构形成的注意力矩阵驱动，能够证明性地放大类别分离并实现稳健的期望类别对齐。
Motivation: Transformer 在推理时执行上下文分类的算法仍不透明，现有研究缺乏对内部计算的可识别刻画。作者选择无间隔多类线性分类作为受控场景，希望借助对称性约束让网络内部更新规则变得可解释且可识别。
Method: 该方法强制网络每一层满足特征置换和标签置换等变性，在保持功能等价的同时使计算可识别；随后从训练好的 softmax Transformer 权重中显式提取一个依赖层索引 (depth-indexed) 的递归更新规则。更新由混合特征-标签 Gram 结构构成的注意力矩阵驱动，耦合更新训练点、标签与测试探针。
Result: 摘要报告这是首次在 softmax Transformer 内得到端到端可识别的涌现更新规则；该几何驱动的算法机制可以证明性地放大类别分离，并产生稳健的期望类别对齐 (expected class alignment)。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是：借助对称性约束，softmax Transformer 的上下文分类算法可以被端到端识别为一组几何驱动的层间更新动力学，并能够证明性地改善类别分离。该分析目前设定于无间隔多类线性分类场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Adalina: Adaptive Linear Approximation for the Shapley Value and Beyond
papers.abstract_en: The Shapley value, and its broader family of semi-values, has received much attention in various attribution problems. A fundamental and long-standing challenge is their efficient approximation, since exact computation generally requires an exponential number of utility queries in the number of players $n$. To meet the challenges of large-scale applications, we explore the limits of efficiently approximating semi-values under a $Θ(n)$ space constraint. Building upon a vector concentration inequality, we establish a theoretical framework that enables sharper query complexities for existing unbiased randomized algorithms. Within this framework, we systematically develop a linear-space algorithm that requires $O(\frac{n}{ε^{2}}\log\frac{1}δ)$ utility queries to ensure $P(\|\hat{\boldsymbolφ}-\boldsymbolφ\|_{2}\geqε)\leq δ$ for all commonly used semi-values. In particular, our framework naturally bridges OFA, unbiased kernelSHAP, SHAP-IQ and the regression-adjusted approach, and definitively characterizes when paired sampling is beneficial. Moreover, our algorithm allows explicit minimization of the mean squared error $\mathbb{E}[\|\hat{\boldsymbolφ}-\boldsymbolφ\|_{2}^{2}]$ for each specific utility function. Accordingly, we introduce the first adaptive, linear-time, linear-space randomized algorithm, Adalina, that theoretically achieves improved mean squared error. All of our theoretical findings are experimentally validated. Our code is available at https://github.com/watml/adalina.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Shapley 值及其更广的半值族 (semi-values) 在 Θ(n) 空间约束下的高效近似问题。作者基于向量集中不等式建立理论框架，给出更紧的查询复杂度分析，并提出首个自适应、线性时间线性空间的随机算法 Adalina，能够针对具体效用函数显式最小化均方误差。所有理论结果均经实验验证。
Motivation: Shapley 值精确计算通常需要指数数量的效用查询，大规模应用中的高效近似是一个长期挑战；现有无偏随机算法的查询复杂度分析不够紧，也缺少在 Θ(n) 空间约束下的系统性处理方法。
Method: 建立基于向量集中不等式的理论框架，统一刻画 OFA、unbiased kernelSHAP、SHAP-IQ 与回归调整方法等现有无偏随机算法，并明确配对采样 (paired sampling) 何时有益；在此基础上提出线性空间算法 Adalina，允许对每个效用函数显式最小化均方误差。
Result: 该算法以 O(n/ε² log(1/δ)) 次效用查询保证 P(||φ̂−φ||₂≥ε)≤δ，适用于所有常用 semi-values，并在理论上取得改进的均方误差；摘要称所有理论发现均经实验验证。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架在理论上统一了多种现有近似方法并刻画配对采样的适用条件，Adalina 作为首个自适应线性时间线性空间随机算法实现了更优的均方误差，实验验证支持其理论结论。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该框架在理论上统一了多种现有近似方法并刻画配对采样的适用条件，Adalina 作为首个自适应线性时间线性空间随机算法实现了更优的均方误差，实验验证支持其理论结论。

papers.title: PhyEdit: Towards Real-World Object Manipulation via Physically-Grounded Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Achieving physically accurate object manipulation in image editing is essential for its potential applications in interactive world models. However, existing visual generative models often fail at precise spatial manipulation, resulting in incorrect scaling and positioning of objects. This limitation primarily stems from the lack of explicit mechanisms to incorporate 3D geometry and perspective projection. To achieve accurate manipulation, we develop PhyEdit, an image editing framework that leverages explicit geometric simulation as contextual 3D-aware visual guidance. By combining this plug-and-play 3D prior with joint 2D--3D supervision, our method effectively improves physical accuracy and manipulation consistency. To support this method and evaluate performance, we present a real-world dataset, RealManip-40K, for 3D-aware object manipulation featuring paired images and depth annotations. We also propose ManipEval, a benchmark with multi-dimensional metrics to evaluate 3D spatial control and geometric consistency. Extensive experiments show that our approach outperforms existing methods, including strong closed-source models, in both 3D geometric accuracy and manipulation consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhyEdit，一个面向真实世界物体操作的物理接地图像编辑框架。核心思路是用显式几何模拟作为上下文 3D 感知视觉引导，并结合 2D-3D 联合监督来提升操作的物理准确性和一致性。作者同时构建了带配对图像与深度标注的真实数据集 RealManip-40K，以及用于评估 3D 空间控制和几何一致性的基准 ManipEval。实验表明该方法在 3D 几何准确性和操作一致性上优于现有方法，包括强闭源模型。
Motivation: 现有视觉生成模型在图像编辑中缺乏显式机制引入 3D 几何与透视投影，导致物体缩放和定位不准确，难以实现精确的空间操作。
Method: 开发 PhyEdit 框架，利用即插即用的 3D 先验（显式几何模拟）作为上下文 3D 感知视觉引导，并与 2D-3D 联合监督相结合，改善图像编辑的物理准确性和操作一致性。
Result: 在真实世界数据集 RealManip-40K 上支持训练与评估，并提出带多维指标的 ManipEval 基准。摘要报告该方法在 3D 几何准确性和操作一致性上超过现有方法，包括强闭源模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式 3D 几何模拟作为视觉引导可以显著提升图像编辑中的物理准确性和操作一致性，但未提及具体限制。

papers.title: Multi-objective Evolutionary Merging Enables Efficient Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning models achieve strong performance on complex problems by leveraging long chains of thought, but this deliberate reasoning incurs substantial inference-time cost. The Long-to-Short (L2S) reasoning problem seeks to preserve accuracy while reducing generated tokens. Yet, current training-free model merging approaches rely on brittle, fixed-hyperparameter arithmetic methods that force suboptimal compromises. We introduce \textbf{Evo-L2S}, a multi-objective evolutionary model merging framework that explicitly optimizes accuracy and output length to recover a Pareto front of merged models. To make this search computationally tractable, we propose an entropy-based subset sampling technique that substantially reduces fitness-estimation overhead. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, Evo-L2S reduces reasoning length by over 50\% at the 1.5B and 7B scales while preserving or improving problem-solving accuracy; at 14B, the steeper Pareto front reveals that attainable compression depends on the intrinsic compressibility of the reasoning model. Overall, Evo-L2S shows that reasoning models can be made substantially more concise while preserving strong problem-solving performance.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Evo-L2S，一个多目标进化模型合并框架，用于解决 Long-to-Short (L2S) 推理问题，即在保持准确率的同时减少推理模型生成的 token 数。方法显式优化准确率和输出长度，恢复合并模型的 Pareto 前沿，并用基于熵的子集采样降低适应度评估开销。在六个数学推理基准上，1.5B 和 7B 规模下推理长度减少超过 50% 且准确率保持或提升；14B 规模下可达压缩取决于模型内在可压缩性。
Motivation: 推理模型通过长思维链获得强性能，但推理成本高；现有无训练的模型合并方法依赖固定超参数的算术方法，导致次优折中。
Method: 提出 Evo-L2S，一种多目标进化模型合并框架，显式优化准确率和输出长度以恢复合并模型的 Pareto 前沿，并设计基于熵的子集采样技术大幅降低适应度估计开销。
Result: 在六个数学推理基准上，Evo-L2S 在 1.5B 和 7B 规模下将推理长度减少超过 50%，同时保持或提高问题求解准确率；14B 规模下更陡峭的 Pareto 前沿表明可达到的压缩程度取决于推理模型的内在可压缩性。
Conclusion: Evo-L2S 表明推理模型可以在显著更简洁的同时保持强问题求解性能，但压缩收益与模型规模及内在可压缩性相关。

papers.title: Not All Turns Are Equally Hard: Adaptive Thinking Budgets For Efficient Multi-Turn Reasoning in Agents
papers.abstract_en: As LLM reasoning performance plateaus, improving inference-time compute efficiency is crucial to mitigate overthinking and long thinking traces even for simple queries. Prior approaches including length regularization, adaptive routing, and difficulty-based budget allocation primarily focus on single-turn settings and fail to address the sequential dependencies inherent in multi-turn reasoning. In this work, we formulate multi-turn reasoning as a sequential compute allocation problem and model it as a multi-objective Markov Decision Process. We propose TAB: Turn-Adaptive Budgets, a budget allocation policy trained via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that learns to maximize task accuracy while respecting global per-problem token constraints. Consequently, TAB takes as input the conversation history and learns to adaptively allocate smaller budgets to easier turns and save appropriate number of tokens for the crucial harder reasoning steps. Our experiments on diverse agentic benchmarks demonstrate that TAB achieves a superior accuracy-cost tradeoff saving up to 35% tokens and reducing latency up to 30% while maintaining accuracy over static and off-the-shelf LLM budget baselines. Further, for systems where a plan of all turns is available apriori, we propose TAB All-SubQ, a budget allocation policy that budgets tokens based on the conversation history and entire plan saving up to 40% tokens over baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多轮推理中简单轮次过度思考导致的推理时计算浪费问题，将多轮推理建模为序贯计算分配问题，并提出 Turn-Adaptive Budgets (TAB) 预算分配策略。TAB 通过 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 训练，在满足全局 token 约束的同时最大化任务准确率，依据对话历史为简单轮次分配较小预算、为困难推理步骤保留 token。实验表明 TAB 在多种 agentic 基准上可比静态和现成 LLM 预算基线节省最多 35% 的 token 并降低最多 30% 的延迟，同时保持准确率。
Motivation: 现有推理时计算效率方法（如长度正则化、自适应路由、基于难度的预算分配）主要面向单轮设置，无法处理多轮推理中存在的序贯依赖关系，导致简单查询也会产生冗长思考轨迹。
Method: 将多轮推理形式化为多目标 Markov Decision Process 的序贯计算分配问题，提出 TAB 策略：以对话历史为输入，通过 GRPO 学习在全局 per-problem token 约束下自适应分配各轮预算。另提出 TAB All-SubQ，用于可预先获得完整计划（plan）的系统，基于对话历史和完整计划分配 token。
Result: 在多种 agentic 基准上，TAB 相比静态基线和现成 LLM 预算基线，在保持准确率的同时节省最多 35% 的 token 并降低最多 30% 的延迟；TAB All-SubQ 可额外节省最多 40% 的 token。
Conclusion: 作者认为自适应轮次级预算分配能显著改善多轮推理的准确率-成本权衡，且利用全局计划可进一步提升 token 节省效果。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Characterization of Gaussian Universality Breakdown in High-Dimensional Empirical Risk Minimization
papers.abstract_en: We study high-dimensional convex empirical risk minimization (ERM) under general non-Gaussian data designs. By heuristically extending the Convex Gaussian Min-Max Theorem (CGMT) to non-Gaussian settings, we derive an asymptotic min-max characterization of key statistics, enabling approximation of the mean $μ_{\hatθ}$ and covariance $C_{\hatθ}$ of the ERM estimator $\hatθ$. Specifically, under a concentration assumption on the data matrix and standard regularity conditions on the loss and regularizer, we show that for a test covariate $x$ independent of the training data, the projection $\hatθ^\top x$ approximately follows the convolution of the generally non-Gaussian distribution of $μ_{\hatθ}^\top x$ with an independent centered Gaussian variable of variance $\mathrm{tr}(C_{\hatθ} \mathbb{E}[xx^\top])$. This result clarifies the scope and limits of Gaussian universality for ERMs. Numerical simulations across diverse losses and models are provided to validate our theoretical predictions and qualitative insights.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高维凸经验风险最小化（ERM）在一般非高斯数据设计下的渐近统计特性。作者通过将凸高斯极小极大定理（CGMT）启发式推广到非高斯设定，推导出ERM估计量均值与协方差的渐近min-max刻画，并证明测试投影近似服从非高斯均值投影与独立中心高斯变量卷积的分布。模拟实验验证了理论预测，并阐明了高斯普适性（Gaussian universality）的适用范围与局限。
Motivation: 现有高维ERM的渐近分析大多依赖高斯设计假设，而实际数据往往非高斯；CGMT的适用范围不清楚，缺少对非高斯设定下估计量分布特征的严格刻画。
Method: 将Convex Gaussian Min-Max Theorem（CGMT）启发式扩展到非高斯数据矩阵，在数据矩阵满足浓度假设及损失和正则项满足标准正则性条件下，推导估计量均值μ_θ̂和协方差C_θ̂的渐近min-max表征，并得到测试投影的卷积型极限分布。
Result: 摘要报告：对独立测试协变量x，投影θ̂^T x近似服从μ_θ̂^T x分布与独立中心高斯变量（方差为tr(C_θ̂ E[xx^T])）的卷积；数值模拟在多种损失和模型下验证了理论预测。
Conclusion: 该结果界定了非高斯设定下高维ERM中Gaussian universality成立的范围与失效情形，为推广CGMT类分析提供了依据。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Not All Frames Deserve Full Computation: Accelerating Autoregressive Video Generation via Selective Computation and Predictive Extrapolation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models enable long-form video generation but remain expensive due to repeated multi-step denoising. Existing training-free acceleration methods rely on binary cache-or-recompute decisions, overlooking intermediate cases where direct reuse is too coarse yet full recomputation is unnecessary. Moreover, asynchronous AR schedules assign different noise levels to co-generated frames, yet existing methods process the entire valid interval uniformly. To address these AR-specific inefficiencies, we present SCOPE, a training-free framework for efficient AR video diffusion. SCOPE introduces a tri-modal scheduler over cache, predict, and recompute, where prediction via noise-level Taylor extrapolation fills the gap between reuse and recomputation with explicit stability controls backed by error propagation analysis. It further introduces selective computation that restricts execution to the active frame interval. On MAGI-1 and SkyReels-V2, SCOPE achieves up to 4.73x speedup while maintaining quality comparable to the original output, outperforming all training-free baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自回归视频扩散模型（AR video diffusion models）多步去噪带来的高推理成本，提出训练无关（training-free）加速框架 SCOPE。SCOPE 在缓存（cache）、预测（predict）与重算（recompute）之间引入三模态调度，并用基于噪声水平的泰勒外推（noise-level Taylor extrapolation）填补直接复用与完整重算之间的空白，同时通过选择性计算只用活跃帧区间参与执行。在 MAGI-1 和 SkyReels-V2 上，SCOPE 取得最高 4.73 倍加速，同时保持与原始输出相当的质量，并优于所有训练无关基线。
Motivation: 现有训练无关加速方法只做二元的缓存或重算决策，忽略了直接复用过于粗糙但完整重算又无必要的中间情况；此外，异步自回归调度会给共同生成的帧分配不同噪声水平，但现有方法仍对整个有效区间统一处理，造成计算浪费。
Method: 提出 SCOPE，一个训练无关框架，包含三模态调度器（缓存、预测、重算）；预测通过噪声水平泰勒外推实现，并利用误差传播分析提供显式稳定性控制；同时提出选择性计算，将执行限制在活跃帧区间内。
Result: 在 MAGI-1 和 SkyReels-V2 上，SCOPE 实现最高 4.73 倍加速，输出质量与原始结果相当，并超越所有训练无关基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为针对自回归视频扩散的调度特性进行选择性计算与预测外推，可以在不训练的情况下显著加速长视频生成，同时保持质量。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有训练无关加速方法只做二元的缓存或重算决策，忽略了直接复用过于粗糙但完整重算又无必要的中间情况；此外，异步自回归调度会给共同生成的帧分配不同噪声水平，但现有方法仍对整个有效区间统一处理，造成计算浪费。

summary_sections.result: 在 MAGI-1 和 SkyReels-V2 上，SCOPE 实现最高 4.73 倍加速，输出质量与原始结果相当，并超越所有训练无关基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为针对自回归视频扩散的调度特性进行选择性计算与预测外推，可以在不训练的情况下显著加速长视频生成，同时保持质量。

papers.title: Jagle: Building a Large-Scale Japanese Multimodal Post-Training Dataset for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Developing vision-language models (VLMs) that generalize across diverse tasks requires large-scale training datasets with diverse content. In English, such datasets are typically constructed by aggregating and curating numerous existing visual question answering (VQA) resources. However, this strategy does not readily extend to other languages, where VQA datasets remain limited in both scale and domain coverage. In this work, we introduce Jagle, the largest Japanese multimodal post-training dataset to date, comprising approximately 9.2 million instances across diverse tasks. Rather than relying on existing VQA datasets, we collect heterogeneous source data, including images, image-text pairs, and PDF documents, and generate VQA pairs through multiple strategies such as VLM-based QA generation, translation, and text rendering. Experiments demonstrate that a 2.2B model trained with Jagle surpasses InternVL3.5-2B in average score across ten Japanese evaluation tasks and comes within five points of Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct. Moreover, combining Jagle with FineVision improves English performance over training with FineVision alone. These benefits generalize across model backbones and scales: LLM-jp-4-VL 9B beta, a 9B-scale model built on the Japanese-centric LLM-jp-4-8B-instruct, achieves Japanese performance comparable to Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. To facilitate reproducibility and future research, we release the dataset, models, and code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Jagle，目前规模最大的日语多模态后训练数据集，约含 920 万条实例，覆盖多种任务。与依赖现有 VQA 数据集不同，作者从不限于图像、图文对和 PDF 的异构来源收集数据，并通过 VLM 问答生成、翻译和文本渲染等策略构造 VQA 对。实验显示，2.2B 模型在十项日语评测任务上的平均分超过 InternVL3.5-2B，并接近 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct；数据集、模型和代码已公开。
Motivation: 英语环境下的 VLM 训练数据通常通过聚合、整理大量现有 VQA 资源构建，但这一策略难以迁移到其他语言，因为非英语 VQA 数据集的规模和领域覆盖都有限，阻碍了多语言 VLM 的泛化。
Method: 构建 Jagle 数据集：收集图像、图文对和 PDF 文档等异构源数据，再通过 VLM 生成问答、翻译和文本渲染等多种策略自动生成 VQA 对，以获得大规模、多样化的日语后训练数据。
Result: 2.2B 模型在十项日语评测任务上的平均分优于 InternVL3.5-2B，且与 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct 的差距在五分以内；将 Jagle 与 FineVision 结合能提升英语性能；9B 规模的 LLM-jp-4-VL 9B beta 达到与 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 相近的日语性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调该收益在多种模型骨干和规模上均成立，并通过发布数据集、模型和代码支持可复现性和后续研究。

papers.title: Revision or Re-Solving? Decomposing Second-Pass Gains in Multi-LLM Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Multi-LLM revision pipelines, in which a second model reviews and improves a draft produced by a first, are widely assumed to derive their gains from genuine error correction. We question this assumption with a controlled decomposition experiment that uses four matched conditions to separate second-pass gains into three additive components: re-solving, scaffold, and content. We evaluate this design across two model pairs on three benchmarks spanning knowledge-intensive MCQ and competitive programming. Our results show that the gains of multi-LLM revision are not monolithic, but depend on task structure, draft quality, and the type of draft information. On MCQ tasks, where the answer space is constrained and drafts provide little structural guidance, most gains are consistent with stronger-model re-solving, and directly routing queries to the stronger model can be more effective than revising a weak draft. On code generation tasks, however, two-stage prompting remains useful because even semantically null drafts can provide substantial structural scaffolding, while weak draft content can be harmful. Finally, role-reversed experiments show that strong drafts clearly benefit weak reviewers. Ultimately, our findings demonstrate that the utility of multi-LLM revision is dynamically bottlenecked by task structure and draft quality, necessitating more targeted pipeline designs rather than blanket revision strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对“多 LLM 修订管线 (multi-LLM revision pipelines) 的收益来自真正的错误修正”这一常见假设提出质疑，并用四个匹配条件 (matched conditions) 的受控分解实验将二轮收益分解为 re-solving、scaffold 和 content 三个可加成分。研究在两组模型对、三个覆盖知识密集型 MCQ 与竞争性编程的基准上评估该设计，结果显示修订收益并非铁板一块，而是取决于任务结构、草稿质量和草稿信息类型。
Motivation: 多 LLM 修订管线的收益通常被归因于真实错误修正，但这一假设缺乏检验；如果收益实际来自更强模型的重新求解或草稿提供的结构性脚手架，那么直接路由或针对性设计可能比一律修订更有效。
Method: 设计四项匹配条件的受控分解实验，将二轮 (second-pass) 增益分离为 re-solving（重解）、scaffold（脚手架/结构）与 content（内容）三个可加成分；在两组模型对、三个基准（知识密集型 MCQ 与竞争性编程）上评估，并补充角色互换 (role-reversed) 实验验证强草稿对弱评审模型的帮助。
Result: 在 MCQ 任务上，收益大多与更强模型的 re-solving 一致，直接向更强模型路由查询可能比修订弱草稿更有效；在代码生成任务上，两阶段提示仍然有用，因为即使语义上为空的草稿也能提供可观的结构性脚手架，而弱草稿内容可能有害。角色互换实验显示强草稿明显有利于弱评审模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为多 LLM 修订的效用受任务结构与草稿质量动态瓶颈限制，需要更有针对性的管线设计，而非一刀切的修订策略。

papers.title: Critic-Free Deep Reinforcement Learning for Maritime Coverage Path Planning on Irregular Hexagonal Grids
papers.abstract_en: Maritime surveillance missions, such as search and rescue and environmental monitoring, rely on the efficient allocation of sensing assets over vast and geometrically complex areas. Traditional Coverage Path Planning (CPP) approaches depend on decomposition techniques that struggle with irregular coastlines, islands, and exclusion zones, or require computationally expensive re-planning for every instance. We propose a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) framework to solve CPP on hexagonal grid representations of irregular maritime areas. Unlike conventional methods, we formulate the problem as a neural combinatorial optimization task where a Transformer-based pointer policy autoregressively constructs coverage tours. To overcome the instability of value estimation in long-horizon routing problems, we implement a critic-free Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) scheme. This method estimates advantages through within-instance comparisons of sampled trajectories rather than relying on a value function. Experiments on 1,000 unseen synthetic maritime environments demonstrate that a trained policy achieves a 99.1% Hamiltonian success rate, more than double the best heuristic (46.0%), while producing paths 7% shorter and up to 24.1% fewer heading changes than the closest heuristic baseline. All three inference modes (greedy, stochastic sampling, and sampling with 2-opt refinement) operate under 50 ms per instance on a laptop GPU, confirming feasibility for real-time onboard deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于深度强化学习 (DRL) 的覆盖路径规划 (Coverage Path Planning, CPP) 框架，针对不规则海域的六边形网格表示，将问题建模为神经组合优化任务，用基于 Transformer 的指针策略自回归地构造覆盖路径。为克服长视野路由问题中值函数估计的不稳定，作者采用无评论家 (critic-free) 的 Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)，通过实例内采样轨迹比较估计优势。在 1,000 个未见过的合成海事环境上，训练策略达到 99.1% 的 Hamiltonian 成功率，超过最优启发式 (46.0%)，路径缩短 7%，航向变化最多减少 24.1%。
Motivation: 传统 CPP 方法依赖分解技术，难以处理不规则海岸线、岛屿和禁航区，或需要对每个实例进行昂贵重规划，难以满足海上监视任务对传感资源高效分配的需求。
Method: 将 CPP 表述为神经组合优化问题，使用 Transformer 指针策略自回归生成覆盖路径；采用无评论家的 GRPO 替代值函数估计优势，通过同一实例内采样轨迹的组内比较计算优势，从而规避长视野路由中值估计不稳定的问题。
Result: 在 1,000 个未见的合成海事环境上，训练策略的 Hamiltonian 成功率为 99.1%，远高于最佳启发式的 46.0%；路径长度比最近的启发式基线短 7%，航向变化最多减少 24.1%。贪心、随机采样以及带 2-opt 细化的采样三种推理模式在笔记本 GPU 上每实例均低于 50 ms。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架在合成海事环境中验证了实时机载部署的可行性，并表明无评论家 GRPO 结合神经组合优化可有效解决不规则区域的覆盖路径规划问题。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: From Independent to Correlated Diffusion: Generalized Generative Modeling with Probabilistic Computers
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have emerged as a powerful framework for generative tasks in deep learning. They decompose generative modeling into two computational primitives: deterministic neural-network evaluation and stochastic sampling. Current implementations usually place most computation in the neural network, but diffusion as a framework allows a broader range of choices for the stochastic transition kernel. Here, we generalize the stochastic sampling component by replacing independent noise injection with Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) dynamics that incorporate known interaction structure. Standard independent diffusion is recovered as a special case when couplings are set to zero. By explicitly incorporating Ising couplings into the diffusion dynamics, the noising and denoising processes exploit spatial correlations representative of the target system. The resulting framework maps naturally onto probabilistic computers (p-computers) built from probabilistic bits (p-bits), which provide orders-of-magnitude advantages in sampling throughput and energy efficiency over GPUs. We demonstrate the approach on equilibrium states of the 2D ferromagnetic Ising model and the 3D Edwards-Anderson spin glass, showing that correlated diffusion produces samples in closer agreement with MCMC reference distributions than independent diffusion. More broadly, the framework shows that p-computers can enable new classes of diffusion algorithms that exploit structured probabilistic sampling for generative modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将扩散模型中的随机采样环节从独立噪声注入推广为带有已知相互作用结构的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛 (MCMC) 动力学，提出相关扩散 (correlated diffusion)。当耦合设为零时退化为标准独立扩散。该框架天然映射到由概率比特 (p-bits) 构成的概率计算机 (p-computers) 上，并在 2D 铁磁 Ising 模型与 3D Edwards-Anderson 自旋玻璃的平衡态采样中展示了优于独立扩散的样本质量。
Motivation: 现有扩散实现通常把大部分计算放在神经网络中，而随机采样部分往往只使用独立噪声注入；扩散框架本身允许更广泛的随机转移核选择，但这一自由度尚未被充分利用。
Method: 用包含 Ising 耦合的 MCMC 动力学替代独立噪声注入，将已知的空间关联结构显式纳入扩散的加噪与去噪过程，并借助 p-bits 在 p-computers 上实现该采样框架。
Result: 在 2D 铁磁 Ising 模型和 3D Edwards-Anderson 自旋玻璃的平衡态上，相关扩散产生的样本比独立扩散更接近 MCMC 参考分布；同时 p-computers 在采样吞吐量和能效上相较 GPU 具有数量级优势。
Conclusion: 该框架表明 p-computers 可以支撑利用结构化概率采样的一类新型扩散算法，从而扩展扩散模型在生成建模中的应用范围。

papers.title: Design Space of Self--Consistent Electrostatic Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have become widely used tools in atomistic simulations. For much of the history of this field, the most commonly employed architectures were based on short-ranged atomic energy contributions, and the assumption of locality still persists in many modern foundation models. While this approach has enabled efficient and accurate modelling for many use cases, it poses intrinsic limitations for systems where long-range electrostatics, charge transfer, or induced polarization play a central role. A growing body of work has proposed extensions that incorporate electrostatic effects, ranging from locally predicted atomic charges to self-consistent models. While these models have demonstrated success for specific examples, their underlying assumptions, and fundamental limitations are not yet well understood. In this work, we present a framework for treating electrostatics in MLIPs by viewing existing models as coarse-grained approximations to density functional theory (DFT). This perspective makes explicit the approximations involved, clarifies the physical meaning of the learned quantities, and reveals connections and equivalences between several previously proposed models. Using this formalism, we identify key design choices that define a broader design space of self-consistent electrostatic MLIPs. We implement salient points in this space using the MACE architecture and a shared representation of the charge density, enabling controlled comparisons between different approaches. Finally, we evaluate these models on two instructive test cases: metal-water interfaces, which probe the contrasting electrostatic response of conducting and insulating systems, and charged vacancies in silicon dioxide. Our results highlight the limitations of existing approaches and demonstrate how more expressive self-consistent models are needed to resolve failures.

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，将现有的机器学习原子间势 (MLIPs) 视为密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的粗粒度近似，并据此梳理自洽静电 MLIP 的设计空间。作者用 MACE 架构和共享电荷密度表示实现了几种代表性方案，并在金属-水界面和二氧化硅带电空位两个测试案例上评估，结果显示现有方法的局限以及更具表达力的自洽模型的必要性。
Motivation: 大多数主流 MLIP 依赖短程局域原子能量假设，难以处理长程静电、电荷转移和感应极化起核心作用的体系。虽然已有多种引入静电效应的扩展模型，但其隐含假设和基本局限尚未被很好理解。
Method: 以 DFT 粗粒度近似为视角显式化各类模型的近似过程，澄清学习量的物理含义，揭示已有模型之间的联系与等价性；在此基础上识别关键设计选择，并借助 MACE 架构与共享电荷密度表示实现设计空间中的代表性方案以进行受控比较。
Result: 在金属-水界面和 SiO2 带电空位测试中，现有方法在导体与绝缘体静电响应对比以及带电缺陷等场景下暴露失败，需要更富表达力的自洽静电模型才能解决。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架为理解和设计自洽静电 MLIP 提供了系统性视角，并指出现有方法在长程静电起关键作用体系中的根本局限。

papers.title: SimulCost: A Cost-Aware Benchmark and Toolkit for Automating Physics Simulations with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating LLM agents for scientific tasks has focused on token costs while ignoring tool-use costs like simulation time and experimental resources. As a result, metrics like pass@k become impractical under realistic budget constraints. To address this gap, we introduce SimulCost, the first benchmark targeting cost-sensitive parameter tuning in physics simulations. SimulCost compares LLM tuning cost-sensitive parameters against traditional scanning approach in both accuracy and computational cost, spanning 2,643 single-round (initial guess) and 2,304 multi-round (adjustment by trial-and-error) tasks across 11 simulators from fluid dynamics, solid mechanics, and plasma physics, whose costs are analytically defined and platform-independent. A twelfth simulator, a production plasma code measurable only by wall clock, is reported separately. Frontier LLMs achieve 45-62% success rates in single-round mode, dropping to 34-50% under high accuracy requirements, rendering their initial guesses unreliable especially for high accuracy tasks. Multi-round mode improves rates to 66-81%, but LLMs are 1.5-2.7x slower than traditional scanning, making them uneconomical choices. We also investigate parameter group correlations for knowledge transfer potential, and the impact of in-context examples and reasoning effort, providing practical implications for deployment and fine-tuning. We open-source SimulCost as a static benchmark and extensible toolkit to facilitate research on improving cost-aware agentic designs for physics simulations, and for expanding new simulation environments. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Rose-STL-Lab/SimulCost-Bench

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SimulCost，据称是首个面向物理仿真中成本敏感参数调优的基准与工具包，评估 LLM 智能体在以仿真时间等工具使用成本为约束下的表现。基准覆盖 11 个来自流体力学、固体力学和等离子体物理的仿真器，共 2,643 个单轮初始猜测任务和 2,304 个多轮试错调整任务，成本被解析定义且平台无关。结果显示前沿 LLM 单轮成功率为 45-62%，高精度要求下降至 34-50%；多轮模式提升到 66-81%，但 LLM 比传统扫描方法慢 1.5-2.7 倍。作者将 SimulCost 作为静态基准和可扩展工具包开源。
Motivation: 现有对 LLM 科学任务智能体的评估只关注 token 成本，忽略了仿真时间、实验资源等工具使用成本，导致 pass@k 等指标在现实预算约束下不实用。
Method: 构建包含 11 个物理仿真器（涵盖流体力学、固体力学、等离子体物理）的基准 SimulCost，任务分为单轮初始猜测和多轮试错调整两种模式，并以解析定义、平台无关的方式计算成本；另对第十二个只能用墙钟时间测量的生产级等离子体代码单独报告。研究还分析了参数组相关性、上下文示例和推理努力的影响。
Result: 前沿 LLM 在单轮模式下达到 45-62% 成功率，高精度要求下降至 34-50%；多轮模式将成功率提升到 66-81%，但 LLM 耗时是传统扫描方法的 1.5-2.7 倍，经济性较差。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LLM 的初始猜测尤其在高精度任务上不可靠，多轮模式下相比传统扫描也不经济，并为部署和微调提供了实践启示；基准与工具包已开源以促进成本感知智能体设计的研究。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Adversarial Latent-State Training for Robust Policies in Partially Observable Domains
papers.abstract_en: Robustness under latent distribution shift remains challenging in partially observable reinforcement learning. We formalize a focused setting where an adversary selects a hidden initial latent distribution before the episode, termed an adversarial latent-initial-state POMDP. Theoretically, we prove a latent minimax principle, characterize worst-case defender distributions, and derive approximate best-response inequalities with finite-sample concentration bounds that make the optimization and sampling terms explicit. Empirically, using a Battleship benchmark, we demonstrate that targeted exposure to shifted latent distributions reduces average robustness gaps between Spread and Uniform distributions from 10.3 to 3.1 shots at equal budget. Furthermore, iterative best-response training exhibits budget-sensitive behavior that is qualitatively consistent with the theorem-guided diagnostics once one accounts for discounted PPO surrogates and finite-sample noise. Ultimately, we show that for latent-initial-state problems, the framework yields a clean evaluation game and useful theorem-motivated diagnostics while also making clear where implementation-level surrogates and optimization limits enter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究部分可观测强化学习中对潜在分布偏移（latent distribution shift）的鲁棒性，提出对抗性潜在初始状态 POMDP（adversarial latent-initial-state POMDP）的聚焦设定。理论上证明潜在极小极大原理（latent minimax principle）、刻画最坏情形防御分布，并给出近似最佳响应不等式与有限样本集中界。在 Battleship 基准上，定向暴露移位的潜在分布将 Spread 与 Uniform 分布间的平均鲁棒性差距从 10.3 枪降至 3.1 枪（相同预算）；迭代最佳响应训练表现出与定理指导诊断定性一致的预算敏感行为。
Motivation: 部分可观测强化学习中的潜在分布偏移鲁棒性仍未得到很好解决，现有工作缺少对这一对抗性潜在初始状态偏移的清晰形式化与理论分析，论文旨在填补该空白。
Method: 形式化 adversarial latent-initial-state POMDP，证明 latent minimax principle 并刻画最坏情形防御分布，推导近似最佳响应不等式及显式包含优化与采样项的有限样本集中界；实证方面在 Battleship 基准上采用定向暴露的对抗训练与迭代最佳响应训练进行验证。
Result: 在 Battleship 基准中，相同预算下 Spread 与 Uniform 分布的平均鲁棒性差距从 10.3 枪降至 3.1 枪；迭代最佳响应训练在考虑折扣 PPO 替代目标（discounted PPO surrogates）与有限样本噪声后，表现出与理论诊断定性一致的预算敏感行为。
Conclusion: 该框架为潜在初始状态问题提供了清晰的评估博弈和定理驱动的诊断工具，同时明确指出了实现层面替代目标与优化限制介入的环节。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LineGraph2Road: Structural Graph Reasoning on Line Graphs for Road Network Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Extracting routable road networks from satellite imagery requires accurate topology recovery beyond pixel-level segmentation. Recent methods decompose the task into keypoint detection and connectivity prediction, but reliably inferring road connectivity under structural ambiguity remains challenging. Overpasses introduce non-planar crossings that can create false shortcuts, and occlusions break visual continuity, requiring long-range structural reasoning. We formulate road extraction as fully unobserved connectivity inference and construct a global but sparse Euclidean graph from detected keypoints to better leverage the long-term context. To improve link prediction, we transform this graph into its line graph and perform reasoning using a Graph Transformer. We propose an end-to-end pipeline that integrates vision-based segmentation, sparse graph construction, and structured inference. Our method explicitly models overpasses and uses topology-preserving vertex extraction to mitigate routing-critical errors. This approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on City-scale, SpaceNet, and Global-scale benchmarks in topology metrics including TOPO-F1 and APLS. In addition to quantitative gains, our method improves reconstruction of multi-level road structures crucial for real-world routing reliability. The code is available at: https://github.com/wzzzzzzy/LineGraph2Road.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LineGraph2Road，将道路网络提取建模为完全未观测的连通性推理问题，从检测到的关键点构建全局稀疏欧氏图，再变换为线图 (line graph) 并用 Graph Transformer 进行链接预测。方法以端到端管道整合视觉分割、稀疏图构建与结构化推理，显式建模立交桥并使用保持拓扑的顶点提取来减少路由关键错误。在 City-scale、SpaceNet 和 Global-scale 基准上，该方法在 TOPO-F1 与 APLS 等拓扑指标上达到当前最优。
Motivation: 卫星影像中的可路由道路网络提取需要超越像素级分割的精确拓扑恢复；现有方法将任务分解为关键点检测与连通性预测，但立交桥造成的非平面交叉会产生虚假捷径，遮挡还会破坏视觉连续性，可靠的连通性推断需要长程结构推理。
Method: 将道路提取形式化为完全未观测的连通性推断，由检测关键点构造全局但稀疏的欧氏图以利用长程上下文；借鉴线图概念把该图变换为线图后，使用 Graph Transformer 进行关系推理，并设计包含视觉分割、稀疏图构建和结构化推理的端到端管道，配合拓扑保持的顶点提取显式处理立交桥。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 City-scale、SpaceNet、Global-scale 基准上的拓扑指标（TOPO-F1 与 APLS）上取得当前最优性能，并改善对多层级道路结构的重建。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式建模立交桥并采用拓扑保持的顶点提取，可以缓解路由关键错误，提升对真实世界路由可靠性至关重要的多层级道路结构重建。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Predict to Skip: Linear Multistep Feature Forecasting for Efficient Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiT) have emerged as a widely adopted backbone for high-fidelity image and video generation, yet their iterative denoising process incurs high computational costs. Existing training-free acceleration methods rely on feature caching and reuse under the assumption of temporal stability. However, reusing features for multiple steps may lead to latent drift and visual degradation. We observe that model outputs evolve smoothly along much of the diffusion trajectory, enabling principled predictions rather than naive reuse. Based on this insight, we propose \textbf{PrediT}, a training-free acceleration framework that formulates feature prediction as a linear multistep problem. We employ classical linear multistep methods to forecast future model outputs from historical information, combined with a corrector that activates in high-dynamics regions to prevent error accumulation. A dynamic step modulation mechanism adaptively adjusts the prediction horizon by monitoring the feature change rate. Together, these components enable substantial acceleration while preserving generation fidelity. Extensive experiments validate that our method achieves up to $5.54\times$ latency reduction across various DiT-based image and video generation models, while incurring negligible quality degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PrediT，一个面向 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 的免训练加速框架，将模型输出特征的预测建模为线性多步问题。作者观察到扩散轨迹中模型输出沿大部分路径平滑演化，因此用经典线性多步法 (linear multistep methods) 从历史信息预测未来输出，并在高动态区域启用校正器抑制误差累积，同时用动态步长调制机制按特征变化率调整预测范围。实验显示在多种 DiT 图像和视频生成模型上最高可实现 5.54 倍延迟降低，且质量退化可忽略。
Motivation: DiT 在图像和视频生成中迭代去噪过程计算成本高；现有免训练加速方法依赖特征缓存与重用，但跨多步重用特征会导致潜在漂移 (latent drift) 和视觉退化。
Method: 提出 PrediT，将特征预测形式化为线性多步问题，用经典线性多步法基于历史输出预测未来模型输出；引入在高动态区域激活的校正器以避免误差累积，并通过监控特征变化率动态调整预测步长。
Result: 摘要报告在多种基于 DiT 的图像和视频生成模型上最高实现 5.54 倍延迟降低，同时质量退化很小。
Conclusion: 摘要强调沿扩散轨迹的模型输出平滑演化，使得基于历史信息的原理性预测可以替代朴素特征重用，从而实现大幅加速并保持生成保真度。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 PrediT，一个面向 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 的免训练加速框架，将模型输出特征的预测建模为线性多步问题。作者观察到扩散轨迹中模型输出沿大部分路径平滑演化，因此用经典线性多步法 (linear multistep methods) 从历史信息预测未来输出，并在高动态区域启用校正器抑制误差累积，同时用动态步长调制机制按特征变化率调整预测范围。实验显示在多种 DiT 图像和视频生成模型上最高可实现 5.54 倍延迟降低，且质量退化可忽略。
summary_sections.motivation: DiT 在图像和视频生成中迭代去噪过程计算成本高；现有免训练加速方法依赖特征缓存与重用，但跨多步重用特征会导致潜在漂移 (latent drift) 和视觉退化。
summary_sections.method: 提出 PrediT，将特征预测形式化为线性多步问题，用经典线性多步法基于历史输出预测未来模型输出；引入在高动态区域激活的校正器以避免误差累积，并通过监控特征变化率动态调整预测步长。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告在多种基于 DiT 的图像和视频生成模型上最高实现 5.54 倍延迟降低，同时质量退化很小。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调沿扩散轨迹的模型输出平滑演化，使得基于历史信息的原理性预测可以替代朴素特征重用，从而实现大幅加速并保持生成保真度。

papers.title: On the Infinite Width and Depth Limits of Predictive Coding Networks
papers.abstract_en: Predictive coding (PC) is a biologically plausible alternative to standard backpropagation (BP) that minimises an energy function with respect to network activities before updating weights. Recent work has improved the training stability of deep PC networks (PCNs) by leveraging some BP-inspired reparameterisations, but the scalability and theoretical basis of these methods remain unclear. To address this gap, we study the infinite width and depth limits of PCNs. For linear networks, we derive stable and "non-lazy" parameterisations when scaling both the model width and depth, revealing that the output of standard PCNs explodes with width during training. Moreover, under stable parameterisations, we show that the gradients computed by PC at activity equilibrium converge to the BP gradients for networks that are much wider than deep ($depth/width\to0$). Experiments show high gradient alignment between PC and BP at large width for different nonlinear models, including convolutional networks and transformers. Overall, this work constrains the parameterisations that are scalable with PC, while suggesting how BP could be implemented using only local updates in much wider than deep networks like the brain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究预测编码网络（PCNs）在无限宽度和深度极限下的理论行为。对线性网络，作者推导出稳定且“非懒惰”（non-lazy）的参数化，并发现标准 PCN 的输出在训练中会随宽度爆炸。在稳定参数化下，当网络远宽于深（depth/width→0）时，PC 在活动平衡（activity equilibrium）处计算的梯度收敛到 BP 梯度。实验在卷积网络和 Transformer 等非线性模型上显示，大宽度下 PC 与 BP 的梯度高度对齐。
Motivation: PC 是标准反向传播（BP）的生物 plausible 替代方案，近期工作通过 BP 启发的重参数化提升了深度 PCN 的训练稳定性，但这些方法的可扩展性和理论基础仍不清晰。作者希望填补对 PCN 在同时增加宽度和深度时行为的理论理解空白。
Method: 从线性网络出发，推导无限宽度和深度极限下的稳定、非懒惰参数化；在稳定参数化下证明 PC 梯度在活动平衡时收敛到 BP 梯度，条件为 depth/width→0；并用卷积网络和 Transformer 等非线性模型进行实验验证梯度对齐。
Result: 摘要报告标准 PCN 的输出在训练中随宽度爆炸；在稳定参数化下，大宽度时 PC 与 BP 的梯度高度对齐，该结论在不同非线性模型上得到实验支持。
Conclusion: 该工作约束了能与 PC 一起扩展的参数化方式，并提示在远宽于深的网络（如大脑）中，BP 可能仅通过局部更新即可实现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Universal One-third Time Scaling in Learning Peaked Distributions
papers.abstract_en: Training large language models (LLMs) is computationally expensive, partly because the loss exhibits slow power-law convergence whose origin remains debatable. Through systematic analysis of toy models and empirical evaluation of LLMs, we show that this behavior can arise intrinsically from the use of softmax and cross-entropy. When learning peaked probability distributions, e.g., next-token distributions, these components generically yield power-law vanishing losses and gradients, regardless of many microscopic details, creating a fundamental optimization bottleneck. This ultimately leads to power-law time scaling of the loss with a universal exponent of $1/3$. Our results provide a mechanistic explanation for observed neural scaling and suggest new directions for improving LLM training efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过玩具模型系统分析和 LLM 经验评估，提出大语言模型训练中损失呈幂律缓慢下降的现象可内生地源于 softmax 与交叉熵的组合。当学习峰值型概率分布（如下一个 token 分布）时，这些组件会普遍产生幂律衰减的损失与梯度，最终导致损失以 1/3 的普适指数随训练时间幂律下降。
Motivation: 训练大语言模型计算成本高昂，部分原因是损失呈现缓慢的幂律收敛，而其起源仍存在争议；本文旨在给出这一现象的机制性解释。
Method: 通过系统分析玩具模型并在真实 LLM 上进行经验评估，将幂律收敛归因于 softmax 与交叉熵在峰值概率分布（peaked distributions）学习中的内在行为，并推导出损失随时间以 1/3 指数幂律标度。
Result: 摘要报告该幂律行为独立于许多微观细节而普遍存在，损失的时间标度具有普适指数 1/3。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果为观察到的神经标度（neural scaling）提供了机制性解释，并为改进 LLM 训练效率指明新方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diving into Kronecker Adapters: Component Design Matters
papers.abstract_en: Kronecker adapters have emerged as a promising approach for fine-tuning large-scale models, enabling high-rank updates through tunable component structures. However, existing work largely treats the component structure as a fixed or heuristic design choice, leaving the dimensions and number of Kronecker components underexplored. In this paper, we identify component structure as a key factor governing the capacity of Kronecker adapters. We perform a fine-grained analysis of both the dimensions and number of Kronecker components. In particular, we show that the alignment between Kronecker adapters and full fine-tuning depends on component configurations. Guided by these insights, we propose Component Designed Kronecker Adapters (CDKA). We further provide parameter-budget-aware configuration guidelines and a tailored training stabilization strategy for practical deployment. Experiments across various architectures and modalities demonstrate the effectiveness of CDKA. Code is available at https://github.com/rainstonee/CDKA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文聚焦 Kronecker adapters 的参数高效微调方法，指出组件结构（Kronecker 组件的维度和数量）是决定其容量与 full fine-tuning 对齐程度的关键因素。作者提出 Component Designed Kronecker Adapters (CDKA)，并给出参数预算感知的配置指南与训练稳定化策略。在多种架构和模态上的实验表明 CDKA 有效，论文已被 ICML 2026 接收。
Motivation: 现有 Kronecker adapters 研究大多把组件结构当作固定或启发式设计，对其维度和数量缺乏系统探索；作者识别出组件结构是控制 Kronecker adapter 容量的关键因素，需要精细分析。
Method: 对 Kronecker 组件的维度和数量进行细粒度分析，揭示其与 full fine-tuning 的 alignment 依赖于组件配置；据此提出 CDKA，并配套参数预算感知的配置指南和针对实际部署的训练稳定化策略。
Result: 摘要报告在多种架构和模态上的实验证实 CDKA 的有效性，但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 组件设计本身显著影响 Kronecker adapters 的容量与对齐效果，参数预算感知的配置和训练稳定化策略有助于实际部署。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond the Node: Clade-level Selection for Efficient MCTS in Automatic Heuristic Design
papers.abstract_en: While Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) shows promise in Large Language Model (LLM) based Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD), it suffers from a critical over-exploitation tendency under the limited computational budgets required for heuristic evaluation. To address this limitation, we propose Clade-AHD, an efficient framework that replaces node-level point estimates with clade-level Bayesian beliefs. By aggregating descendant evaluations into Beta distributions and performing Thompson Sampling over these beliefs, Clade-AHD explicitly models uncertainty to guide exploration, enabling more reliable decision-making under sparse and noisy evaluations. Extensive experiments on complex combinatorial optimization problems demonstrate that Clade-AHD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods while significantly reducing computational cost. The source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/Mriya0306/Clade-AHD.
papers.comment: v2 substantially expands the experimental evaluation with large-scale zero-shot benchmarks, broader baselines, and additional ablation and sensitivity analyses. Code: https://github.com/Mriya0306/Clade-AHD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Clade-AHD，一个针对基于大语言模型(LLM)的自动启发式设计(Automatic Heuristic Design, AHD)中蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)过度开发问题的框架。它用进化枝级别(clade-level)的贝叶斯信念替代节点级点估计，将后代评估聚合成 Beta 分布并通过 Thompson Sampling 显式建模不确定性，从而在稀疏、带噪的评估下更可靠地指导探索。在复杂组合优化问题上的实验表明，Clade-AHD 持续优于现有最先进方法并显著降低计算成本。
Motivation: MCTS 在 LLM 驱动的自动启发式设计中虽有效，但在启发式评估计算预算受限时存在严重的过度开发(over-exploitation)倾向，稀疏且带噪声的评估使得基于点估计的决策不可靠。
Method: 提出 Clade-AHD 框架：将后代节点的评估结果聚合成 Beta 分布以形成 clade-level 贝叶斯信念，并在这类信念上执行 Thompson Sampling，用显式不确定性建模来驱动探索。
Result: 在复杂组合优化问题上的大量实验表明，Clade-AHD 在性能上一致超越最先进方法，同时显著降低计算开销；v2 版本还扩展了大规模零样本基准、更广泛的基线和额外消融与敏感性分析。
Conclusion: 作者认为以 clade-level 贝叶斯信念替代节点级点估计，能更高效地利用受限的启发式评估预算，使 LLM 自动启发式设计中的决策更可靠；代码已公开。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Shattered Compositionality: Counterintuitive Learning Dynamics of Transformers for Arithmetic
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often achieve strong benchmark accuracy yet remain brittle under small distribution shifts. While recent mechanistic studies reveal the discrepancy between LLMs and humans in skill compositions, the learning dynamics of skill acquisition and the role of data distributions remain elusive. In this study, we train transformers on synthetic arithmetic tasks with black-box model-agnostic metrics for analyzing non-human skill compositions. We discover that transformers often acquire skills for arithmetic in reverse order or in parallel instead of human-like sequential rules--a phenomenon we refer to as shattered compositionality. To explain these behaviors, we provide evidence that correlational matching to the training data, rather than causal or procedural composition, shapes learning dynamics. As a consequence, this non-human acquisition creates competition between partially learned skills, producing characteristic mixing errors and weaker robustness under controlled distribution shifts. We further show that the same qualitative behavior persists in modern LLMs and is not mitigated by pure model scaling or scratchpad supervision. Our results highlight a mismatch between training-time skill acquisition and the human-like hierarchical compositions, with implications for reasoning reliability and out-of-distribution robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在合成算术任务上训练transformer，并用黑盒、模型无关的指标分析非人类技能组合，发现技能习得经常以反向或并行顺序发生，而非人类式的顺序规则，作者称之为“shattered compositionality”。证据表明，关联匹配（correlational matching）而非因果或程序组合塑造了学习动态，导致部分习得技能之间的竞争、特征性混合错误，以及受控分布偏移下的弱鲁棒性。该行为在现代LLM中依然存在，单纯扩大模型规模或使用scratchpad监督均不能缓解。
Motivation: LLM通常有强基准准确率，但在小分布偏移下容易失效；已有机制研究揭示LLM与人类在技能组合上的差异，但技能习得的具体学习动态以及数据分布的作用仍不清楚。
Method: 在合成算术任务上训练transformer，采用黑盒的模型无关指标来分析非人类技能组合，考察技能习得顺序与训练数据分布的关系，并在现代LLM、模型缩放和scratchpad监督等条件下检验该行为。
Result: 摘要报告transformer常以反向或并行顺序习得算术技能，而非人类式的顺序规则；学习动态由与训练数据的关联匹配主导，产生部分技能竞争、混合错误和更弱的受控分布偏移鲁棒性；相同定性行为在当代LLM中持续，纯模型缩放和scratchpad监督无法缓解。
Conclusion: 结果显示训练时的技能习得与人类式层级组合之间存在失配，对推理可靠性和分布外鲁棒性有影响。
Relevance: 12

summary_sections.conclusion: 结果显示训练时的技能习得与人类式层级组合之间存在失配，对推理可靠性和分布外鲁棒性有影响。

papers.title: Demystifying Prediction Powered Inference
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning predictions are increasingly used to supplement incomplete or costly-to-measure outcomes in fields such as biomedical research, environmental science, and social science. However, treating predictions as ground truth introduces bias while ignoring them wastes valuable information. Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) offers a principled framework that leverages predictions from large unlabeled datasets to improve statistical efficiency while maintaining valid inference through explicit bias correction using a smaller labeled subset. Despite its potential, the growing PPI variants and the subtle distinctions between them have made it challenging for practitioners to determine when and how to apply these methods responsibly. This paper demystifies PPI by synthesizing its theoretical foundations, methodological extensions, connections to existing statistics literature, and diagnostic tools into a unified practical workflow. Using the MOSAIKS housing price data, we show that PPI variants produce tighter confidence intervals than complete-case analysis, but that double-dipping, i.e. reusing training data for inference, leads to anti-conservative confidence intervals and below-nominal coverage. Under missing-not-at-random mechanisms, all methods, including classical inference using only labeled data, yield biased estimates. We provide a decision flowchart linking assumption violations to appropriate PPI variants, a summary table of representative methods, and practical diagnostic strategies for evaluating core assumptions. By framing PPI as a general recipe rather than a single estimator, this work bridges methodological innovation and applied practice, helping researchers responsibly integrate predictions into valid inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统梳理了预测驱动推断 (Prediction-Powered Inference, PPI) 的理论基础、方法变体、与经典统计文献的联系及诊断工具，并基于 MOSAIKS 房价数据展示不同 PPI 变体的实际表现。摘要指出 PPI 变体相比 complete-case analysis 能产生更紧的置信区间，但重复使用训练数据（double-dipping）会导致置信区间反保守、覆盖率低于名义水平；在 missing-not-at-random 机制下所有方法（包括仅用标注数据的经典推断）都会产生有偏估计。作者提供决策流程图、代表性方法汇总表和核心假设的实用诊断策略，将 PPI 视为通用框架而非单一估计量。
Motivation: 机器学习预测常被用来补充不完整或测量成本高的结果变量，但直接当作真值会引入偏差，而忽略又会浪费信息。PPI 提供了纠偏框架，然而其变体不断增加且差异细微，实践者难以判断何时以及如何负责任地使用这些方法。
Method: 作者通过归纳 PPI 的理论基础、方法扩展、与现有统计文献的联系和诊断工具，将其整合为统一实用工作流；同时利用 MOSAIKS 房价数据开展实证分析，检验 PPI 变体的置信区间表现、double-dipping 的影响以及 missing-not-at-random 下的行为，并给出决策流程图和汇总表。
Result: 在 MOSAIKS 房价数据上，PPI 变体的置信区间比 complete-case analysis 更紧；但 double-dipping（为推断重复使用训练数据）会产生反保守的置信区间并导致覆盖率低于名义水平。在 missing-not-at-random 机制下，包括仅用标注数据的经典推断在内的所有方法都会产生有偏估计。
Conclusion: 作者将 PPI 定位为通用配方而非单一估计量，通过强调假设违背与对应变体的映射、提供诊断策略，帮助研究者负责任地将预测集成到有效推断中。摘要强调实际应用中需警惕数据复用和缺失机制带来的推断失效。

papers.title: IndexTTS 2.5 Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: In prior work, we introduced IndexTTS 2, a zero-shot neural text-to-speech foundation model comprising two core components: a transformer-based Text-to-Semantic (T2S) module and a non-autoregressive Semantic-to-Mel (S2M) module, which together enable faithful emotion replication and establish the first autoregressive duration-controllable generative paradigm. Building upon this, we present IndexTTS 2.5, which significantly enhances multilingual coverage, inference speed, and overall synthesis quality through four key improvements: 1) Semantic Codec Compression: we reduce the semantic codec frame rate from 50 Hz to 25 Hz, halving sequence length and substantially lowering both training and inference costs; 2) Architectural Upgrade: we replace the U-DiT-based backbone of the S2M module with a more efficient Zipformer-based modeling architecture, achieving notable parameter reduction and faster mel-spectrogram generation; 3) Multilingual Extension: We propose three explicit cross-lingual modeling strategies, boundary-aware alignment, token-level concatenation, and instruction-guided generation, establishing practical design principles for zero-shot multilingual emotional TTS that supports Chinese, English, Japanese, and Spanish, and enables robust emotion transfer even without target-language emotional training data; 4) Reinforcement Learning Optimization: we apply GRPO in post-training of the T2S module, improving pronunciation accuracy and natrualness. Experiments show that IndexTTS 2.5 not only supports broader language coverage but also replicates emotional prosody in unseen languages under the same zero-shot setting. IndexTTS 2.5 achieves a 2.28 times improvement in RTF while maintaining comparable WER and speaker similarity to IndexTTS 2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 IndexTTS 2.5 的技术报告，在 IndexTTS 2 基础上从四个方面改进零样本情感语音合成：将语义码率从 50 Hz 降到 25 Hz 以缩短序列长度、用 Zipformer 替换 S2M 模块中的 U-DiT 骨干、提出三种跨语言建模策略以支持中英日西四种语言的情感迁移、并在 T2S 模块后训练中应用 GRPO。实验显示 IndexTTS 2.5 在保持与 IndexTTS 2 相当的 WER 和说话人相似度的同时，RTF 提升 2.28 倍。
Motivation: 先前工作 IndexTTS 2 已实现情感复制与自回归时长可控生成，但其多语言覆盖、推理速度和整体合成质量仍有提升空间，本文目标是在零样本设定下扩展语言支持并降低训练和推理成本。
Method: 提出四项改进：降低语义 codec 帧率至 25 Hz 以减半序列长度；将 S2M 的 U-DiT 骨干替换为更高效的 Zipformer 架构；设计边界感知对齐 (boundary-aware alignment)、token 级拼接 (token-level concatenation) 和指令引导生成 (instruction-guided generation) 三种显式跨语言建模策略；对 T2S 模块采用 GRPO 进行后训练优化。
Result: IndexTTS 2.5 支持中、英、日、西四种语言的零样本情感 TTS，可在没有目标语言情感训练数据的情况下迁移情感韵律；相较 IndexTTS 2，RTF 提升 2.28 倍，WER 和说话人相似度保持相当。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些改进提供了零样本多语言情感 TTS 的实用设计原则，并显著提升推理速度与合成质量。

papers.title: Agentic AI for Clustering, Relationship Discovery, and Semantic Trading in Prediction Markets
papers.abstract_en: Prediction markets allow users to trade on outcomes of real-world events, but are prone to fragmentation with overlapping questions, implicit equivalences, and hidden contradictions across markets. We present an agentic AI (AAI) pipeline that autonomously recovers cross-market structure from contract text before prices enter the analysis. The workflow first clusters markets into coherent topical groups using natural-language understanding over contract text and metadata, and then identifies contracts within each cluster, but from different event markets, that exhibit strong dependence or leader--follower relationships. We evaluate this system, along with a natural language inference (NLI) benchmark, on a large prediction market dataset from early 2026. Using resolved outcomes to evaluate identified relations, we find that AAI-identified relations are 62.8\% consistent with exchange-recorded settlements, whereas the NLI benchmark only achieves 40.6\% accuracy. Within clusters, the AAI output is sparse and also remarkably compatible as a signed graph with a frustration rate of 0.324\%. As an application, we show how discovered relations inform semantics-based trading strategies on prediction markets. One such strategy yields 14.12\% net ROI after fees in a two-month period in 2026. Overall, we demonstrate the potential for agentic AI as a structural discovery layer for prediction markets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个 agentic AI（AAI）流水线，在预测市场的价格分析之前，先从合约文本自动恢复跨市场结构：先用自然语言理解对市场按主题聚类，再识别同一主题簇内、来自不同事件市场的强依赖或 leader–follower 关系。基于 2026 年初的大型预测市场数据集评估，AAI 识别的关系与交易所结算的 62.8% 一致，而 NLI 基准仅为 40.6%；簇内符号图 frustration rate 为 0.324%。作为应用，作者利用这些关系构建语义交易策略，其中一个策略在 2026 年两个月内实现 14.12% 的净 ROI（扣除费用）。
Motivation: 预测市场容易出现碎片化：跨市场存在重叠问题、隐含等价关系和隐藏矛盾，直接基于价格分析会受此影响，因此需要在价格进入分析前自动恢复跨市场结构。
Method: 提出一个 agentic AI 流水线，首先利用合约文本和元数据上的自然语言理解将市场聚类为连贯主题组，然后在每个簇内识别来自不同事件市场但表现出强依赖或 leader–follower 关系的合约，并用已结算结果评估这些关系。
Result: AAI 识别的关系与交易所记录的结算 62.8% 一致，NLI 基准只有 40.6%；簇内输出作为带符号图具有 0.324% 的 frustration rate，且输出稀疏。基于发现关系的语义交易策略在 2026 年两个月内取得 14.12% 的净 ROI。
Conclusion: 作者认为 agentic AI 可以作为预测市场的结构发现层，揭示跨市场关系并支持基于语义的交易策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Benchmarking In-context Experiential Learning Through Repeated Product Recommendations
papers.abstract_en: To navigate ever-shifting real-world environments, agents must grapple with incomplete knowledge and adapt their strategies through experience. However, current evaluations of LLM-based agents largely overlook this capability. Crucially, we stress not just the ability to contend with uncertainty within a task (episode), as episode-specific information is progressively revealed across turns, but also the refinement of such adaptive ability across similar episodes, as agents accumulate experiences and infer their shared latent structure. Repeated product recommendation offers a natural setting to isolate this need for experiential learning: within each interaction, an intelligent recommender must elicit unknown customer preferences through questions; across multiple interactions, it should tailor its questioning strategy to the observed customer and product distributions. We instantiate the Benchmark for Experiential Learning and Active exploration (BELA) by combining (1) a rich catalog of real-world products from Amazon, (2) a diverse collection of synthetic customer personas aimed to capture heterogeneous latent preferences, and (3) an LLM-based customer simulator framework that emulate preference-revealing interactions. Rather than aiming to faithfully replicate real consumer behavior, BELA provides a controlled and scalable testbed for whether agents can exploit consistent latent preferences across episodes. Benchmarking current models reveals that they can learn across turns, but struggle to improve across episodes. This underscore the need for frontier models to advance in experiential learning capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BELA（Benchmark for Experiential Learning and Active exploration），用重复产品推荐的交互场景来评测 LLM agent 的经验学习能力：agent 既要在单次交互（episode）内通过提问逐步揭示未知的客户偏好，也要在多次交互之间利用积累的经验推断客户与产品分布的共享潜在结构并改进提问策略。基准由 Amazon 真实商品目录、多样化的合成客户画像以及基于 LLM 的客户模拟器组成。评测结果表明当前模型能在单次交互内学习，但跨 episode 的提升很弱，凸显前沿模型在经验学习能力上的不足。
Motivation: 现有对 LLM agent 的评估大多只看单次任务内的不确定性处理，而忽略了 agent 在相似任务之间积累经验、推断共享潜在结构的能力；在动态真实环境中这种跨 episode 适应至关重要。重复产品推荐提供了一个能够隔离该能力的自然场景。
Method: 构建 BELA 基准，结合 Amazon 真实商品目录、旨在刻画异质潜在偏好的多样化合成客户画像，以及模拟偏好揭示交互的 LLM 客户模拟器框架，从而在可控、可扩展的测试环境中考察 agent 能否跨 episode 利用一致的潜在偏好。
Result: 基准测试显示当前模型可以跨 turns 学习，但难以跨 episodes 改进，作者据此指出前沿模型需要在经验学习（experiential learning）能力上取得进展。
Conclusion: 作者强调 BELA 的目标不是忠实复现真实消费者行为，而是提供一个受控且可扩展的测试平台来检验 agent 是否能利用跨 episode 一致的潜在偏好；结论是现有模型跨 episode 学习能力不足。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Length-MAX Tokenizer for Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a new tokenizer for language models that minimizes the average tokens per character, thereby reducing the number of tokens needed to represent text during training and to generate text during inference. Our method, which we refer to as the Length-MAX tokenizer, obtains its vocabulary by casting a length-weighted objective maximization as a graph partitioning problem and developing a greedy approximation algorithm. On FineWeb and diverse domains, it yields 14--18\% fewer tokens than Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) across vocabulary sizes from 10K to 50K, and the reduction is 13.0\% when the size is 64K. Training GPT-2 models at 124M, 355M, and 1.3B parameters from scratch with five runs each shows 18.5\%, 17.2\%, and 18.5\% fewer steps, respectively, to reach a fixed validation loss, and 13.7\%, 12.7\%, and 13.7\% lower inference latency, together with a 16\% throughput gain at 124M, while consistently improving on downstream tasks including reducing LAMBADA perplexity by 11.7\% and enhancing HellaSwag accuracy by 4.3\%. Moreover, the Length-MAX tokenizer achieves 99.62\% vocabulary coverage and the out-of-vocabulary rate remains low at 0.12\% on test sets. These results demonstrate that optimizing for average token length, rather than frequency alone, offers an effective approach to more efficient language modeling without sacrificing -- and often improving -- downstream performance. The tokenizer is compatible with production systems and reduces embedding and KV-cache memory by 18\% at inference.

papers.title: M$^3$Prune: Hierarchical Communication Graph Pruning for Efficient Multi-Modal Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in multi-modal retrieval-augmented generation (mRAG), which enhance multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) with external knowledge, have demonstrated that the collective intelligence of multiple agents can significantly outperform a single model through effective communication. Despite impressive performance, existing multi-agent systems inherently incur substantial token overhead and increased computational costs, posing challenges for large-scale deployment. To address these issues, we propose a novel Multi-Modal Multi-agent hierarchical communication graph PRUNING framework, termed M$^3$Prune. Our framework eliminates redundant edges across different modalities, achieving an optimal balance between task performance and token overhead. Specifically, M$^3$Prune first applies intra-modal graph sparsification to textual and visual modalities, identifying the edges most critical for solving the task. Subsequently, we construct a dynamic communication topology using these key edges for inter-modal graph sparsification. Finally, we progressively prune redundant edges to obtain a more efficient and hierarchical topology. Extensive experiments on both general and domain-specific mRAG benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms both single-agent and robust multi-agent mRAG systems while significantly reducing token consumption.
papers.comment: Critical flaw in Eq.(5)/Alg.1 (Sec 3.2): scoring fails Lipschitz continuity in multi-modal spaces, causing invalid hierarchy. Thus, latency/FLOPs in Tables 2&3 are overestimated & irreproducible. Core defect unfixable by minor update. Withdraw to avoid misleading; will revise theory & experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出M$^3$Prune，一个面向多模态多智能体检索增强生成（mRAG）的分层通信图剪枝框架，目标是在保持任务性能的同时降低token开销。作者声称通过模态内与模态间图稀疏化并结合渐进式剪枝，在通用和领域mRAG基准上优于单智能体与强多智能体系统。但arXiv注释明确指出论文存在关键缺陷并已撤回，声称作者主动撤回以避免误导。
Motivation: 多模态多智能体mRAG系统虽性能优越，但通信带来大量token开销和计算成本，影响大规模部署。
Method: 提出M$^3$Prune：先对文本和视觉模态做模态内图稀疏化，选取关键边；再利用关键边构建动态通信拓扑进行模态间稀疏化；最后逐步剪除冗余边获得分层高效拓扑。
Result: 原摘要报告在通用与领域特定mRAG基准上持续优于单智能体和强多智能体系统，且显著降低token消耗；但作者撤回声明指出，Eq.(5)/Alg.1中的评分函数在多模态空间不满足Lipschitz连续性，导致层次结构无效，表2和表3中的延迟/FLOPs被高估且不可复现，核心缺陷无法通过小更新修复。
Conclusion: 作者已撤回论文，指出理论缺陷使方法与实验结论不可靠，计划修正理论并重做实验；读者不应依赖原摘要中的性能结论。

papers.title: Automating Deception: Scalable Multi-Turn LLM Jailbreaks
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn conversational attacks, which leverage psychological principles like Foot-in-the-Door (FITD), where a small initial request paves the way for a more significant one, to bypass safety alignments, pose a persistent threat to Large Language Models (LLMs). Progress in defending against these attacks is hindered by a reliance on manual, hard-to-scale dataset creation. This paper introduces a novel, automated pipeline for generating large-scale, psychologically-grounded multi-turn jailbreak datasets. We systematically operationalize FITD techniques into reproducible templates, creating a benchmark of 1,500 scenarios across illegal activities and offensive content. We evaluate seven models from three major LLM families under both multi-turn (with history) and single-turn (without history) conditions. Our results reveal stark differences in contextual robustness: models in the GPT family demonstrate a significant vulnerability to conversational history, with Attack Success Rates (ASR) increasing by as much as 32 percentage points. In contrast, Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash exhibits exceptional resilience, proving nearly immune to these attacks, while Anthropic's Claude 3 Haiku shows strong but imperfect resistance. These findings highlight a critical divergence in how current safety architectures handle conversational context and underscore the need for defenses that can resist narrative-based manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一套自动化流水线，用于规模化生成基于心理学策略的多轮越狱数据集，将"登门槛"（Foot-in-the-Door, FITD）技术操作化为可复现模板，并构建包含1,500个非法活动与冒犯性内容场景的基准。作者在三个主要 LLM 家族的七个模型上比较带历史的多轮与不带历史的单轮条件，发现 GPT 家族对对话历史显著脆弱，攻击成功率（ASR）最多提升32个百分点，而 Gemini 2.5 Flash 几乎免疫，Claude 3 Haiku 表现强但仍有缺陷。
Motivation: 多轮对话攻击可利用 FITD 等心理原理绕过安全对齐，持续威胁大语言模型；但相关防御研究因依赖人工、难以扩展的数据集构建而进展受限。
Method: 提出自动化数据集生成流水线，将 FITD 心理技术系统化编码为可重复模板，构建大规模心理驱动的多轮越狱基准；随后在七个模型上同时执行多轮（含历史）与单轮（无历史）条件下的对比评估。
Result: 在1,500个场景上，GPT 家族模型在加入对话历史后 ASR 最高上升32个百分点；Google 的 Gemini 2.5 Flash 表现近乎免疫，Anthropic 的 Claude 3 Haiku 展现较强但不完全的抵抗能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调当前安全架构对对话上下文的处理存在显著差异，凸显了抵御基于叙事操纵的防御需求的紧迫性。

papers.title: Towards Realistic Guarantees: A Probabilistic Certificate for SmoothLLM
papers.abstract_en: The SmoothLLM defense provides a certification guarantee against jailbreaking attacks, but it relies on a strict "k-unstable" assumption that rarely holds in practice. This strong assumption can limit the trustworthiness of the provided safety certificate. In this work, we address this limitation by introducing a more realistic probabilistic framework, "(k, $\varepsilon$)-unstable," to certify defenses against diverse jailbreaking attacks, from gradient-based (GCG) to semantic (PAIR). We derive a new, data-informed lower bound on SmoothLLM's defense probability by incorporating empirical models of attack success, providing a more trustworthy and practical safety certificate. By introducing the notion of (k, $\varepsilon$)-unstable, our framework provides practitioners with actionable safety guarantees, enabling them to set certification thresholds that better reflect the real-world behavior of LLMs. Ultimately, this work contributes a practical and theoretically-grounded mechanism to make LLMs more resistant to the exploitation of their safety alignments, a critical challenge in secure AI deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 SmoothLLM 防御的认证保证依赖严格且现实中很少成立的 "k-unstable" 假设这一问题，提出更现实的概率化框架 "(k, ε)-unstable"，用于认证针对越狱攻击（从梯度型 GCG 到语义型 PAIR）的防御。作者结合攻击成功的经验模型，导出数据驱动的新下界来估计 SmoothLLM 的防御概率，并据此给出可操作的认证阈值。
Motivation: SmoothLLM 的现有安全认证依赖 "k-unstable" 这一严格假设，该假设在实践中很少满足，从而限制了所提供安全证书的可信度。
Method: 引入 (k, ε)-unstable 概率框架，通过纳入攻击成功的经验模型，推导出 SmoothLLM 防御概率的新的、基于数据的下界，并为实践者提供可设置的认证阈值。
Result: 摘要未给出具体实验数值，仅说明该方法能针对从 GCG 到 PAIR 等多种越狱攻击提供更可信和实用的安全证书。
Conclusion: 该工作为防御 LLM 安全对齐被利用的问题提供了有理论依据且可操作的机制，使安全保证更贴近 LLM 的真实行为。

papers.title: Tokenisation over Bounded Alphabets is Hard
papers.abstract_en: Recent works have shown that tokenisation is NP-complete. However, these works assume tokenisation is applied to inputs with unboundedly large alphabets -- an unrealistic assumption, given that in practice tokenisers operate over fixed-size alphabets, such as bytes or Unicode-characters. We close this gap by analysing tokenisation over bounded alphabets, considering two natural variants: bottomup tokenisation and direct tokenisation, where we must, respectively, select a sequence of merge operations or a vocabulary whose application optimally compresses a dataset. We prove that even with binary alphabets, both variants are not only NP-complete, but also APX-hard and thus admit no polynomial-time approximation scheme (unless P=NP). We further show that direct tokenisation remains NP-complete even when applied to unary alphabets. These results establish that the computational intractability of tokenisation is not an artifact of large alphabets or complex constructions, but a fundamental barrier. Overall, our results explain why current practical algorithms such as BPE and UnigramLM are heuristic, and point toward approximation algorithms being an important path going forward for tokenisation research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有界字母表上的分词 (tokenisation) 计算复杂度，证明即使是二元字母表，自底向上分词 (bottom-up tokenisation) 和直接分词 (direct tokenisation) 两个变体不仅都是 NP-complete，而且都是 APX-hard，因此在 P≠NP 下不存在多项式时间近似方案 (PTAS)。此外，直接分词在一元字母表上仍保持 NP-complete。作者认为这解释了 BPE 和 UnigramLM 等实际算法为何是启发式的，并指出近似算法是未来分词研究的重要方向。
Motivation: 以往证明分词 NP-complete 的工作假设输入字母表无界，这与实际不符，因为真实分词器通常作用于固定大小的字母表，如字节或 Unicode 字符。本文旨在填补有界字母表情形下分词复杂度的空白。
Method: 分析两种自然变体：自底向上分词要求在给定数据上选择一串合并操作 (merge operations) 以最优压缩；直接分词要求选择并应用一个词表 (vocabulary) 以最优压缩。作者通过归约证明二者在二元字母表下 NP-complete 且 APX-hard，并进一步证明直接分词在一元字母表下仍为 NP-complete。
Result: 即使在二元字母表上，两个变体均为 NP-complete 且 APX-hard，即除非 P=NP，否则没有 PTAS；直接分词在一元字母表上也保持 NP-complete。
Conclusion: 分词的计算难解性并非大字母表或复杂构造造成的假象，而是本质性障碍。该结果解释了 BPE 和 UnigramLM 等实际方法只能是启发式算法，并提示近似算法是后续分词研究的重要路径。
