papers.title: Reasoning about Intent for Ambiguous Requests
papers.abstract_en: Large language models often respond to ambiguous requests by implicitly committing to one interpretation, frustrating users and creating safety risks when that interpretation is wrong. We propose generating a single structured response that enumerates the different ways an ambiguous request can be interpreted, each coupled with a corresponding answer. Our models are trained with reinforcement learning using a dual reward objective: recall on ambiguous inputs to maximise coverage of valid interpretations, and precision on unambiguous ones to suppress spurious alternatives. Training requires only multiple valid answers per input as supervision, no clarification questions or explicit interpretations are needed. Experiments on conversational question answering and semantic parsing demonstrate that our method achieves higher coverage of valid answers than baseline approaches. Human evaluation confirms that predicted interpretations are meaningful and explain their corresponding answers. Our approach promotes transparency with explicit interpretations, avoids additional interaction rounds by producing all interpretations in a single generation, and supports downstream applications through its structured output format.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型面对模糊请求时隐式选择单一解释的问题，提出生成一个结构化响应，枚举请求的不同解释并为每种解释给出对应答案。方法使用强化学习训练，奖励函数包含两个目标：在模糊输入上最大化有效解释的召回率，在明确输入上抑制无关替代解释。实验在会话问答和语义解析任务上显示，该方法比基线获得更高的有效答案覆盖率，人工评估确认预测的解释有意义并能解释对应答案。
Motivation: 大语言模型常对模糊请求隐式承诺单一解释，当该解释错误时会导致用户体验差并带来安全风险。
Method: 提出生成单个结构化响应，列出模糊请求的多种解释并分别配以答案。模型通过强化学习训练，采用双重奖励目标：对模糊输入最大化有效解释的覆盖（召回），对明确输入抑制虚假替代解释（精确）；训练仅需每个输入有多个有效答案作为监督，不需要澄清问题或显式解释。
Result: 在会话问答和语义解析上的实验显示，该方法比基线覆盖更多有效答案；人工评估确认预测的解释是有意义的，并能解释对应答案。
Conclusion: 该方法通过显式解释促进透明性，通过单次生成输出所有解释避免额外交互轮次，且结构化输出格式支持下游应用。

papers.title: Routesplain: Towards Faithful and Intervenable Routing for Software-related Tasks
papers.abstract_en: LLMs now tackle a wide range of software-related tasks, yet we show that their performance varies markedly both across and within these tasks. Routing user queries to the appropriate LLMs can therefore help improve response quality while reducing cost. Prior work, however, has focused mainly on general-purpose LLM routing via black-box models. We introduce Routesplain, the first LLM router for software-related tasks, including multilingual code generation and repair, input/output prediction, and computer science QA. Unlike existing routing approaches, Routesplain first extracts human-interpretable concepts from each query (e.g., task, domain, reasoning complexity) and only routes based on these concepts, thereby providing intelligible, faithful rationales. We evaluate Routesplain on 16 state-of-the-art LLMs across eight software-related tasks; Routesplain outperforms individual models both in terms of accuracy and cost, and equals or surpasses all black-box baselines, with concept-level intervention highlighting avenues for further router improvements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Routesplain，据称为首个面向软件相关任务的 LLM 路由器，覆盖多语言代码生成与修复、输入/输出预测和计算机科学问答等任务。与现有黑盒路由不同，Routesplain 先从查询中提取人类可解释的概念（如任务、领域、推理复杂度），并仅基于这些概念进行路由，从而提供可理解且忠实的理由。在 16 个 SOTA LLM 和八个软件任务上的评估显示，它在准确率和成本上优于单个模型，并持平或超越所有黑盒基线。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 路由工作主要面向通用任务且依赖黑盒模型，而软件相关任务中 LLM 性能在任务间和任务内差异显著，需要既能提升质量又能降低成本的可解释路由方案。
Method: 提出概念级路由方法：先从用户查询中提取人类可解释的概念，再仅依据这些概念选择合适的 LLM，而不是直接学习黑盒路由映射；该设计同时支持概念层面的干预以诊断和改进路由。
Result: 在 16 个 LLM 和八个软件相关任务上，Routesplain 在准确率和成本上都优于单个模型，并与所有黑盒基线持平或更优；摘要还指出概念级干预揭示了进一步改进路由器的方向。
Conclusion: 作者将 Routesplain 定位为软件相关任务上首个可解释且可干预的 LLM 路由器，强调忠实理由和概念级干预的价值。

papers.title: The Collaboration Gap: Exploration and Benchmarking of Open-World Agentic Cooperation
papers.abstract_en: The trajectory of AI development suggests that we will increasingly rely on agent-based systems powered by language models, composed of independently developed agents with different information, privileges, and tools. The success of these systems will depend critically on effective collaboration among these heterogeneous agents, even under partial observability. Despite intense interest, the literature lacks empirical studies evaluating agentic collaboration without relying on fixed communication protocols, limiting insights for open-world deployments. We propose an illustrative collaborative maze-solving benchmark that (i) isolates collaborative capabilities, (ii) modulates problem complexity, (iii) enables scalable automated grading, and (iv) imposes no output-format constraints, benchmarking unguided, natural communication. Using this benchmark, we evaluate 32 leading open- and closed-source models in solo, homogeneous, and heterogeneous pairings. Our results reveal a surprising collaboration gap: models that perform well solo often degrade substantially when required to collaborate. We identify mitigations that show remarkable influence. For example, a small nudge via a relay inference approach, where a stronger agent leads before handing off to a weaker one, closes much of the gap. Our findings argue for (1) collaboration-aware evaluation, (2) training strategies to enhance collaborative capabilities, and (3) deliberate interaction design to elicit agents' collaboration skills, principles relevant to AI-AI and human-AI settings where agents must establish common ground.
papers.comment: Accepted to COLM 2026, code available at https://github.com/trdavidson/collaboration_gap
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个协作式迷宫求解基准，用来在无固定通信协议、无输出格式约束的条件下评测语言模型智能体之间的自然协作。作者用该基准评估了 32 个开源与闭源模型在单独、同质配对和异质配对中的表现，发现存在明显的协作鸿沟：单独表现好的模型在需要协作时常大幅退化。作者还测试了中继推理（relay inference）等缓解策略，发现由较强智能体先主导再移交给较弱智能体可以缩小大部分差距。
Motivation: 现有文献缺乏在不依赖固定通信协议的前提下对智能体协作进行经验评测的研究，这限制了对开放世界部署场景的洞察；而未来由语言模型驱动的异构智能体系统需要在部分可观测条件下自然协作。
Method: 设计了一个协作迷宫求解基准，其特点是隔离协作能力、调节问题复杂度、支持可扩展的自动评分，并且不施加输出格式限制；在该基准上系统评估 32 个模型在单独、同质和异质配对下的协作表现，并测试中继推理等缓解方法。
Result: 摘要报告了一个出人意料的协作鸿沟：单独表现优异的模型在协作时往往明显退化；而采用中继推理方法，即较强智能体先主导再移交给较弱智能体，能大幅弥合该差距。
Conclusion: 作者认为需要引入协作感知的评测、增强协作能力的训练策略以及刻意的交互设计来激发智能体的协作技能，这些原则同样适用于需要建立共同基础的 AI-AI 与人机协作场景。

papers.title: SARVLM: A Vision Language Foundation Model for Semantic Understanding in SAR Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) is a critical imaging modality due to its all-weather operational capability. Although recent advances in self-supervised learning and masked image modeling (MIM) have enabled SAR foundation models, these approaches primarily focus on low-level visual features and often neglect multi-modal representation. Moreover, multimodal data for SAR is scarce, limiting the development of robust cross-modal models. To address this limitation, we construct SARVLM-1M, a large-scale vision-language dataset comprising over one million image-text pairs aggregated from existing datasets. Furthermore, to mitigate the substantial differences between SAR and natural imagery, we propose a two-stage domain transfer training strategy that leverages optical remote sensing data as an intermediate bridge, facilitating effective knowledge transfer from natural images to SAR domains. Based on this strategy, we develop SARVLM, the first vision-language foundation model tailored for SAR, consisting of SARCLIP and SARCap. In addition, an ensemble strategy is utilized to improve the cross-scene generalization capability of the model. Moreover, SARDet and SARRot further validate the capability of the proposed framework in object detection. Extensive experiments on 13 benchmarks across image-text retrieval, target recognition, zero-shot classification, object detection, semantic localization, and image captioning demonstrate the superior feature extraction and interpretation capabilities of SARVLM. It consistently outperforms state-of-the-art vision-language models and advances semantic understanding in SAR imagery. Code and datasets will be released on https://github.com/KlayMa527/SARVLM.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SARVLM，据称是首个面向 SAR 影像的视觉语言基础模型，并构建了包含一百多万图像-文本对的 SARVLM-1M 数据集。作者利用光学遥感数据作为中间桥梁，设计两阶段域迁移训练策略，解决 SAR 与自然图像差异大的问题，并发展出 SARCLIP 与 SARCap。在图像-文本检索、目标识别、零样本分类、目标检测、语义定位和图像描述等 13 个基准上，该方法一致优于现有视觉语言模型。
Motivation: 现有 SAR 基础模型主要依赖自监督学习和掩码图像建模，侧重低层视觉特征，忽略多模态表征；同时 SAR 领域的多模态数据稀缺，限制了跨模态模型的稳健发展。
Method: 构建大规模 SAR 视觉语言数据集 SARVLM-1M；提出两阶段域迁移训练策略，将光学遥感数据作为中间桥，实现从自然图像到 SAR 域的知识迁移；通过 SARCLIP 与 SARCap 组成模型框架，并采用集成策略提升跨场景泛化；此外利用 SARDet 与 SARRot 验证框架在目标检测上的能力。
Result: 在 13 个基准上覆盖图像-文本检索、目标识别、零样本分类、目标检测、语义定位和图像描述等任务，SARVLM 始终优于最先进的视觉语言模型，展现出更强的特征提取与语义理解能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SARVLM 推动了 SAR 影像语义理解的发展，并计划公开代码与数据集；但摘要未给出具体量化指标或局限性讨论。

papers.title: QuArch: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Reasoning in Computer Architecture
papers.abstract_en: The field of computer architecture, which bridges high-level software abstractions and low-level hardware implementations, remains absent from current large language model (LLM) evaluations. To this end, we present QuArch (pronounced 'quark'), the first benchmark designed to facilitate the development and evaluation of LLM knowledge and reasoning capabilities specifically in computer architecture. QuArch v1.0 provides a comprehensive collection of 2,671 expert-validated question-answer (QA) pairs covering various aspects of computer architecture, including processor design, memory systems, and interconnection networks. Our evaluation reveals that while frontier models possess domain-specific knowledge, they struggle with skills that require higher-order thinking in computer architecture. Frontier model accuracies vary widely (from 34% to 73%) on these advanced questions, highlighting persistent gaps in architectural reasoning across analysis, design, and implementation QAs. Furthermore, via fine-tuning we find that QuArch can translate to improved performance on a realistic memory hierarchy design task, resulting in up to 1.99x more area-efficient solutions and up to 40% more viable solutions overall. By holistically assessing fundamental skills, QuArch provides a foundation for building and measuring LLM capabilities that can accelerate innovation in computing systems. The QuArch benchmark and leaderboard are publicly available at: https://quarch.ai/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QuArch，据称是首个面向计算机体系结构领域的大语言模型（LLM）知识与推理能力评测基准。QuArch v1.0 包含 2,671 个专家验证的问答对，覆盖处理器设计、存储系统和互连网络等主题。评测显示前沿模型在分析、设计和实现类问题上准确率波动较大（34% 至 73%），且微调 QuArch 可提升真实内存层级设计任务的表现。
Motivation: 计算机体系结构作为连接高层软件抽象与低层硬件实现的领域，目前缺少专门的 LLM 评测基准，现有评估无法衡量模型在该领域的知识与高阶推理能力。
Method: 构建 QuArch 基准，收集并专家验证 2,671 个问答对，按分析、设计和实现等需要高阶思维的类别组织评测；同时通过微调实验验证基准对真实内存层级设计任务的可迁移性。
Result: 摘要报告前沿模型准确率从 34% 到 73% 不等，表明模型虽有领域知识但在体系结构推理上存在明显短板；在内存层级设计任务上，基于 QuArch 微调带来最多 1.99 倍面积效率提升和最多 40% 更多可行解。
Conclusion: QuArch 为系统评估和构建 LLM 在计算机体系结构中的能力提供基础，基准与排行榜已公开。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 构建 QuArch 基准，收集并专家验证 2,671 个问答对，按分析、设计和实现等需要高阶思维的类别组织评测；同时通过微调实验验证基准对真实内存层级设计任务的可迁移性。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告前沿模型准确率从 34% 到 73% 不等，表明模型虽有领域知识但在体系结构推理上存在明显短板；在内存层级设计任务上，基于 QuArch 微调带来最多 1.99 倍面积效率提升和最多 40% 更多可行解。
summary_sections.conclusion: QuArch 为系统评估和构建 LLM 在计算机体系结构中的能力提供基础，基准与排行榜已公开。

papers.title: Rethinking Reasoning with MDLMs: Early Exits, Post-hoc Reasoning, and Beyond
papers.abstract_en: The reasoning paradigm, where language models reason before answering, has enabled breakthroughs on tasks such as mathematical problem-solving. While current tooling for reasoning is built around next-token prediction trained models, recent works introduce an alternative choice: masked diffusion language models (MDLMs). MDLMs are trained to infill positions in randomly masked sequences. We introduce reasoning-as-infilling, a prompting technique that pre-fills tokens to explicitly delimit reasoning and answer regions, unlocking a unified set of capabilities for MDLM reasoning. Because answer positions are explicitly designated, the model's conditional distributions over answer tokens are directly accessible during generation. This enables early exits when the model is certain of its answer. The same framework supports post-hoc reasoning: given question-answer pairs, MDLMs can sample high-quality reasoning traces from their posterior, a distribution that is intractable for autoregressive models. On GSM8k, fine-tuning LLaDA-8B-Base on these posterior traces improves accuracy by +14.9%, matching gains from human-written traces (+13.4%). Finally, given a reference answer, the answer region distributions enable scoring partial reasoning traces at intermediate steps, providing intermediate rewards that are more strongly correlated with correctness than scores from a specialized process reward model. At intermediate steps, answer-likelihood scores from autoregressive models are significantly less predictive of correctness than those from MDLMs. Our results demonstrate that the MDLM training objective provides promising benefits for reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 reasoning-as-infilling 提示技术，面向掩码扩散语言模型 (MDLM) 的推理任务：通过预填充 token 显式划分推理区与答案区，从而在生成过程中直接访问答案 token 的条件分布。该框架支持基于置信度的早停 (early exit) 和基于后验采样的后验推理 (post-hoc reasoning)。在 GSM8k 上，用 LLaDA-8B-Base 在后验推理轨迹上微调带来 +14.9% 准确率提升，接近人工编写轨迹的 +13.4%。
Motivation: 当前关于语言模型推理的工具和方法主要围绕自回归的下一个 token 预测模型构建，而掩码扩散语言模型 (MDLM) 作为另一种训练范式，其推理能力尚未被充分开发。
Method: 引入 reasoning-as-infilling 提示技术，预填充 token 以显式界定推理区和答案区，使模型在生成时可直接获取答案 token 的条件分布；该框架同时支持早停、后验推理轨迹采样，以及用答案区分布对中间推理步骤进行评分。
Result: 在 GSM8k 上，将 LLaDA-8B-Base 在后验采样的推理轨迹上微调，准确率提升 +14.9%，与人工轨迹的 +13.4% 相当；MDLM 的答案似然分数在中间步骤与正确性的相关性高于专门的 process reward model，且自回归模型在该设定下显著更不具预测力。
Conclusion: 实验表明 MDLM 的训练目标能为推理提供有价值的优势，reasoning-as-infilling 框架统一了早停、后验推理和中间步骤评分等能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adversarially Robust Few-Shot Anomaly Detection with Vision Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation models such as DINOv2 enable strong few-shot anomaly detection (FSAD) through simple non-parametric k-nearest-neighbor (k-NN) scoring over frozen patch features. Existing robust anomaly detection methods assume large normal-class training sets and adversarial training of the feature extractor. The few-shot regime, where the detector consists of a frozen backbone and a non-parametric scorer, has remained unaddressed despite its widespread deployment. We develop a white-box attack framework adapted to k-NN memory-bank detectors and introduce an adversarially robust FSAD method which is training-free with respect to the backbone. We introduce the DistanceProbe (DP), a lightweight MLP trained by regression to predict per-patch k-NN distance directly from frozen features, providing the differentiable proxy required for gradient-based attacks against non-parametric scorers. We further propose a two-level combined defense that operates using only the normal reference support set images. At the input level, PatchShift (PS) applies random pixel shifts to exploit the misalignment of adversarial perturbations with the encoder's patch grid, aggregating scores across multiple shifted views via element-wise median pooling. At the feature level we employ the FeaturePurifier (FP), a lightweight residual MLP trained on clean and adversarially augmented support features to project perturbed representations back toward the clean feature manifold. Through comprehensive experiments under various adversarial settings, we show that our method exhibits robust detection and localization with performance gains of ~27% image-level AUROC and ~51% pixel-level PRO over the undefended attacked baseline across MVTec-AD, VisA, and MPDD at k=4 shots, while preserving clean accuracy within 3%, matching full-shot adversarially-trained baselines on pixel-level AUROC, and holding under adaptive attack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉基础模型（如 DINOv2）的少样本异常检测（FSAD）在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性问题，提出了一套无需训练主干网络的防御框架。作者设计了 DistanceProbe（DP）作为可微代理，使梯度攻击能作用于基于 k-NN 的非参数打分器，并提出输入级 PatchShift（PS）与特征级 FeaturePurifier（FP）的两级联合防御。实验显示，在 MVTec-AD、VisA 和 MPDD 上以 k=4 shots 设置，该方法相对无防御攻击基线在图像级 AUROC 提升约 27%、像素级 PRO 提升约 51%，干净精度损失保持在 3% 以内。
Motivation: 现有鲁棒异常检测方法依赖大规模正常类训练集和对抗训练，而少样本场景下检测器由冻结主干和非参数打分器组成，其对抗鲁棒性问题尚未被解决，尽管该场景已被广泛部署。
Method: 提出白盒攻击框架以适配 k-NN 记忆库检测器；DistanceProbe 是一个轻量 MLP，通过回归直接从冻结特征预测逐 patch 的 k-NN 距离，为梯度攻击提供可微代理。防御方面，输入级 PatchShift 通过随机像素位移利用对抗扰动与编码器 patch 网格的错位，并用逐元素中位数池化聚合多视图分数；特征级 FeaturePurifier 是一个轻量残差 MLP，在干净与对抗增强的支持特征上训练，将扰动表示投影回干净特征流形。
Result: 综合多种对抗设置下的实验表明，所提方法在 MVTec-AD、VisA 和 MPDD 上以 k=4 shots 实现鲁棒检测与定位，图像级 AUROC 提升约 27%，像素级 PRO 提升约 51%，干净精度保持在前 3% 以内；像素级 AUROC 与全 shot 对抗训练基线相当，并在自适应攻击下保持稳定。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在冻结主干与非参数打分器下即可实现对抗鲁棒的少样本异常检测，无需对主干进行对抗训练，且能同时保持良好干净精度和抵御自适应攻击。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Affordance-Guided Diffusion Prior for 3D Hand Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: How can we reconstruct 3D hand poses when large portions of the hand are heavily occluded by itself or by objects? Humans often resolve such ambiguities by leveraging contextual knowledge -- such as affordances, where an object's shape and function suggest how the object is typically grasped. Inspired by this observation, we propose a generative prior for hand pose refinement guided by affordance-aware textual descriptions of hand-object interactions (HOI). Our method employs a diffusion-based generative model that learns the distribution of plausible hand poses conditioned on affordance descriptions, which are inferred from a large vision-language model (VLM). This enables the refinement of occluded regions into more accurate and functionally coherent hand poses. Extensive experiments on HOGraspNet, a 3D hand-affordance dataset with severe occlusions, demonstrate that our affordance-guided refinement significantly improves hand pose estimation over both recent regression methods and diffusion-based refinement lacking contextual reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对手部被自身或物体大面积遮挡时的 3D 手部姿态重建问题，提出一种由可供性 (affordance) 引导的扩散先验。该方法利用大视觉语言模型 (VLM) 从手-物交互 (HOI) 中推断可供性相关的文本描述，并将其作为条件输入扩散生成模型，以细化被遮挡区域的手部姿态。在 HOGraspNet 数据集上的实验表明，这种可供性引导的细化相较于回归方法和缺乏上下文推理的扩散细化显著提升了手部姿态估计精度。
Motivation: 遮挡导致手部姿态存在歧义，仅凭视觉证据难以重建；人类会利用物体形状与功能提示的抓取方式（可供性）来消解歧义，而现有方法缺乏这种上下文推理。
Method: 提出一个以可供性感知文本描述为条件的扩散生成先验：先用大 VLM 从手-物交互中生成描述，再训练扩散模型学习给定描述下的合理手部姿态分布，并用于遮挡区域的姿态细化。
Result: 在具有严重遮挡的 3D 手-可供性数据集 HOGraspNet 上，该方法显著优于最近的回归方法，以及未使用上下文推理的扩散细化方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调利用可供性上下文能帮助被遮挡手部区域得到更准确且功能上一致 (functionally coherent) 的姿态；实验限于 HOGraspNet 这类手-物交互场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Quokka: Accelerating Program Verification with LLMs via Invariant Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Program verification relies on loop invariants, yet automatically discovering strong invariants remains a long-standing challenge. We investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can accelerate program verification by generating useful loop invariants. We introduce Quokka, a framework for LLM-based invariant synthesis with soundness guarantees and state-of-the-art performance. Unlike prior work that treats LLM outputs as noisy symbolic material requiring substantial post-processing, Quokka adopts a simpler algorithm design that directly validates whether each LLM-generated invariant helps prove the target assertion. We construct a benchmark of 866 evaluation instances and 3589 training instances derived from SV-COMP, and evaluate 9 LLMs spanning multiple model families. We demonstrate that supervised fine-tuning and Best-of-N sampling yield measurable improvements, and we show that Quokka consistently outperforms prior LLM-based verifiers. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/Anjiang-Wei/Quokka
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Quokka，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的循环不变量（loop invariant）合成框架，用于加速程序验证，并带可靠性（soundness）保证。作者构造了源自 SV-COMP 的 866 个评测实例和 3589 个训练实例，评估 9 个来自不同模型家族的 LLM。结果表明监督微调和 Best-of-N 采样能带来可测量的改进，且 Quokka 一致优于先前的基于 LLM 的验证器。
Motivation: 程序验证依赖循环不变量，但自动发现强不变量仍是长期难题。作者希望探究 LLM 能否通过生成有用的循环不变量来加速程序验证。
Method: 与把 LLM 输出当作需要大量后处理的噪声符号材料的既有工作不同，Quokka 采用更简单的算法设计：直接验证每个 LLM 生成的不变量是否有助于证明目标断言，并结合监督微调（supervised fine-tuning）与 Best-of-N 采样。
Result: 在 SV-COMP 派生的基准上，Quokka 评估了 9 个 LLM，显示监督微调和 Best-of-N 采样带来可测量改进，并一致优于先前的基于 LLM 的验证器。代码和数据已公开。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Quokka 以更简单的设计实现了带可靠性保证的最新性能，表明直接验证 LLM 生成不变量是加速程序验证的有效路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient identification of critical regions via Flow Matching-based Monte Carlo initialization
papers.abstract_en: Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) is a standard tool for studying many-body systems, but its practical cost can become substantial, especially when simulations must be repeated across temperatures and lattice sizes or near transition regions where equilibration becomes increasingly difficult. In this work, we introduce a Flow Matching (FM) framework. It is not a standalone replacement for equilibrium Monte Carlo. Instead, we present it as a scalable, physically informed initializer for downstream MCMC simulations. We use a U-Net architecture. The FM model is trained on small-system configurations of the 2D XY model and then deployed across unseen temperatures and larger lattice sizes. FM-generated configurations preserve the correct qualitative physical trends across temperature and system size. This makes them suitable warm-start states for subsequent Monte Carlo refinement. Observables computed from FM-generated samples primarily serve as diagnostics of initializer quality, not as precision equilibrium estimates. The regression-based $L_2$ objective suppresses variance and limits the accuracy of fluctuation-sensitive observables. Examples include susceptibility and spin stiffness. Still, the model captures sufficient local statistical structure to yield physically aligned initial states across a broad range of conditions. These results support a reusable hybrid FM--MCMC workflow. The one-time FM training cost can be amortized across temperatures and lattice sizes. The generated warm-start configurations then reduce the burden of initializing large-scale Monte Carlo simulations. Our findings show that Flow Matching can support efficient exploration of transition regions in many-body systems by providing reusable warm-start configurations for downstream Monte Carlo simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 Flow Matching (FM) 的通用初始化框架，用于为下游 Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) 模拟提供暖启动配置，而非替代均衡蒙特卡洛。作者用 U-Net 在 2D XY 模型的小系统配置上训练 FM 模型，并部署到未见过的温度与更大的晶格尺寸。FM 生成配置保持正确的定性物理趋势，适合作为后续 MCMC 精化的初始状态；同时摘要指出回归式 L2 目标会抑制方差并限制磁化率、自旋刚度等波动敏感可观测量的精度。
Motivation: MCMC 在研究多体系统时成本显著，尤其是需要跨温度和晶格尺寸重复模拟、或接近难以平衡的相变区域时，初始化负担成为瓶颈。
Method: 引入 Flow Matching 框架作为物理信息初始化器：采用 U-Net 架构，在 2D XY 模型的小系统构型上训练，生成可跨温度和更大晶格尺寸迁移的暖启动状态，供后续蒙特卡洛精化使用。
Result: 摘要报告 FM 生成的配置在宽范围内保持正确的物理趋势并适合作为 MCMC 暖启动，但其回归式 L2 目标限制了磁化率和自旋刚度等波动敏感量的精度。
Conclusion: 结果支持一种可复用的混合 FM-MCMC 工作流：一次性 FM 训练成本可跨温度和晶格尺寸摊销，生成的暖启动配置可减少大规模蒙特卡洛模拟的初始化开销，有助于探索多体系统的相变区域。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LogicIF: Towards Complex Logic Instruction Following
papers.abstract_en: Instruction following has catalyzed the recent era of Large Language Models (LLMs) and is the foundational skill underpinning more advanced capabilities such as reasoning and agentic behaviors. As tasks grow more challenging, the logic structures embedded in natural language instructions becomes increasingly intricate. However, how well LLMs perform on such logic-intensive instructions remains under-explored. We propose Logic Instruction Following (LogicIF), a task requiring models to precisely follow and simulate every logic step within complex instructions. To generate these instructions, we construct LogicIFGen, a scalable, automated framework for generating verifiable instructions from code functions, which can naturally express rich logic such as conditions, loops, nesting, and function calls. Using this framework, we curate a collection of complex code functions to construct LogicIFEval, a benchmark comprising 426 verifiable, human-examined, logic-rich instructions. Our experiments demonstrate that current state-of-the-art LLMs still struggle to correctly follow the instructions in LogicIFEval. Most LLMs can only follow fewer than 60% of the instructions, revealing significant deficiencies in their capacity to handle instructions that involve complex logic structures. To further demonstrate the efficacy of our framework, we collect an extensive set of code functions across a wide range of logic difficulties to generate LogicIFTrain, a fully synthesized training set featuring 27,324 verifiable instructions. Our results show that a model trained on LogicIFTrain using reinforcement learning significantly outperforms the base model on both in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks. All the data, codes and models are released at https://github.com/mianzhang/LogicIF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出逻辑指令跟随任务（Logic Instruction Following, LogicIF），要求模型精确跟随并模拟复杂指令中的每一步逻辑。作者构建了 LogicIFGen 自动化框架，从代码函数生成可验证指令，并据此发布包含 426 条人工检查指令的基准 LogicIFEval，以及包含 27,324 条可验证指令的训练集 LogicIFTrain。实验表明现有 SOTA LLM 在该基准上表现不佳，多数模型只能跟随不足 60% 的指令；基于 LogicIFTrain 的强化学习训练可显著提升基座模型在域内与域外基准上的表现。
Motivation: 自然语言指令中嵌入的逻辑结构随任务难度增加而愈发复杂，但 LLM 在逻辑密集型指令上的表现尚未被充分探索，现有基准难以覆盖条件、循环、嵌套与函数调用等丰富逻辑。
Method: 提出 LogicIFGen，一种从代码函数自动生成可验证指令的可扩展框架，并构建 LogicIFEval 基准（426 条人工检查指令）与 LogicIFTrain 训练集（27,324 条合成指令）；训练阶段采用强化学习（reinforcement learning）微调模型。
Result: 摘要报告当前 SOTA LLM 多数只能正确跟随少于 60% 的 LogicIFEval 指令；在 LogicIFTrain 上使用强化学习训练的模型显著优于基座模型，且在域内和域外基准上均有效。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LLM 在处理含复杂逻辑结构的指令时存在明显能力缺陷，并公开了全部数据、代码与模型以推动后续研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SplitGaussian: Reconstructing Dynamic Scenes via Visual Geometry Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing dynamic 3D scenes from monocular video remains fundamentally challenging due to the need to jointly infer motion, structure, and appearance from limited observations. Existing dynamic scene reconstruction methods based on Gaussian Splatting often entangle static and dynamic elements in a shared representation, leading to motion leakage, geometric distortions, and temporal flickering. We identify that the root cause lies in the coupled modeling of geometry and appearance across time, which hampers both stability and interpretability. To address this, we propose SplitGaussian, a novel framework that explicitly decomposes scene representations into static and dynamic components. By decoupling motion modeling from background geometry and allowing only the dynamic branch to deform over time, our method prevents motion artifacts in static regions while supporting view- and time-dependent appearance refinement. This disentangled design not only enhances temporal consistency and reconstruction fidelity but also accelerates convergence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods in rendering quality, geometric stability, and motion separation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SplitGaussian，一种从单目视频重建动态3D场景的框架，核心是将场景表示显式分解为静态与动态组件，仅允许动态分支随时间变形，从而避免运动泄漏、几何畸变和时间闪烁。摘要报告该方法在渲染质量、几何稳定性和运动分离上优于先前基于Gaussian Splatting的SOTA方法，并加速收敛。
Motivation: 现有基于Gaussian Splatting的动态场景重建方法将静态和动态元素纠缠在共享表示中，导致运动泄漏、几何畸变和时间闪烁；作者认为根因是跨时间的几何与外观耦合建模，损害了稳定性和可解释性。
Method: 提出SplitGaussian框架，显式分解场景表示为静态与动态两部分；将运动建模与背景几何解耦，仅动态分支随时间变形，同时支持视图和时间相关的外观细化。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在渲染质量、几何稳定性和运动分离方面优于先前SOTA方法，并增强时间一致性、重建保真度，且加速收敛；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调解耦静态与动态组件的设计是提升时间一致性和重建保真的关键，并加快收敛；该方法针对单目视频动态场景重建任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TS-Mob: Social and Geographical-Aware Time Series Foundation-Model Framework for Human Mobility Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Short-term forecasting of aggregated human mobility flows supports urban planning, intelligent transportation systems, and emergency response, yet existing models often require substantial mobility history and learn spatial structure implicitly through grids or graphs. Time series foundation models provide strong temporal priors but typically lack explicit geographic and social conditioning for origin-destination interactions. We introduce TS-Mob, a framework that conditions a fine-tuned time series foundation model (TimesFM) forecaster on a gravity-inspired destination-attractiveness index that encodes geographic and social signals computed from open data (living population, centroid distances, and Overture POI counts), together with weather covariates. Evaluated on commonly used benchmarks like Bike New York City, Taxi Beijing, and a nation-scale Spain origin-destination matrix estimated through mobile phone data, TS-Mob outperforms classical, deep spatio-temporal, and a set of foundation model-based baselines across RMSE, MAE, and CPC, with gains up to 78.71% lower MAE and 137.93% higher CPC over the best classical baseline, and up to about 4.27% lower RMSE over the strongest foundation baseline. Stratified analyses further show robustness across different temporal regimes, like weekdays/weekends.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TS-Mob，一种基于时间序列基础模型 (times series foundation model) 的人类移动性预测框架。它微调 TimesFM 作为预测器，并用重力启发的目的地吸引力指数显式编码地理与社会信号，同时加入天气协变量，用于预测聚合的人类移动流量。在 Bike New York City、Taxi Beijing 以及基于手机数据的西班牙全国 OD 矩阵基准上，TS-Mob 在 RMSE、MAE 和 CPC 上优于经典方法、深度时空方法以及多个基础模型基线，并在工作日/周末等不同时间状态下表现稳健。
Motivation: 短期聚合人类移动流预测对城市规划、智能交通和应急响应很重要，但现有模型通常需要大量移动历史数据，并通过网格或图隐式学习空间结构；时间序列基础模型提供了强时间先验，却缺少对起讫点 (origin-destination) 交互的显式地理与社会条件。
Method: TS-Mob 将可微调的时间序列基础模型 TimesFM 作为预测器，并引入基于开放数据（居住人口、质心距离、Overture POI 数量）计算的重力启发目的地吸引力指数作为条件输入，同时结合天气协变量进行预测。
Result: 在所用基准上，TS-Mob 相比最佳经典基线最高降低 MAE 78.71%、提高 CPC 137.93%；相比最强基础模型基线，RMSE 最高降低约 4.27%。分层分析显示该方法在诸如工作日/周末等不同时间状态下具备稳健性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过显式地向时间序列基础模型注入地理与社会信号，并辅以天气协变量，可以显著提升聚合移动性预测的准确性。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: AQUA20: A Benchmark Dataset for Underwater Species Classification under Challenging Conditions
papers.abstract_en: Robust visual recognition in underwater environments remains a significant challenge due to complex distortions such as turbidity, low illumination, and occlusion, which severely degrade the performance of standard vision systems. This paper introduces AQUA20, a comprehensive benchmark dataset comprising 8,171 underwater images across 20 marine species reflecting real-world environmental challenges such as illumination, turbidity, occlusions, etc., providing a valuable resource for underwater visual understanding. Thirteen state-of-the-art deep learning models, including lightweight CNNs (SqueezeNet, MobileNetV2) and transformer-based architectures (ViT, ConvNeXt), were evaluated to benchmark their performance in classifying marine species under challenging conditions. Our experimental results show ConvNeXt achieving the best performance, with a Top-3 accuracy of 98.82% and a Top-1 accuracy of 90.69%, as well as the highest overall F1-score of 88.92% with moderately large parameter size. The results obtained from our other benchmark models also demonstrate trade-offs between complexity and performance. We also provide an extensive explainability analysis using GRAD-CAM and LIME for interpreting the strengths and pitfalls of the models. Our results reveal substantial room for improvement in underwater species recognition and demonstrate the value of AQUA20 as a foundation for future research in this domain. The dataset is publicly available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/taufiktrf/AQUA20.
papers.journal_ref: Arabian Journal for Science and Engineering (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AQUA20，一个面向水下物种分类的基准数据集，包含 8,171 张图像、覆盖 20 种海洋物种，并体现光照、浑浊度、遮挡等真实水下挑战。作者评估了 13 个深度学习模型，包括轻量 CNN（SqueezeNet、MobileNetV2）与 Transformer 架构（ViT、ConvNeXt），结果显示 ConvNeXt 表现最佳，Top-3 准确率 98.82%、Top-1 准确率 90.69%、F1 分数 88.92%。此外，作者用 GRAD-CAM 和 LIME 做可解释性分析，指出水下物种识别仍有较大改进空间。
Motivation: 水下环境中的浑浊、低光照和遮挡会严重降低标准视觉系统的性能，鲁棒水下视觉识别仍是显著挑战；现有研究缺乏一个能够反映真实环境困难且覆盖多种海洋物种的综合基准数据集。
Method: 构建并公开 AQUA20 数据集，包含 20 类海洋物种的 8,171 张水下图像；系统性评测 13 个主流深度学习模型（含 SqueezeNet、MobileNetV2 等轻量 CNN 以及 ViT、ConvNeXt 等基于 Transformer 的架构），并使用 GRAD-CAM 与 LIME 对模型预测进行可解释性分析。
Result: 摘要报告 ConvNeXt 取得最佳性能：Top-3 准确率 98.82%、Top-1 准确率 90.69%、总体 F1 分数 88.92%，参数规模适中；其他基准模型展示了复杂度与性能之间的权衡，且整体结果表明该任务仍有较大提升空间。
Conclusion: 作者认为 AQUA20 可作为水下物种识别领域未来研究的基础资源，并指出在困难水下条件下现有模型的表现距离实用仍有差距；数据集已公开提供。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: WebChoreArena: Evaluating Web Browsing Agents on Realistic Tedious Web Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Powered by large language models (LLMs), web browsing agents operate graphical user interfaces in a human-like manner, offering a transparent and general framework for automating web-based tasks. As these agents rapidly improve and achieve strong performance on existing benchmarks such as WebArena, a key question arises: $\textit{Can current benchmarks still accurately evaluate the capabilities of increasingly powerful agents, especially for more tedious and cognitively demanding tasks?}$ In this paper, we present $\textbf{WebChoreArena}$, a substantial extension of WebArena designed to push beyond general browsing scenarios. WebChoreArena introduces 532 carefully curated tasks developed over 300+ hours, explicitly targeting more labor-intensive and complex web chores. It systematically expands the evaluation space along three critical dimensions: (i) $\textbf{Massive Memory}$, requiring agents to accurately retain and retrieve large amounts of information from observations; (ii) $\textbf{Calculation}$, demanding precise mathematical reasoning over collected information; and (iii) $\textbf{Long-Term Memory}$, necessitating consistent information tracking across multiple webpages. Built directly on top of the four reproducible WebArena environments, WebChoreArena ensures strict compatibility and enables fair, controlled comparisons with prior work. Our experimental results demonstrate that as LLMs evolve, significant performance improvements are observed on WebChoreArena. These findings suggest that WebChoreArena is well-suited to measure the advancement of state-of-the-art LLMs with greater clarity. Nevertheless, the results also indicate that even with GPT-5, there remains substantial room for improvement compared to WebArena, highlighting the increased challenges posed by WebChoreArena.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WebChoreArena，一个基于 WebArena 大幅扩展的网页浏览 agent 评测基准，包含 532 个耗时 300+ 小时精心设计的任务，专门针对更繁琐、认知要求更高的网页杂务。基准沿三个维度扩展评估空间：大规模记忆 (Massive Memory)、计算 (Calculation) 和长期记忆 (Long-Term Memory)，并直接构建在四个可复现的 WebArena 环境之上以保证兼容性。实验显示，随着 LLM 能力的提升，模型在 WebChoreArena 上取得显著性能进步，但即使是 GPT-5 仍留有较大改进空间，说明该基准比 WebArena 更具挑战性。
Motivation: 现有基准如 WebArena 在越来越强大的 LLM 驱动的网页浏览 agent 上已接近饱和，可能无法准确区分更繁琐、认知要求更高的任务上的真实能力差异，因此需要更具区分度的新基准。
Method: 在四个可复现的 WebArena 环境上搭建 WebChoreArena，新增 532 个任务，并沿三个关键维度系统扩展评估空间：要求 agent 从观察中准确保留和检索大量信息的 Massive Memory、需要对收集信息进行精确数学推理的 Calculation、以及要求跨多个网页持续追踪信息的 Long-Term Memory。
Result: 实验结果表明，随着 LLM 进化，模型在 WebChoreArena 上出现明显的性能提升，说明该基准能更清晰地衡量前沿 LLM 的进步；然而即使 GPT-5 相比 WebArena 也仍有大量改进余地，反映出 WebChoreArena 带来的难度提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为 WebChoreArena 适合用于以更高分辨率度量 SOTA LLM 的进步，同时也凸显了当前模型在繁琐且认知密集的网页任务上仍存在明显不足。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EgoBrain: Synergizing Minds and Eyes For Human Action Understanding
papers.abstract_en: The integration of brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), in particular electroencephalography (EEG), with artificial intelligence (AI) has shown tremendous promise in decoding human cognition and behavior from neural signals. In particular, the rise of multimodal AI models have brought new possibilities that have never been imagined before. Here, we present EgoBrain -- the world's first large-scale, temporally aligned multimodal dataset that synchronizes first-person (egocentric) vision and EEG of human brain over extended periods of time, establishing a new paradigm for human-centered behavior analysis. This dataset comprises 61 hours of synchronized 32-channel EEG recordings and first-person video from 40 participants engaged in 29 categories of daily activities. We then developed a multimodal learning framework to fuse EEG and vision for action understanding, validated across both cross-subject and cross-environment challenges, achieving an action recognition accuracy of 66.70%. EgoBrain paves the way toward a unified framework for multimodal and egocentric brain-computer interfaces, bridging neural signals and first-person perception. Our dataset and code are publicly available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ut-vision/EgoBrain and https://github.com/ut-vision/EgoBrain .
papers.comment: Accepted to ICLR 2026. Camera-ready version. Project page: https://lin-nie.github.io/EgoBrain/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoBrain，据称是首个大规模、时间对齐的多模态数据集，将第一人称（egocentric）视频与人类脑电（EEG）信号在长时间跨度上同步采集。数据包含 40 名参与者在 29 类日常活动中 61 小时的 32 通道 EEG 与第一人称视频；作者还开发了一个融合 EEG 与视觉的多模态学习框架用于动作理解，在跨被试与跨环境设定下达到 66.70% 的动作识别准确率。数据集与代码已公开。
Motivation: 脑机接口（BCI）尤其是 EEG 与 AI 结合在解码人类认知与行为方面有巨大潜力，多模态 AI 模型也带来新可能；但缺乏大规模、长时间同步的第一人称视觉与大脑信号的公开数据，限制了以人为中心的行为分析研究。
Method: 构建 EgoBrain 数据集：40 名参与者在 29 类日常活动中同步采集 32 通道 EEG 与第一人称视频，共 61 小时；并提出一个融合 EEG 与视觉信息的多模态学习框架进行动作理解，同时在跨被试和跨环境条件下验证。
Result: 在跨被试与跨环境挑战下，动作识别准确率达到 66.70%。
Conclusion: EgoBrain 为多模态与第一人称脑机接口的统一框架奠定基础，桥接神经信号与第一人称感知；论文未在摘要中说明明显局限性，仅强调数据集与代码公开可用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Alignment to Synthesis Contrastive Volumetric Grounding for Text-to-CT Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating semantically controllable 3D CT volumes from radiology reports requires more than a rich text encoder, it requires vision-language alignment grounded in volumetric space. Existing Text-to-CT approaches condition generation on encoders pretrained with language only or 2D vision-language objectives, providing conditioning signals that are linguistically expressive but volumetrically blind. We argue this is a structural limitation: the quality of 3D vision-language alignment, not the richness of the text encoder, is the primary bottleneck for semantic controllability in volumetric diffusion models. To address this, we propose a generation-oriented 3D-CLIP encoder trained with structured hard negatives that operate exclusively at the text level. This design increases contrastive difficulty without any additional 3D memory cost, overcoming the small-batch constraints inherent to volumetric encoders. The resulting encoder conditions a fully end-to-end latent diffusion model that operates directly in 3D latent space, eliminating the spatial artifacts and cross-slice inconsistencies introduced by super-resolution pipelines. Through systematic ablations, we establish a clear empirical link between grounding quality and downstream generative controllability. Evaluated on CT-RATE across 18 pathological conditions, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on both image fidelity and factual correctness, while requiring less inference time and GPU memory than all competing methods. Code is at https://github.com/danielemolino/Text2CT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种生成导向的 3D-CLIP 编码器，使用仅在文本层级的结构化难负样本 (structured hard negatives) 训练，并配合直接在 3D 隐空间操作的端到端潜扩散模型，解决 3D 视觉-语言对齐质量对体素扩散模型语义可控性的瓶颈。在 CT-RATE 的 18 种病理条件下达到图像保真度和事实正确性的最优表现，且推理时间和 GPU 内存均低于对比方法。
Motivation: 现有 Text-to-CT 方法依赖仅用语言或 2D 视觉-语言目标预训练的编码器，其条件信号在语言上表达丰富但在体素空间上是盲的；作者认为 3D 视觉-语言对齐质量而非文本编码器丰富度才是体素扩散模型语义可控性的主要瓶颈。
Method: 训练一个生成导向的 3D-CLIP 编码器，通过只在文本层面构建的结构化难负样本增加对比难度，不增加额外 3D 内存开销，从而规避体素编码器的小批次限制；该编码器条件化一个完全端到端、直接在 3D 隐空间中运行的潜扩散模型，避免超分管线引入的空间伪影与跨切片不一致。
Result: 在 CT-RATE 数据集上覆盖 18 种病理条件，方法在图像保真度和事实正确性上均达到 SOTA，并且比所有竞争方法推理时间更短、GPU 内存更低；系统消融实验建立了 grounding 质量与下游生成可控性之间的实证联系。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 3D 视觉-语言对齐质量而非文本编码器丰富度是体素扩散模型语义可控性的关键瓶颈，并指出文本级结构化难负样本可在不增加 3D 内存成本的前提下提升对齐质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Temporal Convolutional Autoencoder for Interference Mitigation in FMCW Radar Altimeters
papers.abstract_en: Reliable altitude estimation with frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) radar altimeters is increasingly a challenge due to in-band interference from modern communication systems. In this paper, we present a temporal convolutional autoencoder (TCAE) that directly processes in-phase and quadrature (IQ) samples to suppress structured interference while preserving signal phase and frequency content for range estimation. The model is trained and initially evaluated within a full radar altimeter simulation chain, then further validated via over-the-air (OTA) experiments using a universal software radio peripheral (USRP)-based testbed. Results show that the TCAE reduces altitude estimation error by more than 85% compared to least mean squares (LMS) adaptive filtering under severe interference conditions, including low signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) and full temporal overlap between interfering and radar signals. Unlike conventional methods, the TCAE maintains phase fidelity and beat structure, enabling accurate range estimation even when interferers occupy more than one-quarter of the radar bandwidth. The implemented TCAE performs mitigation directly on fixed-length IQ windows using a single feed-forward pass and was integrated into the MATLAB/ONNX-based evaluation chain used for both simulation and OTA testing. These findings demonstrate that learned IQ-domain interference mitigation can enhance radar-altimeter resilience under a range of tested interference conditions.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 8 figures; final version to appear in IEEE Access
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现代通信系统带内干扰导致 FMCW 雷达高度表测高可靠性下降的问题，提出一种时序卷积自编码器 (temporal convolutional autoencoder, TCAE)，直接处理 IQ 采样以抑制结构化干扰，同时保留信号相位与频率信息用于距离估计。模型在完整雷达高度表仿真链中训练和评估，并通过基于 USRP 的外场 (over-the-air, OTA) 实验进一步验证。摘要报告在低 SINR 且干扰与雷达信号完全时间重叠的严重干扰条件下，TCAE 相比 LMS 自适应滤波将测高误差降低超过 85%。
Motivation: FMCW 雷达高度表因现代通信系统的带内干扰而难以保持可靠的测高性能，传统方法在强干扰下误差较大。
Method: 提出 TCAE，对固定长度的 IQ 窗口进行单次前向推理实现干扰抑制；模型在完整雷达高度表仿真链中训练，并集成到基于 MATLAB/ONNX 的评估链中，用于仿真和 OTA 测试。
Result: 在严重干扰条件下（低 SINR、干扰与雷达信号完全时间重叠），TCAE 相比 LMS 自适应滤波将测高误差降低超过 85%；即使干扰占用超过四分之一雷达带宽，仍能保持相位保真和拍频结构，实现准确距离估计。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，学习式的 IQ 域干扰抑制能够增强雷达高度表在多种测试干扰条件下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: HyperFake: Hyperspectral Reconstruction and Attention-Guided Analysis for Advanced Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deepfakes pose a significant threat to digital media security, with current detection methods struggling to generalize across different manipulation techniques and datasets. While recent approaches combine CNN-based architectures with Vision Transformers or leverage multi-modal learning, they remain limited by the inherent constraints of RGB data. We introduce HyperFake, a novel deepfake detection pipeline that reconstructs 31-channel hyperspectral data from standard RGB videos, revealing hidden manipulation traces invisible to conventional methods. Using an improved MST++ architecture, HyperFake enhances hyperspectral reconstruction, while a spectral attention mechanism selects the most critical spectral features for deepfake detection. The refined spectral data is then processed by an EfficientNet-based classifier optimized for spectral analysis, enabling more accurate and generalizable detection across different deepfake styles and datasets, all without the need for expensive hyperspectral cameras. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first approach to leverage hyperspectral imaging reconstruction for deepfake detection, opening new possibilities for detecting increasingly sophisticated manipulations.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Preliminary results on FaceForensics++ dataset. First approach to use hyperspectral reconstruction for deepfake detection
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperFake，一个从标准 RGB 视频重建 31 通道高光谱数据以进行深度伪造检测的流程。方法用改进的 MST++ 架构做高光谱重建，用光谱注意力机制选择关键光谱特征，再交给面向光谱分析的 EfficientNet 分类器。摘要称这是首篇将高光谱图像重建用于 deepfake 检测的工作，并在 FaceForensics++ 上给出初步结果，声称无需高光谱相机即可提升跨操纵类型和数据集的泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有 deepfake 检测方法多基于 RGB 数据，受限于 RGB 的固有信息，难以在不同操纵技术和数据集间泛化。作者希望借助高光谱数据中隐藏的伪造痕迹来突破这一限制，同时避免依赖昂贵的高光谱相机。
Method: 提出 HyperFake 流水线：先用改进的 MST++ 架构从标准 RGB 视频重建 31 通道高光谱数据，再通过光谱注意力机制筛选判别性最强的光谱特征，最后由针对光谱分析优化的 EfficientNet 分类器进行检测。
Result: 摘要在 FaceForensics++ 数据集上报告初步结果，未给出具体数值；主要声称该方法在不需要高光谱相机的情况下，相比传统 RGB 方法能更准确、更泛化地检测不同 deepfake 风格与数据集。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是首个利用高光谱图像重建进行 deepfake 检测的方法，为检测更复杂的操纵开辟了新可能。摘要未讨论明确的局限性；仅提及初步结果（6 页、1 张表）。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Cell Must Go On: Agar.io for Continual Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual reinforcement learning (RL) concerns agents that are expected to learn continually, rather than converge to a policy that is then fixed for evaluation. This setting is well-suited to environments that the agent perceives as changing over time, rendering any static policy ineffective. In continual RL, researchers often simulate such changes either by modifying episodic environments to incorporate task shifts during interaction or by designing simulators that explicitly model continual dynamics. However, transforming episodic problems into continual ones primarily captures scenarios involving abrupt changes in the data stream and still relies on episodic structure. Meanwhile, the few simulators explicitly designed for empirical continual RL research are often limited in scope or complexity. In this paper, we introduce AgarCL, a research platform for continual RL that enables agents to progress toward increasingly sophisticated behaviour. AgarCL is based on the game Agar.io, a non-episodic, high-dimensional problem with stochastic, ever-evolving dynamics, continuous actions, and partial observability. We provide benchmark results for DQN, PPO, and SAC on the primary continual RL challenge, as well as across a suite of smaller tasks within AgarCL. These smaller tasks isolate aspects of the full environment and allow us to characterize the distinct challenges posed by different components of the game. We further evaluate three continual learning methods-Shrink and Perturb, ReDo, and Continual Backpropagation-and observe little improvement over standard RL algorithms, suggesting that the challenges posed by AgarCL extend beyond the stability-plasticity dilemma.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgarCL，一个基于游戏 Agar.io 的持续强化学习 (continual RL) 研究平台，其环境为非情节式 (non-episodic)、高维、随机且随时间演化，具有连续动作与部分可观测性。作者在主要持续 RL 挑战及一系列用于隔离环境成分的小任务上给出 DQN、PPO、SAC 的基准结果，并评估 Shrink and Perturb、ReDo 与 Continual Backpropagation 三种持续学习方法。摘要报告这些持续学习方法相比标准 RL 算法改进甚微，表明 AgarCL 带来的挑战超越了稳定性-可塑性困境 (stability-plasticity dilemma)。
Motivation: 现有持续 RL 研究多通过改造情节式环境加入任务切换来模拟环境变化，这类做法主要捕捉数据流中的突变且仍依赖情节结构；而少数专门为持续 RL 设计的模拟器在范围或复杂度上受限。因此需要一个非情节式、复杂且能表征持续动态的研究平台。
Method: AgarCL 以 Agar.io 游戏为基础，构建具有随机、持续演化动态、连续动作和部分可观测性的非情节式高维环境；同时设计一组较小的任务来隔离完整环境中的不同成分，以刻画各组成部分带来的独特挑战。
Result: 摘要给出 DQN、PPO 与 SAC 在主要持续 RL 挑战及多个小任务上的基准结果；对 Shrink and Perturb、ReDo 和 Continual Backpropagation 的评估显示，它们相比标准 RL 算法几乎没有带来改进。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 AgarCL 所提出的挑战超出稳定性-可塑性困境的范畴，该平台可用于推动持续 RL 研究朝更复杂行为的方向发展。

papers.title: SuperCoder: Assembly Program Superoptimization with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Superoptimization is the task of transforming a program into a faster one, and ideally the very fastest possible one, while preserving its input-output behavior. In this work, we investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can serve as superoptimizers, generating assembly programs that outperform code already optimized by industry-standard compilers in end-to-end runtime. We construct the first large-scale benchmark for this problem, consisting of 8,072 assembly programs averaging 130 lines, in contrast to prior datasets restricted to 2-15 straight-line, loop-free programs. We evaluate 23 LLMs on this benchmark and find that the strongest baseline, Claude-opus-4, achieves a 51.5% test-passing rate and a 1.43x average speedup over gcc -O3. To further enhance performance, we fine-tune models with reinforcement learning, optimizing a reward function that integrates correctness and performance speedup. Starting from Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct (61.4% correctness, 1.10x speedup), the fine-tuned model SuperCoder attains 95.0% correctness and 1.46x average speedup, with additional improvement enabled by Best-of-N sampling and iterative refinement. Our results demonstrate, for the first time, that LLMs can be applied as superoptimizers for assembly programs, establishing a foundation for future research in program performance optimization beyond compiler heuristics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）能否作为超优化器（superoptimizer），将汇编程序转换为比工业级编译器（gcc -O3）优化后运行更快的版本，同时保持输入输出行为。作者构建了首个大规模汇编程序超优化基准，包含 8,072 个平均 130 行的程序，并评估了 23 个 LLM；最强的基线 Claude-opus-4 达到 51.5% 的测试通过率和 1.43 倍平均加速。通过强化学习微调 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct，得到的 SuperCoder 模型将正确率提升到 95.0%，平均加速提升到 1.46 倍，首次证明 LLM 可用于汇编程序的超优化。
Motivation: 传统编译器优化依赖人工设计的启发式规则，而经典超优化方法只能处理 2-15 行的无循环直线程序，难以扩展到真实规模。本文希望探索 LLM 是否能在汇编层面生成超越编译器优化效果的代码，并为此建立一个大规模基准。
Method: 作者构建了包含 8,072 个平均 130 行汇编程序的大规模基准，系统评估 23 个 LLM 在超优化任务上的表现；随后以 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct 为基础，通过强化学习微调，奖励函数同时衡量程序正确性和运行时加速，并结合 Best-of-N 采样与迭代细化进一步提升性能。
Result: 最强基线 Claude-opus-4 的测试通过率为 51.5%，平均加速为 1.43 倍（相对 gcc -O3）；微调后的 SuperCoder 从初始的 61.4% 正确率和 1.10 倍加速提升到 95.0% 正确率和 1.46 倍平均加速，额外使用 Best-of-N 采样和迭代细化可继续改善结果。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该工作首次展示了 LLM 可以作为汇编程序的超优化器，为超越编译器启发式的程序性能优化研究奠定了基础。

papers.title: Optimal Transport for Machine Learners
papers.abstract_en: Modern machine learning repeatedly manipulates probability measures: empirical datasets, generated samples, latent distributions, class-conditional laws, particle systems, weights of wide networks and attention patterns. Optimal transport is useful in this setting because it compares such objects by asking how mass should move. It therefore combines a statistically meaningful notion of discrepancy with a geometry of interpolation, dual certificates and variational dynamics. This makes OT a common language for losses, generative modeling, domain adaptation, robust learning, barycenters, gradient flows and mean-field descriptions of learning algorithms. This book presents the main OT techniques with these machine-learning uses in mind. It starts from finite assignment and the Monge map viewpoint, passes to Kantorovich couplings and dual potentials, and then explains the algorithmic ideas that make transport usable: linear programming, semi-discrete cells, Sinkhorn scaling and low-dimensional projections. The same objects are then reused as a geometry of measures, giving Wasserstein distances, barycenters, gradient flows, dynamic formulations and Gaussian/Bures formulas. The final chapters emphasize the variants most relevant to modern ML: divergences and adversarial losses, entropic and unbalanced relaxations, robust or spectral ground geometries, Gromov and quantum extensions, and transport-based views of generative models, mean-field networks and attention dynamics. The goal is to keep the mathematics explicit while exposing the computational and geometric intuitions needed to turn OT into a working toolbox for machine learners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一本面向机器学习研究者的最优传输 (OT) 专著，系统梳理从 Monge 映射、Kantorovich 耦合到 Sinkhorn 算法、半离散单元与低维投影等计算工具，并把 Wasserstein 距离、重心 (barycenter)、梯度流与动态公式统一为测度几何。最后章节聚焦现代 ML 相关变体，包括对抗损失、熵正则与非平衡松弛、鲁棒/谱底几何、Gromov 与量子扩展，以及生成模型、平均场网络和注意力动力学的传输视角。目标是在保持数学明确的同时，给出将 OT 用于机器学习所需的计算与几何直觉。
Motivation: 现代机器学习反复处理概率测度（经验数据集、生成样本、潜在分布、类别条件分布、粒子系统、宽网络权重、注意力模式等），需要一种既具有统计意义又能刻画插值与对偶结构的分布比较工具，而最优传输恰好通过“质量如何移动”来满足这一需求。
Method: 全书从有限指派和 Monge 映射视角出发，过渡到 Kantorovich 耦合与对偶势，再讲解线性规划、半离散 cells、Sinkhorn 缩放和低维投影等可计算算法；随后将这些对象复用为测度几何，导出 Wasserstein 距离、重心、梯度流、动态公式及 Gaussian/Bures 公式，并覆盖熵与不平衡松弛、鲁棒/谱几何、Gromov 与量子扩展等现代变体。
Result: 作为一本专著，摘要未报告具体实验数据或基准结果；其核心贡献在于系统组织 OT 理论与算法，并明确其与生成建模、域适应、鲁棒学习、重心、梯度流及平均场学习算法描述的关联。
Conclusion: 作者强调该书的目的是让 OT 成为机器学习学习者可用的工具箱，在保持数学显式性的同时提供计算与几何层面的可操作直觉。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: Decentralized Nonconvex Composite Federated Learning with Gradient Tracking and Momentum
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized Federated Learning (DFL) enables collaborative model training without relying on a central server. When local objectives are nonconvex and coupled with nonsmooth weakly convex regularization, DFL gives rise to a challenging decentralized nonconvex composite optimization problem involving data heterogeneity, stochastic-gradient noise, and consensus error. We propose DEPOSITUM, a decentralized composite optimization algorithm for this problem. DEPOSITUM maintains momentum-filtered stochastic gradient estimates via a tracking mechanism, which accommodates both Polyak and Nesterov momentum. It further allows multiple local updates between communication rounds to improve communication efficiency. Theoretical analysis demonstrates that it achieves an expected $ε$-stationary point with an iteration complexity of $\mathcal{O}(1/ε^2)$ without imposing bounded gradient heterogeneity or mean-squared smoothness assumptions. With an appropriate stepsize and momentum schedule, the averaged stationarity measure further achieves a rate of \(\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{nT})\) after a network-dependent transient, using a mini-batch size independent of $T$. Experiments on different benchmark datasets validate the effectiveness of DEPOSITUM and demonstrate competitive performance against representative federated composite optimization methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DEPOSITUM，一种面向去中心化联邦学习（DFL）的非凸复合优化算法，处理局部目标非凸且带有非光滑弱凸正则、数据异构、随机梯度噪声与共识误差耦合的问题。算法通过追踪机制维护动量过滤的随机梯度估计，兼容 Polyak 与 Nesterov 动量，并允许通信轮之间进行多次本地更新。理论分析给出期望 ε-驻点的迭代复杂度 O(1/ε²)，并在松弛假设下得到网络相关暂态后的平均驻点测度 O(1/√(nT))；多个基准数据集上的实验验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 去中心化联邦学习没有中心服务器，当局部目标非凸并耦合非光滑弱凸正则时，形成具有数据异构、随机噪声和共识误差的去中心化非凸复合优化问题，现有方法在假设条件与效率上存在不足。
Method: DEPOSITUM 采用追踪（tracking）机制维护动量过滤的随机梯度估计，统一支持 Polyak 与 Nesterov 动量，并允许通信之间多次本地更新以提升通信效率。
Result: 在不需要有界梯度异构或均方光滑性假设的情况下达到期望 ε-驻点的迭代复杂度 O(1/ε²)；在适当步长与动量调度下，平均驻点测度在网络相关暂态后达到 O(1/√(nT))，且 mini-batch 大小与 T 无关；实验表明其在多个基准数据集上相对代表性联邦复合优化方法具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 作者强调 DEPOSITUM 在较弱假设下获得非凸复合 DFL 的收敛保证，并在基准实验上展现竞争性能。

summary_sections.motivation: 去中心化联邦学习没有中心服务器，当局部目标非凸并耦合非光滑弱凸正则时，形成具有数据异构、随机噪声和共识误差的去中心化非凸复合优化问题，现有方法在假设条件与效率上存在不足。
summary_sections.method: DEPOSITUM 采用追踪（tracking）机制维护动量过滤的随机梯度估计，统一支持 Polyak 与 Nesterov 动量，并允许通信之间多次本地更新以提升通信效率。
summary_sections.result: 在不需要有界梯度异构或均方光滑性假设的情况下达到期望 ε-驻点的迭代复杂度 O(1/ε²)；在适当步长与动量调度下，平均驻点测度在网络相关暂态后达到 O(1/√(nT))，且 mini-batch 大小与 T 无关；实验表明其在多个基准数据集上相对代表性联邦复合优化方法具有竞争力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调 DEPOSITUM 在较弱假设下获得非凸复合 DFL 的收敛保证，并在基准实验上展现竞争性能。

papers.title: Artifact detection and localization in single-channel mobile EEG for sleep research using deep learning and attention mechanisms
papers.abstract_en: Current methods for detecting artifacts in sleep EEG range from threshold-based algorithms to machine learning approaches, yet applications remain limited for single-channel mobile EEG. We propose a convolutional neural network (CNN) model incorporating a convolutional block attention module (CNN-CBAM) to detect and localize artifacts in sleep EEG using attention maps. We benchmarked this model against 6 other machine learning and signal processing approaches. We trained/tuned all models on 72 manually annotated EEG recordings obtained during home-based monitoring from 18 healthy participants with a mean (SD) age of 68.05 y ($\pm$5.02). We tested them on 26 separate recordings from 6 healthy participants with a mean (SD) age of 68.33 y ($\pm$4.08), which contained artifacts in 4\% of epochs. CNN-CBAM achieved the highest area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (0.88), sensitivity (0.81), and specificity (0.86) among the tested approaches. Under the ideal choice of an attention threshold of 0.66, the attention maps from CNN-CBAM localized artifacts within detected artifact epochs with a sensitivity of 0.61 and specificity of 0.63. This work demonstrates the feasibility of automating artifact detection and localization in wearable sleep EEG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合卷积块注意力模块的卷积神经网络 (CNN-CBAM)，用于单通道移动睡眠 EEG 的伪迹检测与定位。作者在 18 名健康受试者、72 段居家监测记录上训练/调参，在 6 名受试者、26 段记录上测试，伪迹占 4% 的 epoch。CNN-CBAM 在 ROC AUC (0.88)、灵敏度 (0.81) 和特异度 (0.86) 上优于其他 6 种对比方法，并在注意力阈值 0.66 下实现伪迹定位。
Motivation: 现有睡眠 EEG 伪迹检测方法从阈值算法到机器学习均有应用，但对单通道移动 EEG 场景仍受限，需要能在可穿戴设备上自动检测并定位伪迹的可行方案。
Method: 提出 CNN-CBAM 模型：在 CNN 中嵌入卷积块注意力模块，利用注意力图同时检测伪迹 epoch 并定位伪迹在 epoch 内的位置；并与 6 种其他机器学习和信号处理方法进行基准比较。
Result: 在测试集上，CNN-CBAM 取得最高 AUC 0.88、灵敏度 0.81、特异度 0.86；在理想注意力阈值 0.66 下，伪迹定位的灵敏度为 0.61、特异度为 0.63。
Conclusion: 该工作表明在可穿戴睡眠 EEG 中自动检测与定位伪迹是可行的。

papers.title: LF${}^{2}$AR: Accounting for Layerwise Dynamics to Improve Multimodal Adaptation of Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-pretrained language models (LMs) encode rich world knowledge, but adapting them to process and generate perceptual modalities such as audio and images while effectively leveraging that knowledge remains challenging. Perceptual modalities are finer-grained and less semantically dense than text, making it unclear how functions learned during text pretraining can be reused. We study this problem through the lens of a layerwise abstraction-refinement dynamic observed in transformer LMs: representations first become more abstract and compositional, then are refined into representations predictive of fine-grained structure. This perspective suggests that adapting an LM to finer-grained modalities requires: (i) allocating additional fine-to-coarse processing at the input and coarse-to-fine processing at the output, consistent with late modality fusion and an output-side analogue we term late fission; and (ii) allowing the output predictor to preserve input-dependent selective access to both high-level semantic structure and low-level perceptual detail, motivating our use of attention residuals in fission. We instantiate this view in LF${}^{2}$AR, a simple architecture combining these mechanisms, and study it on text-as-images and speech, two modalities for which semantic correspondence to text can be controlled. Across models ranging from 135M to 2B parameters and adapted to these modalities, we find that these components increase feature abstraction, strengthen cross-modal alignment, enable such alignment to emerge at smaller compute budgets, improve preservation of text-like predictive structure, and yield better performance on text-as-images and speech versions of language understanding and reasoning benchmarks. Additionally, attention residuals induce sparse, interpretable use of deep backbone layers, enabling early-exit decoding with a 1.9$\times$ generation speedup.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从Transformer语言模型的逐层抽象-细化（abstraction-refinement）动态出发，提出LF${}^{2}$AR架构，将文本预训练语言模型适配到音频和图像等细粒度感知模态。架构结合了输入端的late modality fusion与输出端的类似机制late fission，并在输出预测器中使用attention residuals，以保留对高层语义和低层感知细节的输入依赖式访问。在text-as-images和语音两种模态、135M到2B参数规模的模型上，该方法提升了特征抽象、跨模态对齐、文本预测结构保持及下游基准性能，并支持1.9倍加速的早退解码。
Motivation: 文本预训练语言模型在适配感知模态（如音频和图像）时，很难复用文本预训练中学到的函数，因为感知模态比文本更细粒度、语义密度更低。现有研究缺乏对这一适配过程的机制性理解。
Method: 从层间抽象-细化动态出发，提出适配细粒度模态需要两类机制：在输入端增加细到粗（fine-to-coarse）处理、在输出端增加粗到细（coarse-to-fine）处理（后者称为late fission），并在输出预测器中引入attention residuals以保留对高层语义和低层细节的选择性访问。LF${}^{2}$AR是一个组合这些机制的简单架构。
Result: 在135M到2B参数模型上，摘要报告这些组件增强了特征抽象和跨模态对齐，使对齐能在更小计算预算下出现，改善文本类预测结构的保持，并在text-as-images和语音版本的语言理解与推理基准上取得更好性能。attention residuals还带来对深层骨干层稀疏、可解释的使用，支持早退解码并实现1.9倍生成加速。
Conclusion: 作者认为层间抽象-细化视角为多模态LM适配提供了有效设计原则，所提出的机制组合在多种模型规模和两种可控语义对应模态上均带来一致收益。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Error Bound Analysis for the Regularized Loss of Deep Linear Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: The optimization foundations of deep linear networks have recently received significant attention. However, due to their inherent non-convexity and hierarchical structure, analyzing the loss functions of deep linear networks remains a challenging task. In this work, we study the local geometry of the regularized squared loss of deep linear networks around each critical point. Specifically, we obtain a closed-form characterization of the critical point set building on existing results and establish an error bound for the regularized loss under mild conditions on network width and regularization parameters. Notably, this error bound quantifies the distance from a point to the critical point set in terms of the current gradient norm, which can be used to derive linear convergence of first-order methods. To support our theoretical findings, we conduct numerical experiments and demonstrate that gradient descent converges linearly to a critical point when optimizing the regularized loss of deep linear networks.
papers.comment: 44 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables; This paper is accepted for publication in Mathematics of Operations Research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究深度线性网络 (deep linear networks) 正则化平方损失的局部几何性质，在已有结果基础上给出临界点集合的闭式刻画，并在网络宽度和正则化参数的温和条件下建立误差界 (error bound)。该误差界用当前梯度范数量化点到临界点集合的距离，可用于推导一阶方法的线性收敛性；数值实验显示梯度下降在优化该正则化损失时线性收敛到临界点。
Motivation: 深度线性网络的损失函数因非凸性和层级结构而难以分析，此前对正则化损失在临界点附近的几何性质缺乏系统性刻画，这限制了对一阶方法收敛性的理论理解。
Method: 基于已有临界点刻画结果，推导正则化平方损失在临界点附近的闭式临界点集合表达，并在网络宽度和正则化参数的温和条件下证明误差界，将该误差界与梯度范数联系起来以支持线性收敛分析。
Result: 摘要报告获得了正则化损失的误差界，该误差界以当前梯度范数量化到临界点集合的距离，并据此推导出一阶方法的线性收敛；数值实验表明梯度下降对深度线性网络的正则化损失线性收敛到临界点。
Conclusion: 作者强调该误差界为深度线性网络正则化损失的优化分析提供了工具，并能够用于证明一阶方法的线性收敛性。

papers.title: A Rigorous Turing Test: a Foundation for Evaluating Artificial General Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Several studies claim that large language models have passed the Turing Test and hence can "think", yet none follow Turing's original instructions precisely. Passing the test holds significance as evidence that a machine demonstrates human-like intelligence, and as a marker for artificial-general intelligence in commercial and legal domains. We conducted Turing's three-player imitation game with an LLM by following the guidelines identified by Turing and applying scientific standards wherever detailed instructions were missing. We performed a computer-imitates-human game without duration constraints and a man-imitates-woman game as a benchmark. In the computer-imitates-human game, only one participant misidentified the large language model, indicating that claims of large language models' passing the Turing test are premature. Participants required over five minutes for both tasks, with the man-imitates-woman game taking longer; shorter time limits elsewhere may explain earlier positive results. We expect the Turing Test to remain central in assessing machine intelligence for years to come.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出此前声称大语言模型通过图灵测试并因此能“思考”的研究均未精确遵循图灵原始指令，并据此重新设计实验。作者按照图灵设定的三玩家模仿游戏，在无时长限制的 computer-imitates-human 游戏和 man-imitates-woman 基准游戏中测试 LLM，结果只有一名参与者将 LLM 误认为人类，表明 LLM 已通过图灵测试的说法为时过早。参与者完成两项任务均需超过五分钟，且 man-imitates-woman 游戏耗时更长，提示更短的时间限制可能是此前阳性结果的原因。
Motivation: 通过图灵测试常被当作机器展现类人智能的证据，并在商业和法律领域被视为通用人工智能 (AGI) 的标记；然而现有 LLM 通过图灵测试的声明都没有严格按图灵原始指示执行，因此需要更严谨的评估基础。
Method: 遵循图灵认定的指南，并在其缺少详细说明之处应用科学标准，开展计算机模仿人类的三玩家游戏（不设时长限制），并以男人模仿女人的游戏作为基准对照。
Result: 在 computer-imitates-human 游戏中仅一名参与者误认了 LLM，参与者完成两项任务均耗时超过五分钟，其中 man-imitates-woman 游戏用时更长；摘要认为较短时限可能是先前报告正面结果的原因。
Conclusion: 摘要预期图灵测试在未来数年仍将是评估机器智能的核心手段，并强调目前关于 LLM 已通过图灵测试的结论并不成熟。

papers.title: Motion-Aware Animatable Gaussian Avatars Deblurring
papers.abstract_en: The creation of 3D human avatars from multi-view videos is a significant yet challenging task in computer vision. However, existing techniques rely on high-quality, sharp images as input, which are often impractical to obtain in real-world scenarios due to variations in human motion speed and intensity. This paper introduces a novel method for directly reconstructing sharp 3D human Gaussian avatars from blurry videos. The proposed approach incorporates a 3D-aware, physics-based model of blur formation caused by human motion, together with a 3D human motion model designed to resolve ambiguities in motion-induced blur. This framework enables the joint optimization of the avatar representation and motion parameters from a coarse initialization. Comprehensive benchmarks are established using both a synthetic dataset and a real-world dataset captured with a 360-degree synchronous hybrid-exposure camera system. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of the model across diverse conditions. Codes Available: https://github.com/MyNiuuu/MAD-Avatar
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种从模糊多视角视频直接重建清晰3D人体高斯头像的方法。方法结合3D感知的基于物理的运动模糊形成模型和3D人体运动模型，以消除运动引起的模糊歧义，并从粗初始化开始联合优化头像表示与运动参数。作者在合成数据集和360度同步混合曝光相机系统采集的真实数据集上建立基准，实验表明该方法在多种条件下有效。
Motivation: 现有3D人体头像重建技术依赖高质量清晰图像作为输入，而真实场景中人体运动速度和强度变化常导致图像模糊，难以获得满足要求的清晰输入。
Method: 提出一个3D感知的基于物理的人体运动模糊形成模型，并配合一个3D人体运动模型来解析运动模糊的歧义，从而在联合优化框架中同时估计头像表示和运动参数。

Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能够直接从模糊视频重建清晰的3D高斯人体头像，并公开了代码。

papers.title: Regret of exploratory policy improvement and $q$-learning
papers.abstract_en: We study the convergence of $q$-learning and related algorithms introduced by Jia and Zhou (J. Mach. Learn. Res., 24 (2023), 161) for controlled diffusion processes. For exploratory policy improvement, we establish exponential convergence under growth and regularity assumptions on the model parameters. For q-learning, we derive quantitative error and regret bounds under additional assumptions on the function approximation and the associated stochastic approximation dynamics.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 1 figure. Several examples and remarks are added
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究受控扩散过程中 q-learning 及相关算法的收敛性，这些算法由 Jia 和 Zhou 提出。在模型参数的增长与正则性假设下，作者为探索性策略改进 (exploratory policy improvement) 建立指数收敛结果；在函数逼近和随机逼近动力学的额外假设下，为 q-learning 导出定量误差界与后悔界。
Motivation: 强化学习算法在连续时间受控扩散过程中的理论保证尚不完整，特别是探索性策略改进和 q-learning 的收敛速度与后悔界需要更严格的刻画。
Method: 在给定的模型假设下，分别对探索性策略改进证明指数收敛，并在函数逼近与随机逼近动力学假设下推导 q-learning 的定量误差与后悔上界。
Result: 摘要报告了探索性策略改进的指数收敛，以及 q-learning 在附加假设下的定量误差界和后悔界。
Conclusion: 该工作为连续时间受控扩散过程中的 q-learning 类算法提供了收敛性与后悔界的理论支撑，但结论依赖较严格的参数假设与逼近假设。

papers.title: See Me, Believe Me: Causality, Intersectionality, and Interventions Improving the Appearance of Patients
papers.abstract_en: In the context of medical records, patients often experience testimonial injustice, where the textual account undermines the validity of their experiences. Past work has demonstrated that intersectionality of demographic features is crucial to \emph{detect} such injustice. We use causal discovery to study the degree to which certain demographic features tied to marginalization (namely age, gender, and race), together lead to specific types of testimonial injustice terms. This offers us an insightful Structural Causal Model (SCM) relating those demographic features to the different ways a patients' reality may be undermined. We then move toward \emph{addressing} such injustice, by very selectively (based on insights from the SCM) editing physicians' notes. For comparison, we contrast these rule-based edits with blanket context-based modifications using an LLM. We assess the impact of these changes on the perception of patients' experiences, using human experts and an LLM. We find that edits, in general, enhance clarity regarding the urgency and causes of patients' conditions. Additionally, for human experts, rule-based modifications show a tendency to shift blame away from patients, and toward more objective external factors. These findings (1) underscore the importance of quantifying sources of injustice in how patients' testimonies are recorded, (2) reveal that making minimal intentional changes accordingly can effect improved patient perception, and (3) call for larger efforts to assess health outcomes under such more just representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究医疗记录中患者证词经常遭受的证词不公正 (testimonial injustice) 问题，即文本记录削弱了患者经验的有效性。作者用因果发现 (causal discovery) 构建结构因果模型 (SCM)，刻画年龄、性别、种族等边缘化相关人口特征如何共同导致特定类型的证词不公正表述，并据此对医生笔记做选择性编辑以改善患者观感。评估采用人类专家和 LLM 对比规则式编辑与基于 LLM 的全局上下文修改。
Motivation: 现有工作已表明人口特征的交汇性 (intersectionality) 对检测证词不公正至关重要，但少有研究从因果层面量化哪些人口特征共同导致不公正表述，也缺少从不公正检测走向实际干预的手段。
Method: 使用因果发现方法建立人口特征与证词不公正表述类型之间的 SCM；基于 SCM 的洞察对医生笔记做高度选择性的规则式编辑，并与使用 LLM 的无差别上下文修改进行对比；用人类专家和 LLM 两类评估者检验修改对患者经历感知的影响。
Result: 摘要报告称编辑总体上提升了患者病情紧迫性和原因的清晰度；对人类专家而言，规则式修改倾向于将责备从患者转移到更客观的外部因素。
Conclusion: 这些发现强调应量化患者证词记录中不公正的来源，表明相应地进行最小化、有意的修改即可改善患者感知，并呼吁开展更大规模研究以评估更公正表征下的健康结果。

papers.title: Weak Correlations as the Underlying Principle for Linearization of Gradient-Based Learning Systems
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models, such as wide neural networks, can be conceptualized as nonlinear dynamical physical systems characterized by a multitude of interacting degrees of freedom. Such systems in the infinite limit, tend to exhibit simplified dynamics. This paper delves into gradient descent-based learning algorithms, that display a linear structure in their parameter dynamics, reminiscent of the neural tangent kernel. We establish this apparent linearity arises due to weak correlations between the first and higher-order derivatives of the hypothesis function, concerning the parameters, taken around their initial values. This insight suggests that these weak correlations could be the underlying reason for the observed linearization in such systems. As a case in point, we showcase this weak correlations structure within neural networks in the large width limit. Exploiting the relationship between linearity and weak correlations, we derive a bound on deviations from linearity observed during the training trajectory of stochastic gradient descent. To facilitate our proof, we introduce a novel method to characterise the asymptotic behavior of random tensors.
papers.comment: 41 pages; 10 pages main tex; 0 figures. Aviv Orly added new results requested by the ICLR reviewers after the discussion phase had ended
papers.journal_ref: International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于梯度下降的学习算法在参数动力学中呈现线性结构（类似神经正切核）的现象，并论证这种表观线性源于假设函数关于参数的一阶与高阶导数在初始值附近的弱相关性。作者以宽神经网络为例展示该弱相关结构，并利用线性与弱相关的关系给出随机梯度下降训练轨迹偏离线性的界限。为完成证明，论文引入一种刻画随机张量渐近行为的新方法。
Motivation: 深度学习模型可视为由大量相互作用的自由度组成的非线性动力系统，而在无限极限下这类系统往往表现出简化动力学；论文试图解释梯度型学习算法中出现的线性参数动力学背后的统一原理。
Method: 提出弱相关性（weak correlations）作为线性化现象的潜在机制，证明线性来自假设函数一阶与高阶导数在初值附近的弱相关；为推导训练轨迹偏离线性的界限，引入刻画随机张量（random tensors）渐近行为的新方法。
Result: 在大宽度极限下的神经网络中展示出这种弱相关结构，并据此推导随机梯度下降训练轨迹偏离线性性的上界。
Conclusion: 论文的要点是弱相关性可能是此类系统中观察到线性化的根本原因，并强调该联系可用于分析训练动态；摘要未讨论具体实验验证或实际应用范围。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AMD:Anatomical Motion Diffusion with Interpretable Motion Decomposition and Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Generating realistic human motion sequences from text descriptions is a challenging task that requires capturing the rich expressiveness of both natural language and human motion. Recent advances in diffusion models have enabled significant progress in human motion synthesis. However, existing methods struggle to handle text inputs that describe complex or long motions. In this paper, we propose the Adaptable Motion Diffusion (AMD) model, which leverages a Large Language Model (LLM) to parse the input text into a sequence of concise and interpretable anatomical scripts that correspond to the target motion. This process exploits the LLM's ability to provide anatomical guidance for complex motion synthesis. We then devise a two-branch fusion scheme that balances the influence of the input text and the anatomical scripts on the inverse diffusion process, which adaptively ensures the semantic fidelity and diversity of the synthesized motion. Our method can effectively handle texts with complex or long motion descriptions, where existing methods often fail. Experiments on datasets with relatively more complex motions, such as CLCD1 and CLCD2, demonstrate that our AMD significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art models.
papers.comment: Corrected missing spaces in the abstract; no changes to the paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Adaptable Motion Diffusion (AMD)模型，利用大语言模型将输入文本解析为简洁可解释的解剖学脚本序列，并设计双分支融合方案以平衡文本与解剖脚本对逆扩散过程的影响，从而从文本描述生成真实人体运动序列。该方法主要针对复杂或长运动描述场景，实验在CLCD1和CLCD2数据集上显著优于现有最先进模型。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的人体运动合成方法难以处理描述复杂或长运动的文本输入，需要既能利用语言多样性又能保持合成运动语义保真度与多样性的机制。
Method: AMD使用LLM将输入文本解析为对应目标运动的解剖学脚本序列，利用LLM提供解剖学引导；随后设计双分支融合方案，在逆扩散过程中自适应平衡输入文本与解剖脚本的影响。
Result: 在CLCD1和CLCD2等包含较复杂运动的数据集上，AMD显著优于现有最先进模型；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 该方法能有效处理现有方法常失败的复杂或长运动文本描述，并通过解剖脚本与文本的融合保证语义保真度和多样性。

papers.title: From Fake to Real: Pretraining on Balanced Synthetic Images to Prevent Spurious Correlations in Image Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Visual recognition models are prone to learning spurious correlations induced by a biased training set where certain conditions $B$ (\eg, Indoors) are over-represented in certain classes $Y$ (\eg, Big Dogs). Synthetic data from off-the-shelf large-scale generative models offers a promising direction to mitigate this issue by augmenting underrepresented subgroups in the real dataset. However, by using a mixed distribution of real and synthetic data, we introduce another source of bias due to distributional differences between synthetic and real data (\eg synthetic artifacts). As we will show, prior work's approach for using synthetic data to resolve the model's bias toward $B$ do not correct the model's bias toward the pair $(B, G)$, where $G$ denotes whether the sample is real or synthetic. Thus, the model could simply learn signals based on the pair $(B, G)$ (\eg, Synthetic Indoors) to make predictions about $Y$ (\eg, Big Dogs). To address this issue, we propose a simple, easy-to-implement, two-step training pipeline that we call From Fake to Real (FFR). The first step of FFR pre-trains a model on balanced synthetic data to learn robust representations across subgroups. In the second step, FFR fine-tunes the model on real data using ERM or common loss-based bias mitigation methods. By training on real and synthetic data separately, FFR does not expose the model to the statistical differences between real and synthetic data and thus avoids the issue of bias toward the pair $(B, G)$. Our experiments show that FFR improves worst group accuracy over the state-of-the-art by up to 20\% over three datasets. Code available: https://github.com/mqraitem/From-Fake-to-Real
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 From Fake to Real (FFR) 的两阶段训练流程，用于缓解图像识别模型因偏见训练集而学到的虚假相关性 (spurious correlations)。FFR 先在平衡的合成数据上预训练以学习跨子组的鲁棒表示，再在真实数据上用 ERM 或常用损失式偏差缓解方法微调。实验表明，FFR 在三个数据集上将最差组准确率 (worst group accuracy) 相比现有技术提升最多 20%。
Motivation: 视觉识别模型容易因训练集中某些条件 B（如 Indoors）在特定类别 Y（如 Big Dogs）中过度代表而学习虚假相关性。使用合成数据增强欠代表子组时，直接混合真实与合成分布会引入新的偏差来源，使模型偏向 (B, G) 组合（G 表示样本是真实或合成），而先前方法未纠正这种偏差。
Method: 提出两阶段训练流程 FFR：第一步在平衡的合成数据上预训练，以获得跨子组的鲁棒表示；第二步在真实数据上使用 ERM 或基于损失的偏差缓解方法微调。通过将真实与合成数据分开训练，模型不会被暴露于二者之间的统计差异，从而避免对 (B, G) 组合产生偏差。
Result: 实验结果显示，FFR 在三个数据集上相比现有技术的最差组准确率提升最多 20%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分开训练合成与真实数据可以避免因数据分布差异引入的额外偏差，且 FFR 简单易实现；代码已公开。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出两阶段训练流程 FFR：第一步在平衡的合成数据上预训练，以获得跨子组的鲁棒表示；第二步在真实数据上使用 ERM 或基于损失的偏差缓解方法微调。通过将真实与合成数据分开训练，模型不会被暴露于二者之间的统计差异，从而避免对 (B, G) 组合产生偏差。
summary_sections.result: 实验结果显示，FFR 在三个数据集上相比现有技术的最差组准确率提升最多 20%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调分开训练合成与真实数据可以避免因数据分布差异引入的额外偏差，且 FFR 简单易实现；代码已公开。

papers.title: A Differentially Private Weighted Empirical Risk Minimization Procedure and its Application to Outcome Weighted Learning
papers.abstract_en: Data used to train predictive models via empirical risk minimization (ERM) often contain sensitive personal information. While differential privacy (DP) provides mathematically provable bounds to protect such data, previous work has focused almost exclusively on unweighted ERM. We consider weighted ERM (wERM) -- an important generalization where individual contributions to the objective function vary. We propose the first DP algorithm for general wERM with formal privacy guarantees and derive both its empirical and population utility bounds. Crucially, this general wERM framework provides a pathway for deriving privacy-preserving learning methods for individualized treatment rules, including the popular outcome-weighted learning (OWL) approach. We evaluate DP-wERM applied to OWL in simulated and real data experiments. Our empirical results demonstrate that training OWL models via wERM provides strong DP guarantees while maintaining robust performance, proving the method is practical for sensitive, real-world data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出第一个针对一般加权经验风险最小化（weighted ERM, wERM）的差分隐私（DP）算法，给出经验与总体效用界，并将其应用于结果加权学习（outcome-weighted learning, OWL）以保护个体化治疗规则训练中的敏感数据。模拟与真实数据实验显示，DP-wERM 训练的 OWL 模型在提供强隐私保证的同时保持稳健性能。
Motivation: 经验风险最小化训练常使用含敏感个人信息的数据，差分隐私可提供数学可证明的隐私保护，但已有工作几乎只关注无权重 ERM；加权 ERM 作为重要推广尚未有正式隐私保证的通用算法。
Method: 提出首个用于一般 wERM 的差分隐私算法，推导其经验与总体效用界，并将该通用框架用于个性化治疗规则学习，特别是 OWL 方法。
Result: 模拟与真实数据实验表明，通过 wERM 训练 OWL 模型能在提供强差分隐私保证的同时保持稳健性能，验证了方法在敏感真实世界数据上的实用性。
Conclusion: 该通用 wERM 差分隐私框架为隐私保护下学习个体化治疗规则提供了可行路径，摘要强调其在实际敏感数据上的实用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stochastic Subgradient Methods with Guaranteed Global Stability in Nonsmooth Nonconvex Optimization
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we focus on providing convergence guarantees for stochastic subgradient methods in minimizing nonsmooth nonconvex functions. We first investigate the global stability of a general framework for stochastic subgradient methods, where the corresponding differential inclusion admits a coercive Lyapunov function. We prove that, for any sequence of sufficiently small stepsizes and approximation parameters, coupled with sufficiently controlled noises, the iterates are uniformly bounded and asymptotically stabilize around the stable set of its corresponding differential inclusion. Moreover, we develop an improved analysis to apply our proposed framework to establish the global stability of a wide range of stochastic subgradient methods, where the corresponding Lyapunov functions are possibly non-coercive. These theoretical results illustrate the promising potential of our proposed framework for establishing the global stability of various stochastic subgradient methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究非光滑非凸优化中随机次梯度方法 (stochastic subgradient methods) 的收敛性保证，聚焦其全局稳定性。作者建立了一个通用分析框架，将迭代序列与微分包含 (differential inclusion) 相联系，并在存在强制性 Lyapunov 函数的条件下证明：只要步长与逼近参数足够小、噪声受控，迭代一致有界并渐近稳定到微分包含的稳定集附近。随后通过改进分析将该框架推广到 Lyapunov 函数可能非强制的情形，从而覆盖更广泛的随机次梯度方法。
Motivation: 非光滑非凸优化中的随机次梯度方法缺乏一般性的全局稳定性理论，已有结果往往依赖局部假设或强制性的 Lyapunov 函数，难以适用于更广泛的算法类别。
Method: 提出一个通用框架，将随机次梯度方法与其对应的微分包含相联系，在强制性 Lyapunov 函数下建立全局稳定性；再给出改进的分析，将结果扩展到非强制性 Lyapunov 函数，以覆盖更多随机次梯度方法。
Result: 摘要证明了对任意足够小的步长和逼近参数序列，在充分受控的噪声条件下，迭代序列一致有界并渐近稳定于对应微分包含的稳定集。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了为多种随机次梯度方法建立全局稳定性的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Causal Falsification of Digital Twins
papers.abstract_en: Digital twins are simulation-based models designed to predict how a real-world process will evolve in response to interventions. This modelling paradigm holds substantial promise in many applications, but rigorous procedures for assessing their accuracy are essential for safety-critical settings. We consider how to assess the accuracy of a digital twin using real-world data. We formulate this as a causal inference problem, which leads to a precise definition of what it means for a twin to be "correct". Unfortunately, fundamental results from causal inference mean observational data cannot be used to certify a twin in this sense unless potentially tenuous assumptions are made, such as that the data are unconfounded. To avoid these assumptions, we propose instead to find situations in which the twin is not correct, and present a general-purpose statistical procedure for doing so. Our approach yields reliable and actionable information about the twin under only the assumption of an i.i.d. dataset of observational trajectories, and remains sound even if the data are confounded. We apply our methodology to a large-scale, real-world case study involving sepsis modelling within the Pulse Physiology Engine, which we assess using the MIMIC-III dataset of ICU patients.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the Journal of Machine Learning Research (JMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用真实世界数据评估数字孪生 (digital twin) 模型的准确性，将该问题形式化为因果推断问题，并给出数字孪生“正确”的精确定义。作者指出观测数据在无混杂等假设下无法用于认证 (certify) 数字孪生，因此转而提出一种通用的统计程序来寻找孪生不正确的场景。该方法仅需 i.i.d. 的观测轨迹数据集，即使数据存在混杂也保持有效，并在 Pulse Physiology Engine 的败血症建模与 MIMIC-III 数据集上进行了大规模真实案例研究。
Motivation: 数字孪生在安全关键场景中应用潜力巨大，但缺乏严格的准确性评估程序；观测数据通常无法在不作脆弱假设（如无混杂）的情况下认证数字孪生的因果正确性。
Method: 放弃认证数字孪生正确性，转而寻找其不正确的场景；提出一个通用的统计伪造 (falsification) 程序，仅假设观测轨迹数据集为 i.i.d.，且允许数据存在混杂。
Result: 该方法在 Pulse Physiology Engine 中的败血症建模案例上，使用 MIMIC-III ICU 患者数据集进行了大规模真实世界评估。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法能在无混杂假设下提供关于数字孪生的可靠且可操作的信息，适用于安全关键应用中的数字孪生验证。
Relevance: 5
