papers.title: Classical $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ Models Match or Exceed Shallow Variational Quantum Circuits on Vision Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Quaternion-valued neural networks and variational quantum circuits (VQCs) both derive local transformations from $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ geometry, yet their performance on classical supervised learning remains poorly understood. We compare real-valued, quaternion-valued, and quantum classification heads on identical frozen features across MNIST, FashionMNIST, and CIFAR-10. CIFAR-10 uses a learned 16-dimensional bottleneck and frozen ImageNet-pretrained ResNet18 features to separate architecture from representation quality. Quaternion classifiers match or approach real-valued baselines while outperforming shallow VQCs. On MNIST and FashionMNIST, quaternion networks nearly equal real-valued MLPs, whereas product-state VQCs show lower accuracy and higher cost. On CIFAR-10, quaternion networks retain 94--97% of real-valued performance and remain stable under a 32-fold increase in dimensionality. Product-state circuits underperform quaternion classifiers, while entanglement gives modest grayscale gains but reverses under pretrained CNN features (9.25 pp degradation vs.\ product-state). Fubini--Study/QFI natural gradients improve geometric alignment but not short-horizon loss reduction vs.\ Adam. A Friedman test on five-seed MNIST detects model differences ($χ^2=12.796$, $p=0.0051$, $n=5$), with Wilcoxon tests yielding large effect sizes ($d>5$) for QuatNet vs.\ quantum comparisons. For FashionMNIST and CIFAR-10, large effects ($d>2.0$) are the primary statistic given $n=3$. These results indicate that quaternion networks provide efficient, stable $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ alternatives to shallow VQCs on tasks lacking intrinsic quantum structure. Shared local $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ geometry and shallow entanglement are insufficient, within the regime studied, to confer practical quantum advantage. Conclusions are limited to shallow, measurement-limited circuits on such tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 MNIST、FashionMNIST 与 CIFAR-10 上比较了实值、四元数 (quaternion) 与变分量子电路 (VQC) 分类头在相同冻结特征上的表现。摘要报告四元数分类器能匹配或接近实值基线，并优于浅层 VQC；在 CIFAR-10 上保留实值性能的 94–97%，且在维度增加 32 倍时保持稳定。作者认为所研究的浅层纠缠结构不足以带来实际量子优势。
Motivation: 四元数神经网络与 VQC 都源于 SU(2) 几何的局部变换，但它们在经典监督学习上的性能差异尚不清楚；本研究旨在分离架构与表征质量，检验浅层 VQC 是否在无内在量子结构的视觉任务上具有实用优势。
Method: 在冻结特征上比较三类分类头；CIFAR-10 采用 16 维可学习瓶颈与冻结的 ImageNet 预训练 ResNet18 特征。量子侧考察 product-state 与纠缠电路，并测试 Fubini–Study/QFI 自然梯度相对于 Adam 的优化行为，辅以 Friedman 与 Wilcoxon 统计检验。
Result: 在 MNIST 与 FashionMNIST 上，四元数网络接近实值 MLP，而 product-state VQC 准确率更低且成本更高；在 CIFAR-10 上纠缠相对 product-state 在灰度图上仅有小幅提升，但在预训练 CNN 特征下反而退化 9.25 个百分点。自然梯度改善了几何对齐但未带来短视界损失下降；五种子 MNIST 的 Friedman 检验为 χ²=12.796、p=0.0051，四元数对量子的 Wilcoxon 效应量 d>5，FashionMNIST 与 CIFAR-10 上 d>2.0。
Conclusion: 四元数网络是该研究范围内高效、稳定的 SU(2) 经典替代方案；共享局部 SU(2) 几何与浅层纠缠不足以赋予实际量子优势，结论仅限于所研究任务上的浅层、受测量限制的电路。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Preserving Item Semantics for Free: Rethinking Token Initialization in LLM-Based Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative recommendation (GR) leverage large language models (LLMs) as recommender backbones, enabling LLMs to directly generate recommendations conditioned on item-interaction histories. In these systems, items are often represented through semantic IDs (SIDs) added to the LLM vocabulary as special tokens. Ideally, SIDs imbue item token representations with semantic priors, thereby improving model generalization. However, standard vocabulary expansion typically initializes these tokens as random Gaussian vectors, discarding the SIDs' underlying continuous geometry and forcing the LLM to relearn token relationships from interaction data. To demonstrate the consequences of this design, we first show that training from this initialization tends to organize SID embeddings around item popularity rather than semantics. We further show that, despite partially reducing the reliance on popularity and improving cold item performance, the computationally expensive process of continual pretraining (CPT) fails to reliably recover the original semantic geometry. To address these findings, we propose a simple, parameter-free intervention that initializes SID token embeddings directly from their corresponding centroids in the semantic embedding space. Requiring only a few lines of code and no additional training or inference overhead, this drop-in approach improves pure-SFT Recall@5 by up to 16%, reaches peak performance with up to 40% fewer SFT steps, and improves cold-item Recall@5 by up to 60%. Moreover, on datasets that benefit from additional CPT, centroid initialization reaches comparable performance while requiring half as many CPT epochs. Together, our findings show that preserving SID geometry, beyond shared-prefix structure, provides a simple and effective semantic prior for LLM-based GR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于LLM的生成式推荐（GR）中物品语义ID（SID）的token初始化问题。作者发现标准随机高斯初始化会使SID嵌入围绕物品流行度而非语义组织，且昂贵的持续预训练（CPT）无法可靠恢复语义几何。他们提出一种无参数干预：直接从语义嵌入空间的质心初始化SID token嵌入，仅需几行代码且无额外训练/推理开销，显著提升纯SFT和冷物品的Recall@5，并减少达到峰值性能所需的训练步骤。
Motivation: 生成式推荐系统将物品表示为加入LLM词汇表的特殊token（SID），理想情况下SID应携带语义先验以提升泛化，但标准词汇扩展通常随机初始化这些token，丢弃SID的连续几何结构，迫使模型从交互数据重新学习token关系。作者想证明这种初始化的后果，并提供一个简单的修复方案。
Method: 提出一个参数免费的drop-in干预：将SID token嵌入直接初始化为其在语义嵌入空间中对应质心的向量。该方法无需额外训练或推理开销，只改动初始化方式，并可与纯SFT或后续CPT流程兼容。
Result: 在纯SFT设置下Recall@5最高提升16%，达到峰值性能所需的SFT步数最多减少40%，冷物品Recall@5最高提升60%；在需要额外CPT的数据集上，质心初始化用一半CPT轮次即可达到相当性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为，除共享前缀结构外，保留SID的语义几何本身即为LLM-based生成式推荐提供了一种简单且有效的语义先验。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究基于LLM的生成式推荐（GR）中物品语义ID（SID）的token初始化问题。作者发现标准随机高斯初始化会使SID嵌入围绕物品流行度而非语义组织，且昂贵的持续预训练（CPT）无法可靠恢复语义几何。他们提出一种无参数干预：直接从语义嵌入空间的质心初始化SID token嵌入，仅需几行代码且无额外训练/推理开销，显著提升纯SFT和冷物品的Recall@5，并减少达到峰值性能所需的训练步骤。
summary_sections.motivation: 生成式推荐系统将物品表示为加入LLM词汇表的特殊token（SID），理想情况下SID应携带语义先验以提升泛化，但标准词汇扩展通常随机初始化这些token，丢弃SID的连续几何结构，迫使模型从交互数据重新学习token关系。作者想证明这种初始化的后果，并提供一个简单的修复方案。
summary_sections.method: 提出一个参数免费的drop-in干预：将SID token嵌入直接初始化为其在语义嵌入空间中对应质心的向量。该方法无需额外训练或推理开销，只改动初始化方式，并可与纯SFT或后续CPT流程兼容。
summary_sections.result: 在纯SFT设置下Recall@5最高提升16%，达到峰值性能所需的SFT步数最多减少40%，冷物品Recall@5最高提升60%；在需要额外CPT的数据集上，质心初始化用一半CPT轮次即可达到相当性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，除共享前缀结构外，保留SID的语义几何本身即为LLM-based生成式推荐提供了一种简单且有效的语义先验。

papers.title: Shape Mutating Expert Compression:LorExperts and BTExperts
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models deliver high capacity at low per-token compute, but deploying them cheaply requires compressing their many expert weight matrices. Expert pruning (e.g., REAP) and merging reduce cost but sacrifice accuracy and require retraining the router; low-rank delta decomposition of experts (e.g., D^2-MoE) preserves all experts and the router, but degrades sharply as the expert count grows because a single shared component cannot approximate many near-orthogonal experts. Because MoE expert weights are near-orthogonal, a single shared component (as in prior delta decomposition) scales poorly with the expert count; we show that experts nonetheless organize into functional co-activation communities that are decoupled from weight similarity. Building on this, we introduce LorExperts, a router-preserving compression method that clusters experts, keeps one full-precision dominant per cluster, and represents the remaining members as low-rank corrections to their local dominant. LorExperts retains all experts and the original router (no router retraining). At ~50% expert compression on Qwen3-30B-A3B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B, LorExperts preserves downstream accuracy and perplexity better than the baselines on most of the tasks; the margin over D^2-MoE grows with expert count E. We further give a reconstruction fine-tuning procedure for LorExperts, and BTExperts, a tree organization of dominants and corrections that enables inference-time amortization of shared computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 MoE 语言模型专家权重矩阵的压缩问题，观察到专家权重近似正交，但存在与权重相似性解耦的功能共激活社区 (functional co-activation communities)。据此提出 LorExperts：对专家聚类，每簇保留一个全精度 dominant，并将簇内其余专家表示为对该 dominant 的低秩校正，从而保留全部专家与原始 router，无需重训 router。在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 和 Gemma-4-26B-A4B 上约 50% 专家压缩下，多数任务上比基线更好地保持下游准确率与困惑度，且相对 D^2-MoE 的优势随专家数 E 增大。
Motivation: 部署 MoE 语言模型需要压缩大量专家权重矩阵以降低成本；专家剪枝和合并会牺牲精度并要求重训 router，而低秩 delta 分解 (如 D^2-MoE) 因使用单一共享分量来近似多个近正交专家，在专家数量增长时退化严重。
Method: 提出 LorExperts：对专家进行聚类，每个簇保留一个全精度 dominant 专家，其余成员表示为对该局部 dominant 的低秩校正，从而实现 router-preserving 压缩；还给出 reconstruction fine-tuning 流程，以及 BTExperts——一种将 dominants 与校正项组织成树结构、支持推理期共享计算分摊的方法。
Result: 在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 与 Gemma-4-26B-A4B 上实现约 50% 专家压缩，在大多数任务上比基线更好地保持下游准确率和困惑度；其相对 D^2-MoE 的收益随专家数 E 增大而扩大。
Conclusion: 摘要强调专家权重虽近正交但可按功能共激活社区组织，基于该结构的低秩校正压缩能在保留原始 router 的同时随专家规模扩展；BTExperts 进一步提供推理期共享计算的分摊。

papers.title: When the Judge Should Not Decide: Evidence-Locked, Non-Compensatory Selection Bounds LLM-Judge Failure in Reasoning Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: An LLM judge deployed inside a reasoning pipeline does not merely measure quality, it decides which answer ships. We show that the cost of that decision depends less on judge accuracy than on the decision rule the judge is embedded in. On frozen candidate pools from four GRPO policies, an unconstrained scalar DeepSeek-R1-7B judge buys almost nothing over answer-level majority vote (+1.0 pp on 500 GSM8K questions, +0.34 EM on 300 HotpotQA questions), and on a frozen-rule 30-question confirmation split it is 10 points worse than majority, a judge that destroys accuracy while scoring candidates confidently. We then subordinate the same judge to Evidence-Locked Derive-Gate-Repair (EL-DGR), a task-adaptive non-compensatory rule under which a judge preference may override evidence-supported consensus only with an extractive evidence certificate, and a repair only when neither alternative is certified and the repair is. With no change to the judge, the candidates, or the budget, EL-DGR reaches 58.2% on GSM8K (vs. 56.8% judge, 55.8% majority, 55.4% first candidate) and 17.33 EM / 25.46 F1 on HotpotQA (vs. 15.67/23.49, 15.33/23.19, 15.33/22.97), improving on first-candidate GRPO by +2.8 pp (exact McNemar p=0.0026) and +2.00 EM (p=0.070, borderline). A decision audit shows why: EL-DGR overturns consensus on only 8 of 30 pilot questions and never converts a correct consensus into an incorrect answer. We also report what did not work: the same seven-channel decomposition used as a step-level gated training reward is null, and corrected channel-drop ablations show no channel is individually necessary (p=1.0 throughout). The practitioner-facing finding is negative about judges and positive about admissibility, bound the judge's blast radius rather than trying to make it accurate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究推理流水线中 LLM judge 的决策价值，指出其代价主要取决于嵌入的决策规则而非 judge 本身的准确率。在四个 GRPO 策略的冻结候选池上，无约束标量 DeepSeek-R1-7B judge 相比答案级多数投票几乎没有收益，而 Evidence-Locked Derive-Gate-Repair (EL-DGR) 这一非补偿性选择规则在不改动 judge、候选或预算的情况下提升了 GSM8K 与 HotpotQA 结果。作者给出的实践结论是负面的：与其追求 judge 更准确，不如限制 judge 的决策影响范围。
Motivation: 现有 LLM judge 部署在推理流水线中不仅评估质量，还会决定最终输出的答案，而这一决策成本与 judge 嵌入的决策规则关系更大，现有工作往往只关注 judge 准确率而忽略规则设计。
Method: 提出 EL-DGR，一种任务自适应的非补偿性规则：judge 偏好只有在附带抽取式证据证书 (extractive evidence certificate) 时才能覆盖证据支持的共识；只有在两个候选都未被认证且修复方案被认证时才允许修复。同时将无约束标量 judge、多数投票和首个候选作为对照。
Result: 无约束 judge 在 500 条 GSM8K 上仅比多数投票高 +1.0 个百分点、在 300 条 HotpotQA 上高 +0.34 EM，在 30 题的确认集上反而比多数投票差 10 分。EL-DGR 在 GSM8K 达到 58.2%（对比 judge 56.8%、多数投票 55.8%、首个候选 55.4%），在 HotpotQA 达到 17.33 EM / 25.46 F1，相对首个候选 GRPO 提升 +2.8 个百分点（McNemar p=0.0026）与 +2.00 EM（p=0.070，边缘显著）；决策审计显示它仅在 30 题中的 8 题推翻共识，且从不把正确共识变成错误答案。此外，七通道分解用作步级门控训练奖励时效果为零，且修正后的通道剔除消融显示没有单一通道是必要的（p=1.0）。
Conclusion: 作者强调对实践者的启示是：对 judge 应持负面态度、对“可采纳性”约束持正面态度，应当限制 judge 的爆炸半径 (blast radius)，而不是试图提高其准确率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CausalNav: Reliability-Certified Causal World Models for Control under Physical-Parameter Shift
papers.abstract_en: A world model is only useful for physical AI if it changes what the agent does, and only safe if it declines to do so when it is wrong. We study both halves of that requirement with CausalNav, a controller built around a signed, action-conditioned transition graph over identified state coordinates. At deployment CausalNav simulates a small library of intervention sequences, converts their objective error into policy-logit advice, and admits that advice only when a scale-free predictive-reliability certificate, a policy-margin gate, and an argmax-agreement gate all pass; otherwise it falls back exactly to its own model-based base controller. We evaluate against nine controlled baselines (transformer, recurrent, split-latent, graph, causal-induction, and three recent model-based reasoning modules) on CartPole-v1 and discretized Pendulum-v1 with physical-parameter shifts, under one shared PPO trainer, one interaction budget, and ten held-out seeds (200 runs). CausalNav attains the best average rank (1.25 of ten). The diagnostic result is more informative than the ranking: the learned graph recovers structure well above chance (CartPole F1 = 0.59 +/- 0.09), yet per-seed structural fidelity is uncorrelated with per-seed control benefit (r = -0.15, p = 0.67), and the certificate abstains on 10/10 Pendulum seeds, where forcing the planner on costs return. Model fidelity did not predict downstream control utility in our setting; certified abstention, not better prediction, is what made the world model safe to deploy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CausalNav，一个围绕带符号、动作条件的转移图构建的控制器，用于在物理参数偏移下提供可靠的世界模型控制。部署时，CausalNav 模拟少量干预序列，将目标误差转化为策略 logit 建议，并仅当无标度预测可靠性证书、策略裕度门和 argmax 一致性门全部通过时才采纳该建议，否则回退到自身的基于模型的基础控制器。在 CartPole-v1 和离散化 Pendulum-v1 上、共享同一 PPO 训练器与交互预算下，CausalNav 在十个固定种子（200 runs）中取得十种受控基线里的最佳平均排名（1.25/10）。诊断结果显示，细粒度因果图结构恢复优于随机水平，但逐种子结构保真度与控制收益不相关，且证书在全部 Pendulum 种子上弃权，说明模型保真度不能预测下游控制效用。
Motivation: 世界模型只有在能实际改变智能体行为时才有用，并且在自身错误时拒绝改变行为才是安全的；现有方法往往没有同时满足这两个要求，尤其在物理参数偏移下预测误差与下游控制效用之间的关系不清晰。
Method: 构建带符号、动作条件的转移图作为因果世界模型，在部署时模拟一组干预序列，将目标误差转换为策略 logit 建议，并通过一个无标度预测可靠性证书、一个策略裕度门和一个 argmax 一致性门三者的联合判定来决定是否采纳建议；若不通过，则回退到基础模型控制器。
Result: 在统一 PPO 训练器、单一交互预算和十个保留种子的设置下，CausalNav 对九个受控基线（transformer、recurrent、split-latent、graph、causal-induction 及三个近期基于模型的推理模块）取得最佳平均排名（1.25/10）；CartPole 上的图结构恢复 F1=0.59±0.09，但逐种子结构保真度与逐种子控制收益无相关性（r=-0.15，p=0.67），且证书在 10/10 个 Pendulum 种子上弃权，强制规划器反而造成收益损失。
Conclusion: 作者强调，在本文设置中模型保真度并不能预测下游控制效用；真正让世界模型可安全部署的是有证书的弃权机制，而不是更好的预测本身。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The Anatomy of a Prompt Injection: A Component Model for Structured Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Four years after prompt injection was first identified in 2022, attacks are still predominantly documented as verbatim strings rather than structured exploits, despite advancing agent capabilities and threat actors embedding injections to subvert AI-assisted security analysis. This paper formalizes the structure of prompt-injection artifacts, enabling defenders, red teamers, and cyber threat intelligence (CTI) teams to label, compare, and mutate attacks without relying on fragile string matching. Because large language models compile varied natural-language realizations into identical executable actions, labeling must track attacker intent (tool targets, sinks, and effects) rather than surface wording. We propose a seven-component model (carrier, delivery vector, concealment, context-break, privilege escalation, payload, and return channel) consisting of five artifact fields and two environment fields. This framework unifies roles partially addressed by HOUYI's payload decomposition, the Promptware Kill Chain, and campaign taxonomies, while framing minimal jailbreak frameworks like ReNeLLM as projections onto a restricted subspace. We provide clear labeling rules, a logical analysis record mapping directly to industry CTI schemas, worked examples including EchoLeak (CVE-2025-32711) and an in-the-wild malware AI-evasion sample, and an illustrative agentic flowchart.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对提示注入 (prompt injection) 攻击长期以原始字符串而非结构化漏洞形式记录的问题，提出一个七组件模型（carrier、delivery vector、concealment、context-break、privilege escalation、payload、return channel），用于标注、比较和变异攻击。框架将 HOUYI 的 payload 分解、Promptware Kill Chain 与活动分类学统一，并把 ReNeLLM 视为受限子空间上的投影。摘要给出标注规则、映射到 CTI schema 的逻辑分析记录，以及 EchoLeak (CVE-2025-32711) 和野外恶意软件 AI 规避样本的示例。
Motivation: 由于大语言模型会将不同自然语言表述编译为相同的可执行动作，基于字符串匹配难以追踪攻击意图；攻击者已把注入嵌入 AI 辅助安全分析，防御方需要不依赖脆弱字符串匹配的结构化标注方式。
Method: 提出七组件模型，包含五个工件字段（artifact fields）与两个环境字段，明确攻击者意图（工具目标、sink、效果）而非表层措辞；提供标注规则、逻辑分析记录和示例流程图。
Result: 摘要以 EchoLeak (CVE-2025-32711) 与一个野外恶意软件 AI 规避样本作为 worked examples，并说明模型能把 ReNeLLM 等最小越狱框架表述为受限子空间投影。
Conclusion: 该模型为防御者、红队和 CTI 团队提供统一、可比较、可变异的攻击结构化表示，直接映射到行业 CTI schema。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Integrating spectral and morphological plant features with decision-tree models for early-season cotton biomass and nitrogen status estimation from multi-year UAV data
papers.abstract_en: Precision nitrogen (N) management (PNM) for cotton requires in-season monitoring of crop growth parameters and N status indicators to decide fertilizer timing, placement, and application rates for optimal canopy development and yield. This study developed remote sensing and machine learning-based methods to estimate cotton dry biomass weight (DBW), plant N uptake (PNU), plant N concentration (PNC), critical N dilution (Nc), and nitrogen nutrition index (NNI) to support PNM. To achieve this, a three-year field-based N-management study was conducted and unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based multispectral images were acquired between early vegetative growth and flowering stages, critical for fertilizer applications. Spatiotemporally consistent spectral and morphological plant features, including plant height (PH) and fractional canopy cover (FCC), provided reliable model training inputs. DBW, PNU, and PNC estimates from simple regression using vegetation indices (VIs), multiple linear regression (MLR) combining VIs, PH, and FCC, and decision-tree models, random forest regression (RFR) and extreme gradient boosting (XGB), combining spectral reflectance, PH, and FCC were evaluated using trial-held-out (THO) and leave-one-year-out (LOYO) validation methods. The best validation accuracies were from RFRTHO (R2 = 0.88 and MAPE = 23.14% for DBW; R2 = 0.84 and MAPE = 20.61% for PNU; R2 = 0.85 and MAPE = 7.82% for PNC) and XGBTHO (R2 = 0.87 and MAPE = 21.91% for DBW; R2 = 0.81 and MAPE = 21.40% for PNU; R2 = 0.86 and MAPE = 7.66% for PNC). Nc was calculated from model estimated DBW and PNC for high-yielding, medium-to-tall cotton varieties grown in the Texas Coastal Plains and validated using ground-truth biomass measurements. NNI derived from XGBTHO outputs performed marginally better than NNI from RFRTHO in identifying N-deficient plots and multi-level N-stress categorization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于三年田间N管理试验和无人机多光谱影像，开发机器学习方法在棉花早期营养生长至开花期估计干生物量（DBW）、植株氮吸收（PNU）、植株氮浓度（PNC）、临界氮稀释（Nc）和氮营养指数（NNI），以支持棉花精准氮管理。研究比较了植被指数简单回归、结合VI/株高/冠层覆盖度的多元线性回归，以及随机森林（RFR）和极端梯度提升（XGB）等决策树模型，并用试验留出（THO）和留一年（LOYO）验证。最佳精度来自RFR和XGB的THO验证，DBW、PNU、PNC的R2在0.81–0.88之间。
Motivation: 棉花精准氮管理需要季内监测作物生长参数和氮状态指标，以决定施肥时机、位置和用量；现有方法在早期生长阶段对棉花生物量和氮状态的可靠估计仍不足。
Method: 利用三年田间试验中获取的UAV多光谱影像，提取时空一致的植株高度（PH）和冠层覆盖度（FCC）等形态特征，与光谱反射率和植被指数结合；采用简单回归、多元线性回归（MLR）、随机森林回归（RFR）和极限梯度提升（XGB）估计DBW、PNU和PNC，并基于模型输出计算Nc和NNI，通过THO和LOYO两种验证方式进行评估。
Result: 摘要报告的最佳验证精度来自RFRTHO（DBW: R2=0.88, MAPE=23.14%；PNU: R2=0.84, MAPE=20.61%；PNC: R2=0.85, MAPE=7.82%）和XGBTHO（DBW: R2=0.87, MAPE=21.91%；PNU: R2=0.81, MAPE=21.40%；PNC: R2=0.86, MAPE=7.66%）；由XGBTHO输出导出的NNI在识别缺氮地块和分级氮胁迫方面略优于RFRTHO。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合光谱与形态特征的决策树模型在德克萨斯海岸平原中高秆棉花品种上能有效支持早期棉花生物量和氮状态监测；Nc基于模型估计的DBW和PNC计算，并用实地生物量测量验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Drone-Assisted UAV-UGV Collaboration for Autonomous Navigation in Snow-Covered Terrain
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a collaborative UAV-UGV navigation framework for high-altitude, snow-covered terrain, where reduced visibility and unstable ground render conventional methods ineffective. We introduce a custom efficient U-Net architecture that falls under the computational constraints for real-time road segmentation, utilizing a novel synthetic snow data augmentation technique to achieve 96.5% segmentation accuracy. For UAV localization, we implement an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) fusing onboard GPS and IMU data, achieving a maximum observed positional error of +-0.5 meters. The UGV position is determined via a visual tracking pipeline using YOLOv5 and depth data from the UAV's RGB-D camera. A dynamic path planning algorithm utilizes this segmentation to adjust for snow drifts, enabling successful navigation in obscured test environment with minimal deviation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种 UAV-UGV 协同导航框架，面向高海拔、积雪覆盖且能见度低、地面不稳定的地形。核心是满足实时计算约束的高效 U-Net 道路分割网络，并采用合成雪景数据增强技术；UAV 定位使用扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）融合 GPS 与 IMU 数据，UGV 位置通过 YOLOv5 与 UAV 的 RGB-D 深度数据的视觉跟踪流程确定。结合动态路径规划以适应雪堆偏移，在遮挡测试环境中实现了低偏差的成功导航。
Motivation: 高海拔积雪地形的低能见度与不稳定地面使传统导航方法失效，需要一种在计算资源受限条件下仍能实时分割道路并协同定位的框架。
Method: 提出自定义高效 U-Net 架构用于实时道路分割，配合新型合成雪数据增强；UAV 定位采用 EKF 融合 GPS/IMU；UGV 位置通过 YOLOv5 与 RGB-D 深度数据的视觉跟踪管线确定；动态路径规划利用分割结果应对雪堆偏移。
Result: 摘要报告分割准确率达到 96.5%，UAV 最大观测位置误差为 ±0.5 米，并在遮挡测试环境中以最小偏差实现成功导航。
Conclusion: 该框架在满足实时计算约束下实现了积雪覆盖环境的自主导航，验证了合成数据增强与多传感器融合的可行性。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: CliniCARE-Bench: Clinical Calibrated Audit of Medical Reasoning in EHR
papers.abstract_en: Large language models perform strongly on medical knowledge benchmarks, but reliable clinical deployment requires agents to conduct defensible investigations over heterogeneous, longitudinal records: determining what evidence is needed, retrieving and reconciling structured and free-text data, grounding conclusions in verifiable evidence, and deferring cases that cannot be resolved reliably. We introduce CliniCARE-Bench (Clinical Calibrated Audit of Medical Reasoning in EHR), a benchmark for retrospective clinical audit: 25 clinician-validated scenarios instantiated as 750 patient-specific cases over real-patient-derived MIMIC-IV data. Systems investigate each case through a governed, logged tool environment for record retrieval, computation, and policy access, and return one of four verdicts---Yes, No, Indeterminate: Lack of Data, or Indeterminate: Medically Ambiguous---the last two separating missing evidence from residual medical ambiguity. Beyond verdict accuracy, we score patient-evidence and policy grounding, process adherence, calibrated abstention, reliability, and efficiency against case-level reference verdicts produced by independent multi-model adjudication and calibrated against Clinical Board review. Every retrieval, computation, and report is replayable, so the investigation trace is inspectable and scorable. To our knowledge, CliniCARE-Bench is the first deployment-oriented clinical-agent benchmark to jointly evaluate real longitudinal EHR investigation, claim-level evidence grounding, governing-policy use, process adherence, and calibrated abstention within a common patient-level adjudication framework. Across 16 agentic systems, four-way accuracy spans 65.3-76.1%, but raw accuracy overstates investigation quality. Defect-free accuracy, which credits a verdict only when correct and free of prohibited shortcuts, is 4.8-14.8 points lower and reorders the leaderboard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CliniCARE-Bench（Clinical Calibrated Audit of Medical Reasoning in EHR），一个面向 EHR 回顾性临床审计的智能体基准：25 个经临床专家验证的场景，实例化为基于 MIMIC-IV 真实患者数据的 750 个病例。系统通过受治理且可记录日志的工具环境检索记录、执行计算并访问政策，返回 Yes、No、Indeterminate: Lack of Data、Indeterminate: Medically Ambiguous 四种裁决之一。基准在裁决准确率之外还评估患者证据与政策依据、流程遵循、校准弃权（calibrated abstention）、可靠性和效率，且所有检索、计算和报告均可重放。
Motivation: 大语言模型在医学知识基准上表现强，但可靠临床部署要求智能体对异质纵向记录开展可辩护的调查，包括判断需要什么证据、检索并调和结构化与自由文本数据、将结论锚定于可验证证据，以及对无法可靠解决的病例主动弃权。现有基准缺少对这种证据调查与问责能力的联合评估。
Method: 构建 25 个临床验证场景并实例化为 750 个基于 MIMIC-IV 的病例；系统在治理化、可记录的工具环境（记录检索、计算、政策访问）中调查，输出四类裁决。参考裁决由独立多模型联合仲裁产生并对照 Clinical Board 审查校准；对患者证据与政策依据、流程遵循、校准弃权、可靠性和效率进行计分。
Result: 在 16 个智能体系统上，四类裁决准确率为 65.3%–76.1%；但原始准确率高估了调查质量，无缺陷准确率（defect-free accuracy，仅当裁决正确且无被禁捷径时计分）比原始准确率低 4.8–14.8 个百分点，并重排了排行榜。
Conclusion: 据作者称，CliniCARE-Bench 是首个部署导向的临床智能体基准，在统一患者级仲裁框架内同时评估真实纵向 EHR 调查、声明级证据锚定、治理政策使用、流程遵循与校准弃权。结果表明单纯原始准确率会掩盖调查质量差异，需要更严格的缺陷感知评估。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Conformal Calibration for Multi-Modal Regression with Missing Modalities
papers.abstract_en: Prediction intervals for multi-modal regression with tabular variables, text, images, or other input sources are difficult to calibrate when those sources disagree or one is missing. A single global quantile averages these regimes together instead of calibrating to the modality pattern observed at test time. We address this through a modality-aware conformal calibration layer. The layer trains or reuses one predictor per modality, computes a disagreement score from their predictions, and uses that score in split conformal calibration under a strict split protocol. We use the score in two complementary ways. First, a continuous disagreement-scaled method reallocates interval width across examples while preserving the usual marginal split-conformal guarantee. Second, a Mondrian (stratified) method calibrates within groups defined by disagreement or modality availability fixed before calibration, giving group guarantees under joint exchangeability of the calibration and test examples. Across four multi-modal datasets, the disagreement-scaled layer matches or improves the marginal conformal baseline in 59 of 60 paired runs for interval continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) and in 52 of 60 for interval width, while keeping empirical coverage near the 95% target. In stress tests with missing modalities, mask-matched recalibration recovers up to 19.5 percentage points of coverage in the hardest fixed-mask regime. The result is a simple, model-agnostic reliability layer for multi-modal regression systems. A project page is available at https://unco3892.github.io/modality-aware-conformal.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态回归中模态不一致或缺失导致预测区间难以校准的问题，提出一种模态感知的保形校准层 (modality-aware conformal calibration)。该层为每个模态训练或复用预测器，计算预测之间的不一致分数 (disagreement score)，并在严格划分协议 (strict split protocol) 下将该分数用于分裂保形校准 (split conformal calibration)。摘要报告该方法在四个多模态数据集上、60 次配对运行中分别有 59 次和 52 次优于边际保形基线，并能在缺失模态压力测试中恢复最多 19.5 个百分点的覆盖率。
Motivation: 传统单一全局分位数会把不同模态不一致或缺失的情形平均在一起，无法针对测试时观测到的模态模式进行校准，导致多模态回归系统的预测区间不可靠。
Method: 提出模态感知的校准层：每个模态对应一个预测器，用预测差异构造不一致分数；分数有两种用法，一是连续的不一致缩放方法 (disagreement-scaled) 在保持边际分裂保形保证的同时重新分配区间宽度，二是 Mondrian 分层方法在固定分组内进行校准并给出组级保证。
Result: 在四个多模态数据集上，不一致缩放层在 60 次配对运行中分别有 59 次在区间 CRPS 上、52 次在区间宽度上匹配或改进边际保形基线，经验覆盖率保持在 95% 目标附近；缺失模态压力测试中，掩码匹配重校准在最难的固定掩码机制下最多恢复 19.5 个百分点的覆盖率。
Conclusion: 该方法是一个简单、模型无关 (model-agnostic) 的多模态回归可靠性层，适用于模态缺失和不一致场景；论文提供了项目页面。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Who Built This Model? Tracing LLM Lineage via Spectral Fingerprints in Weight Space
papers.abstract_en: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) are increasingly developed through complex, multi-stage pipelines, leading to intricate lineage relationships that reflect model origin, ownership, and evolution. Understanding these relationships is important for model provenance, governance, and supply-chain integrity. In this work, we investigate the notion of LLM "biometrics" (analogous to human biometrics) to ask whether LLMs exhibit intrinsic fingerprints in weight space alone, without access to input data, that reveal their origin and lineage. We formulate this as a lineage discrimination problem, distinguishing among independent-origin, same-series, and shared-base models. To characterize these relationships, we propose a unified geometric fingerprinting framework that analyzes weight matrices from two complementary perspectives: (i) spectral energy, captured by singular value distributions to encode global magnitude patterns, and (ii) subspace alignment, quantified via subspace deviations to capture directional geometry. Our analysis uncovers a clear hierarchy of structural similarity in weight space: spectral energy reliably distinguishes independently trained models and different model families, while subspace alignment enables fine-grained discrimination among closely related models, including variations in dataset scale and post-training procedures. Extensive experiments on over 110 diverse open-weight LLM pairs demonstrate that weight-space geometry provides a robust and interpretable signal for model lineage, enabling coarse-grained regime separation and fine-grained discrimination within shared-base models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究开放权重大语言模型（LLM）的谱系追踪问题，提出仅在权重空间中利用谱指纹（spectral fingerprints）来判别模型的独立来源、同系列和共享基座关系。作者提出统一的几何指纹框架，从谱能量（奇异值分布）和子空间对齐（子空间偏差）两个互补视角分析权重矩阵，并在超过110个开放权重LLM对上进行实验，证明权重空间几何结构能提供稳健且可解释的模型谱系信号。
Motivation: 开放权重LLM通常经过复杂的多阶段流水线开发，产生反映模型来源、所有权和演化的复杂谱系关系，而理解这些关系对模型溯源、治理和供应链完整性至关重要。现有方法往往依赖输入数据，本文则追问是否能在完全无输入数据的情况下，仅凭权重空间的内在指纹来揭示模型的谱系。
Method: 将谱系判别形式化为区分独立来源、同系列和共享基座模型三类关系的问题，并提出一个统一的几何指纹框架：一方面通过奇异值分布捕获谱能量以编码全局幅度模式，另一方面通过子空间偏差量化子空间对齐以刻画方向性几何结构，结合两种视角实现粗粒度与细粒度的谱系判别。
Result: 实验在超过110个多样的开放权重LLM对上进行，发现权重空间存在清晰的结构相似性层级：谱能量能可靠区分独立训练模型和不同模型族，而子空间对齐能对密切相关模型（包括数据集规模和训练后程序的变化）进行细粒度判别，从而实现粗粒度区间分离和共享基座模型内部的细粒度区分。
Conclusion: 摘要强调权重空间几何结构为模型谱系提供稳健且可解释的信号，可支持粗粒度体制分离和共享基座模型内的细粒度判别。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Capability Ladder: A Curriculum-Modernization Framework for Workforce Readiness in the AI Era
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence is changing the task composition of computing work faster than curricula and training typically adapt. This is a curriculum-framework paper, grounded in a structured narrative review of labor-market and software-engineering evidence and illustrated through an exploratory pilot course: the review supports the framework, and the pilot illustrates it rather than serving as primary evidence. The central claim is that near-term change is task reallocation rather than full replacement: routine implementation is increasingly automated while verification, systems thinking, security, and the ability to supervise and orchestrate AI (keeping a human in the loop) gain value. We organize the response as a capability-assurance framework anchored by a Capability Ladder: a five-level progression (trigger, automation, workflow, AI agent, agent team) that classifies the operational autonomy of AI-augmented work and the human supervision it requires. We map the ladder to course-level updates, workload-aware assessment, and stackable workforce credentials, and illustrate it through a two-semester pilot of a team-based, no-code course enrolling computing and business students. We argue for targeted modernization around durable capabilities rather than wholesale curriculum replacement, and we are explicit about evidence limits: labor signals are confounded by non-AI forces, industry reports are directional, and the pilot is exploratory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为 Capability Ladder 的课程现代化框架，基于对劳动力市场和软件工程证据的结构化叙述性回顾，并辅以一个探索性试点课程作为说明。核心论点是近期变化是任务重新分配而非完全替代：常规实现日益自动化，而验证、系统思维、安全以及监督和编排 AI（保持人在回路中）的能力更具价值。框架包含五级进展（trigger、automation、workflow、AI agent、agent team），用于分类 AI 增强工作的操作自主性和所需人类监督，并映射到课程更新、工作量感知评估和可堆叠的劳动力凭证。
Motivation: AI 改变计算工作任务构成的速度快于课程和培训的适应速度，导致现有课程和培训容易过时，需要一种系统性的回应框架。
Method: 作者通过结构化叙述性回顾支撑框架，并设计一个为期两学期、团队化、无代码的试点课程来展示其应用；核心是五层 Capability Ladder 等级分类，以及课程级更新、评估和凭证映射。
Result: 摘要未提供量化实验结果，仅说明试点课程具有探索性质，旨在说明框架而非作为主要证据。
Conclusion: 作者主张围绕持久能力进行有针对性的课程现代化，而非全面替换课程；同时明确承认证据局限：劳动力信号受非 AI 因素混淆、行业报告仅为方向性、试点课程只是探索性的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AndroidReality: How Far Are Mobile Agents from the Real World?
papers.abstract_en: Mobile agents have achieved promising results on clean online benchmarks such as AndroidWorld, yet their performance often degrades sharply in real-world deployment due to environmental variations and imperfect interface conditions. In this work, we introduce AndroidReality, a perturbation-based framework for evaluating and improving the robustness of mobile agents. Through a Markov Decision Process (MDP) perspective, we organize real-world interface variability into a principled taxonomy of perturbations along three axes: state, transition, and action. Guided by this taxonomy, we build a perturbed mobile benchmark on top of AndroidWorld with realistic and controllable perturbation injections, enabling systematic robustness evaluation of mobile agents. Our evaluation reveals substantial robustness gaps and four recurring error categories, motivating a simple training-free Test-Time Introspective Recovery (TTIR) mechanism that mitigates these failures on both perturbed and clean settings. Together, these results position robustness as a missing dimension in mobile agent evaluation and establish benchmark perturbation as an effective tool for both stress testing and surfacing latent weaknesses of mobile agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AndroidReality，一个基于扰动 (perturbation) 的框架，用于评估和提升移动智能体 (mobile agents) 在真实世界部署中的鲁棒性。作者从马尔可夫决策过程 (MDP) 视角，将真实界面变异性组织为状态、转移和动作三个轴上的扰动分类，并在 AndroidWorld 之上构建带可控扰动的基准。评测显示智能体存在明显的鲁棒性缺口和四类反复出现的错误，由此提出无需训练的训练时反思恢复 (Test-Time Introspective Recovery, TTIR) 机制，可同时缓解扰动与干净设置下的失败。
Motivation: 移动智能体在 AndroidWorld 等干净在线基准上取得不错结果，但在真实部署中因环境变化和界面条件不理想而性能显著下降，现有评测缺少系统评估和诊断鲁棒性的方法。
Method: 从 MDP 视角将真实界面变异性组织为 state、transition、action 三个轴的扰动分类，并据此在 AndroidWorld 上构建可注入现实且可控扰动的移动端基准；进一步提出一种无需训练的 TTIR 机制来缓解失败。
Result: 评测揭示了显著的鲁棒性缺口，并归纳出四类反复出现的错误类别；TTIR 在扰动设置和干净设置上都能缓解这些失败。摘要未给出具体量化数字。
Conclusion: 作者认为鲁棒性是移动智能体评测中缺失的一个维度，并将基准扰动定位为压力测试和暴露潜在弱点的有效工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Sample Complexity of Policy Learning with Mu-Resets
papers.abstract_en: We study policy-based reinforcement learning under the $μ$-resets interaction protocol of Kakade and Langford [KL02]. This interaction protocol enables the learner to sample trajectories from a given exploratory reset distribution $μ$, in addition to the starting distribution. We resolve the question raised by [KLS25] on the role of policy realizability for the sample complexity of this problem. Critically, the dependence on horizon $H$ is governed by the notion of coverage assumed of the reset distribution. Under bounded all-policy concentrability, we show a $\exp(Ω(H))$ sample complexity lower bound; with bounded pushforward concentrability, we show the dependence on horizon is tightly characterized as $\exp(Θ(\sqrt H))$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Kakade-Langford μ-resets 交互协议下基于策略的强化学习样本复杂度，重点刻画重置分布覆盖率假设对 horizon H 依赖的影响。作者回答了 [KLS25] 提出的策略可实现性 (policy realizability) 在该问题样本复杂度中作用的问题，并表明 H 的依赖取决于对重置分布所假设的 coverage 概念。
Motivation: 在 μ-resets 交互协议中，策略可实现性如何影响样本复杂度此前未被完全理解，尤其 horizon 依赖如何随重置分布的覆盖率假设变化，是该文要解决的关键开放问题。
Method: 通过理论分析建立样本复杂度下界与匹配的上界刻画；在 bounded all-policy concentrability 假设下证明指数下界，在 bounded pushforward concentrability 假设下给出紧的 horizon 依赖特征。
Result: 摘要报告：在 bounded all-policy concentrability 下样本复杂度下界为 exp(Ω(H))；在 bounded pushforward concentrability 下 horizon 依赖被紧刻画为 exp(Θ(√H))。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 horizon 依赖由重置分布的覆盖率假设决定，且 pushforward concentrability 假设下得到的指数根号 H 依赖显著弱于全策略集中可约束下的线性 H 指数依赖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Benchmark Performance to Tool Deployment: Human-in-the-Loop Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Automated anomaly detection methods often report strong performance on curated academic benchmarks, but their behavior under real-world industrial conditions is less clear. In this work, we evaluate 19 unsupervised anomaly detection models on the BowTie dataset, a challenging manufacturing dataset with reflective surfaces, subtle defects, and profile-specific variation. In contrast to benchmark results, we observe that model performance is less stable than typically reported on standard benchmarks such as MVTec AD, highly sensitive to preprocessing, and inconsistent across conditions, with no single approach emerging as uniformly robust; a consensus audit further indicates that nominal-data quality affects deployment. Motivated by these findings, we developed and initially deployed a unified human-in-the-loop framework for manufactured-part inspection that combines image annotation, AI-assisted defect detection, and an integrated validation engine, replacing a prior manual visual inspection and documentation workflow. The system supports heatmap-guided defect review, SAM-refined candidate regions for inspector acceptance, rejection, or boundary adjustment, mask evaluation where annotations exist, and review history for inspector consistency and onboarding. Together, the results highlight the gap between benchmark performance and deployment reality, and provide a practical framework for addressing it.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Accepted as a regular paper at the 25th International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在制造领域数据集 BowTie 上评估了 19 种无监督异常检测模型，发现其性能远不如在 MVTec AD 等标准基准上报告的那样稳定，对预处理高度敏感，且不同条件下表现不一致，没有单一方法普遍稳健。基于这些发现，作者开发并初步部署了一个统一的人机协同（human-in-the-loop）检测框架，用于制造部件检测，替代此前的纯人工目视检查和文档流程，并支持热图引导的缺陷审查、SAM 精化候选区域、掩膜评估以及审查历史记录。
Motivation: 自动化异常检测方法在精选学术基准上报告了较强性能，但其在真实工业条件下的行为尚不明确；作者希望用具有反射表面、细微缺陷和轮廓相关变化的制造数据集来揭示基准性能与实际部署之间的差距。
Method: 对 19 种无监督异常检测模型在 BowTie 数据集上进行系统评估；随后开发统一的人机协同检测框架，结合图像标注、AI 辅助缺陷检测和集成验证引擎，包括热图引导缺陷审查、供检查员接受/拒绝/调整边界的 SAM 精化候选区域、存在标注时的掩膜评估，以及用于检查员一致性和培训的审查历史。
Result: 摘要显示模型性能不稳定，对预处理高度敏感，且跨条件不一致；共识审计进一步表明名义数据质量影响部署，且没有单一方法被证明普遍稳健。
Conclusion: 结果表明基准性能与部署现实之间存在明显差距，并提供了一个应对该差距的实用框架；论文强调部署场景下的鲁棒性和数据质量比基准排名更关键。

papers.title: DINO-3DRA: Leveraging 2D Foundation Model Semantics for 3D Cerebral Aneurysm Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate aneurysm segmentation in 3D rotational angiography (3DRA) is hindered by extreme class imbalance, morphological similarity to vessels, and absent large-scale 3D pretraining. 2D vision foundation models encode dense structural priors from 1.7 billion images, yet naïve slice-wise transfer fragments anatomical continuity and destabilises optimisation. We propose DINO-3DRA, a dual-path framework achieving effective cross-dimensional semantic transfer by injecting frozen DINOv3 features into a 3D U-Net backbone via Room-Lite spatial mixing and calibrated residual fusion. On multi-centre 3DRA data, DINO-3DRA achieves state-of-the-art aneurysm segmentation (Dice: 0.758; HD95: 2.75 mm; +13% over nnU-Net) with only 5.72M trainable parameters. Ablation studies confirm that gains arise from structured cross-dimensional transfer rather than loss design alone, with bridged foundation features improving anatomical continuity between aneurysms and parent vessels. Without fine-tuning on CADA and SHINY-ICARUS, DINO-3DRA eliminates all catastrophic failure cases observed in baseline architectures, demonstrating robust generalisation across heterogeneous imaging protocols.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DINO-3DRA，一种双路径框架，将冻结的 DINOv3 2D 基础模型特征注入 3D U-Net，用于 3D 旋转血管造影（3DRA）中的脑动脉瘤分割。在多中心 3DRA 数据上取得 Dice 0.758、HD95 2.75 mm，比 nnU-Net 提升 13%，仅需 5.72M 可训练参数。消融实验表明增益来自跨维度语义迁移而非损失设计。
Motivation: 3DRA 脑动脉瘤分割面临极端类别不平衡、动脉瘤与血管形态相似、缺乏大规模 3D 预训练等困难。2D 视觉基础模型含有丰富的稠密结构先验，但朴素切片式迁移会破坏解剖连续性并导致优化不稳定。
Method: 提出双路径框架 DINO-3DRA，通过 Room-Lite 空间混合和校准残差融合（calibrated residual fusion），将冻结的 DINOv3 特征注入 3D U-Net 主干，实现跨维度语义迁移。
Result: 在多中心 3DRA 数据上，DINO-3DRA 达到 Dice 0.758、HD95 2.75 mm，较 nnU-Net 提升 13%，仅需 5.72M 可训练参数；在 CADA 和 SHINY-ICARUS 上无需微调即消除了基线架构中所有灾难性失败案例。
Conclusion: 摘要认为增益来自结构化跨维度迁移而非损失设计，桥接的基础模型特征改善了动脉瘤与母血管之间的解剖连续性，并在异构成像协议下展现了稳健泛化。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Jako Tako or Fluent? Presenting PoVisLE: A Polish Vision-Language Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on tasks such as image captioning, visual question answering, and image-to-text generation. However, they are predominantly trained on English-centric data, which limits their ability to handle culturally grounded visual understanding and leads to failures in interpreting region-specific meanings, symbolic content, and context-dependent visual cues. Existing benchmarks for cultural competence are often template-driven and focused on surface-level recognition, making them insufficient for evaluating deeper linguistic and pragmatic understanding in culturally situated settings. We introduce PoVisLE, a monocultural vision-language benchmark for Polish designed to evaluate culturally grounded multimodal understanding under a grounded evaluation paradigm, where language is interpreted in interaction with visual context. The dataset contains 1,117 images and 2,366 manually annotated VQA pairs. Overall, our dataset provides a controlled and challenging resource for assessing culturally grounded vision-language understanding beyond surface-level recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PoVisLE，一个面向波兰语的单文化视觉-语言基准 (monocultural vision-language benchmark)，用于评测文化情境下的多模态理解。数据集包含 1,117 张图片和 2,366 个手工标注的 VQA 对，采用 grounded evaluation 范式，强调语言需在视觉上下文中被解读。作者认为现有文化能力基准多为模板驱动、只看表面识别，不足以评估深层的语言与语用理解。
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 主要在英语中心数据上训练，导致其在文化相关的视觉理解上失败，难以解释地域特定含义、符号内容与上下文相关视觉线索；现有文化能力基准又偏向模板化与表层识别，缺乏对深层语言和语用理解的评测能力。
Method: 引入 PoVisLE 基准，为波兰语构建单文化评测资源，采用 grounded evaluation 范式，将语言解释置于与视觉上下文的交互中；数据集包含 1,117 张图片和 2,366 个手工标注的 VQA 对，提供受控且具挑战性的评测设置。
Result: 摘要未报告模型评测数值或对比结果，主要产出是数据集本身及其规模：1,117 张图片、2,366 个手工标注 VQA 对，并声称该资源可评测超越表层识别的文化情境视觉-语言理解。
Conclusion: 作者强调 PoVisLE 为评估文化情境下的视觉-语言理解提供了受控且具挑战性的资源；此为预印本（preprint under review），范围限于波兰语的单文化设定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Who Verifies the Benchmark? Decentralizing Trust in Large Language Model Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: LLM benchmarks can build an organization's reputation and attract customers, but only when results are transparent and verifiable. Unverified claims that DeepSeek R1 outperformed OpenAI's o1 contributed to market panic on January 27, 2025, when Nvidia lost USD589 billion in market value. Yet vendor benchmarks often depend on an honor system. Academic reassessments and independent leaderboards have found undisclosed changes to proprietary models, contaminated training data, and selective reporting. LLM-as-a-judge methods scale evaluation by reducing human review. Studies, however, suggest that judges may show identity-aware bias, scoring an answer according to its source model rather than its quality. This bias has not been fully measured or corrected across politically sensitive, reasoning-intensive, and preference-based tasks. We examine this problem using seven verifier models: GPT-OSS 120B, Llama 3.3 70B, GLM 5.1, Qwen3 32B, DeepSeek V4 Pro, Mistral Large3, and Sarvam M. They score anonymous and identity-disclosed responses from three primary models on 58 factual, reasoning, political, and preference-based questions. Identity disclosure slightly raises scores for factual questions, moderately affects stress-reasoning tasks, and causes large changes for geopolitically sensitive topics. Notable results include GLM5.1 (+7.00 points, p = 0.0249) and Llama 3.3 70B (+1.56 points, p = 0.00). We also introduce a blockchain-based commit-reveal protocol using Autonomous Economic Agents on an Ethereum-compatible ledger. In Phase 1, each judge records a one-way hash of its score and a secret salt before candidate identities are revealed. In Phase 2, the identity and raw score are disclosed and verified on-chain. This creates a tamper-evident audit trail that separates blind evaluation from post-hoc claims and reduces the verification burden on independent researchers and leaderboard operators.
papers.comment: Accepted to International Conference on Quantum Enhanced AI and Secure Computing (QASC2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 评测中的信任与可验证性问题，指出现有厂商基准多依赖信用体系且 LLM-as-a-judge 存在身份感知偏差 (identity-aware bias)。作者用七个评审模型对三个主模型在 58 道事实、推理、政治与偏好问题上进行匿名与身份披露评分，发现身份披露会抬高分数且对地缘政治敏感话题影响最大。论文还提出基于区块链的 commit-reveal 协议，以哈希提交和链上验证分离盲评与事后声明。
Motivation: 厂商基准测试依赖诚信体系，存在未披露的模型改动、训练数据污染和选择性报告等问题；LLM-as-a-judge 虽然扩展了评测规模，但评审者可能按回答来源而非质量打分，且这种偏差尚未在政治敏感、推理密集和偏好型任务上被充分度量或修正。
Method: 使用 GPT-OSS 120B、Llama 3.3 70B、GLM 5.1、Qwen3 32B、DeepSeek V4 Pro、Mistral Large3 和 Sarvam M 七个评审模型，对匿名与身份披露的回答在 58 道题目上评分；并引入基于 Ethereum 兼容账本上 Autonomous Economic Agents 的 commit-reveal 协议，阶段一提交分数与随机盐的单向哈希，阶段二披露身份与原始分数并在链上验证。
Result: 身份披露对事实类问题略微提高分数，对压力推理任务影响中等，对地缘政治敏感话题引起大幅分数变化；显著结果包括 GLM5.1 (+7.00 分, p = 0.0249) 和 Llama 3.3 70B (+1.56 分, p = 0.00)。
Conclusion: commit-reveal 协议可形成防篡改的审计轨迹，将盲评与事后声明分离，从而降低独立研究者和排行榜运营者的验证负担。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Models of Wildland Fire and Ember Spread
papers.abstract_en: In this Chapter we explore the nature and theory of ember transport using observations from controlled laboratory settings, prescribed fire, and wildland fire. Specific examples and statistics from fires are used to gain insight and motivate a hierarchy of modeling approaches from simple idealized models to full-physics atmospheric boundary layer models. The emphasis is on the fundamental processes involved in moving embers away from their sources in vegetation and structures on and near the ground or in the atmospheric boundary layer winds and turbulent flows. We describe the problem first in terms of basic theory about the rate of spread of wildland fire, examine the physical principles at work in ember transport for two principle modes of transport near the ground and in the atmosphere well above the surface, and connect these to statistical models for transport.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本章从受控实验室实验、计划火烧和野火观测出发，探讨余烬输运 (ember transport) 的本质与理论。作者梳理了从简单理想化模型到全物理大气边界层模型的一系列建模方法，并重点分析余烬从地面植被和结构物进入大气边界层风与湍流的基本过程。章节将野火蔓延速率理论、近地面与高层大气两种主要输运模式以及统计输运模型联系起来。
Motivation: 余烬输运是野火蔓延的关键机制之一，但对其物理过程的认识和建模层级尚需系统梳理；本章旨在通过实测统计与理论结合来阐明相关基本过程。
Method: 基于实验室、计划火烧和野火观测中的具体案例与统计，提出从理想化模型到全物理大气边界层模型的建模层级，并分别分析近地面与大气高层两种输运模式下的物理原理。
Result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，主要内容是将野火蔓延速率的基本理论、余烬输运的物理原理与统计输运模型相连接。
Conclusion: 作者强调理解余烬远离地面植被和结构物源区的基本过程，并说明理论与统计模型如何共同描述这一现象。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: XClipGS: Exact Half-Space Clipping for Medical Volume Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian-splatting proxies enable interactive rendering of volumetric medical scans, but a clipping plane exposes anatomy not constrained by external-view training and intersects primitives that conventional splatting can only keep or drop whole. We present XClipGS (eXact Clipping), which treats these as two separate problems: the render-time clip operator and supervision of the hidden interior. Under the local affine model used by EWA splatting, the ray integral of a half-space-restricted Gaussian factorizes exactly into its ordinary 2D footprint and a conditional Gaussian CDF whose argument is affine in pixel coordinates. The resulting closed-form per-pixel operator introduces no learned clipping parameters or auxiliary network and remains differentiable with respect to the primitive and plane. We use multi-distance reference views with varied clipping-plane axes and offsets to supervise the interior through the same operator. We also introduce a paired clipped/unclipped cut-face protocol with difference-referenced cut error (CDE) and culled-side leakage (Leak), because global image metrics dilute errors near the plane. On eight CT and MRI volumes with plane offsets not used for training, XClipGS attains the highest PSNR on every volume (33.56 versus 32.34 dB for ClipGS) while rendering at over 650 FPS, far above real time, versus 278 FPS. On voxel-axis cut-face views, it raises average band SSIM from 0.809 to 0.860 and leaks roughly 40 times less. Without retraining, it also achieves the best average across all four metrics on arbitrary-normal planes; on a fixed interior, it matches RaRa's face fidelity with about 16 times less leakage. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/XClipGS/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 XClipGS，针对医学体积高斯泼溅（Gaussian splatting）交互渲染中的裁剪问题，给出精确的半空间裁剪方案。作者利用 EWA 泼溅的局部仿射模型，将半空间受限高斯射线的积分精确分解为普通 2D footprint 与条件高斯 CDF 的乘积，得到闭式逐像素裁剪算子；该算子不引入学习参数或辅助网络，且对基元和平面可微。在八个 CT/MRI 体数据上，XClipGS 在未见过的平面偏移设置下取得最高 PSNR，并显著提升渲染速度与切面保真度。
Motivation: 高斯泼溅代理虽能交互渲染医学体积扫描，但裁剪平面会暴露未被外部视角训练约束的内部解剖结构，且裁剪与图元相交时传统泼溅只能整体保留或丢弃。作者将问题拆分为渲染期裁剪算子与隐藏内部监督两部分，并指出全局图像指标会稀释平面附近的误差。
Method: 在 EWA 泼溅的局部仿射假设下推导半空间受限高斯的射线积分闭式解，得到逐像素精确裁剪算子；使用不同裁剪平面轴与偏移的多距离参考视图，通过同一算子监督内部结构；同时提出配对裁剪/未裁剪切面协议，以及差参考切面误差（CDE）和剔除侧泄漏（Leak）两个局部评价指标。
Result: 在八个 CT/MRI 体数据上，XClipGS 在每个体数据上均取得最高 PSNR（33.56 dB，对比 ClipGS 的 32.34 dB），并以超过 650 FPS 渲染（ClipGS 为 278 FPS）；在体素轴切面视图上，平均 band SSIM 从 0.809 提升至 0.860，泄漏约少 40 倍；无需重训练即可在任意法向平面上取得四项指标的平均最佳，并在固定内部上匹配 RaRa 的切面保真度，同时泄漏约少 16 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调精确的闭式裁剪算子无需学习参数即可改善裁剪切面的图像质量与渲染速度，并建议采用平面附近的局部指标（如 CDE 与 Leak）而非全局指标来评价切面误差。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CFD-Guided Detection of Concept Drift in Multimodal Physiologic Signals
papers.abstract_en: Cardiovascular AI models can classify clean elec- trocardiogram (ECG) signals, but real wearable signals change because of motion, breathing, posture, sensor contact, and true clinical deterioration. This paper asks when a model should keep its prediction, change it, or flag uncertainty. We propose a physiologic stability framework, called PECS, that compares changes inside the model with measurable changes in the signal. ECG is treated as the main cardiac signal, photoplethysmography (PPG) adds pulse and vascular information, and respiration is used only when ECG and PPG disagree. We test the framework on PTB-XL at pilot and full scales and on synchronized BIDMC and MIMIC waveform cohorts. The PTB-XL pilot and full- scale analyses selected different domain pairs, and the strongest cross-modal pair also changed across BIDMC and MIMIC, showing that adding every available signal is not always the best choice. PECS outperformed the evaluated drift-detection baseline implementations, reaching drift classification accuracy (DCA) of 0.8786 on expanded BIDMC and 0.9560 on MIMIC. The MIMIC results also showed that respiration can help during disagreement cases, but it should be used selectively rather than as an automatic override. Overall, the results support PECS as a candidate monitoring framework for wearable cardiovascular AI while highlighting the need for scale-aware domain selection and interpretable trust routing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向可穿戴心血管AI的生理稳定性框架PECS，用于在多模态生理信号（ECG、PPG、呼吸）中检测概念漂移（concept drift），并判断模型应保留预测、更改预测还是标记不确定性。作者在PTB-XL、BIDMC和MIMIC波形队列上验证，发现跨数据集的最佳跨模态信号对并不一致，且PECS优于所评估的漂移检测基线，在扩展BIDMC上达到0.8786、在MIMIC上达到0.9560的漂移分类准确率（DCA）。
Motivation: 真实可穿戴信号会因运动、呼吸、姿势、传感器接触和真实临床恶化而变化，而心血管AI模型通常只在干净的ECG上表现良好。论文针对的问题是模型何时应保持预测、何时改变预测或标记不确定性，即概念漂移下的可靠监控。
Method: 提出PECS框架，将模型内部的变化与信号中可测量的变化进行比较：ECG作为主要心脏信号，PPG提供脉搏和血管信息，呼吸仅在ECG与PPG不一致时使用。在不同规模（pilot与full scale）的数据集上选择领域对，并在PTB-XL、BIDMC和MIMIC上测试。
Result: PTB-XL的pilot与full-scale分析选择了不同的领域对，且BIDMC与MIMIC中最强的跨模态对也不同，表明并非信号越多越好。PECS在扩展BIDMC上达到0.8786、MIMIC上达到0.9560的DCA；MIMIC结果显示呼吸在分歧情况下有帮助，但应有选择地使用而非自动覆盖。
Conclusion: 结果支持PECS作为可穿戴心血管AI的候选监控框架，同时强调需要尺度感知的领域选择和可解释的信任路由（interpretable trust routing）。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Rethinking 3D Segmentation from Individual LiDAR Scans: Incidence-Aware Sampling on the SIP Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: 3D scene understanding is increasingly important in construction, yet most methods are developed on curated datasets that do not fully reflect real site sensing conditions. In many workflows, individual LiDAR scans provide rapid local updates rather than complete scene representations, producing limited surface coverage, acquisition-driven density variation, and severe imbalance between dominant planar surfaces and sparse construction elements. Because large point clouds must be downsampled, sampling resolution and point allocation directly affect the balance between geometric detail and spatial context. This study evaluates these effects under a fixed per-fragment point budget and introduces an incidence-aware sampling strategy for individual LiDAR scans. The method maps points to a geometry-normalized manifold space for voxel-based selection while preserving original Euclidean coordinates for downstream learning. It requires only point coordinates and normals and no backbone modification. Using the Site in Pieces (SIP) benchmark, experiments with Point Transformer and PointNeXt show improved resolution-averaged segmentation performance, especially for non-planar elements and ladders, while reducing sensitivity to sampling resolution. The results show that acquisition-aware sampling can provide a more stable geometric representation and should be treated as an active component of individual-scan 3D segmentation rather than generic preprocessing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视单个LiDAR扫描的3D分割问题，指出已有方法多在精选数据集上开发，不能充分反映真实工地的传感条件。作者在固定每片段点预算下评估采样影响，并提出入射感知采样（incidence-aware sampling）策略，在SIP基准上结合Point Transformer和PointNeXt验证，显示对非平面元素和梯子的分割性能提升，并降低对采样分辨率的敏感性。
Motivation: 实际工地的单个LiDAR扫描常呈现有限表面覆盖、采集导致的密度变化以及平面与稀疏构件之间的严重不平衡，而现有方法忽略了这些真实传感条件。由于大点云必须下采样，采样分辨率和点分配方式直接决定几何细节与空间上下文的平衡。
Method: 提出入射感知采样策略，将点映射到几何归一化的流形空间进行基于体素的选择，同时保留原始欧氏坐标用于下游学习。方法仅需点坐标和法线，无需修改骨干网络结构。
Result: 在SIP基准上使用Point Transformer和PointNeXt的实验显示，该方法提升了按分辨率平均的分割性能，尤其是对非平面元素和梯子，同时减少了对采样分辨率的敏感性。
Conclusion: 作者认为采集感知采样可以提供更稳定的几何表示，应作为单个扫描3D分割中的主动组件而非通用预处理步骤。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CoCoNav: Conformal Control for Safe Robot Navigation in Crowds
papers.abstract_en: Safe and efficient robot navigation in crowds requires anticipating pedestrian motion despite uncertain and potentially shifting prediction errors. Existing reactive methods can produce oscillatory behavior, while predictive planners often treat forecasts as exact or rely on restrictive error models. Incorporating conservative uncertainty sets as hard constraints can also render model predictive control (MPC) infeasible. We propose \textit{CoCoNav}, a crowd-navigation framework that combines online conformal calibration with runtime-certified planning. A horizon-specific conformal proportional--integral controller adapts trajectory-error bounds to regulate long-run empirical coverage, enabling the framework to respond to changing prediction errors. A \textit{relax-then-verify} planner preserves solver feasibility by generating nominal trajectories with soft-constrained MPC and separately certifying them, together with contingency maneuvers, against the calibrated bounds before execution. Simulations and quadruped experiments show that CoCoNav achieves a favorable balance among collision avoidance, task success, and navigation efficiency relative to the evaluated baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoCoNav 是一个面向人群导航的框架，将在线共形校准（conformal calibration）与运行时认证规划相结合，以应对行人预测误差的不确定性与漂移。框架用视界特定的共形比例-积分控制器调节轨迹误差界，并用“先松弛后验证”（relax-then-verify）的规划器在软约束 MPC 生成名义轨迹后，再依据校准界限连同应急机动（contingency maneuvers）进行认证。仿真与四足机器人实验表明，该方法在避碰、任务成功率和导航效率之间相对基线取得了较好平衡。
Motivation: 现有反应式人群导航方法易产生振荡行为，而预测式规划器常将预测视为精确或依赖严格误差模型；若将保守不确定性集作为硬约束，又会使模型预测控制（MPC）不可行。
Method: 提出 CoCoNav 框架：通过在线共形校准调节轨迹误差界以维持长期经验覆盖率，并采用 relax-then-verify 规划器，先用软约束 MPC 生成名义轨迹，再结合应急机动对轨迹进行独立认证。
Result: 仿真和四足机器人实验中，CoCoNav 相比评测基线在避碰、任务成功率和导航效率间取得有利平衡；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将共形校准的误差界与运行时认证结合，可响应变化的预测误差并规避 MPC 不可行问题，是实现安全人群导航的有效途径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Multi-Task Consistency-based Detection of Adversarial Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have found successful deployment in numerous vision perception systems. However, their susceptibility to adversarial attacks has prompted concerns regarding their practical applications, specifically in the context of autonomous driving. Existing defenses often suffer from cost inefficiency, rendering their deployment impractical for resource-constrained applications. In this work, we propose an efficient and effective adversarial attack detection scheme leveraging the multi-task perception within a complex vision system. Adversarial perturbations are detected by the inconsistencies between the inference outputs of multiple vision tasks, e.g., object detection and instance segmentation. To this end, we developed a consistency score metric to measure the inconsistency between vision tasks. Next, we designed an approach to select the best model pairs for detecting inconsistencies effectively. Finally, we evaluated our defense against PGD attacks across multiple vision models on the BDD100k validation dataset. The experimental results demonstrated that our defense achieved a ROC-AUC performance of 99.9% detection within the considered attacker model.

papers.title: LoRSA: Toward Generalizable Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Biomedical Downstream Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables the adaptation of vision foundation models to biomedical tasks under limited computational resources, but a single low-rank update can constrain all task-specific changes to one narrow parameter subspace. This restriction may prevent the model from simultaneously representing globally shared task structure and localized residual directions required for generalization to unseen imaging domains. We introduce LoRSA, a global--residual adaptation framework that jointly learns a dense low-rank component and a dynamically structured-sparse low-rank component. The dense component captures globally coordinated task adaptation, while the structured component provides complementary residual corrections whose support evolves during training. We characterize the representational capacity, approximation properties, rank structure, and singular-subspace complementarity of this decomposition. We evaluate LoRSA for four-class breast-density classification using DINOv3-Base, with VinDr-Mammo as the source domain and MammosighTR and RSNA as unseen external domains. LoRSA remains competitive on the internal validation set and achieves the best external macro-F1 on both target datasets, improving upon the strongest competing method by 2.15 percentage points on MammosighTR and 3.09 percentage points on RSNA. Weight-matrix analysis further shows that approximately $92\%$ of the energy of each adaptation component lies outside the bilateral singular subspace of the other, indicating that the two components learn largely complementary update directions. These results suggest that organizing adaptation capacity into distinct global and residual paths can improve the external-domain generalization of parameter-efficiently adapted biomedical vision models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LoRSA，一种面向生物医学视觉任务的全局-残差参数高效微调框架，联合学习一个稠密低秩分量和一个动态结构化稀疏低秩分量。以 DINOv3-Base 在四类乳腺密度分类上评估，VinDr-Mammo 为源域，MammosighTR 与 RSNA 为未见外部域；LoRSA 在内部验证集上保持竞争力，并在两个外部数据集上取得最佳 macro-F1。权重矩阵分析表明约 92% 的每个适应分量能量位于另一分量的双侧奇异子空间之外，说明两个分量学到大致互补的更新方向。
Motivation: 参数高效微调中，单一低秩更新会把所有任务特定变化限制在一个狭窄的参数子空间，可能阻碍模型同时表达全局共享的任务结构与局部残差方向，从而影响对未见成像域的泛化。
Method: LoRSA 框架同时学习稠密低秩分量与动态结构化稀疏低秩分量：稠密分量捕获全局协调的任务适应，结构化分量提供支撑集在训练中演化的互补残差修正，并对该分解的表示容量、逼近性质、秩结构和奇异子空间互补性进行刻画。
Result: 在乳腺密度分类中，LoRSA 在内部验证集上保持竞争力，并在两个外部域上取得最佳 macro-F1，较最强对比方法在 MammosighTR 上提升 2.15 个百分点、在 RSNA 上提升 3.09 个百分点；权重矩阵分析显示约 92% 的适应分量能量落在另一分量的双侧奇异子空间之外。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将适应容量组织为不同的全局与残差路径，可以改善参数高效微调生物医学视觉模型在外部域上的泛化能力。

papers.title: Adaptive Two-Level Allocation of a Conserved Capacity Budget Across Locations and Service Classes
papers.abstract_en: We study how to share a single conserved capacity budget across many locations and two service classes when demand is uneven, time-varying, and can exceed supply. The shape recurs: an origin's request-rate cap split across its edge locations, a licensed throughput cap across premium and standard tenants, or an egress budget between latency-critical and batch workloads. We present a two-level algorithm. The first level redistributes capacity within a class across locations by proportional deficit and excess redistribution; the second lends capacity elastically between classes when one has surplus and the other deficit. We prove it conserves the budget exactly, preserves non-negativity, and reaches a stable allocation in one iteration under stationary demand because it carries no per-cycle state, at O(KN) cost per cycle for K classes and N locations. We evaluate it defending a CDN's per-domain budget under volumetric attack, where the classes are confirmed-legitimate and not-yet-cleared traffic; across 8 contention scenarios on a 22-location topology it serves 66-93% of high-priority demand, competitive with a single-class linear-programming optimum, while never leaving capacity idle or over-committing whenever aggregate demand meets or exceeds the budget (the contention regime these scenarios evaluate). Two findings carry beyond the application. First, a throughput-maximizing objective is wrong under contention: a two-class LP maximizing total served load serves less high-priority load than our demand-proportional, reservation-respecting allocator in most scenarios, because it cannot tell that some load it serves is the contention. Second, inter-class borrowing earns its complexity under bursty load, improving high-priority service by 1.5 points (isolated by ablation), and is neutral under stationary demand. A 5-location prototype with real HTTP traffic validates the pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在需求不均、随时间变化且可能超过供给时，如何在多个地点和两个服务类别之间共享单一守恒容量预算的问题。作者提出两级分配算法：第一级在同一类别内按比例进行赤字和盈余跨地点再分配，第二级在类别之间存在盈余与赤字时弹性互借容量。文章证明该方法精确守恒预算、保持非负性，并在平稳需求下因无逐周期状态而在单次迭代内达到稳定分配，每个周期的复杂度为 O(KN)。评估场景是 CDN 在容量型攻击下对每域名预算的防御，其中类别为已确认合法与尚未放行的流量。
Motivation: 一类反复出现的资源管理问题是把单一守恒容量预算分配给多个地点和多个服务类别，而需求可能不均衡、时变并超过供给；在这种竞争（contention）状态下，简单的吞吐量最大化目标可能不会优先服务高优先级负载。
Method: 提出一种无状态的、两级分配算法：第一级在类别内按比例赤字与盈余再分配跨地点容量，第二级在类别间弹性借出容量。算法每周期不保留跨周期状态，在平稳需求下单次迭代即收敛，每次迭代成本为 O(KN)，其中 K 为类别数、N 为地点数。
Result: 在 22 个地点的拓扑和 8 个竞争场景中，该方法为高优先级需求服务了 66%-93% 的负载，与单类别线性规划最优解相当，且当总需求达到或超过预算时不会让容量闲置或过度承诺。两类别最大化总服务负载的 LP 在多数场景中服务的高优先级负载更少；跨类别借用在突发负载下使高优先级服务提升 1.5 个百分点（经消融验证），在平稳需求下效果中性。一个 5 地点的真实 HTTP 流量原型验证了该流程。
Conclusion: 作者强调两个超出具体应用的发现：在竞争状态下，以吞吐量最大化为目标的目标函数是错误的；跨类别借用仅在突发负载下才值得其复杂性，平稳需求下无增益。评估覆盖的是总需求达到或超过预算的竞争区间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LUCID: Latent-Skill Unified Control via Imagined Dynamics for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation requires composing versatile whole-body skills and reliable high-level decision making. Existing methods often coordinate pretrained skills with scripted planners, finite-state machines or task-specific model-free policies, restricting their ability to handle complex task sequences. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{LUCID}, a hierarchical model-based reinforcement learning framework that plans over reusable skills through imagined rollouts of a learned dynamics model. LUCID first trains a structured latent-conditioned low-level policy via adversarial imitation and then freezes it while jointly learning a high-level policy and macro-dynamics world model. The world model predicts the temporally extended state transitions induced by latent decisions, enabling high-level policy optimization through imagined rollouts. We evaluate our framework across various simulated multi-object rearrangement scenarios. Experimental results show that LUCID improves the full-task success and partial-completion rates compared to prior baseline methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in complex sequential loco-manipulation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LUCID，一个分层基于模型的强化学习（hierarchical model-based RL）框架，用于长时域人形机器人移动操作（loco-manipulation）。它先通过对抗模仿训练一个潜在条件化的低层技能策略并冻结，再联合学习高层策略与宏动力学世界模型（macro-dynamics world model），让高层策略通过想象 rollout（imagined rollouts）进行优化。作者在多种模拟多目标重排场景中评估，报告 LUCID 相比基线方法提升了完整任务成功率与部分完成率。
Motivation: 现有方法通常用脚本化规划器、有限状态机或任务特定的无模型策略来协调预训练技能，限制了处理复杂任务序列的能力，缺少可复用的高层决策机制。
Method: LUCID 采用分层结构：先用对抗模仿（adversarial imitation）训练潜在条件化的低层策略并冻结，然后联合学习高层策略和预测时间扩展状态转移的宏动力学世界模型，使高层策略能通过想象 rollout 获得优化信号。
Result: 在多种模拟多目标重排场景中，LUCID 相比先前基线方法提高了完整任务成功率和部分完成率，表明其在复杂顺序移动操作任务中的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过学习到的动力学模型进行想象 rollout 的分层规划能有效应对复杂的顺序 loco-manipulation 任务；摘要未讨论具体局限。

papers.title: QuantumMind: Constraint-Grounded Agentic Reasoning for Speedup Analysis in Quantum Computing
papers.abstract_en: Identifying a meaningful quantum speedup requires more than matching a classical problem to a familiar quantum primitive: the claim must preserve the task, respect access and output models, expose required promises, and remain within a defensible complexity scope. We present QuantumMind, an auditable agentic workflow for generating and conservatively screening quantum-acceleration hypotheses. A fixed sequence of typed, role-specialized actions formalizes the public task, analyzes structure and classical bottlenecks, matches a source-linked registry of quantum primitives and barriers, and constructs a scoped candidate scheme. A deterministic ten-check validator assigns the authoritative verdict; completed states are compiled into a Quantum Acceleration Evidence Graph and passed through a downward-only research screen that cannot strengthen the decision. We evaluate QuantumMind against seven task-adapted prompting and agentic controls on 582 identical open-discovery tasks. Under the frozen Open-Discovery Score (ODS), QuantumMind obtains 53.1 mean ODS, exceeding the strongest baseline by 17.3 points (48.2% relative), and wins 355 of 582 paired tasks against that baseline. It passes the graph audit on 99.8% of tasks, compared with 43.6% for the strongest baseline, and ranks first in all seven task families. The results indicate that typed state transitions and deterministic evidence control contribute beyond fluent generation alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QuantumMind，一个可审计的智能体工作流 (agentic workflow)，用于生成并保守筛选量子加速 (quantum-acceleration) 假设。工作流通过固定序列的角色专用动作形式化公共任务、分析结构与经典瓶颈、匹配带来源链接的量子原语与壁垒注册表，并构造有范围的候选方案；确定性十项校验器给出权威判定，完成态被编译为 Quantum Acceleration Evidence Graph，再经过只能维持或削弱决策的向下研究筛选。在 582 个相同的开放发现任务上，QuantumMind 的平均 Open-Discovery Score (ODS) 为 53.1，超过最强基线 17.3 分（相对提升 48.2%），并在 355/582 个配对任务中胜过该基线；通过图审计的比例为 99.8%，而最强基线为 43.6%，且在全部七个任务族中排名第一。
Motivation: 识别有意义的量子加速不能仅仅把经典问题匹配到熟悉的量子原语：主张必须保持任务不变、尊重访问与输出模型、暴露所需承诺，并保持在可辩护的复杂度范围内。现有方法在这一约束化推理上存在缺口，需要可审计且保守的假设筛选流程。
Method: 采用固定序列的、类型化且角色专用的动作来形式化公共任务，分析问题结构与经典瓶颈，匹配带来源链接的量子原语和壁垒注册表，并构建有范围的候选方案。随后用确定性的十项校验器给出权威判定，将完成状态编译为 Quantum Acceleration Evidence Graph，并通过不能增强决策的向下研究筛选。
Result: 在 582 个相同的开放发现任务上，QuantumMind 的平均 ODS 为 53.1，比最强基线高 17.3 分（相对提升 48.2%），并在 355/582 个配对任务中胜出；图审计通过率为 99.8%，而最强基线为 43.6%；在全部七个任务族中排名第一。
Conclusion: 结果表明，类型化的状态转换和确定性证据控制带来的贡献超出了流畅生成本身；该方法定位为可审计、保守的量子加速假设生成与筛选工作流。

papers.title: BRUCE: Benchmarking Robustness Under Corruption Escalation for Scientific Vision-Language Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Visual-language models (VLMs) frequently struggle with robustness issues in real-world situations due to low- or varying-quality input images. In this paper, we aim at analyzing VLMs' robustness by applying perturbations and distortions to the input images, such as blur or low contrast. Toward this goal, we propose BRUCE (Benchmarking Robustness Under Corruption Escalation, a multimodal reasoning fragility framework for scientific vision-language reasoning. State-of-the-art evaluation frameworks/studies primarily focus on clean-task accuracy and rarely analyze how reasoning stability degrades across robustness dimensions. Besides varying over a wide-range of input perturbations, BRUCE employs two novel metrics -- Robustness Corruption Index (RCI) and Traversal-RCI (T-RCI) -- to quantify how rapidly multimodal reasoning performance deteriorates in VLMs as visual corruption severity increases under progressive perturbation scaling. We evaluate BRUCE across chemistry and mathematical reasoning tasks for multiple datasets, while analyzing corruption-induced prediction failures in terms of four high-level reasoning domains: OCR-dependent reasoning, spatial reasoning, symbolic reasoning, and semantic failures, with each containing fine-grained corruption specific failure subtypes, thereby enabling an interpretable failure analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BRUCE，一个面向科学视觉语言推理的多模态推理脆弱性评测框架，通过对输入图像施加模糊、低对比度等扰动与失真，系统地分析 VLM 在图像质量变化下的推理稳定性。BRUCE 引入 Robustness Corruption Index (RCI) 和 Traversal-RCI (T-RCI) 两个新指标，度量视觉损坏严重度逐步提升时多模态推理性能的退化速度，并在化学与数学推理任务的多个数据集上评估，将损坏导致的预测失败划分为 OCR 相关推理、空间推理、符号推理和语义失败四类高层推理域。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 评测框架与研究主要关注干净任务精度，很少分析推理稳定性如何随不同鲁棒性维度退化，而真实场景中低质量或变化的输入图像会使 VLM 频繁出现鲁棒性问题。
Method: BRUCE 在宽范围的输入扰动上测试 VLM，并采用两种新指标 RCI 与 T-RCI 来量化渐进式扰动缩放下多模态推理性能的下降速率，同时按四个高层推理域及其细粒度失败子类型进行可解释的失败分析。
Result: 摘要报告 BRUCE 在化学和数学推理任务的多个数据集上进行了评估，并针对四种推理域给出了损坏导致的预测失败分析，但未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: BRUCE 提供一个可解释的鲁棒性评测与失败分析框架，强调现有研究忽略的推理稳定性退化问题，但其适用范围为科学视觉语言推理，未涉及天气或降水相关任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Ghost Features and Spooky Transfer Learning for Hypercomplex-Valued Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Hypercomplex numbers extend the concept of complex numbers by introducing additional imaginary components. Besides increasing dimensionality, operations on the imaginary parts provide algebraic and geometrical properties that can be beneficial for solving machine learning problems. In this paper, we show how to create hypercomplex-valued neural network layers where the real part corresponds to the output of a traditional real-valued layer. The additional imaginary parts of these hypercomplex-valued layers produce what we call ``ghost features,'' which contain enhanced information that is not present in the output of the real-valued layer. Moreover, ghost features can be effectively integrated into a trained neural network through a process we refer to as ``spooky transfer learning.'' This approach allows us to harness the richness of ghost features, leading to more efficient neural networks. The source code and Jupyter Notebook are available at https://github.com/mevalle/v-nets/.
papers.comment: 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种构造超复数神经网络层的方法，使该层的实部与普通实数层输出一致，虚部则产生所谓“ghost features”的增强信息，再通过“spooky transfer learning”把这一增强特征整合进已训练的网络，从而获得更高效的神经网络。摘要未给出量化实验数字，且提供了源代码与 Jupyter Notebook 仓库链接。
Motivation: 超复数运算具备额外的代数和几何性质，可用于机器学习，但如何在不破坏传统实数层输出的前提下利用超复数表示并不显然；本文针对如何生成并利用这些附加虚部信息的问题提出方案。
Method: 构造超复数神经网络层，约束其实部对应传统实数层输出，并把虚部包含的增强信息称为 ghost features；随后提出 spooky transfer learning 过程，将 ghost features 有效整合到已训练神经网络中。
Result: 摘要声称该方法能够利用 ghost features 的丰富信息，从而得到更高效的神经网络；未报告具体数据集、基准或数值指标。
Conclusion: 论文强调通过 spooky transfer learning 将 ghost features 集成到训练好的网络中可以提升网络效率；摘要本身没有讨论明确的应用范围或局限性。

papers.title: Complete, Scalable, and Robust Prioritized Planning for Multi-Robot Ordered Storage and Retrieval at Maximum Capacity
papers.abstract_en: Automated warehouses face a fundamental trade-off between maximizing storage density and achieving high retrieval throughput. While puzzle-based storage (PBS) architectures increase capacity by eliminating aisles, coordinating multiple robots in these high-density spaces is computationally challenging due to the potential for deadlocks. This paper introduces a novel multi-robot formulation for the ``ordered storage and retrieval problem at maximum capacity''. The focus is on rectangular grids accessible from a single boundary, where loads need to be first stored up to full capacity and then efficiently retrieved, given a planned departure sequence. This work bridges the gap between geometric feasibility and execution efficiency by leveraging the properties of relocation-free arrangements. These properties guide an online, prioritized multi-agent path-finding algorithm, which is the main contribution of this work. Unlike general centralized planners, the approach exploits the specific invariants of the storage arrangement to guarantee completeness and prevent deadlocks, enabling scalability. Experiments demonstrate that the method achieves near-linear improvement in makespan with respect to the number of robots, up to $m = C$, where $C$ is the grid width. Crucially, the algorithmic overhead of supporting robustness is negligible; the system handles uncertainty in departure sequences using robust storage arrangements with no significant penalty in execution speed compared to the non-robust baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动化仓库中存储密度与取货吞吐量之间的权衡，提出一种面向高密度矩形网格、仅单边可访问的多机器人“最大容量下有序存储与取回问题”(ordered storage and retrieval at maximum capacity) 新公式。方法利用无重排存储排列 (relocation-free arrangements) 的性质，指导一个在线、带优先级的多人路径规划 (prioritized multi-agent path-finding) 算法，以保证完备性并避免死锁。实验表明该方法在机器人数量达到网格宽度 C 时，makespan 随机器人数量近线性改善，且支持离开顺序不确定性的鲁棒扩展几乎不增加计算开销。
Motivation: 最大存储密度与高取货吞吐量存在根本性权衡；puzzle-based storage (PBS) 体系通过取消通道提高容量，但在这种高密度空间中协调多机器人容易因潜在死锁而难以计算。
Method: 将问题建模为单边界可访问的矩形网格上的多机器人有序存储与取回；利用无重排存储排列的不变量来指导在线优先级多智能体路径规划算法，区别于一般集中式规划器，不依赖搜索全部状态空间。
Result: 实验显示 makespan 随机器人数量呈近线性改善，最多到 m = C（C 为网格宽度）；与稳健性相关的算法开销可忽略，面对离开顺序不确定性时执行速度相比非稳健基线没有显著损失。
Conclusion: 作者强调，利用存储排列的具体不变量可以兼顾几何可行性、执行效率与可扩展性，使系统在多机器人高密度存储场景中保持完备和无死锁运行。

papers.title: LGNNIC: Acceleration of Large-Scale GNN Training using SmartNICs
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely used across domains such as natural sciences, social network analysis, chip design, and recommendation systems. However, as graph sizes grow, storing and processing them entirely on a single-node CPU-GPU system becomes increasingly impractical. A promising approach is to distribute the graph across multiple remote memory nodes, though this introduces a major bottleneck: inter-node network congestion during training. To address this, we propose LGNNIC, a novel inter-node system architecture that leverages SmartNICs co-located with remote memory nodes-a configuration already available in modern systems-to reduce communication overhead in distributed GNN training. LGNNIC offloads key preprocessing tasks to SmartNICs, reducing the volume of data transferred to computational (training) nodes and alleviating network congestion. We introduce two complementary techniques executed on the SmartNICs during the preprocessing phase: Neighbor Sampling, which performs mini-batch sampling, and Quantization of the sampled batches. To evaluate LGNNIC under different communication infrastructures, we designed both an optimized low-overhead DMA-based synchronization mechanism and a high-overhead socket-based alternative used as a benchmark. We evaluate the core SmartNIC offloading mechanisms across standard GNN workloads and sampling hyperparameters using a proof-of-concept (PoC) system comprising one remote-memory node with an NVIDIA BlueField-2 SmartNIC and one compute node with an A100 GPU. Both Neighbor Sampling and Quantization on the remote node demonstrated substantial training speedups in most configurations. Neighbor Sampling achieved up to 62.4x and 17.5x speedups with Sockets and DOCA-DMA, respectively, primarily due to reduced data transaction time. Quantization provided additional speedups of up to 3.6x and 1.3x, respectively, by reducing data transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LGNNIC，一种利用 SmartNIC 加速大规模分布式 GNN 训练的节点间系统架构。核心做法是把邻居采样 (Neighbor Sampling) 和量化 (Quantization) 等预处理任务卸载到与远程内存节点共置的 SmartNIC 上，减少传输到计算节点的数据量。在包含 BlueField-2 SmartNIC 与 A100 GPU 的概念验证系统上，邻居采样在 Sockets 和 DOCA-DMA 下分别带来最高 62.4x 和 17.5x 加速，量化再带来最高 3.6x 和 1.3x 额外加速。
Motivation: 图规模增大后单节点 CPU-GPU 系统难以存储和处理全图，跨远程内存节点分布图会引入训练期间节点间网络拥塞这一主要瓶颈。文章目标是降低分布式 GNN 训练中的通信开销，使大规模图训练更可行。
Method: 提出 LGNNIC 架构，利用现代系统中已具备的、与远程内存节点共置的 SmartNIC 卸载预处理任务；在预处理阶段引入两个互补技术：在 SmartNIC 上执行 Neighbor Sampling 进行 mini-batch 采样，以及对采样批次做 Quantization。为评估不同通信基础设施，设计了基于 DMA 的低开销同步机制，并用基于 socket 的高开销方案作为基准。
Result: 在由带 NVIDIA BlueField-2 SmartNIC 的远程内存节点和带 A100 GPU 的计算节点组成的概念验证系统上，Neighbor Sampling 在 Sockets 和 DOCA-DMA 下分别实现最高 62.4x 和 17.5x 训练加速，主要来自数据事务时间减少；Quantization 分别额外提供最高 3.6x 和 1.3x 加速，来自数据传输量减少。
Conclusion: 摘要表明在远程节点上执行邻居采样与量化能在大多数配置下显著加速分布式 GNN 训练，说明将预处理卸载到 SmartNIC 是缓解通信瓶颈的有效方向。结论基于单远程内存节点加单计算节点的 PoC 系统，未扩展到更大规模集群。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 LGNNIC，一种利用 SmartNIC 加速大规模分布式 GNN 训练的节点间系统架构。核心做法是把邻居采样 (Neighbor Sampling) 和量化 (Quantization) 等预处理任务卸载到与远程内存节点共置的 SmartNIC 上，减少传输到计算节点的数据量。在包含 BlueField-2 SmartNIC 与 A100 GPU 的概念验证系统上，邻居采样在 Sockets 和 DOCA-DMA 下分别带来最高 62.4x 和 17.5x 加速，量化再带来最高 3.6x 和 1.3x 额外加速。
summary_sections.motivation: 图规模增大后单节点 CPU-GPU 系统难以存储和处理全图，跨远程内存节点分布图会引入训练期间节点间网络拥塞这一主要瓶颈。文章目标是降低分布式 GNN 训练中的通信开销，使大规模图训练更可行。
summary_sections.method: 提出 LGNNIC 架构，利用现代系统中已具备的、与远程内存节点共置的 SmartNIC 卸载预处理任务；在预处理阶段引入两个互补技术：在 SmartNIC 上执行 Neighbor Sampling 进行 mini-batch 采样，以及对采样批次做 Quantization。为评估不同通信基础设施，设计了基于 DMA 的低开销同步机制，并用基于 socket 的高开销方案作为基准。
summary_sections.result: 在由带 NVIDIA BlueField-2 SmartNIC 的远程内存节点和带 A100 GPU 的计算节点组成的概念验证系统上，Neighbor Sampling 在 Sockets 和 DOCA-DMA 下分别实现最高 62.4x 和 17.5x 训练加速，主要来自数据事务时间减少；Quantization 分别额外提供最高 3.6x 和 1.3x 加速，来自数据传输量减少。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明在远程节点上执行邻居采样与量化能在大多数配置下显著加速分布式 GNN 训练，说明将预处理卸载到 SmartNIC 是缓解通信瓶颈的有效方向。结论基于单远程内存节点加单计算节点的 PoC 系统，未扩展到更大规模集群。

papers.title: Vision Meets WiFi: Physics-Grounded Estimation of Volumetric Mechanical Properties
papers.abstract_en: Estimating volumetric mechanical properties, including Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, and density at each voxel, is intrinsically ambiguous from vision alone, as visually similar objects may have substantially different material compositions and physical behavior. Existing approaches predict these properties independently across voxels, overlooking the piecewise-constant material structure of real objects and producing noisy or inconsistent estimates for voxels that share the same material, while lacking an explicit mechanism to resolve visual ambiguity. We introduce ViWi (Vision Meets WiFi), an object-centric framework for volumetric mechanical-property estimation. ViWi represents each object using a compact set of material slots that aggregate evidence from voxels with a shared material identity and produce coherent slot-level property predictions. To complement visual appearance, ViWi incorporates a compact RF descriptor generated through WiFi-band electromagnetic simulation using permittivity and conductivity. The RF descriptor conditions the material slots with global composition cues that may be unavailable from images, while visual features preserve voxel-level spatial localization. Across volumetric mechanical-property and mass-estimation benchmarks, ViWi improves over the prior state of the art on four of six per-voxel metrics, while its vision-only variant improves all mass-estimation metrics. These results demonstrate that combining object-centric material structure with complementary RF evidence enables more accurate and physically coherent volumetric property estimation beyond what is possible from visual appearance alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ViWi（Vision Meets WiFi），一个用于体素级力学属性估计的对象中心框架，联合估计每个体素的杨氏模量、泊松比和密度。ViWi 用一组材料槽（material slots）聚合共享材料身份的体素证据，并引入基于 WiFi 频段电磁仿真的紧凑 RF 描述子来补充视觉外观，以缓解仅凭视觉无法区分相似外观但材料不同的歧义。摘要报告该方法在体素力学属性和质量估计基准上，六项逐体素指标中四项超过先前最优，其纯视觉变体则在全部质量估计指标上取得最佳。
Motivation: 仅凭视觉估计体素级力学属性本质上存在歧义，因为视觉相似物体可能有完全不同的材料组成和物理行为；现有方法逐体素独立预测，忽略真实物体的分片常数材料结构，导致共享同一材料的体素估计噪声大且不一致，也缺少显式机制来消解视觉歧义。
Method: ViWi 用紧凑的材料槽集合表示物体，每个槽聚合具有共享材料身份的体素证据并产生槽级一致预测；同时通过 WiFi 频段电磁仿真（利用介电常数和电导率）生成紧凑 RF 描述子，用全局成分线索条件化材料槽，而视觉特征保留体素级空间定位。
Result: 在体素力学属性和质量估计基准上，ViWi 在六项逐体素指标中的四项上超过先前最优方法；其仅视觉的变体在所有质量估计指标上均取得最佳。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，将对象中心的材料结构与互补的 RF 证据结合，能够实现比仅依赖视觉外观更准确且物理上更一致的体素属性估计。
Relevance: 3
