papers.title: Finite Constant Frontiers and Auditable Regret Certificates for Average-Reward Reinforcement Learning
authors: Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan
papers.abstract_en: Average-reward reinforcement-learning regret is known up to logarithmic factors, but the numerical content of published guarantees is difficult to compare because probability mode, structural parameter, logarithmic normalization, prior information, and planning assumptions differ. We introduce a constant-aware comparison protocol and derive an explicit finite lower certificate for communicating MDPs. The construction is a binary tree of two-state blocks; its proof uses exact trajectory-level Bernoulli KL divergence and keeps action budget, diameter, occupancy, navigation cost, and terminal bias explicit. A common closed-form envelope improves the published coefficient $0.015$ across a finite frontier: $0.0200$ in a moderate regime and up to $0.0291$ under stronger action, diameter, and horizon conditions, a $94\%$ increase. The limiting coefficient is $\frac1{32}\sqrt{(A-3)/A}$. For upper bounds, we give an auditable composition rule for a span-constrained optimistic learner, but do not claim a coefficient while adaptive directional-variance and planning certificates remain open. We also formalize valid expectation conversion and constant comparability. Controlled diagnostics test diameter dependence, bonus-by-width interactions, span misspecification, and the finite lower certificate on its exact family.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对平均奖励强化学习（average-reward RL）中遗憾界常数难以直接比较的问题，提出常数感知的比较协议，并为 communicating MDP 导出显式的有限下界证书。构造基于两状态块组成的二叉树，证明使用轨迹层面的 Bernoulli KL 散度，并将动作预算、直径、占用率、导航成本与终端偏差保持显式。封闭形式包络将已发表系数 0.015 提升至有限前沿上的 0.0200（中等条件下）乃至 0.0291（更强条件下），提升约 94%，极限系数为 1/32·sqrt((A-3)/A)。
Motivation: 平均奖励强化学习遗憾的已知上界在小对数因子意义下成立，但已发表保证在概率模式、结构参数、对数归一化、先验信息和规划假设上各不相同，导致数值常数难以公平比较。
Method: 提出常数感知的比较协议，并构造两个状态块的二叉树来产生有限下界证书；证明依赖精确的轨迹级 Bernoulli KL 散度，保持动作预算、直径、占用、导航成本和终端偏差显式。同时给出 span 约束乐观学习者的可审计组合规则，并形式化期望转换与常数可比性。
Result: 摘要报告封闭形式包络将已发表系数 0.015 提升到有限前沿上的 0.0200（中等条件）和 0.0291（更强动作、直径与视界条件），提高 94%；极限系数为 1/32·sqrt((A-3)/A)。受控诊断检验了直径依赖、宽度奖励交互、span 误设以及有限下界证书在其精确族上的表现。
Conclusion: 上界方面作者仅给出可审计的组合规则，未在自适应方向方差和规划证书未解决前声称具体系数；下界证书及其常数前沿是文中核心贡献。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Neural Operators for Immersed-Boundary Soft Swimmers Locomotion
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity immersed-boundary simulation resolves the coupled motion of a deforming swimmer and its surrounding flow, but the resulting cost limits repeated evaluations for engineering design, parameter studies, and control. We develop neural-operator surrogates for temporal prediction of the hydrodynamic fields generated by planar and volumetric eel swimmers. The surrogates are trained on regular-grid fields exported from adaptive fluid--structure simulations and are conditioned on swimmer geometry and Reynolds number. The planar model jointly predicts two velocity components, scalar vorticity, and pressure. On five held-out high-Reynolds-number trajectories, its full-domain global relative L^2 error is 3.51 %. The volumetric formulation uses three target-specific models with a common multichannel input: one model predicts three-dimensional velocity, one predicts vorticity, and one predicts pressure. Their full-domain global relative L^2 errors on five held-out within-range trajectories are 3.44 %, 5.58 %, and 19.2 %. Together, the results demonstrate the feasibility of field-resolved neural surrogates for moving-boundary swimmer flows while identifying pressure accuracy and physical consistency as priorities for further development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为平面与三维体鳗鱼游泳者构建神经算子代理模型 (neural-operator surrogate)，用于时序预测其周围水动力场。代理模型在从自适应流固耦合模拟导出的规则网格场上训练，并以游泳者几何和雷诺数 (Reynolds number) 为条件。平面模型联合预测两个速度分量、标量涡量与压力，在五条留出的高雷诺数轨迹上全局相对 L2 误差为 3.51%；体模型分别预测三维速度、涡量与压力，误差分别为 3.44%、5.58% 与 19.2%。
Motivation: 高保真浸没边界 (immersed-boundary) 模拟能解析变形游泳者与其周围流动的耦合运动，但计算成本限制了工程设计中反复评估、参数研究以及控制应用。
Method: 作者提出用神经算子作为时序预测代理，输入多通道正则网格场，并以游泳者几何和雷诺数作为条件；平面模型采用单一联合预测模型，体模型则采用三个目标特定模型分别预测速度、涡量和压力。
Result: 在五条留出高雷诺数轨迹上，平面模型的全局相对 L2 误差为 3.51%；体模型三个任务在五条留出的范围内轨迹上的全局相对 L2 误差分别为 3.44%、5.58% 和 19.2%。
Conclusion: 结果展示了面向移动边界游泳者流动的场解析神经代理模型的可行性，并将压力预测精度与物理一致性列为后续发展重点。

papers.title: CODS: Iterative Bellman-Residual Data Selection for Reusable Offline Reinforcement Learning
authors: Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning repeatedly trains policies from a fixed transition pool, making redundant data costly across seeds and hyperparameters, while naive subsampling can remove rare transitions needed for long-horizon credit assignment. We introduce CODS, a critic-guided selector that alternates between fitting an algorithm-matched critic and acquiring high-residual transitions before freezing a reusable subset. Unlike prioritized replay, CODS produces a static artifact; unlike one-shot residual selection, it refreshes scores as the critic changes. At a 10\% budget, CODS retains 96.6\% of eligible-pool performance across 20 valid D4RL task--algorithm cells. It exceeds ReDOR and OPER on 19/20 cells and every other subset baseline on 20/20; all six subset advantages remain significant under predeclared hierarchical inference with Holm correction. Holding total selector updates fixed, five acquisition rounds improve four representative cells by 11.23 points over one round and saturate thereafter. Equal-pass and equal-hour evaluations clarify that reuse, rather than a single-run speedup, creates the compute advantage. Mechanism and corruption interventions expose both useful sparse-reward enrichment and sensitivity to outliers. Finally, a whole-trace extension retains 95.4\% of pooled ALFWorld success and 96.5\% of pooled GSM8K exact match. CODS is therefore a reusable selection procedure, not a formal coreset guarantee.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CODS，一种基于评论家的迭代式数据选择方法，用于可复用离线强化学习（offline RL）。CODS 交替进行算法匹配的评论家拟合与高残差（high-residual）转移采集，最终冻结一个可复用的静态数据子集；与 prioritized replay 的一次性选择不同，它会在评论家变化时刷新分数。摘要报告在 10% 预算下，CODS 在 20 个有效的 D4RL 任务-算法组合上保留了 96.6% 的合格池性能，整体轨迹扩展在 ALFWorld 和 GSM8K 上分别保留 95.4% 与 96.5% 的合并性能。
Motivation: 离线强化学习会从固定的转移池中反复训练策略，冗余数据在多个随机种子和超参数下代价高昂，而朴素子采样可能移除长程信用分配所需的稀有转移。
Method: CODS 是一种评论家引导的选择器，交替执行算法匹配的评论家拟合与高残差转移获取，然后冻结可复用子集；与 prioritized replay 不同，它产出静态工件（static artifact），与一次性残差选择不同，它会在评论家变化时刷新分数。
Result: 在 10% 预算下，CODS 在 20 个有效 D4RL 任务-算法组合上保留 96.6% 的合格池性能；在 19/20 个组合上超过 ReDOR 和 OPER，在 20/20 个组合上超过其他所有子集基线；在 Holm 校正下六项子集优势均显著。固定总选择器更新次数时，五次采集轮次相比一轮在四个代表性组合上提升 11.23 分并趋于饱和；机制与损坏干预实验揭示了有用的稀疏奖励富集和对离群值的敏感性。
Conclusion: 作者强调 CODS 是可复用的选择流程（reusable selection procedure），而非形式化的 coreset 保证。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.result: 在 10% 预算下，CODS 在 20 个有效 D4RL 任务-算法组合上保留 96.6% 的合格池性能；在 19/20 个组合上超过 ReDOR 和 OPER，在 20/20 个组合上超过其他所有子集基线；在 Holm 校正下六项子集优势均显著。固定总选择器更新次数时，五次采集轮次相比一轮在四个代表性组合上提升 11.23 分并趋于饱和；机制与损坏干预实验揭示了有用的稀疏奖励富集和对离群值的敏感性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调 CODS 是可复用的选择流程（reusable selection procedure），而非形式化的 coreset 保证。

papers.title: Tokenizer Generator Coupling in Medical Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Latent medical image generators usually treat the tokenizer as fixed preprocessing. We test whether this separation is valid in a controlled ChestMNIST study at 64x64, crossing discrete tokenizers, generator families, and sampler settings under a shared latent grid, with continuous-latent reference cells. In this controlled setting, rankings depend jointly on the tokenizer, generator, and sampler: the best quantizer changes with the generator, and validation-based sampler selection changes the apparent generator ranking. We retrain the vocabulary-1024 interaction block at three seeds and the interaction survives (6 of 9 pairwise quantizer comparisons exceed three seed standard deviations), and we scope the wider single-seed grid accordingly. Reconstruction PSNR alone is not a reliable selection criterion; we instead introduce a generator-free statistic, neighbour-conditional predictive gain, that separates the quantizer families by downstream generation quality (rank-AUC 1.00) where reconstruction PSNR and marginal token entropy do not. On LFQ-1024, retuning D3PM and SE-D3PM (selected on a held-out validation split) moves them from default FID-192 0.44/0.41 to 0.09/0.10 at lower NFE, replicated across seeds; the continuous references were not given an equivalent sampler sweep. We report FID-192 as an internal ranking metric; it ranks consistently with standard FID-2048 (Spearman 0.80) and with a label-free classifier two-sample test (0.78). We interpret these results through a rate-distortion-modelability framing, where modelability is conditional on the generator, sampler, and inference budget. All experiments are at 64x64 on low-resolution medical-style images, unconditional, and evaluated with non-clinical FID-based metrics, and we scope every claim to that setting. Code: https://github.com/liamchalcroft/medtokenizers and https://github.com/liamchalcroft/medlatents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在64x64 ChestMNIST控制实验中检验医学图像潜在生成器中tokenizer是否可视为固定预处理。作者交叉离散tokenizer、生成器族与采样器设置，发现最佳量化器随生成器改变，验证集上的采样器选择会改变生成器排名；交互效应在三个种子上多数成对比较中稳健。作者提出生成器无关的neighbour-conditional predictive gain统计量，能以rank-AUC 1.00区分量化器族，并在LFQ-1024上通过重调D3PM/SE-D3PM将FID-192从0.44/0.41降至0.09/0.10。所有实验限定于64x64低分辨率医学风格图像、无条件生成和非临床FID指标。
Motivation: 潜在医学图像生成器通常把tokenizer当作固定预处理步骤，作者质疑这种分离假定是否成立，并希望在受控设置下检验tokenizer与生成器之间的耦合关系。
Method: 在共享潜在网格下交叉离散tokenizer、生成器族和采样器设置，并加入连续潜在参考单元；对词汇1024的交互块在三个种子下重训以检验稳健性；引入生成器无关统计量neighbour-conditional predictive gain来分离量化器族；还对D3PM和SE-D3PM在保留验证集上重新调参。
Result: 最佳量化器随生成器变化，验证集采样器选择会改变生成器排名；6/9对量化器比较超过三个种子标准差；neighbour-conditional predictive gain的rank-AUC为1.00，而重建PSNR和边际token熵无法区分；LFQ-1024上重调后FID-192从0.44/0.41降至0.09/0.10且NFE更低；FID-192与FID-2048的Spearman相关为0.80，与无标签分类器两样本检验的相关为0.78。
Conclusion: 作者以率失真-可建模性（rate-distortion-modelability）框架解释结果，强调模型性取决于生成器、采样器和推理预算；所有主张严格限定在64x64低分辨率医学风格图像、无条件生成和非临床FID评估范围内。

papers.title: SpikeWorld: Fast-State Adaptation for Frozen Spiking World Models
papers.abstract_en: A predictive model receives a self-supervised signal whenever the consequence of an action is observed. Using that signal after deployment is difficult when dynamics and semantics share parameters: freezing prevents adaptation, whereas weight updates require optimizer state and may alter the learned representation. Here we introduce SpikeWorld, a 1.45M-parameter sparse spiking model jointly trained for heterogeneous sensory prediction, semantics, image-text binding and action-conditioned dynamics. At deployment, all trained parameters are frozen. Delayed next-state residuals update two external paths: cumulative fixed-bank losses select the bounded action correction, while route-specific residual matrices refine next-state prediction. Neither path uses labels, teacher outputs, rewards, success signals or the true shift value. Joint optimization improves action next-state MSE by 17.10\% while also improving multimodal prediction, semantic accuracy and image-text retrieval. On held-out shear and attenuation streams, the combined external state improves aggregate prediction by 5.48\% and 30.01\%; its fixed-bank action path improves tracking by 24.20\% and 3.94\%, respectively. In a six-arm study comprising 450 new Meta-World trajectories (75 per arm), SpikeWorld raises frozen-policy reward by 7.90 (95\% CI [2.48, 14.06]); the 13.33-point success difference is descriptive (CI [0, 40]). For identical sensory inputs, model parameters and inherited semantic outputs remain bitwise unchanged. A 16-byte RLS estimator obtains the highest non-oracle reward on linear attenuation, showing that the contribution is not superior linear identification, but its integration with a frozen multimodal spiking checkpoint. Reference code is publicly available at https://github.com/Oooorca/SpikeWorld.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpikeWorld，一个 1.45M 参数的稀疏脉冲（spiking）模型，联合训练用于异构感官预测、语义、图像-文本绑定和动作条件动力学。部署时所有训练参数冻结，仅通过两条外部路径利用延迟的下一状态残差：累积固定库损失选择有界动作校正，路由特定残差矩阵细化下一状态预测；两条路径均不依赖标签、教师输出、奖励或真实移位值。摘要报告该方法在动作下一状态 MSE、多模态预测、语义准确率和检索上均有提升，并在 Meta-World 六臂研究中提高冻结策略奖励。
Motivation: 预测模型在部署后每当观察到动作后果时都会收到自监督信号，但当动力学与语义共享参数时，利用该信号很困难：完全冻结会阻止适应，而权重更新需要优化器状态并可能改变已学到的表示。
Method: 提出 SpikeWorld：一个稀疏脉冲模型，联合训练异构感官预测、语义、图像-文本绑定和动作条件动力学。部署时保持所有训练参数冻结，通过两条外部路径完成快速状态适应：累积固定库（fixed-bank）损失选择有界动作校正，路由特定残差矩阵（route-specific residual matrices）细化下一状态预测；外部路径不使用任何标签、教师输出、奖励、成功信号或真实移位值。
Result: 联合优化使动作下一状态 MSE 降低 17.10%，同时改善多模态预测、语义准确率和图像-文本检索。在保留的剪切（shear）和衰减（attenuation）流上，组合外部状态将聚合预测分别提升 5.48% 和 30.01%，固定库动作路径将跟踪分别提升 24.20% 和 3.94%。在包含 450 条新 Meta-World 轨迹（每臂 75 条）的六臂研究中，冻结策略奖励提高 7.90（95% CI [2.48, 14.06]），13.33 分的成功差异为描述性结果（CI [0, 40]）；在相同感官输入下，模型参数和继承的语义输出保持位级不变。
Conclusion: 作者强调 SpikeWorld 的贡献不在于外部估计器本身的线性识别能力，而在于其与冻结多模态脉冲检查点的集成；实验（如 16 字节 RLS 估计器在线性衰减上取得最高非神谕奖励）支持这一判断。摘要同时报告部分成功差异的置信区间较宽，属于描述性结果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Protecting patient privacy in clinical foundation models: Technical and legal perspectives
papers.abstract_en: Clinical foundation models trained on large-scale patient data are increasingly used for decision support, screening, and public health. As deployment expands, privacy risk increasingly arises from model-mediated leakage, yet its prevalence and severity remain poorly quantified. Models can disclose sensitive training artifacts, enabling patient re-identification in ways not captured by data-handling controls alone. Existing frameworks, including HIPAA and GDPR, offer limited guidance for such indirect threats. We propose a practical framework for assessing privacy risk in clinical foundation models and illustrate realistic leakage scenarios across deployment settings, map them to legal regimes, and outline complementary technical and legal mitigations. Our analysis provides a context-aware risk assessment grounded in realistic usage to preserve the value of medical foundation models while rigorously safeguarding patient privacy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从技术与法律两个角度讨论临床基础模型（clinical foundation models）中的患者隐私风险，指出模型介导的泄漏（model-mediated leakage）可使训练数据中的患者被重新识别，且 HIPAA、GDPR 等现有框架对此类间接威胁的指导有限。作者提出一个基于实际部署场景的隐私风险评估框架，说明多种泄漏情景、将其映射到相应法律体系，并建议结合技术性与法律性缓解措施。
Motivation: 临床基础模型在决策支持、筛查和公共卫生中的部署日益广泛，但模型介导泄漏的普遍性与严重性尚缺乏量化；仅靠数据处理控制无法覆盖此类重新识别风险，而 HIPAA 和 GDPR 对这类间接威胁提供不了足够的操作指导。
Method: 提出一个实用的隐私风险评估框架，通过模拟多种真实部署设置下的泄漏场景，将风险映射到不同法律体系，并给出互补的技术性（如机制层防护）与法律性缓解措施。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验数据，而是通过分析多种真实泄漏场景来展示该框架的可操作性，并强调基于上下文感知（context-aware）的风险评估能够兼顾模型价值与隐私保护。
Conclusion: 作者认为，保持医学基础模型价值的同時要严格保护患者隐私，需要把技术控制与法律约束结合起来，并按使用场景进行风险评估。

papers.title: Towards Researcher Agents for Knowledge-Graph Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Translating a natural-language question into a SPARQL query that can be executed against a large knowledge graph requires resolving lexical ambiguity, grounding surface terms in the target ontology, and producing graph patterns that are both syntactically valid and semantically faithful. We present an agentic text-to-SPARQL system that goes one step beyond static tool-using agents: a researcher agent that, after each round of inference on a validation set, proposes and tests changes to its own prompts, rules, and tool-orchestration code. We instantiate the loop on DBpedia, evolve nine successive versions of the agent driven by a low-cost reasoning model, and deploy the best-performing configuration with two stronger backbone models. The study yields three observations: (i) self-improvement converges quickly and then achieves 0.22 overall accuracy on the 2025 DBpedia validation set; (ii) the bottleneck is consistently in basic-graph-pattern predicate selection, not in SPARQL syntax or modifiers; and (iii) several benchmark items appear to penalise correct queries due to property ambiguity in DBpedia, suggesting that future Text-to-SPARQL benchmarks should be scored using a combination of machine translation and information retrieval metrics.
papers.comment: Second International TEXT2SPARQL Challenge, co-located with Text2KG at ESWC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种 agentic text-to-SPARQL 系统，其核心是 researcher agent：在验证集上每轮推理后，自动提出并测试对自身 prompt、规则和工具编排代码的修改，从而实现自我改进。该系统在 DBpedia 上迭代出九个连续版本，由低成本推理模型驱动，最终把最佳配置部署到两个更强的骨干模型上，并在 2025 DBpedia 验证集上达到 0.22 的总体准确率。
Motivation: 将自然语言问题翻译成可在大规模知识图谱上执行的 SPARQL 查询，需要解决词汇歧义、在目标本体中接地表面术语，并生成语法有效且语义忠实的图模式。作者认为静态工具型 agent 不够，需要能够依据验证集反馈自我修改提示与编排逻辑的研究型 agent。
Method: 提出 researcher agent，在验证集上完成每轮推理后，提议并测试对其自身 prompt、规则和工具编排代码的改动，形成闭环的自改进循环。循环在 DBpedia 上实例化，用低成本推理模型进化九个版本，再将表现最好的配置迁移到两个更强的骨干模型上。
Result: 摘要报告三个观察：自改进快速收敛，取得 0.22 的总体准确率；瓶颈始终在于 basic-graph-pattern 的谓词选择，而非 SPARQL 语法或修饰符；多个基准条目因 DBpedia 属性歧义而惩罚了正确查询。因此作者建议未来 Text-to-SPARQL 基准应结合机器翻译与信息检索指标进行评分。
Conclusion: 该论文是 Text2KG/ESWC 2026 第二届 TEXT2SPARQL 挑战赛的系统描述，范围限于 DBpedia 上的文本到 SPARQL 任务。摘要强调自改进 agent 的后续提升受限于谓词选择瓶颈，并指出现有基准的评分方式可能对正确查询不公平。

papers.title: CosmosAlign: Adapting a World Foundation Model for Generative Traffic Video Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Generative traffic video forecasting aims to synthesize long-horizon, temporally coherent future videos of traffic scenes from a short observation history and textual descriptions. In this paper, we present CosmosAlign, a generative traffic video forecasting framework built upon the pretrained Cosmos3-Nano world foundation model. Our approach is motivated by the observation that successfully adapting large pretrained world models to downstream forecasting tasks depends primarily on distribution alignment rather than increased model capacity. To this end, we propose a two-stage LoRA adaptation strategy that first aligns the conditioning-mode distribution with the target forecasting task, and then aligns the training captions with the model's native structured prompting interface through an LLM-based re-captioning pipeline. During inference, we further improve prediction quality using a fully training-free procedure consisting of consensus-based medoid sample selection and motion-adaptive blending of static scene regions. CosmosAlign achieves a final score of 76.49 on the AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5 benchmark, ranking first on the final leaderboard. Our code is publicly available at https://quangminhdinh.github.io/CosmosAlign/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CosmosAlign，一个基于预训练世界基础模型 Cosmos3-Nano 的生成式交通视频预测框架。作者认为将大型预训练世界模型适配到下游预测任务的关键在于分布对齐而非增加模型容量，因此设计了两阶段 LoRA 适配策略，并在推理阶段采用无训练的后处理提升预测质量。该方法在 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5 基准上取得 76.49 分，位列最终排行榜第一。
Motivation: 生成式交通视频预测需要从短观测历史和文本描述合成长时间、时序一致的未来交通视频，而将预训练世界模型适配到这类下游任务时，分布对齐比扩大模型容量更为关键。
Method: 提出两阶段 LoRA 适配：第一阶段对齐条件分布与目标预测任务，第二阶段通过基于 LLM 的重标注流程将训练文本与模型的固有结构化提示接口对齐。推理时采用完全无需训练的流程，包括基于共识的 medoid 样本选择和运动自适应静态场景区域混合。
Result: 在 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5 基准上获得最终分数 76.49，在最终排行榜上排名第一，且代码已公开。
Conclusion: 作者强调预训练世界模型的下游适配应优先解决分布对齐问题，并通过轻量 LoRA 与无训练推理增强达到领先效果。摘要未提及与天气或降水任务的关系。

papers.title: IntelliAudit: Using Large Language Models to Evaluate Audit Controls
papers.abstract_en: IT audits require auditors to judge whether heterogeneous organizational evidence satisfies semantic security and compliance controls. This judgment is difficult to automate because relevant evidence is distributed across policies, records, spreadsheets, and operational artifacts, and because audit conclusions depend on evidentiary sufficiency rather than keyword matching. We present IntelliAudit, a retrieval-grounded multi-agent system for IT audit evidence evaluation. Given a control and an evidence corpus, IntelliAudit retrieves relevant artifacts, generates an evidence-grounded assessment, challenges adverse findings, adjudicates disagreements, and produces an auditor-facing recommendation with cited evidence, rationale, missing-evidence analysis, and remediation guidance. We instantiate IntelliAudit on ISO/IEC 27001 and evaluate it across multiple simulated organizations using expert auditor review and audit-readiness user feedback. The evaluation shows that IntelliAudit can support control interpretation, evidence-grounded reasoning, and audit-preparation workflows, while also revealing the importance of human oversight for calibrating sufficiency judgments and correcting overly permissive recommendations. These results suggest that retrieval-grounded multi-agent systems can assist audit evidence review, but should remain decision-support tools rather than autonomous certification systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IntelliAudit，一个基于检索接地 (retrieval-grounded) 的多智能体系统，用于 IT 审计中对异构组织证据是否满足语义安全与合规控制进行判断。给定控制项与证据语料库，系统检索相关工件、生成基于证据的评估、质疑不利发现、裁决分歧，并输出面向审计员的推荐，附带引用证据、理由、缺失证据分析和整改指引。作者在 ISO/IEC 27001 上实例化系统，并通过专家审计员评审与审计就绪用户反馈在多个模拟组织中评估，结果显示系统能支持控制解释、证据推理和审计准备流程，同时也凸显了人工监督对校准充分性判断和纠正过度宽松建议的重要性。
Motivation: IT 审计需要审计员判断分散在政策、记录、电子表格和运营工件中的异构证据是否满足语义安全与合规控制。这一判断难以自动化，因为审计结论依赖证据充分性 (evidentiary sufficiency) 而非关键词匹配，而相关证据又分布在多种异构来源中。
Method: IntelliAudit 采用检索接地的多智能体流程：给定控制项与证据语料库，先检索相关工件，再生成基于证据的评估，随后挑战不利发现、裁决分歧，最后产出面向审计员的推荐，包含引用证据、推理依据、缺失证据分析和整改建议。
Result: 系统在 ISO/IEC 27001 上实例化，并在多个模拟组织上通过专家审计员评审和审计就绪用户反馈进行评估。结果表明它能够支持控制解释、基于证据的推理和审计准备工作流，但评估也揭示了人工监督对校准充分性判断和纠正过度宽松 (overly permissive) 推荐的必要性。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是：检索接地多智能体系统可以辅助审计证据审查，但应作为决策支持工具而非自主认证系统；人工监督仍然是校准充分性判断和修正过度宽松建议的关键。

papers.title: PhysAttNet: Enhancing Predictive Performance in Industrial and Astrophysical Time Series via Physics-Informed Attention
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and robust time series forecasting is essential in many applications involving physical processes, such as manufacturing monitoring and astrophysical event detection. In these settings, predictive models must remain reliable under noise, variability, and measurement uncertainty while capturing temporally localized structures corresponding to physically meaningful events. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are widely used for such tasks due to their computational efficiency and strong representational capacity. However, their learned temporal representations often exhibit unstable or physically inconsistent attention patterns, reducing robustness, generalization, and interpretability. This paper introduces PhysAttNet, a physics-informed attention framework for time series forecasting. PhysAttNet augments a lightweight CNN forecaster with an attention head guided by domain-informed regularization reflecting the structural properties of physical signals. Specifically, three complementary constraints are imposed during training: an alignment regularization that encourages attention to follow smooth, peak-centered temporal structures derived from the input signal, a smoothness regularization that enforces continuous temporal evolution, and a sparsity regularization that promotes selective focus on informative intervals. These differentiable regularization terms introduce physics-guided inductive bias without requiring annotated explanations or manual supervision. Experiments on two distinct applications, namely predicting cutting forces during milling and forecasting flares in blazar time series, demonstrate that PhysAttNet improves forecasting accuracy, generalization, and prediction performance on structurally important events.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhysAttNet，一种用于时间序列预测的物理信息注意力框架（physics-informed attention）。它在轻量级 CNN 预测器上加入由领域信息正则化引导的注意力头，通过对齐、平滑和稀疏三种可微正则项，使注意力符合物理信号的时序结构。实验覆盖铣削切削力预测与耀变体（blazar）光变曲线耀发预测两类应用，摘要报告其提升了预测精度、泛化能力以及对结构上重要事件的预测表现。
Motivation: 在制造监测和天体物理事件检测等涉及物理过程的应用中，时序预测需要在噪声、变异和测量不确定性下保持可靠，同时捕捉对应物理事件的局部时间结构。CNN 虽高效且表征能力强，但其学到的时序注意力模式常不稳定或物理上不一致，损害鲁棒性、泛化性和可解释性。
Method: PhysAttNet 在轻量级 CNN 预测器上附加由领域信息正则化引导的注意力头，训练时施加三种互补约束：对齐正则化（鼓励注意力遵循由输入信号导出的平滑、以峰值为中心的时间结构）、平滑正则化（强制时间演化的连续性）和稀疏正则化（促使注意力聚焦于信息区间）。这些正则项均为可微的，无需标注解释或人工监督。
Result: 在预测铣削过程中的切削力以及预测耀变体时间序列中的耀发两个应用中，PhysAttNet 均提升了预测精度、泛化能力以及对结构上重要事件的预测性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过可微正则项注入物理引导的归纳偏置（physics-guided inductive bias）可以改善 CNN 时序预测器的注意力稳定性与预测表现，且不依赖人工标注解释。

papers.title: Keep It Simple: Multi-Key Episodic Memory Retrieval for Ultra-Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: When videos extend from hours to days, directly processing them end-to-end becomes impractical for current Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs). This ultra-long setting necessitates a two-stage paradigm: query-agnostic memory construction followed by retrieval-based inference. Prior work invests in complex memory construction to pre-model high-level relations in videos, despite not knowing the downstream query at build time. We instead prioritize high-recall retrievability during memory building, and defer query-specific, high-level relation composition to inference time. To this end, we propose MERIT(Multi-key Episodic Retrieval with Inference-time Temporal expansion), a simple yet effective agentic framework for ultra-long video understanding. First, we formulate an episodic multi-key representation that enables precise retrieval of fine-grained memories through a simple key-matching mechanism. Second, we introduce a neighbor filtering mechanism to capture broader semantic context without the massive computational overhead of global memory construction. This is achieved by expanding the temporal scope exclusively around the retrieved segments at inference time. By leveraging simple key-matching with this on-demand temporal expansion, MERIT achieves state-of-the-art performance across three long-video benchmarks: EgoLifeQA, LVBench, and Video-MME (Long).
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026 (Oral). Project Page: https://choi-yeeun.github.io/MERIT/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MERIT（Multi-key Episodic Retrieval with Inference-time Temporal expansion），一个用于超长视频理解的智能体框架。它采用两阶段范式：查询无关的记忆构建加基于检索的推理，用简单的多键情景记忆表示和键匹配机制检索细粒度记忆，并引入邻居过滤机制在推理时只围绕检索片段扩展时间范围。摘要称该方法在 EgoLifeQA、LVBench、Video-MME (Long) 三个长视频基准上达到当前最优。
Motivation: 当视频从数小时延伸到数天时，多模态大语言模型（MLLM）无法端到端处理，必须采用记忆构建加检索推理的两阶段范式。已有工作倾向于在构建阶段预先建模视频中的高层关系，但此时并不知道下游查询，导致复杂度高且收益有限；论文主张把查询特定的高层关系组合推迟到推理阶段。
Method: MERIT 首先构造一个情景式多键表示，通过简单的键匹配机制实现细粒度记忆的精确检索；其次引入邻居过滤机制，在推理阶段仅围绕被检索片段扩展时间范围，从而在不进行全局记忆构建的巨大计算开销下捕获更广的语义上下文。
Result: 摘要报告 MERIT 在 EgoLifeQA、LVBench 和 Video-MME (Long) 三个长视频理解基准上取得最先进（state-of-the-art）性能，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，简单的键匹配配合按需时间扩展就足以胜任超长视频理解，并不需要在记忆构建阶段预先建模复杂的高层关系。

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 MERIT 在 EgoLifeQA、LVBench 和 Video-MME (Long) 三个长视频理解基准上取得最先进（state-of-the-art）性能，但未给出具体数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，简单的键匹配配合按需时间扩展就足以胜任超长视频理解，并不需要在记忆构建阶段预先建模复杂的高层关系。

papers.title: An Agentic AI Framework Overcomes Fundamental Limitations of Large Language Models for Glaucoma Detection from Fundus Photography
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in medical image interpretation but suffer from hallucination, limited accuracy, and run-to-run inconsistency. We developed and validated an agentic AI framework integrating LLMs with specialized deep learning tools for glaucoma detection from fundus photography. The workflow had three steps: (1) LLM initial assessment; (2) function calling to invoke specialized tools for image quality (QAModel, FundaQ-8), glaucoma classification (SwinV2-Tiny), and optic disc/cup segmentation (SegFormer-B0); and (3) LLM reflection integrating the initial impression with tool outputs. Two LLMs (Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT-5.4 mini) were evaluated on two public datasets (ORIGA, n=100; RIM-ONE-v3, n=100) under uncropped and cropped fields of view; all images were independently graded by a masked fellowship-trained glaucoma specialist. The agentic workflow improved classification accuracy by 16 to 47 percentage points across all conditions, reaching within 6 points of the specialist; on RIM-ONE-v3 the best configurations matched the specialist accuracy of 88%. LLM-alone approaches failed in two ways: GPT-5.4 mini showed positive bias (sensitivity 95-100%, specificity 0-5%), while Gemini 2.5 Flash varied stochastically between runs; the agentic workflow corrected both. Cup-to-disc ratio error fell 15-50% (MAE 0.156-0.228 to 0.104-0.132), and correlation with specialist grading rose from weak (r=0.12-0.39) to moderate-strong (r=0.59-0.84). Run-to-run consistency rose from near-random (kappa as low as -0.01) to near-perfect (kappa up to 0.96). Integrating LLMs with specialized tools addressed key limitations of LLM-alone approaches, including over-diagnosis and run-to-run variability. Gains held for both LLMs, suggesting generalizability across backbones, and may signal a shift from monolithic models toward orchestrated multi-agent systems in medical AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个将大语言模型（LLM）与专用深度学习工具整合的智能体式 AI 框架（agentic AI framework），用于眼底照片（fundus photography）的青光眼检测。工作流分三步：LLM 初始评估、函数调用（function calling）调用图像质量、青光眼分类与视盘/视杯分割等专用工具，再由 LLM 反思整合初始印象与工具输出。在 ORAC 与 RIM-ONE-v3 两个公开数据集上，该框架将分类准确率提升 16 至 47 个百分点，最高接近或达到专科医生水平，并显著改善杯盘比（cup-to-disc ratio）误差与运行间一致性。
Motivation: LLM 在医学图像解读中虽有潜力，但存在幻觉、准确率有限和运行间不一致（run-to-run inconsistency）等根本性缺陷，单独使用难以可靠完成青光眼检测。
Method: 搭建三步式 agentic 工作流：LLM 先做初始评估，再通过函数调用调用专用工具，包括图像质量模型（QAModel, FundaQ-8）、青光眼分类模型（SwinV2-Tiny）和视盘/视杯分割模型（SegFormer-B0），最后让 LLM 反思并整合初始印象与工具输出。实验采用 Gemini 2.5 Flash 与 GPT-5.4 mini 两种 LLM，在 ORIGA 与 RIM-ONE-v3 数据集上评估，并由遮罩的专科医生独立标注作为参照。
Result: agentic 工作流在所有条件下将分类准确率提升 16 至 47 个百分点，与专科医生差距缩小到 6 个百分点以内，在 RIM-ONE-v3 上最佳配置达到与专科医生一致的 88% 准确率。LLM 单独使用时出现两类失败：GPT-5.4 mini 呈阳性偏倚（灵敏度 95-100%，特异度 0-5%），Gemini 2.5 Flash 在不同运行间随机波动；agentic 工作流纠正了这两种问题。杯盘比误差下降 15-50%（MAE 从 0.156-0.228 降至 0.104-0.132），与专科医生评分的相关性从弱（r=0.12-0.39）升至中等至强（r=0.59-0.84），运行间一致性从近随机（kappa 最低 -0.01）升至近完美（kappa 最高 0.96）。
Conclusion: 将 LLM 与专用工具整合可解决 LLM 单独使用时的过度诊断和运行间变异等关键局限，且收益在两种不同 LLM 骨干上均成立，提示医学 AI 可能从单一大型模型转向编排式多智能体系统（orchestrated multi-agent systems）。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Leveraging generative models to assist Monte Carlo sampling
papers.abstract_en: Sampling high-dimensional probability distributions is a central task in scientific computing, with applications ranging from Bayesian inference to statistical physics and molecular simulation. Despite decades of methodological developments, two major challenges remain: scaling to high dimensions and efficiently exploring multimodal distributions characterized by metastable states. Classical approaches such as Markov chain Monte Carlo, tempering methods, or enhanced sampling based on collective variables have achieved major successes, but they also face intrinsic limitations. This tutorial review explores a new paradigm that has recently emerged at the interface of machine learning and computational statistical physics: the use of generative models as tools for sampling. In this context, models such as normalizing flows and diffusion models are not used in their traditional data-driven setting, but rather as flexible probabilistic models that can assist the sampling of distributions known only up to a normalization constant. This manuscript reviews the early development of this rapidly evolving field and discusses several methodological directions, including exact samplers based on generative models and strategies to train such models in the absence of data. While an exhaustive survey of the literature is not attempted, we present a selection of key ideas and methods, along with a discussion of their strengths and limitations. The review is intended to be an accessible tutorial for both physics and machine learning audiences, and it aims to provide a starting point for researchers interested in exploring this exciting area of research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇教程式综述 (tutorial review)，聚焦机器学习生成模型辅助蒙特卡洛采样的新兴范式。作者指出，normalizing flows 与 diffusion models 在此时不是用于传统数据驱动生成，而是作为只知道未归一化常数的分布的灵活概率模型来辅助采样。文中梳理了基于生成模型的精确采样器以及无数据训练策略等方向，并讨论各自优势与局限。
Motivation: 高维概率分布采样是科学计算中的核心任务，但现有方法面临两个主要挑战：扩展到高维，以及高效探索由亚稳态 (metastable states) 表征的多模态分布。经典 MCMC、退火方法 (tempering) 和基于集体变量 (collective variables) 的增强采样虽有成功，但存在内在局限。
Method: 作为综述，该文介绍生成模型辅助采样的方向：将 normalizing flows 和 diffusion models 用作灵活的概率模型，辅助对仅已知未归一化常数的分布进行采样；具体讨论包括基于生成模型的精确采样器 (exact samplers)，以及在无数据情况下训练这类模型的策略。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值，属于对该领域早期发展的综述；它选择性地梳理关键思想与方法，并讨论其优势与局限，而不是穷尽式文献调查。
Conclusion: 作者将该综述定位为面向物理与机器学习两个领域的入门教程，旨在为有兴趣进入该方向的研究者提供起点；同时明确说明未尝试对文献做穷尽式综述。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Mendel Gödel Machine: Recursive Self-Improving Coding Agents via Comparative Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving coding agents that iteratively rewrite their own source code have demonstrated impressive performance on coding tasks. However, existing solutions generally derive self-modification from a single failure trajectory at a time, overlooking rich comparative signals available in the agent's expanding archive of past attempts. According to Mendelian principles of controlled inheritance, we introduce Mendel Gödel Machine (MGM). In addition to the general single-trajectory clonal mutation, MGM includes two new types of self-modification that better utilizes evidences accumulated: the reaction-norm mutation edits an agent based on its trajectories on multiple tasks simultaneously, and the cross-lineage hybridization edits an agent using the trajectory of a reference agent from another lineage on the same task. Under an additive fitness landscape model, we prove theoretically and demonstrate via controlled surrogate simulation that the new strategies facilitate a faster and better convergence over single-trajectory baselines. Experiments on SWE-bench and Polyglot confirm MGM's consistent improvement in performance, efficiency, and generalizability.
papers.comment: Project Page at https://reallcz.github.io/MGM; Code at https://github.com/RealLcz/MGM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mendel Gödel Machine (MGM)，一种用于自改进编码智能体的递归自修改框架。在传统的单轨迹克隆突变之外，MGM 引入两种新的自我修改方式：基于多任务轨迹的反应规范突变 (reaction-norm mutation) 和基于其他谱系参考智能体轨迹的跨谱系杂交 (cross-lineage hybridization)。作者在加性适应度景观模型下给出理论证明，并通过受控代理仿真与 SWE-bench、Polyglot 实验表明其收敛更快、更优，且性能、效率和泛化性均一致提升。
Motivation: 现有自改进编码智能体通常只从单条失败轨迹中推导自我修改，忽略了代理不断积累的历史尝试中存在的丰富比较信号。作者希望依据孟德尔式受控遗传原理，更充分地利用这些证据来加速和改善智能体的自我进化。
Method: MGM 在一般单轨迹克隆突变基础上新增两类自我修改：reaction-norm mutation 基于同一智能体在多个任务上的轨迹进行编辑，cross-lineage hybridization 则利用另一谱系参考智能体在同一任务上的轨迹来编辑。论文在加性适应度景观模型下从理论上分析这些策略，并通过受控代理仿真验证。
Result: 理论分析和受控代理仿真表明新策略比单轨迹基线收敛更快且收敛结果更好；在 SWE-bench 和 Polyglot 上的实验确认 MGM 在性能、效率和泛化性上取得一致改进。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用多轨迹比较信号的自修改方式能够显著提升编码智能体的自改进能力，其有效性得到理论、仿真和基准实验的多重支持。

papers.title: Data collection from highways: a geometric, class-agnostic approach to embedded vehicle counting
papers.abstract_en: Traffic data collection is dominated today by deep object detectors followed by tracking-by-detection, a pipeline that presupposes what is often missing in practice: a detector already trained on the class one wants to count. We revisit a purely geometric traffic-sensing pipeline for Single Board Computers in which detection is class-agnostic: moving objects come from background subtraction and thresholding, and counting is decided by a geometric rule on an imaginary line across the road, a software inductive loop detector. With no object model, training set or per-object trajectory, it runs faster than real time on Raspberry Pi class hardware. Two counting rules are described: a constant average speed rule, whose expected accuracy is derived analytically as about 86% under a Gaussian speed distribution, and a self-calibrating pre-calibration rule that recovers the lane geometry from blob statistics and counts edges of lane occupancy, additionally yielding per-vehicle average speed at no extra cost. Over four videos the latter counts with 83.3%-100% accuracy; in a field deployment it reaches 91% against 37.5% for a blob-tracking baseline under the same compute budget. We report the observations of that period in detail: the resolution floor below which accuracy collapses, the frame rate floor at which vehicles alias past the counting line, the gap between short curated clips and long uncontrolled footage, and the trade-off between Python (easier to tune, 100% CPU) and C++ (40% CPU, thermally viable). These are properties of the sampling geometry, not of the hardware of the time, and still constrain edge deployments. We close by arguing where motion-based, class-agnostic detection remains the right tool: open-set classes with no annotated data, tight power budgets, privacy-constrained installations, and the cold start of mining training crops to bootstrap a learned detector.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于单板计算机（如 Raspberry Pi）的纯几何、类别无关（class-agnostic）交通车辆计数管线：通过背景减除（background subtraction）和阈值化检测运动物体，并用跨车道的虚拟线（软件感应线圈）上的几何规则完成计数，无需目标模型、训练集或逐目标轨迹。作者描述了两种计数规则：常数平均速度规则（在正态速度分布下导出约 86% 的期望精度）和自校准预校准规则（从 blob 统计中恢复车道几何并计数车道占用边缘，同时额外给出每车平均速度）。在四段视频上后者精度为 83.3%–100%，现场部署中达 91%，而相同计算预算下的 blob 跟踪基线仅为 37.5%。论文还讨论了分辨率下限、帧率下限、短剪辑与长无控素材的差异以及 Python/C++ 实现的权衡。
Motivation: 当前交通数据收集以深度目标检测器加 tracking-by-detection 为主流，但该流程假设已经存在针对目标类别训练好的检测器，这一前提在开放集、无标注数据或资源受限场景下往往不成立。作者希望重新审视一种不依赖对象模型的几何感知管线，用于嵌入式设备上的车辆计数。
Method: 方法基于背景减除和阈值化获得运动 blob，然后在横跨道路的虚拟线上施加几何计数规则，形成软件感应线圈式检测器。文中给出两种规则：一是常数平均速度规则，其期望精度在 Gaussian 速度分布假设下解析推导约为 86%；二是自校准预校准规则，它从 blob 统计中恢复车道几何，并通过对车道占用边缘计数完成计数，同时无额外成本地给出每车平均速度。
Result: 在四段视频上，自校准规则计数精度为 83.3%–100%；在实地部署中达到 91%，而相同计算预算下 blob 跟踪基线只有 37.5%。系统在 Raspberry Pi 类硬件上运行速度快于实时。论文还详细报告了观测现象：精度崩溃的分辨率下限、车辆在计数线上混叠的帧率下限、短精选剪辑与长无控素材之间的差距，以及 Python（易调参、占 100% CPU）与 C++（占 40% CPU、热稳定）之间的权衡。

papers.title: Contextual Value Alignment via Multilayer Combinatorial Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values remains a major challenge, especially for trustworthy AI. While existing approaches such as RLHF, CAI, and their variants have achieved promising results, they often rely on a single-agent framework and a unified reward system. This limits their ability to capture ethical pluralism, adapt to diverse moral contexts, and reflect the dynamics of multi-agent moral reasoning. In this work, we propose a framework that utilizes multilayer combinatorial fusion for contextual value alignment (MCF-CVA). At the first layer of the framework, it instantiates multiple moral agents, each fine-tuned to represent a distinctive value. Their outputs are then expanded combinatorially using both score- and rank-combinations as well as average and weighted aggregations. These combined models are then reduced to the same number of initial moral agents. This expansion and reduction (EAR) process continues for multi-layers until a stopping criterion is reached. The MCF-CVA framework leverages cognitive diversity between agents to mitigate conflicts and redundancies across multiple agents, producing responses that better reflect contextual human values. The framework using the EAR algorithm is performed on the dual architecture of Euclidean score space and Kemeny rank space. Empirical evaluations demonstrated that the proposed framework outperforms single-agent baselines, multi-agent single-layer results, and previous aggregation approaches on standard metrics, showing that the MCF-CVA framework provides a robust and effective mechanism for advancing contextual value alignment in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MCF-CVA，一个利用多层组合融合进行上下文价值对齐的框架。它实例化多个各代表一种价值的道德智能体，将它们的输出在分数空间和秩空间上做组合扩展并缩减（EAR），迭代多层直到停止条件。摘要报告该方法在标准指标上优于单智能体基线、单层多智能体结果以及先前的聚合方法。
Motivation: 现有对齐方法如 RLHF、CAI 及其变体依赖单一智能体框架和统一奖励系统，难以捕捉伦理多元性、适应多样道德情境，也无法反映多智能体道德推理的动态性。
Method: 框架第一层实例化多个微调后的道德智能体，每个代表一种独特价值；随后用分数组合和秩组合以及平均和加权聚合对其输出进行组合扩展，再缩减到与初始智能体相同的数量，该扩展-缩减（EAR）过程重复多层直到停止条件。EAR 算法在欧几里得分数空间和 Kemeny 秩空间的双架构上执行。
Result: 实验评估显示，MCF-CVA 在标准指标上优于单智能体基线、多智能体单层结果和之前的聚合方法，被认为为上下文价值对齐提供了稳健有效的机制。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过利用智能体间的认知多样性来缓解冲突和冗余，从而产生更符合情境人类价值的响应。

papers.title: HeatCast: A Benchmark for Neighborhood-Scale LST Forecasting across 124 U.S. Cities
papers.abstract_en: Land Surface Temperature (LST) is a widely used satellite-derived measure of urban surface heat, but there is no shared benchmark for forecasting it at 30 m. Prior studies usually cover one to three cities, use kilometer-scale products, or do not release data and code. We introduce HeatCast, a Landsat-based benchmark for monthly LST forecasting across 124 U.S. cities from 2013 through June 2025. HeatCast contains 30 m monthly tiles with LST, elevation, surfacereflectance RGB, three spectral indices, broadband albedo, quality masks, and Local Climate Zone (LCZ) labels, together with a fixed temporal split, LCZ-stratified metrics, and a reference evaluation harness. We evaluate a CNN+LSTM and Earthformer on next-month forecasting, where Earthformer reaches 7.74 K RMSE against 10.42 K for the CNN+LSTM. Forecasting from the eight nonLST channels alone reaches 7.72 K, against 8.15 K from LST history and 8.68 K from RGB. The data, code, and weights are released under MIT at https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/9889.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HeatCast 是一个基于 Landsat 的月度地表温度 (LST) 预测基准，覆盖 2013 年至 2025 年 6 月间美国 124 个城市，空间分辨率为 30 m。数据集包含 LST、高程、地表反射率 RGB、三个光谱指数、宽波段反照率、质量掩膜和局部气候区 (LCZ) 标签，并配有固定时间划分、LCZ 分层指标和参考评测框架。摘要报告 Earthformer 在下月预测上达到 7.74 K RMSE，优于 CNN+LSTM 的 10.42 K；仅用八个非 LST 通道预测也能达到 7.72 K，优于仅用 LST 历史 (8.15 K) 和仅用 RGB (8.68 K)。数据和代码以 MIT 许可发布。
Motivation: 目前缺乏用于 30 m 分辨率 LST 预测的共享基准；已有研究通常只覆盖一到三个城市、使用千米级产品，或未公开数据和代码，阻碍了城市地表热预测的可比研究。
Method: 构建 Landsat 基基准 HeatCast，提供 30 m 月度 LST 瓦片及多种辅助通道，并定义固定时间划分、LCZ 分层评估指标和参考评测工具，同时评测 CNN+LSTM 与 Earthformer 两种模型的下月预测性能。
Result: Earthformer 达到 7.74 K RMSE，显著优于 CNN+LSTM 的 10.42 K；仅用八个非 LST 通道预测为 7.72 K，低于仅用 LST 历史 (8.15 K) 和仅用 RGB (8.68 K) 的结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 HeatCast 作为城市尺度 LST 预测共享基准的贡献，并表明非 LST 遥感通道对 LST 预测具有较强信息量；其范围限于月尺度城市热预测，与降水/降雨及资料同化无关。

papers.title: SkillConsist: Detecting Inconsistencies in Agent Skills via Bidirectional Graph Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Agent Skills provide reusable capabilities to LLM agents. Agent Skill inconsistencies can expose undisclosed dangerous behavior or cause wrong Skill selection. Recent Agent Skill research has increasingly examined Agent Skill consistency detection. Existing methods evaluate behaviors or security-property graphs against predefined categories or declared scopes. More recently, PL-HCL uses an LLM-based model to learn consistency across metadata, instructions, and resources. However, declaration and implementation behavior can be mixed across text and code, and a concise declaration can correspond to multiple connected implementation steps. We present SkillConsist to address both challenges. An LLM separates declaration and implementation content into behavior records on the implementation and declaration sides, while static analysis supplements implementation records. These records form declaration and implementation behavior graphs, respectively. Starting from a behavior record on either side, bidirectional graph alignment searches the other graph for a candidate subgraph and expands it along behavior relations until it completely expresses the source-side behavior. Graph differencing identifies conflicts between aligned subgraphs and outputs the detection results. We construct a 633-Skill benchmark from ClawHub's 500 most-downloaded public Skills and 133 Skill-Inject packages. The benchmark contains 319 inconsistent and 314 consistent Skills and 442 localized inconsistency annotations. On this benchmark, SkillConsist achieves 86.85% precision, 89.03% recall, and 87.93% F1 for package-level detection, improving F1 over the best baseline by 20.43 percentage points. For localization, it achieves 67.60% precision, 58.14% recall, and 62.52% F1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillConsist，用于检测 LLM Agent Skill 中声明（declaration）与实现（implementation）之间的不一致。方法先用 LLM 将声明和实现内容分别整理为行为记录，静态分析补充实现记录，再构造声明侧和实现侧行为图，通过双向图对齐（bidirectional graph alignment）找到候选子图并扩展，最后用图差分输出冲突。作者构建 633 个 Skill 基准，包含 319 个不一致和 314 个一致 Skill，包级检测 F1 达 87.93%，较最佳基线提升 20.43 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 Agent Skill 一致性检测方法按预定义类别或声明范围评估行为或安全属性图，难以处理声明与实现行为混合在文本和代码中、以及一个简洁声明对应多个相连实现步骤的问题。
Method: LLM 将声明和实现内容分别拆成行为记录，静态分析补充实现记录；两侧各形成行为图后，从任一侧行为记录出发，用双向图对齐在另一侧搜索候选子图并沿行为关系扩展，直至完整表达源侧行为；最后用图差分识别冲突并输出检测结果。
Result: 在由 ClawHub 下载量前 500 的公共 Skill 与 133 个 Skill-Inject 包构建的 633-Skill 基准上，包级检测精度为 86.85%、召回为 89.03%、F1 为 87.93%，F1 比最佳基线高 20.43 个百分点；局部定位（localization）精度为 67.60%、召回为 58.14%、F1 为 62.52%。
Conclusion: 摘要总结 SkillConsist 能有效检测 Agent Skill 声明与实现的不一致，并支持细粒度局部定位，且显著优于现有基线；摘要未明确说明局限性。

papers.title: Agent-MD: Selective LLM Intervention with Event-Driven Escalation for Stateful GCMC--MD Campaigns
papers.abstract_en: Long-running molecular simulation campaigns require repeated continuation from saved states, provenance-aware progression, adaptive assessment, and occasional interpretation of workflow conditions that cannot be resolved safely by fixed rules. Here, we present Agent-MD, a framework that places large language model (LLM) reasoning selectively at campaign construction and event-triggered review, while routine simulation, analysis, continuation, archiving, and state progression are handled by a persistent rule-based campaign agent using approved policies and explicit state records. Agent-MD was demonstrated in a grand canonical Monte Carlo-molecular dynamics (GCMC-MD) water-vapor desorption campaign comprising five montmorillonite systems and three sequential relative-humidity states (RH = 0.9-0.3-0.1). Across 15 system-RH states, the workflow completed 120 segmented simulation cycles with state-specific sampling lengths and provenance-aware restart inheritance. Routine production required no live reasoning-agent invocation, while one state reached a review boundary; two preserved incidents were subsequently evaluated through blinded reasoning-agent replay, which identified the underlying workflow problems and recommended appropriate follow-up actions. The simulations also revealed distinct composition-dependent low-RH responses, with Ca-bearing montmorillonite retaining more interlayer water and maintaining a larger basal spacing than the Na- and K-bearing systems, while the highest-charge Na system retained more residual water under dry conditions. These results demonstrate that long-running scientific workflows need not place every operation inside an LLM reasoning loop: selective reasoning can instead be combined with deterministic execution, structured evidence, and validated control handoffs to provide reproducible and auditable agent-assisted molecular simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agent-MD 框架，将大语言模型（LLM）推理选择性用于分子模拟活动的构建与事件触发审查，而常规模拟、分析、续算、归档与状态推进交由基于规则的持久活动代理处理。该方法在 GCMC-MD 水蒸气解吸活动中演示，覆盖五个蒙脱石体系和三个连续相对湿度状态，共完成 120 个分段模拟周期；常规生产未调用实时推理代理，但一个状态触发审查边界，两次保留事件经盲法推理代理重放识别出底层工作流问题。模拟还显示含钙蒙脱石在低湿度下保留更多层间水并维持更大基底间距。
Motivation: 长期分子模拟活动需要从保存状态反复续算、来源感知的进度管理、自适应评估，以及固定规则无法安全解决的工况条件的偶尔解读。论文针对这一需求，探讨如何在长时科学工作流中避免将所有操作都放入 LLM 推理循环。
Method: Agent-MD 框架将 LLM 推理选择性部署在活动构建和事件触发的审查环节；常规模拟、分析、续算、归档和状态推进由基于已批准策略与显式状态记录的规则型活动代理完成，并配合盲法推理代理重放进行事后评估。
Result: 在 GCMC-MD 水蒸气解吸活动中，跨 15 个体系-湿度状态完成 120 个分段模拟周期，常规生产无需实时推理代理；一个状态触发审查边界，两次保留事件经盲法推理代理重放被识别出工作流问题。模拟还发现组成依赖的低湿度响应：Ca 基蒙脱石保留更多层间水并维持更大基底间距，最高电荷的 Na 体系在干燥条件下保留更多残余水。

papers.title: Adversarial Attacks on Deep OCR Systems
papers.abstract_en: Deep-OCR (DeepSeek-OCR) advances document recognition by treating the visual modality as an optical compression medium, enabling long-context OCR at low token cost. However, its increased complexity may introduce new security vulnerabilities. In this paper, we present, to the best of our knowledge, the first pure black-box adversarial attack against a generative OCR vision-language model, where only the decoded string can be queried and no gradients, logits, or model internals are available. We recast the attack as a zeroth-order optimization problem driven by a bounded scalar loss defined directly on the string output via sequence similarity, and estimate the gradient with a random-direction finite-difference scheme whose query cost is independent of the image dimension. An Adam update with ell_infinity projection yields imperceptible perturbations for both untargeted and targeted objectives. Pilot experiments on Deep-OCR validate the string-only attack and evaluation pipeline and expose severe qualitative decoder failures, including repetition, truncation, and prompt leakage. They also show that controlled targeted rewriting remains substantially harder than untargeted degradation; we avoid claiming targeted success until the pre-registered evaluation is complete.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成式OCR视觉语言模型Deep-OCR（DeepSeek-OCR）提出首个纯黑盒对抗攻击，攻击者只能查询解码字符串，无梯度、logits或模型内部信息。攻击被建模为零阶优化问题，用基于序列相似性的有界标量损失，并通过随机方向有限差分估计梯度，查询成本与图像维度无关；Adam更新配合ell_infinity投影生成不可感知扰动，支持无目标和有目标攻击。初步实验验证了仅字符串攻击与评估流程，并暴露重复、截断和提示泄漏等严重解码器故障。
Motivation: 深度OCR系统复杂度增加可能引入新的安全漏洞，但针对生成式OCR视觉语言模型的对抗攻击尚未被研究。作者指出这是首个纯黑盒攻击，因为实际OCR场景中通常只能获取解码后的字符串。
Method: 将攻击重写为零阶优化问题，损失函数是直接定义在字符串输出上的有界标量（基于序列相似性），使用随机方向的有限差分方案估计梯度，查询成本与图像维度无关；采用Adam更新和ell_infinity投影生成不可感知扰动，涵盖无目标与有目标目标。
Result: 在Deep-OCR上的初步实验验证了仅字符串攻击与评估流程，并暴露严重的定性解码器失败，包括重复、截断和提示泄漏；同时显示受控目标重写比非目标降级困难得多，因此在预注册评估完成前不声称目标攻击成功。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作为生成式OCR模型的黑盒安全性提供了首个攻击与评估框架；作者避免预先声称目标攻击成功，等待完整评估。当前阶段仅包含初步实验，目标攻击尚未被验证有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: JUMP-lite: Compact, reproducible benchmarking of cell representations
papers.abstract_en: Image-based profiling captures rich phenotypic signatures for drug discovery and functional genomics. Large public datasets like JUMP Cell Painting now provide millions of images for systematic study. However, the scale of these resources, 115 TB for JUMP alone, and fragmented evaluation practices make systematic comparison of representation methods intractable for many researchers. Here we present Nahual, an open-source framework for reproducible model deployment, and JUMP-lite, a curated 116 GB subset of JUMP that is 1000 times smaller while preserving phenotypic diversity through careful selection of perturbations with high-confidence annotations and a storage reduction via lossy JPEG XL compression. With these, we benchmark five representation methods, including classical features (CellProfiler) and deep learning models (MorphEM, OpenPhenom, SubCell, DINOv2), and demonstrate that compression preserves downstream signal while standardized phenotypic activity and consistency metrics reveal meaningful performance differences across methods. Together, JUMP-lite and Nahual provide a foundation for accessible, reproducible benchmarking of image-based cell representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Nahual 开源框架和 JUMP-lite 数据集，后者是 JUMP Cell Painting 的一个经过筛选的 116 GB 子集，比原始 115 TB 数据小 1000 倍，并通过挑选高置信度注释的扰动和使用有损 JPEG XL 压缩来保持表型多样性。作者在此基准上比较了五种表征方法，包括经典特征 (CellProfiler) 和深度学习模型 (MorphEM、OpenPhenom、SubCell、DINOv2)，显示压缩保留了下游信号，且标准化的表型活性和一致性指标能揭示方法间的有意义差异。
Motivation: 像 JUMP 这样的大规模图像资源规模庞大（仅 JUMP 就有 115 TB），加上评估实践碎片化，使得许多研究者无法对细胞表征方法进行系统比较。
Method: 构建 Nahual 这一用于可复现模型部署的开源框架，并创建 JUMP-lite：通过选择具有高置信度注释的扰动和采用有损 JPEG XL 压缩来缩减存储，从而在 1000 倍缩小规模的同时保持表型多样性；随后用五种种表征方法进行基准测试。
Result: 摘要报告压缩不会破坏下游信号，而标准化的表型活性和一致性指标在五种表征方法之间显示出明显的性能差异。
Conclusion: 作者认为 JUMP-lite 和 Nahual 共同为图像细胞表征的可获取、可复现基准测试提供了基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PACE: A Playback-Aligned Context Engine for LLM-Based Full-Duplex Voice Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based full-duplex voice services allow users to speak while the assistant is responding. Because servers can generate output and advance dialogue state faster than clients can play it, subsequent user speech may be interpreted based on content the user never heard. We call this failure Generative Context Mis-anchoring (GCM). To address GCM issues, we present PACE, a provider-independent middleware layer that anchors model-facing context to the client playback boundary, a system-observable proxy for what the user could have heard. After an interruption, PACE repairs this context to exclude assistant content that never reached playback, while preserving low-latency generation across heterogeneous voice runtimes. We implement PACE's audio-only projection path end to end in a browser-based realtime voice assistant using a black-box speech model, without modifying the model service. We also construct GCM-Bench, a new controlled benchmark dataset of 108 playback-relative referent-anchoring cases. On GCM-Bench, PACE raises Referent Anchoring Accuracy from 25.0% to 96.3% over a cancellation-only baseline. On 200 Full-Duplex-Bench v1 interruption samples, it preserves interruption response quality. These results show that grounding model-facing context in actual playback is a practical way to maintain consistency in full-duplex voice dialogue.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 驱动的全双工语音对话中，服务器生成速度快于客户端播放速度、导致后续用户语音被基于用户从未听到的内容进行理解的问题，提出生成式上下文错锚定 (GCM) 这一失败模式。作者提出 PACE，一个不依赖具体服务提供商的中间件层，把模型侧上下文锚定到客户端播放边界，并在打断后修复上下文以排除未到达播放的助手内容。摘要报告在 GCM-Bench 上把指代锚定准确率从 25.0% 提升到 96.3%，并在 Full-Duplex-Bench v1 的 200 个打断样本上保持打断响应质量。
Motivation: 全双工语音对话中，服务器可以比客户端播放更快地推进对话状态，因此后续用户语音可能被模型依据用户实际没有听到的内容来解释，造成对话一致性错误；现有方法缺乏对此类播放/生成错位问题的系统性处理。
Method: PACE 作为 provider-independent 的中间件层，以系统可观测的客户端播放边界作为用户可能听到内容的代理，将模型侧上下文锚定到该边界；在打断发生后，修复上下文以剔除从未到达播放的助手内容，同时保持跨异构语音运行时的低延迟生成。实现上采用纯音频投影路径，在浏览器端实时语音助手中通过黑盒语音模型端到端部署，无需修改模型服务；作者还构建了包含 108 个播放相对指代锚定案例的受控基准 GCM-Bench。
Result: 在 GCM-Bench 上，PACE 将指代锚定准确率从仅取消 (cancellation-only) 基线的 25.0% 提升到 96.3%；在 Full-Duplex-Bench v1 的 200 个打断样本上，它保持了打断响应质量。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是把模型侧上下文锚定到实际播放边界是维护全双工语音对话一致性的一条实用路径，并且该方法不依赖特定模型服务提供商。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Tracing sources of epistemic uncertainty in deep learning predictions: homo- and hetero-scedastic linearized estimators
papers.abstract_en: We adapt two classical statistical estimators for quantifying uncertainty to modern deep learning, in order to provide clearer insights into uncertainty attributable to two sources : aleatoric uncertainty, or locally scarce data. Our approach leverages recent advances in approximate Fisher Information Matrices, to enable scaling to actual architectures. Experimental results demonstrate how each test points is differentially impacted by both sources, highlighting the practical utility of our estimators in improving the robustness of real-world applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将两种经典统计估计器适配到现代深度学习，用于分别归因两类不确定性来源：偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty）与局部数据稀缺导致的认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）。方法利用近似 Fisher 信息矩阵（Fisher Information Matrix）的最新进展实现规模化，实验结果展示不同测试点受两类来源的差异化影响，并强调其对实际应用鲁棒性的价值。
Motivation: 深度学习预测中的不确定性来源混杂，现有方法难以清晰区分由数据噪声引起的偶然不确定性和由局部数据不足引起的认知不确定性，而两类不确定性需要不同的缓解策略。
Method: 将同方差与异方差的线性化估计器（homo- and hetero-scedastic linearized estimators）引入深度学习，并借助近似 Fisher 信息矩阵使估计器扩展到实际规模的架构。
Result: 实验表明不同测试点受偶然不确定性和局部数据稀缺的影响存在差异，说明所提估计器能区分两类不确定性来源，有助于提升实际应用的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在真实应用中具有实用价值，但未给出具体任务或基准上的量化改进指标。
Relevance: 28

papers.title: Embedding Initialization for Unseen Low-resource Languages in Multilingual NMT: A Case Study on Limbum-English Translation
papers.abstract_en: Multilingual neural machine translation models such as NLLB-200 cover 200 languages but leave thousands unsupported, including most Grassfields Bantu languages of Cameroon. When fine-tuning these models for an unseen language, practitioners must choose a proxy language token, yet no principled method exists for this selection. We implemented an embedding initialization strategy where a language token is the average of embeddings from multiple typologically related languages already in the mod el. We evaluate this approach on Limbum-to-English translation using a parallel corpus of 8,837 sentence pairs from New Testament text and a bilingual dictionary. We compare models: NLLB-200 zero-shot (chrF2++ = 12.5), a Transformer trained from scratch (chrF2++ = 14.5), NLLB-200 fine-tuned with a Swahili proxy token (chrF2++ = 47.3), and NLLB-200 with our averaged embedding initialization (chrF2++ = 46.7). We find that the multi-language initialization achieves performance comparable to the best single-language proxy. Both NLLB-200 variants improve over the from-scratch baseline by over 32 chrF2++ points. These results show that multilingual transfer is the dominant factor in extremely low-resource Bantu translation while eliminating the need for heuristic proxy selection. However, all systems fail to preserve tonal diacritics, highlighting an open challenge. We make our dataset and code available to support further research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多语言神经机器翻译模型（如 NLLB-200）在未见低资源语言上的嵌入初始化问题，以林布姆语到英语的翻译为案例。作者提出用多个类型相关语言的嵌入均值来初始化新语言 token，并在 8,837 句对的新约文本和平行词典上评测。结果显示该多语言初始化（chrF2++ = 46.7）与最佳单语言代理 Swahili（chrF2++ = 47.3）性能相当，且两种 NLLB-200 微调变体都比从头训练的 Transformer（14.5）和零样本（12.5）高 32 分以上。
Motivation: NLLB-200 覆盖 200 种语言但仍有大量语言不受支持，包括多数喀麦隆的 Grassfields Bantu 语言；微调这些模型时需要选择代理语言 token，但缺乏可靠的选择方法。
Method: 提出一种嵌入初始化策略：将未见语言的 token 初始化为模型中多个类型相关语言嵌入的平均值，并用于 Limbum 到英语的 NLLB-200 微调；同时对比零样本、从头训练 Transformer、单语言代理 Swahili 微调等变体。
Result: 多语言平均嵌入初始化达到 chrF2++ = 46.7，与最佳单语言代理 Swahili 的 47.3 相当；两种 NLLB-200 变体相比从头训练基线提升超过 32 个 chrF2++ 点。
Conclusion: 在极低资源的班图语翻译中，多语言迁移是主导因素，且多语言均值初始化可消除启发式代理选择的需要；但所有系统都无法保留声调变音符，这仍是待解决的开放问题。

papers.title: Readout-Rank Laws for Isotropic Quantum Tangents
papers.abstract_en: Deep parameterized quantum circuits may remain sensitive to a parameter change while the observables retained by a learning model barely respond. We study this separation for a fixed computational-basis measurement. For a pure-state tangent, we compare the quantum Fisher information $F_Q$, the Fisher information $F_{\rm full}$ in the complete bitstring distribution, and the largest variance-normalized response $\mathcal I_{\mathcal A}$ available to a diagonal readout space $\mathcal A$. If the joint state--tangent frame is Haar random, we prove that the two successive information fractions are independent Beta variables whose means are $1/2$ and $r/(2^n-1)$, where $r$ is the centered dimension of the readout. Consequently, even the joint span of all computational-basis Pauli strings through any fixed weight $k$ retain only $O(n^k2^{-n})$ of the full-record information. Exact-statevector experiments across six circuit families show increasing finite-size agreement with this hierarchy in five nonconserving ensembles as the circuit depth grows. A number-conserving family departs strongly from the isotropic prediction even after correcting the support and readout rank, showing that rank alone is insufficient without tangent isotropy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究深层参数化量子电路中，参数切线的量子信息与对角读出空间可获取信息之间的分离现象。作者在纯态切线与联合状态-切线框架为Haar随机时，证明两个相继信息分数是独立Beta变量，均值分别为1/2和r/(2^n-1)，其中r为读出的中心化维度。六个电路族的精确态矢量实验支持该层次结构，但一个数守恒系综明显偏离各向同性预测。
Motivation: 深层参数化量子电路可能对参数变化保持敏感，但学习模型保留的观测量几乎不响应，理解这种可观测性与完整信息之间的信息鸿沟对量子机器学习理论很重要。
Method: 针对固定计算基测量，比较量子Fisher信息F_Q、完整比特串分布的Fisher信息F_full，以及对角读出空间A上最大的方差归一化响应I_A，并在Haar随机联合状态-切线框架下推导信息分数的分布。
Result: 证明两个相继信息分数为独立Beta变量，均值分别为1/2和r/(2^n-1)；即使所有计算基Pauli串通过任何固定权重k的联合张成，也只保留O(n^k2^{-n})的全记录信息。六个电路族的态矢量实验中，五个非守恒系综随深度增加与理论预测一致，数守恒族则强烈偏离。
Conclusion: 摘要强调秩维度本身不足以解释信息保留，还需要切线的各向同性条件；数守恒族即使在修正支撑和读出秩后仍偏离各向同性预测。

papers.title: From Single Chatbots to Governed Agent Ecosystems: An Agentic AI Pattern Catalogue and Orchestration Framework for Mission-Critical Hospital Information Management Systems
papers.abstract_en: Hospitals are racing to embed AI, while coping with the surge in adaptation of the technology in other industries, into the triage management, documentation, scheduling, and revenue-cycle workflows, yet most deployments remain as fragmented pilots that stall at the edge of production, exposing patients and institutions to operational fragility, ungoverned risk, and mounting technical debt. At the same time, the global AI-in-healthcare market is projected to exceed nearly USD 1 trillion by 2034, according to the report of Fortune Business Insights, amplifying the financial consequences of architectural missteps and failed scaling strategies. This research proposes a compliance-first Agentic AI pattern catalogue and orchestration framework, purposely built for HIMS, moving beyond the single LLM chatbots and towards a governed ecosystem of autonomous and semi-autonomous agents. The framework extends by adding (i) a taxonomy of Agentic roles, (ii) a formal risk-stratification model that maps each pattern to risk tiers, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and governance hooks, and (iii) a unified orchestration runtime capable of coordinating multi-agent workflows across EHR/HIMS landscapes such as Epic, Cerner, and MEDITECH. Technically the framework combines vLLM-based inference, optimized paging memory, confidential computing, and MCP based on-premise deployment, enforcing end-to-end encryption and policy-as-code controls aligned with HIPAA, GDPR, the EU AI Act, India's DPDP and DISHA Acts, ISO 27001, ISO 27002, ISO 14971 and IEC 62304. We exhibit how the proposed architecture is capable and efficient to reduce the documentation time, integration effort, and AI pilot attrition while constricting the governance and auditability, offering hospital leaders and governing authorities an urgently needed blueprint to convert AI investment into sustainable clinical, operational, and financial ROI
papers.journal_ref: International Journal of Innovative Science and Research Technology (IJISRT), 11-2026(5), IJISRT26MAY1651
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向医院信息管理系统 (HIMS) 的合规优先 Agentic AI 模式目录 (pattern catalogue) 与编排框架，主张从单一 LLM 聊天机器人转向受治理的自主/半自主智能体生态系统。框架包括智能体角色分类、风险分层模型与统一编排运行时，可协调 Epic、Cerner、MEDITECH 等 EHR/HIMS 环境中的多智能体工作流，并在 vLLM 推理、机密计算、MCP 本地部署基础上落实 HIPAA、GDPR、EU AI Act 等合规控制。摘要称该方法能减少文档时间、集成工作量与 AI 试点流失，同时强化治理与可审计性。
Motivation: 医院在分诊管理、文档、调度和收入周期流程中部署 AI，但多数仍是碎片化试点，难以进入生产，带来运营脆弱、未受治理的风险和技术债。全球 AI 医疗市场预计到 2034 年接近 1 万亿美元，架构失误和扩展失败的财务后果被放大。
Method: 提出一个面向 HIMS 的合规优先框架，包含三部分：(i) Agentic 角色分类；(ii) 将每个模式映射到风险层级、人机协同检查点 (human-in-the-loop checkpoints) 和治理挂钩的形式化风险分层模型；(iii) 统一编排运行时，协调跨 EHR/HIMS 的多智能体工作流。技术栈基于 vLLM 推理、优化分页内存、机密计算和基于 MCP 的本地部署，并通过 policy-as-code 实施端到端加密，对齐 HIPAA、GDPR、EU AI Act、印度 DPDP/DISHA、ISO 27001/27002/14971 与 IEC 62304。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值，而是展示该架构在能力和效率上可减少文档时间、集成工作量和 AI 试点流失，同时强化治理与可审计性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这是一个面向医院领导者和监管机构的蓝图，旨在将 AI 投资转化为可持续的临床、运营和财务 ROI；其范围是治理与编排框架的提出与示范。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Controlled Memory Interference in Continual LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory enables AI agents to maintain continuity across sessions, personalize behavior, and evolve through accumulated experience. Yet memory evolution is not simply a process of storing more information: new experiences may reinforce, revise, or interfere with existing memory states. Existing systems mainly emphasize memory construction and relevance-based retrieval, but several memories may remain simultaneously relevant while differing in state, temporal validity, or authority. We introduce Controlled Memory Interference (CMI), a controlled diagnostic and data-generation framework for studying how agent memory evolves under different memory relationships. Across controlled memory evolution, benign accumulation has limited effects, whereas relationship-specific interference sharply suppresses update plasticity with little stability gain, either by blocking target-memory exposure or by disrupting its downstream use. Lexical and Dense retrieval exhibit distinct interference pathways, while poisoning is more sensitive to update-authority cues than to recency alone. Beyond diagnosis, CMI provides targeted examples for interference-aware memory learning, improving the distinction between valid updates and interference-inducing memories while preserving performance on original memory tasks. These findings show that memory evolution is shaped not only by memory scale, but also by interactions among accumulated experiences. More broadly, memory interference emerges as an important factor for reliable continual agent memory systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Controlled Memory Interference (CMI)，一个受控诊断与数据生成框架，用于研究持续 LLM 智能体（continual LLM agents）在不同记忆关系下长期记忆如何演化。通过受控记忆演化实验，作者发现良性累积影响有限，而关系特定的干扰会显著抑制更新可塑性且几乎不带来稳定性增益；Lexical 与 Dense 检索表现出不同的干扰路径，毒性（poisoning）对更新权威线索比新近性更敏感。CMI 还提供针对性示例用于干扰感知的记忆学习，在保持原始记忆任务性能的同时提升有效更新与干扰记忆的区分。
Motivation: 现有长期记忆系统主要强调记忆构建与基于相关性的检索，但多个记忆可能同时相关却在状态、时间有效性或权威性上不同；新经验可能强化、修订或干扰已有记忆，而记忆演化并非简单的信息累积，这一干扰机制尚未被系统研究。
Method: 引入 CMI，一个受控的诊断与数据生成框架，在受控记忆演化设置下考察不同记忆关系（如相互矛盾的记忆）如何影响智能体记忆更新；该方法既用于诊断记忆干扰路径，也生成针对性的训练示例来改进干扰感知的记忆学习。
Result: 受控实验显示，良性记忆累积影响有限；关系特定干扰通过阻断目标记忆暴露或破坏其下游使用来强烈抑制更新可塑性，且几乎没有稳定性收益。Lexical 与 Dense 检索产生不同干扰途径，毒性干扰对更新权威信号的敏感性高于对新近性的敏感性；使用 CMI 示例训练后，模型能更好区分有效更新与干扰记忆，同时不损害原始记忆任务性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调，持续智能体的记忆演化不仅由记忆规模决定，也由积累经验之间的相互作用塑造；记忆干扰是构建可靠持续智能体记忆系统的关键因素。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CMU-Drive and V2V-VLA: Cooperative Multi-agent Unified Driving with Reasoning Benchmark and Vehicle-to-Vehicle Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently achieved impressive performance for end-to-end autonomous driving, yet existing approaches are primarily designed for an individual single autonomous driving agent with limited support for cooperative perception, reasoning, and planning. We present Cooperative Multi-agent Unified Driving with Reasoning (CMU-Drive), a closed-loop end-to-end benchmark for evaluating cooperative autonomous driving with multiple connected autonomous vehicles (CAVs) operating in safety-critical driving scenarios with background traffic participants. We further propose Vehicle-to-Vehicle Vision-Language-Action (V2V-VLA), a cooperative VLA model that integrates cooperative driving into a single forward pass by jointly generating driving actions, future waypoints, language reasoning, and communication policies. Experiments on CMU-Drive establish the first benchmark and baseline for cooperative VLA driving and provide a foundation for future research on multi-agent, closed-loop, end-to-end cooperative autonomous driving. Our code, benchmark, and model checkpoint will be publicly released to facilitate open-source research.

papers.title: FlowErase-OPD: Multi-Concept Erasure via Anchored On-Policy Distillation in Flow Matching Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in flow matching models have substantially improved the quality of text-to-image generation, but have also raised increasing safety concerns due to their potential to generate harmful or undesirable content. Existing concept erasure methods for flow matching models predominantly focus on removing individual concepts, while effectively erasing multiple concepts simultaneously remains challenging. We propose FlowErase-OPD, a framework for multi-concept erasure based on on-policy distillation (OPD). Our approach first distills multiple single-concept erased models into a unified LoRA module and introduces Anchored Multi-Teacher Distillation (AMTD), which incorporates a retention teacher to mitigate the trade-off between concept erasure and preservation of generative capabilities. To further improve the coordination of multiple erasure objectives, we develop Adaptive Retention Control (ARC), which dynamically adjusts the sampling frequency and loss weight of each erasure teacher, together with the relative contribution of erasure and retention teachers throughout training. Extensive experiments on nudity, object, and artistic-style erasure demonstrate that FlowErase-OPD consistently improves the trade-off between erasure effectiveness, image quality, and semantic alignment, achieving state-of-the-art performance across diverse multi-concept erasure settings. Furthermore, the resulting models exhibit strong robustness against adversarial attacks. These results highlight the potential of on-policy distillation as a principled framework for safe and controllable generation in flow matching models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowErase-OPD，面向流匹配模型 (flow matching models) 的多概念擦除框架。方法先将多个单概念擦除模型蒸馏到一个统一 LoRA 模块，并提出锚定多教师蒸馏 (Anchored Multi-Teacher Distillation, AMTD) 引入保留教师以缓解擦除与生成能力保持之间的权衡；随后用自适应保留控制 (Adaptive Retention Control, ARC) 动态调整各擦除教师的采样频率、损失权重以及擦除/保留教师的相对贡献。实验覆盖裸体、物体和艺术风格擦除，报告了擦除有效性、图像质量和语义对齐的改善，以及对对抗攻击的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有流匹配模型的概念擦除方法主要针对单个概念，多样概念同时擦除仍具挑战，且擦除与保留生成能力之间存在权衡。
Method: 提出 FlowErase-OPD，基于在线策略蒸馏 (on-policy distillation)：先将多个单概念擦除模型蒸馏为统一 LoRA 模块，提出 AMTD 加入保留教师，并提出 ARC 在训练中动态调整采样频率、损失权重和教师相对贡献。
Result: 在裸体、物体和艺术风格擦除的实验中，FlowErase-OPD 一致改进擦除效果、图像质量与语义对齐之间的权衡，在多种多概念擦除设置下达到 state-of-the-art，并表现出强对抗鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在线策略蒸馏可作为流匹配模型中安全可控生成的通用框架。

papers.title: Stochastic gradient descent with discontinuity across a manifold
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic gradient descent for a loss function discontinuous across lower dimensional manifolds is analyzed by studying its differential equation limit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上分析损失函数在低维流形上不连续时的随机梯度下降（SGD）行为，方法是通过研究其微分方程极限（differential equation limit）。摘要没有给出具体数值实验或定量收敛结果，属于理论分析工作。
Motivation: 标准 SGD 分析通常假设损失函数足够光滑，而损失在低维流形上不连续的情形缺乏理论刻画；这项研究针对这类不连续损失下的 SGD 极限行为进行分析。
Method: 采用微分方程极限方法，将离散的随机梯度迭代与连续时间极限联系起来，从而分析不连续流形情形下 SGD 的动力学。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果或定量结论，主要贡献在于建立并分析上述微分方程极限。
Conclusion: 该工作为损失函数在流形上不连续的 SGD 提供了理论分析视角；具体结论的适用范围和条件需要阅读全文确认。

papers.title: TeXFix-Bench: An Empirically Grounded Multi-Format Benchmark for LLM-Based Document Source Repair
papers.abstract_en: Scientific and technical writing depends on markup sources that must compile: LaTeX, Typst, and Markdown pipelines fail on missing delimiters, mismatched environments, broken imports, or package conflicts. Existing document-repair evaluations inject faults with ad-hoc edits that lack an empirical fault model. We present TeXFix-Bench, a multi-format benchmark for LLM-based full-source document repair grounded in a mined fault taxonomy. A Grounded-Theory study of localized hard-crash LaTeX faults from TeX Stack Exchange, GitHub commits, and package documentation (168 verified faults, dual open coding at $κ$=0.34) yields an 18-category taxonomy instantiated as DocMut: 48 AST-aware operators across three formats. A three-model cross-benchmark shows DocMut faults are 5.6-9.2 pp harder to repair than pattern-based mutations on the same seeds, and a real-error case study (88 mined human crashes, 67.0% repair success) brackets both synthetic sets from below. We construct 10,437 instances from 743 openly licensed seeds and evaluate seven LLMs under a fixed zero-shot protocol with provider-pinned routing, collecting 48,651 attempts at about USD 200 total inference cost. A complete 6,613-instance x 7-model balanced matrix confirms all rankings. A pinned engine gate yields a 27.5-point intention-to-treat compile spread (56.7-84.2%). Typst is markedly harder than LaTeX and Markdown. A restoration oracle over 28,129 compiling repairs shows that 13.6-18.5% of compiling repairs materially alter document text, and restoration rank diverges from compile rank: the model with the lowest compile rate restores content best among its successes. Compile success alone overstates repair quality. We release the taxonomy, DocMut, and all campaign artifacts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TeXFix-Bench，一个面向 LLM 的全源文档修复 (full-source document repair) 多格式基准，基于经验挖掘的故障分类法而非人为 ad-hoc 注入。作者通过对 TeX Stack Exchange、GitHub 提交和包文档中的 168 个已证实 LaTeX 硬崩溃故障进行 Grounded-Theory 研究（双人开放编码，κ=0.34），得到 18 类分类法并实现为 DocMut，含跨 LaTeX/Typst/Markdown 三种格式的 48 个 AST 感知算子。基于 743 个开放许可种子构造 10,437 个实例，以固定 zero-shot 协议评估七个 LLM，共收集 48,651 次尝试，推理成本约 200 美元。结果显示 DocMut 故障比基于模式的变异难修复 5.6-9.2 个百分点，Typst 明显比 LaTeX 和 Markdown 更难，且编译成功本身会高估修复质量。
Motivation: 现有的文档修复评测用 ad-hoc 编辑注入故障，缺乏经验性故障模型，而科学和技术写作依赖必须能编译的标记源（LaTeX、Typst、Markdown），缺失分隔符、环境不匹配、导入损坏或包冲突都会导致失败。
Method: 通过 Grounded-Theory 研究挖掘局部硬崩溃 LaTeX 故障，形成 18 类经验分类法并实例化为 DocMut 的 48 个 AST 感知变异算子，覆盖三种格式；从 743 个种子构造 10,437 个实例，在固定 zero-shot 协议与 provider-pinned routing 下评估七个 LLM，并用 28,129 个可编译修复构建内容恢复 oracle 来检验修复是否改变文档文本。
Result: 三模型交叉基准显示 DocMut 故障比 pattern-based 变异难修 5.6-9.2 个百分点；88 个人类崩溃的真实错误案例研究中修复成功率为 67.0%，从下方框住两组合成集；完整的 6,613 实例×7 模型平衡矩阵确认所有排序，pinned engine gate 产生 27.5 点的 intention-to-treat 编译成功率跨度（56.7-84.2%）；恢复 oracle 显示 13.6-18.5% 的可编译修复会实质改变文档文本，且恢复排名与编译排名不一致——编译率最低的模型在其成功修复中内容恢复最好。
Conclusion: 作者强调仅以编译成功作为修复质量指标会高估质量，并公开了分类法、DocMut 及全部评测工件。

papers.title: HSMLA: Hierarchical Softmax Multi-scale Linear Attention for Efficient Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Vision transformers face significant computational overheads in high-resolution dense prediction due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Linear attention offers efficiency but sacrifices local context modeling. We propose \textbf{HSMLA (Hierarchical Softmax Multi-scale Linear Attention)}, which combines ReLU-based linear attention for global context, selective softmax refinement for critical local features, and multi-scale token representations via depthwise convolutions. HSMLA achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs: up to $4.2\times$ inference-time speedup across dense prediction tasks, $87.3%$ Dice with $3.2\times$ speedup on CT organ segmentation, and $94.2%$ AUC with $4.1\times$ speedup on pathology WSI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HSMLA (Hierarchical Softmax Multi-scale Linear Attention)，一种用于高效视觉 Transformer 的注意力机制，结合 ReLU 线性注意力捕捉全局上下文、选择性 softmax 细化关键局部特征，以及基于深度可分离卷积的多尺度 token 表示。摘要报告在密集预测任务上最高 4.2 倍推理加速，CT 器官分割达到 87.3% Dice 且 3.2 倍加速，病理 WSI 上 AUC 94.2% 且 4.1 倍加速。
Motivation: 视觉 Transformer 在高分辨率密集预测中因自注意力的二次复杂度带来显著计算开销；线性注意力虽高效但牺牲了局部上下文建模能力。
Method: 提出 HSMLA，将 ReLU 线性注意力用于全局上下文、选择性 softmax 细化用于关键局部特征、深度卷积用于多尺度 token 表示，从而在保持效率的同时恢复局部建模。
Result: 摘要报告在密集预测任务上最高 4.2 倍推理加速；CT 器官分割中 Dice 87.3%、3.2 倍加速；病理 WSI 分类 AUC 94.2%、4.1 倍加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 HSMLA 在精度与效率之间取得更优权衡，适用于高分辨率密集预测任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Coordinated incentives in AI-generated misinformation governance
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid diffusion of AI-generated content, AI-driven misinformation is becoming increasingly pervasive and difficult to govern, undermining information credibility and social trust. This study models the strategic interdependence among a government regulator, an AI enterprise, and users through a three-party evolutionary game that incorporates heterogeneous rewards and punishments. From the resulting replicator equations, we characterize the evolutionary stability of competing governance and production strategies. The analysis indicates that neither unilateral regulation nor market incentives alone can effectively curb misinformation. Instead, an evolutionarily stable regime of real-information production arises only when regulatory rewards and punishment intensity, enterprise reputation loss, and user adoption incentives collectively surpass critical thresholds. The findings highlight the need for coordinated and adaptive policy mixes that align regulatory instruments with enterprise behavior and user uptake while managing governance costs.

papers.title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Reasoning Runtime for Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon reasoning requires an agentic runtime that can persist when evidence supports its current approach and pivot when measurements reveal failure, hidden constraints, or a misspecified objective. We present Argus, a persistent, self-evolving runtime in which Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer execute bounded missions over durable project state. Argus separates stable user intent from operational objectives, constraints, and verification criteria, and admits memories, skills, procedures, verifiers, routing decisions, and rejected routes only after role-owned review and, when available, task-native verification. Model weights remain fixed; self-evolution occurs through persistent runtime state and control policy, with autonomous execution between operator-owned escalation points. Across seven GPT-5.5 benchmark arenas, Argus achieves about 78% on SWE-Bench Pro versus 59% for Direct Copilot while using 1.41 times the aggregate tokens. After verification-gated self-evolution, mature SWE-Bench waves use 21% fewer solve-input tokens and 15% less active workflow time per task than startup waves, while recording 34 verifier recoveries and 22 strict review-loop rescues. Argus also reaches 76.8% on AARRI-Bench and a 28.0-point gap on mathematical data synthesis, with competitive GPU-kernel and language-model-training results. Beyond benchmarks, an optimized RWKV6 kernel was merged upstream; a multi-day mathematics campaign retained falsified routes and proof-backed frontier updates; and six paper pipelines completed 254 missions with 16 stage rollbacks. These results show that a fixed-weight, self-evolving harness can revise, recover, and accumulate verified approaches while producing structured trajectories for future supervised and reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Argus，一个面向长时程任务（long-horizon tasks）的持久化、自演化智能体运行时（agentic runtime）。Argus 由 Manager、Planner、Engineer、Reviewer 四个角色在持久项目状态上执行有界任务，模型权重固定，自演化只发生在运行时状态与控制策略层面。摘要报告其在 SWE-Bench Pro 上达到约 78%（对比 Direct Copilot 的 59%），在 AARRI-Bench 上达到 76.8%，并通过验证门控的自演化在成熟任务波次中降低 21% 的 solve-input tokens 和 15% 的活动工作流时间。
Motivation: 长时程推理要求智能体运行时既能依据当前证据坚持既有方案，又能在测量显示失败、隐藏约束或目标设定错误时转向；现有框架缺少这种持久且可自演化的运行时支撑。
Method: Argus 将稳定的用户意图与操作目标、约束和验证标准分离，只有通过角色所属审查（role-owned review）以及可用时的任务原生验证，才会接纳记忆、技能、流程、验证器、路由决策和被拒绝的路径。模型权重保持不变，自进化通过持久运行时状态和控制策略实现，并在操作者拥有的升级点（escalation points）之间自主执行。
Result: 在七个 GPT-5.5 基准竞技场中，Argus 在 SWE-Bench Pro 上取得约 78%，高于 Direct Copilot 的 59%，但总 token 消耗为后者的 1.41 倍；验证门控自进化后，成熟 SWE-Bench 波次比启动波次每个任务少用 21% 的 solve-input tokens 和 15% 的活动工作流时间，并记录 34 次验证器恢复和 22 次严格评审循环救援。此外在 AARRI-Bench 上达到 76.8%，在数学数据合成上拉开 28.0 个百分点的差距，并取得有竞争力的 GPU 内核和语言模型训练结果；一个优化的 RWKV6 内核已被上游合并，六条论文流水线完成了 254 个任务并发生 16 次阶段回滚。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些结果说明，固定权重、自演化的智能体框架能够在更新模型权重之外修正、恢复并积累经过验证的方法，同时为未来的监督学习和强化学习生成结构化轨迹。

papers.title: On the Identifiability of Masked Prediction: Mode Blindness and Mask Schedules
papers.abstract_en: Masked prediction learns representations by fitting a schedule-weighted family of conditional laws, but it remains unclear when near-optimal conditional prediction pins down the underlying joint law. We study this question for data with two well-separated global modes, outside the reach of rapid-mixing recovery guarantees, and show that the answer is decided by the mask schedule alone. Under large-context mode pinning, reweighting the two modes can move the joint law by a constant in total variation while perturbing the masked objective exponentially little in the visible-context size: mask schedules dominated by large contexts are provably blind to the global mode weights. To quantify this, we introduce an $\varepsilon$-identifiability modulus, the largest distributional error consistent with a given excess risk, and prove that it remains macroscopic at an excess risk that is exponentially small. An exact information decomposition pinpoints what restores identifiability: mode-weight sensitivity is governed by the residual mode uncertainty given the visible context. Consequently, low-visibility masks recover this sensitivity, and positive full-mask mass anchors the joint law over all admissible models with no assumption on the data law. Empirically, we test our theory at three levels: enumeration on computable laws verifies the predicted rates, gradient training reproduces both the mode blindness and the recovery, and measurements on real corpora place natural text between the two certified regimes.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究掩码预测 (masked prediction) 何时能从近最优的条件预测唯一确定底层联合分布，聚焦于具有两个分离良好全局模式、且超出快速混合恢复保证范围的数据。作者证明答案仅由掩码调度 (mask schedule) 决定：在大上下文模式固定下，重新加权两个模式可使联合分布产生常数级别的全变差 (total variation) 移动，同时仅指数级轻微扰动掩码目标，因此以大上下文为主的调度对全局模式权重是盲的。论文引入 ε-可辨识性模量 (ε-identifiability modulus) 并给出精确的信息分解，指出模式权重敏感性由可见上下文下的残差模式不确定性决定，低可见性掩码可恢复该敏感性，正的全掩码质量则无需数据假设即可锚定联合分布。实验在三个层面验证理论：可计算分布上的枚举、梯度训练的复现以及真实语料上的测量。
Motivation: 掩码预测通过拟合一组由调度加权的条件分布来学习表示，但近最优的条件预测何时能固定住底层联合分布这一问题尚不清晰，尤其是当数据具有两个分离良好的全局模式时，快速混合的恢复保证不再适用。
Method: 理论上引入 ε-可辨识性模量，即给定超额风险 (excess risk) 下允许的最大分布误差，并对掩码目标做精确信息分解，以刻画模式权重敏感性；同时给出受大上下文支配的调度导致模式盲性的定量论证。实验部分在可计算分布上枚举验证理论速率，用梯度训练复现盲性与恢复现象，并在真实语料上测量自然文本所处的区间。
Result: 理论结果表明，当超额风险指数级小时，分布误差仍可保持宏观尺度；模式权重敏感性由可见上下文下的残差模式不确定性控制，因此低可见性掩码能够恢复敏感性，而正的 full-mask 质量可以在不假设数据分布的情况下锚定联合分布。
Conclusion: 作者认为掩码预测的可辨识性由掩码调度单独决定，贪大上下文的调度会对全局模式权重失明，而低可见性掩码与正的全掩码质量可恢复或保证可辨识性；自然文本实测介于两种被证实的机制之间。
