papers.title: Dysphagia Risk Stratification in Head and Neck Cancer via Two-Stage PRO-Clinical Stacking
papers.abstract_en: Dysphagia is a debilitating late effect of head and neck cancer (HNC) treatment, yet timely identification of at-risk patients remains challenging in survivorship care. Definitive assessment relies on videofluoroscopic imaging, as captured by the Dynamic Imaging Grade of Swallowing Toxicity (CTCAE-DIGEST), which, while validated, requires specialized equipment, trained personnel, and significant patient burden, limiting its routine use in surveillance. Patient-reported outcomes (PROs), by contrast, are low-cost, scalable, and easily collected at any clinical encounter, making them an attractive alternative signal for identifying patients who may warrant further evaluation. However, a clear clinical framework for translating PRO responses into actionable interventions is still evolving. In particular, uncertainty remains regarding when a patient's self-reported symptom burden should prompt escalation of care. This study addresses this gap by formulating a single-visit PRO-clinical prediction framework and introducing a clinically interpretable two-stage stacking model to predict swallowing impairment risk using PRO responses and structured clinical variables, without requiring videofluoroscopic imaging. The proposed framework quantifies the independent contributions of patient-reported symptoms and clinical factors within a unified and interpretable risk assessment model. Our findings demonstrate that individual MDADI responses contain predictive information beyond that captured by composite or global summary scores, while interpretability analyses reveal symptom patterns and clinical risk factors associated with swallowing impairment. Together, these results support the use of structured PRO-clinical integration as a practical, imaging-free approach for dysphagia risk stratification in HNC survivorship.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对头颈癌（HNC）幸存者吞咽困难风险分层问题，提出一种基于单次就诊的患者报告结局（PRO）与临床变量预测框架，采用临床可解释的两阶段堆叠（two-stage stacking）模型，在不依赖视频荧光吞咽造影（videofluoroscopic imaging）的情况下预测吞咽功能损伤风险。研究发现单独的 MDADI 条目反应包含超越综合或总体评分之外的预测信息，可解释性分析揭示了与吞咽损伤相关的症状模式和临床危险因素。
Motivation: 吞咽困难是头颈癌治疗后常见的衰弱性晚期效应，但金标准评估依赖 CTCAE-DIGEST 视频荧光影像，需要专门设备、训练人员且患者负担大，难以常规用于随访监测。PRO 成本低、可扩展且易于采集，但目前缺乏将 PRO 反应转化为临床升级干预的清晰框架，尤其是自我报告症状负担何时应触发进一步评估仍不明确。
Method: 提出一个单次就诊的 PRO-临床预测框架，并引入临床可解释的两阶段堆叠模型，融合 PRO 反应和结构化临床变量来预测吞咽功能损伤风险，无需视频荧光影像。该框架在统一可解释的风险模型中量化患者报告症状与临床因素的独立贡献。
Result: 研究发现单个 MDADI 条目反应包含超出复合或总体评分的额外预测信息；可解释性分析进一步揭示了与吞咽损伤相关的症状模式和临床危险因素。
Conclusion: 结构化 PRO-临床整合可作为头颈癌幸存者吞咽困难风险分层的实用、免影像手段。摘要未报告具体量化指标或前瞻性验证，其证据范围限于单次就诊与所提出的预测框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SoftReason: A Fully Differentiable Neuro-Soft-Symbolic Deductive Reasoning Architecture over High-Dimensional Perceptual Data
papers.abstract_en: In many reasoning problems, the premises are not observed as discrete symbols, but must be inferred from high-dimensional inputs. Further, the predicate vocabulary, argument structure, and trusted evidence are supplied by a Knowledge Graph (KG), or rule definitions. Classical neuro-symbolic pipelines have a discrete interface between perception and deduction. We present a neuro-soft-symbolic architecture for differentiable deductive reasoning over latent perceptual facts and knowledge-provided predicates. SoftReason removes the gradient gap by representing the deductive state as a local soft interpretation tensor over candidate constants and predicates. Perception proposes probabilistic base facts, KG triples enter as high-confidence soft evidence, and every query anchor, predicate choice, and closure update remains differentiable. Our core innovation is a learned differentiable lift of the immediate-consequence operator. It uses predicate-definition embeddings and latent composition channels to form soft body-predicate mixtures, aggregate over all possible witnesses, propose query-conditioned head facts, and update the interpretation through a monotone probabilistic OR. We instantiate the framework on Knowledge-aware Visual Question Answering (KVQA), and demonstrates how SoftReason supports end-to-end perceptual grounding, KG evidence injection, and differentiable deductive closure in one trainable architecture.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SoftReason，一种完全可微的神经-软符号 (neuro-soft-symbolic) 演绎推理架构，面向前提需从高维感知数据推断而非以离散符号直接给出的推理问题。其核心是让演绎状态由候选常量与谓词上的局部软解释张量表示，并将知识图谱 (KG) 三元组作为高置信软证据注入，使感知接地、KG 证据和演绎闭包全部在单一可训练架构中端到端可微。框架在知识感知视觉问答 (KVQA) 上实例化，摘要未报告量化实验结果。
Motivation: 许多推理问题的前提不是离散符号，而是必须从高维输入中推断；经典神经符号流水线在感知与演绎之间存在离散接口，形成梯度断点。谓词词汇、论元结构和可信证据来自知识图谱或规则定义，因此需要一个可微方式将感知事实与知识提供的谓词结合进行演绎推理。
Method: SoftReason 将演绎状态表示为候选常量和谓词上的局部软解释张量，感知模块提出概率基础事实，KG 三元组以高置信软证据进入。核心创新是 immediate-consequence operator 的可微提升：利用谓词定义嵌入和潜在组合通道构造软 body-predicate 混合，对所有可能的见证 (witnesses) 聚合，提出查询条件化的 head 事实，并通过单调概率 OR 更新解释。
Result: 摘要未给出量化实验指标；其报告的是框架在 KVQA 上的实例化，展示了 SoftReason 能够在一个可训练架构中同时支持端到端感知接地、KG 证据注入和可微演绎闭包。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SoftReason 通过可微演绎推理弥合了感知与演绎之间的梯度鸿沟，并将知识图谱证据与感知接地统一到同一训练流程。摘要层面未讨论方法的局限性或失败案例。

papers.title: Digital Fragmentation and Generative AI Use Across 103 Million Application Events
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge workers switch between applications thousands of times per day, spending nearly a tenth of the work year transitioning between digital applications in a process called digital fragmentation. Whether this fragmentation reflects who an employee is, where they work, or what kind of day they are having, has remained an open question. We analyzed 103 million application events recorded second-by-second from 1,017 employees across eight organizations that largely employ knowledge workers (e.g., law, financial services). Day-to-day variation in fragmentation within individual employees accounted for 44.6% of the variation in digital fragmentation, slightly exceeding stable individual differences between employees (35.8%), and far exceeding variation between organizations (19.6%). Fragmentation rose over the work week and reset after weekends and holidays. Higher-than-typical use of communication applications coincided with more fragmented work. Generative AI use also occurred on more fragmented days, but the period following AI use was marked by narrower, longer, and more predictable application use. These findings identify the workday as a key level for understanding and intervening on digital fragmentation and suggest that AI may help structure fragmented work rather than merely intensify it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用来自八家知识工作型组织的 1,017 名员工、共 1.03 亿条秒级应用切换事件数据，分析数字碎片化 (digital fragmentation) 的来源。方差分解显示，同一员工不同工作日的日间波动解释了 44.6% 的碎片化差异，高于员工间稳定个体差异的 35.8%，远超组织间差异的 19.6%。碎片化在一周内上升、周末和假期后重置；沟通类应用使用偏高与更碎片化的工作相伴，而生成式 AI 使用虽发生在更碎片化的日子，但 AI 使用之后的时段表现为更窄、更长、更可预测的应用使用。
Motivation: 知识工作者每天在应用间切换数千次，每年近十分之一的工作时间耗于数字碎片化，但碎片化究竟反映员工个人特质、工作组织还是当下工作日状态，此前尚无定论。
Method: 对 1,017 名员工跨八家组织的 1.03 亿条秒级应用事件进行大规模观测分析，通过方差分解量化个体内日间波动、个体间差异和组织间差异的贡献，并检验工作日周期、沟通应用使用及生成式 AI 使用与碎片化的时序关联。
Result: 个体内日间波动解释了 44.6% 的碎片化变异，超过个体间差异的 35.8% 和组织间差异的 19.6%；碎片化随工作周推进上升并在周末/假期后重置；高于常态的沟通应用使用对应更碎片化的日子；生成式 AI 使用发生在碎片化更高的日子，但其后的应用使用更集中、更长且更可预测。
Conclusion: 作者认为工作日是理解和干预数字碎片化的关键层级，并提示生成式 AI 可能帮助组织碎片化工作，而非仅仅加剧碎片化。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Full-Stack FP4: Stable LLM Pretraining with Quantized Projections, Optimizers, and Attention
papers.abstract_en: Recent NVFP4 pretraining work has primarily optimized Transformer linear projections, leaving persistent optimizer states, optimizer computation, and low-precision attention forward--backward paths less explored. We present \textbf{Full-Stack FP4}, a modular NVFP4 framework with separate recipes for projections, AdamW states, Root/Muon computation, and attention. \textbf{LoRA-SVD} protects a compact projection subspace in BF16 while retaining full-shape NVFP4 computation, reducing the linear-only loss gap from \textbf{1.40\%} to \textbf{0.61\%}. An ordered square-root, tile-mean, and Hadamard pipeline enables stable NVFP4 AdamW momentum storage; shape-dependent coefficients and clipping stabilize direct NVFP4 Root iterations; and mixed-precision attention retains softmax-sensitive operations in BF16. On 3B pretraining with 64B tokens, BF16 and Full-Stack FP4 reach losses of \textbf{2.267} and \textbf{2.286}, a \textbf{0.838\%} gap. Their average zero-shot perplexities are 26.675 and 26.665, respectively, with Full-Stack FP4 averaging 0.10 percentage points lower in accuracy. Native four-block measurements on one RTX 5090 show 2.50--2.83$\times$ Root speedups over optimized BF16 and 37.9--42.5\% lower AdamW peak memory.
papers.comment: Fix experiment bugs and some statement, update current developed hardware efficiency result on 5090
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Full-Stack FP4，一个模块化的 NVFP4 预训练框架，将 4-bit 量化扩展到 Transformer 线性投影之外的优化器状态、优化器计算和注意力路径。框架包含 LoRA-SVD 保护投影子空间、有序平方根/tile-mean/Hadamard 流水线稳定 AdamW 动量存储、形状相关系数与裁剪稳定 Root 迭代，以及混合精度注意力。在 3B 模型、64B tokens 的预训练中，Full-Stack FP4 与 BF16 的损失差距为 0.838%，零样本困惑度几乎持平，并在 RTX 5090 上取得显著的 Root 加速和内存节省。
Motivation: 现有 NVFP4 预训练工作主要优化 Transformer 线性投影，而优化器状态（AdamW 动量）、优化器计算（Root/Muon）以及低精度注意力的前向-反向路径尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出模块化 NVFP4 框架，分别设计投影、AdamW 状态、Root/Muon 计算和注意力的量化方案：LoRA-SVD 在 BF16 中保护紧凑投影子空间；有序平方根、tile-mean 与 Hadamard 流水线实现稳定的 NVFP4 AdamW 动量存储；形状相关系数和裁剪稳定直接 NVFP4 Root 迭代；混合精度注意力在 BF16 中保留对 softmax 敏感的操作。
Result: 在 3B 预训练（64B tokens）上，BF16 与 Full-Stack FP4 的损失分别为 2.267 和 2.286，差距 0.838%；平均零样本困惑度分别为 26.675 和 26.665，Full-Stack FP4 的平均准确率低 0.10 个百分点。线性-only 损失差距从 1.40% 降至 0.61%。RTX 5090 上原生四块测量显示 Root 相对优化 BF16 加速 2.50–2.83 倍，AdamW 峰值内存降低 37.9–42.5%。
Conclusion: 作者表明，通过模块化配方将 NVFP4 扩展到完整训练栈，可以在保持预训练质量接近 BF16 的同时获得显著的优化器计算加速和内存收益。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Can LLMs Rank? A Tale of Triads and Triage
papers.abstract_en: From housing allocation for households experiencing homelessness to triage in emergency departments, LLMs are increasingly being considered as judges of consequential decisions that require ranking people for scarce resources. Ranking large groups simultaneously is cognitively demanding and error-prone. A natural solution, drawing on decades of social choice theory, elicits pairwise comparisons and aggregates them into a total order. However, a fundamental question remains when LLMs serve as the pairwise judge: how can a practitioner tell, before committing to a ranking, whether the LLM's judgments are sufficiently consistent to trust the result? We discuss two different ways of identifying consistency. A classical diagnostic, the coefficient of consistency $ζ$, originally developed to measure judge reliability by counting circular triads in tournament graphs, provides a cheap, model-free measure of intra-run consistency. Various standard measures of distance between rankings, for example Kendall's $τ$, can measure inter-run variability. We show, in both theory and practice, that these measures are independently valuable, and advocate for using both to assess reliability of rankings. We demonstrate the practical importance of our results across two high-stakes prioritization tasks: homelessness service allocation and emergency department triage. Three different leading LLMs have considerably different performance profiles across these two axes of consistency. We provide guidelines for how practitioners could think about measuring and assessing consistency before committing to a model for ranking or prioritization.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Ninth AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 在用于高利害资源分配排序（如无家可归者住房分配、急诊科分诊）时，如何在其作为两两比较评判者的情况下预先判断排序是否可信。作者提出用经典的一致性系数 ζ（通过锦标赛图中的循环三元组计数衡量评判者可靠性）来度量运行内一致性，并用 Kendall's τ 等排序距离度量运行间变异性，主张两者结合使用。理论与实验均表明这两个度量各有价值，并在两个高利害任务上对比了三个主流 LLM 的表现。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地被用于对稀缺资源的人群排序这类后果重大的决策，而利用社会选择理论将两两比较聚合成全序时，实践者面临一个基本问题：在提交排序前如何判断 LLM 的判断是否足够一致以值得信赖。
Method: 采用社会选择理论中的经典诊断工具：用一致性系数 ζ 衡量单次运行内部的一致性（通过统计锦标赛图中的循环三元组），用 Kendall's τ 等标准排序距离度量多次运行之间的变异性，并主张同时使用两类度量来评估排序可靠性；在无家可归服务分配和急诊分诊两个任务上对三个领先 LLM 进行实验。
Result: 摘要报告在两个一致性维度上，三个不同主流 LLM 表现出相当不同的性能画像；没有给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者为实践者提供了在选定用于排序或优先级划分的模型之前如何衡量和评估一致性的指导方针。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cognitive Episodes in LLM Reasoning Traces Enable Interpretable Human Item Difficulty Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting human item difficulty is central to educational assessment, where reliable estimates support fairness and effective test construction. Existing methods often depend on costly human calibration or item-level textual representations, providing limited evidence about the cognitive processes that make items difficult. We argue that difficulty should be viewed not only as a property of item text, but also as an observable consequence of the problem-solving burden an item induces. Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) offer scalable process evidence through reasoning traces, but such evidence must be structured to support interpretable modeling. To this end, we introduce Epi2Diff (Episode to Difficulty), a framework that maps LRM reasoning traces into cognitively grounded episode sequences. These episodes group trace segments into functional problem-solving states, enabling difficulty to be modeled through reasoning scale, effort allocation, and state transitions. Epi2Diff extracts compact episode-dynamic features and combines them with semantic item representations for human difficulty prediction. Experiments on four real-world human difficulty datasets show that Epi2Diff consistently outperforms strong baselines, including fine-tuned small language models, LLM in-context learning, and supervised LLM adaptation. On SAT-derived classification benchmarks, Epi2Diff achieves an 8.1% average relative gain over supervised LLM fine-tuning baselines. Further analyses show that harder items induce more effortful, iterative, and implementation-centered episode dynamics, rather than merely longer responses. These results demonstrate that cognitive episodes in LRM reasoning traces provide a predictive and interpretable process representation for human item difficulty, offering a new lens for educational measurement with reasoning models.

Motivation: 预测人类条目难度对教育测评至关重要，但现有方法常依赖昂贵的人工校准或仅使用条目文本表征，缺乏对造成难度的认知过程的证据。作者主张难度不应仅视为条目的文本属性，也应是条目所引发的解题负担的可观察结果。

Conclusion: LRM 推理轨迹中的认知情节为人类条目难度提供了具有预测性和可解释性的过程表征，为教育测评中利用推理模型提供了新的视角。

papers.title: RoboAtlas: Contextual Active SLAM
papers.abstract_en: We present RoboAtlas, a contextual Active SLAM framework that adaptively balances geometric exploration and semantic reasoning using a scalable 3D semantic mapping system, OpenRoboVox. RoboAtlas integrates frontier exploration, global semantic-map reasoning, and egocentric VLM-based reasoning through a contextual multi-armed bandit that transitions from exploration to semantically guided navigation as scene understanding improves. We evaluate the system in simulation and on a Unitree Go2 robot in large-scale real-world environments exceeding 1800 m2 with approx. 30k mapped semantic instances, achieving a 100% task success rate. On the GOAT-Bench "Val Unseen" benchmark, RoboAtlas achieves state-of-the-art performance with highest reported success rate (SR) of 90.6%, using GPT-4o, improving over the strongest prior baseline by 17.8 percentage points in SR. Using the much smaller Qwen2.5-VL-7B model, it still achieves 88.8% SR, outperforming all baselines using GPT-4o in SR, and revealing the importance of the information gained by our semantic mapping framework over simply replacing the underlying foundation model. The results demonstrate that grounding foundation models with large-scale 3D semantic maps enables robust and efficient contextual Active SLAM.
papers.comment: Alexander Schperberg and Shivam K. Panda made equal contribution
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RoboAtlas，一个上下文感知的 Active SLAM 框架，通过在可扩展的 3D 语义建图系统 OpenRoboVox 之上平衡几何探索与语义推理，将前沿探索、全局语义图推理和基于 VLM 的自我中心推理整合进一个上下文多臂老虎机 (contextual multi-armed bandit) 中，随着场景理解提升而从探索切换到语义引导导航。在超过 1800 m²、约 3 万个语义实例的真实环境中达到 100% 任务成功率；在 GOAT-Bench 的 Val Unseen 基准上，使用 GPT-4o 取得 90.6% 的成功率 (SR)，比此前最强基线高 17.8 个百分点，而使用更小的 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 仍取得 88.8% 的 SR，优于所有使用 GPT-4o 的基线。
Motivation: 现有 Active SLAM 往往只关注几何探索，难以将语义理解纳入导航决策，导致在大规模真实场景中无法高效地执行语义目标相关任务；如何自适应地权衡几何探索与语义推理是待解决的问题。
Method: 提出 RoboAtlas 框架，包含可扩展 3D 语义建图系统 OpenRoboVox、前沿探索 (frontier exploration)、全局语义图推理以及自我中心 VLM 推理，并用上下文多臂老虎机动态决定从探索到语义引导导航的切换时机。
Result: 在仿真和 Unitree Go2 机器人的超过 1800 m² 真实环境中验证，取得 100% 任务成功率；在 GOAT-Bench Val Unseen 上达到 90.6% SR 的 SOTA 结果，比最强先前基线高 17.8 个百分点；使用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 时仍达 88.8% SR，超过所有基线，说明语义建图带来的信息增益比更换底层基础模型更关键。
Conclusion: 作者认为将基础模型与大规模 3D 语义图相结合，可以实现稳健且高效的上下文感知 Active SLAM，并且语义建图框架本身的信息增益比基础模型规模更重要。

papers.title: OmniV2X: A Generative Foundation Planner for Efficient End-to-End Cooperative Driving
papers.abstract_en: We present OmniV2X, a generative foundation model for vehicle-to-everything (V2X) cooperative driving. The model directly interprets independent context sequences comprising multi-modal and multi-agent observations. The new design mitigates the computational cost of dense 3D perception, the vulnerability to data scarcity in cooperative scenarios, and the poor compliance with standardized messaging in existing methods that fuse multi-modal inputs into a shared representation. For training, we present an end-to-end supervised pipeline using a downstream trajectory generation loss, in which a high-capacity generative sequence planner implicitly learns to steer the model and leverage multi-modal inputs via cross-attention injection. As a foundation model, we demonstrate that OmniV2X pre-trained on large-scale single-agent planning datasets can efficiently adapt to cooperative environments by integrating the conditioning context with lightweight, standard-compliant V2X tokens. Evaluated on the DAIR-V2X-Seq dataset, OmniV2X outperforms existing end-to-end cooperative driving baselines, achieving state-of-the-art performance with less than 10% of the fine-tune V2X dataset and less than 1% of the communication bandwidth. We conduct comprehensive evaluations to demonstrate its computational efficiency and robustness under real-world constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniV2X，一个用于车联网 (V2X) 协同驾驶的生成式基础模型，直接处理多模态、多智能体的独立上下文序列，并通过下游轨迹生成损失进行端到端监督训练。在 DAIR-V2X-Seq 数据集上，该方法以少于 10% 的微调数据量和低于 1% 的通信带宽达到现有端到端协同驾驶基线之上的 SOTA，并展示了计算效率与鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有方法通常将多模态输入融合为共享表示，存在密集 3D 感知的计算开销、协同场景下数据稀缺带来的脆弱性，以及对标准化消息的合规性较差等问题。
Method: 提出一个高容量生成式序列规划器，通过跨注意力注入来利用多模态输入，并使用端到端监督的下游轨迹生成损失进行训练；作为基础模型，先在大规模单智能体规划数据集上预训练，再通过轻量、符合标准的 V2X token 整合条件上下文，以高效适配协同环境。
Result: 在 DAIR-V2X-Seq 上，OmniV2X 优于现有端到端协同驾驶基线，达到 SOTA，且仅需不到 10% 的微调 V2X 数据集和不到 1% 的通信带宽；综合评估还表明其在真实约束下具有计算效率和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者强调生成式基础模型结合轻量、标准兼容的 V2X token，可以高效地从单智能体规划迁移到协同驾驶，并大幅降低数据与通信需求。

papers.title: From Errors to Rules: Iterative Prompt Optimization for Text Classification
papers.abstract_en: Prompt optimization for text classification spans diverse approaches, from demonstration selection to exploration-based search to error-driven diagnosis, each with known but incompletely characterized strengths and limitations. We conduct a comprehensive empirical study across diverse classification benchmarks (2 to 150 classes) comparing these paradigms through both quantitative evaluation and qualitative analysis of optimization traces, revealing that each paradigm excels on structurally different task types and that no single method dominates. Guided by these insights, we propose Error-Guided Optimization (ERGO), an error-driven method that iterates over the full training set in non-overlapping batches, diagnoses classification failures, and generates targeted decision rules through a diagnose-prescribe-rewrite feedback loop. ERGO achieves the best accuracy on tasks where errors concentrate in specific confused label pairs (which we term boundary-learnable tasks): TREC: 90.0%, CLINC150: 94.4%, converges in 3-5 iterations, and produces interpretable decision rules. While ERGO does not achieve the highest overall average, it fills a complementary role: demonstration-based ICL wins on coverage-dependent tasks, exploration-based search wins on many-class intent, and ERGO wins where decision boundaries are learnable from error patterns. We provide a complementarity framework linking task characteristics to optimal paradigm selection, offering practical guidance for practitioners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了文本分类提示优化的三类范式——演示选择、基于探索的搜索、错误驱动诊断，在 2 到 150 类的多个基准上结合定量评估与优化轨迹定性分析，发现各范式在不同结构类型的任务上各有优势，不存在单一最优方法。基于此提出错误驱动方法 ERGO，通过 diagnose-prescribe-rewrite 反馈循环在非重叠批次中迭代训练集并生成决策规则。ERGO 在边界可学习任务上取得最佳准确率（TREC 90.0%、CLINC150 94.4%），3-5 次迭代收敛，且规则可解释。
Motivation: 现有提示优化方法各有已知但未被充分表征的优缺点，缺乏跨范式的系统比较和对任务特征与最优范式关系的理解，导致实践者在模型选择时缺乏依据。
Method: 提出 ERGO（Error-Guided Optimization），一种错误驱动方法：在非重叠批次中遍历完整训练集，诊断分类失败，并通过 diagnose-prescribe-rewrite 的反馈循环生成针对性的决策规则。
Result: 在错误集中于特定混淆类别对的任务（作者称为 boundary-learnable tasks）上，ERGO 取得最高准确率：TREC 90.0%、CLINC150 94.4%，3-5 次迭代即可收敛并产出可解释规则；但其整体平均准确率并非最高——演示式 ICL 在覆盖依赖任务上占优，基于探索的搜索在多类意图任务上占优。
Conclusion: 作者提出一个互补性框架，将任务特征与最优提示优化范式的选择联系起来，为实践者提供选型指导；ERGO 扮演的是互补角色而非通用最优方案。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Human agency in initial human-AI proof formalization workflows
papers.abstract_en: For centuries, human mathematicians have written proofs to substantiate their mathematical arguments; yet, the ability to automatically verify the validity of proofs has long been a challenge. Advances in AI systems' ability to generate code and engage in increasingly high-level mathematical reasoning promise to transform people's ability to formalize and thereby verify proofs. While many works focus on benchmarking the current frontier, we instead study how people use these tools and apply agency in doing so. We conduct a mixed-methods analysis into the initial impact of AI on people's formalization workflows: what people claim they want, what they see as the barriers to those visions, and how they actually use and adapt AI in practice. A qualitative survey reveals that people's preferences are diverse, but with a general desire for AI assistance in formalization that preserves high-level human control and agency over the proof discovery process. To assess how people actually engage with AI for formalization, we conduct a controlled user study in which participants formalize informal math problems and their proofs, with and without AI, across a range of mathematical problems at varying levels of difficulty and domains. Despite limitations of the tools at the time for autoformalization, participants tended to attain higher formalization accuracy when allowed access to AI tools than when formalizing on their own, with most participants flexibly choosing to use multiple different AI tools. Taken together, our work sheds light on the early stages of AI integration into formalization workflows, involving an intimate interplay of human agency and AI engagement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过混合方法研究人类在初始 AI 辅助数学证明形式化 (proof formalization) 工作流中的能动性 (agency)。定性调查显示用户希望 AI 辅助但保持高层人类控制；受控用户研究表明使用 AI 工具时形式化准确率更高，且多数参与者灵活使用多种 AI 工具。
Motivation: 许多工作关注 AI 形式化能力的前沿基准，但缺乏对人们实际如何使用这些工具、其偏好与障碍以及能动性如何发挥的系统理解。
Method: 采用混合方法：先进行定性问卷调查了解用户偏好与感知障碍；再开展受控用户研究，让参与者在有无 AI 辅助下形式化不同难度和领域的非正式数学问题与证明，并记录实际工具使用行为。
Result: 在有 AI 工具辅助时，参与者倾向于获得更高的形式化准确率；大多数参与者灵活选择并使用多种不同 AI 工具，尽管当时自动形式化工具仍有限制。
Conclusion: 研究表明 AI 融入形式化工作流的早期阶段表现为人类能动性与 AI 参与的密切互动，用户普遍希望在保持高层控制的同时获得 AI 帮助。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文通过混合方法研究人类在初始 AI 辅助数学证明形式化 (proof formalization) 工作流中的能动性 (agency)。定性调查显示用户希望 AI 辅助但保持高层人类控制；受控用户研究表明使用 AI 工具时形式化准确率更高，且多数参与者灵活使用多种 AI 工具。

summary_sections.method: 采用混合方法：先进行定性问卷调查了解用户偏好与感知障碍；再开展受控用户研究，让参与者在有无 AI 辅助下形式化不同难度和领域的非正式数学问题与证明，并记录实际工具使用行为。

papers.title: Simple Token-Efficient Vision-Language Model for Case-level Pathology Synoptic Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating clinically useful pathology reports for pathology cases from whole-slide images (WSIs) is challenging due to gigapixel resolution, long visual-token sequences, and the complexity of case-level reasoning, where a single case may contain multiple WSIs with heterogeneous tissues and ambiguous findings. We present a simple token-efficient vision--language model for case-level synoptic report generation that remains practical under constrained GPU memory. Our architecture follows a minimal three-component design: a frozen pathology patch encoder, a lightweight two-layer MLP vision-language aligner, and a large language model decoder, with an explicit WSI marker token to separate slides within a case. Training proceeds in two supervised stages: (1) aligner-only WSI captioning using heterogeneous WSI-text pairs, and (2) case-level supervised fine-tuning on case-report pairs for structured report generation. To reduce sequence length, we represent each slide using $512 \times 512$ patches at $5\times$ magnification, which reduces the average sequence length by up to $64\times$ times compared to the commonly used $20\times$ patches. Combined with efficient training techniques, we enable practical training with only half a NVIDIA H100 GPU. Across both training stages, our approach achieves high ROUGE-L/METEOR/BLEU-4 scores while being substantially more efficient in memory and runtime. In AI-based evaluations, our model is consistently preferred over strong baselines. Extensive ablations characterize performance-efficiency trade-offs and identify simple choices that improve robustness in multi-WSI settings. Overall, this work provides a strong, reproducible baseline for efficient pathology report generation, lowering the barrier to multi-WSI VLM research under limited compute. Code is available at https://github.com/AtlasAnalyticsLab/PathoSynVLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个token高效的视觉-语言模型，用于从全切片图像（WSI）生成病例级病理概要报告。架构采用最小三组件设计：冻结的病理patch编码器、轻量两层MLP视觉-语言对齐器和大语言模型解码器，并用显式WSI marker token区分病例内的不同切片。训练分为两阶段监督微调，通过使用512×512 patch（5×放大率）将平均序列长度相对常用20× patch最多缩短64倍，从而仅需半块NVIDIA H100 GPU即可训练，并在保持高ROUGE-L/METEOR/BLEU-4得分的同时显著降低内存和运行时间开销。
Motivation: 从WSI生成临床可用的病理报告面临十亿像素分辨率、长视觉token序列以及病例级推理复杂（单病例含多个WSI、组织异质且发现模糊）等挑战，同时受限GPU内存下需要实用的解决方案。
Method: 模型由冻结的病理patch编码器、两层MLP视觉-语言对齐器和LLM解码器构成，以显式WSI marker token分隔切片。训练分为两阶段监督：先使用异质WSI-文本对进行对齐器only的WSI字幕生成，再在病例-报告对上进行病例级监督微调以生成结构化报告。为缩短序列，采用512×512 patch且放大率为5×，并配合高效训练技术。
Result: 相对常用20× patches，平均序列长度最多缩短64倍；两个训练阶段均取得高ROUGE-L/METEOR/BLEU-4分数，内存和运行时间显著更高效；在AI评估中模型持续优于强基线；广泛的消融研究刻画了性能-效率权衡，并确定了提升多WSI场景鲁棒性的简单选择。
Conclusion: 这项工作为高效病理报告生成提供了强且可复现的基线，降低了有限算力下开展多WSI视觉-语言模型（VLM）研究的门槛。

papers.title: Convex Basins in Single-Index Model Loss Landscapes: Applications to Robust Recovery under Strong Adversarial Corruption
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of robustly learning Gaussian Single Index Models (SIMs) in the presence of heavy-tailed noise and a constant fraction of adversarially corrupted covariates and responses. Prior work on robust recovery has considered settings such as linear regression (Pensia et al., JASA 2024), strictly monotonic link functions (Awasthi et al., NeurIPS 2022), and phase retrieval (Buna and Rebeschini, AISTATS 2025). However, these techniques do not extend to generic asymmetric non-monotonic link functions such as \textsc{GeLU} and \textsc{Swish}, which arise naturally as scalar primitives in modern gated neural architectures. We close this gap by giving the first robust recovery algorithm with near-linear sample and time complexity for generic non-monotonic link functions, thereby establishing the first robust recovery guarantees for a broad family of nonlinear SIMs for which \textit{no guarantees were previously known}. Our central contribution is a new structural understanding of the Gaussian squared-loss landscape under adversarial contamination. Crucially, we prove that for a broad class of nonlinear non-monotonic SIMs, a dimension-independent, constant-radius convex basin exists around the ground truth and is efficiently reachable via robust spectral initialization even under adversarial contamination. Prior works fail to establish both guarantees simultaneously, thereby either breaking down under adversarial contamination or failing to handle generic non-monotonic link functions. Together, these structural insights yield a principled warm start for robust gradient descent that provably converges to a final estimation error of $O(σ\sqrtε)$ in $\tilde{O}(nd)$ time with $\tilde{O}(d)$ samples, where $ε$ is the contamination fraction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高斯单指标模型（Single Index Model, SIM）在重尾噪声和常数比例对抗性污染的协变量与响应下的鲁棒学习问题，针对 GeLU、Swish 等非对称非单调链接函数给出首个近线性样本与时间复杂度的鲁棒恢复算法。核心贡献是证明在对抗污染下，真实参数周围存在维度无关、常数半径的凸盆地（convex basin），并可通过鲁棒谱初始化高效到达。该结构洞察为鲁棒梯度下降提供原则性的热启动，最终以 O(σ√ε) 的估计误差在 Õ(nd) 时间内用 Õ(d) 个样本收敛。
Motivation: 此前鲁棒恢复工作分别覆盖线性回归、严格单调链接函数和相位恢复，但无法推广到现代门控神经网络中自然出现的非对称非单调链接函数（如 GeLU、Swish），这类非线性 SIM 此前没有任何鲁棒恢复保证。
Method: 作者建立高斯平方损失在对抗污染下的新结构理解，证明一类宽泛的非线性非单调 SIM 在真实参数附近存在常数半径凸盆地；在此基础上采用鲁棒谱初始化到达该盆地，再执行鲁棒梯度下降，从而同时保证可达性与收敛性。
Result: 算法以 Õ(nd) 时间和 Õ(d) 样本达到最终估计误差 O(σ√ε)，其中 ε 为污染比例；这是对广义非单调链接函数族的第一类鲁棒恢复保证，且此前工作无法同时建立凸盆地存在性与对抗污染下的可达性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作同时解决了对抗污染下凸盆地的存在性与高效可达性两个问题，为非线性非单调 SIM 的鲁棒恢复提供了统一框架；论文已被 ICML 2026 接收。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Persona Prompting in Multimodal Urban Perception: Descriptive Convergence and Interpretive Variation
papers.abstract_en: This study examines how persona prompting shapes language generated by two multimodal large language models in urban perception, a setting for examining subjective interpretations of shared visual evidence. We organize outputs into three functional levels: descriptive grounding (captions), intermediate semantic layer (perception tags), and interpretive framing (justifications). Using approximately 60,000 persona-conditioned annotations per model from Qwen3-VL-8B and Gemma-4-E4B-it, we find that captions converge strongly across persona profiles and show only small attribute-associated differences. Justifications vary substantially more: economic status produces the largest difference in both models, with political orientation and personality also prominent. Paired image-level comparisons confirm larger justification than caption differences for these three attributes. For perception tags, personas sharing the same attribute level produce more similar tag sets than personas with different attribute levels, with the largest separation observed for economic status. Exploratory topic analysis further reveals persona-specific evaluative emphasis. Across models, profile-pair similarity patterns are strongly correlated for all three output types, although agreement is lowest for justifications. Overall, persona prompting affects interpretive framing more strongly than descriptive grounding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究人物角色提示 (persona prompting) 如何影响两个多模态大语言模型 (Qwen3-VL-8B 和 Gemma-4-E4B-it) 在城市感知任务中生成的语言，将输出分为描述性锚定（标题）、中间语义层（感知标签）和解释性框架（理由）三个功能层级。基于每模型约 60,000 条带角色条件的标注，作者发现标题在不同角色画像间高度趋同，而理由差异显著更大，且经济地位带来的差异最大。整体结论是角色提示对解释性框架的影响强于对描述性锚定的影响。
Motivation: 城市感知涉及对共享视觉证据的主观解释，作者希望考察角色提示如何塑造多模态大语言模型在该情境下生成的语言，从而理解主观性在视觉解释中的体现。
Method: 将模型输出组织为描述性锚定（captions）、中间语义层（perception tags）和解释性框架（justifications）三个功能层面；使用 Qwen3-VL-8B 和 Gemma-4-E4B-it 生成每模型约 60,000 条带人物角色条件的标注，并进行配对图像级比较、感知标签集相似性分析以及探索性主题分析 (topic analysis)。
Result: 摘要报告标题在不同角色画像间强烈趋同，仅存在较小的属性相关差异；理由的差异则显著更大，经济地位在两种模型中均产生最大差异，政治取向和人格特质也较突出。配对图像级比较确认这三个属性的理由差异大于标题差异；共享同一属性水平的角色产生的感知标签集更相似，经济地位分离度最大；两模型在三种输出类型上的画像对相似性模式高度相关，但理由的一致性最低。
Conclusion: 作者总结角色提示对解释性框架的影响强于对描述性锚定的影响，即主观解释层面对角色条件更敏感，而视觉描述层面相对稳定。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Test-Time Collective Action: Proxy-Based Perturbations for Correcting Algorithmic Harms
papers.abstract_en: When machine learning systems under-perform for particular subgroups, affected users typically have no way to correct these disparities without relying on platform-level fixes. Existing approaches to algorithmic fairness rely on provider-centric approaches to correct these failures, leaving users with no external lever when faced with harm. Recent work in Algorithmic Collective Action shows that coordinated users can steer an algorithmic system toward a collective goal, but the existing mechanisms require the provider to retrain on the collective's modified data which users may not have control over. We propose Test-Time Collective Action (TTCA), a framework through which a group of users who share query access to the platform, can correct disparities affecting under-served subgroup without participating in the platform's training loop. We implement this through a proxy-based mechanism where the collective pools query access to a black-box API to extract a proxy of the platform, then optimizes a per-class universal perturbation against the proxy. Each member applies this perturbation to their own inputs at submission time, requiring no cooperation from the platform. We empirically evaluate the mechanism on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and FairFace, showing that modestly-sized collectives close most of the subgroup accuracy gap, transfer across architectures (a small proxy can attack a larger platform), and improve worst-group accuracy, equal-opportunity gap, and disparate impact. A query-budget analysis comparing a per-user black-box attack baseline shows that pooling is cheaper than each subgroup member attacking alone. Test-time collective action thus offers corrective intervention to users when platform-side remediation is unavailable or delayed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出测试时集体行动（Test-Time Collective Action, TTCA）框架，让共享平台查询访问的一组用户可以纠正机器学习系统对特定亚组的不公平表现，而无需参与平台的训练循环。实现方式是通过代理机制：集体把对黑盒 API 的查询访问整合起来提取平台代理，然后针对代理优化逐类通用扰动，每个成员在提交输入时应用该扰动。在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 FairFace 上的实验显示，规模适中的集体能缩小大部分亚组准确率差距，扰动可跨架构迁移，并改善最差组准确率、机会均等差距和不利影响。
Motivation: 当机器学习系统对特定亚组表现不佳时，受影响用户通常没有途径纠正这些差异，现有公平性方法依赖平台方修复；已有的集体行动机制要求平台在集体修改后的数据上重新训练，而用户往往无法控制这一过程。
Method: TTCA 将多个用户对黑盒 API 的查询访问集中起来提取平台的代理模型，再针对该代理优化逐类通用扰动（per-class universal perturbation）；成员在提交时对各自输入施加该扰动，整个过程不要求平台方合作，也不介入训练流程。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 FairFace 上，适度规模的集体即可消除大部分亚组准确率差距，扰动能跨架构迁移（小代理可攻击更大平台），并提升最差组准确率、机会均等差距和不利影响指标；查询预算分析显示，多用户联合查询比每个成员单独进行黑盒攻击更便宜。
Conclusion: 测试时集体行动为平台侧修复不可用或延迟时提供了一种用户侧纠正干预手段，其有效性在图像基准上得到验证。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出测试时集体行动（Test-Time Collective Action, TTCA）框架，让共享平台查询访问的一组用户可以纠正机器学习系统对特定亚组的不公平表现，而无需参与平台的训练循环。实现方式是通过代理机制：集体把对黑盒 API 的查询访问整合起来提取平台代理，然后针对代理优化逐类通用扰动，每个成员在提交输入时应用该扰动。在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 FairFace 上的实验显示，规模适中的集体能缩小大部分亚组准确率差距，扰动可跨架构迁移，并改善最差组准确率、机会均等差距和不利影响。
summary_sections.motivation: 当机器学习系统对特定亚组表现不佳时，受影响用户通常没有途径纠正这些差异，现有公平性方法依赖平台方修复；已有的集体行动机制要求平台在集体修改后的数据上重新训练，而用户往往无法控制这一过程。
summary_sections.method: TTCA 将多个用户对黑盒 API 的查询访问集中起来提取平台的代理模型，再针对该代理优化逐类通用扰动（per-class universal perturbation）；成员在提交时对各自输入施加该扰动，整个过程不要求平台方合作，也不介入训练流程。
summary_sections.result: 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 FairFace 上，适度规模的集体即可消除大部分亚组准确率差距，扰动能跨架构迁移（小代理可攻击更大平台），并提升最差组准确率、机会均等差距和不利影响指标；查询预算分析显示，多用户联合查询比每个成员单独进行黑盒攻击更便宜。
summary_sections.conclusion: 测试时集体行动为平台侧修复不可用或延迟时提供了一种用户侧纠正干预手段，其有效性在图像基准上得到验证。

papers.title: Coupled Training with Privileged Information and Unlabeled Data
papers.abstract_en: In many prediction problems, we have extra information during training (for example, measurements that are expensive or slow to collect) that will not be available when the model is deployed. A common strategy is to first train a model that uses all training information, then use its predictions on unlabeled examples to train a second model that only uses the inputs available at test time. However, when the extra training-only information is weak or noisy, this Two-Stage approach can mislead the deployment model and even hurt accuracy. We propose a joint training method that learns the two models together, so the deployment model can benefit from the extra information only when it actually helps, instead of inheriting its mistakes. We provide guarantees that describe when joint training improves prediction accuracy and analyze a simple alternating training algorithm for large, high-dimensional models. Experiments on synthetic data and real-world prediction tasks show that our approach avoids these failures and robustly outperforms standard Two-Stage baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对训练期存在特权信息 (privileged information)、测试期不可用的预测问题，提出联合训练 (joint training) 方法，同时学习使用全部信息的教师模型和仅使用测试输入的部署模型。作者给出了联合训练何时提升预测精度的理论保证，并分析了一种适用于大规模高维模型的简单交替训练算法。实验表明该方法能避免两段式 (Two-Stage) 基线在特权信息弱或含噪时误导部署模型的失败模式，并在合成数据和真实预测任务上稳健优于标准 Two-Stage 基线。
Motivation: 许多预测任务在训练时可以获取部署后不可用的额外信息（如昂贵或缓慢的测量）。常见的两段式策略先用全部信息训练一个模型，再用其对无标注样本的预测来训练部署模型；但当特权信息较弱或含噪时，这种方法可能误导部署模型，甚至降低准确率。
Method: 提出联合训练两个模型的方法，使部署模型只在特权信息真正有帮助时受益，而不是盲目继承教师的错误。文章提供了刻画联合训练改善预测精度的保证条件，并分析了一种用于大规模高维模型的简单交替训练算法。
Result: 摘要报告在合成数据和真实预测任务上的实验表明，该方法避免了两段式基线的失败模式，并稳健地优于标准的 Two-Stage 基线。
Conclusion: 本文的取态是：与两段式迁移教师预测不同，联合训练能够让部署模型从训练期特权信息中选择性获益；作者同时给出保证性分析及交替训练算法。摘要未明确指出方法的适用范围或局限。

papers.title: ProbSPARQL: Querying Knowledge Graphs with Multi-dimensional, Uncertain Numeric Data
papers.abstract_en: The SFB 1574 Circular Factory is building a shared knowledge graph infrastructure for integrating data about returned products. A central challenge is that circular-factory data include numeric measurements that (i) originate from sensors or are derived from sensor-based measurements, (ii) are frequently multi-dimensional, and (iii) are inherently uncertain, while downstream triage, validation, reliability-modeling, and reassembly-planning modules require queryable uncertainty representations. Current RDF and SPARQL technologies lack native support for harmonized querying and analysis of such uncertain numeric measurement data. To address this gap, we present ProbSPARQL, an upward-compatible SPARQL extension developed as an early-stage query-layer pilot for this infrastructure. ProbSPARQL models uncertain numeric values as random variables whose distributions are encoded by probabilistic RDF literal datatypes, and supports distribution-aware expressions, probabilistic filters, and divergence-based joins. We implement ProbSPARQL on Apache Jena ARQ and expose it through a Fuseki-compatible execution layer. We assess real-data applicability using project-derived measurement fragments covering GMM-encoded uncertainty and histogram-based empirical roughness distributions, and evaluate scalability separately on controlled ontology-conformant benchmarks with up to 5,000 angle-grinder instances and 1.5M triples. The results show feasible in-engine execution, filter-pushdown speedups over application-layer post-processing, and latency-accuracy trade-offs among divergence-join decision strategies.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Accepted at ISWC 2026, camera-ready version. Supplementary material and reproducibility artifacts are available online
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProbSPARQL，一个向上兼容的 SPARQL 扩展，用于在知识图谱中查询多维且不确定的数值测量数据。它将不确定数值建模为随机变量，其分布由概率 RDF 字面量数据类型编码，并支持分布感知表达式、概率过滤和基于散度的连接。系统基于 Apache Jena ARQ 实现，并通过 Fuseki 兼容执行层暴露。实验在项目真实数据片段和受控基准上验证了可行性、过滤器下推加速以及延迟-精度权衡。
Motivation: 循环工厂的知识图谱基础设施需要整合来自传感器或由传感器测量推导的返回产品数值数据，这类数据常是多维且内在不确定的，下游分诊、验证、可靠性建模和重新装配规划模块需要可查询的不确定性表示。现有 RDF 和 SPARQL 缺乏对这类不确定数值数据的原生支持。
Method: 提出 ProbSPARQL，把不确定数值建模为随机变量，其分布用概率 RDF 字面量数据类型编码；扩展包括分布感知表达式、概率过滤器和基于散度的连接。实现基于 Apache Jena ARQ，并通过 Fuseki 兼容执行层提供查询服务。
Result: 在项目衍生的测量片段（覆盖 GMM 编码不确定性和基于直方图的经验粗糙度分布）以及受控符合本体的基准（最多 5,000 个角磨机实例、150 万三元组）上，结果显示引擎内执行可行，过滤器下推相比应用层后处理有加速，发散连接决策策略存在延迟-精度权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要将其定位为面向循环工厂基础设施的早期阶段查询层试点，展示了向上兼容的 SPARQL 扩展能够提供对不确定数值测量数据的统一查询与分析能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Dynamic Regret for Online Regression in RKHS via Discounted VAW and Subspace Approximation
papers.abstract_en: We study online regression with the square loss in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space under a dynamic regret criterion. The learner is compared with a time-varying comparator sequence, and the bounds depend on its path length in the RKHS norm. The proposed method transfers the finite-dimensional discounted Vovk--Azoury--Warmuth approach of Jacobsen \& Cutkosky (2024) to the RKHS setting by means of finite-dimensional subspace approximations. For a fixed subspace, we run a VAW-based ensemble of discounted VAW forecasters over a geometric grid of discount factors. The additional approximation error is controlled by the uniform projection error of kernel sections. We then introduce a general orthogonal truncation method: starting from a feature expansion of the kernel, we construct the associated RKHS by introducing an inner product that makes the feature functions orthonormal, and then use the spans of the first basis functions as finite-dimensional approximation spaces. The resulting subspace reduction is applied to several approximation schemes. Explicit feature expansions yield fast-regime bounds for Gaussian and analytic dot-product kernels. Mercer truncations provide a spectral approximation method and lead to dynamic regret bounds in fast and slow regimes, depending on the eigenvalue decay. Finally, we study subspaces spanned by kernel sections and apply this construction to Matérn kernels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究再生核希尔伯特空间 (RKHS) 中平方损失在线回归的动态遗憾 (dynamic regret)，将 Jacobsen 与 Cutkosky (2024) 的有限维折现 Vovk--Azoury--Warmuth (VAW) 方法通过有限维子空间近似扩展到 RKHS 设定。作者采用几何网格上的折现因子集成 VAW 预报器，并引入基于特征展开的正交截断方法来构造近似子空间，最终给出针对高斯核、解析点积核、Mercer 截断以及 Matérn 核的动态遗憾界。
Motivation: 现有折现 VAW 方法主要在有限维设定下分析，而 RKHS 中的在线回归在时变比较器序列下缺乏系统的动态遗憾理论；同时需要控制有限维子空间近似带来的逼近误差。
Method: 提出将有限维折现 VAW 方法迁移到 RKHS 的框架：对固定子空间运行基于折现 VAW 的集成预报器，用几何网格覆盖折现因子；通过核的特征展开构造使特征函数正交化的内积，以基函数张成的子空间作为有限维近似空间，并控制核截面的均匀投影误差；该子空间缩减方案适用于显式特征展开、Mercer 截断和核截面张成子空间等多种近似方式。
Result: 摘要报告：对显式特征展开，得到高斯核与解析点积核的快速率 (fast-regime) 动态遗憾界；对 Mercer 截断，依据特征值衰减得到快速或慢速 (slow-regime) 界的谱近似方法；并针对 Matérn 核研究了由核截面张成的子空间。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调其核心贡献是给出一种通用的正交截断方法，将折现 VAW 集成与有限维子空间近似结合，从而在多种核设定下获得动态遗憾界。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: FusionRelight: Relighting Portraits in Real Time via Hybrid Domain Knowledge Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Portrait relighting is a low-level vision problem in which physically plausible illumination transfer, identity preservation, and compact real-time inference must be considered together. Iterative diffusion-style methods can synthesize fine detail, but stochastic inference and cost complicate deterministic live video creation; physically grounded relighting preserves identity, but controlled synthetic or light-stage supervision transfers poorly to unconstrained cameras. We present Hybrid Domain Knowledge Fusion (HDKF), a relighting-specific training framework that learns complementary physics, reflectance, and realism priors from synthetic, One-Light-at-A-Time (OLAT), and in-the-wild data, then distills their source-routed supervision into a compact student with clean teacher labels and degraded student inputs. The framework is trained with pixel-aligned RGB, albedo, and normal supervision, providing a simulation substrate for physically grounded low-level relighting. On a held-out OLAT benchmark, HDKF obtains the best MSE, PSNR, and SSIM among evaluated methods while remaining competitive in LPIPS. The distilled model runs in real time at 512x512, reaching 11.89 ms on an RTX 2060 and 1.82 ms on an RTX 4090.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向实时肖像重光照的混合域知识融合框架 HDKF，从合成、OLAT 和真实世界数据中学习物理、反射率和真实感先验，并将源路由监督蒸馏到紧凑学生网络。在留出 OLAT 基准上取得最佳 MSE、PSNR 和 SSIM，LPIPS 与已有方法相当，蒸馏模型可在 RTX 2060 上以 11.89 ms、RTX 4090 上以 1.82 ms 实时处理 512x512 图像。
Motivation: 现有肖像重光照方法难以同时兼顾物理合理性、身份保持和实时推理：迭代扩散类方法细节好但随机推理成本高，物理驱动方法保真但依赖合成或 light-stage 监督，难以泛化到非受控相机。
Method: 提出混合域知识融合（HDKF）训练框架，从合成、One-Light-at-a-Time（OLAT）和真实世界数据中学习互补的物理、反射率和真实感先验，再将源路由监督蒸馏到紧凑学生网络；训练使用像素对齐的 RGB、albedo 和 normal 监督。
Result: 在留出 OLAT 基准上，HDKF 在 MSE、PSNR 和 SSIM 上达到最优，LPIPS 与评估方法相当；蒸馏后模型在 512x512 分辨率下实时运行，RTX 2060 上为 11.89 ms，RTX 4090 上为 1.82 ms。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过学习并蒸馏多源域知识，能在保持物理可解释性的同时实现实时高保真相位重光照。

papers.title: Autonomous Reliability Qualification of Ga$_2$O$_3$-based diode sensors via Safe Active Learning
papers.abstract_en: Ultra-wide bandgap (UWBG) Ga$_2$O$_3$ is a promising semiconductor for high-power and high-temperature electronics. Reliable qualification of these devices under extreme operating conditions is essential, yet conventional reliability testing is inherently time-consuming. Autonomous experimentation offers a new paradigm by enabling measurement planning and model refinement to evolve in parallel in real time. We present a Safe Active Learning (SAL) framework for autonomous reliability characterization of Ga$_2$O$_3$-based diode sensors under coupled thermal and hydrogen stress. We first evaluate SAL in simulation, where it safely expands the explored region while learning the evolving rectification surface. Second, we demonstrate SAL experimentally on an automated high-temperature probe-station platform using a Pt/Cr$_2$O$_3$:Mg/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ diode sensor of H$_2$ and temperature, spanning 0-800 ppm H$_2$ and 350-550 °C. Finally, we use the SAL-generated dataset for offline long-horizon forecasting of the diode current at a target voltage with a structured Gaussian-process model. Its condition-dependent Kohlrausch--Williams--Watts mean and residual covariance kernel were engineered with artificial-intelligence assistance using the SAL data and an auxiliary validation dataset spanning 1,000 hours at 400 °C across multiple H$_2$ concentrations. This dataset guided kernel design and validation, and the resulting model captures its long-time, saturating degradation trends. Although demonstrated here for a rectifying Ga$_2$O$_3$-based diode, SAL is applicable to other device classes whenever a suitable safety observable can be measured in situ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种安全主动学习（Safe Active Learning, SAL）框架，用于Ga₂O₃基二极管传感器在热与氢耦合应力下的自主可靠性表征。作者先在仿真中验证SAL能安全扩展探索区域并学习演化的整流面，随后在自动化高温探针台平台上，对Pt/Cr₂O₃:Mg/β-Ga₂O₃二极管传感器进行实验验证，覆盖0-800 ppm H₂和350-550 °C。最后利用SAL生成的数据集，通过结构化高斯过程模型对目标电压下的二极管电流进行离线长时程预测，模型捕捉了长时间饱和退化趋势。
Motivation: 超宽禁带（UWBG）Ga₂O₃是高温高功率电子学中有前景的半导体，但在极端工作条件下的可靠性验证至关重要，而传统可靠性测试非常耗时。自主实验通过实时并行进行测量规划与模型细化，为加速可靠性表征提供了新范式。
Method: 提出Safe Active Learning框架，融合测量规划与模型实时更新。实验基于自动化高温探针台平台和Pt/Cr₂O₃:Mg/β-Ga₂O₃二极管传感器。离线预测采用结构化高斯过程模型，其条件依赖的Kohlrausch–Williams–Watts均值与残差协方差核通过人工智能辅助设计，并利用SAL数据及覆盖400 °C下1000小时、多种H₂浓度的辅助验证数据集进行校准。
Result: 仿真评估表明SAL能安全扩大探索区域并学习整流面演化；实验演示在0-800 ppm H₂、350-550 °C条件下成功完成自主表征；离线模型捕获了长时间饱和退化趋势。
Conclusion: 虽然该框架是在整流型Ga₂O₃基二极管上演示的，但只要能在原位测量合适的安全观测量，SAL可适用于其他器件类别。

papers.title: Interpreting Video Representations with Spatio-Temporal Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: We present the first systematic study of Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) on video representations. Standard SAEs decompose video into interpretable, monosemantic features but destroy temporal coherence: hard TopK selection produces unstable feature assignments across frames, reducing autocorrelation by 36%. We propose spatio-temporal contrastive objectives and Matryoshka hierarchical grouping that recover and even exceed raw temporal coherence. The contrastive loss weight controls a tunable trade-off between reconstruction and temporal coherence. A systematic ablation on two backbones and two datasets shows that different configurations excel at different goals: reconstruction fidelity, temporal coherence, action discrimination, or interpretability. Contrastive SAE features improve action classification by +3.9 pp over raw features and text-video retrieval by up to 2.8 x R@1. A cross-backbone analysis reveals that standard monosemanticity metrics contain a backbone-alignment artifact: both DINOv2 and VideoMAE produce equally monosemantic features under an independent (CLIP) similarity space. Targeted feature ablation shows that contrastive training concentrates the probe's predictive signal into a small number of identifiable features. Supplementary material, code, configurations and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/atahandokme/spatio-temporal-sparse-autoencoders-video.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Camera-ready version, ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26)
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究稀疏自编码器（SAE）在视频表示上的应用。作者发现标准 SAE 虽然能将视频分解为可解释的单语义特征，但硬 TopK 选择会破坏时间连贯性，使帧间特征分配不稳定，自相关降低 36%。为此提出时空对比目标（spatio-temporal contrastive objectives）和 Matryoshka 层次分组，可恢复甚至超过原始时间连贯性，并指出对比损失权重控制重建与时间连贯性之间的可调权衡。在两种骨干网络和两个数据集上的消融表明不同配置分别擅长重建保真度、时间连贯性、动作判别或可解释性。
Motivation: 标准 SAE 用于视频时虽然能生成可解释的单语义特征，但硬 TopK 选择造成跨帧特征分配不稳定，显著破坏时间连贯性（自相关下降 36%），这是现有方法在视频表示解释性上的关键缺陷。
Method: 提出时空对比目标与 Matryoshka 层次分组来恢复时间连贯性，并通过对比损失权重控制重建与时间连贯性之间的权衡；同时进行了双骨干、双数据集的系统消融、跨骨干分析和针对性特征消融实验。
Result: 对比式 SAE 特征在动作分类上比原始特征提升 +3.9 个百分点，在文本-视频检索上 R@1 最高提升 2.8 倍。跨骨干分析发现标准单语义性指标存在骨干对齐伪影：在独立 CLIP 相似度空间中 DINOv2 和 VideoMAE 产生同等单语义的特征。针对性特征消融表明对比训练将探针的预测信号集中到少量可识别特征上。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，面向视频的 SAE 需要专门处理时间连贯性，且不同配置在重建、时间连贯性、动作判别和可解释性之间各有取舍；同时揭示单语义性指标中的骨干对齐伪影，并表明对比训练能产生更集中的可解释特征。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AIVV: Neuro-Symbolic LLM Agent-Integrated Verification and Validation for Trustworthy Autonomous Systems
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models excel at detecting anomaly patterns in normal data. However, they do not provide a direct solution for anomaly classification and scalability across diverse control systems, frequently failing to distinguish genuine faults from nuisance faults caused by noise or the control system's large transient response. Consequently, because algorithmic fault validation remains unscalable, full Verification and Validation (V\&V) operations are still managed by Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) analysis, resulting in an unsustainable manual workload. To automate this essential oversight, we propose Agent-Integrated Verification and Validation (AIVV), a hybrid framework that deploys Large Language Models (LLMs) as a deliberative outer loop. Because rigorous system verification strictly depends on accurate validation, AIVV escalates mathematically flagged anomalies to a role-specialized LLM council. The council agents perform collaborative validation by semantically validating nuisance and true failures based on natural-language (NL) requirements to secure a high-fidelity system-verification baseline. Building on this foundation, the council then performs system verification by assessing post-fault responses against NL operational tolerances, ultimately generating actionable V\&V artifacts, such as gain-tuning proposals. Experiments on a time-series simulator for Unmanned Underwater Vehicles (UUVs) demonstrate that AIVV successfully digitizes the HITL V\&V process, overcoming the limitations of rule-based fault classification and offering a scalable blueprint for LLM-mediated oversight in time-series data domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AIVV（Agent-Integrated Verification and Validation），一种用大语言模型（LLM）作为审慎外环的混合框架，用于自动化自主系统的验证与确认（V&V）。框架将数学层面标记的异常交由角色专门化的 LLM 委员会处理，先基于自然语言需求区分真实故障与干扰故障，再依据操作容差评估故障后响应，最终生成增益调优提案等 V&V 工件。在无人潜航器（UUV）时间序列模拟器上的实验表明，该方法能数字化人机协同（HITL）V&V 流程，并优于基于规则的故障分类。
Motivation: 深度模型擅长从正常数据中检测异常模式，但无法直接完成异常分类和跨不同控制系统的扩展，常混淆真实故障与噪声或大瞬态响应引起的干扰故障。算法化故障验证缺乏可扩展性，完整 V&V 操作仍依赖 HITL 分析，造成不可持续的手动工作量。
Method: 提出 AIVV，将 LLM 作为 deliberative outer loop，把数学上标记的异常升级给角色专门化的 LLM 委员会（role-specialized LLM council）。委员会先基于自然语言（NL）需求语义验证干扰故障与真实故障，建立高保真系统验证基线；随后依据 NL 操作容差评估故障后响应完成系统验证，并生成如增益调优提案（gain-tuning proposals）等可操作 V&V 工件。
Result: 在无人潜航器（UUV）的时间序列模拟器实验中，AIVV 成功将 HITL V&V 过程数字化，克服了基于规则的故障分类方法的局限。
Conclusion: 作者将 AIVV 视为在时间序列数据领域用 LLM 介导监督的可扩展蓝图；实验验证在 UUV 时间序列模拟器范围内完成。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: To Memorize or to Retrieve: Scaling the Interaction Between Pretraining and Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves language model (LM) performance by providing relevant context at test time for knowledge-intensive situations. In this work, we systematically study the trade-off between pretraining and retrieval by training OLMo-2-based LMs ranging from 30M to 3B parameters on up to 100B DCLM tokens, while varying pretraining data scale, retrieval store size, and retrieval store source (pretraining vs. new data) across reasoning, scientific QA, and open-domain QA benchmarks. We find that retrieval gains depend on model capacity and pretraining exposure and are strongly front-loaded, with a median 91% of the largest observed improvement realized by one retrieval token per model parameter. However, the interaction is objective-dependent: smaller models gain more in gold-answer perplexity, whereas larger, more-pretrained models gain more in accuracy. Retrieval from previously seen data also preserves most of the held-out retrieval gain. Retrieval is therefore a task-, regime-, and metric-dependent complement to parametric learning whose value also depends on datastore size and information novelty. Overall, this motivates the explicit partitioning of data between internalization and external access for LM design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究预训练与检索（RAG）之间的权衡，基于 OLMo-2 架构训练 30M 到 3B 参数的语言模型，使用最多 100B DCLM tokens，并改变预训练数据规模、检索库大小及检索库来源（预训练数据 vs 新数据），在推理、科学问答和开放域问答基准上评估。摘要报告检索收益强烈前置，中位 91% 的最大改进在每参数一个检索 token 时即已实现，但交互效果依赖目标任务、训练区间和评估指标。作者由此建议在 LM 设计中显式划分数据的内部化（internalization）与外部访问（external access）。
Motivation: RAG 通过测试时提供相关上下文来提升知识密集型任务表现，但检索与预训练之间的交互、以及模型容量和预训练暴露程度如何影响检索收益，尚缺乏系统性研究。
Method: 使用 OLMo-2 架构训练 30M 到 3B 参数模型，在 100B DCLM tokens 范围内变化预训练数据规模、检索库大小和检索库来源（来自预训练已见数据 vs 新数据），并在推理、科学问答和开放域问答基准上评估。
Result: 检索收益取决于模型容量和预训练暴露程度且强烈前置，中位 91% 的最大改进在每参数一个检索 token 时实现。较小的模型在 gold-answer 困惑度上收益更大，而更大、预训练更充分的模型在准确率上收益更大；来自已见数据的检索仍保留了大部分 held-out 检索收益。
Conclusion: 检索是对参数化学习的任务依赖、训练区间依赖和指标依赖的补充，其价值还取决于数据存储大小与信息新颖性，因此应显式划分数据用于内部化与外部访问。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Routing: Parameter-Free Expert Routing from Hidden States
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers increase model capacity by activating only a small subset of experts per token, and typically rely on a learned router to map hidden states to expert assignments. In this work, we ask whether a dedicated learned router is strictly necessary for MoE routing. We propose Self-Routing, a parameter-free routing mechanism that uses a designated subspace of the token hidden state directly as expert logits, eliminating the router projection entirely while leaving the rest of the MoE layer unchanged. We evaluate Self-Routing on language modeling across different expert counts and model scales, and on ImageNet-1K classification by comparing it against a standard learned router, random-routing baselines, and dense non-MoE baselines. Our results show that Self-Routing remains competitive with the learned-router baseline while removing all dedicated routing parameters, and yields more balanced expert utilization, with about 17\% higher average normalized routing entropy and no explicit load-balancing loss. On ImageNet-1K with DeiT-S/16, Self-Routing also slightly improves over the corresponding learned-router MoE. These findings suggest that effective MoE routing can emerge from the hidden representation itself without requiring a separate learned router module.

papers.title: Mask-aware inference with State-Space Models
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world computer vision tasks, such as depth completion, must handle inputs with arbitrarily shaped regions of missing or invalid data. For Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Partial Convolutions solved this by a mask-aware re-normalization conditioned only on valid pixels. Recently, State Space Models (SSMs) like Mamba have emerged, offering high performance with linear complexity. However, these architectures lack an inherent mechanism for handling such arbitrarily shaped invalid data at inference time. To bridge this gap, we introduce Partial Vision Mamba (PVM), a novel architectural component that ports the principles of partial operations to the Mamba backbone. We also define a series of rules to design architectures using PVM. We show the efficacy and generalizability of our approach in the tasks of depth completion, image inpainting, and classification with invalid data.
papers.comment: Some results contain significant errors and we are working in a rework on this paper, which is now outdated
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 State Space Models (SSMs)（如 Mamba）缺乏处理任意形状无效数据机制的问题，提出 Partial Vision Mamba (PVM)，将部分卷积 (Partial Convolutions) 的掩码感知重归一化思想移植到 Mamba 骨干中，并定义了一组基于 PVM 的架构设计规则。摘要报告该方法在深度补全 (depth completion)、图像修复 (image inpainting) 和含无效数据的分类任务上展现了有效性与泛化性。需要特别注意的是，作者在 arXiv 评论中说明部分结果存在显著错误，论文正在重做且现已过时。

Conclusion: 作者指出论文部分结果存在显著错误，正在重做，当前版本已过时，因此阅读时应以修订版为准。

papers.title: El Agente Gráfico: A Semantic Execution Runtime for Scientific Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can plan scientific workflows and generate code, but these capabilities do not specify how scientific state is validated, transferred and recorded across heterogeneous computational and experimental operations. Here we present El Agente Gráfico, a semantic execution runtime for scientific agents that uses typed execution graphs to enforce admissible scientific state transitions, record provenance and confine model judgement to explicit decision points. Using the same top-level LLM and task-specific rubrics on six university-level quantum chemistry exercises, El Agente Gráfico improved performance while reducing model cost by approximately 80% and wall-clock time by more than fourfold relative to our previous multi-agent architecture. Across ensemble spectroscopy and metal-organic framework (MOF) design, the runtime supported typed-state transfer, parallel execution and cross-session persistence. Open-ended studies of a disulfide redox mechanism and the vibrational hypothesis of olfaction required the agent to define the chemical scope and computational pathway of each investigation. A graph-construction skill distilled from these studies then enabled coding agents to author typed execution graphs for MOF literature mining. Together, these results show how typed execution graphs turn reusable procedural knowledge into scientific protocols that can be inspected, revised and transferred across computational and physical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 El Agente Gráfico，一个面向科学代理的语义执行运行时，利用类型化执行图 (typed execution graphs) 来约束科学状态转换、记录来源 (provenance) 并将模型判断限制在显式决策点上。在六个大学水平量子化学练习中，与先前的多智能体架构相比，该方法在保持同一顶层 LLM 和任务特定评分标准的情况下提升了性能，同时将模型成本降低约 80%，墙钟时间缩短四倍以上。运行时还支持集成光谱和 MOF 设计中的类型化状态传递、并行执行和跨会话持久化，并通过图构建技能让编码代理为 MOF 文献挖掘编写类型化执行图。
Motivation: LLM 能够规划科学工作流程并生成代码，但未规定科学状态如何在异构计算与实验操作之间被验证、传递和记录，缺乏可检查、可修订的执行基础设施。
Method: 引入语义执行运行时 El Agente Gráfico，使用类型化执行图来强制执行合法的科学状态转换，记录来源，并把模型判断限制在显式决策点；同时包含从开放研究中提炼的图构建技能，使编码代理能够自行编写类型化执行图。
Result: 在六个大学水平量子化学练习中，相对先前多智能体架构，性能提升的同时模型成本降低约 80%，墙钟时间缩短四倍以上；在集成光谱和 MOF 设计中支持类型化状态传递、并行执行与跨会话持久化；图构建技能使代理能够为 MOF 文献挖掘编写执行图。
Conclusion: 作者认为类型化执行图可将可复用的程序性知识转化为可检查、可修订、可跨计算与物理系统迁移的科学协议。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Autorubric: A Unifying Framework for Rubric-Based LLM Evaluation on Non-Verifiable Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Rubric-based LLM judges have become indispensable for evaluating and optimizing systems on non-verifiable tasks, where success cannot be reduced to exact programmatic checks. Yet the underlying judges remain vulnerable to position bias, stochastic inconsistency, criterion conflation, forced judgments under uncertainty, and model-dependent calibration. Rubrics structure evaluation but do not eliminate these failures; they add consequential choices about criterion design, scale types, weighting, aggregation, abstention, calibration, and reliability measurement. Despite extensive research across LLM evaluation, educational measurement, and psychometrics, the relevant methods remain scattered across papers and partial implementations. Researchers therefore pay a reinvention tax, repeatedly rebuilding evaluation machinery instead of accumulating knowledge on a common substrate. We introduce Autorubric, an open-source framework that makes rubric and judge choices explicit, reusable, and auditable. Through a unified API, it supports atomic evaluation of mixed criterion types alongside configurable bias mitigations, calibration, ensembling, abstention, and psychometric diagnostics. Evaluations spanning college chemistry grading, deep-research systems, and CHARM-100---a new mixed-criterion chatbot benchmark---reveal criterion-specific failures, systematic judge-family differences, and configuration effects that do not support a universal mitigation stack. We further demonstrate how per-criterion scores and explanations can support agent skill revision and reward modeling for reinforcement learning. By providing shared infrastructure from measurement through optimization, Autorubric gives the community a common basis for comparing methods, reproducing evaluation choices, and accumulating evidence across studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Autorubric，一个开源的基于评分标准 (rubric) 的大语言模型 (LLM) 评估框架，面向不可验证任务 (non-verifiable tasks)。框架通过统一 API 支持混合准则类型的原子化评估、偏差缓解、校准、集成、弃权 (abstention) 与心理测量学诊断。作者在化学评分、深度研究系统和新增的混合准则聊天基准 CHARM-100 上展示评估结果，并演示逐准则分数与解释可用于智能体技能修正和强化学习奖励建模。
Motivation: 基于 rubric 的 LLM 裁判存在位置偏差、随机不一致、准则混淆、不确定性下被迫判断和模型相关校准等缺陷，而相关方法分散在论文与部分实现中，导致研究者反复重建评估机制，难以在共同基础上积累知识。
Method: 提出开源框架 Autorubric，将 rubric 与裁判选择显式化、可复用且可审计；通过统一 API 支持混合准则类型的原子评估，并配置偏差缓解、校准、集成、弃权与心理测量学诊断。
Result: 在化学评分、深度研究系统及新增的混合准则聊天基准 CHARM-100 上的评估揭示了准则特定失效、系统性的裁判家族差异和配置效应，不支持通用的缓解栈；逐准则分数与解释还可支持智能体技能修订和强化学习奖励建模。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Autorubric 提供从测量到优化的共享基础设施，为社区比较方法、复现评估选择和跨研究积累证据提供共同基础。

papers.title: SIP: Site in Pieces- A Dataset of Disaggregated Construction-Phase 3D Scans for Semantic Segmentation and Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Accurate 3D scene interpretation in active construction sites is essential for progress monitoring, safety assessment, and digital twin development. LiDAR is widely used in construction because it offers advantages over camera-based systems, performing reliably in cluttered and dynamically changing conditions. Yet most public datasets for 3D perception are derived from densely fused scans with uniform sampling and complete visibility, conditions that do not reflect real construction sites. Field data are often collected as isolated single-station LiDAR views, constrained by safety requirements, limited access, and ongoing operations. These factors lead to radial density decay, fragmented geometry, and view-dependent visibility-characteristics that remain underrepresented in existing datasets. This paper presents SIP, Site in Pieces, a dataset created to reflect the practical constraints of LiDAR acquisition during construction. SIP provides indoor and outdoor scenes captured with a terrestrial LiDAR scanner and annotated at the point level using a taxonomy tailored to construction environments: A. Built Environment, B. Construction Operations, and C. Site Surroundings. The dataset includes both structural components and slender temporary objects such as scaffolding, MEP piping, and scissor lifts, where sparsity caused by occlusion and fragmented geometry make segmentation particularly challenging. The scanning protocol, annotation workflow, and quality control procedures establish a consistent foundation for the dataset. SIP is openly available with a supporting Git repository, offering adaptable class configurations that streamline adoption within modern 3D deep learning frameworks. By providing field data that retain real-world sensing characteristics, SIP enables robust benchmarking and contributes to advancing construction-oriented 3D vision tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SIP (Site in Pieces) 数据集，用于建筑施工阶段的 3D 点云语义分割与场景理解。数据集由地面 LiDAR 扫描仪采集室内外施工现场数据，采用面向施工环境的分类体系（建成环境、施工作业、场地周围）进行点级标注，并保留了真实场地的径向密度衰减、碎片化几何和视点相关可见性等传感特性。数据集公开并提供 Git 仓库，支持灵活类别配置以适配现代 3D 深度学习框架。
Motivation: 现有公共 3D 感知数据集多来自稠密融合扫描，具有均匀采样和完整可见性，不符合真实施工场地中孤立单站 LiDAR 视图的特点，导致碎片化几何和视点相关可见性在数据集中代表性不足。
Method: 构建 SIP 数据集，使用地面 LiDAR 扫描仪采集室内外场景，制定扫描协议、标注流程与质量控制程序，并以面向施工环境的分类体系进行点级标注，同时提供可调整的类别配置和开源 Git 仓库。
Result: 数据集包含结构构件及脚手架、MEP 管道、剪叉式升降机等细长临时物体，遮挡引起的稀疏性和碎片化几何使分割尤为困难；SIP 提供保留真实传感特性的现场数据以支持鲁棒基准测试。
Conclusion: SIP 通过保留实际施工场地的传感特征，旨在为建筑场景 3D 视觉任务提供更贴近真实条件的基准，推动施工导向的 3D 感知研究。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 构建 SIP 数据集，使用地面 LiDAR 扫描仪采集室内外场景，制定扫描协议、标注流程与质量控制程序，并以面向施工环境的分类体系进行点级标注，同时提供可调整的类别配置和开源 Git 仓库。
summary_sections.result: 数据集包含结构构件及脚手架、MEP 管道、剪叉式升降机等细长临时物体，遮挡引起的稀疏性和碎片化几何使分割尤为困难；SIP 提供保留真实传感特性的现场数据以支持鲁棒基准测试。
summary_sections.conclusion: SIP 通过保留实际施工场地的传感特征，旨在为建筑场景 3D 视觉任务提供更贴近真实条件的基准，推动施工导向的 3D 感知研究。

papers.title: Assessing Factual Music Comprehension in Large Audio Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large audio language models (LALMs) leverage multimodal representations to generate open-ended answers to natural language queries about audio. In this paper, we (1) provide empirical evidence that assessment of LALMs using the popular MusicQA dataset fails to measure whether a model's responses about music are factually correct, and (2) develop a new protocol for assessing the music comprehension capabilities of LALMs. Specifically, we propose an evaluation protocol that prompts a LALM for factually verifiable information, and parses its open-ended response into a structured format that can be objectively assessed using Precision, Recall, and F1 scores. Using this protocol, we define a benchmark consisting of six factual information retrieval tasks defined on three diverse datasets: MusicNet, the Free Music Archive, and OverClocked ReMix. We benchmark nine recent LALMs, including frontier models like Gemini and the latest open models like Music Flamingo, and release the suite of evaluation scripts at https://github.com/DCL2004/LALM-Eval to facilitate benchmarking of new LALMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出使用 MusicQA 数据集评估大型音频语言模型 (LALM) 无法反映其音乐回答的事实正确性，并提出一种新的评估协议：提示模型输出可验证的事实信息，并将开放式回答解析为结构化格式，用 Precision、Recall 和 F1 客观评分。作者基于 MusicNet、Free Music Archive 和 OverClocked ReMix 三个数据集定义了六个事实信息检索任务，基准测试了包括 Gemini 和 Music Flamingo 在内的九个近期 LALM，并开源了评估脚本。
Motivation: 现有 LALM 评估常用 MusicQA 数据集，但作者提供经验证据表明该评估无法衡量模型关于音乐回答是否事实正确，因此需要更严谨的协议来评估 LALM 的音乐理解能力。
Method: 提出提示 LALM 输出可事实验证信息、再将开放式回答解析为结构化格式的评估协议，并使用 Precision、Recall 和 F1 进行客观评分；以此定义包含六个事实信息检索任务的基准，覆盖三个数据集，并发布于 GitHub。
Result: 摘要报告该基准覆盖六个任务、三个数据集（MusicNet、Free Music Archive、OverClocked ReMix），并评测了九个近期 LALM，包括 Gemini 等前沿模型和 Music Flamingo 等最新开源模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为该协议能更可靠地衡量 LALM 的音乐理解能力，并公开评估脚本以方便后续新模型进行基准测试。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OBCache: Optimal Brain KV Cache Pruning for Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) with extended context windows enable powerful applications but impose significant memory overhead, as caching all key-value (KV) states scales linearly with sequence length and batch size. Existing cache eviction methods address this by exploiting attention sparsity, yet they typically rank tokens heuristically using accumulated attention weights without considering their true impact on attention outputs. We propose Optimal Brain Cache (OBCache), a principled framework that formulates cache eviction as a layer-wise structured pruning problem. Building upon the Optimal Brain Damage (OBD) theory, OBCache quantifies token saliency by measuring the perturbation in attention outputs induced by pruning tokens, with closed-form scores derived for isolated keys, isolated values, and joint key-value pairs. Our scores account not only for attention weights but also for information from value states and attention outputs, thereby enhancing existing eviction strategies with output-aware signals. Experiments on LLaMA and Qwen models demonstrate that replacing the heuristic scores in existing works, which estimate token saliency across different query positions, with OBCache's output-aware scores consistently improves long-context accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/DreamSoul-AI/OBCache.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Optimal Brain Cache (OBCache)，将 LLM 推理中的 KV 缓存逐出形式化为逐层结构化剪枝问题，基于 Optimal Brain Damage 理论推导出针对孤立键、孤立值和键值对的闭合形式 token 显著性分数。这些分数同时利用注意力权重、值状态和注意力输出，为现有启发式逐出策略提供输出感知信号。实验表明，在 LLaMA 和 Qwen 模型上用 OBCache 分数替换现有启发式分数能一致提升长上下文准确率。
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 缓存所有 KV 状态的内存开销随序列长度和批大小线性增长。现有缓存逐出方法利用注意力稀疏性，但通常用累积注意力权重启发式地对 token 排序，未考虑其对注意力输出的真实影响。
Method: 将缓存逐出建模为逐层结构化剪枝问题，基于 Optimal Brain Damage 理论量化 token 显著性，即逐出 token 引起的注意力输出扰动，并为孤立键、孤立值及键值对推导闭合形式分数。分数结合注意力权重、值状态与注意力输出信息，生成输出感知信号。
Result: 在 LLaMA 和 Qwen 模型上的实验显示，用 OBCache 的输出感知分数替代现有工作中估算不同查询位置 token 显著性的启发式分数，一致地提升长上下文准确率。
Conclusion: OBCache 作为统一的逐出框架，可为现有基于注意力的逐出策略提供输出感知信号，并有开源实现。摘要未提及具体局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Score-based Membership Inference on Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) against Diffusion Models (DMs) raise pressing privacy concerns by revealing whether a sample was part of the training set. While existing methods typically rely on measuring reconstruction error across multiple denoising steps as a test statistic, they often incur significant computational overhead. In this work, we present a simple yet successful attack statistic using only the predicted noise vectors from the DM's denoiser, or equivalently, the score. Specifically, we show that the expected denoiser output points toward a kernel-weighted local mean of nearby training samples, such that its norm encodes proximity to the training set and thereby reveals membership. Building on this observation, we propose SimA, a single-query attack that provides a principled, efficient alternative to existing multi-query methods. SimA consistently achieves highly competitive performance across variants of DMs and the Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) on eight different datasets. Its Monte Carlo variant (SimA-MC) exhibits state-of-the-art performance in most experiments at 30 samples, significantly outperforming baseline methods in terms of TPR@1%FPR. These results demonstrate that complex reconstruction trajectories are unnecessary for effective membership inference, establishing SimA as a highly efficient benchmark for auditing privacy in DMs and LDMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出针对扩散模型 (Diffusion Models, DMs) 的成员推断攻击 (membership inference attack) SimA，仅利用去噪器输出的预测噪声向量（即 score）的范数作为攻击统计量，替代需多次去噪步骤的重构误差类方法。作者证明去噪器期望输出指向附近训练样本的核加权局部均值，其范数可编码样本与训练集的接近程度。SimA 在八种数据集上对多种 DM 和潜在扩散模型 (LDM) 变体均取得有竞争力的表现，其 Monte Carlo 变体 SimA-MC 在多数实验中以 30 个样本达到 SOTA 的 TPR@1%FPR。
Motivation: 现有针对扩散模型的 MIA 通常以跨多个去噪步骤的重构误差作为检验统计量，计算开销显著；作者希望寻找一个简单且有效的攻击统计量，以降低审计隐私的计算成本。
Method: 从理论上说明期望去噪器输出指向训练样本的核加权局部均值，因此输出向量的范数编码了与训练集的邻近程度；据此提出单次查询攻击 SimA，并以预测噪声向量（score）的范数作为成员性判据，另给出 Monte Carlo 变体 SimA-MC。
Result: SimA 在八种数据集上对多种 DM 变体和 LDM 均表现稳定且有竞争力；SimA-MC 在 30 个样本下的大多数实验中达到 SOTA，并在 TPR@1%FPR 指标上显著优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 本文表明复杂的重构轨迹并非有效成员推断所必需，SimA 可作为审计 DM 与 LDM 隐私的高效基准方法。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Topographic Constraints Shape Brain-Like Component Structure in Auditory Models
papers.abstract_en: If topography is a fundamental feature of the brain, it should influence both how neurons are arranged in space (i.e. explain brain maps) and how information is structured within the neural population. The human auditory cortex provides a strong, but previously underused test for the latter idea. Neural responses measured with both fMRI and ECoG can be decomposed into interpretable components corresponding to sound categories such as speech, music, and song, offering a view of how sound information is partitioned in the brain. Here we ask whether introducing topographic constraints into the training of audio neural network models shapes their internal representations to better match the component structure observed in the brain. To address this question, we introduce a new class of topographic auditory models, TopoAudio, which incorporate wiring-length constraints and encourage nearby units on a two-dimensional cortical sheet to develop similar response tuning. Despite these additional constraints we find that TopoAudio achieves comparable performance on standard speech and environmental sound classification tasks to standard non-topographic models and matches them in predicting human fMRI responses. Crucially however, topographic models develop more compact internal representations, and their inferred components align more closely with those derived from human ECoG recordings. These results provide initial evidence that topography offers a general mechanism for producing biologically aligned internal representations in artificial neural networks. More broadly, component-level alignment provides a complementary way for testing whether topography reshapes population responses in models to better match the representational structure observed in neural recordings. Our project page: https://topoaudio.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一类新的地形听觉模型 TopoAudio，在音频神经网络训练中引入布线长度约束并鼓励二维皮层片上邻近单元形成相似响应调谐。研究发现这些地形约束虽然增加了训练限制，但模型在标准语音和环境声音分类任务上与无地形模型性能相当，也能匹配 fMRI 响应预测；更重要的是，地形模型形成更紧凑的内部表征，其推断出的成分与人脑 ECoG 记录得到的成分更一致。作者认为这为地形是产生生物学对齐神经网络表征的一般机制提供了初步证据。
Motivation: 如果地形 (topography) 是大脑的基本特征，它应既影响神经元的空间排列，也影响群体内信息结构。人类听觉皮层可用 fMRI 和 ECoG 分解出对应语音、音乐、歌曲等声音类别的可解释成分，为检验地形是否重塑信息结构提供了此前未被充分利用的测试。
Method: 提出新的地形听觉模型类 TopoAudio，通过在训练中引入布线长度约束 (wiring-length constraints)，并鼓励二维皮层片 (cortical sheet) 上邻近单元发展出相似的响应调谐，从而把地形约束注入音频神经网络。
Result: 摘要报告 TopoAudio 在标准语音和环境声音分类任务上与标准非地形模型性能相当，在预测人类 fMRI 响应上也匹配；但地形模型内部表征更紧凑，推断出的成分与人 ECoG 记录导出的成分对齐更好。
Conclusion: 结果提供了初步证据，表明地形是使人工神经网络内部表征与神经记录成分结构更对齐的一般机制；成分级对齐 (component-level alignment) 可作为测试地形是否重塑群体响应的补充方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ToolUniverse: An open platform for democratizing AI scientists
papers.abstract_en: AI scientists are emerging computational systems that serve as collaborative partners in discovery. These systems remain difficult to build because they are bespoke, tied to rigid workflows, and lack shared environments that unify tools, data, and analyses into a common ecosystem. We present ToolUniverse, an open platform for building AI scientists from any language or reasoning model across open- and closed-weight models. ToolUniverse standardizes how AI scientists identify and call tools through an AI-tool interaction standard, in which every tool declares its purpose in natural language, a typed schema for its inputs and outputs, and a backend-agnostic invocation format, and applies that standard to more than 2,700 scientific tools and over 130 research skills spanning machine learning models, datasets, APIs, and scientific packages for data analysis, knowledge retrieval, and experimental design. It automatically refines tool interfaces for correct use by AI scientists, generates new tools from natural language descriptions, iteratively optimizes tool specifications, and composes tools into agentic workflows. In case studies, ToolUniverse was used to create AI scientists that carried out end-to-end analyses in target assessment, chemical strategy, and clinical-trial safety. The open-source ToolUniverse is available at https://aiscientist.tools.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ToolUniverse，一个用于从任意语言模型或推理模型构建 AI 科学家（AI scientists）的开放平台。平台定义了统一的 AI-工具交互标准，覆盖超过 2,700 个科学工具和 130 多个研究技能，并支持自动细化工具接口、从自然语言描述生成新工具、迭代优化工具规范以及将工具组合成智能体工作流（agentic workflows）。案例研究中，ToolUniverse 被用来构建完成目标评估、化学策略和临床试验安全性端到端分析的 AI 科学家。
Motivation: 现存 AI 科学家系统难以构建，因为它们通常是定制化的、绑定在刚性工作流上，并且缺乏能统一工具、数据和分析的共享生态。
Method: 提出 ToolUniverse 平台，建立 AI-工具交互标准：每个工具用自然语言声明用途、提供输入输出的类型化 schema（typed schema）以及后端无关的调用格式。该标准被应用于超过 2,700 个科学工具和 130 多个研究技能，并进一步自动细化工具接口、从自然语言描述生成新工具、迭代优化工具规范、将工具组合为智能体工作流。
Result: 摘要报告在案例研究中，ToolUniverse 被用于创建能够执行目标评估、化学策略和临床试验安全性端到端分析的 AI 科学家；平台以开源形式发布。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ToolUniverse 通过统一标准与开放生态来降低构建 AI 科学家的门槛，从而推动其民主化。

papers.title: From Mimicry to True Intelligence (TI) -- A New Paradigm for Artificial General Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: The debate around Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) remains open due to two fundamentally different goals: replicating human-level performance versus replicating human-like cognitive processes. We argue that performance-based definitions are inadequate, offering no roadmap for research and failing to define the qualitative nature of genuine intelligence. Four decades of work on cognitive architectures have already characterized the relevant mechanisms; our claim is that this knowledge is not being consulted by the research program now driving AGI development. What we offer is a translation of it into terms bearing on contemporary systems, with criteria for assessing them. We define True Intelligence (TI) as a system characterized by six components: five architectural pillars for which assessment criteria can be stated (embodied sensory fusion, core directives, dynamic schemata, a highly interconnected multi-expert architecture, and an orchestration layer), together with Interconnectedness, an emergent quality for which we can offer no independent measure. Two commitments distinguish the framework from the architectures on which it builds: that the topology of the schema network is itself shaped by the directives under which a system has operated, so that identical experience under different directives yields differently organized knowledge; and that a continuously active associative substrate, from which a salience mechanism promotes only a fraction to deliberate processing, is a distinct locus of cognitive work rather than the unconscious support of a task cycle. Based on the five assessable pillars we propose a five-level taxonomy of AGI, applied to four contemporary and classical systems. We hold that Level 5 is the strongest architectural condition for TI that can presently be specified, and leave open whether meeting it is sufficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 AGI 定义之争提出 True Intelligence (TI) 新范式。作者认为基于性能的 AGI 定义无法为研究提供路线图，也刻画不了真正智能的质性特征，而认知架构领域四十年的成果未被当前 AGI 研究充分借鉴。论文将这类知识转译为面向当代系统的评估标准，定义 TI 为包含五个可评估架构支柱（embodied sensory fusion、core directives、dynamic schemata、multi-expert architecture、orchestration layer）与一个不可独立度量的涌现属性 Interconnectedness 的系统，并提出五级 AGI 分类法用于评估四个当代与经典系统。
Motivation: 性能复制与类人认知过程这两类 AGI 目标长期对立，而性能导向的定义既缺乏研究路线图，也无法说明真正智能的质性本质；同时，当前驱动 AGI 发展的研究项目没有充分参考认知架构领域已有的机制刻画。
Method: 提出 True Intelligence (TI) 框架：以认知架构知识为基础，定义五个可陈述评估标准的架构支柱，加上作为涌现属性的 Interconnectedness。框架有两个关键承诺：一是 schema 网络的拓扑由系统运行所依据的 directives 塑造，二是持续活跃的联想基底（associative substrate）是独立的认知工作场所，只有其中一小部分被 salience 机制提升到深思熟虑的处理中。
Result: 基于五个可评估支柱提出五级 AGI 分类法，并将其应用于四个当代与经典系统；作者认为 Level 5 是目前能明确给出的 TI 最强架构条件。
Conclusion: 作者主张性能导向的 AGI 定义不充分，且当前 AGI 研究未充分吸纳认知架构知识；论文明确不判定满足 Level 5 架构条件是否足以实现 TI，即其充分性仍保持开放。
