papers.title: An Attention-Based Stochastic Simulator for Multisite Extremes to Evaluate Nonstationary, Cascading Flood Risk
papers.abstract_en: Flood risk is correlated in space and time, challenging insurance systems that rely on diversification across assets. Financial instruments governing flood coverage are typically structured as 1 to 5-year contracts, exposing portfolios to climate-driven risk at interannual-to-decadal scales. Yet existing tools address climate risk either through seasonal forecasts extending only months or multidecadal projections misaligned with fiscal horizons, leaving a critical gap in actionable flood risk simulation. We introduce a multisite flood simulation framework combining attention-based analog retrieval with stochastic generation of multivariate flood frequency, intensity, and duration sequences. Applied to over 100 sites in the Mississippi River Basin, the model produces spatiotemporally coherent flood portfolios conditioned on interannual climate variability. Explainable AI attribution paired with wavelet analysis links simulated clustering to large-scale climate drivers, yielding physically interpretable flood clusters for portfolio-scale loss simulation. The framework provides plausible, out-of-sample flood risk catalogs for interannual-to-decadal insurance risk assessment and financial planning.
papers.journal_ref: Nayak, A., Gentine, P., and Lall, U. (2026). "Attention-Based Stochastic Simulation of Climate-Informed Spatiotemporal Flood Risk for Multisite Insurance Portfolios." Geophysical Research Letters, 53 (15)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多站点洪水模拟框架，将基于注意力的相似检索 (attention-based analog retrieval) 与多变量洪水频率、强度、历时序列的随机生成相结合。研究将其应用于密西西比河流域的 100 多个站点，生成以年际气候变率为条件的时空连贯洪水组合，并结合可解释人工智能归因与小波分析将洪水聚集现象联系到大尺度气候驱动因子。摘要称该方法能够为跨年度到十年尺度的保险风险评估提供合理的样本外洪水风险目录。
Motivation: 洪水风险在空间和时间上具有相关性，威胁依赖资产多元化的保险体系；而现有工具要么是仅覆盖数月的季节预报，要么是与 1-5 年财政合约时间尺度错位的多年际到数十年投影，缺乏与保险契约期限匹配的可操作洪水风险模拟工具。
Method: 提出一种多站点洪水模拟框架，核心是注意力机制驱动的相似检索加随机生成，用于构建多变量洪水频率、强度与历时序列；同时在密西西比河流域 100 多个站点上应用，并用可解释人工智能归因结合小波分析来识别洪水聚集与气候驱动因子的联系。
Result: 摘要报告该模型能够生成以年际气候变率为条件的时空连贯洪水组合，产出物理上可解释的洪水聚集模式以供组合层面的损失模拟，并提供合理的样本外洪水风险目录。
Conclusion: 该框架面向跨年度到十年尺度的保险风险评估与财务规划，弥补了季节预报与长期气候投影之间的时间尺度缺口。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: Benchmarking the Robustness of Agentic Systems to Adversarially-Induced Harms
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring the safe use of agentic systems requires a thorough understanding of the range of malicious behaviors these systems may exhibit. In this paper, we evaluate the robustness of LLM-based agentic systems against attacks that aim to elicit harmful actions from agents. To this end, we propose a novel taxonomy of harms for agentic systems and a novel benchmark, BAD-ACTS, for studying the security of agentic systems with respect to a wide range of harmful actions. BAD-ACTS consists of five implementations of agentic systems in distinct application environments, as well as a dataset of 238 high-quality examples of harmful actions and an extended dataset containing 699 additional adversarial actions. This enables a comprehensive study of the robustness of agentic systems across a wide range of categories of harmful behaviors, available tools, and inter-agent communication structures. Using this benchmark, we analyze the robustness of agentic systems under an array of attackers attempting to elicit malicious behaviors, including agents acting adversarially and prompt injections. We found that agents are often vulnerable, as indicated by success rates between 40% and 90% depending on the model. We additionally propose an effective defense based on zero-shot message monitoring. We believe that this benchmark provides a diverse testbed for the safety research of agentic systems. Code is available at https://github.com/JNoether/BAD-ACTS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个针对基于LLM的智能体系统（agentic systems）鲁棒性的基准BAD-ACTS，包含五个不同应用环境的系统实现、238个高质量有害行为示例和699个额外对抗行为示例，并分析了多种攻击者（包括对抗性智能体和提示注入）的危害诱发能力。结果显示智能体普遍脆弱，攻击成功率依模型不同在40%到90%之间；作者还提出一种基于零样本消息监控的有效防御方法。
Motivation: 智能体系统的安全使用需要全面理解其可能展现的恶意行为范围，而现有研究缺少针对此类系统安全性的统一基准和危害分类体系。
Method: 提出一种新的智能体系统危害分类法（taxonomy of harms），并构建基准BAD-ACTS，覆盖多种应用环境、可用工具和智能体间通信结构；在该基准上评估多种攻击者，并提出基于零样本消息监控（zero-shot message monitoring）的防御。
Result: 在多个模型上，攻击者成功诱发有害行为的成功率在40%至90%之间，表明智能体普遍存在脆弱性；零样本消息监控被证明是有效防御。
Conclusion: 该基准为智能体系统的安全研究提供了多样化测试平台，代码已在GitHub开源。

papers.title: Ensemble learning of pathology foundation models for precision oncology
papers.abstract_en: Histopathology is essential for cancer diagnosis and treatment selection, and pathology foundation models learn visual representations from whole-slide images (WSIs). However, existing foundation models are trained on disparate datasets using varying strategies, leading to inconsistent performance and limited generalizability. Here, we introduce ELF (Ensemble Learning of Foundation models), which integrates five pretrained pathology foundation models into unified slide-level representations. Trained on 53,699 WSIs spanning 20 anatomical sites, ELF leverages ensemble learning to capture complementary information across models. ELF's slide-level architecture is designed for data-efficient downstream evaluation, including settings with limited data such as therapeutic response prediction. We evaluate ELF for disease classification, biomarker detection, as well as anticancer and immunotherapy response prediction across multiple cancer types. ELF achieves higher performance than the evaluated constituent and slide-level foundation models across the tested tasks, supporting further evaluation of ensemble learning for pathology applications in oncology.
papers.comment: In this version, we fixed some issues and updated some results
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ELF（Ensemble Learning of Foundation models），将五个预训练病理学基础模型集成成统一的 slide 级表示，用于精准肿瘤学中的组织病理学任务。ELF 在覆盖 20 个解剖部位的 53,699 张全切片图像（WSIs）上训练，并在疾病分类、生物标志物检测以及抗癌/免疫治疗反应预测等任务上评估。摘要报告 ELF 在测试任务上优于其组成模型和现有 slide 级基础模型。该方法面向数据有限的下游场景，如治疗反应预测。
Motivation: 现有病理学基础模型在不同数据集和不同训练策略上开发，导致性能不一致且泛化能力有限，这限制了它们在实际肿瘤学下游任务中的可靠性。
Method: ELF 通过集成学习整合五个预训练病理学基础模型，形成统一的 slide-level 表示；其 slide 级架构专为数据高效的下游评估设计，适用于治疗反应预测等样本有限的任务。
Result: 在疾病分类、生物标志物检测以及抗癌和免疫治疗反应预测等多项任务中，ELF 比所评估的组成模型和 slide 级基础模型取得更高的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要认为集成学习值得在肿瘤学病理应用中进一步评估，以提升基础模型的泛化与下游任务表现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: NeuralDMD: Interpretable Neural Representation of Dynamics from Sparse and Noisy Measurements
papers.abstract_en: Many challenges in scientific imaging involve solving ill-posed inverse problems, where the goal is to recover spatio-temporal fields from indirect, noisy, and highly sparse measurements - often without access to ground truth data or reliable simulators. To address this challenging scenario, we present NeuralDMD, an interpretable, untrained (per-instance) reconstruction framework that combines neural implicit representations with Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) to reconstruct continuous spatio-temporal dynamics directly from measurements. NeuralDMD parameterizes DMD modes as continuous neural fields, and imposes a low-rank linear dynamics prior with spectral time evolution to enforce temporal continuity. This formulation enables both forecasting under sparsity, and yields interpretable modes and spectra. We find that NeuralDMD outperforms baselines on a wide variety of tasks: from weather data assimilation from sparse station observations to interferometric (Fourier domain) observations of Sagittarius A, the black hole at the center of our galaxy. Moreover, NeuralDMD remains stable when extrapolating into the future. While this framework is most naturally suited to linear dynamics, we show that it can be applied to nonlinear regimes, though with extrapolation performance that degrades with increasing nonlinearity. Together, these results show that NeuralDMD enables interpretable reconstruction and forecasting of spatio-temporal dynamics directly from sparse and indirect measurements without relying on numerical simulators or training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuralDMD，一个无需训练（per-instance）的可解释重建框架，将神经隐式表示（neural implicit representations）与动态模态分解（Dynamic Mode Decomposition, DMD）结合，直接从稀疏、有噪、间接的测量中重建连续时空动力学。方法将 DMD 模态参数化为连续神经场，并施加低秩线性动力学先验和谱时间演化以强制时间连续性，从而支持稀疏观测下的预报并产生可解释的模态与频谱。实验表明其在气象数据同化和人马座 A* 干涉观测等任务上优于基线，且外推稳定，但在非线性增强时外推性能下降。
Motivation: 科学成像中的许多问题本质上是病态反问题，需要从间接、有噪且高度稀疏的测量中恢复时空场，且常常没有真值数据或可靠模拟器可用；现有方法难以同时满足可解释性与无需训练数据的要求。
Method: NeuralDMD 将 DMD 模态表示为连续的神经场，并引入低秩线性动力学先验与谱时间演化来保证时间连续性，构成一个未训练的、按实例求解的重建框架，可直接从测量中重建连续时空动力学并用于外推预报。
Result: 摘要报告 NeuralDMD 在多种任务上优于基线，包括从稀疏站点观测进行气象数据同化，以及对银河系中心黑洞人马座 A* 的干涉（傅里叶域）观测重建；该方法在未来外推时保持稳定，但在非线性动力学下外推性能随非线性程度增加而退化。
Conclusion: 作者强调 NeuralDMD 能够在没有数值模拟器或训练数据的情况下，直接从稀疏和间接测量中实现可解释的时空动力学重建与预报；框架最自然适用于线性动力学，对非线性机制虽可应用但外推精度受限。

papers.title: Transformer Circuits Can Realize Clustering Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Although transformers are most commonly optimized as statistical sequence models, it is unclear to what extent they can implement and learn exact algorithmic computations. Here, we specify a transformer implementation from first principles that executes a fundamental and widely used method for $k$-means clustering: Lloyd's algorithm. We theoretically prove and empirically demonstrate that this implementation of a transformer architecture, which we term the $k$-means transformer, exactly implements Lloyd's algorithm for $k$-means clustering using the standard circuit mechanisms of modern transformers: attention block, residual connections, and feed-forward block. In learning experiments, we find that training this base architecture on $k$-means clustering yields a generalizable clustering algorithm that surpasses Lloyd's algorithm in terms of clustering quality. Finally, we demonstrate that interpretable alterations (e.g., inclusion of layer normalizations) to this architecture yields diverse and novel variants of clustering algorithms, including soft $k$-means, spherical $k$-means, trimmed $k$-means. Overall, our results show that transformer circuit mechanisms can instantiate exact algorithmic routines for clustering, while simultaneously providing an effective learnable model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从第一性原理构造了一个 Transformer 实现，使其精确执行 k-means 聚类中的 Lloyd 算法，并命名为 k-means transformer。作者用注意力块、残差连接和前馈块等标准电路机制，从理论上证明并实证验证了该实现的精确等价性。训练实验显示，这个基础架构可以学习到可泛化的聚类算法，且聚类质量超过 Lloyd 算法；对架构的可解释修改还能衍生出软 k-means、球面 k-means、修剪 k-means 等变体。
Motivation: Transformer 通常被当作统计序列模型来优化，但尚不清楚它们能在多大程度上实现并学习精确的算法计算。本文要探究 Transformer 电路机制能否实例化聚类这类经典算法，同时保持可学习性。
Method: 作者直接给出一个从零设计的 Transformer 实现，用它执行 Lloyd 算法，核心依赖现代 Transformer 的注意力块、残差连接和前馈块。研究包含理论等价性证明、基于该架构的 k-means 学习实验，以及加入层归一化等可解释架构改动以生成不同聚类变体。
Result: 论文证明并演示了 k-means transformer 能精确实现 Lloyd 算法；在训练实验中，学到的聚类算法在聚类质量上优于 Lloyd 算法；架构改动还产生了软 k-means、球面 k-means、修剪 k-means 等新型聚类变体。
Conclusion: 结论是 Transformer 电路机制足以实例化精确的聚类算法流程，并且可以同时作为一个有效的可学习模型。摘要未明确讨论局限性与适用范围。

papers.title: Lying mirror using structured surfaces
papers.abstract_en: We introduce an all-optical system, termed the "lying mirror", to hide input information by transforming it into misleading, ordinary-looking patterns that effectively camouflage the underlying image data and deceive the observers. This misleading transformation is achieved through passive light-matter interactions of the incident light with an optimized structured diffractive surface, enabling the optical concealment of any form of secret input data without any digital computing. These lying mirror designs were shown to camouflage different types of input image data, exhibiting robustness against a range of adversarial manipulations, including random image noise as well as unknown, random rotations, shifts, and scaling of the object features. The feasibility of the lying mirror concept was also validated experimentally using a structured micro-mirror array along with multi-wavelength illumination at 480, 550 and 600 nm, covering the blue, green and red image channels. Furthermore, we created a broadband lying mirror that operates across a continuous spectral range, enhancing its adaptability under diverse illumination conditions. This framework showcases the power of structured diffractive surfaces for visual information processing and might find various applications in defense, security and entertainment.
papers.journal_ref: Nature Communications (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种全光学系统“lying mirror”（说谎镜子），利用优化的结构化衍射表面通过被动光-物质相互作用，将输入图像信息转换为具有误导性的普通外观模式，从而隐藏底层图像数据，全程无需数字计算。实验使用结构化微镜阵列和多波长照明（480、550、600 nm）验证了蓝/绿/红通道下的可行性，并进一步实现了可在连续光谱范围工作的宽带版本。
Motivation: 现有信息隐藏通常依赖数字计算，作者希望仅通过被动光学元件完成输入信息的视觉伪装，以实现在无计算条件下的保密与迷惑功能。
Method: 设计并优化结构化衍射表面，使入射光与表面相互作用后产生误导性变换；实验采用结构化微镜阵列配合多波长照明（覆盖蓝、绿、红通道），并构造了工作于连续光谱范围的宽带衍射表面版本。
Result: 该设计可伪装不同类型输入图像数据，并对随机图像噪声以及未知的随机旋转、平移和尺度变化等对抗操作表现出鲁棒性；微镜阵列实验验证了多波长下的可行性，宽带版本增强了不同照明条件下的适应性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架展示了结构化衍射表面在视觉信息处理中的能力，并可能在国防、安全和娱乐领域获得应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ethical Framework for Responsible Foundational Models in Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of foundational models represents a paradigm shift in medical imaging, offering extraordinary capabilities in disease detection, diagnosis, and treatment planning. These large-scale artificial intelligence systems, trained on extensive multimodal and multi-center datasets, demonstrate remarkable versatility across diverse medical applications. However, their integration into clinical practice presents complex ethical challenges that extend beyond technical performance metrics. This study examines the critical ethical considerations at the intersection of healthcare and artificial intelligence. Patient data privacy remains a fundamental concern, particularly given these models' requirement for extensive training data and their potential to inadvertently memorize sensitive information. Algorithmic bias poses a significant challenge in healthcare, as historical disparities in medical data collection may perpetuate or exacerbate existing healthcare inequities across demographic groups. The complexity of foundational models presents significant challenges regarding transparency and explainability in medical decision-making. We propose a comprehensive ethical framework that addresses these challenges while promoting responsible innovation. This framework emphasizes robust privacy safeguards, systematic bias detection and mitigation strategies, and mechanisms for maintaining meaningful human oversight. By establishing clear guidelines for development and deployment, we aim to harness the transformative potential of foundational models while preserving the fundamental principles of medical ethics and patient-centered care.
papers.journal_ref: https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/medicine/articles/10.3389/fmed.2025.1544501/full
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文聚焦医学影像基础模型 (foundational models) 在临床整合中的伦理挑战，提出一个涵盖数据隐私、算法偏见、透明性与可解释性等问题的综合伦理框架。作者强调通过稳健的隐私保护、系统性偏见检测与缓解以及有意义的监督机制来促进负责任创新，但摘要未报告实验或定量结果。
Motivation: 基础模型在医学影像中的临床应用带来超越技术性能指标的复杂伦理问题，例如患者数据隐私、训练数据历史偏差可能加剧医疗不平等，以及模型黑箱特性影响医疗决策的透明度。
Method: 提出一个面向医学影像基础模型开发与部署的综合伦理框架，包含稳健的隐私保障措施、系统性的偏见检测与缓解策略，以及维持有意义的人类监督 (human oversight) 的机制。
Result: 摘要未报告实验或定量结果；本文属于伦理框架层面的论述性研究。
Conclusion: 作者旨在通过明确的开发和部署指南，在利用基础模型的变革潜力的同时维护医学伦理和以患者为中心的护理原则。

papers.title: Explainable Machine Learning-Based Security and Privacy Protection Framework for Internet of Medical Things Systems
papers.abstract_en: The Internet of Medical Things transcends traditional medical boundaries, enabling a transition from reactive treatment to proactive prevention. This innovative method revolutionizes healthcare by facilitating early disease detection and tailored care, particularly in chronic disease management, where IoMT automates treatments based on real-time health data collection. Nonetheless, its benefits are countered by significant security challenges that endanger the lives of its users due to the sensitivity and value of the processed data, thereby attracting malicious interests. Moreover, the utilization of wireless communication for data transmission exposes medical data to interception and tampering by cybercriminals. Additionally, anomalies may arise due to human error, network interference, or hardware malfunctions. In this context, anomaly detection based on Machine Learning (ML) is an interesting solution, but it comes up against obstacles in terms of explicability and privacy protection. To address these challenges, a new framework for Intrusion Detection Systems is introduced, leveraging Artificial Neural Networks for intrusion detection while utilizing Federated Learning for privacy preservation. Additionally, eXplainable Artificial Intelligence methods are incorporated to enhance model explanation and interpretation. The efficacy of the proposed framework is evaluated and compared with centralized approaches using multiple datasets containing network and medical data, simulating various attack types impacting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of medical and physiological data. The results offer compelling evidence that the FL method performs comparably to the centralized method, demonstrating high performance. Additionally, it affords the dual advantage of safeguarding privacy and providing model explanation while adhering to ethical principles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医疗物联网（IoMT）系统的安全与隐私挑战，提出一个基于机器学习的安全与隐私保护框架。该框架利用人工神经网络（ANN）进行入侵检测，采用联邦学习（Federated Learning）保护隐私，并引入可解释人工智能（XAI）增强模型的可解释性。作者在多个包含网络与医疗数据的数据集上与集中式方法对比，结果表明联邦学习性能与集中式相当，同时兼具隐私保护和模型解释的双重优势。
Motivation: IoMT 依赖无线通信传输敏感的医疗数据，面临拦截、篡改以及人为错误或硬件故障引发的异常风险；基于机器学习的异常检测虽有潜力，但在可解释性和隐私保护方面存在障碍。
Method: 提出一种新的入侵检测系统框架，使用人工神经网络检测入侵，通过联邦学习实现隐私保护，并结合 eXplainable AI 方法提升模型的解释与解读能力。
Result: 在包含网络和医疗数据的多个数据集上模拟影响医疗与生理数据机密性、完整性和可用性的多种攻击类型，实验表明联邦学习方法在性能上与集中式方法相当。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架不仅保护隐私并提供模型解释，还遵循伦理原则，为 IoMT 安全防护提供了一种可行方案。

papers.title: Exploiting chemical shift variability enables recovery of overlapping metabolites from 1H nuclear magnetic resonance spectra
papers.abstract_en: Overlapping peaks and sample-dependent chemical shift variability prevent reliable metabolite recovery from complex biological spectra. This problem is critical in one-dimensional proton (1D 1H) NMR which has become the standard method providing fast acquisition and information-rich spectra in metabolomics and foodomics. This study demonstrates how chemical shifts can be utilised as a strength in 1D 1H NMR, when suitably modeled through the proposed Bayesian Shift-Invariant Non-negative Matrix Factorization (BSI-NMF) procedure. We find that BSI-NMF accurately recovers the underlying chemical signals in 1D 1H NMR spectra missed by existing analyses approaches across simulations, laboratory created datasets, and a large urine dataset obtained from 2439 people across Europe. Our study highlights how shifts in the chemical signatures - until now perceived as a nuisance - can in fact when suitably modelled be instrumental for unique recovery of metabolites. This creates an opportunity to experimentally induce chemical shifts changes to facilitate unique recovery of spectra.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出贝叶斯移位不变非负矩阵分解（Bayesian Shift-Invariant Non-negative Matrix Factorization, BSI-NMF），将样品依赖的化学位移变异性显式建模，用于从一维 1H NMR 谱中恢复重叠的代谢物信号。模拟数据、实验室数据集以及 2439 名欧洲参与者的尿液数据集上的结果显示，BSI-NMF 能准确恢复现有分析手段遗漏的化学信号。作者强调，过去被视为干扰的化学位移变化，在适当建模后可成为代谢物唯一恢复的关键工具。
Motivation: 一维 1H NMR 中重叠峰与样品依赖的化学位移变异导致代谢物恢复不可靠，而 1D 1H NMR 又是代谢组学和食品组学中快速采集、信息丰富的标准方法，因此解决该问题是关键需求。
Method: 提出 Bayesian Shift-Invariant Non-negative Matrix Factorization (BSI-NMF) 程序，对化学位移进行显式建模，将化学位移可变性转化为信号恢复中的有用信息。
Result: 在模拟数据、实验室构建的数据集以及包含 2439 名欧洲个体的大型尿液数据集中，BSI-NMF 准确恢复了被现有分析方法遗漏的底层化学信号。
Conclusion: 研究显示化学位移变异能被模型化利用以促进代谢物的唯一恢复，并指出可实验诱导化学位移变化来辅助谱图解析。

papers.title: Hit Selection Using SSMD-Based Machine Learning Performance Metrics in High-Throughput Screening Assays
papers.abstract_en: High-throughput screening (HTS) assays are central to early-stage drug discovery but are often limited by extreme data sparsity, as primary screens typically use only a single replicate per test substance. This sparsity makes conventional machine-learning performance metrics, such as sensitivity, specificity, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC), difficult to estimate empirically because they require adequately sized labeled samples. Here, we introduce a model-based framework that derives these classification metrics from the strictly standardized mean difference (SSMD), a well-established HTS effect-size parameter. Under a Gaussian equal-variance assumption, we derive closed-form relationships linking SSMD to Youden-optimal sensitivity and specificity, and sensitivity at a preset specificity, yielding explicit estimators and exact confidence intervals from the noncentral t-distribution, even under single-replicate designs. Unlike classical statistical power, which approaches 1 as sample size grows regardless of how small the true non-zero difference between group means is, the SSMD-derived sensitivity converges to a finite population value that reflects the true degree of separation between two groups, making it a more meaningful and stable performance measure for hit selection. We demonstrate the utility of this framework in a hepatitis C virus primary siRNA screen comprising approximately 22,000 single-replicate measurements, showing that SSMD, AUROC, and sensitivity-based thresholds yield equivalent and interpretable hit sets. This work bridges classical HTS statistics and machine-learning evaluation theory, providing a statistically principled, reproducible way to estimate classification performance in ultra-low-replication screening workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高通量筛选 (HTS) 中单重复测量导致数据极度稀疏、传统机器学习分类指标难以估计的问题，提出一个基于严格标准化均数差 (SSMD) 的模型化框架。在 Gaussian 等方差假设下，作者推导出 SSMD 与 Youden 最优灵敏度和特异度、以及预设特异度下灵敏度之间的闭式关系，并利用非中心 t 分布给出显式估计量和精确置信区间，即使只有单重复也能使用。作者在包含约 22,000 个单重复测量的丙型肝炎病毒 siRNA 筛选中展示，SSMD、AUROC 与基于灵敏度的阈值可产生等价且可解释的命中集。
Motivation: HTS 初筛通常每个测试物质只有单次重复，数据极度稀疏，使得灵敏度、特异度和 AUROC 等常规机器学习性能指标难以可靠估计，因为它们需要足够大的有标注样本。
Method: 提出模型化框架，在 Gaussian 等方差假设下推导 SSMD 与多种分类性能指标之间的闭式关系，得到显式估计量，并借助非中心 t 分布构造精确置信区间，适用于单重复实验设计。
Result: 在约 22,000 个单重复测量的 HCV siRNA 筛选中，SSMD、AUROC 和灵敏度阈值产生的命中集等价且可解释；理论上还指出，与样本量增大时趋近于 1 的经典统计功效不同，SSMD 导出的灵敏度收敛到反映两组真实分离程度的有限总体值。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作衔接了经典 HTS 统计学与机器学习评估理论，为极低重复次数的筛选流程提供了统计上严谨且可复现的分类性能估计方式。

papers.title: Enhanced Real-Time 6-DOF Extended Reality Catheter Tracking for Evaluating Potential Improvement in Efficiency, Precision, and Depth Perception for Cardiac Interventions
papers.abstract_en: Despite advances in 3D ultrasound, most percutaneous cardiac interventions still rely on 2D visualization, limiting depth perception and spatial understanding. To address this challenge, we developed an Extended Reality (XR)-based platform that enables real-time six-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) catheter tracking and visualization within a patient-specific 3D heart model. The system combines a custom machine-vision algorithm for 5-DOF catheter tracking with a 3D-printed electromechanical encoder that measures catheter roll, providing complete 6-DOF motion reconstruction. In a proof-of-concept study, 20 novice medical students navigated an intracardiac echocardiography (ICE) catheter to six anatomical targets using either immersive 3D visualization or a conventional 2D cathlab-style view. Participants in the 3D condition completed the task in 54.6 seconds and traveled 1,939 mm on average, compared with 267.5 seconds and 7,854 mm in the 2D condition. Therefore, the XR-based 3D system was more than 5x faster and required ~5x less catheter travel. The 3D mode also improved targeting precision and reduced performance variability. Participants consistently rated immersive visualization higher for accuracy, speed, usability, and clinical value. Kinematic analysis showed smoother depth-axis navigation in 3D, whereas 2D users relied on repeated corrective movements. These findings demonstrate that XR-based visualization can substantially improve procedural training efficiency, precision, and motor control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于扩展现实 (XR) 的实时六自由度 (6-DOF) 导管追踪平台，在患者特异性 3D 心脏模型中实现导管可视化。系统结合自研机器视觉算法进行 5-DOF 追踪，并用 3D 打印机电编码器测量导管 roll，从而重构完整 6-DOF 运动。在 20 名新手医学生的概念验证研究中，3D 沉浸式可视化相比传统 2D 导管室视图显著更快、所需导管行程更少，并提高了靶向精度。
Motivation: 尽管 3D 超声已有进展，多数经皮心脏介入仍依赖 2D 可视化，导致深度感知和空间理解受限，影响操作效率与精度。
Method: 构建 XR 平台，用定制机器视觉算法实现 5-DOF 导管追踪，配合 3D 打印机电编码器测量 roll 以补足 6-DOF 运动重构；随后在概念验证中让受试者使用沉浸式 3D 或传统 2D 视图完成心内超声心动图 (ICE) 导管导航任务。
Result: 20 名新手医学生中，3D 条件下平均 54.6 秒完成导航、导管行程 1,939 mm，2D 条件下为 267.5 秒和 7,854 mm；3D 模式快 5 倍以上、导管行程减少约 5 倍，并改善靶向精度、降低表现变异性。运动学分析显示 3D 模式深度轴导航更平滑，而 2D 用户依赖反复纠正动作。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 XR 可视化能显著提升心脏介入培训的效率、精度和运动控制。

papers.title: NewtonGS: Physics-Structured Object-Level Neural Newtonian Dynamics for Gaussian Scene Animation
papers.abstract_en: Animating objects in a static 3D Gaussian scene requires an explicit object-level dynamic state and a controllable model of object motion. Existing dynamic Gaussian methods primarily reconstruct time-varying scenes or simulate deformation, rather than provide compact object states for direct control. To address this gap, we present NewtonGS, a physics-structured framework for object-level state rollout and Gaussian scene animation. NewtonGS represents each object with a 22-dimensional state covering pose, linear and angular velocity, anisotropic scale and its rate, mass, and contact properties. Its Gaussian Neural Newtonian Dynamics (Gaussian-NND) model combines analytic translation, quaternion kinematics, gravity, damping, and scale-restoration dynamics with learned continuous and contact residuals. A discrete event map handles floor contact. Predicted poses and scales define a shared affine transformation that updates the means and covariances of all Gaussians associated with each object. We construct two procedurally generated datasets: State-32 for state-rollout evaluation and Gaussian-32 for state-to-Gaussian transformation. On both the in-distribution and velocity-range-shift splits of State-32, NewtonGS achieves lower trajectory RMSE, final displacement error, and velocity RMSE than five analytic baselines. Experiments on Gaussian-32 further demonstrate effective conversion from predicted states to animated Gaussian objects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NewtonGS，一个面向物体级状态滚动与高斯场景动画的物理结构化框架。它将每个物体表示为 22 维状态（包含位姿、线/角速度、各向异性尺度及其变化率、质量与接触属性），并用 Gaussian Neural Newtonian Dynamics（Gaussian-NND）组合解析动力学与学习到的连续和接触残差来预测状态变化。预测的位姿和尺度定义共享仿射变换，更新对象关联的所有高斯的均值与协方差。在程序化生成的 State-32 与 Gaussian-32 数据集上，该方法在状态滚动和状态到高斯的转换上均取得有效结果。
Motivation: 现有动态高斯方法主要重构时变场景或模拟形变，无法提供紧凑的物体级动态状态以直接控制物体运动，本文针对这一空白提出可提供显式物体状态并支持可控动画的框架。
Method: 为每个物体定义 22 维状态向量；Gaussian-NND 模型结合解析平移、四元数运动学、重力、阻尼与尺度恢复动力学，并加入学习的连续和接触残差；使用离散事件图处理地板接触；预测的位姿和尺度通过共享仿射变换同时更新所有相关高斯的均值与协方差。
Result: 在 State-32 的分布内与速度范围偏移两种划分上，NewtonGS 相比五个解析基线获得更低的轨迹 RMSE、最终位移误差和速度 RMSE；在 Gaussian-32 上验证了从预测状态到动画高斯对象的有效转换。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过紧凑的物体状态与物理结构化的动力学模型，实现了对 3D 高斯场景中物体动画的直接控制，并为状态滚动与高斯动画提供了可评估的数据集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LIRA: Local Cross-Layer Information Routing for Vision-Language-Action Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models transform representations from pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) into robot actions, yet the interface that routes intermediate VLM features into action decoders remains underexplored. Existing designs either expose only a narrow part of the representation hierarchy or rigidly match each decoder block to one VLM layer, restricting access to complementary task evidence across depths. We introduce LIRA, a local cross-layer action-conditioning mechanism that formulates VLM-to-action conditioning as depth-aware information routing. LIRA operates on task-token features and LIRA Query features derived from intermediate VLM states, then assigns each Parallel Fusion Block a depth-aligned local window centered on its corresponding VLM layer. Parallel Fusion Blocks aggregate neighboring LIRA Query features and integrate them with task-token features and proprioceptive inputs before action prediction. This routing interface leaves the backbone architecture, action decoder, and supervised training recipe unchanged. Across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D, and real-world manipulation, LIRA improves the principal aggregate metrics over the VLA-Adapter baseline under the same 0.5B-parameter configuration. In zero-shot transfer to LIBERO-Plus, LIRA increases average success from 59.1% to 78.0%, an 18.9-point gain indicating improved robustness under controlled distribution shifts.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance of the paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LIRA，一种用于视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型解码的局部跨层信息路由机制，将中间 VLM 特征路由到动作解码器。LIRA 操作于任务 token 特征和由中间 VLM 状态导出的 LIRA Query 特征，为每个 Parallel Fusion Block 分配深度对齐的局部窗口，并集成邻近特征与本体感觉输入。在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、CALVIN ABC→D 和真实世界操作中，LIRA 在相同 0.5B 参数配置下相比 VLA-Adapter 基线提升主要聚合指标，零样本迁移到 LIBERO-Plus 时平均成功率从 59.1% 提升到 78.0%。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型把预训练 VLM 特征转换成机器人动作，但中间 VLM 特征到动作解码器的路由接口研究不足：现有设计要么只暴露表征层次的一小部分，要么将每个解码器块与单个 VLM 层刚性匹配，限制了跨深度互补任务证据的访问。
Method: 提出 LIRA，一种局部跨层动作条件化机制，将 VLM 到动作的条件化表述为深度感知的信息路由。它基于任务 token 特征和从中间 VLM 状态导出的 LIRA Query 特征，为每个 Parallel Fusion Block 分配以其对应 VLM 层为中心的深度对齐局部窗口；Parallel Fusion Block 聚合邻近 LIRA Query 特征，并在动作预测前与任务 token 特征和本体感觉输入集成。该接口不改变骨干架构、动作解码器和监督训练流程。
Result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、CALVIN ABC→D 和真实世界操作上，LIRA 在相同 0.5B 参数配置下相比 VLA-Adapter 基线改善了主要聚合指标。到 LIBERO-Plus 的零样本迁移中，平均成功率从 59.1% 提升到 78.0%，提升 18.9 个百分点，表明在受控分布偏移下鲁棒性提高。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，深度感知的局部跨层路由能够在保持骨干、解码器和训练流程不变的前提下提升 VLA 解码性能与分布偏移鲁棒性；代码和模型检查点将在论文接收后发布。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 LIRA，一种用于视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型解码的局部跨层信息路由机制，将中间 VLM 特征路由到动作解码器。LIRA 操作于任务 token 特征和由中间 VLM 状态导出的 LIRA Query 特征，为每个 Parallel Fusion Block 分配深度对齐的局部窗口，并集成邻近特征与本体感觉输入。在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、CALVIN ABC→D 和真实世界操作中，LIRA 在相同 0.5B 参数配置下相比 VLA-Adapter 基线提升主要聚合指标，零样本迁移到 LIBERO-Plus 时平均成功率从 59.1% 提升到 78.0%。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型把预训练 VLM 特征转换成机器人动作，但中间 VLM 特征到动作解码器的路由接口研究不足：现有设计要么只暴露表征层次的一小部分，要么将每个解码器块与单个 VLM 层刚性匹配，限制了跨深度互补任务证据的访问。
summary_sections.method: 提出 LIRA，一种局部跨层动作条件化机制，将 VLM 到动作的条件化表述为深度感知的信息路由。它基于任务 token 特征和从中间 VLM 状态导出的 LIRA Query 特征，为每个 Parallel Fusion Block 分配以其对应 VLM 层为中心的深度对齐局部窗口；Parallel Fusion Block 聚合邻近 LIRA Query 特征，并在动作预测前与任务 token 特征和本体感觉输入集成。该接口不改变骨干架构、动作解码器和监督训练流程。
summary_sections.result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、CALVIN ABC→D 和真实世界操作上，LIRA 在相同 0.5B 参数配置下相比 VLA-Adapter 基线改善了主要聚合指标。到 LIBERO-Plus 的零样本迁移中，平均成功率从 59.1% 提升到 78.0%，提升 18.9 个百分点，表明在受控分布偏移下鲁棒性提高。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明，深度感知的局部跨层路由能够在保持骨干、解码器和训练流程不变的前提下提升 VLA 解码性能与分布偏移鲁棒性；代码和模型检查点将在论文接收后发布。

papers.title: Scaling Inherently Interpretable Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Interpretability is often treated as a tax on capability: language models are trained as opaque systems, then explained after the fact, with methods whose reliability is difficult to establish. In this work, we challenge this premise. Rather than reverse-engineering a model, we make interpretability a constraint of the training pipeline, optimized alongside the language modeling objective. Across three orders of magnitude of compute, on both autoregressive and diffusion language models, interpretability scales with capability rather than against it. Surprisingly, model representations become more disentangled and aligned with human-understandable concepts with scale. We instantiate the training-time recipe with Steerling-8B, a diffusion language model with a causal attention mask. For any group of generated tokens, Steerling-8B attributes the output to relevant input tokens, human-understandable concepts, and training data. This enables closed-loop intervention: diagnose an output through its concept or feature attribution, retrieve similar training data, and correct the behavior through concept steering without retraining. Steerling-8B remains competitive with open peer models trained on substantially 2-16x more compute, suggesting a different scaling paradigm: interpretability can be designed into training, and it improves with scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出把可解释性直接作为训练目标之一来优化，而不是在模型训练完成后再做事后解释。作者在自回归和扩散两类语言模型、跨越三个数量级的计算量上验证，可解释性随规模提升而非下降，表征变得更解耦并与人类可理解概念对齐。具体实例是 Steerling-8B，一个带因果注意力掩码的扩散语言模型，可为任意一组生成 token 提供对输入 token、概念和训练数据的归因，并支持无重训的概念引导纠正。
Motivation: 现有可解释性通常被视为能力的代价：模型先以黑箱方式训练，再用可靠性难以验证的方法事后解释。本文试图挑战这一前提，把可解释性变成训练管线的约束，与语言建模目标一起优化。
Method: 将可解释性纳入训练目标，在自回归和扩散语言模型以及多个计算规模上统一验证。Steerling-8B 采用带因果注意力掩码的扩散语言模型，训练即具备归因能力，使生成结果可溯源到输入 token、人类可理解概念与训练数据，从而形成诊断、检索相似训练数据和概念引导 (concept steering) 的闭环干预。
Result: 摘要报告，在三个数量级的计算规模上，可解释性与能力同步提升，模型表征更解耦且与人类概念对齐；Steerling-8B 与使用 2-16 倍计算量训练的开源同级模型相比仍具竞争力。
Conclusion: 作者认为可解释性可以被设计进训练流程并随规模增强，而不是与能力此消彼长；这指向一种不同的扩展范式，即训练时内建的、随规模改善的可解释性。

papers.title: Weather- and Location-Aware Agentic Dining Recommendation: Leveraging LLM World Knowledge for Region-Sensitive Contextual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Context-aware recommender systems have long recognized that factors such as location, time, and weather shape where and what people choose to eat. Existing weather-aware food and point-of-interest recommenders, however, typically treat weather generically -- mapping conditions to preferences through hand-crafted rules or specially trained context models -- and do not capture that the culturally appropriate response to weather is itself region-specific: a rainy evening calls for hot tea and fried snacks in one culinary culture and for very different comfort food in another. Encoding such weather-by-region-by-cuisine interactions as explicit rules or training data is brittle and does not scale. We present a weather- and location-aware agentic dining-recommendation system that takes a different approach: a large language model (LLM) orchestrates tools for location and weather retrieval and then reasons in natural language over the combined context, drawing on the cultural and culinary world knowledge already latent in the model to produce region-sensitive, weather-appropriate recommendations without per-region rule tables or specialized training. We describe the agent architecture, the tool-orchestration flow (Google location services and a weather service feeding an OpenAI LLM), and the reasoning mechanism, and we report on a working prototype that was implemented and briefly deployed end-to-end. We discuss design trade-offs -- cost, latency, ambiguity handling, and fallbacks -- and we are explicit about limitations, including the absence of a formal user study and the risk of cultural stereotyping in locality-based inference. The contribution is architectural: a simple, extensible pattern for incorporating environmental and cultural context into agentic recommendation through LLM reasoning rather than engineered rules.
papers.comment: 5 pages. An agentic LLM system that reasons over combined location and weather context for region-sensitive dining recommendation. Working prototype implemented and briefly deployed end-to-end
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个天气与位置感知的智能体餐饮推荐系统：由大语言模型 (LLM) 编排位置检索和天气检索工具，再对合并后的上下文进行自然语言推理，利用模型内隐的文化与烹饪世界知识给出区域敏感、符合天气的推荐，而不依赖按区域维护的规则表或专门训练。作者描述了智能体架构、工具编排流程（Google 位置服务与天气服务接入 OpenAI LLM）以及推理机制，并报告了一个已实现并短期端到端部署的工作原型。
Motivation: 现有天气感知的食品与兴趣点推荐通常把天气当作泛化信号，通过手工规则或专门训练的上下文模型映射到用户偏好，无法处理“同一天气在不同饮食文化中有不同恰当回应”这种天气-地域-菜系交互；把这些交互编码为显式规则或训练数据既脆弱又难以扩展。
Method: 采用与规则工程相反的智能体方案：LLM 作为编排者调用位置与天气检索工具，然后在自然语言中综合推理天气与位置上下文，依赖模型已有的文化世界知识产生推荐；整体是一个简单、可扩展的架构模式。
Result: 摘要没有给出定量实验结果，只报告工作原型已实现并短期端到端部署；论文讨论了成本、延迟、歧义处理和回退机制等设计权衡，并明确承认缺少正式用户研究以及基于地域推断可能带来的文化刻板印象风险。
Conclusion: 作者将贡献定位为架构性的：用 LLM 推理而非工程化规则来把环境与文化上下文纳入智能体推荐，并明确列出原型验证有限与潜在偏见等局限。

papers.title: Distribution-Free Conformal Prediction for Steel Fatigue Strength: Marginal Validity Is Not Enough
papers.abstract_en: Predicting fatigue failure in steel components experimentally is costly because it requires testing across multiple compositions and processing conditions. This has spurred research on data-driven prediction models. Studies using the NIMS MatNavi steel fatigue dataset often report high point-prediction accuracy but rely on aggregate error metrics, leaving uncertainty about the reliability of individual predictions and whether accuracy is consistent across the fatigue-strength spectrum. This paper is the first to apply conformal prediction to steel fatigue strength, comparing five interval-construction methods across 50 independent data splits and distinguishing marginal coverage from coverage within specific sub-regions of the predicted property. A gradient-boosting point model achieves an R^2 of 0.976 +/- 0.009 and a mean absolute error of 18.3 +/- 2.3 MPa. Split-conformal prediction provides valid marginal coverage (0.918) but drops to 0.755 in the highest-strength quartile, where design margins are most critical, a pattern also observed with a Gaussian process baseline. A cross-fitted, normalized conformal method restores near-uniform coverage across all quartiles (0.869-0.938) without a significant increase in interval width, by scaling the interval based on a cross-fitted estimate of local prediction difficulty rather than using a single global width. Diagnostic analysis traces the residual gap in the highest-strength quartile to elevated residual variance (2.7x the pooled Q1-Q3 level) rather than a systematic bias, situating the shortfall against a proven distribution-free limit on exact conditional coverage. Marginal coverage claims for ML-based fatigue-strength predictions can conceal systematic unreliability precisely where engineering decisions are most risky; therefore, conditional coverage should be routinely assessed alongside marginal coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将保形预测 (conformal prediction) 应用于钢材疲劳强度预测，使用 NIMS MatNavi 钢材疲劳数据集，比较五种区间构造方法在 50 次独立数据划分下的表现，并区分边际覆盖率与预测属性特定子区域内的覆盖率。梯度提升点模型取得 R^2 = 0.976 ± 0.009、MAE = 18.3 ± 2.3 MPa；split-conformal 方法边际覆盖有效 (0.918) 但在最高强度四分位降至 0.755，而一种交叉拟合归一化保形方法可将各四分位覆盖率恢复到近均匀水平 (0.869–0.938)，且不显著增加区间宽度。
Motivation: 钢材疲劳失效的实验预测成本高昂，数据驱动模型常以聚合误差指标报告高精度，但个体预测的可靠性和跨疲劳强度谱的精度一致性未知；边际覆盖率可能掩盖工程决策最危险区域内的系统性不可靠。
Method: 对比五种区间构造方法，包括 split-conformal 预测、高斯过程基线和交叉拟合归一化保形方法；后者根据交叉拟合的局部预测难度估计来缩放区间宽度，而非使用单一全局宽度，并在 50 次独立数据划分上评估边际覆盖率与各强度四分位内的条件覆盖。
Result: 梯度提升点模型 R^2 为 0.976 ± 0.009，MAE 为 18.3 ± 2.3 MPa；split-conformal 边际覆盖为 0.918，但最高强度四分位降至 0.755，高斯过程基线也有类似模式；交叉拟合归一化方法将四分位覆盖率恢复至 0.869–0.938 且区间宽度无显著增加。诊断显示最高强度四分位的残余差距源于残差方差升高 (为 Q1–Q3 合并水平的 2.7 倍) 而非系统性偏差。
Conclusion: 基于 ML 的疲劳强度预测的边际覆盖声明可能掩盖高风险工程区域内的系统性不可靠，因此应常规性地将条件覆盖评估与边际覆盖评估并列进行；该不足还与关于精确条件覆盖的 proven distribution-free limit 相关。

papers.title: MAGIC-SSCIL: Manifold Anchoring and Geometric Incremental Calibration for Semi-Supervised Class Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised Class Incremental Learning (SSCIL) is a severe challenge for neural networks, and it is hardest in the exemplar-free setting where no past data may be stored. Existing methods forget catastrophically due to feature drift, and their pseudo-labels become increasingly unreliable as the label space grows. In this paper, we propose MAGIC (Manifold Anchoring and Geometric Incremental Calibration), a framework that stabilizes plasticity without storing exemplars. MAGIC's design centers on two components. The first is Soft-Weighted Geometry Calibration (SWGC), which uses graph-based label propagation on the learner's plastic feature space to weight and calibrate class means and variances computed on the frozen backbone; from these calibrated Gaussians, we sample phantom features that stand in for data from previous tasks. The second is a Geometric Structural Alignment (GSA) objective that preserves representation topology by matching the relational structure of student and teacher heads and aligning feature anchors with the fixed classifier prototypes, locking the orientation of the feature space. Together, these constraints keep the adapter from drifting, so geometric relations between classes remain stable as new classes arrive. We implement MAGIC with a frozen ResNet-18 backbone and a learnable plastic adapter. Across CIFAR-100, CUB-200, and ImageNet-R, at label ratios of 1%, 5%, and 10%, MAGIC improves average incremental accuracy over most of the supervised CIL methods equipped with FixMatch and native SSCIL baselines; the largest gains occur in the fine-grained, low-label setting, where confidence thresholding fails most clearly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAGIC，一种面向无样本 (exemplar-free) 半监督类增量学习 (SSCIL) 的框架，通过软加权几何校准与几何结构对齐来缓解特征漂移和伪标签不可靠问题。方法使用冻结的 ResNet-18 骨干和可学习的塑性适配器，在不存储旧数据的情况下从校准后的高斯分布中采样幻影特征 (phantom features)。在 CIFAR-100、CUB-200 和 ImageNet-R 上以 1%、5%、10% 标签比例进行实验，MAGIC 的平均增量精度优于多数配备 FixMatch 的监督 CIL 基线和原生 SSCIL 基线，尤其在细粒度低标签场景增益最大。
Motivation: 半监督类增量学习在无样本设置下最为困难，因为无法存储任何旧数据，已有方法因特征漂移而灾难性遗忘，且随着标签空间增长，伪标签的可靠性持续下降。
Method: MAGIC 包含两个核心组件：一是软加权几何校准 (SWGC)，在可塑特征空间上用基于图的标签传播来加权并校准冻结骨干上计算的类均值和方差，再由此采样幻影特征代表旧任务数据；二是几何结构对齐 (GSA) 目标，通过匹配学生与教师头的关系结构、将特征锚点对齐到固定分类器原型来锁定特征空间方向。整体由冻结的 ResNet-18 骨干加可学习适配器实现。

papers.title: LAVE: Latent Visual Evidence-Enhanced Planning for Video Tool-use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-video understanding requires models to efficiently acquire and reuse sparse visual evidence from long and redundant video streams. Recent video tool-use agents address this challenge by iteratively invoking visual Tools at different temporal scales, but their Tool-Planner communication typically relies on textual observations. Such text-only interfaces provide lossy summaries of Tool computations, causing previously computed visual evidence not verbalized to be discarded and unavailable for subsequent planning. We identify this limitation as the Tool observation bottleneck and propose Latent Visual Evidence-Enhanced Planning (LAVE), a training-free framework for reusing latent visual evidence from completed Tool calls. LAVE introduces a dual-channel observation interface: the visible channel preserves the original textual trajectory, while the latent channel stores pre-verbal visual updates with their Tool roles, source-frame timestamps, and visual locations. During planning, LAVE retrieves evidence relevant to the current Planner state but not covered by textual observations, and integrates it through bounded timestamp-aligned latent updates with entropy-constrained frame-time routing. This enables video agents to reuse existing visual computation without additional training, frame replay, or modifications to the original orchestration. Extensive experiments on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and CG-Bench show that LAVE consistently improves video tool-use agents across backbones. Under a comparable frame budget, LAVE improves the Video-MME overall score by 3.76 points over the strongest baseline, demonstrating the effectiveness of latent visual evidence reuse for multi-step video-agent planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LAVE (Latent Visual Evidence-Enhanced Planning)，一个免训练的框架，用于在视频工具型智能体中复用已完成 Tool 调用的潜在视觉证据。LAVE 设计双通道观测接口：可见通道保留原始文本轨迹，潜在通道存储带 Tool 角色、源帧时间戳和视觉位置的预言语视觉更新；规划时检索文本观测未覆盖但与当前 Planner 状态相关的证据，并通过带熵约束帧时间路由的限界时间戳对齐潜在更新来整合。在 Video-MME、LongVideoBench 和 CG-Bench 上的实验表明，该方法能在不额外训练、不重放帧、不修改原始编排的情况下一致提升多种骨干下的视频工具智能体性能。
Motivation: 长视频理解中视频工具型智能体需要在冗长冗余的视频流中获取和复用稀疏视觉证据，但 Tool 与 Planner 之间的通信通常依赖文本观测。文本只是 Tool 计算的有损摘要，未被言语化的视觉证据会被丢弃，形成所谓的 Tool 观测瓶颈，影响后续规划。
Method: 提出 LAVE，一种免训练框架，通过双通道观测接口解决该瓶颈：可见通道维持原始文本轨迹，潜在通道保存预言语视觉更新及其 Tool 角色、源帧时间戳和视觉位置。规划时检索与当前 Planner 状态相关但文本未覆盖的证据，并通过带熵约束的帧时间路由 (entropy-constrained frame-time routing) 进行限界时间戳对齐的潜在更新。
Result: 在 Video-MME、LongVideoBench 和 CG-Bench 上的广泛实验显示，LAVE 在不同骨干网络上一致提升视频工具智能体性能；在可比帧预算下，LAVE 使 Video-MME 总体得分比最强基线提高 3.76 点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，潜在视觉证据的复用无需额外训练、帧重放或修改原有编排，即可增强多步视频智能体规划，验证了该框架对视频工具型智能体的有效性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ComplexityWorld: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Verifiable Visual Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have made rapid progress in visual perception and increasingly support real-world tasks that depend on images. Many such tasks, however, require more than rec- ognizing what an image contains: a model must use visual evidence to make a complete decision whose parts jointly satisfy global constraints. We introduce COMPLEXITYWORLD, a benchmark of 390 tasks across 39 domain-inspired visual worlds and 29 decision categories. Each task is generated from a hidden structured specification, rendered as a visual scene, and scored by an exe- cutable verifier that accepts any feasible solution. Under direct inference, all evaluated models ex- cept GPT-5.6-Sol remain below 40% verifier ac- ceptance rate (VAR), while GPT-5.6-Sol reaches 75.6%. Performance improves substantially when the same decision information is made explicit in structured form, yet varies sharply across equiva- lent visual presentations. Agent scaffolds provide smaller, model-dependent gains. Together, these results reveal a persistent visual-to-decision bot- tleneck that additional inference alone does not remove.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 COMPLEXITYWORLD，一个用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）可验证视觉决策能力的基准，包含 39 个领域视觉世界、29 个决策类别下的 390 个任务。每个任务由隐藏的结构化规范生成并渲染为视觉场景，由可执行验证器（executable verifier）接受任意可行解来打分。直接推理下，除 GPT-5.6-Sol（75.6% VAR）外所有受测模型验证器接受率（VAR）低于 40%；当决策信息以显式结构化形式给出时性能大幅提升，但等价视觉呈现之间差异明显，智能体脚手架仅带来较小且依赖模型的增益。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 评估多聚焦于图像内容识别，而许多真实任务要求模型利用视觉证据做出各部分共同满足全局约束的完整决策；缺乏可验证、可打分的基准来衡量这类视觉到决策的能力。
Method: 构建 COMPLEXITYWORLD 基准：任务由隐藏的结构化规范生成、渲染为视觉场景，并用可执行验证器对任意可行解进行评分。评估设置包括直接推理、将相同决策信息显式结构化、以及智能体脚手架（agent scaffolds）。
Result: 直接推理下所有受测模型除 GPT-5.6-Sol（VAR 75.6%）外均低于 40% VAR；显式结构化决策信息可使性能显著提升，但等价视觉呈现之间性能波动很大，智能体脚手架仅带来较小且依赖模型的增益。
Conclusion: 实验揭示了一种持续的视觉到决策瓶颈（visual-to-decision bottleneck），仅靠增加推理无法消除，说明需要进一步研究如何让模型从视觉证据中导出满足全局约束的决策。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RouteGuard: Certifying Routing Gain in LLM Multi-Agent Systems When Complementarity Is Not Enough
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems route among model-backed advisors, yet a deployer rarely knows before shipping whether routing will help at all. Prevailing routers optimize a gate's AUC and presume that advisor complementarity suffices. We show that neither determines the deployable gain. We introduce RouteGuard, a deployment-certification framework. Routing gain decomposes as $G = πΔ_E$, and the achievable gain is governed by a conditional-regret functional $Φ$, not by AUC. A finite-sample certification bracket comes with a matching Le Cam lower bound, constant-sharp over the fixed-activity class, and a robustness phase transition. On two benchmarks the framework acts as a guardrail. On RouterBench (11 cross-family models) the verdict depends on the sampling unit: the protocol certifies a gain over GPT-4 under prompt-level sampling and withholds it under workload-cluster resampling, because the gain rests on 3 of 86 workload cells. On OpenRCA (three Gemini advisors) the advisors are statistically redundant: the realized oracle sits at or below the independence baseline in all pools we tested (221 RouterBench pools and three OpenRCA distributions), so the protocol correctly refuses to certify. A pre-registered semi-synthetic control confirms calibration: the protocol certifies a genuine gain once $m \ge m^\star$ and does not certify a true null. Code and frozen artifacts will be released with the published version.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RouteGuard，一个面向 LLM 多智能体系统中路由收益的部署前认证框架。作者证明路由器的 AUC 与顾问之间的互补性 (complementarity) 都不能决定可部署的路由增益，并将路由增益分解为 G = πΔ_E，指出可实现增益由条件遗憾泛函 Φ 控制。框架给出有限样本认证区间、匹配的 Le Cam 下界以及鲁棒性相变，并在 RouterBench 与 OpenRCA 两个基准上作为守门机制运作。
Motivation: 部署者在上线前通常无法知道多智能体路由是否真的能带来收益；现有路由器只优化门控的 AUC，并默认顾问互补性足够，但作者表明这两者都不能决定可部署增益，因此需要一种认证框架来事前判断路由是否值得部署。
Method: 引入部署认证框架 RouteGuard：将路由增益分解为 G = πΔ_E，并提出条件遗憾泛函 Φ 作为可实现增益的控制量；构造有限样本认证括号，配有在固定活动类上常数尖锐的 Le Cam 下界，并分析鲁棒性相变。认证协议在 RouterBench 和 OpenRCA 上测试，并通过预注册的半合成控制实验验证校准性。
Result: 在 RouterBench（11 个跨族模型）上，认证结论取决于采样单元：提示级采样下认证了对 GPT-4 的增益，而工作负载簇重采样下拒绝认证，因为增益仅来自 86 个工作负载单元中的 3 个。在 OpenRCA（三个 Gemini 顾问）上，顾问统计上冗余：所有测试池（221 个 RouterBench 池和三个 OpenRCA 分布）中可实现 oracle 处于或低于独立基线，协议因此正确拒绝认证。预注册半合成控制显示，协议在 m ≥ m* 时认证真实增益，且不认证真实零假设。
Conclusion: 作者强调路由收益必须通过部署认证来把关，仅凭 AUC 或互补性不足以判断可部署增益；RouteGuard 可作为部署前的守门机制。代码与冻结工件将在出版版本发布。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Predictive Failure Detection in Network Hardware Using Thermal Imaging and Deep Learning with Sensor Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Unplanned network hardware malfunctions can interrupt services and result in expensive downtime in data centers. A deep learning-based predictive maintenance strategy is presented that utilizes thermal imaging and power sensor data to detect early indicators of equipment breakdown in routers, switches, and servers. A simulated dataset was generated comprising annotated thermal pictures and power readings indicative of three operating states: Normal, Warning, and Critical. Three ImageNet-pretrained convolutional neural network (CNN) models ResNet-50, InceptionV3, and VGG16 were assessed together with a multi-modal CNN-LSTM fusion model that integrates visual and sensor time-series information. Experiments were performed with and without pre-processing procedures, including region-of-interest (ROI) extraction and normalization. In the absence of pre-processing, CNNs attained moderate accuracy (e.g., ResNet-50 at 52%), but ROI-based pre-processing significantly enhanced performance (ResNet-50 accuracy reaching 91%). The CNN-LSTM model attained the greatest accuracy of 94%, with precision and recall approaching 95%, illustrating the effectiveness of multi-modal fusion. The results validate that domain-specific pre-processing and sensor fusion substantially improve early failure prediction, providing a potential foundation for proactive maintenance of network hardware through non-intrusive monitoring.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于深度学习的预测性维护策略，利用热成像与功率传感器数据检测路由器、交换机、服务器等网络硬件的早期故障迹象。研究在包含 Normal、Warning、Critical 三种运行状态的模拟数据集上评估了 ResNet-50、InceptionV3、VGG16 以及融合视觉与传感器时间序列的多模态 CNN-LSTM 模型。结果表明，无预处理时 CNN 准确率中等（ResNet-50 为 52%），ROI 预处理后显著提升（ResNet-50 达 91%），CNN-LSTM 融合模型取得最高 94% 的准确率，精确率与召回率接近 95%。
Motivation: 数据中心中计划外的网络硬件故障会导致服务中断与高昂的停机成本，因此需要能够提前识别设备故障迹象的预测性维护方案。
Method: 采用热成像和功率传感器数据构建模拟数据集，标注三类运行状态；比较三种 ImageNet 预训练 CNN 模型（ResNet-50、InceptionV3、VGG16），并引入整合视觉与传感器时序信息的多模态 CNN-LSTM 融合模型；同时考察含与不含 ROI 提取和归一化等预处理步骤的影响。
Result: 无预处理时 CNN 准确率中等（如 ResNet-50 为 52%），基于 ROI 的预处理显著提升性能（ResNet-50 准确率达 91%）；CNN-LSTM 模型取得最高 94% 的准确率，精确率和召回率接近 95%，验证了多模态融合的有效性。
Conclusion: 领域特定的预处理与传感器融合能大幅提升早期故障预测能力，为非侵入式监测下网络硬件主动维护提供了潜在基础；实验基于模拟数据集开展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Branch Policy Optimization for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Group-based reinforcement learning methods for multimodal large language models typically rely on trajectory-level credit assignment that applies a single advantage to all tokens in a response. However, multimodal reasoning involves substantially higher perceptual uncertainty than text-only settings, where the model must repeatedly re-examine visual information to verify intermediate interpretations, and different visual groundings can lead to divergent reasoning paths, making such uniform credit assignment particularly inadequate and causing relative advantages to progressively degenerate toward zero. To address these challenges, we propose Multi-Branch Policy Optimization (MBPO), a tree-based framework that constructs reasoning trees at vision-language decision boundaries, enabling sibling branches to explore diverse visual hypotheses and assigning segment-level credit through branch-relative advantages. We further introduce a temporal replay buffer to reuse informative segments while controlling policy staleness. Experiments on several multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that MBPO outperforms representative baselines, improving both learning signal quality and optimization efficiency. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/ShuaiLyu0110/MBPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Multi-Branch Policy Optimization (MBPO)，一种面向多模态大语言模型的树状策略优化框架，用于解决现有 group-based 强化学习在轨迹级 credit assignment 上的不足。MBPO 在视觉-语言决策边界构建推理树，让兄弟分支探索不同的视觉假设，并通过分支相对优势进行 segment 级 credit assignment，同时引入 temporal replay buffer 重复利用信息片段。实验表明，该方法在多个多模态推理基准上优于代表性基线，并提升了学习信号质量与优化效率。
Motivation: 现有基于分组的强化学习方法通常对整条响应中的所有 token 施加单一 advantage，但在多模态推理中，模型需要反复查看视觉信息以验证中间解释，不同视觉 grounding 会导致不同推理路径，这种统一的 credit assignment 不充分，且相对优势会逐渐退化到零。
Method: 提出树状框架 MBPO：在视觉-语言决策边界构建推理树，使 sibling branches 探索多样化的视觉假设；使用 branch-relative advantages 进行 segment-level credit assignment；并引入 temporal replay buffer 来复用信息片段，同时控制策略陈旧性 (policy staleness)。
Result: 在多个多模态推理基准上的实验显示，MBPO 超过代表性基线，同时改善学习信号质量和优化效率；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，通过树结构构建推理树并采用分支级相对优势进行 credit assignment，可以显著提升多模态强化学习中的学习信号质量与优化效率；代码已公开。

papers.title: From Trajectories to Evidence: Auditable Experimental Records for Industrial Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: Research agents increasingly conduct multi-round machine-learning experiments in industrial recommendation settings and retain the resulting trajectories to guide later decisions. Yet a completed trajectory is not automatically evidence: generated artifacts may be unsupported or incomplete, executed rounds may be invalid or confounded, and later modifications may obscure earlier findings. We study \textbf{trajectory-to-evidence conversion}, asking what a completed research process has actually established. We introduce an evidence-grounded framework that couples bounded verification of consequential artifacts with post-execution claim qualification. A context-isolated generate--verify--repair process checks artifacts for evidence violations and missing downstream requirements before release. After execution, validity and attribution checks consolidate evidence across rounds, qualify intervention-level claims as actionable repairs, diagnostic guards, or withheld findings, and preserve admitted claims as auditable records with explicit provenance and applicability boundaries. A hybrid LLM-assisted controller subsequently applies, defers, or rejects records based on available target evidence. Record audits characterize which claims survive qualification, while downstream diagnostics identify affirmative applicability judgment as a bottleneck for the tested controller. Across paper-to-target adaptations, later rounds often improve on the first, while final rounds frequently underperform an earlier best, exposing non-monotonic trajectory evolution. Candidates produced through the complete workflow also yielded positive online lifts relative to deployed baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究工业推荐场景中多轮机器学习实验轨迹如何转化为可审计证据的问题，提出一个证据导向框架：结合受控验证与执行后主张限定，通过上下文隔离的生成-验证-修复流程检查产物，再对跨轮次证据做有效性与归因检查，并用混合LLM辅助控制器决定是否采纳记录。摘要报告了在论文到目标适配任务上的表现、记录审计结果以及相对部署基线的在线提升。
Motivation: 研究代理保留多轮实验轨迹以指导后续决策，但完整轨迹并不能自动成为证据：生成产物可能缺乏支撑或不完整，已执行轮次可能无效或受混淆因素影响，后续修改还可能掩盖早期发现。论文聚焦轨迹到证据的转换，追问一个完成的研究过程究竟确立了哪些结论。
Method: 提出证据导向框架，包含两部分：一是对关键产物进行有界验证（bounded verification），用上下文隔离的生成-验证-修复（generate–verify–repair）流程在发布前检查证据违规和缺失的下游需求；二是执行后的主张限定（claim qualification），通过有效性与归因检查跨轮次整合证据，将干预级主张限定为可操作修复、诊断性防护或暂缓发现，并保留为带显式来源和适用边界的可审计记录。随后混合LLM辅助控制器根据目标证据应用、延迟或拒绝记录。
Result: 记录审计显示哪些主张能通过限定，下游诊断表明肯定性适用判断是所测控制器的瓶颈。在论文到目标适配任务中，后续轮次常优于第一轮，但最终轮次常不如早期最优轮次，暴露轨迹演化的非单调性；经过完整流程产生的候选相对部署基线带来正向在线提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将轨迹转换为可审计、带适用边界的证据记录，并提出验证与限定结合的工作流；同时指出轨迹质量非单调演进以及肯定性适用判断成为控制器瓶颈这两点观察。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Real-time physics inversion for retrieval of sub-pixel wildfire temperatures from VSWIR imaging spectroscopy
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we present a wildfire temperature retrieval framework for VSWIR imaging spectroscopy data, employed on data from NASA's Airborne Visible Infrared Imaging Spectrometer (AVIRIS-3). The retrieval framework utilizes a full-physics approach in which a forward model is employed to resolve both solar and emitted radiance derived from a temperature distribution and utilizes the full spectral range in the residual fit. To optimize the forward model retrieval, we use state-of-the-art nonlinear least squares methods implemented for fast convergence on the on-board GPU, allowing for estimation of effective fire temperature within flight cadence. We verify the forward model assumptions on simulated spectra with an injected thermal signature and find good agreement with an RMSE of $41.8$ Kelvin (K). We apply the retrieval over the full 2025 FireSense AVIRIS-3 campaign, totaling 168 overflights with probable active fire spectra, and demonstrate a residual radiance fit of $\leq 10\%$ across bands in the short-wave infrared (SWIR). Lastly, we verify the applicability of the retrieved posterior fire temperature parameters to generalize to space-borne imaging spectrometers such as EMIT, by retrieving at coarsened spatial resolution. We find that the posterior distribution exhibits good coverage of the underlying sub-pixel temperature range with an absolute error of $30$ K across quantiles and a mean absolute error of $27.16$ K between spatial resolutions.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于 VSWIR 成像光谱数据的野火温度反演框架，并应用于 NASA AVIRIS-3 机载数据。该方法采用全物理正演模型，同时解析太阳辐射与来自温度分布的热辐射，并在残差拟合中使用全光谱范围；通过非线性最小二乘在机载 GPU 上快速收敛，使有效火温估计可在飞行周期内完成。模拟光谱验证得到 41.8 K 的 RMSE，2025 FireSense AVIRIS-3 任务的 168 次疑似活跃火过境中 SWIR 波段残差辐射拟合不超过 10%，并在粗化空间分辨率下验证了对 EMIT 等星载成像光谱仪的适用性。
Motivation: 需要从机载 VSWIR 成像光谱测量中实时估计亚像元野火温度，以便在飞行周期内获得有效的火温信息，并检验这类反演结果能否推广到星载成像光谱仪。
Method: 采用全物理正演模型，将观测辐亮度表示为太阳辐亮度与由温度分布产生的发射辐亮度之和，并在残差拟合中使用完整光谱范围；优化使用面向机载 GPU 快速收敛的非线性最小二乘方法。
Result: 在注入热信号的模拟光谱上，反演有效火温的 RMSE 为 41.8 K；在 2025 FireSense AVIRIS-3 任务的 168 次疑似活跃火过境中，SWIR 波段残差辐亮度拟合不超过 10%；在粗化空间分辨率下，后验分布对亚像元温度范围覆盖良好，分位数绝对误差为 30 K，不同空间分辨率间的平均绝对误差为 27.16 K。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该全物理反演框架能够在飞行节奏内估计亚像元野火温度，并具备向星载成像光谱仪推广的潜力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Geometry Beats Estimated Depth: RGB-Only Multi-Camera 3D Tracking under Sim2Real
papers.abstract_en: The AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1 evaluates multi-camera 3D perception in large indoor warehouses under a synthetic-to-real (Sim2Real) setting; depth is available only for training and validation, so inference is RGB-only. We use two RGB-only routes as a controlled test of one hypothesis: that cross-view geometric consistency, not monocular depth accuracy, governs performance under Sim2Real. The first is a geometry-first pipeline: YOLO11x detection, homography lifting to the world frame, class-level 3D size priors, multi-camera fusion, world-coordinate tracking, and offline tracklet stitching. The second is estimated-depth pseudo-LiDAR: monocular depth (D4RT, Metric3D~v2) back-projected into a fused point cloud and passed to a 3D detector (V-DETR), mirroring prior point-cloud winners that used depth. The gap is decisive: geometry-first reaches 13.0 3D HOTA (51.6 LocA), whereas pseudo-LiDAR collapses to 0.12 (9.2 LocA). We trace the collapse to cross-view inconsistency of monocular depth---scale correction is necessary but not sufficient---which domain-adaptation fine-tuning does not repair within budget. Within the geometry pipeline, offline stitching is the only intervention that helps; SAHI detection, appearance Re-ID, learned lifting, RT-DETR ensembling, test-time augmentation, and domain randomization all fail to beat the baseline detector. The bottlenecks are complementary: detection quality bounds the geometry route (DetA), localization consistency bounds pseudo-LiDAR (LocA). We release a complete, reproducible RGB-only pipeline and ablation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1 的室内大仓库多相机 3D 感知任务，在 Sim2Real 设置下验证了一个假设：跨视角几何一致性比单目深度估计精度更决定性能。作者对比了两条仅 RGB 的路线：几何优先管线（YOLO11x 检测、单应性提升、类别级 3D 尺寸先验、多相机融合、世界坐标跟踪与离线轨迹拼接）和估计深度伪激光雷达管线（D4RT、Metric3D v2 反投影后交给 V-DETR）。结果表明几何优先达到 13.0 3D HOTA（51.6 LocA），而伪激光雷达仅 0.12（9.2 LocA），失败原因是单目深度跨视角不一致。
Motivation: AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1 的推理阶段仅提供 RGB 图像，深度只在训练和验证阶段可用，因此需要探索不依赖估计深度的多相机 3D 跟踪方案，并厘清跨视角几何一致性与单目深度精度各自的作用。
Method: 构建两条受控的 RGB-only 路线进行对比验证：一是几何优先管线，包含 YOLO11x 检测、单应性提升到世界坐标系、类别级 3D 尺寸先验、多相机融合、世界坐标跟踪和离线轨迹拼接；二是将单目深度（D4RT、Metric3D v2）反投影为融合点云并输入 3D 检测器 V-DETR 的伪激光雷达路线。
Result: 几何优先管线达到 13.0 3D HOTA 和 51.6 LocA，而伪激光雷达路线仅 0.12 3D HOTA 和 9.2 LocA。摘要将失败归因于单目深度的跨视角不一致，指出尺度校正是必要但不充分的；在几何管线内部，离线拼接是唯一有效的干预，SAHI 检测、外观 Re-ID、可学习提升、RT-DETR 集成、测试时增强和域随机化均未超过基线检测器。
Conclusion: 检测质量（DetA）限制几何路线的上限，定位一致性（LocA）限制伪激光雷达路线的上限，作者据此发布完整可复现的 RGB-only 管线与消融实验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Open-World Hierarchical Perception: Taxonomic Abstraction over Class-Agnostic Proposals for the Safe Handling of Out-of-Vocabulary Road Objects
papers.abstract_en: A closed-set detector for autonomous driving must assign every object one of a fixed set of labels. On an object outside that set (a horse-drawn carriage, road debris, livestock on a rural road) it can only force a confident but wrong specific label or drop the object. Prior work in this series replaced the flat label set with a hierarchical taxonomy and a runtime abstraction rule, but evaluated it only on the boxes a closed detector already produces. This paper takes the layer open-world: we place taxonomic abstraction on top of class-agnostic region proposals so objects the closed detector never boxes can still be classified or flagged; we report a feasibility study of three open-world signals (class-agnostic segmentation, appearance-based out-of-distribution scoring, monocular depth) that shows why no single 2D cue suffices and how they compose; and we run the evaluation the earlier papers could not, a ground-truth leave-classes-out benchmark on real annotated objects. Holding out seven COCO classes and classifying their 235 ground-truth crops, a flat closed head emits a confident wrong specific label 100% of the time (37% of them in the wrong super-category, e.g. an animal named as a vehicle), whereas the hierarchical layer emits zero confident wrong specific labels and safely handles 94% of the objects (a correct super-category, or an explicit UNKNOWN OBSTACLE). We are explicit that this is a safety result, not a specificity one: the correct super-category is recovered only 26% of the time and the remaining 69% are conservatively flagged unknown. The contribution is an open-world perception layer that never makes a confident categorical mistake on an out-of-vocabulary object, together with an honest account of its cost.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Third paper in a series; v1 archived at Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21593472. Code: https://github.com/freshNfunky/IE2025-Research-Paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是系列论文的第三篇，针对自动驾驶闭集检测器在词汇外（out-of-vocabulary）物体上只能给出自信但错误的特定标签或丢弃物体的问题，提出把层级分类抽象（taxonomic abstraction）放在类无关区域提议（class-agnostic region proposals）之上的开放世界感知层。研究表明，在留出七个 COCO 类、对 235 个真实标注对象进行分类的基准上，扁平闭集检测头 100% 输出错误的具体标签，而所提层级层输出零个错误的具体标签并安全处理 94% 的对象；但正确超类仅被恢复 26%，其余 69% 被保守标记为 UNKNOWN OBSTACLE。作者明确这是一个安全性结果而非特异性结果。
Motivation: 闭集检测器必须把每个目标归入固定标签集，遇到该集合之外的物体（如马车、道路杂物、牲畜）时只能强行给出自信但错误的特定标签或直接丢弃。系列前作虽把扁平标签集换成层级分类法和运行时抽象规则，但只评测了闭集检测器已产出的框，未处理从未被检测器框出的物体。
Method: 本文把层级分类抽象叠在类无关区域提议之上，使闭集检测器未框出的物体也能被分类或标记；并开展可行性研究，考察类无关分割（class-agnostic segmentation）、基于外观的分布外评分（appearance-based out-of-distribution scoring）和单目深度（monocular depth）三种开放世界信号，说明单一 2D 线索为何不足以及它们如何组合。
Result: 在留出七个 COCO 类、标注 235 个真实对象的 ground-truth leave-classes-out 基准上，扁平闭集检测头 100% 输出自信的错误具体标签（其中 37% 落到错误超类，例如把动物命名为车辆）；层级层输出零个自信的错误具体标签，安全处理 94% 的对象。但正确超类恢复率仅为 26%，其余 69% 被保守标记为 UNKNOWN OBSTACLE。
Conclusion: 论文的贡献是一个对词汇外物体从不做出自信分类错误的开放世界感知层，并如实说明其代价：正确超类恢复率低，大量对象被保守地标记为未知；该工作被明确定位为安全性（safety）结果而非特异性（specificity）结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Isotropic Assumptions: Continuity-Constrained Segmentation and GPU Morphometry for Nanoscale GBM Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Confocal microscopy of optically cleared and swelled tissue resolves complex biological structures in 3D, but such acquisitions are highly anisotropic: along the under-sampled axial direction the structure can appear discontinuous, hampering reconstruction and automated quantitative analysis. The usual remedy upsamples the axial dimension to an isotropic volume before training a segmentation model, which requires dense annotations in the upsampled space, a prohibitive labeling burden. We present an end-to-end, GPU-accelerated framework that overcomes this without additional annotations. The model is trained on the native acquisition volume; random rotation of training patches leverages the well-resolved lateral plane to supply the missing axial information, and a z-axis continuity loss keeps neighboring slices consistent. We adapt both a convolutional (3D U-Net) and a transformer (SwinUNETR) backbone, aggregate overlapping patches by Gaussian consensus, and compute point-spread-function-corrected membrane thickness by ray-surface intersection on the GPU. We apply the method to the glomerular basement membrane (GBM), a thin, highly convoluted part of the kidney's filtration barrier that grows more irregular in disease. Segmentation accuracy matches inter-expert agreement. Continuity-aware training improves reconstruction smoothness and suppresses a periodic terracing artifact at minimal accuracy cost. We quantify GBM thickness across the reconstructed 3D surface and capture disease-related thickening, enabling fully automated anisotropic 3D morphometry of biological structures without dense volumetric labels or image restoration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个端到端、GPU 加速的框架，用于各向异性（anisotropic）三维共聚焦显微图像的连续感知分割与形态测量，无需在轴向过采样或密集标注。模型在原始采集体上训练，利用随机旋转和 z 轴连续性损失，适配 3D U-Net 与 SwinUNETR 骨干并用高斯共识聚合重叠 patch。应用于肾小球基底膜（GBM）厚度测量，分割精度接近专家间一致性，并抑制周期性阶梯伪影。
Motivation: 光学清除和膨胀组织的共聚焦显微镜在轴向欠采样，导致结构看似不连续，妨碍重建与自动定量分析。常规补救是先轴向过采样到各向同性体积再训练分割模型，这需要在过采样空间中进行密集标注，标注负担过重。
Method: 在原生采集体上端到端训练，随机旋转训练 patch 利用高分辨侧向平面补充轴向缺失信息，并用 z 轴连续性损失保持相邻切片的连续性。作者适配了卷积（3D U-Net）和 Transformer（SwinUNETR）两种骨干，通过高斯共识聚合重叠 patch，并在 GPU 上用射线-表面相交（ray-surface intersection）计算经点扩散函数校正的膜厚度。
Result: 摘要报告分割精度达到专家间一致性水平；连续性感知训练改善重建平滑度，并以极小的精度代价抑制周期性阶梯伪影（terracing artifact）；该方法可量化重建 3D 表面上的 GBM 厚度，捕获与疾病相关的增厚。
Conclusion: 该方法实现无需密集体积标注或图像恢复的全自动各向异性 3D 形态测量，适用于生物结构。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Multimodal Skin Lesion Classification with Swin Transformer and Clinical Metadata Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Skin lesion classification plays an important role in supporting the early diagnosis of skin cancer. However, automated analysis remains challenging due to class imbalance, inter-class similarity, and intra-class variability in dermoscopic images. This paper proposes a multimodal classification framework that combines Swin Transformer-based image features with structured clinical metadata to improve diagnostic performance through integrated visual-context learning. Experiments on a publicly available dataset show that the proposed model achieves a test accuracy of 92.55% and a macro F1-score of 91.33%, with strong performance across minority classes. Temperature scaling is applied as a post-hoc calibration method, resulting in a reduction in expected calibration error and improving prediction reliability, while uncertainty estimation is incorporated to further assess the confidence of model predictions. Qualitative explainability analysis further shows that the model focuses on lesion regions during inference. Therefore, the results demonstrate that multimodal fusion, combined with calibration and interpretability analysis, provides an effective and trustworthy approach for automated skin lesion classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多模态皮肤病变分类框架，将 Swin Transformer 提取的图像特征与结构化临床元数据相融合，以改进皮肤镜图像的诊断性能。在公开数据集上，模型取得 92.55% 的测试准确率和 91.33% 的 macro F1-score，少数类上也表现良好；温度缩放 (temperature scaling) 被用作事后校准方法以降低期望校准误差，并引入不确定性估计与定性可解释性分析。
Motivation: 皮肤镜图像中的皮肤病变分类面临类别不平衡、类间相似性和类内变异性等挑战，导致自动化分析仍然困难，需要更可靠的诊断支持。
Method: 采用基于 Swin Transformer 的图像特征提取器，并将视觉特征与结构化临床元数据做多模态融合；训练后使用温度缩放进行概率校准，同时结合不确定性估计来评估预测置信度，并通过定性可解释性分析观察模型关注区域。
Result: 在公开数据集上达到 92.55% 的测试准确率和 91.33% 的 macro F1-score；温度缩放降低了期望校准误差 (expected calibration error)，可解释性分析显示模型在推理时聚焦于病变区域。
Conclusion: 摘要认为多模态融合结合校准和可解释性分析，为自动化皮肤病变分类提供了一种有效且可信的方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: BRACE: Taming Sharp Irregularities via Barycentric Rational Forecasting for Fast Diffusion Transformers Inference
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have demonstrated exceptional performance in high-fidelity image and video generation. To alleviate their massive computational overhead, temporal feature caching has been proposed to bypass redundant computations. However, existing cache-then-forecast methods driven by derivative-based polynomials often cause severe quality degradation under high acceleration due to unstable long-step predictions. To address this bottleneck, we propose Barycentric Rational Forecasting with Chebyshev Enhancement (BRACE). Motivated by the observation that DiT feature trajectories are globally smooth yet frequently exhibit sharp irregularities and local non-smoothness, BRACE shifts the paradigm from derivative-driven polynomial extrapolation to feature-driven rational forecasting. Specifically, it maintains a local sliding window to cache sparse historical features and leverages adapted Chebyshev weights to formulate a barycentric rational function, directly aggregating these raw features to ensure numerical stability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BRACE achieves state-of-the-art quality-efficiency trade-offs across various DiT architectures with negligible computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BRACE（Barycentric Rational Forecasting with Chebyshev Enhancement），针对 Diffusion Transformers（DiTs）推理加速中的时间特征缓存问题，将预测范式从导数驱动的多项式外推转为特征驱动的有理预测。BRACE 使用局部滑动窗口缓存稀疏历史特征，并通过适配的 Chebyshev 权重构造重心有理函数（barycentric rational function）直接聚合原始特征，以获得数值稳定性。摘要报告其在多种 DiT 架构上取得最先进的质量-效率权衡，且计算开销可忽略。
Motivation: 现有基于导数驱动多项式的 cache-then-forecast 方法在高加速比下会出现长步预测不稳定，导致生成质量严重下降；而 DiT 特征轨迹虽全局平滑，却常呈现尖锐不规则与局部非平滑，需要更稳定的预测方式来利用历史特征。
Method: BRACE 采用特征驱动的有理预测：维护局部滑动窗口缓存稀疏历史特征，用适配的 Chebyshev 权重构造重心有理函数，直接聚合原始特征，从而避免导数驱动的多项式外推带来的数值不稳定。
Result: 摘要称 BRACE 在多种 DiT 架构上实现了最先进的质量-效率权衡（state-of-the-art quality-efficiency trade-offs），且额外计算开销可忽略不计；未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调从导数驱动多项式外推转向特征驱动有理预测，可以更好地处理 DiT 特征轨迹中的尖锐不规则性，为快速 Diffusion Transformers 推理提供了一种数值稳定的新途径。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: A Review of Vision-Based Vehicle Detection for UAV-Based Traffic Monitoring: Experimental Insights and Future Directions
papers.abstract_en: In Intelligent Transportation System (ITS), unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based surveillance offers an innovative solution to traffic surveillance with wide coverage and real-time data collection capabilities. In comparison to fixed ground-based infrastructure, UAVs are able to respond to dynamic traffic but present challenges such as vehicle detection at varying altitudes, compensation for motion-induced image variations and efficient processing of high-resolution images. Deep learning has been largely beneficial on improving the detection accuracy; however, for practical deployment, a critical assessment of the accuracy, latency, and harmonization with current transportation systems needs to be carefully considered. This survey reviews recent advancements in the UAV-based traffic monitoring, with a primary focus being deep neural network models for traffic analytics in various urban settings. Three main challenges identified in the literature are ensuring compatibility with traffic control systems, achieving real-time processing to optimize traffic flow, and maintaining robust detection in different environmental conditions. Existing solutions often lack comprehensive frameworks for utilizing UAV captured data to respond to incidents and manage traffic effectively. Future research should focus on optimal detection models, edge processing, and adaptive control integration to improve the responsiveness of urban traffic management.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems (T-ITS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述，回顾基于无人机（UAV）的交通监控中视觉车辆检测的最新进展，重点关注用于不同城市环境交通分析的深度神经网络模型。作者梳理了部署时面临的精度、延迟以及与现有交通系统协调问题，并归纳出文献中的三大挑战：与交通控制系统的兼容性、实现实时处理以优化交通流、以及在不同环境条件下保持稳健检测。
Motivation: 无人机监控相比固定地面设施能覆盖更广并实时响应动态交通，但实际部署需要对检测精度、延迟以及与当前交通系统的协调进行审慎评估，现有综述缺乏面向实用化视角的系统性梳理。
Method: 采用文献综述方法，围绕基于深度神经网络的无人机交通监控研究，从应用挑战、检测模型与系统集成角度归纳现状，并指出已有解决方案往往缺少利用无人机数据响应事件并管理交通的综合框架。
Result: 识别出三个主要挑战：确保与交通控制系统的兼容性、实现实时处理以优化交通流、以及在不同环境条件下保持稳健检测；同时指出现有方案缺乏面向事件响应和交通管理的整体框架。
Conclusion: 未来研究应聚焦于最优检测模型、边缘处理（edge processing）和自适应控制集成，以提高城市交通管理的响应能力。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: COMEX: A Composition-Grounded Benchmark and Learning Framework for Explainable Aesthetic Image Cropping
papers.abstract_en: Explainable aesthetic image cropping requires not only localizing a visually pleasing crop but also explaining why it is preferred. Existing crop-and-explain methods largely treat explanation as post-hoc text generation and overlook composition, a key aesthetic factor that links crop decisions with interpretable reasoning. In this paper, we reformulate explainable aesthetic image cropping as a structured crop-composition-explanation problem. To support this setting, we introduce COMEX, a new benchmark built through image expansion and an IO-reversal pipeline. COMEX contains 33,161 quadruples, each consisting of an expanded image, a crop box, a composition category, and a composition-grounded explanation, enabling joint learning of crop localization, composition understanding, and explanation generation. We further propose a two-stage SFT+GRPO framework, where supervised fine-tuning establishes the structured output protocol and basic cropping ability, and GRPO further improves crop quality, composition prediction, and explanation faithfulness. We benchmark 15 large vision-language models and existing cropping methods on COMEX, establishing a comprehensive testbed for composition-grounded explainable aesthetic cropping. Experiments on both COMEX and prior benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and transferability of our framework, with strong performance across evaluation metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 COMEX，一个用于可解释美学图像裁剪 (explainable aesthetic image cropping) 的基准与学习框架，将任务重新定义为结构化的 裁剪框-构图-解释 (crop-composition-explanation) 问题。COMEX 通过图像扩展和 IO-reversal 流程构建，包含 33,161 个四元组（扩展图像、裁剪框、构图类别、构图驱动的解释），支持裁剪定位、构图理解与解释生成的联合学习。作者进一步提出两阶段 SFT+GRPO 框架，并在 COMEX 上评测了 15 个大视觉语言模型及现有裁剪方法。
Motivation: 现有 crop-and-explain 方法大多把解释当作事后文本生成，忽视了构图这一连接裁剪决策与可解释推理的关键美学因素；缺乏支持结构化 裁剪-构图-解释 联合学习的基准。
Method: 提出 COMEX 基准，通过图像扩展与 IO-reversal 流程生成大规模四元组；同时提出两阶段训练框架，先用监督微调 (SFT) 建立结构化输出协议和基础裁剪能力，再用 GRPO 进一步提升裁剪质量、构图预测与解释忠实度。
Result: 在 COMEX 及先前基准上的实验表明，该框架具有有效性和可迁移性，并在各评估指标上表现强劲；COMEX 作为测试平台评测了 15 个大视觉语言模型和既有裁剪方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将构图作为显式中间因素纳入可解释美学裁剪是可行且有效的，COMEX 可为构图驱动的可解释裁剪提供综合测试基准。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Latent-Frequency Validity: Fast Spectral Editing with Screened Video-VAE Transfer Operators
papers.abstract_en: Direct spectral editing in video-VAE latents can control noise, flicker, smoothness, and frequency content without a decode--filter--reencode pass. However, video VAEs may redistribute pixel-space frequency bands across latent channels, and latent edits can disrupt VAE round-trip dynamics. We introduce \emph{latent-frequency validity} (LFV), which learns a compact VAE-specific spectral response and deploys it only when it improves decoded-target fidelity without worsening round-trip drift. LFV follows a validation-selected path from a diagonal per-frequency calibrator (C1) to full channel mixing (CM), making cross-channel capacity a controllable per-edit resource. Across 544 VAE--edit cells spanning six spectral families, LFV emits 423 cheap operators: 277 are handled by C1, while 146 (34.5\% of emitted operators) require channel mixing. On the primary 120-cell radial sweep, 99/100 emitted operators pass source-video-grouped held-out evaluation. Across five additional filter families, all 323 emitted operators pass held-out evaluation. Fully frozen OpenVid-fitted operators, including the validation-selected path coefficient, pass all 20 tested CogVideoX and HunyuanVideo generated-domain cells without adaptation. The selected response matches direct latent-filter latency and is about $3\times$ faster than pixel filter--reencode. The resulting maps reveal distinct VAE regimes, including strongly channel-coupled CogVideoX responses and a sharp Open-Sora high-band stability frontier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 latent-frequency validity (LFV)，针对视频 VAE 潜空间中直接谱编辑导致的跨通道频带重分布与往返漂移问题，学习一个紧凑的、VAE 特异的谱响应，并仅在能提升解码目标保真度且不恶化往返漂移时部署。LFV 通过验证选择路径从对角逐频校准器 (C1) 过渡到全通道混合 (CM)，把跨通道容量变成可逐编辑控制的资源。在 544 个 VAE-编辑单元、六个谱族上，LFV 输出 423 个低成本算子；主径向扫描中 99/100 的发射算子通过源视频分组的留出评估，冻结的 OpenVid 拟合算子无需适配即可通过全部 20 个 CogVideoX 与 HunyuanVideo 生成域单元。
Motivation: 直接对 video-VAE 潜空间做谱编辑可以避免 decode-filter-reencode 通路，但视频 VAE 可能把像素域的频带重新分布到潜通道上，且潜编辑可能扰乱 VAE 的往返动力学，导致编辑不可靠。
Method: LFV 学习一个紧凑的 VAE 特异谱响应，并通过验证选择路径决定使用逐频对角校准器 (C1) 还是全通道混合 (CM)；只有能改善解码目标保真度且不增加往返漂移的算子才会被部署。
Result: 在 544 个 VAE-编辑单元中发射 423 个低成本算子，其中 277 个由 C1 处理，146 个（34.5%）需要通道混合；主径向扫描 120 单元中 99/100 通过留出评估，另外五个滤波族全部 323 个算子通过；冻结算子通过全部 20 个跨域单元，延迟与直接潜滤波相当，约为像素 filter-reencode 的 1/3 速度（即约 3 倍更快）。
Conclusion: LFV 提供了一种快速、可验证的潜空间谱编辑机制，将跨通道混合作为受控资源，并揭示了不同 VAE 的谱行为差异，例如 CogVideoX 的强通道耦合响应和 Open-Sora 的高频稳定边界。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Temporal Generalization in fNIRS-Based Autism Classification: A Cross-Time-Window Transfer Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a promising modality for autism spectrum disorder (ASD) classification, yet existing approaches assume temporally aligned evaluation. In practice, the optimal observation window varies across subjects due to differences in hemodynamic delay and neurovascular coupling, creating a temporal distribution shift that degrades performance. We formalize this as a \textit{cross-time-window transfer problem}, introducing a protocol that varies window length (2.5--10\,s) and offset within biological motion trials. Using topographic map representations of fNIRS recordings, we benchmark three vision architectures under two zero-shot baselines and eight adaptation strategies under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation ($N{=}124$). Key findings: (1) zero-shot cross-window accuracy is near chance (54--69\%); (2) ${\approx}5\%$ subject-specific fine-tuning recovers 90--96\%, while a subject-specific upper bound reaches 97--100\%, identifying inter-subject variability as the dominant barrier; (3) domain-adversarial and self-supervised strategies achieve 78--90\% without target-subject data; and (4) discriminative information is recoverable from windows as short as 2.5\,s. These findings provide a practical roadmap for deploying fNIRS-based ASD classifiers under realistic temporal variability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把 fNIRS 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）分类中的时间对齐假设放宽，形式化为跨时间窗迁移（cross-time-window transfer）问题，并提出一种在生物运动试次内改变窗口长度（2.5–10 秒）与偏移量的评测协议。作者使用 fNIRS 地形图表示，在留一受试者交叉验证（N=124）下基准测试了三种视觉架构、两种零样本基线和八种适配策略。主要发现包括零样本跨窗口准确率接近随机（54–69%），约 5% 的受试者特定微调可恢复至 90–96%，而域对抗与自监督策略无需目标受试者数据即可达到 78–90%，且短至 2.5 秒的窗口仍包含可判别信息。
Motivation: 现有 fNIRS 自闭症分类方法假设时间对齐的评测，但实际中最优观测窗口因受试者的血流动力学延迟和神经血管耦合差异而不同，造成时间分布偏移并损害性能。
Method: 提出跨时间窗迁移问题的正式定义与评测协议，在生物运动试次内变化窗口长度和偏移量；用 fNIRS 地形图表示，基准测试视觉架构、零样本基线与域对抗、自监督等适配策略，采用留一受试者交叉验证（N=124）。
Result: 零样本跨窗口准确率为 54–69%；约 5% 的受试者特定微调可达到 90–96%，受试者特定上界为 97–100%；域对抗和自监督策略在无目标受试者数据下达到 78–90%；2.5 秒短窗口中仍可恢复判别信息。
Conclusion: 受试者间变异性是主要障碍；上述发现为在真实时间变异性下部署 fNIRS 自闭症分类器提供了实用路线图。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文把 fNIRS 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）分类中的时间对齐假设放宽，形式化为跨时间窗迁移（cross-time-window transfer）问题，并提出一种在生物运动试次内改变窗口长度（2.5–10 秒）与偏移量的评测协议。作者使用 fNIRS 地形图表示，在留一受试者交叉验证（N=124）下基准测试了三种视觉架构、两种零样本基线和八种适配策略。主要发现包括零样本跨窗口准确率接近随机（54–69%），约 5% 的受试者特定微调可恢复至 90–96%，而域对抗与自监督策略无需目标受试者数据即可达到 78–90%，且短至 2.5 秒的窗口仍包含可判别信息。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 fNIRS 自闭症分类方法假设时间对齐的评测，但实际中最优观测窗口因受试者的血流动力学延迟和神经血管耦合差异而不同，造成时间分布偏移并损害性能。
summary_sections.method: 提出跨时间窗迁移问题的正式定义与评测协议，在生物运动试次内变化窗口长度和偏移量；用 fNIRS 地形图表示，基准测试视觉架构、零样本基线与域对抗、自监督等适配策略，采用留一受试者交叉验证（N=124）。
