papers.title: The Field Knows: Cross-Dimensional Geometry from Navigation to Black Holes
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a continuous metric field framework trained by a single causal contrastive loss. The framework encodes a scene into coefficients of a fixed symmetric matrix basis, assembles them into a Lie algebra element, and exponentiates the result to a Riemannian or Lorentzian metric. Across dimensions, this field discovers the full spectrum of geometric structures: from obstacle-avoiding geodesics in robot navigation across planar and manipulator configuration spaces, to event horizons of black holes in Lorentzian spacetime. Extensive zero-shot generalization studies demonstrate that the field captures transferable geometric structure rather than memorizing specific configurations. In the black hole setting, the causal loss spontaneously evolves genuine black-hole-like structures with the correct Lorentzian signature. The same loss, the same architecture, and the same training protocol produce the full range of geometric phenomena across dimensions. The field knows geometry, and geometry knows physics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种连续度量场框架，仅用单一因果对比损失 (causal contrastive loss) 训练，将场景编码为固定对称矩阵基的系数，组装成李代数元素并指数映射为黎曼或洛伦兹度量。摘要称该框架在不同维度下发现了从机器人导航中的避障测地线到洛伦兹时空中黑洞事件视界的完整几何结构谱系，并通过零样本泛化实验表明其捕获的是可迁移的几何结构而非记忆特定配置。
Motivation: 作者希望用一个统一框架跨维度捕获几何结构，使同一损失、同一架构和同一训练协议能够产生从平面与机械臂构型空间导航到黑洞时空的多种几何现象。
Method: 引入连续度量场，输入场景后输出固定对称矩阵基的系数，将其组装为李代数元素，再通过指数映射得到黎曼或洛伦兹度量；整个框架由单一因果对比损失驱动训练，不依赖任务特定的监督信号。
Result: 摘要报告了在平面和机械臂构型空间导航中的避障测地线结果，以及在洛伦兹时空设定下因果损失自发演化出具有正确洛伦兹号差 (Lorentzian signature) 的真黑洞式结构；零样本泛化研究显示该场学到的是可迁移的几何结构。
Conclusion: 作者强调同一个损失、架构与训练协议即可在多个维度上产生完整的几何现象谱系，认为该框架表明场本身能习得几何，且几何与物理存在内在联系。

papers.title: What to Edit Next: Visually Aligned Image-Editing Follow-Up Suggestions in Conversational Systems
papers.abstract_en: Conversational assistants increasingly recommend follow-up edits to help users continue a task. Existing systems primarily target text-only interactions, leaving image-creation conversations underexplored. In image-creation tasks, useful follow-up edit suggestions must reflect user preferences, offer diverse directions, and remain executable on the current image. We collected 100,000 real multi-turn image-creation conversation samples from Qwen App and found that 80.1% are image-dependent, underscoring the need for multimodal recommendation. We address this setting with a three-stage framework. In Stage 1, we use real online data to build a human-reviewed table of appropriate follow-up editing intents, then create SFT targets and fine-tune a multimodal policy. In Stage 2, to align rule-guided SFT suggestions with actual user choices, we use user click feedback to optimize the policy through multi-objective reinforcement learning. In Stage 3, to reduce visual inconsistencies between suggested edits and the current image, we introduce a visual verifier as additional training supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms baselines on both automatic and human evaluations. In a live user-randomized A/B test with millions of users, our final framework reduces visual inconsistency from 3.7% to 0.9%. Furthermore, it significantly improves recommendation CTR by 32.70%, image take-away rate by 16.32%, and average conversation turns per user by 39.90% (all p<0.05).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究对话式图像创建系统中的后续编辑建议推荐问题，收集了来自 Qwen App 的 10 万条真实多轮图像创建对话样本，发现其中 80.1% 的后续编辑建议依赖于当前图像。作者提出三阶段框架：先用真实数据构建人工审核的编辑意图表并微调多模态策略，再用用户点击反馈通过多目标强化学习进行对齐，最后引入视觉验证器减少建议与图像之间的视觉不一致。在线 A/B 测试显示视觉不一致率从 3.7% 降至 0.9%，推荐 CTR 提升 32.70%。
Motivation: 现有对话助手主要面向纯文本交互，图像创建对话中的后续编辑建议这一场景尚未被充分探索；此类建议需要反映用户偏好、提供多样化方向并能在当前图像上执行，而大多数建议都依赖图像内容，因此需要多模态推荐方案。
Method: 提出三阶段框架：阶段一利用真实在线数据构建人工审核的后续编辑意图表，生成 SFT 目标并微调多模态策略；阶段二使用用户点击反馈，通过多目标强化学习优化策略以对齐真实用户选择；阶段三引入视觉验证器作为额外训练监督，降低建议编辑与当前图像之间的视觉不一致。
Result: 自动评估与人工评估均显示该框架显著优于基线；在覆盖百万用户的在线随机 A/B 测试中，视觉不一致率从 3.7% 下降到 0.9%，推荐 CTR 提升 32.70%，图像带走率提升 16.32%，人均对话轮次提升 39.90%（均 p<0.05）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该三阶段框架能够结合真实数据、用户反馈与视觉验证，在真实图像编辑对话系统中显著改善编辑建议的视觉一致性并提升用户参与度。

papers.title: Coarse-to-Fine Registration of Jawbone CT and Intraoral Scan Data Using GeDi and ICP with Pseudo-IOS Ground Truth
papers.abstract_en: In digital dentistry and oral surgery, the registration of jawbone CT and intraoral scanner (IOS) data is essential for integrating internal bone structure with high-resolution dental surface geometry. However, this registration is challenging because the two modalities share only a limited region in common, and their true correspondence is generally unknown. This uncertainty has prevented rigorous quantitative evaluation of registration accuracy. In this study, we propose a pseudoIOS evaluation framework in which a point cloud emulating an intraoral scan is generated from CT data within the same coordinate frame, so that the transformation between them is known by construction and can serve as a true ground truth. Using this framework, we propose a coarse-to-fine registration method that combines a domain-generalizable local descriptor (GeDi) for initialization-independent global alignment with the iterative closest point (ICP) algorithm for local refinement, and also evaluate the influence of metal artifacts on registration. In experiments on seven cases, ICP alone frequently converged to local minima from a perturbed initial position, whereas GeDi$+$ICP maintained submillimeter mean absolute error (MAE) across all evaluated jaw and artifact conditions (0.55-0.69 mm). A three-way repeated-measures analysis confirmed that GeDi$+$ICP was significantly more accurate than GeDi alone. Metal artifacts had a statistically detectable overall effect, but their absolute impact on GeDi$+$ICP was small.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向数字牙科中牙颌骨 CT 与口内扫描 (IOS) 数据的配准问题，提出一个伪 IOS (pseudoIOS) 评估框架，从 CT 在同一坐标系内生成模拟口内扫描点云，使其变换关系已知并可用作真实真值。配准方法采用粗到细策略，先使用跨域泛化局部描述子 GeDi 做全局对齐，再用迭代最近点 (ICP) 精修。在七例实验上，GeDi+ICP 在所有颌骨与伪影条件下保持亚毫米平均绝对误差 (0.55–0.69 mm)。
Motivation: 牙颌骨 CT 与口内扫描数据的配准对数字牙科和口腔外科至关重要，但两种模态仅共享有限区域且真实对应关系未知，导致配准精度难以进行严格的定量评估。
Method: 提出 pseudoIOS 评估框架，从 CT 生成与口内扫描形态相似的点云并赋予已知变换作为真值；在此基础上提出粗到细配准流程，先用与初始化无关的 GeDi 描述子进行全局配准，再用 ICP 进行局部精修，并评估金属伪影对配准的影响。
Result: 在七例实验中，单独使用 ICP 从扰动初始位置出发时经常陷入局部极小，而 GeDi+ICP 在所有颌骨和伪影条件下均保持亚毫米 MAE (0.55–0.69 mm)。三因素重复测量方差分析显示 GeDi+ICP 显著优于单独 GeDi；金属伪影存在统计上可检测的总体影响，但对 GeDi+ICP 的绝对影响较小。
Conclusion: 摘要表明伪真值框架能够支持对无配对真值的医学配准任务进行定量评估，且 GeDi+ICP 组合可在牙颌骨 CT 与口内扫描配准中稳定实现亚毫米精度，金属伪影对最终精度的影响有限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mechanistic Interpretability-Guided Selective Fine-Tuning of Vision-Language Models for Centimeter-Level Flood Depth Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Urban flooding poses an escalating threat to transportation infrastructure, yet no operational system provides real-time, street-level flood-depth estimates at centimeter resolution. This paper presents three vision-language models fine-tuned for continuous flood-depth estimation from street-level imagery: FloodLlama-Dense, a fully fine-tuned QLoRA baseline, and FloodLlama-MI5 and FloodLlama-MI6, interpretability-guided sparse variants that fine-tune only the top five and six causally relevant cross-attention layers identified through mechanistic interpretability analysis, respectively. Training uses an approximately 610,000-image subset of a 2.81-million-image synthetic corpus generated in Unreal Engine 5. The dataset combines single-vehicle subsets with 5 cm depth increments and mixed-vehicle subsets with 1 cm depth increments, spanning seven vehicle types, four weather conditions, and flood depths from 0 to 40 cm. FloodLlama-Dense achieves an MAE of 0.40 cm, an RMSE of 1.97 cm, and an Acc@5cm of 97.59%. Mechanistic interpretability analysis combining linear probing, logit lens, centered kernel alignment (CKA), and cross-attention entropy reveals a two-stage adaptation pattern: layers L13-L22 restructure visual representations, while depth first becomes linearly decodable at layer L23. FloodLlama-MI5 and FloodLlama-MI6 leverage this insight by fine-tuning only five or six of the eight cross-attention layers, achieving an 86-88% reduction in trainable parameters (6.55-7.86 million versus 54.4 million) with minimal accuracy loss. On a real-world benchmark, FloodLlama-MI6 achieves 98.62% accuracy, compared with 86.61% for the published STURM-FloodDepth baseline.
papers.comment: This Paper is accepted in International Conference on Machine Learning and Application (ICMLA) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出三种用于街道图像连续洪水深度估计的视觉-语言模型：全量微调的 FloodLlama-Dense，以及通过机制可解释性分析识别出因果相关交叉注意力层后仅微调其中五层或六层的稀疏变体 FloodLlama-MI5 和 FloodLlama-MI6。模型在约 61 万张 Unreal Engine 5 合成图像子集上训练，FloodLlama-Dense 达到 MAE 0.40 cm、RMSE 1.97 cm、Acc@5cm 97.59%；稀疏变体在参数减少 86-88% 的情况下精度损失很小，并在真实世界基准上优于已发表的 STURM-FloodDepth 基线。
Motivation: 城市洪水对交通基础设施构成日益严重的威胁，但尚无业务化系统能够以厘米级分辨率提供实时街道级洪水深度估计。
Method: 结合线性探测 (linear probing)、logit lens、中心核对齐 (CKA) 和交叉注意力熵进行机制可解释性分析，揭示两层适应模式：L13-L22 层重构视觉表征，深度信息在 L23 层才开始线性可解码；据此仅微调八个交叉注意力层中的五个或六个，并以 QLoRA 微调作为全量基线。训练数据为约 61 万张 Unreal Engine 5 合成图像子集，包含 5 cm 与 1 cm 深度增量的单车和混合车场景，覆盖七种车辆类型、四种天气条件和 0-40 cm 水深。
Result: FloodLlama-Dense 达到 MAE 0.40 cm、RMSE 1.97 cm、Acc@5cm 97.59%。FloodLlama-MI5/MI6 将可训练参数从 54.4 百万降至 6.55-7.86 百万（减少 86-88%），精度损失极小；在真实世界基准上 FloodLlama-MI6 准确率为 98.62%，而已发表的 STURM-FloodDepth 基线为 86.61%。
Conclusion: 机制可解释性引导的选择性微调能以远少于全量微调的参数实现厘米级洪水深度估计，并指出视觉表征重构与深度线性可解码的分层机制是高效稀疏微调的依据。

summary_sections.motivation: 城市洪水对交通基础设施构成日益严重的威胁，但尚无业务化系统能够以厘米级分辨率提供实时街道级洪水深度估计。

summary_sections.conclusion: 机制可解释性引导的选择性微调能以远少于全量微调的参数实现厘米级洪水深度估计，并指出视觉表征重构与深度线性可解码的分层机制是高效稀疏微调的依据。

papers.title: XEns-CKD: An Explainable Ensemble-Based Approach for Chronic Kidney Disease Stage Detection
papers.abstract_en: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a silent disease. Its progression may not significantly hamper a person's daily routine. Human kidney function can be classified as normal or as one of the five stages of CKD. Early detection of the CKD stage can help patients understand the functional status of their kidneys and follow medical advice to slow CKD progression. In this paper, we propose XEns-CKD, a novel ensemble vision transformer-based scheme for CKD stage classification using ultrasound images. Three ViTs were trained on a private ultrasound image dataset using different training parameters. The performance of each ViT was evaluated using macro sensitivity, macro specificity, macro precision, macro F1-score, macro Youden index, the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), and macro balanced accuracy. The ensemble model achieved an overall classification accuracy of 86.36%. This work also emphasizes identifying and interpreting kidney regions affected by CKD progression. Explainable artificial intelligence techniques, including LIME, LRP, Attention-Min, and Attention-Max, were used to improve model transparency and clinical trust. An attention map combining the Attention-Min and Attention-Max results effectively identified and interpreted kidney regions affected during CKD progression from one stage to another. The attention map also highlighted the effects of CKD progression in these regions. Compared with existing methods, the proposed method classified the five CKD stages and normal kidney status with a 4% improvement in accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 XEns-CKD，一种基于集成视觉 Transformer (ViT) 的慢性肾病 (CKD) 分期分类方案，使用超声图像区分正常肾脏与 CKD 五个分期。三个 ViT 以不同训练参数在私有超声数据集上训练，集成模型总体分类准确率为 86.36%，相比现有方法提升约 4%。作者还结合 LIME、LRP、Attention-Min 和 Attention-Max 等可解释人工智能技术生成注意力图，用于定位和解释 CKD 进展影响的肾脏区域。
Motivation: CKD 是一种沉默性疾病，其进展可能不会显著干扰患者日常活动，因此早期检测 CKD 分期有助于患者了解肾功能状态并遵循医学建议以延缓疾病进展。
Method: 提出 XEns-CKD，训练三个不同参数的 ViT 并在私有超声图像数据集上集成；使用 macro sensitivity、macro specificity、macro precision、macro F1-score、macro Youden index、MCC 和 macro balanced accuracy 评估，并利用 LIME、LRP、Attention-Min、Attention-Max 进行可解释性分析，将 Attention-Min 与 Attention-Max 结合生成注意力图以解释 CKD 分期进展涉及的肾脏区域。
Result: 集成模型在五期 CKD 与正常肾脏分类上达到 86.36% 的总体准确率，比现有方法准确率提高 4%；注意力图可识别并解释 CKD 从一个分期进展到另一个分期时受影响的肾脏区域。
Conclusion: 作者强调可解释性对临床信任的重要性，认为结合 Attention-Min 与 Attention-Max 的注意力图能有效揭示 CKD 进展对各肾脏区域的影响。

papers.title: MVMD: A Multi-View Approach for Enhanced Mirror Detection
papers.abstract_en: In 3D reconstruction, mirrors introduce significant challenges by creating distorted and fragmented spaces, resulting in inaccurate and unreliable 3D models. As 3D reconstruction typically relies on multi-view images to capture different perspectives of a scene, detecting and labeling mirrors in multi-view images before reconstruction can effectively address this issue. However, existing methods focus solely on single-image detection, overlooking the rich information provided by multi-view setups. To overcome this limitation, we propose MVMD, a novel Multi-View Mirror Detection method, along with the first database specifically designed for mirror detection in multi-view scenes. The design of MVMD is grounded in the inherent associations between objects seen from different views and those reflected inside and outside of mirrors. These relationships are learned through cross- and self-attention mechanisms. MVMD consists of three key blocks: the Inter-Views Block tracks the shifts of objects within mirrors caused by changes in viewpoint; the Intra-View Block detects object reflections inside mirrors; and the Refinement Block sharpens mirror boundaries and enhances detected details. Experimental results show that our method improves accuracy by up to 2.6% and IoU by up to 11.1%, compared to single-image mirror detection techniques. This substantial improvement makes MVMD particularly effective for computer vision tasks, especially in enhancing the accuracy of 3D reconstruction in mirror-dense environments.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MVMD，一种多视图镜像检测方法，并构建了首个针对多视图场景的镜像检测数据库。方法通过跨视图和自注意力机制学习不同视点下物体及其镜内外反射之间的关联，包含Inter-Views Block、Intra-View Block和Refinement Block三个模块。实验表明，相比单图像镜像检测技术，准确率最高提升2.6%，IoU最高提升11.1%，尤其有助于镜像密集环境下的3D重建。
Motivation: 镜子会扭曲和分割3D重建中的空间，导致模型不准确，而现有镜像检测方法仅针对单张图像，未利用多视图设置中丰富的关联信息。
Method: 提出MVMD，利用跨视图注意力（cross-attention）和自注意力（self-attention）建模物体在不同视图及镜内外的关联。三个关键模块分别负责：Inter-Views Block追踪视点变化引起的镜内物体位移，Intra-View Block检测镜内反射物体，Refinement Block锐化镜像边界并增强检测细节。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在准确率上最高提升2.6%，在IoU上最高提升11.1%，优于单图像镜像检测方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法对计算机视觉任务尤其有效，能提升镜像密集环境下3D重建的准确性。

papers.title: Learning Physical Interaction: A Survey of Tactile- and Force-aware Robot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Physically grounded robot intelligence requires robots to perceive, reason about, and regulate their interactions with the physical world. This capability is particularly critical in contact-sensitive manipulation, where successful task execution depends not only on visual perception and motion generation, but also on force regulation and adaptive control. In this context, recent robot learning methods have made substantial progress by integrating force, tactile, vision, language, and proprioceptive sensing into learned manipulation policies. In parallel, many systems adopt multi-phase architectures that combine high-level policies, action-refinement modules, and low-level controllers to bridge semantic task understanding with reactive physical execution. Despite these advances, existing surveys have not explicitly reviewed force- and tactile-aware robot learning from a unified perspective that jointly captures multimodal sensing and multi-phase system design. This survey addresses this gap by proposing TF-ART, a Tactile/Force-Aware Robot learning Taxonomy for multimodal and multi-phase frameworks, which maps individual methods into a unified hierarchical structure. The framework characterizes how recent works organize observation modalities, encode and fuse heterogeneous sensory inputs, generate and refine actions across multiple phases, and connect learned policies to reactive robot-end control. Building on this methodological view, we further examine the task settings and infrastructure requirements of physical interaction, thereby integrating both algorithmic and practical perspectives on force- and tactile-aware robot learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于力/触觉感知机器人学习（tactile/force-aware robot learning）的综述，提出统一分类体系 TF-ART，用于组织和比较多模态感知与多阶段系统设计下的各类方法。作者从观测模态组织、异构传感器信息编码与融合、跨阶段动作生成与细化、学习策略与反应式末端控制的连接等维度梳理现有工作，并讨论物理交互的任务设置与基础设施需求。全文 53 页、7 幅图，未报告实验基准。
Motivation: 机器人的物理交互能力对接触敏感操作至关重要，但现有综述没有从同时涵盖多模态感知和多阶段系统设计的统一视角来梳理力/触觉感知的机器人学习方法。
Method: 提出 TF-ART（Tactile/Force-Aware Robot learning Taxonomy）分类体系，将各方法映射到统一的层次化结构；从观测模态组织、异构输入编码与融合、动作生成与细化、学习策略与底层机器人控制的连接等方面刻画方法，并纳入任务设置与基础设施要求。
Result: 作为综述，本文没有定量实验；其主要成果是提出 TF-ART 分类框架，并基于该框架系统梳理近期力/触觉感知的机器人学习方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为该综述填补了现有工作未能统一刻画多模态感知与多阶段系统设计的空白，为力/触觉感知机器人学习提供了算法与实用层面的综合视角。

papers.title: AeroDPO: Unleashing Lightweight UAV Navigation with High-Fidelity Perception and Automated Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Navigation for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV-VLN) requires rapid and reactive control in complex 3D environments. Recent minimalist end-to-end paradigms show great promise but typically rely on massive language models containing billions of parameters, incurring prohibitive latency for real-world edge deployment. In this paper, we challenge this parameter-heavy reliance. Comprehensive cross-scale evaluations reveal the critical insight that perception quality fundamentally outweighs language reasoning capacity. We demonstrate that a lightweight 2B model equipped with high-fidelity visual inputs completely matches the overall success rates of massive 7B baselines. However, this minimalist policy exposes a fundamental robustness flaw inherent to pure Behavior Cloning (BC). Lacking explicit negative feedback, the agent fails to internalize robust spatial constraints and exhibits alarming collision rates in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. To overcome this vulnerability without relying on unscalable human annotations, we propose AeroDPO, a zero-cost automated Direct Preference Optimization pipeline driven by deterministic physical simulation state rollback. Upon detecting collisions, the system autonomously rewinds the environment to extract causal reasoning errors as rejected actions, applies decoupled privileged interventions to synthesize collision-avoidance preferred maneuvers, and leverages an offline vision language inspector to filter visual ambiguities. By equipping our 2B model with this automated data flywheel, AeroDPO boosts success rates to 49.16% on unmapped scenarios while drastically suppressing collision rates, establishing a new SOTA for autonomous aerial agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无人机视觉-语言导航（UAV-VLN）端侧部署中模型参数量过大的问题，提出轻量化自动偏好优化管线 AeroDPO。跨规模对比实验发现感知质量比语言推理容量更关键：2B 参数轻量模型配合高保真视觉输入即可达到 7B 基线的整体成功率。针对纯行为克隆（BC）缺少负反馈导致的分布外（OOD）碰撞缺陷，AeroDPO 利用确定性物理仿真状态回滚自动构造偏好数据，将未映射场景下的成功率提升至 49.16%，并显著压低碰撞率。
Motivation: 现有极简端到端 UAV-VLN 范式依赖数十亿参数的大语言模型，推理延迟过高，难以在真实边缘设备部署；而纯行为克隆策略缺乏显式负反馈，无法内化稳健的空间约束，在 OOD 场景中碰撞率较高。作者希望通过不依赖人工标注的自动化方式来克服这一脆弱性。
Method: 提出 AeroDPO，一种零成本的自动化直接偏好优化（Direct Preference Optimization）管线：检测到碰撞后，系统自动回滚环境以提取因果推理错误作为被拒绝动作，施加解耦特权干预（decoupled privileged interventions）合成避碰首选动作，并借助离线视觉语言检查器过滤视觉歧义，形成自动化数据飞轮。
Result: 跨尺度评估显示感知质量压倒语言推理容量：2B 模型配合高保真视觉输入在整体成功率上与 7B 基线完全持平。AeroDPO 将 2B 模型在未映射场景上的成功率提升至 49.16%，同时大幅抑制碰撞率，为自主空中智能体建立新的 SOTA。
Conclusion: 摘要主张轻量感知配合自动化偏好优化可以取代对大规模参数模型的依赖，为边缘端无人机的快速反应式导航提供可行路径。该方法依赖确定性物理仿真回滚生成偏好信号，其效果与实际仿真环境对复杂 3D 世界建模的保真度相关。

papers.title: MasDrift: Benchmarking Authorization Preservation Across Multi-Agent Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) decompose long-horizon tasks across supervisors and subagents, but delegated goals do not necessarily carry their original authorization boundaries. Existing safety benchmarks mainly study adversarial compromise, while work on constraint drift lacks controlled architecture-level evaluation. We introduce MasDrift, a benchmark of 600 benign productivity tasks across eight domains. Each task pairs required work with reserved actions. MasDrift compares single-agent, centralized, and decentralized coordination while varying hierarchy depth and peer width, measuring task completion and authorization preservation. Across generic multi-agent conditions, centralized hierarchies achieve 93.9--98.6% task completion versus 85.7--87.0% for peer networks, while unauthorized actions occur in 2.7--19.8% of tasks versus 0.6--0.8%, a gap that widens with hierarchy depth. We further compare two defenses that differ in where authorization evidence resides. One re-anchors every pending call to the original user request. The other carries an attenuated policy along the delegation chain. Re-anchoring reduces unauthorized actions in every model configuration we evaluate, at a cost of 1.6 points of pooled completion. Chain propagation blocks required work instead, forfeiting up to 36.3 points. A heterogeneous case study confirms that the failure follows from coordination rather than model strength. MasDrift exposes a centralization tradeoff and makes authorization preservation a measurable property of MAS design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MasDrift，一个包含 8 个领域、600 个良性生产力任务的基准，每个任务把必要工作与保留动作（reserved actions）配对，用于度量多智能体架构下的授权保持（authorization preservation）。作者对比了单智能体、集中式和分散式协调，并改变层级深度与同级宽度，同时测量任务完成率和未授权动作率。结果显示集中式层级在任务完成率上更高但未授权动作更多，而将待处理调用重新锚定到原始用户请求的防御能普遍降低未授权动作。
Motivation: 多智能体系统（MAS）会把长时程任务分解给监督者与子智能体，但委派目标未必继承原始授权边界。现有安全基准主要研究对抗性入侵，而约束漂移（constraint drift）缺乏受控的架构级评估。
Method: 提出 MasDrift 基准并在单智能体、集中式和分散式协调下进行比较，通过改变层级深度与同级宽度来测量任务完成和授权保持。还比较两种防御：将每个待处理调用重新锚定到原始用户请求，以及沿委派链携带衰减策略（attenuated policy）。
Result: 在通用多智能体条件下，集中式层级实现 93.9–98.6% 的任务完成率，而同级网络为 85.7–87.0%；未授权动作出现在 2.7–19.8% 的任务中，对比同级网络的 0.6–0.8%，且该差距随层级深度扩大。重新锚定在评估的所有模型配置中都减少未授权动作，代价是合并完成率下降 1.6 个点；链传播则转而阻断必要工作，最高损失 36.3 个点。
Conclusion: MasDrift 揭示了集中化带来的权衡，并使授权保持成为多智能体系统设计可测量的属性。异质案例研究确认失败源于协调方式而非模型能力。

papers.title: Impact of Dataset Composition on Embedded Real-Time UAV Wildfire Detection Using Compact YOLO Models
papers.abstract_en: The development of vision-based wildfire detection systems for unmanned aerial vehicles is constrained by the limited availability of diverse real-world training images. This paper investigates the impact of dataset composition on embedded real-time UAV wildfire detection using compact YOLO models as a controlled validation family. Four training configurations were evaluated: real non-augmented, real augmented, hybrid non-augmented, and hybrid augmented, where the hybrid sets combine real wildfire images with AI-generated samples. The objective is to determine whether synthetic data mixing and image augmentation improve practical detection performance under resource-constrained deployment conditions. Experimental results show that the best overall operating point was obtained with the real non-augmented dataset, which achieved the strongest balance between recall and mean average precision for UAV-based wildfire detection. The results also show that neither hybridization with synthetic data nor augmentation produced a better final deployment choice. These findings suggest that, for embedded UAV wildfire detection, dataset realism and domain alignment are more valuable than increasing training set size through synthetic expansion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究数据集组成对嵌入式实时无人机野火检测的影响，以紧凑型 YOLO 模型作为受控验证族。作者比较了真实未增强、真实增强、混合未增强和混合增强四种训练配置，其中混合集将真实野火图像与 AI 生成样本结合。实验显示最佳工作点来自真实未增强数据集，在召回率与平均精度均值 (mAP) 之间取得最强平衡，且合成数据混合与图像增强均未产生更优的部署选择。
Motivation: 基于视觉的无人机野火检测受限于多样化真实训练图像的稀缺，因此需要厘清合成数据混合与数据增强是否能在资源受限部署条件下实际提升检测性能。
Method: 采用紧凑型 YOLO 模型作为受控验证族，系统比较四种训练配置：真实未增强、真实增强、混合未增强和混合增强，其中混合配置在真实野火图像中引入 AI 生成样本。
Result: 实验结果表明，真实未增强数据集取得最佳整体工作点，在无人机野火检测的召回率与 mAP 之间达到最强平衡；与合成数据的混合以及增强均未带来更好的最终部署选择。
Conclusion: 对嵌入式无人机野火检测而言，数据集真实性与域对齐 (domain alignment) 比通过合成扩展增大训练集规模更有价值。

papers.title: Auditing Medical Vision-Language Models on Chest Radiographs: Estimating Reference Agreement Across Institutions
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models return structured chest-radiograph findings through interfaces exposing no confidence score, so a receiving institution cannot read off how far to trust an individual judgment. Whether agreement with an institution's reference standard transfers across sites, findings, prediction directions and question formats is largely unmeasured. We evaluated three generative vision-language models on three institutional chest-radiograph corpora and six findings under two elicitation protocols, comprising more than 345,000 finding-level predictions, and estimated finding-by-direction reference agreement at a receiving institution from a small budget of local labels. Estimation strategies were then stress-tested under repeated strict institution-held-out evaluation. Under evaluation excluding the receiving institution from development entirely, adaptive selection among the seven estimators that design admits did not improve on simple fixed alternatives: it achieved a mean Brier score of 0.1083, against 0.0853 for always using a Beta-Binomial empirical-Bayes estimator and 0.0855 for a target-only logistic model. Those two differ by 0.0003, less than this family's own sensitivity to a change of solver version, and each leads in about half the settings, so no default can be recommended. Their advantage over estimators pooling across institutions was concentrated at one site and not confirmatory once clustered by institution, and a plug-in empirical-Bayes posterior-predictive count interval at a nominal 95% level covered 87.0%, less at the hardest institution. Reference agreement therefore has to be re-evaluated per site and per interface; these results concern agreement with institutional labels, not clinical correctness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计医学视觉语言模型（vision-language models）在胸部X光片上的结构化发现输出，讨论接收机构如何在无置信度分数的情况下估计与本地参考标准的一致性。作者在三个机构语料库、六种发现和两种问答协议下评估了三个生成式视觉语言模型，共涉及超过345,000条finding-level预测，并用少量本地标签估计finding-by-direction的参考一致性。严格留出接收机构的评估显示，自适应选择七个估计器并不优于简单固定方案，且95%名义覆盖区间实际覆盖87.0%。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型通过不暴露置信度分数的接口返回结构化胸部X光发现，接收机构无法判断单条判断的可信度；参考标准一致性是否跨机构、发现类型、预测方向和问题格式迁移，目前基本未被测量。
Method: 在三个机构胸部X光语料库、六种发现和两种提示协议下系统评估三个生成式视觉语言模型，产生超过345,000条finding-level预测；利用少量本地标签估计接收机构处的finding-by-direction参考一致性，并在严格机构留出（institution-held-out）的重复评估下对七种估计策略进行压力测试。
Result: 自适应选择七个估计器未优于简单固定方案：其平均Brier分数为0.1083，而始终使用Beta-Binomial经验贝叶斯估计器为0.0853、仅目标逻辑回归为0.0855；两者相差0.0003，小于该系列方法对求解器版本变化的敏感度，且各在约一半场景中领先。跨机构池化估计的优势集中在一个站点，按机构聚类后不具备确证性；名义95%的plug-in经验贝叶斯后验预测计数区间实际覆盖87.0%，在最难的机构更低。
Conclusion: 无法推荐默认估计器，参考一致性必须按站点和接口重新评估；这些结果涉及与机构标签的一致性，而非临床正确性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: P2Voxel: Pyramid Pivot Voxelization for 3D Mesh Tokenization
papers.abstract_en: Triangle meshes provide explicit and accurate surface geometry, yet their irregular topology connectivity makes 3D mesh tokenization a geometric sampling problem: how to sample and organize geometric evidence into compact, structured and learnable tokens. Beyond field-centric volumetric sampling and edge-intersection surface sampling, we retarget mesh tokenization as \textit{local surface evidence sampling}: identifying the minimal geometric evidence inside each active voxel that is sufficient for deterministic surface recovery. To this end, we introduce \textbf{P2Voxel}, a pyramid pivot voxelization framework for compact and reconstruction-aware mesh tokenization. P2Voxel is built on three key innovations. Under the \textit{Local Planarity} assumption, Pivot Voxelization represents each active voxel with a surface pivot and an orientation sign, providing minimal local evidence that can induce the corner values required for deterministic reconstruction. Under the \textit{Spatial Complexity} assumption, Pyramid Pivot Voxelization exploits the spatial non-uniformity of real surfaces by allocating finer pivot tokens to geometrically complex regions while keeping smooth regions coarse and compact. Under the \textit{Block Reconstructability} assumption, a Pyramid VAE learns compact multi-resolution latent codes over locally reconstructable pivot blocks, avoiding the need to model the entire high-resolution voxelized shape as a dense global field. Together, these designs convert meshes into compact, structured, and learnable pyramid pivot tokens, enabling efficient mesh reconstruction for downstream 3D tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 P2Voxel，一种用于 3D 网格 tokenization 的金字塔枢轴体素化（pyramid pivot voxelization）框架。作者将网格 tokenization 重新定义为局部表面证据采样，即在每个活动体素内寻找足以确定性恢复表面的最小几何证据。框架基于三个假设：Local Planarity 下用表面枢轴与方向符号表示体素，Spatial Complexity 下对复杂几何区域分配更细的 token，Block Reconstructability 下用 Pyramid VAE 学习局部可重建块的多分辨率潜码。摘要未报告定量实验，声称可将网格转换为紧凑、结构化、可学习的 token 以支持下游重建。
Motivation: 三角网格能提供显式且精确的表面几何，但其不规则拓扑连接使 3D 网格 tokenization 成为一个几何采样问题。现有基于场（field-centric）的体素采样和基于边交点（edge-intersection）的表面采样没有聚焦于局部最小几何证据的选取，本文试图弥补这一点。
Method: 在 Local Planarity 假设下，Pivot Voxelization 用每个活动体素内的表面枢轴（surface pivot）和方向符号（orientation sign）提供可诱导确定性重建所需角值的局部证据；在 Spatial Complexity 假设下，金字塔式结构对几何复杂区域分配更细的 pivot token，平滑区域保持粗粒度；在 Block Reconstructability 假设下，Pyramid VAE 在局部可重建的 pivot 块上学习紧凑的多分辨率潜码，避免把整个高分辨率体素化形状建模为稠密全局场。
Result: 摘要没有给出具体实验数字、数据集或基线，只陈述该设计旨在将网格转化为紧凑、结构化、可学习的金字塔 pivot token，并为下游 3D 任务提供高效的网格重建。
Conclusion: 作者认为将网格 tokenization 重构为局部表面证据采样，并结合金字塔细节分配与分块重建，可以避免稠密全局场建模，从而改进 3D 网格 tokenization 的紧凑性与可学习性；其适用范围是下游 3D 任务。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SC$^{2}$-WM: A Self-Correcting World Model with Closed-Loop Feedback for Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
papers.abstract_en: Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires agents to make fine-grained navigation decisions under partial observability. However, most existing methods rely on open-loop execution, lacking mechanisms to detect and correct internal state drift during inference. We propose SC$^{2}$-WM, a self-correcting world model framework that introduces internal feedback for closed-loop decision making in VLN-CE. Our method derives feedback from world-model foresight to perform state-level plan refinement before action execution. To handle challenging scenarios, we further introduce conditional world-aware adaptation, which enables model-level correction by selectively updating the world model at test time when feedback indicates model capacity insufficiency. Experiments on standard VLN-CE benchmarks demonstrate improved navigation robustness and generalization. Our code is available at https://github.com/sunrise-ikun/SC2_WM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SC²-WM，一种面向连续环境视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）的自校正世界模型（self-correcting world model）框架，通过引入内部反馈实现闭环决策。方法利用世界模型的前瞻性反馈在动作执行前进行状态级计划细化，并引入条件世界感知适应以在测试时按需更新模型。在标准 VLN-CE 基准上的实验表明导航鲁棒性和泛化能力得到提升，代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有 VLN-CE 方法大多依赖开环执行（open-loop execution），在部分可观测环境中缺乏检测和纠正内部状态漂移（internal state drift）的机制。
Method: 提出自校正世界模型框架，从世界模型的前瞻（world-model foresight）中导出反馈，在动作执行前进行状态级计划细化；并引入条件世界感知适应（conditional world-aware adaptation），当反馈表明模型容量不足时在测试时选择性地更新世界模型，实现模型级校正。
Result: 在标准 VLN-CE 基准上的实验显示，该方法提升了导航的鲁棒性和泛化能力；摘要中未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为闭环反馈与测试时的模型级校正相结合能够改善连续环境中视觉语言导航的鲁棒性与泛化，并公开了代码仓库。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning an Interior Layout Policy in a Domain Specific Language Action Space
papers.abstract_en: Indoor scene layout generation is a challenging task in interior design. Existing methods often oversimplify the task by reducing room conditions to coarse 3D bounding boxes and neglecting structural elements such as doors and windows. More fundamentally, many prior approaches formulate spatial reasoning as direct coordinate prediction, thereby casting interior layout design as continuous regression over raw geometric parameters, which hinders the model from learning the underlying reasoning logic of intelligent layout design. We propose \textbf{LayoutDSL}, a novel LLM-based framework for learning an interior layout policy in a domain-specific language (DSL) action space. The DSL provides an explicit symbolic representation of layout information and serves as a structured action space for layout reasoning, where each action corresponds to an interpretable design decision. Under this DSL-based policy learning paradigm, we construct 3D-FrontDSL, a dataset of room-structure annotations paired with synthetic DSL action sequences for supervised fine-tuning. To promote a more generalizable and scalable policy with verifiable feedback, we design rewards grounded in interior design principles and physical plausibility, and optimize the policy via reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LayoutDSL substantially improves spatial plausibility and design logicality over strong baselines and existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LayoutDSL，一个基于 LLM 的室内布局生成框架，将布局推理建模在领域特定语言 (DSL) 动作空间中，而非直接预测连续坐标。作者构建了带房间结构标注和合成 DSL 动作序列的 3D-FrontDSL 数据集，先做监督微调，再用基于室内设计原则与物理合理性的奖励进行强化学习。摘要报告该方法在空间合理性和设计逻辑性上显著优于强基线与现有方法。
Motivation: 现有室内场景布局生成方法常把房间条件简化为粗粒度 3D 包围盒，忽略门窗等结构元素；同时多数方法将空间推理视为对原始几何参数的连续坐标回归，难以学习布局设计背后的推理逻辑。
Method: 提出 DSL 动作空间，将布局生成转化为可解释的设计决策序列；构建 3D-FrontDSL 数据集用于监督微调，并设计体现室内设计原则和物理合理性的奖励，通过强化学习优化策略以获得更具泛化性和可扩展性的行为。
Result: 摘要指出大量实验表明 LayoutDSL 相比强基线和现有方法显著提升了空间合理性与设计逻辑性，但未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调 DSL 结构化动作空间与带可验证反馈的强化学习是提升布局策略泛化性和可扩展性的关键。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Generalizing deep reinforcement learning across cable-driven parallel robot configurations with actuator-level policies
papers.abstract_en: Cable-driven parallel robots (CDPRs) present diverse configurations and complex control challenges, which can be addressed by deep reinforcement learning (DRL) by learning their nonlinear dynamics. However, DRL methods often require extensive training time, and the resulting policies do not generalize well to different robot configurations or varying numbers of actuators. In this article, we introduce a novel DRL approach for controlling CDPRs that does not depend on the specific robot configuration. Our method trains an actuator-level policy that controls each motor to achieve its target cable length, in contrast to conventional DRL approaches that learn to control the entire robot to reach a desired end-effector position. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to apply DRL to control CDPRs using an actuator-level policy. This approach offers two main advantages: (i) a single shared policy can be applied to any CDPR configuration, regardless of actuator count, and (ii) reliance on inverse kinematics, avoiding the more challenging forward kinematics problem. Training is performed in simulation, and the learned policy is successfully transferred to a real CDPR. Experimental results show that the actuator-level policy (ALP) surpasses traditional reinforcement learning methods in both robustness and precision. We further control a real 8-motor CDPR with 3D motion using a policy trained on a simulated 4-motor planar CDPR operating in 2D. This illustrates that the proposed method is applicable to any CDPR configuration, independent of actuator number or placement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于绳驱并联机器人（CDPR）控制的深度强化学习（DRL）方法，核心是训练执行器级策略（actuator-level policy），让每个电机各自达到目标绳长，而非像传统方法那样直接控制整个机器人到达末端位置。训练在仿真中进行，并成功迁移到真实 CDPR；实验表明该方法在鲁棒性和精度上优于传统强化学习方法，且可将 2D 四电机平面仿真中训练的策略直接用于真实 8 电机 3D 运动 CDPR。
Motivation: DRL 方法训练时间长，且学到的策略难以泛化到不同 CDPR 配置或不同执行器数量，这限制了其在实际多配置机器人上的可用性。
Method: 提出与机器人配置无关的执行器级策略，每个电机独立控制以到达目标绳长；单一共享策略可适用于任意电机数量的 CDPR，并依赖逆运动学而非更难的正运动学问题。
Result: 实验结果显示执行器级策略在鲁棒性和精度上超过传统强化学习方法；此外，用 2D 四电机平面 CDPR 仿真训练的策略成功控制了真实 8 电机 3D 运动 CDPR。
Conclusion: 作者称这是首个使用执行器级策略进行 CDPR 深度强化学习控制的工作，并表明该方法可适用于任意 CDPR 配置，与执行器数量和布置无关。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: DarwinX: Evolving Agent Harnesses Through Natural Selection
papers.abstract_en: An LLM agent's capability depends not only on model weights but on its harness: prompts, tools, skills, and control flow. Self-improvement loops already edit harnesses, yet single-lineage search is path-dependent and local wins often regress other tasks. We introduce DarwinX, which treats self-evolution as selection over a population of harnesses with the model frozen: a preserve-and-extend contract admits only variants that extend coverage without regressing, an archive keeps alternative lineages for recombination, and failure-, teacher-, and self-derived evidence share one edit interface. Fitness comes from each benchmark's own verifier: no gold solutions, no hand-picked winners. Across four benchmarks that progressively separate the evolution signal from the test, one loop adds about 17 points on average: Terminal-Bench 2.1 rises +7.7 to 83.2% on a matched base and to the verified frontier at 84.7% on a stronger one; TerminalWorld's held-out split reaches 68.3%, ahead of every off-the-shelf agent; WebArena-Infinity real-task pass@1 rises from 43.5% to 93.0% audit-clean; and a Terminal-Bench 2.1 harness transfers unchanged to SWE-bench Verified. What evolves is general agent competence, not benchmark-specific patches, so it survives changes of task, verifier, and base model. A frozen model need not be a fixed agent: harness selection turns evaluation compute into durable capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DarwinX，将 LLM agent 的自我进化视为在冻结模型下对 harness 种群进行选择的过程，而不是单一路径的局部编辑。系统通过 preserve-and-extend 契约只接受能扩展覆盖范围且不造成回退的变异，用归档保留替代谱系以支持重组，并让失败、教师和自生成的证据共用一个编辑接口；适应度直接来自每个基准自身的验证器，无需 gold solutions 或人工挑选胜者。摘要报告在四个基准上单轮进化平均提升约 17 个点，且得到的 harness 可以跨任务、跨验证器、跨基座模型迁移。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 的自改进循环只编辑单一路径上的 harness，这种搜索受路径依赖影响，局部改进常常导致其他任务回退。作者认为需要把自我进化建模为对 harness 群体的自然选择，以摆脱单线路搜索的局限性。
Method: DarwinX 在模型权重冻结的前提下维护一个 harness 种群，采用 preserve-and-extend 契约只接受在扩展覆盖的同时不引入回退的变异；归档机制保留替代谱系用于重组；失败、教师和自生成三类证据统一到同一个编辑接口。适应度由每个基准自带的验证器计算，不依赖人工标注的答案。
Result: 摘要报告四个基准上单轮进化平均提升约 17 个点：Terminal-Bench 2.1 在匹配基座上从 75.5% 提升 7.7 个点到 83.2%，在更强基座上达到 84.7% 的已验前沿；TerminalWorld 的 held-out split 达到 68.3%，超过所有现成 agent；WebArena-Infinity 的 real-task pass@1 从 43.5% 提升到 93.0%（audit-clean）；Terminal-Bench 2.1 的 harness 无需改动即可迁移到 SWE-bench Verified。
Conclusion: 作者的结论是进化出来的是通用的 agent 能力而不是针对特定基准的补丁，因此在更换任务、验证器和基座模型后仍然有效；冻结的模型不必是固定的 agent，harness 选择可以把评估算力转化为持久的可复用能力。

papers.title: MOSAIC: Adversarial Co-evolution of Specialist Heuristics and Problem Instances for LLM-based Automated Heuristic Design
papers.abstract_en: Automated heuristic design (AHD) with large language models (LLMs) has produced strong heuristics for combinatorial optimization problems (COPs). Yet existing frameworks optimize for average performance on a small fixed dataset and steer the search with "verbal gradients" distilled from scalar better/worse feedback. No single heuristic dominates across instance distributions, and scalar feedback tells the LLM whether a heuristic improved, but not where in the instance space or why. We propose MOSAIC, a grid-based framework that adversarially co-evolves problem instances and specialist heuristics inside a Quality-Diversity (QD) archive indexed by structural instance features. Instances evolve to expose weaknesses of the current heuristics, and heuristics evolve to eliminate them by specializing to the newly exposed regions. Each archive cell keeps a specialist heuristic, representative instances, and insights explaining what works in its region, forming a persistent memory that accumulates over the evolutionary search. For each heuristic pair sampled from distant grid regions, an LLM-guided evolutionary loop generates discriminative instances, and a decision tree identifies the feature-space regions where each heuristic wins. A reflection LLM then contrasts the two heuristics to produce multi-directional insights that persist in those regions and guide crossover and mutation. The archive is simultaneously a co-evolved benchmark of discriminative instances and a pool of region specialist heuristics, from which greedy selection extracts a compact complementary portfolio. Across COPs, test sizes, and LLM backbones, the portfolio consistently outperforms state-of-the-art LLM-based AHD methods, and the co-evolved instances attain higher feature-space coverage and stronger heuristic discrimination than evolutionary instance-generation baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MOSAIC，一种基于网格的 LLM 驱动对抗性共同进化框架，用于自动化启发式设计（AHD）。它将问题实例和专家启发式在按结构实例特征索引的质量多样性（QD）档案中共同进化，用决策树和反思 LLM 产生持久的多方向洞察，使档案同时充当判别性实例基准和专家启发式池。摘要报告该组合在多个组合优化问题、测试规模和 LLM 骨干下一致优于现有 LLM-based AHD 方法，且共同进化实例具有更高的特征空间覆盖和更强判别力。
Motivation: 现有 LLM-based AHD 框架在小规模固定数据集上优化平均性能，只靠标量更好/更差反馈形成的“言语梯度”引导搜索，无法指出启发式在实例空间的何处失败以及为什么失败；同时没有任何单一启发式能在所有实例分布上占优。
Method: MOSAIC 使用 QD 档案索引实例结构特征，实例与启发式通过对抗循环共同进化：从距离较远的网格区域采样启发式对，LLM 引导的进化循环生成判别性实例，决策树识别每个启发式获胜的特征空间区域，反思 LLM 对比两启发式并产生持续保留的洞察，用于指导交叉与变异；最后通过贪心选择从档案中提取紧凑互补的启发式组合。
Result: 摘要称该互补组合在多个 COPs、测试规模和 LLM backbones 上持续优于最新的 LLM-based AHD 方法；共同进化出的实例相比进化式实例生成基线，获得更高的特征空间覆盖和更强的启发式判别能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过让启发式专门化到不同特征空间区域并积累解释性洞察，可以在分布变化下形成更具鲁棒性和互补性的启发式集合，且档案本身也可作为判别性实例基准。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: MOSAIC 使用 QD 档案索引实例结构特征，实例与启发式通过对抗循环共同进化：从距离较远的网格区域采样启发式对，LLM 引导的进化循环生成判别性实例，决策树识别每个启发式获胜的特征空间区域，反思 LLM 对比两启发式并产生持续保留的洞察，用于指导交叉与变异；最后通过贪心选择从档案中提取紧凑互补的启发式组合。
summary_sections.result: 摘要称该互补组合在多个 COPs、测试规模和 LLM backbones 上持续优于最新的 LLM-based AHD 方法；共同进化出的实例相比进化式实例生成基线，获得更高的特征空间覆盖和更强的启发式判别能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，通过让启发式专门化到不同特征空间区域并积累解释性洞察，可以在分布变化下形成更具鲁棒性和互补性的启发式集合，且档案本身也可作为判别性实例基准。

papers.title: Performance of large language models in the optical diagnosis of colorectal polyps
papers.abstract_en: Background and Study Aims: Accurate optical diagnosis of colorectal polyps guides resection strategy and surveillance, with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) showing potential for image-based diagnosis. We aimed to evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of MLLMs in classifying colorectal polyps and predicting histology. Methods: We conducted a retrospective diagnostic performance study using the PRIME dataset, a curated set of white light and narrow-band imaging (NBI) images. We evaluated Claude Opus 4, Google Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-o3, GPT-4o, and GPT-5. For Paris, Narrow-band Imaging Colorectal Endoscopic (NICE), and predicted histology, we calculated F1 scores, percent correct scores, and accuracy of each MLLM compared to expert responses for 132 cases. Cochran's Q and McNemar's Test were used to determine differences between predicted values of each MLLM. Results: The F1 scores among MLLMs were >0.9 for all models for neoplastic vs. non-neoplastic polyps. Gemini 2.5 Pro demonstrated the highest F1 scores for invasive vs. non-invasive polyps and low- vs. high-grade adenoma, at 0.560 and 0.492 respectively. Claude Opus 4 and GPT-5 had statistically significantly higher percent correct scores than other MLLMs at 41.7%, using Paris classification. Conclusions: Claude Opus 4 and Gemini 2.5 Pro showed the highest accuracy in differentiating polyp subtypes, performing closest to expert consensus. Sensitivity and specificity, however, did not meet ESGE standards, highlighting the need for prospective multicenter trials and the design of human-in-the-loop workflows before clinical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在结直肠息肉光学诊断中的表现，回顾性使用 PRIME 数据集中的白光与窄带成像（NBI）图像，对 Claude Opus 4、Google Gemini 2.5 Pro、GPT-o3、GPT-4o 和 GPT-5 在 Paris 分型、NICE 分型及组织学预测上进行了诊断准确性比较。结果显示所有模型对肿瘤性与非肿瘤性息肉的 F1 均高于 0.9，但对息肉亚型的区分能力普遍有限，且敏感度和特异度未达到 ESGE 标准。
Motivation: 结直肠息肉的准确光学诊断直接指导切除策略和随访决策，MLLM 在基于图像的诊断方面显示出潜力，但其真实诊断准确性尚需系统评估。
Method: 这是一项回顾性诊断性能研究，使用 PRIME 数据集的 132 例白光和 NBI 图像；计算各 MLLM 的 F1 分数、正确率和准确率，并与专家判断比较，采用 Cochran's Q 和 McNemar 检验评估模型间的预测差异。
Result: 所有 MLLM 在肿瘤性 vs 非肿瘤性息肉上的 F1 均大于 0.9；Gemini 2.5 Pro 在浸润性 vs 非浸润性息肉和低级别 vs 高级别腺瘤上取得最高 F1，分别为 0.560 和 0.492；Claude Opus 4 和 GPT-5 在 Paris 分型上以 41.7% 的正确率显著高于其他模型。
Conclusion: Claude Opus 4 和 Gemini 2.5 Pro 在区分息肉亚型方面最接近专家共识，但整体敏感度和特异度未达到 ESGE 标准，作者强调在临床部署前需要前瞻性多中心试验以及人机协同（human-in-the-loop）工作流的设计。

papers.title: An AI Scientist that Doesn't Drift: Taste, Structure, and Falsifiable Findings in a Quadruped Navigation Research Loop
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous research loops driven by large language models can run machine-learning experiments at scale but tend to drift toward local refinements of whichever metric they optimise rather than testing the hypotheses that motivate the experiments. We address this structurally and present an AI Scientist for studying generalisation in quadruped robot navigation policies in simulation. Building on the autoresearch paradigm of Karpathy, our loop adds three components: an immutable experiment card that pairs each iteration's prediction with its outcome under a fixed schema, so a falsified hypothesis cannot be retconned; specialised subagents restricted to mechanical roles; and kkanbu, a preference oracle that holds the user's research taste as a typed knowledge graph and is the only component permitted to make subjective judgements. To isolate the oracle we run the identical loop twice across eleven research streams, with and without kkanbu. Neither arm drifts: both falsify roughly three quarters of their own hypotheses, and the best trained policy comes from the oracle-less arm. What the oracle changes is direction, not score: it alone explores test-time adaptation, it authored the winning designs where its arm led, and it carried lessons across streams that the other arm repeatedly re-derived. The scaffold keeps the loop honest; kkanbu decides where it looks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个结构上防止漂移的自主科研循环（AI Scientist），用于在仿真中研究四足机器人导航策略的泛化。该循环在 Karpathy 的 autoresearch 范式上增加三个组件：不可变的实验卡片（experiment card）、限定机械角色的专门子代理，以及一个将用户研究品味表示为类型化知识图谱的偏好预言机 kkanbu，后者是唯一允许做主观判断的组件。作者在 11 条研究流上分别运行带与不带 kkanbu 的相同循环，结果显示两条手臂都没有漂移：约四分之三的自设假设被证伪，得分最高的策略来自无预言机的手臂；预言机改变的是探索方向而非分数。
Motivation: 大语言模型驱动的自主研究循环可以大规模运行机器学习实验，但倾向于朝着当前优化指标的局部改进漂移，而不是检验驱动实验的假设本身。作者希望从结构上解决这种漂移问题，使研究循环能保持对假设的验证而非简单调优。
Method: 构建一个用于四足机器人导航策略泛化研究的自主循环，在 Karpathy 的 autoresearch 范式上加入三个组件：固定模式的不可变实验卡片，将每次迭代的预测与其结果绑定，使被证伪的假设无法事后改写；限定机械角色的专门子代理；以及 kkanbu 偏好预言机，它把用户的研究品味编码为类型化知识图谱，且是唯一允许做主观判断的组件。为隔离预言机的作用，作者在 11 条研究流上分别运行带与不带 kkanbu 的相同循环。
Result: 两条手臂都没有漂移：各自约四分之三的自设假设被证伪；最佳训练策略来自无 kkanbu 的手臂。预言机改变的是方向而非分数：只有它探索了测试时自适应（test-time adaptation），在它领先的研究流中创作了获胜设计，并跨研究流传递了另一条手臂反复重新发现的教训。
Conclusion: 摘要强调脚手架（scaffold）保持循环诚实，而 kkanbu 决定循环观察的方向；即结构约束防止假设被改写，主观品味组件负责引导探索方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NeuroPilot: An Agent-Driven Smart Pipeline for Processing, Quality Control, and Managing Neuroimages
papers.abstract_en: Transforming raw neuroimage archives into analysis-ready derivatives relies on three brittle stages: data standardization, modality-specific preprocessing, and quality control (QC). While individual neuroimaging tools are well developed, their orchestration requires project-specific scripts, environment-adaptive tuning, and labor-intensive manual QC. To address this, we introduce NeuroPilot, a multi-agent system that digitalizes the expertise of neuroimage processing, QC, and data management into three LLM-invocable skills: dcm2bids-skill, neuroimage-pre-skill, and qc-agent-skill. The LLM-driven agent autonomously orchestrates workflows, generalizing various infrastructure settings into a single configuration to achieve the highest scalability. Demonstrating the system's generalizability, we deployed NeuroPilot across 17 cohorts (>123,000 subjects) spanning infant to aging populations and multiple MRI modalities (structural, diffusion, functional). In practice, after standardizing data via the dcm2bids-skill, the agent dynamically routes datasets to the optimal neuroimage-pre-skill based on available modalities and cohort traits (e.g., dispatching T1w and fMRI data to fMRIPrep, or selecting specialized pipelines for infant cohorts). The qc-agent-skill then drives an evidence-based, semi-automated QC via a 3-D browser dashboard, utilizing a multi-tiered verification system to optimize failed cases and escalate complex issues for supervisor inspection. Quantitatively, our QC agent screened 558 production subjects, validating its automated flags against FreeSurfer's topology-defect metrics. The infant processing pipeline achieved a 100% (201/201) completion rate on QC-validated inputs. Importantly, NeuroPilot compresses the traditional 2--3 month timeline for training staff and processing complete datasets into a single week. NeuroPilot is deployed in https://wanda-cyberbench.com/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuroPilot 是一个面向神经影像数据处理的多智能体系统，将数据标准化、模态特定预处理和质量控制 (QC) 封装为三个可被 LLM 调用的技能（dcm2bids-skill、neuroimage-pre-skill、qc-agent-skill），由 LLM 驱动的智能体自动编排工作流。该系统已在 17 个队列（超过 123,000 名受试者）上部署，覆盖从婴儿到老年的多种人群及结构、弥散、功能等多种 MRI 模态。实践中，QC agent 对 558 名生产受试者进行了筛查，婴儿处理流程在 QC 通过的输入上达到 100% (201/201) 完成率，并将传统 2–3 个月的处理时间压缩到一周。
Motivation: 原始神经影像档案转化为分析就绪产物依赖数据标准化、模态特定预处理和质量控制三个脆弱环节；虽然单个工具成熟，但其编排需要项目特定脚本、环境自适应调参和大量人工 QC，缺乏可扩展的自动化方案。
Method: 提出多智能体系统 NeuroPilot，将神经影像处理、QC 和数据管理专家经验数字化为三个 LLM 可调用的技能；LLM 驱动的智能体将不同基础设施设置泛化为单一配置以自主编排工作流，并在标准化数据后根据可用模态和队列特征动态路由到最优处理管线（如对 T1w/fMRI 选择 fMRIPrep，为婴儿队列选择专门管线）。qc-agent-skill 通过 3D 浏览器仪表盘驱动基于证据的半自动 QC，采用多层验证系统优化失败案例并将复杂问题上报给监督人员。
Result: QC agent 筛查了 558 名生产受试者，并依据 FreeSurfer 的拓扑缺陷指标验证其自动标记；婴儿处理管线在 QC 验证通过的输入上实现 100% (201/201) 完成率。整体上，NeuroPilot 将培训人员和处理完整数据集所需的传统 2–3 个月时间压缩到一周。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 NeuroPilot 通过 LLM 驱动的多智能体编排实现了跨队列、跨模态、跨基础设施的高可扩展性，并已在 https://wanda-cyberbench.com/ 部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TREAT: Evaluating Access to Formal Knowledge across Equivalent Mathematical Representations
papers.abstract_en: AI systems increasingly operate between flexible input representations and formal objects used by downstream tools. A key challenge is recognizing when an unfamiliar formulation denotes a known formal object. We study this challenge through theorem recognition: given an equivalence-preserving transformation of a theorem condition, a model must recover the theorem identity associated with the standard statement. We introduce TREAT, a benchmark for evaluating whether large language models can recover known theorem identities from equivalence-preserving formula-level transformations. Rather than paraphrasing theorem text, TREAT changes the mathematical form of theorem conditions themselves, expressing known results through residual equations, witness statements, optimization identities, set relations, operator forms, and proof-intermediate characterizations. Starting from scraped theorem pages, we filter for entries with usable mathematical expression forms, extract canonical theorem conditions, and generate transformed variants with recorded assumptions and inverse mappings. The final corpus contains 737 theorem identities and 29,480 transformed rows. On a test panel, the best model retrieves the correct theorem identity in only 60.73% of cases. Other systems reveal different failure modes, including abstention, wrong detection, and malformed outputs. These suggest that theorem knowledge can be fragile under equivalent changes in representation. TREAT therefore provides a controlled testbed for evaluating representation-robust access to formal knowledge, with broader relevance to domains that require stable target objects, explicit equivalence relations, validation procedures, and auditable scoring.
papers.comment: Accepted at 28th International Symposium on Symbolic and Numeric Algorithms for Scientific Computing (SYNASC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TREAT，一个用于评估大语言模型能否从等价保持的公式级变换中恢复已知定理身份的基准。该基准不是改写定理文本，而是改变定理条件本身的数学形式，用残差方程、见证陈述、优化恒等式、集合关系、算子形式和证明中间特征等方式表达已知结果。最终语料包含 737 个定理身份和 29,480 个变换行；在测试面板上，最佳模型仅以 60.73% 的正确率恢复定理身份，表明定理知识在等价表示变化下是脆弱的。
Motivation: AI 系统常在灵活输入表示与下游工具所使用的形式对象之间工作，识别不熟悉表述所对应的已知形式对象是一个关键挑战。论文通过定理识别来研究这一问题：给定定理条件的等价保持变换，模型必须恢复与标准表述关联的定理身份。
Method: 从爬取的定理页面中筛选具有可用数学表达形式的条目，提取规范定理条件，并生成带有记录假设和逆映射的变换变体。变换形式包括残差方程、见证语句、优化恒等式、集合关系、算子形式和证明中间特征等。
Result: 在测试面板上，最佳模型仅在 60.73% 的情况下正确检索出定理身份。其他系统展现出不同的失败模式，包括弃权、错误检测和格式错误输出。
Conclusion: 结果表明定理知识在等价表示变换下可能很脆弱。TREAT 因此为评估对形式知识的表示鲁棒访问提供了一个受控测试台，对需要稳定目标对象、显式等价关系、验证程序和可审计评分的领域具有更广泛的参考意义。

papers.title: When LLM Agents Negotiate: Private Information and Dynamic Bargaining in Supply Chains
papers.abstract_en: As LLM agents move from decision support to autonomous procurement, firms need to know whether delegated negotiators create value, divide it predictably, and avoid money-losing contracts. We study this in a canonical supply chain bargaining problem: a buyer with private demand information negotiates a quantity-payment contract with an uninformed seller. We benchmark nine LLMs from OpenAI, Google, and Alibaba against a validated Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium across 9,840 LLM-to-LLM negotiations. First, capability governs value creation. Agents agree in 98.9% of negotiations and capture 95.4% of first-best surplus undiscounted, but average 2.98 rounds against the benchmark's 1.25, and this delay erodes 21-34% of surplus. Capability also governs reliability: baseline models accept individually irrational contracts in 19.2% of cases, versus 0.0-0.6% at mid-tier and flagship, making automated profit verification the binding guardrail below that threshold. Second, surplus capture is relational. Provider identity predicts who captures surplus better than capability rank: self-play buyer shares average 40% for OpenAI, 50% for Google, and 70% for Alibaba's Qwen, an ordering that survives restricted communication and no discounting. Reversing which provider sells moves the division by 7-18 percentage points, and the capable Qwen flagship is the weakest cross-family seller: vendor choice is a first-order distributional decision. Third, the prompt is a strategic lever. Delegation separates the principal's economic patience from the agent's prompted strategic patience, a free deployment choice that is the single strongest driver of surplus division (90% of explained variance). Together these establish an equilibrium-referenced audit of AI agents along three dimensions: discounted efficiency, distributional profile, and operational reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM代理在供应链讨价还价中的表现，以拥有私有需求信息的买方与不知情卖方之间的数量-付款契约为基准场景，将OpenAI、Google、Alibaba的九种LLM与验证过的完美贝叶斯均衡（Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium）在9,840场LLM间谈判中对比。结果显示能力决定价值创造（98.9%达成协议，捕获95.4%的未贴现一阶最优剩余，但平均2.98轮对比基准1.25轮，延迟侵蚀21-34%剩余）；盈余分配具有关系性（供应商身份比能力排名更能预测谁捕获剩余）；提示词是战略性杠杆（委托分离经济耐心与提示的策略耐心，解释90%的已解释方差）。
Motivation: LLM代理正从决策支持转向自主采购，企业需要知道委派谈判者是否能创造价值、可预测地分配价值并避免亏本合同，而现有研究缺乏对这类谈判的均衡基准审计。
Method: 在规范的供应链讨价还价博弈中，以私有需求信息的买方与不知情卖方谈判数量-支付契约为模型，用九种LLM进行LLM对LLM的谈判，并以验证过的Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium作为基准，从贴现效率、分配特征和运行可靠性三个维度审计。
Result: 基线模型在19.2%的案例中接受个体非理性合同，而中端和旗舰模型仅为0.0-0.6%；自博弈买方平均盈余份额对OpenAI约40%、Google约50%、Alibaba的Qwen约70%，反转供应商身份使分配变动7-18个百分点；提示驱动的策略耐心是盈余分配最强的单一驱动因素。
Conclusion: 摘要强调LLM代理谈判需要一个均衡参照的审计框架，并指出能力、供应商身份与提示词分别影响效率、分配与可靠性，其中自动利润验证是低能力阈值下的关键护栏。

papers.title: An evolutionary model of animats with VLM-based subjective evaluation
papers.abstract_en: In this study, we propose a framework that incorporates subjective evaluations provided by a Vision-Language Model (VLM) into the fitness evaluation and selection processes of a genetic algorithm. As the target of evolution, we employ virtual soft robots with flexible morphologies and locomotion and present the VLM with sequence images representing the locomotion of two individuals. Selection is performed via pairwise comparisons based on subjective evaluation terms such as adorably and weirdly. The outcomes of these comparisons are used as selection pressure within the genetic algorithm, enabling the simultaneous evolution of morphology and locomotion. Experimental results demonstrate that subjective selection by the VLM accelerates population convergence compared to random selection, while also giving rise to distinctive morphologies and motions corresponding to each evaluation term. An auxiliary experiment with human participants further showed that, although individual pairwise choices only partly agreed with the VLM selections, the resulting morphological and locomotion tendencies were qualitatively similar and repeated human evaluations imposed noticeable fatigue. Moreover, the observation that similar evolutionary outcomes emerged across different evaluation terms suggests that the VLM does not apply these terms in a purely literal manner but instead decomposes them into multiple internal evaluation criteria when making judgments. This work visualizes the evolutionary process through which subjective linguistic expressions are mapped onto embodied phenotypes and provides a foundational framework for analyzing the structure of subjective judgment in VLMs. The proposed approach is expected to contribute to new developments in evolutionary computation and artificial life research based on subjective evaluation.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables. This manuscript has been accepted for publication in Artificial Life and Robotics following peer review
papers.journal_ref: Shota Miyazaki, Takaya Arita and Reiji Suzuki: An evolutionary model of animats with VLM-based subjective evaluation, Artificial Life and Robotics (2026). https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10015-026-01135-4
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个将视觉语言模型 (Vision-Language Model, VLM) 提供的主观评估纳入遗传算法 (genetic algorithm) 适应度评估与选择过程的框架。演化目标是具有柔性形态与运动能力的虚拟软体机器人，VLM 以序列图像比较两个个体的运动，并根据 adorably、weirdly 等主观评价词进行成对选择，以此作为选择压力同时演化形态与运动。实验表明主观选择比随机选择更快促成种群收敛，并产生与各评价词对应的独特形态与运动模式；人类参与者的辅助实验虽在个体成对选择上与 VLM 仅有部分一致，但形态与运动倾向定性相似，且重复评估对人有明显负担。
Motivation: 传统进化计算通常依赖客观适应度函数，而主观语言表达如何映射到具身表型 (embodied phenotypes) 尚不清楚；作者希望研究 VLM 主观判断在进化过程中的作用，并为人工生命与基于主观评价的进化计算提供分析框架。
Method: 提出将 VLM 的主观评价融入遗传算法的适应度与选择流程：以具有柔性形态和运动能力的虚拟软体机器人为演化对象，将两个个体的运动序列图像呈现给 VLM，基于 adorably、weirdly 等主观评价词做成对比较，比较结果作为遗传算法的选择压力，从而同时演化形态与运动。
Result: 摘要报告主观选择相比随机选择加速了种群收敛，并催生对应各评价词的独特形态与运动；辅助人类实验显示个体成对选择与 VLM 仅部分一致，但形态与运动倾向定性相似，且反复评估使人类感到疲劳。此外，不同评价词下出现相似的演化结果，提示 VLM 并非逐字理解这些词，而是将其拆分为多个内部评价标准。
Conclusion: 该工作可视化了主观语言表达映射到具身表型的进化过程，为分析 VLM 主观判断的结构提供了基础框架，并有望推动基于主观评价的进化计算与人工生命研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Evolving Safety Landscape of Multi-modal Large Language Models: A Survey of Emerging Threats and Safeguards
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) integrate heterogeneous modalities through modality alignment and fusion, enabling stronger understanding and reasoning. However, this architectural shift reshapes the safety landscape of machine learning. Increased model complexity and cross-modal interactions give rise to novel threats, including compromised modality integration, modality misalignment, and fused safety risks, reflecting shifts in threat modeling beyond uni-modal assumptions. These shifts, in turn, impose new constraints on safety solutions not captured by existing frameworks rooted in uni-modal learning. Motivated by these challenges, this survey provides a systematic analysis of the evolving safety landscape of MLLMs. We first propose a multimodal grounded taxonomy of safety threats and analyze shifts in threat models, covering adversarial attacks, data poisoning, jailbreaks, and hallucinations. We then summarize updated safety assumptions and organize recent advances in MLLM safety strategies accordingly. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future directions to inform the development of more principled and scalable safety mechanisms for multimodal systems.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Principled Design for Trustworthy AI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 安全性的综述，系统分析了模态对齐与融合带来的新型安全威胁与防护策略。作者提出一个基于多模态的威胁分类体系，涵盖对抗攻击、数据投毒、越狱与幻觉，并梳理了对应的安全假设更新与近年防御进展。文章还讨论了开放挑战与未来方向，旨在为多模态系统的可扩展安全机制提供原则性指导。
Motivation: 现有安全框架多基于单模态学习假设，无法覆盖 MLLMs 因跨模态交互而产生的新威胁，如模态整合受损、模态错位与融合安全风险，威胁建模已超出单模态范畴。
Method: 作者提出一个多模态 grounded 的威胁分类体系，分析威胁模型从单模态到多模态的转变，并据此总结更新的安全假设，组织并归纳近年 MLLM 安全策略的研究进展。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果；其主要产出是覆盖对抗攻击、数据投毒、越狱和幻觉的威胁分类体系，以及按安全假设组织的现有防御策略梳理。
Conclusion: 作者强调需要发展更具原则性且可扩展的多模态系统安全机制，并指出开放挑战与未来研究方向。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Ultraconstructive Model Theory via Bounded Adversarial Finite Structures
papers.abstract_en: Ultraconstructive Model Theory (UCMT) replaces idealized satisfaction, at finite compu- tational scale, by bounded adversarial survival. A finite partial structure is tested by an Opponent (Devil) drawing legal challenges from a bounded attack surface, repaired by a Builder (God) through legal replies, and certified by a symbolic Judge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ultraconstructive Model Theory (UCMT)，用有界对抗生存 (bounded adversarial survival) 替代有限计算尺度上的理想化满足关系。框架将有限偏结构建模为一场对抗博弈：Opponent (Devil) 从有界攻击面提取合法挑战，Builder (God) 通过合法回复修复结构，symbolic Judge 对结果进行认证。摘要仅给出框架定义，未提供具体定理或实验。
Motivation: 传统模型论依赖理想化的满足关系，在有限计算尺度下难以直接构造或验证；作者希望用有界对抗博弈的视角重新定义模型论中的满足与构造过程。
Method: 提出一种三元角色框架：有限偏结构接受 Opponent 从有界攻击面提出合法挑战，Builder 以合法回复进行修复，再由 symbolic Judge 进行符号层面的认证，以此替代传统的可满足性判定。
Conclusion: 摘要的核心贡献是提出 UCMT 这一替代性框架，将模型论中的满足问题转化为有界对抗生存问题；未涉及实证结果或局限性的讨论。

papers.title: MetaSpace: Metamorphic Testing for Spatial Cognition in Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: An embodied agent is an intelligent entity that interacts with its environment through a physical body. Currently, the evaluation of embodied agents primarily relies on two paradigms: (1) manually annotated Visual Question Answering (VQA) pairs and (2) high-level task completion metrics, such as success in navigation or manipulation. The former is labor-intensive and subject to variability in annotation quality. The latter may obscure critical vulnerabilities, allowing agents to complete tasks through suboptimal means or safety violations, thereby concealing safety risks and inefficiencies. Given that spatial cognition is the cornerstone for executing embodied tasks, there is a pressing need to assess whether embodied agents possess robust spatial cognition during task execution. Inspired by metamorphic testing principles in software engineering, we propose MetaSpace, a novel framework designed to evaluate the spatial cognition of agents. By leveraging spatiotemporal multimodal states derived from real execution trajectories, MetaSpace automatically generates test cases based on predefined metamorphic relations (MRs) grounded in logical rules and physical laws. Crucially, we encode these MRs as executable rules in a logic programming language (Prolog). Violations of these relations indicate failures in spatial cognition. Our empirical evaluation across three embodied scenarios demonstrates that MetaSpace successfully detects 90,422 spatial cognition errors in state-of-the-art (SOTA) MLLM-driven agents. We introduce the Spatial Cognition (SC) score to quantify performance. Results indicate that all SOTA agents achieve average scores between 0.44 and 0.52, significantly lower than the human benchmark of 0.96.

papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the ACM on Programming Languages, 10, OOPSLA1 (April 2026), 343-372
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MetaSpace，一个基于蜕变测试 (metamorphic testing) 原理评估具身智能体空间认知的框架。它从真实执行轨迹中提取时空多模态状态，依据逻辑规则和物理定律定义蜕变关系 (MR)，并将其编码为 Prolog 可执行规则；违反这些关系即视为空间认知失败。在三个具身场景中，MetaSpace 在 SOTA MLLM 驱动的智能体上检测到 90,422 个空间认知错误，并引入 Spatial Cognition (SC) 分数进行量化。
Motivation: 现有具身智能体评估主要依赖手工标注的 VQA 对或高层任务完成指标（如导航/操作成功率），前者成本高且标注质量不稳定，后者可能掩盖关键漏洞，使智能体通过次优手段或违反安全完成目标，从而隐藏安全风险与低效问题。
Method: MetaSpace 借鉴软件工程中的蜕变测试思想，利用真实执行轨迹产生的时空多模态状态，根据逻辑规则和物理定律自动生成基于预设蜕变关系的测试用例；这些 MR 被编码为 Prolog 逻辑程序中的可执行规则，运行时若关系被违反则判定为空间认知缺陷。
Result: 在三个具身场景上的实验显示，MetaSpace 在 SOTA 智能体（MLLM 驱动）中检测到 90,422 个空间认知错误；所有 SOTA 智能体的平均 SC 分数介于 0.44 至 0.52，明显低于人类基准的 0.96。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 MetaSpace 能够自动、大规模地暴露具身智能体在执行任务过程中的空间认知失败，并通过 SC 分数对性能进行量化对比；摘要未提及方法的局限。

papers.title: Dynamic Coalition Formation and Communication Pricing in Skill-Based Agentic AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Modern agentic AI systems combine multiple large language model agents with heterogeneous skills, yet most architectures either fix communication in advance or allow full broadcast. Both can be inefficient because token cost, latency, redundancy, and error propagation increase with the number of active agents and communication links. We model agent selection and communication as a cooperative game with task-conditioned net utility $U(C\mid x)=V(C\mid x)-\sum_{i\in C}c_i$, separating coalition-level costs from agent activation costs. We propose a marginal-value activation rule and greedy router, extend the model to optimize communication edges with per-edge costs, and use estimated Shapley values to predict which agents are worth contacting before and during execution. We connect the problem to submodular maximization and prove two limited guarantees: a curvature-refined bound for a monotone, cardinality-constrained special case, and a tight $1/2$-approximation, with a correction for signed objectives, for an unconstrained non-monotone case via double greedy. Neither guarantee applies directly to the main router, which remains a heuristic. We also prove a Shapley-submodularity sandwich bound linking the error of marginal-value routing to a per-agent diminishing-returns quantity. In synthetic experiments, greedy routing achieves $99.5%$ of brute-force-optimal utility while activating $1.96$ of $8$ agents on average, compared with $38.8%$ for full broadcast. Performance is robust to activation cost and redundancy weight but falls to $66%$ under strong violations of submodularity or noisy value estimates. We distinguish the framework from Shapley pricing, hedonic coalition formation, and communication-graph pruning, and propose evaluation on real multi-agent LLM benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把技能异构的多智能体 agentic AI 系统中的 agent 选择与通信建模为带任务条件净效用的合作博弈，提出边际价值激活规则和贪心路由 (greedy router)，并用估计 Shapley 值在运行前及运行中预测值得联系的 agent。摘要证明了两类受限理论保证（单调基数约束下的曲率修正界、非单调无约束情形下 double greedy 的紧 1/2 近似），但主路由仍属启发式。合成实验中贪心路由达到暴力最优效用的 99.5%，平均激活 8 个中的 1.96 个 agent，远优于全广播的 38.8%。
Motivation: 现有 agentic AI 系统要么预先固定通信结构，要么允许全广播，二者都因 token 成本、延迟、冗余和错误传播随活跃 agent 数与通信链路数增长而低效。
Method: 将 agent 选择和通信建模为合作博弈，效用为任务条件价值减去 coalition 级成本与 agent 激活成本；提出边际价值激活规则和贪心路由，扩展到带逐边成本的通信边优化，并用估计 Shapley 值预测执行前后值得联系的 agent。理论部分把问题联系到子模最大化 (submodular maximization)，给出曲率修正界、无约束非单调情形的双贪心 1/2 近似，以及连接边际价值路由误差与逐 agent 递减收益量的 Shapley-子模 sandwich bound。
Result: 合成实验中，贪心路由获得暴力最优效用的 99.5%，平均激活 8 个中的 1.96 个 agent，而全广播只达到 38.8%；性能对激活成本和冗余权重鲁棒，但在子模性被强违反或价值估计有噪声时降至 66%。
Conclusion: 摘要明确主路由不适用所证明的近似保证，仍为启发式；论文将框架与 Shapley pricing、hedonic coalition formation 和通信图剪枝区分开，并提议在真实多智能体 LLM 基准上进一步评估。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Search-G1: Grounded Search Agents via Representation-Based Intrinsic Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Search-augmented language agents should retrieve external information only when necessary and ground their answers in retrieved evidence. Existing external rewards provide either sparse outcome supervision or richer feedback from process annotations and LLM judges. Outcome rewards scale readily but cannot distinguish grounded retrieval from redundant search, whereas richer signals require costly annotation or inference during training. Internal rewards based on policy-side signals such as entropy, likelihood, or information gain are graded and inexpensive to evaluate, yet mainly reflect model confidence rather than evidence grounding. We propose Search-G1, a representation-based intrinsic reward framework that measures the operational grounding of an agent's answers through two intervention-calibrated readouts. A prompt-state readout predicts closed-book sufficiency, whose complement defines policy-relative retrieval necessity; an answer-commit readout estimates evidence reliance from answer-stage sensitivity to evidence deletion. Together, they provide additional credit to correct searched trajectories when retrieval is estimated necessary and the answer is evidence-sensitive, favor correct direct answers when closed-book knowledge suffices, and penalize repeated search. After calibration, reward scoring requires neither process annotations nor LLM-as-judge inference during policy optimization. Because reinforcement learning changes policy representations, Search-G1 periodically refits both readouts on trajectories from the latest checkpoint, allowing the reward to co-evolve with the policy. Experiments across multiple search-based question-answering benchmarks and two model scales show that Search-G1 improves the grounding--search-cost trade-off, producing shorter response-side trajectories at competitive task accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/Rosy0912/Search-G1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Search-G1，一个基于表征的内在奖励框架，用于搜索增强语言代理。它通过两个干预校准的读头分别估计封闭书籍充分性和证据依赖，从而在不依赖过程标注或 LLM-as-judge 推断的情况下提供奖励信号。实验表明，在多个搜索式问答基准和两种模型规模下，该方法改善了接地与搜索成本之间的权衡，在保持竞争力任务准确率的同时缩短响应侧轨迹。
Motivation: 现有外部奖励要么是稀疏的结果监督，要么依赖昂贵的过程标注或大模型评判；而基于策略侧的熵、似然或信息增益的内部奖励主要反映模型置信度，而非答案对检索证据的接地程度。
Method: 提出两个干预校准的读头：prompt-state 读头预测封闭书籍充分性，其补集定义策略相关的检索必要性；answer-commit 读头通过答案阶段对证据删除的敏感性估计证据依赖。由于强化学习会改变策略表征，Search-G1 会周期性地在最新检查点的轨迹上重新拟合两个读头，使奖励与策略共同演化。
Result: 在多个基于搜索的问答基准和两个模型规模上，Search-G1 改善了 grounding–search-cost 权衡，产生更短的响应侧轨迹，同时保持有竞争力的任务准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，校准后的奖励评分在策略优化期间既不需要过程标注，也不需要 LLM-as-judge 推断，且奖励能与策略共演化。

papers.title: NL2SHACL-Bench: A Benchmark Suite for Natural Language to SHACL Translation
papers.abstract_en: SHACL is a core technology for validating the conformance of RDF knowledge graphs (KGs). Yet, authoring SHACL shapes requires technical expertise that most domain experts lack. Translating natural language requirements into SHACL (NL2SHACL) would lower this barrier. However, there is no dedicated benchmark for NL2SHACL, and evaluating generated shapes requires methods beyond string comparison, as semantically equivalent shapes can differ in serialisation and structure. To tackle these challenges, we present NL2SHACL-Bench, a benchmark suite for natural language to SHACL translation. Using NL2SHACL-Bench, we evaluate four state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) for this task. Our results show that current LLMs are highly capable of generating syntactically valid SHACL, but still struggle to produce semantically equivalent constraints for complex logical and structural patterns. This indicates that NL2SHACL-Bench provides a meaningful basis for measuring advances in the NL2SHACL state of the art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NL2SHACL-Bench，一个用于评测自然语言到 SHACL 翻译（NL2SHACL）任务的基准套件，旨在解决 RDF 知识图谱中 SHACL 形状编写需要专业知识的问题。作者用该基准评估了四种先进的大语言模型（LLM），发现当前 LLM 能生成语法有效的 SHACL，但在复杂逻辑和结构模式下难以生成语义等价的约束。基准提供了一种超越字符串比较的语义级评测方式。
Motivation: SHACL 是验证 RDF 知识图谱一致性的核心技术，但编写 SHACL 形状需要专业技术知识，领域专家难以直接使用。将自然语言需求翻译为 SHACL 可以降低该门槛，但缺乏专门的基准来评测这一任务，且语义等价的形状可能在序列化和结构上不同，需要超越字符串比较的评估方法。
Method: 构建 NL2SHACL-Bench 基准套件，包含自然语言需求与其对应的 SHACL 形状，并采用关注语义等价性的评测方法。使用该基准评估四种当前先进的大语言模型在 NL2SHACL 任务上的表现。
Result: 结果显示当前 LLM 在生成语法有效的 SHACL 方面能力较强，但对于复杂的逻辑和结构模式，难以生成语义等价的约束。这表明 NL2SHACL-Bench 为衡量 NL2SHACL 技术的进展提供了有效基础。
Conclusion: 论文强调 NL2SHACL-Bench 填补了 NL2SHACL 领域缺乏专门基准的空白，并为后续评测和提升 LLM 在该任务上的表现提供了基础。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: WuYuEval: A Multi-Level Benchmark for Large Language Models in Solid Waste Management
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as technical assistants, but their competence in solid waste management (SWM) remains difficult to assess because existing benchmarks emphasize general knowledge rather than professional decisions under engineering, environmental, and policy constraints. We introduce WuYuEval, a multi-level benchmark for evaluating LLMs in SWM across foundational knowledge, domain reasoning, and expert decision-making. After quality auditing, WuYuEval contains a Foundation Module with 4,590 closed-ended multiple-choice questions across six task types and eight domain categories, together with an Expert Module with 247 scenario-based open-ended questions involving multi-objective optimization, constraint trade-offs, and system design. For expert tasks, we combine anchor-calibrated LLM-as-a-Judge scoring with Elo-based pairwise comparison. Across 33 LLMs, performance varied widely. The leading model reached 94.64\% accuracy on the Foundation Module, but average accuracy still fell from 84.14\% on easy questions to 42.50\% on hard questions, with lower performance concentrated in calculation, experimental design, urban planning, and open-ended expert tasks. Reasoning-oriented Thinking modes improve most matched model pairs after auditing, but the gains depend on baseline capability and are not uniformly positive. These results suggest that visible deliberation helps only when it remains anchored to units, assumptions, and engineering constraints; otherwise, it may drift from decisive answer boundaries. WuYuEval therefore provides both an evaluation resource and an empirical basis for developing SWM-oriented foundation models with professional reasoning chains and explicit constraint control.

papers.title: The Knowing-Saying Gap: When Probes See Errors that Confidence Misses
papers.abstract_en: Linear probes detect corrupted context in language models with near-perfect accuracy, yet this does not translate into reliable failure prediction. The result is a dissociation with direct implications for deployment monitoring. Across multi-hop arithmetic chains, probes that detect corruption turn out to be uninformative about final answer correctness; models forced into structured confidence formats collapse to two values with indistinguishable error rates; and probe persistence across hops fails to separate correct from incorrect outcomes, refuting our pre-registered "persistence beats peak" hypothesis. This pattern of knowing but not saying generalises across model families including reasoning models. As a real-time monitor, probe-based interventions are sharply model and error-type dependent: branch-and-pick is net-positive across models and uniquely non-breaking on Llama-3.1-8B (4 rescued, 0 broken), while reprompt and replace-prior break correct traces at roughly the rate they rescue wrong ones. Probe-based monitoring is a necessary complement to verbalised confidence, but no single intervention dominates, and the deployable answer is model-aware, error-type-aware routing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型中线性探针 (linear probes) 的高检测准确率与失败预测能力之间的脱节，作者称之为 knowing-saying gap。在多跳算术链上，能检测上下文损坏的探针对最终答案正确性没有信息量；模型被强制采用结构化置信度格式时，输出坍缩为两个错误率无差别的值；跨跳的探针持续性也无法区分正确与错误结果，否定了预先注册的 persistence beats peak 假设。该现象在包括推理模型在内的多个模型家族中普遍存在，且基于探针的干预效果高度依赖模型与错误类型。
Motivation: 探针能近乎完美地检测损坏上下文，但这种能力并未转化为可靠的失败预测，这种分离直接关乎部署监控。现有依赖口头化置信度 (verbalised confidence) 的监控方式可能漏掉探针可见的隐藏错误，因此需要系统检验探针信号与最终正确性之间的关系。
Method: 作者在多跳算术链任务上设计了预注册实验，考察线性探针的损坏检测能力、结构化置信度格式下的输出分布，以及探针跨跳的持续性是否与答案正确性相关；并比较三种基于探针的干预策略：branch-and-pick、reprompt 和 replace-prior。
Result: 摘要报告核心发现为探针检测与正确性预测的分离：探针持久性无法区分正确与错误结果；结构化置信度坍缩成两个值。干预实验中 branch-and-pick 在所有模型上净收益为正，且在 Llama-3.1-8B 上唯一不破坏正确轨迹（4 个被挽救，0 个被破坏），而 reprompt 和 replace-prior 破坏正确轨迹的比率与挽救错误轨迹的比率大致相当。
Conclusion: 探针监测是口头化置信度的必要补充，但没有任何单一干预策略占优；可部署的答案应是模型感知、错误类型感知的路由 (model-aware, error-type-aware routing)。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DocAtlas: Long-Document Understanding as Mutable-State Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Long-document understanding requires models to find and combine evidence across many pages, layouts, tables, figures, and charts. Existing retrieval-augmented systems usually select evidence from a static index before generation, while recent agentic systems add multi-turn tool use but often rely on frozen proprietary backbones whose behavior is set by prompts. We present DocAtlas, a system that treats long-document understanding as a mutable-state information-seeking process. We instantiate DocAtlas as a mutable document harness: an external environment that determines what document information is searched, read, stored, reviewed, and shown to the model at each step. Given a document and question, the harness exposes search, reading, note-taking, and review tools, maintains a hierarchical tree and note store, and updates both as the agent records evidence. DocAtlas combines self-improving retrieval, selective evidence access, and active working memory under a fixed context budget. The same harness supports inference-time use with large VLMs and end-to-end reinforcement learning for compact VLM agents. With GPT-5.4, DocAtlas reaches 71.4\% on MMLongBench-Doc, exceeding the human-expert reference of 65.8\%. A Qwen3.5-4B VLM trained with end-to-end RL in the DocAtlas environment reaches 63.7\%, compared with a 54.4\% direct-input baseline, showing that mutable document-harness design can improve compact document agents by a large margin.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DocAtlas 将长文档理解建模为可变状态的信息寻求过程，通过外部可变的文档 harness 控制每一时刻对文档信息的搜索、读取、存储、回顾与呈现。系统维护分层树与笔记存储，在固定上下文预算下结合自改进检索、选择性证据访问和主动工作记忆。用 GPT-5.4 在 MMLongBench-Doc 达到 71.4%，超过人类专家参照 65.8%；用 Qwen3.5-4B VLM 在环境内做端到端 RL 训练达到 63.7%，显著高于 54.4% 的直接输入基线。
Motivation: 现有检索增强系统通常在生成前从静态索引选择证据，而 agentic 系统往往依赖由提示词设定的冻结专有模型，难以在交互过程中动态决定应该搜索、阅读、存储和回顾哪些文档信息。
Method: 提出 DocAtlas，将长文档理解视为可变状态的信息寻求过程，并实现为可变文档 harness：外部环境决定每一步的搜索、阅读、笔记与回顾工具，维护分层树和笔记存储，在智能体记录证据时更新两者；结合自改进检索、选择性证据访问和主动工作记忆，并保持固定上下文预算；同一 harness 既支持大 VLM 的推理期使用，也支持对紧凑 VLM agent 做端到端强化学习。
Result: 使用 GPT-5.4 时在 MMLongBench-Doc 上达到 71.4%，超过人类专家参照的 65.8%；在 DocAtlas 环境中用端到端 RL 训练的 Qwen3.5-4B VLM 达到 63.7%，而直接输入基线为 54.4%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可变文档 harness 设计能以较大幅度提升紧凑文档智能体的表现，并展示了同一环境同时支持推理期增强与端到端 RL 训练。

papers.title: Unified Hallucination Fuzzing for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Hallucination remains a persistent challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), severely limiting their reliability in high-stakes applications. Existing evaluations, predominantly based on static benchmarks, suffer from narrow taxonomical coverage and rapid performance saturation, failing to reflect model robustness in evolving real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic evaluation framework integrating a comprehensive benchmark with self-evolving stress testing. First, we introduce UniHall, a fine-grained dataset grounded in a unified taxonomy spanning Object, Instruction, and Knowledge dimensions. Second, to address benchmark saturation, we propose Self-Adaptive Multimodal Fuzzing (SAMF), a self-adaptive framework that employs evolutionary mutation strategies to explore the boundaries of model hallucinations. Crucially, to ensure reliable assessment of dynamic inputs, SAMF incorporates a structured metric suite driven by an ensemble of multi-modal oracles. Our extensive experiments reveal that state-of-the-art MLLMs exhibit significant performance degradation under fuzzing compared to conventional settings, exposing a dissociation between reasoning capabilities and factual grounding. Furthermore, we identify a helpfulness-hallucination trade-off, where reinforcement learning alignment inadvertently exacerbates sycophancy in instruction-following tasks. The framework, code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/LanceZPF/EvalHall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）幻觉问题的系统评估框架，包含基于统一分类体系（Object、Instruction、Knowledge 三维度）的细粒度基准 UniHall，以及自适应的多模态模糊测试方法 SAMF。SAMF 采用进化变异策略探索模型幻觉边界，并通过多模态 oracle 集成的结构化指标套件保证动态输入评估的可靠性。实验表明，SOTA MLLM 在模糊测试下性能显著下降，并暴露出 helpfulness-hallucination 之间的权衡。
Motivation: 现有幻觉评估主要依赖静态基准，存在分类覆盖窄和性能快速饱和的问题，难以反映模型在动态真实场景下的鲁棒性，因此需要更具演进性的压力测试框架。
Method: 引入 UniHall 数据集，基于统一幻觉分类体系覆盖 Object、Instruction、Knowledge 三个维度；提出 Self-Adaptive Multimodal Fuzzing (SAMF)，用进化变异策略动态生成输入以探索幻觉边界，并设计由多模态 oracle 集成的结构化指标套件来可靠评估动态输入。
Result: 实验显示 SOTA MLLM 在模糊测试下相比常规设置出现显著性能退化，暴露出推理能力与事实根基（factual grounding）的分离；同时识别出 helpfulness-hallucination 权衡，即强化学习对齐会无意中加剧指令跟随任务中的谄媚行为（sycophancy）。
Conclusion: 论文强调用动态模糊测试补充静态基准以评估不断演化的幻觉风险，并开源了框架、代码和基准。
