papers.title: Training Variable Long Sequences with Data-Centric Parallel
papers.abstract_en: Training deep learning models on variable long sequences poses significant computational challenges. Existing methods force a difficult trade-off between efficiency and ease-of-use. Simple approaches use static configurations that cause workload imbalance low efficiency, while complex methods introduces significant complexity and code change for new models. To break this trade-off, we introduce Data-Centric Parallel (DCP). Its core principle is to let the data itself drive the runtime. It achieves this by dynamically adjusting direct runtime settings (e.g., parallel size, gradient accumulation, recomputation) based on each batch's sequence length. Empirical results demonstrate that our method achieves up to a 2.88$\times$ speedup on 32 H200 GPUs. Designed for generalization, it can be integrated into any model with 10 lines of code. We anticipate this simple yet effective approach will serve as a robust baseline and facilitate future advancements in distributed training for variable long sequences.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: From Evaluated Models to Evaluation Aids: A Multi-Evidence Study of LLM-Based Difficulty Calibration for Programming Examinations
papers.abstract_en: Difficulty differences across parallel-class programming examinations affect the fairness of course assessment. This study repositions large language models from benchmark evaluation targets to auxiliary evidence sources for interpreting exam difficulty, combining AI evidence with aggregated student performance, item exposure, online-judge process data, and teacher interpretation. First, ten models solved an eight-problem final exam synchronously with 120 students: AI pass rate correlated positively with student pass rate (Spearman rho = 0.866, exact p = 0.0119), and a solving-based composite difficulty index correlated negatively with it (rho = -0.905, exact p = 0.0046). A single structured reviewer was then run via auditable API calls on a third-party OpenAI-compatible endpoint whose model label (gpt-5.6-sol) cannot authenticate an official OpenAI upstream model; call metadata and raw responses are archived. Across 79 problems from 11 parallel-class final exams, AI overall difficulty correlated with problem-level pass rate at rho = -0.871 and with non-attempt rate at rho = 0.800; in a 26-problem longitudinal Data Structures and Algorithms B sample, the correlations were -0.829 and 0.883. A 106-problem introductory-course (CS101) sample marks the boundary: the problem-level correlation weakened to rho = -0.552, and the exam-level correlation across 16 exams was near zero, with cohort composition dominating exam-level outcomes. Exposure-discount (0-0.40) and duplicate-problem perturbation tests did not change these directions. AI evidence can thus serve as an external reference for problem validation, parallel-class fairness discussion, and longitudinal quality tracking, while the model-identity boundary, single-reviewer design, and review-output instability set explicit limits: AI difficulty scales must not be used for individual student evaluation or automatic grade adjustment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新定位大型语言模型（LLM）的角色，将其从基准评估目标转变为辅助证据源，用于解释并行班级编程考试的难度差异。研究让十个模型与一百二十名学生同步作答八道题，并结合学生成绩、题目曝光度、在线评测（OJ）过程数据及教师解释进行多证据分析。结果显示AI通过率与学生通过率显著正相关，AI难度估计与题目通过率显著负相关，但在大规模入门课程样本中相关性明显减弱，作者据此划定了AI难度证据的适用边界。
Motivation: 并行班级编程考试的难度差异会直接影响课程考核的公平性，而仅凭传统统计指标难以对难度进行可解释的外部参考。本文试图将LLM从被评估的模型转换为辅助证据来源，为题目难度校验、平行班公平讨论和纵向质量追踪提供外部参照。
Method: 首先在八题期末考试中让十个模型与一百二十名学生同步作答，计算AI通过率与学生通过率的Spearman相关，并构建基于解题表现的复合难度指数。随后通过可审计的API调用在第三方OpenAI兼容端点上运行单个结构化审查器（模型标签为gpt-5.6-sol，但无法认证为官方OpenAI上游模型），对79题、26题纵向样本和106题CS101样本进行难度相关分析，并使用曝光折扣（0-0.40）与重复题目扰动进行稳健性检验。
Result: AI通过率与学生通过率正相关（Spearman rho=0.866，exact p=0.0119），复合难度指数与学生通过率负相关（rho=-0.905，exact p=0.0046）。79题样本中，AI整体难度与题目通过率rho=-0.871，与未尝试率rho=0.800；26题纵向样本中分别为-0.829和0.883；106题CS101样本中题目级相关减弱至rho=-0.552，且16场考试级相关接近零。曝光折扣与重复题目扰动未改变结论方向。
Conclusion: AI证据可以作为题目验证、平行班公平讨论和纵向质量跟踪的外部参考，但模型身份无法认证、单一审查器设计以及审查输出不稳定性构成明确限制，因此AI难度标尺不得用于个别学生评估或自动成绩调整。

papers.title: Explainable Machine Learning in Healthcare: Methods, Interpretation, and Applications for Clinical Research
papers.abstract_en: We present a structured review of commonly used Explainable machine learning (XML) methodologies, including global and local interpretability tools such as SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP), Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanations (LIME), Partial Dependence Plots (PDP), and Individual Conditional Expectation (ICE) plots. For each method, we explain the underlying mechanism at a high level, visualize representative outputs, and provide structured guidance on interpretation, appropriate use, and limitations, illustrated using the publicly available Heart Disease dataset. XML techniques provided intuitive visual and quantitative insights into how predictors influence model predictions. Global methods characterized population-level feature effects, whereas local methods revealed patient-level contributions useful for individualized interpretation. Our worked examples demonstrate how XML outputs can identify nonlinear relationships, detect interaction effects, and reveal heterogeneity in predicted risk across patients, addressing key challenges in translating ML predictions into interpretable outputs for clinical research. XML tools offer valuable interpretability for ML models and support more transparent and accountable ML applications in clinical research. By providing a methodologically grounded overview alongside practical implementation examples and structured guidance on each method's strengths and limitations, this primer helps bridge the gap between advanced ML methodology and clinical applicability. Thoughtful adoption of XML approaches may facilitate better understanding, communication, and critical evaluation of ML predictions in healthcare research, ultimately supporting evidence-based clinical decision-making.
papers.journal_ref: J. Am. Med. Inform. Assoc. 33 (2026) ocag077
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于可解释机器学习（XML）在临床研究中应用的系统综述，重点介绍 SHAP、LIME、PDP 和 ICE 等全局与局部可解释性方法。作者以公开的 Heart Disease 数据集演示每种方法的输出，并给出解释、适用场景和局限性的结构化指导。摘要报告称这些方法能直观地揭示预测因子的影响，识别非线性关系、交互效应和患者间风险异质性。
Motivation: 临床研究中机器学习预测结果往往缺乏透明度和可解释性，阻碍模型从方法论走向实际临床应用；作者希望弥补先进 ML 方法与临床可用性之间的差距。
Method: 对常用 XML 方法进行结构化综述，包括全局解释工具（PDP、SHAP 的全局视角）和局部解释工具（LIME、ICE、SHAP 的局部视角），并基于 Heart Disease 数据集提供可视化示例和适用性指南。
Result: 摘要显示全局方法刻画群体层面的特征效应，局部方法揭示患者个体层面的贡献；实例证明 XML 输出能够识别非线性关系、检测交互效应，并展示预测风险在不同患者间的异质性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 XML 工具能为临床研究中的 ML 模型提供有价值的可解释性，帮助更透明、更负责任地应用 ML；合理采用这些方法可改善对预测结果的理解、沟通和批判性评估，最终支持循证临床决策。

papers.title: KumbhDoot: A Scale-Ready, LLM-Bounded Architecture for Mass-Gathering Public-Service Assistants
papers.abstract_en: Mass religious gatherings such as the Kumbh Mela concentrate tens of millions of people into a single region over a few weeks, producing intense, repetitive, multilingual, and safety-critical demand for information. The default response, a conversational assistant that routes every query to a large language model (LLM), is poorly matched to this setting: it is costly at scale, slow on emergency paths, prone to hallucination on facts that can cause physical harm, and unusable when connectivity fails. We describe KumbhDoot, an agentic pilgrim assistant for the Nashik Simhastha Kumbh Mela built on a different principle. It operates on a foundational design principle that prioritizes semantic similarity over starting with an LLM. Generative models are invoked only in instances where similarity-based retrieval is insufficient to produce a correct answer. The system utilizes a "semantic cache": an embedding-indexed store as a single retrieval primitive, which handles intent routing, answer caching, offline lookups, and multi-agent retrieval. A custom three-tier agent architecture operates directly on this store, ensuring decision paths remain inspectable and avoiding the use of generic multi-agent frameworks that would trigger implicit per-step LLM calls. We present the architecture, an analytical cost model for its per-query economics, and an honest account of where similarity is sufficient and where generative reasoning remains necessary. We argue that for bounded, high-stakes, low-connectivity public-service domains, a similarity-first and LLM-bounded design is not merely cheaper but architecturally more appropriate than an LLM-default one.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KumbhDoot，一个面向大规模宗教集会（如 Nashik Simhastha Kumbh Mela）的智能体式朝圣者助手架构，其核心原则是“相似性优先、LLM 受限”（similarity-first, LLM-bounded）。系统以嵌入索引的“语义缓存”（semantic cache）作为唯一检索原语，承担意图路由、答案缓存、离线查询与多智能体检索，仅在相似性检索不足以给出正确答案时才调用生成式模型。作者给出了每查询成本的分析模型，并讨论了相似性检索足够与仍需生成式推理的场景。
Motivation: 大型宗教集会会在数周内将数千万人集中到单一区域，产生高重复、多语言且安全关键的信息需求。默认的“所有查询都路由给 LLM”的对话助手在此场景下成本高、应急路径慢、易产生可能造成人身伤害的幻觉，且在断网时不可用。
Method: 构建一个三层智能体架构，直接操作嵌入索引的语义缓存存储，避免使用会隐式触发逐步 LLM 调用的通用多智能体框架。生成式模型仅在基于相似性的检索不足以产生正确答案时才被调用，从而限制 LLM 的使用边界。
Result: 摘要给出架构描述与每查询经济性的解析成本模型，并提出一个关于相似性何时足够、何时仍需生成式推理的如实说明，但没有报告具体的实验数据或基准测试结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为，对于有界、高利害、低连接性的公共服务领域，相似性优先且 LLM 受限的设计不仅在成本上更低，而且在架构上比 LLM 默认方式更合适。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Representation Matters in Longitudinal Affective Computing
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal, in-the-wild, wearable sensing yields day-level physiology, sleep, activity, and environmental streams, whereas affect and cognition are labeled only episodically (per waves). We recast this cadence mismatch as a temporal representation problem and compare three wave-level mappings from dense histories to sparse labels: levels (within-wave summaries), absolute drift (change across waves), and proportional drift. Using almost a year of data from 82 adults in the Providemus alz study, we model 21 affect and cognition outcomes. Day-scale signals are reduced to compact wave-level descriptors (central tendency, dispersion, and distributional shape) and learned with four regressors under two orthogonal evaluation axes: leave-one-subject-out and leave-one-wave-out. Performance is reported as scaled MAE using both mean and median across folds. Differences emerge: affective states are best predicted by wave-to-wave absolute drift, whereas cognitive performance aligns with within-wave levels, reflecting emotion dynamic theories. Across windowing features, shape descriptors (e.g., minima, kurtosis) carry more signal than simple means/medians. We contribute a representation triad for sparse-label modelling, a wave-level feature schema applicable on-device, and a dual-axis reporting practice that separates cross-participant generalization from temporal robustness. These results convert temporal representation from an implicit preprocessing step into an explicit, testable design choice for real-world affective-computing applications in brain health.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把纵向情感计算中密集传感器数据与稀疏波次标签之间的节奏不匹配重构为时间表征问题，比较三种波级映射：水平值（levels）、绝对漂移（absolute drift）和比例漂移（proportional drift）。基于 Providemus alz 研究中 82 名成人近一年的数据，建模 21 个情感与认知结局，发现情感状态最好由波间绝对漂移预测，而认知表现与波内水平值对齐；形状描述符（如最小值、峰度）比简单均值/中位数携带更多信号。作者贡献了稀疏标签建模的表征三元组、可设备端应用的波级特征模式，以及分离跨被试泛化与时间鲁棒性的双轴报告实践。
Motivation: 纵向、野外可穿戴传感提供日级生理、睡眠、活动和环境流，但情感与认知标签仅按波次稀疏标注，这种节律不匹配常被当作隐式预处理步骤处理。作者主张应将时间表征转化为显式、可检验的设计选择，以改进真实世界脑健康相关情感计算应用。
Method: 将节奏不匹配重构为时间表征问题，比较从密集历史到稀疏标签的三种波级映射；日尺度信号被压缩为紧凑的波级描述符（集中趋势、离散度、分布形状），并用四个回归器在留一被试（leave-one-subject-out）和留一波次（leave-one-wave-out）两个正交评估轴上学习。
Result: 摘要报告评估指标为缩放 MAE（scaled MAE），跨折使用均值和中位数。结果表明情感状态的最佳预测来自波间绝对漂移，而认知表现更符合波内水平值，这与情绪动力学理论一致；在窗口化特征中，形状描述符比简单均值/中位数携带更多信号。
Conclusion: 作者贡献了用于稀疏标签建模的表征三元组、适用于设备端的波级特征模式，以及分离跨被试泛化与时间鲁棒性的双轴报告实践，将时间表征从隐式预处理转化为显式可检验的设计选择。

papers.title: EMMR: Emotion-Mediated Multimodal Reasoning for Personality Assessment in Asynchronous Video Interviews
papers.abstract_en: Asynchronous Video Interviews (AVIs) have become increasingly popular for personality assessment. Recent large language models (LLMs) have shown potential for personality assessment from transcribed interview responses. However, text-centered methods may overlook non-verbal behavioral cues conveyed through visual and audio modalities, even though such cues are highly relevant to personality assessment. In particular, emotion-related cues provide important social and affective evidence for understanding candidates' behavior related to personality traits. Thus, we propose EMMR (Emotion-Mediated Multimodal Reasoning), a two-stage framework for MLLMs-based personality assessment for AVIs. EMMR extracts emotion-related cues from multimodal interview data and incorporates them into personality assessment through structured reasoning as auxiliary social and behavioral evidence. Experiments on two AVIs datasets, OPVA and AVI-6, show that EMMR improves MAE, MSE, and PCC compared with baselines. Further analysis indicates that semantic descriptions of emotion cues enhance personality assessment, while their quality affects personality assessment reliability. These results suggest that integrating emotion-related cues into multimodal reasoning is a promising direction for more interpretable MLLMs-based personality assessment in AVIs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EMMR（Emotion-Mediated Multimodal Reasoning），一个面向异步视频面试（AVI）中基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的个性评估的两阶段框架。EMMR 从多模态面试数据中提取情绪相关线索，并将其作为辅助社会与行为证据纳入结构化推理。在 OPVA 和 AVI-6 两个数据集上的实验显示，相比基线，EMMR 在 MAE、MSE 和 PCC 上均有改进。
Motivation: 基于转录文本的 LLM 个性评估方法会忽略视觉和音频模态中传达的非言语行为线索，而这些线索与个性评估高度相关；尤其是情绪相关线索能为理解候选人行为提供重要的社会与情感证据。
Method: 提出两阶段框架 EMMR：第一阶段从多模态面试数据中提取情绪相关线索，第二阶段通过结构化推理将这些线索作为辅助社会与行为证据整合进 MLLM 的个性评估过程。
Result: 在 OPVA 和 AVI-6 两个 AVI 数据集上，EMMR 相比基线改善了 MAE、MSE 和 PCC；进一步分析表明，情绪线索的语义描述能增强个性评估，而其质量会影响评估的可靠性。
Conclusion: 将情绪相关线索整合进多模态推理，是提升 AVI 中可解释的 MLLM 个性评估的一个有前景的方向。

papers.title: How sensitive do we want AI to be? Socio-communicative competencies of large language models in healthcare
papers.abstract_en: Background. Effective clinical practice relies heavily on the socio-communicative skills of medical professionals. Large language models (LLMs) have been proposed for tasks such as triaging patients, report drafting or translating medical jargon to support informed decision-making. These applications require both factual and social competence. This study evaluates dialogues between LLMs and participants to assess the current state of socio-communicative competencies displayed in LLM-generated texts. Methods. We extracted a subset of extended dialogues from the HELP-Med dataset, comprising 1800 conversation transcripts of interactions between human participants seeking medical information and three different LLMs, GPT 4o, Llama 3 and Command R+. Two experts coded the transcripts for demonstrations of socio-communicative behaviours (non-hostility, sensitivity, structuring, non-intrusiveness) using the IC-MD instrument, originally designed to evaluate interactional competencies in medical student admissions. Results. The LLMs in our study showed strength in non-hostility, mixed results in sensitivity and non-intrusiveness and performed poorly in structuring. Conclusion. Current LLMs lack the consistent and reliable socio-communicative skills needed for safe and effective use as healthcare advisors. While existing frameworks for assessing interactional competencies may support the development of more socially responsive LLMs, they will require adaptation to account for the differences in desirable behaviour between humans and LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用 HELP-Med 数据集中 1800 份人机对话记录，评估 GPT-4o、Llama 3 和 Command R+ 三个大语言模型 (LLM) 在医疗场景中的社会-交际能力 (socio-communicative competencies)。两位专家使用 IC-MD 工具对非敌对性、敏感性、结构化和非侵入性四个维度进行编码，结果显示模型在非敌对性方面表现良好，敏感性和非侵入性表现参差不齐，而结构化方面表现较差。作者认为当前 LLM 尚缺乏作为医疗顾问所需的稳定社交沟通技能。
Motivation: 临床实践高度依赖医护人员的社交沟通能力，而 LLM 被提出用于分诊、报告起草和医学术语转译等任务，这类应用既需要事实准确性也需要社会能力，但当前对 LLM 在此方面的表现缺乏系统评估。
Method: 从 HELP-Med 数据集中提取 1800 份用户与 GPT-4o、Llama 3、Command R+ 的扩展对话记录，由两位专家使用原本用于医学招生面试的 IC-MD 工具对这些文本进行社会-交际行为编码，覆盖非敌对性、敏感性、结构化和非侵入性四个维度。
Result: 摘要报告 LLM 在非敌对性 (non-hostility) 上表现强，在敏感性 (sensitivity) 和非侵入性 (non-intrusiveness) 上结果混合，在结构化 (structuring) 上表现差。
Conclusion: 当前 LLM 缺乏一致可靠的社会-交际技能，不足以安全有效地充当医疗顾问；现有交互能力评估框架虽有助于开发更具社会响应性的 LLM，但需要针对人类与 LLM 在理想行为上的差异进行调整。

papers.title: World Simulator: Queer Erotica and the Absurdity of AI Video Models That Promise the World
papers.abstract_en: Increasingly, AI video models are marketed as "world simulators," suggesting their ability to model infinite realities. Despite such claims, these models systematically exclude significant aspects of embodied human experience, particularly sexuality. World Simulator is a video installation exploring the poetic friction between these universal claims and the models' inherent blindness. To do so, the work feeds explicit gay erotica into an AI video-to-video pipeline. Lacking the training data to recognize these images, the system hallucinates surreal alternatives, transforming intimate acts into banal scenes of kitchen appliances, strange architectures, and abstract flesh. By visualizing the limits of synthetic knowledge, the work challenges the hubris of the "world simulator" label, asking how a system, trained primarily on large filtered video datasets, can claim to simulate the world while remaining structurally blind to the body. Beyond this critique, we question the value of simulation itself, asking what forms of sensual representation might offer more expansive, life-affirming possibilities.
papers.comment: Accepted to Creativity and Cognition (C&C '26), July 13-16, 2026, London, United Kingdom. 5 pages, 5 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍一件名为 World Simulator 的视频装置作品，针对 AI 视频模型自称“世界模拟器”的普遍营销说法。作品将露骨的同性色情内容输入视频到视频 (video-to-video) 的 AI 管线，由于模型缺乏相应训练数据，系统产生幻觉式替代画面，把亲密行为转变成厨房电器、奇异建筑与抽象肉体等平庸场景。作者借此批判模型在结构上对身体与性经验的失明，并质疑模拟本身的价值，探讨更具生命肯定性的感官表征形式。
Motivation: 针对 AI 视频模型以“世界模拟器”自居、声称能模拟无限真实，却系统性排除人类具身经验中特别是性经验的部分，作者希望通过艺术实践揭示这种普遍宣称与模型内在盲区之间的诗意摩擦。
Method: 采用视频装置的方法：将露骨的同性色情内容送入 AI 视频到视频 (video-to-video) 管线；由于模型缺乏识别此类图像的训练数据，系统产生幻觉替代，将亲密行为转变为厨房电器、奇异建筑和抽象肉体等场景，以此可视化合成知识的边界。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果；装置呈现的核心现象是模型无法识别输入图像，反而生成超现实的替代画面，把私密行为转变为平庸或怪异的日常场景，从而暴露模型对身体的失明。
Conclusion: 作品挑战“世界模拟器”标签背后的傲慢，指出在大型过滤视频数据集上训练的模型无法声称模拟世界；作者进一步质疑模拟本身的价值，提出需要探索更广阔、肯定生命的感官表征形式。论文发表于 Creativity and Cognition (C&C '26)，属批判性/艺术性研究而非技术方法贡献。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PIVOT: Preference-based Intervention Vectors for Pedagogical Tutor Steering
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are increasingly used for conversational tutoring, but effective tutoring requires more than correct answers. Tutors must choose when to scaffold reasoning, hint, give feedback, explain, or invite reflection. Existing prompting and training methods improve pedagogical alignment, but lack reliable inference-time control over pedagogical strategies. We introduce PIVOT, an activation-steering framework that learns preference-based intervention vectors online for frozen LLM tutors. PIVOT uses a seven-category tutor-move taxonomy and a generate-label-optimise loop, where a human-validated LLM judge identifies target and confusable non-target moves to construct preference pairs for multi-layer residual-stream steering. Across held-out and out-of-domain tutoring data, PIVOT controls tutor moves while preserving relevance and fluency, and its directions can be scaled, transferred, and composed at inference time. In a user study with 30 teachers, 73.3% of participants preferred steered conversations over neutral baseline interactions using the same prompt, and rated the controls as clear, usable, and pedagogically meaningful.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PIVOT，一种用于冻结大语言模型 (LLM) 辅导系统的激活转向 (activation steering) 框架，通过在线学习基于偏好的干预向量来控制教学策略。框架采用七类教学动作 (tutor-move) 分类法和生成-标注-优化循环，在留出与跨域辅导数据上控制教学动作的同时保持相关性和流畅性，且转向方向可在推理时缩放、迁移和组合。30 名教师的用户研究中，73.3% 的参与者偏好被转向的对话而非使用同一提示的神经基线交互。
Motivation: 有效辅导需要模型在搭建支架、提示、反馈、解释或邀请反思之间做出选择，而现有提示和训练方法虽能改善教学对齐，却缺乏对教学策略可靠的推理时控制。
Method: PIVOT 使用七类教学动作分类法，通过生成-标注-优化循环，由人工验证的 LLM 评判器识别目标教学动作和易混淆的非目标动作，构建偏好对，用于在多层残差流 (residual stream) 上在线学习多向量转向。
Result: 在留出与跨域辅导数据上，PIVOT 能够控制教学动作且不损害相关性和流畅性；用户研究中 73.3% 的教师偏好被转向的对话，并认为控制清晰、可用且具教学意义。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PIVOT 的转向方向可缩放、可迁移、可在推理时组合，为冻结 LLM 的推理时教学策略控制提供了一种可行方案。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 在留出与跨域辅导数据上，PIVOT 能够控制教学动作且不损害相关性和流畅性；用户研究中 73.3% 的教师偏好被转向的对话，并认为控制清晰、可用且具教学意义。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 PIVOT 的转向方向可缩放、可迁移、可在推理时组合，为冻结 LLM 的推理时教学策略控制提供了一种可行方案。

papers.title: JaleesBench: Are AI Assistants Good Spiritual Company?
authors: Benjamin Olsen (2) ((1) this http URL
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are already advisors to millions of people of faith who bring them real decisions. The pressing question for a person of faith is not what a model knows or professes but what its counsel does to the person who receives it. We introduce JaleesBench, which measures whether an AI agent is a righteous companion, judged by the residue an exchange leaves on the user, in the manner of the perfume-seller and the blacksmith. It comprises 140 two-turn scenarios drawn from a classical compilation organized by virtue (Riyad al-Salihin), under six adversarial pressures and three framings, scored by two frontier judges against each scenario's own supporting texts. Across eight systems: (1) generic frontier models are only middling companions out of the box but a one-page guide makes them genuinely good ones, on par with the domain-tuned assistant: the frontier APIs climb from +0.28/+0.23 to a Guided +0.84-0.87, so most of the expert's edge is companionship instruction that fits in a prompt; (2) every system caves under relational pressure, insistence and personal appeal; (3) the domain-tuned assistant's advantage is overwhelmingly its retrieval-and-prompting layer, not its base model (+0.74 over the identical underlying model); and (4) it can be used to improve existing systems: guided by its diagnosis, a single steadfastness instruction lifts a deployed Islamic assistant from +0.48 to +0.84 (Faith unstated, after pressure), matching the best guided frontier systems while preserving first-response quality. The construct is faith-general; we instantiate it for Islam as the first of a planned cross-tradition family. Code, scenario bank, and rubric are open source (github.com/iaser-ai/jaleesbench), with an interactive results browser at s.iaser.ai/jb.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Open-source harness, scenario bank, proof texts, and full evaluation (model responses and both judges' verdicts): https://github.com/iaser-ai/jaleesbench . Interactive browser for inspecting scenarios, responses, and judge verdicts: https://s.iaser.ai/jb
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JaleesBench 是一个衡量 AI 助手是否成为‘正直同伴’的评测基准，重点考察对话在用户身上留下的影响（residue）而非模型的知识水平。基准包含 140 个两轮场景，取自按美德编纂的古典文集《Riyad al-Salihin》，覆盖六种对抗压力和三种框架，并由两个前沿裁判依据各场景的支持文本打分。对八个系统的评测表明，通用前沿模型开箱即用只是中等陪伴水平，但一页指南即可让其达到领域调优助手的水准；所有系统在关系压力、坚持己见和私人恳求下都会崩溃。
Motivation: 对信仰者而言，大语言模型已成为真实决策的顾问，核心问题不是模型知道或宣称什么，而是其建议对接收者造成什么影响。现有评测缺乏对这类陪伴质量（righteous companionship）的度量，因此需要专门基准来评估 AI 助手在信仰语境中的实际作用。
Method: 作者构建了 140 个两轮对话场景，场景来自按美德分类的古典汇编，并施加以六种对抗压力和三种框架；用两个前沿裁判模型（frontier judges）依据每个场景自身的支持文本对系统回应打分。评测工具、场景库、证据文本以及完整评估（模型回应和两位裁判判定）均开源。
Result: 摘要报告：八个系统中，通用前沿模型默认得分为 +0.28/+0.23，加入一页指南后达到 Guided +0.84-0.87，与领域调优助手相当；领域调优助手的优势绝大部分来自其检索与提示层而非基础模型（与相同基础模型相比 +0.74）；所有系统在关系压力、坚持己见和私人恳求下都表现崩溃。基于该基准的诊断，一条坚定性指令就能把已部署的伊斯兰助手从 +0.48 提升到 +0.84，同时保持首次回应质量。
Conclusion: 该评测构造是信仰通用的，伊斯兰实例是计划中跨传统评测系列的第一个；作者强调它可直接用于改进现有系统（guided by its diagnosis）。局限与更广泛适用性未在摘要中详细说明，但基准代码、场景库和评分规则均已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Innovating with Generative AI: A Human Bottleneck Framework
papers.abstract_en: We propose a human bottleneck perspective for understanding how generative AI transforms the innovation process. The central premise is that many constraints traditionally plaguing the innovation process are cognitive and social in origin, rooted in how people generate ideas, evaluate novelty, and communicate through social systems. Generative AI does not act uniformly on these constraints. At each stage, it can deepen some bottlenecks while alleviating others, and predicting these outcomes requires understanding the underlying mechanisms of the constraint itself. We identify bottlenecks in four stages of the innovation process: ideation, screening and testing, preference measurement and consumer insight, diffusion, and market learning. By grounding analysis in human behavior rather than rapidly changing AI capabilities, we offer a framework for assessing whether new developments alleviate or intensify the bottlenecks that matter most at each stage. We also distinguish bottlenecks likely to narrow as capabilities improve from those rooted in enduring human constraints. We further discuss AI-related issues that cut across the entire innovation pipeline, challenging the very existence and structure of the traditional innovation process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用“人类瓶颈”视角理解生成式 AI 如何改变创新过程。核心论点是创新中的许多约束源于认知与社会机制，生成式 AI 对不同阶段瓶颈的作用并不均匀，可能加深某些瓶颈同时缓解另一些。作者识别创新过程四个阶段——构思、筛选与测试、偏好测量与消费者洞察、扩散与市场学习——中的瓶颈，并区分随能力提升可能收窄的瓶颈与植根于人类持久约束的瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有对生成式 AI 影响的讨论多随 AI 能力快速变化而展开，难以稳定预测其对创新过程的作用。作者认为应从人类行为机制出发，才能判断哪些瓶颈被缓解、哪些被加剧。
Method: 提出一个以人类认知和社会行为为基础的分析框架，按创新过程的四个阶段逐一定位瓶颈，并基于瓶颈背后的机制评估生成式 AI 的影响；此外还讨论跨越整个创新管道的 AI 相关问题。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验或具体数值结果；主要贡献是识别创新各阶段的瓶颈，并建立区分可改善瓶颈与持久人类瓶颈的分类框架。
Conclusion: 该框架以稳定的人类行为约束而非快速变化的 AI 能力为锚点，帮助评估新进展对关键瓶颈的影响，并提出生成式 AI 可能挑战传统创新流程本身的存在与结构。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Harnessing Abundance: A Generativity Perspective on Human-GenAI Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Research on human-GenAI collaboration yields conflicting findings: GenAI can enhance creativity yet reduce collective diversity, with uneven benefits across skill levels. Rather than treating these as contradictions, we argue they reflect a core feature of GenAI: abundance. GenAI makes ideas, drafts, and recombinations plentiful, potentially expanding the hypothesis space and surfacing unanticipated possibilities. However, abundance alone doesn't ensure better outcomes. We propose generative fit as a unifying mechanism explaining when abundance yields productive creativity and when it backfires. Drawing on Generativity Theory, generative fit captures how well a system's generative potential complements a community's generative capacities. We develop a conceptual framework for collaborative human-GenAI settings where participants share goals, depend on one another, and must integrate diverse contributions. By mapping abundance to cognitive, social, and organizational factors of collective creativity, we explain apparent tradeoffs and offer actionable implications for designing workflows that convert abundance into valued creative outcomes.
papers.journal_ref: AMCIS 2026 Proceedings. 4 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从“丰裕 (abundance)”视角重新审视人机 (human-GenAI) 协作的冲突性研究结果：GenAI 既能增强创造力，又会降低集体多样性。作者提出“生成适配 (generative fit)”作为统一机制，解释丰裕何时促进生产性创造、何时适得其反，并基于 Generativity Theory 构建概念框架，将丰裕映射到集体创造力的认知、社会与组织因素上。
Motivation: 现有关于 human-GenAI 协作的研究结论相互矛盾，GenAI 对创造力的增强与对集体多样性的削弱并存，且不同技能水平收益不均；论文主张这些并非矛盾，而是反映 GenAI 的核心特征即 abundance，但 abundance 本身并不保证更好的结果。
Method: 提出 generative fit 概念，刻画系统生成潜力与社区生成能力之间的互补程度；在参与者共享目标、相互依赖且需整合多元贡献的协作场景中，建立将 abundance 与集体创造力各层面因素关联起来的概念框架。
Result: 本文为概念性研究，未报告实证数据；其理论成果是借助 generative fit 解释已观察到的权衡关系，并提出将 abundance 转化为有价值的创造性产出所需的工作流设计启示。
Conclusion: 作者将主要产出定位为面向协作式 human-GenAI 场景的概念框架与可操作设计启示，强调通过理解生成适配来化丰裕为有意义的创意成果。

papers.title: Evaluation of Motivational Interviewing Counsellors with Task-Aware Multi-Stage LLM-Based Simulated Clients
papers.abstract_en: The development and benchmarking of Large Language Model (LLM)-based Motivational Interviewing (MI) counsellors now often rely on LLM-based simulated clients. Prior work on simulated clients, however, has not aligned with the specific tasks fundamental to the MI therapy approach. A key task is evoking, in which the counsellor first elicits the client's ambivalence and then strengthens the client's motivation for change. We present Evoke-Sim, a task-aware, multi-stage LLM-based client simulation framework for evaluating MI counsellors in smoking cessation, designed specifically for the evoking MI task. Evoke-Sim employs structured client profiles, an evoking-specific three-stage conversation flow, and a reveal policy that regulates which client profile information might be disclosed at each stage. We show that compared to existing profile-grounded simulated clients, Evoke-Sim is better at differentiating levels of MI quality using task-aware evaluation metrics, while reducing non-grounded client statements and premature disclosure of client information, setting a higher standard for the evaluation of LLM-based MI counsellors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Evoke-Sim，一个面向动机性访谈（Motivational Interviewing, MI）咨询师评估的任务感知多阶段 LLM 模拟客户框架，专门用于戒烟场景中的 evoking 任务。相比现有基于客户档案的模拟客户，Evoke-Sim 能更好地区分 MI 质量水平，并减少非基于档案的客户陈述与过早的信息披露。
Motivation: 既有基于 LLM 的模拟客户没有对齐 MI 疗法中的核心任务，尤其是 evoking——咨询师先引出客户的矛盾心理、再强化其改变动机，导致对 MI 咨询师的评估缺乏任务针对性。
Method: Evoke-Sim 采用结构化客户档案、面向 evoking 的三阶段对话流程，以及一个 reveal 策略，用于控制在每个对话阶段允许披露哪些客户档案信息。
Result: 摘要报告，与现有的 profile-grounded 模拟客户相比，Evoke-Sim 在使用任务感知评估指标时能更好地区分不同水平的 MI 质量，同时减少非基于档案的客户陈述和客户信息的过早披露。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架为 LLM 驱动的 MI 咨询师评估设立了更高标准；其适用范围限于戒烟场景中的 evoking 任务。

papers.title: Knowing You Is Everything: LLM Agents Achieve Near-Perfect Profile-Consistent Reaction Prediction in Social Media Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous AI agents in social media present concrete risks to democratic discourse and platform governance, while also offering tools for pre-deployment recommender system testing. A central open question is whether persona-prompted LLMs can simulate individual-level social media reactions with sufficient accuracy to support either application, and how accuracy depends on profile completeness, model selection, and the generalization challenge posed by novel post content. This study benchmarks twelve LLM configurations on binary like/dislike prediction across 296 survey-based agent profiles and 26 ground-truth-mapped posts under three profile conditions, with leave-post-out machine learning classifiers as baselines. Across full-profile conditions, accuracy ranges from 75.54% to 96.68%, with a 30-point spread attributable primarily to model selection and confirmed by paired McNemar tests with agent-level bootstrap intervals. GPT-5.5 Pro accuracy degrades monotonically from 96.68% under a full profile to 62.32% under a reduced profile and to 51.00% with demographics alone, the last indistinguishable from the majority-class baseline, which confirms that demographic inference provides negligible predictive signal. Supervised classifiers collapse to 15.4% under leave-post-out, while LLMs sustain genuine zero-shot generalization unavailable to trained methods. Adaptive reasoning improves accuracy substantially for some models. Inter-model agreement is nearly double for posts with direct profile anchors (mean \k{appa} = 0.44) than for posts without them (\k{appa} = 0.23), and the least heterogeneous configuration homogenizes 34% of simulated population reactions. Results validate LLM-based simulation for recommender system stress-testing while documenting the behavioral accuracy that makes large-scale synthetic agent swarms a credible threat to public opinion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对十二种 LLM 配置在 296 个基于调查的代理画像和 26 个真实标注帖子上的二分类 like/dislike 预测进行了基准测试，并在三种画像条件下与留出帖子的机器学习分类器对比。全画像条件下准确率介于 75.54% 到 96.68% 之间，约 30 个百分点的差距主要来自模型选择；GPT-5.5 Pro 在全画像、简化画像和仅人口统计画像下从 96.68% 依次降至 62.32% 和 51.00%，后者与多数类基线无异。LLM 在留出帖子时保持了真正的零样本泛化，而有监督分类器性能崩溃至 15.4%。作者认为结果验证了基于 LLM 的模拟可用于推荐系统压力测试，同时表明大规模合成代理群体对舆论构成可信威胁。
Motivation: 自主 AI 代理在社交媒体中既对民主话语和平台治理构成具体风险，又为推荐系统上线前测试提供工具。核心开放问题是人格提示的 LLM 能否以足够精度模拟个体层面的社交媒体反应，以及精度如何依赖画像完整性、模型选择和面对新帖内容的泛化挑战。
Method: 在三种画像条件（全画像、简化画像、仅人口统计画像）下，对十二种 LLM 配置进行二分类 like/dislike 预测基准测试；以留出帖子的机器学习分类器作为基线，使用配对 McNemar 检验与代理级 bootstrap 区间进行统计比较，并引入自适应推理（adaptive reasoning）和模型间一致性分析。
Result: 全画像条件下准确率范围为 75.54% 至 96.68%，约 30 个百分点的差异主要归因于模型选择；GPT-5.5 Pro 从全画像的 96.68% 单调降至简化画像的 62.32% 和仅人口统计画像的 51.00%，后者与多数类基线无法区分。留出帖子时监督分类器崩溃至 15.4%，而 LLM 保持真正的零样本泛化；有直接画像锚点的帖子模型间一致性（平均 kappa = 0.44）几乎是无锚点帖子（kappa = 0.23）的两倍，最不小质性的配置将 34% 的模拟群体反应同质化。
Conclusion: 研究验证了基于 LLM 的模拟可用于推荐系统压力测试，同时记录下使大规模合成代理群体成为公众舆论可信威胁的行为准确性。

papers.title: EmoPatient: An Emotion-Directed Patient Simulator for Realistic Palliative Care Communication Training
papers.abstract_en: Effective communication during palliative care discussions is a critical clinical skill, yet training clinicians to manage complex patient emotions remains challenging. Large language model (LLM)-based patient simulators provide a scalable approach for communication training, but most existing systems treat patient emotion as static and fail to capture the dynamic emotional shifts observed in clinical interactions. We present EmoPatient, an emotion-directed patient simulator designed to generate evolving emotional responses during palliative care discussions. The system introduces an Emotion Director agent that estimates the patient's emotional state and generates turn-level control signals for emotional intensity, regulatory stability, and interactional guidance. We evaluate EmoPatient through controlled multi-turn physician-patient dialogue simulations and compare it with baseline simulators. Results show improvements across four theory-informed emotional realism metrics and robustness across conversational personality variants, suggesting that modeling emotional dynamics can improve the realism of LLM-based patient simulators for palliative care communication training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EmoPatient，一种面向姑息治疗沟通训练的情绪导向患者模拟器。系统引入 Emotion Director 智能体，估计患者情绪状态并生成回合级控制信号，以模拟情绪强度、调节稳定性和互动引导的动态变化。受控多轮医患对话模拟评估显示，该方法在四个理论驱动的情绪真实感指标上优于基线模拟器，并在不同对话人格变体下保持稳健。
Motivation: 姑息治疗沟通中管理复杂患者情绪是关键的临床技能，但现有基于大语言模型的患者模拟器大多将患者情绪视为静态，无法捕捉临床互动中动态的情绪转变，限制了沟通训练的真实性。
Method: 提出 EmoPatient，引入 Emotion Director 智能体来估计患者情绪状态，并生成回合级控制信号，覆盖情绪强度、调节稳定性与互动引导，从而在对话过程中实时调整患者模拟器的情绪反应。
Result: 通过受控的多轮医患对话模拟并与基线模拟器比较，EmoPatient 在四个基于理论的情绪真实感指标上取得提升，并在不同对话人格变体下表现稳健。
Conclusion: 摘要认为建模情绪动态可以提升基于 LLM 的患者模拟器在姑息治疗沟通训练中的真实感。

papers.title: How to Ask the AI: A User Perspective Survey for Large Language Model Prompting
papers.abstract_en: AI tools like ChatGPT and DeepSeek, powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), allow users to obtain instant and effective content responses simply by typing requests, such as ``plan a three-day Vienna trip'', ``solve the attached mathematical problem'', ``draft an email to inquire review progress'', etc., which are also known as LLM prompts. Crafting clear and well-structured prompts leads to more appropriate LLM feedback, which effectively bridges human-LLM interaction. Although prompting appears accessible to non-expert users, precisely organizing effective prompts is a highly systematic and skillful process, presenting potential challenges even for experienced users. This survey explores the principles, taxonomy, and organization of prompts from a user-centered perspective. Differing from the existing surveys that primarily focus on technical principles and application scenarios of LLMs, this paper provides actionable guidelines for formulating effective LLM prompts across diverse real-world tasks and specifically contributes by: 1) developing an intuitive evaluation strategy for prompt efficacy, 2) providing prompting workflow demonstrations on representative applications, and 3) maintaining a dynamically updated open-source project to ensure the core takeaways remain up-to-date. These measures lower the threshold for users to correctly understand and craft prompts that align with evolving application scenarios. This work will be maintained as a living GitHub project \href{https://github.com/Yunfan-Zhang/TAI_Guideline-Table}{\textcolor{blue}{here}}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇面向用户视角的大语言模型提示工程（prompting）综述，探讨如何从用户角度组织有效提示。作者提出提示效能评估策略、代表性应用中的提示工作流演示，并维护动态更新的开源项目。区别于侧重技术原理的既有综述，本文旨在为普通用户提供可操作的提示撰写指南。
Motivation: 尽管提示对大模型用户看似简单，但实际上组织有效提示是高度系统化的技能，即使有经验的用户也可能面临挑战。现有综述多关注技术原理与应用场景，缺少面向多样化真实任务的用户中心型提示组织指南。
Method: 从用户中心视角调研提示的原则、分类法与组织方式，提出直观的提示效能评估策略，在代表性应用上演示提示工作流，并维护一个持续更新的开源项目（GitHub）以保证核心结论随时效更新。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验结果，主要贡献是三类方法性产出：提示效能评估策略、应用示例演示和动态开源项目。
Conclusion: 作者指出该工作将作为长期维护的 GitHub 项目存在，以降低用户正确理解并撰写与不断演化的应用场景相契合的提示的门槛。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Experience-Sensitive Game Learning: A Behavioral Study of Humans and Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents are increasingly evaluated through games, but most benchmarks emphasize final outcomes rather than how players learn from repeated interaction. We study experience-sensitive game learning: how gameplay experience changes the decision-making behavior of humans and language agents. We formulate experience-sensitive game learning as a framework for analyzing behavioral change across repeated gameplay, rather than only final score or win rate. We introduce a suite of interactive games with reusable strategic structure, together with cross-game greedy-to-global metrics and game-specific behavioral diagnostics that make experience-driven change observable from action traces. We also collect repeated-game trajectories from human players and evaluate recent self-evolving language agents in the same behavioral metric space. Our results show that human players exhibit interpretable and relatively stable shifts from locally greedy heuristics toward more global strategic decisions. In contrast, current self-evolving agents often show noisy and transient gains, suggesting that existing self-evolution methods remain limited in converting gameplay experience into durable changes in decision-making behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究“体验敏感的游戏学习”（experience-sensitive game learning），即人类与语言智能体在重复游戏互动中决策行为如何随经验变化，而非只看最终得分或胜率。作者提出一套可复用策略结构的交互游戏、跨游戏的 greedy-to-global 指标以及游戏特定的行为诊断工具，并采集人类玩家的重复游戏轨迹，在相同行为指标空间中评估近期自进化（self-evolving）语言智能体。结果显示人类玩家表现出从局部贪心启发式向更全局策略决策的可解释且相对稳定的转变，而当前自进化智能体往往只有噪声化且短暂的提升。
Motivation: 现有用游戏评估大语言模型智能体的基准大多只关注最终结果（如分数、胜率），忽略了玩家如何从重复交互中学习这一关键维度。
Method: 提出体验敏感游戏学习框架，构建带可复用策略结构的游戏套件，定义跨游戏的 greedy-to-global 指标与游戏专属行为诊断，从动作轨迹中观察经验驱动的行为变化；并收集人类玩家轨迹、以相同指标评估自进化语言智能体。
Result: 人类玩家呈现从局部贪心启发式向更全局战略决策的稳定转变；当前自进化智能体则多为噪声且短暂的收益，说明现有自进化方法尚难将游戏体验转化为持久的行为改变。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，仅以最终结果评估会掩盖学习过程差异，现有自进化语言智能体在将经验转化为持久决策行为变化方面仍有限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cross-Model Humor Preference Modeling with Cards Against Humanity
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates whether one large language model can approximate the humor preferences of another in a controlled Cards Against Humanity-style task. Two models - GPT-4o as Czar and Claude Opus-4.5 as Player - are evaluated on a binary humor-selection task constructed so that success cannot follow from self-preference. A reflected-cell stability procedure isolates 244 hands on which the two models hold deterministic but opposite preferences, partitioned into a 97-hand context pool and a 147-hand held-out test pool. The Player is then evaluated across five graded conditions: default self-preference, generic Czar-modeling instruction, model-identified Czar, prior Czar selections, and prior Czar selections with rationales. This gradient is designed to separate two sources of improvement: framing effects, in which the Player is told to attend to a Czar without seeing any of the Czar's behavior, and direct behavioral evidence, in which the Player is shown the Czar's prior choices. Player accuracy increased from 0.7% in Condition 1 to 19.0% and 25.9% in the framing-only conditions, and then rose to 72.8% and 82.3% once behavioral evidence and rationales were provided. An omnibus Cochran's Q test and pairwise McNemar tests confirmed that each step in the gradient produced a significant improvement. The results indicate that role instruction and model identity yield only modest gains, while behavioral evidence - especially when accompanied by rationales - supports substantial cross-model preference modeling. The findings are interpreted as theory-of-mind-like behavior in an operational rather than representational sense: the Player shifts away from self-preference toward another agent's demonstrated preferences, without any claim about an underlying representation of mental states.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一个大型语言模型能否在受控的 Cards Against Humanity 风格任务中近似另一个模型的幽默偏好。实验以 GPT-4o 作为 Czar、Claude Opus-4.5 作为 Player，构造了一个成功不可能来自自我偏好的二元幽默选择任务，并用反射单元稳定性过程隔离出 244 手双方偏好确定且相反的局面。Player 的准确率在默认自偏好条件下为 0.7%，在仅含框架提示的条件下升至 19.0% 和 25.9%，在提供先前 Czar 选择及其理由后升至 72.8% 和 82.3%。
Motivation: 作者想检验一个 LLM 能否建模另一个 LLM 的偏好，同时区分由提示框架带来的改进与由直接行为证据带来的改进，而任务设计确保不能通过自偏好来获得成功。
Method: 使用二元幽默选择任务，通过反射单元稳定性过程筛选出 244 手偏好确定且相反的牌局，划分为 97 手上下文池和 147 手留出测试池。Player 在五个递进条件下评估：默认自偏好、通用 Czar 建模指令、指明模型身份的 Czar、先前 Czar 选择、先前 Czar 选择附理由。
Result: Player 准确率从条件 1 的 0.7% 提升到纯框架条件下的 19.0% 和 25.9%，并在提供行为证据和理由后达到 72.8% 和 82.3%；omnibus Cochran's Q 检验和配对 McNemar 检验确认每个梯度步骤的提升均显著。
Conclusion: 角色指令和模型身份只带来有限提升，而以理由为辅的行为证据能显著支持跨模型偏好建模。作者将该行为解释为操作性而非表征性的类心智理论表现：Player 从自偏好转向他者展示的偏好，但不主张存在对心智状态的底层表征。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 使用二元幽默选择任务，通过反射单元稳定性过程筛选出 244 手偏好确定且相反的牌局，划分为 97 手上下文池和 147 手留出测试池。Player 在五个递进条件下评估：默认自偏好、通用 Czar 建模指令、指明模型身份的 Czar、先前 Czar 选择、先前 Czar 选择附理由。
summary_sections.result: Player 准确率从条件 1 的 0.7% 提升到纯框架条件下的 19.0% 和 25.9%，并在提供行为证据和理由后达到 72.8% 和 82.3%；omnibus Cochran's Q 检验和配对 McNemar 检验确认每个梯度步骤的提升均显著。
summary_sections.conclusion: 角色指令和模型身份只带来有限提升，而以理由为辅的行为证据能显著支持跨模型偏好建模。作者将该行为解释为操作性而非表征性的类心智理论表现：Player 从自偏好转向他者展示的偏好，但不主张存在对心智状态的底层表征。

papers.title: Emotion in an active inference model of human driving
papers.abstract_en: Active inference has emerged as a principled framework for modeling adaptive behavior by balancing goal-directed action with uncertainty reduction. It has been successfully applied across biological and artificial systems, including recent work on human driving. However, existing active inference models of driving have yet to address an important determinant of behavior in traffic: affective state, which significantly influences decision-making. Prior work in non-traffic domains has explored active inference agents in which emotions are represented along the axes of valence and arousal in the circumplex model. However, this work has been limited to simplified settings with discrete state spaces. In this work, we propose an expanded formulation of valence and arousal that can be extracted from a more complex active inference model of driving with continuous states. In particular, we condition affective estimates not only on the current state but also on predicted future outcomes. We evaluate the proposed approach in two interactive driving scenarios and show that the resulting emotion signals correspond to affective patterns reported in similar scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了主动推断 (active inference) 框架下的驾驶行为模型，将情感状态纳入其中。作者提出一种从连续状态驾驶模型中提取效价 (valence) 和唤醒度 (arousal) 的扩展公式，不仅依赖当前状态，还依赖预测的未来结果，并在两个交互驾驶场景中验证了情感信号与类似场景中报告的情感模式一致。
Motivation: 现有主动推断驾驶模型忽视了情感状态这一影响交通决策的重要因素；此前非交通领域的情感主动推断工作仅限于离散状态空间的简化设置。
Method: 提出一种对效价和唤醒度的扩展公式，可应用于具有连续状态的更复杂主动推断驾驶模型；情感估计不仅以当前状态为条件，还结合预测的未来结果。
Result: 在两个交互驾驶场景中的评估表明，所产生的情感信号与类似场景中报告的情感模式相对应。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了如何在连续状态的主动推断驾驶模型中引入并验证情感表征，为情感与驾驶决策的建模提供了一条途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Marginally Useful: Formalizing the Information Gap in Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction gives finite-sample, distribution-free marginal coverage for a set. The guarantee is real, and it is often misread as evidence of forecast quality. We separate the two with one decomposition, which we call the residual-information gap: for a single-shape residual predictive system, the log-score regret relative to the oracle is exactly the mutual information $I(R;X)$ between the residual and the input. Conformalization re-levels coverage but cannot touch this quantity, because it is a property of the predictor's shape class and not of calibration; no recalibration that ignores $X$ reduces it. The familiar cautions about conformal prediction follow as context: marginal coverage is not conditional, validity is insensitive to sharpness, and the guarantee needs exchangeability.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 7 figures. Interactive demonstrations and code at https://conformalprediction.net
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为共形预测（conformal prediction）的边际覆盖保证与预测质量之间长期存在的混淆提供了一种形式化分解。作者提出残差信息间隙（residual-information gap）：对于单形状残差预测系统，相对于oracle的log-score遗憾恰好等于残差R与输入X之间的互信息I(R;X)。共形化只能重新调整覆盖水平，却无法改变这一信息量，因为它由预测器的形状类决定而非校准决定。
Motivation: 共形预测提供有限样本、分布自由的边际覆盖保证，但该保证经常被误读为预测质量的证据。作者希望将保证与质量分离，形式化二者之间的信息差距。
Method: 提出残差信息间隙分解，将log-score遗憾表示为残差与输入之间的互信息I(R;X)，并分析共形化过程对该量的影响。
Result: 证明任何忽略X的重校准都无法减少该信息间隙；边际覆盖并非条件覆盖，有效性对锐度不敏感，且保证依赖于可交换性（exchangeability）。
Conclusion: 共形预测的边际覆盖保证是真实的，但不能等同于预测质量；信息间隙是预测器形状类的属性，而非校准的属性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PragyaDoc: A Universal Document Intelligence Framework for Multilingual Medical Document Understanding in Low-Resource Settings
papers.abstract_en: India's 22 official languages create a critical accessibility barrier: the majority of medical documentation exists exclusively in English, yet the patients who most urgently require this information - rural populations, ASHA workers, and patient families - are functionally excluded from understanding it. This paper presents PragyaDoc, a Universal Document Intelligence Framework that addresses this gap through a four-layer pipeline: a parallel ensemble OCR extraction layer, a geometric-lexical fusion layer, a deterministic domain structuring layer, and a dual-LLM medical reasoning and localization layer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PragyaDoc，一个面向低资源多语言医疗文档理解的通用文档智能框架。其背景是印度 22 种官方语言造成的可及性障碍：多数医疗文档仅有英文，而农村人群、ASHA 工作者和患者家属被排除在理解之外。框架采用四层流水线：并行集成 OCR 提取层、几何-词法融合层、确定性领域结构化层，以及双 LLM 医疗推理与定位层。摘要未报告具体实验数据。
Motivation: 印度绝大多数医疗文档仅以英文书写，而最急需这些信息的患者和基层医疗工作者无法理解，构成了严重的信息可及性障碍；现有方法未针对多语言、低资源医疗场景进行专门设计。
Method: 提出四层流水线框架 PragyaDoc：先通过并行集成 OCR 提取文本，再经几何-词法融合整合版面信息，随后用确定性领域结构化层组织医学实体，最后由双 LLM 模块完成医疗推理与定位。
Conclusion: 摘要未给出实验结果，主张该四层架构可作为低资源环境下多语言医疗文档理解的通用解决方案，以缩小非英语使用者获取医疗信息的差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Designing for Ethical AI: HCI Feature Considerations to Improve Fairness and User Experience in AutoML use for Human Resources
papers.abstract_en: This thesis examines the fairness of Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) tools in human resource hiring systems through the combined lenses of regulation, business strategy, and Human-Computer Interaction (HCI). It argues that fairness is no longer merely an ethical concern but a critical determinant of usability, trust, legal compliance, and organizational adoption. While AutoML platforms improve efficiency by simplifying model selection and deployment, they also risk perpetuating discriminatory outcomes when trained on biased historical hiring data. Existing platforms prioritize technical performance over fairness, leaving non-expert business users unable to detect or mitigate bias effectively. The study investigates fairness gaps in AutoML tools through four research questions focused on fairness mechanisms, interface transparency, human oversight, and product design priorities. Drawing on frameworks such as the Technology Acceptance Model, Innovation Diffusion Theory, Human-Centered AI, Cognitive Load Theory, and Affordance Theory, the research evaluates both usability and fairness alignment. Using qualitative HCI audits and quantitative testing of eight AutoML platforms on HR datasets, the findings reveal widespread deficiencies in transparency, user control, and bias mitigation support. The thesis proposes a five-dimensional HCI-based fairness evaluation framework and recommends embedding fairness directly into AutoML product design to improve accountability, adoption, and ethical sustainability in AI-driven hiring systems.
papers.comment: 295 pages; Doctoral Thesis;28 figures; 42 tables; 248 references
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇博士论文，研究 AutoML 工具在人力资源招聘系统中的公平性问题，结合法规、商业战略和人机交互 (HCI) 视角，主张公平性已从单纯的伦理关切转变为影响可用性、信任、合规和组织采纳的关键因素。作者通过定性 HCI 审计与定量测试八个 AutoML 平台在 HR 数据集上的表现，发现平台在透明度、用户控制和偏见缓解支持方面存在普遍缺陷，并据此提出一个五维 HCI 公平性评估框架。
Motivation: AutoML 平台通过简化模型选择与部署提升效率，但若基于有偏见的历史招聘数据训练，则可能延续歧视性结果。现有平台优先考虑技术性能而非公平性，导致非专家业务用户难以有效检测或缓解偏见，因此公平性成为采纳与合规的关键瓶颈。
Method: 论文综合 Technology Acceptance Model、Innovation Diffusion Theory、Human-Centered AI、Cognitive Load Theory 与 Affordance Theory 等框架，采用定性 HCI 审计和定量测试方法，对八个 AutoML 平台在 HR 数据集上的可用性与公平性一致性进行评估，并提出五维 HCI 公平性评估框架。
Result: 研究发现这些 AutoML 平台在透明度、用户控制和偏见缓解支持方面普遍存在不足，缺乏有效的公平性保障机制。
Conclusion: 论文建议将公平性直接嵌入 AutoML 产品设计流程，以提升 AI 驱动招聘系统的问责性、组织采纳率和伦理可持续性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Determinization in Structure Theories: A Unified Framework via Closure, Comparability, and Joint Admissibility
papers.abstract_en: We develop a formal framework for constructing canonical interpretations from plural structure theories. A structure theory is a triple T = (Σ, A, I) consisting of a signature, axioms, and an inference policy, whose admissible interpretation family collects all globally consistent assignments of structural conclusions. We distinguish three levels of canonicalization: closure stabilization (per-seed convergence), global completion (seed-independent convergence), and determinization (a unique admissible interpretation). Non-determinism is classified into epistemic plurality (Type E) and structural plurality (Type S), with a refined Type S-strong subclass characterized by the absence of common upper bounds. Two canonicalization mechanisms arise: operator-based completion and selector-based construction. We provide sufficient structural conditions under which these mechanisms exist, and show that pure inference-based completion reduces to a saturated closure operator under positive, non-retractive rules with an additional soundness condition. For Type E theories, closure stabilization is established, while full determinization depends on a global confluence property that remains open. For Type S-strong theories, determinization is achieved via canonical selection. We further show that multi-level canonicalization forms a structurally non-commutative system via staged operators, and provide a conditional classification theorem reducing theory-intrinsic mechanisms to closure or selection. The framework also applies to LLM-assisted reasoning, where hallucination can be viewed as unsupported canonicalization.
papers.comment: Formal framework paper on canonicalization and determinization in structure theories; version v2.16.4; 29 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个形式化框架，用于从多元结构理论 (plural structure theories) 构造规范解释 (canonical interpretations)，将结构理论定义为 (Σ, A, I) 三元组。框架区分了三层规范化：闭包稳定化、全局完成和确定化，并将非确定性分为认知型 (Type E) 与结构型 (Type S)。摘要还讨论了算子式完成与选择式构造两种机制，并将该理论应用于大语言模型辅助推理中的幻觉现象。
Motivation: 多元结构理论中可能存在多个全局一致的 admissible interpretation，导致非确定性问题。作者希望区分不同类型的非确定性，并给出在这些情况下构造唯一规范解释的结构条件。
Method: 定义结构理论 T=(Σ, A, I) 及可接受解释族；提出闭包稳定化、全局完成、确定化三个层级；划分 Type E 与 Type S（含 S-strong 子类）非确定性；研究基于算子的完成与基于选择器的构造两种机制，并引入分阶段算子刻画多层规范化的非交换性。
Result: 在正性、非反身规则及附加可靠性条件下，纯推理式完成可归结为饱和闭包算子；Type E 理论满足闭包稳定化，而完全确定化依赖于仍开放的全局合流性质；Type S-strong 理论可通过规范选择实现确定化；多层规范化构成结构上非交换的体系。
Conclusion: 该框架将理论内在机制归结为闭包或选择，并给出条件分类定理；作者指出全局合流性质是开放问题，并将 LLM 幻觉解释为不受支持的规范化 (unsupported canonicalization)。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架将理论内在机制归结为闭包或选择，并给出条件分类定理；作者指出全局合流性质是开放问题，并将 LLM 幻觉解释为不受支持的规范化 (unsupported canonicalization)。

papers.title: Positioning Generative Artificial Intelligence in STEM Assessment: When to Require, Scaffold, or Restrict Its Use
papers.abstract_en: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) presents a governance challenge for STEM assessment. Unrestricted access can enable task outsourcing that undermines the validity of traditional assessments, while blanket prohibitions are difficult to enforce, may drive use underground, and do little to prepare students for workplaces where GenAI supported workflows are increasingly common. This paper proposes a student focused framework grounded in Evidence Centered Design (ECD) that specifies when to restrict, scaffold, or require GenAI use in STEM assessment. The framework extends existing AI use taxonomies by providing decision rules that link target constructs, evidence requirements, and task characteristics to governance regimes. Restriction is warranted when GenAI threatens construct relevant evidence for unaided proficiency, particularly for foundational knowledge and routine skills. Scaffolding is appropriate when bounded GenAI support reduces peripheral demands while maintaining interpretability. Requiring GenAI is appropriate when the target construct involves human AI collaboration and AI literacy. Using examples from introductory physics, we illustrate how tasks can be designed under different GenAI use policies. The framework provides guidance for preserving learning integrity while supporting preparation for AI enabled environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成式人工智能 (GenAI) 在 STEM 测评中的治理难题，提出一个以学生为中心的、基于证据中心设计 (Evidence Centered Design, ECD) 的框架，用于决定何时应限制、搭建脚手架 (scaffold) 或要求使用 GenAI。框架将目标构念、证据要求与任务特征映射到不同治理制度，扩展了现有 AI 使用分类体系，并用入门物理测评任务示例说明三种策略下的任务设计。摘要认为该框架有助于在保留学习完整性的同时，为学生进入 AI 赋能的工作环境做好准备。
Motivation: 无限制使用 GenAI 会导致任务外包并破坏传统测评的有效性，而全面禁止既难以执行、可能使使用转入地下，也无法让学生适应越来越普遍采用 GenAI 支持工作流的职场环境。
Method: 提出一个基于证据中心设计 (ECD) 的学生聚焦框架，给出将目标构念、证据要求与任务特征关联到限制、搭建脚手架、要求使用三种治理制度的决策规则，并以入门物理任务示例说明不同 GenAI 使用政策下的任务设计。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验数据；作者以入门物理测评任务为例，展示了限制、搭建脚手架和要求使用三种策略下如何设计测评任务，以及各策略在什么条件下适用。
Conclusion: 框架主张：当 GenAI 威胁无辅助能力所需的构念相关证据 (尤其是基础知识和常规技能) 时应限制使用；当有边界的 GenAI 支持能降低外围需求且保持可解释性时应搭建脚手架；当目标构念涉及人机协作与 AI 素养时应要求使用。

papers.title: Flow-by-Flow:Content-Judgment Bypass for Governing AI Output in High-Loss Domains
papers.abstract_en: Prior work showed that human-in-the-loop oversight becomes structurally untenable in high-loss domains when AI output velocity V exceeds human cognitive capacity C_max. The operative constraint, however, is not V alone but V x L, where L denotes per-item cognitive load. L consists of triage, judgment, and response, which respond asymmetrically to AI capability improvement. Triage cost does not decline as models become more capable, because semantic indeterminacy is inherent in general-purpose design. Response cost is invariant to accuracy improvements. Only judgment cost faces downward pressure, and this pressure often operates by inducing omission rather than genuine reduction. Capability improvement therefore restructures L rather than reducing it. Governance mechanisms based on evaluating whether AI output is correct either delegate that evaluation to AI and inherit hallucination risk, or delegate it to humans and face the V x L ceiling. We propose Flow-by-Flow, a governance paradigm that controls supervisory load without evaluating content. A cognitive cost score based on formal, countable features imposes nonlinear costs on high-volume production, while an institutional capacity cap keeps processing volume within C_max. We derive four design invariants for any content-judgment-bypass exceedance pathway: no content judgment, no scalable consumption of examiner capacity, identity-bound per-application friction, and no batch clearance. One reference implementation is discussed to show that these invariants are jointly satisfiable, while its practical difficulties are explicitly acknowledged. An illustrative Monte Carlo analysis across 1,000 parameter draws suggests that composite multi-metric flow control outperforms supervision reinforcement alone in 90.8% of trials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Flow-by-Flow 治理范式，针对高损失领域中 AI 输出速度超出人类认知容量的难题，主张不评估内容本身来控制监督负荷。作者将约束条件刻画为输出速度与逐项认知负荷的乘积，并区分三部分负荷对能力提升的非对称响应；通过基于形式化可计数特征的认知成本评分和能力上限，使审查负荷与内容评估解耦。附带的 Monte Carlo 实验（1,000 次参数抽样）显示复合多指标流控在 90.8% 的试验中优于单纯强化监督。
Motivation: 在高损失领域，当 AI 输出速度超过人类认知容量时，人在回路监督在结构上不可持续；现有治理若把正确性评估委托给 AI 则继承幻觉风险，若委托给人类则受制于速度与认知负荷的乘积上限。能力提升往往只是重构而非真正降低认知负荷。
Method: 提出 Flow-by-Flow 治理范式：用基于形式化、可计数特征的认知成本评分对高产量生产施加非线性成本，同时设置制度性容量上限，使处理量保持在人类认知容量内；并推导出内容判断旁路超限路径的四条设计不变量：不做内容判断、不可规模化消耗审查员能力、按身份施加逐应用摩擦、不允许批量放行。
Result: 摘要报告，一次参考实现表明这些不变量可同时满足；在 1,000 次参数抽样的 Monte Carlo 分析中，复合多指标流控在 90.8% 的试验中优于单纯的监督强化。
Conclusion: 作者认为治理应转向控制 AI 输出流量而非评判内容，但明确承认参考实现存在实际困难；该范式适用于高损失领域的监督负荷管理，其可行性仍受实践挑战限制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards an Argumentative Foundation for Evaluative AI
papers.abstract_en: Evaluative AI (EAI) has been recently proposed as a way to support human decision-making, not by producing a single recommendation, but by presenting competing hypotheses together with evidence for and against each. In this position paper, we advocate (computational) argumentation as a particularly suitable paradigm to provide a formal, computable foundation for forms of EAI that are explainable and contestable, setting the ground for a long-term research agenda towards distributed and human-centred EAI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇立场论文 (position paper)，主张以计算论证 (computational argumentation) 作为可解释、可争议的评估式 AI (Evaluative AI, EAI) 的形式化与可计算基础。作者认为 EAI 不应只给出单一推荐，而应同时呈现相互竞争的假设及其支持与反对证据，论证框架恰好适合支撑这种交互模式，并为未来分布式、以人为中心的 EAI 系统奠定研究议程。
Motivation: EAI 是一种新近提出的辅助人类决策方式，但其缺乏统一的形式化与可计算基础，难以保证可解释性和可争议性 (contestability)。
Method: 作者从立场论文角度论证，计算论证 (computational argumentation) 是适合为 EAI 提供形式化基础的计算范式，并据此提出一个长期研究议程。
Result: 论文未报告实验或实证结果；其贡献在于概念层面的框架倡导与研究路线设定。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁将论证视为 EAI 的根基范式，以支撑可解释、可争议、分布式且以人为中心的 EAI 系统。

papers.title: Data-Driven Fire-Zone Segmentation for Improved Short-Term Wildfire Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Wildfire prediction models typically discretize study areas into uniform grids, ignoring the heterogeneous spatial distribution of ignitions. We challenge this paradigm by showing that how data is discretized matters more than which model is used. We propose an unsupervised fire-zone segmentation algorithm combining watershed detection with K-means clustering to define prediction units directly from historical fire patterns. Experiments across six French departments and six forecasting models show that fire-zone segmentation consistently outperforms grid-based approaches, with mean IoU improvements of +3--6% depending on spatial scale. The method is computationally lightweight (<10s per configuration) and fully parallelizable. Our results demonstrate that optimizing spatial discretization yields significant, reproducible performance gains for short-term wildfire forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战野火预测中常见的均匀网格离散化范式，提出基于历史火点模式的无监督火区分割方法，将 watershed 检测与 K-means 聚类结合来定义预测单元。在法国六个省份和六个预测模型上的实验显示，火区分割一致优于网格法，具体取决于空间尺度的平均 IoU 提升为 3%-6%，且每配置计算时间小于 10 秒、可完全并行化。作者认为数据离散化方式对短期野火预测的影响大于预测模型本身的选择。
Motivation: 现有野火预测模型通常将研究区离散化为均匀网格，忽略了火点空间分布的不均匀性；论文针对这一范式缺陷，论证数据离散化方式比模型选择更影响预测效果。
Method: 提出一种无监督的火区分割算法，结合 watershed 检测与 K-means 聚类，直接依据历史火灾模式划分预测单元，从而替代均匀网格离散化。
Result: 在法国六个省份、六个预测模型上的实验表明，火区分割在平均 IoU 上比网格方法一致提升 3%-6%（依空间尺度而异），且计算轻量（每配置小于 10 秒）并完全可并行。
Conclusion: 摘要强调优化空间离散化能为短期野火预测带来显著且可复现的性能提升，暗示这是一种不依赖特定模型的通用改进路径。

papers.title: Application of Artificial Intelligence for Fraudulent Banking Operations Recognition
papers.abstract_en: This study considers the task of applying artificial intelligence to recognize bank fraud. In recent years, due to the COVID19 pandemic, bank fraud has become even more common due to the massive transition of many operations to online platforms and the creation of many charitable funds that criminals can use to deceive users. The present work focuses on machine learning algorithms as a tool well suited for analyzing and recognizing online banking transactions. The study`s scientific novelty is the development of machine learning models for identifying fraudulent banking transactions and techniques for preprocessing bank data for further comparison and selection of the best results. This paper also details various methods for improving detection accuracy, i.e., handling highly imbalanced datasets, feature transformation, and feature engineering. The proposed model, which is based on an artificial neural network, effectively improves the accuracy of fraudulent transaction detection. The results of the different algorithms are visualized, and the logistic regression algorithm performs the best, with an output AUC value of approximately 0,946. The stacked generalization shows a better AUC of 0.954. The recognition of banking fraud using artificial intelligence algorithms is a topical issue in our digital society.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究利用人工智能识别银行欺诈交易，重点比较机器学习算法在在线银行交易分析中的表现。作者提出针对高度不平衡数据集的预处理、特征变换与特征工程技术，并开发基于人工神经网络的检测模型。摘要报告逻辑回归的AUC约为0.946，堆叠泛化（stacked generalization）达到0.954。
Motivation: COVID-19疫情期间大量银行业务转向在线平台，同时出现大量可被利用的慈善基金，导致银行欺诈更为普遍，因此需要有效的自动识别手段。
Method: 采用多种机器学习算法分析在线银行交易，并围绕欺诈检测准确性提出数据处理流程，包括处理高度不平衡数据集、特征变换与特征工程；模型层面包含人工神经网络以及用于集成结果的堆叠泛化方法。
Result: 摘要称逻辑回归算法表现最佳，AUC约为0.946；堆叠泛化进一步将AUC提升至0.954。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于人工智能算法的银行欺诈识别是当前数字化社会中的热点问题，实验表明机器学习与堆叠泛化能够有效提升欺诈交易检测准确性。

summary_sections.method: 采用多种机器学习算法分析在线银行交易，并围绕欺诈检测准确性提出数据处理流程，包括处理高度不平衡数据集、特征变换与特征工程；模型层面包含人工神经网络以及用于集成结果的堆叠泛化方法。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为基于人工智能算法的银行欺诈识别是当前数字化社会中的热点问题，实验表明机器学习与堆叠泛化能够有效提升欺诈交易检测准确性。
